“The ice here is showing signs of melting.”Aisha looked at the ice cave around her. Her eyes slightly flashed with light and a trace of gentleness. She softly said, “It’s time for us to leave.”
Dudian looked at her: “Are You Ready?”
“Yes.”Aisha nodded slightly.
Dudian bent down and picked up the armor: “Let’s go. I will lead the way.”
Aisha looked at the two rats in the corner. After five days of growth, the size of the two rats had increased by half. They had been fed with the shells and brains of the giant prawns which allowed them to evolve rapidly, now they could be considered as two rat kings.
After five days of interaction, the two rats were no longer afraid of Dean and Aisha. When they saw Aisha looking at them, they immediately squeaked as if to warn her.
Dean smiled. This little thing saw that they didn’t kill them. It was getting more and more greedy. He said to aisha: “Should we roast them and eat them?”
Aisha looked at the two rats and shook her head: “Forget it, keep them.”
“Alright.”Dean said to the two rats: “Little Guys, you are lucky.”He held the dagger and put the remaining saltpeter, gauze, antidote powder and other belongings into his backpack, then he picked up the two shadow hunter eggs and dived into the water.
Aisha followed him to the entrance of the water hole. She suddenly stopped and turned to look at the ice hole. Her eyes flickered slightly, and she slowly withdrew her gaze and dived into the water.
In the blink of an eye, Dean and Aisha came to the pool in the square one after another and broke out of the water.
Dean’s wings stretched out from the gap cut by the dagger behind the armor. He stood in the air and scanned the surroundings. He didn’t see any heat source, so he was slightly relieved. He knew that from the moment he left the ice hole.., it meant that danger would appear at any time.
Whoosh!
Aisha jumped out of the water. Her feet stepped on the water as if she could borrow strength. She jumped to the square on the shore and wrung her wet hair dry. She threw it behind her and said to dudian, “Let’s go.”
Dudian nodded and landed. He folded his wings and said to Aisha, “Why don’t we go to the Shadow Hunter’s Cave First?”
“Yes.”Aisha nodded.
Dean immediately held the two eggs and led the way.
The two shadow hunter eggs had not made any movements for five days in the low body temperature of the ice cave. If they wanted to hatch, they would most likely need to be in the same high temperature environment as the underground nest.
He walked along the street and headed to the mountain where the Shadow Hunter’s Cave was located.
The road was littered with skeletons and moss-covered, car-like objects, collapsed buildings and rubble tangled in vines. The road was barren and cracked.

chapters.title: Chapter 573
chapters.content:
Chapter 573
Dudian found a familiar feeling from the desolate building. He walked along the edge of the street. The ground was filled with the bones of monsters that had been dead for many years. There were huge footprints covered in wet moss. The soil had been baptized by too many monsters during the three hundred years of the disaster, it was already very muddy.
After walking for four or five miles, aisha suddenly said, “Change the route. There are monsters ahead.”
“Okay.”Dean immediately changed the route. Although Aisha’s wounds had only healed and her strength had not recovered, but the sensory ability of her body organs was not comparable to his.
After taking a long detour, the two continued to move forward.
Along the way, Aisha reminded him that Dean did not encounter any dangerous high-level monsters. As for the common undeads and small monsters, he could easily kill them. There was no need to avoid them.
Half an hour later, the two arrived in front of the Shadow Hunter Cave.
“Has anyone been here?”Dudian saw the footprints in front of the cave. His face slightly changed. He carefully looked at the footprints and found that the number of footprints was messy. From the depth of the footprints, there were seven people in total!
This was the number of people in a dragon team!
“It’s the footprints of the Dragon Guard.”Aisha looked into the cave, “I guess they came with me to find Parna’s exploration team. They found this place and asked the Dragon Guard to transplant the eggs inside. Let’s go in and take a look.”
“Dragon Guard?”Dean was surprised, “How do you know?”
“I know the patterns on the soles of the boots.”Haisha said as she walked into the cave.
Dudian didn’t expect that the patterns on the soles of the boots would become her means of identification. He felt that he had learned another trick.
After entering the cave, Dudian noticed that the footprints went deep into the cave. He couldn’t help but feel a bit regretful. He thought that he would be able to steal a few eggs for collection. But now it seemed that all of them had been handed over.
“This time we have so many eggs of legendary monsters. Should the Dragon Clan be able to cultivate many strong people?”Dudian said: “It shouldn’t be the first time such a thing has happened in the wasteland for so many years. Does that mean that the pioneers of the Dragon Clan are all legendary magic marks?”
Aisha shook her head slightly, “The reason why legendary magic marks are called legendary magic marks is that the number of people with legendary magic marks is extremely rare. It doesn’t mean that they can obtain legendary parasitic soul worms.”
“What do you mean?”Dudian didn’t understand.
“The absorption of legendary parasitic soul worms is different from other parasitic soul worms. The host is easy to be devoured by the soul worms. The host’s consciousness will be taken away and the host will become a worm-man!”Aisha turned to look at him, “You live outside the giant wall and your information is limited. The highest level outside the giant wall is hunter. So you don’t know that there are conditions for magic mark replacement. Not everyone can carry out magic mark replacement.”
Dean was startled. He suddenly remembered that when he had absorbed the splitter’s parasitic soul worm, the parasitic soul worm had drilled into his body and desperately drilled into his head. Fortunately, he had tightly grasped his neck, the parasitic soul worm of the splitter couldn’t find a place to live so it had lodged in the original magic mark nest on his chest.
It seemed that if it had drilled into his brain at that time, he would have most likely become what aisha called “Insect Man”.
Although he didn’t know what insect man looked like, but the name alone made him feel nauseous.
“There are conditions for magic mark replacement?”Dean looked at her with a hint of inquiring attitude. He knew that the information in this world was blocked by layers. It was difficult for his previous identity to get complete information, he might even get false information.
“That’s right.”Aisha said: “You also know that the higher the physique, the more parts of the body become beast. This is caused by magic marks. “When there are too many beast parts, if the magic marks are replaced, the body that has been transformed will find it difficult to accept the new magic marks. It may even conflict with each other and cause unpredictable consequences. The most serious possibility is death!”
“And if you are lucky, your consciousness will collapse and your body will expand, turning into a strange and ugly inhuman bloodthirsty monster.”
“Therefore, if your physique is too high, your magic marks will be fixed and can not be replaced.”Aisha turned to look at Dudian, “You are very lucky to have obtained a legendary magic mark at the hunter stage. Generally speaking, even if you have evolved to the senior hunter stage, the risk of replacing your magic marks is only about 20% . Unless you are especially unlucky, most people will be fine.”
Dean was stunned.
“So, even if there are a lot of eggs from these hunters, they can only be used by the new members of the family who have potential. The magic marks of the people who have long become the frontiersmen and pioneers have already been fixed and can not be used.”
Aisha said, “And the problem is here. The replacement of a legendary magic mark by a hunter-level new member. Although the resistance of the magic marks is less and there is no danger, but the legendary parasitic soul worm itself is very dangerous! “This is not something that ordinary hunters can subdue. Even the elite hunters who are specially trained by the Dragon Clan will be infected by the legendary parasitic soul worm and turn into human insects.”
“So even if we get dozens of legendary eggs this time, it would be good if only one-tenth of them can be branded with a legendary magic mark. Moreover, there are very few people who can survive to the pioneer level.”
Dudian was surprised. He didn’t expect that absorbing legendary magic marks would be so dangerous. Even the elite hunters trained by the Dragon family had such a high failure rate. If it was an ordinary person.., wouldn’t the legendary parasitic soul worm become poison?
“What would happen if it became… an insect?”Dudian asked.
Aisha narrowed her eyes: “It will be disposed of.”
Dudian thought.
Aisha slowed down and walked side by side with Dudian. She looked at him: “I see that you have a lot of scars on your body. Have you experienced a lot of hardships before?”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he thought of the prison, “It’s alright. It’s all in the past. But according to you, I have to thank these trials and temper my willpower. Otherwise, I would have died when I got the splitter’s parasitic soul worm.”
“When we experience pain, we hate pain. After the pain, we thank the pain.”Aisha slowly said.
Dudian looked at her and nodded slightly, “Yes.”
“Here we are.”Aisha briskly took a few steps forward. She came to the front of the cave and looked inside, “Sure enough, there are no traces of the egg pit.”
Dudian squatted by the hole and looked. As Aisha said, the originally stuffy nest was empty. The eggs that were once densely packed in the nest were all gone.
“I guess they have been moved to the stronghold.”Aisha looked at Dean, “It’s a pity that you are already a limiter. Otherwise, with your willpower, replacing the magic marks with the magic marks of the shadow hunter would be a success. You would be able to further deify the magic marks and become a legendary magic mark. Your potential in the future will be second only to mine.”
“In that case, I will recommend you to the family. You will definitely get a lot of resources.”There was a trace of sigh in her eyes.
Dudian’s heart was moved as he heard the words: “You are a legendary deified magic mark?”He almost said the word “Also”.
Aisha nodded, “My magic mark was prepared when I was born. It is the third of the eight legendary monsters. It is the magic mark passed down from generation to generation.”
Dudian was stunned. Passed down from generation to generation? Didn’t that mean that the Dragon Clan had a large number of parasitic soul worms?
Could it be that… the Dragon clan was raising a magic dragon?
However, what surprised him more was that the legendary monster had a ranking.
Aisha seemed to know what Dudian was thinking, she smiled: “There are strong and weak creatures in this world. Even if they are the same type of monster. Legendary monsters are no exception. Shadow Hunter is ranked seventh among the eight legendary monsters. Although his stealth ability is first-class, but if his disguise is seen through, his positive ability is only slightly stronger than rare monsters.”
“What about splitter?”Dudian asked.
Aisha smiled: “Splitter is an ultimate attack type monster. It is ranked fourth. It is a very rare legendary monster.”
Dudian was a bit disappointed but he was comforted as he thought that splitter wasn’t the last one. He suddenly thought of something: “Are the wings and the Rock tribe the same as you? They have legendary magic marks passed down from generation to generation. are their legendary magic marks ranked first and second?”
“Of course not.”Aisha smiled, “It’s true that there are legendary magic marks passed down from generation to generation. Otherwise, once the generations are gone, it would be the same as destruction. “However, their legendary magic marks are far from being comparable to our dragon race. The legendary magic marks passed down from generation to generation of the wings race are ranked fifth among the bat musicians. Therefore, they are also known as the ‘gospel’in the ears of the wall master. They always like to snitch in front of the wall master. They are not promising.”
“The legendary magic marks of the Rock clan are ranked sixth and above the shadow hunter. So your splitter’s magic marks are better than the magic marks of the wing clan and the Rock clan. However, they are deified magic marks. Under the stimulation of deified magic marks, they can make up for the gap of one or two ranks. Especially the magic marks ranked in the top three. The gap is not big.”
Dudian was startled. He didn’t expect that the magic marks of the splitter would be better than the two big families of the three big families. It meant that his growth potential could surpass them!
If he used the new magic then even if they had bloodline power it would be enough to wipe out or even surpass them!
“However, this ranking is not absolute,”Aisha said. “Every legendary monster has its best domain, terrain, and environment, and they will not easily leave the environment they are good at. Once other legendary monsters enter the environment they are good at, they will inevitably fall into a disadvantage, or even be killed. At some times, even the seventh-ranked shadow hunter can kill the splitter and the bat-sounder!”
“However, the actual ranking changes due to other factors have little effect on the top three legendary monsters.”
Aisha whispered: “Although they are known as the eight legendary monsters, but the gap between the top three legendary monsters is bigger than the other. Especially the number one legendary monster, ‘Dreamer’, has almost surpassed the range of legendary monsters. No matter what environment it is in, it can easily kill other legendary monsters. Even a legendary hunter could be killed by it!”
“So Strong?”Dean was surprised.
Aisha nodded slightly, “I heard it from Grandma Dragon. I haven’t seen it with my own eyes. There hasn’t been any trace of ‘Dreamer’for more than a hundred years. The last time it appeared was a hundred years ago. At that time, only footprints were left behind. The saintesses of that generation couldn’t find it, so it didn’t matter. “But we can be sure that no one has the magic marks of ‘Dreamer’. So we should just treat it as a legend and listen to it.”
Dean’s eyes flashed. There was a desire in his heart for power. However, just as Aisha said, it was enough to listen to the story. Let alone ‘Dreamer’, even other legendary monsters were hard to come by.
“Let’s find a place to rest.”Haisha said.
Dudian nodded.
Both of them went out of the cave. Dudian found the place where Ruby had hidden the bag. However, he didn’t see the bag. Instead, he left several footprints in front of the cave. Apparently, the bag of food.., had been taken away by the Dragon Guards.
He bitterly smiled and took Haisha to the desolate neighborhood. He found a relatively shabby building and drilled into it. He used branches and vines to cover the ground as a bed. Aisha’s strength had not recovered yet, so she could only continue to live in the Orange Wasteland.
In the following days, Dean and Aisha went out to hunt together every day. With Aisha’s super strong perception, the two of them did not encounter any high-level monsters. However, this was also related to the scope and time of each hunt, there was no large-scale hunting. Each time they went out, the time was short. After killing the small monsters, they quickly returned to their hiding place.
After eating and drinking in the house, Dudian trained his heart muscle.
Haisha had nothing to do. She taught him a complete set of Dragon’s Thorn chapter, which was the secret skill that Dudian had learned.
In Haisha’s words, it was against the rules to teach Dragon’s blood anyway. She didn’t care about another time.
Time flew. In the blink of an eye, Dudian and Haisha had lived in the orange wasteland for more than half a month. This didn’t include the unknown time when they lived in the ice cave.
“Have you packed everything?”Aisha was alone. She carried the blood-red greatsword on her back. She stood outside the gate of the ruins and turned her head to look at Dean who was tidying up.
Dean put on the washed armor and the bone-eating rat clothes. He put the other sets of clothes that Aisha had sewn from the fur of the monsters that she had captured into his backpack. He turned around and looked at the place where they had lived for half a month, the place was decorated like a cave. He looked back and jumped in front of Aisha: “I’m ready. We can go back.”

chapters.title: Chapter 574
chapters.content:
Chapter 574
Aisha looked at the beast clothes that Dudian had put into his backpack. Her eyes slightly flickered but she didn’t say anything. She waited for Dudian to come to her side and whispered: “Hold on to me. We will fly back.”
“Fly Back?”Dudian said: “Your injury is just right. Is it alright to fly so far?”
“It’s alright.”Aisha raised her hand to hold the blood red giant sword on her back. Her fingers slightly twisted the hilt of the sword. A blood light suddenly splashed out. The blood red giant sword slowly dissolved in the bandage and turned into flowing blood. It adhered to her back, blood gas emerged and gradually outlined a pair of extremely huge wings that flickered with demonic blood light.
Whoosh!
The blood light converged and the wings revealed their true appearance. It was a pair of huge dark red wings. The wings were more than ten meters long and extremely vast. When they stretched out, the sound of wind swept up the sand on the ground and emitted waves of whistling sounds.
Dean’s heart was shocked. Was this the legendary magic weapon? Even the genetic weapons that he knew didn’t seem to have such great power. Moreover, they didn’t connect to her nerves and veins. It was simply incredible that they could change on their own!
“Are You Ready?”Aisha tilted her head and asked Dudian.
Dudian reacted and was about to reach out to grab her. When he stretched out his hand, he suddenly didn’t know where to grab her.
Aisha saw Dean’s embarrassment and was slightly startled. A trace of gentleness appeared in her eyes, but she quickly regained her calm. She reached out and grabbed Dean’s wrist, putting it around her waist, “Take off.”
Whoosh!
Without waiting for Dean’s response, the bloody dark red wings suddenly flapped. The ground seemed to be swept up by a category 10 hurricane. Sand and stones flew, and countless dust flew, haisha and Dudian’s bodies were still flying high in the sky as if they were launched from the ground.
Dudian felt the wind whistling in his ears. The scenery in his sight was quickly pulled away. In the blink of an eye, he had risen from the ground to hundreds of meters high in the sky. Everything on the street was in his sight, he could overlook the scenery of the entire desolate neighborhood.
“So Fast!”Dudian was secretly surprised.
The speed of flight was beyond his reach.
No wonder she was able to climb over the wall of sighs when she was eight or nine years old.
A faint fragrance floated from the tip of his nose. Dudian’s peripheral vision swept over it. His heartbeat was a few times faster. At the moment, the posture of the two was too close. His body was almost completely hanging on Aisha’s body, both of his hands were wrapped around her waist. It felt soft and delicate. Her armor was not made of cold metal, but was made of glue and fiber.
This also made her exquisite figure obvious.
His head was just under her shoulders. His eyes were on her plump chest.
He felt a trace of restlessness in his blood. His heart was beating uncontrollably. But soon, he remembered that the girl he was hugging had saved his life several times. This favor was hard to repay.
The distracting thoughts in his heart suddenly cooled down, and he felt a trace of shame. He turned his eyes to other places and was surprised to find that the desolate street scenery under his feet was like a blurred afterimage, such a speed was simply appalling if he was running on the ground.
Was this her real strength?
Dean’s eyes moved to Aisha’s face above his head, but he saw that her expression was very calm.
Aisha looked ahead and held dean with one hand to prevent him from falling down. At the same time, she was a bit nervous. Since Dean hugged her, the image of the Dark Ice Cave suddenly appeared in her mind, the two of them were hugging each other for warmth.
This image couldn’t be erased from her mind. It appeared repeatedly. She felt her cheeks were hot and red, but thinking that Dean would notice her abnormality, she immediately controlled her heart to change the blood flow, she reduced the blood flow in her face so that her expression remained calm.
At this time, she noticed that Dudian was looking up at her. Her heart tightened and she pretended to casually bow her head: “Is there any discomfort?”
Dudian saw that her expression and tone were very calm. He suddenly felt an inexplicable loss in his heart, a self-deprecating thought appeared in his mind: “Dudian Ah Dudian, you are really too dirty. She is a girl and there is no reaction. How could you think of such a ridiculous thing…”
Thinking of this, his expression returned to calm. He shook his head: “Nothing.”
Aisha noticed the change in Dudian’s expression. There was a trace of doubt in her eyes but she did not ask. She could only remain silent.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The wind whistled past their ears. They were silent as they flew.
The desolate street, the mountains, the swamps in the suburbs and other landscape quickly passed under their feet. It was like an illusion. Only the lead gray clouds above their heads were lingering.
“We are about to enter the Red Wasteland.”Aisha spoke after flying for half an hour.
Dean looked up from the silence. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes. Although he had heard from Ian and the others that the red wasteland and the orange wasteland hadn’t changed much, but at this moment he could feel the difference between them!
In the orange wasteland, the outline of the old era dilapidated buildings could still be seen on the ground. Including the streets and rubble, it could still be seen that this place was once a ruined city.
However, a few kilometers in front of them, there were several holes in the ground that were dozens of meters in diameter. It was like a deep pit created by a meteorite. The surroundings were full of rubble, but there was no shadow of any buildings. All the ruined buildings.., were destroyed into flat ground!
Whoosh!
The Bloody Dragon Wings swept across the sky. Aisha and Dean quickly flew to this messy area. Dean immediately saw that in front of this messy area, the ground was even more dilapidated. There were deep pits everywhere, there were also cracks on the ground. It was rare to see dense trees and dense vines on the ground. It was obvious that something had passed through here for a long time.
It was still a ruined city, but there was no trace of the city. Only the location of the buildings could be vaguely seen from the place where the broken stones were piled up.
Aisha looked down at the front with a trace of solemnity in her eyes.
More than ten minutes after the two entered the Red Wasteland, a dark shadow suddenly jumped out from the gap between the broken stones on the ground, just in time to block the two, as if it had calculated Aisha’s flying speed.
“Roar!”
It was a monster that looked like a spider but had a huge mouth on its back. Its jumping ability was extremely shocking, it actually jumped to a height of two to three hundred meters, and spat out a piece of green spider silk from the huge mouth on its back. It was obviously covered in venom.

chapters.title: Chapter 575
chapters.content:
Chapter 575
“Six-eyed Magic Spider!”Dean was startled by the monster that suddenly jumped up. His face changed when he saw its appearance. It was a level 65 monster, obviously, it had reached the mature stage.
Aisha’s eyes were cold as she suddenly threw out a dagger.
Whoosh!
The dagger was pointed out and its speed was very fast. It directly hit the green spider web that the six-eyed magic spider spat out. The next moment, the green spider web suddenly fell down and pounced on the six-eyed magic spider.
The huge mouth on the six-eyed demon Spider’s Back let out a sharp cry. Its body suddenly flipped over, wanting to dodge, but its speed was too slow. It was instantly covered by the green spider web, and even the dagger hit its back.
Aisha’s body suddenly sank. She raised her leg high, and it was like a whip lashing down.
With a bang, the six-eyed demon Spider’s head was hit by this kick. Its skull instantly caved in, and it fell straight down like a meteorite. With a bang, it fiercely crashed into the rubble on the ground, raising countless clouds of dust.
Aisha glanced at it but didn’t stop. She didn’t want to pick up the dagger and continued to fly forward.
Dudian was shocked. He didn’t expect that she would be able to kill a level 65 monster in the blink of an eye. Although he couldn’t see what was going on inside because of the separation of the dust and fog. But he knew that the fall from two to three hundred meters in the air and the strength of Aisha’s kick would shatter all the bones in his body.
“This six-eyed magic spider should be hungry, so it took the risk to hunt food in the air.”Dudian thought. He had read the information about this six-eyed magic spider in the Advanced Monster Atlas that Ian had given him, it was a kind of amphibious monster that lived mainly on the ground, but it could live for weeks in the water. Moreover, there was a mouth under its abdomen that could spit out the air it inhaled at once as a driving force, it flew high into the air.
However, the role of the driving force was only to fly, but to change the direction freely was very slow. That was why he didn’t Dodge in time when he was reflected by the spider web.
Speaking of the reflection of the spider web, Dean couldn’t help but admire Aisha. In that instant, she could actually think of such a way to hit the tenacious spider web with the handle of the blunt dagger, which led to the counterattack of the spider web, she was able to use the same method to counter Aisha.
“In terms of combat experience and adaptability, the gap between me and Aisha is too big…”Dean secretly thought, he had to seize the time to train his fighting skills. Although he could rely on the new technology to protect himself but he still needed his own strength to defeat the top experts in the inner wall.
Whoosh!
As he continued to fly, Dudian looked down at the red wasteland from the high sky. The ruins on the ground were in a mess. There was very little intact land. Compared to the ruins of the city in the orange wasteland.., this place was completely a wasteland.
After seven or eight minutes, a giant rock suddenly came from the ground and smashed towards Dudian and Haisha.
Aisha flapped her dragon wings and avoided the giant rock which was coming towards them.
Dudian looked at the ground and saw a seven or eight meter tall monster in the shape of an orangutan. Its body was covered with thick black hair. There were a few curved horns on its head and two arms on its back, it was the mighty ape monster which was Level 62.
Whoosh!
Dragon Wings flew across the sky.
In the blink of an eye, the Mighty Ape Demon was left behind until it disappeared.
Dudian felt cold sweat on his forehead. If he had flown earlier, the giant stone would have come so fast that it would have been difficult for him to react and avoid it. As Aisha had said before, flying in the red wasteland was extremely dangerous.
He looked at Aisha and suggested, “Why don’t we fly higher to avoid being attacked by these land monsters?”
Aisha looked up at the dark sky and said, “It’s… more dangerous up there.”
“More dangerous?”
“Above the clouds is where the Thunderbirds Live.”Aisha calmly said, “Thunderbirds usually live in groups. If I attract the attention of the Thunderbirds, even I can only hide.”
Dudian was startled. He couldn’t help but look up at the gray clouds above his head. He felt a chill in his heart. The wilderness outside the giant wall was full of killing intent..
Whoosh!
The strong wind whistled. Aisha’s dragon wings flapped vigorously and flew straight ahead.
Half an hour later, aisha whispered: “In front of us is the edge of the first red wasteland. It is the closest place to the black wasteland. It is also the base camp of our Dragon Clan.”
Dudian followed her line of sight as he looked at the desolate black soil. Soon, he saw a fortress that looked like an ancient city. The ring-shaped city wall was about a hundred meters high, there were a few watchtowers and residential buildings inside the city wall.
“This is… The Dragon Clan’s stronghold.”
Whoosh!
Aisha’s figure blocked the light and flew at high speed. In the blink of an eye, she came to the sky of the fortress and landed like a terrifying shadow.
Around the high walls of the ring-shaped fortress, there were soldiers in strange armor. The armor was engraved with dragon patterns. They were most likely dragon guards.
“Saintess?”The guards were shocked when they saw Aisha. They quickly went forward and bowed, “Greetings, Saintess.”
The news that Aisha was deposed as the SAINTESS had not reached the wasteland yet. Therefore, they still called Aisha as the SAINTESS.
“What about the eight generals?”Haisha put away her dragon wings and said indifferently.
Dudian saw this and immediately put away his hand on her waist and quietly stood by her side.
Haisha’s eyes moved a bit and looked at dudian. There was a trace of gentleness in her eyes, but when she looked at the servant in front of her again, her indifference was restored.
“Saintess, which eight generals are you looking for?”A servant asked.
Aisha squinted her eyes and didn’t say anything. She turned around and walked to the edge of the fortress. She stepped into the air and her body fell down. Her knees slightly bent as she landed on the ground, she landed smoothly and only left two deep footprints on the ground.
She stepped forward.
Dudian followed her and jumped down from the fortress. However he wasn’t as cool as her when he landed. He stepped on the fortress to cushion the impact and then did a somersault in the air.
“Saintess!”
“Greetings, Saintess!”
The soldiers saw Aisha and bowed their heads. At the same time they secretly looked at Dudian who was behind Aisha. There was a flash of understanding in their hearts when they saw the standard armor on Dudian’s body.
It was most likely a lucky person that her highness picked up from the outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 576
chapters.content:
Chapter 576
“All of them are at the level of the limiter.”Dudian observed the heat source reaction of the soldiers through his thermal vision. The result surprised him. He didn’t expect that these ordinary soldiers.., would have such strong power.
Could it be that the most ordinary existence here was the dragon guard?
When Aisha passed by, the soldiers looked up and saw that Dudian was sizing them up. They slightly raised their heads and grinned at him. There was a teasing smile on their faces.
Dudian’s expression remained the same. His eyes swept over their faces.
Aisha walked along the street and passed by buildings.
When she passed by one of the buildings, Dean immediately heard the sound of women crying and some men’s laughter coming from the building. He turned his head and saw that there were many heat reactions in the building. Some of the heat reactions were weak and seemed to be at the level of ordinary primary hunters. Judging from their figures, they seemed to be women.
“This is?”Dudian retracted his gaze and looked at Aisha.
Aisha looked at him and narrowed her eyes: “Are you interested?”
Dudian was startled: “How could it be? I just want to ask how could there be such a place here.”
Aisha looked at him deeply. Her expression returned to normal as she looked at the road in front of her, “The Dragon Guard has lived in the wasteland for a long time. He is far away from the protection of his hometown and the giant wall. He is living a precarious life. If he doesn’t have something to do, he will go crazy.”
Dudian’s eyes slightly moved. He suddenly thought of the things in the Thorn Flower Prison. People would go crazy when they were imprisoned in a cage. If the giant wall was a cage then the people living outside the giant wall should be free and happy. However, the reality was not like that. If the bird in the cage broke out of the cage, it would die..
What was a real cage?
Dudian’s thoughts slowly drifted away. He couldn’t see the buildings on both sides of the street until a voice came from the front, “Your Highness, you are finally back. We were worried to death!”
It was a young man’s voice.
Dudian looked up and saw a handsome young man standing in front of Aisha. He was tall and thin. He had bright blonde hair. He was wearing a soft white robe. His temperament was refined and elegant. The only flaw was.., there was a long and narrow scar on his cheek. It was like a crack on a fine porcelain. It was a pity.
“How long have I been away?”Aisha asked.
The handsome young man was slightly surprised. He immediately said: “It has been more than forty days since I last left.”
Dean was surprised. The last time Aisha left was to kill Parna from the wing clan in the Orange Wasteland. Then she met him. It meant that they had been together for more than a month and he had been in the wasteland for more than a month!
Haisha squinted her eyes and thought, “Her ceremony has been held for so long.”
She thought of something, she turned to dean and said, “This is Eureka, one of the eight generals and my friend. Eureka, this is my friend, Dean. I hope you can take care of him in the future.”
Eureka’s eyes flashed with surprise. He had noticed Dudian behind Haisha when she was far away. He thought that Haisha had picked him up when she went to the Orange Wasteland! He didn’t expect that he was her friend!
He had been in the wasteland for so many years. He knew Haisha’s character very well. Although she was very strong but her EQ was very ordinary. She had always been a loner and didn’t like to talk much, she didn’t like to go to busy places so she had very few friends. He didn’t expect that this little dragon guard could become the friend of the Holy Maiden. It was incredible!
He looked at Dudian from top to bottom but still couldn’t find anything special. It was too ordinary.
However, since he could become friends with Aisha, there must be some hidden ability or special reason.
Thinking of this, he smiled and stretched out his hand: “Hello, this is the first time we meet. If there is anything I can help you in the future, feel free to look for me.”
Dudian nodded slightly and shook his hand lightly. A friend of a friend might not be a friend. He only recognized Aisha here.
Seeing that Dudian was serious, eureka slightly raised his eyebrows. He suddenly understood that this person’s personality seemed to be similar to Aisha’s. They were both quiet guys. It could be said that birds of a feather flock together.
“Are you the only one in the fortress? Where are the others?”Aisha asked.
Eureka smiled: “Amy and Gabby went out to carry out the mission. The others are busy with their own things. I’m the only one who is free so I came here to look for you.”
Aisha slightly frowned: “Has the fortress been attacked during this time?”
“Twice. It was the little guy who sneaked in. We took care of him.”Eureka glanced at her, “You, on the other hand, came back after such a long time. Did you encounter something difficult? You went out last time to kill the wing clan intruders who sneaked in, right? With the skills of the wing clan, even their holy sons might not be your match. Did you encounter a monster?”
Aisha nodded slightly, “I met a legendary hunter.”
“Legendary hunter? !”Eureka was shocked and could not help but ask, “Then how is it? Are You Okay?”
“I’m fine.”Aisha shook her head slightly, “I’m a little injured. I’m recuperating outside.”As she spoke, she walked forward. In front of her was a castle. There were hundreds of steps, and it was built extremely tall and magnificent.
Eureka immediately followed, “Have you recovered? I’ll find someone to treat you.”
“You have recovered.”
“Let’s take another look. It Won’t be good if there are any sequelae.”
“Alright.”
“Alright, I’ll call the Doctor.”
Eureka turned and ran. He looked at Dudian and nodded.
Dudian also nodded slightly. He frowned slightly after Eureka left.
Aisha didn’t look back but seemed to have noticed dudian’s expression: “What’s Wrong?”
Dudian shook his head: “Nothing.”
Aisha’s eyes lit up: “You don’t seem to be very happy.”
“No.”Dudian immediately denied as he changed the topic: “There should be a lot of monsters in the border of the Red Wasteland. Wouldn’t it be easy to be attacked by monsters?”
Aisha smiled, “There are magic insects outside the fortress. Ordinary monsters don’t dare to approach unless they are at the legendary level. Of course, there are some ordinary monsters that are not afraid of magic insects. However, there are only a few of them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 577
chapters.content:
Chapter 577
Dudian came to the magnificent fortress but saw that there was no one inside. It was especially quiet. There were no maids or squires. There were tall columns on all sides supporting the dome of the fortress. The cold wind rushed in from the outside of the columns, it sounded like a wail.
“This is where you live?”Dudian was a bit stunned. He could vaguely see the bed where he lived. There were weapons hanging on the shelves. There was also a circus where he practiced martial arts. But other than that, there was no whitewash. It was cold and lonely.
Aisha didn’t deny or admit it, she turned to dean and said, “In a moment, I will apply to the family to make a magic weapon for you. But I need to extract part of the magic marks from your body. The medical equipment here is relatively backward, so it may take a period of time to prepare. You should rest for two days and then prepare for the surgery.”
“Well.”Dean nodded. He looked at her thin figure, and the corner of his mouth slightly moved. He whispered, “When my magic weapon is made, I will help you.”
Aisha’s eyes softened: “Alright.”
It seemed like an agreement. The cold wind blew past the two of them and brought a trace of warmth.
After a long time.
Eureka ran up the steps and saw the two of them. His eyes flashed and he rushed over: “Your Highness, the Doctor is here.”
Aisha turned her head and her eyes fell on the stairs behind him. A graceful figure jumped up from there. She was wearing a white coat, silver alloy high-heeled boots, and black stockings on her snow-white legs, she wore a pair of thick-rimmed black glasses and walked over step by step.
“Your Highness, you’re finally back.”The woman said to Aisha.
Aisha smiled, “Fanny, you’re here.”
“It’s all because of you.”Fanny said, “I don’t know where you disappeared these days. The tribe had to send me to the front line. Humph, eight generals? Eight good-for-nothings are more like it.”
Eureka looked embarrassed: “Fanny, we can’t deal with Monsters of that level. It would be good if we can block them.”
Fanny glanced at him: “Good-for-nothings don’t make excuses.”
Eureka smiled wryly.
Dudian stopped his exercise and turned to look at the woman curiously. He was a bit surprised. Her tone and attitude were a bit like the first time he met Aisha.
Aisha slightly frowned: “So the family knows about me?”
“Do you need to say that?”Fanny shrugged her shoulders, “You are our SAINTESS. You have been missing for a long time. The family has sent your sister over. Didn’t you see her?”
Aisha and Dean were startled.
Dean’s pupils shrank. Hathaway was here?
Aisha turned to Eureka: “My Sister Is Here Too? Why didn’t you tell me before?”
Eureka said: “Your Highness, you just came back. I was going to report to you later.”
Aisha’s face was gloomy.
Fanny indifferently said: “What’s the difference? Are you afraid of her?”
Aisha frowned: “This matter is not as simple as you think.”
Dudian looked at her. He knew that she was worried about him. If Hathaway came to the fort she would find trouble with him. But now he was walking into a trap.
He immediately said: “How about I leave here?”
Hearing his words, Fanny’s eyes fell on Dudian. There was a trace of surprise in her eyes. She looked up and down. She frowned and asked Aisha: “Who is this kid?”
“He is my friend.”Aisha said.
Fanny narrowed her eyes and turned to look at dudian: “Dragon Guard? Kid, you are the one who caused little Lisa to lose her identity as a saintess. I didn’t expect you to have the face to appear here.”
Dudian’s face slightly changed.
“Fanny!”Aisha was slightly angry.
Fanny was slightly startled. She didn’t expect that she would be angry with her. Moreover, it was because of someone else. She couldn’t help but look at Dudian again. Her brows slowly wrinkled, “Are you worried that your sister will use him to deal with you?”? “How do you know that this kid isn’t your sister’s Man?”? “Maybe he has already colluded with your sister!”! “Even if you are sure that he isn’t your sister’s man, you should understand that anyone who gets close to you will become your disaster!”
Aisha bit her lips: “Don’t say anymore. He has nothing to do with Hathaway!”
Dudian wanted to leave but heard her last words. He clenched his fists and looked up at her.
Fanny noticed Dudian’s eyes and snorted, “What? Are you not convinced?”? “If you are really little Lisa’s friend then you better leave her at once. Otherwise, you will harm her!”! “Do you know how powerful her sister is? You Want to die. No one will care about you but don’t implicate little Lisa.”
“Shut up!”Aisha glared at her and said, “Don’t say anymore!”
Fanny was stunned and gritted her teeth, “If you want to protect him, let him leave you. Otherwise, you will regret it!”
“I know what to do about this.”Aisha took a deep breath and said, “This is my territory. No one can hurt my people!”
Fanny looked at her deeply: “You should take care of yourself. I didn’t come here to quarrel with you. You should be injured. Let me diagnose you first.”
Aisha looked at her and nodded.
Fanny glanced at Eureka and Dudian: “Do you guys know to give way?”
Eureka wryly smiled: “Alright, I’ll go.”
Aisha said to dudian: “You go with Eureka. He will arrange a place for you. Hailey won’t dare to touch you here. Otherwise… I won’t let her leave Alive!”
Fanny and Eureka were stunned.
Both of them looked at Aisha in disbelief. They never thought that she would be able to do so much for this young man. Hailey had offended and hurt her countless times. She had held back and never fought back, but this time, she was willing to kill her sister for this young man?
Both of them suddenly found that they had greatly underestimated the position of this young man in Aisha’s heart.
Dudian looked at Aisha in a daze. He suddenly had mixed feelings. There was a bit of surprise, but also a bit of shock and fear. He slightly clenched his fist and nodded: “I will not let her use me again.”
Aisha smiled. Her eyes were curved like a crescent moon, like a blooming lily.

chapters.title: Chapter 578
chapters.content:
Chapter 578
“Have you forgotten the previous lesson?”After Dudian and Haisha left, fanny said to Haisha: “Your Sister is not like others. She knows how to repay kindness. What she wants is not just an identity, but absolute rights! As long as you exist, you are her enemy and her obstacle. She will not be soft-hearted. You keep him by your side, sooner or later it will be a problem.”
Aisha turned around and sat down by the bed. She slowly said: “If we let him leave, where can he go?”
Fanny was slightly startled.
“If he returns to the wall, it will be more dangerous for him to be alone.”Aisha said: “There are already many people in the family who have submitted to Hathaway. They are worried that they won’t have the chance to make a contribution. He is an orphan and has no one to rely on. He has long been homeless. Only here has a glimmer of hope to survive.”
“Orphan?”Fanny was slightly surprised. She looked at her and fell silent, after a long time, she said, “He has no background, no strength, and nothing. He shouldn’t have come into contact with a world that he doesn’t deserve to come into contact with. Such a person can only live in the mud. That is where he lives. You shouldn’t force him out. Although he can breathe fresh air, the price… is his life!”
“If he’s here, I can protect him.”Aisha tilted her head and looked at her, “Also, don’t underestimate him. If you were him, you might not be able to get to where he is today. Moreover, he has legendary magic marks!”
“Legendary magic marks?”Fanny was shocked. “This… This kid has legendary magic marks?”
Aisha smiled. “Isn’t he very powerful?”
“As far as I know, this kid is from the outer wall. He’s an orphan and has no one to rely on. How could he have legendary magic marks?”Fanny’s face was full of shock, “Even if he was lucky enough to get a legendary parasitic soul worm, but… without professional training, he could actually withstand the erosion of a legendary parasitic soul worm?”
“So, don’t underestimate him.”Aisha smiled. “I believe that one day, he will fly thousands of miles and soar in the real sky!”
Fanny looked at her in a daze. After a long while, she slowly came back to her senses. The shock on her face gradually calmed down. She shook her head slightly, “Even the legendary magic marks are useless. If your sister knows about it, he will definitely die!”! “Not to mention that he has not grown up yet. Even if he has grown up, he is just an outstanding legendary pioneer.”
“But there is no lack of such a role in the family. Moreover, he doesn’t have the bloodline power and hasn’t learned secret skills since he was young. Compared to the other legendary pioneers who have been practicing secret skills since childhood, he is far inferior.”
Aisha smiled and shook her head. She didn’t say anything. She didn’t tell Fanny that Dudian had used less than half a month to learn the first stage of the dragon blood technique which was extremely difficult to master! It was known that even she who was hailed as a rare genius took a whole month to master the first stage!
“It’s too far away.”Fanny sighed, “It’s a pity. If it wasn’t because of you, he could have become a character. But your status is too high. He and you are like birds and fish! “Even if he has transformed, he is still a fish. At most he can dominate the deep water but he can’t jump into the sky!”
Aisha whispered: “If that’s the case, then I am willing to fall into the water.”
Fanny was stunned as she looked at her.
..
… ..
“This is your residence.”Eureka took Dudian to a manor. He pointed at one of the pointy hat buildings, “You can stay here. This is my manor. Her Highness Hailey’s people don’t dare to Intrude.”
“Thank you.”Dudian nodded.
Eureka sighed and patted Dudian’s shoulder: “As her Highness Hailey’s friend, I advise you to leave her. Otherwise, you will bring disaster to her.”
Dudian shook his head: “I can’t leave her.”
Eureka was startled, eureka frowned: “Haisha’s status is too different from yours. Although she treats you as a friend but there are many things that you can not control. In this world, many people think that they can do whatever they want. But the truth is that you have to do what others want you to do. Otherwise, you will not be able to survive!”
“I know.”Dudian’s expression was calm: “But I can’t leave.”
“What do you mean?”Eureka’s face was sullen.
Dudian looked at him, “You shouldn’t delay the news. Hailey should have known about my news. If I leave at this time she will send people to follow me. She will assassinate me or arrest me as a hostage. So I can’t leave. Understand?”
Eureka was startled. His face changed for a moment. He sighed: “Go and rest.”He turned and left.
Dudian looked at the back of Eureka. He was silent for a moment. He turned and walked towards the pointy hat building.
“I have to find a way to secretly leave. They are right. If I stay here, I will become a burden.”He thought in his heart. Although he didn’t want to admit it but he had to admit that his current strength was too weak.
He came to the pointy hat building. Several servants had already received the order and saluted to Dudian.
These servants and maidservants had the physique of hunters. They served the pioneers as servants.
Although he was in a bad mood, he had to take care of his life. Dudian had been living in the wasteland for more than 40 days. His hair and body had long been smelly. After washing and eating, he was thinking about the way out as he walked around the pointy hat building. From the moment he entered the building he saw that it was full of books.
In the past in the outer wall area of the library he needed to be a noble to enter the more famous library to borrow books. However the books in the famous library were limited, he couldn’t get much valuable knowledge and information. Many of the titles of the books were new to him. These books should have been moved from the Dragon Library for pioneers to read.
After all, it was easy to go crazy if one lived in a long-term slaughter without other thoughts.
“‘divine power’, ‘analysis of Wing clan’s ‘Space Thorn’…”
Dudian’s eyes swept over the books. Suddenly his eyes focused on one of them: “The law of evolution of magic marks?”
He lifted his hand and pulled out the book from the shelf. He looked at the introduction: “The evolution of magic marks is like the evolution of monsters, but also like the evolution of Magic Marks Warriors!”
“The body is like a balloon, and the power is like air. When the power in the body is abundant, saturated, and expanded, the body will change accordingly. When the balloon explodes, it is not destruction, but the birth of another form
“Just like the dream maker, which is ranked first among the legendary monsters, evolved from the Black Weaver, one of the ten rare monsters

chapters.title: Chapter 579
chapters.content:
Chapter 579
“Monster Evolution? Black Weaver?”Dudian was stunned, black Weaver was one of the top ten rare monsters. The magic marks in Glenn’s body were Black Weaver’s magic marks. She was good at hiding and the spider silk was sticky. She could cross any terrain and trap the enemy, she could also assassinate the enemy at close range. It could be said that she had the ability of multi-directional magic marks.
However, according to the information he had read about the legendary monster atlas, there seemed to be only one kind of magic marks ability of the dreamer. It was the ability to numb the enemy’s nerves through poison and create illusions. Other than that, there was no other detailed introduction like other legendary monsters.
“In other words, once the magic marks evolve, the ability will be completely different.”Dean’s eyes slightly flashed as he continued to look down. He saw the list of the low-level forms of other legendary monsters before the evolution, aisha’s magic marks of the dragon were actually evolved from the rare magic marks of the Dragon Steeler, while the shadow hunter was evolved from the rare magic marks of the illusionist.
As for his magic marks of the splitter, they were evolved from the blood blade.
The magic marks of the blood blade were just ordinary rare monsters. Their attack methods were monotonous but their destructive power was astonishing. This point was very similar to the splitter.
“The conditions for monsters to evolve are very strict. The probability is very low. Some monsters will evolve after they have fully grown. Some monsters will evolve at maturity or even in their infancy. The factors that lead to the evolution of new monsters are still unknown…”
“However, according to the statistics, the probability of monsters evolving after they have fully grown is one in ten thousand. The probability of other stages is one in ten thousand.”
Dudian was stunned as he looked at the line. The probability of evolution was so low? Didn’t it mean that only one out of 10,000 black weaver could evolve?
No Wonder Dreamer was a rare legendary monster.
It would be difficult for a big family like the Dragon Clan to find 100 black weaver, let alone 10,000 black weaver!
Thinking of this, he in the heart of a glimmer of hope suddenly dispelled, casually continue to turn down.
“I have interviewed the Master of Monster Research, Puss. According to him, after thousands of experiments, he has found a way to increase the probability of evolution of monsters. That is to feed monsters with insect powder. The more monsters eat, the higher the probability of evolution! “However…”
“However, monsters are naturally afraid of insect powder. It is very difficult for them to eat it. They can only be knocked unconscious and forced to put a tube into their stomach. After two years of feeding Master Puss has successfully made a bloodthirsty monster evolve into a blood carrier.”
Dudian was slightly startled. Insect Powder?
“According to Master Puss there are many methods to increase the probability of evolution. There are many things that can increase the probability of evolution but the effect is weak…”
Dudian continued to read the book.
Soon he saw the main point of the book which was the evolution of magic marks.
“The probability of evolution of magic marks is lower than the probability of evolution of monsters. The factors that lead to evolution are more chaotic. Some people are emotional and lead to the evolution of their magic marks. Some people eat unknown plants which lead to the evolution of magic marks…”
”… Master Puss had given the hunter the divine worm powder. But the hunter choked to death after taking the first bite. He had experimented with more than thirty hunters with different magic marks. The result was the same. Master Puss had to find another way…”
”… After repeated attempts, the known method to increase the probability of the evolution of magic marks was to use legendary parasitic soul worms as nutrients…”
In the blink of an eye, Dudian saw the end of the book. When he saw the final conclusion, he had the impulse to roll his eyes. Sure enough, this was a bad book. It was a typical title. The beginning of the book was amazing, people looked forward to it. They analyzed the reasons and conjectures. However, they couldn’t analyze anything until the end of the book.
Using legendary parasitic soul worms as nutrients for magic marks was no longer a luxury, but madness!
Moreover, from this point of view, it wasn’t enough to just take one legendary magic mark as nutrients, but the more the quantity, the greater the probability! To put it more bluntly, the more the quantity provided, the greater the probability, but it was very likely that there wouldn’t be any changes!
Only a ghost would use the rare legendary magic marks as nutrients because of such a sentence. Moreover, even if there was such a madman, he wouldn’t be able to find so many legendary magic marks!
Moreover, he was very doubtful that master “Puss”who came to such a conclusion had personally tried to use legendary magic marks as nutrients.
“I’ve been reading for half a day, it’s a waste of time.”Dudian felt speechless. He inserted the book back into the bookshelf, turned around and left, continuing to think of ways to sneak away.
Two days passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian had been living in the pointy hat building for the past two days. It was peaceful and quiet. He was worried that Hailey had completely ignored him and didn’t come to find trouble with him.
Moreover, he heard from Eureka that Hailey and Aisha had only met once in the past two days and didn’t say anything. Moreover, according to him, Hailey’s attitude was very modest when she saw Aisha. She didn’t provoke her sister as she used to. It was as if she had changed into a different person.
Dudian was a bit strange after hearing Eureka’s words. He had lived in the wasteland for a few days. He had lived in the same room with Aisha. He had heard her talk about his relationship with Hailey, the reason why he had humbly let his sister go in the past. Could it be that Haisha had changed her mind?
So she didn’t find trouble with him?
Dudian was suspicious but he didn’t waste his brain to think about it. No matter what, it was always right to make the worst case scenario. After all, if he made a wrong step, he would lose his life, he couldn’t be too optimistic about things.
Moreover, based on his understanding of Hailey, this girl didn’t just treat Aisha because of hatred and jealousy. She was also obsessed with power and control.
“Dudian, His Highness wants you to go over.”Eureka’s voice came from outside the building.
Dudian was reading a book called “Basic fighting original solution”. He came to the door and saw Eureka waving at him. He walked over and asked: “Is it Aisha?”
“Yes.”Eureka slightly nodded. He looked at Dudian’s casual robe: “You better go back and change into armor. It is very likely that we will leave the fortress this time. We have found traces of the executioner.”

chapters.title: Chapter 580
chapters.content:
Chapter 580
“Executioner?”Dudian was surprised, “The second most powerful legendary monster? !”
“You also know the ranking of legendary monsters?”Eureka was surprised and smiled, “Yes, it is the executioner. We have found traces of it in the wasteland. We are sending people to search for it. If we can find its whereabouts, there will be hope for the emergence of a super powerful dragon with the magic marks of an executioner!”
Dean saw his excited look and suddenly thought of something. He was a bit stunned. From Aisha’s words, he knew that the top three legendary monsters were very different from each other. The dreamer ranked first.., it was extremely powerful to be able to fight against seven legendary monsters at the same time!
Although the executioner was not as terrifying as the dreamer, but all the monsters below the top three could still remain undefeated!
Obviously, the executioner was such a powerful legendary monster. Ordinary pioneers were no match for it!
This meant that once they found it, they would need Aisha’s help!
There was a trace of worry in his eyes. After all, Aisha had just recovered from her injury. Although she had recovered most of her strength, it was extremely dangerous to meet the executioner!
“Her Highness is going to search the area where the executioner left traces. It is very likely that she will meet the executioner so it is inconvenient for her to bring you with her.”Eureka looked at Dudian’s worried expression, eureka thought that Dudian was thinking about his safety so he patted his shoulder: “Don’t worry. Her Highness is going to send you to the area furthest away from the executioner.”
“Moreover, he asked me to protect you. There won’t be any danger.”
Dudian clenched his fingers in his sleeve: “I know. I will go back and change my armor.”
“Go.”
Dudian turned back to the building. He put on the Dragon Guard armor sent by Eureka. He filled the bag with food. He carried the bow, quiver, dagger, dagger and other things.
“Maybe this is a chance to leave.”Dudian thought. He thought of Haisha’s lonely figure. He felt a bit of heartache. If he could help her at this time.., how good would that be?
However, there was no hero to save the beauty in reality.
He wasn’t a hero.
Even for him, leaving here was to help her.
Although his heart was sullen, but his reason had the upper hand in the end. Dudian took a deep breath, gritted his teeth and quickly left the building.
“Let’s go.”
“Okay.”
The two quickly left Eureka’s manor and went down the street to the huge castle where Aisha lived.
A moment later, the two came to the huge castle.
Aisha was standing next to a cylinder, looking at the rows of buildings in the fortress. She heard the sound of the wind and turned her head. She saw Dudian and Eureka who were fully armed. There was a touch of gentleness in her emotionless eyes, however, she said: “Did Eureka tell you that you are here?”
Dudian looked at the girl. He had the impulse to stand by her side but he restrained himself: “He told me everything.”
Aisha looked at Dudian’s eyes. There was a trace of complexity in his eyes, “Don’t worry, I’ll be fine. You will be with Eureka. He will protect you. After I leave, the fortress will be too dangerous. I will look for you when I’m done.”
The Sun was setting and the yellow light shone on her cheeks. Her hair fluttered in the breeze and wrapped around her cheeks. She gently brushed her hands and pulled them to her ear. Her tone was very gentle.
Dudian looked at the bright red sunset reflected in his eyes. He suddenly felt that the girl was very close to him but far away from him. He couldn’t touch her.
It was because he was too weak..
“I know.”He lowered his head. The sunset shone on his hair. The shadow covered the upper half of his face. “You have to be careful. Not only the monsters but also the people around you.”
Aisha’s eyes were gentle as she smiled: “I will.”
At this time, there was a rush of footsteps coming from outside the steps of the giant castle.
Aisha’s eyes slightly moved. She deeply looked at dudian and said to Eureka: “You go first.”
“Yes.”Eureka bowed his head.
He didn’t say a word and turned to leave.
Dudian looked at Aisha. He suddenly felt that this was the last time he saw her. The graceful figure quietly stood there and gently looked at him. There seemed to be countless stars flashing in her eyes, she was extremely beautiful.
He turned around. The shadow covered his face as he followed behind Eureka step by step.
The air seemed to be silent.
When they walked past the steps, the sound of hurried footsteps came from the front. It was a dragon guard who was passing by.
The next moment, Dean followed Eureka down the steps and went along the street. They were getting farther and farther away from the silent and towering castle.
..
..
East Gate of the fortress.
Eureka and Dudian were like two black lines on the street. They saw three figures standing in front of the high wall of the east gate of the fortress. Two men and one woman were wearing the armors of the dragon guards. It seemed that they were bored.
They heard the sound of wind coming from Eureka and Dudian. They turned around and looked at the face of Eureka. They were surprised and surprised.
“General Eureka!”The three of them saluted.
Eureka and Dudian stopped in front of the three of them. Eureka glanced at the three of them and nodded: “I will lead the way to the second red wasteland. Are the three of you ready?”
“General, everything is ready!”One of the gray-haired youth said. His face was very handsome but there was a bone spike protruding from the back of his neck.
Eureka slightly nodded and introduced to the three: “This is the new teammate. His name is dudian. Let’s go.”
The three looked at dudian. They were surprised to see that Dudian’s face was too young. They were about to greet dudian when they heard Eureka’s words, they nodded to Dudian to show their respect. They followed Eureka towards the open east gate.
Eureka led the way out of the East Gate.
“The trail of the executioner has appeared in Red Wasteland No. 7. It is far away from Red Wasteland No. 2.”Eureka’s voice was cold, “But don’t think that you can be careless. Even if you don’t meet the Executioner, there are other monsters. Do you understand?”
“Yes!”The three of them replied loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 581
chapters.content:
Chapter 581
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Five figures were flying fast outside the fortress. In the blink of an eye, the tall and steep fortress disappeared behind the five people.
“Be careful. Red Wasteland No. 2 is in front of us.”Eureka coldly said.
Dudian knew that Eureka was talking to him. After all, the other three knew the location of Red Wasteland No. 1. He looked up and saw that the ground was covered with black soil. There was no trace of the road and there were no remnants of buildings. There were piles of stones, there was a flag that was four to five meters tall.
The flag was engraved with black dragon patterns. It was fluttering in the wasteland.
The five of them quickly came to the side of the flag. Dudian could smell the strong smell of insect powder which permeated into his pores. His right arm was slightly trembling.
His eyes were focused as he secretly paid attention to it.
Eureka didn’t stop as he rushed past the flag. There was a huge number written on the other side of the flag: Two!
It meant that this was the second red wasteland entrance!
They continued to cross the flag and left the border of the flag behind.
Eureka’s speed slowly decreased as they went deeper into the red wasteland. He stopped and walked: “You Three, the task this time is to protect Dudian. Do you understand?”
“Protect Dudian?”
The three of them were surprised as they looked at Dudian who was following them, the gray haired youth couldn’t help but ask: “General, our task this time is to find the traces of the executioner. How, how could it be…”
Eureka glanced at him: “Find The Executioner? If you really find him, will you be able to go back alive?”
The gray-haired youth was stunned.
“This time we came to red wasteland region two. The main purpose is to protect Dudian. If anything happens to him, you and I will not be able to go back alive. Do you understand?”Eureka’s eyes were cold, he glanced at the three people.
The three of them were stunned.
Dudian was startled. He couldn’t help but look up at him? Could it be that Haisha had told him before he met Haisha?
He suddenly thought of something. He couldn’t help but feel touched and ashamed. Obviously, Haisha was worried about his safety. She sent Eureka to protect him but was also worried that Eureka couldn’t protect him, so she said some harsh words to him.
No wonder he was in a bad mood.
“General, who is Dudian?”The blonde woman asked Eureka carefully.
The other two also looked at him in surprise. No matter how they guessed, they couldn’t figure out why this ordinary youth was so important? Could he be the illegitimate son of the patriarch?
However, they only heard that the SAINTESS only had a younger sister. How could she have a son.
But other than this identity, they really could not figure out what kind of noble identity was there that could be personally protected by a general, and it was more important than the general’s life!
Eureka glanced at the three and said, “You shouldn’t know. It’s best not to ask.”
The blonde woman lowered her head in embarrassment.
Roar!
A roar was suddenly heard.
The five of them looked up and saw a giant zombie that was nearly five meters tall stepping out from behind a pile of rocks. This zombie’s body was similar to a human’s, but its organs were not similar at all. It had dark-colored skin.., white bones protruded from its chest and abdomen, exposing its skin. There were also a few white bones under its armpits. There were sickle bones on its arms, which were extremely sharp.
His head was very big. There was a blood-red eyeball on his forehead. His neck was half a meter long. There were black blood vessels that connected his neck and head. His head could be bent to any part of his body, he could even rotate 360 degrees.
“Giant undeads!”Eureka frowned. He took out a dagger from his leggings and rushed over.
The gray-haired youth and the other two looked at the giant undeads. Their faces were pale and there was a trace of fear in their eyes.
Dudian didn’t move. He stood in the same place and looked at the giant undeads. He had read the Atlas of monsters in the wasteland. The giant undeads were terrifying undeads that had mutated many times, their hunting level was as high as 58!
Different from monsters, undeads’hunting level was precise. There was no room for them to move up or down. Moreover most undeads could defeat monsters of the same level!
Although the undeads were ferocious, they were conscious creatures after all. However, the undeads were different. They only had instincts, which made their fighting style extremely desperate. Even the UNDEADS did not dare to provoke such prey easily.
Whoosh!
The giant undeads and Eureka quickly approached. Eureka’s body suddenly flashed and three Eureka appeared on the spot. They surrounded the giant undeads from three angles and then pounced on them together.
The giant zombie’s face was ferocious. Its dark red eyes rolled left and right, and it suddenly raised its hand to pounce on one of Eureka.
This pounce instantly missed, and the other Eureka also disappeared in an instant. Only Eureka, who was pouncing on its back, jumped up high, and stabbed at the back of its neck with a dagger!
This dagger was extremely sharp, and it immediately pierced into the dark red blood vessels on its neck. Black blood spurted out from it, and when it splashed on Eureka’s armor, it actually emitted a faint white mist.
This time it wasn’t corroded but frozen!
White Frost Crystals appeared on the spot where the blood splashed!
Dudian was shocked. There were cold crystals in the heads of undeads. The blood of ordinary undeads was frozen. However the blood of the giant undeads was flowing but there was an unusual cold air, it could freeze instantly once it was out of the body.
Eureka quickly pulled out the dagger and took a few steps back.
The giant undeads turned their head. The wound that was pierced by the dagger was frozen and healing!
Eureka spat out saliva. Its eyes were cold as it looked at the giant undeads.
Whoosh!
The wind whistled and Eureka disappeared from the sight of Dudian and the others.
The giant undeads’dark red eyes moved quickly. Suddenly, its eyes moved to the edge of its left eye socket and almost burst out. At this time, a figure flashed out from its left. It was Eureka.
Puff!
His dagger cut across the neck of the giant undeads. However, it was stuck halfway through.
At this time, the giant zombie’s head suddenly stretched out and bit toward Eureka’s face.
Eureka snorted and suddenly released the dagger. He held its head with both hands and landed on the ground. The veins on his arms bulged. He roared and pulled its head to the ground.
With a loud bang, a large amount of dust rose from the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 582
chapters.content:
Chapter 582
Surrounded by dust, Eureka quickly hooked his little finger, and the dagger on his leggings quickly fell into his hand. He held it with his back hand, and with a sudden stab of his hammer, it pierced through the ear of the giant zombie.
The giant zombie’s body trembled, and it immediately stopped moving.
Eureka let out a light breath, and pulled out the dagger. At the same time, he also took out the other dagger on its neck. The two daggers rubbed against each other, and the cold blood on the dagger was removed, then he put it back into his leggings.
The gray-haired youth and the other two were relieved to see that the giant undeads had been eliminated. They immediately went forward.
“General is Brave!”
“General is so powerful. He can eliminate a giant undeads without using magic weapons!”
Dudian looked at the giant undeads and asked Eureka: “Aren’t you going to take out the cold crystals from its head?”
The three turned to look at him.
Eureka looked at dudian: “You can take it out yourself. It is useless to me.”
“Alright!”Dudian pulled out his dagger and went to the giant zombie’s corpse. He tried to cut open its skull but found that its skull was abnormally hard, it wasn’t inferior to tungsten steel. His dagger wasn’t able to pry open its skull.
He was secretly shocked. If it was him then it would be almost impossible to kill the giant zombie.
Eureka saw that Dudian was busy for a long time but was still unable to cut open the giant zombie’s head. Eureka shook her head: “It is impossible to hurt it with your dagger.”She pulled out the dagger, she squatted down and quickly cut the giant zombie’s head into pieces.
“Thank you.”Dudian said. He immediately opened the giant zombie’s head. There was a burst of white cold air coming out of its head. It was so cold that his palm hurt. Especially his left arm, the cold air in his arm seemed to be active as it swam towards his body.
He hurriedly controlled his heart to beat and suppressed it with the dragon blood technique.
Soon, the active cold air was suppressed by him. At this time, the white cold air in the giant zombie’s skull gradually dispersed, revealing the brain matter inside. It was completely frozen like a dark red ice ball.
Dudian slightly frowned as he used the dagger to cut off the ice ball.
Fortunately, the ice ball was not as hard as its skull. It was cut open and revealed an oval-shaped dark blue crystal.
He picked it up. The crystal was extremely cold and his fingertips were tingling with pain.
He looked at it and saw that there was a worm-like contoured outline inside the cold crystal.
“Let’s go.”Eureka waited for Dudian to pick up the cold crystal.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He put the cold crystal into his pocket and got up to follow.
Eureka didn’t walk fast. It seemed that he wasn’t in a hurry. He looked around as he walked. He was aware of the unknown dangers. After all, even pioneers could fall in the wasteland. He had to be careful.
Half an hour later, Eureka came to a stone pile and sat down. He said, “Let’s rest here.”
The gray-haired young man and the other two immediately stopped. The blonde woman immediately untied her backpack and took out a bottle of pure water. She jogged to Eureka and handed it to him with both hands. “General, here you are.”
Eureka glanced at her and said indifferently, “No need, I have my own.”After saying that, he untied his backpack and took out the pure water.
The blonde woman took back her hand. She turned around and went back to the other two. The three of them sat on a stone pile. They took out dry food and water to replenish their strength.
Dudian went straight to Eureka’s side and sat down. He would be able to react in time if there was any danger.
Eureka didn’t get up after more than ten minutes of rest. He looked at the blonde woman and the other two: “Tonight We will sleep in the open. Get ready to sprinkle the undead powder.”
The three were surprised. They looked at each other but didn’t say anything. They bowed their heads and prepared to defend the camp.
“It’s still early. Don’t you want to take a walk?”Dudian looked at him in surprise.
Eureka shrugged his shoulders: “The mission this time is to take you out to take refuge. We are not hunting monsters. What’s the point of taking a walk? If I wasn’t worried that the people sent by her Highness Hailey would catch up to me, I would have directly camped next to the flag of the Wasteland.”
Dudian was startled but didn’t say anything more.
Time passed quickly.
In the blink of an eye, Dudian and others had been in the red wasteland for three days.
In these three days, Eureka took Dudian and others to the outer edge of the red wasteland. They didn’t go deep into the unexplored areas so as to avoid encountering monsters. However, they had encountered several giant undeads, weaker skeleton undeads and a large number of ordinary undeads in the past three days. Eureka and the blonde woman had killed them.
Dudian hadn’t made a move from the beginning to the end. He was tightly protected by the few of them.
“I didn’t expect that there would be so many senior undeads in the outer area.”Eureka slightly frowned. He stabbed out his dagger and killed a skeleton, he turned his head and looked around.
Hearing his words, the blonde woman rolled her eyes and said, “General, most of these high-level zombies came from deep areas that haven’t been cleared yet, right?”
“Do I need you to tell me that?”Eureka snorted coldly. He raised his head and looked in the direction of the deep red area in the distance. He frowned slightly. A large number of zombies were wandering. Could it be that something in the deep area scared them?
There was a trace of gloominess in his heart. He turned around and said: “Go back. This place is too deep.”
The blonde woman and the other two looked at each other in dismay? They would have to retreat out of the Red Wasteland Region!
Although they thought so, they obediently followed Eureka and left. They protected Dudian in the middle of the group.
Soon, the group retreated four or five miles. Eureka saw that they had almost retreated. He stopped and said: “This is the place. Get Ready. We will camp here tonight.”
The Blonde Woman and the other two didn’t have any objections. They immediately set up an alarm and sprinkled the undead powder.
Dudian sat on the pile of stones. He looked around in case there were any monsters that were trying to sneak attack him. Suddenly, he heard a faint sound of wind. He couldn’t help but look at the source of the sound. He saw that it was coming from a gap in the next pile of stones.
Dudian was surprised. was there wind in the stone pile? Was there a space under it? Or… was it the sound of the monster’s breath?
“There is movement!”Dudian looked at Eureka: “It is under the stone pile.”
Eureka was sitting on the stone pile. He looked at the direction of Dudian’s finger. He heard a faint sound of wind. He pulled out the dagger, he quietly moved over and slowly broke the stones.
After a moment, there was a gap in the pile of stones. It was pitch black inside.
He threw a few stones into the pile. He heard the sound of Rolling Stones but there was no sound of monster fighting back. The faint sound of airflow was still there.
He was relieved. He knew that it was not because of the monster’s breathing but because of the ventilation.
He opened the stone and continued to walk inside. He didn’t care about walking a few more steps. Moreover, he was curious as to where the ventilation came from.
Soon, the stone pile was opened to reveal a passage. He walked inside.
Dudian immediately followed.
The blonde woman and the other two who were setting the alarm saw their actions and immediately followed them in case of danger.
The five of them went straight down the passage under the pile of stones. The road was full of gravel which made it easy for them to sprain their feet. After more than fifty meters, the gravel disappeared. A flat road appeared in front of them. The ground was horizontal as if it was made by man.
Dudian looked up and his pupils shrank.
He saw a huge stone door twenty meters away from the end of the road!
If not for the crack in the middle of the stone door and the stone pattern on the stone door, he would have thought it was a rock wall.
“Ruins? !”Eureka was surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 583
chapters.content:
Chapter 583
The seventh region of the Red Wasteland.
In the gray and cloudy sky, two huge wings flapped across the sky at high speed. The figure embedded in the middle of the huge wings was slender and long, carrying a huge sword that did not match the size of the body on its back. Every time the wings flapped.., the whirring sound of the wind could be heard even from hundreds of meters below the ground.
While moving at high speed, Aisha’s eyes moved left and right, patrolling around. Although she was moving at high speed, the things on the ground were still presented in her vision.
