The dynamic vision superimposed the thermal vision.., coupled with her enhanced vision, her eyes could see every rotten hole in the gravel on the ground.
Roar! Roar!
Wherever she passed by, there were groups of zombies wandering on the ground. When they heard the movement above their heads, they raised their heads and roared. They waved their sharp arms and ran in the direction Aisha flew in, until she lost her figure in her field of vision, she slowly returned to her wandering state.
“HMM?”
Suddenly, Aisha’s gaze focused and landed on one of the messy gravel. There were two huge footprints on the ground, and there was a long dent behind the footprints, as if it had been crushed by a python.
“Found it!”Aisha’s eyes lit up. She looked forward along the footprints and saw the footprints spread along the gravel into the distance. She immediately flew behind the footprints and chased after them at high speed.
Ten minutes later, Aisha who was flying at full speed suddenly stopped in the air. Her calm face was full of shock. She looked at a place in front of her in horror — the ground was in a mess.., there were huge craters that looked like meteorites everywhere. There were countless zombies lying in the huge craters!
There were all kinds of zombies, including the most ordinary zombies, sickle zombies, horned zombies, giant zombies, and other high-level zombies! At this moment, all of their bodies were broken, and their heads were almost completely destroyed. Only a few zombies were cut in half, and their upper bodies were still crawling in the pile of zombies, making cracking sounds.
However, Aisha’s trembling eyes fell on one of the huge craters.
There was a huge corpse lying quietly, or rather, a corpse.
The flesh and blood on the surface of the corpse had been mostly chewed up, revealing the huge skeleton. At the moment, there were still seven or eight zombies that had been cut in half, desperately chewing on the remaining flesh and blood.
The corpse was a super-large monster. The length of the skeleton from the head to the soles of the feet was about twelve to thirteen meters, and behind it was a tail that was more than ten meters long that was badly chewed up.
Its skeleton was extremely ferocious. Other than the spine in the middle that was extremely thick, the ribs and skeleton that extended from the spine to both sides were also extremely strong. The length that extended to the left and right could be seen from the width of its body, it was at least seven to eight meters.
“How, how could it be…”Aisha looked at the skeleton in a daze. The shock in her heart could not be any greater. Wasn’t this the executioner that she was looking for? !
It was dead.
She could not accept the fact that the executioner was not as weak as the shadow hunter. Judging from its size, the executioner had reached maturity! It was an existence that was only second to the dreamer among legendary monsters. It was much stronger than her magic marks Magic Dragon. How could it die here? !
She was stunned for a moment. Suddenly, she noticed a few zombies that were gnawing on the executioner’s corpse. She was stunned for a moment. Then, she looked around again and saw the dead zombies all over the place, her pupils contracted slightly. “Could it be…”
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
At this moment, three wind-breaking sounds rushed over at high speed. They all had huge dragon wings similar to Aisha’s. However, their dragon wings were covered with a layer of dark red blood membrane. They were pure flesh wings, meanwhile, the back of Aisha’s dragon wings was covered with blood red feathers.
“Sister?”The leading figure let out a surprised voice.
Hearing this voice, Aisha’s constricted pupils immediately recovered. She withdrew the shock on her face and did not turn around. She just quietly looked at the executioner’s corpse on the ground and revealed a thoughtful expression.
Hathaway was the first to rush over. She stopped beside Aisha and swept her gaze forward. She immediately saw the purgatory-like scene below. When she saw the huge monster’s skeleton, she immediately widened her eyes and revealed a shocked expression.
“Your subordinate greets her highness Aisha.”
“Your subordinate greets her highness Aisha.”
The two people behind Hathaway hurried over and immediately bowed to Aisha. Then, they looked in the direction where the two people were looking and revealed a shocked expression.
“Isn’t this the executioner?”One of them said with a shocked expression, “How did it die here? What happened here?”
The shock on Hathaway’s face had already calmed down, and she frowned. Whether it was her appearance or her current expression, she was somewhat similar to Aisha, and she looked thoughtful, “There are so many corpses around, and there are even high-level undeads like giant undeads among them. Could it be that… There’s a zombie king here?”
“Zombie King?”The white-skinned youth who had spoken earlier widened his eyes and said, “Could… could it be that the executioner was eaten by the zombie king?”
The other middle-aged man with protruding bone spikes on his arm had an ugly expression and said, “If it’s the corpse king, then we’re in Big Trouble.”
“If it’s not the corpse king, then it’s another monster.”Hathaway’s eyes flashed slightly as she said in a low voice, “Another monster injured the executioner, and then it encountered this small group of zombies, and was killed.”
Whoosh!
While the three of them were talking, Aisha’s figure suddenly descended, landing several meters above the executioner’s corpse. The zombies that were gnawing on the corpse saw Aisha, and they immediately raised their heads and roared, reaching out to grab Aisha’s boots.
She held the huge sword on her back, and the bandages were automatically untied. With a flash of blood, the bodies of the zombies suddenly froze, and the next moment, their heads slowly slid down from the bridge of their noses, cutting neatly.
Hathaway and the other two also landed.
“Its parasitic soul worm seems to be gone.”The middle-aged man looked at the corpse and saw that its internal organs had been completely eaten up. There were basically no parasitic soul worms left.
Hearing his words, Hathaway slightly gritted her teeth and clenched her fingers, but soon loosened them, she said to Aisha: “Sister, it seems that an incredible monster has broken into the wasteland of our Dragon Clan. We must find it as soon as possible. Otherwise, the other pioneers who are carrying out missions outside will fall into the hands of the monster at any time.”
Aisha ignored her words and looked at the corpse for a moment, she slowly said: “It was killed by the corpse king. This should be a fully formed corpse king with a corpse tide. Lucca, go back immediately and pass down the order. If there is a corpse king, retreat immediately if you see a corpse tide!”
The middle-aged man replied, “Yes.”As he spoke, he flapped his dragon wings and soared into the sky, turning around to fly away.

chapters.title: Chapter 584
chapters.content:
Chapter 584
“Is this the ruins?”
The blonde woman and the other two were stunned.
Dudian was startled as he carefully looked at the door. He soon noticed that there was a protruding stone next to the door.
“Be careful.”Eureka’s expression was serious: “There are many kinds of ruins. Some of them have treasures from the old era. Some of them are traps. There is destructive light which can penetrate everything!”
“Destructive light?”Dudian’s heart was moved. was he talking about the laser?
He immediately stopped his intention to go forward to explore. If there was a laser weapon in the ruins then Eureka’s words didn’t mean that the energy source of the laser weapon was not exhausted, it meant that there was a solar energy storage system installed in the ruins. However, if Eureka had seen a laser weapon then did it mean that the wall also had a laser weapon?
“Destroy light? Is it a kind of weapon?”Dudian deliberately asked Eureka.
The blonde woman and the other two looked at Eureka curiously.
“It should be a kind of weapon from the old era.”Eureka said in a deep voice: “Even pioneers can not avoid it. It is very dangerous.”
“No Way?”
“Are the people from the old era so strong?”
“Weren’t they exterminated? If they had such a strong power, how could they be exterminated?”
The blonde woman and the other two were surprised.
Dudian narrowed his eyes and asked Eureka: “Since this weapon is so strong, why haven’t I heard of it?”
Eureka shook her head: “It can’t be used after being dismantled. After all, it is a weapon of the old era. We don’t know how to use it.”
“I see…”Dudian was relieved. If the giant wall had a laser weapon from the old era then it would be very troublesome. Even his new invention wouldn’t be able to resist it. However, from the current situation, the giant wall shouldn’t have the power of a laser weapon. Otherwise, it would be enough to intimidate all the pioneers and command them!
Obviously, the forces in the inner wall were complicated. It meant that the forces in the inner wall were not loyal to the same person.
“Step back a bit.”Eureka stared at the giant door for a moment.
Dudian and the others immediately stepped back.
Eureka pulled out a long black spear from his back. There were many inscriptions engraved on the body of the spear. It looked very simple. At the moment the inscriptions seemed to be burning with blood. The body of the spear gradually changed, the handle of the spear which Eureka held in his hand gradually dissolved.
The spear that dissolved into mucus spread along his palm and wrapped around his body. It looked like a flowing liquid with life.
Dudian’s pupils shrank. Was this a magic weapon? Was this really a genetic weapon?
A moment later, the mucus that dissolved from the spear wrapped around Eureka’s body. In an instant he was covered in dark red liquid. There were sharp spikes and scales protruding from every part of his body, the mucus gathered and extended to form a three meter long tail. His body changed as the sound of bones cracking echoed from his body.
His body also became a lot taller. The change quickly ended. In the blink of an eye, the handsome Eureka who had a refined temperament disappeared. He was replaced by a black-skinned monster with scales all over his body, the monster with a black tail and a lion-like head appeared in front of Dudian and the others.
Dudian felt a strong sense of oppression. He felt his pores shrink. His intuition told him that the person in front of him was not Eureka but a real monster!
“Step back a bit more.”The monster spoke in a hoarse voice.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he stepped back seven or eight meters.
Eureka stepped forward after Dudian and the others were far away. There was a spike protruding from his long black arm. It was half a meter long. The front end of his arm looked like a spear. Eureka’s figure suddenly flashed as he rushed towards the giant door, the spear-like black spike suddenly stabbed into the gap of the door.
Bang.
The dust fell from the top of the stone wall. The giant door was also covered in dust.
Eureka looked at the front end of the black spike. It didn’t Pierce into the gap of the door. He took a few steps back and waved the black spike. He drew a dent on the giant door.
After a moment, the dust dispersed. Dudian and others saw that lines appeared on the giant door. The lines were dark gold. It seemed to be some kind of metal.
Dudian was startled. He suddenly realized that it wasn’t a stone door but a metal valve. It was just that the dust accumulated over time and formed a stone shell.
“If it is a modern metal door from the old era then…”Dudian’s eyes fell on the protruding stone. He immediately spoke to Eureka: “General, cut the stone fragments there.”
Eureka turned his head and looked at Dudian. His dark green eyes flashed as he looked at the protruding stone. He quickly waved his arm and the stone pieces flew out. Soon, the stone pieces were removed, the shape of the protruding stone was revealed. It was a metal instrument.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he saw the metal instrument. It should be the password to open the gate.
Eureka stopped and looked at the metal instrument.
Dudian waited for a moment but didn’t trigger any mechanism. He walked over.
The Blonde Woman and the other two followed after him.
Dudian reached out to touch the metal instrument.
Eureka hurriedly said: “Be careful!”
Dudian looked at Eureka. He was surprised as he saw that Eureka didn’t sense any mechanism. He lifted his finger and opened the metal shell on the surface of the metal instrument. He was stunned as there was a screen inside. There was no password button. Could it be that this was an iris scan?
Eureka was startled by Dudian’s action. She looked around vigilantly. She was relieved as she didn’t touch any mechanism. She was about to blame Dudian when she saw Dudian’s finger press, dudian pressed the button inside the metal box!
Damn! Eureka was furious.
Before he could scold Dudian, a red light shot out from the metal box and swept towards them.
“Not good!”
Eureka was shocked but he was a pioneer after all. He quickly covered his face and stepped back. He instinctively retreated four or five meters back to protect Dudian’s life.
When he looked up to grab Dudian he saw that the red light had disappeared. Dudian and the other three who were standing in front of the metal box didn’t react in time, there were no wounds on their bodies.
Dudian confirmed that it was an iris scan when he saw the light from the dialysis machine. He couldn’t help but feel disappointed. If it was an iris scan, only the person who had recorded his iris into the machine.., could Open the door.
“Scan complete…”
“Identity confirmed, shelter opened!”
A mechanical electronic sound suddenly came from the metal instrument.

chapters.title: Chapter 585
chapters.content:
Chapter 585
“Open?”Dudian was stunned.
Eureka was startled as he heard the mechanical voice. He pulled Dudian’s body back a few steps. He looked at the metal instrument with vigilance, “Who are you? Come out!”
The blonde woman and the other two were startled as they heard Dudian’s words. They pulled out their weapons and looked at the metal instrument. They didn’t expect that there was a “Person”hidden inside, it was simply terrifying!
“Person?”Dudian was stunned for a moment. He was amused but at the same time he was relieved. It seemed that these people didn’t understand English. It was good that they didn’t suspect him.
Buzz!
At this time, the ground under their feet suddenly shook. The dust on the surrounding walls rustled down.
“Not good, it’s an earthquake!”Eureka’s face slightly changed, and he hurriedly said, “This place is about to collapse, quickly leave…”before he could finish his words, he suddenly stopped and stared at the stone door in front of him with his mouth agape.
Rumble!
The Crack in the middle of the stone door slowly cracked open, and under the trembling sound of the ground, it gradually pulled open to both sides. Thick dust rolled out from under the stone door and pounced on the group, making their faces Dusty.
Whoosh!
The sound of wind suddenly came out from the stone door.
Soon, the stone door was completely gone. It shrank back into the wall on both sides. A large amount of stone chips fell off the wall.
The few of them raised their hands to protect their faces. They squinted their eyes and looked inside. The stone door was pitch black and there was no light. It looked like a black bloody mouth waiting for them to enter.
Eureka, the blonde woman and others were secretly shocked. They didn’t dare to move.
Dudian was completely shocked when he saw the door open. It was actually opened! Not to mention that there was still energy here. The opening of the door was too strange!
Could it be that the previous scan was not an iris scan?
However, he had been in his father’s research institute since young. He was very familiar with the iris scan and fingerprint scan. The previous scan was clearly an iris scan!
He couldn’t help but look at Eureka, the blonde woman and the others. They were nervous and vigilant. Their muscles were tense as if they were ready to fight with the previous ‘people’.
It didn’t seem like they were pretending.
He recalled the scene of the previous iris scan. Eureka stepped back while the blonde woman and the other two covered their heads. It seemed that… he was the only one who had been scanned.
“In other words, this is the first time they are here. Is it because of me that the door was opened?”Dudian was puzzled. Could it be that this place had something to do with him? But he had never been here before. He didn’t remember that there was such a thing buried underground.
According to the previous electronic voice, this place seemed to be called “Shelter”?
Was it a place built by the people of the old era to avoid disaster?
Dudian was puzzled. The thick fog gradually settled down and revealed the scene inside the stone door. Although it was dark but Dudian’s dark vision didn’t hinder him, there were dozens of human skeletons lying on the ground!
The skeletons seemed to have decayed. They were wrapped in the clothes of the old era. Surprisingly, these clothes were well preserved and not seriously eroded by the passage of time.
There were all kinds of clothes. There were dresses, jeans and shorts, long sleeves and so on.
Dudian was stunned. These clothes were ordinary clothes from the old era. Could it be that the corpses on the ground were ordinary people from the old era?
“Start the fire.”Eureka’s voice sounded.
The middle-aged man took out a torch from his backpack. He poured oil on it and lit it. The weak light of the torch immediately dispelled the darkness in front of them. The bones on the ground were reflected in their eyes.
Eureka’s eyes lit up as he looked at the metal instrument by the stone door. He thought that this should be the device to open the relic.
He turned to look at Dudian. He frowned. Did this kid accidentally touch it or did he already know the use of this device?
“I didn’t expect that this is the thing to open the relic. Brother Eureka, what kind of relic is this? Is there any treasure inside?”Dudian saw Eureka’s eyes, he asked.
Eureka’s eyes lit up when he heard Dudian’s words. He thought that even if this kid had a good relationship with her Highness Haisha, he might not know about the relic. After all.., it was a product of the old era more than three hundred years ago. Even Her Highness Haisha didn’t know about it, let alone him?
“I don’t know.”Eureka looked back at the dark relic. He looked at the middle-aged man who was holding a torch: “You, go ahead and light the way.”
The middle-aged man’s expression changed. He hurriedly said, “General, I’m not good at defense. I…”
“If I tell you to go, then go.”Eureka berated. Then, his tone softened a little, he said indifferently, “In my opinion, this should be a treasure ruin. If It’s a dangerous ruin with traps, we will be attacked when the door opens.”
The middle-aged man was slightly startled and could not help but have a thought. However, he was an experienced hunter after all and quickly suppressed his greed. He thought to himself, “In your opinion?”? “How can my life be a scapegoat for you with just a Guess?”?
“General, my perceptive ability is relatively weak. If I walk in front and encounter any danger, I’m afraid I won’t be able to sense it in advance. I’m afraid that I will harm everyone.”The middle-aged man changed the angle of interest and persuaded.
When Eureka heard his words, how could he not understand his thoughts? He snorted coldly and said, “I said, there’s no danger in here. If you continue to talk, I’ll directly throw you in!”
The middle-aged man’s expression was ugly. He knew that there was no way to change things. He secretly gritted his teeth, shouldered the burden and held the torch high. He slowly stepped into the ruins. Every step he took felt like he was stepping into a swamp of death, he would fall down at any time.
Crack!
Dudian’s boots broke the bones on the ground. The bones which had lost moisture were extremely fragile.
Dudian quietly followed in the middle of the team. He was a body away from Eureka. Although Eureka’s attitude towards him had always been calm and there was a task to protect him. But when the real danger came.., it was difficult to guarantee that he wouldn’t grab him and use him as a scapegoat.
To survive outside the giant wall, every step depended on wisdom.
Soon, all of them entered the ruins.
The middle-aged man stepped out of the pile of corpses at the entrance and slowly went deeper into the darkness in front of the torch.
Dudian used his dark vision to scan the surroundings when he entered the ruins. He found that there was an extremely spacious circular hall in the ruins. There were corpses everywhere on the ground, all of them were wearing the clothes of ordinary people from the old era.
In addition to the dozens of skeletons in front of the door, there were more corpses scattered around the circular hall. In some corners, there were more than hundreds of skeletons piled up like a mountain of corpses, they were wrapped in the clothes of the old era. They were lying there quietly. Their empty eyes were filled with loneliness.
There was an indescribable feeling in Dudian’s heart when he saw the corpses dressed in the clothes of the old era. It was like sadness or loneliness. The memories of the old era slowly appeared in front of his eyes. However, perhaps it was because he had been sealed for too long. He suddenly felt that the only thing that appeared in his mind was a vague steel jungle city.
And the faces of his father, mother, and sister.
Other than that, he felt that his impression of other things was somewhat blurry.
Was it because he had been away for too long that he had forgotten about it?
“Are these skeletons all humans from the old era? Why are there so many of them?”The blonde-haired woman looked at the skeletons around her. Among them, she saw some broken hands and half of the skeletons scattered on the ground, it was her first time seeing a group of skeletons from the old era. She felt a strong sense of shock.
“The bodies of these humans from the old era seem to be very fragile,”the young man on the other side said. He stepped on the ribs of one of the skeletons without any hesitation. He did not choose another place to step on. He did not care about the objects under his feet at all, “Even if they have died for 300 years, the bones are too pink. I heard that some of us with special abilities have died for more than 100 years. Their bones are as hard as steel. These skeletons are made of flour at most.”
“There are weak and strong people in any era. These should be the weak.”Eureka indifferently said. He looked around and frowned. It was too quiet inside. There was no sound. Could it be that.., there were no living things inside?
Dudian retracted his thoughts after hearing their words. He looked at the piles of bones around him. He was sure that this place was just a shelter built before the disaster. It could be seen from the bones on the ground, most of the bones were women and children. They were not valuable storage places for the weapons of the old era.
He was a bit disappointed but he didn’t feel too regretful. After all, if there were high-tech items from the old era and Eureka was there, he would have to hand them over to the Dragon Clan and fall into the hands of the inner wall, it would be a hindrance to his future.
“There seems to be a fight here.”
“There are many broken limbs and bones.”
The blonde woman and the other two said.
Dudian frowned. He had already noticed this point. It was obvious that these people were selected by the army and sent to this shelter. The fight here was mostly because of the food.
“Could it be that there is no way to open the door?”Dudian looked back at the two sides of the door but didn’t see the iris scanner. He couldn’t help but frown, they had to fight for food here. In other words, the people who sent the survivors were planning to wait for the disaster to end so that they could open the door from the outside.
The only use of this method was to prevent the people inside from opening the shelter and sacrificing everyone.
Soon, the middle-aged man held the torch and went deep into the center of the circular hall. At this time, Dudian passed by a pile of corpses. Because of the angle, he saw the outline of a door under the gap of the pile of corpses. From the height, it seemed to be about three meters.
His eyes focused and he quietly looked around. However, he used his peripheral vision to carefully look at the pile of corpses. Soon he found that it was not his illusion, there was indeed a door hidden under the pile of corpses.
He didn’t tell Eureka and the others about it. On the contrary, he planned to wait for the next time to secretly look at it. In any case, Eureka and the others wouldn’t be able to move it with the size of the ruins.
Although he didn’t know what was inside the door but since he had found the secret, he wouldn’t easily share it with others.
If there were treasures hidden inside, he would be killed!
“There is a black shadow over there. What is it?”Dudian immediately pointed to another place.
Eureka and the others were a bit nervous after hearing Dudian’s words. Especially the middle-aged man who was holding the torch in front of them. He swallowed his saliva and pointed the torch to the place where Dudian was pointing, they slowly approached the place but found that it was just a pile of corpses. They were relieved and a bit angry. However they resisted the urge to scold Dudian because of his unknown identity.
“This place is very big. There shouldn’t be any danger at the moment. Let’s light it first.”Eureka said.
Dudian secretly thought that it was not good. They might find the door if there was light.
The three of them immediately took out their torches and oil. They lit them and inserted them into the pile of corpses. Several torches and oil lamps lit up in the dark. The outline of the hall was illuminated.
“They are going to be found.”Dudian saw that the three of them were still lighting the new oil dish. He knew that the door would be exposed sooner or later. He sighed in his heart. It seemed that it was not his opportunity.
He didn’t force them. After all, it was inevitable.
Crack!
Suddenly, there were footsteps coming from the gate of the ruins. There was the sound of stones being kicked away.
Everyone was startled and looked back.
Dudian’s face changed as he saw three giant undeads coming from the gate of the ruins!
“Not good! They are giant undeads!”He shouted.
Eureka’s heart skipped a beat as he heard Dudian’s words. This kid’s perception was very strong! He saw three giant undeads coming from the ruins. He was shocked as he thought. How could there be three giant undeads here? Did they follow their smell?
“DAMN!”Eureka gritted his teeth: “Step Back!”
His body slightly crouched as he jumped out.
“Are they giant undeads?”The Blonde Woman and the other two quickly stepped back. They weren’t monsters that they could fight.
Dudian frowned as he stared at Eureka’s figure. He didn’t know if he could deal with the three giant undeads.

chapters.title: Chapter 586
chapters.content:
Chapter 586
Whoosh!
After activating the magic weapon, Eureka’s figure was as fast as a phantom. He was completely different from before. In the blink of an eye, he arrived in front of the three giant zombies. The corpses along the way were all trampled into powder. He suddenly waved the long spear-like dark weapon on his arm that had merged with his body. He jumped up and stabbed at the head of a male giant zombie.
With a whoosh, the vascular tissue of the male giant zombie was extremely flexible. It twisted its head to avoid Eureka’s attack, but there was a blood stain on its cheek.
Eureka missed the attack, and its body instantly pounced on the male giant zombie. Its tail wrapped around the waist of the male giant zombie, and its body used the force to kick on its abdomen. It quickly climbed onto its shoulder, like an agile monkey.
The giant zombie roared and waved its hand to grab at Eureka, but it missed. Eureka was like an agile loach.
Roar!
The half-meter-long neck on the giant zombie’s shoulder twisted and pounced at Eureka.
Eureka squinted its dark green eyes. It waited for a moment. The moment it was about to bite its body, the long spear on its arm suddenly stabbed out and pierced through its mouth. With a poof, it pierced through the back of its head!
All of this happened in the blink of an eye. In less than two or three seconds, a giant zombie fell to the ground and died.
Dudian, the blonde woman and the others were relieved. There was a bit of shock in their eyes. Eureka’s speed and strength had obviously increased by more than one level after activating the magic weapon.
“Is this the power of the magic weapon…”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he quietly clenched his hands.
After one giant undeads was killed, the other two rushed towards Eureka at the same time. However, their speed was slow and clumsy in front of Eureka. They didn’t touch his body but occasionally cut him with their claws, eureka’s black scales blocked the attack and didn’t cause any damage.
Dudian observed the rare pioneer battle scene. He had to say that Eureka’s fighting ability was very strong. He was able to steadily gain the upper hand in a one-on-two situation. There was no injury on his body, on the contrary, there were more and more wounds on the chest and neck of the two giant undeads.
Although these wounds didn’t affect the movement of the giant undeads but it was enough to see that Eureka was able to fight with ease.
“The giant undeads are no different from ordinary undeads. It’s just that their physiques are stronger. They fight by instinct. There is no order and skill. They only know how to attack.”Dudian observed, he noticed that the fighting style of the two giant undeads was very simple. There were no fighting skills. However, their fighting style and physiques would cause a lot of damage if they were to encounter a monster with low intelligence.
But if it was a human then they would be at a disadvantage.
Because they could see their attack methods so they could predict their attack direction and methods in advance. It would be twice the result with half the effort. This was the reason why Eureka was able to quickly kill the first giant undeads, but if it was a monster, it might not have such insight and cunning.
“So Powerful!”
“Is this the true strength of the general?”
“Too Powerful!”
The Blonde Woman and the other two held their torches high. With the weak light of the fire, they could only see faint afterimages. It was difficult to see Eureka’s movements clearly, but they could see the increasing wounds on the two giant zombies.
Half a minute later.
The battle ended quickly. All three giant undeads were killed.
Eureka panted slightly. He turned back to Dudian and the others: “We shouldn’t stay here for long. We should leave now.”
Dudian looked at him. Although the battle ended quickly but he could see that it consumed a lot of energy. Both ordinary people and pioneers had to maintain their full strength for almost the same amount of time.
Boom!
Suddenly, Dudian heard a low trembling sound coming from the ground above his head. He was slightly startled as he had an ominous feeling in his heart.
Eureka heard the trembling sound. Her face changed as she quickly leaned over to listen. Her pupils shrank as she quickly got up and said: “Get out of here. There are a lot of things up there!”
The blonde woman and the other two’s expressions changed, and they couldn’t help but clench their weapons, trying their best to remain calm.
Eureka turned around and led the team, rushing out of the ruins quickly. Just as they left the gate, they immediately stopped. They saw that there were some swaying figures in front of the passage that they had come from earlier. They were actually undeads!
Some of these undeads were ordinary human-sized undeads, but they had sickle-like arms. Some of them were bloated, like a ball, and some of them were tall and sturdy. They were giant undeads!
Different kinds of undeads had gathered here. They were staggering towards the crowd.
Everyone’s face changed.
Eureka’s pupils shrank. He couldn’t help but think of two words — zombie tide!
Only in the zombie tide would there be different kinds of undeads!
“DAMN!”Eureka clenched his teeth. He didn’t expect that he would encounter a zombie tide in an area that was often cleaned. He didn’t know how many undeads there were, if it was a small-scale zombie tide then he could deal with it. But if it was a medium-scale zombie tide then he could only save his own life.
“Get Ready to fight with me!”Eureka clenched his teeth: “You Guys Protect Dudian. If anything happens to him then don’t think about living. Do you understand?”
The blonde woman and the other two looked at dudian. They felt angry and resentful. The wasteland wasn’t a place to play house. They were of noble status but they had to come to such a place to suffer, wouldn’t they have nothing to do?
Dudian noticed the anger in the eyes of the three. He knew that he was a burden to them. He didn’t say anything but secretly paid attention to the situation, after all, orders were orders. who knew if they would obey or not?
“Kill!”
Eureka growled. He was like a black lion. He took the lead and rushed into the crowd. This was the only passage to the outside. He had to kill his way out as soon as possible. Otherwise, when the tide of zombies gathered, even he.., it would be difficult to escape.
“Follow us!”The Blonde Woman and the other two spoke to Dudian in a cold tone. The three formed a triangular formation and surrounded Dudian in the middle. They followed behind Eureka.
Soon, the few of them collided with the undeads in the passage. The battle broke out in an instant.
Eureka’s hands were as fast as lightning. He waved the dark spear in his arm and quickly killed the undeads. He didn’t want to kill the undeads in this group battle. He only wanted to beat them back. Therefore he didn’t want to attack their heads, the fight was getting fiercer and fiercer. He was like a humanoid tank that crashed into the pile of undeads. He immediately sent seven or eight of them flying.
The three golden-haired women formed a triangular formation to protect Dudian as he followed Eureka. They blocked the undeads that were sent flying.
The three of them were dragon guards after all. In addition to the giant undeads, other ordinary undeads and scythe undeads were easily killed by them. Some of their heads fell off, some of them were kicked back into the zombie crowd.
After rushing into the zombie crowd for more than ten meters, a giant undeads that was repelled by Eureka got up from the ground and rushed towards Dudian and the others.
The Blonde Woman and the other two turned pale and hurriedly shouted: “General!”
Eureka heard the voice. He looked back and suddenly roared. He jumped up and pounced on the giant undeads. His tail quickly wrapped around the blood vessels on its neck. The scales on its tail suddenly stood up, it was like a sharp blade. As the tail tightened, the blade continued to cut into its neck. Blood flowed out and the scales on its tail were frozen into white frost crystals.
His body was caught by the giant undead. He had to fight back.
At this time, the other undeads rushed towards Dudian and the others. In addition to the skeleton undeads, there were also the bloated carrion undeads. They were Level 42 and were extremely strong. The middle-aged man on the left side of the line was knocked to the side, they leaned towards Dudian who was in the encirclement.
Dudian immediately put his hand on the middle-aged man’s back. He shook his elbow to get rid of the impact.
After the middle-aged man stabilized his body, he immediately swung his knife and stabbed into the body of the carrion undeads. The blade easily penetrated into its body. However, when the middle-aged man wanted to pull out his knife, he couldn’t pull it out.
At this time, a huge mouth full of strange teeth suddenly opened from the fat belly of the zombie and bit towards the middle-aged man.
“Be careful!”The youth next to him hurriedly stabbed his sword towards the middle-aged man’s belly.
Whoosh!
At the same time as he pulled out his sword, a black figure suddenly jumped out of the zombie crowd and pounced towards the back of the youth. The youth who couldn’t react in time fell to the ground and pressed onto the youth’s body to bite his face.
Dudian and the blonde woman looked at it. It was a lizard-like undead with scales all over its body. Its two legs had degenerated into a tail. It was one of the senior undeads, level 46!
“No, no!”The youth tried to push him but his face was torn into a bloody mess by a few short claws.
With a puff, a black shadow suddenly flashed and wrapped around the neck of the Strange Walker on the young man’s body, pulling him up and landing heavily on the ground. It was Eureka, who had struggled free from the giant walker.
“Follow me!”Eureka shouted and rushed forward.
The blonde woman hurriedly helped the young man up from the ground. Suddenly, she felt a hand holding her foot. Looking down, she saw that it was an ordinary walker that had been cut into two pieces by her.
She was furious. She raised her foot and stomped on its head. With a poof, its head split open, revealing the hardened brain tissue inside.
She kicked the zombie away. With a poof, the zombie’s shoulder was split open. Its body flew into the zombie crowd, but its arm was still clutching her ankle. At this moment, she had no time to squat down and pull the zombie’s hand down.., she could only ignore it and follow behind Eureka.
Soon, under the lead of Eureka, the group of undeads forced their way out of the crowd. They climbed down the steep slope and climbed outside.
Roar! Roar!
As soon as they came to the ground, they heard a deafening roar.
Dudian’s heart couldn’t help but tremble as he heard the hoarse roars. He looked up and saw that there were a lot of undeads wandering around the rubble, hundreds of meters in front of them were thousands of undeads. Some of them were larger than the giant undeads but their bodies didn’t look like human figures. Instead, they looked like a giant elephant, they were extremely bloated.
The tremors that they had heard from underground were caused by the movement of the undeads.
“This is… The tide of undeads? !”Dudian was shocked, it was the first time that he had seen so many strange undeads. Many of them were strange undeads. The so-called strange undeads weren’t the names of a single undeads but a general term which referred to the body of a beast!
“Run!”
Eureka growled as he rushed towards a place where there were fewer undeads. He was like a mad lion as he opened a path in front of the undeads.
Dudian, the blonde woman and others followed him at full speed.
The ordinary undeads behind them couldn’t keep up with the speed of the undeads so they were far behind them. However, there were undeads that were moving at an extremely fast speed. Some of them were like spiders, there were three or four arms under their armpits. Some of them were like the lizard undeads that had been killed. Some of them were crawling on the ground at an extremely fast speed. Some of them had thin wings on their back.
Dudian saw that one of the undeads was wearing a broken armor. The armor was covered with dust and blood. However he could see a fragment of a dragon pattern, it was a dragon warrior who had been infected by the undeads.
At the moment the undeads were chasing after them. They were extremely fast. In the blink of an eye they were close to Dudian and the others.
“DAMN!”The blonde woman shouted in anger.
Eureka turned around and saw seven or eight undeads chasing after them. He was shocked as he waved his arms to send two undeads flying. He looked around and saw a large number of undeads wandering aimlessly, the number of undeads was extremely large.
“How come there are so many high-level undeads? Could it be the middle-sized undeads?”Eureka’s face was ugly. He clenched his teeth and increased his speed by 30% .
At this moment, the injured young man fell at the back of the group. He was immediately caught up by the zombie wearing the broken armor. He fell to the ground and was unable to resist at all. Meanwhile, the other zombies who were chasing him smelled the blood, they immediately rushed over.
“AH –”the young man screamed in pain, full of extreme fear.
“General!”The blonde woman hurriedly shouted.
Eureka had long noticed what had happened and said in a low voice, “I can’t save them. Follow me, I’m going to speed up again!”
The blonde woman and the middle-aged man looked back and immediately saw one of the lizard-like zombies suddenly raising its head, as if it was trying its best to bite. It had a piece of bloody internal organs in its mouth, and as it swung left and right.., it quickly swallowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 587
chapters.content:
Chapter 587
“Run!”
Dudian’s face slightly changed as he saw that the young man was dead. He shouted at the blonde woman and middle-aged man. At the same time, he suddenly increased his speed and caught up with Eureka, his body was as agile as a fish as he dodged the attack of a fish that had escaped the net.
Although a low-level skeleton could kill him with one punch, but it would affect his speed. In such a tide of zombies, even pioneers wouldn’t be able to escape death!
The blonde woman and middle-aged man looked at the scene of the young man being bitten by the undeads. Although they didn’t have a deep friendship with the young man, but they were comrades after all. It was inevitable for them to have a bit of grief and indignation. At the moment they heard Dudian’s shout. They immediately came back to their senses. They saw more and more undeads coming from all directions. The grief and indignation in their hearts were replaced by fear.
Run!
They didn’t dare to stay and quickly turned around to run.
They were running at full speed. They couldn’t help but pray in their hearts that the high-level undeads behind them would be able to eat the young man’s corpse for a while.
Roar! Roar!
The surrounding undeads gradually gathered towards them. The whistling sound was like a tidal wave.
Eureka’s speed was extremely fast. He was like an angry beast as he rushed towards the undeads. His tail, arms, head and whole body seemed to be turned into weapons, he was like a black tank.
The blonde woman and middle-aged man used all their strength to run. They felt that their legs were too fast to listen to their brain. However, they could only watch as Eureka was getting further and further away from them. At the same time, both of them suddenly found out that Dudian’s speed was much faster than theirs. He had been following Eureka closely.
Both of them were shocked. was the strength of this teenager so strong?
Roar!
A low roar came from behind. The trembling of the ground was getting closer and closer.
The Blonde Woman and middle-aged man’s heart turned cold. They knew that there were a few fast undeads chasing after them. Their hair stood on end. There was no doubt that they were terrified, if they were entangled by the undeads then Eureka wouldn’t turn back to save them. After all, they weren’t as lucky as Dudian.
Both of them were in fear and despair.
Run! My Leg!
The middle-aged man screamed in his heart. Fear climbed onto his face.
His speed increased as death approached. He had a strong desire to survive so he burst out at a speed that he had never reached before!
However, he suddenly saw that the blonde woman was faster than him. She was one or two steps ahead of him!
Wasn’t she not good at speed?
The middle-aged man’s mind was blank. Suddenly, he heard a roar coming from behind him. In the blink of an eye, it appeared not far from the back of his head. It seemed that… The undeads were following closely behind him!
His face was full of fear. He turned his head with difficulty.
At the same time, a blood-red giant mouth suddenly bit his face.
Dudian heard the sounds of wrestling and the excited roars of the undeads. His face slightly changed. He didn’t turn back because it would affect his speed. However, he slightly tilted his head, he saw that the middle-aged man had been pushed to the ground by several strange undeads. He was struggling and pushing the undeads. But after all, he only had two hands, there were four or five undeads on his body. At this moment, more undeads were gathering and quickly drowned him.
A scream came out from the pile of undeads. At the same time, the undeads who were crawling outside the pile of undeads couldn’t get in, they continued to chase after them.
Dudian’s face was ugly. In this moment of life and death, he suddenly felt that nothing was important. It was the best if he could live!
“Dudian, Pull Me!”At this time, the blonde woman was chasing at full speed. She begged Dudian. Her blonde hair covered her face in a mess.
Dudian looked at her from the corner of his eyes. He was more than ten meters away from her. If he wanted to pull her, he would have to slow down by ten meters. Although it would take less than 0.1 second.., but once he slowed down, it wouldn’t be as simple as 0.1 second to sprint another ten meters.
“Sorry…”he slightly bowed his head and said. He ran at full speed and followed behind Eureka.
The Blonde Woman’s face changed as she heard Dudian’s words. There was a trace of resentment in her eyes. At the same time, there was a roar coming from behind her.
Her pupils shrank as she instinctively looked back. However, it would affect her speed. She clenched her teeth, dudian didn’t look back as he begged: “Please, we have been protecting you all the way. Can’t you help me? Please, you help me. I will go back and make love with you. I will use my body to repay you. You can do whatever you want. Please…”
Dudian clenched his teeth and continued to run.
The Blonde Woman’s heart was in despair when she saw that Dudian didn’t slow down. At the same time, a claw covered with blood suddenly touched her shoulder. Her mind went blank.
Four or five sharp claws reached out from behind her and grabbed her shoulders. Some held her head while others hugged her waist. Her body was pulled as she ran at full speed, the next moment she was dragged into the zombie crowd. The Sky disappeared and was covered by ugly faces.
Dudian’s face slightly changed as he heard the screams. He didn’t need to look to know that it was the blonde woman. He clenched his teeth and didn’t look back. He tried his best to maintain his full speed as he followed behind Eureka.
“Get Out! Get Out!”
Eureka roared as he rushed forward. He sent the undeads flying and forced a bloody path that stretched for miles! However, he wasn’t happy even though he was thousands of meters away from the undeads. There was a large number of scattered undeads in his field of vision. Wasn’t the scale of the undead tide too large?
Fortunately, he felt that Dudian was still following him closely. As for the other three who had died one after another, although it had slightly stimulated his nerves, he didn’t take it to heart. He had been guarding the wasteland for many years.., he had long been accustomed to the death of his comrades. He wasn’t used to it, but numb.
As long as Dudian could survive, he wouldn’t be punished by Aisha.
From the previous secret explanation, he knew that Aisha wasn’t joking.
“If you want to live, then follow me!”Eureka roared as he rushed past the giant undeads.
Dudian saw the giant undeads coming at him again. His hair stood on end as he activated all the power in his body. He entered primary limiter mode. A large amount of white bones oozed out from under his skin and covered his whole body. At the same time.., his speed burst out again. He rushed out like a cannonball and bit down on the position less than five meters behind Eureka. This distance was the limit!
If he was pulled further away, he would most likely lose Eureka!
At that time, he would have to open a path by himself or activate his wings. But using wings to fly was no longer a matter of exposure. Even if he used wings to fly, he might not be able to rush out of the tide of Undeads Alive!
Both of them ran in a straight line at full speed.
The surrounding zombies quickly gathered towards them.
The strange undeads who had eaten the blonde woman were chasing after them again. But their speed was slightly slower than Dudian’s. They could barely keep up with them from hundreds of meters away.
Eureka looked forward as he rushed. He suddenly found that the number of undeads was less than a thousand meters away.
His eyes lit up. He had finally reached the edge of the zombie tide!
“Fortunately, the zombie tide hasn’t fully formed yet. If we keep the size of the zombie tide and sink this deep, it will be really dangerous this time!”Eureka secretly heaved a sigh of relief and thought.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, an extremely fast sound flew over.
The sound was like a buzzing sound and was ear-piercing.
Eureka was startled as he felt the hair on his body stand up. He couldn’t help but turn his head.
Puff!
A black spear fell from the sky. It pierced through his shoulder like a black lightning. The strong impact caused his body to be nailed to the ground several meters in front of him.
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he was behind Eureka. He didn’t react at all. When he heard the sound, he saw that Eureka had been sent flying by a black object.
“Spear?”Dudian saw that Eureka’s shoulder was pierced by a two meter long black spear which nailed his body into the black soil.
Eureka coughed out a mouthful of blood. There was shock and a trace of fear in his eyes. He turned his head and saw a black figure flying over from the dark clouds. There was a pair of huge wings on its back!
However, these wings were badly damaged. They looked like the fallen angels depicted in the monastery’s bible.
Could it be that the Bible was real?
Such a strange thought appeared in his mind. However, it was dispelled by reason and pain in a flash. His pupils contracted slightly. His high-power vision was magnified at this moment, and he instantly saw the face of the black figure flying over.
His face was full of shock as he shouted: “King Undead?”
Dudian looked back when he saw the black spear on Eureka’s body. He quickly noticed the black figure flying towards him. His thermal vision didn’t see any heat source on the body of the black figure. He was shocked, could it be a winged race expert?
He heard Eureka’s shocked voice. King Undead? There was a zombie king here?
He had learned some information about zombie king from Ian and the others. In the past two days in the fortress, he had read about the zombie tide and Zombie King from books. According to the legends, Zombie King was the final form of the evolution of zombies, it was easier to meet in the zombie tide, but it was not absolute. Not all zombie tides would have zombie king mixed in, but zombie king must be from the zombie tide!
Moreover, the zombie King’s hunting level was the same as that of monsters. There were strong and weak zombie kings. The strong ones could easily kill pioneers, and the weak ones were comparable to pioneers.
Dudian didn’t expect to meet a zombie king here. After all, Eureka was only a pioneer, and the zombie king could call undeads or even control undeads. He was no match for Eureka.
Puff!
Eureka was nailed to the ground by the Black Spear. He suddenly put his hands on the ground and jumped. He pulled out his body from the end of the spear and continued to run forward.
Dudian was startled and hurriedly followed behind him.
However, Eureka’s speed was faster than before. Dudian’s full speed wasn’t enough to catch up. He was thrown more than ten meters away.
Dudian’s face changed. He suddenly realized that Eureka was aware that his life was in danger so he burst out with extraordinary speed. In other words, Eureka wouldn’t care about him at this time!
Dudian clenched his teeth and immediately activated the wings on his back. He flapped his wings and followed after Eureka! He didn’t dare to fly high in the sky. The king of undead had wings. If he flew high in the sky then it would be difficult to avoid attracting its attention. He would use his life to buy time for Eureka to escape.
Dudian was running at full speed. He was paying attention to the king of undead from the corner of his eyes. He was afraid that the king of undead would use long-range attacks again. If he was hit by the spear then he might be killed on the spot.
Whoosh!
Dudian was praying when the sound of air breaking came again.
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he saw a black shadow flying towards him. He tried to dodge but his body seemed to have become dull. Puff! A black bead brushed past his shoulder and shot into the ground.
Dudian was scared out of his wits as he rushed at full speed.
Bang!
Suddenly, the ground under Dudian’s feet rumbled!
His pupils shrank as he looked at the front where the tremors were the most intense. He saw a terrifying scene.
The ground under Eureka’s body exploded as a giant hand stretched out from the inside. The width of the palm was almost two meters. Eureka was caught by the giant hand, the soil under the palm cracked and a huge figure sat up from the ground. The sky and light were blocked.
Dudian was stunned.
This… was a super giant undeads!
In addition to the terrifying difference in size, the structure of the body was similar to the giant undeads that Dudian had seen before. There were several spikes on the chest and back of the giant undeads.
The giant undeads that Dudian had encountered before were only children compared to the giant undeads.

chapters.title: Chapter 588
chapters.content:
Chapter 588
Eureka’s scream echoed as Dudian was stunned. His body was tightly gripped by the giant zombie’s hand. His arms and legs were tightly bound, there was only a dark tail at the bottom of his hand. The tip of the tail was hooked back into the back of his hand. However the giant zombie didn’t feel any pain. It clenched its hand tighter and tighter.
Crack!
Eureka couldn’t help but scream as the sound of bones breaking echoed. The tail that pierced into the giant palm became soft in pain. It shook in the air like a cramp.
Soon, the sound of bones breaking became more and more frequent. Eureka struggled violently but couldn’t exert any strength. It didn’t take long for Dudian to see a lot of blood gushing out of his mouth, at the same time, blood was pouring out of his ears, eyes and nostrils.
Soon, the scream stopped. Bang! The giant hand suddenly clenched. Thick blood was spurting out from the thumb of the giant hand.
The next moment, the Super Giant undeads let go of its hand. The sticky and broken body parts slid down from its palm. It raised its hand to its mouth and licked its mouth, it slowly moved its eyes and looked at the small figure in front of it.
Dudian’s throat was moving. His mind was blank. All of this happened in two or three seconds. Eureka was dead. As a pioneer, he was one of the eight generals guarding the wasteland! He had died so easily!
The fear that he had never felt before gripped his heart. He even forgot to breathe. At this moment he suddenly thought that if God allowed him to return to the giant wall, he would rather live in the giant wall forever and never take another step!
When death was standing in front of him and he was powerless to resist, he realized that life was so humble and his self-esteem was so worthless. The so-called meaning of living was just a stupid and childish idea that he had nothing to do but eat, because just being able to live was already a beautiful thing!
Whoosh!
A whistling sound flew over and stopped above Dudian’s head.
Dudian’s hair stood on end. The blood in his body seemed to be frozen. He didn’t dare to move. He slowly moved his eyes and saw the king corpse behind him. There were two broken wings on its back, it was above his head!
It was looking down at him from above.
Fear and despair. What would be left in his brain when these two situations appeared at the same time?
Would it be a blank?
Whoosh!
The corpse king’s figure slowly descended. The flapping of its wings brought a gentle breeze. However, the breeze was mixed with the smell of rotting corpses.
The next moment, Dudian heard the ground slightly tremble behind his body. At the same time, the cold breath with the smell of blood and corpse came from the back of his neck. It seemed that the corpse king was standing behind him, it was staring at him.
Dudian’s heart suddenly stopped.
Time seemed to slow down. There was no sound in the air.
He was going to die!
There was no doubt that this kind of self-judgment was desperate. But at the same time, there seemed to be a kind of courage in his heart. Since he was going to die, what was there to be afraid of?
He clenched his fist and suddenly turned around.
Bang!
His fist hit a hard object. It wasn’t an absolute hard object like metal but was ten thousand times stronger than rubber.
His fist hit the chest of the King Corpse. At this moment, the man and the corpse were facing each other.
Dudian also saw the face of the King Corpse. There was no white in its black pupils. There were several scars on its face. It seemed that it had just been left not long ago. There was no trace of anger or emotion on its face.
Bang!
All of a sudden, Dudian could only see a vague black shadow. It seemed to be the fist of the King Corpse. The next moment, the pain hit his entire chest. The signal from the pain nerves occupied all of his consciousness. His body flew back as if he was flying into space. His body couldn’t feel the gravity, he felt a sharp pain coming from his back and hit something.
He coughed up a mouthful of blood. He felt that his chest was burning hot, and he felt suffocated. He tried his best to look up, and immediately found that the scenery around him was slowly sinking. To be more precise, his body was rising automatically.
He suddenly turned his head and immediately found himself in the palm of the super giant zombie. At that moment, he was lifted up and sent into its huge bloody mouth.
There were sharp teeth in the huge black mouth. One of the teeth was holding a dark object. It was Eureka’s broken thigh!
No!
Dudian’s pupils dilated.
Whoosh!
Suddenly a whistling sound came from the distant sky.
When Dudian heard the whistling sound, a strong wind suddenly came from behind. His hair was pressed flat on the back of his head. His armor was in tatters. At the same time.., there was a flash of red light above his head. It was like a red lightning that went into the giant mouth of the super giant undeads. Bang! Dudian felt his giant palm shake. The next moment.., there was a loud roar from the ground behind the super giant undeads.
Dudian couldn’t help but look. He was stunned on the spot.
He saw a faint light coming out from the giant mouth of the super giant undeads. It seemed that the giant mouth was penetrated!
Whoosh! Whoosh!
At the same time, several flying sounds were heard. Dudian felt his body become light. A soft hand grabbed his arm and took him high up in the air. He couldn’t help but turn his head to look, he saw a familiar face: Aisha.
“Are You Alright?”Aisha tilted her head to look at him. There was a trace of deep meaning in her eyes.
Dean’s stiff mind slowly recovered. He was startled for a moment. He suddenly thought of the zombie king and immediately said: “Be careful, the zombie king is still there.”
“I’m fine.”Aisha whispered. Her body fell rapidly and landed on the ground. At the same time, a loud rumble was heard behind her.
Dean looked back and saw the super giant zombie fall down and hit the ground, raising a large amount of dust.
When the dust spread over, Dudian felt that Haisha let go of him. He immediately steadied himself and used the dragon’s blood skill that she had taught him to control his heart. He changed the direction of blood flow and stopped the blood in his chest, then he used a small amount of blood to gently soothe the past and slowly heal.
“You rest here. I will deal with it soon.”Haisha’s voice came from the edge of the dust. As she finished her words, a strong wind swept up and blew away the dust. She was holding a blood red giant sword and dragged it out from the ground, she walked towards the corpse king step by step.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
At the same time, several figures rushed over from the sky and landed beside Aisha.
Dudian was startled. Was Hathaway also there?
Hathaway had noticed Dudian long ago. When she saw Dudian looking at her, a trace of craftiness flashed in her eyes. She playfully stuck out her tongue at Dudian, it was the same as when she played Aisha and dated dudian.
Dudian frowned as he looked at her.
“I didn’t expect you to be here. You Didn’t die when you met the corpse king and the giant God.”Hathaway smiled as she looked at dudian.
Dudian’s face sank as he didn’t speak.
“After all, you are too young. You were so scared that you couldn’t move. You actually watched the giant God eat you. You are so weak.”Hathaway showed her white teeth, she smiled: “In the Knight Poems, Heroes Save Beauties, but in our place, she became a beauty saving a bear. Sister, it seems that you are better than me in everything, but your taste in people is much worse than mine!”
“Shut up!”Aisha turned her head and looked at her coldly.
Hathaway slightly shrugged, “It’s the truth…”before she finished her words, she suddenly stopped, and a wisp of cold air pressed against her neck. It was the tip of the blood-red giant sword in Aisha’s hand.
A middle-aged man saw the stiff atmosphere and hurriedly said: “Your Highness Aisha, Her Highness Hathaway is just a joke flower. Why Do You Mind? Let’s finish off this corpse king first.”
Aisha coldly snorted and put away the greatsword. She raised her head and stared at the corpse king who was slowly walking in front of her. Her eyes slightly flashed.
The smile on Hathaway’s face had long disappeared. She expressionlessly turned her head and looked at the corpse king, “It killed the executioner. Its body still has the smell of the executioner.”Her voice was clear and clear.
Dudian was surprised. The Executioner was killed? And by the King Corpse?
“Reynolds, you stay and take care of him.”Aisha said to the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man was startled. He was a pioneer. How could he stay and protect the teenager? However, he couldn’t help but look at Dudian as he thought that the two sisters were quarreling about the teenager. He couldn’t help but look at Dudian. He was handsome and not rare. The heat source in his body was also ordinary, but he was at the level of a limiter.
He frowned and said to Aisha: “Your Highness, the King of Corpses is able to kill the executioner. He should be a strong king of corpses. If I don’t help…”
“You don’t need to.”Aisha interrupted him, “You just take care of him. This corpse king is stronger than you think, not ordinary pioneers can intervene. Hathaway, come over and help me end the battle as soon as possible, to prevent the corpse tide from gathering.”
Hathaway pretended to be surprised and said: “Sister, I am only an ordinary pioneer. Aren’t you afraid that I will be in danger?”
Aisha glanced at her and said: “You better activate the magic soldier, or else you will die even if your bloodline is awakened.”
Hathaway slightly pouted and showed an unwilling expression, but there was a trace of solemnity in her eyes. She pulled out the huge spear on her back, clenched her fingers, and the spear slowly melted, crawling all over her body like wax, she firmly wrapped her body and instantly turned into a magic dragon that was almost three meters tall, with dark red wings on her back and a huge dragon tail on her tail.
However, compared to a real demon dragon, it looked a bit like a human, such as standing upright, arms that looked like human arms, and a chest with breasts.
Aisha stared at the corpse king. Seeing that it didn’t attack right away, she suddenly thought of something. She turned around and saw the surrounding zombies slowly gathering around her. Her face couldn’t help but darken. obviously.., when they were talking, the Corpse King didn’t take the opportunity to attack. It wasn’t because it was polite, but because it sensed that the enemy was unusual, so it took the opportunity to gather the zombies.
“Attack!”Aisha made a quick decision. With a low shout, she suddenly rushed forward, sweeping up a cloud of dust along the way.
Hathaway followed closely behind without saying anything. After using her magic weapon to enter a full combat state, her speed was about the same as Aisha’s. They rushed to the corpse king almost at the same time. The two seemed to have a tacit understanding, they quickly split up and attacked the king from both sides.
“Let’s retreat first.”Reynolds who was ordered to protect Dudian immediately took Dudian back. Even without Aisha’s words, he knew that his role in the battle was minimal, the possibility of sacrifice was very high. He knew that the General King didn’t have the protection of the giant God’s corpse. The power of the giant God’s corpse wasn’t something that the pioneers could fight alone, it would take at least two or three pioneers to kill it.
“I heard that Eureka is with you. where is he?”Reynolds asked Dudian as he retreated.
Dudian looked at the battle in front of him. His face slightly changed as he whispered: “He was eaten by the giant God’s corpse.”
“What? !”Reynolds was shocked. He looked up at the giant God’s corpse. He noticed that one of its palms was stained with blood.
Roar! Roar!
At this time, a roar was heard from the surroundings. A large number of undeads were gathered from all directions. Many of them were very fast. They lunged at Dudian and Reynolds.
Reynolds’s face sank. He pulled out his sword and cut off the necks of several undeads.
After repelling several undeads, Reynolds saw that Dudian’s face was pale. He looked at his chest. It seemed that his ribs were broken. He took out a small bottle from his bag, he said: “Take one of the healing pills.”
Dudian took one of the pills and swallowed it.
As the pill entered his mouth, he felt that the burning pain in his chest had lessened a lot. At the same time, the energy in his body was gradually recovering. He was surprised as he didn’t expect the effect of the pill to be so fast.
As expected of the healing medicine that the pioneers carried with them. He sighed in his heart and quickly controlled his heart. With the effect of the pill, he accelerated the recovery of the injury in his chest. At the same time, he divided part of his attention to look at the battlefield in front of him.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Aisha and Hathaway were fighting with the corpse king. The three of them were extremely fast, like streaks of light. Every time they landed, the ground shook violently, as if they were hit by thousands of pounds of boulders.
However, the corpse king was able to deal with them in a one-on-two situation without being at a disadvantage.

chapters.title: Chapter 589
chapters.content:
Chapter 589
“So Strong!”Reynolds also noticed the battle in front of them. He was shocked when he saw that Aisha and Hathaway didn’t have the upper hand, the Undead King wasn’t an existence that ordinary pioneers could deal with. If it was combined with the undead tide, it would be comparable to those things in the depths of the Dark Wilderness..
Dudian’s heart sank when he saw Reynolds’shocked expression: “Can they win? Why Don’t you go and help them? I can hold on!”
Reynolds came back to his senses and waved his sword to kick a strange undead that was coming from the side, he looked at dudian: “This isn’t a battle that I can participate in. They should be fine. Her Highness Aisha hasn’t used her magic weapon yet. She is invincible. She can definitely win!”
His tone was very confident!
In his years as one of the eight generals, he had never seen this girl lose a battle. When he first met this girl, he blamed the higher-ups for sending such a young girl to guard the wasteland. But after seeing her incredible power that was completely out of line with her age.., he no longer doubted her. In his heart, this girl was the most terrifying monster. There was no monster that she couldn’t defeat!
He had never seen her appearance after activating the magic weapon because her usual posture was enough to defeat all the monsters that he had encountered!
Bang!
Suddenly, a dark red light fell rapidly and shot into the ground. There was a loud bang and a huge crater was created on the ground.
Dudian’s heart jumped. He looked at the huge crater and saw a figure covered in dark red scales. It was the appearance of Hathaway after activating the magic weapon. He was relieved. He looked up at the sky and saw two fast moving lights stopped. They were the King Corpse and Aisha. The two of them were facing each other. The King Corpse wasn’t like an ordinary undeads, it was only going to attack and bite. It seemed to be resting and observing Aisha.
Was it thinking?
Such a thought flashed through Dudian’s mind.
Whoosh!
The King corpse that had stopped rushed out again and rushed towards Haisha.
Haisha’s figure flashed and moved quickly. They fought fiercely in the air.
Dudian’s eyes were dazzled. He was a bit anxious. He suddenly thought of Hathaway. He looked at her and saw her sitting up from the giant pit. Her body moved up and down as she panted, she seemed to be resting on the ground.
“DAMN!”Dudian clenched his fist in anger.
Roar!
A hoarse roar suddenly came from the side.
Dudian was startled. He turned his head and saw a rotten face open its mouth. He quickly pulled out a dagger and stabbed it.
The dagger pierced through the face of the undeads. Dudian raised his foot and kicked the body of the undeads. He gently inhaled and covered his chest. He felt a tearing pain.
“Don’t look around. Take care of yourself first.”Renault quickly used his dagger to kill the undead. He turned to look at dudian: “You Can Fly. Take off immediately. There are too many undead on the ground.”
Dudian clenched his teeth as he endured the pain in his chest. He flapped his wings and flew into the air. He saw that the undead were gathering from all directions, there were still thousands of undeads rushing towards him at full speed. They raised a lot of dust and looked extremely spectacular.
Whoosh!
A green-skinned, flat-headed, fist-sized undeads jumped out of the undeads and directly jumped towards Dudian.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He wanted to flap his wings to change the trajectory but it was too late. The speed of the UNDEADS was too fast. He decisively raised his leg and aimed at the head of the strange zombie. Bang! It hit its forehead.
While he couldn’t change the trajectory, the strange zombie was also unable to change the trajectory. It was sent flying by a kick.
Dudian was about to use the momentum to continue to fly when he felt a soft, warm and slippery thing wrapped around his foot. He couldn’t help but look down. He saw that the strange zombie had a very long tongue sticking out of its mouth, it was wrapped around his leg.
“DAMN!”Dudian quickly bent over and used the dagger to cut it.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
At the same time he bent over, he saw several figures jump out from the crowd of undeads. There were several undeads with strange bodies. Their jumping ability was extremely shocking. One of the undeads’hair was completely glued together, it was like a piece of meat wing draped over his head.
Dudian’s face changed. He quickly swung his dagger and kicked at them.
Bang!
The alloy boots kicked on the chest of one of the undeads. The undeads pounced on Dudian’s feet and tightly hugged him. Then they desperately gnawed on the boots. Sharp teeth went down the front toe of the boots, they actually bit the boots until they were flat. The metal pressure made Dudian’s toes hurt.
At the same time, several other undeads came from other directions. Some of them didn’t jump at a good angle and didn’t hit Dudian but hit the undeads that had their tongues wrapped around his feet, they immediately climbed up the body of the undeads and grabbed its tongue as a rope. They quickly climbed onto Dudian’s feet and tightly hugged his legs.
“DAMN!”
Dudian hurriedly bent over and used the dagger to stab it.
Puff! The dagger pierced through the zombie’s head. The zombie bit his boots but didn’t dodge.
When the head was pierced through, the zombie’s hand immediately loosened and fell down vertically.
At the same time, a gust of wind came. Dudian felt his feet loosen. He saw the body of the zombie that was biting on the other leg fall down. Only the head was still biting on the boots, moreover its mouth was still biting desperately. It didn’t die.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He kicked its temple and its head flew out like a football. It fell in a parabolic trajectory into the crowd of undeads and was soon submerged.
On the ground, the position where he and Renault were standing had been completely submerged by the undeads.
“Thank you.”Dudian turned to Reynolds.
“Nothing…”Reynolds was about to say something when his body was hit by an object. He was sent flying back tens of meters.
Dudian’s pupils contracted. He turned his head and saw that the thing that hit Reynolds was an ugly undeads. It was tightly grasping onto his body and was trying to bite him.
Renault’s face turned red as he mustered up strength to push it away. He kicked its stomach and made it fall vertically.
Dudian was relieved as he saw that Renault had solved the crisis. His face changed as he saw several figures flying towards him from the corner of his eye.
Whoosh!
His body moved instinctively and almost missed the trajectory of a black shadow. His body was covered in cold sweat. He couldn’t afford to be distracted.
Rumble!
The ground suddenly rumbled.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He looked down and was stunned. He saw that the soil under the zombie crowd had cracked. He was very familiar with the scene. As expected, a giant figure slowly sat up from the cracked soil, it was the giant God’s corpse!
“Impossible!”Reynolds flew to Dudian’s side. He was shocked as he saw the giant God’s corpse. “There is a second giant God’s corpse guarding it? How is this possible? The king of corpses…”
There was a loud noise coming from the distance.
Dudian and Reynolds were startled by the noise. They turned their eyes and looked at the place where Aisha and Reynolds were fighting with the king. There was a lot of dust on the ground, there was the sound of metal colliding with metal from time to time.
Roar!
The Giant God’s corpse roared as it sat up from the ground. Its huge tongue suddenly shot towards them. There were huge eyeballs and mouths on its tongue, it looked like a mass of flesh and blood that had been mixed with countless corpses.
“Not good!”Reynolds’face changed as he hurriedly said: “Raise!”
Dudian didn’t wait for him to say anything. The giant corpse opened its mouth and quickly raised its speed.
Whoosh!
The giant corpse’s tongue was fast as lightning. It caught up to Dudian and Reynolds in the blink of an eye. However both of them reacted fast. They raised their speed and didn’t get caught by the thick tongue.
In the blink of an eye the two flew more than 300 meters into the air. The undeads on the ground looked like ants.
The Giant’s tongue didn’t touch the two. It quickly retracted back and roared at the sky.
Reynolds was relieved as he looked at dudian: “Are You Alright?”
Dudian shook his head. He looked at the claw mark on the Giant’s neck. He frowned: “Are you hurt by that undeads?”
Reynolds touched his neck and smiled: “It’s just a scratch. It’s not a bite so it won’t be infected. But it’s better to clean the wound.”He took out a small metal bottle from his waist bag, he poured some white powder into his hand and stretched his neck. He applied the white powder to the wound on his neck.
Dudian looked at the metal bottle in his hand but didn’t say anything. He was about to turn to look at Aisha’s battlefield when he heard the sound of wind. He looked down and his pupils shrank, he saw four or five undeads flying straight towards them!
“Hide!”Dudian hurriedly said.
At the same time, his body swayed and he hurriedly dodged a bloated undeads that were rushing towards him.
“What?”Renault was applying white powder. He heard Dudian’s voice and was slightly startled. He looked down but didn’t see clearly. At the moment he lowered his head, his pupils were reflected by a ferocious face and expanded rapidly.
His brain didn’t have time to react. Bang! His body was hit and he flew into the sky. The metal bottle in his hand loosened and white powder flew out from the bottle.
Bang!
Another undeads hit his waist. The sound of bones breaking was heard.
Reynolds screamed in pain and spat out a mouthful of blood.
“Reynolds!”Dudian rushed over.
The two undeads immediately hugged Reynolds and crazily bit his body.
Reynolds endured the pain and raised his hand to push the undeads on his chest. However, the undeads desperately rushed towards his face. Their mouth was full of sharp teeth, it wanted to hook onto his neck.
“Scram, scram!”Reynolds roared as his body suddenly rolled. He spun 720 degrees in mid-air, instantly tossing the zombie that had knocked into his back and lost its grip. A viscous liquid quickly gushed out from the skin of his entire body, this liquid quickly wrapped around his body like flowing water. When it gathered at his chest, it quickly bulged out and transformed into a sharp knife-like blade.
With a few poof sounds, the sharp blade immediately pierced into the zombie’s body and pierced through its abdomen. However, no blood flowed out.
Such a serious injury didn’t affect the zombie at all. It continued to crazily bite at his head.
Reynolds let out a low growl and suddenly raised his fist to smash at the Zombie’s head. With a bang, the zombie’s head was instantly broken. It was stiff on its neck in a strange twisted position. Its mouth was slightly opened like a machine.
Renault quickly punched its chest and threw it off its body.
Dudian was relieved to see that he was free. However he saw that there were several black shadows flying towards him. He saw that the giant God’s corpse was holding onto the surrounding undeads and throwing them at them!
The undeads were thrown by him!
Whoosh!
Dudian’s body swayed as he dodged the undeads that were flying towards him. He turned to Reynolds: “It’s too low here. We have to continue to rise!”
Reynolds panted: “Remember, don’t go over 800 meters in the air or you will attract the attention of the Thunderbirds. Once the Thunderbirds come, all of us will die!”
Dudian knew about this. He nodded and quickly flew up at full speed.
Reynolds also spread his wings.
Whoosh!
More than ten undeads flew straight towards them.
Their speed was extremely fast. They passed by Dudian and Reynolds.
Reynolds’s body flew sideways to avoid one of the undeads. However, his dragon wings were too big. The two wings were about 12 meters long. One of the Dragon Wings couldn’t Dodge in time and was hit by one of the undeads.
His body flew out for dozens of meters before he stabilized his body. However, his wings were grabbed by the undeads.
Reynolds’face was ugly as he spun his body at high speed.
The undeads finally fell down after dozens of revolutions.
Reynolds was relieved. He was about to continue to climb when he heard Dudian’s shout: “Be Careful –”
