Reynolds was startled. He quickly looked down but saw that there was nothing below. The giant god was holding the undeads and hadn’t thrown them over.
“What happened?”He was startled.
Bang! His shoulder suddenly sank down. There was a sharp pain coming from his shoulder.
He was shocked and didn’t bother to look up. He took the lead to cut the top of his head. There was a sharp metallic sound as the sword hit something hard.
In the next moment, Reynolds felt the world in front of him spin. His body was actually thrown out by a huge force. The sky was getting further and further away under his feet..
The Sky?
His pupils constricted. He hurriedly turned his head to look. Immediately, he saw the densely packed zombies the size of ants on the ground rapidly expanding.
No! His heart was filled with terror. He hurriedly controlled his dragon wings to stabilize himself.
With a crack, when the dragon wings forcefully reversed the wind force, the sound of bones breaking could be heard.
The intense pain caused Reynolds’head to be covered in cold sweat, but he managed to stabilize the momentum of his descent. He hurriedly flapped his dragon wings, and once again flew towards the sky at high speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 590
chapters.content:
Chapter 590
When Reynolds flapped his wings and charged into the sky, he immediately saw a black shadow fall at high speed. It was a zombie with a flesh membrane growing under its armpit. It was charging straight at it.
Reynolds’expression changed. He immediately thought of the power that had been thrown down earlier. It was clearly from this zombie’s hand. He gritted his teeth slightly, resisting the intense pain on the skeleton of the Dragon Wing. He flew to the side, trying his best to avoid colliding with it.
With a bang, an intense pain suddenly struck from his back. The intense force of the collision caused Reynolds to spit out a mouthful of fresh blood. Mixed with saliva, it splashed onto his face. His pupils were about to split open. He only felt two sharp claws on his back, at the same time, he heard a roar. There was a zombie lying on his back!
His flapping dragon wings were grabbed by the zombie, and he was on the verge of collapsing.
“No –”he watched as the zombie that was rapidly diving down from the sky expanded in his eyes. With a bang, the two of them suddenly collided! All of this happened in an instant. The ribs on his chest suddenly cracked, as if he had been hit by a meteorite. His mind buzzed, and the wind whistled in his ears. His body fell rapidly, and with a bang, he fell to the ground, dust splashed onto his face and hair.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
The sea-like roar rushed over and the sky was suddenly covered by darkness.
Dudian looked at Renault who had fallen to the ground. His heart was cold. He didn’t expect the pioneers to be so weak. It was difficult for them to escape in front of the zombie tide.
Roar!
The Giant God’s corpse suddenly roared. It raised its giant hand and grabbed two or three undeads. Some of the undeads were caught at the edge and struggled to fall from its palm.
It opened its hand and saw that Renault’s body was covered in blood. It stretched out its giant tongue and licked the dying Renault into its mouth.
After swallowing Renault, the giant God’s corpse raised its head again and looked at Dudian. It roared and grabbed the undeads around it and threw them again.
Dudian’s face changed as he quickly flew up.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Undeads flew around Dudian’s body and fell into the crowd of undeads.
In the blink of an eye, Dudian was 500 meters high in the air. Some of the undeads that were thrown by the giant God hadn’t reached Dudian’s height before they fell down.
Dudian stopped when he reached 600 meters. He had noticed that none of the undeads that were thrown by the giant God could fly to such a height. This should be the limit of its arm strength!
After throwing more than a dozen undeads, the giant God roared at the sky as it saw that it couldn’t touch dudian. Its eyes were filled with anger and malevolence. At this time, there was a roar from the other end of the battlefield. It echoed in all directions like thunder. It caught Dudian’s attention.
The sound came from the direction of Aisha’s battle. Dudian was stunned when he looked at it.
He saw three ferocious figures fighting in the air. Aisha’s figure was gone. It was replaced by a humanoid dragon beast that looked very similar to Hathaway. Its body was covered in dark red scales, there was a seven to eight meter long dragon tail covered in bone spikes. There were six thin and sharp spikes protruding from the back of the dragon with dark red feathered wings. There seemed to be a small hole in the middle of the spikes that was spewing out white steam!
The upper body of the terrifying figure was Aisha’s beautiful face. However, there were red patterns on her cheeks at the moment. They looked like grooves that were flowing with blood or veins protruding on her face, it looked strange and powerful!
Compared to Hathaway’s magic weapon state, Aisha’s magic weapon state was larger and more powerful.
Seeing this scene, Dean couldn’t help but recall what Reynolds had said before. He was a bit shocked. He didn’t expect that the king of corpses would force Aisha out of her magic weapon state.
Bang! Bang!
Aisha’s figure flashed rapidly. Every time she rushed out, white hot air would shoot out from the spikes on her back. It was like smoke. She was holding a blood-red greatsword in her hand, it was the giant sword that she had always been with.
The giant sword and her original body seemed to be a bit huge. However, after she transformed into a magic weapon, it seemed to be small and slender.
When Aisha flew out, Dudian saw that he couldn’t see her figure. She directly disappeared. When she reappeared, she was already fighting with the king of corpses. The attack was swift and fierce. The giant blood-red sword was flying in a mess, it was like a net of blood lightning that covered the front of the zombie king.
However, the zombie king with black wings on its back wasn’t inferior to Aisha. It waved its black spear and blocked all of Aisha’s attacks. The sound of weapons clashing was endless, occasionally, there would be fierce sparks.
At the same time, Hathaway went behind the Zombie King. Her spear was like a dragon and lightning. It turned into hundreds of spear lights and stabbed at the Zombie King’s back.
The Zombie King’s defense was a bit difficult as the two of them attacked from both front and back. It was injured from time to time and was forced into the low air.
However, the dark tide of zombies gathered on the ground where the three of them were fighting. It was like a group of crazy people who were celebrating. They raised their hands and danced in the air in an attempt to grab Aisha and Haisha.
Roar!
An angry roar suddenly sounded.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He looked down and saw that the voice came from the mouth of the giant God corpse. It slowly stood up from the ground. Its body was extremely huge. It was walking on the ground and every step it took made a rumbling sound. However, its speed was not fast. It was like an ordinary person walking. However, under its huge body, every step it took was huge. Soon, it came to the battlefield where the king of corpses was.
Dudian’s face changed. The previous roar was most likely because the zombie king asked it to help.
“Damn it!”Dudian clenched his fists. He looked at the intense battle. He was nervous and worried. At the same time, he was angry and unwilling. Suddenly, a light flashed in his heart. He immediately turned around and flew away, he flew out of the zombie tide.
“Sister, that kid seems to have escaped.”Hailey turned her head and looked at Aisha. Her eyes flashed with a cold light as she smiled.
Aisha didn’t turn her head and indifferently said: “You better pay attention. This zombie king is not easy to deal with. I will deal with it head on. You can sneak attack from behind. Do you understand?”
“Of course I understand sister’s words.”Hathaway lightly smiled, her eyes were as beautiful as crescent moons, “However, there is a big guy coming, it isn’t easy to deal with.”
“Don’t bother.”Aisha coldly said.
Roar!
With a roar, the corpse king jumped out from the zombie crowd, suddenly pouncing towards Hathaway.
Hathaway’s expression slightly changed, hurriedly dodging, circling to Aisha’s side.
Aisha’s attack was as fast as lightning, and her huge sword quickly blocked the corpse King’s Black Battle Lance, followed by a storm of blood-colored sword strikes, as fast as lightning. If it was any other monster, it would have turned into dust under her attack, but the corpse King’s Black Battle Lance was extremely agile, and as it retreated, it blocked all the blood-colored sword strikes, only leaving one or two light sword wounds on its arm.
Hathaway quickly went behind the corpse king and was about to attack when the giant God corpse suddenly raised its hand and grabbed at her.
Hathaway’s figure flashed and escaped from the giant palm like a butterfly, continuing to attack the corpse king.
At this moment, the weakness of the giant God corpse was immediately revealed. Although its strength was great, its speed was extremely slow. It was as if its arm was pulled by countless threads, and every time it waved it, it seemed to be particularly slow.
“Die!”Hathaway dodged the giant God Corpse, and with a flick of her wrist, the spear instantly vibrated. Like a spiral, it brought with it a spinning force, and suddenly stabbed towards the corpse king’s back.
When the tip of the spear was about to touch the corpse king’s back, the flesh on the corpse king’s back suddenly squirmed, and a lump of flesh suddenly stretched out from it, and crashed towards the spear. With a bang, this lump of flesh was instantly pierced through by the spear, the spiraling power of the spear twisted the flesh and blood, twisting the surface of the flesh and blood like a screw.
Hathaway was slightly startled, feeling a bit strange. This flesh and blood wasn’t shattered?
She felt that things weren’t good, and immediately pulled the spear. However, the body of the spear seemed to be sucked in, and couldn’t be pulled!
Whoosh!
At the same time, the spiraling flesh and blood suddenly stretched out rapidly, swimming toward the spear shaft. The front end of the flesh and blood split open, revealing sharp teeth, which pounced toward Hathaway’s face through the spear shaft.
Hathaway’s pupils contracted as she shook the spear shaft with her palm. The intense force of the tremor caused her flesh to tremble. With a puff, the sharp spearhead cut a hole in the flesh. She found an opportunity and quickly swung the spear shaft, she pulled out the spear.
At this moment, the flesh that had been cut suddenly twisted and turned into a fist that flew towards her chest.
With a bang, Hathaway couldn’t Dodge in time. Her body retreated and hit the ground like a meteor. The surrounding zombies immediately rushed forward as if they saw something thirsty.
“Dragon Flame!”A loud shout sounded, and a flame appeared in the zombie tide. Hathaway’s body was covered in flames, and she quickly rose into the air. When she was in the air, the flames were extinguished.
This was her magic marks ability of a magic dragon, controlling flames!
After entering the magic soldier state, she could control the fat in her body to mix with the Magic Dragon’s carbon gas, and then ignite her own body! In fact, any creature could be flammable, but the magic dragon’s biological characteristics could automatically control self-ignition, just like how a poisonous snake could control the poison in its body.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
After releasing the Dragon Flame, Hathaway panted lightly, cold sweat dripping from her forehead. She stared at the corpse king who was fighting with Aisha, her eyes flashing.
Roar!
The giant God corpse roared and grabbed Aisha again.
Aisha lowered her head to look at it, a trace of coldness flashing in her eyes. She said to Aisha who was fighting with the corpse king, “I’ll deal with this eyesore first.”After saying that, she didn’t wait for Aisha’s reply and quickly dived down, she rushed towards the giant God’s corpse.
Aisha’s eyes sank. She was no longer distracted and attacked the zombie king with all her strength.
Whoosh!
At this time, a figure flew over the edge of the zombie tide. It was Dudian who had left earlier. There was a rumbling sound coming from the ground behind him. It was a group of monsters that looked like wolves.
“Come on!”Dudian encouraged the monsters in his heart. He had met this group of monsters before but Eureka didn’t want to waste her physical strength so she didn’t choose to kill them. Instead, she took a detour.., the territorial awareness of the group of monsters was very strong. They wouldn’t leave easily so he thought of luring them over. Although he felt that it wouldn’t have much effect but at least it would be able to restrain some undeads.
Roar!
The group of monsters rushed to the edge of the tide. Suddenly, the leader of the group roared and stopped the momentum. He turned around and ran away.
Dudian was stunned.
Ran Away?
Was he scared?
Roar!
The undeads at the edge of the tide noticed them and immediately roared to chase after them.
Dudian was relieved as he saw that they had played a little role.
Boom!
A loud roar was heard.
Dudian’s heart jumped. He turned his head and saw the giant God’s corpse which was rushing to the side of the king. The giant God’s body fell down and crashed into the tide of undeads.
Dudian was delighted. He soon noticed that the one who killed the giant God’s corpse wasn’t Aisha but Hathaway.
“Eh?”Hathaway swung her spear. She suddenly noticed a black dot floating in the distance. It was Dean who had escaped earlier. She was stunned for a moment.
Whoosh!
Her figure moved and suddenly flew out.
“Attack behind it!”Aisha saw that Hathaway had finished the giant God corpse and immediately said to her.
Hathaway gently smiled and flew past her. She turned her head: “Good sister, I will leave the King Corpse to you. I don’t want the credit. I will deal with that damn brat first…”
Aisha was startled and her pupils shrank.
Whoosh!
Hailey’s figure was like lightning. She was already hundreds of meters away. Her figure was fast as lightning as she rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian saw Hailey flying towards him. He couldn’t help but feel a bad premonition in his heart. He quickly turned around and ran. He didn’t run towards the tide of zombies but towards the sky!
Hailey saw Dudian flying towards the sky. She narrowed her eyes: “Cunning Kid, you are dead!”If Dudian ran towards the distance, she would be able to catch up to him, however, Dudian was flying high into the sky. Apparently he was aware of her intention. He wanted to use the Thunderbird to stop her!
However..
“Too slow!”
She flapped her wings as fast as a rocket. She caught up to Dudian when he was about 700 meters away.
“Why don’t you continue to fly?”Hathaway smiled as she looked down at dudian.
Dudian’s face was ugly. He looked at her back: “Corpse, King Corpse!”
Hathaway was surprised and turned her head.

chapters.title: Chapter 591
chapters.content:
Chapter 591
Hailey was relieved when she saw that there was nothing behind her. At the same time, a gust of wind blew. She looked back and saw Dudian flapping his wings and flying high into the sky.
“Humph!”
Hailey snorted. She flapped her dragon wings and caught up with Dudian. The time it took to turn her head was nothing to her. Even if she guessed that it might be Dudian’s escape plan, but to her.., even if there was only a slight possibility, it was worth it for her to do so because the danger of the king of corpses was much greater than that of dudian.
Whoosh!
After Dudian flew more than ten meters, Hathaway caught up with him again.
“It’s been so long, but you haven’t grown up at all.”Hathaway indifferently looked at dudian: “In the face of absolute power, is your little trick meaningful?”
“It is quite meaningful to me.”Dudian slightly breathed and coldly looked at her: “Why do you want to do this? You have got what you want. Why do you still want to do this?”
Hathaway gently smiled as if she wasn’t in a hurry: “Do you remember your captain Ian?”
“Ian?”Dudian was startled.
“Yes.”Hathaway said: “He has told me everything that happened during the mission. You were able to kill Eugene. Not Bad, not bad. With your body’s heat, you were able to kill Eugene who was stronger than you. Your magic marks should be special. Are you a legend with such a powerful magic mark?”
Dudian’s heart tightened. He remembered that he didn’t see Ian’s body when he returned to the Shadow Hunter’s Cave. It turned out that he wasn’t dead but was pretending to be dead. He took the opportunity to run away when the youth from the wing clan was chasing after them.
“Eugene is really your man.”Dudian’s eyes flashed, “I killed Eugene because of the advantage of the surrounding environment. I promised Ian a big benefit and he and others helped me. Otherwise I wouldn’t have been able to kill Eugene by myself.”. “As for the legendary magic marks? How is that possible?”? “I was just a hunter in the outer wall. I was very lucky to get a rare magic mark. I didn’t even dare to think about legendary magic marks.”
“A big benefit?”
“Yes. Eugene revealed his identity at that time. Ian and the others knew that I have Aisha behind me. So I took the opportunity to use your sister’s name to promise them a benefit. After the mission is over they will be free and won’t step into the wasteland again.”Dudian said in a serious tone.
Hailey stared at Dudian. After a moment she smiled: “It’s a pity. If I didn’t know how cruel my punishment was then I would have believed your words.”
Dudian was stunned.
“Although I don’t know how you got the legendary magic marks but in any case your existence is an eyesore.”Hailey smiled.
Dudian’s palms broke out in cold sweat as he looked over her shoulder. He saw Aisha being entangled by the king of corpses. She was moving towards him at the same time.
“Stall!”He thought.
“Are you thinking that if you stall, you will be saved?”Hathaway laughed.
Dudian’s pupils shrank but he quickly hid the strange look on his face, “I don’t understand what you are saying. If you want to kill, then kill. Why do you need to talk so much nonsense? However, if you don’t kill me, I am willing to use a secret to exchange with you.”
“Secret?”Hathaway looked at him with a smile.
Dudian nodded: “I know the traces of the dreamer.”
“Oh?”Hathaway’s smile became even wider: “Where is it?”
Dudian’s heart sank as he saw that she didn’t believe him, he said: “Your sister also knows about this matter. I stayed with her in the Orange Wasteland to search for the dreamer. Unfortunately I didn’t find it. Later I heard that you came to the fortress. Your sister was ready to return to the fortress.”
Hathaway frowned. She was a bit surprised. was what the Kid said true?
She knew that Haisha had been missing for a long time. No monster could keep her for such a long time, there was a 70% to 80% chance that Dean was telling the truth!
However, she knew that Dean was a cunning person. He could tell any lies. It was very likely that he was making things up.
However, if it was true and she killed the kid, then only her sister would know the secret of the dreamer. If she got the magic marks of the dreamer.., even if her bloodline was awakened in the future, she might not be able to catch up with her!
She frowned as she thought of this.
Dudian saw her appearance and knew that the mind attack was effective. Although he was not familiar with Hathaway so he naturally didn’t know her weakness. But at least he knew one thing, which was the opposite situation with Aisha, defeating Aisha was her goal and would also become her weakness.
Clang! Clang!
The sound of metal colliding came from the distance and quickly approached.
Dudian looked out of the corner of his eyes and saw Aisha quickly chasing after him. The Undead King was chasing after her and constantly attacking. Aisha had no choice but to turn around and Parry.
The Undead King’s flying speed was not inferior to Aisha’s. Every time its broken black wings flapped, it could control its body to nimbly catch up to Aisha.
“Sigh!”Hathaway who was frowning suddenly sighed. Her frown relaxed and her face returned to a smile.
Dean’s heart sank when he saw her expression.
“Your scheming really annoys me…”Hathaway shook her head and smiled: “Sure enough, I can’t let you speak. Otherwise, I will die.”
She looked down at Aisha and corpse king who were flying towards them. The smile on her face slowly disappeared: “Do you know why I’m not in a hurry to kill you?”
Dudian was startled. He suddenly thought of a possibility. He felt cold all over his body. He looked at Aisha who was rapidly approaching him. He quickly shouted: “Don’t go over…”
Before he could say the word “Come”, his chest suddenly shook. A huge force hit his chest. The bone that was healing suddenly broke and collapsed.
Dudian spat out a mouthful of blood. His body flew back. He felt his shoulder being grabbed before he flew a few meters.
“It’s too late to know now.”Hathaway looked at him indifferently: “Humble Person, pay the price of the weak. I hope this pain can accompany you to Hell.”
The other claw of the dragon suddenly grabbed the wings on Dudian’s back and pulled hard.
Puff.
The translucent wings on Dudian’s back were pulled out from the flesh on his back. Blood spurted out. The roots of the wings along with the blood tendons were thrown far away by her.
Puff! Another sound of flesh being torn out. Dudian’s other wings were pulled out and thrown away by her.
Dudian’s eyes were about to burst from the pain. His body was bent like a shrimp. Blue veins protruded from his forehead. He was in so much pain that he was screaming in a low voice. He didn’t want Aisha to hear him so that she wouldn’t fall into Hathaway’s scheme, but even so, the spasmodic pain in his back made him feel suffocated.
After two low growls, he clenched his teeth and let the growl stay in his chest. He panted and breathed crazily to ease the pain in his back.
“Stop! !”
Aisha, who was rushing over, saw this scene and immediately roared angrily. The scales all over her body suddenly spurted out a thick flame, like an evil dragon burning with Red Devil Flames. At the same time.., the scales on her forehead suddenly broke, and a sharp black horn slowly grew out from it and pierced toward the sky. At the end of the horn, green veins bulged out and spread to her entire forehead, it was like an ancient race’s incantation.
Bang!
She swung her sword and hit the black spear of the undead king. There was an intense buzzing sound and the undead King’s spear was knocked away. At the same time she used the momentum to rush towards Hathaway.
Hathaway’s pupils shrank when she saw the black horn on her forehead: “Third Awakening?”
She quickly came back to her senses and her face turned gloomy: “No wonder the dragon mother is so biased. It turns out that you have really awakened to such a degree. Sure enough, either you die or I die. Humph!” She raised her dragon claw and suddenly stabbed towards Dean’s heart.
Whoosh!
The sound of wind whistled.
Hathaway’s face changed and she hurriedly dodged.
However, although she was mentally prepared, she barely managed to dodge. She saw a blood red light fly past her. It was the blood red greatsword in Aisha’s hand!
At the same time, a strong pain came from behind her. She saw that her magic weapon dragon tail was cut off!
Blood spurted out from the broken dragon tail. However, the blood didn’t flow for long. Black substance quickly gushed out from the wound and stopped the blood.
In this moment of delay, Aisha’s figure was fast approaching. Her wings and dragon tail cooperated with each other. She quickly rushed in front of Hathaway and grabbed her hand.
Hathaway didn’t panic when she saw her. However, there was a smile on her face. The next moment, she grabbed Dudian and threw him in another direction.
Haisha couldn’t help but look over. Her face changed as she saw that Dudian was flying in the direction of the King Corpse.
“DAMN!”Her heart was full of anger. Her eyes were full of anger. However, she didn’t care about attacking Haisha who was close by. She turned around and quickly chased after Dudian.
Haisha was relieved when she saw Haisha turn around and leave. Although she saw Haisha throw her weapon out to save Dudian, but she wasn’t sure if she would directly attack her in anger, it seemed that Dudian’s position in her heart was higher than what she had expected, which made her more satisfied.
Whoosh!
Aisha rushed out at top speed and chased after dudian.
Dudian endured the pain and looked at the black-winged zombie king who was rushing in front of him and Aisha who was chasing from the side. He clenched his teeth and shouted: “Don’t come over. Kill her and avenge me! !”
Aisha ignored him as she stared at his figure. Flames were burning on her dragon wings as she chased after him like a meteor.
Dudian felt a pain in his heart as he saw her determined look. He knew that this was just Hathaway’s method to anger Aisha. At this moment.., he had once again become her weapon to hurt Aisha.
And he couldn’t resist!
When strength was strong, it seemed to be enough to dominate a person’s fate!
Who could resist fate?
“Don’t come over! !”
“Don’t! !”
Dudian looked at Aisha who was flying at full speed. He shouted at the top of his lungs. He saw that Aisha’s body didn’t stop at all. She was still flying straight, he couldn’t help but gush out a stream of hot liquid.
Whoosh!
A whistling sound was heard. The light suddenly turned dark.
Dean saw the body of the Black Wing Corpse King. He roared as he activated the primary limiter state. White bones emerged from his body. He punched its face and roared: “Go to Hell!”
The Black Wing Corpse King was expressionless. Its eyes were as black as ink. There was no white in its eyes. It looked strange and terrifying. When Dudian punched, it suddenly attacked. The black spear suddenly stabbed out.
Bang! A flame suddenly hit from the side and spread the black spear away.
The next moment, Dudian saw a hot air wrapped around him. His body flew back uncontrollably. He turned his head and saw that he was grabbed by Aisha’s hand and held under her armpit.
At this moment, Dean was like a seven or eight-year-old child in her hand.
Whoosh!
Aisha flapped her dragon wings and quickly turned around to fly away.
The black-winged zombie king quickly chased after her.
Two figures, one red and one black, were chasing in the air at high speed.
However, although she had entered the third awakening state, there was still one more person in Aisha’s hand. The impact during the flight was not something that could be calculated by a simple person’s weight.
The black-winged zombie king behind her was closing in at a weak speed.
Dudian saw this and hurriedly said: “Leave me behind. It Won’t Chase Me.”
Haisha didn’t reply. Her eyes looked straight ahead. She quickly flapped her dragon wings. Just when she was about to fly out of the zombie tide, a long spear suddenly came from the sky.
Haisha couldn’t Dodge in time and was stabbed by the long spear.
“My good sister, how could you be so careless?”Hathaway laughed. She didn’t dare to stay after being hit by the spear. She quickly turned around and flew away.
Dudian was so angry that his body was trembling.
Hathaway’s body swayed and her speed slowed down. When she adjusted and continued to fly, a roar came from behind. The black-winged corpse king had caught up with her.
Aisha suddenly turned around and dodged a black spear. When the spear retracted, she suddenly moved like lightning and grabbed the black spear.
With a bang, her dragon claw grabbed the spear. Her tail rolled and struck the Black Wing Corpse King’s chest. With a bang, it hit the Black Wing Corpse King’s chest, the broken armor on the corpse king’s chest immediately caved in.
The black-winged zombie King roared angrily, and used all its strength to pull the spear away.
Aisha’s face changed, and flames instantly burned on her arms. She took a deep breath, and her cheeks puffed up slightly. With a puff, she actually spat out a mouthful of flames!
The Flames hit the black-winged zombie King’s face, and it immediately raised a hand to block them.
Aisha took the opportunity to shake her palm, and the black-winged zombie King’s spear trembled slightly, making it impossible for anyone to hold it.
However, when the black wing corpse king’s hand almost loosened, the trembling weakened. It once again held onto the spear, and at the same time, the hand that was blocking the flames also grabbed it. Both hands exerted force, and the spear was instantly pulled back.
Aisha flew back dozens of meters, her face ugly. She had just recovered from her injuries, and hadn’t fully recovered from her peak condition. She had used her body flames to attack twice, and it had exhausted her physical strength, so she was already completely exhausted.
She turned around and looked around, only to see Hathaway’s figure flying straight into the distance. Apparently, she was concerned that her speed was faster than hers, which made her the target of the Black Wing Corpse King, so she left the battlefield ahead of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 592
chapters.content:
Chapter 592
Aisha was relieved to see that Hathaway had left. She made a prompt decision: “I will lead it away. You Go first. Don’t go back to the fortress. Go straight north. That is the direction of the giant wall.” She turned around and quickly dived down. She fell like a meteorite. When she was close to the ground, she pushed her palm. A gentle force pushed Dudian forward. He fell to the ground and rolled a few times before stopping.
Dudian lay on the ground and looked up to see Aisha’s figure rapidly rise above his head. His heart was full of pain and embarrassment. He knew how dangerous it was for Aisha to lead the king of corpses away in her current state, as a man, he didn’t want to escape at this moment, but he had to hide here.
He wanted to face life and death with her, but his reason told him that doing so would only drag her down and destroy her only chance of survival!
If he didn’t have this damn reason and just chased after her like a reckless man, perhaps he would be more manly? His heart was full of pain and self-blame. He even had a feeling that he hated himself.
“I can’t do anything. I’m just a burden. I’m hiding here to live. How could I become such a person? How could I become such a waste! !”Dudian clenched his hands into the ground, he wanted to get up and fight with the King Corpse. But his rationality made him lie on the ground. His chest was close to the soil and his hands were on the ground like a lizard, he tried to avoid attracting the attention of the King Corpse. At the same time, he was able to move nimbly.
Although he was extremely angry, but he had to try his best to endure. He clenched his teeth. His rationality told him that he would die if he rushed out and would implicate Aisha.
However, there was another thought in his heart that made him feel extremely embarrassed. What Reason? He was obviously a coward! !
A coward used reason as an excuse! !
“Ah Ah Ah Ah! ! !”Dudian roared hysterically, he climbed up from the ground. His self-esteem could no longer bear such humiliation. He looked at the King corpse that was flying over his head and directly chasing after Aisha. He picked up a stone from the ground, he roared in its direction. The sound was deafening.
There was only one thought in his mind. Since she could take risks and sacrifice for me, why can’t I sacrifice myself to distract the Corpse King for her? !
To compromise was to survive.
But I want to Live! ! !
“Come over, Beast! !”Dudian roared at the sky. His eyes were red. He held the stone and opened his arms. He looked like a crazy person who didn’t want to live. He shouted at the back of the corpse king: “Come! ! !”
The roar was as hot as fire. It was filled with a shocking penetrating power. It was heard from thousands of meters away.
Aisha who was flying at high speed heard Dudian’s roar. She couldn’t help but be stunned. She turned her head and saw Dudian get up from the ground and roar at the King Corpse behind him.
She was startled. There was a trace of warm liquid flowing through her eyes. She gently bit her lips and a smile slowly bloomed on her face.
The King Corpse who was chasing after Haisha ignored Dudian’s roar and went straight after Haisha.
Dudian was so angry that his eyes were about to split open. He clenched his fist and threw it towards the King Corpse’s back.
The stone passed through the air behind the King Corpse but didn’t hit it. Although the flying speed of the stone could barely keep up with the king of Undead’s speed. It was like a person’s running speed. It was impossible for him to catch up with the speed of the object he threw, but the speed of the stone was decreasing rapidly. It fell down before it could catch up with the king of undead.
Dudian clenched his teeth. He bent down and picked up another stone from the ground. He was ready to catch up with the king of undead.
At this time, the body of the King corpse which was chasing Aisha suddenly stopped and turned around.
Dudian was surprised. he shouted: “Come Here, Beast! Don’t you want to eat me? Come and eat me!”He threw the stone at the King Corpse.
The stone flew to the feet of the King Corpse and fell down.
The King Corpse’s black eyes seemed to flash with a cold light. Its body suddenly swooped down and flew towards Dudian.
“Not good!”Aisha was shocked to see that the king corpse was lured away by Dudian. She quickly stopped the momentum and turned around to chase after it.
Dudian’s face slightly changed as he saw the king corpse chasing after him. He felt a trace of fear in his heart. It was a lie to say that he was not afraid of death. However, he was powerless to change things. He suddenly felt that his heart was full of regret, there were too many things that he had not done. Too many wishes that had not been fulfilled. Too many enemies that had not paid the price..
Too many.
Too many.
He was full of regret as he stood in the same place. Suddenly, he saw Aisha who was behind the corpse king flying back at high speed. He was stunned. His face immediately changed. He hurriedly shouted: “Don’t come over! Run! ! !”
Aisha’s eyes were determined. She flapped her dragon wings at full speed and her body gradually drew closer to the corpse king.
Whoosh!
Suddenly there was a sound of wind. The black winged corpse king who was flying towards Dudian suddenly stopped and turned around. The black spear in his hand buzzed like a black lightning bolt.
Blood spurted out in the air.
The black spear pierced through Haisha’s abdomen and pierced through the dragon scales on her back.
The dark clouds in the sky suddenly seemed to be silent.
Time quietly stopped.
Dudian stood on the ground in a daze and looked at the scene in disbelief.
He felt as if his head had exploded. His mind was blank. The next moment, an indescribable anger and terrible killing intent burned out from his heart. His whole body seemed to be on fire and was about to explode.
“Ahhhhhhhhhhh…”
His throat roared as if it had exploded, and his eyes were red. The snow-white bones in his body grew crazily, and ferocious spikes protruded from his bones, like evil ghosts from hell wrapping around his body. Why, why even you, ! Even you want to use me? ! ! !
Why! ! !
Bang!
He growled in a low voice, and his feet suddenly stomped on the ground. With a bang, the ground cracked, and his body used the force of the impact to jump straight toward the corpse king like a cannonball. When he was close to the corpse king’s back, his red eyes were bloodshot, he roared and punched the back of the King’s Head!
“Go to hell!”
Bang!
The body of the Black Wing King didn’t move at all. The back of its head resisted Dudian’s punch.
However, Dudian’s attack still caught its attention. It slightly tilted its head and looked at Dudian indifferently. A piece of flesh shot out from its back. Bang! It instantly hit Dudian’s chest, the sound of bones breaking was heard. Dudian’s body fell down like a meteorite and hit the ground. It made a loud noise and raised countless dust.
Dudian was angry to the extreme because of the pain of his broken bones. He couldn’t help but cough and spit out a mouthful of blood. It seemed that there were pieces of internal organs mixed with it.
He clenched his teeth and climbed up from the ground. He looked up at the Black Wing Corpse King. He bent his knees and was about to jump again. Suddenly, there was a whistling sound and a red shadow flashed by.
Aisha’s enchanted dragon tail suddenly raised and hit the Black Wing Corpse King’s chest. The heavy force instantly broke its body. The Black Wing Corpse King was sent flying back. The Black Spear was pulled out from Aisha’s abdomen and blood was spilled.
Aisha coughed and covered the wound on her abdomen. She turned to look at Dudian who was still on the ground. She was relieved to see that he was still able to get up. She looked up at the Black Wing Corpse King and took a deep breath, she turned and flew away.
The black-winged zombie king quietly looked at her back as she left. He suddenly turned around and rushed towards Dudian who was on the ground.
Dudian saw that Aisha wasn’t dead. The murderous intent in his eyes faded. He was stunned for a moment. He saw the black-winged zombie king coming at him again. The anger in his heart was ignited again. He roared and rushed towards it.
Bang!
Suddenly, the body of the black-winged zombie king that was diving at high speed suddenly trembled. There was a red dragon tail on its back. The strong force caused its body to tremble and fall vertically to the ground, there was a roar.
“Go!”Aisha quickly flew toward Dean. She grabbed his wrist and turned around to fly at high speed.
Dean was held by Aisha. He looked down at the black-winged zombie king that had fallen to the ground. He couldn’t help but feel anxious when he saw that the black-winged zombie king didn’t suffer any serious injuries, he said to Aisha: “Let go of me. If this continues, both of us will die! It already knows to attack me so you will come to help. It wants to use me to attack you. Let’s not fall into the trap of these brainless undeads!”! ”…”
“I won’t leave you behind.”Aisha said with a non-negotiable tone.
Dean was anxious and angry, “You want to die together, but I don’t want to die together. Get Out, get out! I’m annoyed when I see you. If it wasn’t for you, I wouldn’t have ended up like this. Get Out!”
Aisha was slightly startled. She looked down at him. When her eyes met Dean’s, her expression returned to calm. She looked up and continued to fly forward, “No matter what you say, I will not leave you behind. I always keep my word!”
Hearing her words, Dudian’s heart became more anxious. At this time, a whistling sound came from behind. He glanced at it from the corner of his eyes and saw the black wing corpse king flying over again. Its speed was extremely fast.
“It’s coming!”Dudian hurriedly said: “Quickly leave me behind! I beg you!”
Whoosh!
As he spoke, the black wing corpse king quickly approached and suddenly thrust out its spear.
There was a clang. Haisha had been paying attention. She swung her dragon tail and swung the spear away.
However, the spear that was knocked away turned into a tricky arc and suddenly stabbed towards Dudian.
Haisha’s face changed and hurriedly wrapped her dragon wings towards Dudian.
Puff! The dragon wings were pierced and the spear pierced into Dudian’s arm. Dudian was afraid that she would be distracted. He clenched his teeth in pain but didn’t make a sound.
Aisha took the opportunity to swing her tail. She wrapped the leg of the black-winged corpse king and threw it out.
The body of the black-winged corpse king was thrown back. The spear was pulled out from Dudian’s arm and the dragon’s wings. It quickly stabilized its momentum and chased after it again.
Aisha’s dragon wings were damaged. She immediately lowered the height and flew towards the ground. If she fought in mid-air, she couldn’t be compared to the black-winged corpse king’s flexibility. She could only have a slim chance of survival on the ground.
When she was twenty or thirty meters above the ground, she pushed Dudian out. Then she turned her body and whipped her dragon tail behind her. She swept away the Black Wing Corpse King’s spear and pulled away.
The black wing corpse king growled. This time, it didn’t chase after Dudian. Instead, it directly rushed towards Aisha.
Aisha’s face slightly changed. She suddenly stretched out her dragon claw and blocked its spear. The other Dragon Claw quickly grabbed Aisha’s neck.
The black-winged zombie King’s reaction was very fast. Its body moved backward and raised its leg to kick Aisha’s injured abdomen. When Aisha dodged, it suddenly turned around and kicked Aisha’s arm. The heavy force instantly sent Aisha flying to the side.
Dudian saw that Aisha was in a disadvantageous position. He knew that she had exhausted too much of her physical strength. He grabbed the dagger from his leggings and picked up the stone on the ground with his other hand. He aimed at the zombie king, he threw the stone at it.
The black wing zombie king completely ignored the stone thrown at it. It attacked Aisha like lightning.
Dudian saw that the stone smashed into the black wing corpse king’s body but couldn’t cause any damage. He was anxious. He picked up another stone and aimed at the Black Wing Corpse King’s head.
Bang! The stone actually hit the Black Wing Corpse King’s head.
The stone exploded on the spot. A lot of powder shot into the Black Wing Corpse King’s eyes.
The black wing zombie king blinked its eyes as if it was trying to squeeze out the sand in its eyes. Aisha quickly used her full strength and waved her two dragon claws to cut across its neck.
The black wing zombie king growled and raised its spear to block her hands. A lightning-fast and fierce battle turned into a static power competition.
Dudian hurriedly threw stones.
The stones fell on the black-winged zombie king’s body and exploded into powder.
Aisha clenched her teeth. Dark red color slowly flowed out of the scales on her arm. She wanted to use her third body inflammation. However, the fat and magic power in her body were not enough to be released.
In the few seconds of the stalemate, a black shadow suddenly flashed.
Puff! A palm pierced through Aisha’s abdomen.
Aisha looked down in a daze and saw the third arm on the chest of the Black Wing Corpse King. It was an arm made of flesh and blood.
Soon, the pain in her abdomen completely removed the power from her body. The arm couldn’t help but loosen. At the same time, the arm that pierced through her abdomen quickly retracted. There were a few pieces of flesh and internal organs in her palm.
“No! !”Dudian’s eyes looked like they were about to crack.
The Black Wing Corpse King waved its spear and hit Haisha’s shoulder like a stick. With a bang, her body fell to the ground.
Haisha coughed out a mouthful of blood. She looked at Dudian who was on the ground. Her lips moved slightly.
Dudian saw the shape of her mouth. She said, “Run.”
“No! ! !”Dudian roared, he rushed up and caught her falling body. However, there was a huge force coming from her body. In an instant, Dudian’s body fell down with a loud bang.
Dudian completely forgot about the pain in his body. He hugged her body tightly. His eyes were red. He reached out and covered the hole in her abdomen, he still held a glimmer of hope: “Quick, use dragon blood to stop the bleeding. The wound will heal soon.”
“Quick… escape…”Aisha slightly opened her mouth. Her voice was hoarse and weak.
“Stop the bleeding! !”Dean crazily shouted.
Puff!
Suddenly, Aisha’s body trembled. At the same time, Dean was also stunned.
The Black Wing Corpse King landed behind Aisha. It was holding the end of the black spear in its hand. The front end of the spear penetrated through Aisha’s back and directly hit Dean who was holding Aisha tightly!
Dean felt that his abdomen was pierced by a cold hard object. In an instant, his stomach felt empty. There was an indescribable feeling of emptiness, followed by a strong tearing pain!
He looked at his chest in a daze and saw the pure black spear shaft. It pierced through Aisha’s chest and heart and connected to his abdomen.
No..
No..
His brain buzzed as if time and space were shaking. His thoughts were blank and chaotic.
Thump, thump.
He heard a strong heartbeat coming from his chest. It was violently contracting and then violently expanding.
At this time, Dean felt the cold hard object in his abdomen slowly twitching, trying to pull out from his abdomen. He slowly raised his head and looked at the black-winged corpse king behind Aisha.
What greeted him was a pair of pure black cold, emotionless eyes.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a blood shadow flashed by. The next moment, a thin blood line appeared on the neck of the black-winged corpse king. The thin blood line became thicker and thicker. At the same time, the head of the black-winged corpse king slightly slid down, it slowly fell down from the neck.
The cut was neat and there was no trace of blood.
Dudian was stunned.
This scene was too sudden. There was no warning. He didn’t react at all.
At this time, a burst of violent coughing sound was heard. Dudian couldn’t help but look down. He saw Aisha coughing with blood all over her face. Many pieces of internal organs fell on his neck when she coughed. It was warm and slippery.
“Fourth awakening… Unfortunately, it was too late…”Aisha’s mouth slightly twitched and revealed a bitter smile.
Dudian was slightly stunned. He suddenly noticed that she was hanging on the side of her tail. There was a blood-red sharp blade protruding like a barb on a scorpion’s tail. was this the one that cut off the head of the black-winged zombie king?
At this time, Dudian felt Aisha’s body slightly flow. She slowly became light. The Enchanted Dragon Armor on her body quickly disappeared and shrank like the tide, the scales, tail, and horns that were made of blood-red mucus also gradually disappeared in the disappearance of the blood-red mucus. Her beautiful face and slender body were revealed.
However, after removing the cover of the scales, her face was frighteningly pale, without any color.
Dean’s heart was in extreme pain, “I’ve harmed you again. I’m sorry, I’m really sorry. You have to persevere for a while, I’ll think of a way to treat you.”
Aisha’s lips moved slightly. Her voice was very soft and seemed extremely weak, but her tone was very gentle, “It’s okay, you can talk to Me First.”
Dudian’s heart was sore. He held back his tears and said: “I will talk to you. You can use the dragon’s blood to heal the wound. It’s just a small wound. It will be alright…” Tears couldn’t be held back anymore. Her heart was pierced. Even a pioneer would die from such a serious injury. It was already beyond common sense that she could still talk.
Aisha’s pale face revealed a faint smile as she heard Dean’s words. There was a trace of reminiscence in her eyes: “If this is my end, I won’t regret it…”
Dean’s heart was shocked. His voice seemed to be drowned by Tears. He asked: “Why?”
Aisha smiled as she looked at him, “Because the days I spent with you were the happiest days of my life. I really want to… go back to that small ice cave. Just the two of US will live there every day. Even if we live there for the rest of our lives… i… Ahem… I Won’t be sick of it.”
Dudian’s eyes were wet. His vision was blurred with tears. He raised his hand to wipe away the blood from Aisha’s mouth, “Don’t say anymore. I’ll take you back to that place after you recover. We will live there together. Just the two of us. Stop the bleeding immediately. We will go after you recover.”
Aisha smiled, “A man’s words must be kept.”
“Of course!”Dudian nodded but couldn’t stop the tears from flowing out.
Aisha smiled and suddenly frowned. She seemed to be in pain but soon her eyebrows relaxed. She was about to open her mouth when her throat suddenly swelled and she began to cough, she coughed out a few pieces of flesh the size of a finger.
“No, don’t talk anymore.”Dudian’s eyes were red.
Aisha gently took a breath and seemed to have recovered some strength, she weakly said: “Don’t… Hate Hathaway. Don’t avenge me. You Can’t fight against them. I hope you can… Live Well, okay?”
Dean heard her mention Hathaway. The killing intent in his heart surged out and made him crazy. He gritted his teeth: “I will live well. I will live well. I must live!”
“No, promise me. Don’t avenge me…”Aisha saw his face full of killing intent. She couldn’t help but be anxious. She spoke quickly and suddenly pulled the wound. She began to cough violently.
Dudian suddenly woke up and said in a panic: “Don’t worry, I Promise You, I will promise you anything. Don’t worry, take your time.”
Seeing the panic on Dudian’s face, Haisha was relieved. She immediately felt that her vision was a bit blurred. It was probably because of too much blood. She suddenly felt a bit reluctant to part with him. At the same time, she felt relieved.
“Promise me one more thing, okay?”She tried to move her eyes to see Dean’s face clearly.
“Yes, all of them, one hundred of them!”Dean said nervously.
Aisha tried to smile and maintain her best appearance. She whispered: “Even if… Everyone has forgotten me, don’t Forget Me, Okay?”
Dean clenched his teeth: “No, I Won’t forget about you. Even if I have forgotten about everyone, I won’t Forget About You!”
Aisha wanted to smile, but she didn’t have the strength to move her mouth. She felt that her strength was getting weaker and weaker. Even opening her eyes was a bit strenuous. She slightly panted and gathered her last strength to look, her blurred vision suddenly became much clearer. Looking at Dudian’s face full of pain, she felt pity in her heart. She whispered: “Don’t be sad, Don’t Cry… Smile for me.”
Looking at her eyes that gradually dimmed, Dudian had a strong sense of fear. It was as if he was going to lose something precious. He knew what it felt like and what would happen next, however, he held back his fear when he saw the calm smile on her pale face. He slowly opened his mouth and smiled.
Although his face was full of tears, his smile was extremely bright. It was as if he had used all the smiles in his life at this moment. It was as if he knew that he would never smile again for the rest of his life.
He grinned and tried his best to maintain his smile. When his face was stiff, he realized that Aisha, who was in his arms, had not opened her mouth for a long time..
In an instant, the bright smile on his face disappeared. It was as if he had been swallowed by darkness. In the next moment, an extremely sad and angry roar suddenly erupted from the ground in the wilderness. It reverberated throughout the entire area!
..
..
If this book was divided into two parts, the first half would be finished, and the second half would begin

chapters.title: Chapter 593
chapters.content:
593  Volume Six, Wall Master, Chapter 594: Tremors
The lead-gray clouds that were filled with dust from the nuclei hovered quietly in the sky like a mass of thick ink that could not be dissolved. They filtered the sunlight outside the atmosphere and sprinkled a turbid and mournful glimmer of light onto this wilderness.
The Breeze hovered silently. It no longer had the sharp and whistling momentum from before.
The wind blew away the bloody smell in the air. It was as if nothing had happened. The world was silent.
The continuous sad roars in the wilderness gradually became hoarse and stopped. Dudian hugged Haisha’s body tightly like a sad beast sobbing. He had countless thoughts of begging in his heart. However, the god who looked down on the common people didn’t seem to care about his pleas.
Slowly, he felt that he didn’t even have the strength to cry. All the tears that flowed out of his body were like his consciousness and soul.
He felt dizzy as if his soul had been separated from his body.
Without a soul, what was left of a person?
Was there only an empty shell?
Or was there a new material to replace the soul and occupy this body?
The tears dried on Dudian’s face. He silently hugged her and gazed at her sleeping gentle and quiet face.
Crack! Crack!
Suddenly, a slight sound of chewing slowly dragged Dudian’s line of sight. His eyes regained a trace of vitality. He looked up and looked at the source of the sound. The next moment, his face that had become numb suddenly showed a strong change. The extreme hatred and anger made his face completely distorted.
There was a head biting on one of Aisha’s feet and her calf. It was the head of the black-winged zombie king, whose head had been cut off earlier!
“Ah! ! Go to hell! ! !”Dean rushed over as if he had gone mad, both of his hands clamped on the head of the black-winged zombie king. He pulled it down from Aisha’s calf and pressed it to the ground. He raised his fist and crazily swung it. He shouted and used all his strength to punch, as a result, the fingers on his fist were broken, and he didn’t feel anything at all.
After continuously hammering it for hundreds of times, the bones in both of his hands had been broken in large areas. The intense pain stimulated his consciousness to gradually recover. He stopped his hands, and his chest rose and fell violently as he panted heavily, as he looked at the Black Wing Corpse King’s head, he suddenly realized angrily that its skull didn’t crack at all. On the contrary, his fist was severely damaged, and he had to pay a heavy price.
“Go to hell! !”He roared as he grabbed its hair and smashed it onto the ground.
After hammering it for dozens of times, he was so tired that he stopped. He saw a deep hole in the ground. The sand was poured into the nose and mouth of the black wing corpse king but its face was still intact.
Dudian’s heart was angry and sad. He was too weak. He was so weak that the black wing corpse king only had one head left. He couldn’t kill it.
He pressed its head and took a deep breath. The anger in his heart slowly calmed down. He slowly activated the energy in his body and entered the primary limiter state. The white bones protruded and soon.., his crippled hands slowly healed. The broken bones were reattached and restored to their original state.
He pulled out the dagger from his leggings and turned the head of the Black Wing Corpse King Upside Down. The cut under its head was covered with a layer of dark red scale-like cuticle.
He reached out and touched it. It felt extremely tough, and the cuticle of the dark red scale was similar to the demonized dragon scale that he saw on Aisha’s body earlier.
He thought of the scene of it biting Aisha’s calf earlier, and at the same time, he remembered that before Aisha died, she had frowned and showed a hint of pain. Could it be that at that time, it had bitten her?
But at that time, she was still in the demonized state. In other words, it ate her demonized dragon scale and absorbed it. That was why the wound had the same scar as her demonized dragon scale.
“You... really should die! !”Dudian’s body trembled. He clenched the dagger and stabbed it into its eye socket.
Puff! The dagger pierced through the eye socket of the Black Wing Corpse King. Blood flowed out from the eye socket.
Although its skull was extremely hard but its eyes were weak. It had nothing to do with its constitution. The structure of its eyes was destined to be incomparable to scales.
“Do you think I can’t Kill You?”
“Don’t you like to eat? Eat...”
Dudian’s face was full of malevolence. He held the end of the dagger and rotated it in the king’s eyes. At the same time he used his knee to support the king’s head. His other hand grabbed the soil and stones from the ground and stuffed them into the king’s mouth.
Suddenly, a high-pitched scream came out of the king’s mouth. It was extremely clear and ear-piercing.
Dudian’s eardrums were in pain because of the scream. He clenched his teeth and stabbed the dagger into the depths of the king’s head. Then he tried to swing it from left to right!
He felt that the brain tissue in its head was extremely tough. There was a lot of resistance when it was cut.
The Scream of the Black Wing Corpse King suddenly stopped. Its slightly opened mouth was frozen. It didn’t move at all.
“Die! Die! Die...”Dudian didn’t stop there. He continued to stir the dagger. He wanted to turn the dagger into a lump of mud.
Rumble!
Suddenly, there was a slight tremor on the ground.
Dudian woke up. He looked up and saw a dark figure coming from the distance. Most of them were human-shaped. They were of different heights.
His face slightly changed but he didn’t panic. He quickly moved his hand and cut the facial muscles of the black wing corpse king. He used his fingers to dig out a piece of cold dark brain tissue, it wasn’t sticky.
He quickly smeared it on his body and Aisha’s armor. At this time, she saw that Aisha’s silver metal belt was still tied with a waist bag, so she immediately took it off, there were many metal bottles inside, and one of them was labeled with “Corpse powder”.
He quickly opened the bottle. There was some light blue powder inside. He immediately sprinkled it on himself and Aisha’s body. He had read about this in the books of the fortress. It was something more expensive than corpse powder, it could cover up the smell of the body to a great extent. Even higher level undead wouldn’t be able to detect it. At the same time, the powder was mixed with some high-level undead’s tissue. Ordinary undead would be able to smell it and move away from it.
Dudian believed that he would be able to escape the tide of undead with the help of the powder and the brain of the Black Wing Corpse King. He understood that the Black Wing Corpse King’s scream wasn’t a painful scream. It was most likely to summon the tide of undead.
Rumble!
As the tide of corpses approached from afar, the tremors on the ground became more and more intense. Dudian calmly tore a string of cloth from his body and poked the other eye of the corpse king, he tied the cloth to his waist. He wanted to keep it and humiliate it in the future!
Although the corpse king was unconscious and had died. It didn’t know pain and humiliation. But the hatred and anger in its heart wouldn’t stop there.
After fastening it, he bent down and picked up Aisha, who was on the ground, and quickly ran into the distance.
Rumble!
The high-speed corpse tide gradually slowed down and stopped at the corpse of the black-winged corpse king. The corpse tide, which was originally as orderly as an army, soon relaxed after it stopped, like a soldier who had lost his command, it turned into a pile of loose sand, wandering around separately, and didn’t chase after Dudian.
After running for four or five miles, he gradually stopped. He came to a pile of stones and sat down. He gently put Aisha on the ground. He was panting as he stared at her face.
He didn’t know how much time had passed. Suddenly, he saw her eyelashes quiver as if he was hallucinating..

chapters.title: Chapter 594
chapters.content:
Chapter 594
Was it my illusion?
Dudian was stunned for a moment before he reacted. His heart began to beat rapidly. He held his breath and stared at her sleeping face. There was an unprecedented tension in his heart.
Time stopped at this moment.
It wasn’t until Dudian saw her eyelashes gently tremble as if she was about to wake up.
With a boom, Dean felt a slight tremor in his mind. The blood in his body seemed to be boiling. He was so excited that all the pores in his body opened up. His fingers couldn’t help but clench tightly.
It wasn’t an illusion, it was real!
She really moved! !
Dean was so excited that he wanted to jump on the spot. He looked up at the sky and shouted, but he held back. He suppressed his rapid breathing and carefully approached her. He carefully looked at her face again.
Aisha’s eyelids slightly trembled as if she was going to open her eyes.
Dean’s heart felt like it was about to burst when he saw such a reaction. He was more excited and grateful than the whole world. His body slightly trembled as he felt hot liquid flowing out of his eyes, he quickly raised his hand and wiped it away. Then he opened his eyes so that he could see her appearance more carefully and clearly.
At this time, Aisha’s eyebrows slightly trembled. It seemed that she was frowning or enduring something.
Seeing this, Dean suddenly woke up. He suddenly thought of the wound on her chest. He immediately looked over and was stunned. He saw that the wound on her chest, which was as big as a bowl, had disappeared and healed itself. There was only a hole in her breastplate, which seemed to prove that the previous injury was not an illusion.
Was it her self-healing ability?
Dudian was secretly happy when he thought of this.
At this time, he noticed that Aisha’s fingers were gently trembling as if she was trying to regain consciousness.
When he noticed her trembling fingers, he suddenly saw that her fingernails were slowly growing in a subtle manner. The originally sparkling and translucent fingernails were now becoming longer and longer. The front end of the fingernails was pulled forward, it became a bit sharp. Moreover, faint dark marks slowly appeared on her white arm. It was as if the blood vessels hidden in the skin were exposed.
However, the color of the blood vessels was not dark red but dark black.
Dudian was slightly startled. He couldn’t help but look at other parts of her body. Soon he found that in addition to her arm, there were also black blood vessels slowly appearing on her neck.
Could it be a secret technique of the Dragon Clan?
He had such doubts and an even more terrible thought. But he suppressed it and didn’t dare to think about it.
However, the excitement in his heart slowly subsided. He was more nervous.
Suddenly, he thought of a way to completely erase the terrible thought that was suppressed. He immediately compressed his pupils and used thermal vision to look. His heart turned cold when he saw Aisha lying in front of him, there was no heat source reaction on her body.
It should be known that her magic marks were not cold-blooded monsters. Unless she deliberately covered it up, her body would emit a powerful heat source.
However, there was no heat source at the moment.
How could this be?
How could this be?
Dudian’s face turned ugly. He slowly bent down and gently pressed his ears against her chest. He was afraid that he would press her and listen to her heartbeat.
One second, two seconds, three seconds..
Half a minute passed but Dudian didn’t hear a heartbeat!
How could it be?
Was she using the dragon’s blood to deliberately suppress it?
(yes, it must be… it must be so!)
He panted heavily and looked up at the girl again. In the blink of an eye, her face was also highlighted with dark lines. The shape was very similar to the meridians. It was particularly eye-catching under the snow-white skin.
He looked down and saw that her nails were still growing. In the blink of an eye, they were about an inch long and extremely sharp.
(no… No…)
He panted slightly and suddenly raised his hand to slap his own head. The pain seemed to have dispelled the distracting thoughts in his head. He gritted his teeth and slowly raised his hand to look into her eyes.
Just as his fingers were about to support her eyelids, Aisha suddenly opened her eyes. It seemed that there were two flashes of Black Lightning.
Dean’s fingers stiffened. The next moment, his whole body froze because he saw that Aisha’s eyes had turned into pure black. There was no white in her eyes!
This kind of creepy eyes made two words appear in his mind — Corpse King!
The Black Wing Corpse King that was killed earlier had exactly the same eyes!
“No… it’s not like that…”Dudian’s body slightly trembled as tears flowed out of his eyes. When he saw that she was looking at him with her pure black eyes, his face immediately burst into a smile that was full of tears, just like what the girl wanted to see, a brilliant smile appeared on her face.
“You are awake… I knew you would be fine.”Dudian grinned as if nothing had happened.
Aisha, who had been looking at him, suddenly sat up from the ground and let out a hoarse growl. There was no gentleness in her voice, but she was like a beast! As she roared, her hands quickly grabbed Dudian and pushed him to the ground. She jumped onto Dudian’s body and opened her mouth to bite him.
Dudian didn’t react at all. He didn’t even think about reacting.
When he was pushed to the ground, he looked at Haisha’s open mouth. Her white teeth had become sharp, especially the canine teeth on both sides. They were like short and sharp bamboo shoots.
Tears filled his eyes. He felt like crying.
Aisha bit his throat. When she was about to bite him, she suddenly stopped. It was not her who stopped, but her neck. There were two hands tightly covering her neck and pushing her up.
Dudian’s face was full of tears. His hands were tightly covering her neck. He lifted her up as if he was lifting a heavy mountain.
“Roar…”Haisha’s mouth was biting down desperately. She seemed to smell the tempting smell of blood. There was a kind of hunger and thirst that made her mouth grow extremely big. Her originally beautiful face.., it was a bit distorted. She was like a beautiful butterfly that was torn apart alive.
“No, don’t do this…”Dudian’s heart was sad. He looked at her as she begged. She was like a humble insect that showed its weakest appearance.
“Roar!”Haisha’s beautiful face was extremely ferocious. Mucus dripped down from her sharp teeth. She twisted her nose and tried to break away from Dudian’s hands. There was only bloodlust in her pure black eyes.
Looking at the bloodlust on her face, Dudian couldn’t help but scream!
“Why! ! !”
“Why do you have to do this… Ah Ah Ah Ah! ! !”
What was despair?
Was she going to destroy her most precious thing with her own hands?
Why did fate tease people like this? ! !
Haisha’s strength gradually gained the upper hand in Dudian’s sorrowful voice. Her ferocious face was getting closer and closer. Poof! Her mouth suddenly bit something. It was Dudian’s left hand.
Haisha bit her left hand and shook her head left and right like a lion. She was biting desperately.
Dudian looked at her face which was close to him. It was full of madness. There was no gentleness and familiarity from before. All that was left was the desire to eat and swallow him… did she really want to kill him?
No, this was not her.
Why? She was already dead. Why would fate torture her like this?
Dudian cried. He couldn’t help but think of the girl who said to him in a weak and gentle voice: “Even if… Everyone has forgotten me, don’t Forget Me, Okay?”
(yes, I Won’t forget, I will always remember your most beautiful appearance…)
“Ah Ah Ah Ah…”he roared.
Aisha ignored him and continued to gnaw at his arm with a ferocious and bloodthirsty face.

chapters.title: Chapter 595
chapters.content:
Chapter 595
The roar was soon exhausted.
Dudian felt empty as he lay on the ground. He looked up at the dark clouds that were slowly moving in the sky. He heard the sounds of biting and gnawing coming from his left arm.
The corner of his mouth slightly twitched. He slowly raised his right hand and gently hugged her back.
If… I can always hug you like this, how good would that be?
Gulp!
Aisha’s throat let out a low roar like a ferocious beast. The sound of biting was accompanied by the sound of hungry swallowing.
Dean’s eyes slowly moved down to her body. There was a trace of gentleness in his empty and numb eyes. His palm gently stroked her silky hair, it was as if he was stroking a kitten in his arms.
Aisha looked up as if she was frightened when he touched her head. Her beautiful face was full of malice as she stared at him. There was half a piece of ice-crystallized flesh in her mouth.
Dean looked at her gently. His eyes were extremely gentle as if he was saying, “Don’t be afraid, I’m always here…”
Aisha suddenly opened her mouth and bit his neck with her sharp teeth.
Whoosh!
Dean touched her hair with his right hand. He suddenly turned and held her neck. There was a bit of pain and sorrow in his eyes. He said in a low voice, “I’m sorry…”
Roar!
Aisha ignored him and rushed over with a ferocious roar.
Dudian’s arm was pressed against her neck. He felt that although his strength was inferior to hers, but it seemed to be able to suppress her. Logically speaking, with her physique, it should be easy for her to kill him. But from the strength that she burst out.., it seemed that she didn’t have the previous extraordinary combat strength.
In the stalemate between the two, a few minutes passed. Suddenly, Aisha’s pure black pupils that had been desperately biting suddenly contracted. It was as if the middle of her pupils was sucked into a black hole, pulling the black curtain on the eyeball into it, the edge of her eyes revealed a trace of Snow White.
Dean was slightly startled.
Roar!
Aisha suddenly raised her head and roared. Her fingernails expanded and became sharper. At the same time, a sharp horn slowly protruded from her forehead. It was the posture of Aisha when she had awakened for the fourth time.
When the roar fell, her body suddenly slanted to the side and twitched like a spasm. The bones in her arms, chest and other parts of her body creaked.
Dudian sat up from the ground. He was a bit stunned when he saw this strange scene. At the same time, a glimmer of hope that he didn’t dare to ask for surged from the bottom of his heart. Could it be that… her consciousness hadn’t completely disappeared and she was fighting with the Zombie King virus in her body?
Although he knew that the possibility was very small, but he couldn’t help but feel nervous. At the same time, he was a bit afraid. He was afraid that his hope would be destroyed again.
Crack! Crack!
At this time, the sound of bones hitting each other suddenly came from Aisha’s back. The horn protruding from her forehead extended out from her body as if it wanted to be completely extracted from her body.
“Ah Ah Ah Ah…”Aisha roared to the sky. Her beautiful and ferocious face was full of pain. Her hands were tightly holding her head.
Dean couldn’t help but clench his fists when he saw this scene. It was as if all the pain she had suffered was happening to him.
Haisha hugged her head and desperately smashed her head onto the ground. Her horns pierced the ground and made holes. Suddenly, she roared and pounced on Dean who was in front of her.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He was ready to retreat, but he quickly stopped.
He saw that Haisha stopped mid-way. Her arms went soft and her body fell down.
Dudian was slightly startled. He immediately went forward to turn her over, but she had already fainted.
“What’s going on?”Dudian was at a loss, but he quickly thought that no matter what, he should find a safe place while she was unconscious. If she woke up and regained consciousness, that would be the best thing, but if… she woke up and was still in her current state then he had to find a way to subdue her!
“As long as there is a glimmer of hope, I will not give up on you!”Dudian picked her up and firmly said: “If you can hear me then you must persevere. You will not lose to the corpse poison!”
He took a deep breath and looked around. There was nothing but rubble in his sight.
Suddenly, the ruins that he had explored previously flashed in his mind. His eyes lit up. It was an excellent safe place in the ruins. However, he had spent a lot of effort to rush out of the ruins. If he wanted to return to the ruins, there were countless wandering zombies in the middle. It was extremely dangerous.
Soon, he threw the idea of “Danger”out of his mind and quickly turned around with Aisha in his arms.
After running for a while, Dudian saw a group of wandering undeads from a distance. He looked at them and quickly took out the powder from Aisha’s backpack. He poured half of the bottle onto himself, then he picked up a stone from the ground and threw it to another place.
The stone fell to the ground.
Hearing the sound, the group of undeads immediately wandered away.
Dudian saw the situation and immediately picked up Aisha and ran away. The only thing that could be used at the moment seemed to be the weakness of the undeads that didn’t have intelligence.
After he got close to the group of undeads that were led away by the sound of the stone, a few undeads heard Dudian’s footsteps and slightly turned around. Their ulcerated facial features were twisted as they tilted their heads and looked at Dudian, they shook their bodies as they walked towards him.
Dudian’s face changed but he soon noticed that the undeads were not rushing towards him. He was relieved. It seemed that the effect of the powder was very good, the undeads didn’t recognize him at all.
However, the powder was not absolute. It might not be effective against some high-level undeads. Especially for the king of undeads.
Whoosh!
Dudian sprinted in the wilderness. Although he should take a long way to be safe, but he was more worried about Aisha when she woke up, he might not be able to escape from her hands.
However, he was a bit puzzled as he was able to resist her bite. However, he didn’t know much about the structure of undeads and the process of the transformation. He couldn’t think of any reason and could only leave it for future investigation.
In the blink of an eye, more than an hour had passed. Dudian met hundreds of undeads on the way back but they were small in number. The previous tide of undeads had completely relaxed after losing the rule of the king of undeads.
There were some high-level undeads among the hundreds of undeads but fortunately there were no giant God corpses.
From the previous battle it seemed that there were only two giant God corpses in the Horde. From the reaction of the dead Renault it seemed that a king of undeads could get the protection of two giant God corpses, it seemed that he was an incredible existence.
“DAMN!”
Dudian looked at the giant shadow that was wandering behind the rubble. His face turned ugly. It was a giant undeads. Its physique was similar to that of a high-level limiter. However, it didn’t care about its life, even the pioneers would find it difficult to deal with it.
The distance was too close. It was too late to take a detour.
Dudian clenched his fists. There was madness in his eyes. He was ready to fight to the death!
As the distance was getting closer, Dudian was ready to speed up and take the lead. Suddenly his pace slowed down. He looked at the giant undeads in disbelief, he saw that it was facing him… it was squatting down! Both of its hands were tightly hugging its body. It was trembling as if it was afraid.
Afraid?
Would undeads who didn’t feel pain be afraid?
Dudian was stunned. He suddenly thought of the head of the Black Wing Corpse King tied on his belt. was the giant undeads afraid because of its smell?
He looked at the giant undeads. It shouldn’t Be a disguise. Except for the Black Wing Corpse King and the giant undeads who were hiding underground to ambush Eureka.., it seemed that he hadn’t seen any intelligent response from the other undeads.
Whoosh!
He didn’t stop and quickly rushed past it.
Dudian found that the zombie’s trembling had stopped when he was hundreds of meters away from it. It slowly stood up and continued to shake its body as it wandered to another place.
Dudian was relieved when he saw this. He turned to look at the head of the black-winged zombie king. He didn’t expect that the hatred at that time would be so helpful at this moment.
He was more confident as he held Aisha and sprinted forward at full speed.
After encountering the giant God’s corpse, he encountered some strange undeads. But without exception, these high-level undeads would stop wandering and crouch down when they were hundreds of meters away from him, or they would crouch down.
Ordinary undeads and low-level undeads didn’t behave like this. But when he passed by them, they would immediately turn around and wander in another direction as if they wanted to get away from them, dudian felt that this reaction should be from the effect of the powder.
He didn’t know how much time had passed. When Dudian felt that his legs were a bit sore and numb, he finally came to the ruins again.
There were dozens of undeads wandering here at different stages. They were wandering along the entrance passage under the rubble.
Dudian picked up two stones and knocked them against each other. The sound soon attracted the undeads out of the passage. One of the giant undeads hadn’t climbed out of the passage yet. It was curled up on the ground and trembling, its body rolled down the slope passage.
Dudian waited for the undeads to come out. He picked up Aisha’s body and quickly went down the slope. Soon he came to the passage where he fought with Eureka and others, there were still broken corpses of undeads on the ground.
Dudian quickly came to the entrance of the ruins. He saw that the huge gate of the ruins was still open. There were dozens of undeads wandering in the dark ruins. He frowned and picked up a stone from the ground and threw it outside.
Soon, the undeads in the ruins heard the movement. They shook their bodies and slowly walked towards the stone. However they stopped halfway. Dudian had to throw the stone again. He found that the auditory memory of these undeads was very short. The amazing thing was that they were not intelligent but were attracted to the source of the sound, however, they were not attracted to each other’s footsteps.
This made Dudian want to study them, but not now.
After drawing out the undeads, he picked up Aisha and quickly went to the ruins. He turned around and looked at the door of the ruins, but he didn’t see the valve that closed the ruins. Could it be that the ruins was closed from the outside?
This idea was rejected by him. There was no valve or dark valve that was closed from the outside. Even if there was a dark valve, it was unlikely to be closed from the outside.
He came to the circular hall in the ruins. He gently put Aisha on the ground and looked at her sleeping face. He turned his head and looked around. He quickly came to the wall and gently knocked on it to find the dark valve.
When he was halfway through the search, Dean suddenly thought of the small door in the pile of bones. He quickly went to the pile of bones and pushed the high pile of bones away. Suddenly, there was a loud crash, the decayed bones fell down in an instant. Countless dust and bone powder were raised.
Dudian covered his nose and walked into the small door. It was a door made of pure metal. It was two meters tall. It was the standard height of most doors in the old era, there was a horizontal window which looked like tempered glass. At the moment it was covered with dust.
Dudian wiped off the dust. He looked through the transparent glass and saw the scene inside. It wasn’t a place where treasures were stored as he had thought. It was a small room which looked like an aircraft control panel. There were many instruments and devices, there were several corpses and some scattered papers and books on the ground.
Dudian was a bit disappointed. However he had expected that this was the main control panel of the shelter.
He looked around. There was no handle on the door. There was a bell-like device on the metal wall. He looked at it and gently pressed it… There was no response.
