He tried to press it a few times but there was no response. He cursed in his heart and punched the door.
Bang! The door was suddenly opened.
Dudian was stunned. The next moment, he found that the door was not closed. There was a palm bone in the gap of the door.
He immediately pushed the door and entered. He saw that the console was very messy. There were four corpses on the ground. Oh No, there should be five corpses. He also saw some scattered bones, arm bones and human hip bones.
In addition to the scattered bones, there were four corpses. Two of them were hugging each other. One was a man and one was a woman. The woman’s hair was Snow White. There was a ruby necklace hanging on her neck. It was very exquisite but was covered in dust.
One of the other two corpses was on the control panel while the other one was lying by the door.
Dudian looked at the corpses. There were crumpled pieces of papyrus on the abdomen of the corpses. He frowned as he vaguely guessed what had happened here.
If the survivors outside had starved to death, then the ones inside should be the same. The only bookshelf in the room was pushed to the ground. The books were torn up and scattered everywhere. They became food for the people before they died, however, despite living on straw paper, they couldn’t wait for rescue and starved to death in the end.
No wonder there were so many bones gathered outside the door. It should be because the people outside wanted to get what was inside, be it food or hope for life.
Dudian was silent for a moment. He pushed the bones away from the console. The bones were all broken and piled on the ground.
He picked up a piece of paper and looked at it. He found that it was the western bible of the old era. He turned around and went to the side of the fallen bookshelf. He wiped off the dust and picked up a few books, these books were classic books from different fields. They were the essence and symbol of human civilization.
“I originally planned to let these people live and pass down the civilization…”Dudian’s eyes flashed. His father had such expectations for him.
However, the great thing of passing down the entire human civilization was ultimately unable to overcome the most primitive instinct, hunger.
There were dozens of books torn on the ground. They were scattered all over the place and became the only rations for the five people. The person whose bones were scattered most likely became the rations for the other four people.
Dudian looked at the books and put them down. He turned around and walked to the console. He looked at the numerous mechanisms and frowned slightly.
At this time, a soft voice sounded from behind him.
Dudian suddenly looked back. The cold vigilance in his eyes suddenly melted. He didn’t know when Aisha quietly stood up and walked towards him step by step. Her body swayed as if she was a baby who had just learned to walk.
Dudian was relieved when he saw her wake up. He was about to open his mouth when he suddenly noticed that her eyes were pitch-black and her hands were in the shape of claws. This was a posture that could launch an attack at any time.
His heart sank.
Roar!
Aisha suddenly roared when she saw Dean notice her. Her beautiful face was full of malevolence as she opened her mouth and pounced on him.
The last trace of hope and fantasy in Dean’s heart was destroyed when he saw her like this. He kicked the half-open door and the bolt of the metal door slid shut.
Bang!
Aisha hit the door and her head slightly tilted back. Then she roared and tried to hit the door again.

chapters.title: Chapter 596
chapters.content:
Chapter 596
Dudian’s heart sank. He quickly leaned against the door and used his body to block the door. At the same time, he looked around the room to find an escape route. However, he didn’t have much hope because of the messy scene in the room.
Bang!
The low sound of impact came from outside the door.
Dean, who was close to the door, felt a slight tremor. He couldn’t help but look up. He saw Aisha’s ferocious face sticking close to the glass window. Her beautiful face was full of malevolence and saliva was flowing from her sharp teeth, she waved her arms and smashed the door.
With each hit, there was a slight tremor on the door.
Feeling the magnitude of the vibration, dean was a bit stunned. With Haisha’s strength, she should be able to easily tear the door apart. But at this moment, the movement caused by the impact was like an ordinary person hitting the door, there was not too much force.
What happened?
Did her strength degenerate to such a weak point?
While dean was puzzled, Haisha continued to hit the door without stopping. But every time the door seemed to be fierce, it only trembled slightly and showed no signs of breaking.
Seeing this, Dudian was slightly relieved. He slowly took a few steps back in doubt. Soon, he noticed a phenomenon — except for the low sound of Aisha hitting the door, he didn’t hear Aisha’s roar.
However, he could clearly see her roar from the glass window. In other words, her voice was completely cut off by the door!
It was close, but no sound penetrated through.
“It’s not that her strength has deteriorated, but the material of this door… is it too tough?”Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed. He felt that the possibility was higher. Since this place was called the shelter.., it was able to withstand the impact of the disaster. Ordinary metal materials should have long been rotten, but there was no sign of oxidation or rust on the surface of the metal.
Puff!
While Dudian was thinking, Aisha suddenly raised her sharp claws and hit the window on the door. The transparent window, which had accumulated dust, did not break on the spot. Instead, it was dented inward by her sharp claws.
Dudian was stunned. He immediately knew that the window on the door was not tempered glass as he had previously thought. It was a more advanced synthetic material. It had a bit of glue and was full of stickiness and toughness.
Aisha raised her claws and pounced on him again.
There was a hiss and a hole was pierced through the window.
Buzz!
An alarm suddenly sounded in the room. A red light shot out from the small hole in the wall next to the console. At the same time.., all kinds of buttons and joysticks came out from the complex console: “Alarm! Alarm! There is an attack. Do you want to activate the attack system?” The same words were repeated.
Dudian was stunned for a moment. He reacted and immediately said: “No! Turn off the alarm!”However.., the alarm continued. The sound of the alarm was transmitted through the small hole in the window. Aisha who was attacking the window became even crazier. She roared and waved her claws to attack.
Dudian woke up and immediately spoke in English. After he finished speaking, the alarm stopped.
Without the interference of the alarm, Dudian suddenly heard Aisha’s roar from outside. He turned his head and saw that Aisha had completely penetrated a hole in the window. One of her arms had reached through the hole, the nails on her white palm were extremely sharp. She tried to grab Dudian but couldn’t touch him who was standing one meter away.
Seeing her crazy look, a trace of grief flashed through Dudian’s eyes. He took two steps back.
Roar!
Aisha roared and tried her best to grab him.
Dudian looked at her dignified and beautiful face. He slightly bit his lips. After a moment, he took a deep breath and whispered: “I’m sorry. I promised you that I will live. I will live well!”
Roar!
Aisha heard his words and immediately let out a more intense roar.
Dean looked at her and slowly turned his head. His eyes swept across the room and slightly frowned. Although he said that he wanted to live, but… This door seemed to be the only exit. If he wanted to leave this place.., he had to let Aisha leave this door first.
He couldn’t bear to do so.
Even if he could lure her away, once Aisha left the ruins, there would only be one outcome. She would become a ghost-like zombie and wander in the wasteland filled with monsters and undeads, she would wander aimlessly into the human fortress and be besieged by humans. She might wander deeper into the black wasteland and be hunted by higher-level monsters.
Even if she could survive..
But where would he find her then?
The world was so big and humans were so small?
Dudian was silent for a moment. He went to all parts of the room and gently knocked on the wall. He listened to the echo to see if there was a hidden door. Dudian’s mood became heavier after he checked the room. The thickness of the wall seemed to have reached an immeasurable level. Even his sense of hearing couldn’t hear the slightest echo.
“If I was the magic marks of the dye-fearing monster, I might have a chance to leave…”Dudian couldn’t help but feel sorry. The ability of the dye-fearing monster to cut metal could allow him to survive in this place, but.., if it was the magic marks of the dye-fearing monster, maybe he wouldn’t have lived until now. He had died countless times in the previous battle. He couldn’t have it both ways.
He slightly squatted down and pondered.
Roar!
Aisha seemed to be tireless. She growled and tried her best to grab him. However, her arms were stretched to the limit. She could only wave in vain in the air.
After thinking for a long time, Dean suddenly thought of something. The sound insulation effect of this door was so strong that it should be absolutely sealed. Even water could not penetrate through. In that case, the oxygen in this door should be scarce soon, they wouldn’t be able to wait until the five people starved to death because of the lack of oxygen.
“In this case, there is a vent inside!”Dudian’s eyes lit up. He looked around to find the place where the ventilation was.
After searching for several times, Dudian found nothing. He checked the ground but still couldn’t find a place like the vent.
He thought for a moment and suddenly thought of an idea. He squatted down and picked up a few bones from the ground. He took out the dagger from his leggings and scraped the surface of the bones. Soon, he scraped out bone powder, at the same time, he used the dagger to scrape the dust on the ground. It didn’t take long before he collected a large pile of dust under his feet.
He picked it up and stood on the chair. He came to the upper part of the room and gently blew the dust in his hand in all directions. Then he squinted his eyes and looked around.
The dust fell quietly but was pushed back by a gentle force.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he came to the wall. Soon, he found the ventilation vent in the room. It was in the gap between the corners of the metal wall.
Dudian tried to pry open the gap between the corners of the wall with his dagger. However, the corner of the wall was completely made of two metal walls. He couldn’t pry open it with the dagger in his hand, there was faint fresh air floating in the air. There was a ventilation pipe that was sending air into the control room.
However, it was completely unrealistic to get out of here.
Dudian angrily punched the wall. He had finally found a glimmer of hope but it was all gone.
He was angry but at the same time there was a trace of dejection in his heart. He slowly squatted down and fell into deep thought.
Roar!
Aisha unconsciously roared outside the door.
Time flew by.
Dudian gradually became a bit upset. He couldn’t think of any other way out.
He stood up and looked at the densely packed buttons and joysticks on the console. There was a trace of anxiety on his face… This was just a shelter. Why was the control room so complicated?
He had looked at the shelter outside. It seemed to be a large-scale warehouse without any devices. There was no need to configure such a console.
Soon, he thought of the alarm and his eyes moved slightly. In this way, this console seemed to be controlling the weapon system here.
Thinking of this, he came to the console and looked at the red and green buttons.
He did not dare to press randomly. If he accidentally activated any device, he would die even faster. Even if he did not activate any device, if he accidentally activated the door and opened it.., then Aisha outside the door would immediately rush in and tear him apart.
He did not think that the door could only be closed manually.
Among these buttons, there was probably a control mechanism to open and close the door.
Thinking of this, he suddenly lost the idea of trying. He turned around and looked at Aisha who was at the door. He quickly withdrew his eyes and sat on the chair next to her. When his arm was on the back of the chair.., he suddenly remembered that Aisha’s left hand had not been dealt with yet.
When he looked at his left hand, he saw that a large part of the biceps of his left arm had been torn off. In addition, the ice crystal of his left hand had turned dark at the part that had been bitten, like a mass of frozen thick ink, it was slowly spreading out.
Dudian’s heart sank.
It was not that he was worried about being infected, but… Aisha was able to infect him with the corpse poison through biting. This meant that the corpse poison in her body did not only spread in her body, it had completely mixed with the blood in her body.
In such a situation, even if it was not the corpse poison, if it was any other poison, it would basically be “Incurable disease”and she would die without a doubt.
If that was the case, then the sudden convulsion and coma that she had earlier was most likely not the “Stubborn resistance of her consciousness against the corpse poison”that he had thought of. Instead, it was her body that was being modified by the corpse poison. At the same time that she was gradually getting used to it.., an instinctive twitching reaction appeared in her body.
Thinking of this, he slowly raised his head and looked at Aisha who was trying her best to stretch her arm out from the window. He felt a wave of sadness in his heart. He only felt that her beautiful and beautiful face was getting further and further away from him.
After a long time.
He slowly calmed down and held the dagger to cut off the thick black part of his left shoulder.
The ice-crystallized arm made the corpse poison that had seeped into it spread very slowly. Because of the ice-crystallized arm, the self-healing ability of his left hand was also very slow. However, he did not feel any pain, even though the wound on his arm looked extremely scary, he did not feel any pain, but it did not affect his movements.
After treating the wound, he leaned against the chair and silently looked at Aisha. Although her face was full of malevolence, but her eyes were still beautiful. He vaguely recalled the scenes he had spent time with before.
In the Ice Cave, in the wilderness, in the fortress..
In his memories, the decadence on his face gradually disappeared, and there was a faint smile.
In the blink of an eye, two days passed.
Dudian stayed in the control room. He didn’t eat or drink. But because of the lack of strenuous exercise, he was able to hold on. But the feeling of hunger still came from time to time. He couldn’t help but think.., maybe he would be like the five people here. He would be trapped here and starve to death.
While he was resting, he was thinking about the way to leave. At the same time he was looking at the books scattered on the ground. He hoped to find the instruction manual of the ruins. But after two days of searching.., there was no book related to the shelter. All of them were huge works that represented the civilization of the old era.
“Food for the spirit… Hehe.”Dudian threw down a huge book about the history of mankind. He touched his stomach and felt a bit bitter.
He leaned against the bookshelf and looked up at the complex control panel.
In the past two days, he had tried to communicate with the intelligent system in English, but the latter didn’t pay attention to him.
Maybe the smart intelligence recognized his voice, and it was not an authorized voice? He felt powerless as he thought about it.
Roar!
Aisha growled and slightly twisted her palm.
After two days of growling, the frequency of her growl seemed to have decreased.
Dudian turned his head and looked at every inch of her face. was the only way to survive was to lure her away?
But that would mean that he would lose her completely. In the future, even her current appearance couldn’t be seen.
Why was he always faced with such a painful choice?
Why was he always choosing between “Yes”and “No”?
He felt a little tired and looked up at her silently. He just wanted to engrave her appearance in the depths of his soul.
Time passed bit by bit.
COO COO!
The hungry stomach began to cry. Dudian lowered his head and reached out to touch it. He thought bitterly in a self-deprecating manner, do you feel hungry too? Do you also want to eat?
“Don’t Cry…”he said to his own stomach.
After saying that, he looked up at Aisha again. But the next moment, he was stunned.
Scream?
His stomach was hungry… could he scream?
He was startled. His eyes slowly opened wider and wider. There was a strong look of shock on his face. There was even a trace of excitement that made him unable to believe it!
“I can scream! I’m hungry! I Can Scream! !”
Dean suddenly sat up and clenched his fists. He felt that his whole body was excited. He couldn’t help but look up at Aisha who was looking at him ferociously. He suddenly had the impulse to rush up and hug her.
“Haha…”he couldn’t help but laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 597
chapters.content:
Chapter 597
Roar!
Aisha heard the sound and roared like she was disturbed.
Dean looked at the girl’s beautiful and ferocious face and slowly stopped laughing. He had come to realize the reality.
Aisha, who used to be proud but gentle, could no longer come back.
A miracle would not favor him.
In that case..
He could only create a miracle himself!
“I will… let you go back to the way you were before.”Dudian’s eyes were extremely gentle as he looked at her. He whispered to her as if he was whispering to his most ardent lover.
Roar!
Aisha growled even more ferociously when she heard the voice.
Dudian slowly stood up. Although he was in a desperate situation at the moment, there was a strong desire to live in his heart. Originally, he was depressed and dejected after seeing Aisha’s corpse, at this moment, all of them disappeared from his body.
“When a person’s stomach is hungry, they will scream. This is an instinctive reaction. It is a kind of conditioned reflex.”Dudian took a step forward and came in front of Aisha’s claw. His eyes were extremely gentle, “Believe me, I will make you return to your original appearance.”
Aisha roared angrily and struggled to squeeze into her arm.
Dudian saw that her sharp fingertip had slightly increased. The confidence in his eyes increased.
Conditioned reflex. This phenomenon did not only exist in conscious living things. It also existed in the bodies of the unconscious undeads!
When he was a scavenger in the early days, he had observed that zombies would be attracted by sound sources and heat sources… even if the zombies’sensory organs were completely rotten, they could still accurately track the prey and lock onto the location of the prey, it was caused by such other factors.
And this proved that zombies also had the ability to receive information and analyze it!
Although the ability to analyze information was weak, they would not be attracted by each other’s footsteps. Instead, they would be attracted by each other’s roars. This proved that they still had a certain level of information analysis ability!
The existence of these abilities meant that they also had conditioned reflexes!
When they heard the source of the sound, they would gather. When they smelled the smell of blood, they would drool… these reactions belonged to their conditioned reflexes!
Moreover, because of the lack of consciousness, the movement of the undeads was completely dependent on conditioned reflex! !
If it wasn’t for the fact that his stomach was growling, Dudian’s mind wouldn’t have been so used to conditioned reflex. It wasn’t even considered as a phenomenon. However, it was a common phenomenon that people wouldn’t pay attention to. It made him burn with incomparable hope and faith!
What could a conditioned reflex do?
When the finger was burned by the flame, people would reflexively shrink their hands.
When people smelled the aroma of food, they would instinctively feel hungry.
This was a conditioned reflex.
This was the main means of taming police dogs and other animals in the old era!
Could the zombies that had conditioned reflex be tamed in the same way?
Although he hadn’t tried it yet but Dudian was very confident.
“She is like this because of the information I gave her. She thought that I was a delicious thing so she wanted to bite me. But she wouldn’t bite a stone. It’s not that the stone wouldn’t give out information but that she had received the information from the stone. After analysis she came to the conclusion that the stone couldn’t arouse her desire to attack.”Dudian’s expression was particularly serious, his eyes slightly flickered as he thought about the way to tame her through conditioned reflex.
He knew that once he had tamed her, he would be able to keep her by his side forever!
This was the last desire in his life!
“If… her information processing becomes chaotic and her conditioned reflex is changed, she will think that I am a rock. In that case, she won’t attack me.”Dudian frowned as he pondered, “In this case, I have to stop her from reacting to the blood. But it seems that something is wrong…”
The desire for blood was as instinctive as the desire for food.
But instinct was the most difficult thing to change.
He held his chin and pondered for a moment. Soon he knew what his mistake was. The people in the old era used conditioned reflex to tame the police dogs. It was not to suppress the instinct of the police dogs. On the contrary, it was to use some instructions.., to replace what the police dog needed!
“Use conditioned reflex to add instructions to tame…”Dudian muttered to himself. He gradually understood that if he wanted to use conditioned reflex to tame Aisha, he had to first establish order!
For example, to feed her on time, no roaring and so on.
Thinking of this, he sat cross-legged and began to make a tame plan in his mind.
When he was halfway through the plan, his stomach growled again. He immediately stopped and frowned. Forget about the training plan, his survival had become a big problem in front of him.
He looked up at Aisha. His action immediately aroused Aisha’s reaction. Her face once again cracked into a ferocious expression as she roared.
Dudian’s heart was silent. Did he really have to lure her away?
Once he lured her away, what method should he use to get her back?
While he was pondering in his heart, he suddenly caught a glimpse of the ground under the control panel. There was a slight dent.
The ground?
Dudian suddenly reacted. He couldn’t help but look at the ground under his feet. He stretched out his hand to touch it. Yes, the ground was not made of metal but concrete! Moreover, after more than 300 years, the concrete had cracked like molting in a sealed dry environment.
Dudian was excited. He couldn’t help but want to Pat himself a few times. He should have noticed this!
“I should have thought that it was impossible to use metal materials on the ground! In the old era people knew that the ground itself was the thickness of the earth. In addition to a solid foundation, it was the most solid defense. There was no need for metal materials at all! On the contrary, if metal materials were used, the project would be even bigger. The time and material consumption would increase. Moreover, the effect would only be slightly stronger. The main danger at that time came from the ground, not the underground. There was no special defense!”Dudian thought.
He quickly stood up and pushed away the messy books and papers scattered on the ground. The molting concrete floor was exposed. There were no tiles on it. Obviously, he was worried that the tiles would lock the moisture in the ground, the shelter was damp.
Dudian didn’t hesitate as he quickly used his hands to dig away the layers of cracked and fluffy concrete.
His fingernails dug into the concrete. He felt as if he was digging into the soil. He quickly dug out a handful of soil.
He was happy as he saw that there was hope. He changed his position and went to the corner of the ventilation vent to dig the soil. There was a ventilation pipe which meant that this place was the closest to the outside.
In the rapid digging, soon, a deep pit was dug out by him.
He could not help but recall his life in prison. He smiled bitterly in his heart. It seemed that he was fated to dig a tunnel.
However, the situation this time was undoubtedly much better than in prison. In prison, he still had to hide the sound of digging and the soil dug out, but he could dig as much as he wanted here.
When he dug out a hole more than a meter deep, he suddenly thought of Aisha outside the door. Once he climbed out of the tunnel, she would also leave this place. He had to leave her inside!
If he wanted to keep her, he had to close the gate of the ruins.
However, there were no valves in the gate of the ruins. The valves that could not be opened and closed were all outside the gate of the ruins.
He didn’t dare to touch the mechanism on the console so as not to accidentally open the gate.
“I’ll leave her here first. After I dig out, I’ll go around the ruins to see if there are any valves to close the gate.”Dudian made up his mind, he felt that the possibility of the valves being outside the gate of the ruins was very high. Otherwise, the people in the control room wouldn’t have starved to death.
He climbed out of the hole and picked up the chair that had fallen to the side. He placed it half a meter in front of Haisha’s finger. Then he cut off the ice crystal flesh on his left arm and hung it on the back of the chair. The height of the flesh was about the same as her finger.
As he moved, Haisha grimaced and growled.
Dudian looked at her and took out a dagger. He cut his wrist and let the blood flow along the back of the chair. He stopped when half of the back of the chair was dyed red. He quickly closed the wound and controlled the blood flow to stop the bleeding.
When he let out the blood, Aisha’s growl suddenly turned into a fierce roar. At the same time, there was a heavy breathing sound coming from her nose.
Seeing that it was effective, Dudian felt relieved. He turned around and went into the hole to continue digging.
He was very fast in digging. After all, his physique was not comparable to that of the ordinary people in the old era who were trapped here. After a few minutes, he dug three to four meters deep. He felt that the height of the foundation should be about the same, he turned to the side of the wall to dig.
As he expected, when he dug to the ground under the metal wall, he touched the soil and easily dug through it.
Dudian dug along the metal wall and found that the thickness of the metal wall was half a meter long. He couldn’t help but be speechless. Even if he was hit by a missile, it might not be able to destroy the ruins.
Soon, he went over the metal wall and immediately went up. After a few meters, he found that there was still mud on the wall. He could only continue to go up.
Ten minutes later, he dug out a gap from the other side of the metal wall. When he climbed out of the gap, he found that he had come to the ground. There were some wandering undeads in the surroundings.
In the two days that he was locked in the small room of the ruins, the tide of undeads still hadn’t completely spread.
Dudian gently exhaled and slid down the passage. The entire passage was like a “U”shape. Outside the metal wall of the ruins, there was more than ten meters of soil. Therefore, it was more like a “U”shape, it was more like a reverse “J”shape.
After sliding into the bottom of the passage, Dudian quickly climbed back into the room. He was relieved to see that Aisha was still roaring outside the door. He picked up the dagger and other things left on the ground and took out the corpse powder, he smeared it on his body again.
After smearing it, he took a short rest to recover some of his strength. He quickly climbed out of the passage and onto the ground.
After he came to the ground, he looked around and found a large rock. He moved it to the entrance of the tunnel to prevent the zombies from falling in and climbing into the control room.
After doing all this, he found the right direction and quickly came to the other side of the ruins. There were still zombies inside, but there were fewer of them than before.
He clenched his dagger and walked into the passage.
Some undeads saw him along the way and immediately avoided him. It seemed that they hated his smell.
Dudian was relieved as he went down the passage. Suddenly he saw a strange undeads lying on the ground in the passage. Its body was like a lizard and its tongue was very long, it had a human face but its cheeks were covered with scales. It looked extremely strange. It had a mouth that was cracked to the ear and a mouth full of sharp teeth.
When Dudian appeared, the strange undeads turned to look at him.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. It was too difficult for him to deal with such a strange undeads in his weak state. Moreover, he was worried that the sound of the fight would attract Aisha. She was completely unaffected by the corpse powder, with her current state, she could easily tear herself apart.
The lizard-like strange undeads stared at him with Amber Eyes. The gills under its mouth were slightly bulging as if it was sensing something. After a while, it slowly crawled to the side and spat out its forked tongue, it growled at Dudian like a demonstration.
Dudian was startled. He quickly realized that the strange undeads most likely thought of him as another senior undeads. After all, the powder mixed with the smell of different senior undeads.
Moreover, from its behavior, it could be seen that if it recognized him, it would most likely jump at him. It wouldn’t react in such a way. However, from this point, it could be seen that.., undeads did not seem to be completely unconscious creatures. When they faced their own kind, they would still have some different reactions.
Dudian took a deep look at it and slowly took a detour from the other side of the passage. He was constantly on guard against its attacks.
The lizard-shaped undeads did not pounce on him. Instead, they confronted Dudian. From time to time, they would demonstrate and growl.
Dudian quickly moved to the outside of the ruins. He paid attention to the lizard-like undeads as he looked into the ruins. From here, he could see the entrance of the control room in the depths of the ruins. Aisha was pouncing on him and growling, obviously, the smell of blood on the chair was more stimulating to her than his presence here.
Dudian was relieved to see that she wasn’t attracted to him. He looked around the gate of the ruins.
After scanning several times, he still didn’t see any device or dark valve. There was only an iris scanning device.
Could it be that the opening and closing were controlled by this device?
The idea flashed through his mind. He tried to open the iris scanning device and hit the button inside.
A Ray of red light shot out from the device and swept through his eyes. It was as if he had heard the electronic synthesizer: “Scanning Complete. Identity confirmed… Do you want to close the shelter?”
Dudian was startled. He didn’t think that it would be like this. He immediately replied in English: “Yes.”
Boom!
The gate of the ruins trembled slightly as he replied. The sound became louder and louder. The metal gate which had shrunk to both sides of the gate was pushed out again.
The ground trembled slightly as it was pushed. The huge movement immediately attracted the attention of the wandering undeads in the passage behind Dudian.
Dudian looked into the ruins and saw Aisha turning her head. At the same time, her palm seemed to be struggling to pull out from the small door of the control room.
“Damn it!”Dudian was a bit anxious, “Hurry up and close it!”
After struggling for a moment, Aisha pulled her arm out of the window. She roared and rushed over at lightning speed like a lightning leopard.
Dean’s pupils shrank.
Bang!
The gate of the relic closed with a loud bang.
At the same time, Dean felt that the gate slightly shook, and some dust fell off the door.
Dudian was shocked as he saw this scene. Was this her current strength?
Roar! Roar!
At this time, the undeads who came from the passage behind Dudian also fell on the giant gate of the ruins.
Dudian immediately withdrew from the crowd of undeads. Although he had hidden powder, but if he was too close, he would be exposed.
He closed the metal box and slowly walked back. He was ready to leave the passage. However he felt that he was in trouble not long after he walked out. He saw that the strange undeads were attracted by the sound and rushed over. The distance between them was about three or four meters, such a distance… … It was a bit too close for the perception of a senior undeads.
Moreover, Dudian saw that there was a fierce light in its eyes.
Suddenly, a rough voice came from the ramp in front of him: “Boss, there seems to be a cave here. Should we go in and take a look?”

chapters.title: Chapter 598
chapters.content:
Chapter 598
Dudian was surprised to hear the voice. was there someone? Was it the Dragon Guard?
At this time, the undeads in the cave seemed to have sensed the voice. They turned around and looked at the exit of the passage. They slowly shook their bodies and growled as they wandered over.
“Be quiet!”A young and gentle voice scolded: “If there are monsters lurking in the cave then you will alert the snake.”
“You don’t understand, do you?”The rough male voice chuckled, “I was trying to alert the enemy. There was a zombie tide here. Do you think there are any monsters here that can survive?”? “Look at the messy footprints here. They are so dense. There must be a lot of undeads left in the cave. They should be lured out when they hear my voice. If there are no undeads, it means that there are monsters living in the cave. If the undeads are lured out, we will take care of them.”
“That’s right.”Another Woman’s voice echoed in agreement: “It is dark inside. It is not good for us to fight inside. It will be much easier to lure them out.”
Another man’s voice was stiff: “There is movement inside. Be careful. Don’t be bitten if you meet high-level undeads.”
Dudian guessed that they were the dragon guards sent from the fortress. He thought of Hathaway as he thought of the fortress. His eyes couldn’t help but reveal cold killing intent.
At this time, the undeads in the passage were talking as they walked towards the ramp. The closer they were to the sound, the faster the speed of the undeads. By the time they reached the ramp, some undeads had already roared.
The lizard-like undeads that was confronting Dudian turned its head when it heard their voices. It quickly climbed out of the ramp.
In the blink of an eye, more than half of the undeads in the ramp had left.
Thump! Thump!
Dudian heard a low sound of impact. He couldn’t help but look back at the gate of the ruins. He saw that every time there was a sound of impact, there would be some dust on the gate.
“I’ll be back soon…”Dudian looked at the gate of the ruins and whispered to Aisha.
He followed the zombie crowd and slowly came to the ramp.
At this time, there was a fierce battle outside the ramp. The previous few people were fighting with the lizard-shaped strange undeads. From time to time, they would scream in fear. It seemed that the battle was extremely dangerous.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. After the sound of the battle gradually moved away from the exit, he slowly climbed to the top of the ramp. He opened his vision and looked out. Suddenly, he saw the open space hundreds of meters away, five figures were surrounded by the zombie crowd. The lizard-shaped strange undeads, the other few skeleton undeads and the ape-arm undeads were fighting with the five people.
Dudian looked at the armor of the five people and found that it was as he expected. It was the Dragon Guard.
He narrowed his eyes and slowly clenched his dagger. He was waiting for the opportunity to ambush them.
In just a few minutes, more than half of the zombies surrounding the five people had died. There were only a hundred zombies in total, and most of them were low-level zombies. If it weren’t for the strange zombies and a few mid-level and high-level zombies holding the five people back.., with their skills, it would be effortless for them to destroy such a small zombie horde.
Soon, one of the rough-built men was pounced on by the strange zombies. Fortunately, his companion came to his rescue in time, so he wasn’t bitten by the strange zombies. However, the armor on his chest was cut open, leaving a bloody mark.
More than ten minutes later, the battle gradually subsided.
The zombie crowd was completely annihilated. The fierce lizard-like Strange Walker was also killed by the combined efforts of a few people. Its head was cut off, and its body was separated from its body.
Among the five people, one of them had his arm bitten by an ape-arm walker, which was cut off in time by his companion. The other people were also injured in many places. Some of them were bitten and scratched by low-level zombies.
After the battle, the few of them took out medicine and began to heal.
Dudian squinted his eyes as he slowly groped for the ramp. Although his abdomen was hungry and there was nothing in it, but he still forced the blood in his body to surge into the bone armor state.
Whoosh!
He suddenly rushed out. He didn’t have any intention to sneak attack.
During the previous battle, he had noticed that the only woman among the five had a strong perception ability. If she had snuck up, they would have noticed her and lost the best opportunity to attack.
Gaston was about to ask Gwyn about the injury on his broken arm when he suddenly heard the sound of the wind. He was shocked and suddenly turned his head. He immediately saw a ferocious figure covered in white bones rushing over at an extremely fast speed.
“Not good!”Gaston shouted: “There are enemies!”
The others reacted and immediately noticed the ferocious monster that was rushing towards them. They noticed that the monster had already appeared in front of them. The distance of 100 meters was just a blink of an eye for Dudian, it was just a blink of an eye.
Puff!
Dudian took the lead and rushed towards the nearest brawny man.
The Brawny man reacted quickly. He raised his arms which were covered with pale golden scales to block the attack. The golden scales on his arms combined with his armor to form a double defense. His magic marks were the magic marks of dragonsteel, it was known as the most powerful magic marks among the rare magic marks!
Dudian’s arms shook. The attack posture changed in an instant. It went through the gap between his arms to block the attack and stabbed into his eye socket.
Although there were scales on his face but his eyeball was still weak. The dagger pierced through his eye socket and directly into his brain.
Whoosh!
He quickly pulled out the dagger. It was as if he picked up a leaf from his side. Everything happened in an instant. It was hard to see clearly.
Dudian’s figure didn’t stop as he pulled out the dagger. He rushed towards the youth.
“Bastard! !”Gaston roared as he jumped up from the ground. He rushed towards Dudian to rescue him.
Dudian’s body turned around and hit Gaston’s shoulder.
Gaston’s face was full of horror. His body was sent flying out of control.
Whoosh!
Dudian once again turned around. The dagger went towards the neck of the youth who was sitting on the ground. Blood bloomed like a lotus.
The youth raised his hand to cover his throat. He opened his eyes wide. Disbelief, anger, fear and other emotions interweaved on his face.
Dudian didn’t glance at the woman who was next to him.
The woman was a bit stunned. Everything happened too fast. From the appearance of Dudian to killing two people, it was less than five seconds. At the moment she saw Dudian rushing towards her. She was shocked as she calmed down. She quickly raised her machete to block and retreated.
However, Dudian’s speed was extremely fast. He quickly caught up with her and grabbed her machete.
The woman was surprised to see Dudian’s bold move. She waved her machete in an attempt to cut off Dudian’s fingers.
However, she was surprised to find that her machete was clamped by pliers. She couldn’t move it at all.
Whoosh!
Dudian pulled the machete with his bare hands. He borrowed the force to quickly approach her. He stabbed the dagger into her body. At the same time he lifted the dagger and cut through her abdomen, he turned to the right side of the young man who was about to escape.
The woman’s face was full of fear. She looked at Dudian who had turned to leave. It was such a big flaw but she didn’t have the strength to attack. She even felt the pain when she raised her hand.
Plop! Her body fell down.
Whoosh! At the same time, the dagger flew out and nailed onto the back of the young man who was trying to escape. After years of archery practice, Dudian’s prediction and accuracy were still maintained at a high level.
Everything happened too fast. From the appearance of Dudian to the defeat of the five people, it was as dazzling as a passing horse.
Gaston got up from the ground and saw that Farrah was killed. He couldn’t help but be stunned. He held his chest and looked at the figure standing in the middle of the field. From the eyes of the figure full of killing intent, he could see that this was not a zombie, he was a human just like them!
“Who… Who Are You?”Gaston couldn’t help but shout.
Dudian’s cold eyes swept over him. He didn’t answer. His figure suddenly jumped out and appeared in front of Gaston like a hurricane.
Gaston’s face changed. He got up and brandished his sword.
Dudian’s eyes narrowed. He didn’t Dodge. He raised his hand and grabbed the sword. The bone covered hand grabbed his sword but the sharpness of the sword was beyond his expectations, he heard the sound of cracking from his palm. At the same time he felt a sharp pain.
He growled and suddenly opened his mouth to pounce towards Gaston.
Gaston was shocked and wanted to pull out the saber but Dudian grabbed onto it. He raised his other hand to attack Dudian. Dudian also used his left hand to punch.
Gaston felt that his fist had hit a block of ice. It was extremely hard. He felt a sharp pain as if his fist had broken.
Roar!
Dudian opened his mouth to bite his throat.
Gaston had never seen a human use such a way of fighting. He was so scared that he let go of the knife and raised his hand to hit Dudian’s chin.
Bang! His fist hit Dudian’s chin.
Dudian couldn’t help but show a trace of joy when he saw Dudian’s head was hit back. The next moment, a silver light flashed through his eyes. It seemed that there was a mosquito bite on his neck. It was a bit numb and itchy.
Dudian was startled. He raised his hand to touch it but his vision suddenly turned dark.
Bang! Gaston’s head fell down.
Dudian held the tip of the knife in his hand. He used the hilt of the knife to hit the ground as he panted. Blood flowed down from the front of the hilt and dyed the hilt red.
All of this ended very quickly but he had exhausted all of his physical strength. Fortunately, the five of them were not on guard and the zombies had consumed a lot of physical strength. That was why his surprise attack was so smooth.
Phew!
He took two breaths and sat down. He could see the bodies of the five people in his wide field of vision. He was in a hurry before so he didn’t have time to identify whether they were really dead or not. But at the moment he didn’t have the strength to attack.
Even if someone pretended to be dead, he could only pretend that he still had some strength left so that they would not dare to attack recklessly.
After a short rest, he got up and went to Gaston’s body, which was clearly dead. He untied his backpack and immediately saw the food and water that he wanted to see in it.
He immediately opened the bottle, tore open the packaging of the food, and swallowed it in large mouthfuls.
While he was eating, he kept his eyes on his surroundings to guard against any unknown sneak attacks.
After he finished eating, he felt the burning hunger in his stomach disappear. The feeling of fullness in his stomach seemed to have recovered its strength.
He took a deep breath, slowly stood up, and took the first aid kit from Gaston’s belt. Then, he held his saber and went to the body of the rough and strong man who had been killed first. He first stabbed at his heart, when he didn’t react, he took off his backpack.

chapters.title: Chapter 599
chapters.content:
Chapter 599
Dudian came in front of the youth who was stabbed by the dagger. He was about to make a move when the youth’s body suddenly turned over. He quickly pulled out a knight’s sword and stabbed towards Dudian’s chest.
Dudian was surprised. Fortunately he was prepared. He raised the sword in his hand and blocked the sword. He quickly kicked the youth’s shoulder and forced him into semi-evolution state.
The youth saw that the sneak attack failed. His face was ugly as he turned and ran.
Dudian immediately dropped the backpack in his hand and quickly chased after the youth.
In his current state, his burst speed was close to that of a pioneer. He easily caught up with the youth. He quickly took out his sword and cut the youth down again.
Dudian slowly put away the semi-evolution state. He took a deep breath and dragged the youth’s body back. He turned around and looked at the surroundings. The smell of blood should have attracted the wandering senior undeads again.
He didn’t stay any longer. He went to the passage not far away and moved the stones. He carried the bodies of the five people to the small control room under the passage.
In an instant, the small room was filled with a strong smell of blood.
Roar!
A figure rushed out of the small room and fiercely hit the door. The door shook slightly. At the same time, a roar sounded. It was Aisha who was at the gate of the ruins.
Dudian saw that she was attracted and looked at her. He turned around and climbed down the passage. He went to the place where the five people were fighting and cleaned up a part of the traces on the ground, especially the footprints and traces on the way to the entrance of the passage.
After doing this, he moved the giant stone to the entrance of the cave to block it and returned to the control panel room.
After returning to the room, Dudian used mud to seal the passage under the metal wall. Even if there were people who noticed the stone covered cave, they would only be able to see a deep well passage, they wouldn’t notice the small room connected to the other side of the passage. Of course, it would be useless if they met someone with strong perception.
He sat next to a pile of soil and leaned against the soft soil. He took out some food and water from his backpack and ate them. After resting for a while, he felt that his physical strength had recovered a little, he immediately got up and came to the front of the small room where Aisha kept roaring.
Looking at her beautiful and ferocious face, he was slightly silent. He slowly clenched his fingers and whispered: “Bear with it. When we return to the giant wall, there will be a way to restore you to your original appearance.”
Roar!
Aisha roared.
Dudian looked at her and slowly turned around. He looked at the five corpses on the ground. The gentleness in his eyes immediately disappeared. He took the risk to kill the five people, it was not all for the supply of their bodies. The more important reason was to get their bodies!
In order to train Aisha’s reflexes to stop attacking him, satisfying her bloodlust was the most important part of the training process, just like training a police dog without bones or simulated bones, it would be difficult to train her.
After all, all the prerequisites of reflexes were based on instinct.
Although it was strange and sad to think that she would be trained by him in the way of training dogs, horses and other animals, it was the only way he could think of at the moment, and the goal.., besides keeping her by his side forever, he could also bring her back to the giant wall one day. He believed that the monster research institute in the inner wall might have some confidential information about zombies.
Although he did not have much hope that he could bring back the consciousness of Aisha who had turned into a corpse, but… more or less, there might be a glimmer of hope!
As long as there was a little possibility, it was worth trying!
He slowly squatted down and picked out the body of the young man who was almost the same size as him. He helped him stand up and stood on the ground. In order to have an effect, he deliberately kept their corpses intact.
Roar!
Seeing the smell of blood floating, Aisha roared even more crazily and tried her best to grab it.
Dean looked at her and felt a bit sad. He knew that his actions were a blasphemy to her. However, it was more difficult for him to stop such actions.
“I’m sorry…”Dean slightly bowed his head, “I’ll let you eat better when we return to the giant wall. Now… I’ll let you make do with this garbage. I’m sorry…”
He muttered strange words to himself. After he finished, he took a deep breath and looked up at Aisha again.
..
..
In the Dragon Fortress.
In an ancient and magnificent hall, a delicate figure dressed in luxurious robes sat on the throne. She looked down at the few dragon guards who were half-kneeling on the red carpet. The middle-aged man in the lead looked respectful, he raised his hands and held a huge blood-red sword in his hands. There seemed to be blood flowing on the blade, and a skeleton was carved on the hilt of the sword. Green light seemed to be flashing in his eyes.
“Your Highness, we only found this. We didn’t find any trace of her highness Aisha,”the middle-aged man said respectfully.
Hathaway narrowed her eyes and stared at the huge blood-red sword. She was definitely not mistaken about this familiar sword. It was her sister Aisha’s demon soldier, Blood Baron!
She had heard from a young age how difficult the forging process was and how many top-tier magic materials were used. She didn’t expect that the sword would fall into her hands today.
She couldn’t help but smile. Compared to the sword, she was happier about the message it sent back. Two days had passed, but the sword was still in the wilderness and hadn’t been retrieved by her sister.
She knew that within a certain range, the demon soldier and its master could sense each other. Two days had passed, and Aisha still had not recovered the sword, which could only mean that she was no longer there!
“My poor sister…”she smiled in her heart, but her expression was very calm, she said to the few people at the bottom of the steps, “You have rendered meritorious service in retrieving my sister’s demon soldier. From today onwards, you will leave your status as slaves of the Dragon clan and officially become members of the Dragon Clan. From today onwards, you will be able to return to your families and never set foot in the wilderness again.”
When the middle-aged man and his team members heard this, they couldn’t help but be overjoyed. They bowed and thanked her, “Thank You, Your Highness. You are truly a kind saintess. We will pledge our loyalty to the Dragon clan to the death.”
Hathaway nodded slightly, “Go.”
“Yes!”After thanking her, they immediately got up and left.
After they left, Hathaway finally couldn’t help but laugh out loud. But after laughing for a while, her expression quickly darkened, she said to herself, “Poor sister, Don’t blame me. If you want to blame someone, blame that old woman, Dragon Mother. She forced me to kill you. It’s all her fault…”

chapters.title: Chapter 600
chapters.content:
Chapter 600
From this chapter onwards, the content is on track, and I will try to write in a way that I feel is better
..
The earth still follows the orbit of the stars.
In the blink of an eye, two months have passed.
The dark snow that lurks inside and outside the giant wall is gradually melting, the temperature of the surface is slowly rising, and the rainy season is approaching.
This was not good news for everyone. Compared to the frozen snow, people hated the ubiquitous rain more.
“Captain, why did we come to this area?”Silas looked at the broken corpses around him with a worried face, he said to the captain, “I heard from a brother of the third team that most of the hunting teams in red wasteland region two have gone missing in the past two months, and none of them survived. There are already rumors that there are very terrifying monsters lurking here. If we meet them, we probably won’t be able to survive.”
Sauniere patted him on the shoulder, he smiled and said, “Buddy, these are all rumors. This place has been baptized by a zombie tide, so there won’t be any high-level monsters left. The Zombie King that gathered the zombie tide has already been killed. All of its weapons have fallen into the hands of His Highness Hathaway.”
“God bless us. I hope we’re okay.”Silas didn’t get rid of his worry and prayed.
Langdon smiled and said, “This is a wasteland, a forbidden land of gods. Even if there is a god, he can not protect you.”
Silas stared at her and said, “Nonsense. This world was created by God. God is anywhere in this world. Don’t blaspheme!”
Langdon was displeased and said, “Even if there is a god, he is an evil god.”
“Shut up!”Sauniere suddenly said.
The two ignored him and continued to argue. Sauniere turned to a spot in front and said in a deep voice, “Who are you?”There stood a thin figure. His figure was relatively slender, but his bones were bony. His eyes were deeply sunken, and he was wearing tattered armor. There was a faint imprint of the Dragon Clan Badge on his body, at this moment, he was looking straight at the five people. His deep sunken eyes were a pair of pitch-black eyes that were as deep as a pool. There was no emotion in them, which made Sauniere extremely uncomfortable. He also felt a great threat.
Langdon and Silas immediately noticed the figure that had appeared silently. They were shocked, especially Langdon. She had the ability to search for heat sources. Although she was arguing with Silas, she was constantly observing her surroundings, however, they did not notice when this person had approached them. Moreover, he had appeared directly in front of them. It was not an exaggeration to say that he was a ghost!
This ghost-like figure did not reply. His pitch-black eyes looked at the few of them indifferently. His figure suddenly flashed and disappeared into thin air.
When Silas saw the latter disappear, he was shocked. Could it be that he was hallucinating? In the next moment, he heard the captain Sonia’s explosive shout, “Be careful!”He had just reacted when he suddenly saw the ghost-like figure that had disappeared earlier appear directly in front of him as if it had teleported. This change was beyond his expectations, just as he was about to block, he felt a pain in his abdomen and his body flew backwards.
After sending a person flying, the phantom figure moved quickly like a wolf entering a flock of sheep. In the blink of an eye, it knocked down Langdon, who was good at perception. A cold light flashed across Langdon’s snow-white neck. The girl stared with her eyes wide open and fell down unwillingly.
“No!”Sonia’s eyes were about to crack. With a furious roar, he drew his sword and rushed out.
His sword was very light, Sharp, and fast.
However, after several exchanges, the sword could not even touch the ghost figure.
Soon, when their palms crossed, Sauniere’s sword suddenly disappeared mysteriously and fell into the ghost figure’s hand. In the next moment, a sword light flashed, and Sauniere’s body stiffened. He raised his hand to cover the sword in his chest, this was the first time he truly felt the sharpness of this sword.
After he fell, the Phantom pulled out the sword. With a flick of his finger, the sharp sword flew out and stabbed into the ground diagonally, trembling non-stop.
The phantom bent down to pick up the bodies of the few people. He turned around and ran quickly, running like a gorilla in the forest.
Soon, the Phantom stopped in front of a huge rock. He moved the huge rock away and threw the three corpses in his hand into the tunnel one after another. Then, he slid down the tunnel and climbed out from another place, it returned to the small control room where it had lived for two months.
The small room was messy. The ground was covered with bones. Most of the bones were still stained with blood and flesh. In addition, there was the smell of excrement and urine coming from the corner of the wall, the filthy smell covered the treasures of human civilization on the bookshelves. However, it was still difficult to cover up the disgusting stench.
Dudian threw the three corpses into the small room which was buried deep underground. He lay on the side to rest. He was breathing heavily and didn’t care about the stench in the air, he looked at the beautiful figure who was standing in front of him. She was like a green lotus compared to the bloody chaos and dirty environment.
As long as he looked at her, even in such an environment, Dudian didn’t feel tired at all. The bones around him were like flowers in full bloom, and each one of them was floating with a pleasant fragrance.
There was a smile on his cheek that was so thin that his cheekbones were prominent.
“After the last instruction is completed, we can go back,”he gently said to her.
Aisha stood in front of dudian. She was expressionless. She didn’t roar or respond. Her eyelids didn’t even blink. She stood in front of Dudian like a wooden statue.
Dudian was used to her state. He smiled and waited for her to recover a little. He picked up the woman’s body from the Three Corpses and handed it to her.
The rich smell of blood wafted out from Langdon’s snow-white neck. It was like a tempting demon claw that constantly stimulated Haisha’s senses. Her pure black eyes slightly contracted and her snow-white nose slightly twitched, the corner of her mouth twitched as if she was cramping. It seemed that she was trying her best to endure but also extremely eager.
Dean silently counted the time in his heart. Soon, five minutes had passed. At this time, Aisha’s reaction was much stronger. Her hands that were originally vertical and motionless began to tremble slightly. Her neck slightly twisted as her eyes stared straight at the snow-white neck in front of her.
Dean saw that she was about to reach her limit and immediately snapped his fingers.
Hearing the snapping sound, Aisha instantly felt as if she had been freed from a cage. She showed a ferocious and ugly expression that could endure to the extreme. In an instant, her beautiful face was torn into pieces. She completely disregarded her image and picked up the food in front of her, she bit, gnawed, and swallowed like a traveler who was hungry to the point of fainting. She wolfed down a piece of black bread.
The twisted and bloody scene played out in front of Dudian.
Aisha seemed to be too excited. She bit extra hard, causing the blood spurting out of Landon’s white neck to splash onto Dudian’s face. However, Dudian didn’t feel anything and just quietly looked at the crazy figure in front of him.
After Landon’s neck was completely bitten off, Dudian snapped his fingers again. Aisha, who was in a frenzy, immediately stopped as if she was frozen and then let go of his hand. The body of Landon in her hands fell straight down. The head with a trace of blood skin fell down and immediately broke. The head fell off and rolled to the side of the corpse’s pelvis, the beautiful eyes were still wide open.
Dudian looked at Aisha who had calmed down. His eyes revealed a gentle look. He took out a clean scarf and gently wiped Aisha’s blood-stained lips. As for where this scarf came from, he couldn’t remember. It seemed that it belonged to a woman from a team that he had killed a few days ago.
Haisha’s face was expressionless as she was wiping her lips.
Dudian looked at her and smiled. Then he reached out his hand to her. He was as polite as a gentleman who invited a noble lady.
Haisha was silent for a moment when she saw his raised hand. Her palm was slightly raised. It was a bit stiff, but she returned the gesture and handed it to Dudian. Dudian was very satisfied. He pinched her fingertips and gently lifted them. He used the other end of the scarf to gently wipe her white and tender fingers one by one, he wiped the blood stains on the gaps of each finger as if he was a rich man wiping his favorite jewelry.
Soon, he finished wiping and put her palm down in the same elegant posture. He asked with a smile: “Are you tired from standing for so long?”
Aisha was expressionless and motionless.
Dudian smiled as if he got the answer: “Are you tired? Let’s sit down and rest, okay?”
Aisha was still standing quietly.
Dudian pretended to listen. Soon his eyebrows moved and he smiled: “Let’s take a rest.”He supported her body and went to the chair next to her, he took out two metal sticks from his belt and gently knocked twice.
Aisha slowly sat on the chair, but her back was still straight.
Dudian smiled and sat on the ground next to the chair. He put his head on her leg and gently stroked her calf, he gently said: “We will go back soon. I will help you find a way to restore your consciousness. There must be a way… After all, didn’t they say that even God exists? If so, why can’t there be a way to bring back the dead?”
“Well, I knew it. You think the same as me.”
“You should rest well. I’m a little tired too…”
..
..
A few days later.
In the Dragon Fortress, jacques lowered his head and said to Hathaway who was sitting on the majestic throne above the steps, “Your Highness, the teams in Red Wilderness Area 2 have been missing frequently recently. Moreover, all of them have been wiped out, and none of them survived. This kind of situation is normal, but it doesn’t make sense. According to our previous experience, even if we encounter a high-level monster, we will more or less send back some information. I hope your highness can understand it.”
Hathaway said condescendingly: “Then, what do you think will happen?”
Jacques stole a glance at her, hesitating in his heart, but he still said his thoughts: “Your Highness, you said before that her highness Aisha died together with the corpse king, but in my opinion, although the corpse king is protected by two giant God corpses and is very terrifying, it shouldn’t be a match for her Highness Aisha. Perhaps, something happened in red wilderness two regions that we don’t know about.”
Hathaway narrowed her eyes: “So, you don’t Think My Sister Is Dead?”
Jacques shook his head: “I don’t mean that. Her Highness Haisha’s blood count is always with her. “I just think that if her Highness Haisha is dead, it means that the corpse king of the Red Wilderness area is stronger than we thought. Maybe the corpse king has three giant God corpses guarding it. If that’s the case, we might have missed one. I think we should send an elite team to investigate so as not to sacrifice the ordinary dragon guards.”
Hathaway slightly nodded, “Interesting, let’s do it this way. You can personally lead a team to investigate this matter.”
Jacques heaved a sigh of relief and quickly accepted the order.
After Jacques left the hall, a person immediately flashed out from the dark side of the hall, she said to Hathaway, “Your Highness, we can’t let Jacques go to Red Wasteland region two. Her perceptive ability is one of the best among the eight generals. If she really finds out any traces, wouldn’t it be…”
Hathaway indifferently said: “The best way to solve the suspicion is to let her find the answer herself. “Do you think I don’t know that her purpose of going to the Red Wilderness is to find out the cause of my sister’s death? HMPH, she is too self-righteous. With the tide of corpses at that time, after my sister died, there wouldn’t be half a corpse left. Don’t forget, My Sister has the purest blood of our dragon race. Her blood has a fatal attraction to monsters.”
“I see.”The shadow lowered his head and said respectfully, “Your Highness is truly thoughtful.”
..
..
In the vast and chaotic wasteland, two figures were walking forward. From the looks of it, they were a man and a woman. The man was carrying a small backpack while the woman was empty-handed. She followed closely behind the man like a ghost.
The sky was filled with dark clouds and there was a faint thunder.
It seemed that a heavy rain was coming.
Dudian was a bit tired from walking. He stopped to take a rest. He heard the Thunder above his head. He looked up and suddenly thought of something. He looked around and soon found a bush.
He walked over and found a few large leaves. He wove them into a grass umbrella.
After he wove the umbrella, the rain began to fall and soon the ground was wet. He held the straw umbrella and covered Aisha’s head. The Breeze blew and he tilted his head to look at Aisha with a smile.
Aisha was expressionless. Her pure black eyes quietly looked into the distance as if she was looking at another world.
Dudian smiled and looked up at the continuous rain. He said to Aisha: “You Say, the sky is so far away from us. Why does it rain on the ground?”
Aisha remained silent and didn’t answer.
Dudian looked at her expectantly. After a long time she didn’t open her mouth and proudly solved the puzzle, “It doesn’t matter if you can’t answer it. The answer will be difficult for the masters. It is because of the gravitational pull of this planet. Haha, How Is It? Isn’t it funny?”

chapters.title: Chapter 601
chapters.content:
Chapter 601
The contents of this book were about to get on the right track. This was what I was looking forward to, and of course, what everyone was looking forward to.
However, not all of the contents that happened after that were what everyone was looking forward to and loved. Perhaps some of them would challenge some people’s worldviews, and they wouldn’t be able to look directly at it. However, this was the appearance of this book.
This book was by no means a good book. Whether it was in terms of business or positive energy, Old Gu didn’t want to use the banner of Black Energy being the true truth to show off. Speaking of this, to mention the original intention of writing this book, there are two points.
The first is to give their own eschatology road to draw a more satisfactory full stop.
The second, there are also some ideas, want to write this book while finding the answer.
So, no matter what happens, this book will not be affected and changed for any reason, if some negative thoughts and extreme circumstances in the book, you can not persist, then we will meet next year’s next book.
Gentlemen Say Goodbye and don’t speak ill of each other.
Finally, I hope all the fans will always be happy ~ ~

chapters.title: Chapter 602
chapters.content:
Chapter 602
Aisha remained silent.
Dudian smiled and held Aisha’s small hand. Although it was cold but he felt a familiar warmth. He held Aisha’s hand and slowly walked forward. They crossed the puddles on the road.
They walked side by side in the heavy rain. Dudian was talking to himself in the rain.
The dilapidated buildings on both sides of the road were like silent haunted houses. The collapsed holes were like deep eye sockets as they looked at the two people passing by, the walls were washed away by the heavy rain.
The rain came and went quickly.
The rain stopped in the blink of an eye. Only one or two drops of rain fell onto the muddy puddles on the road. It rippled and distorted the gray sky reflected in the puddles.
Dudian saw that the rain had stopped and put away the umbrella. He suddenly felt a bit cold on his shoulder. He turned his head and saw that his left shoulder was wet by the rain.
He put away the straw umbrella and grabbed the clothes on his shoulder. He wrung out the rain and continued to walk with Aisha.
When he reached the intersection of the street, he stopped and looked up at the southeast. He was silent for a moment, he turned to Aisha: “Your weapon was not found in the tide of corpses. It should have been recovered by the Dragon Clan. Don’t worry. When we return to the giant wall, everything we lost will be returned to our hands. I Promise You!”
Aisha’s pure black eyes looked at him as if she was saying, “I believe you.”.
Dudian thought so. He smiled and led her in another direction.
..
..
High above the towering wall, a small black dot is crawling, like a small mosquito lying on the wall.
With a rustle, Cage slid down quickly, his hands on the rope, but he breathed a sigh of relief. Every time he climbed over the giant wall, he felt especially nervous and afraid, because this height has already exceeded his bearing limit, once falls, will shatter the bone!
Therefore, every time he jumped, he would carefully check the rope and at the same time, observe the direction of the wind to avoid encountering a gale.
Bang!
When he was seven or eight meters above the ground, his palm loosened and he jumped down from the rope. When his two feet landed on the ground, a tremor came from the soles of his feet. Although it was a little painful, the feeling of stepping on the ground was extremely stable. He let out a light breath and immediately turned around to walk in large strides, in a short while, he arrived at a dilapidated ruin that was covered by deep grass.
He walked around the ruin and pushed aside a cluster of deep green grass, revealing a hole that led into the rubble. He walked in and came to the basement of the ruined building. There was a dusty car parked there.
He lay down and climbed under the metal big piece. There was actually a stairway here.
His body went in along the stairway. He took out a matchstick and lit the oil lamp on the wall. He slowly stood up and walked down the winding stairway. Soon, he came to the end of the passageway. There was a pitch-black iron door.
He took out the key and opened the door. Inside the door was an extremely spacious basement. Rather than a basement, it was more like an underground cave. There were soil and rock walls all around, inlaid with oil lamps. In addition, the spacious cave was filled with items, but they were not hunting equipment. Instead, they were some metal materials and raw materials of different kinds.
Sergei glanced at the familiar cave and saw nothing unusual. He took off the huge bag on his back and put it aside. There was enough food and water for him to continue living here for a while.
He went to a simple bed and lay down. He leaned against the bed and crossed his legs. He took out the dagger and wood. He was bored as usual as he carved the puppets.
This was the entertainment he had thought of when he saw the sculptures in Dudian’s room. He learned quickly after trying it twice. He was able to sculpt the objects in a lifelike manner.
However, his puppets were different from others. He only sculpted naked women.
Because this was his biggest hobby.
The sharp dagger slid across the wood. He was very satisfied with the sculpture. He couldn’t help but kiss it, he felt as if he was kissing the breasts of a real beauty. He closed his eyes comfortably.
Soon, he opened his mouth and revealed a bright smile. “You’re my 108th woman. I’ll call you 108 from now on, understand?”
Of course, the puppet didn’t know how to speak, but Sergei had always been very good with women. After he finished speaking, the dagger in his hand quickly slid across the gap between the puppet’s lips. Soon, the corner of the puppet’s mouth curved upwards, it seemed to be shy, but also seemed to be happy.
Sergei couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
Halfway through his laughter, he was suddenly startled. He couldn’t help but raise his head and look up. His expression became serious. He straightened his body and flipped over the metal board. He came to a wall in the cave and leaned over to listen. Soon, his expression changed, and he was bewildered, “Footsteps? And it’s two people? Who could it be? Could it be that he has returned? Impossible, he has always been a loner, and it can’t be Glenn and the others…”
After eliminating the possibility of his allies, his expression slowly darkened. He turned around and quickly came to the metal board. He put down the puppet and dagger, grabbed the weapons and battle bag beside him, and quietly climbed out of the cave, he came to the deep grass outside and half-squatted by the grass. He looked at the source of the footsteps with a cold gaze, and gradually, two figures slowly walked over from afar.
Because of the grass that covered his waist, he could only see the upper body of the person. When he saw the two black dots, a trace of killing intent flashed in his eyes. He clenched his weapon and silently estimated the best sneak attack range.
As the opponent gradually approached, he slowly saw the face of the opponent. When he saw clearly, he couldn’t help but open his eyes wide. Soon, he rubbed his eyes again. This time, he saw more clearly.
“Young Master!”Sergei couldn’t help but stand up. He looked at Dudian who was walking in front of him and waved his hand.
Dudian saw Sergei who had shaved his head. There was no surprise on his face. He held Aisha’s hand and continued to walk slowly.
Sergei saw that Dudian was walking slowly and immediately took the initiative to run over. When he saw Dudian’s appearance up close, he was shocked. He hadn’t seen him for two or three months. In his heart, he was still a teenager, at the moment there were several strands of white hair in his hair. The rest of his black hair had faded as if it had been smeared with white frost.
Sergei felt incredulous: “Master, you…”
Dudian said: “What?”
Sergei saw Dudian’s calm eyes. His heart suddenly felt as if it had been bitten. He felt that his heart was constricted. It was an extremely strange feeling. He felt that Dudian was a bit strange, it seemed that he was very different from the teenager in his previous memory. But there was one thing that hadn’t changed. It was difficult to guess his thoughts and thoughts from his eyes.
“No, nothing.”Sergei shook his head. Suddenly he felt the hair on his body stand up. It seemed that there was an extremely evil gaze on his body. He couldn’t help but shrink his pores, he looked at the source of the cold air and saw a slim figure behind Dudian. However, when he looked at the figure, he subconsciously took a step back.
It was as if he had met a natural enemy. There was an uncontrollable trembling that spread throughout his body.
Dudian noticed that Sergei was frightened. He looked at Aisha and saw that her expression was a bit gloomy. It seemed that she was enduring. He couldn’t help but frown. It seemed that the training needed to be strengthened.
“This is my friend. You Don’t have to worry.”Dudian said: “But her temper is not good. It is best not to get close to her. Don’t let her see red objects.”
Sergei couldn’t help but glance at the beautiful girl. Her appearance had overturned his previous definition of beauty. However, he had never seen such a perfect face, he couldn’t think of blasphemy.
“Young Master, Your Friend is my friend.”Sergei squeezed out a smile and stretched out his hand.
Dudian pressed his hand down: “Have you forgotten what I just said?”
Sergei was startled: “I didn’t forget. I was afraid that it would be impolite.”
Dudian said: “Have you prepared the materials?”
Sergei immediately said: “I have prepared them. I will take you to see it.”
Dudian nodded.
Sergei quickly turned around and ran back to the ruins: “Master, I have built the wilderness stronghold that you asked me to build. You can tell me if you are not satisfied. I can change it.”
Dudian took Aisha and followed behind him.
After entering the ruins, Dudian quickly saw the underground cave stronghold that Sergei had built. He couldn’t help but nod. Sergei looked rough on the surface but he was meticulous on the inside. He needed such a person to work for him.
“Good.”Dudian glanced at the cave: “Very Good.”
Sergei grinned after receiving dudian’s praise: “This is based on the methods I saw when I was a hunter from other consortia. I just copied them.”
“It is a skill to copy.”Dudian replied.
Sergei scratched his head and smiled.
Dudian came to the front of the materials. He glanced at them and knew that the quantity of materials was correct. He nodded in satisfaction, sergei said: “You have worked hard these days. Go back to your residence and rest. Tell Glenn and Nicholas that I’m going back. Tell them to prepare manpower and money.”
Sergei was surprised: “Master, what are you going to do?”
“War!”Dudian calmly said.
..
… ..
The rain continued. In the blink of an eye, it had been two months since the beginning of the rainy season.
Dudian sat under a broken stone. The stone was like an umbrella which blocked the rain. He looked at the sky which was covered by the rain. He was silent for a moment, he looked at Aisha who was sitting on a stone: “When we first met, it was in such weather. Do you remember?”
Aisha was silent.
Dudian tilted his head and looked at the left side of the giant wall. He narrowed his eyes: “If I woke up that day as my birthday, I would be eighteen years old now.”
Aisha remained silent.
Dean continued: “In the blink of an eye, I have been in this world for ten years! Ten Years… my previous memory was only eight years. In these eight years, I can only remember about five years. Do you think I belong to this world or that world?”
There was silence and no response.
Dudian looked into the distance. After a moment, he slowly withdrew his eyes, “The sky is clear.”
The rain stopped. The sunlight penetrated through the cloudy clouds and shone on the ground. There was a fresh smell in the air that was filled with the smell of decay.
Dudian slowly got up and gently rubbed his fingers to make a small sound.
Aisha immediately got up and followed behind him.
Both of them returned to the cave under the ruins. Dudian moved some strange parts to the outside of the ruins. He piled them on the empty ground and assembled them one by one.
After two months of smelting and forging, his new invention was basically completed.
This time the main purpose of the new invention was not to kill the enemy but to protect himself! Under the current conditions, the only new divine art that he could think of and produce was the Thunder Weapon!
A fortress filled with thunder and lightning, and a set of armor filled with high-voltage direct current. This was his new divine art.
Even if it was someone ten or a hundred times stronger than a pioneer, he believed that it would not be faster than the speed of the electric current. Anyone who attacked him would be killed by him!
As for other technological items, those with high lethality were nothing more than hot weapons. However, whether it was missiles or other weapons of mass destruction, it was too difficult to make them first. Secondly, even if they were made.., the effect on the pioneers was not strong, unless it was a sneak attack.
However, a sneak attack could succeed once. If it happened twice or thrice, it would be equivalent to an all-out war with the inner wall.
