At that time, the effectiveness of the missiles would be almost zero. The inner wall could send assassin-type pioneers to infiltrate his fortress, they would directly assassinate him!
Therefore, in front of many weapons, only lightning could protect him. Even if the enemy’s speed was faster than his reaction and assassination skills were better than his perception, he would have the protection of the fortress and armor which were covered with high voltage electricity, he would have an immortal body!
And this was the biggest capital for his survival!
“If it wasn’t for the electric current that was deployed to the inner wall, there would be too many power grids. Just by relying on electricity, it would be enough to rule the entire world.”Dudian felt regret in his heart. However, he was quite satisfied with his self-protection.
As for the battle, he had other preparations.
Soon, he finished assembling the generator. It used wind energy to generate electricity. There was no need to worry about pollution in the environment outside the giant wall. He was ready to use the super large battery to store electricity.

chapters.title: Chapter 603
chapters.content:
Chapter 603
A few days later.
Sergei returned from the giant wall and reported to dudian: “Master, the things you have told us are ready. Nicholas and Glenn are waiting for you to go back.”
Dudian sat on the stone with Aisha and looked at the sunset. He didn’t look back as he heard Sergei’s words: “Did the news leak out?”
Sergei replied: “No. I only told Glenn, nicotine and your two friends. No one else knew.”
Dudian nodded as he looked at the sunset. He thought in his heart that night was coming. Even the dazzling sun was corroded by blood red. Was it a sign of something?
He slowly stood up and dusted off the dust on his sleeves. He took Aisha’s hand and whispered: “We can go home.”
Aisha quietly stood up with a cold expression.
Sergei looked at Aisha who stood up. He felt a slight throb in his heart. Every time he faced this girl, he had a frightening feeling of living in a cage with a tiger. He couldn’t help but want to leave as soon as possible. But he knew that.., this girl seemed to have a very high position in Dudian’s heart because he had never seen this cold-blooded teenager who was so intimate and gentle to anyone.
Dudian put a few super batteries filled with electricity into the hunter’s backpack and gave them to Sergei to carry. He took the lead and went to the rope in front of the giant wall. He looked at Aisha, he grabbed Aisha’s waist and grabbed the rope with his other hand. He used one hand to climb up.
Sergei was afraid that the rope would be too heavy and break. He didn’t dare to follow. He stood underground and watched the figures of Dudian and Aisha gradually go to the top of the giant wall, he didn’t expect that this mysterious and terrifying girl would follow Dean so well. The intimate relationship between the two was obvious. He was more and more afraid of Dean.
Dean didn’t look down. He climbed to the top of the giant wall in one breath. He pulled with all his strength and jumped up from the rope. He landed on the giant wall. He looked at Sergei who had just climbed up the rope. He didn’t urge him but waited, he looked at the endless scenery inside the giant wall.
Sergei climbed up the giant wall: “Young Master has been waiting for a long time.”
“Let’s go.”Dudian held Aisha with one hand. He went to the other side of the giant wall and slid down the rope.
..
..
The night quietly arrived.
The stars dotted the night sky.
Carriages arrived in front of a luxurious manor in a bustling town in the business district. The carriages didn’t stop outside the gate like the ordinary noble visitors. Instead, they directly galloped to a spacious open space in the manor, the people who got out of the carriages wore strange masks. The attendants led them into the brightly lit manor castle.
Different from the quiet manor, in the depths of the manor, there was a bustling sound. It was like a lively market during the day.
The masked figure wandered around the square, choosing the materials he needed in front of the stalls or the latest news from the district. In addition, there were also some works sold by alchemists and potioneers.
Hawkeye stood by the window, quietly looking at the familiar night scene in the square. After a moment, the door behind him was suddenly pushed open, and a handsome young man of about seventeen or eighteen years old stepped into the room with an arrogant look on his face, he said, “Hawkeye, the meeting is about to begin. The elders asked you to prepare the meeting materials. How are you doing?”
Hawkeye frowned slightly. He did not like to be disturbed by others, and at this moment, it was precisely the person he disliked the most, doing the thing he disliked the most. A trace of killing intent flashed in his Golden Eyes, but it was quickly hidden, including the anger in his heart.
He turned around and said with a smile, “Secretary Ma er, I have already prepared the information. It can be handed to the elder at any time.”
The arrogant youth snorted coldly and said, “If you are ready, come to the meeting room. Don’t let everyone wait for too long.”
“Okay, I will come right away.”Hawkeye said with a smile.
The arrogant youth immediately turned around and left. He grabbed the door handle and casually closed it. With a bang, the door frame shook slightly.
Hawkeye’s smile immediately disappeared. He grabbed an expensive art cup and threw it out. With a bang, it smashed into the wall and shattered. He snorted coldly, grabbed the information on the bookshelf next to him, and left the room.
In the meeting room, seven figures sat on both sides of the Round Table. At the highest seat sat a hunchbacked old man. His face was full of wrinkles, and he was no different from an ordinary old man on the street. On his finger.., he was wearing an inconspicuous dark green jade ring. Only a few people knew that the price of this ring alone was enough to match 50% of the wealth of any one of the six major financial groups!
The meeting room was pushed open and the young man entered. The arrogance on his face had long disappeared. He humbly bent his back and came in front of the old man. He said in a low voice, “Elder, Hawkeye is here.”
The old man’s eyelids, which looked like they were dozing off, were still half-closed. There was no reaction. He only let out a soft hum.
Soon, Hawkeye also entered the room. He glanced at the young man who was standing behind the old man obediently. At this moment, there was no trace of arrogance on the young man’s face. He only took one look before turning his head and saying to the old man, “Elder, I have already prepared the information you asked for.”As he said that, he handed the information in his hands to the old man.
The old man did not receive it.
The young man nimbly took it and placed it respectfully on the table in front of the old man.
The old man was silent for a moment before he slowly opened his mouth, he said, “Everyone, in a few days, it will be the Elders’meeting. “Every elders’meeting is nothing more than discussing the matter of ranking. Based on the performance of our ninth district over the past half a year, everyone feels that after this elders’meeting, what rank do you think our ninth district can still rank in?”
Hearing this, the expressions of the six people under them changed slightly, one of the women with a voluptuous figure immediately said, “Elder, you can’t blame us for this. If you want to blame someone, you can only blame the previous elder. Not only did he not do anything after taking office, he even dismissed six of our representatives and imprisoned me in the dungeon. Fortunately, Elder, you came and freed me. Otherwise, our ninth district’s influence would be even weaker.”
“That’s right!”Another burly man said in a low voice, he said, “Elder, we have tried our best to develop. However, after the previous elder removed the six members of the parliament, he suddenly disappeared. During his term of office, he did nothing. Previously, when our District 9 was violated, he completely ignored it, causing us to suffer heavy losses. If it wasn’t for him, our District 9 would definitely be able to maintain our status in the District 9. We might even have a chance of rising!”
“That’s right!”Another person immediately agreed, he said, “Elder, if it weren’t for your timely arrival, the ninth division would have been even more chaotic without anyone to lead us. It’s possible that we would even be at the bottom. Although I have spent a lot of effort in grooming many new people with potential these past few days, time is limited after all. I believe that we will definitely be able to restore the ninth division’s ranking when the next meeting of elders comes…”
The old man raised his hand slightly and stopped the others who wanted to speak. He said indifferently, “The previous elder has a great responsibility. I know this, but during the period when I took over, how are the tasks that were assigned to you all?”
Hearing this, everyone was stunned. They looked at each other with ugly expressions.
“As a member of Parliament, I’m very disappointed that you have such a negligent performance. The speaker is also very disappointed!”The old man said indifferently.
When they heard the word “Speaker,”everyone’s expression changed slightly. A hint of respect flashed in their eyes.
“The ranking this time will definitely drop,”the old man said slowly. “However, on account of the bad influence of the previous elder, I will bear the responsibility for this matter alone! “However, I hope that everyone will not make things difficult for me during the next elders’meeting. If I’m in a difficult position, everyone will be in a difficult position. Do you understand?”
Everyone had different thoughts and bowed their heads in unison. “Yes.”
“Alright.”The old man’s eyes flashed slightly as he glanced at everyone, he then turned to Hawkeye and instructed, “Pass the information to everyone. Everyone, this is the latest information on the eighth and eleventh regions that have been opposing us for the past half a year. Everyone, take a good look at the increase in the number of three-star alchemists and the status of a new five-star potioneer in the eighth region.”
“There’s a new 5-star Potioneer in the Eighth District?”
Everyone was slightly shocked and immediately picked up the documents to read.
The old man slowly said, “After the Elders’meeting is over, I’m going to conquer Leia Street in the East District. That’s the ancestral land of the Moss family in Huasheng Financial Group. If we can conquer that place, we might be able to strangle the Moss family’s throat. In this way, we can make up for the losses caused by the previous elder…” Suddenly, a gust of cold wind blew in from outside, causing the temperature in the room to instantly drop. It was chilly.
The old man frowned slightly. Just as he was about to instruct the youth to close the door tightly, he suddenly felt an icy cold palm on his shoulder. At the same time.., an extremely calm voice sounded in his ear, “Everyone, are you talking about me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 604
chapters.content:
Chapter 604
Hearing this, everyone was shocked and looked over.
They saw a tall figure appear behind the old man. When they saw his face clearly, the six members of parliament on both sides of the table widened their eyes and exclaimed in shock, “It’s You? !”
They had never expected to see this previous elder again. wasn’t he already wanted by the speaker? How dare he appear here in public?
At this moment, someone noticed that this previous elder did not come alone. Behind him, in the dark, stood a figure that looked like a ghost. From the outline of the figure, it seemed to be a woman, just like his shadow.
The old man felt as if he was being looked down upon by a ferocious tiger, as if he would be struck by lightning at the slightest change. He did not panic, and his expression did not change. However, his shoulder suddenly moved, and a hard force burst out from his bones. He believed that.., not only would this move be able to shake off this hand, but it could also be used to injure this person. After all, not just anyone could casually place their palm on his shoulder.
However, just as this hard force rose, he felt his shoulder suddenly sink. The palm on his shoulder was like a huge mountain pressing down heavily. Not only did it completely cancel out the force that he had burst out, but it also directly crushed over with a bang, the legs of the chair he was sitting on exploded.
His body swayed, and he felt a slight stuffiness in his chest, as if he could not breathe.
The old man was shocked. He could not help but turn his head to look. He saw a handsome young man who was much younger than he had imagined. His expression was indifferent, and his black eyes seemed to be looking at the conference table in front of him, he also seemed to be looking down at him from above.
“Who are you?”The old man suppressed the shock in his heart and asked in a deep voice.
Hearing the old man’s words, the clever young man next to him immediately scolded, “Bastard, give me your dirty hands. Who Are You? How dare you barge in here? Do you want to die…”
The moment he said the word “Die”, his voice immediately became distorted.
His neck was strangled, and a bald man wearing a mask flashed in from outside. He carried a huge black bag on his back and strangled the young man’s throat like he was holding a chicken, he suppressed his voice: “Kid, why don’t you try to say your words again?”
The boy’s throat was suppressed. His face was red and he couldn’t breathe. At this moment it was difficult for him to speak.
“Everyone, long time no see. Do You Miss Me?”Dudian’s voice was flat.
The six of them were members of the dark church. They had been through hundreds of battles with the Holy Church. How could they not see that the old man had been restrained by Dudian, the old man had killed several Grand Knights of the Holy Church since he took over the position. He looked like a skeleton but his body contained terrifying power. However at this moment.., he was restrained by Dudian so easily!
Everyone felt their scalps go numb as they thought of the possibility of this man appearing here. He was wanted by the speaker. Since the other party dared to appear here, there was a possibility that he would kill them!
“Elder, Elder, we all miss you.”A bearded middle-aged man revealed a natural smile. However, the muscles on his face were stiff.
“Yes, Elder, we all miss you.”Another strong man added.
The Calm Old Man’s heart was stirred up again. He didn’t think that this youth was the missing elder. Moreover, he dared to appear here.
“I know that everyone misses me so I came back.”Dudian’s expression was indifferent and natural, “I remember that I promised half a year ago that in half a year I would make the ninth region into the top five regions. Do you still remember?”
The old man was stunned. The six members of Parliament were also stunned.
They naturally remembered Dudian’s words. But after Dudian went missing, they thought that he was bluffing. After all, they were used to this kind of thing, he had promised to set a very high goal. The goal was to win the hearts of the people. After a long time in office, who would dare to talk to him about the goal he had set when he took office? Unless he didn’t want to be mixed up.
“I always keep my word. I will personally participate in this meeting of elders.”Dudian calmly said.
Sergei couldn’t help but secretly curled his lips as he heard Dudian’s words. In his heart, Dudian was definitely not a person who talked about credibility, he wouldn’t get up early without benefits.
The six of them stared at Dudian for a while, the burly man carefully said: “Elder, you have been withdrawn. You are no longer an elder of the 9th region. Only the elders can participate in this elder conference. I’m afraid…”
“It doesn’t matter.”Dudian indifferently said: “It may be the case before me but it may not be the case after me.”
The Brawny man was speechless.
The old man was shocked as he heard Dudian’s words. He knew that the elder’s strength was beyond that of a senior hunter. Perhaps he could be compared to the top few monsters in the outer wall, if the elder wanted to break into the elder’s meeting, he wouldn’t be able to stop him.
He quickly calculated in his heart and politely said: “I didn’t expect you to be the previous elder. Nice to meet you.”
“Yes.”Dudian nodded slightly.
Such an attitude was a bit arrogant. The old man was unhappy but didn’t show it, he continued: “Although you have abdicated but since you are still concerned about the matters of the ninth region then it doesn’t matter if you come with me…”
Dudian patted his shoulder and interrupted him: “Get Up and talk to me.”
The Old Man’s face turned ugly: “I am old. I am sitting and talking to you is not considered rude!”
The six of them were shocked as they heard Dudian’s words. The teenager was also shocked. It was tantamount to admitting that Dudian was stronger than him. The weak needed to be respectful to the strong, so there was no need to salute.
“Don’t talk to me about age.”Dudian said: “Otherwise, my grandson can be your grandfather.”
The old man was stunned. He didn’t expect that Dudian would humiliate him so directly. He clenched his fists as anger surged in his heart. He clenched his teeth and slowly stood up, “Since you want to sit, then sit.”
Dudian pulled out a chair and sat down at a comfortable distance away from the table. He leaned back on the chair and crossed his legs. At this time, everyone saw the figure of the woman standing behind him, the woman’s face was covered by a scarf like black scarf. Her face was covered but her eyes were white.
When they saw her eyes, they felt a chill in their hearts. It was as if they were being stared at by a pair of extremely ferocious eyes.
“What’s Your Name?”Dudian looked at the old man who was standing next to him.
The old man was angry as he saw Dudian’s superior attitude towards his subordinates: “My codename is ‘Shooting Wolf’.”
“Who recommended you to be an elder in the 9th Region?”Dudian looked at his eyes: “Is it the Pope or the elder of the monastery?”
The Old Man’s face changed when he heard the word ‘pope’. The six people on both sides of the table were shocked. They were instinctively sensitive to the word ‘pope’.
The Old Man’s heart was beating fast. He didn’t expect that Dudian would be able to expose his identity. The pope had used the network of the Holy See to infiltrate him. He used to be the highest level librarian of the Holy See and rarely showed his face for many years, even few people in the Holy See had seen him. It was because of this that the pope had sent him here. Logically speaking, no one would be able to see through his identity.
He controlled his heartbeat to calm down, he coldly said: “What Pope? I was personally appointed by the speaker. Do you want to be an elder of the 9th region again? “It is useless to slander me. The only way to become an elder is to get permission from the Chairman.”
Dudian looked at him and gently tapped the table, “After the meeting of the elders you will come with me to the Holy See. I have wanted to meet the Pope for many years.”
The old man’s face sank: “What nonsense are you talking about? Do you know our identity? Do you want to go to the Holy Church? Or do you want to betray the Holy Church? Do you want to seek rewards from those hypocrites?”
Dudian said: “There is only one word in your sentence.”
The old man frowned: “What?”
“I want to ask for something.”Dudian said
“You!”The Old Man’s face was full of anger: “I won’t go with you unless…”
“Unless you want to die.”Dudian said.
The old man was silent as he felt the murderous intent in Dudian’s words. He thought that his face project was in place. At least he would be able to get rid of the suspicion of being a spy.
“When you go to the Holy See you will be ready to die!”He sneered in his heart.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to him. He turned his head and looked at the six people. He naturally saw a familiar face. It was Amy who was imprisoned by him. He didn’t expect that the great potion master would come out, it seemed that the old man had put him in an important position.
He didn’t say anything. Since he was short of manpower at the moment, there was some use in keeping this person.
Amy’s heart tightened as she saw Dudian looking at her. She lowered her head and didn’t dare to look at him. She was afraid that Dudian would hold a grudge against her and lock her up again in that dark and dirty dungeon.
“Everyone, I will give you three days to rule all the branches. All the money, alchemy and potions will be moved to the headquarters.”Dudian’s expression was calm but his words were shocking.
Everyone was shocked. All the resources were gathered at the headquarters? Was this… was he going to rob the savings of the entire 9th Region?
Everyone couldn’t help but look at him in shock. What was this man thinking? was he crazy?
Dudian looked at Hawkeye: “You are responsible for this matter.”
Hawkeye looked at the long-lost teenager. He felt familiar with him. But this time he felt that the teenager was different. Firstly, his height had changed. He was taller than before. This was something that couldn’t be changed by the Beast Glue Mask, he had a guess in his heart. In addition, he felt that the boy was more dangerous than before. There seemed to be a ferocious soul hidden under his calm and indifferent face.
“Hawkeye accepts the order.”Hawkeye bowed his head.
Compared to working for old man shooting wolf, Hawkeye was more willing to work for Dudian. Although he was afraid of Dudian but he had an indescribable trust in him.
Dudian nodded slightly: “I will come back on the day of the Elders’meeting. Oh yes, I am missing. I should be wanted by the higher-ups, right?”
Everyone’s heart jumped as they heard Dudian’s words.
Dudian looked at everyone’s reaction. He had received the answer: “If you are interested, I don’t mind if you report to the higher-ups. However, don’t affect the things I will tell you. Otherwise, you will bear the consequences.”
He turned and walked away.
Aisha followed behind him like a shadow.
Sergei let go of his hand and left with Dudian.
Everyone watched the three of them leave. They were relieved until the footsteps were completely inaudible. Amy said to old man: “Elder, this bastard still dares to appear. Let’s send people to kill him!”
Old Man looked at her. His eyes slowly swept over the faces of the others. He sighed and shook his head: “It is impossible to capture this person by relying on the manpower of the 9th region.”
Amy was stunned.
“If my guess is correct, his strength has exceeded the hunter level. He is strong enough to compete with the inner wall!”Old Man said slowly.
Everyone was surprised to hear his words. They didn’t expect Dudian’s strength to be so strong. It was completely beyond their expectations.
Amy quickly reacted and gritted her teeth: “We can use poison. If we can’t beat him in a frontal attack then we will ambush, ambush and assassinate him! What’s the use of having strong strength? No matter how strong a person is, would he dare to swallow the poison I developed?”
Old Man nodded: “That’s true. But let’s leave him to the other regions. We just need to spread the news about him.”
“That’s Good!”Amy was happy to see him agree.
Dudian took Aisha and Sergei to ride their horses as they headed towards the castle.
“Young master, is that the headquarters of the Dark Church? What do they mean by the ninth region? I see that the people there are extraordinary.”Sergei rode on the horse, he couldn’t suppress his curiosity and asked: “Do you want to use the power of the dark church to fight?”
Dudian replied: “Yes.”
Sergei scratched his head: “Isn’t it too dangerous? The people of the dark church are worse than me. I’m afraid that I will be betrayed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 605
chapters.content:
Chapter 605
“Everything is dangerous.”Dudian’s voice was calm: “So sometimes you have to learn to use danger.”
Sergei heard Dudian’s words. Most people were afraid of danger so they tried to avoid danger. Smart people knew to take precautions. However the teenager in front of him had learned to use danger as a weapon, it was hard to imagine that a teenager in his twenties had such a mind. He suddenly felt that the mysterious dark church was nothing in front of this teenager.
“Although I don’t know what he is thinking but I hope his plan won’t fail.”Sergei thought. He was tied to Dudian and now he had provoked the power of the dark church, this wasn’t a power that only a single noble could rival. If Dudian failed, he couldn’t imagine how many lives would be affected and how many people around Dudian would die without a complete corpse.
The night was hazy. Both of them avoided the inspection of the checkpoints. They rode on the suburban road. Along the way they could vaguely see the streets were brightly lit. The beautiful night life had just begun.
Dudian pulled the horse’s rope. Aisha sat on the horse’s back in front of him and leaned against his chest. Their chest and back were close to each other, but the temperature from Aisha’s back was always cold. He felt that Aisha in his arms was a bit restless. Ever since she came out from the dark church, this kind of restlessness had always accompanied her. He was a bit worried, he whispered in her ear: “Bear with it. I’ll let you have a good meal in a few days.”
Aisha’s restless reaction became more obvious as she heard his words. Her red lips slightly opened, revealing two sharp teeth.
Dudian quietly looked at her face. He shook the rope and sped up.
Aisha’s restlessness gradually calmed down when they were outside the Mozar River.
Dudian was relieved. He looked up and pulled the rope to stop. He raised his hand and pointed to a place: “Who are those people?”
Sergei rushed behind Dudian. He saw that there were several soldiers patrolling the area. He was angry, “Master, don’t be angry. This is the work of the military!”! Two months ago, the military had sent people to guard our area. They said that there were some evil thieves but they didn’t go anywhere. They just stayed here to monitor us!”
Dudian understood why the curfew was not up yet. He saw the patrolling soldiers: “Did you provoke the military?”
Sergei immediately said: “I was angry because I didn’t provoke them. You donated a set of legendary magic to the military to help them repel the strong enemy and establish their prestige. Now that you are gone, they turned around and attacked us. They are worse than me!”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he sensed something else: “Abandon the horse and go back.”
“Yes.”Sergei jumped off the horse without hesitation.
Dudian carried Aisha and got off the horse. They went along the slope of the Mozar River. He used his thermal vision to scan the surroundings but didn’t see any hidden sentries. It seemed that the surveillance here was more relaxed, no experts were sent over.
Dudian was puzzled. He quietly sneaked back to the castle. He saw a few familiar figures in the castle. He jumped over the courtyard and jumped onto the garden lawn.
Sergei followed Dudian into the castle. He stood up from the grass and said: “Master, there is no surveillance in the courtyard. We Can…”
Dudian stopped him and pointed to the ground.
Sergei looked down and saw that there was a dark green line in the grass. He retracted his foot, sergei scratched his head: “They are too careful. They have set up traps in their own yard.”
Dudian didn’t say anything. He crossed the line and went straight ahead.
Sergei immediately followed behind him and followed his steps.
Glenn leaned against the sofa in the living room and yawned in boredom. She was thinking about how to torture the group of Disobedient Mercenaries Tomorrow. Suddenly she heard a strange sound coming from outside. She was startled and her figure flashed, she left the sofa and put on her boots. She appeared at the door of the manor. She looked to the left and saw a strong figure walking towards her.
After seeing his appearance, Graly heaved a sigh of relief and said in a bad mood, “Sergei, why are you back? Didn’t young master tell you to go outside the giant wall?”
Sergei shrugged and said, “I came back with young master.”
“Young master is back too?”Graly was stunned.
“Long time no see.”A calm voice suddenly sounded behind Graly.
Glenn was startled as she felt the hair on her body stand up. She suddenly jumped back and saw a teenager standing behind her. His hair was a bit white and his face was familiar but also a bit strange, what surprised her the most was that there were several pieces of cloth wrapped around the left hand of the teenager. However, there were still a few frozen icicles protruding out as if they were growing on his arm.
“Is it really you?”Glenn was stunned. She quickly recovered and said: “Are You Alright…”as she stepped forward, she suddenly felt a chill coming from behind Dudian.
She looked behind Dudian and saw a long figure with a mask standing there like a ghost.
Dudian nodded slightly and walked into the living room. He sat down on the sofa and held Aisha’s hand. He pulled her to sit on the sofa. He looked up at Glenn: “Call them down. I have something to say.”
“Got it.”Glenn replied. Her eyes were still on Aisha. She frowned as she saw the intimate look on Dudian’s face as he held her hand. She turned and went upstairs.
A moment later, the sound of hurried footsteps came from upstairs.
“Young Master is back?”
“Really?”
“I saw it. It’s true!”
A few figures rushed over. Nicholas was the first to appear in front of dudian. Although the old man’s waist was bent but his movements were like the wind. There was no sign of his old age and weakness. Behind him were Mason, Zach.., gabriel and Hecate who were adopted by him.
“Young master, you are finally back.”Nicholas didn’t wear shoes. He looked at Dudian excitedly as he ran downstairs.
Dudian looked at his bare feet and nodded to him. He looked at Neuss and asked: “Are You Alright?”
Neuss’eyes were wet as he heard Dudian’s words. He knew the reason behind Dudian’s greeting. Since Dudian went missing from the dark church his life had been getting worse and worse, it wasn’t until he overheard Hawkeye’s conversation with a senior knight that he found out that Dudian was wanted by the higher-ups.
Hawkeye was stunned. He escaped from the dark church and sneaked back to the castle before the team prepared by the senior knight came to capture him.
He had recovered his identity as Neuss and had been hiding in the castle. The dark church hadn’t found him. However, his days were dull and painful. Moreover, he was worried every day. He knew that.., once he fell into the hands of the dark church, he would suffer a fate worse than death. In comparison, thorn flower prison could be considered a paradise.
“I’m fine.”Noyce held back his emotions, he said, “Young Master, Are You Alright? You must not return to the dark church. You are already wanted by them. Once you return, you will be arrested by them. It is said that this wanted order was personally issued by the dark speaker. The dark church in the twelve districts will want you…”
Sergei smiled bitterly and said to him, “You said it was too late.”
Noyce was stunned and looked at him in confusion.
“Do you know where we just came back from?”Sergei smiled bitterly.
“Could, could it be… you have already been there?”Noyce widened his eyes and suddenly thought of something. He heaved a sigh of relief and said, “Fortunately, you were not discovered. Otherwise…”
Sergei sighed: “I followed the young master into the meeting room of the headquarters. At that time there were several big figures in the meeting.”
Neuss was stunned and couldn’t speak.
Dudian didn’t let them continue to waste time. He indifferently said: “I remember that half a year ago I gave you a task. Does anyone remember what our purpose was half a year ago?”
Nicholas’s eyelids twitched: “Master, you said that we should complete our tasks and wait for the opportunity. Are you going to…”
Dudian nodded: “Yes. I’m going to unify the outer wall in half a month. All the consortia and forces will have only one title in the future. One Master!”
Glenn, Nicholas, Neuss and the others were stunned.
Dudian didn’t give them time to recover, he continued: “Everything is ready for this war. You Don’t need to worry. This is just an appetizer. You just need to improve your strength every day for half a month. I will bring a batch of God’s marrow tomorrow. It will help senior hunters to break through the limit. But before that, you must reach the limit of senior Hunter!”
Everyone was stunned as they looked at him.
Gwyneth’s expression changed as she heard the word ‘God’s marrow’. She looked up at Dudian and quietly clenched her hands.
Dudian noticed Gwyneth’s eyes as he looked at the girl: “Gwyneth, you will be able to do what you have always wanted to do.”
Everyone looked at Gwyneth.
They knew from Sergei that Gwyneth’s wish was to return to the inner wall and take revenge on the people who had framed her.
“Thank you young master!”Gwyneth bit her lips. She knew that Dudian was no longer the young man who had met her for the first time, although the god’s marrow wasn’t top secret but it was something that only people who had reached a certain level and high positions had the right to know.
Dudian nodded as he thought of the patrolling guards: “What’s Going On?”
“You Already Know?”Glenn was startled. She didn’t expect that Dudian would notice this as soon as he came back. She hesitated for a moment, “According to the information I got, these soldiers seem to be monitoring us. It seems that they are related to the Mel Family?”
“Mel Family?”Dudian narrowed his eyes.
Glenn said: “The superiors of these soldiers are the old subordinates of the Mel family. In the western part of the commercial district, the Mel family has moved there and settled down. It seems that they are ready to start their development again.”
“It seems that I’m not here.”Dudian nodded. There was a trace of cold light in his eyes.
Nicholas suddenly said: “Young Master, I’m guilty. Please Punish Me!”He bent down.
Dudian frowned: “Speak.”
Nicholas bitterly said: “Young Master, I’m afraid that I can’t complete the task that you gave me. I have cultivated the mulberry leaves and other plants. But two months ago, my cultivation base was bought by a group of people. The local land management department actually approved it. So… The things that you asked me to cultivate are gone.”
Dudian’s eyes were cold: “Is it the Mel Family?”
Nicholas felt Dudian’s anger: “Young Master, I have checked. It is related to the Mel family.”
Dudian coldly looked at him: “Didn’t you ask Old Fulin for help?”
Nicholas’s back was covered with cold sweat: “Young Master, I did. But Old Fulin was sick and refused to visit. I couldn’t…”
Dudian’s face sank: “Is he really sick or is it an excuse to not see him?”
Nicholas replied: “He is really sick. The doctor who treated Mr Fulin said that Mr Fulin is infected with a black spot disease. He won’t live for long…”
Dudian’s eyes were filled with killing intent. He nodded and said: “You are guilty of this matter.”
Nicholas’s heart skipped a beat as he knelt down: “Master Please Punish Me!”
“In consideration of your efforts, I will give you a chance to redeem yourself.”Dudian indifferently said: “I’m asking you, the land has been sold. Do you still have the things planted?”
“Yes.”Nicholas replied: “Mel family doesn’t know what those things are for. But we have planted so much land. I guess they think there is a way. So they didn’t destroy it but continued to plant it. I hired all the workers at that time.”
“That’s good.”Dudian was relieved: “In that case, you should gather people and take it back.”
“Now?”Nicholas was stunned.
Dudian’s eyes flashed: “Is there a problem?”

chapters.title: Chapter 606
chapters.content:
Chapter 606
Nicholas saw that Dudian was angry and his scalp tightened, but he still said: “Young Master, it is not difficult to take back the planting base. But the current Mel family is not something we can deal with. Unless you can restore your previous identity, the Mel family will arrest us for the crime of seizing the land.”
“From what I see, the Mel family is probably worried about not being able to punish us. If we forcefully seize the base now, they will most likely seize the evidence and wipe us out.”
Hearing his words, mason immediately said angrily, “Forcefully seizing the land? They are clearly the ones who snatched it from us, yet they are the ones who complained first? !”
Nicholas tilted his head to look at him and sighed, “Isn’t this kind of thing extremely common?”
Mason was even more angry: “It’s because of your opinion that you are allowing more and more things to be reversed!”
Nicholas was speechless. He wanted to refute but felt that there was some truth in his words.
Dudian’s finger gently touched the leather armrest of the sofa: “You can handle this matter. The Mel family will not interfere in this matter.”
Nicholas was startled as he looked at dudian, “Won’t interfere in this matter? Why? Young Master, are you going to personally intervene? This is a bit inappropriate. You Don’t have the identity of a temple master. The Mel family will not give in so easily.”
“I have my own ways.”Dudian waved his hand: “You don’t need to worry. Go.”
Nicholas was surprised. He looked at Dudian but saw that the youth was calm and calm. It seemed that he was planning a strategy. Nicholas was curious. He had tried all the possible solutions but there was no way to solve the problem. Dudian and the Mel family were mortal enemies, it was difficult for the Mel family to stop.
After all, no one would sit and wait for the enemy to grow up and destroy them.
However, since dudian had said so, he could only do as he was told.
After Nicholas left, Dudian retracted his eyes and indifferently said: “Glenn, Sergei, Gwyneth, the three of you will go out with me.”
The three of them were startled and immediately accepted the order.
Dudian said to Neuss: “You stay and watch.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss nodded respectfully.
Dudian immediately got up and stepped out of the castle. Aisha followed behind him like a shadow.
“Master, who is this?”Glenn saw Aisha following closely behind Dudian. She couldn’t help but ask.
Dudian didn’t look back and indifferently said: “You don’t need to know and don’t care. As long as you don’t get close to her. Although she is very gentle but she hates strangers. If you get close to her, you might lose your life.”
The three of them were startled. Dudian’s words meant that the girl had the ability to kill them?
Although they felt that the girl was extraordinary but they believed that they were among the top in the outer wall. There were many people who could defeat them but there were very few who wanted to kill them.
Gwyneth’s eyes stared at the mysterious girl’s back for a while. She felt that she had seen her back before, but she couldn’t remember where. She quickly collected her thoughts and asked Dudian: “Where are we going now?”
“Mel family.”Dudian said.
The three of them were stunned.
Dudian came out of the castle and walked along the river.
Sergei was about to remind Dudian to avoid the monitoring of the soldiers when he saw Dudian’s direction. It was obvious that he was in the position of the soldiers. Sergei couldn’t help but guess what was going on.
Dudian took the lead and went to the camp on the other side of the river. There were seven or eight soldiers barbequing, eating and drinking around the campfire. There were several empty beer kegs on the ground.
“Kid, go away. This is not a place for you to come.”One of the patrolling soldiers shouted at Dudian. He was a bit nervous. He had noticed them when Dudian left the castle, especially Sergei, Glenn and others who were behind dudian. They were very familiar with Dudian. They didn’t know why they came here in the middle of the night.
Dudian slightly raised his hand and coldly said: “Kill!”
The three of them were startled but quickly reacted. Gwyneth was the first to understand Dudian’s meaning. She took the lead and rushed out. The dagger rotated between her fingers and pierced through the neck of the soldier who was shouting at Dudian.
This soldier was just an ordinary soldier. He was killed before he could react.
Sergei and Glenn quickly attacked. In the blink of an eye, all the soldiers who were resting by the fire and sleeping in the tent were killed by the three of them. None of them were left alive.
After killing all the soldiers, the three of them came back to Dudian. Glenn’s face was ugly as she said to dudian: “Master, I’m afraid the military won’t let it go.”
“I’m the one who won’t let it go.”Dudian’s eyes were cold. He was about to turn around and leave when he suddenly felt a burst of restlessness and killing intent coming from behind. He quickly turned around and dodged, a gust of cold wind rushed out and pounced on the body of a soldier on the ground. It was Aisha who was following behind dudian.
The three of them were completely stunned by this shocking scene.
The three of them widened their eyes and looked at the scene in disbelief when they saw Aisha biting the neck of the soldier.
Dudian’s face also changed. There was a trace of pain and anger in his eyes. He stepped forward and grabbed Aisha’s shoulder to stop her from continuing to bite, he said in a low voice: “Don’t be like this. This kind of trash is not worthy of your touch. You have to endure it!”After saying that, he made two short-beat snapping fingers.
Hearing the sound of snapping fingers, Aisha’s biting action immediately stopped. However, the corner of her mouth twitched slightly and her body seemed to be trembling.
Seeing her like this, Dudian knew that she was trying her best to endure. He immediately kicked away the corpse of the soldier in her hand. He immediately picked up her body and turned around to quickly leave. He stopped when he was far away from the dead body. He put Aisha on the ground. She seemed to have recovered her calmness and was not as restless as before.
Dudian was relieved. He turned around and looked at Glenn and the other two. He frowned and coldly said: “It is best not to leak out what you have seen here.”
Sergei recovered from his shock and quickly nodded. He finally understood what was going on with the palpitation he felt from the girl. This… was not an ordinary girl.
The scene of him excitedly gnawing on his own kind made him feel cold from the bottom of his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 607
chapters.content:
Chapter 607
Glenn, Gwyneth, and Sergei subconsciously lagged behind Dudian by a few meters after seeing Haisha gnawing on the soldier’s corpse. They didn’t dare to get too close to Haisha who was following behind Dudian.
They had seen countless ferocious people but they had never seen such a bloodthirsty and cruel person. Moreover, from the previous scene, it seemed that even Dudian might not be able to completely suppress this girl.
The three of them kept silent as if nothing had happened.
After leaving the Mozar River, Dudian stopped and asked Glenn: “How many mercenaries did you gather before?”
Glenn didn’t know what Dudian meant by this question, but she still reported truthfully: “Because of fear of attracting the attention of the military and other forces, we have been secretly recruiting for half a year. The number of ordinary soldiers is close to eight thousand. There are about seventy mercenaries at the level of primary hunter, seven at the level of intermediate hunter and two at the level of senior hunter…”
Dudian didn’t wait for her to finish: “I’ll give you half an hour to gather them in Leith Square.”
Glenn was startled: “Master, I’m afraid that half an hour…”
“We don’t need to gather all of them. We can gather as many as we can.”
“Yes.”Glenn was relieved. She looked at dudian: “Am I Going?”
Dudian nodded.
Glenn turned away and disappeared into the night.
Dudian took Sergei and Gwyneth to the meeting place after Glenn left.
Half an hour passed.
When Dudian and the others arrived at Leith Square, there were thousands of people gathered in the square. They were standing in disarray and whispering. Dudian frowned as he saw the noisy scene: “Is this your management?”
Gwyneth knew that Dudian’s words were directed at her. Her lips moved as she slowly stepped forward: “I will clean up immediately.”She saw that Dudian didn’t reply, she left the place and came to the front of the square:
“Silence!”
When the several hundred people in front of the plaza heard Gwyneth’s voice, they immediately stopped their discussion and quieted down. The people further behind were still discussing in low voices. However, they soon noticed the strange situation in front of them and gradually stopped their discussion, they stood on tiptoes and looked forward.
“Your subordinate greets Commander Gwyneth.”Three figures flashed out from the crowd and respectfully greeted Gwyneth.
Gwyneth coldly replied, “Order everyone to form up and await orders.”
The three of them respectfully replied, “Yes.”They then turned around and returned to the crowd. A moment later, over ten figures flashed past the crowd. The originally loose crowd was led by these ten people as they formed a huge square formation one after another.
At this moment, the sound of footsteps could be heard from outside the plaza. It was Glenn leading a group of over a hundred people as they rushed towards this place.
The noisy square became quiet in an instant. The passers-by were scared and didn’t dare to approach the square.
Gwyneth quickly came back to dudian: “Young Master, we are ready for your orders.”
Dudian said: “Send my orders. Everyone will follow us to fight. Tonight we will massacre the Mel Family!”
Gwyneth’s heart trembled. She didn’t dare to neglect as she replied: “Yes.”
Sergei’s face slightly changed as he heard Dudian’s words. It wasn’t as simple as a demonstration. There would be a bloody storm tonight which would alarm the entire outer wall!
He was a bit worried. With their strength it wouldn’t be difficult to attack the Mel family. However it would be a real trouble after the attack. After all, the Mel family was a famous ancient noble. They had a lot of connections in the outer wall, both the military and the Holy See had family members. These people held high power. As long as they instigated the other forces to attack them.
Looking at Dudian’s back, he wanted to say something but stopped. However, he thought that this youth was different from him. Although he was young and frivolous, but he was more tolerant and cunning than an 80-year-old fox, he was not a impulsive person.
His heart slowly settled down.
Gwyneth had already returned to the square while Sergei was thinking. She spoke in a clear voice: “Everyone, follow me to massacre the Mel family tonight. We will fight immediately!”
The voice spread and the passersby heard it. They were scared and ran away.
All the mercenaries were stunned but soon became excited. They shouted in unison.
Glenn went back to Dudian’s side: “Master, Time is tight. I can only gather these people. I don’t know if it is enough.”
“It is enough.”Dudian said: “Inform Gwyneth and let her lead the team. We will go first.”
“You’re going first?”
Dudian did not answer, has turned straight away.
Sergei paused and followed him.
..
..
Ughong. The Meers.
Wugang town is famous for its seafood in the western part of the business district. There is a famous lake called Blue Lake. The Blue Lake is vast and clear. It is home to many delicious and rare fish. People who live in this town have been fishing for generations.
The skills of fishing had been passed down here for more than a hundred years. There was once a saying that if the people of Wugang could walk, they could swim. This saying described the natural aquatic nature of the people of Wugang.
In the middle of the most prosperous place in the center of the town, there were three buildings that stood out the most. The first was naturally the church of Light’s blessing cathedral, and the second was the victor family’s castle, which was the previous noble of Wugang, and the third building was the newly built castle of the Mel family.
Few people knew that the victor family and the Mel family were once distant relatives. Their ancestors had intermarried, but later, when the victor family declined, they broke off contact with the Mel family. Now, the two families had joined forces again.
“Miss Shaya, in three months, the tuna in the small salt sea of the Blue Lake of Wugang will be in the harvest season. According to our previous income, we will have at least 100,000 gold coins this year. This 100,000 gold coins will be used to recruit soldiers and train hunters. It will be enough to help you make a comeback,”a middle-aged man with a mustache in a black suit said from the other end of the dining table.
The dining table was very long, about six meters long. Fortunately, the hall was extremely quiet, which allowed his voice to reach the other end of the table.
With a smile on her face, Sarah raised her wine glass and said, “My grandfather and father will never forget the favor you have done for us this time. When the Mel family returns to the inner wall in the future, we will definitely bring your Victor family with us.”
The middle-aged man’s eyes lit up and he immediately raised his glass, he smiled and said, “Miss Sarah, you are too kind. It is really enviable for your father to give birth to such a beautiful and intelligent daughter like you. Come!”He raised his glass slightly. Although he was six meters away from her.., however, the height of the glass was still accurately controlled under the mouth of Sarah’s glass. This was a sign of respect.
Sarah smiled calmly, she said, “When I was young, my grandfather often said that he would bring me to Wugang town. He said that the scenery here was beautiful, the seafood was delicious, and it was the most suitable place to live and retire. Now that I finally have the opportunity to come here, it is indeed better to see it than to hear a hundred things. “I heard that Wugang Town reached an agreement with the military many years ago to cancel the recruitment gate of Wugang town. Mr. Jaime is indeed a wise landlord!”
Jaime smiled gently, “No, no, it’s all my father’s doing. He’s retired and hasn’t been feeling well lately. He keeps saying that he wants to visit old Mr. George, but it’s a pity that the journey is tiring, the journey is long, and he’s plagued with chronic diseases. What a pity!”
“There will be plenty of opportunities in the future.”Sarah smiled and said, “Mr. Jaime, your family has been managing wugang town for generations and has won the hearts of the people. Why Don’t you go further and rent the giant wall passage to apply for military rights?”
Jaime’s eyes flashed, he shook his head and sighed. “I thought so too. Unfortunately, my father is too stubborn. He only wants to guard this small town and enjoy his old age. As the son of the man, I can’t do anything about it. However, if I can return to the inner wall, it can be considered as fulfilling my father’s long-cherished wish.”
Sarah nodded slightly, she said, “Returning to the inner wall is also my father’s long-cherished wish. Back then, the Mel family and your Victor family were expelled from the inner wall because they broke the rules. After so many years, my grandfather, my grandfather, and my father all have the same wish. They all want to return to the inner wall and get the title of nobility again.”
She paused and slightly lowered her head. There was a trace of indignation in her voice, she said, “The Mellon Consortium, which was originally run by our family clan, has already found an opportunity to return to the inner wall. I hate that damned despicable person who framed our family clan by dirty means and caused our family clan to go bankrupt. Otherwise, our Mel family and Mr. Jaime would have already returned to the inner wall.”
James looked at her quietly and said with a smile, “There will always be an opportunity. Miss Shaya, don’t be angry. It’s late today. I’ll take a step back and talk to you tomorrow.”
Sarah immediately put away her indignant face and said, “I’ll see you off.”
“Miss Shaya, you’re too kind.”James stood up and left the castle of the Mel family and returned to the nearby castle of the Victor family.
Watching Jaime’s figure disappear into the night, the innocent smile on Saya’s face immediately disappeared. Her eyes revealed a cold look, “Damn you! You want to board a ship with only 100,000 gold coins? Dream On!”
“Miss, is the victor family still only willing to pay 100,000 gold coins?”A short-haired maid next to her frowned and asked.
Saya coldly said, “This country fisherman is short-sighted. Now that our Mel family is in trouble, if he sincerely helps us, we will remember his great kindness. Humph, you want to ask for a favor with only 100,000 gold coins? If it weren’t for the fact that our business hasn’t been unsealed yet, I wouldn’t even be bothered to accept this small amount of money!”
“You are right, My Lady,”said the maid respectfully.
Sarah retracted her gaze and looked at her. The coldness in her eyes immediately disappeared, revealing a trace of gentleness. “Lisa, you are the only one who will never leave me.”
“No matter what happens, I will never leave you, my lady,”said Lisa Softly.
Sarah smiled slightly and held her hand. “Let’s go inside.”
“Yes, My Lady.”Lisa nodded.
The two of them walked hand in hand all the way to the room on the second floor. When the servants along the way saw the two of them, they immediately lowered their heads respectfully and stared at their toes, not daring to peek.
After Sarah took Lisa into the room, she immediately closed the door behind her. Just as she was about to turn around, a cold voice suddenly sounded from the room, causing the air to freeze a little, “I didn’t expect that the extremely intelligent Miss Mel would have such a hobby.”
As if she had been stabbed, Sarah suddenly turned around and said angrily, “Who is it! ?”
As soon as she said that, she saw three figures on the sofa in the main hall of the room. Two of them were standing while one of them was sitting. The person who was sitting had his legs crossed and was leaning on the sofa in an extremely comfortable position. He had black hair and a cold expression, there was no trace of a smile in his eyes but there was a sneer in his eyes.
The anger on Sarah’s face faded like the tide after she saw the face of the man. Her pink face turned pale and her hands trembled as she slowly moved to the back of the room. She regretted closing the door in such a hurry.
“Bring it over.”Dudian indifferently said as he saw Sarah’s small movement.
Karl grinned as his figure suddenly appeared in front of the two. He was about to attack Sarah when suddenly a gust of wind hit him. Lisa’s speed was extremely fast, she was not an ordinary maid.
He was slightly shocked as he saw Sarah quickly grasp the handle of the door. He was ready to open the door and call for help. He felt angry as his fist hit Lisa’s palm, the soft palm hit Lisa’s chest and hit the door with her body.
He took the opportunity to grab Sarah and Sarah’s shoulders and threw them in front of Dudian.
Sarah covered her shoulder in pain and cried out.
Lisa quickly supported her, “Miss, Are You Alright?”
Sarah bit her lips and angrily stared at Dudian, “Why are you here? What do you want to Do? I’m telling you that this is the town of Wugang. It is an important town under the protection of the military. If you kill me then the military and the Holy See will investigate the matter to the end. Our Mel family is a noble family. Not everyone can invade us!”
“Violate?”Dudian’s indifferent eyes revealed a trace of malice. He looked at Sergei: “Don’t You Like Beauties? Do you like this beauty?”
Sergei looked at Sarah and shook his head: “I don’t like femme fatale.”
“I’m not asking you to marry her. I’m asking you to fuck her.”Dudian replied.
Sergei scratched his head: “That’s not a problem.”
“No!”Lisa stood up and looked at dudian: “I won’t let you hurt miss even if I die.”
Dudian looked at her familiar face. The killing intent in his eyes was getting stronger: “It’s been a long time. Lisa, have you forgotten about me?”
Lisa coldly said: “Of course I won’t forget. We are from the Meishan Orphanage. If you still remember our old friendship then let us go. I will promise you anything as long as you let Miss Go!”
“No!”Sarah firmly said.
Dudian indifferently said: “Old Friendship? When I was adopted you wanted to harm me. You said that I was a mute and wanted to take away the adopter. Now it seems that your wish has come true. I didn’t expect that you would climb up from a gardener to become the personal maid of the famous miss of the Meishan family. It seems that I didn’t see the wrong person. The future is always good.”
Lisa’s face turned ugly: “You should know that if you want to be adopted, you have to rely on your own ability.”
“Yes.”Dudian nodded: “I agree with you. So if you want to live, you have to rely on your own ability.”
“You!”Lisa clenched her teeth.
Dudian stood up: “First tie them up and then give a surprise to the beautiful Miss Sarah.”
Sarah’s eyes widened: “What are you going to do? Are you crazy? We are nobles!”
“Nobles?”Dudian indifferently glanced at her: “Do you have a title?”

chapters.title: Chapter 608
chapters.content:
Chapter 608
Sarah bit her lips.
Although the Mel family was one of the ancient nobles in the commercial district… but like the other nobles in the commercial district, they were not conferred titles, they were only ‘nobles’.
Sarah felt ashamed and angry as she looked at Dudian’s cold eyes, she gritted her teeth: “Even if we don’t get a title, we are still nobles! We will be given a title when we return to the inner wall! If the other nobles know that you are treating us like this, they will join forces to arrest you. If you leave now, I will treat it as if nothing has happened. I promise you in the name of the Mel Family!”
Dudian sneered: “A noble? He is just a dog under the hands of a real noble. Do you want to know who your grandfather is? I will tell you after I finish the matter.”
He crossed the middle of the two and left without looking back.
Sarah was stunned. She looked back at Dudian. Her face was twisted with anger as she shouted: “Slums! You slums slums! !”
Bang!
Sergei quickly attacked and knocked her out. He turned his hand to attack the maid Lisa.
Lisa quickly raised her hand to block but Sergei was prepared this time. He easily avoided her attack and cut her neck. She fainted.
“You stay here and watch them.”Dudian opened the door and said.
Sergei was slightly startled: “Don’t you need my help?”
Dudian didn’t answer as he had already left the room. The maidservant outside the corridor saw Dudian coming out of the room. She was stunned for a moment and immediately shouted at him.
Dudian gently rubbed his fingers. Aisha’s expressionless face behind him suddenly seemed to wake up. Her deep and emotionless eyes shot out two bloodthirsty lights and suddenly flew out.
In an instant, a shrill scream echoed from the corridor back to the room with the door slightly open. Sergei heard the scream of extreme fear. He suddenly felt a chill spread through his body. It was as if there were evil ghosts outside the slightly open door that turned the human world into a purgatory.
Blood splattered on the walls on both sides of the corridor. Dudian quietly walked past, leaving behind the corpses of the maids, a figure covered in blood swayed behind Dudian. The two walked down the bloody corridor step by step. The alloy boots stepped on the wooden stairs and creaked.
The screams of the guards on the second floor had excited the castle. When Dudian came to the stairs, more than a dozen knights wearing the mel family’s emblem rushed into the hall. They were armed with long spears and swords, they looked at the stairs and saw Dudian. At the same time, they saw Dudian’s hair was a bit messy and blood was dripping from his chin.
The knights were stunned for a moment and immediately rushed up.
Some of them recognized Dudian and cried out in surprise.
Whoosh!
Aisha smelled the smell of blood. Before the Knights rushed to the stairs, she had already rushed down. She was like a purple Phantom. She rushed into the group of knights and tore a gap.
Her hands were like lightning. Her sharp nails easily tore through the Knights’hard armor. She was like a wolf entering a flock of sheep. In a split second, four or five knights were sent flying. The other two knights were caught in her hands and struggled in fear, but it was difficult to break free.
Dean noticed that although Aisha had the same bloodthirsty characteristic as the undeads, but when she attacked, there was a big difference between her and the ordinary undeads. She actually knew how to avoid the sharp spearhead of the Knight’s spear.
His heart beat faster by two beats. Could it be that she still retained part of her consciousness as a “Human”?
This discovery made him excited. He felt that this was the biggest surprise of the night!
Soon, the Knights who rushed to the hall were killed by Aisha. The undeads’attack method was to attack the living creatures first, not to bite them without care. When all the knights were slaughtered, Aisha’s bloodthirsty eyes immediately turned to the maids, butlers, maids, and other servants in the hall. These people were so scared that their legs had gone soft, and they were shivering on the spot.
Seeing Aisha pounce on them, these people seemed to have forgotten to run for their lives. They just stood on the spot, trembling, and looked at her pleadingly. Their eyes were filled with fear, and tears flowed down their cheeks, but they did not cry.
Aisha’s ferocious face was reflected in the eyes of these people. They didn’t show any mercy in their attacks. They cut off her head, penetrated her chest, or wrung her head off, the attacks were all fatal and extremely bloody.
Dean’s eyes lit up when he saw this scene. He noticed that Aisha’s attack style was different from that of ordinary undeads, instead, she was like an experienced hunter who clearly knew the weakness and weakness of her prey!
“Maybe there is hope for her to regain her consciousness…”he thought. His eyes were full of hope as he heard the screams of fear.
“What’s the matter…”a middle-aged man wearing Hunter’s armor came from outside the hall. He shouted as he arrived at the hall. He saw the scene in the hall, blood flowed like a river. It was like a bloody hell. He was stunned. The next moment he felt a chill coming from the left.
He stiffly turned his head and saw an excited and ferocious face.
Puff!
His head flew up. Blood gushed out from his neck and his body fell straight down.
Dudian looked at the armor of the middle-aged man. It was a senior hunter. He didn’t expect that the Mel family which was defeated by him could not only recover in such a short time but also win over a senior hunter.
After killing the middle-aged man, Aisha seemed to smell something and immediately rushed out of the hall.
Dudian immediately jumped down the stairs and quickly followed.
As soon as he came out of the hall, Dudian heard orderly footsteps and the sound of armor friction. Soon, a group of knights and squires rushed out of the building in the left corner of the castle.
Aisha took the initiative to greet them as soon as they came out of the left corner of the castle.
The bloody slaughter immediately reappeared and the screams were endless.
Dudian looked at the other places. He narrowed his eyes and entered the thermal vision state. He saw Red Hot spots appearing in the darkness, his eyes fell on another castle in the nearby manor. The castle was also decorated with the flag of Mel family.

chapters.title: Chapter 609
chapters.content:
Chapter 609
Dudian waited for Haisha to finish killing the Knights. He used the metal bar in his arms to hit a few times. The sound soon attracted Haisha’s attention. Her beautiful face was full of malevolence as she rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian raised his hand and pointed to the front.
Haisha’s body stopped. She followed Dudian’s finger and looked at the castle with the Mel family’s flag.
“Who is it…”
“Not good, quick…”
Screams and screams were heard. The guards outside the castle were helpless in front of Aisha. Since Aisha had adapted to the corpse poison, her strength had returned to her original peak state, moreover, because of the zombie transformation, it would never be affected by physical exhaustion or injury.
Soon, Aisha killed the knight and crashed into the castle. There was a burst of screams and screams.
Dean stood outside the castle and looked up. He narrowed his eyes and jumped to the second floor window. He grabbed the rough rock and jumped to the third floor balcony.
The people in the room noticed the movement on the balcony and rushed over.
When the curtain on the balcony was lifted by the people, one of the legs kicked over. The elegant youth who was standing in the middle of the room was sent flying. His chest caved in and he spat out a mouthful of blood. He died on the spot.
The eyes of the people who were wearing knight armor narrowed as they saw the scene. Although they were holding weapons but they didn’t dare to attack. The youth who was sent flying wasn’t an ordinary person, he was a Grand Knight invited by the Mel Family! Who would have thought that such a person would have no reaction and would be kicked to death by Dudian!
Dudian walked into the room as if there was no one around. His face was cold as he glanced at the bed. There was a pale middle-aged man lying on the bed. His hair was black and white, it was the current head of the Mel family, Mel Kenson.
The legendary businessman who had stirred up the business world in the commercial district was lying on the bed. There were two doctors in white coats standing next to him, there was a priest holding a ‘bible-blessing chapter’in his hand.
Everyone in the room was stunned as they looked at the dead youth. They couldn’t believe that there was such a young man in the outer wall, he was able to kill a Grand Knight of the holy church at such a young age. Moreover he was able to kill him in one hit!
The room was dead silent as the screams echoed from downstairs. Everyone’s face turned ugly as they knew that the person who attacked them wasn’t alone.
“Who… Who Are You? This is the territory of the Mel Family!”A middle-aged knight stood in front of Dudian as he clenched his teeth.
Dudian indifferently looked at him as he raised his hand.
In his eyes Dudian’s palm was almost like a shadow. He was shocked as he raised his weapon to block. Bang! His palm hit the weapon. The middle-aged man felt as if the weapon in his hand was hit by a hammer. The strong force made his hands numb. He stepped back a few steps and almost fell down.
Dudian didn’t look at the man but walked towards the bedside step by step.
The two doctors and the priest who were standing by the bedside trembled as they moved to the side.
The priest was about sixty years old. When his palm trembled, the book in his hand fell down with a bang. The other people in the room were shocked and their hearts were beating fast.
The priest’s face turned pale. He didn’t know if he should step back or pick up the book.
Dudian went straight to the bed and slowly sat down. He looked at the unconscious Malcolm. He raised his hand and patted his face: “Wake up.”
Malcolm woke up in a daze. He struggled to open his eyes. He saw a familiar face in front of him. Was it the teenager? Am I Still Dreaming? He closed his eyes.
Dudian patted his face again. “Wake up.”.
Malcolm frowned and tried to open his eyes. He saw the face in front of him again. He was a bit upset. Suddenly he saw the doctor and several other family knights.
Was he dreaming? He blinked his eyes and finally saw the scene in the room.
“Patriarch, don’t you recognize me?”Dudian looked at him.
Mason’s face changed as he looked around. He forgot about the pain in his body.
“Your baby daughter is still here.”Dudian slowly said: “Patriarch don’t be nervous. It’s not good for your health. I have to trouble you to move away and come with me.”
Mel responded as he looked at dudian: “What do you want to Do? This is the Mel family. Do you dare to openly attack the nobles? Do you want to be enemies with everyone? !”
“If there is a need, so what if you are enemies with everyone?”Dudian calmly said.
Mel was stunned.
Dudian turned to look at the two doctors: “What is Mr. Mel’s illness?”
The two doctors heard the screams coming from downstairs. They were so scared that their faces turned pale. They saw Dudian looking at them: “Yes, it’s nightmarish fever…”
“Will he die?”Dudian asked.
“We need to calm down and recuperate. We need to cooperate with the treatment…”
Dudian said: “Both of you, keep Mr. Mel alive. If anything happens to Mr. Mel, you will be buried with him. Do you understand?”
Both of them were so scared that their heads were like chickens pecking rice.
Bang!
At this time, the door was suddenly opened and a bloody smell rushed into the room.
There was a bloody figure standing in front of the door. His hair was disheveled as if he was a devil from hell.
The continuous screams outside disappeared at this moment.
Everyone in the room stepped back in fear as they looked at the bloody figure.
Dudian stood up and protected the two doctors.
Whoosh!
Aisha rushed towards the knights who were next to her.
In the blink of an eye, the knights were torn to pieces by Aisha. Their internal organs and intestines were scattered all over the floor. Blood splattered all over the exquisite decorations in the room.
Dudian snapped his fingers.
Aisha’s figure suddenly stopped. Her shoulders slightly trembled as if she was trying to restrain herself.
Dudian said to the two doctors behind him: “You wait here. Someone will come to pick you up soon. You Don’t have to worry. I Won’t kill the Doctor.”
The two doctors heard Dudian’s words. Their hearts that were tightly gripped by fear were slightly relieved and relieved. However, they were worried that Dudian didn’t keep his word. Their hearts were still very nervous.
Dudian walked towards Aisha and held her hand. He walked out of the room step by step. He walked along the long corridor filled with corpses and left the castle, he came to the gate of the Mel family manor and stood in the night with Aisha.
He took out a handkerchief and wiped the blood stains on Aisha’s cheeks.
Haisha’s face was expressionless, but the corner of her mouth was still slightly curved.
After Dudian wiped the blood stains on her face, footsteps came from afar. Gwyneth took the lead and rushed to the place. She followed behind Gwyneth and occupied the spacious street, the sound was majestic.
Gwyneth saw Dudian and Aisha waiting at the door. She was shocked and hurried over. She saw Aisha standing next to Dudian. Her blood was fresh especially on her palm, it was slowly dripping down.
Gwyneth’s face changed. She remembered the scene where she bit the soldier’s body. She was a bit nervous and said to dudian: “Master, we are coming.”
Dudian used a handkerchief to wipe his palm: “Most of the experts are dead. Take people to deal with the rest of the people. Ask Sergei to bring the father and daughter of the Mel family.”
Gwyneth was stunned. She couldn’t help but look at the large manor behind Dudian. It was brightly lit but it seemed especially quiet. She could hear faint crying sounds.
She was shocked. Dudian had single-handedly massacred a large noble’s territory? !
“Do you hear me?”Dudian frowned as he saw that Gwyneth didn’t answer.
Gwyneth quickly replied: “Yes, Master.”She thought of something and asked: “What about the rest?”
“Kill them.”Dudian said: “I don’t want to see any remnants of the Mel family.”

chapters.title: Chapter 610
chapters.content:
Chapter 610
Gwyneth hesitated for a moment before replying, “Yes, Young Master.”After saying that, she turned around and waved her hand, leading the large group behind her to charge into the manor. The large group of more than a thousand people was like a black tide, surging into various parts of the manor. In an instant, a wave of screams and cries rang out from all over the manor. The smell of blood quietly spread out, leaving only the silence of the night.
Half an hour later, Sergei carried the unconscious Sarah and Lisa to the outside of the manor. Glenn escorted the sick Mel and two doctors out.
Mel was not unconscious. His body was tied to the bed and he couldn’t struggle. He was carried out of the manor. He saw Dean standing quietly in the night. His eyes were red as he roared: “You Bastard! You should go to hell!”
Dudian slowly turned around and indifferently looked at him: “How does it feel to see your own people die, Mr. Mel?”
“Damn Beast! !”Mel stared at him angrily: “You are not a human. You will be judged one day. Your Sins will never be washed away. You deserve to die! !”
Dudian indifferently smiled: “Who lives in this world? God Can’t judge me, let alone a human?”
Mason clenched his fists. He was so angry that he felt a sharp pain in his chest. He couldn’t help but cough and spit blood.
Dudian indifferently said: “Take him away.”
“Yes.”Glenn nodded. She called the two mercenaries who were carrying the bed and sent Mason away.
Gwyneth came back from the manor with a group of mercenaries behind her. She was escorting a large number of people dressed as servants. Gwyneth quickly came in front of dudian: “Young Master, what should we do with these people?”
Dudian glanced at the people she was escorting: “Didn’t I say not to leave behind the remnants of the Mel Family?”
Gwyneth continued: “Master, these people are not members of the Mel family. They are hired servants. They are ordinary people.”
“Are you sure that they have no feelings for the Mel Family?”Dudian looked at her coldly.
Gwyneth was stunned.
“Master is dead. As a servant, shouldn’t he be buried with his master?”Dudian coldly asked.
Gwyneth bit her lips. She knew that Dudian was determined to kill her. She turned around and made a beheading gesture.
There were some sharp-eyed servants who heard Dudian’s words. They immediately began to Cry and beg. They scolded the Mel family in an attempt to distance themselves from them.
The mercenaries saw Gwyneth’s gesture and pulled out their weapons. The rest of the servants panicked and fell to the ground.
Seeing this sad scene, Gwyneth could not bear it and closed her eyes.
PFFT! PFFT! PFFT!
The sound of metal blades cutting into flesh rang out continuously. Blood splattered everywhere. The blood of the people who were far away from Gwyneth splattered onto Gwyneth’s smooth face. It was slightly hot.
She slowly opened her eyes and saw that the servants in front of her had been beheaded one after another. Blood flowed like a river and there were heads all over the ground. The rest of the people behind her were still lying on the ground crying and praying desperately.
Soon, all the prayers disappeared. There were only corpses and the cries of babies.
Gwyneth saw that the servants were carrying the babies. She quickly walked over and ordered people to carry them. She turned around and brought them back to Dudian. She was about to speak when Dudian coldly said: “What do you want to say?”
Gwyneth couldn’t help but say: “Master, these children are innocent. Are you going to let them go?”
“Innocent?”Dudian coldly looked at her, he said: “You have killed the adults who have survived for decades. Don’t you find it funny that you pity these children? Or do you think that children are too cruel to be killed because they haven’t committed any sins?”
Gwyneth was stunned. She did think so.
Dudian saw her expression and sneered, “These children didn’t do any evil deeds. It’s not because they are kind, but because they don’t have the ability! When they grow up, they will be ordinary people like others. What qualifications do they have to enjoy the privilege of not dying? “You think it’s cruel. It’s just a reflex caused by your vision, hearing and imagination!”
Gwyneth was speechless. She didn’t know how to refute.
But in her heart, she knew that such behavior was wrong. But she couldn’t say what was wrong.
“If we leave these bastards here today, they will become the rats that we hate the most in ten years. Resources are limited. The resources that they have grown up with are enough to feed many poor and hungry families.”Dudian coldly said: “If you don’t have the heart to do it, you can leave first.”
Gwyneth remained silent. She used to be a disciplinary officer in the inner wall. She specialized in hunting down evil cultists and violent hunters. Although she was framed by the nobles and imprisoned, she only hated certain people. However, what she had done today had exceeded her bottom line and tolerance. It made her feel an inexplicable sense of anger and helplessness. She knew that she could not change this young man’s mind. In fact.., if she was too strongly against it, she would be abandoned by the teenager.
However, in order to protect herself, she had to witness and condone this evil scene. Was it right?
She bit her lips and raised her hand to gesture to the mercenary.
The mercenary was ordered to immediately swing his sword and kill the four or five-year-old children in a pool of blood. The blood spread like a curse and seeped into the dark ground.
At this time, Melissa and Lisa slowly woke up. They saw Sergei carrying them and Dudian who was not far away. Melissa was about to shout angrily when she suddenly smelled a strong pungent smell of blood, her face slightly changed. She looked up and saw corpses everywhere.
She was stunned. After a while she recovered and stared at Dudian: “You will die a horrible death. You are not a human. You are an ugly monster. You deserve to die!”
Dudian slightly raised his hand to gesture.
Sergei understood and immediately cut out his hand to stun Sarah again.
Dudian waited for Glenn to come back and ordered her: “We will go back first. You stay and clean up the place. Remember, even if there is a mouse here, kill it!”
Glenn nodded: “Understood.”
Dudian turned away. He was more at ease with Glenn’s work. After all, she was a seasoned hunter. She wouldn’t be as soft-hearted as Gwyneth.

chapters.title: Chapter 611
chapters.content:
Chapter 611
As soon as he came out of the tavern, he saw his favorite subordinate running over in a hurry. He said drunkenly, “Marton, how many times have I told you that in the job of a priest, you have to be calm…”
“Deacon, something bad has happened!”Marton said anxiously, “Something bad has happened in Wugang Town!”
Mosten shook his head slightly and burped, “Wugang Town? What could have happened there? You, slow down…”
Marton said hurriedly, “The nobles who recently moved to Wugang Town, the Mel family, have been killed!”
Bang! The bottle in Mosten’s hand suddenly fell to the ground and shattered. His drunken eyes suddenly widened and he woke up. He stared and said, “The Mel family was killed? What Happened?”
Marton immediately said, “I don’t know the exact situation. The higher-ups told us to go and investigate immediately.”
“Let’s Go!”Mostine immediately strode forward and entered the carriage that was parked by the roadside. He said, “Let’s go to Wugang Town!”
