The carriage was very fast and the distance was very close. Half an hour later, the two of them arrived in front of the Mel family’s manor in Wugang Town. This place was already surrounded by a large number of judgement knights to protect the scene.
Although it was almost nine o’clock, there were still a large number of people gathered around.
After mostine got off the carriage, a judgement knight immediately went up to him and said, “Lord mostine, you’re finally here.”
Mostine frowned slightly. He had just gotten off the carriage when he smelled the thick bloody smell. His heart sank slightly. As he walked, he said, “What happened? Tell me in detail.”
The Knight of judgment immediately said, “We received a report from the victor family that someone had attacked the Mel family. When we arrived, the attacker had already left, but the members of the Mel family… were all dead!”
Mostine stopped walking and turned his head to look at him. “All Dead?”
The Knight of judgment nodded bitterly and said, “Yes, all dead.”
Mostyn’s eyes flashed and he continued to walk forward. He said, “Have you found out the identity of the perpetrators from the corpses of the enemies?”
The Knight of Judgment looked hesitant, he said in a low voice, “The enemies didn’t leave any corpses behind. They should have been taken away when they retreated. However, according to the people interviewed, a large number of people passed by on the streets half an hour ago. There were quite a number of people who came to attack. I have already sent people to follow the footprints. There should be news coming back later.”
Mostyn snorted coldly and said, “It goes without saying that there are many people who dare to attack the Mel family at night.”
At this time, he had already arrived at the cordon surrounded by the judgement knights. When he looked up, he was immediately stunned.
He saw a few lanterns shining on the cordon, and the corpses on the ground were clearly visible. The ground was covered in blood, as if it was a purgatory on earth.
His expression changed, and he turned around and dived into the cordon. He took out a handkerchief to cover his mouth while paying attention to his footsteps. He glanced at the corpses on the ground, and soon, his expression changed again, revealing intense anger.
“Kill, kill so many!”Marton’s face was pale when he saw the corpses all over the ground, especially the small bodies of children. It was extremely glaring. He clenched his fists, he said indignantly, “B * stard, don’t even spare children!”
The Knight of Judgment Sighed, he said, “Yes, I have been a knight of judgment for so many years, but this is the first time I have seen such a bloody scene. The main culprit of this incident probably has a great hatred with the Mel family. I have already investigated, and there is no one alive at the scene. No matter if it is the old or the children, they have all been killed. The murderer has lost his conscience!”
Marton angrily said: “It’s not just heartless. This is not something that people do!”
“You are wrong.”Morsten looked at the corpses and slowly said: “This is what people do.”
..
..
Dudian sat on the sofa as he returned to the castle by the Mozar River. Gabriel made a pot of tea and drank it while waiting. Soon Glenn and Gwyneth came back one after another.
“How are the mercenaries?”Dudian asked.
Glenn nodded: “They have been dealt with. The magistrate won’t be able to trace them for a while. However, there are too many people in this operation. After a long time they will be found by the magistrate. What should we do next?”
Dudian replied: “Nothing. They have found it. They are the unlucky ones.”
Glenn was slightly startled.
Dudian turned his head and looked at the two unconscious people lying on the floor of the living room. He poured a cup of hot tea and poured it over them. Both of them immediately woke up and sat up.
“Beast, what do you want?”Sarah quickly looked around and knew that they had come to Dudian’s castle. Her face was ugly.
Dudian indifferently said: “Nothing much. I said that I will give you a surprise when you wake up. Do you know how many people died in your Mel Family Tonight?”
Sarah angrily stared at him: “You Are Crazy!”
Dudian acted as if he didn’t hear her, he continued: “I don’t know. But I do know how many people survived in your family tonight. Let me calculate. You, your little maid, your father, and two doctors. There are five in total…”
Sarah’s face turned pale as if she had been painted. Her lips trembled: “What did you do to the others?”
“Of course I killed them.”Dudian said: “Did you invite them to drink tea?”
Sarah felt her vision go black. An indescribable grief surged up from her heart. She stared at Dudian, “Even if I die, I will curse you. I will wait for You in Hell!”
“Then you will have to wait.”Dudian said: “Do you know why I Let You Live?”
Sarah stared at him in anger. She sneered at him, “Why?”? “Don’t you want to know all the properties and properties of the Mel family from me? Your idea is wrong. No matter how you treat me, I will not tell you a word. Moreover, I might tell you the wrong information. You better not believe my words!”
“I never believe your words.”Dudian said: “You think too highly of yourself. I’m keeping you here because I want to take revenge on you. I want you to taste the most painful and despairing thing in the world. I have said that I will repay my enemies a hundred times over. Shouldn’t I keep my word?”
Sarah was stunned.
“As for the property of your Mel family, even if I don’t get it through you I can get it. You overestimate the value of your existence.”Dudian looked at Gwyneth who was standing next to him, he looked at Sarah: “Didn’t you want to know who your grandfather was? Gwyneth, you are a disciplinary from the inner wall. Tell him where the nobles from the outer wall came from.”

chapters.title: Chapter 612
chapters.content:
Chapter 612
Gwyneth’s mind was still immersed in the previous massacre. The bloody scene repeatedly echoed in her mind. She couldn’t help but clench her fists whenever she thought of the faces of the children who had fallen in the pool of blood, there was a kind of regret but there was nothing she could do. She couldn’t help but be startled when she heard Dudian call her. She looked up and saw the dark eyes of Dudian. Her heart shivered and the doubt in her eyes quickly disappeared, she nodded: “Yes, Young Master.”
She glanced at the two people lying in front of Dudian. There was a trace of coldness in her eyes. If these people didn’t provoke Dudian, those innocent servants and children wouldn’t have died!
She had no good impression of the nobles since she was framed in prison. She coldly said: “Young Master, as far as I know, all the nobles in the outer wall are servants who were expelled from the inner wall.”
In addition to Dudian, Sergei, Glenn, Gabriel and Mason who were serving Dudian were all stunned. As a native of the outer wall.., the status of the nobles had been deeply rooted in their hearts. They were as noble as the royal family in the old era. However, these “Royal families”were just servants?
Sarah and Sarah were stunned. After a while, Sarah finally reacted. She turned her head and glared at Sarah angrily, “What did you say? You Lowly peasant, how dare you blaspheme the nobles? Do you think that I will believe you just because you said that? You will die a horrible death! !”
Gwyneth glanced at her coldly, “Whether you believe it or not, this is the truth. The outer wall has always been called the ‘wilderness’by the inner wall. It means that the people living in the outer wall are barbarians who do not understand human etiquette and upbringing. Just like how the people of the outer wall call the barbarians of the radiation zone, in the eyes of the people of the inner wall, all the people of the outer wall are no different from barbarians!”
Sarah looked at her in a daze, unable to speak.
Gwyneth continued, “The ancestors of the nobles in the outer wall were once the servants of the true nobles in the inner wall. Because they had learned etiquette from the true nobles, they behaved like nobles. Over time, they felt that they were superior to the commoners. “However, many of the high-ranking servants who were groomed by the nobles were too proud and offended their masters. Therefore, they were expelled from the inner wall and exiled to the wilderness of the outer wall
“Therefore, the nobles in the outer wall don’t have any fake titles. They are only known as ‘nobles’in the household register and don’t dare to title themselves as nobles.”
Hearing her words, Sergei, Glenn, and the others were dumbfounded. They believed that Gwyneth was not lying. After spending half a year with her, they knew that this girl was proud and disdained to lie, moreover, she was a disciplinary officer from the inner wall, so most of the information she said was true. However, this news was really shocking. They had never thought that the noble that they had once revered was actually a servant of a real noble in the inner wall! Moreover, it was a servant who had been exiled because of his mistake!
It was such a group of people who were self-titled nobles in the outer wall, superior to others, and enjoyed privileges that ordinary civilians couldn’t get!
Thinking of this, Sergei, Glenn, and the others felt a little funny, funny, and ironic.
Sarah sat on the ground in a daze. After a moment, she suddenly reacted and stared at her with a twisted face full of anger, she said, “You’re lying. It’s not like that. It’s definitely not like that. We nobles are only expelled from the outer wall because we violated the taboo. But we are definitely not servants. Our ancestors were all real nobles, but we were stripped of the title of nobility. Look, I’m a blonde, I’m a blonde! ! This is the color of the hair of a noble. Do you know that ? !
Gwyneth grabbed her slightly curled golden hair and looked at the crowd in excitement.
Everyone reacted. It was true that blonde hair had always been the symbol of a noble. It could not be disguised.
Dudian’s expression was calm as he raised his hand to signal Gwyneth to continue.
Gwyneth looked at Sarah with no pity in her eyes, she said: “Blonde hair is the color of nobility. It is the same in the inner wall. In terms of bloodline, you have half of the noble’s bloodline. Because your ancestors were the closest servants to the nobles. Some of them were appreciated by the nobles and married noble ladies. Some of them were visited by noble princes. So you have half of the noble’s genes.”
“However, it’s just a bloodline. It’s nothing. The symbol of a noble is a title. Without a title, you are nothing. No matter how brilliant your blonde hair is, you are a commoner. There is nothing special about you!”
Sarah stood up: “Nonsense! I have a noble bloodline. I am different from you. You are jealous of me. How would you understand the nobility of a noble bloodline?”
Gwyneth frowned. She was about to say something when Dudian opened his mouth, “It seems that Miss Mel doesn’t want to hear this fact. The reality is always harsh because the reality needs to be seen by the eyes. The beautiful ones need to rely on their own brain to fantasize.”
Sarah turned her head and stared at him: “If you want to kill then kill. Why do you need to talk so much nonsense?”
“Death is freedom, not torture.”Dudian indifferently said: “Sergei, I will leave the rest to you. Remember, don’t play to death. I want to keep them.”
Sergei respectfully said: “Yes, master. Thank You Master!”
Dudian waved his hand: “Go.”
Sergei grinned. He grabbed onto Sarah’s shoulder and hugged Lisa: “Two little girls, come with me. Uncle Sergei will let you taste the taste of being a woman.”
Sarah’s eyes were filled with fear as she struggled: “Beast, let go of me! YOU SCUM! Let Go of me…”
Sergei didn’t care about them as he took them upstairs.
Gwyneth and Glenn saw the scene and knew what would happen to them. They looked at Dudian who was sitting on the sofa. They felt that the boy was different from before.
At this time, the sound of horse hooves could be heard.
Soon, a few figures rushed into the hall. They were Nicholas and his attendants.
Nicholas was relieved to see that everyone was in the hall. He saluted dudian: “Master, the cultivation base has been seized back.”
Dudian nodded: “Well done. Very efficient.”
Nicholas replied: “Young Master, you flatter me. But…”
“But what?”
Nicholas hesitated for a moment, “Although the plantation base has been seized back. But I believe that the Mel family will get the news and send people to seize it. With the number of people we have stationed there, we are not a match for the Mel family. Unless Glenn, Gwyneth or Sergei are there to guard it.”
Glenn, Mason and the others looked at him with strange expressions.
Nicholas noticed the strange expressions on everyone’s faces. He carefully said: “Young master, did I. . . Say Something Wrong?”
Dudian shook his head.
Nicholas was puzzled and wanted to ask again. Glenn said: “You don’t have to worry. From tonight on Mel family will disappear from the outer wall.”
Nicholas was stunned: “Disappear from the outer wall? What… What’s going on?”
Glenn told them about the massacre of the Mel family. Nicholas was stunned: “Blood? Blood washed the Mel Family?”
“Yes.”Glenn nodded.
Nicholas was stunned as he looked at Dudian. Dudian had wiped out the Mel family after he took back the planting base? This was one of the oldest noble families. Although they were in decline but the number of knights and experts hired by the family was countless. How could they be destroyed by Dudian in such a short time?
Dudian got up, he ordered: “Since the plantation base has been taken back then you should manage it well. I will use it in the near future. You should be prepared. In addition, hire people to expand the plantation base. There is no limit to the area. You should invest as much as you can.” He turned and went upstairs.
Nicholas was stunned for a moment. He waited for Aisha to disappear from the corner of the building. At this time, he heard a woman’s scream coming from a room upstairs. He couldn’t help but be surprised, was there someone who dared to do such a thing when Dudian was angry?
He immediately asked Glenn. Glenn told him about Sergei. After hearing that, nicotine fell into deep thought.
“The young master has changed a lot since he came back.”Glenn sighed and said, “I used to think that he was a smart and warm-hearted person. I didn’t expect that after not seeing him for a few years, his killing intent became more and more intense.”
Nicotine nodded slightly and said, “Indeed, he has changed a lot since he came back.”
Glenn shook her head and said, “It’s a pity that these two women offended him. When he was still a beginner hunter, I had a feeling that he would have a great future. It’s a pity that the Mel family doesn’t have good taste and doesn’t know how to appreciate talents. Otherwise, when I protected him from the Thorn Flower Prison, I would definitely receive his gratitude and pledge my loyalty to him. In this way, the Mel family would have a terrifying senior hunter. It’s only a matter of time before they enter the inner wall!”
“What a pity, what a pity, what a pity, what an abomination! It was just a moment of difference…”
She could not help but shake her head and sigh.
Nicholas said, “You can’t blame them. Hunters are never liked.”
Glenn sighed.
“However, he brought the two of them back. It shouldn’t be as simple as taking revenge.”Nicholas narrowed his eyes.
Glenn was surprised as she looked at the old man: “What do you mean?”
“Young master is smarter than all of us had imagined. He would never do something without any reward unless the Mel family made him hate them…”Nicholas slowly said.
Glenn looked at him. She knew that he had been in contact with Dudian for a longer time than she did.
Dark.
That night, people from the magistrate’s office and the branch of Holy Church were awakened from their sleep. A sensational news quickly spread out from all the forces and large newspapers.
Countless people were woken up from their sleep and busy with their work.
“Deacon, wake up. There is a big case.”
“How many times have I told you? Even if there is a big case, don’t Disturb my sleep. We will talk about it tomorrow.”
“Deacon, something happened to the nobles.”
“What?”
All the magistrate and knights rushed to the small town of Wugang. They were bound to be sleepless tonight.
The next day.
The front page of every large newspaper published a sensational news. The Mel family was temporarily living in the small town of Wugang. The family was exterminated last night. There was no news about the patriarch of the Mel family and the daughter of the Mel family, it was unknown whether they were alive or dead.
Dudian took a sip of milk from his breakfast as he read the news in the newspaper.
At the same time, a handsome youth in another majestic hall saw the headlines in the newspaper. His eyes turned red as he roared in anger. He tore the newspaper in his hand into pieces.
Some people would be happy with the news but some people would be unhappy.
Scott Consortium, Huasheng Consortium and other major consortia’s nobles all saw the sensational news. Everyone was shocked. Although the Mel family had been banned by Dudian, but now there was no news of the legendary genius. The Mel family had been developing in a low-key way. Although they weren’t in their prime but they were comparable to the first-class nobles. They had been captured overnight, it was simply inconceivable!
As for the missing Mel and his daughter, it was obvious that they had most likely fallen into the hands of evil people. There was no difference whether they died or not.
In the dexing town next to Wugang town, under a manor, there was a grand and Majestic Hall. At this moment, in a room in the hall, there were seven or eight figures sitting. The leader was a middle-aged man dressed in a black robe, he angrily slapped the table, he angrily said, “Look at what this is. The Mel family was destroyed in Wugang town, yet they only received the news now. Are you guys still sleeping in your dreams when the enemy attacks our headquarters in District 12? !”
The rest of the people kept quiet out of fear.
“Our dark church was reduced to reading the newspapers before we knew what was happening outside. Have you guys been underground for too long? Have you forgotten that the surface is where we live?”The middle-aged man angrily said.
No one dared to make a sound.
“The Mel family was wiped out the moment they cooperated with us. It has been so long since we received the news. We still don’t know who the murderer is. Tell me, if the chairman asks, how am I going to explain this to him?”The middle-aged man said furiously.
One of them hesitated for a moment, he said, “Elder, those who were able to massacre the Mel family are most likely people who have enmity with them. Perhaps they are also people who have enmity with us. As long as we follow this point to find them, I believe we will soon find out who did it.”
The middle-aged man roared, “Then why aren’t you going?”

chapters.title: Chapter 613
chapters.content:
Chapter 613
“Master, the matter of the Mel family is spreading outside. I’m afraid we can’t hide it for long.”Nicholas went to Dudian’s room, he was worried: “The Mel family is involved in too many interests. Most of the others will transfer their hatred to the murderer. Last night I robbed the planting base. This matter should be noticed soon.”
Dudian slowly said: “How Soon?”
Nicholas seriously said: “In two days it will be traced back to us.”
“Two days is enough.”Dudian indifferently said: “After two days no one will continue to pay attention to this matter.”
Nicholas was stunned.
… ..
… ..
Time flew by. In the blink of an eye it was time for the meeting of the elders.
Shooting Wolf had prepared a suit made by a master tailor. He was in high spirits. He combed his hair and tie in front of the mirror. He looked at himself in the mirror, he was very satisfied.
In order to make himself look more like an evil elder of the dark church, he tried to imitate the habits of the elders of the dark church. For example, extravagant, rich, cold-blooded, cruel and unpredictable temperament.., he had grasped these places perfectly. He was a natural pretender.
“Elder, you seem to be in a good mood today!”Hawkeye came to the room and was ready to pick him up. Seeing that he was smiling, he couldn’t help but smile.
“As long as I can smell the blood, I will be in a good mood.”Shooting Wolf smiled, tidied his clothes, picked up his walking stick, and went straight out. There was a trace of anticipation in the depths of his eyes. He had waited for this opportunity for too long, in the past few months as an elder of the ninth district, he had been missing this time every day. He had already secretly informed the Pope and passed the location of the Elders’meeting, the number of people, and other information to the pope in secret.
He believed that the Pope would definitely not miss this excellent opportunity. He would send the strongest force of the radiant church to capture all these evil followers of the dark church in one go!
At that time, he would definitely take the first credit, and it would be recorded in the history of the radiant church, leaving behind a glorious stroke!
At his age, he did not have much desire for material things, including power. It was hard for him to be moved. And being famous for all eternity was what he looked forward to and yearned for the most.
When he died, he would still be remembered by the people. What kind of luxurious enjoyment would he have?
“After all the elders have been captured, only the mysterious dark speaker will be left. The dark church will be disintegrated today. The Dark Church, which has been against the radiant church for more than two hundred years, will be disintegrated because of me…”thought shooting wolf, the corners of his mouth could not help but curl up.
Soon, he was escorted by hawk-eye and the other members of the Parliament. He came to a luxurious carriage in the manor and sat down. On both sides of the carriage were dark knights and two dark grand knight commanders who had been waiting for a long time, they would personally escort him to the meeting this time.
“Let’s go.”Sitting in the carriage, shooting wolf ordered.
Seeing that he was leaving now, Hawkeye hurriedly said, “Elder, aren’t you waiting for that person?”
Shooting Wolf knew who the “That person”he was talking about was. He could not help but recall the powerful strength they had fought before. His eyes narrowed slightly, he said, “There’s no need. Didn’t he already know the location of the meeting of the elders? Maybe they went there directly. Let’s go first and meet them there.”
Hawkeye wanted to say something, but he stopped himself in the end.
The team set off again. The Dark Knights outside the carriage had a cold and stern aura. It was a somber scene, and no one dared to approach.
Phelan town.
This was the territory of the Phelan family. A hundred years ago, a female general named Phelan had appeared in the family. She had made great contributions in the barbarian battle, killed countless barbarians, and saved tens of thousands of civilians. Because of her outstanding military achievements.., therefore, she was rewarded with this small town.
Currently, that female general was no longer alive. Her descendants followed the example of their ancestors and were proud of joining the army. There were many amazing people at the level of a great general in the family. This made the FELAN family a big family that was comparable to the Mel family. However.., the FELAN family was not a noble family. Therefore, they were not recruited by the consortium. They were only loyal to the military. When anyone in the military mentioned the FELAN family, they would be afraid of them.
Shooting Wolf’s carriage slowly entered Felan town. This town, which was respected by countless commoners, was the gathering point of this elders’meeting. There was no other reason than that this was the safest place.
Shooting Wolf lifted the curtain of the carriage and looked at the scenery on the side of the road. He narrowed his eyes and revealed some coldness, “Why did he have to seek refuge with the dark church and become the leader of the Dark Council? Humph, the Pope should have contacted the military and used this opportunity to uproot the FELAN family. There should be people in the military who are jealous of this general family…”
The carriage galloped all the way and slowly came to a high mountain behind the town. There was a castle far away from the hustle and bustle of the town. There were flags of the FELAN family with blueprints on all four sides. Teams of knights were patrolling outside the castle. By the side of the road leading to the castle, the flowers and grass were fragrant. The grass was all trimmed. Occasionally, wild rabbits could be seen jumping on the grass, and children could be seen playing on the grass.
Shooting Wolf lifted the curtain and saw the children playing on the grass. He noticed that they were all wearing clothes embroidered with bluegrass patterns, and they were all descendants of the FELAN family.
“Poor children…”looking at the innocent smiles of these children, shooting wolf showed a trace of pity in his eyes. These children hadn’t done anything bad.., they probably didn’t know what kind of disaster they would be involved in.
Soon, the carriage arrived in front of the Felan family’s castle.
The carriage was stopped. Shooting Wolf took out an invitation card from his pocket and handed it to the Dark Knight outside the window.
After reading the invitation card, the guard glanced at the knights on both sides of the carriage and said, “The family has ordered that only ten people are allowed to enter each invitation card.”
Shooting Wolf frowned slightly. After thinking for a moment, he immediately called over a dark grand knight and said, “Pick a few good fighters and stay here. The rest of you stay outside the castle for now. Don’t go far.”
“Yes.”Tumako nodded and turned around to choose a few dark knights to stay behind.
“Please.”The guard pulled open the thick and heavy door of the castle and made an inviting gesture.
When shooting wolf saw that this small guard had such a temperament, he secretly felt a bit of respect for the FELAN family. At the same time, he also felt a bit of regret. He could clearly be a hero, yet he had to fall into the darkness.
After entering the castle, shooting Wolf said to tumako outside the window, “You stay here. If that person comes, you take care of him here.”
Tumako was slightly startled, but he quickly reacted and said, “It’s that person…”
“Shh!”Shooting Wolf made a hand gesture and slightly glared at him. He said, “It’s good that you know. Why did you say it?”
Tumako knew that he had misspoken. He scratched his head and quickly thought of something, he said, “Elder, they don’t have an invitation card. It’s useless for me to receive them here. We’ve brought enough places for ten people. I’m afraid the guards won’t let them in. This…”
Shooting Wolf saw his simple mind and couldn’t help but shake his head. “That’s their problem. We’ve already done our duty.”
Tumako finally reacted and said with a bitter smile, “I know.”
Tumako stopped by the door and watched the carriage enter the castle. He got off the horse and squatted at the fountain in the square to wait. A moment later, the sound of carriages came from outside. He immediately stood up and tiptoed to look. Immediately, he saw a noble-style carriage slowly approaching under the escort of two teams of knights. When he saw the flag on the carriage, his expression changed slightly. He did not expect to meet an old enemy so soon.
Soon, after the carriage showed the invitation card, it was let in by the guard.
A middle-aged man in the guard team beside the carriage saw Tumako. His eyebrows immediately raised and he said mockingly, “Isn’t this Tumako? Why? Has he been abandoned by Your District 9 and came here to be a Watchdog?”
Tumako’s face was gloomy. He said coldly, “You’re still the same. A dog can’t spit out ivory from its mouth!”
“Is that so? Then spit one out for me to see,”the middle-aged man teased.
Tumako was choked by his refutation. He snorted and said, “If your saber had the ability to talk like this, you wouldn’t have been chased by me and fled everywhere last time!”
The middle-aged man’s expression changed slightly. He sneered and said, “You were obviously being chased by me, yet you still bite back. With your little ability, you can still chase after me?”
Tumako was stunned. He didn’t expect that not only did he deny it, but he also said that he bite back first. It seemed that the truth was as he said. He was so angry that he clenched his fists and said, “Who is being chased? Get off the horse and try. Your companions are watching here. If you have the guts, come down and fight me one-on-one!”
A hint of gloominess flashed across the middle-aged man’s eyes. Just as he was about to speak again, a hoarse voice came from the carriage, “Don’t make things more complicated. Let’s go in first.”
Hearing this, the middle-aged man lifted the horse rope and said coldly to tumako, “Today is your Lucky Day. Next time, you won’t be so lucky.”After saying that, he shook the horse rope and rode away.
Tumako did not expect this person to be so shameless. Black and white were reversed, and he even spoke as if he was serious. He was so angry that he wanted to drag him down from the horse to fight. However, thinking that this was, after all, the place where the elders gathered.., if he acted rashly and broke the rules, he would inevitably be punished severely. He gritted his teeth and endured it.
A moment later, the sound of the carriage wheels rolling could be heard again from outside. Tumako stood up and looked over. When he saw that it was the elders of the third district, he could not help but feel a chill in his heart.
Soon, the carriage of the third district passed through the inspection of the guards and entered the castle.
The Dark Knights on both sides of the carriage noticed Tumako by the fountain in the square. They only gave him a cold glance and did not say anything. They just passed by the square.
Tumako silently watched them leave. He secretly heaved a sigh of relief and continued to squat down and wait.
After the elders of the third district arrived, the elders of the other districts arrived one after another. In the blink of an eye, the sun had already shone on the square. Tumako took out his expensive mechanical pocket watch and glanced at it. At this moment, there were still ten minutes left until nine o’clock, the meeting was about to begin.
“Could it be that they aren’t coming?”Tumako was puzzled as he raised his head and looked over.
At this glance, he just happened to see a carriage coming from afar. There weren’t any flags on it. There were four attendants standing guard in front of the carriage. They weren’t wearing knight armor, but rather a strange-looking hunter armor.
“They are coming.”His eyes slightly flashed.
The guard saw the carriage that had arrived at the door and immediately stopped it: “This is the territory of the FELAN family. No one is allowed to enter!”
Dudian slowly lifted the curtain and said to the guard: “You didn’t ask me for an invitation card. How did you know that I am an idle person?”
The middle-aged guard was startled. He remembered that all twelve guests on the list had arrived. Why were there thirteen now? He looked at dudian: “Since you are the guest of my master, Please Show Me the invitation card.”
Dudian nodded and looked at Sergei: “Show him.”
Sergei grinned: “Alright.”He jumped off the horse and came to the front of the middle-aged guard.
The middle-aged guard looked at him strangely. He was about to speak when he saw a black shadow coming towards him. He was shocked. He raised his hand to block but the black shadow hit his face. He felt an indescribable pain coming from his face, his body retreated continuously, rolling a few times.
Sergei shook his hand and grinned. “This is the invitation. Is It Nice?”
“It’s as Nice as a flower.”Glenn jumped down from another horse. Her figure swayed slightly, and she quickly rushed towards the other guards who were alarmed. A dagger quietly appeared between her fingers, shining with a silver light on her fingertips, the guards who were surrounding her fell one after another. Blood spurted out from their necks.
The fight in front seemed to have nothing to do with Dudian. He slowly lifted the curtain and pulled the hook. He turned around and got off the carriage. He reached out to Aisha who was in the carriage and pulled her down the stairs, by the time he turned around to face the gate of the castle, the guards had all fallen. Sergei, Glenn, Gwyneth and Neuss stepped through the blood and corpses and pushed the gate open.
“Gabriel, follow me.”Dudian called out to Gabriel who was the coachman.
It was Gabriel’s first time following Dudian. He saw the corpses of the guards lying on the ground in the blink of an eye. His face was pale. He had never seen so much blood. He had seen the scene of Glenn and the other two slaughtering, he thought of the slaughters that he had seen in the village. The slaughters were as clean as the slaughters. The only difference was that the slaughters were accompanied by the screams of the pigs. The previous slaughters were silent.
Dudian tightened the robe on his shoulder as he led Aisha through the clean ground. He saw a familiar face as soon as he entered the gate: “Have they gone in?”
Tumako’s face was pale as he looked at Dudian. He thought that Dudian would retreat after being stopped by the guards. He didn’t expect that he would break in in such a crazy way, this was the family of the general!
“They have gone in.”Tumako replied: “They are waiting for you inside.”
Dudian nodded as he led Aisha into the room.
Tumako looked at the few people behind Dudian. There was fear in his eyes. The speed of the previous few people wasn’t inferior to his, he didn’t know where Dudian found four people who were comparable to the Dark Grand Knight. The previous elder seemed to be more unfathomable than he had imagined!

chapters.title: Chapter 614
chapters.content:
Chapter 614
Deep in the underground of the Felan family’s castle, complicated dark passages spread across the entire castle like veins. Every entrance of the passage was set up with traps guarded by Dark Knights. After passing through one trap after another, shooting wolf led the nine people who followed him and finally arrived at the dark meeting hall of the Elders’meeting.
This was an extremely spacious hall. The walls were embedded with fist-sized milky-white crystals. If anyone thought that this was a natural ore, they would be gravely mistaken. This was a fluorescent organ of some kind of monster. Even if it was cut off.., as long as it was well preserved, it could still last for several years or even more than ten years.
Shooting Wolf glanced at the hall and suddenly felt that the decorations here, including the Round Table, the twelve elder chairs, and the decorations on the walls, were all very familiar. It seemed to be similar to the highest meeting hall of the Holy See. The only difference was.., the meeting hall of the Holy See was decorated in gold and was filled with a holy aura. Moreover, the light was so bright that even at night, one could see one’s hair.
However, this place was dark and turbid. Even during the day, it was mostly dark and difficult to see.
“Evil people, even the meeting hall imitates the Holy See. Humph!”Shooting Wolf sneered in his heart, but at the same time, he felt a little proud. After finding his seat, he directly sat down, leaving only two knights behind to guard the back of the chair, at any time, they would listen to his orders. The rest of them retreated to the dark side of the Great Hall at the back, waiting for orders.
Shooting Wolf glanced at the four people who had arrived before him. His face was cold and expressionless. His gaze paused on one of the short old men for a moment, and he was secretly shocked, in the past when he was a librarian, and in the past few months when he was an elder of the ninth district, he had heard that the most famous figures of the dark church were none other than the three kings of darkness.
The names of the sword king, Hades, and Night King were equally well-known in both the dark church and the radiant church!
“The Sword King has arrived. Hades and Night King should be here soon. The pope should have sent the great radiant king personally this time…”shooting Wolf’s eyes flashed slightly, and the fear in his heart was immediately replaced by a wave of contempt, the Great Radiant King was the title of the strongest knight of the radiant church. He was also the undefeated God of War of the radiant church. He was also the number one person in the outer wall region!
It was said that even in the inner wall region, he was considered an expert. If he were to make a move, these rats in the darkness would definitely be caught in one go!
Thinking of this, the corners of his mouth curled up. He slowly turned his head and looked outside quietly, hoping that time would pass quickly.
Not long after, people came in one after another from outside. They were dressed differently from shooting wolf. Most of them were wearing black robes and a huge hood covered half of their faces. In the dimly lit main hall, their faces became even more blurry. As a result.., shooting Wolf was dressed in a noble-style suit, which made him seem a little different. It also attracted the attention of a few people. This made shooting wolf secretly frown. He knew that he had been careless.
However, he believed that this alone would not expose his identity. After all, most of these figures of the cult of Shadows had strange and twisted personalities. His clothes could also be classified as a strange hobby and could not be considered a flaw.
“It’s still the same here. It’s dark here.”Suddenly, a voice came from outside. Soon after, a thin and cold-looking young man walked in and glanced indifferently at the hall, his gaze paused on shooting wolf for a moment, then he walked straight to his seat — the second seat at the top!
The short old man that shooting Wolf had noticed earlier glanced at the cold-looking young man and said, “We live in the dark. Do you want to be like the radiant church and make this place magnificent and dazzling?”
After the cold-looking young man sat down, he leaned back on the chair and said indifferently, “Why not? Who said that the meeting hall of the radiant church must be pitch black? How can the radiant church’s Hall be so bright?”
“This is called fitting one’s identity.”The short old man said calmly, “Commoners should wear the clothes of commoners. They can’t wear the clothes of nobles, right? Similarly, nobles can’t wear the hemp clothes of commoners.”
“How boring is that?”The cold-looking young man said, “After a long time, one will eventually get tired of it. Commoners may one day be bold enough to wear the clothes of nobles and eat the food of nobles. They want to change their tastes occasionally. Isn’t that good?”
“If you are not used to eating, you will have diarrhea if you eat too much,”the short old man said indifferently.
Hearing the words of the two, the others in the hall were all silent.
When shooting wolf saw the cold-looking youth give him a sideways glance after he finished speaking, he felt a chill in his heart. He knew that the meaning of his words was to warn him and others! After he became an elder of the ninth district, he did not offer anything to the Night King, nor did he visit him. The ninth district originally belonged to the power of the Night King. By doing so, it was clear that he had angered the king of the Dark Church!
However, he didn’t expect the sword king to speak up for him. It seemed that the relationship between the three kings wasn’t only hostile but also cooperative.
At this moment, a few more people came in.
Shooting Wolf finally saw Pluto, who was the last to arrive. The latter looked like a burly man, but his chiseled face was full of decisiveness. He wasn’t a rough man with muscles all over his body.
“It seems that everyone is here.”Pluto sat on the chair at the top of the hall. He glanced around and said slowly, “In that case, the meeting of the elders will officially begin. Everyone…”
He suddenly stopped and looked up at the top of his head.
The others saw his action and looked up in confusion. They saw that there were no hidden weapons or ambushes on the dome of the hall. One of them said, “Lord Pluto, what are you doing?”
“A guest is here,”the short old man sitting on the other chair said coldly.
Shooting Wolf was slightly startled. His heart suddenly moved. was that person coming? He couldn’t help but look up. He held his breath and listened to the movements on the ground above his head. In the extreme silence, he heard the breathing of the guards brought by some elders, he also heard the sound of increasingly chaotic footsteps coming from the ground above his head. At the same time, there were also ear-piercing sounds of metal colliding.
“Someone is invading?”Another woman wearing a veil said in surprise, “There seems to be quite a number of them. The guards of the FELAN family above seem to have all moved out.”
Shooting Wolf’s heart was filled with joy, and his eyes lit up. “It’s the Pope!”
He could not help but want to stand up and cheer. However, when he thought that these people present were enough to kill him before the top was breached, he suppressed the joy in his heart and sat quietly on the chair. He tried his best to suppress the excitement in his heart.
“Sword attendant, go out and take a look…”the short old man had just ordered a young man who was serving on the back of the chair. Before he could finish his words, the ground suddenly shook slightly. Immediately after, sand and stones fell from the top of everyone’s heads with a crash, a huge rock suddenly collapsed.
The people present reacted very quickly. Before the huge rock hit the round table, they quickly retreated.
Bang!
A knight fell from the huge rock and fell to the ground. He spat out blood and was on the verge of death.
At the same time, a few figures jumped down from above and stood on the table that was crushed by the huge rock.
“They attacked directly?”When shooting wolf saw the collapsed dome of the hall, he was secretly delighted. When the dust dispersed, he hurriedly looked over. He was stunned when he saw the few people who jumped down, it wasn’t the great king of Light and the head of the Knights of light that he had expected. It was a familiar face of a teenager. It was him?
The others reacted as shooting wolf was stunned. The sword king snorted: “So it wasn’t the great king of Light, Luo Ao. How dare you come here to behave atrociously?”
Dudian looked up at the edge of the cave. The Knights of the FELAN family were in a circle. He slowly retracted his eyes and looked at the short old man who had spoken earlier, “Tell them to retreat. I want to talk to you quietly.”
Sword King narrowed his eyes. He had noticed that there wasn’t a large group of people. However, the movement that they made was comparable to an elite division. It was clear that their strength wasn’t weak. It was difficult to deal with experts, moreover there weren’t many knights outside. He coldly snorted and raised his head: “You go back first. Let Phil Look Around.”
The two knights who were surrounded outside heard his words. They immediately waved their hands to signal the others to retreat.
“You are quite smart.”Dudian said a sentence of praise. He led Aisha down from the boulder. They came to a chair on the ground. He pulled up the chair and straightened it. He patted the dust on it, then he sat down.
Sword King and others looked at Dudian’s leisurely appearance. There were six people in total with Dudian. There were only seven people including Dudian. They couldn’t think of seven people who dared to trespass in the outer wall area, it should be known that the top twenty miles of the outer wall area were gathered here. In particular, there were three kings. All of them were close to the great king of light.
“Kid, why are you pretending? Tell me your name. If you want to die then I will help you!”A strong man shouted.
Dudian calmly looked at him: “I am the last elder of the ninth region. By the way, my code name also has the word ‘king’.”
Everyone was startled.
“You are the last… Demon King of the 9th Region?”The man was stunned as he sneered, “Kid, you are tired of living. You have left your post without permission. You are wanted by the speaker but you still dare to appear here. You are courting death. Why do you have the code name of ‘Demon King’? Are you naive enough to call yourself a king? “If you are the devil then I am the Devil!”
Dudian looked at the crowd: “In that case, you must have heard of me. It is very convenient. Now…”
“Kid, cut the crap. Since you are here, prepare to die!”The strong man interrupted Dudian’s words and sneered, he looked at the others: “Everyone, the speaker wants to kill the person here. Why are you still standing there? Kill him!”
Dudian slightly frowned and looked at him: “You are really noisy.”The bell on his wrist was ringing.
Whoosh!
A breeze suddenly swept up.
The dust that had just fallen from the ground gently floated up in the breeze.
The strong man sneered: “Kid, you…”the voice suddenly stopped. A cold and sharp palm pierced through his chest and his heart. He lowered his head in disbelief and stared at his own chest. A slender arm with snow-white skin appeared in his eyes.
“This… how is this possible…”the burly man’s throat was hoarse. He could not believe it, but his eyes quickly dimmed and his body fell down.
Aisha pulled back her palm. The blood in her palm stimulated her instinct. She slightly grinned and revealed a ferocious look. She raised her hand and gently licked the blood on her finger as if she was sucking on an extremely delicious sauce.
Seeing this sudden scene, the people who were ready to attack were all stunned.
The faces of the Sword King, Pluto, and Night King changed drastically. They looked at Haisha in shock. With their eyesight, they didn’t even see how this girl appeared in front of terbury. Such an unpredictable speed.., if they had attacked them earlier, they would probably be the one who fell now.
The three of them shivered as they felt the urgency of their lives being threatened.
“It’s quiet now. Continue with the previous words.”Dudian slowly said: “From today onwards, I will be the Supreme Speaker of the Dark Church. From now on, you only need to be loyal to me. Is there a problem?”
Everyone was stunned.
Shooting Wolf’s face was ugly as cold sweat broke out from his palms. He didn’t expect that the woman behind the young man would be so strong. Although he couldn’t judge how strong the woman was but seeing the reaction of the three kings.., he knew that the woman’s previous attack had completely suppressed them. Her strength was enough to contend with the great king of light. If the great king came tonight then there would be a fierce battle!
“DAMN!”He cursed in his heart and clenched his fists.
After a short silence, the burly Pluto stared at dudian: “Serve You? Although you are very strong but you seem to have nothing.”
“As long as I exist, everything will be born.”Dudian calmly said.
Night King frowned: “Do you think you are a God? Do you think there is light?”
Dudian nodded: “Yes.”
Night King snorted, “Although you are very strong but it is difficult to defeat the three of us at the same time. I advise you to leave as soon as possible. We will pretend that nothing has happened. It is impossible for you to be the speaker. The speaker will not allow your existence. You may not know but the speaker of the dark church is able to communicate with the inner wall. Although your strength is not bad but there are many experts in the inner wall. Any one of them is enough to kill you!”
“If that’s the case, why didn’t they send an expert to help you flatten the Holy Church?”Dudian quietly looked at him.
Night King coldly said: “This is the rule. The Holy Church has forces in the inner wall. We can not ask the inner wall to intervene when we are fighting. Otherwise, the inner wall will be involved in the fight. But you are different. You are not a member of the Holy Church. You are just a traitor. If the speaker knows your whereabouts and strength, he will ask the people of the inner wall to intervene. At that time you will die!”

chapters.title: Chapter 615
chapters.content:
Chapter 615
“What you said is very reasonable. Unfortunately it is useless.”Dudian indifferently said: “I only give you two choices. Either you submit to me and respect me as a king or you die here.”
Everyone’s face slightly changed. They looked at each other but no one spoke.
Dudian saw that no one spoke after a few minutes: “Since you are not willing to make the first choice, I will ask you one by one. You can choose this cameo.”
“Cameo?”The middle-aged man was startled as Dudian pointed at him. He frowned: “What do you mean by cameo? My code name is ‘defense’…”
“Cameo means I don’t need to know your name.”Dudian interrupted: “Let’s cut to the chase. Which one do you choose?”
Defense was angry. He didn’t think that Dudian would be so arrogant. His eyes were gloomy as he slightly clenched his fingers. If it was someone else who looked down on him, he would have been beheaded. But he thought of Terbury who was killed in an instant. He couldn’t help but look at the girl who was emitting a dangerous aura, his face slightly changed. He was silent for a moment and whispered: “I am willing to submit to you.”
“Since you have chosen to submit, you should use the honorific title.”Dudian indifferently said.
Defender clenched his teeth but there was no anger on his face. He bowed his head: “Defender is willing to submit to you!”
Dudian said: “Speak up.”
Defender’s face was ugly. He lowered his head and shouted: “Defender is willing to submit to you! !”His voice echoed in all directions. Defender knew that there was no turning back once he said that. Once Dudian was defeated, even if he begged for mercy, the speaker would not let him off easily, he stepped onto Dudian’s ship.
Dudian nodded slightly and pointed to another person: “It’s your turn.”
“Night King, Sword King, Underworld King, are we really going to submit to him? Instead of being defeated one by one, why not join hands and fight to the death with him? I don’t believe that we have gathered so many strong people and are afraid of seven of them!”The second person named by Dudian was an extremely tall middle-aged man, he didn’t say anything but turned to the sword king and the others.
He wasn’t willing to submit but he didn’t dare to face Dudian alone. The three of them were arrogant and wouldn’t easily submit to others.
The faces of the Sword King and the others changed as they heard Dudian’s words. They looked at each other.
“Ignorant.”Dudian indifferently said. He raised his hand and suddenly threw out a black light. Puff! A dagger appeared on the middle-aged man’s throat. Blood quickly flowed out.
The middle-aged man covered his throat and looked at Dudian in disbelief. He had been focused on the girl who had killed terbury. However he didn’t expect that Dudian would personally kill her, moreover he was throwing knives to kill her!
The middle-aged man’s body struggled as he fell down. He clutched his throat as his windpipe was cut. However he wasn’t able to suffocate for a while but it was only a matter of time.
“Are you called Sword King?”Dudian’s eyes fell on the short old man: “Which do you want to choose?”
Sword King’s face was full of shock. The speed of Dudian’s throwing knife was so fast that it was difficult for him to see clearly. In other words, in addition to the girl, Dudian himself was not inferior to them! If it was just the girl alone, he was confident that with so many of them, even if they were no match, they would be able to escape. However, Dudian’s strength was also not weak. Moreover, there were five other people.., it was hard to guarantee that there wouldn’t be a master like the girl!
He slowly came back to his senses. He looked at Dudian’s cold eyes. He felt that the youth’s calm and profound eyes seemed to be able to see into the depths of his heart. He felt that there was no place to hide.
“Sword King, Let’s Join Hands!”The Night King saw that the sword king was somewhat shaken and immediately shouted.
“Noisy.”Dudian glanced at him. His figure suddenly flew out of the chair. He was like a Black Lightning. In an instant, a gust of wind swept up. His figure rushed towards Night King.
Night King’s face was full of horror. He instinctively retreated.
But the speed of his retreat was incomparable to Dudian’s. In the blink of an eye, Dudian was already in front of him. Night King didn’t see Dudian attack, but he felt a cold and bone-chilling hand on his throat. He was almost suffocated.
“In front of them, you are the king.”Dudian pinched Night King’s throat and lifted his body. His tone was cold: “In front of me, you are nothing.”
Night King looked at him in fear. He had never thought that he would become so weak. He didn’t have the power to resist! However, he was a veteran. He didn’t panic at this critical moment. He pulled out the sword from his waist and cut towards Dudian’s arm.
Clang! The sword stopped halfway.
Dudian’s other hand grabbed the sword. The poisonous sharp blade cut into his palm. It made a sharp sound as if it was cut into metal.
“Stupid!”Dudian said. His fingers suddenly tightened. Kacha! His fingers pierced into the throat of the Night King and crushed his Adam’s apple. Kacha! The Night King didn’t even have time to scream, his eyes were wide open as blood dripped from the corner of his mouth. His body lost strength and his arms drooped down.
Dudian’s hand loosened and the knife fell to the ground.
Dudian threw the body of the Night King. He shook off the blood on his palm and took out his handkerchief. He wiped his palm as he walked back to his original seat. The entire process was silent, pluto and sword king who were ready to attack were stunned. They looked at the scene in disbelief.
“Why do you always feel pain after being slapped?”Dudian slowly wiped his hand, “I thought that you people would be able to reach this position because of your eyesight. I didn’t expect you to be a group of stupid mediocrity. I have the confidence to defeat you. I also have the confidence to deal with the speaker. Why do you use your life to test the strength of the enemy? is your life so cheap? Don’t you know how to cherish it?”
Everyone looked at the teenager in a daze. They had some hope in their hearts but now there was only despair. As one of the three kings the Night King was killed by Dudian in one move, he had no ability to fight back. Such power was far above them. Even if all of them attacked together it would be a waste of their lives.
“Don’t you know how to Cherish Life? It’s obvious that you are killing indiscriminately!”Shooting Wolf came back to his senses, he felt that his feelings were a bit complicated. Although he was happy that the Night King had died, but there was a person who was much more terrifying than the three kings. This person had joined the dark church, in the future, the Holy Church would suffer heavy losses.
He prayed in his heart that the Pope would notice the sudden situation and stop the attack. Otherwise, even if the great king came tonight, he would die here.
“You haven’t answered me, Sword King?”Dudian wiped his fingers and looked at sword king.
Sword King’s face was ugly. His palms were full of cold sweat. He clenched his teeth and said: “I am willing to submit to you!”His voice was very loud. He didn’t let Dudian emphasize the previous lesson.
Dudian saw that he was sensible. He nodded and pointed at another person: “What About You?”
“I’m willing to submit to you, Lord Devil!”
“I’m also willing to submit to you!”
The others didn’t wait for Dudian’s instructions and immediately took the initiative to speak.
They knew that the situation was over and resistance would only lead to destruction. It was better for them to take the initiative and show their sincerity.
“I am also willing to submit to you!”Pluto bowed respectfully.
In the blink of an eye, everyone bowed to Dudian.
Dudian looked at them and nodded: “Not bad, you have a bit of brain.”
Everyone was silent as they heard his mocking praise. They began to think about their future plans. After all, submitting to Dudian was a small matter but the dark speaker was the biggest problem.
“My lord, I don’t know what plans you have in the future. The Dark Council will be able to contact the experts from the inner wall. If the inner wall sends experts to recruit you, I’m afraid…”sword king said in a worried tone.
“You don’t need to worry about that.”Dudian indifferently said: “From today on, the 12th region of the dark church will be a whole. I don’t want to see any internal conflicts. As for the Council and the Holy Church, I will personally solve it tomorrow. I only have one request for you. Unify all the consortia, aristocrats and the rich civilians within a week.”
Everyone was startled.
Shooting Tiger’s face slightly changed as he heard Dudian’s words. He was a bit nervous as he fell into deep thought.
Pluto looked up at dudian and whispered: “My Lord, the foundation of the six consortia and all the aristocrats are spread across all the forces. I’m afraid…”
Dudian indifferently looked at him: “In terms of foundation and influence, is it as deep as the Dark Church?”
Pluto replied: “Of course not.”
“So, I only used one night to unify everyone. You have seven days to unify the six consortia. Do you think it is difficult?”Dudian coldly said.
Pluto was startled. The others’faces slightly changed.
Sword King was aware of Dudian’s thoughts: “My Lord, do you mean that we will forcibly unify the consortia?”
“All rule is forced.”Dudian indifferently said: “There is only a difference between quick and slow effect.”
Sword king asked: “What if the nobles resist?”
“Then we will use more powerful means to suppress them.”
“I know.”Sword King bowed his head and didn’t say anything more.
Dudian’s cold eyes slowly swept over the crowd, “I know that some of you are pretending to submit to me. Later on you will run to the speaker and complain about the secret. However I have to remind you that no master will like a dog that has betrayed him. Even if he doesn’t die, he may not be used in the future. So you should take care of yourself.”
Sword King and the others’faces slightly changed.
It was true that some of them had such an idea. Although Dudian’s strength was very strong but it was far from the inner wall. Moreover the Speaker had the backing of the inner wall, naturally he was the biggest backer.
“If you follow me, as long as you pay your loyalty, you will get what you didn’t dare to dream of before.”Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed, “Now, I want to ask a few things. I will reward anyone who can provide me with effective information.”
“Reward?”Everyone’s ears perked up as they looked at the teenager.
“First, who knows the Pope’s life preferences?”Dudian asked.
Everyone looked at each other. It was obvious that Dudian was preparing to deal with the Pope.
“I know.”Pluto immediately said: “According to the information I have, the Pope likes master Benny’s music. He rarely misses master Benny’s concerts.”
Dudian nodded: “This information is good. From today on you will take charge of the 12th district and be promoted to Deputy Speaker.”
Pluto was surprised: “Thank You Sir!”
The others blinked their eyes in disbelief. They couldn’t believe that they had received such a reward just for providing such information? Was he directly promoted to deputy speaker?
“The second question. Who knows the whereabouts of the genius who appeared not long ago?”
Sword king continued: “Sir, are you referring to the genius named ‘Dudian’?”
Dudian nodded: “Yes.”
“I know.”One of them said: “According to the information I got from the temple of elements, this genius has been recognized by the inner wall and has been sent to the inner wall.”
“Nonsense!”Another woman with white skin said: “The news I got is that this genius has been taken away by the inner wall. They say that he has colluded with the dark church and will be brought to the inner wall for investigation.”
“HMPH!”The person from before snorted, he said, “You don’t know about this, right? The inner wall deliberately slandered him and brought him to the inner wall. Don’t you think that if he really colluded with us, how would the inner wall know? “If they knew, how could there be no evidence? “If there was evidence, why would they bring him back for investigation? He would have been killed on the spot!”
The white woman frowned: “Then why did the inner wall do this? Wouldn’t it be a disgrace to his reputation?”
The previous person shrugged his shoulders: “How do I Know?”
“Is there anyone else who knows?”Dudian interrupted their dispute.
The others looked at each other and didn’t speak.
Dudian shook his head: “The third question. I heard that the adoptive parents of this person knew the secret of this person being brought into the inner wall. But his adoptive parents were killed. Do you know who killed them?”

chapters.title: Chapter 616
chapters.content:
Chapter 616
Everyone looked at each other in surprise.
They had never heard of such a thing. They didn’t think that Dudian would know about it. Apparently the other side’s intelligence network was more extensive than theirs. It had infiltrated deeper into the inner wall!
Everyone was secretly apprehensive. They felt that it was very likely that Dudian would solve the problem of the dark speaker. Moreover Dudian’s strength had far surpassed the level of a hunter. If he didn’t have a background in the inner wall then he wouldn’t have such a powerful strength.
It must be known that only the inner wall had God’s marrow. Although they could exchange it through secret channels but the price was expensive and the amount was small. It would take a long time to accumulate enough to help people break through the hunter’s limit.
Dudian squinted his eyes as he asked the question. His wide vision was able to notice everyone at the same time.
Pluto was startled as he heard the third question. He was surprised because of the intelligence of the cold youth. He had always thought that he was the only one who knew about the information of Dudian’s adoptive parents. After all, the area where the genius lived was not far from his jurisdiction.
He had noticed the genius when he became famous. Later on, he sent people to secretly pay attention to him. From the time his adoptive mother secretly entered his castle with the medical box, he knew that the genius was suffering from some kind of disease. Moreover, it was a disease that could not be known by others!
“Secret”was usually a person’s weakness. It was the best weapon that could be used!
This was a great piece of good news for him. He could use this to make Dudian join him.
Unfortunately, he didn’t dig out the information from the woman’s mouth during the torture. When he was ready to blackmail Dudian, Dudian was taken away by the inner wall. But he didn’t expect that he wasn’t the only one who knew about this.
He secretly glanced at Dudian. Suddenly, he thought of something that he had overlooked.
He had chosen to let the news of the death of Dudian’s adoptive parents be published in the newspaper. The purpose was to let the new elder of District 9 know about it. The purpose of letting him know about the death was to verify whether he was the genius sent by the monastery. After all, it was the monastery that took Dudian away, he knew a little about the way of doing things in the monastery.
“Could it be…”he was surprised. He looked up at Dudian but saw that Dudian was also staring at him. It seemed that his eyes were directed at the depths of his heart, all his secrets were exposed.
His heart tightened. He bowed his head with a smile. His palms were sweating.
“No, no, I must have made a mistake.”Pluto thought: “That kid’s talent is extraordinary. He can’t be compared to this person. Even with the resources of the monastery he can only reach the same level as me. It is impossible for him to be so ridiculously strong. He can easily kill Night King who is a top-notch hunter. This is at least the level of a high-level limit. I should be overthinking.”
His heart gradually relaxed as he thought of Dudian’s previous two questions, “The Pope’s life preference should be to defeat the dark church and start a war with the pope. I guess he wants to get this person. After all, the power of this genius is too great. He can defeat the Barbarians by himself. He only needs to create one legendary item to match the combat power of ten or more senior hunters.”
He was completely relaxed as he thought of this. He was about to report to Dudian but he was stunned. The next moment his pupils contracted and the hairs on his body stood up.
“No!”His heart was shocked, “Why did he ask who killed the kid’s foster parents?”? His goal was to find out the information his foster parents had. Why didn’t he ask the person who killed his foster parents if they knew the news from their mouth? “Isn’t that the most important thing?”
His heart pounded wildly, but he quickly thought, “Maybe I’m overthinking it? He just wants to ask who killed his adoptive parents first, and then ask if he knows anything?”
Thinking of this possibility, he hesitated. His heart was uncertain, and his intuition told him that there was something strange about this. He pondered for a moment but chose to remain silent. He thought that he was already the vice-chairman so there was no need for him to take the credit. He didn’t want to be envied by others. Moreover if he was that kid then he would be dead!
“What? No one knows?”Dudian narrowed his eyes as he saw that no one answered.
Everyone looked at each other but no one spoke.
“Who is the elder of the fourth region?”Dudian frowned.
A middle-aged man who was covered in a black robe said: “It’s me.”
Dudian stared at him: “As far as I know, the place where they died is in your jurisdiction right?”
“Yes.”The middle-aged man said in embarrassment: “But I really didn’t pay attention to such a small figure. Who would have thought that they would know the news of the genius? If I had known earlier, I would have kidnapped them and tortured them.”
Dudian stared at him for a long time. He squinted his eyes and looked at Pluto: “What About You? Do you know anything?”
Pluto’s heart tightened: “Your Excellency, I haven’t paid attention to these small figures.”
“Really?”Dudian stared at him.
Pluto’s heart beat faster as he looked at Dudian’s threatening eyes. It seemed that his thoughts had been read. However, he had been in a high position for many years so his reaction was fast. He bowed his head and respectfully said: “Lord, I really don’t know. But I will go back and investigate this matter. I must find out the cause of their death!”
“Cause of Death?”Dudian narrowed his eyes: “Don’t you know?”
Pluto’s heart beat faster. He clenched his palm and looked up at Dudian with an innocent expression, “Lord, I really don’t know. Although I wanted to use the adoptive parents of the genius to threaten him and help the dark church to create the Divine Arts. But later on I thought that they were just adoptive parents after all. As far as I know, the genius was forced to go to the scavengers training camp not long after he was adopted by his adoptive parents. So they didn’t do that.”
“If we fail, we will be exposed and attract the attention of other forces.”
The others nodded as they heard Dudian’s words. They had similar thoughts but they had given up because of the same reason. After all, the halo of the genius was too strong, moreover, he was conferred by the Knight’s Hall. It could be said that his future was bright. It was unrealistic for him to give up his halo and join the dark church for the sake of his foster parents.
Dudian looked at him. After a moment he slowly retracted his eyes. He looked at Pluto: “Did you kill them?”
Pluto’s heart contracted as cold sweat broke out from his body. He felt that he was completely seen through by Dudian. After all, lying was something that made people feel guilty, although he was experienced enough to lie without changing his face. But this matter was related to his life and death. Dudian had exposed it in front of him. It was a kind of shock!
The next second, he reacted and said with a bitter face: “Elder, I really didn’t kill him. If I killed him, I will certainly report it to you. Please believe in my loyalty!”
Dudian looked at him for a moment and calmly said: “I believe it. It was just a joke. Don’t take it to heart.”
Pluto was about to curse in his heart: “Joke? Who is joking with you?”Although he was angry but he was sure that the person in front of him was the genius Dean!
Moreover from the time when he was appointed as the elder of the 9th region to the time when Dudian was brought into the inner wall he was almost 100% sure!
He was shocked as he thought of this. He didn’t think that a genius would grow to such a terrifying level. Especially his strength was even more terrifying than his attainments in the field of divine arts! However, he admired himself. Fortunately his reaction was fast enough. Otherwise he would have been killed!
“But why did he ask about me? Is there something about me that has been exposed?”Pluto calmed down, he decided that the first thing he would do after he went back was to silence all the people who knew about this matter, including his trusted secretary.
“That’s all for today. Everyone, please disperse. From now on, the twelve districts will not be ranked. We just need to do our jobs.”Dudian indifferently said.
Everyone looked at each other and respectfully said: “Your subordinate will take his leave.”
Dudian said to sword king: “Go and talk to the people above. Don’t make too much noise.”
Sword king immediately said: “Yes, your subordinate will go.”He jumped and climbed up the wall of the hall with his bare hands. He quickly jumped into the hole in the dome to communicate with the senior members of the Phelan family who had gathered outside.
Dudian quietly sat on the chair. His fingers gently rubbed as if he was thinking about something.
The rest of the people took their leave with Dudian. They turned around and left the hall.
Pluto didn’t dare to fall behind. He looked at dudian: “Your subordinate will take his leave too.”
Dudian’s eyes were still focused on the table. His expression didn’t change as he slowly said: “You stay first. As the deputy speaker I have something to tell you.”
Pluto was startled as he respectfully replied: “Yes.”
After a moment, the rest of the people left.
There were only Dudian and the others in the broken hall as well as the ten people under Pluto.
The cold wind blew into the hole in the dome and blew the dust on the ground. The air was silent.
Pluto looked at Dudian who was in a trance. He was a bit nervous. He wanted to speak but was afraid of being disturbed so he held back.
After a long time Dudian slowly recovered. He looked at Hades: “Come with me. I will take you to a place.”
Hades replied respectfully: “Yes.”
Dudian jumped up and went straight to the edge of the hole in the dome of the hall. He raised his hand and snapped his fingers. A slender figure jumped up from the hall and stood quietly by his side.
Dudian held her hand and slowly walked forward.
The soldiers of the FELAN family had retreated. There was no one around them. There was only blood left on the ground.
Sergei and Pluto arrived at the entrance of the FELAN family. Dudian got into the carriage and ordered to leave.
Hades also got into his own carriage. He led his guards and followed behind Dudian’s carriage.
The night was cold and silent.
It was past the curfew and there was no one on the street. There were only patrolling soldiers and noble carriages that occasionally passed by.
Dudian’s carriage gradually came to a suburb. It was getting further and further away from the bustling streets.
Hades’face slightly changed as he saw the remote section of the road. He didn’t know where Dudian was taking him. Was it his secret stronghold?
Two hours later, the carriage stopped in front of a forest.
Sergei, Glenn, Gwyneth and others looked around in confusion. They didn’t know where this place was. They had never heard Dudian mention it before.
Gabriel said to the carriage behind the curtain: “Master, this is the place you mentioned.”
Dudian lifted the curtain and looked at it. There was deep pain in his eyes. He slowly got out of the carriage and said to Pluto: “Come Down.”
Pluto had been paying attention to the situation all the way. He saw the strange and remote open place. He was more confused. At the same time he had a sense of danger. His intuition told him that he should run away immediately, but he thought of Dudian’s amazing speed and strength. He resisted the impulse and got off the carriage. He respectfully asked Dudian: “Adult, what is this place?”
“This is the cemetery of my foster parents, Jura and gray. They adopted another child.”Dudian slowly said. His voice was emotionless and cold like the wind.
Pluto heard Dudian’s words. His pupils contracted as he looked at Dudian in horror. He didn’t think that Dudian would admit it. Moreover… This was the cemetery of his adoptive parents? !
He turned and ran!
Dudian’s figure flashed and appeared in front of Pluto like a ghost. He said: “Where Are you going?”
Pluto quickly stopped his body. At the same time he quickly pulled out the dagger from his waist and stabbed towards Dudian’s throat.
Dudian grabbed Pluto’s wrist and gently twisted it. The sound of bones breaking was heard as Pluto’s wrist was bent in a ninety degree position.
Pluto was in extreme pain but he didn’t care so much at the critical moment of life and death. He quickly punched and spat out an object.
Dudian’s head tilted as if he had expected this. He dodged the small black object that shot out from his mouth. He grabbed his fist and twisted it again. The hand was broken.
Dudian pinched his hands and indifferently looked at him: “Are you puzzled? Why do I know that you killed him?”
Pluto’s face was red from the pain. He trembled: “It wasn’t me. I didn’t kill your adoptive parents. It wasn’t me. I can help you find the murderer. Please let me go!”

chapters.title: Chapter 617
chapters.content:
Chapter 617
“Did you hear their pleas when you killed them?”Dudian’s tone was slow. His hand gradually tightened as he spoke. The pain continued to spread throughout his body. The bones of his broken wrist seemed to be crushed bit by bit, he was covered in cold sweat.
“Sir, sir, I really didn’t. Please don’t believe the slander of a villain. Please believe me!”Pluto looked up with a sincere expression as he pleaded.
At the same time, Pluto’s men reacted and rushed over.
Sergei, Glenn and the others didn’t sit and watch. They quickly came up to them. The sound of weapons clashing echoed around them.
“When I asked the third question, only two people reacted.”Dudian slowly said: “The other person’s reaction wasn’t as frequent as yours. Your mental activity is constantly changing. I forgot to tell you that one of my magic marks ability is perspective! I can see your heartbeat, the peristalsis of your stomach, including the flow of blood!”
Perspective? Pluto was stunned. Such a top-level visual ability actually appeared in Dudian’s body?
His heart suddenly fell into a deep valley filled with despair.
But he didn’t want to accept his fate, he begged: “Sir, I admit that I had a lot of thoughts at the time. But isn’t it too hasty to judge that I killed your adoptive parents? “I just thought of other things, so I had a big reaction. But it has nothing to do with your foster parents. I really didn’t kill them. You are looking for the wrong person to seek revenge. You will only let the real murderer Go!”
“I would rather kill the wrong person than miss it.”Dudian indifferently said: “Moreover, you are the evidence of the murderer. There is more than this. The reason why I didn’t kill you right now is because you have one thing to do.”
Pluto felt that he had grasped a ray of light: “Sir, you really can’t kill me. You have just promoted me to vice-chairman. If you kill me right now, it will be a scandal!”
“Vice-chairman, I can promote you at any time. There is no need to pay attention to the scandal.”Dudian said, the two hands of Pluto were completely broken. There was a pig-like scream from the side of the forest. Even a strong person like Pluto couldn’t bear the pain of having his wrist broken.
“Use this matter to tell them that any position in power is in my joy and anger. It is in my words!”Dudian grabbed the shoulder of the underworld king and carried him into the forest.
Whoosh!
The three attendants who were fighting with Sergei saw the opportunity and immediately rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian didn’t even look at them. He raised his hand and hit the man’s chest. The man was sent flying and hit another attendant.
“Try to keep him alive.”Dudian said as he carried Hades into the forest.
The sound of insects and the rustling of leaves echoed in the dark forest. It seemed that countless ghosts were running in the forest.
Dudian’s face didn’t change. He carried Hades whose hands were crippled and went to an empty space in the forest. There was a small mound on the ground. There was no tombstone sign on it. He threw Hades in front of the mound: “Kneel down.”
Hades clenched his teeth in pain. He used his knees and shoulders to support himself. His heart turned cold when he heard Dudian’s words. He knew what he wanted him to do. He laughed bitterly. He didn’t expect that he would be reduced to such a miserable situation. He had to kneel down to a few ants. Even if he knelt down he wouldn’t be able to exchange his life.
He clenched his teeth and slowly stood up, he said: “Even if I die, I won’t kneel down to die! Yes, I killed your foster parents. I sent people to kill them. Not only did I get people to kill them, but I also tortured them to death. Didn’t you see their death? How miserable it was! Hahaha… you were able to hold back your revenge. In the end, your feelings for them were nothing more than that…”
Dudian’s voice suddenly stopped as he kneeled down.
Dudian’s kick hit the back of his knee.
Pluto’s eyes turned red as he growled and tried to stand up again.
Dudian’s palm pressed on his shoulder as if a huge mountain was pressing down on him.
“Kowtow!”Dudian indifferently said.
Pluto growled: “Don’t even think about it…”his body bent down and his head hit the ground.
Dudian pressed on the back of his head and pressed on the soil in front of the small mound.
“Kowtow Again!”Dudian grabbed his head and pulled it up. He didn’t wait for Pluto’s eyes to see the front before he was pressed down again. The rough sand grains hit his forehead, it was as painful as a needle.
“Again.”Dudian pulled his hair up again and hit him again. At the same time he slowly knelt down and pressed Pluto’s head on the ground, dudian whispered to the small dirt bag: “Aunt Jura, Uncle Gray, I brought the murderer who killed you. Do you see him? He is giving you repentance. He is making an apology…”
“Don’t even think about it…”Pluto roared.
