Dudian’s palm pressed against the dirt. He couldn’t open his mouth.
“Unfortunately, I was too late.”Dudian looked at the small dirt bag. There was a trace of loneliness in his indifferent eyes, “You should be living a normal life and be happy until you grow old. But because of me, although I let you live a good life for a few days, you have paid too much. The most useless thing in the world is to apologize. Nothing can be changed…”
The King of Hell twisted his neck as he heard Dudian’s voice. He struggled but his face was tightly pressed. He could only make a nasal sound.
“I hope you have a good journey…”Dudian looked at the small dirt bag for a moment. He slowly retracted his eyes. The palm that was holding the back of the King of Hell’s head slowly slid down and grabbed his neck.
In an instant, the struggling king’s body suddenly froze as if it was still.
“UHH… …”the next moment, there was a clear sound of bones breaking. The king’s neck was pinched like an hourglass. The sound suddenly stopped, his body gradually softened.
Dudian let go of his hand and slowly got up. He looked back and saw that the fight between Sergei and the others had ended. The four of them were brought into the forest.
“Kneel down.”Dudian calmly said.
Sergei and the others looked at the small dirt bag. They knew that this was the cemetery where Dudian’s adoptive parents died. They pushed the four of them and forced them to kneel in front of the cemetery. The four of them didn’t dare to resist and knelt down one after another.
Dudian quietly looked at them. After a long time he slowly withdrew his eyes. He gestured to Sergei and the others. Then he led Aisha and left the forest.
Sergei understood and immediately took action. Several screams echoed in the forest.
There were five figures kneeling in front of the small mound in the dark forest. It was particularly strange in the dark night.
Dudian got into the carriage after they left the forest. He looked at Gabriel who was nervous and sweating: “Are You Afraid?”
Gabriel swallowed his saliva and shook his head: “No, I’m not afraid.”
Dudian sat back in the carriage and put down the curtain.
Sergei, Glenn and the others came out from the forest and got on their horses.
Dudian’s voice came out from behind the curtain: “Let’s go to Mt. Uto.”
Sergei, Glenn and the others were surprised. Sergei said: “Master, Mt. Uto is the headquarters of the Holy Church. Are you going to deal with the Pope?”
“Do we need to pick a good day to deal with him?”Dudian asked.
Sergei continued: “Master, I don’t mean that. It’s so late now…”
“If you are tired then you can go back and rest.”
Sergei broke out in cold sweat, sergei quickly said: “Master, I mean the holy church is much more powerful than the dark church. Utoto Mountain is their headquarters. There are countless knights of light guarding it. Shouldn’t we go back and gather people?”
“To give the enemy time to breathe is to reduce your own time to breathe.”Dudian’s voice was calm. “I have a plan. Gabriel, Let’s go.”
“Yes, sir.”Gabriel was frightened, and hurried to answer a word, driving back.
Sergei and Glenn looked at each other. They didn’t think that Dudian would be so eager to do things. Did he plan to control the two most powerful forces in the outer wall in one night!
..
..
Mt. Utto, headquarters of the Radiant Church, a sacred and beautiful symbol.
The mountain is 580 meters high, the snow-white sunflowers, in the cold black snow season open bright tender, beautiful unparalleled, to the current continuous drizzle of the rainy season, but gradually withered, erosion by the rain decay.
At the foot of the mountain, the street, which could accommodate eight carriages at the same time, was the most spacious street in the outer wall. The ground was paved with snow-white stone bricks, and occasionally the stars and moonlight shone down, even at night, the entire Uto Mountain was as bright as day. It was incomparably holy.
It was three o’clock in the morning. The street was empty in the dead of night. Even the nobles who liked to hold banquets until late at night had finished their banquets at around twelve o’clock. They went back to sleep.
A carriage rolled over. The sound of horse hooves accompanied the slight shaking of the carriage. The carriage stopped in front of the square. Dudian lifted the curtain and pulled Aisha down.
“Master, are you really not going to consider it?”Sergei looked at the towering mountain in the distance. It was hard to imagine how many soldiers would be needed to attack this mountain.
Dudian looked up at the distance. After a moment he said: “You guys go back first. I will go alone.”
Sergei, Glenn and the others widened their eyes: “You will go alone? This… how can we…”
“It is useless for you to go. Go back.”Dudian said: “Show the badge of the FELAN family if you meet any patrolling soldiers.”
Their feelings were complicated. It was true that Dudian had said that they wouldn’t be of much use if they went. After all, this was the headquarters of the Holy Church, even if they had five times the number of senior hunters, they wouldn’t be able to make any waves here.
Dudian didn’t wait for their reply. He held Aisha’s hand and slowly walked along the street. His figure gradually disappeared from their sight.
There were two eight-meter-tall statues of angels at the gate. Their snow-white wings were lifelike and their feathers were exquisite. They were full of a solemn and sacred feeling. Under the statues of angels, eight knights of light guarded both sides of the huge mountain gate. At this moment, the night was dark, and one could only hear the chirping of insects from the bushes in the distance, as well as the cooing of unknown frogs. Such sounds did not stop for a long time.
Although the eight knights had slept during the day, they still felt sleepy. Four of them had already surrounded each other and were sitting on the ground, drinking and chatting.
Whoosh!
A breeze passed by from afar.
One of the people who raised his head to drink heard the movement and turned his head to take a look. However, he saw a cloud floating over, blocking the Starlight and moonlight. It was pitch-black in the distance, and he could barely see a gray grassland.
A moment later, the cloud and fog were blown away by the wind, revealing the carefully trimmed grassland. There was nothing on the grassland.
“What’s wrong, Old Lei?”Another person asked in surprise.
Old Lei rubbed his eyes and shook his head. “Nothing. I was wrong. I thought someone had just passed by.”
“Old Lei, you must have drunk too much. who dares to come to our place in the middle of the night? Do you want to attack us at night?”
“That’s right. Even those dirty B * stards of the dark church never dared to attack the headquarters of the Holy Church of light. You must have drunk too much!”
On the top of Mount Uto, in St. Mark’s Square, the white jade-like ground was incomparably white. Under the Starlight, it was bright and white. There were knights guarding the square. Their posture was straight, and they were as still as stone statues.
In the temple of light above the square, there were oil lamps hanging on the pillars of the temple. The price of each oil lamp was the income of a commoner for half of his life. The incandescent flames lit up all parts of the temple, there was no darkness.
Richelieu lay on the bed behind the statue of the god of light and fell asleep. Ever since he became the Pope thirty years ago, he had moved here and slept with his back against the statue every day. The lamplight shone on his snow-white beard and hair, emitting a brilliant light.
Suddenly, a gust of cold wind blew from outside the window. One of the windows had opened unknowingly.
A gray figure quietly and slowly came to the front of his bed and knelt down.
Richelieu, who was in a deep sleep, slowly opened his eyes but did not get up. His voice was extremely cold as he asked, “What is it?”
If someone heard his tone at this moment, they would definitely be extremely shocked. This was completely different from his usually gentle and jade-like tone. It was as if he was a different person.
“Sir, something has happened to the Fei Lan clan.”The grey figure knelt on the ground and pressed his palm on his chest, he lowered his head and said, “According to the news, someone has forcefully barged into the Fei Lan clan and taken control of the twelve elders who are holding a meeting of the elders tonight.”

chapters.title: Chapter 618
chapters.content:
Chapter 618
“Oh?”Richelieu raised his eyebrows and slowly sat up from the bed. “Controlling twelve elders? When did our outer wall region produce such a powerful figure?”
The gray figure lowered his head and said, “According to the Fei Lan family’s spies, this person seems to be the previous elder of the Ninth Division.”
“It’s him?”A trace of surprise appeared in Richelieu’s eyes. Others might not know the identity of this previous elder of the ninth division, but he knew it clearly. That little fellow had gone missing for less than a few months, and he actually had such ability?
“Tell me the situation in detail. Among the twelve elders, is there any insider of his?”Richelieu’s expression was solemn as he stared at him.
The gray figure was just about to speak when suddenly a gust of cold wind blew in from the slightly open window, causing the soft muslin curtains in the hall to flutter slightly. At the same time, a voice that was as indifferent as the cold wind rang out, “Pope wants to know the situation at that time. Why Don’t you ask me?”
Both of them were surprised. They turned their head and saw two figures standing quietly outside the soft muslin curtain. It seemed that they had been standing there for a long time.
“Be careful!”The gray figure quickly reacted after seeing the two of them. Cold Lightning flashed in his eyes. He pulled out the dagger from his waist and hid it behind his back with one hand, he suddenly stabbed out when he was close to his body.
Dudian’s expression was indifferent. He raised his hand and grabbed at the gray figure. He said to Richelieu: “Pope, if you don’t want to face the power of the pioneers then it is best for you not to make a sound. I don’t want to kill you for the time being.”His voice was calm, his palm was like lightning as he grabbed the gray figure’s wrist.
The gray figure shook his wrist and suddenly threw out a dagger. At the same time, his other hand suddenly slapped toward Dudian’s face.
Dudian’s eyebrows twitched. He didn’t expect that this person’s skill was not bad. He was far better than other senior hunters he had met. However, the rapid change of the moment was still hard to escape from the vision. He turned his wrist, the force shook off the palm that he had slapped away. At the same time, two fingers came together and stabbed out like a sword.
Puff! The gray figure couldn’t Dodge in time. His throat was pierced by Dudian’s two fingers.
The fight ended at the same time. His fingers touched the gray figure’s warm blood and tissue. He mercilessly pulled out the tissue from the depths of his throat and hit his chin with the back of his hand, he overthrew the gray figure.
The gray figure stared at him in a daze. His eyes were full of disbelief and shock. His body fell down like a falling barrier. Richelieu’s face was full of shock.
Richelieu wanted to shout for help when he saw Dudian appear. However the word ‘pioneer’in Dudian’s words made him swallow the cry for help.
If Dudian used other words to threaten him then he wouldn’t care about it. But the existence of ‘Pioneers’was high-level news in the inner wall. Almost no one knew about it in the outer wall, even the name of the existence of hunters wasn’t known to many people, let alone the top pioneers!
The weight of these three words in his heart had gone deep into his bones. It was the same as the civilians who would subconsciously lower their voice when they heard the nobles. It was the fear and awe of the long-term rule!
By the time he reacted, he saw the gray figure had fallen down. The smell of blood permeated in the hall.
He looked at Dudian in a daze. He couldn’t believe that the young man was a civilian who didn’t have any background!
Dudian saw that Richelieu didn’t shout: “You are smart.”
Richelieu’s face turned gloomy as he stared at Dudian. At the same time he looked at the slim figure behind him. He felt that the silent figure was more dangerous.
“What do you want to Do? If I remember correctly I didn’t offend you. Do you want to kill me and become the Pope?”Richelieu narrowed his eyes.
Dudian shook off the sticky blood on his fingers: “I don’t need to kill you. But you have to cooperate with me.”
Richelieu’s eyes flashed with a cold light. His wrinkled face was gloomy as he said: “You should take off your mask and we will talk about it. Mr. Dean.”
“Alright.”Dudian raised his hand and pinched his face. He quickly pulled out a thin film and revealed his original appearance. He didn’t care about his appearance being exposed, “Since the Pope knows about the dark church, he should be able to guess the reason why I came here.”
Richelieu’s face was gloomy, “If I’m not wrong, you are crazy!”! “Do you know what you are doing? You control the dark church and want to control the underground forces in the outer wall. You are courting death. I believe that the monastery will soon get the news and send out strong people to suppress you. Even if you have the support of the Pioneers, you won’t be able to defeat the monastery!”
Dudian had some guesses when he spoke about the pioneers. Dudian’s original physique had disappeared for a few months but now he had such powerful strength, it was not strange that he had resources from the giant of the pioneers behind him. The only strange thing was why did the giant of the pioneers do this? Did he want to use him as a chess piece to declare war against the monastery?
His mind was filled with thoughts and speculations.
“If my enemies are like you and are in danger, I think I would be very touched.”Dudian’s expression was calm as he looked around, he slowly led Aisha to a chair and sat down: “Since you are so enthusiastic, why don’t you pass your position to me?”
Richelieu saw that Dudian was fearless and his face sank: “My position? Don’t tell me that you want to be Pope as well as the Dark Church?”
“What’s the difference?”Dudian asked.
Richelieu was a bit stifled, he suppressed his anger: “I advise you not to think too much. The position of Pope is not something that I can pass on to anyone. Even if I am willing to pass the position to you, but with your identity and your resume, how can you assume the status of Pope? The church will not accept you. The elders will not accept you. The civilians and nobles will not accept you! Not everyone can sit in the position of Pope.”
“I know.”Dudian indifferently said: “So I have another candidate. This person is someone from your holy church. You just need to pass on the position to him.”
Richelieu was surprised: “Who is it?”
“Are you willing to give up your position?”Dudian didn’t answer but asked.
Richelieu’s face was ugly. He didn’t expect that there would be a spy under his nose. Moreover he was bought over by an unknown kid. It was a disgrace! He slowly clenched his fingers and took a deep breath: “Can you tell me why you are doing this? Is it because you were wronged and went to prison so you want to take revenge on everyone?”
“It seems that I have overestimated you.”Dudian said: “I am just doing what I want to do. As for hatred and hatred, you are not worthy of my hatred.”
Richelieu sighed, “I have seen your identity when the monastery sent you to be the elder of the ninth district. I know that you have suffered a lot along the way. However, you have come so far because the god of light is looking after you. The God of light will pay back all the wrongs you have suffered. You are still young so don’t be blinded by hatred. Hatred will pull you into the abyss of Evil.”
“Hatred will only make people miserable and blind.”There was a trace of compassion in his voice, “When you put down your hatred, you will embrace the light. You will see the world clearly. It is not as dirty as you think. The Darkness will make people blind and unable to see the future. You just need to put it down and you will be free.”
Dudian quietly looked at him: “Don’t forget that there is a strong light in addition to the darkness. Do you think it is possible to use this trick on me?”
Richelieu was startled, he bitterly said: “You are too deep in this world. If everyone is like you and is controlled by hatred, the world will be destroyed. Do you think that the world dominated by killing will be able to last for long?”? Everyone will suffer setbacks. But if you encounter setbacks then you will hate the world. In the end you will only destroy yourself. Even if you don’t believe in God, at least you have to believe in a truth — only a world of love and peace is the most perfect world, isn’t it?”
“Is it?”Dudian asked.
Richelieu stared at him: “Isn’t it?”
“No.”Dudian denied as he looked at him: “Have you heard a story?”
Richelieu was startled: “Story?”
“Once there was a farmer who built a sheep pen. There were white lambs inside.”Dudian slowly said: “Every lambs lived happily and happily. Although they competed for food but they didn’t cause any casualties. So every lambs could eat delicious food. The farmer was happy to see such a situation. However, as the days passed, the lambs in the sheep pen grew bigger and fatter.”
“The gentle farmer finally raised his knife and slaughtered the lambs one by one. He sold them to the meat market.”
“Until that day came, the happy lambs realized the true fear.”
Richelieu frowned as he listened to Dudian’s story.
“The next year, the Farmer bought a group of lambs.”Dudian continued: “These lambs lived happily in the sheep pen. But one day, the wolf came. The wolf rushed into the sheep pen. All the Lambs were scared and ran out of the sheep pen to hide.”
“The farmer rushed over when he heard the news. He saw that several lambs were bitten to death and the others were scared away. He was furious and hated the wolf. The Lambs who ran away also hated the wolf because the wolf had made them lose their stable residence.”
Dudian looked up at him: “Do you hate the Wolf?”
Richelieu’s face was gloomy. He knew that Dudian was asking him to make a choice. He wasn’t choosing whether to hate or not. He was choosing where to stand!
He was silent for a long time: “Have you ever thought that even if these lambs know their final fate, they will still hate this wolf?”
“Oh?”Dudian looked at him with interest.
Richelieu said: “Because in this sheep pen, they can at least live until they are old. But if they leave the pen, they will be in danger. They might die of illness or starvation. Compared to such days, living in the sheep pen is the greatest happiness, right?”
Dudian nodded: “You are right. This is the end of the story. In the end the farmer killed the wolf and found the lamb. This is a happy story.”
Richelieu opened his mouth but didn’t know what he was going to say.
“But…”Dudian’s tone was gentle: “We are human and not lambs. There is a big difference between humans and lambs. Humans have dignity. Of course, there are many people who don’t have dignity.”
“But at least some of them have dignity. They don’t want to be lambs.”
“So in real life, not everyone will hate this wolf.”Dudian looked at him: “The existence of the dark church is like this, isn’t it?”
Richelieu’s lips moved: “You are right. But because of this, it is sad!”
“Do you also think it is sad?”
“What I said is sad. It is not that some people are willing to be lambs.”Richelieu shook his head: “But those smart lambs who think that they have seen the world outside the sheep pen and predicted the farmer’s behavior! They know their own ending so they don’t want to behave themselves. They like to cause trouble. But in the end they are just a sheep. Even if they are angry and irritable, what can they do? They will only hurt their own kind but not the farmer.”
“Therefore, the smarter the person, the more dangerous, the more rational, and the more cold-blooded. When dealing with smart people, don’t share your heart.”
Dudian slowly nodded: “You are right. The world is in the hands of smart people and will be destroyed by smart people. However, if you want to not be destroyed then you have to be the smart one.”
Richelieu said: “Your idea is no different from those smart lambs.”
Dudian was silent for a long time before he slowly said: “If I accept my fate then there is no hope. If I don’t try how will I know that my horn won’t pierce the farmer’s neck?”
Richelieu looked at him: “But have you thought about how many of your kind will be hurt?”
“There are only two kinds of people in this world. Those who accept their fate are one kind and those who don’t accept their fate are one kind.”Dudian coldly looked at him, “Every chess piece on the chessboard has the effect of killing the enemy. In that case, you should be prepared to be killed.”
“You are completely blinded by the darkness.”Richelieu sighed, “Hatred will only lead to destruction. Your current actions are just like that. Even if you have gained the authority of the radiant church and the cult of Shadows, what can you do? “You have broken the stable order of the monastery governing the outer wall region, and you have also broken the rules of the various factions in the inner wall region. Do you know how serious the consequences of breaking the rules are? You are rebelling against all the citizens of the giant wall of Sylvia! ”
“You have broken your own rules. It is called perfection and modification. Other people have broken these rules. It is called Rebellion.”Dudian slowly said: “You don’t have to scare me with all the people of the giant wall of Sylvia. I have seen a vast world that you have never seen before. If you want to say that I am rebelling then do you choose to submit or to be honest and unyielding?”

chapters.title: Chapter 619
chapters.content:
Chapter 619
Richelieu was silent, he whispered: “What you said makes sense. But have you ever thought about how many people lost their lives because of you when you broke the rules? Don’t you feel guilty? They are ordinary people like you. Just like you in the past. But now they have lost their lives because of you!”
“You should tell your superiors about this.”Dudian said: “Aren’t they advocating universal love? In that case, I am willing to exchange positions with them.”
“You!”Richelieu was speechless.
Dudian said: “Tell Me, which path do you choose?”
Richelieu looked at him: “Can we talk before I choose?”
“Yes.”Dudian didn’t think much and agreed.
Richelieu was relieved. It seemed that he was a teenager after all. However, this gave him the opportunity, he said in a deep voice: “Since you have made up your mind and don’t care about the lives of others, then you should care about your own life right? Even if you get the position of Pope and control the dark church, I guess your next step is to break through the military area of the outer wall as well as the magistrate? Do you want to rule the outer wall?” He squinted his eyes and looked at Dudian’s eyes.
Dudian didn’t dodge but calmly said: “Yes.”
Richelieu was surprised to see Dudian admit it so easily. But what was more shocking was that his guess was true. The teenager was planning to control the entire outer wall!
His mood quickly calmed down, he said in a serious tone: “You have come into contact with the monastery. You have the support of the pioneers. So you should know what kind of power the inner wall area has. In their eyes our outer wall area is just an abandoned place. It is not worth mentioning!”
“I know.”Dudian said in a calm tone: “To put it simply, the gap between the inner wall and the outer wall area is like the gap between the commercial area and the slums. I remember that the name of the slums in the commercial area is the garbage dump right?”? “The outer wall in the eyes of the inner wall is naturally the same.”
“Since you know…”
“Don’t forget where I come from.”Dudian interrupted him, “I come from the garbage dump but I have made all the rich people in the commercial district look up to me. I have made all the rich people want to be respected by the aristocrats! I have once broken the barrier between the slums and the commercial district. I can once again break the wall of sighs that separates the inner wall and the outer wall!”
Richelieu was stunned.
He suddenly thought of the incredible miracles that this youth had created time and time again. He also thought of the youth’s background, a lowly, humble pauper, and a child abandoned by the paupers, but it was such a person who lived in the mud that stood in front of him, above the clouds.
The truth was in front of him, and he could not deny it. After a moment, he thought of a new wording, slowly he said: “I know that you are outstanding but your action this time is too reckless. It’s like you are in the slums. You Don’t have any noble status in the commercial district but you want to gather all the poor to oppose the rich nobles in the commercial district. What do you think the result will be?”
“You are right.”Dudian calmly said: “But if the power of the poor can destroy the military in the commercial district, what do you think the result will be?”
Richelieu was stunned as he heard the last question. The next moment he woke up. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes. Was it possible that there was more than one pioneer behind the youth? Was it a major force in the inner wall who was ready to fight against the monastery?
He felt a sense of crisis as he thought of this.
“You should feel lucky.”
“Lucky?”Richelieu frowned.
Dudian said: “I usually act more than I speak. But Tonight, I didn’t kill you or enslave you. I talked with you for so long. Can You Guess the reason?”
Richelieu’s face slightly changed, he stared at dudian: “Because you know that if you kill me, you will not be able to get the position of Pope. The elders of the Holy See will immediately recommend a new pope. They will recommend the pope according to his seniority, contribution, reputation and other ranking. You may not have the advantage in these conditions. So you must keep my life so that I can give up the position to him!”
Dudian didn’t deny or agree: “What else?”
“You want to get some information from me.”Richelieu narrowed his eyes: “You are not in a hurry to kill me because of the monastery.”
Dudian nodded: “This is good.”
Richelieu’s heart shivered. Didn’t Dudian’s words mean that he had denied the first point? If he had denied it then it meant that the person who was Dudian’s insider had a very high reputation and contribution in the Holy See?
He thought of a few names but at the same time another idea popped up in his mind. Maybe it was Dudian’s smokescreen. He couldn’t easily alienate him!
“Anything else?”Dudian continued.
Richelieu raised his eyebrows: “Anything else?”
Dudian shook his head: “It seems you are really old.”
Richelieu’s face sank: “Can you tell me directly?”
Dudian raised a finger: “The main reason is that I need your loyalty.”
“Loyalty?”Richelieu was stunned as he looked at dudian in disbelief: “Do you want me to be loyal to you? !”
“Yes, I want you to be loyal to me.”
Richelieu originally thought that Dudian was talking about abdicating the throne and not going against him. He didn’t expect that Dudian would want to recruit him as one of the two masters of the Holy See, he was just a 20-year-old kid.
“You are not worthy of my loyalty!”Richelieu’s face was gloomy: “I can consider if you just want to get the position of Pope. But to make me submit to you is simply wishful thinking!”
“You can be the dog of the monastery. Why Can’t You Be My Dog?”Dudian looked at him as if it was a matter of course.
Richelieu’s face turned gloomy, “Even if the monastery treats me, they won’t dare to be so impudent! Don’t think that you are holding me hostage. I don’t want to attack but I don’t want to expose my strength. But you have really angered me!” Richelieu’s back slightly straightened as his spine creaked. His body emitted a strong aura. It seemed that he was no longer a gentle old man wearing a magnificent pope robe but a bloody king of slaughter!
Dudian wasn’t surprised at all. His expression was very calm, “Of course I know. As the Speaker of the Dark Church, how can you suppress those little bad guys who don’t obey the law? If I’m not wrong, your strength should have reached the limit of a high-level limit right?”? “He should be stronger than the monastery expected.”
Richelieu was surprised as he didn’t expect Dudian to see through his trump card. Obviously the teenager had strong perception! He snorted in his heart. The stronger his perception was, the weaker Dudian’s combat ability would be. He had used his strongest strength.
“Since you know, I can’t keep you.”Richelieu’s feet moved as he was about to step out.
Dudian suddenly said: “Wait.”
Richelieu’s figure paused as he coldly looked at him: “Beg for mercy? Or…”
“Don’t talk. Let Me Think.”Dudian interrupted him, he frowned as he whispered: “There should be a gap between advanced limit and pioneer. One move shouldn’t be able to kill him…”he frowned as he spoke.
Richelieu thought that Dudian would say something. He was angry and scared as Dudian’s attitude was too calm. However.., it was impossible for anyone to kill him in one move. He was sure that Dudian’s strength wouldn’t be that of a pioneer. After all, even if he was as strong as a big force in the inner wall.., although he could mass cultivate hunters and even borderline. But it wasn’t a matter of a day to cultivate a pioneer.
The masked woman next to him didn’t look like one.
If she was the pioneer behind Dudian then it wouldn’t be Dudian’s turn to talk to him. Moreover from the position and posture of the woman it seemed that she was just a servant. Most importantly, Dudian had held her hand. If there wasn’t a special intimate relationship between them, how could a pioneer allow others to touch him?
He thought for a moment and finally eliminated the distracting thoughts. He didn’t say anything more and suddenly attacked.
He never spoke nonsense when he really needed to attack.
Whoosh!
His figure suddenly rushed out like a golden and gorgeous holy light striking toward Dudian.
At the same time as his feet exerted force, Dudian had already raised his palm. The bell on his wrist slightly shook.
The sound waves drifted into Aisha’s ears. It was as if she had suddenly woken up. Her pure black eyes revealed a ferocious and bloodthirsty look. She growled and quickly rushed towards Richelieu who was rushing towards her.

chapters.title: Chapter 620
chapters.content:
Chapter 620
A gust of wind suddenly blew in the hall, and the curtains fluttered in the wind. Suddenly, a bolt of purple lightning struck the Golden Light, and with a bang, the golden light dissipated, revealing Richelieu’s figure. His face was filled with shock, his shoulders were held by two fair and slender arms, and his fingernail-sharp palms pierced deeply into his gorgeous robe that was inlaid with gold threads, stopping his arms. The strong momentum brought his body back at high speed.
With a bang, Richelieu’s body crashed into the metal pillar at the edge of the bed behind him. The entire pillar instantly caved in, and his back was fiercely pressed against it, completely suppressed.
Roar!
A low roar that was like that of a ferocious beast pounced on him. Richelieu only saw a pair of pure black eyes that were filled with malevolence approaching him with a threatening chill, as if they would be swallowed by an unknown power in the next moment.
“No!”His mind instantly sank into despair. He could only watch in horror. Everything had happened too quickly. He was caught off guard and did not have the time to react.
Ding Dong!
The faint sound of a metal bell could be heard.
The shocking oppressive aura came to an abrupt end and returned to normal. However, only the piercing pain on his shoulder made Richelieu wake up in an instant. His first reaction was to immediately attack, he used his greatest strength to repel the figure in front of him who brought about a terrifying shadow. However, when he raised his arm slightly, he felt an indescribable sharp pain coming from his arm. It was like a cramp, causing him to lose consciousness in an instant.
His raised arm immediately froze. The pain caused his eyes to reveal a trace of unbearable pain. It was not that he could not endure the pain, but the pain on his arm was completely beyond what he could bear, the pain was ten times more intense than the pain of having his arm cut off!
Ding Dong!
The metal bell rang again, but it was different from the previous bell. This time, it shook a few times.
With a whoosh, Richelieu felt a strong wind in front of him. His whole body relaxed, and the pain in his shoulder instantly lessened. At the same time, the mysterious woman who was restraining him also withdrew. The speed at which she left was so fast that he could not see clearly, it seemed that her body temperature had been taken away. He felt an indescribable chill and throb.
When he anxiously looked at her, he saw that the mysterious woman had returned to Dudian’s side. She was like a servant and a close friend. She quietly stood by the side of the youth without making a sound, it seemed that she had been standing there the whole time.
Richelieu’s arm had returned to normal. The strange and twisted pain had returned to normal. He was able to endure it so he didn’t feel any pain. He was shocked as he looked at the youth, the mysterious woman next to him was shocked to the extreme. He didn’t expect that this woman who was silent like a killer would have such terrifying strength!
She had completely suppressed him with just one move!
Moreover… if she didn’t retreat in time, he felt that he might have died.
This was a power that completely surpassed his imagination. Just the most basic speed and strength was enough to make him unable to react and resist!
“President, can we talk about this?”Dudian indifferently looked at him.
Richelieu gradually recovered after hearing Dudian’s words. There was a trace of complicated emotion in his eyes. He wasn’t in a hurry to call for help. The main reason was that he was confident in his own strength, after all, if he couldn’t defeat Dudian, no one in the outer wall would be able to deal with him.
However, the fight just now had crushed all the confidence and confidence in his heart!
“You have such strong power. What is there to talk about?”Richelieu clenched his hands and bitterly said.
Dudian indifferently said: “I am different from you. You are a respectable person. I can give you an equal opportunity to communicate with me.”
Richelieu looked up at the teenager. He saw the calm expression on the teenager’s face. Suddenly he felt an indescribable feeling, “You can defeat me and force me to do whatever you want. Why did you tell me so much?”
Dudian looked at him: “If it was someone else who asked this then it would be understandable. But Pope, isn’t it a bit strange for you to ask this question?”
Richelieu was stunned for a moment. He quickly understood the meaning behind Dudian’s words. He couldn’t help but feel a bit strange: “Do you really want me to be loyal to you?”
“Don’t you want to?”Dudian looked at him, he quietly said: “You can make people convinced by words. The power of words has always been more than a thousand swords. Unfortunately, all verbal communication needs to be based on equality of fists. It is like a theory.”
Cecil’s heart was shocked. He had to say that these words were very reasonable. At least at his age, he couldn’t say such words. The youth’s strength aside, the more frightening thing seemed to be his heart and his wisdom!
“You are really smart.”He was silent for a moment, slowly said: “It seems that we have underestimated you in the past. A person who has strength but only knows how to use strength to convince others is ultimately a boorish man. A person like you who has strength but doesn’t use it easily shows that your understanding of ‘strength’is deeper and farther than ordinary people. If this era is better, you will be able to achieve an extraordinary career!”
He was very serious because these words were his true feelings.
Dudian calmly said: “It’s too good. Since you think highly of me, then it’s time to make your choice. I hope you can make a smart choice.”
Richelieu was silent for a long time: “If I submit to you, do you dare to use me? Aren’t you afraid that I will pretend to surrender and betray you with false information?”
“I have my own methods.”Dudian indifferently replied.
Richelieu deeply looked at dudian. The youth’s confidence made him feel a bit uncertain. At the same time he felt a trace of jealousy and relief. He was jealous of the youth’s wisdom, fortunately, such a person wasn’t born in the same era as him. Otherwise his life as a pope might not be stable.
“I don’t have a choice. I’m willing to be loyal to you as long as you believe in me.”Richelieu narrowed his eyes.
“Very good.”Dudian clapped his hands but there was no smile on his face, he calmly said: “A sensible person is always cute. I will give you the first task. I need you to give the position of Pope to my trusted aides in seven days.”
Richelieu’s heart sank: “You don’t believe me?”
“I do.”Dudian said: “I believe you will listen to me.”
Richelieu was speechless. After a while he said: “I follow your orders. What can I get? After I give up the position, you should get rid of me right?”
“You are looking down on me.”Dudian said: “As long as the people who are loyal to me don’t betray me, they will not be betrayed by me. This is my rule!”! “In addition, if I really want to get the position of Pope, I will be able to get it even if I kill you. I just need to subdue all the elders of the council of elders and let them jointly elect one person. I believe that even if the person chosen is a nameless apprentice, he will be able to step onto the pope’s throne. Moreover, there will be no objection from the civilians.”
“After all, any experience and deeds can be molded. As long as there is a credible person to testify, it is the best evidence, right?”
Richelieu’s face slightly changed. He felt a chill in his heart. He knew that Dudian was right. If the entire council of elders was subjugated, then his existence as the Pope would be equivalent to nothing, moreover with Dudian’s strength it was possible for him to do this but it would be a bit troublesome.
“You will follow me. In the near future when my cause is completed, your position will no longer be just a small pope in the outer wall. Even if you become the dean of the monastery it might not be impossible.”Dudian said, “But before that, I will have to trouble you for a period of time. I hope you can understand and I hope you can cooperate.”
Richelieu’s face changed. He knew that once he took this step, there would be no turning back. His heart couldn’t help but feel sad and lost. Once upon a time, he stood at the highest point and looked down at the civilians and nobles in the outer wall, but now he was forced to become a vassal.
“I know.”Richelieu sighed in his heart. There was a trace of helplessness and vicissitude in his voice.
Dudian said: “You can no longer live here during the period of abdication. I will take you to a new place. All your orders and instructions will be transmitted to the Holy See.”
Richelieu was startled. He understood that Dudian was trying to prevent him from betraying the Holy See. He wanted to cut off his contact with the other members of the Holy See. It was obvious that Dudian had said that he had his own way.
“I know.”He didn’t say anything but agreed.
Dudian nodded: “Now, you are going to leave a written order. The content of the order is that you were attacked by an assassin tonight. You are seriously injured and need to concentrate on recuperating.”
“Encountered an assassin?”Richelieu heard Dudian’s words. He felt that Dudian was bold enough to report his whereabouts. He suddenly noticed the body on the ground. His face slightly changed. The ‘Assassin’that Dudian mentioned was most likely him, in this way, it could also explain the smell and body that he had left behind. At the same time, it would be a foreshadowing for the future..
As he thought of this, he felt a slight throb in his heart, and suddenly he had a feeling that he could not help himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 621
chapters.content:
Chapter 621
“I understand.”Richelieu agreed.
Dudian made a gesture to invite him. Richelieu came to his desk on the other side of the hall. He took out an edict scroll from the drawer and began to write. After a moment he finished writing the edict and handed it over to Dudian.
Dudian looked at it. It was the same as what he had told him. There was no extra content. There shouldn’t be any hidden meaning in the words. He nodded: “Alright, get ready and leave with me.”
Richelieu saw that things had come to this point. He didn’t say anything. He went to the desk and pulled out the drawer. He took out some items including a gold plated quill pen.
Dudian looked at the things that he had packed. He pointed at one of them: “What is this black box?”
“It is the box where I stored the Knight’s badge when I was promoted to captain. I have been keeping it as a souvenir.”Richelieu said.
Dudian’s eyes slowly scanned through the items in the bag. There were expensive quill pens, white paper with strange patterns, and badges with strange patterns, there were silver nails… There were all kinds of things.
He slowly looked up and quietly looked at Richelieu’s eyes: “Do you really want to take these things away?”
Richelieu’s face was bitter, “I don’t think I will come back here in the future. Although there is no practical use for these things, but they were the most precious things to me. For example, I fell into a trap when I was on a mission and was framed by my companions. The nail was shot out by him and pierced into my chest. Fortunately, there was a little deviation or I would have died. So for many years, I have been keeping this nail by my side to warn myself.”
Dudian stared into his eyes. Richelieu also stared into Dudian’s eyes. After a moment Dudian slowly retracted his eyes and nodded: “Since you want to take them away I will let you take them all.”
Richelieu looked relieved and sincerely said: “Thank you!”
Dudian didn’t say anything. He took Aisha’s hand and went to the window.
Richelieu quickly tied the bag and followed Dudian.
The night was dark.
Dudian let Richelieu lead the way down the mountain. Both of them avoided all the gaps of the guards and smoothly came to the foot of Uto Mountain. They didn’t disturb any guards along the way, it was like a no man’s land.
Richelieu didn’t take the opportunity to call for help. He knew that Dudian had given him a test when he asked him to lead the way. However, this small test wasn’t difficult for him. Moreover, he knew that even if the guards were alerted.., it would be difficult to keep Dudian. On the contrary, he would be killed immediately.
Dudian immediately took back the right to lead the way and led Richelieu along the remote street. After a few hours, Dudian and Richelieu returned to the castle by the Teza River.
Sergei, Glenn and Nicholas were stunned as they entered the castle. They looked at Pope Richelieu who was following behind dudian, they didn’t expect that the figure who could only be looked at from afar would appear in such a close place.
Dudian called Nicholas: “How is the Plantation?”
Nicholas looked at Richelieu who was behind dudian. He replied: “Master, the plantation has returned to normal. All the workers have been pacified.”
“Do you have the finished products?”Dudian asked.
Nicholas respectfully replied: “I have them. I have stored them in the warehouse as you instructed.”
Dudian nodded: “Take them out immediately.”
Nicholas was surprised. He wanted to ask: “Now?”? But he immediately replied: “Yes, Master.”He turned and left. He took a fast horse and disappeared into the night.
Richelieu frowned as he heard Dudian’s words. Planting Base? What kind of base?
Dudian called Neuss after Nicholas left, he said: “Go to the 9th region and ask Hawkeye to get two sets of decomposition equipment. One is for alchemists and the other is for pharmacists. We need the best ones.”
Neuss hesitated for a moment as he replied: “Yes, Master.”He had participated in tonight’s operation to suppress the 12th region of the dark church. He estimated that he wouldn’t be chased and killed if he returned to the 9th region.
After Neuss left, Dudian told Glenn to go to the material market to steal some materials and report to her. Glenn’s stealth ability and black weaver’s magic marks ability.., it was a waste to be a thief.
Richelieu looked at the orders issued by Dudian. He was puzzled as he felt an inexplicable crisis. The teenager seemed to be preparing for something big. Moreover he had already planned for it, including his planting base! The hateful thing was that he didn’t pay attention to the people who were related to the teenager. After he was arrested in the inner wall he didn’t pay attention to his previous underlings.
However, he couldn’t be blamed. It wasn’t that he didn’t pay attention to them but that he had paid attention to them for a period of time. However Dudian’s underlings were very well behaved which caused him to gradually relax his vigilance, he didn’t investigate further. After all, Dudian had completely become a person under his control. As for his original underlings, they were insignificant and not worth mentioning.
But who would have thought that in just a few months, the teenager not only broke away from his control, but also stepped on his body. If he was more vigilant towards the teenager and thoroughly investigated the people around him.., perhaps there wouldn’t be today’s ending.
He shook his head and sighed.
Dudian glanced at Richelieu and asked Sergei: “Is Mr. Mel Awake?”
“Yes, but he still refused to say anything.”Sergei replied.
Dudian nodded slightly: “Have the two little girls given up?”
“No, their mouths are too hard. I had sex with them in front of them but they refused to give up. They didn’t even beg for mercy.”Sergei wryly smiled.
Dudian nodded: “It means that they haven’t reached their bottom line. Don’t be merciful to them.”
Sergei scratched his head: “I’m already very rough.”
“I’m not talking about actions. I’m talking about mental torture. Do you understand?”Dudian said in a teaching tone.
Sergei understood: “I understand.”
“Go. I need to see them beg for mercy. I want to see them lose all their dignity.”Dudian coldly said.
Sergei nodded and went upstairs.
Richelieu heard Dudian’s words. His face slightly changed. He didn’t expect that Dudian was the one who massacred the Mel family! How much blood was stained in the hands of this young man?
His lips slightly moved: “The Mel family has been wiped out by you. There isn’t a single child left. Why are you torturing them?”
“Really?”Dudian glanced at him.
Richelieu was startled.
“If I remember correctly, there is a young master of Mel family. His name is Melk. He seems to be a Knight of light from Your Holy Church. He was young and promising. He wasn’t at home that night. He disappeared from your holy church. Do you know his whereabouts?”Dudian indifferently said.
Richelieu shook his head: “I haven’t paid attention to this. But if you want to check it I will send a letter back. I will give you the answer.”
“No need.”Dudian said: “Although the giant wall is big but it is not as big as the world. It is not difficult to find a person.”
Richelieu felt strange but didn’t ask any more questions.

chapters.title: Chapter 622
chapters.content:
Chapter 622
Dudian took Richelieu to his room: “It is hard to avoid suspicion with just a handwritten letter. Tomorrow Morning at seven o’clock in the morning, you will appear in the square of Martha’s Square in the Western Region.”
“I know.”Richelieu nodded slightly.
“How long do you think it will take for the inner wall to notice the movement here?”Dudian asked.
Richelieu knew that Dudian would ask this question. He knew the answer but he still pretended to think, a moment later he said: “If we go to Martha Square tomorrow we should be able to hide it for a while. There are five messengers in the holy church who are responsible for passing information to the monastery and me. Although the frequency of transmission is not high but if they know that I am injured and missing then they will report it to the monastery.”
Dudian said in a meaningful tone: “You should have said this before.”
Richelieu pretended not to understand, he continued: “Even if we hide it from the five supervisors, they will immediately inform the monastery when the news of my transmission comes out in seven days. By then the monastery will know the situation here and send people to stop it. Because the matter of the transmission has always been agreed by them. So if possible, I think it is better to postpone the transmission. I am not selfish. I have been loyal to you and stand on the same side as you. You want me to pass the throne so that you can be more at ease. But the price is too high. If you can trust me…”
“There will be changes if it is delayed.”Dudian indifferently said: “The time of transmission will not change. If it is to be changed then it will be in advance, not later.”
Richelieu was startled, he frowned: “Why is it so urgent?”? “If it is delayed for half a month then you will have more time to control the outer wall.”? “Why Are You So Nervous? If you don’t believe me then I will listen to you.”
Dudian looked at him, he calmly said: “There is an old saying called ‘speed is the most important thing in war’. We have already started a war with the monastery. Naturally we have to seize the opportunity to cut off all the limbs of the enemy before they can react. How can the enemy resist?”
Richelieu was stunned. Although he had never heard of this term but he could roughly understand it. It was very concise and concise. Indeed, if Dudian could grasp the outer wall as fast as possible.., he would have more time to deal with the monastery. If he continued to delay then he would be in chaos!
“Do you have any relatives?”Dudian casually asked as he touched the wooden carvings on the table.
Richelieu bitterly smiled: “I’m sitting in this position. How can I have any relatives?”
“That’s true…”Dudian nodded but didn’t ask further.
Richelieu was relieved to see Dudian’s reaction. He heard Dudian ask again: “Tell me the names and residences of the five supervisors.”
Richelieu’s face slightly changed: “Are you going to kill them?”
“What I do is my business. You just have to cooperate with me.”Dudian casually replied.
Richelieu was silent: “I know their names and positions are…”he immediately reported the identity of the five messengers, he also told Dudian the information.
Dudian wrote down: “Do you have any channels to get the God’s marrow in the outer wall?”
“Yes, but there aren’t many of them. Once the military of the inner wall finds out about it they will be arrested and killed!”Richelieu felt Dudian’s thoughts, “You want to use the god’s marrow to cultivate your men. It will be difficult to cultivate a warrior who can surpass the hunter in a short time. Moreover, even if you can cultivate him, the inner wall’s strength will be able to easily kill him.”
He suddenly remembered that Dudian had the support of the pioneers. was he lacking God’s marrow?
Dudian said: “Give me these channels to connect the signal and the location.”
Richelieu saw that Dudian was determined. He told him about the channels that he knew. These channels were small channels. His own channel was to apply for God’s marrow directly through the overseer and the monastery, so even if Dudian knew about these secret channels, it wouldn’t cause any loss to him.
As the two talked, the sound of horse hooves came from outside the castle. Neuss, Glenn, Nicholas and others returned to the castle one after another. Dudian took out a bottle of knockout potion from his room, it was a high-end knockout potion made by the Great Potion Master. He poured two drops to Richelieu: “Take a rest before dawn. I will call you later.”
Richelieu felt a bit dizzy as he smelled the smell coming from the bottle. He knew that Dudian wanted him to faint and do something that he didn’t want to see.
He resisted in his heart but looked at Dudian’s cold eyes. He took the bottle and fell down.
He didn’t swallow it immediately but swallowed a mouthful of saliva. He used his tongue to hide the two drops of cold liquid. At this time, Dudian patted his shoulder: “How does it taste?”
Dudian’s back straightened as if there was something stirring in his throat. He swallowed the cold liquid and almost choked.
His face turned red as he coughed.
Dudian shook his head and turned away.
Richelieu looked up at Dudian’s back. His vision was blurred. He saw seven or eight shadows of Dudian’s back. He shook his head and clenched his teeth, he tried to stay awake but his vision became more and more blurred. Finally, he couldn’t stand it anymore and fainted.
Plop.
Dudian left the room and heard the sound of Richelieu falling to the ground. He didn’t turn back but went downstairs with Aisha.
“Master, these are the mulberry leaves and other plants that you asked me to plant…”Nicholas took out a few bundles of plants and handed them to Dudian.
Dudian looked at them and saw that the quality was good. He nodded slightly and took the things. He asked Neuss to move the two pieces of equipment into his basement and began to refine them.
In the blink of an eye more than an hour had passed.
It was almost five o’clock in the morning. There was a faint light in the sky.
Dudian came out of the basement and returned to the room upstairs. At the moment Richelieu was still lying on the ground. His luxurious pope robe was in close contact with the carpet. Dudian helped him up and picked up the syringe. He wiped his wrinkled neck and injected the pale white substance into the syringe. After a while he took out another syringe and injected the pale green liquid into it.
He picked up the Teacup from the table and poured cold tea on Richelieu’s face.
Richelieu woke up in a daze. He opened his eyes but his vision was still blurry. He blinked for a moment and gradually became clear. He felt dizzy and Dizzy, at the same time, there was a sharp pain in his abdomen. He felt nauseous

chapters.title: Chapter 623
chapters.content:
Chapter 623
He hugged his stomach and started vomiting, but he couldn’t spit out anything. After a series of dry heaves, he suddenly felt countless ants and insects crawling up his throat and jumping in his throat, it was like countless insect legs were scratching his throat, Itchy and unbearable.
“Cough! Cough! Cough!”
He couldn’t help but cough.
He felt a burning pain in his chest as he coughed violently. Moreover the itching in his throat didn’t disappear. It was getting harder and harder to endure. He wanted to scratch.
“You… What did you do to me?”Richelieu looked at dudian. His face was red as he coughed. He saw that the teenager was staring at him.
“Nothing. I just let you eat something delicious.”Dudian looked at him in a calm tone.
Richelieu’s face changed as he clenched his teeth: “Why did you do this to me? Didn’t you say that you completely trust me? I didn’t betray you!”
“I also hope that I can completely trust you. Unfortunately, you have disappointed me.”Dudian indifferently said: “You should have told me about the matter of the supervisor. It is the same as forcing me to deal with them. I hope that you can remember that the trouble you have created for me will not be an opportunity for you to escape.”
Richelieu’s face turned ugly: “I didn’t mean that. It’s just that the situation was urgent. I didn’t think about it and you didn’t ask. I…”
Dudian waved his hand: “There is no need to explain. No matter if you have this idea or not, this time I will give you a warning. If you play tricks in the future, the punishment will last for a whole day!”
Cesar was angry. He clenched his fingers and slowly loosened them. He suppressed the anger in his heart. He wanted to open his mouth but the strange itch on his throat became more and more intense. His lips couldn’t help but tremble. He growled and raised his hand to strangle his throat. He pressed the Adam’s apple against his neck. This kind of pressure and friction made the strange itch ease for a moment. However, after a few seconds, the strong strange itch returned, moreover, there was a faint feeling that spread to his palm.
He hurriedly let go of his hand. He couldn’t help but twist his head. Although the posture looked very strange. With his previous image and dignity, he would never do such a self-destructive action. But at the moment, he couldn’t care about these things.
However, just twisting his neck couldn’t completely suppress the strange itchiness. He couldn’t help but raise his hand again to squeeze his throat. He even had the impulse to stab his fingers into his throat.
“Ah, ah!”He growled.
“The effect of this thing seems to be better than I expected. It seems that the radiation here is not without any benefits.”Dudian looked at his body twisting. He was surprised and satisfied at the same time, he thought that he would have to inject him a few more times to make him feel addicted. He didn’t expect that it would have such a big effect just for the first time. It was obviously due to the soil of this era, the characteristics of the mulberry leaves and other addictive plants were much stronger than those of the old era.
“Ah, ah, ah…”Richelieu desperately lowered his head and pressed his throat. He let out a strange growl. His wrinkled face was red and he was sweating profusely.
Dudian looked at the clock hanging on the wall and quietly looked at the time.
After a quarter of an hour, Richelieu finally couldn’t bear it any longer. He panted and begged dudian: “Give me the antidote. Please. I… I really didn’t betray you. I really didn’t…”
Dudian looked at Richelieu’s pleading eyes. His heart was touched. Even someone as powerful as Richelieu couldn’t resist such a small plant. He was silent for a moment. He slowly took out a small metal bottle from his pocket: “Find a piece of paper and roll up the antidote. Use Fire to light the paper. Smoke it and it will relieve the itch.”
Richelieu’s eyes turned red as he looked at the small metal bottle in his hand. He couldn’t wait to snatch it away. After hearing Dudian’s words he didn’t have any other thoughts. He turned around and looked around, he quickly found the stack of books on the table. He rushed to the desk and grabbed one of the books that he had read before. He opened the book and pulled out a few books.
Because he was too anxious, his trembling palm accidentally tore the paper into pieces.
He was so anxious that his forehead was full of sweat. He pulled out two pieces and went back to dudian: “Antidote!”
Dudian threw the small metal bottle to him.
Richelieu quickly took it and opened the bottle. He poured out the contents of the bottle. They were black and gray like smoked grass or ashes. He panted as he poured them onto the paper, he quickly rolled them up according to Dudian’s instructions. After he rolled them up he suddenly thought of the lack of flame. He looked around but didn’t see the flint or the matches that replaced the flint.
Dudian lit a match in front of him and indifferently said: “I hope you will remember this lesson.”
He was excited to see the light of dawn in the dark. There was even a trace of gratitude in his heart towards the hatred of Dudian. He completely ignored Dudian’s words, he quickly handed the rolled paper to the match and watched the match light up the paper. The flame slowly burned in front of him. He felt like he was about to be embraced by the light.
Smoke floated up from the roll. He thought of Dudian’s words and tried to bite the roll of paper.
A puff of smoke suddenly entered his lungs. He choked until tears almost flowed out. Then there was a strong nausea and a violent cough. As he coughed hard, he patted his chest and patted it. He suddenly realized that the strange itch on his throat had gradually disappeared and was no longer so painful.
“It seems that it’s the real antidote.”He secretly heaved a sigh of relief in his heart. In order to prevent the antidote from being too thorough, he took another breath and choked until tears flowed out again. The lungs on his chest burned with a burning sensation, but the burning pain was nothing compared to the unbearable itch. It was like heaven. He slowly felt his body become light and light.
“Don’t swallow it all. Use your throat to suck it and then spit it out.”Dudian instructed.
Richelieu took another breath and slowly spat it out. He felt refreshed and especially refreshed. The refreshing feeling made him a bit intoxicated.

chapters.title: Chapter 624
chapters.content:
Chapter 624
“If I Were you, I would leave some of the antidote so that I won’t make mistakes again.”Dudian indifferently said as he looked at Richelieu.
Richelieu was a bit sober after listening to Dudian’s words. However the comfortable feeling of inhaling the antidote made him reluctant to stop. He took another breath and gently exhaled, at this moment he was able to skillfully expel the excess smoke. He didn’t choke until tears flowed down his face. He couldn’t help but want to take another sip after he exhaled. He used his fingers to extinguish the burning paper but there was still a faint smoke coming out.
He felt a pity as he saw the smoke drifting away. He spat a few mouthfuls of saliva onto the paper. He put out the fire and put it into his pocket as if nothing had happened.
Dudian saw his little action and felt a sense of pity, but he didn’t show it, he said: “It’s late. You should rest first. I will send someone to call you at seven o’clock. You can sleep in my study room.”
Richelieu nodded: “I know.”
Dudian immediately got up, held Aisha’s hand and turned to leave.
Richelieu was relieved after Dudian left. He felt that he was a bit sad. His life was in the hands of others and he couldn’t control himself. He had been worried for most of his life, he didn’t expect that he would end up like this in his later years.
He sighed and sat on the chair that Dudian was sitting on. He looked up at the study room but didn’t see anything strange. It seemed that Dudian had let him sleep here, most likely there was nothing valuable in the room or his secret was hidden.
He slowly retracted his eyes and prepared to lie down on the bed. Although he didn’t plan to sleep but he wanted to pretend that he had slept so as not to arouse Dudian’s suspicion. He got up and suddenly his toes touched something. He heard the sound of rolling. He looked down and saw that it was a small metal bottle. It was exactly the same as the one that Dudian had given him.
His eyes lit up. He was about to pick it up when he thought of something. He looked up at the door and heard Dudian’s footsteps. He was relieved as he bent down to pick up the small metal bottle, he opened it and saw that the same antidote was inside.
“Is he testing me? or did he accidentally drop it?”He was worried, he quickly thought, “Let’s keep it first. If he is testing me, then I will give it to him. If he doesn’t, then it means that he really dropped it.”
He immediately put the small metal bottle into his arms. Then he turned around and went to the bed. He opened the quilt and lay on the bed.
..
… ..
Dudian came to the hall and said to Nicholas: “Ask Sergei to bring the two women.”
Nicholas replied and went upstairs. After a moment Sergei, Sarah and Sarah came downstairs. The two women’s hands were tied behind their back. Their hair was messy and their clothes were torn. There were many red marks on their shoulders. There were traces of tears on their faces, they stared at Dudian.
“You hate me but you can’t kill me. Are you angry?”Dudian looked at the two girls.
Sarah screamed and raised her hand to pounce on him. But Sergei immediately held her down. A slap hit her face and she fell to the ground. Her messy hair covered her face.
“When did you not know how to take care of women?”Dudian looked at Sergei.
Sergei said in embarrassment: “Master, you told me not to be polite to them. I don’t treat other girls like this. I love women very much.”
Dudian handed two syringes to Sergei: “Give them the syringes.”
Sergei looked at the two syringes curiously. He wanted to ask but saw Dudian’s cold face. He knew that he would encounter a problem. Sergei held back his questions and walked to the two women.
“Dudian, you bastard! !”Sarah screamed in anger: “I will not let you off! If you are a man then kill me! !”
Sergei immediately grabbed her throat and kicked Lisa’s chest. She was sent flying to the side. He picked up Sarah who looked like a chicken and said to dudian: “Is it okay to hit her?”
Dudian rolled his eyes: “Of course it will hit her blood vessels.”
Sergei let out an ‘oh’and gave a malicious smile to Sarah. He licked her shoulder. He saw the blood vessels and immediately injected the syringe into her body, he slowly injected the pale green liquid into her body.
After the injection he threw Sarah away and gave the same injection to Lisa who was struggling.
Dudian didn’t inject the chemical addictive drugs that he had developed with the decomposition equipment. He found that the effects of the chemical addictive drugs that he had made were not as good as the mulberry leaves.
“Give them one tube of this every day.”Dudian threw two small metal bottles to sergei: “There are many in the basement. You can get them after you use them.”.
Sergei couldn’t help but ask: “Master, what is this?”
Dudian frowned as he saw Sergei’s curious expression, indifferently: “Let’s call this thing ‘cigarette’. I remind you that it is best not to touch this.”Although he used this familiar name which was widely known, but this thing was completely different from the old era’s cigarette.
“Cigarette?”Sergei looked at the small bottle in his hand. He was more and more curious. But he knew that the thing that Dudian gave to the two women was definitely not a good thing.
Dudian didn’t say anything but waved his hand: “Go back.”
The few of them left.
Dudian and Nicholas were the only ones left in the empty hall. Dudian said: “You should go and rest too.”
Nicholas smiled: “Master, I am a butler. You haven’t rested. How can I Go and Rest?”
Dudian waved his hand: “Let me be alone.”
Nicholas looked at his tired face: “I understand.”He bowed and left.
Dudian rubbed his temples as he waited for Nicholas to leave. He grabbed Aisha’s hand and let her sit next to him. He felt a warm feeling in his heart as he held her cold hand, he whispered: “Wait for me. I will avenge us soon.”
Aisha’s expression was indifferent and she didn’t say anything.
Dudian raised his hand and gently stroked her hair. He looked at the darkness outside and said to himself: “You see, before the dawn, the darkness controls everything.”

chapters.title: Chapter 625
chapters.content:
Chapter 625
The first rays of dawn shone on the clock tower in Martha’s Square. Several soldiers on duty who had not slept all night were bathed in the morning light. Their bodies, which had been infected by the cold air, slowly regained some warmth and vitality. They let out a sigh of relief, they thought that in another hour, it would be time for the shift to be over at seven o’clock.
At this moment, the sound of horse hooves suddenly came. They saw more than a dozen knights in bright silver armor galloping over from the avenue outside the square. They rode all the way to the foot of the clock tower. The leading middle-aged knight reined in his horse, he raised his head and said, “Soldiers on duty, listen up. The pope will be holding a blessing ceremony here in an hour. Now, ring the Bell and pray for the rest of your lives.”
The soldiers on duty were stunned, but they immediately became happy and excited. They did not expect the pope to be here in person. This meant that they could see this great figure up close. This was simply an honor!
Dong, Dong, Dong..
The melodious prayer bell sounded. It was different from the normal morning bell. The prayer bell needed to ring eighteen times in a row.
The bell chimes came from far away from the square. The nearby residents immediately woke up from their sleep and heard the continuous bell chimes. Some of the older people had not counted them yet. Just from the duration of the bell chimes.., they could tell that it was a blessing bell. They immediately woke up their wives and children and prepared to head to the square early to grab a good seat at the front.
There was a difference between the Blessing Festival and the Blessing Festival. The Blessing Festival could be held at any time, but only the elders of the Church of light who were at the level of red bishops were qualified to hold it. It was usually held during the black snow season and when there was frequent rain disasters, to pray to the heavens and the gods to avoid plagues and disasters.
For ordinary people, being able to enjoy the blessing festival was something that they could only wish for.
As the bell rang, Knights of the Holy See used carriages to drag wood and shelves to the square to build the blessing altar. These wood and shelves were finished products, and they only needed to be assembled.
As time passed, more and more people gathered in the square. In the blink of an eye, the entire square was filled with people, bustling with noise and excitement.
“Your eminence, it’s almost time.”A young Grand Knight with a gold star on his shoulder lowered his head and said.
Ernorin nodded slightly. His gaze swept across the sea of people below the altar and said in a low voice, “Wait a little longer. Your Eminence has always been punctual.”
“Yes.”The young Grand Knight nodded respectfully.
At this moment, there was a sudden commotion outside the square, followed by a wave of excited exclamations. When ernorin heard the commotion, he immediately looked over and immediately heaved a sigh of relief. He saw an old figure dressed in luxurious golden robes slowly walking over from the commotion. He held an ancient vine scepter that symbolized authority and honor, it was Pope Richelieu!
Behind him were two knights of light. One of them had a head full of flowing golden hair. It was obvious that he was of noble birth. The other had black hair and was about thirty years old. His appearance was mediocre.
The Knights of light who were stationed outside the square immediately went forward to protect him. The crowded crowd looked at the pope in amazement, especially the people closest to him. They were so excited that they wanted to jump up on the spot, but they did not have the slightest intention of rushing over to hug him, the prestige brought by the robe and scepter made people not dare to blaspheme in the slightest.
“It’s actually the Pope!”
“It’s the Pope who is holding the blessing sacrifice. Oh My God, I see His Excellency the Pope.”
“The pope is too kind. He actually came personally to host the blessing sacrifice.”
The crowd was moved and surprised.
In the corridor where the crowd separated, Richelieu walked to the altar with two attendants.
“Greetings to the Pope.”Ernorin immediately bowed respectfully.
The young Grand Knight at the side also bowed respectfully.
Seeing this trusted confidant of his, Richelieu nodded slightly and said, “How much longer?”
Ernorin said respectfully, “Reporting to the pope, there are still five minutes left.”
“It seems that you are not late.”Richelieu smiled slightly. “Have you prepared everything? The Blessing Words and holy book.”
“Everything is ready.”Ernorin was very respectful. He raised his head and glanced at Richelieu. His gaze quickly swept over his entire body, but he did not see any signs of injury. He was slightly relieved, he said in a low voice, “Pope, I have seen the decree you left behind. I don’t know…”
“We will talk about this later.”Richelieu raised his hand and interrupted his low voice.
Ernorin came to his senses and nodded immediately. He raised his head and straightened his back. He looked at the square in front of him and waited for the countdown with the Pope.
Five minutes was neither long nor short. During the process of waiting, Ernorin suddenly noticed the two knights of light beside the pope. Their faces seemed unfamiliar, and one of them was a man with black hair, such hair color had always belonged to slaves or commoners. He did not expect that they would be in front of Richelieu.
He took a few more glances and did not see anything strange. Only then did he shift his gaze to the clock tower beside him.
The huge mechanical clock hanging on the clock tower slowly counted down. Finally, it was seven o’clock.
The bell rang, and the blessing ceremony officially began.
Richelieu took the blessing words and the holy book from Ernorin. His expression was solemn as he began to read the solemn opening words according to the flow. Next was the blessing words. It was not a simple sentence but a very long blessing words, it was a blessing from the Bible.
Dudian stood behind Richelieu as he silently looked at the square in front of him. After the blessing words were read out, everyone entered the prayer stage with Richelieu. They put their hands together and looked pious.
Half an hour later, the blessing ceremony was finally over.
Richelieu looked at ernorin: “Let the others disperse. You come with me.”
“Yes.”Ernorin noticed the strange expression on his face and said solemnly.
Richelieu took Ernorin to a nearby tavern. He ordered the Knights to empty the tavern and stand guard outside, he led ERNORIN, Dudian and Neuss into the tavern.
Ernorin frowned as he saw the two attendants come in: “You two go out first. I have something to discuss with the pope.”
Richelieu waved his hand: “It doesn’t matter. They are trustworthy.”
Ernorin was startled as he looked at the two knights.
Richelieu coughed lightly, he said indifferently, “There are people in the Holy See who want to assassinate me. Fortunately, they did not succeed. However, for the time being, I can not return to the Holy See when I do not know who the culprit behind this is. Therefore, during this period of time, you will temporarily take care of all the matters in the Holy See.”
Ernorlin anxiously asked, “Are you really alright?”
Richelieu shook his head slightly. “It’s not a big deal.”
Ernorlin immediately said, “The church is the safest. If you’re outside, wouldn’t it be even more dangerous? Why don’t I send more people to protect you and let the King of light personally protect you?”
Richelieu waved his hand. “I’m not sure if the person behind the assassination has anything to do with the King of Light.”
Ernorlin was stunned and could not speak. He suddenly felt a chill. He clenched his fists and gritted his teeth. “If I catch him, I’ll definitely teach him a lesson!”
Richelieu patted his shoulder, “If you have the chance, help me to pay more attention.”
“I will.”Ernorlin’s expression was solemn. He suddenly thought of something and said, “I will send a few of my confidants to protect you. Otherwise, if you are outside…”
“No need. They are enough to protect me.”Richelieu waved his hand and said.
Ernorin could not help but look at the two servants again. His eyes revealed a trace of solemnity and a trace of jealousy. He knew that Richelieu did not completely trust him, but he trusted these two people 100% , otherwise, he would not have given himself to them to protect him at this critical moment.
“I’m leaving. You have to protect yourself too.”Richelieu said with a deeper meaning.
Ernorin looked at his eyes and felt that he wanted to tell him something. He thought that he should remind him not to be assassinated by the murderer behind the scenes.
Richelieu took off the gorgeous robe and put on a set of plain coat. He put on the hood and covered his face. He left the pub and took Dudian and Neuss along the streets, after turning into the suburbs, they returned to the castle by the Mozar River.
“How was my performance?”After entering the castle, Richelieu took off the hood and sighed. He turned to dudian and said, “I told you what you wanted me to say.”
“It was alright.”Dudian casually said. He didn’t pay attention to him. He quickly ran up the stairs and came to his room. When he saw Aisha sitting on the bed, his heart settled down.
He took Aisha’s hand and led her out of the room.
Richelieu asked: “What are you going to do next?”
“Do you have eyes and ears in the Dark Church?”Dudian looked at him.
Richelieu was a bit hesitant but he thought that he had to provide a few eyes and ears in order to gain Dudian’s trust, he said: “There are two of them. One is an elder of the 9th region. He is one of the people I sent to the dark church. The other is a strong general under the sword king. Riley is one of the people I sent to the Sword King. He was once the Most Outstanding Genius Sword Master of the Holy Church.”
Dudian glanced at him: “The most outstanding one was sent by you to be an undercover.”
Richelieu forced a smile: “I just want to sharpen him. The sword will rust sooner or later if I don’t use it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 626
chapters.content:
Chapter 626
“It should be because he is too outstanding. You are worried that you can’t control him.”Dudian’s face was calm but there was a deep meaning in his words, “It is a good thing that the weapon is sharp. If you are worried that you can’t control it and try to destroy it in order to avoid being used by others, then it would be sad and useless. What do you think?”
“You are right. I didn’t expect you to know more than me at such a young age.”Richelieu smiled and took the opportunity to compliment dudian. In any case, compliments were free but would bring benefits to himself, it didn’t matter if the person was a friend or an enemy.
Dudian frowned as he saw Richelieu’s modest attitude. He took out a small iron bottle from his pocket: “This is sleeping potion. I’m going out. You take the medicine and rest here. Wait for me to come back.”
Richelieu looked at the small black iron bottle in his hand, he forced a smile: “I am completely loyal to you. I will never betray you. Moreover we are in the same boat. If I betray you it will be the same as death. I Can’t go back to the monastery. If you are worried then you can send people to monitor me.”
“No one here is stronger than you.”Dudian indifferently said: “You are right. If you are a smart person then you should not betray me because you will die!”! But I can not put my life on the body of a person who is not clear whether he is smart or stupid. Do you understand?”
Richelieu was speechless: “Alright, I’ll eat it.”He took the small iron bottle and opened it. He poured out two black pills. The pills emitted a strange fragrance. He looked at them and threw them into his mouth.
“The quantity is not enough.”Dudian said: “Although this is made by a great potion master. Only one of them can make a senior hunter unconscious. But your physique is much higher. You Don’t need to be polite with this bottle.”
Richelieu’s mouth twitched. He saw Dudian’s unquestionable eyes and knew that it was useless to say more. He poured the whole bottle into his mouth and slowly swallowed it. At the same time he hid some of it behind his teeth, he hoped that the part he swallowed would not make him fall asleep.
