Soon, the drowsiness slowly hit him. Richelieu sighed in his heart. He pretended to be extremely tired. He turned around and walked to the sofa. His body slanted and fell on the sofa. Soon there was a slight snoring sound.
“The effect is so fast.”Nicholas exclaimed.
Dudian glanced at Richelieu’s feet: “I’m just pretending to sleep. Go and get the things from my basement.”
“Pretending to sleep?”Nicholas was stunned. He noticed that Dudian had glanced at the place. He turned around and saw Richelieu’s body lying on the sofa. Although he was fast asleep.., but the position of his body wasn’t deviated. Moreover his feet were very close to the sofa. How could a person who was tired to the point of falling down be in the mood to think about the sleeping position?
Nicholas looked at Richelieu who was still pretending to sleep on the sofa. He didn’t expect that the Pope would have such an embarrassing moment.
At the same time, he admired Dudian. If it was him, he wouldn’t be able to tell that the pope was pretending to sleep. He didn’t even think that such a legendary figure would pretend to sleep.
“Why are you still in a Daze?”Dudian frowned.
Nicholas quickly walked to the basement: “Yes.”He quickly returned with syringes in his hands.
Dudian grabbed one of the syringes. It was a light green liquid which was also the liquid form of the broken down mulberry leaves. The liquid form was different from the dried grass that was used to make ‘cigarettes’. First of all, the effect was fast. It was directly injected into the blood. Unless it was someone with magic marks ability who could control the blood in the body.., otherwise, it would be difficult to get rid of the components of the mulberry leaves in the blood.
The tobacco made from Hay needed to be inhaled in a certain amount to accumulate certain components in the blood. It was addictive and slow to take effect. However, the advantage was that it was fast and convenient to make. Moreover, the liquid residue could be treated as waste, it was not a waste.
For people who were already addicted, the effect of the tobacco made from Hay was better. It was like the primer of a bomb. It could directly trigger the strong desire in their blood.
Dudian went up to Richelieu’s arm and used his hand to strangle it. Soon he saw the protruding veins. He injected it into the veins: “It depends on your performance.”
Richelieu was shocked when he heard Dudian say “Pretend to sleep”. At this moment he secretly took a glance at the things that Dudian had injected into his body. His heart was cold. He didn’t think that this kid would be so evil and willful!
Soon, the unbearable but pleasurable itch slowly crawled out of his body. This time it was stronger than the last time. It spread from his internal organs to his whole body. It seemed that all parts of his body were bitten by countless insects, it was unbearable.
He tried to endure but his body trembled uncontrollably. He knew that he couldn’t hide it anymore. He sat up and scratched his arms and neck, he begged Dudian: “I was wrong. Please give me the antidote. I know I was wrong.”
“You are really not smart.”Dudian shook his head.
Richelieu couldn’t care about Dudian’s taunt. He felt itchy all over his body. He wanted to peel off his skin. His eyes were red as he grabbed Dudian’s arm, he begged: “Please give me the antidote. Please!”
“If you are willing to kneel down and show complete surrender then I will consider it.”Dudian indifferently said.
Nicholas’s eyelids twitched as he heard Dudian’s words!
Richelieu’s body stiffened. He looked up at Dudian in disbelief. However he saw that the youth’s expression was as cold as ice. He was angry. He let go of Dudian’s hand and lowered his head, he clenched his teeth.
Time passed by second by second.
Richelieu felt that the strange itch on his body was getting stronger and stronger. On the contrary, the previous strong humiliation and anger were getting weaker and weaker, he couldn’t help but scratch his body again. His nails scratched his skin but he didn’t feel pain. Instead he felt comfortable. He clenched his teeth and continued to scratch.
Soon, he felt his fingers wet and sticky. When he lowered his head to look, he was shocked. He saw that his arm was covered in bloody marks. Some parts of his arm had been scratched so deeply that it was a bloody mess, however, he did not feel any pain at all.
“If this continues, I will claw myself to death.”This thought appeared in his mind. He immediately stopped, but the strange itch all over his body was even stronger. It was as if his entire heart was being gnawed by insects. The Strange Itch was unbearable, he couldn’t help but shrink into a ball. It seemed that this could alleviate the feeling.
“I will give you three minutes to consider.”Dudian’s voice sounded.
Richelieu was lying on the red carpet next to the sofa. He looked up and saw Dudian standing a few meters away. He was holding an expensive cigarette wrapped in snow paper. The cigarette was lit and he was gently inhaling it, the smoke was coming out of his mouth and out of his mouth.
Dudian’s cigarette wasn’t made from mulberry leaves. It was made by him alone. It was similar to the cigarettes of the old era. It was less harmful and less addictive. It was easy to give up.
Richelieu saw Dudian smoking the cigarette. He felt as if there were countless worms crawling on his throat. The itch was unbearable. He wanted to scratch his throat but he thought of the blood stains on his arm, he hit the ground and growled. At this moment he didn’t think about why Dudian didn’t get poisoned but smoked the “Antidote”.
“Last minute.”Dudian took out a mulberry leaf cigarette from his pocket. He rolled it onto the straw paper. He walked to Richelieu and loosened his fingers. The cigarette fell to the ground.
Richelieu saw the falling cigarette. His eyes were wide open and he quickly reached out to pick it up.
Before his palm touched the cigarette, the toe of a leather shoe stepped on it. It slightly twisted the cigarette and slowly moved away.
Richelieu looked at the scene in a daze. He suddenly felt an overwhelming anger and humiliation. He raised his head and stared at Dudian with red eyes, but what he saw was still the cold face.
He clenched his teeth and even bared his teeth. He wanted to punch the face but he knew that he would be defeated before he could hit him.
Time slowly passed in the stalemate. The humiliation and anger slowly weakened again. The hunger and desire turned into the voice of the Devil. He repeatedly hypnotized himself in his mind. As long as he took a sip, he would be free.
No one saw him here. He didn’t lose face..
Moreover, he had long been defeated by him. He didn’t have face to save..
His boots were clean and didn’t get dirty..
He slowly stretched out his trembling hand. He picked up the cigarette and covered it in his palm. There was a trace of moisture in his eyes. At the same time, strong hatred and killing intent burst out. However, he lowered his head, he didn’t dare to let Dudian notice.
A box of matches was thrown in front of him.
Dudian turned back to Aisha and said to Nicholas: “Go to the basement and get another bottle of sleeping pills.”
“Yes.”Nicholas replied. He secretly glanced at the pope who was kneeling on the ground. There was a bit of complex and fear in his eyes.
Richelieu couldn’t wait to light up the cigarette. He put it into his mouth and took a big breath. He felt as if he had jumped from Hell to heaven. The unbearable itch and the crazy emptiness disappeared in an instant, there was only a comfortable feeling as if he had fallen into the clouds. There was no pain. It was as if his soul had left his body and was soaring in the sky.
Dudian looked at Richelieu’s intoxicated face. There was a trace of emotion in his eyes. He knew that the two injections of mulberry leaf liquid had completely penetrated into his blood. He could no longer quit. Moreover, every time after the injection.., he had made Richelieu endure to the limit again and again. In the end he had given him the dried leaves. This kind of drug addiction would only make him stronger and harder to resist!
Moreover, the effects of this thing had been shown. Not only would it make people intoxicated but it would also wear down one’s willpower, spirit and other aspects.
After Nicholas took back the sleeping pills, Dudian let Richelieu take them. Soon, Richelieu fell asleep.
Dudian said a few words to Nicholas and took Aisha out of the castle.
..
..
In an old castle in the town of Loen.
This was a small town in the bustling western district of the commercial district. Although it was a town, but it was extremely prosperous. The people living in this town were either rich or noble. The streets were full of judges and priests of the Holy Church, there were also teams of patrolling soldiers. The security here was very safe. In the past ten years, there had not been any incidents of attacks by the dark cult, let alone robbers, thieves, and so on.
The Lord of the small town was the Lucran family. This family name was extremely famous, and almost everyone in the upper-class noble circle knew of it. Lucran West, one of the eight cardinal bishops of the Holy See, was the current head of the family.
At this moment, in the underground of the main castle of the Lucran family castle, warm cheers rang out from outside a round platform. This was an extremely spacious underground square, built exactly like the arena outside, the high dome was inlaid with densely packed fluorescent stones of high value. The faint light that scattered down illuminated the interior of the square, and at the same time, it was somewhat dark and hazy.
At this moment, on the circular platform surrounded by iron wires, a brawny man of nearly two meters tall was fighting with a petite woman who was less than 1.7 meters tall. This woman had wheat-colored skin and brown hair. At a glance, one could tell that she was from a commoner’s background, there were many wounds on her body. The most eye-catching part was her attire, which was extremely revealing. Her upper body was only a tube top while her lower body was only a short underwear.
The burly man’s attire was similarly simple. His upper body was naked, while his lower body was short pants, revealing his bulging muscles like a dragon. He was like a humanoid tank.
“Kill! Kill! Kill!”
“Kill her!”
“Kill This Bitch!”
The crowd below the stage roared loudly. Some people covered their mouths with their hands as microphones to make their voices louder.
Most of these people had blonde hair. They wore expensive silk clothes and gold, silver, and jade accessories. They had an extraordinary temperament, but at this moment, they were like a group of bulls in heat, shouting at the top of their lungs.
Bang!
The brawny man seized the opportunity and punched the woman’s abdomen.
The woman immediately coughed up a mouthful of blood, and her body bent into a shrimp.
The Brawny Man’s face was full of malevolence, and he did not show any mercy. He grabbed her hair and punched her face. With a bang, the woman’s nose bone was shattered, and blood flowed out.
Seeing this fierce battle, which had a huge disparity in strength, the cheers from the audience became even crazier. Countless people shouted excitedly. At the same time, someone threw a gold coin onto the barbed wire fence. The sound of the gold coin landing on the stage was extremely beautiful.
“Beat, beat her chest!”
“Beat this bitch to death and crush her body!”
The cheers below the stage were excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 627
chapters.content:
Chapter 627
The burly man had no pity for women. His face was full of malevolence. He grabbed the woman’s hair with one hand and punched her face repeatedly with the other. His moves were simple and crude. Every time he withdrew his fist, the woman’s face was covered in blood, sticky blood stuck to his fist like silk. Then, he used his fist to send it back to the woman’s face.
The woman screamed in pain and struggled to hold the strong man’s arm, but it looked like she was shaking an iron wall, and it was useless. Her struggle soon weakened, and the screams slowly stopped. The arm that was holding the strong man fell down weakly, leaving only a slight moan of pain.
“Blow her head off! !”
“Harder, Harder!”
The cheers below the stage were crazy.
The Brawny man looked around and his gaze fell on the woman in his hand. He raised his fist and punched her forehead, one punch after another, until the back of his hand became numb, at this time, the woman stopped moaning and lost her breath.
The Brawny man let go of the hand that was holding her hair. The woman fell down and landed heavily on the stage. Her head was tilted, and a face that had been smashed into pieces looked at the barbed wire powerlessly, the faces outside the barbed wire were screaming excitedly. The only eye that was left was drooping, lifeless and empty.
No one noticed that a figure flashed through her dark, mirror-like pupils.
Behind the audience stand of this small underground arena was a narrow corridor. Behind the corridor was a circular wall that was surrounded on all four sides. There was a wide corridor at a certain distance from the wall, at this moment, people were leaving the audience seats one after another and turning around to enter the dark corridor at the back. The rest of the people were still sitting in the audience seats, excitedly preparing to watch the next match.
The dark corridor was inlaid with sparse fluorite, which looked much more luxurious than cheap oil lamps. The corridor was extremely deep and had several forks. The people who came here were obviously very familiar with these forks, they walked to the places they wanted to go.
Prana walked to the left-most forks of the long corridor. On the wall of this long corridor, there was a door at a certain distance. Obviously, there were rooms inside. Prana walked to the door of the dark golden patterned room with the number “108”engraved on it. As he approached, he heard waves of childish sobs coming from inside. He sighed in his heart, knowing that this lord was addicted to playing again.
He raised his hand and knocked on the door gently, then stood respectfully at the door, waiting for a response.
A moment later, a grumpy voice came from the room. “Who’s so blind? Do You Want to die? Huh? !”
Prana quickly said respectfully, “It’s me, my Lord. Lord luclan asked me to pass on a message to you.”Although luclan was a surname, there was no doubt that it was luclan-ster with the word “My lord”added after it.
“Come in!”The grumpy voice from inside said in a low voice, filled with suppressed anger.
The door was opened from the inside. A fair-skinned young knight smiled at Prana and said softly, “Please, sir.”
“Thank you.”Prana did not dare to be negligent. He knew that this person was the trusted aide of this sir, and also the man he doted on the most.
When he entered the room, he could faintly hear the tender voice of a child. He immediately heard it more clearly. He saw that this was an extremely spacious large room. Inside, there was a large bed and a few wardrobes, in addition, there were some shelves with strange utensils and a weapon rack. The things on the rack were not like swords and sabers. Instead, they were long whips and ropes with densely packed iron thorns.
At first glance, it looked like a torture chamber for interrogating prisoners.
Prana looked to the side of the bed and saw a slender middle-aged man leaning on the big bed. There were two small figures in his arms. They were seven or eight-year-old little girls, there was also a four or five-year-old boy with a childlike face. The skin of these two children was relatively clean. They were obviously not from poor families. There were no dark spots on their hands or faces. They looked extremely cute.
However, at this moment, there were obvious tears on the faces of the two children. Their dark pupils were filled with fear. Every time the middle-aged man touched their hair, the fear in his eyes intensified.
Other than these two children, there were three other children on the bed. However, they were all sitting by the side of the bed. Their bodies were curled up, shivering, and they let out low sobbing sounds.
Prana took a look at them. Although he felt uncomfortable, he did not frown. His face was extremely calm. If it was the same prana from ten years ago, he would not be able to be so calm.
“Sir, Lord luclan asked me to call you to tell you that the pope has news,”Prana said respectfully.
The middle-aged man on the bed raised his eyebrows slightly and snorted, “Is he dead or Alive?”
Prana was not surprised at his rude words. He still said respectfully, “The pope seems to be fine. After the blessing ceremony in Martha Square, he disappeared again.”
“Well? What’s going on?”The middle-aged man said unhappily, “This old man has nothing to do. Why is he running around?”
Prana said respectfully, “Lord Lucran asked me to pass on a message. Please go over and talk to him.”
“How Annoying!”The middle-aged man was a little impatient, but he still slowly sat up from the bed. He pinched the soft faces of the two children with his hands. The irascibility in his eyes suddenly turned into greed and desire. He licked his lips, he picked up the little girl and kissed her hard.
The little girl was so scared that she tried her best to resist. Her little hand pushed against his chest, but how could it move him at all?
Suddenly, the little girl screamed and cried out loud.
At this moment, the middle-aged man opened his mouth, but there was half a piece of soft flesh in his mouth. He chewed it gently. It was a piece of the little girl’s lips.
“Delicious.”The middle-aged man closed his eyes and chewed in enjoyment. After chewing, he swallowed it. Then, he slowly opened his eyes and touched the little girl’s head that was crying in pain. His eyes revealed a fatherly doting look, he said softly, “Be good, be obedient, understand?”
The little girl kept crying, crying in pain.
The middle-aged man smiled and got off the bed. He was naked and barefoot on the clean wooden floor. He said to the white-skinned young knight by the door, “Bring me my clothes.”
The young knight nodded respectfully. He took out a luxurious suit from the wardrobe next to him and put it on for him.
The middle-aged man stretched out his hand like a coat hanger, enjoying his service. When he tied his tie, he asked, “You’re not jealous, are you?”
“Why would I be?”The Young Knight’s face was slightly red.
The middle-aged man laughed and covered his tie to adjust himself. He looked at his own outfit in the mirror outside the wardrobe and was satisfied. Then, he took out a precision mechanical watch from a master, he put on his hat and looked elegant.
“Let’s go,”the middle-aged man said.
The young knight looked at the five children on the bed and said, “What about them?”
“As usual, I’ll kill them and feed them to little loach,”the middle-aged man said casually. After he finished, he buttoned his sleeves and turned around, ready to go out.
“You’re not even dressed properly. Why are you in such a hurry to go out?”A calm voice sounded.
The middle-aged man heard the voice but didn’t think much. He looked down and saw that the buttons of his clothes weren’t fastened properly. He frowned and was a bit angry, the young knight behind him shouted in surprise: “Who… Who Are You?”
The middle-aged man reacted as he heard the voice. He looked up and saw a figure in a black robe standing by the door. The loose hood covered most of his face, his fair and handsome chin was exposed.
“The Dean sent by the monastery has such a weak perception?”Dudian lifted the hood and looked at the middle-aged man indifferently, “The first button was wrong. I twisted it to the last button but I didn’t notice it. Are you too numb or have you already lost sight of it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 628
chapters.content:
Chapter 628
The middle-aged man’s face changed as he heard the words ‘supervisor’. He looked at dudian in anger: “Who are you? !”
Few people in the outer wall knew about this title. Even the Lucran family didn’t know about his identity. They only knew that he was a big shot from the inner wall and had extraordinary power.
“You… You Are His Highness Riley? !”Prana was shocked as he saw Dudian’s appearance. “Why are you here? Aren’t you missing?”
“Riley?”The middle-aged man saw that Prana knew about his identity: “Do You Know Him?”
Prana replied: “Sir, His Highness Riley is the Most Outstanding Knight of Our Holy Church in the past twenty years. His sword talent is very high and he is from a noble family. However, he should have disappeared a long time ago. I heard that he died in the line of duty. I didn’t expect… Strange! Isn’t His Highness a blonde? How come he has black hair now?” There was doubt in his eyes.
“Are you from the Holy Church?”The middle-aged man was relieved. He thought that Dudian was from the inner wall when he heard Dudian’s true identity, he didn’t expect that Dudian was just a small knight of the holy church in the outer wall. He didn’t think that Dudian would be the most outstanding knight in twenty years. He didn’t care about the god’s marrow or secret techniques. No matter how Smart Dudian was, he was still a low-class citizen!
“I don’t like to talk too much when I kill people.”Dudian slowly raised the dagger in his hand, “But for a person like you to be killed by a sneak attack is too easy for you. Death isn’t scary because you can’t even feel pain after death so how can you be afraid? So only by slowing down the process of your death and letting you taste your own death can you experience fear and despair!”
The middle-aged man narrowed his eyes and revealed a trace of malice.
The middle-aged man heard Dudian’s words and sneered, he said: “You know my identity but you still dare to come here to die. I advise you to be honest and tell me who sent you here. You probably don’t know the purpose of the person who sent you here? Because he didn’t clearly tell you how strong I am…”
Whoosh!
A sudden breeze interrupted his words.
Suddenly a fist came towards him and hit his face. Bang! His body fell back and fell onto the soft bed. He rolled several times.
Puff! Puff!
At the same time, the sound of two blades cutting flesh echoed. Prana and the young knight were stunned as they looked at Dudian. Their mouths slightly opened but they couldn’t say a word, blood spurted out from their throats and both of them fell down stiffly.
The middle-aged man was lying on the bed. His head was in a daze and his ears were ringing. He felt as if the world was spinning in front of him. He struggled to turn his head but Dudian’s figure was standing on the edge of the bed and looking down at him, it seemed that he didn’t have the intention to continue the attack.
He took a deep breath. The dizziness immediately subsided. He quickly pushed his palm and jumped back. He landed on the other side of the bed. He bent down and quickly took out a silver sword.
He was a bit calm after holding the sword. At the moment the tinnitus and dizziness had disappeared. He stared at Dudian who was on the other side of the bed. His heart was full of shock, didn’t Prana say that this person was a small knight of the Holy See? Wasn’t the upper limit of the strength of the outer wall a senior hunter? But he couldn’t react to the strength and speed of this person!
He was a primary limiter and had mastered two secret combat skills taught by the monastery. It was rare for him to lose in a fight with someone of the same level. However, he had lost in a fight!
Moreover, he had lost completely. If the man had attacked a weapon then he would be dead by now!
Although he was careless but the speed which exceeded his reaction speed was not something a hunter could achieve, even if it was a rare magic mark!
Dudian looked at him indifferently. His body suddenly flashed. The middle-aged man’s eyelid twitched. He could barely see a blurry shadow. He was scared and hurriedly waved his knife. Silver light flashed, countless knife lights formed a shield in front of him.
Suddenly, he felt pain in his feet. It was as if he was hit by a hard steel rod. His body instantly lost balance and fell down.
His heart went cold as well. A gap appeared in the dense blade light. He raised his other hand to support himself on the ground and stabilize his body. However, a ray of black light suddenly shot straight from the messy gap in the blade light and hit his chest.
A piercing pain instantly came. His back hit the wooden floor hard. All of this took a long time to describe, but it all ended in a second.
The middle-aged man was about to resist the pain when he felt that his right hand was grasped by a cold palm. It was more like a piece of ice than a palm.
The bones of his wrist were twisted and dislocated. He roared in pain and raised his other hand to smash it.
However, his other hand was grabbed by a strong hand. Before he could break free, a burst of excruciating pain came. His left hand was also twisted and dislocated.
“If you like children, then I will make you a child.”Dudian’s cold voice was heard. There was no trace of trembling in his voice. It seemed that he still had some strength left after the fierce battle.
The middle-aged man didn’t understand what he meant. He felt that his feet were pinched. The next moment, he suddenly understood.
The crisp sound of bones cracking echoed. The pain caused the middle-aged man to scream out. But as soon as he screamed out, something was stuffed into his mouth.
In the blink of an eye, Dudian folded the middle-aged man’s limbs into a cross. He sat on his folded hands and feet. He looked at the back of the middle-aged man’s head. He held a dagger and gently cut the middle-aged man’s ear, one of the middle-aged man’s ears was cut off. Blood was gushing out. The pain made his whole body tremble.
“You could have enjoyed the treatment of near death. There was no pain.”Dudian used the dagger to cut the middle-aged man’s face and neck. From time to time he would stab the dagger into the gaps of the blood, he indifferently said: “But your mistake is to kill people unnecessarily. You should know that people live in groups so other people are a kind of resource. But you are wasting such a precious resource. It is really stupid!”
The middle-aged man’s facial features were twisted in pain. He didn’t scream.
Dudian turned the dagger and quickly cut his body. He cut off his broken limbs and other parts. One of his arms was cut to the bone. After more than ten minutes.., he finished the middle-aged man’s life with one cut.
After he got up, the five children on the big bed were scared and quickly shrank to a corner. They were shivering.
Dudian glanced at the frightened look of the children. He whispered: “In your eyes, I am no different from him, right?”
The five children just looked at him in fear. The girl who had been bitten off her lips and cried was too scared to cry.
“Maybe there is a difference.”Dudian saw their expressions and muttered to himself: “It is more terrible.”He put on the hood again but only covered his hair. He went around the bed, opened the door and walked out of the room.
Previously when he tortured the middle-aged man, he used thermal vision to observe the outside of the room. The reason why he ended the torture of the middle-aged man was because he saw the opportunity to leave.
After leaving the room, he walked a few steps and passed by a fork. He met two golden-haired young nobles. The two of them smelled of alcohol but were not drunk.
Dudian deliberately walked through the middle of the two and knocked their shoulders away.
The two of them were in pain from the collision. Dudian angrily shouted: “Stinky Boy, Stop! How can you walk? Are You Blind? !”
Dudian turned his head and saw the weak fluorescent stones on the wall shining on his face. The two young nobles were about to curse when they saw Dudian’s face. They were shocked as they saw Dudian’s face stained with blood, both of them felt a chill from the soles of their feet.
Dudian retracted his eyes and quickly left.
Both of them looked at Dudian’s back as he disappeared into the passage. They slowly looked at each other and saw the surprise in each other’s eyes.
In the castle, luclan-ster frowned. He didn’t expect that Prana hadn’t come back yet. He immediately called the butler. He wanted to send someone to call for him again. Suddenly, there was a sound of armor clanging from outside.
“Sir, something’s Happened Underground!”A knight dressed in heavy armor specially made by the luclan family hurriedly ran over, he said, “The people who were guarding underground just now sent news. Mr. Prana and that sir, they… they died in the room!”
“What?”Luclan-ster was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 629
chapters.content:
Chapter 629
“They died in the room?”Luclan-ster suspected that he was hearing things. He frowned and said, “Say it again, who died?”
“Sir, it’s Mr. Prana and that sir. They’re dead.”The Heavy Armored Knight secretly raised his head and glanced at him. He said carefully.
Luclan-ster was stunned. He suddenly suspected that the armored knight who reported the news was here to fool him. If Prana died, he could accept it, but that “Sir”.., that was an expert even stronger than the great radiant king. How could he die here? In the entire outer wall region, who could kill him?
Could it be someone from the inner wall region? Such a thought suddenly flashed through his mind. His heart trembled, and he asked the armored knight in a deep voice, “Are you sure?”
“Absolutely!”The armored knight lowered his head and said.
Luclan-ster’s expression changed slightly. He immediately stood up and said, “Bring me to take a look.”
The armored knight quickly got up and led the way in front.
After a moment, the two of them arrived at room 108 in the underground passage. At this moment, this underground world had been sealed off, and luclan-ster’s secret army was guarding all the entrances. Luclan-ster pushed open the room. He immediately smelled the stench of blood and the sound of sobbing. His heart sank. He looked up and immediately saw several of his trusted aides standing in the room, they were protecting the scene.
On the floor of the room, there were two corpses. They were prana, whom he had sent, and the Lord’s personal attendant.
His expression changed slightly and he asked in a deep voice, “Where’s his corpse?”
“Lord, it’s here,”a middle-aged man with a scar on his face said in a low voice.
Luclan Ste hoped to hear the word “No”from his mouth, but when he saw the direction he pointed in, his heart turned cold. He saw that on the other side of the bed, there was a large amount of blood, there were messy pieces of flesh, as well as dismembered arms. It was like a slaughterhouse. He slowly walked over and immediately saw a mangled body lying on the ground. Only the clothes he recognized were there. Even the face was cut so badly that the flesh and blood turned outward. It was completely blurry.
Even though he was well-informed and had witnessed hundreds of crimes committed by the Dark Church’s evil members, he was disgusted by this scene. He wanted to vomit. The body on the ground could no longer be called a corpse, but a pile of flesh and blood, moreover, it was clearly flesh and blood that had been destroyed by humans. It was hard to imagine how much pain, fear, and despair the deceased had suffered before he died!
He took a deep breath and felt the bloody smell flowing in his chest, making him feel nauseous.
He raised his hand to pinch his chin and conveniently covered his nose. He slowly turned around, and his thoughts quickly ran through his mind. Judging from the clothes and the mechanical watch on his broken hand, the deceased was undoubtedly that Lord! However, who could have killed that Lord?
To kill him in such a cruel way, there must be an unimaginable deep hatred. Could it be that the enemy he had offended in the inner wall had come looking for him? Would his enemy vent his anger on me?
As he thought of this, he felt a chill run down his spine. He felt that his surroundings were suddenly filled with danger, filled with hidden knives and spears.
“He’s dead. He deserves it!”Luclan-ster took a deep breath and glanced at the people around him, he narrowed his eyes and said, “How long has he been dead? How did the murderer infiltrate our luclan family and find this place to assassinate him?”
The people around him looked at each other, unable to answer.
However, they knew that their master had already suspected that there was a mole in the family.
Luclan-ster slowly glanced at their expressions, then his gaze shifted to the few shivering children on the big bed beside him. Naturally, he did not suspect that there was a mole in his subordinates, how could a person who could kill this lord need a mole to assist him? He was only worried that that person did not leave, but was still mixed in with the Knights under him.
“Have you been here the whole time?”Luclan-ster asked the children.
He was already familiar with the man’s special hobbies, including these children. He had ordered people to find them for him.
The children stared at him with their black and white eyes, their faces full of fear.
Luclan-ster frowned slightly, he turned around and said, “These children are witnesses. They must have seen the whole process of the murderer. Take them down and ask them what the murderer looks like. Remember, don’t scare them anymore. Otherwise, their minds will collapse and they won’t be able to ask anything.”
“Yes.”The middle-aged man from before nodded.
“Also,”luclan-ster said in a deep voice, “Don’t tell anyone about this. If word gets out, you will be responsible!”
“Yes.”The few of them said in unison.
“Father!”At this moment, an anxious voice suddenly came from outside. A brown-haired young man quickly ran in.
Luclan-ster looked at his son’s obnoxious brown hair and frowned. He said, “What is it?”
The young man quickly said, “Father, I found two witnesses. They should know something.”
“Oh?”Luclan-ster’s eyes lit up. “Bring them here quickly.”
The young man said, “Father, I’ve already interrogated them. These two people told us the situation at that time. According to the time of the incident, they happened to pass by outside when the incident happened. They were preparing to gamble outside. In the end, they met a person in the corridor. That person’s face was covered in blood, scaring the two of them. However, they didn’t think too much about it at that time. They thought that that person had played with some slave and went overboard. However, they later found out that a big shot had died here, so they connected it to that person. Then, they told a good friend of theirs, the guard, and that guard told me about it.”
Luclan-ster was startled and immediately said, “You’re saying that they bumped into the murderer in the corridor?”
“That’s right,”the young man said. “The murderer left in a hurry and bumped into them. Only then did they notice the murderer’s face.”
Luclan-ster immediately said, “Find an artist immediately and cooperate with the two of them. Draw the murderer’s face and put it on the wanted list of the cult of Shadows. Let the cult of Shadows find the murderer for us.”
The young man said respectfully, “Father, I have already gotten an artist to draw it. This is the murderer’s portrait. I will immediately send it to Big Brother. He has many connections. Let him help us publish it in the cult of Shadows.”
Ruklan-ster did not expect his son, whom he disliked the most, to be so efficient. In the past, he had looked down on him. He immediately said, “Let me see it first.”
The young man respectfully handed it over.
Luclan Ste opened the portrait. It was an extremely lifelike sketch. He looked at it a few times and suddenly felt that this person was somewhat familiar. After looking at it carefully for a moment, he suddenly thought of someone.
“Riley? The sword genius who has been missing for a long time?”There was a hint of surprise in luclan Ste’s eyes. After looking at it a few more times, he felt that it was more and more similar. However, this portrait was still a little different from the Riley whom he had seen before. It should be caused by the two witnesses’interpretation and the artist’s understanding of the portrait.
“Is it just a person who looks similar? “Riley, how could it be him? How could he kill him? “Wait, Riley was once the Pope’s favorite knight. His disappearance has always been a mystery. Could it be that the pope deliberately arranged all of this and made him disappear, but in fact, he secretly sent him to the inner wall to further his studies?”Luclan-ster was a little scared as he thought about it, the pope had the authority to enter the inner wall, so it was not difficult for him to send someone into the inner wall!
If that was the case, then wasn’t the Pope’s disappearance also part of the Pope’s plan and arrangement?
And most importantly, why did the Pope send him to assassinate this lord?
Could it be that he sensed the power that he had been secretly operating and was preparing to deal with him?
As he thought of these numerous thoughts, he felt some fear in his heart. He furrowed his brows and thought deeply about the purpose and nature behind this matter. As he thought about it, no one in the room dared to make a sound and disturb him. The room fell into a dead silence, only a few children’s frightened sobs sounded softly, but no one paid any attention to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 630
chapters.content:
Chapter 630
A young commoner led a veiled woman dressed in a purple cheongsam out of Loen town. They did not follow the numerous official roads of the caravan. Instead, they went straight to the dense forest in the nearby wilderness, they shuttled through the dense forest.
Wild Wolves, snakes, pigs, and other ferocious beasts roamed the dense forest in the wilderness. The commoner did not dare to approach. However, there was a transportation path in the dense forest. This was a shortcut that the caravan had opened up in a hurry. When the caravan passed by this place.., they would often hire retired soldiers or adventurers who had explored the radiation zone as guards. After all, there were bandits and bandits in the dense forest, there were even terrifying dark cultists who were doing secret evil experiments here.
Dudian took Aisha along the caravan path.
Rustle!
A few bandits dressed in green grass suddenly jumped out of the bushes and blocked Dudian’s way.
“Haha, Old Boss, we met a fat sheep the first time we went out!”
“Stammering, don’t talk so much.”
“HMPH, you two dare to come here. You are courting death. Kid, Hurry up and…”
Before the bandits could finish their opening lines, Dudian’s running figure suddenly sped up. He waved his wrist and the bell tinkled.
Seeing him rushing toward them like a hurricane, the bandits were shocked and stunned.
With a whoosh, Dudian and Aisha jumped at the same time and flew over the heads of the bandits. They jumped to a height of more than ten meters and landed behind the bandits. They continued to run without looking back.
The bandits looked back and saw that Dudian and Aisha had run far away.
“Boss… boss…”
“Have you ever seen a person who can jump to the top of the tree?”
“Boss, I, I want to go back to be a good person…”
Dudian went along the dense forest. He met a hungry tiger along the way. After more than ten minutes he left the dense forest and came to a village, he went straight through the suburbs of the village and went to the next supervisor’s residence.
Padre Commercial Street was one of the four economic centers of the commercial district. There were large-scale trade markets and various entertainment industries, it was undoubtedly the largest vero casino in Padre Commercial Street.
There was a square outside the Vero Casino. The main purpose of this square was not to hold a blessing festival for the Holy See, nor to set up sculptures to worship the ancestors and gods, instead, it was for the wealthy nobles who came to the Vero Casino to park their carriages. The carriages in the square were filled up all year round. One could see all kinds of carriages and the badges and flags of various noble families here.
At this moment, in a luxurious box on the top floor of the Vero Casino, seven or eight blonde nobles were sitting around the Round Table Casino. This was a top-class noble box, and the minimum amount of chips on the casino was.., it was equivalent to the savings of an ordinary civilian family for fifty years.
The side of the gambling table was filled with fruit juice, champagne, delicacies, and so on. The service was very considerate.
Arkony turned the chips in his hand, looked at them for a while, and then sighed lightly. He got up and left the table. He patted the knight attendant behind him on the shoulder and said, “Come and play for me. I’ll change my luck.”
The knight said respectfully, “Yes.”It was not the first time he had encountered such a situation. Usually, when Arkony lost a lot, he would ask him to play for him.
Arkony did not watch the gambling at the side. Instead, he turned around and went to the rest area of the box. From here, he could see the scenery of more than half of the block outside the Vero Casino. The pedestrians on the bustling streets were in a hurry, in the distance, there were countless luxurious carriages parked in the square. Such a beautiful scenery could only be seen in the bustling city even in the inner wall area. However, living in the bustling city of the inner wall area was too expensive, even an aristocrat like him, who had a good position and salary, would feel distressed.
He picked up the red wine beside him and tasted it gently. Although he had lost a lot today, it did not affect his mood at all. Ever since he came to the outer wall area, his mood had been very good. In his impression, this area used to be barren and backward, the dirty area was far cleaner and richer than he had imagined. It gave him a big surprise.
He even felt that there was nothing bad about living here in his old age. It was better to be treated as a “Lord”by a group of pariahs than to be looked down upon as a “Villain”by a group of real nobles.
“Lord, this is a truffle from the snow mountain. It is very expensive and not available in the inner wall. You can try it.”Another knight attendant beside him pointed at a plate of food on the table and recommended it to arkony.
Arkony took a glance at it, picked up the spoon and gently scooped some. He felt that the taste was soft and sweet. It was extremely refreshing and delicious. He could not help but praise, “These outsiders know how to enjoy delicacies better than us.”
The knight smiled and said, “This is a delicacy that only the nobles of the outer wall are qualified to enjoy. After all, these nobles have learned our etiquette and teachings. They still know how to enjoy some of it.”
Hearing that, Arkony glanced at him and said, “Everything here is good, but there is one thing that makes me feel very dazzling. Do you know what it is?”
The knight immediately lowered his head and said, “I dare not make wild guesses.”
“It’s them.”Arkony’s tone was clearly directed at the people around the gambling table on the other side of the private room. He said coldly, “Seeing these lowlifes have blond hair like mine makes me feel disgusted. Do you know?”
The attendant Knight reacted and immediately knew that he had misspoken earlier. He hurriedly said, “I know.”
“Pariahs will always be pariahs. Even if they are mixed-race pariahs, they still have the lowly blood of pariahs in their bones.”Arkony said coldly, “This is something that can not be changed. Just like the barbarians outside the border. Even if they forcefully abduct civilians to give birth to their children, they will still give birth to an uneducated bastard.”
The attendant Knight broke out in a cold sweat. He lowered his head and said, “You’re right, sir.”
Arkony glanced at a golden-haired young man who turned to look at him from the other side of the gambling table and said, “What are you looking at?”
The golden-haired young man saw that Arkony’s imposing manner was extraordinary, so he hurriedly said, “Nothing. I seem to have misheard.”After saying that, he turned around and continued to immerse himself in the gambling table. He no longer cared about those things that had nothing to do with him.
After finishing the truffles, Arkony glanced outside. Seeing that it was getting late, he said, “The Camilla clan invited us for lunch. Prepare to leave.”
“Yes.”The attendant knight respectfully replied. Then, he came to the side of the gambling platform and called for the attendant knight who had replaced Arkony to prepare to leave.
When a fat middle-aged man sitting in the front seat of the gambling platform saw Arkony leaving.., he quickly stood up and said, “Mr. Arkony, you’re going back so early? Why Don’t you play a little longer? If you don’t have enough money, I have it here. I’ll lend it to you.”
Arkony said indifferently, “No need. I have an invitation for lunch. I’m going.”
The middle-aged man came to a realization and said with a smile, “Then I won’t keep you. Take care. Come back next time.”As he said that, he reached out and held his palm, sending him off to the door.
“You continue to play.”Arkony let go of his hand and left with two attendants and knights. When the door of the private room was closed, he took out the handkerchief in his arms, wiped his fingers, and wiped them clean one by one, he crumpled the handkerchief into a ball and threw it into the trash can in the corridor.
Soon, the three of them left the Vero Casino and came to the carriage in the square.
Two servants and knights escorted him to the carriage. As soon as Akoni entered the carriage, his pupils constricted. He saw two figures sitting silently in the spacious carriage. One was a man and the other was a woman. They were as silent as two ghosts.
He instantly realized something. Just as he was about to attack, a ray of cold light suddenly struck him. It was as fast as silver lightning. It expanded rapidly in his pupils and then disappeared. Immediately after, a sharp pain as if it had been split open came from his forehead.

chapters.title: Chapter 631
chapters.content:
Chapter 631
Dudian grabbed the collar of his collar and pulled his body into the carriage. The two knights didn’t notice the sudden assassination in the carriage, one of the Knights jumped onto the front frame as the coachman.
The other knight waited for Arkony’s body to completely enter the carriage. He grabbed the door and went down the stairs into the carriage. As he was used to lowering his head he saw six feet appear in the carriage.
He raised his head in shock and saw a flash of silver light. After that, he did not know anything else.
The dead knight-in-waiting fell and crashed into the carriage. The knight-in-waiting outside immediately sensed something strange and turned around. “Sir?”
There was no response. A silver light suddenly shot out from the carriage curtain and pierced into his throat as fast as lightning. Then, it was quickly pulled out and returned to the carriage.
The knight covered his throat and looked at the carriage in horror. Although the speed was fast, but he clearly saw that the hand holding the dagger was not the hand of arkony, nor the hand of another partner, there were actually other people hiding in the carriage!
His eyes were full of fear. The blood in his throat could not be blocked and kept flowing out. He slightly opened his mouth and wanted to call for help, but he could not make a sound. All his strength and thoughts suddenly disappeared as if they were pulled away by something, his vision went black and he fell down.
Dudian led Aisha out of the carriage. It was as if a noble couple were going to a banquet. They calmly walked along the carriage passage and left the square where countless carriages were parked.
Not long after they left, a noble who came to stop the carriage accidentally saw the knight attendant lying on the carriage frame. He thought that this servant was sleeping here without any rules. Soon, the nobleman noticed the continuous dripping of blood from the carriage frame and the pool of blood on the ground. At this moment, he noticed that the knight-in-waiting was lying on his back in a very strange position, almost falling down.
The nobleman immediately asked his guards to come forward to check. Soon, the news of the death of the knight-in-waiting reached the nobleman’s ears and quickly spread to the entire street outside the square, the soldiers patrolling the security nearby and the Knights of the court were all startled.
The terrifying atmosphere spread. Upon hearing the news, the nobles and wealthy people who came to have fun immediately drove away. One had to know that in such a prosperous economic center, there was actually someone who was assassinated here. This was simply terrifying to them. No one wanted to stay in the same environment as an unknown murderer, especially the so-called iron wall of the security was untrustworthy.
The afternoon passed very quickly.
Dudian came to the town of the 9th region of the dark church at 3 pm. After a morning of hunting, Richelieu had killed all five supervisors, except for the child abuse monster that he had encountered in the beginning. He had finished the other four as fast as possible. He could go to all the secret places in the outer wall without any difficulty.
“Stop!”The guard stopped Dudian.
Dudian took out the identity token of a great potion master.
The guard was shocked as he didn’t expect that the young man in front of him was actually a great potion master. He was covered in cold sweat as he respectfully said: “Greetings Mr. Great Potion Master, Please!”
Dudian pulled Aisha’s hand as they entered the castle.
Dudian went straight to the second floor of the Dark Hall. He followed the smell to find Hawkeye. At the same time he noticed the undercover ‘wolf shooter’that Richelieu had told him about.
“Elder, you are here.”Hawkeye’s attitude was extremely respectful as he saw Dudian. He had heard about Dudian’s suppression of twelve elders through his own family, he knew that the youth in front of him had terrifying strength. This was definitely a big tree. Even if he didn’t rely on it, there was no other way so he could only hold onto it tightly.
Dudian said: “Call Archer Wolf.”
“Yes.”
A moment later, Archer Wolf was summoned by Hawkeye.
Archer wolf was a bit nervous as he saw Dudian again. He didn’t dare to put on airs. His attitude was extremely humble: “Elder, you are here. Come and sit in my office. The air is good there.”
Dudian waved his hand: “It doesn’t matter. I just want to ask you a few questions.”
“I will tell you everything…”shooting wolf laughed.
Dudian casually said: “Tell me as much as you know about Pope Richelieu. Including his family, friends, lover, family and so on.”
Shooting Wolf was startled but quickly understood. Dudian was now the existence of the twelve elders of the dark church. It was not unusual for him to inquire about the archenemy of the dark church. He didn’t hesitate, dudian immediately said: “I don’t know much about the pope. I only know that the Pope was a talented knight when he was young. Moreover, he was born into a noble family. However, the Pope’s family has always been very low-key. He can’t be compared to other small families, not to mention Scott and Mel.”
“Is it to avoid suspicion? It is normal.”Dudian nodded: “There shouldn’t be many families left. Has He not contacted his family for a long time?”
“Yes.”Shooting wolf nodded: “In order to prevent the Dark Church… … We have threatened him. He has separated from his family. Ordinary civilians don’t even know that he has a family or that he is a noble.”
Dudian nodded: “What about his lover and children?”
Shooting wolf shook his head: “I don’t know about that.”
Dudian quietly looked at him. He got up and said to Hawkeye: “Lead the way to the torture chamber. You come too.”
Shooting Wolf was startled. He felt that something was wrong. Was Dudian going to torture him? But it seemed that Dudian didn’t intend to torture him. Moreover there was no reason for him to torture him!
He decided to take a look first and followed behind dudian.
Hawkeye led them to another underground torture chamber. This was an important prison in the ninth region. Most of the prisoners were from the dark church, the other group were from the Holy Church. There were people from the military and the magistrate. There were even nobles who were imprisoned there.
The three of them went straight to the torture room. Dudian glanced at the torture instruments in the room. There were many kinds of torture rooms in the dark church. They were more than ten times more exaggerated than the ones in Thorn Flower Prison. He suddenly felt lucky, fortunately he had entered thorn flower prison and not the prison of the dark church.
Now his identity was different. The things he knew were different. Although Thorn Flower Prison was known as the first prison in the outer wall but it was only the first prison on the surface. There were many prisons that were more terrifying than thorn flower, the two largest prisons were the ‘penitentiary’of the holy church and the top secret torture room of the military. Anyone who was imprisoned in the outer wall would be able to shake the Earth with a stomp, any one of them was either a great potion master or a general.
“Old Man, come and have a taste.”Dudian said to shooting wolf.
Archer wolf was startled and forced a smile: “Elder, you are so humorous.”
“It’s your humor.”Dudian picked up a chain from the wall and came in front of Archer Wolf. He wrapped the chain around his body.
Archer wolf was scared and didn’t dare to move. He saw Dudian’s slow appearance. He still had hope that Dudian was just trying to scare him and didn’t mean to do anything serious. After all, he was an elder, moreover, he didn’t offend Dudian.
Hawkeye was surprised to see this scene but he covered his eyes. He quietly looked down at his toes and didn’t dare to show any thoughts.
Dudian came to the back of the archer wolf. He suddenly pulled his palm. The sound of clothes being cut echoed along with the screams of the Archer Wolf.
Dudian tightened the two ends of the chain. The finger-long triangular spikes of the chain pierced into the body of the shooting wolf. Blood stained the robe.
Dudian tied the chain and kicked the back of the shooting wolf. He went to the rack next to the shooting wolf and picked two new instruments, he said: “You are a spy arranged by Richelieu. You used to be the administrator of the highest library of the Holy Church. You should have read a lot of books. If you can’t tell the truth about the situation of the pope then I can only tell you one word at a time.”
The wolf’s body was in extreme pain as he heard Dudian’s words. He felt that the pain was gone. He looked at Dudian in horror. If Dudian only said the first sentence then he would be able to refute, but he didn’t think that Dudian knew that he was the librarian of the library. In addition to the pope few people knew about his identity.
Since Dudian knew about this, it meant that he had the exact information!
However, he still wanted to struggle: “Elder, you misunderstood me. I, I am not a librarian or an undercover. I…”
“Ignorant…”Dudian shook his head and immediately went to torture.
Half an hour later, the bloody shooting wolf finally opened its mouth and confessed a lot of information.
Dudian continued to torture the wolf until it was dead. He confirmed that he had dug out all the information he knew.
He was very satisfied. He asked Hawkeye to deal with the body and appointed Hawkeye as the elder of District 9 from now on.

chapters.title: Chapter 632
chapters.content:
Chapter 632 – Chapter 632: “Are You Still Willing To Follow Me [ Two In One ] ?
In a gorgeous palace on Mt. Utto, the maid in charge of taking care of the “Young master”was looking around the room. This room was really too big, like a hall in a great hall. The dome was high and the area was wide, it was hard to imagine that this was just a bedroom for a child who was less than 1.6 meters tall.
“Young master, come out quickly. Don’t hide anymore,”the maid shouted anxiously.
Her voice echoed in the empty room and spread far away.
Seeing that her call was ineffective, the maid had no choice but to walk into the room and search everywhere. When she went deep into the room, a figure jumped out from behind a stone pillar near the door and rushed out of the room quickly. The sound of the door closing startled the maid. When she looked back, she was immediately shocked, she hurriedly chased after him, “Young master, don’t go out. Come back quickly…”as she shouted, she opened the door and chased after him.
At the corner of the corridor, a small figure quickly disappeared.
Boise ran all the way and quickly ran out of the square. He came to a white jade-like step that led to Saint Mark’s Square at the top of the mountain. The two knights of light who were guarding the step saw the young master and quickly bowed respectfully.
Boise immediately said, “They said that my grandfather is missing. Is that true?”
The two knights of light looked at each other. One of them winked at the other and advised him not to say anything.
Although Boise was young, he had always been a mischievous person. When he saw this person winking at him, he immediately became angry and shouted, “If you don’t tell me the truth, I will demote you to the outside world and make you apprentice apprentices. I will chase after the followers of the dark church every day!”
The two knights of Light’s expressions changed slightly. Although this young master did not have the right, but… his grandfather, the Pope, did! Moreover, the wet nurse who took care of him had always doted on him. He was also one of the eight cardinal. If this little guy were to report him to her, he would definitely be dismissed from his position. Chasing after the dark cult members every day? What kind of joke was this? That was a life-threatening matter!
Another knight hurriedly smiled apologetically and said, “Young master, don’t be anxious. The pope has not gone missing. He has only encountered some problems and has temporarily left Mount Utopia. He is secretly planning to exterminate the dark cult in another place.”
Puyce looked straight at him. “Really?”
“Really.”The knight immediately said solemnly.
Seeing his serious gaze, platinum believed him for the time being. He snorted and said, “Move aside.”
The two of them left and moved aside.
Platinum immediately ran up the stairs at high speed. He took four to five steps in one step. His speed was astonishing, like a cheetah in the forest.
The two knights of light turned their heads to look at the back of the young master who was leaving quickly. They were secretly speechless. One of them exclaimed in a low voice, “The young master’s strength is probably stronger than both of us, right?”
“More than that…”the other knight exclaimed, “The young master has been trained by the Great Radiant King since he was three years old. He is already nine years old now. If he were to fight, he would probably be able to compete with the Great Radiant King!”
“When the young master grows up, he will be the future Great Radiant King!”
While the two knights of light sighed, Boise ran up the mountain path at high speed. When he was halfway up, a gust of strong wind suddenly swept over from the mountain forest beside the steps. Immediately, fallen leaves flew in all directions.
Boise raised his hand to cover his eyes, causing the strong wind to disappear. When he lowered his palm, he immediately saw that he was enveloped by a shadow.
“You…”Boise looked at this person in shock.
..
..
On a small hill at the edge of Utto Mountain, there were apprentices and low-level knights of light who were stationed here. In one of the shabby houses.., barton carried his sweat-stained clothes to the well. He poured water into the wooden basin and went back to his room. He was going to soak the clothes for a while before washing them.
He had just returned to his room. Before he sat down, a calm voice suddenly sounded in the room: “Long time no see. How are you?”
Barton was startled. He looked in horror and saw a black-haired figure sitting by his bed. He was stunned when he saw his face: “Dean?”
He was stunned for a while before he reacted: “You, why are you here? We are the only ones who can come in here. You, did you sneak in?”
Dudian quietly looked at him: “I came here to look for you.”
“Look for me?”Barton suddenly noticed that there was a child lying on the bed behind Dudian. It seemed that he was asleep.
“Have you heard about my matter?”Dudian quietly asked.
Barton was aware that Dudian had sent him to a down and out noble family. He had participated in the assessment when the Holy Church had recruited him as a knight apprentice. Although his hair color wasn’t golden and his body had some deformities and problems, but because he was a noble, he had passed the assessment and became a member of the Holy Church. After becoming a Knight Apprentice, his life and perception had changed dramatically. He was no longer the poor kid who sneaked into the commercial district from the slums, he was no longer a bird without a nest living under Dudian’s wings.
As a trainee Knight of light, he naturally had the right to read the newspapers of the Holy Church for free. He had learned a lot from them, he also saw the news that Dudian had colluded with the dark church and was arrested in the inner wall.
“I, I heard about it.”Barton looked at the living dudian. He was no longer the poor kid who looked up at the commercial district. He knew that.., the inner wall was the most mysterious place that he had heard about since he was young. It was far more powerful than the commercial district. Even the ancient nobles who were doing well in the commercial district were desperate to join the inner wall, this was the best proof.
“Why are you here? Weren’t you caught in the inner wall? Did you… sneak out of the inner wall?”
Dudian nodded and stared at him: “I need you now. Are you willing to follow me?”
Barton was stunned.
Continue to follow Dudian?
He had thought about this question before Dudian appeared. He had asked himself. Every night when it was quiet, he would ask himself in secret. The answer was firm and had been shaken.
After all, he had lived in poverty in the orphanage. He couldn’t bear to look back at it. After following Dudian, he had been living in fear of being found by the magistrate, he was afraid of being punished by the holy church. He was afraid that he would be thrown onto the fire to be barbecued by the evil cult.
Now he had become a trainee Knight of light. Although his days weren’t very good but at least he had enough to eat and wear warm clothes. He was able to raise his head and walk on the street, the people around him weren’t looking at him in disdain or disgust but in awe. This was something that he had never imagined before. Even when he was following Dudian he was rich but people were looking at him, there was still disgust because of the color of his hair and the dark spots of radiation on his body.
But now these were covered by the shining armor of the Knight of light. He no longer felt inferior.
“Give up all of this and follow him…”Barton asked himself in his heart. Was It Worth It? was he willing?
Dudian quietly looked at him.
After a long time, Barton took a deep breath and looked at dudian seriously: “I’m Willing!”
Dudian was slightly startled. There was a trace of gentleness in his calm eyes but it disappeared in the blink of an eye: “Really?”
Barton nodded: “Yes!”
“Why?”
“Because I said that I am willing to follow you for a lifetime! I am stupid but at least I know that I must keep my promise!”Barton said word by word.
Dudian was silent for a moment: “Your choice is correct.”
Barton smiled and sighed, he wryly smiled: “Honestly, I don’t know what I am doing. I don’t know if I am crazy or not. I lost such a good job and went crazy with you. However, my life was given to me by you. I was able to come here and join the Holy Church because of you. Although I am a bit reluctant but I can’t forget my roots, right?”
Dudian stared at him for a moment. He slowly stood up and patted Barton’s shoulder.
Barton grinned: “You don’t have to comfort me. We are brothers who have risked our lives!”
“I’m sorry that you lost this job. I will make it up to you. I will find you a new job in a few days.”
“I have given up the opportunity to become a Knight of light. There is no need to look for other new jobs. I will follow you!”
“The new job is to be a pope. Are you willing to do it?”
“What?”
..
… ..
After leaving Barton’s residence, Dudian went to a nearby hotel. He saw Aisha sitting in the room. She didn’t move. She was sitting in the same position as when he left. He immediately went forward to hold her hand, he whispered: “I’m sorry to have kept you waiting.”
Aisha didn’t say anything.
Dudian held her hand and whispered: “We will go back now. I will accompany you. You Won’t be angry with me, right?”
Aisha looked at him expressionlessly.
Dudian looked up at her with gentle eyes: “Let’s go.”He pulled her up from the bed and left the hotel.
It was five o’clock in the afternoon when they returned to the castle. The Sun had set.
Richelieu was monitored in the castle. He couldn’t go out or send messages. He was guarded at all times. When Dudian came back he saw a familiar figure, he felt that his blood was frozen. His fingers were trembling. He felt anger spread out from his chest. He stared at Dudian, “What did you do to him? !”
“He is just unconscious. He is not dead yet. Don’t worry.”Dudian saw his reaction: “It seems there is no wrong person.”
Richelieu woke up but he couldn’t control his anger. He gritted his teeth: “He is just a child. I have pledged my loyalty to you. Why Don’t You Believe Me? Why did you use a child to blackmail me? !”
“In my eyes, he is just a bargaining chip.”
“You!”Richelieu clenched his fingers. He suddenly thought of a question: “How did you find Him?”
“Didn’t you confess to the elders of the Ninth District?”Dudian indifferently said: “If you can betray others, why can’t others betray you?”
Richelieu’s face changed: “He won’t betray me. What did you do to him?”
“Kill him.”Dudian didn’t want to tease him anymore: “He is very loyal to you. I tortured him to death so he squeezed out your information bit by bit. It’s a pity.”
Richelieu roared: “You scum! !”
“Scum means the scum of the human race. Obviously I’m not.”Dudian calmly replied.
Richelieu growled: “There are many ways to get him to confess my information. Why did you kill him? !”
“Because of the efficiency.”
“You!”Richelieu gritted his teeth as he tried to endure: “He used to be a librarian. He has never left the library. He has never done anything bad in his life. Why Are You So Cruel?”
“Pigs have never done anything bad. Aren’t they dead?”Dudian indifferently said.
Richelieu was so angry that he couldn’t speak.
“Since you have such a kind heart, you should cooperate more in the future.”Dudian handed platinum to Glenn: “Take him away. You will personally take care of him. The strength of this kid is close to that of a senior hunter.”
Glenn was shocked as she looked at the kid in her hand. He was so young but he had the strength close to that of a senior hunter?
She finally understood the difference between having a background and having no background. She had lost at the starting line from birth.
Richelieu looked at Dudian in anger. He knew that there was no point in getting angry at this time. The more angry he was, the more he would fall into a trap. He took a deep breath, “You have my life in your hands. If something happens then you can harvest my life at any time. Why do you want to do this?”
“There is nothing wrong with adding a few sets of protection to the useful cards.”Dudian casually sat on the sofa, “As long as you cooperate with me you will be fine. What are you angry about? Are you angry that you want to betray me but you can’t do anything?”
Richelieu put away the anger on his face: “No, I have never thought of betraying you.”
Dudian waved his hand: “I have solved the problem of the five supervisors. What should I do next?”
Richelieu looked up in horror: “Five, five supervisors, are all dead? !”
Dudian nodded.
Richelieu’s eyelids twitched as he was shocked. In less than a day Dudian had killed five instructors. The speed was like cutting wheat!
“I know.”He suppressed the shock in his heart: “I will cooperate with you and let your people ascend to the throne.”
..
..
When he was writing more than 3,000 words, he suddenly touched the keyboard. The words were all gone, and he was almost shocked. Fortunately, he retreated a few times and came out again. Hu ~ ~

chapters.title: Chapter 633
chapters.content:
Chapter 633 – Chapter 633: The Bottom Line That Can Not Be Crossed
That night, Dudian took Aisha and left the castle after dinner. They walked straight along the suburbs. Half an hour later, they came to the golden wall which had been built. He found a weak place to guard it, he climbed over the wall and ran in a direction.
Ivette was sitting by the stone in front of the snow-white waterfall. The water splashed on the bluestone in front of her. Looking at the countless splashes of water, her eyes were a little dazed. Many things had happened recently that made her confused, but she could not find the answer.
After a long time, the sound of footsteps suddenly came from behind her.
She woke up from her shock and suddenly turned back to look, only to see her personal maid walking over from the forest.
“Your Highness.”The Maid was wearing a tiger-skin beast robe and said respectfully, “It’s so late at night. Don’t you want to go back and rest?”
Yvette’s tensed nerves slowly relaxed. She withdrew her gaze and looked at the broken water in front of her. She said in a low voice, “You go back first. I’ll sit for a while.”
The maid glanced at her. She wanted to say something but hesitated. In the end, she held it in and silently retreated into the forest. She did not leave but waited quietly.
The Silver Moon Hung High in the sky. The cold light shone on the waterfall, and a trace of cold air spread.
Yvette looked at the surface of the water, which was surging with dark waves, and was in a daze. Suddenly, a soft snort came from the dense forest behind her, as if a stone had fallen from the tree. She was shocked, and immediately turned her head to look. Immediately, she saw two slender figures slowly walking out of the dense forest.
The Shadows on the treetops faded away from the two of them, revealing their faces.
Ivette who had quietly touched the dagger at her waist was stunned. It was like a long-lost nightmare that suddenly came to her face. She felt suffocated and even forgot to breathe.
“It… It’s You?”Ivette looked at the teenager in a daze.
Dudian quietly looked at her, “Are You Alright?”
Ivette’s face slightly changed as she whispered: “How did you come in? This is our forbidden area!”
“You came in.”Dudian replied: “It seems that you are not doing well.”
Ivette was aware of the purpose of his visit. She whispered: “I am doing well.”
Dudian’s eyes were indifferent: “How is the task?”
“It is still in progress.”Ivette whispered: “Give me more time and I will be able to complete it.”
“Time is precious. It is not something you can ask for.”Dudian said: “What Stage have you completed? Have you become your king?”
Ivette’s face slightly changed: “Not yet. We have to take it slowly…”
“Does that mean your father is still alive?”
“I. . .”
“You don’t have the heart to kill him right?”Dudian’s eyes were deep, “In fact, you don’t have to kill him. You can force him to abdicate. As long as the goal is achieved, killing him or not is secondary.”
Ivette was aware of this point. But she knew that with her father’s character, it was impossible to force him to abdicate under house arrest. Moreover, she couldn’t do it.., “Give me more time. I have got my father’s attention. According to you I have performed very well. In a period of time my father will pass the throne to me!”
“I can’t wait.”Dudian indifferently said: “You have two choices. First, I will help you kill him and help you settle everything. You just need to do your job well and listen to my instructions. Second, you and your father will die together!”
Ivette was stunned as tears welled up in her eyes: “Why? Why are you forcing me?”
“You are forcing me.”
“I can help you to persuade my father. Moreover, you have such a strong power. You can personally kidnap my father and make him listen to you. Why do you have to kill him?”Ivette growled in anger.
Dudian indifferently said: “I’m old. I’m not afraid of death. It’s not easy to kidnap him. I need an ambitious person who has desires and is easy to manage.”
Ivette looked at him in a daze. She suddenly understood that the teenager in front of her was a cold-blooded monster. Instead of begging for his forgiveness, she should think of other ways to gain a glimmer of hope. She took a deep breath, “I can help you to persuade my father. He will definitely listen to you. If you are not willing then give me some time. Just one day. I want to try my method.”
“There is no point in delaying.”Dudian looked at her coldly. “I am very disappointed in you.”
“You!”Ivette’s eyes turned red with anger.
“How many of your brothers and sisters dream of getting such an opportunity but you don’t know how to cherish it?”Dudian said in a cold tone: “There are people who are willing to do things that you are not willing to do.”
Ivette’s face turned pale: “No, please don’t. I really can’t do it. I can listen to you but… I really can’t Kill My Father!”
“Then you should accompany your father.”Dudian slowly walked towards her.
Ivette looked at him in horror. Her eyes were full of despair. She knew that this teenager was very powerful. She couldn’t fight back with her own strength.
“You… you are so cruel and crazy. You will get retribution sooner or later!”Ivette cursed in grief.
“I have got all the retribution.”Dudian looked at her indifferently, “It has been proven that cruelty has nothing to do with retribution. It is like you rejected me so you are dead. If you are cruel and agree with me then you will live well. Can this be considered retribution?” The big hand slowly stretched out.
Yvette growled in grief and anger as she fiercely waved the dagger.
Dudian quickly turned his wrist and hit the dagger in her hand. He lifted her body and pulled her in front of him. He grabbed her neck and twisted it. Kacha! Her head was suddenly broken and there was no sound.
Dudian slowly put her body down and threw her into the huge waterfall in front of him.
“Faith has harmed you…”Dudian muttered to himself. He slowly turned around and left the place with Aisha by the side of the dense forest.
In a luxurious tent on the hill, Ian Lal was sitting at the wine table. He was burping and wiping his sword. He had killed a general in the last battle. The quality of this sword was first-class, it was much better than the weapons of the Barbarians. The only drawback was that it looked good and was not durable.
After wiping the sword, he waved it twice. The swishing sound was extremely sharp, and he could not help but laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 634
chapters.content:
Chapter 634 – Chapter 634: Evil Becomes King
“Nice sword.”A calm voice sounded.
Ian was shocked and sobered up a lot. He turned his head and saw two people wearing strange clothes. He had seen the strange clothes of the people inside the tent!
“Assassin?”Ian narrowed his eyes. There was a murderous look on his face: “How did you come in? Who Was Your Insider?”
“Unfortunately, I can’t kill the person I want to kill the most. No matter how sharp the sword is, it is useless.”Dudian indifferently said: “Don’t worry, I just came to make a deal with you.”
“Deal?”Ian raised his eyebrows and sneered: “Nonsense, die!”He suddenly rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian looked at him as he rapidly approached. He suddenly stretched out his fingers and pinched the tip of the sword. He pulled the tip of the sword and twisted it. The sword was extremely flexible as it bent and stabbed towards Ian.
Iannar’s pupils shrank as he quickly retreated.
Dudian quickly kicked him under the knee. The pain made his feet slide back and he almost knelt down. Dudian reached out and grabbed his neck, although IANNAR had a burly body that was unique to barbarians. He was more than two meters tall. But at the moment he was squatting in front of dudian.
“Can we talk about it now?”Dudian asked.
Iannard’s face was full of fear. He didn’t expect that he would be subdued by someone with his own strength. He wasn’t drunk or careless, but the other party was too strong. Both his strength and speed were far superior to him.
“Talk, talk about what?”Ian reluctantly asked. He suddenly noticed that the noise of the fight didn’t disturb the attendants outside. Could it be..
Dudian let go of his hands and indifferently said: “I know you. You are one of the most outstanding princes. Do you want to be the king of the Barbarians?”
Ian’s face turned ugly: “How Do You Know About Me? Who told you about me?”
“Your sister, Ivette.”
“Her? I knew it! That damned slut is not a good person!”Ian clenched his fists in anger.
Dudian glanced at him: “From a certain point of view, she is better than you.”
Ian raised his head and looked at him. He didn’t dare to refute but was angry.
“I came to find you today to help you fulfill your wish.”Dudian said.
Ian stared at him: “Help me fulfill my wish? You, you want me to…”
“Not bad, not bad.”Dudian praised but there was no smile on his face.
The shock in Ian’s eyes slowly disappeared. He suddenly thought of something and looked at dudian suspiciously: “Are you sent by my father to test me? If so, isn’t this method too bad?”
Dudian indifferently said: “If your father had my help, he would have been able to break through the wall and occupy the wall.”
Iannar was startled. He knew that Dudian wasn’t bluffing. With the help of such a person, he could sneak into the wall and assassinate the leaders of the military, he would be able to play a great role in the war.
“If you are willing to be the king, I will fulfill your wish. But you need to listen to me.”Dudian indifferently said.
Ian’s heart sank. His eyes flashed. He knew that if he agreed to the throne then he would be a puppet. But if he didn’t agree then there would be no good outcome, it was better to deal with it first.
“I promise you.”He immediately said.
Dudian nodded: “Then you will kill your father. The throne will be yours.”
Ian was stunned: “Isn’t this too rash?”
“You don’t want to?”
“Yes, of course I do!”Ian smiled bitterly, “But my father is always protected by others. I Can’t get close to him. Moreover I can’t bring weapons to meet him. I Can’t kill him. If I could kill him then I would…”
“I will help you.”Dudian said: “Come with me.”
Ian stared at Dudian. He suddenly thought of something, “Lord, please wait. Even if you help me kill my father I’m afraid I Won’t be able to ascend the throne. My other brothers are very strong. If my father dies then no one will suppress them. Most likely they will fight for the throne. I’m afraid I won’t be able to…”
“Which brother do you think is a threat? I’ll help you kill them.”Dudian said.
Iannard was stunned for a long time. He was surprised: “Really?”
“Yes.”
“Good!”Iannard was excited and immediately nodded.
… ..
… ..
