The night was dark. There was a sudden sound of a bell. At the same time, a fire lit the lampstand. The Flames burned several barbarian royal tents. Cries, flames and slaughter intertwined in the night.
The entire hill was in chaos. It was not until dawn that the hill regained its peace. Only the smoke of the tents burning into ashes gently drifted into the distance. Meanwhile, Iannar held a sword in his hand and wore a divine armor. The tip of the sword was pointed at the neck of a beautiful and dignified woman, he said coldly, “Mother, where is the king of beasts weapon card? Even if you don’t tell me, I will find it sooner or later!”
The woman looked at him with grief and anger. “Kill me. Even if you kill me, you won’t get it, You Beast!”
“Father is dead, and I am the King of tomorrow. Mother, don’t force me!”Iannar said angrily.
“King? Pah! You Beast, I shouldn’t have given birth to you. If I knew this day would come, I would have strangled you to death in the Cradle!”The woman was so angry that her eyes were red, her beautiful face was stained with dried tears. She looked at Iannar in anger, completely unafraid of the tip of the sword on her neck.
IANNAR’s gaze was gloomy. He took a deep breath and said, “Mother, you forced me!”As he said that, he turned around and shouted, “Bring them up!”
“Yes!”One of his trusted servants answered and turned around to leave. Soon, he carried three seven or eight-year-old children who were bound by iron chains. There were two men and a woman. They were all wearing high-grade beast robes.
“Mother, brother…”one of the girls had a face full of fear. She looked at her mother, who was sitting in the ruins, and her brother, who was holding a blood-stained sword in front of her. She was at a loss.
The woman saw the three children who were tied up. She hurriedly wanted to rush up and hug them, but she was stopped by Ianlal’s sharp sword.
“Mother, I’ll give you three minutes to consider. If you don’t say it, I’ll kill them. I’ll kill one every minute. It’s up to you!”IANLAL’s gaze was cold as he turned around and waved at his subordinates.
The trusted aide beside him understood and immediately grabbed one of the boys and pressed his sword against his neck.
When the woman saw this scene, her eyes were about to crack as she said angrily, “Let him go! You let him go! How dare you touch the Royal Family! Do You Want to die? ! !”
The trusted aide’s expression changed slightly as he looked at Iannar.
Iannar looked at his mother coldly and said, “Hurry up and say it. One minute is almost up.”
The woman raised her head and looked at him angrily, “Your father loves you so much. Why did you do such a crazy thing? Even if you didn’t do it, your father would have passed the throne to you. Why did you do such a stupid thing? !”
“How would I know if he passed it on or not? Now that he’s dead, don’t make it sound so nice.”Iannar’s eyes were slightly cold as he said, “The time is up.”He waved his hand.
Seeing this, his trusted aide reached out with his palm. With a Puchi Sound, the sharp sword instantly pierced into the boy’s neck. Fresh blood flowed out. Before the boy could scream, he fell to the ground and died.
IANLAL’s gaze was deep and cold as he said, “Mother, aren’t you going to say it?”
The woman stared blankly at the boy who fell to the ground. Her mind went blank. After a while, she slowly regained her senses. She raised her head to look at this burly son who had once made her proud, but at this moment, she felt that he was so unfamiliar, she was stunned for a moment. Suddenly, she noticed two people wearing strange clothes standing behind her son. She immediately thought of the scene when these two people had killed a few generals who had come to guard, she felt a chill in her heart and an indescribable anger, her voice trembled as she said, “Did you do this because you listened to their instructions? Are they people inside the wall? You actually colluded with people inside the wall and killed your father and brothers. You, you…”
“As long as I can become a king, I don’t care even if my bones are piled up on this mountain.”IANNARAL’s eyes were cold, he said, “If you want to blame someone, blame father for not knowing his place. I originally didn’t want to kill him. I tried to persuade him, but he actually berated me and said I was stupid. Hehe… now that he’s dead, he deserves to die!”

chapters.title: Chapter 635
chapters.content:
Chapter 635 – Chapter 635: The Storm Is Coming
“You! You have gone mad!”The woman was so angry that her body was trembling, and she could not speak.
“If this is madness, then I have long gone mad,”Iannar said indifferently. “It has been two minutes, dear mother. You have caused the death of another one of your children.”As he spoke, he raised his hand slightly.
The trusted servant understood and grabbed one of the girls. He stabbed the dagger fiercely, and with a puchi sound, it pierced through the back of the girl’s cervical vertebra. As soon as she let out a scream, she stopped abruptly, and the girl’s body withered and fell down like a flower petal.
The woman was stunned for a moment. She suddenly pounced on IANNAR and roared hysterically, “I’m going to kill you! !”
Iannar frowned slightly. He shook his wrist and the sharp sword shot out like silver light. With a puff, it pierced through the woman’s chest. The woman’s body froze and coughed out a mouthful of blood. She raised her head in disbelief and looked at Iannar who was as cold as ice in a daze. Endless Despair and sorrow slowly flowed out of her eyes.
“Why do you want to force my hand to be covered in blood?”Ian whispered as he looked at her. He pulled the sword back. Blood splashed and fell onto the charred ground.
The woman’s body fell down like a beautiful butterfly. She didn’t move at all.
Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of cold killing intent as he looked at the woman. He slowly loosened his grip after a moment. He looked at Ian: “How do you control the Barbarians if you kill her?”
Ian put the sword back into its scabbard and turned to look at Dudian, “My father and mother are dead and the other big brothers and sisters have been killed by you. We have complete control over this place and there are people everywhere. As long as we block the news and invite the ‘Prophet’to recommend me to ascend the throne, it doesn’t matter if I find the Beast King Weapon Card or not. I Can Forge One. Whoever dares to verify it will die!”
Dudian looked at him for a moment and nodded: “It seems that I didn’t choose the wrong person.”
Ian smiled: “You chose me. I am the only king from today. Please let me know if there is anything you need me to do.”
Dudian looked at him: “You don’t need to worry about this. I need you to do things that are good for you and all your clansmen.”
“Oh?”Ian’s eyes slightly moved.
“I will come to find you after you have stabilized your position.”Dudian coldly said: “In three to five days, prepare your troops. I will make an area in the wall for you to live in. From now on, you don’t have to live in this barren and harsh place.”
“Really?”Ian’s eyes lit up but his heart was full of doubt.
Dudian didn’t want to stay any longer. He took Aisha’s cold hand and left the mountain.
The faint smile on Ian’s face disappeared as he saw Dudian and Aisha’s figures disappear. His eyes were gloomy and cold.
“Your Highness, we have control of all the forces on the mountain. Should we send people to take them down?”His trusted aide immediately asked.
Iannarre shot him a cold glance, “Can’t you see how powerful he is? He alone can wipe out all the members of our royal family. Who Can you send to stop him? Even Lord Netherworld, who is by my father’s side, was beheaded by him with a single slap.”
The trusted aide jumped in fright and said, “This, is the person inside the wall that powerful?”
IANLAL snorted coldly and said, “It’s getting late. Immediately pass down the order to seal off the entire mountain and not allow anyone to leave. Also, immediately get someone to bring the Prophet Here!”
“Yes!”His trusted aide hurriedly agreed. He immediately saw a few corpses on the ground and said carefully, “Your Highness, should we… deal with this?”
Hearing this, Ianlal glanced at his mother who was lying on the ground, as well as the corpses of his two younger brothers and sisters beside him. There was also another younger brother who was pale and frightened. He was slightly silent, he whispered: “Call a few people to carry them down. Don’t destroy my mother’s body. I still have use for it.”
“Yes.”
..
..
Dean held Aisha’s hand as they walked on the wilderness and returned to the wall.
The grass and fragrance along the way made him slow down. He turned to Aisha and said: “The first time we met seemed to be on the grassland outside the wall. Do you remember?”
Aisha was silent.
“I was hunting a monster. Can you remember?”
“Forget it. It’s okay if you can’t remember now. You will remember sooner or later.”
Both of them walked in the wilderness and gradually returned to the front of the golden wall. Dudian looked up at the light coming from the wall. He sighed and led Aisha to find a place where the guards were weak, they climbed over the wall and quickly walked back to the castle.
Nicholas immediately said to dudian: “Master, the Things You Asked Me to prepare are ready. What should we do next?”
“Open a factory and produce the finished products. I will give you the production process later.”Dudian sat on the sofa and drank a mouthful of tea, “I will send a few great potioneers from the dark church to assist you. You just need to find a place to build the factory. If you don’t have enough funds then look for Noyce. He will be in charge of the funds in the future.”
“The great potioneers from the Dark Church?”Nicholas was speechless. He was a big shot who could cause a sensation even if he stomped his feet. But now it seemed that he could only be a subordinate of dudian.
Neuss looked at dudian in a daze: “I… I am in charge of the funds?”
Dudian nodded, “Do you know how to calculate accounts? Don’t hurry to learn. I will hand over the future finance to you. You will be in charge of the money of the twelve regions of the dark church as well as the money of the Holy Church and the chambers of commerce. If you have nothing to do then hurry up and learn how to manage finance. If you don’t know then go to Hawkeye. He will introduce some outstanding financial managers to you.”
Neuss was in disbelief. Finance was the lifeblood of the outer wall. How could dudian hand over such an important thing to him? Moreover it wasn’t just a little money. It was almost all of the money in the outer wall!
It could be said that he would be the richest man in the outer wall!
“I, I know. I will learn soon!”Neuss was so excited that he wanted to shout. He suddenly thought of what would happen when he returned to his family? What would the expressions of those who despised him when he was in prison be like? He couldn’t help but feel excited. He was determined to learn financial management at all costs!
Nicholas saw that Dudian had handed such an important thing to Neuss. He was a bit jealous but didn’t dare to show it. He was bitter and regretful. He thought that if he hadn’t betrayed Dudian.., neuss was loyal to him from the beginning to the end. Perhaps he would be able to manage the finances for Dudian. After all, he was the Butler!
Moreover, managing the finances was only on the surface. He was jealous that Neuss would become Dudian’s right-hand man!
One must know that money was necessary to do things. Dudian had handed this to Neuss. It meant that he would use Neuss in the future!
Moreover according to Dudian’s current plan he knew that this was a road of no return. If he failed then they would be buried together with him. If he succeeded then he would become the top class Person!
“Master, where are we going to sell the finished products?”Nicholas asked.
Dudian indifferently said: “We are not in a hurry to sell the finished products. The more we accumulate the better.”
“I know.”Nicholas respectfully replied.
“Master!”Sergei came down the stairs. He saw Dudian in the living room: “Richelieu wants to see you.”
Dudian frowned: “I will come in a moment.”He looked at Nicholas: “Come to my study later. I have a list for you. Help me to buy some materials.”
“Yes.”Nicholas respectfully replied.
Dudian went upstairs and came to the room where Richelieu was staying.
Sergei stood in front of the door and opened it for Dudian.
Dudian saw Richelieu sitting on the floor. He looked haggard as he entered the room: “You can change your clothes in my room. You Don’t need to wear such heavy robes.”
Richelieu rushed up to dudian: “Didn’t we agree that I was completely loyal to you? Why didn’t you give me the antidote to cure my poison? How can you not keep your word?”
Dudian saw the red mark on Richelieu’s arm, dudian indifferently said: “I was afraid that you wouldn’t listen to me. The effect of the poison was strong and mixed with your blood. You need to take the antidote a few more times to completely cure it.”
Richelieu hurriedly said: “Give it to me!”
“Write down the names of all the Cardinals in the holy church and their families. I will consider how much to give you.”Dudian calmly sat down.
Richelieu hesitated for a moment but he quickly went back to the table. He picked up a pen and paper and quickly wrote. Even other deeper secrets had been exposed to dudian, moreover, with Dudian’s means, he didn’t need to go through Richelieu to know about this. It would take more time so it wasn’t considered top secret information.
Soon, a document was handed to Dudian.
Dudian looked at it and nodded to Sergei.
Sergei left and went to Dudian’s basement. He took the “Mulberry Leaf cigarette”.
Richelieu was impatient. He saw the cigarette in Sergei’s hand and rushed over.
Sergei wanted to dodge but the cigarette disappeared in front of his eyes. He couldn’t help but be shocked.
Dudian quietly looked at Richelieu who was impatient to light the cigarette. He slowly got up and called Sergei: “Go Out.”Dudian closed the door after the two left the room, sergei asked: “How are the members of the Mel Family?”
“Young master, I have been torturing them as you have instructed. The two women are about to collapse. They are the same as the pope. They are asking for the antidote.”Sergei replied honestly.
Dudian nodded: “Give them one antidote every day. Give it to them when they give up their dignity.”
Sergei looked up at dudian: “Young Master, are you torturing them just for revenge?”
“If they submit then they can be an example for other nobles.”Dudian’s eyes were calm, “These nobles have no title. They haven’t learned anything else. They have learned all the flaws of the nobles. They are proud and arrogant. It is difficult to tame them by force alone. It takes too much time. They are good examples. No matter how down and out the Mel family is, their prestige is still there. They represent the pride of all the nobles.”
Sergei immediately understood: “I understand.”
Dudian patted his shoulder and told him to continue to guard the place. He went back to his study and wrote down the materials needed to build the high-voltage lightning fortress, the reason why he was ready to replace Richelieu’s pope position in seven days was not because it would take seven days but because he needed to make time to make his own trump card as soon as possible.
Although he had Aisha’s help now, which was stronger than his original plan, but the inner wall was full of strong people, so he couldn’t completely count on Aisha’s combat strength.
Time passed, and the Sun Rose and set.
When Dudian closed the door to build the Lightning fortress, the outside world kept exposing the news that shocked the entire outer wall.
For example, there was a scuffle in a certain neighborhood, which was suspected to be a war between the dark cultists and other pagans, which caused a lot of casualties. There was also a huge aristocratic family that suddenly announced that they were leaving the consortium, which caused countless people to be laid off and unemployed There was a shadow of barbarian activity at the border. It was suspected that there was a war… the people in the outer wall were shocked every day.
Many nobles and military officials were aware that there was a shocking change happening in the outer wall.
It seemed that there was an extremely fierce undercurrent lurking in the outer wall. No one knew when it would erupt!
In the blink of an eye, the seventh day arrived.
Dudian looked at Richelieu who had been locked in the study for the past few days. His face was obviously yellow and old. He asked: “Are You Ready?”
Richelieu’s mouth twitched. He whispered: “I have been ready for a long time. Are You Ready?”
“I have been ready for a long time.”
“Really? Once they give up the position, the monastery will soon find out. In addition to the five overseers, there are spies in other forces. Moreover, you have killed the five overseers for so many days. Perhaps they have known about the outer wall. They don’t want to alert the enemy. They want to see who is causing trouble.”Richelieu coughed, slowly: “Are you ready to face the onslaught of the Monasteries?”

chapters.title: Chapter 636
chapters.content:
Chapter 636 – Chapter 636: Alarming The Whole World
“Sooner or later we will face it. Why should we be afraid?”Dudian indifferently said: “Get Ready.”
Richelieu looked at him deeply and bowed his head: “Yes.”
Whoosh!
A snow pigeon landed on the windowsill of Carvey’s study. Carvey was recording the secret activities of the Dark Church’s third region in recent days. He was going to give it to the pope when he came back. He saw the snow pigeon that suddenly landed and disturbed him, he frowned and stopped writing. He took off the scroll from the snow pigeon’s foot and slowly rubbed it. After a while, his pupils constricted and he cried out in shock, “Pass the throne? Promote a little apprentice knight?”
The tiny words on the scroll were very clear. After a moment, Carvey slowly came back to his senses. He still found it hard to believe. He even felt that someone had secretly used this communication channel or replaced the letter.
“I’ll verify it first…”he thought to himself. He immediately took out a new piece of snow paper from the side and wrote with a brush.
On the other side, the famous poet, Antonia, was drinking wine and explaining the difference in rhythm between classical poetry and modern poetry to his two proud students. Suddenly, his eyebrows moved slightly, and a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes, he stopped his explanation without batting an eyelid, he said, “Today’s class is over. You should go back and think carefully about what was mentioned above. Remember, emotion is not the only thing in poetry. Not only does poetry have praise, it also has criticism. Most importantly, poetry must have dignity!”
“Yes.”
“Yes, teacher.”
The two students stood up respectfully, bowed, and left.
After the two students left, Antonia said indifferently, “Sir, come out.”
A figure covered in a black robe slowly walked out from a shadow behind the room. His body seemed to be covered in a blurry fog, making it difficult to see his face and figure clearly, he laughed softly and said, “The master has implanted the eye of a hunter. His perception is indeed not comparable to that of an ordinary person.”
“I don’t dare.”Antonia said indifferently, “Sir is the master.”
“You flatter me. We only know how to do some evil things like what you say. We can’t be compared to you, a great and proper poet.”The black-robed figure chuckled and then stopped laughing, he said, “I came to look for you today mainly because the Holy See has given you a mission. I hope you can complete it by today!”
“Huh? What Mission?”Antonia frowned.
The black-robed figure said in a low voice, “It’s the same. I’m still writing poems. This time, I’m writing a poem to praise an apprentice knight of the Holy See. His name is ‘Barton’!”
“Praise an apprentice knight?”Antonia was a little surprised. Moreover, he was from the Holy See? When did the dark church become so kind-hearted? He thought for a moment and said, “Is there anything special about this person?”
“There’s nothing special about him. He’s just an ordinary person.”The black-robed figure said slowly, “However, his identity is not that ordinary. He’s about to ascend to the throne and become the new pope.”
“New Pope?”Antonio suddenly stood up from his chair and looked at the black-robed figure in shock. “Are you saying that Richelieu is about to abdicate? How is that possible? How can this matter be so Sudden?”
“It is very sudden. That’s why I need you to write a hymn for the new pope to make everything seem more natural,”said the black-robed figure.
Antonia was stunned for a moment before he suddenly realized something. A chill rose in his heart as he said, “Could it be that the dark church is the mastermind behind the succession of popes? How is this possible!”
“These are not things that you should know. You should now think about how to write a hymn.”The black-robed figure said coldly, “After you finish writing the book and hand it over to the Les Chamber of Commerce, they will print it out for you immediately.”
“Les Chamber of Commerce?”Antonia’s expression changed slightly. Although he did not have a deep relationship with the dark church, he knew that the dark church was behind this chamber of Commerce. In other words, this matter was completely planned by the dark church!
He really found it hard to imagine how the dark church could suddenly get involved in the matter of the succession of popes. One had to know that the radiant church had been suppressing the dark church for so many years. Otherwise.., the Dark Church would not have to hide in the dark. After all, the process of hiding was very painful for many dark church members. They were hunted everywhere and could not be seen, they could only live alone in a dark place. Moreover, life was very inconvenient. This caused many dark church members to become more eccentric and cold as they entered the church.
However, now, the followers of the cult of Shadows had directly controlled the heart of the Church of light. This was simply unimaginable!
Once the Church of light was controlled by the Church of Shadows, he could not imagine what the outer wall would become in the future. When the light turned into darkness, but darkness mixed with the light, would it be chaos or destruction?
His thoughts were somewhat chaotic and confused. Soon.., the black-robed figure’s words interrupted his thoughts. “Another thing. In the afternoon, the Les Chamber of Commerce’s newspaper will send people to interview you. During the interview, please support the new pope, Mr. Barton. He is a great leader. I hope you will remember this!”
Antonia came back to his senses, and his expression changed. He knew that the other party wanted him to remember this sentence. It was to make him praise the new pope in the interview, and it had to revolve around this sentence, there must be no other negative words.
This interview was just for show. Even if he did not say so, the newspapers would most likely “Speak for him”.
“I understand.”He lowered his head slightly and agreed.
The dawn shone down from the slope of Mount Utto. The warm light dispelled the darkness and cold air that shrouded the countless buildings. The newspaper delivery man rode a fast horse and sent the newspapers to every family. Some were noble manors, some were rich people’s courtyards, and some were exquisite small houses. They were sent from the bustling area of the outer wall all the way to the suburbs, and then to various small towns and villages.
The newspaper delivery men were like ants, constantly moving around the streets, carrying information.
A farmer was drinking hot soup, eating cheese bread, and flipping through the morning newspaper at 7:30 am. He was enjoying this leisurely breakfast time. However, when the newspaper was opened, he was instantly stunned and widened his eyes, he had drunk so much that he forgot to swallow the soup. He almost let it flow out from the corner of his mouth. He was stunned as he looked at the biggest headline on the newspaper
“The ninth pope of the radiant church, Mr. Richelieu, will inherit the position of Pope today. A new person blessed by God will be in Charge!”
The farmer was stunned for a long time before he reacted. He quickly looked down. After a while, he finished reading the entire newspaper. At this moment, the hot soup was no longer hot. The cheese bread beside it was also cold, but he had completely forgotten about it, he fell into deep thought.
One had to know that the change in the pope was a huge matter even for an ordinary citizen like him! Other than spreading the faith and building the temple, the Holy See also controlled the division of land, as well as the taxation of part of the land, as well as the asylum tax. The so-called asylum tax was something that everyone had to pay, even the ordinary civilians in the civilian areas were no exception, unless they were so poor that they ended up in the slums and became refugees.
This asylum tax included many things, such as the invasion of the dark cultists, the invasion of the monsters outside the wall, and so on. However, it did not include the invasion of beasts, which was the responsibility of the military.
Therefore, if the pope was replaced, these taxes might change! This had happened in the past when the Pope was replaced. After the sixth Pope took office, the biggest change was the increase of the protection tax by 10% ! It made all the civilians miserable. Fortunately, the last pope was killed by the dark cultists after less than 10 years.
It was one of the few times in history when many people were grateful to the dark cultists.
“The new pope…”the farmer looked worried. The harvest this year was not good. If the new pope raised taxes, his family would be burdened, and they might even have to dismiss the serfs.
As the morning paper was issued, cries of surprise came one after another from the various manors and courtyards. This sudden news caught everyone off guard. They did not expect the change in the Pope to be so sudden, such a sudden change.., it had happened in history, but not often. Could it be that something had happened to the previous Pope’s body? For a time, countless people were speculating.
At the same time, they were also curious about the identity of the new pope.
In the room of the headquarters of the Tribunal, Feyerate looked at the newspaper in his hand and read it over and over again. He read every word carefully until there was no possibility of any mistakes. Then, he slowly put down the newspaper, with a bang, he suddenly slapped the newspaper on the table. Flames almost spurted out of his eyes. “Damn Richelieu, what the hell are you doing? !”
“Sir, why didn’t the pope inform us that he was going to abdicate the throne? Did he suddenly get some kind of evil disease?”An old man in a priest’s robe asked in puzzlement.
Feyerat clenched his fingers tightly and crumpled the newspaper into a ball, he said, “With his vigilance, do you think he will get an evil disease? This old man loves his life the most. The doctors around him are the best in the outer wall. If there was any evil disease, they would have found it long ago!”
“Then why did he suddenly abdicate?”The old priest was even more puzzled. “Could it be that his lifespan is approaching? That’s not right. As far as I know, he should be able to live for more than a hundred years.”
Feyerat said coldly, “This matter, we have to ask this old thing to know. Damn it, I don’t know where he is hiding now. I heard that he was attacked by assassins and someone sneaked into the upper echelons of the Holy See, so he disappeared. I didn’t expect that his disappearance would cause such a big incident!”
The Old Priest said in a daze, “Could it be that someone kidnapped him and forced him to pass on the throne?”
Feyerat narrowed his eyes. “It’s possible, but it’s not very likely. This old man’s strength… is much stronger than that of the Great Radiant King!”
“Ah?”The old priest was stunned.
“Immediately inform the presiding judge of each branch. Tell them to mobilize everyone and find this old man for me!”Feyerat’s gaze was cold. “I want to see what he wants to do by giving up his throne so suddenly!”
“Yes.”
At the same time, in the Knight Hall, the nine elders who had received the title of legendary knight gathered in the Parliament Hall. Ilola looked at the crowd, “Everyone, Richelieu is abdicating. It’s too sudden. Who knows where Richelieu is now?”
“First Elder, it’s too sudden. It’s normal if ordinary people can’t get the news, but we didn’t get any news beforehand. Could there be something fishy going on?”Another person said.
“That’s right. In my opinion, Richelieu must have a plan and purpose for making such a decision. We have to guard against it!”
“That’s right. In recent years, the Church of light has been pressuring our Knight’s palace more and more. If there weren’t nobles on our side, we would have suffered a great loss!”! “However, I’m sure you all know the new rule of the Church of light five years ago. Any noble who joins the church of light can pass the exam unconditionally. Moreover, they can become official knights of light after three years. If they perform well, they will improve faster!”! This rule is obviously to snatch the power of the nobles from us!”
“The radiant church has always been full of petty tricks, HMPH!”
“I wonder if the military will cooperate with this matter.”
Ilola listened to everyone’s words and was silent for a moment before saying, “You must find Richelieu before noon today! Also, immediately investigate the background of the new pope!”
“Leave the investigation of the new Pope to me!”One of the old men took the initiative to say.
“Alright!”Ilola nodded.
A moment later, the meeting ended.
The crowd gradually dispersed.
The old man who proposed to investigate the new pope left the hall of knights and went straight back to his castle. As soon as he entered the castle, he went upstairs to his room. As soon as he opened the door, he saw the sofa in the middle of his room, a figure wearing a black robe and a mask was sitting there, enjoying a cup of tea with his legs crossed. There was a black scorpion tattoo on his wrist.
The person who dared to carve the tattoo on such a conspicuous spot on his wrist was obviously not an extremely careless rookie, but an extremely confident one.
“How was the meeting?”The black-robed man tilted his head to look at the old man who entered the door and said with a smile.
The old man saw the relaxed look on the old man’s face and was slightly stifled. His face darkened and he said, “This is my home. You should be more careful. If others see me, I will be exposed!”
“Don’t worry.”The black-robed man said with a smile, “If others come near, I will know without opening the door.”
The old man knew of his ability, but he still felt that this attitude made him a little unhappy. He frowned slightly and did not pursue further. He sat on the other side of the sofa.., he said, “The others also feel that the change of Pope this time was too sudden. There was no news beforehand and they thought that there was some plan. Therefore, the others are currently investigating and preparing to find out the whereabouts of Richelieu first.”
“Yes, this is within the expectations of our Lord.”The black-robed man nodded slightly.
The old man’s gaze moved and he asked, “That Lord is?”
“The one I told you about last time.”The black-robed man glanced at him. “The lord who subdued twelve elders in one night, our new Speaker!”

chapters.title: Chapter 637
chapters.content:
Chapter 637 – Chapter 637: Glory
“It’s him?”The old man was startled. “Could it be that Richelieu’s disappearance has something to do with him?”
“This isn’t something you should know.”The black-robed man’s voice was slightly cold as he went straight to the point. “What did they say in today’s meeting? What are they planning to do? Will they contact the inner wall?”
The old man frowned slightly, he said in a low voice, “Our Knight Hall has always adhered to the principle of fairness and fairness. Although this matter is a little strange, it is not to the extent of contacting the inner wall to interfere with the matters of the outer wall. This will disrupt the structure of the outer wall. They are only preparing to find Richelieu and ask about the situation. I reckon that they should have some suspicions that Richelieu is already dead or has been kidnapped.”
“Ha…”the black-robed man chuckled.
The old man felt a trace of mockery in it. His face darkened as he asked, “What do you mean by ‘ha’?”
“Ha’means that I didn’t expect that the thoughts of those old fellows in the Knight’s Hall would all be predicted by that Lord.”The corners of the black-robed man’s mouth curled up slightly, he chuckled and said, “If you contact the forces in the inner wall to intervene now, you might be able to take advantage of it. Unfortunately, you have missed such a good opportunity. No wonder the Knight’s Hall is getting worse day by day. In today’s era, other than those civilians who have no way out, no background, no connections, and want to climb up, who would abide by the so-called Knight’s Spirit?”
The old man’s expression changed slightly. His gaze flickered slightly as he said, “Aren’t you afraid that I’ll pass these words on to them?”
“Do you dare?”The black-robed man’s smile faded slightly as he tilted his head to look at him.
The old man looked straight at him and said, “I’m cooperating with you because I’m grateful. If it concerns the life and death of countless people in the outer wall region, why wouldn’t I dare? !”
“Then you try.”The black-robed man didn’t care about his furious true energy at all, he said indifferently, “Don’t forget what you’ve done. If it’s exposed, you, your family, your children, your grandchildren, and all your good friends will all be burned on the stake. In history, there were more than one legendary knight who was exposed to collude with the dark church. You know better than me what will happen to them.”
The old man clenched his fists and his gaze was cold, he said, “This is the last time I will cooperate with you. From now on, I hope that you will not come looking for me again. Even if you do, I will not cooperate with you anymore! “I can not sell my soul to the Devils anymore. You Devil Disciples will definitely go to Hell after you die. You will be entangled by the chains of eternal darkness for generations and will not be purified!”
“Chains of eternal darkness?”The black-robed man chuckled. “This is something made up in the Holy Book of the Holy Church of light. We don’t believe it. We only believe that darkness can never be destroyed. Only Darkness is the most real world!”! “Look at you knights, you are so hypocritical and pitiful!”
“You can insult me, but don’t insult the pure honor of a true knight!”The old man said angrily.
“If you don’t want to expose yourself, you’d better keep your voice down.”
The old man suppressed the anger in his eyes. He took a deep breath and said coldly, “Since we’re here to talk business today, please leave immediately after we’re Done!”
The black-robed man smiled calmly and said, “Alright, you’ve talked for so long in the meeting, and this is all you’ve said?”
“There’s one more thing,”the old man said coldly. “They’re preparing to look for the background information of the new pope, but I’ve taken charge of this matter. You should know the background of the new pope, right? What’s his background?”
“No background. He is just a small apprentice knight.”The black-robed man said indifferently, “No background, no noble blood, and no strength. To tell you the truth, this person is just a puppet that the Lord supported. The one who is the real pope is that Lord!”
The old man was stunned, and his eyes revealed an intense shock. “Isn’t he your speaker? Is it possible that Richelieu was really kidnapped by him? He actually passed the position to him? What is Richelieu Thinking? !”
The black-robed man looked at him with a smile and said, “Are you questioning that Lord?”
The old man came to his senses, and his expression changed slightly. He lowered his head and said, “No.”Although he didn’t have a good impression of the black-robed man in front of him, he didn’t dare to offend that Lord because of this.., this figure who could subdue twelve elders of the dark church in one night was definitely not someone he could afford to offend. Moreover, once the matter of the succession of popes in front of him was truly carried out.., the Radiant Church and the dark church in the outer wall region would fall under the control of one person. In time, they would definitely completely dominate the outer wall region!
Such a person was not someone he could afford to offend.
The black-robed man smiled and said, “You just said that you took charge of this matter. You’ve done a good job and saved us a lot of trouble. I hope that you can properly wrap up the background of this new pope and temporarily hide it from the eyes of others. If you can hide it for a while, you’ll be able to calculate it for a while. When the new pope takes the throne, I’ll need you to stand out and show your support. You’ll have to add glory to the new pope. With your legendary Knight Medal and identity, as well as your past glory and authority, your support will definitely reduce the voices of doubt!”
The old man was shocked and said angrily, “I openly support him? Are you trying to expose me?”
The black-robed man waved his hand slightly, he said, “Don’t be agitated for now. That Lord said that you have settled this matter. Not long after the new pope takes the throne, he will let you become the Temple Master of the Knight Hall. Isn’t this the highest goal that you have dreamed of? When that time comes, you will be the knight that everyone in the outer wall admires the most. There will be no one like you! “You will also become the existence that all the knights under the nobles yearn for and pursue. You will be the legendary figure that they worship, and your name will be engraved in the annals of history. Don’t you want to obtain such an honor?”
The old man was stunned.
In fact, there was no need for the black-robed man to say so many enticing words. Just by relying on the condition of “Becoming the temple master,”he already knew what kind of exciting honor this was. This was the pursuit of all the Knights!
After a moment, he woke up and calmed down, he said word by word, “Don’t use your seductive and depraved rhetoric on me. Knight’s Glory is obtained by adhering to the Knight’s spirit, not by selling your comrades and your souls in exchange. You Are Devils. You Can’t Give Me Glory, only shame!
The black-robed man raised his eyebrows and looked at him with some surprise. He looked at him with some admiration in his eyes, clapping his hands lightly, he said, “Not bad, not bad. As expected of a legendary knight. You have good self-control. However, this is not an empty rhetoric, but the real words. It is also what the Lord asked me to bring to you. Believe it or not, that Lord should not have the need to deceive you. After all, you must do this unless you want to expose all the things you have done. In that case, there will be no place for your spirit of a Knight and the Medal of a knight. The hall of knights will not tolerate people like you, right?”
The old man was stunned.
Cold sweat dripped from his forehead. He slowly clenched his fists and said through gritted teeth, “You guys are ruthless!”
“It’s good that you agree.”The black-robed man smiled gently, he stood up and said, “I’ll leave the matter of concealing the true identity of the new pope to you. If there are other tasks, I’ll pass them on to you. Now that the situation is unstable, you must not stand on the wrong side. If you stand on the side that is eliminated, you’ll be in big trouble…”
Hearing his threat, the old man snorted and said, “You don’t need to say anything.”
“That’s for the best, Haha.”
“Will the church of light be able to pass the challenge of you suddenly replacing the Pope?”The old man stared at him and said, “Even if Richelieu agrees to give up his position, those cardinals are not to be trifled with, right?”
“You don’t need to worry about that. We have already fully activated the highest plan — the Dark Moon Plan.”The black-robed man waved his hand with his back facing the old man and said, “Don’t forget, the hotter the sun, the deeper the shadow.”
The old man was stunned.
At this moment, in the military headquarters of the Western Region, there was also an emergency meeting. Many generals with outstanding achievements had arrived one after another. The replacement of the Pope of the radiant church was the biggest matter in the outer wall. To them.., it was even more serious than the savage prisoner realm!
In just a short morning, the news spread like a virus to all parts of the outer wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 638
chapters.content:
Chapter 638 – Chapter 638: Authority
Sander was sitting in the main hall of the Ryan family’s castle. He was drinking tea and reading newspapers. There were seven or eight maids serving in the main hall. If Dudian was here he would find that the Ryan Castle used to be simple and crude, now it had become luxurious. The Maids and knights in the castle were no longer pitiful. There were dozens of maids in the corridors.
There were more than 200 to 300 knights patrolling outside the manor. This was a status symbol for the nobles, which was as important as money!
These knights were the legitimate private military force of the nobles. The number of knights often determined the strength of a noble.
While hiring these knights, the town where the Ryan family lived was also different from the past. Four or five farms and pastures were developed in the mountainous area outside the town, which were managed by the Ryan family, the food produced was enough to feed all the knights, their retinues and servants in the castle.
“The new pope?”Sandro was stunned when he saw the news in the newspaper. He put down his crossed legs and opened the newspaper to read it carefully.
After a short while, he was shocked, “The Pope wants to abdicate the throne? How come there is no news about the new pope? Did the Holy See Block the news?”
He was stunned for a while before he came back to his senses. He frowned and fell into deep thought, “If the new pope inherits the throne, I wonder if the rule that the nobles are not allowed to be selected as Knights of light will be changed… it seems that we must get Jasmine and the others to join the Church of light as soon as possible. If the rule is canceled, it will be difficult for them to join the church again.” He immediately called the butler and asked him to call Molly and the others.
The Butler replied and went downstairs.
Sander looked out of the window. He was middle-aged. His thick beard made him look old. He looked into the distance with a trace of worry: “I hope nothing bad will happen…”
There were twelve figures sitting in the hall of the FELAN family. They were the elders of the 12th district. Dudian had killed the elders but they had been replaced by others. There was a black haired youth and a slender woman sitting in the upper part of the hall. The hall was silent as if there was a heart palpitating power enveloping everyone.
Dudian looked at the Patriarch of the FELAN family: “General Felan, please take a seat.”
Felan was flattered: “Thank you speaker.”
An attendant immediately came up to take a seat.
Dudian looked at him. The Felan family’s loyalty to the dark church wasn’t something that happened overnight. They had been loyal to the dark church since their ancestors, the most respected female general who had built a prominent military merit was a member of the dark church. The military merit that she had built and killed countless barbarians was done with the secret help of the dark church.
The FELAN family had been working for the dark church for generations after the female general. They were the biggest chess piece of the dark church in the Military Area! This was one of the reasons why the dark church would hold a meeting of elders in the FELAN family.
“Everyone should be clear about the dark moon plan.”Dudian looked at the elders of the 12th district, he said in a cold tone: “When the new pope takes over the throne, the dark church and the Holy Church will be one. In the future we will be in charge of the Holy Church. You Don’t have to live in the dark anymore. I believe that when the Holy Church falls into our hands the military and the magistrate will be under our control.”
He said “We”but not “I”. Many people secretly noticed that although they didn’t know whether Dudian meant it or not but they were a bit excited and expectant.
“All of this is the credit of the speaker. I will listen to your orders!”One of the strong men said. If Dudian was the speaker then everyone was afraid of him, but now they were more convinced and expectant. After all, in a short period of time the Holy Church would no longer be the opponent of the dark church but a servant!
As a member of the dark church who had been suppressed by the Holy Church for a long time, this kind of thing had only occurred to him in his dreams. Normally he wouldn’t dare to think about it but now it had become a reality!
How could this not be exciting? !
Dudian nodded, “The civilians don’t know enough about the new pope. I hope that you will fully implement the Dark Moon Plan. In addition to the highest core chess pieces, there is no need to hide our chess pieces in other forces. Now is the time for them to play a role!”
“Sir, these civilians don’t know anything about the new pope. Can they be convinced by their words?”Someone asked in a worried tone.
“Don’t underestimate the power of Authority!”Dudian said in a cold tone: “There was a good example. A deacon of the magistrate easily judged a case without a detailed investigation. He said that he was guilty. So the person who was wronged was really guilty. No one would believe that a deacon would judge a case wrongly. This is the power of Authority!”
The person who spoke earlier was silent.
“My Lord, when the Holy Church falls into our hands, will we be able to rule the entire outer wall?”The eyes of the cold youth who replaced the ‘Night King’who was one of the three kings lit up.
Dudian indifferently glanced at him, “The other forces aren’t fools. They haven’t taken any action yet because they aren’t sure. They will know that the holy church is under our control sooner or later. Don’t forget that there will be spies and pawns in the holy church and US.”
Everyone’s face slightly changed as they looked at each other.
Dudian raised his hand to suppress the commotion: “There is no need to doubt each other. The outer wall will fall into our hands sooner or later. It is useless for them to know. Who Can Stop the Holy Church from joining forces with us?”
“The speaker is right.”Someone agreed.
The respected sword king also expressed his stance, “The speaker is right. If the Holy Church joins forces with us, the military region will be vulnerable. As for the magistrate and the Knight’s hall… They are paper tigers. In the past they had formed a triangle with the military region and the Holy Church. Now that the Holy Church has fallen, they can only submit!”
“Well said!”
Everyone was excited and excited.
Dudian saw that everyone was in high spirits so he began to talk about his plan. The plan also established the prevention of interference from the inner wall. Seeing that Dudian had thought so thoroughly, the others were more and more scared and awed. After all, not everyone thought so simply. Once the outer wall was unified, the biggest problem they would face would be the inner wall.
However, no one dared to voice out their worries. It was the same as pouring cold water on them. Moreover, it would offend dudian.
This was a person who dared to casually kill the Night King. It wouldn’t be worth it if he was killed.
However, after listening to Dudian’s plan, this worry slowly disappeared.
“The chairman has considered everything.”An old man sighed in admiration.
“I have seen the chairman’s strategy and talent when I was in the ninth region. Today I have learned it. It is really admirable!”Hawkeye who was sitting in the position of the elder of the ninth region immediately complimented.
Dudian waved his hand: “Everyone remember it.”
Everyone got up and left one after another.
Dudian saw the sword king get up. He glanced at the attendant behind him. From the looks of it it was similar to the portrait of Riley that he got from Richelieu, “Sword King, I like your attendant. Can you give him to me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 639
chapters.content:
Chapter 639 – Chapter 638: Succession
Most of the people in the hall had dispersed. The Sword King was about to leave when he heard Dudian’s words. He turned around and looked at the black-haired youth sitting on top of him, he smiled: “It is his good fortune that the chairman likes him. I am very willing to offer him to you. I hope you don’t mind.”
“Thank you.”
Sword King turned to the servant: “Black Crow, since the chairman thinks highly of you, you should follow the chairman. Don’t lose my face. Do you understand?”
Black crow nodded: “I understand.”He turned to Dudian: “Black Crow is willing to follow the chairman to the death.”
Dudian nodded and waited for sword king and the other elders to leave the hall, dudian turned to face Firan: “Patriarch Firan, I have to trouble you to deal with the military affairs. I will promote you after this matter is done!”! At that time, underworld king wasn’t satisfied with the position of vice-chairman. He wanted to assassinate me. But now he is dead. The position of vice-chairman has been vacant. I have to personally preside over many matters of the dark church. Sometimes I have no energy to spare!”
Ferran-kes was startled. Her heart was pounding as she suppressed the excitement in her heart. She bowed her head and said: “My Lord Chairman, the Ferran family will do their best to fulfill your orders!”
Dudian nodded: “You can go first.”
“Yes.”Ferran-kes nodded respectfully.
Dudian glanced at Black Crow who was quietly lowering his head after ferran-kes left, suddenly he said: “The code name given to you by Richelle is not bad. ‘Black Crow’is the fastest species among the birds. The meaning is good.”
Black Crow’s body trembled as he slowly looked up at dudian: “Black Crow doesn’t understand the words of the speaker. I hope your excellency can clarify.”
“Didn’t the previous meeting say that the Pope was kidnapped by me? He has confessed everything.”
Raven’s face slightly changed. She looked into Dudian’s eyes: “So, are you going to kill me?”
“If I want to kill you, why bother to talk to You?”Dudian indifferently said: “Richelieu has abandoned you. Your life should have ended but I’m willing to give you another life to be loyal to me. How about it?”
Riley’s eyes slightly moved as he stared at dudian: “I am willing.”
“Very good.”Dudian smiled and gently clapped his hands.
Sergei who was next to him turned back to the back of the hall: “Come Out.”A moment later, a group of footsteps was heard. Sergei was followed by a group of men, women and children who were wearing satin clothes, they were wearing satin clothes that were commonly worn by nobles. However, they couldn’t cover the dark brown scars on their face, arms, neck and eyes.
Riley’s face changed when he saw these people. His figure flashed as he rushed to the front to support the middle-aged man. He looked at the ugly scars on his arms and neck. His eyes turned red, his body slightly trembled as he turned his head to look at Dudian. He growled: “If you want to kill me then kill me. Why are you torturing my clansmen?”
Dudian didn’t speak but the middle-aged man who was supported by Riley quickly said: “Riley, don’t talk nonsense. We are lucky that this Lord saved us. He is our benefactor!”
Riley was stunned. He looked at him and then looked at dudian. He knew that he had misspoken. His body was covered in cold sweat, he looked down at dudian: “Speaker, I’m sorry. Black Crow offended you. Black Crow should die. I hope that you can be magnanimous and forgive them. They are innocent…”
Dudian raised his hand and stopped him: “I will never hurt people who are loyal to me. I Won’t hurt innocent people either. You Don’t have to worry.”
“Thank you!”Riley bowed his head in gratitude.
“Child, it’s great to see that you are alright.”The middle-aged man looked at Riley. His face was full of heartache as he covered his face.
Riley looked at him with red eyes: “Father, how did you get hurt? Who Hurt You?”
“I don’t know.”The middle-aged man shook his head and sighed: “We have to thank this adult. If it wasn’t for him, we would have suffered more torture!”
Riley nodded. He suddenly thought of something. He looked back at the crowd and his face turned pale: “Mother, where is Mother?”
The middle-aged man opened his mouth but stopped. His face was ugly as he clenched his fist and bowed his head.
Dudian slowly opened his mouth: “Sorry, we were a step late. Your Mother is dead.”
Riley was stunned as if he had been struck by lightning.
The middle-aged man bowed his head: “He is right. Your Mother… She couldn’t bear it and has gone.”
Riley felt that his body was on the verge of collapse. He took a few steps back and tripped on the legs of the chair. He sat on the chair of an elder but he didn’t feel anything at the moment.
Dudian looked at him and turned to the middle-aged man: “You guys have a good chat. I will leave first.”
The middle-aged man saw him speak and said in awe: “Thank you, Sir!”
Dudian immediately took Aisha’s hand and left. Sergei followed closely behind.
After a long time, the wooden look in Riley’s eyes gradually recovered. He stood up and rushed to his father. He stared into his father’s eyes, “Father, did he send people to harm you and pretend to save you?”
The middle-aged man was stunned, and his expression changed. He frowned and said, “It shouldn’t be, right?”
Riley immediately asked, “When were you killed?”
“The 15th of last month. It’s a month from now,”the middle-aged man said immediately.
Riley was slightly startled, and he heaved a sigh of relief. He said, “Looks like it’s not him.”
“How do you know?”
“He knows my identity. He got it from the pope. He only kidnapped the pope a few days ago.”Riley narrowed his eyes slightly, and a trace of cold killing intent flashed through them, “There is someone else who harmed you. I will definitely find out who is the murderer!”
The middle-aged man came to a realization. He nodded and said, “This lord has captured a person alive and is interrogating him for us. There should be news.”
“Is that so?”Riley was stunned.
..
..
It was noon.
In the outer wall area, the civilian area, and other streets and taverns, everyone was talking about the succession of the Pope of the radiant church. Especially about the origin of the new pope. This was the most curious place for everyone. As for why the Pope had been replaced.., on the contrary, they were not too concerned. Firstly, they had not thought about it so deeply. Secondly, even if they had thought about it, they knew that with their own abilities, they would not be able to know the reason behind it.
As for the established facts, everyone was more curious about who would be the next pope. would it be the red-robed cardinal they were familiar with, or a secret figure hidden by the radiant church?
“I heard that the new pope is very young. He must be a genius.”
“To be able to become a pope at such a young age, it must be an order from God, right?”
“Why doesn’t the god of light favor me? I don’t want to be a pope, I just want to be a Knight of Light.”
“Your faith is a woman. It’s already good enough that the god of light didn’t purify you, you scum!”
Amidst the discussions in the tavern.., suddenly, a clear voice said, “As far as I know, this new pope is a once-in-a-century genius of the radiant church. He displayed extraordinary talent before the age of ten and received the instruction of the god of light in his dreams. Later on, he was secretly protected by the radiant church and was groomed as the successor of the Pope. It is said that not only is he proficient in poetry and music, but he is also outstanding in swordsmanship. Ever since he was young, the great radiant king secretly taught him swordsmanship. I’m afraid that he has already finished his apprenticeship, right?”
Hearing this, the rest of the people could not help but look over. A burly man who was holding a cup and drinking until his face was red said in a rough voice, “Who are you? How Do You Know All This?”
This person raised his head and drank a mouthful of wine, he laughed loudly and said, “You didn’t read the special report of the Radiant Church, right? It’s all written on it. And today, I read Master Antonia’s new poem. The whole article is full of praise for the new pope! “Tell me, if he’s not a virtuous person, why would master Antonia Praise Him Like This? “You have to know that Master Antonia is famous for his arrogance. He never fawned on anyone. He even wrote a poem to scold a certain general in the Military Region!”
Hearing his words, the others were a little surprised. They looked at each other. The strong man from before stared with his bell-like eyes and said, “Have you read the special report of the Radiant Church? Are you a member of the Radiant Church?”
The man said proudly, “Although I’m not, I have a friend who is. I heard it from him. This matter has long shocked the entire radiant church.”
Everyone was enlightened and could not help but be a little surprised.
“Awesome! I didn’t expect a master like Antonio to write a poem to praise this new pope. I remember that when the previous Pope succeeded the throne, master Antonio did not even write a poem, right?”
“Nonsense! Master Antonio was still wearing pants when the previous Pope Richelieu succeeded the throne!”
“Hahaha…”
“Who is the master Antonio you are talking about?”
“You are illiterate! You Don’t Even Know Master Antonio? You have read the poem for Nothing!”
“You said that he is illiterate. How can an illiterate read a poem?”
The pub was in a mess again. The man who had spoken earlier was drinking and paying the bill. He quietly left the pub and walked towards the end of the street, he went into another tavern.
Dudian left the Felan family and suddenly thought of something. He told Sergei: “Go and inform Hawkeye to do something.”He whispered to Sergei.
Sergei bowed his head and replied: “Yes.”
Barton and the other trainee knights were on duty on the hill next to the Utoto Mountain. Suddenly, more than ten horses galloped over. They were Snow White horses of good breed. Their speed was extremely fast and their teeth were sharp, they were the exclusive steeds of the official knights of light.
On the back of the horses were all figures in bright silver armor. In front of these official knights of light armored figures was a figure in a bright red robe. It was like a thick flame blooming in the snow, filled with a sacred feeling.
Seeing this blood-red robe, Barton and the others who were on duty were stunned. They could not help but rub their eyes. That’s right, it was the clothes of the Red Bishop!
There was actually a cardinal here!
Everyone was stunned and quickly reacted. They held back their excitement and straightened their backs.
Ernorin rode to the front of the hill. According to the portrait, he saw a familiar face in the crowd at a glance. A hint of jealousy flashed in the depths of his eyes, but he knew that things had already come to this. He could not change it and immediately got off the horse, he came in front of this person, bowed slightly, and said, “Is your excellency Mr. Barton?”
Barton was stunned.
The other apprentice knights beside him were also dumbfounded. Their eyes were wide open, and their jaws were about to fall to the ground.
Mr. … Barton?
The Red Bishop… actually called him that?
Barton reacted and was so nervous that he stuttered, “Yes, it’s me.”
Ernorlin sighed in his heart as he saw such a reaction. He thought that the people in the holy church were better than him, he didn’t understand why Richelieu chose such a waste.
He maintained his politeness: “Mr. Barton, are you free? Please come with us.”
Barton was stunned. He suddenly remembered what Dudian had said. His heart jumped. Wasn’t that a joke? !
“Yes, I’m free.”He replied.
“Please come with me.”Ernorin turned back to the horse.
Barton was stunned as he followed behind him.
The other trainee knights wanted to poke their eyes out when they saw this scene. This wooden kid from a down and out noble was actually appreciated by the bishop. It was unbearable!
They knew that from now on, they would lose a free laundryman, and they would have to look up to this person.
When ernorin saw Barton’s stunned look, he pointed at an empty horse and said, “Mr. Barton, please get on the horse.”As soon as he finished speaking, he suddenly remembered that an apprentice knight was still unable to tame the snow wolf horse. Just as he was about to step forward and make a move.., he suddenly saw Barton turn his body, grab the horse’s fur, and jump onto the horse.
The Snow Wolf Horse raised its head to the sky and roared twice. It spun several times on the spot, wanting to shake off the person on its back. However, the horse’s rope was tightly held by Barton. Under his control, the snow wolf horse soon quieted down.
When ernorin saw this, he was slightly stunned. His eyes flashed slightly, and he turned around to get on his horse. He said, “Mr. Barton, please follow me.”
“Yes.”Barton nodded.
After a moment, Ernorin led Barton to the top of Uto Mountain. They got off the horse and walked through St. Mark’s Square.
It was the first time Barton came here. He looked at the huge white square. He felt very small. His heart was full of tension but there was a trace of fear and anticipation. Dudian had told him that seven days later.., he would become the new pope. He would take care of everything. It seemed that the joke had come true.
It was like a dream that had come true.
“Is This a dream? Is this not a Dream?”Barton pinched his fingers, the pain made him feel calm and excited. However, he was more afraid. In his heart, the Pope was supreme. He was unknown. could he really become the pope? Would the others agree? Would they laugh at him? After becoming the Pope, would he be able to manage the Holy See? And how would he manage it?
These thoughts flashed through his mind repeatedly.
If ernorin knew what he was thinking at this moment, he would most likely feel speechless and say two words: ignorant.
Barton did not know that the status and significance of the pope far exceeded his imagination. If someone knew the true situation, they would never believe that a trainee knight with no background and no achievements could become the pope.
However, reality was rolling in an unbelievable direction. Even the El norin who led the way for Barton felt that he could not see clearly. He could not believe that the other seven cardinals.., would agree to such an unbelievable thing!
The reason why he agreed was because the order was passed down by Richelieu. He was Richelieu’s confidant, so he could not reject it. However, the others were not like that. However, after the conference of Cardinals began.., the votes were completely different from what he had expected, and everyone actually agreed with a high degree of agreement!
No one vetoed this trainee knight, jumping from the lowest level to the highest level of Pope!

chapters.title: Chapter 640
chapters.content:
Chapter 640 – : Chapter 639: The Dark Side
[ three hours before the bishop’s vote. ]
Rosa crushed the secret letter in his hand angrily and smashed it on the ground. The secret letter was sent by Richelieu through a secret channel. The seal and handwriting on it were written by Richelieu himself, however, the contents of the letter made him a little angry. This old thing actually made him support the new pope with all his might? Just that Little Apprentice Knight was qualified to be the Pope? ! Had Richelieu lost his mind? !
He wished that he could find Richelieu right now and question him face to face. However, what made him furious was that not only was he unable to see Richelieu, but such an important piece of news was directly released to the public!
In this way, even if he joined hands with the other bishops to oppose this matter, it would also cause the Holy See to lose face. After all, this was a major matter like the succession of the Pope. If it was reversed repeatedly, not only would it cause the public to discuss.., it’ll be a joke to all sides.
However, at this point, he does not care so much.
“Contact the other bishops immediately. I suspect there is something fishy about this. We must not elect a new pope so easily before we meet His Holiness,”Rosa said to the butler beside him, his eyes dark.
Butler looked at his face full of Haze, dare not say more, nodded quietly promised.
“I don’t believe that the other cardinals would tolerate a nameless brat as the Pope!”Rosa thought to himself. As one of the eight cardinals, he was already in his early 70s this year, in terms of seniority, he was considered an elder among the Cardinals. He thought that when Richelieu abdicated, he would be one of the most powerful competitors. But now, he had directly destroyed all of his hopes.
In order to wait for the day Richelieu abdicated, he had secretly laid down his chess pieces twenty years ago, preparing for the arrival of that moment. However, this moment had come too quickly and caught him off guard, leaving him completely unprepared, moreover, he had directly skipped the voting segment and swept him out of the game!
He really could not swallow this resentment. After more than twenty years of careful management, he was now facing a situation where he would lose the entire game.
“Old Man, what are you planning? Damn it!”Rosa clenched his fists and hammered the table. The wooden table immediately cracked.
At this moment, footsteps came from outside the room again. Rosa turned his head and saw that the butler who had left earlier had returned. A hint of anger flashed across his face, “Why are you back? Hurry up and go. If you miss the time, I’ll take your head!”
“Aiya…”
A mocking voice came from behind the butler. The next moment, the butler’s body fell to the ground. He was dead.
Rosa’s pupils constricted. He looked at the wizard-like figure in a black robe behind the butler. His expression changed slightly. He said with a cold gaze, “The dark church? How dare you come to me. Are you here to die?”
Although he said that, his palm quietly moved behind his back and touched the hidden alarm line under the table.
After all, the latter was able to break into his castle and was still so fearless. It was most likely that he came with ill intentions.
The black-robed man said with a smile, “Let me introduce myself first. I am an elder of the fifth district. You have given me a good title, Ghost. I quite like it.”
Rosa said with a cold face, “I know you. You were lucky enough to escape from the Battle of Red Castle eight years ago, but you still dare to appear in front of me today. You are quite brave!”
“I was bullied by you when I was outnumbered. Today, I want to experience the feeling of being bullied by outnumbered.”The black-robed man clapped his hands with a smile. Suddenly, the sound of wind was heard from several broken lattice windows in the room, with a few bangs, the glass windows were smashed. A few figures jumped into the room and landed in the middle of the room. They seemed to form a triangle and surrounded Rosa.
Rosa’s expression changed slightly when he saw this. He touched the finger under the table and hooked it. However, he found that the dark line was loose. This meant that the line had been cut short!
He had an ugly expression. He did not expect that his heavily guarded home would be infiltrated by the other party unknowingly. This could only mean that there must be a dark church’s chess piece lying in wait by his side, otherwise, these people would not have appeared here silently!
“You Think You can assassinate me with just the few of you? Aren’t you thinking too simply!”Rosa’s gaze was gloomy. He did not act rashly but instead, he was stalling for time, he hoped that his trusted aides and the Knights stationed around the castle would be able to sense the situation here. “If there really is a fight, my men will rush over immediately. Since you have all walked into the trap, don’t even think about leaving!”
Although he knew that he was at a disadvantage, he could not lose his imposing manner.
The black-robed man chuckled and said, “Your eminence, we are not here to kill you.”
“HMM?”Rosa’s gaze moved slightly, but his heart was still vigilant.
The black-robed man said leisurely, “My Lord has asked me to communicate with you. I believe that you have heard about the succession of popes. My lord hopes that you can give your full support to the new pope.”
Rosa’s expression changed. These words were too familiar. He had just read the contents of the secret letter. Could it be that..
“Your Lord? You are one of Richelieu’s people? !”Rosa looked at him gloomily, but a chill rose in his heart.
“No, no, no.”The black-robed man immediately shook his head and said, “Richelieu has already pledged his loyalty to my lord. So, as Richelieu’s subordinates, I hope that you can cooperate.”
Rosa was startled: “Pope will swear loyalty to your lord? Who Is Your Lord?”
“You won’t know even if I tell you. My lord is a big shot from the inner wall.”The man smiled. He didn’t know much about dudian. At this moment he deliberately said that he came from the inner wall, the purpose was to intimidate Rosa. After all, Dudian had given him the task to ask Bishop Rosa to support the new pope.
“Please”was a very particular word.
“Inner wall?”Rosa was surprised. He felt the pressure in his heart. It was very likely that someone from the inner wall was able to kidnap Richelieu. After all, Richelieu’s power wasn’t simple. At least as far as he knew.., this old man’s power was above that of the great king of light!
“Cardinal Rosa, have you thought about it?”The black-robed man was not anxious at all, and he said with a smile.
Rosa stared at him, and after a moment.., he gritted his teeth and said, “The new pope is a member of Your Dark Church, right? If you let him take the position, it’s equivalent to giving the church to you dark church disciples. Don’t even think about it! Even if I die, I won’t agree to it!”
“Then you die!”The black-robed man shrugged and waved his hand.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
A few figures around suddenly jumped up and pounced toward Rosa.
Rosa was shocked, but he did not panic. His body suddenly fell back and hit the glass window behind him.
Poof!
A cold light suddenly pierced through the window at an extremely fast speed. Rosa was shocked when he saw it. He did not expect that there was another person hiding outside the window. There was not even the slightest sound, although his perceptive ability was not strong, it was not so weak that he could not be detected even if someone was so close to him. This could only mean that the latter was a terrifying assassin who was extremely good at hiding!
The sharp blade pierced through his back. The pain instantly spread throughout his body. Rossa let out a low growl in pain and struck out with his palm.
With a bang, the withered old palm hit the black shadow outside the window. The black shadow let out a muffled groan and his body flew out of the window. He fell more than ten meters down the building. Just as he was about to fall, he quickly grabbed the wall with his palm, the palm seemed to have a suction force and was firmly attached to the wall, like a spider.
On the other side, when Rosa repelled the attacker from behind, his body was blocked, and he was immediately surrounded and attacked by the surrounding people. He glared angrily and growled as he slapped his hands toward one of the slim figures, preparing to find an opening from there.
The slim figure held a soft sword in his hand. As he shook it, it was like countless shining silver snake heads that were moving, pouncing toward Rosa’s face.
Rosa did not dare to meet the attack with his bare hands. He immediately withdrew his hands. At the same time, he felt his strength rapidly drain away. The pain on his back spread to his entire body in a short moment. He was about to change his hand gesture to defend, but the pain surged to his arm, in an instant, his body was a little stiff, like a cramp.
In this short moment of stiffness, the pincer attacks instantly hit Rosa.
With a bang, Rosa’s body flew out like a rag bag and crashed into a wall of the room. The huge oil painting hanging on the wall was also shaken down. Dust fell down, landing on Rosa’s face and hair, he looked extremely miserable.
Rosa struggled to get up from the ground. A counter-current surged up from his chest and he immediately spat out a mouthful of blood, splashing onto the expensive carpet. His face was flushed red. He raised his head to look at the approaching black-robed men. He was so angry that his beard and hair were all spread out, however, he could not exert any strength at all. He just lay on the ground, trembling all over!
“As a human being, why do you have to make things difficult for your own life?”The black-robed man said with a smile, as if he did not care about what he said.
Rosa’s eyes were about to crack, and he glared at him. “If you want to kill, then kill. Bah!”He spat out a mouthful of blood, splashing it on the black-robed man’s face.
The people around him immediately held their weapons and prepared to attack.
The black-robed man immediately stopped them. Then, he raised his hand and slowly wiped the blood on his face. He ordered, “Go and get a pen and paper.”
A person beside him immediately took it from the desk and handed it to him.
Rossa saw this and immediately knew what they were going to do. He said angrily, “Even if I die, I will not let you do whatever you want. Don’t even think about touching the Holy See! !”
The black-robed man kicked his arm. With a crack, his arm was instantly broken. He screamed in pain, but his body was still numb. Obviously, the sharp blade that attacked him earlier contained poison.
“Cut off this hand.”The black-robed man ordered.
“Yes.”The person next to him immediately drew his sword. Without waiting for Rosa to react, he felt a chill on his arm. His arm was actually cut off!
The black-robed man picked up the broken arm and said softly, “Even if you are not present, it will be the same even if you are sent here. Your Eminence, I will send you to the embrace of your god of light right now.”
Rosa glared angrily and cursed.
The black-robed man turned around and raised his hand slightly to signal.
PFFT! PFFT!
A few sounds of flesh being pierced rang out. Rosa, who was lying on the ground, had four sharp swords stabbed into his body, nailing him to the gorgeous carpet. Fresh blood flowed down the sharp blades.
Carly was one of the two women of the eight cardinals. She was thirty-eight years old this year. To be able to become a cardinals at this age was extremely impressive. She was the youngest among all the Cardinals. Of course, this was also related to her family’s help. After all, her grandfather was the fourth pope!
“Mrs. Carly, have you finished writing?”On the sofa in the study, a short old man sat with a wide sword on his back and a black cloth wrapped around his back. In other places in the study, four figures dressed in black robes stood, their temperament was cold, like four ghosts.
Beside the short old man’s crossed legs, there were two corpses. One had his head chopped off and the other had his chest pierced through. The wounds were extremely large. Many nobles recognized these two people. They were Bishop Kali’s personal attendants. Although they were only attendants, in the eyes of many nobles, they were also important figures.
In front of the study table, Carly’s hair was disheveled. She sat on the chair with an unsightly expression. Holding a pen, she was struggling to write down the words that the short old man had told her. On her beautiful face, there was a bright red palm print, it was from the hands of the short old man.
In the hands of this sword king, who had a long reputation in the dark church, she was actually unable to retaliate. She could only be forced to obey!
After a while, Carly finally finished writing the letter word by word. The pressure on her body seemed to have suddenly been relieved. She bit her lip slightly. She knew that by doing so, she had betrayed her faith and the church, she had also betrayed the great god of light! However, if she didn’t do this, not only would she die, but she would also implicate her family. She only hoped that the other bishops would be able to escape this disaster. As long as someone objected, this puppet pope controlled by the dark church would be unable to ascend to the throne, would not be able to ascend to the throne!
“Let me take a look.”The sword king casually stretched out his hand.
Carly picked up the letter that she had written and slowly handed it to him.
The Sword King took a look and narrowed his eyes. He smiled and said, “The words are pretty.”After saying that, he put away the letter.
Carly’s expression was unsightly. She said, “I have already done as you said. Don’t hurt the innocent anymore!”
“Innocent?”The Sword King raised his head and glanced at him. “When you killed our disciples, why didn’t you think that they were innocent as well? They just like things and are a little different from you.”
Carly knew that she had no right to reason with him. She gritted her teeth and lowered her head, not saying another word.
“Now, I still have to ask you to come with us.”The Sword King stood up and dusted off the invisible dust on his body, he said, “How can the new pope not have the support of the Bishop? When the time comes, you will be able to meet Pope Richelieu, whom you have been longing for. He will give you an answer. I hope you won’t be stupid. I can kill you at any time. Anyway, your vote is already in my hands.”
Carly clenched her hands tightly, her nails sinking deep into her palms. She knew that she had no choice. However, there seemed to be a glimmer of hope for her to meet Richelieu!
In another castle, Lados was covered in cold sweat. He quickly finished writing the letter and handed it to the black-robed man in front of him. He forced out a smile and said, “Do you think this will work?”
The black-robed man glanced at it and put away the letter. He raised his head and looked at him mockingly, saying, “I didn’t expect that there would be such a weak existence like you among the Cardinals. If the other cardinals were like you, it would save us a lot of trouble.”
Lados smiled and said, “You’re right. If there’s anything else that requires my cooperation, feel free to say it.”
“Come with us.”The black-robed man was too lazy to say anything else. He snorted and turned around to walk outside. He stepped over a few corpses that were bleeding on the ground.
[ two hours after the voting meeting ended ]
Barton followed Ernorin through St. Mark’s Square and came to the front of the Holy Temple of the Pope. Barton looked up at the magnificent holy temple with a face full of shock.
