It was the first time he had seen such a grand and magnificent building.., a solemn and solemn holy aura rushed to his face, making him feel awe and respect in his heart. All the distracting thoughts were instantly thrown to the back of his mind, and his heart was filled with piety.
“Come in.”Ernorin led the way in front.
Barton followed him into the hall. Immediately, he saw many high-ranking officials of the Holy See standing in the hall. There were knights wearing bright silver armor, holy priests holding books in their hands, and people wearing snow-white high hats, he did not know what profession they were from, but they seemed to have a noble temperament. They were most likely important figures.

chapters.title: Chapter 641
chapters.content:
Chapter 641 – Chapter 640: The New Emperor
These people wore gorgeous and noble clothes and stood in two rows. Their expressions were respectful and their attitudes were pious, as if they were praying for the blessing of the common people. The fluorite that was taken from the body of the monster emitted a holy and gentle light, shining on the hall, it also shone on their bodies, faces, and even each eyelash in the gentle light, emitting a solemn and sacred aura.
On the high steps behind these people stood a figure with a scepter in hand and a crown on his head. He was an old man dressed in a gorgeous robe that resembled the stars and the Moon. His temperament was refined, and his expression was gentle. However, the white hair on his temples and his slightly sunken eyes.., he appeared somewhat haggard.
When Barton saw this refined old man, his heart trembled. His eyes widened, and he stood rooted to the ground, unable to move his feet.
“Pope… Pope!”Barton looked up at him. His heart was filled with shock and awe. He didn’t think that he would be able to see the great pope.
Richelieu looked down at the trembling youth. Although the latter’s appearance wasn’t outstanding but it was surprising that he could gain the trust of the suspicious dudian.
The people on both sides of the row looked at the teenager. They looked at him with sharp eyes. They wanted to see what was so special about him that he could become the new pope.
However, after looking at him for a moment, everyone found out that the latter was an ordinary apprentice knight. He didn’t have any temperament just from his appearance. It should be known that most of the time others didn’t know about his inner self, it was often through one’s temperament and appearance that one imagined one’s personality and character. However, the appearance and temperament of this youth was really unable to match the identity of a ‘pope’.
It was the first time that Barton was being watched by so many people. He felt his heartbeat quicken and his entire body felt like it was pressing down on a huge mountain. He could not breathe as if even the dark spots of radiation that were hidden under his clothes were exposed to the air, making him feel insecure, he was so nervous that cold sweat was breaking out all over his body, but he was too shy to show it. He could only secretly hold it in. Under the guidance of Ernorin, he slowly walked into the hall.
Richelieu quietly watched Barton. When he walked in, his gentle face slowly revealed a smile that was just right. “Mr. Barton, Tomorrow is the time for you to inherit the throne and become the new pope. Are You Ready?”
Barton heard his words and his heart jumped. He stuttered, “P-pope, i-i…”
Seeing his reaction, the two rows of people on the side frowned slightly, but they lowered their heads subconsciously and did not show it.
Richelieu raised his hand slightly and stopped him. He said softly, “You don’t have to be nervous. When I was the pope, I was as anxious as you. I didn’t even sleep the whole night!”At this point, he laughed lightly.
The tense atmosphere in the hall immediately eased. The others looked at each other and thought that this was true. If they were the ones who became the pope, they would probably be nervous and excited.
Barton saw his gentle look and immediately felt a sense of familiarity. He nodded hard and said, “I got it!”
Richelieu smiled and said, “When you become the Pope Tomorrow, you need to recite the Holy Scripture. You have to prepare this tonight. Don’t make any mistakes. “In addition, there will be many nobles and important figures from the military region coming to watch the coronation ceremony. There can’t be any mistakes in the ceremony to avoid being laughed at, understand?”
Barton was shocked. “You still need to recite the Holy Bible?”He didn’t know many words, and they were words that had been adapted in recent years. The Holy Bible was written earlier, and it was filled with ancient words from the past, so he might not be able to recognize all of them, if he could not read halfway, wouldn’t that be too awkward?
Richelieu’s eyes flashed slightly, and he said softly, “You don’t have to worry. You just need to choose one of them to recite. There’s no need to recite the whole thing. Later on in the evening, I will send someone over to guide you.”
Barton heaved a sigh of relief. He was about to say that that was great, but he felt that it was too casual to speak like that. He could only say embarrassedly, “Thank You, your holiness the Pope.”
“The ceremony will be a rehearsal tonight. You should familiarize yourself with it first,”Richelieu said gently, then, he turned to the two rows of people on the side and said, “Don’t make any mistakes during the succession ceremony tomorrow. All the documents must be prepared. We can’t afford to be careless in this matter, do you understand? !”At this point, his expression was extremely stern. He did not have the slightest gentleness toward Barton.
“Yes!”Everyone replied in unison.
Ernorin also responded, sighing in his heart. He knew that the matter was already set in stone, and he was powerless to change it. However, this was not the worst thing for him. He guessed that the reason why the other bishops would agree to it was most likely because they had thought of one reason — this little brat being the pope was at least better than Richelieu being the pope, when his foundation was unstable, he would be able to take advantage of him and even plunder resources for his own use!
This was something that Richelieu could not do when he was still in office. Secondly, this little brat was too ordinary. Even if he was nurtured by the Holy See in the future, he would not be able to achieve anything in a short period of time. The chances of him being replaced in the future.., was far greater than replacing Richelieu!
From all these aspects, this was a greater benefit.
Thinking of this, he felt relieved in his heart. Suddenly, he felt that looking at this little brat was much more pleasing to the eye.
A night passed in the blink of an eye.
The Holy See’s St. Mark’s square had been conducting a rehearsal of the ceremony throughout the night. Barton had participated in it several times. After familiarizing himself with it, he began to read the Holy See’s scriptures under the guidance of the People Richelieu had arranged. Meanwhile, the rest of the Knights of light, the head knight, and the priests of light were still rehearsing the ceremony over and over again. It was only until they had cooperated with each other without any mistakes that the grand rehearsal ended.
The dawn shone down from Mount Utto.
Although it was early in the morning, it was already extremely lively at the foot of the mountain. Groups of carriages slowly drove over. The carriages were adorned with the flags of various nobles. Among them, there were carriages of the military region, as well as the carriages of important figures such as the Court of Justice and the hall of knights. The pedestrians who came to watch the grand ceremony on the side of the street saw the passing carriages. They were excited and pointed at them.
Thump, thump!
The Holy Bell Rang, and the echo spread throughout the entire Mt. Utto.
The grand ceremony began in St. Mark’s Square. On this square, which had been bearing the weight of more than two hundred years, the statues of successive popes stood tall and huge, looking down at the densely packed figures on the square.
As the Psalms and music sounded, Barton and Richelieu entered the square and ascended to the highest altar.
Barton had never seen so many people. As far as he could see, all he could see were black heads and cheers. He was so nervous that his back was covered in cold sweat.
Richelieu sensed his nervousness and guided him to slowly follow the ceremony.
A moment later, as the alternating ceremony ended, Richelieu left the altar, leaving Barton alone to recite the Holy Scripture of light.
Richelieu returned to the main hall behind the square. At this moment, the main hall was empty, without a single guard. Everyone was gathered in the square in front. Richelieu pushed open the door and entered the center of the main hall. He looked up and saw a black-haired youth leaning comfortably on the pope’s throne behind the main hall. He crossed his legs and rested his chin on his hands, staring at the ground in a daze.

chapters.title: Chapter 642
chapters.content:
Chapter 642 – Chapter 641: The Forgiveness Of The Devil
Dudian’s eyes gradually focused as he sensed Richelieu’s arrival. He looked up at him: “How is the ceremony going?”
“It is ongoing. There won’t be any mistakes.”Richelieu bowed his head in a humble manner. He had put down his identity and was respectful towards Dudian.
Dudian nodded: “After the ceremony we will let him read out our statements.”
“I will.”Richelieu nodded.
Dudian slowly retracted his eyes and looked at the air on the ground. His thoughts drifted away.
Richelieu peeked at Dudian. He saw that there was nothing for him to do so he slowly retreated.
When the sun was getting stronger, the ceremony was coming to an end. Barton stood alone on the altar, facing the gazes from all directions. Although he was nervous, he focused all his attention on the Bible in his hand, it did not seem that awkward.
This bible was very thick, but when he opened it, there was another layer of paper. On it was the new words that the ancient language teacher had translated from the Bible last night. He had read every word correctly twice last night, at this moment, although he was a little nervous, there was nothing wrong with it.
No one knew that at such a solemn moment, the people on the stage who were devoutly reading the poetry of universal love only wanted to make no mistakes.
After a moment, the Bible was finally read. Barton breathed a sigh of relief and closed the Bible. Only then did he feel that his hands were stiff and strained. He looked up and immediately saw countless black heads, there were also the gazes of the powerful figures in the front row. These gazes seemed to be able to see through everything and see through all of his foundations.
At this moment, Richelieu led two old men dressed in snow-white robes slowly onto the stage. The two of them held a tray in their hands. On it was the Pope’s scepter and the Holy Crown. Richelieu’s expression was solemn. His footsteps were steady as he approached Barton step by step.
It was the first time Barton saw such a serious pope. His heart jumped and he was nervous. He didn’t know what to do.
Richelieu looked at the fear and embarrassment in the eyes of the youth. His heart was filled with melancholy and sadness. Although Dudian had planned this matter but he had never thought that he would be replaced as the new pope, he felt that he had let down the previous popes and the mountain that he had loved.
After a moment of silence, the church bell rang. Richelieu woke up and put away his distracting thoughts. He handed the scepter and crown to Barton.
Barton was wearing a white hat that covered his black hair. When Richelieu crowned him with the crown, he did not take off the white hat. Instead, he put it on, although people with ulterior motives would find it strange to see this scene, most people had not seen the pomp of the Pope’s succession and did not know about the traditions of the Holy See, so they did not pay much attention to it.
In the blink of an eye, Barton put on the magnificent Pope’s robe and the crown that represented the most holy of all. He held the scepter that was given to him by the god of light and stood on the high altar, although his eyes were filled with nervousness and uneasiness, however, his dignified temperament had already spread out, and the square gave out a tsunami-like cheer, which was transmitted like waves.
Seeing the cheers, Barton’s heart gradually grew confident, as well as an unprecedented experience.
Amidst the cheers, Richelieu handed the scroll in his hand to Barton, he said in a low voice, “You are now the new pope and have just succeeded the throne. According to the rules, you have to state your views on the future of the radiant church and criticize the dark church. After you have finished your statement, you should express your grace. These are all written on this scroll.”
Barton was slightly startled. He came to his senses and immediately put it away.
After the cheers ended, Barton coughed lightly and mustered his courage. He opened the scroll and roughly scanned through it. After understanding the general content, he immediately recited it from the beginning.
Countless people in the square were listening. This was also their main purpose for coming here today.
”… I announce that from today onwards, the Holy See will halve the collection of the protection tax in all places! From today onwards, all poor villages and towns can apply to the Holy See to help the poor…”Barton said in a rough voice, he wanted his words to spread as far as possible, “Second, from today onwards, pardon all criminals who disturb the governance of the Holy See and insult the Holy See within five years…”
There was a thunderous cheer below the stage.
The military general sitting in the front row, the head of the judicial branch, as well as the legendary knights in the Knight’s Hall, were all dumbfounded when they heard this. Wasn’t the first clause too generous? Halving the collection of the protection tax, how much money would they lose? ! At least it would be worth the annual income of a consortium!
As for the second rule, it was within their expectations. Most of the previous popes would give a series of pardons to the criminals to show tolerance.
“The third point is to restore the identity of the legendary genius of the temple of elements ‘Dudian’. Master Dudian was framed by the dark church. After a detailed examination, the innocence of Master Dudian has been found out. Master Dudian’s identity will be restored from now on…”Barton read, he was excited. He was worried that Dean was banned but he didn’t expect that he would be unbanned now.
“The fourth point is to launch the poverty alleviation program in the slums…”
In the blink of an eye, Barton finished six items in one breath. He put away the scroll.
The square was filled with thunderous applause and cheers.
Especially the rich businessmen and civilians who were gathered outside the square. They were excited from the bottom of their hearts. In addition to the protection tax, there were many other taxes, these heavy taxes had always been on their shoulders but now they had been reduced by more than half. How could they not be excited and cheer?
Richelieu was watching silently. His eyes were a bit complicated. He didn’t know what Dudian was thinking. He thought that Dudian would take this opportunity to raise taxes and squeeze the people dry, dudian had gathered all the wealth in his hands but he didn’t expect that the latter was the opposite. Not only did he not squeeze the civilians but gave them more opportunities and help.
He didn’t know whether the holy church was good or bad to fall into the hands of Dudian. At the same time he felt ashamed. He wasn’t as good as the sinister little devil in this aspect.
Sergei heard Barton’s words. He was relieved as he looked at dudian: “Master, your identity has been restored. You can no longer hide it.”
“The only one who can save yourself is yourself.”There was a trace of depth in Dudian’s dark eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 643
chapters.content:
Chapter 643 – Chapter 642: Thorough
Inside the inner wall, in a side hall of the monastery.
“Elder, an emergency letter has just arrived from the outer wall!”A middle-aged man dressed in a white monk’s Daoist Robe said respectfully in a low voice. At the same time, he handed over the black secret letter he had received with both hands.
Stuart, who was processing a few documents, frowned slightly and raised his hand to receive it.
The middle-aged man immediately took small steps forward and handed it over to him.
After opening the black secret letter, Stuart took a quick glance at it. His old eyes instantly narrowed slightly and a cold glint flashed past them, “That old thing Richelieu actually dares to spread the position of Pope without permission? After being Pope for so many years, does he think that his wings have hardened?”
“Elder, in my opinion, there must be a reason for this,”the middle-aged man said with his head lowered.
Stu Yaluo’s brows moved slightly, and he said coldly, “The five supervisors didn’t send any news back? They don’t know about such a big matter? or have they already been killed?”
The middle-aged man lowered his head even deeper, “I think so too.”
Stuart slowly raised his head and looked into the distance, his palm kneading the secret letter, “To be able to kill five supervisors silently and control Richelieu, he must be at least a quasi-pioneer level expert. How are the reactions of the other forces? Can they deduce which force is secretly involved in the outer wall area?”
“This, I am still investigating,”the middle-aged man said in a low voice.
Stuart lowered his head and stared at him. After a moment, he slowly moved his gaze away, he said coldly, “Let Delphine take Francis and the others to the outer wall area to investigate. Although this is a backward barbarian land that has been eroded by radiation, it is also an important part of our strategic deployment. We can not let others rob it so easily. Moreover, they are snatching fruits from our hands. Humph, we must cut off his hand!”
“Yes!”The middle-aged man’s heart trembled slightly, and he bowed his head in agreement.
..
..
After the inauguration ceremony, the name of the new pope, Barton, was immediately published in all the major newspapers and spread to every corner of the outer wall region. For a time, other than the underground miners in the slums.., and the adventurers who went out to pick up gold in the radiation zone, almost everyone knew about it.
Accompanied by Richelieu, Barton nervously dealt with the important figures sent by various forces. Then, he was brought by Richelieu to the Supreme Holy Light Palace where the Pope lived, which was also where Richelieu used to live.
Barton didn’t have time to exclaim about the magnificence of the ‘chamber’when he saw a familiar figure sitting on the throne. Although the latter’s face was familiar but the temperament he exuded was different, he was different from the kind youth in his memory.
However, he didn’t think about it. He excitedly ran over: “Di, Dean, I really became the Pope!”
“Impudent!”Sergei who was standing next to dudian immediately shouted: “How Do You Call My Young Master? !”
Dudian slightly raised his hand to indicate that it was alright.
Barton was startled for a moment and reacted. He suddenly remembered that this scene was predicted by Dudian seven days ago. In other words.., all of this was arranged by him. He couldn’t help but feel deep awe in his heart. He had seen the shocking scene when he was on the stage. He knew very well that.., he was sitting in a lofty and great position. But such a great position seemed insignificant in front of dudian.
“Young Master.”Barton immediately bowed his head and called out like the time when he was training in the Ryan family.
“You and I are friends. There is no need to be like this.”Dudian waved his hand.
Barton was no longer an ignorant kid. How could he believe Dudian’s politeness? He immediately shook his head, “Young master, it is my honor that you are willing to let me be your brother. If it wasn’t for You Then I wouldn’t be here today. You will always be my loyal young master!”He bowed his head.
Dudian immediately stood up and held his arm: “You will always be my brother. It is my honor that you are willing to believe in me!”
Barton’s eyes were wet as he looked at Dudian’s sincere eyes.
Sergei saw Dudian’s abnormal appearance. He couldn’t help but shake his head! Shameless!
Dudian said: “I came to find you today mainly to protect you.”
“Protect me?”Barton was startled as he felt nervous.
Richelieu’s eyes lit up as he looked at dudian.
Dudian stared at him, he slowly said: “You should know that the truth is the same as giving and receiving. To be honest, I have thought about it for a long time. It is not easy to be a pope. You have to face the assassination of the dark church and other forces at all times. I think Richelieu knows this very well. Don’t you think so?”
Richelieu looked up at him and then looked at Barton. He nodded: “Yes, honor and sacrifice coexist. You should be ready to sacrifice at any time when you get this honor.”
Barton was a bit nervous but he was embarrassed to show it. He couldn’t hide his thoughts because of his experience.
Dudian saw through his thoughts and looked at him: “Master Richelieu is right. If you want to wear the crown, you should bear the weight. Are You Afraid?”
Barton looked at Dudian’s deep eyes. He felt a bit of courage rush to his chest: “I’m Not Afraid!”
Dudian patted his shoulder and nodded: “Well, you don’t have to worry. I’m here to protect you. No one can hurt you unless I Die!”
Barton was moved: “Don’t say that. I’m the one who will die. My life was given to me by you. If I have to sacrifice myself for you then at least I will repay your kindness!”
“Repay kindness…”Dudian silently muttered these two words in his heart. At the same time he thanked one person. It was aunt Dai from Meishan orphanage, it was Aunt Dai who taught the orphans.
“Later you will send an order to the temple of elements. Tell them to invite me to discuss the matter of the Holy Church. In that case I will be able to live here and protect you in the future.”Dudian said.
Barton nodded.
Richelieu secretly sighed. He knew that Dudian was going to put his finger on the core organization of the Holy Church. The temple of elements.
That night, the commercial district was brightly lit. All the taverns and streets as well as families were talking about the change of Pope today. In particular, Barton announced the six reforms, many squire nobles and wealthy businessmen were talking about it.
The young ladies and young masters of these squire nobles were more curious about Barton’s age, appearance and other information.
“The new pope is indeed as great as master Antonia’s praises. From now on, our lives will be at least twice as rich!”
“That’s right, the radiant church is really good. It’s much better than the military. Every year they fight, they collect military salaries.”
“The military is nothing. The nobles fight, and they want money from us. Disgusting!”
“Shhh! Keep your voice down! If the military knows about this, they will send you to prison.”
“That’s right! Let’s talk about the new pope. I heard that a legendary knight from the Knight’s Hall publicly praised the new pope’s virtue. I heard that the new pope is young and Young.”
“He has such talent and glory at such a young age. He is even more terrifying than the legendary genius dudian. They are all young heroes!”
“Yes, I thought that the legendary genius was a rare figure in a hundred years. He has achieved unprecedented achievements at such a young age. I didn’t expect that the new pope would be the same. But why haven’t I heard any news about him?”
“What do you know? The holy church must have groomed him as the next pope. How could he be so easily exposed? Unless his brain is damaged.”
“That’s right. If the dark cultists knew that such a figure was the next pope, they would have sent people to assassinate him every day!”
“This brother is still the most thorough!”
“You flatter me. Everyone, let’s Drink a toast to this great new pope!”
“Cheers! !”
Countless heroic shouts rang out in the tavern, and the clinking of glasses could be heard.

chapters.title: Chapter 644
chapters.content:
Chapter 644 – Chapter 643: Chaos Begins [ First Update ]
Barton’s tax reduction treaty after becoming the pope caused the outer wall to sink into a sea of cheers. In this era where the class system was clear, the tax burden far exceeded the imagination of ordinary people, at this moment, no one would protest against the fact that the new pope had succeeded to the throne. However, places like the military and the Knight’s Hall were excluded.
“What does the Holy See want to do this time? Reduce taxes? They want to use such a method to gather the People’s hearts?”
In the conference room of the military headquarters, many generals and chief of staff, led by the three commanders-in-chief, were sitting in the hall. Some looked worried, some looked deep, and some were deep in thought.
“According to the latest intelligence, I have found the identity of the new pope. If I tell you, you will think that I am joking.”A five-star general with a full beard looked around the crowd, there was a trace of mockery and coldness on his face.
“Don’t keep me in suspense. Just tell me directly!”
“What identity?”
The general with a full beard said calmly, “This kid named Barton is not a noble at all, nor has he been crowned with a Knight Medal. In fact, he is just an orphan kid from the slums! “I have found the orphanage where he came from and verified his identity.”
“What? !”
“What are you talking about?”
“He’s from the slums? !”
Everyone was dumbfounded and looked at the bearded general in disbelief.
This reaction was completely within the bearded general’s expectations. When he first received the news, his reaction was exactly the same as theirs. However, at this moment, he only felt a trace of ridicule in his heart. It wasn’t because he felt that his peers were laughable.., it was because he felt that the actions of the radiant church were laughable. They actually allowed a lowly commoner to sit on the position of Pope. No one would believe it even if it was said!
“He is an orphan from the slums. How can he join the Radiant Church?”A heroic female general said with a frown.
The bearded general shrugged slightly, “Didn’t the radiant church change the recruitment rules a few years ago? As long as one comes from a noble background, they can avoid the assessment and enter the probation stage. Before he entered the radiant church, he was adopted by a lonely noble. As for why this poor noble would adopt such a lowly person, no one knows.”
“Didn’t you get it out?”
“I can’t ask the mouth of a dead person.”
“They died?”
“When my people investigated, they had already been dead for a long time. Their entire family was killed, and even their children were not spared. Not a single one survived, including their distant relatives who came to visit them. Unfortunately, they also suffered!”The bearded general said indifferently.
The other general, who was as tall as a bear, had a gloomy face, he said in a muffled voice, “In other words, they were silenced. It seems that all of this was meticulously planned. When the time comes, what kind of conspiracy is the church planning? Why would Richelieu support a commoner from the slums to succeed the throne? Isn’t he afraid of blasphemy by doing this?”?
“The Church of light has been blaspheming the gods for a long time. Using the name of God to educate the commoners and extort their money, it’s extremely despicable!”The female general from before said coldly.
“I don’t agree with your words.”The other blonde and white-skinned general looked unhappy, “Although the Holy See has gone overboard in some areas, if it wasn’t for the Holy See’s ability to spread justice for so many years, the outer wall region wouldn’t be so peaceful. The plague and poverty would bring about riots. The Holy See has calmed the emotions of the commoners. This is something that we soldiers will never be able to do. We Can’t point our weapons and spears at everyone and tell them not to fight or cause trouble. Otherwise, they will be punished, right?”
The female general sneered and said, “Are you sure that the person who spreads the power of justice is the person of Justice?”? “We didn’t use weapons to intimidate the civilians, but they have already done so. If the Knights of light didn’t patrol around, how many riots would there be?”
“You’re making nonsense!”The blonde general said angrily, “Who said that the person who spreads the power of justice must be the person of Justice? “Even if the pope’s goal is to benefit, at least the impact of what he does is good. That’s Enough!”
“Enough.”A commander in his eighties raised his hand slightly to stop the two from arguing, he said, “The contribution of the Holy See is undeniable. However, after so many years, the Holy See has become more and more unscrupulous. Behind any power is the word ‘benefit’. The Holy See is no exception. We have suffered losses in the hands of the Holy See these years. Everyone should know that if we allow the Holy See to continue expanding, when all the nobles and civilians are on their side, as the ones who maintain the security of the outer wall, we can only look up to the Holy See.”
“Your words are too serious.”A similarly aged white-haired old man beside him smiled faintly. “What use can the commoners be? Even if they all become believers of the Holy See, what can they do? Do they still dare to overturn the heavens?”
“Why not? I feel that the power of the commoners can not be underestimated. Although they are weak, their numbers are great. If they gather together, they might be able to shake our power!”The eighty-year-old man from before said in a deep voice.
“You are worrying too much.”The white-haired old man chuckled. “Let’s not talk about the fact that these commoners do not dare to do so. Even if they listen to the words of the Holy See and oppose us, they will only be seeking their own destruction. There is only one path to death. Do you think that the Iron Lion Crusade under us is afraid of these unarmed commoners?”
“If we underestimate the commoners, we will suffer a great loss sooner or later!”The eighty-year-old man said angrily.
“I agree,”a general echoed.
The white-haired old man glanced at him, he said indifferently, “Rather than caring about these lowly commoners, why don’t we talk about the Holy See? This time, they have elected a new pope to succeed them. They must be planning to do something big. What I’m most worried about is the inner wall behind the Holy See… if they are guided by the inner wall, this matter will be troublesome.”
Hearing his words, everyone looked at each other, their expressions ugly.
“Commander, if the Holy See has the inner wall interfering, should we apply to the defense army of the inner wall and ask them to send reinforcements?”The female general from before immediately asked.
The white-haired old man sneered and said, “Nothing has happened. It’s just a guess, and they have invited the inner wall over. Are you trying to start a war in the inner wall?”
The eighty-year-old man sitting next to him did not say anything. He did not agree or reject.
When the female general heard his words, a trace of disappointment flashed across her eyes. She sighed in her heart. She knew that the military region had always been against requesting reinforcements from the inner wall. Even though the last time the barbarians invaded the territory and broke through the fortress.., the military region had also waited until the very end before requesting reinforcements from the inner wall. The reason for this was that many of the generals present were against requesting reinforcements because once the inner wall sent people over.., they would all face the possibility of being reshuffled, especially the three commanders-in-chief. They would also face the possibility of being governed, and would no longer be supreme!
“I think it’s better to use our spies to investigate the details and see what the Holy See is planning to do.”The bearded general from before spoke, breaking the deadlock.
Someone immediately agreed.
While the military region was having a meeting, an angry voice shook the meeting hall of the hall of knights, “Bori! Are You a spy sent by the Holy See? Who allowed you to act on your own accord and support the Holy See on behalf of the entire hall of Knights? Do you want to drag the hall of knights into this mess? !”
The one who spoke was an old man with white hair and beard. He was also the Hall Master of the Hall of Knights, Vic Jones!
Everyone stared coldly at a thin old man, waiting for his explanation.
Boray smiled bitterly. When he was praising the new pope as a legendary knight, he knew that he would face this scene. He silently chose his words, he said, “Temple Master, I’m not representing the entire hall of knights. I’m just representing myself. I’ve seen the resume of this new pope. I think this person is very good. He will be an outstanding pope in the future. That’s why I’m praising him.”
“Personally?”? ! Vic Jones said angrily, “Will the people outside think that you’re representing yourself? Will the military region think so? Will the Court of Justice Think So? Let me tell you, the succession of the Pope of the Holy See has always been controlled by the inner wall region! The sudden change of the Pope of the Holy See this time must be because the inner wall region suddenly had some sort of plan. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be so sudden! You dragged us into this mess to destroy us!”

chapters.title: Chapter 645
chapters.content:
Chapter 645 – Chapter 644: Return To The [ Second Update ]
Boree quickly said, “Temple master, it’s not that serious. Besides, even if there is an operation in the inner wall, it wouldn’t be bad for us to take the initiative to express our goodwill, right?”
“Stupid! If the inner wall is behind the plan of the Holy See, do you think that the military region and the Court of Justice would not take action? !”Vic Jones looked at him angrily, “They all have the support of the big forces in the inner wall. Although Our Knight’s Hall is famous in the outer wall, our foundation is shallow in the inner wall. We can’t be compared to them at all. Once they pass the fire of war in the inner wall through the outer wall as a warm-up, our Knight’s Hall will be the first to suffer!”
Bori was stunned. The other elders also looked at him in surprise. He had never told them such a secret before.
Vic Jones looked at his reaction and did not hide it anymore, he said, “For so many years, we have made friends in the hall of knights. We have gained the love of the nobles in the outer wall and the respect of the Holy See. Even the military region does not dare to look down on us. On the surface, we seem to be very strong and are the belief of all knights. But why have we been standing still for so many years and never actively develop our power?”
“It’s not because we believe in the principle that we can’t fight with people without reason. It’s because our foundation is not as strong as theirs!”
Boray’s face slightly changed as he heard Dudian’s words. He didn’t expect that there was such a hidden story. What he didn’t expect was that the principles that bound them weren’t the ones that he respected and believed in, the most straightforward thing, not strong enough!
..
..
The next day, Dudian returned to the temple of elements. His appearance caused countless onlookers and cheers. The temple of elements was the most exciting thing when Barton became pope, since Dudian was arrested for secretly colluding with the dark church the whole atmosphere of the temple of elements has been in a depressed state and the image of the outside world has declined a lot.
The Holy Masters would talk about this matter in private. After all, they had no way to forget this person. They couldn’t help but talk about this person no matter what kind of invention they were making, especially the wood and Lightning Holy Masters. After Dudian left, they had been studying the principles of wood and lightning rod that Dudian had left behind.
The name ‘Dudian’had become a monument that couldn’t be bypassed on the path of a Holy Master!
Although the ‘gas’system was banned, there was no lack of holy masters who were interested in the ‘gas’system. After all, this was a completely different new world. The Charm was incomparable!
“Master Dudian!”
“Master Dean!”
“Teacher!”
“Teacher!”
Dudian heard a different name in the crowd. He looked towards the source of the voice. He saw a small figure trying to squeeze through the crowd. He kept calling out ‘teacher’, but the voice was drowned out by the surroundings. If it wasn’t for his amazing hearing, it would be difficult for him to detect it.
Dudian immediately remembered that this was the student he had accepted when he was captured into the inner wall. It seemed that his name was Edward.
“Teacher!”Edward used all his strength to squeeze forward. He was afraid that he would miss this opportunity.
Dudian walked towards Edward. The crowd quickly separated and revealed Edward who was struggling to squeeze out.
“Teacher! !”Edward looked at Dudian who was close to him. He was so excited that he almost shed tears.
Dudian saw his expression and knew that he wasn’t just crying because of joy. He asked: “Have I been wronged after I Left?”
Tears rolled out of Edward’s eyes. He didn’t expect that Dudian’s first sentence after meeting him would hit deep into his heart. He felt that all the grievances and pain were nothing at this moment, he clenched his teeth and wiped the tears from his face: “No, teacher, I haven’t been wronged!”
Dudian quietly looked at him. He didn’t ask further: “From now on, you won’t be wronged anymore. You will be wronged when I leave.”
“Yes! Teacher!”Edward nodded with determination in his wet eyes.
Dudian patted his shoulder: “Follow Me.”
“Yes, teacher!”Edward firmly said.
Dudian held Aisha’s hand as they slowly walked along the temple of elements. They walked through the buildings and went down the mountain. They didn’t meet the Masters in the castle.
Edward followed Dudian into the carriage.
Dudian and Aisha sat in the carriage while Edward sat next to them. He told them about his life.
Dudian quietly listened. It was the same as what he had thought. Because of his bad reputation when he was arrested, this child who became his student but didn’t learn from him for a day had become the laughingstock of everyone, especially the people who lived with him made fun of him every day.
Even if he wanted to close the door and study his experiments, but he was only a junior architect. He was forced to live in the same room with other people. There was no separate castle, moreover, he needed to apply for the resources to produce the divine arts. However, there were many obstacles in his way. His life was extremely miserable. No one was willing to teach him new knowledge of the Divine Arts. After all, his identity as a teacher was too sensitive.
Dudian looked at the scenery outside the carriage. He quietly looked into the distance.
Edward looked at Dudian’s eyes. His thoughts drifted away. He felt that there was no difficulty that couldn’t be overcome. The world was big.., he had to rely on his own efforts to control his own fate!
Dudian brought Edward to the temple where Barton lived. He asked Sergei to carry some of his luggage over. The luggage was just some experimental materials that he needed.
The temple was very big. Dudian occupied most of the area. Edward was sent to live in the side hall outside the top of the mountain. Barton and Dudian stayed in the square during the day, dudian had taught him swordsmanship and taught him by the Sword Genius Riley.
No one recognized the person who had taught the new pope swordsmanship. He was the sword genius Riley.
In the blink of an Eye Dudian had moved to the temple for three days.
Whoosh! Dudian finished the experiment and went to the bedside. He lit a cigarette and gently exhaled smoke. He looked out of the window at the far side of the inner wall. He could faintly see the outline of the wall of Sighs.
“Master, why do you and Richelieu like to smoke this? Is It Good?”Barton was curious as he saw Dudian standing by the bedside.
“Maybe it is because it only hurts the lungs but not the heart.”Dudian didn’t look back. There was a trace of silence in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 646
chapters.content:
Chapter 646 – Chapter 645: Assassination [ First Update ]
Barton was startled as he heard Dudian’s words. He looked at his old friend who used to eat in the same dilapidated dining hall. He suddenly found that he had become a bit strange, he no longer had the vitality and vitality of an eighteen-year-old. He was like a piece of frozen ice that could no longer be eroded or warmed.
He thought of the days that they had experienced together. There was a kind of sadness that came from nowhere. He forced a smile: “Since it hurts the lungs, it’s better not to breathe.”
Dudian gently took a breath and slowly exhaled. Smoke lingered in the air.
Barton stared at him, he whispered: “Master, you have been alone all the way. You must have had a hard time. But now we are standing at the top. We have obtained the things that countless people dream of. No one can hurt us in the future.”
“There is no so-called gain. I have been losing and will continue to lose until the end of my life.”Dudian murmured as if he was talking to himself.
Barton felt a burst of sadness but he didn’t understand where the sadness came from. He didn’t understand why Dudian would say such words. He didn’t know why Dudian’s mood was so low as he was standing at the top, it was as if there was an invisible gap in front of them. It was as if they were separated into two worlds. The world that Dudian was standing in was close to him but it was like a distant place that he could never reach.
He fell into silence. He didn’t know what to say.
After a long time he thought of something. His eyes lit up: “Master, Let’s bring Joseph over. He is alone in the military. No one will take care of him. He should be having a hard time.”
Dudian’s blurred eyes gradually became clear. He gently put out the cigarette butt and flicked it out of the window. He turned his back to Barton: “Joseph still has his task. He will come back to us soon.”
Barton slightly opened his mouth. He wanted to open his mouth but resisted the urge to ask.
The night was coming but St. Mark’s square was as bright as day. There were street lights hanging high on the four sides of the stone pillars. There were fluorescent stones embedded in the stone pillars which illuminated the ground of the square.
Dudian opened the wooden tray. There was a piece of fresh blood inside. The rich smell of blood made Aisha slightly excited. The corner of her mouth slightly opened as if she was drooling.
Dudian took out a knife from the side. He cut out a small piece of meat and handed it to her mouth.
Aisha’s body slightly trembled, but she didn’t immediately open her mouth to eat.
Dean’s eyes were gentle as he gently shook the bell on his wrist. The bell emitted a short and regular tinkling sound. After hearing the tinkling sound, Aisha immediately opened her mouth and bit the flesh on the fork. Her white and smooth teeth had become a bit sharp. She wolfed down the flesh and blood, and the excess blood flowed out from the corner of her mouth, it was a bit ferocious.
Dudian slowly cut another piece of flesh and gently handed it to her mouth.
Aisha quickly chewed and swallowed it piece by piece. Dudian poured a cup of cold water from the side and gave it to her. She opened her mouth and drank it. After these days of interaction, he had basically grasped Aisha’s food category. The main food was raw meat. The fresher the better. As for what type of meat it was, it didn’t matter. Just like this piece of meat.., it was a piece of beef.
If she was fed roasted meat, she would definitely have diarrhea later. Moreover, because the instructions hadn’t been trained to this stage, she would often directly poop out when she had diarrhea and dirty her clothes.
In addition, Dean would give her water. In his concept, even if Aisha had turned into a corpse, her body still needed to replenish water. However, she couldn’t drink hot water, otherwise her body would have bubbles.., although it wouldn’t affect her combat ability and actions, but it would make her appearance change greatly and become hideous.
In the trial, Dudian found that although she didn’t need water and didn’t feel thirsty for water, if she wasn’t given water, her skin would become dry and cold.
After a moment, a piece of fresh beef was finished. Dudian gently patted Aisha’s back to prevent her from choking. Although he knew that she wouldn’t, but he couldn’t help but do so.
“Rest for a while. We will take a bath later.”Dudian whispered to her.
Haisha was silent. There was blood on her red lips. She looked like a cold vampire.
Dudian held her hand and looked at her gently. This time of day was the most relaxing moment for him. So he couldn’t help but talk more, “When I rule the inner wall, I will find a way to save you. They will certainly have a way. When you recover, I will take you to live in a faraway place. In my hometown, I will take you to see the scenery of my hometown. I will take you to see the sea…”
“We will live by the sea and slowly grow old…”
Dean gently said. Suddenly, the corner of Haisha’s mouth slightly moved. Her pure black eyes revealed a trace of light.
Dean was slightly startled when he saw this scene. He immediately had an unbelievable thought. Could it be that she could hear his words and her consciousness had recovered? !
He couldn’t help but tremble in excitement. His eyes were wet but soon the fantasy was broken. Aisha suddenly stood up and flew out like a sharp sword.
Whoosh! She disappeared from Dudian’s sight.
Dudian was stunned for a moment. He turned his head and saw Aisha jump into the back of the temple. There was a bottomless cliff
His pupils shrank as he quickly caught up to Aisha. The automatic thermal vision changed the world in front of his eyes. He saw two heat source figures hidden under the window of the cliff. They were climbing up!
Ambush?
Dean was startled. The excitement and fantasy in his heart was shattered. Cold water poured down his face. There was a trace of cold killing intent and anger in his eyes. Bones appeared on the surface of his skin.
Boom!
A loud sound was heard. It seemed to shake the entire mountain!
Dudian rushed to the window. He was about to jump down when he felt a sense of danger. He quickly jumped back. The window was broken and two figures flew into the temple. It was Aisha who had attacked earlier, there was another graceful woman in a black robe.
The woman’s arms were as white as jade. They were as smooth and delicate as porcelain.
Aisha immediately steadied herself after landing and turned to pounce on the black-robed woman.
The hood covering the black-robed woman’s face had long been removed. After rolling to the ground, she was about to stand up when she saw Aisha rushing toward her. Her expression immediately changed, and she hurriedly stepped back, her fingers quickly reaching for her waist, the sound of iron thorns was heard. A soft black whip suddenly swung out from her wrist, lashing toward Aisha who was pouncing toward her.
Aisha did not retreat in the face of this fierce attack. Instead, she raised her hand and grabbed the flying black whip with her slender palm. Her elbow exerted force and pulled the black whip toward her direction. At the same time, she borrowed the force and rushed toward the black-robed woman, she arrived in front of the black-robed woman as if she had teleported. Her originally beautiful and cold expression suddenly revealed a zombie-like malevolence. She opened her bloody mouth and pounced toward the black-robed woman to bite her.
The black-robed woman’s face was pale. She hurriedly raised her hand to block but her strength was like weak cotton. Aisha hugged her body and bit her throat. Her neck was instantly bitten through, blood and flesh splattered all over her face. However, she didn’t care and continued to bite crazily. The woman’s scream echoed in the hall and soon died down.
Dudian narrowed his eyes as he saw the outcome of the battle. He recognized the woman’s face the moment she appeared. She was the one who was forced to bring him to the monastery, he had seen the woman in the underground passage of the monastery. He didn’t expect her to appear here. Moreover the heat reaction from her body was extremely hot, she was definitely at the pioneer level!

chapters.title: Chapter 647
chapters.content:
Chapter 647 – : Chapter 646: [ Second Update ]
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Several figures rushed up from the broken window. They were stunned when they saw the scene in the hall.
Dudian turned to look at the few people. He recognized the leader of the group. It was Francis who had brought him into the inner wall.
“Roar!”Aisha roared. She shook off the woman who had lost her life. She turned around and stared at Francis and the others. Her body flashed as fast as lightning. She appeared in front of Francis and the others, a hand passed through the throat of a burly young saint. The latter didn’t even react. His eyes were wide open.
Dudian quickly raised his hand and shook the bell.
There were three ‘Dong Dong Dong’sounds. Aisha who was about to pounce on the others suddenly stopped.
Francis and the others woke up and felt as if they had fallen into an ice cave. Their bodies were cold and slightly trembling. Aisha’s hand had pierced through the throat of their companion. It gave them a sense of pressure.
Francis’s throat was stiff and his eyes slowly climbed onto Aisha’s face. His pupils shrank and showed an unbelievable horror. It was as if he had seen the destruction of the world. How… How..! How could this person be here? !
“Did the monastery send you?”Dudian asked.
Francis’s eyes were glued to Aisha’s body. He turned his head and looked at Dudian. The horror on his face turned into shock: “You… It’s You? Why are you here? !”
“This is my territory. Who else can be here besides me?”Dudian wasn’t in a hurry to kill them. The first time the monastery sent people over, they sent a pioneer and five saints led by Francis, it was out of his expectations. He thought that they would only send a few saints. He didn’t expect that they would directly send pioneers. They weren’t like the villains in the fairy tale who constantly sent small fry heroes as targets to practice their skills, then, the main character would grow stronger and stronger until he could beat up the boss of the villains.
“Your territory?”Francis was stunned. He turned to look at Aisha in front of him and immediately saw a clue. Aisha’s face was expressionless and her pupils were completely black. This strange phenomenon gave him a sense of familiarity, however, he could not remember where he had seen such a situation before.
At this time, a burst of hurried footsteps came from outside.
Richelieu was the first to rush into the hall. He saw the messy scene and the bodies on the ground. His face couldn’t help but change. The next moment, his eyes fell on Francis and the others, he immediately rushed to Dudian’s side and asked with concern: “Master, Are You Alright?”
Dudian indifferently said: “I’m fine. Tell the guards to stand down. Tell them that the assassin has been dealt with.”
“Yes.”Richelieu respectfully nodded. He looked at Francis as he left. He knew that most of them would be buried here. He was disappointed and sighed.
Francis looked at Richelieu who trotted over and respectfully stepped down. His eyes widened in disbelief. How could he be in such a posture? !
“What did the monastery say?”Dudian coldly said: “If you tell the truth then I might spare your lives.”
Francis couldn’t help but look at the legendary girl next to him. He looked at dudian. His heart was full of shock, francis hurriedly said: “We are old acquaintances. Today is a misunderstanding. We are just here to observe the situation in the outer wall. There is no malice.”He squeezed out a kind smile.
Dudian was living in the holy temple which only the Pope could live in. It was obvious that the change in the outer wall was caused by the youth who was once a prisoner!
Moreover, there was a legendary girl next to him. Could it be that the dragon clan was ready to take control of the outer wall and start a war with the monastery?
“The monastery already knows about the succession of popes. They sent you here to assassinate the new pope and capture Richelieu.”Dudian indifferently said: “Don’t continue to play tricks with me. I just want to know the current situation of the monastery and the current situation of the inner wall.”
Francis’s face slightly changed as he saw that Dudian had predicted the situation. He had a deep impression of the last time he captured the youth. He knew that the youth’s intelligence was something that he wouldn’t let go of today, he immediately said: “You have basically told us everything that we know. As for the situation in the inner wall, I don’t know what you want to know. Otherwise, I don’t know where to start.”
“The matter of the Monster Research Institute, the matter of the Dragon family of the Witcher family, the matter of the nobles in the inner wall, and the matter of your monastery.”Dudian coldly said: “Tell us everything you know. The one who talks the most will live!”
Francis’s face changed. He suddenly felt that there was some commotion behind him. He knew that Dudian was ruthless and ruthless. With the legendary girl by his side, it would be a daydream if he wanted to take the opportunity to escape, he immediately said: “I say, the Dragon Clan hasn’t had any major events recently. Oh, right, the front end of the Dragon Clan is the change of time…”he looked at Aisha.
“Continue.”
“Yes…”
A moment later, Francis finished his sentence.
Dudian looked at the people behind him: “Do you have anything to add?”
They looked at each other and didn’t know how to answer.
Dudian slowly walked past one of the youth. The youth didn’t have time to relax as his neck suddenly hurt. His consciousness was cut off and his body collapsed.
“You!”The two saw Dudian sneak attack the youth. They clenched their weapons in anger. They wanted to attack but held back.
Dudian shook his dagger and coldly said: “Don’t you have anything to add?”
Both of them looked at each other. One of the women said: “Will you really let us go?”
“Of course.”Dudian indifferently said: “I always keep my word.”
Both of them looked at each other, the woman gritted her teeth: “Captain didn’t mention the core of the monastery. I can add that our monastery has spent a lot of effort to control the outer wall area. First of all, a legendary missionary of our monastery left a notice which told us to teach barbarians and not to give up our lives. Secondly, when our monastery taught the outer wall area, we found that the population of the outer wall area was not small. Although the conditions were bad but the population was close to the population of the inner wall. So the outer wall area was included in our monastery’s strategic deployment site. As for the specific deployment, I’m not sure. But it seems that we are preparing for future battles.”
“Why didn’t they send you saints?”Dudian asked.
“Yes.”The woman said: “They sent five supervisors. It’s enough to monitor the outer wall but I didn’t expect that all of them were destroyed.”
Dudian nodded and looked at the other young man: “Do you have anything to add?”
The Young Man’s face turned pale: “I… I want to say the same thing as them.”
“What About You? Don’t you have anything to add? Only one of you can live.”Dudian looked at Francis.
Francis’s head was full of cold sweat. He was in a complicated mood. The people behind him were his brothers who had risked their lives with him!
“I’ll talk, I’ll talk.”Francis clenched his fists: “We have told you everything else. I also know that the Elder’s magic marks are legendary magic marks Shadow Hunter!”
“Francis, you!”The two behind looked at him. Their faces were red with anger.
Dudian slightly frowned. This news was not important to him. However, it was enough to show that he had squeezed the three of them. If he continued to talk, he would talk about some messy things.., he pondered for a while and raised his hand to shake the bell.

chapters.title: Chapter 648
chapters.content:
Chapter 648 – : Chapter 647: Erosion
Aisha, who had been motionless, let out a low growl when she heard the bell. She suddenly pounced on Francis and the other two.
Francis was shocked and hurriedly raised his hand to parry. However, when he raised his arm, he felt that his chest was pierced by a sharp object. It was so cold that it pierced his bones. His body was violently thrown out and smashed onto the floor.
“Didn’t you say…”he was panicking. He was about to get up from the ground as he angrily questioned Dudian.
However, before he could finish his words, the black shadow attacked his line of sight. With a bang, Francis’s head was twisted off and his body fell down. His expression was still angry as he stared at the ground.
In the blink of an eye, the three of them were killed by Aisha.
Dudian shook the bell in time to stop Aisha from biting one of them. He took out a handkerchief and came in front of her. He wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth and fingers but there was still a bloody mark.
He turned around and called Richelieu who was guarding the entrance of the hall: “Get Someone to clean up their bodies. Tell them that the dark church attacked the pope and burned them in public.”
Richelieu was surprised as he looked at the corpses on the ground. He didn’t expect that the few saints sent by the inner wall would die so quickly. They didn’t even hurt Dudian, it was the woman who was always by Dudian’s side. This was definitely the strongest line of defense. It was the most dangerous and beautiful line of defense.
Barton rushed in after Richelieu left. He was relieved to see that Dudian wasn’t injured. He was surprised to see the bodies on the ground as well as the broken windows, he asked Dudian: “Master, Are You Alright? Are they here to assassinate me?”
“Yes.”Dudian nodded.
Barton didn’t expect that these people would climb up from the cliff behind the temple. If he lived here alone then he would have been quietly beheaded.
“Fortunately young master you are here. Otherwise I would…”Barton was grateful to Dudian. Although he knew that if he didn’t become Pope then he wouldn’t be assassinated but Dudian had saved his life once again, but it was the truth.
Dudian waved his hand: “The person who wants to hurt you is my enemy. This matter is also because of me. It’s late. Go to sleep. I will deal with it here.”
Barton looked at the corpses on the ground. The rich smell of blood was pungent. It made his stomach churn. He felt nauseous. But he resisted the urge. How could he sleep after such a big thing happened tonight?
He agreed and left the place. It took courage to stay with the corpses.
“You have worked hard.”After Barton left, Dudian pulled Aisha back to the chair. The coldness on his face had long melted. He was full of tenderness and tenderness as he touched her cold hands, “Next time, they will send stronger people. Fortunately, you are by my side.”
Aisha was expressionless and didn’t say anything.
After a while, Richelieu led a team of knights of light into the hall. He dragged the bodies down to deal with them. He called the servants to clean the ground several times to get rid of the smell of blood. Dudian took clean water and cleaned Aisha’s fingers and lips. He took her to the other side of the hall and sat down. He estimated that it was almost time for the other forces to.., most likely they had begun to take action.
After dawn, the bodies of Francis and the others were locked in the prison carriage by the Knights of light. They were paraded in the streets. Countless passers-by gathered around and pointed at them.
The news of the assassination of the Pope quickly spread to the military headquarters and the Knight’s Hall.
“General, I have personally seen it. The faces of these dark cultists have been destroyed. They can not be recognized. Their deaths were tragic. They were not caused by weapons. Instead, it was as if they were torn by something.”
“Forcefully torn apart?”
“That’s right. I even had someone secretly shoot a cold arrow at the corpses. The result was very shocking. The arrow actually did not pierce through the corpses of these people. According to this subordinate’s guess, these people’s physiques are most likely at the level of top hunters, or their magic marks are biased towards body strengthening.”
“Oh? The arrow actually could not pierce through the corpses? Are you sure?”
“This subordinate is sure!”
“It seems that the dark church has sent out all their experts this time. I didn’t expect that there would be such a powerful expert hidden in the dark church. Even after death, the arrows couldn’t hurt the corpse. If he was still alive, who knows how strong he would be…”
In the Knight’s Hall on the other side, everyone was discussing animatedly.
“The dark church is so eager to make a move. It seems that the glory of the new pope is not completely fabricated.”
“This time, they must have sent many experts to assassinate the pope. I didn’t expect that all of them would die.”
“The power of the new pope can not be underestimated. There might be experts hiding by his side!”
“If we can find out from the dark church which experts they sent, we can roughly know the power of the Radiant Church.”
When Francis and the others’corpses were paraded on the streets, the ones who were the most shocked were the dark church members who were hiding in the dark alleys and secretly watching the scene. When they saw the black tattoos on the corpses, they were both disappointed.., they were also excited. They didn’t expect the dark cult that they were loyal to to be so awesome. They actually dared to assassinate the pope. Although they failed, it probably scared the pope out of his wits, right?
At the same time, after the elders of the 12th district of the dark cult received the news, they immediately called for an emergency meeting.
“Who sent people to assassinate him?”
“Which district sent people?”
“Why didn’t they discuss this beforehand? Isn’t this alerting the enemy? B * Stard!”
Everyone was angry as they questioned the person who “Made the decision”. However after half an hour they found that… no one had sent anyone to assassinate the pope.
They were stunned for a moment. Soon someone thought that other forces might have framed the dark church.
At the end of the meeting the elders of the 12th district received a secret letter from Dudian. Everyone was stunned as they looked at each other. They didn’t expect that Dudian would send someone to assassinate the pope, dudian was the one who orchestrated this event. Moreover, he was listening to the contents of the secret letter. The purpose of doing so was to pave the way for the rule of the military headquarters and the Knight’s Temple!
Terrible!
After the secret letter was read, the entire meeting room was silent.
In the blink of an eye, a day had passed.
Dudian called Barton the next day after Francis and others’bodies were paraded in public. He ordered Barton to send troops to capture Commander Bryson of the military headquarters. The reason was that he was colluding with the dark church!

chapters.title: Chapter 649
chapters.content:
Chapter 649 – Chapter 648: Everyone Is Guilty
“Master, Commander Bryson is colluding with the Dark Church?”Barton was shocked as he heard Dudian’s words. This news was too shocking. He was one of the most powerful people in the military headquarters, it was unbelievable that he had dealings with the dark church.
“The collusion is fake, but he is guilty.”Dudian didn’t lie to Barton, “The only obstacles in front of us are the headquarters of the military region and the magistrate. The Knight’s Temple is nothing to be afraid of. Those who establish their family based on faith will be trampled under the feet of faith. As for us, if we don’t hurt others, we won’t be hurt. We seem to be high and mighty, but in fact, there is no way out. Do you understand?”
Barton was stunned. Although he didn’t fully understand but he understood two points. The first point was that commander Bryson was wronged because he was the enemy. The second point was that Dudian’s goal was to rule the entire outer wall. Perhaps this was just the beginning!
He didn’t know what to say. In his heart, the title ‘Commander of the military region’contained too much solemnity and solemnity. He didn’t think that just because it was a hindrance, Dudian would slander him or even destroy him!
He didn’t know whether Dudian was right or wrong. He suddenly felt a bit lost.
Dudian understood Barton’s thoughts from his expression. He patted his shoulder, “Don’t think too much. Think about what the military region has done. Think about the families of civilians who were forced to be separated by the military. Think about what the military did when they bullied the civilians. They didn’t discipline the civilians. They acquiesced to it. This is their crime!”
Barton was startled. He recalled the scenes of the military coming to the slums to arrest the soldiers. His heart softened as he nodded, “I know. They are not worthy of sympathy!”
“Go.”Dudian said.
Richelieu looked at Barton as he left. He sighed in his heart. He turned around and looked at the black-haired teenager, “Are we really going to cut open the military? Bryson is the commander. Even if the dark church can prove that he colluded with the dark church, the military won’t let us take him away so easily. Otherwise, I would have used this method in the past.”
“You didn’t use it in the past because you had too many concerns.”Dudian’s face was cold, “If you have too many concerns then you will have too little courage. In the past, as long as you were a noble or a general of the military region, you would turn a blind eye even if you colluded with the dark church to commit despicable acts. Some nobles sold human organs and some sold orphans from the slums. You knew about these things but you acquiesced. This is your sin!”
“Every one of us is guilty and should die.”Dudian looked down at him: “But only the strong can judge others. The biggest sin of death is weakness!”
Richelieu was stunned.
“Bryson will not be obedient. The military will not let such a thing happen. They will lose face and prestige. They will stubbornly resist. This is a declaration of war!”Dudian said in a cold tone: “I want to control the holy church. I want to use the name of the holy church to sweep across all forces. No matter what war it is, we will always win. This is the lesson of history. You will not understand.”
Richelieu felt touched. As the Pope, he had been managing the Holy See with divine power and faith for many years. He knew how important the existence of faith was. There was no need for him to spend any resources. Just a single sentence.., could make countless believers sacrifice their lives without fear. This was the power of faith. But the young man in front of him had said it more clearly. It was the will of the people!
In the aristocrats, military regions, and even the Knight’s hall, they did not take the commoners seriously. Just from the expression of the word “Lowly”that came out of his mouth without any cover, one could see what kind of discriminatory concept it was, however, only he knew that although the commoners were weak, when they gathered together, they were an unrivaled force that could overturn everything!
In addition to him, the teenager was also aware of this point. Just this vision alone made him feel terrible!
“This is not an arrest but an all-out declaration of war!”Dudian stared at Richelieu, “This time, I need you to personally lead the team and let the great light cooperate with you to defeat the military region in one fell swoop. Those who resist will die and those who block me will die. Do you understand?”
Richelieu looked at him in a daze. After a moment he slowly lowered his head: “I understand. I will do it.”
“Go. I will wait here for Your Good News.”Dudian indifferently said.
Richelieu bowed deeply and turned to leave.
The holy edict spread out and the entire holy church was in an uproar. The news quickly spread to all the forces and even the civilians.
“Commander Bryson is actually colluding with the dark cult? My God, the Grand Commander is actually mixed up with the dark cult!”
“No wonder the dark cult can never be killed off. They are so arrogant and have been appearing all over the business district in recent days. It turns out that there is a military region protecting them from behind!”
“Will the Military Region Hand Bryson over? Such a big matter shouldn’t be taken away by the radiant church just like that. In the past, arresting a general who was doing business with the dark cult caused quite a bit of friction.”
“Is this news true?”
The commoners speculated.
The nobles of the six consortia, the Inquisition, and the hall of knights were all stunned when they heard the news.
They knew the consequences of the Holy Church announcing this news. It was equivalent to officially declaring war with the military region. If the holy church retreated, then the holy church’s prestige would be greatly damaged. However, if Bryson was really sentenced.., the prestige of the military region would also be damaged. Once this news was released, it was equivalent to forcing the two factions to declare war!
“Father, is this matter true? Commander Bryson actually colluded with the dark cult?”
“Child, your political awareness is still too shallow. The Holy See is just deliberately finding an excuse to start a war. Moreover, if the Holy See wins this time, the outer wall region will be dominated by the Holy See in the future.”
“I see. Does this mean that this matter is fake?”
“It’s not that important. What’s important is power. If a person with power says something that is fake, people will take it seriously. If a person with no ability speaks the truth, people will also take it as fake. They might not even listen.”
“I know. This is just like us nobles. No matter what we say, the commoners will believe it.”
“That’s right. The pariahs won’t be jealous of the nobles, but they will definitely be jealous of a pariahs who are better off than themselves.”
“I know, Father.”

chapters.title: Chapter 650
chapters.content:
Chapter 650 – Chapter 649: Gift -Lfirstiupdatedate ]
“Riley, there is something I need you to do.”
Dudian called Riley to accompany Barton to practice swordsmanship, “Help me pick up a person from the military. His name is ‘Joseph’. His military rank shouldn’t be high. Find Hawkeye Elder from the 9th region and ask him to give it to you. In addition, ask him to send people to assist you in this matter. Make sure that this person is safely sent out.”
Riley was silent as he bowed his head: “Yes.”
“Don’t pick up the wrong person.”Dudian looked at him as he handed Hawkeye a secret letter: “Pass this to Hawkeye.”
“Yes.”Riley bowed his head.
“This Is Your Holy Knight’s badge. There is no need to sneak in and out of the Holy Church.”Dudian threw a blue badge to him, “I know what your wish is. I will let you fulfill your wish after you complete this task.”
Riley’s body slightly trembled as he bowed: “Yes!”
Dudian stood up and went to the gate of the temple. He saw Barton practicing his sword in the square. Barton stopped as he heard the call. He put away his wooden sword and wiped the sweat from his forehead. He trotted over the steps and asked: “Master, are you looking for me?”
“I haven’t given you any gifts.”Dudian took out a handkerchief to wipe the sweat from his forehead: “I have something for you. Come with me.”
Barton was moved as he saw Dudian carefully wipe the sweat from his forehead. Although he felt that Dudian was very different from before but there was no difference in his treatment.
“Master, you have given me the position of Pope. I Can’t take your things anymore.”Barton quickly said.
Dudian handed the handkerchief to him and turned: “Let’s take a look.”
Barton took the handkerchief and slightly clenched it. He followed Dudian into the hall.
Dudian came to the desk and opened the drawer. He took out a black wooden box, “This is a rare parasitic soul worm called ‘silencer’. I asked someone to find it for you. You are in a high position now so you will encounter hostility from all directions. You have to improve your strength. Are you willing to use it?”
Barton was stunned. He was no longer a small figure. He knew about the existence of magic marks as a trainee knight. The rare parasitic soul worm was basically the best magic marks! As for the stronger legendary parasitic soul worm, it only existed in the legends. No one had ever seen it. He didn’t expect that Dudian would prepare such a big gift for him!
“Yes, of course I’m Willing!”Barton was grateful but he thought of something: “Such a precious magic mark. Are you really going to give it to me? If I waste it…”
“You are my brother. Who else can I give it to?”Dudian patted Barton’s shoulder: “In the future I will defeat the inner wall. If I get the legendary parasitic soul worm then I will replace it for you.”
Barton’s eyes were slightly moist. He lowered his head so that Dudian wouldn’t see it. He didn’t want to appear pretentious. But his heart was moved beyond words. After a moment he took a deep breath, “I’m very satisfied to get this!”
Dudian handed the black box to Barton: “You can use the resources to upgrade the magic marks. The Holy See should have a lot of God’s blessings in reserve.”
Barton nodded and hugged the box tightly.
At the same time, there was a heated debate in the conference room of the military headquarters in the west of the commercial district.
“The Holy See is simply outrageous! They dare to publicly slander commander Bryson. has that new pope’s brain been kicked by a pig? !”
“The Holy See is preparing to declare war on us. HMPH, they actually found such a clumsy excuse!”
“Sir, we will defend you to the death!”
The generals were filled with righteous indignation. Among them, they were so hot-tempered that they even slammed the table loudly.
Bryson sat upright on the left side of the seats with a gloomy expression. He had not expected the Holy See to attack them after the new emperor had just been replaced. Shouldn’t they be focusing on dealing with the voices of the villains within the Holy See at this time, moreover, among the three commanders, he had been chosen. No matter what the outcome was this time, it was an irreparable loss to his personal reputation.
“Commander Bryson.”Beside him, Saint Lorenzo turned to look at him. His gaze was deep, as though he had seen into the depths of Bryson’s heart. However, Bryson also looked at him calmly. There was no fear in his gaze, and it was filled with righteousness. Saint Lorenzo slowly said, “We believe in you and will not collude with the dark cult. The Holy See has announced this news without discussing it with US beforehand. They should be prepared to take you by force.”
Bryson’s eyes flashed slightly and he said in a deep voice, “If I am guilty, I am willing to bear the responsibility alone!”
“No!”Someone from the general below immediately stood up and said loudly, “You are the commander-in-chief of our military region. How can you let the Holy See Judge You? Who are they? They act all mysterious all the time. I don’t Believe This!”
“That’s right!”Someone beside him immediately agreed. “The Holy See slandered you at will. It’s ridiculous! They want to judge you with just them? They are overestimating themselves!”
Saint Lorenzo nodded slightly, “That’s right. You represent our entire military region. We won’t let you bear the responsibility alone. No matter what evidence the Holy See has, we have to make them give a reasonable explanation. This is openly undermining the prestige of our military region!”
Bryson fell silent. He knew that his identity was too awkward at this time. Not speaking was the best language.
“If the Holy See wants to judge the commander-in-chief, they will have to ask if the sword in my hand will agree!”
“I don’t believe that the Holy See would dare to start a war with our military region with just that little bit of power!”
“This order was issued by the new pope. HMPH, he probably wants to step on commander Bryson’s shoulder and intimidate the others. Don’t even think about getting away with it!”
Seeing that the generals were agitated, Saint Lorenzo raised his hand and slightly suppressed his heated words, he said, “Immediately send someone to the Holy See to clarify things. Also, tell them that if they start a war with our military region, they won’t have a good ending.”
“Commander, I’m willing to go personally!”
“Commander, I’ll Go!”
Immediately, a few generals raised their hands and said.
Saint Lorenzo glanced at them and chose one of the female generals. He said, “Roland, you go. You’re meticulous. It’s best for you to say it. Remember, don’t be too tough, and don’t be weak either!”
“Yes!”The female general immediately stood up and accepted the order.
At the same time, Riley came to District 9 and handed the secret letter to Hawkeye. Hawkeye opened the secret letter and read it quickly. He was stunned.
Riley stared at him quietly.
Hawkeye noticed his gaze and smiled bitterly. “Fortunately, our Lord is not our enemy. I don’t know if the military district can accept this great gift from him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 651
chapters.content:
Chapter 651 – Chapter 650: Punishing Evil [ Second Update ]
Riley’s gaze moved slightly, but he did not ask.
Hawkeye looked at him and pondered for a while before saying, “Go and pick him up first. I will send Five Knights to assist you. This is the information of that ‘Joseph’. Don’t pick up the wrong one.”
Riley reached out and took it. After flipping through it, he nodded and said, “I understand.”
After Riley left, Hawkeye immediately called his secretary and asked her to write a few secret letters and send them to various places at the fastest speed.
“The military region, poor…”Hawkeye put away the secret letters and lit them on the candle. He sighed softly.
At the foot of Mount Uto, Richelieu was wearing the holy armor of the past. He sat upright on his holy sun dragon horse, looking awe-inspiring. In the huge square in front of him, there were countless knights of light gathering. They occupied the entire square. There were tens of thousands of people, which was almost 60% of the military strength of the Holy See stationed in the commercial district!
Although the number of knights of the Holy See could not be compared to the soldiers of the army, their quality was far better than the soldiers of the army.
“Your Majesty!”A burly middle-aged man riding a nearly three-meter-tall horse galloped over from afar. On the side of his horse hung a three-meter-long giant sword that was nearly half a meter wide and extremely huge.
