Richelieu looked at the person who came and waited for him to come closer before he said, “Pulo, don’t Call Me Your Majesty anymore. If it wasn’t for this matter being too troublesome, I would have already prepared to find a farm and live a small life.”
Pulo’s bell-like eyes opened wide, full of vigor, he said, “In my heart, you will always be my majesty. Why do you want that young man… that man to be the Pope? Could it be that you are really as sick as they say?”
“I’m old, it’s time to give up the throne.”Richelieu shook his head slightly. “Let’s not talk about these things. This time, we will lead a team to arrest Bryson. Are You Ready?”
“Are we really going to break with the military?”Pulo’s face revealed a serious expression. Although he had a rough appearance, it did not mean that he was brainless.
Richelieu glanced at him, he said, “Watch your words. Our belief is to punish evil and eliminate evil. Bryson colluded with the followers of the dark cult. This matter is irrefutable evidence. No matter who he is, he must pay the price for his actions. This is also the meaning of our existence!”
Pullo was stunned and immediately said solemnly, “I have misspoken. You have taught me a lesson!”
“Let’s Go!”Richelieu pulled the reins of his horse, he said, “Let the main force follow behind. You will follow me and lead the light cavalry to the Military Region first. We will treat them with respect first. If the military region insists on forcefully protecting Bryson, we will consider using forceful methods.”
“I understand.”Pullo nodded.
The news of the Holy See’s Army’s action spread along the streets. Countless civilians and nobles along the way all heard the news. Seeing the battle formation, they immediately knew that the Holy See was serious this time.
The news quickly spread to the conference room of the Military Region headquarters. When the people who had not yet finished their meeting heard the news, they immediately fell into silence.
“Richelieu and the Great Radiant King Pulo actually went out personally? Are they preparing to start a war with us? !”
“What a Holy See. They came so quickly. They are trying to catch us off guard!”
“It seems that they have also expected that this matter will not go as they wish!”
“Damn it, General Lorraine has just set off!”
Saint Lorenzo looked at the furious generals and turned to look at Bryson. He knew that they could not engage in internal strife at this time. Although the three commanders would usually fight each other secretly, if they were to engage in internal strife this time.., they would only let the Holy See succeed. In the end, even if there was one less commander, it would cause the military region to lose all face. It would also make him, who was also a Commander, lose face.
“Stall them first and wait for Roland’s reply.”Saint Lorenzo immediately ordered, “Transfer back the troops of the City Defense Department and prepare for battle!”
“Yes!”A five-star general who was the Minister of the City Defense Department immediately stood up and accepted the order.
A moment later, Richelieu and Pulo led a team of light cavalry to the front of the military headquarters’courtyard. Behind this courtyard was not just a manor, but a vast green area that contained the military headquarters’barracks, the general’s residence, as well as the training grounds and many other places, were important places in the military headquarters, but also a restricted area for civilians!
Richelieu stopped his horse and looked at a guard who was trotting over in front of the courtyard. This guard had long received the news from the higher-ups. When he saw Richelieu and plop sitting on the tall horse, he felt both nervous and fearful. Although he did not believe in the Holy See, his wife did, his mother and father also believed in it. Under the atmosphere of the entire family believing in religion, he was more or less infected. At this moment, facing these two supreme figures of the Holy See, he felt as if there were two mountains pressing down on his head and shoulders, he could not help but bend down and lower his head.
“Kid, go and call someone who can take care of things.”Before the guard could speak, Pulo was the first to shout out.
The guard was shocked and hurriedly said, “Yes, yes, I’ll go right away. You, please wait a moment.”After saying that, he did not bother to be rude and hurriedly turned around to run away.
A moment later, Saint Lorenzo led a few generals out on horseback. Just as he left the courtyard, he saw Richelieu and Pulo, who were parked at the door, as well as dozens of light cavalry behind them.
Saint Lorenzo’s gaze moved slightly, and he gently pressed on the horse’s back. The horse immediately slowed down and slowly walked in front of Richelieu, he smiled and said, “Mr. Richelieu, Mr. Pulo, the people below are not sensible. Please excuse us. Come in and talk with me.”
Richelieu smiled and said, “It’s said that soldiers are straightforward. The commander-in-chief doesn’t need to beat around the bush with us. I’m sure you know why we’re here this time. Give us a straightforward answer. Are you going to hand them over or protect them?”
Seeing that he was so direct, the smile on St. Lorenzo’s face slowly disappeared, he looked at him and said, “Do you have evidence that Commander Bryson colluded with the dark cult? “There’s something fishy in this matter. I think it’s better to investigate it thoroughly before arresting him. After all, as the commander of Our Military Region, Bryson was arrested by you just like that. How will our military region maintain its footing in the future? How will we maintain the peace and order of the outer wall region?”
“We are here to bring people. Naturally, we have evidence.”Richelieu said, “If you don’t believe me, please ask Commander Bryson to come out and meet us.”
Saint Lorenzo frowned slightly and said, “Commander Bryson is out on official business and is temporarily unable to meet us. I can help you summon him back, but it will take some time. Everyone, please come in and rest with me first. How about it?”
Richelieu narrowed his eyes and smiled, “There’s no need. We’ll wait here.”
Seeing that he wasn’t going to be soft, Lorenzo didn’t say anything more and returned on his horse after a few polite words.
“Richelieu, that old thing. He won’t listen to good words. Does he really think that our military is afraid of them?”After they entered the courtyard, one of the generals immediately lowered his voice and said angrily.
Although he was deliberately restraining his voice, they were not far from the courtyard, so it was not difficult to hear his words.
Saint Lorenzo glanced at him and knew that he was deliberately saying it for Richelieu to hear. He said, “Don’t be rude. When the matter is investigated clearly, they will give commander Bryson Justice.”Although he was reprimanding the general.., there was not a trace of anger on his face.
“Little Bastard!”Pulo’s ears trembled slightly. When he heard the voices from behind the courtyard, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes. He clenched the horse rope tightly.
Richelieu’s expression was calm. He said, “There’s no need to be angry. The dog bit you. You Can’t Bite the dog back.”
Pulo gritted his teeth slightly. He knew that the other party was deliberately provoking them. Once they forcefully broke in, the nature would be different. The military region would use this as an excuse to make a fuss and take the opportunity to cover up Bryson’s matter.
Richelieu heard the sound of horses galloping away from St. Lorenzo and the others. He turned to plop and said, “There’s no need to rush. Since they want to delay, let them. The longer they delay, the more advantageous it will be for us.”
“Advantageous for us?”PLOP did not understand.
“Don’t forget, we still have the new pope behind us,”Richelieu said with a faint gaze. In his heart, he thought that there was still that person behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 652
chapters.content:
Chapter 652 – Chapter 651: Where Everyone Wants To Go
Under the dusky sky of nuclear dust, Black Crows flew out from the temple at the top of Mount Utok. Their dark wings carried the flames of war, and with the top of Mount Utok as the center, they drew flames in all directions.
A noble was drinking fine wine and holding a woman. He looked at the graceful and graceful singer at the banquet in front of him and laughed loudly. Suddenly, he saw the black crows flying toward him from the windowsill, and his expression changed slightly.
A priest and deacon in a pure white robe was reading through the detailed records of today’s case. Suddenly, he heard the sound of wings flapping outside the window. He turned his head and saw a black crow stopping on the window lattice, there was an exquisite small scroll tied to its sharp black claws, and its dark black pupils reflected its own face.
In an ancient castle of a Gold Knight, a knight was holding his beloved woman in his arms. He was wiping his dagger and playing with it gently. While he was chatting and laughing with his lover, his ears suddenly moved slightly. He looked out of the window to the side and saw a small black shadow flying over quickly..
Roland was riding on a huge black-maned horse on the street. He was looking straight ahead. That was the direction of Utto Mountain. She did not notice that a black crow was flying directly over her head, it was flapping its wings towards the distance behind her.
After a moment, Roland came to the front of Utto Mountain, grabbed the rope of the horse and shouted, “General of the military, Roland, I request to see the Pope. Hurry up and report!”
The servants looked at each other in dismay. There was a respectful response as they trotted down the stairs.
“General?”Dudian heard the news from Barton: “It seems that the military doesn’t want to make a big fuss and fall out with us.”
Barton curiously asked: “Is the military’s strength inferior to ours?”
“Of course it’s stronger than ours.”Dudian twirled the pen in his hand, he indifferently said: “But the stronger the person, the more they cherish their feathers. The strong will not easily fight with others. Once they are injured, they will no longer be strong.”
Barton asked: “What Should we do now?”
“You are the pope. How can a general of the military meet you so easily? Let her wait.”Dudian looked at him: “You have full authority to deal with this matter. You should think about what to do.”
Barton was startled. He felt a bit embarrassed. He had a vague feeling that Dudian was the one who decided everything. But now Dudian had given him the responsibility, he suddenly felt that he was holding a hot potato in his hand. He didn’t know how to deal with it. If he didn’t deal with it well, it would ruin the big matter.
“Young master, you should deal with this. If I mess up…”Barton scratched his head.
“I won’t blame you if I mess up.”
Barton saw that Dudian had turned around. He knew that there was no room for maneuver. He secretly complained in his heart. He suddenly felt that it was extremely painful to make the decision himself.
“Then I’ll go.”He said.
“Go.”
Eighteen noble families from Huasheng Consortium expressed their support for the Crusade of the Holy See. At the same time, three famous masters in the poetry world published articles in the express newspaper. Their slogan was loud and clear. They wanted to purify all darkness!
For a time, many masters who were loved by the commoners, some were painters, and some were musicians. All of them stood out to express their views.
“I hope that the military will not protect criminals. As the Grand Commander-in-chief, they colluded with the dark cultists and bullied the commoners. This is simply detestable!”
“God said that the existence of light is to dispel all darkness!”! “I agree with the sacrifice of the Holy See this time. If the military decides to protect their accomplices, it will be a war that will bring disaster to the entire outer wall. It will definitely cause rivers of blood. I hope that the military will reconsider!”
“The Sword of a Knight protects the glory of a Knight! The Sword of the Holy See, the luster of the Guardian God, All Evil and darkness will definitely be destroyed. I hope the military will be able to personally execute Bryson and give everyone justice!”
..
..
“Reconsider? Reconsider my ass!”
In the conference room of the military headquarters, everyone was looking at the news that had just been delivered. They were all extremely furious.
“Since they knew that they would bring disaster to the entire outer wall, why didn’t they blame the Holy See for their recklessness? A bunch of bastards!”A general slammed his hand on the table, his face was filled with anger. “They can’t differentiate right from wrong. They are trying to twist the truth. Without any evidence, they are trying to convince us to be good. Shameless! Extremely Shameless!”
“It was a waste of our previous efforts to protect them. Now, they are trying to bite us back. They are supporting the Holy See without even investigating the matter. A bunch of pigs!”Another General was also furious. His beard was trembling from anger.
Saint Lorenzo’s face was gloomy. He said, “Things have happened so quickly. There must be something fishy going on. The Holy See’s hands are deep enough to make the Inquisition, the knight hall, the nobles, and these masters all stand out. How Sinister!”
“What is Roland doing? He hasn’t returned yet? Isn’t it enough for two trips back and forth to the Holy See Now? !”Another one-eyed general roared angrily.
Another person beside him said unhappily, “Don’t count on it. Looking at the Holy See’s stance, this time they will definitely break with our military. It’s useless for Roland to go. He’ll probably be delayed by them.”
“Damn the Holy See. Why didn’t I see that they were so cunning in the past!”
“Humph, in the name of God, they are deceiving the world and stealing the reputation. They are the ones who despise God the most!”
“It’s too late to talk about this now. What should we do? Are We really going to start a war?”
Everyone looked at each other.
At this moment, the sound of an announcement came from outside again.
A captain quickly ran in and handed over the express newspaper in his hand.
The general who was standing at the end of the table took it. A general beside him asked, “What News is it now?”
“You don’t need to look to know. It’s probably someone supporting the Holy See again,”the other general said mockingly.
The general who took the express newspaper quickly glanced at it and his expression immediately changed, he said to Bryson, who had been sitting silently at the conference table, “Commander, the Holy See has seized your castle and found the dark cult members hiding in the properties under your name. They are being punished on the street!”
“What? !”Everyone was stunned.
St. Lorenzo couldn’t help but look at Bryson, who was also shocked, and his heart skipped a beat.
The other generals all looked at Bryson. Apart from shock, there was also a hint of doubt on their faces. Could it be that this was not the Holy See’s slander, but Bryson really colluded with the followers of the dark cult in secret?
At the thought of this, the boiling atmosphere suddenly turned cold.
Bryson came to his senses and clenched his fists angrily. “This is a trap. The despicable church actually used such dirty methods to frame me. They must have secretly collaborated with the Dark Church!”
..
He didn’t want to cook dinner and ordered takeout. However, there were bugs in the milk tea, so he lost 100 yuan to the shop owner. It was too late to update it. Sigh, what bad luck..

chapters.title: Chapter 653
chapters.content:
Chapter 653 – Chapter 652: Fight
“Get out of the way!”
“Get out of the way!”
On the streets of Berlin, hundreds of knights of light had completely surrounded a luxurious manor. At this moment, two knight commanders were escorting a hunchbacked old man dressed in a black robe out of the manor slowly.
This old man was dressed in a dirty black robe that was stained with dark green and other strange-colored potions. His silver-gray hair was disheveled, and he had his head lowered. A withered old arm was exposed under the robe, there was a black tattoo that looked like a poisonous snake. It was extremely eye-catching under the sunlight, and it made people fear it.
Outside the defensive line that was surrounded by a large number of knights, a large crowd of onlookers gathered. When they saw the black-robed old man being escorted out, some people immediately cried out in surprise and couldn’t help but step back.
Black robes. This was a common costume used by the followers of the Dark Cult, although some adventurers also preferred to use it.
The black tattoo was a devil symbol that everyone feared. It was as if the black tattoo itself represented disease, disaster, and death!
“Dark cultists!”
“Kill him! Burn him!”
“Why are we still keeping him? Burn him! !”
A series of ferocious roars came from behind the crowd, but the people standing in the front rarely spoke, as if they were afraid that the dark cultists would be enraged and commit murder. Even though there were many knights of light around them and they were under the Sun.., however, the shadow that the dark believer had accumulated in the hearts of the people all year round did not disappear.
Did the deepest darkness come from the heart?
The black-robed old man lowered his head, as if he did not hear the exclamations and roars around him. He silently walked forward. There was a huge shackle on his ankle, and every step he took, he rubbed his ankle until it hurt, there was already blood oozing out from the shackle, sliding down the instep and landing on the ground. He was barefooted. Every step he took, he could feel the roughness of the earth and the thickness of the ground that was warmed by the sun.
How long had it been since he walked on the ground barefooted like this?
He slowly raised his head and looked ahead. He saw the Knights of light at the defensive line holding hands and forming a circle. Outside the circle, there were countless unfamiliar faces, looking at him with fear and anger.
Walking from one circle to another seemed to be always out of reach!
His gaze continued to move upwards, looking at the white clouds in the sky. When the breeze blew, he felt waves of warmth and a sense of relief.
‘it will be over soon…’he thought silently in his heart. A young and tender face appeared in his mind. That was his grandson and the only family he had left. His death could allow him to live.., this seemed very fair.
Birth seemed to always be accompanied by death.
Death also meant a new life.
He was old. He felt that using his old body to exchange for his grandson’s life was very worth it.
After all, he was still a child. He still had many years to live.
“Behave yourself,”a chief knight reprimanded.
The old man was pushed forward by him. The intense pain caused by the friction of the shackles made him slightly grin. He endured it and did not cry out. After living for so many years, he was already used to the pain.
Behind the old man and the two chief knights, dozens of knights of light were escorting dozens of figures dressed in strange black clothes. These black clothes had strange styles, but the people of the dark church could recognize them at a glance, they were all the clothes worn by the apprentices.
Soon, everyone was escorted to the street and knelt down in a row.
Seeing that these followers of the dark church were so honest, the onlookers outside gradually became more courageous and roared angrily.
“Burn them!”
“Burn these devils!”
A head knight glanced at the crowd outside. Seeing that it was almost time, he immediately called a knight over and prepared to execute them!
“In the name of God, I sentence all of you!”
A Holy Knight walked over. He held a silver greatsword in his hand and held it high in the sky. The light shone on the blade of the sword. It was dazzling and reflected a rainbow-like halo, making it impossible for people to look at it directly. After reciting the sentence, he walked up to the old man and said sternly, “Do you have anything else to say?”
The old man was slightly silent and suddenly shouted, “We pledge our lives to follow Lord Bryson! !”
“Evil creature, damn it!”The Holy Knight roared and suddenly swung his sword.
Puff!
The blade of the sword was exceptionally sharp and instantly cut off the old man’s head.
A huge head fell to the ground and blood splattered onto the body of the person next to him. The kneeling youth next to him was so frightened that his face turned pale. He collapsed to the ground and cried out in fear.
A knight next to him immediately pressed his shoulder down.
“Kill!”
“Kill them all!”
The angry shouts outside became even more ferocious.
The Holy Knights decided in turn. Heads fell to the ground one by one. The bloody scene made some women close their eyes in fear. They covered their eyes and shrank back to the back of the crowd.
Soon, everyone was executed. The Head Knight said in a clear voice, “The followers of the dark cult are secretly conducting evil experiments here. All of them have been killed. If you have any clues about the followers of the Dark Cult, please report it to the Holy See. The Holy See will reward you handsomely!”
“Okay!”
“The Holy See is Glorious!”
A few voices shouted from the crowd.
The rest of the crowd immediately cheered as well. Waves of cheers came from the crowd.
The two head knights looked at each other and called for their subordinates to take away the bodies on the ground and clean up the bloodstains. Then, they left the crowd.
As they left, the crowd gathered on the streets gradually dispersed. They only looked at the luxurious manor behind the pool of blood. Their eyes were filled with respect and fear. Everyone who lived on this street knew that.., the owner of this manor was Commander Bryson’s mansion in the military headquarters. Moreover, many people heard the screams of the old man who had been beheaded before he died.
“I didn’t expect Commander Bryson of the military headquarters to actually collude with the dark cult!”
“And he even covered up for the dark cult to conduct experiments in his residence. Disgusting!”
“Shh, Lower Your Voice. Don’t let others hear you!”
The crowd gradually dispersed and discussed in low voices.
They stopped by a carriage outside a high-end restaurant. A young nobleman casually looked in the direction of the luxurious manor. Beside him stood a delicate girl, he asked curiously, “Young master, I heard from my father that the Holy See is going to arrest the commander of the military region this time. Is this true?”
The young man said indifferently, “Who cares if it’s true or not. What does it have to do with us?”
“If the Holy See and the military region fight, wouldn’t there be a big battle?”
“That has nothing to do with us nobles. Would they dare to fight against us?”
“That’s true…”
“Let’s go and eat your favorite plum blossom juice mixed with foie gras.”
..
..
“Commander Bryson, we believe in your innocence. There’s probably something fishy about this matter.”Saint Lorenza looked at the flustered Bryson and comforted him.
Bryson looked at him, his heart filled with anger. He thought to himself, “This matter might be you colluding with the Holy See to frame me. You want to use the Holy See to get rid of me. Stupid!”!
When the others heard Saint Lorenza’s words, they immediately knew that the military region must protect Commander Bryson this time. They did not dare to show any strange expressions. They could not help but curse in their hearts. The Holy See colluded with the dark cult to frame you.., only you dare to say such words, who would believe it!
“Since the Holy See doesn’t care about the face of our military region, we don’t need to say anything to them. Let’s see the truth with our fists!”Saint Lorenza looked at everyone present, he said, “Commander Bryson would never collude with the dark cult. The Holy See is clearly doing this to insult our military region. We must make the Holy See apologize for this matter. Since they now have the so-called evidence and are forcing us to submit, we can only defeat them and discuss with them again.”
The generals looked at each other. They did not expect that although he was old, his boldness still did not decrease. One had to know that when he was young, he was nicknamed the Golden Lion. From this, one could see how hot-tempered he was!
“I agree with the commander. This battle is unavoidable!”
“The evidence that the Holy See investigated was decided without discussing with US beforehand. Once we concede, we will no longer have the face to face people in the future!”
“We must make the Holy See Apologize!”
“That’s right!”
Everyone agreed.
Bryson was stunned as tears welled up in his eyes. He stood up and held Saint Lorenz’s hands. His heart was filled with guilt and gratitude as he said, “Thank you, thank you for Trusting Me!”
“We are old comrades. There’s no need to be so polite.”Saint Lorenz smiled.
Bryson’s heart stirred when he heard that. Indeed, back then, he and Saint Lorenzo were comrades who had gone through life and death together. Later on, they both established merits and became commanders. After so many years of fighting for power, they had schemed against each other, but he did not expect that when it was a matter of life and death, the most reliable person was this “Enemy”who had fought openly and secretly in the past.
“Richelieu and the great king of Light are waiting outside. Should we capture them first?”A general asked.
Saint Lorenza’s eyes flashed slightly, he said, “We can not attack directly. Otherwise, even if we win, the people will feel that the Holy See was forced to admit their mistakes by us. Not only do we want to fight, we also want to fight on the side of the Innocent!”
The generals were energized and looked at him curiously.
Saint Lorenzo glanced at the crowd and immediately whispered his plan.
After hearing his words, the whole place fell into a short silence. Everyone looked at each other with respect.
“The commander is WISE!”
“This plan is too high!”
“This time, we will definitely make the Holy See break their teeth instead of biting people!”
..

chapters.title: Chapter 654
chapters.content:
Chapter 654 – Chapter 653: Assassination [ First Update ]
[ time goes back to half an hour ago ]
“I’ve already waited for an hour. Is His Holiness still unwilling to see me? !”
In a side hall at the top of Utto Mountain, Roland stared angrily at a deacon of the Holy See in front of him. From the other party’s delaying attitude, she could already see that it was useless for her to come here. The Holy See was not just here to Judge Commander Bryson, they wanted to fight a decisive battle with their military!
“General Roland, please calm down. His Majesty asked me to invite you over,”the middle-aged deacon said with a smile.
Roland was so angry that he choked. She had already planned to leave. At such a critical moment, it was impossible for the Holy See not to know her purpose of coming here at such a high speed, but she had left her here on the pretext of “Handling official business”. It was clearly a deliberate delay!
However, she had waited for so long and now she was leaving.
She clenched her teeth: “Lead the way!”
Soon, she followed the middle-aged deacon to the temple behind St. Mark’s Square. She was stunned as soon as she entered the temple. She saw Barton who was wearing a pope’s robe and holding a scepter sitting on one side of the table. She recognized Dudian who was sitting on the other side of the table!
She had heard about this genius. Especially during the last barbarian invasion the news that the latter donated a legendary item for free spread throughout the outer wall. As a soldier she knew the situation better than anyone else. She knew that the effect of the legendary item was shocking. It was not an exaggeration to say that it was the effect of the legendary item that turned the weakness of the military into victory, banishing the barbarians from the country!
Because of this, many soldiers and generals in the military were grateful to him. This was not just a simple victory or defeat in a battle, but it saved countless soldiers’lives and also saved countless families!
Barton looked up at the female general who came in. He was a little nervous and uneasy, and he forced himself to be calm. “You want to see me?”
Lorraine came back to her senses. Her heart was filled with anger. She resisted the impulse to fly into a rage, “Your Holiness Pope, you found out that Commander Bryson of our military region colluded with the dark church. Is It True? Commander Saint Lorenzo thinks that there is something fishy about this. I hope you can investigate in detail so that our military region will be clean!”
Barton didn’t know how to respond. He turned to look at Dudian.
Roland was staring at the new pope’s face. He was stunned when he saw that Barton turned his head to ask Dudian’s opinion, he subconsciously looked at the Holy Genius who had appeared out of nowhere and disappeared. He found that the latter’s temperament was calm and indifferent. There was no emotion in his expression. He was as unfathomable as the starry sky.
“How can you say that he is innocent?”Dudian glanced at Lorraine.
Lorraine was stunned. She even suspected that there was something wrong with her ears. She opened her eyes: “Mr… Mr Dean? What did you say? !”
“I said that you are black. How Can I bleach you?”Dudian patiently repeated.
Lorraine was sure that she wasn’t hallucinating. She couldn’t help but turn to look at the new pope who was sitting next to her. He was quietly watching but didn’t speak. It seemed that he had given the right to speak to Dudian, she was confused and confused. Although she had always admired the young genius but the latter was just a divine genius. This involved the chaos of the outer wall. What did he know?
However, the attitude of the new pope made her feel incredible!
“Mr. Dudian, I hope you don’t talk nonsense. You should be responsible for your own words!”Although she was confused but she still stared at Dudian. At the same time her good impression of the new pope decreased.
“Of course I will be responsible.”Dudian glanced at her: “Just like I said I will replace your military region. I always keep my word when dealing with the enemy.”
Roland was stunned as he looked at dudian in disbelief: “Are you crazy? What are you talking about? !” He turned to Barton: “Your Highness, Mr. Dean has maliciously insulted our military region. I beg you to punish him immediately!”
Barton slightly spread his hands: “I can’t punish Young Master.”
“Young Master?”Roland was a bit confused.
Dudian shook his head as he saw her slow reaction, “The military region has asked you to come over to mediate in private. It’s really stupid. If you like to hold a bit of illusion when dealing with the enemy then you will be the one who will be harmed.”
Roland looked at him in a daze. Although he did not understand what he meant, he already somewhat understood. However, the truth that he understood was too unbelievable and too terrifying. It made her feel as if she was in a dream, “You, you’re the real pope? How, how could it be? How could richelieu give up his position to you? And even work for you?”
She couldn’t imagine that a genius in the field of divine arts would be able to do this.
“You don’t need to think about it because you are losers. Losers will never know why they have failed.”Dudian put the Teacup on the table as if it was a foregone conclusion, “The three commanders have no way out. They should be planning how to make us suffer and swallow the ‘consequences’of their recklessness. I guess they will create a bigger scandal to cover up the matter of Commander Bryson. Then they will take the opportunity to attack the holy church and gain nominal justice…”
Roland looked at him in a daze.
“Unfortunately, you never know how many spies I have in your military.”Dudian looked down at her, “Moreover, the military sent a general here. It is really a heavy coffin cover.”
Roland was stunned for a moment. She suddenly woke up. She had a strong premonition: “You, what do you want to Do? I’m just here to deliver a message. You Can’t kill me…”
Dudian glanced at her indifferently and turned to Barton: “Are You Ready?”
Barton bowed his head and said, “I am ready, my Lord.”Then he revealed his arm, which was wrapped in white bandages under his robe.
Lorraine froze.
..
..
In a conference room at the military headquarters.
San Lorenzo raised his hand to suppress the generals’praise, saying: “Just do it. Time is of the essence.”
“Yes!”
The generals immediately accepted the order.
“Report!”
Almost at the same time, a report came from outside. A major ran in quickly with an express report in his hand.
Everyone’s eyelids twitched when they saw the express report in his hand. They instinctively felt an ominous feeling. Every express report that came today seemed to be bad news.
“What’s going on?”Saint Lorenz stood up and looked over.
A general at the end quickly took the report and looked over. His expression immediately changed, and he cried out involuntarily, “General Lorraine assassinated the Pope? !”

chapters.title: Chapter 655
chapters.content:
Chapter 655 – Chapter 654: Ghost Dragon [ Second Update ]
Assassinate the Pope?
Everyone was stunned.
“Not good!”Saint Lorenzo suddenly realized something, and his face turned extremely ugly. “Damn the Holy See, their methods are actually so despicable. We made a mistake. We shouldn’t have had any hope and let Lorraine go to them to reconcile.”
Hearing his words, the others gradually came to their senses and immediately knew the insidiousness of this. Obviously, Lorraine would never be stupid enough to assassinate the pope. Instead, she was used by the Pope. As a result.., the already disadvantaged situation of their military region became even more passive.
“Treacherous!”
“He actually used the person sent to deliver the message!”
Everyone was furious.
At this moment, another major ran over from outside and hurriedly said, “Reporting to the commander, Generals, Richelieu and the Great Light King have led the Holy Knight army stationed behind to attack!”
“What? !”Saint Lorenza and Bryson suddenly stood up, their faces full of shock.
The other generals were also stunned. Wasn’t the pace of the matter too fast?
“They are actually preparing to attack? Are they crazy? !”Saint Lorenza was extremely shocked and furious, most of them didn’t understand. “Even if Roland assassinated the pope, it was only a subordinate’s matter. They actually attacked our military region? Aren’t they afraid of being criticized? !”
The major was sweating profusely, he hurriedly said, “Reporting to the commander, their attack was not because of the assassination of the Pope, but because a senior colonel stationed outside the compound falsely passed down your orders and shot arrows at Richelieu and the others who were waiting outside the compound. This angered them.”
“What? !”Saint Lorenza was stunned again.
The other generals were also dumbfounded.
“Damn fool, how, how…”Saint Lorenz was so angry that his body was trembling. If he could barely endure the assassination of the pope, then how could his own men attack Richelieu and the others, he couldn’t bear it anymore if he started the war first. The significance of this matter was far more terrible than the assassination of the pope, especially at this critical moment, which was a disaster!
“What’s the situation outside now?”Bryson hurriedly asked.
The major quickly replied, “The senior colonel who passed the fake military order has already been controlled by Major General Moss. However, Richelieu and the Great Radiant King have already led the Holy Knight Army to attack. Our defense has been broken through. I reckon that they will attack here very soon.”
Hearing this, everyone was stunned. Their minds buzzed and they felt dizzy. The change in the situation was far beyond their expectations. Their minds could not keep up with it.
One had to know that if it was a head-on confrontation, their military region would not be afraid of the Holy See at all. However, the soldiers stationed at the military region headquarters had not entered the state of battle yet, firstly, they did not expect the Holy See to attack them without giving them any warning. Secondly, the soldiers of the military region were scattered in various barracks. These barracks were not in the military region headquarters but in other divisions.
Such a distribution was mainly to facilitate the support of the fire of war.
Although they had already gathered the troops of these divisions, the army needed time to move forward. The Holy See’s attack time was too fast, and the situation instantly went out of control!
“How many troops do we have?”Saint Lorenza woke up and immediately asked the generals. At this point, he knew that there was no point in pursuing the matter of the senior colonel, the Holy See now had sufficient reasons to send troops to attack, and the attack was already in front of them. The only thing they should do now was to defend and defeat the Holy See. As for the rest of the matters, they could only wait until the war was over, they could use other ways to change it.
“Reporting to the commander, the first Legion is on standby. The First Division, Second Division, and Fifth Division of the second Legion are on standby!”A burly general with five stars on his shoulder immediately said.
The other generals had solemn expressions. They knew that this battle had finally begun. Although they were at a disadvantage in name, they had a huge advantage in war. It was not difficult for them to take down the Holy See.
“All the troops are to be mobilized immediately to block the Knights of the Church!”Saint Lorenza immediately said.
Bryson’s expression was gloomy as he said, “Richelieu and the great light king are a little troublesome. I will personally take action. Damn the Holy See. It has been too long since they took action. Do they really think that our military region is a soft persimmon that they can easily crush!”After saying that.., he stood up and left in large strides.
A few generals in charge of the division immediately stood up and followed behind him.
Saint Lorenza did not stop him. After all the generals leading the army left.., he said to the remaining generals and staff officers, “The Holy See came prepared this time. From the current situation, all of this is a conspiracy of the Holy See. The excuse to attack us is too well prepared. It should have been planned for a long time. The attack this time will definitely not be so simple. Although Richelieu is the pope, before he became the Pope, he was the number one person in the Holy See. His strength is unparalleled. Now that he is cooperating with the current great radiant king, the Sea of people tactic may not be effective. Do you have any plans?”
“Commander, in my opinion, one of them will lead a sharp knife team to break out of the encirclement and attack our headquarters. Otherwise, they won’t be able to contend with us by relying on their military strength alone!”A small-eyed old staff officer said in a low voice, “We can set up an ambush in advance and send the poison front team to defend outside our headquarters building. Even if Richelieu can break through the poison front team’s defense, he will still be severely injured. There is nothing to fear.”
“Commander, I think we should let ‘Ghost Dragon’take action and kill Richelieu on the spot before attacking the Holy See.”Another staff officer in his sixties said in a cold voice, “Now that the Holy See has won the hearts of the people and used the name of the dark cultists to attack us, once we lose, we will have nothing. The military region will be like the elemental temple and become a puppet of the Holy See. We can only completely destroy the Holy See. Although the reputation is not very good, the power can suppress all rebellious voices. When the Holy See is no longer around, we can slowly build up our reputation.”
“I agree,”another person said.
Hearing their words, Saint Lorenza frowned and said, “Ghost Dragon is violent. We can’t completely control him. If he takes the opportunity to run away…”
“Commander,”the old staff officer said, “If we let Ghost Dragon Go, we can promise him that as long as he helps us destroy the Holy See, we will grant him freedom!”
Saint Lorenza glanced at him and pondered for a while, then said, “Immediately send someone to find Ghost Dragon and ask if he agrees.”
“Yes.”A general immediately ordered the young captain who was waiting outside the conference hall.
“Commander, should we ask for reinforcements from the inner wall?”Another staff officer looked worried, he said, “It’s too strange for the Holy See to hand over the position of Pope this time and send troops to us. Don’t you think it’s a little strange? If all of this is controlled by the power behind the Holy See in the inner wall, I’m worried that there are experts from the inner wall mixed in with the army of Knights of the church. If that’s really the case, even if we let Ghost Dragon take action, it’s most likely…”
Hearing his words, the faces of the people changed slightly.
Saint Lorenzo was shocked and lowered his head in silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 656
chapters.content:
Chapter 656 – Chapter 646: War
“Your Majesty, the Great Radiant King has already invaded the military region. The military is retreating, but the troops from the other regions are rushing over. The Great Radiant King is worried that they will surround the military region, so he is requesting reinforcements.”
In the temple at the top of Mount Utto, a deacon of the Holy See rushed over and reported to Barton.
Barton sat on the throne, holding a scepter in his hand. After listening to his words, he said, “I understand. Send a message to him. Reinforcements will be arriving soon.”
“Yes!”The deacon quickly replied. Barton asked: “Are the craftsmen here yet?”
The deacon was startled. He didn’t know why the Pope would ask such a small matter at the critical moment: “Your Majesty, the master craftsmen have arrived. They are in the church at the foot of the mountain.”
“Let them come up and get ready to work.”Barton said.
“Yes.”The deacon replied.
After he left Barton immediately got up and walked to the inner hall behind the throne. He saw Dudian sitting in front of the desk quietly drawing something, there was a beautiful woman standing next to him who seemed to never tire. He looked at the woman’s almost perfect body and quickly turned away, dudian respectfully said: “Master, the craftsmen have arrived.”
Dudian nodded: “Wait for them to come. Let them transform according to the drawings I gave you.”
“Yes.”Barton replied. He looked up at dudian: “Master, aren’t you here?”
“I’m going to the Military Region.”Dudian put the pen on the shelf. He looked at Barton: “I’ll leave this place to you.”
Barton was startled: “Master, the military region is in chaos. Is it too dangerous for you to go there? Do you want the remaining Cardinals to protect you?”
“No need.”Dudian got up and went to the clothes rack: “The war will be over by the time I go there.”
Barton continued: “But I heard from the scouts that the other divisions of the military region are rushing there. If the military region is surrounded then even if the lord of Light and Lord Richelieu win the war they will be surrounded…”
“The head was cut off, the body is strong again what?”Dudian didactically looked at him.
Barton came to his senses.
..
..
On the vast plain of the headquarters of the military region, the sound of fighting resounded for hundreds of miles.
The army of Paladins, led by the great king of Light, PLO, swept like a snow-white wave in the direction of the headquarters of the military region. In front of these buildings was a small river, across which a sandbag barricade had been built, the most powerful weapons of war were placed behind the wall. They were aimed at the Holy Knight Army.
Behind the wall there was a neat formation of square soldiers. Each soldier was equipped with a legendary ‘steam gun’which Dudian had given to the military for free, all the soldiers stared at the Holy Knight Army that was sweeping towards them. They saw that the green grass was quickly swallowed by the Holy Knight Army. When they entered the firing range all the cannons were opened and shot out like meteors, they crashed into the Holy Knight Army.
Boom! Boom! Countless holy knights and their horses were blown into pieces.
“Holy Shield Formation!”Pulo took the lead and roared toward the sky.
His voice spread across the tens of thousands of soldiers. The Holy Knight Army at the front immediately raised their golden shields above their heads. The cannonballs crashed down, creating a huge crater. However, the number of Holy Knights who were injured and killed was reduced by more than half.
In the blink of an eye, Pulo had already led his army to charge in front of the fortress. They galloped across the river, creating countless splashes.
The soldiers behind the fortress roared as they faced the attack.
Bang Bang Bang..
The bullets shot out from the steam guns quickly pierced through the warhorses and the paladins on the warhorses. However, some of the paladins that were farther away were still charging straight after being hit by the Bullets.
The range and power of the steam guns could not be compared to the rifles of the old era. However, the armor of the Paladin Army was the best quality battle armor in the outer wall region. It was abnormally hard and only effective when struck at close range.
In the blink of an eye, the two armies clashed and entered a chaotic battle.
“I’ll go and capture the King!”Richelieu roared at PLOP. He called out to the thousands of light cavalry led by a cardinal behind him and charged into the army. They were unstoppable and tore a hole in the army, they charged towards the headquarters building behind the army.
When Pulo saw that he was alone in danger, he was anxious. He roared and waved his axe crazily to kill the soldiers.
Under the cover of Pulo, the light cavalry led by Richelieu broke through the defense of the soldiers. Some generals saw that the situation was not right and led the heavy armored soldiers to stop them. However, in one move.., they were cut in half by Richelieu.
The strength of the generals of the military region were all at the level of high-level hunters, and they had rich combat experience. However, in front of Richelieu, they were no different from ordinary soldiers. Under his lead, over a thousand light cavalry formed a cone shape and pierced into the heavy armored army. In an instant, they tore them in half and rushed straight to the front of the Military Region Headquarters’building complex.
“Kill! !”Richelieu’s face was covered in blood, the battle that he had not seen for a long time had made his blood boil. The sounds of battle beside his ears were like war drums, making his fighting spirit high. He took the lead and rode his warhorse up the stairs of a building, swiftly killing the soldiers that were blocking his way, a rider took the lead and charged in.
“Die! !”A general in armor rushed out from the building’s courtyard. His eyes were red as he roared and charged at Richelieu with his spear.
Richelieu leaped up from his warhorse and landed directly on the spear of the general in armor. When he landed, he grabbed the spear with his palm and used the momentum to pounce forward. He kicked the general in the chest, with a bang, the general spat out a mouthful of blood. His eyes were wide open and his face was filled with disbelief. His body was sent flying and he crashed into the wall behind him, knocking the wall down.
Richelieu did not stop. He rushed towards the conference hall of the military headquarters.
Along the way, there were soldiers who came to stop him. Most of them were the trump card division of the military region, the purple feather army. Every purple feather army helmet had a purple feather on it, which was extremely eye-catching. However, in front of Richelieu, they did not have the ability to fight back, all of them were killed in one blow.
Cardinal Ernorin, who was following behind Richelieu, was already stunned. Although he knew that his master’s strength was unfathomable, he did not expect that he was so strong that he could ride freely in the military region without being injured at all!
With a bang, one of the purple feather army was kicked away by Richelieu and crashed into the door of the conference hall of the Military Region headquarters, knocking the door open.
In the conference hall, Saint Lorenzo, the remaining generals, and the chief of staff were all shocked. They did not expect the enemy to attack here so quickly. One of the Chief of staff hurriedly asked, “What happened outside?”
“Sir, sir, the enemy has attacked!”A captain hurriedly ran over to report.
Saint Lorenzo’s face was full of shock. He hurriedly asked, “Who is it, Pulo?”
“It’s the old Pope!”The captain said in a panic, “He’s too strong. No one can stop him. General Kurt was killed as soon as he went up!”
Saint Lorenza was stunned.
The rest of the chiefs of staff widened their eyes and looked shocked.
“Commander!”One of the Chiefs of staff came back to his senses and looked at Saint Lorenza.
Saint Lorenza knew what he meant and immediately said, “Quick, let the Ghost Dragon do it!”
“I’ll go too!”A general said and quickly ran out of the hall.
Richelieu led ERNORIN and the remaining hundreds of light cavalry to break into the door of the conference room of the military headquarters, killing the soldiers who were blocking their way. Richelieu already saw a few red figures in the conference room in front of him, one of them had the strongest heat source figure, like a fireball. He knew that it was the old man from Saint Lorenz.
Just as he was about to step forward, a dangerous aura suddenly came from the corridor beside him. He turned his head and saw a black figure with disheveled hair and tattered clothes rushing over at high speed.
He was shocked and hurriedly jumped up to meet it, in case his warhorse was injured.
Bang!
He kicked out and immediately felt as if he had kicked an iron plate. He looked down and saw the beggar-like tattered figure holding his ankle with a backhand.
With a whoosh, the beggar’s figure swung his arm and fell down. Li Ceriu’s body smashed heavily on the floor of the corridor like a hammer, breaking through the floor and covering his body with wood chips. Before the beggar’s figure could swing his body again, Li Ceriu’s other leg suddenly kicked out and landed on his chest. The Beggar’s figure immediately let out a muffled groan and let go of his hand, taking a few steps back.
Richelieu took the opportunity to widen the distance between them and looked over.
The beggar’s figure rubbed his chest, grimacing in pain. His face, which was covered by his messy hair, revealed a few traces of shock.
“High-level limiters, the military region really hides deep…”Richelieu narrowed his eyes slightly and slowly pulled out the sharp sword on his back. He took a deep breath, and the blood in his body slightly squirmed, the power of the magic marks at the end of his spine was immediately activated. His flaxen hair immediately regained its luster and turned bright golden. The wrinkles on his face also quickly disappeared and he returned to his prime appearance of around thirty years old, his facial features were clear and he looked incomparably handsome. Moreover, there was not a single wrinkle on his skin.
Whoosh!
He exerted force with his feet and suddenly rushed out.
The beggar’s figure saw the changes in Richelieu, and a solemn expression appeared on his face. With a low growl, all the bones in his body moved violently, and his body twisted slightly in a strange posture. The next moment, on his forehead, on his elbows.., and the end of his spine, sharp white bone spikes slowly grew out. He lay on the ground like a lizard, swaying his body. At the same time that Richelieu pounced on him, he also rushed forward.
Whoosh!
He waved his sharp claws and tore at Richelieu’s chest.
The sword light in Richelieu’s hand flashed and blocked his palm. However, the moment he blocked it, he saw a white spike coming from the side.
He hurriedly slammed his palm on the ground and rolled over to dodge the white spike. Then, he stabbed with his sword.
The Beggar’s reaction was quick. He dodged quickly and jumped up to the dome of the cloister. His fingers were firmly stuck into the wood chips and he dived down.
Richelieu’s face was gloomy. He waved his sword to parry.
While the two were fighting, Ernorin led his light cavalry into the meeting hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 657
chapters.content:
Chapter 657 – Chapter 647: End
Looking at Ernorin and the paladins behind him, the chiefs of staff on both sides of the conference table suddenly became restless. They nervously retreated to the side of Saint Lorenz.
Saint Lorenz’s face was gloomy. He walked out of the crowd and pulled out his greatsword from the weapon rack beside him.
Ernorin looked down at Saint Lorenz and said, “Commander, prepare to surrender…”
Just as he said this, Saint Lorenz suddenly rushed toward him with a sword in his hand. His speed was as fast as a white dove, and the sword hummed in the air.
Ernorin’s expression changed. He hurriedly retreated and called the Holy Knights on his left and right to stop him.
With a few bangs, Saint Lorenz raised his hand and slapped out. The Holy Knights who were rushing toward him flew backward at an even faster speed and crashed into the Holy Knights behind him. They immediately fell to the ground.
Seeing that the situation was not good, Ernorlin hurriedly turned around and fled.
Bang Bang Bang!
Seven or eight paladins were thrown out of the hall and smashed into the indoor bonsai outside the hall.
Saint Lorenza stood at the entrance of the hall with a sword in one hand and looked coldly at the numerous paladins outside. His silver hair fluttered in the wind and his aura completely covered the hundreds of light paladins.
Ernorlin looked at him in shock and anger. He did not expect that the already old Saint Lorenza would still have such a strong strength.
Bang! Bang!
In the cloister beside them, Richelieu and the beggar fought fiercely, tearing the cloister into pieces.
Richelieu heard the commotion beside him and looked out of the corner of his eyes. He immediately saw Saint Lorencia standing proudly at the entrance of the hall with a greatsword in hand. A large number of Holy Knights had fallen in front of him. At the same time, outside the building behind them.., faint sounds of fighting could be heard. It was as if the army outside had come back to surround them.
“We can’t drag this on any longer.”His gaze was slightly cold. He raised his hand to block the beggar’s pounce and leaped backward. He knew that the battle between the army led by Pulo and the Army of the military region would be difficult to determine the victor in a short while, however, the army of the military region could take the opportunity to send a portion of their troops to reinforce this place. The longer they dragged this on, the more disadvantageous it would be for him. It might even lead to the failure of the mission.
He took a deep breath and suddenly exerted his strength, shooting toward the beggar’s figure like an arrow.
The beggar’s figure was shocked. He growled as bone spikes protruded from his arm, and he grabbed at Li Ceriu.
With a clang, the sword light in Li Ceriu’s hand flashed, and he pushed away the beggar’s arm. His body suddenly shook, and three Li Ceriu appeared in an instant, stabbing at him from three different directions.
The Beggar’s face was filled with shock as he hurriedly retreated out of the range of the sword light.
Richelieu took advantage of his victory to pursue. The sword light was like the wind and every move was fatal, forcing the beggar’s figure to retreat step by step.
“Die!”Richelieu shouted in a low voice. The veins on his arm bulged and the long sword suddenly slashed down.
The beggar’s figure raised his hand to block as before. However, the moment he touched the long sword, he felt that something was wrong. By the time he wanted to withdraw his hand, it was already too late. With a Kacha Sound, the sword light cut open the bone spur on his arm and followed the momentum, the sharp tip of the sword stabbed straight at his chest, leaving a huge bloody scar and fresh blood spurted out.
Richelieu raised his foot and kicked his stomach, chasing after him again.
At the entrance of the hall, Saint Lorenz was dealing with the Holy Knights who were pouncing on him while paying attention to the battle on the side. However, when he saw that Richelieu was actually suppressing the ghost dragon, he could not help but be shocked. One must know that.., this ghost dragon was a high-level limiter in the inner wall. Even in the inner wall, which was filled with experts, he was considered the number one expert. How could he lose to Richelieu at this moment?
Ernorin also saw the change in the situation. He immediately ordered the paladins to stop Saint Lorenz in case he rushed over to help.
Not long after, a miserable cry sounded. Richelieu rushed out from the broken corridor with a long sword covered in blood. He charged straight towards Saint Lorenz.
Saint Lorencia was shocked. He glanced at the ruins where Richelieu was rushing towards, but there was no movement inside. His heart sank immediately. He swung his sword to cut a paladin and shouted at Richelieu, “Are you really going to do this? !”
Richelieu’s sharp sword came straight at him in response.
Saint Lorencia’s face was full of anger. He returned the sword to block. Just as the sword touched Richelieu’s sword, he felt a huge force coming from it. It shook his thumb and thumb, and he almost let go of the sword.
Richelieu landed on the ground and turned his body. Like a ghost, he circled around Saint Lorenza’s back. He used his arm to lock Saint Lorenza’s throat and controlled his upper body. At the same time, his knee pressed against the spine on his back, with just a little force, his body could be broken.
“You lost. Stop,”Richelieu said in a low voice.
Saint Lorenza gritted his teeth and wanted to swing his sword to cut back. However, the arm holding the huge sword was numb. The huge sword, which was originally as light as nothing, was now incomparably heavy. He knew that the situation was over, and he was filled with grief and indignation, he said, “Aren’t you afraid of stirring up Chaos? If you want to rule our military region, have you asked the military of the inner wall region? Will they agree to it? !”
Richelieu was indifferent and said, “Pass down the order immediately. Tell your men to stop fighting and surrender. If you lose, don’t create more killings and sacrifices.”
Saint Lorenz was so angry that he laughed, “Killings? Sacrifices? Haven’t you created enough of these? Do you really think that you can control the thousands of iron-blooded soldiers of our military by controlling me? They will not surrender. They will never lower their heads like you! !”
Richelieu said coldly, “Then don’t blame me.”After saying that, he grabbed his shoulder and twisted it violently. With a crack, his arm was broken. Then, he dragged his body and turned to walk into the hall.
Ernorin led the other paladins and quickly entered the hall. They occupied all parts of the hall and killed all the servants who tried to resist, leaving only the chief of staff and a few honorary generals behind the conference table.
“Take off his clothes.”Richelieu suddenly pointed at an honorary general.
Ernorin immediately sent people to take him down and take off his coat.
“Get Someone to change into it. Immediately pass the order to stop the war and surrender!”Richelieu said coldly.
Ernorin came to his senses and could not help but look at Richelieu. He did not expect that he, who had always been kind, would actually think of such a strange method.
Saint Lorenz and the other chief of staff were shocked and angry when they heard this. Saint Lorenz said angrily, “Old Pope, you are too despicable!”
“You forced me to do this.”Richelieu looked at him coldly.
Soon, a Holy Knight put on the armor of an honorary general and ran out of the building. Not long after, the sounds of fighting outside gradually weakened.
Saint Lorenz heard the change and closed his eyes in pain. Although he could not see the battle outside, his hearing was very sensitive. As the sounds of fighting weakened, he also heard waves of cheers that became stronger and stronger, the content of the cheers was “Long live the Pope”. Obviously the Knights of the church had won.
The other chiefs of Staff had ugly expressions on their faces. They were angry as if they had eaten a coal ball. They knew that the hearts of the generals and soldiers who had stopped fighting outside were probably even more broken than them.
A carriage with the flag of the Cardinal of the Holy See was running at full speed on the street. The pedestrians on the street saw the flag on the carriage and were scared away. They didn’t dare to stop it. A moment later, the carriage came to the military headquarters. The wheels stopped. Dudian opened the door and got off. He looked up at the high wall of the courtyard. The coldness in his eyes faded.
“Young master, it seems very quiet inside.”Sergei who was the coachman jumped down and looked at dudian.
“Quiet is good news.”Dudian held Aisha’s hand and walked in big steps.
After entering the compound’s wall, there was a vast grassland plain. In front of the plain, there were a few rampart-like buildings scattered around. There were sentry towers, Arrow Towers, training grounds and camps.
After walking for a while, Dudian saw a large number of corpses and blood that dyed the plain red.
Sergei followed behind Dudian and nervously looked around. Although he was accompanied by Dudian, he was still a bit nervous. After all, this was the headquarters of the military region. He was imprisoned in the Thorn Flower Prison, he was arrested by the military. He had the same natural fear of the military as the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 658
chapters.content:
Chapter 658 – Chapter 648: Take The Head Of The Enemy General (Top)[ First Watch ]
It didn’t take long for Dudian to see a team of Holy Knights standing by the river in front of the plain. The sunlight shone on the silver armor which reflected the dazzling light.
He saw a red-robed figure riding in front of the Holy Knights. It was Cardinal Ernorin who was next to Richelieu.
“Sir.”Ernorin trotted to Dudian. He jumped off the horse and bowed respectfully. He was one of the few people in the holy church who knew the real inside story, he didn’t dare to treat Dudian as a genius.
“Let’s go.”Dudian didn’t ask anything but directly said.
“Yes.”Ernorin was surprised. It seemed that Dudian was familiar with the situation inside.
Two knights were holding the throats of two knights in the conference hall. They were sitting on chairs. The other commander Bryson wasn’t treated so well. He was personally looked after by Pulo. His hair was messy and there were many wounds on his body. His armor was broken. He was captured by Pulo when the army stopped fighting, this was the first time that he had fought with the first person in the outer wall. The strength of the latter was beyond his imagination. He didn’t even have the chance to escape from the enemy.
“Even if you capture us, it’s useless.”Saint Lorenza gritted his teeth and glared at Richelieu, “Commander Hidavin will soon lead troops to surround this place. The forces in her hands are ten times more than yours. Together with the steam guns, it’s enough to wipe out this place. None of you can escape!”
Richelieu sat on a general chair and said indifferently, “With you here, does he dare to attack?”
“Heh!”Saint Lorenza sneered, “Don’t think that you can force them to retreat just because you’re holding us hostage. In the current situation, it’s best if she exterminates you and US together. At that time, both the military region and the Holy See will regard her as their king. With such a big temptation, do you think she will be merciful? Just wait to be buried with us!”
Richelieu frowned slightly and exchanged a glance with plop.
Plop thought for a while and said, “Sir, why don’t we retreat first and capture them at Mt. Utto. With the terrain there, we can definitely defend against them.”
Richelieu’s eyes flashed and he hesitated.
“What’s troubling you so much?”Suddenly, a clear voice came from outside.
Everyone was startled as they looked outside.
They saw Cardinal Ernorin slowly enter the hall with three figures. The generals and staff officers of the military were stunned when they saw the face of the youth behind ERNORIN.
Richelieu was surprised to see Dudian in person. He was relieved as he got up to greet him: “Young Master, you are here.”
The hall was silent.
Saint Lorenzo was stunned as he looked at Richelieu. He suspected that he was hearing things. Young Master? Did he use honorifics?
Bryson and the other generals who were defeated looked at the scene in disbelief. They couldn’t wrap their heads around it. How could the head of the holy church be in awe of this genius?
Pulo who was holding Bryson was also shocked. He looked at Richelieu in confusion.
Dudian patted Richelieu’s shoulder: “You have worked hard. Are You Hurt?”
Richelieu was startled. He quickly replied: “No, it’s just a small scratch.”He put away the cut on the back of his hand.
Dudian’s eyes were sharp. He looked at Ernorlin: “The old Pope is injured. Why didn’t you bandage him?”
Ernorlin was startled: “I will call the priest.”He turned and ran out.
Dudian took Richelieu’s hand and went into the hall. He passed by Bryson and the other generals who were kneeling on the ground. It was as if they didn’t see him, dudian sat down on the general’s chair and turned to the other chair: “Old Commander, long time no see. How are you?”
Dudian waved his hand as he spoke.
The two knights who were holding onto the chair looked at Dudian in confusion. They couldn’t help but look at Richelieu.
Richelieu nodded to the two. One of them carefully reminded dudian: “Master, be careful.”
Saint Lorenzo looked at Dudian in a daze. From Richelieu’s performance and Dudian’s attitude, he couldn’t see the youth as a simple master, moreover, this was a historic moment for the survival of the Holy Church and the military. How could a holy master waste time here.
Dudian pulled a chair from the side and sat next to Saint Lorenzo. He saw that Ernorin had rushed over with two priests. As soon as the priests arrived, they immediately checked Richelieu’s wound to prevent infection.
Saint Lorenzo looked at Dudian who was sitting next to him, he said: “Mr. Dean, we have a good relationship before. Can you talk to the old Pope and ask him to retreat? Otherwise, we will die here when Commander Hidaven attacks!”
Dudian looked at him in surprise. He shook his head: “Old Commander, you are really confused. Why would I help you? It was my idea to take down your military region.”
Saint Lorenzo was stunned.
“You have treated me well when it comes to friendship.”Dudian slowly said: “You immediately blocked my news when I was arrested by the inner wall. If I had come out later then the people would have forgotten about my existence. I gave you a legendary item for free. I didn’t expect the friendship price of a legendary item to be so low. Not only did I not get the help of your military region but I was trampled by you.”
Saint Lorenzo’s face turned ugly: “There is a misunderstanding. Let me explain…”
“It’s in the past. There is no need to explain.”Dudian waved his hand: “The war will be over when Commander Hidaven comes. I can go back to work.”
Bryson angrily said: “Do you really want to die together with us? Commander Hidaven won’t Let You Go!”
Dudian glanced at him: “Those who are kneeling don’t deserve to talk to me.”
Bryson’s body trembled in anger.
Saint Lorenzo suppressed his anger: “Mr Dean, why do we have to fight to the death? You are also a member of the Holy See. Don’t you have any compassion?”
“We have used up all of them.”Dudian said: “If you have any left then take the initiative to surrender. At the same time persuade Hidaven to surrender. From now on the military region will be loyal to the Holy See and me.”
Saint Lorensa was stunned. He looked at Richelieu and looked at dudian: “Loyal to you?”
Bryson and the other staff officers were shocked. They thought that Dudian had instigated the pope to attack them. If that was the case.., dudian’s words were too presumptuous!
“Is it because he is too stupid or because he has underestimated me?”Dudian indifferently said: “Is there a problem if he is loyal to me?”
Saint Lorensa reacted. He noticed that Richelieu’s expression was as if it was a matter of course. He suddenly thought of his previous address and honorifics to Dudian, he suddenly thought of an incredible conclusion — Dudian was the real power behind the Holy See!
He immediately thought that Dudian had been arrested in the inner wall and now he had come back from the inner wall. It was very likely that he had received something from the inner wall or was appreciated by a certain force, it was a leap!
Although the possibility was low but it was not impossible.
“What is your relationship with the Pope?”He looked at dudian.
Dudian ignored the boring question.
“Report!”A paladin rushed in: “Lord of Light, Commander Hidaven has led the Army to surround the military area. He is assembling siege weapons and preparing to attack!”

chapters.title: Chapter 659
chapters.content:
Chapter 659 – Chapter 649: Take The Head Of The Enemy General (Second Update)
“So Fast?”Pullo was surprised.
Bryson and the other generals and chief of staff were happy to hear this. They were finally saved.
Although St. Lorenzo had said that Hidavin would kill them along with Richelieu and the others. But they knew that St. Lorenzo was trying to intimidate the Holy See. If Hidavin really did that.., there was only one consequence.
“I will stop the enemy!”Pulo looked at Dudian and asked Richelieu for instructions.
Richelieu didn’t respond. He looked at Dudian and waited for his decision.
“Finally.”Dudian’s eyes lit up: “Old Pope, I’ll leave this place to you. I’ll be back soon.”
Richelieu was startled: “I’ll go with you.”
“No need.”
Richelieu hurriedly said as dudian walked out of the hall: “Wait. Pulu, give the token to Mr. Dean.”
Pulu was stunned: “You want to give the Holy Knights to him?”
Dudian interrupted before Richelieu could speak: “No need. There is no need to go through so much trouble. There are enough casualties.”He led Aisha out of the hall with Sergei following behind.
Sergei looked back at Richelieu and the other generals: “Master, where are We Going?”
“The enemy is coming. Of course we are going to kill them.”Dudian replied without looking back.
Sergei was stunned: “Kill the enemy? Just… Just the three of us?”
“Of course not.”Sergei was relieved but the next sentence scared him: “I will do it alone.”
Dudian had come to the plains outside. He stood on the high slope and quietly looked forward. He saw that there were holy knights and surrendered troops stationed in the defense line, there was a black line at the end of the plains.
Sergei looked forward and saw that the black line was gradually becoming clear. There were countless black heads. He swallowed his saliva and felt his heart beating fast, although he had the strength of a senior hunter but he felt unbearable pressure as he faced the Sea of soldiers.
“Young master, you must be joking.”Sergei felt as if something was stuck in his throat. His muscles tensed up: “We should let the Holy Knights out.”
“Cold weapons war is good. One person can change the situation.”Dudian ignored Sergei’s words, he whispered to Aisha: “Wait for me here. I will be back soon.”
Aisha was expressionless as she looked at the front. It seemed that there was nothing to be afraid of. She didn’t care about the danger of Dudian’s attack.
Dudian turned to Sergei: “Take care of her here. Don’t let anyone near her.”
Sergei quickly tried to stop him: “Master, we have so many people. Why do you have to fight alone? It’s dangerous!”
“Because of efficiency.”Dudian said.
Sergei was stunned.
Dudian took off the black coat and handed it to Sergei. He pulled out the dark steel sword from his waist. He jumped down the high slope and rushed towards the black army outside the defense line.
Sergei was stunned as he heard the sound of armor friction coming from behind. He turned his head and saw that Richelieu and Pulo were holding the military generals of Saint Lorenzo and Bryson.
“Where is he?”Richelieu couldn’t help but ask Sergei as he didn’t see Dudian.
Sergei wryly smiled: “The Young Master is going to fight.”
“Fight?”Richelieu was stunned.
Pulo couldn’t help but say: “He is a master of Holy Light So why is he fighting? Are you tired of living? How could you not stop him? How many people did he lead? How did he mobilize the Holy Knights without my permission?”
Sergei looked at him. He knew that he was the great king of light so he was too lazy to respond to him.
Pulo didn’t expect this little servant to dare to give him a look. He was so angry that he glared at him. Just as he was about to scold him, he was stopped by Richelieu. Richelieu stood in front of the high slope and looked at the Paladin Army and the surrendered army that were divided into two camps. He found that these two armies didn’t move at all and didn’t show any signs of disorder. He couldn’t help but be stunned. In the next moment, he suddenly saw a black figure rushing out from the defensive line. It jumped out of the defensive line and rushed toward the black tide on the other side of the plain.
“What? !”Richelieu was so shocked that his tongue almost trembled. He said in horror, “He… He’s alone?”
Hearing that, Pullo who was beside him was stunned. He looked up and soon saw an extremely tiny black figure dashing forward on the plain. He could not help but be stunned.
Saint Lorenzo, Bryson, and the others who were imprisoned behind were stunned. They could not help but struggle to stand up and look forward. One of the chief of staff ignored them, he sneered: “He is going to fight alone. Isn’t it called suicide? Does he think he is a god? How can he defeat the Army brought by general? It’s ridiculous…”
The burly general next to him exclaimed: “He… he is going to fight alone? !”
The old chief of staff was stunned.
“Isn’t there a Holy Knight? Why did he go alone?”Richelieu couldn’t help but ask Sergei. In his impression Dudian had always been cautious and liked to drive others in the dark, however at the moment the situation was such that some brave generals didn’t dare to go out and fight alone.
Sergei’s face was bitter: “Young Master said that it would be efficient.”
“Efficient?”Richelieu was stunned.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Dudian quickly approached the enemy’s army. The deafening roar shook his eardrums. His heart rate increased uncontrollably as if it was stimulated. He clenched his sword as his pupils changed, the black tide in front of him turned into a red disaster. The heat of countless figures stuck together. There were seven or eight figures that were emitting heat like fireballs, it was far more than the other heat. It should be the general of the army.
Dudian’s eyes turned and soon found three heat sources that were more vigorous than fireballs. Two of them were standing together and the other one was on the left side of the army. He thought for a moment, his eyes locked onto the two hot figures standing together.
It would be impossible to determine the specific location of the other heat sources in the crowd. But Dudian’s vision wasn’t thermal vision but thermal vision!
Through layers of penetration, it was easy to lock the position of each heat source in the crowd.
Charles noticed a person rushing out of the defensive line. He raised his hand and ordered the army to slow down. Soon, he saw the appearance of this person. He was wearing a strange black armor. It was not military armor, it was not the silver gray armor of the Knights of the church. He couldn’t help but frown and shouted: “Who is it? !”
Dudian’s eyes narrowed as he looked at the army that was gradually coming to a stop. He didn’t pay attention to the shouts of the other side. He used the dragon’s blood to control the boiling blood in his body. The power of the magic marks surged out from his chest, his body was covered with Snow White Bones. He clenched his sword and rushed towards the shouting general.
Charles looked at Dudian’s terrifying speed and shouted: “Prepare to face the enemy! Heavy armor soldiers form a formation! Archers shoot arrows!”
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The Archers immediately released the arrows that they had prepared. Rain of arrows fell from the sky and fell on the plain in front of Dudian.
Dudian didn’t Dodge. He waved the sword in his hand and cut the arrows that fell from the sky. Under his 270 degree vision, all the arrows were blocked.
Whoosh!
After he left the group of arrows, he jumped over the heavy shield raised by the heavy armored soldiers. The height of the jump was so high that the knight’s spear couldn’t reach it.
Charles’s face was full of horror. Even other generals couldn’t achieve such a skill. He pulled out his sword and waved it in front of him. He roared: “Cornered Beast Army! Kill!”
Thousands of cavalrymen rushed out from the army behind him. The sound of horse hooves echoed as they surrounded Dudian. They tightened the encirclement and rushed towards the center.
Dudian’s eyes were cold. His body didn’t stop at all. He rushed forward and suddenly attacked.
His palm grabbed the front leg of a Knight’s Warhorse. He used his other hand to swing his sword to block the spear. The warhorse let out a long neigh and let out a sad cry. It was pulled by Dudian and began to dance.
The knight’s legs were bound by the rope so he didn’t fall down. However it was difficult to attack when the horse was dancing.
“Get lost!”Dudian swung the horse several times and suddenly smashed towards the encirclement.
The horse rushed like a black cannonball and instantly broke through the four or five cavalrymen. The knight on the horse spat out blood and died on the spot.
Dudian stepped on the corpse of the horse and rushed forward. He turned the sword in his hand and cut off the heads of the two cavalrymen who were coming from the side. His body didn’t stop at all, he rushed towards the general who had commanded the army.
“Damn it! Stop Him!”Charles looked at the Beast Army which was easily torn apart by Dudian. He was scared. He could feel that the youth’s killing intent was coming for him.
Whoosh!
Dudian stepped on the head of the Iron Knight and rushed forward.
In the blink of an eye, he arrived in front of the general who was riding on the horse.
“Die!”Charles was extremely angry. He clenched his teeth and rushed forward.
Dudian’s eyes were indifferent. His body suddenly sped up. He shook his wrist. Blood splashed out and splashed onto Dudian’s cheek. At the same time, a head flew up.
..
..
I was going to the third watch today, was consumed by trifles a lot of energy, put the second more a little longer, tomorrow to strive for the third watch

chapters.title: Chapter 660
chapters.content:
Chapter 660 – : Chapter 650: Unstoppable [ First Watch ]
