“General Charles! !”The two trusted servants of Charles saw the unbelievable scene. They angrily roared and rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to them. He stepped on the shoulder of a knight and used the momentum to rush towards the army behind him.
“Kill!”
“Kill!”
“Stop him! !”
The three generals saw Dudian who had beheaded Charles. They were shocked and angry. They didn’t expect that there would be such a brave person in the enemy’s army. They didn’t expect that this person would look down on them, it was unforgivable that he dared to enter the army alone!
Under the orders of the three generals, the army quickly scattered. The archers and musketeers retreated to the sides while the light cavalry and heavy armor soldiers came from the side to attack Dudian.
In the current situation of close combat, the archers and musketeers were useless. They would only hurt their own people. Dudian’s single charge into the army made the newly established strongest division “Musketeers Regiment”completely useless.
Whoosh!
Dudian’s feet didn’t touch the ground as he flew through the crowd of soldiers. He stepped on the shoulders of the knights who were rushing towards him. He was like a dragonfly skimming the water or a butterfly. His movement was light and agile.
The Knights raised their spears and stabbed at Dudian. The destructive power of the Spears was increased to the maximum. However Dudian’s speed was too fast. He stepped on the heads of the horses or the spears, it seemed that he could borrow the power of any material object. In the blink of an eye he was hundreds of meters away. He didn’t stop and didn’t suffer any harm!
The three generals, the other colonels, the captain and the other officers were shocked as they saw the scene. What kind of momentum and strength was this? He was able to come and go freely without any injury!
Dudian’s eyes were fixed on the front. It was a kind of look that looked down on the world and was tired of all things. Anyone who saw it would be frightened and respectful. He held a three feet long dark steel sword, he stepped on the body of the soldiers who were blocking his way. The head of the horse quickly rushed forward. All the spears, sharp blades and swords were unable to hurt the snow-white bones outside his body.
This skeleton-like ugly and hideous appearance wrapped around his body tightly, protecting it tightly!
Deep in the center of the Army, Hildwin was wearing an exquisite bronze battle dress that accentuated her slender and plump figure. Paired with her snow-white skin that did not look like a soldier’s, she appeared extremely dazzling and beautiful, she was not only the only woman among the three commanders, but also the goddess in the hearts of all the soldiers in the military region. At this moment, she was looking forward with her deep brown eyes, which were like Eagle Eyes, observing the chaos that was suddenly stirred up on the front line. She also saw the figure that was as black as ink charging into the army with a sword. She frowned slightly, suddenly, she felt that this person’s face was somewhat familiar.
“It’s him?”Xidavan finally recalled and could not help but reveal a trace of surprise on his face. “Isn’t this person a person who practices divine arts? How can he have such powerful strength?”
“Commander, you recognize this person?”A five-star general beside him said in surprise. His vision couldn’t see the details of the chaotic area ahead, only the general situation.
“You also know this person. He’s the young master who gave us the military’s legendary divine priest for free before.”Hiddavin stared at the chaotic area, and his brows furrowed more and more tightly.
“Are you talking about the master named Dean?”The five-star general was stunned. From the chaos in front of him, the strength of the newcomer was not lower than his. But such an existence was actually the young master who practiced the legendary items?
Hidaven was focused on the battlefield. He wasn’t in the mood to talk to him. He saw Dudian’s speed was extremely fast. The light cavalry and heavy armor guards were unable to stop him, she knew that even she might not be able to do better. Moreover she could clearly see that the man was coming for her. Obviously, his aim was to kill her!
In the midst of thousands of soldiers and horses, he came alone to kill her. She was shocked and shocked. Was this the thinking of a normal person? ! What gave him so much courage? !
“Why haven’t we taken him down yet? Didn’t you say that he came alone? !”The five-star general said to a colonel knight beside the chariot, “Give me the Spyglass.”
The Colonel Knight immediately took out the spyglass and handed it to him with both hands.
The five-star general raised it in front of his eyes and looked. The blurry front suddenly became clear. He saw a young man in black armor holding a bronze dark steel longsword stepping on the shoulder of the knight. As if he was walking on flat ground, he rushed over at high speed, countless soldiers stabbed their spears or brandished their swords in an attempt to block the attack, but they were easily dodged. The swords that occasionally hit the soles of his feet were blocked by his metal boots and did not cause any damage.
“How is this possible? !”The five-star general was stunned, he originally thought that the intruder had already been surrounded by the army and was deep in a quagmire, struggling in pain. However, things were completely different from what he had thought. Not only was the latter not surrounded by the army, but he treated the army as grass and trampled on it at will, he treated it as a stepping stone!
He put down the telescope and scolded the colonel, “What are they doing? The enemy broke the formation by themselves. If the Paladin Army charged at them from behind, how can they fight? !”
The Colonel felt bitter in his mouth. He thought to himself, “I know this too, but the people in front can’t take down the enemy. What can I Do?”? “Blame me?”?
He naturally didn’t dare to take the blame. He could only say: “I will immediately send out the purple feather army to encircle the enemy!”
“Hurry Up!”The five-star general shouted in anger.
The Colonel quickly accepted the order and rode out.
Whoosh!
Dudian flew all the way. Suddenly he saw that the army in front of the war chariots with the commander’s flag was divided into two sides. There were purple armored knights riding out of the chariots. There were floating purple feathers on their helmets, it was the famous purple feather army of the military. They were the trump card of the military which had made the barbarians suffer a lot.
Dudian narrowed his eyes but didn’t stop. He continued to rush forward.
He could tell that the heat in the body of the Purple Feather army was five times more than that of ordinary soldiers. It was almost the same as that of a primary hunter!
Although the primary hunters were very weak in his current strength, but the army of thousands of primary hunters was no less than a flood beast, the total number of primary hunters in the six consortia might not exceed two thousand. This was the absolute power of the military to suppress all parties!
Crash!
Dudian heard the sound of the chains as he approached the purple feather army. He saw the vanguard suddenly raise a large black net and jump towards his net.
Dudian quickly waved his sword.
Whoosh ~ ~
The dark steel sword pierced the black net. Sparks flew but it didn’t break the Black Net!
“Is it made of Alloy?”Dudian’s eyes flashed with cold lightning. He immediately abandoned the sword. He grabbed onto a bowl-sized hole in the black net, “Break! ! !”
Hiss!
The flexible and tough black net was torn apart like cloth. It made an ear-piercing sound!
Dudian was like a beast that had escaped. He stepped out and the ground slightly trembled. He used the momentum to rush out like an arrow and directly hit the Purple Feather Army.
The purple feather army’s reaction was very fast. They saw that Dudian had broken through the net lock. Dozens of shields formed a giant shield and blocked in front of Dudian.
Bang!
Dudian hit like a meteor. The next moment he broke the giant shield without any suspense. Dozens of purple feather soldiers behind the giant shield fell to the ground. Some of them were sent flying more than ten meters away.

chapters.title: Chapter 661
chapters.content:
Chapter 661 – Chapter 651: One Punch [ Second Watch ]
Dudian rolled out of the mess. He raised his head and saw a shield coming towards him. He punched it.
Bang!
The sound of a fierce collision rang out. The heavy armored soldier holding the shield spurted blood. His body rushed back and knocked over two knights. One of the Knights was hit on the head and died on the spot.
The shield in the heavy armored soldier’s hand was deeply dented. It looked like a fist mark.
Several purple feather cavalrymen were dumbfounded. What kind of monster was this? !
Dudian’s palm patted the ground. He shot up like a cannonball and rushed forward.
“How is it possible? !”The five-star general looked at the scene through the telescope. He was a bit stunned.
Hildwin stared at Dudian who was unstoppable. He was silent for a moment. He turned to a young man who was leaning on the sofa: “We have encountered a difficult enemy. We may need your help.”
The young man was enjoying the delicacies and fruits on the table. He heard Hildwin’s words: “What kind of person is he? Look at how scared you are.”
Hilda Wen said in a deep voice, “This person is very strong. He has far surpassed the level of a hunter. He might not even be a primary limiter!”
“Oh?”When the young man heard this, his interest was immediately piqued. He took a bite of a fruit that was worth as much as gold and threw it out of the car. His figure flashed and appeared beside Hilda Wen. He raised his hand to cover his eyebrows, as if he wanted to block the sunlight, he looked forward and soon saw the chaotic area in front of him. He raised his eyebrows slightly, he smiled and said, “Interesting. No wonder you dare to charge at the formation alone. I guess you want to capture you directly and end this war.”
Hilda Wen stared at him. “Are you confident?”
“Confident?”The young man looked at her in surprise as if he had heard an unbelievable word. “You’re asking me if I’m confident? Darling, are you insulting me?”
“No, no.”The five-star general knew that this young man was a big shot from the inner wall, so he didn’t dare to offend him. He smiled apologetically and said, “The commander-in-chief definitely didn’t mean that…”
“Why would a child interrupt when a big shot is talking?”The young man gave him a sideways glance. This glance was as cold as ice and didn’t contain any emotion. It didn’t have the slightest bit of playful attitude that he had when he was dealing with Hidavin.
The five-star general was stunned. He felt a chill all over his body. He was embarrassed and did not know how to reply. However, he was a little embarrassed and angry in his heart. He was old enough to be the father of this young man. How could he be called a child? However, when he thought of the other party’s identity, he could only admit it to himself.
Xi Da Wen’s expression was indifferent. He said, “I know that you are very strong, but the enemy is not weak either. It is better for you not to underestimate the enemy.”
“It seems that you’ve underestimated me,”said the young man with a sad expression, “I’m from the inner wall after all. Although I don’t know where this kid came from, judging from his skills, he’s only a basic level limit holder. HMM, he’s close to a high level limit holder, but even if he’s a high level limit holder… I’ve killed many of them.”
“Sir is indeed powerful!”The five-star general found an opportunity to immediately compliment him.
The young man smiled at him.
The five-star general immediately felt overwhelmed by the favor, and his face was full of smiles.
Xidavan looked at the battlefield in front of him and said, “In that case, you should make your move earlier so that my men won’t die in vain.”
“They’re just some trash. So what if a few of them die?”The young man didn’t care at all, but he didn’t have the intention to continue watching the battle. He twisted his neck and made cracking sounds. After doing a few warm-up actions, he winked at Hidawen with a hint of temptation. “When the matter is settled, don’t forget what we agreed on.”
“I always keep my words,”Hidawen said calmly.
“Okay!”
Whoosh!
Just as he said this, the young man’s body had already flown out. The position where he stood was like a hurricane, causing the war chariot to shake slightly.
The five-star general looked at the young man who had flown out as if he had teleported. His eyes revealed a look of shock. Although he disliked this young man, it had to be said that other than his status being higher than him.., this strength was also something that he had never seen before.
“So Strong!”The five-star general sighed. “I didn’t expect that any random person from the inner wall region would be so strong!”
“He didn’t come here casually,”Hiddavin said indifferently.
The five-star general glanced at her and wanted to say something, but he stopped himself in the end.
“What do you want to say?”Hiddavin looked forward, but he seemed to notice the slight movement of the corners of the five-star general’s mouth.
The five-star General’s heart trembled slightly, and he immediately found a topic to talk about, he said, “This subordinate wants to say, after he finishes this person, do we need to capture all of the Holy See? If they treat us like this, shouldn’t we also capture all of the Holy See in one go?”
“We’ll talk about this when the three commanders are all present,”Hiddavin said coldly.
“Yes,”the five-star general said respectfully and patted another horse. “The commander saved Saint Lorenzo and Commander Bryson this time and saved the entire military. With such a great merit, it must be…”
“What?”Hiddavin suddenly cried out.
The five-star general felt strange and could only repeat himself. “The commander’s rescue this time…”he was halfway through his sentence when he heard a creaking sound. He saw that Hiddavin’s hand that was holding the edge of the chariot was too tight, it had actually crushed the guardrail.
He was shocked and hurriedly raised his head to look at Hiddwin’s face. He immediately saw a beautiful face that was shocked to the extreme. Due to being too shocked, her expression was slightly distorted.
He was stunned for a moment before he suddenly reacted. He grabbed the telescope and looked in the direction where Hiddwin was looking. Immediately, he saw the chaotic area in front of him. That youth in black armor was charging straight towards him, in the air beside him, a head rolled and fell down. It was the young man who had rushed out earlier. ! At this moment, the young man’s face was no longer the frivolous and frivolous look from before. Instead, it was filled with fear. His eyes were wide open, as if they were about to fall out.
“What? !”
He cried out in shock. Just as he cried out, he suddenly realized that his reaction was actually the same as that of Commander Hilda Wen.
“Just, just one punch…”Hidaven stared at him. She was not ignorant of the power system of the inner wall. On the contrary, it was because she knew that there was such a strong shock. Although the previous fight was short.., but she had been paying attention to it. She clearly saw that Dudian had killed the young man with just one punch. Moreover, he had broken his neck!
What kind of terrifying power was it to break his neck and cause his head to fly away? !
In her mind, the only people who could kill the young man were the legendary figures in the inner wall.
But the scene in front of her was so real that she suspected that it was fake.
Whoosh!
Dudian swung his left arm and knocked away the spears. He looked at the woman who was wearing the commander’s clothes in front of him, he had to release his full strength. Otherwise he would be delayed until he was trapped in the army and exhausted. At the moment he had exposed his true strength. He was too lazy to keep it.
Bang! Bang!
Dudian’s feet stepped on the cavalrymen. The sound of their shoulders cracking was heard. The cavalrymen fell to the ground. The recoil was too much for the horses to bear.
Dudian was like a black shadow. He passed through the crowd and arrived in front of the magnificent chariot in the middle of the army.
Bang! Dudian’s speed gradually slowed down. He stepped on the shoulder of a cavalryman and jumped into the air. He kicked the chest of the cavalryman who was guarding the front of the chariot and sent him flying backward, he brushed past the chariot and fell into the rear of the army.
Dudian stood on the back of the horse and looked down at the chariot. His indifferent eyes looked like he was looking at an ant.
… ..
There was no hope in the third night. Tomorrow he would go to the kitchen and cook

chapters.title: Chapter 662
chapters.content:
Chapter 662 – Chapter 652: The Opposite
The chaotic battlefield suddenly fell silent.
Hildwin stared blankly at the youth on the horse. The flying grass and the soldiers rushing over in slow motion seemed to be gradually moving away from her. She felt as if she was suddenly isolated from the entire world, she was sealed in an ice cave with no temperature in the world. The most eye-piercing sight was the gaze of the youth whose armor was covered in blood. It was like two deep black holes projected from the clouds.
The short illusion was broken by the neighing of the horses. The shouts of the soldiers who were rushing over were deafening again.
Dudian tiptoed and jumped from the frightened horse. He gently landed on the edge of the chariot. This time he was closer to Hildwin. Hildwin’s face was on his knees, it was less than an arm’s distance.
The five-star general who was standing next to Hildwin was completely stunned. It was as if his body was strangled by some mysterious force. He was frozen in place and couldn’t move. He could only hear his heart beating wildly, he desperately tried to move back but his feet were nailed to the ground.
“Do you want to be free or do you want to submit to me like St. Lorenza?”Dudian ignored the swords and spears coming at him. He squatted down and quietly looked at the mature beauty.
Bang! One of the Spears stabbed his face from the side. He gently raised his hand and grabbed the head of the spear. He pulled the other end of the spear and pulled the senior colonel off the horse, with a twist of his palm, the standard 4.4-meter long lances made by the military started to rotate between his fingers. They swung like a giant windmill, blocking all the weapons that were coming at him from other directions.
Although he exerted force with his hand, his body did not sway at all. From this, it could be seen how skilled he was at controlling his strength.
This could not be separated from the fact that he used his left hand to train when he did not use it all these years. Although his left hand was still unconscious, it was a far cry from the time when he lost his senses, because of the training of his left hand he had a lot of different understanding of strength. His control over the details was not inferior to many experienced experts.
The wind from the rotating lance blew the hair in front of Hilda’s forehead. She felt that it was difficult to breathe. It was as if the surrounding air had been plundered, it was the teenager who was squatting on the railing of the chariot.
However, she had been the commander for many years. She calmed down and looked into Dudian’s deep eyes, she said word by word: “Even if you kill me, you will die! They will attack until all the Knights of the order are killed!”
Dudian waved his arm and stabbed the spear to the side. The spear pierced through the throat of a major general who was rushing over to rescue him. He slightly twisted the tip of the spear in the throat of the major general, blood splattered onto the chariot as he looked at her emotionlessly. He raised his other hand and gently held her chin, he said: “I didn’t kill you because I don’t want to waste my life. Don’t think that you are really important. Without You, Saint Lorencia will be able to manage these people.”
Hidavin felt that the hand on her chin was extremely cold. It wasn’t a human hand but a piece of bone-chilling ice. She slightly leaned back and broke away from Dudian’s hand. But the coldness on her chin slowly seeped into her heart because she knew that she was completely defeated. Dudian was right. If she died.., dudian would be able to manage the army if he threw out the surrender of Saint Lorenzo.
At that time, her death would be a meaningless sacrifice.
Moreover, she knew that Dudian would say these words to her not because he cared about her sacrifice but because… he was too lazy to bother! Because she could clearly see the impatience in the eyes of the youth.
“Choose.”Dudian quietly looked at her.
Hilda Wen’s mind was in a mess. She knew that she was not the opponent of the youth since Dudian had killed him with one punch. It was futile to struggle as the gap in strength was too big.
“I admit defeat!”Hilda Wen slightly bowed her head and clenched her fingers. This was the first time that she had suffered such humiliation as a soldier. At this moment, she could only place her hopes on the inner wall, as long as the military of the inner wall took action, there was still hope to eliminate Dudian.
“Let them rest in place.”Dudian immediately issued an order.
Hilda took a deep breath and looked at the five-star general: “Immediately pass the order to rest in place!”
The five-star general came back to his senses. He wanted to open his mouth but he thought that the commander had surrendered. If he opened his mouth then wouldn’t he be in danger? He bowed his head and shouted to the generals: “Stop! Pass down the order! All the troops are to rest and reorganize! Don’t move forward!”
The generals who were riding at full strength were stunned. They looked at Hidaven and Dudian who was squatting on the railing of the chariot, one of the Colonel couldn’t help but say: “Commander, are you being coerced by him? We will help you!”
The five-star General’s face slightly changed: “What nonsense are you talking about? Are you going to disobey the military order? !”
The Colonel’s face changed as he shrank his head. He didn’t dare to make a sound.
The other generals didn’t dare to say anything as they rode away.
Dudian’s eyes glanced at the five-star general, he said: “I used to know that the general of the military region was stronger than the civilians. I didn’t expect that the ability to surrender wouldn’t lag behind the civilians. It’s not strange for a corrupt system to have corrupt people. It’s a pity that his blood is not as good as that of a small soldier.”
The five-star General’s face turned awkward, he changed the topic: “Mr. Dean, I have long heard of your name. I didn’t expect that you have such a good skill in addition to making divine instruments. If we had known this earlier we would have discussed with the Holy See and asked you to develop in our military region.”
“Aren’t you here now?”Dudian waved his hand and gestured for him to move aside. He jumped onto the chariot, he looked at Hilda Wen: “Since ancient times, the inheritance of power will lead to corruption. I only know that noble titles can be inherited and the position of the Holy See can be inherited. This is the first time I know that the general of your military region can also be inherited. Fortunately, the Phelan family is good. Although it is also an inheritance, but the other generals may not have such a strict family style.”
Hilda Wen’s face was gloomy, and she did not want to talk about this with him. After all, these systems had been passed down for more than two hundred years. Even if she knew about them, she did not have the ability to change them. She went straight to the point and said, “You work for the Holy See?”
“It’s the other way around.”
Hilda Wen and the five-star General were stunned at the same time, and their pupils suddenly contracted. The Holy See Works for you? !

chapters.title: Chapter 663
chapters.content:
Chapter 663 – Chapter 653: Snooping
“Send the order. Call the generals who are in charge over there. Come with me to the headquarters. Don’t let everyone wait for too long.”Dudian said to Hidaven.
Hidaven came back to her senses and looked at the teenager. She suppressed the shock in her heart and was silent for a while. She let the five-star General Pass down the order. She knew that Dudian was going to empty the command of the army, he was going to cut off the joints of the army.
Soon, six generals came with their guards to meet Hilda Wen.
“You stay here to guard the army.”Dudian said to the five-star general.
The five-star general was stunned: “Why do you want me to stay?”
“Because you are afraid of death. I know that you will not act recklessly.”Dudian was very direct.
The five-star general felt embarrassed. But he was able to get to his current position. This insult was nothing. He bowed his head and kept his anger in his heart.
Dudian was relieved as he saw the general’s expression. He called out to Hidaven and jumped from the chariot. He sat on the back of a warhorse. He pulled the rope and clamped his legs, the powerful force suppressed the struggling warhorse and looked back at hidaven.
Hidaven didn’t say anything but called a warhorse from the side. He led the six generals and rode away from the army with Dudian.
On the high slope, Richelieu, Saint Lorencia and others watched the chaos in front of the army gradually calm down. Because of the large number of soldiers, Dudian was trapped in the army, even Richelieu’s vision couldn’t see where Dudian’s figure was. He was anxiously waiting when he suddenly saw a small path in front of the army. A few cavalrymen rushed out from the path, it was Dudian!
Richelieu was shocked. Although he knew that the army might not be able to kill Dudian but he was surprised to see him return safely, he saw a few cavalrymen behind dudian. They were all wearing general’s armor and epaulets. There was a beautiful figure with long hair, he was one of the three commanders of the military region!
“He really did it!”Richelieu was shocked as he felt a trace of fear in his heart.
Saint Lorenzo, Bryson and the general of the military region quickly saw the faces of the cavalrymen. They were stunned as they didn’t expect Dudian to come back safely, moreover, there was also commander Hidaven behind him!
“Is Hidaven Crazy? She has left the army!”Bryson couldn’t help but shout in anger.
Saint Lorenzo was calm. The shock in his eyes slowly disappeared as he said in a low voice: “She should have been forced to come out.”
Bryson turned his head to look at him. He saw the depressed look on his old face. He was stunned. He suddenly realized that the situation was over. The military would change hands from then on.
Dudian rode his horse to the top of the hill. He saw Aisha standing next to Sergei. Aisha was standing in the same position as when Dudian left. He was relieved, there was a trace of gentleness in his eyes but it quickly disappeared. Dudian rode his horse to stop in front of Richelieu and the others. He got off the horse.
At this time, the six generals led by Hivind arrived one after another.
“Are you here to celebrate my triumphant return?”Dudian looked at St. Lorenzo and the others.
The Generals of St. Lorenzo and Bryson felt humiliated. Although they didn’t have a mirror but they could feel how ugly their faces were. They lowered their heads in shame and anger, silence was the last defense against dignity.
“Take them in.”Dudian said to Richelieu.
“Yes, Master.”Richelieu replied.
Ernorin and the other knights who were standing behind Richelieu looked at Dudian in shock. They felt that everything that they saw today was like a dream. It completely subverted their imagination.
“Commander Bryson! Commander of Saint Lorencia!”
The six generals behind Hidavin saw that Saint Lorencia and the others were subdued. They were shocked and angry. One of the generals pulled out his sword and glared at Richelieu and the others.
Hidavin knew that the situation was set. He didn’t want them to sacrifice themselves. He said: “Stop! We have lost!”
“Lost? !”The six generals looked at her in astonishment.
One of the generals was impatient: “Commander, there are so many brothers behind us. We have tens of thousands of soldiers. Why should we surrender? ! Are We Afraid of the Holy See? !”
Hidaven’s face sank, he said: “We are not afraid of the Holy See. But Mr. Dean is able to kill us one by one in the army. You have seen the previous chaos. He rushed into the army without any injuries. He has killed several generals in a row. No one can stop him. I am far from his opponent. He is not someone who can be defeated by using the Sea of people tactic. We have lost!”
The six generals were stunned.
“The biggest characteristic of the army is to obey orders. The lower level is subordinate to the higher level. Just like ants, the soldier ants are subordinate to the queen ant.”Dudian slowly said, sergei said: “It is very difficult to kill the soldier ants one by one. But if the queen ant is trampled to death then the soldier ants will be a pile of loose sand. The biggest advantage is also the biggest weakness. Moreover it is a weakness that can not be covered up. Do you understand?”
“I understand, young master.”Sergei nodded. He didn’t think that Dudian would be able to capture the leader of the enemy in the midst of an army, he had only heard of such things in the stories of bards.
Dudian knew that he didn’t completely listen to him. He didn’t say anything more. He walked to the side and took Aisha’s hand. The coldness on his face was like melting snow. His eyes were gentle.., “We have been waiting for a long time. Let’s go in.”
Aisha was silent.
Dudian held her hand and walked towards the military headquarters.
Richelieu immediately stepped aside. Ernorin and the other knights of the Holy See also stepped back.
At the same time, there was a remote grassland tens of thousands of meters away. The grassland slightly shook and rose up. There was a person’s head under the grassland. He was holding a telescope and looking at the high slope in the distance.
“That woman is… am I mistaken?”He was a little confused. He frowned and thought for a long time, he shook his head and said to himself, “Forget it. Forget it. I should report the situation here first. However, this little devil from the outer wall is really terrifying. He could kill a high-level limiter in an instant. His strength should be close to that of a pioneer. No wonder there is no news of them. It seems that they died here.”

chapters.title: Chapter 664
chapters.content:
Chapter 664 – Chapter 654: Military Transactions
Dudian was sitting at the top of the conference room in the military headquarters. His body was covered in black armor which was stained with blood. The smell of blood was heavy. Aisha and Sergei were standing next to him. Richelieu, Pulo and the other knights of the Holy See were standing at the bottom of the stairs. They were holding the surrendered generals of the military region as well as the three commanders Bryson, Saint Lorenza and Hidaven.
Pullo and the other leaders of the Knights had already seen through the situation. Although they found it hard to believe, they still silently digested this terrifying conjecture. After all, Richelieu, who had made them respect him by the side.., he had already shown a very clear attitude. At this time, they did not dare to say anything more.
Saint Lorenza looked at this high and mighty young man with mixed feelings. He had never thought that he would one day fall into such a situation. He had also never thought that this genius young man who only specialized in divine arts would actually have such terrifying power, he had changed the pattern of the outer wall region for more than two hundred years. The only person who could defeat him was probably the big figure of the inner wall region.
“Richelieu.”Dudian called out Richelieu’s name. His tone wasn’t too stiff: “I’ll leave the military affairs to you. I hope to see a complete military by the end of today.”
Richelieu was startled. He didn’t expect that Dudian would throw the hard-won military into his hands. Was it out of trust? Was he fearless? Or was it to test his loyalty?
He couldn’t guess and could only follow Dudian’s words: “I won’t let you down!”
The knights and generals in the hall felt an inexplicable throb. They had never imagined that the high and mighty pope would have such a humble moment?
The knights were secretly indignant but they didn’t dare to express their dissatisfaction when they thought of Dudian who had broken into the tens of thousands of troops to capture Hidwin.
“Commander Hidwin, the person I killed shouldn’t be from the outer wall?”Dudian asked Hidwin.
Hidwin’s heart was cold as he calmly replied: “Yes.”
Dudian nodded slightly, “The power that he had burst out should be at the level of a high-level limit. It’s a pity that he underestimated the enemy. He hasn’t shown his magic marks. How could he help you? Is He the trump card of your military?”
Richelieu, Pulo and the other knights were shocked. They didn’t expect that there would be such a brutal expert hidden in the previous army, such a character was killed by Dudian. Moreover, he was killed with the help of tens of thousands of soldiers!
Hilda had expected that Dudian would ask about this matter. She didn’t plan to hide it. Saint Lorenzo and Bryson knew about it, “He is from the Institute of Monsters in the inner wall. He has made a deal with us so he is willing to help us.”
“Deal?”Dudian narrowed his eyes: “What Deal?”
Richelieu and the others looked at her. They were surprised as they didn’t expect the military to be in contact with the Monster Institute in the inner wall. Fortunately they didn’t have any fierce conflict with the military before.
Hildwin said: “The Monster Institute in the inner wall has been dedicated to the research of monsters. The consortia have trained the hunters. The Monster Atlas was published by the Monster Institute. The Holy Church’s blessing was also obtained from the Monster Institute. Because of some experiments they needed some special materials so they were invited to our military to provide them.”
“What about the reward they gave you?”Dudian looked at her.
Hildwin’s face slightly changed. She wanted to skip this matter but Dudian pointed it out. She looked at Saint Lorenzo and Bryson. She sighed in her heart, she knew that there was no need to continue to hide the truth. She sighed: “In return they will provide us with military assistance and God’s marrow if necessary!”
“Your military’s superior in the inner wall is the military of the inner wall. Do you need them to provide military protection?”Dudian asked in a cold tone.
Hidebin hesitated for a moment: “Military protection is secondary. The main thing is God’s marrow.”
“No wonder your physique has surpassed the level of a hunter.”Dudian indifferently said.
Richelieu and Pulo looked at the female commander in surprise.
Hidaven wryly smiled: “I have made a breakthrough recently.”
“What do you mean by special materials? Monster Materials? It would be better for them to cooperate with the Holy See. The hunters have handed over a lot of monster materials to the Holy See.”Dudian asked with interest.
Hildwin’s face was ugly as his lips moved.
“There is nothing special about it. It’s just some rare monster corpses.”Saint Lorenzo interrupted.
Dudian glanced at him: “What are you trying to cover up?”
Saint Lorenzo’s face changed as he sighed in his heart. He knew that he couldn’t hide from Dudian. He looked at Hildwin as he hinted her not to say anything.
Hilda Wen understood what he meant. He lowered his head and fell into silence.
“Captives should look like captives. Do they want to suffer?”Dudian’s face turned cold.
Hilda Wen clenched his fingers and slowly loosened them. He looked up at dudian. He was about to speak when Lorenzo hurriedly said: “We can’t say anything. Our military will be destroyed if we say anything!”
Xidavan looked at him and then looked at Dudian who was sitting on the steps. He was silent for a long time. He whispered: “There is nothing that we can’t talk about. These special materials are human bodies.”
Richelieu’s eyes lit up. He wasn’t too surprised. It was common for human bodies to do experiments in the dark church.
Beside him, Plo and the other knights were stunned. They looked at Hildwin and the others in disbelief. They did not expect that the military would actually trade human bodies to the Monster Research Institute in the inner wall, using human bodies for research had always been illegal. It was also despised by them. How was this different from the dark church that they wanted to kill everywhere? It was the military who had been guarding the outer wall!
Dudian frowned: “Boring.”He thought that it was some mysterious thing that he didn’t know about. He didn’t expect that it would be such a dark deal that went against humanity. No wonder the Monster Research Institute found the military, the military was more suitable than the Holy See to transport human bodies.
“Is it a living human body?”Dudian asked.
Hildwin lowered his head.
Dudian’s heart suddenly moved. He looked at Aisha who was next to him. There was a glimmer of light in his eyes. If they were to do experiments on human bodies, the Monster Institute might have a way to solve the zombie infection!
He felt more and more anxious as he thought of this. He stood up and said to Richelieu: “I’ll leave this to you. I’ll go back and deal with it as soon as possible. Anyone who disobeys will be killed!”
“Yes.”Richelieu respectfully replied.
Dudian held Aisha’s hand and strode out of the hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 665
chapters.content:
Chapter 665 – : Chapter 655: Forbidden Arts
In the monastery in the inner wall, the white jade monastery was filled with a pure and holy aura. At this moment, in one of the spires, there were seven or eight figures sitting in the hall, and dozens of monastery nurses stood beside them, although the nurses here had the same name as the nurses in the hospital, they were completely different concepts, and were equivalent to servants and knights.
“Mogran, why did you call us here for an emergency?”One of the old men, who was tall and sturdy, asked.
Mogran, who was sitting at the table next to him, stood up and said, “Director, the outer wall area that you asked me to be in charge of has undergone some small changes recently. I need to report to you.”
“Since it’s only a small change, what’s there to report?”A short and thin old man on the opposite table held his chin and said with a face full of ridicule.
Mogran glanced at him and a dense killing intent flashed in his heart. However, he still had a smile on his face and said, “Although it’s just a small change, a person has recently appeared in the outer wall. It’s worthy of our attention.”
“Mogran, just say it directly,”the dean of the monastery said bluntly.
“He likes to keep us guessing,”the short and thin old man beside him said with a smile.
Mogran glanced at him and turned to look at the abbot, with a smile, he said, “It’s a long story. Half a year ago, the outer wall changed very quickly. A Genius Youth appeared out of nowhere and invented many divine arts. He also created the tenth divine arts system among the original nine divine arts basic systems, called the ‘Qi’System!”
“This divine art is somewhat similar to the legendary forbidden secret art mentioned by his majesty. Therefore, I used the Holy See of the outer wall region to seal this young man’s divine art. I also brought him here and erased his original identity. I appointed him as an elder of the Dark Holy See of the outer wall region. I originally wanted to promote him to become the new pope of the outer wall region after he had a rich experience in all aspects. I didn’t expect him to suddenly disappear not long after he started working there.”
“Qi-type?”The attention of the people next to him immediately fell on this divine art, one of them said, “From the name alone, it is indeed similar to that forbidden art. One is called Qi-type, and the other is ‘steam’. It seems to be related to the air.”
“How could such a genius be born in such a desolate place like the outer wall?”
“If the divine art system invented by this person is really that forbidden art, then this person is truly a peerless genius! It’s a pity that he’s not someone from the pure wall. His status is too low, and he’s not worth nurturing.”
The dean stared at Mogran and said, “Continue.”
Mogran smiled slightly, he continued, “After he went missing, I asked the people from the outer wall to search everywhere, but there was no news. “Not long ago, this person suddenly appeared again, and as soon as he appeared, he took control of the Dark Vatican that we had worked so hard to build. He also used the Dark Vatican to take control of the Pope of the outer wall. And today, he sent troops to attack the military. Without any suspense, he defeated the military and completely took control of the two biggest chess pieces of the outer wall!”
“What? !”The people around were shocked, although they didn’t take the outer wall seriously, they knew something about the outer wall after so many years of being under Mogran’s control. A person who appeared in the outer wall didn’t have any resources or background, it was impossible for them to control and unify the outer wall that Mogran had worked so hard to build in such a short time! However, they knew that Mogran was not lying. This could only mean that there was too much information that was worth digging deeply into.
The dean’s gaze was slightly focused as his thoughts moved. After a moment, he said to mogran, “As far as I know, the instructors that you stationed in the outer wall area are all limiters. How did this youth solve them?”
Mogran smiled slightly, “This is what I want to talk about. In fact, besides the five supervisors, there is also a good friend of mine who fell in the hands of this young man. Her strength can be considered as a pioneer. Although there is still a gap between her and a real pioneer, it is not much. “Not long ago, when I sent her to the outer wall to investigate the internal cause with the five limiters, they did not send any message back. Until today, the people I sent to investigate in the dark again sent back the news. That young man is still alive. It clearly means that my good friend is dead and the five limiters she brought with her.”
“All the pioneers are dead?”The surrounding people were stunned.
Even in their inner wall, pioneers were not easy to find, but they were rare powerhouses.
The dean narrowed his eyes and stared at him, “Continue.”
Mogran smiled, “I thought that this young man killed them with a hidden weapon or some fierce poison, but it was not the case. My spies saw a person during the investigation. This person is the last Saintess of the Dragon Clan, Aisha!”
Everyone was stunned again.
The previous Saintess of the Dragon Clan had appeared in the outer wall? If that was really the case, then everything before that could be explained!
But, what did this mean?
The Dragon Clan wanted to encroach on the outer wall? Deliberately announcing the death of the previous Saintess to confuse them?
Thinking of all the possibilities, everyone frowned. They felt a trace of worry, as if a dark cloud was about to arrive.
The Dean lowered his head in silence. After a moment, he slowly said, “Tell me what you think.”
Mogran glanced at him and was secretly afraid. Among all the people present, the one he could not figure out the most was this dean, he said, “Since we have found the source and know our target, then there is only one problem. How to take back the outer wall from the hands of the Dragon Clan! I have three views on this.”
The principal said, “Speak.”
“First, although I saw traces of the previous Saintess in the outer wall, I didn’t see it with my own eyes. Furthermore, the spies didn’t dare to get close to observe, so they weren’t 100% confident either! “Therefore, I temporarily set up this news. If this news is true, then there is a problem. As far as I know, although the previous Saintess of the Dragon tribe and the current Saintess are blood-related sisters, they aren’t on good terms with each other! Do you still remember what the Dragon Clan announced when the Saintess was replaced? They said that because the previous SAINTESS was guilty, they temporarily dismissed her! And there is a rumor outside that the previous Saintess Haisha was framed by Saintess Hathaway, so she lost her position as the SAINTESS
“I think the credibility of this rumor is quite high.”Mogran smiled, “After all, since Haisha became the SAINTESS, the Dragon Clan’s power has been rising day by day. The wing clan and the Rock clan were completely suppressed by the Dragon Clan, and they didn’t fight for the Dragon Clan’s territory in the desolate area. “The contribution of this Saintess Aisha to the Dragon Clan is obvious. The Dragon clan dismissed her because of her crime. There is only one possibility, which is that she has committed an unforgivable crime!”
“But think about it, who is Saintess Aisha? “The wing clan and the Rock clan have been painstakingly trying to kill her for so many years, but they haven’t hurt her at all. How could she be so stupid as to commit an unforgivable crime? “Therefore, the possibility of her being framed is very high, and this is the key point!”
“If she is framed, then the hatred between her and Saintess Hathaway is a sharp blade that we can use!”
Hearing his words, everyone looked at each other and slightly nodded, feeling that his analysis made sense.
The short and thin elder sitting on the opposite table snorted. Although he was a bit unconvinced, he knew that he was right.
“If the dragon clan really wants to attack the outer wall, there is no need to send a saintess to take charge of the situation.”The dean was silent for a moment, he slowly said, “If this SAINTESS holds a grudge against the Dragon Clan because of her dismissal, she wants to seize the outer wall and set up a new platform to contend with the Dragon Clan. The possibility is higher.”
Mogran smiled slightly, he said, “That’s right. Therefore, I think we can send the news to the dragon clan to see their reaction. If our guess is correct, I believe that the Dragon Clan will want to destroy her more than us, especially that Saintess Hathaway.”

chapters.title: Chapter 666
chapters.content:
Chapter 666 – Chapter 656: Quickly Prepare For War
“Continue with your second point.”The Dean did not deny or agree. It seemed like he wanted to hear more ideas.
Mogran knew what he was worried about, but he did not expose it, “The second point is to use the military. “I just said that this person has already ruled the military in the outer wall region. Such a move will definitely anger the military! “For so many years, we have always left some face for the military of the outer wall region. We just don’t want to offend the military before they are mature, but he has already done so.”
An old man beside him nodded and said, “This idea is not bad. The military will definitely not sit idly by. We can send them to take the lead first. In addition, we can hide the information about this youth and have them collide with us to see if they can create any situation that we still don’t know about.”
“Although this person might be a divine arts genius, he is still too young and his mind is not clear. He actually wants to unify the outer wall region. How Pitiful, how laughable!”Another old man wearing a black and white striped hat sneered.
“Although the outer wall region is an abandoned land, it is still his majesty’s territory after all. This person trying to rule the outer wall region is really stupid!”
“What is Your Third Point?”
Mogran glanced at them and smiled when he saw that they were leaning towards him, he said, “The third point is to wait and see! “Although I am not sure whether the woman that this young man is relying on is the real Haisha Saintess, I am sure that he has the power to kill pioneers. If we kill him personally, we need at least two pioneers to work together. The safest way is for three pioneers to work together so that he has no chance to escape! However, in this way, we have to mobilize the pioneers in each branch. The consequences would be too great and the losses would outweigh the gains.”
“Fortunately, this young man is greedy. In this way, we don’t need to personally take back the outer wall. Isn’t it best to borrow the knife of others to kill our own enemies?”
Dean nodded: “You are the most familiar with the situation in the outer wall. I will leave this matter to you. Inform the military and the Dragon clan to see their reaction.”
“Yes, Dean.”Mogran respectfully replied.
..
… ..
“Young master, you are back.”Barton rushed out of the temple and greeted Dudian.
Dudian nodded. He was relieved to see that Barton was safe and sound. He glanced at the wall builders who were digging the walls and trenches: “Is the progress going well?”
“It is going well.”Barton smiled: “They are the best builders. They are good at repairing the giant wall. It is a piece of cake to renovate the temple.”
Dudian nodded and asked: “Has Riley come back?”
“I haven’t seen Mr. Riley.”Barton shook his head. There was a trace of worry in his eyes: “Will Anything Happen?”
“No.”Dudian patted his shoulder. He turned around and led Aisha to the side hall. He called Sergei: “Call Gwyneth, Glenn and the others. Also, tell Neuss to come here.”
“Yes, Young Master.”Sergei replied and left.
Dudian asked Barton to fetch Aisha’s lunch. After feeding her, he began to work on his own matters. The temple was in the process of reconstruction. He planned to build it as a future war wall. He wanted to build tunnels and ditches so that he could easily bury cables. As for why he chose this place as a fortress, the reason was very simple. Utuo mountain was the highest mountain in the outer wall area. It had a wide field of vision and was easy to defend, but difficult to attack. Behind the temple was a hundred thousand feet cliff, which was convenient for discharging the pollution of electricity, it could also stop the enemy.
He knew that after poking this hornet’s nest of the military, the real battle would come next.
But he wasn’t worried. At least for a while, the inner wall wouldn’t put him in their eyes. He had enough time to perfect his layout.
The only thing that the divine arts could give him was protection, but if he blindly defended, he would be penetrated sooner or later. He had to defend, but at the same time, he had to counterattack and Attack!
“You said that without the Witcher, you can’t fully activate the ability of the magic marks. The Witcher can only be developed by the Monster Research Institute…”Dean looked at Aisha next to him, but his eyes were very distant, it was as if he was looking into the distance, “I can only be considered as half a primary limiter. The effect of deifying the legendary magic marks is too strong. If I continue to evolve, my body will mutate. Moreover, it will be permanent and can not be restored.”
“I can only develop my witcher before then. I just don’t know what level of people in the research institute can develop a witcher. It’s time to investigate.”
He frowned and fell into deep thought.
Sergei brought Neuss, Glenn and the others.
“Young master, they are here.”Sergei panted.
“Thank you for your hard work.”Dudian said to Gwyneth and Glenn: “Do you remember the last time I took you to the inner wall? I need you to go to the inner wall.”
“Yes.”Gwyneth’s eyes lit up: “Young Master, what is it?”
“Go and investigate what level of people in the Monster Research Institute can develop a witcher.”Dudian looked at Glenn, “Your ‘Black Weaver’magic marks are good at hiding. I’ll leave this to you.”
Glenn felt a bit of pressure: “Am I going alone?”
“Gwyneth has other tasks.”Dudian said, “You don’t have to worry about the situation in the inner wall. Gwyneth will give you a detailed introduction. You can first find a map of the inner wall. As far as I know, there should be many branches in the Monster Research Institute. You only need to sneak into the relatively remote monster research institute to know. Although your strength is far from the inner wall but you are already at the limit of a senior hunter. I will help you to evolve your physique to the level of a primary limiter before you set off. You can be considered as an outstanding guard in the inner wall.”
Gwyneth and Glenn were relieved to hear his words. Glenn nodded: “I will try my best to complete the task.”
“The time limit is twenty-four hours. The sooner the better.”Dudian solemnly said: “Because we will encounter a very strong enemy. The longer we delay, the more dangerous it will be for us.”
“I know.”Glenn solemnly said.
Dudian nodded and said to Gwyneth: “Your task is to go to the inner wall and investigate the underground structure of the inner wall. I need a map of the sewer of the inner wall.”
Gwyneth was stunned. She didn’t know why Dudian wanted this. But it was a good thing for her to be able to return to the inner wall. She replied: “I know, Young Master.”
“I will give you twenty-four hours. Once the time is up, you must come back no matter how much you finish.”Dudian looked at her deeply.
Gwyneth lowered her head: “I promise to complete the task!”
“Go.”Dudian waved his hand: “The military will transport a batch of God’s marrow. I have left one for both of you. You can get it from Barton later.”
Their eyes lit up as they were pleasantly surprised: “Thank you young master!”
Neuss was stunned: “Young Master, What About Me?”
“You will stay by my side.”Dudian said: “Your Magic Marks are able to digest the poison. I am worried that someone will try to assassinate me. I will leave all my meals to you to test the poison.”
Neuss realized that Dudian had almost been poisoned when he lived in the castle. It was not strange for him to stay by his side. Moreover, because of this, he felt warm, from this point of view, Dudian obviously trusted him!
Sergei looked at Neuss and sighed in his heart. After all, they had been in prison together.
“Sergei, my two classmates are still in the castle.”Dudian asked.
Sergei knew that he was referring to Mason and Zach: “They are both here.”
“Contact Hawkeye from the 9th region. Hawkeye will take them to exercise. In addition, give them rare magic marks. Make sure that they grow up as fast as possible.”Dudian said, he had a lot of feelings for Mason and Zach. They had supported each other during the Scavenger training. He had saved them many times and they had saved him.
Although he was disappointed about Sham’s matter but it didn’t affect his opinion of Mason and Zach. He believed that as long as he gave them the resources and opportunities.., they would be able to make a difference.
Many people sometimes lacked an opportunity.
The successful ones would be able to find opportunities and create opportunities.
The other group of people, although outstanding, lacked the vision to find opportunities. If given an opportunity, they might be able to do something big!
Mason and Zach were the same kind of people. Moreover, with Dudian’s current status and the resources he had, it was a piece of cake to cultivate several senior hunters. It wasn’t difficult to cultivate a few limiter, however, he couldn’t inject too much God’s blessing at once. Even if he used the most frequent frequency within the limit, it would take one or two weeks. However, Dudian wanted to train both of them. In addition to strength, he also wanted to train their minds.
He knew that the things he had seen along the way had subverted his original perception. He didn’t want them to see him doing something beyond their understanding.
“Let them go to the Dark Church?”Sergei looked at Dudian. He quickly understood his thoughts. He had an indescribable strange feeling in his heart, he suddenly felt that the teenager was a bit sad. But he didn’t dare to express his thoughts. Although Dudian’s attitude towards him wasn’t different from the others but he knew that.., he wasn’t comparable to Dudian’s two childhood friends.
“Bring Artemis and Gabriel.”Dudian almost forgot about the two little guys. His eyes lit up as he thought about Artemis’s green hair.
“I know.”Sergei bowed.
“Wait for the military to transport the god’s marrow. You and Neuss will get a portion each. You will become a limiter as soon as possible to deal with the coming enemies.”Dudian said.
Sergei bowed: “Thank you young master.”
Neuss also said: “Thank You Young Master!”
“Go.”
Barton rushed to the side hall not long after Sergei left: “Young Master, Joseph Is Back!”
Dudian’s eyes moved: “Bring him here.”
Barton quickly turned around and ran. He brought several people. The leader was Riley. He knelt down and saluted: “Greetings Young Master. I have picked up the person you asked me to pick up.”
“Get up.”Dudian said as he looked at the person behind him. It was Joseph who he had placed in the military. It had been a long time since they had last met. Joseph was completely different from his impression. His skin was tanned and his body was bronze. He had many muscle lines and was full of strength. It was obvious that he had suffered a lot in the military. He got up to welcome him, “You are finally here.”
Joseph looked at Dudian in a daze. Until now he had an unbelievable feeling. This was the headquarters of the Holy Church. His impression of Barton was that he was always dressed in scruffy clothes but at the moment his skin was white and clean, dudian was dressed in a gorgeous pope’s robe. His skin had always been white and even a bit pale. The change was not obvious but he was still pale. He looked a bit sickly and haggard.
However, no matter how he looked at him, he couldn’t see any familiar shadow. It was as if he was a different person.
However, as Dudian spoke, a warm feeling rose in his heart. The previous sense of strangeness disappeared in an instant. He excitedly hugged dudian and said: “I thought I would never see you again.”
“How could it be?”Dudian patted his shoulder: “How are you?”
“I didn’t expect you to become muscular so soon after you went to the army.”Barton laughed as he punched his chest.
Joseph’s eyes moistened as he gave Barton a big hug.
Dudian chatted with Joseph for a long time before he thought of Riley: “Riley, you should leave first. Barton, think about what reward you should give him.”
Barton patted his head: “That’s true. But what should I give him?”His face turned red. Although he was the pope but he didn’t know what kind of treasures the Holy See had. As for the position, he was clear about it, but he knew that Dudian’s attitude towards Riley couldn’t be included in the establishment of the Holy See. After all, he used to shine in the Holy See and suddenly disappeared. If he went back to the Holy See.., it would inevitably lead to some unjustified speculation.
“Take your time to think. I don’t think Riley is in a hurry, right?”Dudian said.
Riley respectfully replied: “Yes, Young Master.”
Dudian and Joseph chatted for a moment after Riley left. Barton took him to rest while he continued to busy himself.
Another Day passed in the blink of an eye.
The next morning’s morning newspapers and special reports didn’t publicize the war between the Holy See and the military but said that both sides had reached an agreement and so on, the military and the Holy See used to cover things up by blurting out that Bryson was a member of the dark church.
Richelieu returned to the Holy See the next day, he reported to dudian: “Young Master, the military has been completely adjusted. All the generals have been replaced by our people. The three commanders have been replaced. I have appointed Bishop Ernorin to temporarily supervise them but he will not appear.”
“Well, I will leave the military to you. I will only look for you if there is a problem.”Dudian handed a piece of beef to Aisha. He tried to slowly change her taste, he first changed the human meat to beef. Now he was heating the beef for her to eat. He hoped that one day she would be able to eat the mature beef “Happily”. That way he would feel slightly better.
At least he didn’t have to see her mouth full of blood every time. He believed that she wouldn’t like him like this.
Richelieu looked at him: “Young Master, we have taken down the military. The rest of the magistrate and the Knight’s Hall are nothing to be afraid of. Should we seize the opportunity to take them down?”
“There is no hurry.”Dudian said: “We have attracted the attention of the inner wall. Now we should think of a way to deal with the anger of the military and the monastery. As for the magistrate and the Knight’s Hall, as long as they don’t cause trouble for us, we don’t need to worry about them. If they dare to cause trouble, we will directly destroy them.”
Richelieu knew that the inner wall was the biggest problem. He immediately asked: “Young Master, do you have a way to deal with it?”
“You came at the right time. There are some things that need to be done by you.”Dudian said: “Send the military’s God’s marrow here. In addition, contact the nobles and rent all of their nitrite mines. The dark church used to be forbidden in the past. Now we can lift the ban. Let the Dark Church do their best to develop and increase the rewards. We don’t need to be stingy with money. We must make sure that everyone is involved in the research of the forbidden technique.”

chapters.title: Chapter 667
chapters.content:
Chapter 667 – Chapter 657: This Wall
“Make a forbidden spell?”Richelieu’s face slightly changed.
The reason why a forbidden spell was classified as a forbidden spell was either because of its destructive power which could easily destroy the giant wall or because of its cruelty which could destroy human nature! However, Dudian was prepared to activate such a forbidden spell. It could be said that he was going to pursue victory at any cost!
“Master, do you want to fully activate these forbidden techniques? Some of them require a large number of human experiments. If you activate them then the dark church will catch people everywhere and cause a big mess…”Richelieu carefully said, he knew that the only possible reason to stop Dudian was not because of the destructive power but because of the sacrifice of too many lives.
“It doesn’t matter. This is the time for our holy church to establish its prestige.”Dudian indifferently said, “The dark church’s frequent activities will make people understand the fear of being attacked by the dark church. They will be more dependent on our holy church. In this way, even those who secretly hold grudges against us will not dare to say anything. After all, we only need to suppress the dark church and we will be able to offset all the other mistakes!”
“You should know that people are selfish and forgetful. No matter what you have done, as long as you can protect him in times of danger, he will be grateful to you.”
Dudian looked down at him: “Isn’t this something you used to do? I don’t need to explain it in detail.”
Richelieu’s face changed. From the point of view of interests, he admitted that Dudian was right. But he had to deny one point. Although he had done the same thing in the past, but the degree of grasp was very important, at least in the area of forbidden spells he wouldn’t easily touch them. Although this was the intention of the monastery but he had the same idea in his heart.
After all, it was easy to lose control if there was too much chaos.
“I know.”He lowered his head. He knew that Dudian had made up his mind. It was useless to say more. He didn’t continue to persuade Dudian. After all it was dangerous for him to persuade Dudian, the civilians didn’t know that Dudian had done such a thing. Dudian had never been willing to be a hero. He didn’t have the kind of heroic feeling. The way of thinking about benefits had already seeped into his bones.
“If the history books I read are true then the wall of Sighs was built by the inner wall right?”Dudian looked out of the window. He could see the wall of sighs from the top of Uto Mountain, of course, it was difficult for ordinary people to see the wall. But it wasn’t difficult for him and Richelieu to see it clearly.
Richelieu was stunned as he heard Dudian’s words. He didn’t know what he meant, he lowered his head: “Yes, the original giant wall of Sylvia wasn’t divided into the inner wall and the outer wall. But because of a sudden disaster most of the survivors moved to the inner wall which was the core of the giant wall. They built the wall of sighs in this isolated area.”
“All the people born in the outer wall want to cross this wall. Don’t you?”Dudian asked.
Richelieu looked at him: “I have thought about it.”
“Thought about it? Why didn’t you think about it later? Did you enjoy the comfort of being Pope?”
There was a trace of embarrassment on Richelieu’s face. Although Dudian’s words were very straightforward but they hit the nail on the head. The older he was, the more he didn’t want to move. He didn’t want to struggle anymore, he felt quite satisfied. After all, he was at the peak. If he continued to struggle then he would have nothing.
“We have to rely on this wall for this war.”Dudian retracted his eyes, he indifferently said: “This time, the inner wall will be eager to break this wall. They might even hate this wall.”
Richelieu was a bit puzzled but he didn’t ask. It seemed that the teenager was planning something.
“Go and do your work.”Dudian waved his hand.
..
… ..
The inner wall, the territory of the Dragon Clan.
As one of the three big families of the Witcher family, the territory of the Dragon clan was extremely vast. The territory of the family was comparable to a large city. As for the territory built on the edge of each city, it was even larger.
At this moment, on the Holy Maiden Peak of the Dragon Clan, Hathaway was practicing her spear in the square. A huge spear was flying up and down in her slender hand, like a flood dragon or a ferocious beast. It was so swift and fierce that the servants around her didn’t dare to make any noise.
This holy maiden peak was completely different from when Aisha was in charge. The mountain was no longer desolate and desolate. Now, all the buildings had been renovated by the best craftsmen and changed into her favorite style, the floors had been completely renovated. The mountain path was filled with attendants and was heavily guarded. It was like a fortress with iron walls. Even if a bird intruded, it would be shot down.
On the steps at the end of the square, an extremely pale middle-aged man who looked like a ghost quietly floated over. He walked without wind, but he was extremely fast, he quietly came to the side of the field where Hathaway practiced her spear and stood there, watching her practice.
Hathaway had noticed him long ago. When he came over, she shook her wrist and finished the last dragon spike stance. She immediately put away her spear and turned her head to ask, “Sir, what’s The Big Matter?”She knew.., if it wasn’t a big matter, he wouldn’t come to find her personally.
“Miss, I just received news from the monastery. I heard that the monastery’s spies saw your sister in the outer wall area,”the white-faced middle-aged man said straightforwardly.
Hathaway was startled, and her eyes widened. She pushed the huge spear in her hand to the ground and pierced through the floor, “Impossible, she’s already dead, it’s impossible for her to still be alive!”
“I know this, but the monastery’s news shouldn’t be false. There might be something fishy about this.”The white-faced middle-aged man said.
“Absolutely impossible!”Hathaway clenched the spear shaft, she said angrily: “No matter what is fishy, she can’t Be Alive! “We met the great corpse king who evolved into a consciousness, and she was seriously injured. I saw it with my own eyes. She can’t be alive. Her witcher device was left in the wilderness for so long, but it hasn’t been retrieved. How Can She Be Alive? !”
The white-faced middle-aged man’s eyes flashed. He didn’t expect that after so long, mentioning that person again would make her so excited, and it was difficult for her to control her emotions. He sighed in his heart. It seemed that the shadow that that person had cast on her since she was young was too big.
“As far as I know, the monastery has been secretly managing that isolated outer wall area for all these years. Although I don’t know why they did it, I once sent people to the outer wall area to secretly visit. The outer wall area is indeed not as desolate and barren as we imagined. However, we can’t see any value in using it,”the white-faced middle-aged man said. “The area there is too small. The people who were left there in the past were all low-class pariahs. The people who were expelled to the outer wall area these years were also noble servants and criminals. They were all low-class people with low bloodlines. The descendants they gave birth to were also the same
“However, I saw a laughable phenomenon in the outer wall. These expelled noble servants actually called themselves nobles, and even imitated the wall of sighs to build a wall to separate the lower people. They’re really ignorant!”
Hathaway’s heart was in turmoil. Hearing his words, she frowned: “You still care about this?”
The white-faced middle-aged man saw her disdain and smiled, not going further, he said: “Recently, there has been unrest in the outer wall area. The monastery’s power in the outer wall area has been uprooted. It is said that they even sent pioneers to solve the problem. In the end, the pioneers they sent were killed. There were also people who saw people like your sister appear in the outer wall area, so I think we need to investigate it.”
“Her name is Aisha, not my sister!”Hathaway’s eyes were cold as she said word by word.
The white-faced middle-aged man was slightly startled. He immediately smiled and said, “Okay, I was wrong.”
Only then did Hathaway turn her gaze away from his face and coldly said, “I have already understood what you want to say. I will let Eleanor investigate this matter.”
..
Qixi Festival, hehehe

chapters.title: Chapter 668
chapters.content:
Chapter 668 – Chapter 658: Temple Of Thunder
Temple at the top of Uto Mountain, glenn was the first to report back to dudian: “Master, I infiltrated a branch of the Institute of Monsters in the inner wall and asked the staff. They said that there are many levels of difficulty in casting a witcher. It depends on the material and grade of the witcher. If you want to create a top-notch legendary witcher then you need a doctor in the institute to do it.”
“Doctor?”Dudian heard the term. He was puzzled. Was it a coincidence or did they inherit the name from the old era? If it was the latter then it could only mean that the inner wall had grasped the clues of the old era but he didn’t know how much. He had been to the inner wall but he didn’t see any power tools. It was clear that even in the inner wall he didn’t have the ability to generate electricity.
“Is it really a coincidence?”Dudian frowned. From the environment of the inner wall it didn’t seem like he had mastered the knowledge of the old era. Otherwise the language system wouldn’t have completely changed.
It was very difficult to create a new language system. It would be very difficult to complete in a short 300 years, he found that the language system they were using now was completely comparable to the Chinese characters of the old era!
Chinese characters were the only high-level language in the old era. They had been used for thousands of years but the language system they were using now was not inferior to Chinese characters.
“Young Master?”Glenn whispered as she saw that Dudian didn’t speak for a long time.
Dudian frowned: “Go on.”
“I did some research. The title of ‘doctor’is very high in their institute. There is a great doctor level above the doctor level. Usually the great doctor will be the director of the branch.”Glenn said: “The great doctor rarely shows up. Usually he will only study the legendary monster level projects. Usually the rare monster level projects are in the hands of the Doctor.”
Big Doctor? Dudian was relieved: “It’s hard for you to find out so much in one day. What happened to your shoulder? Did you hurt it?”
Glenn looked at her right hand under the black robe. She didn’t expect that Dudian’s eyes would be so sharp. She smiled: “It’s just a small injury. There is no big problem. Young master don’t worry.”
“Neuss, go and ask the priest to treat Glenn.”Dudian ordered Neuss.
“Yes, Young Master.”Neuss respectfully nodded and quietly left.
Glenn’s heart was warm. She didn’t refuse, she continued: “Young Master, I didn’t know how to describe the strange things I saw when I infiltrated the Monster Research Institute. Er, I think it was a big green jar. It was like a water tank. It was filled with green liquid. There were strange creatures inside. Some of them were monsters but some of them were monsters with human heads and bodies. It looked like they had grafted human heads onto the bodies of monsters.”
She recalled the faces of the creatures that seemed to be sleeping in the green jar. She instinctively felt a chill.
“Human head and Demon Body?”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he thought of the things that the military had told him, every year the military would send a large number of people from slums and civilian areas to the monster research institute in the inner wall. These people included people of different types and ages, the Monster Research Institute seemed to have been dedicated to studying the relationship between humans and monsters.
However, this kind of cruel and dehumanizing research was not known in the inner wall whether it was an open secret or a private experiment conducted by the Monster Research Institute.
However, this might be good news for him! The Monster Research Institute had a large number of humans as experimental targets, which meant that they might also study people infected by zombies. In this way, there might be a way for Aisha to regain her original consciousness!
It was a glimmer of hope, but he was very excited!
A moment later, the priest came and took Glenn down to heal.
Not long after Glenn went down, Gwyneth also returned.
Dudian didn’t expect her to come back. Since the previous events, she could see that the girl’s heart was no longer with him. Maybe it was because of what he had done during this time that the girl found it hard to accept. He had long expected such a situation. This was the reason why he sent Mason and Zach to Eagle Eye for training.
Gwyneth was different from Glenn and Neuss. She had experienced the feeling of being surrounded by darkness in thorn flower prison. Her previous life was a blank slate.
The blank slate didn’t mean ignorance but purity!
As a disciplinary officer in the Court of Justice, it was obvious that the ideals instilled in her by the Court of Justice were mostly hatred of evil, hatred of the dark cultists, and all sorts of people who broke the law and discipline.
Although she was sent to prison as a scapegoat and was cruelly tortured, this girl did not completely sink like the others. She took revenge on the world, and her conscience was still alive. He had long seen this and had long expected it, sooner or later she would leave him because she couldn’t stand his actions. White and black could never coexist. They could only be opposite unless he dyed her black.
“You are back.”Dudian quietly looked at her.
Gwyneth quietly came to the steps in front of dudian: “Master, I am back. I have completed the task that you gave me.”
“Is that so?”Dudian’s eyes narrowed as he calmed down: “Have you checked the underground sewer structure of all the large cities in the inner wall?”
Gwyneth lowered her head: “Yes, Master.”
“Let me see.”
Gwyneth handed a stack of snow paper to Dudian.
Dudian looked at each piece of paper. Each piece of paper was engraved with a clear picture of the underground sewer structure as well as the general appearance of the entire city. His face sank as he looked at Gwyneth, he asked Gwyneth: “Did you draw all of these?”
Gwyneth shook her head: “I used my connections to find the latest drawings of the city’s renovation.”
Dudian’s face relaxed. If Gwyneth said that she had drawn them herself then it would be a big problem. In a short 24 hours it would be difficult for her to travel around the city. Moreover she had to draw so many exquisite drawings, even with her hand speed it would be difficult for her to do so.
“I didn’t expect that you have acquaintances in the past years.”Dudian looked at her: “They should know that you have been arrested and imprisoned. Didn’t they inform the military to arrest you?”
Gwyneth lowered her head: “They are my family. They won’t inform the military.”
Dudian narrowed his eyes: “Didn’t you go to the laporte Family? How are they doing?”
Gwyneth’s body trembled. The word ‘laporte’was like a dark cloud in her life. It covered all her hope and light. She wanted to tear it apart at all times!
“I didn’t go!”Her fingers clenched into fists. Her chest rose and fell. Her heart wasn’t calm.
Dudian knew that she was relying on him for the sole purpose. She wanted to use his power to destroy the Raptor family in the inner wall. She couldn’t do it by herself, she was only a punisher of the rank of the Sun Medal. Although she had obtained the god’s marrow and had the combat power of a primary limiter, she was still too weak in front of the nobles.
Even if she tried to assassinate them, she would only be able to assassinate one or two people. She would lose her life.
She had done so in the past. So she had entered the thorn flower prison. The Laporte family was still prosperous and only lost one or two leaves.
“I didn’t expect you to have relatives. You must miss them after so many years.”Dudian said: “If I had known that this would happen, I would have given you more time to get together with them. If there is an opportunity in the future, I would have brought them here. It would be much safer than staying in the inner wall.”
Gwyneth bowed her head: “Thank you young master for your kindness.”Although she promised but she knew that it was impossible! She had seen Richelieu being threatened by Dudian because of his grandson’s life. How could she pull her family into the Sea of Fire? For her, as long as she could take revenge she would die without regrets.
But she didn’t want to implicate others.
“You should go and rest.”Dudian didn’t say anything more. He looked down at the drawings in his hand and counted. There were thirteen of them. He pondered for a moment, although he didn’t know what percentage of the population lived in the inner wall. But if the plan was implemented, the effect should be the same as what he had expected.
He handed the drawings to Neuss: “Find someone to copy these drawings into two copies.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss took the drawings.
After Neuss left, only dean and Aisha were left in the empty temple. Dean turned to look at her profile. His eyes were full of tenderness and tenderness, “I will find you soon.”
Aisha was silent.
