Dean smiled as he saw her reaction. His heart was sad. He touched her cold hand and kissed it. After a long time he let go of her hand, he got up and went to the desk next to her. He continued to create his next invention. He could create more things with electricity.
The most urgent thing that he needed right now was the biosensor that he could make with his current technological level.
With this thing coupled with the lightning barrier that he had meticulously built, he would no longer have to worry about being ambushed.
After all, although Aisha’s perceptive ability was outstanding, she was good at hiding her magic marks. Some of them might not be able to be sensed by her. The biosensor that he was going to make was more comprehensive, from the heat source reaction.., the biomagnetic field, as well as the echo on the ground, could detect all aspects. Even if it could hide the heat source and the sound of footsteps, it would be difficult to hide the biomagnetic field emitted by the body.
If this set of equipment could not detect the enemy, then it was basically omnipotent.
After a day and night of Reconstruction, the current temple had been completely transformed into the appearance that he had designed. Although the appearance did not change much, cables were buried on all the pillars of the temple, under the floor.., there were some seemingly casual art vases and sculptures in the temple. Hidden inside were activated mechanisms. Once the mechanisms were activated, all the wires in the temple would be charged. Once touched, they would become light bulbs!
In addition to these manual mechanisms, he had also designed a few passive mechanisms in the secret compartment. These mechanisms were located in unusual locations. Once someone tried to climb up from the window or the cliff behind the temple.., without waiting to enter the temple, they would trigger the traps and become the target of the power outpouring.

chapters.title: Chapter 669
chapters.content:
Chapter 669 – Chapter 659: Lurk
Buzz!
A patterned bee flew past the leaves in front of her.
Eleanor completely ignored it. She stuck her body tightly to the tree. The rough bark scratched her smooth skin, giving her an extremely uncomfortable feeling. However, she knew that she had to endure it, this was because there was a high possibility that the previous Saintess lived in the temple 300 meters away. If she discovered that she was here, it would not be as simple as feeling uncomfortable.
She had sneaked into the most heavily guarded Holy Mountain in the outer wall area for half an hour and had found the best observation angle. As long as she did not come within two hundred meters and did not have any killing intent.., she believed that even if Aisha really existed here, she would not be able to detect her existence. She had verified this many years ago when she sneaked into the Holy Maiden Peak.
“There is a total of… two people’s scents. One of them has the scent of a male’s sweat. According to the intelligence report, there has been a youth following her closely. This scent should be that youth’s.”Eleanor’s gaze swept over the temple, for a veteran expert like her, she would be able to detect anyone who looked at her from afar, “The other smell is a little similar to her. It should be her. However, there is some bloody smell mixed in with the smell of decay. It’s a little strange.”
She gently sniffed and picked up the smell coming from the temple in front of her. She was a little doubtful. She was already seventy percent sure that the other person in the temple was really Aisha, she did not die outside the wall like Hathaway said.
However, she understood Hathaway’s character. Seventy percent was clearly not enough to satisfy her. She could only wait until she verified it with her own eyes!
She waited for half an hour. Ten minutes ago, she saw a figure walking toward the window of the temple. It was the youth who was given to her in the information. He had black hair and stood alone by the window, he was holding a roll of paper in his mouth. He lit it up and breathed in and out smoke.
When the smoke came out, it immediately made her feel nauseous. The smell was pungent and unpleasant. However, she saw that the youth did not seem to care about the smell. He inhaled and exhaled the smoke that gave off a strange smell, his face did not look like he was enjoying it, nor did it look like he was rejecting it. He seemed to be thinking about something.
She looked at the corner of the window but did not see Aisha. She was a little disappointed, but she thought to herself that with Aisha’s mysophobia, it was already very kind of her to be able to tolerate the boy to create such a strange smell under the same roof, it was already very merciful.
Time passed quickly, and in the blink of an eye, it was lunchtime.
She had been waiting for this moment. She saw the boy who frequently entered the temple, dressed in the Pope’s robe, bringing his attendants into the hall. Among the food covered by the lid, she smelled a fragrant smell, at the same time, she also smelled the pungent smell of blood. It was obviously raw meat! And it was the smell of raw beef. There was a hint of the smell of beef.
She frowned slightly. This raw beef was most likely cooked beef that was only slightly fried. It should be eaten by the young man. As for Aisha, she had never liked to see fresh blood. The food she ate was usually eighty percent cooked.
Not long after, lunch ended, and the servants left with their cutlery.
Eleanor continued to wait for a while, but still did not see anyone coming out. She could not help but feel depressed. Could it be that Aisha and the youth planned to stay inside for the whole day, and did not even know to come out to exercise?
When it was around three o’clock in the afternoon, there was still no movement inside. She felt depressed and quietly descended from the tree. A few strange limbs slowly grew out of her chest and quickly dived into the ground. This was her magic marks ability.
After she dived into the ground, her eyes were still open. However, her normal eyes had turned completely white, as if she had rolled her eyes. In her eyes, although there was no light source, the surroundings were not pitch black, moreover, the crowded sand and stones around did not damage her eyes. If one looked carefully, they would find that there was a layer of transparent crystal-like material outside her eyes, protecting them.
She listened quietly. Her perception spread along the soil like spider silk, extending straight to the bottom of the temple. The soil under the temple was like a dark lake, as quiet as a mirror, at this moment, in the middle of the Dark Lake, there were some ripples. In the materialization of her auditory perception, there were two feet at the ripples. The feet did not move when they stepped on the ground, but the limbs on the feet, all the way to the chest, had hearts beating. This weak beating transmitted a faint sound, it was transmitted to the ground through the soles of the feet and then into her ears.
Other than her super sense of smell, which could distinguish hundreds of thousands of smells, her hearing was the strongest weapon.
“The heartbeat rate is stable, and there is only one person’s movement…”Eleanor’s white eyes stared unblinkingly at the soil in front of her, which seemed a little terrifying. She listened even more attentively, the scent that she had smelled earlier was clearly two people’s. Why was there only one person’s movement? Could it be that she had already sensed her existence, so she had covered up her movement?
But even if she had to cover it up, how could she cover it up? Could it be that she was soaring in the Divine Hall?
After listening carefully for a long time, there was still no movement from the second person. The doubt in her heart slowly turned into fear. Could it be that she was such an existence, yet she could not sense her?
Was this her new ability?
She could not think of an answer. After hesitating for a long time, she gritted her teeth. A few strange limbs grew out from under her body and quickly pierced through the soil, pushing her deeper into the ground. After diving more than a hundred meters underground, she carefully approached the divine hall in front of her.
After a moment, she came to the bottom of the Divine Hall, and then continued to climb forward for a distance before stopping.
“A meter further is the cliff. Once I go out, I might expose my scent. It’s Too Close.”Her eyes flashed and she smiled bitterly in her heart. It was really a tough job.
Fortunately, she was prepared. She immediately took out a thin black pipe from her armor, poked the soil, and stretched it out.
When she reached out, she opened her mouth and took a mouthful of soil. She used her teeth and lips to hold the soil, then blew a breath into the pipe. The force of the breath was strong, forcing the soil out of the pipe, because of the soil in her mouth, her breath was full of the smell of soil. It was not easy to be suspicious, and most people would think that it was the mountain wind that blew.
After the tube was connected, she took out a thin wire and a lens the size of a finger cap. She put a thin wire through a small needle hole on the lens and tied it. Then she stuffed the lens into the thin tube and blew it out of the tube, exposing it on the cliff, then, she gently adjusted the thin wire and pulled the lens back into a very tiny “V”-shaped indentation at the mouth of the tube, making the lens tilt up fifty degrees.
From this angle, she could just see the situation on the cliff from the tube. This was her favorite observation method for many years. There were not many materials, but it was portable, hidden, and could be casually thrown away without being noticed.
After finishing the observation tool, she took out a second thin tube and carefully stuck it out of the soil, exposing it outside the cliff. The tube had a curved curve, and she took out a small red nail that she had prepared with her, she stuffed it into the tube. At the end of the red nail was a glass tube device, which was her unique design. After adjusting the angle of the red nail in the tube, she took a deep breath from the surrounding soil and blew it out.
The Red Spike shot out rapidly, following the arc of the tube towards the top of the cliff. It nailed onto the cliff that was dozens of meters high, making very little noise.
After doing all this, she began to wait quietly.
Not long after, there was a rustling sound on the cliff. Some wriggling poisonous snakes and small poisonous lizards climbed up the steep cliff one after another. These poisonous insects crawled towards the red spike as if they were summoned.
Eleanor looked through the thin tube and waited attentively.
She knew that the people in the temple would definitely notice the movement and come over to observe.

chapters.title: Chapter 670
chapters.content:
Chapter 670 – Chapter 660: First Watch
“These materials should be transported as fast as possible.”
Dudian handed the list of materials to Sergei, he looked at Sergei: “In addition, send five of the best alchemists from the dark church. Especially the one who wrote the ‘mechanical production’book.”
“Yes, young master. I will go now.”Sergei respectfully said as he took the list of materials. He had obtained the highest pass of the dark church. He could go anywhere in the 12th region, moreover the elders of the 12th region recognized him so it was very convenient for him to do things.
Dudian was about to continue to prepare the next item when he heard rustling sounds coming from the window of the back hall. Although it was very weak but it couldn’t escape his ears, it seemed that it was caused by a large number of reptiles.
His eyes flashed as he looked at Neuss: “Get Someone to check the back hall.”
Neuss also heard the sound coming from outside the back hall: “Young Master, I’ll go and check.”
Dudian looked at him.
Neuss was startled as he saw Dudian’s eyes. He immediately knew that the situation was unusual: “I understand, young master.”He left the temple and quickly took back a paladin, he said, “Go to the back hall and check it out.”
The Holy Knight was trembling with fear and answered respectfully. He quickly walked to the back of the temple and looked over. When he saw this, he was immediately shocked. He saw a large number of poisonous creatures crawling over the cliff behind him. They were densely packed. These poisonous creatures seemed to have also seen him and immediately crawled toward him as if they had a target. One of them, a fist-sized toad-like creature that was green all over, suddenly jumped up and jumped toward his face.
He was so scared that he broke out in a cold sweat. He hurriedly retreated away from the window and instinctively drew his sword to block, but only when he clenched his hand did he remember that his sword had been left outside when he entered the Divine Hall.
He hurriedly retreated from the back hall. As soon as he came out, he saw Noyce waiting by the curtain. He hurriedly said, “Sir, there are many poisonous insects crawling up from behind. I’ll go and get someone to clean them up.”
“Poisonous insects?”Neuss was startled. He looked at dudian: “Go back and wait in the hall. There is no hurry to call people.”
“Yes, sir.”The Holy Knight bowed and ran out of the hall.
Neuss quickly went back to Dudian’s side. Dudian asked: “It has been quiet in the back. How come there are poisonous insects?”
Neuss was surprised: “Master, what do you mean?”
“Recently we have been sitting in this position and many people are jealous of us. I think it is a prank by some people.”Dudian looked at him. There was a trace of light in the depths of his eyes, he said: “Get Someone to clean the place and sprinkle some insect repellent powder on the cliff. It will prevent such things from happening in the future.”
“Yes, Master.”
Neuss was about to leave but was stopped by Dudian: “Take these things with you. They will disturb my peace and quiet. Come with me to the side hall.”Dudian’s eyes were fixed on him, he handed the paper and pen to Neuss.
Neuss felt Dudian’s eyes fixed on him. He looked up at dudian. He saw Dudian’s eyes flash for a moment.
Neuss was startled for a moment but quickly recovered. He was a bit surprised. was someone spying on him? Otherwise, what did Dudian mean by this look?
Although he didn’t understand but he didn’t show it. After all, he had been in Thorn Flower Prison. He had the ability to cover up. He took the pen and ink and led the way out of the hall.
Dudian shook the bell and led Aisha out of the hall.
“One, two, three…”Eleanor’s ears were close to the soil, so she could hear the conversation clearly. Although the sound was transmitted in the air, it was not close to the ground, so it was easy to be blocked, but don’t forget that the sound would spread to the ground through the bones of the human body. But the sound was very weak. Ordinary people couldn’t hear it, but she could hear it clearly.
She felt a trace of fear and nervousness when Dudian stopped the attendant from coming over to check. She didn’t expect the teenager to react so quickly and be so cautious! However, this situation was also within her expectations. The poisonous insects would climb into the temple and they would have to clean up. At the same time, she would be able to find the location of the person suspected to be Aisha.
At this moment, the youth did not choose to clean it up himself but left the temple. This made her feel relieved. At the same time, she was a little puzzled. The youth seemed to be very cautious. Why would he mistake these poisonous insects for an attack method from the outer wall? Was it because this method was too low? Or was it because he had too many enemies in the outer wall? Although she was puzzled, her attention soon followed the sound of footsteps leaving.
“This sound of footsteps…”her attention fell on the third moving footsteps, and the joy in her heart quickly turned into surprise. From the images transmitted from her auditory senses.., the other two footsteps allowed her to clearly picture the appearance of two figures walking. However, the third footsteps were like a ghost, and she could only see the sound of two feet landing on the ground.
In addition, there was no heartbeat. There was no sound of internal organs shaking or stomach fluid flowing. If she had to describe it, it was like a wooden man!
She hesitated for a moment but decided to follow and observe again.
The strange limbs under her abdomen quickly played with the soil. They sneaked behind dudian and swam in the direction of the side hall. They were like fish in the sea.
At this time, she heard the people from the top had entered the next hall. The teenager said: “Close the curtains.”
Soon, the sound of the curtains was heard.
“Young master, close the curtains.”
“Come here, I have something to say to you.”
“Yes, Young Master.”
“These poisonous insects should not be from the outer wall but from the inner wall.”The teenager pulled out a chair and sat down.
Eleanor’s heart tightened when she heard this. At the same time, her previous doubts were immediately cleared. It seemed that this little brat had deliberately deceived her earlier. He thought that while she had released the poisonous insects, he was still peeping at her from afar, so he had kept his words, after all, lip reading was not a difficult thing, especially for those who were investigating and assassinating. However, the Little Brat was still a little brat after all. He had been careless. He did not know that she was investigating from underground!
Thinking of this, she felt a trace of pride and contempt in her heart, so she listened more carefully.
“The people from the inner wall did it?”The youth’s attendant said in surprise, “Could it be that the monastery sent people over again? “The expert they sent last time was killed by you, young master. You said that if they sent people again, they would definitely be very powerful characters. Now, we…”
“Shh, Keep Your Voice Down.”The teenager reminded him, at the same time, he said: “It is possible that they are from the military. I didn’t expect the inner wall to act so quickly. It is time for us to prepare to wipe out the entire inner wall. My Plan has been completed. Go and inform them to start the plan. The code name of the plan is…”
“Master, your voice is too soft. I Can’t hear you clearly.”
“Be careful. The wall has ears. Come closer.”
Eleanor slightly frowned. She didn’t understand what the code name of the teenager was. She saw that Dudian was going to repeat it. She immediately swam up more than ten meters. Her goal was to find out if Aisha was here, but the teenager’s plan was to destroy the entire inner wall. It sounded like he was bragging! Although she did not believe that this young man could do it, she was still extremely curious. After all, with such a large target, even if he could not wipe out the entire inner wall region, it would most likely have a very strong destructive power.
“Have you memorized it?”The young man said.
Hearing this, Eleanor was slightly stunned. He had already finished speaking? She did not even hear it clearly!
“Young Master, your voice is really too soft. Why Don’t you write it down?”The attendant said.
“Sure.”
The sound of the young man picking up a pen was heard, followed by a slight rustling sound.
Eleanor listened carefully to the sound, trying to decipher the content of the young man’s writing through his strokes. However, she was soon stunned by what she heard. This was because the strokes of the young man’s writing were completely out of order. In other words, he was saying a paragraph.., he was writing one stroke per word, and the strokes were not arranged in order. In this way, even if she listened to it a hundred times, she would not be able to understand what the young man was writing.
“Young master, I will remember it.”
“Take this token with you. Only when they see this will they carry out the plan. Alright, go. Go through the secret passage.”
“Yes, Young Master.”
Eleanor heard the footsteps of the servant become heavier. The sound of the servant’s footsteps was louder than before. It meant that the weight on his body had increased. Moreover, it was combined with the “Token”that Dudian mentioned. Obviously, the servant was carrying this item.
She hesitated in her heart. Should she continue to stay here to investigate Aisha’s matter or go and see what the plan was?
After thinking for a while, she decided to go and see the plan first. Her intuition told her that she wouldn’t be able to identify Aisha’s authenticity in a short time. If she could find out about the plan, she would have an explanation when she went back.
After all, Hathaway had asked her to come over to verify whether the monastery’s story was true. From the current situation, although she couldn’t confirm that this person was Aisha, she could at least confirm.., the matter of the monastery’s pioneer being killed was true. There was a pioneer level powerhouse here!
Moreover, she had already seen the appearance of this youth. He was the person Hathaway was looking for. Completing this, her mission could be considered a success. If she could find out about this plan and make use of it, it could be considered a great merit!
Thinking of this, she immediately followed the footsteps of the attendant.
Soon, the attendant followed the secret passage down and got closer to her.
She wasn’t in a hurry to act. After waiting for a moment, the attendant followed the secret passage towards St. Mark’s square outside, as if he wanted to leave from there. And that place was already over a thousand meters away from the direction of the temple. Moreover, it was in the secret passage fifty meters underground. She believed that if she acted here, she wouldn’t be noticed by ‘Aisha’in the temple.
Whoosh!
She broke out of the ground without hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 671
chapters.content:
Chapter 671 – Chapter 661: Battle Of The Holy Mountain [ Second Update ]
Bang!
Noyce heard the sound coming from inside the secret passage wall and was shocked. He quickly turned his head and saw a terrifying scene. He saw a woman whose body was as ferocious as a reptile rushing out from the stone wall. Her face was filled with killing intent.
“So Fast!”When Noyce saw the speed at which she pounced on him, his vision blurred. A feeling of death that he had never felt before enveloped his entire body. His entire body felt cold, but in the next moment, he felt his body become lighter, then, there was a loud bang, and the flying gravel hit his face. He quickly looked up and immediately saw the sunlight shining on him. The tunnel beside the rock wall was actually pierced through!
He looked out of the tunnel in a daze. At that moment, there were two slender figures tightly entangled together.
“It’s you, it’s really you!”Eleanor looked at Aisha in front of her in horror. Her mind was buzzing. She did not expect that she would really see her with her own eyes again, and at such a close distance!
The moment she broke out of the ground, she saw the servant carrying something wrapped in a black cloth. She knew that it was the token that the youth had mentioned, but she did not expect that the token was Aisha herself!
Roar!
Aisha’s face was full of malevolence. Her sharp nails grabbed Eleanor’s shoulder tightly and bit towards her face.
Eleanor looked at her malevolent face. She could not believe that this was really the invincible Aisha that she had seen before. That beautiful face that was always calm and had a faint smile on it was now so malevolent and bloodthirsty! She did not dare to delay. She instantly activated all her magic marks ability. The Witcher device hidden in the armor on her back trembled slightly. It instantly pierced into her body and merged with her body!
Kacha!
A layer of viscous black ink rushed out from the pores of her skin. It was as thick as oil. It quickly solidified and turned into a smooth pitch-black shell. At the same time, a few sharp barbs grew out from the spine of her back, the strange limbs on her abdomen seemed to have completely extended out. They were two to three meters long. Her face was also covered by a black substance. Her silky hair had long disappeared and turned into a black, forked sharp blade. There were green and yellow spots of light in her pupils, the vision she saw was completely different from before.
This was the complete form when she activated her magic marks. It was ferocious, ugly, and nauseating. However, it had super power!
“Hiss!”!
She shouted angrily, but her voice had already changed. She let out a venomous lizard-like hiss. A few strange limbs on her abdomen suddenly pushed forward and hit Aisha’s chest. With a bang, she instantly forced Aisha’s body back, at the same time, she pulled away.
At this time, she noticed that Aisha’s eyes in front of her were completely black, like two deep pools. She was shocked. She had seen such evil eyes outside the giant wall before. They were on the Corpse King!
She suddenly thought of what Hathaway said. Could it be that Aisha was infected by the corpse king?
She felt a chill in her heart. She hurriedly looked at the place where her shoulder was scratched. Fortunately, she reacted in time and the enchanted shell protected her body from being scratched.
She knew that the strength of the virus moving in the corpse king’s body was definitely not something that the antibodies in her body could kill, especially a corpse king at Aisha’s level.
“Roar!”Aisha roared and pounced again. This time, she was even faster.
Eleanor’s face changed. She did not dare to stay any longer and turned around to run. She was no match for Aisha at all, especially now that Aisha had turned into a corpse. Although turning into a corpse would cause her brain to degenerate and her battle consciousness to be greatly reduced, her physique after turning into a corpse was several times stronger than before! She couldn’t imagine that with Aisha’s previous body, who would be able to stop her after she turned into a corpse?
She just wanted to escape and tell the terrible news to Hathaway and the Dragon Clan!
[ before Eleanor’s attack ]
Dudian sat quietly in the temple. His eyes were staring at the ground in front of him. His pupils shrank into a black dot. The soil under the floor passed through the middle layer of his x-ray vision. He could see all kinds of buried rocks.., and cables. In the deeper part of the temple, there was a woman who didn’t emit any heat. She was swimming at high speed along the place where Noyce had left.
After leaving the temple about 500 meters away, he immediately got up and chased after her.
A few seconds later, there was a roar outside the square. Dudian saw Aisha and Eleanor rush out from the secret passage.
He immediately chased after them.
At this time, Eleanor pushed Aisha away from the battlefield and ran away without saying a word.
Suddenly, the bell rang.
Dudian stood on the high slope outside the secret passage and shook the bell in his hand. The sound clearly entered Aisha’s ears. He was relieved. Fortunately, he came in time. If he was one step late, he might have let this person slip away.
Hearing the bell, Eleanor hurriedly glanced at it. She saw that the little devil in the temple had actually appeared here. Her expression changed slightly. She immediately knew that her whereabouts had long been exposed. The words that the youth had spoken to the attendant earlier.., the purpose was just to lure her out!
Damn it! She was angry and angry, but at this moment, she did not have the time to kill this youth. She could only endure it.
Aisha who was chasing after her heard the bell. Her body slightly trembled and stopped.
“Roar!”She suddenly looked up to the sky and let out a long roar. The sound of bones cracking could be heard. The clothes on her back were torn and two huge pieces of flesh protruded out. These pieces of flesh quickly formed two dark red dragon wings, the flesh membrane on the surface was still stained with blood. It was extremely ferocious. It was completely different from the dragon wings that she used to cover the feathers. Instead, it looked like the dragon wings that Hathaway used.
Dudian knew that at this moment she was using the magic marks in her body to drive the changes. Without the help of the blood baron, her strength would be greatly reduced. But even so, it was not to be underestimated. She was even stronger than Hathaway!
Eleanor heard the roar behind her. She hurriedly glanced at it and her face changed. She hurriedly waved the strange limbs in front of her chest and dug into the soil. She could not fly, so she could only burrow into the soil to hide.
Fortunately, this ability was more survivable than flying. After all, she could still be shot down while flying in the sky. However, it was very difficult to deal with her in the soil.
Roar!
Aisha’s transformation ended very quickly. When the change in the soles of her feet had just ended, she rushed out impatiently. The speed of the dragon wings made the distance of several hundred meters between Eleanor and Aisha disappear instantly. However, Eleanor’s reaction was fast enough. A second before Aisha caught up to her, she burrowed into the soil and rushed straight down.
There was no cave outside the soil that she burrowed into. At the same time she burrowed into the ground, she covered the passage that she passed through. This was the terrifying part of her ability.
Aisha roared and raised her scaled fist to smash the ground. With a bang, the ground cracked as if thousands of tons of stones had smashed into the ground, dudian could feel the ground shaking as he stood hundreds of meters away. He was surprised and anxious. He didn’t know if she could catch this powerful assassin.

chapters.title: Chapter 672
chapters.content:
Chapter 672 – Chapter 662: Berserk Aisha [ First Watch ]
Eleanor, who had burrowed into the soil, swam to the depths at full speed. She was frantically running for her life. Suddenly, a loud rumble came from her back. It was as if an entire mountain had suddenly pressed down on her back. It was so heavy that it was beyond her imagination. She spat out a mouthful of blood, the weird limbs that were crawling under her abdomen were instantly pressed down to the point that they could not move. One of the limbs was instantly broken under the impact of the solid soil that was suddenly pressed down. Fresh blood flowed out and seeped into the soil.
She was terrified. This Aisha’s strength was even more terrifying than she had imagined. was this really the strength of a pioneer? !
She could not care less about the pain. She hurriedly twisted the weird limbs and pushed away the soil that was somewhat compressed again. She continued to drill down crazily. Life and death were in the blink of an eye!
“Roar! !”Aisha’s pitch-black eyes revealed a ferocious fury, as if enraged by her prey’s escape, she raised her head and roared. The two giant dragon wings on her back that were covered with blood threads suddenly twisted. The tendons on them wriggled like worms, as if there were some wriggling poisonous snakes wrapped within the flesh membrane, in the next moment, these wriggling tendons suddenly extended out and rapidly extended along the edges of the dragon wings. They actually turned into blood-red spikes that drew an arc in the air and suddenly stabbed into the ground beneath her feet, seven or eight blood-red spikes pierced into the soil.
“What’s that sound? !”Eleanor dug into the soil, suddenly, she heard a sharp sound of breaking through the soil behind her. Her heart was aghast, and she could not help but turn back to look. Judging from the number of sounds, there were eight or nine of them. It should not be Aisha chasing after her.., moreover, her magic marks of the Magic Dragon did not have the ability to drill into the ground.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The piercing sound was extremely fast. It quickly approached Eleanor. Although she was good at burrowing into the ground, her huge body burrowed into the ground. It was inevitable that her speed would slow down.
“Not good!”Eleanor suddenly turned around. Her back was facing the ground. The strange limbs under her abdomen and the sharp claws on her arms that were covered in black carapace were protecting her chest. She nervously looked at the sharp sound of friction that was rapidly approaching, the sound instantly arrived in front of her and broke through the soil in front of her. It was a blood-red sharp object. Its surface was covered with blood threads, and there were blood vessels and green tendons inside. It was extremely ferocious.
Eleanor was shocked and hurriedly raised her hand to catch it.
There were a few splashing sounds. The rest of the sharp friction sounds instantly arrived. They pierced through the soil almost at the same time and attacked from both sides of her body.
Eleanor had just raised her hand to block the blood-red long spike that was aimed at her face when the blood-red spike pierced through her waist, side, and legs. In an instant, she was bleeding non-stop. The intense pain made her feel as if her body was being torn apart, she could not help but Groan in pain. A layer of sharp blade instantly appeared on the inner side of the strange limb on her abdomen and slashed at the blood-red long spike.
With a few poof sounds, the strange limb on her abdomen cut off the blood-red long spike. Before she could heave a sigh of relief, she saw a large amount of blood spurting out from the inside of the blood-red long spike that had been cut off. At the same time, the blood-red long spike actually extended and regenerated.
The regenerated blood-red long spike did not wait for Eleanor’s reaction. It quickly wrapped around her body and tightly strangled her like a dumpling. At the same time, it quickly contracted and pulled her body towards the surface of the ground.
However, because there was no technique to break through the soil, the blood-red spike pulled her to the ground by force. The previously solid and heavy soil squeezed Eleanor’s body so hard that she could not move.
“Roar!”Aisha growled. Her dragon wings suddenly flapped, and the blood-red spike that suddenly appeared from the edge of the wings quickly retracted. At the same time, the soil in front of her feet loosened. As she growled, the ground suddenly cracked, with a bang, a huge monster that looked like a spider and a lobster was pulled out from the soil. It was the demonized Eleanor.
The blood-red long spike was like an arm. It lifted Eleanor high up and smashed her hard on the ground.
Aisha exerted force with her feet and suddenly rushed over. She threw Eleanor, who was unable to fight back from the fall, onto the ground. She opened her mouth and bit hard on one of the monster limbs on her chest. Her sharp teeth instantly bit through the black shell on the surface of the monster limb, blood and flesh oozed out from it. She crazily bit. The blood-red thorns on the dragon wings were like seven or eight poisonous snakes. They wrapped around Eleanor’s body more and more tightly. One of them wrapped around her neck and made Eleanor feel suffocated.
Dudian who was on the high slope in the distance was relieved when he saw Aisha pulling out the attacker from the soil. He quickly chased after her. When he saw that Aisha had completely suppressed the other party, he quickly raised his hand and shook the bell, he issued an order to stop the attack.
Aisha’s body stiffened when she heard the bell. However, her claws and dragon wings trembled violently. It seemed that she was trying to break free from some invisible comfort. At the same time, it seemed that she was trying to stop her killing instinct.
Dean was surprised and nervous when he saw her change. He told Aisha to put away her demonized state. In addition to the fact that it was too frightening, there was also the fact that after she entered this state.., her desire to kill and thirst for blood would increase. It would be more difficult to control her. So she would only release her full strength when she had no other choice.
Haisha’s throat made a “Gurgle”sound like a blade stirring in her throat. She looked up at Dean. Dean’s figure was reflected in her dark eyes. She looked at him ferociously, one second passed. Two seconds and three seconds passed. The trembling on her body gradually calmed down until she was completely still. It was as if she was frozen by time.
Dean was relieved. He immediately activated the semi-limiter state. White bones rushed out of his body to protect his vital points. He jumped in front of Haisha and looked at the purple-red face of the attacker who was strangled by her demonized body, he found out that it was a woman. Moreover, judging from her skills, she should be a pioneer! He didn’t expect that the inner wall would send another pioneer. Moreover, from the behavior of this pioneer, it seemed that she didn’t want to attack him but was here to investigate information.
After all, if it was an attack, he wouldn’t attract poisonous insects to alert the enemy.
Moreover, if it was him who had lost a pioneer, he wouldn’t send another pioneer to attack. At least two to three more would be needed to ensure zero loss of the target!
He squatted in front of the female pioneer and suddenly punched her temple. Although it was protected by the black shell, but through X-ray vision, it was still the weakest part of her skull.
As the dark force entered, the female Pioneer’s eyes were stunned and she fainted.
Dudian looked at her flushed face and immediately shook the bell.
Haisha heard the sound and the dragon wings on her back contracted slightly. The blood red thorns on her back shrank back into the dragon wings. Finally, the dragon wings shrank back into her body. The scales covering her body also disappeared, the outermost layer of scales lost its luster and became dry and hard. They fell down like tree bark and fell all over the ground.
Dudian looked at her. At the moment, her clothes were damaged because of the battle. Her legs and arms that had lost the scales were as white as jade. She looked very beautiful. He glanced at the attendants who had rushed over. He took off his coat and put it on her shoulder. He covered her smooth back and took off his robe to tie around her waist.
He waved to Neuss who was far away.
Neuss rushed over. He looked at the messy battlefield which had left several huge pits. He asked Dudian: “Master, Are You Alright?”
Dudian immediately said: “Take this woman with you. Prepare the largest amount of anesthetic for her.”
Neuss looked at the unconscious attacker. He was a bit scared as he saw the ferocious body of the attacker. He had seen some hunters with strange beast limbs because of magic marks, but none of them had such large scale beast transformation. Except for the face and the body, there was almost no other human shadow. was this really considered as a human?
Such a thought flashed through his mind. He endured the fear and disgust and picked her up.
Dudian put away the semi-limiter state, picked up Aisha and returned to the square. He said to Barton who was attracted by the noise: “Immediately seal the scene and write down all the witnesses. Don’t tell anyone about this.”

chapters.title: Chapter 673
chapters.content:
Chapter 673 – Chapter 663: Human Bauhinia [ Second Watch ]
“I, I know.”Barton was a bit panicked and subconsciously agreed. When he wanted to ask if Dudian was injured, he found that Dudian had already left with Aisha. His eyes turned to the battlefield behind him and saw Neuss holding a strange humanoid monster. The strange limbs of the humanoid monster made him instinctively afraid and disgusted.
“I’ll go first.”Neuss said in a hurry as he passed by Barton.
Barton nodded as he looked at Neuss’back. He slowly withdrew his eyes and came to the previous battlefield. He was shocked as he saw a shocking crater. If he didn’t see it with his own eyes.., he didn’t dare to imagine that this was the damage caused by human power. was the one Neuss was carrying a human?
He thought of Dudian’s order and immediately called the Knight in charge of the square to pass down the order.
Dudian had already carried Aisha into the temple. He looked at Neuss who was following him. He told him to throw the assassin on the ground and get the anesthetic.
After Neuss left Dudian immediately found the weapons rack in the temple. He took out some swords and blades. He looked at the emergency medicine rack and found some drugs, this concept was universal in any country in the world. There were many medicines made in this era that were broken down by poisons. For example, if there was too much of an anesthetic.., an ordinary person would die!
There were many medicines that could relieve pain and stop bleeding.
Dudian took out a few pieces of medicine. He found a container and used it to make powder. He smeared it on the dagger and sword. He went to the unconscious female assassin and looked for the weak structure under her carapace. Soon he found a few targets, he clenched the dagger and stabbed through a hair-thin crack on the inside of her throat. Blood oozed out from the crack.
At the same time, Eleanor woke up from her coma. The first thing she saw when she opened her eyes was a teenager sitting on top of her.
Dudian didn’t panic when he saw her wake up. He couldn’t tell how long it would take for her to wake up when he knocked her out. He didn’t wait for Neuss to get the anesthetic so that she wouldn’t wake up first.
“Don’t move!”Dudian said quickly, “My hand will cut off your neck if it quivers. Moreover, her highness Aisha will also kill you!”The other party was a pioneer. He guessed that she must recognize Aisha, therefore, he might be able to subdue her by moving her out.
Eleanor’s face changed when she heard Dudian’s words. She thought of Aisha who had defeated her earlier. She quickly glanced around and saw the figure sitting on the chair next to her. It was Aisha.
Her heart tightened as she suppressed her killing intent. She coldly stared at Dudian, she said: “Do you want to hold me hostage? You? Although I don’t know what is going on with her Highness Aisha. But if I’m not wrong, she is dead? She is just a zombie now. I just don’t know why she won’t attack you.”
“Shut up!”Dudian suddenly shouted and slapped her face.
Eleanor was stunned. Although she didn’t feel much pain because of the black shell covering her face, but she didn’t expect that her words would anger this teenager. Moreover, the latter’s courage was unbelievable! When had she been slapped in the face? !
“She isn’t dead! She Won’t Die!”Dudian’s face was full of malevolence, there was even a trace of distortion in his eyes. There was a frightening cold light flashing in his eyes. He looked straight into her eyes as if he wanted to make her yield and agree with his words, “She is not an undead. Don’t let me hear you insult her again. Otherwise, I will make your life worse than death! !”
Eleanor was so angry that her body trembled slightly. She completely ignored Dudian’s words. Her fingers clenched and loosened, then clenched again. The anger in her heart surged several times. In the end, she resisted it, it was not because of the teenager’s threat. It was because if Aisha attacked, she would be killed immediately in her current state!
(a pariah from the outer wall can not be compared to my life.)
She silently comforted and digested the anger in her heart.
Dudian saw that she was silent. The anger in her brain gradually cleared up. He thought of the previous loss of control. His heart was a little nervous. However, more than that, it was killing intent and anger. He had secretly decided.., no matter how cooperative she was, he would torture her to death!
Neuss came over from outside the temple. He was startled as he saw Dudian riding on Eleanor’s body. He didn’t expect that the terrifying woman would wake up. However it seemed that Dudian had controlled the situation, he carefully stepped forward and said: “Master, the thing is here.”He didn’t directly say the anesthetic as he was afraid that it would stimulate the female monster.
Dudian stared at Eleanor and said to Neuss: “Inject it into her.”
Eleanor was shocked: “What are you going to do? Inject what? !”
Dudian coldly said: “It’s just a little analgesic so don’t be so emotional.”
Eleanor wouldn’t believe his nonsense. There was anger and doubt in her heart. If she resisted, not to mention that Aisha would take action, but the teenager alone could kill her. She knew that Dudian was right. As long as the dagger in his hand quivered a little, it would cut the blood vessels in her throat. Once it was cut, with her self-healing ability, she would bleed to death before it healed! Moreover, Aisha was watching from the side. She might not be able to get timely treatment. She would definitely die!
She gritted her teeth and decided to endure it.
She didn’t know that her hesitation made her regret endlessly!
Neuss saw that she didn’t resist. He immediately found a part of her body and injected the anesthetic into it.
As the anesthetic was injected, Eleanor suddenly felt that the part that was injected gradually lost consciousness as if it was stiff. She immediately knew that this wasn’t the analgesic that Dean said. It was a kind of poison that made her lose the ability to fight! However, she had expected this. She had considered the possibility of becoming a prisoner when she chose to endure! Becoming a prisoner wasn’t the worst outcome for her. First of all, she was sure that the other party wouldn’t kill her easily. Otherwise, they would directly attack her. So, during the time she was a prisoner.., there were many opportunities for her to escape. As long as the other party was a bit careless or exposed a flaw!
Moreover, even if she couldn’t escape and was imprisoned all the time, she believed that Hathaway would know the answer she wanted if she didn’t go back. Then she would come to the outer wall to fight with Aisha and save her.
No matter what, it was better than being killed on the spot.
Dudian was relieved to see her surrender. Although her resistance could directly kill her, but it wasn’t worth it. Living was more valuable than dying! Of course, there were some living people who couldn’t even compare to a dead person’s leg hair.
Dudian asked Neuss to get rope to tie Eleanor’s body.
Eleanor coldly looked at dudian: “If you want to ask something from my mouth then you are making a big mistake.”
“I have always been tolerant towards captives. You should sleep first.”Dudian took another tube of anesthetic and injected it into her throat. The anesthetic effect quickly flowed into her brain through the blood vessels.
Eleanor felt that her brain was a bit stiff. Her vision gradually blurred.
She closed her eyes and pretended to be unconscious. She slowly fell asleep.
Dudian asked Neuss to take more. The amount of anesthetic alone might not be enough to kill a pioneer.
Soon, a large amount of anesthetic was sent into the temple. Dudian injected it into every part of her body. He took out the chains and tied all of her demonized limbs in a weak position. Even if she had the strength of a pioneer it would be difficult for her to fully display her strength.
Neuss looked at dudian and asked: “Master, should we lock her up now?”
“Lock her up?”Dudian shook his head: “Go and get my weapon.”
Neuss was startled as he knew which weapon Dudian was talking about. He ran back to the temple after a moment. He was holding the weapon that Dudian had forged in the 9th region.
Dudian was holding the splitter’s sword. Although it was overlapping but it was extremely long and wide. He held the sword and aimed at the weakness of the woman’s abdomen.
Puff! A demonized body was cut off and blood spurted out.
Dudian looked at the woman and found that she was still unconscious. He knew that the anesthesia was completely effective so he immediately aimed at the second demonized limb.
A moment later, all of Eleanor’s demonized bodies were cut off, including her arms. Her legs were also cut off by Dudian. There was only a black armor covering her upper body.
Dudian sprinkled hemostatic powder to stop the bleeding so that she wouldn’t bleed to death. Through the ability of X-ray he could observe her heartbeat and see her state of life at any time.
Neuss looked at the bloody limbs scattered on the floor of the hall. It was like hell on Earth. There was a feeling of vomiting and inexplicable discomfort in his heart. This was the temple, the most sacred place.., but now it was like living hell!
Dudian wiped the sweat off his forehead after he cut off the woman’s body parts. He threw the knife to the side. He washed his hands in the basin and asked Neuss to get some hallucinogenic and nerve-weakening drugs, these drugs were commonly used in the dark church. The entire dark church was in his bag. Naturally, there were many rare high-level drugs refined by five-star alchemists and great potion masters in the side hall, the effects were extremely strong. Some of the fierce poisons, if taken directly, could even poison a pioneer to death.
Of course, the prerequisite was that this Pioneer’s magic marks ability was not good at detoxifying poison.

chapters.title: Chapter 674
chapters.content:
Chapter 674 – Chapter 664: Inquiring [ First Update ]
Dudian checked all kinds of drugs after Neuss took them. He carefully adjusted the dosage. If the dosage was too low then it would be difficult to take effect, he was afraid that he would directly inject the female pioneer who was extremely weak at the moment.
For the sake of safety, he first prepared a medium dosage and injected it into her body. He observed the changes in her vital features. Soon he saw that her heartbeat suddenly increased, then it quickly weakened and then began to beat rapidly. This was an abnormal reaction after the drug took effect. It would greatly consume the user’s lifespan, but at the same time, it would bring incomparable pleasure.
Dudian picked up the cold water and poured it on the female scavenger’s face.
The water splashed in all directions. Eleanor woke up from her stupor. She hurriedly looked up. Her pupils shrank and her face was full of horror. She saw that in front of her, except for the teenager, the ground under his feet was completely dyed red, the limbs covered in black carapace looked extremely familiar! She lowered her head to look, and was instantly stunned. Her arms had actually disappeared, and the parts below her knees had also disappeared. Only her naked body was left!
“No, no!”Her heart was filled with terror, and it was difficult for her to accept this fact. She had never thought that this delicate-looking youth in front of her would actually be so cruel and merciless! She thought that at most he would use drugs or instruments to lock her up. She didn’t expect that the other party would do such a thorough thing and directly cripple her body!
Her heart was full of regret. If she had known this would happen, she would have risked her life to kill this young man. At least she would have died together with him!
Dudian quietly looked at her. He saw her face change from shock to regret. She didn’t hide her killing intent, he said in a cold tone: “The change in mentality is quite fast. No wonder you are a pioneer. If it was an ordinary person, they would have fainted or burst into tears.”
Eleanor clenched her teeth and stared at Dudian angrily. She wanted to eat him with her eyes: “You will die a horrible death!”
“What a simple curse.”Dudian indifferently said: “Your Mistake is that you have underestimated me. You have overestimated yourself. If you had a bit of backbone then at least you would have died a quick death. But now it is too late.”
Eleanor was angry but she was an experienced pioneer after all. She wasn’t blinded by anger, “You want to extract information from my mouth. Don’t be delusional. I Won’t tell you. Even if I tell you, aren’t you afraid that I will tell you false information?”? “I advise you to let me go. I have no malice towards you. If you go too far, it will bring you a disaster!”
“Is this a threat or a plea?”Dudian stared at her: “Even if I let you go, you won’t live. Don’t you know that you are infected with poison?”
Eleanor sneered: “Don’t Scare Me!”
Dudian coldly said: “Have you forgotten that her highness Aisha Bit Your Body?”
Eleanor was shocked and her face changed.
She suddenly remembered that the demonized body in her abdomen had been bitten by Haisha. She was caught and trapped by Haisha. She didn’t think about this for a moment. Now that Dudian mentioned it, her whole body broke out in cold sweat! It must be known that Haisha’s form was clearly a corpse. Although the teenager didn’t admit it, she wouldn’t doubt her judgment! In other words, she was very likely to be infected with the corpse poison. Moreover, it was an ultra-strong corpse poison that could infect Haisha!
“It’s over…”her heart turned cold as despair appeared in her eyes.
Dudian’s heart sank when he saw the despair in her eyes. The reason why he said that was mainly to see her reaction. From her current reaction, it was clear that she was infected with the corpse poison, it meant that the worst case scenario was hopeless!
Even if he saw that his limbs were cut off, he wouldn’t be so desperate!
Could it be that he was infected by the zombie poison and there was nothing he could do?
Humans had been fighting against the undeads outside the giant wall for hundreds of years. Could it be that they couldn’t develop a drug that could cure the infection of the zombie poison? !
He clenched his fists. His heart was full of anger. He didn’t believe it!
He suddenly thought that maybe this woman’s status wasn’t high enough. Even if she knew that there was such a drug, she wouldn’t be able to get it. That was why she was in despair! It was also possible that her status was too low so she didn’t know the top secret!
(yes, it must be so!)
Dudian thought in his heart. He grabbed onto a life-saving straw in his mind. He took a deep breath and coldly stared at the female pioneer: “Do you think you have any hope to survive?”
Eleanor’s eyes looked at the air in front of her. Her thoughts were completely blank. She couldn’t hear what Dudian was saying. There was only endless fear in her mind. She had never thought that her life would suddenly come to an end, what kind of feeling was this? She thought that she still had a lot of things to do. She hadn’t enjoyed many beautiful days.
Suddenly, there was a light in her eyes.
Dudian’s heart skipped a beat when he saw the sudden burst of light. The next moment, he was hit by Eleanor’s question, “How long have I been in a coma? How long has it been since you caught me? !”She looked at Dudian impatiently, her eyes were full of expectation.
Dudian’s mood turned cold as he looked at her eyes which were full of hope. There was a trace of death in his eyes, he expressionlessly said: “It has been about half an hour since the infection. With your physique, you should be able to hold on for an hour. You have half an hour left to think. Do you have any last words?”
Eleanor’s heart turned cold as she heard Dudian’s words. It was as if an ice cube was stuck to her body.
She was stunned for a moment: “I should have killed you if I had known earlier. I would have dared to fight you!”
“As long as you can tell me your identity and the information about the forces behind you, I will release you immediately.”Dudian was still holding a glimmer of hope as he quietly looked at her.
Eleanor laughed and looked at him with ridicule, “You can forget about getting any information! I am hopeless. I will wait for You in Hell. I will always look up to you. When you fall, I will pull you into the Endless Abyss!”Her voice was full of resentment, however, there was a desperate smile on her face. Neuss shivered as he looked at her.
Dudian’s heart sank. The answer made him angry. He grabbed her throat, “You are too low-level! You are too low-level! You are just a small soldier sent to scout the situation. You are a piece of trash! Why didn’t they send a smarter person! Why didn’t they send a stronger person! !”
Eleanor grinned. Her teeth suddenly rose and became extremely sharp. She bit the back of Dudian’s hand and tore off a piece of skin.
She chewed twice and spat to the side. She laughed: “You are done for this time. You are proud and arrogant. You are going to be infected!”
Neuss saw her sudden attack and looked at Dudian’s bloody hand: “Master, Are You Alright?”
Dudian looked at her hysterical laughter. The anger on his face slowly calmed down. After she finished laughing he slowly said: “Do you really think so?”
Eleanor looked at Dudian’s calm expression. The smile on her face disappeared. She thought that it might be Dudian who was trying to calm down. However, she soon noticed that.., dudian’s heartbeat was still calm. There was no fluctuation. In other words, there was no tension in his heart! It was impossible. No matter how shrewd one was, they wouldn’t be so calm in the case of death!
She suddenly thought of a possibility. A new hope burst out in her eyes. Was it possible that she wasn’t infected?
Dudian saw the change in her expression and said in a cold voice: “I forgot to tell you that I have the antidote to cure the zombie infection.”
“What? !”Eleanor was stunned. Her face was full of disbelief. But soon, she thought of Aisha who had already turned into a zombie but would not attack the teenager. This situation was too unbelievable. She was sure that Aisha had already turned into a zombie, the faint rotting smell that she had smelled earlier was clearly locked on when she saw Aisha. The smell came from her body. It was a very familiar zombie smell!
However, Aisha was very different from the zombies in her impression. Although the way she fought was similar to zombies and more primitive, the way she fought was more instinctive, but it would not attack anyone other than her, such a phenomenon was impossible, but it really existed!
Thinking of this, she looked at the faint mockery in Dudian’s eyes and suddenly believed a bit. Although the probability was very low, but maybe the teenager really had such a magical drug in his hands?
“If you want to live, we can make a deal and use your information to exchange.”Dudian turned back to sit on the chair next to him and said fearlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 675
chapters.content:
Chapter 675 – Chapter 665: The Ten Gods Of War [ Second Update ]
Eleanor stared at dudian: “What Kind of information do you want?”
“Everything.”Dudian said: “You can start from your identity and the person behind you.”
Eleanor was silent. The situation at the moment made it difficult for her to back down. She had to sell Hathaway in exchange for a chance of survival or stubbornly resist to the end. However, once she died, nothing would exist. She was not a professionally trained death warrior, nor was she a believer who was completely dominated by her thoughts. Life was above everything to her! However, she was not willing to let the hateful teenager extract information from her.
“If I say it, will you let me go?”She stared into Dudian’s eyes.
Dudian indifferently replied: “Of course, I will keep my word.”
Eleanor was silent for a moment, she slowly said: “My name is Eleanor. I am from the military. Of course I am from the inner wall. The military in the inner wall is different from the outer wall. If you count the military here, you can only be considered as a small military in the inner wall. It is like a soldier stationed in a place of exile. The military sent me here to check the situation of the outer wall. You have ruled the outer wall. This matter has angered his majesty. After all, although this abandoned land is dirty and despicable but it is his territory. He won’t allow others to plunder it!”
Dudian narrowed his eyes. It wasn’t the first time he had heard the name ‘Aristotle’. The last time he heard it was from Gwyneth. She was the manager of the giant wall of Sylvia, she was the one who knew the most secrets. He had expected that the fall of the outer wall would lead to the counterattack of the inner wall military. So he didn’t take into account when he seized the military. After all this was a step that would be taken sooner or later.
“What is the strength of the inner wall military?”Dudian looked at her and asked.
Eleanor replied: “What do you mean?”? As far as I know, there are about 300,000 soldiers in the regular army and 100,000 soldiers in the reserve army. The general constitution of the soldiers is higher than that of the outer wall. Although these ordinary soldiers have not integrated into the magic marks but they have undergone professional training. Their physique is strong. Compared to the hunters with magic marks, they are only slightly weaker. Some of the soldiers in the Ace Legion have superb fighting skills. They can even kill the hunters head on. If the army attacks, you will have no room to resist.”
Dudian’s eyes revealed a thoughtful look. Although he knew that the power of the inner wall was very strong but he was surprised that the basic level of the military was so terrifying. However.., this world was not the Old World of World War II. It was equivalent to the existence of a BUG-like magic marks that created the super human experts. It was the key to dominate the battlefield. The number of basic level soldiers couldn’t control a war.
“How many pioneers are there?”He asked.
Eleanor guessed dudian’s thoughts: “There are ten pioneers. They are known as the ten military gods. They are invincible!”
“What About You?”Dudian looked at her.
Eleanor was shocked. She had forgotten about herself! Fortunately, she wasn’t dead. She calmly said: “I can only be considered as a substitute. I have just become a pioneer. There are thirteen to fifteen people like me in the military.”She gave a rough number, it seemed more real. As for the other information about the military, she didn’t make it up. She wasn’t sure how many pioneers were hidden in the military. But at least she was sure that in addition to the ten military gods on the surface.., there were definitely more powerful pioneers hidden in the military!
Dudian nodded slightly. He knew that she wasn’t lying.
“What is the level of pioneers?”He asked. He was curious about this question. He had asked Aisha about it when he was recovering in the wasteland. But she didn’t say much because she wasn’t clear about it.
“I don’t know. As far as I know, the pioneers are the strongest. However, there are strong and weak pioneers. Her Highness Aisha is one of the top pioneers. She has the power of the Witcher bloodline and has awakened three times. She is far stronger than the other pioneers. Moreover, she is ranked in the top three of the legendary magic marks.”Eleanor thought for a moment, “Maybe His Majesty knows about it.”
Her mood became heavier. It was obvious that Haisha had turned into a corpse as she had judged. Otherwise, she would have asked Haisha directly, she knew more than him.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. The worries in his heart eased a little. After all, the strongest existence he could deal with at present was at the level of a pioneer. If there was a more terrifying power above the pioneers.., then he would have no chance of winning. He could only hide his strength and build an electric field in the outer wall!
“Tell me about the monastery.”He said.
Eleanor said: “I don’t know much about the monastery. As far as I know there are only six pioneers. They are the six guardians of the monastery. But I estimate that there are at least ten pioneers in the monastery. Their dean is unfathomable. He should be one of the top pioneers. He is even stronger than her highness Aisha!”
“Isn’t the monastery also under the command of His Majesty?”Dudian looked at her. Gwyneth was the one who provided the information. The monastery and the military in the inner wall were under the command of His Majesty Aristotle. One of them was armed force, the other was faith. Both of them ruled the giant wall.
Eleanor said: “Yes. Although they are under his majesty but the monastery has very little contact with our military. So we don’t know much about them.”
Dudian nodded. He said: “Then let’s talk about the Dragon Clan and the other two families that you are loyal to.”
Eleanor was stunned: “What Did You Say?”
“I didn’t hurt your ear. You should be able to hear my words.”
Of course Eleanor could hear it but she was shocked. So Dudian already knew her identity? How did he know? Did Aisha tell her? But she obviously couldn’t speak..
“Your armor told me.”Dudian no longer pretended to be profound because the effect was better, “This is the first lie. I didn’t point it out at the beginning because I didn’t want you to be vigilant. At least in this way, you will be more or less accurate in providing information about the military and the monastery. You can continue to tell me now. In addition, I don’t like to listen to stories. I hope you understand.”
“Armor?”Eleanor was shocked. The armor that she was wearing on the mission was worn by the pioneers of her family when they were outside the giant wall. How did the teenager Know About It?
Hathaway didn’t tell her that Dudian had been to the wasteland. After all, Dudian was just a small character. It was enough to know whether he was alive or not. However, this point was ignored. At this moment, Eleanor suffered a great loss.
“You have five minutes left.”Dudian looked at the clock on the wall and reminded Eleanor.
Eleanor turned her head and looked at Dudian. Her face was slightly pale: “Didn’t you say that you have thirty minutes left? It has only been five minutes!”
“Because my medicine can only treat the current you. The longer it is, the deeper the infection of the toxin. Your body is close to becoming a corpse. At that time, even if you retain consciousness, I can’t do anything about it.”Dudian said in a serious tone, of course, he couldn’t tell her that he had other purposes in the remaining twenty minutes.
Eleanor’s face changed. She hesitated for a moment and immediately said: “I will tell you what you want to know. I will tell you everything. Hurry up and ask!”
“The dragon mother also has a bloodline awakening right? How many times has she awakened?”Dudian asked.
Eleanor anxiously said: “I don’t know. I really don’t know. The Dragon Mother hasn’t attacked for many years. But I know that she attacked once twelve years ago. Although I don’t know if she used her full strength, but the power that erupted at that time has already reached the level of four-degree awakening.”
“Fourth Awakening?”Dudian narrowed his eyes. Aisha was also a fourth awakening but as the manager of the Dragon Clan, the power of the dragon mother should be more than that.
“I want to know about Hathaway’s situation.”Dudian immediately said.
Eleanor thought that even if she told him, he would die without a doubt. She would go back and ask for forgiveness from Hathaway. At least the punishment wouldn’t be death. She quickly told Dudian some basic information about Hathaway.
Five minutes passed in the blink of an eye.
“The holy son of the wing family is as strong as her highness Aisha. It is said that he has awakened his bloodline three times…”Eleanor continued to talk about the information about the wing family and the Rock family, she didn’t waste time to fabricate lies. In any case, the two families were enemies of the Dragon family. It wasn’t a big deal to sell them to Dudian.
“Alright.”Dudian interrupted her: “It’s time to treat you.”
Eleanor didn’t expect that Dudian would keep his word. She couldn’t help but show a surprised expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 676
chapters.content:
Chapter 676 – Chapter 666: Internal Wall Disposal -Lthirdhwatchatch ]
Dudian came in front of Eleanor. He raised his hand and touched her smooth face: “Remember your words. Look up to me in Hell.”
Eleanor was startled.
Dudian’s fingers pierced into her eyes. He pulled out two eyeballs which were stained with blood.
Eleanor screamed out. Although her body was anesthetized but the anesthetic in her brain had slowly subsided. Dudian’s action was very rough. The pain was unbearable even for people with strong will.
Dudian threw her eyeballs into her mouth and covered her mouth. His calm face was full of killing intent and malevolence, “If you have eyes but no eyeballs then why do you need these eyes?”
Eleanor screamed as blood oozed out from the gap between Dudian’s fingers.
Dudian turned to the stunned neuss: “Go and get a big bag. I want to transport her to the inner wall.”
Neuss was startled for a moment. She quickly turned around and ran away. She felt nauseous as if she was escaping from the Temple of Purgatory.
Dudian let go of his hand. Eleanor screamed in grief and anger as she spat out two blood red beads. Her eyeballs fell to the ground. She no longer had any hope from the youth, she was angry and resentful. However she regretted that the youth was so cruel. Not only did he break his promise but he also didn’t show any mercy.
If she had known earlier, she wouldn’t have had the slightest hope!
The hope was the most complete despair!
“Even if I turn into a zombie, I will not let you go. I will kill you. Her Highness Hathaway will avenge me. She will definitely kill you!”Eleanor shouted in anger, her face was completely distorted by the indescribable anger. She clenched her teeth and stretched her neck. As long as she touched Dudian’s body, she would bite him. Otherwise, she wouldn’t be able to vent her anger!
Dudian looked at her quietly: “You have killed people before. In that case, you should be prepared to be killed just like me.”
“Shameless scum! Despicable scum! I will eat your flesh and crush your bones! !”Eleanor roared in anger, the pain and despair made her want to break free of all shackles and destroy everything. However her body was firmly fixed by the chains and didn’t loosen because of her anger.
Dudian took out a washcloth and stuffed it into her mouth. Eleanor was extremely angry. She bit the washcloth and spat it out. She continued to curse.
“If you refuse the toast then you will be punished!”Dudian coldly snorted. He took out the sword and stabbed it into her mouth. Eleanor screamed. She didn’t dare to eat the sword in her mouth. Dudian pulled back the sword and put a rag into her mouth.
Eleanor screamed as she bit the rag in her mouth. She couldn’t spit it out because her tongue had been cut off.
Neuss returned to the temple with a huge bag in his hand.
Dudian picked up Eleanor and threw her into the bag. He told Neuss: “Clean up the place. Don’t cause panic. I will be back soon.”
“Yes, master…”Noyce suppressed the fear in his heart.
Dudian carried Eleanor and jumped off the cliff behind the Utoto Mountain. He climbed down the cliff and rushed towards the inner wall. He didn’t want to waste resources. He was ready to start the plan to deal with the inner wall anyway. He was just an advance soldier.
After leaving the mountain he flew along the straight path. He silently calculated the time in his heart. He hoped to reach the inner wall before she turned into a corpse.
Dudian walked along the official road at an extremely fast speed. He passed by the carriages that he occasionally met along the way. After fifteen minutes Dudian finally arrived at the wall of Sighs. He felt that Eleanor’s struggle was getting weaker. He knew that she was close to turning into a corpse so he ran along the wall of Sighs, he came to the giant wall.
He looked up and saw some red dots on the top of the wall of Sighs. They were the soldiers stationed in the inner wall.
He didn’t want to alert the enemy. He took off his backpack and held it in his arms. At the same time he held his breath and used all the magic marks power in his body. He slowly raised two bumps on his back and broke the clothes, it was two translucent wings!
Although his wings were pulled out last time, the genes in his body were still there. The stem cells in his body were molded according to the original condition of the genes. He could still reassemble the wings, however, it was similar to the healing of human wounds. The recovery speed was very slow. Moreover, it couldn’t be treated by external forces. He could only rely on the energy accumulated by his body to repair it. Until now, his wings hadn’t completely recovered.
Whoosh!
Dudian flapped his broken wings and slowly flew up. Although it was a broken wing, but he was still barely able to fly.
He patted the smooth giant wall with one hand. He used the rough surface left by the dust of the years to climb up the giant wall.
After climbing up the giant wall, Dudian immediately lowered his body and ran towards the inner wall.
The soldiers who were stationed on the wall of sighs were sitting in groups of two or three. It seemed that they were chatting and having fun. They didn’t pay much attention to the surrounding guards.
Dudian smoothly passed through the wall of Sighs and continued to run for thousands of meters. Then he quickly descended from the wall.
He found that Eleanor had stopped moving after he landed on the grass. He knew that it was about time so he continued to rush forward. The soil in the inner wall was four times that of the outer wall. The outer wall only occupied one-fifth of the area of the giant wall, so the outer wall was an empty grassland.
Dudian held Eleanor and walked forward. After four or five minutes, he suddenly heard a roar coming from his bag. He was very familiar with the roar, which was often heard from Aisha’s mouth, it was like a monster full of wildness.
Dudian’s eyes were gloomy as he continued to move forward.
Suddenly, a sharp object suddenly poked the edge of the bag and hit the armor in his arms.
He was startled. He quickly shook off the bag and looked down. There was a scratch on the armor but it didn’t hurt his skin.
He was relieved. The arm that was bitten by him was his left hand. It could freeze the diffusion speed of the corpse poison but the rest of his body couldn’t. Once Bitten, he would die without a doubt!
At this time, the bag that he threw out began to roll violently on the grass. Suddenly, the bag exploded. A few strange limbs stretched out from the inside. Then, a figure slowly stood up from the inside, or rather, a figure was lying on the ground like a spider, but the body was still Eleanor’s.
Dudian saw Eleanor’s ferocious face and immediately noticed that her pupils were not completely black like Aisha’s, but were emitting a terrifying green light like the other undeads.
..
..
Last night there was a person whose leg was bitten by a Mosquito in the book review section

chapters.title: Chapter 677
chapters.content:
Chapter 677 – Chapter 667: “Cruelty”[ First Update ]
Roar!
Eleanor who was lying on the ground growled. Her delicate face was extremely ferocious. The corner of her mouth was cracked by the fangs. Saliva dripped from the fangs as she stared at Dudian.
Dudian didn’t have time to think. He immediately turned and ran.
He didn’t expect that Eleanor was completely different from Aisha when she was infected. Her injuries were healed by the virus. Moreover, her current body shape was different from the previous magic marks. But there was no doubt that.., her combat power was definitely not weak!
Whoosh!
As Dudian turned around to escape, Eleanor roared and chased after him. Her speed was extremely fast.
Dudian was secretly shocked. He quickly used his broken wings and flapped them to rush forward. At the same time, he slowly rose from the ground and flapped his wings in the air. However, this time he didn’t use his palms to borrow strength from the giant wall, the speed of flying with only two broken wings was slow. Moreover, it was extremely difficult for him to fly. He swayed in the air and sometimes rose and fell. It was also very difficult for him to control.
Although the broken wings were as easy to control as his hands, but using the broken wings to control the wind was completely different. The holes on the broken wings were blown by the wind. Occasionally, there would be a breeze blowing in front of him, which made him feel like he was overturned.
Roar!
Eleanor roared as she quickly chased after him on the ground. The mutated limbs under her abdomen crawled crazily, leaving several inches deep marks on the grass.
Dudian quickly raised his altitude. He didn’t expect that this person would have such strong strength as soon as he turned into a corpse. He thought that he would be like Aisha. He would need a period of time to recover, however, it seemed that this was not the case.
Roar!
Eleanor’s neck was raised ninety degrees as she looked up at dudian. It was as if her face was on the back of her neck. Her face was full of malevolence. The limbs under her abdomen quickly crawled and chased after her. At the same time, she grabbed the sand and mud on the ground, she threw it at Dudian.
Dudian tried to dodge but her throwing power was extremely fast. The sand and stones were like sharp arrows. Although he tried to dodge but the broken wing was hit by a few stones. His body lost its balance and fell down.
His face changed. If he fell down then he would have no chance to win.
He used all his strength to control the broken wing. He stabilized his body when he fell to more than 30 meters. He continued to flap his wings and fly up.
Roar!
Eleanor roared in anger. She jumped from the ground to a height of more than 80 meters but Dudian had already risen to more than 100 meters. He didn’t manage to catch her.
Dudian heard the angry roar from behind him. He secretly complained in his heart. In the blink of an eye, he had fallen to the point of escaping from her hands.
Roar!
Suddenly, an excited roar sounded.
The Roar quickly rushed to the left in another direction.
Dudian was stunned as he looked back. He saw Eleanor pouncing towards the grass on the left. From the high sky, he could see that there was a ten meter long black patterned python crawling in the grass.
Eleanor came to the front of the black patterned python. Her beautiful face was wide open as she grabbed the black patterned python and bit it.
The Python felt the danger. Its head was curled up like a bow. It wanted to attack but was hit by Eleanor’s limbs. The head of the Python was smashed and its brain splattered all over the grass.
Dudian seized the opportunity to run forward. In the blink of an eye he left Eleanor behind.
It didn’t take long for him to return to the giant wall. He climbed up the wall and climbed to the top of the giant wall.
He gently exhaled. He didn’t expect to be saved by a python. Fortunately, the Python had lured her away. Otherwise, if she continued to chase after him, it would be difficult to guarantee that he wouldn’t lose his life.
He walked along the giant wall. He rested as he walked. After he recovered some of his strength, he immediately rushed back to the mountain.
Although the plan to dispose of Eleanor’s body wasn’t very successful, but at least she was sent to the inner wall. Although she was in the wilderness of the inner wall, there were military garrisons here. If she wandered around.., sooner or later someone would find her and cause chaos.
“Unfortunately, it would be better if she was sent to the city and then turned into a corpse.”Dudian was secretly regretful.
Barton was relieved when he saw Dudian’s safe return: “Master, Are You Alright?”
