Dudian shook his head: “I made you worried. Have you found the witnesses of the previous battle? This news must be sealed. If there is any news, say that it was an attack by the dark cult.”
“I know, Young Master.”
Dudian patted his shoulder and quickly returned to the temple. He saw Aisha sitting quietly on the chair. His heart finally calmed down.
“Young master, the temple has been cleaned.”Neuss came over and respectfully bowed: “Do you have any orders?”
Dudian looked at him: “Come here.”
Neuss’s heart tightened but he still went forward.
“Do you think that woman should be killed?”Dudian calmly looked at him.
Neuss was startled: “Master, that woman offended you. Of course she should die!”
“I saw you when I cut off her body.”Dudian said: “Do you think I am too cruel and inhumane?”
Neuss was scared to the point that his heart was beating fast. He bowed: “Master, I don’t think so…”
Dudian lifted his arm and stared at him: “Jin, we have been in a prison. I hope you can understand me.”
Neuss was startled. It had been a long time since dudian had called him that.
“It’s normal for you to feel sad. I Don’t blame you.”Dudian calmly said: “Everyone will feel sad and cruel when they see bloody scenes or things that go beyond their bottom line. But the feeling is temporary. It’s like when a person hears that someone has starved to death. He won’t be touched. At most he will have a trace of sympathy in his heart. But if he sees a person starving to death then his sympathy will be expanded. It will be enough to influence him and help him.”
Neuss lowered his head and listened.
“It’s the same as starving to death but you use different ways to look at it. The feeling you get is different too. There are people who can only imagine the bloody scene but they can’t smell the nauseating smell of blood. So you felt that you couldn’t bear it because you were there. Your senses were stimulated so your heart couldn’t bear it.”Dudian indoctrinated him as if he was talking about some kind of truth.
Neuss was confused but he knew what Dudian was trying to say.
“People are emotional. Emotional is an uncertain factor. Since it is uncertain then it can’t be considered as a rational judgment.”Dudian quietly looked at him, “I hope you can understand me. There are too many things in this position. I must be ruthless and cruel! If I was weak and didn’t notice her then we would be dead!”
Neuss was silent. He knew that Dudian’s words were true. He couldn’t help but feel a trace of guilt in his heart. He felt guilty for his previous thoughts, he bowed his head: “Master, you are right. I understand you. I shouldn’t have such messy thoughts. I thought that you were too cruel. Now that I think about it, what kind of cruelty is this?”? Who Didn’t commit a crime? She deserved to die!”
“No!”Dudian denied his words, “The previous matter was indeed cruel! Cruelty is cruelty. There is no need to cover it up. I Won’t cover up my own ugliness because of other people’s ugliness. But I have to do this. Even if it is cruel, it should be done.”
Neuss understood and nodded: “Young Master, I know. I will remember these words in the future!”
“Yes.”Dudian nodded. He was relieved as he saw that Neuss had removed the grudge in his heart. He didn’t want to see the people around him betray him like sham. The first step of betrayal was to have a grudge, that was why he had told Noyce so much. It was close to his true thoughts.
“I didn’t expect that the one who attacked us this time was the Dragon Clan. The one who told the Dragon clan this news was either the military or the monastery.”Dudian whispered to himself, “Did they tell the Dragon clan the reason? Did they know that I have a grudge with Hailey? Or did their spies recognize Aisha? Hailey should have known about my existence.”
He felt a bit troubled. The perfect arrangement in his plan was to deal with the military and the monastery before seeking revenge from the Dragon Clan. After all, the Dragon clan was full of experts. He needed to accumulate strength through the military and the monastery during the war, only then would he have the ability to personally step into the Dragon clan to take revenge!
“It seems that we can’t delay any longer.”Dudian said to Neuss: “We should let the inner wall know what ‘living in Hell’means.”

chapters.title: Chapter 678
chapters.content:
Chapter 678 – Chapter 668: Making Chaos [ Second Update ]
Neuss’s heart skipped a beat: “Master, are we going to war with the inner wall? But…”
“But what?”
“But the woman said that there are ten military gods in the inner wall. They are pioneers.”Neuss knew that hunters were not the end of power, he knew that the woman was a pioneer: “There are so many strong people in the military alone. Moreover there are six hidden experts in the monastery. If we go to war with them, wouldn’t it be like hitting a rock with an egg?”
Dudian shook his head: “That’s not how the account is calculated.”
Neuss was stunned.
“On the surface there are 300,000 soldiers in the inner wall. There are countless elite soldiers and ten or more pioneers. This kind of power is enough to flatten us.”Dudian said: “But war is not a numerical method. We can use numbers to statistics but we can not just look at the data!”
“First of all, the military will not easily send the ten gods and 300,000 soldiers to attack us. What is the reason?”
Neuss was stunned: “I know. The military also has its own enemies. We need to keep our troops to deal with them.”
“This is the first reason.”Dudian said: “The second reason is that we are too weak! Would we send all of our people to deal with a person who is shouting at the Holy See? No, we would only send a slightly higher force to deal with him. This is not contempt. It is a reasonable use of resources and not a waste of resources.”
Neuss suddenly understood and admired Dudian. He thought that Dudian was able to come to this step because of his extraordinary intelligence.
“Moreover, there is a big figure on our side. The military and the monastery already know about it. I think it will hurt our brains. The only enemy we have to face is the Dragon Clan.”Dudian said.
“Big Figure?”Neuss was curious.
“It’s Aisha.”Dudian pointed at Aisha who was sitting quietly.
Neuss patted his head. He had forgotten about the mysterious identity of the tough woman.
“The military knows about her existence. I believe that they won’t come out to bite us. They will send people from the Dragon clan to negotiate with us. After all, we are weak but we have Aisha. We have the qualifications to negotiate with them.”Dudian said.
Neuss said in admiration: “I know, Young Master.”
“In this way, the pioneers of the monastery, the military and the army can be subtracted.”Dudian indifferently said: “As long as Aisha is there, the Dragon Clan will not openly fight us to the death. But they will give us a crime to capture or even kill us! Therefore, the only thing we have to think about is defense and counter-attack!”
“Young master is Smart.”Neuss sighed.
Dudian said: “Sometimes the enemy may be a friend or a knife in our hand. In addition to fighting resources we have to fight heart. For example, we have to create chaos in the inner wall so that the Dragon clan and the military won’t have time to deal with the affairs of the outer wall. In this way the upcoming enemies will be considered as a bubble.”
Neuss was excited and curious: “Master, can we create chaos in the inner wall? Can We do it?”
“We can do it if we want to.”Dudian said: “Go and call Glenn and Gwyneth. In addition, get Sergei to call the Sword King and Hawkeye from the Dark Church.” He had to advance the plan and use this strategy to delay time. Moreover he could increase his strength and make his savings stronger!
“Yes.”Neuss replied and quickly left.
After a moment Neuss and Dudian arrived at the scene.
Sword King and Hawkeye couldn’t help but look around after they entered the temple. There was a sense of shock in their hearts as well as a strange feeling. Once upon a time, this temple was the place where they dreamed of invading, but they didn’t expect that one day they would be able to walk through the main door. It was a strange feeling.
Dudian saw that everyone was present, he looked at sword king and Hawkeye: “Elders, I remember that there are several ranking lists in the outer wall. I hope that you can find the top twenty assassins. I need these people to do something for me in the inner wall. The people who are willing to participate can fulfill their wishes as long as it is within their capabilities.”
Sword King and Hawkeye were stunned. They didn’t think that Dudian would ask them to come to the inner wall to deal with this matter? Or should twenty people go together? Is it so easy to go to the inner wall?
Both of them were stunned for a moment. They wanted to ask but held back.
“I know, Chairman.”Hawkeye took the lead. He was familiar with Dudian so he knew that Dudian didn’t say anything.
“Go.”Dudian waved his hand: “You must find it by Seven o’clock Tonight.”
“Yes.”Sword king bowed.
Dudian said to Glenn: “You will lead the team in this mission. There must be no mistakes.”
“Yes, Young Master.”Glenn replied.
Dudian said to Gwyneth: “Your task is to go outside the giant wall. I rented the passage. The right side of the passage is about 50 miles deep. There is a monster that I have imprisoned. I used the tungsten steel cage that I forged before. If the cage is broken then it means that the monster has run away. If the cage is gone then it is most likely still nearby. Come Back and report to me as soon as you find it.”
Gwyneth was startled. She remembered that Dudian had used a lot of materials to forge the huge tungsten steel cage. Her face slightly changed as she thought about the size of the cage?
“I know, Young Master.”She hesitated for a moment but still agreed. She knew that Dudian didn’t let her go to the inner wall. It was very likely that other people would go to the inner wall, so he didn’t let her participate.
After Gwyneth left, Dudian asked Neuss to give the drawings that Gwyneth had brought back to Glenn, he said: “These drawings are the sewer conditions of the cities in the inner wall. Your task is to lead the assassins to infiltrate the cities in the inner wall and throw poison into the well water. You must create a large area of chaos.”
Glenn was surprised: “All the cities have to be poisoned? Isn’t this…”
“Don’t worry. It doesn’t mean that everyone will die. If it was so easy to eliminate everyone in the inner wall then someone would have done it already.”Dudian said.
Glenn relaxed. She thought that even if someone thought of it, they might not dare to do it!

chapters.title: Chapter 679
chapters.content:
Chapter 679 – : Chapter 669: “Everyone Is Equal”
“I know, I will do my best to complete the task!”Glenn said. She didn’t have a good impression of the inner wall. Even if a lot of people died, she wouldn’t have the slightest sympathy.
“The Red Circle on the drawing is the place I marked. These places must be poisoned! “Anyone who doesn’t poison the marked places will be executed!”Dudian said in a cold tone: “In addition, you have to be careful that some of them will take the opportunity to sneak into the inner wall and live in peace. You have to grasp their weaknesses!”
“Yes, Young Master.”Glenn nodded.
“I will give the poison to Neuss. Gather your men and collect it.”
“Yes.”
After Glenn left, Dudian went to another side hall. It was originally a place to store the scriptures of the Holy See. Now the scriptures had been emptied and all kinds of experimental tools had been set up. It had become Dudian’s alchemy room.
Dudian took Aisha to the side hall. Neuss was waiting outside. He went to a cabinet and used the key hidden in another cabinet to open the cabinet. He took out a head, it was the head of the King corpse that had bitten Aisha!
Dudian put on gloves and held the head of the King corpse to a bubbling water tank. He slowly put the head into the water and soon it sank. At the same time, the water in the water tank slowly changed color. Traces of black liquid flowed out from the mouth of the King Corpse. It mixed with the water and dyed the water.
The virus that he chose to release this time was not the strong poison made by the pharmacist but the zombie poison! His aim was not to kill but to create chaos. The King Corpse’s virus was the best choice.
By the time Glenn gathered her people and came to the temple, Dudian asked Neuss to give her the refined zombie poison. The zombie poison had been put into water sacs, he said again: “Be careful. I have prepared some gold for you. If there is a need then you can bribe others to do things for you. But remember not to leak any information.”
“I know.”Glenn solemnly said.
Neuss said to Dudian after Glenn left: “Master, can they throw all the poison into the cities in the inner wall? The defense of these cities should be very tight right?”
Dudian said: “As long as they don’t do anything bad, then they don’t have to do anything else.”
Neuss was speechless.
“As long as they have the courage, they can do it. Many people don’t do it. It’s not that they don’t have the ability, it’s that they don’t have the courage. They are afraid of being traced back to them.”Dudian said.
Neuss nodded as he heard Dudian’s words.
“When the inner wall is in chaos, the military’s priority is to stabilize the chaos in the inner wall. There will be no time to send out too many people to control us. Even if the scope of chaos is expanded, even the families of the witchers might be forced by His Majesty Aristotle to suppress the Chaos.”Dudian said.
Neuss understood that Dudian was using offense as defense. He couldn’t help but admire him. He was the only one who could calculate the inner wall in such a way.
“The world is chaotic. If there is no chaos then we will create chaos.”Dudian narrowed his eyes: “We must seize the opportunity to accumulate strength as soon as possible to deal with the upcoming war!”
“Yes, Young Master.”
Dudian calculated the time. It was time for barbarians to enter the wall. It would be a waste if he didn’t use a lot of manpower.
“Call Sergei to call Richelieu and Barton to come in.”Dudian said to Neuss.
Neuss left.
The undercurrent was surging. The civilians living in the commercial district were still living a peaceful life. The young masters and young ladies of noble families were drinking afternoon tea. They were talking about which family’s snacks were delicious and which family’s Moulin Rouge was beautiful. The farm owners were also conscientiously encouraging their serfs to work hard in growing food. In the mines that the nobles had contracted, the foreman was beating the miners and making them work hard in mining..
Some wealthy merchants and consortia who had smelled a certain scent were secretly using their connections to secretly inquire about the movements of the military and the Holy See. They wanted to know some internal information so that they could see clearly the current situation in the outer wall region.
However, before many people could find any useful information, two pieces of news from the Holy See and the military made the entire outer wall region explode.
The military and the Holy See issued a notice at the same time, deciding to cancel all the household registration of the poor so that they could become ordinary civilians and have relative freedom. They could not be slaves and were exempted from slave recruitment. Moreover, they could also enjoy the legal protection of the Court of Justice.
Once this news was released, the entire outer wall region was turned upside down.
Among them, the most excited were the poor in the slums. To them, this reform by the Holy See and the military was simply a great blessing from the heavens. It had completely changed their lives. Such a thing was something that they did not even dare to dream about, but it had really happened!
And the most intense reaction was from the nobles and civilians in the business district. All of them voiced out their opposition! For the nobles, if they were to abolish the household registration of the poor, it would mean that they would lose the cheap labor force of the poor. In the future, if they wanted to hire workers, they would have to pay the price of the commoners! For them, this was equivalent to losing a large amount of money for no reason!
For the commoners, it was the same. If the poor became commoners, then they would have fewer opportunities to work, and their competitiveness would increase. Correspondingly, the wages would inevitably decrease. This was inevitable! Moreover, the existence of the poor for a long time made them more or less have a sense of psychological superiority. They couldn’t tolerate the dirty smell of the poor!
When the news spread through the newspapers, it didn’t take long for people to come to the front of the Holy See and the military. They paraded in front of the streets and held signs to protest. The scene was chaotic.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to Neuss when he sent the news back to Dudian. He had taken these two major obstacles into account when he introduced the policy to abolish the household registration of the poor, it was equivalent to fighting against all the people in the outer wall! It was as difficult as a national leader to carry out a policy that all the people in the country were opposed to!
After all, 95% of the wealth of the entire outer wall region was in the hands of the nobles and commoners. The poor could barely fill their stomachs, but they had almost no savings. After all.., the poor had always been a cheap labor force. Some were even treated as slaves. It was already good enough that they could eat their fill. There was no such thing as a salary at all. Most people knew that some black-hearted aristocrats specialized in abducting and selling the poor as coolies. However, they tacitly acknowledged that there were no poor people in the high-level forces. No one would complain for such a group, they would cry for injustice.
But now, Dudian had done it.
Of course, he wouldn’t go against the aristocrats and civilians. Even if he had more force, he wouldn’t be able to suppress the riots.
“Master, do you want me to send people to chase those people away?”Neuss carefully asked.
Dudian waved his hand, “Don’t worry. These people are just pawns sent by us. The people behind them are waiting to catch us. We can’t escalate the conflict. Let Barton release the news that he will give a reasonable explanation to everyone tomorrow. Let them adapt to this matter today.”
Neuss couldn’t help but ask: “What if there is a disturbance today?”
“Let the Dark Church deal with it. If there is a disturbance then it won’t appear today.”Dudian calmly replied.
Neuss understood and immediately turned away.
After he left Dudian was ready to write a speech. The title of the speech was: Everyone is equal!
At the same time, the outside world was shocked by the sudden policy.
Some of the literary writers stood out and publicly supported the policy of the Holy See and the military. However, the glass of the house was smashed by the mob, the publishing co-operative had issued a ban notice.

chapters.title: Chapter 680
chapters.content:
Chapter 680 – Chapter 670: Black And White [ First Update ]
“Young master, three bishops have come over. They want me to abolish the household registration of the poor.”Barton came to the temple and spoke to Dudian.
Dudian asked: “What do you think?”
Barton whispered: “I think young master has other purposes. But in my opinion, we must pacify them as soon as possible. Otherwise, the outer wall will be in chaos.”
“You know more about the lives of the poor than anyone else. Don’t you want this to come true?”Dudian said without raising his head.
Barton bitterly smiled, “Of course I hope that the poor will not be bullied. But to be honest, it is not worth offending others for the sake of the poor. Even if all the poor are grateful to us, it is just gratitude to us. But the nobles and civilians control the land and farms as well as other high-end resources. If they resist, it is a bit dangerous.”
“Did the three bishops tell you these words?”Dudian casually asked.
Barton blushed: “I think they are right. I also think so.”
Dudian quietly put down his chopsticks and quietly looked at Barton, “You see, even you are not willing to help these people. Who is willing to help them?”? Because no one has changed the current situation, the abnormal situation has always existed. It is reasonable to exist. This sentence is BULLSH * T! If you go back to the slums and continue to live, do you still think the words of the three bishops are right?”
Barton was stunned. After a while he hesitated: “But, to us…”
“The nobles haven’t jumped up yet and the bishops have jumped up. They usually talk about benevolence but at the critical moment they are the first to stand up against benevolence.”Dudian said in a cold voice: “If someone in the Holy See tries to persuade you about this, then immediately deal with it!”
Barton saw that Dudian was angry and bowed his head: “I know.”
Neuss saw that Dudian’s anger had subsided after Barton left, he whispered: “Young Master, don’t be angry. These people from the Holy See talk about it in an open and aboveboard manner. They spread the faith of God and love all living things. But you also know that this is just fooling the civilians. It will really affect their own livelihood. No one will hesitate.”
Dudian coldly said: “That’s why we need to clean them up!”
Neuss was a bit puzzled.
Dudian continued: “Why did the monastery set up the Holy Church and the Dark Church? The purpose is to do bad things and to catch thieves!”! If the Holy Church had become the same as the dark church then what was the need for them to exist? There are enough people who have done bad things for us, but there are fewer and fewer people who have done good things for us. In the long run, what prestige does the holy church have? What is the need to exist?”
Neuss woke up and felt ashamed. He admired Dudian’s foresight.
“The people will trust the holy church because of the dark church. Some of the Knights of the holy church have killed the enemy bravely. They have sacrificed their blood and sacrificed their lives to gain the trust of the people! If one day the people think that the holy church and the dark church are the same as the vampires then what should they use to manage them? Should they rely on force and deterrence?”Dudian snorted, “Richelieu has failed to manage the dark church and the holy church at the same time for a long time. The two places have been mixed up. The White has become cloudy and the Black is not dark enough. The two swords have become incomplete so they have failed!”
“Why don’t some nobles or military officials believe in the god of Light?”? “It’s because they have been in contact with the god of light for a long time. They know that they are fighting for their own interests so they don’t believe in the god of Light.”Dudian continued: “If the holy church was pure then there would be no military and magistrate in the outer wall. Unfortunately, Richelieu didn’t use the two swords well. He only knew to use the dark church to promote the strength and holiness of the Holy Church. He didn’t know that corruption would arise in the inner wall of a powerful force!”
“Some people can see the corruption at a glance, so they won’t believe it. It’s like you see an apple that is rotten inside. Will you eat it? No.”
Neuss nodded and said: “Young Master, I have been taught.”
Dudian finished the dishes and poured out a small cup of white wine from the white porcelain bottle. He felt a trace of warmth in his stomach. The coldness in his body and the cold feeling in his left hand had dispersed a lot, his mood also became a little better.
This white wine was brewed by him. It was the only one in the entire outer wall and was not sold to the outside world. Other people here liked to drink red wine. The pungent smell of white wine was unbearable and he couldn’t swallow it. But he liked to drink it.
However, he didn’t dare to drink too much. He needed to keep his mind clear at all times. As long as he drank until the cold air in his body slightly subsided, he would stop.
The night was long. Dudian looked at the super chip in the room and learned from it. Aisha accompanied him. She sat quietly like a virtuous wife.
Dudian looked back at her when he was tired. He felt that his fatigue had subsided a lot.
At the same time, in the bustling commercial district outside the Utoto Mountain, the lights were bright. People came and went from the densely populated commercial district. The relaxing and lively night life began, carriages with noble flags were going in and out of some high-end places.
In the homes of these nobles, some of the heads of the families were frowning, unable to fall asleep.
The night would eventually pass, and Dawn would break.
Amidst all kinds of anxiety, anger, and unwillingness, the nobles in the business district received the morning newspaper that had been sent out by the Holy See and the military ministry today. The headlines on the front page were almost identical.
When everyone saw the contents of the newspaper, they were all stunned.
If the news of “Abolishing the household registration of the poor”that had been released yesterday was a bomb, then today’s news was equivalent to a clap of thunder!
First of all, the Holy See and the military confirmed that the plan of abolishing the household registration of the poor would not change. Furthermore, all the poor could apply to leave the slums and live in the commoner district. However, they had to follow the rules of the commoner district in their daily lives, and they had to pay basic taxes, they could not sleep on the streets, they had to sleep in houses, and they could not be naked in the street. And all the poor who entered the civilian areas could apply for a house and a job opportunity from the military, but they had to pay rent and payroll taxes to the military every month..
Other than a series of policies aimed at the slums, the real thunder was the news aimed at the nobles and civilians.
First of all, all civilians would have the opportunity to apply to become nobles. As long as they met the corresponding conditions, they could become nobles!
And the nobles could apply to enter the inner wall and obtain the title of nobility!

chapters.title: Chapter 681
chapters.content:
Chapter 681 – Chapter 671: The Second Update
The commoners and nobles who read the newspapers could not believe their eyes. In their hearts, the hierarchy was strict and sacred, and could not be broken! However, now all the commoners had the chance to become high and mighty nobles! To them, this was something that they did not even dare to dream about. The most excited of them were the wealthy merchants. Most of them were commoners. Although they were smart and had businesses all over the world, they had a lot of money, they were not inferior to some of the ancient aristocratic families.
However, no matter how much money they had, in the eyes of the nobles, they were still just country bumpkins.
This kind of contempt did not only involve the issue of face.
In some high-end banquet venues, even if they received an invitation, they would still be ostracized at the very edge. No one would pay attention to them and they would not be able to expand their network. They would even directly reject some business deals when they knew that they were not nobles. This contempt was reflected in all aspects. This was not only the advantage of the strict class system, but also the disadvantage. Those who stood on the high side would receive the best treatment, while those who stood on the low side would face the most difficult situation.
Now that there was such an opportunity, for some people who wanted to become nobles, it was worth it no matter what price they paid.
The same mentality existed in the hearts of the nobles. The position of the inner wall in the hearts of the nobles was just like the position of the nobles in the hearts of the commoners. It was unattainable and unreachable. They could clearly see it, but they could not reach it, it seemed to be the same as the saying that what could not be obtained was always the best and the most desired.
The news spread through the entire outer wall like a hurricane. It was even faster than the news when the barbarians invaded the chaotic war.
“Child, you have to learn well. Sit, walk, stand, and run. You have to have a temperament and style. Follow what the teacher taught you. You must not act recklessly.”In a courtyard in the civilian district, a khaki-haired mother was teaching her child.
The child, who was only five or six years old, was dressed neatly and meticulously. His khaki-colored hair was also combed neatly. He wore a small suit and a red tie around his neck. He looked very distinguished.
The child followed his mother’s instructions and walked in the yard. As he walked, he asked, “Mom, why do I need to practice these things? Lili, who lives next door, has already gone to school. I want to go too.”
“Silly child, what’s so good about her attending a carpenter’s college? In the future, when she comes out, she can only do things that commoners do. You are different from them. If you practice these noble etiquette well, one day, we will become nobles,”his mother said with a smile.
“Mom, can we become nobles just by practicing this?”The child asked, puzzled.
His mother smiled and said, “Your grandmother once married a noble. Later, because of some matters, she migrated out of the business district. In our generation, she’s already a commoner. But one day, we’ll go back. When you finish practicing these things, we’ll be able to go back.”
“I know, mother. I will train hard!”
The nobles in the business district received the news one after another. In the Gallo family, which was in charge of the Green Consortium, the head of the Gallo family looked at the newspaper in his hand. He was shocked for a few minutes before he slowly came back to his senses, a pair of fierce eyes, which were used to shout at the business district, became a little red at this moment. Tears welled up in his eyes. He was so excited that his voice trembled. “Finally, finally, we have a chance to return to the inner wall…”
“We, we can finally return to the inner wall!”
Similar voices rang out in many noble castles, and early in the morning, cries could be heard all over the noble castles.
At the same time, in the conference hall of the monastery’s main courtyard, in the central area of the inner wall behind the wall of sighs.., the burly old man sitting in the lead seat said to Mogran who was sitting to the side, “How is it? Did the dragon clan send someone to the outer wall? Why is there no movement at all?”
Mogra said respectfully: “Dean, according to the people I bribed from the Dragon Clan, that Saintess Hathaway has already sent someone to the outer wall. However, the people I sent to the outer wall to observe the situation have reported that the youth is still alive and there seems to be no movement. I guess that the Dragon Clan is not sure whether the news is true or not. They only sent one person to investigate. I think the Scout has already sent the news back to the Dragon Clan. If the person beside the youth is indeed that Saintess Aisha, I think that the Dragon Clan will make a big move soon!”
“Really? There’s no movement at all in the outer wall?”The burly old man frowned. “Who are the people sent by the Dragon Clan to investigate the outer wall? There shouldn’t be many experts who can investigate Aisha, right?”
Mogran shook his head, “I don’t know about that, but they should send an expert. I remember that the person ranked third on the assassination list is from the Dragon Clan. If we send him over, we will definitely be able to find out the true identity of the woman beside this young man.”
The burly elder nodded slightly, “It seems that we need to wait for another day or two. Ask your men to pay close attention to the changes in the outer wall area. By the way, has the military responded?”
“Those guys from the military are thinking the same as us. They also want the Dragon Clan to be the first to test the truth. They are not willing to send the ten war gods to fight with Aisha. It is said that this woman has already awakened her witcher bloodline power three times. Her strength is extraordinary. It is not something that ordinary pioneers can deal with. Even if the ten war gods go out, there will be a lot of casualties,”Mogran said.
The burly elder nodded slightly. Suddenly, his eyes moved and he asked, “Do the wing clan and the Rock Clan Know About This?”
Mogran immediately understood what he meant. He said with a smile, “I have already secretly revealed it to them. I guess they are also watching the Dragon Clan’s actions. They have even sent people to the outer wall area to check it out.”
“A Saintess of the dragon clan is wandering outside. This is a good opportunity to get rid of her. They should be tempted.”The burly Elder’s eyes were deep, he said softly, “This is a good opportunity to see the performance of the three great demon-hunter families. Oh, right, has His Majesty returned?”
“Not yet.”Mogran shook his head.
The burly old man nodded slightly and did not say anything else.
At the same time, in a city in the inner wall area, Glenn dressed up as a noble lady. She was accompanied by two attendants, holding a snow-white fluffy puppy in their hands as they strolled on the street, they slowly walked to a remote street. There were armored soldiers stationed there, but there were not many of them, and they were sparse.
Glenn inadvertently glanced at them a few times. After seeing the defense situation clearly, she handed the puppy in her arms to a lackey. This lackey’s palm was rough, and there was a scar between his thumb and forefinger. It was obvious that he was not an ordinary lackey.
Glenn came to an uninhabited place and immediately used her magic marks power to dive into the earth.
After a short while, she arrived at the underground area where the soldiers were stationed. Soon, she saw a huge well that led to the depths of the underground. According to the description on the drawing, this well was the largest source of water in the city, it was connected to an underground reservoir.
Glenn dived to the side of the well and unscrewed the cap of the glass bottle in her arms. Then, she threw the bottle into the well.
When she was done, she immediately went back the way she had come, and soon she was back on the ground. She put on her bright coat, took the puppy from her attendant, and turned away.

chapters.title: Chapter 682
chapters.content:
Chapter 682 – Chapter 672: Two-In-One Chapter
“Barton, ask the previous architect to come over and build the temple again.”Dudian handed the new design to Barton, “This project is classified as top secret and can not be leaked out. The materials should be supplied through the highest priority channels. We must finish the construction as soon as possible.”
Dudian had noticed the negligence of the temple when Eleanor had sneaked in yesterday. Although he had placed cables and other defense equipment under the temple but the depth wasn’t enough, people who were good at drilling underground wouldn’t just lurk ten meters below the temple. In this way the power system would be useless.
Barton took the blueprint and immediately thought of the person who had sneaked in yesterday. His heart was cold as he turned around and left.
Neuss came in from outside and said to dudian: “Master, the alchemists have arrived.”
“Yes.”Dudian nodded: “Have the auxiliary hall on the west side of the square been vacated?”
“Yes.”Neuss said: “According to your instructions, there are all kinds of experimental equipment inside. They are the highest level of equipment.”
“Alright, let them go. give them these materials and let them make them as soon as possible.”Dudian took out a stack of materials from the two books next to the desk and handed it to Neuss, these were the materials he had written about the assembly of the parts of the biosensor. Now he only needed to steer the rudder. There were many things that he didn’t need to do personally. For example, he would leave the smelting of these parts to these alchemists, after all they were people who had studied science and technology for decades. They were experienced and there were some aspects that he couldn’t compare to them. It was the most suitable for them to be his assistants.
He was even prepared to take out some of the materials and hand them over to the masters in the temple to help him with the production.
Neuss took the materials and left. Dudian was thinking about the next item. The war was coming so he had to quickly produce a few items that would help him the most in the limited time, “There is a virus to replace the biological weapons. We can only rely on electricity to make weapons. The military’s artillery can improve a large range of weapons. The current equipment is not enough to make missiles. The purification technology of raw materials is not enough…”
He stopped the plan to continue to expand the new items. Weapons were not as good as weapons. It was better to use the things in his hands to the maximum.
He immediately began to write the detailed drawings of solar power generation according to the knowledge in the super chip.
“When will I be able to make a laser weapon…”Dudian thought. But he knew that he couldn’t even make a missile with the current technology, not to mention a laser weapon.
After Neuss came back, Dudian asked: “What is the situation of the military? Have the people from the slums moved to the civilian areas?”
“Young master, the military has sent a letter this morning saying that there is no room for people to live in the civilian areas. Almost all of the people from the slums are lining up to move to the civilian areas. The military is really worried about this!”
“What is there to worry about?”Dudian said: “As long as the people from the civilian areas meet the conditions, they can move to the commercial areas. Wouldn’t that make room?”
Neuss lowered his head: “Young Master You don’t know that there is a lot of friction when the poor moved to the civilian district. The military has sent most of their forces to maintain and suppress them but they are still unable to do so. There are too many people.”
“Richelieu doesn’t know about the number limit. They are only allowed to move 30,000 or 50,000 people a day. The military has more than 100,000 soldiers. Don’t tell me they can’t take care of tens of thousands of people?”Dudian raised his eyebrows.
Neuss was stunned: “Young Man you are smart. But how could richelieu not think of such a simple method? Strange.”
“It’s not that he doesn’t want to. He doesn’t dare to.”Dudian dipped the quill into the ink: “Tell him to be bold as long as he doesn’t go against my will.”
“I understand.”Neuss understood.
Barton came in from outside: “Master, your student Edward wants to see you. He wants to ask you a question.”
Dudian guessed what the student wanted to ask: “Let him go to the auxiliary hall to ask. Also tell him that he can freely go in and out of the hall.”
“Yes, Young Master.”Barton left the temple and went outside. Edward who had been waiting outside the temple immediately came up to him: “Pope, is teacher willing to see me?”
Barton said: “Your Teacher said that you should go to the auxiliary hall. As far as I know, there are a lot of extraordinary people who have come. Your question may be answered by them. Your teacher also said that you should learn from them.”
Edward was startled. He replied respectfully: “Thank You Pope.”
“Go.”Barton smiled.
Half an hour later, Dudian finished the drawing of the solar power. He stretched his body as his bones cracked. He looked out of the window in the direction of the wall of Sighs. Glenn hadn’t come back so he didn’t know how she was doing.
His eyes slightly flashed as he called Neuss: “Come with me and take a look at the situation outside.”
“Yes, Master.”
The carriage was soon ready. Dudian led Aisha and Neuss left the Uto Mountain to patrol the commercial district.
The inner wall of the Dragon Clan’s Holy Maiden Peak.
Hathaway was sitting on the throne carved with a dragon’s head. She coldly looked at the youth in front of her: “Eleanor hasn’t Come Back Yet? How long has she been in the outer wall? How long does it take for her to investigate a little devil? !”
The young man said in fear: “Your Highness, please spare my life, this has nothing to do with me!”
“HMPH!”Hathaway snorted and was about to speak when a figure suddenly walked into the hall. It was the white-faced middle-aged man. His face was as white as a dead man and he had a faint smile on his face, looking even more terrifying, he said to Hathaway: “Your Highness, there is no need to ask. Eleanor hasn’t come back yet, most likely she can’t come back. This means that the person in the outer wall is most likely her highness Aisha!”
Hathaway looked at him coldly, “How do you know, sir?”
“Eleanor is ranked twelfth on the assassin list. She is not going to assassinate, she is only going to investigate the situation. With her skills, even if the target is her highness Aisha, she will be able to find what she wants in five hours at most. She is not a fool, she will not lie in wait forever. An excellent assassin knows how to create opportunities for herself, not only know how to ambush.”The white-faced middle-aged man said: “More than half a day has passed and she still hasn’t sent back any news. We can basically confirm that she is already dead. Even if she isn’t dead, she is probably captured and become a prisoner.”
Hathaway narrowed her eyes, flashing with a cold light. Of course, she had expected this possibility, but it was precisely because of this that she was angry, suppressing her voice, she said: “Eleanor knows the gravity of the situation. I have already told her that the target might be Aisha. She will not expose herself so easily. Even if she can’t find out the situation, she will not be caught.”
The white-faced middle-aged man shook his head slightly, he said: “Your Highness, have you heard of an old saying? If you survive a great disaster, you will definitely have good fortune!”! “Her Highness Aisha did not die in the tide of corpses. According to my guess, it is most likely because she broke through her limit in the face of danger and forced out her potential. Her bloodline has awakened four times!”
Hathaway’s pupils constricted. She stood up from the throne in shock, “Impossible!”
“Nothing is impossible.”The white-faced middle-aged man’s expression was calm, he said: “The Awakening of bloodline power is inherently unstable. Usually, when emotions fluctuate to the extreme, there is a higher chance of awakening. This kind of situation, according to the history of the clan’s awakening, has long been calculated. Therefore, it is understandable that her highness Aisha was forced into a desperate situation in the tide of corpses, and then awakened her bloodline power to escape. Otherwise, with her condition at that time, the chance of surviving was too low, unless there were other experts to help her. But at that time, there was only one youth present. This youth was just trash, how could he help her?”
Hathaway’s face turned ugly. Although she didn’t want to admit it or believe it, she knew that it was very likely!
“Fourth awakening… damn it! !”She clenched her fists, her beautiful face full of anger and hatred, “Fourth awakening at the age of nineteen, faster than the once-in-a-century genius dragon mother, she must die! !”
The white-faced middle-aged man said: “If she has a fourth awakening and obtained some unknown special ability, it is understandable that she wants to kill Eleanor. No matter what, it is 80% certain that this person is her highness Aisha. We must attack as soon as possible, we can not give her any more time to grow. Moreover, we must kill her in one shot, we must not leave any hope!”
The malevolent expression on Hathaway’s face gradually darkened, she said: “I don’t need you to say it. The last time was already a certain death. She could still survive. This time, I want to completely, completely destroy any possibility of her survival!”
“Your Highness is wise!”
In the Dragon Clan’s Divine Hall, on a three to four meter wide scarlet bed, there was a beautiful young woman lying quietly. Her skin was smooth and delicate, and she wore a bright red robe. It was not blood red, but a blazing scarlet red, the hem of her robe covered the entire bed, making her body look extremely delicate and beautiful.
“I heard that Hathaway has been paying attention to the outer wall area recently?”The beautiful young woman asked softly.
The old woman who was waiting on the side said respectfully: “Miss, His Highness Hathaway secretly sent a maid to the outer wall area. I don’t know what she wants to do.”
“I heard that the monastery and the military have been paying attention to the outer wall area recently. Is there anything worth paying attention to in this small abandoned land?”Dragon Mother’s voice was gentle, revealing the purity and elegance of warm water.
The old woman said in a low voice: “Miss, why don’t I send someone to the outer wall area to check it out?”
Dragon mother lightly nodded and said: “How’s the selection of the candidate Saintess?”
“Reporting to miss, in terms of bloodline purity, we have not found anyone who can reach the level of her Highness Aisha.”The old woman said in a low voice: “We have only found one who is close to her Highness Hathaway, but there is still a gap. However, that child’s talent is not bad, a bit stronger than her Highness Hathaway. She is on par with her highness Aisha, maybe in the future she can make up for her lack of talent with hard work.”
The dragon mother’s gentle eyes suddenly became indifferent. After a moment of silence, she slowly said, “Little Lisa’s talent is the best in the history of our Dragon Clan. Unfortunately, I couldn’t protect her well. I’m guilty.”
The old woman quickly looked up and said, “Miss, you can’t say that. No one wants to see what happened to her Highness Aisha. If you want to blame someone, you can blame Miss Hathaway for being too reckless. She was so ruthless that she wanted her sister’s Life!”
“I didn’t discipline her well.”The dragon mother shook her head, “Originally, our Dragon Clan had the hope to break out of the wall. Now, we can only wait…”
The wrinkles on the old woman’s face all drooped together as she deeply sighed.
The sun slowly swayed across the sky, and night gradually descended.
Lights were lit up in the cities one after another, lighting up the night. Almost all the houses in the cities were lit up. Some housewives came to the well in the yard, carrying the vegetables and meat they had chosen. They put down the bucket, shook a bucket of water from the well, and began to clean the vegetables. After washing, they went back home, they cut the bread they had prepared and put in the fresh vegetables.
While the wife was preparing dinner, the husband also got off work from the factory. After a busy day, he didn’t want to say anything more. When he got home, he lay on the sofa. After resting for a while, he picked up the newspaper on the sofa and started to read, this was the only entertainment in the day.
The children who had finished their homework were already famished. They were looking forward to it at the dining table.
The wife brought the prepared dinner to the table one after another. She lit the oil lamp on the table. The dim yellow light of the candle shone on the faces of the family of three. They were happy and harmonious. The few of them put their hands together and finished reciting the blessing poem that came from the monastery. Then, they began to eat dinner.
Compared to the simple dinner of an ordinary family, the dinner of the nobles was much more magnificent. In the splendid and luxurious dining hall, crystal chandeliers hung high on the roof, illuminating the dining hall as if it was daytime.
Red wine and delicacies were served by the servants one after another.
When the dinner began, the master, who had been massaged by the servants, led the human slaves and dogs on the ground to the dining hall to eat.
The servants were busy serving her and serving her wine.
The human slave dog lay at the feet of the mistress and rubbed its head against her thigh. This was a skill that they had long mastered. As long as the mistress was comfortable with the rubbing, they would be rewarded with food.
Soon, the thigh of the lady, who was beautifully dressed, was rubbed until it was numb and comfortable. She smiled and used a knife to cut the untouched steak on the plate. She cut a piece of steak and put it on a plate. She bent down and handed it to the human slave dog at her feet.
The human slave dog stuck its tongue out and shook its head to express its joy.
In the hands of a noble, being a human slave dog was no less difficult than being a servant. First, it would undergo professional training to master the behavior and language of the human slave dog. It also had to make the human slave dog forget its original language.
As a human slave dog, no matter what happened, it could never speak.
“Gulp…”the human slave dog bit the steak on the plate and quickly swallowed it. Then, he expressed his gratitude and joy and rolled on the carpet at the side, shaking his head.
The noble lady giggled and covered her mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 683
chapters.content:
Chapter 683 – : Chapter 673: Success And Death [1St Update ]
Cough! Cough!
Suddenly, the young man who had just finished eating the steak lay on the ground and started coughing violently. He grabbed his throat with both hands as if he was going to spit out something that was stuck in his throat.
When the lady saw this, she rolled her eyes at him and said, “Useless thing. You can still choke after eating something.”
The human slave dog was still coughing violently. His face was flushed red from coughing and he raised his hand to cover his mouth.
The noble frowned and said, “Get lost. Go back to the punishment room and receive twenty strokes of the Whip.”After saying that, he kicked the boot with the embroidered pattern on it on his body.
The human slave dog acted as if he did not hear anything. His coughing became louder and louder. Gradually, the gap between his fingers that were covering his mouth was coughing so hard that liquid sprayed out and fell on the carpet. The noble lady thought it was saliva, and became more and more disgusted. She kicked him.
The young man suddenly stopped coughing and quietly lay on the ground.
The noble lady became more and more angry. She used the sharp part of the heel of her boot to kick his shoulder and neck. She did not care that this was a weak part of the human body, and it was very likely that she would kick him to death, as she kicked him, she said angrily, “I told you to get lost. Did you hear me? Did you hear me? !”
With a poof, the heel of her sharp and long high-heeled boots suddenly kicked into the young man’s neck. When she pulled back her foot, she immediately saw a bloody hole in his neck, but strangely, there was no blood spurting out from it.
When the noblewoman saw this, she hurriedly lifted her foot that was about to land and stepped on the young man’s shoulder. “You almost dirtied my carpet, you bastard!”
The young man’s neck twitched slightly, and the joints inside seemed to have hardened. It was extremely difficult for him to move. When he turned his head and looked up at the lady, the lady was instantly stunned. She saw that the young man’s face was covered in blood, he seemed to have coughed out from his mouth and was covered by his palm, causing blood to splash onto his face. At first glance, he looked like a beast that had just bitten a living creature.
“You…”
Roar!
The young man suddenly let out a sharp cry and pounced towards the noble lady.
The noble lady was so frightened that she screamed and cried out for help.
The surrounding servants were so frightened that they hurriedly pulled out their weapons and stepped forward to help.
At this moment, a little girl who was sitting at the end of the dining table suddenly pounced towards her brother beside her after coughing violently.
For a moment, the entire dining hall descended into chaos.
This chaos extended out from the ancient noble castle like moonlight. Terrified screams and scattered flames filled the entire outside of the ancient castle. The patrol road in the ancient castle manor was already filled with fighting, “Humans”wearing the same armor pounced on the people beside them with ferocious faces. The streets outside of the ancient castle wall were also extremely chaotic. The commoners cried and fled in all directions, numerous figures were baring their fangs and brandishing their claws as they chased in all directions..
Night, panic, Slaughter, and chaos filled every corner of the city.
A heart-wrenching scream spread to the wilderness outside the fortress and gradually became inaudible. In the vast grassland of the wilderness, a black figure was crawling rapidly like a spider. However, its head was a beautiful woman with snow-white skin. However, at this moment, its mouth was full of sharp teeth, and the corners of its mouth were so wide that they reached the ends of its ears, it looked as if its entire face had been torn apart. It was extremely ferocious. It crawled quickly toward the fortress and the chaotic city behind the fortress.
In the distance behind it, the wall of Sighs stood tall and silent. It was like a giant that did not care about the screams and tragedies around it.
In the outer wall of the wall, the streets were brightly lit. The taverns were very lively. The smell of food came from some small shops along the road, and the atmosphere was peaceful. The top of the Uto Mountain in the center of the commercial district was a bit cold. Although there were lanterns hanging outside the temple which made it seem as if it was daytime but there was a lack of people. The only sound that could be heard was from the auxiliary temple outside the square, from time to time there would be faint sounds of communication.
“Master, there is someone outside who wants to see you. He claims to be Glenn’s subordinate.”Neuss came to the temple and bowed to Dudian.
Dudian paused and said: “Call him in.”
“Yes, Young Master.”
Neuss turned and left. He quickly led a young man in black clothes to the temple. The young man’s head was half-bowed as he entered the temple. He didn’t dare to look at the front because he was afraid of offending the big figure. However his peripheral vision was scanning the surroundings as he looked at the most sacred temple in the outer wall.
Dudian didn’t say anything as he noticed the youth’s small movement: “Where is Glenn?”
The youth looked up and saw Dudian’s face. He was startled as he didn’t expect that the person who lived here wasn’t the pope but Dudian! As an assassin he would pay attention to some famous figures. He recognized Dudian’s identity at a glance. Wasn’t this the genius master who had disappeared for a period of time?
Why was he sitting in the temple?
He was puzzled but didn’t dare to ask. He whispered: “Sir, I am one of the assassins called by Glenn. My name is ‘Nuria’. Lord Glenn was accidentally exposed during the mission and died…”
“Died? !”Neuss was stunned as he looked at Dudian in disbelief.
Dudian’s heart sank: “Tell me what happened.”
Nuria half-kneeled on the ground: “We are going to release the poison at one of the locations. A big shot came. Glenn was killed on the spot.”
Dudian’s eyes were gloomy: “Which location?”
“The sixth mission point of the city of Victor.”Nuria lowered his head.
Dudian thought for a moment and remembered this place. It was a well for the military of the city of Victor. It was one of the more dangerous places. He was silent as he recalled the first time he met Glenn. At that time he was a primary hunter and helped her to kill the black weaver. Since then they had formed a friendship, after the collapse of Mellon consortium she was willing to follow him and didn’t choose other old consortia.
He didn’t expect that he would harm her this time.
The hall became dead silent as Dudian was silent.
Neuss looked up at dudian. His expression was complicated. He thought of Nuria and the anger in his heart suddenly found an outlet: “Why did you poison Glenn? Isn’t your task to help her? !”
Nuria’s face was pale as he kneeled on the ground: “Master Please spare my life. Glenn said that it was too dangerous. She was worried that we wouldn’t be able to fool the guards so she personally took action. I didn’t expect…”
“How did she die?”Dudian’s eyes were cold: “Do you remember the appearance of the person who killed her?”
Nuria quickly replied: “I remember. I saw his medal. He was a military officer. He was lying in ambush at the place where Glenn had broken out of the ground. He was waiting for Glenn to come out. Then he launched a sneak attack and cut off Glenn’s head…”
Dudian closed his eyes.
The scene almost appeared in front of his eyes.
He gently took a breath and slowly opened his eyes: “Have you completed the mission?”
Nuria quickly replied: “Sir, except for one location, the rest of the places have been completed.”
“Which location?”
“The fourth mission point of the city of Florida.”
“I know. You can leave first.”
Nuria was relieved to see that Dudian didn’t demote him. He carefully got up and left.
Neuss clenched his fist and said to dudian: “Master, Glenn’s death can not be let off like this!”
“Before the mission began, I thought that they would be sacrificed and would encounter danger.”Dudian’s words stunned Neuss. He looked at Dudian but saw that the teenager was looking at the dark night sky outside the window, his voice was as cold as the cold wind: “But I didn’t think that the one who would be sacrificed would be her.”
Neuss was silent. After all, this mission was to infiltrate the inner wall where there were many experts. It was very dangerous in itself. It was natural to have sacrifices. But among so many people.., it was fine to sacrifice any unknown person but she was the one who had to sacrifice.
He felt bad.
“Does Glenn have any relatives?”Dudian looked at Neuss.
Neuss understood what he meant: “Although she filled in the information as an orphan. But as far as I know she has a younger sister.”

chapters.title: Chapter 684
chapters.content:
Chapter 684 – Chapter 674: Revenge Sword [ Second Update ]
“Sister?”Dudian nodded, “How old is she?”
“She should be 16 years old this year. She is studying in a law school. I heard that her grades are good and she has always been the top student in her class.”Neuss said.
“You know it very well.”Dudian looked at him: “Take a thousand gold coins and go to see her. Tell her about Glenn. She has the right to know.”
Neuss was startled: “Master, what if she asks about the cause of Glenn’s death?”
“Then tell her the truth.”
“But…”Neuss carefully looked at him: “What if she doesn’t think it through and thinks that it was the task you gave her that caused her sister’s death? If she holds a grudge against You Then…”
“She is right to think so.”Dudian said: “She is not the only one who holds a grudge against me. The Dragon Clan, the military and the monastery all want me to die. I don’t care about these people so why should I be afraid of a Child?”
Neuss looked at him and suddenly felt sad. He didn’t say anything but turned around and left.
“Glenn…”Dudian quietly put down his pen and sighed. In addition to Mason and Zach, there were only Glenn, Neuss and Sergei, mason and Zach were still training at Hawkeye. It would take some time for them to help Dudian. Now that Glenn had died, there was one less person he could trust.
He suddenly felt that it was a mistake to involve Mason and Zach.
Although it was normal for them to live in peace, they might live to the end of their lives. But if they were to follow dudian, they would inevitably encounter danger. There were many secret missions and they could only send their most trusted people.
The word “Trust”also contained a kind of emotion.
He silently thought that since ancient times, all the people in power would face such a situation.
Sending the people they trusted the most to carry out the most dangerous mission!
This was like a theory!
“Could it be that, to the people in power, emotions are only a tool to win over People’s hearts?”He thought this and felt a little lost. Although he had achieved a heart of stone, if someone betrayed him, he would be ruthless, but those who trusted him and never betrayed him died under his orders. This was the first time he had experienced such a feeling.
And when he experienced it, he realized that there were some things that he thought, saw, and experienced that were completely different from what he felt. The thoughts that grew out of it were also completely different.
He turned his head to look at Aisha beside him, and a hint of warmth appeared in his cold eyes. But soon, he suddenly thought of a question. would there be a day when he encountered a powerful enemy that he needed to send her out to deal with in order to save his life?
At the thought of this, he suddenly felt a chill of fear. The gentleness in his eyes disappeared in an instant. He lowered his head and remained silent.
After a moment, he slowly sat up. The confusion in his eyes disappeared. He could not change the things that he would face as a ruler, but he knew that the only thing he could do was to become stronger! So strong that he had no enemies, he did not need to sacrifice the people around him to deal with it!
Time flew by.
Neuss returned to the temple at nine o’clock in the evening.
Dudian saw him: “How is it?”
Neuss bitterly smiled: “Master, I have been there and met her sister. But her sister insisted on coming to see you.”
Dudian was startled: “Bring her.”
“I have brought her.”Neuss said: “Should I invite her in?”
Dudian slightly nodded. His pupils slightly narrowed as he saw a heat source standing outside the temple.
Soon, a girl was brought in by Neuss.
Dudian looked at the girl and found that she looked similar to Glenn. However the lines on her cheeks were more beautiful, gentle and full of gentle temperament.
Dudian saw tears in her eyes: “I’m sorry that I harmed your sister.”
The girl looked up at Dudian who was sitting in front of the desk behind the steps. She shook her head: “It wasn’t you who killed my sister.”
Dudian looked at her: “Then why are you here?”
“I want to avenge my sister!”The girl looked at Dudian. The gentleness on her face quickly faded away. She looked cold and determined. Her temperament changed in the blink of an eye, “I hope you can help me for the sake of my sister!”
Dudian was surprised to see the change in her temperament. He frowned: “I will do the revenge. I promise you that I will avenge your sister!”
“No, I will personally take revenge!”The girl firmly said.
“No!”Dudian firmly refused, “Your sister has died because of me. I Can’t drag you down with me. You should go back and read your book. In the future your life will be very rich. When my matter is settled I will let you live the best life.”
“No!”The girl’s eyes were determined, word by word: “Even if you don’t help me, I will find a way. No matter how much time or how long it takes, I will find a way. Although I can think of a limited way, but I will definitely find that person to settle the score. If because I am too weak and was killed by him, I will not blame you!”
Dudian couldn’t help but look at the girl for a bit more. She was obviously forcing him to help her. But she was very tactful and made it difficult for him to refuse, most people would have broken down or filled their brains with hatred when they heard such news. But she was still thinking about how to help her, for her, revenge had already begun. Letting him help her was the first step of revenge!
Dudian frowned as he thought of this. He looked at her for a while and said: “Do you know that if you follow me, even if you take revenge, you might die!”
“I’m not afraid!”The girl said in a firm tone.
Dudian was silent: “Your Sister wants you to study law so that you can live a good life in the future. She is a hunter and has stained too much blood. She doesn’t want you to get involved. Do you want to go against your sister’s wishes?”
“Do you think I can live a good life?”The girl looked straight at dudian, “I spend my sister’s money and the money you give me. I buy food, clothes. Every time I eat, every time I see my clothes, I will think of my sister. I will think of the life she gave me in exchange for her life. How can I enjoy it so comfortably!”!
Dudian looked at her slightly wet eyes. His heart ached and he was speechless for a moment.
The girl seemed to see through Dudian’s thoughts, “Adult, you don’t have to worry about me. I know that you feel guilty for harming my sister. You are worried that you will harm me again. Please rest assured. If I die, I will be blamed for not being proficient. It is not your fault. Adult, don’t take it to heart. Please treat me as a sharp sword in your hand. Please Polish me so that I can kill people! Revenge! If one day this sword is broken and embroidered… you can just throw it away and find a better sword.”
Dudian’s heart was shocked as he looked at her. He saw a pair of bright but cold eyes.
He thought for a long time before he slowly opened his mouth, “I know. Since you insist, I will use the best resources and ask the best teacher to teach you. I will never let you follow in your sister’s footsteps. I will definitely make you the sharpest sword in the world. I will cut down all the ugliness and inferiority in the world!”
The girl’s eyes lit up. She knelt down and kowtowed: “Thank You, my Lord!”
Dudian didn’t know whether his decision was right or wrong. But things had already come to this point. He didn’t want to continue to consider. Hesitating wasn’t his style. He said: “Get Up. What’s Your Name?”
“My name is ‘Aurora’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 685
chapters.content:
Chapter 685 – Chapter 675: Caged Beast [ First Watch ]
“Aurora…”Dudian silently read and said to Neuss: “Get Someone to arrange for him to rest in the side hall.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss nodded.
Dudian said to Neuss: “Get the top three assassins to train her.”
Neuss hesitated for a moment: “Master, she is the only relative of Glenn. She is the one who wants to protect the most. Are We…”
“Are you worried that she will follow in Glenn’s footsteps?”Dudian saw through Neuss’s thoughts, “Revenge is not a simple word. She is just an ordinary person. If she wants to surpass her sister, she will need a lot of hard training. What are people most afraid of?”? “It is to endure hardship. Ninety-nine percent of the people in this world are lazy. It is unavoidable for everyone to be lazy. If it is just a moment of anger, under the harsh training, it will slowly fade over time. If she cowers, we have a reason to let her leave and return to her original life.”
Noyce smiled bitterly and said, “I don’t think this little girl is like an ordinary child. I don’t think she is just saying that. If she persists…”
“Then we have no reason to stop her.”Dudian continued: “Even if we stop her now she will do something unexpected and stupid in her anger. It is better to give her hope. If she can persevere then we won’t be able to shake her determination.”
Neuss understood that Dudian wanted her to retreat. In order to take revenge she had to go from an ordinary person to a top killer. The path was too long and hard, anger and hatred, including love, would fade with time. This was probably the most terrible part of time!
He sighed in his heart.
After Neuss left, Dudian wrote to Raven to send a letter to Richelieu. Now everything was ready. The inner wall was in chaos and the slums were about to be cleared out. It was time to lead the barbarians into the wall, the Barbarians would become his power during the war.
He planned to leave this matter to Richelieu. It had been a long time since he had returned from the Barbarian Mountain. He didn’t know if the youth named Ian would be able to suppress the Barbarians and sit on his throne. However it didn’t matter even if he couldn’t sit still. He was his solid backing. With the assistance of the military he could immediately support a new puppet as king.
“This night is a little long…”he looked at the wall of sighs in the distance and remained silent.
After Noyce returned, he asked Noyce to summon Nuria, who had left earlier, and asked him to bring people to observe the movements of the inner wall. If all the target points had been poisoned, the inner wall would probably be in chaos by now.
On the barbarian mountain outside the fortress, the hills were tall and dark. The Barbarians liked to live in caves. They could avoid the attacks of wild beasts, but they could also avoid the cold. Only a few sheds on the top of the mountain were emitting the faint light of oil lamps, iannar sat in the chief’s tent, drinking wine. His eyes were gloomy. He could hardly sleep these days. After killing his father to take his place, he was attacked by an assassin on the first night.
Fortunately, he was on guard and was not injured. This assassin was sent by one of his uncles to avenge his father.
Although he covered up the cause of his father’s death, he could not hide it from everyone. At this moment, there were seven or eight teams patrolling outside his tent. He did not sleep through the night, but he still could not sleep in peace.
He suddenly felt that this position was not as comfortable as he had imagined. There seemed to be many needles below him. If he relaxed his body slightly, these needles would stab him.
“Clan leader, that kid inside the wall said that he will let us move inside the wall. Do you think this is a conspiracy of the people inside the wall?”A woman wearing animal clothes and covered in animal teeth said from inside the tent, her face was painted with the patterns of worshiping the gods. Her skin was dark and full of valiant and heroic spirit.
IANNARAL narrowed his eyes, he said word by word, “Don’t worry about this matter. When the day comes, I will send a part of my people into the wall with me to inspect the situation first. If it is true, you will take the rest of your clansmen and leave this place immediately. You will hide here and accumulate strength. When the time comes in the future, you will fight inside the wall and take revenge for us!”
“Chief, are you going in person?”? “Isn’t this too dangerous?”Another strong man with a huge axe scar on his shoulder frowned and said, “The various tribes have already submitted. With our current strength, why should we listen to that Brat inside the wall? Even if we can’t beat him inside the wall, can he still kill us all?”? “This is our world outside the border. Let him try!”
Iannard looked at him: “Don’t talk nonsense. That man is not an ordinary person. His strength is far beyond your imagination. Even a warrior of Tumu might not be able to block a punch from him.”
“So Strong? !”The burly man was shocked.
Iannard said in a cold tone: “If I didn’t have such strength, how could I be willing to be his puppet?”
The people in the tent looked at each other in silence.
The night was getting darker.
Dudian and Neuss arranged for the alchemists from the dark church to come over to make the solar power station. There were footsteps coming from outside the square. Dudian looked up and knew that Gwyneth had come back.
He stopped and waited for Gwyneth to enter.
“Young master, I’m back.”Gwyneth respectfully said to Dudian as she entered the temple.
Dudian frowned as he saw that her clothes were a bit torn: “Did someone attack you?”
Gwyneth shook her head: “Master, I have completed the task that you asked me to do. I found the tungsten cage that you mentioned. There are two monsters inside. One big and one small. They are trapped inside and are on the verge of death.”
Dudian was relieved. It seemed that the two splitters were trapped in the cage and didn’t leave. He was pleased and surprised that the splitter didn’t break out of the cage, logically speaking, after such a long period of growth, it should have entered the mature stage. It would be easy for it to break out of the tungsten cage.
“I wanted to take a closer look. But a monster suddenly jumped out of the cage. It was like a hedgehog. Its body was covered with soft and wet limbs. It wanted to kill me. Fortunately, master gave me the God’s marrow so that I could break out of the cage. I didn’t dare to stay and ran all the way back.”Gwyneth said.
Dudian asked: “Do you recognize the monster that attacked you?”
Gwyneth shook her head: “I don’t. I think I can find information about it in the Atlas of monsters in the inner wall.”
“It seems that it is not an ordinary rare monster. It might not even be a rare monster…”Dudian murmured, he looked at Neuss: “You stay here and wait for me to come back. The rest of the small matters will be settled by Barton. Gwyneth, come with me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 686
chapters.content:
Chapter 686 – : Chapter 676: New Species [ Second Watch ]
Dudian took Aisha and Gwyneth down the mountain. They climbed over the fortress and headed towards the passage of the giant wall.
Gwyneth was running at full speed but found that she could barely keep up with Dudian’s pace. She was shocked because she was a limiter now, but she didn’t expect that the distance between them was getting farther and farther.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The three of them came to the passage of the giant wall. There were no knights of light guarding the passage. Dudian asked Barton to remove the people guarding the passage so that Gwyneth could come in and out. But if there were monsters sneaking into the giant wall.., it would be difficult to detect.
Dudian opened the iron plate on the ground and entered the familiar passage of the giant wall. There was a smile on the face of the goddess carved on both sides of the passage. She looked a bit mysterious under the flickering lights.
Dudian let Gwyneth lead the way out of the passage.
After half an hour, the three of them came to a lush plain. There were collapsed buildings in the messy grass. However, they were pierced by the tenacious grass and branches. They looked like a giant who had fallen to the ground, their bodies were full of worms.
Dudian wiped the dagger from his hand. It was covered with the blood of monsters who had come out to hunt. He put away the dagger and hid in the grass. He quietly approached the front. His vision had caught three groups of heat sources, two of them were together and slightly squirmed. The other group of heat sources was very large. It was like a giant ball with a diameter of about 13-14 meters. However the heat source’s reaction was weak. It was like a dim sunset, the heat source’s density was similar to that of an intermediate hunter.
Gwyneth pointed to the front.
Dudian squinted his eyes. Although it was dark but he could still see a huge cage in the grass. There were two monsters lying in the cage. One was big and the other was small. They were the two splitters that he had imprisoned in the cage.
Half a year had passed but the two little splitters hadn’t changed much. According to normal growth they should be more than three times the size of the cage but they were squeezed in the cage, the tungsten steel cage was like a black net that bound them. Their flesh was squeezed out of the hole, making it difficult for them to move.
Seeing this, Dudian suddenly understood why they didn’t break out of the cage. Under such circumstances, it was difficult for them to twist their bodies, let alone attack the cage, moreover, it was estimated that it was already very difficult for them to grow to this stage. The scarcity of food, coupled with the shackles of the cage, had made their development become abnormal.
Dudian suddenly felt a trace of cruelty. But he knew that it was his instinct to sympathize with the cruel scene in the cage.
Hiss!
At this time, the two little splitters in the cage suddenly let out a wail. It sounded like a threat or a plea. Their bodies were struggling to wriggle. The flesh and blood outside the cage were squeezed, the hard outer shell of their bodies seemed to degenerate and become fragile.
At this time, Dudian saw a huge black shadow slowly approaching from outside the cage. It was like a giant black ball. It was emitting strands of black limbs. If it wasn’t for its huge size, it would have looked like a head full of hair, countless strands of hair floated in the air.
However, these “Hair”were incomparably thick. They were as big as bowls. They were emitting an evil and terrifying aura as they twisted and stretched towards the two little splitters in the cage.
The two little splitters screamed and struggled violently. However, they were still approached by the black limbs. A few of the black limbs suddenly pierced into the cage and went through the flesh and blood in the hole.
The two splitters screamed in pain.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He had never seen this giant black ball monster. He had never seen it even in the monster atlas of the inner wall, there was no monster with such a strange shape!
“Is this a new mutated species?”Dudian’s heart was moved. The Monster Atlas was always updated to record the information of the latest mutated monsters. Obviously, the information of this monster hadn’t been recorded by the Monster Institute.
As he was thinking, the struggle of the two splitters became more and more intense. The cage shook and turned over on the ground.
A few black limbs were pressed under the cage and quickly retracted. The rest of the black limbs swarmed up and pierced through the holes outside the cage to wrap the entire cage. If the people with agoraphobia saw this scene, they would have been scared to death.
Dudian didn’t wait any longer. He was ready to attack. If he continued to attack then the parasitic soul worms of the two young splitters would be gone.
Just as he was about to get up, the black limbs suddenly retracted and put the cage on the ground.
Dudian was startled. From the heat source, the two young splitters didn’t die. Why would it suddenly stop?
At this time, the giant black ball slowly rolled towards the distance. It seemed that it had given up on killing the two splitters.
Dudian was even more puzzled. Suddenly, he noticed that the two splitters seemed to be on the verge of death. Their spirit was weak and their bodies seemed to have become smaller. The flesh and blood outside the cage had become much thinner, the most important thing was that there were no wounds on the bulging parts. Not a drop of blood flowed out!
Dudian was startled for a moment. He suddenly realized that the new mutated species should be some kind of blood-sucking monster. The limbs that previously penetrated the body of the splitty had the effect of leeches, it was eating the blood of the host.
No wonder it didn’t kill them. Apparently it had treated them as its own blood bag!
Dudian didn’t stay any longer as he saw that it was about to leave. He said to Gwyneth: “You wait here.”He shook the bell and quickly chased after it with Aisha.
The giant black ball noticed that Dudian and Aisha were chasing after it. Its body slowly stopped and a large number of black limbs were emitted from its body. It quickly shot towards Dudian and Aisha as if they were prey.
Dudian snorted and shook the bell to let Aisha attack.
Roar!
