Aisha growled and increased her speed. She suddenly jumped onto the black monster and bit its black limbs.
The Black Monster’s body immediately caved in. The surrounding black limbs swarmed up and closed Aisha’s body as if they were embracing her.
Dudian saw through the heat reaction that there was a human figure missing from the Black Monster’s body. Aisha had entered its body and it seemed that it had taken the initiative to send her into its body!
What kind of structure was this?
It wanted to digest her?
Dudian growled and pulled out the dagger. He activated the power of magic marks and white bones gushed out of his body. It looked like a skeleton. He roared and grabbed one of the black limbs. He used it to pounce on its body and ruthlessly stabbed it with the dagger.
As soon as he stabbed it, he felt as if he had stabbed into a giant jelly. The body of this thing was very elastic.

chapters.title: Chapter 687
chapters.content:
Chapter 687 – Chapter 677: The Beginning Of Hell [ Two In One, Ggg ]
The dagger immediately entered the body of the black monster without much resistance. At the same time, Dudian felt a sticky suction force from his chest. It was pulling him into the body of the Black Monster.
“Do you want to swallow me?”Dudian’s face slightly changed. He immediately slapped the surface of the black monster’s body. At the same time, he activated the broken wings on his back. He flapped them and pulled the body out inch by inch.
However, the black monster seemed to be aware of his intention. Its body suddenly secreted a large amount of sticky and smooth liquid. The suction force from its body was even stronger. It was like a wriggling swamp.
Dudian’s palm was stuck on the surface of the black monster’s body and slowly sank into it. His face changed. He wanted to pull his hand out but his palm was firmly held by an invisible suction force from its body. It was difficult to pull out just by relying on the pull force from the broken wings, if he used the power of his body, it would instead create a reverse thrust force that would cause his body to sink faster.
At this critical moment, he forced himself to calm down. He glanced to the side and saw Aisha’s body sinking deeper into the monster’s body. She was struggling violently, struggling left and right in her body, however, it seemed to have no effect. Instead, he let his body sink faster and slowly approached the center of the monster’s body.
Dudian’s heart tightened. He felt a bit of danger. The monster’s heat response was average, but its body structure was extremely special. He felt that he had nowhere to use his strength. Even Aisha, who was far stronger than him.., couldn’t do anything about it.
Could it be that only by letting her release all of her strength could she have a chance to escape this disaster? Dudian’s heart was filled with killing intent. He didn’t expect to encounter such a troublesome monster in such a place close to the giant wall. If it wasn’t necessary, he didn’t want to see Aisha release all of her strength, moreover, she frequently released her strength. It was easy for her to lose control in the absence of deep reflexes training.
While he was hesitating, he suddenly felt that the palm of the monster’s body was slippery. No matter how he clenched his fists and scratched, it was useless. The tissues in the monster’s body were not like the flesh of ordinary creatures, it was like a soft mud.
He turned to Gwyneth who was squatting in the dark grass and shouted: “Come on, use fire!”
Gwyneth didn’t expect that dudian would ask her for help. She was surprised and rushed out of the grass. She took out a match and lit it. She took out a kerosene torch and ran to fifty meters away from the black monster, “What should I do?”She shouted
“Throw the torch to me!”Dudian shouted.
Gwyneth looked at the monster with black limbs. She hesitated for a moment but still rushed out.
The black ball monster felt Gwyneth’s approach. Its body suddenly trembled as it crawled forward.
Dudian was happy to see its reaction. He knew that there was a chance.
Gwyneth quickly approached and threw the torch at Dudian.
Whoosh! The black body of the black ball monster suddenly swung the torch. Sparks flew as the torch was extinguished. Its black body shrank back as if it was scalded.
Dudian’s face slightly changed as he saw the extinguished torch. However he shouted at Gwyneth: “Give Me the match!”
Gwyneth was aware that the monster was afraid of fire. She looked at the messy black limbs. She was scared but she mustered up the courage to jump towards Dudian.
The black ball monster waved its limbs and hit the black limbs of the previous torch. It looked like a scalded child who was holding his fingers and blowing. Gwyneth didn’t care about it.
Gwyneth jumped accurately and landed under Dudian’s feet. She immediately threw the match to Dudian.
Dudian quickly grabbed the match box. His fingers nimbly opened the box and took out a match. He pinched the match box with two fingers. The two fingers rubbed the match.
The black ball monster was shocked as it felt the temperature of the match. All of its black limbs were attacking Dudian.
Dudian didn’t give it a chance. He put his finger on the flame of the firewood. The flame immediately ignited his finger. The Hand had been sucked into the monster’s body and was stained with a wet liquid, at this moment, it was on fire. The flame burned the entire palm. It looked like he had practiced the flame palm.
Dudian didn’t feel pain. His face didn’t change. He took advantage of the time when the palm was burning to stick to the body of the Black Monster. His fingertips slightly bent and pierced into its body.
Whoosh!
As his fingers pierced into the monster’s body, a fierce flame suddenly burst out and lit up Dudian’s eyes. The next moment, there was a loud bang and the black monster’s body suddenly exploded, the hot air wave and the impact of the explosion sent Dudian flying. The world was spinning rapidly and the burning sensation spread throughout his body. It was as if he was in a sea of fire. The intense pain came from his face and chest.
He felt his body hit the ground and almost fainted from the pain. However, he didn’t care about the pain. He quickly opened his eyes and saw that the body of the black monster had exploded into pieces, it scattered on the ground and ignited the nearby weeds into a pile of fire.
There was a rare panic on his calm face. He looked around anxiously and soon saw a figure climbing up from the grass. It was Aisha.
He rushed over and didn’t notice that his body was also burning.
Aisha turned her head to look at Dudian. She roared and pounced on him.
Dudian was shocked and quickly shook the bell. Aisha’s body stopped. The next moment, Dudian threw her down and rolled on the ground. He carried her and drilled into the sand. Soon, the flames on his and Aisha’s bodies were drowned by the sand and gradually extinguished.
Dean stood up and saw Haisha lying in the sand motionlessly. He slowly helped her up and saw that her clothes were charred black and tattered. There were many burns on her pale skin.
His heart ached and he held her in his arms.
Haisha stood in a daze and let him embrace her.
After a moment, Dean’s mood gradually calmed down. The burning pain in his body made him slightly grimace. He looked down at himself and found that his condition was also terrible. His chest was charred black and his clothes were burned, there were different degrees of severe burns on the skin of his chest. His body was trembling in pain and his face was pale.
At this time, he suddenly thought of Gwyneth. He quickly looked around and saw a weak heat source lying on the grass. He rushed over and saw Gwyneth lying on the ground like a Burning Man, her whole body was burning.
He quickly covered her body with sand and put out the flames. After he put out the flames, he saw that Gwyneth’s body was almost charred. She was on the verge of death and had already fainted.
Dudian saw that her heart was still beating weakly. He was relieved and turned her body around. He saw that the first aid kit on her back had been burned and the things inside were scattered all over the ground, only a few bottles and jars were still intact.
He picked up the bottles and jars. They were boiling hot. He opened them and poured out the powder. He sprinkled it on Gwyneth’s body as if he was sprinkling cumin on barbecued food.
He didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. After he finished sprinkling the powder, he picked up Gwyneth and returned to Aisha’s side. He gently put her down and turned to look at the place where the monster exploded. There were only some fur and black limbs on the ground, these black limbs were not stiff. They were still wiggling like a poisonous snake with its head cut off.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He didn’t expect to meet an unknown monster and almost lose his life. Fortunately, his guess was right. The greasy things in the monster’s body were mainly made of fat. It was best to attack with fire, if it was a one-on-one encounter, once it was sucked into its body, even a pioneer wouldn’t be able to escape death!
Although the monster’s movement speed and strength were average, but being able to flexibly dissolve all of its strength was the most terrifying thing. He couldn’t help but think of an old Chinese saying, ‘good is like water’, this monster was obviously using the flexibility of water to the extreme. Even if its strength was as strong as Aisha’s, it would be difficult to hurt it. Instead, it would be trapped and slowly digested in its body.
“What a terrifying monster…”Dudian was secretly afraid. He didn’t know how the new species evolved or how it crossed the wasteland and came to the area that had been cleared out.
He took a gentle breath and endured the burning pain in his body. He slowly came to the center of the explosion. The monster’s body had completely exploded. There was a big pit on the ground. It was charred black and nothing was left.
He took a deep look and remembered the appearance of the monster.
Gwyneth woke up. She snorted and wrinkled her face in pain.
Dudian immediately went back to her and picked her up. He took Aisha and went back to the tungsten cage. He looked at the two little splitters who were struggling in the cage. There was a trace of sigh in his eyes, “Since it is so painful to live, let’s end it.”
He once again activated the power of magic marks. White bone armor emerged from his body. He put Gwyneth down and went straight to the cage. He opened the cage but the two splitters seemed to have grown in the cage, there was still no reaction and he didn’t know how to climb out.
After being imprisoned for a long time, he seemed to have forgotten what freedom was.
Dudian clenched his teeth. He endured the injuries on his body and quickly took action. He pulled the two young splitters out of the cage and quickly killed them.
The two young splitters wailed and fought back. However, their strength was very different. Moreover, they had been imprisoned for a long time. Their limbs were extremely stiff. The sharp scythes outside their bodies had become extremely fragile, it seemed that the hard calcium inside the scythes had been grinded.
Dudian killed them and quickly dismembered them. Soon, he found two parasitic soul worms inside their bodies.
He sighed in his heart. The healthy little splitty had chased him into the wall and treated him as one of its own kind. This was an emotion that came from the blood. He could feel it from its body, but he also knew that.., after all, it was a ferocious monster. Violence and killing were its nature! He had once considered taming it. In the future, it would become a trump card in his hands to help him kill his enemies.
But looking at its current appearance, it was obviously no longer worth taming. At the end of the day, it was just a tool. It was just like how snake tamers, even if they had tamed a venomous snake, would prevent its bestial nature from acting up and bite them back. How many people would dare to sleep with a venomous snake or beast?
The difference in species seemed to mean that there was no trust from the very beginning.
Just like the difference in class within the wall, there was no fairness from the very beginning.
He put the two parasitic soul worms into the bottle that was floating in the air and prepared to change into a potion bottle that was specially used to store parasitic soul worms when he returned to the wall. He turned around and picked up Gwyneth. He shook the bell and returned to the wall with Aisha.
Before he left, he looked back at the explosion in the distance. There was a trace of darkness in his eyes. He had an inexplicable ominous feeling in his heart.
It was late at night. Dudian quickly moved forward. When he arrived at the outskirts of the fortress, he sneaked into a tailor’s shop and stole three sets of clothes. He changed them for Aisha, Gwyneth, and himself before continuing to move forward.
Dudian asked Neuss to call the priest to treat Gwyneth. He also prepared healing potions for her.
He soaked Aisha’s body in the wooden basin. He washed her body and helped her change into clean clothes. At the same time the priest came and took Gwyneth for treatment. He also washed her body with potions, while applying the healing ointment, he said to Neuss: “Ask Sergei to bring a few trustworthy people to the west side of the giant wall. There are two dead monsters there. Let him drag them back. Remember to keep it a secret.”
Neuss saw that Dudian was so cautious. He guessed that the two monsters must be extraordinary. Otherwise, it would be impossible for Dudian to be injured so badly, it was the first time he saw Dudian in such a sorry state. Moreover, Aisha who was able to kill the pioneers was also seriously injured. It was clear that the danger they encountered outside the giant wall was beyond his imagination.
He immediately accepted the order and turned around to find someone to explain.
Neuss returned to the temple after a moment. He looked at Dudian who had applied the ointment and wrapped his body. He saw that Dudian was still sitting in front of the desk, he couldn’t help but worry: “Master, it’s late. You are seriously injured. You should rest early.”
“The enemy hasn’t rested. I don’t have time to rest.”Dudian said. He really wanted to lie down and sleep. But he couldn’t afford to be careless at the critical moment, he asked: “Is there any news from the inner wall?”
“Ten minutes before you came back, Nuria came and said that the inner wall was in chaos. There was an outbreak of the undead plague. Many people were infected and turned into undeads. The streets were in chaos.”Neuss immediately reported, he couldn’t help but look at Dudian. It was obvious that this result was caused by Dudian. It was what he needed. It was just that he was too generous. He didn’t care about the lives of countless people.
Dudian nodded slightly: “Call the two best priests and doctors. I have to fully recover by tomorrow night.”
Neuss was startled: “Master, what are you doing?”
“I wanted to sneak into the inner wall and catch some people from their research institute. But it seems that it won’t work.”Dudian said: “I can’t Wait for Tomorrow!”
Neuss thought of the last time Dudian mentioned about the witcher. He immediately knew his intention: “I will go.”
“Chaos…”Dudian looked out of the window as he muttered: “Nobles have become undeads. Let’s see how you will respect them.”
The towering wall of sighs separated the two places. The city stretched for hundreds of miles. There were chaotic screams and screams. Some of the wooden houses were burnt down and collapsed. The women were running away in panic, the children were pressed down. The children’s painful voices were particularly loud in the night. Beside them were figures who were running away in panic. No one reached out to help, but the cries attracted the ferocious figures who were walking behind them, they pounced on the survivors like evil ghosts.
The once prosperous streets were now completely in chaos, like hell on Earth.
The night quietly spread over the cities, and the moonlight coldly shone on the land.

chapters.title: Chapter 688
chapters.content:
Chapter 688 – : Chapter 678: Enter The City [ First Watch ]
Time flew by and another day passed in the blink of an eye.
After the treatment of several priests and doctors, his internal injuries had completely healed. The skin on his face and chest had been healed by the special medicine provided by the alchemists of the dark church, although the process of making the medicine by these alchemists was inhuman and cruel. They used living people to do experiments but the effects of the medicine were extraordinary.
Dudian called Neuss after dealing with Barton. He asked him to stay with Barton to take charge of the overall situation. The outer wall wasn’t peaceful these days, although the problem of the migration of the poor wasn’t as fierce as it was in the beginning but there was still a lot of controversy. However because of the pressure of the Holy See and the military there wasn’t too obvious.
“Don’t tell anyone that I’m going to the inner wall.”Dudian said to the two: “No matter what the problem is, calm down and wait for me to come back.”
“Yes, Master.”Barton nodded.
Neuss replied to dudian: “Master, are you going alone?”
“Two people.”Dudian said: “Don’t worry.”
Neuss didn’t say anything more.
Dudian changed into his stealth armor and put on the splitter’s blade. He left the mountain with Aisha and went to a quiet place in the suburbs, they went straight to the edge of the giant wall. There were few people near the giant wall. Most of them lived in old villages and small towns. Most of them were old people and children. The young people had left the village to work in the commercial district, at night, the village was pitch black. Only a few houses were lit up.
Dudian brought Aisha to the giant wall. He activated the broken wings on his back and grabbed Aisha’s arm to climb up the giant wall.
The wind on the giant wall was a bit strong. Aisha’s hair was blowing in the wind. She was not injured in the explosion but her clothes were burned. Her body was protected by dragon scales unlike Dudian and Gwyneth, she was directly burnt.
Dudian led her along the giant wall towards the inner wall. Along the way he looked at the gray clouds above his head and the desolate night scene outside the right wall. He could vaguely see some monsters crawling in the dark, from time to time there were sharp screams which were extremely loud in the wilderness.
Dudian’s nervous heart gradually calmed down. His eyes fell on Aisha from time to time. Her face was expressionless. There was no emotion in her pure black eyes. She seemed to be in a daze, she seemed to be thinking about something.
Dean tightened his fingers and whispered: “We will find a way to let you recover when we get to the Monster Institute.”
Aisha was silent.
Dean’s footsteps gradually sped up. Soon he saw that the wall of sighs was less than half of the giant wall. He found that the number of soldiers stationed there was less than half of what he had seen before, it seemed that the chaos in the inner wall was more serious than he had expected. It was estimated that the military had already had a difficult time dealing with it.
He lowered his body and dived over the place where the wall of sighs was erected with Aisha. They continued to move forward for more than two thousand meters before they jumped down from the giant wall and landed on the grass. He pulled Aisha into the next official road. He thought that he must not meet the pioneer woman here. He hoped that she had already touched the city.
After walking more than 30 miles along the official road, Dudian suddenly heard the sound of horse hooves. He immediately stopped and looked into the distance. He saw a group of carriages. There were three carriages and more than a dozen horses. It didn’t look like an army.
When they were close enough, Dudian saw that there was a pattern totem on the three carriages. Although he hadn’t seen the pattern of the totem, but this kind of dress was very similar to the nobles in the outer wall. The armor of more than ten knights who were escorting the carriages were engraved with the same shoulder emblem as the pattern totem.
A trace of black light flashed through Dudian’s eyes. He saw the heat in the bodies of these knights and found that the strongest one was only a high-level limiter. He was relieved and walked towards the convoy.
The blonde middle-aged knight who was leading the convoy quickly noticed Dudian and Aisha on the road. He immediately pulled the rope and slowed down. he shouted: “Who is it? !”
Dean waited for him to stop and asked: “It’s so late. Where are you going?”
“Why do you care? !”The middle-aged knight shouted, he suddenly noticed Aisha. Aisha was wearing a veil. Dean had specially made a cheongsam for her. It was very suitable for her.
The middle-aged Knight’s eyes flashed with surprise as he saw Aisha’s dress. He had heard some rumors about this unique style of clothing.
Dudian noticed the change in the middle-aged Knight’s eyes: “Aren’t you afraid of being attacked by wild beasts when you leave the city at night?”
The middle-aged knight turned to look at Dudian. He was about to speak when an urgent voice came from the carriage: “Why are you still stopping? Run!”
“Yes, Master.”The middle-aged knight turned back to the carriage and respectfully nodded. He turned back to dudian: “Please step aside. There is an outbreak of the plague in the city. I advise you to leave as soon as possible. Don’t go back to the city.”
“Did you come out to escape?”Dudian didn’t say anything more.
The middle-aged knight patted his mount and rode past Dudian. He led the carriage forward.
Dudian continued to lead Aisha. According to Gwyneth’s drawings, he remembered that there was a city called Carmen more than ten miles away. The Monster Institute that he was looking for tonight was in this city.
Ten minutes later, Dudian saw a fortress in the distance. It was in front of the plain. The gate of the fortress was completely open. There were some black shadows wandering in front of the gate. Although Dudian didn’t see them clearly but he recognized that they were undeads. He had seen too many of them walking in this way.
“It seems that the fortress has fallen.”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He had arranged people to poison the drinking water sources of the fortresses. It seemed that it had worked, there were still some people fighting in the fortress. At the same time there were roars and screams.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. Most of the city in front of him had turned into a sea of corpses. He didn’t know if the monster institute would be able to withstand it. However he didn’t send people to poison the water sources near the Monster Institute, if they were aware of the situation outside and used the institute as a cover they should be able to withstand it for a period of time.
After all, apart from the researchers who specialized in studying monsters, there were also some powerhouses in the Monster Research Institute.

chapters.title: Chapter 689
chapters.content:
Chapter 689 – Chapter 679: Corpse City [ Second Update ]
Dudian took out the undead powder that he had prepared in his Fanny Pack and smeared it on his armor. The strong smell of decay spread out and covered his own smell. He used the dragon blood spell to control the blood flow rate in his body to reduce the heat, then he held Aisha’s hand and walked straight to the fortress.
The undeads that were wandering outside the fortress seemed to feel something and slowly stopped.
Dudian looked at their pale faces. Some of the undeads had blood stains on their mouths. They were staring at him.
Dudian was calm. He had brought the highest level of undead powder. Even if the bodies of the undeads were different from ordinary people, they would be able to muddle through.
He directly walked over. At this time, the undeads suddenly moved. They didn’t pounce on Dudian but avoided him. They hid on both sides of the road as if they were afraid of something.
Dudian was startled. Suddenly, he thought of Aisha. were the undeads afraid of her?
When he came to the front of the fortress, a soldier fell from the front of the fortress. His body violently hit the ground. He spat out a mouthful of blood. There was a big bite mark on his arm. At the moment, he was seriously injured.
He saw Dudian and Aisha coming towards him. He was scared and quickly got up. He was about to make a move when he saw Dudian’s complexion was ruddy and white. It was completely different from the pale undeads. Moreover, his eyes were calm, dean wasn’t filled with bloodthirsty eyes. He was stunned: “You, you are a human? !”
His eyes slowly turned and looked at the trembling corpse behind Dean. His whole person was stunned. This scene was too strange.
Dean pushed his body and held Dean’s hand as they went through the open door behind him. He didn’t pay attention to the injured soldier. After he entered the fortress, the screams of the wounded soldiers echoed through the night sky.
Dudian and Aisha walked forward. From time to time, there would be a few undeads in armor rushing towards them. However, when they got close to them, they stopped and trembled.
Dudian noticed the strange reaction of the undeads. Obviously, the reaction of the undeads was probably because of Aisha. But what puzzled him was that the undeads had no consciousness or even thought, they didn’t know pain and fear, but why would they be afraid of Aisha? After all, having a “Commander’s consciousness”meant that they had thought!
However, the fact that the undeads had no consciousness had been proven countless times. Even if they were faced with monsters that were countless times stronger than them, they would still fearlessly pounce on them.
“Could it be that the only thing that can make them afraid is their own kind?”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He felt that there should be some deeper secrets hidden in the undeads. Perhaps this kind of secret had already been revealed.., it was just that no one was aware of it. It was like an era without technology. People could feel the air but they didn’t know what the composition of the air was. The only thing that was missing was the tools to explore it!
He wanted to see the monster research institute more and more. They had been studying monsters for years so he didn’t know how many secrets they had hidden.
“Help –”
There was a scream coming from the military camp. Dudian turned his head to look. The sound didn’t attract the help of other survivors. On the contrary, it attracted the nearby undeads and pulled them down. Soon, their intestines were thrown out.
Dudian didn’t make a move. He led Aisha forward. The surrounding world of slaughter seemed to be isolated from him. The two of them were like walking in the jungle of heavy artillery, but they didn’t touch a leaf.
They walked out of the fortress. The soil behind them had turned blood red. The sand of their footprints was mixed with blood.
There was a wide avenue behind the fortress. It led to the towering Carmen City. They could clearly see the wall lamps hanging on the city gate which was more than 20 meters high. However, there were a lot of figures moving on the city wall at the moment, from time to time, a few sharp arrows shot out from outside the city.
Dudian looked up and saw that the top of the city wall was also in chaos. It was occupied by the undeads.
He was silent as he took Aisha to the city gate. The gate was half-closed and he pushed it open with one hand. The sound of squeaking echoed out and the gate was suddenly filled with the roars of undeads.
Dudian was not afraid as he took Aisha’s hand and strode forward.
The undeads who were wandering around the city gate stopped as soon as they got close. They swayed their bodies and walked to the side of the road. Their bodies were trembling and they didn’t dare to approach.
Dudian glanced at the streets outside the city gate. There were shrill screams coming from the streets. Some of the houses were lit by overturned oil lamps.
He guessed that most of the other cities were in the same situation. He couldn’t help but ask himself: should I use other methods to restrict the action of the military and the monastery?
However, the moment this thought came out, he killed it.
He abandoned the softness in his heart. He had done everything, and now he sympathized with her. It was really hypocritical!
Thinking of this, he took out the map in his arms and looked at it. He immediately held Aisha’s hand and walked along a street on the left.
The street was in chaos. Some houses were tightly shut. Through the heat source captured by his vision, he could see that there were people hiding in the houses. They were curled up in a ball, shivering. It had always been when disasters erupted, not everyone was infected with the zombie poison. When the undeads rushed to the streets and caused a riot, most of the people who were playing on the streets had fled back to their homes.
Dudian walked along the street and saw the corpses of the people who were bitten. Some of them were girls who were less than one meter tall. There were also the corpses of women. There were also old people with white hair who had their chests torn open, he was lying on the ground.
Dudian glanced at the corpses and continued to move forward.
“Help! Help Me!”A woman suddenly jumped out of the alley and threw herself into Dudian’s arms. She cried and begged as she looked back in horror.
Dudian also looked behind her. There was a teenager who was about fifteen or sixteen years old. His face was ferocious and his mouth was stained with blood.
Dudian was about to kill him when the woman who had grabbed him suddenly came behind him. She pushed his back and took the opportunity to escape to the other side of the street.
Dudian’s body shook as he stood up. He turned his head and looked at the figure who was running away. His eyes narrowed and a trace of killing intent flashed through his eyes. However, it soon disappeared. He thought that such a situation was not strange.
He didn’t bother with this woman and continued to walk forward.
After the young undeads rushed out of the alley, they sensed the smell of Aisha. They immediately stopped and stood in the same place trembling.
Dudian followed the map. Along the way, he saw many people being bitten to death by the undeads. He didn’t deliberately attack. Some of them had been bitten. He was too lazy to care. Anyway, he would die sooner or later.
After walking for more than ten minutes, Dudian had entered the inner area of the city. He suddenly saw a square surrounded by a large number of soldiers in a neat formation. There were a large number of passers-by gathered in the square shouting loudly.
“Get out of the way, Bastard!”
“We are not infected. Why do you want to catch us! ?”
“Why don’t you kill those monsters? Why are you stopping us! ?”
These passers-by shouted angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 690
chapters.content:
Chapter 690 – Chapter 680: Nobility And Inferiority [ First Update ]
Dudian saw a middle-aged officer with shiny armor come out from the army. His skin was white and he looked well maintained. He stood out from the crowd and looked at the noisy crowd: “If you don’t want to die, then be quiet!”
The crowd stopped cursing and looked at him in fear.
The middle-aged officer whispered a few words to an adjutant beside him. The adjutant nodded and said loudly, “Miss Alice, please come out for a moment.”
The people in the square looked at each other. Suddenly, there was a commotion from a crowd. They retreated to the surroundings, revealing a slim and graceful young girl. She wore a white silk hood and was dressed in a foreign and noble manner. There were two knights surrounding the young girl. She had a straight posture and a humble attitude.
The middle-aged officer’s eyes lit up when he saw the young girl. He immediately led a few servants and entered the square from the defensive line. The crowd around them moved aside. They were shocked, angry, afraid, and did not dare to stop her.
“Miss Alice, are you hurt?”The middle-aged officer came in front of the young girl, placed his hand on his chest, and bowed respectfully.
The girl called Alice looked at him impatiently and said, “What is it? Speak quickly!”
The middle-aged officer was very polite and smiled. “Miss, we have been ordered to come and pick you up. There is an outbreak of the zombie plague outside, and it is very dangerous. Please come back with us.”
Hearing his words, hope immediately surged in the eyes of the surrounding civilians. They pushed and stretched out their hands to grab the middle-aged officer and begged, “Sir, please take us away. Please, take us away!”
A few servants beside the middle-aged officer immediately blocked the commotion of the civilians. One of the servants pushed a dirty civilian away in disgust. He used a lot of strength and flipped him over and fell to the ground, he was immediately trampled and drowned by the people behind him.
Alice heard the noise around her and became even more impatient, she said, “I don’t want to go back. I still have to go to Christine to get my evening gown. I have a banquet to attend tonight. Tell my father that I will definitely go home when the banquet begins!”
The middle-aged officer smiled bitterly and said, “Miss, there is an outbreak of the zombie plague everywhere. It is really too dangerous. If anything happens to you, we can not afford it!”
“Then you just protect me well.”Alice said indifferently, “We are not feeding you people for nothing. You Can’t even deal with a small zombie plague. You Are Really Useless!”
The middle-aged officer was speechless and felt a headache. Suddenly, he had an idea, he smiled apologetically and said, “Miss, the scale of the plague is too large. It has already swept through the entire city. I noticed it when I came here. All the shops are closed, including Christian’s. Even if you go now, you probably won’t be able to get your evening gown. Instead, you’ll be in danger. Why Don’t I help you find another tailor shop and buy another one?”
“How can other shops be compared to the dress made by Christine?”Alice looked at him with disdain, as if she was looking at a retard. Then, she raised her chin slightly, “It’s okay even if it’s closed. Our family is Christine’s VIP. Even if it’s closed, it will serve me. Stop nagging. There are so many people here. It stinks. Move aside!”
The middle-aged officer was about to persuade him again when he suddenly heard a wave of terrified screams coming from the back of the square. His heart skipped a beat. He quickly looked up and immediately saw a large number of people crowding over from the back of the square. On the street behind.., four or five figures ran quickly. Their running posture was strange. They were swaying and their hands were like paddling water as they threw themselves forward.
His expression changed slightly, and he immediately said to Alice in front of him, “Miss, sorry for offending you. You have to come back with me!”After saying that, he reached out and grabbed her wrist.
Alice did not expect him to dare to use force. She screamed angrily, “What do you want, Bastard? Get lost!”
The two knights around him immediately attacked and stopped the middle-aged officer. One of them grabbed the middle-aged officer’s wrist, and the powerful force made the middle-aged officer feel a trace of pain.
He could not help but look at the two knights with cold faces angrily, “Do you want to die? If something happens to Miss Alice, you will all die!”
The two knights just stared at him coldly as if they had not heard anything.
The middle-aged officer was extremely shocked and furious. At this time, the crowd in front of him suddenly pushed over like a landslide. The two knights and the middle-aged officer were caught off guard and could not stand steadily. When the middle-aged officer came to his senses, he suddenly saw that Alice, who was protected by the two knights, was gone. He was so shocked that his face turned pale and cold sweat poured out of his entire body, he shouted in a panic, “Miss Alice, Miss Alice!”
A wave of terrified screams rang out from the crowd, drowning out his voice.
Roar!
Roars rang out from behind the crowd. The few figures chasing from the streets had already rushed into the square. The few soldiers blocking them were completely no match for them and had long fallen in a pool of blood. Meanwhile, the nearby civilians witnessed this bloody scene.., they immediately lost confidence in the army. They panicked and fled in all directions. They pushed and squeezed the crowd. The people in the square swayed like waves.
More and more undeads ran from the back of the street. They bared their fangs and brandished their claws at the crowd as well as the soldiers who were guarding outside the crowd.
The square suddenly became chaotic.
Dudian frowned as he saw the change. He thought that it was stupid to gather so many people. It was like a beacon for the undeads.
He turned around and walked to another place. He didn’t plan to make a move.
As he left, the screams from the square became louder and louder. Some of them were crying in despair.
He followed the route to the Monster Institute and came to a street corner. Suddenly, he saw a figure jump out from the side of the path. It was the girl that the middle-aged officer wanted to protect, Alice.
Alice had just run out of the path and almost bumped into Dudian. He looked at Dudian who was parked at the exit of the path and stared: “What are you looking at? Haven’t you seen such a beautiful woman? If you continue to look at me, I will dig out your eyes!”
Dudian indifferently glanced at her. He took Aisha’s hand and continued to move forward.
Alice looked around and found that her two knights didn’t come out from the square. She didn’t dare to approach because of the screams coming from the square. She looked around and looked at Dudian again. She rushed forward and shouted: “Hey, look at your clothes. You should have some skills. Now go and find a carriage for me. Send me to Christine!”
Dudian didn’t hear her. He took Aisha and walked straight to her.
Alice didn’t expect that she would be ignored. She shouted: “Stop! I am a noble. Do You Want to die? Do you dare to treat me like this? !”
Dudian didn’t turn his head and said: “Get Away from me.”
Alice was stunned. The next moment she was so angry that her mouth was crooked. She clenched her teeth and ran in front of dudian. She grabbed Dudian’s armor, she angrily said: “Apologize to me or I will turn you into a slave. I will sell you to a noble and make your life worse than death!”
Dudian slapped her face and hit her body. She stumbled a few steps and fell to the ground.
“Stupid!”Dudian coldly glanced at her as he strode forward.
Alice covered her burning cheeks as she sat on the ground. She didn’t know how to react. She was hit by a black-haired pariah!
There was a strong resentment in her eyes as she saw Dudian was about to walk out of the street. She got up from the ground and chased after him.
As she rushed out of the street, she saw several swaying figures walking on the side of the street. She knew that they were infected by the zombie plague and were very dangerous. But at the moment, she didn’t care about them. She waved her hand and shouted at the swaying figures, “Come over! Come over!”
The few undeads heard the voice and immediately turned around. Their eyes emitted green light. They locked onto Alice’s figure and quickly rushed over.
Dudian saw that the girl was seeking death. He was slightly startled.
But the next moment, his eyes turned cold. He saw that the girl was waiting for the undeads to come close. She turned around and pointed at Dudian who was walking towards another street: “Help me kill him! Kill him!”
Roar!
The undeads couldn’t understand her words. They roared and showed their fangs. Their mouths cracked to the ears as they rushed towards her.
Alice was shocked to see such a ferocious appearance. But the next moment she reacted. Her face turned pale and her body trembled: “You… What do you want to Do? I want you to kill him… No…”
Before she finished her words, a zombie pounced on her and bit her shoulder.
The other undeads quickly followed. They pressed Alice’s body to the ground and tried to bite her.
“No, it hurts…”
“I… I’m a noble. Do you want to die…”
“AH…”
The sound was accompanied by screams of fear and despair. It was obvious that the zombie had bitten her throat.
Dudian looked at the smell of blood. The coldness in his eyes deepened. He didn’t stop and walked down the street.

chapters.title: Chapter 691
chapters.content:
Chapter 691 – Chapter 681: Sneak Attack [ Second Update ]
The doors of every house on the street were tightly shut. Most of the buildings in the street had been evacuated.
Dudian didn’t see the Army nor the Knights. The streets were deserted. There were only undeads wandering around.
In just one day and one night the bustling city had become like a ghost city.
After half an hour Dudian finally came to the Monster Institute on the map. It was the largest monster institute in Carmen City. Its back was against the mountains and the left was against the river. It was surrounded by forests and rolling hills, it was extremely remote.
Dudian met two or three small monsters as he went through the forest. Although they were small monsters but they were also ferocious beasts that had been exposed to radiation. Most of the ordinary people wouldn’t be able to escape death.
It was obvious that no one was willing to go near the forest where these small monsters were.
Dudian was standing behind a tree. There was a green poisonous snake hanging on the branch of his neck. Its head was broken and its flesh was mangled. Using the cover of the trees, Dudian looked at the empty space in front of him. The terrain was low and there was a low building. It was not eye-catching and was different from the castle-style building of the aristocracy, this building leaned towards the modern concrete industrial building.
The moonlight shone on the building and it was a bit cold.
Through the visual capture of the heat source reaction, Dudian found that there were a lot of people living underground. The heat source reaction of these people was similar to that of ordinary soldiers. They were slightly stronger than ordinary civilians.
There were some strange heat sources in the depths of the building. They should be captured monsters.
“The underground laboratory is similar to the research institute of the old era…”Dudian’s eyes flashed. It was almost as he had guessed. There was no outbreak of the plague in the Monster Research Institute, everything was still going on in an orderly manner. It seemed that he didn’t care about the outbreak of the virus in the outside world.
“Wait for me here.”Dudian whispered to Aisha. He decided to go alone. When he encountered a danger that he couldn’t deal with, it wouldn’t be too late to call her for help. As long as he didn’t go into a soundproof place.., aisha could hear him shaking the bell from thousands of meters away. It was just that she was a bit slow in receiving it.
After saying that, he saw that Aisha had acquiesced. He immediately restrained his aura, sealed his pores, and quietly groped his way through.
After going through two trench traps and crossing a dark line buried in the grass, Dudian smoothly approached the low building built by the Monster Research Institute on the ground. He used thermal sensing to capture it, he could see that there were eight guards stationed in several corners of the low building. The heat in their bodies was strong. They were all high-level limiters.
He did not know if there were stronger people hiding in the dark. It would be best if he could sneak in smoothly. If it was really impossible, he could only ask Aisha to force his way in.
His body crawled on the ground, avoiding a blind spot in his field of vision. He slowly approached the door, silently calculating the success rate of his attack. For him, killing eight advanced level limiters was not difficult, however, it would be difficult to kill them quietly.
“Did you hear? There’s a zombie epidemic outside. Many cities have been sealed off!”
“Do you think the virus leaked out of our research institute?”
“Someone must be behind this. With so many cities erupting at the same time, it’s definitely not a simple leak. It must be some faction that wants to use the virus to control the various cities!”
“Isn’t this a power struggle with his majesty?”
“WHO KNOWS!”
There were three men and one woman chatting in the room. The others didn’t participate in the conversation.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he heard the conversation. He slowly left the low building and went back to the woods. He left the place and went to a nearby street. He deliberately made noise as he kicked the closed doors of the undeads along the street. He released the UNDEADS and used the speed advantage to lead them out. Soon.., dozens of undeads were chasing after him.
The survivors saw this scene and were stunned.
Dudian quickly ran into the woods. When he was close to the Monster Institute, he sped up and disappeared from the undeads’senses.
The undeads continued to search for him for a while. They gradually returned to their wandering state. Some of the UNDEADS encountered small monsters in the forest and immediately began to fight.
Dudian once again sneaked back to the low building and waited in a shadow corner.
Not long after, the eight guards in the building heard the ferocious roars coming from the forest and the screams of the monsters living in the forest. One of them said: “It seems something is coming.”
“Molly, take a look at the situation.”The other person said.
The room was silent for a few seconds. Suddenly a woman said in surprise: “There is someone lurking in the west corner!”
Dudian’s face slightly changed as he leaned against the shadow. He didn’t expect that someone could sense him. He had taken advantage of the surrounding environment and eliminated his own heat source and smell, it wouldn’t be difficult to find his trace unless he was extremely sensitive to sound. But such a person should have found him when he first approached.
Although he didn’t know how the woman named Molly found him. Dudian didn’t bother to continue to hide. He jumped out of the shadow and rushed towards the window. The dagger in his hand instantly fell into his palm and he rushed towards the two guards.
“You are courting death!”The two guards reacted when they heard Molly’s voice. They saw that the window was broken and immediately attacked.
Dudian’s dagger was quickly parried. The sneak attack failed. He quickly withdrew his hand and shook the bell.
Although he could defeat the two with his ability, but it would take some time to kill them in a one-on-two fight. Since he had been exposed, he had to end the fight quickly!
The bell rang. Aisha heard it and her black eyes flashed with a trace of murderous intent. She rushed out in an instant.
Dudian retreated out of the building as Aisha rushed over. At the moment, eight guards had surrounded the building. When Aisha moved out, one of the women exclaimed, “Not good, someone is coming. So Fast!”
A burly youth next to him shouted: “Send the order, there is an enemy attack!”
Dudian saw that one of the eight short youth turned around and was ready to drill into the building. He immediately threw a dagger to block his way.
“Die!”The burly youth saw Dudian’s intention and growled: “Kill Him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 692
chapters.content:
Chapter 692 – Chapter 682: Double Kill [ Two In One Chapter ]
The other seven people’s bodies rapidly changed under the command of the burly youth. They entered the magic marks state without holding back. Some of them had soft tissues protruding from their backs. Some of them had opened their mouths, some of them had exposed their teeth. Some of them had bloodshot eyes. At first glance, they looked like a group of monsters. If an ordinary person saw this scene, they would have fainted on the spot.
Dudian didn’t hold back. He activated the magic marks in his body. His body was covered with white bones. He looked like a human skeleton, his transformation was the most “Normal”one.
Whoosh!
Dudian didn’t retreat. He rushed towards the short youth who was about to run back into the building.
The burly youth roared as he swung his knife towards Dudian. His body was covered in pale golden scales. There were a few spikes on his back. It looked like a protruding spine. As he swung his knife, two black whips shot out from behind him, it was another woman who attacked.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. The dragon Spike chapter’s fighting technique flashed through his mind. His body flashed and he dodged the Burly Youth’s attack. At the same time he quickly grabbed the two black whips that came from above, it was like a monster’s tongue. He shouted in his heart. The white bones on his palm suddenly protruded and pierced into the soft tissue of the black whip. He firmly grabbed it and pulled it back!
The woman who was connected to the soft tissue of the black whip groaned in pain. She rushed towards Dudian. At the same time, the other black whips behind her shot at Dudian like Dancing Vipers.
Dudian was about to make a move when a gust of cold wind came from the side. It was another middle-aged man who was holding a gun. The middle-aged man’s magic marks were extremely ferocious. His mouth was cracked to the ear and his mouth was full of teeth, his soft tongue was covered with fine teeth. Once he was bitten, a piece of flesh would be torn off.
Dudian didn’t have time to continue to attack the woman. Two sharp blades protruded from the bones of his palm. He cut off the two soft tissues of the black whip. He turned around and dodged the spear of the middle-aged man. He turned around and punched the middle-aged man’s face.
The middle-aged man was hit by the fist. His body staggered back a few steps. There was a bloody hole in his face. On the contrary, there was a sharp bone spike protruding from Dudian’s fist.
Whoosh!
A cold wind suddenly pierced into his face.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He hurriedly turned his head. An ice-cold arrow passed by his cheek. The wind caused a trace of pain on his skin.
He saw that the short youth had taken the opportunity to enter the building. His heart sank as he knew that it was impossible to stop him. It would be difficult for him to fight against eight people at the same time, it would only take a few seconds for the opponent to enter the building. In such a short time, the remaining seven people were enough to delay him!
“DAMN!”Cold light flashed in his eyes. The dragon blood in his body suddenly surged. His blood boiled as he took a step forward and rushed towards the youth who was flanking him from the left.
The youth raised his weapon to block but Dudian’s body swayed. He rushed towards the middle-aged man who was ready to support him. He punched the middle-aged man’s face.
The middle-aged man was caught off guard but his reaction was very fast. He was scared and stepped back. His face was pale.
His neck leaned back to avoid Dudian’s fist. But the next moment, his eyes were wide open.
Blood spurted out from his throat and cut off his throat and artery.
It was unknown when Dudian’s fist had protruded an extremely thin and long spike. Seeing that the attack had succeeded, he immediately pounced and prepared to follow up and kill him.
“Courting death! !”The burly youth who was restraining dudian from the front saw that Dudian was ignoring him. He roared and brandished his knife. His momentum was fierce and his body was full of flaws. He had no intention of thinking about defense.
Dudian had to stop as he looked at the burly youth. He bent his body and dodged the attack. He punched Dudian’s chest. The spikes on the back of his fist hit him. It felt like he had hit an iron wall, there was a kind of pain but the spikes on his fist broke through the tough thing and pierced into his chest.
The burly youth brandished his knife and slashed down. He avoided Dudian. He looked down and saw that there was a hole in the armor on his chest. Blood was oozing out from it.
He was shocked and angry but there was some fear in his eyes. His magic marks were the magic marks of the rare monster ‘Dragon Steel Man’. It was difficult for people of the same rank to hurt him. However Dudian’s attack was beyond his imagination.
“What kind of magic marks is this? Who Is this person? !”The burly youth looked at Dudian who was still resisting despite being surrounded by four people, his face was ugly. From the looks of the opponent’s attack, he was not a pioneer. However, his movements were clever and his attacks were sharp. The defense of his bones was not inferior to his. Even if he was accidentally stabbed, he was not injured, he only received some impact force.
“Molly, use your poison gas!”The burly youth turned around and shouted.
The woman who was standing behind didn’t make a move. She hesitated for a moment but still quickly accumulated it. Her body change was the smallest among the eight people. However, if the moonlight was bright, she would be able to see it, the color of her skin had turned dark green, and strange patterns were crawling all over her face. These patterns were like the patterns of trees, showing faint texture bumps, or like poisonous pythons winding around her whole body.., the degree of terror was not inferior to the others at all.
She took a slight breath, and her originally plump chest swelled up even more, like a bullfrog.
Just as she was about to open her mouth, a black shadow suddenly flashed in front of her eyes. Her pupils constricted, and before she could see clearly, she felt her vision go black, and she completely lost consciousness.
Puff!
Aisha’s sharp fingers pierced through Molly’s forehead and directly into her brain. Like a wild beast that had gone out of control, Aisha let out a ferocious roar. Her fingers exerted force and instantly crushed Molly’s entire skull!
Molly’s body convulsed and fell to the ground. Blood was flowing out of her head. As Aisha withdrew her hand, her skull, scalp, and hair were all lifted off. Only bloody brain matter was flowing out.
The burly youth standing not far away saw this scene, and his face was filled with shock as he cried out, “Stop! !”
Aisha was just about to pounce down and eat Jasmine’s body when she heard the burly youth’s cry from behind her. She turned her head abruptly, and the veil covering her face was blown off by the wind as she moved at high speed, revealing a face that could topple cities, but at that moment, the expression on that face was extremely ferocious, and the pure black eye sockets seemed to exude endless evil black holes, devouring all life.
When the burly youth saw her face, he was instantly stunned. His heart seemed to have stopped beating.
Roar!
Aisha let out a low roar and pounced over.
She was as fast as a phantom. The burly youth did not even have time to react before his body was pushed to the ground. His head slammed heavily onto the ground, causing the grass to splash with mud. The next moment, an intense pain came from his neck.
By the time the burly young man came back to his senses, a large piece of flesh had been torn out of his neck.
When Aisha was ready to eat again, an angry roar came from the side. The woman who had mutated the soft tissue black whip on her back was full of anger. She controlled the soft tissue black whip on her back to swarm over like black sharp arrows, it stabbed toward Aisha’s back.
Aisha bared her teeth and jumped from the burly youth’s body. She directly rushed towards the woman.
The woman controlled the soft tissue black whip to hit Aisha’s body. However, it didn’t cause any damage. It only broke the clothes on her shoulder. Aisha was like an angry beast as she directly rushed in front of her. She pressed her to the ground and bit her face. Soon, she bit off a large piece of flesh.
The people surrounding Dudian noticed the changes behind him and were stunned for a moment.
Dudian took advantage of the middle-aged man’s distraction and quickly rushed forward. He pressed his hand on the back of the middle-aged man’s hand that was holding the gun. The spikes on the bones that covered his palm fiercely pierced into the back of the middle-aged man’s hand, the pain made the middle-aged man scream. His palm instinctively loosened a bit. He wanted to withdraw his hand. Dudian took the opportunity to knee the barrel of the gun. He held the back of the middle-aged man’s hand and twisted it upwards. Puff! The long spear pierced through the middle-aged man’s chin, it went through the middle-aged man’s chin.
The other people didn’t expect to lose another companion in the Blink of an eye. They were shocked and angry as they attacked Dudian.
Dudian immediately retreated and dodged left and right in the encirclement of the three people.
Aisha bit the soft tissue woman to death. She was attracted by the three people who were attacking Dudian. She growled and quickly rushed over.
One of them was caught off guard. Aisha hugged him from behind and bit his neck. He screamed and tried to break free from Aisha but Aisha’s teeth didn’t bite him, a large piece of flesh fell down.
This cruel scene made the other two scared. Dudian took advantage of the time when they were slowing down to pounce on one of them and fight with him.
The other one wanted to rush to help but saw his companion being bitten alive by Aisha. He was so scared that his face turned pale. In less than a second of hesitation, he immediately turned and ran, he rushed back to the building.
In a one-on-one situation, Dudian quickly killed the young man. At this time, his magic marks ability was demonstrated. He could attack and defend. In a group battle with equal physiques, he was not weak at all.
Dudian looked at Aisha who was biting the body. He quickly pulled her away and shook the bell to control her. Then he rushed into the building with her.
Through the visual heat source, he had seen that the short youth and the person who had escaped earlier rushed into the basement of the building. The staff in the basement.., at this moment, they were also going deeper into the basement. Apparently, they had received the alarm.
Dudian’s eyes swept around and soon found an unclosed floor. There were stairs below. He guessed that the last person who escaped had left in a hurry and forgot to close the passage.
He immediately led Aisha down the stairs. Soon, they came to a brightly lit passage. This was the first floor of the underground building. According to the heat source that he had previously captured, there were eight floors in total, however, because the eighth floor was quite far away, the heat source’s figure was already very faint and indistinct. It was difficult to even see the figure of a human. He was not sure if there was a ninth floor or deeper.
The walls of the first floor’s passageway were all khaki-colored. With the dim yellow light of the oil lamp, it looked like a secret room. He walked along the stairs and kicked open some of the doors along the way. These rooms were already empty, but there were various rooms that looked like hospital operating rooms. Some of the shelves in some of the rooms were filled with strange bottles and jars, some of the bottles and jars were sealed with the palms of children.
There was a newborn baby’s head. It seemed that its eyes were closed and its eyelids were almost transparent.
In addition to human body tissues, Dudian saw many strange monster tissues. There were fist-sized eyeballs and cute little claws that were like small tigers, it looked like the laboratory of some evil alchemists in the outer wall area.
Dudian walked along the corridor to the end. There was a corridor here. He went to the second underground floor.
He kicked open the door of the room. There was a woman with disheveled hair tied to the metal table. She was naked but the most shocking thing was.., the skin of her chest from her shoulder to her abdomen was missing. There were some black tubes inserted into her chest. There was a blood-red glass jar next to the table.
Dudian frowned. This woman was most likely captured by the Monster Institute as an experimental material.
Aisha’s nose twitched slightly as she smelled the blood.
Dudian broke the handle on the door. He hit the woman’s head and pulled Aisha away. Death was probably the best outcome for this woman. Even if he released her.., the body that had been tested wouldn’t be able to survive.
Dudian didn’t look at the other rooms. He stomped on the ground and jumped down to the third floor.
There were several weak heat sources in the rooms on the third floor. The situation was similar to that of the woman upstairs. The two heat sources were big and small. The big one was as big as an elephant and the small one was like a puppy, the shape was not human. It was most likely a monster that was being experimented on.
Dudian continued to stomp on the floor and fell to the fifth floor.
He looked down. There were many people on the sixth floor who were preparing to retreat. They were in a hurry.
He stomped on the floor and fell to the sixth floor.
A middle-aged man wearing a white coat ran in front of him. He was scared by Dudian who suddenly fell to the ground. His face turned pale.
Dudian glanced at his clothes. There was a badge on his chest with his name and position: “Director of the Health Department?”He slightly raised his eyebrows and walked to the middle-aged man: “What’s your position, doctor?”
The middle-aged man looked at Dudian and then looked at Aisha. Compared to Dudian, Aisha’s appearance was more frightening. Her face was stained with blood and her hands were red. He swallowed his throat and stammered: “I, I’m just a sanitation manager. I don’t know anything…”
“If you don’t know, then go to Hell.”Dean kicked his chin. With a crack, the strength of the tip of his foot caused his jaw to fly out of his mouth, the middle-aged man’s tongue fell from his jaw. It hung on his chest and his head was raised. He died on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 693
chapters.content:
Chapter 693 – Chapter 683: Black Prison [ First Watch ]
Dudian turned around and rushed to stop the other three who were running away in panic. They were wearing the same white coats as the previous middle-aged man. One of them was wearing a thin dustproof glove, he kicked the wall next to him. Bang! A hole was created in the wall. The fierce force made the three of them scared and didn’t dare to act rashly.
“Which one of you is the Doctor?”Dudian coldly asked.
The three of them looked at each other. They didn’t know what Dudian’s purpose was so they didn’t know how to answer.
Dudian glanced at the badge on their chest. He didn’t see the title of the doctor: “Where is the Doctor? The person who speaks can live. The person who doesn’t speak can die!”
“I… We are in the Institute of Monsters. Who… Who Are You? !”The Man in the middle was brave enough to question Dudian. However his pale face seemed to be weak.
Bang! Dudian’s fist hit his head. His skull was shattered and his brain exploded. His body only shook slightly before he fell down, the headless body leaned on the left shoulder of a middle-aged man in his fifties. Blood spurted out and wet his coat. He fell to the ground.
The two men on the left and right were so scared that their bodies trembled. They didn’t dare to breathe. They looked at Dudian in fear. The man on the right reacted immediately, “I said, I said, don’t kill me. The Doctor is on the eighth floor. Don’t kill me…”
The Man on the left also woke up. He hurriedly said: “The doctor is down there. It’s none of our business. Don’t kill me…”
Dudian turned around and kicked the man’s waist. The man’s body hit the wall. The wall cracked. The middle-aged man’s body was embedded in the broken wall. The organs in his abdomen were squeezed by a huge force. Blood gushed out, blood flowed out from his seven orifices and he died on the spot.
Dudian ignored the man on the right. He quickly ran back to Aisha’s figure. He took Aisha’s hand and stomped on the ground. The corridor split open and he and Aisha fell to the seventh floor of the basement.
Researchers in white coats ran out of the corridors and rooms on the seventh floor of the basement. Four or five attendants in armor ran from the end of the corridor. They ran in the opposite direction from the crowd, they ran toward Dudian.
Dudian ignored them and grabbed a bald middle-aged man next to him, “Where is the Doctor?”
“I, I don’t know, I don’t know…”the middle-aged man was caught by Dudian. His face was full of fear.
Dudian was too lazy to talk nonsense. He picked up his body and threw it at the attendant. He stomped his foot again and the floor cracked. He and Haisha fell to the eighth floor. There were two or three figures in white coats walking in the corridor, they were in a hurry but not in a hurry. They heard the sudden sound of cracking. They looked back and saw Dudian and Haisha who had landed.
The three people’s faces changed as they rushed forward.
Dudian’s figure flashed as he quickly caught up to the three people. He stopped them: “Who is the Doctor?”He looked at the badge on their chest and found that one of them was not wearing a badge, he looked like a leader.
The faces of the two people changed as they heard Dudian’s words. They subconsciously looked at the man in the middle. One of them raised his chest, “Who are you? How Dare You Attack Our Institute? Aren’t you afraid that His Majesty will kill you?”
“Your colleague has said the same thing. Now he is dead.”Dudian’s eyes fell on the old man: “Are you the Doctor?”
The Old Man’s face slightly changed: “I’m just an assistant. I’m not a doctor.”
Dudian coldly snorted and suddenly kicked the man’s knee. The man’s knee was broken and bones pierced through the skin behind the knee. His body lay on the ground as he cried out in pain.
The other two didn’t expect Dudian to suddenly attack. They hurriedly raised their hands to stop him but didn’t dare to.
Dudian grabbed the man’s hair and grabbed his arm: “Who is the Doctor?”
The Man’s face was full of pain. He kept screaming and completely ignored Dudian’s words.
Dudian’s fingers used force. His nails deeply pierced into the man’s shoulder. He repeated: “Who is the Doctor?”
The man screamed in pain.
Dudian tore off the old man’s arm. Blood spurted out and splashed onto the old man’s pants. He repeated: “Who is the Doctor?”
The man’s head was covered in cold sweat. He opened his eyes in horror. He looked at Dudian’s calm face as if he was looking at a devil: “I, I don’t know, I don’t know…”
Dudian’s fingers cut through the man’s chest. His sharp nails easily cut through his unprotected clothes and exposed the skin on his chest, his fingers grabbed the edge of the bloody scar and tore it. The pain made the man scream like a pig. His whole body twitched and he was in so much pain that he almost fainted.
“Who is the Doctor?”Dudian repeated.
The man was in so much pain that he couldn’t hear Dudian’s words. The Old Man’s face turned ugly as he saw the bloody scene: “Stop! I am the Doctor! What are you going to do?”
“You are?”Dudian stopped. He looked at the old man. From his appearance and temperament, he had some guesses and doubts. However, he might not believe the old man’s words, “Take me to your personnel archives. I want to see your identity information.”
The Old Man’s face changed and hesitated.
Dudian saw the strange look on the old man’s face. He narrowed his eyes and looked at the young man whose legs were trembling: “If you don’t want to learn from him, you will lead the way.”He loosened his grip on the man who had been tortured half to death.
The youth’s body slightly trembled. He looked at the old man who was next to him. He hesitated for a moment and said to dudian: “I will take you there. Don’t hurt me.”He made a gesture to lead the way.
Dudian grabbed the old man and said: “You follow.”
The Old Man’s face was ugly. He didn’t dare to resist and followed the youth.
The file was on the third floor. Dudian was holding Aisha’s hand as he led the two people up the stairs to the third floor. Along the way they met servants who were stationed at different levels, these guards were weaker than the eight high-level limiters outside. They were no match for him.
As the guards died, the faces of the two people who were held by Dudian became more and more desperate.
Soon, they reached the third underground floor. The youth found the archives room and said: “I don’t know the password of this door…”before he finished his words, Dudian kicked the door and directly kicked the heavy metal door open.
“Now I know.”Dudian walked into the room. He saw many files on the shelf: “I’ll give you two minutes to find the doctor’s files.”
The youth’s face turned pale. He knew that there was no room for negotiation. He ran to the shelf and searched through the files. Soon, he found a sealed file. He was relieved, dudian handed the file to dudian: “This is the file of Dr. Poland.”
Dudian opened the file and looked at it. There was no portrait on it but the body information was recorded. He was 72 years old and 167 centimeters tall. He was from the Pami family..
He looked at the old man: “You are not Dr. Poland. where is the real doctor?”
The old man clenched his fingers: “I won’t tell you. Don’t even think about finding the Doctor of Poland!”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as his pupils shrank. The world in front of him became clear. He saw the heat source reaction of the underground research institute, he saw that most of the people from the research institute had fled to the ground. However there were four hot figures around three of the heat sources. They were running in another direction.
“They want to escape!”Dudian coldly snorted. He threw out the file in his hand. The compressed paper hit the old man’s throat. The sound of bones breaking was heard. The old man’s mouth was wide open. He looked at Dudian in fear as if he was suffocating. He staggered back.
The youth next to him was trembling. He didn’t dare to support him.
Dudian held Aisha’s hand and quickly chased after them.
“Doctor, quick, Quick!”The short young man looked at doctor Poland who was panting. He was anxious.
Doctor Poland was running out of breath. His face was red and his head was full of sweat. He said: “I can’t take it. My Feet Hurt…”
The short young man was anxious and immediately ran up: “Doctor, let me carry you. If you don’t hurry they will catch up.”
“It won’t be that fast. I have already asked Jeff to disguise as me. If they look for me, Jeff will replace me.”Professor Poland stopped and panted heavily, he said, “Do you know who they are? What do they want to do by attacking our Monster Research Institute? Could it be for the ‘Black Prison’Experiment?”

chapters.title: Chapter 694
chapters.content:
Chapter 694 – Chapter 684: A Glimmer Of Hope [ Second Update ]
The short youth was about to open his mouth when his pupils suddenly shrank. He looked up and saw two black shadows rapidly approaching from behind. He could feel the shocking murderous aura coming towards him.
“Not good, they are coming!”The short youth panicked. He had seen the skills of these two people who killed his companion. It was definitely not something that they could resist. He hurriedly pushed away professor Poland, “Doctor, you should run. We will stop them!”
Poland also noticed Dudian who was chasing them. Their faces changed. They wanted to run forward but their legs were weak. They were scared and almost fell down.
At this moment, Dudian had caught up. He looked at the old man who was surrounded by several people. Compared to the information on the file, his age and height were basically the same. He was no longer soft-hearted. He shook the bell, he rushed over with Aisha.
“Doctor, run! !”The short youth roared and pulled out his knife to meet Dudian.
Aisha growled and rushed out. She was faster than Dudian and immediately knocked the short youth to the ground. She tore off one of his arms.
Dudian went to kill the other people.
These people knew that they couldn’t escape and tried to resist.
Poland and the other two researchers in white coats panicked. They supported each other as they tried to escape.
The fight ended in a few minutes. Dudian and Aisha quickly caught up with Poland who was running away. He jumped in front of the three people and blocked the way, he said: “Doctor, take a rest if you are tired.”
Poland looked at him in fear. He forced himself to calm down: “Who Are You? Do you know what the crime of attacking our Monster Institute is? No matter who is behind you, you will be found out!”
Dudian coldly said: “If you don’t want to suffer then speak less. As long as you are obedient, you will not die.”
Poland’s face turned green and white. He thought: “What do you want to do with me?”
“I want to make a witcher.”Dudian wasn’t afraid of exposing his thoughts: “I will let you live after I finish making it.”
Poland was startled for a moment. No wonder the two didn’t search for materials and experimental materials but wanted to catch him. He was calm for a moment, he clenched his teeth: “I can’t make a witcher by myself. Even if you catch me it will be useless.”
“So you have no value?”
Poland’s face changed: “I don’t mean that. I’m just saying that you don’t want to kill innocent people. I can help you make a witcher. Please let my friend Go.”
“Professor is kind-hearted.”Dudian said in a cold tone: “You can’t even save your own life and you still care about your friend. Don’t worry. As long as you are obedient then everything will be fine.”
Poland was relieved. They felt a bit strange. The only ones who could make the Witcher’s device were the big forces like the family of the witcher or the nobles above the Baron. Even if such forces didn’t need to kidnap him.., as long as there was an order, the Institute of Magic would tailor it for them. Why would they take such a big risk to attack their institute?
He was a bit puzzled about Dudian’s identity but he suppressed it in his heart.
Dudian’s mind was sharp. He could guess the thoughts in Poland’s eyes: “Come Back to the institute with me. I want to visit Your Institute.”
Poland was stunned: “You… You Want to go back?”
“Why? Don’t you want to go back?”Dudian asked back.
Poland replied: “No, no.”He didn’t think that Dudian would attack the institute. He didn’t want to take the opportunity to capture him. But he still dared to return to the institute. wasn’t he worried that their reinforcements would come?
However, returning to the institute was good for him. He only hoped that Dudian would stay as long as possible.
Dudian brought the three back to the institute. The place was empty. Almost all the people in the institute were escorted by guards. Dudian continued down, as he walked he asked: “What do you research in Your Institute? Do you study undeads?”
Poland couldn’t guess dudian’s thoughts: “We usually study all kinds of monsters. Undeads are one kind of monsters. Although they were human when they were alive but they were infected by the virus. There is no difference between them and monsters.”
Dudian casually said: “If they are infected into undeads, is there a way to treat them?”
Poland was slightly startled. He looked at Dudian and thought for a while: “Is your family infected?”He thought of the outbreak of the plague yesterday. Many people in the city were infected, if Dudian’s family was infected by the virus then it would be reasonable for them to take the risk to attack the Monster Research Institute.
Dudian didn’t deny it: “Is there any way?”He put away his relaxed face and looked into his eyes.
Poland’s heart slightly trembled as Dudian looked at it, dudian said: “If you are infected by an undead, you can remove the infected tissue if it is a preliminary infection. But if the infection is very deep and the virus spreads to the heart, then it will be more troublesome. But there is still a glimmer of hope.”
“What if the whole body is infected, including the brain?”Dudian stared at him and asked. His muscles couldn’t help but tense up.
Poland was stunned: “You mean that you have been infected and become an undead? This, this…”
“How is it?”
“Basically, there is no cure.”Poland swallowed his throat. He felt that it was difficult to speak. When he finished speaking, he suddenly felt that the air around him had suddenly cooled down. It was cold to the bone, there was an inexplicable feeling of panic and trembling. This feeling came from the eyes of the youth in front of him. It was extremely cold, filled with endless killing intent. There was also infinite madness in his eyes. However, it gave people a strange calm, it was like a frozen tornado.
“What do you mean by basically there is no cure?”Dudian’s voice was a bit hoarse. His fingers were clenched and his bones were cracking. His footsteps had stopped and his eyes were fixed on Poland’s face.
Poland’s heart was beating fast and he barely moved his eyes away, he looked down: “If we have turned into a corpse then our consciousness has basically disappeared. It is no different from death. We have been researching how to solve this problem but the progress is slow. No, but there was a prophet who put forward a concept. He said that if we can reunite consciousness then we can restore the undeads to human.”
“Reunite consciousness?”Dudian grabbed a glimmer of hope and pressed his hands on his shoulders, “How?”
“This, this…”Poland was a bit difficult to answer. He thought for a long time about the wording, he said: “With the current method, it’s basically impossible to do this. It’s just a concept. It’s impossible to implement it. We haven’t figured out what consciousness is. Some say it’s soul, some say it’s thought, but what is soul, what is thought, what is made of material. These are still unknown, so…”

chapters.title: Chapter 695
chapters.content:
Chapter 695 – : Chapter 685: The Long Dawn [ First Watch ]
Dudian’s heart slowly sank. What was consciousness? What was soul? Such a question couldn’t be answered even in the old era. Even if the world had produced nuclear weapons, it was still unable to analyze the human soul!
In this barren and backward world, it was impossible to peep into the depths of the soul!
“Is there no other way?”Dudian was silent for a moment as he stared at Poland.
Poland smiled bitterly, “This is the only feasible way so far. However, if we want to implement it, we need to go through hundreds of years of development. The current research is not able to explore such a deep level. If we can find the important relics of the last era to store information from outside the giant wall, it may be possible to shorten the time for the Great Leap of Science.”
Dudian was silent. Hundreds of years of development might have touched on the research of the soul. But would he be able to live for hundreds of years?
Poland looked at Dudian’s silent face. He was nervous. From Dudian’s question he was able to determine the motive of the teenager to attack the institute, maybe it was related to the plague. Maybe the attack on the institute wasn’t the intention of the forces behind the teenager. It was his own decision to find a way to save his family.
This was the only explanation that he could think of. After all, no force in the inner wall would be stupid enough to attack the institute.
