After a long silence Dudian slowly regained his calm. Even if what the Doctor said was true, there was no other way. At least he still had a glimmer of hope. He could use the knowledge in the super chip to develop biological technology as soon as possible, perhaps he could find a way to reunite consciousness!
The super chip contained all the core technologies of the old era. But even in the old era he hadn’t found the mystery of consciousness. He had only touched the edge of it. It would be too inefficient for him to study it by himself, if the knowledge in the super chip was spread out and the insight and knowledge of the other alchemists and doctors in the Institute of Magic and monsters were improved, the speed of research in this area would be greatly increased.
Dudian also knew from Poland that a lot of knowledge in the inner wall was obtained from the ruins outside the giant wall. This knowledge could promote the technology circle of the inner wall by a large margin, the Super Chip was undoubtedly the most complete and omni-directional repository of knowledge. It was enough to promote the technology circle by a large margin. After all, there were many geniuses in this era. If they were given the corresponding knowledge.., it was not impossible to research the secrets of the soul through the collision between them!
However, all of this had to be established under his rule in the inner wall!
At the thought of this, the killing intent in his heart grew stronger and more impatient. He knew that he had to hurry up. Only by doing so could he help Aisha regain her consciousness and let her return in his lifetime!
Poland had been looking at the teenager. His eyes had gone from depression to despair to hope and killing intent. He was secretly shocked. He didn’t know what was going through his mind.
“Do you have anything valuable here?”Dudian turned around and walked along the corridor.
Poland’s face slightly changed when he heard that Dudian was no longer entangled in the previous question. He hesitated for a moment, he whispered: “It’s mainly to study the monsters. Everything here is valuable to me.”There was nothing wrong with his words. He believed that although Dudian looked calm, but he shouldn’t stay here for long.
“How are the God’s blessing and God’s marrow produced?”Dudian asked.
Poland was startled as he looked at dudian: “I’m not very clear about this…”
Dudian’s footsteps paused as he looked at him. He grabbed the palm of one of his two colleagues and broke one of his fingers. The man screamed as he covered his broken finger. His face was distorted from the pain.
Poland was shocked: “What… What are you doing? !”
“I hope you will answer my questions.”Dudian looked at him, “You better not think about luck. I know more about you than you think. In addition, if you continue to be so uncooperative, your son, granddaughter and all the clansmen will pay the price for your words!” Dudian paid attention to the relationship of the Doctor. Obviously, he was not alone.
Poland’s face changed as he heard Dudian’s words: “What did you do to them? !”
“What will happen to them will depend on you.”Dudian said a mouthful of words.
Poland’s face changed as he stared at dudian: “If you hurt my family you won’t get anything!”
“As long as you cooperate they will be fine.”
“No! I want to see them first!”Poland’s attitude was firm: “I won’t say anything until I see them. Even if you kill me, I won’t Say Anything!”
“You have backbone.”Dudian narrowed his eyes: “Are you threatening me?”
Poland looked at Dudian’s eyes. She felt as if there was a murderous intent cutting through her body. Her heart tightened and her tough attitude softened, “How do I know if you will keep your word? How Do I know if they are injured? After I tell you everything, there will be no value. If you want to harm them, I can’t Stop You. You have to let them go!”
Dudian raised his hand and patted his shoulder, “You have to see clearly. You Don’t have the qualifications to negotiate with me. Even if I take you to see them, if you don’t listen, I will kill them one by one in front of your face. There is nothing you can do. Even if I have killed half of them, don’t you care about the other half?”
His tone was calm like a mentor who was trying to persuade his students.
Poland’s heart was cold. His face was pale. He looked at the youth in fear. He suddenly felt that there was a devil’s soul hidden under the delicate skin. He knew what Dudian meant. His threat was meaningless, according to the general situation, he could have used his information to exchange for the life and death of his family so that Dudian wouldn’t dare to act rashly against his family!
But this was just his idea. But Dudian didn’t follow his routine at all. In other words, his idea was too childish. As Dudian said, he wasn’t qualified to negotiate. Dudian could kill his family one by one in front of his face until he said so! This kind of ruthlessness made his trump card completely useless. He could only obediently comply!

chapters.title: Chapter 696
chapters.content:
Chapter 696 – Chapter 686: Original Parasitic Insect [ Second Update ]
“Can you tell me now?”Dudian took back his hand and looked at him: “How did the God’s blessing come about?”
Poland was slightly panting as she felt the pressure. Although God’s blessing and God’s marrow were common things in the inner wall. Of course, this was meant for the upper echelons of the major forces but in their monster research institute.., this was one of the top secrets! All the God’s blessing and God’s marrow came from the Monster Research Institute. In other words, all the forces had to look up to the Monster Research Institute!
This monopoly also made the Monster Research Institute detached itself from the outside world and become a monastery. All the Witcher families feared it and didn’t dare to provoke it!
If it wasn’t for the rules of the previous generations of His Majesty, the Monster Research Institute could even completely block the supply of God’s marrow from the forces of the various families, making the extraordinary power unique to the Monster Research Institute and using it to suppress the entire giant wall!
But there were many complicated reasons why they didn’t do so.
No matter what, the God’s marrow was a secret that the Monster Institute couldn’t divulge!
“Is it extracted from the body of the monster?”Dudian looked at the hesitant expression on his face, “I only asked you to tell me the source. I didn’t ask you to tell me the manufacturing process. What are you afraid of?”
Hearing this, Poland came to a realization. Indeed, the manufacturing process was complicated, and it was impossible to tell them one by one. As for the source, it was no longer a big secret. After all, this thing had been out for more than 200 years, although the other forces could not figure out how it was made, the materials needed to make this thing were real. From these materials, it was easy to guess the source of the God’s marrow.
“The god’s marrow comes from the ‘soul crystal’and the ‘parasitic soul worm’. Strictly speaking, it should be the ‘parasitic soul worm’!”Poland was silent for a moment, he slowly said, “The ‘Soul Crystal’comes from the brain of the zombie. More than 200 years ago, there was an outbreak of the zombie plague in the giant wall. It was also this time that the wall of sighs was built in the giant wall, cutting off the area where the zombie plague broke out. Most of the nobles and rich people were the first to migrate to the central area
“In the process of solving the undead plague, we accidentally found the blue crystal in the brain of the undead. It can strengthen the body but the strengthening is unstable. It is easy to lose control and even cause the body to crystallize.”
“Later, after decades of research, we finally mastered the method to analyze the ‘soul crystal’. So we made the God’s blessing and later the condensed version of ‘God’s marrow’.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He didn’t think that the wall of sighs would come from this way. The source of the God’s blessing was similar to what he had guessed. It was the energy extracted from the soul crystal.
“What is the ‘parasitic soul worm’that you are talking about?”Dudian asked. He had come into contact with it before. For example, he had used the god’s worm powder to draw the boundaries of the hunting area, there was a boundary where the parasitic soul worm could be cut.
“This is the earliest discovered parasitic soul worm.”There was a trace of confusion in Poland’s eyes, “I haven’t seen the original parasitic soul worm. It is said that the parasitic soul worm can survive for a long time even if it doesn’t live in an organism. Its survivability is very strong. Even if it is in a sealed jar it won’t suffocate to death. Even if it is thrown into the magma it will be able to swim and play. Its body will be cut into countless pieces and ground into powder. Then it will be combined again!”
Dudian was stunned. So tenacious?
Doesn’t this mean that the primitive parasitic worm doesn’t need air to survive? Moreover it has an unimaginable regenerative ability and the ability to divide cells. Moreover it can withstand high temperature!
It must be known that high temperature sterilization was a common knowledge in the old era. No bacteria and organisms could resist high temperature! If there was one, it must be because the temperature was not high enough! Moreover, from the old era, everything in nature was afraid of the flame. No matter how fierce the beast was, it would avoid the fierce fire. It was clear how destructive the flame was!
“You said that the primitive parasitic worm is so tenacious. How did the worm powder come about?”Dudian asked.
Poland looked at him, “The worm powder is made by parasitic worms. There is a big difference between the parasitic worm and the original parasitic worm. It is said that all the parasitic worms are transformed from the dead body of the original parasitic worm. The parasitic worms reproduce very fast. As long as a few parasitic worms are put together, hundreds of them will grow in a month!”
Dudian felt a chill in his heart: “So the parasitic worms used to make God’s marrow come from the primitive parasitic worms? How did the primitive parasitic worms die?”
“I don’t know. It has been too long. I think His Majesty knows.”Poland shook his head.
Dudian looked at him to confirm that he didn’t want to talk. However he felt a trace of mystery and unease in his heart.
“This way.”Poland raised his hand to lead the way.
Dudian frowned as he heard Poland speak. He looked at the room next to the room and immediately stopped. He opened the door and saw that it was filled with all kinds of frozen organs. Some of them were human and some of them were monsters, he saw that some of the babies were sealed. He frowned and turned to leave the room. He saw that Poland’s face wasn’t too good.
Poland’s face was a bit embarrassed: “This is all part of the experiment. I hope you can understand.”
“If these children are your family, will you understand?”Dudian casually asked.
Poland’s mouth slightly opened. He couldn’t speak.
Dudian’s previous thoughts were disrupted. He didn’t want to think about it anymore. Maybe everything would be solved after the giant wall was completely ruled. He asked: “Do you have the god’s marrow stored here?”
Poland slightly opened his mouth. He didn’t know if he had it or not.
But he knew that there was no way to hide it. He bitterly smiled: “Yes.”
“How much is there?”
“I’m not in charge of these things. But I know where they are stored. I can take you there.”Poland said.
“Then hurry up.”Dudian said.
Poland’s eyes slightly moved as they took Dudian Underground. They went deep into the sixth floor. He patted his head and said: “I remember wrong. It should be on the fifth floor.”.
Dudian didn’t say anything and followed him back to the fifth floor.
Poland came to a tightly closed heavy metal door: “There is no key. I guess…”
Dudian kicked the door open and walked in. He looked around and saw that there were many metal cabinets. It was like a bank’s savings cabinet. The air inside was cold, it was not the air conditioner that was emitting the cold air but a few piles of ice.

chapters.title: Chapter 697
chapters.content:
Chapter 697 – : Chapter 687: Underground Black Objects
The technology of using saltpeter to make ice had been popularized in the outer wall area. It wasn’t strange that there was an ice pile here. Dudian’s eyes fell on the metal cabinet. He looked at the cabinet. There were bottles of strange shaped metal bottles which were as thick as a finger.
He punched the metal cabinet and cracked it. He grabbed one of the metal bottles and opened it. A strange fragrance floated out, the smell was exactly the same as the god’s marrow that he got from the Dragon Clan.
He looked down and saw the golden liquid inside the bottle. It was God’s marrow!
“Very good!”He turned to the two men next to Poland: “Wrap all the God’s marrow here. I’ll give you five minutes.”
The two men’s faces changed as they looked at Poland.
Poland couldn’t help but ask: “The God’s marrow is all that we have in the past month. Do you want all of it?”
“Are you going to keep it?”Dudian coldly shouted: “Hurry Up! I will cut off your hand if it takes more than one minute!”
Both of them were scared out of their wits. They didn’t bother to look at Poland as they hurried to open the cabinet. They took out a bunch of keys from the drawer under the table. They opened the cabinet one by one according to the number on the keys. They were sweating profusely.
Dudian’s attention was diverted to the surface of the Earth to prevent reinforcements from coming at any time.
Soon, the two took out all the god’s marrow and put it into a huge black bag that looked like cloth or plastic. Dudian raised his hand and estimated that it weighed 400-500 kilograms, he casually asked: “How many minutes have passed?”
One of the middle-aged men’s face turned pale as he said in a trembling voice: “One, one minute…”
“Alright.”Dudian raised his hand and cut off the arm of an old man who was standing next to him.
Poland didn’t expect that dudian would attack without hesitation. It was as easy as pulling weeds. He was shocked, angry and scared, “You… you are so indifferent to life. It’s… It’s…”
“If you think it’s cruel, I can help him to reattach his arm. You can take one of his arms.”Dudian glanced at him.
Poland’s face turned red. He was so angry that he was trembling.
The old man hugged the wound of his broken arm. His lips were white from the pain. He was about to faint.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to him. He carried the huge black bag out of the room. He was about to leave when he heard a sharp scream coming from underground. It was as sharp as a metal whistle. He looked down and saw the source of the sound. There was an irregular weak heat source.
He was a bit surprised. He had noticed the heat source reaction earlier. But at that time the heat source reaction was in an oval shape, it should be the hatchling of a monster or an egg that was about to hatch. But at this moment the oval shape of the heat source was gone. Instead it became a thin irregular shape like a puddle of mud.
He was a bit curious. What kind of creature could change its body shape at will?
He suddenly thought that the heat source was on the eighth floor. According to the scene he had seen during the attack, the professor was working on the eighth floor. In other words, the deeper he went, the more advanced the experiment was.
He immediately turned and walked down the corridor.
Poland saw Dudian going down and was startled: “Are you going underground?”
“It’s rare for me to come here. How can I not visit?”Dudian said as he quickly went down the stairs. Soon he came to the eighth floor. He went straight down the corridor towards the room with the irregular heat source.
Poland saw Dudian running down the stairs. His face changed as he chased after him.
Dudian noticed Poland’s expression. He kicked the door open and looked at the irregular heat source in the room. He was surprised as he saw that the room looked like a laboratory. There were many test tubes inside, there was a huge transparent glass tank in the middle of the room. It was about three meters in diameter and two meters in height.
The bottom of the glass tank was pitch black. A mass of black substance was squirming inside. It seemed to be trying to squeeze out from the bottom of the glass tank and the cracks in the ground.
The black substance seemed to be alive. After Dudian kicked the door in, his body rippled. The frequency of the squirming increased. At the same time, there was a sharp sound, a fist-sized black mass slowly wriggled. It looked like a head but also like its eyes. It quietly stood there as if it was staring at Dudian.
Dudian had a feeling of being stared at. Moreover, the feeling of being stared at was not friendly. It was full of evil and murderous intent. It was like a ferocious beast was staring at him. His eyes flashed. From the environment here, this thing should be an experiment of the Monster Research Institute. However, he had never seen such a monster. It was not recorded in the Monster Atlas.
“What is this?”Dudian asked Poland who was chasing after him.
Poland’s face changed when he saw the black substance in the glass tank. His mouth was bitter as he saw Dudian ask. He didn’t expect that he would be noticed by the teenager. However, he was slightly glad that the teenager didn’t recognize this object, it seemed that he didn’t recognize it.
He immediately said: “This is the black stream. Our experiment is only half-finished. It hasn’t been completed yet.”
“Is it?”Dudian noticed that his eyes flickered before he replied. He narrowed his eyes, “Is this thing life? How is it made? What is its function? What is the purpose of making it?”
He quickly asked a series of questions. He stared at Poland.
Poland’s face slightly changed. It was alright for him to make up a name but it would take some time to think about other things. He saw that Dudian’s eyes were burning as if he was looking straight into his heart. He felt a bit nervous. He wasn’t good at lying, so he didn’t know where to start. He hesitated for a moment, he said: “It is a kind of life, but its intelligence is relatively low. It is similar to ordinary cattle and sheep. It is made of monsters and other materials. The specific process is too complicated.”
“What is the purpose of making it?”Dudian repeated. He didn’t give Poland time to think.
Poland clenched her teeth: “It is mainly used for exploration. Its perception is very sharp. It can be used as a tamed beast to explore the wasteland.”
Dudian felt his heart beat faster. He narrowed his eyes: “So its attack is weak?”
“Yes, yes.”
Dudian stepped forward and kicked the glass cylinder. The glass cylinder looked transparent but it was extremely hard. Fortunately, he used all his strength. Bang! There was a hole in the glass but there were no shards of glass splashing out, instead, it was like an iron sheet that was dented into the inside.
Before Dudian’s feet could pull back, the black substance seemed to have sensed something. It stretched out black tentacles and wrapped around Dudian’s feet.
Dudian immediately stopped and turned back to Poland. He grabbed the arm of the old man who had his arm cut off and threw it into the hole in the glass tank.
The old man stayed on the spot. He picked up the arm and hoped that he could reattach it in the future.
The black substance immediately surged like an excited child as it fell into the glass tank. It squeaked as the liquid from its body rushed to the arm and quickly wrapped it up, the black beard that was wrapped around Dudian immediately pierced into the broken arm. The next moment, the skin on the surface of the broken arm quickly withered. The old arm became more withered. The color of the skin also became dull and dark spots appeared, it was like the hand of a dead body.
Dudian narrowed his eyes. ‘feeding on life?’? He seemed to have seen such a situation before.
..
Don’t wait

chapters.title: Chapter 698
chapters.content:
Chapter 698 – Chapter 688: Return
“Is this called weak attack?”Dudian looked at Poland.
Poland was a bit embarrassed. He coughed: “This is a semi-finished product. It is still in the experiment. We don’t know what kind of ability it has. So we shouldn’t get too close to it.”
Dudian was too lazy to pay attention to him. Previously he said that it was used to explore perception. Now he said that it was a semi-finished product. It was obvious that he wasn’t telling the truth. However the other party was deliberately hiding it. Even if he used coercion it would be difficult to get the core information.
Suddenly a picture flashed in his mind. He was stunned. The next moment he looked at Poland: “What is this thing called? How many more do you have?”
Poland saw Dudian’s sudden change in expression. His heart tightened, he lowered his head: “This is called ‘black prison’. It is the only one in our research institute. There are other branches but they are the same as this semi-finished product.”
Dudian narrowed his eyes: “You have always said that this is half-finished. What does the finished product look like? What are its abilities?”
Poland’s face slightly changed. She hesitated: “The finished product should be similar to this but its volume is a bit bigger. Its ability is the same as this but it is much stronger.”
Dudian deeply looked at him. He turned around and looked at the black mucus squirming in the glass tank. White bone armor suddenly appeared on his arm as he grabbed the black mucus in the glass tank.
The black mucus sensed that Dudian was approaching. The surface of the mucus squirmed and stirred up many particles. It looked like a frightened cat. But the next moment, a bunch of black tentacles jumped out from the mucus and stabbed towards Dudian’s arm.
Dudian’s speed suddenly increased. He punched the black mucus and quickly retracted his hand. He held a ball of black mucus in his palm. It felt soft and wet. He took out a match and lit it up. The hot temperature made the black mucus in the glass tank dormant. The surface of the mucus also calmed down. It was like a black mirror, smooth and smooth, it didn’t move at all.
Dudian was more convinced. He lit the match on the small ball of black mucus in his hand. There was a loud sound and a vigorous spark suddenly appeared. It was as if a large ball of combustible material was suddenly burning.
Dudian clenched his fist and extinguished the flame. However the burning pain was coming from his palm. He opened his hand and saw that the color of the burnt black mucus had changed. It had become lighter and looked like grease.
He turned his head and looked at Poland: “This thing was originally made by you.”
The black mucus was very similar to the monster he had met outside the giant wall which had absorbed the life of the splitty. Moreover the splitty could change its body shape at will. It could be kneaded at will. Moreover it was also afraid of flames, the same thing as the black mucus was not recorded in the Monster Atlas!
He had to think of the two as the same kind of creature. The only difference was that the latter was bigger. If Poland’s description was correct then perhaps the monster he had met outside the giant wall.., it was the finished product of the little thing in front of him!
Poland looked at the coldness in Dudian’s eyes. He subconsciously took a step back and forced a smile: “Wh-what?”
“What is your purpose for making this?”Dudian grabbed his collar and lifted his body: “You better be honest. If you say something false again, I will make you regret it for the rest of your life!”
Poland’s face was ugly. He didn’t think that Dudian knew about the black prison. From his previous performance, he didn’t think that Dudian knew from the beginning. Could it be that he had seen the extraordinary features of the black prison? What kind of eyesight was this? Could it be that these crazy fighters were so sensitive to this kind of thing?
He hesitated and decided to submit to Dudian to protect himself. Dudian’s eyes narrowed as he was about to open his mouth, “It seems that we should go. What does it eat?”
Poland was puzzled but said: “It eats meat.”
“Find a way to put this thing on. I will go and meet your friend.”Dudian put the god’s marrow package in the room and took Aisha out of the room. However his peripheral vision was focused on Poland, he could clearly see Poland’s every move even if he wasn’t underground. It was impossible for him to escape from his weak physique.
Dudian heard the whistling wind as he came to the surface. He looked up and saw a huge black bird flying towards him in the dark night. Its four to five meters long black wings were extremely ferocious, there were sharp thorns growing on the edges of the black wings. It was full of destructive power but it seemed a bit out of place. There was a black haired youth in the middle of the black wings. His face was cold, his skin was white and his eyes were deep, his eyes were particularly deep and charming.
It was the first time that Dudian had seen a pioneer with black hair. Most of the pioneers he had seen before were blonde. This was the color of the noble’s hair. In the ordinary people, the noble ruled over the civilians, and in the strong.., the strong people with noble blood also had an absolute advantage in numbers.
“I can only rely on you.”Dudian turned to look at Aisha. There was a trace of sigh and gentleness in his eyes. He whispered: “After this time is over, I will deal with these kittens and puppies.”
Aisha was silent.
Dudian raised his hand and gently shook the bell.
The bell rang rhythmically. Aisha’s indifferent eyes revealed a trace of bloodlust. It was as if she had woken up from a deep sleep. She suddenly looked up, she looked at the black-haired youth who was approaching from the sky. She growled and attacked him.
The youth saw Dean and Aisha from afar. Because Aisha was wearing a veil, he didn’t recognize them. But from their clothes and the aura they emitted, he knew that they were the real culprits who attacked the Monster Research Institute, he immediately sped up and was about to land. Before he could ask about the identity and background of the two people, he was scared by Aisha who was the first to pounce on him.
Aisha’s footwork was unskilled and messy, but her speed was astonishing. She soon arrived in front of the young man.
The young man was shocked and angry. “Who are you? !”
Roar!
Aisha growled and pounced at him with bared fangs and brandished claws.
The young man was angry. He flipped his palm and a long spear appeared. He swung it and stabbed at Aisha’s neck.
Aisha was different from the ordinary zombies after all. She did not just bump into the long spear. Instead, she raised her hand and slapped. This slap was not like an ordinary and unskilled slap. Instead, it was like a set of grappling techniques. Bang, she pressed the spear into the ground and stepped on the shaft. She rushed to the front of the young man and stabbed her finger into his carotid artery.
The young man was shocked. He wanted to pull out his spear and retreat. However, he felt that he was trampled by Haisha. He had no choice but to throw away his spear and retreat.
Dudian’s eyes lit up when he saw Haisha’s sudden change in attack. He was surprised and surprised. The ordinary zombies would completely lose consciousness and only have the primitive instinct to eat and attack, but Aisha’s attack was completely different from what ordinary zombies could do. Did It mean that his consciousness still existed in his mind, but he couldn’t speak or express it?
Thinking of this, he was excited.
At this time, the young man used the advantage of his wings to swoop down and attack Aisha from time to time. His wings looked like they had grown on his shoulders. The spikes on the wings seemed to be spliced together, but they were extremely powerful.., if an ordinary person was caught by the wings, they would have to tear off a layer of skin.
Aisha stood on the ground and roared like a lioness Roaring Falcon.
Dudian was not worried about fighting at all. Instead, his mind was distracted by his previous thoughts. He thought of Eleanor who had turned into a corpse. The latter’s performance was completely different from Aisha’s. If the physique of the infected was different.., eleanor’s physique was that of a pioneer. Logically speaking, she should be at the level of a zombie king if she was infected.
However, her performance only had the characteristics of an ordinary zombie. The only zombie that he had seen with black eyes was Aisha and the zombie king that had infected her!
If the infected zombie poison was the key, then the infected zombie poison came from Aisha. It could be considered as the zombie King’s zombie poison, but it still didn’t cause the same change.
He could only think of one possibility, and that was the biggest difference between Eleanor and Aisha — bloodline power!
Eleanor was only an ordinary member of the Dragon Clan, she didn’t awaken her bloodline power. That was the biggest difference between her and Aisha! If that was the reason, then the young corpse king that infected Aisha was most likely a strong warrior of the Witcher clan that possessed bloodline power!
However, there was another possibility. There was a certain probability that the pioneer would be infected by the Zombie King. Aisha fell for the concept but Eleanor didn’t.
“I’ll have to ask the professor about this.”Dudian thought. At this time, the battle in front of them suddenly changed. Aisha roared and two huge wings appeared on her back like two huge palms, she supported herself on the ground and suddenly threw herself into the sky.
The youth in the air saw the black wings and his pupils shrank. He cried out in horror: “Dragon? !”
Aisha had already rushed out like an arrow from a bow. In the blink of an eye, she was in front of him. The dragon wings rolled and her whole body turned into a sharp cone like a hurricane and drilled into his chest.
The youth flapped his wings and couldn’t Dodge in time. He hurriedly tightened his wings and used his hands to protect his chest.
Bang! The two collided. The youth’s wings were torn open, and his body flew backward like a man with broken wings. He slid down from the air and crashed to the ground.
Dean was a bit surprised. He didn’t even give the order, but Aisha had activated her magic marks state to fight. Was it because she had encountered a difficult opponent that she had activated her hidden power?
While he was thinking, he looked at the young man who was getting up from the ground. He suddenly had an idea and raised his hand to shake the bell.
Haisha’s body slightly trembled when she heard the bell. She put away her diving posture and turned to look at Dean who was on the ground behind her. There was a faint luster in her black eyes.
The young man saw that Dean didn’t take the opportunity to chase after him. He quickly flapped his wings and flew to the distance. He knew that it was difficult to compete with the pioneers of the Dragon Clan who had magic marks, but flying on the ground with the advantage of geography, the latter might not be his opponent.
Aisha slowly landed and put away her wings. She returned to her previous silent appearance and stood quietly.
Dudian looked at the direction where the young man had left. He turned around and went back to the underground of the institute.
When he arrived, Poland heard footsteps. She immediately stood still and smiled: “You Are Back?”
“Your Friend’s luck is good. He escaped fast enough.”Dudian casually said. He went to the next drawer and opened it. He took out a key and looked at Poland.
Poland saw that Dudian had found the hidden key. His face turned red. It was as ugly as a pig’s liver. He clearly saw that Dudian had left the surface. Moreover, the movement from the ground also showed that.., dudian was fighting outside. How could he know what he was doing here?
Dudian took the key and turned to the next room. It was like a private laboratory. There were beds, desks and simple daily necessities. He took the key and opened a safe in the room. There was a thick stack of documents inside. He picked it up and flipped through it. He raised his eyebrows slightly and saw the “A +”symbol on one of the documents.
He turned around and looked at Poland, who was at the door. There was a hint of mockery in his eyes, “I thought you were so loyal to the research institute, but it turns out that your greed is no less than mine. You actually wanted to use me to attack the research institute and steal the confidential information of the research institute. Are you a mole planted in the research institute by other forces? In other words, you have built other institutes. What are you secretly researching?”
Dudian patted the information in his hand: “Aren’t you afraid that other people will come over and see it? You are so confident that they won’t search your safe?”
Poland lowered her head. She didn’t speak.
Dudian put down the information in his hand and went out to pick up the package. He looked at the other side of the room. There was a complete sealed glass jar. He grabbed it and said to Poland: “Let’s go.”
Poland looked at the information on his safe and hesitated.
Dudian saw his concern and indifferently said: “Don’t think about it. From now on, you will work with me.”
Poland was startled: “You want me to work for you?”
“Otherwise you would have died.”Dudian’s words were very direct.
Poland reacted and bitterly smiled in his heart. He quietly followed behind Dudian.
Dudian called Poland and told the other two to run for their lives. He took Poland back along the street and found a tailor’s shop. The cloth in the tailor’s shop was stained with blood. It was a sign of the disaster that had happened here.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to them. He changed his clothes and found perfume in a woman’s bag that was lost on the street. He sprayed it on the three of them to cover up their smell, he found them based on the scent.

chapters.title: Chapter 699
chapters.content:
Chapter 699 – Chapter 689: Making Witcher [ First Watch ]
Dudian took Aisha and Poland back to the outer wall. Along the way, he saw a large number of undeads wandering in the streets. The whole city was full of signs of desolation. There were trembling survivors hiding in some houses, it seemed that they were praying for rescue. But from the situation on the streets, the army hadn’t begun to clean up. Or rather, the army had gone to another place.
Dudian guessed that the army was most likely protecting the retreat of the nobles.
It could be seen that the situation in the inner wall was not much different from the outer wall. The nobles occupied an absolute height while the life and death of the civilians were as cheap as grass and trees.
Dudian didn’t rescue the survivors. He didn’t have the slightest sympathy. The good ones were sheep and the evil ones were wolves. He had chosen the wolves and sheep. Moreover, he had expected this kind of phenomenon, however the reality was more cruel than he had imagined. However he was more willing to see such a situation. It would become a chess piece in his hand and pave the way for his revenge!
Dudian found an empty horse for Poland to ride. He was carrying the god’s marrow. He was holding the black mucus creature named ‘black prison’. He was running at full speed. There was a faint light in the sky when he arrived at the giant wall, dawn was coming.
This night was destined to be extremely long for the people of the inner wall.
“Are you from the outer wall?”Poland saw Dudian standing in front of the giant wall.
Dudian glanced at him: “Is there a problem?”
Poland’s face changed. He bowed his head but didn’t say anything. He was shocked. In his heart the outer wall had always been ruled as a barren area. Moreover they had limited supplies from the Monster Research Institute, it was already good enough to reach the level of senior hunter. But Dudian’s strength was not only not that of a senior hunter but also that of a pioneer. This was not something that could be done by the people of the outer wall!
He knew that he was involved in a huge conspiracy. It was very likely that Dudian had a deal with a big force in the inner wall.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to his thoughts. He flew up the giant wall and returned to the ground. He picked up the god’s marrow and flew back to the giant wall. He took him along the passage of the giant wall to the outer wall. An hour later.., he took Poland back to Mt. Utoto. At this moment the first ray of dawn shone from the edge of the giant wall. It fell on the square of the temple. It brought warmth to Dudian’s body.
“Master, you are back.”Neuss was waiting at the entrance of the temple. He was the first one to greet dudian.
Dudian nodded slightly and brought Poland into the temple.
Neuss handed a cup of hot tea to dudian: “Master, you have worked hard. Are You Hurt?”
“No.”Dudian took a sip of the hot tea to dispel the chill on his left hand. He looked at Poland: “How long will it take to make a Witcher?”
Poland saw the magnificent hall. Although he didn’t know anything about the outer wall but he knew that Dudian’s power in the outer wall was extraordinary, moreover he wasn’t a hidden force. This meant that Dudian’s power in the outer wall was monstrous. Moreover his power was comparable to that of the pioneers. It was estimated that the entire outer wall was in his hands.
He couldn’t Guess Dudian’s purpose. He pondered for a moment: “It will take at least a month.”
“A month?”Dudian frowned: “I can’t wait that long. I will give you half a month at most!”
Poland said: “It will take at least half a month. If my guess is right, you shouldn’t have the equipment to make a witcher. One month is very tight.”
“I’ll give you half a month.”Dudian coldly said: “You don’t have to worry about the equipment. Tell me what you need and I’ll send people to cooperate with you. If you can’t make it in half a month then there is no need for you to breathe.”
Poland saw Dudian’s overbearing attitude: “The process of making the device is very complicated. Unless you can get my former colleagues to help you, I won’t be able to do it in half a month.”
“I will personally help you. There is no need to talk about this.”Dudian waved his hand, “Write a list of the materials and equipment you need. I will get people to prepare it. Also, tell me the process of making it.”
Poland was angry. He thought that there was no use for you to help me! But since things had come to this point, he knew that it was useless to talk about it. He could only rely on Dudian, “To make a witcher, the owner of the witcher first needs to cut off half of the parasitic soul worms in the body. This is the key to the witcher. Only in this way can the witcher replace the mutation of the body. Moreover, only the owner of the witcher can use the witcher. If it falls into the hands of others, it is just an ordinary weapon.”
Dudian nodded slightly. He had learned some things from Aisha. Cutting off half of the parasitic soul worms was the most dangerous step in making a witcher. The parasitic soul worms would form magic marks after entering the body. Just like the human heart, it was the biggest weakness, cutting off half of the magic marks was equivalent to cutting off half of the heart. If one was not careful, they would lose their life. Therefore, most people would make a witcher before the magic marks entered the body.
This kind of condition could only be achieved by the Witcher family or the military bigwigs. Aisha’s witcher was made when she was very young. She cut off the parasitic soul worms in advance and only half of them entered the body.
Such a harsh condition was a huge threshold for many people who evolved into pioneers through their own luck. After all, the removal of magic marks was life-threatening. At worst, they would be crippled, at worst, they would die, not all pioneers dared to cut off magic marks to make witcher devices. Therefore, most pioneers chose to give up their own bodies and could not care about their image.
Most of the pioneers would be sent to guard the wilderness so as not to scare the people.
“The process of cutting off magic marks will be more dangerous if I do it alone.”Poland saw Dudian’s calm expression and thought that he wasn’t aware of the dangers, “The probability of death is at least 50% . 70% will result in disability. If you have the most advanced equipment in the institute and find two doctors then the chances of success will be much higher. At most there is only a 20% chance of failure.”
Dudian nodded slightly. The 20% chance was not low. Not everyone dared to take such a risk.
“Isn’t there another way?”Dudian looked at him.
Poland was slightly startled. His eyes flashed with a trace of surprise. He didn’t expect that Dudian knew so much. He hesitated for a moment, “Indeed, there is another way to replace it. It is to find the same kind of parasitic soul worm, cut off half of it to make a witcher, and use the other half as nutrients to fuse into the magic marks in the body. Then take a drop of magic mark blood, and it will be done, but…”
Dudian saw that he wasn’t lying. He nodded slightly. Aisha told him about this method. However, this method was rarely used. It was almost forgotten.
Generally, only those who had evolved to the limit would need a witcher. The financial resources and connections needed to make a witcher were enormous. Even for the Dragon family, only the core family members and people with outstanding qualifications could get a witcher, only then could they be nurtured by the clan and given a witcher device. Ordinary members were not qualified to apply for it at all. As for the core clansmen, most of them would apply to make a witcher device since they were young, so they did not need to extract the magic marks from their bodies.
Therefore, other than this kind of people, the others who did not have strong connections would apply to make a witcher device only after they had advanced to a pioneer and obtained rich financial resources.
As for ordinary people who became pioneers, it was almost destined that their magic marks were extraordinary. They were all extremely rare magic marks, or even legendary magic marks. It was already good enough to get one of these magic marks. It was even harder to find parasitic soul worms of the same kind, however, it did not exclude some people who were extremely lucky.

chapters.title: Chapter 700
chapters.content:
Chapter 700 – Chapter 690: Backlash [ Second Update ]
Dudian naturally wouldn’t take the risk to extract the deified parasitic soul worms from his body. But he still had two splitter soul worms. He could use these two soul worms to make a witcher and then take a drop of deified magic Mark’s blood!
There was almost no danger if he only took a drop of magic Mark’s blood. Moreover, the deified genes in the drop of blood would not only allow him to be one with the witcher but also slowly assimilate the quality of the witcher.
After all, his deified splitter’s magic mark was very different from the ordinary splitter’s magic mark.
But according to Aisha’s words, over time, the Witcher would slowly assimilate with the body. Even if he used the splitter’s magic mark to make the witcher, after a long time, it would slowly transform into a deified splitter’s witcher!
“Since this method can work, let’s do it.”Dudian said, “The most time-consuming part of making a witcher is to cut off the magic mark. Now you don’t need to cut off the magic mark. Half a month is enough for you to make a witcher.”
Poland smiled: “If that’s the case then I won’t eat or sleep. I can barely make it.”
Dudian didn’t pay attention to his complaints. With his help and the help of five-star Alchemists, half a month was more than enough. He waved to Poland, “Write the list of the required materials. I will call people to arrange it.”
Poland sighed as she walked to Dudian’s desk. She picked up the pen from Dudian and bent down. She pondered for a moment and began to write.
After a moment, Dudian picked up the list and looked at it. Although he couldn’t see anything wrong with it but at least he could pretend to understand it, at the same time he could read the secrets of making a witcher.
He handed the list to Neuss: “Go and get it.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss respectfully nodded. He took the list and left.
After he left.., dudian looked at Poland: “I haven’t asked you about it. I remember you said that more than 200 years ago you were the first to notice the effect of the God’s marrow. Didn’t you say that someone ate the Soul Crystal by mistake?”
Poland bowed: “Yes.”
“Is this kind of ice-crystal body called ‘corpse’?”Dudian looked at him.
Poland shook his head, “There is a difference between ‘corpse’and ‘corpse’. The tissues in the body will freeze but the ice-crystal body will slowly lose the flesh and blood and turn into a special kind of ice. This kind of ice is different from the ice that is frozen by water.” He paused for a moment and frowned, “It’s a bit difficult to describe it. You should know that ice that is frozen by water is lifeless. After melting, it is water. However, this kind of ice is different. It Won’t melt but it is alive.”
“Alive?”Dudian looked at him, “How do you define it?”
Poland wryly smiled: “It’s a bit difficult to understand. I don’t know how to describe it to you.”
“Your ability to express is quite bad.”Dudian evaluated. He thought that the ice crystals on his left hand wouldn’t melt no matter how high the temperature was. But it would bring warmth.
“Can this kind of crystallized body be treated?”Dudian asked again.
Poland shook his head: “We haven’t found a way to treat it.”
“What happened to those who were crystallized more than 200 years ago?”Dudian narrowed his eyes.
Poland’s face slightly changed as he shook his head: “I don’t know.”
Dudian noticed the change in his face: “Do you still want to lie to me?”
Poland’s face was ugly as he lowered his head.
“Are you really not going to tell me?”Dudian stared at him.
Poland lowered his head in silence.
“Don’t forget that your family is still in my hands.”Dudian coldly reminded him.
Poland’s face changed as he clenched his fingers. He lowered his head and didn’t say anything.
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. He didn’t expect that Poland wouldn’t tell him. He had a bad premonition in his heart. Could it be that there was a big secret hidden in this matter?
He pondered for a long time but was still unable to answer. He deeply looked at Poland. He didn’t continue to probe into this matter. Instead, he would expose the fact that he didn’t kidnap his family. He changed the question, “You are doing research. Why didn’t you grow magic marks to strengthen your physique? In this way, at least your thinking will be more agile and your lifespan will be longer, right?”
This was what he felt strange about. But in his heart, he felt that the magic marks didn’t only bring strength to his body!
Especially when he saw the distorted worm entering his body and forming the magic marks, there was an inexplicable strange feeling. It was both fear and an unspeakable sense of loss. It was as if he had lost something extremely important.
Poland saw that Dudian didn’t continue to ask. He loosened his clenched fist. He was afraid that Dudian would really kill his family and force them to die. If he did that he would feel that he would go crazy from the pain. However.., although his heart was relieved but Dudian’s question made him feel troubled. He felt that every question of the teenager was tricky and incisive. It touched the taboo in his heart.
“We are doing research. Strength is useless.”Poland bowed his head.
“Strength is useful to everyone. Don’t you want to live a long life?”Dudian looked at him, “If a doctor doesn’t take his own medicine and accept his own treatment, there is only one reason. He will die if he takes it. After treatment his condition will be worse.”
Poland’s face changed. His face was covered in cold sweat. He lowered his head. It was hard for him to imagine that he would be questioned by a teenager who was less than 20 years old.
The hall fell into silence. Poland could only hear his heavy breathing. He held his chest but his heartbeat was faster. He could only slightly open his mouth to breathe in the air so that his breathing was not so obvious.
“Tell Me, why?”Dudian looked at him.
Poland bit his lips. After a long time he sighed. He looked up like a deflated ball. His face was full of fatigue, “You are a monster. Didn’t you kidnap me to help you make a witcher? How could you be in the mood to pay attention to this?”
“Just answer my question.”Dudian said.
Poland smiled bitterly and sighed: “Actually it’s nothing. I Can’t go back now. Just say it. I will admit that I broke the ban.”He paused for a moment, he whispered: “In fact, this is the rule of the research institute. As for the reason, it is probably because of the effect of magic marks. It is not as significant as you feel. It is true that using magic marks to strengthen one’s physique can make one’s mind more agile and have extraordinary abilities. But it can not make one live longer.”
There was a bitter smile on his face, he said: “People who have magic marks will not live longer than ordinary people. Once they die of old age, the magic marks will bite their master. I believe that you will regret it if you see it.”
Dudian’s pupils shrank. Magic marks bite?
“I have seen a lot of death. Why haven’t I seen the magic marks bite?”He asked.
Poland looked at him in ridicule, “I am talking about old death. Have you seen a hunter who died of old age? No. If you have seen it then you wouldn’t ask. People who died in battle will die with their magic marks. But people who die of old age will not die with their magic marks. Instead, the magic marks will bite their master and take away their master’s last life.”
Dudian was stunned.
Suddenly a chill spread from his chest. His scalp went numb and goosebumps rose all over his body. His heart trembled as he suddenly remembered that there was a living parasitic soul worm wrapped in the magic marks on his chest! How could this thing counterattack when its Master was dying?
“Is there only one reason?”Dudian’s face changed as he stared at Poland.
COMMENT 0 comment

Although Dudian was afraid of the magic mark backlash but he felt that it shouldn’t be enough for them to give up the power of magic marks. After all, according to Poland.., dying of old age would be affected by the magic mark backlash but dying in battle wouldn’t. If they wanted to prevent the magic mark backlash then they would have to commit suicide.
Poland looked at Dudian’s sharp eyes and sighed, “Yes, this is only one of the reasons. There are two other reasons. The first reason is that our institute has a ban on the use of experimental items. Once you violate the ban, you will be immediately executed. There was once a person who was attracted by the power of magic marks and bred a legendary parasitic soul worm. As a result, he was wanted by the whole wall and ended up dead.”
“Ban?”Dudian narrowed his eyes. He didn’t expect that the research institute would ban them from breeding magic marks. From Poland’s expression it seemed that they weren’t lying. Moreover it was easy to verify the truth of such a lie, there should be no need to lie.
“The second point is related to the myth.”Poland continued: “In the myth, the goddess of war stabilizes the world order and brings peace. But when the Devil invades, the magic marks are taken from the body of the Devil. It is an ominous brand that will bring disaster to oneself and others. Although it can bring great power but it is a hotbed for the devil to descend. So unless it is necessary, ordinary people won’t easily breed magic marks. After all, this is the power of the Devil.”
Dudian was startled. He didn’t think that the second reason was related to the myth. However, the myth that Poland had told him was very strange. Although he wasn’t well-read yet, but he was slightly familiar with the myths of the world. But he had never heard of any country’s myth that was similar to Poland’s.
Could it be that this myth was created after the disaster?
He felt that it was necessary to go to the library to find some books. He had looked for them before but his status was low at that time. He had limited access to the library, but he had to do a lot of things so he slowly ignored this matter.
“The myth of the upper epoch…”Dudian muttered. Suddenly his heart skipped a beat. He looked at Poland: “Wasn’t the upper epoch destroyed? All the materials were gone. How could there be a myth of the upper epoch?”
Poland said: “Because of the cataclysm many knowledge of the last epoch has been lost. But the myth is engraved on the stone tablet. It is said that the first wall master brought it back from the sea. The myth is incomplete.”
Dudian frowned: “The first wall master was able to fish things from the sea?”
Poland nodded: “The first wall master received the gift of the Kingdom of God. He has extraordinary power. It is a piece of cake to fish things from the sea.”
“The Kingdom of God?”Dudian heard another strange word. It wasn’t an adjective. His heart jumped: “The Kingdom of God?”
Poland was surprised to see Dudian’s surprised expression. He felt a bit strange. It wasn’t a big secret in the inner wall. At least it wasn’t unfamiliar to the pioneers. But it seemed that Dudian didn’t know about it, he thought for a moment: “The Kingdom of God is the kingdom of gods. It is said that the god of war has created a paradise. It is peaceful and peaceful. There is no war. There is no plague or disaster. All the monsters don’t dare to invade it.”
Dudian looked into his eyes: “Are you talking about a myth or is it true? where is the Kingdom of God?”
“It is outside the giant wall. It is very far away.”There was a trace of yearning in Poland’s eyes, “According to His Majesty, the life there is completely different from ours. People live in harmony. They don’t have to worry about food and drink. There is no need to personally plant them. Moreover there are rich minerals and gold everywhere. His Majesty also said that there is an eternal coffin…”
He didn’t notice that Dudian’s face had turned extremely ugly. By the time Poland finished speaking, Dudian had already controlled his emotions and regained his calm. However his mood was complicated and he didn’t know whether to be happy or not, he didn’t expect that there would be a ‘Kingdom of God’in addition to the giant wall. He thought that by overthrowing the inner wall he would be able to rule all the surviving humans. But now.., this was only a part of it.
“You said that the Kingdom of God is far away. How does His Majesty Know About the Kingdom of God? Has He been there?”Dudian looked up at Poland.
Poland indifferently smiled: “Of course His Majesty has been there. He has been there many times. Only His Majesty can go there at will.”
“How did he go?”Dudian stared at him. The farther away he was from the giant wall, the stronger the monsters would be. Especially in the depths of the wasteland, legendary monsters would be killed, the power of the giant wall was far stronger than that of the Pioneers?
“Of course the envoys of the Kingdom of God came to welcome the past.”Poland’s voice was filled with envy and pride as she glanced at Dudian, “I don’t know if you have seen a flying dragon. The envoys of the Kingdom of God usually come here once every ten or five years.”
Flying Dragon? Dudian felt a bit familiar as he was startled.
He remembered that he had accidentally looked up and saw a black shadow flying over the giant wall. At that time people said that it was a flying dragon but he didn’t pay attention to it. He felt that it was a bit strange, it didn’t eat the living things inside the giant wall. After hearing Poland’s words he suddenly realized that there were people riding on the back of the Flying Dragon. No wonder it didn’t land and attack humans.
“Riding the flying dragon across the wasteland…”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he looked at Poland: “Tell Me Everything You know about the Kingdom of God!”
Poland saw the trace of fear in Dudian’s eyes. He felt very comfortable but didn’t show it, “I’m just an experimenter so I don’t know much. I only know that the previous generations of the giant wall were appointed by the Kingdom of God. Our Monster Research Institute is also a force of the Kingdom of God. It doesn’t belong to his majesty. Moreover His Majesty has to unconditionally cooperate with us in our experiments.”
“The Wall Master is appointed by the Kingdom of God?”Dudian was surprised again? Doesn’t this mean that the Kingdom of God is completely superior to the giant wall? In other words, the Kingdom of God has the power to easily crush the giant wall!
He felt a trace of fear. This also proved that the pioneers were not the end of evolution. There should be a stronger existence above them and that kind of existence lived in the Kingdom of God!
“The giant wall was appointed by the Kingdom of God. Isn’t our entire giant wall a city of the Kingdom of God?”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he felt the pressure in his heart, he thought that the giant wall was the same as the giant wall of Sylvia but the name was different. However, from the fact that the giant wall was appointed by the Kingdom of God, the name didn’t seem to be for show, instead, it really had the function of a “Kingdom”!
From what Poland said, it could be seen that the status of the giant wall and the Kingdom of God was just like the difference between a mayor and a King!
Moreover, a kingdom envoy was able to invite the wall master out and let the wall master enter the Kingdom of God alone. This meant that the giant wall itself was a subsidiary land of the Kingdom of God!
He suddenly felt that the world in front of him, the hazy fog that covered the outside of the giant wall, was suddenly torn apart, revealing a towering giant creature. It was entrenched in front of him with unparalleled power, and it could not be looked at directly. Meanwhile, he was struggling hard.., the giant wall that he had carefully overthrown was just a subsidiary of this behemoth. What he had to face was not just the inner wall!
Once he overthrew the inner wall and gained control, it would be equivalent to a war with the divine kingdom!
What he would face then would be the divine kingdom’s sanction!
His face was slightly pale. He felt that the air was suddenly very stuffy, and he could not breathe. If he had known about the divine kingdom before, he would not have started the war so quickly. Instead, he would continue to operate at the price of a long time, he would completely devour the inner wall and become a demon king in the darkness. He would be in charge of the giant wall. At that time, he would only need to push out a puppet to be the wall master.
But now that the arrow was on the bowstring, he had no choice but to do it!
His thoughts moved quickly. He suddenly thought of what Poland said. The Flying Dragon would come once every ten or five years. He remembered that it had only been a year since the last time he saw the Flying Dragon. In other words, in the shortest amount of time.., the next time the flying dragon came to the giant wall would be four years later!
If he was lucky, the flying dragon would only come once every ten years, so he still had nine years to plan!
“It’s not a dead end yet…”he muttered to himself and heaved a sigh of relief. However, he still felt that time was tight. Even if he came once every nine years, he could not guarantee that he would find a way to fight against the divine kingdom within nine years, after all, it had been ten years since he came to this world in the blink of an eye. In these ten years, he had only climbed up from a lowly commoner to his current status.
During this process, he had already fallen into desperate straits several times. He had only narrowly escaped death.
Moreover, a large part of the credit for his achievements today was brought about by the super chip. However, he did not know if the knowledge inside would still be useful in fighting against the Kingdom of God.
“If I can produce a nuclear bomb within nine years…”this thought appeared in his mind, and he quickly felt a chill. Putting aside whether he could produce it or not, even if he could produce a nuclear bomb, he wanted to eliminate this threat.., the price was likely to be the burial of the entire God’s kingdom. The number of humans living there should be more than the number of people in the giant wall!
He thought of his father’s words before he fell asleep, using the super chip to lead the survivors to find a way to survive and reproduce.
But now, the things he did were more and more deviant from his father’s instructions. He did not want to go against the orders of the people he loved the most, but if he did not do so, he would die. Even when that thought appeared, he felt that he was the biggest pest and the biggest destroyer in this world. Perhaps his death would be a good thing for this world!
He felt something and turned to look at Aisha beside him. The confusion in his black eyes instantly disappeared, revealing a gentle and loving expression. He thought to himself, even if I die, I will let you come back to Life Before I Die!

chapters.title: Chapter 702
chapters.content:
Chapter 702 – Chapter 692: The Origin Of The Catastrophe [ Second Update ]
Haisha sat quietly beside Dudian like a virtuous wife.
Dudian slowly withdrew his eyes from her face and slightly closed his eyes: “You can leave first. If you need anything else about making a witcher’s device, you can come to me anytime.”
Poland saw that Dudian didn’t continue to ask. She was relieved and bowed her head.
“Arrange a place for him.”Dudian’s words were directed to Neuss, “In addition get the materials on the list ready as soon as possible. Hawkeye and Sword King will send some of the best alchemists from the life faction to assist him.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss nodded respectfully.
Dudian slowly opened his eyes and looked at the empty temple. There was a trace of worry in his heart. He sighed and gently rubbed his nose. There were some other doubts in his heart, but he was too lazy to ask. It was difficult for him to digest the ‘Kingdom of God’that Poland had mentioned. It was a huge hidden danger which he would have to face in the future!
The plan to overthrow the inner wall had exhausted his mind and spirit. The inner wall hadn’t been solved yet. Moreover the ‘Kingdom of God’was looking down from the distance, it was extremely far away, and the divine kingdom would only go back and forth to the giant wall once every ten or five years. It could be seen that the journey was extremely far and dangerous. He would not know the changes of the giant wall for a while.
If it was in the old era where communications were developed, his actions might have already been met with the powerful suppression of the supreme ruler.
In the world where information was blocked, he could only touch the elephant blind. In the end, he was too small, like an ant. If he could cover the sky with one hand and hold the entire elephant with one hand, it would be obvious.
He sighed in his heart and suddenly thought that the existence of the “Divine kingdom”might not be a bad thing for him. According to Poland, the first wall master had an extraordinary ability to find things from the bottom of the sea, and this ability was given by the divine kingdom. That meant that the technological level of the divine kingdom was far higher than the giant Wall’s level! Then, the corpse transformation problem that could not be researched in the giant wall might be able to find a glimmer of hope in the Divine Kingdom!
His heart began to heat up as he thought of this. His eyes flashed as he recalled the information that Poland had told him.
“He said that the reason why he didn’t have magic marks is because of the ban and the myth. The magic marks came from the devil so he rejected them! The myth that he spoke of seemed to be related to the end of the world but…”Dudian’s eyes flickered, these two reasons were still untenable in front of him. He was no longer a small figure but the ruler of the outer wall.
The biggest difference between a small figure and a ruler was not only wealth, power, power, but also thinking!
He felt that if he was the ruler of the Kingdom of God, not only would he not prohibit these experimenters from entering the magic marks, but he would also think of ways to encourage them to enter the magic marks! After all, the magic marks could bring faster thinking and faster skills. These would help increase their efficiency in conducting experiments. Efficiency could condense time and improve development. These were both beneficial and harmless!
Moreover, with the power of the Kingdom of God, they could control a giant wall. There was no need to worry that they would not be able to control the experimenters of a mere monster research institute. Excluding these factors.., he couldn’t think of a reason to stop them from colonizing the magic marks!
Unless..
The Kingdom of God didn’t want their experiments to progress too fast!
This was the only possibility that Dudian could think of. He had thought that there might be dangers hidden in the magic marks so he would ban them from colonizing. It was like selling poison but he wouldn’t eat it.
But this era was different. There wasn’t so much humanistic care and moral dogma. In the face of constant attacks from monsters outside the giant wall, the lives of people in this era were worthless. Even if the magic marks contained great dangers.., at least in his opinion, after being implanted with the magic marks for so many years, nothing had gone wrong. And according to what he knew, if the other hunters did not die in battle, they could live for many years.
If these experimenters were to be implanted with the magic marks, even if the magic marks still contained a danger that he could not know, then before the danger erupted, it would be enough to create a greater value!
Therefore, this possibility was eliminated by him. However, the conclusion that he came up with made him feel strange. If the Kingdom of God did not want the progress of the monster research to be too fast, then why did they create the Monster Research Institute?
Wasn’t that contradicting themselves?
He pondered for a long time, but still could not come up with a clue. In the end, he could only give up. After all, this matter was not the most urgent matter at the moment. He could wait and think about it later.
Other than that, there was another thing that he felt that he had to understand as soon as possible. That was the origin of the giant wall. After the appearance of the “Divine Kingdom”, he could not help but think of one possibility — the giant wall of Sylvia.., was it the only giant wall?
If this giant wall was ruled by the divine kingdom, then were there any other giant walls under the divine kingdom?
Moreover, the structure of this giant wall was magnificent and huge. It was definitely not something that could be created by simple human strength. After all, there were so many monsters outside the wall, and they could attack at any time. It was almost as difficult as ascending to the sky to build such a building while defending against the monsters.
It was very likely that the giant wall was created by the Kingdom of God. Even if it wasn’t, the answer should be found there!
Moreover, even if it was the Kingdom of God, he didn’t think that they had the ability to create such a giant wall. It was unheard of and difficult to build such a giant wall.
He got up and walked out of the temple. He found Barton and asked him to take him to the library of the Holy See. He wanted to immediately read all the books about the giant wall.
In the blink of an eye, from dawn to dusk, Dudian stayed at the top level of the library for a whole day. He sat at the wooden desk. His face was ugly as he was surrounded by books, there were also some thick books scattered on the ground.
“The invasion of demons, the human race is facing a catastrophe. The God of war has come to fight back the demons, build the giant wall and shelter the living…”Dudian muttered to himself. His expression was a bit dull. He read the “Giant wall record”, although there were slight differences in the books such as “War myth”but the general content was good. Although most of the myths were fictional but there was still a bit of history to be seen from them.
Just like the Chinese myth “Suiren”, he made fire from wood and brought fire to mankind. This merit was deified and the more it was spread, the more god-like it was. It made people feel that it was fictional but the thing about making fire was true.
This was why Dudian would read these myths to find the truth from the fiction. Today’s reading didn’t waste his time. He had read all the books about demons, they came from the Stars!
It was because of this that he was convinced that the things in the myths were true!
Because he had personally witnessed the disaster before the catastrophe!

chapters.title: Chapter 703
chapters.content:
Chapter 703 – Chapter 693: Confusion [ Third Update ]
Three hundred years had passed and most of the survivors of the old era had died of old age. Dudian felt that he was the one who was the most aware of the catastrophe in the world. According to the records of the giant wall, the catastrophe originated from the old era when humans borrowed the power of the Devil. The “Power of the devil”was the nuclear bomb! All the nuclear bombs in the world, especially Russia in Asia, had detonated all the hidden big Ivan and caused a destructive nuclear storm!
Because of this, three hundred years later, the nuclear radiation was still raging outside the giant wall. The sky was covered with nuclear dust and countless ordinary creatures had mutated into bloodthirsty monsters.
However, the reason why countries detonated nuclear bombs was not because of the Third World War but because of the Great War with the monsters recorded in the records of the giant wall!
Human beings on Earth were determined to resist the alien invasion. This was a common theme in the sci-fi movies of the old era. However, Dudian had witnessed such a fictional thing three hundred years ago, it was like a nightmare that had really happened in reality!
He had heard from his father that it seemed that the exploration signal sent by human beings into space had attracted the unwanted guests in the starry sky!
On that day, he had witnessed the beginning of this disaster from the news of various television stations. Various countries had built fortresses in large cities to resist the alien races in the starry skies. He had once explored a military fortress outside the giant wall that stored a large amount of munitions. It had been built to fight against the alien races in the starry skies.
Before he fell asleep, the news reported that various countries in the world had been defeated by the alien races in the starry skies. Some small countries had even been completely destroyed. Various countries had established a World Federation to fight against the alien races in the starry skies, abandoning the borders, the situation was extremely tense. It was also at this moment that his father’s freezing chamber was developed. However, due to the urgency of the situation, there was no time to test it.
At this moment, his father seemed to have received some news, so he let him enter the freezing chamber. He would never forget the scene that day when he looked out of the freezing chamber. It was still vivid in his mind, just like yesterday.
At that time, his father’s tone when he explained things to him was clearly as if he had entrusted the hope of humanity to him on his deathbed!
Now that he saw the nuclear disaster that was left behind, he naturally knew about it. His father had probably found out about humanity’s final plan through some channels — to detonate all the nuclear bombs and perish together with the alien race!
This was a tragic war. Humanity had no ability to resist. They could only rely on their home ground advantage to barely defend and barely hold on.
Now that 300 years had passed, the barbarians who had been expelled to the radiation zone knew that the global nuclear explosion did not completely wipe out all humans. There were still some survivors who survived and passed on their language.
However, strange things seemed to have happened.
According to the normal trajectory, the survivors of the old era either barely survived and adapted to the environment to slowly develop and multiply, or they could not adapt to the environment of the earth that had been baptized by the nuclear bomb and completely went extinct!
He could only think of these two possibilities, but surprisingly, the third possibility appeared, and that was the current giant wall world.
A brand new language system appeared, and it was suspected that the descendants of the former survivors were expelled from the border and became barbarians. The people who now lived in the inner wall region instead thought of themselves as nobles, and there was even a giant wall that stood tall and firm!
He did not know whether the giant wall was built before the world-ending war or after the war broke out. However, from the news he saw before he fell asleep, he felt that with the trend of continuous retreat.., it was almost impossible to have extra strength to build such a giant wall and protect so many people. Moreover, the countries around the world had plans to build the giant wall, so they would not build underground shelters in the cities, which were now ruins.
This was a self-contradictory thing. The only explanation could be that this huge wall was not built by the humans of the old era!
This point was also recorded in the books he read, and there was another name that made him even more confused — the god of War Race!
This name might have been a name that the descendants gave to praise and praise, and it was not the original name. However, from all the relevant records, it seemed that the people in the huge wall loved and respected this race very much, he had heard of “Sylvia”countless times. It wasn’t just a place name but a person’s name!
This person came from the god of War clan!
It was easy to imagine how much the people who lived in the giant wall loved and worshiped her.
“The god of War clan defeated the alien races and built the giant wall to protect the living beings…”Dudian muttered to himself. He frowned. The global nuclear explosion disaster had continued until now, it was enough to wipe out most of the alien races that invaded the Earth. But in the historical records of the giant wall it was believed that the humans of the old era were bewitched by the devil and used the power of the devil to create the current terrible environment, the one who expelled the devil was the alien race. It was the god of War!
He couldn’t understand and felt extremely angry. It was a suicide war that used the sacrifice of the entire human race. It was carried out with the determination of blood and sorrow. But in the end it was abandoned by the later generations, instead, it was an existence that he had never heard of that was praised and praised by others.
According to the records in the books, this god of war race possessed an extremely powerful strength that could easily kill demons. He felt that this so-called god of war race should not be the hidden strength of the various countries in the old era, otherwise, there was no need for the various countries to use an extreme method of mutual destruction to resolve the war.
However, there were records in these books of the appearance of “Sylvia”, a woman from the god of War clan. Although she only had the upper body, her curvaceous figure and beautiful appearance could not be described as perfect, her facial features were exquisite as if they were carved, without a single blemish. Furthermore, her features were filled with a strange allure. She looked very pure, yet she seemed to exude an endless amount of seduction that was hard to resist, even he who had never been confused by appearances felt a rush of warmth when he saw the peerless beauty painted on the snow paper.
“God of war…”Dudian rubbed his nose. His mind was a bit confused. He thought that he knew the origin of the disaster when he first woke up. But after seeing the undeads outside the giant wall, he felt that he couldn’t see through them until now, he felt that it was even more difficult to understand. He didn’t know what happened in the three hundred years after he fainted.
Why did humans become undeads after the baptism of the nuclear bomb? Where did the virus that infected humans come from?
Logically speaking, after the explosion of the nuclear bomb, all humans should have been vaporized by the high temperature.
But there were a lot of undeads outside the giant wall. It didn’t look like they had been baptized by the nuclear bomb. It was as if the explosion of the nuclear bomb didn’t exist.
However, if a nuclear bomb explosion did not exist, then the collapsed buildings, the giant pits that could be seen everywhere, and the ultra-dense nuclear radiation in the air all proved that all the countries in the world had detonated nuclear bombs.
Moreover, these monsters were only infected and mutated by nuclear radiation. Why would there be strange things like parasitic soul worms in their bodies? Could it be that they were just parasites that were infected and mutated by nuclear radiation?
The existence of the god of War clan made it even more difficult for him to see through them. Let’s just say that they were humans. When the alien races invaded the starry skies, he had never heard of the existence of such a group of people. Logically speaking, the situation at that time was extremely urgent, each country should have used this trump card.
If they were not humans, this Sylvia’s appearance was more beautiful than all the humans he had ever seen!
She was as beautiful as a god!
Furthermore, the fact that the god of war race built the giant wall and protected humans for centuries was also an ironclad fact!
He rubbed the bridge of his nose, his brows tightly furrowed into a few folds. After a long while, he sighed, feeling as if he had overlooked something. It was also possible that his habitual thinking had caused a loophole in his speculation, he had originally thought that he could find the source of the giant wall through these books and use it to understand the divine kingdom. However, the information he obtained made him sink into an even greater confusion. It was like standing under the night sky and looking up, but he could only see darkness, he could not see his fingers.

chapters.title: Chapter 704
chapters.content:
Chapter 704 – Chapter 694: First Update
Although there were many things that couldn’t be explained or thought through, but Dudian still saw a trace of the true face behind the world. He believed that there should be more information hidden in the inner wall, when his plan to overthrow the inner wall was completed, he might be able to find other clues about the ‘God of war’.
He put away the books and turned around to leave the library. He did not continue to think hard here.
After all, he was still too far away. The problems in the inner wall region had not been solved, and he could not care about the dangers hidden in the distant divine kingdom.
