He could only take things one step at a time. However, this incident had given him a warning. The inner wall region was not the end. There was still a huge danger higher up. He did not know if he would be noticed by an unknown existence when he defeated the inner wall region, but he had no way back.
He had to accumulate more strength to resist!
It was night time when he returned to the temple. Dudian asked about the situation in Poland. The materials needed for today’s collection had been completely prepared, sword King and Hawkeye had attracted the six most authoritative alchemists from the dark church to assist Poland in the production of the Witcher. They were currently preparing the materials.
At the same time, the military had sent news that Richelieu had used a lot of connections and financial resources to move all the poor people in the slums to the residential area. Although the poor people in the slums had no background and did not have the financial resources to fight.., however, the relationship between them was not simple. Many nobles and wealthy businessmen had their own businesses in the slums. When the poor people moved away, the factories they worked in would also close down.
Some of the working poor were bound by the contract of the factories and couldn’t leave. Richelieu used the relationship between the holy church, the military and the dark church to deal with the nobles and rich businessmen behind the factories.
Dudian saw that the time was right. He sent Gwyneth to send a message to the barbarians outside the border. They would be ready to migrate into the slums in three days.
“It will take at least a month for the inner wall to suppress the plague and stabilize the situation of the people. I will be able to inject God’s marrow into my body after the creation of the Witcher.”Dudian thought, his body had been stuck in the early days of the limiter for a long time. Although he had Aisha’s help and electric weapons but he couldn’t fall too far behind.
Moreover, he was deified by the legendary magic marks. When his body reached the level of a pioneer, it would be better than an armed army of 100,000!
Time flew by.
After the kidnapping and returning to Poland, Dudian threw himself into learning the knowledge of the super chip. On average, he only slept about two hours a day. He could barely recover his spirit. But this kind of overdraft day after day, he felt more and more tired, however he was more at ease. Aisha was by his side and the inner wall was in chaos. He wouldn’t be in the mood to deal with the outer wall for a month.
On the seventh day Dudian finally made the electromagnetic biosensor. With the help of electricity the efficiency of his work had increased a lot. All the wall lamps in the temple had been replaced with light bulbs, if such a divine item was handed over to the temple of elements, it would be considered a legendary level item. After all, the electric light was a super civil item that had been passed down for hundreds of years. Once it was popularized, it would be a must for every household.
Dudian put the electromagnetic biosensor in the center of the temple. The range of the instrument was five hundred meters, including the depth of the underground. This distance was enough for him to avoid danger. He had spent a lot of materials and wasted a lot of materials in order to make the sensor. The cost of making the sensor was hundreds of times more than in the old era. After all, there was no perfect industrial system in the old era including a screw, in the old era there were specialized manufacturing factories that mass produced the sensor. The efficiency was high and the cost was low.
He had to start from scratch. It took him seven days to build the sensor. Moreover there were a lot of people who were his assistants.
“Master, the Doctor said that the materials for the body of the witcher are ready. We need you to provide parasitic soul worms.”Neuss went to the temple and reported to Dudian.
Dudian nodded: “So soon? Didn’t you say that it would take half a month?”
“The Doctor said that it was all thanks to the alchemists of the life faction. Their professional knowledge is richer than he imagined.”Neuss smiled.
Dudian nodded and got up: “Go to the side chamber and take one of the two parasitic soul worms that I gave you.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss felt warm in his heart. He was inexplicably excited as he thought of the two legendary parasitic soul worms. He had only heard of them in legends, but he had seen them up close.
Dudian came to Poland to carry out experiments. It was a temporary laboratory. It was located next to the temple. He would come to take a look when he was tired from studying the super chip, he would come to take a look.
“Greetings to the Speaker.”
The six people who were wearing black robes bowed respectfully as they saw Dudian.
Dudian nodded slightly. He looked at the figure who was busy in front of the operating table: “Doctor, I heard that the body has been completed?”
“It’s almost done.”Poland stopped what he was doing, he looked at dudian: “You can give me your parasitic soul worm. The next step is to implant the parasitic soul worm into the witcher. Is this witcher made for you?”
Dudian looked at the pitch-black knife that was soaked in a green test tube. The material of the knife was a large knife made from the arm of the splitter. Now it was completely transformed. The blade was wide and long, the surface of the knife had blood-like patterns. There were irregular sharp thorns on the edge and back of the knife. It looked ferocious and domineering. Moreover, it was obvious that the shape of the knife was modified from the limbs of the monster.
There was a reverse spiral at the hilt of the knife. When the hand held the hilt, the spiral would be like a huge mouth. It would hold the user’s arm and play a protective role.
“Good.”Dudian nodded. Neuss came over with a sealed jar.
Poland turned around and saw a dark brown parasitic soul worm lying in the jar. His pupils shrank.
The parasitic soul worm’s shape was different. Dudian saw Poland’s reaction and knew that he recognized splitter’s magic marks. There was a trace of cold light in the depths of his eyes but it disappeared in an instant, he asked: “How long will it take for the complete production of the Witcher?”
Poland recovered from his shock and bowed: “If everything goes well, it will be done in three days.”
Dudian nodded and asked Neuss to give him the parasitic soul worm. He was about to say a few words when his ears twitched and his face changed. He rushed out of the laboratory and came to the square.

chapters.title: Chapter 705
chapters.content:
Chapter 705 – Chapter 695: God Of War [ Second Watch ]
Whoosh!
The hurricane-like wind pressure came from the sky and descended on the square.
Dudian looked up and saw a black eagle hovering over the square. Its wings were more than 20 meters long and it looked like a black fighter jet, its dark golden eyes were full of murderous intent. It was obvious that it was not a monster to be trifled with.
However Dudian was surprised to see that there were two people standing on the back of the giant eagle. They were wearing armor of different shapes.
“Are they from the Kingdom of God?”Dudian’s mind was filled with such thoughts. However he soon noticed that there were white cross marks on the armor of the two, his heart immediately relaxed.
“Are you the leader here?”The blonde youth looked down at Dudian who appeared in the square. His face was cold and his eyes were as sharp as daggers. He had a cold and arrogant noble temperament.
“What are you here for?”Dudian narrowed his eyes.
“We are here to visit her highness Aisha. You should go and inform her.”The blonde youth ordered as if it was a matter of course.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to his tone. He was surprised that the military of the inner wall knew about Aisha? Eleanor who had come to investigate the intelligence had turned into a corpse. Aisha’s identity shouldn’t have been leaked. was the witness bribed by the people sent by the inner wall to investigate?
He thought for a while and looked up at the two: “Her Highness Aisha is in the temple. Please follow me.”He gestured to the two and led the way.
Since he had been looked down on, he was happy to do so.
The two on the back of the giant eagle looked at each other. They didn’t suspect anything. They had used their perception to scan the surroundings but didn’t see Aisha’s position. They knew that the former saint of the Dragon Clan had extraordinary strength, it wasn’t easy to find her tracks. However they knew that Dudian was the person with the strongest physique. Therefore they knew that the youth was Aisha’s subordinate.
Whoosh!
The two men jumped down from the back of the giant eagle and landed on the square. The blonde youth raised his hand and put it in his mouth. He blew a whistle. The giant eagle flapped its wings and slowly landed on the square. It put away its scythe-like black wings.
The Knights outside the square quickly gathered and saw the giant bird. They were shocked and scared but they still braced themselves to surround it.
Dudian saw Barton who came from the side hall and ordered him: “Tell everyone to leave the top of the hill. No one is allowed to come near.”
Barton looked at the Giant Eagle and the blonde youth who were slowly walking towards the square. He felt a murderous aura coming towards him. His heart trembled and he slowly retreated according to Dudian’s words, he went out of the cloister to pass the order.
Dudian went up the steps and opened the door of the temple. He saw Aisha sitting on the chair in the main hall. She was quiet as a virgin. Her fingers were placed on the cheongsam on her knees. She had a dignified temperament. She lowered her head as if she was thinking, she seemed to be in a daze.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he turned to the two behind him: “Please.”
The blonde youth saw Aisha in the temple when the door opened. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes. Although Aisha was wearing a light veil but their eyes were sharp, he didn’t expect the news to be true. The former Holy Maiden of the Dragon Clan who was rumored to have died in the wasteland was still alive and had seized the military power of the outer wall!
Dudian walked in front of Aisha and covered her body behind her back. He didn’t want to be stared at by the two for a long time. His action immediately made the two dissatisfied. However, what surprised them more was that Aisha would condone her subordinates to do such a rude action to him.
Dudian saw the two enter the door. His mouth slightly curved into an imperceptible arc. He said to the two: “His Highness doesn’t like to talk to strangers. If you have anything to say, just talk to me directly.”
The blonde youth frowned. As a member of the inner wall and a noble, he looked down on people from the outer wall. From the color of Dudian’s hair, it was obvious that he was from a lowly civilian background. He wanted to directly scold him, however, he held back. After a few seconds, he found that Aisha didn’t respond. It seemed that she had acquiesced. The surprise in his heart grew. He couldn’t help but seriously look at Dudian.
“Since her highness Aisha is here, we can talk in person. You should leave.”The square-faced middle-aged man next to him coldly said. There was a dignified and solemn temperament between his eyebrows. His words couldn’t be doubted, it made people instinctively want to obey.
Dudian indifferently said: “I have said that her highness doesn’t like to talk to strangers. If I have said something wrong, her highness will come out and correct me. You two should just say it directly. What exactly do you want to do here?”
The blonde youth raised his eyebrows. He wanted to scold but he held back his anger when he thought of Aisha who was behind Dudian, he said: “I am Hiro. I came to visit His Highness Aisha. A few years ago we had cleared out the monsters together with His Highness. I wonder if His Highness still remembers?”
“Hiro?”Dudian narrowed his eyes. He had long seen that their physiques were unusual. Both of them were pioneers but he didn’t expect them to be the ten war gods of the military. It should be known that there were more than ten pioneers in the military, the ones who could be named as the ten war gods were undoubtedly the best among the pioneers.
“I’m Ronon. It’s my first time meeting you. I came to visit after I heard the news about your Highness.”The square-faced middle-aged man politely introduced his name.
Dudian heard the name of another war god. He thought for a while and asked: “May I know why the two war gods are here?”
Hiro didn’t expect that Dudian would talk to him. He was angry. Both of them were on the same level as Aisha and represented the military. Aisha didn’t even bother to say anything, it was a deliberate humiliation!
However, he thought about the purpose of this trip. He held back his words and smiled, “I heard that not long ago, His Highness was framed and almost injured in the wasteland. We came here with some healing gifts. I hope it will be helpful to His Highness.”After saying that, he took off the luggage on his back, he took out a box made of pure gold and handed it to Dean.
Dean looked at it and pretended to turn back to ask Aisha. Although the two didn’t exchange words, but this action was enough to make people feel that Dean was looking at Aisha’s eyes. Dudian took a few steps forward and took the golden box. His clairvoyance had already seen the things in the box. It wasn’t a trap but a few white eggs-shaped pills.
Dudian put the golden box on the table and looked at the two with interest: “The military of the outer wall was subdued by us a while ago. Are you here for this matter?”

chapters.title: Chapter 706
chapters.content:
Chapter 706 – Chapter 696: Negotiation, The Non-Existent [ Three Watch ]
Hiro was unhappy. Dudian didn’t even thank him when he received the gift. It felt like he didn’t respect them at all. Moreover, his tone was the same, he didn’t even bother to be polite. It was too casual.
He looked at Aisha and saw that she was indifferent. It seemed that she had acquiesced to Dudian’s intention. The anger in his heart grew but he was calm on the surface, he said: “We Are Here to visit His Highness. As for the military matters in the outer wall, it is just a small matter.”
Dudian didn’t have the mood and time to chat with him: “Since the military matters in the outer wall is a small matter, then I am relieved. I am worried that I will offend you because of this matter. It will hurt our friendship.”
Hiro almost vomited blood. He thought: friendship? Damn friendship!
Ronon stared at Dudian, he said: “To tell the truth, the first reason we came here is because we heard that her highness Aisha was injured. We came to visit her. The second reason is to understand the outer wall. Her Highness should know that the military is arranged by us. You have seized the power of the military and monopolized the outer wall. Do you know what this means?”
Dudian knew that they couldn’t hold back anymore. In fact, when the two of them appeared in the square, he had some speculations about their intentions. The truth was that the military got Aisha’s news from God knows where, they were unwilling to admit defeat. So they wanted to ask for an explanation and try to solve the matter in other ways.
If it was him, he would do the same. But unfortunately, he wasn’t in the military and the military didn’t understand him.
“The meaning is what you see.”Dudian indifferently said: “The military in the outer wall has offended his highness so he was taught a lesson by His Highness. I hope you can give an explanation. If it wasn’t for the fact that the outer wall is under the control of your military, His Highness would have dealt with these people.”
Hiro’s mouth twitched. He didn’t know where Aisha found such a sharp-tongued underling. No wonder she handed the communication rights to the teenager, he was quite capable.
“His Highness has always lived in the inner wall. He doesn’t often appear outside the wall. These people don’t know you so they have offended you. I hope you don’t mind. You can let me help you deal with the people who have offended you. But the others are innocent. I hope you can show mercy.” It seemed that he had mistaken dudian for Aisha.
Dudian looked at him: “There is no need for that. I have dealt with the people who offended his highness. As far as I know, the inner wall has recently erupted into chaos. Now is the time when we are short of manpower. How can you two have the leisure to come here?”
Hiro didn’t expect that dudian would suddenly change the topic to the inner wall. Moreover, he knew about the chaos in the inner wall. Hiro’s heart was moved. Aisha was a member of the inner wall after all. It was not strange that Dudian could enter and exit the inner wall.
“Under the security of our military, the chaos has been suppressed. So they sent us to inquire about the situation in the outer wall and pay a visit to your highness.”Ronon calmly said: “I heard that Your Highness and your sister Hailey have some grudges. She was the one who planned the attack in the wasteland. Is It True?”
Dudian looked at him: “What do you mean?”
Ronon looked at him: “We just want to seek justice for His Highness.”
Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of mockery: “Do you want to sow discord between His Highness and the Dragon Clan? Or did the Dragon Clan send you to test his highness’attitude?”
Hiro stared at Dudian and looked at Aisha: “I Hope His Highness can tell us about this matter.”
Ronon stared at Dudian, “Although the Dragon Race is loved by His Majesty but he doesn’t have the authority to command us. His Highness is guarding the wasteland and killing monsters. If the news of this spreads to his majesty, he will be furious!”
Dudian understood the meaning behind his words: “This is a family affair of the dragon race. I hope you two don’t participate in it.”
Although he felt that Luonong wanted to please Aisha and even rope her in so that he could use the military to punish the Dragon Clan, but he felt that there should be other secrets, the military wouldn’t offend the entire Dragon Clan because of Aisha. After all, the relationship between the other two families was too complicated.
Hiro saw that Dudian refused their kindness: “Kid, do you represent the words of His Highness? !”
Dudian looked at him: “If I am wrong, His Highness will correct me first. It is not your turn to speak!”
“You!”Hiro was about to go forward but was stopped by Ronon.
Ronon looked at dudian: “His Highness has occupied the monastery which has been operating in the outer wall area for many years. He has taken away the power of the military. What does he want to Do?”
“This is what you really want to ask.”Dudian said: “His Highness just wants to find a quiet place to recuperate. It is not as complicated as you think.”
Ronon naturally didn’t believe such nonsense. He was silent for a moment as he saw Dudian’s tight mouth: “If our military wants you to return the authority of the military in the outer wall region, will his highness agree?”
Dudian replied without thinking: “Impossible.”
Ronon frowned and looked at dudian, “You have to think clearly. According to my understanding, His Highness has a lot of conflicts with His Highness Hailey. They are sending people to kill His Highness. If it weren’t for the outbreak of chaos in the inner wall region, many members of the Dragon Clan would have been infected. They wouldn’t have been able to spare time and would have attacked this mountain. Do you really want to make enemies on all sides?”
“Is this a threat?”Dudian looked at him.
Ronon’s face was cold: “This is just an advice.”
Dudian thought for a moment: “You want the military to restore the rule of the outer wall. What benefits can you give us?”
Hiro slightly raised his head: “Of course there are. The benefits are that when the monastery and the Dragon Clan come to find trouble in the future, our military will never take action. We promise you that we will do it!”
Dudian was surprised and felt a bit funny: “In this case, there is no advantage. You have the nerve to say such words.”
Hiro had tolerated dudian for a long time. His eyes flashed with murderous intent, he said: “Pay attention to your tone! The outer wall was originally managed by our military for his majesty. If His Majesty knew about this, he would have sent troops to exterminate you. We have given you enough face by personally coming to discuss with you. You are a disrespectful servant. I can not take it seriously. Your Highness Aisha, if you acquiesce to the servant’s intention, then I hope you will consider it carefully!”
“The outer wall used to be yours. We spent a lot of effort to rob it so it was ours.”Dudian’s logic was very strong, “Now you have to pay the price if you want to take it back. Don’t tell me that you will give US benefits if you don’t take action. If I don’t Kill You Then you have to thank me.”
Hiro was so angry that he laughed, “You don’t understand human language right? If it wasn’t for your good luck the monastery and the Dragon Clan would have come to teach you a lesson. After the chaos is over they will be the first to come to us. Our military won’t take action. It is already considered as giving face to his highness. Otherwise the debt wouldn’t be settled so easily!”
“I probably don’t need this face.”Dudian’s eyes were calm and indifferent. It was only a matter of time before they would fight against the military of the inner wall. Even if they didn’t come to besiege them they would soon fight, “If the two of you don’t bring practical benefits then stay!”

chapters.title: Chapter 707
chapters.content:
Chapter 707 – Chapter 697: Temple’S Cage
“Stay?”
Ronon and Hiro’s face changed. They were shocked and angry. Ronon said in a deep voice: “We are here today to negotiate. There is no malice. Even if we can’t come to an agreement, there is no need to fight!”
“You don’t have malice, but I do.”Dudian said in a cold voice: “I was hoping that you would bring me something that I was satisfied with. Since you are so stubborn and seek death, then go to hell!”
“You!”Hiro was angry as he looked at Aisha behind dudian, he shouted: “Your Highness Aisha, is this your intention? Are you indulging your men? We came to see you out of goodwill, but you actually want to attack us? !”
“Don’t tell her.”Ronon shook his head: “Don’t you see that Aisha is dead? This person is no longer Aisha. Don’t you realize that she has no breath and Heartbeat?”
Hiro was stunned.
He could understand that Aisha was hiding her body heat, but it was abnormal for her to not be breathing and her heart wasn’t beating.
Ronon looked up at dudian, “Although I don’t know what method you used to control her highness Aisha, but don’t think that you can do whatever you want just because she is here. The military of the inner wall isn’t someone you can mess with. Do you really want to be our enemy?”
“I also want to be friends with you, but reality doesn’t allow it.”Dudian remembered that Hiro had been looking at him when he spoke. He expected that Hiro had long realized the truth about Haisha. He no longer hid it and murderous intent shot out from his eyes, “Instead of waiting for you to clean up the mess in the inner wall before attacking, why don’t we cripple the two military gods of your military first? I think even if they know, they won’t be able to withdraw and launch a large-scale attack!”
Hiro was furious, “Cripple Us? With just you? Don’t think that you can do whatever you want with Aisha. Although we don’t think that we can compete with Aisha, but two against one, even if we can’t win, you are far from being able to keep us!”
“I also want to see if Aisha’s strength is really as strong as the legends say!”
Ronon didn’t try to persuade them. He knew that there was no room for negotiation. Dudian was determined to kill them so they had to kill their way out. He thought that even if they weren’t their match.., it wouldn’t be difficult to escape.
“Humph!”
Dudian raised his hand and patted the head of a jade lion. The lion’s head sank under the table and the sound of gears turning echoed, the door of the temple closed behind the two of them. The sun was blocked and dense killing intent filled the hall.
“We should treat each other with respect. The two armies don’t kill envoys. Since you don’t follow the rules, I will kill you first!”Hiro roared. He couldn’t tolerate Dudian any longer. He flicked his sleeve and shot out a sharp sword, hiro grabbed the hilt of the sword. The hilt dissolved into silver liquid and wrapped around his arm as if it was alive. It spread to his entire body and formed a set of silver scales!
Hiro’s shape had completely changed. There were two silver horns on his head. His eyes were dark gold and there were rings of patterns. He looked like a poisonous lizard. His fingers were sharp and sharp like an angry rhinoceros.
Dudian didn’t dare to stay and shook the bell.
Two murderous auras shot out from Aisha’s eyes. Her figure that was sitting quietly on the chair slightly trembled. Her dark eyes slightly turned and fell on Ronon and Hiro, there was a bloodthirsty look in her pure black evil eyes. She slowly stood up. A shocking evil aura was emitted from her body. She looked like a demon that was released from its cage!
Hiro’s eyelids twitched when he saw Aisha move. He thought that Dudian was using her to intimidate her. He didn’t expect that Aisha could still move. He was afraid of her.
However he was the god of War after all. He roared as he rushed towards Dudian.
Roar!
Aisha also roared and pounced towards Dean.
It was the same roar, but Aisha’s scream was shrill and sharp, like a fierce monster.
Hiro and Aisha collided. He turned his claws and grabbed Aisha’s throat. At the moment, he was surprised that Aisha’s body was full of flaws, but the speed of his attack was not slow.
Aisha’s pure black eyes suddenly shot out a demonic light as she faced the silver claws. She roared and waved her arms. Her hands suddenly turned in a wonderful arc and grabbed onto Hiro’s elbow, she turned and threw the most basic combat over her shoulder. Bang! Hiro’s body hit the ground. The wooden floor instantly cracked and splinters flew out.
Dudian took a few steps back. He couldn’t participate in the fight.
Hiro patted the ground and slipped away from Aisha’s hands. He returned to Ronon’s side. His face was ugly. Aisha’s combat technique was magical and caught him off guard, he had no ability to fight back. Moreover, from the short fight he could tell that the opponent’s strength was not inferior to his. However, the opponent didn’t activate the magic body!
“Go!”Ronon’s face was gloomy. Seeing that Hiro had retreated, he immediately said, “Her strength has not been lost, so it will be difficult for us to win. Let’s Retreat First!”
Hiro had the same idea. After all, this was the enemy’s nest. He was not sure if there were any other dangers besides Aisha here. It would be difficult to deal with Aisha alone, and when he could not figure out the situation.., he was not willing to risk his life!
The two of them left immediately. They turned around and rushed out of the temple.
Although the sealed temple door was shining with a metallic luster, it was just a piece of scrap paper in the eyes of the two of them. They did not care at all. They raised their hands and slapped it away.
Bang! Bang!
Two loud bangs were heard. The temple door was knocked out.
At the same time, two screams were suddenly heard from the mouths of Ronon and Hiro.
Both of their bodies stiffened at the entrance of the temple. Their bodies were trembling as they screamed in pain. Their hair was messy and green smoke was coming out of their bodies. Especially their hair was slowly burning!
Dudian looked at them coldly. He shook the bell to stop Aisha who was ready to attack.
The screams of the two startled the giant eagle which was resting in the square outside the temple. The monster flapped its wings as it stood up. Its sharp black eyes were as black as gems, it had been tamed so that it had some intelligence. It could see that its master seemed to be in danger, but it was not sure. After all, its master had given it the order to wait here.
While the bird was in shock, Hiro and Ronon’s screams had also stopped. However, their bodies were still frozen at the entrance of the temple. They trembled slightly. Their hair was soon burned away, leaving only their bald heads. The Flames also spread to their entire bodies, they became two burning people.
After burning for about half a minute, their bodies fell to the ground with a plop. The burning continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 708
chapters.content:
Chapter 708 – Chapter 698: Knife Into [ First Update ]
Dudian waited for a few minutes to make sure that the two of them weren’t pretending to fall to the ground. Then he pulled the switch under the table. The Lion Head which he had shot earlier popped out.
He strode forward and activated the white skeleton’s defense. He came to the front of the two. He looked down and kicked Hiro’s head. There was no reaction, he turned around and poured the water from the basin onto the curtain. He pulled the wet curtain and put out the flames on the duo’s bodies.
Hiro and Ronon’s bodies were charred black. There was smoke and the smell of burnt meat.
Dudian saw that the duo’s heart was still beating slightly. He was surprised that they didn’t die. At the same time he grabbed the duo and found that their bodies were burning hot, at the same time there was a weak electric current running through his fingertips. It was the residual electricity.
Ronon didn’t activate the magic body. His clothes were burnt and his body was scorched.
Dudian called Neuss and handed them to him: “Take them away. Lock the tendons of the hands and feet and wear the pipa bones!”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss replied. He looked at the two’s charred bodies. His heart was trembling. The two who were riding the giant eagle were big figures in the inner wall. How could they fall into such a miserable situation in the blink of an eye, it was hard to believe. His respect for Dudian was even stronger.
Dudian picked up the two witchers after Neuss left. One of them was a smooth dagger while the other was a soft black inner armor. Without the two witchers, Lonon and Hiro wouldn’t be able to unleash the full power of their bodies. They would be able to trap them.
“So many days of hard work haven’t been in vain.”Dudian was relieved. He didn’t plan to let them leave safely when he first met them, he was worried that the military of the inner wall was too strong and couldn’t be weakened. The other side probably didn’t expect that Dudian would break the rules and attack the negotiators.
“It seems that the voltage of the temple needs to be increased a bit. The two pioneers should be electrocuted at the same time but they can’t be electrocuted on the spot. If they are surrounded by four or five people then most likely they will break free.”
Dudian asked Neuss to arrange people to repair the gate of the temple after he returned.
The temple was no longer made of mud. The walls were covered with steel bars and cables. As long as the switch was turned on the current would flow through the entire temple and form a huge electric prison!
Even he couldn’t enter or exit.
The doors and windows of the exits were made of metal. The purpose was to conduct electricity!
Dudian went to the back hall of the temple. He opened the secret compartment on the wall and checked the power meter. He was surprised that half of the temple’s power reserves had been used to injure Hiro and the other two! In other words, the current power reserves could only cope with four pioneers.
“It seems that both the voltage and the power reserve need to be improved!”Dudian made up his mind. “We need to build a few more power stations. It is not enough to rely on solar panels and one power station.”
Fortunately, he had built a power station before. There were drawings and materials so it wouldn’t take too long to build the second one.
Squeak!
At this time, there was the sound of an eagle outside the square.
Dudian looked up and saw that the giant eagle was still crouching in the square. It seemed to be uneasy as it was calling to the temple.
“It doesn’t know how to escape.”Dudian didn’t expect that the stupid bird would stay here. He didn’t dare to disobey the previous two’s orders. It could be seen that it had suffered inhuman torture during the training process, the psychological shadow was very big so it didn’t dare to easily disobey its master’s orders.
“Since you have lost the courage to fly into the sky, then stay on the ground!”Dudian didn’t have the slightest bit of pity. His body was wrapped in white bones as he quickly approached the giant eagle.
The Giant Eagle’s eyes shot out a fierce light. It lowered its head and pecked at Dudian like pecking a small insect.
Dudian could see the heat reaction in its body. It was only a level 40 hunter. He could easily deal with it. He jumped up as it pecked at him. The white bones in his palm turned into spikes and pierced through the smooth feathers on its neck. He used the momentum to climb up and ride on its head, he wrapped his hands around its neck and punched its head.
The giant eagle screamed and struggled desperately. It shook its head and hit the square. The floor was broken but no matter how Dudian hit its head, its wings didn’t stop, it didn’t dare to fly in the air. It just stayed on the ground as if there were two shackles on its feet.
Soon, the giant eagle’s struggle weakened. It whined and gave up on resisting. Its head fell to the ground.
Dudian saw that it didn’t dare to leave the place. He felt a strange feeling in his heart. He admired the method of taming the beast but also felt a bit sad for it. He didn’t kill it. He didn’t expect to make it submit to him. After all, this bird was a monster and not a horse. It wasn’t something that could be suppressed by simple strength. It was a fear that accumulated over time!
He planned to ask Hiro and Lonon about the method to control the giant eagle from their mouths. From the fact that the two of them shared a mount, it could be seen that a monster like the giant eagle was an extremely rare existence in the inner wall, there wouldn’t be too many of them. After all, it wasn’t easy to tame a ferocious monster.
“If I have to go to the Kingdom of God in the future, it would be good to ride this thing. But I don’t know how long it will last. I don’t know if it is afraid of Thunderbirds.”Dudian thought as he fell from the giant eagle’s body, he asked Barton to reduce the number of guards in the square by half so as not to scare the bird away. Such a bird couldn’t be trapped by ordinary chains. He could only rely on the orders left by Hiro and Barton.
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
Poland took out a giant black sword from a giant test tube. Her face was red and her eyes were shining with a hot light, she looked at dudian: “Your Witcher is ready!”! Tut Tut, this is my first time making a legendary level witcher. The magic cells in it are too beautiful. I didn’t expect you to find the body of the splitter. You have forged this witcher. The compatibility with your body should be perfect!”
Dudian stretched out his hand and took it. He felt his arm slightly sink. He was surprised that the three meters tall and half a meter wide giant knife weighed thousands of kilograms. It should be known that even if it was made of lead or iron, it might not be so heavy.

chapters.title: Chapter 709
chapters.content:
Chapter 709 – Chapter 699: Full Magic Body [ Second Update ]
Poland saw Dudian’s sinking arm and smiled: “It is very compatible with your body. You can resonate with it as soon as you touch it.”
“Resonate?”
“This witcher is one with your body. It is like a part of your body.”Poland smiled and explained: “You will feel heavy. It is just an illusion caused by the resonance reaction. In fact, it is very light. It is lighter than a knife made of aluminum of the same size! When you digest the resonance reaction, you will feel that it is as light as a Feather!”
Dudian was surprised. He didn’t expect that the weapon would have such a reaction. It was similar to his understanding of the magnetic field theory.
“You can try.”Poland’s face was full of expectation.
Dudian looked at him. The joy in his heart gradually calmed down: “I hope you are not playing tricks in this weapon. You should know that if anything happens to me, they will kill you!”
Poland smiled: “Of course I won’t do such a stupid thing. If you are worried then it’s up to you. I have done it anyway.”
Dudian didn’t think that Poland would dare to play tricks on the device. Moreover he had arranged six alchemists to be his assistants. Moreover they were monitoring his eyes.
“Is it possible to communicate with the device by activating the power of the magic marks?”Dudian asked.
Poland nodded, “Yes, it is a part of your body. Although there are no blood vessels and meridians but as long as your body is in contact with it then the magic marks in your body will be activated. Moreover this is your exclusive witcher. Only you can activate it.”
Dudian understood that it was just like how he had obtained Hiro and Ronon’s magic tools. It was just an ordinary sword in his hands. At most it would be a bit sharp and wouldn’t be able to stimulate its potential magic power.
Buzz!
As Dudian’s magic marks were stimulated, he suddenly felt a strange resonance. It was as if his body suddenly had an extra hand and foot. His senses became sensitive. At this time, he saw the giant saber in his hand slowly melt. It turned into black liquid and wrapped around his shoulder, chest, neck and whole body!
What made him strange was that when he was covered by the black liquid, he had an unprecedented clear and comfortable feeling. It was as if his senses were further enhanced. He could accurately feel the temperature change of the surrounding air, he could even feel the slightest flutter of the air current.
When the black liquid covered his nasal cavity, he subconsciously held his breath. However, he soon discovered that there was air surging into his nasal cavity. It was as if he was wearing an oxygen mask. His breathing was unimpeded, and he was not affected at all.
At this moment, white bones emerged from his body, protruding out from the black liquid that covered his entire body. It was like a white reef that floated out from the deep sea. The black liquid quickly solidified and became smooth like a shell.
He looked down and saw that his hands had turned into two black claws. His five fingers were long and his elbows were covered with a layer of black spikes. In addition, there were white bones oozing out, it was extremely strange.
Suddenly, Dudian felt the cold feeling of the floor as well as the friction. He couldn’t help but look back. He was shocked to find that there were three tails on his back. The tails were like sharp blades. There was no hair and they were very thin, they were exactly the same as the limbs of the splitter!
Dudian’s heart was strange. He couldn’t help but want to look at the mirror.
“Here you are.”Poland was prepared. He handed a mirror to Dudian. His face was full of surprise as he looked at Dudian. It was as if he was looking at a masterpiece. He was full of exclamation and joy. Although his current situation wasn’t good.., but it didn’t stop him from making a legendary witcher.
Dudian used the mirror to look at his body. He was speechless.
As he had expected, his body had changed. He couldn’t be called a “Human”anymore. He was a young splitter! However, he was different from the young splitter. His body was in the shape of a human. The proportion of his body was more uniform and perfect. The outline of his muscles was full of vigorous strength.
“This is my magic body…”Dudian was slightly silent. He was prepared to activate all the power of his magic marks. When he entered the magic body state, he would usually transform into a monster of the same type as his magic marks, just like when Aisha and Hathaway were fighting against the king of undead. The magic bodies that were activated were dragon-like. However, there were some human forms.
“Aisha said that the higher the level of evolution, the deeper the fusion of magic marks with the body. After the full strength of the body, the change will be greater…”dudian thought: “When I become a pioneer, I will become more like the splitter.”
“How is it? Are You Satisfied?”Poland looked at Dudian with a smile. He was very satisfied with this masterpiece. It could be made in one go. Moreover, it was a legendary level witcher. If it was in the research institute.., he would be praised by the higher-ups. His status would be greatly improved. After all, there was a huge difference between doctors.
“Good.”Dudian nodded slightly. He used his mind and the solid black shell of his body quickly softened. It once again turned into black liquid. It retracted from his body and condensed into a giant sword.
“There are two ways to use a witcher’s weapon. The first is to half-melt and the second is to completely melt.”Poland explained to dudian: “Half-melt means that you can still maintain the prototype of the Witcher’s weapon and use it as a combat weapon. The complete melting means that the prototype of the Witcher’s weapon will completely disappear and merge into your body. It will maximize the power of the Witcher’s weapon.”
“The latter will give you a significant increase in speed and strength. The former will give you a powerful weapon.”
Dudian immediately thought of the battle between Aisha and the undead king. At that time, the giant sword in her hand was still there and had not completely merged into her body.
“No matter which method you use, the effect is the same. It depends on the situation.”Poland took the initiative to speak before Dudian asked: “If you want to enter a place filled with poisonous gas, then the weapon will have no effect on you. You can use the full fusion and use the magic body to the greatest extent. But if you meet an opponent with similar strength and the opponent has a sharp weapon, then it is better to use half fusion.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up: “What’s the advantage of using a prototype to fight? Why not create another weapon to fight? Wouldn’t it be able to merge all the weapons and strengthen the magic body?”
Poland smiled, “It’s not wrong to think that way. However, it’s more convenient to use a weapon to fight. A pioneer once told me that using a weapon to fight with ordinary steel weapons is completely different. It can maximize the improvement of one’s fighting skills. Moreover, it’s not convenient to bring two weapons out at the same time. Moreover, the weapon itself is a divine weapon. It’s too extravagant to forge another one. Not everyone has the money to do so.”

chapters.title: Chapter 710
chapters.content:
Chapter 710 – Chapter 700: Step Into The Boundary [ First Update ]
Dudian thought of the battle between Aisha and Hathaway. Both of them only used Witcher’s weapons and didn’t carry any other weapons. It was obvious that creating another weapon in battle was a complete burden. Moreover, the most important point was.., with the current smelting process, there was a limited amount of metal materials that could be purified. It was difficult to create a weapon that was comparable to a witcher’s weapon.
“Is it possible to create two Witcher’s weapons?”Dudian asked Poland. Although he had never seen such a thing in Aisha, but he still wanted to hear Poland’s answer.
“One person can create two witcher’s weapons?”Poland looked at him strangely, “Yes, but it is a waste to do so. Each person’s body can only contain one witcher’s weapon. It is impossible to activate two witcher’s weapons to enter the body at the same time. So the second witcher can only be used as an ordinary weapon.”
Dudian understood and said: “Then please use the remaining materials to forge a suitable weapon for me.”The huge body of the splitter was enough to forge dozens of weapons, moreover the strength of the weapon wouldn’t be inferior to the one in his hand. After all the main materials of the weapon were made from its two main sharp limbs.
“Can you let me see my Family First?”Poland carefully asked. The reason why he had worked so hard to make the weapon was because he wanted to see his family. He didn’t suspect that Dudian was lying. After all, Dudian was able to capture him from the Institute of Magic. So far the institute hadn’t found him so it wasn’t difficult to find his family.
“I will let you meet them when the weapon is ready.”Dudian patted his shoulder, “I will get someone to change the place for your family. You Don’t have to worry. Their lives are better than yours.”
Dudian waved his hand and left the laboratory.
Dudian called Neuss to get the God’s marrow which was hidden in the secret chamber of the side hall.
“I can finally step into the limiter level.”Dudian’s heart was excited. He didn’t need to worry about the mutation of his body anymore.
He grabbed the god’s marrow and filled it into the syringe.
One, two, three… The God’s marrow continued to be injected into his body. It was like a stream of clear water flowing into his body. After it entered his heart, the cool God’s marrow immediately became as hot as lava and spread throughout his body.
His skin was red and blue veins were bulging.
“DAMN! My body can’t handle too much at once!”Dudian immediately stopped and held his breath.
His body was as hot as a volcano. The blood was spurting out like magma at any time. The air was extremely hot. At this moment the coldness in his left hand was completely suppressed.
Gulp gulp!
He seemed to be able to hear the sound of blood rushing in his body. It was like a surging river.
The scorching temperature gradually decreased from his body. However it was followed by a strange itchiness. It was as if countless insects were crawling on his body. He couldn’t help but look around. He even used his x-ray vision to check his body, he immediately saw a shocking scene. His heart was thumping wildly, and every beat pushed the diaphragm of his heart to bulge. The bones in his body seemed to be contracting slightly, and the joints of his bones were getting tighter, the shape also became sharp, like a god’s blade!
Outside his body, on his arms and chest, there were no insects crawling, as if it was just his illusion, but the feeling was real. He looked over and immediately saw that the color of his skin was gradually dimming, as if it had lost its moisture and luster. It was as if he had been exposed to the sun for many days. The longer it was, the uglier his skin looked, and it was gradually wrinkling.
“What’s going on?”He was shocked. Could it be that his body was not holding up? Could it be that injecting too much at once caused side effects?
Although he felt uncomfortable, but he was able to hold on. Could it be that his consciousness was much stronger than his body?
Soon, he knew the reason. When the skin was wrinkled, several parts of the skin had ruptured. However, there was no blood flowing out. Instead, a faint pink color could be seen.
He raised his hand to tear the skin. He immediately found that there was a piece of new pink skin under the wrinkled skin. It was warm and tender. There was no dust at all. It was like the skin of a baby.
He was surprised that he had shed his skin.
After a long time, the strange feelings in his body gradually disappeared. Dudian’s mind also returned to calmness. He rubbed the dead skin off his body and found that there was a comfortable feeling throughout his body. It was as if he was breathing the fresh air in the morning, every part of his body was breathing. Moreover, his senses had become more sensitive than before. It was like the feeling after entering the devil.
“Don’t tell me that I have broken through to the limit?”Dudian thought. He was already a half-step limiter. With Aisha’s help, he had controlled his body to the limit between hunter and limiter, there was no reason for him to break through to the limiter by injecting God’s marrow again.
“I feel that it is several times stronger than before. I wonder if it will be stronger after activating the Devil’s body!”Dudian’s eyes lit up. He grabbed the saber and immediately activated the magic marks on his chest.
“Splitter!”
The saber turned into black mucus and covered his entire body. His fingers were like claws and covered with black scales. The black mucus on his body hardened and turned into iron-like black armor. There were a few sharp horns on top of his head. These horns seemed to be able to sense the temperature and humidity of the surroundings. His senses were more sensitive. The Broken Wings on his back appeared at this moment, but they were complete wings. They looked like two giant black blades.
The sharp tails of the blades hit the ground and easily cut the floor.
Dudian was like a humanoid beast sitting on the chair. His black eyes had turned dark gold. There was a ring of cold golden rings around his pupils. He looked like a monster.
“Eh? Are they awake?”Dudian saw, hiro and Lonon had woken up after being locked by Neuss. The layers of soil under their feet couldn’t block his line of sight. He could even see the bones and hearts in their chests, the penetrating power of the X-ray pupil was countless times stronger than before!
He was surprised. He took a step and disappeared like a hurricane. Even the snow paper on the table was moving. His body appeared outside the square in an instant, he stood beside the giant eagle.
The giant eagle’s feet were locked by two huge chains. The other end was tied to the giant rock outside the square. It woke up from its sleep. It flapped its wings and looked at dudian.

chapters.title: Chapter 711
chapters.content:
Chapter 711 – Chapter 701: Civil Strife [ Second Update ]
Dudian glanced at the giant eagle. Previously it was fierce enough to bite him as if he was an insect. But now it was scared and didn’t dare to approach it. The chains on its feet were rattling. If it wasn’t firmly tied to the giant rock.., it would probably take off into the air.
“It seems that this monster has completely covered the smell of humans. It is no different from a monster.”Dudian thought. If it was a monster then it would be normal for the giant eagle to be scared, after all, his physical strength was much stronger than the bird. The Beasts and monsters were much more accurate than humans. They could distinguish what was prey and what was hunter.
Dudian ignored the giant eagle. He quickly used a set of fist techniques in the square. Bang! Bang! The air seemed to explode in front of his fist. His body turned and created a strong wind. The sand and dust on the ground avoided him.
He jumped in front of an ancient tree outside the square. He raised his hand and grabbed the tree. There was a tearing sound as half of the bark of the ancient tree was pulled out by him.
Dudian let go of his hand and withdrew his magic marks. The magic marks on his body gradually condensed and turned into a giant sword.
“The feeling of having a magic body is different from before.”Dudian’s eyes lit up. Although he didn’t have an opponent to train with him to test his strength, but through the previous display.., he could feel that the strength of his body was stronger than all the other limiters he had seen! However, there was still a big gap between him and the pioneers.
The strength and speed displayed by Emino, Hiro, Ronon and the others were all above his. Moreover they had exquisite fighting skills. He wouldn’t be able to match them in a real fight, however, it was possible for him to protect himself and escape.
To be able to do this was already quite amazing!
One must know that most people who could become pioneers would not be too inferior to the magic marks in their bodies. At the very least, they would have a rare magic mark, which was only second to a legend!
And he was only at the early stage of the limit-holder. If it were any other limit-holder, even if they were amazing, they would still be unable to withstand a single blow in front of the pioneers. They would be as insignificant as ants, his physique was much stronger than the rare magic marks at the same stage.
In addition to his strong physique, Dudian felt that his combat ability was far stronger than before. The benefits of his magic body had fully played out the role of his legendary magic marks, he felt particularly free as if he had broken away from all the shackles. Even if he made movements that were completely unimaginable in the past, it would be extremely easy.
When the magic body was put away, he felt as if he was bound in a solid turtle shell. He felt uncomfortable all over. He had strength but nowhere to use it.
But if he had experienced the sweetness of the magic body, he wouldn’t have such a feeling. It was easy to enter the luxury but difficult to enter the simplicity. He could only adapt to this feeling. After all, he had entered the magic body state with the help of the witcher, it consumed a lot of physical energy. Unlike other people who could directly evolve their bodies into the magic body state, they could only maintain the magic body state without any additional consumption.
However, entering the magic body through the witcher would consume a huge amount of energy. He felt hungry as soon as he removed the magic body.
“God is fair.”Dudian thought. It was obvious that he would be more powerful if he didn’t forge the witcher to evolve into the monster form. It would be more advantageous in the long-term battle but he had abandoned the human society, he could only live in the shadow of the giant wall. He would be despised and feared by others. It was hard to guarantee that he wouldn’t go crazy if he lived for a long time.
Dudian went back to the temple and asked Neuss to bring food and white wine to replenish his body. The cold air in his left arm spread to his left chest, it would even hurt his heart and his life would be in danger.
The white wine that he brewed didn’t disappoint him. Every time he drank a little bit he would be able to dispel the cold air and restore his body’s warmth.
“I’ll take a rest and continue to inject the god’s marrow.”Dudian put away the god’s marrow on the table. Although he had a large amount of God’s marrow but he couldn’t inject it in a short period of time, however he estimated that if he consumed the maximum amount of God’s marrow every day he would be able to use up the god’s marrow in ten days to half a month. He didn’t know if he would be able to break through to the pioneer realm.
If he could reach that step, he believed that his combat ability would definitely surpass Hiro, Ronon, and the others. By then, with the Thunder divine spell, it would be time for him to officially attack the inner wall area.
In the inner wall area, in the meeting hall of the monastery, seven to eight people were sitting around. The old man sitting in the chief seat was tall and sturdy. His physique was strong, and his hair was white, but his body did not seem to be bent at all, instead, his muscles were bulging as if he was in his prime. The people sitting below him looked gloomy. One of them had bandages on his arm. His face was pale and haggard, as if he was seriously injured.
“Everyone, the higher-ups have ordered that our monastery is in charge of assisting the military. We will clean up all the infected zombies in each city and help them build the isolation zone.”The tall and strong Dean said in a deep voice, “Carmen, Wissen, and Big Brin are said to have pioneer-level zombies. The military has sent the god of war to kill them. Which of you is willing to represent the monastery?”
Everyone looked at each other in silence.
“Humph!”The dean snorted and slammed his palm on the table, “Don’t you usually talk a lot? Why are you so dumb at the critical moment? Do you want me to assign you personally?”
Hearing that, the faces of several people changed slightly, the old man who was bandaged in his hand said carefully, “Dean, I went to clean up the zombies in Crowe city not long ago. I’m already injured. If I go to fight with pioneer-level zombies, I’m afraid…”
The dean glanced at him and snorted, “You don’t have to go. I don’t want to add another pioneer zombie.”
“Dean, many people in our west road branch are infected. They haven’t fully recovered from their internal problems. I’m afraid they don’t have time…”another person said in a low voice.
The others immediately complained when they saw the situation.
“It seems that I really have to assign them.”The dean sneered and pointed out three names, “Each of you will have a city. You can choose your own city. This matter is not negotiable! You have to arrive before the moon rises tonight. If anyone doesn’t go, I will directly hand them over to the higher-ups for punishment!”
The faces of the three people who were called out changed. They looked at each other and could only agree with bitter expressions.
“This matter is urgent. The three of you should leave first. The rest of you, tell me about the situation of your branch.”
The three of them immediately got up and left.
“Dean, are we still going to the outer wall area?”After the three of them left, a person next to them asked cautiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 712
chapters.content:
Chapter 712 – Chapter 702: Persuade Him To Be Kind
The dean glanced at the person who spoke, he said coldly, “Now that the inner wall is in chaos and the root of the chaos has not been found yet, the matter of the outer wall can wait for a while. However, the matter of the outer wall can not be let go just like that. I heard that the military has already sent two war gods to the outer wall. They probably want to inquire about the situation. I’ll leave this matter to you to handle. First, get a clear picture of the situation.”
The one who spoke was Mogran. His eyes rolled and he said carefully, “Dean, I wonder if the Dragon Clan has any response to this matter?”
“The military sent people to the Dragon Clan to inquire about this matter, but the Dragon Clan said that Aisha is dead. If someone is pretending to be Aisha, they can do whatever they want.”The dean glanced at him and said, “Is your information true?”
Mogran was stunned and said hesitantly, “After all, the informant didn’t see it with his own eyes. I just feel that the facial features are similar. I Can’t be 100% sure.”
“Since the hard way won’t work, then let’s use the soft way. We are a monastery, not the military. There is no need to fight and kill. It is our mission to persuade people to be good. This matter will be handed over to you. There is no need to report to me.”The dean’s face was gloomy, he said, “The higher-ups have already ordered us to help the military find the source of the virus as soon as possible. Humph, to be able to infect all the cities with the corpse virus overnight, there must be a big scheme behind it. How can it be found in such a short time?”
Mogran did not say anything else to avoid upsetting him.
After continuing to discuss the matter of the virus for a while, the meeting ended. Mogran returned to his residence and convent, calling over a trusted aide of his, he said, “I heard that the military has two war gods heading to the outer wall. When did they go?”
“I don’t know.”
“Investigate immediately!”
Half a day later, Mogran received news from his subordinates. “The military sent Hiro and Ronon to the outer wall. They were sent three days ago. They haven’t returned yet.”
“They went for three days?”Mogran was slightly stunned. A serious look flashed in his eyes as he said, “Is there any movement in the outer wall?”
“The spies who sneaked into the radiant church said that there was no movement.”
“There is no war?”
“There should be no war. Otherwise the spy would have sent a message back.”
Mogren frowned as he heard the news. He felt that something was wrong. Did the military reconcile with Dudian? He vaguely remembered the appearance of the youth. His face was tender but his eyes were deep. It seemed that there were many thoughts hidden in his mind. He knew that the youth was able to make a name for himself in the Dark Council, because in his eyes, there was a coldness that was beyond ordinary people, as well as a disregard for life.
“Knowing that the mysterious expert of the outer wall region is suspected to be Aisha, and that he is undoubtedly a pioneer, yet he only sent two war gods. It is unlikely that he is going to kill him. Otherwise, he would have to send at least three people to kill an expert of the same level without getting hurt.”Mogran frowned slightly, if they were not going to kill the mysterious expert in the outer wall region, they might have gone to negotiate. If that was the case, it would be even stranger.
No matter how much they negotiated, they would not go for three days. After all, the inner wall region was in a period of chaos, and experts were needed everywhere.
However, if it was a battle, it was impossible for there to be no movement. After all, there were two war gods. No matter how strong Aisha was, it was difficult for her to kill them silently.
He felt that there was some unspeakable secret in this matter, so he speculated silently in his heart.
At this time, his right-hand man asked him, “Elder, the Dean has left the matters of the outer wall area to us to handle. How can such a thorny problem be solved by our academy alone? What does the dean mean by being soft?”
Mogran retracted his thoughts and said coldly, “It means that through negotiations, we should first understand what they need and what their purpose is. The best way is to let them understand the great spirit of the god of light and join our Church.”
“Let them join our Church?”The trusted aide was dumbfounded. “How is that possible!”
Mogran thought for a moment, “There’s nothing impossible. Our Monastery is a world of preaching, and we build our foundation on teaching. Since the hard way isn’t enough, let the missionaries go and talk to them. At the same time, we can let them understand the spirit of our church. If they join our church, things will be easier.”
“The elder is right. which missionary should we send?”
“I already have a candidate.”
“Who?”
“Lucius!”
“It’s him? He’s a freak. He doesn’t deserve to be a missionary at all. How can we send him?”
“I have my own reasons. Go and inform him immediately. Tell him the main mission of this trip.”
“Yes…”
In a tavern, the lights were red and the Willows were green. The sound of laughter was endless. In addition, there was a well-dressed young man surrounding a burly man. Listening to him talk, his face was full of curiosity.
“I heard that there are infected corpses everywhere outside. What exactly are these corpses like?”
“Big Brother, have you really seen them before?”
The burly man raised his head and drank a mouthful of draft beer. He raised a thick and strong arm with a scar in his drunken state, he said, “Nonsense, did you see that? The wound on this old man’s arm was caused by the corpses. They bite and eat everyone they see, whether it’s an old man or a child. Fortunately, you didn’t see it, or else you would have been scared out of your wits!”
“I’m Not Afraid!”One of the flax-haired youths wrinkled his nose and snorted. “If I meet him, I’ll cut him in half with my sword!”
The burly man laughed loudly. “When you really see him, I’m afraid you’ll be so scared that you won’t be able to hold your sword.”
“Impossible!”The flax-haired youth said stubbornly.
The other youths ignored him and asked excitedly, “Is it really that scary? Why do I hear that if you’re bitten by a corpse man, you’ll also be infected?”
The burly man coughed and said, “I was only wounded in the battle. It was not caused by the corpse. Otherwise, I would not have been able to come back alive.”
“I heard that the corpse was isolated outside of Baron Cuser’s city and could not be attacked. Is that true?”
“I have been hearing shrill screams outside for the past few nights. It’s really scary.”
“I heard from the army that anyone who joins the army and kills the corpse will be rewarded and promoted. We also want to join the Army!”
The burly man looked at the energetic faces of the young men and shook his head with a smile, he said, “It’s not easy to live. It’s better for you to stay here obediently. Fortunately, the Baron has many experts under him and cleaned up the corpses outside the city. Otherwise, you would know what the Hell on Earth is.”
The young men were a little scared when they heard his scary words, but they were still eager to give it a try.
“As long as you don’t do anything bad, you won’t see Purgatory.”At this moment, a voice came from the side. The person who spoke was a young man in his early twenties. He had a smile on the corner of his mouth. What was surprising was that.., there were seven or eight empty beer glasses on the table in front of him. One had to know that the amount of beer in one glass was enough to burst an ordinary person. Even for adventurers who frequented pubs, it was rare for them to drink three or four glasses in one go, however, the young man did not change his expression after drinking seven or eight glasses, as if nothing had happened.
When the burly man heard the young man’s words, he glanced at him and said, “Little Guy, what do you know?”
“I know you’re lying.”The young man picked up the beer and took a sip indifferently, he said, “If you were scratched by the corpse man, you would have been infected long ago. How could you drink here? Besides, the Baron’s city had been closed long ago. It was closed on the first day of the outbreak of the corpse poison, but you said that you came in from outside. It’s impossible. You haven’t even left the city.”
The burly man glared at him and slammed the table. “What nonsense are you talking about!”
“Are you anxious?”
“Bullsh * T!”The burly man cursed angrily. “Little Bastard, what are you pretending for? Have you seen a corpse before?”
“We are all adults. It’s better not to swear,”the young man said with a smile.
“I’m going to swear. F * ck your mother, F * ck your mother, you B * Tch, i…”The burly man cursed, but halfway through, he suddenly froze. His drunk eyes suddenly saw clearly, there was a special mark on this young man’s sleeve. It was the symbol of the monastery!
His alcohol instantly sobered up half, and his entire body went cold. Although he didn’t know who this young man was from the monastery and whether his position was high or low, everyone knew that if he provoked someone from the monastery, he would definitely be in big trouble, even if he provoked a small nun.
“Why aren’t you scolding him anymore?”The young man looked at him with interest. He noticed his gaze and lowered his head to look at his sleeve, he said with a sudden realization, “It seems that you saw me. Now, apologize to me obediently and I will forgive you.”
The burly man’s expression was ugly. He didn’t expect to kick an iron board.
He hesitated, but in the end, he still decided to lower his head. After all, compared to face, his life was more important.
But at this moment, the youth with flax hair next to him suddenly said, “You are not a member of the monastery. You actually dare to pretend to be a member of the monastery. How dare you!”
The burly man was stunned and asked in puzzlement, “What?”
“The symbol of the monastery on his clothes should normally be on his right hand, but his left hand is a fake,”the youth explained to him.
The burly man came to a realization and immediately slapped the table as he stood up. “Brat, you actually dare to impersonate a member of the monastery. You’re courting death. I’ll take you to the monastery right now and let you repent!”
The youth looked at the flax-colored youth and smiled. “You have good eyesight. It’s a pity that you’re a little inexperienced.”
The burly man reached out his hand to grab him and angrily shouted, “Cut the F * cking nonsense and follow me!”
Halfway through his grab, there was a sudden bang. His body turned around and he fell to the ground.
The young man sat still and drank from the beginning to the end. When he saw him fall, he sighed and said, “I already said that he’s an adult. Stop swearing. Why Can’t You Keep Your Mouth Shut?”
The few youths beside him looked at him in a daze. No matter how stupid they were, they knew that he was behind this.
The young man looked at the teenagers and smiled: “Who is willing to pay for my drinks? I will tell you about the real situation outside.”
..
..
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian sat in the temple and looked at the transparent glass jar in the corner. It was the strange creature called the black prison. He had obtained a lot of information from Poland in the past few days.
First of all, he was surprised to find that the black prison was the same creature as the giant black ball that he had met outside the giant wall. The only difference was that the giant black ball was formed, however, this was only a defective product.
According to Poland, this thing was made from the tissues of many kinds of monsters. It was mainly made of fat. The purpose of the production was to specifically target pioneers and high-level monsters!
There were many research institutes in the inner wall but there was no finished product yet.
Dudian had repeatedly asked about this matter but Poland had given the same answer. He was very uneasy. If all the black jails in the research institutes were half-finished then the giant black jails that he had met outside the giant wall.., where did it come from?
He had asked Poland if there were other giant walls but Poland’s answer was that he didn’t know. He only knew that there was a kingdom of God. It was like heaven inside. There were no diseases and plagues. There were no massacres and disasters.
Dudian’s intuition told him that there should be other giant walls. With the ability of the Kingdom of God, it was very likely that there was more than one giant wall. However, if there were other giant walls then it would be very far away, it would be difficult to meet them even if they went deep into the wasteland.
He didn’t know if the black prison outside the giant wall was a secret product of the inner wall or if it came from another place.
Dudian also asked about the ice crystallization of the body. However Poland’s reply was similar to the information he got from the temple. They said that it was a terminal disease. Usually people who took cold crystals directly.., it was possible for the body to produce ice crystallization. As time went on, the degree of the ice crystallization would increase until it spread throughout the body and turned into a complete iceman.
At that moment, it meant death.
The temple had been secretly collecting people with terminal ice blood disease. They had sent them to the monster research institute in the inner wall to do experiments on them.
In order to research the secrets of the undeads, they had tried to inject cold crystals into ordinary people to make them suffer from ice blood disease.
However, this experiment wasn’t a task assigned by the Kingdom of God. It was a derivative of the research of the Monster Institute. So the progress was slow, there wasn’t much progress.
“I guess I have to go to the Kingdom of God to solve the secrets of the undeads.”Dudian didn’t have much hope for the Institute of Monsters in the inner wall, he thought that the inner wall had the highest core secret in the world. But now it seemed that it was just a chess piece. The real secret was in the hands of the Kingdom of God. They had arranged the Institute of monsters in the giant wall, it was a very strange problem to study all kinds of monsters but not the undead.
“In a few days we will run out of God’s marrow. I have to go to the inner wall again.”Dudian looked at black prison. He had been injecting God’s marrow every day for the past three days, his physique had almost reached the level of a high-level limit.
“Master, there is someone outside who wants to see you. He claims to be a member of the inner wall monastery.”Neuss reported to dudian.

chapters.title: Chapter 713
chapters.content:
Chapter 713 – : Chapter 703: The Frank Missionary [ First Watch ]
“People from the monastery?”Dudian was surprised. Last time the monastery had sent people to investigate the situation. Why would they send people to investigate? Was it the same as the military? Did they want to negotiate?
He thought for a moment: “Bring him in.”
As Neuss turned to leave, he put away the god’s marrow on the table. He arranged the confidential documents on the table and put a veil on Aisha’s face. At this moment, he sensed the sound of footsteps, and his eyes looked over. Through the metal door, he saw Noyce leading a young man slowly toward him outside the square.
The heat in this young man’s body was relatively ordinary, only at the level of a hunter. However, his X-ray vision saw a horrifying scene. The number of bones in the latter’s body was not the 206 pieces of a normal human body, there were countless of them!
Although these bones maintained his body in the shape of a human body and the appearance was not the same, but the bones were like scales. Just the bones in the palm were not simple finger bones, there were tiny bone spikes on the joints of each finger bone. This strange structure was not something that hunters could evolve!
This man hid the heat response of his body! Dudian’s eyes lit up. He would have been fooled by the strength of the heat and heartbeat. However, the structure of the bones in his body couldn’t be easily changed.
Moreover, the difference in evolution was so big compared to humans. It was very likely that he was a pioneer.
Neuss pushed the door and invited the young man into the hall.
The young man saw Dudian sitting on the throne above the hall. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes but it quickly disappeared. He smiled as he stepped forward: “I am Lucius from the inner wall monastery. I am here to visit you.”
Dudian looked at Neuss and gestured for him to leave. He didn’t want to accidentally hurt him if he activated the power system of the temple during the battle.
Neuss understood and closed the door after he left the hall.
The young man looked at the closed door and looked at Dudian. He smiled as he walked to the seat next to him and sat down. He crossed his legs, “I guess you want to ask me the purpose of my visit. I have no choice but to say it. Those old men forced me to come. The purpose of my visit was to see if the beauty next to you is her highness Aisha of the Dragon Clan. By the way, I wanted to see if you dare to go against the inner wall and occupy the outer wall.”
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “Are you here to gather intelligence?”
“Don’t you think so?”Lucas shrugged his hands, “I don’t think so either. But the military sent two war gods and they were killed by you. My strength is low. Even if I sneaked over I wouldn’t be able to find anything. So I simply came over to talk to you.”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he heard about the war god: “What are you talking about?”
“More straightforward than me.”Lucis was a bit surprised, he clapped his hands: “That’s good too. I’ll tell the truth. They asked me to gather intelligence so I’m not interested. I’m just here to complete the task. They have spies in your holy church. My task is basically completed when they see me coming in.”. However, I can’t leave immediately. I don’t think you will let me leave so easily. So, let me stay here for a few days. As long as you don’t kill me, I will give you a big gift. I will give you the secret of the monastery.”
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. He felt that this person was a bit unconventional. However, he wouldn’t easily believe his lies. The inner wall would never send a useless person to gather intelligence, he said: “I don’t care about the secret you told me. Since you are here, you don’t have to go back. I can let you stay here for a Lifetime!”He didn’t conceal his killing intent.
Lucis bitterly smiled: “Didn’t the ancient books say that when two armies fight, the envoy will not be hurt? You are not being kind!”
“Before you die, you should tell the truth. What is the purpose of coming here?”Dudian coldly said: “Do you think you can fool others with these words?”
Lucius sighed: “Then I will be honest. I am a missionary.”
“Missionary?”Dudian was startled. It was said that the first Pope of light was a missionary from the monastery.
“That’s right.”Lucius Sighed, “To tell the truth, the inner wall is in chaos. You should know this. The monastery sent people to kill you because of your crime. But because of the chaos, they wanted to use the soft one to explore the way. So they sent me to persuade you. Do you think I am unlucky?”
He looked depressed.
Dudian looked at him. Was this man really a weirdo?
However, Dudian believed his words. The monastery had only sent one person. Most of them didn’t have time to care about the situation of the outer wall. This was part of his plan. However, his persuasion made him feel strange, was the monastery too naive? Did they think that he would put down the butcher’s knife and obediently listen to them?
“Aren’t you too young to say that you are a missionary?”Dudian expressed his doubt. He wanted to see how he would explain, “Missionaries are familiar with the Bible. They have rich experience and mature mentality. They are in their forties or fifties. Are you a missionary?”
“You can question my purpose, but you can not question my profession!”Lucius suddenly said with a serious face.
Dudian raised his eyebrows. He was too lazy to joke with him. He couldn’t figure out who this person was. No matter what, he had to kill him first.
“No matter what kind of missionary you are or what other purpose you have. If you die, there will be nothing left.”Dudian slowly stood up. He felt that his physical strength had reached the high-level of the limiter, his strength was more than twice as strong as when he had just broken through to the limiter level. It was a good opportunity to test his strength. Anyway, Aisha was standing by his side so he wasn’t worried unless he was killed in an instant.
But he felt that the people who could kill him in an instant were probably the best among the pioneers. They were even stronger than Aisha. If such a person came, there was no need to talk nonsense with him.
“Uh, wait!”Lucius saw the murderous look in Dudian’s eyes and was scared, he hurriedly waved his hand: “If you are not interested in the secrets of the monastery, I can tell you other things, such as the Kingdom of God, the road above the pioneers, or other things that you want to know. I know more than you think!”
Dudian was startled as the killing intent in his heart subsided. He coldly looked at dudian: “How do you know these secrets? You shouldn’t be able to get in touch with these secrets at your age. Do you want to delay?”

chapters.title: Chapter 714
chapters.content:
Chapter 714 – Chapter 704: True And False [ Second Update ]
“You don’t know about this.”Lucius was relieved when he saw Dudian sit down again, “My father was the greatest missionary in the monastery. Even the dean of the monastery was polite to him when he saw him. His position was like that of an elder. So my father came into contact with some of the core secrets of the monastery. These secrets include all aspects. All of them are things that the pioneers are eager to know. My father told me before he died so I know about it.”
