“If you don’t kill me, I can tell you what you want to know in exchange.”
“But if you want to kill me, then I have no choice. Anyway, I was sent here to be a scapegoat. I can only admit that I’m unlucky.” “If you want to use criminal law to force me to confess, then I advise you to forget about it. Although I haven’t undergone any strict secret training, but I have at least ten methods of suicide that you can’t stop.”
Dudian stared at him. He felt that there were some omissions. But from the terrifying bone structure in his body, he was not a simple missionary.
“It is impossible for you to stay here for a few days unless you are willing to let me cripple your hands and feet.”Dudian coldly said: “No matter what your purpose is, I advise you to either confess or tell me what you know before you die. Maybe I can make your death quick.”
“We are all adults. Can you stop talking about death? It is so bloody!”Lucius Sighed, “You are really suspicious. I have already confessed to you but you don’t believe me. I swear in the name of the god of light. If there is any falsehood in my words then I will immediately go to Hell. I will be locked in Purgatory forever!”
Dudian’s eyes slightly moved. The monastery and the holy church were of the same lineage. There were many ways of doing things in the monastery which included faith and dogma. Even the most evil people in the Holy Church didn’t dare to lie, they didn’t dare to swear in the name of the god of light. Could it be that this person was really a weirdo?
However, this person had hidden his strength and definitely had a plot!
“Even if I believe in You, I won’t let you stay here.”Dudian looked at the time, “I’ll give you 15 minutes to finish what you have to say. I don’t have time to talk to you. If I’m not satisfied then you won’t be able to leave.”
“I wanted to stay here for a few days to fool that Old Guy Mogran. It seems that it will be very difficult.”Lucius bitterly said: “It seems that there are only two paths for me to choose. Either I use my knowledge and experience as a missionary to persuade you to join our monastery or let you have a bit of goodwill in your heart.”
“There is a third way.”Dudian said: “If you tell me what you said before then I will show you some kindness.”
Lucius shook his head: “It’s a long story. A quarter of an hour is not enough.”
“It’s impossible for you to increase the time. I have limited time to rest.”Dudian’s words pierced through his thoughts, “You can recite the Bible for me or say the principles of your monastery. But it will be difficult to influence me.”
“I won’t say the things in the Bible.”Lucius’s mouth twitched: “I haven’t read the entire Bible, let alone memorized it.”
Dudian was surprised to hear his words. It was the first time he had heard someone say the Bible in front of him. Moreover it was someone from the monastery. He suddenly suspected that the person was from the monastery, could it be that other forces disguised as the monastery?
Lucius saw the doubt in Dudian’s eyes, he shrugged his shoulders: “Don’t think too much. I am a true missionary of the monastery. Even if you suspect my people, you can’t doubt my clothes. No one in the inner wall would dare to impersonate our monastery.”
“That’s true. After all, there are too few fools.”Dudian nodded.
Lucius was speechless, he wryly smiled: “You are right. There are fewer and fewer fools nowadays. It is not easy to deceive them. If you want to coax people into the church then you have to take out real gold and silver. The charm of the god of light is not enough.”
Dudian looked at the strange missionary: “How can you be a missionary if you don’t believe in it?”
“I am different from other missionaries. I don’t want to use the god of light to fool people.”Lucis’s expression was disdainful, “If there is a god then why do we need people like us? We can use his divine power to drive away all the evil and make all the fools become smart.”
Dudian felt that the man’s thinking was similar to that of the people in his era. He was familiar with the feeling: “But there are many people who don’t understand such a simple principle.”
“Some people are fools who really don’t understand. Some people understand but pretend not to understand!”Lucius sighed: “People say that people who pretend not to understand are terrible. In fact, people who pretend not to understand are terrible!”
Dudian said: “Since you don’t believe in God, why did you join the monastery? Why did you become their missionary?”
“I don’t believe, but my father does.”Lucius’eyes slightly moved. He shook his head: “Instead of talking about God, Let’s talk about truth and falsehood.”
“Truth and falsehood?”
Lucius’expression suddenly turned serious: “I think that everything in this world is not distinguished by the nobility or the inferiority. It is not distinguished by the high and low. It is just like your current life. Do you think this is true or false?”
“This is not a dream. Of course it’s true.”
“Is it?”Lucien’s mouth curved, “Then do you think that the real world is like this? What is your goal?”? “You have been sitting in this position for a long time. You should have killed a lot of people. You sacrificed so many people’s lives just to get this right?”
Dudian narrowed his eyes and stared at him. He didn’t answer.
He had seen that this person seemed to be talking to him. But he wanted to slowly open his mouth and grasp his thoughts step by step.
Lucis saw that Dudian didn’t open his mouth. He smiled: “Anyway, I have fallen into your hands. Are You Afraid of being brainwashed by me?”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he nodded: “Alright, since you want to talk, I will accompany you to chat.”
He didn’t say this because he was excited but because he suddenly thought that if he killed him in a quarter of an hour, it would be a waste. Since the other side wanted to use dialectical methods to persuade him or to get information.., then he could also brainwash the other side and get information. It was better than directly killing him.

chapters.title: Chapter 715
chapters.content:
Chapter 715 – Chapter 705: Teach You How To Be A Person [ First Update ]
Lucius smiled as he saw Dudian was provoked: “Since we are going to talk then let’s talk about the truth. We are all adults so there is no point in lying. Don’t you think so?”
“Yes.”Dudian was willing to do so: “I can only guarantee that I am telling the truth. But how do I know that you are telling the truth?”
“We can swear.”
“Swear by the god of Light?”
“Of course not. The god of light is fake. There is no credibility in using a fake thing as an oath.”Lucius was blunt, “We will swear on the things that we respect and love the most. If you lie then the thing that you want the most in your heart will be lost. What do you think?”
Dudian raised his eyebrows and looked at him for a few seconds: “No problem. But you have to add two more. In addition to these two, you have to swear in the name of the god of light. You have to swear in the identity of the monastery.”
“I don’t believe in God. I didn’t expect you to believe in him.”Lucius shook his head: “Well, I’m at a disadvantage. I’m sitting lower than you because of these two.”
Dudian didn’t comment.
Both of them quickly took the oath. Lucius said: “As far as I know Mr Dean’s childhood wish is to be a doctor or a priest?”
“It seems you have done a lot of homework.”
“After all, I’m here to visit you. Wouldn’t it be rude if I don’t know anything about you?”
Dudian didn’t pursue further. His information had been sent to the monastery by the Holy See when he was an elder of the 9th region. The details of the information were more than what he knew. However, the information was dead, life was alive and would never stop. He said: “In that case, why don’t you tell me about you? I want to know how did the monastery cultivate you?”
“Do you want to say that a person like me wouldn’t be allowed to exist in the monastery?”Lucius shrugged his shoulders: “Of course it depends on the relationship. If the relationship wasn’t strong then I would have been kicked out.”
“Your father’s relationship?”
“Yes.”Lucius nodded as if he didn’t want to continue to talk about this, he took the initiative: “Mr Dean had a fiery heart when he was a child. Why is he so ruthless now?”? You should be clear that the power of the inner wall is not something you can shake. If your actions succeed then it’s fine. But the possibility is not low. If you fail then you and the people around you will be killed. Even their families, wives and daughters will be implicated. Even if you don’t sympathize with the ordinary people, you should sympathize with the people who follow you, right?”
Dudian frowned. His words made him uncomfortable. This was a problem that he had deliberately avoided in the past. After all, he was not 100% sure that he could overthrow the inner wall!
“They are ready to sacrifice when they follow me.”Dudian coldly looked at him, “There are many people in this world who are not like you. They can do whatever they want and have connections to support them. Many people want to live a better life. They can only exchange their lives for it. What they enjoy now is what they have taken risks to get.”
The corner of Lucius’s mouth slightly curved, “Do you think that this kind of exchange is worth it? They are exchanging their lives for wealth with you. What is the difference between this and the Devil’s Contract?”? “Moreover, with your ability, you can lead them to a good life. There is no need to rebel.”
“What is rebellion?”
“You are now called Rebellion.”
Dudian quietly looked at him: “You also think that rebellion is unnecessary. Why did you choose to rebel? You went against the mission given to you by the monastery. Isn’t this considered as betraying the monastery?”
“I didn’t betray.”Lucius shook his head, “If I didn’t come then it would be called betrayal. But if I came then it wouldn’t be considered as betrayal. Moreover, what I am doing now is the duty of a missionary to persuade you to be good. How can this be called betrayal?”
“But you are not satisfied with this arrangement, aren’t you?”Dudian’s eyes were deep, “You mentioned the truth and falsehood. In my opinion, your action is false. You are not satisfied but you don’t dare to show it on the surface. This is called hypocrisy!”
Lucius was startled. He didn’t think that Dudian would use his words to pressure him. He was silent for a few seconds, “It is true that this is hypocrisy. But hypocrisy is human nature. As long as you don’t hurt others, it can’t be considered a bad thing.”
“I have never thought that being hypocritical is a bad thing.”Dudian said.
Lucius was stunned again. He wanted to defend himself but he didn’t think that it would be in vain. Moreover Dudian’s words were out of his expectations, he frowned: “The hypocritical people in this world are always detestable. Although our monastery uses the name of the god of light but it is not hypocritical. After all, no one can prove that the god of light is real. But at the same time, no one can prove that the god of light doesn’t exist!”
“And we use the name of God to spread kindness, justice, and love! I think this is great kindness and has nothing to do with hypocrisy!”
Dudian’s expression was indifferent, “Indeed, no one can prove that there are no ghosts or gods. The monastery is not hypocritical. Even if it is hypocritical, it is beneficial for everyone. People would rather like a real villain than a hypocrite. The reason is not that hypocrisy is a vicious thing, but that there are too many stupid people. They can’t distinguish what is true and what is false. So they are deceived and say that others are hypocritical.”
Lucius was speechless. He felt that there was something wrong with the words, he retorted: “Most people are just kind and not stupid. There are always people who regard kindness as stupidity. But kindness is kindness. If everyone is very smart then there will be many people who do bad things.”
“But if everyone is really a villain then what do you think the world will be like?”Dudian quietly looked at him, “I’ll tell you what will happen. Politicians will tear the mask of serving the country and the people. They will directly use tough means to suppress the voices of resistance. The treacherous businessmen will also be permitted by the law. As you said, there is only truth and falsehood in this world. Then the truth is more terrible than the falsehood.”
He didn’t give Lucius the opportunity to interrupt, “If the body of two people is very dirty, one of them will wear clothes and cover it. The other person will be naked. He will let others see his body and know that he is dirty. From then on, he will stay away from him to protect himself. “In this way, the cute part of a villain is to warn others to avoid danger
“Therefore, people hate hypocrisy! “However, if all the people who are wearing clothes take off their clothes and expose their dirty bodies, what will happen then? You will find that most of the people on the street are naked and have dirty bodies, but those who are truly kind and honest are few and far between
“What will happen at this time?”? “There will only be one result, and that is that all the naked people will bully the weak with their numbers and enslave these kind and honest people. They will not cover up their ugliness and will openly break the law.”. “Of course, there will be no law at that time. Because there are many bad people, they will make the law. When that time comes, killing people will be innocent and rape will be innocent. Everyone will openly release their true nature. At this time, do you still think that small people are really cute?”
Lucius was stunned and speechless.
After a while he said: “What You Said is too extreme. It is impossible for such a thing to happen.”
“It is indeed impossible.”Dudian nodded, “Because everyone is hypocritical. Hypocritical is derogatory. It means that the appearance is not the same. Is it also considered as hypocritical to restrain people’s nature? If it is, then people who know how to restrain their own nature are called human! “In other words, the first step of being a human is to start from ‘hypocrisy’.”
He continued, “In my opinion, being a human is not a conclusion, but a process. In the process of ‘doing’, from birth to death, the experience of this life is called being a human, not being born a human.”

chapters.title: Chapter 716
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: – Chapter 706: Change The Mode Of Thinking [ Second Update ]
Lucius was stunned. Dudian’s words had a great impact on him. Although it sounded like a bit of nonsense but he couldn’t find any rebuttal mistakes.
After a while, he sobered up and immediately retorted: “You say that because you are the ruler of the outer wall. You play with power so naturally you praise ‘hypocrisy’.”
Dudian shook his head, “I’m not praising. It’s just my personal opinion. Although I have said so much but I don’t think that hypocrisy is better than a real villain. In fact, I don’t think that the two kinds of people are more annoying because I have the wisdom to see through their hypocrisy. I have the power to suppress their evil in front of me!”
Lucius said in a cold tone: “No matter which kind of person they are, they are like worms. According to your words, hypocrites are better than villains. At least people know how to protect their face. They won’t kill people on the street or do anything out of the ordinary. But such people are greedy and secretive. If they are officials then they will breed corruption. But if they are friends then they will stab people in the back. They are simply animals in human skin!”
“That’s right, so you need a pair of eyes.”Dudian indifferently said: “If you don’t recognize the right person but blame others for lying to you, then you deserve it!”
Lucius shook his head: “Who can be like you and guard against anyone? Moreover, People’s hearts are complicated. It is difficult to see a person, especially for a kind person.”
“That is not called kindness. It is just that I am too lazy to use my brain.”Dudian said: “The World is fair. If you use less brain, you will suffer more losses.”
Lucius shook his head, “If everyone knows how to restrain their own nature and don’t hurt others, they will not be a true villain or a hypocrite. They will be as pure as a newborn baby. That is the best thing and the most ideal state of being a person.”
Dudian looked at him. He felt that he was about to distinguish the difference between a hypocrite and a true gentleman. He had to thank the treasures left behind by the ancestors of China. Half of the hypocrites he talked about were deliberately ignoring the part of “Courtesy”to bewitch this person. As he said above, everyone was a hypocrite. Most people hated the hypocrite which was to use hypocrisy to do evil.
The other kind of positive kind of hypocrisy was called courtesy!
There was a world of difference between the two. In short, the hypocrisy of kindness was the most important thing to learn in the process of “Being a person”.
“Both kinds of people are wrong and can not be a pure person.”Dudian opened his mouth to refute Lucius’words, “Purity means a blank. A baby is not a ‘person’. If you live for many years and want to be a baby then what’s the difference?”
Lucius didn’t think that Dudian would refute such a thing, “There was an artist who told me that people are born on a piece of white paper. Years have painted on it so people will grow old and die. Because the paper has been painted and painted so badly that it can not be painted anymore, so people have to die!”! “Death is God’s greatest punishment for life. It is a judgment and also a warning!”
“If people can live a bit more easily and be kind, then the painting of life won’t be so bad and ugly.”
Dudian indifferently said: “If birth, old age, illness and death are God’s punishment, then survival is the struggle between man and God! According to you, if you don’t have so many distracting thoughts and live a bit more easily, then the white paper of your life won’t be painted so quickly? In my opinion, it is the opposite. You are just casually living. You are resigned to your fate. You will leave your life to God to decide. You will live as long as he wants you to live.”
“Those who have more ideas and smear more people just want to live better and more exciting lives. They are struggling and you are resigned to your fate. You will hang your head under the blade of God and let him cut it off.”
Lucius was stunned. He didn’t think that Dudian could find a rebuttal to this kind of thing. He couldn’t help but ask: “Do you think that being kind is a mistake? !”
If Dudian admitted it, he would find it ridiculous because it was the root of his belief and couldn’t be shaken. At the same time, it meant that he could ignore what Dudian said.
Dudian didn’t answer him but asked: “What is kindness?”
Lucius was stunned again but quickly reacted: “I think all three-year-olds know this question.”
“Who told the three-year-old?”Dudian asked again.
Lucius’face slightly changed. He realized that this question was not so simple to answer. He quickly thought about it, he said: “Our Monastery has always been biased towards the good. Of course, although we have done bad things and killed people, but you have to know that the monastery is a whole. There are countless people. The quality of the monastery is naturally uneven. However, the purpose of our monastery is good. This is indisputable. Even I have to admit it.”
His words were very accurate and firm.
Dudian nodded. From this point of view, he was much better than the people from other monasteries. At least he wouldn’t blindly say things that he might not believe. He wouldn’t blindly maintain the monasteries, however, this wouldn’t win his good impression and lower his vigilance.
“The so-called goodness is determined by morality.”Dudian continued: “The definition of goodness in morality is goodness. Who will make morality? What is the role of morality? I will tell you that the role of morality is to manage places that the fist can not control. Every king can use swords to subdue every citizen in the territory. But they can not subdue every person who does evil. At this time, the role of morality is obvious. It is to maintain the development of mankind.”
“Everyone is good and the world is peaceful. Only then can peace be well managed and developed. But long-term peace will lead to comfort and decline. So War is necessary. Although everyone hates war, but those who hate war are just people who can not benefit from it. Because war will bring death to them. If War only brings death to others but benefits them, then they won’t hate it.”
Dudian said: “Not everyone will abide by the moral constraints. The Ancients said that every day to reflect on their own mistakes. It is like a person will go astray and need a direction. However, this direction is set by others and not by you. The path you take is also the path that others want you to take. Because everyone walks in this way. There are rules and regulations that will be good for everyone.”
“Those who like to walk around blindly follow their own nature. So they bump into others and hurt the law-abiding citizens.”
Lutheus’s face was ugly. Dudian didn’t answer his question but analyzed the question in more depth. He felt a burst of pressure. Although his faith was still unshaken, but he had to admit that the teenager in front of him was the most terrible person he had met in more than twenty years. He was completely incomparable to the other rigid missionaries who only knew how to recite the Bible.
He had won the argument against the missionaries. He had always felt that he had seen enough of the world. But Dudian’s words had raised his thinking to another angle — the ruler’s angle.
Everyone looked at the problem from their own habitual point of view. A suspicious person would always have a skeptical attitude. A businessman would always look at the problem from the point of view of interests, he looked at the problem from the philosophical point of view of good and evil. But Dudian had brought him to the point of view of the survival and destruction of the entire human race!
It was no longer about pure interests and good and evil, but the trend of human activities.
He suddenly felt that it was a bit childish to talk about good and evil. On the contrary, the interests were more practical. However, the interests were too narrow and shallow.

chapters.title: Chapter 717
chapters.content:
Chapter 717 – Chapter 707: I Am Innocent [ First Update ]
Dudian struck while the iron was hot as he saw that Lucius was silent, he said: “You said that your monastery is trying to persuade people to be good. But what is good? I think there are two kinds of good. The first kind is the good of ordinary people. You Said ‘good is always right’. Why is it right to say good? Because the law only sanctions the wicked but not the good.”
“This kind of kindness refers to a person with a pure heart, tolerant, willing to help others, and willing to sacrifice himself for others
“If it was an ordinary civilian, he would naturally be considered a good citizen. He would not cause damage to the surrounding environment and others. This is something we are happy to see. But will the military abide by this kind of kindness? “If they abide by it, they will not forcibly enlist civilians to fight. Will the magistrate abide by such kindness? If they abide by it, they should forgive all the people who have made mistakes. After all, only when others have made mistakes will they use ‘forgiveness’. and ‘forgiveness’is also a kind of expression of kindness.”
“Obviously, they didn’t do that. For evil people, they will punish the evil. Killing an extremely evil person is equivalent to saving countless good people. This is the second kind of kindness that I said. Some people like to call it ‘Great Kindness’.”
Dudian’s words were continuous, “Killing people is a bad thing, but killing bad people is a good thing. The difference between the two lies in their role. Killing people is to destroy the system and killing bad people is to maintain the system. In other words, no matter which kind of good it is, the purpose is to maintain the overall system.”
“There is nothing wrong with being kind. Because everyone is kind, mankind will be peaceful. The sacrifices will be reduced. It is good for everyone.”
“But for those who don’t want to follow the rules, this kind of good is evil. It is the rope that binds them!”
Lucius listened to Dudian’s words but his mind was not disturbed. He looked up at dudian: “According to you, what you have done is great good?”
Dudian shook his head, “In your opinion, I sacrificed the lives of others to satisfy my own selfish desires. But you should be clear that I sacrificed a lot of people. But I have brought a better life to others. The material resources in this world are limited. It is like a scale. When one end is reduced, the other end will naturally increase.”
Lucius sneered, “It’s good that you know. This world must have rules and obey them. It’s like a carriage moving forward. This is the direction of the entire human race. Everyone has to follow this route to move forward. If someone doesn’t follow the rules then the carriage will stop moving forward. So, it’s good to follow the rules and morals!”
Dudian’s eyes were deep, he said: “The world naturally needs rules. But why should we obey other people’s rules and not our own? Our human society has been imitating the ant colony. There is only one commander who can command everyone. Everyone is like an ant that obeys the Queen’s orders. They listen to the ruler’s orders and carry out the group’s activities in an orderly manner. Such a social form can bring about efficient development. It is like a factory. Everyone can complete their own tasks in their own positions.”
“However, there is a drawback to doing so. If the ruler makes a mistake, the entire race will be doomed
“Thankfully, we humans are smarter than ants. Although we are like ants and don’t dare to go against the ant queen, we have our own will, and we don’t have to obey her unconditionally like puppets
“Every ruler of the human race will be scrutinized by all the civilians. Although the civilians are stupid, if the ruler makes a mistake, there will be wars, rebellions, and rebellions! To put it bluntly, the rulers of the human race don’t have the absolute ability to rule. They are the embodiment of the collective consciousness of all the civilians. If this embodiment goes against the collective will of all the civilians then it will be overthrown by everyone!”
“There is an old saying that water can carry a boat but it can also overturn a boat.”
Dudian indifferently said: “You Think I am rebelling and rebelling. This just shows that the current direction of the Wall Master is wrong and needs a new person to replace it!”
“You still want to replace the Wall Master?”Lucius stared at him in disbelief. He thought that Dudian’s ambition was to occupy the outer wall. He didn’t expect that he would want to replace Aristotle, it was unbelievable!
“Why don’t you dare to think about it?”Dudian looked at him: “How did the first wall master come about? How did the second wall master come about? Are they born without using their brains?”
Lucius was stunned for a long time, he said in a deep voice: “They are made by the Kingdom of God. If you want to be a wall master, you have to go through the Kingdom of God First! What you said above is just an excuse for your rebellion. In the end, you are just fulfilling your own selfish desires!”
Dudian quietly looked at him: “Since you don’t listen to me then let me ask you. You said that your monastery spread kindness and fairness. Do you think that your monastery has done it?”
Lucius replied without thinking: “Of course!”
Dudian indifferently replied: “If they have done it then why are you here? If they are kind then why didn’t they reward me with the outer wall? Why did they want to take it back? They didn’t hesitate to let you take risks and sacrifice your life. They even wanted to fight with me. If I stubbornly resisted then the military of the outer wall would all die! “Do they dare to look at such casualties?”
Lucius was speechless. He didn’t expect Dudian to bite back. He clenched his teeth: “I said that this is the rule. You took away the outer wall without permission. It is against the rules!”
“Do good people have to kneel in front of the rules?”Dudian looked at him: “I will ask you again. Do you believe in fairness?”
Lucius’s face changed. He knew that this was a controversial issue, he said: “I know that some people think that there is no fairness. For example, those who were born humble and those who were born noble. This is unfair. But this is God’s appointed. He is a poor man in this life. In his previous life he must be a vicious person. In this life he must pay for his sins.”
“Our Monastery is to uphold fairness. Although people are born unfair but if they commit a crime they will receive the same sentence. Isn’t this fair?”
Dudian indifferently said: “I think that the world is very fair. It is you who are trying to do these things.”
Lucius was stunned. Dudian’s words were out of his expectations. He asked: “What do you mean?”
“The rich are twenty-four hours a day and the poor are twenty-four hours a day. Isn’t it fair?”Dudian slowly said: “Whether it is the poor, the rich, or the aristocrats, everyone will feel that it is unfair. Isn’t it fair?”
“There are differences in the world and your monastery is trying to make people believe in fairness. This is the biggest injustice for those who believe in your words!”
Dudian looked at him: “You say, if this is not creating injustice, then what is it?”
Lucius was stunned and speechless.
He felt that every word Dudian said was completely different from the people he had met in the past. It was as if he was chatting with people from another world, a brand new door quietly opened in his heart.
After a long time he slowly opened his mouth, “In any case, your actions have ruined the lives of many innocent people. They didn’t provoke you or hurt you. But you took the initiative to hurt them. This is your sin!”
Dudian shook his head, “The world is a game. All living things are chess pieces. Whether you are a pawn, Queen or king, there is a possibility of being killed. You can choose to stop but it doesn’t mean that you are innocent. Once your side loses, the game will be full of Useless Chess Pieces!”! “Therefore, most of us desperately want to live a better life. Those who pursue power only want to make themselves safer in the beginning. It’s just that as time passes, they enjoy the feeling of controlling the safety of others more
“This is the rule of the game, so I am not guilty.”

chapters.title: Chapter 718
chapters.content:
Chapter 718 – Chapter 708: Abyss [ Second Update ]
“The rules of the Bureau…”
There was a trace of dullness in Lucius’eyes. Although he didn’t want to admit Dudian’s words, but Dudian had let him see a bigger world. He recalled the many beliefs in his heart, even when he wanted to say it, he felt that he couldn’t stand because he couldn’t completely believe it.
Dudian saw the change in Lucius’expression. He knew that half of the ideas that he had instilled into him had succeeded. This was completely within his expectations. After all, the world described by the monastery was too beautiful, but what he was talking about was a real bloody world. Secondly, he believed that even if Lucius had a noble identity, his life would not be smooth sailing.
“Your monastery used the name of God to beguile the civilians. You claim to be the spokesperson of God but you can’t prove the existence of God.”Dudian continued to press, “They are the subordinates of the wall master. If the wall master does bad things then they are accomplices. You are also accomplices…”
“Enough!”Lucius Interrupted Dudian’s words. He took a deep breath and calmed down. However, his expression was solemn and solemn, “I admit that I lost this time. Even if I win in the end, you will not be easily persuaded by me. However, I will not let this matter go. I will come again.”
From what Dudian had said, he had seen that this teenager was completely different from other teenagers. He was even more terrifying than some wily old men. He had a firm belief and a set of his own thinking, moreover he was very thorough. Unless he could refute the other party’s thinking and completely destroy the other party, it was impossible to persuade him to surrender.
“See you later!”
Lucius suddenly got up. He shook like a hurricane. Bang! The door of the temple was suddenly pushed open. The Breeze swept Lucius’body and disappeared from the square.
Dudian was stunned. He wasn’t electrocuted?
He knew that something was wrong when Lucius admitted defeat. He patted the lion’s head and activated the power system of the temple. However, the situation was unexpected!
Didn’t he use his own hand to open the door?
Or did his magic marks have a resistance to electricity?
“He ran so fast…”Dudian narrowed his eyes as he looked at Lucius who had disappeared at the end of the square. Lucius’s physique was definitely at the level of a pioneer. He was even stronger than Hiro and Ronon, he knew that his plan had failed. He didn’t delay and didn’t give Lucius a chance to capture him. Even the power system of the temple had been evaded by him.
“How did he know that the temple has electricity? Electricity shouldn’t exist in the inner wall. So it could only be unintentional. Or was he cautious enough to think that I would smear poison on the door so he didn’t touch the door but used something else to open the door?”Dudian frowned, he was puzzled. He looked down at his watch. It was almost fifteen minutes.
He sighed. He had wasted so much time.
However, it was not a waste. He believed that there was a seed planted in this person’s heart that could be used by him in the future.
..
..
“Elder, do you think that Lucius could successfully persuade that person? He took control of the outer wall without anyone noticing and took over the entire outer wall. Such a person is vicious, cruel, and scheming. I’m afraid he won’t listen to us, the missionaries, so easily, right?”In the monastery of the inner wall, a sixty-year-old man in a red robe stood in front of Mogran and said.
His face was full of worry as he said, “I hope nothing bad will happen to this child. Back then, his father went deep into a dangerous place and tried to persuade a heinous beast. In the end, he lost his life instead.”
Mogran smiled slightly, he said, “You don’t have to worry. This child is different from you. After his father died, although no one controlled him, his lobbying ability was not inferior to that of ordinary missionaries. Moreover, I sent him over because he had seen the darkness with his own eyes. Therefore, he knows better than most missionaries how to deal with these arrogant and evil people.”
“It’s hard to persuade these evil people just by explaining the stories in the Bible. Although the light of God is great, how can people who have fallen into the darkness see the light of God clearly?”
“You have to know that even a glimmer of light is very dazzling to people in the darkness. They don’t want to open their eyes to see it.”
The old man was startled: “It’s not that we are incompetent but too many people have abandoned their faith. They won’t listen to us no matter what we say.”
Mogran smiled: “We will wait for his good news.”
“I hope he can come back safely…”the old man was worried.
..
..
Five days passed in the blink of an eye.
Clang!
Dudian injected the last tube of God’s marrow into his arm. He couldn’t help but sigh as he felt the surging power in his body: “I’m still a bit off.”He had consumed all of the god’s marrow. His physique was at the same level as a primary limiter, he had successfully reached the level of a senior limiter. There was a further change in his posture after entering the devil. He was closer to the splitter but he looked more ferocious than the splitter.
“It seems I have to go to the inner wall.”Dudian thought, “I should be able to collect God’s marrow and evolve into a pioneer by ransacking the Monster Research Institute.”
“I don’t know if my fighting capacity will be comparable to Aisha’s after I become a pioneer. Aisha’s fighting capacity should be ranked in the top ten of the inner wall…”Dudian felt a bit of pressure in his heart, he could only hope that his deified legendary magic marks would be able to exert power when he evolved into a pioneer. He would be able to surpass the ordinary pioneers and even the pioneers of the witcher family like Aisha who had the power of bloodline.
He had asked Poland. The strongest in the inner wall was the pioneers. There was no existence above the pioneers.
Although he didn’t tell him the question that Lucius had mentioned before, he asked Poland afterwards and got the answer from him.
The stage above the pioneers was called the Abyss Walker.
There were no people at this level in the giant wall because the evolution from the pioneers to the Abyss Walker required special energy, which was not available in the giant wall.
The Pioneers were also divided into several levels. Pioneers like Aisha who had bloodline power were usually the best among the pioneers.

chapters.title: Chapter 719
chapters.content:
Chapter 719 – Chapter 709: The Strongest Monster [ Two-In-One Chapter
Although Poland was an ordinary person, but because he was a doctor of the Institute of Monsters, he had a lot of information about the pioneers.
Dudian learned from him that the pioneers were divided into three levels: the Outer Wilderness, the inner wilderness, and the dominator. The power span between each level was very large. It was no less than the difference between the frontiersman and the pioneer. The two war gods who were captured by Dudian were the best among the pioneers. They could easily defeat ordinary pioneers!
As for pioneers like Aisha who had bloodline power, once they activated their bloodline power, they would have the power of the inner wilderness. They would be able to go deep into the red wasteland to save their lives.
Moreover, Dudian also knew that the bloodline power of the Hunter family could be awakened seven times in total. When they completed the seventh awakening, their power would exceed that of the ruler and they would have the power of the Abyss!
However, for so many years, there had never been a pioneer who had awakened seven times in the giant wall of Sylvia. The two ancestors of the Dragon clan and the Rock clan had the highest level of awakening. Their sixth awakening was unparalleled! They were born in the same era, and it was also under the leadership of the two of them that the desolate area of the three witcher clans was able to be developed on a large scale.
The original desolate area was extremely close to the giant wall, only about a hundred miles away. Every night, the residents in the giant wall could even hear the ferocious roars and the angry roars of unknown creatures outside the giant wall.
It was a dark era. Under the leadership of two talented ancestors of the Hunter family, the wasteland outside the giant wall was cleaned up and became the hunting area, there were only some small monsters that hadn’t been cleaned up yet.
Dudian asked Poland about the origin of the Hunter family but Poland didn’t know about it. He only said that it was one of the top secrets. Even if he had the authority, he wouldn’t be able to know the secrets of the giant wall.
Poland also didn’t know anything about the power of the wall master. They only knew that there were many experts in the military who didn’t object when the wall master was appointed by the Kingdom of God, they knew that the wall master’s power wasn’t simple!
Dudian got more information from Poland than from Gwyneth. There were many ordinary pioneers in the military besides the top ten military gods, there were three commanders who had supreme status. Each of them was an existence of the inner wilderness level. They were comparable to Aisha’s status and power!
Aisha was the Saintess of the Dragon Clan. She had the best resources in the Dragon Clan. Moreover she had a strange bloodline which could stimulate the power of the bloodline. She was one of the top experts in the entire dragon clan, can only with the military’s three commander-in-chief draw in the same level!
“The Monster of the Abyss Walker has never appeared in the inner wall. The most powerful one is the ancestor of the Hunter family who has awakened for six times.”Dudian had a new understanding of the power of the inner wall, “If a pioneer evolves to the inner wasteland level, if his bloodline awakens five times, he will have the power to fight against a ruler-level pioneer. If he awakens six times, he will be even stronger than an ordinary ruler!”
“But a pioneer is different from a limiter. They can not evolve by relying on God’s marrow alone. There is a requirement for magic marks.”
Dudian learned from Poland that magic marks had another function. Not only would it bring more abilities but it would also limit the limit of growth! Generally rare magic marks could only be instilled into the physique of an ordinary pioneer. Only rare magic marks could increase the strength of a pioneer to the level of the top ten military gods. But if one wanted to enter the inner wasteland level.., if one wanted to enter the inner wilderness then they had to have legendary magic marks!
Dudian also heard shocking news. Although the Atlas was from the Monster Institute in the inner wall but it wasn’t determined by the institute. It was from the Kingdom of God!
Every time the envoys from the Kingdom of God came they would bring the latest list of the Atlas. However because of the long time gap between the envoys from the Kingdom of God they would only come once every ten to five years, therefore, some of the newly mutated small monsters outside the wall were recorded by the Monster Research Institute. Through the comparison of various data in the illustrations, they were divided into their illustrations.
Therefore, the eight legendary monsters were named and designated by the Kingdom of God, including many rare monsters. There were even some rare monsters recorded in the illustrations that people had never seen before, at least, they didn’t exist in this area.
However, there were very few of them so no one paid attention to them.
Dudian knew why he had never seen ‘Dreamer’who was ranked first among the eight legendary monsters in the giant wall of Sylvia. Perhaps this legendary magic mark didn’t live in this area.
However, he was even more puzzled because the highest record in the Atlas provided by the Kingdom of God was only for legendary monsters. Especially for ‘Dreamer’who was ranked first, according to the record in the Atlas provided by Poland, it was Level 182! It was almost an unimaginable hunting level system. It was no wonder that the Monster Research Institute published the Monster Atlas in the outer wall. The hunting level of legendary monsters was recorded as a question mark. There was no specific description of the hunting level, after all, one hundred and eighty-two hunting levels was a bit frightening. It could even cause unnecessary panic among hunters!
However, did this mean that ‘Dreamer’was the strongest monster on this planet?
Dudian couldn’t judge because this hunting level was an astronomical figure to him. It was enough to give most of the pioneers a headache, they might even lose their lives.
However, after knowing the hunting level of ‘Dreamer’, he didn’t wonder why it was ranked first. It was really shocking. He couldn’t imagine what kind of power it had, it would cause such a terrible disaster!
It was estimated that even people who wanted to get ‘Dreamer’magic marks would be deterred when they saw the hunting level.
“My magic marks are legendary magic marks. The God’s marrow is enough to directly evolve into the inner wilderness level. I have reached the level of the three commanders of the military. However, the amount of God’s marrow needed to evolve from the outer wilderness level to the inner wilderness level is as much as a river. Even the military of the inner wall has only trained three commanders over the years. The ten war gods are only the top of the outer wilderness level. The title of the top is mostly because of their hard training and battle experience.”
Dudian felt a bit of pressure. According to the current situation, even if he looted another monster research institute, he would only be able to reach the pioneer level. He wouldn’t be able to directly rob the Monster Research Institute and evolve to the inner wilderness level.
Dudian’s heart was filled with regret as his good wish failed. However, he wasn’t too disappointed. In his heart, it was already good enough that he could reach the pioneer level. After all, the only way to overthrow the inner wall was to rely on wisdom, becoming a pioneer was enough to satisfy his plan.
A few days later.
Dudian was ready to go to the inner wall to raid another monster research institute.
Through the information sent back by the assassins in the inner wall, although he had never been down the mountain but he had a clear understanding of the situation in the inner wall, the chaos of corpses did not calm down so quickly, causing the various forces in the inner wall to be overwhelmed!
Although the military had ten military gods and three commanders, all of whom were as strong as gods and could easily kill all the ordinary people who had turned into zombies and clean them up, the process of cleaning them up was met with numerous obstacles!
Among the people who were infected, there were some nobles and wealthy country gentlemen. Some of them could not bear to see their family members being killed like this. Some nobles even accused the military of “Barbaric actions”, they believed that the military should find the cause of the disease and treat them instead of blindly “Killing the innocent”.
Dudian’s guess was right. Although the fist was fierce, but what could it do to the secular world?
After all, this was not a simple and rough world where the Fist was supreme. The social formation was extremely complex. The situation in the inner wall and outer wall was no different. The identity of the aristocrats was detached and brought about the class system, it also led to the phenomenon that the strong would listen to the orders of the weak. Just like the hunters in the outer wall who received the small amount of wealth from the consortium.
The nobles in the consortium didn’t go out but enjoyed the continuous flow of large amounts of money into their pockets. This was the wonderful cycle of suppression.
The pseudo-nobles in the outer wall could suppress the hunters because they had the magistrate to maintain order, protect the nobles and punish the evil. The same was true in the inner wall. Even the military which had many experts was controlled by the nobles, because the lord of the wall was the one who gave the title to the nobles in the inner wall!
“Young master, be careful on the way.”Neuss saw that Dudian was going to go deep into the inner wall.
Dudian patted his shoulder: “It’s nothing. I’ll be back soon.”
He saw the giant eagle that was tied to the square. It had been imprisoned in the square for the past few days. Fortunately he asked Neuss to bring a few live cows to feed it so that it wouldn’t be hungry and fly away, otherwise, the chains under its feet might not be able to bind the giant.
Seeing it, Dudian couldn’t help but think of the two military gods in the dungeon. He asked Neuss: “How are the two people?”
“According to your instructions, they were treated with extreme torture every day. Their injuries didn’t heal.”Neuss knew who Dudian was referring to.
Dudian nodded slightly: “Remember to check them every day. Break their tendons and replace the spikes. Don’t let their injuries heal.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss nodded.
Dudian didn’t say anything else. He looked at the sunset and spread out his wings. He grabbed Aisha and flew towards the inner wall. He didn’t need to hide his wings anymore, it was no secret.
His wings had recovered while his physique had greatly increased. His wings had healed. There wasn’t a single feather on his black wings. It didn’t look like the wings of a dragon. Instead, it looked like two black blades, the frequency of the flapping was very fast. It was more like a vibration than an insect flapping. It was almost impossible to see the trajectory of the flapping wings.
Dudian came to the giant wall and saw two figures dressed in black robes sitting on top of the giant wall. He wasn’t surprised because these two were the people he had transferred to transfer the intelligence of the spies in the inner wall, they were the ones who had followed Glenn into the giant wall to poison them.
“Speaker!”
The two sat on the ground and chatted. They leaned against the edge of the giant wall. They were relaxed and relaxed. They saw Dudian who had suddenly landed on the giant wall. They were startled and stood up in a hurry.
Dudian put away his magic wings and said to the two: “I don’t care about rest but don’t let the giant wall patrol see you.”
The giant wall patrol was the first time he had sneaked into the inner wall. He had seen the extremely strong heat from the giant wall. He knew from Poland that there were patrols on the giant wall who were responsible for the safety of the giant wall, it was to prevent monsters from climbing up the giant wall and entering the wall.
However the number of patrols of the giant wall patrol was uncertain and the time was also uncertain. Moreover the main patrol area was the giant wall of the inner wall. It was rare for them to come to the giant wall of the outer wall. After all, the giant wall had been cleared by the pioneers, large monsters were almost extinct. There were only some small monsters. It was almost impossible for them to climb over the giant wall.
“Yes, President. We won’t dare to do it again.”The two nervously said.
Although they were notorious killers of the outer wall, but they couldn’t help but tremble in front of Dudian because they knew the high status and power of the teenager.
Dudian didn’t say anything more and led Aisha along the giant wall.
The two saw Dudian’s move and hurriedly said: “Speaker, are you going to the inner wall? Do you want us to accompany you?”
“No, do your job well.”Dudian said without turning his head.
After walking for thousands of meters, Dudian saw the wall of sighs in the inner wall. The number of patrolling soldiers was still the same as before. There was no increase. This was a good sign for him, it meant that the inner wall didn’t suspect him of poisoning.
After passing through the wall of Sighs, Dudian went more than ten miles deep. He didn’t see any patrolling soldiers. He spread his magic wings and landed in the inner wall with Aisha in his arms.
After landing, he shook the bell and asked Aisha to follow him. He took Aisha and ran forward.
This time, he chose another city. A few hours later, he walked along the wilderness and arrived in front of the city. He looked into the distance and saw that the huge wooden fortress outside the city was unguarded, it was filled with the smell of decay and blood.
He used his X-ray vision and saw that there were no living people but some undeads. He was relieved and walked into the fortress with Aisha.
The undeads in the fortress saw Dean and Aisha and immediately roared and pounced on them.
Dean smeared undead powder on his body and hid his smell. He walked straight through the undeads. Aisha’s smell made them afraid to come near.

chapters.title: Chapter 720
chapters.content:
Chapter 720 – Chapter 700: The Heart Of The Devil
The once prosperous streets were now deserted. There were overturned stalls and carriages. There were broken limbs and bones everywhere. There were children’s bones among the corpses. It was like a purgatory, it was a pity.
Dudian’s footsteps were silent as if he was a ghost floating in the ruins.
Aisha was the same. Although she didn’t have consciousness, but her fighting instinct was still engraved in her bones. She walked quietly. The two of them passed through the streets like shadows.
The night covered the sky of the city. There were no sparks or laughter. There were only one or two howls and screams from afar.
“There have been hundreds of thousands of pows killed by generals in history. I don’t know how many people will spit on me in the future.”Dudian whispered to himself as he stepped over the messy corpses on the ground, it sounded like he was talking to Aisha but also to himself.
He smiled faintly and self-deprecatingly.
It seemed that every time he was alone with Aisha, he would be more sentimental and have human emotions.
After passing through half of the city, Dudian gradually approached the Monster Institute on the map. At this time, he suddenly noticed two figures hiding in the corner of the alley in front of the street. One was big and the other was small.
He was surprised that he didn’t see any living people along the way. He didn’t expect that there were people here.
He didn’t change his route and continued to walk forward. He immediately saw that the two people hiding in the alley were an old man and a seven or eight-year-old girl. They were wearing coarse linen clothes. It was obvious that they were poor civilians.
The old man also noticed Dudian and Aisha. He was shocked when he saw them. He thought that there were two undeads quietly approaching. However, under the faint moonlight, he quickly saw the appearance of Dudian and Aisha, the color of their skin was not pale like the undeads. Moreover, they didn’t have blue eyes. He was relieved. He waved to Dudian and Aisha and pointed to the corner in front of him.
Dudian didn’t intend to pay attention to the two but he noticed the old man’s action. He looked in the direction of the old man’s finger and saw four or five undeads wandering in the street corner.
Since he saw the old man’s kind gesture, Dudian didn’t continue to be blind. He was ready to clean up the undeads. Suddenly, the old man held the little girl’s hand and quietly ran over, she grabbed Dudian’s hand and used two fingers to write a shushing gesture on her small mouth. She used the other hand to grab Aisha’s hand as if she was going to pull her into the alley.
Aisha was covered by her hand. Her face was expressionless but her pure black eyes slightly turned as if there was evil killing intent seeping out.
Dudian didn’t expect the little girl to be so bold. His heart moved but he didn’t resist. He held Aisha’s hand and went back to the alley with her.
The old man saw the little girl return. His anxious face was obviously relieved. Previously, he didn’t hold the little girl down and caused her to run out by herself. He almost scared her to death. At this moment, seeing that she had returned safely, he immediately held her firmly, he gave her a reproachful look. However, when he thought of the presence of outsiders, he didn’t want to be too obvious. He raised his head and looked at Dudian and Aisha.
Dean whispered to the old man: “Why didn’t you stay in the house? Why did you come outside? There are undeads in the vicinity.”
The old man was frightened by his words. He looked at the entrance of the alley. He was relieved to see that the undeads didn’t notice him, he lowered his voice and said to dean: “We don’t have any food in our house. If we don’t come out to find food, we will starve to death. Are you going to take refuge in Baron Angeli’s castle? If you are willing then we can go together.”
He saw that Dudian and Aisha were young and strong. If they were in danger then they might be able to help them.
Dudian understood the old man’s thoughts. He asked: “Can Baron Angela take refuge? Does he have an army?”It was rare to meet a disaster victim in the inner wall so he could understand the situation here.
“You don’t Know?”The old man was surprised. He looked at Dudian and Aisha. His eyes lit up when he saw the giant sword on Dudian’s back, “Baron Angela’s castle is guarded by knights. The infected people can’t get close to it. Many people have gone there to take refuge. If we can get there then we will be completely safe!”
Dudian nodded. It seemed that the civilians were the most affected by the chaos in the inner wall. The nobles and monasteries had enough power to protect themselves in the chaos.
He asked: “Have the army entered the city to clean up the undeads?”
The old man felt strange but replied in a low voice: “The army has come a few times but only took a few people away. It is said that the army will come to deal with them soon.”
Dudian understood that the army had temporarily given up on ordinary civilians. It was like the last time he saw them. They had given priority to protecting the nobles. Perhaps the military would choose the nobles from the chaos, they would be able to use lightning to clean up the mess. As for whether ordinary civilians would be implicated or not, it would depend on their own luck.
“I have something to do. I will take my leave first.”Dudian didn’t stay any longer and was ready to leave.
The old man was stunned.
“Big Brother, don’t go. Those people will eat people.”At this time, Dudian’s wrist was pulled by the little girl. He looked down and saw that the little girl’s face was dirty, but at the moment she was anxiously pulling him: “Once you go out, they will eat you. You will go with us. As long as we go to the Baron, we will be safe.”
The old man saw the situation: “Yes Yes, you will go with us!”
Dudian looked at him. He knew that the old man wanted to borrow him to protect them. But the little girl obviously didn’t see this. He raised his hand and touched the little girl’s head. He looked at her pure eyes, he sighed: “Poor Child.”
The old man quickly said: “The child’s parents went out to look for food a few days ago. Now only the child is left alone…”
Dudian slightly shook his head and interrupted him. He took out half a bottle of undead powder and handed it to the old man, “You Smear this thing on your body. These monsters won’t chase after you. As for the ones in front, I will take care of them for you. You should seize the opportunity to leave.”
The old man was startled. He held the small bottle in his hand and was a bit confused.
Dudian had already taken Aisha out of the alley. He strode towards the few undeads at the corner.
The undeads felt Aisha’s smell as they were close to her. The malevolence on their faces suddenly disappeared. They shivered and their mouths were full of sharp teeth.
Dudian grabbed the handle of the knife and swung it in a circle. The heads of the undeads were cut off. He walked straight away without looking back.
The old man and the little girl were stunned. They waited for a long time after Dudian left before they reacted. The old man immediately opened the bottle and poured out the powder to smear on his body, then he held the little girl’s hand and carefully walked along the street.
Dudian walked to the front of a forest. In front of him was the Monster Institute. He looked back at the street. The old man and the little girl had gone far away. His eyes slightly flickered, he looked at Aisha: “I have harmed many people like them. Don’t you think it’s hypocritical of me to save them out of sympathy? Sure enough, it is difficult for people to control the stimulation brought by the senses. Visual touch can control emotions…”
Aisha was silent as if she had acquiesced.
Dean shook his head slightly and no longer looked at it. He slowly went deeper into the forest.
The moonlight didn’t shine into the forest. It was dark inside but under Dudian’s night vision everything was as bright as day. He killed the poisonous snakes and insects that ambushed him. Soon he walked out of the forest. There was a small hill in front of him, there was a flat building on top of it. It was the Institute of Monsters.
The structure of the Institute of Monsters was the same as the one in Carmen City. Dudian could see that there was a nine-story underground institute under the hill. There was no activity on the ninth floor. There were only some items on the other side, it seemed that the ninth floor was too deep and the humidity on the ground would affect the experiment.
This time Dudian found that the range of his perspective was much larger than before. Moreover the things he could see were much clearer. His confidence increased a bit. He raised his hand to hold the knife to ensure that nothing was wrong, he directly activated the magic body. The knife melted and covered his body like a living black mucus. Soon, his appearance turned into a ferocious human-shaped beast. His arms were long and scythe-like.
Whoosh!
His body flashed as the leaves on the ground splashed. The Breeze brushed past the leaves and swayed slightly.
There were eight people guarding the building. The defense was the same as that of the Monster Institute in Carmen City. Dudian quickly approached and broke through an open window.
The young man who was holding the blade was talking to his companion. He didn’t notice that Dudian was suddenly alert when he jumped through the window. He was about to turn his head when a cold light flashed past. His movement suddenly froze, his head fell down.
Dudian didn’t stop as he killed one person in an instant. He jumped towards the person who was chatting with the youth. It was a beautiful woman who was wearing armor. She was stunned for a moment but quickly reacted and retreated, however Dudian’s speed was as fast as a tiger. Her back hit the wall and the next moment she saw the terrifying figure in front of her.
Puff! Dudian’s arm passed by and turned to another place. He didn’t look back at the result.
He saw the position of the eight people when he attacked. He planned all the actions and sequence of the attacks. When he attacked the third person, the others reacted and immediately shouted in anger, at the same time he activated the magic body to surround Dudian.
“Too slow!”Dudian’s dark golden eyes slightly turned. Every time his arm crossed the human body he would feel a sense of pleasure. He suddenly changed his mind when he saw the group of people surrounding him, he gave up on the original plan to attack them one by one. He suddenly realized that these people were not on the same level as the last time he met them.
Moreover the splitter was the legendary monster that was not afraid of group battles!
It could be said that the splitter was a monster that was born for group battles. The more it was in the army, the more it could unleash its destructive power to the extreme!
Puff! Puff! Puff!
Dudian’s tail was spinning rapidly. The structure of his tail was extremely special. Every part of his tail could open up and become a fierce blade bush. At this moment, it was dancing and shooting out in an instant, the four people who came over immediately fell to the ground. They didn’t have time to scream. Their injuries were too horrible to look at. Their faces were blurred. From the neck to the upper half of their chest they were all broken. It was as if they had been cut by a sharp blade countless times.
Dudian’s knees slightly bent. He suddenly rushed forward and rushed to the person in front of him who was about to escape. He hugged him with both hands. To be precise, he pierced through his back and out of his chest.
“No, don’t –”the other man was scared out of his wits when he saw Dudian turn his head. He knelt down and begged. He knew that he couldn’t escape from Dudian’s speed.
Dudian quickly rushed forward and cut off the man’s head. He didn’t hesitate to beg.
He looked at the corpse on the ground. He felt that the excitement in his mind was getting stronger and stronger. There was an extremely pleasant feeling in his heart. He didn’t expect his strength to be so strong, he had observed the heat reaction of the eight people. Five of them showed the heat reaction of the high-level limiters. However, he didn’t have the strength to fight back.
“With my current strength, ordinary pioneers should be able to fight. Unless I meet a god of war, it will be difficult for me.”Dudian thought as he stepped on the door, he entered the research institute.
Although the previous fight was short but it still alerted the guards. Dudian went down the stairs and met a few guards who were rushing up to check the situation. He immediately took action and dealt with them.
When Dudian came to the underground laboratory, he saw that some people were still conducting experiments. They didn’t notice the chaos outside. Some people opened the door and came out of the laboratory, they were asking the guards what had happened.
Dudian was more familiar with the last robbery. He killed all the guards. As for the experimenters, he let them escape.
An hour later.
Dudian carried a three meter tall storage bag and escorted a middle-aged man with glasses out of the institute. The middle-aged man was called Summer Manson. He was the director of the Institute and also the Doctor here, there were two doctors in the institute. The other one happened to be out tonight. He had received an invitation from a noble to attend a banquet.
“Walk faster.”Dudian shouted.
“It’s not that I’m slow. It’s that you are too fast.”Shamanson bitterly smiled as he took a few steps forward.
Dudian took him to the edge of the woods. He shook the bell and asked Aisha to follow him. They continued to walk through the woods and came to the street outside.
Summer Manson said: “I heard that the Monster Institute in Carmen City was attacked not long ago. That person is you. Who Are You? How dare you go against Our Monster Institute? Do you know how dangerous it is?”
“Do you know Poland? You will see him later.”Dudian said: “He will tell you what to do.”
Shamanson was surprised: “Poland is still alive?”
“You are also alive.”
“I know.”
There was no communication along the way.
Dudian went back the way he came. He walked through a few streets. Suddenly a red dot came into his eyes. His pupils shrank. He looked up and saw that the red dot was flying from the sky, its body was emitting an astonishing heat. It was as strong as the pioneers he saw in the wasteland of the Dragon Clan.
“Support? It Came So Soon?”Dudian was shocked.
But at this time, the figure flew over. It didn’t slow down at all. It flew over the heads of the three people and flew into the distance.
Dudian was startled for a moment. It seemed that the person didn’t come for Charmanson. It seemed that he was in a hurry to go somewhere. He didn’t notice them. He had practiced the dragon blood technique so that the heat in his body was always low. Moreover, Charmanson was an ordinary person so it was even more insignificant. Needless to say, Haisha’s body didn’t have any heat fluctuation.
Charmanson looked at the rapidly disappearing figure. The excitement in his eyes suddenly became dull. He couldn’t help but stomp his feet. He was so angry that he wanted to curse.
Dudian looked at him: “It seems that this person has an urgent matter. You are destined to fall into my hands.”
Charmanson heard his words and held back the anger on his face, he pretended to be calm: “It’s nothing. He should be rushing to Baron Angela’s castle. There should be a situation there. It’s better to save more people than to save me here.”
“Oh?”Dudian frowned. Baron Angela? He suddenly thought of the old man and the little girl he had met earlier. It seemed that they were going to take refuge there. Could it be that the place was not safe?
Wait a minute. The people who had rushed to the castle were pioneers. Could it be that there were pioneers? Could it be Eleanor who he had thrown back to the inner wall?
As he thought of this, his thoughts were in turmoil. The images of the old man and the little girl flashed through his mind.
The reason why he thought of them was not because he was worried about their safety.
Instead, it was because what he planned to do would very likely cause the two people who had just helped him to be sacrificed there.
When he thought of the possibility of Eleanor appearing there, the first thing he thought of was to stop the pioneers who had just rushed there. To him, there were very few pioneer-level zombies. If he could protect one, he would be able to protect one.., the main force that was really holding back the inner wall was also relying on these limiter-level zombies and pioneer-level zombies.
However, if he helped Eleanor, it would be equivalent to sacrificing everyone in Baron Angeli’s Castle!
“The plan can not be messed up…”he closed his eyes slightly and discarded the images in his mind. He turned his head to look at Aisha beside him and took a deep breath, he said to Charmanson coldly, “Lead the way to Baron Angeli’s castle.”
“Go There? Why?”Charmanson was surprised. This was in a completely different direction.
“Help.”

chapters.title: Chapter 721
chapters.content:
Chapter 721 – : Chapter 711: Super-Speed Evolution [ First Update ]
Dudian picked up Charmanson and asked him to show him the way. He followed the street at full speed.
It didn’t take long for him to see the pioneer in front of him. The heat source in his body was as hot as a fireball. It was extremely eye-catching in the dark night sky. Dudian knew that Charmanson didn’t blindly show him the way.
He slowed down a bit to avoid alerting the enemy.
Four or five minutes later, Dudian saw a group of faint red light behind the Dark Street building. It seemed that a large group of ordinary people had gathered together. He jumped to the top of a building on the street. He saw the situation in front of him. It was a huge castle. There were several torches lit on the wall, a large number of figures gathered on the wall.
A large number of undeads gathered on the spacious street in front of him. They were swaying towards the huge castle.
Dudian could faintly hear the chaotic shouts coming from inside the castle. Apparently there was a fierce battle with the undeads. The shouts attracted more undeads to the castle.
Bang!
Suddenly a loud sound came from thousands of meters away from the east side of the castle.
Dudian was startled. He turned his head and saw a group of extremely high density hot figures appear at the location of the loud sound. It seemed that he was fighting with something!
Dudian immediately thought of Eleanor who had turned into a zombie. At this time, the pioneers who were flying in the air quickly descended. They didn’t care about the castle but rushed to the east side of the battle.
Roar!
Dudian heard the roar. It was extremely ferocious. The sound was as ear-piercing as if it was broken. He couldn’t tell if it was a man or a woman. He saw a three-story building with a pointy hat suddenly burst. A black figure covered in rags rushed out, the other two groups of hot figures followed after him and attacked crazily.
“There aren’t many pioneers who can fly. Most of the reinforcements are from the wing clan. I’m afraid that their skills are extraordinary.”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He was a bit worried. After all, it was one against two, his strength would increase by several times but he would lose consciousness. The battle would be chaotic and he would be at a disadvantage. He didn’t want to lose the pioneer level undead that he had sent in.
He quickly made a decision and left Shamanson behind: “You wait here. It’s best if you don’t try to escape!”
Shamanson also noticed that the situation in front of Baron Angelique’s castle was fierce. Moreover the undeads on the street seemed to have been guided. Most of them rushed over. The situation wasn’t optimistic. At the moment he saw that Dudian was prepared to help. He suddenly thought of many things, including Dudian’s identity.
At the moment he saw Dudian’s explanation. He was eager to do so: “No, I Won’t run away. There are undeads around. If I accidentally bump into them then I would be better off dead.”
Dudian sneered and grabbed his ankle. He flipped him onto the ground. Both of his hands were on his knees. There was a slight tremble and a cracking sound. Under the observation of the x-ray vision, his knees had been dislocated.
He did the same thing and dislocated his other leg. He believed that with his ability, he should not be able to recover on his own.
Charmanson almost screamed out in pain. Fortunately, Dudian’s actions were fast and the pain quickly disappeared. He looked at Charmanson who was sitting on the ground: “Stay there. She will take care of you.”
He quickly jumped off the building and ran down the street.
He didn’t plan to take Aisha with him because from the heat source’s density, the two pioneers were weaker than Hiro and Ronon. They should be ordinary pioneers. He wasn’t worried that he was wrong. At the moment in the fierce battle, the two of them shouldn’t be in the mood to hide their strength so the heat source reaction in their bodies should be the most real.
He was confident that with his current strength he would be able to compete with the ordinary pioneers.
Roar!
The undeads on the street saw Dudian running at high speed. They were attracted by him. Although Dudian’s body was covered with undead powder but his movements were too big. He successfully attracted the attention of the undeads.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to them. He ran all the way and soon shook off the undeads. As for the ones blocking the way, he threw them to the side of the street. Their skulls were bent but they were still roaring.
Dudian rushed to the battle circle. He didn’t join immediately but observed the situation.
He found out that the undeads who were fighting with the two pioneers weren’t Eleanor but a middle-aged man. He looked ferocious. There were more than ten spikes of different lengths protruding from his back. His hair was standing up like steel needles, there were a few strange short arms growing out of his armpits. His eyes were shining with green light. He was roaring non-stop. In addition to his head, more than 90% of his body was demonized.
The two pioneers also entered their demonic body state to fight. At first glance, it looked like three humanoid monsters were fighting each other.
One of the flying pioneers who rushed over had a pair of giant black wings on his back. The wings were 14 to 15 meters long. The demonic body was more than three meters tall. Skeleton-like bones protruded out of his body. It was hard to tell if it was a strange-looking armor, or was it the physical structure of the demonic body.
The other was a woman, but her hair split like a sharp blade. Dark Silver Scales covered her entire body, including her plump chest. There was a strange mouth on her abdomen, revealing long, thin, sharp teeth.
The two of them alone are enough to scare the hell out of a lot of civilians.
At this moment two people join hands, flanking left and right, will be the middle-aged male corpse forced to retreat.
The two of them clearly knew the weakness of the undead. They cooperated with each other so that the middle-aged corpse didn’t know which one to attack. When the middle-aged corpse pounced on the pioneer, the silver-scaled woman attacked his legs. As for the spikes on his back, there was no way to attack.
Dudian looked for a while and found that the middle-aged corpse’s speed was much faster than the two of them. But the two of them were clever. Although they were caught but they could always escape. Especially the pioneer of the wing clan.., when they couldn’t retreat, they used the giant wings to fly in the air. The middle-aged man could only stand on the ground and roar.
The middle-aged man was seriously injured by the two’s attacks. Although it didn’t feel any pain but its body would still be affected by the injury.
Roar! Roar!
The middle-aged man’s body flowed with ink-like blood. He angrily roared and once again caught up with the pioneers of the winged race. His beast-like claws pounced on his shoulder.
The pioneer of the wings race’s face changed. He hurriedly flapped his wings and swept up the sand on the ground. His body leaped into the air and stepped on its chest. Using the momentum, he flew backward and jumped into the sky.
The middle-aged man’s body missed and almost fell to the ground. He looked at the pioneer of the wings race who was flying in the air and roared at the sky. He was so angry that he could not control himself. Suddenly, the spikes on his back changed and grew again, the spikes merged together in twos and threes. In a short while, the merged spikes turned into two ferocious wings that looked like bones.
The wings were extremely ugly, short and asymmetrical. However, the middle-aged corpse roared and flapped its body, sending it flying.
The silver-scaled woman who was about to attack the middle-aged corpse was so shocked by the sudden change that she did not attack. When the middle-aged corpse flew up, she realized that she had missed the best opportunity to attack. She was annoyed, she stomped her feet and continued to attack the middle-aged man’s body.
The middle-aged man’s body seemed to be flying for the first time. His control was unstable and he was flying slowly.
The pioneers of the wing clan saw this and immediately swooped down. They whipped the middle-aged man’s chest and shot him down.
Dudian was surprised to see the middle-aged man’s body hit the ground. He didn’t expect that the middle-aged man would mutate again. No, it should be called evolution! In order to adapt to the enemy who could fly, it had evolved to fly!

chapters.title: Chapter 722
chapters.content:
Chapter 722 – Chapter 712: Fighting The Pioneers [ Second Update ]
“The virus has the ability to make a rapid leap in the evolution of life. It has greatly shortened the normal evolution process.”Dudian’s eyes flashed. The theory of evolution was common knowledge in the old era but not many people knew about it, darwin’s theory of evolution was gradually perfected. It was more appropriate to call it the theory of evolution. Species evolved according to the environment but the process was slow. The reason was that life was too complicated. Even if it was an extremely small life.., even a tiny organ in the human body had a complicated structure. Even in the old days when technology was advanced, it could not create a human organ out of thin air to replace it. It could only be transplanted.
Seeing the change in the middle-aged man’s corpse, he could not help but think of Aisha. Would she still maintain her human appearance in the future when she was in danger? Would she also be stimulated by the demonic factors in her body and mutate into another appearance, never to be restored?
Thinking of this, he suddenly felt lucky that he did not put her in danger previously.
In the future, he would never let her fall into a desperate situation again!
While his thoughts were drifting, the situation in front of him had already reversed. The middle-aged corpse combined with the ugly wings that had just mutated, forcing the silver-scaled woman and the youth of the wing clan to retreat repeatedly. In a short moment of battle.., it had already gradually mastered the use of its wings. With the help of its wings, its speed increased explosively once again. The more it fought, the faster it became.
A blood-curdling scream rang out. The silver-scaled woman was pounced into by the middle-aged corpse. She was unable to dodge in time and was accidentally bitten on her arm. She was greatly shocked. Without hesitation, she swung her sword and chopped off the bitten arm.
