The surface of this arm was covered with silver scales and strange spikes, when the sharp sword slashed down, the scales retracted into the arm, revealing a slender arm that was as white as a lotus root. There was a bite mark on it. With a flash of Sword Light, the arm was cut off.
In the next moment, silver scales surged out and covered the broken arm, stopping the blood.
The middle-aged corpse roared and pounced again. At this time, the youth from the wing clan saw that the situation was not good and hurriedly dived down. His two eagle-like palms grabbed onto the back of its neck and tore off a piece of its flesh. However, he was unable to tear off its head.
The middle-aged male corpse did not care. It roared and pounced on the silver-scaled woman. It opened its mouth and bit the bulging part of her chest. Sharp teeth as thick as fingers protruded from the completely torn mouth, it easily pierced through the silver scales on her chest.
The silver-scaled woman screamed in pain. She raised her hand and slapped it, but she was unable to push it away.
When the pioneers of the wings race saw this scene, their faces turned pale. They knew that she was finished. The bite was so close to the heart that even if they immediately cut off the flesh, it would be difficult to save it.
He looked at the middle-aged man who was crazily biting the silver-scaled woman. He stood in the air for a while and suddenly woke up. He flapped his wings and turned to run.
He knew that he couldn’t kill the man by himself. It would be a waste of time if he continued to stay here. It was better to report it to the higher-ups.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he turned to leave. He immediately stepped out and entered the magic body state. He flew into the air. His opponent was the pioneer so he didn’t dare to hold back.
The pioneer was startled when he saw Dudian suddenly jump out. He was relieved when he saw that Dudian was a human. The next moment he felt that the heat intensity in Dudian’s body was extremely strong. It was not inferior to his, he was overjoyed: “Are you from the monastery? Or the military? Let’s kill it while it is not on guard!”
Dudian nodded: “Alright!”
His dark golden pupils fell on the middle-aged man’s body. He emitted a shocking killing intent as he firmly locked onto the corpse.
The pioneers of the winged race were confident that they would be able to kill the corpse on the spot. It would be good if the silver scaled woman was eaten as soon as he left. But if she wasn’t completely dead.., there would be a pioneer level undead. It was a potential danger. Naturally he had to get rid of her while she still had human consciousness!
“Kill!”He shouted in anger. He turned around and flew out with his gun. His black wings danced like a giant rotating cone as he rushed straight towards the male corpse.
Dudian followed closely behind. The sharp blade on his tail was raised. At the same time the strange limbs on his back were raised like a peacock’s tail. His speed suddenly increased as he caught up with the pioneer.
“What!”The pioneer felt that something was wrong. He turned his head and saw Dudian looking at him with killing intent. He was shocked and angry.
Dudian didn’t say much. The sharp blade on his tail suddenly pierced through his wings. He slightly twisted and tore off a large amount of feathers. At the same time, the sharp limbs on his back extended and shot out like a few hidden guns, several holes were pierced through his wings.
The pioneer turned back and stabbed at Dudian’s face. He forced Dudian to retreat. At the same time he turned around and looked at Dudian. His eyes flashed with coldness: “Who are you? !”
“Man.”Dudian rushed again. He didn’t give him a chance to breathe.
He thought that his sneak attack would be successful. He didn’t expect that Dudian would notice that the pioneer wasn’t so easy to deal with.
The pioneer roared in anger. His golden hair fluttered in the wind. He brandished his spear like thousands of arrows. It was as fast as an afterimage, but it was also very real. It covered all parts of Dudian’s body.
Dudian was secretly shocked. He couldn’t see through the flaw of his attack and immediately had the intention to retreat. However, the pioneer seemed to have seen through Dudian’s plan. He suddenly thrust his spear towards Dudian’s throat.
It was too late for Dudian to retreat. Cold Sweat broke out in his heart. All of his limbs and long tail were thrown out. The spear was sent flying in the chaos.
The pioneer retreated a few meters. His face was ugly. There were cracks on the back of his hand. Blood was oozing out.
Dudian was relieved after repelling the pioneer. The next moment he noticed the injury on his claw. He was startled. He suddenly thought that although his fighting ability was not as good as the pioneer’s but his strength and speed were faster than the pioneer’s, it was just that he lacked experience in dealing with the enemy. It was difficult to think of a way to break the previous gorgeous marksmanship. But at the moment he thought that it was not difficult to break the marksmanship. He just needed to treat any spear light as a real spear, he ignored the others and only parried one. In this way the other illusions would naturally be broken!
This method was simple but it was difficult to make an instinctive judgment in a battle between minutes and seconds. In the end it was because of the lack of experience. At the same time it also showed that this marksmanship had its merits. For example, the peacock was full of momentum. It was enough to intimidate the enemy, it made people’s judgment slow.
“You have your strengths, I have mine. Let me use my long to attack the short!”Dudian’s eyes were full of killing intent. He suddenly rushed out again and continued to attack head on.
The pioneer of the wing clan snorted. He shook his spear and attacked Dudian again. But this time, he didn’t use the phantom-like spear technique. Instead, he used a simple and direct spear. It was like a flood dragon going out to sea, carrying a momentum of ten thousand tons.
Dudian squinted his eyes and suddenly attacked. His scythe-like arm cut the head of the spear. His body slanted so that the trajectory of the spear was slightly slanted. At the same time, the sharp limbs and sharp tail on his back suddenly stabbed out, he was like a poisonous snake.
With the help of many years of sculpting training, he was multitasking. His attacks were swift and fierce. He was like a man-eating flower that suddenly opened its fangs and surrounded the pioneer of the wing clan.
The pioneer of the wing clan’s face changed. He suddenly changed his hand and pulled the spear shaft. He actually pulled the spear that was moving rapidly. Then, he swung the spear shaft. With two clangs, he blocked two sharp blade limbs. However, it happened so suddenly that his arm could not dodge in time, he was cut by another sharp blade monster limb, and a huge wound instantly appeared. The dark hard shell covering the surface of his arm seemed to be useless.
The pioneer of the wing clan hurriedly flapped his wings and retreated. He was shocked. His demonic body could be said to be invulnerable, but he was actually cut so deep with just a light slash. If he had retracted his hand a little slower.., his entire arm would have been chopped off!

chapters.title: Chapter 723
chapters.content:
Chapter 723 – Chapter 713: Destruction
Dudian immediately followed up the attack. His movements were extremely strange. He quickly approached the pioneer. He swung his tail and stabbed at the pioneer’s waist from the side. At the same time.., the few sharp limbs on his back attacked from the other side.
The Pioneer’s face changed. He immediately waved his spear to block the attack. Although he only had one arm but the shaft of the spear was like a pen in his hand.
Dudian suddenly stretched out his hand as he blocked the sharp limbs and tail. His arms were like two war knives. The tip of his hand was like a sharp blade as it cut through the Pioneer’s chest.
The Pioneer’s face changed. He quickly flapped his wings and swept up the sand on the ground. It affected Dudian’s line of sight.
He looked at the cut arm and found that blood was flowing out. The wound had no signs of healing. He was secretly shocked. Normally a cut by a sword would heal in the blink of an eye. One must know that the magic body could be reconstructed repeatedly, dudian was not afraid of being hurt.
However, the magic body covering his arm had not been reconstructed. He noticed that the shape of the wound was unusual. It seemed to be very fine serrated shape. He looked up at the few sharp limbs on Dudian’s back. All of them were as sharp as knives. The edges were smooth and there was no serrated shape. However, the damaged tissue of the wound was not fake.
“DAMN!”He looked at dudian. The strange magic body made it impossible for him to distinguish which kind of magic marks. He suppressed his killing intent and turned away.
Dudian couldn’t let him leave so he immediately chased after him.
Dudian’s sneak attack had pierced several holes in the giant wings of the pioneer. His flying speed was greatly reduced and Dudian caught up with him.
Dudian immediately activated the dragon blood spell. His heart was beating wildly. Blood was like a surging river. His whole body was full of energy and wild strength.
He growled and waved his arms to attack the pioneer.
The pioneer was shocked and quickly turned his spear to block.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to his spear but rushed towards his wings. Puff! His hands cut the giant wings. Two terrible wounds were cut and blood spilled.
“Bastard! !”The Pioneer’s eyes were red with anger. He stopped running and turned around to stab him.
Dudian’s eyes were cold as he rushed towards the pioneer’s spear. He raised his arm to block the spear. The black liquid covering his other arm suddenly disappeared and revealed his pale hand, he grabbed one of the Pioneer’s wings.
“Get down! !”Dudian roared as he swung his arm and smashed down.
The wings of the pioneer were controlled and fell down uncontrollably. Before he fell, he readied his spear and thrust it at Dudian’s chest. The tip of the spear seemed to pierce a metal plate, dudian’s body was pushed back and the speed of the Pioneer’s fall was faster.
Boom!
He heavily fell to the ground. The giant wings landed at the same time and raised a lot of dust.
The pioneer slowly got up from the ground. He panted as he stood up. The giant wings flapped and the dust in front of him was swept away. He looked up at Dudian who was in the air. There was killing intent in his eyes, however the next moment, his face changed. He looked down in horror. He saw a ferocious and burly figure standing in front of him. The mouth of the monster was full of blood.
It was a male corpse!
The face of the pioneer of the wing clan stiffened. He saw that the body of the silver-scaled woman had been gnawed into a bloody mess. Her chest was completely missing and her abdomen had been torn open. Her organs were scattered all over the ground, it was extremely bloody.
“No!”He suddenly woke up. He flapped his giant wings and retreated. In the moment of life and death, he burst out with unprecedented speed and strength. The giant wings were already covered in wounds, his body shot into the sky like an arrow leaving the bow.
He looked at the corpse on the ground and didn’t have time to relax. He suddenly heard a buzzing sound. He looked up in horror and saw Dudian appear above his head, he was hit by several sharp monster limbs.
Puff! Puff!
The sound of two pieces of flesh being torn sounded. His body fell to the ground like a broken angel.
The male corpse smelled the tempting smell of blood coming from his body. He couldn’t wait to chase after him. He rushed to the front of Dudian and threw him to the ground, there was a shrill scream coming from the pioneer of the wing clan.
Dudian frowned as he looked at her. He turned around and left. He looked at the silver scaled woman and found that her head was still intact. Although her beautiful face was a bit blurry and the bridge of her nose was bitten off, the left side of her face was bitten off but her brain was still intact. Although her neck was seriously injured but it was not broken. It seemed that she would wake up sooner or later.
His figure quietly flew away in the night. He returned to Aisha’s side and landed.
Charmanson sat on the ground. His face turned pale as he saw Dudian’s ferocious demon figure. He instinctively shrank back.
Dudian looked at the castle in front of him. The war was spreading and more and more undeads were gathering there. It was obvious that there were no strong ones who could clear the undeads. The two pioneers who came to help.., they had already died. All the people who were sheltered in the castle would die in this night.
He could almost picture the faces of those desperate people who were hugging each other. There were tears of despair in their eyes. They thought that they had found a shelter but the shelter was broken through, this peaceful place immediately became the bloodiest hell.
He thought of the old man and the little girl, especially the little girl who looked up at him with her dark eyes. She was so cute, but she would eventually be destroyed, just like a pure lily, she was swallowed by the flames.
He was silent for a moment. After a moment, he felt the movement of the man’s corpse. He didn’t stay any longer. He picked up Charmanson, shook the bell, and asked Aisha to follow him. Then he turned and jumped down the building, he quickly left along the messy street.
Dudian held Charmanson in his hand, he was stunned: “Aren’t you going to help? The situation there should be bad. The longer they drag the fight, the more undeads will be attracted. Aren’t you going to help them get rid of the undeads?”? “With your strength, it should be easy to deal with them, right?”
Dudian indifferently said: “I have helped them.”
“Helped them?”Charmanson was at a loss.
After a few hours, Dudian left the inner wall and returned to the outer wall of the Uto Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 724
chapters.content:
Chapter 724 – Chapter 714: Sadism [ First Watch ]
Neuss didn’t sleep all night. He was waiting in the square. He saw Dudian coming back.
Dudian threw Shamanson to him: “Give him to Poland. Poland will teach him what to do.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss saw Shamanson’s clothes. He knew that he was the same person as Poland. He asked: “Master, are you doing well?”
“Yes.”
Dudian said: “You should rest after you are done. It’s late.”
“Yes, Young Master.”
Dudian took Aisha and went into the temple. He took out the god’s marrow from the package and injected himself with three tubes. He stopped the injection after his body had a feeling of swelling. Then he put away the rest of the god’s marrow, he closed the temple and went back to his bed to rest.
Aisha sat quietly by his bed as he fell asleep. Her black eyes were silent as she looked at the Dark Hall.
Dudian woke up the next day. He washed up and enjoyed his breakfast. He was chewing and swallowing as he listened to Barton’s news. The outer wall had gradually calmed down. The Barbarians had secretly moved into the slums, although the news had been leaked out many times but it was blocked by the Dark Council and the military. The civilians didn’t know about it and no one cared about the changes in the barren land.
Moreover, the military had been consolidated by Richelieu and became the First Army of the Holy Church.
In addition, the Knight’s Temple, the magistrate, the nobles and other forces were gradually integrated under the influence of the Dark Council and the Holy Church. It was only a matter of time before they were completely unified.
There were many small incidents that happened in addition to these big picture problems.
“The temple of elements’Arsen has asked to see you and exchange knowledge with you.”Barton said to Dudian: “I think he wants to stay by my side.”
Dudian nodded slightly. Although he didn’t elaborate but he had some impression of the old man. He was one of the few people in the temple who had offended him, most of them were jealous that he had lived in the temple for a long time so they wanted to get a share of the spoils. After all, they were accompanying the pope. This honor was enough to make people envious.
“If he wants to talk about the exchange then let Edward do it.”Dudian said. The current master of the temple was a small figure in his eyes but he could use him as a whetstone for Edward.
“Alright.”Barton understood Dudian’s meaning: “Edward is still so young. Can you deal with him? Arsen is a master after all.”
“What master? He is just a person who knows the basics.”Dudian was very assured, “Heroes don’t care about youth. Some people take a year as a day. Some people take a day as a year. The only difference brought by age is that they are faced with marriage and children. The other differences are just the thoughts of growing up.”
Barton scratched his head: “I know.”
Dudian asked: “Is there any trace of the person who left us in the outer wall?”
“Is he the missionary who called himself the monastery in the inner wall?”Barton saw Dudian mention, “This person is strange. He didn’t go back to the inner wall after he left us. He was playing in various entertainment places. He drank in different pubs and was thrown out. I have sent people to keep an eye on him.”
Dudian was surprised: “Don’t disturb him. Let him be.”
“Yes.”Barton nodded.
Neuss woke up after breakfast and went to report to the temple. Dudian asked him to lead the way to the dungeon. He wanted to see the two war gods.
Dudian saw the two war gods again after they went through the dark underground tunnel. Although he was prepared but he still felt a trace of instinctive cruelty. Their hair was disheveled and their bodies were chained, there was a tinkling sound when they moved.
The heavy smell of blood was emitted from their bodies. The chains wrapped around their bodies were made of dried blood. Their bodies were riddled with scars. Their limbs were crippled and they were hanging on the rack, their breath was weak and their mouths were blocked. They couldn’t bite their tongues and beg for death.
It was obvious that no one had bathed them during the days they were imprisoned. The blood from the daily criminal law baptized their bodies over and over again. They became dry and hard like beggars.
“Sir!”
The two burly men who were on duty saw Neuss. They stood up and looked at Neuss with fear.
Neuss nodded: “Wake them up.”
“Yes!”The two men turned around and picked up the bucket next to them. Cold water was poured over their heads.
Both of them noticed Dudian who was standing in front of them. They struggled violently as they stared at Dudian, it was as if they wanted to kill him with their eyes.
Dudian pulled a chair and sat in front of them, “Are you willing to cooperate with me or are you willing to continue to suffer here?”? “You have suffered so much that the military might not know your loyalty. Even His Majesty Aristotle might not know. Why are you suffering?”
Both of them were angry.
Dudian slightly raised his hand.
Neuss understood and asked the two burly men to take out the gag from their mouths.
“You will die a horrible death!”Hiro roared in anger. His face was covered in blood.
Ronon looked at dudian: “I will curse you forever even if I go to hell!”
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows, “Are you so tough? As long as you lower your head you will be able to leave this place. You Won’t be in pain anymore. You will be able to sleep in a soft and comfortable bed. There will be beautiful women in your arms. You will be able to eat and drink well. Don’t you want to consider it?”
“Fuck you #% …”Hiro cursed.
Ronon’s character was gloomy. Although he didn’t speak but he looked at Dudian.
Dudian frowned as he looked at the two burly men: “How do you take care of them?”
Both of them were scared and didn’t know how to answer.
Neuss immediately shouted: “I asked you to ‘take care’of them every day. Didn’t you hear me?”
Both of their bodies trembled as they told Dudian about the torture. Dudian glanced at the props on the wall. Most of them were stained with blood, hiro and Ronon had tasted the pain of the torture instruments.
He shook his head: “It’s just physical pain. There is nothing to be afraid of.”
Neuss carefully asked: “Master, what do you mean?”
“Get the cigarettes that Richelieu likes. We will light five cigarettes every day.”Dudian said: “In addition, go to the prison and find one hundred strong men. You know how to do it.”
“Strong men?”Neuss was stunned: “One Hundred?”

chapters.title: Chapter 725
chapters.content:
Chapter 725 – : Chapter 715:12Th Earl [ Second Update ]
Hiro and Ronon’s face changed as they heard Dudian’s words. The anger in their eyes turned into fear. As the military god of the inner wall, their understanding of the prison environment was as clear as their own bedroom, naturally, they knew what Dudian meant. Moreover, they knew that this teenager was a person who would do anything.
“You, you!”Hiro was so angry that his body was trembling. His heart was about to explode. At this moment he wanted to use all his hatred to kill Dudian or pray to God that he would use all his life to kill Dudian, he couldn’t imagine what would happen when one hundred strong men arrived. As one of the ten military gods, would he suffer such a painful and undignified torture?
Even if Dudian said that torture would be doubled, he might not be afraid. But at this moment, he was afraid.
“How is it?”Dudian looked at the two and asked again.
Hiro’s face was ugly. He clenched his teeth. He was struggling in his mind.
Ronon was silent for a moment. He looked up: “I’m willing to cooperate with you.”
“Ronon, you!”Hiro looked at him in anger.
Ronon didn’t look at him but looked at dudian: “I’m willing to cooperate with you. I’m sincere. I can betray the military!”
Dudian indifferently said: “In that case, show me your sincerity. I want to know all the information you know about the military. I want to know the number of soldiers, strength, location of the military and so on. Of course, there is also the residence of the three commanders as well as their magic marks.”
“Don’t even think about it!”Hiro roared in anger.
Dudian stretched out a finger and slightly cut.
Neuss understood and winked at the two burly men. They immediately grabbed the plug and stuffed it into Hiro’s mouth. They used a rope to strangle his mouth so that he couldn’t spit it out.
Ronon listened to Hiro’s struggling voice. Although he could hear that he was trying to stop him but he didn’t turn his head. He whispered: “Can you let me out of here if I say it?”
“Yes.”
Ronon looked at him and took a deep breath: “Alright, I’ll Talk!”
Ten minutes later Dudian was satisfied with the information. Although he knew that the information might be false but at least it could be used as a reference.
“I won’t give you extra punishment because of your sincerity.”Dudian said to Neuss: “Give one hundred strong men to the strong God of War!”
Neuss bowed his head.
Hiro’s eyes were wide open as he looked at Dudian in fear. He shook his head as he tried to open his mouth to speak.
Dudian glanced at Ronon. He saw that there was no reaction from him and there was no change in his body. He turned around and left the dungeon. He didn’t ask Hiro to verify the information.
“Master, are you really going to let Ronon go? If he escapes from US and goes back to the inner wall then all the information you have will be useless.”Neuss carefully advised Dudian after they left the dungeon.
Dudian shook his head, “They are not ordinary people. They can not be subdued by intimidation. They have resentment in their hearts. As long as there is an opportunity to kick them when they are down, they will never miss it. How can I let a person who will kick me when I Am Down Be Free?”
Neuss agreed with Dudian’s style. He asked: “Master, do you plan to kill them? Anyway, they have already gotten what they know. There is no point in keeping them.”
“No, the living are more important than the dead.”Dudian tilted his head and looked at him, “You personally supervise this matter. I want to completely destroy their faith and destroy everything they stand for. Don’t blindly use torture. There are many things that are more unbearable than pain.”
Neuss saw the trace of blame in his eyes. He knew that Dudian wasn’t satisfied with his previous ‘care’. He didn’t ask what was the purpose of doing so, he immediately said: “I understand, young master.”
Dudian didn’t say anything more. Although Neuss was one of the trusted people around him. But occasionally he would whip him.
Time flew by.
In the blink of an eye a month had passed.
The original twenty-three cities in the inner wall had been reduced to twelve in a month. Almost half of them had been destroyed. All the survivors were sent by the military to live in the cleaned up cities. The main reason why there were twelve cities was that there was an earl in each of the twelve cities. The size of the cities was large enough to accommodate millions of refugees. The defensive force was very strong and there were pioneers in the cities, they were protected by the military so they didn’t suffer any losses in the chaos. On the contrary, they earned a lot of money.
Moreover, the drawings of the underground passage in the twelve cities were in the hands of the general manager of the Earl. Outsiders could only get some fragments of the drawings which were useless, therefore, Dudian’s poisoning didn’t involve the twelve cities.
It had caused the twelve cities to become the largest gathering place for the transportation of refugees. The refugees didn’t have nothing. Some of them were rich businessmen and other Viscounts and barons.
The plan to clean the undead was to restore the twelve cities to peace. However the streets were stained with blood.
The other eleven cities had been occupied by zombies. Other than zombies, there were also many animals bitten by zombies. All of them had mutated into bloodthirsty monsters and were extremely ferocious.
At the same time when the army began to recover, the monastery and the three great demon-hunter families had also actively sent out experts to surround the pioneer-level zombies that appeared in various places. Once the traces of these zombies were exposed.., they would immediately be hunted down by the military and even issued a sky-high bounty.
On the Saint Peak of Witcher Dragon Clan, Hathaway was practicing her spear techniques in the square while listening to the female officer’s report. At this moment, a figure rushed over from the square, it was the white-faced middle-aged man.
He looked at Hathaway who was practicing her spear techniques and reading the news. He slightly shook his head and sighed. However, this sigh was quickly covered. He came in front of Hathaway, he said, “You must have heard about what happened outside. Currently, six pioneers are wanted. The military doesn’t have enough pioneers. Dragon Mother asked you to act as a preparation for guarding the wasteland.”

chapters.title: Chapter 726
chapters.content:
Chapter 726 – Chapter 716: From One To The End
“You finally plan to let me guard the Wasteland?”Hathaway’s arm shook, and she put away the huge spear. She stood on the ground, causing the floor under her feet to tremble slightly. She looked at the white-faced middle-aged man, “Did dragon mother find a target to help me head to God Country?”
“Since she let you guard the wasteland, she naturally found a suitable target.”
“Hehe.”Hathaway lightly smiled and said, “In the heart of our Grandma Dragon Mother, she really puts the ‘big picture’First!”
“If not for that, she wouldn’t have let you live until now.”The white-faced middle-aged man said straightforwardly, “The wasteland isn’t that easy to guard. You saw it the last time you went to investigate. In the depths of red wasteland, terrifying monsters could jump out at any time to attack the stronghold. You have to go out and defend that place. Surviving there is completely dependent on luck. No matter how strong you are or how you plot, it’s meaningless.”
Hathaway didn’t think much of it and said, “Since it depends on luck, then there’s nothing to worry about. Anyway, worrying is useless.”
The white-faced middle-aged man was speechless.
“I’ve already told Dragon Mother about the chaos this time. It’s definitely the work of that stinky brat from the outer wall.”Hathaway changed the topic and looked at him with a thoughtful attitude, “Eleanor, who I sent to the outer wall, was infected into a zombie. I don’t believe that she was infected by other zombies. There aren’t many pioneer level zombies to begin with, and she’s been missing for so long. I think that the other pioneer level zombies might have been infected by her.”
“It’s so obvious. I don’t know why Mother Dragon doesn’t believe it. Didn’t the military send two war gods to the outer wall? They’ve been missing for so long. Isn’t that enough to explain the problem?”? “This virus is clearly the work of the outer wall. It caused chaos in our inner wall, so we don’t have time to care about them. Humph, this must be the attention of that little brat. He’s very evil and will do anything.”
“However, my sister actually agreed. I really underestimated her.”
The white-faced middle-aged man shook his head slightly, “Currently, we are still unable to confirm whether that person is your sister or not.”. As for the virus, Dragon mother should have her own thoughts. Right now, the inner wall region is in chaos. Although the monasteries, the military, and the Witcher family have all helped to suppress the undeads, no one knows which family is behind this virus. Now that His Majesty Aristotle has gone to the divine kingdom, it is a sensitive period. Even if dragon mother has evidence that the virus came from the outer wall region, she will not easily take it out.”
Hathaway revealed a contemptuous smile and said: “Because of this, after hundreds of years, we humans still live in the giant wall and can’t walk out of it!”
“Such a wall exists in everyone’s heart.”The white-faced middle-aged man lightly sighed, “The people inside the wall yearn to get out, and the people outside the wall yearn to get in. They build walls in their hearts to protect themselves and also imprison themselves. However, they can’t blame anyone for doing this. They can only blame the outside world for being too dangerous. If we leave the giant wall, we won’t even have a home.”
Hathaway’s eyes flashed with a different light, and she said: “When we become Abyss walkers, we can freely travel to the world outside the giant wall. There is no place that can stop us!”
The white-faced middle-aged man glanced at her and shook his head: “This is too far away. We don’t have the abyss formula in the giant wall. If you want to become an Abyss Walker, it is almost impossible unless your bloodline awakens seven degrees.”
Hathaway didn’t think much of it, “Seven times it is. Take it slowly, you will reach it sooner or later.”
The white-faced middle-aged man smiled bitterly, but didn’t refute her. Although he knew clearly that even the talented Aisha, who had awakened once from birth, might not be able to complete the seventh awakening in her lifetime. After all.., in history, the ancestor of the Dragon Clan who had awakened six times was even more talented. Not only was he born to awaken, he had already awakened three times before the age of ten. But for the rest of his life, he had barely reached the level of sixth awakening, he couldn’t go any further!
“This time, going to hunt down the pioneer level undeads is also an opportunity.”Hathaway said thoughtfully: “They didn’t take the outer wall seriously and didn’t pay attention to it for the time being. However, they didn’t know that a sinister little devil was growing there. I will never let him succeed. They want to take advantage of the chaos in the inner wall to take a breather. Humph, they underestimate me too much!”
The white-faced middle-aged man frowned and said, “Miss, what are you trying to do?”
“To encircle and annihilate the pioneer level zombies!”
“But…”
“They didn’t say where to encircle and annihilate the zombies, right? Besides, if the zombies run to the outer wall, as a duty, we should chase after them to prevent them from harming the innocent civilians in the outer wall, right?”
”…”
Deep inside the main peak of the Dragon Clan, in a cave that looked like a natural karst cave, the walls were red and filled with hot air waves. The temperature in the air was extremely high. The rock wall on the inner side was like the skin of a living creature, densely covered with crimson veins.., a bright red liquid that looked like blood was flowing inside, like magma, slowly flowing into the ground and converging into the huge rock pool in the middle of the cave.
There was a snow-white color in the monotonous color of the rock pool. It was a beautiful woman with skin as smooth as cream. She wore a bright golden laurel crown and was elegant. She quietly closed her eyes and sank into the rock pool. White mist surrounded her body, covering her face and making her faintly visible.
At this time, an old woman carrying a lantern came from the dark tunnel outside the cave. When she came to the outside of the rock pool, she immediately stopped. Her white, withered hair immediately curled in the heat wave. Sweat oozed out from her forehead and immediately evaporated, she said respectfully, “Miss, there’s a reply on that matter. The person in the outer wall is indeed Miss Aisha. However, her condition doesn’t seem to be right. She seems to have been infected with a virus and became a zombie.”
The beautiful woman in the rock pool opened her eyes slightly, revealing a pair of lake-like calm and deep eyes. She slowly said, “Did he go to see it personally?”
“Yes.”The old woman lowered her head and said, “Carreen also said that Miss Aisha seemed to be under the control of others and listened to the words of a young man. However, this young man treated Miss Aisha very politely and respectfully.”
The beautiful woman’s eyes were as calm as the surface of a lake. There was not a trace of Poland in them. She said, “Let carreen kill him and bring Aisha back.”
Hearing this, the old woman’s face had a strange look, she said, “Miss, when Kerrijin replied, he also said that if you want him to assassinate this youth, he can’t do it. I hope you can forgive him. He said that his strength is weak and that he might not be able to kill this youth. Instead, he will kill him when Miss Aisha reacts.”
The beautiful woman frowned slightly and said, “He is ranked third on the assassin list. He can’t even kill a Youth?”
The old woman smiled bitterly, “I asked him about that too. He said that this young man’s strength is close to that of the ten war gods, and that he is extraordinary. Besides that, he is very cautious. Other than Miss Aisha, even his most trusted subordinates can’t take the initiative to get close to him.”
“Oh?”The Beautiful Woman’s eyes had a trace of fluctuation as she said, “What’s the background of this young man?”
Even the youngest person who could match the Ten Great War Gods was in his early twenties. Only a genius like Aisha with a large background and resources could reach the peak of the outer wilderness when she was young.
“I heard from Miss Hathaway that this young man is the poor boy from the outer wall who caused Miss Aisha to lose her position as a saintess. He was born in the dust, and even in the outer wall, he is the lowest class of commoners.”The old woman felt a bit strange when she said it, “After he joined our Dragon Clan’s Dragon Guard, he obtained resources and became a limiter. I didn’t expect that he would become a pioneer in such a short period of time, and he is also a powerhouse close to the Ten Great War Gods. I’m afraid that this kid has a lot of secrets, and he has a big figure backing him up.”
The beautiful woman lowered her eyebrows, and after a moment, she said, “Investigate his identity clearly.”
“Yes, miss.”
The old woman agreed. Seeing that she did not speak anymore, she said carefully, “Miss, since Carrey Jin is unable to do it, should we send the person who is ranked first on the assassin list?”
The beautiful woman closed her eyes slightly. Her lips moved slightly, but her voice was very calm, she said, “No need. Even the person who is ranked first on the assassin list can only barely assassinate the war god. He is an executioner groomed by the winged race. He will not work for us.”
The old woman came to her senses and said, “That’s true. It looks like we’ll have to send out a true expert.”
“We’ll discuss this matter in the future.”The beautiful woman didn’t want to say anything more.
The old woman glanced at her and realized that she didn’t have any killing intent at the moment. It seemed like she was planning to investigate this youth’s background before saying anything else. She immediately took her leave and prepared to do it right away. At the same time, she also wanted to leave this hot place as soon as possible.
Two figures flashed in the square of St. Mark’s Square on top of Uto Mountain. From time to time they would collide with each other. The swords in their hands were clanging. They were two wooden swords.
Dudian’s hands were holding two wooden swords. He fiercely hacked and hacked. The slender figure was forced to retreat. The girl was Aurora.
After a month of training, Riley had taught her a lot of swordsmanship. After the injection of God’s blessing, her physique had reached the level of a primary hunter. It wasn’t that Dudian wanted to save resources but if he was willing.., he could even train her to the level of a borderline within this month. However, it wasn’t a good thing to have a high physique. Especially for the initial stage of combat training, just a basic skill required repeated practice.
The real training of the basic skills was not only to modify the posture of the body but also to train the willpower.
The stronger the body, the harder it was to train the willpower.
If one trained hard in times of weakness, the willpower would be as hard as steel!
In addition there was another reason. If there was no parasitic soul worm, the god’s blessing could only upgrade the body to the hunter level.
“Clang”
The wooden sword in Aurora’s hand was sent flying. Her wrist was red as it was cut by Dudian’s wooden sword.
Aurora’s face turned ugly as she saw the wooden sword flying out. She bit her lower lip and picked up the wooden sword. She used her swollen hand to hold onto it. She turned her head to look at Dudian.
Dudian put away the two knives and took the towel from Neuss. He wiped his sweat: “Let Riley accompany you to practice. I will tell him later that there is no need to show mercy.”
Aurora clenched her wooden sword and didn’t speak.
Dudian looked at her but didn’t comfort her. He shook his head and went back to the temple. Today he was interested in testing Aurora’s level. The result was a bit surprising. Although he was disappointed in the end.., but he was very surprised. In a short month of training, Aurora’s fighting ability was comparable to most hunters. It was incredible!
It was not an exaggeration to say that she was a combat genius!
Such an astonishing rate of improvement made him feel a little ashamed. He thought about it for so many years. Although his physique had improved by leaps and bounds, the rate of improvement in his combat ability was not very fast. Other than archery, which could be used.., close combat combat skills appeared to be somewhat weak.
In fact, he knew that this was also something that he could do nothing about. At the beginning, he trained hard in archery and made astonishing progress in archery. However, after he was imprisoned, his archery skills did not have any environment to practice in. Gradually, he neglected it. As a result, after he was released from prison.., he could only rely on his strengthened physique to slowly restore his archery skills to their original level. However, that level was not high either. It was only at the level of a hunter.
Later on, he obtained the Dragon Clan’s Dragon Thorn chapter, which recorded most of the various spear techniques. He practiced according to it for a period of time and made some progress in his spear techniques. He also figured out his own spear techniques, as a result, his physique had increased sharply. He had mastered the complete body of the splitter and turned his whole body into a sharp blade. His fighting style was more saber-like. As a result, he had to use his training saber to enhance his fighting ability behind the demon.
When he changed his fighting style repeatedly, his fighting style became weaker. At least, it could not be compared with other pioneers. When he was helping the male corpse in the inner wall.., he had been broken by a pioneer whose physique was obviously lower than his. He had almost let him escape. If his fighting style could be consistent.., he felt that his archery skills could be considered as one of the best in the inner wall.
If he could adhere to the training of firearms, he would be able to upgrade his marksmanship to the level of a pioneer. At least he would be able to match the marksmanship of the Pioneer.
“I can’t afford too many delays and detours in my short life…”Dudian sighed in his heart. He had decided that he would continue to train in knife training and make sure to upgrade it to the same level as other pioneers.
Fortunately, he had been training and sculpting with his right hand over the years. He had a deep understanding of the flexibility of the body and the clever use of strength. He felt that this understanding of the movement of power was the foundation of combat, no matter what weapon it was.., it was just the appearance of the weapon. But the skill of using power could be applied to all kinds of moves. As long as he could master the way of using power of different weapons.
“It has been more than a month. The chaos in the inner wall hasn’t subsided. The efficiency is slower than I thought.”Dudian looked outside the temple. He asked Neuss to call the informant in the inner wall, he asked about the progress of the things he had arranged.

chapters.title: Chapter 727
chapters.content:
Chapter 727 – Chapter 717: Demon Chariot [ Two In One Chapter ]
“According to your plan, we have infiltrated the cities of the 12th Earl in the inner wall. We have secretly bribed the civilians in the inner wall to spread the rumors. At present, nine of the cities have been burned by the rumors. The people in the other three cities have been found out and killed. However, they haven’t been traced back to us…”
A short middle-aged man reported to Dudian.
Dudian nodded slightly, “Tell them that the chaos is caused by the Monster Institute. The military and the monastery are accomplices. It is just a conspiracy for them to shelter the refugees. They will be secretly caught and dissected at any time. If necessary, let the people over there create several ‘experimental accidents’for the people in the shelter to see. Pay attention to the hidden identity.”
The middle-aged man bowed his head: “Yes, Chairman.”
“Go.”
Dudian waved his hand to dismiss the middle-aged man. Both the middle-aged man and the people working for him in the inner wall were elites who had been selected from the dark church. They had been working for the dark church for a long time. Although they weren’t strong but they were hunters, however they were cunning and cruel. It was appropriate for them to do this kind of thing.
He chose people different from others. He only focused on temperament. Strength was the second choice.
Although he didn’t have many trusted aides but there were many people who worked for him.
After the middle-aged man left, neuss said to dudian: “Master, the gunpowder produced by the alchemist camp has been buried in the wall of Sighs. However the current amount is only enough to destroy a small gap in the wall of Sighs.”
“Let them seize the time and continue to produce.”Dudian said. The Dark Church had been integrated into six divisions. The top alchemists from the twelve divisions formed the alchemist camp, the potioneers formed the potioneers camp. They were his two sharp swords to deal with the upcoming war.
“Master, we have almost dug out the saltpeter mines. The rest of the saltpeter mines are in the hands of the nobles. Should we buy them from them?”Neuss knew that Dudian was very serious about this matter, “What if they don’t agree to the acquisition?”
“Then let them agree.”Dudian’s answer was very simple.
Neuss understood his meaning. He nodded and didn’t say anything else. With Dudian’s permission, he was able to do things freely.
Dudian went to the dungeon after he finished explaining things. He looked at Hiro and Ronon who were on the verge of death. The two of them looked more miserable than the last time he saw them. They were naked and their armors had been stripped off, there was only blood on their bodies. Their hair was messy and their heads were drooping. They looked like dead bodies hanging on the chains.
There were hundreds of burly men living in the cell next to the dungeon. They were all from the military and Thorn Flower Prison. More than half of them were lascivious criminals, however most of their targets were beautiful women and children. There were even some who liked old women and children. There were only a few who liked men.
Dudian had just arrived at the dungeon when he smelled the strong smell of semen in the air. It wasn’t the authentic old era cigarettes but a special kind of cigarettes made from poison, both of them had been passively addicted to drugs during this period of time.
“Have you taken care of them today?”Dudian asked.
The two men in charge of the execution were trembling in fear: “Not yet.”
“Then what are you waiting for?”
Both of them replied: “Yes, my Lord.”They took out the instruments of torture and whipped them.
Both of them woke up and screamed like frightened mice. Their messy hair covered their eyes which were full of fear and pleading, hiro shouted: “Don’t hit… Don’t hit…”
Both of them lashed out one whip after another.
Dudian quietly looked at them. After a while he raised his hand to signal them to stop. He came in front of them: “What do you think?”
Hiro heard Dudian’s voice and stopped screaming. He looked up at him but there was no hatred or resentment in his eyes, “Please kill me! Please! I’m willing to do anything! Please kill me!”
Dudian raised his hand to touch Hiro’s hair but found that his hair was stuck in bundles. He retracted his hand, he calmly said: “If I Kill You Then my efforts will be in vain. Are you two willing to fight for me?”
“I’m willing! I’m Willing!”
Hiro shouted as he heard Dudian’s words. It seemed that he didn’t hesitate at all.
Ronon said: “I’m willing as long as you let us leave this place. I’m willing to help you kill the people of the military!”Although his expression was calm but his words were very serious, there was a trace of urgency and desire in his eyes.
Dudian didn’t expect that the time was so short to torture their consciousness to such a fragile state. It seemed that drugs and dignity were enough to completely destroy a person! In other words, either one of the two could completely defeat a person!
He had long been aware of the concept that people were fragile. Whether they were hunters or pioneers, they were equally deadly in soft places.
“In that case, you will cooperate with me to complete an experiment. You will be by my side from now on.”Dudian said.
Hiro’s body slightly trembled as he heard Dudian’s words. Tears flowed out of his eyes. He looked like he was crying because of joy. However, there was a sense of sadness and despair in his eyes.
Ronon was silent as he lowered his head.
Dudian asked the supervisor to untie the shackles of the two and take them to wash their bodies.
After a moment they changed into a set of clean clothes. Dudian took them to the side hall at the top of the mountain. It was his own alchemy laboratory.
There were many strange materials inside. The largest object was a metal war chariot in the center of the laboratory. The dark body of the war chariot exuded an ancient aura, there were sharp spikes protruding from the outer rim of the war chariot. The spikes were different in length and curvature. If one looked carefully they would find that they were the horns of unknown monsters!
The base of the war chariot was connected to several dark ropes which were hanging upside down on the war chariot.
Dudian came to the war chariot. He asked Noyce to carry Hiro who had his hamstrings crippled. He put on sterile gloves and took out a scalpel. He pressed on Hiro’s head, he whispered: “It’s a bit painful. Bear with it.”
Hiro’s voice trembled: “What… What are you going to do?”
“It’s just a small experiment.”Dudian took anesthetic from the side and injected it into his back. He cut his back. The scalpel rotated between his fingers as if it was sculpting a piece of art, he cut the layers of silk from Hiro’s back. Soon, the skin on his back was completely peeled to both sides. The flesh was rolled up to reveal a centipede-like long back.
Dudian narrowed his eyes as he took out the chain hanging on the chariot. With the cooperation of the scalpel, he slowly inserted the chain into his back. After half an hour, the operation was completed.
Hiro’s back had been sewn up. The thread on the surface of the skin was extremely neat. It looked like an excellent tailor’s clothing. However there was a chain protruding from the skin of the cervical vertebrae. The chain went deep into his flesh.
Dudian took healing powder from the side and smeared it on his back. He took out two small red pills and put them into his mouth: “Eat it.”
Hiro hesitated but didn’t dare to resist. He licked his mouth and swallowed them. He didn’t dare to pretend.
After taking the healing powder, the wounds on Hiro’s body healed quickly. Especially the wounds on his back. He could see that the flesh was slowly sticking together and new flesh was growing out of the gaps.
Dudian estimated that his wounds would heal completely. At least three hours later. The healing powder was made by the top pharmacist and it was also due to his own self-healing ability.
Three hours passed by quickly. During this time Dudian was fiddling with the chariot. He removed the thread on Hiro’s back and asked him to stand up: “Take Two Steps.”
Hiro walked down the experimental platform. At the moment his hamstrings and tendons had healed. Perhaps it was because he hadn’t walked for a long time. His walking posture was a bit unfamiliar. Every step he took made a tinkling sound.
Hiro looked back and was stunned. The chains on his back were connected to the bottom of the chariot. He was like a horse tied to the chariot.
“From now on, this is your nest.”Dudian said to him: “Try to see if you can pull my chariot.”
Hiro turned his head to look at him. Suddenly two lines of tears flowed out. He roared in grief and anger as he punched the test bench. He was like an angry beast as he rushed towards Dudian!
Dudian’s eyes were cold. He kicked Hiro’s chest and sent him flying.
Although Hiro was at the peak of the wilderness level but he had been imprisoned for many days. He was seriously injured and his limbs had just recovered. His strength wasn’t as good as before so he was directly knocked down by Dudian.
Dudian stomped his feet and jumped onto the chariot. He put his hands on the metal table and hit one of the buttons.
“Ah! !”Hiro was convulsing on the ground as he jumped onto the shore.
Dudian hit the button again. He looked at Hiro: “You have no choice unless you want to go back to the previous days.”
Hiro stopped convulsing and panted. His hands were still trembling. He stood up and looked at the youth on the chariot. His eyes were full of hatred but there was more fear in them, he shouted: “Then let me go back to the days before. I would rather stay in the dungeon than be your slave!”
“Didn’t you say that you are willing to do anything?”Dudian said in a light tone: “You have to keep your word.”
Hiro’s heart was filled with grief. He thought that Dudian wanted him to fight for Dudian. If that was the case then he would have a way to escape and return to the inner wall. But Dudian had tied him to such a chariot. It was obvious that Dudian intended to enslave him forever until he died!
He would rather return to the dark days of Hell and give up his dignity!
“You, You Devil!”Hiro wanted to cry but he couldn’t. He had hated him so much that he was numb to it. There was only regret in his heart. Why did he come to the outer wall, he wanted to enter the temple!
Dudian indifferently said: “The experiment has been completed. It is impossible for you to go back to the old days. But as long as you listen to me and fight for me, you can at least survive. If you still hate me, you would rather be humiliated than to work for me. I can only make you take off your clothes and pull the chariot to go around the inner wall. Your family, your lover, your children or your parents will see your appearance. Oh right, there should be no need for your penis to exist.”
“You! !”Hiro’s hair stood up in anger. He was like a berserk beast as he stared at Dudian. However Dudian didn’t care about him. Hiro wished that he could kill Dudian with his eyes. If his will could kill Dudian then he would have destroyed him. But he stared at him for a long time but nothing happened, but his eyes were more dry than before.
His heart was full of bitterness. The hatred slowly faded away. Just like a person who couldn’t maintain a happy mood for a long time, he couldn’t fall into a frenzy for a long time. The hatred and anger were like the waves, rolling to the climax, then it gradually faded away and gradually subsided.
He once again deeply experienced what it meant to live a life worse than death. He also knew what it meant to be happy at this time because there would be worse situations in the future.
He suddenly felt that his days in the dungeon were nothing — if Dudian really wanted to castrate him and expose his ugly behavior in front of his loved ones.
“It’s also a kind of courage to accept fate. What do you think?”Dudian said.
Hiro lowered his head. He was so sad that he couldn’t cry. He squatted on the ground.
Dudian looked at Ronon who was sitting in the corner: “It’s your turn.”
Ronon’s face was ugly. His fingers were tightly clenched into fists. He wanted to commit suicide but it was difficult for him to do so. His heart was full of fear.
Dudian saw the struggle in Ronon’s eyes. His expression was calm. After the humiliation and torture, their willpower was no longer comparable to the past. They were even more fragile than ordinary people. It took courage to commit suicide, hope was an evil thing. As long as people saw a glimmer of hope, even if they knew that there was a greater possibility of facing a worse situation, they would still yearn for that glimmer of hope.
Dudian was very clear about this so he wasn’t afraid of his self-destruction.

chapters.title: Chapter 728
chapters.content:
Chapter 728 – Chapter 718: Hathaway’S Personal Visit [ First Update ]
Dudian picked up Ronon and threw him onto another experimental table. Ronon didn’t resist. He closed his eyes in pain and continued to struggle mentally.
Dudian drugged him and took the scalpel. He skillfully cut through the skin on his back. After his back was exposed, he took the chain from the next chariot, he wrapped the chains around his spine and began to sew.
The whole process was very smooth. Hiro squatted on the ground and saw that Ronon didn’t make a sound. His eyes were filled with sadness. He couldn’t help but lower his head and sob like a wronged child.
After the surgery Dudian wiped his hands and said to the two: “When I become the Master of the inner wall I will return your freedom and your family will be safe.”
Both of them were silent as if they had accepted their fate.
Dudian left the temple and asked Neuss to send food to them. He tied them to the chariot. He wasn’t worried that they would resist or escape. He only hoped that they would recover their strength as soon as possible.
Another Day passed in the blink of an eye.
The next morning, Dudian finished his breakfast and was about to ask about the situation in the inner wall. Neuss suddenly rushed into the temple, he looked at dudian: “Master, there is news from the Watchtower. It seems that someone is coming out from the inner wall!”
Dudian’s heart was cold. He built watchtowers which could transmit the situation of the wall of sighs in real time. Each watchtower was equipped with the latest ten times telescope, the people on duty in the Watchtower were hunters with vision perception. Their range of vision was about five kilometers. Although the distance between the watchtower and the wall of sighs couldn’t be compared to the distance of the mountain but there wasn’t one watchtower, there were more than a dozen watchtowers, just like the beacon towers in ancient China. When the watchtower closest to the wall of sighs saw the enemy, it would immediately make a sign. The second watchtower would constantly monitor the first Watchtower’s sign, then, it would give out the information. Under such layers of transmission, he would be able to receive the latest information at the same time.
Since Noyce was reporting to him now, it meant that the people from the inner wall had just passed through the wall of Sighs.
“What is the specific information?”He asked immediately.
He was worried that the inner wall would react and launch a large-scale attack.
“The news said that there are twelve people riding two giant eagles.”Neuss quickly said.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. Twelve people? ! Could it be twelve pioneers? !
“Get ready immediately and start the first level defense plan!”Dudian quickly made a decision. He wasn’t worried about the possibility of twelve pioneers, but if the possibility was true, then it meant that there were twelve people.., most likely there would be a leader from the inner wilderness level. This was the biggest threat!
“Yes!”Neuss immediately turned and ran.
Dudian estimated the flying speed of the giant eagle. He knew that they had at most three minutes to prepare. He rushed out of the temple and went to the side hall. He took out some bottles of medicine from the cabinet, two of the bottles were filled with powder. He poured it onto Hiro and Luonan who were leaning against the war chariot.
Both of them were puzzled but they quickly recognized that the powder was used to cover the smell. Hiro asked: “Are there people from the inner wall?”
Dudian replied: “There are more than ten people riding the giant eagle. They should be from your military.”
Hiro and Lonon looked at each other with complicated expressions.
Dudian took two masks from the side and threw them to them, he said: “Later you will have to help me fight. If it doesn’t work then we will have to escape back to the temple. There is a secret passage under the temple which leads to the bottom of the mountain. I will give you a hand gesture. You will follow me back to the temple.”
Both of them looked at each other in silence.
They slowly put the masks on their heads.
Dudian took out another bottle from the cabinet. He took out three purple pills. He swallowed one and threw the other two to Hiro and Ronon, “Eat it first. This is the antidote.”
Both of them saw Dudian eat it. It was easy for Dudian to kill them. However they knew that Dudian would use poison to attack them in the next battle!
Insidious Kid!
Both of them thought in their hearts.
“He is coming!”Dudian looked up at the sky and rushed out of the side hall.
Hiro and Ronon were shocked as they looked at Dudian’s eyes. After a moment they saw two huge black shadows flying over from the sky. Both of them were shocked as their perception was one step behind Dudian’s! They were at the peak of the wilderness. Although they weren’t good at perception but they weren’t inferior to the ordinary perceptive pioneers.
They looked at the thin back of the youth who was standing at the door. They suddenly felt a trace of coldness. The youth was more terrifying than they had imagined. He wasn’t just a schemer!
They didn’t know that Dudian didn’t sense the arrival of the enemy. He calculated that they were almost there through the flying time of the giant eagles.
“Sure enough, there are two giant Eagles!”Dudian squinted his eyes as he saw the two huge black spots in the sky. He knew that the information was correct. It meant that there were twelve people standing on top of them. Moreover, they were most likely pioneers!
It was such a big move to send twelve pioneers to kill him!
There were only seven or eight pioneers guarding the fortresses in the wasteland all year round!
Dudian’s eyes were cold as he clenched his fists. He didn’t expect that the war would come so soon. Moreover, the momentum of the war was as fast as lightning!
As the distance closed, Dudian gradually saw the figures on the back of the giant eagle. There were exactly twelve of them. They were all pioneers!
The last hope in his heart was lost. The worse news was that three of the heat source figures were stronger than the other ten pioneers. They were comparable to Hiro and Ronon!
“Do I have to ask her to help?”Dean thought of Aisha. This was his last life-saving charm. From the current situation, if Aisha took action, it would not be difficult to solve the crisis, however, Aisha had to enter the magic body state to deal with so many people. Once she lost control and went berserk, it would be difficult to control. Moreover, what worried him the most was that if she went all out.., she might be like the male corpse. Her body would mutate into new tissues and she would never be able to return to the appearance of a human.
Suddenly, his pupils shrank and two murderous auras shot out from his eyes. He looked directly at the person on the back of one of the giant eagles. This person was one of the three strongest heat sources, she was wearing a set of green soft armor and holding a giant spear. She was absolutely beautiful. She was the face that he would never forget in his life. She was also the face that he hated to the bone!
Hathaway!
It was her! She came personally!
Dudian was waiting for the right time to personally kill the Dragon Clan. He didn’t expect that she would come to the outer wall and take the initiative to come in front of him!
He clenched his fingers so tightly that his bones were cracking. The silent killing intent in his body exploded like a flood. His eyes bulged and his pupils were hot. Every pore on his body was bulging and spurting out hot air, every strand of hair seemed to stand on end and explode!
Die! Die! Die!
His mind was filled with violent thoughts of destruction. The entire world was gone in his eyes. There was only the beautiful young girl in jade-green soft armor and her beautiful hair that fluttered in the wind with a relaxed expression, it made the hatred in his heart surge to the top of his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 729
chapters.content:
Chapter 729 – Chapter 719: Violent Fist -Lsecondcwatchatch ]
At this time, Hathaway seemed to have noticed dudian. Her watery eyes slightly moved as she looked down. Her eyes met Dudian’s murderous eyes.
At this moment, both of them were looking at each other. It seemed that the space between them didn’t exist.
The corner of her mouth slightly curved up.
The brutal aura in Dudian’s eyes intensified. The strong killing intent made his delicate face contort as he stared at her.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The giant eagles flapped their wings and the whistling sound was gradually heard. Two Giant Eagles flew over the square in the blink of an eye. They were like two pieces of dark clouds that covered the morning sun and reflected two huge shadows on the square.
The Knights of light who were stationed outside the square looked up at the scene. Their mouths were wide open.
Barton who had just eaten breakfast was ready to greet dudian. He stood in the corridor and looked up at the two eagles. He could even see the sharp claws of the Eagles. They were as sharp as iron hooks.
The Eagles landed. The wind blew in the square as dust swept towards Dudian.
Dudian stared at Hathaway who was standing on the head of the Eagle. Her appearance was exactly the same as what he had seen at the beginning. Her green soft armor was her favorite color.
There was a harmless smile on her face. It was as if she was meeting an old acquaintance.
Dudian’s killing intent couldn’t be controlled and made him mad. However his mind was calm. His face was still angry and ferocious.
Hathaway looked at Dudian’s appearance. She covered her mouth and laughed: “You look so fierce. Are you going to eat me?”
Dudian gritted his teeth: “Your Meat has rotted. I will only marinate you and feed you to the dogs!”
“Shut up!”A giant eagle shouted from the side. It was a young man in armor, he angrily scolded dudian: “Who do you think you are? How dare you talk to Her Highness. Do you know who she is? Kowtow to her three times and apologize. Otherwise I will make your head fall to the ground!”
Dudian looked at him with gloomy eyes: “What are you? Master didn’t say anything and you are screaming!”
“You are courting death!”The youth was furious. He jumped from the body of the giant eagle and flew like a ROC. He landed on the ground and rushed towards Dudian like a sharp sword. He put his palm behind his back, the palm behind his back suddenly took out a sharp sword and stabbed towards Dudian’s throat.
“Get lost!”Dudian couldn’t suppress the killing intent in his heart. He roared as anger burst out from his heart. The bones on his arm protruded as he punched out.
Bang! !
The Fist and the sword collided. The sharp sword pierced into the fist. The fist followed the blade until it hit the hilt of the sword.
The anger in the youth’s eyes disappeared. He found that his sword was frozen and couldn’t move!
At the same time, Dudian’s other fist came over and hit his face. The sound of bones breaking sounded. The youth’s body flew out and hit the ground. He slid for dozens of meters, he rolled to the front of the giant eagle’s claw. There was no sound. There was a huge hole in his face!
Dudian retracted his fist. A 20 cm long white bone thorn protruded from his fist and slowly retracted back into his body. The Sword in his other fist was released, the sword didn’t Pierce into his fist but went through the gap between his fingers. It only cut his arm. He used his fingers to clamp the sword and fix it.
Everyone on the giant eagle looked at the scene that happened in a flash. It wasn’t until the young man hit the eagle’s claw that they reacted. They were stunned and in disbelief.
This young man was a pioneer. How could he be killed by a single punch? !
Everyone’s eyes were no longer calm as they looked at dudian. Although the young man didn’t use his magic body and was careless, but Dudian was able to kill him. It was enough to prove that he was a pioneer!
However, from the heat source of Dudian’s body, he was only a primary limiter.
Hathaway was also surprised. She remembered that when she met Dudian outside the giant wall, Dudian was just a small hunter. Later he was sent to the Dragon Clan and became a dragon guard. He was nurtured by resources and was only a limiter, she didn’t expect that when they met again, Dudian would become a pioneer. He was on the same level as her!
“Your Highness, is this the traitor who disturbed the outer wall?”A slim woman asked Hathaway.
Hathaway nodded slightly, “Your monastery should have mentioned that the military is aware that the outer wall has been occupied by someone who wants to establish himself as a king. Moreover he has something to do with the recent outbreak of corpse poison in the inner wall. Our Dragon Clan has evidence that the corpse poison is likely to be controlled by him. This person must be eliminated. However, it is not that simple here. There should be other experts in charge besides him. Everyone be careful and don’t underestimate the enemy!”
“That’s right. I heard that our military sent two war gods here, but they haven’t returned to the inner wall yet. It’s probably a disaster. Everyone should be careful.”A burly middle-aged man said in a deep voice, the armor on his body had a special cross-shaped sword pattern. It was an armor made by the military.
Hearing his words, the others were surprised. They didn’t expect the two war gods of the military to die here.
They suddenly understood why Hathaway would invite so many pioneers to come to such a barren place.
“I can’t feel any other strong people except him. He should be good at hiding.”A young man with burn marks said. One of his eyes was purple and flickered with a strange light.
Hathaway looked around. Her eyes suddenly fell on the temple. She narrowed her eyes and said to dudian: “My Sister is in there right? I can feel it. Tell her not to hide.”
Dudian coldly stared at him. He was a bit surprised. He didn’t think that she would be able to sense Aisha. Even pioneers who were good at perception might not be able to sense Aisha’s current state, just like the young man who had a burn on his face.
“If you want to see, why don’t you go in and take a look? Are You Afraid of your sister?”Dudian stared at her.
Hathaway frowned and the smile on her face disappeared, she sneered: “She should be afraid of me. She betrayed our Dragon Clan for a stinky man like you. She was stripped of her identity as a saintess by the dragon mother. Now she is fooling around with you in the outer wall. She wants to occupy the outer wall and live a happy life here. HMPH!”

chapters.title: Chapter 730
chapters.content:
Chapter 730 – : Chapter 720: Fierce Battle
“If you didn’t attack your sister in the Wasteland, your sister wouldn’t have been injured by the king of Corpses!”Dudian didn’t continue her words, he was angry: “Since you are here today, don’t think about leaving!”
Hathaway frowned and subconsciously looked at the temple. She had taken a big risk to come here today. After all, her sister’s strength was several times stronger than hers. Although she didn’t want to admit it.., but the fact was that she couldn’t change it. For this reason, she specially called the pioneers of the other extermination teams and prepared to join hands to kill her.
She believed that without the blood baron, her sister couldn’t enter the demonic body state and her strength was greatly reduced. She might not be able to defeat her. Moreover, there were two pioneers at the peak of the outer wilderness helping her. They had a high chance of killing Aisha together!
However, this plan was good but they couldn’t be careless.
Aisha hadn’t shown up since she appeared. But her feeling wasn’t wrong. Aisha was in the temple!
Was she going to attack unexpectedly? Hathaway narrowed her eyes. She didn’t dare to act rashly, she looked at a bald middle-aged man: “Magic Scorpion God, you will deal with the scumbag who has disturbed the rules of the outer wall. We will attack together after we have dealt with him.”
“No problem.”The bald middle-aged man agreed without thinking. Although Dudian had killed the pioneer with one punch, but people could see that it was the youth who was careless, he was caught off guard and killed by Dudian. The strength that Dudian had shown was only at the level of an ordinary pioneer. He could kill him with a raise of his hand!
“Are you sure that Aisha is really there?”Another old man in a black robe asked. He had an imposing bearing. His cheekbones were extremely protruding and his eyes were full of cold killing intent, there was a symbol of the monastery on the chest of the robe.
Hathaway nodded slightly, “There is no mistake. I can feel that she is there. It is definitely her!”
“In that case, don’t be careless. Aisha has been the SAINTESS for many years, and her strength is extraordinary. It’s said that her bloodline power has been awakened many times, but I don’t know how many times it has been awakened.”The black-robed old man said to the end, he looked at Hathaway.
“Third Awakening.”Hathaway said.
Hiss!
Everyone sucked in a breath of cold air. Shock appeared in their eyes, followed by solemnity.
“Everyone, don’t worry. I’ve already said that my sister’s Witcher, Blood Jue, is in my hands. She can’t enter her demon body state. Moreover, she hasn’t shown up yet. She probably doesn’t have the confidence to fight US head on!”Hathaway encouraged.
Everyone looked at each other. Although they knew what Hathaway was thinking, they still agreed with her words.
“Then let’s kill this kid first and then open the temple!”
“That’s right, let’s get rid of one first!”
They quickly made a decision. The bald middle-aged man waved his hand and four people flew out from the back of the giant eagle. They jumped onto the square and stared at Dudian with hostile expressions, the weapons on their bodies quickly softened. It was as if there was a living mucus covering their bodies. One by one, they entered the magic body state without the slightest bit of carelessness, they didn’t give Dudian any chance.
They were pioneers. Four against one was enough to crush them!
At this time, the sound of an eagle echoed from the back of the mountain.
The bald middle-aged man looked up. His face slightly changed: “Is this the voice of the Dragon Eagle?”
He suddenly thought of something. His face changed as he stared at dudian: “Hiro and Ronon have come. Where are they?”
Dudian didn’t care about his angry shout. He turned around and rushed back into the hall.
“Want to escape? !”The four pioneers sneered as they saw Dudian’s action.
The distance of dozens of meters quickly passed by. The four of them broke into the hall and hit the door.
However the next moment there was a scream coming from the hall.
Hathaway, the bald middle-aged man, and the others, who were standing on the back of the giant eagle, heard the scream, and their eyelids twitched. They felt that something was wrong.
At this time, three black figures flew out of the hall and fell on the square. At the same time, there was a clanging sound of metal, as if something had broken free from the shackles, and the scream became more and more shrill, they rushed out of the hall.
The first to jump out were two ferocious monsters that looked like human-shaped monsters. One of them was holding the neck of a pioneer. The demon body of this pioneer looked like an insect. The demon body was petite and was less than 1.5 meters tall, however, its body was full of tiny limbs. Each of the limbs had a barb. At this moment, these limbs were hitting the human-shaped monster that was holding it. However, the surface of the human-shaped monster’s arm was extremely smooth and its claws were sharp, dark red blood seeped out from the cuticle on his neck.
Clang!
The sound of chains echoed out from the back of the two monsters. It was two black chains that were connected to his back. The chains were stretched straight as they rushed out of the hall, a ferocious looking chariot rushed out of the hall. The metal wheels ran over the threshold and rushed out.
Dudian’s palm was pressed on the metal platform as he looked coldly at Hathaway and the others.
Hathaway and the others were stunned as the war chariot rushed out of the hall. The scene was too shocking. The two humanoid monsters were clearly the appearance of the pioneers behind the devil. But the incredible thing was.., the two pioneers had become slaves of the war chariot!
“Kill! !”Dudian shouted as he drove the war chariot.
Hiro and Luonong had entered the state of a monster. Their bodies were completely demonized. Only their heads were still the same. They were wearing black masks so they couldn’t see their faces clearly.
The two roared in anger as they heard Dudian’s roar. The chains on their backs were pulled straight. The war chariot rushed forward and rushed towards the three people in front of them.
The pioneer who was caught by Hiro hadn’t escaped from Hiro’s claws. Hiro’s sharp claws had pierced through his neck and strangled his neck. He died on the spot!
“They… they are…”the bald middle-aged man was stunned as he looked at the two human-shaped monsters pulling the carriages. He thought of the two of them! They are Hiro and Luonong? ! ! !
He looked at this scene in disbelief.
Whoosh!
Hiro and Luonong quickly caught up with the three pioneers. Their speed was obviously much faster than the three of them. They pulled the chariot and rolled forward.
The three of them were so scared that they hurriedly retreated. They could tell that the two of them were not existences that they could resist with just one look. They turned around and fled to the foot of the giant eagle.
The distance between the hall and the giant eagle was not far. The three of them quickly returned to the foot of the giant eagle. At this moment, the bald middle-aged man had already reacted. With a furious roar, he jumped down from the giant eagle, he shouted at the two people who were charging towards him, “Stop! Hiro, Luonong!”
Hearing his angry shout, Hiro and Luonong were stunned. They immediately stopped. Their expressions were extremely unsightly under the hood. The eyes that were revealed from the eyes of the hood flickered slightly. They did not dare to look at the bald middle-aged man.
When the others heard the name that the bald middle-aged man shouted, they were immediately stunned. Then, they looked at the two people who stopped and were dumbfounded, looking at this scene in disbelief.
These two people who pulled the carriage like servants were actually Hiro and Ronon, the two war gods? !
The black-robed old man’s face was full of shock, but he quickly thought of something. His expression slightly changed, and he said to Hathaway, “The Magic Scorpion War God alone can’t deal with it. I’ll go and help. Please help us keep an eye on that place.”
Hathaway knew what he was referring to. She was sure of her own feelings. She slightly squinted her eyes as she looked at the temple in the distance. It turned out that there were two war gods working for her. No wonder they were hiding in the dark.
“Stop! Kill! !”Dudian roared.
Hiro and Ronon hesitated. The chains on their backs were clanking.
Dudian was so angry that he hit the weak electric mechanism on the metal table. An electric current flowed out from the chains and spread to the back of Hiro and Ronon. The pain made them scream in pain.
Dudian stopped immediately. He didn’t want them to lose their fighting strength.
“Kill!”He roared again.
Hiro and Ronon stopped trembling. They hesitated for a moment but rushed out after hearing Dudian’s words.
“What did you do to them? !”
The bald middle-aged man was furious. He looked at Dudian and Ronon’s eyes which were filled with despair and sorrow. He knew that it was Dudian’s doing. He clenched his fists in anger, he looked up at the sky and roared. The sword on his back suddenly melted and covered his entire body. In the blink of an eye, it turned into a three meters tall giant black scorpion. There was a sharp poisonous hook on his tail.
Both of his hands turned into pincers. There was a thick human-shaped arm on his back. He was holding a sword.
“Go to hell!”He roared as he jumped up and rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he saw that Hiro and Ronon didn’t stop him. He hit a mechanism on the metal table.
