The sound of chains echoed as several chains shot out from the bottom of the chariot, there were four iron pillars on the four corners of the chariot. The chains wrapped around the iron pillars and formed a cage.
“You Want to stop me? Go To Hell!”The God roared in anger. The pincers hit the chains on the outside of the chariot. The chains were pulled out from the drawer and Sparks were produced.
Dudian dodged to the side to avoid the pincers.
At the same time, two heart-wrenching screams echoed out. The God couldn’t help but look back when he heard the screams. His eyes turned red, hiro and Ronon, who were embedded in the chains, were pulled back by the chains. A large amount of blood oozed out from their backs. They were in so much pain that they wished they were dead.
It was only then that he noticed that the chains that he had pressed down earlier were actually related to the chains on their bodies. If he pulled on the chains that surrounded the war chariot, it would be the same as pulling on the chains on their backs!
Whoosh!
He immediately pulled back his pincers and pushed off the side of the war chariot with the sole of his foot, increasing the distance between them.
Hiro and Ronon had already retreated to the side of the chariot. The two of them were rolling on the ground and letting out painful howls. It was as if their hearts were being ripped out of their lungs, causing everyone’s hair to stand on end and their scalps to go numb.
At this moment, Hathaway and the others on the giant eagle also saw that the two war gods were restrained by the chains of the chariot and couldn’t turn over. They had no choice but to fight!
Everyone felt a chill from the bottom of their hearts. It was hard to imagine what kind of life they had encountered here.
“Why don’t you continue?”Dudian coldly looked at the bald middle-aged man who was retreating: “It seems that you have a good relationship with your two old friends.”
“You, you!”The Scorpion Army’s eyes were red but they didn’t dare to attack as they saw the chains around Dudian’s chariot and Hiro and Ronon who were still screaming in pain.
Dudian looked at the two who were screaming in pain: “I told you not to play tricks. Since you have promised to fight for me, you should keep your promise. Don’t go easy or you will be at a disadvantage.”
“You will die ugly!”The God of the Scorpion Army looked at Dudian’s arrogant face. The anger on his face disappeared as he looked at Dudian coldly.
Dudian looked at him: “Get Up and Attack!”
“You!”The eyes of the god of the Scorpion army flashed as he rushed out. He didn’t rush towards Dudian but towards Hiro and Ronon.
All of this happened very quickly. In the blink of an eye he was in front of the two of them. The arm on his back was waving as he slashed down with his sword. The ground cracked. His sword cut the chains on the back of Hiro and Ronon. Sparks flew but the chains were like dead snakes. They were shaken but didn’t break.
“Stupid!”Dudian looked down at Hiro and luonon: “What a good opportunity! Why aren’t you attacking?”
The God of the Scorpion Army didn’t expect that his witcher wouldn’t be able to break the chains. He was stunned as he heard Dudian’s words: “I will skin you!”
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Two sharp whistles echoed out.
The general’s pupils shrank as he heard the sound. He turned around and saw two black shadows pouncing towards him. It was Hiro and Ronon.
He was shocked as he quickly retreated. However he wasn’t able to dodge in time. He was cut by the sharp thorn under Hiro’s armpit. There was a bloody wound on his chest. At the same time, Ronon’s attack failed. He twisted his body and whipped his tail like a snake whip.
The Demon Scorpion Army God watched helplessly as the tail covered with scales lashed out. There was no way to avoid it.
With a bang, a sharp sword stabbed over from the side and cut open the tail. It was the black-robed old man who helped.

chapters.title: Chapter 731
chapters.content:
Chapter 731 – : Chapter 721: Rebellion
“Two gods please stop!”The old man raised his sword in front of the Scorpion God, hiro and Luonon quickly said: “I know your difficulties. Please believe in us. We will rescue you.”
Hiro and Luonon paused for a moment. The next moment they felt Dudian’s hand on the mechanism. They roared and rushed towards the old man.
The old man’s sword quickly melted and covered his entire body. In an instant he turned into a lizard-like monster. There were many strange limbs on his body. The hair on his head was covered by dark green cuticle, his appearance was ferocious. It was similar to the shadow hunter that Dudian had seen before.
There was a sharp spike on his claw. It was like a sharp sword that blocked Hiro’s claw, he said hurriedly, “Two war gods, we came here together with so many people to calm down the chaos in the outer wall. Two War Gods, please do not fight for this kid again and let your reputation be damaged.”
Hiro and Ronon’s eyes revealed a look of sadness. How could he know what they had experienced? The word “Reputation”had long been erased from their hearts. Compared to the hellish experience in the dungeon.., reputation and reputation were as light as bubbles.
Roar!
Hiro roared in grief and anger and charged out again with his claws.
The black-robed old man brandished the sharp sword in his palm. His body moved nimbly and evaded the attacks of the two people. He seemed to be retreating step by step, but he was at ease, while parrying, he continued to persuade them, “Please stop, two war gods. After we kill this kid, we will release you immediately.”
Hiro and Ronon didn’t pay attention to them as they crazily attacked.
The war chariot rolled and rolled under their tugs. There were rhombus spikes on the outside of the wheel. The air was stirred as the war chariot rolled.
“Unless you want them to die with me.”Dudian saw that the old man didn’t give up, he taunted: “Don’t try to flatter me. If they stop and let you attack me then the chains will be broken and their spine will be pulled out. Not only will I die but they will also die. What’s the point of giving them a medal?”
The Old Man’s face slightly changed as he looked at dudian: “Smelly Boy, don’t be too proud. Do you really think that they can protect you? !”
“Then you should try.”Dudian deliberately provoked him.
The Old Man’s face turned cold. Hiro’s sharp tail almost cut his neck when he was distracted. His face turned green and white as he jumped back, he shouted: “Two gods, are you really going to work for this scumbag? Where is your backbone? !”
Hiro and Ronon heard him mention the word ‘backbone’. They immediately roared in anger as their attacks became more fierce.
The other God saw that they were determined to protect Dudian. There was no way to persuade them. There was a trace of determination in his eyes, he shouted at the people on the giant eagle: “Come Over and help me kill this scumbag. I will hold them back!”
The people on the giant eagle heard their words. They looked at each other and jumped off the giant eagle. After all, it was magic scorpion who had spoken. They didn’t dare to disobey.
“Remember not to attack the chains.”Magic Scorpion rushed towards Hiro and reminded the people behind him.
Everyone knew this point. After all, the chains were related to the lives of the two gods. If they attacked the chains and the two gods lost their lives, it was hard to say whether the military would blame them.
Fortunately, the chains were not dense. The gap in the middle was large enough to find the angle to attack Dudian.
Dudian’s face turned gloomy as he saw the seven pioneers surrounding him. He activated his magic body without saying a word. The giant sword on his back melted and covered his body. Sharp limbs grew out of his body, it looked like a monster made of countless blades. Only the parts above the neck were still human.
“Is it the magic body of the splitter? !”
One of the pioneers couldn’t help but exclaim out loud when he saw the shape of Dudian’s magic body.
The black-robed elder and the Magic Scorpion God who were fighting with Hiro and Ronon couldn’t help but look over. Hathaway who was on the giant eagle also looked down, a trace of surprise flashed through her eyes.
Legendary magic marks were relatively rare even among pioneers. Most of them were rare magic marks but the legendary magic marks were the key to the inner wilderness, only in the Witcher family would there be a reserve of legendary magic marks.
Dudian coldly looked at the seven pioneers around him. His wide vision allowed him to see the posture of each pioneer. It was like seven humanoid monsters were surrounding him from all directions. If ordinary people saw this scene.., they would think that they had come to hell.
“Kill!”One of the burly pioneers was the first to react, his eyes revealed a fierce look. He roared and took the lead to step forward. He was a humanoid hedgehog monster. There were countless small spikes protruding from his back. There were four or five ivory-like spikes protruding from his chest, no matter if it was his back or chest, no one could attack him.
His hands were full of hair and were like a lion’s paw.
Dudian’s eyes were cold as he cut his scythe-like arm.
Puff! The edge of the arm cut into his wrist. Blood gushed out and his hairy palm was cut off without any obstruction.
The burly man screamed as he retracted his arm. He looked at Dudian in anger. His magic marks were not good at attacking in such a gap but were more inclined towards defense. If he was on the chariot.., he was not afraid of the other six pioneers who would attack him. But he was the one who took the initiative to attack. He didn’t expect to be injured so badly.
The others immediately retracted their claws and limbs. Although there were few splitter pioneers but they had a deep impact on the splitter. It was the most terrifying monster among the legendary monsters, especially in group battles.
Looking at Dudian’s appearance, they were frightened. He was using his body to attack a monster that was full of sharp blades!
“Use your weapon!”Another woman with strange colored patterns on her face shouted. She quickly threw out a black whip and lashed it into the gap of the chains.
Dudian swung his arms and cut the chains!
“Get out of the way! I’ll do it!”Another pioneer shouted. He rushed to the side of the chariot. A strong wind shot out from a bone tube protruding from his shoulder and shot into the chariot.
Dudian saw the shape of the other pioneer’s body and guessed that he was good at using magic marks. He held his breath.
However, even though he held his breath, he still felt dizzy as the strong wind blew. The seven pioneers in front of him became fourteen and then twenty-eight, it seemed that they were circling around him.
He shook his head. At this time, a whistling sound came from the side. When he turned his head, he felt a pain in his waist. He was stabbed by a sharp weapon.
He immediately raised his hand and slapped. The sharp palm cut off the sharp weapon. He looked down and saw a broken gun on his waist.
“Go!”The other pioneers saw that Dudian was poisoned and immediately rushed forward.
Dudian’s body slightly shook as he tried to open his eyes. The Shadow in his vision barely disappeared. He knew that he couldn’t stay here for long. Although the war chariot could protect him but it was also hindering him, if it was the square he wouldn’t be afraid to face the seven pioneers. Although they had different magic marks and skills but he had the limit attack magic marks, it was enough to kill them one by one when they formed a formation.
“Hiro! Ronon!”He shouted as he swung his limbs to protect his body.
Hiro and Ronon couldn’t help but look back. They saw Dudian raise an arm. They had seen this posture before. It was the pre-planned retreat gesture!
They noticed the broken gun on Dudian’s waist. They saw the seven pioneers swarming around the chariot. They knew that Dudian was unable to hold on.
“Stop him!”Hiro’s eyes were filled with hatred. He stopped the attack and roared: “He wants to escape back to the temple! There is an underground passage! Stop Him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 732
chapters.content:
Chapter 732 – Chapter 722: Suspicious [ First Update ]
“Stop him!”Hearing Hiro’s words, the demon Scorpion Army God immediately roared at the seven people surrounding the war chariot.
The seven people were shocked. Only then did they notice that the battle between him and Hiro had stopped without any hesitation or hesitation. This could only mean that their previous ‘battle’was just for show.., they didn’t really use their full strength. Moreover both of them were slightly injured. Although it seemed fierce but there was no fatal injury.
“Stop him!”The seven of them immediately reacted and surrounded Dudian.
Dudian narrowed his eyes as he heard Hiro’s roar. The next moment his face showed anger. He raised his hand and patted the mechanism: “Traitor, go to hell!”
Hiro’s body twitched as he fell to the ground. His body was trembling like a dead fish.
There were several mechanisms to control the chain. There were integrated mechanisms and separate mechanisms. Dudian only patted the mechanism to punish Hiro.
Luonong was surprised as he saw that he wasn’t electrocuted. He was relieved as he saw the Magic Scorpion God trying to help Hiro: “Don’t touch him!”
The God of the Scorpion Army stopped and looked at him in surprise.
At the same time Dudian’s body was like a fish as he jumped up from the chariot. He abandoned the chariot and flew towards the temple.
Hailey who was standing on the giant eagle frowned as she saw the scene. She wanted to stop Dudian but she was afraid that Aisha would take the opportunity to launch a sneak attack.
At this time, the seven pioneers were chasing after Dudian. They were angry but their speed was much slower than Dudian’s. Only two of them could barely keep up with Dudian’s speed, it was a bit difficult to catch up with Dudian.
“You are courting death!”
Dudian’s body suddenly stopped and he suddenly stopped. He was caught off guard. At the same time, his body opened up like a peacock’s tail. The sharp blades on his body reflected the cold murderous aura, he suddenly strangled the two people who were chasing him.
The pupils of the two people shrank. They were scared out of their wits. They didn’t think that Dudian would dare to turn back and kill them while he was desperately trying to escape.
They had no time to prepare. They could only wave their weapons to parry.
Rip! Rip!
Two sounds of cutting rang out. Their weapons couldn’t withstand a single blow from Dudian’s sharp limbs. They were cut in an instant. Even their bodies were cut into several parts. One of them died on the spot while the other reacted fast, they avoided the fatal parts in time. Although they were cut in half but their upper body didn’t die. They quickly used their hands to climb back as they landed. They didn’t even care about the internal organs and blood flowing out of their abdomen, they let their intestines and stomach organs drag on the ground.
The scene was extremely bloody and chilling. The speed of the five people behind them was greatly reduced.
Dudian didn’t look back. He turned around and rushed towards the temple.
In the blink of an eye, the distance between the two sides was widened. The five people behind them couldn’t catch up. They slowly stopped in front of the temple and didn’t dare to approach. After all, Hathaway had said that.., the former Dragon Saintess Aisha was in the temple. If she made a move then the five of them would be killed in an instant!
Seeing that the opportunity was missed, the Magic Scorpion General God and the black-robed old man sighed in anger.
“Your Highness Hathaway, we can’t let them run away. Let’s go in together!”The Magic Scorpion General God knew that the opportunity couldn’t be delayed. He raised his head and said to Hathaway. He was ready to attack, since Aisha didn’t have a witcher, he believed that they could trap her!
“Alright!”Hathaway nodded. She knew that she couldn’t wait too long. If she let her sister run away this time, it would be difficult to catch her. If she couldn’t get rid of her in time, she would feel uneasy. She knew better than anyone else how terrifying her sister’s talent was. If she was given time to grow, she couldn’t guarantee that she wouldn’t face a crisis in the future.
As they prepared to attack, Lonon looked at Dudian who was standing in front of the temple’s Gate. The latter’s cold expression suddenly hit his brain like lightning. He suddenly remembered.., what happened before he and Hiro were captured!
Although he was too fast to react and see the situation but he knew that he and Hiro were injured when they rushed out of the temple. Afterwards he was puzzled in the dungeon. It wasn’t until Dudian locked him in the chariot that he experienced the mysterious attack again!
“Don’t go! !”He shouted as he looked at the general: “There is a trap inside! Don’t go in! !”
The general and the old man were startled as they stared at him.
“Trap? Are you sure?”The old man was the first to ask.
Ronon’s face turned pale: “I’m sure! Hiro and I were caught in this way. Don’t go in there!”
The general frowned: “But Hiro said that there is a passage in there. He is going to escape from it!”
“That’s a lie!”Ronon was fully aware of Dudian’s plan. He deliberately told them that there was a secret passage in there. If they betrayed him then he would tell them, he wanted to lure the others into the secret passage so that he could catch them all in one go!
His heart slightly trembled as he felt fear. In his eyes the teenager was a devil in human skin. He was dirty and evil, he immediately said to the god of scorpions: “There is a trap inside. You must not go in or else…”his heart welled up with sadness, he couldn’t bear to look back at the miserable experience in the dungeon.
Hathaway frowned as she looked at him. She turned to look at the temple and found that Dudian was still standing at the door. He didn’t directly enter the temple to escape. If it was an ordinary person who saw this action, it would undoubtedly confirm what Ronon said. There was a trap inside and Dudian was waiting for them to chase after him.
However, she had spent time with Dudian so she knew that he was a cunning person. If what Ronon said was true then what he had done was a failure.
She was shocked as she thought of this. Suddenly she saw Hiro who was convulsing on the ground. Her pupils shrank as she looked at Ronon: “He is injured. How Are You Alright?”
The old man and the other five pioneers were stunned. They reacted and looked at Ronon with doubt in their eyes.
They were chained. Hiro was convulsing and unconscious. He was drooling but Ronon was alright. He was able to talk to them and tell them the information.
Could it be that he was completely loyal to Dudian and deliberately stayed here to delay them?
Lonon was stunned for a moment when he heard Hathaway’s words. The next moment he felt cold from head to toe. His body slightly trembled as he looked up at the Scorpion God and Hathaway, there was doubt and doubt in everyone’s eyes.
He slightly opened his mouth but felt dry and bitter.
He suddenly understood why Dudian didn’t attack him but only attacked Hiro. He thought that Dudian didn’t notice that he was rebellious so he only punished Hiro.
But now he knew that he was too naive!
This little devil’s “Mercy”was the same as pushing him into the abyss. All the truth that he said was empty!
If the previous deliberately told them that there was an escape passage in the temple was the first step to prevent them from rebelling, then punishing Hiro was the second step to prevent him from rebelling! He and Hiro didn’t resist at all. In fact, their resistance would be used by Dudian to become his accomplice!
He suddenly felt like crying. He had never felt so powerless before.
“I really didn’t lie to you…”his voice was bitter. He felt as if he was in a death struggle. After he understood Dudian’s plan, he naturally knew what his image was like in the hearts of Hathaway and the others, at the same time, he thought of another puzzled point. Why didn’t Dudian directly attack him and make him unconscious? This way, he wouldn’t betray him and lose the risk of dialectics at the moment.
The only answer he could think of was that Dudian had calculated that if they were unconscious at the same time, they might not be able to completely trust Hathaway and the others with their one-sided words.
After all, a person who could betray at any time shouldn’t be able to get such important information. Once they were suspicious, it would be difficult to trick them into entering the temple.
Seeing Ronon’s pale explanation, Hathaway’s brows furrowed even more. The other five pioneers were also skeptical. One of them had already put away his weapon and helped the halved pioneer to put his organs into his stomach.
The Magic Scorpion Army God stared at Ronon. The doubt in his eyes slowly disappeared. He was about to speak when someone suddenly shouted, “What is he doing?”

chapters.title: Chapter 733
chapters.content:
Chapter 733 – Chapter 723: Enter The Temple [ Second Update ]
Hathaway, Magic Scorpion and the others turned to look at Dudian who was still standing in front of the temple. He stretched out an arm and pointed at the sky.
Above?
Hathaway and the others were startled as they looked up at the sky.
White clouds floated over and the sunlight shone on the clouds.
Other than that, there was nothing else.
Just as everyone was puzzled —
Boom! !
Suddenly, a loud sound exploded without warning!
The source of the explosion wasn’t elsewhere, but the square under Hathaway and the others’feet!
The explosion was too sudden. Everyone was caught off guard and looked at the sky. The moment the square exploded, they were all affected by the explosion. Instantly, broken stone slabs flew out. They were as sharp as knives and shot out in all directions. The ground rumbled, huge Sparks and dust were set off.
Several Black Shadows flew out from the Sparks and dust and fell on the outer edge of the square. Some of their legs were broken and only their upper body was left. They screamed in pain. Some of their arms were broken and half of their faces were disfigured, the miserable situation was different.
Dudian retracted his finger and covered his eyes to block the flying stones and dust.
He had secretly buried a large amount of explosives under the square. His previous gesture wasn’t just to distract Hathaway and the others but also to inform Noyce to detonate the explosives.
After all, he had used gunpowder on the wall of sighs. How could he not leave this big weapon in his nest!
Through the gaps of his fingers, he saw that there were several heat source figures still standing in the explosion wave. He immediately looked back and ran into the temple without looking back.
He had already estimated the amount of gunpowder under the square. It was almost impossible to directly kill Hathaway and the others. This wasn’t just a matter of quantity, unless he hollowed out the entire mountain and buried it with explosives, it would form a complete mountain of gunpowder, but in that case, he would be buried together with them. After all, what he could produce at the moment was only black gunpowder. It wasn’t packaged as a military bomb, and the explosion power was scattered, making it difficult for it to have a destructive effect.
He couldn’t tell when the enemy would attack so he could only make such a trap.
However, although he couldn’t kill the enemy but it was enough to lure them.
Dudian turned and rushed into the temple. Several figures rushed out from the dust and sparks to disperse the black smoke. They were Hathaway, magic scorpion and the black robed old man, there were two more people who ran out from the black smoke. However, compared to the three of them, they were in a much more miserable state. There were injuries of different sizes on their bodies, especially on their legs. One of them had his lower leg broken, he only relied on one leg and demonized limbs to support him.
On the other hand, Hathaway, the general of the Magic Scorpion Army, and the black-robed old man had all entered the magic body state. There were only light burns on their bodies. Especially for Hathaway, she had entered the Magic Dragon Body State, her body still maintained the appearance of more than half of a human. The black dragon wings on her back were huge, blocking the sunlight and wrapping around her body. Other than the light burns on the wings, her clothes were not damaged.
“Follow me!”Hathaway’s eyes were cold, revealing an astonishing chill. She stared at the temple and squeezed out three words from between her teeth.
Magic Scorpion and the black-robed old man were also angry. There were many pioneers from the military and the monastery who were attacked by the explosion. Most of them were more or less seriously injured, some of them died on the spot which made them angry and angry. However, what made them even more angry was that they were fooled by Dudian’s inexplicable gesture of pointing at the sky!
If they hadn’t been distracted by the explosion, they wouldn’t have reacted so slowly that they would have been injured.
“Kill! !”The Scorpion general roared and followed Hathaway.
In addition to anger, they also knew that the situation was difficult at the moment. If they didn’t take advantage of the situation to pursue, they could only choose to retreat. They had come to this place with a total of twelve people, but now more than half of them had died. The other pioneers were dead.., with injuries, they had almost no fighting ability. Only the three of them could still maintain their peak condition. Even if there was Aisha in the temple, they could only go up.
In fact, their original plan was to rely on the three of them to deal with Aisha. The other ordinary pioneers could not intervene in such a battle. Blindly intervening would only cause more trouble.
The black-robed old man followed closely behind Hathaway and the Magic Scorpion Army God. His eyes were cold, like a lizard, flashing with a cold luster. The words of Ronon had left a trace in his heart, although he was furious at the moment.., but he was still cautious and slightly behind, letting Hathaway and the Magic Scorpion Army God test it out first.
In the blink of an eye, the three of them rushed into the temple.
As soon as they entered the temple, Hathaway stopped. Her pupils constricted as she stared at a slender and calm figure sitting above the temple. The figure was wearing a thin veil, but the outline of her face could be clearly seen. It was her sister.., aisha!
The Magic Scorpion Army God also saw Aisha, and his expression changed, his gaze becoming serious.
The old man quickly looked around after entering the hall. He saw that there was no strange reaction. He slowly stopped and walked behind Hathaway and Magic Scorpion. He also saw Aisha in the hall, he frowned and secretly became alert.
“You are indeed here.”Hathaway looked at Aisha and sneered: “The pure and Pure Holy Maiden is actually fooling around with a man. It is simply Filthy!”
“Shut up, Slut!”Dean who was standing next to Aisha heard her words. He was really angry this time. He could smile and tolerate being insulted but he couldn’t accept others saying anything about Aisha, that was a forbidden area in his heart: “You pretended to be your sister to seduce me. At such a young age you would flirt and seduce men. You are a slut. You Don’t deserve to mention your sister!”
Hathaway’s face slightly changed. She was an eighteen-year-old girl after all. Although she was young but it was the first time she was insulted in front of others. Her face quickly turned gloomy, she said: “Scum, you are at the end of the road. Hurry up and beg my sister to protect you. If she can really protect you… oh… right, she was injured by the king of corpses to protect you. You are a disaster…”
Her face was full of ridicule. Her words were like knives stabbing into Dudian’s heart.
Although Dudian knew that he had to calm down, but after hearing her words, he felt that his eyes were red. The blood in his body seemed to be about to explode. His body slightly trembled as he tightly clenched his fists, the killing intent and anger in his heart as well as the deeper layer of sadness were completely displayed on his face. Although Hathaway’s words were ironic, but it was the truth. Because of this, he was so angry that he almost lost his mind.
Seeing Dean’s reaction, the corner of Hathaway’s mouth slightly curved. She knew that she had the upper hand. She slightly raised her head, she said to Aisha: “Sister, it’s been so long. Don’t you want to talk to me? You betrayed the Dragon Clan. Grandma dragon is very disappointed in you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 734
chapters.content:
Chapter 734 – Chapter 724: Catch [ First Update ]
“Your Highness Hathaway, your sister’s condition doesn’t seem right.”The black-robed old man suddenly spoke. He stared at Aisha who was wearing a veil, “Look at her pupils. They seem to be completely black. Could it be that she has…”
Hearing his words, Hathaway and magic scorpion were shocked. They found that Aisha’s eyes were dark like a deep pool.
Hathaway’s face changed as she shouted at dudian: “What’s Going On? !”
“What’s going on?”
Dudian laughed at her words, but his expression became twisted and ferocious: “You asked me what’s going on? Have you forgotten what you did? If it wasn’t for you, if it wasn’t for you…”
He clenched his teeth and stared at her as if he wanted to devour her.
Hathaway was stunned for a moment. The last scene she saw when she flew away suddenly appeared in her mind. She suddenly understood. No wonder she felt so strange when she saw her sister again. She couldn’t help but laugh, “I see. I didn’t expect her to be as strong as I thought. She was still no match for that corpse king. I say, with her character, even if she hates me, she will at least go back to the Dragon Clan. Grandma Dragon loves her very much. If she goes back, she will definitely make a decision for her. So it’s not that she won’t go back, it’s that she can’t go back…”
The more she spoke, the more gorgeous her smile became. It seemed that she was more relaxed.
Originally, she was confident that she could fight with Aisha without the help of the blood baron. Now that Aisha was infected by the king of corpses and lost her consciousness, she was even more fearless. Even without the help of the god of scorpions and the black-robed old man.., she had the victory in her hands!
Dudian looked at her smile. The madness in his eyes slowly cooled down. He quietly looked at her. Any words were unnecessary at this moment. He didn’t say another word, he slowly raised his hand and patted a wooden pillar next to him.
The moment the wooden pillar fell, the sound of a switch was heard in the hall.
Magic Scorpion and the black robed old man heard the sound. The previous battle had made them clearly aware of the youth’s craftiness. Although they had a greater chance of winning but they didn’t dare to let down their guard.
Soon, the two noticed that the water was quietly flowing out of the hall. It covered the ground under their feet.
Water?
The three of them saw the water spread to their feet. They didn’t know if it was clean water or some unknown poison.
The God of the Scorpion army and the black robed old man quickly moved. They jumped like birds and landed on the high platform next to the hall. The height of the platform was exactly the same as that of Dudian’s, they wouldn’t be submerged by the water.
Hathaway looked at the water that was moving closer and closer. She was about to jump up to avoid it when she suddenly thought of the previous battle. Dudian deliberately pointed to the sky to attract their attention but let them be injured by the explosion.
Her heart sank when she thought of this. She thought that with Dudian’s cunning character, it would be too reckless if the water was a poison trap, even a small hunter would notice the spread of the water and have enough time to escape!
Such a trap had no offensive effect, but it could force others to other places.
Thinking of this, she glanced at the hall and found that in addition to the hall they were standing in, the other higher places were the steps in front of Dudian and Aisha, next is the Magic Scorpion God of war and the black-robed old man standing under the pillars of the high platform, a total of four high platforms, if this water is considered poison, the average person will most likely jump to these four high platforms to avoid.
However, the strangest thing is, why is there a high platform under the beams and columns of the building?
Thinking of this, her pupils constricted, hurriedly to the Devil Scorpion God of war and the black-robed old man shouted: “Quickly get out of there, there is the real trap!”
The general and the old man were startled but reacted in an instant. Before they jumped down Dudian’s palm had touched the lion’s head and pressed it down.
How fast was the Lightning?
Even a pioneer wouldn’t be able to reach one percent of the speed!
The general and the old man’s feet hadn’t been raised when their bodies trembled. They stood on the high platform and twitched. It was as if they were dancing in a strange position. Their eyes were trembling more and more, the saliva was thrown out from their mouths.
Seeing their strange appearance, Hathaway immediately thought of Hiro who was locked outside the chariot. Hiro was also in the same situation. Her body inexplicably twitched.
A trace of coldness rose in her heart. This attack was too strange. She couldn’t understand how Dudian attacked. Could it be poison? But the Magic Scorpion general and the old man in black robe didn’t touch anything. Even if the high platform was covered with poison, their boots didn’t touch their bodies, could it be that this mysterious poison could poison people through clothes?
She couldn’t imagine what kind of poison it was. She knew that there was no poison that had such a terrifying effect.
Moreover, she was more convinced that it wasn’t a poison but a mysterious special method that she had never seen before!
She didn’t go forward to help the two. Previously, Ronon had stopped the god of the Scorpion Army from saving Hiro. It was clear that this strange attack could be contagious!
“You are smart.”Dudian looked at Hathaway who was standing in the same place. There was a murderous look in his eyes, “But you still have to die!”
Hathaway wanted to jump to the top of the hall to avoid the water that spread from her feet. However, after hearing the first sentence, she gave up the idea. When she heard the last sentence, she realized that something was wrong and wanted to take off, however, her body froze and her mind went blank.
Dudian took a small bow from the wall and took out a small arrow that was about 10 cm long. It was as thin as a quill, he looked at Hailey who was trembling because of the electric current in the water. He aimed at her throat and shot the arrow. The small arrow shot out like a pencil.
Puff! The small arrow hit Hathaway’s throat but it didn’t pierce through. It was only embedded two or three centimeters. It was blocked by the scales on her neck.
Dudian aimed at one of her eyes again.
“Die!”
His eyes were cold as he pulled the small bow to the maximum. The special small arrow flew out and pierced through one of Hathaway’s left eyes. Blood splattered everywhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 735
chapters.content:
Chapter 735 – Chapter 725: Second Base [ Second Update ]
Dudian took advantage of the situation to grab another small arrow. He was about to shoot it into her other eye when Hathaway suddenly let out a scream. She flapped her dragon wings and hugged her body, she flew towards the dome of the hall.
Dudian’s face changed as he shot the small arrow. Puff! It nailed onto one of her wings.
However, at this moment, Hathaway had escaped from the paralysis of the electric current. Her wings turned into a black hurricane and rushed towards the dome. Bang! It hit the earth brick of the dome and made a huge hole.
Dudian didn’t expect that she would be able to escape from the electric shock. He was shocked and angry. He flapped his wings and chased after her.
Hathaway’s face was full of fear and anger as she flew into the sky. Her beautiful little face was extremely ferocious. Her tail wrapped around the small arrow on her wings and fiercely threw it at Dudian.
Dudian hurriedly dodged. The small arrow almost touched his cheek and almost got stabbed.
“I will kill you! ! !”Hathaway’s sharp voice echoed through the sky. It was full of killing intent and endless anger. The next moment her body rushed towards the wall of sighs without looking back.
Dudian rushed out of the roof of the hall. He saw that Hathaway was thousands of meters away. It was almost impossible for him to catch up with her.
He was so angry that his heart and lungs almost exploded. The enemy that he had captured had escaped. If the god of scorpions and others had escaped, he wouldn’t be so angry. But the person who had escaped was the person he wanted to kill the most. He hated the most!
“Ah Ah Ah! !”He threw his head back and roared, venting the anger in his heart.
At this time, Hathaway’s back had completely disappeared from his eyes, drowning in the white clouds in the sky. His gaze was like a fierce ghost in the abyss, staring at that place. After a long time, he slowly withdrew his gaze, and the killing intent in his eyes gradually disappeared, returning to calm.
At this time he thought of the Magic Scorpion general and the black-robed old man who were still in the hall. He immediately turned around and drilled into the hall through the hole in the dome. He saw that the two of them had fainted on the ground.
“The power has been strengthened. How can we fail to trap three people at once!”Dudian clenched his fists. It was such a rare opportunity but he let Hathaway escape just like that. He felt great hatred in his heart!
He raised his hand and closed the mechanism. He went forward and disabled the limbs of the Scorpion God and the old man. He stabbed daggers and steel needles into their weak joints to restrict their movement.
He looked up at the hole in the dome. He hated in his heart. The walls of the temple were made of metal but the dome was made of concrete instead of metal. If it was made of metal.., it was inevitable that lightning would be attracted when it rained. Although there were lightning rods, the use of the lightning rods would be completely destroyed by the all-metal structure.
It was because of this layer of safety considerations that the all-metal dome wasn’t used. This also caused Hathaway to successfully escape!
If she had turned around and rushed out of the temple, she would have been struck by the electricity on the door again, and the chances of escaping would be much smaller.
Perhaps, this was fate?
He was angry in his heart. This Hathaway didn’t know about the conductive material, but she chose to leave from the dome. He didn’t know whether it was her good luck, or she accidentally chose the fastest route to escape because she was eager to escape.
“I’m sorry, I couldn’t keep her…”Dean looked at Aisha next to him. His eyes were full of guilt and sorrow. He reached out to cover her slender cold little hand and put it on his forehead. He couldn’t help but want to cry.
Aisha was silent. There was no reaction.
Dudian put her cold hand on his forehead. He was full of regret and guilt. After a long time he looked up and said: “But she was hit by my arrow. There is mercury and poison in the arrow. She shouldn’t be able to live!”
Aisha was still silent.
Dudian looked at her: “Even if she is lucky enough to survive, I will kill the Dragon clan sooner or later. I will make her pay with her life. I will make her body kneel in front of you and repent!”
Aisha’s face was emotionless as if she didn’t hear him.
Dudian looked at her for a moment. He slowly turned his head and looked at the few figures outside the temple. His eyes flashed and he immediately rushed out.
The dust from the explosion hadn’t subsided yet. There was still dust in the air. Some of the pioneers were lying on the ground. Some seemed to have fainted while others crawled together to bandage their wounds, they were applying powder to save themselves.
Dudian’s sudden appearance startled the conscious pioneers. They didn’t expect him to come out of the temple alive.
Soon, the pioneers noticed that there was no sound of the battle between the black-robed elder and the god of scorpions. In addition to Hathaway who had flown away from the high sky, an ominous premonition spread to their hearts.
“It’s a sin that can not be redeemed!”Dudian whispered and suddenly flew away.
“Kill!”One of the pioneers who had lost an arm saw Dudian pouncing towards him. Although he was scared but his momentum was not weak. He roared and pounced towards Dudian. But the next moment, he was surrounded by the sharp limbs of the monster on Dudian’s back, the monster’s limbs flashed and cut a huge wound.
Dudian didn’t kill them but knocked them out. He turned around and pounced on the other person.
Even though they were in their peak condition they were struggling to fight against dudian. At the moment they were in a serious condition so they were defeated by Dudian one by one.
Dudian raised his hand and beckoned. Neuss who was standing on the edge of the square immediately rushed over: “Master, Are You Alright?”
Dudian shook his head and pointed to the few pioneers: “Lock them in the dungeon like what we did to Hiro and Ronon and the other two in the temple.”
Neuss was relieved to see that Dudian was safe. He turned around and ran to call the guards.
Half an hour later, the square completely calmed down. Only the explosion of the crater told the story of the terrible battle.
Dudian sat back on the throne of the temple. He was still brooding over the matter of Hathaway’s escape. He closed his eyes for a long time before he gently exhaled, it would only waste his time and energy.
He waited for Neuss to return and immediately asked him to call the builders to repair the square. At the same time he asked the attendants to clean up the water traces in the hall.
“How is the construction of our second base going?”Dudian asked Neuss. He asked Neuss to hand over the task to Hawkeye.
Neuss was surprised to see Dudian ask about this. He thought of the previous war and immediately guessed what Dudian was thinking, “Master, the second base is progressing smoothly. It can be used as our second fort at any time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 736
chapters.content:
Chapter 736 – Chapter 726: Bloodline Elimination [ Two In One ]
“That’s good.”Dudian was relieved, he said: “Prepare a batch of wall builders to transform the mountain. Also stop the transportation of the flame to the wall of Sighs. Send it here and be ready for war.”
“If we want to bury the gunpowder then we can bury the gunpowder at any time.”Neuss immediately said.
Dudian shook his head, “The previous gunpowder was too little. This time we will bury the entire mountain. This time they have suffered a great loss. The next time they will be better prepared. Maybe there will be stronger people who will come. We will have to use more gunpowder.”
“Bury the entire mountain with gunpowder?”Neuss was shocked. He couldn’t help but say: “If the explosion happens then everyone on the mountain won’t be able to escape.”
Dudian nodded: “So Barton and Sergei will go to the second base to deal with the matters there. I will be the one in charge.”
“But you will be injured!”
“I have my own way to protect myself.”Dudian’s eyes were calm: “In addition, send more people to patrol the mountain. Don’t let your guard down.”
Neuss was startled. He was about to speak but suddenly felt a chill in his heart. Why did they send people to patrol the mountain? It was unnecessary! He knew that Dudian’s ruthless methods were just a cover. If the enemy really attacked then they would be killed along with the entire mountain. No one would be spared!
His heart was cold. This was a cruel and ruthless method to kill the enemy. However he couldn’t say anything to stop it because today’s battle had shown him how difficult Dudian’s situation was, he had been killed at the moment.
If Dudian was killed then he and Sergei wouldn’t have a good ending!
“I know. I will send people to deal with it.”Neuss bowed his head.
Dudian nodded slightly.
“Go.”
He waved to Neuss to leave. He sat alone on the cold throne and quietly looked at the blue sky outside. The following days were the real danger. He didn’t know whether the poison on the arrow and the mercury hidden inside.., he had to make two preparations to kill Hathaway. Moreover, regardless of whether she died or not, the news of this war would spread to all the major forces in the inner wall and attract their attention.
“At that time, I really should have smeared the corpse poison on the arrow…”he thought with a trace of regret.
Many of the enemies who died in his hands died due to carelessness. He didn’t expect himself to make such a mistake. Hathaway was actually able to break free from the shackles of the electric current. This was something he didn’t expect. He originally wanted to capture her alive and kill her, only then could he vent the monstrous hatred in his heart. In the end, it became a loophole to let the enemy escape. Success was also caused by hatred, and failure was also caused by hatred. It was really hateful!
..
..
Whoosh!
Hathaway flew high into the sky towards the wall of Sighs.
Her body was like a giant black bird. She was relieved when she saw that Dudian didn’t chase after her. Her body slowly slowed down as she flew. She felt dizzy and nauseous.
Soon, she flew over the wall of Sighs. She didn’t fly directly to the inner wall but to the outside of the giant wall.
She slowly slowed down after crossing the giant wall. Her body gradually landed on the grass outside the giant wall. There were rotten bones of monsters around her. She looked back and saw that no one was following her, she immediately folded her wings and went into a forest.
There were poisonous snakes lurking in the forest. When Hathaway passed by them, they immediately attacked.
Hathaway didn’t even look at them. She raised her hand and cut off the head of the poisonous snake with her nails. Then, she walked straight into the depths of the forest.
She found a big tree and couldn’t stand it anymore. She sat on the vine under the tree and panted heavily. There was an unhealthy red color on her small face, as if her face was filled with blood.
She untied her demon body and took out some bottles and jars from her purse on her back. Her snow-white jade-like fingers trembled slightly as she opened the first-aid medicine in a panic. She took out a few green pills from a bottle and swallowed them. She exhaled lightly, then, she continued to grab another bottle and poured out dark red powder from it. She smeared it on her wound.
She swallowed her saliva slightly and mustered up the courage to reach out to grab the arrow in her eye socket. When her fingers touched the arrow, it trembled and immediately felt a tearing pain. She gritted her teeth and suddenly grabbed it with her palm, she grabbed the entire arrow and yanked it out. Blood gushed out from her eye socket and fell on the exquisite soft armor on her chest. It was a shocking sight.
She didn’t need to look at herself in the mirror to know that her current appearance was extremely ugly. However, that wasn’t what she was most concerned about. She didn’t know if the arrow had been smeared with zombie poison.
If Dudian smeared her sister’s zombie poison on the arrow, she wouldn’t be able to escape. Even if she removed all the tissues in her eyes, she wouldn’t be able to reverse the fate of being infected by the virus.
This was the reason why she didn’t choose to return directly to the inner wall. If she was infected as an undead, she would die if she returned to the inner wall. Even if the Dragon Clan killed her personally, no one would save her!
Instead of that, she might as well continue to “Live”as an undead in the world outside the giant wall!
After all, even the Monster Research Institute couldn’t tell whether the infected undead had consciousness or not!
This was an eternal mystery, just like how humans did not know if there were ghosts in the world or if their consciousness would continue to wander between heaven and earth after death. The only way to get the answer was to die! But after death, there was no way to tell the answer to the living.
The same was true for the zombies. After being infected by the virus and becoming zombies, whether there was still consciousness in the brain and observing everything from the perspective of a bystander, only the zombies would know the answer.
She didn’t want to die. Even if she became a zombie, she still wanted to live!
Whew!
She leaned against the tree and panted heavily. She was waiting. Although the discomfort and dizziness let her know that there was no zombie poison on the arrow, it definitely contained a deadly poison. If she treated it a little later.., it might not be able to cure it completely!
“If he wanted to apply the zombie poison, he would definitely take it from her mouth. She is already a zombie king. If I was infected by her poison, I would probably become a zombie or another zombie king in half an hour!”Her expression was ugly, she clenched her teeth and felt her body turn cold. It was not because of the cold in her heart, but because of the cold. It was as if she was surrounded by an ice valley.
She took out her dagger and tore a piece of clothing from the soft armor. She twisted it into a twist and bit into her mouth. Then she disinfected the dagger. She raised her neck and cut a small hole in her neck that was pierced by the arrow.
Blood flowed down her throat. She was slightly panting. This was the first time she had experienced such intense pain in her life. She was resentful in her heart. She didn’t expect that Haisha hadn’t made a move yet. Just Dudian alone had made her so miserable!
She had an 80% chance of winning this trip. She didn’t expect that before she met Haisha, the entire army was defeated, and she was the only one who escaped!
No one would believe such a battle record!
Who would believe that a commoner from the outer wall who had no background not only became a pioneer, but also defeated all twelve of them by himself! After all, besides her, the Magic Scorpion Army God and the black-robed old man were all important figures in the inner wall. The other pioneers were also famous. Such power was enough to run rampant in the wilderness, but they fell in the outer wall!
“If you don’t die, I will definitely kill you! !”She gnashed her teeth in hatred, this kind of hatred even exceeded her hatred for her sister, because her sister had never hurt her. Since she was young, she had never suffered any injuries other than training herself!
Half an hour quickly passed.
Hathaway had been silently calculating the time. When the half an hour was getting closer and closer, she was also pleasantly surprised. Until the time passed, she checked her body several times, but still didn’t find any signs of turning into a corpse, then she smiled again.
Although she was seriously injured and was blind in one eye, compared to the worst case scenario of being infected by the corpse poison, she was extremely lucky!
“B * Stard, you didn’t apply the corpse poison on the arrow. Today, you let me live. When we meet again, it will be your death! !”The smile on Hathaway’s face disappeared, there was a trace of sinister killing intent. She no longer waited and entered the magic body. She spread her wings and left the ground. The Magic Wings cut off the tree which was resting on her back. She flew high into the sky like a ROC.
“You wanted to capture me alive but I ran away. I shouldn’t have died!”Hathaway was happy as she flew high in the sky. She had guessed the reason why Dudian didn’t apply the corpse poison, it could be seen that the strange attack would absorb her and give Dudian enough opportunity to kill her.
It was because of this that Dudian didn’t want to directly kill her because of his hatred for her. It would be too easy for her but it would become her only hope to survive.
“Life is unpredictable. You Can’t have too many distracting thoughts to kill the enemy!”After struggling back from the edge of life and death, Hathaway’s temperament had grown. She secretly warned herself to meet Dudian in the future, she must not make such a big mistake. Even if she was fully confident, she must kill him directly without leaving any accidents!
She flew straight to the giant wall. She was ready to rush back to the Dragon clan to heal and detoxify.
At this moment, she suddenly glanced at it from the corner of her eyes. Her expression suddenly changed, and she stopped abruptly. She looked down at a ditch in the distance, where a huge black figure was squirming.
Although she was thousands of meters high in the sky, she could see it clearly as if she was standing next to the huge black figure. She instantly recognized that this thing was very similar to the black prison created by the Monster Research Institute!
“The Black Hell of the Monster Research Institute? How could it come here? And it’s so huge…”Hathaway was bewildered, as the Saintess of the Dragon Clan, she naturally knew many secrets. The “Black Hell”developed by the Monster Research Institute in recent years was a strange monster weapon. Some elders of the monastery even condemned the experiment of the Monster Research Institute, they thought that the black prison they created was a man-made creature.
And creating life had always been the god of Light’s right!
The experiment of the Monster Research Institute was clearly a violation of divine rights!
However, from what she knew, the size of the black prison of the monster research institute was very small. She had even personally gone to observe it. However, the size of this one was more than ten meters in diameter. It was practically a moving hill!
Her eyes flashed. She suddenly felt that the monster research institute wasn’t as simple as she thought. She looked around, but she didn’t see anyone else, nor did she see anyone from the Monster Research Institute, could it be that the black prison came here on its own?
She thought for a moment and wanted to go down to take a look, but her mind suddenly felt dizzy, making her vision go black. At the same time, she felt her whole body go numb and stiff. She was shocked and didn’t dare to stay any longer, she turned around and rushed into the giant wall, flying towards the direction of the Dragon clan at full speed.
When Hathaway staggered back to the sky above the Dragon Clan’s territory, she couldn’t hold on any longer. Her vision turned black and she glided downwards, landing on a mountain square. Soon, the news of the SAINTESS being injured spread throughout the dragon clan. All the elders were alarmed and the clan leader was the first to rush over. At the same time, he brought the best doctor in the Dragon clan to check on Hathaway’s injuries and treat her.
A few days later.
Hathaway gradually woke up. Under the questioning of the patriarch and elders, she told them the whole story of her injury. She knew that she couldn’t hide it. Too many people were involved in this matter, the Magic Scorpion army god of the military and the black-robed elder of the monastery were famous figures. Their disappearance without any reason would definitely attract their close investigation. However, while she was talking, she concealed her real purpose. She only said that she was chasing after a zombie pioneer to reach the outer wall area. Then, she noticed that the situation in the outer wall area was not right and investigated all the way to Mount Utto.
After that, it triggered the big battle that followed.
In addition, she also said that she had met sister Aisha, but she had already turned into a zombie and became the king of zombies.
In fact, the news that Aisha was still alive had already spread to the dragon clan, but no one had seen it with their own eyes. And at this moment, Hathaway’s words immediately caused a huge uproar. All the elders and clan leaders of the Dragon Clan were shocked. It was unbelievable. Aisha, who had been in charge of the wasteland for more than ten years, had killed countless monsters and zombies, aisha had actually been infected into a zombie!
This was simply unbelievable!
Some elders didn’t believe it, but they didn’t say it on the spot.
The patriarch was also half-convinced. He knew the relationship between the sisters, but he felt that Hathaway shouldn’t lie about such things.
No matter what, the Dragon Clan would definitely send someone to check it out personally. However, the information Hathaway provided this time made them estimate the people they sent. The Magic Scorpion War God and the black-robed old man of the monastery were quite powerful. It could even be said that if Hathaway didn’t have the bloodline power.., it would be difficult to win against the two of them, not to mention the other nine pioneers. Such a lineup to go to the outer wall to kill the enemy was like killing a chicken with an ox knife. However, this ox knife was broken!
They had to consider the danger level of the outer wall.
After Hathaway told them the news, she asked about her own situation. The answer she got immediately made people feel cold to the bottom of the valley, and even despair.
“Although the poison in your body has been removed, you came back too late. Even though I had already called someone to treat you, it was still too late. In addition to the poison, there is also Mercury seeping into your body. The doctor could only cut off the inner walls of your organs and wash your blood at the same time to save your life. However, in this way, the bloodline power that you have awakened will all be eliminated, and your strength will also be weakened. However, your life is finally saved.”Hathaway’s father said, the Patriarch of the Dragon clan comforted her.
Hearing this, Hathaway was completely dumbfounded.
The bloodline power had been eliminated?
She had already awakened twice. Could it be that she had become an ordinary pioneer who hadn’t awakened the bloodline power yet?
She lay there in a daze. Her mind couldn’t hold anything else. This blow was a hundred times more difficult to accept than losing an eye!
“Your eye is stable for the time being, but the tissue inside is too damaged and can’t be repaired. After you recover, I will take you to the Monster Research Institute and let them grow another eye for you. Your eyesight will not be inferior to your own.”The patriarch continued to comfort her.
Hathaway was stunned for a long time. She slowly turned her head and looked at the Patriarch of the Dragon Clan. Her father suddenly revealed a bitter smile, “Father, you never know what your child needs…”
The patriarch was stunned and fell silent for a moment.
“I would rather die than receive such a treatment. Who Did This? I want to kill him!”Hathaway’s eyes suddenly revealed a crazy killing intent. She bit her lips, and blood flowed out from the corner of her mouth, then, it slid down the side of her face and onto the bed sheet.
“Your Highness, please be sorry. If we had no other way, we wouldn’t want to do this.”Another white-haired old man sighed, “However, you have already awakened your bloodline power for the second time. Now that your blood has been cleansed, the awakened bloodline is still hidden in your body. In the future, it will be much easier for you to awaken your bloodline power for the second time. Don’t be too disheartened. After you recuperate, perhaps your bloodline power will automatically awaken.”

chapters.title: Chapter 737
chapters.content:
Chapter 737 – Chapter 727: Lost Time [ First Update ]
Hearing the white-bearded old man’s words, Hathaway slowly calmed down. After a moment, she suddenly thought of the black prison she saw outside the giant wall. She immediately told the patriarch and the elders present about this situation, at the same time, she observed their expressions.
After hearing this, the patriarch and the elders looked at each other, their eyes full of surprise.
“Really?”The patriarch asked.
“Of course.”Hathaway answered in a cold voice. At the same time, there was a trace of doubt in her heart. It seemed that her father and the elders didn’t know. It meant that her information channels weren’t blocked by the family. However.., how could the huge black prison be explained? What secret did the Monster Research Institute hide?
“If this is true, then it’s a bit scary!”An elder took a deep breath and said solemnly.
The other elders twitched their eyelids and remained silent.
“Scary?”Hathaway raised her eyebrows and immediately asked: “Is the Monster Research Institute going to use this black prison to deal with us?”
“It’s not impossible…”an elder sighed.
The patriarch coughed and interrupted him. He said to Hathaway: “You have just recovered from a serious injury. Rest well and we will discuss this later. Everyone, let’s go out first.”
The elders didn’t say anything more and turned around to leave with him.
Hathaway narrowed her eyes and fell into deep thought.
Half a day later, in the Western District of an undamaged Earl City, there was a huge building. The surface of the land was vast and boundless. There were also mysteries hidden underground. There were many underground bases that were dozens of meters deep, like bamboo shoots sticking out from the ground, there were all kinds of bases.
This was the headquarters of the Monster Research Institute.
“What! You said that the people of the Dragon clan saw the black prison outside the wall? And it was more than ten meters in size?”In the office of one of the underground bases, a burly middle-aged man in a white coat was shocked. He had a fierce look on his face and was about two and a half meters tall. His temperament was like that of a butcher, but he wore a refined white coat, which made him seem a little unusual and strange, at this moment, he stared at a thin old man who came to report.
The thin old man stood in front of him like a chicken. Hearing his roar, he trembled and said, “This news came from the Dragon Clan. It was said by the injured Princess Hathaway after she woke up.”
“Impossible!”The burly middle-aged man roared, “The black prisons in our branches are still in the experimental cultivation. How could a black prison with a size of more than 10 meters appear? This is a complete black prison. It’s enough to trap a wasteland level pioneer. How could it be cultivated at this stage!”
The thin old man lowered his head and did not dare to reply.
However, a cold-looking woman with oval face and black-rimmed glasses beside the office said, “Director, is it possible that a branch secretly cultivated it but did not report it. Instead, it was secretly sent out of the giant wall to be raised?”
“Impossible!”The burly middle-aged man said without thinking, “The breeding of black prison requires the mixed feeding of the corpses of eight kinds of monsters above level 50. Although these eight kinds of monsters aren’t very precious, they are rare in our area and very difficult to catch. Even if all the resources of each branch were gathered together, they wouldn’t be able to breed one, let alone the process of breeding, which requires repeated experiments and corrections. With the current progress of the experiments, there is no later correction data. Even if there are resources, it is impossible to breed one. Unless there are several times, or even more than ten times the resources, it is impossible to breed one in repeated experiments!”
“Then… could it be that Hathaway was mistaken, or the Dragon Clan intentionally released this information to frame our research institute?”The cold-looking woman slightly frowned. She couldn’t think of any other answer.
The burly middle-aged man’s huge eyeballs slightly rolled. No one knew what he was thinking, but he didn’t answer her.
..
..
“Barton, how long do you think our battle will last?”
At night, on Mt. Utto, the sky was filled with stars. Joseph and Barton sat on the steps on the hillside, looking at the builders of St. Mark’s Square who had been mending the square all night. They pulled the grass on the ground with their hands and said in their mouths.
Barton rolled up the pope’s robe and clamped it on his legs. He sat on the ground with his undergarments. He did not want to dirty the expensive robe. He shook his head, “When we win, or… when he can’t hold on anymore, it will end, right?”
“He may not be able to hold on every time,”Joseph said slowly. His small face was no longer as young and tender as before. There was a mature calmness, “He is the same as us. He is also a human and a lowly commoner. It was not easy for him to get to this point. No one helped him, and we could not help him either. This time, the enemy attacked. We could only watch and pray by the side…”
Barton fell silent and lowered his head.
“We’re his burden.”Joseph’s expression was wooden, as if he was stating a fact.
Barton tilted his head to look at him and said, “Do you plan to leave him?”
“No.”Joseph shook his head. “On the contrary, I’m prepared to not continue being a burden.”
“Oh?”
“Do you remember what he once said? There are many types of strength. It’s not just strength that matters.”Joseph raised his head to look at the night sky, he said, “You dare to go all out. You’re ruthless enough. It’s also strength. I’m going to train for a period of time.”
“Where to?”Barton asked.
“The dirtiest place,”Joseph answered.
Barton was stunned. He looked at him for a while and did not say anything else.
Going to the dirtiest place, was he trying to dye himself into the dirtiest person?
He did not ask, but he knew that this was the only way to bring “Strength”. Because their wrist strength was small, they could only dirty themselves. If they were so dirty that others did not dare to touch their hands, they would win.
This was a way for the weak to “Become stronger”.
“You should stay and continue to assist him. There aren’t many people he can trust, and the people he trusts the most are unable to help him. Wait for my return!”Joseph patted Barton’s shoulder and said goodbye.
Barton raised his hand and gave him a fist bump.
“Don’t forget your original intention,”he said.
Joseph slightly grinned, revealing his snow-white teeth, “If you forget, are you still human?”
The two looked at each other and smiled.
The temple at the end of the square in front of them was brightly lit. The hall was empty except for Dean and Aisha. Dean rested his head on Aisha’s legs. The back of his head was especially cold because of the cold legs. It was uncomfortable as if he was lying on ice. But he still liked to lie on his head because of this position, it made him feel very intimate and warm.
There were several brief histories of the giant wall in his hands. He wanted to look into the secrets of the Witcher family. However, the brief history of the giant wall seemed to erase the time when the Witcher family appeared. He flipped through several of them, he still couldn’t find any information. It was as if a period of time had silently disappeared into the river of history. He found that this period of time was about thirty years after the construction of the giant wall, the record of that period of time was very vague.
There was a reason mentioned in the book. At that time the giant wall had just been built but it wasn’t a book yet so there was no record of it. However he found that it wasn’t the case from the later records.
“It seems that the Witcher family appeared out of thin air and was appointed as the guardian of the giant wall by Queen Sylvia. However Queen Sylvia disappeared from the world not long after the giant wall was built. There are records that she went to the god’s kingdom and there are records that she returned to the god’s realm…”Dudian frowned, although he knew that it was difficult to understand the god of war with the current information he had, but he only wanted to know about the hunter family and the source of the bloodline power of the Hunter family.
Now he was a pioneer. If he wanted to continue to improve, in addition to the vast amount of God’s marrow, there was the bloodline awakening which was an unusual power.
But he didn’t know whether this power was good or bad. He didn’t know how such power could be hidden in the human body. Moreover, there was no such power in the human body. Only the people of the Hunter family had it.
“If only you could talk…”Dudian closed the book and put it on the ground. Aisha’s beautiful face was reflected in his eyes. It looked like an ancient sculpture, he quietly stared at her.

chapters.title: Chapter 738
chapters.content:
Chapter 738 – Chapter 728: Abnormal Situation [ Second Update ]
The next day, St. Mark’s Square had been repaired. Another team of dark church members secretly moved gunpowder into the passage under the square. The fight yesterday was also blocked by the Holy See, only a few well-informed nobles spread the news.
The number of knights stationed in every part of the mountain had doubled. All the patrolling knights knew that all the reasons were caused by the war yesterday. No one dared to guess the enemy of the war, because the most likely target was the inner wall.
Dudian had brought Aisha to the empty place at the back of the square early in the morning to practice her conditioned reflex command. Since he had returned to the wasteland, he had been neglecting his training. He was worried that after a long time, her attacks would increase, his instinct would gradually overshadow his conditioned reflex control. This sign was also displayed after she burst out into her half-demon body state.
This time he mainly strengthened her attack and stopped the two commands. For him, these two points alone were enough.
In the past, he had to let Aisha attack because he was weak and had to use her as a weapon. But that was the situation that he didn’t want to see. He believed that Aisha’s consciousness still existed in her body, if she saw these things, she wouldn’t want to be ferocious and bloodthirsty.
Although Dudian thought that if Aisha attacked then she would be able to keep Aisha. But she didn’t train Aisha to focus her attacks, the first enemy she would attack was the closest to the old man and the general. She wouldn’t chase after Aisha who was far away. Her attack would be the same as his.
Although he had learned his lesson, he didn’t plan to train her in this area. The reason was that similar situations might not appear in the future. Secondly, he didn’t plan to let her attack again, even if he met an enemy like Hathaway, he believed that his own strength and cooperation would be enough to deal with her. He didn’t want to see her roar again..
After the morning training, Dudian went to the temporary laboratory outside the square. He saw Poland and Charmanson busy making the second instrument.
“How do I make the God’s Marrow?”Dudian asked the two of them in the gap between their experiments.
Instead of going to the inner wall to ransack the monster research institute, it would be better to master the method of making the god’s marrow. He believed that it shouldn’t be difficult to get the materials to make the god’s marrow.
Mason had accepted his fate under the guidance of Poland. He was here to help Dudian make the Witcher’s magic tool. He was surprised: “You want us to make God’s marrow? It’s impossible!”
He had witnessed yesterday’s war. He was excited from the beginning to despair at the end. The result was hard for him to accept. But he believed that with the strength of the inner wall, as long as Dudian continued to provoke them.., sooner or later he would be struck by lightning!
“How is it impossible?”
“This, this is a secret. If we make it for you, we will die!”
Poland heard his words. He was about to open his mouth to stop Dudian but was finished by Dudian. He couldn’t help but smile bitterly. He knew that it was too late to stop Dudian. He regretted that he didn’t inform him in advance.
“So you know how to make it?”Dudian’s words extinguished the last bit of hope in Poland’s heart.
Shamanson seemed to be suddenly awakened. He shook his head: “We only know a little bit. We don’t know. This is a secret.”
Dudian didn’t talk to Shamanson anymore. He said to Poland: “Do or don’t do. Tell me what materials you need.”
Poland looked at Charmanson who was trying to make eye contact with him. He wanted to strangle him to death. He thought that Charmanson was a pig-like teammate! He ignored Charmanson’s eyes, he looked at dudian: “We can do it but the materials are difficult. If you can move the equipment from the research institute then it will be the best. If you can’t move it then we can forge a new set. As for the two main materials, one is the soul crystal. It shouldn’t be difficult for you to get it. The other is the divine worm. It is a bit difficult so you need to go to the research institute to get it.”
Charmanson was so angry that he almost fainted. He couldn’t help but stare at Poland.
Poland saw his expression and rolled his eyes. He was too lazy to pay attention to him.
“God’s insect… Alright, how much do you need?”Dudian pondered for a moment.
“It depends on how much God’s marrow you need to make. The breeding speed of God’s insect is very fast. If you want to rob the research institute then the amount of God’s insect stored in the research institute should be enough to make the god’s marrow you need.”Poland said.
Dudian nodded. He wanted to go to the inner wall to deal with the matters of the 12th Earl. He couldn’t let them continue to occupy the city and eliminate the other disaster cities, it wouldn’t take long for the chaos to subside.
After Dudian left, summer couldn’t help but grab Poland’s collar and angrily said: “What are you thinking? Do you know that you are going to kill us? !”
Poland pushed him away and coldly looked at him: “Idiot, do you know that your first sentence has already sentenced us to death?”
“What did you say? !”Charmanson was furious.
“You let him know that we can produce. Unless we die now, we can only obediently produce for him!”Poland coldly looked at him, “Didn’t you see the two war gods from yesterday, Hiro and Ronon? Who are they? War Gods! War gods honed in the military! What would happen to such a figure in his hands? They would have to obediently listen to him and fight for him. They would even be tied to a war chariot by him and be treated like cows and horses!”
Charmanson was stunned.
“This little devil’s methods, even if you’re dead, he can make you talk!”Poland’s gaze was cold as he said, “If you pretended that you didn’t understand at the beginning, we wouldn’t know how to make it. If that’s the case, we might still be able to escape. He still needs us to help him make witcher devices and won’t torture us. But you, this idiot, said something about secrets. You’re really an idiot. If he would sympathize with us, would he still keep us here? Do you think this kid is a compassionate person? !”
Charmanson was completely stunned. His mouth was slightly trembling and he couldn’t speak.
After Dudian left the temple, his keen sense of hearing could still hear the quarrel between Poland and Charmanson. Poland should know that he could hear it. But since things had come to this point, he was too lazy to hide it.
Although Dudian heard it, he was too lazy to pay attention to it. After all, asking the other party to sincerely submit to him was also a lie.
When he was about to go to the inner wall and bid farewell to Aisha, Aisha’s body suddenly trembled without warning. Her calm face was completely distorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 739
chapters.content:
Chapter 739 – : Chapter 729: Natural Awakening [ First Watch ]
Dean was surprised and couldn’t help but take two steps back, worried that she would lose control.
But soon, he knew that he was wrong. Aisha’s body slowly bent and curled up. Her face was full of pain. She put her hands on her head and squatted on the ground, screaming in pain. Her voice was as sharp as a blade.
Dean was startled. He wanted to reach out and pull her into his arms. But his reason told him that it was very dangerous.
His heart was angry and sad. His eyes were slightly moist. It seemed that all the pain that the girl had inflicted on him made him regret. But he could only stand there and watch her scream in pain.
He clenched his teeth and slowly walked closer. He tried to reach out and touch her hair.
Aisha looked up as if she was startled. She bared her teeth and roared angrily at him.
Dudian immediately withdrew his hand but tears flowed out of his eyes. He thought that he wouldn’t cry anymore, but looking at her appearance, his heart broke once again.
What was going on? What was going on?
He felt pain in his heart and was even more puzzled.
At this time, the sound of eggs breaking came from Aisha’s back. The slender jade back slowly protruded with lumps. The lumps grew bigger and sharper, like sprouting bamboo shoots, the lumps grew at a speed visible to the naked eye until they pierced through the soft cheongsam on her back. The lumps were exposed to the air. They were dark red spikes!
The spikes were like bones, but also like a mixture of substances in the stratum corneum. They were extremely ferocious.
Dudian was stunned as he looked at them.
The dark red sharp bones grew more and more luxuriant. The longer ones were about fifty centimeters long. They covered her back like a small bamboo forest. At the same time, on her face and white arms.., dark red veins appeared on her neck and other visible parts of her skin. It was as if blood vessels were protruding out. However, the dark red veins seemed to be flowing with a strange brilliance.
This scene was extremely strange. Dean’s mind was completely blank. He didn’t know why it was like this.
Aisha’s painful groans continued. The dark red bones had slowly stopped growing. She crouched on the ground. Her back was like a hedgehog. At the edge of the sharp bones, dark red liquid was slowly squeezed out, it looked like blood, but there was no smell of blood. It was deeper than the color of blood.
The liquid looked extremely thick. It slowly formed a shape. It was a pair of magic wings.
The magic wings grew larger and larger until they were fully extended. They swept out and knocked away all the chairs on both sides of the hall. The carpet was also torn. Aisha’s hands on the ground were also covered in fine red scales. Her fingers were like claws, she dug the carpet and pierced into the depths of the floor. She entered the demon body state and emitted a frightening murderous aura. She looked like a peerless monster that had escaped from the abyss.
Dudian was shocked by the frightening murderous aura. He didn’t give any orders. How could she suddenly enter the demon body state?
Moreover, the demon body state this time was completely different from the past. It was even more terrifying than the demon body state when Aisha fought with the king of corpses!
At this time, Dudian suddenly saw that the cold aura in her body had disappeared. Her body was emitting an astonishing heat like a thick fireball. The hot air that she exhaled was extremely hot like a flame!
