While he was in a daze, Aisha’s body swayed as she stood up. Her pure black eyes fell on Dean. The two of them looked at each other.
At the moment when they looked at each other, Dean’s mind went blank. It was as if something exploded in the depths of his mind. His eyes opened wide. At this moment, he had a strong feeling that the person in front of him.., was Aisha!
Although her eyes were still pure black, but the look in her eyes was definitely Aisha herself! !
His heart was beating wildly. The blood in his body was boiling as if it was burning. He trembled and couldn’t help but take a step forward.
Just as he took a step, Aisha’s expression suddenly changed. She hugged her head and cried out in pain. Both of her legs fell to the ground.
Dudian quickly went forward to help her.
Unexpectedly, when his fingers touched her arm, Haisha’s arm suddenly shook. A surge of power came from her arm and Dudian’s body flew out. At the same time, he felt a sharp pain in his chest.
He looked down and was stunned. The armor on his chest was broken and there was a clear claw mark. A part of the skin inside was torn off!
He could not help but look up. Aisha fell to the ground, groaning in pain. She rolled around on the ground, and her magic wings drew deep trenches on the surrounding floor. Fortunately, the cable was buried deep, or else she would have been electrocuted on the spot.
After more than ten minutes, Aisha gradually stopped, and her face returned to calmness. It was as if the twisted look of pain did not exist, and her magic body slowly shrank back into her body, her whole body lay on the ground, motionless like a dead body. There was no expression on her face.
Dean slowly got up from the ground and found that the heat on her body was quickly dissipating. She returned to her previous zombie state. There was no breathing and no body temperature. She was just like a corpse.
He was startled. He slowly and carefully moved two steps closer. He raised his hand and shook the bell to give the order to stand up.
Hearing the bell, Aisha’s hands and feet pushed her body in a strange posture and stood up from the ground.
Dean was relieved. He was puzzled. He circled around Aisha and looked around several times. The dark red bone spikes on her back had disappeared. Her back was smooth and white, as beautiful as satin, it seemed that the previous scene was just his illusion.
What happened?
He was confused.
Neuss ran in and saw the mess in the hall. He couldn’t help but ask: “Young Master, Are You Alright? Just now…”
“Nothing.”Dudian didn’t look back. He continued to think: “The trip to the inner wall will be delayed until the evening.”
“I know.”Neuss was puzzled but didn’t ask any more questions. He turned around and left.
Dudian continued to look at Aisha. He frowned. The change was too sudden and there was no warning. He had never heard of the previous strange and terrifying change.
After thinking for a long time, he slowly thought of an answer. He turned out of the hall and went back to the laboratory. He looked at the busy Poland and Charmanson and called them to the front, he asked: “The Awakening of the Dragon’s bloodline is seven degrees. Do you know what the changes are like each time?”
Poland and Charmanson looked at each other. They were puzzled as to why Dudian suddenly asked this question.
“Speak!”Dudian didn’t give them time to exchange eyes and think.
Poland frowned and thought for a moment: “The awakening of the bloodline of the Witcher family is special. We don’t know about it. But our research institute has the most outstanding information about the dragon’s ancestors.”
“Tell me about it.”
Poland said.
Dudian nodded: “I got it.”He turned around and went back to the temple.
“It is the awakening of the bloodline.”Dudian looked at Aisha who was expressionless. His guess was right. The previous terrifying change was caused by the awakening of her bloodline power. It was the fifth awakening!
The Awakening of the bloodline of the Witcher family was extremely difficult. Aisha was forced into a desperate situation when she was fighting with the undead king. She had awakened the fourth awakening. It was not long ago but she had awakened again. This was an incredible thing. Under normal circumstances.., it would never happen. However, Dean thought of an explanation which was the corpse poison!
After all, if an ordinary person was infected with the corpse poison and turned into an undead, their physique would increase by two to three times! Although the zombie virus was a virus, it could bring a great degree of improvement to the human body. The speed of improvement was far faster than the speed of natural evolution. If evolution was the division and rebirth of cells, then the improvement brought by the virus.., was the frenzied reproduction and division.

chapters.title: Chapter 740
chapters.content:
Chapter 740 – Chapter 730: Destruction [ Second Update ]
“The ordinary senior Hunter was infected into a zombie and her strength was comparable to a borderline. She was originally a pioneer. Although she lacked a witcher but her physique was stronger than before. I just didn’t expect that her bloodline power would evolve in the virus…”Dudian stared at Aisha who was silent, he didn’t know whether this change was good or bad. Would she slowly awaken until the seventh degree as the virus divided in her body?
At that time, would she still be under his control?
What would happen then?
He was a bit uneasy. However, he recalled the feeling when her bloodline awakened. Although the feeling was short-lived, he could feel that what he saw at that time was the real her!
He did not know if this feeling was an illusion or if it was caused by excessive longing, but he did not want to doubt it. That feeling was like a brand that stayed in his mind and could not be erased, his faith and confidence in reviving her became even stronger!
After a dead silence, he raised his hand and held her hand, watching her reaction — there was no reaction.
He slowly breathed a sigh of relief. He held her hand and gently held it. He felt the warmth of his palm slowly spread to her palm. How happy would he be if he could hold her hand forever?
He gently held her hand and stared at her beautiful face. Time seemed to not exist.
After a long time, he slowly came back to his senses. He let go of her hand that was already warm. He whispered: “I will find you!”
Aisha was silent.
Dudian helped her to the bedroom and sat her down. He was a pioneer now. He didn’t plan to bring her with him this time.
After settling her down, Dudian turned around and left. His mind was focused again, “The bloodline power of the Witcher family can be stimulated by the virus. I wonder if the people of the Witcher family know about this. What is the structure of the virus? I really want to see the state of its movement in the human body…”
He came to the side hall and cleaned and bandaged the wound on his chest. Fortunately, he often helped Aisha wash her body. Although her teeth would secrete virus, but her fingernails did not contain lethal poison like ordinary zombies, most of the zombies lived outside the wall. In addition to the virus, there were all kinds of monster’s hair and flesh gaps. There were countless bacteria growing in them, but Aisha’s fingers were as clean as jade, they wouldn’t be infected if they were scratched by her.
Evening.
Dudian went to the inner wall alone after he had recovered.
He flew up the giant wall and saw that the number of troops stationed on the wall of sighs had increased. There were seven or eight heat sources who were strong. They were all boundary level experts. There was also a pioneer level heat source.
He knew that the inner wall had been alerted to the outer wall.
He flew outside the giant wall and flew through the giant wall. After he entered the inner wall he climbed over the giant wall and landed in the inner wall.
After landing he followed the map of the inner wall and rushed towards one of the isolated cities.
On the way he found that there were wandering undeads in the wilderness. There were some undeads fighting with the monsters in the wilderness.
In addition, he saw a few wanderers in the wilderness. Their clothes and fabrics were good but they were tattered. It was obvious that they were refugees.
He didn’t help them. He went around and rushed towards his target city.
More than half an hour later, he arrived in front of a city. There were a lot of soldiers stationed in the fortress. The air was filled with a strong smell of blood. It was different from the previous two times he had come to the fortress, the fortress seemed to have been occupied by the army. There were no traces of undeads. The air was filled with the smell of burnt corpses.
Dudian easily passed through the defense of the army. He climbed over the wall to the city. The streets were covered in blood but there were no corpses. It was obvious that the streets were cleaned up, it was inevitable that the air would spread plague and disease.
He walked along the street and slowly released his perception. He didn’t see any survivors on the way. He occasionally saw the remains of the undeads wandering in the houses.
After walking for a while, Dudian met an army that was cleaning the undeads in the city. There were only ten people. They were all limiter. Killing the undeads was like cutting vegetables. He looked at them from afar. It felt like hunters were hunting undeads outside the giant wall. Some were responsible for attracting the undeads with blood and sound while others were responsible for killing them. Usually the speed of the undeads was not as fast as the speed of killing.
“If it was in the old era, it would be time to drive a tank into the city…”Dudian couldn’t help but have such a thought. He didn’t walk away. This time he didn’t just come to the inner wall to look for the divine worm, the most important thing was to destroy things.
He slowly approached.
He heard the ten people laughing and chatting as they hunted the undeads. They didn’t treat their surroundings as a disaster zone.
“It feels so F * cking satisfying to slaughter so openly!”
“Killing undeads is so much better than killing monsters. Haha!”
“I’ll take a rest after I clean this area. I brought beer.”
“You are so smart…”
“Don’t be too careless. Be careful to lead the senior undeads away.”
The few of them were talking nonsense but their hands didn’t stop. The undeads that were attracted by the smell of blood from an animal’s corpse quickly fell to the ground. There were corpses all over the ground and their heads were destroyed.
Dudian and others came close to a certain distance. He looked around and saw that there was no one else around. His eyes flashed and he suddenly attacked.
Whoosh!
He was like a sharp arrow in the dark night. He quickly rushed towards the nearest strong man.
The strong man was swinging his machete and hacking at the undeads. Before he could react he was attacked from behind by Dudian. Dudian’s scythe arm cut off his neck and he was still laughing, then his head fell to the ground and rolled a few times.
Another slim woman in military uniform had her back facing the Brawny man as she killed the undeads. She turned her head and laughed: “What, is it…”before she finished her sentence she saw the headless body of the Brawny Man Standing Still, blood spurted out from his neck. At the same time an unfamiliar face appeared in front of her.
Her smile froze for a moment.
Before she could react, Dudian’s arm pierced through her heart and continued to rush towards the other person.
The person who was standing on the high ground quickly noticed the change: “There is an enemy attack!”
“What? !”
The others turned their heads one after another.
Dudian’s movement didn’t stop. He was like a black civet as he flashed past and killed two people in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 741
chapters.content:
Chapter 741 – Chapter 731: One Versus Two [ First Update ]
The others opened their eyes wide. They saw that Dudian was a pioneer and immediately fled in all directions.
Whoosh!
One of them pulled out the pipe. A long rainbow shot into the sky accompanied by a sharp whistle. It was a signal flare.
Dudian’s expression didn’t change as he calmly chased after them one by one.
After a few minutes, the battle ended. None of the ten people who escaped were killed. Dudian didn’t stop. He covered the smell and turned around to fly in another direction.
About ten minutes after he left, a figure came from the distance. He looked at the ten dead bodies on the ground. His face was pale and his eyes were cold. He looked around, after making sure that the murderer wasn’t hiding in the surroundings, he jumped down from the building and landed in front of a corpse. He touched the wound and checked it.
At the same time, Dudian followed the route of the map and ran towards the direction of the Monster Institute.
He saw some wandering undeads along the way but ignored them.
Half an hour later, he appeared outside the Monster Institute. The city’s Monster Institute was also built in a remote place. There were two hills around it. There were poisonous snakes and insects in the woods. He walked through the woods and stood on the top of the hill, he looked through the building built by the Monster Research Institute on the ground and saw more than ten patrolling figures inside. They were all high-level limiters, two more than the monster research institute that he had robbed before.
His eyes flashed slightly and he focused his eyes on the underground base. There were many light-colored ordinary heat source figures wandering inside. They were busy with their own things and there was nothing unusual.
He hid on the mountain and quietly watched.
Half an hour later, the underground base of the research institute was as usual. There was no unusual movement. He no longer hesitated. He activated his magic body and crawled on the ground. He rushed down the slope like a monster.
There were sharp limbs on his back. It was as if there were more than a dozen blades on his body. He cut the snake which was disguised as rotten leaves into pieces as he ran. He rushed to the front of the research institute in a few seconds.
The ten people in the research institute immediately noticed the unusual movement. They shouted out in alarm. Dudian had already jumped into the building and killed one of the guards by the window.
“Enemy Attack!”
“Come!”
“Release the signal…”
All kinds of calls sounded. Dudian was like a beast out of its cage as he pounced on the surrounding limiter.
Some of the limiter activated their magic bodies. Some brandished their weapons to resist. Some took the initiative to attack… but as soon as they met Dudian they were cut into pieces. Dudian’s body was too sharp. It was like countless blades were churning. The strength was extraordinary. Ordinary metal weapons were cut in an instant. They were as fragile as wood, one of them who activated the rare magic Mark ‘Dragon Steel’magic body was also killed by Dudian in an instant.
Dragon steel magic marks were the strongest kind of rare magic marks. They were known for their terrifying defensive power. They could make the whole body as hard as steel, especially the back. It was harder than ordinary metal, even the advanced weapons made from the limbs of monsters might not be able to cut it. But the fragile paper in front of Dudian’s limbs was torn in an instant.
In the blink of an eye, there were seven or eight scattered corpses around dudian. Some of them had a horrible hole in their chest and some of them had half of their heads cut off, some of their bodies were broken into pieces… the rest escaped to the underground base.
Dudian was about to rush in when his pupils shrank. He saw two extremely hot figures suddenly appear in the underground base. They were two pioneers!
“Ambush?”His eyes flashed with murderous intent. The two pioneers hid the heat source in the underground base. He didn’t use X-ray vision and only used the heat source to capture them, however, at this moment, the intensity of the heat source exposed by the two pioneers was only at the level of an ordinary pioneer. It could not be compared to Hiro and Luonong.
He did not retreat. He broke into the underground base at a faster speed and passed by the two limiters who had just run to the stairs. The bodies of the two immediately froze. Immediately, blood sprayed out from all parts of their bodies and pushed them away, they were broken into pieces and fell to the ground. Their organs and blood rolled on the ground.
At this time, two pioneer heat sources rushed out from the underground base. They were a young man and a young woman. The woman was less than twenty years old while the man was in his early twenties.
Dudian knew that there were many drugs in the monster research institute that could preserve youth. Although it couldn’t restore the appearance of a fifty or sixty year old man to that of a teenager, but it wasn’t difficult to change the appearance of a man in his 30s or 40s into a young man in his early 20s. If there was a persistent pursuit in this area then he could change his skin. But the price was too high.
“Who are you? !”The young man saw the two piles of flesh and blood on the steps. There was anger in his eyes. He coldly stared at Dudian. He had seen that Dudian was just an ordinary pioneer. He was relieved.
Dudian didn’t waste any time and directly rushed towards the two.
“Kill!”The sixteen or seventeen-year-old girl shouted as she entered the magic body state. The lower half of her body turned into a long snake tail. There were two broken wings on her back which looked like a split sword, there was a cold light.
The youth didn’t hold back. His magic body was like a giant ape. It was three meters tall. Dark golden hair appeared on his body. The muscles on his chest were as full as granite. His mouth was full of animal teeth.
Dudian had rushed over when the two entered the body. His movements were strange. He looked like a fox but also like a monkey. The sharp limbs on his back and chest were shaking in the air, the sound of the friction made people’s teeth ache. All the sharp limbs shot out when the youth was close to the giant ape. At the same time, his body bounced up from the ground and pounced on his chest.
The young man roared as he raised his huge fist.
Rip! Rip!
Dudian’s body fell into the arms of the young man. His hands went into his chest. On the contrary, the young man’s eyes were wide open. His face was full of disbelief and fear.
The next moment, Dudian retreated and dodged the attack of the woman.
The body of the young man fell down. There were two bloody holes in his chest which were pierced through by Dudian’s arms. Both of his fists were cut off!
He was killed on the spot!
Dudian deeply felt the horror of the magic marks of the splitter. If it was any other enemy, the young man would have a chance to play. But his body was full of sharp limbs. More than 80% of his body parts could be used as sharp blades to attack, the young giant ape had no way to attack!
“No!”Snake girl was shocked as she saw the young giant ape fall to the ground. Her face was full of fear. She suddenly opened her mouth and spat out a green liquid from the back of her teeth.
The speed of the liquid was very fast but Dudian was prepared for it. He jumped up from the ground and dodged the green liquid. At the same time he pounced towards snake girl.
Snake girl held two thin swords in her hands and slashed towards Dudian. The sword light danced like two silver discs. However, the moment it touched Dudian’s limbs, the dancing silver sword light suddenly stopped, it was like a rapidly moving fan was suddenly stuck. There was a sound of metal breaking. A thin sword broke and the tip of the sword fell to the ground.
Snake Girl’s eyes opened wide as she twisted her tail and retreated.
Dudian’s sharp limbs quickly grabbed her like a palm and surrounded her.
“AH ——”a scream echoed as snake girl’s body was surrounded by sharp limbs. Blood oozed out of her body. The dark green snake phosphorus on her body was useless as it could easily cut her.
Dudian twisted his body and the sharp limbs instantly rotated. Snake Girl’s scream was shrill but soon stopped. Her upper body was cut into several pieces. The lower half of her body fell to the ground. The end of her tail was still gently rolling.

chapters.title: Chapter 742
chapters.content:
Chapter 742 – Chapter 732: Inquiring [ Second Update ]
The battle ended very quickly. Although Dudian felt that he could kill them but he didn’t expect it to be so easy. He suddenly felt that he had underestimated his actual combat ability, perhaps it was a bit difficult compared to Xiro who was at the peak of the wilderness. But compared to ordinary pioneers he was far behind.
He put away his demon body and took out a small bottle from his pocket. He walked to the young giant ape and poured a few drops of water from the bottle onto the bloody hole in his chest. Then, he walked to Snake Girl and dripped a few drops into the wound on her neck.
Although he did not know if it was too late, if he succeeded, he could create two more pioneers’zombies.
He had to push the chaos in the inner wall to the extreme if he wanted to give himself room to grow.
After doing all this, he turned around and rushed into the underground base. Although the battle here was short, the people in the base had been alerted. At this moment, they were rushing out of the various laboratories in a hurry. The alarm bells rang continuously on all the floors.
He flew all the way and casually killed the researchers along the way. A few minutes later, in a laboratory on the eighth floor of the underground base, he looked at the white-bearded old man in front of him and his young female assistant. He could now identify the identity of the Doctor from the monster research institute from his clothes and work badge, he said to the old man, “Hand over the god’s syrup here and the god Bug.”
The young female assistant was so scared that she was trembling. Her face was pale as she hid behind the white-bearded old man.
In the corridor outside the laboratory, the corpses of people in white coats fell to the ground. Blood dyed the corridor red. It looked like hell on Earth.
The white-bearded old man stared at dudian: “Even if you kill me, you won’t be able to get it!”
“I know. Poland told me that if I want to get the worm, I have to use your password. Otherwise, the things inside will be destroyed.”Dudian’s hands were stained with blood, “Old Man, don’t be stubborn with me. You will pay the price you don’t want to see.”
“If you have the ability then kill me!”The old man stared at Dudian without fear.
Dudian’s eyes were indifferent. He looked at the old man for a while. Suddenly he raised his hand. A sharp blade protruded from his arm and pierced through the chest of the young female assistant behind the old man, the sharp blade protruded from her back and lifted her whole body.
“What do you think?”Dudian calmly said: “I will give you three seconds. I will stop in time and she will survive.”
The old man angrily looked at him. He clenched his fists and his body trembled. He clenched his teeth: “You, you!”
Dudian waved his arm. The young female assistant was thrown out like a sandbag. She hit the door and died.
“I won’t let you off even if I Die! !”The white bearded old man gnashed his teeth and pointed at Dudian’s nose: “You will die a horrible death! !”
Dudian slowly said: “Even if you don’t say it, it doesn’t matter. I can smoothly come here because I have some understanding of you. You are not afraid of death. What about your family? If you think that they are not afraid of death then you can continue to be stubborn. It doesn’t matter. I can continue to go to the next research institute. I believe that the next person won’t be as stupid as you.”
The white bearded old man’s eyes were wide open. There was a trace of fear in his eyes.
“Your stubbornness will only lead to the death of the next research institute. You will lose your life as well. You should learn from Charmanson and Poland. You should simply surrender and give everything to me.”Dudian continued to coerce.
Ten minutes later Dudian carried two large bags out of the research institute. One bag was filled with the semi-finished product ‘Black Prison’which was produced by the Research Institute. The other bag was filled with the divine insects which were stored in iron bottles. The old man was lying in front of the oval metal instrument which was used to cultivate the divine insects. His chest was pierced.
Dudian didn’t plan to take him out of the research institute. He had Charmanson and Poland to help him. Moreover he had to go to Earl City Tonight to check the situation. He had lost his eyes and eyes. The inner wall was in chaos, it was extremely difficult for him to pass the information. He had to come over personally to check the situation.
The night was dark. From time to time there were screams of undeads coming from the streets of the city. There was no sound of metal colliding.
Dudian went out of the city. He went straight to the west and arrived at the giant wall. He buried the two bags under the giant wall. He didn’t return to the previous city, he went straight to the east. After two hours he arrived in front of a magnificent city.
The fortress of the city was lit. Soldiers were stationed there. The smell of blood in the air was weak. It was almost hard to smell. Compared to other cities, the place was calm as if it had never been attacked by the undeads.
However Dudian saw the corpses of the undeads on the road outside the city. There were arrows nailed to their heads.
Dudian looked up for a moment. He moved to the side of the fortress and quietly climbed over the wall.
It was a piece of cake for a pioneer to sneak into the city.
Dudian was surprised to see the situation inside the city. It was very lively. The streets were full of lights and pedestrians were wandering. There was no smell of war, it was like the city that he saw when the chaos didn’t break out.
He knocked out a civilian who was alone in the shadows. He took off his clothes and put them on. He mixed with the crowd and walked as he looked around. After walking along the city wall for a few streets, Dudian saw the changes. There were several high walls built around the city wall. It seemed that they were used for isolation.
“I’m starving to death.”Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed as he came to a nearby pub.
The best place to ask for information was naturally the tavern.
“One Cup.”Dudian sat at the bar counter and shouted.
“Young man, what kind of wine do you want?”A beautiful woman smiled charmingly.
“The most expensive wine.”Dudian said.
“Young man is so forthright.”The smile on the beautiful woman’s face was even more charming, “I’ll give it to you.”
Soon a cup of dark red wine was placed in front of him. The wine was different. Even the cup wasn’t made of wood.
Dudian took it but didn’t drink it. He muttered to himself: “If I don’t spend money then I won’t have the life to spend it when the plague comes.”
The gorgeous woman heard his mutter and smiled: “Young Man You are right. Do you want to have another Cup?”
Dudian was speechless. He wanted to talk about the corpse plague but didn’t expect that she would take advantage of the situation and use his words to encourage him to spend money. It seemed that he couldn’t be too subtle with these people, he immediately said: “Aren’t you afraid that the corpse plague will come here? I heard that many people died in other cities.”
The beautiful woman spat, “Young man, it’s such a Killjoy to talk about this at night. Why would the corpse plague come to our city? We have the protection of Earl Feinan. A few days ago a large group of people came and were shot to death outside the city.”

chapters.title: Chapter 743
chapters.content:
Chapter 743 – Chapter 733: Littleflower -Lfirstiwatchatch ]
Dudian saw the undeads outside the city. He knew that she was right. He looked around carefully, “Isn’t the rumor that the corpse plague was created by the joint efforts of the Earl, the monastery and the military? Will it be more dangerous if we continue to stay here?”
The beautiful woman was startled. She quickly covered Dudian’s mouth and stared at him. She slowly let go of Dudian’s hand but her eyes were full of warning, “Don’t talk nonsense. Do you want my shop to be smashed?”
“I have no choice but to do so.”Dudian immediately apologized. It was no wonder that he didn’t hear anyone talking about this matter in the tavern. He had his spies spread the news in the Earl’s city, it was as if they had disappeared.
It was no wonder that the rumors were not only limited to the wise but also the strong.
The beautiful woman looked at Dudian. She thought that Dudian had spent a lot of money, she whispered: “Don’t tell anyone about this matter. If it is leaked, be careful of going to the dark prison! Even if the news is true, we have no way out. We can only stay here. There are corpse plagues everywhere outside the city. If we go out, we will die!”
“Can we spend money to hire strong people to protect us?”Dudian immediately asked.
The beautiful woman shook her head, “Don’t think about it. As you said, who would bring a burden out of the city when it is life-threatening?”? Unless you have tens of thousands of gold… however, if you really have so much money, I advise you to stay here. If you are afraid of death, then use this money to bribe the people from the military. Maybe you can get shelter and give it to those who met by chance to lead the way out of the city. In the blink of an eye, they will rob you and throw your body into the wilderness. That would be an unjust death.”
Dudian saw that she had a good heart and nodded: “Thank you. I will treat you to another Cup.”
“Treat me?”The beautiful woman didn’t expect that Dudian would be so generous. She smiled: “Thank you.”
Dudian took two sips and got up. He took out ten banknotes from his back and handed them to her: “Is this enough?”
“Of course it is. There is more.”The beautiful woman immediately took the money from the drawer behind the counter and gave it to Dudian.
Dudian took the money but didn’t put it into his pocket. He turned around and walked away. As he passed by a strong man who was drinking, his arm slightly shook. The banknotes disappeared and were stuffed into the pockets of the strong man. It was his money, naturally he had to return the excess to him.
“It seems that the effect of spreading rumors is not ideal.”Dudian walked out of the pub and walked down the street, “It seems that it is impossible for the Earl City to be in chaos. If we continue to maintain this trend and use the 12th Earl City as the foundation, we will send troops to clean up the other cities. In less than half a month, all the cities will be cleaned up and restored to life.”
Such a situation was something that the civilians and nobles in the inner wall were happy to see, but it was not what he wanted to see. He needed to save up time for himself, so he had to keep the inner wall area in chaos.
“It seems that I can only prepare other methods.”His eyes flashed slightly. He walked around the outer wall of the city and observed the city defense forces everywhere. He found that most of them were guarded by hunters, every few hundred meters, there would be a border protector stationed there. At the four main city gates, there would be a pioneer stationed there.
With such a city defense force alone, he could easily break through it. However, he believed that near the Count’s castle at the center of the city, there would be at least one war god level pioneer stationed there. There might even be two to three of them. He did not plan to get close.., after circling around the city, he quietly climbed over a weak city wall and left. He did not follow his previous plan to wreak havoc. These people guarding the city were only hunters. No matter how many he killed, it would be useless.
Moreover, after understanding the security situation in the count’s city, he knew that even if he created one or two more pioneer zombies, it would not be able to delay the recovery time of the inner wall area.
He took advantage of the night and left quickly. Two hours later he came to the giant wall where the god’s marrow was hidden. He checked the bag that was sealed in black prison. He was relieved to see that black prison was still inside the glass tank, he flew up the giant wall.
It was two o’clock in the morning when he returned to the top of the mountain. It was late at night. The top of the mountain was quiet and the moonlight was cold.
Dudian descended from the sky and landed in front of the temple. He gently pushed the door and entered. The candlelight was bright and the wall lamp was burning quietly. Aisha was sitting alone on the bed. She was still in the same position as when Dudian left.
Dudian felt guilty when he saw her blank expression. He put down the things in his hand and sat down with her.
He told her the whole process of going to the inner wall. It was as if he was talking about a very simple thing. In the end, his hand transformed into a small purple flower. He handed it to her nose and smiled, “Is your favorite purple good?”
Aisha sat in a daze and didn’t answer.
Dudian smiled and put the flower between her hair. He took a mirror from the side and handed it to her, “Is it good?”
”…”the response was still silence.
Dudian’s smile didn’t change. He put down the mirror and went to the side of the bedroom. He took the bottle of hot water, washed his hands, washed his face, and then washed the towel. He took the clean warm towel back to her and held her hand, he gently wiped his fingers with the towel. Each finger was as white as jade. It was a daily habit of his.
Ten minutes later, after wiping her body and changing into new clothes, he helped her lie down and caressed her eyes. After doing all this, he turned around and returned to the basin. He washed his hands, wrung out the towel, and returned to the hall again. He untied the bundle that was placed on the carpet, took out the divine worm and black prison, and left the divine hall with the two objects, he went to the laboratory on the side of the square.
Although it was late at night but the laboratory was still brightly lit.
Dudian entered the door.
The three alchemists who were busy saw Dudian. They were scared and quickly saluted.
Dudian put down the items and asked them to wake up Charmanson and Poland.
After a moment the two came to him and yawned.
“Mr. Dean, if we don’t Sleep well, we won’t be able to work during the day…”Mason grumbled as he walked over.
“This is the God’s insect. I have taken it back. I hope that you can make the god’s marrow with the greatest benefit.”Dudian pointed at the things on the table, “Don’t be lazy. I have asked Dr. Lowe how much God’s marrow you can make every day. I know in my heart. I hope that you won’t let me use superfluous means to force you.”He said of Dr. Lowe, it was the old man with the white beard.
Poland and Charmanson’s drowsiness disappeared as they heard Dudian’s words. Their eyes were wide open as they looked at the black prison and the insect god. They didn’t expect that Dudian would be able to get the things back in such a short time.
“Have you seen Dr. Lowe? where is he?”Poland’s eyes moved away from the black prison and asked Dudian.
“I killed him.”Dudian’s expression didn’t change. It seemed that he had killed a fly.
Poland and Charmanson were stunned as they looked at Dudian. They knew that Dudian wasn’t lying!
“You, you even killed Dr. Lowe!”Poland clenched his fists: “You Are Inhuman!”
Charmanson didn’t expect that he would dare to talk like this. He was scared and stepped back a bit, at the same time he asked Dudian: “Mr. Dean, Why didn’t you bring Dr. Lowe back? His technology is much better than ours.”
“You two are enough. Unless you don’t want to live, I can catch another one to replace you.”
Summer Manson mouth slightly twitch, no more words.

chapters.title: Chapter 744
chapters.content:
Chapter 744 – Chapter 734: The Second Update
Dudian went back to the temple after he left the laboratory. He took out the god’s marrow and injected two tubes of it into his body. He felt that his body was boiling hot. He climbed onto the bed and went to sleep.
Dudian woke up on time the next morning. He called Neuss to ask about the situation in the outer wall area.
The outer wall had become peaceful. Although Dudian’s proposed policies had caused a huge uproar but it had gradually calmed down. Occasionally there would be some chaos which was dealt with by Richelieu and Barton, the four forces of the magistrate, Holy Church, military and dark council had joined hands. The nobles of the outer wall had no choice but to bow their heads.
Although the nobles were strong but there were a lot of them. They were loose and couldn’t compete with the four forces.
Dudian was able to control the entire outer wall. He had the military’s “Military”and the magistrate’s “Law”as well as the holy church’s “Faith”in his hands, even if he reversed the situation, it was legal. No one dared to object.
“It will take at least three days to develop the mountain and fill it with gunpowder.”Neuss said.
Dudian frowned, “So Long?”
Although it was a huge project and it was rare to complete it in three days. But don’t forget that he had a lot of labor and money in his hands. He could drive countless civilians to work for him.
“There is a wall builder who has investigated. The rock structure in the mountain is very special. It will be difficult to break through.”Neuss lowered his head.
Dudian frowned. Three days was a bit slow for him. Although the inner wall region would recover in half a month but it didn’t mean that the inner wall region wouldn’t send troops to attack the outer wall region. After all, Hathaway had led many pioneers to attack the inner wall region, it would definitely cause a huge uproar if it involved all the forces. It was enough for the inner wall to pay attention to it.
“You should send people to the parliament to select some hunters who are good at opening rocks and have similar magic marks ability to assist.”Dudian said after thinking for a moment.
“I understand, master.”Neuss nodded. There was a trace of worry in his eyes. He saw that Dudian was mobilizing the troops. This meant that the crisis was imminent.
“How is the pharmacist Camp of the parliament? Is there anything that can be taken out?”Dudian didn’t wait for Neuss to leave.
Neuss paused for a moment: “Since the establishment of the pharmacist camp we have been studying all kinds of drugs. There is a big breakthrough in the treatment of drugs. If there is a war in the future…”
“What about poisons?”Dudian interrupted him.
“Poisons?”Neuss was startled: “The research on poisons is slow. Considering that we are going to fight against the inner wall, the pharmacists camp will focus on the treatment…”
Dudian sighed in his heart. He blamed himself for not reminding them earlier, “No need to research on the treatment drugs. Stop immediately and let them develop poisons. No matter what type they are, as long as they can make people lose the ability to fight then it will be fine. The most important thing is that they must be unable to solve the problem!”
“Uh… do all the pharmacists make poisons?”
“Yes.”
“Then the medicine…”
“If the war really comes, the soldiers of the outer wall won’t be able to compete with the inner wall. If the battlefield is one-sided and massacred, what’s the use of the medicine?”
Neuss was startled: “But… but if that’s the case then why did you let the Barbarians move into the slums and let the Army recruit people? Wouldn’t that be sending them to their deaths…”
“Yes, but not in vain.”Dudian saw that Neuss hadn’t understood his intention, he could only say: “There are only two options for the inner wall to recapture us. The first is to send the pioneers to kill me and reduce the number of innocent casualties. The second is to launch an all-out attack. In this case, if all the people in the outer wall are soldiers then they will have to think twice.”
“They want to recover but not destroy the outer wall.”
Neuss suddenly understood. He didn’t think that Dudian would use the lives of these people as a bargaining chip instead of strength. It was true that no matter how many soldiers there were they wouldn’t be able to compare with the fighting strength of the inner wall, he didn’t have the capital to think of them as strength.
“But…”Neuss looked at dudian, “Although the military’s recruitment benefits are high but there aren’t many people who join the army. If the war really starts then these civilians may not be willing to help us.”
“They will help us.”Dudian’s eyes were calm, “They have enough reasons to fight for us. This reason is the reason that the inner wall has been reminding them for the past 300 years.”
“What reason?”
“You can become a noble if you go out to kill the enemy!”
..
..
Four days passed in the blink of an eye.
Everything was carried out in an orderly manner. The mountain had been completely opened up and filled with explosives. With the cooperation of a large number of hunters, the entire project only took two days.
At the same time, countless miners were digging and opening up the saltpeter mines in the outer wall area.
The entire outer wall area was in the stage of preparation for war.
Dudian had been staying in the temple for the past four days to practice combat. He was thinking about the current situation and the means of deployment. He was observing the inner wall area and arranging people to infiltrate it.
Although the war could break out at any time but he had to send his men into the inner wall to make long-term plans.
“Unfortunately, the time is too short.”
“If I have three years then I won’t need to spend a single soldier to subdue the inner wall.”
Dudian sighed in his heart. Some people felt that time was too slow and they couldn’t spend it all. Some people didn’t have enough time.
The number of soldiers patrolling on the wall of sighs was hundreds of miles away. The outline of the human city was clearly visible but the war was still raging. There was smoke everywhere and the city was in ruins, there were many towering and strong city walls that were destroyed. The traces of destruction were shocking. The air was filled with the strong smell of rotting corpses.
The clouds were ethereal, and the breeze was gentle.
All of these changes could not affect the sky that was thousands of miles high. Sunlight quietly penetrated through the clouds and shone outside the towering giant wall, in the hunter’s zone that was inhabited by monsters, one by one, huge monsters crawled and caught their prey.
At the end of this area, a group of human figures slowly appeared.
These human figures stood in a row and walked. They were all wearing large robes and carrying all kinds of strange weapons on their backs. Some of the weapons were giant scythes that were four to five meters long, and some were giant sticks that were full of spikes.
They walked very slowly, but their figures quickly became clear. A wild boar-like monster that was gnawing on the zombies sensed the human figures and immediately rushed toward them while howling.
Before it got close, it suddenly flew backward, and its several-ton body exploded into a sea of blood in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 745
chapters.content:
Chapter 745 – Chapter 735: Invasion
No one made a move, but the group of people still maintained the pace of strolling forward. They were calm and composed as they lined up in a row. There were a total of ten people. Each of them had a unique temperament that was as eye-catching as a black hole. When they passed by the corpse of the monster whose organs were scattered all over the ground, one of them bent down and reached out to grab a heart that was still beating and well-preserved from the chaotic organs. He lowered his head and ate it, it made a cracking sound.
At this time, the other nine people came to the shadow of the giant wall and stopped. They looked up at the majestic and steep giant wall.
“We’re finally here.”One of them lifted the hood on his head, revealing a handsome face. However, there was a twisted tattoo of a centipede on the left side of his face, which made his faint smile look a little ferocious.
“Squeak, Squeak, Squeak. There’s actually no one guarding the giant wall. The people inside this giant wall sure live a comfortable life…”another person let out a sharp mouse-like voice, and his shoulders kept shaking as he spoke.
“Let’s go up and take a look first,”said another petite woman. After saying that, her body suddenly jumped up the giant wall, and then she ran up the steep and straight giant wall at high speed, as if the gravity on the ground had lost its effect on her.
In the blink of an eye, she arrived at the top of the giant wall and stood at the edge. The ground below her feet was a thousand meters below her, like a cliff. People who were afraid of heights would feel dizzy just by looking at it, but she was very calm, she allowed the strong wind blowing from the high sky to flutter her robe.
“He’s really impatient!”Another person shook his head and jumped up. This jump was more than a hundred meters high. He clapped his palm on the giant wall, as if he could use the force to jump up again. After repeating this for more than ten times, he quickly climbed up the giant wall.
The others also displayed their abilities. Some transformed into wings and flew directly onto the giant wall. Some had their hands stuck to the giant wall like suckers and climbed up like geckos.
In the blink of an eye, the ten people all stood on the top of the towering giant wall. Looking over, they immediately revealed surprised expressions.
“It’s All Wilderness? Why is the inside of this divine wall even more desolate than the outside?”
“There’s no sign of human activity. If we hadn’t walked all the way here, I would have thought that we had just climbed over the wall. We just came out of the divine wall.”
“Zhi Zhi Zhi, such a barren place. No Wonder His Highness said that there are no rulers here.”
“Every divine wall is the same size. The humans in this divine wall seem to only live in the central area. Their population is completely incomparable to ours. Boss, should we exterminate the Witcher family here while we’re at it?”
As soon as he finished speaking, the gazes of a few of them fell on a hunchbacked old man among them. The Old Man’s face was snow-white, as if he did not have any hair. There was a small black snake tattoo on his cheek. He shook his head slightly, “Our mission this time is to seize the God’s corpse of the Sylvia Goddess of war. Don’t do other meaningless things.”
“But his highness said that if necessary, we can also weaken the power here so that we can use it in the future.”The one who asked earlier said.
“Big Brother, there are no rulers here. Who Dares to fight with us? Why don’t we sweep this place while we’re at it? Maybe we can get some treasures.”
“Zhi Zhi Zhi, I agree!”
The old man glanced at them and sighed. “Since your hands are Itchy, you can go by yourselves. But first, let’s get down to business.”
After getting his permission, the few of them immediately revealed bloodthirsty looks. They were so excited that they seemed to want to jump down from the divine wall immediately to slaughter.
“Old Seven, you stay here.”The old man said to a short youth on the left. “You can’t get into trouble. Otherwise, we’ll be trapped here forever and can’t go back.”
“Big Brother, you are too careful. With the strength of the ten of us, even if there is a ruler guarding this place, we will still die under our blades, let alone without one.”Another burly man said heroically.
“Don’t be careless.”The old man frowned. “Although there is no ruler, the witcher family should have experts at the peak of the internal wilderness level. They are comparable to you.”
Hearing his words, the burly man licked his lips and did not say anything. However, his eyes revealed a belligerent look.
“Seventh brother, wait for us here. If you encounter any situation, do not accept the challenge.”The old man said to the short youth.
“Little seven knows. Big Brother, pay attention to your safety. I will wait for you here.”The short youth nodded and said.
A woman with a graceful figure rubbed his face when she heard this and pulled him into her embrace. She used the fullness of her chest to caress his head and only let go when he was almost out of breath, she smiled and said, “Little seven, be obedient. This is a reward for you.”
“Third sister, it’s time for you to wash up. There’s a smell…”the short youth coughed and said.
The graceful woman rolled her eyes in annoyance. “How many times have I told you on the way here? I told you to stop so that I could go down and take a shower. You insist on listening to Big Brother. I think you won’t be able to find a girlfriend in this lifetime.”
The short boy smiled bitterly and muttered.
“Let’s go.”The old man said coldly and jumped down from the giant wall.
The graceful woman waved at the short boy, turned around and fell down from the giant wall. She didn’t care about the height of thousands of meters.
The others followed her. Some waved goodbye to the short boy and got down from the giant wall. They followed the old man and moved forward at a high speed.
..
..
Inner wall, Dragon Clan.
“Father, what did the Monster Research Institute Say?”Hathaway had already recovered. She could walk and exercise. She looked at her father who was exhausted. Her expression was concerned, but what she was concerned about was his reply.
“They said that there wouldn’t be such a big black prison. Either we were wrong, or there was another reason. They will send people to investigate.”The patriarch said to her, “Don’t worry about this. Rest well. Your Dragon Mother knew that you were injured, so she specially gave you two bottles of dragon blood. She hopes that you can use this opportunity to stimulate the power of your bloodline.”
Hathaway didn’t pay attention to what he said. Her eyes flashed for a moment, “Father, I have an idea. Can We secretly capture the black prison outside the wall and use it for our own use? Since the Monster Research Institute said that they didn’t have it, then they wouldn’t dare to say anything if we brought it here.”
The patriarch shook his head without thinking, “Of course not. If you saw the real black prison, then it means that the monster research institute is hiding something. If the black prison doesn’t even know about the Monster Research Institute, then its origin is even more strange. If we bring it back, the monster research institute will definitely take it back. At that time, wouldn’t it be up to them to say what to say?”
“Father, we don’t need to bring it back to the wall. We can send it to the fortress in the desolate region. Ever since my sister left, there is a shortage of people to guard the fortress. With the black prison there, we can even deal with monsters with hundreds of levels. The Monster Research Institute won’t know what is going on in our fortress. Even if they know, we have our own reasons.”
The Patriarch’s heart moved. He glanced at her and immediately knew what her daughter was thinking. But what she said was right. If it was sent to the desolate area fortress, the Monster Research Institute couldn’t do anything about it.
“I’ll think about it. No matter what, let’s find the black prison first. I sent people to look for the landmark you reported to me several times, but they still couldn’t find it.”
Hearing his words, Hathaway immediately knew that he had long been tempted. She sneered in her heart and said, “Father should send more experts in the area of scent tracking. I’ll go and find it myself.”
The patriarch narrowed his eyes and looked at her for a while, slightly nodding, “Okay.”
Seeing this, Hathaway immediately stood up and said, “There’s no time to lose. I’ll go now.”
“Your injury hasn’t recovered…”
“It’s fine. It’s already healed.”
After saying this, Hathaway had already turned around and left the hall.
The patriarch looked at her leaving figure and sighed.
“Patriarch, the coordinates that His Highness gave you should be wrong, right?”A middle-aged man dressed as a housekeeper said in a low voice.
“I know.”

chapters.title: Chapter 746
chapters.content:
Chapter 746 – Chapter 736: Infiltrate [ First Update ]
“How are the people selected this time?”
Dudian was engraving the blueprint of the giant mercury crossbow as he asked Neuss about the matter.
“Young master, according to your instructions, the people selected are the top 50 assassins. The military and parliament have sent a total of 20 experts who are good at hiding. They can infiltrate the inner wall at any time to form a new intelligence network.”Neuss stood at the bottom of the stairs, he spoke in a pious manner.
Dudian nodded slightly. He put down the pen: “Are they ready?”
“They are ready at any time!”
“Alright.”Dudian nodded, “Let them go to the inner wall and enter through the new infiltration route. Also prepare three pieces of high-level undead powder for them every day. The inner wall is in chaos so let them be careful on the way.”
“I’ve already prepared it for them.”
“Go.”
Noyce cupped his hands and left the temple. Half an hour later, he came to a church-like hall outside Mt. Utuo. There were 70 figures standing in the hall, each with a different temperament. Although there were many people, the hall was quiet and silent.
Noyce stood on the steps and looked around at the people. After examining them, he said, “Have you remembered the mission?”
“Yes!”Everyone answered in unison.
Noyce was very satisfied. He took out three sets of blueprints from his handbag and handed them to the three people standing at the front. He said, “This is the route of the inner wall area and the route that you have infiltrated. The chairman has ordered us to set off immediately!”
The three people took the blueprints and nodded.
With the three people in the lead, everyone left in an orderly manner from the front and back doors. The hall of seventy people was cleared in the blink of an eye.
Noyce looked at their backs as they left and sighed softly. He muttered to himself, “I hope all of you can come back alive…”
..
..
After the seventy people left the hall, they left in a vast and mighty manner along the streets. Their actions were swift. They wore the medals of the Holy See on their bodies. When passersby saw them from afar, they hid to the side and did not dare to block the way.
They ran all the way out of the town and came to the bottom of the giant wall. There were more than ten people standing guard here, watching over the two iron locks that were hanging down from the giant wall.
Seventy people came to this place, gave the order to attack, and then climbed up the giant wall along the rope.
It was almost the first time for all of them to come to the top of the giant wall. When they stood at a height of 1,000 meters and looked down at the ground, they realized that the people on the ground were so small, so small that they were insignificant.
“So the scenery on the high ground is so beautiful.”
“Look, there is a monster hunting there.”
“I see it.”
Although the seventy people were disciplined, they were a little excited at the moment.
“Don’t waste time. Remember your respective missions. Stay here and wait. The rest of you, follow us down.”The three people who had received the blueprint from Noyce earlier shouted softly.
They climbed down along the ropes that were placed outside the giant wall and directly climbed to the hunting area outside the giant wall.
Climbing down from a height of 1,000 meters undoubtedly had a high psychological requirement. Although many people were frightened, they still had to obey the order. After everyone climbed to the outside of the giant wall, under the lead of the three people, they stuck close to the giant wall and kept moving forward.
After walking for more than ten miles, they saw two iron locks hanging down from the giant wall again. There were two people hiding in the grass and soil here. After verifying the warrant with them, they watched them climb up the giant wall along the iron locks.
The new infiltration route was very simple. First, they would climb out of the giant wall, then go around the wall of sighs from the outside. When they reached the giant wall of the inner wall, they would climb in again.
After they successfully sneaked into the giant wall, what was in front of them was a wasteland. They smeared the zombie powder on their bodies and then separated into small teams. They ran along the wasteland at high speed, like ants scouting the way.
When their line of sight was raised, their figures running at high speed became barely visible on the entire land. At the end of the wasteland in front of them, a towering city stood on the ground, a purple thorny flower flag was placed on the city gate. This was the city protected by one of the twelve earls, the Earl of the thorny flower.
The city was bustling with activity, and the streets were filled with people.
Near the four entrances to the north, south, east, and west of the city walls, there were fortresses and high walls, which were heavily guarded. It was broad daylight, and the four city gates were all open. From time to time, there would be zombies wandering outside the city, but before they could get close, they would be shot to death by the soldiers on the city gates.
A group of pedestrians in shabby clothes lined up at the city gates, waiting to enter.
“Stop!”
“Ten silver coins to enter the city!”
The city guard held his sword and ordered the pedestrians.
“Sir, we don’t have any money on us…”
“No Money? Get lost!”
“Please, let us in. I’ve been hungry for five days, please…”
“Get lost! Don’t touch me with your dirty hands, or I’ll cut off your hands!”
The city guard roughly lifted a few refugees from the line and threw them to the side. He pointed his sword at them, scaring them so much that they trembled.
Someone behind them could not stand it and shouted, “Wasn’t it enough to enter the city for ten copper coins in the past? Why are you asking for ten silver coins now? How can there be such a high entrance fee? You are collecting dirty money. I want to report this to the Court!”
“Report? Go ahead! But you have to pay first before you can enter the city. If you don’t have money, then get lost!”
“You!”
“HMPH, what you! It was true that you had ten copper coins in the past. Don’t you see the situation now? Charging you ten silver coins is considered light. You Can’t even take out ten silver coins. Why are you still alive?”
The attitude of the city guard was rude. He glared at the dissatisfied people with a cold aura. The others who wanted to say something but hesitated immediately stopped, not daring to open their mouths and cause trouble for themselves.
A few of them who had paid the money were immediately let through by the soldiers, but they were only allowed to enter the city gate. Behind the city gate was another checkpoint. Every pedestrian who entered the city would be brought into the tents to have their bodies examined.
“Sir, I, I only have eight silver coins. I have money. I have a lot of money. It’s just that I was in a hurry when I escaped and didn’t bring that much with me. After the army has calmed down the corpses, I will give you ten gold coins. What do you think?”
“Eight…”the city guard weighed it and said, “You can do it. Sign an IOU.”
“Thank you, thank you…”
At the back of the line, there were nine figures with unique temperaments standing quietly in line. Some of them were impatient.
“Big Brother, I didn’t expect that this wall was not only barren, but also so chaotic. There was actually a riot of corpses inside the wall. I really don’t know how this wall master manages it. It’s a joke.”
“According to me, we should just kill our way in. We can’t even manage a small riot of corpses. I really don’t know what kind of people are raised here!”
“It’s true that this place is a little weird. This is the first time I know that there will be a mess of corpses inside the wall. I really don’t know what the divine wall is for.”
“Keep your voices down, we’re almost here.”
Soon, the team was in front of the nine people.
The city guard saw the hunchbacked old man in the lead and glanced at the nearly three-meter-long saber on his back. The arrogance in his eyes calmed down a little and he said, “Ten silver coins to enter the city!”
The hunchbacked old man didn’t say anything. He took out a gold note from his pocket and handed it to him. “Keep the change for the entrance fee for the nine of us.”
When the city guard saw it, his eyes lit up. He immediately put it away and said with a smile, “Please.”
The nine of them immediately entered the city. When they were checking their bodies, the hunchbacked old man handed them two gold notes again. “Let me enter the city.”
The military officer who was checking immediately understood. He smiled and allowed the nine of them to enter the city without taking off their clothes.
“Fortunately, old nine killed that military officer on the way. Otherwise, we wouldn’t even have the money to enter the city.”
“Big Brother, why don’t we just climb over the wall and enter? It’s so troublesome.”
Walking on the street in the city, one of the burly men muttered.
The hunchbacked old man said without turning his head, “What’s the rush? We spent half a year to get here, and we’re still short of time?”
“It’s not a matter of time, it’s a problem…”the burly man corrected him.
“We need to stay in this city for a few days to understand the situation here. It’s easier to do things with a legitimate identity,”the hunchbacked old man said coldly. “Don’t cause trouble for me. Although there’s no existence here that can threaten us, if they know that our intention is the female war god’s corpse, they can destroy that God’s corpse. Do you understand?”

chapters.title: Chapter 747
chapters.content:
Chapter 747 – Chapter 737: Imperial City [ Second Update ]
“Big Brother, you are always so cautious.”
“We should be able to find out by simply catching a pioneer and asking.”
“It’s not that simple. Normal pioneers might not know where the Sylvia God of war’s corpse is hidden. In our place, this is top secret. Big Brother’s thoughts are the most thorough. If we expose our identity in advance and the people here know of our existence, it’s hard to guarantee that we won’t start a war. Although we are not afraid, if they know that we are from another place, they will most likely guess our purpose and destroy the God’s corpse.”
“They dare!”
“What’s there to be afraid of? They’re willing to risk their lives to do anything.”
The hunchbacked old man said indifferently, “This is only one of the reasons. Secondly, we can also explore the situation of this divine wall. The process of their development is a rare opportunity. Don’t you want to see what secrets are hidden in the other divine walls?”
Hearing his words, the others looked at each other and immediately knew his plan. They immediately fell silent.
..
..
The military of the inner wall region.
“Hiro, Ronon lost contact in the outer wall region. A few days ago, Prince Hathaway of the Dragon Clan, the Magic Scorpion Army God, elder black dove of the monastery, and the other nine pioneers went to the outer wall region. They said that they were going to kill the pioneer zombies, but in fact, they were just using this as an excuse to attack the outer wall region. But in the end? “Only Hathaway escaped. According to the spies of the Dragon Clan, Hathaway was seriously injured, and her second awakening bloodline power was sealed.”
In the huge meeting room that was hundreds of square meters, there were hundreds of guards around. On the long table in the middle, there was a sixty-year-old man with five gold stars, and his eyes were as sharp as an eagle, he said coldly, “No matter who wants to occupy the outer wall, they are openly provoking us. Although this involves the monastery and the dragon clan, the most shameful thing is our military! “We have already lost three war gods in the outer wall!”
“Old Luo, don’t be anxious. Sit Down and talk,”another five-star general advised.
“How can we not be anxious? !”Robert said angrily, “If His Majesty comes back at this time and sees such a situation, how can we explain to His Majesty? How Can We Face His Majesty?”
“His Majesty has only been in the divine kingdom for a few years. He won’t come back so soon.”The previous five-star general advised, “Even if he comes back, the monastery is also responsible. After all, the outer wall has been handed over to them to manage. Everything is under their nose. When did such a dangerous figure appear, and they don’t know about it? His Majesty will punish them first.”
“That’s right. Our main responsibility is to maintain the safety of the inner wall. The monastery is in charge of the outer wall. In the past, when the outer wall was peaceful, which time didn’t they use the outer wall to curry favor with his majesty? At that time, why didn’t they think of leaving some face for our military? Instead, they ridiculed us! Now that the outer wall has been lost and fallen into the hands of others, they came to seek our help? What a joke!”Another middle-aged general sneered.
“I didn’t approve of the two war gods Hiro and Luonong, but now something has happened, Sigh!”Another white-haired old man in his eighties sighed with regret.
“Even if we don’t make a move, the dragon clan and the monastery will make a move sooner or later. This time, Prince Hathaway of the Dragon Clan is seriously injured. I don’t believe that the Dragon Clan can take this lying down!”
“I heard that Prince Aisha is backing the people of the outer wall. Aisha is a brutal figure. Do you still remember what happened six years ago? The winged clan invaded the territory of their Dragon Clan. Aisha made a move and killed the pioneer of the winged clan without saying a word. She fought against five people by herself. The younger brother of the leading holy son of the winged clan was killed on the spot. It was simply terrifying!”
Upon hearing this, the generals on both sides of the long table turned solemn.
“If that’s the case, we can ask her Highness Ulita to send out the dragon race to solve this problem by Her Majesty’s decree. We can’t let the malignant tumor in the outer wall continue to spread!”Robert immediately said.
The general sitting next to him glanced at him, “Old Luo, Her Highness Ulita won’t listen to us. This matter is too complicated. Right now, the chaos in the inner wall has not yet subsided. If we want to quell the rebellion in the outer wall, we have to at least ask the three marshals to help us. However, the outer wall is already Aisha’s lair. There must be many traps set up there. Even if the three marshals come out personally, they might not be able to escape unscathed!”
“If something happens to them, even if we have made a meritorious service this time and His Majesty has rewarded us, would he reward us as a Marshal?”
“That’s right. Even if we have made a meritorious service and also dealt a blow to the monastery, the price we have to pay is too high!”! “Unless the monastery is willing to send three more elders, the Dragon Clan sends the Mother Dragon, or their patriarch personally, it will be too difficult for us to rely solely on the military!”
“We are counting on them to act, and they are counting on us to act,”Robert said angrily. “It is because we have been evading each other that the rebellion in the outer wall has not been quelled until now. Moreover, we can only watch as the people occupying the outer wall grow stronger and stronger. If they completely rule the outer wall and unite with everyone in the outer wall to start a war, there will be too many people who will have to sacrifice!”
“There’s nothing we can do even if we sacrifice ourselves. How can we not sacrifice ourselves in a war?”Another General said indifferently.
“We’ve already asked Hiro and Ronon to help us last time. We thought that we could recover them, but who knew that we would never be able to return! “We’ve already tried our best. Don’t forget, our mission is only to maintain law and order in the inner wall. The most important thing is to calm the chaos of corpses as soon as possible!”
“That’s right. The zombie riot has spread to such a large area. Those guys from the monastery are still laughing at us. Look at the pioneer zombies we’ve killed. Nine out of ten were killed by our military. The Dragon Clan, the wing clan, and the Rock clan also contributed. As for the monastery, although they sent a lot of people, they didn’t even kill a pioneer zombie. Of course, they didn’t lose a single person! “With such an attitude, they still expect us to help them resolve the rebellion in the outer wall district? “When the time comes, if His Majesty really wants to hold them accountable, he will only be able to trace it back to the Dragon clan and their heads!”
Seeing that everyone was evading him, Robert clenched his fists in anger. In the end, he snorted angrily and left.
..
..
A few days passed.
In the central area of the inner wall district, there was a majestic and magnificent city. It also had a very beautiful name, but all the people who lived here liked to call it directly — the imperial city.
This was the city where the wall master lived, and it was also the economic center of the inner wall. It was the richest, safest, and most beautiful city.
The residents who were born here were very proud, and they felt superior when they went to other cities. Even a commoner who was very ordinary here would raise his head as high as a noble when he went to other cities.
The sun shone on the city walls. There were a lot of soldiers, and their bodies were as straight as javelins. They were clearly on a higher level than the city guards of other cities.
At this moment, nine figures suddenly jumped up from one of the city walls and landed on the towering wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 748
chapters.content:
Chapter 748 – : Chapter 738: Forcing Their Way Into The First Watch
“This is their Imperial City?”
“I didn’t expect their goddess corpse to be hidden here. How Stupid.”
“Zhizhi, we can finally start a massacre!”
The nine of them stood on the city wall and looked down at the bustling scene. They were all extremely excited.
“Who are you!”
“Who are you? !”
When the surrounding city guards saw the nine of them suddenly jump up, they shouted in shock and anger and quickly rushed over.
A burly man standing on the far right glanced at them and raised his hand to pull out the broadsword on his back. This broadsword was completely black, and the back of the broadsword was like a shark fin with sharp spikes protruding out. He stabbed the broadsword into the ground beneath his feet, the sturdy city wall instantly split open. He flipped his hand to pick up the gravel on the ground and swung his broadsword at them.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The rubble shot out like arrows, instantly killing the city guards who had rushed over. Thumb-sized bloody holes appeared on their bodies.
“Let’s go to the Palace!”The stooped old man’s gaze was cold. He leaped down the city wall and dashed along the streets. The passersby along the way did not have time to dodge and were pushed around by his arms. They crashed into the surroundings like sandbags and died on the spot.
Along with the slaughter, a hint of bloodthirsty killing intent faintly appeared in his cold eyes.
The other eight immediately followed and turned into nine black shadows as they sped along the streets.
“Quick, quickly report to the palace that there is an enemy attack!”
“Quickly report to the General!”
The city wall was in chaos. Someone reacted quickly and released the emergency black pigeon in the bird cage.
“Report?”A handsome youth with shoulder-length hair among the nine glanced at the sky above him. He raised his head slightly and puffed out his mouth. In the next moment, he spat out a mouthful of transparent liquid. It was like saliva, but it was extremely fast, like a water arrow.., with a whoosh, it hit the black pigeon flying in the sky.
This black pigeon was the fastest and most agile bird among all the messengers. However, at this moment, it was hit like it was hitting the water arrow. A few feathers fell from the sky and fell vertically in the next moment, blood spilled out.
“Big Brother, can I kill all these people after I steal the god’s corpse?”While the nine people were running, a short man with wrinkled skin and ugly face said sinisterly. He licked his lips and looked at the passersby passing by quickly, his throat rolled slightly, as if he could not suppress the excitement and killing intent in his body.
“As long as you steal the god corpse, you can do whatever you want,”the hunchbacked old man said indifferently.
The nine of them moved forward in a straight line. There were buildings in front of them that blocked them, so they jumped onto the buildings. The entire complex imperial city in front of them seemed to be a flat wasteland. They rushed to the imperial palace as fast as they could, they did not sneak around, because they believed that the speed of transmission was far from their speed of travel.
“There are two military commanders in the imperial city, both of whom are experts in the inner wilderness. There is also a great state preceptor in the imperial palace, who is also an expert in the inner wilderness. There are three of them in total. What a weak defensive force…”
“The power in this divine wall can’t be compared to our place at all. It’s too peaceful, Haha…”
“The inner wall is so big, but there are so few people living there. They even pushed some people to the outer wall and built the wall of sighs to separate them. How Stupid…”
The nine figures moved like shuttles, like nine blurry black shadows. The distance of 1,000 meters passed in the blink of an eye. Even though they were moving at such a high speed, they still seemed to be at ease, casually chatting.
At the same time that they invaded, the alarm on the city wall had already sounded, and the sound of the bell rang out. When the garrison troops in the city center received the alarm outside the city, they immediately sounded the alarm, but when their alarm rang out.., the nine people had already far surpassed their defensive line.
“Get lost!”
“Die!”
The nine people moved forward rudely. The carriages and passers-by that blocked the way were all knocked away and flipped over. Some directly jumped over their heads.
“Miss, are you alright? Someone come quickly. Miss is injured!”
“Ah, my leg… is broken.”
“Help, help me…”
A wave of wails could be heard wherever the nine of them passed.
The wails fell into the ears of the nine of them. The person who liked to shake his shoulders and speak in a squeaky voice like a mouse had a face full of intoxication. He narrowed his eyes and was full of smiles.
After a moment, the nine people arrived in front of the palace.
The square in front of the palace was extremely wide. The view was broadened. The steps of the palace reached up to a thousand levels. It was like a heavenly palace. It was extremely luxurious. Countless maids and servants stood on the steps to guard it. It was solemn and solemn, ordinary commoners did not dare to come close to this place.
Even the arrogant nobles who came here could not help but sigh in admiration.
The nine of them paused and raised their heads to look at the magnificent palace. Even though they were experienced and knowledgeable, they were still amazed. However, the main reason for their amazement was that they did not expect such a magnificent building to be built in such a barren and backward divine wall, they did not expect such a magnificent building to be built.
In the next moment, the hunchbacked old man took the lead and rushed forward, while the other eight followed.
At this moment, the alarm had yet to reach the front of the palace. The guards patrolling in front of the palace were still patrolling in an orderly manner. The sudden appearance of the nine of them immediately attracted the attention of the patrol team. However, before they could give the order.., the nine people turned into nine black shadows and quickly jumped up the stairs that were thousands of stories high. This phantom-like speed made the patrol team and the servants on each of the stairs dumbfounded, and they all turned their heads to look at the top of the stairs.
There, the nine figures had already disappeared and entered deep into the palace.
“There is an expert from the inner wilderness 800 meters away from the three o’clock direction!”The graceful “Third sister”immediately pointed out the target.
Killing intent flashed in the eyes of the hunchbacked old man. Without saying a word, he rushed in the direction he pointed out. His speed suddenly increased by a step, rapidly increasing the distance between him and the eight people. The Golden Palace in front of him was smashed open like a piece of paper. Breaking through the wall, he rushed all the way into the palace. The main hall of the palace was extremely luxurious and spacious. Behind the main hall was a courtyard corridor, at this moment, a middle-aged man was sitting by the pond in the courtyard, talking with a noblewoman who was wearing a strange official uniform.
“Huh?”The middle-aged man suddenly frowned. His expression changed. He suddenly stood up and turned his head to look.
With a bang, the wall of the palace was broken open. The hunchbacked old man suddenly rushed out. At this moment, there was no sign of his old age. Instead, he was like a lion who had just come out of its cage. He was rude and domineering.
“Who is it! ?”The woman’s face changed as she stood up and shouted.
The middle-aged man’s pupils contracted. Black mucus flowed out from under his clothes and covered his whole body. His body was extremely ferocious and terrifying. His body was covered with sharp blades. He looked like a creature made of countless scythes. There were sharp blades growing out of his face like daggers, except for his eyes, almost every part of his body was covered with sharp blades!
If Dudian saw this scene, he would immediately recognize that it was the magic marks of the splitter!
“Eh?”The old man’s eyebrows jumped as he saw the strange and ferocious body. He was a bit surprised. His body slowed down and stopped. He looked at the middle-aged man with interest, “Interesting. Is this the top parasitic soul worm?”

chapters.title: Chapter 749
chapters.content:
Chapter 749 – Chapter 739: Below The Palace [ Second Watch ]
The middle-aged man was shocked when he heard his words. Although his splitter’s magic mark was a rare legendary magic mark, it was not the first time it had appeared in history. This old man gave him an extremely dangerous feeling. He was definitely an inner desolation level expert, it was even more powerful. There was no reason for such a person not to recognize the splitter’s magic mark. Moreover, the latter’s words were a little strange.
Just as he was feeling apprehensive, a few whistling sounds flew over from the palace. It was the other eight people.
The middle-aged man raised his eyes and swept his gaze over. Instantly, his face turned pale and the hairs on his back stood on end. The feeling that these eight people gave him was that their strength was not inferior to his!
