“You are not from here!”He took a deep breath and felt waves of death shrouding his body. However, his aura did not dare to retreat, he said firmly, “Where are you from? What are you doing here? Our King is an abyss walker. If you don’t want to die, leave immediately!”
“Of course I know. Your King is an Abyss Walker.”The hunchbacked old man revealed a smile. “Every Wall Master is an abyss walker. Unfortunately, so what if he is the Lord of the Abyss? Can He save you?”
The hope in the middle-aged man’s heart instantly vanished, his heart filled with fear. He knew that these people were definitely not refugees scattered outside the wall, but came from another giant wall! ! Furthermore, they also knew that His Majesty was not here, which meant that their invasion was premeditated!
Suddenly, his mind flashed like a bolt from the blue, instantly remembering the purpose of the nine people from the other giant wall. “You want to snatch the corpse of our goddess Sylvia? Don’t even think about it! !”
He glared angrily. The Rage in his heart instantly surpassed fear. He roared, “Even if I die, I won’t let you have your way! !”His voice was extremely loud and spread throughout the entire palace.
“It’s a little difficult to die.”The stooped old man smiled calmly. He tilted his head and looked at the stocky fatty beside him. “Second brother, this kind of demonic body should be your dish. I’ll leave it to you to deal with it.”
“Big Brother, can you not call me second brother? It sounds very strange!”The fatty muttered. Although he said that, his body stepped towards the Grand Imperial preceptor. As he walked, he entered the demonic body. A circular plate hanging on his back melted, it turned into black mucus and covered his entire body. In the blink of an eye, his demonic body was revealed. This was a huge fatty who was nearly four meters tall. His body was round. Other than the outline of his four limbs, he looked somewhat similar to the spherical black prison.
When the middle-aged man saw that the nine people did not take him seriously and actually did not join hands to attack, he was slightly relieved. However, when he saw the strange demonic body of the Fatty, he could not help but widen his eyes. He had never seen such a demonic body before, it was definitely not the appearance of the eight great legendary demonic marks that he knew. Of course, he had only seen seven demonic bodies transformed by the eight great legendary demonic marks. As for the number one dreamer, he had never seen it before, but he guessed that it would not be such an ugly and simple appearance.
The fatty slowly moved forward. He did not seem to be in a hurry.
When the grand tutor saw this, he slowly retreated. It was not because he was afraid, but because he wanted to slowly put some distance between him and his companions so that he would not be ambushed by his companions when he attacked.
“Why are you running? Look at your demonic body. You should be very good at attacking. Come and hit me!”The fatty shouted.
The Grand Imperial preceptor ignored him and continued to slowly retreat. Looking at this fatty’s demonic body, he guessed that he was not good at speed and was more inclined to passively defend.
Seeing that he continued to retreat, the fatty was a little impatient. “Didn’t you say just now that you wouldn’t let us succeed even if you died? Why are you cowardly in the blink of an eye? Seriously, since you’re not going to make a move, I’ll attack.”
The Grand Imperial preceptor stared at him, not daring to relax.
Fatty moved as he wished. His body suddenly bounced towards the grand imperial preceptor at an extremely fast speed. The Grand Imperial Preceptor’s pupils constricted. He did not expect that with his size, his speed would be so fast. However, he was already prepared. He instantly counterattacked. The sharp blades all over his body circulated like a peacock spreading its tail. Every sharp blade rubbed against each other, creating a metallic texture, he pounced towards Fatty, and the sharp blades pierced into his body like countless sharp swords before spinning.
His actions were swift, and the sharp blades all over his body trembled rapidly, causing terrifying destruction.
In an instant, Fatty’s body was cut several hundred times, but… not a single drop of blood flowed out.
After the Grand Imperial Preceptor’s attack, the feeling that came from the sharp blades’limbs was that every attack had succeeded. When he retreated, he originally thought that fatty had already been cut into countless pieces. However, when he looked over, he was stunned to discover.., this fatty was still standing perfectly fine on the spot. There were countless lines on his body, all of which were from his cuts. However, there was no fresh blood seeping out. Furthermore, these lines were gradually becoming lighter and lighter until they completely healed and disappeared.
“How is this possible!”He widened his eyes in disbelief.
The attack just now was enough to kill him hundreds of times, yet he wasn’t injured at all?
“It seems that my ability just so happens to be able to restrain you!”The fatty saw the expression on his face as if he had seen a ghost. He grinned and pounced forward. His fat body was like lightning as he hugged the grand preceptor. He opened his big mouth.., his mouth was as elastic as if it could swallow a human head. He directly held the Grand Preceptor’s head in his mouth, and then his body slowly hugged the grand preceptor.
The Grand Tutor’s body seemed to have sunk into a swamp. He struggled with all his might, but the effect was weak.
Soon, the fatty’s body became twice as fat, but there were sharp blades and limbs sticking out from every part of his body, as if his whole body was full of spikes.
He patted his belly and grinned, “This guy is a bit difficult to digest. It will probably take some time.”
“It seems that the top-level experts in this divine wall are only so-so. They are too weak.”The graceful third sister shook her head.
“It’s not that he is weak. It’s that second brother’s ability is too special. It just happens to be able to restrain his type of attack.”Another handsome young man with shoulder-length hair said, “One look at that kind of demonic body can tell how terrifying it is. If it were us, we might not be able to defeat him in a one-on-one fight. The attack power is too strong!”
“Little Three, look at the place where the female God of war’s corpse is buried. There should be pioneers guarding around there.”The hunchbacked old man said coldly.
The graceful woman could not help but mutter, “Big Brother, can you stop calling me that? I’ve told you so many times!”
“That’s right!”The fatty immediately agreed, “Mine too. You have to change it.”
“Cut the crap. Hurry up.”The hunchbacked old man frowned.
The graceful woman pouted slightly, but she still spread out her perception net as she was told. After a moment, she looked down at her feet with some surprise on her face, she said, “There are five experts down here. Four of them are pioneers, and the other one can’t sense their actual strength. Wait, there are two other things. Are they monsters?”
“Monsters?”
“Why are they here? Are they the monsters they tamed?”
“I didn’t expect these people to be so skilled. They can actually tame monsters. What level is that monster?”
The graceful woman closed her eyes again. After a moment, she slowly opened her eyes and said, “I can’t sense one of them. The other monster should have a hunting level of more than a hundred. Also…”she turned her head and looked outside the palace, “Someone is coming. Both of them are inner wilderness level masters.”

chapters.title: Chapter 750
chapters.content:
Chapter 750 – Chapter 740: Kill Them All
“Two?”
“It should be the two commanders in charge of the Imperial City.”
They looked outside the palace and could see two blazing figures rushing over from the streets below the thousand steps outside the palace like Blazing Suns. These few days, they had infiltrated various places and captured the pioneers who were cleaning up the undeads outside. From this, they understood the history of the giant wall of Sylvia and the current situation of the various factions. Because they understood it, they were fearless.
“Wait!”
Amos, who was rushing to the palace at full speed, suddenly stopped. Kate, who was beside him, immediately stopped and looked at him. “What’s Wrong?”
“One, two, three, four…”Amos looked at the towering palace in front of him. The sounds that sounded like the scorching sun in the Golden and resplendent building made his heart skip a beat. His face was filled with shock. “How is this possible? There… There are so many experts?”
“How many?”Kate knew that his perceptive ability was stronger than hers. Seeing his shocked expression, she could not help but feel her heart sink.
“How can there be so many experts all of a sudden? They even invaded the palace. Could it be that they want to snatch His Majesty’s Royal Seal? “No, that’s not right. The Witcher family would never do such a stupid thing. They don’t have so many experts…”amos muttered to himself in a daze, soon, his eyes widened and he cried out involuntarily, “They came from another place? !”
Kate’s heart skipped a beat. “What’s going on?”
Yamos was stunned for a moment. He suddenly thought of something and his eyes revealed a look of horror. He turned his head to look at Kate, “Quick, quickly inform the Witcher family and the monastery. They are people from another giant wall. They should be trying to snatch the god’s remains of the Sylvia War God!”
“What? !”Kate was shocked.
He quickly reacted and glanced at the quiet palace. There was an inexplicable palpitation in his heart. Although he could not see what kind of danger was hidden inside, his intuition told him that if he went over like this, he would definitely die!
Moreover, there was the Grand Tutor in the palace all year round. However, there was no sign of battle at the moment. This could only mean that the grand tutor had been killed!
“We must not let them take the god of war’s corpse!”Kate took a deep breath and immediately said solemnly to him, “You stay here and watch the situation. I will inform them immediately. We must delay them no matter what!”
“I Will!”Amos gritted his teeth. Taking the corpse of the Sylvia War Goddess was absolutely not allowed. This was not as simple as blasphemy..
Kate quickly turned around and left. Her figure quickly disappeared into the streets. This time, she was even faster than before. She was afraid that the enemies in the palace would stop her, so she activated her demon body and sprinted at full speed.
Alarms had been sounded all over the imperial city. All the civilians on the streets had consciously returned to their homes. They did not dare to stay on the streets. When the alarms in the entire imperial city sounded, the troops stationed on the outskirts of the city immediately entered the city, like a black torrent, they poured in from the streets and headed towards the imperial palace in the center of the city.
“One of them ran away. He must have sensed us and ran off to deliver the news.”The graceful woman frowned slightly and said to the hunchbacked old man, “Big Brother, aren’t you going to stop him?”
“It doesn’t matter.”The hunchbacked old man looked at him indifferently, “Even if he doesn’t go, the experts of the other forces will soon know about the changes here. After all, this is the imperial city. If these forces do not have an intelligence network in the imperial city, it is impossible. Even if he goes to call all the experts of the Witcher family, it will be too late. Let’s go and get the God’s corpse first.”
“Zhizhi, Zhizhi, let him call it. The more people he calls, the better. It’s a good chance to warm up.”
“Anyway, without the god corpse, this god wall will be destroyed sooner or later. Rather than that, why not let us kill to our heart’s content!”
“Haha, My Blood Is Boiling!”
Seeing their excited look, the graceful woman pursed her lips and smiled. “That’s true. Let’s go down as soon as possible. I see that the people underground seem to have noticed us. Don’t let them move the god corpse.”
“Little Six, hurry up.”The hunchbacked old man gave the order.
Little Six was a short, muscular man with dark skin. Hearing this, he grinned, revealing two rows of white teeth. The huge axe on his back quickly turned into liquid and covered his entire body. He entered the Devil Body State with a strange appearance, it was a monster that looked like a scorpion or a lizard. It was crawling on the ground, and with its tail included, its body was more than five meters long. It pressed its four claws on the ground and quickly dug into the ground.
The ground in the courtyard was made of stone, but it was quickly dug open by his claws. The soil was quickly dug out, and soon a pitch-black hole appeared. The speed of digging was astonishing.
The hunchbacked old man and the others jumped down the passage he dug. They slid all the way, and soon they were out of the passage. The other end of the passage led to the secret passage under the palace. There were a few wall lamps in the secret passage, and the lights were dim. The few of them quickly went down the stairs.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The stooped old man at the front stepped on the stairs and sank down. Dense poison arrows shot out from the walls on both sides.
The burly fourth brother reacted extremely quickly. With a low roar, he waved the huge blade in his hand and swept it. Ding! Ding! All the poison arrows were blocked. At the same time, his huge blade slashed at the wall on the side, instantly destroying the mechanism.
However, a burst of poisonous fog shot out from the broken mechanism and quickly rushed into the tunnel.
The expressions of the few people changed when they saw this. They did not expect the person who designed the trap to be so sinister. He had calculated that the intruder would use violent means to break the wall. This action happened to be the activation condition of the poisonous fog mechanism.
“Second Brother!”The hunchbacked old man covered his nose and growled.
The Fat Man, who still maintained his demonic body, was still covered in sharp blades. When he heard the old man’s words, a hint of helplessness appeared on his face, but his actions were very agile. He suddenly puffed up his stomach and opened his mouth to take a breath, the poisonous fog that filled the tunnel immediately rushed into his mouth and was swallowed by him.
“BURP!”The Fat Man burped and patted his stomach. Just as he was about to speak, his expression suddenly changed. He opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of dark green thick phlegm, which landed on the ground and corroded a hole on the stairs.
His face and stomach quickly changed color and turned dark green.
“Second brother, are you alright?”The graceful woman asked.
The Fat Man’s body trembled slightly, swaying left and right as if he was drunk.
After a while, he regained some consciousness and panted, “I’m fine. Let’s continue.”
“Little Six, go into the wall and destroy the traps below,”the hunchbacked old man glanced at the Fat Man and said to the short man.
The short man nodded and immediately dug into the wall.
“Everyone, be careful. These people should have set many traps. Second Brother, are you better?”The hunchbacked old man asked the fatty behind him as he cautiously went down.
The fatty shook his head slightly.
“It’s an ordinary poison. Second Brother will be fine after eating it and farting. I didn’t expect the poisonous fog just now to be so powerful. Second Brother’s complexion is still so bad now.”The burly fourth brother’s expression was solemn.
Fatty rolled his eyes and said, “I also want to fart now, but I’m afraid of suffocating all of you.”
“Then it’s better for you to hold it in.”The graceful woman saw that he could still joke and knew that he should be fine. She also heaved a sigh of relief in her heart.
At this moment, the group walked down for more than a hundred meters. They didn’t encounter any more traps. Obviously, they were all destroyed by sixth brother who had burrowed into the wall.
However, even though the traps were ineffective, it still made the secret passage below difficult to walk through. Some of the steps were filled with sharp thorns, making it impossible to step on. Some of the steps were filled with poisonous water. Although the traps were no longer in the dark.., they were still lethal even if they were exposed in the open.
The group moved forward with great difficulty.
Rumble!
Suddenly, the entire ground sank and shook slightly.
Everyone hurriedly stood up, somewhat surprised.
“What’s going on?”
“Could it be another trap?”
They were bewildered and did not dare to continue forward.
The graceful woman spread out her perception net to look, and her pupils immediately constricted. She cried out involuntarily, “Sixth Brother!”She was stunned for a moment. In the next moment, she completely ignored the hidden dangers on the stairs below and hurriedly pounced forward, she came to a corner of the secret passage below and stopped. She took out the sharp sword on her back and hacked at the rocks on the wall. Her expression was filled with grief and indignation.
The others immediately felt that something was wrong and immediately went forward to help. At the same time, they asked, “What’s going on?”
“Sixth brother is in here. He’s being pressed down.”The graceful woman was filled with grief and indignation. She used her fingers to press against the wall. Her beautiful nails that were smeared with paint were scratched and blood flowed out. However, she was completely unaware.
“What?”The others were in disbelief. Sixth brother was actually being suppressed by the earth? It would not be an exaggeration to say that he was a person who lived in the earth!
“How Deep Is it inside?”The burly fourth brother hurriedly asked.
“3.2 meters.”The graceful woman seemed to know what he was going to do, so she took two steps back.
Fourth brother let out a low growl and brandished his huge blade. With a loud bang, the rocks exploded. The depth was about three meters. He immediately brandished his huge blade and struck again. Very quickly, a gap was created, fresh blood seeped out from the gap.
Everyone looked at the fresh blood seeping out in disbelief. Everyone was furious. Their necks were red as they attacked one after another. Soon, the wall was broken and sixth brother was dug out.
However, sixth brother was already dead. His body was flat and all his organs, including his organs and eyeballs, were shattered. When he was dug out, he was crushed like a puddle of blood!
The hunchbacked old man and the other seven people looked at the bloody corpse. They couldn’t believe that the person who was best at fighting underground would actually die underground! Moreover, looking at the injuries on the corpse, it was obvious that he was crushed to death!
This was simply unimaginable. It was as absurd as a fish being drowned by water. However, the truth was right in front of their eyes, and they couldn’t refute it.
“Sixth brother! !”The burly man roared in grief and indignation as he clenched his fist and smashed it against the wall.
They had been leisurely and carefree all the way, and did not take the experts in this divine wall seriously at all. However, they did not expect to lose a brother before they could even fight with the experts here!
The hunchbacked old man stared blankly at the blood in his palm. The grief, anger, and wails of the people around him also entered his ears, making him feel as if it was not real. He took a deep breath, his eyes revealed an extremely intense killing intent as he said, “Don’t let any of the people here go. I want to kill them all! !”
“Kill them all! !”
“Avenge sixth brother! ! !”
“I want to tear them into thousands of pieces and kill every single one of them! !”
They roared in grief and indignation, wishing that they could immediately capture people and kill them crazily.
The hunchbacked old man gritted his teeth and clenched the blood in his hands. The killing intent in his eyes gradually turned cold. He looked at the graceful woman and said, “Did little six fall into the trap inside the wall?”
“Yes, Big Brother.”The graceful woman’s eyes reddened, she clenched her teeth and said, “The sound we heard before should be the sound of the trap being activated. The person who set up the trap must have considered that there would be people who were good at drilling among the intruders. Little Six must have wanted to destroy a trap, but that trap was bait, and he fell into the trap instead!”
“The person who set up this trap must be someone who is extremely familiar with the ability to drill into the ground!”
“Isn’t there someone called the Rock tribe in the Witcher Family? It must be their scheme. I want to kill them all!”
The hunchbacked old man slowly walked towards the stairs. His eyes were gloomy as he said, “Let’s slow down. Little San, keep an eye on the situation underground. See if they can move the god corpse.”
“I know.”The graceful woman no longer cared about how he addressed her. She wiped away her tears and followed closely behind him.
The hunchbacked old man took the lead. This time, he no longer pursued speed. Under careful investigation, many of the traps and mechanisms were discovered by them. They solved them one by one, but they did not trigger the traps.
Half an hour later, they finally arrived at the bottom of the palace. The journey was thrilling but not dangerous. Although they still triggered some traps, making them a little miserable, there were no more casualties.
When they arrived at the underground, they saw an extremely developed underground tomb. The light was dim, and a large number of precious gemstones were embedded in the wall, emitting a weak light.
In the middle of the tomb, there was a nearly ten-meter-long giant coffin. It was snow-white and made of metal. There were exquisite streamlined patterns on it. There were pictures printed on the divine coffin, and on the picture was a woman with a perfect face, standing high up, there was a giant wall behind her, and in front of her were countless monsters. These monsters were all kinds of strange, but most of them were strange snake-like creatures.
This snake-like creature had no feet, and its body was much thicker than a snake. It stood upright, and there seemed to be a horn and eyes on its head.
There were so many monsters that it was hard to count. It was like a large-scale beast tide that almost drowned half of the beautiful woman’s body in the armor.
“The Divine Coffin!”The hunchbacked old man saw the divine coffin in the middle of the mausoleum. He narrowed his eyes and looked around. He saw a black pool surrounding the divine coffin. There seemed to be an undercurrent in the pool.
In the next moment, three huge heads jumped out of the pool. They looked like giant pythons. Their mouths were ferocious, and they were swallowing and swallowing. They stared at the hunchbacked old man and the others.
“There is another one on the wall.”The graceful woman pointed at the wall.
Everyone looked at the wall and saw that she was pointing at an ordinary wall. However, since she had said it, it was obvious that the monster was good at disguising and hiding there.
“Kill!”The old man squeezed out a word.
..
..
That night, Dudian received news from the inner wall. It meant that the people sent to the inner wall had connected the intelligence network.

chapters.title: Chapter 751
chapters.content:
Chapter 751 – : Chapter 741: [ The First Update ]
“The inner wall is still in chaos. But there are many isolated disaster cities. They say that it won’t be long before order is restored.”Neuss reported back to dudian.
Dudian nodded: “Let them go deep into the twelve cities and imperial cities. Don’t easily expose their whereabouts.”
Neuss looked at Dudian as he pondered, he whispered: “Master, what should we do next?”? In my opinion, the inner wall will send strong people to attack us after the disaster is over. There are many strong people in the monastery, military and family. Can you deal with the traps left by us?”
“This is not how the battle is calculated.”Dudian’s finger gently tapped on the table, “It is a pig’s work to wipe out ten small soldiers and ten small soldiers of the enemy. The value of a Commander is to defeat the strong with the weak. Although it is unlikely that we will go to war with them but we are in the dark. There are at least fifteen wasteland level pioneers in total. If they send out all of them then naturally we will be wiped out. Even if they send out two or three of them it will be enough to damage our strength.”
“So Many?”Neuss was shocked when he heard Dudian’s words. Although he was only a limiter and his strength was low, but he knew a lot of things about pioneers, each of them was an existence that surpassed the ten war gods and was comparable to Aisha. But there were about fifteen of them. It was simply terrifying!
On the other hand, they only had one.
One to fifteen. The result of such a battle was obvious.
“Don’t worry.”Dudian’s expression was calm, “Even if there are fifteen of them, there won’t be many who will take action. The Dean and vice dean of the monastery wouldn’t personally come to the outer wall to attack us. The head of the family wouldn’t take action either. As for the three commanders of the military, they would only send one or two. It is impossible for them to send out all of them. After all, in their eyes, we are the same existence as the Barbarians.”
“Even so, the rest is enough for us to lose.”Neuss looked at him. He didn’t know why he was so calm. The current situation could be said that they would lose without a doubt. He continued to plan, it was just a struggle. After all, the absolute disparity in strength was too great. Dudian wanted to overthrow the inner wall. Sooner or later he would have to face them head on. At that time he would have to show his strength!
“So I have to go to the inner wall as soon as possible. If the earl is willing to live in the outer wall then the military will not send people over. Moreover we will occupy the outer wall.”Dudian said.
Neuss was confused.
Dudian didn’t talk to him anymore. He took the materials and went to an alchemy room halfway up the mountain. There were top alchemists and potioneers from the dark council in the room. These people were once wanted criminals. Now they were called to work for him. However they had to stay hidden. After all, the other clerks of the Holy See didn’t know about the dark believers that they were searching for, they were right beside him.
Dudian handed the information to an alchemist in the laboratory. The Alchemist’s hair was sparse and there were only a few strands left. His face was swollen and ugly. It was impossible to tell his age, however the other alchemists and potion masters respected him.
“Make this as soon as possible and inject it into a batch of fleas.”Dudian ordered.
“Yes, Chairman.”The Alchemist replied respectfully.
Dudian turned around and left. The information he handed to him was about an infectious virus. In the old era there was a well-known name called ‘smallpox’. He was going to throw this thing into the city where the 12th Earl was sheltering. He was going to trigger the smallpox epidemic and create chaos again. At the same time he was going to force the earl to open the city gates so that the other nobles who were sheltering in the city would be able to escape, they would move out of the safe place and run away from the giant wall.
This time he didn’t use the corpse poison because the effect of the corpse poison was too strong. Once they were infected they would die without a doubt. On the contrary it wouldn’t cause too much trouble for the military.
This kind of virus which couldn’t be cured in a short time and spread quickly would cause more trouble. They couldn’t kill or touch it.
“I didn’t think that I would use this trick to coerce the nobles to order the army.”Dudian thought. He thought of the consequences of the smallpox spreading to the cities, the face of the little girl and his grandfather appeared in his mind again. The dirty little face left a deep impression on him. It wasn’t that the face was so pure and special, but that the situation was caused by him, at the same time, there were many people who he couldn’t see. They would be in a similar situation. They would be homeless and have nowhere to live. They would be struggling to survive in the city full of undeads.
He sighed in his heart. He felt a bit guilty, but it was just a little bit of guilt.
When the number of people killed was too high, perhaps the life in his hands was just a number, an outline, or even a map. A victory!
In the blink of an eye, two days passed.
The smallpox virus that Dudian had given to the potion master camp had also been completed. With the information provided by him, in addition to the materials randomly allocated by the outer wall, the efficiency was very fast.
Neuss rushed over when Dudian received the smallpox virus: “Master, there is news from the inner wall. Something big has happened there!”
“Something big?”Dudian’s eyelids twitched: “Speak.”
“Two days ago, a group of unknown experts attacked the imperial city and destroyed the palace. It is said that they killed many people. Even the grand tutor was killed. There were also many experts from the witcher family and the monastery.”Neuss spoke quickly.
Dudian was stunned. His eyes widened as he looked at Neuss: “Unknown experts? Attacked the Imperial City? Destroyed the palace? The monastery and the Witcher family participated in the war?”
Neuss thought of his reaction when he heard the news, he wryly smiled: “I also suspect that there is a problem with the news. But the news from several people is the same. It should be true.”
“The monastery and the Witcher family are involved in the war. It is impossible that they launched the attack. The origin is unknown…”Dudian muttered to himself. He slowly frowned as a terrifying thought emerged in his mind, are these people from the Kingdom of God? But why would the Kingdom of God suddenly attack the palace?
His brain was working fast. He pondered for a moment and asked Neuss: “How come the news from two days ago is coming now? Wasn’t the intelligence network connected?”
“The news from the inner wall is spreading too slowly.”Neuss lowered his head, “There are corpses everywhere. The news is spread directly from the imperial city to the higher-ups of other cities. The process is too slow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 752
chapters.content:
Chapter 752 – Chapter 742: Go To [ The Second Update ]
“It’s too slow!”Dudian was a bit angry. This was a good opportunity. Unfortunately the news was too slow so he missed the opportunity, he immediately asked: “What’s the current situation? are those people still there? Do you know why they attacked the Palace?”
“They are still in the inner wall.”Neuss said. Dudian was relieved.
“It was said that there were eight or nine people who attacked the palace. They were very strong and destroyed the palace. It seemed that their goal was to take the remains of the goddess of Sylvia.”Neuss quickly explained: “But the two commanders who were guarding the palace arrived and held them back. Then the people of the Witcher family also arrived. There was a big war with them in the palace.”
“It is said that the battle scene is very terrible. It has caused countless civilian casualties. Even the city wall has been destroyed.”
“This group of attackers were not able to resist the pursuit of the military and the families. They fled to the Pugard Mountains. They were surrounded by the three families and the military. There is no other news for the time being.”
“Pugard Mountains?”The outline of the mountain appeared in Dudian’s mind. He had seen it on the map. It was a famous and dangerous mountain range in the inner wall. There were countless wild beasts inside, even experienced hunters didn’t dare to approach it. Even hunters with extraordinary physique wouldn’t dare to enter it. It was easy for them to get lost inside. The terrain was extremely complicated and mysterious.
“Eight or nine people attacked the imperial city and destroyed it. This kind of strength isn’t something that ordinary pioneers can do. At least they are at the level of a military god or even an expert of the inner wilderness.”Dudian’s eyes flashed, “Although the wall master is not here but there are other experts under him besides the three commanders. The National Master was also an expert but he was killed. Then the two commanders rushed over. This means that the two commanders were sitting in the imperial city. Otherwise they wouldn’t have been able to get the news so quickly!”
“They are all experts but they couldn’t stop the attackers. All three families had rushed over but weren’t able to keep them. It means that there are at least five or even more experts!”
“They attacked the palace and took the body of the goddess of war? According to the history of the outer wall the goddess of war has disappeared for a long time but she is already dead.”Dudian pondered, “Why would they need a dead body? Is there a big secret hidden inside?”? “Or is the real purpose of the attackers is the king’s Seal?”? “Are they using this matter to cover up?”? It would be foolish to take the king’s seal. But if it was to take the god’s corpse then there should be a more careful plan. There wouldn’t be such a big commotion unless the attackers were from outside the giant wall.”
From the current rumors dudian speculated that the attackers were most likely from outside the giant wall. But he didn’t know whether they were from the Kingdom of God or other giant walls.
He had guessed that there were other giant walls when he learned about the existence of the Kingdom of God. But there was no information to prove it. The difference between the two was very big for him. If they came from other giant walls.., it meant that it was possible to cross the wasteland and go to another giant wall. If they came from the Kingdom of God then it was really dangerous. It was very likely that something happened to the giant wall in the Kingdom of God.
“I have to go to the inner wall personally.”Dudian made a decision. He couldn’t sift out more effective information from the information. After all, rumors were not reliable, it was best to see it in person.
However, doing so was undoubtedly very dangerous. He was a sensitive person. Both the attackers and the experts in the inner wall would attack him.
“Young master, this is too dangerous!”Neuss hurriedly said.
Dudian waved his hand: “While I’m not here, you and Barton Guard this place. If the enemy comes, just leave and run.”He turned back to the temple and prepared.
A moment later, he was armed. He spread his wings and grabbed Aisha’s waist as he flew into the sky.
..
..
In a cliff valley in the Pagar Mountains.
Six figures were sitting around a huge silver coffin. Some of them were leaning against the coffin, while others were sitting on the coffin. If others saw their actions, they would probably be extremely angry, this was a blasphemy against the female God of War!
The hunchbacked old man sat on the coffin with his eyes closed. Bean-sized cold sweat dripped down from his temples. His face was red, and his old fingers were trembling slightly, as if he was trying his best to hold back something.
The fatty standing next to him looked at him worriedly and said in a low voice, “Can Big Brother Hold On?”
“Second brother, what are you saying?”The burly fourth brother beside him said angrily, “How can a mere bit of poison defeat Big Brother? “These damn grandsons are too damn sinister. They can use all kinds of sinister moves. When Big Brother’s injuries recover, I will definitely go back and take revenge for sixth, ninth, and tenth!”
“This is not an ordinary poison.”The graceful woman who was leaning against the divine coffin covered one of her arms. Only a section of her arm was left, and it was actually broken from the elbow down. She had a worried expression on her face, “Who would have thought that such a small toad would have such a strong poison? It’s too terrifying. If we were to encounter it, we would probably have died on the spot. Fortunately, Big Brother is powerful, so he was able to endure until now.”
“If I had known earlier, I would have caught that Toad and eaten it,”the fatty muttered.
A handsome young man with long hair beside him sighed and said, “Even you probably wouldn’t have been able to digest it. To be able to poison big brother to such a state, this little thing is too terrifying.”
“If Big Brother hadn’t been poisoned and injured underground and that bunch of grandsons came, how could we not be able to defeat them? How could old nine and Old Ten Die!”The burly man gritted his teeth and clenched his fists.
There was a huge cut on his chest, but it had already turned into a bloody shackle, making him look particularly ferocious.
Upon closer inspection, the six of them were all injured. Some were more serious, some were only cut by swords and sabers, but there were no broken limbs.
“If we had known earlier, we would have sneaked into the three great demon-hunter families and exterminated them one by one!”
“Didn’t Big Brother say that this would alert the enemy and alert the Imperial City? When they move the god’s corpse to a place we don’t know about, it would be difficult to find it.”
“It’s US who underestimated the people in the divine wall. Although they don’t have a ruler, I didn’t expect there to be so many experts in the inner wilderness, especially that bitch. She’s too difficult to deal with. Old Nine died in her hands. I must kill her!”
“When Big Brother’s poison is neutralized, I will avenge old nine and old ten.”
Fatty sighed, he said, “Everyone should recuperate and recover as soon as possible. Those damn things are still outside. They are probably discussing how to deal with us. We must protect Big Brother’s safety. When Big Brother’s poison is neutralized, we must kill them and turn the world upside down!”
“That’s right. When the time comes, we will round up those B * tches one by one. The men will all be chopped up and thrown outside the wall to feed the monsters!”

chapters.title: Chapter 753
chapters.content:
Chapter 753 – Chapter 743: Pause [ First Watch ]
Outside the Pagar Mountains.
Dozens of figures with powerful auras stood on a high slope. They were vaguely divided into five camps. If there were people who were familiar with the forces in the inner wall, they would be identified by the medals or armor patterns on their bodies. In addition to the well-known military and monasteries, there were the Witcher Dragon clan with black dragon patterns, and the wing clan with four wings, there were also the witcher rock race with Turtle shell-shaped badges.
On the flat ground in front of these people, several figures with unfathomable auras stood together, forming a small circle to discuss matters.
“Your Highness Ulita, is the real Lord Sylvia the god of war sealed inside the coffin that these people robbed?”A burly man with a height of nearly three meters asked. His voice was deep and powerful, it was as if rolling thunder was surging in his throat, and his words were imposing without anger.
He was asking about a slender girl. The girl was not short, but standing in front of him only to his abdomen, she looked petite and lovely. She was wearing a unique crown, and her temperament was noble and elegant. When she heard the giant’s words.., she frowned slightly, “Of course, the god of war’s remains of Sylvia have always been sealed under the palace. These people killed the grand preceptor, and also killed the four pioneers and the previous grand preceptor who guarded the divine coffin. Even the two divine beasts guarding the divine coffin were killed. Fortunately, Commander Kate called you here in time. Now that they are all heavily injured, you should destroy them as soon as possible and take back the God’s remains of Sylvia!”
“Do not attack by force.”A woman in a golden robe, with a flame totem burning at the corner, shook her head slightly. She had a graceful and elegant temperament, looking like a young woman in her early twenties, she also looked like a charming young woman in her early thirties, with a cold and unique temperament. She looked calm and said calmly, “If they are forced to destroy the God’s remains, we can not bear the consequences.”
“That’s right. These people are all masters of the inner desolation level, and the demons they cast are unprecedented. It is obvious that they came from another giant wall. If they are forced into a dead end, the possibility of destroying the divine remains is very high.”The one who spoke was an old man wearing the robe of a missionary in a monastery, he had a refined and sacred temperament, which made people believe him.
Seeing their worries, Ulita was anxious, she said, “However, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. One of them was injured by the poison arrow frog, and two more were killed. The rest of them are also seriously injured. If we don’t act now, it will be even more difficult to take back the god’s remains when they recover. Once the God’s remains are taken away by them, we will all be destroyed!”
“Your Highness, don’t be anxious.”The giant said in a deep voice, “We will not let them move the god’s remains out of the giant wall. They are only six people left. Although they are all experts of the inner wilderness, we will not lose to them. Dragon mother, Old Bird, and I are enough to suppress the three of them. Mr. DE, Amos, and Kate can also hold the three of them back. With so many pioneers’help, it is not difficult to keep them. However…”
“Yes, we have to find a way to separate them from the coffin so that they don’t have time to care about the coffin.”
Urita clenched her fingers as her heart was burning with anxiety. Her father had left the giant wall to go to the Kingdom of God and handed the giant wall to her. She didn’t expect that there would be such a big mess. However, she knew that.., it was impossible for them to attack unless… there was no ‘unless’. She lowered her head and fell silent.
..
..
In the wilderness, a figure was flying fast in the air. It was Dean.
He spread his wings and advanced at full speed at high altitude. Now that the inner wall royal city had been attacked and the royal palace had been destroyed, most of the pioneers must have gone to the first front. He was not afraid of flying so high to expose himself.
By contrast, he is more concerned about the current state of the attackers and, if he can, this is an opportunity for him.
He bypassed some of the city routes protected by the Earls and rushed all the way to the central area of the inner wall, the direction of the Imperial City.
When he got close to the imperial city, he looked down from a high altitude. After flying around it once, he saw the destroyed city wall on the west side. There was a huge breach that was dozens of meters long. It was not difficult to imagine what kind of shocking battle broke out at that time, at present, there were a large number of builders building the broken city wall. The soldiers were patrolling back and forth. The security was even more strict.
In addition, he saw that several city gates were closed. It was obvious that they were blocking the entry and exit of people.
He hid his aura and climbed over the opposite wall of the broken city wall. The guards there were relatively weak. After he sneaked into the imperial city, he immediately disguised as an ordinary civilian and went to inquire about the news.
Half an hour later, Dudian flew out of the Imperial City again. This time it was very easy to inquire about the news. It seemed that everyone in the imperial city knew about it. Everyone was talking about it, dudian found that although there were some differences but the general situation was the same. The attackers had attacked the imperial city, destroyed the palace, killed the Grand National Master, and were besieged by the Witcher family, they fled in a sorry state.
In addition, there were witnesses who saw them carrying a ten meter long silver coffin.
“I didn’t expect that these people would really come to rob the god’s corpse. However, the body of Sylvia should be placed in a ten meter long coffin?”Dudian thought as he flew towards the Pugard Mountains, there should be some big secret hidden in the body of the female God of war. Perhaps it had an extremely important role that would make the other giant wall or the people of the Kingdom of God cross the Dangerous Abyss and wasteland to rob them.
However, only the Abyss Walkers could cross the Abyss. Even the master level pioneers could fall in the Abyss!
However, if there were abyss walkers among these people, then they shouldn’t have been forced to escape. Could it be that there were abyss walkers among the people sent by the Witcher Family?
Dudian didn’t understand. The information was too scarce. The main reason was that these big forces had been rooted in the inner wall for hundreds of years. It was hard to guarantee that there wouldn’t be any hidden forces that outsiders couldn’t detect.
However, he felt that the possibility of Abyss Walkers among the three families wasn’t high. If there were such strong people, there was no need to hide them. If they were exposed, it would create more value and would be enough to make others submit to them, it would also be able to open up a large amount of wasteland.
If this possibility was not established then it meant that there was no abyss Walker among the attackers. At the same time it meant that they had used other methods to come here.
“Other methods…”Dudian’s figure suddenly stopped. His eyes slightly flickered as he turned to look at the towering giant wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 754
chapters.content:
Chapter 754 – Chapter 744: Search For [ Second Update ]
“Are they flying from the Sky?”Dudian couldn’t help but think of this possibility. After all, the land was full of monsters. It was almost impossible for them to come over from the land, they had to have the power of an Abyss Walker in order to be able to travel all the way.
But if they were flying from the sky, as far as he knew there were Thunderbirds in the clouds. If they flew too low then they would be easy targets for the monsters on the land. If they flew too high then they would be easily detected by the Thunderbirds unless.., their mounts were wyverns that the Thunderbirds wouldn’t attack!
Dudian’s eyes lit up.
These attackers were riding wyverns!
“If that’s the case, their wyverns should stay outside the giant wall in case the wyverns meet with misfortune. In that case, they will stay in the giant wall forever. They can not leave and can only wait for the return of the giant wall…”Dudian felt that it was possible, his heart was beating fast.
However, he knew that this was only the first possibility.
The second possibility was that there was someone among the attackers who had a special ability to cover their smell and all their whereabouts. It would allow them to pass through the Abyss and live in peace.
However, the possibility was not very high. After all, these people came here with a premeditated plan. They should have calculated all kinds of factors when the giant wall was not here. The Abyss was the deepest and most unpredictable place. Any monster could appear. No one was 100% sure that they could hide from the eyes of all the monsters in the abyss.
After all, the detection ability of some monsters with top perception was unimaginable.
In comparison, the first possibility was the biggest!
“If I can get the flying dragon that they are riding, I can go anywhere in the world, even if it is the Kingdom of God…”Dudian’s heart pounded. With the flying dragon in his hand, even if his plan failed.., he would be able to escape. After he controlled the inner wall, he would be able to use the dragon to go to other places in the future. He wouldn’t be restricted by the giant wall!
He took a deep breath and suppressed the excitement in his heart. He pondered for a while before he turned around and flew towards the giant wall.
Originally he wanted to investigate the situation of the pagar mountains and observe the situation from afar. But now compared to this information, finding the dragon was obviously the most valuable. He could even use the dragon to negotiate with the attackers.., let them help him overthrow the inner wall!
“Where will they stop the Flying Dragon?”? “It shouldn’t be safe to leave one flying dragon alone. After all, this is the only way for the nine of them to return. At least one or even two people will be left to guard. In other words, I might face two experts from the inner wall…”Dudian thought, he looked at Aisha who was in his arms. Her expression was calm as usual.
He whispered: “I might need your help later.”
Aisha was silent.
He held her hand and silently flew forward.
A moment later, he came to the sky above the giant wall. He looked around. There was an endless wilderness outside the giant wall.
“These attackers appeared in the inner wall and directly attacked the imperial city. It means that they have investigated and know the location of the God’s corpse.”Dudian pondered, “They should have been here for some time. They shouldn’t have attacked so recklessly. Although this attack is quite stupid but it also means that they are so reckless. They should have absolute confidence…”
“They should be in the inner wall. It means that the route and direction of the giant wall is the inner wall and not the south of the outer wall. Otherwise, they will directly find the Utoto Mountain or the military. They will seize the strongest person in the perception to gather intelligence…”
Dudian eliminated the possibility that the dragon was in the south of the giant wall. After all, the attackers were so confident that they wouldn’t deliberately stop the dragon in the south and sneak into the other side.
However, there were still three giant walls left. The length of each wall was extremely long. With his flying speed, it would take him two to three hours to complete one wall. It would take him eight to nine hours to complete three walls. It was too long, if the attackers in the Pagar Mountains broke out of the encirclement of the Witcher family and the military and were hit by him then they would be in bad luck.
“The giant wall near the wall of sighs can be ignored. If they saw the wall of sighs, they would have come to the outer wall to check out the situation out of curiosity. After all, the majestic spirit of the wall of Sighs is enough to scare people. However, they did not come to the outer wall. Otherwise, my intelligence network would definitely know. In this case, they would not be able to see the wall of sighs when they entered the giant wall.”
“There must be at least one of them who has the top perception ability. One of them is an expert who is good at perception. The perception of the source of sound is at least twenty miles. The perception of smell is more than a hundred miles. From the wall of sighs to the inner wall, other than the radius of his perception, the rest of the places could be where they enter the giant wall…”Dudian pondered for a while, he immediately found the giant wall thirty miles away from the wall of Sighs and flew along the giant wall. He observed the situation outside the giant wall and the situation on the giant wall.
He maintained a high level of concentration along the way. He was observing every minute detail, especially the smell in the air.
He felt that it was unlikely for the nine of them to clean up their own smell. It hadn’t rained for two days so they would stand on the wall and observe for a while, although it was faint but it was enough for him to detect.
Dudian flew for about half an hour before he suddenly stopped. He gently inhaled and soon his eyes locked onto the giant wall in front of him. He flew over and carefully observed the giant wall. There was a very faint smell floating on it but.., there was only one smell and he was very familiar with it. It was Hathaway’s!
“She didn’t die!”There was a trace of cold killing intent in Dudian’s eyes. He looked around and followed the faint fragrance. The smell seemed to drift out of the giant wall?
Moreover, although the smell was faint, it seemed to have been left behind in the past two days.
“Even if the mercury and toxins in her body are cleaned up, she should be seriously injured. Her vitality is severely damaged and she still has the strength to run out again. Could it be that the medical methods in the inner wall are so brilliant that she can immediately recover?”Dudian’s eyes flickered, he didn’t believe that. There was another possibility that she was dragging her body out of the giant wall.
Why did she leave the giant wall so urgently? Could it be that something happened in the wasteland? Or was she planning something to deal with him?

chapters.title: Chapter 755
chapters.content:
Chapter 755 – Chapter 745: Fierce Battle -Ltwo Two In One Chapter ]
Dudian pondered for a moment and decided to follow the scent of Hathaway. If he couldn’t find her then he would retreat and continue to search for the remaining party of the attacker. Although it would be a bit late.., it was easy for things to change. But this was a rare opportunity to kill Hathaway. He didn’t want to miss it.
Whoosh!
He flew in the direction of the smell.
After the smell left the giant wall, it didn’t go in a straight line to the wilderness outside the hunting area. Instead, it stopped in all directions. The route was chaotic.
Dudian was relieved after flying for a long time. From the smell’s route, it seemed that Hathaway wasn’t summoned to the wilderness. Instead, she seemed to be wandering in the area outside the giant wall as if she was looking for something.
Ten minutes later, Dudian followed the smell and flew over a collapsed building. Suddenly, his pupils shrank and he lowered his body from the sky. He fell down and crouched on the moss and vines covered building, he looked up and saw that the ground in front of him was a mess of collapsed buildings. He could vaguely see the shape of the streets of the old era. The streets were covered with weeds and small trees which blocked his vision, the visibility on land was not far, but his pupils contracted and entered the semi-transparent state. The weeds and small trees were easily penetrated through.
In his eyes, a figure emitting waves of heat waves was sitting more than ten miles ahead. Because it was too far away, the heat waves were extremely weak, but he could see it clearly from high up in the sky, it was an extremely eye-catching red dot!
He thought for a moment and restrained his aura. He let the blood in his body flow through his frozen right arm. After the blood entered his right arm, it flowed out again. A chill spread through his entire body. It was as if he was in winter. It was so cold that he wanted to tremble.
He pursed his lips and let the heat in his body decrease to the minimum. Then, he slowly lowered his altitude. He flapped his wings and flew close to the ground. His speed was extremely slow. He maintained a speed that was slightly faster than walking so that the wind would not be too strong and alarm the person.
He didn’t choose to walk because he was worried that the source of the sound would attract attention.
As the distance slowly approached, the silhouette of the heat source gradually became clear. The latter was in a sitting position. One of his legs was straight while the other leg was bent inward. It seemed that his hand was playing with something.
This sitting posture was obviously not like a girl’s sitting posture. Dudian was startled. Suddenly, he thought of a possibility. His heartbeat suddenly increased by two beats. Could it be that this was the remaining party of the attacker?
He immediately stopped and looked around, especially in the high sky.
He carefully identified the person but there was no other heat source around.
He slightly frowned and gently sniffed. He could still smell Hathaway’s smell in the air. It meant that she had been here before and the direction of the smell was in front of them. Could it be that Hathaway knew the remaining party of the attacker?
If that was the case, then his previous deduction would be completely overturned.
He pondered for a moment and looked at Aisha. He hesitated for a moment, but his face still sank. He continued to sneak forward with Aisha in his arms.
“If there is only one enemy, with your strength and mine, we should be able to kill her. But I don’t know how she came here. Moreover, it seems that she has been in close contact with that person…”Dudian’s eyes slightly flickered, although there was some risk, but in any case, the enemy was not the two people he had expected but one. According to the rumors in the imperial city, the attackers were all masters of the Inner Wilderness. Most of the people who stayed here were the same, it was impossible for them to leave the strongest master level pioneer here. On the contrary, a group of small fries ran to the imperial city to invade.
Dudian slowly flew to a kilometer away from the man. At this distance, he could use his clairvoyance to see the bone structure of the man’s body. If he closed his eyes and listened carefully.., he could even hear the sound of the man’s dagger cutting through the sand. He looked at the man from afar. There was no killing intent in his eyes, he looked at the man.
The man was wearing a big black robe and his back was facing him. It was impossible to tell his age and appearance.
However Dudian could smell that the air around him was filled with the smell of Hathaway. It was much stronger than the smell he had smelled along the way. It meant that Hathaway had stayed here for a period of time!
“This person is either the attacker or someone from another force that Hathaway colluded with. The possibility of the latter is much higher.”Dudian frowned, if this person was the attacker, then Hathaway shouldn’t know them. If the two of them met, a war would definitely break out. However, there were no traces of battle and no smell of fresh blood.
While he was thinking, he suddenly whispered: “Since you don’t want to sneak attack me, then come out!”
The words came from the black robe!
Dudian’s face changed. He looked left and right. There was no one else. Did they already notice him or deliberately blackmail him? ”…”
He held his breath and continued to lurk.
“Come out!”The black robe turned his head and looked at Dudian’s direction. Under the Loose Black Hood was the face of a teenager.
Dudian’s eyes turned cold. He slowly walked out from the ruins of the building. He didn’t pull Aisha out but let her continue to stay behind the stone wall.
“Intruder?”The figure in black robe looked at Dudian with interest.
“Intruder?”Dudian looked at him with a cold expression.
“An Outsider?”The black-robed figure raised his eyebrows: “How do you know? Is there something going on inside the wall? How did you find this place?”The relaxed smile on his face disappeared bit by bit, he realized that this was not a simple encounter.
Dudian saw that he did not mention Aisha, so he was relieved. At the same time he asked: “How did you find me?”
“AH, although you flew all the way here and created a breeze as gentle as a natural breeze, but you are too close to me. Your Smell has exposed your existence.”The black-robed teenager indifferently said: “You haven’t answered my question.”
“Are you from the Kingdom of God or other giant walls?”Dudian continued to ask: “You Shouldn’t have the power of an Abyss Walker. How did you cross the Abyss Region?”
“You have a lot of questions.”The black robed youth sneered: “But you don’t have the qualifications to ask me questions!”His figure suddenly shook as he rushed towards Dudian.
The black robe on his head was overturned by the strong wind. A handsome youth’s face was exposed but there was no tenderness or cuteness on his face.
The moment he moved, Dudian saw the intensity of the heat source in his body rapidly increase. In an instant, it was like a burning fireball. The intensity had increased by several levels. It completely surpassed the intensity of the heat source of Hiro and Ronon.
His eyelids twitched. He quickly retreated and raised his hand.
Whoosh!
In the blink of an eye, the distance of a kilometer passed by.
When the black robe teenager was about to reach the stone wall, Dudian raised his wrist and shook it. The bell rang.
At the same time, the black-robed youth was about to pass the stone wall when he suddenly heard the sound of his feet stepping on the sand. He was shocked. He turned his head and saw a beautiful bloodthirsty face with dark pupils, it was like a whirlpool that was about to swallow him.
He was shocked. He didn’t expect that there was a person hiding here. When he saw Aisha’s black pupils, he instantly understood that this was not a person, but a king corpse!
Roar!
Aisha bared her fangs and brandished her claws as she pounced forward.
A strange limb suddenly shot out from the black-robed youth’s abdomen. He supported himself on the ground, causing his body to instantly change direction. He fell to the other side, narrowly avoiding Aisha’s sneak attack.
After landing on the ground, the black-robed youth quickly increased the distance between them. When he saw Aisha pouncing at him, he still felt somewhat unreal. This was clearly the corpse king. The smell that he emitted was also the smell of zombies, that was why he didn’t notice her existence. However, the king of undead was apparently hidden in the wall. How could the man in the wall control the king of undead?
He felt that it was incredible but he didn’t have time to think too deeply. He waited for the king of undead to come close. He quickly turned around. At the same time, the flesh on his back bulged. He spread his two dark red wings and flew into the air.
He looked at the Roaring King and Sighed in relief. He looked up at Dudian who was far away. There was a trace of murderous intent in his eyes as he quickly dived towards Dudian.
Dudian saw the shape of the king’s wings. It wasn’t a magic body that he had seen before. He was shocked as he instinctively thought of the magic body that had been activated by the other rare magic marks, but the amount of information was too much. He stopped as he thought of this. He immediately activated the magic body and shook the bell again. He silently said: “Sorry…”
Roar!
A roar was heard when the bell rang.
The black-robed teenager who was flying towards Dudian heard the roar. He couldn’t help but look back. His face changed as he saw Aisha’s ferocious face. She stretched out her hands to grab him but was unable to grab him, however, her body had undergone an earth-shaking change. Black liquid oozed out from her body and covered her whole body. Black Dragon Wings were propped up from her back to block the sunlight. Fine black dragon scales appeared on her skin, her neck and cheeks were covered by the scales. She looked like a real dragon.
But what was even more strange was that there were a few strange limbs in the middle of the dragon wings on her back. They looked like human arms but each arm was two to three meters long. The five fingers were claws and the nails were sharp.
Roar!
Aisha who had completed her magic body roared. She flapped her wings on the ground and flew into the air to catch up with the black-robed teenager.
Dudian looked up at Aisha who was completely liberated. He was nervous and prayed in his heart. At the same time, he didn’t feel good.
“Go to hell!”The black-robed teenager saw her chasing him and turned around to kill her. A sharp bone spike protruded from his arm like a two-meter-long spear and stabbed toward Aisha who was chasing from below.
Aisha seemed to be in extreme anger. She did not dodge and kept roaring ferociously. With a ‘chi’sound, the bone spike spear pierced through her shoulder and went all the way into her body, the Magic Dragon Scales on her body seemed to have no defensive function at all.
The black-robed teenager was about to pull his hand away, but Aisha’s speed was faster than he imagined. The strange limb arm in the middle of the wings on her back pounced at him with bared fangs and brandished claws. She immediately grabbed his arm. At the same time, Aisha’s arms waved and clawed at him, the five fingers of the arm that had turned into a dragon claw were full of sharp blades. They grabbed onto the black-robed teenager’s chest and instantly tore the robe on his body. Even the armor inside was slashed with several bloody marks.
The black-robed teenager’s face was full of fear. The strength of the undead King was beyond his expectations. He thought that the undead king that was controlled by a small ordinary pioneer like Dean was not very powerful, but the fact was completely opposite to what he thought, this was clearly a monster. Its strength was several times stronger than his!
He twisted his arm and broke away from the arm of the monster on Aisha’s back. He kicked Aisha’s shoulder. The latter didn’t Dodge and was immediately stopped by his kick. He used the momentum to fly forward, dean rushed forward at full speed.
“Go to hell! !”His face was full of crazy killing intent. A sharp tail suddenly appeared on his abdomen. It looked like a poisonous tail of a scorpion. There were barbs but they grew out from his abdomen. They curved and hooked towards Dean.
Dean’s face changed. He knew that he wanted to kill him so that Aisha would lose control and then throw him away. He immediately turned to the left and made an escape gesture.
However, when he took one or two steps, his body suddenly changed and rushed to the opposite right.
The black-robed teenager had just tilted his left wing and was ready to pursue dean. He didn’t expect Dean to change direction. In such a short distance and at such a high speed, it was almost impossible for him to change direction quickly, especially when Aisha was chasing after him, he could only slow down if he wanted to change direction to catch up with Dudian!
“DAMN!”He clenched his teeth and didn’t slow down. Instead, he continued to fly to the right side of Dudian. However, because he didn’t slow down, when he flew to the right side, he couldn’t stop the car and made a big arc, dudian ran in the opposite direction. The distance between the two was increased. When the black-robed teenager turned around, he saw that Dudian had appeared behind Haisha.
The distance between Haisha and him had been shortened.
“Roar!”Haisha’s face was full of killing intent. The killing intent seemed to be projected from her eyes. It was unknown whether it was because the killing intent was too crazy or because of other reasons. The scales on her forehead were lighter. The meat bun slowly protruded, the meat became more and more sharp and turned into black horns.
The black-robed teenager was extremely angry as he was entangled by Aisha. His dark red wings were spinning and sliding in curves. He wanted to shake off Aisha. He knew the weakness of the king of corpses. Its intelligence was low. Although the latter’s speed and strength were better than his.., however, his chances of winning were still very high. However, he was worried that Dudian could control the king of corpses to carry out complex combat attacks. In that case, he wouldn’t be facing an unconscious king of corpses!
Whoosh!
A cold arrow suddenly came.
The black robed teenager was about to fly in a serpentine shape when the cold arrow caught him off guard. He was startled and quickly stopped the momentum. He narrowly dodged the Arrow and looked back, he saw that Dudian, who had escaped earlier, was aiming an arrow at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 756
chapters.content:
Chapter 756 – Chapter 746: Black Prison [ First Update ]
“You are courting death!”The black-robed teenager was furious. He wanted to get rid of the king of corpses after failing to pursue Dudian. However, the king of corpses took advantage of the situation and even shot arrows to disturb him.
He clenched his teeth and suppressed his anger. He took a short snake-shaped flight to get away from the king of corpses.
Aisha was swayed by his swaying figure and flew left and right. She always missed him. However, her flying speed was faster than his and she was still following closely behind him.
Dudian saw the man’s intention and his expression was solemn. This was the first time he was fighting against a peak-level master of the wasteland. The latter’s experience was better than he imagined. Although Aisha could defeat him in a head-on fight.., but he lacked the flexibility to compete with him. He raised his hand and continued to shoot at his opponent. In addition to blocking his route of action, the more important thing was to provoke him.
The black-robed teenager was on guard this time. He dodged Dean’s cold arrows and continued to fly in a snake shape. However, the curve of his flight was slowly approaching Dean’s direction.
Dean continued to shoot and slowly moved at the same time. He formed a triangle with Aisha. If he wanted to attack himself, he would be caught by Aisha. The other party was unwilling to face such a result, after all, once Aisha bit him, he would die!
The black-robed teenager flew at full speed. He looked at the position where Dudian was constantly moving. The anger in his heart grew. He wanted to kill him with his eyes. He clenched his teeth and continued to Dodge Aisha. At the same time, he approached Dudian, he was ready to break his route and stop him from approaching Aisha.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a whistling sound came from behind.
The black-robed teenager was startled. He didn’t turn his head and suddenly dodged. A strange hand grabbed him from the side and missed. However, he saw it clearly from the corner of his eyes, aisha, who had been pulled away from him previously, unexpectedly caught up with him without him knowing.
His heart tightened and he hurriedly turned into a snake again.
However, this time, Aisha’s figure was inseparable from his. It was like a shadow attached to his body, firmly grasping the distance between them. She flew in the same snake shape as him, and her limbs seemed to be much more flexible than before.
“Not good!”The black-robed youth suddenly realized that the corpse king was slowly getting used to its body. In the chase, it had activated the subconscious ability of the original owner of its body. After all, there was a difference between the corpse king and the zombies, the difference was not only because of the disparity in strength and the fear of other undeads. More importantly, the corpse king could stimulate the body potential of the original owner.
This was the most terrifying point of the corpse king.
“This kid is deliberately delaying! No, we must leave now!”The black robed youth saw the corpse king behind him, he glanced at Dudian who was shooting at him from a distance. His eyes were almost spitting fire. The strong killing intent made him angry. However, he knew that he had to swallow his anger and leave now, otherwise, when the battle potential of the corpse king was restored more and more, it would be even more difficult for him to escape.
He was decisive and immediately flew up without looking back. He no longer paid attention to Dudian.
As he flew up, Aisha also followed closely behind him.
The black-robed teenager’s figure suddenly twisted and flew forward in parallel. Then he quickly fell down.
Aisha who was following closely behind him seemed to have expected it. She was not misled by his rapid change of direction. She also flew forward in parallel at an extremely fast speed and then quickly fell down. The route was almost exactly the same.
Whoosh!
The few strange limbs on Aisha’s back quickly pounced out and grabbed at the tail behind the black-robed youth.
The black-robed youth felt the terrifying aura that was firmly locked on his back. His expression was unsightly. He swung his tail rapidly and struck at the strange limbs that Aisha extended.
However, the strange limbs on Aisha’s back were extremely agile. They were no longer as rigid as before. Two of the strange limbs directly shook at the black-robed youth’s tail. The other strange limb suddenly stabbed like a sharp knife and instantly hit the black-robed youth’s tail, the claws of the strange limb were like barbs and firmly held onto his tail. The other strange limbs immediately climbed up along his tail and closed the distance between them.
The black-robed teenager turned pale with fright. He suddenly let out a low roar. With a ‘chi’sound, his tail suddenly broke off from the root.
After losing his tail, he sprinted forward for a short distance, but his speed quickly decreased. Without the balance of his tail, it would be very difficult for him to use the nimble snake-like flying form from before.
Whoosh!
A sharp arrow suddenly shot over from the front.
The black-robed youth’s expression changed as he dodged to the side. The suppressed anger in his heart instantly surged up, but at this moment, a cold killing intent enveloped him from behind, like a black haze that turned into a bloody mouth.., it was as if it could swallow him at any moment.
His anger instantly disappeared, and his face turned pale. He mustered all the strength in his body and charged forward with all his might. At the same time, he took out a strange stone from his bosom. There were many small holes on this stone, and he aimed at one of them and blew.., suddenly a ripple-like sound was heard.
The sound was not loud but it was very distant.
Dudian was surprised to see his action. was he calling for help?
At the same time he heard a rumble from thousands of meters away. The ground under his feet shook. The next moment he saw a huge black mountain-like sphere rising from the ground like a black hole, it rolled quickly and crushed all the weeds and broken stones along the way. It was the black ground that he had seen before. Moreover, it was the huge black prison!
“So, the black prison outside the giant wall is theirs…”such an idea popped up in Dean’s mind. The next moment, he suddenly remembered that Aisha had been locked by the black prison. His face changed and he immediately reached for his waist bag, soon, he touched the match. His heart calmed down as he looked around. The most abundant thing in the hunting area outside the giant wall seemed to be weeds.
He immediately found a withered yellow weed and rubbed the match to light it up.
The ground rumbled and trembled slightly.
The match finally lit up a few withered yellow weeds. He twisted the weeds into a ball and stretched them into the bushes next to him. Soon, the flame gradually burned the growing weeds. The flame slowly covered more weeds.
The black-robed youth felt the heat and turned his head to take a look. His pupils immediately constricted, and he almost cried out.
At this moment, he felt a sharp pain on his back, as if he had been stabbed by a few sharp knives. He looked back and saw a ferocious face filled with killing intent coming toward him. He hurriedly flapped his wings, two daggers suddenly appeared from the flesh on his palms. These daggers seemed to be part of his body. He waved the daggers and quickly returned the attack. However, in the next moment, a few black shadows flashed, and with a few ding ding sounds, the daggers in his hands were knocked away.
His hands were covered with several bloody scars, and the Daggers in his hands also had a few small holes.

chapters.title: Chapter 757
chapters.content:
Chapter 757 – Chapter 747: Change [ Second Update ]
“Impossible!”The black-robed teenager was terrified. He looked at the claws of the monster. He roared and waved his dagger to stab at Aisha’s forehead. He couldn’t avoid the attack, even if he was injured, he would be able to kill the zombie king. As for Dudian, he believed that he could kill him even if he was heavily injured.
Whoosh!
At this time, one of the claws of the monster suddenly turned and moved to the front of the dagger. It hit the dagger with its palm. The dagger pierced through her palm but her palm didn’t feel any pain, she tightly grabbed the palm of the black-robed teenager.
The black-robed teenager was scared out of his wits. He quickly struggled but his palm was tightly held. He looked at Aisha who was slowly approaching him. Aisha’s dark eyes seemed to flash with cold killing intent, it was like a ghost that crawled out of Hell. He had an illusion that this was not a senseless corpse king. It seemed that there was a brutal soul hidden in this body!
That’s right. At this moment, he felt that the corpse king had evolved into wisdom!
He could tell from the fact that he knew about defense.
Dudian who was standing on the ground saw the black-robed teenager’s attack. His heart was in his throat but he was stunned the next moment. Aisha actually knew how to defend? ! Could it be that her consciousness had recovered? !
He looked at Aisha in a daze and even forgot to put the arrow to launch a sneak attack.
The strange limbs on Aisha’s back suddenly turned and drew a black light like a poisonous python. In an instant, it pierced through the black-robed teenager’s chest and stabbed out from his back, it looked like there were a few sharp claws on his back. The skin of these hands was pale, like the claws of a malicious spirit. It was eerie and terrifying.
The black-robed teenager’s chest was pierced and his body froze. When he struggled to push forward, he felt a tearing sensation on his chest. The next moment, his consciousness turned black.
Blood rain flew in the air.
The black-robed teenager’s body was torn into pieces and grabbed by the sharp claws.
Aisha lowered her head. The black wings of the giant magic dragon curled slightly and hugged her body. It was like a huge black sphere floating in the air. It slowly descended and stood on the ground.
Dudian could hear the sound of bones breaking and gnawing coming from the black ball. His face changed and the hope in his heart disappeared. His palm slightly trembled as he raised his arm, he gently shook the bell.
There was an inexplicable fear in his heart when he shook the bell. He was afraid that the command would go out of control and she would never return to his side.
He suddenly regretted that he didn’t come here and meet the black-robed teenager.
The sound of the bell echoed out. The sound of chewing disappeared but it didn’t return to Dudian’s side. Instead it fell into a dead silence.
After a long time.
Dudian was awakened by the sound.
He turned his head and saw that the black prison had stopped outside the burning weeds. It seemed that it was afraid of the heat of the flame. But it hesitated and didn’t leave immediately, it rolled on the ground and created a deep pit.
Dudian looked back. He wasn’t in the mood to care about the black prison. He only hoped that Aisha would be safe and return to his side.
He stood in place and looked at her. He didn’t dare to approach her.
There was also a trace of fear in his heart.
After a long time, the wings of the dragon slowly spread and revealed Aisha’s body. She looked like a lone dragon standing with her back to Dudian. There were broken limbs and heads scattered on the ground.
His heart almost stopped beating as he stared at her.
The next moment, Aisha slowly turned around and walked towards Dudian step by step.
