Dudian looked at the terrifying figure walking towards him. He felt an inexplicable throb in his heart. He had a feeling that Aisha’s body had undergone some changes. Her temperament seemed to be different from before, it seemed that there was more violent and violent aura. She was no longer as calm as before.
He slightly raised his hand and used the bell to give the order to stop.
Aisha stopped and quietly looked at dudian. However, her dark eyes were no longer as empty as before. It was as if… she was seriously looking at Dudian.
However, there was no calm in her eyes. There was a kind of evil hidden in them.
Dudian looked at her eyes and suddenly felt that the distance between him and her had become more distant.
He was silent as he slowly approached her.
As he got closer to her, his heart beat faster and faster uncontrollably. A wave of oppressive murderous aura stood in front of him like a mountain, making him unable to breathe.
He took out a handkerchief, raised his hand and gently wiped the blood on her lips.
Aisha didn’t move. She quietly looked at him, but the violent murderous aura on her body seemed to gradually calm down like a violent hurricane.
Dudian was relieved to see that she didn’t make a move. However, he felt a bit of pain in his heart when he saw that she was still in her magic body. He was worried that it would be difficult for her to return to her human form after she used her full strength, however, he didn’t expect that such a situation would happen in this battle. Sure enough, no luck would come to him. The worst probability would always be met by him.
He silently looked at her for a while. After he calmed down, he turned his head to look at the black prison that was lingering in the distance.
“Wait for me here for a while.”He said to Haisha while shaking the bell.
Haisha didn’t respond but her head seemed to move slightly.
Dudian didn’t think much. He uprooted the burning weeds and rushed towards the black prison.
Black prison saw Dudian approaching with the flame. It seemed that it was scared. It immediately turned around and ran away.
Dudian spread his wings and caught up with it. Although the structure of the black prison was strange. It was able to block strong people like Aisha but its movement was slow. As long as they didn’t fight it in close combat it would be fine.
Dudian used his body to protect the burning weeds. He twisted the grass and approached black prison.
Black prison let out a sharp scream as it shot out a few black limbs from its spherical body.
Dudian’s figure flashed as he dodged the attack of its tentacles. He grabbed the burning grass and jumped onto its body. The flames lit up its body as it let out a sharp scream.
Dudian saw that the flames were burning on its body so he quickly turned around and flew away.
Boom! !
An earth-shaking explosion was heard. Dudian’s back seemed to have been hit by a huge rock. He pushed his body forward and fell down uncontrollably. He hit the ground and buried his face into the sand.
He coughed and got up from the ground. He felt that his ribs were broken. He turned his head and saw that the black prison had disappeared. There was a huge crater left in its place, black fat was scattered all around.
Suddenly, he saw a faint figure of heat from the corner of his eyes. It appeared in the grass hundreds of meters to the left.
He stood up and looked over. He was instantly stunned, and the killing intent in his eyes immediately shot out.

chapters.title: Chapter 758
chapters.content:
Chapter 758 – Chapter 748: Out Of Control [ First Update ]
Whoosh!
Dudian rushed to the front of the figure. It was a seventeen or eighteen-year-old girl. She was wearing a green armor. The surface of the armor had faded due to corrosion. She was lying motionless on the ground, it seemed that she had fainted.
Dudian would never forget this face. He didn’t expect to meet Hathaway here. Moreover she was in a coma due to severe injuries. He understood why there were traces of her smell, it turned out that she had come here earlier and fought with the black-robed youth but was swallowed by the black prison.
Looking at her face which was covered with unknown mucus, his eyes were filled with killing intent. He didn’t approach her directly but controlled the few sharp limbs on his back to shoot out and Pierce through her wrists and knees, two of the sharp limbs were pressed against her throat and chest at the same time. As long as she moved slightly, they would immediately pierce into her.
The arm and knee parts were hit hard. Hathaway seemed to wake up from the pain. She frowned slightly and slowly opened her eyes.
Dudian saw that she had regained consciousness and didn’t stop. The few sharp limbs suddenly flew and cut off her arm and knee. Blood sprayed out and Hathaway’s body lost all four limbs in an instant.
At this time, Hathaway had completely woken up from the pain. Her eyes were wide open and there was a trace of fear in them. When she saw Dudian in front of her, she was stunned. There was a trace of shock on her face but the next moment.., she saw that her limbs had been cut off. Her brain suddenly buzzed and went blank.
“You didn’t expect to meet me here.”Dudian’s face was full of malevolence and killing intent as well as sadistic pleasure, he said word by word: “You were lucky to escape last time, but God will not always look after you!”
Hathaway woke up and looked around. Soon she saw that it was still the wilderness outside the giant wall. She could see the towering giant wall behind Dudian and the beautiful figure standing in the distance that was indelible in her memory, her mind was in a mess. Although her limbs were in pain, but what made her more afraid was that she was facing Dudian without any resistance. She was facing the youth who had crazy hatred and killing intent towards her.
She knew what would happen if she fell into her hands. But the current situation was terrible to her. There was no possibility to reverse the situation!
Dudian saw her gnashing her teeth and grinned. The limbs of the monster on her back danced rapidly. The armor on Hathaway’s body was immediately peeled off, she was thrown dozens of meters away. In the blink of an eye, Hathaway was naked. She was lying on the grass like a snow-white lamb. Every secret part of her body was exposed.
There was a trace of panic in Hathaway’s eyes but she quickly regained her cool. If there was anything that could make her persist, it was that she would never do as Dudian wished. She knew that.., even if she did that, she would not be able to get the forgiveness of this teenager. There was no way to resolve that kind of hatred other than killing!
“Even if you kill me, you won’t be able to get my sister. She has become the king of undead and will never come back!”Hathaway coldly looked at dudian. Although she was lying on the ground, her chin was slightly raised, it was as if she was looking down at Dudian.
These words pierced into Dudian’s heart like a sharp awl. He suddenly roared and threw a sharp blade onto her cheek. He immediately cut a bloody wound, “Shut up, Bitch!”He roared in anger, blue veins protruded from his neck.
“Kill me if you have the ability, you lowly man. Look at your ugly face. Even if my sister didn’t become the king of undead, she wouldn’t be interested in a man like you.”Hathaway endured the pain coming from her face and limbs, she felt cold because of the loss of blood but she still looked at Dudian proudly, she taunted: “You are a loser. Do you think my sister is good to you because she likes you? Don’t you look at yourself in the mirror? There are many people who are a hundred times more handsome than you. There are countless people who are better than you in terms of ability. What is it that makes you worthy of my sister’s attention? You are just a clown, a lowly pariah…”
Dean’s sharp limbs pierced into her shoulder. The sharp pain interrupted Hathaway’s words. Dean’s face was distorted so much that it was almost inhuman. He looked at her ferociously, word by word: “You don’t deserve to talk about her. You Don’t deserve to talk about her!”
“You don’t deserve to talk about her!”Hathaway slightly twitched in pain, but she still clenched her teeth and retorted.
Dudian’s eyes bulged out. He suddenly smiled and said: “You Like to talk, right? Without a tongue, can you talk?”His sharp limbs reached out to Hathaway’s mouth, the sharp blade pierced through her lips. Blood seeped out from the corner of her mouth.
Hathaway clenched the sharp blade with her teeth. There was a trace of fear in her mocking eyes.
Dudian grinned: “This is just the beginning. You Won’t be so lucky this time. I will make you suffer hundreds of times more than what you have done to me and her!”
Hathaway clenched her teeth and didn’t dare to speak.
Dudian didn’t really intend to cut off her tongue. He was hoping to get some secrets from him about the Dragon clan and other families. He took back the sharp blade but still pressed it against her chin, “If I hear you say bad things about your sister from your mouth, I will cut off your tongue piece by piece and feed it to the dogs. Your tongue will come into close contact with the wild dog.”
Hathaway’s face changed. Although she could endure the pain of having her tongue cut off, but Dudian’s next words made her heart palpitate. She felt nauseous thinking about her tongue being eaten by a wild dog.
“Lowly peasant, a peasant like you who has done all kinds of bad things will definitely die! !”Hathaway clenched her teeth.
Dudian gently grinned. His sickle-like arm stretched out and cut her snow-white body like a lamb, “What do you think will happen if I tie you up and throw you into the most bustling imperial city or throw you to the Dragon Clan?”
Hathaway’s face changed. This was something she couldn’t bear. It would be more painful than death. But she knew that she couldn’t be cowardly, she sneered: “Despicable scum. Your mind is filled with filthy things. Don’t you want to fuck me? Go ahead. I’ll see if you have the face to do something as shameful as being an animal in front of my sister!”
Dudian spat on her white belly. His eyes were filled with disgust, “Fuck You?”? “You are more disgusting than an ugly monster in my eyes!”! “Do you think I want to fuck you by stripping your clothes?”? “You think too highly of yourself. I just want to get rid of your witcher and other hidden equipment. However, since you are so eager to be fucked, I will satisfy you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 759
chapters.content:
Chapter 759 – Chapter 749: [ Second Update ]
“This excuse is so bad! After saying so much, don’t you want to do those dirty things? A pariah is a pariah!”Hathaway slightly raised her chin, she looked at dudian in ridicule: “As long as you are shameless enough to do such a thing in front of my sister, you can come!”
“You really think highly of yourself.”Dudian’s smile was cold, “I will let the slums come to you. There is no lack of slums in the outer wall. Don’t you call them slums? You can spend the rest of your life serving them!”
“You!”Hathaway was angry. She had underestimated Dudian’s sinister methods. She would rather die if those dirty slums were to lay on her body!
“You framed your own sister because of her identity as a saintess.”Dudian stabbed her shoulder blade and lifted her body, “I won’t let you die so easily. I will let you see me ascend to the position of the Supreme Wall Master. I will make sure that you will never be able to turn back. Even if you die, I will hunt you down and torture you forever!”
Hathaway was in pain. She barely raised her eyes to look at Dudian. She tried to squeeze out a mocking smile: “You are delusional!”
Dudian smiled but didn’t say anything. His pupils entered the perspective state. The sharp limbs on his back danced like a few tails. There was a sizzling sound. There were many cuts on Hathaway’s body, the wounds were shallow and there wasn’t much blood oozing out. But in Dudian’s perspective, all the joints and meridians of Hathaway’s body were cut off. It was as if she had undergone a precise operation, she was completely disabled. There was no way for her to escape by herself.
Although he had made up his mind to capture her last time when he let her escape. He would never give her a chance to escape. But this time he seemed to be blessed by God, he was able to capture her without any effort.
“You will die a horrible death…”Hathaway’s body was crippled and she was on the verge of death. Her head tilted and she fainted.
Dudian threw her body aside, picked up her hands and feet and wrapped them with her clothes. He went to the place where the black prison exploded. He looked around and found several pieces of black prison’s exploded flesh. He wrapped them with his clothes, he was going to take them back to Poland and Charmanson to see if he could learn something from them so that the three small black prisons that he brought back from the inner wall would quickly grow up.
He had seen the ability of the black prison many times. Even someone as strong as Aisha could be wrapped and swallowed by it. From the corrosion of the Chromium on Hathaway’s armor, it was clear that the black prison’s body had a very terrifying digestive ability, dudian couldn’t think of any other way to deal with it. He felt that even the most unfathomable dragon mother would be swallowed by it in a close combat with the black prison, it would digest them to death.
“It’s a pity that this person is dead. I can’t find out the secret of their departure.”Dudian flew in a circle and looked around. He didn’t see any powerful heat source. He didn’t see any other black prison in his field of vision, as well as the flying dragon that he had guessed.
“Could it be that the flying dragon inhabits the sky?”Dudian looked up at the sky. The white clouds were thick and the blue color was particularly beautiful. He frowned. The black robed youth hadn’t summoned the flying dragon until he was killed, could it be that he died too quickly and didn’t have time to react? Or did he know that the flying dragon wouldn’t be able to escape death so he didn’t summon it? Or was it because they didn’t want to ride the Flying Dragon?
Dudian sighed in his heart. It would be great if the black-robed teenager was still alive. He would be able to find out many secrets from him? What was the scale of the Kingdom of God? There were other giant walls besides Sylvia? How many were there? Why did they rob the body of the god of War of Sylvia?
“It seems that I have to find a way to find out from the mouth of the rest of the people.”Dudian shook his head and felt sorry. He landed and picked up the torn limbs of the black-robed teenager. He wrapped them up in his clothes, he hugged Aisha and used his tail to wrap Hathaway as he flew towards the giant wall.
He was still thinking as he flew back to the giant wall. He changed his direction and flew towards the outer wall.
Half an hour later he returned to Mount Uto.
He sent Aisha to the temple and asked Neuss to call Riley.
Riley lived on the mountain. His daily job was to teach aurora how to practice swordsmanship so his days were quite easy.
He came to the temple and saw Hathaway who had no limbs on the ground. His face slightly changed. He felt that every time he came to see Dudian he would have a heart palpitating feeling. He bowed his head: “Young Master.”
“There is something I need you to do.”Dudian threw a silk handkerchief to him: “Go to the west of the giant wall. Thirty miles north of the wall of Sighs. Sixty miles away from the giant wall. Wait for people there.”
“Wait for people?”Riley took the handkerchief and found something wrapped inside. He opened it and saw a broken finger.
“There will be a group of strong people coming over. They will ask you what happened there. Tell them that if they want to know where the owner of the finger is then they have to kill all the experts in the inner wall.”
Riley was startled. He knew what the concept of wasteland level was. Dudian wanted to use this group of people to help him clear the obstacles, he was aware of the danger that he was going to deal with. The owner of the finger must have an unusual relationship with this group of people. If this group of people got angry after seeing the broken finger then they would kill him on the spot!
He clenched his teeth. He knew that he had no choice but to bow his head.
“This group of people might not go there.”Dudian saw Riley’s worry but didn’t point it out, he calmly said: “Even if they go, as long as you open your mouth, they will not make things difficult for you. After five days, if you don’t meet anyone, you can come back.”
“I understand.”Riley was relieved and respectfully took his leave.
After he left, Dudian asked Noyce to take Hathaway to the dungeon and asked about the situation in the inner wall. However, his intelligence network was not that efficient and there was no latest news.
He didn’t have much hope. He got up and went to the inner wall personally. He didn’t bring Aisha with him. He felt that if he let her fight with all her strength again, she might really lose control.
Moreover, he was only there to gather information. He thought that even if he was discovered, it should not be a problem for him to escape with his strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 760
chapters.content:
Chapter 760 – Chapter 750: Probing
The inner wall, in the Pagar Mountains.
Tents had been set up on the hillside where everyone was gathered. In the most brightly colored golden royal tent, Ulita sat on the seat of honor, her small face full of anger, “These witcher families are indeed as my father said. They are unreliable. The situation is so urgent, yet they are still not willing to attack with all their strength. Do they think I don’t know what they are thinking? HMPH!”
“Your Highness, you have to hold your breath!”A white-bearded old man said, “They are not willing to attack. They must be suspecting that this god’s corpse is not real. They want to know the location of the real God’s corpse from Your Highness. Once they know, the danger will be even greater.”
“What do you mean by real or fake? This is real!”Ulita’s eyes flickered and she immediately rebuked angrily.
The white-bearded old man knew that he had misspoken and quickly said, “Yes, Yes, your highness. Why Don’t you use the king’s seal to order them to attack?”
“Even if we force them to attack, they might not fight with all their heart.”Ulita glanced at him and said.
“Your Highness, don’t worry. At the beginning, they had nine people. Now, they have lost three people and only six people are left. Although they are all inner barren level experts like me, we have enough people here to keep them.”Yamos, who was sitting under the tent, said.
Ulita’s eyes were deep, she said, “Who knows if they still have people waiting for them outside? “Have you ever thought about how they crossed over from the abyss? “Although we can be sure that there are no abyss walkers among them, they definitely have some special means to let them come here. Moreover, they should know that my father left the giant wall and went to the Divine Kingdom!”
“Your Highness, what do you mean?”
“They should still have some trump cards that we don’t know about. Don’t think too simply.”Ulita said in a deep voice, “If we can’t finish the battle as soon as possible, although this is our home ground, delaying it is definitely not a good thing!”
The people in the tent looked at each other in dismay, and their mood immediately became heavy.
Half an hour later, Ulita gathered the experts from the three great demon-slaying families, the monastery, the court, and other forces for a meeting. She said, “Everyone, after such a long time, have you thought of a way to take back the god’s coffin?”
“Your Highness, Please Calm Down. We can not rush this matter.”The muscular man with the turtle shell medal on his armor said calmly, “We have set up a cordon around them. They will not be able to escape even if they have wings!”
Ulita’s eyes were cold as she stared at him, “Really? “But I hope you understand that once the god’s corpse is destroyed, we will all be buried with it! “Now that the god’s coffin is in their hands, the longer we drag this out, the greater the possibility of it being destroyed! “If they know that they won’t be able to escape and are in complete despair, the possibility of destroying the god’s corpse will be even greater! “Do you really want to gamble?”She said the last sentence, her meaning was clear as day.
Hearing her words, everyone’s expression changed slightly. The meaning of this sentence was obviously very clear.
The muscular man frowned slightly, and a hint of displeasure appeared on his face. With his status, even if Ulita was the only daughter of the wall master, he shouldn’t speak to him in such an attitude. After all, he was also considered an elder, but now that everyone was here.., he could not blame her on the spot, so he asked in a deep voice, “If that’s the case, What Idea Does Your Highness have in mind? Or do you still think that we can snatch back the divine coffin just by rushing forward like a swarm of bees?”
Ulita’s gaze was like a sword as she looked straight at him. The young girl’s tender face was filled with determination, without the slightest fear or retreat, she said word by word, “It’s not advisable to attack forcefully and forcefully, and it’s even more unacceptable to sit and wait for death! “I’ve already thought of an idea. We’ll take turns to send people out to fight. We won’t launch a forceful attack, but only consume them. Now that they’re all seriously injured, we can’t give them time to recover. When they’re exhausted, we’ll launch a fierce attack and take back the divine coffin in one fell swoop!”
“Your Highness, this is a good idea.”Beside them, the dragon mother, who was dressed in a gorgeous robe, smiled faintly, she said, “I agree. The longer the divine coffin is in their hands, the greater the variables. Besides, I think they have other tricks up their sleeves. We have to deal with them as soon as possible.”
Ulita glanced at her and nodded. “Lady Dragon Mother is smart.”
The muscular man raised his eyebrows slightly and glanced at her. He didn’t say anything and said indifferently, “In that case, let’s do it.”
“Since it has been decided, then quickly arrange people to prepare for the first round of battle.”The old man who was wearing the monastery robe said.
..
… ..
The wind whistled as Dudian flew through the sky. The Pagar Mountains gradually appeared at the end of his field of vision. It became clearer and clearer as he looked down from the sky. It was a mountain range with seven or eight mountains, he slowly lowered his body and restrained his aura. He suppressed the heat in his body until he slowly landed on the grassland. He folded his wings and quietly approached.
As he approached the mountains, he soon saw a large number of heat source figures gathered on the mountains. Each heat source figure seemed to be a pioneer. There were also many figures that were as hot as the sun, they were stronger than Hiro and Ronon. They were on the same level as Hathaway.
“It seems that most of the experts in the inner wall have gathered here. I didn’t expect there to be so many of them. There are twenty to thirty pioneers alone.”Dudian thought, this power was stronger than he had expected. He suddenly felt grateful to the intruders. No matter what their intention was, at least they had drawn out the hidden power of the inner wall for him, moreover, it would consume a lot of pioneers for him.
Dudian didn’t continue to approach. He hid in the soil to eliminate the smell and heat. He would be able to observe if a war broke out in the mountains.
Time passed bit by bit.
Dudian observed more and more hidden figures. He memorized all of them but there were some doubts in his heart, “There are seven experts from the inner wilderness. There are thirty-eight ordinary pioneers and twelve people from the peak of the outer wilderness like Hiro. How can such a strong force stay here and not attack?”? “There are only six enemies. They should be able to attack from the front. What are they waiting for?”
“Is it because there is no unity? Or is there something in the hands of the enemy that they need to care about? Is it the god’s corpse? But the god’s corpse is dead… are they worried that they will destroy the God’s corpse?”
“What is the God Corpse Hiding?”? “Are these intruders trying to take the god corpse’s cells for experiments?”? “But if the god corpse can be used for experiments, is there no god corpse in their homeland?”? “Moreover, the giant wall has kept the god corpse for so many years. Has It not thought of this?”? “Or is the purpose of taking the god corpse not for research but for other purposes?”
“In that case, what will happen if the God’s corpse is destroyed?”
Dudian’s heart was full of doubts. Although he couldn’t figure it out but he was sure that the god’s corpse should be closely related to the safety of the giant wall. The reason was very simple, if it wasn’t related to the interests of the giant wall, why would the three families, the monastery and the magistrate rush over? And they even brought so many experts?
One had to know that the enemy’s strength wasn’t weak. If they went to stop them, it would mean that they would suffer casualties. Once a family didn’t go and saved their strength, the family that went might decline. However, at this moment, they didn’t fight with each other like this, instead, they all took action. This only meant that once the god corpse was taken away, something big would happen to the entire giant wall!
This big event was likely to affect the interests of all the forces!
However, he couldn’t figure out how a dead body could create such a big event?
“It seems that no matter what, I can’t let these intruders take away the god’s corpse. Otherwise, I will suffer too.”Dudian thought in his heart. After a moment, he saw that these people still had no intention to take action, he frowned. From their performance it seemed that the god’s corpse was very important. But they had surrounded the enemy but didn’t attack. Was it because they were worried that the enemy would destroy the God’s corpse?
If it was because of this factor then they could take part of the people to feign attack and part of the people to contain the enemy. or they could send people to disturb the enemy at any time.
“What the Hell Are These bastards doing? !”He looked a bit anxious.
After half an hour, Dudian finally saw the people move. Among the seven inner wilderness level heat source figures, five of them took eight outer wilderness level pioneers and more than ten ordinary pioneers to leave the high mountain, they rushed into the cliff valley in front of them.
The six heat sources below the cliff valley were motionless as if they were resting. The intensity of their heat sources was different. Some of the heat sources had very weak reactions, similar to hunters. It was obvious that they were deliberately suppressing or were seriously injured.
Soon, Dudian saw that both sides were fighting. There were many pioneers surrounding the mountain. Two of them didn’t participate in the battle but stood on both sides of the valley.
Dudian immediately saw through their plan. It was obvious that they were planning to exhaust the other side.
“They finally made their move.”Dudian was relieved. Their thoughts were similar to his. They planned to exhaust the energy of the other side and then attack in one go.
The fierce battle lasted for more than ten minutes. Four ordinary pioneers were killed. One pioneer was killed. The rest were injured. Five experts of the inner wilderness had retreated. The six intruders in the valley were not killed, most of them were also injured.
He noticed that only five of the six intruders were fighting. The weakest figure of the heat source was injured. However, the other five people protected him and did not injure him again. From this point of view, these intruders were obviously partners who had been fighting together for a long time. They were not a temporary team, otherwise, their relationship would not be so deep.
After the first round of battle ended, less than half an hour later, the five people led the same number of pioneers into the Cliff Valley again. The fierce battle broke out again.
..
..
In the Cliff Valley.
The hunchbacked old man sat upright on the divine coffin. The dark green color on his face had faded a lot compared to before. His cheeks had returned to their normal color, but there was still a hint of green on his lips. Around him, fatty and the graceful woman were guarding on both sides, fighting fiercely.
The enemies kept charging in front of them, trying to snatch the divine coffin they were guarding.
The stalemate lasted for four to five minutes before it ended. Fatty looked at the retreating enemies and was so tired that he sat on the ground and panted heavily. At the same time, he tore off a pioneer’s arm from his hand and chewed and swallowed it, he recovered his strength.
The rest of them were so tired that their heads were covered in sweat. They could not be compared to fatty. Fatty could still recover his strength by eating, but they needed to rest and recuperate.
“These grandsons did not use their full strength at all. They are deliberately exhausting our physical strength. I can’t hold on much longer.”The burly man who was in fourth place covered the sword wound on his chest and grimaced.
The graceful woman leaned on the divine coffin and panted. She said, “They are probably worried that we will destroy the divine coffin and perish together with them.”
“Big Brother’s poison is about to be neutralized. When Big Brother recovers, it will be time for all of them to be buried!”
“Why don’t we call little seven over? With him around, we can stall for a little longer. Everything will be fine once big brother recovers.”
“No, if anything happens to little seven, we will be completely finished.”
“How about this, I will call black jail over.”Fatty saw that everyone was extremely tired and hesitated for a moment before standing up and saying.
“Black Jail is moving slowly, is there enough time?”
“We should have brought the black prison in from the beginning. We have underestimated these beasts!”
Fatty no longer said anything. He reached into his stomach. His stomach was like a swamp. His palm easily sank into it. Soon he took out a stone. There were many small holes on the stone. If Dudian saw it he would recognize it, this stone was exactly the same as the one that the black robed teenager used to summon the black prison.
He blew his mouth towards the biggest hole. A melodious and strange sound was heard.
The few pioneers who were watching the valley saw Fatty’s action. They heard the strange flute sound and their faces changed. Some of them immediately went back to the camp to report.
Soon, Urita, Dragon mother and others rushed to the edge of the valley.
“Are they preparing to call for reinforcements?”
“Indeed, there are more than nine of them!”
“What should we do now?”
“Send someone to guard outside the mountain immediately. It’s best if it’s the wing clan.”Urita was the first to react, “Although we don’t know what they’re calling for, the sound of the flute can’t travel far. The thing they’re calling for might be nearby, or it might be something with special hearing. We Can Intercept and kill the thing that’s waiting for them halfway.”
“No problem.”The middle-aged man nodded. He turned around and left. He called out to his clansmen and set up a defensive line.
Outside the mountain range, in the soil.
Dudian heard the strange sound of the flute. His face changed as he thought of black prison. These people wanted to summon black prison to rescue them? But he had already killed black prison. Moreover he had killed two of them including the previous one!
He did not find a second black prison around the black-robed youth. Could it be that there was another black prison hiding somewhere else?
At that moment, he saw a group of pioneers on the mountain leaving and running toward the outside of the mountain range. He immediately guessed their intention. They must be preparing to intercept the black prison summoned by the intruders.
“This won’t do. If I stay here, I will be discovered.”He immediately got up from the soil, turned around, and ran away from the mountain range. He quickly retreated. At the same time, he suddenly thought of something, now that the powerful warriors of the three great demon hunter families were gathered here, it meant that the defense of their families should be at its weakest!

chapters.title: Chapter 761
chapters.content:
Chapter 761 – Chapter 751: Sweep
Whoosh!
Dudian flew out of the Pagar Mountains and went straight in one direction.
Along the way he passed by isolated cities. There was a lot of fighting going on. There were groups of undeads wandering in the streets. Some cities had been cleaned by the army and the buildings were in ruins. Some were still like a dead city, occasionally he could see some huge monsters sleeping on the streets of the city.
Dudian silently watched the scene from the high sky. He didn’t stop as he flew to the farthest region of the Pagar Mountains.
Although he hated the Dragon clan the most among the three families. However, the Dragon clan was close to the Pagar Mountains. If the Dragon Clan was fighting then they would send a message to the mother dragon and other dragon experts, it was difficult to avoid timely support.
Two hours later, he arrived at the territory of the Rock clan. It was a remote city. There weren’t many nobles living in it. Most of the nobles didn’t want to get involved with the demon hunters, however, order had been restored in the city. Most of the houses were closed. The patrolling soldiers were heavily guarded on the city wall.
“I’ll start with you.”Dudian whispered in his heart. He sneaked into the city and went straight to the magnificent building in the center of the city, most of the buildings were decorated with the shell-shaped flags of the Rock tribe.
Dudian hid outside the building and observed the heat sources in the buildings. Soon he saw that there were three pioneer level experts in the building. Two of them were at the level of a war god.
“I didn’t expect that there would be so many experts gathered in the Pagar Mountains. There are five pioneers left in their nest. Two of them are at the peak of the wilderness.”Dudian’s eyes lit up, the background of the family was unfathomable. However, they were in the open while he was in the dark. It was possible for him to fight against five of them as long as there were other experts hiding inside.
He thought for a moment and decided to take the risk.
This was a once in a blue moon opportunity. It could weaken the strength of the enemy. Moreover, if he succeeded he would be able to harvest a large amount of God’s nectar. The amount of God’s nectar stored by the Witcher family was several times or even more than ten times that of a monster research institute, it would be enough for him to break through to the inner wilderness level. He could even increase the strength of Sergei and Neuss. After all, he was the sole commander. Although Neuss and the others could help him but their strength was too weak, there were many things that they couldn’t do.
“First we will sneak attack one of them. The other four will be easy to deal with.”Dudian’s eyes lit up. Even if they couldn’t beat him they could retreat. He didn’t think that they would come out in full force to chase after him.
After making up his mind, he restrained his aura and controlled the heat in his body.
At the same time as Dudian arrived at the territory of the Rock tribe, in the valley of the Pagar Mountains, Urita, Dragon Mother and the others launched another attack. This was the sixth round of attack. Dragon mother was the leader, in addition to the Rock Tribe’s strong man and the winged tribe’s hawk-nosed middle-aged man, the monastery’s old missionary and commander Amos, there were more than ten pioneers who interfered from the side.
Although these pioneers could not fight against the inner wilderness level masters head-on, some of them with special abilities could help from a distance and interfere with the six people in the cliff valley.
Under the wheel of battle, the six people in the cliff valley were already exhausted, or rather, it was fatty and the other four who were exhausted. They stood by the stooped old man’s side and did not let the Dragon mother and the others have the slightest chance of getting close.
However, the dragon mother and the others had seen through their intentions. They deliberately feigned to attack the stooped old man many times, but they used their killing moves to attack the people who came forward to block them, causing them to suffer even more injuries.
Whoosh!
The Dragon Mother held her sword and charged towards the graceful woman. Her demonic body was an extremely huge black demonic dragon. There were sharp spikes protruding from its tail, and the edges of the pitch-black dragon wings on its back had a hint of snow-white color, like some kind of crystal, the collision produced a metallic sound, and it was extremely sturdy. However, her arms still maintained the appearance of a human, and she did not fully activate her demonic body. However, maintaining this state made her battle even more agile and agile, the two dragon swords in her hands, which were nearly three meters long, were mysterious and ever-changing, forcing the graceful woman to the front of the divine coffin.
The graceful woman’s demonic body was like an alligator or a snake, and her lower body was a forked snake tail. There was a spike protruding from her back, and the rest of her skin was covered by a pimple-like stratum corneum. It was extremely tough, and the scales on her snake tail were seven-colored, when she brandished it, the colors were gorgeous and dazzling. Her weapon was also a long sword, and the hilt of the sword was wrapped around her wrist like a fencing sword. The sword moves in her hand were agile and swift, but she was forced back by the twin swords of the Dragon Mother, she couldn’t withstand it!
Fatty, who was beside her, saw her predicament and wanted to intervene. However, he was entangled by the Rock Tribe’s strong man with his huge axe, so he couldn’t be distracted.
What made fatty angry was that the Rock Tribe Man’s magic marks seemed to be able to restrain him. He grabbed his arm several times and dragged it into his body. He wanted to swallow it, but the feeling of digestion came from his stomach, it was a piece of sand. There was a layer of extremely hard sand powder on his arm. Although it was sand powder, it was harder to digest than gold powder. He couldn’t do anything about it.
Moreover, the rock tribe’s muscular man’s skin was like petrified, extremely hard. Even if he occasionally slashed with his sword, there wasn’t the slightest wound left.
Fortunately, he could see that the rock tribe’s muscular man and the others didn’t plan to attack with all their strength. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be able to hold on for so long. After all, there were only five of them, and they still had to guard the divine coffin closely, moreover, they had to protect their big brother.
However, it was precisely because they did not leave the divine coffin for a moment that the muscular man of the Rock tribe and the others were worried. They were worried that they would risk their lives to counterattack and destroy the Divine Coffin and the divine corpse inside.
Although the divine coffin was made of metal, it was like paper in front of an inner desolate level powerhouse. One punch could pierce through it. If the Fatty and the others really wanted to destroy the divine corpse inside, they only needed a few punches.
Suddenly, a painful cry sounded.
Fatty and the others’hearts twitched. They hurriedly looked over and immediately saw a scene that looked like it was about to crack. The graceful woman’s arm had been cut off by the dragon mother, and blood was dripping all over the ground.
“Retreat!”The dragon mother did not dare to continue attacking and immediately shouted.
Seeing that they had won, the others immediately retreated.
“Third Sister!”
“You, are you alright?”
Seeing that mother long and the others had retreated, the others hurriedly surrounded them.
The graceful woman shook her head slightly and immediately released her demon body to recover her strength. The intense pain from her broken arm made her grin slightly, but she did not want to let everyone worry, she endured the pain and shook her head, “I’m fine. Fortunately, they retreated. Otherwise, it would really be dangerous.”
Fatty looked at her pale face and his eyes were full of pity. He said, “Quickly apply the medicine. They will attack again later.”
“Keep this arm for now. It can be reattached when we go back,”the burly man said.
“These grandsons are planning to exhaust us all to the point where they can kill us all in one go.”Sixth, who looked like a handsome young man, gritted his teeth and said, “They had the chance to kill third sister just now, but they were afraid that we would destroy the god corpse in anger, so they didn’t do it. These grandsons are really F * cking evil!”
“Stop talking. Hurry up and take a rest. We have to drag it out until Big Brother wakes up no matter what,”said Fatty.
The few of them no longer complained. They sat down, applied medicine, and rested.
Time passed quickly.
Half an hour later, mother dragon, the muscular man of the Rock tribe, and the others attacked again.
Fatty, the graceful woman, and the others quickly stood up. Their faces were unsightly. They each activated their demon bodies and prepared to fight.
“Hand over the divine coffin to us, and we’ll spare your lives,”dragon mother said coldly as she flew in the air.
Fatty spat and said coldly, “I’ve said this nonsense many times, but you’re not tired of it. I’m tired of listening to it. Do you really think we’re stupid enough to believe this nonsense of yours? !”
“Humph, you’re still trying to act tough even when you’re about to die!”The strong man from the Rock tribe landed like a huge rock. The ground rumbled, and his entire body transformed into a tall and sturdy rockman as he walked toward Fatty and the others step by step.
“Wait,”mother long suddenly called out.
The muscular man from the rock tribe frowned slightly and raised his head to look at her.
Mother Long’s gaze was fixed on the divine coffin behind Fatty and the others. She saw that the hunchbacked old man slowly opened his eyes and tilted his head to look at her. The moment their gazes met, mother Long’s expression changed slightly and she immediately said, “You come back first.”
The muscular man from the rock tribe was slightly startled. He suddenly sensed something and raised his head to look. He immediately saw that the old man on the divine coffin was looking down at him. His heart was suddenly filled with an inexplicable fear as he stopped in his tracks.
“Big Brother?”
“Big Brother, you’re finally awake!”
“Zhizhi, Zhizhi, that’s great. Big Brother is awake.”
The fatty, the graceful woman, and the others also noticed that the hunchbacked old man had woken up. They were immediately overjoyed, especially the graceful woman. She was so happy that she wept. Her eyes were somewhat moist. This was not because she had a weak personality.., it was because the situation in front of them was too desperate.
“Mistress…”the hunchbacked old man saw the graceful woman’s severed arm, and his eyes narrowed slightly. He slowly stood up and said, “Thank you for your hard work. You can leave now.”
“Big Brother, you have to be careful. Although they are at the inner desolate level, their methods are very troublesome,”the Fat Man quickly reminded them.
“Don’t worry.”The hunchbacked old man looked at Mother Dragon and the others quietly. “The reason why rulers are called rulers is because they can rule everyone below the ‘ruler’level.”
“Rulers? !”
Mother Dragon, the Rock tribe muscular man, and the others widened their eyes when they heard the hunchbacked old man’s words. Their faces were filled with astonishment and disbelief.
This old man was actually a ruler? !
“Not good, quickly inform her Highness Ulita. Immediately call Kate and the others over!”Mother Dragon reacted almost instantly and called out hurriedly.
Behind the crowd, a pioneer who was climbing on the cliff wall had a pale face. Hearing that, he quickly climbed up and quickly ran out of the cliff valley to spread the news.
“It’s a ruler…”the Rock Tribe Man’s face was ugly as he slowly retreated. He did not expect that there was a ruler among the six of them! After the hunchbacked old man came out of the palace, he was poisoned and did not attack. The heat intensity on his body was not high, so they all thought that he was just an internal wilderness level master, but they did not expect him to be a dominator!
“Big Brother, kill all these bastards!”
“Especially that black-winged bitch. She cut off third sister’s hand.”
The burly man and the handsome young man shouted.
The stooped old man narrowed his eyes and locked his eyes on long mother. Black liquid slowly emerged from his body and covered his whole body as if he was alive, entering the demonic body state.
Long Mu saw the killing intent in his eyes and her elegant and cold expression changed slightly. She immediately said, “Retreat and fight outside. Don’t hurt the God Corpse!”
The others immediately retreated. The strong rock tribe man who jumped down first turned around and retreated. Suddenly, he felt as if two sharp swords had pierced his back. His heart turned cold and his figure suddenly shrank. With a whoosh, he instantly dived into the ground.
“The few of you, protect the divine coffin well.”The hunchbacked old man saw the strong rock tribe man who had dived into the ground. He frowned and said to Fatty and the others.
“Leave the divine coffin to us. Big Brother, be careful.”Fatty called out.
The hunchbacked old man didn’t say a word. He jumped down from the divine coffin and landed on the ground. Then, he bent his knees slightly and suddenly shot out. The ground cracked and caved in. With a whoosh, his body rushed toward the retreating mother dragon and the others like a cannonball, he jumped to the top of the cliff valley that was more than 200 meters high and made a hole in the cliff wall. He pressed his palm on the cliff wall and jumped to the top of the Cliff Valley. He looked at the Dragon Mother and the others in front of him, his demonized dark golden eyes were bloodthirsty. With a whoosh, he suddenly jumped out.
His demonized body did not change much. He was like a human-shaped lizard. Other than the tail and scales on his back, he did not grow any other strange limbs. When he rushed out, the ground was stirred up like a hurricane, the Dragon Mother who was the first to bear the brunt of the attack had a drastic change in expression. She flapped her dragon wings and immediately flew to a height of more than 100 meters.
At the same time that she flew high into the sky, a series of screams came from the ground.
The other pioneers did not have time to escape. When they were approached by the hunchbacked old man’s afterimage, their bodies exploded into a bloody mist with a bang.
“Ruler…”the dragon mother looked at the ordinary pioneers who had died one after another on the ground, as well as the wilderness level pioneers. Her expression was extremely ugly. Many of them were experts of their dragon clan, however, at this moment, they were like puppets in front of the hunched old man. They couldn’t resist at all, and even their escape movements seemed to be extremely slow.
..
..
In a huge building that was as large as a church in the territory of the Rock tribe.
Loris was sitting on the desk in the study. He was reviewing the documents applied by the various regions recently. Suddenly, there was a knock on the door. He said without raising his head, “Come in.”The door was pushed open, a servant came in with a tea set in his hand.
“Please have some tea.”The servant handed the tea set to Loris.
Loris woke up from the thoughts of the documents. He frowned and said, “When did I. . .”Before he could finish his sentence, he suddenly felt something strange. The air in the room seemed to have decreased a lot, a weak cold air was emitted from the servant in front of him.
His eyes focused, and there was a hint of killing intent in his eyes. He said, “You Are…”
Whoosh!
A whistling sound suddenly sounded, and the tea set and tray in the attendant’s hand flew over instantly. The scalding hot tea and tray flew towards Loris’face, but Loris also reacted very quickly. He grabbed with his palm and lifted the desk in front of him to block it, at the same time, the tip of his toes touched the ground, and his body slid backward to increase the distance between them. He turned around and touched a black short knife hanging on the wall beside him.

chapters.title: Chapter 762
chapters.content:
Chapter 762 – Chapter 752: Serial Killing
Rip!
The clothes of the servant were torn and a hideous figure came out. It looked like a monster made of countless sharp blades as it rushed towards Loris.
Loris’s pupils shrank. The black dagger in his hand quickly melted and turned into black mucus to cover his whole body. However it would take at least one to two seconds for him to enter the magic body state. Dudian had already rushed out.
The desk was torn into pieces in an instant. It couldn’t stop Dudian’s sprint. He rushed in front of Loris in an instant. His arms were like knives as he swept towards Loris’s chest, at the same time, the sharp limbs on his back and shoulders surrounded him and hugged loris.
“No –”Loris roared. The next moment he was completely hugged by Dudian. The Roar suddenly stopped. A lot of blood oozed out from Dudian’s sharp limbs and flowed onto the soft carpet under his feet.
When Dudian let go of his hand there were organs and limbs scattered on the ground. The surface of these limbs was still covered with black mucus. His magic body was only halfway into the body and hadn’t formed yet.
Dudian took a look and found that the black mucus on the surface of his limbs was still crawling slightly. It seemed as if it was alive. Some of the black mucus was slightly raised and extended towards Dudian’s feet, it gradually stopped and then completely stopped flowing.
It was the first time that Dudian saw such a situation. His face slightly changed. He felt a chill in his heart. For a moment he felt as if he was surrounded by an unknown monster.
At this time, there was a rush of footsteps coming from outside. Dudian quickly broke out of the window and rushed towards the nearest building.
When Dudian rushed out of the window, the guards outside were startled and quickly gathered over. However, Dudian quickly crawled outside the building’s wall. The sharp limbs penetrated the wall and firmly absorbed his body, he rushed into another building and broke through the wall.
Through the heat source capture, he saw that the pioneers in the building had noticed the unusual situation and rushed towards his position.
Bang!
Dudian cut a wall and immediately met the pioneers in the building. It was a handsome young man wearing casual clothes. He was stunned when he saw Dudian’s appearance, but he quickly reacted. Black liquid seeped out from under his skin and covered his whole body.
Dudian rushed straight through the wall. When he came to the front of the pioneer, the latter had just entered the magic body. His magic body was strange. His head was elongated like a horse but his chest was covered with soft silver scales, his hands were like hoofs and his ears were long like a rabbit’s ears.
Dudian could see that this appearance was somewhat similar to the rare monster ‘silencer’. Silencer was a monster that was good at perception. Its combat aspect was average and its speed was excellent, this could be seen from the young man’s demonized hands.
When Dudian rushed in front of him, the young man seemed to judge the strength gap between the two sides. He turned around and ran.
However, although Dudian was a pioneer but his physique was similar to the war god. Moreover the splitter was good at speed, soon he caught up with the other side in the narrow corridor.
“Get lost!”
The young man felt the terrifying aura behind him. He turned around and threw out a sharp sword. The sword was clamped between his hoofed palms. The hilt of the sword seemed to be forged to adapt to his hoofed palms, at the moment it was heading towards Dudian.
Dudian didn’t even look at it. The sharp limbs on his back flew out and cut off the sword. At the same time, the other sharp limbs rushed out from both sides of his body, it pierced through the young man’s back and out of his chest.
The young man screamed. Dudian didn’t wait for him to continue to struggle. He waved his arms and cut off the young man’s head.
In just a few seconds, a pioneer from the first line of the pyramid fell at Dudian’s feet. It was different from the previous sneak attack. This time it was a frontal battle, the gap between magic marks was very important!
Dudian didn’t linger. He continued to rush to the next building. He saw that another pioneer from the peak of the wilderness level was rushing over. He had to catch up with the other, he had to kill as many other pioneers as possible so that he could have a greater chance of winning against the pioneer.
However, things didn’t go as he had hoped. When Dudian rushed to the next building, the pioneer who lived there had gone underground. His heat source reaction was moving hundreds of meters underground. It was actually a magic mark that could drill into the ground.
Dudian could only give up on this goal and continue to rush to the last pioneer.
The pioneer was on the top floor of an office building. He climbed all the way from the wall to the top floor. All the staff in the building were startled. Some gathered by the window and looked up. Some directly escaped out of the building.
When Dudian climbed to the top floor, he saw an armed and ferocious figure standing in a spacious office. There was a trace of nervousness in his eyes.
Dudian had noticed that the pioneer had rushed to the building. He didn’t stop but pounced on him. Although he couldn’t identify the magic marks from the Pioneer’s magic body, but he didn’t need to identify it.
Bang!
The Pioneer’s body was bent like a hunchback crocodile. He stared at Dudian. When Dudian pounced on him, he immediately lifted the chair next to him and threw it away. At the same time, he stepped back and rushed out of the window.
The window was made of glass. It broke in an instant and his body fell straight down.
Dudian didn’t stop. He rushed to the window but didn’t jump down. Instead, he stabbed the monster’s limbs into the ground. In an instant, he stopped his body and then grabbed the wall below, he climbed like a spider.
For him, the speed of falling was slower than crawling.
Moreover, his magic body had another advantage. The sharp limbs on his back were equivalent to a few extra arms. It made his extreme speed change very flexible.
The pioneer saw Dudian quickly climb over the wall. The fierce killing intent in his eyes turned into horror. He quickly grabbed the wall with his palm. He wanted to use the momentum to push himself down, but it was extremely difficult to change his body in mid-air. He could only watch as Dudian crawled like a beast.
He screamed.
The sharp limbs on Dudian’s back pierced through his body. At the same time they hooked onto his body. The other sharp limbs immediately loosened the wall and pierced into him from different directions.
Blood sprayed out in the air. Dudian twisted his back and the sound of tearing echoed. The body of the pioneer was torn into pieces. His internal organs and intestines fell down from the sky like hailstones, some of them splashed onto the windows of the building. The people who were watching the building turned pale.
At this time Dudian’s body fell to the ground. The building was hundreds of meters tall. His chest felt heavy as he fell to the ground, he looked at the heat source coming from the other corner of the building.
The appearance of the heat source was revealed when it rushed out of the corner. It was a three meter tall stone monster. Its appearance was still in the shape of a human but its skin, hair, face and other parts.., it was covered with a layer of stone skin. It held a rough stone sword in its hand. It had two sharp edges and in the middle was a stone bone. It looked ancient and simple.
“Die! !”He saw the pieces of corpses scattered under Dudian’s feet. He roared as he rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian didn’t move. The monster’s limbs on his back slightly twisted. He narrowed his eyes as he looked at dudian. He didn’t know if his blade could pierce through his body.
From the looks of it, the latter was good at defense.
But he was an extreme attack type of legendary magic marks.
As the distance got closer and closer, Dudian’s eyes became more and more sharp. The Rockman roared as he slashed at Dudian. It seemed that he was going to split the whole earth.
Dudian’s heart was scared. He didn’t dare to face it head on. His body quickly dodged to the side. At the same time, the monster’s limbs on his back pushed his body. It was as if several arms were controlling his body.
“Go to hell! !”The stone man roared, he raised his stone fist and smashed it towards Dudian’s head. The shell covering his head was the least visible weakness.
Dudian’s head tilted and his body was like a monkey. He was in an incredible posture. The monster’s limbs on his back and shoulders were moving fast as they stabbed towards the stone man.
Dudian felt as if he was cutting metal. He leaned back and rolled away. When he looked up.., he saw several bloody scars on the arms and chest of the Rockman. It looked like stones were bleeding.
“So that’s it.”Dudian’s eyes were indifferent. He was most worried that the other party was a toxic type of magic marks. This type of pioneer was the most troublesome to deal with, because even if he could kill the other party, he might be poisoned to death. Among all types of magic marks, he was most willing to meet the enemy who was good at defense.
This was the case for the Rockman Pioneer.
However, for others, this Rockman pioneer should be an extremely difficult bone to chew. His sharp limbs could easily cut through metal without any obstruction. However, when he cut into the other party’s body.., he felt a bit of friction. It was enough to show that his body was several times harder than metal! For other magic marks that were not good at attack, it was like a super meat shield that could not be killed!
Feeling the tearing pain in his arms and chest, the Stone Man’s eyes revealed a trace of shock. The anger had long disappeared. He looked at Dudian who was climbing up again. He glanced at his arm from the corner of his eyes, although his skin was petrified but he felt that his face was extremely ugly. His best advantage had been broken!
“Do you want to escape? You are just a rock.”Dudian slowly walked towards him, at the same time he opened his mouth to taunt. At the same time his vision was opened to the maximum. He was always paying attention to the pioneers in the soil in case of a surprise attack. However, so far the man didn’t seem to have any plans to launch a surprise attack. He was still lurking hundreds of meters below his feet.
“Are you the group of invaders who attacked the Palace?”The stone man’s intention to retreat suddenly disappeared. He looked at dudian, “Since you know that we are hunters of the Rock Tribe, you should know that you are just a wilderness level pioneer. It is not enough for you to behave atrociously here!”
“Is that so? Don’t tell me that there are other strong people here?”Dudian deliberately asked.
The Rockman saw that Dudian’s eyes were covered by the carapace. He sneered in his heart: “It is too late to know now!”
“It is too late…”Dudian murmured.
The Stone Man’s heart was moved. Before he had time to think, he saw Dudian suddenly attack like a hurricane. His pupils shrank as he quickly swung the stone sword.
The monster’s limbs on Dudian’s back slammed onto the ground. He pulled his body back in a strange folding posture to avoid the sword’s sweep. At the same time the monster’s limbs on his abdomen shot towards his chest.
Puff Puff Puff. The monster’s limbs pierced into the chest of the Rockman.
Dudian immediately twisted the sharp blade in front of the monster’s limbs. It slightly opened from the back of the sharp blade to form a barbed hook. It was almost impossible for the other party to escape.
“It’s too late…”Dudian pushed the monster’s limbs on his back and pushed his body towards the Rockman. He immediately overthrew the Rockman and pressed him onto his body. At the same time he used the monster’s limbs to wrap around his arm, in this way, the stone sword in the hands of the Rockman was almost useless.
The Eyes of the Rockman narrowed as he heard Dudian’s words. He was in despair. He suddenly knew why Dudian was mocking him. From the very beginning he was using his words to close the distance, if he had drilled into the ground to escape from the moment he was injured, he believed that the other party wouldn’t be able to catch up with him. After all, the Rock tribe was an expert in tunneling.
But because of Dudian’s words, he missed the opportunity to escape. Moreover, in the second exchange, he clearly felt that Dudian’s strength was not inferior to his, moreover, the terrifying sharp limbs were sharper than he imagined. They could easily pierce through his body.
“Goodbye, oh no, bye.”Dudian crossed his hands and put them against his throat. He suddenly pulled. Poof! The head of the Rockman fell off. However, no blood flowed out from the wound, the flesh inside seemed to have hardened into stone. However it looked like a beautiful dark red gem.

chapters.title: Chapter 763
chapters.content:
Chapter 763 – Chapter 753: Godfiend Ritual [ First Update ]
Dudian stood up and glanced at the pioneer who was about 80 meters underground. It seemed that he was going to launch a surprise attack. However he stopped as soon as the Rockman pioneer died.
“It seems that there are no wasteland experts in the territory of the Rock clan. The one who tried to assassinate the pioneer seems to be the leader of the Rock Clan?”Dudian thought of the pioneer who was the first to be killed, the latter was located in the largest building. Moreover his temperament was mature and steady. It was obvious that he had been in a high position for a long time. Logically speaking, it would be good enough if the demon family sent experts to stop the intruders from snatching the god’s corpse, there was no need for the patriarch to come personally.
After all, if the patriarch had any mishaps, the whole family would be shaken.
However, if that person was the patriarch then it would be too weak. In his impression, the patriarch of the demon family should be a wasteland level expert.
“It seems that the background of the Witcher family is deep but the resources are not as rich as I thought. It is the limit to accumulate one or two experts of the inner wilderness level.”Dudian thought. He didn’t stay any longer, there was nothing he could do since the pioneer was hiding. He could only search for God’s marrow and other treasures.
Two hours later Dudian flew out from the messy territory of the Rock tribe. He had been counting the time since he had invaded the rock tribe, it would take about one and a half hours to two hours even if they informed the experts of the Pagar Mountains to come back to reinforce them.
“God’s marrow, God’s insect, secret skill…”Dudian carried a huge bag which was larger than his own. He flew high in the sky, he was surprised to see some secrets of the Witcher family.
Dudian saw a strange vessel in their secret chamber. It was extremely huge and connected to many tubes. According to the captives he had captured, it was a devil’s instrument to cultivate magic marks, it could store parasitic soul worms for a long time.
Dudian finally understood why the previous leaders of the Witcher family had the same magic marks. The Devil’s instrument could promote the reproduction of parasitic soul worms but it needed to feed on a large number of God’s insects, as long as the family didn’t suffer a destructive blow, the breeding wouldn’t be interrupted. The breeding wouldn’t be interrupted which meant that the family would always have legendary magic marks to create strong people.
“As long as there are no major mistakes in other aspects, it will last for a long time. The Dragon Clan and the wing clan should also have such instruments. Unfortunately the source of the Devil’s instrument is too secret. Ordinary people don’t know and can’t get anything out of it.”Dudian felt that there was a big secret hidden behind the Devil’s instrument, from the structure of the instrument, not to mention the alloy, the many parts and components as well as the style of the infusion tube gave him an extremely advanced feeling. It didn’t seem like something that could be produced by the Monster Research Institute, especially this thing didn’t appear in recent years but had existed since the beginning of the Witcher family!
It should be known that the history of the Witcher family was almost the same as the history of the giant wall. It should be the weakest era. Humans had just experienced the end of the world. It was not easy for the survivors to survive. It was not easy to create such a thing, it was almost unimaginable. The most contradictory point was that since they could even create that, the technology inside the giant wall should not be so backward.
Unfortunately, the demon god instrument was too huge and connected to many pipes. If he wanted to move it by himself, not only would it take twice as much time, but it would also cause damage to the instrument during the process of moving it. The loss outweighed the gain.
When he left, he did not destroy it. It was probably one of the most important things to the rock tribe. Once it was destroyed, it would inevitably infuriate the rock tribe, causing them to attack crazily at all costs. As such.., it would instead cause the other factions to sit on the mountain and watch the tiger fight. Even if he could repel the rock tribe, his vitality would be greatly damaged. After all, his many tricks and traps would be guarded by others once they were exposed. It was only suitable to wipe them out in one fell swoop.
Moreover, the devil instrument wouldn’t be of any use to the rock tribe in a short time. If he could succeed in seizing the giant wall then it would fall into his hands.
“I wonder how the situation is in the Pagar Mountains.”Dudian flew out of the territory of the Rock tribe. He flew in an arc and headed towards the direction of the Pagar Mountains, in this way he could avoid bumping into the reinforcements of the Rock tribe.
It had been more than four hours since he left. Dudian estimated that the place should be in a mess. He didn’t expect to pick up the scraps but he knew the situation of the battle. It was good for him to make preparations.
After flying for less than an hour, Dudian suddenly saw a figure running rapidly on the plains in front of him. The figure was emitting vigorous heat. It was a pioneer. His heart moved. He glanced at the plain behind the man and the mountains in the distance. He didn’t see anyone following him. He immediately landed and blocked the man’s way.
“Who is it? !”The man had noticed Dudian who was flying in the air. He slowly slowed down and looked at Dudian cautiously.
Dudian noticed the turtle shell badge on his armor. His eyes lit up. It was a pioneer of the Rock tribe. Most of the pioneers of the Rock tribe had magic marks that could drill into the ground, he calmly said: “I am a missionary of the monastery. I was ordered to go to the Pagar Mountains to reinforce. I also brought some supplies. What are you doing?”He wanted to pretend to be a member of the wing tribe. After all, he had wings, but considering the relationship between the rock tribe and the wing tribe, if he saw them he would be jealous.
“A missionary from the monastery?”There was a trace of doubt in the man’s eyes. He looked at dudian. His eyes paused on the huge bag on Dudian’s back for a moment, he was shocked: “You are lying! Who Are You? !”
Dudian’s eyebrows were raised. He noticed the change in the man’s expression. He guessed that the bag was exposed. But he didn’t panic. He took out a badge and threw it to the man, “I’m not lying. It’s normal that you haven’t seen me. I’m weak and usually work in the courtyard. I heard that there was a problem at the front line so I came to deliver the supplies. Oh yes, there is a part of the supplies from the Rock Tribe.”
Dudian put the bag on the ground and patted it.
The Man took the badge and looked at it. His eyes were full of doubt. This was the badge that only the pioneers of the monastery were qualified to get. It didn’t look like a fake badge. Moreover the group of intruders were all masters of the Inner Wilderness, it was easy to kill him so there was no need to lie. He was skeptical: “Materials from our rock clan? How come I haven’t heard of it?”
“It was just discussed.”Dudian stretched out his hand and took the badge. He had seized the badge from the woman who had invaded the temple for the first time. He had brought it with him whenever he came to the inner wall, he didn’t think that it would come in handy at this moment. He said as he walked: “You should be the one who participated in the war in the Pagar Mountains. Why are you here? Are You…”
He looked at Dudian with a strange expression?
“Of course not!”The man immediately refuted. He handed the badge to Dudian. Dudian’s arm suddenly shook as he rushed to the front of the man. Black liquid rushed out of his arm, the man’s neck was firmly pressed against the man’s neck.
The man was caught off guard by the sudden change. He was an ordinary pioneer. His body reaction was not as good as Dudian’s and he was caught off guard.
“You… you are not a member of the monastery? !”The Man’s face turned pale as he felt the chill on his neck.
Dudian coldly said: “Tell Me, why did you appear here? What happened there?”

chapters.title: Chapter 764
chapters.content:
Chapter 764 – Chapter 754: Two-Way Cooperation [ Second Update ]
Ten minutes later, Dudian picked up the bag. He didn’t even bother to bury the corpse as he flew towards the outer wall at full speed.
Dudian’s face was extremely ugly. Under Dudian’s coercion, the man finally told him about the situation of the Pagar Mountains. However, it was completely different from what he had imagined. The intruders at the bottom of the valley didn’t summon black prison, one of them suddenly burst out and revealed the power of a master. He killed the people who surrounded them and scattered in all directions. This man was temporarily arranged to be outside the mountain range and was responsible for intercepting the intruders, because of this, he was lucky enough to escape the disaster. He was about to rush back to the clan and send the news back to the clan but was intercepted and killed by Dudian.
“Both Mother Dragon and the Rock clan’s inner wilderness experts were no match for them. The two commanders of the military were killed on the spot. When I left there were a total of seven inner wilderness experts guarding the place but they were killed and scattered in all directions…”although Dudian didn’t see it with his own eyes, he could imagine the scene of a master leading five experts of the inner wilderness to kill everyone. However it was clear that the strongest group of people of the family hadn’t reached the stage of a Master!
“If the highest combat power of the inner wall is only of the inner wilderness then who can stop them?”Dudian’s face was ugly. He was worried that these people were too weak and couldn’t be easily eliminated by Mother Dragon and the others, however, the situation was reversed in an instant. Mother Dragon and the others were the ones who were defeated. He didn’t want to see such a situation. After all, these people still had the coffins in their hands!
Although it was very likely that the way to return was the black-robed youth. Moreover, the black-robed youth had been killed by him. It was very likely that they would lose the ability to return. But it was because of this that it was even more terrifying!
This was equivalent to forcing them into a desperate situation!
If they reached the extreme, it was not impossible for them to massacre the city!
Although Dudian didn’t know if there were any hidden cards in the inner wall to fight against them. But at the moment he was burning with anxiety. The change of the situation had caused him to set himself on fire. He had calculated everything.., however, he didn’t expect that there was a master level power hidden in these people. Moreover, they had been besieging them for so many days.
He could only blame himself for getting the wrong information from the beginning. The enemy wasn’t nine masters but a master and eight masters, he didn’t see the possibility of the enemy hiding a master.
He reckoned that mother dragon and the others hadn’t expected this.
“We must get Riley back…”Dudian flapped his wings as fast as he could. He wished that he could grow another pair of wings. If it was the previous situation where six masters were encircled.., he estimated that he would be able to break through the encirclement of dragon mother and the others. Even if several of them didn’t die, they would be seriously injured. At the very least he would be able to negotiate with them by using the temple of thunder and the Utosa Mountain which was filled with explosives.
Even if the negotiations failed and the temple of thunder detonated the mountain, the other party wouldn’t be able to eat it even if they were a desolate level expert.
However, with a ruler, the situation was completely different!
Even if his negotiation could be successfully completed, even if he could use the dead black-robed youth as a bargaining chip to fool them and get them to help him eliminate the experts in the inner wall region, in the end, it would still be his turn to face this situation!
If it was in the previous situation, he estimated that even if they were lucky enough to escape, if they wanted to kill their way back to fight against the Dragon Mother and the others, they would only end up with mutual losses. At that time, he would be able to sit back and reap the benefits effortlessly.
But now, killing Mother Dragon and the others was no pressure for them. After killing all the experts in the inner wall, it would be his turn.
“Damn it, a master…”Dudian couldn’t help but clench his fists and gnash his teeth. Just this change had made his plan completely collapse. This was the benefit of strength, it was not as good as actual strength.
He was praying that a master level expert would come out from the inner wall. However, the situation would be more complicated. However, it would be better than the current situation unless he hit the jackpot.., two master level experts would die together and the rest of the severely injured experts would be left. He would be able to move forward smoothly. However, he didn’t dare to have any illusions about the probability.
After all, from the current situation, the probability of having a master level expert in the inner wall was very low. Even if there was one, there was only a low probability that they would perish together.
It was like two hunters fighting. The probability of one dying and one injured was the greatest. It was not the same level of people fighting and they would die together. That was usually the case in novels.
After more than an hour, Dudian flew back to the outer wall. He was ready to throw the bag on the giant wall to find Riley. But when he was ready to throw the bag, he suddenly remembered that so much time had passed, what if the group of people had already returned to the gathering point outside the giant wall? Wouldn’t he be walking into a trap by flying over?
Although he had the black-robed youth as a bargaining chip, but he couldn’t guarantee that the black-robed youth was the only way back. Even if he did, he couldn’t guarantee that they wouldn’t kill him in anger.
His eyes flashed, and his mind spun rapidly. After a moment, he suddenly cleared his thoughts, and his vision seemed to jump to a higher level. He could clearly see his current situation, like a chaotic ball of thread, he suddenly found the thread.
“These people are inland desolation level powerhouses, which means that their magic marks are all legendary! “Although I don’t know if they are deified or not, but the magic marks of each legendary level usually have a wide range of augmentation abilities. For example, my splitter’s magic marks have given me super vision and vision…”
“In this way, even if I call Riley back, they may follow the smell or other methods to track me. It’s too late to eliminate the traces.”
Dudian’s heart calmed down, “It’s not scary for them to find me. What’s scary is that they will find out that the person is dead. Moreover, if the next negotiation is successful, what we will face is how to solve them. Time is tight…”
He thought for a long time and quickly made a decision. He took the bag and flew back to Mount Utosa. He put the bag into the temple and immediately called Neuss, he said, “Pack up the armor of the war gods and the armor of the people from the monastery. Get Someone to bring them to the inner wall. Find the highest person-in-charge of the three witcher families and the imperial city. Tell them that Aisha is willing to help them kill the intruders. Also, tell them that her highness Aisha has awakened five times!”

chapters.title: Chapter 765
chapters.content:
Chapter 765 – Chapter 755: See You
“Cooperate with the inner wall?”Neuss was puzzled.
Dudian didn’t bother to explain to him: “Send people to pick a group of smart ones.”
“I know.”Neuss felt the urgency in Dudian’s eyes. He didn’t dare to ask more and was ready to leave.
Dudian stopped him, “In addition, let Barton, Sergei, Charmanson and Poland take equipment and leave the Holy Mountain. Other than the normal guards, the rest of the people will be sent to the second base. Hiro and the other pioneers will be taken as prisoners.”
Neuss was shocked. Move the position? Was this place going to be a battlefield? He was aware of the seriousness of the matter and immediately agreed.
“Go.”
“Yes.”
Dudian took out the secret techniques of the Rock tribe. He couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. The time was too short. Even if he had the secret techniques, he wouldn’t have time to learn them. If he could make the whole world pause.., he would be able to solve all the problems in a month’s time. But if he had the ability then it would be better to kill all of them.
Dudian smiled bitterly in his heart. He took out the god’s marrow and injected it into his body. His body was hot and saturated but he was far from a breakthrough. After all the God’s marrow he had plundered in the past few times had made him step into the Pioneer’s territory, even if he had enough God’s marrow injected every day, it would take half a month to reach the peak of the outer wilderness.
