As for the breakthrough to the inner wilderness level, it would take more God’s marrow and more time.
“I have to get through the current difficulty. After the invaders have taken the coffin and fought their way out of the encirclement, they will certainly go to the gathering point of the outer wall. Then I will meet Riley and follow the clues to find this place…”Dudian leaned on the chair, he pondered as he waited for his body to digest the god’s marrow: “If they find it then it means that the black-robed teenager is hiding something important from them. He can use it as a threat.”
“Even if the threat doesn’t work then we can use the explosion of the Holy Mountain to buy time to escape. But the chances of escaping from the hands of the master are Slim…”Dudian felt upset. This was a huge crisis, it was bigger than the crisis brought by the inner wall. Whether he could survive depended on the importance of the black-robed teenager to the group of intruders. If it wasn’t as important as he thought, he would die without a doubt!
His current situation had been exposed in front of the intruders. He could only gamble with them!
He had to make several preparations. He had to prepare the plan after the gamble. As for the failure of the gamble, there was no need to say anything.
“Judging from the importance of the god’s coffin, the inner wall should not miss out on a combat power like Aisha’s. The New Saintess of the Dragon Clan who has awakened five times is still very tempting to them. Moreover, with Aisha’s identity, she must know the importance of the god’s corpse. Therefore, she took the initiative to help them. They can understand that the possibility of cooperation between the two parties is very high. However, the difficulty lies in how to deal with these intruders even if they cooperate.”
“There is still some hope to kill the master with my traps and the other experts of the inner wall. But after I kill the master, the inner wall will not let me go. It would be best to kill them all…”
Dudian frowned and fell into deep thought.
It was not difficult to capture the enemy with the destructive power of the traps he had created. However, it would be very difficult to kill everyone in one go. According to the previous battle, he had a clearer understanding of the power of the traps he had created, it was estimated that even if the entire sacred mountain exploded, it might not be able to kill an inner wilderness level powerhouse unless they were standing still and were at the core of the sacred mountain.
However, this was almost impossible.
Other than the explosion, the other big killer weapon he could use at the moment was electricity.
However, with the voltage of the sacred mountain, even Hathaway could escape last time. Although Hathaway could be considered an inner wilderness level powerhouse, she had to face a ruler level powerhouse this time. Moreover, there were many of them, and they were distributed to everyone, the effect might be weaker than last time.
“The power of the power station on the mountain is still far from enough. If the second base is added then the damage should be increased by one-third but it is still not enough…”
Dudian rubbed his eyebrows as he felt his head swell.
..
..
Whoosh! Whoosh!
A few figures whistled through the giant wall. Two of them had wings. One of them was holding a silver coffin which was more than ten meters long.
In the blink of an eye, they had arrived outside the giant wall. The other four were flying through the land. A moment later, they arrived at a hillside and stopped. The leader of the group, the hunchbacked old man, raised his hand slightly and glanced around. His expression changed slightly, he said, “Little seven has disappeared.”
The people behind him were shocked. The graceful woman did not say anything. Her pupils suddenly turned dark red as if they were filled with blood. After a moment, her figure suddenly flew out and rushed into a bush. A moment later, she returned, she was holding a youth in her hand.
She casually threw the youth onto the ground and said to the old man: “Big Brother, I don’t see Little Seven’s figure nor the black prison. But I see this person sneakily here.”
The Old Man’s face was completely gloomy as he stared at the youth: “Who Are You? What are you doing here?”
The young man was Riley who had been arranged by Dudian. He looked at the six people in front of him. He was scared as he felt the strong murderous aura and aura coming from them, however, he had experienced a long period of undercover life. His Mind was outstanding. He stood up and said in a trembling voice: “Everyone, the person you are looking for is a man in black robe?”
“Have you seen him?”
The old man squinted his eyes as he heard the news from Little Seven. It was as if two sharp swords were shot out.
Riley was relieved as he knew that they were the people Dudian was talking about, he said: “My young master said that if you want to know the news about him, you must kill all the experts in the inner wall. In exchange, when you kill the experts in the inner wall, my young master will let him come to see you.”
“Huh?”The people next to him raised their eyebrows.
“Little seven has been kidnapped?”
“Little Seven is not weak, and he has the protection of the black prison. Who can kidnap him?”
“I didn’t expect that there were at least two inner wilderness level experts hidden in this divine wall!”
“I don’t think so. The enemy seems to know the weakness of the black prison,”the graceful woman said. Seeing the people looking over, she raised her hand and pointed at a few bushes in front of her, “I can smell the smell of black prison here. When I captured him previously, I saw a big pit of an explosion. The enemy seems to know that black prison is afraid of fire, so he detonated black prison and then kidnapped little seven. It seems that he is also a difficult expert to deal with.”
“This person is from the divine wall, but he actually made such a request. Could it be that he wants to use this opportunity to rebel?”Said another person.
“Squeak squeak. I know who it is.”
“Who?”
“Squeak squeak. A few days ago we asked around for information. Do you still remember that there was a high wall built inside the wall called the wall of Sighs. It isolated a small part of the space and was called the outer wall area. The pioneer that we caught said that there was a riot in the outer wall area. In my opinion, this man should be the one who created the riot in the outer wall area. He wants to borrow our hands to get rid of the experts in the inner wall area and then lead the inner wall area. Squeak squeak…”
Riley was surprised to hear the man’s words. He didn’t expect that they would guess Dudian’s identity in the blink of an eye. He didn’t know how these people would deal with him.
“They want to use us as knives. HMPH!”The burly man’s eyes were full of killing intent: “We will directly kill this man in the outer wall!”
“No. If that’s the case, if something happens to little seven, we won’t be able to return.”The hunchbacked old man immediately spoke out to stop him.
“This person should also be a ruthless person. To be able to go against so many experts in the inner wall region and still be able to live until now, he most likely has several experts helping him. We can’t be rash.”The fatty glanced at Riley, “Take us to your master. We want to see little seven face to face.”
Riley’s heart tightened. He didn’t know if Dudian would allow him to take these dangerous people to see him. According to his understanding of Dudian, he didn’t have so many experts under him.
Although he didn’t know the level of these people, but from the fact that Dudian had sent them to kill the experts in the inner wall, he could tell that they were a group of extremely terrifying people.
“Wait.”The graceful woman’s eyes suddenly focused. She bent down and searched for a moment in his arms. She pulled out a broken finger: “This, this is…”
“Squeak, it’s little seven’s finger. Damn it!”
“Tell me, what did your master do to Little Seven? !”The burly man picked up Riley’s collar.
Riley felt suffocated when he saw his face full of killing intent, but he caught a message from their reactions, he said reluctantly, “My master didn’t just take him away and didn’t kill him. This broken finger is a warning to everyone. I hope you don’t Be Reckless. You just need to help my young master get rid of the experts in the inner wall. My Young Master will return your little seven to you. He always keeps his word.”
“Threaten me? You are courting death!”The burly man roared as he raised his fist.
Riley’s pupils shrank and his heart almost stopped. But the next moment, the rapidly expanding fist in his sight stopped and was pulled by the other hand.
“Don’t be impulsive.”The old man pressed his hand and coldly stared at Riley, “Take us to see your master. We want to talk to him about this matter face to face. I advise you to be honest and not to suffer unnecessarily. We have a hundred ways to make you cry and lead the way for us.”
Riley’s face turned ugly as he heard Dudian’s words. There was a trace of resentment in his heart. Dudian had sent him here to prepare for his sacrifice.
“Alright.”He agreed.
..
..
“Young master, you have to take care of yourself…”Barton reluctantly said goodbye.
“Call me if there is anything.”Sergei said.
Dudian watched them leave the mountain one after another. There were many figures locked in the prison carriage behind them. There were Hiro, Ronon, and the captured Devil Scorpions, there were other pioneers who weren’t killed on the spot. These were the top masters of the inner wall. But now they were locked in the dirty prison carriage. Their bodies were limp and they had no fighting strength.
Some of the pioneers leaned their heads on the pillars of the prison carriages and looked at the beautiful scenery outside the hillside. Their eyes were dull, and their mouths were slightly open, as if their souls were not attached to their bodies.
There was a strong smell of men all over their bodies, which made people vomit.
Behind these prison carriages, there was a prison carriage covered in black cloth. Hathaway was lying naked in it. Beside her were a few thin figures. Their chests were as thin as ribs, which could be clearly seen, moreover, each of them had some black spots or rotting scars. These were all mutations caused by the high radiation levels in their bodies.
There were also people with distorted faces. Half of their mouths were shriveled up like an 80-year-old toothless woman. Some of their skin protruded out small particles, as rough as matte.
However, at this moment, these people were hugging each other. They sat beside Hathaway, not daring to approach. Their bodies swayed along with the shaking of the carriage.
Hathaway’s eyes were full of hatred as she stared at the few of them. Although they knew that the girl had no ability to move but they didn’t dare to get close to her.
Dudian looked at everyone who had left the Holy Mountain. It didn’t take long before the only ones left were the patrolling knights of light and some servants who were in charge of cleaning the place. Originally Dudian planned to send away these servants as well, after all, they were just ordinary people. But later on he thought that it would be easy to expose them so he let them stay. He didn’t want to cause more losses because of his mercy.
Dudian returned to the empty temple. At the moment even Aisha wasn’t by his side. He handed her over to Sergei and the others to take her to the second base. After all, if the enemy broke out in battle here, even if Aisha was by his side.., it would be difficult for him to compete with the master. He didn’t want to hurt her body anymore.
Time passed quietly.
Dudian sat in the temple. Suddenly he felt an unusual wind. His eyes slightly moved as he looked out of the temple. He saw a hurricane push open the door and windows. A few black shadows rushed in from outside, there were seven people in the temple. One of them was Riley.
His eyes focused. Although he was prepared but he was nervous as he looked at the six people who could easily kill him. However he had experienced the same situation many times, he calmed down and calmly said: “You are the intruders from outside the giant wall. Can you let go of my men? The people you want are safe. We can talk about it.”
Seeing that Dudian’s first words were about his safety, Riley felt ashamed. He kept looking for reasons to tell himself, he didn’t do anything wrong. But at this moment, all these reasons were gone. There was only guilt because he knew that if he did this, at least Dudian would be in danger because of him.
However, as a subordinate, he didn’t think that his danger was because of Dudian. He didn’t know that Dudian had let the old man and others let go of his purpose, he just wanted to test their attitude and see if they were ready to fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 766
chapters.content:
Chapter 766 – Chapter 756: Deal
“We want to see Little Seven.”The old man ignored Dudian’s words: “Hand him over or I will make you die miserably!”
Dudian didn’t care about the old man’s words but his heart was moved. Although the old man’s accent was different from the common language of the giant wall but it wasn’t difficult to understand, he calmly said: “I said that there is no need to be anxious. Your Little Seven is in a very safe place. Of course, if anything happens to me then he might not be safe.”
“You dare to threaten me? !”The old man’s eyes flashed with murderous intent. He took a step forward. In an instant the murderous intent rushed towards Dudian. It seemed that as long as dudian said “No”he would immediately take action!
The murderous intent was terrifying.
Even though Dudian was prepared, he quickly regained his calm, “This is my bargaining chip. I hope we can have a peaceful conversation. After all, our goals are the same. My goal is to destroy the inner wall and become the king of this place. You are from another giant wall. You are here to rob the god’s corpse. The people from the inner wall have surrounded you and killed many of your people. If it were me, I wouldn’t let this matter go.”
“Since everyone has the same goal, why don’t We Sit Down and talk?”
He looked at the old man. It was obvious that this man was their leader and the master level expert.
The old man narrowed his eyes as he saw that Dudian wasn’t scared by him: “Talk to me? Do you think I won’t dare to kill you because of seven?”
“You can take my life at any time.”Dudian’s face was calm, “Use my life in exchange for one of your comrades. If you think it is a good deal then go ahead. But I can tell you that as long as something happens to me your little seven will definitely die. You Don’t need to think about torturing me. Let me tell you his location. First of all, I don’t know the exact location. Secondly, if I tell you, wouldn’t I lose the bargaining chip and Die?”? In that case, how could I let go?”
His words were very objective and clear. There was no fear in his expression. As a negotiation, he was trying to find the initiative.
“Despicable kid!”
“Big Brother, let me kill him. Little Seven was caught. It’s really shameful. Let Him Die!”
“That’s right, Big Brother, kill him!”
The others immediately shouted.
Dudian heard their words. His blood seemed to gush out of his body. Was His guess wrong? The black-robed teenager was not an important member in their hearts?
He glanced at the lion’s head and prepared to activate the temple’s mechanism.
However, the next moment, he suddenly had a warning in his heart. Wait, if they really wanted to kill him, there was no need to say so much. He could just attack directly. Any one of them could easily kill him. After all.., the thermal reaction that he displayed was just a pioneer. Moreover, there were perceptive pioneers among them. Most of them could sense his strength.
Was He deliberately deceiving him?
No, it was possible that he was asking the leader. After all, the price of doing so would be the sacrifice of one of their members.
His heart was cold again but he still held a glimmer of hope as he waited for the old man’s response.
“Alright!”The Old Man didn’t blink his eyes, he said: “I asked Little Seven to stay behind in case of an emergency. Since he is so useless, he deserves to die. You should die with little seven. I will kill everyone here!”He slowly stepped forward, however, the killing intent in his body increased with each step. By the time he reached the steps in front of Dudian, the killing intent had already filled the entire temple.
Dudian’s face was pale. Although he had prepared a backup plan but it was very difficult to escape from the hands of a master and five experts. It was a gamble for him but now he had made the wrong bet!
His heart was beating fast. He hadn’t felt the sense of crisis for a long time. But this time he knew that no one could help him and there was no possibility of a miracle. Even if the wall master suddenly returned.., if he killed the intruders then he would be killed in the blink of an eye. He could only rely on himself and fight!
“In that case, let’s die together!”Dudian clenched his teeth. There was a trace of malevolence on his face. He was forced into a dead end. There was only killing intent and strong hatred in his heart!
He didn’t know what he hated. Maybe it was the intruders in front of him, or the people in the inner wall. Maybe he was weak and powerless. Maybe he didn’t care about his fate.., the killing intent and hatred intertwined. He was ready to fight to the death!
Just when he was ready to fight to the death, the old man suddenly stopped. The killing intent in his eyes slowly converged. He deeply looked at dudian. He saw the death aura from Dudian’s expression, he knew that if he continued to force them, the worst situation would happen. So he could only stop. But in this way, their trump cards were exposed in front of dudian.
Thinking of this, he hid his killing intent in his heart.
Dudian saw that the other side suddenly restrained his killing intent. He was ready to activate the mechanism. His eyes changed, “Aren’t you going to kill me? Why aren’t you taking action? Are you afraid of an ordinary pioneer like me?”
The old man snorted: “Although Little Seven is useless, but using your life is not enough to exchange with him. I will let you live for a while.”
Dudian’s heart relaxed as he heard the old man’s words. It seemed that they had deliberately blackmailed him. Fortunately, he wasn’t afraid to surrender so they had failed.
The price of failure was to expose their trump cards.
They had many choices but they had chosen the most risky one. It was the worst idea to use intimidation to find the enemy’s weakness.
“No wonder a master and eight experts of the inner wilderness level would end up in such a miserable situation.”Dudian looked down on their intelligence but he didn’t let down his guard, after all this might be the reason why the other side looked down on him. If it was any other pioneer they would be scared. If he hadn’t experienced too many life and death situations he would have surrendered or turned to run away.
“Since you want to talk to me, I hope that you can keep your mouth clean. I don’t want to talk to a dog.”Dudian sat back in his seat. At this moment, he had the upper hand, he gave the other side a bit of color. It was a test and also to strengthen his confidence and power. However, he couldn’t push it too far.
The old man narrowed his eyes. His killing intent flashed but he endured it. He walked to the next chair and sat down. He said in a cold voice: “Will you release little seven if you kill all the experts in the inner wall?”
“Yes.”Dudian nodded.
“Humph, what if you go back on your word?”The burly man looked at dudian.
Dudian glanced at him: “If I go back on my word then it means that I can’t hand over your little seven. What reason do you have to not kill me?”
The Burly Man’s face turned red as he heard Dudian’s question. His words seemed a bit retarded. If Dudian didn’t hand over little seven then he would die. No excuse could save his life.
“We will take a look at little seven to make sure that he is safe.”The graceful woman said to Dudian.
Dudian indifferently said: “It is impossible. We have spent a lot of effort to catch your little seven. How could we let you meet him? Wouldn’t that be putting my head in your hands?”
The graceful woman’s face slightly changed. She was about to speak but was stopped by the old man. He stared at dudian: “Aren’t you afraid that we will kill you after we kill everyone in the inner wall?”
Dudian had expected this question, he replied: “Of course I am afraid. So after I confirm that you have killed all the experts in the inner wall I will send little seven to you. I will hide for a period of time. I believe that you have come from other giant walls. I don’t want to stay in this foreign place. After all, if the master of the giant wall comes back then none of you will be able to escape.”
“Cunning Kid!”The old man thought in his heart. Dudian’s method was a feasible one. If he hid, they might not be able to find him in a short time. After all.., this was the opponent’s home ground. They were familiar with the geographical environment. Moreover, the opponent didn’t have to hide in the giant wall. The large area outside the giant wall could be used as a hiding place. With their speed, they would be able to find Dudian in this vast area, it was almost impossible unless they were waiting for him. However the danger would multiply.
“In that case, how can we be sure that you will fulfill your promise?”The old man stared at Dudian, “If you hide directly after we finish the task but don’t return little seven, wouldn’t we have no way to deal with you?”
Dudian shook his head and sighed as he looked at the old man: “If I don’t return your little seven, wouldn’t it be the same as tying you Tigers to the same cage as me?”
The Old Man’s face slightly changed.
The graceful woman and the burly man had a big reaction. Their faces changed as they looked at Dudian in anger.
Dudian deliberately spoke in a vague way. He didn’t directly point out his guess. But he knew that his guess was right. Little Seven was an important link in their return!
Moreover, from his previous words, he had probed that these people didn’t come from the Kingdom of God but from the other giant wall!
This information was of great significance to him. After all, these were two different natures. If they came from the Kingdom of God, then it meant that the giant wall of Sylvia had been secretly suppressed by the Kingdom of God. The future would definitely be a bad place, it was a good idea to leave as soon as possible. If it came from other giant walls, then it could explain many problems and information. But at this moment, it was not necessary to elaborate.
“You!”The burly man clenched his fists and stared at dudian: “What did you do to Little Seven? What did he say to you? !”
The Old Man’s face was gloomy. He knew that even if little seven didn’t say anything, their performance was enough for Dudian to get the answer. In this way, the other party had grasped their lifeblood, there was almost no advantage in this negotiation. Even if they were strong enough to easily crush Dudian like an ant, but at this moment, the other party was the master and could control their lives!
“I have said what I should say.”Dudian was completely calm, “Kill all the experts in the inner wall and then leave the giant wall. I will send little seven to you. After all, I want the rule of the giant wall and you want the coffin. This is a win-win deal. I am a bit curious. What do you want the coffin for? Can you tell me?”
“In Your Dreams!”The burly man stared at Dudian.
The old man narrowed his eyes as he stared at dudian: “Don’t you know the function of the God’s corpse?”
“What function can a corpse have? Is It Worth for you to come all the way here to rob it?”Dudian looked interested: “If you are willing then tell me about it.”
“Aren’t you a member of the Family?”The old man asked.
“If so, then it would have been eliminated.”Dudian said: “According to you the secret of the God’s corpse would be known by the people of the family?”
The old man looked at him for a while but didn’t say anything. He raised his hand and gestured for fatty to release Riley. He said: “If you don’t hand over little seven then the consequences will be more serious than you think.”
His voice was calm but the killing intent in his voice was chilling.
Dudian felt the strong killing intent hidden in his eyes. He nodded slightly, “I won’t let you down. I hope you won’t let me down. We have talked for so long but you haven’t told me your names?”
“I don’t need to know your names.”The old man turned around and left.
“You are going to die anyway.”The burly man turned around and sneered.
“Squeak squeak… there are traitors who collude with the enemy. It’s interesting…”
The few of them no longer looked at Dudian with disdain. They turned around and left.
Dudian quietly looked at their backs as they walked out of the temple. His eyes flickered as he waited for them to leave, he looked at Riley: “Inform Noyce of the second base to come back here to manage the affairs. I’m going to the inner wall.”
“Go to the inner wall? Why?”Riley understood Dudian’s thoughts, he had an indescribable feeling in his heart. He felt that the youth was respectable but also terrifying. It was difficult for him to accept that he had colluded with foreign enemies to kill people in the inner wall. He was a bit conflicted but he didn’t dare to show it, he was confused for a moment. Could it be that justice would eventually be defeated by Evil?

chapters.title: Chapter 767
chapters.content:
Chapter 767 – Chapter 757: Opening The Divine Coffin [ First Update ]
The stooped old man and the others carried the divine coffin and flew out of Mount Wutuo. They came to a stop on the towering giant wall.
“Big Brother, are we really going to let that kid manipulate us? He actually used us as chess pieces. I’m so angry!”The burly man gritted his teeth in anger when he said this.
The graceful woman glanced at him and looked at the stooped old man, she said, “Big Brother, this kid probably doesn’t know the function of the divine coffin. It seems like what he said isn’t false. He wants to use us to get rid of the obstacles and ascend to the throne himself. Humph, a greedy little man!”
“If he knew the function of the divine coffin, he wouldn’t let us take it so easily. Without the divine corpse, the divine wall will be destroyed sooner or later.”The fatty scratched his belly, he said, “But we can’t rule it out. He knows about this, but he deliberately pretended to be stupid. In this way, he might not let us leave. It is very likely that this is a conspiracy. Even if we help him get rid of those damn guys, he might not give us little seven. If there is no little seven, we will cross the desolate region. Except for you, Big Brother, who has a chance of surviving, we will all die.”
The hunchbacked old man narrowed his eyes and said, “If you want to use us, you’re overestimating yourself! Little San, you stay behind and monitor this person. The five of us will go to the inner wall to take revenge for old nine and old ten.”
The graceful woman sighed, she said, “It’s a pity that old nine is dead. Otherwise, he would be the most suitable person to track. I’m only good at sensing, but I’m not as good at disguising as Old Nine. I hope they don’t have any experts in sensing.”
“Did you sense anyone else in the temple earlier?”Fatty asked.
“No.”The graceful woman shook her head, “Just him. I sensed little seven’s aura and the smell of his blood in the temple. Although it has been eliminated, little seven should have fallen into his hands and suffered serious injuries.”
“To be able to capture little seven, it’s difficult with this person’s strength. He should only be an errand runner. There’s a mastermind behind the scenes.”Fatty pondered for a moment, he said to the hunchbacked old man, “Big Brother, why don’t third sister and I stay here together so that we can take care of each other. Even if something happens, we can still escape. The four of you should be enough. If a ruler-level expert appears, Big Brother, you must not resist.”
“I know.”The hunchbacked old man nodded slightly. “It’s good that you stay.”
“Big Brother, it’s inconvenient to carry this divine coffin. Let’s discard the coffin and retrieve the corpse.”The graceful woman’s gaze landed on the huge silver divine coffin at the side. She said, “Speaking of which, we haven’t seen the guardian God of this divine wall yet.”
The hunchbacked old man’s gaze moved and he nodded in agreement. He went up to the side of the divine coffin and searched for a moment. He found a location and raised his hand. With a crack, a cold air spread out from the divine coffin, like white frost hitting his face.
The hunchbacked old man’s expression suddenly changed. He covered his mouth and retreated. “It’s poisonous. Spread Out!”
When the others heard this, they hurriedly retreated. However, the handsome sixth brother was closer and could not dodge in time. He was pounced on by the White Frost and immediately let out a miserable cry.
Fatty, who was beside him, grabbed him and threw him dozens of meters back before smashing him onto the ground.
The others hurriedly rushed over. Immediately, they saw that sixth brother’s cheeks were corroded by an unknown liquid and were emitting white smoke. His face had already festered, and there were still hot bubbles emitting from his festered face, making gurgling sounds like magma.
Everyone was shocked. Fatty hurriedly made a move and lifted him up. His big hand pressed on his head and stuffed him into his stomach.
After a moment, he pushed sixth brother out. Sixth Brother’s face was a mess. His facial features were like melted wax. His skin and flesh were drooping on his face. It was so ugly and horrifying that people could not look at him directly.
Fatty panted heavily. There was a hint of pain on his face as he gritted his teeth.
“Second brother, how are you?”The hunched old man hurriedly asked.
Fatty shook his head slightly and said while holding his stomach, “I’m a little powerful. I need to rest for a while.”
“This group of damn bastards, I + + !”The Burly Man’s face was filled with anger as he clenched his fists.
The graceful woman looked at the trembling sixth brother and asked, “Are you feeling better?”
Sixth Brother’s body was in so much pain that he was trembling non-stop.
The hunchbacked old man glanced at him. Seeing that he was fine, he let out a sigh of relief. He turned his head to look at the divine coffin in the distance and his expression changed slightly. He saw a group of black reptiles rushing out from the gap of the divine coffin, they were rapidly spreading toward them.
“It’s a poisonous bug!”The graceful woman also noticed it and hurriedly reminded him.
“Let me do it!”The burly man roared. He threw out his large saber and took the initiative to charge forward.
His large saber swept across, throwing the poisonous bugs on the ground to the bottom of the giant wall. Some of them were smashed to death on the spot. The others immediately went forward to help. In the blink of an eye, the flood-like black poisonous bugs were quickly swept away. The ground was left with the corpses of poisonous bugs and dark green blood, emitting waves of a foul smell.
The foul stench was dizzying. Fortunately, the few of them had extraordinary physiques. Without being directly infected, this bit of poisonous gas could still be withstood.
The hunchbacked old man raised his leg and kicked. With a bang, the lid of the divine coffin flew out and fell to the ground with a clang. A large amount of white cold air gushed out from within and spread out.
The few of them quickly retreated. The person who liked to shake his shoulders extended a pair of huge wings on his back. They were as terrifying as bats. They flapped quickly and blew away the cold fog, revealing the bottom of the divine coffin.
The hunchbacked old man slowly approached carefully. He lowered his head and saw that there was nothing inside the divine coffin. There was no divine corpse at all!
His face darkened. His fingers made cracking sounds, and his face was filled with cold killing intent.
“Is it fake?”The others also saw the situation inside the divine coffin, and their faces immediately became angry.
They had sacrificed three people, and little seven had gone missing. In the end, the divine coffin that they had finally gotten their hands on was actually a fake! Moreover, they had almost caused sixth brother to lose his life!
“F * ck!”The burly man slashed the ground, leaving a small cut on the giant wall.
“We actually carried a coffin full of poisonous insects everywhere. If we had known earlier, we would have opened this divine coffin when we were underground.”The graceful woman was angry and powerless. She had come over with full confidence, after understanding the situation of the divine wall, she was even more confident. However, she didn’t expect that the attacks would come one after another in the blink of an eye. She suddenly regretted it. If she had known earlier, she would have been more careful and scouted the place for a period of time, after ensuring that everything was safe, she changed from snatching to stealing. This way, there wouldn’t be any sacrifices, and she would be able to find the real divine coffin and leave safely.
“Big Brother, let’s kill our way back. Kill them all!”The burly man said to the hunchbacked old man with a face full of anger.
The hunchbacked old man’s gaze was gloomy as he stared at the empty divine coffin without saying a word. After a long while, he slowly said, “We have to change our strategy.”
“Change our strategy?”The fatty looked at him with a hint of solemnity in his eyes.

chapters.content:
Chapter 768 – Chapter 758: Cooperation From The Imperial City [ Second Update
“Look at their performance.”
Dudian replied to Riley as he got up from the temple. He put on the armor made from the hardest bones of the great splitter and walked out of the temple.
Riley followed behind Dudian. He pondered for a moment and whispered: “Master, Will Neuss expose our second base? If they send people to follow you…”
Dudian looked at him: “It’s not a big deal. The people they want aren’t there so they don’t dare to act Rashly.”Although the second base was hidden but he knew that.., if these people wanted to search it would be easy to find. Moreover… he was happy to let them know about the place.
“You stay and hand over to Neuss.”
“Yes, master. Be careful…”
Dudian’s wings stretched out from the gap of the armor. He flew towards the direction of the wall of Sighs.
It didn’t take long for Dudian to reach the inner wall. He found the central base of the intelligence network. It was located at the edge of the inner wall where the earl was sheltered. The intelligence personnel immediately recognized him.
“Master, the Dragon Clan and the Rock clan have rejected our invitation. The Wing Clan hasn’t received any news yet.”The few of them immediately reported to dudian.
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows: “The dragon clan and the Rock clan have refused? Why?”
“I didn’t say why.”
“Got it.”
Dudian turned around and left the place. He flew out of the inner wall and stayed in the imperial city. He was a bit surprised that the dragon clan would refuse. After all, they had invited him in the name of Aisha, now that he had Hailey in his hands, no one dared to provoke him. Why would the Dragon Clan refuse the cooperation? Did they know about Aisha’s situation? Even if they knew, wouldn’t they want to see her?
Dudian ordered the most expensive cup of Amber wine from the tavern owner. He quietly drank it. He understood that the Rock clan would refuse to cooperate and participate in the war. After all, he had destroyed the nest, they didn’t dare to easily withdraw the power to guard the nest. After all, the Devil’s instrument was their foundation. It wasn’t destroyed but it should have scared them.
“Kid, move over.”A rude voice interrupted Dudian’s thoughts.
Dudian glanced at a burly man. He was ugly but he was wearing a gold bracelet and a fluffy robe. He looked like he came from a good family. He frowned and coldly said: “Get Out!”
“Eh? Kid, you…”the burly man raised his eyebrows and wanted to scold Dudian.
Dudian didn’t wait for him to continue. He slapped the burly man’s body. The burly man’s body rolled a few times and fell to the ground. Dudian took off the gold bracelet from his wrist and threw it on the counter, “Money for alcohol.”Dudian left the pub.
He went to a nearby hotel with the name of a noble. He booked a suite and took out the god’s marrow from his body. He injected it into his body and stopped the injection.
Time flew by. In the blink of an Eye Dudian stayed in the hotel for two days. He walked around the imperial city and saw the destroyed palace. It was as if a bomb had detonated the entire palace, there were several holes in the middle of the steps. Although the scene had been surrounded and many builders were repairing it but it was not difficult to imagine what kind of war broke out.
Dudian used his thermal vision to observe the situation in the palace. He saw seven or eight pioneers. One of them had reached the inner famine level. These people were estimated to be the majority of the remaining forces in the palace.
“It seems that there is nothing wrong with the Witcher family and the monastery. What are they doing?”Dudian frowned. He had been living in the imperial city for the past two days. He had been paying attention to the movement in the direction of the palace. At the same time he had been spying on all kinds of intelligence, however the information he got was still about the war in the Pagar Mountains a few days ago. Moreover the information didn’t mention the situation where the dragon family and the royal family were defeated and scattered.
The news should be blocked to avoid panic. On the contrary, it said that the intruders had been killed.
As for the intruders, they were defined as the rebels in the outer wall.
“If they attack the Witcher family, two days will pass. Even if the Witcher family doesn’t have enough time to spread the news, it wouldn’t be so long. If their news is leaked out, other forces such as the Witcher family, the monastery, the magistrate and so on will gather together to fight against the enemy. But it’s not the case…”Dudian’s eyes flashed, he found it hard to believe that these people had killed all the members of the family or the monastery so that the news didn’t leak out. After all, although the family couldn’t compete with them, but there were many of them.
There were only six of them. No matter how fast they killed, it wouldn’t be impossible for them to spread the news.
Unless they sneaked in and assassinate one by one.
However, it was also possible that they didn’t take action.
Dudian thought for a while and decided to observe for another day.
On the third day he waited. The situation in the palace was as usual. Dudian didn’t wait any longer. He went back to the intelligence base and asked about the response of the wing clan and the magistrate.
“Young master, the Wing Clan has also rejected our invitation. The magistrate is the same but the imperial city has found us and said that they are willing to cooperate with us.”The intelligence officer said.
“The Royal City wants to cooperate with us?”Dudian was surprised. After all, the biggest enemy of the outer wall was the royal city. After all, the entire giant wall was under the jurisdiction of the royal family, the outer wall was the territory of the royal family. But in the end, the only one who was willing to cooperate with him was the royal family.
“Reply to them. If they are willing to cooperate, come to the outer wall to look for me.”Dudian said.
“They have invited you to meet them in the palace.”The intelligence officer said.
Dudian shook his head: “I won’t go. Let them come to see me in my territory.”
“I understand, Speaker.”
Dudian left the place and returned to the outer wall. He was waiting for the royal family to arrive. At the same time he had used up the god’s marrow.
Half a day later at dusk.
Neuss came to the temple and said to dudian: “Master, there are two people outside who claim to be the royal family.”
“Let them come up.”Dudian said. He used the heat source to look at the two figures. They were at the bottom of the steps.
“After the battle in the Pagar Mountains, the number of ordinary pioneers has become tight…”Dudian murmured. He put down the drawing and quietly waited for the other side to come, but he wouldn’t underestimate them. After all, the other side came to talk. The brain was far more important than strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 769
chapters.content:
Chapter 769 – Chapter 759: The End Of The Season
Neuss led two middle-aged men to the temple.
They looked at Dudian who was sitting on the Pope’s throne. The middle-aged man asked: “Are you the person in charge here?”
Dudian indifferently replied: “Who are you?”
The middle-aged man frowned as he saw Dudian’s arrogant attitude, however he calmly replied: “I’m Stanley, the Minister of the Royal Family. Next to me is Lord Henry who is also the right-hand man of His Highness. We are here to discuss cooperation with you. May I know where is Her Highness Aisha?”
He looked at other places.
“She is resting. It is not convenient for her to see guests. If there is anything you need to discuss with me then I will take full responsibility here.”Dudian quietly looked at him. He knew that this person should be the main person in charge of this meeting, his official position was higher than that of Lord Henry. Although the Minister of the royal family was like the chief steward of the ancient Chinese dynasty. He was in charge of all the big and small things in the royal family. But here.., the Minister of the palace was in charge of a wider range of things, including all levels of communication meetings. The people who were in charge were usually at the rank of Earl.
Stanley couldn’t see the anger or joy on Dudian’s face. He couldn’t figure out what was going on in the boy’s mind, he said: “Her Highness Urita really appreciates the character of her Highness Aisha. I’m sure you have heard about the attack of the intruders. I Won’t go into details. The intruders have left the giant wall. But they may be lurking in the dark. I hope that her highness Aisha will respond to the signs and come to support the next time the intruders appear.”
Dudian nodded, “Of course. But you know that the resources in the outer wall are scarce. Aisha needs the god’s marrow to improve her strength. Do you have any indication? By the way, who is the one you are talking about?”
“Aisha is the only daughter of the lord of the giant wall. She is the princess of the giant wall of Sylvia. She is temporarily in charge of the giant wall in place of the lord of the giant wall.”Stanley smiled, “The royal family will provide the god’s marrow that you mentioned. I will send someone to deliver it to you when I return.”
“That’s good.”Dudian nodded: “Her Highness is aware of the fact that we are temporarily occupying the outer wall area. I wonder what she thinks?”
Stanley’s eyes lit up, “Her Highness has investigated the reason behind this matter. Her Highness said that if the cooperation is good then you can forget about the matter of occupying the outer wall area. After all, this is just an abandoned barbarian land. If Her Highness wants it then why not give it to her?”
Dudian heard his tone. The image of Her Highness appeared in his mind. He said: “Her Highness is so generous. We will come to apologize later.”
Stanley smiled but didn’t comment.
“Aren’t you going to give us a chair?”Henry reminded.
Dudian looked at him and waved his hand to signal Neuss to take a seat.
Dudian said: “I heard that the group of intruders have lost a few people. I think the possibility of them fighting back is very high. I wonder if His Highness is prepared?”
“His Highness is actively preparing. As long as they dare to come, we will catch them off guard!”Stanley said confidently.
Dudian smiled in his heart. These words were most likely to stabilize the morale of the army. The invader’s skills were so strong that they wouldn’t be able to withstand a single blow. He didn’t point it out, dudian continued to talk about the royal family.
After half an hour, Dudian sent the two away.
The conversation went very smoothly. Although there was disdain in the eyes of Lord Henry but Dudian didn’t pay attention to it. In front of the big picture, these small figures were not worth mentioning, unless something interfered with him.
“It seems that the royal family has taken precautions. I don’t have to worry about them. If they can invite me then they will invite the Witcher family and the research institute. The Combat Power of the research institute is not inferior to a single family. Although there are not many strong people but the tamed monsters are not weak.”Dudian was afraid of the research institute, the first time he sneaked into the inner wall, he saw an extremely terrifying monster in the wilderness that fed on undeads. From his current perspective, that monster was probably at the peak of the wilderness.
“However, three days have passed and they still haven’t taken any action. It seems that they have learned their lesson.”Dudian thought, he wasn’t worried that the inner wall would attack him in a short period of time. The longer it took, the more advantageous it would be for him. After all, his power station and the saltpeter mines were producing a lot of electricity and saltpeter every day.
The longer it took, the more he would save.
The next morning, Dudian received 500 pieces of God’s marrow from the inner wall. It was out of his expectation!
He had robbed thousands of bottles of God’s marrow from the Monster Research Institute.
“It seems that the royal family has sent me away as a beggar.”Dudian’s eyes flashed with coldness. He had thought that Urita was a nice person but it seemed that he was just wishful thinking.
However, his desire for God’s marrow wasn’t big. Since he had plundered a lot of God’s marrow, he had enough to advance all the way to the inner wilderness level, in addition to the amount of God’s marrow that Shermanson and Poland made every day, he didn’t need to plunder God’s marrow anymore.
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian continued to absorb God’s marrow every day until his body was saturated. It was almost as he had expected. After half a month of continuous saturated absorption, his physique had a breakthrough, he had evolved from an ordinary pioneer to the peak of the wilderness. He was on the same level as the war god.
The change brought by his physique breakthrough was that his demon body was closer to the demon. After the transformation, his appearance was more ferocious and terrifying. There were fewer and fewer human characteristics. He estimated that when he reached the inner wilderness level or the master level.., his body’s appearance should be completely demonized.
He didn’t know what kind of shape the Abyss Walker would have after it was activated. But it should be very distorted and terrifying.
“I don’t know if I have a chance to win against the inner wilderness level.”Dudian’s heart was eager to try. But his reason told him that the chances of winning were not very high. Although he was deified splitter’s magic marks.., however the magic marks of the experts of the inner wilderness were legendary magic marks. This was the main limitation of the evolution into the inner wilderness. Dudian’s advantage over the experts of the inner wilderness was the difference in deified magic marks.
Deified magic marks would trigger new abilities and strengthen the original abilities. However the difference in physique between the peak of the outer wilderness and the inner wilderness was enough to offset the advantage of the magic marks, the only thing left to do was to compare the experience of both sides. It was hard to say whether they would win or lose.
“With the current rate of resources and absorption, I estimate that I will be able to advance to the inner wilderness in a month. This is the advantage of the foundation.”Dudian was looking forward to this peaceful time, nothing Big had happened in the outer wall and inner wall for the past half month. The group of intruders seemed to have disappeared. But he knew that they were hiding in the dark. He estimated that they were investigating and understanding the giant wall. They were no longer as arrogant and reckless as before.
It was even more dangerous.
Fortunately, the danger wouldn’t come to him at the first moment. If there was an accident in the inner wall then it meant that they would take action. They would get rid of the inner wall and most likely find a way to deal with him, in the past half month they had investigated the location of the second base and knew the process of taking over the outer wall.
“If I can successfully advance to the inner wilderness level before the outbreak of the war, I might be able to fight against the master with my deified magic marks.”Dudian hoped that the more detailed the investigation of the group of intruders, the better, the longer he delayed, the greater his advantage. Moreover, Aisha had suddenly awakened for the fifth time for no reason. Perhaps she would naturally awaken again soon.
That would be the sixth awakening.
Once she awakened for the sixth time, her combat power would be no less than that of the Dominators. In fact, she would be stronger than most of the Dominators!
If such a thing happened, he would be completely sure of victory!
However, he couldn’t figure out the time cycle of Aisha’s natural awakening. If he had a microscope, he would be able to deduce it from the fission of the virus in his body.
Time passed and the giant wall regained its calm.
The military of the inner wall had accelerated the speed of calming down the chaos of the dead. By the time Dudian had broken through to the wasteland level, the inner wall had already recovered all the cities and the chaos of the dead had been completely suppressed.
After calming down the chaos of the dead, the inner wall began to repair the cities and send the refugees back to their respective cities to restore order. Everything was like a new grass growing on a withered prairie, tenaciously recovering its vitality.
Dudian spent every day absorbing the god’s marrow and learning the super chip. He sifted out the scientific and technological items that could be created in a short period of time. In the temple of elements in the outer wall.., the air system had become an upright branch of the holy church. After the fall of Barton in the name of the Pope, the air system was in the limelight over the other nine systems. There were even holy masters who called it the new century’s holy church!
The development of the air system had also brought rapid progress in science and technology. Everything was ready to move.
Half a month later.
The nuclear haze in the sky gradually disappeared. The air was warm again. It was the first rain after the new year.
The black snow season had come to an end. The New Year’s rainy season was coming.
“In another half a month, it will be good to continue to maintain this calm…”Dudian stood in front of the window and smoked. He blew the smoke out of the window and looked at the heavy rain, the distant mountains and St. Mark’s Square were shrouded in mist.
After a long time, he finished his cigarette.
He stayed by the window for a while and took a few deep breaths. After the smell of smoke dissipated, he returned to the desk of the temple. Aisha sat quietly on the chair next to him and accompanied him.
Dudian felt that the calmness at the moment was rare. However, he also knew that the rain would get heavier and the storm would come.
“If only I could have made the phonograph…”Dudian looked at Aisha with gentle eyes. His heart was full of regret. If he could have made the phonograph then he would have been able to keep her voice.
Unfortunately, at that time he was only busy with things that could increase his strength.
If it was now, he would rather use one or even ten hundred legendary items to replace a phonograph.
But if he missed it, he would miss it. No matter how much he tried, he could not make up for it.
The heavy rain fell rhythmically on the windows of the temple. It drifted across the entire sacred mountain and into the inner wall. In the royal family in the center of the Royal City, the palace that had been destroyed previously had been repaired, ulita was wearing a light red robe and holding a scepter. She sat in the hall and heard a count general next to her shout, “Your Highness, more than a month has passed. Those thieves have already left. What are we waiting for?”
“General Clinton, don’t be impatient. That Aisha is, after all, a fifth-level awakened. With our current strength, it will be too difficult for us to take back the outer wall.”
“That’s right. Let’s wait for a while more.”
The people next to her advised.
Urita looked at Clinton, who was about to speak, and raised her hand to stop him, “I know what you’re worried about, but things have already come to this. We can’t fight among ourselves again in the short term. Regardless of whether this Aisha is really a fifth-level awakened or not, even if it’s fake, it should be at least a fourth-level awakened. If we want her to surrender, we can only rely on force. These invaders have caused us to lose two marshals. It’s better to recuperate for a period of time first.”
Clinton sighed. “I’m afraid that while we are resting, they are making progress. They are in the dark, and we are in the light…”
Ulita shook her head. “There’s no need to say anymore.”
The heavy rain bathed the palace. In the heavy rain outside the palace, six figures wearing raincoats stood in a corner of a building. Their eyes were cold as they stared at the towering palace. After a moment.., one of them said, “Big Brother, with such heavy rain, they shouldn’t go out today.”
“Big Brother, this is a good opportunity.”
The hunchbacked old man stared at the palace for a moment, nodded slightly, turned around and said, “Let’s Go!”
“Okay!”The others immediately followed, their eyes filled with excitement and killing intent.
Half an hour later, everyone appeared outside a square two districts away from the palace. This square was the altar where the palace worshipped the gods. In the middle of the square was a towering stone platform with two angel statues on it.., in the middle of the square was a stone statue that was about ten meters tall. It was an extremely beautiful woman. One could not tell her age. She looked like a young girl in her twenties, but also like a mature woman in her thirties. The lower half of her body was wearing a strange skirt.
Everyone who lived in the Imperial City knew that this was the well-known Sylvia goddess of war!
The hunchbacked old man stared at the stone statue and said in a low voice, “Attack!”

chapters.title: Chapter 770
chapters.content:
Chapter 770 – Chapter 760: Stolen [ First Watch ]
In the heavy rain, six people suddenly jumped out and pounced on the statue in front of the square.
In front of the statue was a group of ordinary soldiers wearing black raincoats. They stood at the feet of the statue like ghosts in the heavy rain. The figures of the six people flew through the rain and instantly pounced in front of the soldiers. Without making any noise, they killed the group of soldiers.
After getting rid of the guards, the six of them quickly rushed up to the altar and pushed the statue down.
The statue did not fall to the ground. Instead, it was held by the Fatty and tilted in the rainstorm.
The hunchbacked old man looked at the altar under the statue. Just as he thought, there was a deep, dark hole that led to the underground. The hidden loss he had suffered under the palace made him a little hesitant. However, he quickly dispelled this concern and took the lead to rush down.
At this moment, the streets were pouring with rain, and there were no pedestrians. The buildings near the square had also closed their doors and windows to prevent the rain from seeping into their homes.
However, in one of the hotel rooms, although the transparent glass windows were closed, the curtains were not closed. A white-haired old man, who looked to be in his seventies, sat by the window, holding a glass of red wine in his hand and quietly tasting it, his gaze was fixated on the storm outside. To be precise, it was fixated on the statue of the god in the storm.
When the statue of the god tilted, the old man’s trance-like thoughts suddenly froze and he woke up. He was stunned for a moment before he abruptly stood up from his chair. With his eyes wide open, he pushed open the window and stretched his head out to look, he completely ignored the rain that was pouring in from the outside. Very soon, he saw the fat man holding the statue, as well as the hunched old man and the others.
“Intruders? !”His pupils constricted, shocked, he hurriedly raised his foot and was about to jump out of the window, but he suddenly thought of something. He quickly withdrew his foot, turned around, and ran to the other side of the room. He moved too fast, he knocked over a bottle of expensive red wine that cost at least a thousand gold coins on the ground and ran to a small cage. In the cage was a pitch-black little mouse that looked no different from an ordinary mouse, however, he was not an ordinary mouse. If one were to look carefully, they would find that there was a ring-shaped outline in its ears. It was a sound-seeking mouse.
It was also one of the favorite pets of the dark cultists in the outer wall.
The old man tore open the cage and took out the sound-seeking mouse. He took out a small wooden cylinder from the bottom of a pen box and hung it on its chest. Then, he patted its fur and said anxiously, “Go quickly!”
The sound-seeking mouse regained its freedom and quickly ran away. In the blink of an eye, it jumped out from the crack of the door and disappeared.
After releasing the sound-seeking mouse, the old man took a deep breath, turned around and walked to the window. He casually took apart a pitch-black bundle of cloth hanging behind the chair. There was a pitch-black battle knife wrapped inside.
The battle knife was not wide. It looked like a sword, but it had an arc and a single blade. It had a competent temperament.
He held the saber, stepped on the window, and jumped down from the hotel that was more than ten stories high.
A couple on the fourth or fifth floor were making out by the window, leaving the curtains open. The man was about to kiss his girlfriend who had her eyes closed when he suddenly saw the figure falling from the window behind her. He immediately cried out in fear.
“Second brother, someone is coming!”Just as the graceful woman was about to jump down from the deep hole under the statue, her eyes suddenly moved. She turned her head and looked at the back of the square. A black shadow was approaching rapidly in the rainstorm, and its body was emitting an astonishing heat, it was not inferior to them in the slightest.
She narrowed her eyes and said, “I didn’t expect there to be an expert hiding here. I didn’t even notice it before.”
“Third sister, leave it to me. You Guard it!”A dense killing intent appeared in the eyes of the burly man. He pulled out his large saber and suddenly rushed out. The rain water surged on the back of the saber, reflecting a sparkling luster.
“I’ll go too,”said sixth brother, whose face had been destroyed. He quickly rushed over. He was worried that fourth brother alone would cause the battle to fall into a stalemate and cause too much commotion.
In the blink of an eye, the two went up to the old man.
The black knife in the old man’s hand melted when he rushed out and entered the demonic body state. His whole body was like a human-shaped lizard, but his body was like an insect. There were network-like structures on his muscle lines, which looked extremely strange.
Seeing this strange demonic body, the burly man recognized it at a glance. He growled, “It’s their legendary monster here, Shadow Hunter!”
“Kill!”Sixth Brother made up his mind. Without saying anything, he entered the demon body and pounced over.
With one against two, the old man was at a disadvantage in the blink of an eye. In fact, just dealing with one person was already difficult for him. After all, although his demon mark was a legendary demon mark, Shadow Hunter’s greatest strength was assassination, it was not a direct battle. However, the current situation made it impossible for him to assassinate. He could only jump out to pin them down. He could only hope to delay until the arrival of reinforcements.
“Go to hell! !”The old man’s claws were like knives. His originally amiable and ordinary face was filled with malevolence as he roared and pounced on the weaker sixth.
The torrential rain washed down like seawater, covering the figures of the three people.
In the palace, Ulita had a meeting with the generals and Earls. Although the things they discussed were of no value to her, she had no choice but to find a topic to keep these people. After all.., to the Witcher family and the Monster Research Institute, the loss of the God’s corpse was a devastating blow. They should not remain calm.
The pace of the meeting was very slow. The rainstorm outside made the generals and earls unwilling to end the meeting so early. After all, going out during the rainstorm, even if there was a carriage to pick them up, it was easy to get their boots dirty.
In this quiet meeting, after an unknown amount of time, a female official suddenly jogged in from the side hall. She went around the backs of the generals in the meeting room and came before Ulita. She turned to the side and handed her a small note.
Ulita saw the anxiety on her face, and her heart sank slightly. However, she remained calm on the surface. She glanced at the generals present. Some of the generals and earls who were looking at her saw her gaze and immediately looked away as if nothing had happened, she continued to chat with the people beside her, but her gaze inadvertently swept towards Urita.
Urita’s fingers were very nimble. She quickly unrolled the rolled up piece of paper. When she saw the words on the piece of paper, her eyes widened. She abruptly stood up from her chair. Her face was filled with shock and disbelief!
This huge commotion immediately caused the whispers in the meeting room to stop.
Everyone looked at her in shock.
Urita felt that her brain was a little short of oxygen and she felt dizzy. After a while, she finally regained her senses, she immediately shouted, “Gather everyone immediately and head to the altar. The intruders have returned. They want to steal the Sylvia God’s corpse under the statue! !”
“What? !”
“How, how is this possible!”
“Isn’t the god’s corpse already…”
The generals and counts present were all dumbfounded. They were so shocked that they did not know what to do.
Urita did not have the time to explain anything to them. She took the lead and rushed out of the royal family.
When the personal maid at the door saw Urita, she quickly came up to her. “Your Highness, it’s raining heavily outside. Please bring your umbrella…”she handed the umbrella over, but Urita did not even look at it. She rushed over like a flying bird, she even threw the scepter in her hand and the crown on her head to the side. She was drenched by the rain. She displayed an astonishing speed and rushed into the storm.

chapters.title: Chapter 771
chapters.content:
Chapter 771 – Chapter 761: Catch Up [ Second Watch ]
When urita arrived at the square, she saw the towering statue of the god collapsed on the square. The perfect face on the statue was stuck to the muddy water, allowing the dirty rain to wash over it. On the altar where the statue was standing.., there was a huge hole.
She was stunned for a second before she rushed to the altar. The hole under the altar had been destroyed by someone. There were dents made by swords on the outside of the hole. She quickly jumped in. Under the hole was a secret chamber made of granite, the Secret Chamber was not big. There were no unnecessary items on display in it, but at this moment, there was nothing.
The last glimmer of hope in her heart was instantly extinguished. She stood in the Secret Chamber in a daze, as if she had lost her soul. Her eyes were dull.
After a long, long time.
She slowly came back to her senses. The corners of her mouth moved slightly. She turned around and quietly climbed out of the secret chamber. At this time, she saw the other counts and generals rushing over, but a few noble counts were driving a carriage, they were also wearing raincoats, and there were servants beside them holding umbrellas, afraid that they would be splashed by the rain.
When she saw the appearance of these people, a bitter smile appeared on her beautiful and heroic little face.
“Your Highness, Your Highness!”
One of the generals, who was completely drenched, hurriedly ran over. He opened the umbrella in his hand and covered Ulita’s head, he said with concern, “Your Highness, Are You Alright? What did you mean when you said that the god’s corpse was stolen? have those intruders been here before?”
As he spoke, he glanced around. When he saw the hole under the altar, his expression changed slightly as if he had thought of something.
At this moment, the other generals and earls also surrounded him.
“Your Highness, haven’t these intruders already left?”
“Are they still here with us?”
“My God, isn’t this too dangerous? Don’t they plan to leave?”
The few earls looked around nervously, afraid that the intruders would suddenly appear. They had heard the inside story of the puggle mountain range and knew how terrifying these intruders were, it was not like the situation where the commoners said that they had won a great victory and expelled the intruders.
Faced with the Earls’questioning tone, Ulita lowered her head indifferently. At this moment, she looked extremely disheveled. Her hair was disheveled and wet from the rain. It draped over her face. After a moment of silence, she suddenly thought of something, she sniffed lightly and her expression changed. She quickly pushed away the crowd and rushed into the rain.
Soon, he arrived at the building at the outer edge of the square. There was an alley here. At this moment, there was an old man lying on the ground at the entrance of the alley. His hair was white and he was lying face down on the ground. The rain below his body was dyed red, the blood flowed along the rain to the entrance of the surrounding sewer.
Ulita’s face was pale. She hurriedly went forward to pick him up, only to see that he was already dead. His wrinkled old face was frighteningly pale, and there was a huge hole in his chest. His heart was missing, and there were a few claw marks on his throat, one of his arms was also broken. His abdomen was also torn open, and his intestines were dangling under his hip bone. It was not difficult to imagine what kind of terrible battle he had experienced earlier.
“Uncle Mick!”Ulita cried out in grief. She hugged him and cried into the sky.
Tears and rain mixed with each other fell from her face. It was as if the heavens were pitying her.
However, she felt that the cold rain was so merciless. After the grief and indignation, only hatred remained in her heart.
She carried the old man’s corpse and slowly returned to the square. A group of generals and earls also came forward and looked at him with concern. Some people noticed the old man in her arms, but they were puzzled.
“Your Highness, who is this man?”
“Is he the intruder?”
Everyone looked puzzled.
Ulita was silent. When she heard that someone said he was an intruder, her face changed a little. She raised her head, she said expressionlessly, “He is my father’s most trusted person. He has always lived here and pretended to be an ordinary lonely old man, guarding the god’s corpse here. The last time the intruder took the god’s coffin, it was just a smoke bomb. It was not the god’s corpse, but this time, the god’s corpse was really lost!”
Hearing her words, everyone looked at each other, seeing the shock in each other’s eyes.
“Your Highness, What You Said… Is It True?”A general couldn’t help but ask.
Ulita looked at him expressionlessly and said, “If we can’t take back the God’s corpse, after a while, you will see with your own eyes whether the god’s corpse is lost or not.”
The general’s face changed, and he couldn’t help but shiver.
“Your Highness, the God’s corpse is so important. How can it be hidden in a place like the altar? Isn’t this… isn’t this nonsense? !”A fifty-something-year-old earl with white hair scolded in anger.
Urita raised her eyelids and glanced at him, she said, “This was arranged by my father. If you have any objections, you can wait for my father to come back and talk to him. Besides, even if it was arranged under the palace, wasn’t it also robbed? is the defense there weak?”
The Earl’s expression changed slightly, and he could not speak.
“Your Highness, who else knows about the god’s corpse hiding here besides you? How did these intruders know?”
“That’s right. We’ve been here for so many years, but we didn’t know about the god’s corpse hiding here. How did these intruders find it?”
“There must be a mole!”
Hearing their words, Ulita felt a kind of irritation in her heart. It could even be said that she was manic. However, her restraint was extremely strong. Her fingers tightened slightly, and she took a deep breath, she said coldly, “No one else knows about this except my father, uncle Mick, and myself! “After the false god Coffin under the palace was robbed, I never came here. I was worried that they would follow me and trace me here, but they still found this place.”
“How is this possible? Did this Mick leak the secret?”
“He died in battle. How could he leak the secret?”
“Let’s not talk about the strangeness of this matter for now. The priority now is to find the god’s corpse. Since it has already been stolen, what’s the point of thinking so much? If this group of intruders returns to their territory, we will be completely finished.”
“That’s right. Let’s think about how to find the god’s corpse first!”
Ulita acted as if she did not hear the chattering of the crowd. Her gaze slowly shifted to a spot outside the square. If one observed carefully, there was a faint smell of blood on this route. Although it was covered by the rain.., the smell was very faint, but it should be the direction in which these intruders left.
She was silent for a moment, she said, “Immediately inform the dragon mother, Rock Demon, and wing king of the Witcher family. Tell them about this. Tell them to immediately lead the pioneers in the clan to intercept the intruders. I will go first and see if I can follow them. I will leave a scent along the way and let them follow my scent.”
“Your Highness, you want to go in person?”
“How can that be? There are masters among them!”
“Your Highness, you should stay here and take charge of the situation!”
The generals and earls quickly persuaded.
Urita ignored them, pushed away the crowd, turned around and rushed out.

chapters.title: Chapter 772
chapters.content:
Chapter 772 – Chapter 762: Goddess Sylvia
On the giant wall in the rainstorm.
Six figures leaped up and stood on the wide wall. The burly man and the fatty gently placed a seven to eight meter long oval-shaped metal ball on the ground. The metal ball was like a mango, flat and round, there were many solidified gray shells on the surface, revealing pieces of bright silver metal under the washing of the rainstorm. There were streamlined metallic patterns on the surface of the metal, making it look very simple.
“Big Brother, let’s check the goods!”The graceful woman said to the hunchbacked old man.
The hunchbacked old man looked around and said, “The rain here is too heavy. If we open the coffin, the god’s corpse will be easily contaminated. Let’s find a clean place first.”
“Then let’s go to the outer wall and find a place to settle down.”
“I don’t think they will chase us here for the time being. Even if they do, they are not afraid. As long as they have the god’s corpse, they will kill anyone who comes!”
“Okay.”
The few of them quickly made a decision. They carried the god’s coffin and sped along the wall. A moment later, they arrived at a village on the outskirts of the outer wall and sneaked into a farmer’s house.
The rain poured down and lightning flashed, lighting up the world occasionally.
In the spacious hall, the farmer and his wife fell to the ground. Their necks were bent ninety degrees, and they died from a broken neck. Their two daughters, who were studying medicine in the bedroom, also fell on the desk and the ground. Blood flowed out of the corners of their mouths, it was the same person who had broken their necks.
Soon, only the hunchbacked old man and the others were left in the room.
They moved the oval metal ball into the farmer’s bullpen. The bullpen was very large and could accommodate a huge metal ball. All the cows in it were killed and piled up in a corner of the bullpen. The six of them surrounded the metal ball, the hunchbacked old man reached out and caressed the soil on the surface of the metal ball, wiping it clean. Soon, he found a gap that was even smaller than a hair on the edge of the metal ball.
In addition, in the middle of the crack, there was a square protruding metal plate.
The hunchbacked old man frowned. The shape of this divine coffin was completely different from the fake one they had seized earlier. It did not look like a coffin at all, and there were no epic scenes of female war gods and monsters fighting on the surface, it was too ordinary and low-key.
“Big Brother, how do I Open This Thing?”
“Is this a lock?”
The burly man and the fatty looked at the strange shape of this thing and felt a little helpless.
The hunchbacked old man thought for a moment and tried to put his palm on the metal board to move, but the metal board was firmly fixed. Just as he was about to stop, the metal ball suddenly trembled, giving them a fright, after all, they had been injured by the poisonous gas released by the fake and had suffered losses, leaving behind many shadows.
Just as the hunchbacked old man retracted his palm, a pleasant female voice suddenly came from behind the metal plate. The six of them had never heard the language spoken by this female voice before.
When they heard the female voice, the six of them were so scared that they stepped back, their faces filled with shock.
The hunchbacked old man was also quite frightened. He looked at the metal ball in shock. Could this voice be coming from the female war god inside?
Could it be that she wasn’t Dead?
Fatty, the graceful woman, and the others had the same thought. They looked at each other and saw the disbelief in each other’s eyes.
One had to know that this female war god had been alive for more than three hundred years. How could she still be alive? Moreover, if she was really alive, how could she let them kill their way into this divine wall?
This sweet-sounding female voice repeated the strange language from before. After two beeps, the metal board lit up with a red light, and then the voice sank.
The stooped old man waited for about ten minutes, until the voice did not ring again. Only then did he let out a slight sigh of relief, only to discover that his back was already drenched. He turned his head to look at the graceful woman and said, “Is that a living thing inside?”
The graceful woman shook her head slightly. When the female voice from before rang out, she immediately used her ability to sense it. “There is no living response.”
“Big, Big Brother, didn’t the wall master say that this Sylvia Valkyrie died a long time ago?”Sixth, whose face had been destroyed, said in a trembling voice.
The hunchbacked old man stared at the Divine Coffin for a moment before saying in a low voice, “All of you, step back a little first.”
Hearing that, the few of them immediately stepped back a distance.
The hunchbacked old man carefully stepped forward and raised his hand to slap the metal ball. After a few slaps, there was no response from the inside.
He let out a sigh of relief and said, “It seems that this is something similar to the wall master’s phonograph. It left her voice here, and it wasn’t her speaking.”
The others let out a sigh of relief. If the Valkyrie was still alive, she would have easily killed them with just a lift of her finger. How could they be allowed to play around like this?
The hunchbacked old man stepped forward and looked at them carefully. After some deliberation, he took out his battle saber and slashed through the tiny crack on the edge of the metal ball. After several failed attempts, the blade finally cut into the crack. He immediately used force to pry it up.
Crack!
The metal ball let out a cracking sound and loosened slightly.
Seeing that it was effective, the hunchbacked old man adjusted the blade and used the same method to pry it open in other places.
After about ten minutes, the tiny crack outside the metal ball had become half a centimeter wide. The hunchbacked old man melted the saber and entered the demonic body state. He asked the others to step back, then used the demonized claws to hold the edge and lift it up abruptly.
With a hiss, a burst of frost-like cold air gushed out.
This cold air was exactly the same as the fake god Coffin from before. The hunchbacked old man’s pupils constricted and he hurriedly stepped back. Soon, the cold air spread out and gradually spread out. The temperature in the surroundings dropped rapidly. Even the torrential rain that had fallen on the cow shed suddenly became light, because the white cold air had absorbed onto the roof of the cow shed, it condensed into a thick layer of cold crystals. If the six of them stood outside the cow shed at this moment and watched, they would have noticed that the rainwater that had fallen on the cow shed had just splashed out when it froze into ice.
The temperature in the entire cowshed quickly dropped below zero degrees Celsius.
The cold air spread more and more widely. The rainwater that flowed down from the edge of the cowshed turned into icicles. The entire cowshed was soon frozen into an ice chamber. Even the dead cows piled up in the corner were frozen stiff, the blood that flowed out turned into ice.
A moment later, when the cold air had almost dissipated, the hunchbacked old man who had retreated outside the cowshed tentatively reached out his hand to touch a bit of the free cold air. He felt a chill on his fingertips, but other than that, he did not feel any other discomfort.
He tried again and again, and finally came to the conclusion that the cold air this time was different from the last time. It was not highly toxic, but just pure cold air.
After knowing that the cold air was not toxic, he immediately rushed into the cowshed. However, just in case, he held his breath and went to the open oval metal sphere to look. He saw a faint white gas floating inside, a perfectly proportioned snow-white naked body was lying inside, as if it was in a deep sleep.
