When he saw the face of the body, his eyes heaved a sigh of relief. This appearance was consistent with the mission information he had received. It was true that this was the goddess Sylvia! His gaze landed on her body. She was completely naked. There was nothing to cover her body, including the hidden parts of her lower body. However, there was not a hint of desire in his eyes. Instead, he was looking at her with increasing horror.
There was not a hint of life on the body of the goddess Sylvia. She was undoubtedly a dead person! However, the skin of her corpse was even more lustrous than that of a living person. Her skin was as tender as jelly. Logically speaking, even if it was not rotten, it should at least be a dried corpse after more than three hundred years. However, this Sylvia’s corpse was like a sleeping living person.., there was not a single wrinkle on her skin!
This could be explained by the freezing cold. However, there was another point that made him feel incredulous. That was that the lower half of Sylvia’s body from the waist down was not the structure of a human’s legs, instead, it was a mass of hideous limbs that made one vomit. It was grotesque and ugly. It formed a stark contrast with her flawless upper body. Her upper body was like a god, but her lower body was like a devil from hell!
He stared at it in a daze. Because he was engrossed in it, he stared at it for a long time. Suddenly, he seemed to see the god’s corpse’s closed eyes open. It was a pair of extremely deep yet incomparably bright eyes that seemed to contain endless stars, a lofty gaze that was filled with holiness, yet completely emotionless, was looking down at her. Compared to her cold gaze, her face seemed to reveal a smile. The corners of her mouth curled up slightly. Just this slight expression.., instantly, it made her incomparably dazzling. She was filled with an irresistible allure that was extremely womanly.
And the group of strange and ugly limbs beneath her that caused people to vomit seemed to be twisting slightly, wanting to climb out of the metal sphere.
“No! !”The hunchbacked old man roared loudly and took a few steps back.
The things that he saw suddenly disappeared. As if it was an illusion, everything returned to what he had seen before. Sylvia was still lying quietly in the metal sphere. Her eyes were closed, as if she was in a deep sleep.., the terrifying limbs on her lower body also remained in the same position as before. There was no change at all. However, the fantastical scene from before was still lingering in his mind for a long time.
His face was pale as he panted heavily. He had the urge to immediately flee from this place.
“Big Brother!”
“What’s wrong, Big Brother!”
When fatty, the graceful woman, and the others heard the voice, they hurriedly rushed in. When they saw the hunchbacked old man’s appearance, they were shocked. It was as if he had experienced an intense battle. In this extremely cold cowshed.., he was sweating profusely as he panted rapidly.
“I’m fine.”The hunchbacked old man panted as he slowly calmed his beating heart. His heart was still palpitating. He did not dare to look at the Holy and evil body anymore. He even stayed beside this thing.., he felt like he needed a great amount of courage to support himself.
However, from this, he could confirm that this corpse was not a forgery. It was a genuine GOD CORPSE!
“This is the war god Clan?”
“Her body structure, how could it…”
The graceful woman and the others also noticed Sylvia in the metal ball. When they saw the terrifying structure of her lower body, their expressions instantly changed.
The hunchbacked old man took a deep breath and said, “Don’t stare at it too much. This thing is a little evil. No wonder it can suppress the god wall after death.”
“Ah!”With a scream, the burly man took a few steps back. His legs trembled slightly, and his head was covered in sweat. His eyes were filled with fear.
When the hunchbacked old man saw him like this, he knew that he was most likely the same as himself. He saw a terrifying fantasy. He went forward and pushed the other half of the metal ball up, covering it. When the ball covered Sylvia’s beautiful face.., he seemed to see her eyes open. His heart trembled. He did not dare to think too much. He quickly fastened the metal ball tightly. In his heart, he even regretted opening the thing.
“Now that we have the God’s corpse, Big Brother, what should we do next?”
“Follow the previous plan.”The hunchbacked old man gritted his teeth and said.
..
..
Urita quickly climbed onto the giant wall. Looking at the muddy water left on the wall, she knew that the intruders had come here before. She looked around, but she did not see any footprints or traces. As for the scent.., it had been washed away by the storm, and she was not good at tracking smell.
“Have they escaped the giant wall…”she looked at the vast hunting area outside the giant wall. She could vaguely see some huge monster figures crawling in the rain. Her face was ugly, and she gritted her teeth.
After a moment, a few figures flew over. They were several generals who had the power of pioneers.
“Your Highness, have you found them?”
Urita shook her head. The anger in her eyes had calmed down. She turned around: “Gather people and prepare to search for them. We must find them before they enter the Abyss!”
The generals looked at each other and immediately agreed.
..
… ..
“It’s raining heavily…”Dudian stood by the window and looked at the cloudy sky. Occasionally he heard a few thunderclaps, “Such heavy rain should cover the entire giant wall…”
“Young Master.”Neuss came to the outside of the temple and called out.
Dudian turned around: “Come in.”
Neuss crossed the threshold and quickly walked into the temple. He said to dudian: “The inner wall has sent a letter to summon you and Haisha.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up: “I know.”
Neuss hesitated for a moment: “Master, are they going to deal with you and deliberately summon you?”
“I don’t know.”Dudian shook his head and looked at the sky: “I hope they won’t be so stupid.”
Dudian took some items with him and left the temple. He went to the inner wall alone. He knew that he wouldn’t be able to defeat the masters of the inner wall, after all, it wasn’t a long journey unless they had set up a trap. But even if Aisha went with them, it would be useless.
A moment later, Dudian arrived at the inner wall.
He didn’t go directly to the palace. He observed the surroundings for a while. He saw that there were many figures gathered inside. There were four figures of the inner wall. He knew all of them, he had seen them during the siege battle in the Pagar mountain range. They were members of the three Great Demon Hunter families.
“It seems that something has happened.”He heaved a sigh of relief in his heart. The Imperial City should not have set up such a big scheme just to deal with him. Moreover, even if the imperial city had such a goal, he was confident that he could survive, that was because he had the imperial city in his hands. They would never dare to touch his chips.

chapters.title: Chapter 773
chapters.content:
Chapter 773 – Chapter 763: Discussion
“Who is it? Stop!”
The guard stopped Dudian and scolded him.
“His Highness Ulita invited me to come here. Please inform me.”Dudian’s attitude was humble and polite.
The guard looked at him: “Please tell me your name.”
“Dudian.”
“Wait here. I will inform you.”The guard’s attitude wasn’t polite. There was a sense of superiority in his eyes.
After a moment the guard returned. His attitude was much more respectful and his waist was bent. “Mr. Dean Please.”
The thousands of steps made the palace look like a temple. It was solemn and solemn. When Dudian came to the front of the palace he saw many extraordinary figures gathered in the hall, some of them were people he recognized, including one or two pioneers who were elders of the Dragon Clan.
These two pioneers were fully qualified to sit in the palace. But at the moment they were standing. There were not many chairs in the palace. There were only four or five people sitting there.
The one sitting in front of the Dragon Clan was a cold and elegant lady. Her appearance was similar to that of Aisha and Hathaway. However, she had a mature and charming charm compared to the two of them, however, under her cold and distant expression, it seemed a bit cold and elegant.
When Dudian came to the door, someone had already noticed him and turned to look at him.
Urita was sitting on the throne at the top of the hall. She was holding a scepter and wearing a crown. The little face of the girl was full of solemnity. Although she was young, her aura was not weak, she looked down at Dudian who was outside the hall. She immediately got up and waved to Dudian.
Dudian’s expression was calm as he stepped into the temple. His eyes swept over the faces of the people present. Most of them were looking at him with a bit of curiosity. There was obvious hatred in their eyes, it was the monastery, the Dragon Clan and the military. Dudian knew that they had recognized his identity so he didn’t care.
“Your Highness, who is this?”A black-robed elder asked.
Dudian squinted his eyes. He had seen this person before. He knew that the other party also recognized him. He was the elder of the Ministry of Justice who had secretly captured him and given him the identity of elder of the dark church, dudian sneered as he heard the elder’s words: “Elder, how long has it been since we last met? Don’t you recognize me?”
Mogran’s face sank: “When did I know you?”
“It seems you are old and forgetful. I didn’t expect that your monastery is so short of people.”Dudian spoke as if he wasn’t afraid of offending people.
“You!”Mogran was angry as he took a step forward.
The burly Dean who was sitting in front of him raised his hand and stopped him, he looked at dudian: “Are you the one who used despicable means to seize the outer wall? You are as arrogant and ignorant as the rumors say!”
“Everyone!”A clear and loud voice was heard, “Don’t forget why you are here today. Mr. Dean is invited by me. As long as Mr. Dean is willing to join us, I will let bygones be bygones. I hope you remember that the god’s corpse was stolen. Do you need me to repeat the consequences?”
The one who spoke was urita. Everyone looked up at him and looked at dudian.
Mogran didn’t intend to let Dudian off, he sneered: “Your Highness, you let such a person join our team to fight against the invaders. What if he stabbed us in the back?”? “This kid is very sinister. He is capable of doing anything. I think the Dragon Clan knows this very well.”
Dudian looked at him, “Didn’t you say that you don’t know me? How do you know that I am very insidious?”? “Do you people like to slander people?”? “If you only have this bit of accomplishment then I really feel sad for you. I also feel sad for all the civilians. Oh, I forgot that you are an elder of the Ministry of Justice. You are only responsible for fighting and killing. So even if you are forgetful, it is understandable.”
“You!”Mogran’s eyes were wide open. He was so angry that he couldn’t speak.
“What are you doing in the monastery? Don’t involve our Dragon Clan. I am not familiar with you.”The cold and elegant lady on the chair looked at dudian.
Mogran’s face changed. If it was just Dudian, then it would be fine. But the attitude of the dragon mother was different. Could it be that their dragon clan had reconciled with Dudian?
Dean glanced at the Dragon Mother. He was a bit surprised but didn’t think much about it. In any case, the Dragon Clan’s way of handling Aisha’s accident had disappointed him to the extreme. It was unforgivable!
It was also the first time that Urita had met Dean. She didn’t expect that the person who stirred up the outer wall was about the same age as her. She was surprised but also a bit curious. However, Dean’s behavior gave her a headache, it was obvious that he was a difficult person to appease. She changed the topic, “I hope that you can put down your hatred in the past. We should unite against the common enemy. No matter what, the first goal is to take back the god’s corpse!”
“That’s right.”Dudian nodded in agreement.
The others who wanted to open their mouths looked at him but didn’t say anything.
Dudian didn’t care about their eyes. He looked at urita: “Your Highness, Can I Sit Down?”
The people who had been prejudiced against Dudian were angry, mogran sneered: “You? It’s enough to let you into the hall. Do you know who is sitting here? Who Are You? You are just a small pariah in the outer wall…” He seemed to realize that his words were too much. Although he thought so but it was a bit inappropriate to say it out loud.
Dudian looked at him but didn’t say anything. He looked up at urita.
Urita felt a headache. Dudian was really going to stir up trouble for her. He asked for a seat right away. At present, the people sitting in the hall were all the top leaders of the forces. If Dudian was given a seat.., it was the same as looking down on others. If she didn’t give him a seat then she was afraid of angering Dudian. After all, the god’s corpse was stolen. With Aisha’s help, the chances of getting it back would be greatly increased.
Urita hesitated for a moment and said: “Alright, take a seat with Mr. Dudian.”
The crowd was in an uproar.
“Mr. Dean, why isn’t her Highness Haisha Here?”Urita immediately pointed out Haisha’s name. She wanted to tell the others that it was for her sake.
“This is a small matter. I will take care of it. She is resting at home.”
“Resting? Don’t let her rest when she goes to war.”Moglang sneered. He didn’t want to miss any opportunity to attack Dudian.
Dudian didn’t look at him as if he didn’t hear it. This kind of disregard made Mogren’s sneer quickly become gloomy.
Soon, the seat was moved over. Dudian naturally sat down.
Dragon mother, the dean and others were calm. They knew that Ulita valued Haisha behind Dudian so she gave him a seat. Therefore, they didn’t have the same knowledge as dudian.
“Your Highness, can we talk about business now?”The burly man asked. He was the previous leader of the Rock tribe, nicknamed Rock Demon.
Ulita saw his dissatisfaction, she nodded and said, “It has been a month since the last time in the Pagar Mountains. I thought that these intruders had already left this place after taking the fake God’s coffin. I didn’t expect them to hide here. They must have found that there was no God’s corpse in the god’s coffin when they left, so they hid here and waited for an opportunity. This time, they planned very well and caught US unprepared. Now, the real God’s corpse has been stolen by them. I tracked them to the giant wall and saw the traces they left. I reckon that they have already left the giant wall. However, there is still a long way to go from the outside of the giant wall to the abyss. They should rest for a while. This is our chance to catch up with them.”
“Your Highness.”Rock Demon’s eyes were like torches. “Last time, I asked you if the God’s corpse was real. You said it was real. This time, you said it was real. I want to know if it’s real or Not!”
Ulita had expected that they would ask such a question. She looked straight at rock demon, “This time, it’s real!”! “Last time, I lied to everyone. That was not my original intention. The fake God’s coffin was father’s idea. He had been worried that other people from the giant wall would come and steal the god’s corpse. Therefore, he hid the real body of the god’s corpse under the altar while the fake one was hidden under the heavily guarded Palace.”
“I believe that you all know that the god’s corpse is hidden under the palace. It’s not difficult to find out about it, but the only people who know that the real God’s corpse is hidden under the altar, other than the dead uncle Mick, are me and my father
“The purpose of doing this is also to prevent any intruders from infiltrating the palace and secretly infiltrating the bodies of the people here. They will learn about the real God’s corpse from you, so they have to keep it under wraps.”
Rock demon stared at her for a while, he nodded and said, “I believe it’s true this time. However, it won’t be so easy to let go of the matter of deceiving us last time. After that, I will report to the wall master and ask him to give us an explanation. Your Highness, if it weren’t for you deceiving us last time, we would have attacked that person while he was injured. They would have died a long time ago. There would be no more trouble now.”
“That’s right.”The middle-aged man said in a cold tone: “If we knew that there was no God’s corpse in the coffin then we would have killed all of them!”! The master’s injuries had healed and he had broken out of the encirclement. But now he had stolen the real God’s corpse. Your Highness, you have killed all of us!”
Dudian noticed that one of the sleeves of the man was empty. There were several new scars and corroded wrinkles on the face and neck of the rock man. It was probably caused by the last battle in the Pagar Mountains.
Ulita’s face was ugly. She knew that she was responsible for this but she had her own considerations. She didn’t tell them because she wanted to keep the information about the real God’s corpse secret. She was worried that there were more than nine intruders, there were other intruders lurking in the giant wall. Moreover, she did not know at that time that there was actually a ruler-level powerhouse among the six people. After that ruler rushed out from under the palace, he did not make a move along the way, it was to the extent that they mistook him for an expert of the inner wilderness, which caused them to be caught unprepared and defeated.
“This matter has passed. Now, it’s time to consider how to take back the God’s corpse,”dragon mother said with a frown.
Ulita took a deep breath and said, “I am responsible for this matter. But now, please think about how to find the god’s corpse first. If the God’s corpse is taken away by them, I am afraid that something big will happen before my father comes back!”
“The area outside the giant wall is vast. If they want to hide, it is no different from finding a needle in a haystack. And even if we find them, we can’t defeat them…”the dean of the monastery sighed.
“I don’t know how many pioneers are there. If we let them lead the team to search, there might be a slight possibility.”Rock devil glanced at the middle-aged man.
“Counting me, there are four in total.”The middle-aged man said.
Dudian sat on the side and listened to their conversation. He suddenly thought of a possibility. He knew that the intruders wouldn’t leave or couldn’t leave. They were definitely still lurking around the giant wall, but they weren’t in a hurry to attack. Apparently, they didn’t plan to act as recklessly as before. In fact, according to the method that Urita and the others had discussed, they would go out to search for these people. The defense of the giant wall would be greatly reduced!
If they were to destroy the giant wall, no one would be able to stop them!
They could even ambush outside the giant wall and kill the teams that went out to search!
It was obvious that they had thought of this but they had to try and salvage the situation.
“The giant wall hasn’t come back yet and something big has happened. What can happen without the God’s corpse?”Dudian was curious about the situation after the god’s corpse was stolen, but he had an intuition that it was best not to appear in such a situation. Otherwise it would be very bad.
“These intruders will certainly kill them one by one. It seems that the possibility of their destruction is very high. It is a good thing for me. But without them as a shield, the next intruders will be more difficult to deal with. I need time to accumulate more electricity and gunpowder. If I can slow down the efficiency of their killing…”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he lowered his head.
“Mr. Dudian, what do you think?”A voice came from the side.

chapters.title: Chapter 774
chapters.content:
Chapter 774 – : Chapter 764: War Begins
Dudian’s thoughts were interrupted. He didn’t need to look to know that the person who was speaking was Mogran. He didn’t have any good ideas so naturally he wouldn’t make any suggestions, he coldly said: “My opinion is that you should keep your mouth shut. Don’t interrupt the meeting. You will waste everyone’s time. Do you understand?”
His words were merciless, especially the last question. It was like a critical hit. It was easy to cause people’s rebellious heart to explode in anger.
Mogren wanted to make Dudian make a fool of himself and retaliate against his arrogant attitude. But he didn’t expect that the latter’s temper was more fiery than he imagined. It was completely different from the previous time when he was submissive in front of Mogren, he didn’t dare to raise his head. Sure enough, once he gained power, his despicable heart was exposed. But after gaining power, how many gentlemen could endure it? He was angry in his heart but he endured it.
He was aware that if he provoked Dudian at this moment, it would only bring shame to himself. If he was angry, it would be the same as Dudian’s wish. It would cause dissatisfaction among others. At this moment, enduring it would make everyone feel disgusted with Dudian’s attitude, sometimes not being angry was more destructive than being angry.
Dudian saw that Mogrong was silent. He was a bit surprised but quickly thought of the other’s thoughts. He glanced at the other dissatisfied eyes. He knew that Mogrong had succeeded. His face was calm, dudian didn’t waste his thoughts on this small episode. He continued to connect the previous thoughts and fell into deep thought.
“The best way is to tell them that the intruders haven’t left. Let them prepare a trap and gather everyone. I will use the life of the seventh brother to force them to jump out and fight with them. This way it will cause more casualties to the intruders. However it will be difficult to explain it to them. They will even suspect that I have colluded with the intruders. It is a sensitive period. There are snakes in the grass and trees. Once there is such a suspicion it will be very disadvantageous to me.”
People’s hearts were complicated because simple things couldn’t be said in a simple way.
After a moment, Dudian saw that urita, Dragon mother and others had divided the pursuit team. They had marked the route and map of the pursuit as well as the scope of the main search. The plan was drawn very quickly, they still chose to pursue the search.
Dudian sighed in his heart. He had to open his mouth: “Everyone, I think we can do one thing before trying to pursue the search.”He took the initiative to open his mouth. Many people immediately looked over.
URITA frowned: “What is it?”Time was tight. She was upset to hear more nonsense.
“As far as I know, these intruders are not temporary mercenary groups. The relationship and friendship between them is not simple cooperation. They can be called ‘partners’!”Dudian said.
“How do you know? Even if you know this, so what?”Mogren saw that Dudian took the initiative to jump out.
Dudian knew that the relationship between the intruders was not shallow because of the way they addressed each other when they met in the temple, he looked at urita: “They are supporting each other in life and death. They should have a deep friendship with each other. You have killed several of their brothers. At the same time, their task is to take away our goddess Sylvia. Now that the task is completed, they can return at any time. But will they really leave so dejectedly? “I don’t think it’s possible if it was me or everyone here!”
Urita’s eyes lit up as she heard Dudian’s words.
Dragon mother nodded as she thought for a moment.
The middle-aged man looked at Dudian as the dissatisfaction in his eyes faded, he said: “Yes, I heard them talking about Big Brother and third sister. If it was me, the first thing I would do after taking the god’s corpse would be to find a safe place to hide it and then come back!”
“That’s right!”
Ulita nodded with excitement in her eyes. She was not stupid. She knew that this possibility was very high. After all, the enemy could hide here for a month and find out the location of the god corpse, they would most likely find out the strength of the experts in the wall. They didn’t have a ruler here. If the enemy knew this, there was no reason for them not to kill their way back!
“In this case, it is too risky for us to hunt them down. It is better to think of a way to lure them to take the initiative to attack.”Urita quickly thought of a way to take the opportunity to ambush them.
Dudian didn’t need to say anything as he saw that Urita understood. He continued to think about his own matters.
Mogran saw that Urita and the witcher family were optimistic about Dudian’s proposal. He didn’t say anything more. He didn’t even look at Dudian, there was no need to continue to test the attitude of the Dragon family and His Highness towards Dudian.
Half an hour later, the meeting ended.
The heavy rain outside the hall slowly came to an end.
“Mr. Dudian came in a hurry. His clothes were wet. You should be careful when you go back.”Urita took the initiative to send Dudian off. She handed him a jade green leather umbrella. It was very delicate and strong. It was waterproof like an oil cloth, there was a faint fragrance coming from it.
Dudian took it and said: “Send someone to inform me if there is anything.”
“I will.”Urita smiled.
“I hope the plan goes smoothly.”Dudian said a half sentence with blessing. He turned around and left.
Urita looked at the back of dudian. Her eyes flashed with light. Previously she had been in a terrible situation. But Dudian’s reminder made her think of the next plan. She felt a lot more at ease. This made her curious about dudian, if it wasn’t for the current situation she would have sent people to investigate Dudian’s background. She felt that it was incredible that such a person could be born in such a barren place!
“I hope it goes well… otherwise I will have to take the risk to hunt him down.”She muttered.
Dudian had returned to the mountain. Urita and the others had made a plan to wait for the intruders to take the bait. But from the way he had been hiding for a month and stealing the god’s corpse.., it was completely different from the previous time. The previous time he had been reckless but this time he was careful. He knew that the enemy had stopped looking down on him. It wasn’t easy for him to fall into the trap of Urita and the others.
“It seems that I have to push it further.”Dudian thought. However the intruders didn’t leave a way to contact him so he couldn’t find them. It was because of this that the intruders dared to delay, the first thing they would do after a month was to seize the God’s corpse. They didn’t want to kill people for Dudian. This was probably because they didn’t dare to kill the hostage.
It was like the kidnappers who kidnapped people but couldn’t contact their families. In this case, the kidnappers wouldn’t kill the hostage easily.
Dudian guessed that they would interrupt him. Even if he wanted to use this to threaten them, he wouldn’t be able to do anything. After all, he wouldn’t dare to kill the hostage. After all, once the hostage died.., they didn’t kill them for him. In the end they would have to bear their anger. It wasn’t worth it. So even though their life was in danger, they were still fearless, they didn’t take Dudian’s deal seriously.
Dudian thought for a moment before he came up with an idea. He called Neuss and asked him to bring the finger bone of the black-robed teenager. He would gather the military and the nobles who were loyal to the Holy Church as well as all the forces of the dark church to hold an auction, the name of the item to be auctioned was “Old seven”.
It was obvious that the name didn’t conform to the general rules of the auction. But Dudian was the one who organized the auction. Everyone listened to him. No matter how unruly it was, it would be held smoothly. Moreover, the news would spread throughout the outer wall.
Dudian believed that these intruders would leave at least one or two people in the outer wall to monitor his movements. They would also check his intelligence and the location of Old Seven’s hiding place. Although they wanted old seven to be dead.
Soon, the news of the auction was spread through the newspapers. In less than half a day, the news spread to every family except the suburbs and small villages, almost all the residents in the other places knew about the matter.
Less than half a day after the auction began, three figures appeared on the top of the mountain. The leader was a hunchbacked old man. The other three were not there.
Dudian’s heart was moved. The other three most likely stayed behind to guard the god’s corpse. It meant that the location of the god’s corpse wasn’t outside the giant wall. It wasn’t far from here. It wouldn’t be more than half a day’s journey!
“Stinky Boy, what did you do to old seven? !”The burly man rushed into the hall. He stared at Dudian angrily.
Dudian calmly said: “Please sit.”
The burly man was so angry that his body was trembling. The old man looked at Dudian deeply. He sat on the chair: “I saw Old Seven’s finger bone. What do you mean? Do you want to break the contract?”
“You should be the one who broke the contract.”Dudian coldly said: “You disappeared for a month. Did you do the things for me? are the experts in the inner wall still alive?”
The old man indifferently said: “It is not easy to kill so many experts. Moreover I don’t know if they have a master like me. Naturally we have to investigate first. Moreover we didn’t specify how long to kill them. How can we break the contract?”? “But you. I doubt whether seven is alive or dead. We have to see him.”
“There is no need to talk about meeting him.”Dudian coldly said: “If you want to see him then we will die together. I will kill him. You will wait for the Lord to come back and deal with you!”
The old man slightly raised his eyebrows. He didn’t expect that Dudian’s reaction would be so fierce. He was angry but he held back his anger.
“I will give you three days. Kill them all in three days.”Dudian estimated the time that Urita and the others had to endure.
In fact, the longer the intruders delayed the better for him. But he was afraid that Urita and the others wouldn’t be able to wait. It would be suicide if they went out to hunt them down.
“Three days is too short.”The old man frowned.
“At most three days.”Dudian’s tone was firm.
The old man looked at him: “I hope you can let me see a living seven. Otherwise…”
“Time is tight. You should hurry up.”Dudian interrupted the old man’s threat.
The old man snorted and left. As he walked to the door he suddenly thought of something: “Next time you want to find us. You can find us in a hotel called ojem.”
“How much?”
“I have bought the hotel.”
“Alright.”
After the three left Dudian knew that the noise made by Urita and the others in the inner wall would soon reach their ears. When the war broke out he would be able to sit back and take advantage of the situation.
Such a lucky thing was planned by him. If there was a slight mistake in the process he would be crushed into pieces.
But now things were on the track of his control. The next thing to consider was whether the experts in the inner wall could withstand the attack of a master level expert.
“Young master, what should we do next?”
“Sleep, rest.”Dudian said.
He had been busy for several days. He was exhausted. He had to adjust his condition before the next big battle.
Two days later.
On a cloudy afternoon, a loud bang exploded in the inner wall of the imperial city.
The residents of the imperial city heard the loud sound. It was like an earthquake. Countless troops seemed to have been waiting for orders. They rushed out from the streets.
The residents of the Imperial City were stunned. They didn’t know what had happened.
Dudian who was sitting in the outer wall area received the news that there were unusual movements in the imperial city. There were two pieces of news. The first was a secret report from his intelligence network and the second was a request from the royal family to send reinforcements, he put on his armor and called Neuss: “The battle has begun. Prepare as I said!”
“I know, Young Master!”Neuss’s expression was solemn. He knew that this was a battle that would determine the fate of the city!
Dudian rushed to the inner wall alone.
A few hours later when he flew out of the city he saw a large number of soldiers gathered on the streets. The residents were scattered back to their houses. In the middle of the city high in the sky.., a few figures were fighting with each other.
“They are in a stalemate?”Dudian was surprised and happy to see this scene. He knew that the time difference was enough to determine the outcome of the battle. But he didn’t expect that the battle would continue when he arrived, it was not a one-sided situation as he had imagined!
He restrained his breath and landed in the city. He jumped on the roof of the building and rushed to the battlefield. He was ready to take a close look.

chapters.title: Chapter 775
chapters.content:
Chapter 775 – Chapter 765: Dragon Mother [ First Watch ]
A few minutes later, Dudian arrived at the center of the Imperial City. He stopped on the roof of a building and saw several ferocious figures fighting each other in the air, one of them was obviously the magic mark of the bat musician. His demonized body had a pair of huge bat-like wings. There were white spiral patterns on his body which looked like poisonous snakes. The one fighting with him was short and small, the body of the monster was like a mouse. Its head was long and its whole body was covered with shiny black hair. Its facial features couldn’t be seen clearly.
Obviously, one of them was a member of the wing clan of the giant wall while the other was an intruder.
The other half of the two were fighting in the sky. The heat was like the sun hanging in the sky. It was extremely dazzling. The demonized body was even more terrifying. One of the demonized bodies was a dragon. Dudian recognized that it was a member of the Dragon Clan at a glance, moreover, she seemed to be a female. She should be the mother of the Patriarch of the Dragon Clan, the dragon mother.
Her demonized body was bigger than Haisha’s that Dudian had seen before. Her dragon wings covered the sky and the Sun. Her body was covered with black and red scales. Her body seemed to be burning with flames, this scene looked very strange and detached from reality. But Dean had come into contact with some monsters that could spit fire and acid. He knew that some mutated creatures could produce high concentrations of fat or phosphite, that would bring fire, corrosion and other abilities.
For these creatures, spitting fire was as simple as human spit.
The one fighting with the dragon mother was a lizard-like monster with wings. It looked a bit like a western dragon in the old era. It was similar to the Dragon Mother’s dragon form, but the scales on their bodies were different in color and shape, moreover its abdomen was bulging. It looked bloated and its head was almost completely demonized. At first glance it was obvious that it was a monster’s head. It didn’t have any human features, only the skin around its ears and eyes showed a bit of human skin color.
“It’s hard to tell which is better?”Dudian recognized the lizard-like monster’s face. It looked like a hunchback old man. He was surprised to see that the dragon mother wasn’t at a disadvantage when fighting with him! Could it be that the dragon mother had been hiding her strength? In fact, she had long reached the level of a master!
“No wonder the battle could last for so long.”Dudian’s mood was complicated. He turned to look at the few battles on the ground. He saw that the buildings in the circle of the battle had been destroyed. The ground was covered in blood, there were corpses everywhere. There were soldiers and civilians who were on the verge of death. The three intruders formed a golden triangle to resist the attacks from all sides, there was a corpse lying on the ground. It was a young man whose face had been destroyed.
Dudian saw that it was one of the intruders. He looked at the other intruders. There were only five people left and one of them had been sacrificed.
However, there were a lot of corpses on the ground. There was only one intruder. The rest were left by the pioneers and ordinary soldiers.
The most eye-catching among the corpses were two extremely huge monsters. They were giant pythons that were dozens of meters long. Their bodies were covered with pitch-black scales. There were sharp thorns on their sides and backs, the softest part of the abdomen of a normal snake was a piece of armor-like hardened scales. It was extremely tough. Dudian recognized that it was not a monster but one of the most terrifying monsters. It was called the Titan Snake!
The sharp thorns on its body were filled with venom. It was as if it was bitten. Judging from its size, its hunting level was at least 90 or so. It was comparable to an inner wasteland level expert! If it was a level 90 legendary monster, its combat power would be even more terrifying. It would be several times more powerful than a non-named monster!
The other monster was like a giant ape. There were several ten meters long ivory-like bone thorns protruding from its back. It was lying on the ground. There was a large pool of blood under its body. It was also a non-named monster but its hunting level was over 100. Its combat power was terrifying.
Dudian knew that it was a monster that had been tamed by the Monster Research Institute. It was impossible for the intruders to bring such a huge monster to the central area of the Imperial City. However, the two monsters had died, however, only one of the intruders had died. It was obvious that the dragon mother didn’t use her full strength. It was very likely that the intruders were the ones who had killed the monsters.
“The last time the coffin was taken away, Dragon Mother didn’t show the power to fight against the master. Either she knew that the coffin was fake or she didn’t have the ability to use such power. These families can not be underestimated…”Dudian’s eyes flashed.
He looked around. He found the rock demon who was at the meeting in the palace. The previous head of the Rock clan was dead and his chest was pierced. No one had the time to retrieve his body.
Without the Rock Demon, the Rock clan would have no more experts.
Dudian frowned. The Rock Demon and the mother dragon were experts from the same era. It seemed that their strength was much weaker than the mother dragon.
Dudian heard a shout. He turned his head and saw the only daughter of the wall master, Princess Urita, commanding the army and pioneers to attack the three intruders on the ground, she looked anxious as if she wanted to deal with the three intruders so that she could support the dragon mother and the wings race. However, the Fat Man was like a monster in human form. His attack power was abnormally strong and his endurance was extraordinary. No matter how the pioneers attacked, they would always rush up to block them.
It seemed that the pioneers had suffered a loss before. They didn’t dare to be knocked down by him.
“It seems that it is difficult to be a piece of iron when disaster strikes.”Dudian’s eyes revealed a trace of indifference. It was easy to see from the side, the pioneers who were surrounding the invaders didn’t have the murderous intent to face death. If they were to rush forward without fear of death, no matter how strong the three invaders were, they wouldn’t be able to resist. After all, the number of people was overwhelming, moreover, there were two marshals of the military and the dean of the monastery. There was no reason why they couldn’t kill the three of them.
But from the looks of their battle, it was like a dragonfly skimming the surface of the water. They didn’t dare to fight head on.
The bravest ones were the pioneers who were wearing the military armor. They were completely abiding by the orders of urita. The pioneers of the three families and the monastery seemed to be a bit dispirited.
Dudian observed the details of the surroundings. Suddenly a whistling sound came from the sky. Bang! Dudian saw a black shadow fall into the ground. It hit the ground and destroyed a broken building, the Black Shadow rushed out again. It was the dragon mother.
The moment she flew out of the dust, the salamander monster swooped down and hit her again. It instantly suppressed her.

chapters.title: Chapter 776
chapters.content:
Chapter 776 – Chapter 766: Change [ Second Update ]
Dudian’s eyelids twitched. He was ready to retreat at any time.
The reason why he dared to come close to watch the battle was because the battle would last for hours. Both sides had no time to care about him so he dared to take the risk to come close.
But at the moment, Dragon mother was suppressed. It seemed that she was losing. If the battle ended in a short time, it would be dangerous for him to stay here.
“Dragon Mother!”Ulita’s expression changed when she saw the dragon mother being shot down. She knew that the key to victory in this battle was still the dragon mother. If she lost, she would lose without a doubt!
The hunchbacked old man swooped down and charged into the dust fog. With a few loud bangs, the ground shook violently. At the same time, a figure wrapped in the dust fog flew out at high speed and passed through seven to eight buildings. The sturdy buildings were like pieces of paper that were easily penetrated, half of the wings of the magic dragon stretched out from the broken buildings. It trembled as it slowly climbed up. It was the Mother Dragon.
Her wings flashed. The gravel and dust on her body were blown away. Dudian suddenly noticed that the faint red light emitted from her scales had weakened. It looked like there were only black scales left. Moreover, the heat in her body.., it seemed that it continued to drop. It was only slightly higher than the other inner wasteland level experts.
Dudian’s eyes moved. It seemed that the dragon mother had used some secret technique to temporarily increase her strength. It was a treasure that could temporarily increase her strength, it seemed that if his plan was successful he would be able to control the inner wall. He would have to thoroughly investigate the secret techniques of the Dragon Clan.
Although such a secret technique might cost a lot but it could turn defeat into victory at the critical moment.
At this moment, the hunchbacked old man rapidly closed in, not giving the dragon mother any chance to catch her breath. The dragon mother continued to retreat. The battle went from being evenly matched to one-sided suppression. The hunchbacked old man seemed to have endless energy, and the more he fought, the braver he became, the dragon mother, on the other hand, gradually became weaker and powerless to resist, and the wounds on her body grew more and more.
After several minutes, with a crack, the hunchbacked old man’s sharp claws suddenly reached out and grabbed the dragon mother’s wings, twisting and breaking them abruptly. The dragon mother was in so much pain that her eyebrows were tightly knitted together, and the dragon swords in her hands quickly stabbed toward the hunchbacked old man, the move was exquisite like a silver arc light. However the old man’s action was very fast. He released the broken wings and used his claws to hit her wrist. He went around the sword light and cut her palm.
The sword in one of her hands fell to the ground. The dragon mother took the opportunity to retreat but the old man was close to her.
Dudian saw that the dragon mother had no strength to turn back. There was a strange feeling in his heart. He was relieved but also felt some pity and sigh. He didn’t know why these emotions appeared, perhaps it was because she was struggling that it was easy for people to sympathize with her. After all, humans were extremely contradictory creatures. It seemed to be an instinct to sympathize with the weak, and this instinct would eventually be replaced by “Reason”.
The other pioneers on the land saw that the situation of the Mother Dragon was dangerous. They became anxious. They attacked Fatty and the graceful woman. It was inevitable that they would be careless. Although the pressure on Fatty and the other two had increased, however, the pioneers were killed one after another.
Urita’s face was ugly as she jumped down from the tower. Black liquid flowed out of her body and entered her magic body.
Dudian noticed the battlefield from the corner of his eyes. He saw Urita’s magic body. His eyes focused. Urita’s magic body was a bit eye-catching. It wasn’t ugly but quite the opposite, most of her body was still in the shape of a human. She had white skin and long legs but her hands had turned into sharp claws. Her legs were the same. There was a snake-like tail growing out of the armor behind her buttocks, a pair of hairy ears grew out of her hair. Other than that, her abdomen and thighs were not demonized. She was still in the shape of a human.
However, her speed was extremely agile. In the blink of an eye, she was in front of Fatty and the others.
Dudian saw from the heat source that the heat wave in her body was maintained at the peak of the wilderness. However, every time she attacked, the heat would burst out like an explosion and instantly reach the inner wilderness level, it was clear that her control of power was extremely precise. Her combat ability was not inferior to the commander of the military or even stronger!
Moreover, her demonic body had not been fully transformed. Generally speaking, the more demonic bodies that covered her body, the higher the degree of demonic transformation and the stronger her power would be. And the demonic transformation of an inner barren level expert had reached over 80% of her body, except for her head, all the other parts of her body had been demonized. As for the ruler, like that hunchbacked old man, even more than half of his head had been demonized. Unless he deliberately controlled the degree of demonization, otherwise, it was the same.
Since Urita was participating in the battle, she naturally went all out. However, her body only had a small amount of demonization. It was really strange!
The strangest thing was that Dudian had never seen such a demonized shape. In his understanding of high-level magic marks, there didn’t seem to be any such shape!
With URITA’s addition, the pressure on Fatty and the other two increased sharply. Very soon, urita’s claw injured the graceful woman’s arm. The other pioneers found a gap and concentrated on attacking the graceful woman, the Golden Triangle of the three soon revealed a flaw. It was only a matter of time before it was broken.
Dudian saw Urita’s agile body. He knew from intelligence that Urita was not old. She was two years younger than him but she was much stronger than him, he estimated that she could compete with Aisha!
But it was no wonder. Her father was the lord of the giant wall and had all kinds of resources. Dudian suspected that her magic marks were not from the monsters near the giant wall but from other places or even from the Kingdom of God, it was probably a legendary magic mark or even a higher level magic mark!
While Urita was leading the pioneers to attack, the situation on the other side suddenly changed.
Most of Dudian’s attention was still on the Battle of the Dragon Mother. She was unable to resist the attack of the old man. She was forced into the battle circle and her injuries were increasing, dudian felt that the battle would end in five minutes at most. The dragon mother suddenly burst out an amazing aura and forced the old man to retreat.
The old man didn’t think that she would have such strong strength. He coughed out a mouthful of blood and looked at her in shock.
Dudian couldn’t help but narrow his eyes as he saw the shocking changes that happened to the dragon mother.

chapters.title: Chapter 777
chapters.content:
Chapter 777 – Chapter 767: Explosion! [ Two-In-One Chapter ]
The heat on the mother dragon’s body rapidly disappeared. At the same time, the black scales on her body gradually transformed into a white crystal that emitted white mist. The speed of the transformation was very fast, the giant wings on her back turned into two ice-like crystal wings in the blink of an eye.
“Ice Crystal?”Dudian was shocked. It looked like his right arm which had been frozen. Could it be that the dragon mother had ice blood disease? Moreover, she seemed to be able to control her own body to transform into ice crystals?
The old man saw the mutation of the Dragon Mother’s body. He let out an angry roar and suddenly attacked. His speed increased by another level as if he wanted to interrupt her transformation.
However, the body of the dragon mother was already more than half crystallized, and the heat in her body had also dropped to the freezing point. She was like a dying person, extremely light. She let out a high-pitched Phoenix cry and charged forward, the demonized ice dragon claw tore out fiercely, and the air seemed to be torn apart. White mist surrounded her body, and the Dragon Claw hit the hunchbacked old man’s sharp claw. In the next moment, the hunchbacked old man withdrew his hand like lightning, the old man’s Claw was surrounded by cold air. It seemed to be frozen.
The Old Man’s face was ugly. He immediately retreated.
The dragon mother took advantage of the situation and chased after the old man. She forced the old man to retreat. He didn’t dare to fight and could only Dodge in all directions.
Dudian’s eyelid twitched. He didn’t expect the situation to be reversed in an instant. The power that the dragon mother had displayed was enough to force a ruler to avoid her attack.
During the process of the pursuit, the area of ice crystals on the body of the dragon mother became larger and larger until all parts of her body turned into crystal ice. She looked like a goddess of war carved out of ice and snow. The heat on her body had completely disappeared, even when she was fiercely attacking, she didn’t emit any heat.
Dudian looked at the two who were fast as lightning. The roles were switched in the blink of an eye. He was surprised. was there such power hidden in the ice blood disease? How did she control it?
After his right arm was crystallized, no matter how he controlled it, his right arm was always ice crystal. He couldn’t restore normal human skin. However, he didn’t see any signs of ice blood syndrome from the dragon mother during the previous meeting, this made him suspect that the dragon mother wasn’t suffering from ice blood syndrome. It was just that the ice crystal body was so real. It was exactly the same as his right arm.
“However, she has only revealed her strength so far. There should be a lot of sequelae…”Dudian thought. At the moment, the Mother Dragon’s combat power was slightly higher than that of the master. She was considered as a strong existence among the masters, this power was completely superior to the other two families. The Rock Demon was the strongest of the Rock clan. It had died in battle. It meant that it didn’t have the power of the Mother Dragon. It was the same for the strongest of the wings clan, with only the power of the internal desolate realm, it was not considered the top of the internal desolate realm. The dragon mother was on a completely different level from them.
If she could control this power freely, there would be no possibility for the rock tribe and the wing tribe to exist.
This could only mean that this power would bring a huge sequela to her, and she could not use it at any time. It was very likely that she would have to pay a huge price if she used it once!
“If I can directly exterminate this group of intruders, it will save me a lot of trouble. After she kills them, I think I will also fall into a weak period of sequela. At that time, the remaining people…” Dudian couldn’t help but look at the battlefield of Urita and the others. He saw Urita leading all the pioneers to fiercely besiege Fatty and the other three intruders. The graceful woman was the most seriously injured. Her chest was stabbed and showed a bloody scar.
Fatty who had been unhurt all this time was also injured. There were several purple and black patches on his skin. It seemed that he had been poisoned. His actions were not as fast as before. He didn’t have time to care about the graceful woman.
“The strongest of the wing clan, Urita and the two military experts. There are a total of four experts from the inner wall. The rest of the pioneers and experts from the outer wall… There are… seventeen, eighteen!”Dudian’s eyes swept over the battlefield, he observed the situation on the field and quickly thought. If the dragon mother could kill the intruders, then the inner wall would be at its weakest.
By the time the dragon mother recovered, he had almost no hope of conquering the inner wall. After all, the hidden strength of the dragon mother had frightened him. It was far beyond his expectations.
Therefore, he had to make a move when the battle was over. He couldn’t give them time to recuperate.
However, from the current situation, even with Aisha’s help, it would be difficult to deal with so many pioneers.
Dudian didn’t care about the ordinary pioneers. With the limit of his splitter’s magic marks, even if there were twice as many ordinary pioneers, he wouldn’t put them in his eyes. No one would be able to withstand his sharp attacks, he would die if he touched them.
However, the four inner wasteland level experts were a bit troublesome. Aisha’s strength could only restrain one of them. Moreover, these people weren’t stupid. Once they fought, they would be aware of Aisha’s special situation, they could let one of them delay Aisha while the other three would kill Dudian.
Although Aisha’s current strength was at the top level of the inner wasteland level, but she lost in her consciousness. It was very difficult to deal with an inner wasteland level expert in a short time. Moreover, unless it was a last resort.., dudian still wanted to prevent Haisha from taking action as much as possible. But in the current situation, there were only four inner barren level experts left. It was meaningless to let Haisha take care of one of them.
With his current strength, it was too difficult to deal with all the experts in the inner wall. It was almost impossible. But once he missed this opportunity, it would be even more difficult to let the dragon mother recover her strength.
Moreover, he didn’t know when the Master of the Abyss would return. Once he appeared, Dudian could only slip out of the giant wall and live in the wilderness. He didn’t dare to step near the giant wall.
So there was only one opportunity in front of him!
Dudian was thinking while paying attention to the movements of the two sides. The old man was being pursued by the Mother Dragon. His body was torn by the claws of the dragon. Some parts of his body even had frostbite, the old man’s blood vessels were sealed. It was almost impossible to reverse the situation.
Dudian knew that the old man didn’t have any trump cards. This meant that the dragon mother would win!
There was a trace of ruthlessness in his eyes. He no longer hesitated. He rushed into the battlefield and used his magic body. He turned into a terrifying monster with sharp blades all over its body. He rushed towards the direction of the battlefield.
Urita noticed the astonishing aura coming from behind. She turned her head and saw that the monster was Dudian. There was a trace of surprise in her eyes. She recognized Dudian’s magic body, she didn’t expect that a resident of the outer wall would be able to get the magic marks of the legendary splitter! Moreover, there seemed to be some differences between Dudian’s magic body and Grand Tutor’s. However, she couldn’t tell the difference at the moment. It seemed that there were more sharp blades on her body and the luster of each part of the shell was slightly different.
“Where is Aisha?”Urita pulled out from the battle and retreated to the outer edge. She was anxious as she approached Dudian.
Dudian stopped in front of her and said: “She will be here soon. I will come to support her first. Not Good…”his pupils shrank as he looked at Urita in horror.
Urita’s heart jumped. She quickly turned her head. The battle in the encirclement was still going on. The three intruders didn’t break out of the encirclement of the pioneers. She suddenly had an ominous feeling in her heart, a murderous aura burst out from behind her.
Urita turned her head in horror. Dudian’s fair and handsome face was full of murderous intent. All the sharp limbs of his body were attacking her head and chest.
Puff!
The sound of a cut was heard.
Urita’s body flew out. She was sent flying in the air for a few rounds before landing on one foot. Her body was like a civet. Her eyes were red as she stared at Dudian in anger.
There was a shallow scratch on her neck but it had cut through her neck artery. There were several bloody holes on her chest, arms, shoulders and other places but there was no fatal injury.
Urita raised her hand to cover the artery of her neck. She clenched her teeth as her eyes were filled with hatred. How could she not understand that Dudian had betrayed her and attacked her at this critical moment to help the intruder!
She was especially angry because of this. She wanted to tear Dudian apart with her eyes.
Dudian’s heart sank when he saw that she had dodged the fatal attack. He felt a trace of fear in his heart. He had seen Ulita’s quick reaction but he didn’t expect her reaction speed to be so fast, in such a short moment, she was able to avoid his sneak attack at such a close distance. It was simply terrifying. If they were to fight head on, even if his body was full of sharp weapons, it would be difficult to hurt her!
He didn’t continue to pursue Urita but immediately changed direction and rushed towards the encirclement of the three intruders.
The surrounding pioneers were focused on attacking the three intruders. When they saw Dudian coming over, they didn’t think much. But when Dudian approached them, they immediately attacked. In the blink of an eye, several pioneers were caught off guard and were injured by the sneak attack, two of them were beheaded on the spot and died.
Fatty thought that Dudian was here to help them. There was anger in his eyes. But the next moment when he saw Dudian’s attack, he was stunned for a moment, he immediately approached Dudian.
“Inform your boss to retreat immediately. I have left a trap under the wall of sighs which leads to the outer wall. I can help you to cover the rear.”Dudian joined the circle of three people and repelled the surrounding pioneers, at the same time he whispered: “Leave immediately. That Dragon Mother has used a special method to increase her strength. But it should only last for a short time. After this time it won’t be too late to kill her back.”
Fatty looked up and saw the ice-crystallized dragon mother in the distance. His face changed.
“Gather in my territory. I will leave first. Hurry up.”Dudian didn’t wait for his reply. He rushed out of the circle and escaped into the distance.
Urita saw Dudian escape. She clenched her teeth and shouted to the few pioneers who were chasing after dudian: “Don’t care about him. Kill them first!”
The few pioneers stopped and continued to surround Fatty and the others.
Urita also joined the battle. She was angry and angry. The reason why she didn’t let anyone chase after Dudian was because she was concerned that there was aisha behind dudian. Moreover, Dudian had shown his strength earlier, he wasn’t inferior to the military God at the peak of the wilderness. If they wanted to kill Dudian, they had to send at least two experts from the inner wilderness level. Otherwise, they would be sent to their deaths. Once they sent people to kill Dudian, the three intruders would easily escape, she was worried that Dudian would deliberately lure her to kill him to restrain their strength so that the intruders could escape.
In the blink of an eye, Dudian rushed seven or eight miles away. He jumped to a roof and stopped. He was relieved to see that no one was chasing him. He looked at the battle in front of him. He believed that the intruders should have a way to break out of the encirclement, once they caught up with him, they would be able to act according to his plan.
A few minutes later.
As Dudian had expected, fatty sent the news to the old man. The old man held back the Dragon Mother. Fatty suddenly burst out and tore a gap in the encirclement. He led the other two to kill their way out.
But halfway through the fight, Urita and others saw through their intentions. They fiercely attacked. The graceful woman was killed on the spot. Her head was separated from her body.
Fatty was angry and sad. He didn’t irrational to avenge the graceful woman. He took another person and rushed out of the encirclement towards Dudian’s direction.
Dudian saw the situation and immediately turned to run. He couldn’t wait for them to catch up, especially the old man who was chasing after him. Once he brought the dragon mother, no matter who they were, they could easily catch up to him and kill him.
Dudian used his magic wings and rushed forward. In the blink of an eye, he rushed out of the imperial city and flew into the wilderness.
After flying at full speed for more than an hour, Dudian arrived at the wall of Sighs. At this moment, there were seven or eight limiter patrolling on the wall of sighs. They immediately issued a warning when they saw Dudian flying over.
Dudian landed and quickly killed all the guards on the wall.
He took out a signal tube that hunters usually used outside the giant wall. He was a bit nervous as he quietly waited.
After a moment, a few black shadows appeared in the distant sky and quickly approached. They were the few intruders led by the old man. However there were only three of them. The fifth one who was fighting with the wing clan’s experts was missing, there were only the old man, the burly man, and the Fatty.
The three of them were in a sorry state because of their injuries and the smell of blood.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. He shouted as they approached: “Are there any pursuers?”
The old man panted slightly. His eyes were deep as he looked at dudian: “They are not far behind.”
“Is the person who is fighting with you coming?”Dudian continued to ask.
“No.”The old man’s answer was very short.
Dudian looked at the wilderness at the end of the horizon. He saw some black dots approaching. He looked up at the three: “Go to my territory first. I will kill them after I recover.”
The old man didn’t say anything. He nodded and flew over the wall of Sighs.
Dudian flew behind them. After flying for thousands of meters, he pulled the signal tube in his hand. A red smoke bomb rushed into the sky.
The old man turned his head. His eyes were filled with killing intent: “What Is This?”
“Signal bomb.”Dudian said without hesitation: “I told you that I will cover the rear. They are coming. My people will delay them while they pass through here. They should be able to stop a few of them. As for the rest, you should be able to easily deal with them. They don’t dare to chase too deep.”
Dragon mother didn’t chase after them but the others did. Dudian estimated that Urita and the others were anxious. This was the only chance they had to kill the intruders and take back the god’s corpse but he had ruined it.
The old man looked at Dudian but didn’t say anything. He adjusted his breathing and tried to recover as much as possible.
They were about to reach the mountain when they heard an earth-shaking roar. It was as if a mountain had fallen from the sky and hit the ground.
Dudian looked back. There was a huge dust cloud in the direction of the wall of Sighs. It seemed that the explosives buried there had been detonated.

chapters.title: Chapter 778
chapters.content:
Chapter 778 – Chapter 768: Destruction -Lfirstiwatchatch ]
The Old Man’s heart skipped a beat when he heard the loud explosion. He looked back and saw that the wall of sighs was filled with a huge dust cloud. The dust cloud rose to hundreds of meters high in an instant, it could be seen from dozens of miles away.
The three of them were shocked. They didn’t expect that dudian would set such a dangerous trap. Fortunately, it wasn’t used to deal with them.
There was a trace of coldness in their eyes as they looked at dudian. It was obvious that the man wasn’t an ordinary person.
In the blink of an eye, Dudian, the old man and others flew to the top of the mountain. Dudian was the first to land. He was relieved as he didn’t see Neuss and the others, he quietly walked into the temple. The servants of light who were stationed outside the temple saluted to Dudian. After Dudian entered the temple they couldn’t help but look up at the wall of Sighs, they could faintly hear the sound of thunder rolling on the ground. It was hard to imagine what had happened.
The old man and others followed Dudian into the temple. The old man was relieved. He knew that the experts of the family weren’t chasing after them. There were only a few ordinary pioneers and several experts from the inner wilderness, the strength of the traps left by Dudian was enough to make them suffer. They wouldn’t be able to catch up to him in a short time. Even if they did, he would be able to deal with them.
After he entered the temple, he immediately found a chair and sat down. He took out the medicine from his backpack and took it. He didn’t talk to Dudian.
The burly man and fatty looked at dudian. They wanted to say something but held back.
They could guess that Dudian had spared no effort to help them because he was worried that they would die. There was no one to help him kill the experts from the inner wall. Both sides were using each other’s relationship.
“You should quickly heal your injuries. Once your injuries recover, you should immediately kill them back. Otherwise, the next attack will be even more difficult.”Dudian quickly said to the three.
The old man’s lips moved slightly. He wanted to say something but quickly stopped. He closed his eyes and tried to heal his injuries.
Fatty saw his reaction and immediately understood his thoughts. He didn’t talk to Dudian but took out the healing medicine for himself.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he saw the trio’s urgent treatment. He sat on the throne and naturally placed his palm on the armrest. He touched the groove on the inner side of the armrest and gently pressed it.
The sound of cracking echoed throughout the temple. It was so soft that even hunters might not be able to hear it. However the trio’s hearing was very sharp. They immediately sensed the abnormal situation and looked up.
In the next moment, on the pillars of the Divine Hall, on the walls, on the ground, and other places, a pitch-black hole appeared. Water Arrows shot out from the hole and shot into the hall below the stairs.
The three people’s expressions changed. Although they did not know what the reason was, they did not need to think to know that it was definitely not a good thing.
Just as the three people were about to get up and Dodge, suddenly, their bodies froze. They stood or sat on the ground, as if they were in a daze.
The old man was ‘stunned’for a moment. He angrily stood up from the chair. The wings on his back grew out and floated in the air. There was anger in his eyes as he turned to look at the throne.
He saw Dudian sitting on the throne sinking down.
“You Trash, prepare to die. I have killed your seventh brother. Do you want to go back? Be Good and die!”Dudian shouted as he looked at the old man in contempt.
The old man’s pupils shrank as he heard Dudian’s words. He was so angry that his eyes were about to explode. It was obvious that they had been deceived by Dudian. But the most important thing was.., the seventh brother who was in charge of the return trip was dead. No wonder he had seen Dudian’s second auction of the seventh brother’s fingers. He was puzzled but didn’t dare to think about it, old Seven was obviously dead.
Dudian was using old Seven’s corpse to pretend that old seven was in his hands!
“Ah Ah Ah…”the old man was so angry that he was about to go crazy. He roared and rushed towards dudian, “Go…”before the word “Word”was spoken, a fire spread to the entire temple, boom! It was as if a hole had been pierced through the sky. The sky was covered with flames and thick smoke.
If one looked down from the sky, they would see that the entire sacred mountain had exploded!
The height of the mountain was more than 400 meters. It was like a volcano had exploded. The destructive explosion was so loud that it shook the sky. The streets more than ten miles away from the mountain were swept away by the strong wind, the pedestrians wandering on the streets were instantly blown away. Some of the fluttering flags of the Chamber of Commerce were even broken by the wind. Countless tiny pieces of gravel and metal pieces shot out. Some of the pedestrians wandering on the streets were shot through the heads by the gravel, or their bodies. Destructive heat waves spread out, sweeping up thick fog and countless dust into the streets.
With the entire sacred mountain as the center, it was as if a magnitude 12 earthquake had erupted. The ground rumbled and the dust mixed with flames engulfed everything like a beast tide, sweeping up all the streets.
The explosion only lasted for an instant. The moment the explosion occurred, the entire mountain was instantly destroyed. It was like an exquisite porcelain had suddenly shattered. The mountain was blasted into ashes and the destructive power of the apocalypse spread out, the Knights of light who were patrolling around the mountain didn’t even have time to react before they were engulfed by the explosion. Their bodies were shattered and evaporated.
The aftershock of the explosion spread quickly. It was more than ten times more violent than the explosion of the wall of Sighs. At this moment, everyone in the commercial district felt the ground shaking and trembling, they also heard the furious explosion of the thunder god from afar. Everyone stopped what they were doing and looked in the direction of the source of the sound in shock.
“This…”in an office in the military, the Teacup on Richelieu’s desk fell. The tea had soaked the documents that he had just finished. However, his eyes were staring blankly at the direction of Wutuo Mountain outside the window, and the corners of his mouth trembled slightly.
With a whoosh, a large number of stones were ejected from the explosion of the Divine Mountain in the dense fog and flames. One of the black oval objects flew out together with the crushed stones, after flying two to three hundred meters from the top of the sacred mountain, it fell to the ground in a parabolic trajectory and hit a castle. It pierced through the castle and landed in the courtyard of the castle. It rolled for more than ten rounds before it stopped, black smoke was coming out.
It was not a rock, but a five to six-meter-tall oval-shaped metal ball. However, one end of the metal ball broke.
When the metal ball stopped, a hound in the courtyard immediately ran over and looked curiously at the metal ball that was emitting a scorching temperature. As if it had smelled something, the hound moved closer to the broken end.

chapters.title: Chapter 779
chapters.content:
Chapter 779 – Chapter 769: Attack [ Second Watch ]
A sharp claw suddenly stretched out from the edge of the crack.
A terrifying shadow covered with sharp blades emerged from the crack. The Bloodhound whimpered in fear and ran away.
The sinister figure was Dean. He slowly climbed out of the metal ball. Every time he climbed out, he couldn’t help but cough. Blood splattered on the ground. He was in so much pain that he slightly grinned, he dragged his body out of the metal ball. He turned over and lay on the ground. He was gasping for breath.
The drowsiness hit him. He struggled to open his eyes and rest for a moment. He got up from the ground. His body was shaking and several sharp blades on his back were broken. They stabbed into his body and caused a lot of injuries, the biggest injury was caused by a piece of metal in his chest. It pierced through his enchanted shell and stuck on his ribs. He was bleeding non-stop. Fortunately he had entered the metal ball and used his magic body, otherwise, this piece of metal would have been more than just stuck in his ribs. It might have pierced through his chest and killed him on the spot.
He took in a cold breath to relieve the burning pain on his body. He looked up at the direction of the explosion in the distance, and a trace of fear appeared in his eyes. He didn’t expect the destructive power of the explosion on Mount Utopia to be so terrifying, when he activated the explosive device, he had already sunk into the protective cabin below on his throne. This protective cabin was made of tungsten steel and was extremely tough. However, it was pierced through by the shockwaves of the explosion and penetrated into the aftershock, it almost took half of his life. One had to know that at that time, he was still in the state of full protection of his demon body. If he were to be hit by the explosion without even realizing it, he did not dare to imagine what kind of outcome he would have.
He thought of the three stooped old men. At the last moment when he sank, other than the stooped old man breaking free from the electric current, the fatty and the other burly man seemed to still be in the state of paralysis from the electric shock.
It was almost impossible to make a defensive reaction in that state. Their consciousness was stiff, and even if they woke up in time, it would be difficult for them to react.
Moreover, the power of the explosion of the gunpowder in Mount Wutuo had exceeded his expectations. He had thought that it would be good enough to inflict serious injuries on the three of them, but judging from the current situation, the chances of the three of them surviving were less than 10% !
He had originally intended to expose the death of the black-robed youth to the stooped old man in order to infuriate him and make him chase after him. Then, he would lead him to the second base.., the wind and solar power stations there were twice as many as here, and the explosives stored there were more than three times as many as here. There was a high chance of killing the stooped old man, but from the current situation.., there was probably no need for that anymore.
Now that he thought about it, he still felt a lingering fear. After all, he was not an explosives expert, so his estimation of explosives was not that accurate. Especially with such a large amount of explosives, even a professional explosives expert.., might not be able to estimate how much damage it could cause. After all, there were no advanced instruments from the old era here, so they could evaluate the specific data.
If there were more explosives in the mountain or if he didn’t prepare the tungsten steel protective cabin, he would have died in the explosion and died together with the three intruders.
Fortunately, such an accident didn’t happen. Otherwise, he would have wanted to cry but no tears would have come out.
Dudian looked at the distant explosion that was gradually subsiding. He slowly stood up. His muscles pulled the metal plate on his chest. He slightly bared his teeth. His body’s demonization was lifted and he returned to human appearance, he raised his hand to cover the huge metal piece that was stuck in his chest. He pulled it out. Puff! He felt a sharp tearing pain. He almost cried out in pain.
Fortunately, the intense pain was only temporary. He clenched his teeth and controlled the blood flow in his body. He stopped the blood flow in his chest. He felt as if his chest was being burned by a flame.
However, he had experienced this kind of intense pain many times. He took a few deep breaths to get used to it.
He dragged his feet and walked in the direction of Mount Utopia. His pupils entered the clairvoyance state as he searched for the figures of the three intruders. Although the power of the explosion was enough to kill them, he did not see their corpses, however, he could not relax just like that.
The explosion came very suddenly and ended very quickly. The gunpowder was burned out and the curtain fell in an instant. There were no mountains in the Utoto Mountain. There was only smoke and dust rising like a high mountain, there was a faint bloody flame coming out of it. It looked terrifying.
Dudian walked to the square in front of the mountain. His eyes penetrated through the thick fog. He saw the destructive traces of the terrible explosion. The area around Utoto Mountain was completely sunken, both the square and the castle-like buildings were razed to the ground. The streets more than 200 meters away were in a mess. The roads were full of rubble and thick dust. There were passers-by who were screaming on the ground.
Dudian’s scalp went numb. Although he was standing on the ground but he could picture the whole Utoto mountain completely disappearing. The ground at the foot of the mountain had collapsed into a huge crater, smoke was emitted from the soil. The land had been baptized by the explosives. It was charred black as if human skin had been burnt.
There was nothing left except for the crater.
Many buildings, temples, laboratories and the Goddess Monument were gone. It seemed that they had never existed.
It was the first time that Dudian had witnessed such terrible destruction. The first thought that came to his mind was that the world had activated nuclear weapons in the old era. Black gunpowder alone had such a terrifying effect. No wonder after the nuclear explosion.., there was no peaceful place in the world. It was like the ruins outside the giant wall. After more than 300 years the nuclear radiation in the air was still silently attacking the survivors’bodies.
He took a deep breath and looked around. It was very likely that the three of them were blown away and landed in a distant place.
He activated his magic wings and rushed into the thick smoke. He squinted his eyes and looked around. At the same time he was alert to the surroundings in case of a sneak attack. Four to five minutes later, Dudian found a figure with a limited heat source on the west side of the mountain. He rushed over and saw the figure lying in the rubble, it was the old man!
At the moment the old man seemed to have fainted. His body was covered with scars. There were large and small stones and metal pieces embedded in his body. One of his legs was broken and his hair was burnt black.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he looked at the old man. He took out his dagger and threw it at the old man’s throat.
The dagger stabbed into his throat and was blocked by the magic scale on his neck.
Dudian saw that the old man didn’t wake up. He wasn’t sure if he was playing dead. He approached the old man in doubt. The old man’s body was deeply demonized. His broken limbs were restored as he activated the magic body again, when he was close to a certain distance, he suddenly swooped down and cut the old man’s body.

chapters.title: Chapter 780
chapters.content:
