Chapter 780 – : Chapter 770: Kill The Dragon Clan [ Two In One Chapter ]
Dudian was extremely nervous at the moment he took the risk. He was afraid that the old man would pretend to be unconscious and deliberately lure him closer.
But he had to make a move. He only had one chance. If he really fainted then his caution would be stupid.
Whoosh!
Dudian’s sharp limbs approached the old man in an instant. All of them pointed at the weak points of his body. His heart was in his throat. The next moment, Puff Puff Puff sounds were heard, all of his sharp limbs hit the old man but the scales on the old man’s body were abnormally tough. It was beyond Dudian’s imagination. They were much tougher than steel.
His sharp limbs barely pierced into his body but didn’t penetrate through.
At this time, the old man seemed to wake up from the pain. He opened his eyes.
Dudian’s heart almost stopped when he saw the old man open his eyes. The difference in strength between the two made him feel the danger of death. He roared and crazily waved all of his sharp limbs.
“Die Ah Ah…”he roared. His scythe-like limbs turned into countless afterimages as he crazily shot out. The speed was so fast that it was only a shadow. He didn’t know how long he continued to attack, dudian slowly woke up when he felt a wave of extremely weak feeling in his heart. He slowly stopped waving his sharp limbs. He looked at the old man who was standing in front of him, he saw that his body was broken and there was no sound.
There were bloody holes in his throat, chest, head and other fatal parts. Especially his neck. It was almost completely broken.
Dudian was stunned for a long time. He couldn’t help but raise a few sharp limbs to stab into his body. He looked at his body several times and finally confirmed that he was dead. His heart had stopped beating, through the x-ray vision he could see that his heart had been cut open and the spine in his neck had been cut off. He couldn’t be more dead.
The Master of the giant wall had died.
He had died in front of him.
Dudian had an unreal feeling. Everything seemed to be much easier and smoother than he had expected.
The second base that he had prepared for this was the next trap. It was completely useless.
He gasped for breath. After a long time he slowly regained his calm. He waved his arm and cut off the old man’s head. He lifted the old man’s head and flew into the sky above the explosion, he looked around for the two remaining intruders. Although there were no other high-level heat emitted from the scene but it couldn’t be ruled out that they had hidden the heat.
He wanted to see them alive or dead. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to calm down.
Half an hour later, Dudian finally found the bodies of the other two intruders. However, it was only the remains of the Fatty’s head, the arm of the burly man, and his big knife.
Dudian flew back to the broken headless body of the old man. Now he was basically sure that all three intruders had died.
It was unbelievable that these intruders who gave the inner wall a headache were killed by him.
However, in order to prepare for the day he had mobilized almost all the resources of the outer wall. The amount of black gunpowder in the mountain was more than a thousand tons. It took a lot of manpower to mine and produce it, moreover, it was a crucial step to lure the intruders here. Any mistake could lead to another situation.
The purpose of detonating the wall of sighs was not only to stop the pursuit of the inner wall, but also to make the three of them relax their vigilance.
One had to know that the impact of intentionally defending and unintentionally resisting were two completely different levels.
Whoosh!
He let out a light breath and felt a wave of exhaustion. His physical strength seemed to be completely exhausted. He sat on the ground and rested to recover. At the same time, he took out another signal tube from his bag and pulled it open, a green smoke bomb shot into the sky.
A moment later, the sound of horse hooves echoed. Neuss led a group of knights of light to rush over.
Neuss and the Knights of light were shocked as they looked at the ruins around dudian. They couldn’t believe it. If it wasn’t for the outline of the buildings around them then they would know where it was located, they couldn’t imagine that this huge pit was Mount Utoa which was full of holy flowers.
Neuss saw Dudian’s pale face and immediately ran over: “Master, how are you? Are The Intruders Dead?”
“Yes.”Dudian gasped: “Send people to seal this place and find the pieces of their bodies. Also send people to bring Aisha. I will go to the inner wall later.”
Neuss was relieved to hear that the intruders were dead. He knew that the main purpose of this plan was to kill the intruders but he didn’t expect.., he didn’t carry out the last step of the plan as Dudian had told him. He looked at the horrible wound on Dudian’s chest. He took out the medicine and antidote from his wallet, he asked: “Haven’t the intruders been dealt with? Why do you want to go to the inner wall? Why Don’t you wait until your injury is healed?”
Dudian took the medicine and applied it, he said: “The experts in the inner wall are seriously injured. I have to kill her before her injury is healed. Otherwise, it will be difficult to find such an opportunity in the future. If I don’t come back then it is very likely that I won’t be able to come back. You have to let Sergei and the others leave the Holy See. They can live in anonymity.”
Neuss felt his heart throb as he heard Dudian’s last words, he couldn’t help but say: “Master, don’t say such discouraging words. You will definitely come back. You are the only person who has escaped from Thorn Flower prison for hundreds of years. What is this little difficulty?”
Dudian’s mouth twitched as he smiled bitterly. Thorn Flower’s escape was nothing to him. But it seemed that Neuss had left a deep impression in his heart. He sighed in his heart, he thought that if he had more pioneers by his side, the chances of survival would be much higher. Unfortunately, he could only fight alone. Only Aisha could accompany him.
Neuss saw the bitterness in Dudian’s eyes. He wanted to say something but hesitated. In the end, he held back. He knew that it was useless to say any words of encouragement at this moment. It was better to think of ways to help Dudian. But when it came to ideas.., he knew that he could think of it. Dudian had already thought of it. It was useless to say it. He felt helpless. He really hoped to help Dudian but he couldn’t.
Dudian saw that Neuss was annoyed. He patted his shoulder: “Don’t worry. Aisha is with me. I will be fine. Hurry up and bring her here. I will heal her first.”
“I know.”Neuss took a deep breath and nodded. He turned around and ordered the Knights of light to guard Dudian.
“The Mother Dragon didn’t chase after me. It’s most likely because of the sequela. She is in urgent need of recuperation. Otherwise she wouldn’t have missed this rare opportunity. I hope that the Dragon Clan doesn’t have any holy medicine to heal her. Otherwise, this trip will be a disaster…”Dudian sat on the ground, a young knight of light took a stone and placed it on his back.
Dudian looked at the young knight and thanked him. He leaned on the stone and used the dragon blood spell to speed up the recovery of his body. At the same time he was thinking about the possibility of going to the inner wall.
The young knight knew that Dudian was a big shot. He was flattered and left. He stayed with the other knights of light to guard around Dudian.
Two hours later, Dudian’s injury was almost healed. At this time, Neuss was also driving the carriage to send Haisha to Dudian.
Dudian’s final instruction to Haisha was to wait in place. However, in her concept, there was no “In place”. It was just that her body was stiff and unmoving, so she could be dragged to the second base by Neuss, she could also be dragged from the second base to here.
Dean got up and took Haisha’s hand. He took a deep look at her calm face and whispered: “This time, it’s very likely that you will make a move. It’s really an opportunity that can’t be missed. You Won’t be angry, right?”
Haisha remained silent.
Dean’s mouth showed a trace of bitterness. He held her delicate hand and said to Neuss: “I’ll go. I’ll leave the matters here to you.”
Neuss was worried: “Be careful.”He didn’t use honorifics but his words were more sincere than ever.
Dudian looked at him and nodded: “I will.”
He took Aisha and flew towards the inner wall.
As they flew high into the sky, they could see more things on the ground. They saw that Mt. Utoto had disappeared. There was a huge scorched pit on the ground. There were cracks like earthquakes on the streets within seven to eight miles, the aftermath of the explosion spread far away.
Dudian saw that many civilians were gathering towards the direction of the mountain. He thought that there would be no more mountain from now on.
He liked this mountain in his heart. Perhaps it was because its name was only one word different from the “Utopia”of the old era but it was a symbol of beauty.
Dudian saw a shocking scene when he flew to the wall of Sighs. The wall of Sighs had been erected for more than 200 years but it had broken into a huge hole. The edge of the hole was dark, there was a faint smell of blood and heavy smell of gunpowder around the hole. In addition there were some soldiers stationed there. There were two pioneers guarding the place.
Dudian dared to pass through because he hadn’t seen any pursuers for more than two hours. He deduced that the pioneers should have been injured by the explosion and didn’t dare to continue to chase.
At the moment there were only two pioneers and they seemed to be ordinary pioneers. Dudian didn’t hesitate and immediately dived down.
The two pioneers also saw Dudian flying in the sky. Their faces changed and they hurriedly ordered the patrolling soldiers to send out signal flares.
Dudian quickly landed and put Aisha on the wall. Then he activated his magic body and rushed towards the two pioneers.
The two pioneers didn’t dare to keep their magic bodies. They activated their magic bodies at the first time. The young female pioneer was a black weaver. After activating her magic marks, she immediately burrowed into the ground and drilled into the rocks.
The other one was like a porcupine. His body was covered with steel spikes. He used his hands and feet to escape.
Dudian flapped his wings and rushed to catch up with him. The sharp limbs on his back stabbed out. Puff! Puff! It pierced through his body like a piece of tofu, the Pioneer’s body was cut in half. Blood and intestines flowed all over the place as he was killed in an instant.
Dudian’s combat experience was different from the past. Ordinary pioneers weren’t his match. Although the number of times these ordinary pioneers fought was far more than Dudian’s, but their combat skills weren’t much better than his. Some people fought ten times and gained more experience than others who fought hundreds of times. These people were called geniuses and Dudian was such a genius.
Moreover, the abnormal part of the splitter’s magic marks was its terrifying cutting power. There were few opponents of the same level. Moreover, Dudian’s physique was one level higher than the other’s.
Whoosh!
Dudian turned around and flew back to Aisha. He grabbed Aisha’s body and continued to fly forward. He didn’t pay attention to the black weave magic marks pioneer who was hiding in the ground.
He entered the inner wall, flew through the wilderness and headed straight towards the border of the Dragon Clan.
After two hours of traveling, Dudian finally arrived at the border of the Dragon Clan. Unlike the Rock clan, the Dragon Clan didn’t build their territory in the city but in the suburbs outside the two cities.
The Dragon Clan lived on the mountain and surrounded by peaks. It was easy to get lost if they walked in.
“Who are you? Stop!”The eight guards on duty shouted at dudian.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he accelerated towards them.
The faces of the eight people changed as they saw Dudian approaching them. Some of them panicked as they saw how terrifying Dudian was. However they didn’t dare to escape because of their duty. They pulled out their weapons and rushed towards Dudian.
Puff Puff Puff Puff..
Dudian’s figure flew straight past them without stopping.
A bloody mist exploded behind him. The bodies of eight border guards were broken and they died on the spot.
“This is the family that you have been protecting. We haven’t seen each other for a short period of time. Even you can’t recognize them.”Dudian held Aisha and flew up the stairs. His eyes were cold, “They should die!”
Aisha was held in Dudian’s arms. She was silent but her pure black eyes seemed to flash slightly.
Dudian quickly flew to the mountainside. There was a large building here. The style of the building was similar to the ancient houses in the east. It was built with wood and had a unique charm. At the moment, the guards on the square on the mountainside saw Dudian, they immediately shouted in anger.
One must know that flying was prohibited on this mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 781
chapters.content:
Chapter 781 – Chapter 771: Kill
Dudian ignored the guards who were gathering in the square. He held Aisha in his arms as he descended from the sky. His wings were retracted behind his back. The terrifying sharp blades of his body fell on the ground and cut the floor, he put Aisha down and held her hand, he whispered: “I will see your father later. I will ask him for you. Why is he so indulgent towards Hathaway? is their blood as cold as my hand?”
Aisha was silent as she let him hold her hand.
Dudian looked up and stepped forward.
“Stop!”
“Who dares to trespass our Dragon Territory!”
“Kill him if he moves forward!”
The guards gathered in front of Dudian and blocked his way.
Some of the guards saw Aisha who was being held by Dudian. Their eyes were filled with doubt. Aisha’s face was covered with gauze, but the mist-like gauze couldn’t cover her beautiful face, the clothes and temperament made them think of a person.
Seeing that Dean didn’t intend to stop, the guards couldn’t bear it anymore. They roared and brandished their weapons as they rushed toward Dean.
Puff! Puff! Puff! The guards who were rushing toward Dean approached Dean, but their bodies suddenly froze on the spot. Their faces were full of disbelief.
Dean’s eyes were cold as he held Aisha’s hand and walked straight forward. The guards barely rolled their eyes and stared at Dean in horror. The next moment, a large amount of blood spurted out from their necks and chests, the impact of the blood broke their bodies into pieces and fell to the ground.
The other guards saw such a strange scene. The anger and ruthlessness on their faces disappeared. Their faces were full of horror as they kept retreating.
Dudian went from the gate tower to the square. The guards also retreated from the gate tower to the square.
Whoosh!
A figure rushed out from the hall behind the square. After a few jumps he landed in front of the guards. It was a handsome youth. His face slightly changed when he saw Dudian’s terrifying magic body, it was obvious that the latter’s physique was that of a pioneer. Moreover, he had never seen the shape of this magic body. It should be a rare legendary monster.
The next moment, his eyes noticed Haisha who was held by Dudian. He was stunned and stood in place.
Dudian didn’t stop but continued to step forward. It seemed that nothing could stop him.
The handsome youth came back to his senses, he couldn’t help but call out to Aisha: “Your Highness, you are finally back. We heard that you had an accident in the wasteland. It is great to see you back. Who Is This?”He still had a lot to say, however, he saw that Dudian’s killing intent had not yet subsided so he had to open his mouth.
Aisha naturally wouldn’t answer him. Dudian replaced Aisha’s mouth and said in a cold voice: “If you don’t want to die then get out of here. Get the patriarch and mother dragon to come out to see me. Otherwise, none of you dragons will be able to live!”
The handsome youth was stunned. He didn’t expect that Dudian’s tone would be so arrogant. Moreover, he was the person who accompanied Haisha. He was in disbelief. How could haisha be with such a person? However, seeing that Haisha didn’t respond, he knew what she meant. His face quickly sank, he said, “It is impossible to see the patriarch and the Dragon Mother. Your Highness, you can’t let this person mess around. He has killed our clansmen. If he continues, he will become the number one most wanted target of our dragon clan. Kill him without mercy!”
Dudian’s eyes flashed with coldness. He didn’t say anything more. He let go of Aisha’s hand and let her stand on the spot. The next moment, his figure suddenly rushed out like a black phantom and flew towards the handsome youth.
The handsome youth’s pupils shrank. He said in horror: “How dare you –”his words suddenly stopped. His head was thrown high up into the air.
When the rotating head was about to fall to the ground, the body of a sharp blade on Dudian’s back slightly trembled. Puff! It cut the head that was full of fear into two halves. He stepped down and crossed over from above. He turned back to Aisha, he held her hand and continued to move forward.
The handsome young man probably didn’t expect that just two people would dare to start a massacre in the Dragon Clan! Moreover, one of them was Aisha. All the members of the Dragon Clan knew that Aisha had sheltered the dragon clan many times. It was because he saw Aisha present that he didn’t expect that dudian would attack. Otherwise, in this situation.., no matter how careless he was, he didn’t dare to let Dean get close to him.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Two figures rapidly flew over from the distant hillside. One in front and one behind. At the same time, there was the sound of rapid rustling from the foot of the mountain as well as the sound of clothes fluttering in the wind.
Dean’s vision expanded to the maximum. He saw hot figures rushing over from all directions. They were all pioneers level experts. There was no lack of top-level experts from the outer wilderness, however, so far there were no experts from the inner wilderness level. He was relieved. He had seen the forces gathered by Ulita in the Pagar Mountains, he had noticed that there were only seven experts from the inner wilderness level.
Not long ago in the battle in the Imperial City, he had only seen the inner wilderness level experts of the Dragon Clan. The Mother Dragon was the only one who had reached the inner wilderness level. She was basically the leader of the forces. He had made the worst prediction in his heart, in other words, the Dragon Clan’s lair would have at most one inner wilderness level expert to guard the territory. But now it seemed that there wasn’t a single one.
“You once said that you don’t have any friends. I’m the only friend you can talk to.”Dean looked at the pioneers who were approaching. His eyes were bloodthirsty, he whispered to the figure of Aisha: “Even if they have your friends, they deserve to die!”
Aisha was indifferent and didn’t respond.
At this time, the pioneers came from all over the place. Dudian let go of Aisha’s hand and aimed at the pioneers who had arrived first. He jumped out and tried to kill as many of them as possible, he tried to kill as many of them as possible.
The first one who came was a sixty-year-old man. He was thin and weak. His movements were abnormally fast. He saw a few pools of blood on the square and the corpses on the ground. He was shocked and angry. He shouted and rushed towards Dudian.
However, Dudian happened to rush towards him.
MIFF felt the shocking killing intent from Dudian. The anger in his heart was like cold water pouring over his head. He instantly woke up. As an old pioneer who had participated in more than five hunting operations in the wasteland.., his battle experience had told him that Dudian was extremely dangerous. He was no match for him. He immediately braked and activated his magic body. He turned around and ran.
The scene was quite comical. The guards who were waiting for reinforcements were stunned.
Whoosh!
Dudian’s magic wings flapped. The limbs on his back were stretched in a strange posture. If a wind master was here, he would find that each of Dudian’s limbs had a strange streamlined body, it could greatly reduce the air resistance and even accelerate with the help of the wind. This was the reason why the attack speed of the limbs was faster than ordinary pioneers of the same rank.
Dudian was like a mad beast with its own propeller. He caught up with mife in the blink of an eye as he quickly stretched out his arms.
MIFE felt the terrifying killing intent coming from his back. He turned around in horror as he grabbed the two new demonized arms under his armpit. The arms were demonized and would disappear when the magic body was removed, no matter how big the injury was, it would recover when the magic body was activated again. So his first reaction was to use the arms to block Dudian’s attack.
Puff! Puff! Puff!
Three cutting sounds were heard almost at the same time. It was like a sharp knife cutting through three pieces of cloth. The two demonized arms were cut off by Dudian’s scythe and directly pierced into his back.
Dudian’s arms turned and blood spurted out. MIFE’s heart was broken in an instant. There was no life in his eyes. His body fell to the ground and rolled a few times.
Dudian didn’t stop to kill the man. His eyes were locked on the second target. He slightly turned and changed direction to rush towards the second person.
In the blink of an eye, he was in front of the man. MIFE’s reaction was the same as MIFE’s. He wanted to escape but it was too late. Dudian quickly caught up and killed him.
Some of the pioneers were good at speed but they couldn’t escape in front of dudian. The horror of the legendary magic marks was that even the extreme attack type splitter’s speed and perception had increased, it was not inferior to the ordinary rare magic marks. This was seen from the perspective of the pupil and the ultra-range vision. It was close to the speed of an inner wilderness level expert.
After Dudian killed two people, the other pioneers who heard the news seemed to be aware of the changes here. The next moment, they gathered closer to each other.
Dudian took aim at the target.
After killing two more people, the rest of the pioneers finally gathered together. However, there were only five people. Including those killed by Dudian, there were a total of nine people.
Dudian licked his lips as he looked at the five pioneers who rushed over. Two of them had reached the pinnacle of the wilderness. However, Dudian wasn’t afraid. Instead, he felt inexplicable excitement, the smell of blood spread out from his body. It made him have a crazy impulse.
“MIFF!”
“Crixus!”
The five people saw two corpses lying on the edge of the square. They were shocked, sad and angry. One of the middle-aged man frowned as he saw Dudian, he whispered: “Everyone be careful. This person should be the intruder. We must not let him go!”Although he knew about the existence of Dudian but he wasn’t interested in it. Moreover there were no photos in this era, he didn’t recognize Dudian because of the portraits.
The anger in the eyes of the others became stronger when they heard the word “Intruder”. One of them roared and took the lead.
Dudian also rushed towards the five people. It was the most suitable time for him to deal with the pioneers when he was fighting against the Dragon Mother.
“Go!”The others shouted as they activated their magic bodies and rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s speed didn’t decrease. The sharp limbs of his body spread out like a ball full of sharp blades. The appearance alone was enough to make people’s scalp go numb. Two of the five pioneers were assassination pioneers with weak defense. They were good at hiding and using poison. They felt a toothache when they saw Dudian’s ferocious form. They immediately rushed to the side and didn’t dare to touch him.
Dudian noticed the expressions of the five people as he rushed out. He quickly locked onto the two evading people as his priority targets. He knew that they were often missing in a certain aspect, on the other hand they would be strengthened. Just like his splitter magic marks. He was good at attacking but his defense was weak. However his defense was weak compared to the other legendary magic marks, he was only slightly inferior to the rare magic marks Dragon Steel.
Whoosh!
Dudian rushed towards one of the evading people.
The man saw the speed of Dudian’s attack and thought that he would meet the other three. He didn’t expect that Dudian would suddenly turn around and rush towards him, he wanted to distance himself from Dudian.
He was bitter in his heart. He couldn’t understand why dudian would attack him from a distance. Moreover he would fall into a situation where he was attacked from both sides. It was not worth it. He even suspected that he had accidentally offended him, but he didn’t have such a character in his impression.
“Go to hell!”A Knight holding a lance roared as he stabbed Dudian from behind. The lance in his hand was a standard four meters long lance. Although it didn’t have the cooperation of a warhorse but it was extremely flexible in his hands, after all, his body was almost four meters tall. He was extremely thin and long. His arms were very thin. His body looked like a soft rubber. There was a layer of film on his spine which looked like the wings of a Cicada.
There wasn’t much difference between his body and that of a human. The only difference was that his skin color was as pale as a corpse. However, this didn’t mean that his body wasn’t fully displayed. On the contrary, his original body was less than two meters but now he was almost four meters tall, although his body structure was similar to a human’s but it was also completely demonized. This was the shape of the magic marks of a corpse eater.
Dudian’s body suddenly shot out and swept towards the lance. The lance was cut off.
The Knight was stunned for a moment. He didn’t expect the monster’s limbs to be so terrifying. It was as if it could cut through iron like mud. If he got closer then his whole body would be cut into pieces. How could he fight in close combat?
The other two also saw the scene. Their eyes were filled with horror. They couldn’t help but slow down. They didn’t know how to attack.
Dudian suddenly accelerated. He shook off the three of them and quickly caught up with the man who was running away.
“No –”
The Scream came to an abrupt end. When Dudian’s body was three meters behind him, the limbs of the monster flashed and turned into several afterimages. The next moment, Dudian’s body passed by and left a pile of body parts.
Dudian quickly turned around and killed another person.
“Quick, stop him!”It was a round-faced woman who looked about 30 years old. She was scared out of her wits when she saw Dudian kill a person in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 782
chapters.content:
Chapter 782 – Chapter 772: Murray
“Stop! !”
Dudian was about to catch up to her when he heard an angry shout. Dudian’s eyes lit up. The person who spoke was the current patriarch of the Dragon Clan. He was rushing up the stairs.
Dudian snorted and sped up. He was close to the back of the round-faced woman. All of his limbs shot out.
The woman was shocked. Her eyes were filled with despair. She clenched her teeth. Her abdomen suddenly bulged. She turned her head and spat out a ball of green mucus.
Puff! Puff!
Dudian’s sharp limbs easily pierced through her body. It was as if he had pierced into a bubble. However at the same time, the green mucus that the woman spat out touched the body of the sharp limbs, dudian felt a corrosive burning sensation coming from the sharp limbs. His face slightly changed. He immediately released the magic body. The black liquid condensed into the weapon and the green mucus appeared on the weapon.
When the magic body was released, the weapon was restored to its original state. It cut off the connection with Dudian’s body. He looked at the green mucus on the weapon and smelled the stench, he tore off a piece of clothing from the woman’s body. He rolled it into a ball and wiped the mucus.
Although the woman was an ordinary pioneer but she was good at using poison. Her fighting strength couldn’t be looked at with common sense. Even if the poison was created by a frontiersman, if it was injected into the blood of a pioneer.., it would be easy to kill it!
He was glad in his heart. Fortunately, he used his demonized limbs to block the dark green mucus. If it had landed on his body, he estimated that even if he did not die at this moment, his fighting strength would be greatly reduced.
“You!”Mudley looked at the round-faced woman’s body that fell down. His eyes were slightly bulging. He clenched his fists, he clenched his teeth: “Our Dragon Clan has no enmity with you. Even if we had captured you in the past, it was because Aisha had privately taught you the secret skill. It violated the rules. So, we still owe you a favor. Not only did we not kill you, but we also gave you resources to increase your strength. You actually repaid kindness with enmity. Isn’t that too bad?”? ”!”
Dudian looked at him and glanced at the other three who were chasing after him. He faintly smiled with a hint of ridicule, “So the patriarch knows about my matter. I didn’t expect you to remember that small figure. Since you have come out, I would like to ask you. Aisha and Hathaway are your daughters. Don’t you know what kind of character they have?”
“What do you mean?”Mudley’s face was gloomy.
“How could aisha do such a thing as stealing the secret skill? Her character is very easy to understand. It’s impossible that you don’t know.”Dudian’s voice was cold, “You also know that Hathaway has been jealous of her sister for so many years. This is clearly a trap. The funny thing is that you are aware of it but still stick to the rules and punish Aisha. She was born to awaken. She was nurtured as a SAINTESS since she was young. How much did she pay for the family? All her life up until now, which day didn’t she fight to protect your family? But how did you treat her?”
Murray’s face slightly changed, “This is her mission. If her sister has the same talent as her, she will also get such a mission from a young age. This is the tradition of our dragon family. The other families are the same. It is not your place to judge. My own daughter. Don’t I Feel Sad?”
“If you really feel sad then you should destroy this tradition for your own daughter!”Dudian’s eyes were cold, “You are the patriarch but you can’t protect your own daughter. What qualifications do you have to be the patriarch? What qualifications do you have to be her father? I have never seen your dragon clan sad even when she had an accident in the wasteland. Is there anyone who is sad for her? “Is there anyone who went to the wasteland to look for her body?”
“No!”
Dudian’s eyes were sharp, he stared at him word by word: “She is like a tool. When she is broken, she will lose all her value and be abandoned by you. Is this the tradition of your family?”? “You are indeed prosperous. But if you want to maintain your prosperity, then what the F * CK is the use of your prosperity?”? !”
Mudley angrily said: “What do you know? Do you think this is as simple as you think? Do you know how many members there are in a family? Do you think you can do whatever you want? The Wasteland is very dangerous. She is already dead. If we send more people to look for her, the losses will be even greater! It is already unacceptable for us to lose her. If we lose more people, it will only bring more negative effects!”
Dudian was slightly stunned. He couldn’t believe his ears. Such cold-blooded and selfish words could come out from the mouth of a father. He suddenly felt a burst of heartache and sorrow, the heartache was that Haisha had sheltered such a group of people since she was a child. The sorrow was that the latter spoke to him in an angry tone.
Mistakes were not terrible. What was terrible was that in his understanding, this was not a mistake!
And this thought was the most difficult thing to reverse, even if it killed him!
Dudian was silent for a moment, then he slowly said: “You can not bear that you have lost such a powerful fighting force. But you don’t see that behind this strength, the love and loyalty to You is the most precious thing in the world, isn’t it?”
Murray coldly said: “Of course I know.”
“I can understand the thoughts of a superior.”Dudian said: “The environment of a superior is very different from that of ordinary people. The first reaction of the choice is to think from the point of view of interests. It is customary to think from the point of view of interests. But if you think too much, then people will become utilitarian. When a person is staring at something for a long time, they will slowly ignore other things. You are a qualified superior, but not an outstanding superior. Because understanding the hearts of people is the most important thing. Countless emperors have fallen because of this point.”
Murray’s face was gloomy: “What do you want to do here? To avenge her? Do you think that Hathaway killed her?”
“Since you can ask this, it means that you know what to do. It seems that you deserve to die too!”Dudian looked at him indifferently, “I wanted to spare your life because you are her father. But since you know what to do, you let her be killed. You Don’t want to help her to get justice. A father like you is not worthy!”
“They are my daughters. Although I have a guess, but this matter is unclear. Did you see with your own eyes that Hathaway framed her sister?”? “Even so, I have already lost a daughter. Do You Want Me to lose another one?”
“I don’t expect you to kill her, but at least you should be severely punished.”Dudian saw three people slowly approaching from the corner of his eyes. His eyes slightly flashed and he didn’t want to talk about Aisha anymore, after all, it was easy for people to admit their mistakes, but it was difficult for people to realize their mistakes. He asked: “You are all gathered here. What happened to Mother Dragon?”

chapters.title: Chapter 783
chapters.content:
Chapter 783 – : Chapter 721: Fight
Mudley’s face slightly changed as he clenched his fists, “You dare to step into this place because you saw the battle between the dragon mother and the intruders. You despicable person. When the intruders entered the giant wall, you didn’t help them to escape. Do you know that when they come back, the people here will be in misery? What you did with the intruders was simply stupid. Do you think that you can rely on them to strengthen yourself? When no one in the inner wall can stop them, they will be the first to kill you!”
Dudian was almost certain that dragon mother was recovering from her injury. It was difficult for her to make a move. He calmed down, “So many experts are gathered here to visit Dragon Mother. I want to visit her. Lead the way!”
“Bastard! Do you deserve to see Dragon Mother?”A handsome youth shouted.
“Do you think that you can trespass into the territory of our Dragon clan just because the dragon mother is injured? If the whereabouts of the intruders were not unknown, she would have come out to kill you regardless of her injuries!”
Dudian’s heart slightly moved. It seemed that the power of the ice blood disease of the dragon mother was seriously overdrawn. If she was forced to make a move personally, then he could only let Aisha fight against it, he was only relying on himself to fight against a desolate level expert. Even if the latter was injured, he didn’t show any weakness as he stared at Mudley’s murderous eyes, “You said so much because you are worried that I will let her take action. It seems that you know something about me. In that case, let me see the dragon mother before I start a massacre.”
Mudley looked straight at him, “You just said that I am not worthy to be her father. Who Do you think you are?”? “Although I don’t know how you infected her into a zombie queen but I advise you to let her go. My Daughter is not your fighting tool!”
Dudian’s face turned gloomy: “I have never seen her as a fighting tool!”
Mudley snorted, “As far as I know, when Hathaway brought people to the outer wall to kill you, it was because of her that you were able to survive, right?”? “Even if you have the magic marks of a legendary splitter, it is impossible for you to defeat Hathaway. What’s more, there are the god of war and the elder of the monastery. Do you dare to say that you didn’t use her as a fighting tool?”? “You brought her here because you were worried that you wouldn’t be able to escape unscathed.”
Dudian stared at him for a moment, “I asked her to fight for me, but my goal is different from yours. I believe that even if she is conscious she would take the initiative to fight for me. But you asked her to stay in the wilderness and guard the desolate land outside the giant wall day and night. This is not what she wants. But for the sake of your family and the overall situation, she must do this because she is your daughter. You even think that she should do this when she becomes the Saintess!”! However, none of you have ever asked her if she was willing to be the SAINTESS and if that was her goal!”
Mudley’s expression changed slightly as he sneered, “Of course, I know. She didn’t want to be the SAINTESS. When she was young, she secretly ran out, but she ran in the wrong direction and ran to the outer wall. However, she was able to endure it for so many years. Why? How many people in this world can spend their whole life doing what they like and pursuing what they like? You came here today to kill my clansmen. If she was here, do you think she would help you? This is the person she tried her best to protect when she was alive!”!
“She couldn’t refuse because her heart is too kind. If you didn’t exist, she wouldn’t have so much pain. Even if she did, it would be temporary.”Dudian’s eyes were cold, “If you don’t follow my path then I will give you a chance to live. I just want to get the highest authority in the inner wall. I want to investigate the method to restore her. If the giant wall doesn’t exist then I will go to the Kingdom of God. I will restore her consciousness in my lifetime. I will destroy all of you!”! Anyone who tries to stop me will die!”
“You are crazy!”Mudley looked at him in anger, “How can a corpse regain its consciousness? This is something that has never been heard of for hundreds of years. Even the Kingdom of God can’t do it. It is futile for you to kill so many people!”
“If killing isn’t enough then kill God!”There was anger in Dudian’s eyes, “You have never been to the Kingdom of God. How do you know that the Kingdom of God doesn’t exist?”? “Even if God’s kingdom isn’t there, I will plunder the high-level resources of this world. I will personally create a way to restore her. Even if she is dead, I will bring her back from hell!”
Mudley looked at him for a long time, “No matter what, you can forget about leaving here today. You will hurt my clansmen and I will spare your life to compensate. As for her, after you die, I will let her go. She will not want to see herself living like this. After all, this is what she hates the most…”
“What is freedom? What do you know!”Dudian couldn’t help but be angry. He suddenly attacked. His body suddenly danced like a terrifying blade. His body suddenly dived forward. However, the moment he took two steps.., he suddenly turned around and attacked in the opposite direction.
The other three saw Dudian attack and instinctively chased to stop him. However, Dudian suddenly attacked back. The three were caught off guard. One of them was shocked as Dudian instantly approached his body, the man’s body was cut into pieces before he could react. His demonized body was covered with armor. It looked extremely hard but he was still killed in an instant!
Mudley saw this scene. He roared and his body quickly demonized. His magic marks were similar to Aisha’s. They were magic marks of the dragon. They were ranked ahead of the splitter in the legendary monsters. They had extraordinary defensive power, they had terrifying attack power. They were rare magic marks that could attack and defend at the same time. Their attack was slightly inferior to the splitter but their defense was much better than the splitter’s magic marks, moreover, their flying speed was much faster than the splitter. In addition to not being able to enter the ground, they were extremely powerful in air and land battles. There was also the high-fat dragon breath. They were the nemesis of many magic marks.
He turned into a dragon and roared. His feet turned into dragon claws and stepped on the ground. The floor was cracked as he rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian felt the hot energy behind his back. He had to turn back and attack. His sharp limbs gathered into a huge sharp spine and stabbed towards Mudley’s chest.
Mudley twisted his body and his body flashed. It seemed that he had split into two and attacked from both sides. It was difficult to distinguish the real from the fake.

chapters.title: Chapter 784
chapters.content:
Chapter 784 – Chapter 774: No One Can Stop [ First Watch ]
Dudian coldly snorted. He stretched out his limbs and twisted his feet. His body was spinning like a top. The sharp blades turned into an impenetrable sphere.
The faces of both of them changed. They had to stop and retreat.
As they retreated, the circle of blades suddenly stopped. Dudian turned around and pounced on an old woman. There were several sharp blades in front of his chest.
The old woman’s face was full of horror. She quickly waved her sword to block. The sword was cut into three pieces. Dudian’s speed was faster than the old woman. Although both of them were at the peak of the wilderness but his legendary magic marks and deification had increased his physique, he was close to the experts of the inner wilderness. One of them was attacking forward while the other was retreating. In the blink of an Eye Dudian was close to her.
“No!”The old woman screamed in fear. She knew how terrifying Dudian’s limbs were. She had no chance of winning in close combat.
Mudley roared as he rushed over but it was too late.
Puff!
Dudian’s sharp limbs shot out and pierced through the old woman’s chest. His scythe-like arms danced and cut off the old woman’s head from the bridge of her nose. The cut was smooth and the brain tissue trembled inside.
Dudian pulled back the sharp limbs and turned to kill Mudley.
Mudley’s eyes were filled with anger. He used his magic dragon claw to hold the spear and stabbed out like lightning. It happened to avoid the sharp limbs that were waving in front of Dudian’s chest. Dudian felt a sharp pain in his chest, it seemed that something was broken.
He roared in anger and waved his hand.
The spear in Mudley’s hand broke. At the same time, the blade in front of his chest was cut towards Mudley’s chest.
Mudley didn’t dare to resist. He pulled back but was still cut by the tip of the blade. A bloody scar appeared on his chest and blood oozed out.
Puff!
There was the sound of water spraying from behind when Dudian pushed back Mudley. He saw that the young and handsome pioneer’s cheeks were as big as a toad’s, he suddenly spat out a blood mist. It was called a mist but in his vision it contained countless weak heat source reactions. It seemed to be countless tiny lives.
Dudian’s heart was cold. He tried to dodge but the blood mist still touched his body. After all, the range of the blood mist was too large.
His face was ugly. It was very likely that this method was a poison attack. He no longer paid attention to Mudley. He flapped his magic wings and rushed towards the handsome pioneer.
“Stop!”Mudley roared in anger. A fire-like crack appeared in his throat. The next moment, his abdomen shriveled as if he took a deep breath, he spat towards Dudian’s back.
Dragon’s breath!
A strong flame was spat out from his mouth. The surrounding air instantly heated up. The flame was aimed at Dudian’s back.
Dudian noticed his action from the corner of his eyes. He knew that he was going to use dragon’s breath. However, the length of the dragon’s breath was much longer than he expected. The speed of the dragon’s breath was frightening, the dragon’s breath was in a straight line. Dudian dodged to the side but the wings on his back were still touched by the flames. He felt an intense burning sensation coming from the wings.
He looked at the Flames on the wings. The dragon’s breath didn’t extinguish the flames but it was like a gangrene that was attached to the bones. It was fiercely burning.
The pain made him mad. However, he didn’t beat the wings to disperse the flames. Instead, he wrapped the burning wings like a devil and rushed towards the handsome pioneer.
The handsome pioneer looked at Dudian’s ferocious face as he rushed towards him. He panicked and retreated. However, his speed wasn’t as fast as Dudian’s. Dudian caught up with him in a few steps.
He waved the sharp limbs in front of his chest and hugged the handsome pioneer tightly.
Blood spurted out from his arms. The handsome pioneer’s body was broken into seven or eight pieces.
Dudian roared and turned around. He looked at Murray who was behind him. He was the only pioneer left.
“You!”Murray looked at the dead body at Dudian’s feet. He was so angry that his eyes turned red. Almost all of the pioneers who had stayed in the family had fallen at Dudian’s feet, even if he could kill Dudian now, the Dragon Clan wouldn’t be as strong as before. Moreover, his reason told him that if he continued to fight, he would step into their path of retreat.
“I don’t want to kill you in front of her. Don’t force me!”Dudian’s eyes emitted a monstrous murderous aura. It seemed that the hostility hidden in his chest had burst out at this moment. However, his reason was still there as he stared at Mudley, “If you surrender, I will go around your entire clan. If you resist, I will kill every member of your clan!”
Murray’s face changed: “Don’t You Dare! I will kill you even if I die with you!”
Dudian’s eyes were filled with murderous intent: “Since you don’t know the meaning of death then don’t blame me for being merciless!”He turned around and rushed towards the top of the mountain.
Murray’s face changed as he saw Dudian rush towards the top of the mountain. He immediately chased after him.
There were a large number of dragon guards on the steps of the mountain. They were all at the limit level. They were frightened as they saw Dudian’s terrifying demonized figure rush towards them. However they still brandished their weapons and rushed towards him.
Dudian’s eyes were cold as he looked at the top of the mountain. He quickly rushed up the steps. As he approached the guards he stretched out his body, the guards who were attacking him fell down in large numbers. Their bodies were cut into pieces. Their intestines, hands and heads were scattered on the ground. Blood was flowing and dyed the entire hillside. It was like a purgatory.
Dudian’s footsteps didn’t stop as he rushed up the stairs.
He ignored the waves of guards along the way. He stretched out his limbs and killed the guards who were trying to attack him.
The advantage of the splitter’s magic marks could only be shown in group battles. The shape of the monster’s body was perfect. It was very suitable to be used in a chaotic group.
In the blink of an eye, Dudian arrived at the top of the mountain. Mudley was chasing after him but the distance between them didn’t close.
Dudian’s vision swept across the entire mountain top. He didn’t see any heat source reaction from the other pioneers. But soon he saw many figures gathered in a hall at the top of the mountain. It seemed that they were having a meeting.
He immediately rushed to the hall and kicked the door open.
There were dozens of senior members of the Dragon Clan sitting in the hall. Their body heat was ordinary. It seemed that they were in charge of all aspects of the operation of the clan.
Everyone in the hall was scared to stand up when they saw the door being kicked open. They had long received the news that there was an invasion at the foot of the mountain. Many of them were worried that the intruders would come to attack them, dudian’s kick was like thunder. After all, they didn’t have the ability to sense the fast approaching figure of Dudian.
“This is…”Dudian kicked open the door. His eyes fell on the top of the hall. He was slightly stunned. There was a dark golden coffin about five meters tall, his vision was blocked by the coffin so he couldn’t penetrate it. However he noticed that the temperature around the coffin was very low, the two guards who were standing next to the coffin were wearing the same armor as the border guards. However the heat source on their bodies was only that of hunters. It seemed that they were shivering due to the cold.
He couldn’t believe the familiar cold air. Could it be that the mother dragon was in the coffin?

chapters.title: Chapter 785
chapters.content:
Chapter 785 – : Chapter 725: Blood River [ Second Update ]
Whoosh!
A strong wind suddenly blew from behind.
Dudian quickly bent down. The sharp blade in front of his chest pushed the ground and moved horizontally to avoid the attack from behind.
“Patriarch!”
“Patriarch is coming!”
The people in the hall saw that Murray had forced Dudian to retreat. They were relieved and immediately ordered the guards to protect the dragon coffin.
Mudley looked at Dudian who was hiding by the door: “Where did you get the magic marks of the splitter? Did she give it to you?”
Dudian stood up from the ground and looked at him: “Is the Dragon Mother Dead?”
Mudley’s eyes slightly flashed, he coldly said: “If she is really dead then it will be a tragedy for the entire giant wall of Sylvia. Who else can resist the intruders? “Only a stupid and despicable person like you would expect such a thing to happen.”
“Really?”Dudian ignored his sarcasm: “She is in the coffin. I can feel it. If you don’t tell me then I will open it myself!”
“You Dare!”Mudley’s eyebrows were raised as he stepped forward to block Dudian.
“Can you stop me?”Dudian coldly looked at him.
Mudley growled and rushed forward. When he was close to the attack range of Dudian’s limbs, he suddenly turned around and went to the side of Dudian. His abdomen had already bulged, he opened his mouth and spurted out a blazing dragon flame.
Dudian had suffered from the dragon breath before so he was on guard. When his abdomen bulged, he knew that he was going to use dragon breath. When his mouth slightly opened, he suddenly squatted down and swept the sharp blade across his legs.
The Blazing Dragon’s breath brushed over Dudian’s head but didn’t hit him. On the contrary, there were many bloody wounds on Mudley’s legs.
Mudley staggered back two steps. His eyes were filled with anger. He roared and rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian was startled. He saw a trace of madness in Mudley’s eyes. He quickly retreated but it was not convenient to retreat. Soon, Mudley caught up to him and was within three meters of him, this was also the range of attack of his monster limbs.
He didn’t hesitate to throw out his sharp blades.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The whistling sound of arrows echoed. Dudian’s monster limbs pierced through Murray’s body. They went through his shoulders, chest, arms, abdomen and other parts of his body.
Dudian was slightly startled. He didn’t expect that he didn’t Dodge.
The next moment, his pupils constricted and revealed a trace of horror.
He saw that Murray slightly opened his mouth. The extremely intense heat gathered in his mouth. The surrounding air was burning and slightly distorted. It was definitely not just a thousand degrees high temperature, he couldn’t imagine how the human body could produce such a terrifying flame.
Whoosh!
Dragon’s breath shot out.
The blazing flame reflected in Dudian’s pupils. He felt as if he was about to be swallowed by the flame. The feeling of death made his hair stand up. He wanted to pull out his limbs to dodge but it was too late.
Whoosh!
The Flames of the dragon’s breath covered Dudian’s face and chest and swept over his upper body.
Shrill screams echoed in the flames. The limbs of the monster were twisted as they were burned. They struggled violently as they were torn into pieces.
The flame was attached to Dudian’s face and chest. It burned fiercely as if it was attached to the wings.
Dudian fell to the ground and rolled in pain. The pain this time was dozens of times more than the previous time. The nerve endings on the wings were weak so the feeling was not sensitive. However the nerve endings on his face and chest were more concentrated, the burning pain almost made him break down. He rolled on the ground repeatedly in an attempt to extinguish the flame.
However, the flame of Dragon’s breath was a mixture of high concentration of fat and bile oil. It could burn continuously for dozens of seconds even if it was sprayed on a metal plate, it wouldn’t be extinguished until the high fat and bile oil in the flame was completely burnt out.
The screams of the devil echoed in the flame. The people in the Hall felt their scalps tingle and their bodies turned cold.
They stared at the corpse of the patriarch in front of Dudian. They didn’t expect that their patriarch would die like this.
For a long time.
The screams seemed to have lasted for a century. But as the flame weakened, it gradually stopped.
The flame was completely extinguished.
There was silence outside the hall. Only the sound of deep breathing could be heard.
The hall was also dead silent. Everyone looked out of the hall in horror. Their faces were pale as they couldn’t accept the fact.
A low laughter echoed outside the hall. It sounded like the Devil’s grin. The terrifying figure covered in sharp blades slowly climbed up and staggered into the hall. It seemed that his trembling body would collapse at any time.
Everyone stared at the intruder who didn’t die. Some of them stood in front of the crowd and stood in front of them.
“The obstacle has finally been removed…”Dudian’s face revealed a strange smile. He was now convinced that the mother dragon was in the coffin. There was no life response. From the arrangement of the scene, it was a bit like a memorial, if the Mother Dragon was dead, it meant that the goal he had been striving for was finally in front of his eyes.
He slowly walked into the hall. His eyes were only on the coffin above the hall.
“Stop!”
“Die…”
One by one, angry shouts sounded.
Although they were civil servants, but there was no way to retreat. Several of them angrily rushed towards Dudian and tried to stop him.
However, before they got close to Dudian, they were swept by Dudian’s sharp limbs. Their bodies were cut in half or pierced through the chest. None of them could get close to Dudian.
The other people who were standing at the back saw this scene. At the moment, Dudian was obviously at the end of his rope. He would fall at any time. However, they didn’t expect that he would still have such terrifying strength.
“Kill!”
“Don’t let him get close to the Mother Dragon!”
“Follow me!”
Angry roars were heard one after another. Under the pressure of life and death situation, the group of people were forced to rush towards Dudian. It was tragic and tragic.
Dudian’s footsteps didn’t stop. He continued to step forward step by step. The people who were shouting and rushing towards him were cut off as soon as they stepped into his attack range. Limbs and blood were flying around his body.
It was a miserable and bloody scene. After an unknown amount of time, Dudian finally walked to the steps and stood in front of the coffin. The red carpet was strewn with broken limbs and corpses. There was a river of blood. In the distance, only a few people were scared out of their wits. They were shivering in the corner. The rest of them were lying in a pool of blood, blood soaked the carpet.

chapters.title: Chapter 786
chapters.content:
Chapter 786 – : Chapter 276: Heroes Covered In Dust
Dudian felt the frightening cold air coming from the coffin. The burn pain on his face and chest seemed to have lessened a lot. He took a deep breath and slowly raised the sharp limbs on his chest, the cold air spread from the tip of the coffin as if it was going to freeze his body. He gathered strength and suddenly stabbed the sharp blade.
The coffin was made of metal but it was cut by the monster’s limbs. A large amount of white cold air rushed out from the coffin and rushed towards Dudian. The surrounding temperature seemed to have dropped to the freezing point.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The monster’s limbs quickly danced and completely cut the coffin. The cold air spread in all directions. When the cold air was almost gone, a beast-like figure emerged from the coffin. It was the dragon mother.
She was still in the state of demonization when she fought with the intruders. However her body was covered with a layer of frost. She looked like an ice sculpture.
Dudian was stunned. He was almost sure that this was the mother dragon and not a fake sculpture. The charm of her eyebrows, including every hair and eyebrows were vivid as if she was alive, but there was no heat in her body. Dudian looked into her body. Her internal organs, blood and heart were frozen.
He was stunned for half a second. He suddenly realized that the monster’s limbs were quickly cut out. The ice sculpture of the mother dragon was cut into pieces. Her head fell to the ground but it didn’t break as easily as ordinary ice.
Dudian’s heart was relieved after destroying the ice sculpture of the Mother Dragon. Even if the mother dragon hadn’t died before, she was completely dead now. This meant that the only master level combat power in the inner wall had been wiped out, he didn’t need to worry about the remaining masters of the inner wall. He had planned so far and had done all kinds of bad things. He had sacrificed countless people. Even Glenn who was by his side had died in the mission. Everything was finally coming to an end.
“Hahaha…”he laughed softly. His laughter became louder and louder and spread throughout the hall.
He hadn’t laughed since Aisha turned into a corpse. He hadn’t laughed in front of her. But at this moment, he was laughing so hard that it sounded a bit crazy.
“I thought you were seriously injured. I didn’t expect that you would turn into an ice sculpture and be completely crystallized. Is this the sequela of ice blood disease? No wonder you didn’t show such power before. You didn’t rely on such power to expand the power of the Dragon Clan. You completely overtook the Rock clan and the wing clan. It turned out that such power could kill you…”Dudian looked at the pieces of ice sculpture scattered on the ground, there was a trace of bitterness in his mouth as he muttered to himself.
The few people hiding in the corner of the hall saw Dudian destroy the ice sculpture of the Dragon Mother. Their eyes were filled with fear, shock and anger. But in the end there was only despair. One of them stood up from the corner and shouted in anger, he rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian didn’t turn back. When the man came close to him a sharp blade was thrown out from his back. It pierced through his mouth and pierced through his head.
The faces of the remaining people turned pale.
Dudian slowly turned around and walked down the stairs. He walked towards the corner of the hall. He stopped in front of an old man. His voice was hoarse as if a knife was rubbing against his ear, “Has mother dragon been like this ever since she came back?”
The old man looked at Dudian in horror. His legs were trembling: “Please don’t kill me.”
“Answer me.”Dudian stared at him.
The old man’s body trembled: “The ice poison of the dragon mother is deep in the bone marrow. She didn’t hesitate to activate the power of the ice poison in order to kill the intruders. She didn’t even have the chance to explain what happened after she came back.”
Dudian confirmed the idea in his mind. The ice sculpture of the dragon mother was the same as the previous battle with the intruders. Perhaps her body was irreparable from the time when her body was frozen to repel the intruders, this was the reason why she was able to maintain her demonized image even after she was completely frozen and lost consciousness and life. Her frozen body had made it impossible for her to dispel the demonization.
“Are you going to bury her in a Coffin?”Dudian asked.
Cold Sweat broke out on the old man’s face, he bowed his head: “We don’t know about this. Although there have been cases like this in the past but the records aren’t clear. I heard that if you are infected with methamphetamine then your whole body will freeze. All the tissues in your body will turn into ice and you will lose consciousness. If you are in a high temperature environment then you might be able to regain consciousness and come back to life. But this is just hearsay. No one knows if it is true or not…”
“Is it possible for her to regain her consciousness?”Dudian couldn’t help but look at the pieces of the Mother Dragon. Even if her body was defrosted it would be useless.
“You are a great hero. You are a heroine. You are much stronger than the others…”Dudian thought. If he didn’t exist then the mother dragon would use her life to fight back the intruders, the story of taking back the god’s corpse would be spread for hundreds of years. It would become a legend. However, if he took back the rights of the wall master then he would be destined to erase the glorious achievements, the name of the Hero would be added to his name.
After all, he needed a positive image to be praised and loved by others.
Moreover, he was the one who killed the intruders.
However, the real heroes were covered up and turned into dust. They slowly disappeared in the river of time.
“When the power is big enough, one hand can cover the sky. The ‘Sky’that is covered is not the ‘sky’but the people…”Dudian sighed, there was no joy in his heart. Instead, he felt empty.
He slowly turned, step by step, dragged his tired body out of the hall, and then went down the hill to the side of Aisha.
Aisha was still standing quietly in the square, surrounded by a large number of ordinary guards, but they didn’t dare to approach. Some of them had recognized Aisha’s identity, but they repeatedly questioned her.
Whoosh!
Dudian was like a hurricane. The crowd surrounding Aisha was quickly torn into a bloody path. Blood splattered, and broken limbs fell to the ground. The other guards saw the monster that suddenly appeared next to Aisha, they were scared and took a few steps back.
It was no wonder that they were so surprised. It was because Dudian’s demonized body was too terrifying. In addition to his face and chest were burned. He looked like a ghost that crawled out of Hell. His appearance alone was enough to shock everyone.
Dudian ignored the ordinary guards. He grabbed Haisha’s waist and whispered: “Let’s go back. Soon, I will find a way to treat you…”
Aisha was silent and didn’t respond.
Dean was used to it. When she acquiesced, he took off and flew straight out of the dragon territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 787
chapters.content:
Chapter 787 – Chapter 277: Winner Takes All
A few hours later, Dudian returned to the outer wall.
He went straight to the second base. The second base was located in a quiet area in the western part of the commercial district. There were dark cult members who had committed crimes in this area. They had massacred several villages, dudian had chosen it as the second base. The area was wide and sparsely populated. It was convenient for him to arrange wind power stations and solar panels. Moreover it was hidden and not far away from Mt. Uto.
Dudian flew back to the second base. He saw Sergei, Gwyneth, Neuss and others in the base. In addition there were Shamanson and Poland who were busy in the laboratory.
He slowly descended from the sky.
The sensor in the base lit up as it sensed his life fluctuation. The intelligence department immediately sent the news to Neuss. Neuss saw Dudian fall from the sky when he received the news, he immediately went up to greet him.
“Master, you…”Neuss was about to ask about Dudian’s condition but he was stunned when he saw Dudian’s face.
At the moment Dudian had dispelled the magic body but the high temperature burns of dragon’s breath had penetrated through the magic skin and burned the skin inside. Therefore Dudian’s face looked extremely frightening. Half of his face was burnt and completely disfigured, moreover his chest was covered with lumps of flesh and blood. The lumps were slightly red as if the blood had solidified in the rotten flesh.
“Did Richelieu deal with the explosion?”Dudian asked.
Neuss reacted, he replied: “He has dealt with it. He has temporarily controlled the situation and blocked the news. He has made newspapers report the scandals of other famous people and aristocrats. He has covered up the matter and downplayed it. But it is only temporary. He is waiting for your reply. He will see what the news will say about the explosion.”
“Let’s say that the dark church has attacked and created a terrorist disaster. However the dark church has been brought to justice. Hawkeye will capture a few refugees to act as terrorists and execute them in public.”Dudian casually said, it seemed that he was prepared as he walked towards the main hall.
Neuss slightly nodded. He had been following Dudian for a long time. He could guess Dudian’s thoughts. It was the easiest way to make the dark church take the blame, although this would inevitably bring a certain degree of panic to the ordinary people. After all, the headquarters of the Holy See was destroyed. However, there would be news of the dark church being captured, naturally, the strong image of the Holy See would be created again.
“Young master, your injury…”Neuss’s eyes had a trace of worry. He was more concerned about Dudian and the movement of the inner wall. This was the key to determine the survival of all of them.
Dudian found a chair and sat down. Aisha sat down with him. He breathed a sigh of relief as he rested in his own territory. He touched his face after hearing Neuss’s words, the smooth skin of his face was full of potholes. A small part of his skin was abnormally smooth. However the shape of his face was like a lump of meat. His pores were burnt and melted.
“It’s nothing. I came back alive.”Dudian’s tone was calm.
“But your face…”
“It’s alright if it can be restored. But if it can’t be restored then let it go. It’s just a skin bag.”Dudian indifferently said: “As long as it doesn’t affect the combat power it’s a small matter.”
Neuss’s lips moved but in the end he bitterly smiled in his heart. If it was an ordinary person, even if they were strong they would feel angry. After all, disfigurement.., it was difficult for most people to accept this point. This point could be seen from the strength of the women who were looking for cosmetic drugs. Moreover it wasn’t just women who needed cosmetic drugs.
“Get me some medicine to heal my wounds.”Dudian shouted.
Neuss replied and immediately turned away. A moment later he came back with a medicine box. He opened the medicine box. There were many bottles and jars inside. They were neatly stacked. The effects covered all aspects. There were antidotes and extremely effective hemostatic drugs, bone healing drugs and so on. There were life-saving drugs which could let the dead breathe twice. However the effect of this medicine was just to breathe twice.
Dudian took out a few bottles and opened them. He took the pills and potions one by one and quietly closed his eyes to rest.
Neuss saw that Dudian was recuperating. He took the medicine box and prepared to leave.
Dudian suddenly said: “By the way, drive the war chariot over. Also, bring Hathaway to see me.”
Neuss was startled. He replied and quietly left.
Half an hour later, an ancient chariot rolled over and stopped outside the main hall. There were six figures tied to the rope outside the chariot. The first ones were Ronon and Hiro. There were others who were subdued by Dudian, the ordinary pioneers who used the poison pin to crush their will were still resisting. Dudian didn’t have time to subdue them. He was still in the dungeon and didn’t tie the chariots.
“Go in!”Neuss shouted.
A figure with disheveled hair was pushed into the hall.
Dudian slowly opened his eyes and looked at the figure who was sitting on the ground. In just a month’s time, the figure in front of him was completely different from the arrogant and arrogant Hathaway, her clothes were torn and torn. Her clothes were stained with a strong man’s smell. Her chest and thighs were faintly visible. Her hair which used to be neatly combed and sprayed with high-level perfume was now scattered, the smell of dandruff and grease.
Hathaway seemed to have adapted to the dirty environment. She didn’t mind the carpet and just sat there. She was too lazy to get up. In the past, the place she stepped on with her boots was cleaner than other people’s bedsheets. She looked at dudian, there was a sneer on her lips, she said: “Do you want to see me kneel in front of You and beg for mercy? Unfortunately, unless you tie my hands and feet, pinch my face and force me to make such a gesture, you will never see such a scene!”
Dudian quietly looked down at her and said: “I went to your dragon clan today.”
Hathaway was startled. She noticed the terrifying burn marks on Dudian’s face and chest. Her face slightly changed. With Dudian’s strength, the one who could burn him to such a state was most likely the Dragon Clan’s dragon breath, this also meant that Dudian had fought with the patriarch or the mother dragon. In addition to her, only the two of them had the magic marks of a magic dragon.
“It seems that you are lucky to have escaped back. Now You know that my Dragon Clan is not a place that people like you can enter.”Hathaway sneered.
Dudian quietly looked at her, “The Mother Dragon is dead and your father is dead. In addition to the pioneers guarding the wasteland, there are basically no pioneers of your dragon clan in the giant wall. It can be said that your dragon clan has been crippled.”
Hathaway was stunned.
“Take her down.”Dudian said to Neuss.
Hathaway reacted, she sneered: “Nonsense. If you say that you can deal with my father, I will believe you. But you want to deal with the Mother Dragon? The Mother Dragon is the last Saintess of our Dragon Clan. She has outstanding talent and is not inferior to my sister. She was an expert in the wasteland 30 years ago!”
Dudian didn’t say anything.
Neuss dragged Hathaway out of the hall.
“Nonsense! You Want to lie to me? Ridiculous!”Hathaway shouted from outside the hall.
Dudian quietly looked in front of him.
“Let me go! Let Me Go!”Hathaway struggled in anger. She wanted to break free from Neuss but her limbs were broken. Her shoulder blades were pierced with steel nails. She looked at the hall which was getting farther and farther away from her, a look of fear slowly appeared in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 788
chapters.content:
Chapter 788 – Chapter 278: Famine
Dudian asked Neuss to get the God’s marrow when he returned to the hall.
“Master, about the inner wall…”Neuss carefully asked as he took the god’s marrow.
Dudian poured the god’s marrow into the syringe and injected it into his body, he expressionlessly said: “The danger of the inner wall has been eliminated and the intruders have died in our hands. If nothing unexpected happens then there will be no one to block our way.”
He looked at Neuss, “Remember, the news that the intruders have been killed by US must be sealed. We can’t let the inner wall know about it. As long as they don’t know that the intruders have died, they won’t dare to attack us. This is the safest time for us. We will continue to follow the previous pace. When my constitution is further improved then we will dominate the inner wall!”
Neuss was startled. His eyes were filled with disbelief. It seemed that they had won? Was it just a matter of time?
However, he found that there wasn’t much joy on Dudian’s face. His heart couldn’t help but feel uneasy. He knew that Dudian wouldn’t deceive him. But with his understanding of dudian.., if it was necessary then the teenager could deceive and use all the people around him!
He didn’t dare to think too much in order to avoid being exposed. He knew that Dudian’s observation ability. He bowed his head and respectfully retreated.
Dudian injected the god’s marrow into his body. Although he had done this many times but every time he felt strange. In his old ideas, only the patient.., would need to inject foreign substances into his body. He wasn’t sick but he was doing things that only the patient would do. He felt that he was really sick.
As the saying goes, people would have a lot of emotions when they were happy and sad. They would even reminisce about their own lives.
Dudian’s mood was neither happy nor sad. But he also had this kind of reminiscence because he knew that the moment when he dominated the inner wall would come sooner or later. All the obstacles had been removed. He just needed time.., to push him to the supreme throne.
He didn’t feel the slightest joy in his heart when he thought of becoming the Lord of the wall of Sylvia. He was superior to all the people here. This kind of mood also made him recognize his own inner heart and the pursuit of the leader, he didn’t desire. He felt that perhaps he had seen too many people from all walks of life. From the humble to the dust of the poor orphans, to ordinary civilians, wealthy businessmen.., to the nobles who had been banished to the outer wall to amuse themselves, to the true nobles in the inner wall who had been conferred titles by the Divine Kingdom, to the head of the hunting family, to the leaders of such powerful forces as the monastery. He had seen all of them.
After seeing so many of them, he realized that the differences between these people were not that great.
He felt that he might have seen through them.
If he could see through a thing, it would be boring.
If he could see through a person, he would be separated.
If he could see through everyone, he would be disgusted with the world.
Dudian felt that he belonged to the last category. He was tired of the world. Even when he was with others, he could see through their thoughts. He could easily make others happy and make them cry, he knew that some people were respectful to him and made him happy. But to others, they might be arrogant and despotic.
Everyone had a good side and an ugly side.
He happened to see that such thoughts would flood his mind and make him feel bored. Sometimes he even felt that his thoughts were too extreme.
Extreme was easy to lead to destruction.
But he also felt that only by using extreme methods could the truth of the world be verified and the hypocrisy be torn apart.
He tried to give examples, but the result was successful in convincing himself.
“When I find a way to let you recover, we will find a desolate place to live alone. What do you think?”Dudian looked at Aisha, his eyes tender and tender, he occasionally dreamed of living with her on a golden beach by the sea. It was enough for him to live with two people every day.
As for other people and things, he didn’t want to pay attention to them. It was too complicated and he felt tired.
Aisha didn’t answer.
But in Dudian’s eyes, it was a tacit agreement. He smiled and gently held her hand, he whispered: “I will become stronger as time goes on. I believe that I will be able to see what kind of secrets are hidden in the giant wall.”
Dudian called Neuss the next day and asked him to gather a group of loyal people from the dark church.
Neuss received the order. Two days later a group of fifty people were gathered. They were all qualified candidates that Neuss had personally selected.
“The previous intruder stole the god’s corpse from the inner wall. The six of them didn’t bring the god’s corpse with them when they fought with the inner wall. They should have hidden it somewhere. You should lead people to search the outer wall first.”Dudian said.
Neuss suddenly understood, he curiously asked: “Young Master, what is the use of the God’s corpse? It is worth them to come all the way to rob it. Moreover the area of the giant wall is like looking for a needle in a haystack. The probability of finding it should be very low.”
“They won’t hide it too far because they have gone through a lot of trouble to get it. I also want to know what the use of the God’s corpse is. But from the current situation, the god’s corpse should still be in the giant wall.”Dudian said, “Remember to let them hide and not to be exposed.”
“I understand.”Neuss nodded.
Time flew by.
A month and a half passed in the blink of an eye.
The drizzle moistened the ground and covered the entire base in the drizzle.
Dudian quietly looked at the dark clouds outside the window. He could almost see the electric snakes moving in the clouds. After a long time, when the rain gradually stopped, he also came back to his senses. After a moment of silence, he slowly got up, he looked at Aisha: “You have a good rest here. I’m going to the inner wall. I believe I will be back soon.”
Aisha’s pure black eyes seemed to be staring at a point in the air. She didn’t respond.
Dudian was used to it. He smiled and turned around. Neuss was waiting at the door of the hall, “Master, your chariot has been prepared for you. Do you really want to go to the inner wall alone?”
Dudian nodded as he looked at the chariot that was parked in front of him. There were twelve chains on the outside of the chariot. Each chain was connected to a figure with disheveled hair. There were both men and women, even the rebellious Devil Scorpion God and the elder of the monastery were tied to the war chariot.

chapters.title: Chapter 789
chapters.content:
Chapter 789 – Chapter 279: Go Straight To The Yellow Dragon
Dudian’s feet slightly moved as if there was a thrust behind him. He stood in the middle of the carriage and held the cleaver. He whispered: “Go to the inner wall. Full speed.”
Hiro, Luonon and the others who were tied to the side of the carriage heard the order. Their bodies slightly moved as they looked up. There was a pair of dark eyes in their hair. Hiro and Luonon were in the lead, they pulled the war chariots and sped forward. The others pulled the war chariots from the side and ran forward in a fan shape. The chains rattled and the wheels of the war chariots rolled under their tugs.
Soon, the war chariots rushed out of the base and came to the wilderness outside. As they moved forward, they met a shallow stream. They crossed it and crashed into it, causing water to splash everywhere. They were like twelve angry beasts.
Their expressions were numb like puppets. Under the corrosion of the poison pin, their willpower was weak.
They crossed mountains.
They ran into dense forests.
Dudian stood on the war chariot. His eyes looked through the rainy sky as he looked at the wall of Sighs.
The wall of sighs had been blocked by the Knights of light. Many nobles had secretly visited the Holy See during this period of time. They had sent many expensive gifts to the Holy See, but most of them were rejected.
