Dudian didn’t enter through the gap. The eyes of the entire commercial district were focused on the area. All the forces had sent spies to observe the area. He didn’t want to cause any trouble, hiro and the others pulled the carriage from other directions.
When they arrived at the wall of Sighs, the elders of the monastery and the other pioneers immediately spread their wings. Some of them used their crawling ability to pull the carriage to climb up the wall of Sighs, the others were flying in the air. They used chains to pull the carriage. The others who didn’t have the ability to climb over the wall were holding the chains and fishing behind the carriage.
The steep wall of sighs was easily crossed by the joint efforts of the pioneers. Their speed didn’t decrease at all.
“Go to the Imperial City.”Dudian ordered.
The bodies of a few of them trembled as if they knew something. They lowered their heads and continued to pull the war chariot.
The war chariot was flying in the wilderness. Occasionally it would meet one or two undeads that wandered into the wilderness. Hiro and Luonan were responsible for the main direction. They were killed by the undeads. They passed by the border of several cities and directly passed through the imperial city.
“It seems that the intruders haven’t been eliminated and the God’s corpse hasn’t been recovered. I don’t even have the mood to calm down the chaos of corpses.”Dudian noticed that there weren’t many troops in the cities, the broken fortress wasn’t repaired and was in chaos.
“Go to the palace and kill those who block the way!”Dudian coldly said.
Everyone hesitated after hearing Dudian’s words. Hiro and Ronon pulled the chariot again after a short moment of hesitation. The others had no choice but to follow, they had no choice but to put it behind them.
The chariot rushed towards the city gate.
The long line of people in front of the city gate were stunned when they saw the passing of the chariot. They felt incredulous when they saw that the people pulling the chariot were all people. They immediately stepped aside, the only people who could make such a grand display were nobles of noble status.
“Stop!”
“Stop!”
“Who are you? Stop!”
The guards at the city gate saw the war chariots rushing over at high speed. When they saw that the people pulling the war chariots were all beast-like people, they were a little shocked. However, when they saw that the family flag was not inserted into the war chariots, they had no choice but to summon their courage and order the war chariots to stop.
The war chariots didn’t slow down at all.
The guards were surprised as they grabbed their weapons to block the front of the gate.
Hiro and Luonan who were at the front of the group quickly attacked and sent the guards flying. Some of them were hit in the chest. The armor on their chests was dented and their bones and hearts were broken.
“Stop! !”
Dong Dong!
“Someone is trying to break through! Stop Them!”
The guards behind the gate were scared and frightened as they saw Dudian and the others coming. Some of the guards had sounded the alarm.
Dudian’s face was indifferent. He didn’t react. He looked straight ahead. The war chariots were flying in front of the twelve pioneers. They were either killing or repelling the guards in front of them, the war chariot was as weak as a piece of paper. It quickly rushed into the imperial city and ran along the street. The pedestrians on the road were scared and moved away. There were nobles who were riding on the carriages in the middle of the road, they couldn’t avoid the scenery of the shops. Hiro who was leading the way directly lifted the carriage and threw it several meters high. It fell on the side of the road and smashed into pieces. It was unknown whether the people inside were alive or dead.
The carriage swept through the road and no one was spared.
Dudian stood firmly with the sword in his hand. The structure of the carriage was very strong. The body of the carriage bounced up when it ran over the bodies of some passers-by who were killed in the road.
The scenery of the streets of the imperial city quickly retreated in the corner of Dudian’s eyes. The screams and screams of the pedestrians as well as the shocked faces of some nobles were swept by the carriage, he saw many things that he had never seen in the outer wall but he wasn’t in the mood to appreciate them. He narrowed his eyes and waited for the battle to begin soon.
Half an hour later, the war chariots rushed to the front of the palace.
There were a lot of guards gathered at the steps of the palace. They were strong and all of them were limiter. It seemed that they had already received the news and had set up an army here in advance.
Several figures came out from the steps of the palace when the chariot arrived. They looked down at Dudian who was standing on the thousands of steps. Ulita was standing in the middle. Next to him was the military commander, Amos, he was the only one left among the three commanders. One of the other two had died in the battle in the Pagar Mountains while the other had died in the last ambush in the imperial city.
There were four or five generals standing in addition to Amos. They were all pioneers.
“Dudian, do you have to choose this time to attack my imperial city and Seize My Throne?”Urita jumped down. Her figure was light. She came to the height of 30 steps, there was a trace of fear in her eyes as she looked at Dudian who was emitting majestic aura. She felt that Dudian’s temperament had a new change compared to the last time. He was stronger, more introverted and more at ease!
“Is this time special?”Dudian narrowed his eyes as he looked at her, “Could it be that you have a monthly vacation today?”

chapters.title: Chapter 790
chapters.content:
Chapter 790 – Chapter 780: God’S Corpse Suppression
“You!”Urita’s face turned red: “What nonsense are you talking about!”
At this time, Amos and the other generals rushed to Urita’s side from the front of the palace. Amos saw twelve figures tied to the outside of Dudian’s chariot. His face changed, he shouted: “Hiro, Ronon?”
Hiro and Ronon’s bodies trembled as they heard his call. They lowered their heads.
Urita’s face was flushed as she looked at the figures tied to the chariot. There was a trace of fear in her eyes, she angrily said: “Dudian, what did you do to them? Were you the one who broke into the Dragon clan a month and a half ago? Do you know that without the presence of the dragon mother, the intruders will come back at any time and wipe us out? Do you think that you can get the King’s power by colluding with the intruders? You are seeking your own destruction!”
“The Dragon Mother has already frozen to death. What can she do if the intruders return?”Dudian’s expression was indifferent. His words were tantamount to an admission.
Although urita knew that it was Dudian but she couldn’t help but feel anger welling up in her heart when she heard him admit it. She clenched her teeth, “You are worse than a pig or a dog! Do you know that the intruders have stolen the God’s corpse? Without the god’s corpse we will be destroyed! Even if you have supreme power you will die! Do you think you are very smart? You are too stupid!”
Dudian was indifferent.
Urita saw his expression and became even more angry, she angrily said: “Although the ice has melted but it is only temporary. I have the item of God’s kingdom which can let her break the ice and resurrect. But you have killed her and destroyed her body! She can not resurrect anymore. When the intruders come, you and I will die in their hands. Even if they don’t kill you, you will still die if they take away the god’s corpse!”
“Stop scaring people. What does it have to do with my life?”Dudian looked at her in disbelief.
Urita was angry, she gritted her teeth: “Why do you think that those horrible things in the Abyss region didn’t wander to the giant wall? Do you really think that the Witcher family guarding the wasteland is the only resistance? They are scarecrows in front of those horrible things! If there is no god of War of Sylvia to guard the giant wall, these things will come to the giant wall sooner or later. With the population here, it is simply a feast in front of them! By that time even if my father comes back, he may not be able to protect everyone!”
Dudian was startled. Although he had expected that the god’s corpse would leave the giant wall and lead to a disaster, but he didn’t expect that it would lead to those terrifying things living in the abyss. No wonder they valued the god’s corpse so much.
Urita looked at Dudian’s stunned expression. She was angry that the god’s corpse hadn’t been lost. She wouldn’t have openly said such a secret. But she knew that.., even if she had said it, it was a foregone conclusion. The death of the mother dragon was something that couldn’t be changed. It was hateful that Dudian didn’t know about it in advance. He had colluded with the intruders to kill the Mother Dragon and completely destroyed their hope, it was so stupid that she hated him to the point of helplessness.
“It seems that my guess is correct. The God’s corpse is still in the giant wall.”Dudian thought. A month and a half had passed but there were no unusual monsters attacking the giant wall. It meant that the god’s corpse was still here, unfortunately, the intruders hadn’t found the whereabouts of the god’s corpse. The location of the god’s corpse was a bit remote.
However, he would be able to find it very soon after he seized control of the inner wall.
“Scum! Get out of the carriage and die!”Amos shouted at Dudian, he knew that most of them were under Dudian’s control. He was angry because Hiro used to be his subordinate, he had watched him grow up step by step to become a war god. He didn’t expect that he would end up in such a miserable situation.
Dudian glanced at him. He wanted to open his mouth but he suddenly thought that he wouldn’t be able to convince them to surrender. He didn’t want to waste his breath, he drove the chariot and rushed towards Urita and Amos.
Hiro, Ronon and the other pioneers pulled the chariots and rushed towards Dudian. Amos, Urita and the other generals felt cold and sad. Amos’s eyes turned red, he roared and activated his magic body. He took the lead and jumped towards Dudian.
Dudian didn’t use the iron chain protection net. He could only use the life and death of Hiro and the others to restrain the other party. But his purpose was to flatten the place. He stood on the chariot and the splitter in his hand quickly melted, the terrifying magic body appeared. Compared to the Pioneer’s magic body, the current magic body was more complete. Its face was covered with a hard shell. If there was a mirror.., dudian could see that his eyes were no longer the black and white eyes of a human. The whites of his eyes had turned black and his eyeballs had turned into yellow strange eyeballs.
After entering the monster’s body, the things that Dudian saw were completely different from before. His field of vision was maximized at all times. He could see the flesh and bones of the Flying Amos, his blood vessels were swelling and his heart was beating.
He felt that his thoughts had become clearer, faster and calmer than before. There was only the awareness of hunting and killing left in his heart.
He could see the flaw in Amos’attack. It wasn’t from the surface of his body but from a bone under his armpit. This bone was the weak point of his joints, there were only two small bones which meant that the strength was the weakest here.
“Go to hell!”Amos’demonized body was like a crocodile or a lizard. He roared as he raised his claws and hit Dudian’s head.
The sharp limbs on Dudian’s shoulder were like magnets. They were straight up. The ferocious sharp blades reflected the cold luster. He wasn’t afraid of the sharp claws, dudian’s back suddenly shot out a sharp blade. The moment the two approached, it pierced into the armpit of Amos. The surface of the armpit was green scales. It was extremely tough and harder than most steel armor.
Because of this, when he saw Dudian’s terrifying appearance, Amos still dared to pounce on him.
But the moment the sharp blade pierced out, Amos felt a sense of crisis. He wanted to turn his body but it was too late. The next moment, a sharp pain came from his armpit. It went straight to his bone marrow.
His body landed on the chariot. The demonized claws quickly kicked, wanting to retreat and increase the distance between them.

chapters.title: Chapter 791
chapters.content:
Chapter 791 – Chapter 781: Start A Massacre
Dudian was waiting for him to get close to him so he wouldn’t let him get away. He immediately pounced forward and closed the gap between him and Amos. The sharp limbs of his chest suddenly pierced out like a few long daggers.
Amos was shocked. He roared and stomped his feet. The beam under his feet suddenly cracked. His body shrank down and avoided Dudian’s embrace. He went under the carriage and rushed out from behind the wheel.
The pioneers who were tied around the carriage were pulling the carriage. They didn’t attack Yamos.
Dudian didn’t expect them to work for him wholeheartedly. He took off and rushed towards Yamos. He flapped his wings and looked like a black bird.
“How is it possible!”Urita was shocked. Yamos was seriously injured and was at a disadvantage. Dudian’s momentum was like a tiger. He was able to completely suppress yamos. Urita found it hard to believe, yamos had been famous for many years. There were few people who could be said to be better than him. In addition to the previous great national master, there were three people from the family who had retreated behind the scenes.
Urita had noticed that the heat in Dudian’s body had soared to the level of the inner wilderness. But she didn’t expect that Yamos couldn’t control such a newcomer.
Whoosh!
She didn’t dare to continue to watch the fight. She dived down and shouted: “Stop!”
Dudian didn’t look back. His eyes locked onto Yamos. He rushed out at full speed. In the blink of an eye he was close to Yamos.
Yamos’s demonized body was stronger. He was clumsy compared to Dudian. He felt the sound of the wind behind him. He turned around in horror. He quickly swept his tail towards Dudian.
Dudian waved his scythe arm to cut off the tail.
Puff! Puff!
Yamos’s green tail was cut off but Dudian didn’t feel good either. Yamos’s demonized tail was tougher than he had imagined. It made his arm numb but he couldn’t miss the opportunity, he endured the pain in his arm and rushed out. The sharp blades of his body quickly moved like a storm of blades.
The pupils of Amos contracted. He was shocked as he waved his hand. The conical shape of the witcher appeared in his palm.
Puff Puff Puff Puff..
Blood spurted out as pieces of flesh and blood splattered on the ground.
Whoosh!
Dudian’s body passed by Amos and stopped on the way to escape. He turned around and saw urita using the strange shape of a spiritual cat. She quickly rushed over, the ground was littered with pieces of flesh and broken hands. There was almost no complete body. Half of Amos’s head was on the ground. His eyes were wide open.
Dudian licked the blood on his lips. A warm smell of rust was emitted from the tip of his tongue. There was a trace of excitement and bloodlust in his eyes. He didn’t expect that the previous strong inner barren would be so weak, in other words, at the moment he was stronger than he had imagined. This made him more confident than ever.
Urita looked at the pieces of meat scattered in front of Dudian’s feet. There was a trace of shock on her hairy face. She slowed down as she rushed towards Dudian. She wanted to come over to help and cooperate with Amos to kill Dudian, she didn’t expect that Yamos wouldn’t be able to hold on for such a short distance. He had been famous for many years but he had died just like that.
He died so quickly as if he was facing a master!
Dudian stepped forward and stepped over the body of YAMOS. There was dark evil in his eyes, he whispered: “Your Highness, it seems that you have seen through the situation. If you submit to me, I can spare your life. At least I can keep you alive until your father comes back. How about that?”
Urita’s face sank as she heard Dudian’s words, “Cut the crap. I don’t have the right to spare your life. You want to keep me because you want to wait for my father to come back. You want to use me as a hostage to threaten my father. I’m telling you that you are thinking too much! Compared to the giant wall, what am I? My father will kill you on the spot and sacrifice my undead!”
“You are wrong about me.”Dudian approached her step by step, “There are two possibilities to use you as a hostage. Either your father will give in and let me live, or he will kill me to avenge you. No matter what the outcome is, there is a risk. So before your father comes back, I can leave this place. The existence of the intruders has proved that this giant wall is not the only one in the world. I can go live in other giant walls.”
URITA sneered: “Then you go!”
“Do you think I don’t have a way to cross the Abyss?”Dudian slowly said: “Originally I didn’t. But after the appearance of the intruders I did.”
Urita was startled. She suddenly had an answer in her mind, “So that’s the case. You colluded with the intruders. They helped you to get the throne. They told you the way to cross the Abyss. You helped them to take away the god’s corpse so that when my father comes back you will have a way out. No wonder you aren’t afraid of being abandoned by the god’s corpse…”
“Your Highness…”Dudian spoke again. It seemed that he wanted to say something but his figure suddenly rushed forward. It turned out that he had already reached about ten meters away from urita, ten meters was like a step away.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Dudian’s body turned into countless afterimages as he shot out.
Urita didn’t move. After the afterimages flashed by, her figure slowly disappeared like smoke. The next moment, she appeared twenty meters away. Her hairy little face was full of ridicule, “Do you think I didn’t notice this small action? You used to kill people because of this kind of cunning?”
Dudian was surprised as he saw that Urita didn’t feel anything. The last time he saw Urita’s agile speed when she attacked the intruder, he didn’t expect her reaction speed to be faster than he had imagined. It was as fast as lightning. He slightly raised his eyebrows as he heard Urita’s ridicule. He looked at her coldly: “Then I’ll show you how smart you are.”
He turned to the guard in front of the steps.
Urita was shocked as she saw Dudian’s whereabouts: “If you have the ability then come at me!”
Dudian rushed to the guards in front of the stairs.
His body was full of sharp blades and limbs. The guards who were holding the shield and lance were torn into pieces. It was as if a meteorite was falling from the sky. The iron walls were as weak as paper.

chapters.title: Chapter 792
chapters.content:
Chapter 792 – Chapter 782: Becoming King [ First Watch ]
Urita looked at the Royal Guard who was killed in front of Dudian as if he was cutting grass. She couldn’t hold it in any longer. She rushed out as fast as a phantom and approached Dudian’s back, she tore at the back of Dudian’s neck.
There seemed to be eyes on Dudian’s back. As she approached, the sharp limbs on his back quickly rolled and stabbed towards her.
The length of the limbs was more than two meters and immediately forced Urita to retreat.
Dudian ignored her and continued to rush towards the guards.
Urita looked at the familiar faces that were quickly torn apart in front of Dudian. Each and every one of them was spewing warm blood. There were guards who had greeted her in the past, she even knew that the wives of some of the guards were pregnant. It wouldn’t be long before the children would come into the world. But Dudian’s body was mercilessly brandished and they were quickly killed. Almost all of their bodies were incomplete.
She clenched her fists and clenched her teeth. She was angry but helpless. Although she could Dodge Dudian’s attack but she couldn’t get close to him. She could only watch as he massacred.
“How could he have the magic marks of the splitter? He is a pariah in the outer wall. Moreover the changes are even more powerful than that of the grand tutor. Could it be that he has deified the magic marks of the splitter? How could he get such a thing? Damn!”Urita stood behind Dudian, there were screams coming from the slaughterhouse in front of dudian. The well-trained royal guards were like golden wheat in the wheat field.
“Kill!”
“Don’t be afraid! The ones who retreat will die!”
Several pioneers roared in anger behind the royal guards. Three of them were war gods. Their eyes looked like they were about to explode. They activated their magic bodies and rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s strange magic eyes slightly turned. He glanced at the three pioneers who were rushing towards him.
One of the pioneers had green scales all over his body. His body was full of strange bumps. At the same time as he approached Dudian, a green mucus shot out from his throat. The mucus emitted a fishy smell.
Dudian recognized his magic body. It was the Green Monster of the rare monsters. It was a kind of poisonous monster. He was prepared for it. As the venom flew towards him, the sharp limbs on his back pierced into the chest of a guard, he hooked his body and threw it towards the venom.
The venom landed on the back of the guard. Dudian flapped his magic wings and rushed at full speed. In an instant he was in front of the pioneer.
Puff! Puff!
The Pioneer’s eyes were wide open. He didn’t have time to retreat as his body was cut into pieces.
Dudian turned to kill the other two.
The other two war gods saw Dudian’s monstrous power but they weren’t afraid. They roared as if they were going to die.
Dudian was like a killing machine. He stepped on the steps as if he was walking on flat ground. He quickly cut into the front of the two. He waved his blade and pierced through the chest of one of the war gods, he quickly tore his body apart.
Urita found the opportunity and immediately attacked Dudian’s back.
Just when her magic claws were about to hit the back of Dudian’s neck, a few sharp monster limbs stretched out from Dudian’s armpit. They went around his back and stabbed Urita’s throat and face.
Urita’s pupils shrank. She stomped her feet and instantly stopped her body. She stepped back. Her body was covered in cold sweat. Previously she saw the sharp monster limbs on Dudian’s back attacking. She thought that Dudian wouldn’t be able to defend in time, she didn’t expect that the monster’s limbs could go around his back to protect him. It seemed that he could use the monster’s limbs to kill the enemy but deliberately exposed the flaw to draw her close!
She was furious but she didn’t dare to act rashly.
Dudian had killed all three of the military gods. The terrifying monster’s body was like a devil from Hell. No one could stop it!
“I don’t believe that I can’t kill him. I have to take a step back and ask for help from the Monster Institute and the Wing Clan.”Urita looked at the guards who were falling at Dudian’s feet. Her eyes reddened as she clenched her fists, she felt that she had never suffered such humiliation in her life. She could only watch as the guards who were loyal to her died one after another. She had no choice but to flee!
At this moment, she even felt that if time could be reversed, she could give up the opportunity to kill the intruders. She would kill Dudian in the last meeting!
Whoosh!
Urita didn’t look at her anymore. She clenched her teeth and turned to leave.
Dudian’s magic eyes slightly turned. He glanced at Urita’s back. He felt a bit regretful. He couldn’t catch Urita. He had never seen her magic marks before, he guessed that Urita didn’t belong to any of the magic marks in the atlas. It was most likely her father. The Lord of the giant wall had found her high-level magic marks from the Kingdom of God or other giant walls. Her speed was completely faster than his. He wanted to kill her, it was almost impossible. Unless he broke through to the master level then it was possible to crush her with his physique. He wanted to use the death of the guards to anger her so that she would lose her mind and attack him, but he didn’t expect her to hold back.
He regretted that he couldn’t capture Urita. It would take more time for him to control the inner wall.
“Your Highness has abandoned you. Those who surrender will live and those who fight will die!”Dudian shouted at the guard in front of him.
His voice echoed throughout the hall. It was so loud that the eardrums of those who were close to him began to buzz.
The guards who were standing at the back woke up after hearing Dudian’s words. They looked around and saw the figure of Urita who was thousands of meters away. Many people looked at each other in dismay.
Many of the guards clenched their teeth and threw their weapons away.
However some of the guards roared and continued to attack Dudian.
A few minutes later, the battle came to an end or the massacre was over.
Blood flowed like a river on the thousands of steps leading to the royal palace. Countless corpses and limbs were scattered. The bloody scene was shocking.
There were hundreds of guards who bowed their heads and chose to surrender. Dudian left them alive. They looked at the corpses of their companions. Their faces were pale and their hearts were sad.
“From today onwards, I will be the wall master of Sylvia. Those who submit to me will be promoted to nobility. Those who resist will be killed without mercy!”Dudian stood on the steps, the terrifying magic body was exuding an intimidating aura. His voice was loud and echoed throughout the palace. Although his words were a bit stupid but he knew that he had to say it.
This was his attitude so that all the servants, guards, or civil servants in the palace knew what he meant.
Moreover, this sentence meant that the era of Ulita’s rule no longer existed. Even those who supported Ulita would be labeled as ‘rebellious’.
The winner was the king and the loser was the bandit.
Dudian’s body was stained with blood as he walked step by step towards the palace. The servants on both sides were trembling as they looked at him in fear. They bowed their heads and stepped aside.

chapters.title: Chapter 793
chapters.content:
Chapter 793 – Chapter 783: [ Second Update ]
Dudian stepped into the palace and stepped on the gorgeous red carpet to sit on the throne. There were many servants and maids standing in the hall. Their heads were lowered as they secretly looked at dudian. Their eyes were full of fear.
Dudian glanced at a young servant with a baby face who was not far away: “Who is in charge of the palace when Urita is not here?”
The young servant’s body trembled as he took a small step forward. He stammered: “Master, Your Highness, if His Highness is not around then the master of the palace will be in charge.”
“Master of the palace? Isn’t he dead? Who is the new master of the Palace?”
“Yes, he is.”
“Go and call him over.”
The young servant’s face was pale as he secretly looked at the youth in dark gold robe.
The youth was standing next to several attendants. His face turned ugly when he saw Dudian mention about the Grand National Master. He knew that he couldn’t escape so he took the initiative to step out, he bowed to dudian: “Master, I am the new Grand National Master. You can call me ‘Saul’.”
Dudian looked at him. The heat reaction in his body was limited but it couldn’t be ruled out to control the heat fluctuation. After all, the previous Grand National Master was a pioneer, his voice was flat and inscrutable: “I didn’t see you attack when they attacked me. Are you betraying me?”
Saul’s face slightly changed. He didn’t expect that Dudian wouldn’t ask about anything else. Instead, he wanted to investigate on behalf of Urita. He quickly guessed Dudian’s thoughts and smiled bitterly, “Master, it’s not that I don’t want to attack. But I know that my strength is low. If I attack directly, I will certainly be slaughtered by you. I’m Looking for your weakness but I haven’t found it yet. You have killed them and forced his highness to flee.”
Dudian knew that this person’s emotional quotient was high, he said: “There is a saying that ‘a wise man understands the situation’. It means that a person who understands the situation and adapts to the situation is a hero. Do you intend to continue to be loyal to Urita or to me?”The original meaning of this sentence was naturally not the same, but he could misinterpret it as what he wanted to express.
Saul knew that he had no choice. He knew that the outcome of the battle had been decided when Urita attacked Dudian. He pretended to hesitate but hesitated for a while, he clenched his teeth: “My Lord is right. I am willing to be loyal to you!”
“In that case, you come up.”
Saul was a bit hesitant. But he thought that it would be easy for Dudian to kill him. He gathered his courage and went forward.
Dudian stood up and gave up the throne: “Sit Down.”
Saul’s face slightly changed. Only the king and Urita had sat on the throne. Although he was the national master but to sit on the throne was tantamount to treason! He immediately understood Dudian’s meaning. Once he sat down there would be no turning back. If he didn’t sit down then he would lose his head!
He glanced at the hall and saw many guards and maids looking at him. There were a few cabinet ministers who were discussing in the palace. They were also watching from below. Once he sat down, although he was being coerced.., but once word got out, it would be hard to clear his name. This made him very hesitant. He didn’t think that the loyalty test would come so fast and so ruthless!
“What? You Don’t dare to sit?”Dudian looked at him as if he could see the depths of his soul.
Saul squeezed out a smile: “My Lord, this is your throne. I sit… isn’t it a bit inappropriate?”
“What’s wrong with it? Since you have submitted to me, can’t you do such a small thing?”There was a trace of coldness in Dudian’s eyes.
Saul looked at Dudian’s strange demonized eyes. He felt like he was being stared at by a poisonous snake. He braced himself and said: “Since my Lord has said so, then I have no choice but to sit down!” He slowly sat down.
Dudian nodded: “How do you feel?”
Saul bitterly smiled in his heart. He whispered: “This throne is too honorable. It is not suitable for people of my status to sit on it.”He stood up, he moved aside.
Dudian didn’t ask him to continue to sit. He knew what Saul was worried about. Although he had defeated Urita today. No one could stop him in the inner wall but there were two major factors in the hearts of others, the first factor was the joint attack of the Institute of Magic and the family. It was possible to defeat him. The second factor was the return of the giant wall!
Dudian knew that the second factor would be the last hope in everyone’s heart.
However, no one knew when the giant wall would return. If he came back then he would have to hide outside the giant wall. But if he came back too late then he would have the capital to negotiate with the giant wall.
If he had more time then he would be able to build a large power station. Even if the giant wall returned then he would be able to kill it!
Dudian needed to control the entire inner wall. No matter what kind of hope they had he would use force to suppress them!
“Send people to block the news here. In addition inform the most authoritative newspaper that the city is looking for Urita. The crime is colluding with the intruders to cause chaos and squeeze money from the civilians!”Dudian said to Saul.
Saul was stunned as he heard Dudian’s words. Wanted Urita? She was the only princess of Sylvia! How could she become a wanted criminal in the blink of an eye? Moreover, the crime was false and malicious!
“What? Can’t do it?”
Saul quickly replied: “Yes, yes!”
“Urita’s escape is most likely because she contacted the Institute of Magic and the Witcher family to make a comeback. But after the war with the intruders, their remaining forces are unable to contend with me. Send a letter to them and tell them that anyone who wants to help Urita will be treated as a traitor. Cut off all transactions with them. Anyone who has dealings with them will be punished!”Dudian said in a cold tone.
Saul was startled: “Master, even if I send a message to them, they might not listen to me. After all, Her Highness is the princess and the only daughter of the wall master. They will definitely help her.”
“I know.”Dudian said: “But the letter must be sent.”
Saul looked at him and felt a bit strange. He thought that they would be able to see through his intention. Wouldn’t they want to separate them one by one and then break them one by one? “Doesn’t this mean that you helped Ulita push forward their alliance and force them to join forces to attack you as soon as possible?”?
He thought so in his heart, but he didn’t say it out loud and agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 794
chapters.content:
Chapter 794 – Chapter 784: Wing King
Whoosh!
Ulita ran at full speed, like a white phantom sweeping across the rooftops of the buildings on the streets. A moment later, she rushed out of the imperial city. The vast wilderness came into view, and she felt as if waves of shrill screams were still lingering in her ears, the image of blood splattering appeared in her mind, and she could not get rid of it. She bit her lip slightly. She had never thought that she would have such a humiliating and miserable time, like a stray dog.
After flying out of the Imperial City, she went straight to the territory of the wing clan.
Although the territory of the Dragon clan was the closest to the imperial city, there wasn’t much combat strength left in the Dragon Clan. It was the same for the territory of the Rock clan. Not to mention that the rock demon was the only expert of the Rock clan, it had also died in the war of the intruders. Although there were seven or eight pioneers left but after seeing Dudian’s demon, she knew that ordinary pioneers were no longer a threat to him, unless there were some magic marks with special abilities.
But most of the magic marks were mainly used for close combat, attack or defense. These two types of magic marks contained all kinds of strange attacks. There were countless defensive types. There were fat types, there were scales, bones and so on.
“I should be able to kill wing king with the help of the magic marks of the splitter. He can attack from a distance. The snake can block him from the front while I will interfere from the side. Although his magic marks are terrifying but his defense is weak. As long as he is injured he will slowly weaken and wear him out…”urita secretly planned to retaliate, fortunately, although Dudian was strong, he wasn’t as tyrannical as the lord of the intruders. Although he was able to look down on the other masters of the wasteland by relying on the magic marks of the splitter, but the rest of their strength was not to be underestimated.
“Find the dean of the monastery and the other top masters of the wasteland to coordinate with them. If they attack together, he will die!”Ulita’s eyes flashed, she found an outlet to vent the anger in her heart. She sneered but the next moment, her body stiffened and stopped in place.
Her face turned ugly. She remembered that Dudian was not alone! Behind him was the corpse of the Dragon Saintess ‘Aisha’! Moreover, Dudian had said that Aisha had awakened five times. From the reaction of the Dragon Clan, it seemed that they were not surprised.
Moreover, she knew that after the death of the Witcher family, the bloodline would naturally awaken. Moreover, it would awaken every once in a while.
After a long time, Aisha would eventually reach the level of seven times awakening!
Once she awakened seven times, it would be equivalent to the level of an Abyss Walker. She would be even more ferocious than an ordinary abyss walker!
“Aisha who has awakened five times is equivalent to an inner wasteland expert. Moreover, she is more powerful than an ordinary inner wasteland expert. She is at the level of dragon mother, Wing King, and Rock Demon. He has Aisha’s help, and we alone…”her face was pale, she didn’t dare to think further because the answer had clearly appeared in her heart — she couldn’t kill Dudian by relying on the remaining combat power in the wall!
Although she didn’t want to admit the cruel fact, but the fact was in front of her eyes so she had to admit it.
“The battle with the intruders had caused the death of the dragon mother. More than half of the other experts were killed or injured. He jumped out at this time and attacked my palace. It turned out that everything was calculated. He knows that we have no trump cards…”urita muttered to herself, she looked at the vast wilderness. She suddenly felt that the world was big but there was no place for her to stay.
She was born with a golden spoon in her mouth. At this moment, she also lamented that her fate was unfair. Dudian’s luck was too good. The appearance of the intruders had helped him to exhaust their combat power. This led to him being born as a pariah in the outer wall, he had stepped onto the supreme throne of the giant wall. It was like an earthworm on the edge of a sewer. He had suddenly become a noble and magnificent God.
After a long time, Urita slowly recovered. The depression, loss and sadness in her eyes slowly disappeared. Her thoughts turned over and over again. In the end she rushed forward again.
She thought of the words her father had extracted from an ancient book of the old era: if you don’t know what to do, then go ahead and run!
She continued to run forward, and confidence slowly surged in her heart again. Although she had no chance of winning in terms of the combat strength of both sides, the battlefield was constantly changing. Military Commander Amos had once told her when she was young, war was different from numbers. Although both sides competed in the number of soldiers, equipment, comprehensive combat strength, and so on, the number was one minus one, equal to zero. And War was one minus one, which was equal to one, and sometimes it was even equal to two!
Since a frontal attack was not enough, they would ambush and sneak attack.
Ulita clenched her fists. No matter what, she would take back her home!
Two hours later, Ulita arrived at the wings race’s territory. She had been here before, so when the guards saw her, they were all shocked and immediately bowed.
Ulita looked at the people living in the winged race’s territory. It was still a peaceful atmosphere, as if she did not know about the changes in the imperial city. She sighed in her heart. Her father had said that although the winged race was rebellious, they were the most loyal to the imperial family, just from this point alone, it could be seen that the intelligence network the winged race had set up in the imperial city was too weak.
“Why would your highness have the time to come here to play?”In the winged race’s main hall, the thin old man sitting at the top was the winged king. He watched as Ulita trotted into the main hall, and the gentle smile in his eyes gradually disappeared, there was a trace of surprise: “Your Highness, did something happen? Did the intruders appear again?”
Urita looked at the elders of the wing clan who were sitting next to her. She didn’t hesitate, she immediately said to wing king: “Uncle Wing, I’m not here to see you about the intruders. Do you remember the last meeting? Dudian attacked my palace and killed Commander Amos. He wanted to occupy the imperial city and become a king. He wanted to become a wall master!”
Wing king was slightly stunned. His eyes widened and he said in shock, “Him? I have an impression of him, but he is only an outer wilderness level pioneer, right? How could he fight Commander Amos? Did he sneak attack you?”
Ulita’s face was calm, she shook her head and said, “He attacked head-on. In the past one and a half months, he has already broken through and become an inner wilderness level master like us. Moreover, his magic marks are the legendary Splitter’s magic marks. The shape is somewhat different from the Grand Tutor’s. I suspect that his magic marks might even be the deified splitter’s magic marks!”
The wing king was stunned. Among the legendary monsters, the splitter was even higher than the wing clan’s bat-sounders. Only the Dragon Clan’s Dragon Clan’s Dragon Clan’s Dragon Clan’s dragon clan could firmly suppress one, he could not help but ask, “Your Highness, are you sure? Not only is he the splitter’s magic mark, he’s also deified?”
“Basically, I am sure,”Ulita said seriously. “His physique is slightly higher than that of an ordinary inner desolation level expert. Although he is not as strong as the ruler, he is not far from it. If he is only at the level of the Grand National Master, with my speed, he would not be able to react at all. If Commander Yamos and I attacked together, it would be enough to kill him. However, during the battle, although he could not keep up with my speed, he was able to use silence to stop me from getting close to him. As a result, Commander Yamos was killed. I was also lucky enough to escape.”
Wing King looked at him in a daze. He felt that the sudden information was too much for him to digest. In his impression, the youth who used to sit next to him in a meeting was not eye-catching at all. He did not take it to heart at all, the only person who looked at him twice was curious about how he controlled Aisha who had turned into a corpse. As for himself, he did not care.
However, he did not expect such a small figure to become an inner wilderness-level powerhouse. After all, even the Witcher clan that had dozens of pioneers only had one or two inner wilderness-level powerhouses, it was clear how harsh the conditions and resources needed to nurture an inner wilderness-level powerhouse were!
“He must be from the outer wall. How could he grow to this extent in such a desolate and barren place?”Wing King seemed to be talking to himself. He found it hard to believe in his heart, but he knew that Ulita would not lie.

chapters.title: Chapter 795
chapters.content:
Chapter 795 – Chapter 785: Fear
“Isn’t he on good terms with Aisha? When Aisha was dismissed as the saintess, she must have violated the taboo of the clan. I guess that it was likely that Aisha transferred the resources of the Dragon clan to him, which was why he was dismissed. And because of that, he, an ordinary kid from the outer wall, was able to become a pioneer!”Ulita’s eyes flashed, he reasoned, “With Aisha’s help and fortuitous encounters, it is not surprising that he has become a renowned expert in the Inner Wilderness.”
Wing King felt that what she said made sense. However, he knew that the process was not something that could be summarized with just a few words. Even if an ordinary person had such an opportunity, it was extremely difficult for them to take it step by step, furthermore, as a half-successful person, he was very clear that the most difficult thing to overcome on the path of success was not the difficulties brought by the outside world, but his desire to be at ease.
He did not have such an idea, so he obediently submitted to the wall master, unlike the dragon mother and the rock demon who had hidden their ambitions.
“This little brat is not simple!”Wing King narrowed his eyes, he slowly said, “According to what you said, he is the deified splitter’s magic marks, stronger than the grand tutor. Even if you and I work together, we most likely won’t be able to compete with him. We still have to work together with those old fellows from the monastery and the Monster Research Institute. Are they willing to help?” He looked at Ulita.
Ulita shook her head, “When I escaped the capital, the first thing I did was come to you. I haven’t looked for them, but I think they will definitely help. After all, I am acting as the wall master now. They should not dare to disobey my orders!”
“It’s not that simple.”Wing King had expected that she had never been to the other two places, he said slowly, “They don’t want me to be so easy to talk to. You know that the Monster Research Institute is not a local faction of our Sylvia, but someone planted here by the divine kingdom. Even your father could not force them to do so. The last time they stole the god’s corpse, they would help because the god’s corpse was not around. Sylvia would suffer a devastating blow and endanger them. However, it’s different this time. This kid surnamed du has seized the throne and it has nothing to do with them. It doesn’t matter who becomes the wall master to them. Anyway, they don’t dare to touch them. Otherwise, when the envoys of the divine kingdom come to visit, they would not let them off so easily. Therefore, it’s a little difficult to get the monster research institute to help.”
Ulita’s expression changed slightly. “That won’t happen. We’ve been together for so many years. The royal family will try our best to cooperate with the things that the monster research needs. It’s impossible for them not to be grateful!”
“When you are in a high position, they will be grateful for your kindness. But after you fall from the throne, they might not remember who you are.”Wing king shook his head slightly. He was older, so he had a more thorough and indifferent view of the ways of the world.
Urita looked at him in a daze. She suddenly wanted to cry. She was already at a disadvantage, could it be that she was going to lose the Monster Research Institute? Without the Monster Research Institute’s Dragon Snake, just her and wing king?
“Don’t be anxious, sit down and drink some water.”Wing king saw the disappointment in her eyes and sighed.
Urita was not in the mood to drink water and rest. She looked up at him, “Uncle Wing King, what do you think we should do? Is there no way to convince the Monster Research Institute?”
Wing King Sighed, he said, “It’s very difficult. In my opinion, we can only tolerate this matter for now. You just said that this kid is stronger than the grand tutor. Don’t forget that he has Aisha who has awakened five times. Although we don’t know whether Aisha’s five times awakening is real or fake, that Aisha was a real thorny person when she was alive. Now that she has turned into a corpse, her physique will definitely increase greatly. Her bloodline will also continue to awaken automatically. Relying on us alone is really powerless. We can only wait for your father to return before we can kill this kid. By then, you can also return to the capital.”
Urita saw through his thoughts and widened her eyes, “You mean, I will hide for now until my father returns?”
“That’s the only way.”Wing king nodded, his face filled with regret.
Urita was furious. She did not expect him to be so cowardly, but she did not dare to scold him, gritting her teeth, she said, “Uncle Wing King, my father has only been in the divine kingdom for five to six years. He usually goes for ten years. This time, it is very likely that he will be gone for ten years as well, returning with the messenger of the Divine Kingdom! “Before he returns, do you want me to live in the Shadows of darkness for four to five years?”
“Your Highness, don’t be so pessimistic. Perhaps your father will return very soon!”Wing king persuaded, “Moreover, to achieve great things, a moment of patience is nothing. This kid surnamed Du was able to succeed today. Isn’t he also enduring patiently?”
Ulita gritted her teeth, “It’s not that I’m pessimistic, nor is it that I can’t endure. It’s that the enemy is right in front of us. We have the ability and hope to kill him, but we are afraid of failure. We can only watch him act arrogantly. Furthermore, according to my guess, my father will probably stay in the divine kingdom for ten years this time. When he returns, it will be four to five years later. By then, this brat will have become the ruler. Even if my father returns, he will be able to escape to the wilderness and live outside the wall for a long time.”
“How did your Highness know that your father was going to be gone for ten years?”
“When the intruders attacked us this time, the wall master behind them must have gotten the news from the divine kingdom and knew that my father wasn’t around. They chose to invade our giant wall at this time because they must have made detailed plans and calculated the time they would arrive here. They also knew that even if there was an error during this time, there would be enough time to avoid bumping into my father!”Ulita gritted her teeth, “This means that my father will not return for a short period of time!”
Wing King was stunned. He suddenly came to a realization, but he quickly thought of the problem of the intruders, “This intruder was taken away by that Brat during the last battle. where is he now? The God corpse is still in their hands. Could it be that they have already taken the god corpse and left this place?”
Ulita’s mood was chaotic. “I don’t know either, but he has colluded with these intruders. He shouldn’t let them take the god corpse just like that. As for the specifics, we have to take him down before we can find out.”
Wing King’s gaze shifted. “Your Highness, there’s no need to be anxious. Perhaps we can try to contact the intruders and make them lose.”
Ulita was slightly startled. She glanced at him with a hint of disappointment in her eyes. She remained silent and did not say anything.
Half an hour later, a secret letter arrived.
Wing king took it and glanced at it. He immediately raised his head to look at Ulita and said, “Your Highness, it’s from that Brat.”After saying that, he handed the letter to her.
Ulita took it and looked at it. She was so angry that her eyes almost turned black. This letter actually said that she had colluded with the intruders to create a mess of corpses? And wanted her to be wanted? The most infuriating thing was that she saw the bottom stamp of the royal scepter under the letter. This meant that this was genuine royal news!
“Your Highness, I see that there is a royal stamp on the letter. It seems that someone in the palace has betrayed you.”Wing King said in a low voice, “He wants to reverse the truth and put you on the wanted list. If you sit firmly on the throne, he will probably attack the counts next. I just don’t know how many of the twelve lords can withstand it.”
Urita’s face slightly changed. How many people could stand up for her in the face of life and death?
In the palace.
Dudian told Saul to send letters to the twelve counts, barons, viscounts and other nobles to inform them of the news of their succession.
The so-called congratulations was a screening. Those who didn’t come were enemies.
The nobles who received the letter would naturally know about this.
Dudian only needed to wait for them to make a choice. If they chose to be the enemy then he only needed to kill them.
“The next step is to see the reaction of the Monster Institute.”Dudian’s heart was a bit anxious. The moment he sat on the throne he was most anxious to get the attitude of the Monster Institute, if he could conquer the Monster Institute as soon as possible, he would be able to learn all the top-secret information about the corpse transformation as soon as possible. For him, even if he became the wall master, he wouldn’t have the heart to take care of the things in the wall. In any case, the wall master would return sooner or later.., he only hoped to find a way to cure Aisha during this time and to plan a new way out for himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 796
chapters.content:
Chapter 796 – Chapter 786: Bloody Day (Part One)
Mount St. Lucia, the headquarters of the Monster Research Institute.
A pitch-black mountain path snaked like a snake, leading straight to the peak of the mountain. On the square at the peak of the mountain stood sculptures of all kinds of ferocious monsters, as if they were from another world. Some familiar monsters could be seen among them, such as the splitter, the magic dragon.., legendary monsters such as the bat musician had different postures and looked lifelike as they looked down at the mountain path outside the square. Anyone who came here from the mountain path would have a terrible feeling of being stared at by many monsters.
Behind these ferocious monster sculptures was a dark building. No matter how brilliant the Sunny Day was, this place was gloomy and dead silent. All the light seemed to have been absorbed by the sculptures on the square, leaving only the gloom.
In one of the buildings, there were piles of books. This was the library of the Monster Research Institute’s Headquarters and also the place where the director stayed all year round. It was more like an office than the council hall.
“Director, there is a letter from the palace.”A shadow wearing a dark purple robe and a silver hood quietly came to the ground floor of the library. He whispered in front of a curved bookshelf that was four to five meters long.
There was an old man with silver hair sitting on the bookshelf. He was wearing a brown scholar’s robe and presbyopia glasses. He was holding a book with a dark red cover. There was a string of letters on the book. If Dudian saw it, he would recognize it, this was the English of the old era. The silver-haired old man was reading the book as if he was reading the contents.
The silver-haired old man looked up at the shadow and took the letter. It was a secret letter. He took out the letter and looked at it. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes, “The palace has been attacked?”
The person who was covered in shadow said in a low voice, “I just received the news. The palace has been attacked. The news in the palace is still unknown. The intruders are inside. His Highness Ulita’s whereabouts are unknown. Does this letter ask us to go and reinforce them?”
“I see.”The silver-haired old man shook his finger and caught the letter. He handed it to the torch beside him and burned it into ashes, “The letter was not sent by His Highness, but by the person who attacked the palace. He said that His Highness colluded with the intruders outside the wall to create a mess of corpses. The loss of the God’s corpse was planned by His Highness. Ha, this person is thick-skinned enough to convict little ulita as soon as he drove her away. He even asked us to cooperate and capture her.”
The shadow was slightly startled and seemed to be relieved. “So, the person who attacked the palace was not an intruder who robbed the god’s corpse. I didn’t expect that someone would take advantage of the situation. Chief, are we going to help His Highness Ulita get rid of this person?”
The silver-haired old man put down the book in his hand, he muttered, “Commander Amos and Little Ulita are guarding the palace. Both of them are masters of the inner wasteland. The fact that this person could defeat them and make it difficult for little ulita to fight against them shows that he is also a rather difficult master of the inner wasteland. If Little Ulita’s ‘Lightstrider’magic marks were ranked in the divine wall of Sylvia, they would probably be on par with the Magic Dragon. The person who could defeat her is at least on the same level as the dragon mother who did not activate the power of the ice magic. With the current strength of our institute, even if we wanted to help, we would not be able to do anything.”
Yin Ying understood and nodded. “This person has been in hiding for a long time. It just so happened that we were fighting for the weakest moment with the intruders and he suddenly attacked. He should have prepared for a long time. What a despicable person!”
The silver-haired old man nodded, he said indifferently, “But it is precisely because he is despicable that he has succeeded now. We don’t need to worry about this matter. The intruders are very likely still hiding here. From the success of the luring plan last time, we can see that these intruders will not let this matter rest. They should take revenge and slaughter all of our people here. This is the most troublesome matter.”
Shadow was stunned for a moment. “They haven’t left yet? How is that possible? But it has been more than a month, and they haven’t received any news at all. Aren’t they in a hurry to report back?”
“If they have already left with the god corpse, I reckon it won’t be so peaceful for the next few days.”The silver-haired old man seemed to have thought of something, he said, “I reckon it won’t be long before his highness comes here to ask for help. I Won’t see her anymore. This child has spoiled me since young, so it’s not good for me to reject her face to face. It’s better for you to go and say it. Let her wait quietly for her father’s return and rest here for the time being.”
The shadow nodded and said doubtfully, “Director, since you know that they have not left, why don’t we take this opportunity to take back the god’s corpse from their hands?”
“Too difficult.”The silver-haired old man sighed, “We have tried our best,”he said. “Leave the rest to fate. If it doesn’t work out, just ask the Kingdom of God to send another one. It’s just that we’ll have to suffer a little in the middle.”
..
..
The Secret Letter of the royal family was sent to all the nobles in the cities. Now that the chaos of the dead had subsided, and it was the limiters who sent the secret letter, the communication speed was extremely fast. In just half a day, the message could be sent to all the nobles.
“Dudian? Who is he? How dare he call himself the Lord of the Wall?”
“It is ridiculous that we should be asked to assist in the arrest of the Princess!”
“Her Highness colluded with intruders to steal the god’s corpse? Hehe, what a load of nonsense!”
“This person’s surname is quite strange. It seems that there is no such surname among the three great demon-hunter families. He was able to send the news through the secret letter of the royal family. He must have taken control of the palace. According to the letter, the whereabouts of the palace master is unknown. Her Highness the princess has been valiant and good at fighting since young. At such a young age, she has long been on the same level as those old guys of the demon-hunter family. How could she not be able to do anything to this person? How Strange!”
When the nobles of the various cities received the secret letters, they were all in an uproar. They immediately contacted each other to confirm the authenticity of the news. Very quickly, they unified the source of the news and shared the information network that the earl had planted in the royal city, they received the latest news from the royal palace.
When the news was sent back, the nobles were once again in an uproar. They did not expect that the royal palace would actually be occupied by someone without anyone knowing. and the legitimate princess had actually become a wanted criminal at this moment!
Even in the streets and alleys of the royal city, the military had put up wanted posters!
It was too sudden and too fast. All the nobles felt like they were in a dream.
“Let me go to the succession ceremony? Humph, wishful thinking!”
“Quickly find out who this Dudian is and where he came from.”
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian had breakfast in the warm and luxurious restaurant. He estimated that the time was about right to give these people a buffer time. It was time for them to express their attitudes.
“The Institute of Monsters hasn’t replied to the letter so far. I don’t think they are going to pay attention to it. Since they have chosen to wait and see, I will let you have a good look.”Dudian walked out of the palace accompanied by Saul. He looked at the thousands of steps in front of him, although the corpses had been treated but there was still a strong smell of blood in the gap between the steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 797
chapters.content:
Chapter 797 – Chapter 787: Bloody Day (Middle)
“Which of the twelve counts has the least servants?”Dudian asked Saul who was next to him. He had sent an invitation letter to the twelve counts but there was no reply, in the past three days there were only a few small nobles who came to seek refuge with Dudian. They wanted to be promoted to nobility and be rewarded with territory. Dudian didn’t care about them and let Saul temporarily settle down in a hotel near the palace.
“The least number of servants?”Saul was surprised. He didn’t think that Dudian would ask such a strange question. He already knew what Dudian was going to do but what he was going to do had nothing to do with the number of servants? He couldn’t figure it out, “Your Highness, as far as I know Count Hemin has the least number of servants. Count Hemin is eccentric and doesn’t like to interact with people. He rarely attends the banquet held by the nobles. Even the banquet held by the royal family often doesn’t come. In addition to him there is only one daughter left in his family. He doesn’t have many children…”
Saul was startled. He suddenly realized the purpose of Dudian’s question.
There weren’t many servants in the family. Dudian wanted to choose an earl who had fewer family members?
He looked at Dudian but only saw his side face. He was indifferent and didn’t have any sense of human feelings. There was an illusion in his heart. But soon he thought of Count Siming. Although he was eccentric.., but he was also a well-known count who was infatuated with his wife. His wife had died early and he had only left a daughter. He hadn’t married for the rest of his life which led to the lack of connections in the family.
His wife was an ordinary singer. In the past he had pursued his wife in spite of the rumors and became a legend of the bards. Later on his wife’s virginity was widely spread. He was a pitiful person.., was he going to be the first to die?
He sighed in his heart. He didn’t say anything else. Who wouldn’t be pitiful in the face of Death?
“Ximing…”Dudian whispered. He remembered the name. Two wings quickly grew out from the gap of the splitter’s armor.
Half an hour later Dudian came to a big city not far from the imperial city. There was a white flower flag on the high city wall. It was a kind of flower called ‘snowbird’. It represented the family of Count Ximing.
Looking from the sky, the city was not as dilapidated as other disaster cities.
Dudian flew into the city. Not long after, two figures suddenly flew in front of him. Both of them had strange wings on their backs. One of them had huge wings that looked like a butterfly. The other one’s wings were vibrating very fast, the thin wings were transparent and there were silver lines on the wings.
“May I know who you are?”The mature woman with butterfly wings asked Dudian carefully.
Dudian saw that the heat source reaction of the two was limited. However the magic marks were rare magic marks which had good life preservation ability. He didn’t slow down as he shouted: “Get lost!”
The expression of the two changed. The mature woman held back her anger: “This is the territory of Count Siming. If you want to visit, please report your life. We will help you…” She stopped as she saw Dudian didn’t slow down. On the contrary, a shocking murderous aura was emitted from him. She was so scared that she quickly dodged to the side.
Whoosh!
Dudian passed through the two’s bodies.
The two reacted when they saw Dudian’s back. They knew that they had derelict their duty. They looked at each other and immediately chased after him.
Although they were chasing but they felt that they were flying backward. They were getting farther and farther away from Dudian’s back.
A moment later, Dudian came to an old castle in the west of the city center. There were bustling streets ten miles away from the castle. However, there were vast fields and green hills near the castle, there were large orchards and manors. There was a large horse farm behind the castle. There were a few ant-like workers leading their horses on the green grass.
Dudian squinted his eyes as he saw the scene. If it wasn’t for the flag on the castle, he wouldn’t believe that this was the place where an earl lived. It was too simple, moreover the area of the huge horse farm required an immeasurable amount of wealth. But the feeling it gave was very primitive. It was completely different from the other nobles who lived in the Golden Zone.
Dudian dived down and landed in front of the main gate of the castle.
“Who? !”
“Who are you? How dare you!”
The guard behind the Iron Gate was frightened by Dudian who fell from the sky.
Dudian pushed open the iron gate. The lock creaked and the Iron Gate was broken. He looked at the guard behind the iron gate: “Is this the castle of Count Hemin?”
The guards reacted and pulled out their swords. They surrounded Dudian. The reason why they were shocked wasn’t because of Dudian’s casual display of power. After all, such power could be achieved by ordinary people, they didn’t think that someone would dare to intrude into the castle without saying a word. Even the big figures they knew wouldn’t do so!
“How dare he intrude into the castle! take him down!”
“Damn Kid!”
The guards immediately attacked Dudian.
Dudian frowned as he stepped forward. The magic wings on his back flashed and shadows flashed. The guards who were surrounding him froze in place and scattered into pieces.
Dudian followed the gravel path to the front of the castle. There were some maids who were holding quilts to dry in the manor. They were curious as they saw Dudian’s strange clothes.
“The defense is so weak…”Dudian’s eyes penetrated through the castle. He found that there was only one pioneer level heat source reaction. The rest were mostly hunters. There were only about twenty of them, it didn’t seem like the strength of an earl but it was in line with the criteria of his selection.
“Who is it? !”
A few knights rushed out of the castle. They were wearing heavy armor and looked at Dudian. They were the first to notice the unusual situation at the door.
“I want to see Ximing.”Dudian said.
“If you want to visit the Earl, you need to get his invitation or wait for us to inform you!”The Knights looked at Dudian coldly. If they didn’t feel that Dudian’s strength was unusual then they would have taken him down.
Dudian noticed that the only pioneer in the castle was aware of the movement and rushed over. He didn’t act immediately but quietly waited.
The knights frowned as they saw that Dudian didn’t speak. They slowly stepped forward.
Whoosh!
The castle’s gate was suddenly blown by the wind. An old man wearing a white robe floated out and landed in front of the Knights. He looked up and down at dudian. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes: “You Are?”
The knights behind him didn’t expect that he would be alarmed. They were surprised to see him using honorifics to dudian.
“Are you the only pioneer here?”Dudian casually asked as he looked at the old man.
The old man smiled: “I’m the only one here. I don’t know who you are. How come I’ve never seen you before?”
Dudian indifferently replied: “You haven’t seen me but you should have heard of me. Three days ago my invitation was sent to your Earl. He was invited to participate in my succession ceremony. Why hasn’t he replied?”
The old man was stunned: “You, you are…”
“Why? Didn’t he tell you about this?”Dudian looked at him.
The old man quickly replied: “No, no. The Earl has told me about this. It’s just that the Earl has been ill recently so it’s inconvenient for him to attend. Please forgive me.” There was a bit of cold sweat on his wrinkled face.
“I don’t want to talk nonsense. I came here personally so I want a satisfactory answer. Either Ximing will go to my succession ceremony to congratulate me and help me to arrest the traitor Ulita, or you can be the chicken in my hands. There is an old saying called ‘kill the chicken to warn the monkey’. It means to kill the chicken to show the monkey. It means to warn the monkeys who like to jump.”Dudian’s eyes were cold, now, let Ximing come out and give me an answer at once

chapters.title: Chapter 798
chapters.content:
Chapter 798 – Chapter 788: Bloody Day (Part Two)[ First Update ]
The Old Man’s face turned ugly. If it was any other pioneer expert, even if he knew that he was no match for them, he would not allow them to be so rude. However, three days ago, the Count had mentioned to him about the changes in the imperial city. He knew that.., the young man in front of him was not just a verbal threat. Even the princess had been defeated by him. Now that his whereabouts were unknown, if they resisted, they might really be killed by him!
The knights behind him were angry. They clenched their fists but didn’t dare to say anything.
The old man looked at Dudian: “Please wait for a moment. I will ask the Earl.”
“Don’t make me wait for too long.”Dudian coldly said.
The old man quickly entered the castle. After seven or eight minutes Dudian was tired of waiting. He rushed out of the castle and came in front of dudian, dudian smiled: “My Lord, the Earl’s body has improved a lot. He will attend your coronation ceremony.”
Dudian saw the old man enter the castle to discuss with another ordinary heat source. He knew that the person was siming. He nodded slightly, “Remember to let Siming inform the whole city that the traitor Ulita is wanted. In addition, I don’t want any bad rumors to spread in the city. Otherwise I won’t greet you the next time I Come!”
The old man looked embarrassed: “Yes, yes.”
Dudian didn’t delay any longer and turned to leave.
The old man saw Dudian’s back disappear into the horizon. He was relieved. He felt like he was facing a huge monster when he stood in front of Dudian, the killing intent emitted from the youth’s body made his heart tremble. Even if they didn’t fight, he knew that he wasn’t his opponent. He was afraid but also a bit lonely.
“Sir, who is this person? What is the coronation ceremony? Isn’t she wanted by her highness? Her Highness is the princess and we want her. Isn’t she going against her superior?”The Knights saw Dudian leave and immediately said to the old man.
The old man turned to look at them and sighed, “The situation has changed. Her Highness has been defeated by this person and occupied the throne. Her whereabouts are unknown. We can only pretend to submit to him before he comes back. I hope he won’t blame us…”
The knights were stunned as they heard Dudian’s words.
A few hours later Dudian arrived at another Earl City.
He flew into the city and killed the guards who came to stop him. Soon he arrived at the center of the city. There were people on the ground who seemed to have noticed him. They looked up and pointed at him.
Dudian flew down and landed in front of the castle on the hill behind the busy street. The castle was arranged into several tall buildings. It was magnificent. There was a large manor outside the castle. A large number of servants were pruning the fruit trees in the manor, there were hundreds of guards patrolling around the manor.
He landed in front of one of the largest buildings in the manor.
The ten knights in silver armor saw Dudian and were shocked. They pulled out their guns and shouted: “Who are you? How dare you trespass the Earl’s Manor!”The guards were startled, dozens of spears were pointed at Dudian.
“Let visitrin come out to see me.”Dudian ordered.
The dozens of guards were angry. One of them waved his hand and shouted: “Take him down!”
Everyone rushed forward.
Whoosh!
The next moment, the spears in their hands were broken and fell to the ground. The sound of Clanking was heard. Their arms that were holding the spears fell to the ground, blood flowed out from the broken arms. Before they could scream in fear, their bodies fell to the ground. In the blink of an eye, there was a pile of neatly cut stones around dudian, blood quickly flowed out from the stones and dyed the steps red. A large amount of warm internal organs rolled out and fell to the ground along with the sticky blood.
The solemn door was like a purgatory.
Dudian’s expression was calm. His body was still in the original position. Blood slowly spread to his feet and dyed the soles of his shoes red.
The sound of air breaking came from the back of the building. The first person who rushed over was a handsome middle-aged man with long hair. His hair was draped over his shoulders. He was wearing a dirty robe. The robe was stained with colorful paint, he looked like a painter who had lived at home for a long time. But at the moment he was emitting a powerful aura. He was like a huge rock that landed in front of Dudian.
The steps slightly trembled and cracked.
Dudian calmly looked at him: “My Name Is Dudian. Ask vicitrin to come out and see me.”
“Fuck off! You Dare to kill my people? Go To Hell!”The middle-aged man looked at the corpses around dudian. His eyes were full of anger as he roared and punched.
Dudian frowned. He didn’t expect the man to be so bad-tempered. His body swayed as his nails cut through the ground. He went behind the man and naturally put down his arm, blood was dripping from his fingertips. The middle-aged man’s back had a huge hole which happened to be in his heart.
The next moment, the middle-aged man fell to the ground.
At this time, several other figures rushed over. They saw the middle-aged man who had fallen to the ground.
“Let vicitrin come out to see me.”Dudian repeated.
One of them was a well-built noble woman with a dignified face: “Are You Dudian who took advantage of the chaos to attack the Imperial City? Since you are here, don’t think about leaving!”
Dudian slightly raised his eyes: “So the Count has told you about me?”
“Of course I have. The count is deeply regretful that he didn’t go to the Imperial City to help His Highness kill the rebels. Since you took the initiative to come to his house to die, we will accept the head for His Highness!”The woman said as black substance spread out from her body, she activated her magic body and rushed towards Dudian like a half-man half-scorpion monster.
“Stupid…”Dudian’s eyes revealed a deep look. He also activated his magic body. Terrifying sharp limbs were growing out of his body, the light in front of the castle dimmed down.
Whoosh!
Blood splattered and broken limbs flew.
There was no fighting scene. It was a one-sided massacre.
Screams echoed out. Dudian killed one of the noble women who was half man and half scorpion. The gate of the castle was knocked away and blood spread into the castle.
..
..
Half a day later, the news of Count Vicitrin’s death spread out to the cities and caused an uproar.
All the nobles in the cities, from the count to the Viscount, were stunned. Even if the wall master came back, he wouldn’t kill an earl for no reason. Even if there was a clear crime.., they had to pass the vote of the other earl before they could be punished. After all, they weren’t fake nobles from the outer wall but the Earl who was rewarded by the Kingdom of God.
Although they didn’t have the ability to connect with the Kingdom of God, but as long as the Kingdom of God existed, their status would be guaranteed!
However, Dudian’s violent action of killing Count Vicitrin and washing his manor with blood was like a heavy slap that woke up all the nobles.
“My lord, there is news that several dukes are going to join forces with other nobles to crusade against the Imperial City.”Saul carefully said to Dudian.
He had expected such a possibility. He was afraid that these nobles would anger Dudian again and lead him to kill.
Dudian’s expression was calm, “If they are planning to attack the city then you should deal with them. Don’t let them go back. But I think they won’t be able to call for long. The other counts aren’t fools. They will soon understand how weak and weak they are. There is no need to worry about this matter. I will be the chief of the wall for half a month. During this time, you will let those prestigious writers, poets and musicians to spread my positive image.”

chapters.title: Chapter 799
chapters.content:
Chapter 799 – Chapter 789: Migration [ Second Update ]
Saul was relieved to see that Dudian didn’t take these counts seriously. However he felt a bit sad. It seemed that there was no one in the giant wall who could stop Dudian unless the master of the giant wall returned, but when would the master of the giant wall return? What would the master of the giant wall do to him when he returned?
His heart was bitter. He was worried about these things but there was nothing he could do. He looked at Dudian and saw that he didn’t notice him, he said: “Sir, these famous poets and musicians are eccentric and arrogant. What if they don’t want to do so?”
“Then kill them.”
Saul’s heart thumped, “My lord, if we kill them, I’m afraid it will arouse public anger. Many civilians may not have any impression of his highness, but there are many admirers of these famous poets and musicians. Moreover, they are scattered in different groups and professions! Moreover, even if we kill them, some people may not be willing to bow down. As far as I know, there was once a noble who used his life to threaten a musician to come to his house to play a solo for him. However, the musician refused. Later on, the noble was ready to use force. As a result, another Earl who loved the musician knew about this and…”
Dudian slightly waved his hand and interrupted Saul’s words, “I’m not going to kill them. I’m going to kill their loved ones or loved ones. There are many people in this world who don’t cherish themselves but they cherish the people around them. If a person doesn’t want to bow down to the people they cherish then they will kill them. What’s so strange about the death of a person in this day and age?”
Saul was startled. This was indeed an effective method. However, ordinary people couldn’t bear to hurt innocent people. However, this kind of emotion didn’t seem to exist in Dudian’s body. He looked at dudian. He suddenly thought that if he kidnapped your beloved, wouldn’t he be able to grasp your weakness? However, he saw that there was no trace of warmth on Dudian’s face. He quickly dismissed this idea because he felt that some people didn’t belong to this category of people. Dudian was one of them.
“Do you have any questions?”Dudian asked.
Saul bowed his head: “No, I will try my best to do it.”
“It’s best.”
A few days after Dudian killed count vicitrin, nobles came to the imperial city one after another. They handed in invitations and were ready to attend Dudian’s coronation ceremony. There were even two counts.
Dudian had expected that killing the chicken to warn the monkeys would work. However there was still no response from the institute. He could only ask Saul to write to the institute again, he wanted to see what their attitude was.
At the same time, Dudian asked the nobles to praise his positive image in their own territories. He had killed his way into the palace. There were corpses everywhere and he had seized the throne. Now he had to be forgotten, although he didn’t have the heart to manage the giant wall but he had to have a positive image in order to be convenient.
In addition to singing praises of him, he also wanted to arrest URITA.
Through the connections of these nobles, Dudian was able to attract famous people from all walks of life to create public opinion. As the saying goes, three people become a tiger. Even if it was fake, it would slowly become true.
After all, the speed of information transmission in this world was very primitive.
