Although the existence of hunters and the birth of a matching high-efficiency intelligence system.., but compared to the old era where a telephone could transmit information thousands of miles away in real time, it was too slow. Moreover, the efficient transmission of information usually only existed in the big forces. Ordinary civilians could only communicate through newspapers.., birds, mailmen, etc. .
After staying in the palace for a few days, Dudian left the palace to Saul. He went back to the second base in the outer wall to pick up Aisha, at the same time, he sent Noyce, Sergei, Gwyneth and other familiar confidants to the inner wall. In addition, he planned to take Mason and Zach to the inner wall to train them.
Dudian was going to move the second base to the inner wall. He was going to bring back the old staff who had been working in the factories in the second base to produce solar power components, he was going to make them his masters and bring out more workers. He was going to increase the production of solar power as soon as possible. It was the biggest reliance in his hands and the most lethal weapon he could create!
As long as the power was strong enough, the power would be limitless. Even the Abyss Walkers could be directly electrocuted!
All the nobles were looking forward to the return of the giant wall. It reminded him that the giant wall was the biggest threat to him!
“Unfortunately, if the giant wall is really left to me to rule, I will be the king of this place. I will be able to popularize electricity and let this place enter the new century as soon as possible…”Dudian stood in the palace, he looked at the vast world and felt a bit regretful. If there was no kingdom of God and the giant wall, he might be able to fulfill his father’s last wish even if this place was the only survivor in the world, he was confident that he could lead them to break the giant wall and expel all the monsters on earth!
However, things didn’t go as he had hoped. He had used all means to get to this point and was destined to not be able to stay for long. Even if he could kill the giant wall or even the next messenger of the Kingdom of God who came to visit this place, ten to twenty years would have passed, the Divine Kingdom would definitely notice something strange. Although the electric energy in his hand would be very large at that time, enough to easily electrocute the Abyss Walker to death, but he did not know what kind of powerhouses and weapons were in the divine kingdom, he did not know, but he felt that the divine kingdom would never be as primitive and backward as the giant wall. At least, things like electric energy were not rare in the eyes of the supreme ruler of the divine kingdom.
Therefore, he didn’t have the confidence to fight against the Kingdom of God even if he had the confidence to fight against all the monsters in the giant wall.
He felt that it was laughable. He wasn’t afraid of the ferocious monsters outside the giant wall but a group of people who had a better life.
“Saul, ask the Rock clan, Wind Clan and Dragon clan to take out a legendary magic mark.”Dudian said to Saul: “Tell them that if they can’t take it out then ask their patriarch to come to see me personally.”
Saul was stunned for a moment as his face turned bitter. Dudian was giving him another difficult problem, “Master, the number of legendary magic marks is very small. Even the witcher family might not be able to take it out at once!”! “Moreover, forcing them to take it out will force them to have a rebellious heart. The gains won’t make up for the losses. Master, you already have a legendary magic mark. Moreover it is the splitter’s magic mark. It is far stronger than theirs. If you want to replace it, it would be too much of a loss!”
“This is for my brothers.”Dudian glanced at him: “I’m not talking to you. If you feel sorry for them then you can take it out for them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 800
chapters.content:
Chapter 800 – Chapter 790: Loyalty
Saul was speechless as he bitterly smiled in his heart. He had seen Dudian bring back a few of his companions. Their strength was average but it seemed that dudian intended to cultivate them. This also meant that.., as his companions gradually became familiar with the affairs of the Imperial City, he might have to abdicate. If it was just not important, he could accept it but he was afraid of being silenced..
Dudian glanced at him. His eyes seemed to be able to see through everything, “Since you have submitted to me, you should think about me in the future. If you want to live for a long time then you should assist me. Maybe when the wall master returns, I will have the strength to fight against the wall master. In that case, you can continue to live well, right?”
Saul bitterly smiled in his heart. It was almost impossible to grow into the abyss by relying on the resources here. However he understood Dudian’s meaning: “I understand. I will write to them.”
“Go.”
Dudian looked at Neuss, Sergei, Gwyneth and Aurora after Saul left. His eyes paused on Gwyneth for a moment, “Gwyneth, when you followed me, I promised you that I would take revenge for you. Now I have done it. No matter if your enemy is the commander of the imperial city or the Earl or Marquis, you can go and find him. No one dares to stop you!”
Sergei, Neuss and others looked at Gwyneth with curiosity.
Gwyneth’s expression was complicated. She still remembered the scene when Dudian picked her up from the Thorn Flower Prison. She didn’t expect that her wish would come true in the blink of an eye. Moreover, it was far beyond her imagination, she never thought that she would be able to stand in the palace. She was just a small disciplinarian. There were many disciplinarians like her in the inner wall but her fate was completely different from the other disciplinarians, she was destined to be different from the time she was in prison. It seemed that her life had entered another turning point when she was released from prison.
She knew how much time it took for Dudian to climb from a small figure in the outer wall to his current position. She had always held a bit of rejection in her heart, she couldn’t agree with the values that she had learned from the monastery. Even though she had experienced inhuman torture in prison, her original intention hadn’t changed. She only hated her enemy but she still loved the world.
She knew about Dudian’s experience but she felt that she and Dudian were two different kinds of people. Moreover, they were mutually exclusive. From the bottom of her heart, she felt that Dudian was an extremely evil person, sooner or later he would end up in a miserable situation. In the end, he would lose everything! Whether it was poetry or oral folklore, they were all evil. But at this moment, her belief was somewhat shaken.
Especially when she heard Dudian’s words, she suddenly felt a burst of guilt. If Dudian didn’t kill so many innocent people and didn’t do so many bad things, he wouldn’t be able to reach today’s status. He wouldn’t be able to avenge her!
How could she blame him?
Although such a way was rejected by her, but her conscience made her unable to give birth to dissatisfaction and contempt.
“Thank you young master…”she lowered her head and whispered.
Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed, he nodded: “No need to be polite. There is one thing I want to tell you today. Although I have seized the inner wall but I don’t know when the wall master will come back. If I can’t defeat him then I can escape but you will suffer. So if you are willing to leave then I will arrange people to completely erase your previous identity so that you can live as ordinary people again. You can choose.”
Gwyneth was stunned.
Sergei and Neuss were also stunned.
They knew that Dudian needed trustworthy people by his side but they didn’t expect that he would give them such a choice. Even Sergei who had a deep impression of Dudian’s cunning.., there was a ripple in his heart as he felt touched.
“Young Master, my life is given by you. Without You I would still be in the dark prison. I will be like this for the rest of my life. If the master comes back and you are no match for him then I am willing to buy time for you!”Neuss’s eyes lit up, he seriously said: “Scar and I have said that we will follow you to the death. He has sacrificed for you and fulfilled his promise. How can I go against it?”
Dudian looked at him. The coldness in his eyes was much gentler. He nodded: “Thank You!”
Sergei saw that Noyce had expressed his stance. He said: “Noyce is right. I will always follow you, Master!”
Dudian nodded.
Aurora looked at dudian: “Master, I swear to follow you to the death. I hope you can let me avenge my sister!”
Dudian looked at her: “I’m afraid that your strength is not enough. You can go after Saul takes back the legendary magic marks.”
Aurora’s eyes were full of surprise. She knelt down and kowtowed: “Master, Aurora is willing to follow you to the death!”
“Get up.”Dudian stretched out his hand.
Gwyneth looked at dudian: “Master, although I have some opinions about you, but I am willing to continue to follow you until the end of my life!”
Dudian looked at her and nodded. He knew that Gwyneth had opinions about his work. But he still kept Gwyneth by his side because of one of her qualities. She had a firm outlook on life, ordinary people would be filled with hatred after going through such hardships but Gwyneth wasn’t. He believed that as long as he gave her enough kindness he would be able to get back her loyalty.
With the resources and connections in his hands, Sergei and Gwyneth’s strength wasn’t enough in his eyes. But he didn’t plan to replace them. After all, strong people were easy to find but loyalty was hard to find. Moreover with the resources in his hands it wouldn’t take long for him to cultivate them into pioneers.
Two days later.
The Dragon Clan and the Rock clan each sent a legendary parasitic soul worm. The Dragon Clan didn’t send the dragon but the legendary shadow hunter that Dudian had met. The Rock clan sent the Gold Eater’s magic marks which were passed down from generation to generation. They were good at drilling underground and could live long underground. They could eat metal and rock. Their digestion and defense were top monsters.
“There is no reply from the wing tribe. Lord, you see…”Thor lowered his head and secretly looked at Dudian.
“It seems that her highness should be in the wing tribe.”Dudian narrowed his eyes.
Thor was shocked by Dudian’s words. He didn’t know why Dudian would suddenly mention Urita. But his heart suddenly thumped when he thought of the most likely place where the princess would go.

chapters.title: Chapter 801
chapters.content:
Chapter 801 – Chapter 791: Terrorist Incident [ First Update ]
“Your Highness, do you need me to send people to the wing clan?”Saul asked.
Dudian glanced at him: “Send Who? You? Who Can Keep Urita? or send people to alert the enemy?”
Saul’s heart jumped: “I don’t Dare!”
“Send an order to the wing clan to immediately cooperate with the imperial city to post a notice to arrest urita. If they don’t comply with the order within three days, they will be punished with the crime of rebellion. In addition, let them deal with the legendary parasitic soul worm!”Dudian said in a cold voice.
Saul’s face slightly changed: “Yes, my Lord.”
Dudian asked Neuss to follow Saul. He was familiar with the big and small affairs in the palace as well as the positions of the officials in the palace. In addition, he asked Sergei to return to the outer wall, hawkeye and his cronies were summoned to the inner wall. He wanted them to get in touch with the network of the royal family. He was ready to take control of the inner wall as soon as possible.
It wasn’t the first time for Richelieu to come to the inner wall but it was the first time for him to come to the royal palace. He found it hard to believe that dudian had threatened to attack the inner wall when he seized the pope’s position, but he thought that it was a joke. After all, he couldn’t count the number of experts in the inner wall. He knew that the big figures could crush Dudian with a finger.
But in the blink of an eye, this strange thing had come true. It was like a miracle!
He didn’t know whether to be happy or sad. But from Dudian’s performance, his heart was calm. He knew that Dudian didn’t intend to kill him. He thought that his previous worries were unnecessary. Now that the royal power was in Dudian’s hands, why would he need to kill him? Even if he revealed everything in the past, what kind of threat would he pose?
“Although everything will be in vain after the return of the wall master, but my life has been tied to his. It’s not bad to be able to enjoy such a life before my death…”Richelieu comforted himself.
Compared to Richelieu, Hawkeye, sword king and the other elders of the dark church were excited. In their hearts, the inner wall was an unreachable existence since birth. They had fantasized about the scenery of the inner wall countless times, it was only today that they saw it. Furthermore, it was in the highest authority center of the inner wall, the palace. This was somewhat inconceivable to them.
“The dark church will continue to maintain the style of the dark church. It is the same in the inner wall. The Dark and light tricks played by the monastery in the outer wall can also be performed in the inner wall. The monastery doesn’t have the ability to do so but we do.”Dudian said to Hawkeye and the other elders: “The Royal Family will provide you with rare magic marks for free. You can take as much as you need. You must improve your strength as soon as possible. You have one month to let the people in the inner wall know about your existence. You also have to know about the things in the cities including the color of underwear that the daughter of an earl likes to wear. Do you understand?”
Hawkeye and the others were tongue-tied and felt the pressure. In less than a month’s time, they had the support of Dudian’s royal power. There was great hope for them to achieve this. No one dared to shake their head.
Time passed quickly.
Two days later, the winged family sent back the news. They posted the information of the wanted Urita in the territory of the winged family. It meant that they had submitted. At the same time, they handed over a legendary parasitic soul worm, the bat musician, and five rare parasitic soul worms. The winged family sent an envoy to the palace to apologize to Dudian. They earnestly complained and begged for forgiveness.
Dudian didn’t continue to force him and let Saul send the envoy away.
Dudian handed over the shadow hunter to Aurora, the Rock Tribe’s gold eater to Neuss, and the bat musician to Gwyneth. He didn’t have anyone for the time being. He originally planned to give it to Gwyneth, but considering that Gwyneth sometimes had a soft heart and was worried that she would hear some secrets, he didn’t report it because there were too many innocent people involved.
“It’s a pity that Glenn isn’t here…”Dudian sighed in his heart. Glenn was one of his friends. They first met when he was released from prison. Mellon Consortium had sent her to assassinate him but she had let him go, it could be said that she had saved his life.
“You should use the god’s marrow as much as you can everyday. Don’t use too much or too little. According to Dr. Shermanson’s estimation, you should be able to become a pioneer in about two months. Remember to make good use of the time to train your fighting skills. I will get people to make the weapons for you as soon as possible. Aurora, you should go outside the giant wall to train.”Dudian said to Aurora.
Aurora’s eyes lit up. She was no longer a naive little girl. She knew that the pioneers were the top experts in the inner wall. Moreover, they had experienced the trauma of the intruders, the number of pioneers in the inner wall was greatly reduced. If she was promoted to the level of a pioneer then she would be considered as a strong combatant.
Neuss looked at dudian: “Master, What About Me?”
“Stay by my side. I will hire people to train you.”Dudian said: “The inner wall is not completely settled. It is inevitable that there will be some rebels who want to assassinate me. They don’t have the strength to do so. They can only use poison. I need you to test my food.”
Neuss felt helpless. Although his magic marks had been upgraded from rare to legendary level but his job hadn’t changed. He was still a poison tester for Dudian.
“Saul, is there any news from the Monster Institute?”Dudian looked at Saul.
Saul bowed: “There is no news yet. But they have given me the God’s marrow that you asked me to extract.”
“They have given me the God’s marrow.”Dudian pondered for a while, “Send a message to them. Tell them to put up the wanted notice of His Highness Ulita. Send someone to the imperial city to build a witcher for us. Also, tell them that the imperial city will provide them with many conveniences in the future. If they ‘need’then send them another city.”
“Master, are you planning to use both kindness and power?”Saul saw through Dudian’s intention and pondered for a moment, “Master, I don’t understand. I would like to ask for your advice. With your strength, you can directly suppress the Monster Institute and make them submit to you. With their savings, they won’t be able to compete with you. There is no one else in the Monster Institute who can compete with you. Master, with your strength, you can kill the dragon snake. Why do you need to use force to subdue it?”
Dudian looked at him, “I have a lot of things that I need their cooperation for in the future. It would be best if they take the initiative to surrender. It is inevitable that there will be old grudges. Do you have any opinions about the institute?”
Saul was startled, he lowered his head: “I don’t dare to. I have heard that the wall master and the princess have deliberately suppressed the institute. I don’t know if the news is true or false but the institute has made a lot of contributions over the years. However the reward given by the wall master is very ordinary. If something happens then the punishment will be doubled. I think if you give the institute a city and provide them with facilities then I’m afraid that the institute will be out of your control…”
“Is there such a thing?”Dudian was surprised. He thought for a moment: “Do you think that the suppression of the Monster Institute is because they are afraid of their development?”
Thor bowed his head but didn’t say anything.
Dudian’s fingers touched the throne as he thought. The Monster Institute was specialized in researching monsters and related things. What was the most dangerous thing in the old era? There was no doubt about the answer.
Even if a stupid ruler tried to launch a global war they might not be able to destroy the Earth but the researchers could.
This was the terror of the researchers. The wall master was aware of this so he tried to suppress them.
“It seems that the Monster Institute wasn’t happy in the past.”Dudian thought back to the first time he sneaked into the inner wall. He saw the Monster Institute grazing monsters in the wilderness. It was clear that the experiments of the Monster Institute.., not only would it bring fear to the civilians but it would also bring fear and disgust to the nobles. Moreover it would make the wall master afraid. All of this meant that the Monster Institute had done great things that shocked the world.
“Has the Monster Institute ever caused any disasters?”Dudian asked Saul.
Saul was startled, he nodded: “Yes, more than once. Two hundred years ago, there was no wall of Sighs. The wall was peaceful. Later on, the Monster Institute leaked the zombie virus in a research accident. As a result, it caused a large area of infection. The situation was more terrible than the recent outbreak of chaos in our inner wall. At that time, there were more than twenty million people in the wall. But after the outbreak of the virus, the number of people decreased to twelve million. More than eight million people died! “The wall of Sighs was built at that time to isolate the zombies that were infected by the virus.”
Dudian’s eyes moved: “What else?”
“The second time was hundreds of years ago. The monster was created by the Monster Research Institute. At that time the Master of the wall went all out to kill the monster. The Master of the wall was seriously injured and later died. The Master of the wall was the father of the current master of the wall of Aristotle. That’s why the Master of the Wall suppressed the Monster Research Institute. If the research institute is allowed to do so, who knows if they will create more terrifying things?”Saul said.
Dudian was surprised that the Monster Institute had created a monster that could rival the wall master hundreds of years ago?

chapters.title: Chapter 802
chapters.content:
Chapter 802 – Chapter 792: Insect Experiment [ Second Update ]
“How can the wall master be sure that they have completely destroyed the data?”Dudian couldn’t help but ask.
Saul looked at Dudian. Dudian’s question was very clever. He didn’t foolishly ask if the experiment still existed. He was asking from the point of view of the ruler, he said: “The Wall Master banned the experiment and completely destroyed the research institute where the monster was found. All the people were killed including their friends and relatives. All the related people were executed. Even the people who came in contact with the Monster Research Institute during the experiment were executed!”
“This matter was a sensation at that time. The data of the experiment was completely erased. Although there were some evil people who tried to revive the experiment and re-create the monster, but they were all killed in the bud.”
Dudian was startled. He sighed and felt a bit regretful. The situation was as he had thought. If it was him, he would have done the same thing. If the Monster Research Institute wasn’t a force of the Kingdom of God.., he would even uproot the institute and destroy it. The Lord of the Aristotelian wall had the same idea but there was a kingdom of God above his head so he didn’t dare to go too far.
“The Monster Institute has recently developed a monster called ‘Black prison’. You should know that the potential of this monster is very strong. I estimate that the complete monster would be able to trap the master or even the abyss. Is It related to this?”Dudian asked.
Saul shook his head, “I know ‘Black Prison’. The last time the ambassador of the Kingdom of God came, he brought a task from the Kingdom of God. The Kingdom of God appointed the Monster Research Institute to create the monster. It is said that after the monster is created, the Kingdom of God will accept it. So the experiment on ‘Black Prison’is different from the monster in the past. ‘black prison’is lazy and has little destructive power. But it is said that the monster in the past was violent. It was extremely bloodthirsty and caused a lot of casualties. Moreover the monster wasn’t a research task assigned by the Kingdom of God but something that was privately researched by the professor in the Monster Research Institute.”
“Will the Kingdom of God accept the ‘Black prison’?”Dudian was surprised as he asked: “How Long is the production cycle of ‘Black Prison’?”
Saul knew what Dudian was worried about, he bowed his head: “Lord don’t worry. As far as I know, ‘Black prison’requires a huge amount of materials. Although the material is provided by the Witcher family but it is very difficult for the witcher family to obtain the materials. It will take at least seven or eight years to produce the ‘black prison’. This is what His Highness Ulita told me. Lord should ask the Institute of Magic to know the exact amount.”
Dudian was relieved. Aristotle had left for more than six years. If the cycle of ‘Black Prison’was eight years then it would be at least two years before he would come back. However, the specific time.., he asked Mason to think about it.
“How much do you know about the monster?”Dudian asked.
Saul shook his head: “I heard it from an observer. I don’t know much. But I have heard a rumor that half of the monster is human!”
“Half is human?”Dudian was startled. He suddenly thought of another experiment of the Institute of Magic: ‘Insect-man’. It was a mixture of human and monster’s limbs. It was dominated by humans and controlled the monster’s body, it was called ‘insect-man’.
Saul looked at Dudian’s absent-minded expression. He vaguely guessed what Dudian was thinking. But he knew that he couldn’t be too smart so he asked: “My Lord, what are you thinking about?”
Dudian frowned: “I’m thinking that the experiments of the monster research institute are similar to the previous monster experiments. Didn’t Aristotle prohibit the experiments of the insect people?”
Saul smiled, “Sir, the experiments of the insect people were assigned to the Monster Research Institute by the envoys of the Kingdom of God. It is different from the previous monster experiments. There hasn’t been any major riots in the experiments of the insect people. It is said that 99% of the experimental subjects have died because they couldn’t adapt to the body of the monster.”
“Is it God’s kingdom again?”Dudian frowned.
What kind of research did they want to do by using human and monster bodies to conduct experiments?
“This kind of experiment to destroy human nature was issued by God’s kingdom. They have the nerve to call themselves God’s kingdom.”Dudian’s eyes revealed a trace of coldness.
Saul had a rare feeling of approval in his heart when he heard Dudian’s words. Such an idea had surfaced in his mind when he first heard about it. However he didn’t dare to say it out loud. After all, God’s kingdom was above the giant wall, even the master of the giant wall didn’t dare to talk about it. He said: “Don’t let the people of the Monster Institute hear your words. Otherwise, the messenger of the Kingdom of God will come and spread to the Kingdom of God.”
“I know.”Dudian’s eyes were cold: “If there is an opportunity, I would like to see what is going on behind these people’s Back!”
Saul smiled wryly. He thought that Dudian was still a teenager. He said: “Adults should not be serious. There are many things in this world that don’t make sense. If you are too serious, you will only add to your troubles.”
Dudian looked at him: “You seem to understand.”
Saul laughed at himself: “That’s why I will submit to adults. I am not like some stubborn people.”
“It’s boring to live a casual life. But I like to be direct.”Dudian didn’t get angry but praised him.
Saul’s expression changed but he didn’t say anything.
Dudian looked at the outside of the palace. There was a trace of excitement in his eyes. He knew about the monster experiment a hundred years ago from Saul, if the institute could create such a monster then even if he couldn’t control it he would be able to use it as a bomb and throw it into other giant walls or even the Kingdom of God. It would cause a large number of casualties!
However he knew that it would be very difficult. After all, it had been more than a hundred years. The Lord of Aristotle wouldn’t be able to sleep at night if he couldn’t destroy the institute. He had to dig three feet into the ground to erase everything related to it, only then would he be able to feel at ease. After so many years, it would undoubtedly be extremely difficult to reassemble the destroyed experimental data. He did not know if the monster research institute had thought about it after so many years.., reviving the experiment of such a great killing device.
If there was, the Monster Research Institute might have been secretly collecting the relevant experimental data over the years. However, the monster research institute might not be a whole. Even if someone collected the data, it might only be an individual.., or someone close to a small group of forces.
It would be an extremely difficult and time-consuming task to find out who was secretly collecting monster experiments.
Dudian fell into deep thought. After a long time, he suddenly woke up. Although the temptation was great, the most important thing at the moment was to find the resurrection of Aisha as soon as possible!
He wanted to slap himself when he thought of the most important thing. He turned his head and looked at Aisha who was sitting quietly next to him. His eyes were full of apology.
“Sorry, I’m going to the Monster Institute now.”Dudian said in guilt.
Saul looked at Dudian’s sudden change of mood. He was a bit surprised. When he heard his words, he couldn’t help but say: “My Lord, didn’t you say that I should send a message to the Monster Institute? Are you going to go now?”
“There is no need to send a message. I will go myself!”Dudian stood up. There was killing intent in his eyes: “I have given them enough time!”
Saul was speechless. He thought that Dudian didn’t want to use force to suppress them. Why did he suddenly change into a different person? He noted down Dudian’s characteristics: “Eccentric”and “Temperamental”. He didn’t continue to speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 803
chapters.content:
Chapter 803 – Chapter 793: Poison 1[ First Update ]
“Is there anything else other than the ‘Dragon Snake’?”Dudian asked Saul. Although the answer might not be true but it could be used as a reference.
The monster that the Monster Research Institute had created hundreds of years ago was comparable to the wall master. It was difficult to guarantee that there wouldn’t be any other experiments. Some methods to kill the enemy couldn’t be revealed when they attacked, they could be used in defense.
Saul looked at Dudian and thought, “Although I haven’t been to the Monster Institute’s headquarters but there should be many traps. If possible, I suggest that you don’t try to break through them. These traps have been accumulated by them for a long time. Their destructive power is no less than that of the traps in the palace.”
Dudian knew that he wasn’t lying. Urita had proposed to lead the intruders to the headquarters of the Institute of Magic. However the proposal was rejected, the reason was that the possibility of failure was too high. The intruders had been lurking in the giant wall for a long time. Since they knew the location of the real God’s corpse it meant that they had read a lot of information, there had been several battles in the history of the giant wall. Two of them were experiments where the monsters went out of control and rampaged on the mountain. The result was that a series of traps were triggered and they were rotting to death.
“What else is there besides the traps?”Dudian asked.
Saul was surprised as he saw that Dudian didn’t seem to care about the traps. He couldn’t help but feel surprised. After all, even the master of the giant wall didn’t want to go to the headquarters of the Monster Research Institute.
“There seems to be nothing except for the traps. Although the president of the institute is just an ordinary pioneer but in fact he isn’t that strong. At most he can fight against the experts of the inner wasteland. He has been immersed in research for many years so he doesn’t have time to train his fighting skills. The only thing he needs to pay attention to is the traps and the dragon snake. The venom of this monster is very fierce. It is ranked third in the list of known poisons in the Atlas. The green toad arrow frog is ranked second. The last time it paralyzed the only master of the invaders for many days. If the master’s magic marks didn’t have a high anti-poison ability then he would have been poisoned to death on the spot!”Saul replied.
It was the first time that Dudian had heard of the ranking of poisons. He couldn’t help but ask: “What is the first place?”
“The first place is the ‘Dreamer’.”Thor replied without thinking: “The ‘Dreamer’is different from the green toad arrow frog. The latter isn’t a monster. There are no parasitic soul worms in its body. Even the green toad arrow frog is weak. It is barely comparable to a level 20 to 30 monster. If it doesn’t use poison then most of the level 20 monsters will easily kill it as a meal. But if it is hit by its venom then even a level 50 or 60 monster will die on the spot.”
“But the ‘Dreamer’is not only several times more toxic than the frog, but also more than ten times more toxic. It also has very strong combat ability. Even if you exclude poison attacks, its speed, strength, defense and other aspects are also outstanding. In particular, its anti-poison ability is close to being immune to all poisons. Unfortunately, this kind of legendary monster only appeared in a very long time ago, but no one has seen it since then. No one knows whether it is true or not, but there are seven other kinds of legendary monsters that have been seen. Therefore, although the rumors about the ‘dreamer’are extremely exaggerated and powerful, but it should be a real monster.”
Dudian was a bit surprised. He didn’t expect the ‘Dreamer’to be more powerful than the frog. After all that little thing had paralyzed a master and completely lost its fighting power, wasn’t the dreamer more terrifying than it?
No wonder it was ranked first in the legendary monster list. From the looks of it, the dreamer was more than ten times more terrifying than the executioner.
“The green toad arrow frog is provided by the Monster Research Institute. Although it is said that there is only one but no one knows whether the rumors are true or not. Because of this reason His Majesty hasn’t personally visited the headquarters of the Monster Research Institute. So, your excellency should think twice!”Thor bowed his head and sincerely said.
Dudian’s eyes flashed for a moment. He shook his head: “It doesn’t matter. I will go. You can take care of the palace for the time being.”He didn’t wait for Thor to continue to persuade him. The splitter’s wings grew out of the gap of the armor on its back and it soared into the sky, it was as if a black magic light broke through the sky.
Saul was a bit dumbfounded. He smiled bitterly until Dudian’s back disappeared into the sky. After all he was young and vigorous!
Dudian came to Mount St. Lucia a few hours later. He looked down from the sky. The whole mountain was extremely majestic. There was a small mountain behind the mountain. There was a dense forest. He could faintly see the castle and the winding steps, he looked calm as he landed in front of the mountain.
The four guards in front of the mountain saw Dudian coming down from the sky. They knew that he was a big shot, one of the guards respectfully said: “This is the headquarters of the Institute of Magic. May I know who you are?”
“Go and inform them that Master Dudian has come to meet me. Tell Olava to come out and see me.”Dudian ordered.
The four guards were stunned as their eyes opened wide. Dudian’s occupation of the palace had been spread to every city for a long time. They naturally heard about it from their friends, they didn’t expect that this mysterious person would be in front of them.
“Sir, our Dean said that if you come to visit, you can go in directly.”One of the guards replied respectfully.
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows: “Let him come out personally to invite me.”
The guard was slightly surprised. He looked up at Dudian and saw that Dudian wasn’t joking. There was a trace of strange expression on his face: “Sir, our Dean is busy. I’m afraid…”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he coldly looked at the guard: “Are you the Dean or the Dean’s assistant? Can your words replace his words? I asked you to inform him. I didn’t ask you to discuss with me here.”
The guard’s face changed as he felt the cold killing intent in Dudian’s eyes. His heart was beating fast. He didn’t dare to say anything more. He bowed his head and ran away.
Dudian quietly waited as he looked around.
His range of vision had become extremely wide. He could see things that were thousands of meters underground. The range of thermal vision was naturally much wider. He could see almost all the life on Mount St. Lucia, the guards who were running down the steps were getting further and further away from him. There were a lot of heat source figures on the mountain. There were many human-like heat source figures, there were some huge and strange shapes of heat source figures. It seemed that a group of researchers were studying the monster.
He searched for a while but didn’t find the reptile dragon snake that Saul mentioned. He guessed that it should be a cold-blooded monster.
“There are four pioneers and two military gods. One of them has contacted the guard. It should be the dean. Thor is right. The Dean is only at the peak of the wilderness…”Dudian’s eyes lit up, he quietly looked at the place. Soon he saw the guard turn around and come back. The Dean didn’t move. He didn’t want to see him.
He retracted his eyes and his eyeballs returned to black and white.
A moment later, the guard ran back. He didn’t wait for the guard to speak, dudian said: “Tell Olava that if he has this attitude then all the branches of your institute will disappear by Sunset Today!”
The guard was stunned. The other three stared at Dudian in astonishment.
Let all the points disappear? That’s too big of a statement!

chapters.title: Chapter 804
chapters.content:
Chapter 804 – Chapter 794: Submit To [ First Watch ]
It didn’t take long for Dudian to see Orava get up and follow the guard. At the same time, the other three pioneers in the research institute came to Orava.
A moment later, Dudian saw a silver-haired old man who was accompanied by three pioneers. He walked slowly behind the guard. His attitude was calm and composed.
“Mr. Dean?”Olava’s eyes slightly moved as he saw Dudian. This was the first time he had met Dudian. He didn’t participate in the crusade against Intruders Conference organized by URITA, he asked the vice dean to attend. It had been many years since he had left Mount St. Lucia.
“Dean Olava?”Dudian looked at him. There was no smile on his face, “Dean should know the purpose of my visit. I’m going to get straight to the point. Firstly, cooperate with the royal city to arrest the criminal Ulita. Secondly, the Monster Research Institute should cooperate with the royal family as Aristotle did in the past. Can these two things be done?”
Olava’s old eyes flashed as he quietly looked at dudian. There was a trace of inhumanity in his way of speaking. Moreover, there was no smile on his face, however, the latter seemed to be unwilling to fake a smile. His attitude made him feel a trace of anger. However, he didn’t show it, he faintly said: “Mr Dean, I’m afraid that there is something fishy about the accusation of His Highness. I hope you don’t jump to conclusions.”
Dudian coldly said: “I like to get straight to the point. I don’t like to be long-winded. You know very well what is going on with His Highness. I’m not here to discuss with you because you have missed the opportunity to discuss with me. I’m here in person to inform you that you can resist or disobey but that would be making an enemy out of me!”
Olava slightly frowned. Dudian’s tone made him feel very uncomfortable. If he used four words to describe it then it would be ‘overbearing’or even aggressive. However, such a strong attitude.., he couldn’t help but think about the cards in Dudian’s hand. There was a trace of coldness in his eyes, “Mr. Dean, since you like to talk so directly, then I advise you not to overestimate yourself. The wall master will return at any time. Leave a line in everything and give yourself a Chance!”
Dudian looked at him, “Are you threatening me?”? “Do you think that the wall master will forgive me for what I have done?”? Since there is no possibility, why can’t I kill all of them? When the result is the same, I will kill one person and kill ten thousand people. Why do I have to kill until I am happy? In addition, I also advise you that the wall master will not come back for at least two years. If you don’t believe me, you can ask Ulita. She should have the confidence.”
Olava’s face slightly changed. He knew that master wall wouldn’t come back for a short period of time. However, Dudian’s previous words made him uncomfortable. However, he knew that there was no need to make a theory with such a crazy person, he said in a deep voice: “Mr. Dean, before Master Wall comes back, you will be your majesty. Our Institute will continue to do our research. We don’t care about the matter between you and His Highness. We hope that you won’t interfere with us. Our Institute doesn’t like to be involved in these things.”
Dudian quietly looked at Olava. There was a trace of uneasiness in his heart. Dudian slowly said: “Dean, what gives you the confidence to talk to me like this?”
Olava was stunned.
The three pioneers behind him looked at Dudian in anger. His words were quite rude!
Olava’s gentle face was covered with a trace of haze, “Mr. Dean, since you have taken away the palace and occupied the magpie’s nest for so many days, you should know what kind of existence our institute is. Even if Aristotle is here, he wouldn’t dare to Touch Our Institute. Don’t think that no one can control you!”
Dudian’s eyes were full of ridicule as he looked at him, “Speaking of which, your confidence is only because of the support of the Kingdom of God. But you shouldn’t be so ignorant. There is an old saying that the enemy is close at hand. No matter what confidence you have, you are already in the range of my attack. As long as I am willing, I can immediately take your head. You Don’t have the capital to negotiate with me!”
Olava narrowed his eyes, “I’m not afraid of your stupidity. Even if you kill me you won’t Make Our Research Institute surrender to you. Moreover if you kill me you will still die. The Messenger of God won’t let you off. It is worthwhile to exchange my old bones for your young life.”
“Can the messenger of God Search for me on the entire earth?”Dudian said in a cold tone: “The world is so big. I can go anywhere and change my appearance. It is easy for people like us. Do you think I will wait for the return of the giant wall and fight to the death with him?”
Olava smiled faintly, “The world is big, but you and I have to live inside the wall. If we leave the divine wall, we will die. Although you are strong, you are not even a ruler. Although the area around the divine wall is safe enough for you to live, it is far away in the abyss. Even Abyss walkers have to be careful. and every giant wall is surrounded by such an area, just like the moat outside the castle. How can you cross it? There are Thunderbirds in the sky and monsters in the Abyss on the ground. Where do you think you can escape to?”
“It seems you know a lot.”Dudian’s expression was calmer than his, “But you have forgotten that I have colluded with the intruders. I will leave the same way the intruders came. Do you think I have the confidence to do so?”
Olava was stunned.
He was stunned for a moment. His face slightly changed as cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
He knew that Dudian had helped the intruders to escape from the ambush. He also knew that Dudian had colluded with the intruders. But he didn’t think that.., the intruders would come up with a way to leave the giant wall to make a deal with Dudian!
Now thinking about it, just like what Dudian said, there was no way out. How could he be so strong?
“To be able to cross the Abyss region and trap him here…”Olava’s thoughts were somewhat disrupted. This point was beyond his expectations. He was caught off guard. Moreover, it also made him confident, it seemed a bit ridiculous.
Since Dudian was going to leave at any time and had the ability to leave, how could he be afraid of the Kingdom of God behind them?
“Dean, are you willing to cooperate?”Dudian looked at him with a trace of disdain.
Olava felt that his face was a bit ugly at the moment. He tried to remain calm and looked straight into Dudian’s eyes. However, he saw a pair of black eyes full of confidence without hesitation, the last trace of hope in his heart was extinguished. He was silent for a moment and whispered: “We are willing to cooperate with you just like we did with Aristotle.”
“It’s good that you are sensible.”Dudian indifferently said: “I will send my people to pick up some things from you.”
Olava’s face was gloomy: “I know.”
Dudian glanced at him and glanced at the three pioneers behind him. He turned around and left the mountain.
A middle-aged pioneer clenched his fist as he watched Dudian’s back, he gritted his teeth: “Dean, this kid is too much. Do we really want to humiliate him? What can he do to us if we stay on the mountain?”
Olava’s expression was complicated as he slowly retracted his eyes. He sighed: “I underestimated this person. If I didn’t see it with my own eyes, I wouldn’t believe that he is a teenager.”
The middle-aged pioneer said in a muffled voice, “Dean, I don’t see what kind of wisdom this kid has. His temperament is also childish, arrogant, and arrogant. He doesn’t have any shrewdness at all. If he had a better attitude, he would have told us properly. Although we wouldn’t have agreed, at least he would have appeared to be more sensible. How can he talk like that? He doesn’t have any manners at all!”
Olava shook his head slightly, he sighed and said, “Because he knows that we must be humiliated, so he no longer has to give us a good look. Instead, such a tough attitude has left us with no room for maneuver. If he were to talk politely, this matter could still be delayed for a while. Sigh, I thought that Little Ulita was already a rare intelligent person, but I didn’t expect that this youth was ten times stronger than her. It’s hard to believe that such a talent could be nurtured in a place like the outer wall where the lowlifes live…”
The middle-aged pioneer felt aggrieved and said, “Dean, why should we submit to him? If he really forces us into a corner, we will join forces with His Highness Ulita and King Wing. We will defend the Divine Mountain. What can he do to us?”
Olava glanced at him, he said, “According to what you said, although he can not break in, we can not get out either. Don’t forget, he asked us to come out and meet him in person. This means that he knows that there are many traps on the divine mountain. The reason why the traps are powerful is because they are unexpected. Since he already knows, what is the point of this trap? “If he can’t attack us then he can attack our branch. After a long time we will have no food or water. How are we going to fight back?”
The middle-aged pioneer was stunned and couldn’t speak.
“I hope the Wall Master can come back soon. I hope he won’t go too far. Otherwise…”Olava sighed as he looked at the direction where dudian had left, there was a trace of cold light in the depths of his eyes.
… ..
Last night he had planned to finish the first watch and then go to dinner. He had to write half of the second watch. His stomach hurt, his whole body was itchy and he was allergic to food. He couldn’t continue to write

chapters.title: Chapter 805
chapters.content:
Chapter 805 – Chapter 795: Blood Count [ Second Update ]
Dudian descended from the sky and put away his magic wings.
Saul and Neuss immediately came out to greet him. Saul’s eyes quickly glanced at Dudian’s body. He was surprised to find that there was no injury. He went forward and saluted, “Master, didn’t you go to the Monster Research Institute?”
Dudian glanced at him: “Do you need me to come back with a full body injury?”
Saul replied: “I didn’t mean that…”
“Orava has submitted. Send a few professors from your royal family to take my people to the headquarters of the Institute of Magic.”Dudian walked towards the palace, he said: “Ask the professors to bring all the materials and books related to the research of zombies and viruses to the palace. Also, inform Orava to give you people to mobilize the tokens of the other professors.”
Saul was stunned: “Orava has surrendered? How is that possible!”
“Am I joking with You?”Dudian frowned as he glanced at him.
Saul’s face slightly changed, he smiled: “I’m sorry. But Olava is arrogant. Even the wall master might not be able to get him to submit to him. Do you think he is pretending to submit?”
Dudian waved his hand: “There is no need to think. Just do it.”
Saul bowed: “Yes.”
Dudian said to Neuss: “Go and call Gwyneth. Let Her go to the Institute of Magic.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss turned around and left.
Saul bowed to Dudian and followed after him.
A moment later, Gwyneth was brought in front of Dudian. Dudian handed the paper to her, he said: “Remember the questions above. When we go to the headquarters of the Institute of Magic. Remember to ask Orava himself. If he doesn’t answer then mention my name. As for whether his answer is true or false, you should pay attention to it. I believe you can see it.”
Gwyneth was surprised. She didn’t expect that Dudian had asked her to come here for such an important task. She was born in the inner wall so she naturally knew what kind of person Orava was, he was a big shot who was on the same level as the Lord of the wall. His position was higher than the patriarch of the family. Usually, even her previous superior wasn’t qualified to meet Orava, let alone ask him questions, moreover, he had to answer.
Soon, she knew why Dudian had chosen her to do this task. She used to be a disciplinarian. She had a certain ability to judge people. Sergei and Neuss couldn’t compare to her, moreover, she knew that Dudian lacked people and trusted people so she was the best candidate.
She took the note and looked at the question. She looked up at Aisha who was next to dudian and nodded: “I will do my best to do it.”
“Alright.”Dudian nodded.
It didn’t take long before the royal professors who were selected by Saul and the royal attendants came to the front of the palace.
These royal professors were usually teachers of the royal family. They had taught the knowledge of Urita and the children of Earl who were close to the royal family. They were the most knowledgeable people in the royal city.
Gwyneth took her leave and led the people outside the palace down the thousand steps to the headquarters of the Institute of Magic.
Dudian wrote down all the questions that he wanted to ask. Although the answers given by Ovala might not be true but he didn’t expect him to do so, he could read the materials and books of the Monster Institute. Moreover he could combine the information from the other research institutes. It was enough for him to understand the progress of the Monster Institute.
“Saul, what happened to the corpses hanging under the steps of the Palace?”Dudian asked Saul.
Saul saw that Dudian finally asked about this, he bowed his head: “Sir, those corpses were traitors who came to the front of the palace to slander you. I sent people to stop them. They were stubborn so I took the initiative to kill them. I hung them in front of the palace so that others wouldn’t dare to do it again!”
Dudian nodded. He could roughly guess the answer, he said: “Let people take their bodies down. I have just succeeded the throne. I will cause panic among the people. Although I have seized power by force but if I want to continue for a long time I have to govern them with benevolence. Do you understand?”
Thor was startled: “I know I was wrong.”
“In the future, if you meet such a fool, send people to assassinate him secretly. There is no need to make such a fuss.”Dudian said indifferently.
Saul’s mouth twitched: “I know.”
Dudian turned to look at Aisha. He looked at her serene profile. His mood had also recovered. Suddenly, he thought of something and immediately stood up: “I’m going out. If there is anything, wait for me to come back.”
Thor and Neuss were about to speak but Dean had already rushed out of the palace.
Whoosh!
Dean flapped his magic wings and flew away.
“I’ve been busy with things in the palace these days. I almost forgot about this important matter.”Dean was in an urgent mood. He flew at full speed. In less than an hour, he had arrived above the dragon territory.
His mood was much calmer than the last time he came here.
“Who…”the guard saw Dudian who had landed. He was about to open his mouth to scold him when he saw Dudian’s face. His face was pale and his legs were trembling. He took a step back.
Dudian’s expression was calm: “Who is in charge of the Dragon Clan?”
“Yes, it’s elder Lariel.”The guard’s voice trembled.
Dudian’s eyebrows twitched as he remembered the name. His figure flew past the mountains of the Dragon Clan. His eyes changed color as he saw the figures of heat sources appear one after another. Soon.., his eyes locked onto the most energetic figure on the main peak. He quickly rushed over.
“Who!”
“Who is it…”
The guards on the mountain path saw Dudian rushing over. They were about to scold him but Dudian had already passed by them like a hurricane. In less than half a minute he had rushed to the top of the mountain. This was once a heavily guarded place of the Dragon Clan, at this moment it was like a no man’s land in front of him.
Dudian rushed to the square in front of the main peak and shouted: “Larry, come out and see me!”His voice echoed through the entire peak.
The guards on the square were startled and gathered over. When they saw Dudian they stopped shouting. Their faces were pale as if they had seen a ghost.
Seven or eight figures flew out from the building at the end of the square. They were shocked and frightened when they saw Dudian surrounded by guards.
Dudian looked at the middle-aged man who had the most heat in the group: “Are You Larry?”
The middle-aged man was embarrassed as he looked at dudian: “I… I’m not.”
“I am!”An old woman took a step forward and slammed the crutch onto the ground. Her face was full of anger as she stared at Dudian. There was no fear on her face, “What are you doing here? Do You Want to kill me?”
Dudian looked at her. She was also a pioneer but she wasn’t as strong as the middle-aged man. He felt strange but didn’t think much about it. After all, the Dragon clan was a family with nearly 300 years of history. The rules of the clan were strict, the strongest person might not be able to hold the power. He said: “If you want to die, I can fulfill your wish. But I only want one thing today. I hope you will behave and give it to me.”
The old woman frowned and coldly said: “What is it?”
“Aisha’s witcher. Blood Count.”Dudian said.

chapters.title: Chapter 806
chapters.content:
Chapter 806 – Chapter 796: Absorbing The Witcher [ Third Watch ]
“Blood count?”Larry frowned but was relieved. She knew the relationship between Dean and Aisha. She also knew that Hathaway had brought Aisha’s witcher back to the Dragon Clan. It was because she had brought back the blood count.., it was confirmed that Aisha was dead. After all, most pioneers wouldn’t abandon the witcher. Even if they were injured, they would find the witcher after they recovered. Moreover, there was a special connection between the owner and the witcher, usually, they could sense the location of the device. Even if they were thousands of miles away, they could feel a vague direction. So as long as they wanted to find it, they would definitely be able to find it.
“The blood baron is something of our Dragon Clan…”Larry considered his words and was ready to say some euphemistic words. After all, Dudian had come to their dragon clan to ask for something, they had obediently given it to them. It would be a joke if word got out.
“If you don’t give it then there will be no existence of the Dragon Clan.”Dudian interrupted her.
Larry’s words were stuck in her throat. Her mouth was slightly open and her tongue was almost tied. She looked at Dudian’s cold face. She was stunned for a long time. Anger rose in her heart as she clenched her teeth, she wanted to speak but she held back in the end. The Dragon Clan was no longer the same as before. Although their foundation was still there but their vitality was greatly damaged. The Dragon Mother, patriarch and other pioneers were killed one after another, there were only a few pioneers left in the wasteland but it was difficult for them to compete with Dudian. She didn’t dare to anger the teenager in front of her.
“Alright, I’ll give it to her!”She took a deep breath and calmed down the anger in her heart. Her old face gradually calmed down, “Aisha is a member of our Dragon Clan. No matter in the past or in the future, this blood baron is her witcher. It should be given to her.”
The coldness in Dudian’s eyes decreased: “Then give it to me.”
“Wait a moment, I’ll get someone to pick it up.”Larry saw that Dudian didn’t interrupt her this time. He whispered to the person next to him.
Dudian quietly waited. His eyes changed color as he looked at the person who left. After a moment, the person went to another mountain and returned. He was holding a huge dark red box. It was two feet wide and nine feet long, it looked like a door. The red paint on the box was deep. It was filled with an ancient and noble feeling. It was decorated with complicated patterns and the emblem of the Dragon Clan.
Dudian looked through the box and saw a huge sword lying quietly inside. It was the blood baron.
The person holding the blood baron was a young man. There was a bit of effort on his face but he carefully covered it up. It seemed that the box in his hand was quite heavy.
Larry gestured to him. The young man held the box and walked to Dudian. He looked at Dudian nervously as he carefully handed out the box.
Dudian grabbed the box and put it on his shoulder. He glanced at the crowd and turned around. He stretched out his wings and took off. In the blink of an eye he disappeared from everyone’s sight.
Larry and the others were relieved as they looked at dudian. They felt cold sweat on their backs. Although it was almost the Hot Black Death season but they felt cold in their clothes.
Larry clenched his walking stick and pursed his lips. There was hatred in his eyes, but there was more pain and sorrow.
Back in the palace, Dudian put away his magic wings and walked as fast as he could. He came to the front of Aisha who was sitting on the throne. The throne was spacious enough for two people to sit on. Dudian sat next to Aisha and put the box on his lap, he put the box in front of her and smiled: “Although it is a bit late but I have finally found the thing. Guess what is inside?”
Thor was stunned when he saw Dudian’s expression. He was like a child with a mischievous tone. Was it really the cold-blooded monster who had seized the palace and killed people?
Neuss was calm as if he was used to it.
Aisha’s expression finally changed when the box in Dudian’s hand was moved in front of her. Her pure black eyes slightly turned and looked down at the dark red box on her leg. She slightly raised her arm and touched the box, bang! It seemed to be a gentle touch, but it contained a terrifying power. It crushed the box and grabbed the hilt of the sword.
The dark red gem embedded in the hilt seemed to flash with a demonic light the moment she held it.
Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise when he saw Aisha take the initiative to change. Aisha could maintain her original posture even in the face of blood. Perhaps her appearance would change, but she would never reach out to touch it! Even her bloodthirsty instinct could be restrained, but at this moment she took the initiative to reach out and grab her witcher.
He thought of Larry’s words, and his heart was inexplicably shaken. Hunter and Witcher seemed to be inseparable partners!
At this time, the blood jue that Haisha was holding suddenly melted and turned into black mucus. It spread along her palm and climbed to her body. A moment later, black scales appeared on her body. She was about to enter the state of a demon.
Dudian was startled. He quickly shook the bell six times with a strange rhythm. This was the order to stop all actions.
When the bell ended, the black mucus on Haisha’s body also stopped. The next moment, the black mucus slowly sank into her skin and disappeared.
Dudian was startled. He helped her up and looked around her. He was surprised to find that her body was still in human form. However, the Blood Jue was gone. It seemed that it had sunk into her body!
However, once the witcher entered the human body, it would enter the state of the magic body. If the Witcher was released from the state of the magic body, it would return to the “Instrument”and leave its master’s body.
Dudian was a bit worried. He wasn’t worried that Aisha would lose control. He was worried that her body would be in a bad condition and hurt her body. He had never seen such a situation. He didn’t know what the consequences would be.., he suddenly felt a bit regretful for bringing the witcher back to her.
“I hope nothing will happen to you…”Dudian looked at her eyes. He wanted to see some feedback from her eyes, but all he could see was the darkness deep under the sea.
..
He finally knew why he was allergic to food yesterday. It should be said that he was poisoned. He was hungry and wanted to eat instant noodles, but he found that the flavor of the instant noodles was not right. He bought two packets of instant noodles and ate one yesterday, moreover, I directly threw the seasoning into the pot to cook. I didn’t smell it. Fortunately, I didn’t throw it into the pot to cook today. The date of production was September. Logically speaking, it shouldn’t have expired, my wife said, this date might have been reprinted by expired food. I thought about it. This noodles seemed to be on sale, so I bought it… speaking of which, this supermarket is a relatively famous big supermarket. As expected, there are no good products on sale

chapters.title: Chapter 807
chapters.content:
Chapter 807 – Chapter 977: Black And White [ First Update ]
After absorbing the witcher, Aisha returned to her original state. The light in her eyes gradually disappeared. She sat quietly like before. There was no expression and no movement.
Dudian stared at her for a long time. Time seemed to have stopped.
Seeing that she still didn’t respond, a dark golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes. He activated the magic marks’ability to see through her body. He carefully observed her body and soon found that there was black mucus on the gap of her spine, it was the melted blood baron.
The blood baron was bigger than Aisha when it was weaponized. But now after it melted, it shrank greatly. The condensed black mucus was only attached to the spine and dyed the spine black, moreover, the Horn of the bone became sharper. It looked like a ferocious black centipede or a dragon that was emitting demonic energy.
Dudian frowned and stared at it for a while. The black mucus seemed to have calmed down and there was no change. He looked at Aisha and finally retracted his eyes, at least there wouldn’t be any problems for the time being. But he couldn’t figure out why the witcher could merge into the body but not become a demon. It was probably because of Aisha’s corpse.
The incident was like an interlude that passed quickly.
Gwyneth and the royal professors returned to the palace in the middle of the night. Dudian was washing his feet. He called Neuss to let them in and continued to soak his feet.
“Young master, I’m back.”Gwyneth bowed as she looked at Dudian who was sitting in front of the desk in the back hall of the palace.
There were seven or eight professors behind her. Most of them were over fifty years old. Some of them had white hair. One of them looked the youngest but was already middle-aged.
“It’s been hard on you. Have you had dinner?”Dudian looked at Gwyneth.
Gwyneth bowed: “Thank you for your concern young master. I’ll go back to eat after I’m done.”
“There is no need to go back. I have asked Neuss to prepare it for you.”Dudian said.
Neuss understood and looked at the maid who left.
Gwyneth looked at dudian: “Thank you young master.”
“How was the harvest this time?”Dudian asked.
Gwyneth took out a small notebook: “Young Master, I have written Olava’s answers in this notebook.”
Neuss went forward and handed the notebook to Dudian.
Dudian opened the notebook and saw Gwyneth’s arm. He looked at each of the answers which corresponded to his question. He frowned and finally closed the notebook, “This old man didn’t live in vain. He isn’t afraid of Death!”
Gwyneth saw his expression and knew that there was a problem. She bowed her head: “Master, do you think his answer is to fool us?”
“This old man was aware of our purpose from the second question. He should have known about me and Aisha’s situation. So he answered all of your questions and some of his answers may deliberately mislead us.”Dudian’s eyes were indifferent, she threw the notebook into the trash bin.
Gwyneth looked at the notebook as it fell into the trash bin. She bit her lips: “Master, Please Punish Me for my incompetence!”
“You didn’t do anything wrong. Don’t blame yourself.”Dudian’s expression was calm, “I didn’t expect him to answer my questions so there are a few that are specifically aimed at him. In short, I have got the answer I want. You did a good job. Stay for dinner later.”
Gwyneth was startled as she didn’t understand what Dudian was saying. There was no trace of happiness on Dudian’s face but his words seemed to praise her. She couldn’t understand his thoughts, she thought for a moment and said: “I’ll go back and eat. It’s late so I Won’t disturb young master’s Rest.”
“It’s okay. I slept late. Neuss has prepared everything for you.”Dudian waved his hand and didn’t give her the opportunity to discuss, he asked the professors behind her: “Old Gentlemen, have you brought back all the books related to undead research? Have you missed anything?”
The eight professors saw that Dudian had finally mentioned them. One of them took a step forward, he respectfully replied: “Sir, we have selected all the books related to undead research in the underground library of Orava. We have checked twice to make sure that we haven’t missed anything. As far as I know, all the precious materials of the Institute of magic are stored in Orava’s library. He often reads them.”
Dudian nodded: “Were there any traces of passive movement in the library?”
The old professor was smart enough to understand Dudian’s meaning, he smiled: “Lord Gwyneth said that there would be a surprise attack so we went very suddenly. I don’t think they would be able to move some materials in time. Moreover they don’t know the purpose of our trip. I see that there is no empty space on the bookshelves. All the books in the empty bookshelves can be found on the next desk.”
Dudian nodded: “What was the old man’s attitude when you asked for the book?”
Although the old professor knew that Dudian was referring to Olava but he felt a bit embarrassed. After all he was the same age as Olava, he said: “Although Olava was surprised but he didn’t stop us. His students were angry but he stopped them.”
Dudian understood: “Everyone has worked hard. It’s late. Go back and rest early.”
“Yes, sir.”The old professor and the other seven respectfully said. They were disappointed to see that Dudian didn’t ask them to stay for dinner.
After the professors left the palace, Gwyneth asked the guards to carry the selected books to the palace. The books were stacked high. Dudian estimated that there were about two or three hundred books.
He would rather die than read so many books when he was young. But now he was excited to see these books. It was not because he was eager to learn, the more books there were, the more research the institute had done in this area. It meant that there was a greater hope to find a way to solve this problem!
Moreover, with his current memory and vision, his reading speed was dozens of times faster than ordinary people. Although there were many books but he believed that he would be able to finish them in a short time.
Late at night, after Gwyneth and Neuss left the room, Dudian asked the maid to light the fireplace. He prepared a brazier and put it under the desk to dry. This request made the maid surprised, it was almost the hot and dark season. Dudian had used the brazier and fireplace which was only used during the black snow season. If others knew about it, they would think that he was crazy.
Dudian was very sensitive to the temperature. The temperature dropped at night. He felt the cold air in his right arm. It seemed to flow into his body so he had to use the fireplace and brazier, at the same time he prepared his own white wine. He was not addicted to alcohol but it could warm him up. Moreover white wine was better than wine in driving out the cold.
He picked up the night light and piled seven or eight books on the desk. He picked them up and read them one by one.
Later in the night he was sleepy. He asked the maid to prepare hot water. He washed his face and continued to read.
Time flew by.
Dudian was reading in the palace. However, the royal city was still in shock because of the arrest of urita. The nobles in other cities were also eager to make a move. Many wealthy businessmen were looking forward to it. They were ready to take advantage of the situation to make a big profit.
Saul was working with Neuss according to Dudian’s instructions. He was helping Dudian to clean up his reputation and spread his prestige.
Neuss was more experienced than Saul in these two aspects. However he wasn’t familiar with the positions and forces in the inner wall so he had to cooperate with Saul. Both of them discussed and spread the news of Dudian’s succession to all the cities.
“It’s unbelievable that her highness is a traitor who colluded with the invaders!”
“What’s there to be surprised about? What can’t be done in this day and age?”
“How come I heard that Dudian is the one who took over the palace? There are rumors that he is the intruder who defeated the princess. Now he wants to arrest her highness?”
“Where did you hear such unreliable news?”? The matter of the princess colluding with the intruder had long been fixed. Didn’t you read the previous newspapers? Master Morksey has come out to condemn and scold her. He is so old. How could he lie?”
“That’s true. Master Moxie has always been upright. I really didn’t expect her highness to be so ambitious. Indeed, ugly people have ugly hearts…”
“Yeah, I heard that her face was replaced by the Monster Research Institute when she was twelve years old. Haven’t you seen her original appearance? She’s so ugly that she can’t Eat!”
“Tut Tut, it’s good to have power and influence!”
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian had read more than two hundred books. His memory had been strong since he was young. Now he had evolved into an expert of the inner wilderness level. His memory had improved a lot, although it wasn’t as exaggerated as having a photographic memory, but he could write it down after reading it a few times.
“My Lord, Tomorrow is your coronation. Do you have anything to prepare?”Saul asked respectfully.
Dudian looked up from the book: “How are the restless nobles?”
“My lord, eight counts have come to the imperial city to participate in your coronation. There are three left. One of them has no news. The other two are going to join forces with the Institute of Magic to attack you. But the Institute of Magic hasn’t replied to them so they are still waiting.”

chapters.title: Chapter 808
chapters.content:
Chapter 808 – Chapter 798: Duonuclear Undeads [ Second Update ]
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he heard Saul’s words: “Then prepare their heads as the prelude to the celebration!”
Saul was startled. He knew that Dudian would be tempted to kill him. He didn’t want to be dragged into the water because of the three people who couldn’t see the situation: “Sir, is it an assassination or… ?”
“Do you need to ask?”Dudian glanced at him. “They don’t obey the orders of the king and are openly rebellious. If it is an assassination, aren’t we wrong?”
Saul was frightened by Dudian’s look. He bowed his head but cursed in his heart. We were wrong. He knew what Dudian meant. He spoke in a respectful tone: “I know, sir. But there are pioneers under the command of the three counts. We…”
“You will lead the team. Anyone who disobeys will be killed!”Dudian’s eyes fell back to the book.
Saul was surprised. He wanted to reduce the amount of sin he had. He didn’t expect that Dudian would increase his sin. He didn’t dare to haggle. He heard a trace of impatience from Dudian’s tone. He bowed his head, he slowly retreated.
“Master, Tomorrow is your coronation ceremony. Aren’t you going to rest?”Neuss was worried as he saw Dudian continue to study hard.
He knew that Dudian hadn’t slept for four days and four nights. Even if Dudian’s physique was different from ordinary people, but it was quite hard for him to read for such a long time.
“It’s alright. I will sleep for a while.”Dudian casually said. He didn’t think that the coronation was a big day. In his opinion, it was a small matter. After all, he had confirmed the throne, he didn’t care about the title anymore. On the contrary, this ceremony was an extremely important day for the other people in the inner wall. Everyone who was considered as a person would pay more attention to this ceremony.
The Sun was setting in the west.
The faint light reflected from the window into Dudian’s desk. There was a warm feeling on the soft carpet.
“Increase Soul Crystals?”Dudian’s eyes were attracted by the book in his hand. There was a trace of concentration in his eyes. He carefully looked at the book. It was an experiment record and speculation carried out by a doctor from the Monster Institute, the experiment record made him find it interesting. It was a whim: “Experiment Subject: UNDEADS. Number: two. Gender: male and female.”
“Main experiment process: cut the skull and add soul crystals.”
“Experiment result: after the male undeads were cut the second undeads of the same gender were added with soul crystals. After the skull was sutured, the male undeads behaved normally.”. (the experiment was traced to three months later. During a predation, the target’s body suddenly stiffened and died on the spot.)
“The result of the female zombie experiment was that the second soul crystal of the same gender was added and the target died on the spot.”
“After the experiment, the ‘male zombie’was dissected to confirm the cause of death. The two soul crystals were connected together and caused the original soul crystals in the head to shift and die.”
“The 142nd experiment begins…”
Dudian flipped through the pages. The doctor’s experiment always revolved around adding new soul crystals to the zombie’s head. The Soul Crystals added to the zombie’s head would change every time. Some would choose the same soul crystals, some would choose the soul crystals of the same sex zombie. Some were of the opposite sex, he had the spirit catcher (an organization in the Monster Research Institute mentioned in the book, which specialized in finding rare experimental materials for researchers) infect a mother and daughter, a mother and son, and a pair of twins with the corpse poison.
In these experiments, only the infected twins reacted. The Doctor in the experiment killed the younger brother of the twins, took the soul crystals from their heads, and added them to his elder brother’s head, as a result, his brother’s strength became extraordinarily powerful. According to the data in the experiment, the strength of a level five undead suddenly increased to level 60. It could easily tear the limiter apart, only the pioneers were sent to suppress it.
But soon after, the body of the undead began to show signs of ice. The final result of the experiment was that his brother’s body was completely frozen and became the collection of the Doctor.
Dudian read until the end. The doctor had tried many combinations. There were father and son, partners who had slept with each other, and so on. But all of the experiments failed. Only the experiment of the twin brothers was considered progress.
Dudian had read more than 200 books. There were few changes in the research of zombies. Although this kind of change did not help Aisha, but compared to other inhuman experiments that failed.., it wasn’t bad.
“The soul crystals between twins will fuse with each other and cause the power to go berserk. It seems that the genetic method is a bit special…”Dudian’s eyes lit up, the doctor had carried out experiments with twins. He planned to develop his experiment into a terrifying weapon. After all, a level five undead could go berserk and easily tear the limiter apart, if he could produce such zombies in large numbers, it would be quite terrifying.
Therefore, the doctor carried out the twin experiments with different physiques. Before they were infected, he raised their physiques to the level of beginner, intermediate, and advanced hunters.
The strength of an ordinary person’s infected zombies was only around level three. The first pair of twin brothers were relatively strong military first lieutenant officers, so they reached level five, a beginner Hunter was equivalent to a level 10 zombie. If they were infected, their physiques would greatly increase, reaching the bottom of level 13 to 15.
In the Doctor’s experiment, he failed twice in three experiments, but because of a problem with the operation of the experiment. Later, he filled in the same “Material”to carry out the experiment, after three successful experiments, the zombie’s physique was that of a pioneer, a pioneer, and three pioneers who had joined hands to suppress it.
“Eh?”Dudian’s peripheral vision swept to the inner side of the last page. There seemed to be a bit of paper beard. His eyes moved, “Has it been torn at the back?”
He looked at the inner side. The trace was a bit old. It seemed that it had been torn a long time ago.
“Could it be that there was an experiment on the limiter twins?”Dudian couldn’t help but think of this point. He suddenly thought of the monster event that Saul had mentioned, could it be that the professor had used the limiter twins to create the experiment?
He wasn’t sure if it was the same experiment. But this experiment was shocking enough. The senior hunter twins were able to burst out with power close to that of the inner wasteland level after the experiment. Such an increase was simply terrifying!
However, from the contents of the book, it could be seen that all the experimental subjects were locked up and could only be controlled by force. It was clear that the Monster Institute didn’t have a way to control the undeads.
“It seems that they haven’t thought of the way of conditioned reflex. If they could control it, I guess the old guy wouldn’t have put this book on the shelf…”Dudian thought, the results of the experiment were very shocking. The only drawback was that the undeads couldn’t be controlled by Dudian. They could only be used as bombs to attack the enemy.
However… everyone in the giant wall was in the same area. Once the undeads were created it would be a disaster for the entire giant wall. No one would be able to escape!
However, things were not so absolute. If they could accurately calculate the strength of the UNDEADS after the experiment then they could estimate the number of enemy forces, they could also greatly weaken the enemy’s strength.
From this point of view, this experiment was enough to be used as a weapon of war!
It was even ten or a hundred times more terrifying than a cannon!
“Scientific research is really dangerous…”Dudian thought. Although there weren’t many twins but it was easy to find hundreds of pairs in the giant wall.
