However, the success rate of the experiment wasn’t 100% even for twins. Moreover the process of the experiment was complex and the steps were complicated. It was easy to make mistakes. It was possible that more than ten pairs of twins had to be sacrificed in order to succeed.
“It seems that the headquarters of the Monster Laboratory is more dangerous than I thought. It is very likely that they have hidden an inner wasteland level or even a master level dual-core undeads. However, they shouldn’t be able to control them so they don’t dare to release them. However, if they take the initiative to rush in, they will fall into the same cage as the dual-core undeads. The result will be very miserable. It seems that there is a deeper reason why the wall master never goes to the headquarters of the Monster Laboratory…”Dudian thought, this made him feel a little fortunate, but also a little fearful.
But more than that, he was pleasantly surprised.
Although he had the super chip in hand, most of the thermal weapons that he could create had limitations. For example, cannons and missiles, not to mention the complicated manufacturing process, they had strong requirements for various materials. Even if he could create them.., in this post-disaster world where non-human combat power existed, they were not popular.
With his current strength, the only people who could make him feel danger were the rulers and the abyss. It was impossible for such people to be killed by missiles, or even hit by them.
After all, although the missiles were fast, they were still visible to the naked eye. Unlike electricity, even the abyss might not be able to react in time.
Under such circumstances, such a dual-core berserk zombie was undoubtedly a super single-soldier war weapon!
This was his biggest gain so far. Although many of his previous experiments could produce extremely powerful monsters, such as the bug-man experiments, which had detailed records, the combat strength of the bug-man was not strong, moreover, the experiments were even more difficult than this.

chapters.title: Chapter 809
chapters.content:
Chapter 809 – : Chapter 799: Poisoning
That night, Dudian decided to have a rest after eating.
Before going to bed, he habitually drank a small bottle of hot white wine. He felt warm all over and the chill in his right arm was dispelled a lot. He hugged Aisha and went to sleep.
The beauty was like Jade. She was lying in his arms. Dudian gently hugged her body without any evil thoughts. It was not that he did not have feelings for Aisha, but he could not bear to blaspheme.
Slowly, Dudian’s consciousness blurred. He vaguely saw Aisha sitting up in his arms. He also sat up. Their surroundings had turned into a world of ice and snow, then he saw Aisha use her hands to build ice and cast a wall to surround them. The wind and snow were suddenly blocked. He sat on the ground and looked at her in a daze for a long, long time..
Until a sharp pain came from his abdomen. Dean suddenly woke up and opened his eyes.
The light in the bedroom was on, even when he was sleeping. The ultra-wide field of view allowed him to see everything in the room in an instant, except for the mattress on his back. There was no one in the bedroom so he was relieved. He slowly stretched out his hand to support his body. He felt that the pain in his abdomen slowly turned into a cramp. He found that his back was soaked with cold sweat.
He was slightly panting. He felt that his mouth and tongue were dry. He wanted to drink water but his body was paralyzed. The pain made him unable to exert himself.
“Come, come!”Dudian shouted.
After a few minutes, there was a rush of footsteps coming from outside the bedroom. A few maids rushed in. They saw Dudian who was sweating all over the bed. His face was red. They were scared, “Sir, sir, what happened to you?”
“Call, Call Neuss.”Dudian panted.
A few maids heard him and ran away. One of them was left in the bedroom to look after dudian. She saw Dudian’s weak face, she couldn’t help but carefully ask: “My lord, is there anything I can help you with?”
“Water.”Dudian reluctantly spat out a word.
He felt that his breathing was getting heavier and heavier. The pain in his abdomen spread to his chest. His entire heart seemed to be distorted and twitching. Moreover, the pain affected his nerves. He even felt that his head was hurting.
The maid heard his words and quickly took the cup to pour water for Dudian. She brought it to Dudian.
Dudian was about to take the cup when he suddenly thought of something. He waved his hand and knocked the cup to the ground. Fortunately, the carpet in the bedroom was thick. The cup wasn’t broken but the water was spilled.
The maid was scared and hurriedly knelt down: “Lizhi should die. Lizhi should die. Please spare my life…”
Dudian was breathing heavily. He was upset to hear her begging but he didn’t have the strength to stop her. He let her kneel. He slightly drooped his eyelids and looked ahead. His vision was a bit blurry, he felt that his brain wasn’t working. But his previous life and death experiences made him have a strong resistance to this uncomfortable state.
He reluctantly concentrated and thought about the reason for the sudden situation. At the same time he quietly waited for Neuss to come.
Ten minutes later Neuss rushed over. He was still wearing his pajamas. Dudian’s heart was warm.
“Master, what happened to you? Why are you so Red?”Neuss saw Dudian’s red face. He was shocked and panicked.
“I… I might be poisoned.”Dudian reluctantly said: “Go and find a doctor. Prepare the life capsule.”
Neuss was shocked. He came to the inner wall and knew that the life capsule was the most precious medicine in the royal family. It was not an exaggeration to say that it was a life-saving medicine. Basically as long as there was a breath left, it could be saved, however there were only two in total. Moreover the formula had been lost. He didn’t expect that dudian would use it now. It was clear that his condition was in danger.
He turned around and shouted at the guard to pass on Dudian’s words.
Dudian felt that his throat was about to dry. He struggled to say: “Give Me Water.”
Neuss immediately turned around and took two cups. He poured out one cup and drank two mouthfuls. After a while he poured out another cup and handed it to Dudian.
Dudian slightly raised his hand but he couldn’t lift it halfway. He could only use his eyes to signal Neuss.
Neuss was surprised. He didn’t expect that dudian would be poisoned so severely. He was nervous because he was Dudian’s drug examiner.
He was worried but he was more afraid that if anything happened to Dudian then everything would be over.
He helped Dudian up and fed him water.
A moment later, a few doctors and a large group of guards came. Sergei, Gwyneth and Saul also came. In addition there were several ministers in charge of the internal affairs of the royal family who had surrendered to Dudian.
“Get out. Doctors stay.”Dudian said.
Sergei, Gwyneth, Saul and others looked at each other. They wanted to ask but they held back and slowly retreated.
Several doctors came forward to diagnose dudian. Neuss was holding the box of the life capsule and waiting. If Dudian was going to die, he would immediately pass the life capsule to Neuss.
“Master, you are poisoned.”The doctor exclaimed as he looked at Dudian’s body.
The other doctors saw that there were lumps of sarcomas on Dudian’s abdomen. It was extremely ugly. Moreover they could faintly see the veins on his chest. It was obvious that he was poisoned. Another doctor immediately opened the medicine box and took out a bottle. He poured the powder inside onto the gauze. He took out a knife and said to dudian: “Elder, we need to further check. Do you think we need to exsanguinate?”
“Yes.”Dudian said.
The doctor nodded slightly. His face was solemn. He went forward and cut the sarcoma on Dudian’s abdomen. He applied the gauze which was stained with powder. A moment later he took off the gauze. He saw that the gauze was pitch black and emitted a foul smell.
“It is poison.”The Doctor next to him took a deep breath: “What a powerful poison!”
Neuss’s face was ugly as he looked at the doctors: “What Kind of poison is this? Can it be cured?”
The doctors looked at him and then looked at dudian: “This needs to be further tested. I will give the adult some antidotes. I hope the adult can stand it!”
Dudian thought that if he couldn’t stand it then he would die.
“Go and prepare.”Dudian said.
The doctors saw that he was ready. They turned around and left.
Dudian looked at Neuss. Neuss’s soul almost flew out, he hurriedly said: “Master, I have tested everything you ate. There is absolutely no poison. If there is poison then I will be poisoned too. I didn’t lie to you…”
Dudian stared at him for a while and slowly said: “I have never doubted you. Everyone will betray me. You Won’t either.”
Neuss was stunned. He felt touched. His eyes reddened: “Master, do you really believe me?”
“Of course. Otherwise how would I dare to put my life in your hands?”Dudian’s voice was weak but very serious. He felt that the pain in his body was slowly adapting. It was not as unbearable as before, at least his words were complete: “There are countless people who want to assassinate me. Someone has poisoned me. Either your body is immune to the poison or I have eaten something that you haven’t eaten.”
Neuss saw that Dudian’s eyes were serious. It seemed that he didn’t suspect him. He was touched. He couldn’t help but think of the strangeness of the matter, he said: “If there is poison then I should be able to test it out. The poison is so strong. Even if I am immune to it it is impossible that I didn’t notice anything abnormal. Could it be… master you have eaten something that I haven’t eaten?”
Dudian also felt that the possibility was greater. His eyes revealed a thoughtful look.
He was cautious in every way. Neuss had tasted everything that he had eaten. Even the water that he had drunk had been tested by Neuss… suddenly his eyes moved as he looked at the small wine bottle on the desk.
He didn’t let Neuss test the white wine.
“You should drink the wine.”Dudian said.
Neuss was startled. He knew that Dudian liked to drink wine. He wanted to try the wine for Dudian but the wine was too strong. It was stronger than the beer and wine that he had drunk, the taste could be said to be pungent. He didn’t want to try it because of his endurance.
He immediately went forward and grabbed the small wine bottle on the desk. He saw that there was half a bottle inside and drank it in one gulp.
The cold liquid passed through his throat but brought a burning feeling. He choked and almost burst into tears. He couldn’t understand why Dudian liked to drink such strong wine. wasn’t wine a hundred times more delicious than this?
Dudian looked at his uncomfortable face. It seemed that a man’s tears were about to flow out. He couldn’t help but feel a bit funny. But he also knew that Noyce’s taste was biased towards the taste of Westerners, it was normal that he couldn’t get used to drinking white wine. It was the same reason why he thought that wine tasted bad.
Noyce tried to adapt to the discomfort brought by white wine. At the same time he looked at his own body and seriously felt it. After a moment, the stimulation of the wine gradually subsided but he felt that there was nothing strange about his body.
“Master, it seems that the liquor is not poisonous.”Neuss said.
Dudian said: “There is no hurry. It has been a while since I drank the liquor.”
Neuss turned back to Dudian.
Dudian wanted to wait for his body to have a toxic reaction but he suddenly thought that the news of his poisoning should have spread out. The person who poisoned him probably already knew the news, he had to confirm whether there was poison in the wine as soon as possible so that he would have a direction to follow.
“Go and find a maid.”Dudian’s eyes flashed a trace of coldness.
Neuss was stunned for a moment. He didn’t understand but he called a maid to come in.
The maid was delicate and beautiful. She had a graceful figure. She looked shy and shy. She didn’t dare to look at Dudian but her face was full of fear and trepidation, everyone in the palace knew the process of Dudian’s ascension to the throne. The story of Dudian’s ascension to the throne was becoming more and more brutal. The maid’s impression of him was like that of a devil.
“Give her some wine from the bottle.”Dudian said.
Neuss was stunned: “Master, this…”
“What’s Your Name?”Dudian didn’t pay attention to him but asked the maid.
“My name is Aina.”The maid lowered her head.
Dudian asked: “Who is in your family?”
The maid was at a loss but answered truthfully: “Your honor, in addition to my parents, I have a younger brother who is studying tailoring in the hill district.”
Dudian nodded slightly but there was a trace of coldness in his eyes, “After drinking the wine, your parents will move to the Trump District to live. The royal family will assign them a house. Your younger brother will be sent to the Trump District to study. The royal family will pay the tuition fees.”
Neuss looked at him and then looked at the maid called Aina. He found that the maid seemed to be shocked by Dudian’s generous conditions. She seemed to think that such a beautiful thing was not real, he felt a bit of pain in his heart. He could only sigh in his heart. He knew what Dudian was thinking. The maid was just an ordinary person. If she drank the poison then she would immediately be poisoned, the poison was in the wine.
However, the maid didn’t know that Dudian’s condition was to buy her life.
This was an unequal deal. The weak side wasn’t qualified to talk about conditions.
The strong preyed on the weak. The fate was unfair. At this moment he deeply felt the helplessness of life. He felt pity for the maid but it was only pity because he was once a weak person, he knew that everything was the iron law of the world. Fortunately, he was now standing on the strong side.
Dudian naturally didn’t know that this move made Neuss feel a lot of emotions. But he knew that Neuss would feel a bit cruel. But he knew that he had to adapt to it. So he didn’t avoid him.
“Drink.”Dudian said to Aina.
Aina looked at the wine on the table. She saw that Dudian often drank wine. She knew what wine was. When she was chosen to be a maid in the royal family she knew that men often used wine to cheat women into bed, so now her face was a bit red and her heart was beating fast. She didn’t know how she would be treated after drinking. Would she become a Princess?
She had a little bit of expectation but was also a bit nervous. She picked up the wine but found that the bottle was empty.
She looked at Dudian with an innocent expression.
Dudian glanced at Neuss and said to aina: “There should be one or two drops left.”
Aina’s face was slightly red. She turned the bottle upside down and licked the wine out of the bottle in front of Dudian and Neuss. She felt that she was not a lady so her face was very red.
Soon, a strong smell of wine made her feel a bit drunk. Her consciousness gradually blurred and her body seemed to be hot. was this the feeling of drinking wine? She thought so, and then blackout, completely unconscious.

chapters.title: Chapter 810
chapters.content:
Chapter 810 – Chapter 800: Failure
Neuss hugged the fallen aina and touched her neck. Her neck was warm and soft but it didn’t beat.
“Young master, she is dead.”Neuss sighed in his heart and turned to Dudian.
“I know.”Dudian’s eyes were gloomy.
Neuss slowly put down Aina’s body and looked at the bottle on the table: “There is poison in the wine. Young master, should I capture all the people who made the wine and interrogate them one by one?”
Dudian was silent for a moment: “In addition to the people who made the wine, there are also all the servants, attendants and poisoners who have served me in the palace.”
Neuss replied: “I know.”
It didn’t take long for the doctors to come back and prepare for Dudian’s bloodletting operation.
The treatment lasted until the second half of the night. The doctors wiped the sweat from their foreheads and stitched up Dudian’s wound, the chief surgeon said: “My Lord, the toxin in your body is stable for the time being. You should take anti-toxin regularly. After a period of time, you will be completely cured.”
Dudian nodded slightly, he said: “I have been poisoned. Don’t tell anyone about it. If someone asks you about it, report it immediately. I will reward you handsomely. In addition, if someone forces you, say that I have been poisoned so deeply that I won’t live long.”
The doctors were startled and bowed their heads.
Neuss returned after the doctors slowly retreated, he looked at dudian: “Master, the results of the interrogation have come out. One of the workers who made the wine has confessed. He said that his distant relatives had visited him recently. Other people also accused that his relatives had come to the brewery. It is very likely that this person poisoned him. I asked the worker. His relative is not a big shot. He is just an ordinary small-scale family. He has two manors and fifty acres of land. There is nothing special about him.”
“Oh?”Dudian’s face was pale but his expression was calm. He was surprised to hear Neuss’words: “Have you found his distant relatives?”
“I have sent people to capture them.”Neuss said.
Dudian’s eyebrows twitched. He didn’t expect to find the poisoner so soon. It seemed that the enemy’s preparations were not complete. However, it was possible that the secret work was not needed.
“The dawn is coming and the succession ceremony is about to begin. Let’s Get Ready.”Dudian looked at the faint light outside the window.
Neuss was startled: “Master, you are seriously injured. Should we postpone the succession ceremony? If the enemy sneaks into the ceremony and attacks you…”
“It doesn’t matter. If there is a sneak attack then aren’t you still there?”Dudian’s face was calm, “It’s just a small poison. Since I’m not dead then it doesn’t matter. But the poison is not ordinary. Fortunately the enemy has nothing to do with the Monster Institute. Otherwise I wouldn’t have just died from poison.”
Neuss was stunned. He understood what Dudian meant. If the enemy had something to do with the monster institute then maybe the poison in the wine would be an undead virus. If that was the case then there would be no cure.
Cold sweat broke out on his forehead as he thought of this.
What a dangerous accident!
If the enemy’s poison was stronger then Dudian would die!
Once Dudian died then their lives would end and they would be torn apart by the aristocrats!
Moreover Dudian’s words gave him a warning. Although he could digest most of the toxins but he wasn’t immune to the absolute toxins. If the enemy was crazy enough to poison dudian.., then the first one to be infected would be him!
This possibility made it difficult for him to digest. In the past he had only considered toxins in the outer wall because it was extremely difficult to get the zombie virus in the inner wall. Especially in the outer wall but the inner wall was different.., the Institute of Magic was holding the undeads. It was not difficult to get the zombie virus from their hands. Moreover the people who could assassinate Dudian were not ordinary people but more or less influential.
“It seems that I have to choose a few people to be my drug examiner…”he thought. It was his way to save himself.
Dudian felt Neuss’stiff body. He looked at him but he didn’t say anything. He pretended not to see anything, he continued: “I don’t know if they didn’t think about it or if they didn’t have the ability to get the zombie virus.”
Neuss came back to his senses, he forced a smile: “Master, I think they didn’t expect that these people would be able to secretly poison your wine. They should have some ability. There was an outbreak of chaos in the inner wall recently. Although the undeads in the city were burned but it shouldn’t be difficult to get the corpse poison.”
“According to you they should have thought of using the corpse poison.”Dudian said.
Neuss was stunned. He was speechless.
“There are only two possibilities. Either they think that using the corpse poison to infect me would be more dangerous. After all, I am an expert in the inner wall. Once I am infected, there will be two more undeads in the inner wall. The result will be worse than the current situation.”Dudian’s eyes lit up, slowly, he speculated: “The second possibility is that they don’t have a deep understanding of the zombie poison. They think that the low-level zombie’s zombie poison might not be able to infect me. Which one do you think is more likely?”
Neuss was stunned: “It should be the first one, right?”
Dudian nodded, “That’s right. This means that they know about Aisha’s existence. They also know that she is infected by the zombie poison. They are afraid that she will lose control of herself if she loses control of me!”! From this point of view, it’s not that they don’t want to use the zombie poison. It’s that they don’t dare to use it! However, this also means that the person who poisoned her shouldn’t be a noble or the Institute of Magic.”
He fell into deep thought.
Neuss asked: “Why not a noble or the Institute of Magic?”
“Because they wouldn’t care so much. The nobles are pursuing profits. The Institute of Magic should have a way to trap the undeads. If it was them, they would have directly poisoned the undeads. But the person who poisoned her has a heart that takes the overall situation into consideration. It’s considered kind.”Dudian said.
Neuss scratched his head: “Master, are they heroes?”
Dudian looked at him: “You are talking as if we are the villains in the novels.”
Neuss smiled in embarrassment. He thought that they were not far from the villains.
“What is the name of this maid? First settle her family and compensate them according to what I said.”Dudian pointed to the corpse on the ground.
Neuss looked at the swollen and rotten cheeks of the maid. He bitterly smiled in his heart. He didn’t believe that with Dudian’s memory he would forget the name he had just heard, unless Dudian didn’t take the latter’s words to heart and didn’t use his brain to remember it.
Cold-blooded. He thought of this word but asked himself. So what if he remembered her name? She was already dead. would remembering it make her look more friendly?
He could only sigh. He squatted down and picked up Aina’s body. He looked at the rotten skin all over her body. In just a short while, the poison had made a clean and beautiful girl look like this, neither human nor ghost, it could be seen how terrifying the poison was!
The sky was clear, and the Sun had just risen.
The succession ceremony slowly began in front of the palace. The nobles, led by the count, entered the venue one after another. The guards were dressed in silver armor. They were neat and orderly, and their auras were mighty. Everything was proceeding in an orderly manner, outside the venue of the ceremony, a large number of people came to watch the rare moment.
When all the officials and nobles took their seats, Saul came forward to give a speech.
After the long opening speech, Dudian put on the royal robe and held the scepter. He appeared on the highest platform in front of the palace. He finished Saul’s pre-written lines and returned to the palace. As for the rest of the matters.., he left everything to Saul. Neuss was his assistant.
“Is this Dudian?”
“I didn’t expect him to be so young. He is younger than the rumors!”
“He is at most twenty years old!”
“His Highness seems to be around the same age as him. I didn’t expect that one is in the sky and the other is on the ground. It’s a pity!”
“Shhh, keep quiet. Don’t let others hear you. If this person hears you… Humph! Don’t you know what will happen to Ximing?”
The nobles in front of the hall were discussing and feeling complicated.
They didn’t have the heart to listen to Saul’s long speech.
Dudian returned to the study room. The bells and music were playing outside the window. He knew that the ceremony would last until the evening, the entire imperial city would hold a carnival. He didn’t have much time to spend on these things. Although his absence would make people feel proud.
“There are dozens of books. I hope they won’t let me down!”Dudian looked at the pile of books in front of him. He was a bit nervous. He even felt that these books were too few. It would be good if he could double them.
He read carefully.
Five days passed in the blink of an eye.
The carnival had long ended. The imperial city had fallen into silence. Dudian stayed in the study for several days. He only met the nobles and ministers in the palace on the night of the celebration, he stayed in the study and read the books of the research institute.
Five days had passed and he had finished reading the remaining dozens of books. During this time the toxins in his body had been completely digested by his body. His adaptability was even more effective than the anti-toxin drugs prescribed by the doctors.
“Failure, failure, all failure…”Dudian’s hair was messy as he looked at the pile of more than 200 books. His eyes were dull, almost half of the research about the undead was about how to cure the undead and restore them to their original state. In addition to his concern, the Monster Institute was also concerned about this experiment.
Over the past 200 years, a large number of doctors had studied this experiment, but all of them failed!
There were those who removed the soul crystals from the skull and replaced them with human brains.
Some had locked the zombies in a room they were familiar with while they were alive to observe them.
Some had used the blood of their relatives to exchange for blood.
There were all kinds of methods, and some of them even made him feel that they were completely unscientific and superstitious methods. However, these doctors had also used up almost all of the methods he could think of.
And the result was the same — failure.
It was difficult for him to accept such a conclusion.
Was she really dead after being infected by the zombie poison?
Why could she still move and bite people?
If she wasn’t dead, why couldn’t she recover her memory?
“Master…”Neuss shouted from outside the room and was ready to push the door open.
Dudian suddenly shouted: “Get Out!”
Neuss who had just pressed his hand on the door was startled. He had never seen Dudian shout at him, let alone lose his temper. His face slightly changed as he looked inside with concern, he could see Dudian sitting on the desk with his back facing the door. He didn’t know what he was thinking.
He hesitated for a moment but slowly turned back and stood guard outside the door.
He had been standing guard for seven days.
Seven days was exceptionally fast for the residents of the Imperial City. But for Neuss it was as difficult as the entire black snow season because Dudian hadn’t left the bedroom for seven days. He didn’t eat or drink, he was ready to deliver food when Dudian shouted out again.
“What happened to Young Master?”Sergei ran into the palace. He heard that Dudian stayed in the study for seven days without eating or drinking.
Neuss looked at him and sighed: “It should be related to Aisha.”
“With her?”Sergei was puzzled.
“The young master brought back a lot of experimental materials related to zombies from the Monster Research Institute. It seems that he has read all of them. I guess he couldn’t find the answer from them, so he couldn’t accept it.”Noyce sighed.
Sergei was slightly startled and widened his eyes. “Is there really no way?”
“It’s probably very difficult,”Noyce said in a low voice.
Sergei looked at the shadow in the room in a daze. “Then won’t He Go Crazy?”
“He hasn’t eaten anything for seven days. I’m worried that he won’t be able to hold on,”Noyce said worriedly. “He was poisoned previously and hasn’t recovered yet.”
Sergei shook his head slightly. “Eating and drinking is a small matter. I’m just afraid that he won’t be able to take it lying down.”
Noyce glanced at him. “Why don’t you go up and persuade him?”
“How?”Sergei glared at him. “Don’t you know how important this woman is to him? Have you ever seen him smile at you? I don’t think so.”
Noyce sighed and said, “I heard from the Dragon clan that Aisha ended up like this because she saved young master. She’s the most important thing to young master.”
“Sigh, what kind of world is this? Good people have short lives.”Sergei was a little helpless.

chapters.title: Chapter 811
chapters.content:
Chapter 811 – Chapter 801: Transformation
“I hope that young master can come to his senses. Although the separation of life and death is the greatest sorrow in the world, everyone will experience it. There will inevitably be regrets in life, and there are things that can not be helped. However, life will not stop here. I hope that he will not continue to be decadent,”Noyce said in a low voice, his gaze was gloomy.
Sergei nodded. “Even the painful torture in prison was unable to defeat him. He should not be defeated by this.”
Neuss bitterly said, “For people with weak will, it is easy to be broken by external pressure. But for people with a strong will like young master, the only thing that can destroy him is himself.”
Sergei was silent as he looked at the closed door.
Aisha was quietly sitting on a chair in the room. There was a messy figure sitting on the carpet in front of her feet. It was Dean. In just seven days, there was stubble growing out of his mouth, there was a bit of sadness in his eyes. He looked up at Aisha. He put his hand on her knee and felt the smooth but cold knee. His heart was throbbing.
Although he didn’t have much hope that he could find a way to cure the undeads from the experiments of the Monster Institute. After all, if such a method existed, the monster institute would have used it a long time ago, this was definitely a good thing for mankind, but the Monster Research Institute did not use it, so he was already confident. However, he still held a hope that even if there was no cure, he could at least find some direction and clues from it, or a method that could inspire him to explore.
However, none of these were there.
All the experiments ended in failure.
Moreover, these experiments were very complete. Even if he were to do them, it would be difficult for him to do them better.
Was there really no hope?
He looked at her and asked himself repeatedly in his heart.
Although he didn’t want to think about it or admit it, the remnant of reason in his heart told him how far and irreversible the boundary between life and death was! Even the richest man in the world in the old era could not buy his own life from the god of Death!
He knew more about Aisha’s situation than anyone else, but he did not want to think about it or believe it. However, he always knew in his heart that he even hated himself for knowing too much. If he could be like the people of this era.., a little more ignorant and superstitious, perhaps he could still hold on to hope.
If he could bring her back to life, he would rather believe that there was a god.
He would even be willing to pray to God.
The experimental data from the Monster Research Institute made him admit the reality.
He really could not return.
He thought of the mischievous smile on the girl’s face when he first met her. He thought of the noble and cold look she had when she was a saintess when they met again. He also thought of the weak look of them cuddling and supporting each other in the ice cave in the desolate area, if he could go against the flow of time, how he wished that he could return to the ice wall. It was the warmest place in his memory!
However, time wouldn’t go against the flow of time. It was like a dead person who couldn’t be resurrected.
It was irreversible. He could only rely on himself to adapt.
But how painful was it to adapt to the loss?
Time didn’t accelerate in the process of adaptation. It continued to flow slowly as if it had nothing to do with it.
Dudian looked up at her beautiful face. It was as if it had been frozen and never faded. He felt like crying, but he could not cry. It seemed that all the tears had run out.
His eyes slowly became hollow. He moved close to her knees and rested his head on her legs.
He did not know how much time had passed. He felt a gentle hand gently stroking his hair. The comfortable feeling made him intoxicated. He did not want to open his eyes. Then he heard a gentle voice, it came from the top of his head. “It’s cold on the ground. Get Up.”
The familiar voice, the familiar tone, his heart trembled. He slowly opened his eyes and looked up at her, only to see that Aisha was still the same as before. Then, he looked at her hands, she was still in the same position as before, as if everything was an illusion.
Then he saw that his vision was a little blurry. He raised his hand and wiped it. His face was wet and full of tears.
He smiled at the sight. He smiled and smiled. Suddenly, he hugged her leg and burst into tears. He cried like a child.
He cried so hard that his voice was hoarse. As he cried, he could not help but think, would she see his sad look and comfort him like she did in a dream?
The thought made him burst into tears. He looked up at Aisha and saw the same cold expression. There was no change, and he couldn’t go back to the past.
For a long time.
Dean slowly calmed down. He slowly got up from the ground and sat next to Aisha. He looked around the empty room. It was decorated extremely luxuriously. He looked at it and suddenly thought.., the human race in this world could evolve to the level of pioneers. It had completely broken the cognitive view of the old era. Why should he care about the so-called “Rational world view”of the old era?
What was rational?
Was it rational to not be emotional?
Or was it rational to judge according to the basic cognition of the world view?
If that was the case, since things like zombies existed and those extraterrestrial invaders appeared, why should he follow the world view of humans on earth?
Thinking of this, his gloomy eyes gradually lit up. He thought of what he had said to Richelieu before. No one could prove the existence of God. Therefore, no one could deny the existence of God.
In that case, no one could prove the existence of the soul. Then, no one could deny the existence of the soul!
In this world, if they were told that there was a plane, no one would believe that technology would always break the original worldview. In that case, when the technology developed to a higher level, why couldn’t it bring the dead back to life?
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that it made sense. At the same time, he felt a vigorous motivation in his body, an impulse to immediately do something big, he said to Aisha: “Even if everyone’s experiment fails, I will succeed! I will save you!”
Aisha was silent.
Dudian stared at her for a while. He stood up and opened the torn experiment materials on the desk. He looked at Neuss and Sergei who were outside the door. They were talking in a low voice, he could hear them clearly: “Both of you, come in.”
Neuss and Sergei were shocked when they heard the voice from the room. They opened the door and saw that the room was in a mess. There were books scattered on the floor, neuss looked at the books. He looked at Aisha who was sitting on the chair next to him. He looked at Dudian but found that he hadn’t seen her for seven days, he almost couldn’t recognize Dudian.
Sergei had the same feeling. Although the human body was growing at the speed of seven days, but they felt that Dudian was completely different from before. Although his appearance had changed, but his temperament seemed to have changed, if they had to describe it, the previous Dudian gave them the feeling of a resourceful youth. But at this moment, Dudian was like a king who looked down on the world. He seemed to have no fear.
“Young Master?”Neuss carefully called out.
Dudian looked at him in a gentle manner: “Why? Did I shout at you before? Are You Afraid of Me Now?”
Neuss was slightly surprised. He didn’t expect that Dudian would joke with him. He quickly replied: “No, no. Why would I be angry with young master? It’s because I am not sensible. I have disturbed young master.”
“I’m fine.”Dudian calmly said: “Didn’t you say that you had prepared a big meal for me? I’m hungry now. Oh, call someone to tidy up the place. Don’t throw away the broken books. I’m still useful.”
Neuss and Sergei looked at each other and nodded in agreement.
Dudian followed Neuss out of the room to the dining room. He hadn’t eaten for seven days. He was starving.
He thought of the poisoning incident and asked: “Did you catch the distant relative of the last worker?”
Neuss replied: “Master, the distant relative of the worker was found but he was already dead. It seems that he had killed himself.”
Dudian wasn’t surprised: “Are there any clues about the follow-up?”
Neuss replied in embarrassment: “Not at present. I have sent people to contact the person in recent months but I haven’t left any clues.”
“So this matter has come to an end?”
”… Yes, yes.”Neuss replied in embarrassment.
Dudian drank a spoonful of soup, he vaguely said: “Let’s put this matter aside for the time being. The enemy is in the dark and we are in the light. It will be very difficult to find them. Fortunately these people are not smart enough to deliberately leave clues to mislead us. Otherwise we will become weapons in their hands.”
Neuss saw that Dudian didn’t seem to care about this matter. His attitude was completely different from the previous one. He couldn’t help but ask: “Young Master, is this thing going to end like this?”
“This is the only way.”
Neuss was stunned: “These people almost caused a big accident to young master. Are we going to suffer this loss?”
“We have been sitting in this position. isn’t it normal to suffer a loss?”Dudian comforted him: “You should pay what you get. You should be careful in the future. They didn’t succeed this time. I guess they will continue to do so in the future. As long as you are careful they will come to you sooner or later.”
Neuss clenched his teeth: “Young Master, I will be more careful next time. I Won’t let them succeed!”
“Well.”Dudian nodded. His attitude became more serious as he patted Neuss’s shoulder: “In order to punish you, you have to learn to drink white wine from today. I Won’t stop drinking because of these villains!”
Neuss opened his mouth but couldn’t refute.

chapters.title: Chapter 812
chapters.content:
Chapter 812 – Chapter 802: Phonograph
Half a month after Dudian ascended the throne, the Black Death season came. There were a lot of busy things to do. For example, the monastery was arranged to hold a blessing assembly in each city, in addition, the military had to supervise the timely cleaning of the garbage and the bodies of the unexpected deaths in each city. As long as they were not careful, some homeless people would die or the bodies of the servants killed by the nobles would become the starting point of the plague.
Dudian deeply understood the feeling of being a “King”. He was superior to everyone and at the same time, he had to serve everyone.
Fortunately, he didn’t intend to be a dedicated and competent wall master. He left all these trivial matters to Saul. Noyce accompanied him so that he could learn and supervise.
“Teacher, what is this?”Edward looked at the speaker-like instrument in front of him.
“This is called a phonograph.”Dudian looked at the original phonograph that he had just made. There was a trace of sadness and regret in his eyes. It would be good if this thing could be made a few years earlier.
Edward asked: “Phonograph?”
“It is able to retain your voice.”Dudian moved the needle to the black turntable: “Do you have anything to say to your future self?”
“Future self?”Edward’s eyes slightly opened. Future was a very distant word for him. He thought for a moment, “I hope that my future self will always be by the teacher’s side. I want to do many great experiments like the teacher’s phonograph. I also want to carry forward the Qi system!”
Dudian nodded: “Yes, but to accomplish this, you need to work harder than others. Do you understand?”
“I understand, teacher.”Edward nodded.
Dudian played the duplicate voice on the phonograph. Soon, Edward heard what he had just said from the speaker. At the same time, there was Dudian’s instruction, the voice was no different from Dudian’s. Edward’s mouth was wide open. His face was full of disbelief.
Dudian lifted the needle and took the black turntable. He handed it to Edward: “Later you can make a phonograph according to my drawings. You can use this to play your own words. Go back and refuel.”
Edward stared at the black turntable in his hand. He was stunned for a moment before he recovered. He suppressed the excitement and curiosity in his heart and held the turntable to bid farewell to Dudian.
Dudian watched him leave and then slowly walked to the table next to him. He took out a new black turntable and put it on the phonograph. His eyes slowly turned to Aisha who was next to him. There was a trace of gentleness in his eyes, “I have something to say to you every day. There are too many things that I want to say to you. I’m worried that I won’t be able to say so much to you in one breath. So I will record all these words. When you recover, you will be able to hear everything I want to say to you during this period of time.”
Aisha was silent and expressionless.
“In a few days, I will also make a camera. Then I will take pictures of Sergei, Gwyneth, Noyce, my former friend Macon, and my student Edward. Of course, there will also be pictures of us. I will use the camera to record my life and yours every day. One picture a day, that is 365 pictures a year.”
“Maybe it will take me a year or even a few years to find a way to restore you. But don’t worry. You can see my changes through these photos. You Won’t feel unfamiliar with me.”
Dudian’s eyes were extremely gentle. He looked at her for a moment before he thought of the turntable. He picked up the needle and took the turntable. He carefully put it into the bookcase.
A few days later.
News came from the outer wall. They had found the coffin and the remains of the goddess of war.
Dudian was overjoyed. He sent Sergei, Neuss, Aurora and the others to lead the exploration chariots to secretly receive the coffin. The Pioneers on the chariots were still chained by iron chains. Their will was no longer as strong as before. Even their will to fight had faded, the electric shock mechanism was enough to control the chariot.
In less than half a day, everyone took the coffin back to the palace.
When the coffin returned to the palace, Saul who was always by Dudian’s side knew the news. He looked at the huge coffin placed in the hall of the palace. He was stunned. He didn’t expect that the god’s corpse would fall into the hands of Dudian, i Can’t believe Dudian got it.
“Master, this is the captain of the search team.”Sergei pointed to a short youth in black. The youth’s appearance was ugly. There was a mole on the corner of his mouth, at the moment kneeling in front of the steps, face nervous looking at Dudian, the atmosphere did not dare to breathe, trembling.
Dudian was happy but he was calm on the surface: “What’s Your Name?”
The short youth replied: “My name is Teron.”
“Tell me how you found it.”Dudian was interested. He hadn’t stopped sending people to search for the whereabouts of the god’s corpse in the inner wall but he hadn’t found it until today, he was curious as to where the intruders had hidden the god’s corpse.
Teron lowered his head. His voice was a bit nervous, “Young master, I followed Young Master’s instructions and led people to search around the outer wall. We searched the commercial and civilian areas but didn’t find it. Afterwards we went to the slums. There weren’t many people living there. We found the coffin under a very sloppy abandoned factory. There were many rats gathered around the coffin so i… Found it.” He paused for a moment as if he was choking. He lowered his head after he finished speaking.
Dudian heard his heart beat faster. He knew that it was his men who saw the vision. But he didn’t mention it. He knew that it was a great achievement and he wanted to get a share of the spoils.
“Why are there rats gathered around the coffin?”Dudian didn’t care about the small matter of greed. He asked: “What was the vision of the coffin?”
Teron lowered his head: “Master, I don’t know. We followed the rats and saw the coffin. We dispersed the rats and moved the coffin out from the factory. The coffin looked a bit dirty at that time. We informed Hawkeye and cleaned the coffin. Then the adults came to pick us up.”

chapters.title: Chapter 813
chapters.content:
Chapter 813 – : Chapter 803: Mysterious Language
Dudian nodded: “This time you have made a great contribution. What is your wish? Tell me. If I can do it then I can satisfy it for you.”
Teron’s heart was beating fast. He was waiting for this moment. He clenched his teeth and fell to the ground: “Master, if possible I want to become a noble. I want to be a true noble in the inner wall!”
Dudian indifferently said: “Don’t you want anything else?”
“I don’t dare to ask for more.”Teron nervously replied.
Dudian nodded slightly, “Alright, Neuss, you take note. I will leave this matter to you later. As for Teron, I will give your team members the rank of major in the inner wall. At the same time, I will provide them with the resources they need to grow to a senior limit. Each of them can choose a rare parasitic soul worm as their magic marks.”
Teron’s eyes were wide open. He didn’t expect that Dudian would give him such a big reward. It was beyond his imagination!
“You go first.”Dudian said.
Teron thanked him and slowly left.
Saul hesitated for a moment as he saw Dudian’s request: “Lord, the nobles in the inner wall are appointed by the Kingdom of God. Even the master of the wall doesn’t have the authority to appoint them. This person’s request is too rude…”
Dudian glanced at him, “The succession ceremony has ended. You should change your words. In addition, this is my territory and has nothing to do with the Kingdom of God. There are many ways to replace the Kingdom of God to appoint nobles. For example, kill a noble and change his name. Does the Kingdom of God have the files of every noble?”? “Even if they do, they wouldn’t know what these nobles look like, right?”
Saul was stunned. He opened his mouth but held it back. He wanted to say that this was against the laws of the Kingdom of God. But he remembered that the youth in front of him was a usurper. The laws of the Kingdom of God were worthless in front of him.
Dudian’s eyes fell on the coffin. It was completely different from the coffin in his impression. There were no decorative carvings on the surface of the coffin. It didn’t look like a rectangular coffin but a huge metal ball, the surface of the coffin was abnormally smooth. There was no trace of dust on the surface of the coffin. The Golden Luster appeared in his pupils. His vision suddenly rushed through the surface of the object. Soon he saw a turbid net of metal structure covering the entire metal ball.
He wanted to go deeper into the perspective but he saw a turbid dark red light. Other than that he couldn’t see anything else.
“I can’t completely see through it?”Dudian was surprised. This was the first time he had encountered a situation where he couldn’t see through it. The main reason was that the distance was too far or the thickness of the metal was too high, but although the metal sphere was big, it couldn’t be full of metal. There would always be room for the corpse. There was no reason why he couldn’t see through it.
He felt that his vision was mainly blocked by the layer of dark red light. He did not know what material it was made of to be able to block vision penetration.
However, when it came to vision penetration, it had a lot to do with the light. He guessed that there were probably materials inside that were extremely light-resistant.
He stood up and circled around the metal sphere. He carefully reached out and touched it. It was cold to the touch. He knocked on it and pressed his ear against it. There were echoes, indicating that it was empty inside.
Soon, he saw a thin metal line in the middle of the ball. It was thinner than hair. It seemed that two semicircular metal balls were locked together.
“How do I Open This Thing?”Dudian felt strange. He reached out to touch the thin line. Was it hard to open it?
Crack.
When his fingers touched the gap of the thin line, there was a soft sound from the metal ball. Dudian was scared and pulled back his fingers as fast as lightning. He took a few steps back to increase the distance. But the next moment, he saw the metal ball crack, a metal plate protruded from the surface of the metal ball.
Dudian was a bit surprised. The change of the metal mechanism was very high-tech. Moreover the surface of the metal plate was similar to a glass screen. His first thought was fingerprint identification.
He slowly approached and reached out to touch the screen.
The screen suddenly lit up. It emitted a soft light blue light. At the same time a strange language came out from the screen. It spoke a string of words. After the end there were two beeps coming from the screen.
Dudian frowned as he heard the strange language. This language was very strange. He had never heard of it before. It didn’t belong to English nor to the modern world. In the old era he was familiar with the language of the big countries, there was no such language.
He suddenly thought of the origin of the god of war. They came out of nowhere and rescued human beings. They fought with the aliens who came to Earth and defeated them. At the same time they built giant walls to protect the survivors of human beings.
Other than that, there seemed to be no record of where they came from.
And the electronic intelligence language emitted from the coffins where their bodies were placed did not belong to the countries on Earth. At least, it was the language of the big countries that he had never heard of.
Could it be that the god of war race was also aliens from outer space?
When he thought of this, he felt a little incredulous. He felt that it was a little similar, but he could not explain it. Before he fell asleep, the countries on Earth faced the invasion of extraterrestrials. They had no choice but to build shelters in the cities of various countries, his father had sent him to the cryo chamber to sleep. Could it be that during the time when he was in the Cryo Chamber, another group of extraterrestrials came to earth?
And it was the god of War?
If so, why would the god of war help humans to fight against the first wave of extraterrestrials?
Dudian felt that the amount of information was too much. However, this was built on the fact that the god of war was also an alien. However, there was one thing that he couldn’t figure out, why would the two groups of aliens come to Earth in such a short time? It must be known that the old era had been developing for so many years. They had been exploring the universe and looking for extraterrestrial life forms but there was no news about them, now there were two groups of aliens coming to Earth. It was completely unreasonable.
Even if the coincidence was established and the two groups of aliens were fighting each other because they were enemies or came from the same galaxy, why would the god of war build a giant wall to protect human beings?
Dudian didn’t believe that the situation at that time would allow humans to form an alliance with the aliens while they were being invaded by aliens.
However, he couldn’t predict what the leaders of the old era were thinking. He couldn’t figure it out from his own point of view. It was possible that the god of war would join forces with humans to fight against the first batch of aliens, after all, the enemy of the enemy was a friend.
However, Dudian felt that he was thinking too much.
He couldn’t determine that the god of war was an alien just by looking at the unknown language on the coffin.
“How do I Open This Thing?”Dudian looked at the pale blue screen. There were no projections nor words on the screen. He touched the screen again and the previous language was repeated, moreover, it was completely repeated.
Dudian was deep in thought.
Sergei, Saul, Neuss and others were frightened by the sound coming from the coffin. They retreated to the corners of the hall, there was only a giant coffin in the middle of the hall and Dudian who was standing in front of the coffin.
“The… The God of war has spoken.”Saul’s face was pale. He wanted to kneel down. In his blood and faith, the god of war was more awe-inspiring than the god of the monastery. Just the construction of the giant wall.., the people of the sanctuary deserved the greatest respect for their centuries-long achievements. Moreover, his reverence came from the bottom of his heart. From childhood to adulthood, all the legends depicted the power and greatness of the god of War Sylvia.
If she knew that he had joined the rebels, would she kill him on the spot?
His heart trembled and he trembled.
Neuss, Sergei and others were nervous. They didn’t dare to breathe. They felt great pressure. Even if the master of the wall was standing in front of them, they wouldn’t be so afraid. After all, they were mentally prepared, however, Sylvia was different. Even if they were born in the outer wall, they knew that Sylvia was a great existence. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that she was the mother of everyone in the wall.
Dudian didn’t notice the reaction of the others. He was thinking about how to open the coffin, “There must be a way to open the coffin. Otherwise, the intruders wouldn’t believe that it was the coffin. After all, they have been cheated by urita. The second time they would have to see Sylvia in person.”
“From the current point of view, there should be an object on the screen. Maybe it isn’t a fingerprint or iris identification. Maybe it is an object identification. Do the intruders know what object was used to identify this thing?”? “But their bodies have been searched. There is nothing special. It is impossible for them to hide such an important thing.”
“Unless they opened it with brute force but…”
Dudian looked at the metal ball in front of him. Would he break the metal ball if he opened it with brute force?
He touched the gap of the thin thread and felt a chill. He turned his head and shouted: “Neuss.”He found that the other people in the hall were scared to retreat to the edge of the hall.
Neuss heard Dudian’s shout and his throat rolled. He gathered his courage and went forward: “Master.”
“You stay and let the others retreat first.”Dudian said.
Neuss was relieved and called Saul and other officials to retreat.
Dudian asked Neuss to take his witcher when there were only Neuss and Dudian left in the hall.
Dudian stabbed the tip of the knife into the slit of the thin line. He tried to jam it and pry it open.
At this time, the blue screen once again emitted the strange language sound. After it finished speaking, the blue screen flashed. A light red beam shot out from the blue screen and slanted towards the carpet, it was like a small spotlight.
Dudian was startled. He looked at the light beam which was reflected on the carpet. He looked at the metal ball and waited for a moment. He thought for a moment and said to Neuss: “Call a servant.”
“Okay.”
Soon, a young servant came into the hall. He looked nervous.
Dudian asked him to stand in the light beam.
The youth stood in front of it.
At this time, Dudian saw the projection of the youth’s body on the screen. It was just an outline of lines. The projection turned on the screen for a moment and then dimmed down.
Dudian saw the light beam retracting. He guessed that it should be the system’s recognition but obviously the recognition failed.
He was regretful and could only continue to use the tip of the knife to get into the gap.
At this time, the blue light on the screen suddenly disappeared and a red light appeared. It looked like a warning. The next moment, a red light beam shot out from the edge of the metal ball and swept around.
When it hit the young servant, the red light beam suddenly materialized. It was like a laser beam that pierced through the body of the young servant.
Dudian’s pupils shrank. He wanted to dodge but it was too late.
The red light beam swept through his body. The splitter in his hand melted in an instant. He instinctively entered the magic body and was ready to dodge. But the next moment, the red light beam on his body suddenly changed color, it turned green.
Dudian was stunned when the metal ball slowly opened.
Dudian’s eyes were wide open and his face was full of astonishment.
There weren’t many things that shocked him, but this time he was completely shocked.
While he was in a daze, the metal ball slowly opened and a thick white cold fog surged out. It rushed into the hall and froze the teacups on the surrounding tables. The water in the teacups instantly froze into ice, it was like entering an ice cave in winter.
Dudian felt the chill in his left arm. He quickly covered his left hand. His face was ugly as he left the hall.
Although he was very curious to see what was inside the coffin but he didn’t dare to stay inside. The chill in his body was controlled in his left arm. He didn’t dare to let it spread further. Once it entered his body.., perhaps he would follow in the footsteps of the Dragon Mother.
Neuss followed Dudian out. Dudian said to him: “Call people to get rid of the cold.”
Neuss knew that Dudian was afraid of the cold so he immediately agreed and ran away.
It didn’t take long before the cold was dispelled with the help of a large number of servants. Dudian rushed into the hall and saw a shocking scene. There was a huge woman in the metal ball. She was naked, her skin was as smooth as grease. Although her body was huge, but the proportions were perfect. The most eye-catching thing was her face. It was a sleeping, flawless face, it was so beautiful that it was intoxicating.
Even with Dudian’s calmness, when he saw this face, he felt a bit lost.
Although he had seen the face several times and knew that it was the goddess of Sylvia, but the feeling of seeing the real person was completely different from the one on the paper. It seemed to have a strange charm.
But soon, the feeling of charm was broken. Dudian saw the lower half of her body and suddenly felt his stomach churn. There was an indescribable feeling of nausea. It was a twisted and disgusting body, it was in stark contrast to the perfect figure of the upper body. Half was like a god and the other half was like a demon.

chapters.title: Chapter 814
chapters.content:
Chapter 814 – Chapter 804: Information?
Is this Sylvia?
Dudian’s eyes swept over her body from the waist down. He couldn’t help but frown. He couldn’t maintain the calm expression on his face because of the strong nauseous feeling, it was like the internal organs of a cockroach. There were strange eyeballs and things like lips on it. Ordinary people wouldn’t want to look at it again.
Dudian would be shocked if he looked at her upper body. But the terrifying lower body pulled him out of the beautiful picture. He suddenly thought of something, he had seen Sylvia in all the secret books. It seemed that she only showed her upper body. The lower body was either not painted because of the lack of paper area or it was blocked by some monsters.
It seemed that this was intentional.
After all, if one really drew her whole body, it would be difficult for anyone to love her. They would only hate her.
Dudian had always thought that he was not a person who judged people by their appearance. But after seeing Sylvia’s body, he felt disgusted, repelled, and hated. These thoughts were like instincts that could not be controlled.
“Is she really the goddess of war among the survivors of the Sanctuary?”Dudian looked at the huge body. He couldn’t help but have such doubts in his heart, he couldn’t have such a subjective imagination because of her strange and terrifying body. After all, no one could be sure that the savior must have a face as benevolent as Jesus and a great body, in history, many famous generals and heroes had rough looks and bodies as tough as butchers. However, through novels, plays and other cultural arts, they gradually beautified the image.
It was just like what he saw in the secret book. Sylvia’s perfect upper body was taken out to cover the other part of her body which was horrible and ugly.
“But her body shouldn’t be human.”Dudian looked at her huge body. Her upper body was four to five meters in size. It was completely beyond the standard of a human. However, if she was an alien.., she had the appearance of a human. He would believe that there were extraterrestrials in the entire universe. But he would never believe that the extraterrestrials had the upper body of a human.
He did not approach her rashly. Instead, he used his X-ray vision to examine her body. He was shocked when he saw her body.
The structure of her upper body was similar to that of a human’s. However, the number and shape of her bones were different from that of a normal human’s. The number of bones was less than that of a human’s. However, the shape of her bones was much more effective when used to exert force, what shocked him the most was that the density of her bones was hundreds of times more than that of a normal human’s. It was so dense that it was difficult for his x-ray vision to penetrate through it completely.
Such a high density of bones meant that her weight was not normal. It also meant that her strength was far beyond human imagination.
In addition to these, Dudian also found that her remains were extremely fresh! It might not be appropriate to use the word “Fresh”to describe her, but Dudian’s first impression was that she was like a dead body. Except for the black blood in her body which had solidified, all the tissues in her body.., they were kept fresh for less than half a day as if they were frozen immediately after death.
Dudian couldn’t help but extend his attention to the metal ball coffin. The shape of the coffin was too strange and the cold air inside was completely frozen. It made him think of his own sleeping freezer.., however his cryocooler was more advanced than the metal ball cryocooler because it was for the living. There was no cold air coming out of the cryocooler because the cold air would damage the body and brain tissue and nerves, when the cold air thawed the remaining water would accumulate in the body. Most of the frozen life wouldn’t come back to life when the cold air thawed, no matter if it was the hydrocephalus of the brain or the failure of the heart after thawing, it would not be able to bring back life.
The cold air emitted from the metal ball was obviously for the dead. The body would be frozen and the original appearance would be maintained forever.
However, what surprised Dudian was that the body of Sylvia was not frozen into an ice sculpture. Her body was still full of the luster of a living person. Her hair was smooth and lustrous, there was no trace of dryness in her body. If Dudian didn’t use X-ray to see the frozen black blood in her body, he would suspect that she was sleeping here just like him.
“The technology contained in the coffin is definitely not something that can be produced by the industrial technology inside the wall. The unknown language verification and the change of the laser during the verification are completely the technology of the old era. Hundreds of years have passed but there is still energy left in the coffin. It is a top-tier machine…”Dudian’s eyes flashed, speaking of the unknown language verification, he could not help but think of the strange thing that he had passed the verification.
The servant had been shot to death. It was obvious that the verification had failed.
Logically speaking, he should have been shot to death as well. However, when it came to him, it turned into a green light and opened the divine coffin.
This made him puzzled. It could not be just a coincidence. It was because this thing had killed people and had opened its meat, so it opened itself, right? However, he couldn’t find any difference between himself and the servant. If he had to say it, there were some big differences. First, he was from the old era. Second, he was a pioneer, third, he was a virgin… of course, he didn’t know whether the servant was a virgin or not. Perhaps both of them were.
However, these differences were secondary in his opinion. Since the metal ball had a verification system, it naturally needed a specific verification object, and he seemed to be in agreement with their verification object.
However, what exactly were the specific verification requirements they set?
Was it an evolved pioneer?
Or a person with legendary magic marks in his body?
Was he a human from the old era?
He couldn’t figure it out. But he remembered that he had passed the identification test in the shelter in the wasteland.
Were the two types of identification the same?
He couldn’t guess. He felt that there were some secrets in his body. But he felt that the biggest possibility was that he was a human from the old era or that he had legendary magic marks in his body!
“Speaking of which, those intruders should have opened the coffin. Did they pass the verification? If that’s the case then it can be inferred that the verification should apply to pioneers.”Dudian thought, the biggest similarity between him and the intruders was that they were pioneers. Moreover, the number of people who appeared after the intruders took away the coffin wasn’t small. It could be seen that they had passed the verification.
If this verification was said to be a pioneer, it could be explained. In some novels, didn’t the strong people bury peerless secret manuals in the cemetery after their death? Would the fated people be able to get them when they came here?
At the thought of this, his eyes lit up slightly. He looked at the things around Sylvia’s body. With one look, he immediately found many strange structures. First of all, the place where Sylvia Lay was like an extended version of an old chair, there were several metal balls that were the size of a head next to her limbs. There were metal rods attached to them. There were several blue screens in other places.
This structure..
Dudian’s eyes widened as he thought of something. But he wasn’t sure.
He slowly approached. The temperature near the coffin wasn’t that cold anymore. It seemed that the system had stopped the supply of cold air when the coffin was opened. Dudian smelled a faint stench, it was a bit like the stench of dead fish and rat’s internal organs. Dudian almost vomited on the spot.
He had seen all kinds of ferocious monsters and smelled the rotten smell of countless dead bodies. But he felt that it was nothing compared to what was in front of him.
He held his breath and used his magic body to cover his body. He raised a sharp limb to touch her snow-white palm.
His movement was very gentle but there was an inexplicable tension in his heart. He couldn’t help but look at her eyes. He felt that her eyes were half-opened as if she was looking at him.
Soon, his sharp limbs touched her palm. He suddenly felt a cool feeling but it was not as cold as he imagined. Moreover, his palm was elastic and extremely tough, dudian saw that his sharp limbs did not pierce her skin. He tried to apply a bit of force and saw that her skin was slowly sunken, but it was not pierced.
Dudian’s strength gradually increased. In the end, he used almost 50% of his strength but still failed to pierce her palm. He did not dare to apply more force and withdrew his sharp limbs. His heart was a bit shocked, he used 50% of his strength to attack. It was enough to cut off most of the Pioneers’witchers. However, he couldn’t pierce through her soft and smooth palm.
“It seems that her body is the most valuable research material.”Dudian looked at her huge body. His heart was burning. He wanted to immediately dissect her body and study it thoroughly, her hair which was covered by the strong cold air made him very curious. He didn’t know what structure was inside. However, he wouldn’t rashly treat her as a research material. After all, with the current scientific instruments.., the information that could be dug out from her body was very limited.
At this time, Dudian suddenly saw a metal plate next to her huge palm. There was a glass screen in the middle of the metal plate. There were no other parts connected to the metal plate, it seemed to be an individual.
Dudian was curious. He picked up the metal plate and took it out. The size of the metal plate was similar to that of an adult’s upper body. The size of the giant hand of Sylvia was just enough to hold it.
Although the area was huge but Dudian found something unusual when he picked it up. It was like a piece of paper.
He used his hand to grab it and knocked on the dark screen. At this time, the screen suddenly lit up with blue lines and ripples.
Dudian looked at the energy source. After all, the entire metal ball had energy source. But he didn’t know what the individual metal plate was. He looked at it again and again, he suddenly found that the blue lines and ripples on it were not constant. They would increase and decrease like uneven mountain ranges. This made him think of a special communication code that had been used in a big country for a long time.
Could it be that there was a piece of information on the screen?
He looked at it carefully.
But after less than two minutes the ripple lines on the screen suddenly disappeared. The next moment, the middle of the screen seemed to collapse and a black hole vortex appeared. It seemed to swallow the entire screen.
At the same time, a strange language came out from the black hole vortex. This language seemed to be the same type as the recognition language that Dudian had heard before.
Dudian was startled. Was it the language message that Sylvia left before she died? He thought of the gramophone that he had just made. He immediately asked Noyce to get it.

chapters.title: Chapter 815
chapters.content:
Chapter 815 – Chapter 805: Communication Device To ‘God’
Dudian had just finished talking to Neuss when suddenly a strange voice came out from the black vortex on the screen. The tone was strange but Dudian could understand the language, it was the giant wall language: “Are you a resident of the giant wall?”
It was a question..
Dudian was stunned on the spot.
His eyes widened as he looked at the black vortex on the screen. Was it a communication device instead of a message?
But if it was a communication device, where would it lead to?
His body stiffened for a few seconds. He saw that there was no sound coming from the black vortex. He was nervous and asked: “You Are?”
The black vortex was still rotating. It seemed that it could swallow Dudian’s eyes. After a long silence the black vortex suddenly flashed and returned to the previous blue wave image.
Dudian was stunned. He looked at the huge metal plate in his hand. Was this really a communication device? Who was the one who received it? Why was the communication suddenly cut off?
Moreover, Dudian noticed that the strange voice was speaking the language of the giant wall which he could understand, it was very likely that he had heard what he said to Neuss so he changed the language. If it was really a communicator and not a voice mail then the person who was communicating with him was likely to be a god of War!
His heart was beating fast. The probability of a communicator was as high as 90% . In other words, he had just contacted the legendary race and had a dialogue with them!
However, he didn’t know why the other party suddenly cut off the communication.
Could it be that the signal was bad? Dudian couldn’t help but think maliciously. But he knew that the other party had cut off the communication because of some other reason. He couldn’t think of any other reason but he didn’t plan to guess. In any case, the short communication.., it gave him a big surprise. The metal board in his hand could be used to contact the god of War!
He looked forward to the next contact. Although he didn’t know how to contact the other party. It seemed that the previous communication had opened by accident.
Dudian decided to go back and study it. He hoped that it wouldn’t be damaged.
“Master, the phonograph you wanted…”Neuss carefully ran over with the phonograph.
Dudian waved his hand: “Send it back.”
“Ugh…”Neuss was stunned.
Dudian put away the metal plate and went to the metal ball. He climbed on his tiptoes and looked inside. He looked for other individual objects. However there were no other individual objects. He tried to endure the nausea, he used the sharp limbs to pick up the twisted limbs of her lower body. He felt a hair-raising smell which made him nauseous.
He looked inside her limbs but didn’t find anything useful. Instead his sharp limbs were sticky and emitted a foul smell, he felt that he might not be able to wash away the smell even if he used soap.
“The original insect was born from her body. But how could her body decompose into maggots?”Dudian was curious, sylvia’s body seemed to have a strange ability to resist the cold. The mucus on her lower body was not frozen by the cold. It was a bit infuriating for scientists.
He looked around and soon found that there seemed to be a broken mark on her lower body.
He used his sharp limbs to pick her up. Soon he saw that a part of her python-like tentacle was cut off. The cut was neat as if it was cut off by something extremely sharp.
“Could it be that someone used her body as an experiment? was the original insect cultivated from the cut part?”Dudian guessed, it seemed that the Monster Institute was the only one who had the ability and courage to do this.
However, the god’s corpse was so important. Why would the wall master let the Monster Institute carry out the research? It should be known that Sylvia was not only a god’s corpse but also the belief of all the survivors. How could the original wall master agree to destroy the belief? Or was there some special reason at that time?
He felt that there were still many secrets that he did not know. He pondered for a while and suddenly remembered that there were top-secret files in the palace that recorded the most confidential things, previously, he was busy studying the experimental materials sent by the Monster Research Institute and did not have the time to read them. But now, it was time to see what kind of secrets were hidden in this world!
He stared at Sylvia’s face for a while. Her eyes were half-opened. No matter how many times he saw her, he was shocked. It was an extreme beauty. Even if he knew that she was a corpse, he would still be infatuated with her, he was willing to give everything for her. Of course, the prerequisite was that he didn’t see her lower body. That ugly and hideous body brought intense discomfort and fear. It was enough to tear everything beautiful and make people completely sober.
Dudian slowly closed the metal ball. He called Neuss and asked him to send the coffin to the secret chamber under the palace. He was living in the palace so he could guard it at all times.
He didn’t need to personally guard it after the wind power station and hydroelectric power station had been completed.
As for the communication device that could contact the god of war, he left it by his side. He was ready to study how to take the initiative to contact them.
Dudian ordered Saul to seal the news about the coffin. Although he knew that it might not be completely sealed, but it was the best case scenario for him to suppress this matter. Now that the coffin was in his hands, he was relieved. He asked Saul to take him to the top-secret archives of the palace. He wanted to look at the prohibited information. There were too many questions and he wanted to get answers.
As Dudian was exploring the secrets of the giant wall, the news of the return of the coffin to the palace reached the ears of the Giants.
“Uncle Wing, you said that the coffin was found? How is that possible? wasn’t the coffin stolen by the group of Intruders?”Urita looked at the wing king in disbelief.
The wing king looked at her shocked expression and sighed. He was surprised when he heard the news but he believed in the loyalty of his confidant. He knew that the news wouldn’t be wrong, the youth was too terrifying. He said, “Many witnesses saw the return of the divine coffin. It Can’t be fake. Those intruders were most likely killed by this person.”
“What? !”Ulita widened her eyes, she suspected that there was something wrong with her ears, “Those intruders were killed by him?”? “How, how is this possible? The leader of the intruders is a ruler. This kid is only at the inner wilderness level. Even if he teamed up with Aisha, he would not be able to compete with a ruler. Although his magic marks might be deified splitter’s magic marks, for a ruler to become a ruler, his magic marks are definitely not simple. This…”
She could not accept such a blow. She was not even happy about taking back the divine coffin.
Wing king sighed, he said, “To kill someone, you don’t have to use your fists. I sent people to investigate the explosion of the wall of Sighs and the outer wall region. After the group of intruders left, they went to the outer wall region. Not long after they left, an explosion occurred in the outer wall region. The highest mountain in the outer wall region, Mt. Utto, was flattened by the explosion. If the group of intruders were on that mountain, they most likely would not have survived.”
“Mt. Utopia was razed to the ground? !”Ulita’s eyes almost popped out of their sockets, the news she received today was more and more shocking to her. Although she didn’t care about the outer wall, he still knew the name of Mt. Utopia. This mountain was tall and straight, and was often written into poems by some bards and musicians, but at this moment, such a famous scene was actually blown to the ground?
How much gunpowder could this be caused by?
And with so much gunpowder, these intruders actually did not notice it?
Wing king frowned slightly, he said, “These few days, there was no movement outside the giant wall. I felt that something was wrong. I did not expect that the god corpse was still inside the wall. Those intruders were most likely already dead. Hehe, I really do not know whether to be happy or angry. From the looks of it, this kid has become a great hero inside the wall, and has dealt with an enemy that we can not deal with.”
Urita’s eyebrows shot up when she heard that. She said angrily, “What Hero? He’s just a despicable and shameless person!”
Wing king saw her agitated expression and knew that this failure had dealt a huge blow to her, he said, “Don’t be too angry. This kid is indeed cunning, but he has some hard skills. Before your father returns, we should temporarily endure. Now that the god corpse has fallen into his hands, I’m afraid that when your father returns, he will have the ability to negotiate. At that time, we have to think of a way to kill him…” He narrowed his eyes slightly.
Urita glanced at him and suppressed the anger in her heart. She said in a low voice, “Uncle Wing King, thank you for your care during this period of time. I want to go out for a walk.”
