Wing king frowned slightly, he said, “You are not his opponent. It is best that you do not do anything small. Although he is currently looking for you, it is not a big deal. If you do anything to anger him, he will probably hunt you down at all costs. When that happens, it will be really troublesome.”
Urita bit her lips and clenched her fist: “I won’t provoke him. I just want to go to the Institute of Magic.”
Wing King looked at her but didn’t try to persuade her: “Then you should pay attention to your safety.”
… ..
… ..
Dudian read the most confidential documents in the palace. He thought that since these confidential documents were top secret, there wouldn’t be many of them, however he was stunned by the mountain of documents in front of him when he came to the secret room. He skimmed through them and saw thousands of documents. were they top secret?
He casually took out a few documents and looked through them.
Coase killed his brother and changed his name to take his place. He inherited his brother’s identity as an earl.
Scott family was divided. The wife of his eldest son Scott Plin had an adultery with his father..
Milan city’s snow maple mountain was rebuilt and 123 families were buried..
Dudian was shocked as he looked at the documents. They were confidential documents that couldn’t be released to the public. Any matter that was released would become the biggest news and spread everywhere.
“It turns out that the Scott Consortium in the outer wall was formed when the Scott family was divided more than 100 years ago. Some of the family members and servants were expelled…”Dudian’s eyes lit up. It seemed that the six consortia in the outer wall.., there was a dark history behind them.
His eyes skimmed over the events of the nobles. He soon noticed several documents that were written about the Witcher family.
He took them off and opened the fire paint.
“The third generation Patriarch of the Dragon family was killed by the winged family. The Dragon family didn’t know about this…”
“The first patriarch of the Rock family left the giant wall in search of a way out. There was no news about him since then…”
Dudian looked down. Soon he saw a document about the history of the Witcher family.
“The Witcher family was born at the beginning of the first year of the giant wall. It was inherited from the Witcher warrior…”
“The Witcher Warrior is an ancient architect. The power of the Devil is buried in his body. He can be activated and become a half-human half-devil monster…”
Dudian was like a traveler who was walking in the desert. He couldn’t help but dive into the oasis. He crazily flipped through the files.
Dudian was shocked as he looked at the history of the Hunter family. The three big families of the Hunter family, Dragon family, Wing family and rock family were experiments from the Monster Research Institute! The first Patriarch of the three families was a hunter from the Monster Institute. He was a mature product developed by the Monster Institute using the bodies of monsters and humans. He was able to control the power of non-human beings.
At that time, magic marks hadn’t been discovered yet. People didn’t know how to absorb magic marks and cold crystals. Therefore, the warriors of that period were all hunters. Their bodies were buried with the genes of monsters, at the same time, they were mixed with human genes. They were a batch of freaks created by the Monster Research Institute!
Among the witcher warriors, most of them had completely demonized and lost their rationality. They became “Human-like monsters”! The remaining witcher warriors were mainly divided into seven branches. Other than the current Dragon clan, Wing clan, and Rock clan, there were four other branches.
They gave birth to the next generation and gradually became a clan.
At that time, the main opponents of the Witcher clan were not only the monsters outside the wall, but also the later demonized humanoid monsters! As these humanoid monsters used to be witcher warriors, they lived inside the wall. Therefore, after demonizing, they could directly cause terrible damage to the wall. It was a dark battle history that was later buried.
As a result, the people living today did not know that there had been such a “Humanoid monster”in history.
In the chaotic war, the seven families gradually died out. Some of them had gone berserk for generations, and humanoid monsters appeared, slaughtering their own families. Some of them were wiped out in the war against the enemy families, in the end, only the three great witcher families were left.

chapters.title: Chapter 816
chapters.content:
Chapter 816 – Chapter 806: Two Years
“The Witcher family is the first generation of the Witcher family created by the Monster Research Institute…”Dudian was surprised but it seemed reasonable. The status of the Witcher family was high and they had gathered the strongest pioneers in the giant wall, the responsibility of the Witcher family had been to protect the safety of the giant wall since ancient times. However it was the age of the magic marks warriors. The earliest experiments of the witcher warriors had gradually disappeared.
The reason for the disappearance was also recorded in the top secret.
The risk of the Witcher’s demonization was too high. It was easy for them to go out of control. The experiments of the witcher warriors gradually stopped after they found the magic marks as a medium to bring power to humans.
“The three big families have long become the Witcher Warriors. The witcher genes have declined after generations of reproduction. Occasionally there will be talented people who will awaken the witcher genes. It is the so-called bloodline power. Instead of saying that these people are talented, it is more appropriate to say that they have a strong demonic nature…”Dudian looked at the top secret information, his heart was shocked, “When the bloodline power is fully awakened, the complete power of a witcher will be obtained. It will eventually be awakened and become a ‘humanoid monster’. This is a destructive experiment. The end of evolution is destruction. It can only be squandered for a short period of time…”
Dudian knew about the seventh awakening of the bloodline. After the seventh awakening, the strength of the monster would be comparable to that of an abyss walker. But he didn’t expect to get such power in the end. It was destruction!
No wonder the Monster Research Institute didn’t carry out the experiment anymore.
However the monster created by the Monster Research Institute seemed to be a transformation of the witcher experiment. They used the human body and the monster’s body to carry out the experiment. However the results were different after the experiment.
“It seems that although the Witcher warrior experiment is very dangerous and difficult to control, the power it brings is huge. The Monster Research Institute doesn’t want to give up the experiment easily and try to pick out the shining spots to optimize it. However, it doesn’t seem to have succeeded at the moment. The Witcher family has also become a magic mark warrior, with the magic mark power as the main force and bloodline as the auxiliary force. No wonder there are very few experts who have awakened seven times in the history of the Witcher family. It is estimated that there were many experts who had awakened seven times in the earliest period, but the disaster brought about by them sealed that period of history.”
“Awakening is not necessarily a good thing. The family should be aware of this. It is very likely that they will stop the excessive awakening…”
Dudian speculated in his heart. At the same time he thought of another matter. From the earliest transformation of the witchers to the present magic marks warriors. The survival of the fittest was eliminated. The existence of the Witchers was eliminated. In the future.., would there be a brand new power evolution model to eliminate the current magic marks warriors?
In his opinion, the magic marks warrior was also unreasonable, dangerous and disgusting.
After all, the parasitic worm was a disgusting parasite.
Moreover, Dudian had been influenced by the culture since he was young. It was self-improvement and not relying on external forces. Therefore, in his mind, any power that was obtained through external forces might not be long-term.
However, the magic marks warriors were in charge now. He was also a magic marks warrior. Perhaps there was a better way to obtain power but he didn’t know or wasn’t sure if he could find it.
“The Monster Research Institute is arranged by the Kingdom of God in the giant wall. Listen to the command of the Kingdom of God. The Witcher Warriors are the products of the Kingdom of God. They are made by the Kingdom of God. The current magic marks Warriors are the same. Perhaps in the Kingdom of God there is a desire to have a more optimized and better way to obtain power. I really want to see the Kingdom of God…”for the first time Dudian had a trace of yearning and curiosity towards the Kingdom of God, would there be advanced research on biology there?
Would he find a way to save the undeads if he went there?
He felt that he should try his best to go to the Kingdom of God in the future. At least, it was a hope!
However, there were many experts there. He didn’t want to experience a life where he was at the mercy of others. He didn’t dare to venture there without sufficient savings and understanding. Moreover, the road to the Kingdom of God was extremely dangerous, it was difficult to reach without the power of the abyss.
“In the first year of the disaster, the God’s wall fell from the sky and stood on the Earth. The ancestors knelt and looked up to the gods. The God of War killed the monsters and protected the people…”Dudian continued to read through the secret book, he saw the earliest history which was not recorded in the history books. It was the beginning of the first year of the history of the giant wall. The content was about the survivors living in the giant wall under the protection of the god of war’s Sylvia.
Meanwhile, the monsters outside the wall had invaded and were all killed by Sylvia.
At that time, the outside of the wall was not as harmonious as it was now. There were only low-level monsters.
At that time, there were all kinds of ancient monsters of different sizes outside the wall. According to the secret book, these monsters came from the “Doomsday Ball”. At that time, there were abyssal pits everywhere outside the wall. Ancient Monsters were born from the pits.., the ancient monsters outside the giant wall could easily climb over the thousand meters tall giant wall and enter the giant wall. It was all thanks to the protection of the goddess of war Sylvia that these monsters were expelled and killed.
The monsters outside the giant wall were expelled and destroyed by the goddess of war. Several pits of the abyss were filled up and destroyed. No more powerful monsters could be born. However, there were still pits of the abyss and terrifying monsters further away from the giant wall, however, there were still pits of the abyss and terrifying monsters outside the giant wall.
“No wonder the giant wall treats Sylvia as its life. No wonder she is loved by the giant wall…”Dudian was enlightened as he read the historical records. He couldn’t help but think of Sylvia’s body, she had defended the life of the giant wall!
However, he was more curious about the pit of the abyss. How did the pit appear?
He suddenly felt that there were too many things that he didn’t know. What kind of changes had happened to the Earth after he slept in the freezing chamber?
Dudian was silent for a long time. He slowly withdrew his thoughts and continued to read the history book.
He saw the development of the giant wall of Sylvia. The life inside the giant wall was also changing. In the past 300 years, there had been thousands of large and small battles. The largest one was.., for example, the Battle of sighs between the inner wall and the outer wall, and the so-called King’s battle where the Barbarians were expelled. Here, the history of the Barbarians was also mentioned.
When it came to the history of the Barbarians, one had to mention the Kingdom of God.
After the first year of the giant wall, people named the divine wall after Sylvia. In the next three years, Sylvia went on expeditions all over the place. Finally, after one of the expeditions ended, she returned with serious injuries and died. She sealed herself in the divine coffin and slept for a long time, two years later, the self-proclaimed messenger of God came to this place. He showed strength comparable to the god of war and subdued the first generation of the giant wall. From then on, the giant wall of Sylvia was included in the territory of the God nation.
Barbarians were the survivors who didn’t want to submit to the God nation. They didn’t want to accept the new language passed down by the Messenger of God. They insisted on the original language so they were killed and expelled.
Dudian looked at the history. It seemed that the chaotic era had appeared in front of his eyes. However, he was shocked that the language inside the giant wall was handed down by God, the history of the giant wall was only five years old! How could god develop a brand new language in just five years?
Moreover, what was most needed after the disaster was order and resources for survival. Who would exhaust their efforts to overthrow the language and replace the old language with a brand new language? What were the benefits of doing so? What was the meaning?
He could not figure it out, but creating a new language in five years and popularizing it made him feel horrified. Behind the divine kingdom, there seemed to be a darkness deeper than the giant wall, there was also a more viscous swamp.
He had made up his mind to look for a glimmer of hope in such a place in the future.
“The giant wall that fell from the sky, the Kingdom of God…”Dudian felt that his eyes were filled with fog. He couldn’t see it clearly. If it wasn’t for the fact that the time shown on the freezer was 300 years later.., he would have suspected that he had slept for more than 300 years. After all, how could such a giant wall fall from the Sky?
These four words were easy to say, but when they turned into a phenomenon and a scene, how magnificent and shocking was it? !
He originally thought that he would find the answers here, but these answers brought him deeper confusion and unknown. He was not particularly interested in exploring these so-called truths, but he knew at the same time that.., if he wanted to live long, he had to explore the truth and understand the things that he was not interested in. Perhaps, life was like that.
Time flew by.
Dudian flipped through the secret book in the palace every day, read the experimental materials sent by the Monster Institute, and crazily studied the knowledge on the super chip. In the busy time, time always passed quickly. He didn’t know whether it was spring or autumn, neither did he know whether it was hot or cold.., a month later, there was an episode in Dudian’s peaceful life. Aisha’s body awakened again. It was her sixth awakening!
Before, Dudian would be very happy to know the news. But after knowing that the end of the awakening was “Humanoid monster”, he wasn’t happy anymore. He didn’t know if the undead Aisha would become a “Humanoid monster”after the seventh awakening, he had never seen such a thing and felt helpless. He couldn’t stop her natural awakening just like how he couldn’t save her.
So he worked even harder to learn and strengthen himself.
The knowledge of the old era recorded in the super chip involved various fields. It would take a long time to master one of them. Although his memory was extraordinary and he needed to spend a lot of time on it.
Apart from knowledge, he would occasionally train and spar with Sergei, Riley, Thor, and others in swordsmanship and saber techniques.
In addition to learning, he would take the God’s marrow regularly every day until his body was saturated. Through the secret book, he also knew the method and conditions to evolve into a ruler. The main method was to use the energy of the god’s marrow, the condition was to deify the legendary magic marks!
This condition would keep all pioneers out of the wall. However, according to Dudian’s knowledge, there were more than one parasitic soul worm cultivated in the three families. It was hoped that they could cultivate a master level expert. However, the three families didn’t choose to bet all the parasitic soul worms on one person.
It was very risky to do so. Once the person who had been bet got into trouble, the descendants would be completely destroyed, just like the other four witcher warrior families that disappeared in history.
With the four witcher families as a warning, the three witcher families did not dare to make such a bet easily. After all, to accumulate six legendary parasitic soul worms would affect the resources of at least three generations, moreover, there wasn’t only one person in the family who had the final say. At the same time, there was a way to awaken the bloodline power. It was more reliable and stable to rely on the bloodline awakening compared to the method of concentrating magic marks on one person to cultivate the master.
Because of this, the three families didn’t have the courage to put all their eggs in one basket. Therefore, the three families couldn’t raise their heads in front of Dudian.
Dudian had learned a truth from the examples of the three big families. If he was sure that he had his own opinions, then what would he do as a tyrant?
If he was restrained by mediocrity and listened to their opinions, he would end up ordinary and become mediocre.
How many geniuses in this world weren’t drowned by Mediocrity and pulled into the partnership?
“I don’t have enough conditions to become an abyss walker. But I have Sylvia’s corpse. She is the key to becoming an abyss walker. I don’t know if the Witcher family knows about this secret. It is no wonder that Aristotle hid the god’s corpse so deeply…”Dudian thought.
The black snow melted and the rain came again.
The unrepaired sewer was once again blocked by the water on the street. The nobles sat at home, roasting the heaters. The civilians huddled in their beds to keep warm.
“Spring goes and autumn comes…”Dudian looked at a poem written by a learned musician. It said that the theme of life was full of vitality. ‘spring’and ‘autumn’had long become history, so he missed them.
“In the blink of an eye, two years have passed.”Dudian said to Aisha.
Aisha was wearing an exquisite purple cheongsam with a purple sachet on her waist. She sat quietly beside him.
Dudian smiled and held her hand, “I have been here for twelve years.”
Aisha remained silent as if she was listening quietly.
“Twelve years, it has passed so fast…”dudian sighed, “I have been in prison, fought with monsters, killed people, slaughtered my family, and blew up the wall of Sighs. These twelve years have not been monotonous.”
Aisha was silent.
Dudian called Neuss and asked him to take a photo of himself and Aisha.
Neuss was familiar with camera operation. He had been taking photos of Dudian every day for the past two years.
“Smile.”Dudian looked at her.
Aisha was still calm.
Dudian smiled.
The photo was frozen at the moment of his smile.
After the Flash, he smiled and stood up. He looked at the prosperous imperial city in front of the palace and whispered: “Neuss, I’m going to go out for a walk.”

chapters.title: Chapter 817
chapters.content:
Chapter 817 – Chapter 807: Farewell
Neuss smiled: “Young Master, the weather has been fine recently. It is suitable for you to go out and play. You have been staying in the palace so you haven’t had a good look at the scenery of the inner wall.”
“I want to leave here.”Dudian slowly said: “I want to go to the Kingdom of God or to other giant walls. If I stay here, I will eventually become a frog at the bottom of the well… Aristotle should be back soon.”
Neuss was stunned. He didn’t expect that Dudian would leave this place. The smile on his face disappeared and his heart sank, “Master, you have become the master. You have deified the legendary magic marks. You have created the air system and the electric power. Can’t you fight against Aristotle?”
“It’s very difficult.”Dudian shook his head, “Don’t forget that all the masters have deified legendary magic marks. His magic marks and strength are higher than mine. I’m not his match. I can only rely on traps, poisons, ambushes and other means. But since they are means, there is a possibility of failure. Once they fail, they will be doomed. So there is no need to take such risks.”
Neuss slightly opened his mouth. There was a trace of complexity in his eyes.
Dudian saw his expression and knew what he was thinking, he said: “There is no need to be reluctant. I am leaving this time to find the way to become the abyss. It would be best if I could be above the Abyss.”
“Master, didn’t you say that the key to becoming the Abyss is in the body of the God? Why do you want to find it?”Neuss couldn’t help but ask.
Dudian sighed, “The god’s corpse is the key. Unfortunately, I don’t have a ‘door’to the abyss. My deified legendary magic marks are rare but the conditions are too bad. Even if I have the god’s corpse, it would be difficult for me to enter the Abyss. The only way to find better resources is to go to the God’s kingdom.”
Neuss bitterly smiled: “Master, I don’t know how many years will pass before we meet again.”
“It depends on the depth of our fate.”Dudian said.
“What is Fate?”Neuss asked. He was knowledgeable but he didn’t know the concept of ‘Fate’.
“It can be understood as cause and effect.”
“I see.”
“Have you prepared everything that I asked you to prepare?”Dudian asked.
“Is it about the coffin?”Neuss lowered his head: “It has been built by the best craftsman in the wall. It is made according to the appearance of the goddess of Sylvia’s coffin. The materials are almost the same.”
“Take me to see it.”
Neuss took Dudian to the secret passage under the palace. They went down hundreds of meters and came to an extremely spacious chamber. There was a huge metal ball inside.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he looked at the metal ball. His heart was full of admiration. The appearance of the metal ball was exactly the same as Sylvia’s. The only flaw was its internal structure.
He could barely see through the material of the metal ball. Although his current strength was at the master level but it was difficult to see through the dark red layer of the metal ball.
“However, Aristotle’s magic marks are ranked second among the eight legendary monsters. This executioner is known for his brutal attacks so he shouldn’t have the ability to see through.”Dudian thought, this executioner was second only to the number one legendary Magic Mark ‘Dreamer’. It was very rare. It was several times stronger than the legendary magic marks like bat sound and shadow hunter.
The executioner and the splitter were both good at attacking, but the difference was that the executioner’s defense was far stronger than the splitter’s, and it was also good at using poison, if it was two executioners and the splitter who were of the same hunting level, then the executioner could easily tear the splitter apart. The splitter’s invincible sharp blade could only leave a little wound on the executioner.
If the Magic Dragon was a powerful monster that could attack and defend at the same time, then the executioner was more powerful than the magic dragon when it came to both offense and defense. Moreover, it also had a special poison. Once other people’s monsters were infected with this poison.., it was like being hanged and could only wait for death slowly. This poison was basically incurable at the moment. The reason why there were no executioners among the top three poisonous monsters was that although this poison was strong, it was a delayed poison. It was not immediately released, it would take a long time but it would increase day by day and erode the body.
“Send a team of confidants to bury the coffin. I have chosen the location.”Dudian looked at the metal ball: “Bury it in the Imperial City.”
Neuss was surprised: “So Close?”
“The closer it is, the less likely it is to be detected.”
Neuss was puzzled: “But if it is not detected then the fake coffin will lose its function.”
“The more undetected it is, the more believable it is.”Dudian slowly said: “After it is buried, those who are directly related to this matter will be executed. As for those who are indirectly related, as long as the involvement is not deep, it can be ignored. Give him a thread to find it.”
Neuss understood, he looked at dudian: “Master, what can be put in the false god’s coffin to hurt this Aristotle?”? “Unfortunately there was only one poison arrow frog who was severely injured by the intruder. He had been killed. Otherwise he would have suffered a great loss.”
“It’s not a big deal to suffer a loss but to kill him.”Dudian narrowed his eyes: “I have been prepared for this day for the past two years. As long as he is tricked into opening the coffin, even if he doesn’t die, he will lose a layer of skin!”
Neuss was startled. He was curious as to what kind of terrifying mechanism could make the Abyss Walker to be skinned?
“Young master, where is the real God’s corpse buried?”He asked.
Dudian replied: “I will personally deal with the real God’s corpse. You Don’t need to worry.”
Neuss saw that Dudian didn’t say anything and didn’t ask further.
Dudian asked Neuss to call Sergei, Gwyneth, Aurora, as well as the brother and sister he had adopted. Two years had passed and Gabriel was already over ten years old, but compared to other children of the same age, they were much more mature.
The biggest reason why Dudian took them in was because of the green hair of Artemis. It was the first time he had seen such a hair color in the giant wall. He was curious about Artemis’s identity, but in the past two years he had read all the secret books but he hadn’t seen anything about green hair. He guessed that it was different from what he had imagined. Her green hair should be a small change in her genes, she didn’t come from any family or special bloodline.
Although he knew about this but he had brought them back. Dudian didn’t give up and kept them by his side. Although they were young but he was also young, this meant that he would have a long time in the future. By the time he was in his thirties the brother and sister would have grown up. At that time they would be two sharp weapons in his hands!
However, no one could be sure about the changes in the future. The world was unpredictable. Perhaps there would be an accident during the process of their growth.
In any case, Dudian had planted a seed. It would be best if it could sprout and blossom.
“Young master, are you going to leave?”Mason who was wearing silver armor asked Dudian anxiously.
Zach was beside him. He had grown into a handsome young man.
Dudian sat on the throne. His eyes swept over Mason, Zach, Sergei and others. There was an infinite emotion in his heart. There was even a trace of sadness. In addition to Aisha, these people in front of him.., they were the people who accompanied him throughout his childhood and adolescence. Although there was betrayal, but there was more warmth. Although his heart had long been cold, but he still remembered the kindness that came from them.
Because of this, he had long prepared a way out for them.
“Yes, I will take Aisha away for a period of time to go to the Kingdom of God.”Dudian said.
Mason saw him admit it and became more anxious: “So soon? The Lord of the wall called Aristotle is not back yet. Even if he comes back, we will fight to the death!”
“Don’t always be so reckless.”Dudian sighed, “Although you are pioneers now, but this strength is nothing in front of the Abyss. After I leave, you better keep a low profile. You should learn to endure things. Only when you know how to endure will you be more powerful next time. Do you understand?”
Mason waved his hand: “I don’t care where you are going. I’m going too!”
Sergei, Nicholas, Gwyneth and others looked at him. Mason was usually very polite to Dudian. Two years ago when Dudian took Mason and Zach to the palace, they followed Sergei and others to address Dudian as young master. They had never resisted Dudian’s words. But this time they wanted to support Mason.
“Young master, I’m willing to follow you to the death.”Nicholas said. He secretly glanced at Dudian. He was a bit nervous. He knew that he wasn’t Mason after all, he wasn’t a good friend who had experienced life and death with Dudian. If Mason could anger Dudian then he might not be killed.
Dudian was amused and sad as he saw the old man’s tactful look: “The road to God’s kingdom is far and dangerous. You will only become a burden if you follow me!”
Mason clenched his fist, “Why do you want to go to God’s kingdom? I heard that you have to reach the level of Abyss Walker to go to God’s kingdom. You are just a master now. If you go, wouldn’t you be sending yourself to death?”
“I have my own methods.”Dudian said. He didn’t want to tell them about this method so that they wouldn’t act rashly.
Mason’s face was full of anger. There seemed to be a trace of red in his eyes.
Dudian saw that Mason’s true feelings were revealed. His heart felt a bit guilty, he comforted them: “You don’t need to be too sad. I have told Noyce that I won’t be gone for long. I will come back when I have the ability to control the giant wall. Don’t forget that I will lead you to conquer the Kingdom of God if necessary in the future!”
Mason snorted and turned his head. He didn’t want to talk to them.
The others were amused to see Mason’s angry expression. They thought that although he was talkative but he had a big temper. They didn’t expect that he would act like a child now.
Everyone thought of Dudian who was the same age as Mason. They couldn’t help but feel awe in their hearts.
“After I leave the palace will be managed by Saul. I have arranged a new identity and a new life for you. You Won’t know who each other is. You shouldn’t try to find each other. If one of you is in trouble then the others will be implicated.”Dudian said: “After Aristotle comes back he will clean up the palace and thoroughly investigate the imperial city. All the families and forces that have been related to me will be wiped out. No matter who is in trouble, the rest of you can not make a move. Remember This!” There was a trace of coldness in his eyes.
Everyone looked at each other and didn’t say anything.
Mason looked at Dudian but didn’t say anything.
Dudian continued: “Don’t be discouraged. I have prepared a lot of God’s marrow for each of you. It is enough for you to grow to the peak of the Inner Wilderness. The way to become a master is to deify the legendary magic marks. I can’t continue to find them for you. You will have to rely on yourself in the future. I hope to see you again when I come back.”
Everyone looked at Dudian with eyes full of reluctance.
Mason clenched his fists and clenched his teeth. His eyes were wet.
Zach sighed in his heart and patted his shoulder.
Neuss knew that Dudian was going to leave so he slowly accepted the result. He didn’t have too much emotional fluctuation but was sad and sad.
Gwyneth looked at the youth on the throne. Her expression was complicated. The years she had spent together with him flashed through her mind. From the cold youth who took her out of the prison to the cold-blooded youth who made her unhappy, she suddenly felt strong reluctance to part with the youth. She lowered her head and clenched her fingers. She resisted the urge to persuade him.
Because she knew that she couldn’t persuade him.
Just like how she couldn’t persuade him to kill people in the beginning, now she couldn’t persuade him to stay.
“Nicholas, you don’t need to care about the business of the herbal field anymore. I gave you a new identity as a butler. It’s your favorite profession.”Dudian said to Nicholas.
Nicholas wryly smiled: “Master…”
Dudian said to Gwyneth: “You said that your dream is to be a traveler. I will give you a new identity as a traveler. You can go to different places to see flowers and plants. You will be far away from killing and the so-called truth trial.”
Gwyneth bit her lips.
“Neuss, you have worked hard these years. Without You I would have died at least one hundred and thirty-four times.”Dudian said to Neuss.
“Master, don’t say that…”Neuss bitterly smiled: “Last Time I almost caused you a big accident. I…”

chapters.title: Chapter 818
chapters.content:
Chapter 818 – Chapter 808: North
“It’s nothing compared to the number of times you have saved me. It’s not your fault. I drank too much.”Dudian whispered, “Although you haven’t known me for the first time but you have been by my side for the longest time. I have given you a new identity as a bartender. It is something you are good at. But remember not to mix white wine so as not to leak your whereabouts.”
“It seems young master wants me to live a leisurely life.”Neuss immediately guessed dudian’s thoughts: “I will make the most delicious wine for you when you come back.”
“I’m looking forward to it.”Dudian’s eyes turned to Sergei: “You like beautiful women. You have been imprisoned because of lust. I will give you a new identity as a guard of the Moulin Rouge. You will see many beautiful women every day.”
Sergei’s face turned red as he scratched his head: “Don’t mention the past.”
The others smiled.
Dudian looked at Artemis and Gabriel: “Take Care of your sister after I leave.”
Gabriel felt the sad atmosphere in the hall. His face turned serious as he heard Dudian’s words: “I Will!”
“You will be adopted by a kind family. They have no children. You should be filial to them and follow their choice of academy. But remember to train well in private. When I come back, I hope to see your fighting skills. You Won’t lose to anyone. Do you understand?”Dudian looked at them.
Gabriel was nervous and excited at the same time. He didn’t expect that Dudian would give them such high expectations. he shouted: “I will work hard!”
Sergei grinned: “I’m afraid it won’t be so easy to surpass us. I Won’t let my guard down.”
“Me too.”Neuss smiled but there was a bit of pride in his eyes.
Dudian looked at them. He knew that they were talking to him and not to compete with the Gabriel siblings. He also knew the meaning behind their words. They would wait for his return.
Return..
He slightly clenched his fingers.
A few days later, outside the palace, everyone was practicing for Dudian.
Dudian was holding Aisha’s hand. He was carrying a hunter’s bag that was nearly two meters tall. It was filled with high-calorie dry food and high-purity purified water. In addition, there were two sets of clothes to change into. He had one set and Aisha had one set, there were also some medicines for emergency treatment in the wild. The key to cross the Abyss was the broken limbs of the goddess!
He dared to cross the Abyss with the body of a ruler to search for the Kingdom of God. It was because of the body of Sylvia that some powerful monsters outside the giant wall didn’t dare to come close to her. It was the effect of exorcism.., however, at the same time as exorcism, she also possessed the ability to attract monsters.
Simply put, most of the monsters that feared her body and did not dare to approach her were of a level that even abyssal walkers would find difficult to deal with. Meanwhile, the monsters that were lower than that top-tier monster, from high-tier to low-tier monsters, would flock to her scent like a flock of ducks.., such a characteristic made the intruders not dare to use her body to open a path and cross the Abyss when they took her body away.
After all, the number of master level monsters in the Abyss was frightening. Bringing Sylvia’s God’s corpse was like lighting a bright lamp in the dark night.
Dudian didn’t want to use the broken limbs of the goddess to exorcise the monsters. He wanted to use the parasitic worm that was born from the broken limbs.
The God’s worm powder came from the broken bones of the parasitic worm that was born from the god’s corpse. Many senior monsters were afraid and didn’t dare to come close. Dudian had brought a lot of God’s worm powder but in case of emergency.., he had to spare a part of the broken limb of the goddess. With this broken limb, in addition to making a large amount of God’s worm powder, he could also get the God’s worm. The effect of this god’s worm was much stronger than the god’s worm powder.
“I’m leaving.”Dudian looked back at Sergei, Mason and other familiar faces. There was a trace of longing in his eyes but he didn’t look back the next moment. He picked up Aisha and flew away.
“Young Master!”
“Young master…”
The voices came from behind and gradually became farther and farther away.
Dudian flew up to thousands of meters high in the sky. He looked back and saw that the palace was getting smaller and smaller in his line of sight. The faces of Sergei and others were still clearly visible.
He retracted his eyes and rushed forward.
In the blink of an eye he flew out of the imperial city.
Dudian’s mood gradually calmed down as he looked at the desolate wilderness outside the giant wall. His eyes were sharp as he looked towards the north.
“Although there is no record of the route to the Kingdom of God in the palace. But in the notes of the second wall master it was mentioned that the Kingdom of God had sent him to the south to search for a strange object. Since the Kingdom of God had sent the wall master to the south then the Kingdom of God could be in the north. In other noble novels it has been recorded that there are gods in the north. There shouldn’t be any mistakes.”Dudian thought.
He could only go in a straight line. Out of the four directions, the north was the most likely. Even if the Kingdom of God wasn’t in the north, he believed that he would meet other giant walls. Moreover, the Earth was round, he could always return to the origin.
After flying for half a day, Dudian’s speed slowly decreased. He slowly flew down and landed on the top of a broken statue. The statue was tilted. Its body seemed to be submerged in mud. Half of its head was tilted on the ground, it should be a famous statue building from the old era. However, it was covered in moss and dust now.
“There is a wasteland ahead. Let’s take a rest,”Dudian said to Aisha.
Aisha was as silent as ever. There was no miracle to respond to Dudian.
Dudian was also used to it. He smiled, took out the food and water from his backpack and slowly ate. After ten minutes of rest, he picked up Aisha and continued to move forward.
After entering the wasteland, Dudian felt that the monsters he saw along the way were much stronger. There were monsters around level 40-50 which were comparable to high-level limiters. In addition, he occasionally saw some strange giant footprints, it seemed that they were left by some huge monster.
Dudian was familiar with the monster atlas but he was still unable to identify what the footprints came from.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a black shadow shot out from the ground.
Dudian raised his hand and smacked it. His palm instantly turned into a sinister scythe which cut the black shadow. At the same time he looked down and saw that it was a monster with long arms. It was beating its chest muscles to challenge him.
Dudian took a glance at it and turned back to his hand. He slightly raised the height of his hand by a few hundred meters.
“This is the border of the wing clan’s wasteland. We should be able to reach the depths of the red wasteland before the sky completely turns dark.”Dudian thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 819
chapters.content:
Chapter 819 – Chapter 809: “Forest Of Despair”
Dudian sped up a bit in hopes of reaching the depths of the red wasteland before nightfall.
As he went deeper into the red wasteland, he saw that the ground was covered with barren black soil. There were no weeds but potholes. There were no traces of old buildings, it seemed that hundreds of years of wind and frost and the footprints of monsters had been flattened.
There was a strong smell of blood in the soil. It seemed that blood had been soaked in the soil for a long time.
Dudian saw bones scattered all over the ground. Some of the bones were extremely huge. They were more than 20 meters long. There was no blood or flesh left on them. There were only some birds with strange feathers that were resting on the bones, they were like branches.
Dudian didn’t dare to fly too high as he didn’t want to provoke the Thunderbirds that were resting on the clouds. The Thunderbirds were more terrifying than the legendary monsters on the ground or even the monsters in the abyss. The Thunderbirds collectively released lightning, it was enough to turn him into ashes in an instant. If the birds were big enough then even the Abyss Walkers wouldn’t be able to escape death. This also made the high sky a restricted area.
He flew at a height of about 1,000 meters. His eyes scanned the ground. Although the red wasteland wasn’t like the Abyss but there were still many monsters that could threaten his life.
Thump, thump, thump.
After flying for more than ten miles, Dudian heard rumbling sounds coming from the ground in front of him. It was a huge monster that looked like a rhinoceros. It walked on the black soil and left a series of footprints along the way. Every step it took.., the ground slightly trembled.
Dudian looked at the heat source reaction in its body. It seemed to be a heavy monster but its heat source density was abnormally high. It was estimated that its hunting level should be over 100.
Dudian flew directly over its head but his eyes kept on its body to prevent it from throwing stones from the ground. After all, the distance of a kilometer was completely within the perception range of these monsters.
After flying for a long distance, Dudian saw that the monster was still shaking its body and slowly walking. He knew that it was not interested in him so he stopped paying attention to it.
After flying for another half an hour, Dudian saw two giant monsters fighting in the wilderness. One monster was a giant python that was more than 30 meters long. However, this giant python had a triangular head. Its scales were sharp and the patterns on its body were particularly strange, it looked like countless eyes. The one fighting with it was a crawling monster. It looked like a lizard or a crocodile. Its body was about 10 meters long and the tip of its tail was like a spiked meteor hammer. It was extremely destructive.
The heat sources in the bodies of these two monsters were extremely shocking. Dudian recognized their identities. There were records of them in the Atlas. Both of them were comparable to the pioneers of the wilderness.
The two monsters were evenly matched. Dudian didn’t stop as he flew past them. He was observing the battle from the corner of his eyes. When he was about to fly out of the field of vision, he suddenly found that the two monsters were not far away, a giant centipede-like monster slowly crawled over. The shell on its back was dark. It was not eye-catching as it crawled on the black soil.
He seemed to be able to foresee what was going to happen next. He had some feelings in his heart. This kind of thing would happen every day and every moment in the world outside the giant wall. It was already a normal state. If the whole world was like this.., did It mean that the world was like this?
The sun set on the West Mountain. The evening light shone from the clouds.
Dudian basked in the warm evening sunlight as he flew over a high mountain. He saw that the black earth stretched thousands of meters in front of him. However, the sky seemed to have completely darkened, there was a huge forest on the ground. He couldn’t see the end of it.
“This is the ‘Desperate Forest’recorded on the map.”Dudian slowed down as he saw the scene. He knew that he had come to the edge of the red wasteland.
The ‘Desperate Forest’was located in the abyss.
The ancestors of the residents of the wall had divided the ‘Forest of despair’into the Abyss because all the residents had gone to the ‘Forest of despair’. There was no news about them and they hadn’t returned, this became the deepest barrier of the wasteland guarded by the wing clan. No one dared to cross this place and go to the dark forest.
There were similar dangerous places like the ‘Desperate Forest’at the end of the red wasteland where the Dragon Clan and the Rock clan were suppressing. People were stopped from exploring. Death divided the wasteland and the abyss into a distinct ravine.
Dudian looked around and sniffed. Soon he could smell the smell of insect powder. The smell was thicker than the border between the Hunter area and the wasteland. He knew that the wing clan who was guarding this place would come here once every half a month, they would come here to outline the border with insect powder. If there was a rainy season, the frequency would be faster.
This was the border. It was considered the safest area in the Red Wasteland.
Dudian slowly landed on the hillside. The hillside was full of lush weeds and strange plants. However there were no monsters living here. There were only some unconscious undeads wandering around, however, most of these undeads had been mutated many times. Some of them were thin and long, four to five meters tall. The bones of their arms were bent, turning into strange crescent blades. Some of them were bloated, the flesh on their bodies was like tumors, making people’s scalp numb.
Seeing these undeads foolishly wandering around, Dudian felt a bit sad. But he quickly shook off the idea in his mind and told himself that Aisha was different from them.
He looked at Aisha who was still as beautiful as a virgin. Her purple cheongsam was floating in the air with a kind of oriental classical beauty. He looked at the zombies again and felt very comfortable, because the difference between the two was really different!
He used the dragon blood spell to control the heartbeat of his heart to reduce the heat source in his body to the minimum. Then he found a relatively clean rock and pulled out a lot of weeds to spread on it. Then he sat down with Aisha, he took out the undead powder from his backpack and sprinkled it around. The undead powder was made from the highest level of undead powder. Among them was the head of the king that Bit Aisha, and the body of the king that the Dragon Clan carried back to the giant wall.
After the arrangement, Dudian sat comfortably by Aisha’s side. He quietly watched the sunset reflecting the rainbow in the sky. The cold wind in the wilderness blew past them. In the distance were the figures of the scattered ferocious undeads, these undeads were far away and didn’t notice Dean.
Dean looked up at the sunset. He quietly watched it move bit by bit. He had a good feeling in his heart. If the surrounding environment was better, he would feel happier. It would be like a honeymoon trip between a couple.
His eyes lit up as he thought of this. He took out a small notebook and pen from his backpack and recorded the scene on it. It was the first day after leaving the giant wall.
He took out a small camera that he had specially made and took a photo with Aisha’s back facing the sunset.
His mood was better after doing this. He put away the camera and took out food and water to eat. At the same time, he fed Aisha a sealed fresh beef.
After eating, Dean looked at the dark forest thousands of meters in front of him. He squinted his eyes and used the heat source to scan it. He found something strange. There was no heat source reaction in the forest!

chapters.title: Chapter 820
chapters.content:
Chapter 820 – Chapter 800: “Living Forest”
“Are there no monsters living in the outer regions?”Dudian thought. He thought of the other members of the family who had entered the ‘Forest of despair’. Most of them had checked the forest through the heat source reaction, but they didn’t come out.
“Although heat source tracking vision is a rare perception ability, but at least one out of ten pioneers have it. There is no reason that the ancestors of the Hunter family wouldn’t bring people with strong perception. Especially after so many people died in the forest. In this case, the things that are really dangerous may not emit heat source reaction or smell. The latent ability is probably as strong as the shadow hunter. Moreover, there are far more than the shadow hunter.”
Dudian had a trace of fear in his heart. So many pioneers had been buried here. It meant that the hidden dangers were extremely terrible. He wasn’t a master who could easily take risks.
However, flying at high altitude in the abyss was undoubtedly more risky.
The wings were good at flying but they had only explored the ‘Forest of despair’before stopping. It was clear that they had already tried flying.
“It seems that the first step to cross the Abyss is very difficult…”Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed. He looked up at the sky. The Sun had completely set. A crescent moon was visible on the edge of the clouds. The cold light shined on the Earth, the weeds on the hillside were fluttering in the wind. The air seemed to be filled with a faint smell of blood. At the same time, he heard the roar of a beast coming from far behind, it was a terrifying beast.
Night came.
It was time for the monster to move.
Dudian glanced at the undeads that were wandering around. He found that a few of them were attracted by the roar. The others were still wandering around unconsciously. It seemed that they would approach at any time.
Dudian wasn’t worried. He leaned back and lay on the rock. He crossed his legs and looked at the night sky. He was deep in thought.
There were more and more roars coming from all directions. However the ‘Forest of despair’in front of Dudian was silent, the moonlight seemed to be unable to penetrate through the forest.
Dudian stared at the forest. He still couldn’t see anything strange in the forest.
In the blink of an eye, the night passed.
Dudian took a few naps but was woken up by the roars of the beasts. There were many monsters wandering in the wilderness behind the hillside but they didn’t dare to approach this place. Instead, a few undeads slowly wandered over, however, they seemed to have sensed the smell of Aisha. They stopped two or three hundred meters away from Dudian and turned around to continue to wander in other directions.
Dean woke up at dawn. He took out the food and ate breakfast. He stood up and stretched his body. He looked at Aisha who hadn’t slept for a night and felt a bit of pity in his heart, although he knew that she didn’t have the habit of “Sleeping”.
“It’s time to go.”Dean held her hand and whispered: “Find something to help us open the way.”
As he spoke his eyes fell on the few wandering undeads behind the hillside. He bent down and picked a rock and threw it at one of them.
Bang! It hit.
The undeads were four to five meters tall but extremely thin. Its body was like skin and bones without any flesh. Sharp blades protruded from the joints of its bones. In terms of fighting strength, it was not inferior to ordinary pioneers.
Even the undead king who had bitten Aisha didn’t have such a high-level undead.
After being hit by the stone, the undead quickly noticed Dudian. Originally, Dudian had the undead powder to cover the smell, and Aisha’s smell field made the undead not dare to come close. But at this moment, he took the initiative to attack, suddenly, it showed a difference, so that the undead recognized that it was “Not my kind”.
Roar!
The zombie roared and rushed over. Its running posture was extremely strange. It was as thin as a bamboo pole and had long arms and legs like a strange insect. However, its speed was very fast. In the blink of an eye, it was in front of dudian.
Dudian immediately shook the bell.
Aisha’s pure black eyes suddenly shot out a cold light. She turned her head to look at the zombie.
When the zombie was looked at by Haisha, its body suddenly stopped as if it had been struck by lightning. The next moment, it suddenly let out a scream and curled up on the ground, shivering.
Seeing that the enslavement was effective, Dean’s heart was relieved. For the past two years in the inner wall, he had been staying with Haisha every day. He had repeatedly consolidated the conditioned reflex training for her, especially half a year ago, when she awakened seven times.., he had almost lost control. Although he was barely controlled at that time, but after this, he had strengthened her conditioned reflex training. In addition to the basic instructions, he had also extended other training.
For example, the servant undeads now.
As early as when Dudian brought Aisha back from the wasteland to the giant wall, he knew that undeads were afraid of Aisha. Later, through experiments, he found that all the undeads that could be captured outside the giant wall would tremble in front of Aisha and would not dare to come close, however, Aisha was not like the king that bit her. She could control the undeads, gather the tide of undeads, and even arrange for the undeads to be buried underground for sneak attacks. This kind of consciousness did not exist in Aisha’s body, dudian could only rely on himself and try to let her learn how to control the undeads step by step.
Fortunately, controlling the undeads seemed to be the instinct of the king. Although Aisha did not show the intelligence of the undeads like the other kings, but when she was with the other undeads.., she seemed to slowly learn how to control the undeads.
After a long period of training, Dudian was finally able to use the conditioned reflex training to drive the enslaved undeads. In this way, he didn’t have to let Aisha fight in person anymore.
Clang Clang Clang Clang Clang Clang!
In a series of bell sounds with a specific rhythm, the enslaved undeads slowly moved forward. They passed by Dudian and walked towards the “Forest of despair”.
Dudian cut down the rock and hit the other undeads.
These undeads were angered by Dudian and immediately roared and rushed over.
Dudian immediately let Haisha control them.
When the undeads rushed in front of dudian, they were like the previous blade undeads. They trembled and didn’t dare to go forward.
Dudian let Haisha control them to move in groups and step into the “Despair forest”one after another. He and Haisha followed them from a distance of 1,000 meters. If they encountered any danger.., they would be able to escape in time.
“If we want to occupy other giant walls, it seems that Aisha’s gathering tide is the fastest way to attack them,”Dean thought.
At this time, the sharp-edged undeads at the front had already walked to the front of the forest of despair. It seemed to hesitate for a moment and then slowly walked in.
This short hesitation made Dean’s eyes slightly focused. He already knew that although these undeads didn’t have consciousness and intelligence, they still had instincts, including bloodlust, eating, and fear of the king of undead.., their fear seemed to be only for the undead king. Even if they were faced with monsters that were dozens or even hundreds of levels higher than him, they would still roar and pounce on them. They didn’t know what fear was.
At this time, the next few undeads also came to the front of the despair forest. They seemed to be hesitant but still stepped into it.
Dudian had a bad premonition but he couldn’t turn back to the giant wall. He could only move forward.
“Could it be that there is a zombie king in the forest? Right, zombies are cold-blooded creatures, there is no heat source reaction…”dudian guessed in his heart. If there was a zombie king, it was very likely that there was a tide of zombies buried in the forest.
He and Aisha came to the front of the forest. Looking at the dark branches and weeds in the forest, there was an inexplicable feeling of fear in his heart. It was as if waves of the aura of death were coming at him!
He hesitated for a moment but still stepped into the forest.
After entering the forest, Dudian felt that the temperature around him seemed to have dropped. He followed the undeads for more than 200 meters. The ominous feeling in his heart became stronger and stronger. He stopped, at the same time, he stopped the undeads. He looked around and saw that the trees and weeds around him were extremely quiet. There was no sound of wind. It was as if they were dying.
The hair on his back stood up. Suddenly, his heart moved. He immediately let Aisha control the undeads to make noise.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
The undeads were under Aisha’s control. They roared as if they were angered. At the same time, they hit the surrounding trees. It was as if they were alive in the silence.
Dudian looked at them to see what they would attract.
A few undeads wantonly destroyed the trees and continued to roar for half an hour. Dudian lost his patience as he saw a scene that made his pupils contract. He saw that under the destroyed trees.., a few pitch-black vines which were about two meters in diameter shot out and quickly hit the undeads. The sharp undead was the first to be hit. It was obviously good at attacking but not good at defending.., the vines fiercely hit the ground.
When the vines were lifted, Dudian saw that it was growling and ready to climb up. But at this time, its body suddenly sank down as if it fell down.
Seeing this scene, Dudian didn’t turn back. He pulled Aisha and turned to run.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The sound of wind whistled in his ears. In the blink of an eye, he rushed out of the forest and came to the plains outside the forest. He turned his head and looked. His vision was blocked by the trees in the forest. He used x-ray vision and saw that the undeads were standing where they were, there was only one undeads left. He saw that the undeads were hit by a vine and quickly sank into the soil under the forest.
It was as if they were frozen and couldn’t move.
Dudian was shocked. This was too shocking. It should be known that most of the undeads were comparable to ordinary pioneers. Although two of them were slightly weaker but the soil wasn’t enough to restrict their movement, unless the soil he saw was unusual. But from his perspective, the forest was covered with soil and sand. There was nothing strange about it!
“Fortunately, I didn’t go too deep. It was only 200 meters…”Dudian felt a trace of relief in his heart. He recalled the thick black vines and his heart throbbed. It was just a vine.., how Big and terrifying was the body of the undead? He used his X-ray vision and found that the black vines extended to the depths of the ground. However the distance was too far. His X-ray vision could only see a depth of less than twenty meters, it was more than forty meters in total. It might only be a small part of the vines..
Dudian’s eyes flickered. He thought for a moment and decided to test them again.
This time he let Aisha enslave the two undeads and controlled them to enter the forest. He and Aisha were standing 20 to 30 meters away from the forest.
He didn’t let the two undeads go too deep. He just entered about 100 meters and began to wreak havoc.
The destruction lasted for four to five minutes. Suddenly a strange scene appeared. The sand under the feet of the two undeads was swept up and wrapped around their bodies. Soon the two angry undeads were completely wrapped in the sand, then they slowly sank into the ground.
Dudian was stunned and his heart was cold.
He saw that after the two undeads were dragged into the ground for more than ten meters by the sand, they were completely silent.
Then their bones slowly slid down from the sand to the depths that he couldn’t see.
This sand… was actually alive?
Dudian looked at the vast forest in front of him and a terrifying thought emerged in his mind. Could it be that this entire forest was a living creature? !
In his previous encounters with monsters, monsters that were forty to fifty meters tall were already quite terrifying. However, if this entire forest was a living creature, then it couldn’t be measured by “Rice”, it would be more than a kilometer!
Dudian’s mind was filled with terrifying thoughts. After a long time he slowly calmed down. He thought that he was thinking too much. It should be some kind of mutated monster that was beyond his understanding, maybe there were records in the God’s kingdom which couldn’t be measured by normal monsters.
He wanted to reach the god’s kingdom as soon as possible.
“What is the world like now? The giant wall of Sylvia is just a speck of dust on the entire Earth. There are other giant walls and survivors. But how many giant walls are there? How Big is the God’s Kingdom?”Dudian’s eyes flashed, he pondered for a long time as his thoughts slowly returned to the despair forest in front of him. It was obviously impossible to walk from the ground so he could only fly.
But flying was too risky. He didn’t know if using the remains of the goddess would make this strange forest afraid?
Dudian felt that the horror of the despair forest was enough to understand the level of fear of the remains of the goddess.

chapters.title: Chapter 821
chapters.content:
Chapter 821 – Chapter 811: The Abyss
“Let’s try it first.”Dudian took out the insect powder from his backpack. He then lured a zombie from the vicinity to be enslaved by Aisha. He sprinkled the insect powder on the zombie’s body and let it enter the forest of despair.
The zombie seemed to respond to the smell of the insect powder. However, Aisha was able to intimidate it so it obediently went into the forest.
After entering the forest, Dean let Aisha control the undead to wreak havoc in the forest.
Whoosh!
After destroying a few trees, the sand suddenly jumped up and wrapped the undead. It was pulled into the depths of the soil and quickly decomposed it.
“The insect powder really doesn’t work.”Dean wasn’t too disappointed to see the result. The insect powder was everywhere on the border. The ancestors of the winged family didn’t lack it either. However, they weren’t able to explore the forest. He knew that this thing wouldn’t work, he was still holding on to a glimmer of hope.
He took out a small box from his backpack. There was a piece of the remains of the goddess in the box. He took the sealed box and lured another undead from the vicinity. He opened the sealed box, he took out a thumb-sized piece of thin meat and put it into the hollow bone pit on the back of the undead’s neck. He commanded it to go to the forest.
After the thin piece of meat came out, the air was filled with a rotten stench. The smell was so strong that even the rotten smell and blood smell of the undead were completely covered.
Dudian stared at it.
Soon, he found the difference. The undead hadn’t come close to the forest yet. The trees in the forest suddenly wriggled like living things. They wriggled into the soil and went down, they actually shrank into the darkness deep underground.
Dudian was surprised by this scene. He didn’t expect that a small piece of flesh from the goddess would have such a magical effect.
Every step the undeads took, there would be pieces of trees that shrank into the sand. It looked extremely shocking.
The dark forest seemed to be purified. Large pieces of trees shrank into the sand, leaving only the bare dark ground.
The other trees in the distance were squirming uneasily. It seemed that they were hesitating whether to escape into the sand or not. But as the undeads approached, more and more trees shrank into the ground.
Dudian was shocked. He was shocked by the effect of the corpse of the goddess. He was also shocked by the ‘forest’. All the trees that he had seen before could move! Was this a plant? Or was this a group of monsters disguised as plants? Or was this not a ‘group’but a single one?
He had imagined the scene of the abyss countless times but he didn’t expect that he would be deeply shocked before he stepped into it. It was as if an unknown and dangerous door was slowly opening in front of him.
After a moment, he slowly came back to his senses. He looked at the semi-circular arcs of trees that had disappeared in the middle of the forest. He slowly raised his feet and followed behind the undeads.
He prayed in his heart that this strange forest didn’t have a high IQ. If he deliberately lured him in, then he would die.
The trees within a radius of 500 meters of the undeads were all shrunk into the sand. As the undeads continued to move forward, the forest slowly opened up a bare road. After going seven or eight miles deep, Dudian looked back, he found that there were black plants coming out from far behind. They were still in the same state as before. The wind couldn’t blow. The twisted tree trunks were like monsters, they looked at him ferociously.
Dudian retracted his eyes and let the undeads quicken their pace.
Ten Miles, twenty miles, thirty miles..
Dudian calculated the distance under his feet as he walked. He walked for more than forty miles before he saw the faint light from the trees in front of the forest. It didn’t take long for the trees at the end of the forest to shrink into the soil, a vast plain was revealed. There were scattered trees and a lake on the plain. The lake was as calm as a mirror and reflected the blue sky.
Dudian was relieved as he finally walked out.
He was the first one to walk out of the Forest of despair which no one had ever been able to return to. All the credit was due to the pieces of meat on the corpse of the goddess.
Dudian made the undeads stop and put on plastic gloves. He cut off the pieces of meat from the back of the undeads’neck and sealed them into boxes. He had stepped into the Abyss and could meet a terrifying existence who was interested in the corpse of the goddess at any time, the meat from the corpse of the Goddess was a double-edged sword. If it was not used well, it would die without a burial place.
Although the meat had been cut off, the neck of the undeads still had a strong smell. Dudian made it continue to open the way. He noticed the lake on the plain. According to the knowledge he had learned as a scavenger.., where there is water, there will be beasts.
Such a simple principle was suitable for the low-level hunter area and the terrifying Abyss area.
Dudian’s eyes entered the perspective state. He looked at the lake and found that the lake was dark and deep. There was a faint red light at the bottom of the lake. He was shocked. The red light was the heat source reaction, although the heat was faint and the density was low. It was similar to ordinary cattle and sheep. But the area of the lake was frighteningly large. From thousands of meters away he felt that the diameter of the lake was about fifty meters. The specific size of the lake might be more terrifying.
What made Dudian scared was that there was no other heat source reaction in the lake. It seemed that there was only one creature.
Dudian didn’t dare to go near. He controlled the undeads to go around the lake.
The creatures in the lake didn’t seem to notice Dudian.
Dudian went around the lake for thousands of meters. He saw a place that led to the lake. There were several huge footprints on the ground. He stood in the pit of the footprints, it felt like he was standing alone in a square.
Dudian’s face was ugly as he slowly walked. He held his breath and suppressed the heat reaction in his body. He regretted that he had taken the risk to cross the abyss. However he quickly extinguished the intention to retreat.
After going around the lake, Dudian walked along the plain for more than ten miles. He saw a huge skeleton. It looked like a rhinoceros. The body seemed to have died not long ago. It was emitting a strong smell of revenge. Its flesh and blood were gnawed, however, the thing that killed it didn’t seem to have a big appetite. It didn’t eat its body completely. Dudian used x-ray vision to take a look and found that its internal organs were all gone. Its body was empty.
Dudian took Aisha and quickly left the place. He didn’t want to attract other monsters to bump into him.
After walking for less than five or six miles, Dudian met a rock-scaled python that was entrenched in the grass of the plain. The Python’s body was 20 meters long. Its body was thicker than a water tank. Its scales were extremely tough, it could exert dozens of tons of strangling power when it was entangled with its prey.
“It’s A Level 102 existence, the No. 1 overlord of the Red Wasteland Region. It’s close to the power of a ruler.”Dudian narrowed his eyes. He didn’t run away. The more it ran, the more it would chase after him. He let go of Aisha, he entered the demon body state and quickly rushed forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 822
chapters.content:
Chapter 822 – Chapter 812: Traces Of Human
The rock scale Python soon noticed Dudian’s existence. Its body that was originally coiled on the ground slowly swam. Its huge head was slightly raised and exposed from the grass. Its dark green vertical pupils coldly stared at Dudian, its head slowly arched in a defensive posture as if it would launch an attack at any time.
Whoosh!
Dudian quickly approached like a monster with a group of ferocious sharp blades. The strange and twisted sharp blades moved on the ground and pushed his body forward. It was as if all the sharp blades in his body could transform into legs and feet, his speed was very fast. It was three times faster than a normal human’s body. In the blink of an eye, he had arrived in front of the rock scale Python. He looked at the snake’s swaying head and suddenly his body protruded to the left.
The rock scale Python’s reaction was very fast. It quickly rushed towards Dudian’s left side to bite him.
However, after Dudian took a step, his body twisted. The sharp limbs of his body cut across the ground and stopped his direction. He dodged to the side and avoided the mouth of the rock scale Python, at the same time the mouth of the snake brushed past Dudian’s body, the sharp blade protruding from his arm instantly pierced through the edge of the mouth of the snake. Puff! The dark red scales that seemed to be soaked in blood were cut open, blood flowed out.
Dudian saw that he could break the scales. He was calm. The sharp limbs on his body moved quickly. One by one, the sharp limbs pierced the rock scale Python’s body like nails. His body quickly climbed to about seven inches on its back, this position was where its head couldn’t turn around and bite.
The rock scale Python’s body was pierced with several bloody holes. It was in extreme pain. It tried to shake its head to throw dudian off. However, it was futile. Dudian used the sharp limbs to firmly hook its body, he waved his arms and cut the scales on its back.
The Python was in extreme pain as it twisted its huge body. The ground shook slightly. It turned its head towards its body and used its body to squeeze dudian.
Dudian didn’t dare to neglect. He quickly used his sharp limbs to cut a bloody hole. When the Python used its body to squeeze it, it immediately jumped into the bloody hole and drilled into it.
After a while, the rock scale Python gradually stopped struggling and lay on the ground. Its head stretched out from its body. It slowly raised its head and climbed up. It seemed that it wanted to drag its heavy body away, but after seven or eight meters, it slowly stopped. Its head hit the ground and stopped moving.
From the back of the rock scale Python’s Neck, Dudian crawled out like a bloody man. The sharp limbs of the python were stained with blood. He looked particularly ferocious. He shook off the blood stains on his body and jumped down from the body of the rock scale Python, he came to the middle of its body and used the sharp limbs to cut through its belly. After a moment he came out with a bottle-sized snake gall.
The gall of the rock scale Python was the main ingredient of the top antidote. If it was taken directly, it could detoxify most of the snake venom. Even if it was not poisoned, it could be taken to greatly enhance its anti-poison ability.
After taking the gallbladder, Dudian went to the front of the Python’s head and opened its mouth. He broke the four sharp fangs in its mouth. The teeth of ordinary snakes were relatively fragile so most of them used the swallowing method to hunt for food, but the rock scale Python was different. Its teeth could be said to be the hardest part of its body. It was the best material for forging weapons. Although it had a witcher and didn’t lack sharp weapons, but the fangs were used as trap materials, it was very suitable.
Dudian took away the two treasures. He looked at the rock scale Python which was completely dead. He sighed in his heart. This was the wilderness. He would either kill the other or be killed by the other, there was no more nonsense or words. The loser would die.
He picked up the four short sword length fangs and carried them on his back. The snake bile was stored in a sealed jar to prevent poisoning.
Although there were many valuable things on the rock scale Python’s body, but Dudian’s backpack was limited. He was too lazy to take things that were not useful in crossing the abyss.
“I didn’t expect to see this kind of thing at the outermost part of the abyss…”Dudian put away his magic body and continued to lead Aisha forward. He was in a heavy mood. Although he had won the first battle.., but only he knew the dangers of the previous battle. If his reaction was a bit slower then maybe he would be the one to die at this moment.
In the blink of an eye, the corpse of the rock scale Python was left behind. Dudian walked forward. It didn’t take long before he met two undeads wandering on the plain. These two undeads looked extremely strange. They were called undeads.., it was similar to the portrait of the bugmen that Dudian had seen from the information of the Monster Laboratory. One of the undeads was in the shape of a spider. Its body was lying on the ground and its buttocks were swollen. There were four or five sharp legs under its abdomen. Its outer appearance was the color of human skin.., however, the shape of the legs only had three toes. Each toe was extremely long and sharp like a dagger. It stood on the ground.
The body of the other undeads was bent backward. It seemed that its spine was broken. Its chest was facing the sky and its head was about to collide with its buttocks. However, there was a huge crack in its chest. The shadow inside was filled with sharp teeth.
Dudian had never seen such undeads in the Monster Atlas. He was afraid. After all, they were undeads that had survived in the abyss. The shape alone was very unusual. He looked at Aisha and hesitated for a moment, he decided to take the risk.
He threw a stone to attract the spider-shaped zombie so that Aisha could control it.
The spider-shaped zombie quickly climbed in. Aisha growled and her crystal-like pupils seemed to glow with a strange light. At this moment, it was no longer the usual quiet and dull appearance. It seemed to be a god that stood above all things, there was a kind of malevolent and evil aura of the emperor.
The spider-like undead’s body suddenly stopped. Its disheveled head was full of malevolence. However, there was obvious fear in its eyes. Its teeth were slightly closed. It shook its body and slowly lay down to show its submission.
Dean’s heart relaxed as he saw Aisha’s control. He didn’t expect that even the undead living in the Abyss couldn’t resist the control of the undead king. Moreover, this control seemed to come from instinct.., what made these unconscious undeads instinctively fear the undead king?
Dean felt that there must be an incredible secret hidden in the undeads. However, it wasn’t something he could deduce at the moment.
There were one and two undeads. After controlling the undeads, Dean did the same thing and lured the chest-split undeads. Haisha made a move and easily controlled them again.
Dean was satisfied. It was not bad to have two undeads as a stepping stone. Moreover, these two undeads were fast. He estimated that they could compete with or even win against the war god level experts.
After controlling the two undeads, Dean continued to move forward.
After walking for forty to fifty miles, Dean once again met a few giant rat-shaped monsters. The heat source was not very strong. It was only at the level of a limiter. However, the appearance of the giant rat, coupled with such strength, was a bit terrifying.
Dudian controlled the two undeads to bite and kill the giant rats and then continued to move forward.
As he went deeper and deeper, Dudian found that the topography of the Abyss region was very different. One moment it was a plain and the weeds were ten feet high. The next moment it was a dry desert. Moreover in the desert there would be a small area of swamps, it was like a rain pit. There were many strange creatures hidden inside. Dudian used his x-ray vision to see them and avoided them in advance.
“It seems that the number of monsters in the Abyss is not as dense as in the wasteland.”Dudian thought. He didn’t encounter many monsters and undeads but all of them were strong, few of them were lower than the level of pioneers. It was undoubtedly a dead world for the pioneers. As long as they encountered monsters, it would be a life and death battle.
Dudian didn’t encounter any master level monsters after walking for hundreds of miles. However, he didn’t dare to let down his guard. The giant wall didn’t record how long the Abyss region was, it was possible that the path he was taking now was just the border of the Abyss region.
“Most of the time when the lord of the giant wall returns to the giant wall from the Kingdom of God is once every ten years. I don’t know how far the journey will be…”Dudian thought. He suddenly thought of the journey to the west that he had read when he was a child, he bitterly laughed in his heart. He felt that he was like the monk Tang in the journey to the west. He would have to travel through mountains and rivers to get the scriptures. He didn’t know how many monsters he would meet on the way. Moreover, he wasn’t like the monk Tang, he was a relative. He had to send Sun Wukong to the beginning. He could only rely on himself and Aisha.
He looked at Aisha as he thought of her.
She was enough.
In the blink of an eye, they had entered the abyss for three days.
Dudian traveled day and night and only traveled during the day. However, he had traveled more than two hundred miles. As he went deeper, his original idea was gradually broken. He met more and more monsters along the way, there were huge corpses of monsters everywhere. Their skin and bones were still there but they were like rags.
“Eh?”Dudian stopped when he came to the foot of a gloomy mountain. His eyes fell on a huge claw print. It was about six to seven meters long and three meters wide, it was not difficult to imagine the owner of the claw print. Dudian had seen countless claw prints of this size but he couldn’t look away this time.
Because there was a person embedded in the claw mark.
A normal-sized person!
Since Dudian came to the abyss, he had never seen a normal human except for Aisha.
Even the undeads had mutated into extremely hideous appearance. It was hard to identify them as half human and half beast.
