The person in the claw mark was facing the ground and was pressed into the claw mark. It seemed that the monster had stepped on him. However, the monster didn’t seem to notice the person or it was too small. It was too lazy to pick him up and eat him, the man was lying on the ground.
Dudian used his X-ray vision to look at the man. He found that the man’s body hadn’t rotted and there was no smell of undeads. It was a “Living”human corpse!

chapters.title: Chapter 823
chapters.content:
Chapter 823 – Chapter 813: Survivor
Dudian was stunned for a long time before he reacted. He entered the Devil’s body state and slowly approached. He used his sharp limbs to dig out the corpse from the soil. He saw that it was a man, he had flaxen hair. He had a western face from the old era. He had a high nose and deep eye sockets. At the moment his face was pale. Most of his face was stained with blood from his nose and mouth. The blood was dry and hard. There was no external injury on his body, it seemed that he had been suffocated to death.
Dudian looked at the clothes on his body. The top of his body was a beast suit. There was a string of vertical bones hanging on his neck. There was an oval scale sewn on the chest of the beast suit. It seemed that it was used to defend against frontal attacks, he was holding a cone-shaped tusk. The handle was rough and sharp. There was a water bag and backpack on his back but it had been flattened.
Dudian’s heart wavered as he thought of the barbarians who had been banished to the radiation zone of the outer wall. Could it be that there was a group of ‘barbarians’who had been banished from the outer wall?
From the smell of the corpse, it shouldn’t have been more than two days since he died. Dudian used the sharp limbs to cut open the corpse. He checked the density of his bones. It wasn’t hard but it should be comparable to that of a senior hunter, in this abyss region, such strength was as small as a reptile. Any monster would become its food. However, such a small existence actually appeared here!
Dudian couldn’t imagine how he survived in this place. Of course, he couldn’t use the word ‘survive’to describe it. However, from the dirty degree of his body.., it wasn’t difficult to see that he had lived in the harsh wilderness for a long time. It was very likely that he was born here!
“There are people living in the abyss. Moreover, they are not abyss walkers but such a weak person. They must have a special method to live in the Abyss and know how to avoid the monsters.”Dudian thought, his heart was boiling. If he could find these people and learn from them how to survive in the Abyss then it would be helpful to increase his success rate in crossing the abyss.
His mind became active as he carefully checked the things on the corpse. He opened the backpack. There were some leaves and flowers inside but they were squashed, there was also a corpse of a worm wrapped in a cloth.
Dudian’s heart slightly moved as he thought of the worm. However, there was no smell of the worm powder.
He thought for a moment and put away the worm’s body. He put away his backpack and searched his body. He didn’t find anything that could avoid the monsters.
He thought for a moment and squatted down. He took the vertical bone necklace from his neck and dug a deep pit to bury his body.
He looked around and saw a lot of red dots between the flowers. They were about the length of a finger. They were poisonous insects in the jungle. Other than that, there was no other large-scale heat reaction.
“This person’s strength is low. He shouldn’t dare to move too far away from his residence. Most likely, he came out to look for food. A hunter’s pace shouldn’t be too fast. His residence should be around here.”Dudian thought, he held Aisha’s hand and controlled the two undeads to lead the way. He was ready to search within a hundred miles radius of the corpse.
He was very cautious. He was constantly checking the heat source reaction in his field of vision. It should be known that this person had died not long ago but was trampled to death by the giant footprint, it meant that the owner of the footprint was probably still wandering around.
Dudian followed the footprint forward. Along the way, he saw many traces of trees being trampled and some monsters being trampled to death. After seven or eight miles, Dudian finally saw the owner of the footprint. He looked at it from afar, it was like a 20-30 meter hill. It was crawling on the wilderness. Its body was dark and full of hair. It looked like a lump of fat meat. At the moment it seemed to be resting and sleeping.
Dudian didn’t dare to move forward. The heat source emitted by this thing was the most terrifying one he had seen so far. It was more than twice as strong as the rock scale python. It was estimated that it was at the peak of the master level.
Fortunately, this thing seemed to be sleeping. There was no movement.
Dudian didn’t dare to stay any longer. He controlled the two undeads to take a detour and leave from another place.
Dudian followed the mountain where the man’s body was buried. He searched the surroundings in a carpet-like manner. In addition to the monster that looked like a huge mountain of flesh, he also met two monsters of the same level as the rock scale pythons, however he avoided them and didn’t notice them. After all, he was too small compared to these monsters. Ordinary Monsters wouldn’t be interested in hunting him even if they noticed him.
It was the same reason why Lions wouldn’t catch ants and insects.
Moreover Dudian’s breath was restrained and the heat emitted from him was very low. Moreover he was covered in undead powder so he was able to disguise as an undeads. Therefore the three master level monsters didn’t take the initiative to chase him, he was far away from them.
On the contrary, some pioneer level or even lower level monsters directly chased after him and the two undeads he controlled.
Dudian didn’t show any mercy to these monsters that could be killed in an instant. He quickly killed them and moved to other places to avoid the smell of blood that would attract more monsters and cause unnecessary trouble.
On the third day, Dudian came to a lake.
The lake was blue and vast. Dudian was surprised to see such a pure water source. No wonder he followed the trail to this place. It was not strange that there were people living in such a pure water source.
He searched around the vicinity for the past three days. Although he didn’t meet the man’s companions but he found some footprints of their companions. The reason why he determined that these footprints belonged to their companions was because the shape of the footprints was similar, he remembered the shape of the man’s boots. These footprints were made by the same boots.
The number of footprints was messy. There were big and small footprints. It meant that there were more than one or two people. Dudian found at least eight people from the footprints.
“I should be able to meet them here to get water.”Dudian glanced at the lake and thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 824
chapters.content:
Chapter 824 – Chapter 804: Fishing
Dudian took Aisha and hid in the grass by the lake. He let the two undeads fall into the other grass.
In the blink of an eye, another day passed by.
In the wilderness, the days were meaningless. There was only the difference between day and night. At the end of the night, the monsters would come out of the nest. Dudian took out the empty water bag from his backpack. He quietly got up and went to the lakeside. He was going to scoop the water and save it for the night.
He squatted by the lakeside. He felt a chill in his heart. Soon, he found something strange. At this moment, the sunset was shining on the lake. The lake water was still blue. The color didn’t change much!
His face slightly changed. He took ten steps back and picked up the stones on the ground and threw them into the lake.
The stones fell into the lake and splashed up the waves. The next moment, Dudian saw that the entire blue lake was like a huge piece of skin. It suddenly wrinkled and in the blink of an eye rippled like boiling water, surprisingly, there were countless rhombus-shaped small fish jumping over the bottom of the lake. They jumped towards the place where the stone fell. Soon, the small blue fish found that the stones were not food and calmed down, then the rippling lake water also became calm. The entire lake became as blue as a mirror. Those small fish seemed to have disappeared in the blue.
Seeing such a change, Dudian’s heart was cold. His heat source vision didn’t realize that there were so many small fish in the lake. There was no heat source reaction on these small blue fish. They gathered together and stood still, they were like pure water. It was difficult to distinguish them. But if he had reached into the lake to scoop the water, he would have met these small fish. These small fish would jump up and attack him.
Dudian’s face changed. He slowly stepped back and returned to the grass. He put the water bag into his backpack. Although these small fish didn’t seem to have strong physiques but he didn’t want to provoke them. After all, some monsters had weak physiques, although their bodies were small but they were poisonous. For example, the poison arrow frog in the giant wall was enough to almost kill the master. Although he had a way to avoid these small fish but he didn’t know if the lake water was a normal source of water.
“I can only wait for the rain.”Dudian thought in his heart. At the same time he was a bit relieved. It had been a long time since he had taken action in the wilderness. He had been fighting for power in the giant wall so he had neglected his life outside the giant wall.
The sun gradually set and the insects began to chirp. Later in the night there was a loud roar in the distance. It seemed that a giant beast was approaching.
Dudian squatted in the grass and saw a giant figure with a strong heat source. It was almost ten meters tall and looked like a giant cow. It walked to the lakeside and stretched its head into the lake to drink water. The water was boiling in the place where it was drinking water, countless small blue fish were jumping but they were all swallowed by the monster.
After ten minutes of drinking, the monster was still gulping down water. It didn’t stop at all. At this time, Dudian suddenly saw an extremely deep blue strip on the lakeside, it seemed that the back of the monster was about seven or eight meters long. It was slowly swimming towards the monster. When it was more than fifty meters away from the monster, the dark blue shadow gradually sank into the water and disappeared.
Dudian tried to use heat source vision to observe but he found that the monster was also a cold-blooded creature without heat source reaction.
Whoosh!
In less than two seconds a splash of water shot out from the monster’s mouth. A dark blue strange fish jumped out from the water. Its belly was not a fin but a sharp claw, its body was as long as a fish. The spikes on its back were like gears. It suddenly pounced out and wrapped around the monster’s head like a blue ribbon.
The Monster Bull was strangled until it roared in anger. Its hooves stepped high on the lakeside, sending sand and stones flying into the lake. Its body quickly retreated to the back of the lake and shook its head violently.
Seeing that it was about to leave the lakeside, the dark blue monster fish immediately let go of its head and retreated into the water.
The monster bull retreated dozens of meters, still with lingering fear. It panted and growled in a low voice, as if it was unwilling to show its power. Then, it turned around and slowly walked away.
On the other hand, the body of the dark blue monster was swimming around the lake for a moment. It slowly swam towards the deep water in the middle of the lake. It gradually sank to the bottom of the lake. Everything returned to calm in the cold night, it seemed that nothing had happened.
Dudian was surprised. He didn’t expect that there was a monster in the lake. The monster’s heat source reaction was at the master level but it didn’t dare to tangle with the monster.
A few hours later, Dudian heard the roars of monsters coming from the distance. It seemed that there were several monsters fighting.
Dudian squinted his eyes as he looked around. He was used to the night scene in the wilderness. It was different from the night scene in the wall. The rich nightlife was just the beginning, there was only cold scenery and monsters.
It was daybreak.
Dudian was about to take a nap when he heard faint footsteps coming from the distance. He turned his head and saw two figures of heat sources, two human figures were walking from the bushes.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. They were outsiders!
The heat source of these two people wasn’t high. One of them was a senior hunter while the other was a primary limiter. Both of them were extremely cautious. They walked and stopped to observe the movement of the surroundings. From time to time they squatted down, they picked up the soil and sniffed.
Dudian held back the excitement in his heart and secretly observed.
After a moment, the two carefully groped to the blue lake. They looked up and looked around. After seeing that there was no strange phenomenon, the two seemed to be slightly relieved. They held the spear on their back and came to a shallow foot of the lake, they looked into the water and suddenly thrust the spear into the water. Puff! The spear plunged into the water and the bottom of the water suddenly began to roll violently.
The man quickly raised his head and saw a small blue fish stuck on the spear. It was struggling hard and its vitality was extremely tenacious.
Dudian was enlightened. It turned out that the two were here to kill the fish. Indeed, with such a physique, they could only kill the small blue fish as food. Although the small blue fish was strange, but it didn’t seem to have a high physique, moreover, it was a monster in the water. It could only wait for death after being picked by the two of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 825
chapters.content:
Chapter 825 – Chapter 815: Rescue
Blue light rippled on the surface of the lake. A large number of small blue fish gathered in front of their feet.
The two of them seemed to understand the habits of these small blue fish. They didn’t panic. They used their spears to stab the fish. The other one was behind them. They looked up at the surface of the lake from time to time, it seemed that they were afraid of something.
Dudian thought of the strange fish that he saw last night. He thought that if the strange fish swam over then the two of them would suffer.
He suddenly thought that this was a good opportunity to get to know them? If they were to suddenly appear then it would inevitably arouse their vigilance. But if they were to save their lives then it would undoubtedly be the fastest way to infiltrate the other party.
However, judging from the vigilant looks of these two people, they were already prepared. The chances of the strange fish attacking them were slim.
He quickly came up with an idea. He gently shook the bell beside Aisha’s ear. Aisha heard the sound and controlled the two zombies in the distance to get up from the bushes and swim toward the two people by the lake.
The two people by the lake moved quickly. In the blink of an eye, they had already stabbed more than a dozen fish and filled up their backpacks. Just as they were about to turn around and leave, they saw two ferocious zombies walking out of the woods. The two people were so scared that their faces turned pale, the man who was holding the spear quickly reacted. He took out a handful of powder from his backpack and patted it on his body. At the same time, he patted the powder on his companion who was in a daze. He pointed at the fish in his companion’s hand.
His companion was stunned for a moment. There was a trace of reluctance in his heart but he quickly put the fish on the ground. Then the two slowly moved to the side.
Dudian could smell the smell of undead powder. He couldn’t help but feel a trace of interest in his heart. They actually knew how to make undead powder to avoid the undeads. No wonder they could survive in the abyss.
However, he let Aisha control the two undeads and walked straight towards the two of them.
The two of them quietly moved to the other side as if they were thieves. The middle-aged man holding the spear was extremely nervous. He tightly held his companion’s hand so that his companion could calm down.
However, in the next moment, the two undeads did not even look at the fish bag on the ground and directly pounced on the two of them.
The middle-aged man was so scared that his pupils contracted. He said in shock, “Run!”After saying that, he turned around and ran.
However, their speed could not be compared to the two pioneer-level undeads. In the blink of an eye, they barked their fangs and brandished their claws as they approached from behind the two of them. Their hysterical and hoarse roars caused the two of them to have goosebumps and their scalps to go numb, their blood seemed to flow backward in their heads. Their Hearts were beating wildly. They felt that death was approaching.
However, the next moment, they saw a figure dressed in fierce armor suddenly jump out from the grass in front of them. He was holding a large black knife and rushing straight towards them.
The two were stunned. It seemed that they didn’t expect to see other humans here. Their minds couldn’t work for a moment. The next moment, Dudian passed by them. He brandished his sword to meet the two undeads behind them. He didn’t directly kill them but deliberately fell into guerrilla warfare. At the same time, he kept the upper hand so that he wouldn’t be at a disadvantage, the two undeads were scared away. After all, it was normal for them to not rescue Dudian in the wilderness.
Both of them turned their head and saw Dudian fighting with the two undeads. Their fear was slightly stabilized. Soon, they saw that the victory was leaning towards Dudian, dudian’s performance was smooth but occasionally there was a bit of danger. After two minutes of fighting Dudian drilled a gap and killed one of the undeads. He cut off the head of one of the undeads.
After killing one undeads the other one was killed by Dudian’s blade.
Dudian let out a breath. His head was full of sweat. He turned around and came in front of the two. He wiped the blood off the blade and put it away.
The two saw that Dudian didn’t mean any harm. They were relieved. The middle-aged man covered his chest and said: “Thank you for your help. My name is priory. May I know your name?” He looked at Dudian with respect and curiosity. There was a bit of envy in his eyes.
Dudian was surprised to hear his language. It was English but he was also relieved. If it was another language then communication would be very troublesome. He quietly observed the two, he didn’t see any repulsion or vigilance from their expressions. It meant that his plan was half successful. He spoke in English: “My Name Is Dudian. It is safe here. I killed them.”
He didn’t directly ask about the identity of the two. He casually repeated the previous events to add to their impression.
Priory looked at Dudian’s feet as he heard Dudian’s words. There was gratitude in his eyes: “Thank you for your help. If it wasn’t for you we would have died.”
“It’s nothing.”Dudian said.
At this time, the light shone from behind Dudian’s back. Priory’s face slightly changed as if he was awakened, he looked at dudian: “Mr. Dudian, the White Night is coming. It is very dangerous here. Would you like to come back to the ‘camp’with us? I want to thank you for saving my life.”
“Me too.”There were a few crooked scars on the face of his companion.
Dudian was surprised. wasn’t it safer to come in the day? How could it be dangerous? He nodded: “Alright, Please Wait for me. I have a friend. I will ask her to come with me.”
Priory was stunned for a moment. There was a trace of hesitation in his eyes.
At this time, Dudian had turned around and walked to the bushes. He took Aisha and said to the two: “Let’s go.”
Priory looked at Aisha. Although Aisha was wearing a veil, but he could still see the perfect outline of her face. Moreover, her fair skin and beautiful body.., they didn’t fit in with the surrounding environment.
“Good, good.”Prieret nodded. He swallowed a mouthful of saliva and said to his companion: “Go and take the fish.”He took out a bag from his backpack, he picked up the two undeads’heads and put them into the bag. He handed it to Dudian: “These are your spoils of war.”
Dudian said: “I’ll give them to you.”
Prieret was startled as he didn’t expect that Dudian would give him such a precious thing. He stared at dudian: “Give Them to me? Really?”
“Really.”
Prieret couldn’t help but be excited. He held the two heads in his arms and thanked Dudian repeatedly.
His companion came over with a fish bag. He looked at dudian with envy: “Old Ray, this thing can be your family heirloom.”
Priory laughed out loud, but he seemed to have thought of something. He stopped laughing and looked around guiltily. Seeing that nothing had happened, he heaved a sigh of relief and said, “Let’s talk about it when we get back.”

chapters.title: Chapter 826
chapters.content:
Chapter 826 – Chapter 816: The Great God
Dudian held Aisha’s hand and followed the two of them back.
After seven or eight miles they came to the canyon where the two mountains were separated. Dudian had been to this place when he went to the lake. He had seen the footprints of the residents of the abyss, however he didn’t find any signs of habitation. At this moment he saw Priory stopped in front of the canyon as if he was looking at something. After a moment he came to a rock and gently tapped the handle of the spear in his hand.
Dudian was surprised to see his action. His eyes flashed as he looked at the rock. The rock was extremely thick. It was about three meters in diameter. There was a deep tunnel behind the rock.
Rumble!
After Priory knocked six times, the rock suddenly began to roll slowly, revealing a gap.
Priory signaled to Dudian and took the lead to enter.
Dudian pulled Aisha through the gap in the rock. As soon as they stepped into the tunnel, he saw two burly men with strange paint on their bodies standing behind the rock. He was shocked, he didn’t see them when he used the perspective to observe them.
The two men were stunned when they saw Dudian and Aisha behind pulley. After a few seconds they reacted. They took out their weapons from the wall and cautiously pointed at Dudian.
Priory quickly said: “He is the Savior of me and Polk. There is no malice.”
The two giants looked at him and looked at Dudian and Aisha for a moment. Their eyes lingered on Aisha for a while but they quickly retracted their eyes, one of the Giants with a bird tattoo scolded: “You two are stupid. You brought back outsiders without permission. Do you want to bring destruction to the ‘camp’? !”
Priory smiled: “How can that be? He doesn’t mean any harm.”
The Man with the bird tattoo coldly looked at dudian: “I hope you will leave as you owe them a favor!”
Dudian didn’t think that he would be stopped here. Things had come to this point so he naturally couldn’t back down, he was unhappy: “Is this how you treat your benefactor?”? The White Night is coming and the outside is so dangerous. You Want Me to leave? Isn’t it the same as killing me with your own hands?” Although he didn’t know what kind of danger the white night would bring but it was obvious that there was a strong character who wanted to come out.
The giant bird tattoo was startled as he heard Dudian speak their spoken language. He looked at Dudian in surprise but soon he frowned, he shouted: “I don’t care where you came from. We didn’t kill you. We have treated you well. You have saved them. Priory, give him the fish you have hunted. I will return the favor. Outsider, you should leave quickly or don’t blame me for being rude!”
Dudian slightly bowed his head. There was a trace of murderous intent in his eyes but it quickly disappeared, he turned to priory: “I’m leaving. I hope you can live well. The area by the lake is dangerous. You shouldn’t go there to fish in the future.”
Priory’s heart was burning when he heard Dudian’s words, he couldn’t help but turn to the giant with the bird tattoo: “They are our saviors. We have always been grateful to them. Now White Night has come. If you ask him to leave, it is the same as sending him to his death. I will report to the Great God and let her decide!”
The Giant’s face turned gloomy: “Even if you do, the High Priest won’t agree to let him in.”
“I will try!”Pried said resolutely.
The giant frowned and was silent for a moment, he looked at dudian: “You stay here. Pried, think carefully. If you disturb the high priest, you will be punished. I will give you fifteen minutes. If you don’t reply, I will immediately expel them!”
Priory nodded and looked at dudian: “Mr Dean, Wait for me here. I will be back soon!”He looked at dudian and ran into the tunnel.
Dudian looked at Priory’s back as he left. His eyes quickly entered the magic pupil state. His vision quickly extended. He saw that the sand and stones in the dark tunnel were clearly visible. It extended all the way to the underground, priory’s figure ran away without a trace. There was no heat source reaction at the end of the tunnel. He didn’t look at it and quietly withdrew his eyes.
“Mr. Dean, I will accompany you.”Priory’s companion said.
Dudian nodded to him: “Thank you.”
Ten minutes passed in the blink of an eye. Dudian silently calculated the time. There were three minutes left until the end of the tunnel. He saw Priory’s figure appear at the end of the tunnel. He was panting as he ran over. It seemed that he was very happy.
Dudian was relieved to see his expression.
“The Great God has told me to take them to see her.”Priory ran over. He raised a piece of cloth with the word ‘God’embroidered on it.
The giant with the bird tattoo and the other one with the lion head tattoo saw the cloth. Their faces slightly changed. They raised their hands to cover their chest and knelt down: “We obey the god’s order.”
Dudian looked at the cloth but didn’t say anything. He nodded to the two giants and turned to follow pulley into the depths of the tunnel.
“What is a great god?”Dudian asked Pulley.
Pulley’s face showed a pious expression: “A great god is a great god. He is the greatest person here. We obey the instructions of the great god so that we can survive in this sinful land.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. It seemed that the great god was their leader. However, it was clear that there weren’t many survivors, if it was a survivor tribe with more than 100,000 people then the leader wouldn’t be seen in ten minutes. There wouldn’t be more than 3,000 people or even less.
Dudian was a bit relieved after he made a guess about the situation. However he wasn’t able to see the two desolate generals with his X-ray vision. He didn’t know the reason why.
At this time, he and Priore walked along the tunnel for thousands of meters. Their vision gradually widened. Dudian saw a large number of heat source reactions. However these heat source reactions were extremely weak, generally, the heat source reactions of hunters were lower than those of hunters. It was almost impossible to see them. However, the heat source reactions of hunters were also very rare.

chapters.title: Chapter 827
chapters.content:
Chapter 827 – : Chapter 817: Aragami
Soon, an underground village appeared in front of Dudian. Each of the houses was built with rocks. They were simple and crude. The gaps were filled with weeds, there were a few barefoot children running on the path. Most of their hair color was flaxen and brown. There were big lamps on the walls of the village, it was like the halo of a light bulb.
Dudian was surprised. He didn’t expect that there would be humans living underground. The strangest thing was that compared to the rough houses on the ground, the lights on the top of their heads were electric, it wasn’t special crystals or firefly pebbles.
“Uncle Priory!”A few children who were playing saw priory coming out of the tunnel. They immediately gathered up and said: “Uncle Priory, did you catch any fish today? Can you take me outside next time?”
“Uncle Priory, who are these brothers and sisters? They are wearing strange clothes!”
“Wow, are these weapons made of divine iron?”
Priory smiled and said in a friendly manner: “These brothers and sisters are from outside. I will take them to see the great god. I will tell you when I come back. You guys go and play.”
“People from outside?”
“Wow! People from outside? !”
The eyes of the children lit up when they heard his words. They curiously looked at Dean and Aisha.
Priory pushed the children away and led Dean forward. Along the way they passed by a few rough houses made of rocks. Some of the houses had dried meat hanging in front of them. Some of them walked out and saw priory, they would greet him with a smile. Some would ask him how his harvest was today. However, they were soon attracted by Dudian and Aisha. When they asked, Priory told them the truth. Many people looked at him.
Some people were curious. Some people lost their smile. They looked at Dudian and Aisha in fear. They leaned against the door as if they were ready to hide back in the houses.
Dean’s heart sank when he saw the mixed expressions of these people. He thought of the words of the desolate general who was stationed outside the tunnel. He guessed that they had met outsiders and something extremely bad had happened here, that was why they reacted like this. However, judging from the behavior of these children and Priore, this kind of thing was most likely a long time ago.
Time would wear away the memories of some people. Even the next generation would forget the hatred of their homeland.
This was the tragedy of human nature. But at the moment, Dudian was lucky. At least from the innocent and curious expressions of the children, it could be seen that they were not afraid of the Outsiders, it was very likely that they did not understand the terrible things that happened to the outsiders.
Dudian roughly noticed that there were about 200 people. It didn’t take long for them to arrive at the center of the village. There was an open mini square of about 200 square meters, dudian was completely stunned when he saw the things in front of the square. His face was filled with disbelief.
He saw a steep ramp that extended from the air to the ground. The ladder was made of all metal. It was dark silver in color. It was extremely introverted and high-end. The top of the ladder was connected to an oval metal ball that was suspended in the air. It looked like a coconut, it could accommodate hundreds of people.
Dudian slowly looked up and found that the oval metal ball was not completely hanging in the air. There were several thick black iron pillars connected to the top of the stone wall.
Priory saw Dudian’s stunned look and smiled, “Mr. Dudian, the great priest is waiting for you. Please follow me. Don’t be too casual when you meet the great priest. She is the greatest person in the world!”
Dudian nodded as he turned around to lead the way. He couldn’t help but use his power to see through his eyes. However he found that the oval metal ball was dark red and he couldn’t see through it, what surprised him was that the scene that he saw was the same as when he looked through Sylvia’s coffin.
The metal ellipsoid seemed to be made of the same material as Sylvia’s coffin!
There were two huge men with strange tattoos standing guard in front of the stairs. Dudian knew that they were desolate generals so he looked at them, his eyes were attracted by a tall statue which was ignored by the square. The statue was more than ten meters tall. Its upper body was human but its lower body was like a ferocious spider.
The half human and half beast body made him think of Sylvia again. Moreover this person was also a woman. Her beauty was suffocating. Dudian thought that she was the most perfect face in the world when he saw her, but when he saw this woman he felt that the two were on par. The beauty of this woman was another kind of temperament. There was a bit of heroic spirit and other kind of charm.
“This is our great Aragami.”Priory turned around and looked at Dudian, he smiled at dudian: “Aragami has sheltered us for hundreds of years. It is reasonable to bow to the Aragami. But you are an outsider. It is not too late to bow to the Aragami after you have seen the great god.”
Dudian retracted his eyes but his heart was in turmoil. There was a statue of the god of war in this small village. From the statue, it seemed that the god of war was half human and half beast. But.., why was the god of war in the wilderness of the Abyss while Sylvia was in the giant wall? Could it be that the people here used to live in the giant wall but later migrated out?
He felt that there were many secrets inside. He retracted his eyes, nodded and continued to move forward.
“Stop.”The two desolate generals by the stairs stopped priore.
One of them coldly said: “Outsiders are not allowed to bring weapons when they meet the god.”
Puley turned to dudian: “Mr Dean, this is the rule. Don’t worry…”
Dudian nodded: “Nothing, I don’t mean any harm.”He took off the cleaver and put it on the ground. Then he took off the blood baron from Aisha’s back and put it together, he went back to the two generals: “I don’t like people touching my weapon. I hope you can help me take care of it.”
The two generals nodded: “Please.”
Dudian and priory walked up the stairs.
Priory stopped in front of the oval metal ball. He bowed to the cabin door: “Master, my benefactor Mr. Dean and Miss Haisha have arrived.”

chapters.title: Chapter 828
chapters.content:
Chapter 828 – Chapter 818: Goddess [ First Update ]
Whoosh!
The metal cabin door slowly rose and a faint fragrance of a woman’s body floated out from it.
Dudian’s heart slightly moved. He was more and more convinced that there was electricity in this place. However, the rough stone house outside didn’t seem to match the technology level of electricity. He glanced inside the cabin, he saw that the red carpet covered the entire corridor. The inside was very spacious. The wall emitted a hole-shaped light which illuminated the magnificent interior.
Priory’s face was full of piety. He lowered his head and took off his shoes.
Dudian didn’t wait for Priory’s instructions. He took off his boots and walked in barefoot. He felt that his feet were very warm and soft.
There was a huge oval room inside. After passing through the corner of the cabin door, Dudian saw that there were several steps at the other end of the room. There was a curtain behind the steps. There was a shadow sitting inside, there was a beautiful girl standing in front of the curtain. She was about fourteen or fifteen years old. Her golden eyes were charming and her skin was white and tender. There was a world of difference between her and the children and residents outside the house.
“Priory pays respect to the goddess and the Great God!”Priory bowed as if he was on a pilgrimage. He knelt down on one knee.
Dudian didn’t bow with him but quietly stood there. He looked at the girl and the figure sitting behind the curtain. The thin silk curtain couldn’t block his line of sight, there was an old woman wearing a luxurious robe. Her face was kind and her hair was white. She had a western face which was somewhat similar to the girl.
Dudian suddenly thought that most of the residents he saw along the way seemed to be human faces from the old era. He rarely saw Asian faces which might have something to do with the region he was in.
The girl named ‘Goddess’looked at Dudian curiously. Her big golden eyes blinked. She frowned: “Are you two outsiders?”
Dudian nodded: “Greetings Goddess and priest. My name is dudian. This is my… lover, Aisha.”He paused for a moment as he introduced Aisha’s identity, it seemed that he was a bit unfamiliar with her. However, he didn’t have her consent to say that she was his wife’s lover. Although he was aware of her feelings but he hadn’t confessed to her when she was alive, he hadn’t gotten her consent. But after so long he had treated her as his other half. Even if she didn’t agree he wouldn’t allow her to object because he couldn’t bear to lose her again.
The girl saw a trace of hesitation in Dudian’s eyes. She felt a bit strange: “I Heard That You Saved Priory?”
“I just happened to pass by.”Dudian didn’t dare to take credit.
The girl nodded slightly and slowly went forward. She came to less than half a meter in front of Dudian. She looked up at dudian. Her pure eyes looked straight into Dudian’s eyes, it seemed that she wanted to see all the secrets and shadows in Dudian’s heart. However, Dudian had climbed all the way to the position of the wall master. His mind was already deep. He also looked down at him. His eyes were pure and there was no trace of distracting thoughts.
Both of them looked at each other for a moment. The girl’s face suddenly turned red. She looked at Aisha and frowned, “This sister doesn’t seem to have a Heartbeat?”
Dudian’s heart trembled. However, he had already expected that Aisha would be seen through. He immediately said, “She has a strange disease. Goddess shouldn’t be too close to her. Tell me if there is anything.”
The girl slightly pouted and turned back to the front of the curtain: “Where Are you from?”
“From a God’s wall.”Dudian replied truthfully.
The girl was startled. She didn’t know if it was because she didn’t expect Dudian to be so Frank or because it was the first time she heard of a place like the God’s wall. She quickly reacted and turned to look at the curtain.
The old woman heard Dudian’s words. She was silent for a moment before she nodded to the girl.
The girl understood and said to Prier who was still kneeling on the ground: “You go first. The priest wants to talk to Mr. Dudian.”
Prier respectfully said: “Yes, Prier will take his leave.”She bowed her head and slowly left. Before she left she gave Dudian a look of encouragement.
After Prier left, the girl knocked on the metal wall. The cabin door slowly fell down and closed. Dudian and the girls were the only ones left inside.
Dudian was alert but calm on the surface. At this time, the girl took the lead to speak to Dudian as if she had changed into a different person, she coldly said: “What is your purpose in coming here? If I’m not wrong, the ‘lover’by your side is a corpse of a puppet!”
Dudian’s eyes were cold, “I can say that but don’t talk about her. I told you that she has a strange disease. I came here because I was passing by. I didn’t think that I would meet you here. I didn’t know that there were people who could survive in this area. If I had a purpose, I would have made a move against you. In my opinion, you are the leaders here, right?”
The girl sneered: “Do you want to do it? If you do, will you be able to walk out of here alive?”
Dudian’s heart moved. He had said it on purpose. But from the looks of the girl, there seemed to be some kind of mechanism in the metal cabin of the spaceship? He didn’t plan to use tough means to conquer this place and dig out the secrets of this place. He looked angry, “Is this how you treat your benefactor? If you suspect me, why do you need to see me?”
The coldness in the girl’s eyes slowly disappeared as she saw the anger in Dudian’s eyes. She turned to look at the old woman in the curtain.
The old woman nodded to her and took out a bracelet from her sleeve.
The girl understood and took the bracelet from the curtain, she turned to dudian: “I took the liberty before. We were attacked by outsiders like you and almost destroyed. So we were worried that you would come here with other intentions. It seems that you have no intention to come here. The next priest has something to ask you. Please put on the wristband.”
Dudian looked at the pure white metal bracelet in her hand. He deliberately put on a gloomy face: “What is this?”
“This is the god’s ring. It contains the power of the Aragami. It can see through all lies. If you have no intention to come here then please put on the God’s ring. If you are not willing then please leave.”The girl said in a serious tone.
Dudian frowned. It was impossible for him to leave. Moreover she had said it. If he didn’t put on the God’s ring then he would feel guilty. It was the same as acquiescing that he had other intentions, at that time he might not be able to leave safely. It was very likely that the next moment they would activate the mechanism in the metal cabin. He was most worried about the laser.
There was a trace of regret in his heart as he thought of this. He shouldn’t have boarded the pirate ship. However, he had no choice but to go.
He felt that he could at least kill the girl and the priest when the mechanism was activated or capture them alive!
Moreover, the girl had to manually control the cabin door. Even if there was an attack mechanism, they would be needed to activate it.
After thinking for a moment, Dudian agreed. Although the other party’s attitude was very tough, even overbearing, but he had to yield. Who asked him to come here with other purposes?
“Wear this hand.”Dudian stretched out his right arm which was corroded by ice. In this way, even if the bracelet would release electric current, or even some attacks, he felt that his right hand could withstand it, at the same time, there was a bell in the pocket of his left hand. He could also use his left hand to instantly take out the bell so that Aisha could attack and capture them.

chapters.title: Chapter 829
chapters.content:
Chapter 829 – Chapter 819: Trust [ Second Watch ]
The girl looked at Dudian but didn’t say anything. When Dudian raised his right hand she was ready to put a wristband on Dudian’s wrist. At this time Dudian’s hand suddenly turned into a claw and quickly grabbed her wrist, at the same time his other hand grabbed her neck. All of this was done in an instant. In the blink of an eye the girl was subdued by Dudian and became a hostage.
“You!”The girl’s face turned pale.
The old woman’s face changed as she put her hand on the next step.
“I have no malicious intent.”Dudian quickly opened his mouth. He let go of the girl and calmly looked at her, “I just want to tell you that if I was a bad person, I would have the opportunity to capture you and use you as a hostage to leave this place.”
Dudian let go of the girl. She rubbed her neck and coughed twice. She took a few steps back and looked at dudian: “You Sneak Attack!”
Dudian didn’t speak but looked at the old woman: “I hope that my kindness will be reciprocated by your kindness.”
The old woman saw that Dudian let go of the girl. Her body relaxed but her eyes were much more serious.
The girl turned to look at the curtain. The old woman nodded to her.
The girl understood and turned to glare at Dudian: “We won’t hurt you. This ring is only effective on evil people. If you have good intentions then nothing will happen to you.”
Dudian didn’t say anything but handed her the ring.
The girl was alert this time. She quickly put the ring on Dudian’s wrist and quickly returned to the front of the curtain.
Dudian looked at the ring on his wrist. The material was very light. There was a screen with wavy lines on it. There were a few English letters next to it. The shape combined with the words of the girl.., it made him think of the lie detector that he had seen in the super chip.
“You came to us. Do you really have no malice?”The girl angrily asked Dudian. Apparently she was still concerned about being captured by Dudian.
Dudian looked up at her cute little face: “Of course not. I have already expressed my position. Can’t there be some basic trust between people?”
“Well, it’s useless to say less.”The girl slightly pouted: “Was it by chance that you saved Priory?”
“Of course!”Dudian replied without thinking.
The girl raised her eyebrows: “Then why did you come here from your hometown?”
Dudian frowned: “This is my private matter.”
The girl snorted: “How would I know what secret you have if you don’t tell me? What if you deliberately came to us?”
Dudian sighed, “Since you don’t trust me, I will tell you. I want to see the world outside the wall. As you can see, my lover has a strange disease. There is no way to treat her in the wall. I want to see if there are other people living in the outside world and if there is a way to treat her.”
The girl looked at him as if she believed him. The dissatisfaction on her face gradually disappeared, she whispered: “We have no way to treat this sister. She is suffering from a very terrible evil poison. Usually people who suffer from this kind of evil poison would attack their closest friends. I don’t know why she didn’t attack you.”
“I know that her disease is contagious. So I told you not to get too close to her.”Dudian sadly said.
The girl slightly raised her head: “I have long seen that her body condition is not right. I Won’t let her bite me.”
Dudian lowered his head and didn’t speak.
The atmosphere was a bit sad.
The girl reacted and coughed in embarrassment: “I will take off the ring for you.”
Dudian looked at her: “Do you want to believe me?”
The girl blushed as she looked at Dudian’s bright and pure eyes: “I have to listen to the god.”She took off the ring for Dudian and looked at the screen, her expression relaxed as she turned back to the curtain.
Dudian believed that the ring was a kind of lie detector.
The old woman took the god’s ring and looked at it for a moment. Her attitude became much gentler, “Young man, thank you for saving our clansmen. Please forgive us for the previous offense.”Her voice was very sweet. She didn’t sound like a white haired old woman.
Dudian was more convinced that the god’s ring was an instrument to test whether he was speaking the truth or not. It seemed that he had passed the test.
“I heard that you have met outsiders before and were attacked by outsiders. It is inevitable that you would be hostile towards me. I understand.”Dudian said in a generous manner.
The girl smiled: “Is It? Weren’t you nervous just now?”
Dudian was speechless.
“One hundred and thirty years ago, we met outsiders like you.”The old woman slowly opened her mouth. Her sweet voice was refreshing, “At that time, we were very happy when we first met the outsider. We took him in and treated him well. Unexpectedly, the outsider had ulterior motives. After finding out the details of our place, he was ready to enslave us and make us his servants. Fortunately, the power of the Great God was not bad at that time so he was killed. However, the great god was also seriously injured. This matter has left a deep lesson for us. That’s why we have offended you.”
Dudian nodded slightly. He didn’t need her to say that he could guess the plot. But the old woman’s words might not be true. Most of the people who came here were abyss walkers or even stronger, if they were in the giant wall then they would be the master of the giant wall. If they were in the Kingdom of God then most of them would be high level personnel. They would know many secrets.
As for the purpose of attacking them, it might not be to enslave them. After all, there were not many people here. There were tens of millions of people in the giant wall?
Dudian felt that the outsider was aiming at the corpses of the god of war.
The old woman was a great god. Although he couldn’t see her strength but so far she didn’t have the strength of the Abyss level, this meant that the great god priest at that time might not have had the strength to fight with that outsider. It was very likely that he had used other things to kill him, such as the spaceship-like metal cabin he was in now, or some other trump card.

chapters.title: Chapter 830
chapters.content:
Chapter 830 – Chapter 820: Utilization
“I will leave after the white night has passed so as not to disturb you.”Dudian said to both of them.
The priest whispered: “Mr Dean, if you don’t mind I would like to invite you to stay with us for a few more days. I believe that there are good and bad people everywhere. You have saved priory so we believe in your kindness.”
“As you can see, there are wild beasts and dead bodies everywhere. If it wasn’t for the outsider from more than a hundred years ago, we wouldn’t even know that there are other human survivors in this world. If the outsider didn’t show his fangs then the goddess of that generation would have married him and become husband and wife. We and you outsiders would be united because of this. But I didn’t expect that such a thing would happen later on.”
“Marriage?”Dudian looked at the girl in front of the curtain.
The girl’s face turned red as she stared at dudian: “Why are you looking at me?”
Dudian looked away: “If you don’t mind then I will be happy to stay here for a few more days. Let me know if there is anything I can help you with.”
“Thank You Mr. Dean. Amelia, let the general arrange a residence for Mr. Dean. He is our honored guest.”The priest whispered.
The girl slightly pouted and nodded.
After sending Dudian out of the metal cabin, Amelia ordered the two desolate generals to take Dudian to rest.
The girl went back into the metal cabin and gently knocked on the wall. The cabin door slowly closed. It became extremely quiet in an instant.
Amelia looked at the priest behind the curtain: “Sister, why did you let him stay? The ring clearly shows that he lied. This person must have other motives!”
The curtain was lifted, and the old woman looked at her gently, she said softly, “Although he lied, from the divine ring, it seems that he only lied about saving priory. But he came here without knowing anything, which means that he didn’t come here on purpose. As for why he deliberately saved priory to get close to us, I think it should be what he said earlier, thinking that he could find a way to save his lover from us.”
“Sister, do you really believe that the corpse is his lover?”Amelia pouted.
The old woman smiled faintly, “Haven’t you noticed? This person’s expression has always been incomparably cold and unfeeling. However, when he looks at the corpse beside him, his eyes will reveal a special gentleness. That kind of gentleness is rare even for a loving couple. Moreover, the results on the divine ring indicate that he did not lie on this point. Therefore, I believe that what he said is true.”
“But even so, he is an outsider after all. If we let him stay, wouldn’t it be very dangerous if he had any evil intentions?”Amelia was still somewhat unwilling, she said, “Priolet also said that this person could easily kill two corpses. You have seen the heads of those two corpses. They are both desolate general level corpses, yet he could easily kill them. If such a dangerous figure were to attack our clansmen, it would cause unimaginable casualties. And if we want to deal with him, we would have to pay a huge price. It would be best if we let him leave. Nothing would happen.”
The old woman sighed, she said, “Why would I be willing to take such a risk?”? However, the desolate divine hall did not have much energy left. It could only supply us for about ten years. In ten years, we would be in complete darkness. We would no longer be able to rely on the desolate divine hall to fend off the abyssal desolate beasts outside. The only way would be to find a new shelter as soon as possible. This person came at the right time. I have been studying the information left behind by the outsider. The area we live in is called the abyssal region by the Outsiders. Very few people can enter because the desolate beasts here are too powerful.”
“But outside the area where they live, the desolate beasts are very weak. And they live in the divine wall. With the protection of the divine wall, they are never afraid of being attacked by the desolate beasts. Being able to grow rice inside is a permanent shelter. We have to find a divine wall before the desolate divine hall’s energy runs out. Otherwise, the future in ten years will be unimaginable…”
Amelia was stunned for a moment, and her little face was a little gloomy, she said, “Sister, the thing you said last time about developing a new energy substitute, is that not possible? “If we leave this place and migrate to the divine wall, wouldn’t it be too risky? The outsider from over a hundred years ago and this person are both so powerful. How many more powerful people like them are there in the divine wall? “If we migrate there, who knows how many people will die if a war breaks out?”
The old woman was silent, after a moment, she said, “The law of the jungle is the law of the world. With the power of the Wilderness Divine Hall, we might have a chance to fight. However, if we continue to wait, we will only get weaker and weaker until we are completely wiped out.”
Amelia looked at her. Her eyes were slightly red and moist. Her small mouth was tightly pursed.
The old woman looked at her and gently touched her head, she said, “Don’t worry. We still have ten years. We can first get the coordinates of the divine wall from this person. Then, we will send people to investigate the situation there. If it is suitable, we will migrate there. If it is not, we can also migrate to other places. Living here is too tough…”
“Sister, shall I try him again?”Asked Amelia earnestly.
The old woman glanced at her and nodded slightly.
..
..
Dudian pricked up his ears as he left the small square to listen to the God’s cabin. He found that he couldn’t hear anything. When the cabin door fell down, it was as if it was completely isolated, he glanced at the giant statue in the square. He thought that there should be a god’s corpse of the god of war here.
Each god’s corpse was the core of the giant wall. It was no less important than the imperial seal of a country in the old era.
On the contrary, a new giant wall could be built with the god’s corpse.
Although the giant wall wasn’t as strong as the mysterious giant wall but it should be able to resist ordinary monsters.
However, he wasn’t interested in the god’s corpse but the whole place. Especially the place where the great God lived. There should be a lot of offensive weapons hidden there. If it fell into his hands.., he could use it to kill Aristotle!
“If the God’s ring is a lie detector, they shouldn’t be able to see that I have guessed the effect of the god’s ring. They should believe the result of the God’s ring. From their performance, they should believe it.”Dudian pondered, how should he build a good relationship with them and get more useful information? For example, why didn’t they live in the giant wall but in the abyss.
This mystery might be related to three hundred years ago. It might also be related to the origin of the giant wall and things that he didn’t know.

chapters.title: Chapter 831
chapters.content:
Chapter 831 – Chapter 821: Desolate Worm
“Look, it’s an outsider.”
“Mom, are they from the outside world?”
“That sister is so beautiful!”
“Stay away from them. Be careful not to be attacked.”
A desolate general brought Dudian to the village. Along the way, many residents heard the news and came to watch. They stood in the distance and whispered. They were both curious and excited, but also afraid of fear. Some of the elders directly frowned, there was disgust and hostility on their faces.
“Please.”The desolate general led the way for Dudian.
The other residents followed behind them. They came to a spacious and rough house, the desolate general said to dudian: “You can stay here for the time being. I will ask someone to send you some living equipment. If you need anything else, just let me know.”
Dudian glanced at the house and nodded: “Thank you.”
“You are welcome. If there is nothing else, I will go back first.”The general said goodbye to Dudian and left.
After the general left, Dudian led Aisha into the house. The inside of the house was almost as rough as the outside. There was a mat made of weeds on the floor. Next to it was a stone platform. It seemed to be a table, there was nothing else.
Dudian felt sorry for the shabby appearance. It had been more than 300 years. Even if there was a gap in civilization, at least they could rely on creation to restore a simple civilization. After all, the greatest talent of human beings was creation, however, the environment of the primitive barbarians was maintained here. He was a bit disappointed.
He took out a towel from his backpack and placed it on the mat, letting Aisha sit on it to rest. He sat on the grass mat and quietly listened to the whispers of the residents gathered outside. After listening for a moment, he found that.., the older people were often very hostile and vigilant toward him. The young people and children were ignorant and just curious.
“It seems that they have forgotten about it for more than a hundred years. Only the older people know about it.”Dudian thought.
The residents gathered outside the house for a few hours and gradually dispersed.
Dudian stayed in the house and didn’t do anything. He lay on the mat and quietly listened to the movements around him. He felt that the priest would send people to monitor him. He would even use some technology to monitor him. After all.., the scientific and technological components of the place where she lived were not inferior to the scientific and technological standards of the old era. From the environment here, it was obvious that they were not the ones who created it. They were just users.
“Little Mouse, little mouse…”suddenly, a tender voice interrupted Dudian’s thoughts.
Dudian couldn’t help but sit up from the mat. He looked at the little head that was peeking out from the door. It was a seven or eight year old girl. Her face was very cute. The little girl saw Dudian. She slowly walked out of the door and asked: “Big Brother, have you seen the little mouse?”
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “No.”
The little girl replied with an “OH”. She was a bit depressed and turned away.
Dudian’s heart suddenly moved: “I can help you find out what your little mouse looks like.”
“Really?”The little girl turned her head and began to draw: “It is like this. It is very small. It is very timid. It is furry and gray. Its head is very small…”
Her description was a bit confusing but Dudian understood that it was a small pet about the size of a cat.
His eyes lit up. He turned his head and looked around. Soon he found something similar in size and shape. He smiled and got up: “I know where it is. I will take you to find it.”
“Really, Big Brother?”The little girl was very surprised.
Dudian took her hand and went to another corner of the stone house behind the house. He reached into the corner and quickly grabbed a small gray furry thing. It looked like a mouse, but it was fatter than a mouse. Its ears were longer and it looked like a rabbit. It looked cute.
“Ah, it’s a little mouse.”The little girl happily stretched out her hand and hugged it.
Dudian smiled and touched her little head.
“Little Jasmine, Little Jasmine!”Suddenly, an anxious voice came from the side. Dudian turned his head and saw a middle-aged man running out in a hurry. The middle-aged man passed by the corner and saw Dudian, his eyes opened wide as he said in anger: “You, you let go!”
Dudian slightly frowned and put his hand down from the little girl’s head.
The little girl saw the middle-aged man and happily ran over: “Dad.”
“Little Jasmine, Are You Alright?”The middle-aged man squatted down to check the little girl’s hair and body. He saw that there was no wound and was relieved. He turned his head and stared at Dudian, “Foreigner, I warn you that you are not allowed to get close to our children.”
The faint smile in Dudian’s eyes gradually disappeared. He quietly stood up and looked at the middle-aged man.
The little girl pulled the middle-aged man’s clothes and looked up: “Dad, is he the foreigner? He is not as fierce as you said. He helped me find the little dormouse.”
The middle-aged man was startled. He looked at the cute little beast in her arms. He frowned but didn’t say anything. He picked up the little girl and hurried away, soon she disappeared from Dudian’s sight.
Dudian narrowed his eyes and slowly walked back to his house.
Soon, an acquaintance appeared at the door of the house. It was Prieret and his companion who Dudian had saved. Both of them were holding two stone plates. There were a few grilled fish inside.
Dudian smelled the faint smell of fish. He sat up and said to the two: “Why are you here?”
“Mr. Dudian, I heard that you haven’t eaten lunch. I specially sent you two some small fish. I don’t know if they are to your liking.”Priory smiled, he put the stone plates on the table and opened the lid. There were a few grilled blue small fish. There were light blue scales on the surface of the fish.
Dudian thought that it was just the right time. He said, “Since you are here, let’s eat together. I also have a few questions to ask you.”
“No, no, we have already eaten at home. There is not much here. If we eat more, you and Miss Aisha won’t be enough.”Priory waved his hand and said. At the same time, a trace of embarrassment flashed across his face.
Dudian saw his appearance and looked at a few small blue fish. He suddenly understood that it was very dangerous for them to take the risk to hunt these small fish. This showed how important food was to them, it was obvious that priory was already married. A family was not something that he could control alone. It seemed that the fear of his wife had never disappeared in the past five thousand years.
Dudian didn’t try to persuade him: “It is so dangerous out there. You are taking such a big risk just to catch so few fish. What If You Lose Your Life? Wouldn’t it be too much of a loss?”
Priory thought of Dudian’s life saving grace. His face became more and more embarrassed, he said in embarrassment: “It is thanks to you that we are able to survive. We don’t often go out to catch fish. We usually go out to hunt at the exact time of the great god. We rarely encounter any danger. But fortunately we met you. Otherwise we wouldn’t be able to come back.”
“The Great God will calculate the dangers of hunting?”Dudian was surprised.
Priory’s eyes revealed a pious look: “The great God has inherited the will of the Aragami. She is able to guess the bad luck and know all kinds of things in the outside world.”
Dudian was surprised. Didn’t this mean that the Great God had a way to observe the situation in the surroundings? Did she have a super detector?
His eyes lit up. He didn’t ask about this but turned to another question, “I see that the desolate generals here are very powerful. Why Don’t you let them do the hunting outside? Wouldn’t it be more reliable and the harvest would be more?”
“The desolate generals will guard this place. If they meet some ferocious beasts and sneak in, they will know in time and kill them. Things like hunting are done by US desolate hunting teams.”Priory laughed.
“Desolate hunting team?”
“Yes, people like us who hunt outside.”There was a trace of pride in priory’s eyes: “Mr. Dean, I am the leader of a desolate hunting team.”
“It’s the leader of the team.”His companion reminded him.
Priory stared at him: “The leader of the team is also the leader.”
Dudian asked: “Are there many people like you who go out to hunt? How Can I join you?”
Priory smiled: “There are only about a hundred people. As long as there are adult strong men who can catch wild insects in the dragon cave then they can become a wilderness hunter and join our wilderness hunting team.”

chapters.title: Chapter 832
chapters.content:
Chapter 832 – Chapter 822: Another Path Of Evolution
“Earth Dragon Cave? Desolate worm?”
The former was obviously a place name so there was no need to ask but the latter made Dudian curious. He thought of parasitic soul worms but they were hidden in monsters, he asked: “What is this desolate worm? Is it difficult to catch it?”
“With the skill of benefactor, it is easy to catch it. But for people who have never eaten desolate worms, this little thing is very dangerous. Although it is easy to catch it but these little things have all kinds of strange abilities. Some of them have strong acid which can corrode protective gloves. Moreover, these little things have a common ability which is to suck blood and parasitize. If they accidentally touch the body, they will drill into the body. This is very dangerous and it is very easy to kill people. Therefore, to dare to go to the dragon cave to catch the desolate worm is in itself a proof of Courage!”
Priory was a bit proud: “If you don’t dare to go to the Dragon Cave then you won’t be able to face the terrifying beasts outside.”
Dudian was surprised as he heard priory’s words: “Can the desolate worms be eaten? Don’t tell me that you have eaten the desolate worms? What will happen to the people who have eaten the desolate worms?”
Priory’s eyes were filled with admiration, he said: “Benefactor is really smart. The desolate insects are a great tonic. If you eat the desolate insects then your strength and physical strength will greatly increase. As long as you eat enough, you can even become a desolate general!”! But the desolate generals are all experienced in the underground Dragon Cave. Even those of us who have eaten the desolate insects wouldn’t want to enter the Underground Dragon Cave again. These small things are too dangerous. Even if a desolate general enters the cave, there is a possibility of death.”
Dudian was slightly stunned but his heart was in turmoil. Eating the desolate insects could increase his strength? Priory’s physique was at the level of a senior hunter. Could it be that he ate the desolate insects?
“You said to eat the desolate insects… do you mean to eat them like this?”Dudian made a gesture to throw something into his mouth.
Priory said in a strange tone: “Yes, how else can I eat them?”
”…”Dudian was a bit speechless. He was interested in the desolate worm. He had established his knowledge from the giant wall of Sylvia. He had to rely on parasitic soul worms to enter his body and borrow the strength of the Soul Worms, only then would he be able to increase his strength!
No one had thought that there would be other evolutionary routes since the end of the experiment. Especially Dudian.
His world view was the scientific materialism of the old era. He knew the physical limits of human strength. Even the strongest fighter in the world was a muscle maniac who had been training every day since he was young, his strength could barely reach the level of a primary hunter. He wasn’t like Priory who was a senior hunter. Moreover his muscles were bulging like monsters.
He could barely accept the fact that he was using magic marks to increase his strength. However he could rely on eating to strengthen his physique!
“Even if I eat the world’s top delicacies which contain the most nutritious comprehensive products, I might not be able to have such an effect right? How much can the human body absorb? The digestive ability of the stomach is limited. If there is too much nutrition then it will not strengthen the physique. On the contrary, it will only increase by three levels or even more diseases…”Dudian thought, but it didn’t seem like he was lying. was the worm really so magical?
“Do you want to become stronger? Do you have to go to the Dragon Cave to find the worm to Eat?”Dudian asked.
Priory nodded: “I have been there three times so I am the leader of the team. I am much stronger than this guy. He is timid and has only been there once. It is different for those desolate generals. They have been there at least ten times.”
Dudian felt that there was another evolutionary path in front of him. However, he didn’t know which one was more perfect or which one was harmless, the end point of both was destruction.
“Why not let those desolate generals catch more desolate worms from the Dragon Cave? Wouldn’t it make many people stronger?”Dudian asked.
Priory was stunned, he shook his head: “The number of desolate insects is limited. After a period of time the Dragon Cave will open. Some people want to catch more desolate insects but it would be good if they can catch one. Moreover these desolate insects can sense each other. If you catch one then it will be much more difficult to catch other desolate insects. The other desolate insects will sense your existence through their companions. They will stay far away from you or even gather together to attack you. There were people who were greedy for the desolate insects. They caught three at a time but weren’t satisfied. In the end they were surrounded by a group of desolate insects. In the end they only found his bones and clothes.”
Dudian asked: “Can I go to the Underground Dragon Cave? The Great Priest has invited me to stay here for a few more days. I can join your hunting team and help you hunt.”
“Of course.”Pulley was happy: “Even if I don’t go to the Underground Dragon Cave, it is more than enough to join our hunting team. The Underground Dragon Cave will open in a month. If you want to go to the underground Dragon Cave then you can apply to the great priest. I don’t know if the great priest will agree or not.”
“More than a month?”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he nodded: “I will try. Do I need to apply to join the hunting team?”
“There is no need.”Priory smiled: “If you want to join then I will do it now. I am the captain so I can make you a member of our team. But it would be a bit unfair to you.”
“Yes.”His companion reminded him again.
Priory glanced at him.
Dudian smiled: “I’m not unfair. I have a sensitive identity. I will leave after a period of time. I can help you a bit. The position is meaningless to me.”
“Don’t you plan to stay for a long time?”Priory asked.
Dudian shook his head: “We will see.”
Pley understood and didn’t ask any more questions. He remembered that he hadn’t eaten the fish on the plate, he said: “Benefactor eat the fish first. I have forgotten about it. It is going to be cold soon. Benefactor eat slowly. We will go back first. If there is anything you can find me on the 21st. I will stay there.”
Dudian nodded. There were numbers engraved on the houses so it wasn’t difficult to find the numbers.
After they left Dudian looked at the small blue fish. He suddenly missed the days when Neuss was by his side. However he didn’t think that he would poison them.
He peeled the surface of the fish and ate some of the meat. He found that the meat was delicious. After eating a few of them he felt that his body was full of strength. He couldn’t help but be surprised, this small blue fish seemed to be a rare and precious ingredient.

chapters.title: Chapter 833
chapters.content:
Chapter 833 – Chapter 823: Absurdity
In the blink of an eye, five days had passed.
During these five days, Dudian spent most of his time in his own house. The villagers seemed to be accustomed to his existence. Many villagers were warned by the old man, however, curiosity still prompted them to come closer and peek. The result was that Dudian seemed to be completely different from the “Fierce”and “Cruel”image described by the old man, so they gradually grew bolder.
Some children often came to play outside Dudian’s residence. At first, they were called back by their parents. But later nothing happened, so they let the children play here.
For five days, Priory sent food to Dudian every day. At first, it was small blue fish. Later, the number of small fish gradually decreased. In the end, they only sent some strange leaves and fruits.
Dudian knew that most of the people here ate these fruits. The radiation in the soil here was too severe to be planted. These edible fruits were plants that they had tried for hundreds of years to transplant into the village, but there weren’t many of them. So even light fruits were very precious. Most people could only eat some boiled water grass and bark.
Dudian occasionally wandered around the village. Every place he went would attract the eyes of the surrounding residents. But he didn’t care. After five days of contact he found that the population of the village wasn’t very large, there were only four or five hundred people in total. The temple where the Great God lived was the center. Most of the villagers were unable to have children because of the radiation. Most of them were members of the hunting team who often went out to explore, women and children were very precious here. It was difficult for Dudian to imagine the marriage of a maid.
In his opinion it was an absurd marriage but there was still “Love”. For example, priory who often came to deliver food to Dudian. He shared his wife with two other men, in this case, he still loved his wife deeply. He thought that his wife also loved him deeply. Both of them were true love.
Moreover, he would not be jealous because of the existence of the other two. On the contrary, he was good friends with the other two.
When he knew about this, Dudian felt that his worldview had been completely destroyed. However, he thought of the dangerous environment and monsters that he had encountered along the way. They were able to survive for more than 300 years in this kind of environment, it was extremely difficult and unimaginable. In such an absurd environment, there was such an absurd marriage and love.
Dudian had a special feeling every time he saw priory happily talk about his wife. Adaptation was a terrible thing. Once he got used to it, he would no longer be able to judge right and wrong, but in the end, the standard of right and wrong was built on the world view that he had long been accustomed to. As a common saying goes, no one could see their own mistakes. No one knew that they were clowns.
In addition to this strange marriage system, Dudian found that the residents seemed to be lazy. Except for pulley and the other members of the hunting team, the rest of the old people and women were sitting at home in a daze, they were playing simple games to kill time. It seemed that no one wanted to improve the environment. No one wanted to create anything.
After asking a few people Dudian knew that they were counting on the great god.
In their hearts, the Great God was an omnipotent existence. He was appointed by the Aragami and had the power of God. Because of this, many people lost the desire to fight. After all.., why bother to waste their brains when they could get answers to questions from the Great God?
This made Dudian think that a good leader might not be able to bring out a group of outstanding talents.
However, there were environmental factors. In this closed underground world, the range of their activities was limited. As time went on, people became lazy.
Dudian was familiar with the atmosphere of the place. Every day he trained in his own room. His physique had reached the bottleneck of the peak of dominance. Even if he injected more God’s marrow into his body, he wouldn’t be able to reach the abyss level, however, the improvement of fighting was endless. Dudian relied on the power of the wall master to obtain the secret fighting skills of the Dragon Clan, the wing clan, the Rock clan, the dragon blood technique, the Rock clan’s diamond body, the wing clan’s lightning wings.., all of them were very practical combat skills. They could improve his defense, flying speed, as well as burst and lurk.
“Benefactor!”
Priory carried the stone box and ran to Dudian’s house. He rushed in excitedly. He saw Dudian crouching on the ground in a strange position: “Benefactor is training?”
Dudian stood up from the ground. He didn’t blame him for not knocking on the door: “What are you so happy about?”
Priory grinned: “The high priest said that we can go to the Blue Fish Lake to fish at dawn tomorrow. There is no danger.”
“That’s good. We can catch more this time.”Dudian faintly smiled. He had asked Priory to take him out to hunt these days. He wanted to rely on the harvest of the hunt to establish a good relationship with the village but was refused, the reason was that it was too dangerous. Now he could finally go out to get some fresh air.
“Yes!”Priory excitedly said: “This time there will be benefactor. I will prepare the bags when I go back. Benefactor, I will look for you in the evening. We will gather in the tunnel.”
“Gather?”Dudian asked: “There are others?”
“Yes. I heard that benefactor’s strength is extraordinary. There are many people who want to join us to go to the Blue Fish Lake to fish.”Priory smiled: “I saw that their family’s situation is not good so I agreed. Anyway the high priest said that there is no danger if there are less than twenty people. So there are eighteen people in addition to us.”
“Oh, okay.”Dudian nodded but felt helpless in his heart. He said that there were no more than 20 people but there were exactly 20 people.
“I will go back and prepare now.”Pulley excitedly said.
Dudian nodded. He opened his stone box after pulley left. There were two small blue fish inside. He hadn’t eaten these small fish for two days. He thought that there would be a lot of harvest tomorrow, so he took out his storage.
“I wonder what the taste will be like if I catch the things at the bottom of the lake?”Dudian thought of the terrifying strange fish in the depths of the lake. His eyes slightly flickered. Since he was going to perform well and establish a friendly relationship with the villagers.., naturally he couldn’t act ordinary this time. But if he relied on his own strength to catch the fish, it would cause some people to be afraid. There might even be spies arranged by the Great God, he deliberately used this matter to test his strength.
“I used the dragon’s blood to suppress the reaction of the heat source. They shouldn’t know my specific strength. I can only speculate from the two undeads. At most they think that I am a pioneer or even an inner wasteland. It seems that it is necessary to hide my strength.”Dudian thought, he could only use tools to fish if he hid his strength.
At the thought of tools, his mind was filled with countless old-fashioned fishing tools, and he had an idea.

chapters.title: Chapter 834
chapters.content:
Chapter 834 – Chapter 824: Harvest
Night came.
Priory came to Dudian’s door with a spear. He invited Dudian to gather in the tunnel.
“So early?”Dudian was surprised. He was wearing a pocket watch. It was less than six o’clock in the evening. There were more than ten hours to dawn tomorrow.
“The beasts are out hunting at night. It is not suitable for us to walk in the tunnel. So we have to go to the tunnel in advance and rest there for the night.”Priory explained.
Dudian thought for a moment: “I have an idea. I want to double the harvest of the hunt. But I need to prepare some tools. Do you have any?”
Priory’s eyes lit up: “Double the harvest of the fishing? What tools does benefactor need?”
“I want to weave a fishing net.”
Puley’s eyes lost interest, he wryly smiled: “Benefactor, do you want to use a fishing net? It’s useless. We have tried this method for a long time. The fish in the Blue Fish Lake are meat eaters. Their teeth are sharp and can easily bite through the fishing net.”
Dudian shook his head: “The fishing net is not used for fishing but for encircling the fish. You will know when the time comes. Do you have a ready-made fishing net?”
“Trap fish?”Pulley was puzzled, “We have a ready-made net but it is not used to catch fish. It is used to trap small beasts. It is kept by other hunting teams. I can borrow it if you want but if it is broken we will have to compensate them.”
