Dudian knew that pulley was worried about the safety of the net so he didn’t say much: “Go and borrow it. I will compensate you if it is broken.”
Priory saw that Dudian was confident: “Benefactor, is your method really effective?”
“It should be.”Dudian didn’t say anything: “By the way, there are eighteen people. Let them wear the tools to dig the soil.”
“Don’t need to wear the Spears?”Priory was stunned. They were going out to hunt without weapons but with tools to dig the soil? Was he going to dig a hole to bury himself?
Dudian saw the strange expression on Priory’s face. He could guess what he was thinking: “Trust me. It is useless to bring a spear. Bring a tool to dig the soil. We need to borrow a large one for the fishing net.”
“Benefactor, this…”priory hesitated. After all, it was not easy to go out to hunt. It was a rare opportunity. It would be better if he went alone. But there were eighteen other people, there were more than ten families behind the eighteen people. They were carrying the food for the children and the elderly. If they went out without any harvest then the next days would be very miserable.
“Benefactor, it’s not that I don’t trust you. It’s just that I’m worried that other people might not be willing to do so.”Priory said in a tactful manner.
Dudian saw his dilemma: “If someone wants to carry a spear then let them carry it. Others can carry digging tools. They can carry bags to carry fish. If there are no accidents this time then there should be a good harvest.”
“Alright.”Priory wryly smiled. If Dudian hadn’t saved him then he wouldn’t have bothered to listen to his nonsense? It would be good if he didn’t come back naked.
An hour later, Priory brought the borrowed net to find Dudian. There were three or four adults who came with him. They were carrying tools such as shovels and hoes. Priory saw Dudian waiting at the door so he hurried over, “Benefactor, we have borrowed the net. But you must be careful when you use it. They said that if it is damaged they will compensate them with at least thirty fish.”
Dudian looked at the net. It was made of bark fibers and vines. The net was very thick but it was used to hunt monsters outside. He pinched the net. It was quite tough. He was satisfied and asked: “Where are the others?”
“They are waiting for us outside the tunnel.”Priory looked at the weak light on the top of the village: “It’s late. Benefactor, should we go now?”
“Okay.”Dudian nodded and went back to the house. He took Aisha out: “Let’s go.”
“Miss Aisha is going too?”Priory was surprised.
Dudian smiled: “I won’t separate from her.”
Priory understood and didn’t ask any more questions. He called the people behind him to carry the fishing net and set off.
It didn’t take long before they came to the tunnel outside the village. There were more than ten people waiting in front of the tunnel. Most of them were holding spears and carrying a small basket on their back. They were bored as they waited.
More than a dozen people looked at Dudian and pulley. Their eyes were full of curiosity. There were a few who were alert and indifferent.
Dudian didn’t care and walked over.
“Everyone, this is Mr. Dudian, my benefactor.”Pulley introduced Dudian to everyone.
Everyone looked at Dudian but didn’t say anything. The atmosphere was a bit awkward.
Pulley knew that Dudian’s identity was sensitive. He coughed: “Everyone, it’s late. Let’s go to the tunnel.”
“Old Ray, do you really only carry shovels and not spears?”A middle-aged man who was about forty years old frowned.
Pulley looked at him and then looked at dudian: “We don’t need spears. You can bring your own.”
“Old Ray, if there is no harvest this time you will have to eat horse grass for a few days.”The middle-aged man reminded.
Priory shook his head: “Get Ready to go.”
The middle-aged man looked at Dudian. There was a trace of dissatisfaction in his eyes but he didn’t say anything. Priory was the leader of the team. He just had to make sure that he wouldn’t return empty handed.
Everyone entered the tunnel one after another. It didn’t take long before they came to the entrance of the tunnel which was blocked by rocks. There were two groups of people guarding the entrance, there were about a dozen people in each group. They were sleeping on the ground.
Dudian glanced at the clothes of the two groups of people. They carried a lot of tools. There were hunting nets, huge wooden frames, spears, swords and other weapons.
Priory was familiar with the way. He came to another open space and asked everyone to rest.
Dudian asked about the two groups of people. Priory explained in a low voice: “They are the 3rd and 5th hunting teams. They mainly hunt small beasts in the south of the wilderness. It has nothing to do with us.”
Dudian was curious. He asked a few more questions and found out that their hunting teams were responsible for different areas. Priory was mainly responsible for the Blue Fish Lake, the Blue Fish Lake was originally found by Priory’s grandfather so it was assigned to him by the Great God. It was passed down from generation to generation and now it fell to Priory. The others wanted to go to the Blue Fish Lake to hunt, they had to join Priory’s hunting team. Priory would get one-tenth of the profits.
Dudian was surprised by such a regulation. It was quite a perfect contract. He didn’t expect that it would be implemented in this backward and poor place. However it did improve the efficiency.
“Old Ray, are you going to go out tomorrow?”A middle-aged man who was about the same age as priory walked out from the group. It seemed that he was familiar with priory, “Are you going to lead so many people this time?”
Priory laughed: “How are you going to prepare this time?”
“What are you talking about? No matter how good the preparation is, it depends on the weather.”The man smiled as he looked at the crowd, “I heard that you brought the outsider to hunt. Isn’t he strong?”
Priory replied: “He is several times stronger than you.”
“Haha, he is indeed stronger than me.”The man laughed.
Dudian glanced at the two of them. He leaned against the wall and closed his eyes. He was waiting for tomorrow’s Hunt.
Time passed by quickly. By eight or nine o’clock everyone was falling asleep. The sound of snoring rose and fell in the tunnel. They didn’t know how much time had passed in the darkness, a rough voice shouted: “Get Up! It’s Time!”
Dudian woke up from his shallow sleep. He opened his eyes and saw that the others had also woken up.
The one who spoke was a desolate general. The rock at the entrance of the tunnel had been pushed open by a gap.
Priore woke up as well. He patted the people who were still asleep. He pulled everyone up and said: “Get Ready, Let’s go.”
Everyone quickly packed their things and followed priore out of the cave.
In the blink of an eye, three groups of people went to their own hunting spots.
The Sky was dark and the faint light shone from the clouds. Dudian smelled the unique humidity and freshness of the morning in the wilderness. He felt that all the pores on his body were slightly relaxed. His consciousness was exceptionally clear. He held Aisha’s hand, he followed priory over the woods. After walking for a while, he came to the Blue Lake. The lake was as calm as a mirror. It was blue and beautiful.
The eyes of the others lit up when they saw the Blue Lake. They wanted to go up and do something.
Dudian sniffed the air. He could smell the smell of blood. He looked around and saw a few messy monster’s paw prints in the distance. It seemed that other monsters had come here in the past few days, it seemed that they had experienced a fierce battle.
“It seems that this water source is a good place to attract monsters.”Dudian thought. At this time, priory came to Dudian’s side and asked: “Benefactor, we have limited time. We only have two hours. What do you plan to do?”
Dudian knew that time was tight so he didn’t waste time: “Go to the shallow water where you went last time. Listen to my command and dig a deep hole. We will lead the fish to the hole and then concentrate on fishing.”
Priory was a bit confused but he didn’t say much. After all he didn’t have any weapons so he could only listen to Dudian’s command. He turned around and called everyone to the shallow water where they went last time, he asked Dudian: “Where are we going to dig the hole?”
Dudian pointed at the shallow lake: “Make a hole here and dig a hole here. Everyone start to dig. The hole will be two meters deep and will extend to about ten meters.”
Priory saw Dudian’s gesture. Although he had never thought of this method but he knew that it was very feasible. He called everyone, “Everyone is ready. Let’s do as Mr. Dean said.”The first person to carry a shovel came to the edge of the lake and quickly dug.
The others looked at each other and followed him to dig.
The other seven or eight people holding spears looked at each other when they saw priory and the others’actions. They were at a loss. They did not know whether to help or wait.
Soon, the middle-aged man who had warned priory earlier turned around and left first. He came to another foothold by the shallow lake and stabbed a fish into the water with his spear. Soon, he stabbed a fish and put it into the basket.
Other people saw that he had made a harvest and immediately surrounded him. One after another, they found a foothold in the shallow water and poked the fish with a spear.
There were many small blue fish in the lake. They came to the lakeside when they saw people approaching. Some of the small fish jumped up and bit the tip of the spear. Their mouths were full of sharp teeth.
Dudian looked at these people but didn’t say anything. He looked at the middle of the lake from time to time. He was on guard against the monster fish that lurked over to attack them. At the same time, he came to the side of the forest and cut the trees with his knife, he cut them into small wooden sticks and used them to support the fishing net.
After a moment Dudian made a deep hole. Everyone had the physique of a hunter so the efficiency of digging the hole was very fast.
“Benefactor, what about now?”Priory wiped the sweat from his forehead. There was a trace of heat and tension in his eyes. He asked Dudian.
“Put the net here.”Dudian gestured for him to put the net horizontally into the deep pit.
The few of them worked together and fixed the net in the pit.
Dudian took the shovel from Priory’s hand and quickly opened the gap between the pit and the lake. The lake water slowly flowed into the deep pit. However the small blue fish were attracted by the fish, only a few small fish flowed into the deep hole along the lake water.
Dudian swung his sword and stabbed into the lake water. He picked up a small blue fish. He turned his wrist and cut the small fish into pieces. Blood flowed out and he threw the fish into the middle and the end, as he expected, the smell of blood stimulated the small fish. The surface of the lake was boiling and the small fish kept jumping.
As the lake water flowed, the small fish quickly rushed into the deep pit. Coincidentally, the opening of the fishing net in the deep pit was aimed at the mouth of the lake. All the small fish rushed into the net and swam toward the deep part of the net.
In less than a few minutes, the fishing net in the deep pit, which was two meters deep and ten meters long, was filled with the blue small fish and the lake water. The small fish inside surged. With a cursory glance, there were at least hundreds or thousands of them.
Priory and the other people who were digging the hole saw this scene. They were in a daze and couldn’t believe it.
Dudian saw that it was almost time. He said to priory: “Block the mouth of the lake.”
Priory reacted and asked the few people to carry shovels. They shovelled the soil into the mouth of the lake and filled the mouth of the lake.
The lake water stopped pouring in. The deep hole was full of fish and lake water. Dudian let priory continue to dig the hole at the end of the deep hole. He dug deeper so that the lake water would flow out.
Prier understood what Dudian said. The others also came to their senses. They were excited as they picked up shovels to dig. They felt that their blood was boiling.
Soon, the few of them worked together to dig a small pit. The water in the pit quickly flowed out and was absorbed by the soil. The fishing net in the deep pit quickly sank. There were only small blue fish struggling in the net.
Dudian looked at the time. It had only been an hour. He estimated that he could make another net.
“There are so many of them!”Priory looked at the blue fish struggling in the net because of the lack of oxygen. His eyes were wide open. He was so excited that he couldn’t control himself.
The others were also staring at them. They swallowed their saliva. It felt like a dream.
Dudian said: “Get ready to close the net. Pour out the ones inside and make another net.”
Priory couldn’t help but look at Dudian as he heard Dudian say that he wanted to throw another net. He subconsciously said: “I… I don’t think we have enough bags…”
“It’s alright. I have a way. You can go to the side and pick some big leaves. Put them under the net and use the net to drag them back.”Dudian said.

chapters.title: Chapter 835
chapters.content:
Chapter 835 – Chapter 825: Each Has His Own Harvest
“Old Lei, How’s Your Harvest Here?”One of the people who was fishing by the lake noticed the excited expressions of priory and the others surrounding the deep pit. He felt strange and walked over with a spear in his hand.
Priory turned to look at him. His gaze fell on his basket. There were a few small fish bouncing gently inside. “Bean, your harvest is not bad.”
Bean grinned. Just as he was about to say something, his gaze was suddenly attracted by the scene in the deep pit. He opened his mouth slightly and stood rooted to the ground. After a while, he turned his head to look at Priory in disbelief, “This, this was all done by you guys just now?”
“Could it have been done last night?”Priory laughed.
The others also laughed. They were very excited. At first they were worried that they wouldn’t get anything by bringing a shovel. However, this novel hunting method gave them an unexpected surprise. Just the fish in the deep pit.., it was enough for them to live for many days. Moreover Dudian was going to catch another net. They felt unprecedented happiness and excitement.
“My God!”Bean exclaimed.
The people who were fishing by the lake heard the movement and came over curiously. Soon, there was an exclamation. All the people who were fishing were stunned.
Dudian saw the blue fish in the net struggling and jumping. He frowned. He didn’t think that these small fish would be so fierce. They were dehydrated but they could hold on for so long until they suffocated to death, it would take about an hour later. He looked at priory: “Ask everyone to open a hole behind the net. Prepare to harvest the fish. Put them in the mud pit behind the net. Be careful not to be bitten.”
The others were listening to Dudian’s words. Dudian didn’t wait for Priory to reply. Someone shouted: “I’ll do it!”
“I’ll do it too!”
“Count me in.”
Pley saw that everyone was excited and laughed. He immediately assigned them to the back of the deep hole. Because of the low terrain, the fish slipped out of the net when the gap was opened, they fell into the mud pit.
Several people stood in the mud pit and used shovels to scoop up the fish. They threw them onto the shore.
The others waited by the pit and immediately smacked the fish to death or fainted before putting them into bags and baskets.
The few people who were fishing nearby saw them collecting the fish wantonly and were extremely envious. They felt like a delicious piece of food was emitting a tempting fragrance in front of their eyes. Some of them also bent down to pick up the fish with baskets.
Priory noticed that the few people who were fishing were also picking up fish and shouted, “You guys, didn’t we agree before that you would catch your fish and we would catch ours? How are you going to pick up our fish?”
The moment he opened his mouth, the other people who were working hard also noticed this and immediately shouted, “Yes!”
“What are you guys doing? Why are you picking up our fish?”
“We dug this pit and we caught the fish. It’s not appropriate for you guys to pick up our fish, right?”
When the people who were picking up fish heard their protests and unkind gazes, they immediately felt embarrassed. One of them said embarrassedly, “There are so many fish, and you guys can’t hold them all. We all came out together, why do you have to do this?”
“What do you mean we can’t hold them all? Who said we can’t hold them all?”Someone immediately said angrily.
Although everyone present knew each other and could be considered acquaintances, in front of food, they were not so easy to talk to.
The fish pickers knew that they were in the wrong, but seeing that they could not get any of the fish, they could not bear it in their hearts, the middle-aged man who was trying to persuade priory said: “Old Ray, we came out to hunt. You Can’t be so heartless. There are so many fish and you don’t want to share one with us. Isn’t it too much?”
Priory’s eyebrows twitched, he angrily said: “I told you to bring a shovel. Did you bring it? When we were digging, you were fishing. If we didn’t catch a fish, would you share your catch with us? !”
The middle-aged man was speechless.
Dudian saw that they were about to quarrel so he came out to smooth things over: “Old Ray.”
Everyone looked at him.
“Let them keep the fish. We are all from the same village. There is no need to share these. We are all on the same side.”Dudian said generously.
Priory was a bit unwilling: “But they didn’t listen to you and talked about you behind your back. They didn’t use any strength…”
Dudian raised his hand: “Everyone’s life is not easy. Give me face and I’ll give them my share. I Can’t eat so much anyway.”
“No Way!”Puley shouted when he heard that Dudian was going to give up his share.
The others didn’t expect that dudian would speak up for them. They couldn’t help but feel grateful. At the same time, they felt ashamed and regretful.
“Old Ray.”Dudian looked at pulley.
Pulley saw that Dudian’s attitude was so firm: “Since you have spoken, as long as no one has any objections then we will give them a share!”
“I don’t have any objections.”
“I don’t have any objections either. These fish were Mr. Dudian’s idea. Mr. Dudian will give them to whoever he wants.”
“Do you agree if Mr. Dudian says that he won’t give them to you?”
“I. . .”
The others laughed as the atmosphere eased up.
“Hurry up and load the fish.”Dudian said.
Everyone knew that time was tight. They clenched their teeth and worked hard. The people who were fishing also helped. They realized that the small basket they brought was too small, before they came they thought that it would be a big harvest if they could hold a full basket. But now it seemed that compared to the people like priory who had big bags, it was nothing.
Many people regretted their short-sightedness.
It didn’t take long before the fish were thrown out of the deep pit. Dudian looked at the time and ordered priory to re-set the net. He opened the bank of the lake and water rushed in. There were a lot of small blue fish.
Everyone was excited as they picked up the small fish on the shore.
The few people who had caught the fish before finally knew why they could catch so many fish. Compared to them, this fishing method was simply a robbery.
Dudian looked at the front of the lake and paid attention to the appearance of the monster fish. However, when the net was full again, the monster fish still didn’t appear. He was relieved, in this way he didn’t have to make a move.
In the blink of an eye the hunting time was over. Dudian led everyone back. Everyone was carrying bags and baskets full of fish. More than a dozen of them were carrying fish in the net. The harvest was amazing.
After returning to the canyon, priory hit the rocks and everyone returned to the tunnel.
The two guards were surprised to see that everyone was full of harvest. They couldn’t help but look at Dudian. They knew that such a terrifying harvest should be related to this outsider. After all.., they had seen pulley lead the team to catch fish countless times but they had never had such a huge harvest.
Although the fish were very heavy but the atmosphere of the team was very happy. After entering the tunnel, one of them couldn’t help but hum a song. The others heard the melody and sang together.
They returned to the village.
Everyone gathered all the fish in the square at the entrance of the village. Some children who were playing nearby saw it and were stunned.
The news quickly spread throughout the village and attracted many people to watch.
Dudian saw the excited expression of these people and smiled in his heart. This bit of food was not very valuable to him but it was the best tool to close the relationship with the residents.
He felt that if he could catch a few more times, he would soon become the beloved existence of everyone here. At that time, it would be very convenient for him to do something.
“Old Ray, count the number of fish.”Dudian said.
Priory looked at the surrounding residents who were amazed and envious. He felt a sense of pride and honor. After hearing Dudian’s order, he felt a sense of enjoyment. He ordered the few people to pour out the fish, they began to count.
There were two groups of people coming from the back of the tunnel. They were the two groups of people who had gone hunting with them.
One group of people carried a three meter tall monster which looked like a wild boar.
“Eh, Old Ray?”The middle-aged man who had greeted priory when he was sleeping in the tunnel pushed away the crowd. He saw Priory but didn’t say anything. His eyes were attracted by the piles of fish on the ground, he couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
Priory turned around and saw him: “Jess, you are back. Not bad. You have a big harvest this time.”
Jess couldn’t help but stare at him: “Are you mocking me? Did you fish up all the fish in the lake? So Many?”
Priory laughed: “If all the fish were fished out then this place wouldn’t be able to fit them.”
Jess rolled his eyes and looked around the square. He saw Dudian’s figure and asked: “Old Ray, is this an outsider?”
Pulley replied: “Don’t call him an outsider. This is my benefactor, Mr. Dudian.”
Jess slightly curled his lips and looked at the pile of fish on the ground. He was a bit envious but knew that it was useless to look at it. He turned around and waved: “Let’s go and share our fish.”
After a while, the number of fish was counted out. There were more than 1,800 fish in total. Priory gave Dudian 500 fish but Dudian refused. He proposed to hold a fish feast in the evening, he invited the whole village to taste the fish.
Priory was a bit reluctant when he heard that the whole village was invited to taste the fish. But since Dudian had asked him to do so, he was embarrassed to refuse. Moreover, he had learned Dudian’s method, there would be a good harvest if he went out to fish in the future. He didn’t have to be stingy this time.
Metal Temple.
Amelia finished her report to the High Priest, she pouted: “This man is quite powerful. He didn’t use any force but he caught so many fish. I wanted to take this opportunity to see what he is capable of. I didn’t expect that he didn’t see anything.”
“I can see quite a lot,”the great divine priest said slowly. “He is very smart, and he has designs on our village.”
“Smart is right. Sister, you said that he has designs on us?”Amelia was surprised.
The great divine priest said slowly, “He is just a passer-by. There is no need for him to be so friendly to us. Amelia, you have to remember that behind any unnecessary kindness, there is something else. I don’t think that a person like him who dares to come to such a dangerous place to survive by himself will retain a childlike kind heart. So, he must have taken a fancy to us.”
“Sister, what does he see in US?”Amelia asked her obediently.
“We’ll observe for a few more days,”the high priest said softly, “He’ll give us an answer. However, don’t remind them to go hunting at the Blue Fish Lake. The more fish they catch, the more grateful they’ll be to him. I don’t want them to become his loyal followers in the end.”

chapters.title: Chapter 836
chapters.content:
Chapter 836 – Chapter 826: Interview [ First Update ]
More than twenty days passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian stayed in the village all day. He ate, drank, and rested. There was little entertainment. Most of the people were used to sleeping after eating. After all, sleep was the most energy-saving thing, it was also the thing that parents supported their children the most.
But such a phenomenon was undoubtedly a slow death.
Since the end of the fish feast, Dudian had never left the village. Priory and others had looked for the great god several times but the answer they got was that it was not suitable to hunt, after all, it was not easy to learn this fast fishing method of Dudian. It would be a great harvest if they went once. But after more than twenty days, they had no chance to go. Such a long interval was rarely seen in the past.
Fortunately, there were still many fish left after the fish feast. It was enough for them to live for one or two months. After all, they had other sundries to eat.
Dudian wasn’t in a hurry and quietly waited. He could guess the thoughts of the Great God. He was worried that his close relationship with the villagers would threaten her existence.
Dudian felt that it was time to meet the Great God again. In the past twenty days the Great God hadn’t taken the initiative to look for him. He hadn’t taken the initiative to look for the Great God, although they hadn’t met but Dudian could roughly guess her thoughts. It was time to talk about it.
Dudian came to the small square in the middle of the village. He looked at the metal sphere in the air. Every time he saw it there was a stunning feeling. The contrast between it and the rough stone houses was very clear, dudian said to the general in front of the stairs: “I want to meet the Great God. Please inform me.”
The general indifferently looked at dudian. He turned and went up the stairs. He whispered to Dudian.
There was a soft sound coming from the cabin. The general came to Dudian and said: “Please.”
Dudian nodded. He didn’t bring the witcher so he didn’t need to disarm. He went up the stairs and came to the cabin door. The cabin door slowly opened. It was as luxurious and bright as before.
Dudian went in and saw the goddess in front of the curtain.
“Mr. Dean, are you living well here?”Amelia smiled as she looked at dudian.
Dudian indifferently said: “The environment here is ordinary but the people here are good.”
“Mr. Dean is really good at talking. We are naturally inferior to the wall where you live.”Amelia smiled.
Dudian looked at her and turned to the priest: “Greetings to you.”
“Mr. Dean don’t need to be polite.”The priest smiled.
Dudian looked at the eyes of the priest behind the curtain, “I’m here today because I have something to ask of you. Soon the Earth Dragon Cave will open. I’m very curious about the Earth Dragon Cave. I want to talk about it. I hope you will agree.”
The smile in the eyes of the senior priest slowly faded: “Mr. Dean, what do you mean?”
“There is no hidden meaning.”Dudian looked at her.
The senior priest frowned: “Mr. Dean, are you here for the Earth Dragon Cave?”
“Senior priest, I don’t know anything about the Earth Dragon Cave. I only know from the villagers that the insects in the cave can increase their strength. Who wouldn’t want to get such things? Is there anything more attractive than strength?”Dudian’s eyes were calm.
Master stared at him and whispered: “Is your lover not as attractive as strength?”
Dudian replied: “She is priceless and can not be measured by anything. Strength is something that can be pursued. It is a vulgar thing.”
“What a vulgar thing.”The priest sneered: “You have endured for more than 20 days. Are you finally unable to endure?”
Dudian quietly looked at her, “I just want to see if this worm is useful to me. If this matter makes the priest feel embarrassed then forget it. I have been here for a long time. If you don’t have a way to restore my lover then I won’t waste any more time here. Goodbye.”
The priest and Amelia were startled. They didn’t expect that Dudian would leave so quickly.
Amelia quickly said: “Wait.”
Dudian was relieved as he saw her speak in time. He was going to stay for a while and wait for them to ask him to stay. If they didn’t ask him to stay then it would be awkward. Fortunately the situation was as he had expected.
“What?”Dudian looked at her indifferently.
Amelia turned to look at the priest. The priest frowned and was silent for a moment, “Mr. Dean, you have stayed here for so long. Isn’t it a bit unreasonable for you to leave just like that? What if you leave and attract your companions? Wouldn’t that put us in danger?”
Dudian smiled in a mocking tone: “Master, according to you I can’t stay and I Can’t Leave?”
The eyes of the master flashed: “It’s not impossible for you to enter the Dragon Cave. But I have a condition.”
“Go ahead.”Dudian said as if he was waiting for her to make a condition.
The master felt a bit uncomfortable as she said: “Mr Dean comes from the wall. I’m interested in the wall so I want to know more about it. I hope Mr Dean won’t hesitate to tell me.”
Dudian replied: “Of course.”
The priest frowned as he saw Dudian agree so readily. He was a bit uneasy but he heard Dudian speak: “Do you want to move the people to the wall?”
The words were like thunder in the ears of the priest.
The senior priest and Amelia were shocked as they looked at dudian.
Dudian knew that his guess was correct as he saw the change in Amelia’s expression.
“Mr. Dudian, you are right.”The senior priest quickly put away his shock, the senior priest slowly said: “We have lived here for hundreds of years. Although the resources are poor but it is safe. If we move to other places, the journey will be far and the casualties will be heavy. You Don’t have to worry. We have no interest in moving to the wall. We just want to understand how many strong people like you exist in the outside world.”
Dudian faintly smiled. If it was an ordinary person, they would have believed his words. But he had already seen through the situation here. The resources were far more than the word “Barren”could describe. It was a serious radiation, a large number of men who went out to hunt were sterilized. As the number of women decreased, the number of children would also decrease. Sooner or later, they would die out. It must be known that the human reproduction rate was not slow. After hundreds of years of reproduction.., there were still less than a thousand people left, especially in this place where the concept of marriage was distorted. The population was still unable to increase. It was clear how fast the rate of extinction was.
In his opinion, in less than 30 years, the population here would shrink by more than half. In another 50 years, it was estimated that they would face extinction. At that time, it would be considered good if there were more than a dozen survivors.
It was impossible for them not to predict such a situation. A safe living environment was more important than anything else. Although it was safe here but the serious radiation penetration was irresistible.
“I have been living here for more than 20 days. Since the first few days I learned from Priory that the Earth Dragon Cave would open in a month, I wanted to go to the cave to have a look. So I will insist on staying here.”Dudian seemed to say insignificant words, he said in a light tone: “When I was free I was thinking that I wanted to go to the underground dragon cave to have a look. Great Priest, why did you let an outsider stay here?”? “Now I know the answer.”
The expression of the great priest and Amelia changed again. They looked at Dudian in shock and anger. They had been observing Dudian’s life through the villagers for more than 20 days. They didn’t meet Dudian because they didn’t want to expose their purpose, they were waiting for Dudian to open his mouth. They didn’t expect that Dudian’s words would hit their heart!

chapters.title: Chapter 837
chapters.content:
Chapter 837 – Chapter 827: Exchange [ Second Update ]
“Did you come to find us because you expected it?”The priest’s tone wasn’t friendly as he coldly stared at Dudian. She didn’t have anything to hide.
Dudian indifferently said: “I have been waiting for more than twenty days. I have guessed that you have designs on me but I don’t know the details. It wasn’t until you wanted to know about the god’s wall that I knew that it wasn’t a problem. The God’s wall is very vast and most of the territory is uninhabited. Moreover the environment should be considered as heaven compared to this place. It is able to accommodate you.”
The eyes of the priest slightly moved: “How do I know whether what you said is true or not?”
“If I didn’t tell you at the beginning, I would have guessed your thoughts and told you directly. Would you be more willing to believe it?”Dudian taunted: “I can pretend that I don’t know anything and answer you foolishly. Then you will be skeptical and take the time to speculate. What is the meaning of this? “What you are seeking is to move to the wall. It is a very, very, very small matter. It is as if there is an insect flying in your village. No one will even notice it. Of course, this is not an appropriate metaphor but it is the truth.”
Amelia looked at the great priest. She was shocked. According to Dudian’s words, the territory of the wall was unimaginably vast?
The great priest’s face was cold, “I know about the wall. I know that the wall is extremely tough and can resist the invasion of most of the beasts. There are millions of people living there. But I want to know what the world inside the wall is like. Is it a world where the weak are prey to the strong? The weak are servants and the strong are respected.”
Dudian chuckled: “It seems that any world is like this. Aren’t you here?”
“Impudent!”Amelia shouted: “We are not like this. We are very peaceful. There has never been a war!”
“There is no war because they have been tamed without greed.”Dudian looked at her, “If there is another girl in the village who has replaced your position as the goddess but you can only be an ordinary villager. Will you be willing to eat the same disgusting food as them? What will you do if you are not willing? There is no war but the weak are still servants. You are respected!”
Amelia was so angry that she couldn’t speak. She gritted her teeth: “I, I will not!”
Dudian shrugged his shoulders.
The priest coldly stared at Dudian. It had been a long time since anyone had talked to her in such an attitude. She was angry but she knew that Dudian had the hope that they would continue. She pondered for a moment, “In a sense, you are right. But the law of the jungle is different. There are naked and hidden in the dark. I don’t know which one is in the wall.”
“The second one.”Dudian said without hesitation. He knew what the priest was worried about. If the first one was the naked law of the jungle then there would be no benevolence on the surface, it would be the most brutal world. It meant that the strong could wantonly kill and plunder. There would be no order and rules.
The iron rule of “The strong preys on the weak”was hidden in the darkness. In a sense, it was a distinction between human society and the animal world, but this was the biggest difference between humans and animals!
In the animal world, strength was not enough and they would become prey.
In the human world, intelligence was not enough. They would be eaten until there were no bones left.
The priest nodded slightly. She was relieved. She could see that Dudian wasn’t lying. Moreover, the first possibility was low, she asked: “Can you tell us the location of the Wall?”
Dudian’s heart moved, “Even if I tell you, you won’t be able to go there. It is a long way and I have gone through many hardships to get here. I will tell you that there are few monsters in the area around the wall. People like priory can hunt there at any time. The number and strength of monsters are much higher in the far places. The farthest place is the area where you live. We call it the abyss and it is usually forbidden to enter.”
Amelia was surprised and asked: “Is it because the beasts here are more powerful?”
“Yes.”Dudian nodded, “No one would easily enter this place unless they are seeking death. We usually hunt in the wilderness outside the abyss. Moreover the area inside the giant wall is vast. We don’t need to hunt to maintain our lives. We only need to grow crops. We are hunting because we want to expand the area. We hope that one day we can eliminate all the monsters in the world. In that case we will be the only ones left here. We can go anywhere.”
Naturally, he had replaced his own expectations and wishes. The reason why the Hunter family was hunting was because of the needs of the Monster Research Institute and the Kingdom of God.
“Eliminate all the monsters?”Amelia knew that Dudian was talking about the monsters. Her eyes lit up as she heard Dudian’s words, “Can we completely eliminate all the monsters? It would be good if the Aragami were still around. Perhaps we would be able to go anywhere in the world like you said. Unfortunately, we humans can only curl up here. These monsters are too strong. There are too many of them and they are multiplying fast. It is impossible to kill all of them…” His eyes were gloomy and his face was full of depression.
“Although the task is difficult but how do we know if we don’t do it? After all, we humans used to be the rulers of this world!”Dudian’s eyes lit up.
Amelia was surprised: “We are the rulers of this world? How is it possible!”
“How is it not possible?”Dudian looked at her as if it was a matter of course.
The priest stared at Dudian, slowly he said: “You are right. Before the great calamity we humans were the strongest race in the world. But since the death of the Aragami we no longer exist. I hope that there are still surviving Aragami in this world who will lead us to the strongest!”
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. He thought that it had nothing to do with the Aragami. But from her words it seemed that they didn’t know much about the things that happened before the cataclysm. Otherwise they wouldn’t think so highly of the Aragami.
He didn’t continue to delve into this issue, he went back to the topic: “After I go to the Underground Dragon Cave, I will tell you the location of the divine wall regardless of whether the Aragami can improve my strength or not. However, it is alright for you to live in hiding here. If you move there there will be no more than five people who can reach the divine wall alive.”
“No!”The priest frowned: “You have to tell us the location of the wall.”
“Even if I tell you, you won’t be able to go.”Dudian helplessly emphasized.
The priest coldly said: “How do you know that we won’t be able to go? We will be able to find a way to go to the wall. Even if we can’t find a way, our next generation will be able to find a way to move to the wall.”
Dudian thought that it wasn’t a big deal for them to go to the wall. It was more than enough to accommodate them. Even if there was a conflict, Aristotle would be the one to solve it, “Alright, I will draw the route to the wall for you. Whether you can go or not depends on you. However, I can only draw half of it for you. I will draw the rest for you when I come out of the cave.”
Amelia was angry: “Are you worried that we will go back on Our Words?”
“Of course.”Dudian replied.
Amelia was so angry that she rolled her eyes. She stomped her feet as she didn’t know what to say to Dudian.
The priest said: “This won’t do. If you draw the wrong route then we will be at a disadvantage.”
“It seems that we don’t trust each other.”Dudian frowned. Trust was a problem. Moreover their ancestors had suffered losses from outsiders so it was difficult to establish trust.
The priest also saw the problem. He pondered for a moment: “I have an idea. You take Amelia back to the wall. After you finish the task Amelia will write a letter for you to bring back.”
Dudian frowned. It would be a bit of a delay. After all, he had experienced danger and spent a lot of time. It would take months for him to go back and forth.
“What if he kills me?”Amelia was nervous and worried when she heard that she was going to leave with Dudian.
The priest said: “So, let Mr. Dudian keep your lover here. I will…”
“No!”Dudian refused before she finished her sentence: “I won’t keep her here.”
The priest didn’t expect that Dudian’s reaction would be so fierce. He frowned: “She is just a dead body. We won’t do anything to her. What do you have to worry about?”
“No need to say anything. I Won’t keep her here as collateral.”Dudian’s face turned cold. His eyes flashed with cold light and his body emitted waves of killing intent.
The priest knew that Dudian was angered so he didn’t say anything else.
Amelia heard the priest’s words and wanted to jump. She didn’t expect that Dudian’s reaction was stronger than hers. She was so angry that her eyes were wide open, she looked at dudian: “Can’t my life be compared with hers? She is dead but I am still alive!”
Dudian’s fingers cracked as he looked at her: “If you say one more word then you are dead!”

chapters.title: Chapter 838
chapters.content:
Chapter 838 – Chapter 828: Hijacking
“You!”Amelia was mad. She had never been wronged like this. She wanted to say more but was interrupted by the priest: “Mr. Dean, since this method doesn’t work, do you have a better idea?”
The priest saw that Dudian was serious. Although she was angry but it was not the time to fall out with Dudian.
Dudian coldly looked at Amelia. He didn’t think that the little girl was cute anymore. He said: “Since we can not trust each other then the only way is for you to compromise.”
Amelia was angry: “Why do we compromise and not you?”
“Because this exchange is not equal. To be honest, this matter is not negotiable. You either refuse or agree!”Dudian’s face was cold. His words were more aggressive than before, “I can not go to the Dragon Cave. For me, going there means that I have hope to improve my strength. If I don’t go, I won’t have any loss! But you are different. If you don’t move to the wall, sooner or later you will be destroyed. How many years can you hold on here? Thirty Years? Fifty Years?”
“For you, this is a matter of life and death for all of you. But for me, it is only possible to improve my strength. What qualifications do you have to negotiate with me about this exchange? !”
The priest and Amelia were angry. However, the priest was a bit scared. He didn’t expect Dudian’s attitude to change so quickly. He was friendly before but now he was as tough as a stone.
“Mr. Dean, don’t Go Too Far!”The priest felt that he should save some face, “This is our territory after all. Do you think you can walk out of here without our consent? You are using your life in exchange. Isn’t It Worth It?”
Dudian sneered: “Let’s not talk about whether you can keep me or not. Even if you do, I guarantee that not many of you will survive. You can try if you don’t believe me!”
The priest didn’t expect that Dudian wouldn’t give in. His face slightly changed. There was a trace of regret in his heart. Previously he shouldn’t have mentioned Dudian’s lover and provoked him. But now he was making things difficult. This was the situation that she didn’t want to see, she coldly said: “Mr Dean, we will fight until both sides suffer. It Won’t be good for anyone. It will only make the extinction of our human race faster. I don’t want to use the worst means to deal with you. But I hope you won’t bully others too much!”
“I’m not bullying anyone.”Dudian saw her compromise and coldly snorted, “You and I will take a step back. I will draw the complete route for you when I get out of the cave. I can only guarantee that the route I will give you is absolutely confirmed. In addition I will give you two pieces of information.”
The priest’s face was ugly. It was the same as the original negotiation. However this time she couldn’t refuse. Otherwise it would be tantamount to a falling out. She asked: “What News?”
“I can tell you the First News Now.”Dudian said in a cold tone: “There isn’t only one God’s wall in this world. The God’s Wall I told you is called the Silvia God’s Wall.”
“Not one?”The eyes of the great god narrowed in horror.
Amelia’s eyes widened as she looked at dudian: “What about the second news?”
Dudian glanced at her: “You haven’t given anything yet and you want to ask so many questions. Aren’t you too greedy?”
Amelia was angry because of Dudian’s retort but she knew that she had offended Dudian. It was natural for him to target her. She was angry that she was outdone by a corpse. It was simply infuriating!
The priest slowly came back to her senses. Her heart was still a bit shocked. She was eager to move to the wall. She had learned about the general situation of the wall from the outsiders more than a hundred years ago. But she didn’t expect that there would be more than one such paradise, it was more than one!
She felt sad and angry. She was sad that they were both human beings but they lived in this desolate and barren land for hundreds of years.
After a long silence, the priest finished digesting the news. She said to dudian: “Alright, I will agree to your conditions. But you must swear that everything you say is true. Swear in the name of your lover!”
Dudian clenched his fists. His eyes were full of murderous intent: “Do you like to self-destruct so much?”
The expression of the priest changed: “It’s just an oath. It Won’t hurt her unless you are lying.”
“This is a matter of dignity!”Dudian stared at her, “Nothing can implicate her. I completely agree if you want me to swear on my life. But what you shouldn’t do is to implicate her again and again!”
The priest thought that it was because of your strong reaction to her that he believed that you wouldn’t take her as an oath and lie. However, looking at Dudian’s angry face, she knew that it was impossible. She could only settle for the second best.., “Well, then swear in your own name.”
“It’s too late.”The killing intent in Dudian’s eyes gradually disappeared, indifferently: “You have offended me and questioned me. There is no problem. But you shouldn’t disrespect my lover. I have changed my mind. I Won’t give you the additional information. In addition, you must apologize to my lover in person.”
“What? !”Amelia’s eyes widened: “Do you want us to apologize to her? How is that possible! We didn’t do anything wrong!”
The priest’s face was full of anger. He felt that Dudian had gone too far: “Mr. Dean, are you guilty by doing this?”
Dudian looked at them coldly. Suddenly his mouth slightly twitched as a trace of ridicule appeared on his face, “Your ignorance will destroy your people. I have given you a chance but you don’t know how to cherish it. To be honest, this situation is not what I want to see. But your ignorance has created such a situation. In that case, let’s share the consequences!”
The priest heard the murderous intent in Dudian’s words. She didn’t want to see the relationship break because she knew that she would have to pay a lot of price to blackmail Dudian, they were talking about Dudian’s lover. She was a bit regretful. She didn’t think that Dudian would see his lover as important as her, it was difficult for her to understand. But she was a great god so she wouldn’t apologize to a dead body.
“Since you insist on it then don’t blame us for being rude.”The Great God clenched his teeth and looked at Amelia.
Dudian’s eyes penetrated through the curtain. He sneered: “You Barbarians don’t know what is polite and polite. Amelia, what does the great god mean by reaching out to you?”
Amelia was about to attack Dudian when she saw the high priest’s eyes. She was puzzled as she heard Dudian’s words. She couldn’t help but look back. Did her sister have other instructions?
The wind whistled. Amelia felt light all over her body. The next moment she was far away from the curtain. She felt that a slender hand was squeezing her neck and strangling her throat.
Her heart was cold. She knew that she had been tricked.
“You!”The priest saw that Dudian had taken Amelia away. He was so angry that he stood up from the ground and lifted the curtain. It was reasonable to say that her identity couldn’t be easily seen. But at the moment she didn’t have time to care about these things.
But she didn’t know that Dudian had seen her through the curtain.
“You better stop.”Dudian indifferently looked at the priest, “Although I don’t know what means you will use to subdue me. But no matter what you do I guarantee that she will be buried with me before you make a move.”
The Great God knew that Dudian was right. Even the most powerful great God couldn’t save Amelia from Dudian’s hands. After all, no matter how fast she was, she couldn’t be faster than Dudian’s fingers, moreover, Dudian himself was a top expert.
If he used any traps, he would probably kill Amelia as well.
She clenched her teeth, she said to dudian: “If anything happens to Amelia, don’t think that you can do whatever you want with her. Although Amelia is a goddess but she has sacrificed a lot for her people. She was the first to resist the sacrifice when the outsider attacked her. Amelia was prepared to do so!”
Amelia’s pale face calmed down as she heard her words. Her body was no longer trembling. Her eyes were full of determination and courage. It seemed that she was ready to die at any time.
Dudian felt that the hostage had calmed down. He looked at the priest: “Well said. So I decided to give you another chance.”
“Huh?”The priest frowned.
“After the opening of the cave I will bring Amelia in. I will draw the route of the wall for you when I leave. It is up to you whether you believe me or not.”Dudian said.

chapters.title: Chapter 839
chapters.content:
Chapter 839 – Chapter 829: Capture [ First Update ]
“No!”The priest said: “Amelia can’t go to the Dragon Cave with you!”
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “Why?”
“It’s too dangerous there.”
“I can protect her.”
The priest said in a deep voice: “How can you protect her if you can’t even protect yourself? Will you sacrifice your life to protect her or yourself if you are in Danger?”
“She is a hostage. What good will it do me if she dies?”Dudian didn’t answer but asked, “If she loses her life in the cave then you can kill me when I come out. I will be buried with her. I will protect her even if it is for my own life. Unless you want to fight with me but I guarantee that she will die in front of me!”
The priest’s face turned ugly: “I can promise you to go to the cave. I Won’t attack you after you come out but you can’t take her there.”
“Is there any meaning to such a verbal promise?”Dudian indifferently said: “I’m not familiar with the cave so it’s good that I have a guide. If you use some unknown means to create danger in the cave then I will be ambushed by you.”
“We are not so shameless…”Amelia shouted in anger.
Dudian pinched her chin and made her face contort. She pouted and couldn’t speak.
The old priest’s face was gloomy. He knew that it would be difficult to change Dudian’s mind. The most important thing was that he didn’t have any bargaining chips in his hands! If she refused Dudian’s proposal then Amelia would die without a doubt. If she agreed then it would be extremely dangerous for her to go to the underground dragon cave with her special body, however, the only advantage would be that Dudian would be buried with Amelia without having to go through her hands.
There were some contradictions and hesitation in her eyes.
“I’m willing to go!”Amelia saw the struggle and pain in the eyes of the high priest. She clenched her teeth and shook off Dudian’s hand, she shouted: “Amelia is a goddess. It is necessary to sacrifice for the tribe. Amelia is willing to take the risk!”
The high priest’s body trembled. There was a trace of guilt in his eyes but it quickly disappeared. She didn’t want Dudian to see anything strange. This would make the smart teenager suspicious. She lowered her head and pretended to meditate. In fact, she was adjusting her emotions, after a moment she suppressed the sadness in her heart. She took a deep breath and looked up at dudian: “Alright, I Promise You. But after you come out, you must release Amelia and give us the map of the wall!”
“Of course.”Dudian indifferently said: “I’m a man of my word. But you better not play any tricks.”
The priest stared at him for a moment: “You better bring Amelia out safely. If anything happens to her I will bury you with her!”
Dudian was too lazy to listen to this nonsense, “You don’t need to worry about this. There is still some time before the opening of the cave. I want to know everything about the cave. In that case the chances of your goddess and I coming out alive are higher. You better tell me the truth.”
“I will naturally tell you.”The priest coldly snorted: “However, I don’t want the villagers to know what happened here today. It is not a good thing for you. I hope you can understand.”
“Of course I won’t publicize it.”Dudian said. It was not good for him. The priest wanted to keep it a secret because he was worried that the villagers would attack him and cause unnecessary chaos.
After all, he had kidnapped the goddess but he was still living in the village. This was something that the villagers couldn’t tolerate.
“If there is nothing else then I will take my leave. You can ask general desolate to tell me about the underground Dragon Cave.”Dudian said. He didn’t want to stay here any longer. He felt that his life was threatened at any time.
The priest frowned but didn’t say anything. He looked at Amelia. His lips moved but he didn’t open his mouth.
Dudian stepped out of the door, suddenly he said: “In fact, we could have peacefully carried out this transaction. You want to go to the divine wall. I just need to go to the underground dragon cave to see what is going on. We don’t have much loss to each other but it is a pity that things have turned out this way!”
The priest looked at him. She didn’t think so. But things had come to this point and she couldn’t change it. She said: “If you can trust us then these things won’t happen.”
Dudian sneered. If you can trust me then why not? But he didn’t say it out. There was no point in talking about it now. He said: “Open the door.”
The priest looked at him deeply. He raised his hand and knocked on the wall. The metal door slowly opened. Dudian didn’t continue to strangle Amelia’s neck. He put his palm on her shoulder. It seemed that he was very gentle, in fact, his strength was dark. He squeezed her shoulder tightly to remind her not to play tricks.
Amelia fiercely raised her head and stared at Dudian. Dudian pulled her to go down the stairs.
The two wasteland generals who were guarding the stairs were surprised to see Dudian and Amelia come out. One of them shouted: “Please take your hand away. How can you touch the Goddess?”
Dudian didn’t speak but glanced at Amelia.
Amelia clenched her teeth but knew that she had to cooperate with Dudian. She said: “Nothing. I want to go to Mr. Dudian’s residence and teach him the teachings of God.”
The two generals looked at each other in dismay. They bowed respectfully and retreated to the side.
Dudian glanced at Amelia. He thought that she was holding a grudge and wanted to teach him? He gently exerted strength on his fingers. Amelia cried out in pain. The two generals looked up at him and quickly put away the pain on their faces, they pretended to be calm: “Nothing. I just saw a disgusting insect.”
The two generals heard her words and looked around to find the ‘disgusting worm’.
Dudian raised his eyebrows and quickly left with her.
After returning to the house, Dudian closed the door and pushed Amelia into the house: “Stay well for the next few days or you will suffer.”
“You!”Amelia was so angry that she clenched her teeth. However, she remembered that Dudian was not a person who cared about women. She angrily shut her mouth and snorted. She crossed her arms and stood in the corner of the house with her back facing Dudian.
Dudian saw her position: “Stand in the middle. Don’t leave within two meters of me.”
Amelia turned her head and angrily said: “Why?”
“Because you are a prisoner, hostage, captive and a weak mortal. Are you satisfied with this answer?”Dudian coldly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 840
chapters.content:
Chapter 840 – Chapter 830: Start The -Lsecondcupdatedate ]
“You!”Amelia felt that she was about to explode. She had never met someone who made her so angry.
Dudian sat down next to Aisha and silently calculated the way out. He was in a deadlock. From this moment until the time he entered the underground Dragon Cave and the time when he came out of the cave, he would face ambushes and traps at any time, he couldn’t relax for even a moment.
In the blink of an eye, it was evening. Amelia was hungry. She muttered to dudian: “I want to eat.”
“Endure it and wait for them to send it to you.”Dudian said. He took a bite of the blue fish and slowly chewed it.
Amelia gritted her teeth: “Don’t you have food?”
“This is mine.”Dudian frowned as he felt that she was a bit noisy.
Amelia saw Dudian’s disgusted expression and was even more annoyed. But she knew that it was impossible to get food from Dudian. She was a goddess after all, endure.
In the evening, a desolate general came to the house and knocked on the door. There was food and a book.
“The great priest asked me to give this to you.”The desolate general put the things down, “Your Highness, this is your dinner tonight.”
Dudian nodded slightly. He took the book and began to read it. Amelia quickly opened the stone basket and saw that there were several plates of exquisite meat which emitted a tempting fragrance.
Amelia’s eyes lit up as she happily picked up one plate, she said to dudian: “How about it? Do you want to eat it? It’s much more than your stupid fish. If you want to eat it, please beg me. I might be able to give you a taste.”.
Dudian didn’t raise his head: “Don’t be long-winded. Go to bed early after eating.”
Amelia sneered: “Why? Are you worried that the food is poisonous? Coward!”
As soon as she finished her words, her vision blurred. The stone plate in her hand disappeared and fell to the ground.
“I can not eat, but I can also make you unable to eat. Don’t provoke me.”Dudian said without raising his head. It seemed that the food had nothing to do with him.
Amelia was slightly stunned. She looked at the food on the ground. Her heart ached so much that she wanted to pick it up. But she thought about it and decided to forget about it. She stared at Dudian. She thought that when you fall into my hands, I will make you beg for your life.., beg for death!
She no longer paid attention to Dudian and began to eat the remaining plates of food with relish.
Dudian was gradually attracted by the things in the book. The things described in the book were about the Earth Dragon Cave. It included the date, the reason, the appearance of the desolate insects and other characteristics.
“The original date of the opening of the cave was not a special day. It was just to limit the villagers to enter the cave at will to protect the desolate insects and villagers. So there was a specific date to enter.”
“The desolate insects like blood? Where did the fresh blood come from?”
“In the outer layer of the cave, the number of the desolate insects is weak. The deeper they go, the denser they are. The desolate insects can distinguish strength according to their size. The bigger they are, the stronger they are. There are some special cases. Although they are small, but they are also very strong. Such special cases can be distinguished by the color of the tentacles on the head. The yellow ones are weaker and the red ones are stronger…”
Dudian carefully looked at it and found that although there was a lot of useful information, but there were some key things that were not explained. For example, what was the deepest part of the Earth Dragon Cave? Why did the desolate insects live in the Earth Dragon Cave, where did the desolate insects come from? Why was the Earth Dragon Cave called the Earth Dragon Cave? Was there an Earth Dragon hidden inside?
After Dudian finished reading the book, he still didn’t get an answer from the back of the book. He could only ask Amelia.
“The deepest part of the Dragon Cave? I don’t know. There are a lot of desolate insects. Do you want to go to the deepest part? Don’t look for death.”Amelia bluntly hit Dudian.
“If you don’t answer well, you may not be able to eat for the next few days.”Dudian calmly said.
Amelia stared at him. She thought that he would dare to do so! But she thought that Dudian would really dare to do so. She quickly compromised, “In fact, I don’t know. I haven’t been a goddess for long. There are many things that I haven’t learned yet. You should ask the great priest.”
Dudian stared at her: “Do you think I’m retarded or do you think you are retarded?”
“You, how can you talk like that!”Amelia was furious.
Dudian looked at her: “Forget it. We will know when we go.”
Amelia was surprised: “Do you really want to go to the deepest part of the cave?”
Dudian turned around and ignored her.
Amelia came to Dudian, she seriously said: “I advise you not to seek death. If you want to die, don’t take me with you. Don’t you want to test whether these insects can improve your strength? You Can Catch a few small ones and eat them. Why do you have to go to such a deep place to take risks? If we provoke the insects, both of us will be bitten to the bone!”
Dudian turned around again: “I know what to do. Shut up and go to sleep.”
“You!”Amelia clenched her teeth in anger.
Time passed quickly. In the blink of an eye, it was time for the opening of the Underground Dragon Cave.
Although Dudian had read in the book that the opening of the Underground Dragon Cave was not a special day. He could let the priest open it for him in advance. This would save him a lot of unnecessary trouble, but he didn’t know whether the information in the book was true or false. If he was deliberately tempted to do so, he would fall into a trap. So he was cautious and entered with the other villagers.
“I finally see the sunlight outside.”Amelia came out of the house and couldn’t help but stretch.
She and Dudian had been staying in the house all this time. They didn’t even go out of the door. It was suffocating.
“Sunlight? The light is more like it.”Dudian said as he held Aisha’s hand and put his hand on Amelia’s shoulder: “Don’t play tricks. Don’t ask for trouble.”
Amelia was a bit embarrassed as she rolled her eyes at Dudian. She was too lazy to respond. She was used to Dudian’s sarcasm these days.
After a while, the two desolate generals came in front of them: “Your Highness, the Great Priest invites you to go over.”
“Let’s go.”Amelia indifferently said. She restored the noble temperament of the goddess.
The two desolate generals looked at Dudian’s hand on her shoulder. They frowned but didn’t say anything. They bowed slightly and led the way.
Earth Dragon Cave was located on the most remote hillside in the west side of the village. There were wooden stakes inserted outside the cave. Every wooden stake was connected to a rope which sealed the place. Normally no one would come here and it was considered a forbidden area. But on this day.., it was the most lively place.
When Dudian and the goddess arrived, they saw that the open space outside the hillside was full of people. More than 90% of the people in the village had come here to observe.
“It’s the goddess. The goddess is here.”
“I heard that the goddess has been teaching the outsiders for the past few days.”
“I hope that the Outsiders can understand the teachings of God and behave well.”
“Get out of the way.”
The arrival of Dudian and Amelia quickly attracted the attention of the crowd. The crowd immediately opened up a path for Dudian and Amelia to pass through. Dudian also put his hand down from her shoulder. He whispered to her that if she played any tricks, everyone present would be buried with her.
In such a chaotic place, Amelia naturally didn’t dare to take the risk to escape. She knew that she wasn’t Dudian’s opponent. If she angered Dudian, the villagers would kill the innocent. The loss would be even greater.
“Benefactor!”Pulley shouted in the crowd.
Dudian looked over and saw pulley. He nodded to him.
Pulley saw the eyes of the surrounding crowd. He was proud and smiled.
After Dudian took Aisha and Amelia to the front of the crowd, the villagers gradually calmed down. However, they were still discussing in low voices, they also looked at Dudian and Amelia.
Not long after, the priest arrived. He read the blessing words and gave some instructions. Then he officially announced the opening of the cave.

chapters.title: Chapter 841
chapters.content:
Chapter 841 – : Chapter 831: Eating Insects [ First Update ]
“Amelia.”The priest came in front of Amelia. He looked at her deeply and whispered: “Pay attention to your safety.”
“I will.”Amelia took a deep breath. There was a serious look on her face. She slowly stepped out and said: “Let’s go in.”
Dudian looked at the priest but didn’t say anything. He took Aisha and Amelia and walked into the cave.
When they came to the front of the cave, the other villagers lined up and were ready to enter.
The cave was pitch black and the light from the top of the wall couldn’t shine in. However, Dudian could still see the inside of the cave through his night vision. There were broken stones everywhere and the walls were extremely smooth, it seemed that the mucus had dried up.
Dudian let go of Aisha and let her follow him. He held the cleaver in one hand and grabbed Amelia’s shoulder in the other. He slowly walked into the cave.
The cave was extremely quiet, but if one listened carefully, they could hear very slight friction sounds. The sound was greasy and disgusting. It seemed to be the feeling of something sticky rubbing against his body. He stared into the depths of the cave, he couldn’t see any heat source reaction, but from the subtle sound, he could tell that there was something not far in front of him.
It was his first time facing a desolate worm, so he didn’t dare to be careless. He used his X-ray vision to the extreme. Soon, he saw a few finger-long worms in the crevices of the wall seventy to eighty meters in front of him. They were gently squirming.
The worms looked like a snail without a shell. There was a fishy smell of mucus under their bodies. Their entire bodies were naked, and they didn’t seem to have any offensive power.
“Is this a desolate worm?”Dudian slowly walked over with Amelia. When they were about ten meters away from the worms, the worms seemed to be startled. They raised their heads like poisonous snakes, they turned their heads to look at Dudian’s position. The next moment, they crawled out from the gap in the nest. They were like caterpillars. But every time they arched their bodies, their bodies were stretched very long, the body that was originally as long as a finger was stretched to about half a meter long. The speed of their wriggling was extremely fast. In about ten seconds they would be in front of dudian.
“Desolate worms!”Amelia saw the wriggling worms. Her face that was full of determination showed a trace of panic but she quickly clenched her teeth, she said to dudian: “Attack! Don’t let them get close! This thing will spit corrosive liquid!”
Dudian had read about the ability of the desolate insects in books. The ability to spit corrosive liquid was just one of its abilities. Different desolate insects could spray different characteristics of liquid. Some of the liquid could frostbite people while others could corrode rocks, some of them could elongate their bodies and strangle their prey like snakes. Dudian looked at Amelia: “I’ll leave these few to you.”
Amelia was stunned. She didn’t expect that Dudian would throw this trouble to her. She wasn’t mentally prepared. After all, she had never been to the Dragon Cave. She had heard about the appearance of the desolate insects from the great god, this was the first time she had seen these ugly insects. As a girl she had a natural fear of insects. If she didn’t have a mission in her heart she would have turned around and run away.
However, Dudian was crazy to let her attack. She didn’t have any weapons!
“I, I, I…”Looking at the squirming insects that were getting closer and closer, Amelia’s legs trembled and her body moved back.
Dudian saw her appearance and slightly raised his eyebrows. He didn’t expect that as a goddess, she couldn’t even deal with a few desolate insects. Her combat ability was inferior to ordinary villagers. After all, Priory had said that.., he could deal with one or two small insects at the same time. The size of the insects in front of him was small.
The insects were getting closer and closer but Amelia was still scared. Dudian didn’t expect her. He picked up a few stones from the ground and quickly threw them out, the stones flew out at the same time but hit the insects in different positions.
All of them were hit!
However, the stones hit the worms and quickly sank down. Two of the stones accurately hit the head of the two gray-white worms which were wriggling forward, the stones sank into their bodies and their heads quickly returned to their original state. They continued to wriggle towards Dudian.
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. It was just as the books said, ordinary physical attacks were ineffective against them.
He stepped out and slightly turned his wrist. The battle in the cave was covered with several dark lights. The worms that were wriggling over were cut off. At the same time, the broken bodies were separated by Dudian. In the blink of an eye.., the five worms on the ground turned into ten. They were like snakes with broken tails. They jumped on the ground but there was no blood flowing out of the wounds.
“Go and catch them.”Dudian ordered Amelia.
Amelia was relieved to see that the worms were severely injured by Dudian. However, she felt disgusted as she saw them wriggle and jump. She held back the fear in her heart and took out a jar from her backpack, she picked up a broken body of the worm and quickly threw it into the jar. She closed the mouth of the jar. Half of the worm hit the jar.
She wiped the mucus from the finger of the worm and returned to Dudian: “It will die soon. Do you want to eat it?”
“You eat it first.”Dudian said. He had learned about the methods of using the worm from books, pulley and other villagers. The answer he got was very consistent. He washed it and ate it directly.
He didn’t pay attention to anything. He ate it just like food and then he would become stronger!
“I… I don’t want to eat it.”Amelia’s face was ugly. She didn’t want to eat it. Even if she looked at it twice, her scalp would feel numb.
Dudian coldly glanced at her: “Don’t force me to grab the whole thing and stuff it into your mouth.”
Amelia looked at Dudian’s indifferent expression and shivered. She knew that Dudian would always keep his words when he spoke to her. This man wasn’t a soft-hearted person. She clenched her teeth and felt humiliated, time passed by. The nine pieces of worms that were scattered on the ground were still jumping on the spot. Some of them were wriggling gently and were still crawling towards Dudian.
Dudian used the tip of the knife to flick away the worms that were crawling in front of him. He quietly waited for the worms in the jar to suffocate to death.
That’s right. The worms weren’t afraid of attacks but they were easily suffocated to death. In this regard, they were like most of the creatures on Earth. They were highly dependent on oxygen.
After a few minutes, the jar in Amelia’s hand gradually quieted down.
“Eat it.”Dudian urged her.
Amelia’s body slightly trembled. She hesitated for a moment and slowly opened the jar. The half of the worm was still at the bottom of the jar. It was dead and its body had recovered to the size of half of a finger.
Her face was extremely ugly. She trembled as she stretched out her finger and took out the worm. The sticky feeling on her finger made her want to vomit. She instinctively wanted to raise her head and beg Dudian. However, the cold face of Dudian flashed through her mind, she clenched her teeth and endured it. She closed her eyes and suddenly stuffed the half of the worm into her mouth. In an instant, she felt that she was about to die. The smell and the feeling made her feel more painful than death!
She chewed and the worm’s body split open. It was as if internal organs had burst out. The taste was fishy and bitter.
She felt that her stomach was churning. She couldn’t endure it any longer and vomited. She bent down and coughed. She coughed and vomited. She would vomit all the exquisite meat she had eaten in the future.
The thing that she vomited had a sour smell. Dudian frowned slightly. He took the jar from her hand and picked up another struggling worm. He threw it into the jar. He closed the lid and waited for the worm to die, he waited for her to recover.
“Your villagers have risked their lives to get what they want. Now it is in front of you. You have to know how to treasure it.”Dudian said to her.
Amelia knew that this worm was extremely precious. However, eating it was worse than killing her. She wanted to cry. At this moment she wished that she was just an ordinary girl in the village, because women didn’t need to come to the barren hole. This was a traditional rule.
Soon, she was tired of vomiting. She wiped her mouth. At this time, Dudian handed the jar to her. The worm inside was suffocated.
“Eat it.”
There was fear in Amelia’s eyes. She looked at Dudian and saw the same cold expression. She clenched her teeth and tears welled up in her eyes. She trembled as she opened the jar and took out the worm, she was about to spit out the fishy smell but this time she clenched her teeth. She closed her eyes and threw the worm into her mouth.
This time she didn’t chew much. She only chewed a few mouthfuls and swallowed it.
The moment she swallowed it she felt like she was relieved.
Dudian saw her eat it but didn’t say anything. He picked up another worm and threw it into the jar.
Seeing Dudian’s action, Amelia felt a bit broken. She clenched her teeth and her eyes were full of hatred.
After a few minutes, the worm in the jar was suffocated. When Amelia was about to take over, Dudian directly opened the jar and used two slender fingers to pick it up. He threw it into his mouth and chewed it a few times, then he swallowed it.
After eating, Dudian didn’t look at Amelia. He bent down and picked up a section of the struggling worms. He said to Amelia: “The people behind are coming. Let’s go.”
Amelia saw that Dudian’s expression didn’t change. There was shock in her eyes. After hearing his words, she subconsciously looked at the worms on the ground: “What about these?”She regretted saying it, she was afraid that Dudian would pick them up for her to eat.
“Let’s leave them to the people behind us. We will go inside and take a look.”Dudian said. He used the knife to push away the insects on the ground and walked straight towards them.
Amelia looked at the insects that were still wriggling on the rock wall. Her face was ugly as she quickly followed behind Dudian.

chapters.title: Chapter 842
chapters.content:
Chapter 842 – Chapter 832: Descendants Of The Wasteland God [ Second Watch ]
After walking for about 40-50 meters, Dudian casually cut off seven or eight more desolate insects. All of them were gray and white. Only one of them was completely black, the black insects would spit out corrosive liquid which could corrode the rocks.
Soon, a fork appeared in front of dudian. Dudian chose to go straight. This path led to the deepest part of the cave. The other path was created by the desolate insects over the years, most villagers would go to another path. For the villagers, it was enough to catch the desolate insects. Only a few proud people would go straight. They wanted to go to the deepest part of the cave to see what was going on and prove their courage.
After walking for more than twenty meters, Amelia suddenly groaned in pain. She bent down and covered her stomach.
Dudian calculated the time in his mind. It had been five or six minutes. It was time for the effect to take effect.
Generally, it would take about five to ten minutes for the effect to take effect.
Amelia curled up in pain. Her body trembled slightly. After less than ten seconds, she quieted down. She quickly stood up from the wet ground and looked at her hands in surprise.
Dudian noticed that the heat in her body had increased a lot. At first her body’s reaction was no different from that of an ordinary person. But in such a short period of time, she had reached the level of a primary hunter. He was a bit surprised, could it be that this little goddess was just an ordinary person at the beginning and didn’t deliberately hide the heat? If that was the case then the benefits brought by the waste insects were too strong!
However he thought of what priory and the other villagers had said. The first time they ate the waste insects was a very painful experience. The pain would last for about half an hour before it disappeared. Then their strength would be enhanced, the effective time would be shortened. In the later stages, the pain would only last for a few minutes. However, Amelia only had about ten seconds. The difference was too big!
“Have you never eaten this thing before?”Dudian narrowed his eyes. He suspected that Amelia was pretending. However, he thought about her vomiting reaction when she ate the worm. It didn’t seem like it unless the girl’s acting was at the Oscar level.
Amelia shook her head. She was about to answer but suddenly realized the reason why Dudian asked. She frowned and lowered her head.
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “You better answer what I ASK. Otherwise I don’t mind letting your body have more intimate contact with these worms.”
Amelia’s face changed as she looked at him: “You are so vicious. Be careful not to fall into hell!”
“That is after death. You Don’t need to worry about it.”Dudian narrowed his eyes, “It doesn’t work so fast for ordinary people. Unless you have taken it many times or you are a goddess. Although I don’t know what the basis of your village is but there should be something different from ordinary villagers. You better be honest. Otherwise, I can strip your clothes and lead the insects to you. I will let them taste the blood of the Goddess.”
“You!”Hearing Dudian’s shameless words, Amelia was so angry that her body was trembling. Her face turned white and red, “Yes, I am different from the others. So I can digest these insects faster. Are you satisfied with the answer?”
“How is it different?”Dudian asked.
Amelia wanted to stomp her feet. She wanted to keep this secret but now it seemed that she couldn’t. However, she wasn’t afraid that Dudian would abandon her even if she said it. After all, this place was not far from the cave entrance, she looked up at dudian, “I am the heir of the Aragami. I have the blood of Aragami so I can easily digest these Aragami.
