In addition, I am not afraid to tell you that these Aragami are very interested in my blood. It is your biggest mistake to bring me here because the Aragami will smell my scent. The deeper you go, the more Aragami you will encounter. You might even encounter a swarm of Aragami!”
Dudian was startled. was she a descendant of the Aragami? Was she a descendant of the god of War?
He couldn’t help but look at Amelia. The body of the god of war was more than ten meters tall. The lower half of their body was twisted. However, Amelia’s height and appearance were no different from a normal person.
“If you are a descendant of the Aragami then what is a great god Priest?”Dudian stared at her.
Amelia snorted: “Of course you are the descendant of the Aragami.”
Dudian narrowed his eyes, “Since you are the descendants of the Aragami then why haven’t you eaten the Aragami before? If you want it then you should be the strongest person here!”
Amelia’s face slightly changed. Dudian’s question was too sharp. Although Dudian’s question might be unintentional but if she answered truthfully then it would expose a lot of things including the weakness of the great god, her eyes flashed as she looked up: “I’m a goddess. Even if I’m not the strongest in the village, everyone should respect me. Why should I go against myself and eat these disgusting insects?”
“Is that so?”Dudian stared into her eyes.
The goddess also looked straight at Dudian. Time seemed to stop at this moment but Dudian’s eyes didn’t blink. It was so sharp that it seemed to pierce into the depths of her soul. Amelia’s heart thumped as she looked at him for a long time, she slowly turned her head: “You can believe it or not!”
Dudian looked at her deeply, “I have a guess. I don’t know if it is true or not. You said that you ate the first time. I believe you. But the reason why you didn’t eat the first time was not because you were disgusted but because you didn’t want to increase your strength! Because the stronger your physique was, the stronger the smell would be. The more attractive it would be to these desolate insects! At that time, the desolate insects wouldn’t stay here. That’s why you didn’t increase your strength! From this point, I can guess that the great priest is different from you. She is not a descendant of the Aragami. Otherwise, why would one be a goddess and the other a great priest?”
Amelia’s heart turned cold as she listened.
It was a hit.
She didn’t expect that Dudian’s speculation would hit the target!
Dudian was sure about her reaction. He had been trained in the giant wall for a long time. It seemed that Amelia’s acting skills were not at the Oscar level, she was a teenage girl after all. Although she was much smarter than the average person but she didn’t experience much in this small village.
“The children of the Aragami, your ancestors should be the combination of human and Aragami, right?”Dudian once again speculated.
Amelia’s body slightly trembled because Dudian was right. She looked up at Dudian and saw his dark eyes. She suddenly felt that she was completely seen through. She was disappointed and even lost, “How do you know?”This secret was not a big deal. She had no strength to argue.
“Your mind doesn’t look like a person who has lived for decades. From this point, your age is consistent with your appearance. The Aragami has been dead for hundreds of years. Your parents have given birth to you. It means that your parents are human. However, you are still considered as a descendant of the Aragami. It can only mean that you have half or even less of the blood of the Aragami in your body. It can be inferred that your ancestors are only the combination of Aragami and human.”Dudian said.
Amelia was startled for a moment. She suddenly felt that it was not difficult to guess her identity. She felt a bit better but was still angry that Dudian had seen through her so many secrets, she clenched her teeth: “What’s there to be proud about? Who said that I didn’t live for dozens of years? You Act as if you know everything. How much older than me are you?”
“You have to call me big brother even if I’m one year older.”Dudian no longer cared about her angry words. He turned around and looked around. He felt that there was a faint movement coming from the front of the cave. Something was slowly approaching, it was most likely a desolate worm.
He was about to move forward when he suddenly found that he had overlooked something.
He had eaten the desolate worm but why didn’t he react?

chapters.title: Chapter 843
chapters.content:
Chapter 843 – Chapter 833: Relapse
Dudian raised his arm and looked down at his body. He felt the changes in his body. He waited for about two minutes but still couldn’t feel any changes. His face slightly changed. He was surprised, was the desolate worm ineffective against him? Or was it because his physique was much stronger than Amelia and the other villagers?
While he was thinking, a burst of cold air was emitted from his right arm. The frozen right arm suddenly seemed to wake up. Cold blood flowed into his body and he shivered slightly, it was as if he was in an ice cave.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He immediately activated his heart and used the dragon blood technique to increase the heartbeat and blood circulation in his body. After a while, the cold air was slightly dispelled, however, the cold blood that flowed into his body through his right arm had spread throughout his body. He felt his body temperature drop. He didn’t dare to hesitate and quickly opened his backpack, he took out a bottle of white wine and drank three mouthfuls of it.
The difference between wine and water was that the wine was cold but hot after entering the body. The alcohol was burning in Dudian’s throat and chest. He felt that the chill in his body was dispelled, at least he wouldn’t shiver and his nerves wouldn’t tremble.
“What’s wrong with you?”Amelia saw Dudian’s abnormal state and asked in shock.
Dudian gently shook his body. He used muscle resonance to generate heat. His face was gloomy. He didn’t pay attention to Amelia’s words but his heart gradually sank. His right arm would only act up if it was in an extremely cold environment, normally, under his careful control, his activities were normal. But now, it suddenly acted up. The only change was that he ate the desolate worm.
In other words, the desolate worm would make the cold air in his right arm act up!
He didn’t know the reason but he didn’t feel any increase in strength. It was enough for him to confirm his judgment.
“For them, eating this worm can strengthen their physique. I ate it but it almost caused an attack of the ice blood disease. Don’t tell me I have to come back empty-handed?”Dudian thought of something, he told Amelia: “Wait here. I’ll be right back.”He didn’t wait for Amelia’s reply. He turned around and ran back half a minute later.
In the Dark Cave Amelia’s vision was very low. After eating the desolate worm, she could only see less than two meters around her body. Moreover, she couldn’t see clearly, her tensed heart relaxed when she saw Dudian appear again. She felt a sense of security which made her react. She felt that she was a bit ridiculous and pathetic.
“Where did you go?”She asked.
Dudian ignored her question: “I’m asking you. Do the people in your village have the bloodline of the Aragami? or did their ancestors have a marriage with the Aragami?”
Amelia frowned: “Why are you asking?”
“Yes or No?”Dudian’s ears twitched as he looked at her. The faint sound was getting clearer and clearer. More than fifty meters away from the corner, there were more than a dozen gray worms crawling over, there were two pitch-black worms among them.
Dudian believed that Amelia could also hear their squirming sounds. He coldly said: “You better answer honestly.”
Amelia saw the naked threat in Dudian’s eyes. She was angry and aggrieved. She gritted her teeth: “Just Say Yes.”
Although her answer was a bit angry but Dudian knew what she meant. It seemed that his speculation was correct. Most of the ancestors of the villagers had a marriage with Amelia’s ancestors, the marriage had led to the emergence of close relatives’marriage. He had learned about this from priory when he had learned about the strange marriage system, at this moment, it was basically confirmed that the villagers here could be considered as “Family”!
More or less, they had the Aragami’s genes. Amelia should be considered as the orthodox descendant of the Aragami. The other villagers were just a diversion.
This was the only explanation that could explain why Amelia and these villagers could increase their strength by eating the desolate worms, but he could not!
He had left earlier to check if the people behind him had picked up any of the desolate worms that he had cut off. The result was that all of the desolate worms had disappeared, which made him even more certain of his conjecture.
However, he still couldn’t understand why his right arm would be stimulated even if he couldn’t increase his strength after eating them?
What would the reaction be if an outsider ate the waste insects like him? Or would there be no reaction and just fill his stomach?
Amelia saw that Dudian was silent. She didn’t know if her words had exposed something. She carefully looked at dudian: “What’s wrong with you? Are You Stupid?”
Dudian looked at her: “I remember you said that the deepest part of the cave is the body of the Aragami.”
Amelia was startled: “What are you going to do?”
“I’m going to take a look.”Dudian said. He had given up on the idea of catching the Aragami to increase his strength. He had wasted a month in the village, moreover he had kidnapped the little girl and offended the entire village. However, he wasn’t afraid of further offending her. He couldn’t go back empty-handed. If he could find the remains of the Aragami in the deepest part of the cave.., it would be a great harvest!
At least the Aragami’s remains were extremely precious. A giant wall and a god’s corpse would suppress them. If he could get the Aragami’s remains then he would be able to get rid of the giant wall of Sylvia. He would be able to choose any place in the wilderness, he would then build another shelter!
And this shelter was his territory. Even God’s kingdom would not be able to find out about it. It would be convenient for him to do many things.
Even if he did not have the energy to build such a shelter after he obtained the god’s corpse, he would continue to hide inside the giant wall. With the protection of the giant wall, the god’s corpse in his hands would be of unlimited value, at least this level of things was enough to make some big figures in the Kingdom of God jealous. After all, the other giant wall had sent people to seize it.
“Let’s go.”Dudian held the saber and took Aisha with him.
Amelia’s face was ugly, “Do you want to die? The more you go in, the more the number of desolate insects will increase. I know you have the ability, but you can’t stop the insects alone. If I die, you will never get out of here. If you don’t believe me, you can try!”
“Use Your Life to try? I don’t mind.”Dudian replied without looking back.
Amelia was almost angered to death by his words. But her body was very honest and followed closely behind Dudian. She was afraid to leave the range of her body. Before entering the cave, she was ready to die with Dudian, but she was afraid to see these twisted and ferocious insects. The thought of being eaten alive by these insects made her shudder.
So her thoughts were in a mess. She instinctively followed Dudian. Her heart was still trying to find an opportunity to severely wound him.
Dudian rushed to the front of more than ten desolate insects. He quickly slashed out his sword. His body flashed like a phantom. More than ten desolate insects were cut off before they could spit out corrosive liquid and frozen liquid, at the same time, his soft body was hit on the rock wall and slid down.
Dudian didn’t look back as he walked forward: “If you don’t want to die then follow me. If I can’t Protect You Then you should be prepared to be a snack for these insects!”
Amelia’s face was ugly as if she had been awakened. She knew that Dudian would be unable to take care of her sooner or later.
“Sacrifice, glory, sacrifice, Glory…”Amelia clenched her teeth as she cheered herself up.
Both of them quickly moved forward along the cave. Dudian aimed at all the worms that were crawling on the wall and cut them off.

chapters.title: Chapter 844
chapters.content:
Chapter 844 – Chapter 834: [ First Watch ]
He went about 50 meters deep and came to a corner. Dudian looked forward but still couldn’t see the end of the cave. There were a lot of worms in the cave. They looked like dogs that had smelled strange smells, the worms squirmed out from the crevices and the wet ground. They looked up at Dudian and Amelia.
The worm was like an earthworm. It had no eyes at both ends. There was only a round hole that looked like a mouth. It looked disgusting and creepy.
Amelia’s face turned pale. She subconsciously hid behind dudian. She saw Aisha standing quietly on Dudian’s right side.
Although she knew that she was a dead body and didn’t know fear, but Amelia had a strange feeling in her heart.
The next moment, all of the worms left the nest and swarmed toward Dudian. The body of the worm that was originally the length of a finger was stretched to half a meter long. It squirmed and moved forward in a bow shape. Its speed was slightly faster than an ordinary adult’s walking speed, when the worm squirmed to four or five meters in front of dudian, it raised its body and sprayed transparent mucus from the round hole at the front end. Its speed was extremely fast and it shot toward Dudian like a water gun.
Dudian quickly rushed up and dodged the shot of the transparent mucus. He lifted the worm and cut off its body. Although he couldn’t kill it but he could restrict its movement.
The simplest way to kill the worm was to cut its body into two halves. If it was cut horizontally, it wouldn’t die on the spot. Instead, the wound would heal over time, the two parts of the body would slowly grow into two worms.
But to cut them vertically, the body of the crooked worms had to be pulled straight and fixed.
Although with Dudian’s knife skills, he could cut them in half even without fixing their bodies, but he needed to concentrate and waste more time. Therefore, cutting them in half was the best way.
Soon, Dudian cut a path through the desolate insects. He turned his hand to shake the bell and let Aisha follow him.
Amelia didn’t need Dudian to say much and quickly followed behind Aisha.
Dudian walked forward. Everywhere he passed, the bodies of the desolate insects fell on the ground and twisted.
“How Deep is it?”Dudian asked as he walked and killed.
Amelia looked at half of the insects that occasionally fell to the ground. Her face was pale: “I don’t know. But I heard that it is very deep.”
Dudian frowned slightly. At this time, he continued to go nearly fifty meters deeper. The number of insects in front of him was increasing. Some of the walls were covered with a layer of insects, dudian even thought that they were part of the wall. But when Dudian arrived, they slowly wriggled and woke up. It was as if the front wall was twisting.
In addition to the large number, the size of the desolate insects was also much larger. Dudian finally realized how courageous it was for ordinary villagers like priory to come in and hunt the desolate insects.
Whoosh!
A black worm jumped out from the side of the wall. It was like a poisonous snake. It quickly wrapped around Dudian’s thigh and stretched towards his crotch.
Dudian quickly grabbed it and pulled it down. He threw it into the cave and continued to move forward.
Hiss!
Several white worms swam towards Dudian. They didn’t move in a bow but in a snake shape. Their bodies were thick and strong like a baby’s arm. They were about one meter long and smooth, the first half of their bodies were slightly raised. The soft tissues under their bodies extended out and turned into two sharp blades. They were like mantis arms as they swam towards Dudian, their speed was faster than that of a primary hunter.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. This should be considered one of the stronger ones among the insects. Although the ordinary insects were very strong. The mucus they spat out could corrode the body and armor. But after all, their movement was slow. A normal person would be able to dodge it, but from the shape of the desolate insects, they were like killers. Ordinary people would definitely die if they encountered them. What surprised him the most was that the body of the desolate insects had changed. Its round body could suddenly produce sharp blades!
Whoosh!
Dudian waved his sword and cut off several white desolate insects that were swimming towards him. In front of a master level expert, these insects were as slow as a turtle’s speed.
Dudian picked up a broken white blade insect and said: “Open the jar.”
Amelia’s face turned pale but she quickly opened the jar in her arms.
Dudian threw the slightly twisted half of the insect into the jar. Amelia quickly closed the jar. Dudian turned around and continued to kill the insects: “You can eat it after it suffocates.”
Amelia’s face was ugly but she knew that there was no point in arguing. She could only hold the pot and follow dudian.
In the blink of an eye, they went deeper than a hundred meters.
Dudian found that the number of the worm had decreased. However, the size of the worm had increased. The grey worm that he had met outside the cave had disappeared, they were as thick as an adult’s arm and one meter long. But when they swam over, their round bodies were like machines. There were seven or eight sharp blades in their soft tissues. There were even two short wings on the back of the desolate insects, they could fly up like dragonflies that were magnified hundreds of times.
Dudian brandished his sword and quickly cut them into pieces. Although the large desolate insects were strong but their speed was similar to a limiter. In front of him they could only be considered as “Small monsters”.
“It’s so deep.”Dudian crossed the body of the worm. He calculated the distance. He had walked about 200 meters from the outside of the cave, but if it was a 200-meter tall building then one could feel the length of the building. A normal monster’s cave was at most 30 meters deep.
“Whoosh!”
There was a worm hanging upside down from the top of the cave. It suddenly spat out a mouthful of mucus and shot at the ground in front of Dudian’s feet.
However, Dudian found that the mucus touched the rock in front of his feet. It quickly dissolved and collapsed into a small pit.
He was secretly shocked. The speed of corrosion was too fast. Even the king’s water of the old era was not so terrifying?
Previously the corrosive liquid spat out by the desolate worm could only slightly corrode rocks. Dudian didn’t care much about it but this desolate worm was different. Dudian recognized its appearance and rushed up to cut it down.
Dudian cut it into three parts. He picked the middle part and threw it back to Amelia: “Eat it later.”
Amelia looked at the arm-thick part of the worm. Her face turned green. She had swallowed the white blade desolate worm which was suffocated to death. She didn’t expect to eat such a big one now.
Dudian continued to move forward.
The worms emerged from the cave one after another and swam towards Dudian.
Dudian quickly cleared the path. He noticed that almost all of the worms were rushing towards Amelia. Although Amelia had been standing behind him but the worms didn’t have eyes, they were aiming at the direction of Amelia.
It seemed that Amelia and her clansmen were able to eat the insects to become stronger. The insects were also interested in their meat quality.
Dudian walked along the winding cave. He suddenly stopped. He saw that the inner wall of the cave had suddenly expanded. It could accommodate five or six people at the same time, there was a thick dark worm coiled around it.
Dudian’s eyes focused. This was the biggest worm he had seen so far. There was no record of such a big worm in the books given by the god.
The worm seemed to be sleeping. When Dudian saw it, it seemed to have smelled something. Its body slowly moved. It raised one end of its body and looked in the direction of dudian.
“Why didn’t it leave?”Amelia’s heart jumped when she saw Dudian stop.

chapters.title: Chapter 845
chapters.content:
Chapter 845 – Chapter 835: Adversity [ Second Watch ]
Dudian looked at the slowly recovering worm and said to Amelia: “You stay here.”
Amelia saw that Dudian was about to leave. She was nervous. It was dark here. She ate two worms and her strength increased. Her vision was still limited to three to five meters. She didn’t know what Dudian had found.
Dudian held the knife and rushed towards the desolate insect.
The desolate insect was completely startled by Dudian’s action. Its body was almost three meters long. The hole on its head suddenly expanded. It opened vertically from the inside to reveal a ferocious mouth, the mouth was full of sharp teeth. The mouth was slightly opened but the inside of the mouth was pitch black. The sharp teeth extended deep into the body. It seemed that the entire body was full of sharp teeth.
It let out a sharp sound and quickly swam towards Dudian.
Dudian’s eyes narrowed. He raised the knife and cut off its head. He twisted his wrist and raised the knife to cut off the middle part of its body.
The body of the worm was cut into several pieces.
Although it was quickly dealt with but Dudian’s eyes were still solemn. The speed of this worm was extremely fast. It was faster than all the previous ones. It was comparable to the pioneer level. He didn’t know if it was the strongest worm here, if there was a stronger worm in the depths of the cave, then it was very likely to be an inner desolate or even… there might be a dominant level worm!
He didn’t dare to be careless. He turned around and shouted to Amelia: “Come here.”
Amelia heard Dudian’s voice coming from the cave. She was relieved and immediately rushed forward.
Soon, Aisha and Amelia came to Dudian’s side. The difference was that Aisha was summoned by Dudian with a bell.
Seeing that the ground was broken into several pieces of giant worms that were still wriggling, Amelia’s face was extremely pale. Her first thought was how could there be such a big worm. Her second thought was how could she eat such a big worm?
Dudian saw her eyes and said: “Do you want to try it?”
Amelia quickly shook her head like a rattle drum.
“Go!”Dudian continued to move forward. After walking for a while, the vision of the cave suddenly opened up. There was a wide cave like the underground world in front of him, there were four or five worms which were as thick as the previous ones.
Dudian was surprised. He told Amelia to wait for him and took the initiative to rush towards the worms.
The worms reacted quickly after being startled. They immediately screamed and rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s figure seemed to have split into three. His blade flashed and the few worms which were rushing towards him were quickly dealt with.
Dudian was relieved but his mood was a bit heavy. His previous guess seemed to have a faint possibility of coming true. If he encountered a dominant level insect, he would have to ensure that he would not be injured, he had to let Aisha cooperate with him to attack. However, this was the thing that he was most unwilling to do. In the wilderness, being injured would increase the probability of death to more than 70% .
The cave was very wide, as if he had returned to the village world outside the Earth Dragon Cave. The dome of the cave was more than ten meters high, and the surrounding rock walls were stained with viscous liquid. It was very wet, and there was a puddle on the ground, the water inside was jet black, and there were sharp stone cones protruding like bamboo shoots. After walking for more than ten meters, Dudian suddenly heard a rustling sound.
He stopped and listened carefully.
The sound was like the sound of scales rubbing against the ground, but the sound was dense and there were many of them.
He tried his best to look forward. Soon, there was an aghast scene at the end of his field of vision. He saw a mass of desolate insects coming from the cave in front of him. They were like a school of fish in the water, he found that there were black and thick insects. Each of them was as big as the previous ones. There were several four to five meters long giant insects among them.
Dudian’s scalp went numb. He had encountered insect swarms in the passage. He had encountered them several times because of Amelia’s attraction to the insects. However those insects were small and medium sized. Even if they were in groups they could be easily dealt with, however, the insects in front of him were different. They were comparable to pioneers. Moreover, he didn’t know what other special abilities these insects had, such as super-strong corrosive liquid or poisonous gas.
Run!
Dean turned around and pulled Amelia to run. Aisha followed closely behind him.
Soon, Dean retreated to the narrow passage outside the cave. The few giant insects that he had cut off previously seemed to have mastered half of the method of movement. They wriggled and crawled towards him, but their speed was not fast.
Dudian used the knife to cut them off and rushed into the passage. He was trying to find a solution as he ran.
The passage was full of broken worms. Some were still writhing on the ground while others were dead. However, when Dudian passed by, he immediately raised his body and stretched towards Dudian’s feet.
“Ah!”Amelia screamed.
Dudian looked at her. There was a Snow White Worm on her leg. It was wrapped around her thigh.
Dudian frowned as he swung his sword. Amelia was scared and shouted again. However the next moment she felt her leg loosen. The white worm was cut into two ends but her white thigh was not hurt.
She was relieved as she didn’t expect Dudian’s knife skills to be so accurate.
Dudian turned around and saw that the giant worms were still chasing after him. They rushed into the narrow passage.
Dudian’s face turned ugly. would these insects chase him out of the Dragon Cave?
He suddenly saw a group of small and medium sized insects in front of him. All of them had been cut off by him. He didn’t expect that in less than half an hour they would be able to move again.
Two groups of insects were attacking him from both front and back.
Dudian’s face was ugly. Although he wasn’t afraid of the small and medium-sized insects coming from the front, but there were many of them. It would take time to clean them up. Moreover, the huge group of insects behind him was imminent. He couldn’t wait.
Amelia didn’t understand what had happened. But when she saw the anxious look on Dudian’s face, her heart was a bit scared. She knew that the thing she was most worried about had happened, she heard the sound of the rear passage wall being hit. The sound was louder than the previous ones she had heard. It was like the sound of countless beasts approaching. She could imagine some terrifying images in her mind.
Was she going to be buried with him here?
There was a trace of bitterness and fear in her heart. This was her purpose for coming here. Even if she couldn’t bury Dudian with her, she could severely wound him. Moreover, the priest had already arranged the preparations outside, she would capture the severely injured Dudian and interrogate him to find out his secret and the coordinates of the wall.
This was the plan of her and the Great God. It was obvious that the plan was going to be completed. However, she was a bit afraid. She wasn’t afraid of death but she was afraid of being bitten to death by these ugly things.

chapters.title: Chapter 846
chapters.content:
Chapter 846 – Chapter 836: Fear Of Fire -Lfirstiwatchatch ]
Dudian frowned. The best way to escape was to rush out with Aisha and leave Amelia here to attract the giant Aragami. However, after the giant Aragami ate Amelia and returned to the nest.., if he went deeper, he would have to face the giant Aragami again. If he couldn’t get rid of the giant Aragami, he wouldn’t be able to get the deepest Aragami remains.
This thought flashed through his mind. He grabbed one of Amelia’s arms and used the edge of the hilt to cut off a piece of flesh. He threw it to the giant desolate insects behind him.
Amelia was in a trance and was caught off guard. The pain from her arm made her scream. She was in so much pain that tears almost fell down. She angrily shouted: “What are you doing? !”
Dudian didn’t answer. He took out a match from his waist and quickly burned it. He tore off Amelia’s sleeve to reveal her Snow White Arm. He lit the match. The material of Amelia’s clothes was very thin, it was woven from animal hair. It was very warm and easy to ignite. The sleeve was ignited and burned into a big fire before the match was finished.
Dudian quickly tore off the other sleeve of Amelia. He took out a small bottle from his backpack and threw it to her: “Apply it on the wound to stop the bleeding. Quick!”
Amelia took the bottle. She was angry and amused. However she had guessed the purpose of Dudian cutting the flesh. She rolled her eyes and opened the bottle. Dark red powder was poured out, she applied it on the wound and frowned in pain.
Dudian lit the other sleeve. He threw the half-burned sleeve to the front of the group of desolate insects. The flame flickered in the passage. The Shadow on the wall swayed like a ghost, the flame was still burning but the desolate insects quickly dispersed. They didn’t dare to get close to the flame.
Dudian was relieved. Although there was no record in the books, but since ancient times, flames were the nemesis of all life. Humans relied on flames to survive. Using Flames to disperse beasts was the knowledge of the ancient ancestors, although the desolate insects were special and had strong survival ability, they were obviously afraid of flames. After all, even microorganisms and bacteria with strong survival ability would be destroyed by the high temperature. If they were not destroyed.., it could only mean that the temperature was not high enough!
Amelia used the light from the fire to see the swarm of giant worms in front of her. Her scalp was numb and her face was blue. She forgot about the pain in her arm.
Dudian noticed that the giant worms behind him had stopped. They pounced on the piece of Amelia’s flesh that he had thrown out and bit it. The giant worms behind him swarmed over and rushed into the center of the fight, he opened his backpack and took out two pieces of black stone. He rolled the burning sleeve towards the black stone.
Amelia didn’t understand Dudian’s action: “What are you doing?”
“Take off your clothes.”Dudian ordered.
Amelia was stunned: “What… What did you say? !”
Dudian looked at her: “Take Off your clothes if you don’t want to be eaten by these things. I need burning materials.”
Amelia’s face turned red: “Why don’t you take off your clothes? You… you…”
“Really?”Dudian was too lazy to explain the reason to her. He was wearing a set of splitter armor so he couldn’t burn it. Only his underwear and underwear were combustible. But he wouldn’t take off his clothes until the last moment.
Amelia had seen Dudian’s strength and dominance. She was slightly trembling in anger. She had never exposed her arms and legs in front of a man, let alone taking off all of her clothes, she clenched her teeth: “If you want to kill me then kill me. I would rather die than be insulted by you!”
“You are quite virtuous.”Dudian glanced at her: “I will use up all of my fuel. You can do as you see fit. If I don’t take off my clothes then I will have to leave you here and let you be their dinner.”
Amelia looked up at the passage in front of her. Her sleeves were burning until the end and were about to be extinguished. From the light of the fire she could see that a large number of insects were rushing towards her. Her face was ugly as she clenched her fists, she didn’t say anything.
Dudian didn’t say anything. He blew at the two black stones. The stones were soon burned into red. He took them with him as fuel. They were necessary items in the wilderness, the effects of the two stones were more effective than first aid. After all, first aid wasn’t able to cure all kinds of injuries but fire was indispensable to human beings.
After the stones were burned red, Dudian put them behind his back. He held the knife and rushed to the front of the swarm of insects.
Whoosh!
He activated his magic body. The knife turned into mucus and covered his whole body. In the blink of an eye, he turned into a monster with sharp blades. He stood in the passage like an evil god. Countless insects rushed towards him, it was like a helicopter’s propeller. The grey insects that were three meters in front of him were cut into countless pieces.
Amelia saw Dudian’s appearance through the flames. Although she couldn’t see him clearly but the terrifying figure almost scared her out of her wits. Her heart was beating fast. She didn’t expect that she wasn’t accompanied by a human, it was a monster. No wonder it was so cold and heartless!
THUMP THUMP!
At this time, the giant worm in the passage came again. The piece of flesh that was thrown out by Amelia’s arm had been snatched away. At this moment, it was like a flood. However, when it was close to the two pieces of coal, its speed quickly decreased, then it stopped three meters away from the coal and didn’t dare to approach.
When Amelia saw this scene, her little heart that had been raised to her throat slightly relaxed. She suddenly thought of an ancient legend. She did not expect it to be true. These desolate worms were extremely afraid of flames. To be more precise, they were extremely afraid of high temperatures, that was why this cave was so deep and cold.
The huge desolate worms stopped in front of the two coal rocks, not daring to get close. Some of the desolate worms opened their huge mouths from the round hole in front of them, and sharp blades split out from the sides of their mouths. Like two mantis arms, they wriggled forward ferociously, however, when they got close to two meters or so, they quickly shrank back as if they were burned.
In fact, the temperature brought by the two pieces of coal was not high. However, it miraculously blocked the giant insects which were comparable to pioneers.
Dudian was paying attention to the movement behind him as he killed the giant insects in front of him. He was surprised to see this scene. He thought that it would be good if he could slow down the attack of these giant insects, he didn’t expect that they would stop. How Afraid of fire was he?
He thought of the black prison. It would explode at any moment. It was also extremely afraid of fire. However, the black prison was afraid of fire because its body was made of fatty oil. Moreover, the black prison was an artificial product created by the Monster Research Institute, could it be that the materials used in the creation of the black prison contained the giant insects?
The hissing sound pulled Dudian’s mind back. The scene in front of him told him that this was not the time to be distracted. He concentrated on killing the desolate insects in front of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 847
chapters.content:
Chapter 847 – Chapter 837: Guess [ Second Update ]
Plop!
Suddenly, a giant worm climbed to the top of the cave. The cave was about four meters high and the temperature of the coal was very weak. This gave the giant worm an opportunity to take advantage of the situation.
Amelia screamed and stepped back.
Dudian was scared by her scream. He turned his head and looked at the giant worm. His face slightly changed and his body quickly sprinted in the opposite direction. He came in front of the giant worm. The giant worm was killed in a second, it was cut into seven or eight pieces.
Dudian quickly retreated to the front to block the group of Worms. At the same time he shouted to Amelia: “Quickly move a few stones from the side and pile them up. Put the coal on top and let its light shine on the top.”
There was still a trace of fear on Amelia’s face. She quickly followed Dudian’s instructions and picked up a few stones from the side. But when she came in front of the coal, she was in a difficult position. The coal was burning red, how could she lift it to the top of the stone?
Dudian noticed her movements. He saw that she was in a difficult position. He couldn’t help but roll his eyes: “Don’t you know how to wrap a piece of cloth and quickly bring it to the stone? So Stupid!”
Amelia’s face turned red. She clenched her teeth and tore off a piece of cloth. With her current strength, it was easy for her to tear the cloth. If it was before, she would have to rely on her teeth to do so.
After tearing out a piece of cloth, she grabbed both ends, strangled the coal rock, and brought it to the rock. At this time, the cloth was also ignited by the coal rock. She saw the huge desolate worms climbing up the rock wall one after another, trying to find the weakest point to break in, she immediately threw the cloth towards the place where the huge desolate worms were gathered.
The Flames danced, and the huge desolate worms were thrown into chaos. They squeaked and shrieked as they retreated. However, one of them did not have the time to retreat. The burning cloth drooped on its head, and it immediately let out a painful cry as it shook crazily, it crashed into the rock wall, creating a few deep craters. Then, it slowly slid down. Its body actually softened, like a piece of melted ice. Especially the head that was drooped over by the burning cloth, its tissue actually drooped down.
Amelia did not expect that this terrifying bug would be so easily injured. She was surprised and secretly excited. However, she soon realized that fuel was a major problem. If there was enough fuel.., she felt that she could kill these insects with her own strength. But how could she get fuel in this wet cave?
She looked at her body and her face turned red again.
The coal was piled on the stone. The warm flame seemed to form a barrier that blocked the cave. The ferocious looking insects didn’t dare to come close.
After a few minutes, Dudian killed the insects that were rushing towards him. He cut them at high speed for a few minutes. He had consumed a lot of physical strength. His body was covered in sweat, he sat on the ground and slowly untied his magic body. He looked like a human again. He leaned against the wall and panted.
Amelia was relieved to see that Dudian was back to his human form. Although she knew that Dudian wasn’t a human but she felt that he could communicate with words.
“These insects seem to be afraid of fire. Should we go out and find some fuel to deal with them?”Amelia whispered.
Dudian glanced at her. It was the best way to go out and find fuel. But he was afraid that he wouldn’t have the chance to come back in. Most of the priests had already arranged an attack, he could only escape. He didn’t want to leave before he got the remains of the Aragami, “If there is nothing to burn then burn your clothes. If there is nothing to burn then I will peel off your skin and burn the oil on the stone.”
Amelia’s heart was beating fast as she heard the words. She shrank back. She felt terrible and painful as she thought about the scene of the skinning. She clenched her teeth: “If you dare to do this then I will perish with you!”
Dudian ignored her. He looked at the giant insects gathered in front of the coal. He was surprised. These giant insects were afraid of the fire. If it was two pieces of coal instead of two burning bonfires.., he could understand why they were scared. But the temperature of the small coal was enough to scare them. It was incredible!
Dudian quietly looked at them and pondered. He suddenly felt hungry. He took out some dry food from his backpack and began to eat.
Amelia saw Dudian eat and suddenly felt hungry. She looked at Dudian and wanted to ask for it. But she thought that Dudian wouldn’t give it to her, so she was too lazy to lose face.
Dudian saw her eyes: “Do you want to eat?”
Amelia saw that Dudian took the initiative to ask. She slightly raised her head: “It’s Alright.”
Dudian grabbed the thing on the ground and threw it at her: “Eat it.”
Amelia took it but found that it was a wriggling worm. She was so scared that she almost threw it out.
“This thing can increase your strength and fill your stomach. is your goddess so wasteful?”Dudian indifferently said.
Amelia stared at him and put the worm into the jar. She suddenly felt that her stomach was not so hungry.
Time passed.
Dudian finished his food and leaned against the rock wall to rest. After less than half an hour, he opened his eyes and looked at the ground filled with worms. When he looked at the ground, the rock wall next to the worm section suddenly cracked, several giant worms crawled out of it.
Dudian’s face changed as he looked back. He saw that the number of giant worms in front of the coal was much less. They had actually opened the cave and come to the other side.
Amelia also noticed and became nervous.
Dudian quickly took out a piece of coal from his backpack. He took out a towel from his backpack and lit it up. He wrapped the burning towel around the coal and put it on the stone next to it, the giant worm that drilled through the passage suddenly stopped.
Amelia was relieved when she heard Dudian say: “It seems that we are surrounded.”
“I have said before that we should rush out to find fuel before coming in. You Don’t believe me.”Amelia said in a bad tone.
Dudian glanced at her, “There are only two ways. The first is to throw you out and lead these things away. Then I will escape by myself. The second is to continue to wait here until the fuel is burned. Then I will throw you out. which do you think is better?”
“You!”Amelia was angry.
Dudian leaned against the rock wall and quietly pondered. He suddenly thought that these insects were interested in the descendants of the Aragami. Logically speaking, they should be more interested in the Aragami’s remains. After all, the descendants of the Aragami had been passed down for so many generations, the bloodline of the Aragami had long been weak. Could it be that the Aragami’s remains in the depths of the cave had been eaten up? No, if that was the case, why were these Aragami gathered here again?
But if they had not finished eating, why would they leave the Aragami remains so easily and be attracted to him?
Could it be that..

chapters.title: Chapter 848
chapters.content:
Chapter 848 – Chapter 838: Leader [ First Update ]
There must be a leader for a group of living creatures.
Dudian should have thought of this. These insects weren’t simply attracted by the smell of Amelia but were under the command of the leader, this was the most reasonable explanation.
He didn’t know the level of the leader but as long as he killed it then the rest of the insects would be easier to deal with.
Dudian stood up and said to Amelia: “Find something. Take the coal and prepare to fight with me.”
“Fight with me.”Amelia was surprised: “Do you want to go inside?”
Dudian indifferently glanced at her: “Whether you can keep up with me or not depends on your own luck.”
Amelia saw that Dudian was serious. Her heart was beating fast. If she couldn’t keep up with Dudian then she would become food for these insects. She quickly looked around the ground to find something that could cover the burning coal, but there were only stones left on the ground. She suddenly thought of the boots under her feet. She hesitated for a moment but quickly took off the boots. Her snow white feet stepped on the cold wet ground. There was a sticky feeling, it made her feel nauseous, but at the moment she couldn’t care too much.
Dudian no longer paid attention to Amelia. He turned around and looked at Aisha. There was a trace of apology in his eyes. He whispered: “I’m sorry, but I have to ask you to act again.”
Aisha was indifferent and silent.
Dudian took a deep breath, raised his hand and shook the bell. At the same time, the sword in his hand turned into mucus and covered his whole body. He entered the magic body state.
Roar!
Haisha heard the sound of the bell. The bones in her body made cracking sounds. Pure black scales spread out from her body and entered the most powerful state of the magic body.
In the blink of an eye, Dudian and Haisha turned into two ferocious monsters. They stood in the cave. Dudian no longer stayed. He rushed into the depths of the cave and passed by the coal like a Phantom, the sharp limbs of his body danced and cut the giant worm into minced meat. He was like a giant meat grinder that pushed straight through the cave.
Aisha followed him and tore the giant worm that Dudian had missed.
Amelia saw the changes in Dudian and Aisha. She was so scared that her face turned pale. She wanted to turn around and run away. However, the giant worm on the other side was eyeing them. She chose to follow Dudian in the end, although she felt that Dean was also a monster, but at least he could turn into a human and communicate with them. However, the giant worm was a pure monster. There was no possibility of communication.
Hiss!
The giant worm’s body protruded sharp thorns and screamed as it pounced towards Dean.
If other magic marks warriors encountered such a situation, even if their strength was far superior to the giant worm, they would be entangled and gradually fall into the trap. However, Dean happened to be a splitter that specialized in group attacks. The sharp limbs of the giant worm could cut through iron like mud, the toughness of the sharp blades was stronger than many legendary magic marks that were famous for defense. Although other parts were weak but Dudian had long learned to use the sharp limbs as his attack and defense weapons.
It was both a sharp blade and a shield.
The giant insects were cut into pieces as they approached Dudian. Seven or eight sharp limbs were swung like a rotating meat grinder. Soon they were pushed more than ten meters away and left a ground of minced meat.
Puff! Puff!
Dudian continued to wave the sharp limbs. As he continued to push forward, a lot of hot sweat overflowed from his body. His physical strength had not fully recovered from the previous elimination of the ordinary worms. At this moment, he was completely relying on the dragon blood technique to stimulate his heart, it made his body excited, but the more he killed, the slower he felt the killing speed. The invincible sharp limbs seemed to be gradually blunt.
More and more giant worms rushed out from the gaps of Dudian’s body, but they were torn to pieces by Aisha who was following closely behind.
When the body of the blade cut the giant worm from the side, Dudian suddenly felt that it was different. He didn’t directly cut the giant worm. When he looked at it, his pupils suddenly shrank, the edge of the body of the giant worm was covered with ice crystals. It was as if it was frozen. The coverage of the ice crystals increased the width of the blade and decreased the sharpness.
Dudian was shocked. What was the reason?
He didn’t have time to think or solve the problem. He could only continue to swing the ice crystal covered body of the giant worm. However he had to spend more effort to cut off the giant worm.
Dudian found that the other limbs were covered with ice crystals. He was paying attention to the way the limbs cut the giant worm’s body, the ice crystals would grow a little.
After knowing the reason, Dudian could only try his best to rush forward.
After four or five minutes, Dudian finally rushed out of the passage and returned to the spacious underground cave. He turned around and saw that the passage behind him was full of giant worms, there was also Amelia who was holding a coal stone with her boots.
There were pieces of Worms on Amelia’s hair and shoulders. They were still gently squirming but the girl had no time to care about them. Her face was pale as she stepped onto the ground.
Dudian looked at Aisha. She was still in the state of the magic body. She was silent like ice but her murderous aura was so strong that no one dared to provoke her.
Dudian released his magic body and was ready to take a rest. The short process of killing had completely exhausted his physical strength. If the leader of the giant worm was a master level or even an abyss level.., he would most likely be killed in an instant if he faced it in his current state. He could only stop and rest.
Amelia ran out of the passage and saw that Dudian had recovered his human body. She was relieved and poured out the coal from her boots. However, the leather boots had been burned to smoke and could no longer be worn, she used her fingers to pull off the pieces of flesh on her body and hair. She went to the side and sat down to rest. At the same time, she said to dudian: “You could have killed your way out long ago. Why did you run away before?”
Dudian told Haisha to remove her magic body. Then he sat down against the wall and closed his eyes to rest. He ignored Amelia’s words.
Seeing that Dudian ignored her again, Amelia was so angry that her mouth was puffed up. However, she didn’t dare to counterattack as casually as before. She was afraid that Dudian would attack her.
Time slowly passed in silence.
After resting for a few hours, Dudian took out dry food and water to eat.
Amelia looked at him. She knew that Dudian wouldn’t share it with her so she was too lazy to ask.
When he recovered his physical strength, Dudian got up again and entered the magic body state. Aisha also entered the attack state. He called out to Amelia and continued to walk into the depths of the cave.
This time, after walking for more than a hundred meters, he still didn’t see any desolate insects. It was expected that the desolate insects were the ones that took the initiative to attack.
After winding around a few corners of the cave, the field of vision in front of him suddenly opened up. Dean suddenly stopped. There was a bit of shock in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 849
chapters.content:
Chapter 849 – Chapter 839: Crystal Worm [ Second Update ]
There was no way to go to the end of the cave. There was a giant figure that was more than ten meters tall. Its upper body was human-like and its head was perfect, its long arms were full of temptation but its lower body was as ferocious as a spider.
Aragami!
Dudian had seen her sculpture in the village square. Her appearance was exactly the same. But what shocked Dudian was that there was a huge snake-like worm wrapped around her body!
It was a bit inappropriate to describe her as a “Worm”. After all, her size was larger than most of the beasts. The only difference was that her size was much larger, its body was crystal clear. Even in the dark and humid depths of the cave, there was no trace of sunlight.
Aragami’s remains, Aragami.
Dudian thought that the Aragami’s remains were completely eaten up. He didn’t expect that it was still intact. There was no trace of damage. It was as if the Aragami had died, it was a bit strange.
Although he couldn’t see the heat source reaction but dudian had an intuition that it was alive!
Amelia saw that Dudian had stopped. She was a bit puzzled but didn’t dare to ask Dudian. She hugged the coal and stayed behind Dudian.
Time seemed to have stopped.
Dudian looked at the Aragami and the Crystal Aragami that was wrapped around her body. He suddenly waved his two sharp limbs. He picked up a stone from the ground and threw it at the Crystal Aragami.
Dudian would have thrown the stone if the stone hadn’t been burnt.
Whoosh!
The next moment, the crystal worm that was wrapped around the Aragami’s remains suddenly twisted and dodged the stone.
The stone hit the Aragami’s body and fell down. It rolled on the ground and made a loud noise. It was particularly ear-piercing in the cold dark cave.
Dudian’s eyes sank. He swung his body but he didn’t make a move. He turned to the back of the Aragami. There was a tearing sound. Amelia felt cold all over her body. The next moment she screamed.
The clothes on her body were torn by Dudian’s sharp blade. She was naked.
Dudian took her clothes because he didn’t want to waste too much energy. The Crystal Aragami was no exception.
The Crystal Worm heard Amelia’s scream as if it was stimulated. It swam out from the remains of the Aragami and swam along the wall above her head. Its body seemed to be able to stick to the wall.
Dudian’s arm quickly recovered from the sharp blade state. He took out a match and lit up Amelia’s clothes. He used the sharp blade to hang the burning clothes as he rushed towards the crystal worm.
Suddenly the fire lit up the cave. Amelia who was naked and blushing saw the crystal worm rushing towards her from the wall. She was stunned as she saw the remains of the Aragami embedded in the wall, she stood in place.
The crystal worm was shocked as if it was frightened by Dudian’s sharp blade. Its body suddenly stopped. The next moment, white mist sprayed out from the hole in front of it. The air quickly decreased.
Dudian felt cold all over his body as he was hit by the White Mist. The cold air in his right arm seemed to recover. His right half of his body was numb. But what shocked him more was that.., the burning clothes were hit by the white mist and quickly froze!
That’s right, the flame was frozen!
If he didn’t see it with his own eyes, Dudian wouldn’t have thought that such a thing would happen. How Strong was the rapid freezing?
In addition to the burning clothes being frozen, Dudian’s clothes and other sharp blades were also quickly frozen. In the blink of an eye, half of his body was covered in ice and turned into an ice sculpture.
Plop.
The inertia and sudden freezing made him lose his balance. Fortunately, although his body was frozen, but the frozen ice seemed to be extremely tough, it didn’t break.
Whoosh!
The crystal worm on the rock wall quickly swam away but didn’t rush towards Dudian. Instead, it rushed towards Amelia who was naked in front of her chest.
Amelia saw the terrifying scene by the faint light of the frozen flame. She was so scared that she screamed and stepped back. She accidentally stepped on a stone and fell to the ground. Her smooth buttocks hit the rough ground. It was extremely painful, however, she couldn’t feel it. There was only the crystal worm that was rapidly approaching her.
Roar! !
A roar was heard. It was like a devil from hell. It was filled with murderous aura. A black whip suddenly swung. Bang! The crystal worm that pounced on Amelia was hit. Its body was tilted and it rolled seven or eight meters away.
The one who attacked was Aisha.
Aisha’s pure black eyes slightly turned. She looked at Dudian who was half frozen. She took a deep breath. Her throat that was covered with scales slightly bulged. A red light appeared. In the next moment.., a thick flame was spat out from her mouth and rolled toward Dudian.
Dudian’s frozen body quickly melted and thawed under the burning of Dragon Breath. His body quickly regained its freedom. The burning clothes on the edge of the blade were burning again. He was surprised, he didn’t know why Aisha knew that she would defrost herself first instead of pouncing directly on the crystal worm? But why didn’t she show it before?
At this moment, the situation was urgent. Dudian didn’t have time to think. He quickly threw the burning clothes at the crystal worm.
The Crystal Worm got up from the ground. It saw the fire coming. It growled and two sharp blades appeared under its body. It moved the stones on the ground and hit the burning clothes on the other side of the wall.
Dudian’s eyes were serious as he rushed towards it.
However this time he was more careful. He didn’t dare to touch the strange white mist. The white mist was beyond his understanding. It was incredible that it could freeze the flame!
The crystal worm shook its body slightly. It spat out the white mist when Dudian was less than three meters away from it.
Dudian suddenly accelerated. The Magic Wings on his back fluttered. He used all his strength to push his body to the left.
It was as if he had teleported. However, when he moved to the left, the crystal worm seemed to have calculated that he would appear here. Its body directly rushed towards him. It seemed that he was the one who took the initiative to hit the Crystal Worm!
Bang! The crystal worm hit his chest. Dudian felt as if he was hit by an extremely cold piece of ice. His chest hurt so much that he was suffocated. His body flew out and hit the other side of the wall.
When Dudian got up from the ground, he found that the shell of his chest was covered with a layer of ice. It was frozen!

chapters.title: Chapter 850
chapters.content:
Chapter 850 – Chapter 840: Response [ First Update ]
After the crystal worm hit Dudian, its body slightly cushioned and once again pounced towards Dudian. The hole at the front end cracked open, revealing a mouth full of sharp teeth. It suddenly expanded several times like a snake and was able to swallow Dudian whole.
At this time, a black shadow flashed. Dudian felt his body being moved and flew back. Aisha’s demonized figure blocked in front of him. The dragon tail gently patted the ground and confronted the crystal worm.
She was saved again.
Dean looked at her in a daze. was her consciousness awake? Before he could think, cold air suddenly spread from his chest and spread throughout his body. He hurriedly looked down and saw that the ice on the shell of his chest was spreading in all directions. Except for the shell on the surface of the shell, it was frozen, he found that the flesh under the shell, including the heart, seemed to be frozen. The blood in his body could not circulate.
His whole body quickly became cold!
He was shocked and hurriedly used the dragon blood technique to stimulate the heart. However, the heart seemed to have no response and didn’t move at all.
In medicine, if the heart suddenly stopped, people might die.
However, Dudian’s mind was clear. Although the heart stopped, but he didn’t lose consciousness. His face was ugly. He immediately used the dragon blood technique to control the blood vessels in his body. He let the blood bypass the heart and circulate back and forth in his limbs, this process was a bit difficult. It was his first time trying it. Moreover, he knew that he wouldn’t be able to hold on for long. Without the return of the heart, the oxygen in the blood would gradually be lost and become dead blood.
At this time, Aisha and the crystal worm were fighting. Aisha’s body was like a young magic dragon. Her arms turned into dragon claws and her body was covered with scales. There were four wings on her back, she had a pair of wings more than a normal magic dragon. She growled on the ground. The blood-like veins on her flesh wings were slightly hot. Then she spat out a scorching dragon flame at the crystal worm.
The crystal worm seemed to realize that Aisha was far more difficult to deal with than Dean. It was as if it was facing a great enemy. The moment Aisha’s dragon flame was out, its round body quickly rolled to the side and then slithered like a snake, it opened its mouth and spat out a crystal-like icicle.
The Icicle was extremely fast, but Aisha dodged it even faster. The four wings on her back flapped, causing her body to twist in the air and Dodge the icicle. With a bang, the icicle passed under her body and stabbed into Dean’s sharp limbs, it almost pierced through one of his sharp limbs.
The cold air emitted from the Icicle Stimulated Dean’s hair. He quickly turned his body and fell to the other side to avoid being hurt by accident.
After spitting out the icicle, the crystal worm quickly rushed towards Aisha who was rolling in the air. Sharp icicles suddenly protruded from its round body like a long hedgehog.
Aisha roared. She swung her dragon tail and angrily whipped it down, hitting the crystal worm’s body. With a bang, the crystal worm fell to the ground, creating a deep pit. Aisha’s dragon tail was also covered in blood, however, there were signs of freezing before the blood flowed out.
Aisha looked down at the crystal worm. She looked up at the crystal worm and growled as if she was angered.
The Crystal Worm got up from the ground and saw Aisha falling from the sky. It didn’t want to be outdone. It opened the hole on the top of its head and revealed its sharp teeth. It expanded several times as if it wanted to swallow Aisha.
“No!”Dean hurriedly roared.
Aisha’s zombie nature was that she was not afraid of death. Her attacks were brutal. It would be difficult for her to escape death if she tried to rush forward.
The next moment, Aisha rammed straight into the crystal worm’s mouth. Her upper body rushed into the crystal worm’s Big Mouth. The crystal worm’s body swelled up. Before the crystal worm could close its mouth, there was a bang, the lower body of the crystal worm suddenly exploded.
Dean was stunned.
Aisha’s body slowly stood up from the ground. She shook her upper body and shook off the half of the crystal worm that was holding her. The chest, neck, hair, cheeks, and other parts of her upper body were covered in wounds and blood, in the short process of being swallowed, she was almost chewed up.
Her face was cold and emotionless. Her pure black eyes looked at the half of the crystal worm that was thrown away. She screamed and suddenly opened her mouth. Her entire face was filled with blood. A mouthful of vigorous dragon flame shot out again, it hit the half of the crystal worm that was writhing on the ground.
The flame bathed on the crystal worm’s body. An ear-piercing scream sounded. The flame was extinguished in the blink of an eye. However, the body of the crystal worm that was burned by the flame quickly softened like a pool of viscous liquid.
Dudian was relieved to see that the crystal worm was defeated. He felt dizzy as his head tilted and he fainted.
He didn’t know how much time had passed. Dudian woke up in the darkness. He opened his eyes and jumped up from the ground. Soon he saw the surrounding scene. It was still the dark cave, there were Aragami’s remains embedded in the rock wall in front of him. The perfect face quietly looked down at him as if it was alive. There was a kind of unspeakable evil aura looking at him.
Dudian quickly looked around and saw Aisha sitting on the rock wall not far behind him. She was leaning against the rock wall with her eyes closed. It seemed that she was sleeping. She had touched the magic body.
Dean was relieved to see that she was fine. Then he saw Amelia. She was curled up on the other side of the wall with her hands on her knees. Her head was curled up as she secretly looked at him.
Dean was too lazy to care about her. His eyes fell on the place where the crystal worm had fallen. The crystal worm was still lying there but its body had melted into a pool of white mucus like mercury, it was motionless on the ground.
It was the first time that Dean had seen such a strange creature. He didn’t dare to approach it. At this time, he suddenly thought of his frozen chest. He looked down and found that his magic body had touched it when he was unconscious, the temperature of his chest was normal. There was no coldness at all. His heart had also resumed beating.
Did she do it?
Dean looked at Aisha. He thought of her previous actions. His heart was boiling. Was she conscious? Did she regain some consciousness?
He walked to her side and squatted down. His eyes were slightly moist. He whispered: “Can You Hear Me?”
Aisha opened her eyes and looked at him. There was no emotion in her pure black eyes.
“Can’t you talk?”
“If you can hear me, blink your eyes.”
Dean’s voice trembled slightly. He was extremely nervous.
Aisha quietly looked at him as if she didn’t hear him.
Dean’s tensed heart suddenly felt as if it was pricked. It hurt but at the same time, he felt discouraged. But he didn’t want to give up so easily, he continued: “I know that you are aware. Why Don’t you respond to me? You can do whatever you want. Can you respond to me?”
“Please.”
“Can you respond to me?”
Dudian’s face was full of eagerness and almost begged.
Aisha looked at him. She didn’t speak or react.
Dudian could only see her pure black eyes reflecting his begging face.

chapters.title: Chapter 851
chapters.content:
Chapter 851 – Chapter 841: Remind [ Second Update ]
He didn’t give up and continued to persuade her. Ten minutes later, Aisha still didn’t respond. Dean gradually became silent. After a moment, he turned his head and asked Amelia who was sitting on the other side: “What happened after I fainted?”
Amelia seemed to have expected Dean to ask, she whispered: “After you fainted, she lay on your chest. I don’t know what she was doing. It was as if she was kissing you. Then she touched the magic body and sat there. After that, it was a long time until you woke up.”
“She was lying on my chest?”Dudian’s heart was shocked. She was the one who thawed his frozen chest. It meant that she was conscious! He couldn’t help but look at her. His feelings were complicated. Why didn’t she respond to him now?
After a long time Dudian’s mood calmed down. He asked Amelia: “How Long was I unconscious?”
“I don’t know.”
“How long?”
“About seven or eight hours.”
Dudian slightly frowned. He looked up at the mercury mucus not far away and slowly walked over.
Amelia secretly looked at him. Her eyes were shining.
When Dudian was about to walk to the side of the mercury mucus, there was movement behind him. He turned his head and saw Aisha sitting upright.
Dudian was a bit puzzled. He didn’t give her any instructions. Would she adjust her sitting posture? He didn’t think much and continued to walk towards the mercury mucus. He wanted to see what the function of the mercury mucus was.
At this time, there was a sound from behind again.
Dudian looked over and saw Aisha standing up from the ground.
Dudian was slightly startled. He turned around and came in front of her: “Do you want to talk to me? Can you hear what I Said?”
Aisha quietly looked at him and didn’t say anything.
Dean repeatedly asked her several times and found that she had returned to a silent state. His heart was a bit discouraged. After repeated testing several times, there was still no response. He sighed, turned around and continued to walk towards the mercury-colored mucus.
Just as he was about to approach, there was a sound behind him. It was the sound of footsteps.
Dean looked over and saw Aisha walking towards him.
Dean looked at her in confusion. After a while, he suddenly came to his senses. He glanced at Amelia and said to her: “Is this the dead body of the worm?”
Amelia’s heart jumped when she saw Dean’s question. She quickly nodded.
Dean slightly narrowed his eyes: “Is that so? The previous worm was too big for you to swallow. This time it has melted. Come and have a taste.”
Amelia’s face changed: “What do you mean try it? Do you think it is a delicacy? I don’t want to eat it!”
“I told you to come.”Dudian narrowed his eyes: “Unless you want to eat the worms outside.”
Amelia stubbornly said: “I won’t go!”
Dudian looked at her. He looked at the pool of silver liquid in front of him and slowly took a few steps back, without looking back, he said: “This thing should not be completely dead, but I am quite curious about how it attacks people. You Go over and let me see.”
Amelia’s face changed and reluctantly said: “What did you say? This thing is already dead. I don’t want to get close to such a disgusting thing.”
Dudian came in front of her and said: “Either you go over, or I will throw you over. You choose one.”
Amelia saw Dudian’s serious expression. She was so angry that she was trembling. She clenched her fists. She stared at Aisha and said to dudian: “Yes, it is not dead. It can still move. Are you satisfied now?”
Dudian indifferently said: “Tell me how you know and how it attacked.”
Amelia clenched her teeth: “I wanted to go over to take a look but it stretched out its tentacles and almost caught me. So I know.”
Dudian understood. He glanced at her but didn’t say anything. He didn’t do anything to her because she deliberately hid the matter. He turned around and went to Aisha’s side. Aisha sat back down on the ground.
Dudian looked at her unchanged expression. His heart was a bit tender and complicated. Apparently, her previous action was to remind him that she was conscious, was to protect him. But he didn’t know why he couldn’t get a response from her, which made it difficult for him to understand. But this situation finally let him see a glimmer of hope!
“You saved me again, always saving me…”Dean held her hand and gently said.
Aisha was silent.
Dean whispered to her, telling her the feelings he had been holding in his heart for a long time. As he spoke, he suddenly saw her back. Clothes were damaged. His heart was shocked, and he immediately stretched out his head to take a look. His heart suddenly turned cold, then his heart was in pain.
Haisha’s back was a bloody mess. The spine in the middle of her snow-white skin was as ferocious as if it was dragged on the ground and scraped off a layer of blood skin. At the same time, he also found that on the soles of her feet.., the heel and other places were full of scars.
“Was it caused by the previous battle?”Dudian remembered that when she killed the crystal worm, the upper half of her body was also covered by the crystal worm. It was most likely caused by the scars at that time. His heart was in pain and he hugged her tightly.
After a while, he woke up. He wanted to give himself a slap. He quickly took out his backpack and took out the hemostatic and healing drugs. He carefully bandaged Haisha.
Ten minutes later, Dudian bandaged all the wounds on her body. He felt cold and hungry. He took out the remaining dry food from his backpack and ate a lot, he ate the rest of the dry food.
The previous continuous battle and the coma had consumed a lot of his physical strength. At the same time, the cold air in his right arm showed signs of recovery. He could only fill his stomach as much as possible to increase the amount of decomposition material in his body.
Amelia couldn’t help but clench her teeth as she saw Dudian eat. Her stomach was hungry but every time she thought of the appearance of the desolate worm, she felt that her appetite was gone, she didn’t have the appetite to swallow the disgusting thing.
“Now that you have seen the arrowworm, should we go out?”Amelia blinked her watery eyes as she looked at dudian.
“We will go out after her and I recover.”Dudian glanced at her, “If I’m not wrong, that priest should have arranged several things outside. I’m going to find some arrowworms. If she doesn’t eat the arrowworm then you should prepare to cut the meat.”
Amelia’s face changed: “You… You Want to eat me?”
Dudian stood up and ignored her. He turned and walked out.

chapters.title: Chapter 852
chapters.content:
Chapter 852 – Chapter 842: Alien Spacecraft
Dudian came to the passage outside the cave. He picked a few thick giant worms from inside and brought them back with a knife. These giant worms were still struggling gently. They were still alive.
Dudian wiped them clean and sliced them. Each piece was as thin as bacon. He handed them to Aisha.
Amelia who was sitting opposite her nervously looked at the scene. She was relieved when Aisha opened her red lips and swallowed the piece of worm meat.
If she didn’t eat the worm meat then she would eat her.
Dudian stopped and carefully looked at her changes. After all, eating and being able to eat were two different things. Aisha didn’t have the bloodline of the Aragami so it was hard to guarantee that nothing would happen to her.
After observing for a few hours, Aisha still sat quietly. There was no reaction. Dean touched her hands and feet. The temperature didn’t change. He couldn’t help but feel puzzled. was there not enough?
He fed her a few more pieces. At this time, he also felt a burst of hunger. He checked his backpack and found that the dry food had been finished. There were only two bottles of high-purity water left. He could only drink a few mouthfuls of water to alleviate the hunger, at the same time, he glanced at Amelia.
Amelia’s body trembled under Dudian’s gaze. She felt like a small sheep that had been warned by a poisonous snake. She could be entangled and swallowed at any time. Her heart was sad. was she going to be reduced to Dudian’s food? Was there any meaning to her sacrifice?
She curled up and buried her head. She was sad as she thought about her worries.
It was unknown whether it was day or night in the dark cave. After a few hours, Dudian saw that Aisha still didn’t have any reaction. He was temporarily relieved. At the moment, it seemed that the desolate worm wouldn’t have any reaction to her. As for whether it could strengthen her physique.., dudian didn’t dare to ask for more. As long as they could be used as food to help her recover as soon as possible. After all, it was inevitable that there would be a bitter battle when they left the cave. He wasn’t afraid of the power of the great priest but he was afraid that she would use some high-tech weapons such as laser guns.
A cold light flashed in his eyes.
“When I leave, do you want me to take you away or leave you here?”Dudian leaned against Aisha as he talked to Amelia.
Hearing this, Amelia’s body slightly trembled. She didn’t look up and whispered: “You can’t leave without taking me out.”
“So you are willing to be my hostage?”
“I’m just reminding you out of kindness.”Amelia calmly said.
“So you know how they will deal with me outside?”Dudian looked at her, “Do you think it’s worth it for me to use you as a hostage? You look so young. You haven’t seen the outside world. Do you think your people will remember your contribution to them when they migrate to the wall?”
Amelia’s face slightly changed as she looked up at him in anger: “Don’t talk nonsense!”
“Nonsense?”Dudian indifferently said: “I don’t think so. Do you think I will deceive you?”? In fact, I had planned to tell you the location of the wall from the beginning so that you could migrate there. Unfortunately, you didn’t believe me so you didn’t question why I was so kind. In fact, strictly speaking, I wasn’t kind. However, as a member of the wall, I never thought that it was an invasion for outsiders to enter my hometown. So I welcomed you to come. After all, the strength of numbers is great, isn’t it?”
“If you migrate to the wall, it will only promote the prosperity of the wall. Why shouldn’t I? Unfortunately, you have been here for a long time. The local resources are scarce so you think that other places are the same. But I’m sorry to tell you that the wall can support tens of millions of people. You Don’t need to worry about the resources. As long as you work hard, there will be food.”He spoke with assurance, he spoke so much that he almost believed it.
Amelia was in a daze. She knew some things about the situation inside the wall from the secrets of the clan. Dudian’s words not only included what she knew but also complemented the environment inside the wall in her mind, she slowly came back to her senses and looked at dudian: “Why didn’t you say so earlier?”
“I’ve said it from the beginning but trust is mutual. I don’t believe you. Unfortunately, you don’t have the conditions. You are so barren but you still don’t believe me. To be honest, what are you worth to plot against? Even if there is, isn’t it worth it to use your things to exchange for the future of the entire clan? Unfortunately, you have followed a foolish leader…”Dudian shrugged his shoulders.
Amelia’s face slightly changed: “Don’t say bad things about the Great God!”
Dudian glanced at her, “Although I don’t know how she will deal with me. Maybe she will kill me and you so that I won’t return to the wall and bring more people to attack you. But her worries are unnecessary. Because of her worries, I will tell her the coordinates of the wall. I hope she won’t be so stubborn.”
Amelia’s face was complicated and her eyes were flickering.
Dudian saw that her mind was moved. He knew that his goal had been achieved. He didn’t say anything but looked around. There was nothing except the remains of the Aragami. There was no feces made by the Aragami, he was a bit puzzled. Did they only eat but not vomit? He thought of another matter: “Don’t you know that the Aragami are afraid of Fire?”
Amelia recovered from her thoughts and heard a trace of contempt in Dudian’s tone, she frowned: “Of course I know. More than 200 years ago, our villagers came here with torches and torches. They used flames to kill these insects. But later on, the appearance of the flames alarmed the monsters in the deepest part of the cave. It was the crystal insect that we just met. It killed everyone who entered the cave.”
“Later on, no one dared to light the fire after they entered the cave. There were a few times when people accidentally lit the fire which would alert the group of desolate insects and bring more trouble. Later on, it was stipulated that no firestarter was allowed to enter the cave.”
Dudian understood that the fire would alert the crystal worm. No wonder they didn’t use fire when they knew that there was such a big weakness. It turned out that they had no other choice. Indeed, with the strength of the villagers, even if they brought torches.., it was a dead end if they encountered the crystal worm. The scene where the crystal worm spat out white gas to freeze the flames was still in his mind.
This scene went against the scientific concept in his mind. It was simply incredible that the flames were frozen. But later when his chest was frozen, he slowly felt a trace of abnormality. Although the temperature of the white gas was extremely low.., but he couldn’t rely on this low temperature to freeze the flame. It was a kind of sticky web that wrapped the flame. He didn’t know how to describe it. It was an attack that he had never seen before. It seemed to be frozen but it wasn’t frozen.
He even suspected that this crystal worm didn’t come from the creatures on Earth but the monsters that appeared in the world during the Apocalypse!
Dudian was still unable to find an answer. The cave was very quiet. After a long time Dudian asked Amelia: “Did you put the remains of the Aragami Here?”
Amelia looked at the huge Aragami’s remains: “Our ancestors put it here. Unfortunately the Aragami invaded and occupied this place. We couldn’t enter.”
“Where did the Aragami come from?”
“I don’t know. One day it suddenly appeared.”
“Suddenly appeared?”Dudian frowned as he felt that there were many doubts in her words, he asked again: “You are the heir of the Aragami. Since the Aragami likes your blood, it should also like the body of the Aragami. Why is she able to keep it intact?”
Amelia rolled her eyes at him: “Aragami is a supreme god. After death it will be invulnerable to hundreds of insects. What’s so strange about that?”
Dudian was speechless. was she trying to explain the science with a myth?
He couldn’t get the answer from Amelia. He was too lazy to ask any more questions. With Amelia’s age, she probably knew very little. All the secrets should be hidden in the old woman’s brain. Unfortunately.., he couldn’t pry open her mouth.
