Suddenly, he thought of something, he asked: “If I tell you the coordinates of the wall, how will you migrate to the wall? It is a long way. Even if I come alone, I would almost die several times. There are so many of you. What is the difference between you and Fireflies in the wild? You will die faster if you go out than if you stay here.”
Amelia knew that Dudian was trying to trick her. She snorted and hugged him.
Dudian looked at her, “Don’t tell me that you have something that can safely send your people to a distant place?”? “Such a thing should be a large object, right?”? “Don’t tell me that it is the thing that you live in the village?”
Amelia was shocked. She didn’t think that Dudian could guess it.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he saw her trembling body. He didn’t think that he had guessed it right.
The lighting of the village meant that there was energy. From the size and breadth of the light mosaic, Dudian had long suspected that it was a very large aircraft. From the remains of the Aragami, it could be inferred that.., this aircraft might not be made on Earth. It might be the spacecraft of the alien creatures that invaded Earth! If that was the case, Amelia and the others obviously had the authority to control the spacecraft!
“It seems that the harvest this time is bigger than imagined.”Dudian’s eyes flashed. An alien aircraft was more valuable than the Aragami’s remains. Moreover, this aircraft had energy!
“No wonder the place where you live is so gorgeous and has energy. The village is so simple.”Dudian looked at him with a smile, “You have lived here for such a long time but haven’t encountered any monster invasion. There should be a way to cover up your smell. Even if you occasionally go out to hunt and leave behind the smell. For some of the beasts you are just small ants. You are too lazy to chase after them. But you are living here. It is a good meal for the large monsters but you have failed to attract their attention. It is not only because of the protection of the Aragami right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 853
chapters.content:
Chapter 853 – Chapter 843: Hunger
Amelia’s face was pale. This was the deepest secret of their clan. She didn’t expect that not only did it catch Dudian’s attention, but it was also deduced by him. Although she felt that if she were to put herself in Dudian’s shoes, she would be able to deduce these things, however, she wasn’t as confident as Dudian. It was as if she had confirmed the fact that she had deduced. This feeling made her very disgusted. At the same time, she was very depressed. She bowed her head: “You can think whatever you want.”
She had made up her mind and wasn’t going to be tricked by Dudian.
Dudian looked at her and turned to look at the Aragami embedded in the stone wall. His eyes slightly flashed but he couldn’t figure out why the Aragami’s remains were here. If it was Amelia’s ancestors who buried the Aragami here.., why would the Aragami let the Aragami invade? Moreover, the exit of the cave extended to the village but not from the outside world. This was very intriguing.
At this time, his stomach began to growl again.
The hunger was burning his stomach. Dudian frowned slightly and looked at Aisha who was next to him. Her injury was still not effective and the medication he used was not effective on her body, she could only rely on herself to recover.
According to his understanding of undeads, the fastest way to recover was to eat. Although undeads could starve for a long time, but their body would not grow when they starved. On the contrary, their movement would be slowed because of lack of water, even the unconscious undead could not even be called “Living beings”, but even an object had its own internal circulation and needs.
Moreover, according to his notes in the monster laboratory, the way the undead digested was completely different from that of humans and other creatures. Some of the undead’s internal organs were broken or even missing, but they could still digest, the reason was that their digestive organs were not ‘individual’like the stomach, but were similar to reptiles ‘snakes’or some insects. The entire feeding passage was their digestive organs, even the throat!
This was also the reason why the sound of the undeads’roars was so hoarse. It didn’t matter whether the vocal cords were injured or not. The reason was that the vocal cords had long dissolved into a part of the digestive organs.
Dudian quietly looked at her. He felt that this time was exceptionally quiet and even had a hint of sweetness.
No matter how dangerous the environment was, with her by his side, he would always feel the warmth of spring.
He was counting the time, estimating the speed of Aisha’s digestion and absorption. From time to time, he would cut out a piece of desolate worm and feed it to her mouth. Time passed. On the other side, Amelia was so hungry that she could not bear it. The stomach acid in her stomach seemed to be digesting her body. She felt that she would be dissolved by the stomach acid, especially the soft sound of Aisha chewing, she wanted to grab a few stones and stuff them into her stomach.
Slowly, she suddenly felt that the worm was not so bad. At least when Aisha ate it, there was nothing unusual. It was as if she was just eating a normal piece of meat.
Thinking of this, she licked her dry lips and said to dudian: “Can, can you give me one?”
Dudian glanced at her: “Go and find it yourself.”
Amelia had expected that Dudian wouldn’t be so kind. She clenched her teeth and was about to get up when she suddenly thought of something. Her face turned red. She was naked at the moment. If she didn’t curl up on the ground and cover her body with her calves.., it was inevitable that her body would be exposed to Dudian if she got up at this moment. She clenched her teeth and lowered her head in anger. She didn’t say a word.
After a long time, hunger was once again invading her. She slowly thought that since dudian had already seen her, it didn’t matter if she looked at her again.
She stood up shakily. She leaned against the wall and turned to face Dudian. She covered her chest with her hand and slowly walked out of the cave. At the same time, she was prepared not to sit with Dudian.
Dudian opened half of his eyes and glanced at the direction where she left. He tracked her movement through the heat source.
He saw that she had gone to the passage. She stopped there for a while and then returned. He didn’t look at her anymore.
Several days passed.
Aisha had eaten all of the fat worms that Dudian had taken back. Aisha’s body didn’t show any signs of freezing after taking so many worms. Dudian was relieved.
After a few days of recovery, a small part of her injuries hadn’t healed. Dudian was a bit surprised. Aisha’s body could heal quickly even if she had broken her wrist, however, there were still blood marks on her back and legs as if they had just been cut open.
Dudian got up when he saw that the worms had finished eating. He felt his stomach growl again. He was cold and hungry after not eating for a few days. He even planned to eat Amelia a few times but in the end he held back.
He had killed many people but this was the first time he had eaten someone. Unless he had no choice, he didn’t plan to take this step. That meant failure.
After going around the wall, Dudian saw that Amelia was curled up on the other side of the wall. There were several pieces of worms around her. She was unconscious and didn’t have any vigilance.
Dudian went straight to the passage. He was surprised to see that most of the broken worms were gone. There was only a small stand of worms left on the ground, but they were listless and didn’t move.
“Strange!”Dudian frowned. He had noticed that even if Amelia had a big appetite, she wouldn’t be able to eat so many worms. Could it be that those worms had wriggled away?
It seemed that there was only one possibility.
He looked at the darkness in front of the passage. He gave up the idea of chasing after them. He picked up a few slightly fat worms but found that one of them was nearly two meters long, its size was almost the same as the previous giant insect. However, this insect was also lying on the ground weakly. It saw Dudian approaching and quickly raised its head to pounce on Dudian.
Dudian casually waved his sword and cut it into several pieces. He took it back but he was a bit surprised. It seemed that he didn’t miss such a big insect.
He took the worm back to Aisha and cut it into small pieces. When he cut it, he found that there were several scars on the worm’s round body, he had never seen such injuries on the worm before.
He frowned and didn’t think much. He cut out a few pieces for Aisha to eat. His stomach growled again.
He could not bear the hunger any longer. He turned his head and looked at Amelia who was sitting on the other side of the rock wall. A hint of killing intent flashed in his eyes. After a moment, the killing intent slowly subsided.
At that moment, he suddenly remembered that he still had a few pieces of Sylvia’s corpse in his backpack.
Perhaps, he could use them to satisfy his hunger?

chapters.title: Chapter 854
chapters.content:
Chapter 854 – Chapter 844:100 Years Without Decay
The idea had taken root in his mind. There were two main reasons why Dudian was carrying Sylvia’s corpse. The first reason was that if he encountered some terrifying existence in the abyss.., he would be able to use the corpse of the goddess to suppress and disperse it. The second reason was that if he encountered other giant walls along the way, he would be able to use the advanced technology to analyze the corpse of the goddess.
But now in this difficult situation, the goddess’corpse seemed to have the most primitive function as a food for hunger.
Dudian was a bit hesitant. However, when hunger hit his stomach again, he quickly stopped worrying. He got up and went around the dark silver mucus, he came to the body of the Aragami embedded in the wall. He looked up and looked at the face that was covered by dust but the contour of the face was still perfect. There was a special feeling in his heart. It seemed that she didn’t die but was temporarily asleep, she would be awakened.
He knew that the feeling was very likely to come from the dangerous aura emanating from the body of the Aragami. Even if she was dead, the dangerous feeling could still be transmitted. It was clear that the power of the Aragami was terrifying.
Dudian raised his knife and cut the legs of the lower body of the Aragami. It was as if the invincible blade had cut into a piece of hard wood. He sawed back and forth before he pulled the knife back, he cut down the previous cut.
The hardness of the Aragami’s body was almost the same as Sylvia’s. He was glad that his magic marks were from the splitter. If it was a dragon or shadow hunter then he would be helpless.
There was no blood on the limbs of the Aragami. It was the same as Sylvia’s. The blood in their bodies seemed to be coagulated in the cells of their bodies. Moreover there didn’t seem to be blood vessels in their bodies, the blood existed in every part of the body. It didn’t seem to need to enter the heart to circulate.
A few minutes later, Dudian cut off a piece of flesh that was as long as an arm. It was equivalent to the entire body of the Aragami but it was only a small wound.
“The color is the same as Sylvia’s.”Dudian carried the piece of flesh back to Haisha’s side. At this time, Haisha seemed to feel something. She slightly tilted her head and looked at Dudian, her eyes fell on the piece of flesh in Dean’s hand.
Dean was surprised to see her reaction to the flesh of the Aragami. He asked: “Do you want to eat it?”
Haisha didn’t respond. She just looked at it.
Dean thought for a moment and decided to give her a taste. But he had to see if there was any problem with the flesh of the Aragami.
Sylvia’s body was frozen in the metal cabin so it could be stored for 300 years. But the Aragami was buried in the cold underground cave. Although the temperature here was close to zero degrees Celsius.., however, it was still far from Sylvia’s freezing chamber. Although it didn’t look rotten from the outside but it was hard to guarantee that the meat inside wouldn’t go bad and grow some terrifying bacteria.
Dudian took out the pieces of Sylvia’s body from his backpack and checked them again and again. After half an hour he was surprised to find that the flesh of the Aragami was no different from Sylvia’s body. The only difference was that the surface was slightly dirty, the color, smell and hardness of the flesh were all the same!
This result made him a bit shocked. Could it be that the corpses of the god of war wouldn’t decay? Wouldn’t Sylvia’s body be embalmed in the metal freezer? Or… did the Aragami die not long ago?
Dudian dispelled the last thought. The survivors of the Abyss had been here for a long time. If the Aragami had died not long ago then at least she would have been able to rob a wall and use it as a shelter for the residents.
He pondered for a moment and finally gave up thinking. There were too many secrets in there. If he could get the top secret information of the God’s kingdom, he might be able to know everything. But with his current strength, he obviously couldn’t come into contact with them.
He cut a piece of the flesh of the Aragami. He went around the corner and came to the side of the cliff. He looked at Amelia: “Are You Hungry?”
Amelia was drowsy. She heard the sound and looked up at Dudian. The drowsiness in her eyes disappeared when she saw Dudian. She was alert as she looked at the piece of meat handed by Dudian, “What is this?”
“Don’t you recognize the meat?”
”… I mean, what kind of meat is this?”Amelia held back her anger.
“Meat that can fill your stomach.”Dudian frowned and impatiently said: “I want to kill you, but do I need to poison you?”
Amelia slightly gritted her teeth. She knew that Dudian was telling the truth, but Dudian’s attitude made her very humiliated. However, after seeing Dudian’s previous tough means, she could only be a good woman.
“So Tough!”Amelia put the piece of meat into her mouth and chewed. However, she found that she couldn’t chew it. She could only swallow it.
Dudian saw the piece of meat slide down her throat. He turned around and left. However, his eyes were focused on her body. It was like a precision instrument that was scanning her body, it included the local heat source reaction and heart rate. After two or three hours, Amelia suddenly reacted.
She clutched her stomach and curled into a ball. Her face was full of pain.
Dudian’s heart skipped a beat as he thought of her reaction when she first ate the desolate worm. Could it be that she could eat the flesh of the Aragami?
Dudian soon found that he was overthinking. Amelia didn’t hold back this time but cried out in pain. It didn’t take long for Dudian to see her crouching on the ground with her knees bent, then there was a miserable scene… diarrhea.
When she had diarrhea, Dudian saw that there was a piece of undigested flesh of the Aragami mixed with the shit.
“Indigestion?”Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. He didn’t expect this result. Amelia’s current physique was equivalent to that of a senior hunter. Her digestive ability was several times that of an ordinary person. She was unable to digest the flesh of the Aragami, was this the secret of the Aragami’s body not decaying?
After having diarrhea, Amelia seemed to be relieved. But soon, she noticed the dirt behind her. Her face turned red. She secretly glanced at Dudian’s side. She couldn’t see Dudian through the wall, she didn’t know if Dudian had noticed or smelled the smell of the dirt. But she felt that it shouldn’t be able to escape Dudian’s nose.
She clenched her teeth and gently moved the worm to the other side. She was still feeling ashamed and angry.
Dudian observed her for another two hours. He was relieved to see that she didn’t have any discomfort. He cut off a small piece and threw it into his mouth to chew. He wanted to use Amelia to test the poison. After all.., this was a corpse that had lived for hundreds of years. If he ate it, it was hard to guarantee that he wouldn’t get food poisoning. Although Amelia hadn’t digested the piece of flesh of the Aragami, but it had stayed in her stomach for so long. If it was poisoned.., she would definitely react. From her behavior, this piece of Aragami’s flesh should be considered safe food.

chapters.title: Chapter 855
chapters.content:
Chapter 855 – Chapter 845: Sojourn
After confirming that the flesh and blood of the Aragami wasn’t poisonous, Dudian couldn’t wait to eat the whole piece of flesh in his hand. However, his rationality restrained him. He cut off a small piece of finger, he tasted it in his mouth. It was a bit fishy. He tried to chew it slowly. The piece of flesh was extremely tough but he was the master. The bite force was far superior to that of Amelia.
After chewing for a few minutes, he chewed the meat and slowly swallowed part of it.
The feeling of hunger was alleviated as the meat entered his stomach. He leaned against the rock wall and quietly recuperated.
A few hours passed but Dudian didn’t feel any discomfort. The hunger in his stomach once again hit him. He cut off a small piece and ate it. He continued to rest to save energy.
In the blink of an eye, another two days passed.
During this time, Dudian ate a small piece of the flesh of the Aragami to relieve his hunger. Although he ate a few pieces of meat, his body still didn’t feel any discomfort. There was no other reaction. But after all, this was the flesh of the Aragami that hadn’t rotted for hundreds of years. It came from an unknown Aragami. He didn’t dare to eat too much, as long as he could survive this difficult period.
Haisha’s injuries were slowly recovering. Dudian estimated that she would recover in two or three days.
Amelia stayed on the other side. She seemed to have slowly adapted to the smell of the desolate worm. She went out to look for food. The amount of food she ate was getting more and more. Her physique was getting stronger and stronger. In just a few days she had reached the level of a high-level limit, it was faster than consuming the god’s marrow. Dudian was both envious and regretful. If he could also eat the waste insects to strengthen his constitution then he would have reached the level of the abyss. He would be stronger than ordinary Abyss Walkers!
The cave was filled with the smell of blood and excrement. Fortunately Dudian was used to it as he had been in the toilet for a long time. Amelia didn’t feel embarrassed anymore, after all, the most embarrassing scene was seen by Dudian. It seemed that her temperament had grown a lot in just a few days. She no longer cared about Dudian’s attitude and was no longer easily angered by him.
The three of them stayed in the dark cave and allowed time to pass.
Dudian couldn’t endure the hunger. He skillfully took out a knife and cut off a piece of the flesh of the Aragami. He slowly chewed and swallowed it. Then he closed his eyes to rest.
Half an hour later, Dudian suddenly felt hot all over his body. He was sweating. He opened his eyes in surprise. He looked down to inspect his body. He had been staying in the cold cave for the past few days, the cold air in his right arm would move from time to time. But at this moment, the cold air in his right arm seemed to have disappeared. He didn’t feel cold at all. It was as if he had recovered from the previous ice blood disease.
He looked at his chest and abdomen. Under the surface of his skin, there were complex blood vessels, meridians, and bones. The first thing he looked at was his internal organs. Other than stomach acid and undigested pieces of Aragami meat, there was nothing else, he heaved a sigh of relief, but in the next moment, his expression suddenly changed. He stood up abruptly from the ground, took off the armor on his body, and turned his hand to touch his back.
His movement was very fast. He immediately felt a protruding sarcoma on his back. He was shocked.
At first, he thought that it was a worm that crawled into his armor, but he didn’t expect that the crawling feeling came from the protruding thing under his skin.
When his fingers touched the protruding sarcoma, the sarcoma seemed to have a life of its own. It quickly crawled toward the back of his neck. The squirming feeling was like a naked worm running on his back.
Dudian’s face changed as he twisted his palm. He quickly pressed the sarcoma and blocked its path.
However, when his palm pressed down on the sarcoma, the sarcoma suddenly sank into the depths of his skin.
The sudden appearance of the sarcoma frightened Dudian. Even though he had always been calm, he was frightened by this strange situation. The most important thing was that he smelled the smell of danger and death.
The sarcoma disappeared. He didn’t dare to stop and wait for it to reappear. He immediately squatted down and took off his armor. He leaned against the wall behind him. The Heart Protection Mirror in the middle of the armor reflected light. His field of vision was 270 degrees, his head was slightly tilted. He could see the situation of his back through the heart protection mirror in the armor. He quickly saw that there was a fist-sized sarcoma lying quietly on his back, the color of the sarcoma was very strange. It was golden like liquid metal.
He was very clear about his physical condition. This golden sarcoma had never appeared before. Could it be caused by eating the flesh of the Aragami?
He could only think of one possibility. His face turned pale. He had been eating the flesh of the Aragami for the past few days. He had gradually relaxed but he didn’t expect such a sudden change.
“I have to dig this thing out.”Dudian didn’t dare to let the thing stay in his body. He was scared because of the fast movement of the thing. He immediately took out the dagger from his leggings and stabbed it.
Puff!
He was very fast. The dagger stabbed into his skin and went straight through it. However the moment his skin was pressed, the golden sarcoma quickly slid forward as if it was in danger. It went straight up his spine and slid towards the back of his neck.
Dudian’s face changed. He immediately grabbed the back of the neck and pressed hard. The flesh on the back of the neck was firmly pressed against the cervical vertebrae. In this position, his arm was twisted in a nearly broken position. It looked extremely terrifying.
The golden sarcoma rushed to the front of the back of the neck. It seemed to feel that there was no way forward. It suddenly turned and went around Dudian’s throat. It continued to rush up.
The head was going up.
It was going to enter his brain!
It was an extremely terrifying feeling. Dudian didn’t even think about it. He waved the dagger to cut his throat. This time he used the fastest speed. Puff! The blade cut through his throat, his throat was also broken. The next moment his fingers were like hooks. He reached into his throat and grabbed the golden sarcoma.
The movement was as fast as lightning. But the reaction of the golden sarcoma was much faster than what Dudian had imagined. As he cut his throat, the golden sarcoma quickly retreated and sank into his chest. It seemed that it was accumulating power.
Dudian’s face was ugly. He covered his throat which was bleeding non-stop. If he didn’t rely on his self-healing ability, he wouldn’t have died even if his throat was cut. He wouldn’t have cut his throat so decisively. He only needed to hesitate for a moment, it was very likely that the thing had drilled into his head. At that time he couldn’t imagine what would happen. This feeling reminded him of the first time he got the Splitter’s magic marks.
At that time when the splitter’s parasitic soul worm entered his body it was also a living thing. It rushed towards his brain. Fortunately he was able to stop it in time so the parasitic soul worm had to retreat and return to his chest to live in the magic marks.
He covered his throat to stop the bleeding. At the same time, he looked at the golden sarcoma on his chest. His heart was full of regret. He shouldn’t have eaten the flesh of the Aragami and put himself in such a dangerous situation. However, it was useless to regret now, people would always regret when they encounter worse things. They would rather go back to the previous situation. Perhaps when the worse situation appeared, he would be glad that the current situation was good enough.
The golden sarcoma stayed in his chest for a while. Then it suddenly moved fast again and slid to the back of Dudian’s neck.
Dudian immediately swung the dagger and cut open the back of his neck. As long as it passed by, he would be able to take it out.
The golden sarcoma seemed to be “Aware”of this. It quickly stopped and then slowly sank. After a while, it quickly rushed to Dudian’s throat again.
Dudian used his hands to block the throat and waited for it to attack.
The golden sarcoma stopped halfway and then continued to turn to the back of the neck.
Dudian used both hands to cover the neck. Blood gushed out and dyed his palms red. He felt weaker and weaker. There was a trace of anxiety in his heart. He slowly used his fingers to repair the wound on his throat, at the same time, he felt that his brain was dizzy due to lack of oxygen.
After repeated attempts, the golden sarcoma seemed to know that it was too risky to rush to Dudian’s head. It sank again but didn’t stop. This time it directly rushed to Dudian’s chest where the magic marks of the splitter were, the next moment, Dudian felt that the magic marks of the splitter on his chest seemed to come back to life. It gently squirmed and confronted the golden sarcoma.
Dudian’s face was full of shock as his mind almost went blank.
In his impression, the splitter’s parasitic soul worm had already died and become a magic mark. But at this moment, it had come back to life!
However, although it had “Come back to life”, Dudian found that it didn’t return to the appearance of a parasitic soul worm. Instead, it turned into a dark mucus-like strip. It looked like a worm but also like a pool of conscious mucus, it didn’t give way to the golden sarcoma.
The golden sarcoma didn’t hesitate and quickly pounced on it. The sarcoma turned into a pool of golden mucus and entangled with the magic marks.
The next moment, the dark black magic marks were entangled by the golden liquid. The area of the golden liquid was increasing but the dark black magic marks were getting smaller and smaller until they were completely wrapped. It was as if they were swallowed and disappeared.
Dudian was stunned. He quickly thought of one thing. Could it be that his magic marks were swallowed? Could he enter the magic body of the splitter? Dudian was worried. He wanted to enter the magic body to verify. However he thought that if he entered the magic body then his body’s structure would change. If the golden sarcoma took advantage of this gap to enter his brain then he might not be able to stop it in time.
He endured the verification and continued to watch.
He saw that the golden sarcoma didn’t change in size after it wrapped the magic mark. It paused for a moment then suddenly turned and rushed towards his right arm.
At this time, Dudian felt the cold air in his right arm as if it had come back to life. It was so cold that his body was trembling.
The golden sarcoma quickly came to his right shoulder. It didn’t hesitate and directly rushed into his arm.
The tissue in his right arm was completely crystallized. It looked like a transparent ice block. When the golden sarcoma rushed in, the cold air in his arm became even thicker. It was as if he had been invaded by an enemy, the bones in his arm were protruding with sharp ice spikes.
This scene was too strange. It was as if his right arm was conscious.
Dudian was at a loss. Soon, he saw that the cold air in his right arm covered the surface of the golden sarcoma. There were faint signs of ice. The golden sarcoma seemed to feel that something was wrong. It stopped and withdrew in the opposite direction.
When it retracted back to his right shoulder, the surface had completely frozen. It stopped. Then the cold air on the surface became thicker and thicker. It completely froze on his right shoulder.
This series of changes made Dudian’s heart skip a beat. At the same time, he felt waves of cold. First, there was the inexplicable appearance of this kind of bacteria-like golden sarcoma in his body. Then there was the “Conscious”change in his right arm, he felt that he couldn’t understand his own body. However, the change in his right arm could be a reaction of stress, just like how water would boil when it was heated.
If it was a reaction of stress, why would the golden sarcoma stimulate his right arm?
At this time, there was a dizziness in front of his eyes. Dudian quickly took out the first-aid medicine from his backpack and smeared it on his throat. After a while, his cut throat and crushed throat gradually showed signs of healing, the first aid medicine he brought were the top healing medicines in the giant wall. It was not an exaggeration to say that they were divine medicines.
While his throat was healing, Dudian stared at the frozen golden sarcoma on his right arm. He was lost in thought.
The cold air in his right arm was caused by the overconsumption of cold crystals in the brain of the undeads. The golden sarcoma should have appeared after eating the flesh of the Aragami. The cold air would be stimulated by the golden sarcoma. There should be some connection between the two.
After a long time Dudian suddenly woke up. He thought of the magic marks of the splitter which he had swallowed. He looked at his chest. The magic mark was gone. There was only a faint black mark. He quickly grabbed the blade, he entered the magic body in the same way as before.
Soon, the blade melted and turned into mucus which covered his body. The next moment, the familiar feeling of power covered his body. Dudian entered the magic body state again. He was relieved but soon he found that.., his right arm didn’t turn into the splitter’s sharp blade. Instead, the ice crystal had become more serious. His arm had become one meter long. His fingers were no longer visible. Instead, it was an ice claw!

chapters.title: Chapter 856
chapters.content:
Chapter 856 – Chapter 846: The Power Of Palpitation [ First Update ]
“How…”Dudian looked at the ugly claw. He was confused and confused. His right arm was still in the shape of an ice crystal arm, it was a monster’s claw. Although it wasn’t unusual for him to have a monster’s body but why could the monster’s body affect the ice crystal transformation of his right arm?
He raised his right arm and rotated his fingers. Although his entire arm was like a hard ice block, but his fingers moved freely. There was no effect but he couldn’t feel it. If his eyes didn’t see the fingers moving according to his will.., he couldn’t even feel his fingers moving.
Ice was fragile. Dudian didn’t know how much strength the ice claw could withstand. He raised his hand and gently patted the rock wall. He controlled the strength and first tested the hardness of the ice claw.
Bang! !
Suddenly there was a loud sound.
The sound was so loud that Dudian who was mentally prepared didn’t expect it. He was shocked as he looked at the scene in front of him. His Ice Claw didn’t break but the rock wall, there was a claw mark that was half a meter deep. It was ferocious and cold. It looked like the mark left by a monster’s claw.
A few seconds later, Dudian came back to his senses. His eyes were full of shock. Only he knew how much strength he had used just now, it was very easy to break the ice with the thickness of the ice claw. Moreover, there were weak joints on the ice claw. Therefore, he had only used a very light force. It was so light that he just wanted to touch it.
However, the result gave him a shock. He could not help but reach out his sharp blade and touch the claw gouges on the rock wall. The sharp blade had a sense of perception. The clear and rough feeling that came from it let him know that he was not hallucinating.
He could not help but look at his ice claw. Could it be that there was no sense of perception and his control of the force was somewhat fuzzy? He had used a lot of strength just now?
But he had already grasped the strength of his right arm very accurately when he was carving every day.
He thought for a moment and felt that it was necessary to test it again.
He raised his sharp blade limb and came to the rock wall at the side. He tried to use medium strength to slash out. Bang Bang, a few hoarse friction sounds rang out. Three cuts were made on the rock wall. Due to the sharpness of the blade, the cuts were very thin, it was more than half a meter deep. It was similar to the depth of the ice claw but the area of damage was far from it. In addition to the scratches, the ice claw had dented the wall, the body of the blade had only left three deep and thin scratches on the wall.
Dudian was aware of the situation. He raised the ice claw again and came to the other side of the wall.
“What are you doing?”Amelia poked out half of her head from the corner. She looked at Dudian’s enchanted body. She wasn’t afraid but curiously asked.
Dudian turned his dark golden pupils to look at her: “It’s none of your business. Go back.”
Amelia frowned slightly. She looked at him but didn’t say anything. She stepped back.
Dudian retracted his eyes. This time he was going to use medium strength.
Bang! !
A loud explosion was heard.
Dudian’s eyelids twitched as he looked at the cracked rock wall. It seemed that the entire rock wall was about to be split by the claw marks. The entire protruding rock wall had caved in. It looked like a super heavy truck had crashed into it.
Dudian quickly reacted and looked at his right hand. He was relieved when he saw that the ice claw didn’t break. He looked up and carefully observed the collapsed rock wall. His eyes slowly revealed shock, his strength control was correct. In his mind, the right hand and the sharp blade were the same strength but the damage was more than ten times different!
This could only mean that his right arm was too developed and stronger than any part of his body!
He didn’t continue to try. His eyes went back to his right arm and penetrated into it. His face slightly changed as he saw that there was a faint golden color on the frozen golden sarcoma, it was as if it was dyed.
“Is this thing going to merge with my right arm? Or is it not completely frozen? is it going to disperse and gradually move?”Dudian’s face turned ugly, he wasn’t happy at all because of the strange power from his right arm. He pondered for a moment and finally made up his mind. He was ready to cut out the golden sarcoma on his right shoulder. Although he guessed that the terrifying strange power of his right arm.., it was very likely related to this golden sarcoma. After cutting out the golden sarcoma, the strange power might also disappear. However, he did not dare to be greedy for the power that he had obtained!
He could still clearly see the golden sarcoma rushing toward his brain. Fortunately, the golden sarcoma was frozen by the cold air in his right arm. Otherwise, he did not dare to imagine how long he could hold on. Perhaps it had already entered his brain by now, this made him have a lot of terrifying associations.
He took a deep breath and raised his sharp limbs. He slightly gathered strength and suddenly stabbed towards the golden sarcoma on his right shoulder.
Clang! Bang!
Two sounds were produced almost at the same time. The first sound was caused by the sharp blade stabbing into the frozen right shoulder. The second sound was caused by the sharp blade sliding down from the right shoulder and stabbing into the ground.
Dudian’s face changed. He looked at the intact right shoulder in a daze.
The indestructible cutting blade couldn’t break his right shoulder?
What kind of hardness was this?
Dudian woke up after a few seconds. There was a trace of panic and fear in his heart. He raised the four most powerful limbs on his back. He aimed at his right shoulder and fiercely stabbed.
Bang!
Dudian’s body fell to the ground and made a dent in the ground.
A cold feeling came from the front of the limbs. Dudian looked at his right shoulder. His heart sank. It was the same as what he felt on the blade. It didn’t Pierce through his right shoulder. Instead, the huge force knocked him down.
His heart was cold to the bone. Could it be that he could only let the golden sarcoma stay in his right arm? But now it was showing signs of melting and spreading. If it was removed from his right arm and returned to his body, wouldn’t his nightmare come?
He couldn’t accept such a thing. He clenched his teeth and stood up. He waved the sharp blades around his body and stabbed towards his right shoulder again.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
He tried seven or eight times in a row and fell seven or eight times. He looked at his right shoulder which was still intact. There were only a few shallow scratches on it. Dudian’s face was ashen. He slowly stood up as he thought to himself. Should he completely abandon his right arm?
But in this case, he would only have one arm. Although his magic body of the splitter had other sharp limbs as support. It was like an arm. Losing an arm was not a big deal but it would eventually cause irreparable damage, if he met another master, it was very likely that he would lose to the other party because of the loss of this arm.
He hesitated in his heart but he didn’t want to let the strange golden sarcoma stay in his body.
He silently leaned against the rock wall, his thoughts in a mess.
After a long, long time.
He still made a decision.
Judging from the changes in his right shoulder, the golden sarcoma should not be able to come out from his right shoulder in a short time. After he left the Earth Dragon Cave, he would most likely face a tough battle. It would undoubtedly be very disadvantageous for him to cut off his right arm at this time, he had to at least survive this hurdle.
He decided to perform an operation on himself, the isolation surgery!
However, with the conditions in the cave, it was obvious that he would not be able to complete this surgery. He had to rely on the items in this village. If the alien spaceship that he had guessed had relatively high-tech medical equipment.., and if he happened to know how to use it, it would be able to help him complete this internal isolation surgery.
After making the decision, he sat on the ground as if he had been relieved of a heavy burden. He felt cold sweat all over his body, but there was a trace of disappointment in his heart. He had already turned himself into this person who was neither human nor ghost in pursuit of survival and strength, he did not know what his future would be like. Or rather, did he have a future?
This thought was a little negative and made him feel depressed. He turned his head to look at Aisha who was sitting quietly beside him. Her face, which had always been quiet and beautiful, was like a snow lotus blooming in the dark and cold cave, illuminating his eyes.
Fortunately, no matter how bad it was, he had you by his side..
A faint smile appeared on his face, but his heart became more and more determined. No matter what, he had to hold on until she recovered.

chapters.title: Chapter 857
chapters.content:
Chapter 857 – Chapter 847: Coming Out Of The Cave
Dudian didn’t dare to eat the flesh of the Aragami in the following days in order to avoid stimulating the golden sarcoma in his right shoulder. Without the flesh of the Aragami, Dudian also lost his source of food. Fortunately, he could see that Haisha’s wound would heal in a day or two at most. By then, he would be able to leave the place. If her healing time was longer.., it would take four to five days. He had to consider whether or not he should make an exception and get “Ingredients”from Amelia.
Seeing that the day of the hole was coming, Dudian also began to prepare. He took the sealed jar from Amelia to suffocate the Aragami. He came to the edge of the pool of mercury-silver mucus. He was only two meters away from it, the mucus began to squirm slightly. It seemed to sense the smell of life. The silver mucus that was as thick as a finger protruded from the edge and reached towards Dudian’s feet.
Dudian’s eyes turned serious. The crystal worm was not only different from the other worms in terms of physique but also in terms of ability and vitality, the Crystal Worm would die when its body was cut open. However the crystal worm maintained a terrifying vitality as it melted into the slime. It seemed that as long as it was nourished by fresh blood and flesh it would be able to recover.
Moreover, Dudian had thought of a problem that he had overlooked. The remains of the Aragami were well preserved. What would the Aragami feed on in this bare cave?
This pool of mucus had been here for several days and hadn’t eaten anything. Could it be that it could maintain a long feeding time without moving?
Dudian opened the sealed jar and put it on the ground. He picked up the knife and stabbed it into the silver mucus. It felt like he was stabbing into an unimpeded water. The tip of the knife stabbed into the soil.
Dudian quickly moved but found that the characteristics of the mucus were very similar to that of water. No matter how he cut it, in the blink of an eye it would stick together and still squirm.
No matter how sharp the knife was, it couldn’t cut the soft water.
Dudian saw that he couldn’t hurt it so he simply changed the method and moved it into the jar.
Fortunately, the mucus was soft like water so it was easy for Dudian to move it. Although the process was a bit cumbersome and there was no spoon or other suitable tools, but with a wider knife.., dudian smoothly moved the mucus around the pot. He cut a hole next to the pot and moved the pot in. The mouth of the pot was level with the ground. Then he moved the mucus into the mouth of the pot.
During this process, from time to time, silver tentacles stretched out from the mucus towards Dudian. But Dudian used the knife to hit them down and sank them into the mucus.
Half an hour later, Dudian moved all the silver mucus into the pot. When the last bit was in the pot, Dudian didn’t wait for it to climb out again. He quickly covered the pot and pressed it to death.
When the pot was pressed to death, Dudian clearly felt that the inside of the pot was trembling. The pot gently shook but the force was not strong. The impact lasted for a while and then stopped.
Dudian dug out the jar and put it aside. He didn’t open it to check. He didn’t care if it was dead or alive. If there were conditions, he would like to use it to study. But in his current situation.., it would be good if he could take this thing away from here.
Although the crystal worm was big, but there was not much mucus after melting. It was like it had been concentrated. It was enough to fill the jar with the size of a basketball. It saved a lot of space for Dudian.
Dudian looked at the Aragami embedded in the rock wall. There was something strange in his eyes but he didn’t know what it was. However he was thinking about.., how to take it away.
The Aragami was about ten meters tall. It was impossible to carry it away. Moreover the smell of the Aragami could attract terrifying things from the abyss. It had to be sealed in a bag or a box, just like the few pieces of Sylvia meat that he carried with him.
He came before the Aragami thoughtfully and looked at the left and right sides. He estimated the thickness of this Aragami’s body and calculated silently in his heart. His backpack was three meters tall, two meters thick, and two meters wide, the backpack that was used for hunting outside the giant wall could be considered to be the largest one. If this Aragami was placed into it, it would naturally not be able to fit in. However, he was considering whether he could cut her up and dispose of her into neat pieces of meat, he would then pile it into the backpack.
However, looking at the thickness of the Aragami’s body, especially the size of its lower body, it was still a bit difficult to fit it in his backpack.
After thinking for a while, he decided to keep the intact body of the Aragami for the time being. It was a big headache for him to leave this place.
Two days passed in the blink of an eye.
Haisha’s injuries were finally fully recovered. Dudian didn’t cut off all of the Aragami’s limbs. Instead, he cut off a part of the Aragami’s limbs that looked like spider legs. He put it into his backpack and took Amelia and Haisha with him, he was ready to explore the outside of the cave.
After leaving the depths of the cave, Dudian returned to the passage. He found something strange. There were only small pieces of the giant Aragami’s limbs that he had cut off. The entire passage seemed very empty, when he rushed out of the passage, the limbs of the giant worm were piled up to half a meter high. It was almost impossible to move.
Dudian looked at Amelia and frowned: “What’s Going On?”
Amelia blinked her eyes and innocently said: “How do I Know?”
“You ate it?”Dudian squinted his eyes. He noticed that Amelia’s physique had reached the level of a pioneer. The speed of improvement was like a rocket. He suspected that if she ate it.., she would become an Abyss Walker in this cave!
Amelia rolled her eyes, “Even if I was a pig, I wouldn’t be able to eat so much!”! “When I came to take it, I found that a lot of the worms had disappeared. Every time I came to take it, I saw a large part of them disappear. I guess they have climbed into the passage to hide.”
Dudian frowned slightly. He looked at the depths of the passage. Indeed, he hadn’t seen Amelia leave the cave many times in the past few days. Even if she ate day and night, she wouldn’t be able to eat so many worms, moreover, although she was used to the desolate insects but she wasn’t willing to eat them. Her appetite was limited.
He stepped into the passage and slowly moved forward. He found that the number of desolate insects was decreasing. When he reached the passage which he used to block with coal, he found that the ordinary desolate insects which he had crushed in the passage were gone, the ground was very empty. There were only some gaps and grooves in the rock wall. There were some finger-sized desolate insects which were crawling weakly inside.
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. This situation was a bit strange. Could it be that other villagers had come in from behind?
However, there was no trace of other people’s smell.
He pondered for a moment and continued to move forward along the passage.
After walking for a while, he suddenly saw a large dent on the ground. It was about half a meter wide. It seemed to be caused by something round. He squatted down and touched the Dent. It was sticky and smelled, it was the smell of the mucus on the desolate worm’s body.
A hint of shock flashed in his eyes. He raised his head and looked into the darkness in front of him along with the Dent.

chapters.title: Chapter 858
chapters.content:
Chapter 858 – Chapter 848: Laser Cannon
“Could it be that there is a giant worm here?”Amelia’s eyes were full of doubt. She also saw the huge dent on the ground. There seemed to be no other monsters in the cave.
Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed. He pondered for a moment and continued to move forward.
The skid mark moved along the passage until it reached the fork in front of the passage. The skid mark turned to the other side of the dead end passage. This passage was also the place where the villagers explored. The depth was short and the habitat of the worm was small.
Dudian looked at the skid mark which was sliding towards the passage. He used his thermal vision to scan the passage. There was no heat source reaction. The villagers should have retreated long ago. The usual exploration time was half a day, after all, the passage was only a few hundred meters deep. If it wasn’t for the dangers lurking inside, half a day would be enough to come in hundreds of times.
“Let’s not go?”Amelia secretly looked at dudian.
Dudian nodded slightly. Even if Amelia didn’t say it, he wouldn’t track the thing that was suspected to be a super giant worm. From the slippage, it could be predicted that its size was bigger than that crystal worm, even if its strength wasn’t dominant, it was at least at the inner barren level. This worm was useless to him. Killing it would be a waste of his physical strength.
There was a trace of surprise in Amelia’s eyes as she saw Dudian listen to her proposal. She couldn’t help but look at him twice.
Dudian walked straight along the passage. The entrance of the cave was not far ahead. After walking for dozens of meters, he saw the faint light coming from the entrance of the cave. He stopped and took out a telescope from his backpack, although he had night vision but his night vision couldn’t be compared to the daytime. It was like being in the cave. The distance of his vision was greatly shortened. He could only see dozens of meters outside the entrance of the cave.
“What is this?”Amelia looked at Dudian’s binoculars and curiously asked.
Dudian ignored her. He used binoculars to look at the green grass outside the cave. There were a few tattooed wilderness generals stationed in front of the cave. They were fully armed, there were no villagers gathered to watch. It was very empty. But in this empty place there were two strange mounds of grass. They were three to four meters tall.
How could there be two more mounds of grass here?
Dudian frowned slightly. He used his X-ray vision to look at the mounds of grass. The next moment, his face changed and quickly shrank back to the previous place. His back was full of cold sweat.
Amelia saw that Dudian was so nervous. Her heart sank but her face remained unchanged. She asked: “What’s Wrong?”
Dudian came back to his senses after hearing her words. He looked at Amelia and turned back to the cave: “Let’s go.”
Amelia was startled. She looked back at the outside of the cave. There was a bit of complexity and hesitation in her eyes. It was a rare opportunity to get out of the cave. The Way Out was right in front of her and her strength had greatly increased..
She hesitated for less than two seconds before she retracted her eyes. She turned around and followed Dudian into the cave. She had secretly tested her skills during the past few days when her strength had increased. She knew that she was far from Dudian, if she tried to escape, she would be caught by Dudian.
After passing through the passage and returning to the deepest part of the cave, Dudian stopped. His face was gloomy. He almost cried out in fear when he saw the things in the haystack. His guess had come true. There were two cannons! Moreover, the cannons were not filled with gunpowder. Although the appearance was similar but he found out that the cannons were built with energy plates. If he was not wrong, they should be laser cannons!
Only such energy weapons needed built-in energy plates!
Although the possibility was not very certain but it was very high. He didn’t dare to verify it himself. No matter how fast he was, he couldn’t be faster than the speed of the laser cannon. He was secretly glad that he had investigated in advance, otherwise, if he had stepped out of the cave rashly, he might have just stepped out and his head would have been blasted by the laser cannon, instantly killing him!
Two haystacks and two laser cannons. It was possible that they wanted to kill him and Aisha at the same time.
Initially, when he saw that the place where the high priest lived had modern technology, he had guessed that there would be laser guns and other weapons here. He did not expect that the other party would take out two laser cannons. Such a great weapon could even kill an abyssal-level monster.., such a weapon would be able to directly kill an abyss level monster!
Of course, the prerequisite was to aim at the vitals.
Dudian didn’t know the specific effects of the two cannons. Would the gaps between the shots be filled one by one or more shots? If they could be fired consecutively.., the value of the two laser cannons was frightening.
If it was just the laser cannons, Dudian wouldn’t be scared to retreat. If it was an ordinary person who controlled the laser cannons then he could easily predict the position of the shots and Dodge, but if it was a pioneer level expert who controlled the two laser cannons then he would have to suffer.
“Since there is such a thing here then my previous speculation should be right. There are alien spaceships or something similar to spaceships left behind by advanced technology. However, the people here don’t seem to have learned anything from it. They only know how to use it but not to analyze it to develop themselves.”Dudian’s eyes lit up, this phenomenon was very critical.
They could only use the technology but not apply it to their daily lives. It meant that the people here were not very knowledgeable about these things.
“It seems that your methods are more powerful than I thought.”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He looked down at Amelia and sneered, “And you are ruthless enough. Do you want to be buried with me?”
Amelia’s heart skipped a beat as she pretended not to understand: “What did you say?”
“Do you know that the great priest is waiting for me outside?”Dudian looked at her: “What do you think I should do now?”
Amelia was at a loss: “What ambush? What did you say?”
“There is no need to act.”Dudian stared at her, “The trap has been set. But I want to know where you got the two cannons. Are they from the thing above us?”He pointed at the dome.
Amelia’s face changed but she quickly realized that her expression was exposed. She turned around and angrily said: “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
“I have already seen it. Why are you still acting?”Dudian glanced at her, he muttered to himself: “The lights on the top of your village are so bright. You need a lot of energy right? In addition to solar energy, I really can’t think of where to place the power station. I want to see the place where the lights are connected.”
Amelia’s face was ugly. She knew that Dudian had seen through her plan. She was depressed: “How do you know about the beam cannon? Do you have it in your wall?”

chapters.title: Chapter 859
chapters.content:
Chapter 859 – Chapter 819: Golden Dome
Beam Cannon? Dudian asked: “Did you get this from above?”
Amelia frowned as she knew that Dudian was referring to the place on the dome. It was the biggest secret of their tribe. She didn’t expect that dudian would be able to see through it. Most people would be amazed by the brilliance of the dome, however they wouldn’t think about the thing behind the light. It seemed that they had seen something similar from Dudian’s words. It wouldn’t be strange if they saw through it.
Moreover she knew that Dudian lived in the wall. Most likely there was such a thing in the wall. She was a bit vigilant. The thing that they relied on the most was this. If there was something similar in the wall.., it was inevitable that they would suffer a great loss if there was a war in the wall.
Her thoughts drifted far away.
Dudian saw that she wasn’t in the mood so he didn’t rush her. He went to sit down and rest, he said: “I don’t know how much spirit of sacrifice you have but you have two ways. First, you try to die with me. Then you die and I live. I will retaliate against your clansmen. Second, you cooperate with me. When I leave here, I will give the map to the great god. As for how to verify the authenticity of the map I gave you, I think you should have a way. Otherwise, you wouldn’t be so eager to ask me to hand over the map.”
Amelia came back to her senses and looked at Dudian who was sitting on the ground. Her heart sank. She had seen the scheming mind of this teenager who was only a few years older than her, she sneered: “Why should I die with you but you can live? If you didn’t hold me hostage, you would be dead by now. Once I die, you will be buried with me!”
Dudian was very patient, “Although you have two beam cannons that can kill me. But unfortunately it seems that the high priest only wants to ambush us. He doesn’t intend to directly attack the cave. The sacrifice is too big. It will destroy the foundation of the cave. It is possible to destroy the Aragami that you believe in. Of course, this is just my guess. But one thing is certain. If you push the two beams into the cave, it will be difficult to kill me. Unless you have an ESP Lock on me.”
Amelia knew that Dudian was right. This was the reason why she was depressed and sullen. She thought that she could directly kill Dudian with the surprise attack of the beam cannon. She didn’t expect that Dudian would see through it, this was supposed to be an ambush. How could they talk about an ambush if they were seen through?
“Even if you are right, you can forget about stepping out of the cave without me.”Amelia didn’t back down. She had grown a lot in just a few days, she looked into Dudian’s eyes, “You are a human after all. You should eat. If I am not wrong, you can’t eat the desolate worm or the corpse of the Aragami. I don’t believe that you can stay here forever!”
“Oh?”Dudian looked at her, “It seems you are secretly paying attention to me?”
Amelia snorted and replied in disdain.
Dudian didn’t care about her attitude, “You are right. I am a human after all. But because I am a human, I know that there is no way out so I have to change the path. Since I can’t leave from the exit, I can dig a path from any place here. But now I want to go to the top.”
Amelia’s pupils shrank. Why didn’t she think of this before? No Wonder Dudian didn’t panic when he saw the laser cannon retreat back into the cave. It turned out that he had thought of this escape route!
However, the great god outside didn’t think of this!
This was a serious omission in their plan!
The most chilling thing was that if the great god relied on the two laser cannons to guard the cave entrance, Dudian could use this method to drill out without anyone knowing! She had miscalculated and the Great God had miscalculated!
She knew that but she couldn’t inform the great god outside. It was impossible for her to rush out and shout. It was estimated that her mouth would be pinched by Dudian as soon as she shouted out the first word!
How could she inform the great god so that she could respond as soon as possible?
Her eyes slightly turned as she pondered.
Dudian quietly looked at her but didn’t say anything. His eyes quickly made Amelia come back to her senses. She looked at Dudian’s calm expression: “Why are you looking at me?”
“I’m waiting for you to think it through.”
“Think, think what through?”
“Think about your own result.”
“What result?”Amelia’s face sank: “Anyway I’m already in your hands. You can kill me if you want to. Don’t even think about humiliating me!”
Dudian shook his head, “If you want to inform the high priest and let her ambush me then the final result will be that you will die and I will live. Then I will leave this place. What’s the meaning of this result for you? What’s The Meaning for your clansmen? Build a dangerous enemy?”
Amelia’s eyes were gloomy: “How can you be so sure that you can escape from here?”
Dudian continued to shake his head but didn’t answer, he said: “If you are willing to cooperate with me, after I leave here, not only will you get the map of the wall, but you will also have one less enemy like me. This is the most cost-effective deal. Although you are young, but at least you should understand this point.”
“You!”Amelia was angry. She didn’t know how many times she had been scorned by Dudian’s vicious tongue. She had been indifferent but after the failed ambush of the beam cannon, her mood became impetuous again, “Aren’t you very capable? What do you want me to cooperate with you for?”
“I don’t need your cooperation for the time being. I may need it when I go up. I hope you will be tactful when the time comes.”Dudian calmly said.
Amelia was angry again. She sullenly turned her head to face the rock wall. In her heart she was thinking about how to inform the high priest about the news.
Dudian looked at her but didn’t say anything. He got up and went to the deepest part of the cave. He was in the Devil State. He waved his body and climbed up the rock wall. He used the sharp blades as shovels to cut the rock wall, pieces of rock were cut.
Dudian’s attention fell on Amelia who was standing in front of the passage. He frowned and shouted: “Aren’t you going to come over?”
Amelia heard the voice and slowly walked over. Her face slightly changed as she saw Dudian who was hanging upside down on the top of the wall. Her eyes became more gloomy and there was a trace of anxiety in them.
Dudian glanced at her and continued to cut the wall. Soon, he cut more than 20 meters deep. He saw a piece of metal in front of him. Without any hesitation, he waved the sharp blade to cut it.
The sharp blade cut into the metal but it wasn’t able to cut it open. There was only a shallow white scratch. It was estimated that it would take millions of cuts in the same place to destroy it.
Dudian saw that the thickness of the metal was extremely deep. The deepest part of the metal was a dark red grid. It blocked his vision so he couldn’t see through it. He thought of the sleeping coffin of Sylvia. It was made of the same material.

chapters.title: Chapter 860
chapters.content:
Chapter 860 – Chapter 850: The Interior Of The Spaceship
“It’s useless. The top of the metal wall is designed to bear the weight of the rocks. Its thickness is beyond your imagination. You Can’t break it.”Amelia saw that Dudian’s attack was ineffective so she was relieved, she deliberately said in a casual tone.
Dudian frowned. Amelia’s words weren’t wrong. It was difficult for him to break the metal wall with his strength unless he attacked the same place day after day. However, it would take too long, he couldn’t hold on. Even if he used the ice claw that was embedded in the golden flesh, it wouldn’t be able to cause any effect. After all, the indestructible cutting blade was almost completely ineffective. There was only a shallow mark left, the hardness of the metal was beyond most of the metals he knew.
Even the chrome metal which was known as the hardest metal might not have such hardness. Moreover, the chrome metal was silver white while the one in front of him was gold. The inner layer was dark red, it didn’t exist. But it was understandable that it might be an alien spaceship. It was most likely a metallic element from an alien planet.
“Is it used for bearing weight?”Dudian let go of the sharp blade and jumped down from the rock wall. He landed in front of Amelia. The beast-like figure was emitting a ferocious aura. He calmly looked down at Amelia, there was a trace of fear in her eyes: “You have lived here for generations. How did you deal with the feces?”
“Feces?”Amelia was startled. She didn’t think that Dudian would say such a dirty thing so bluntly. Especially when a man and a woman said such a thing, it was even more embarrassing, however, she thought that her body had been exposed to Dudian’s eyes. There was nothing to hide. She said in a sarcastic tone: “Have you been hungry for too long? Why are you interested in this thing?”
“When I first came to your tribe, I didn’t smell the smell of feces. Logically speaking, with the number of people living here, the amount of feces produced every day is an astonishing amount. It accumulated every day and every year. It should have piled up like a mountain and smelled for ten miles. But the fact is that it didn’t.”There was a trace of calm and interest in Dudian’s eyes, “Can you tell me where these things went?”
Amelia was surprised. She understood why Dudian would suddenly mention such a dirty thing. Although it was dirty but it was a crucial problem. It could lead to the secrets of their tribe, her heart sank again. Although Dudian couldn’t break the metal wall and was basically in a dead end but she felt that the other party had other means.
“I don’t know. I’m a goddess so I’m not interested in these things. If you are interested then you can ask the villagers to contribute to you.”Amelia looked at dudian.
Dudian looked at her eyes for a while. He turned around and went to the side of the Aragami. He lifted the limbs of the Aragami and continued to cut the wall.
Amelia frowned as she looked at Dudian’s back. She had an ominous feeling in her heart.
“Do you know how Hunters Track Monsters?”Dudian didn’t look back as he talked to Amelia, “The feces and footprints left by monsters are the most valuable clues for hunters to track them. So the feces accumulated here haven’t been dumped out for generations. I didn’t smell the smell of human feces outside. The feces accumulated for so many years wouldn’t be able to fit in your space. So you should have a special way to deal with the feces or special passage to move them to a far place in case the monsters smell them and attack them.”
Amelia’s heart gradually turned cold as she listened to Dudian’s words. She felt that her limbs were getting cold.
“If there is such a passage then it is the place where we can escape.”Dudian said: “There should be air purification passage and other passages in addition to the excrement passage.”
After seeing the laser cannon he no longer considered this backward and simple village as a primitive tribe. After all, the place where the Great God lived was full of high-tech equipment.
Amelia bit her lips and looked at Dudian’s back: “Even if there is such a passage, do you still want to climb out of a passage filled with feces?”
“Why not if you can survive?”Dudian said: “But don’t worry, I am not looking for this passage.”
Amelia clenched her fingers and felt a wave of frustration and powerlessness. She thought that Dudian would once again be forced into a desperate situation. She didn’t expect that Dudian would find a new way out and hope. It seemed that he would never face a difficult situation.
A moment later, Dudian dug the rock wall next to the Aragami to the deepest part. With a ding sound, a metal rock wall was revealed. He dug all the rocks around the metal rock wall and found that the metal rock wall was oval, it was connected to the top of the golden wall. It was obviously unrealistic to dig a tunnel out from the depths of the tunnel to leave the village.
Dudian wasn’t surprised. He frowned and continued to dig. This time he went deeper into the ground.
He continued to dig down the metal wall. He dug out 30-40 meters of soil and dug out a metal plate. It was extremely smooth.
“I see…”Dudian looked at the metal plate in the depths of the ground. There was a trace of shock in his eyes. He had many guesses from the signs of the village, there were countless monsters that could survive in the abyss for hundreds of years. The protection from the outside was far from enough. After all, there were many monsters that could burrow into the ground, if there was no corresponding protection, these monsters would become the number one enemy to destroy the village. The metal plate buried in the ground responded to his guess.
The entire village was contained in a metal ball.
Or rather..
The entire village was in the alien spaceship that he had guessed earlier!
The reason why he thought so was that besides what he saw, there was also the matter of the great divine priest asking for the map and planning to lead his people to migrate. This made him come to this conclusion. After all, no matter how stupid the great divine priest was.., she should know how dangerous it was to migrate on foot. There was almost a 100% chance that they would be wiped out. However, she still insisted on asking for the map. There were only two possibilities. The first was that they had to migrate or they would be destroyed. The second was.., they needed to migrate. At the same time, they had a special migration method so that they wouldn’t be wiped out.
Now that he thought about it, if they were living in an alien spaceship then the migration would be done directly by the spaceship. The risk would be much smaller.
“If this is a spaceship then is the control room the place where the great God Lives?”Dudian recalled the luxurious decoration of the metal cabin, he didn’t feel like he was in the control room of the spaceship. If that wasn’t the control room then the control room should be in another secret place. Perhaps only the great god or the goddess knew about it.
But to open the spaceship, the Great God must be the one to open it.
He thought so because the great god didn’t hysterically rescue Amelia after she was taken hostage. He didn’t panic too much. At most, he was sad. If the goddess was the key to open the spaceship.., then Amelia’s life was related to the safety of the whole family.
“If this is a spaceship then it is impossible to dig a hole to leave. We can only dig a hole to go to the other side of the village. There is nothing to be afraid of.”Dudian’s eyes rolled, he thought of another problem, “If this is the interior of the spaceship then the tonnage of this spaceship is at least a million tons. This level of spaceship must be equipped with super powerful attack weapons including the internal defense system. However, the great god used two separate laser cannons to ambush me… could it be that she is unable to fully utilize the power of this spaceship?”

chapters.title: Chapter 861
chapters.content:
Chapter 861 – Chapter 851: Descendants Of The Desolate Insects [ First Watch ]
Dudian was relieved as he thought about it. Either the great priest was unable to control the spaceship or the spaceship was shot down during the cataclysm, the internal defense system and the external attack weapon system were completely ineffective or both problems existed at the same time. Amelia and her family had been living here for generations.
The most basic configuration of such a large spaceship was to have a wide range of scouting instruments. The three-dimensional image of the nearby map was used to find the way out.
Although the Great God could predict the bad luck outside which made Dudian think of such a configuration, but the range of the Great God’s premonition seemed to be extremely limited. The Bluefish Lake was not far from here, he could even hear the movement of the Bluefish Lake with his own perception. Of course, it had to be a big movement.
“The ship’s only function is to migrate. The weapon system has long been ineffective. Otherwise, the ship would have swept through the Abyss region.”Dudian speculated, “The energy of the ship is estimated to be very little. Otherwise, the Great God wouldn’t want to get the coordinates of the God’s wall from me. However, the lights on the top of the village are still on day and night. From this point of view, the Great God shouldn’t be able to completely control the ship. He can’t even adjust it to an energy-saving mode.”
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that it was possible. However, he was also not very interested in such a spaceship. However, he wanted to know if the database of this spaceship was still there and if there was any useful information recorded in it. One had to know.., earth could not produce a spaceship with such a structure. At least, according to what he knew from his authority, no country on Earth could produce such a war weapon. The biggest war weapon known was the aircraft carrier, however this was beyond the concept of an aircraft carrier. There was a ninety percent possibility that it was an alien spaceship. It might contain the secrets of the aliens, including the secrets of the Aragami and the unknown insects.
“Why don’t you continue to dig?”Amelia saw Dudian stop and seemed to be thinking. She immediately interrupted Dudian’s thoughts, she spoke in a gloating tone: “Didn’t you want to go up? Why did you go down?”
Dudian didn’t reply to her. He climbed to the top of the cliff. As he passed by the Aragami, he lifted his sharp limbs and cut the soil that was embedded in the Aragami. He stuck to the metal wall and cut to the back of the Aragami.
“What… What are you doing? !”Amelia saw Dudian’s action. She was shocked and angry: “You are not allowed to destroy the Aragami! Stop!”
Dudian said: “There is no need to be so excited. I Won’t destroy the Aragami if there is no need. It is useless for you to say if I want to destroy the Aragami. Moreover it is debatable whether you are a descendant of the Aragami or not.”
Amelia was angry: “What do you mean? The Aragami is our ancestor and you don’t even recognize it?”
“I only know that my ancestors were a group of mortals who liked to fight with the sky.”Dudian stopped and glanced at her, “I don’t know about your ancestors. You said that you are a descendant of the Aragami and the Aragami liked your smell. Why are the remains of the Aragami preserved here? Do the Aragami eat them alive?”
Amelia was angry: “How do I Know?”
“Of course you don’t know because you are still young.”Dudian continued to dig, “What you think is what others make you think. So what you think is not necessarily what you think. I know that you are not lying but it doesn’t mean that what you said is not a lie. I have a guess. I don’t think you will believe it. In my opinion, your ancestor might not be an Aragami but the Aragami.”
Amelia frowned as she heard Dudian’s words. She was about to think when she heard the last sentence: “If you want to kill then kill. What kind of man are you to insult me like this?”
“If what I said is the truth then it is not an insult.”Dudian said: “I am not lying to you about the corpse of the desolate worm that disappeared in the passage. It is obvious that the giant slimy mark was left by another giant desolate worm. We have killed our way here. It is possible that we have missed the small desolate worm. But do you think it is possible for such a big desolate worm to be missed? “Moreover, I discovered before that this desolate worm can be pieced together from several different parts of its body. I reckon that the great desolate worm was pieced together from the other parts of the desolate worm.”
Amelia’s face was filled with anger as she said, “What does this have to do with me?”
“This is the ability of the desolate worm. The desolate worms do not eat Aragami, but they will eat their own kind. These desolate worms live here, but they do not have any prey delivered to them. How do they survive? Don’t they eat? If they don’t eat, why would they eat you? It means that they have a need to eat. But when you cut open their bodies, have you seen the sand? No. There is no sand in their stomach. It means that they don’t eat rocks but meat. Then, whose meat do they eat? It can only be the meat of their own kind. They ate the meat of their own kind while they reproduced. Then they ate the worms that reproduced. It was probably a cycle…”Dudian said casually, but his words made Amelia’s heart jump.
Her anger was completely extinguished by Dudian’s questions. She wanted to open her mouth to refute but she couldn’t think of anything to say.
It was true that the Aragami liked her smell but didn’t hurt the Aragami. She was surprised but at first she comforted herself. She felt that the Aragami had the power of God but she wasn’t completely convinced, she didn’t think too much about it. Now Dudian had repeatedly mentioned it. She was gradually at a loss. She wanted to leave the cave and ask the priest to answer her questions.
She still had a long way to go. She had a lot of things to learn. She felt that she had a lot of time to learn in the future so she wasn’t very diligent. But now she regretted it.
“If you are the descendant of the Aragami then there are many things that can be easily explained.”Dudian cut the back of the Aragami. He wanted to peel off the wall, he said: “The Aragami are buried in the depths of the cave. You knew that the Aragami liked your smell and you believed in the Aragami. But you didn’t guard the body of the Aragami. If it was anyone else, they would have killed the Aragami but you didn’t do so.”
“This… this is because the Aragami can provide power. If we kill the Aragami then our future clansmen will always be ordinary people. They won’t be able to hunt in the future.”Amelia felt that what Dudian said was wrong, she retorted: “Moreover, the desolate insects are so strong. How many warriors must be sacrificed to kill all of them? I believe that the Aragami will understand our difficulties.”

chapters.title: Chapter 862
chapters.content:
Chapter 862 – Chapter 852: Passage [ Second Update ]
“Well, don’t forget that the insects are afraid of fire. No matter how strong they are, it’s easy to destroy them. Even if they don’t go extinct, if you want to use them to cultivate the villagers, you should at least move them to another place. Don’t you think it’s a blasphemy to let them stay with the remains of the Aragami? Haven’t you thought about this before?”Dudian casually said.
Amelia was stunned and was at a loss for words.
“Either your so-called belief is bullshit and you don’t take the Aragami as your ancestor seriously, or you are the descendants of the Aragami. The great gods or the first generation of gods and priests knew about this, but they sealed off the news and chose the Aragami who looked similar to you, especially the Aragami whose upper body looked like a perfect human, to be your ancestor. After all, who doesn’t like their ancestor to be a heroic and peerless perfect human? “It’s just like how some children find their parents unsightly or even poor, so they like to have beautiful and rich parents.”
“As the saying goes, children don’t find their mothers ugly, but you do. You can only say that your ancestors, the first generation of goddesses and gods, are too ugly to be human!”
Dudian’s expression was very casual, but his words were like needles.
Amelia was so angry that her body trembled: “Shut Up!”
“Are you afraid to know the truth, or do you think I’m Wrong?”Dudian looked at her.
Amelia bit her lips. Her face was gloomy as she suddenly said: “You are taking revenge for my previous sarcasm, so you deliberately said so!”
“There is a point.”Dudian looked away from her and continued to busy himself: “So don’t gloat in front of me.”
Amelia snorted, “What you said seems reasonable but there are two fatal problems. First, if the desolate insects killed each other, they would have died long ago. How could they reproduce as fast as they eat?”? “Second, as far as I know, different kinds of mating are unable to produce offspring. Our village used to use cattle and wild boars but we haven’t been able to reproduce. This is the best evidence.”
“These two questions are also the problem that I am not 100% sure that you are the offspring of the desolate insects.”. “Dudian’s expression was indifferent, “However, I guess that these desolate insects should have a special diet. Occasionally, they will eat other things. For example, you have come to explore the village. As for the problem of reproduction, human and beast mating is indeed impossible to reproduce. However, this desolate insect can not be generalized by ordinary beasts. It may be a parasite. If it has the ability to tamper with its own or other living DNA, then it is possible to mate with humans and have offspring.”
