“If there was an instrument that could verify the DNA, we would be able to get the results immediately. That’s why I only said that there was an 80% chance that your ancestor was a desolate bug and not an Aragami.”
Amelia heaved a sigh of relief and said, “You’ve said so much, but it’s all your speculation. What DNA? I don’t understand. Anyway, you don’t have any evidence, so you’re just spouting nonsense!”
“If there is evidence then I will make an instrument to verify the DNA. I will naturally help you find your true ancestor.”Dudian said: “But you can assume that if your ancestor is really these ugly desolate insects. From the situation of the desolate insects and Aragami, they are either symbiotic or arch enemies. If it is the first type then it is fine. But if it is the second type then you are the father of the thief!”
Amelia angrily said: “Don’t make wild guesses since there is no evidence!”
“But you don’t have any evidence. You are the heir of the Aragami, aren’t you?”
“You!”Amelia was angry.
Dudian ignored her and increased the speed of his blade. The stones fell down and rumbled on the ground. Soon, Dudian cut more than half of the wall behind the Aragami. He moved to the middle of the Aragami’s buttocks, dudian was startled. He quickly cut the wall behind the Aragami. He saw a protruding metal block which was five centimeters thicker than the metal wall.
Dudian found that there was an empty passage inside the protruding metal block!
The passage was half a meter tall. It was square as long as the edge of the metal block.
His eyes lit up as he was surprised and surprised. He didn’t expect to find the passage so soon. Moreover the passage was behind the Aragami. Was it intentional or not?
If it was intentional then did the person who put the Aragami here want to use the Aragami’s remains to block the passage? What was the side of the passage?
Dudian turned to Amelia: “Did the first generation goddess put the Aragami’s remains in here?”
Amelia replied in a depressed tone: “Of course, it was buried by the goddess and the priest.”She didn’t want to answer any of Dudian’s questions but she was afraid that Dudian would be narrow-minded, what kind of words would he say to retaliate against her? She couldn’t fight against Dudian but she couldn’t withstand the ‘vicious’language attack.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He cut the soil behind the lower body of the Aragami. He pushed the Aragami’s body to the side and knocked it to the ground.
Amelia saw that Dudian was so rude. She was scared and rushed forward: “What are you doing!”
Dudian ignored her shout. His eyes fell on the protruding metal plate. He waved the sharp blade and suddenly hit it. Bang! The sharp blade cut the metal plate. However.., the metal plate seemed to loosen a little bit and the soil around it fell down.
Dudian understood the situation. He lifted his hand and pressed on the metal plate. The next moment, the metal plate was pushed down to the level of the surrounding metal wall. It looked extremely smooth, the wall suddenly cracked and revealed a metal passage. It was dark inside but Dudian could see that there was a square passage. It was one meter high and about ten meters deep inside, he turned the corner. He couldn’t see through the metal passage. He had to drill into it to know where it led to.
Dudian pondered for a moment before he turned back to the ground. He said to Amelia: “That’s the exit. Let’s go in.”
Amelia was surprised to see that Dudian had created a passage. She knew that he was using her as a pathfinder. She was dissatisfied but she knew that resistance was useless. Moreover she was curious, where would this passage lead to? Was it the temple that the great priest had been talking about?
The entrance of the passage was only four or five meters above the ground. Amelia jumped and grabbed the entrance of the passage. Dudian held Aisha’s hand and followed after her.
Amelia didn’t run away immediately after she entered the passage. Although it was a great opportunity but she wasn’t familiar with the passage. She was afraid that Dudian would catch up to her if she got lost, she thought that if they really went to the temple then she might be able to use some of the mechanisms in the temple to kill Dudian!
Dudian and Aisha went into the passage one after another. They came to a corner ten meters away. They saw that the passage went straight seven or eight meters to the left. He let Amelia Crawl in front while he followed behind, they went deeper into the passage. After seven or eight turns they came to a place similar to an elevator shaft. There was only a metal ladder leading to the top.

chapters.title: Chapter 863
chapters.content:
Chapter 863 – Chapter 853: Unknown Experiment
Dudian looked up and saw that there was an entrance to a passage more than ten meters above them. He urged Amelia, “Go up.”
Amelia hesitated for a moment. She grabbed the handrail and quickly climbed up. When she came to the entrance of the passage, she saw that the passage was three meters high and extremely spacious. On the other side was a dark room, she was puzzled and tried to walk slowly.
Dudian and Aisha followed closely behind. When Amelia walked to the door of the passage, the room suddenly lit up, lighting up the room as if it was daytime.
It was a very simple room with a bright silver metal structure. The floor and walls were all silver white. There was nothing in the room and the area was not big. It was more like a passage than a room, the light from the top of the head shone on the floor. The smooth silver wall reflected the figures of Dean, Aisha, and Amelia.
Amelia was shocked by the sudden light. She quickly saw her naked figure on the opposite wall. She was so embarrassed that her face turned red. She covered her chest with both hands and slightly squatted down. She turned her head and looked at Dean in anger, “Don’t you have towels? Can’t I use them?”
Dudian didn’t pay attention to her. He used his x-ray vision to scan the surroundings. The material here was the same as the outside. He couldn’t directly know the environment here. He had to explore step by step, he turned to look at Amelia: “I have already seen it. There is nothing to hide. I am not interested in you. Don’t Dawdle and continue to lead the way.”
“You!”Amelia looked at Dudian with anger and shame. She covered her chest and continued to walk in front.
Dudian followed behind her. From Amelia’s reaction when the lights were turned on, he felt that she should not have come in here. However, he could not rule out that she was not mentally prepared, of course, there was another possibility. She was acting. If that was the case, then it could only mean that she had made great progress. Her acting skills were so realistic that he did not want to doubt it.
Both of them walked along the corridor. The corridor in front of them was dark but as they approached, the lights slowly turned on. After a while they entered a dead end and were blocked by a metal wall.
Amelia stopped and was about to turn her head to ask. Dudian went straight past her and came to the front of the metal wall. He found that there was a groove on the side of the wall. It should be a locked door.
There was a similar identification device on the side of the door. The surface was made of glass. Dudian said to Amelia: “Stand over here and try.”
Amelia reluctantly came to the metal box that Dudian mentioned: “Try What?”
“This should be the mechanism to open the door. Try to see if you can open it.”Dudian said.
Amelia frowned. Although she didn’t believe it but she carefully looked at the metal box. She looked at the pearl which could reflect her face. At this time the pearl seemed to sense something, the red light turned into a red dot and shot onto Amelia’s forehead. The red dot split and turned into a rotating polygon net. It rotated on Amelia’s forehead. After a moment the red light converged, the Pearl also returned to its original state.
Amelia didn’t see the rotating polygon on her forehead. She was puzzled as she saw the red light disappear. She turned her head and looked at Dudian.
Dudian ignored her and went to the metal box. It seemed that the glass bead was scanning Amelia’s forehead. It seemed that it was some kind of identification method, however, it was different from the iris recognition and interrogation recognition that he had imagined. However, it didn’t seem to be an attack device. Otherwise, after the scan Amelia would only have two results. Either her identity would pass through and the metal door in front of her would open.., or she would trigger the mechanism and be killed on the spot!
But neither of the two situations happened. Her identity didn’t open the metal door and she wasn’t killed. It meant that even if the identification failed, it was harmless.
He didn’t have much hope for himself. He simply wanted to try. He moved in front of the glass bead. Soon, the glass bead once again lit up with red light. A red dot shot onto Dudian’s forehead and slowly dispersed into a polygonal mesh, the rotating area was getting bigger and bigger. It gradually moved from Dudian’s forehead to his cheek, then to his neck, then to his right shoulder. Finally, it stopped.
Crack!
There was a soft sound. The metal wall in front of them cracked from the middle and closed into the metal grooves on both sides.
Amelia was stunned as she witnessed the scene. She didn’t expect that there would be such a ‘magical’thing.
Dudian’s heart skipped a beat when the red mesh moved to his right shoulder. The metal door suddenly opened and his heart skipped a beat. He thought that it was an attack weapon, he then knew that the identification was successful. The door was opened. From the position of the red light, there was no doubt that it was the flesh of the Aragami on his right shoulder.
His eyes flashed. This gave him a message: this place belonged to the Aragami.
He looked at Amelia who was surprised: “Lead the way.”
Amelia came back to her senses. She saw that Dudian was still using her as a pathfinder stone. She curled her lips and continued to lead the way.
After crossing the metal door, they walked more than ten meters straight. After a corner, a bright metal room appeared in front of dudian. It was full of cold mechanical aura as usual. However, the things displayed in the room.., amelia and Dudian were completely stunned. The room was like a laboratory. There were several thick metal plates that were similar to operating tables protruding from the wall. On the other side, there was a metal cabinet that looked like a morgue cabinet, one of the cabinets was dented. It seemed that it was attacked by something. The marks were sharp like axes. The other two cabinets were half open. One cabinet was empty, the other cabinet was pulled out. There was a dried corpse lying on top of it!
Although the flesh on the surface of the corpse had lost some moisture but it was well preserved. It was a blonde human with deep eye sockets. It looked like a zombie. Its hair was messy and it was wearing a blue and white striped uniform.
The smell of the corpse was not strong.
Dudian noticed that the temperature in the room and the passage outside was low. There was enough cold air. The temperature was not more than five degrees, the corpse should not be able to be preserved for a long time. Could it be that the corpse appeared here not long ago?
Who put it in?
Dudian felt the hair on his back stand up.
The first thing Amelia saw was the mummy. The mummy was leaning on the cabinet as if it was staring at her. She almost screamed. Fortunately, she was by Dudian’s side during this period of time, she was used to all kinds of scaring. She was able to endure in time but she still felt waves of fear and fear. She had never seen such a terrifying scene. She had never even seen a dead person.., not to mention that she was stared at by a dried corpse.
Dudian felt the fear coming from Amelia’s trembling body. He whispered: “Do you recognize this person?”
Amelia heard Dudian’s voice. The fear in her heart suddenly disappeared. She turned to look at Dudian. Although she felt that this face was extremely hateful and wanted to tear it apart, but at this moment she felt that it gave her a sense of security. She shook her head: “I haven’t seen her before. But her appearance is very similar to the people in our village. She should be from our village.”
She saw Dudian’s appearance so she imagined that the people in the wall were similar to Dudian’s black hair and black eyes.
Dudian slightly frowned. He had seen most of the post-disaster human faces from the west. Perhaps it was because the location of the wall where he was sleeping was in Russia, it was hard to say if he was from Amelia’s place. After all, she didn’t know him.
He said to Amelia: “Go and open all the cabinets.”
“What? !”Amelia’s voice was raised by a few decibels as she stared at dudian.
Dudian looked at her indifferently: “If you don’t do it then I can let you stay here and accompany them forever.”
Amelia clenched her teeth. The good impression she had towards Dudian disappeared. She clenched her fists and slowly stepped forward. Soon, her anger was replaced by nervousness and fear, she silently chanted the blessing runes and exorcism spells.
Dudian looked around the room. There were many strange tools on the floor. There were several small glass jars next to them. There seemed to be a vacuum inside. There were a few dry insects floating around. They were thinner than fingers, the insects were all different. Some of them had hair and some of them had small sharp blades. It made him think of the parasitic soul worms in the bodies of monsters.
Could it be that there were several parasitic soul worms inside?
Then who did everything here?
At this time, Amelia opened the cabinets one by one. The smell of corpses in the room was getting stronger and stronger.
Dudian found that there were many dried corpses in the cabinets. Most of them had blonde hair and blue eyes. He frowned slightly and looked at the bodies of the dried corpses. He found that there were no wounds on the surface of the bodies, however, there was a coin-sized round hole at the back of the head of each corpse. He used x-ray vision to observe and saw that the hole was empty. Only the top of the head had shrunken brain tissue, there was a twisted worm in the middle of the brain tissue!
Amelia looked at Dudian who was holding the head of the corpse in a daze. She couldn’t help but feel a chill. She took a few steps back and stayed away from him.
Dudian’s eyes slowly moved to her body. He wanted to cut open her brain to see if there was any important information about the tribe in her memory. The corpse that appeared here was too suspicious, it seemed that it was used as an experiment by someone. He had speculated that it might be an Aragami spaceship but the Aragami had already died. The only people who could do experiments here were the high-level priests and goddesses of the tribe, however it seemed that Amelia didn’t know about it. She didn’t know if it was because she was too young and hadn’t come into contact with these things or because she wasn’t qualified to come into contact with these things as a goddess, only the great God knew all the secrets here?
“What kind of things do the experimenter want to create? Is this worm a parasitic soul worm or a young desolate worm?”Dudian frowned, he felt that there was an unimaginable deep connection between the parasitic soul worm and the desolate worm. However, he wasn’t sure about the living environment and the characteristics of the two. However, that kind of intuition remained in his heart.
He checked the bodies of the two mummies and found that he couldn’t deduce their time of death. But at least it wasn’t recent. Their bodies seemed to have some kind of mutation. With his shallow forensic skills.., it was impossible to tell the specific year. After all, his judgment of the time of death was mainly from his hunting experience and not professional knowledge.
After pondering for a long time, Dudian memorized all the clues and left them in his heart. He couldn’t infer the result at the moment. Maybe he would get more clues in the future. He looked at the room. There were obvious signs of fighting, he didn’t know if it was caused by the experimenter or the experiment subject or something else. He said to Amelia: “Let’s go from here.”He pointed to the metal door in the laboratory.
Amelia saw that they could finally leave this place. She went forward and was very active.
Dudian followed her and left the laboratory. They walked along the corridor and came to a metal door. Dudian saw the metal box and the glass identification instrument. He personally went forward to scan it, the flesh of the Aragami in his right shoulder was effective again. The door opened and Dudian and Amelia walked in. They stopped when they saw the things in the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 864
chapters.content:
Chapter 864 – Chapter 854: Star Map
“What… What is this?”Amelia’s face was stiff.
Dudian’s eyes flashed with shock as he looked at the glass jars in the room. There were people of different ages and genders in the jars. It was as if they were sleeping in the jars, pale yellow transparent liquid covered their bodies. They could clearly see every part of their bodies. There were children, women, men, old people and so on. But they all had one thing in common, the lower half of their limbs were hideous and ugly. They looked like monsters.
There was no doubt that they were the experimental subjects.
However, the familiar half-human half-beast shape was too similar to that of an Aragami.
Could it be that they were Aragami?
Or were they made into Aragami?
Dudian slowly stepped into the room. He felt a cold aura. It seemed that the experimental humans in the glassware would come to life at any time. Their skin was soaked in pale yellow liquid, there was not the slightest bit of decay but the liquid was like stagnant water without any bubbles. It meant that their bodies had stopped breathing and had been dead for a long time.
Dudian could see the condition of their bodies through x-ray vision. Their bones and flesh were still “Fresh”. They didn’t rot but their hearts didn’t beat and blood didn’t flow. They were completely dead.
“Is it an Aragami experiment or an insect experiment?”Dudian thought of the experiments made by the Institute of Monsters. However those experiments were different from the Aragami. The parts of their bodies were either up or down or left or right, arms, legs and other parts of their bodies had mutated into insects. He had to rule out other possibilities.
However, if these were the Aragami that had been created and were being incubated, then was that how the Aragami outside had come about?
Could it be that the Aragami were not aliens, but an experimental weapon created by some existence?
However, in the old era on earth, such experiments to destroy humanity were banned by all countries. Even if they were not banned, with the technology of the old era, it might not be possible to create them. After all, mixing human and beast limbs.., this meant that the technology of DNA had reached an extremely terrifying level. If there was such a terrifying technology, then the pharmaceutical industry of the old era would have long reached an unimaginable level. At the very least.., the vast majority of cancers could be easily treated. It could even extend one’s lifespan!
However, in his impression, the low-key wealthy aristocratic families of the old era did not have any existence that exceeded their lifespan. With those existences that were as rich as countries, if there was such a technology.., they would try to use it on themselves, but such an example didn’t appear.
However, if it wasn’t made by the humans in the old era, could it be the group of Earth invaders?
But how could the Aragami protect the humans and oppose the invaders?
These thoughts flashed through Dudian’s mind. He was a bit confused. He didn’t know if the scene in front of him was a secret in the ‘Kingdom of God’, maybe they already knew about it? Or maybe they were also studying these things?
His face changed as he stood at the door. He didn’t move for a long time.
Amelia was so scared that her face turned pale. She didn’t dare to enter the room. There were at least a dozen glassware in the room. There were many strange and ferocious corpses floating in the room. Her scalp was numb, she felt a sense of security when she was next to Dudian. At least Dudian was more ‘kind’than dead people and ghosts.
Dudian slowly came back to his senses and came to the nearest glassware. There was a fourteen or fifteen-year-old girl floating in front of the door. Her hair was messy and fluttered like a ghost. Her eyes were slightly closed, she seemed to be looking down at Dudian.
Dudian looked up and carefully observed her body parts. There was a question in his heart. were they really Aragami? Although their strange body structure was very similar but the size was far from the same. Could it be that their bodies would become bigger after they took shape?
Dudian pondered for a moment but didn’t know the answer. He turned around and looked at the other glass containers.
“Asian faces…”Dudian saw three Asian faces. One of them was obviously Chinese. The other two looked like people from an island country and a shameless bandit country. Although they were all Asian faces.., westerners couldn’t distinguish the difference but Dudian could see the obvious difference at a glance. For example, most of the people in a bandit country had narrow eyes and single eyelids. They had round faces and were ugly, so plastic surgery was prevalent.
“You Shouldn’t know these people, right?”Dudian asked Amelia.
Amelia was scared by Dudian’s sudden words. She angrily glared at him: “Of course I haven’t seen them.”
Dudian nodded slightly. There were almost no Asian faces in the village. It could be seen that these people had been caught early to be experiments. The reason why they didn’t rot was most likely related to the pale yellow liquid.
Dudian looked at the passage and door behind the glassware. He didn’t stay here any longer. He looked at Amelia and said: “Let’s go and take a look in front.”
Amelia had wanted to leave for a long time. She saw that Dudian was going to go forward. Her face suddenly became bitter. She prayed in her heart that she wouldn’t meet such a terrible thing in front of her.
After scanning the right shoulder, the metal door opened. Dudian and Amelia walked in together. Aisha followed behind Dudian like a shadow.
There was a corridor behind the third door. At a glance, it was more than 20 meters long. It was relatively wide and there were no corpses. Amelia was relieved but soon she was attracted by the picture frames hanging on the corridor.
Dudian was also looking at these “Picture frames”. They looked like pictures but they didn’t look like pictures. Instead they looked like hand-drawn pictures, the pictures were drawn on the wall. Some of them were Aragami, some of them were Aragami. There were also pictures of the Big Dipper and the Solar System. The corridor was dark but there were different colors of light. The solar system was surrounded by stars, the Red Sun was emitting steam as if it was a real sun hanging on the wall.
Dudian slowly walked along the corridor. His eyes swept over the pictures. His heart was full of shock but he was more confused. There were scenes of Aragami and Aragami fighting each other. However, the Aragami was not an ordinary Aragami in the cave, it was the White Crystal Aragami. In one of the paintings, the Aragami was wrapped around the legs of an Aragami. The Aragami was holding another Aragami, there was half of the Aragami’s flesh in its mouth.
The Aragami in the other painting was burrowed out from the chest, neck and other parts of the Aragami. It seemed that the Aragami had been killed by the Aragami.
From the painting, it was clear that the two were opposites.
“Aragami…”Amelia looked at the words on the wall. Her eyes were confused. She knew that Aragami was the greatest and unique Aragami. However, there were several different faces of Aragami, each face was stunning. It was not an exaggeration to say that it was perfect. It didn’t look like a natural face. There were no flaws. It was as if God had carved it with a fine brush. It was perfect and had different temperaments.
Dudian slowly walked and looked at it. When he came to the end of the corridor, he was attracted by a star chart. This star chart was different from the previous one. There were many planets around other star charts, including the Solar System, it looked vast but this star chart was like a taiji. However, the two planets were not black and white but blue and red.
The two planets were far away from each other. There were stars like spots of light. The two planets were in opposition to each other.
The reason why Dudian was attracted to this star chart was because he knew that there were no such special galaxies in the galaxies that he had observed.
He looked at it for a while and slowly took back his eyes. He took note of the picture and looked back at the other pictures in the corridor.
There was a fourth door at the end of the corridor. Dudian scanned the door and saw that it was a dark passage.
Dudian once again let Amelia Walk in front of him. She would act as a pathfinder stone so that he could react in time if any mechanism was triggered.
He walked along the dark passage for a while. There was a spiral staircase in front of him. Dudian saw a relatively empty hall. It was still a cold silver metal structure, dudian saw the layer of rock behind the metal dome. His heart was moved as he recalled the height he had reached. Was it possible that he was standing at the top of the valley?
He used his x-ray vision to scan the surroundings. No matter what, there was a layer of rock outside which meant that there was hope to leave.
Dudian looked for a moment but he didn’t find the passage. Instead, he saw several huge glass windows. However, the material was definitely not glass. How could glass withstand the weight of more than ten tons of rock?
Dudian activated his magic body and came to the front of these huge transparent glass. He waved the sharp blade and cut it. Whoosh. The sharp blade cut on the glass and made a sharp sound.
Amelia covered her ears and screamed.
Dudian looked at the glass which didn’t have any scars. He raised his eyebrows and waved his ice claws. Bang Bang. He hit the glass several times but still didn’t leave any trace.
He was stunned for a moment. He suddenly reacted and wanted to slap himself. If this was a spaceship then the seemingly fragile glass was probably the hardest thing on the ship. It was even harder than the metal next to it.
He untied the magic body and gave up on the hard attack. He turned his head and looked around.
Soon, he found a hole the size of a green bean. It was in the corner of the wall. It seemed to be used to purify the air. There were complex pipes connected to the metal wall.
Dudian immediately stretched out his hand and once again activated his magic body. He waved his ice claw and punched the small hole. Bang! There was a gap in the inner layer of the complex metal pipe. Dudian’s fist hit it and it slightly sank in.
Dudian saw that there was hope. He quickly punched. The Ice Claw didn’t feel anything. Under the full force of the attack, the metal wall and the metal floor seemed to tremble slightly. Through a few pieces of transparent glass.., he could see that the rock layer above was also trembling.
Bang! The small hole in the metal wall collapsed. Dudian waved his ice claw and pulled out the metal pipe. He grabbed the cracked metal wall and tore it along the crack.
The tough metal in his hand was like a piece of tough leather. It was torn apart bit by bit.
Dudian was relieved as he saw that the metal pipe was connected to a 30 cm diameter pipe. He smiled as he looked at the pipe, the pipe was connected to the outside of the rock layer. Moreover, it was not inside the rock layer but outside.
In the tunnel outside the village, Priory and more than a dozen members of the hunting team were waiting quietly. It was not long before the time was up. The two members of the hunting team who were guarding the entrance pushed away the giant rocks and watched priory and the others go out to hunt.
After stepping out of the tunnel, Pulilei led the team along the corridor in the canyon. Just as they exited the canyon, a few rocks suddenly fell down and almost hit him.
He raised his head to take a look. Seeing that they were naturally falling rocks, he retracted his gaze.
A person beside him said in a low voice, “We almost got killed the moment we stepped out of the door. There won’t be any accidents this time, right?”
“What are you worried about? How can the divination of the great divine priest be wrong?”Someone beside him said.
“That’s true.”This person did not dare to question the divination of the great divine priest. He changed the topic and said, “Without that outsider, can we really catch so many fish by ourselves?”
Seeing that this person was talking to him, pulilei nodded and said, “Mr. Du has already passed the method to me. When the time comes, you just have to listen to my instructions.”
“Speaking of which, Mr. Du and the goddess have been in the Earth Dragon Cave for so long. I wonder how they are doing.”
“Shh, when you are outside, shut up if you can. Be careful not to attract bad things!”

chapters.title: Chapter 865
chapters.content:
Chapter 865 – Chapter 855: Advance
Dudian quietly watched pulley and the others leave the valley. They had stayed in the dragon cave for too long. The other villagers had come out and returned to their own lives, no one would care about it. He was about to leave. For him, this was just a small episode in the journey. The new journey was still going on.
Next to him, Amelia looked at the canyon. She stepped on a few loose stones and almost fell down. Fortunately, Dudian caught her in time.
She turned to look at Dudian who was calm. Her mood was a bit complicated: “Why did you save me?”
“Save You?”Dudian looked at her: “Even if I don’t hold you, you won’t die from the fall. You are not the same as before. Adapt to the power in your body.”
Amelia was startled. She remembered that she wasn’t the same as before. Dudian had forced her to eat the worms in the Dragon Cave. Her body had been reborn and possessed extraordinary strength. She could see very far away, she could hear the whispers of priory and others at the bottom of the canyon. She hadn’t adapted to such a strong body as Dudian had said.
However, she had an indescribable feeling in her heart when she thought that Dudian had forced her to have such a strong body. She knew more about the preciousness of power than Dudian, at the moment she didn’t think that those insects were difficult to swallow. She had gotten used to eating them and even liked the feeling of the changes in her body after eating them.
However she knew that there was a long distance between her and Dudian. The speed of Dudian’s fight with the insects was too much for her to catch.
“Are you going to… Leave Here?”Amelia bit her lips and whispered.
Dudian looked up into the distance and calmly said: “Of course, even if I want to stay, you don’t welcome me here.”
Amelia looked at the side of the boy’s face and asked: “Where do you want to go?”
“To a promising place.”Dudian looked ahead, “The world is very big. The place where you live is too small. If you have the opportunity, you can go to the outside world. However, the premise is that you have the power to travel around. The God’s wall that you want to go to is just a big cage. There are many places like the God’s wall. There are even God’s kingdoms. They are the largest cage in the world.”
“There are many walls? There is a Kingdom of God?”Amelia was shocked by Dudian’s words.
“This is what I know. The more places you go, the more you will know. Maybe there is a bigger place above the Kingdom of God.”Dudian didn’t hide his information, he told her everything.
Amelia looked at dudian and suddenly asked: “Why are you saying that it is a cage? Don’t you want to stay in the wall? There are so many beasts out there and they will die at any time. It is safe to stay in the wall.”
“There is no place that is safe forever. Moreover there are more than just beasts in the human world. There are other people like you who think that I am your enemy.”Dudian looked at her, “There are too few people here and you are high up in the world. You will know that everyone wants to be high up in the wall. But some people can’t be high up in the world. But they have such expectations. They can only get it through some means. It is either a formal way or an informal way.”
“Speaking of which, the informal way is a shortcut. The shortcut is hidden in every formal way. It is like light and darkness. There is only day and night. It can not be called a day. It can only be counted as half a day.”
Amelia was startled. She felt that what Dudian said was difficult to understand. However, she felt that it made sense. She instinctively didn’t want to accept it because she knew that the informal way was cruel, ugly.
“We can’t go to the wall. Although you said many things but we don’t know any of them.”Amelia quietly bowed her head.
Dudian quietly said: “I said that I will tell you the route to the wall when I leave. I will keep my word. In addition, you should go back after I leave. You have done your part as a hostage. If you continue to follow me then you will die. Even I will die at any time in the abyss. If I take you with me then you will die!”
Amelia raised her head and looked at him in disbelief: “You, you let me go?”
“You don’t want to?”
“No no no, I want to, I want to!”Amelia waved her hand and almost tripped. She was afraid that Dudian would go back on his words: “I will never tell you about leaving. I will keep it a secret.”
“No need.”Dudian indifferently said: “By the time you go back, I will have already left this place. Even if you tell the high priest, it will be fine. For me, this is just a hotel. After staying there, I will leave. Maybe there will be no more interactions.”
Amelia was startled. She looked at Dudian’s calm face. She suddenly felt that this teenager was different from her previous impression. She knew that Dudian was serious. With his strength, there was no need to deceive her. It was just that.., this happiness and hope came too suddenly. She was ready to die. She was even thinking about how Dudian would bring her out of the wilderness and cause the beasts to die together with Dudian, but now she was let go by Dudian. She wasn’t mentally prepared.
“Don’t you want to kill me to avenge you?”Amelia looked into Dudian’s eyes.
“Revenge?”
“The great priest used the beam cannon to ambush you. We came up with this idea together. Don’t you hate me?”
Dudian indifferently replied: “Since I didn’t die and wasn’t injured, why should I hate you? Although you are talkative and noisy, but what good would it do me to kill you? Now that I have escaped danger, the previous matters can be written off as long as you don’t provoke me in the future.”
Amelia looked at Dudian’s calm appearance. She wanted to say something but stopped. She couldn’t believe that Dudian would be so kind. After all, she had seen the face of this man in the Dragon Cave, he was merciless and used her as a pathfinder stone. He didn’t care about her feelings and life. He was cold-blooded and cruel. But now, he let her go so easily?
Her mind suddenly thought of something. Her eyes flashed with coldness. She bowed her head but didn’t say anything. She didn’t want to anger Dudian and kill herself.
Dudian took out a metal cylinder from his backpack. There was pen and paper inside. He sat on the ground and spread the paper on a piece of thick leather. He quickly drew the map and handed it to Amelia, “This is the route to the wall where I live. The name of our wall is Sylvia. It is the name of the Aragami.”
Amelia took the map. She looked at it and put it away.
Dudian saw that she wasn’t happy. He guessed her thoughts and shook his head, “You don’t have to worry about the map being fake. It will lead you to a dangerous place. As far as I know, you should have a way to explore it when you asked me for the map. I guess you have some other extraordinary detection tools. If you are worried that the map is fake then you can send people to explore it. After all, you don’t have much time to live here. You will need to migrate sooner or later. Of course, if you are still suspicious then you can tear up the map.”
Amelia was startled. She didn’t think that Dudian would speak out her thoughts so directly. Indeed, she thought that Dudian’s gift of the map might be a conspiracy but Dudian had made it clear, moreover, what he said was what she thought in her heart. She originally planned to go back to explore the authenticity of the map. If it was true then she would migrate so that there wouldn’t be the risk of extinction.
“Why are you willing to give me the map? Is there a danger waiting for us in the wall?”Amelia looked at dudian, she was afraid that her words would expose Dudian and anger him. But she still wanted a true answer. After all, they could only detect whether the wall was true or false, but they couldn’t detect the danger inside.
Dudian was speechless, “Do you have such a bad impression of me? Do you need to be so skeptical? Or do you have a suspicious nature? Anyway, I have fulfilled my promise. If you are worried then tear up the map and pretend that I didn’t give it to you.”
Amelia looked at Dudian’s eyes. She was silent: “I will verify this. In any case, if you don’t kill me today, I will save you in the future.”
“It’s good to know how to repay kindness. Unfortunately you don’t have the opportunity.”Dudian looked at the dawn: “I should go. If I can live back then maybe we can meet again.”
Amelia looked at Dudian who was about to leave. She felt guilty that she was wrong about this person, she couldn’t help but ask: “Do you really want to find a way to save your… lover?”
“Of course. Otherwise, why would I come here?”Dudian’s eyes fell on Aisha’s body. There was only gentleness and a trace of regret in his eyes, “Unfortunately, there is no way or clue here. I can only go to further places to find it.”
Amelia looked at the tenderness on Dudian’s face. She bit her lips and didn’t say anything else.
Dudian had told her everything. He whispered to Aisha: “Let’s go.”
The Breeze Blew. Aisha’s purple cheongsam was slightly opened, revealing her snow-white calves. The scenery was picturesque and she was as calm as water.
Dudian held her hand. With a whoosh, his magic wings appeared on his back and he flew away. In the blink of an eye, he glided to the other side of the canyon and disappeared from Amelia’s sight. After flying into the forest.., the peace on his face gradually disappeared and he returned to his usual indifference.
Whoosh!
In the forest, Dudian and Aisha quickly flew forward. He used x-ray vision to check the environment in front and left to avoid being ambushed by monsters.
After four or five miles, Dudian met a forest python. Ordinary Pythons were not poisonous but this forest python had black stripes all over its body. It opened its mouth and a fishy smell wafted out. It made people dizzy. It was obvious that it was highly toxic, dudian didn’t dare to be careless. He entered the magic body and rotated his body in the air. He was like an awl as he hit the Python. Puff Puff Puff. The head of the Forest Python and the body of the giant python were instantly crushed by Dudian.
Dudian didn’t stop and continued to move forward. He wanted to leave this place as soon as possible.
Although he believed that Amelia wouldn’t let the High Priest to kill him but he couldn’t guarantee that the high priest wouldn’t want to kill him. After all, the latter wasn’t like Amelia who was inexperienced and simple-minded.
Dudian rushed out of the forest and killed a few monsters that lived in the forest. However, they were all inner barren level monsters. He was able to kill them in one move. The horror of the splitter was once again demonstrated, even if the other masters of magic marks could kill these monsters, they would need to spend a lot of effort. Only the splitter which was an extreme attack monster would be able to burst out and kill the enemy in an instant.
After leaving the forest, Dudian slowed down and continued to move forward.
Half a day later, the Sun appeared. It was noon. The Sun was the hottest time of the day. However, Dudian didn’t feel a trace of warmth. The Fog in the sky was too thick and the Sun couldn’t shine into the ruins.
After half a day of traveling, he felt that there shouldn’t be any pursuers. With the strength of the Amelia clansmen, they wouldn’t be able to chase him for so long. He crossed mountains and crossed ridges. There were some railway lines and broken houses, he came to an even bigger ruin. This ruin was already full of weeds, but he could vaguely see that it was once a city.

chapters.title: Chapter 866
chapters.content:
Chapter 866 – Chapter 856: Abyss Walker
Dudian pushed away the weeds and walked through the grass. The height of the weeds was nearly three meters and it completely submerged him and Aisha. Their vision was completely blocked. Fortunately, Dudian could use thermal response to observe the surrounding environment. After a certain distance of each line.., he would use X-ray to carefully observe the surroundings again. X-ray was too taxing on his eyesight and physical strength. However, after reaching the distance observed by X-ray, he would open it again. This time, it was repeated so that there was a greater safety guarantee.
Through x-ray, according to the arrangement of the foundation of the building, Dudian knew that he was walking on an abandoned street. There were two rows of houses around him. However, the houses had long been broken. Only the foundation which was buried in the ground was still there, however, from the outside, he couldn’t see that it was a street. It was a dense jungle with weeds. Occasionally, he would meet one or two giant skeletons that fell in the grass.
These skeletons were huge. Some of them were four or five meters tall and looked like cattle. Some of them were 20 or 30 meters long. They looked like lizards and dragons. It was not difficult to see that they used to be extremely fierce monsters but now they had turned into skeletons, in this desolate grass, insects and strange birds were allowed to stay.
Whoosh!
A fierce shadow with dark green fur and black spots suddenly jumped out from the grass. It looked like a cheetah but its body was very slender. It opened its mouth and emitted a fishy smell as it bit towards Dudian’s shoulder.
Dudian had long noticed this monster through the heat source reaction. Its level was only around 60. It was the same as a normal pioneer. He didn’t Dodge as it was lying in ambush.
Bang!
He quickly waved his right arm. A cold light flashed in front of his eyes. The next moment, the head of the monster that bit towards his shoulder was broken. It was like a crisp eggshell. Its brain was cracked and its right arm directly smashed into its body, the monster’s body fell to the ground. It didn’t Twitch or scream and died instantly.
Dudian waved his arm and threw away the brain and blood stuck on it. He sped up and waited for four or five miles before returning to his normal speed.
“Let’s find a place to rest.”Dudian turned to Aisha and said.
Although he knew that Aisha wouldn’t respond, he was already used to communicating with her.
After saying that, Dudian glanced around and saw a few monsters with lower physiques living in the grass. They were far away from him, so there was no need to pay attention to them. Seeing that the place was safe, Dudian immediately found a nearby stone pile and sat down. He took out a piece of flesh from his backpack, cut it open and fed it to Aisha.
After watching her eat it, he took out the rib meat of a forest wet tiger that he had killed on the way. Among the monsters, some of their flesh and blood were edible, just like the small blue fish in the Blue Fish Lake, although there was a lot of nuclear radiation which had a slight effect on the body after eating, but in the wilderness, one’s life could be lost at any time.
Dudian didn’t use the fire to roast the wet tiger to prevent it from emitting too strong a smell. He cut the ribs into finger-long strips and threw them into his mouth to chew and eat. The smell of blood was a bit pungent, but after eating too much, he felt that it was a bit sweet and delicious.
After eating more than half of the rib meat, Dudian felt that his stomach was cold, but his body had recovered a lot of strength. He looked at the sky. In less than four hours, the night would come.
“Let’s take advantage of the night to walk a little more.”Dudian said to Haisha.
Aisha sat quietly and didn’t speak.
Dudian stood up and continued to walk with her.
After walking for more than an hour, Dudian came out of the jungle. There was a plain in front of him. His field of vision was instantly opened. He saw dozens of piles of bones on the plain. Some were big and some were small. Some were complete and some were messy, there was a six-meter-long crawling figure that was slowly moving. It seemed to have seen Dudian and turned its head.
Dudian had never seen this monster in the Atlas. In fact, after coming to the Abyss region, there were many monsters that he had never seen in the atlas. He could only rely on the heat source reaction to judge.
When the monster looked at him, Dudian saw the heat source reaction in its body. He was relieved but he didn’t dare to be careless. After all, some monsters knew how to hide the heat source reaction, some monsters’heat source reaction was completely different from their normal state. He quietly stood and watched the monster climb over.
It was very fast but it was only at the pioneer level. Dudian was relieved. He quickly rushed out and waved his right arm. Bang! He tore the monster’s head and threw its body seven or eight meters away.
Dudian didn’t stop as he continued to move forward.
This was a plain. If he met other monsters he would be directly exposed. But fortunately he could see other monsters ahead of time.
When night fell Dudian had already crossed the plain and came to another forest. The environment outside the wall seemed to be either the plain and the jungle or the swamp and the barren black soil ruins.
“Phew, let’s rest here.”Dudian exhaled and looked at the forest in front of him. If it was not dark, he would not want to spend the night in the forest. In his experience.., the night in the forest was the most dangerous because the forest environment could collect a large amount of rain on rainy days. Moreover, it could block the sun and reduce the evaporation rate of accumulated water. Therefore, most of the forests had water sources.
Where there was water, there would be ambushes.
Dudian did not go deep. Although it was only about four o’clock at the moment, the thick fog in the sky had made the sky dark. He jumped onto a branch of a giant tree with Aisha, he checked the surrounding environment. There were two small heat sources in front and two kilometers away from the left. It was not a problem. He opened his backpack and took out the undead powder from it. He sprinkled it around the branches and under the tree, then he used a knife to cut a groove in the tree trunk. It could accommodate him and Aisha as a nest for the night.
He picked some leaves and used the branches to make a leaf door.
After they were ready, he and Aisha entered the tree hole and closed the leaf door. They were ready to wait until dawn — if they were lucky tonight.
Dudian sat in the tree hole and observed the movement around him. He didn’t dare to relax for a moment.
In this sealed environment, time quietly passed by. Loneliness, stiffness and loneliness were the enemies of wilderness hunting. The only thing that Dudian could do was to endure.
When night fell, Dudian saw that the reaction of the surrounding heat sources had increased. Red heat sources appeared around him. Some passed by in a hurry, some stayed there as if they were looking for food.
Some met each other and fought with each other.
From time to time, the loud roar of the beasts became the only song in the wilderness at night.
When it was late at night, Dudian felt sleepy. He looked at Aisha and felt that his spirit had recovered a lot. He looked around again.
At about three o’clock in the morning, suddenly, the ground shook violently. Dudian was startled. He quickly looked and saw a group of ferocious monsters sprinting from seven to eight miles behind him. They rushed straight into the forest, they were far away from him.
He was a bit surprised. Through the heat source he found that the species of the monster group were very different. Most of the monsters were from the same group but this group of monsters were strange.
He was surprised when he suddenly saw a sharp whistle fly up from behind the group of monsters. Then it swooped down and rushed into the group of monsters.
For a moment, the panicked roars of the beasts rose and fell one after another.
Dudian’s pupils shrank. He found that the flying figure was in the shape of a human!
Moreover, the heat response emitted by the human-shaped figure was as strong as the sun. It was dazzling in the dark night. He had never seen such a strong heat response, it was several times stronger than the ruler of the giant wall!
Abyss Walker!
Dudian’s heart tightened as these words appeared in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 867
chapters.content:
Chapter 867 – Chapter 857: Hoot
Dudian quickly held his breath and controlled his heartbeat to reduce the heat in his body so as not to attract the man’s attention.
His eyes faded into the smoke as he casually looked at the place where the man was. It seemed that his eyes were not focused on the man as he was afraid that he would be noticed. Generally, people with rich combat experience would be noticed by a glance. It seemed that the eyes of a creature could transmit its own thoughts, experienced hunters would be able to sense if they were being targeted by hunters.
Although Dudian’s eyes were dull but he was able to see the figure of the heat source. Most of its body looked like a human but there were strange wings on its back and a long tail behind its body, it looked like a demonized monster but it could also be a humanoid monster. In any case, the heat source emitted by the other party was not to be underestimated.
His eyes flashed. If the latter was an abyss Walker, did that mean that he was about to reach the divine kingdom? Or, was there a giant wall nearby?
Obviously, the former was more likely. The area near the giant wall had been cleared. The gathering places that could survive in the abyss were only left with the divine kingdom, except for the tribes like the Amelia tribe who lived on the sly.
The impression of the Kingdom of God was too strong. Even the Abyss Walker and the king of the giant wall had to bow to the Kingdom of God. It was clear how high the authority of the Kingdom of God was!
Dudian was a bit distracted as he thought about the possibility of the Kingdom of God in front of him. The Kingdom of God was the last place that he wanted to resurrect Aisha. He wanted to arrive immediately but he was also a bit afraid.
As his thoughts drifted to the Kingdom of God, the figure that was diving down from time to time paused for a moment. However, it was only a second and then it returned to its original state. The pause was too short, even if Dudian concentrated on observing, he might not be able to see it. After all, what he saw was only thermal imaging and not the real picture.
Whoosh!
The figure dived down again and entered the Beast Group. Suddenly there was a burst of panicked beast roar.
Dudian’s eyes slightly moved as he heard the Beast Roar. He shifted his attention to the figure. He saw that the figure was flying through the Beast Group. Soon he caught up with a huge figure that looked like a lion, it overlapped with the heat source imaging of the monster. It looked like the monster’s stomach was carrying a demon-like human.
The other monsters fled in panic. Several heat sources passed by the monster. When the monsters were far away, Dudian suddenly found that the heat source image of the monster’s stomach had disappeared.
He was startled. He couldn’t help but glance at other places. However, he still couldn’t see it. He was startled for a moment. Suddenly his heart thumped and he kicked open the leaf door in front of the tree hole, he pulled Aisha and quickly jumped out of the tree hole.
Bang!
In less than a second, the tree hole was broken and the giant tree was broken. A scarlet figure cut the giant tree like a sharp blade. He stopped and flapped his dark wings, he stood in the air like a demon and looked down at Dean and Aisha who were standing on the branch of the next giant tree.
There was a trace of surprise in his eyes when he saw Aisha.
Dean’s face was gloomy as he coldly stared at the man. At this moment, he had completely seen that this was a human. Although the latter’s magic body shape was a bit strange, but when he saw the other’s eyes, he was sure, it was the eyes of a human.
“My Friend, where are you from? How come I haven’t seen you before?”Baptiste looked at Dean. There was a trace of solemnity in the depths of his eyes, but his expression was very relaxed.
Dudian coldly said: “I haven’t seen you before either. Where are you from?”He glanced at the distant beast group and saw that they had fled in all directions, it was obvious that the latter had noticed his existence but didn’t show it. If it wasn’t for his high vigilance, the sneak attack would have taken his life.
The latter was seven or eight miles away a moment ago but he was able to quietly approach him. This speed was beyond his imagination. Was this the power of the Abyss Walker?
“It should be the speed type, the latent type.”Dudian was able to judge but he wasn’t completely sure.
Baptiste smiled and said: “I know all the experts in my place. You should be from another place, right?”
Dudian’s expression was still cold: “Don’t ask me where I come from. Tell me about the sneak attack.”
“Oh?”Baptiste’s heart sank but there was no change in his expression. He raised his eyebrows: “How? So you want to ask me for an explanation?”
Dudian’s heart tightened as he saw the change in the other’s expression. He couldn’t say anything. With the speed of this person he wouldn’t be able to run away. It would be a waste of energy. It would be better to fight head on, fortunately, the other side didn’t directly attack. It seemed that they were afraid of Dudian’s strength. After all, this was the Abyss region. Most of the people who came here were abyss walkers, the other side didn’t expect that he would dare to come here as a ruler. Therefore, he could still show off. It would be best if he could make the other side retreat.
After all, he and Aisha were two different people. Even if the other side won, they wouldn’t be able to retreat unscathed. In fact, they might even be defeated.
Therefore, he couldn’t be weak. Once he was weak, he would be exposed.
“Otherwise, do you want to let it go?”Dudian’s eyes were as cold as a sword as he looked at him, “There are few people who have provoked me in this world. Even if you call all the experts you know, you have to give me an explanation today!”
Baptiste looked at Dudian’s tough appearance. He carefully looked at every pore on Dudian’s face but didn’t see the slightest bit of fear. Although Dudian’s performance wasn’t as smooth as his but everyone’s character was different, he had seen too many experts with cold personalities. It wasn’t surprising. He had a trace of retreat in his heart. No matter how he looked at it, he might not be able to gain the upper hand in a one-on-two fight. Even if he won, he would be injured, he couldn’t do the following things.
There was a trace of regret in his heart. If he had known that it would be like this, he would have come out with those guys tonight.
“Unfortunately, I can’t send a signal to them. I didn’t think that there was a corpse king hiding here. Moreover, it seems that his physique is not low. I have never seen this person controlling a corpse king. I don’t know what method he used. Damn it!”Baptiste’s thoughts quickly turned, he was even more afraid of Dudian. After all, there were two of them. Moreover, he could see that it was the corpse king from Aisha’s appearance.
He believed that Dudian would never bring a pioneer-level king of the undead here. It would be a complete burden.
As for Dudian’s strength, he was also afraid. Previously, when he launched a sneak attack, he was actually narrowly avoided. He didn’t know whether the other party had noticed him or the flaw in the illusion that he had created, he chose to escape immediately. If it was the latter then he would admire the decisive character of the man.
“I thought that some monster was spying on me. I didn’t expect it to be the same species. If I knew it I wouldn’t have attacked. After all, there are monsters everywhere. Shouldn’t We Unite?”Baptiste’s face was relaxed, “Since it’s a misunderstanding, I apologize to you. Let’s forget about this matter. I still have things to do. See You Later!”
He smiled and turned to fly away.
Dudian was slightly startled. He didn’t expect that the other side would suddenly retreat. Soon, he understood the reason. He was relieved and broke out in cold sweat. Fortunately, he had scared the man. Otherwise, he could only let Aisha take action.

chapters.title: Chapter 868
chapters.content:
Chapter 868 – Chapter 858: Magic Pit
Whoosh!
Baptiste flew through the forest. In the blink of an eye he was back in front of the herd. He didn’t stop as he jumped over the herd and continued to move forward. At the same time he paid attention to the rear, he was relieved to see that Dudian was still standing on the branch of the giant tree. He slowed down a bit. There was a trace of coldness in his heart, “Little Brat, you are lucky this time. If I didn’t come out to relax tonight, I would have tortured you to control the undead King!”
There was jealousy and anger in his heart. Although he had killed countless undead kings but he was able to control one of them to serve him. It was an unimaginable value! It should be known that the Zombie King could control other high-level zombies. Just this characteristic alone was equivalent to bringing an army of zombies with him. He could move freely in the Abyss and even go to many dangerous places, he could even use zombies to open a path and explore.
Other than this ability, the most valuable thing was the growth of the Zombie King itself!
In terms of evolution, the Zombie King was the same as other zombies. It relied on eating flesh and blood to evolve. Compared to humans, this was extremely terrifying! One had to know that for humans to evolve from Hunter to limiter, they needed concentrated energy divine liquid. To advance from pioneer to ruler, they needed deified legendary level magic marks. These harsh factors greatly limited the number of human powerhouses.
But the Zombie King didn’t need to care about these things. As long as there was flesh and blood, it was fine. The speed of evolution depended on the quality of the flesh and blood.
Some people would ask, “If that’s the case, why are some zombie kings only at the level of pioneers?”?
The reason was very simple. Although the growth rate of zombie kings was heaven-defying, their intelligence was too low. Most zombie kings only had instincts and simple consciousness in the early stage. Their instincts were to control other zombies and eat.
Therefore, where there was a zombie crowd, there were mostly zombie kings. When Zombie Kings controlled the zombie crowd to attack their prey, even if they could kill the prey, there wouldn’t be much flesh left in their mouths. After all.., the Zombies in the zombie hordes were also crazy about fresh blood and flesh. The zombie kings in the early stages didn’t even know how to control the zombie hordes to keep the spoils of war for themselves. This was a basic selfishness that most humans and even most living beings understood, it wouldn’t exist in the Zombie Kings’minds. Unless they had evolved to an extremely powerful level, they wouldn’t have intelligence that was close to that of ordinary animals or even humans.
It was precisely because of this that the growth of the zombie king was greatly restricted. Moreover, when attacking its prey, the zombie king, like most zombies, wouldn’t pick an opponent. Even if it encountered something that it couldn’t match, it would continue to attack, as a result, they would sooner or later step into the territory of an existence that it couldn’t defend against, and would be directly killed.
The King corpse was like a piece of excellent steel. It was like forging this piece of steel into a sharp weapon or armor. Nothing could break the rules!
It was because of this that Baptiste was jealous of Dudian. In his knowledge, no one could control the King Corpse! Even the supreme existences in the Kingdom of God couldn’t do this!
Whether it was in the place where he lived or in the divine kingdom, they were all secretly researching this difficult problem. However, no one had been able to do it for hundreds of years. Although someone had once controlled the corpse king, it was only a simple control, soon, it was killed by the backlash of the corpse king, whose strength had increased. After all, while the corpse king was evolving, its intelligence would also slowly evolve. Using some long-term experimental methods, it could indeed control the corpse king, who was almost unconscious at the beginning, but after the undead king evolved to a certain extent, it would devour its master. This had happened more than once in history.
He didn’t know what kind of method Dudian used but he knew that the beautiful elf-like woman next to the teenager was definitely not an early pioneer level undead King!
“If this news spreads to the holy kingdom, it will cause a sensation. At least among those big figures.”Baptiste thought maliciously in his heart. Unfortunately, he didn’t see where the teenager came from, if he knew the giant wall where he lived, then it would be easier to deal with him. As long as he spread the news, it was estimated that the giant wall would soon become the target of all forces.
After ten minutes, he was already hundreds of kilometers away from the youth’s position. This was because he didn’t rush at full speed. He was always paying attention to the monsters that might be hidden in the dark, he didn’t see Dudian chasing after him. Although he had encountered some powerful monsters along the way, but he had quietly avoided them. After all, his magic marks were very good at hiding.
“It seems that this kid is a coward. He doesn’t dare to chase after me. If it were me, I would kill him in a two-on-one fight. Hehe, when I ambushed him, he was still hiding in the tree hole. It’s ridiculous…”Baptiste couldn’t help but laugh in his heart, however, before he could laugh, he suddenly stopped and stood rooted to the ground. A few breaths later, he slapped himself in the face.
“Bastard!”
“I actually missed this!”
Baptiste quickly turned around and returned at full speed along the original path. Along the way, his figure flashed as he charged forward at high speed.
He was both anxious and angry. This crucial point had actually been overlooked by him earlier. It was simply unforgivable!
“If that youth was an abyss, why would he hide in the tree hole outside the magic pit? There aren’t even many rulers around here. I’m So Stupid!”Baptiste was regretful, he had previously thought of the youth and the corpse king beside him as two abyss walkers, but now it seemed that the youth was at most a ruler, and the corpse king was most likely the same.
With such strength, he could only wander around the periphery of the magic pit. Moreover, he was hiding in the tree hole at night. There were obvious means to cover up traces in the surroundings. It was clear that he was afraid of being found by the monsters.
Although he would occasionally stop to rest in such an area, but he would never be so cautious.
He flew back and forth. He wanted to give himself a few more slaps. He was a dignified abyss, but he was actually intimidated by a master, not even a ruler. It was simply a disgrace!
..
..
Dudian watched as Baptiste left. He used his X-ray vision to lock onto Baptiste’s figure. After half a minute, he took Aisha’s hand and left.
The reason why he was calm was because he was pretending to be calm. He had to be calm. After all, he didn’t know what the range of the opponent’s perception was. If the range was larger than his range of vision.., if the other party saw him fleeing in panic, they would most likely come back to kill him.
After flying in the opposite direction for thousands of meters, dudian estimated that the other party had either fled far away or hidden his figure again. He couldn’t show any panic, he continued to calmly fly forward while he considered the second possibility. It was not the second possibility. On the contrary, his intuition told him that the other party should have fled far away.
However, his survival experience told him that the most dangerous possibility was the most likely. That was the way to live long.
“Let’s check if he is behind us.”Dean’s eyes slightly flashed. He slightly accelerated and ran from the side of Aisha who was originally running in parallel to her. The two figures overlapped. If he looked from the back.., unless he had perspective, he would be able to see his movements.
His hand speed was very fast. He took out a small bottle and a roll of nearly transparent silk thread from his backpack.
He put the bottle into his sleeve and hid the transparent silk coil. He looked at the surrounding environment and rushed to another forest in front of him.
The previous scene of the man driving away the beasts and wantonly killing made Dudian less afraid of the forest in front of him. He faintly guessed that there might not be any strong monsters in the vicinity.
After entering the Dark Forest, Dudian jumped from tree to tree while he was in a hurry. It seemed very natural but in fact it was not strange for him to jump onto the tree. After all, compared to the branches.., there were more dangers on the ground.
When he jumped onto the tree branch, the semi-transparent silk coil in his hand quickly decreased. The silk was very thin and completely transparent. It would not reflect light. It was specially made by him. It was very useful for setting up early warning in the wild, there was also a bell, but he was in a hurry. He did not hang a bell on the silk, which could only be used to defend against monsters. If it was used against humans, the bell would expose the silk.

chapters.title: Chapter 869
chapters.content:
Chapter 869 – Chapter 859: Lurk And Lurk
Dudian rushed out of the forest. He didn’t stop but continued to move forward. He came to a hill about 20 miles away from the forest. He found a small hill surrounded by craggy rocks and hid there, this was the limit of his thermal vision. He could see the movement of monsters in the forest through the heat source. If these monsters came close to the warning zone and triggered the mechanism.., at least he could tell that they were not the pursuers.
However, he knew that he couldn’t completely rely on this small warning device. After all, he knew nothing about the enemy’s ability. But since he had reached the level of the abyss, in addition to some extremely terrifying abilities.., he wouldn’t be too inferior in other aspects.
Dudian took out the water from his backpack and drank a few mouthfuls to recover his strength. At the same time he was thinking about the follow-up preparations.
Whoosh!
Baptiste returned at full speed. The noise he made along the way was a bit loud and startled some monsters. However the monsters seemed to have sensed his murderous aura. They stopped after a few steps, dudian didn’t continue to chase after them. After all, with his speed it would only be a short time for him to pass through the territory of these monsters. Most of the monsters wouldn’t fight with strong enemies unless their territory was invaded.
It must be known that the survival of humans was very difficult in this abyss. Monsters were the same. Once they were injured, they would become the food of other monsters.
“Damn kid, I will tear your face apart when I catch you!”Baptiste was angry. In less than 15 minutes, he went back to the previous forest. When he came to the tree hole where Dudian was attacked.., dudian’s figure was long gone. Baptiste had expected this. But when he saw this scene, his heart was even more angry. At the same time, he was more convinced that Dudian had slipped away.
His eyes followed the branches and extended to the distance. In the dark forest, there seemed to be a road that only he could see. The road seemed to be a shining footprint, it was guiding the direction in which he was tracking.
“You’re just a mere ruler. It’s your bad luck to meet me!”Baptiste sneered in his heart. Although his tracking ability was not as good as his hiding ability, it was still considered the second strongest among his many abilities.., it was precisely because he could both track and hide that he dared to come to the outer edge of the magic pit in the middle of the night to relax and not worry about being ambushed by other high-level monsters.
Whoosh!
His figure flew out, shaking the tree branches so much that they rustled. His figure dashed out of the forest like an arrow leaving the bow. After a moment, he continued to move forward, passing through plains, bushes, and a forest that was more than ten miles in diameter.
“He actually walked in a straight line. HMPH, the smell is still very strong. He should not be far from here.”A hint of cruelty flashed in Baptiste’s eyes. The other party did not try to erase his aura, which surprised him a little. was he fearless? Or was he really stupid? Obviously, even if he had reached the master level, he should understand this basic common sense. However, in his opinion, Dudian didn’t erase the smell. It was obvious that he was going to act calm as before. He wanted to trick him but he wouldn’t fall for it anymore!
Baptiste’s eyes became more and more obvious as he quietly rushed into the forest. There was a trace of a sinister smile on his face as he quickly moved forward. Suddenly.., his figure suddenly stopped as if the scene had been paused for an instant. The pause was extremely abrupt, but the leaves stirred by the breeze and the clouds floating in the sky above the forest.., all showed that time had not stopped.
Just this ability to stop at high speed was enough to make most experts gasp in admiration and envy.
Bartiste narrowed his eyes slightly. His gaze fell on a leaf that was about to touch his hand. The clouds on the forest dispersed and moonlight shone down. A flash of light flashed past. He saw clearly that it was a thread. In fact.., he could see it clearly even without the moonlight because he “Saw”it with his nose.
His gaze followed the extremely concealed thread. He saw that the thread was crisscrossing and twining around the branches of the giant tree in front of him. Moreover, they were all twined around the areas where the leaves were lush. They were extremely concealed and even those with good eyesight would not be able to notice them.
He swept his gaze over and the scarlet color in his eyes became even more intense. There was also a hint of a smile. Clearly, this was a trap left behind by the youth. From this, it could be seen that the youth was wary of him. He was basically 100% certain now.., this youth was definitely not an abyss Walker like him!
“Brat, you’re finished!”Baptiste sneered in his heart. His figure moved slightly, bypassing the place where the transparent threads entwined, and passing by the side. After successfully bypassing the giant tree, he glanced around, soon, he caught sight of a monster perched on the giant tree. It looked like a cheetah, but also like a big cat. He took out a piece of hard candy from his bosom, threw it in the middle of the giant tree area where the threads entwined, and then turned around to continue forward, the speed this time was not as fast as before. Therefore, the place that he passed by was so light that even the breeze was very light. There was no movement at all.
“With the current temperature, three minutes of saccharification will loosen the mucous membrane inside and give off the fragrance of meat. Three minutes later, the trap will be activated. During this period of time, you will be the most relaxed. No matter if you are a ruler or an abyss, you will die!”Baptiste was like a hunter who had sneaked into the night, his gaze was cold and cruel as he quietly advanced through the night.
Following the scent, he soon arrived at the hilly area. His gaze locked onto a small hill.
“The scent is still there. It has stopped here. HMPH, are you trying to ambush Me Here?”Baptiste smiled coldly. He was just about to approach when he suddenly stopped. A sharp light flashed in his eyes, “I see, this is the real trap. If he knows that he is no match for me, then the thread in the forest is the early warning device. Since he has made the early warning method, then this place will be the ambush site. However, he didn’t hide the smell, which shows that this place is also an early warning device, and it is very likely that it has combined the effects of the trap, a double early warning method!”
“As long as I make a move, he will know that his original body and the corpse king should have been hidden nearby. They won’t be able to go far.”
Thinking of this, Baptiste stopped and carefully used his ability to simulate the shape and characteristics of the surroundings. At the same time, he looked around and used his sense of smell to search and distinguish carefully.
Even if one used some kind of method to wipe away the smell, there would always be something left behind. One had to know that other than the body secreting sweat and releasing the smell, there would be traces of the original smell on one’s clothes and boots, or the smell of the place one passed by. There were too many of these smells and it was impossible to completely eliminate them. Even someone with his special latent ability could not do it.
So as long as he was careful enough, he could find the flaw.
However, he knew that he didn’t have much time left. When the silk thread was touched, the teenager should be the most alert and the most relaxed. If he appeared next to him and attacked, he would definitely be able to kill him in one hit!
However, three minutes had passed. He was anxious to find Dudian in the short time left. However, the anxiety didn’t affect his body’s fluctuation.
“The fragrance of flowers, the moist soil…”baptiste searched carefully like a hunting dog.
Suddenly, the sound of a strong wind came from the distance.
Although it was a strong wind, but only his hearing could hear the sound of branches moving in the forest twenty miles away. Moreover, he had been paying attention to the movement of the branches.
The sound of the wind was like the sound of a giant tree being bent. He knew that the silk thread was broken.
His face slightly sank. He had missed the best opportunity to attack.
He controlled himself to calm down and continued to concentrate on the search.
A few minutes later, Dudian heard the sound of stones being smashed. His eyes flashed cold. He didn’t look back and continued to move forward.
Baptiste searched for a few minutes but still couldn’t find Dudian. He knew that there was no point in continuing to disguise. Dudian knew that he was here so he didn’t hide anymore, he rushed to the source of the smell. There was a white towel hanging on top of a stone. There were words engraved on the stone under the towel: Idiot, Congratulations!
That’s right, there was an exclamation mark behind the word “You”, filled with malice.
Baptiste was so angry that his mouth almost twisted. He immediately punched the rock, and with a bang, the rock shattered.
When he smashed the rock, he suddenly woke up and could not help but curse. He suspected that the words on the rock were deliberately left to provoke him, and he smashed the rock with anger, the sound that was created just happened to remind the other party.
This was another warning device, and he had clearly seen it, but he had personally triggered it!
Thinking of this result and the few words carved on the stone, he felt that his head was about to explode with anger!

chapters.title: Chapter 870
chapters.content:
Chapter 870 – Chapter 860: Counter-Chase
Batiste hadn’t fought with Dudian yet. He didn’t even hurt a hair on his body but he felt extremely humiliated.
He clenched his teeth. The anger in his heart made him want to roar. But he held back this time. He didn’t want Dudian to take advantage of his roar to hide his voice, he couldn’t be fooled again!
He controlled himself to calm down. His anger turned into murderous intent. He looked at every inch of the soil. He checked every leaf and weed on the ground. He was looking for Dudian’s footprints, and the smell.
However, he checked again and again. There was no trace of Dudian’s footprints near the stone. He suddenly understood that Dudian or the king of corpses had the ability to fly!
Looking at the vast night sky, Baptiste took off into the air. His fists were clenched and his eyes were gloomy. He knew that it would be very difficult to find Dudian again.
He thought of the Abyss, but he was deceived and even humiliated by a ruler. The hatred in his heart almost swallowed the whole hill under his feet. He suppressed his anger and continued to search in the vicinity.
Dudian slowly moved forward in the forest. It was very difficult for him to move because he had hidden himself and Aisha in the body of a python. The Python was not dead but it was not far from death.
He believed that as long as the person did not have the ability to sense the smell and heat source, they would not be able to detect him. After all, he had covered up the smell before entering the python, although it wasn’t completely covered up, but now with the Python to cover up, even people with extremely sensitive sense of smell would find it difficult to detect him! Moreover, he could use the Python’s heat source to cover up the weak heat emitted from his body.
Dudian knew that the second warning he had set up had worked. He didn’t stop but continued to squirm. He maintained the snake’s wriggling posture and squirmed very slowly, he used his X-ray vision to penetrate the body of the giant python. He saw the figure of the abyss. The Abyss was scanning the ground as it flew but didn’t seem to notice anything unusual about the giant python.
The body of the giant python couldn’t even squeeze out the outline of a human after swallowing two people.
Dudian stopped for a moment and continued to move forward.
Ten minutes later, Dudian saw the abyss fly back and disappear into the distance.
