He didn’t drill out of the mouth of the snake but continued to control the giant python to move forward. Half an hour later, he saw the Abyss Pass by again. However this time it didn’t come from above his head but flew over the left side of the forest, he rushed into the distance.
Dudian wryly smiled in his heart. It seemed that the Abyss was angry because of his words. It was obvious that there was no clue but it didn’t want to give up. It wasn’t afraid that it would attract other monsters.
He stayed in the body of the dying Python. He coiled around the tree and quietly waited.
Dudian saw the Abyss return and fly away. He ignored it and controlled the Python to swim to another tree. He waited for the night to pass.
This time the Abyss didn’t appear and seemed to give up. Dudian still didn’t come out of the Python’s body. He controlled the Python to swim a distance from time to time and stayed in the sticky Python’s body for a long time, his body was used to it. The night had passed and Dawn appeared on the horizon as if it was hope.
Dudian suddenly understood something when he saw the ray of sunlight. The gods and beliefs that all living beings sought were like this ray of light. No matter how dark the night was, it could be torn apart and bring hope to the people who were struggling in the darkness, bring light.
“Unfortunately, it will not appear at night. This is the rule of the universe and the rule of life…”Dudian looked at the warm dawn. He sighed in his heart. Hope was beautiful. He never denied it but it was a pity.., hope always came too late. The saddest thing was that hope would never come early because early hope would only bring greater despair.
Just like the dawn that came early, it lengthened the day and affected many factors, which would instead cause the collapse of the biological chain. All of this was ultimately the rule of creation.
The only thing that could be changed was to become a king in that long night.
He thought sentimentally and quickly put away his thoughts. The Day had arrived, and it was time for him to get down to business.
“From last night’s situation, the Abyss is good at hiding and tracking. I don’t know if it was for hunting or other purposes. The majority of the beasts are pioneers and there isn’t even a master. It is too low for the abyss to hunt such monsters. I don’t know if he is bluffing or if there is an abyss that matches his strength. Logically speaking, this shouldn’t be the Kingdom of God…”
After a night of escape and a long wait in the giant python, Dudian thought of many things. It had been ten years since the Lord of Aristotle had gone to the Kingdom of God. It was clear that the road to the Kingdom of God was very long, although it was impossible to spend all of the ten years on the road but it wouldn’t be so close. After all, it wasn’t a long time for him to come out from the giant wall.
It could be determined that the Kingdom of God wasn’t nearby. The Abyss was either an existence of other giant walls or a survivor of the abyss like Amelia.
Dudian felt a headache. Most of the time he felt that information was more important than combat power. He didn’t know what was happening in the other giant walls. He only knew that the lord of the giant wall was an abyss, were there any other abyss in the other giant walls?
Dudian felt that the strength of each giant wall should be uneven. At least the giant wall where the group of nine was located was stronger than the giant wall of Sylvia. After all.., they were able to send nine strong experts to cross the Abyss to find Sylvia and almost kill all of them. This was something that Sylvia couldn’t do.
If the Abyss came from the other giant wall then Dudian would be able to deal with it. But if the others came from the survivors of the Abyss then it would be troublesome. After all, the giant wall was an “Official force”under the control of the Kingdom of God, although he didn’t know the strength of the giant wall. Maybe there were two or three masters of the Abyss. But in comparison, the survivors of the Abyss were more terrifying.
After all, he didn’t know what the survivors of the Abyss had in their hands. For example, the Amelia tribe was weak but they had a laser cannon. Moreover, they were living in a super aircraft which was suspected to be an Aragami spaceship, it was much more difficult to understand than the giant wall.
“I should be able to find clues about him from the direction of the beasts that he expelled yesterday.”Dudian thought. No matter which possibility it was, he was going to take the risk to get close to the giant wall, at least it would be good to know the location of the giant wall. It might be useful in the future. If it was the survivors of the abyss, he would need to find a way to kill the person from last night. Then he would need to break into their interior to see if there was a way to treat Aisha.
After making up his mind, Dudian climbed out of the mouth of the Python which was half-dead. He cut its belly and pulled Aisha out. Both of them were in a bit of a mess but they were used to such things in the wilderness.
Dudian took Aisha out of the forest and flew along the plains outside. At the same time, he paid attention to the surroundings in case the abyss was still in the vicinity last night. Although the possibility was very low.
After a moment, Dudian found a path that was trampled full of mud pits. It was the same path that the herd passed last night. There was a monster’s corpse on the ground every distance, the smell of the Abyss from last night was still lingering in the air.
Dudian looked at the direction where the footprints came from. His eyes narrowed as he quietly followed Aisha.

chapters.title: Chapter 871
chapters.content:
Chapter 871 – Chapter 861: Team From The Abyss
Whoosh!
A figure landed in a certain hill basin.
The humidity in this basin was rather thick. At this moment, a bonfire was lit in the middle of the basin. Four people were surrounding the bonfire. Some of them were lying on the rocks beside the bonfire while others were playing with knives and carving wood, some of them were holding a furry little animal in their arms. They gently stroked it and stared at the bonfire in a daze.
Hearing the commotion, one of the women who was sitting quietly by the bonfire and resting with her eyes closed opened her mouth and said, “You’re back?”
The other two people turned their heads and saw a tall and thin figure slowly walking over from the basin. Under the illumination of the bonfire, his thin face looked a little eerie. It was Baptiste. He did not reply, he sat down on an empty spot by the bonfire and casually picked up a piece of firewood to add in.
Phisnia slowly opened her eyes. Her blue eyes fell on Batiste, who was opposite her, and she frowned slightly, “Why do you smell like blood? Didn’t I tell you that it’s okay to go out for a walk? When you come back, clean up the stench on your body. Don’t affect our Big Event Tomorrow!”
“I’ll clean it up later,”Batiste replied weakly. He did not dare to be angry with this woman even if he wanted to. He could only feel depressed. Now, whenever he thought of the words on the stone wall, he could not help but clench his teeth, he wanted to clench his fists, but the regret in his heart made him feel aggrieved. However, it was his own fault, which made him feel like he had nowhere to vent his frustration.
Phisnia’s dark blue eyes were pure and crystal clear. She stared at Baptiste and frowned. “What happened?”
“What else could have happened to him? He must not have found a suitable person to practice with,”the young man who was carving wood beside him raised his head and said with a smile.
Baptiste rolled his eyes at him, but he didn’t hide it. He said, “When I went out for a walk tonight, I bumped into a person. Judging from the armor of that person, he shouldn’t be from our place. Most likely, he’s from one of the divine walls nearby.”
“Oh?”
“There’s another abyss here?”
Hearing Baptiste’s words, the others were all interested and looked up at Baptiste.
Felicia frowned slightly and said to the middle-aged woman who was hugging the furry animal, “Wifetler, are there any other sacred walls nearby?”
This middle-aged woman with a slightly masculine name was extremely beautiful. Just by looking at her appearance, one would never believe that she was already in her fifties. Her skin was as white as cream, and her delicate oval face made her appear cold and charming, at the same time, she was also somewhat cute. She stroked the furry little animal in her hand, and with her other hand, she took out a scroll from the bag on her back and opened it to look, she shook her head and said, “No, there is no divine wall within three thousand miles of here.”
“I told you, which divine wall would be so close to the magic pit?”The young man who carved the wood said with a smile.
Phisnia frowned and looked at Baptiste. “Have you fought with that person? What kind of strength do you have? Middle or lower? Or… Upper?”
Baptiste sighed and shook his head slightly.
Seeing him like this, Phisnia, Wifetler, and the carved wood youth couldn’t help but be moved. Seeing their expressions, Baptiste immediately knew that they had misunderstood. He was a little conflicted. He really didn’t want to mention this. “If my feeling is right, that person is just a ruler.”
“Ruler?”Everyone was startled, but they were relieved.
Phisnia glanced at Baptiste and said, “Is there anything special about this ruler?”
The carved wood youth also saw the strange expression on Baptiste’s face and teased, “Could it be that he wanted to kill this ruler, but he ran away?”
Baptiste didn’t expect him to guess correctly. He couldn’t help but glare at him and said unhappily, “You’re the one who talks too much!”
“Is that really the case?”Wittler was surprised.
The carved wood youth laughed loudly, he said, “You still don’t know Baptiste’s character. He suddenly saw a person in this abyss, and he was a ruler. It would be strange if he did not capture him as a toy. Looking at his dejected look, it was obvious that he had failed. However, I only made a casual guess. I did not expect that I would really hit it. Haha, Baptiste, you actually managed to let a ruler escape from your hands. You’re really amazing!”
Baptiste’s lips trembled slightly as he glared at him coldly. “Do you believe that he can escape from my hands? With your abilities, he can make you run around in circles.”
The carved wood youth smiled and said, “Yes, I believe you. Who doesn’t know that you have a strong tracking ability? However, if it were me, he wouldn’t have the chance to escape. As long as I see him, he will die in my hands. Do you believe this?”
Batiste’s eyes were spitting fire as he said, “What do you mean?”
“Enough!”Seeing that the two of them were about to quarrel again.., he frowned and said, “Sven, tell me what’s the situation first. This person is only a ruler, yet he dares to come here. He must have extraordinary abilities.”These words were deliberately to give Batiste a way out, but she knew clearly in her heart.., to be able to escape from Batiste’s hands as a ruler, this was definitely not something that could be described with the simple words “Extraordinary abilities.”.
Batiste snorted lightly, he said, “Speaking of this matter, it was also my negligence. I was having fun when I suddenly saw that kid hiding on a tree. When I launched a sneak attack, this kid also noticed me and dodged in time. At that time, I didn’t know whether this kid was an abyss or a ruler. Most importantly, this kid was able to control the corpse king. Beside him was a beautiful corpse king. It gave me a feeling that it was quite dangerous. At that time, I thought that this corpse king was also an abyss. I thought that if I fought two against one, even if I won, I would most likely be injured and implicated in tomorrow’s operation.”
The carved wood youth smiled lightly, the corners of his mouth curling up. Although he didn’t say anything, his meaning was clear: you are obviously cowardly, what does it have to do with tomorrow’s Operation?
Baptiste looked at him coldly, and then continued to explain, “After I left, I realized that this kid might not be the ruler, so I went back to investigate. In the end, this kid really slipped away, and his hiding ability is quite strong. I searched for more than two hours, but I still couldn’t find him. If Wifetler was here at that time, this kid would definitely be finished!”
A trace of fluctuation flashed in Phisnia’s blue eyes. She said, “You said that this person can control the corpse king?”
“That’s right!”Only then did batiste think of the important point that he wanted to say, he said, “I don’t know where this kid learned it from. I suspect that this kid might not be from the other divine walls. It might be this abyssal survivor. Didn’t someone say that there are still survivors from the previous era in this abyss? There were once people who saw the things and traces of activity created by the abyssal survivor here. I suspect that this kid might be the abyssal survivor here.”
PHISNIA asked, “Have you talked to him? Do you know what language he speaks?”
Baptiste said, “It’s the common language of the divine wall.”
“Since it’s the common language of the divine wall, what else is there to doubt?”The carved wood youth said unhappily.
Baptiste rolled his eyes at him and said, “Wouldn’t the abyssal survivors sneak into the divine wall to secretly learn it? There’s no way to control the corpse king in the divine wall. Which Monster Research Institute in the Divine Wall found such a method and dared not to hand it in?”
Phesenia nodded slightly, he said, “It doesn’t matter where he is from for the time being. At present, this person should still be nearby. Although a small ruler doesn’t have much influence on us, we don’t know what level the king of corpses he controls is. No matter what, Wifetler, you should pay more attention to the surroundings for the next operation. Don’t let others pick up the scraps behind us.”
“Yes, I will.”Wittler nodded and touched the furry little animal in his hand.
“When we go back, we can tell that Lord about this person. He has always been very interested in the undead. If he knew that someone could control the zombie king, he would probably find this person at all costs. At that time, we can also be considered to be the informants. If it’s valuable, we might be able to receive a big reward.”Phisnia smiled.
Baptiste smiled in his heart. The reason why he said such a shameful thing was because of this purpose. He wanted to take revenge through the hands of the Lord.
“Go and clean yourself up. It’s almost dawn. We are ready to move out.”.
Baptiste nodded. He looked at the sky and got up to leave.
..
… ..
Dudian walked along the tracks of the beasts. He didn’t walk fast in case he ran into the abyss. He hid his breath all the time. After more than an hour, he came to a hill country.
There were no tracks of the beasts but there was still the smell of the abyss. Dudian could smell other scents in the air, including the faint body scent of a woman.
Dudian was surprised. Cold Sweat broke out on his back. was there someone else here? Was there more than one abyss?
He wanted to turn around and leave. If there was only one person from the abyss last night, even if he met him, he was confident that he could escape. But from the smell in the air, there were at least four people. If all of them were from the abyss.., he wouldn’t be able to escape even if he had wings.
He stopped moving forward and slowly retreated far away. As he retreated further and further away, the tension in his heart slowly relaxed. He couldn’t help but think that if these people were from the Abyss, then why did they come here in groups?
Hunting a monster?
Wait, in addition to the Kingdom of God, which God wall could have so many abysses?
Although Dudian wasn’t sure if the four smells were all abysses, but he was sure that there were at least two abysses. Otherwise, the Abyss wouldn’t have left four masters there and he wouldn’t have come out alone.
“So many abysses gathered at once. If all of them were abysses, then it would be equivalent to five wall masters. So they came here to hunt a monster? What else is there in the abyss? The survivors of the Abyss? The ruins of the last century?”Dudian speculated, these speculations made him more curious. He wanted to follow them to find out the truth. But his reason told him that he wasn’t the main character in the novel. He didn’t have such good luck. Even if the other party was looking for treasures.., he could only stare at them with his puny strength.
In that case, wouldn’t it be stupid to risk his life in order to feast his eyes?
“You go your way and I’ll go mine. I’ll let it go this time. If we meet again in the future, HMPH, whoever is weak will be unlucky.”Dudian thought in his heart, both of them turned back to look for each other. But after looking for each other, there was no result. They could only resentfully end it.
Dudian didn’t think much as he saw the sun rise. He continued to follow his original path. It was the opposite of the previous exploration of the hill. He only prayed that this direction was the opposite of Last Night’s Abyss, it was not the same route.
For the sake of insurance, he decided to move 300 miles horizontally and continue north.
This time he was more cautious. After all, Last Night’s Abyss and his companions would appear in the surroundings at any time. There was a possibility that they would run into him while chasing a monster. If that was the case, he could only admit that he was unlucky.
Three hundred miles wasn’t long or short. If it was in the hunting area, Dudian would be able to fly there in an hour. But in the abyss he could only obediently go on foot. He met many monsters along the way. Most of them were pioneer level monsters, occasionally there would be small monsters of Hunter level. However most of them were poison type monsters. Dudian would either avoid them or go all out to kill them. He didn’t dare to be careless.

chapters.title: Chapter 872
chapters.content:
Chapter 872 – Chapter 862: The Second Wall
Puff!
The head of a rock lizard was cut off and its body fell down.
Dudian looked around and quickly squatted down. He cut open the body of the rock lizard and took out the ‘soul guide bottle’. It was a special bottle that could be used to get parasitic soul worms from monsters in the wilderness, there was the smell of parasitic soul worms at the bottom of the bottle. He inserted the mouth of the bottle into the neck of the rock lizard. Blood flowed. After half a minute there was no movement from the body of the rock lizard.
Dudian sighed. He knew that the rock lizard was not a monster. He took back the bottle and continued to move forward.
He had never seen most of the monsters in the Abyss. He could only rely on the ‘soul guide bottle’to identify which one was a monster. However he didn’t kill many of them, moreover, some of the monsters were obviously ordinary monsters, so he did not bother to test them. Only some of the more cunning monsters with special abilities would he test them.
For example, the rock lizard had disguised itself as a rock and lurked around him, but he did not notice it at all. It showed how strong its camouflage ability was. Fortunately, its strength was average, only at the level of a pioneer.., so it didn’t cause any harm to him.
“The magic mark on the chest of the splitter is gone. There is only an empty magic nest left. Fortunately, the splitter’s ability can still be used. I don’t know if the splitter’s ability will be cut off after the right arm is cut off. After all, the magic mark has been swallowed by that thing…”Dudian thought about his own situation, he was a bit upset as he thought about his own situation. The change in his right arm made him feel uneasy. If he didn’t consider the possibility that the splitter’s ability would be cut off after the right arm was cut off, he would have taken action long ago.
In the past two days, he saw that the frozen flesh within half a centimeter of the golden sarcoma in his right arm had turned into a faint golden color. It was obvious that the golden sarcoma had infected him.
When the golden color spread to his body, he felt that his brain might be invaded again.
This made him very depressed. Although the increase in the strength of his right arm had given him another card, but if he could give up the danger in his body, he would rather not have this card. Unfortunately, it was not up to him.
After moving 300 miles horizontally, Dudian continued to go north. Although the journey was boring, but he had to be very careful.
Puff!
Dudian suddenly attacked and killed a monster that looked like a cow or a mouse. He took out the ‘soul guide bottle’and aimed at its broken neck. Ten seconds later, Dudian saw that there was a slight bulge on the back of this strange monster, it seemed that something was swimming over. His eyes lit up. He used his X-ray vision and saw that it was a small blood-red worm. It was the parasitic soul worm!
Soon, the parasitic soul worm drilled into the ‘soul guide bottle’. When Dudian screwed the cap on the bottle, the blood-red worm seemed to realize that it had fallen into a trap. It struggled violently in the bottle and knocked into the bottle.
Dudian put it into his backpack and quickly left the place with Aisha. He came to a messy stone pile. He sat on a piece of stone that looked like concrete. He looked at the surrounding environment and confirmed that it was safe, he asked Aisha to guard him. Then he took out the syringe and the corresponding props from the backpack. He wanted to verify whether the parasitic soul worm could still be used as nutrients for his body.
Soon, the blood-colored worm inside the soul guide bottle was sucked into the syringe. Dudian took off his armor and lifted his shirt. He looked at the faint scar in the middle of his chest, through x-ray vision he could see that there was a bubble-like thing inside. The surface of the bubble-like demon nest was covered with a layer of membrane. However, there were many fine hair-like blood vessels around the bubble-like demon nest. In a sense.., his limbs didn’t belong to the category of human structure.
Dudian took a deep breath and injected the parasitic soul worm into the nest.
Dark red mucus quickly filled the nest. From the surface it looked like there was a red birthmark. It was very soft and bulging.
Dudian stared at it and felt its changes.
Time passed by but the burning sensation didn’t appear. Dudian looked at the parasitic soul worm mucus in the nest. His face slowly sank. He continued to wait for more than ten minutes but there was no change. He put away the syringe and soul guide bottle. He put on clothes and armor, “Do I have to inject it into the golden sarcoma in order to have an effect?”
“The golden sarcoma will be removed sooner or later. If it is removed then the splitter’s magic marks will be gone. Won’t my power decline to the bottom?”
He sighed in his heart. If he encountered such a situation in the giant wall then he would be able to make a choice. He wouldn’t be in such a dilemma. But in this dangerous abyss he wasn’t willing to give up his right arm, he didn’t want to take the risk of losing the magic marks of the splitter. It meant that he would lose his ability to see through things. He would lose his ability to sense heat and his magic body. At that time he wouldn’t be as good as an ordinary pioneer.
Dudian felt frustrated and helpless as he didn’t want to cut out the golden sarcoma.
Suddenly he thought of the abyss that he had met before, “If it isn’t the Kingdom of God then the other side is using the common language of the giant wall. It should be a very powerful wall. I don’t know if it is divided into different levels. In any case, if we can find a wall and sneak in, it will be safer than in the abyss. Then we can take the opportunity to find out the situation. We can find other legendary magic marks and get rid of the sarcoma. Even if we lose the splitter’s magic marks there will be other legendary magic marks to replace it.”
It was the worst-case scenario, but compared to other options, it was the best solution at the moment.
Although he was very hesitant to replace the splitter’s magic marks, there was nothing he could do about it. With the rate at which the golden sarcoma was spreading, it would probably spread out from his right arm in less than four to five days, at that time, he would face even more danger and headaches.
If time was not tight then he would be able to return to Sylvia where he could at least guarantee that he would get a legendary parasitic soul worm.
“If I replace the magic marks then I will fall from the master level. The limit of a legendary magic mark is the inner wasteland level. Only a deified legendary can bear the body of a master. I don’t know what level the magic marks of the Abyss Walker are but I think there should be a higher existence above the legendary level…”Dudian sighed in his heart, eating the flesh of the Aragami was a wrong choice, but now he had to pay the price for it.
He stood up. Although he had made a decision, but it was still unknown if he could find the wall. After all, the area where the Abyss Walkers were active was too wide, it was hard to say if the wall from the Abyss was nearby.
“The level of monsters around the wall is generally low. I should have a chance to find them if I look in the direction of the lower level monsters.”Dudian recalled the distribution of monsters he had met along the way, he found a strong and weak route but it was in conflict with his northward direction. It was in the east.
Dudian immediately walked along the east. There was still a long way from the Kingdom of God so he wasn’t in a hurry. Maybe there would be some unexpected gains in the east wall.
Moreover, he had only seen Sylvia but he had never been to other walls. He might be able to compare the differences between the walls and some secrets.
Most of the monsters that Dudian met along the way were at the pioneer level. As he walked further and further to the east, the monsters he met became weaker and weaker. It proved that the route he had chosen was correct.
At night, Dudian stopped to rest. He ate the flesh and blood of the monsters he had hunted. He drank the water from the huge potholes. The next day, he continued to travel.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
Dudian traveled thousands of miles in a day. In just three days, he had traveled more than three thousand miles. The main reason why he was able to travel so fast was that most of the routes he had taken were at the pioneer level. Occasionally, he would encounter master level and inner wilderness level monsters, as for the Abyss level monsters above master level, he had only met two of them. He had bypassed them in advance without alerting the other party.
“If I haven’t found the wall by the day after tomorrow, I will have to lose my arm in the wilderness.”Dudian looked at his right arm which had turned into an ice claw. The golden sarcoma on his shoulder had spread more and more. In just three and a half days.., it had expanded to more than one centimeter. He found that the parasitic soul worm mucus injected into the magic nest in his chest had dried up a lot.
He didn’t know if there was a relationship between the two. He planned to extract the parasitic soul worm mucus tonight. If his body couldn’t absorb the mucus then it would rot in the magic nest.
Dudian didn’t meet the trail and smell of the Abyss Walker for three days. He felt that he should be far away from the group of people.
Dudian flew out of the jungle. There was a limiter level monster three miles ahead of him. He rushed towards it. The monster was like a giant rabbit. It was hairy, however its ears were not furry but were as sharp as horns. It turned to look at Dudian. Its scarlet eyes were filled with hostility. It was about to scream when a cold light flashed and blood burst out.
The head of the monster fell down and rolled on the ground.
Dudian took out the ‘soul guide bottle’. Soon, a parasitic soul worm crawled out from the monster’s blood and drilled into the bottle.
“Another one.”Dudian screwed the cap. He had killed thousands of monsters in the past three days. Twelve of them were named monsters. Including the one in front of him, there were thirteen parasitic soul worms, there were many monsters that he didn’t think were named monsters so he didn’t test them.
Dudian took the parasitic soul worm and continued to move forward with Aisha.
He looked up at the setting sun. The warm light made him feel like he was taking a stroll in the sunset. He felt relaxed as he walked along the east direction, the monsters he met along the way were much weaker than the ones he had met before.
As he walked, a ray of sunset flashed past his eyes. There was a towering giant wall standing in the distance above the weeds in front of the jungle. It looked like an ancient city wall.
Dudian stopped and raised his hand to cover his eyes. He was sure that his eyes weren’t blurred. It was a giant wall!
He was stunned for a few seconds before he reacted. There was an inexplicable excitement in his heart. This was the second giant wall that he had seen in addition to Sylvia!
Were the intruders like him? Did they come from the Abyss?
“I don’t know if this wall is the place where the abyss lives, or a similar wall to Sylvia, or a weaker place?”Dudian’s eyes lit up. If it was a weaker giant wall.., he didn’t mind being an intruder.
He took Aisha and rushed over. As they were getting closer to the giant wall, he used his clairvoyance to observe the surroundings of the giant wall in case of an ambush. Although there was no such setup in Sylvia.., but it didn’t mean that the other giant walls wouldn’t be like this.
After searching for a while, he didn’t see any sentinels. Dudian spread his magic wings and took Aisha with him.
The thousand-meter tall giant wall quickly closed in. Dudian jumped onto the giant wall. The width and shape of the top of the giant wall made him feel very familiar. It was as if he had returned to the giant wall of Sylvia.
He quickly went to the other side of the giant wall and looked around. He saw lush green mountains and lush green water. The environment was beautiful. There was no trace of human habitation in his sight.
He knew that the place close to the giant wall was heavily radioactive. It was a wasteland. Although the environment was beautiful but there were many mutated beasts and low-level monsters that had been exposed to radiation.
“I didn’t expect to find the second giant wall in the abyss. I haven’t seen any master level monsters within a thousand miles of this place. is the distribution of the abyss the farthest place outside the giant walls?”Dudian pondered, he felt that he could faintly see the distribution of the current world.
The giant wall stood at the farthest edge of each giant wall. The Abyss was the place where there was no development.
“In addition to the lack of development, perhaps there are ‘magic pits’in these places. According to Aristotle’s notes, magic pits are the deepest place in the abyss. The closer to the magic pit, the stronger the monsters. It is obviously not suitable to build giant walls around the magic pit. The geographical environment of the magic pit can not be changed so the giant wall was built far away from the magic pit. In this way, the Abyss is not a sealed area.”
Dudian finally sketched out a picture of this world. It was like a completely black world. Every giant wall was like a lighthouse. The light emitted by the lighthouse was the hunting area, the Dark Area outside the light was the abyss!

chapters.title: Chapter 873
chapters.content:
Chapter 873 – : Chapter 863: Territorial System
Dudian flew down and landed on the giant wall. The radiation level here was much lower than outside. The air he smelled was very fresh and natural. There was no strange smell, he was going to find a place in the vicinity to solve the problem of his right arm. However, it was not easy for him to meet a new giant wall. He was very curious about the environment inside. Was it the same as Sylvia?
Most importantly, what was the standard of the experts here?
He restrained his aura and went more than 200 miles. He saw the beast pen and the shadow of the human village. Although it was a long distance but the land inside the wall was very vast, it was easy to accommodate tens of millions of people. Two hundred miles of wasteland was nothing.
“No Wall?”Dudian was surprised. He had met many mutated beasts and low-level monsters along the way. They were comparable to hunters. The thick wooden beast pen seemed to be strong, however, there was no protection in front of such mutated beasts. Sylvia at least had the golden wall to protect her. The main purpose of the sturdy stone wall was to isolate the Barbarians.
Dudian looked at the population and strength of the town behind the Beast Pen. All of them were ordinary people. There were only six of them with high heat. Two of them were guarding the other side of the beast pen, their combat strength should be slightly higher than ordinary scavengers. It should be three to five times that of ordinary people.
Dudian let Aisha stop in the forest in the distance. He quietly touched the village and found a high heat source. He grabbed it and took it to the forest in the distance.
The person who was caught by Dudian looked to be in his thirties. He was thrown to the ground by Dudian. He saw Dudian’s appearance. Dudian’s face turned pale as he was frightened by the ferocious splitter armor, his voice trembled: “Who… Who Are You?”
He was speaking the common language of the giant wall. Dudian knew that there would be no language barrier after the capture. From this point of view, it reflected the difference between this place and Sylvia.
“Answer my question honestly and you will be able to go back alive. You Don’t need to talk nonsense. Do you understand?”Dudian’s eyes were cold and there was a murderous aura in them. The middle-aged man quickly nodded.
Ten minutes later, Dudian finished asking what he wanted to know. He knocked the middle-aged man out and left the place with Aisha.
“I didn’t expect that this place is more real than Sylvia. It’s a blatant system of privileges.”Dudian went around the village and continued to move forward. He knew that the village was here because of the middle-aged man’s words, because of the lack of tributes they were assigned to this place. All the residents here needed to pay tribute to the Lord in order to exchange for protection.
The lords here were similar to the noble lords of Sylvia. They controlled the life and death power of the territory. However there was no commercial district here. There were only many territories and a large number of servants and residents, there were also serfs.
Every suzerain had a large number of warriors under their command. The suzerains would fight each other for land resources and engage in continuous battles. Every time a war broke out, the first to be affected would be the residents at the edge of the territory.
It could be said that the people here had been ravaged by the flames of war all year round.
Although the noble suzerains of Sylvia would also fight each other for territory and wealth, it was rare for war to break out directly. It was all open and hidden battles in the business world. Moreover, they would care about their reputation. When the situation became tense.., there would be Knight’s Hall and military to mediate. However, there was only one king’s city. From the middle-aged man’s words, unless the lord was too extreme and massacred the residents of other territories, the king’s city would not intervene, otherwise, they would basically not come out.
“It seems that this place is much simpler and more brutal than Sylvia. Strength is king. Poor civilians can only live in fear and trepidation. Every time there is a war, they will have to migrate. If their lord wins, it will be fine. But if he is defeated, it is very likely that he will be implicated in the massacre or become the lowest level servant of the new Lord.”Dudian’s eyes flashed, the capital city was the center of power. It was also the place where the big figures lived. It was a hell for the poor and a paradise for the rich.
He wanted to go to the capital city to take a look. It would be best if he could find a legendary parasitic soul worm before he replaced his right arm.
Moreover, he wanted to use the magic atlas of the wall to identify the parasitic soul worms. After all, the owners of these parasitic soul worms were killed on the way here. The Kingdom of God had given the magic atlas to this place, it should be different from Sylvia’s.
After passing through many villages and towns, some were prosperous and some were down and out. It wasn’t long before Dudian came to the most prosperous town he had seen so far. At a glance, the roads of the town were paved with stones, there was a sharp contrast with the other villages and towns. Moreover, the population of the town was very large. There were hunter level guards everywhere.
Dudian took off his armor and hid it with his backpack in a nearby forest cave. The cave was close to the level 20 monster’s Cave and was guarded by the monster, there should be no problem. He was afraid that the monster would be scared away by him and wouldn’t dare to return to the cave.
“I’ll test the water first.”Dudian looked at the large building in the center of the town. It was the most prosperous square in front of the building. The buildings and blocks around the square were all in the prime area. There were all kinds of shops, behind the square was an extremely spacious luxurious manor. There were several elegant villas inside. When he came to the square he could see the gardeners and servants coming and going through the iron fence outside the manor.
For the first desolate village he had seen, the town was considered a paradise. However the manor was more like a place where the gods lived. It was clean, tidy, elegant and very stylish.
However, this style was loved by Westerners. Dudian was not interested in it. He used his heat sense to scan inside. Soon, he saw many heat source figures. The entire villa was filled with hot spots, it was as if countless infrared rays were shining on it. There were three heat source figures which made Dudian surprised. They were pioneers!
He had met three pioneers in the manor of the first Lord! Moreover, this didn’t exclude the pioneers who were hiding in the dark and instinctively hid heat sources.
Dudian was a bit surprised. In Sylvia, except for the military of the inner wall and the Witcher family, there were no pioneer level experts.
Dudian squinted his eyes and looked up at the sky. He was going to wait until night time.
Late at night.
Dudian turned into the manor. Although it was past 11 pm but the manor was still brightly lit. Dudian figured that the lights wouldn’t go out so he was too lazy to wait any longer.
The servants in the manor had fallen asleep. They were sleeping in the basement of the manor. There were groups of red dots in the basement. However there were more than a dozen red dots scattered over the exquisite villa.
Dudian picked a red dot that was always accompanied by a pioneer. It should be the lord of this place. There were pioneers protecting him at all times. Most likely it was because the lords were trying to break away from each other, dudian was always on guard against sneak attacks. However this provided him with an obvious target.
“Phew!”Rosik gently exhaled. He leaned against the back of the chair and finally finished his work. Although he was a lord who enjoyed the scenery but he was very tired every day, all needed him to take care of. Moreover, he also needed to operate the few shops under his command in the capital. These things might sound simple, but if it were an ordinary person, being the manager of a shop would be enough to cause them a lot of trouble, not to mention all the matters in a large territory?
Fortunately, he had many capable assistants under his command who helped him simplify and concretize the matters. Otherwise, it would take several days just to look through these complicated matters.
“Thank you for your hard work, sir,”a young man in dark green armor said with his head lowered.
Rosickle smiled and said, “I say, don’t be so tense all the time. It’s so tiring to wear this armor.”
“It’s my duty. If an enemy comes, I can also stand in front for you, sir,”the young man said respectfully.
Rosickle smiled slightly. Before he could say anything else, the young man suddenly charged forward with a murderous aura.
LOSIC’s pupils constricted, and his heart was filled with shock. His first thought was, ‘have you been bribed by those guys?’?
But soon, he saw the young man charging in front of him with his back facing him. He turned his head and stared forward. When he looked forward, he was immediately covered in cold sweat. He did not know when, but he saw a tall and thin figure standing in the room, although there was light in the room, it was too late. He was a thrifty person and did not light up all the lights in the room, so he could not see the person’s face clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 874
chapters.content:
Chapter 874 – Chapter 864: Selling
Dudian looked at Lothick. From the way he dressed, he should be the lord of this place. However, his physique was only at the level of an ordinary person. He could see the structure of his bones through X-ray vision. There was no alienation and the strength was not high, he was not an expert in hiding heat.
He took a step forward and said: “If you are smart, don’t make a fuss.”
Lothick looked at Dudian who came out from the shadows. His face was ugly. He was able to sneak into this place. It meant that Dudian was an expert. Lothick looked at the youth in front of him. He didn’t know if he could deal with him.
The youth’s eyes were full of killing intent: “Who Are You? Which Lord sent you?”
“I’m here to talk about some things. Don’t be nervous.”Dudian didn’t respond to the youth but to Lothick, “Considering that you might be disobedient, it is necessary to make you docile. I can only sacrifice your subordinate.”
The youth saw that Dudian was walking forward and completely ignored him. He was angry but also had some concerns. However, he couldn’t be timid. He growled and entered the demon body state. Thick hair grew out of his body like a werewolf, his arms turned into sharp claws and his legs were bent. He rushed towards Dudian. His eyes were full of hostility and killing intent.
Dudian continued to walk forward as if he didn’t see anything. He waited for the youth to pounce on him. Bang! The youth’s body suddenly stopped and his head was grabbed by a huge ice claw, there was no sound. The youth’s head exploded in the Ice Claw. Blood and brain matter flowed out and his body suddenly became soft.
Dudian casually threw out a piece of trash and continued to walk towards Lothick.
Lothick’s pupils contracted as he looked at the scene. He knew the strength of the youth. He was his most trusted protector and the strongest protector in his territory. How could he die in front of Dudian?
He didn’t see Dudian reveal his magic body. Although he was an ordinary person but he was a lord after all. He knew what kind of posture the pioneers had when they were fighting, however Dudian was able to subdue and kill the youth. It was a complete crushing!
Lothick’s heart was beating fast. He looked at Dudian as if he saw a devil approaching him. The smell of death was so thick that he didn’t dare to breathe.
“Don’t be afraid. I Won’t kill you.”Dudian’s voice was calm. It seemed that he was the master of this place. He came to the desk in front of Rosik, dudian said: “Now we can talk. I have some questions. I hope you will answer them honestly. Otherwise I will be very unhappy.”
Rosik’s face was ugly. He was nervous and afraid. He had never felt so close to death. His voice trembled: “You… What do you want? I can give you money, territory…”
Dudian shook his head and interrupted: “I don’t need anything else. Can you help me get the legendary parasitic soul worm?”
“Legendary parasitic soul worm?”Rosik was relieved as he heard Dudian’s words: “Yes, no problem.”
Dudian was a bit surprised. He didn’t think that Rosik would understand what a legendary parasitic soul worm was. He was worried that because of the differences between the giant walls there would be some changes. He wanted to explain but it seemed that it was unnecessary, the name of the legendary parasitic soul worm should be issued by the Institute of Magic. It should be a title given by the Kingdom of God. However Rosik agreed too quickly. It seemed that it wasn’t difficult.
“No problem?”Dudian looked at him: “Don’t speak too early. This thing must be delivered to me within three days. Otherwise you and your territory will disappear, including your children.”
Rosik’s heart tightened: “No problem. I will deliver it.”
Dudian was surprised to see that Rosik didn’t force him. Legendary parasitic soul worms were so rare that it wasn’t easy to get them. Although Rosik was a lord but he knew from the information he had gathered, rosik wasn’t a big deal as there were so many lords here. He thought for a moment and asked: “What I want is a live one. It can be immediately implanted into the body. Where do you get it?”
Lothick was stunned for a moment. There was a trace of strangeness in his eyes. This time it was his turn to be surprised. He didn’t expect that Dudian would ask such a strange question. But he thought that it was possible that Dudian was worried that Lothick would fool him, so he deliberately tested him.
“I will send people to the temple in the king’s City to buy them tomorrow. I will get them tomorrow afternoon. Please rest assured.”Lothick quickly expressed his position. Although the legendary parasitic soul worms were very expensive but compared to his life.., he was willing to part with them.
The temple in the King’s City? Buy Them? Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise. He pondered for a moment and directly asked: “Did you buy the legendary parasitic soul worms from there?”
“Yes.”Lothick replied without thinking. He was a bit suspicious. Dudian’s questions were too strange. It seemed that Dudian knew nothing about them. He didn’t buy them from the temple, was he going to hunt outside the giant wall? How much manpower would he waste?
Dudian looked at Lothick. He could guess his thoughts from the doubt in his eyes. However he didn’t deliberately hide it. He was even more curious about the giant wall, the legendary parasitic soul worms could be bought directly from the temple. Lothick’s performance showed that since he bought them from the temple, the other lords were the same, the temple sold an astonishing number of legendary parasitic soul worms!
It was not difficult to cultivate legendary parasitic soul worms in places with so many legendary parasitic soul worms. In other words, the temple had at least a ruler or even a stronger abyss.
“Can you buy them at any time?”He asked another question.
Lothick was stunned: “Yes.”
Dudian raised his eyebrows. What kind of force would provide legendary parasitic soul worms at any time? What was behind this force?
He didn’t ask further. He felt that the temple should be related to the monster research institute. He asked again: “How many lords are there like you?”
Rosik felt that Dudian’s questions were strange. But he wasn’t sure if Dudian was asking about the number of lords in this area or the number of Lords, he replied: “Sir, there are only five lords like me in this area. But there are at least thirty or forty lords with the same strength as me.”
“So Many?”Dudian was startled. There were thirty or forty lords and Lothick had three pioneers guarding it. Wouldn’t there be more than a hundred pioneers? Moreover, the number of lords who were weaker or stronger than Lothick wasn’t included. Moreover, the temple could provide legendary parasitic soul worms at any time. He had a rough idea of the number and distribution of forces in the giant wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 875
chapters.content:
Chapter 875 – Chapter 865: No1: Supplicant
“Show me the Monster Atlas.”Dudian made another request. Since he wanted to replace the splitter’s magic marks, he naturally had to find a comparable legendary parasitic soul worm. Of course, it would be best if he could find a better one.
Rosik was stunned. He didn’t understand but said: “I don’t have the Monster Atlas. If you want it, I will take you to get it.”
“Send it over.”Dudian glanced at the corpse of the youth: “Be honest. You know what to do.”
Rosik’s face slightly changed: “Yes, I will send someone to send it over.”He shouted at the corridor: “Butler!”
Rosik heard footsteps approaching: “Don’t come in. Go and find the Atlas.”
“Yes, Master.”
The sound of footsteps faded away.
Dudian had noticed the people waiting in the corridor. The low growl of the youth had alerted the other party. However the Butler didn’t expect the enemy to sneak into the room, dudian didn’t come close. He didn’t know what was going on inside because of the thick door. He didn’t dare to disturb them.
After a moment, the sound of footsteps came back.
Rosik went forward and opened the door. He took the pamphlet from Rosik’s hand before Rosik spoke: “Wait outside. No one is allowed to disturb you without my instructions.”
“Yes, Master.”
Rosik took the pamphlet and handed it to Dudian.
Dudian saw that Rosik was honest and didn’t say anything. After the Butler left, Rosik went back to his original position and continued to wait. He didn’t move to other places or contact other people. He was relieved, he picked up the booklet and began to read.
He was a bit surprised. On the first page of the Atlas, Legendary Monsters were recorded. They were arranged in order. The first page of the Atlas was marked with the ranking: No1!
The NO1 monster was called “Supplicant”. Its name was very similar to an astrologer, but the sketch on the side depicted an extremely ferocious and strange human-shaped monster. Its body was covered with a layer of snow-white shell, like a cape, on both sides were protruding shoulder blades. At first glance, it looked like an old scholar’s snow-white robe, which was more refined. On the protruding shoulder blades, there was a pointed head. Six eyeballs were arranged under the head, like a vortex, no matter how one looked at it, it wasn’t a simple character.
“Sure enough, there are different kinds of monsters around each giant wall. Splitter is ranked fourth among the eight legendary monsters in Sylvia. However, it is possible that it is ranked in the top ten or even behind the giant wall. It seems that there is a huge gap in strength between the rulers and the abyss…”Dudian thought, in the giant wall of Sylvia, the three great demon-hunter families were led by the Dragon Clan because of the Dragon Clan’s magic marks of the Demon Dragon. Compared to the magic marks of the bat sounder of the winged clan of the same level, they were several levels stronger in head-on combat.
As pioneers, the Dragon Clan could easily defeat the pioneers of the winged clan.
It was the same for his splitter. When he was still a pioneer, he could easily kill other pioneers. The sharp blades of the splitter were all-conquering. Although the other pioneers had all kinds of abilities, in a head-on battle.., they might not be suitable. For example, some of their abilities were reconnaissance, some were stealth, and some were poison.
After all, the splitter didn’t have these strange abilities but it was able to attack to the extreme. This alone made Dudian look down on others of the same level.
Dudian had seen the ability of the supplicant. Although he was mentally prepared for the position of No1, but he was still surprised. The supplicant was good at three aspects: camouflage, stealth, and magic attack, eye of the sky.
These three aspects combined stealth, attack and detection. The only weakness was probably defense. But the defense here was only relative to these three abilities, in fact, in defense it was better than many legendary monsters such as Dudian’s splitter.
“It’s a multi-faceted legendary monster. It’s a bit like the dragon. The dragon has the best defense and attack. Although its attack is inferior to the splitter but it can spit high pressure liquid fire. Its defense is several times stronger than the splitter. Even the splitter can’t cut down a dragon of the same rank. It will be defeated by the dragon because of its high defense.”Dudian narrowed his eyes, the supplicant’s comprehensive ability was much stronger than the dragon’s.
Camouflage, detection, attack, rely on detection to judge the strength of the enemy. Camouflage to sneak up and attack to kill. Such an enemy was simply the god of death in the Shadows!
No wonder it was called the supplicant. Once it was targeted, it could only pray.
Dudian’s heart was moved when he saw the legendary monster. Splitter was good, but the magic attack of the supplicant was not weak. According to the description above, the magic attack was just a name, the supplicant’s body would exude high concentration of magic energy. Dudian thought that the magic energy could be radiation energy. The supplicant seemed to be able to control and gather this energy at will and inject it into the enemy’s body during the attack, no matter which point it was, it was very terrifying. If a large amount of radiation energy was injected into the enemy’s body, it would be enough to kill him on the spot!
Although its attack wasn’t as straightforward as the splitter’s. But the effect was better. For example, the magic attack would be able to completely destroy the enemy from the inside!
Dudian looked at the second monster, the ‘Phantom’.
The ‘Phantom’ability was very exclusive. It was the same ability as the ‘Phantom’in the middle of the name. It had a strong charm ability which could charm most of the enemies, it could even make enemies and monsters that were much stronger than him to relax their vigilance and reduce their hostility. In addition to that, it was not good at attack, defense, stealth, detection and so on!
This introduction made Dudian a bit surprised. Charm the enemy? How to charm? This was the real world. Could it be that this monster could use magic?
He continued to read and soon understood. There was a trace of shock in his heart. The form of the ‘charm’was very small. It was similar to a butterfly and belonged to the flying category. Its charm mainly relied on the special powder that was emitted from its body, it could create illusions and illusions for the enemy. It could even make the enemy see it as their own kind or as their own natural enemy!
After reading the details of the ability, Dudian finally understood why a monster that was weak in a frontal battle could be ranked in the legendary rank. Moreover, it was second only to the three omnipotent supplicants, it turned out that it relied on one move to eat the whole sky. Although its charm was weak in a frontal battle but if it was used well, even the supplicants couldn’t compare to it.
The most important thing was that in the face of more powerful monsters, the survival ability of this thing was far better than other monsters.
“Creating illusions is a bit similar to the ‘Dreamer’but the dreamer is directly controlled by poison. It can produce a long-term illusion enslavement effect. Moreover it is one of the best in poison attacks. It has a strong head on combat ability. This can only rely on illusion to create a threatening effect or an intimate effect. The real power to kill the enemy is very weak. It is strong but it is too simple…”Dudian’s eyes flashed, he sighed in his heart as he thought about the effects of the splitter. It would be perfect if the power of the splitter was reflected in the body of the supplicant.
It would be even more perfect if the splitter was added to the mix.
If the high pressure liquid fire and defense of the dragon were added to the mix..
The more Dudian thought about it the further he went. He felt that the combination of the power of these legendary monsters was simply an invincible perfect creature!
However he also knew that the Moon had its ups and downs. There was no perfect thing in the world. If he had to choose then it would be better to beg. After all, there were some enemies that he didn’t want to scare away to resolve the resentment in his heart, he loved to cut the weeds and eliminate the roots.
Dudian continued to look down. The later legendary monsters had their own special abilities. They were different but the later the legendary monsters were, the more mediocre their abilities were. Their effects were even similar to those of the previous legendary monsters, in terms of strength, they were weaker by hundreds of power.
However, the number of legendary monsters here made Dudian amazed. There were thirty-seven of them!
There were only eight of them in Sylvia but there were thirty-seven of them here! The number was close to the total number of legendary monsters in Sylvia!
However, there were only four or five that Dudian was interested in. He asked Rosik: “Can you find all the legendary monsters here? I want the parasitic soul worm of the supplicant!”

chapters.title: Chapter 876
chapters.content:
Chapter 876 – Chapter 866: Kill Tens Of Thousands Of People
Lothick saw that Dudian had been looking at him for a long time. He was secretly trying to figure out Dudian’s identity, lothick bitterly smiled: “My lord, this ‘supplicant’is ranked first in the legendary monster list. It can be encountered but not sought. Do you want to change to another one?”
“I’m asking you if you can get it!”Dudian coldly said. He heard that Lothick didn’t obviously refuse. It seemed that there was a chance. He was excited because he didn’t have much expectations, after all, Sylvia was the number one dreamer. However, she was the only one who had existed in history.
Lothick’s mouth was bitter. He wanted to use euphemism to remind Dudian that it was difficult to find the supplicant. He didn’t expect that Dudian’s attitude would be so rude and direct, he couldn’t beat around the bush to refuse but he had to shake his head and say no. If Dudian left here and went to other territories to find out about this matter, he would come back to retaliate against Lothick, he couldn’t afford to be assassinated by an expert like Dudian.
“I can get it but it will cost a lot of money…”Lothick said in a pitiful tone. He was interrupted by Dudian.
“No matter how much it costs, I must get it!”Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise. He didn’t think that Lothick would have a way to get it, there were thirty to forty other lords like him. It was incredible that such a small lord could get the number one legendary monster!
However, he believed that Lothick wasn’t lying because there was no need to. Even if he was afraid of angering him, he wouldn’t be able to do it. The risk of angering him would be greater.
Lothick slightly opened his mouth. He thought that it was easy for him to say that. It wasn’t his money that was being spent. However, he wasn’t sure what Dudian would do if he said it out loud. He knew that this young man in front of him was in his early twenties, he was absolutely ruthless.
“Are you going to buy it from the temple?”Dudian asked.
Rosik smiled: “I can only get it from the temple. Master, don’t you know about this?”He looked at Dudian with clear eyes, there was no doubt in his eyes.
Dudian knew what Rosik was thinking, he said: “It’s not good for you to know too much. You just need to do a good job for me. I will give you some benefits when the matter is done. But if the matter is done wrong, I don’t need to say much about the consequences, right?”
Lothick’s heart trembled: “Master, please rest assured. I will definitely do a good job for you.”
“How long will it take?”Dudian asked.
Lothick saw that Dudian was in such a hurry, he said: “The supplicant is the strongest legendary monster. Its parasitic soul worm needs to be booked in advance. In general it takes half a month. If master is in urgent need then you can consider the second most powerful one. You can buy it in ten days. As for the top ten, you can get it in two or three days.” He looked at Dudian and saw that there was no doubt on his face. He was relieved.
In fact, he had something to say. If he spent double the price and added some money to manage the relationship, he would be able to get the legendary parasitic soul worm in three days!
However, he thought that Dudian didn’t seem to understand these things so he took the risk to skip these things. He thought that if Dudian could get the supplicant from here, he wouldn’t go to other territories to ask.
Dudian didn’t know about the situation here. He didn’t think that he would be able to get the legendary parasitic soul worm in advance by spending money to manage it. For him, this was something that was taken out of the monster’s body. How could he buy it just like that, however Lothick’s words overturned his original idea. It seemed that the legendary parasitic soul worm was just a commodity in the mysterious temple.
“Do I need to make an appointment?”Dudian pondered for a moment, he asked: “Are the parasitic soul worms stored in the temple? It is impossible. Do you need so long to get them? Do you want them to go out and hunt after you place an order?”
Lothick’s heart jumped, he shook his head: “I don’t know. This is a matter of the temple. We Lords don’t have the right to ask about it. But some of the lords who have connections in the king’s city might know some insider information.” Dudian didn’t know that he had guessed Dudian’s identity. He was trembling in his heart. If Dudian came from outside the giant wall.., then his situation would be even more dangerous. Once Dudian used him it was very likely that he would silence him.
Dudian looked at him suspiciously. He didn’t hide the doubt in his heart. On the contrary, he showed it on his face. He stared at Rosik without saying a word, although he didn’t know if Lothick was lying to him but in order to prevent him from lying, he deliberately tried to blackmail him.
Lothick’s heart skipped a beat as he looked at Dudian’s suspicious attitude. He had lied but was stared at by Dudian. Even though he had been a lord for many years, he had a trace of guilty conscience, this was human nature. Moreover Dudian wasn’t an ordinary person. He had the temperament of a superior. Moreover he had Lothick’s life in his hands. He could easily kill him. Lothick couldn’t help but feel nervous, however he tried to remain calm, lothick bitterly smiled: “My Lord, I’m not lying to you. I’m telling the truth. If you don’t believe me, you can ask other lords. If I have half a lie then you can come back and deal with me.”
His words were very sincere.
Anyone who saw such an attitude would be reassured.
Dudian narrowed his eyes, “Life is not easy. It’s not easy to be born into a Lord’s family. I forgot to tell you that I have an ability which is specialized in lie detection. I don’t know which sentence you lied to me. But I hope that you can be honest. Otherwise I can only let you be silent forever. For me, finding another Lord is just a few more steps. Do you understand?”
His words were not intended to scare him. Instead, he was able to see Rosicko’s physical condition through his X-ray vision. In the two years after Sylvia became the wall master.., he would occasionally flip through some psychological books from the old era recorded in the Super Chip. With his X-ray vision, it was almost equivalent to a lie detection ability. Rosicko’s previous reaction, his heartbeat increased by a few beats and his fingers moved slightly.., the contraction of his pores and other small reactions fully showed that he was lying.
Rosik’s throat rolled as his heart went cold. He looked at Dudian’s serious expression and knew that Dudian didn’t lie to him. If it was someone else who said this, he would have scoffed. However, Dudian’s words were different, he had long guessed Dudian’s identity and determined that he was an outsider. What kind of ability did an outsider have? It was completely out of his understanding.
However, he naturally wouldn’t reveal it so easily, he could only say: “I’m not lying to you. But there is one thing I didn’t say. The lords who are able to interact with the temple have many experts under their command. Even if you go, you won’t be able to win.” He looked up at dudian. He wanted to see if Dudian’s reaction was true.
Dudian narrowed his eyes: “Is that all?”
Rosik didn’t expect that the young man would be so difficult to fool. He said: “I have said everything that you asked.”He thought, even if Dudian knew that Rosik deliberately omitted some things in the future, he would be able to say that he was nervous and forgot about it.
Dudian didn’t pursue further. He was completely unfamiliar with this place. He could only rely on coercion to make Rosik confess. If Rosik wanted to lie and hide something, there was nothing he could do. It was not 100% accurate to analyze the psychology by physical reaction, he continued to ask: “How many supplicants can you buy? Since you can buy them, are there any experts in your territory who can use supplicants?”
Lothick saw that Dudian wasn’t satisfied and almost vomited blood, he bitterly said: “My lord, I can buy one from the temple. I think I will go bankrupt. I don’t have the fortune to buy such good things. I can buy ten other legendary parasitic soul worms.”
Dudian raised his eyebrows as he thought about the item. Even if he could buy it, the price would be the most expensive. It seemed that not every noble could afford to buy it, there were thirty or forty nobles like Rosik who couldn’t afford to buy it.
“The upper echelons of the temple should be able to afford this item. There are still surplus for sale.”Dudian narrowed his eyes as he thought about it, he asked Rosik: “Who is the strongest Lord in your eyes? How much stronger than your territory?”
Rosik pursed his lips in his heart? It was obvious that he was asking the strongest lord. His answer was very honest, dudian continued: “I think the strongest lord should be the red rose lord. Their territory is much larger than mine. There are tens of thousands of experts. It is far from comparable to ours.”
“Kill tens of thousands of people?”Dudian raised his eyebrows as he glanced at the young man’s corpse: “That’s it?”
Rosik nodded as he was more sure of Dudian’s identity.
Dudian didn’t care about his identity as he didn’t care about it. He didn’t expect that the giant wall would be called the ‘kill tens of thousands of people’because of his identity as a pioneer. It seemed that the strength level wasn’t unified by the Kingdom of God, if he wanted to know the unified name he would have to go to the Kingdom of God.
“Are there any masters above the ten thousand people executioner?”Dudian asked.
Lothick knew that Dudian wasn’t asking about the red rose territory but he replied: “Yes. It is said that there are two magic general level masters in the red rose territory. They can easily kill ten thousand people executioner.” Lothick looked at dudian. In his opinion, Dudian belonged to this level.
Dudian frowned but didn’t say anything. He asked about other things such as the situation in the king’s city, the temple and the research institute.
However, when he asked about the research institute, Lothick said that he had never heard of it.
Dudian was surprised. He asked about the origin of the atlas and found out that the temple was the research institute. However he didn’t expect that the position of the temple would change and become the strongest force.
Dudian gradually understood the system of the temple. The royal family was above the Lord and the temple was on the same level as the royal family.
The lords were loyal to the royal family but they were in awe of the temple.
“It seems that the manager of the Monster Institute has great ambitions for power. All the masters under the Lords come from the temple. It can be said that no matter how fierce the fight is, the lords have to be obedient in front of the temple. If it wasn’t for the fact that the royal family has the wall master who can cross the Abyss and enter the Kingdom of God, the temple would have soft control over the royal family. But now it is no different from riding on the head of the royal family…”Dudian thought, the Monster Research Institute here was a bit like the monastery in Sylvia.
It was a devil but he had the identity of a god. Moreover he was more competent than a god.
Dudian quickly patted Rosik’s shoulder twice.
Rosik felt that his shoulder was sore as if something had entered his body. His face turned pale as he took two steps back. He looked at Dudian in fear and anger: “What… What are you doing? Didn’t you say…”
Dudian raised his hand to interrupt rosik, “Don’t worry. I Won’t kill you for the time being. I just put a small thing in your body. As long as you are obedient and send the supplicant to me in half a month I will take it out. By the way, don’t do anything useless. No one can find this thing except for me.”
He deliberately said “Here”. He had asked so many questions before. As long as Rosik wasn’t stupid, he would have guessed his identity.
Now that he said so, it was the same as admitting.
“I almost forgot to tell you that if you don’t take this thing out in twenty days, you won’t want to see your end. Oh right, your wife and children don’t want to see that kind of scene. So you better not play any tricks. I rented a room in the town called Frog Hotel. I will wait for you there in fifteen days.”Dudian patted Rosik’s shoulder.
Lothick’s body shrank back in fear. His face was ugly. He didn’t doubt Dudian’s words. He didn’t see clearly when Dudian pointed at his shoulder, but he felt that there was something drilling into his shoulder. He hoped that Dudian’s words weren’t true. He hoped that he could find someone to take it out.
Dudian smiled and put his palm in front of Lothick’s eyes. Lothick saw that the atlas was thrown up and down in front of his eyes. Dudian had disappeared without a trace, the only thing left was the booklet which fell to the ground. The cold sound made his heart cool down.
Dudian took advantage of the night to return to the town. He patted Lothick’s shoulder. Naturally, he didn’t put anything into it. He just touched his acupuncture points, he had read the knowledge of acupuncture points left by his ancestors from the super chip. It was the essence of the ancient medical technology. He could only fool Rosik and say that the people here couldn’t check it out, rosik wouldn’t be able to find the problem. He would be worried and wouldn’t dare to ignore it.
After all, a small part of the doubt was enough to control people when it came to his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 877
chapters.content:
Chapter 877 – Chapter 867: Disregard For Human Life
There were guards patrolling the town. Dudian easily avoided them and sneaked back to a simple and plain hotel. The sign hanging on the hotel was painted with a green frog, it was quite childlike.
Back in the room, he saw Aisha sitting quietly at the table, like a virtuous wife waiting for her husband’s return.
There was a trace of warmth in Dudian’s heart. He went back to Aisha and whispered to her. He told her about his trip tonight. After that, he helped Aisha wash her teeth and face. He carried her to the bed and let her lie down to sleep, although Aisha didn’t need to sleep. He had never seen her close her eyes, but he still hoped that she could have a good rest like a normal person.
After taking care of Aisha, Dudian lit the oil lamp and sat by the table. He looked at his right arm. His mood was a bit complicated. It was unknown if he could get the magic marks of the supplicant, but his right arm couldn’t be delayed any longer, he saw that the gold in his right arm had dyed his shoulder. In another day or two, it would flow into his body. At that time, the threat of the golden sarcoma might come back.
“I’ll cripple one arm and start over. I don’t know if I can get the magic marks of a supplicant here…”Dudian’s eyes lit up. He would have to rob at least four more territories to get the magic marks of a supplicant, he wanted them to buy magic marks for him. However, if five Lords bought magic marks of a supplicant in a row, it would attract the attention of the temple. There should be no lack of experts in the temple who could deify supplicants.
He pinched the bridge of his nose and sighed.
In the end, he was still reluctant to lose his right arm. However, no matter how reluctant he was, he could only do so.
However, it was naturally not suitable to lose an arm in this small hotel. He planned to leave this place at dawn.
After staying in the wilderness for so long, he had not had a good rest for a long time. After thinking for a while about what to do next, he washed up and crawled into bed to sleep.
This time, he slept very soundly. He didn’t need to hold the splitter’s saber. His heart was tense.
It was almost noon when Dudian woke up. He stretched and felt that the tiredness of the past few days had been swept away. He got up to help Aisha wash up and put on clothes, he took Aisha downstairs to eat.
“Boss, give me ten pieces of black pepper steak.”Dudian casually found a seat and sat down. He called out to the lady boss who was at the counter.
The Lady Boss was a young woman in her mid-twenties. She was wearing a light red scarf and was very capable. She glanced at Dudian and saw that Dudian and Haisha only had two people. She asked for ten pieces of steak, but the more Dudian shouted, the more she earned. There was no reason for her to refuse. Moreover, looking at Dudian and Haisha’s clothes and fabrics, they were not poor people.
She replied and turned to report to the kitchen in the back hall.
After a while, an eleven or twelve-year-old girl came over with two sets of fragrant black pepper bone steak. This was one of the more expensive dishes. Although the little girl looked tender, but she was well developed, her chest was full and exuded a youthful and tender aura. She was not inferior to a fifteen or sixteen-year-old girl. Dudian took the steak and ate it. He sighed in his heart. The people here had the ability to marry early, she could be a mother at twelve or thirteen years old.
In the slums of Sylvia, there were many people who had children at twelve or thirteen years old. Not only did they have children but they also had to take on the task of making money in the family, what did twelve or thirteen-year-old children know? They could only cry in front of their parents and wait to be fed.
When Dudian finished eating one of the steaks in his hand, he cut off the other one and fed it to Haisha.
This steak was only medium-rare. It was more nutritious and had blood vessels in it. Haisha did not reject it.
The little girl brought two more steaks over. When she saw Dudian’s appearance, her freckled face was full of envy. She smiled and said: “You and your wife are really in love.”
Dudian nodded. He finished feeding Haisha and began to eat his own share.
Dudian heard a few rough voices when he ate the sixth portion. He felt a bit harsh. The door of the hotel was kicked open. Three or five burly men with strong muscles walked in, the leader of the group was wearing a pointed helmet and armor. He looked quite capable. He arrogantly glanced around the hall. His eyes didn’t stop on Dudian but finally landed on the lady boss behind the counter, she sneered: “Lady Boss, business is good today. Shouldn’t we pay the protection fee?”
The Lady Boss’s face changed as they barged in: “Big Brother Mimon, didn’t you say two days ago that we would pay at the end of the month? As you can see, we are located in a remote area and our business is not good…”
“That’s your problem. How can you blame me if our business is not good?”The burly man looked at the Lady Boss’s bulging chest, he sneered, “We’ve been here so many times, and our feet are aching. I haven’t settled the score with you yet. You have to pay today. Otherwise, my brothers have a bad temper. If they destroy your store, I won’t be able to control them!”
The Lady Boss’face changed, and she quickly said, “Big Brother Mi Meng, you can’t go back on your words. We…”
“Don’t talk nonsense. I don’t believe that you don’t have money!”MIMO said impatiently.
“We really don’t have money.”The girl who had served the dishes to dudian said angrily: “We have just paid the rent and the Lord’s tax. How can we have money to pay you? We don’t have anything to eat!”
“Nothing to eat? Then what are they eating?”MIMO stared at her, his eyes turned to the little girl and looked up and down. The corners of his mouth curled up slightly as he said, “If they really can’t come up with money, that’s fine too. Little Sister, Tonight, accompany my brothers to vent their anger. Let’s forget about this matter for the time being. Lady Boss, what do you think?”
When the little girl heard his words, she was so frightened that her face turned pale. She hurriedly hid behind the lady boss.
The Lady Boss protected her with one hand and squeezed out a smile at him, she said, “Big Brother Mi Meng, children are not sensible. Please don’t mind. It’s just that we really can’t take out this money. These are sold to customers for food. How can we bear to part with them? It’s not like you don’t know that there is no money to be made in our business. We can only barely make a living.”
“Big Brother, since this woman won’t listen to our kind words, I think we should teach them a lesson.”A strong man with a scar on his face snorted coldly.
“Boss, look, my brother is impatient…”Mimon chuckled. Before he could finish his words, a whistling sound was heard. A silver light flashed in front of his eyes and nailed onto the wooden pillar, it was a knife.
Mimon was startled. He turned his head and saw that there was only one table in the direction of the knife handle. The guests on the other tables saw that something was wrong and had already left the place. They went upstairs to pack their luggage and leave.
Dudian continued to cut the steak with the knife in Aisha’s plate. He said in a neutral tone: “Get away from here. Don’t be noisy.”
Mimon raised his eyebrows, he sneered: “Yo, a hero saving the damsel in distress? It’s none of your business that I’m talking here? You are a guest here right? I advise you not to be too arrogant. Don’t tell me that you like this widow? I see that your female companion has a good figure, Kid. Don’t look at the pot while eating.”
Haisha was wearing a veil, so Mimon couldn’t see Haisha’s appearance. However, from her figure and temperament, she was a beautiful woman. If it wasn’t for the fact that Dean and Haisha were dressed well.., mimon would have directly made a move.
Dean used the fork to put the cut meat into his mouth. He gently chewed and swallowed it. He sighed and turned to look at the few people.
The sneer on Mimon’s face disappeared when he saw Dudian’s eyes. He felt that the air around him seemed to be a few degrees cooler. His face slightly changed. He was about to say something to support the situation, dudian raised his hand and swung it.
Whoosh!
His neck was cold and then very hot. The pain was unbearable!
