Mimon stood in a daze. He touched his nose. There was hot liquid. He looked up and saw that it was blood.
He was a bit confused. He saw Dudian raise his hand to throw the knife but he couldn’t see Dudian’s hand clearly. The speed of that moment was beyond his reaction, he didn’t even have time to prepare to dodge.
Thump!
A sound came from the side.
Mimon felt that his strength had been sucked away and he fell down.
“Big Brother!”
“Big Brother!”
The other three people were shocked. Some wanted to go to Ramon, while others looked at Dudian in fear. They were ready to escape.
“Get lost!”Dudian whispered.
Their hearts trembled. They had clearly seen the injury of Mimon and the other person. Their throats had been pierced. The knife was still staring at the table. The knife was stained red with blood.
The three of them looked at Dudian’s indifferent expression. They were scared out of their wits. Although they were evil but they didn’t dare to kill people in public. Although they were protected by the higher-ups, but killing people was two different things. It wasn’t good for them to make a big noise. However Dudian killed two people in a word. Moreover he killed two birds with one stone.
The three of them hurriedly dragged the bodies of Mimon and the other person out of the hotel. In the blink of an eye they disappeared. There was only a long trail of blood on the ground.
The Lady Boss and the little girl were stunned. This change caught them off guard. They turned their head and looked at dudian. At the moment in their eyes, this young man who looked delicate and weak was even scarier than the previous few people who had left.
“Lady Boss, give me another set of cutlery and five more steaks.”Dudian glanced at the lady boss.
The lady boss reacted and subconsciously agreed. She ordered the little girl to go and get it. She hesitated for a moment and slowly approached Dudian. She whispered: “Thank you…”
“No need to thank me. I didn’t do it for you. It’s because they have disturbed me.”Dudian indifferently said. He was speaking from the heart. Originally, when the few people came in and talked about the protection fee.., he was already tired of listening to them. He had just woken up and heard the noise. If it wasn’t because he didn’t want to cause trouble, he would have killed all of them.
But the other side seemed to be endless. His warning didn’t have any effect so he was too lazy to talk to them.
In his eyes, let alone these few punks, even if there were some people with honor and reputation, he would kill them if they provoked him. He was no longer the juvenile who would feel guilty if he killed a person, now for him, there was no difference in the nature of killing and hitting people. If there was a difference, it would be more convenient to kill people. Once and for all, he wouldn’t hear the screams.
The boss’s heart trembled. She saw that Dudian didn’t want to comfort her. She felt that Dudian was too dangerous. She only hoped that Dudian would finish eating as soon as possible and send the god of plague away.
She didn’t think that Dudian would benefit from killing those people. On the contrary, she might encounter more trouble. After all, those people died in her hotel. There was no guarantee that people wouldn’t come to look for trouble, she just hoped that her hotel wouldn’t be implicated.
After saying a few words of thanks, the lady boss left Dudian’s side. She could see that Dudian was frowning impatiently.
At this time, the little girl came over with two plates of steak and a set of cutlery. She secretly glanced at Dudian, she whispered: “Big Brother, thank you. But if you kill them, you will be in trouble. You should leave as soon as possible.”She turned to look at the lady boss who was at the counter, he was relieved.
Dudian glanced at the little girl: “You Don’t seem to be afraid of death.”
If it was a normal girl, two people would die in front of her. No matter how fierce the person was, they would be afraid of the person who killed them. But this little girl dared to talk to him.
The little girl blushed as she heard Dudian’s words: “People often die outside. I’m used to it.”
Dudian looked at her but didn’t say anything. After eating the steak, he paid the bill and left the hotel with Aisha. As for the bill and the deposit of the hotel.., he found them from the pedestrians on the roadside after entering the town. With his hand speed, he was more than enough to be a thief.

chapters.title: Chapter 878
chapters.content:
Chapter 878 – Chapter 868: Return To Your Original Position
After leaving the hotel, Dudian brought Aisha to the town. He wanted to take the opportunity to buy a few sets of clothes for Aisha and himself. Although he could tolerate the mess, but since there were conditions to pay attention to, it was natural to focus on comfort. People lived for these two words.
After visiting several good tailor shops, Dudian ordered a few sets of clothes. He would be able to get them in a few days.
“Big Brother, do you want to buy flowers?”A young voice came from a little girl holding flowers.
Dudian looked at Aisha and nodded, “How much is a bunch?”
“One copper coin.”The little girl looked at Dudian innocently.
Copper coins were the smallest unit. In this place copper coins, silver coins and gold coins were used. However, the head of the coin was different. Therefore, Sylvia’s coin would only be considered as a counterfeit, she was going to jail.
Dudian nodded. He took out a pale blue copper coin and handed it to her. He picked a purple flower from her hand. He had seen these flowers in the wilderness, most of them were picked by the little girl or the people behind her. Although selling one copper coin was low, it was also a waste of money. He only needed to pay a little cheap labor.
“Big Brother, your girlfriend is so beautiful. Don’t you want to Buy More?”The little girl saw that Dudian’s voice was gentle. A trace of cleverness flashed in her innocent eyes.
Dudian ignored her sales promotion and pinned the flowers on Haisha’s temples. He whispered: “It’s very nice. Do You Like It?”
Haisha was silent and didn’t respond.
Dudian smiled, took her hand and left.
The little girl was about to open her mouth to persuade him again. After all, in front of her partner, most people would be embarrassed to refuse. Moreover, looking at Dudian’s appearance, he was not a person who was short of money. But before she could continue to persuade him, Dudian had already left, she sighed in her heart. Her small face showed a bit of regret. However, she quickly picked up her spirits and looked for a new target.
After strolling until about four o’clock in the afternoon, Dudian took Aisha to find a more upscale restaurant to have dinner. While eating, he looked at the sunset outside the window and said to aisha, “This kind of day is actually not bad.”
Aisha was silent.
Dudian looked at her and felt a bit regretful. If Aisha returned to normal, he and Aisha would live in such a place without any worries.
When it was late at night, Dudian took Aisha to a private clinic. The clinic was dark and closed. When there was no one around, Dudian and Aisha sneaked in, soon, he found some medicine and surgical tools in the clinic. He packed them and went to the wilderness outside the town. The Moon was high in the sky, illuminating the ground as bright as day, in the distance, he could faintly hear the howling of wolves, low-cut insects, and frogs.
Dudian found a cleaner place to sit down and let Aisha guard the side. Then he spread out the hemostatic medicine, gauze, and other things.
Thinking of cutting off his right arm, Dean couldn’t help but sigh. Then his eyes flashed with a trace of solemnity. He raised his right arm and saw that the golden color of the arm had been dyed to the shoulder that had not been frozen, he couldn’t delay any longer.
He took a deep breath and entered the magic body state. His left hand turned into a sickle and the sharp limbs on his back were raised like tails.
“Break!”He used his mind to cut the limbs on his right arm.
There was a sound as he cut off some ice chips.
Dudian looked at his right arm which was in pain. There were only a few scratches on the frozen arm. It was as strong as the last time.
Dudian was silent. He had no other choice but to cut off the entire arm! He hesitated for a few seconds but finally made up his mind. A sharp limb was cut out and stabbed into his shoulder. Blood gushed out.
The body of flesh and blood was in sharp contrast to the frozen right arm. It was easily torn apart in front of the sharp limb.
Dudian couldn’t help but clench his fists. At this moment the sharp limb had cut into his shoulder. He only needed to use a little more strength to completely cut off the right arm!
Compared to the pain caused by his arm, his heart was in more pain. But since things had come to this point, he had no choice but to cut off his right arm. He clenched his teeth and was ready to cut off his right arm. Suddenly, he felt a numbness coming from his right arm. It was as if something was extracted from it.
Dudian couldn’t help but look at his right arm. It was the same as before. There was no change. The feeling just now seemed to be an illusion.
He looked at his right arm and quickly found that it was not an illusion. The numbness in his right arm was accompanied by the feeling of withdrawal, there was a ‘feeling’transmitted out again!
Dudian was startled. He looked at his right arm for a while but still couldn’t see the abnormality. However he confirmed that his right arm had regained the feeling. However the feeling was still numb. There was no reaction from the touch on the surface of the arm, however he could feel it if it was painful.
He felt bitter in his heart. His right arm had regained some sensation when he was about to lose it. He felt ironic.
He was about to continue to exert his strength when suddenly a familiar crawling feeling came from his body. Dudian was shocked. He operated his X-ray vision to the extreme and quickly looked at the crawling place.
He was stunned.
He saw that there was a hairy ball that looked like a sharp blade under his right ribs. It was about the size of a fingernail. Its body was mainly black but a few of the sharp blades were golden in color.
When did such a thing grow in his body? Dudian’s hair stood up and his scalp went numb. He waved the sharp blade to cut through his chest and stab at the small hairy ball.
The slow speed of the small thing suddenly increased as if it felt threatened. The speed had caused it to cut off many blood vessels and veins along the way.
Dudian screamed in pain. He felt as if his chest was being rubbed by a cactus. The burning pain made his body tremble. Sometimes the endurance of Willpower was one thing, but the body’s reaction to the pain was out of control. People with high willpower wouldn’t be indifferent to the tickling. At most they wouldn’t be humiliated and abandon their dignity.
The pain made Dudian’s sharp blade stop. He was worried that the sharp blade would try to kill the little thing. He was afraid that it would tear his whole body and cut his chest!
The pain didn’t last for long. Suddenly a strange feeling came over. Dudian woke up from the unbearable pain. The pain in his chest seemed to have weakened by several times. He couldn’t help but look down, he was stunned again. The monster had climbed into the nest and curled up. The spikes on its body were as soft as feathers, it occupied the entire nest.
Dudian was stunned. His mind was in a daze.

chapters.title: Chapter 879
chapters.content:
Chapter 879 – Chapter 869: Magic Gold
What’s the situation?
Is this little thing a parasitic soul worm?
Dudian was stunned for a long time before he came back to his senses. He looked at the little thing on his chest. He only had the splitter’s parasitic soul worm in his body but it was already dead, the splitter’s parasitic soul worm was suspected to have revived and turned into a black mucus-like life form. However, it didn’t give him the feeling that it was a ‘living creature’.
However, there were many differences in appearance between splitty’s parasitic soul worm and the hairy ball on its chest. One was long and the other was round. However, there were some similarities between the two. Even the naked eye could see the extremely sharp spikes.
However, wasn’t Splitty’s parasitic soul worm swallowed by the golden sarcoma? Where did it come from?
Dudian came back to his senses as he thought of the golden sarcoma. He looked at the torn right arm. His face changed as he saw pale golden blood gushing out from the golden sarcoma on his right arm, there was also a touch of pale golden blood. He looked around his body and almost cursed out of anger. He saw that there was a touch of pale golden blood flowing down from the place where the sharp hairy ball crawled.
The pale golden color was mixed in the blood and spread to all parts of his chest. However, because of the wide dispersion, the color was very light. If one didn’t look carefully, they wouldn’t be able to notice it.
Dudian couldn’t help but swing the sharp blade and cut a ravine on the ground. His face was extremely ugly. The reason why he cut off his right arm in such a hurry was because he was worried that the golden sarcoma would spread to his body. He didn’t expect that it would spread out.
He was angry. He looked at the hairy ball on his chest. He felt that it was a scourge. He didn’t notice where it came from but the faint golden marks left by it were enough to prove that.., it came from the golden sarcoma. Although he didn’t know how the golden sarcoma could breed such a thing but its origin was extremely dangerous!
The most infuriating thing was that he felt that he had been cheated by the golden sarcoma.
This thing was clearly frozen by the right arm, but it had actually silently bred something that looked like a parasitic soul worm. Moreover, it had even made its way into his body without anyone noticing.
One had to know that during this period of time, he would occasionally use x-ray vision to check the condition of his right arm, but he did not see anything unusual. Until now, he did not know whether the sharp-edged hair ball had long emerged from the golden sarcoma and was hiding in his body, or if it had just taken advantage of the tear in his right arm to crawl into his body. However, no matter which one it was, he was not in the mood to delve into it now.
Putting aside the problem of the sharp-edged hair ball, he did not know how to deal with the pale golden substance that was scattered in his blood.
If it had previously gathered into the golden sarcoma, he could still think of a way to cut it out in one go. But now that it had spread throughout his body, how was he going to clean it all out?
If he didn’t get rid of it, would it reproduce? Would it grow stronger and stronger?
At this moment, even Dudian felt that he was a dead man. His body was invaded by unknown things but he couldn’t resist. This feeling made him feel sullen and helpless. Even in the past when he was facing a strong enemy.., he had never felt so conflicted and depressed. Even if the enemy was several times stronger than him, he could still run and hide if he couldn’t beat them. A man could bend and endure for a while. But now the crisis had invaded his body. He couldn’t hide, he had no way to solve it. He could only wait for death.
He thought of the many difficulties in the past. So many people had been defeated by him. He didn’t expect that he would be defeated by an unknown little thing. This made him feel a bit funny, but he thought of the similar cases in history. He felt more bitter in his heart. There was a famous general with outstanding military achievements, but he fell to his death while riding a horse. There was a profiteer who was rich enough to rival a country, but he had an incurable disease. Was this fate?
There was a reason for Dudian’s pessimism. He still remembered the feeling when the golden sarcoma rushed into his brain. It was as if his consciousness was about to be taken away. He wouldn’t forget it even if another 10 or 100 years passed, now the golden sarcoma had differentiated and returned to his body. Perhaps it would expand again and invade his brain. He wouldn’t have the energy to resist it at all times, moreover, it was very difficult to resist it. Once it entered his blood, he could not stop it even if he wanted to.
He could not stop the blood supply to his brain. In that case, in less than 15 minutes, his brain would die.
After being depressed for a long time, the pain from his right shoulder made Dudian come back to his senses. He heard that his right arm had been torn. It was not completely cut off. The wound was terrible. He did not have the time to bandage the wound, he bitterly smiled as he looked at his right arm. The corner of his mouth twitched. In the end he took back the sharp blade and helped his right arm back. He smeared the healing medicine on the wound and used the gauze from the clinic to bandage it.
There was no point in continuing to cut off his right arm. Previously cutting off his right arm could isolate the golden sarcoma. Now the substance from the golden sarcoma had flowed into his body and the unknown little thing was also there, if he could take his life, it would be enough.
However, he didn’t leave his right arm because he had given up on treatment. Instead, he thought of another possibility, or a glimmer of hope.
“The ice on the right arm can freeze the golden sarcoma. When this thing gathers into a group and wants to invade the brain, we can count on the ice to stop it.”Dudian held a trace of hope in his heart, if the frozen part was extended to his neck then even if the golden substance in his body gathered again, it would be able to block the way for it to invade his brain. But in that case he would have to absorb the cold crystals again.
Absorbing the cold crystals was not a problem. But now he was not afraid of the magic marks of the dye but the splitter.
Back then the magic marks of the dye were able to directly absorb the cold crystals to strengthen his physique. But the magic marks of the dye were not able to completely digest the side effects of the cold crystals. As a result his right arm was frozen and almost crippled.
If he directly absorbed the cold crystals without the magic marks then he would be in big trouble.
However if he replaced his magic marks with the magic marks then his physique would be very weak.
Dudian had a headache as he thought of these problems. He applied healing medicine on the wound on his right shoulder and looked at his chest. The little thing was curled up inside.
He touched the soft surface but it was very stiff. He poked the little thing but it didn’t respond.
Dudian pondered for a long time but there was no result. He sighed in his heart. He was about to get up when he saw his reflection under the moonlight. He was startled as he saw several sharp blades swaying behind him, he remembered that he was still in the splitter’s magic body state. In other words, his magic marks didn’t fail! However, his chest was obviously occupied by the little thing. How could there be no reaction?
There was a trace of doubt in his eyes. He thought for a moment and undid the magic body. Then he held the splitter’s sword and entered the magic body again.
The sword melted and covered his whole body. This time, Dudian saw that the little thing in his chest slightly trembled when the sword melted. After a moment, his magic body stabilized.
Dudian looked down and found that there was no big change in his body. Through the reflection of the moonlight, he could see that the shape of his back was the same as before. When he was suspicious, the sharp limbs on his back fell to the ground, dudian saw that there was a pale gold color on the front and edge of the sharp blade.
“So fast, the golden substance has spread to the magic body?”Dudian’s heart was shocked. The speed of the spread was too fast. He didn’t feel it at all. Moreover, the golden substance could spread to the sharp limbs on his back, it meant that it was effortless to invade his brain!
His heart was cold. At this moment his brain was still in a blood supply state. The golden substance that was wandering in his body had to be mixed into a tiny part of his blood to enter his brain, it was impossible for him to detect it. It was very difficult to identify it through x-ray vision. After all, x-ray vision didn’t mean that he could see the microorganisms clearly.
Dudian was stiff for a moment. He slowly came back to his senses. He looked at the pale golden substance that was spreading around his body. He asked himself in his heart: Is This thing that smart? Does it know how to lurk and use wolf tactics? It should be known that this thing was just like a bacteria. In a big sense, it was just a parasite. Did It have such a cunning mind?
Thinking of this, he got some comfort in his heart. No matter what, he didn’t feel anything strange at the moment.
Speaking of strange things, his heart moved. He quickly felt his body. He couldn’t feel much just by looking at it. He looked at it for a while and began to run on the spot. Usually when he was seriously ill and couldn’t exercise, he would have an attack, dudian also wanted to see if there would be any symptoms in his body during the intense exercise. He didn’t want to be caught off guard during the battle.
He didn’t expect that his face would change as soon as he started to exercise.

chapters.title: Chapter 880
chapters.content:
Chapter 880 – Chapter 870: Upgrade [ First Update ]
Thump! Thump! Thump!
Dudian’s figure flew forward like lightning. He was so fast that he was shocked. He quickly stomped on the ground and made several deep pits. He stopped and almost hit the tree a hundred meters away, the tree was definitely injured but he would be in a sorry state.
Dudian was still in shock as he stopped in front of the tree. He looked back at the short distance of 100 meters. The deep pit footprints were still clearly visible. He was stunned and a trace of shock flashed through his eyes.
Too Fast!
So fast that he couldn’t adapt to it!
He thought of several possibilities. Although he was ready to exercise, he didn’t think of full-strength exercise. But even so, the speed of his previous burst was faster than his previous full-strength sprint, it was like a child who suddenly got the body of an adult. He couldn’t control his own strength!
Dudian had experienced this kind of explosive change in the past. For example, when he first got the magic mark and replaced it with the magic mark of the splitter. But now he was the master. His control of strength was different from the past, even if his strength suddenly increased by one or two times, he wouldn’t be so flustered. But his previous speed had exceeded his full sprint speed. He was so scared that he almost tripped on the brakes.
Dudian looked at his own magic body. He picked up the blade on his back and gently swung it towards the ground. Whoosh! He cut into the ground like a sharp knife. The gravel and grass were cut off.
Dudian tried his strength again. At this time, he clearly felt the changes in his body. The most intuitive feeling was that his vision was clearer than before. Previously, he could only see the outline of the Black Shadow, but now the outline of the Black Shadow was clearly visible in his vision. It was neither big nor small.
A few minutes later, Dudian stopped the experiment and went back to his original place. There was still a bit of disbelief in his eyes. Whether it was strength, speed, vision, these basic values, he had improved them all. Moreover, it was not one or two times the increase, but four to five times!
What was the concept of four or five times the basic value soaring? If his current enemy was his previous self, he could easily kill him!
That’s right, instant kill!
It must be known that he was a master before. Moreover, he was the splitter’s magic marks. He was considered a strong master. But at this moment, he could directly kill him! The speed of his full speed was faster than his previous reaction speed. In addition to the sharpness of the splitter it wasn’t difficult to kill him in one hit!
For Dudian who had the magic marks of the splitter the most important basic value wasn’t strength but speed! As long as he could get close to the splitter and let it attack first then it would be the others who would die.
This was the strength of the splitter. It was invincible in close combat!
Unless the enemy’s defense was extremely terrifying and could block the attacks of the splitter or the enemy’s reaction was faster than his. If the splitter was able to get close to him and attack him first then the disadvantages of the splitter would be exposed, for these two kinds of enemies, he could only send vegetables to them. If he couldn’t kill the enemy with the weak defense of the splitter then he might be killed by the enemy.
However, it was difficult for other magic marks to have such an effect. Even the magic dragon would be able to survive a blow from Dudian. But if Dudian’s attack was on the head, throat, eye socket and other weak points.., he would be able to kill the enemy in one blow. However, his reaction speed was faster than the opponent’s so that the opponent wouldn’t be able to dodge.
However, with his current physical fitness, Dudian felt that ordinary rulers weren’t his opponent. It was because of this that he found it hard to believe. After all, there was the legendary abyss above rulers!
Although he had seen an abyss in the wilderness and the opponent might be an abyss team, but for him, the Abyss was still a distant existence. It was just a step away but it was like a natural moat.
The reason he had such a feeling was that the method to become an abyss was too harsh and mysterious. Even after he searched through Sylvia’s secrets, he could not find a specific method, but now.., he stood among the rulers. Although he could not say that he could instantly kill all the rulers, he believed that most of the rulers were not his match. Of course, most of what was said here covered the entire divine kingdom!
After all, there were legendary magic marks like the supplicant in this giant wall. It was hard to guarantee that there would not be some more unusual and strange legendary magic marks in the other giant walls. Sometimes, being strong did not necessarily mean that one could instantly kill all the low-level ones, the most common example was the highly toxic magic marks. If it was an extremely rare type of highly toxic magic mark, even a ruler could poison the Abyss to death!
In the final analysis, although there were classes, but there was no absolute class!
It was like nobles and civilians. No one could guarantee that the nobles wouldn’t beg the civilians one day. It was just that the probability was very low.
Dudian didn’t know whether he was an abyss or not. His understanding of the Abyss was too little. Even Sylvia didn’t have many records. After all, there was only one abyss there.., aristotle wouldn’t record his physical condition in a small notebook. If he wanted to know about it he would have to go to the wider world. However, he felt that even if he wasn’t an abyss.., he wouldn’t be much worse than an ordinary abyss.
In addition to the increase in basic values, Dudian regretted that he didn’t extend any new abilities. Although his perspective had been strengthened but he didn’t have any other abilities, he wasn’t sure if he had stepped into the abyss or not.
“Speaking of which, compared to before, I have strengthened a lot in all aspects. The sharpness of the blade has also increased.”Dudian shook the blade on his back and slowly put away his magic body, he looked at the hairy ball which was curled up in the magic nest. The little thing was like a golden hedgehog. He knew that the strengthening of his physique was related to the little thing.
He even suspected that this little thing was probably the original splitter’s magic marks, but it was not swallowed by the golden sarcoma. Instead, it absorbed energy from the golden sarcoma and evolved.
Thinking of this, his expression was a little complicated. Increasing his strength was a good thing. He urgently needed strength. When he found God’s kingdom, he did not know how many experts he would have to face. He estimated that the Abyss was as common as a ruler, it was even more common than a ruler. After all, Aristotle was the Master of the Abyss but he had to travel thousands of miles to go to the Kingdom of God. It was clear how big the Kingdom of God was!
Moreover, once he knew the method, he didn’t believe that it would be difficult to cultivate dozens of abyss with the resources accumulated by the Kingdom of God for hundreds of years. It must be known that human beings were not weak in reproduction and were extremely creative, there was no technology from the old era in Sylvia but it didn’t mean that there wasn’t any in the Kingdom of God. Although the great cataclysm had almost wiped out the human population but it wasn’t easy to wipe out the traces left by humans.
If the Kingdom of God wanted to use the technology of the old era, it wouldn’t be a problem for them to develop better than the old era in just 300 years.
In Dudian’s opinion, the monsters in the Abyss were just a small problem. It should be known that the most powerful period of the human race could shake the entire earth!
Because of this, power was extremely important to Dudian. It was just that the increase in strength this time was a bit unclear. He wasn’t sure if the small thing in his chest would bring harm to him.
After thinking for a long time, Dudian finally decided not to bother about it. There were enough problems on his body, so he wasn’t in a hurry to deal with it. After all, it was difficult for him to resist the temptation of the four or five times increase in physique.
After thinking about it, Dudian felt a lot more relaxed. He packed his things and took Aisha back to the town.
It was late at night. Dudian walked around and returned to the Frog Hotel.

chapters.title: Chapter 881
chapters.content:
Chapter 881 – Chapter 871: Banquet [ Second Watch ]
There were candles on the first floor of the hotel. Dudian saw the landlady sleeping on the counter. The other tenants were sleeping in their rooms. The reason why the landlady was sleeping in the living room was because.., she didn’t want to open the hotel at night. She was afraid that the tenants would wake up in the middle of the night and find her.
Dudian knocked on the door.
The boss woke up in a daze: “Who is it? We are not open at night.”
“It’s me. Open the door.”Dudian whispered.
The boss heard Dudian’s voice and felt that it was familiar. She quickly remembered it and woke up. Her face changed. She didn’t expect that Dudian would come back, wasn’t he trying to find trouble for her? She hesitated for a moment before she realized that the door wouldn’t be able to stop Dudian. She quickly opened the door and saw Dudian standing outside. She smiled, “So it’s benefactor. It’s so late. Do you have something to do?”
Dudian saw that she didn’t want to let him in. He knew what she was thinking: “Since you are benefactor, is it convenient for you to stay for a night?”
The Lady Boss complained in her heart but didn’t dare to refuse. Although Dudian was polite but if he didn’t let him stay in the middle of the night he would be met by the patrolling guards. If there was any trouble then she would be blamed, she could only open the door and invite Dudian in.
“Give me a room and prepare some food.”Dudian took out two silver coins from his purse and gave them to her.
The Lady Boss took the silver coins from Dudian and smiled bitterly in her heart. For the first time, she felt that the silver coins were too hot to handle. But since things had come to this point, it was better to have money than no money at all. She accepted them and led Dudian upstairs to the guest room with a big smile on her face, then she brought hot water and snacks.
Dudian washed up with hot water and ate snacks. Then he rested with Aisha.
It was another sweet night. Dudian woke up when the sun came in through the window. He washed up and took Aisha downstairs for breakfast. It was almost noon, guests came in to eat.
The girl who greeted Dudian yesterday was surprised to see Dudian in the shop. She whispered to the boss.
The Boss glared at her. She told her to greet Dudian as soon as possible.
Yesterday Dudian had killed two people here. She didn’t want the other party to come and treat her small hotel as a fighting arena.
Dudian ate, drank and enjoyed the rare leisurely time. It didn’t take long before a burst of hurried footsteps came from outside the door. At the same time there was a low voice coming from outside. However the distance was far so the other people in the shop couldn’t hear it, dudian frowned but quickly recovered. It wasn’t a problem for him. The most he could do was to add a few more lives under his hands.
When he was in Sylvia he was able to poison hundreds of thousands of people in the inner wall. If the military and internal big shots couldn’t handle this matter well then it wouldn’t be a problem for millions of people to die. But now he was killing people.., it was no longer painful for him. Moreover, these people were not good people. They were not kind people. Although they did not deserve to die, he did not feel any burden when he killed them.
As expected, a few minutes later, the Inn was kicked open. Four or five figures rushed in. The sunlight shone from behind them. Everyone looked over and felt that it was blinding.
“Who is the boss!”The young man in the lead shouted angrily.
Everyone saw that the youth was a one-eyed man. He was wearing a black eye mask and looked a bit fierce.
The lady behind the counter was shocked. She immediately saw that there was a face that she had seen yesterday. Her heart skipped a beat. She secretly looked at Dudian’s direction, she quickly walked towards the few people.
Dudian was still eating and drinking. He wasn’t in a hurry. If it was too noisy then he wouldn’t mind taking action, but he still felt that it was necessary to give these people a chance.
At this time a weak voice came from the side: “Sir, you should run. They are not to be trifled with.”
Dudian looked at the little girl who had persuaded him yesterday. Her eyes were full of anxiety.
Dudian looked at her. He looked at the one-eyed young man who was trying to persuade the boss. He sighed in his heart, “Don’t worry. Continue to serve your dishes. Bring me two sets of cutlery.”
The little girl’s eyes widened. Yesterday’s cutlery was used to kill people. Did Dudian want to kill again?
She didn’t dare to ask. Her heart trembled and she retreated.
Dudian finished his meal and saw the owner looking over. The one-eyed youth also looked over. He was playing with the knife in his hand, there were more than one horse hooves coming from outside.
Dudian’s eyes slightly moved as he looked up.
The sound of horse hooves stopped in front of the inn. The one-eyed youth who was ready to go up to Dudian raised his eyebrows. He didn’t rush to make a move. He turned his head and saw several knights wearing silver armor lifting the curtain and coming in, dudian’s eyes swept over the inn. He completely ignored the one-eyed youth and others. He looked at the owner who was wearing a headscarf: “Are you the owner?”
It was a middle-aged knight who asked the question. He was very accurate in judging people. He could roughly tell that the lady boss was from here.
The Lady Boss was stunned. Her face changed as she smiled: “I am the Lady Boss. Do you want to stay or eat?”
The middle-aged knight whispered: “Is there an adult named Dudian living here?”
“Dudian?”The Lady Boss was stunned as she looked at Dudian.
Dudian saw the middle-aged knight say his name and knew that he was sent by the Lord. He glanced at him.
The middle-aged knight followed the Lady Boss’s gaze and saw Dudian calmly glance at him. He knew that Dudian was the adult that he was looking for, he saluted: “Are You Lord Dudian?”
Dudian nodded: “The Lord is looking for me?”
The middle-aged Knight’s attitude was more respectful: “Yes, Lord. The Lord asked me to send a message to the lord. He said that there will be a banquet in the king’s city. Do you want to go with him?”
“Banquet? King’s City?”Dudian’s eyes slightly moved, he knew what the Lord meant. If he wanted to go to the king’s city to attend the banquet then he would be worried that Dudian would keep an eye on his whereabouts. Dudian thought that the lord was going to run away so he specially invited him. However, he couldn’t rule out the possibility that the banquet was fake and the trap was real. He thought that the Lord wouldn’t dare to take the risk when he knew Dudian’s identity and strength.
He asked: “When do we leave?”
“The Lord will leave tomorrow.”The middle-aged Knight replied.
Dudian nodded: “Alright, I will talk to him later.”
The middle-aged knight saw that Dudian was indifferent and his attitude was more humble: “Sir, if there is nothing else, shall we take our leave?”
Dudian nodded.
After the middle-aged knight and others left, the eyes of the inn all focused on Dudian. Especially the one-eyed youth. He opened his mouth and swallowed a mouthful of saliva with difficulty. His limbs felt numb, his whole body was cold.
He recognized the badges on the chest of the middle-aged knight. It was the Knight Group of Lord Lothick. He was so scared that he didn’t dare to move. After all, his industry wasn’t that glorious, he thought that these people were coming to arrest him but they went straight to the youth who was looking for trouble.
Everyone in the hotel heard the conversation between the middle-aged knight and Dudian. Lord Lothick had invited Dudian to the banquet in the king’s city. What kind of honor was this? What kind of identity did dudian have?
The youth was like sitting on wax. He wished that he could disappear into thin air. He didn’t expect that he would provoke such a terrifying existence. He was relieved after the middle-aged knight left, fortunately Dudian didn’t let the middle-aged knight attack them. Otherwise he wouldn’t be able to leave the hotel alive.

chapters.title: Chapter 882
chapters.content:
Chapter 882 – Chapter 872: The Road To The Abyss
Dudian didn’t sit for long after the middle-aged knight left. He took Aisha and left after eating the food.
The one-eyed youth saw that Dudian was going to leave. He bowed and nodded: “Sir, I have offended you before. I don’t know if you…”
“Get lost.”Dudian frowned.
The one-eyed youth was startled and quickly left.
Dudian took Aisha and went straight out.
The one-eyed Youth’s expression changed as he watched Dudian leave. He didn’t know if Dudian would mention him when he went to meet the Lord. If he did, he would be dead, even the big shot above him wouldn’t be able to protect him. However, he thought that the middle-aged knight could deal with him when he was here. Dudian didn’t mention this matter and most likely wouldn’t go to the Lord to complain.
He was relieved as he thought about this point. He quickly called his men to leave and didn’t dare to appear here again.
Dudian called a carriage: “Go to the Lord’s Manor.”
The Coachman was stunned as he heard Dudian’s words. He looked at Dudian and saw that he was extraordinary. His face showed respect as he carefully pulled Dudian towards Lothick’s manor.
Dudian threw a silver coin to the coachman. He didn’t wait for the coachman to find the money but went straight to the manor.
There was a middle-aged man in a black tuxedo standing in front of the manor. He had a pair of glasses on his left eye and a white glove on his hand. He looked like a butler. His eyes lit up when he saw Dudian get out of the carriage, he stepped forward: “Are You Mr. Dudian?”
Dudian nodded.
“The Lord has been waiting for you for a long time. He asked me to wait for your arrival.”The middle-aged Butler smiled.
Dudian nodded slightly: “Lead the way.”
The Butler saw that Dudian didn’t like to talk much so he didn’t say anything. He turned around and led the way. He went through the gate and entered the manor through the gravel path. He went around the small pools in the manor, the water in the pond kept gushing. The gardeners were working hard to mow the lawn. Occasionally there would be maids carrying teapots.
Dudian sighed in his heart. Although Rosik wasn’t a big deal but his life was more carefree than his.
However he knew that although Rosik wasn’t worth mentioning in his eyes but he ruled over many villages and towns. Rosik was a noble big shot who lived in a luxurious and beautiful place, it was a matter of course.
The middle-aged Butler slowly pushed the door of the castle in front of the manor. The Magnificent Hall had crystal chandeliers. Compared to the town, this place was like a royal palace with mountains of gold and silver. It was extremely luxurious.
The middle-aged Butler slightly leaned over to invite dudian. At the same time, he looked at Dudian’s reaction. He saw that Dudian simply glanced at him but there was no strange expression on his face. His heart was secretly surprised, he vaguely understood why the old master would let him, the butler of the house, wait for an unknown young man in front of the gate. It seemed that the identity of the young man was more noble than he had imagined
Although Lothick was the ruler and the person with the highest status in the territory, but he didn’t exclude the important people from other places to visit. The middle-aged Butler had received a lot of people. He couldn’t help but speculate Dudian’s identity, could he be from the king’s City?
Dudian naturally didn’t know what the Butler was thinking. He was too lazy to guess. Lothick was a small figure to him, let alone a butler of a small figure. He bluntly asked: “Where is Lothick?”
The middle-aged Butler’s eyes narrowed as he saw Dudian call Lothick by name. He didn’t dare to Scold Dudian. He carefully said: “Mr Dean please wait for a moment. I will send someone to inform the Lord.” Dudian was led to the reception table in the hall.
Dudian casually sat down and said to the middle-aged butler: “Tell him not to let me wait for too long.”
The middle-aged butler replied: “Yes, yes.”His heart was filled with awe. He immediately turned around and called for help.
Dudian grabbed the fresh and delicious fruit on the table. He wiped it and began to eat. The fruit had been washed and there was a bit of water on it. It was as tempting as dewdrops. He was too lazy to be polite with Rosik.
A woman’s voice came from the stairs as Dudian was eating. “Who is this person? Why doesn’t he have any manners?”The sound of high heels came over.
Dudian heard the sound of high heels. He turned his head and looked at his feet. It was a pair of bright red high heels. It was almost the same as the old era. He had a strange thought in his mind, the technology that dominated the planet had been destroyed but the high heels of women had not disappeared from the stage of history.
He looked back but the owner was angry. he shouted: “Where are you looking? Don’t you have some self-cultivation?”
Dudian looked up. She was a young girl in her early twenties. She was very beautiful and well-dressed. She was dressed in noble clothes. She was quite elegant but her face was full of anger.
Dudian had Aisha by his side so he didn’t miss other women. He had seen the perfect face of the Aragami. At most he was amazed but he didn’t have any improper thoughts, he looked down and continued to eat his fruit: “I can look anywhere I want. My eyes are on my face. How can you control them?”
“You!”The girl didn’t expect that Dudian would say such shameless words. Her face turned red: “Who are you? Why are you sitting in my living room? Who invited you? Get Out!”
“Your father invited me.”Dudian tilted his head and looked at her. Although he was full of murderous intent but he didn’t want to be serious with a second generation girl. He smiled: “You are the one who will go out later. Do you believe me?”
Roxanne was stunned for a long time. It took her a long time to realize that “Your father”was referring to her father. She had stayed by her father’s side since she was young. Every day she learned to play the piano and read books. Occasionally she would meet other girls with high status, she had never heard such vulgar words but since ancient times it was easy to understand. She reacted and stared at him: “This is my house. How dare you ask me to go out? Why would my father invite a person like you to my house?”
Dudian wanted to say more to anger the girl. He found that he liked the feeling of anger. But he looked down and continued to eat his fruit.
Loxanne saw that Dudian was silent. She wanted to say a few more words but heard a dignified middle-aged voice from behind: “What are you doing here?”
Roxanne turned her head and saw that it was her father roxick. She quickly went forward, “Father, I was about to go out for a walk when I saw this man in our living room. His feet were on the table and the mud on his boots had hit the table. I went up to remind him. He said that you invited the guest. Father, how could you invite such a person to our house? This man is a scoundrel!”
Lothick’s face changed as he saw her scold Dudian. He slapped Lothick’s face: “Get Out!”
Lothick covered her face and stared at him. She was completely stunned. Lothick had never talked loudly to her since she was a child, let alone slapped her, she even suspected that the man in front of her was her father.
The middle-aged Butler was shocked. He didn’t expect that the old master would think so highly of an outsider. He didn’t expect that the old master would hit his beloved daughter, he quickly went forward and tried to persuade: “The old master is angry. Miss is also confused…”
“Shut up!”Lothick scolded.
The Butler didn’t dare to say anything.
Dudian frowned. He didn’t think that Lothick would react so much. But he knew that Lothick was afraid that he would get angry. He didn’t plan to kill Lothick, dudian didn’t care about Lothick. He didn’t think that Lothick was a bad person. Although Lothick was talking about him but he didn’t think that Lothick was superior in the eyes of ordinary nobles. So he wanted to anger this simple little girl, if it was any other noble lady who had a sense of superiority, Dudian would have ignored her and told her to get lost.
“What a Great Show! Are you trying to fool me?”Dudian said as he glanced at Lothick.
Lothick was stunned: “Mr. Dean misunderstood. It’s all my fault…”
Dudian raised his hand to interrupt him: “Alright, let the others out. Let’s talk.”
Lothick was relieved as he saw that Dudian didn’t probe further. He immediately asked the butler to take Lothick away.
The Butler thought that Dudian was Lothick’s guest but it was obvious that Lothick was afraid of Dudian. He didn’t know who the young man was so he quickly pulled lothick away.
Lothick came back to his senses. Even if she didn’t understand the world at this time she would be able to see through him. She didn’t expect that this man who was about the same age as her would make her father so afraid. She clenched her teeth, she left with the butler. She thought of Dudian’s words and felt ashamed.
“Mr. Dean, Please Calm Down.”Roxick poured a cup of tea for Dudian.
Dudian took his legs off the table. There was a lot of sand on the table. Roxick would have been angry if it was someone else but Dudian was in front of him. He could only cheer even if the table was broken, rosik didn’t dare to show his displeasure. He smiled and asked Dudian: “Mr Dean knows about the banquet? Are you willing to go?”
“You invited me to the banquet because you want to introduce me to a few fat sheep?”Dudian looked at him and said in a playful tone.
Rosik’s eyes flashed with a trace of embarrassment but his smile didn’t fade: “Mr Dean You are joking. I will send you the parasitic soul worms in fifteen days. I always keep my word!”
Dudian didn’t pursue his thoughts. His strength had increased greatly. Even if there were traps in the king’s city he wouldn’t be afraid, let alone a Lord who only had three pioneers guarding him, it was impossible for him to set up a trap that could kill the Lord. Otherwise, Rosik would have been the first to be defeated. The reason why he came to negotiate was because he wanted to attend the banquet.
Now that the crisis in his body was temporarily resolved, he was not in a hurry to ask the supplicant to parasitize the soul worm. In fact, he might not even want it. Although the supplicant parasitize the soul worm was very rare, its comprehensive ability was more comprehensive than the splitter, and it had an extremely strong survivability, it also had an extremely strong offensive ability. However, to replace the magic marks, his strength would be greatly reduced in a short period of time. When he got used to the attack method of the supplicant’s magic marks, it would take him at least half a year before he could control it as he wished.
Moreover, if he only obtained one of the petitioner’s magic marks, it would not be of much use to him. Unless he obtained five of them and deified them, he would only be able to recover his ruler-level strength. However, if he obtained five of the petitioner’s parasitic soul worms.., he would need to spend quite a bit of time. He could not just kidnap five lords and buy magic marks for himself. That would definitely alarm the temple and secretly investigate.
The reason why he attended the banquet was, firstly, that since he was already here, he was not in a hurry to travel. A little in-depth understanding might be beneficial for his development in the divine kingdom in the future. Secondly, he felt that the giant wall was quite different from Sylvia. Even the parasitic soul worm ranked first among legends was being sold. It should not be because he was short of money, but that it meant that there was no shortage of legendary magical marks here!
The number of strong people here was much more than Sylvia’s. It could be seen from the fact that there were three pioneers guarding a single lord.
There were many pioneers and the number of rulers was naturally large. There might be more than one abyss Walker above the ruler. Perhaps they could find a way to advance to the Abyss from here.
“Let me ask you. Who is the strongest here? What is his strength?”Dudian asked Rosik.
Rosik was stunned. He glanced at Dudian. He didn’t dare to lie as he thought that Dudian was from outside the giant wall.
Ten minutes later, Dudian’s eyebrows wrinkled as a strange light flashed in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 883
chapters.content:
Chapter 883 – Chapter 873: Polar Ice Worm
“There are three abyss. One of them is the lord of the giant wall. It seems that this is the official name of the giant wall…”Dudian thought that there would be more experts than Sylvia, however, he didn’t expect that there would be so many abyss. There were three abyss in one giant wall. Moreover, this was known by the Little Lord Rosik. Who knew if there were one or two more in the dark?
Still, he had expected that the wall was beyond Sylvia’s reach. Although he was surprised, he did not panic. After all, he was now in the dark, and even if there were three abysses, they might not know of his existence, moreover, he had seen Asian people of the same skin and hair color as himself along the way, which was why his bloodline was not special here. Even if the abyss saw him, they would not know that he was from outside the wall.
In addition to this, his physique had greatly increased last night. The fear of the Abyss in his heart wasn’t as strong as before. Instead, he was eager to see the difference between himself and the real abyss.
However, he restrained his impulse. After all, he had never fought with the Abyss before. He wasn’t sure how big the gap was.
“Since parasitic soul worms can be bought, why didn’t the other great lords nurture a few generals or the Abyss?”Dudian asked Rosik.
Rosik saw that Dudian’s expression didn’t change much when he heard about the three abyss. His heart became more and more fearful, rosik wryly smiled: “My Lord, the general great lords can nurture generals but it is difficult to nurture the abyss. No matter how much money they have, they can’t do it.”
“Why?”Dudian’s face showed a bit of interest.
Lothick was startled as he didn’t think that Dudian would ask this question. He understood and was relieved. He had roughly figured out Dudian’s strength. It was lower than the Abyss but higher than the 10,000 kills, it was most likely the master level!
In their world, the master was also called the master and the famine was called the demon general. If Dudian knew Lothick’s thoughts he would praise him and guess it very accurately.
As a lord of more than ten towns, Lothick had a lot of things to deal with. Moreover, Dudian didn’t deliberately hide it. It wasn’t difficult for him to guess. He thought that Dudian was the master and not the magic general, the main reason was that Dudian’s performance when he killed his personal guard was too easy. It wasn’t something that the magic general could do.
Lothick’s heart wasn’t so scared after he guessed Dudian’s level. Although the master was a superior existence to him but he wasn’t someone who couldn’t be solved!
Lothick’s face was calm as he thought about it, he replied: “My lord, if you want to become an abyss then you have to get the ‘polar ice worm’. This thing isn’t sold in the temple and is rarely seen outside the giant wall. So you can only rely on luck to become an abyss.”
“Polar Ice Worm?”Dudian was surprised. He didn’t expect that a small lord like Lothick would know the method to become an abyss so easily, this was a secret that couldn’t be found in Sylvia. But it was easy to find it here.
“What is a polar ice worm? What does becoming an abyss have to do with this?”Dudian asked. He didn’t want to expose his strength.
Rosik knew that his previous guess was correct, he smiled in response: “It is said that the polar ice worm is an extremely rare soul worm. It is the ancestor of all parasitic soul worms. If you want to become the Abyss then you have to get the polar ice worm.”
Dudian frowned. The name was a bit strange. Since it was the ancestor of all parasitic soul worms why wasn’t it called ‘progenitor worm’or ‘source worm’instead of ‘Polar Ice Worm’, was it named according to its characteristics?
“What ability does the polar ice worm have as magic marks?”Dudian asked.
Lothick knew that Dudian had never come into contact with this matter. But he didn’t dare to hide it. If Dudian didn’t trust him and went to other lords to inquire about this matter, it would anger dudian, lothick laughed: “My lord misunderstood. The polar ice worm can not be used as a magic mark. It doesn’t have any special ability but it contains pure ice energy. That’s why it has this name.”
“Generally the polar ice worm is used as an energy material. It is injected into the magic mark and the magic mark evolves to a new level. It will bring the increase of physical strength and jump into the abyss. Unfortunately, the polar ice worm is rare in the world. It is not sold even in the temple.”
Dudian was stunned as he heard Rosik’s words. The polar ice insects that were known as the ancestors of parasitic soul worms couldn’t be used as magic marks? Could they only be used as evolution materials for magic marks? Dudian was suspicious but he felt relieved. He thought that Rosik wouldn’t lie to him. It would be strange if the polar ice insects were the exclusive magic marks of the Abyss, it meant that all the Abyss had the same magic mark and the same ability.
The mysterious path to the Abyss was unexpectedly opened. Dudian thought that the method to become the Abyss was in the hands of a few high-level officials. He didn’t expect that the small lord of the giant wall would know about it, it was most likely leaked from the temple. If the temple was the monster research institute then the attitude of the monster research institute in the giant wall was a bit intriguing.
“Are you sure?”Dudian stared at Rosik as his eyes slightly revealed killing intent.
Rosik’s face slightly changed: “It is absolutely true. You can ask the other lords if you don’t believe me…”
Dudian’s eyes slightly retracted: “I want to know all the information about the polar ice worm. I want to know its living area, habits, appearance and so on.”
Rosik’s face turned bitter, “Sir, I really don’t know about this. I only know about the surface of the polar ice worm. I have already told you about it. I don’t care about anything else. Even if this thing appeared in front of me, I wouldn’t dare to take it. So I didn’t have a deep understanding of it. But if you want to know, I can go to the temple to help you inquire about it. In addition, there should be a lot of people who want to inquire about this thing. It Won’t be too strange…”
He was relieved to see Dudian’s expression calm down.
“It seems that I need to go to the king’s city.”Dudian muttered to himself.
Rosik’s eyes turned, he said: “My lord, there are many important people in the king’s city. What you want to know can be heard from there. Moreover, it is absolutely reliable. You may not believe my words but there is nothing that can not be done as long as you spend money.”
Dudian glanced at him: “In that case, I don’t have much money. You should bring all your money.”
“Ah?”Rosik’s mouth was wide open.

chapters.title: Chapter 884
chapters.content:
Chapter 884 – Chapter 874: Pre-Purchase
Dudian didn’t joke with Lothick. The next day, Lothick exchanged all the rare gems, gold coins, antiques and other valuables into royal gold notes, after emptying the inventory of all the money houses in the territory, there were still many agate jades, famous carvings and rare antiques. Lothick packed them and put them on the carriage to be towed to the king’s city.
Lothick naturally couldn’t bear to part with the wealth that he had accumulated over the years. However, he didn’t expect that Dudian would directly open up his small treasury. Moreover, he checked his account book and revealed all his secrets, if it wasn’t for the fact that there weren’t many money houses in his territory, Dudian would probably be able to mortgage his manor and sell it.
In a short day, Dudian and Lothick were sitting in the same carriage. One of them was frowning while the other had a calm expression. They were leisurely leaning against the window and enjoying the scenery along the way.
From time to time, dudian would talk to Aisha about the scenery outside. Aisha didn’t say much and was silent. This strange situation naturally attracted Rosik’s attention. However, he didn’t ask too much.
Dudian controlled the heat in his body to the level of a normal pioneer. If it was too low then he would follow Rosik and attract more attention, he would be Lothick’s personal guard.
“Are there many lords in the banquet?”
“Sir, there are about forty or fifty of them. But I don’t know how many of them will come.”
“Why are there so many lords in the banquet?”
“This is a banquet organized by the Rose Lord. It is said that there are important matters to discuss. I’m not sure. I’ll know when I get there.”
Dudian chatted with Rosik from time to time and asked about the situation in the king’s city. In the blink of an eye, a day had passed. They left in the morning and arrived at the king’s city at sunset. They stayed in the carriage for a whole day. They passed by four or five territories, rosik showed his identity and had lunch in one of the territories.
Dudian gradually understood that although these lords were competing for resources and territories of each other. They had been fighting for years but there was no lack of cooperation and trade among them. Many of them were allied with each other, they were fighting against other lords. Today they passed through five territories which were allied with Rosik. Rosik was a member of the Alliance but not the leader.
It would take two to three hours to go straight from Rosik’s territory to the king’s city. However they had wasted a lot of time bypassing the territories of the hostile lords.
Dudian didn’t understand the situation of the lords. He looked at the towering city wall in front of him. The height of the city wall was two or three hundred meters. It was more than half of the height of the wall of sighs, the wall of sighs was used to isolate the inner and outer areas. In his impression, it was the tallest city wall in addition to the giant wall. If it was an ordinary person.., it would be more shocking to look up.
Dudian looked at the fleet of carriages as they slowly entered the king’s city. There was a trace of solemnity in his heart.
“Sir, the banquet will be held tomorrow night at the Taylor Hotel. How about we rent a hotel nearby to rest tonight?”Rosik seemed to relax a lot after entering the king’s city. He wasn’t as tense as before. He smiled at Dudian.
Dudian looked at the yellow sky and pondered: “Let the Butler lead the team to find a good hotel. Take Me to the temple.”
He had asked Dudian that the temple wouldn’t close until 8:30 pm. It was still early.
Lothick didn’t expect Dudian to be so impatient. He smiled: “Master, isn’t this a bit too urgent? Should we go tomorrow?”
“Now.”Dudian said.
Lothick sighed in his heart as he saw that he couldn’t change Dudian’s mind: “Alright, I will talk to the Butler.”
After a moment, Lothick told the butler: “If you see them, tell them that I have something to do.”
The Butler replied.
Dudian knew that Rosik was referring to the other good lords. In fact, they were slightly better than Rosik. Rosik didn’t want to neglect them.
Rosik ordered the coachman to leave the convoy and go to the temple.
Dudian felt as if he had come to the royal city of Sylvia. The streets were clean and lively. There were many shops and a lot of tourists. However, the styles of the two cities were completely different, dudian didn’t see them in Sylvia. He often saw bards selling their skills. There were many audience members around him. There were also some abject musicians who were playing musical instruments, such a situation could be seen on every street. From time to time he would hear a melodious melody drifting into the car.
The architectural style of the roadside was different from that of Sylvia. The walls were gold in color and looked extremely luxurious. Sylvia was dark and dark red in color.
The two giant walls were similar but had different cultures.
Rosik suddenly said: “Master, the temple is here.”
Dudian turned his head and looked at the other side of the street. There were dozens of clean steps. Behind the steps was a golden wall of the temple. There were two beautiful angels outside the temple, the outline of the face was perfect. Dudian looked at it as a thought popped up in his mind. was this angel sculpture imitated by the Aragami?
Dudian saw Rosik get off the carriage. He took Aisha out of the carriage and sighed: “I didn’t expect the temple to be so close to the city gate.”
Rosik smiled: “There are several temples in the king’s city. This is the temple’s sub-temple. But if you want to inquire about information, you can do so here.”
Dudian nodded and went up the stairs with Rosik. There were two or three people coming up the other end of the stairs. They were wearing armor and had extraordinary temperament. It seemed that they were here to do business.
Rosik was used to this. He led Dudian to the front of the temple. He took the initiative to help Dudian Open the revolving door.
The inside of the temple was golden. It seemed that the entire temple was made of gold. Dudian glanced at it and sighed in his heart.
There were many people standing in the hall. It was similar to a bank. There were four or five counters and there was a queue outside.
Dudian was about to go over to the queue when Lothick stopped him: “Elder, let’s go to the VIP room and have a rest.”
Dudian raised his eyebrows. Although he looked down on Lothick but the latter was a lord. His status was much higher than ordinary people.
Rosik led Dudian and Aisha to a room next to the hall. There was a desk in the room. An old man in dark red robe was drinking coffee. He saw Rosik and Dudian come in, rosik put down the coffee and stood up: “This is the VIP room. Who Are You?”
Rosik raised his hand. There was a medal in his hand. The design on it was the same as the one on the flag in his manor.
The old man’s eyes lit up: “It’s Lord Lothick. I’ve heard a lot about you. Please sit down.”
Lothick immediately asked Dudian and Aisha to sit down. Dudian looked around. There was a trace of solemnity in his eyes. Everything here was too similar to the banks of the old era. He thought that the temple was extremely sacred, he didn’t expect that it was programmed like an office. Was it intentional or not? It was possible that the Monster Institute was behind the temple. The headquarters of the Monster Institute was in the Kingdom of God. If it was intentional then it meant that the things of the old era were not completely destroyed, but it was in the hands of a few big figures in the Kingdom of God!
Rosik saw that Dudian was deep in thought. He didn’t expect that the young man’s thoughts would fly to the distant kingdom of God just because of the environment. He coughed, he looked at the old man: “I want to pre-order ‘supplicant’.”
There was a trace of surprise in the eyes of the old man: “Supplicant is ranked first on the list of legendary monsters. It is worth a lot. Lord Rosik, are you really going to buy it?”
As a person who specialized in serving vips, the old priest naturally knew about the lords. Otherwise, he would not be able to tell Rosickle’s name just from his family badge, although he might not remember his appearance.., however, Rosickle’s name and his information had long been memorized in his heart. He did not expect that with Rosickle’s wealth, he would actually want to buy the supplicant. Could it be that he was prepared to make a desperate gamble?
Thinking of the few hostile Lords Rosickle faced, the elderly priest’s eyes flickered slightly as he looked at rosickle without batting an eyelid.
“I have that intention,”Rosickle said. “Can you buy them?”
The elderly priest nodded, “You can buy them, but you know the value of supplicants. I’ll say one more thing. Rather than buying supplicants, it’s better to buy other legendary magic marks. You can buy ten. Although supplicants have great potential, it’s impossible for them to fight against ten people of the same level, right? Moreover, if you want to buy supplicants, you have to take out your Lord’s land contract and the Lord’s contract.”
Lothick’s heart ached when he heard Dudian mention the Lord’s contract. He would have to pay half of the Lord’s contract and a lot of territory to buy the supplicant, the area of his territory wouldn’t change but his rights would be reduced by half. In the end he would be completely replaced by the temple.
Dudian quietly looked at Rosik. He knew the conditions to buy the supplicant. The so-called Lord’s contract was equivalent to letting the temple buy shares in Rosik’s territory. Moreover, the shares were equivalent to 49% , although Rosik still had the power of execution and management, the temple only needed to use some small means to easily take over Rosik’s territory.
Therefore, most small and medium-sized lords weren’t willing to buy supplicants to sign such an unequal treaty with the temple.
Only the big lords had a large territory and concentrated power so they could play with the temple.
The temple relied on selling magic marks to control the lifeblood of all the lords. It could be said that the temple was the uncrowned King!
“I’m willing.”Rosik was mentally prepared but he still felt a burst of weakness and pain after saying these three words. Dudian patted his butt and left. But the remaining trouble.., but he had to deal with it himself. Even if Dudian didn’t deal with him he wouldn’t have a good time in the future. However he had no choice but to accept it.
The old man looked at him but didn’t say anything: “Do you have the title deed?”
“This is a deposit of 100,000 gold coins. This is the title deed.”Rosik was prepared. 100,000 gold coins was a thick stack of gold notes. It was equivalent to the annual income of his territory, he still needed to pay 900,000 gold coins!
A supplicant was worth a whole million gold coins, which was almost enough to empty Lothick’s family fortune.
Seeing that Lothick was ready, the old priest didn’t say anything. He took out documents from the drawer and helped Lothick with the pre-purchase procedures. When the procedures were completed, a lot of documents were needed. During this time, the old priest called several groups of people, including the temple master of the temple, who personally came to witness and pressed his handprint.
Half an hour later the procedure was finally completed.
The old man smiled: “Lord, you can go back and wait for us. We will mail you the result in ten days.”
Rosik squeezed out a smile. He put away the documents and turned to dudian: “Let’s go.”
Dudian sat next to Rosik. He saw that the matter of buying the supplicant had been settled. He said: “Don’t forget about the polar ice insect.”He was more concerned about the polar ice insect than buying the supplicant.
Rosik had a guess in his heart. could the crystal desolate insect that he had met in the cave of the Amelia tribe be the polar ice insect?
Although the latter was a desolate insect but Rosik had said that the polar ice insect didn’t have other abilities but it had pure ice energy. The crystal desolate insect had frozen the flame, that method was beyond the concept of ice. His scientific knowledge was completely unable to solve it. In addition to its huge size, it was completely in line with the image of the polar ice worm in his mind.
Rosik came to his senses after hearing Dudian’s words. He patted his head and turned to the old man: “I want to know about the polar ice worm, such as its appearance and living habits.”
The old man was stunned. He looked at Dudian and then looked at lothick. He thought that Dudian was Lothick’s guard but it seemed that Dudian’s status was higher?
He looked at dudian. He didn’t remember that there was such a person but he hadn’t seen many big figures. He nodded: “No problem. I will find him for you.”
“Thank you.”Rosik thanked him.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. He didn’t expect the old man to be so direct. He didn’t make any requests.
He thought about it and slowly felt relieved. Maybe the temple didn’t care about the information about the polar ice worm. It would be a good thing if a lord like Rosik got it. Maybe Rosik would directly sell it to them, even if they did not sell it, they would most likely secretly pay attention to Lothick’s movements. Once Lothick could get it, it would not be difficult to snatch it from him.
This was equivalent to a free reward. Naturally, there was no need to hide it.

chapters.title: Chapter 885
chapters.content:
Chapter 885 – Chapter 875: The Abyss
A moment later, the old priest took out a shabby book from the file. He dusted it off, flipped it open and checked it. After confirming that it was correct, he turned around and handed it to rosickle, “My Lord, this secret manual contains information about the polar ice worm, including its appearance and habits, as well as its abilities. There are also some rumors and stories about tourists that can be used as a reference.”
He continued: “This book is very precious. Master, you can read it but you can’t pass it out.”
Rosik politely said: “Of course. I will stay here and read it.”
The old priest nodded and went to do his own things.
Rosik sat on the sofa next to him. He pretended to open the book and handed it to Dudian who had been waiting impatiently.
Dudian saw that the book wasn’t thin. There were hundreds of pages. He slowly opened the book. He was a bit nervous. There was no unnecessary nonsense at the beginning of the book. After all, it wasn’t a novel, the purpose of the book wasn’t to attract people to read it. So the first page was full of information. When he turned to the second page, a sketch of a monster appeared in front of Dudian.
Dudian’s heart was shocked as he saw the shape of the monster. There was a trace of disbelief in his eyes.
His guess was right!
The ice worm was the crystal worm!
Dudian was stunned for a moment before he reacted. He was excited and excited. For the first time, he felt that he was blessed by God!
Although he had been lucky in the past but he had paid a great price. He had almost lost his life. For example, when he got the magic marks of the splitter, he almost became a supplement for the little splitter. Although he had survived in the end.., he had also benefited from misfortune, but good and bad went hand in hand. He did not think that God was taking care of him, but that he had saved himself. Luck was also earned through his own efforts!
But this time, he felt as if he had been hit by luck.
Although he had almost lost his life in the battle with the crystal desolate worm, and it was only with Aisha’s help that he was able to defeat the crystal desolate worm, the danger had long passed. The crystal desolate worm’s corpse in his hand.., in his eyes, it was only worth researching. But he didn’t expect that it was the polar ice worm that opened the key to the Abyss!
It felt like he had picked it up for nothing!
Didn’t that mean that he could become the abyss now?
Dudian felt that it wasn’t true. He was prepared to sneak into the Kingdom of God and carefully manage it. He would secretly inquire about the information. Maybe in a few years he would be able to grasp the method to become the abyss.
But now the key to the Abyss was in his hands.
“Master?”Lothick saw Dudian’s face change and couldn’t help but carefully call out.
Dudian recovered and ignored him. He was impatient as he quickly scrolled down. The patterns on the sketch were similar to the crystal worm’s shape. Moreover there were data such as length and width. So he felt that.., this was the crystal worm. But there were countless monsters in the world. It wasn’t that there weren’t similar monsters. He needed to look at other information to be sure.
Dudian took a deep breath as he read four to five pages. The crystal worm was indeed the polar ice worm. It didn’t matter if it was its shape, ability, living habits, combat form or the state after death.., it was the same as the crystal worm!
He even felt that the information was based on the description of the crystal worm. There was no error in what he saw!
There were some legends about the polar ice worm. There were the figures of the god of war and the War of monsters and so on. Dudian looked at the back of the story, there were some mysterious stories that said that the polar ice insects came from the Arctic. There were gods living there and so on.
The legends were not believable but they were not completely false. Dudian knew that the Arctic was the old Arctic. The name of the polar ice insects was linked to their abilities, the ice would make people think of the Arctic and the Antarctic. Maybe the polar ice insects really liked to live in the Arctic.
He had a thought in his mind. If there was an opportunity, he could go to the Arctic. If there were polar ice insects living there, it would be a huge profit.
Perhaps there were rare polar ice insects but there were many of them.
Dudian was aware of the situation. He didn’t even know where he was now, let alone go to the Arctic. Moreover, there was an ocean in the middle. Even if he could fly, could he cross the ocean to the Arctic? If there were birds gathering over the ocean then he would be delivering food. Moreover there were monsters everywhere on the land. He didn’t know what was happening in the ocean. If the situation was affected then his scalp would go numb.
The excitement in his heart suddenly calmed down. There was even a trace of melancholy, “If the creatures in the ocean had mutated and demonized, would the earth still be the same as before?”? “Even if all the monsters are expelled and broken through the giant wall, what’s the difference between the land surrounded by the sea and the giant wall?”? “It’s just a big sheep pen.”
Dudian was silent for a moment. He couldn’t help but laugh. He didn’t want to talk about whether the creatures in the sea were demonized or not. Even if there were, it wouldn’t be related to him, he could only fantasize about it. It was thousands of times more difficult than becoming an abyss. But now he was just a survivor who had just obtained the key to the abyss.
Even if he stepped into the abyss, it wouldn’t be a big deal.
In the past, Dudian would have thought that the Abyss was the top class in the post-disaster human world. But now he knew that there were three abysses in the giant wall. Moreover, Aristotle had personally gone to the Kingdom of God, he knew that in the Kingdom of God the Abyss could only be considered as a superior. But there was still a long way to go before he could reach the top level. The water in the Kingdom of God was so deep, not to mention the countless monsters in the land.
Dudian shook his head. He knew that he had some old times complex. He hoped that one day he would be able to break away from the shackles of the giant wall and return to the Old World. People would go wherever they wanted to go, but he also understood that the times were different. Even if he wanted to change many things, he wouldn’t be able to do it.
The more his strength increased, the less he dreamed of breaking the giant wall when he was a scavenger. Because the more powerful he was, the more he understood the difficulty, there was rarely such an impulse and fantasy. He was satisfied as long as he could restore Aisha to her original state.
Rosik returned the book to the old man. Rosik, Dudian and Aisha left the temple together. The sky was completely dark. The streets were bustling with lights. Especially the area near the temple, there were several large shops in the vicinity. It could be said that it was one of the busiest streets in the vicinity.
Rosik took Dudian back to the hotel.
“Give me some money. I plan to take a look around in the next few days.”Dudian bluntly asked Lothick for money on the way back to the hotel.
Lothick’s mouth twitched. But he thought that it was good that Dudian could leave him for a period of time. It was better than being stared at by Dudian all the time. He hesitated for a moment and took out a stack of gold notes from his pocket and handed it to Dudian, “I only have these with me. The rest of the money is for the deposit.”
Dudian knew that Lothick wasn’t lying. He took the gold notes and put them into his pocket. Then he looked at the scenery on the street as if nothing had happened.
Lothick’s heart was bitter. He felt that he was out of luck. There was no benefit in helping Dudian this time. But after the event, he might lose his family and even be annexed by other lords.
Ordinary people wouldn’t accept such a deal even if they died. But he didn’t have a choice because he didn’t even have the qualifications to fight with Dudian.
Now that he knew that the polar ice worm was a crystal desolate worm, Dudian didn’t have any expectations for the magic marks of the supplicant. For him, it was dispensable.
