He might just get it as an energy material, he injected the parasitic soul worm into his chest. He felt that this thing should be the splitter’s parasitic soul worm. After all, his magic body was still the splitter.
He just wanted to leave this place as soon as possible. He wanted to find a place to absorb the polar ice worm and evolve into the abyss.
The book also recorded the method to absorb the polar ice worm. Dudian only needed to prepare some auxiliary tools. It wasn’t difficult.
Soon, they arrived at the hotel. Rosik and Dudian got off the car.
Rosik was ready to send Dudian back to his room when he entered the hotel. Several people came over to chat. One of them seemed to recognize Rosik and immediately shouted: “Lord Rosik?”
Rosik looked up in surprise: “Old Luo? You are here too?”
“You received an invitation too?”The middle-aged man called old Luo quickly understood: “It has been a long time. Why Don’t you come to My Room Tonight?”
Rosik glanced at dudian.
Dudian didn’t intend to pay attention to Rosik’s personal communication: “You Go. I’m a bit tired.”
Rosik nodded to old luo: “Let’s talk in your room tonight.”
Old Luo and the others looked at Dudian in surprise. Old Luo knew Rosik’s identity. Although they didn’t know Rosik but old Luo called him ‘lord’so they knew what kind of character Rosik was, however it seemed that he was in awe of Dudian. They couldn’t help but look at Dudian a few more times.
However, they were all high-ranking figures. Although they were aware of Dudian’s identity but they didn’t show it on the surface.
Dudian didn’t let Rosickle to send him. He took Aisha upstairs.
Old Rosickle, Rosickle and others began to chat as Dudian went upstairs. They casually mentioned Dudian but Rosickle knew what they were thinking. He laughed and ignored them, although he wanted to tell the other lords that this was an intruder and that he was being held hostage by him, but he didn’t dare to say it out loud. Moreover Dudian was here!
Although he wasn’t a pioneer but he knew what kind of ability the pioneers had. In addition to their strength they had their own unique skills. With Dudian’s strength he could hear the conversations within three miles, it was simply a piece of cake.
It was true, but Dudian didn’t pay too much attention to Lothick after he came to his room. He felt that if he gave Lothick two guts, he wouldn’t dare to reveal his identity. It was tantamount to courting death.
Dudian and Haisha sat in front of the window, enjoying the night view outside. The hotel was simply very high. The distant and close-up view outside was very beautiful. The lights were brilliant, and they could see such a beautiful night view, it also showed that the hotel was very high-class.
Dean told Aisha about the interesting things outside while thinking about the things after absorbing the polar ice worm.
After becoming an abyss, he could continue on his journey. There was no difference between supplicants and other inferior legendary parasitic soul worms.
As he thought about it, the night gradually deepened. Dudian was also sleepy. He carried Aisha to the soft bed and hugged her to sleep.
In the middle of the night, Dudian was woken up by a whisper. The sound was not loud, but it was somewhat loud in his ears. In addition, he had been sleeping comfortably after entering the giant wall for the past few days, so he was not particularly sleepy.
Dudian was aware that the whispers came from a room on the second or third floor. He heard Rosik’s voice. Rosik’s words had woken him up, he said that Rosik had come to wake him up.
Dudian frowned as he thought of the person who had greeted Rosik. He took out his pocket watch and checked the time. He had slept for less than two hours. It was only twelve o’clock, it wasn’t too late for some people who liked nightlife.
He was about to continue to sleep when his eyebrows moved. He carefully listened to the conversation of Rosik and the others.
After a moment the whispers stopped and the meeting was over.
Dudian looked at the downstairs. He looked through several rooms and found that some of the people were sleeping and some were not sleeping. They were doing indescribable things with their female partners, there were guards waiting by the window in several of the rooms. They were all pioneers.
Four or five people went out of the rooms where Rosik was talking.
Dudian recalled their conversation: “The purpose of the banquet? Is It related to the Abyss?”
Old Luo and two other people who were close to Rosik guessed the purpose of the banquet. One of them said that he had information about the abyss. It seemed that a lot of money and manpower were needed, so he called them over.
Dudian thought for a moment and suddenly had an idea. Although they deliberately lowered their voices but it wasn’t difficult for them to eavesdrop on their conversation, did the person who released the news about the Abyss deliberately say so?
If it was intentional then what was the purpose?
Dudian frowned slightly. He thought for a moment but couldn’t think of any reason. He didn’t think much and went back to sleep.
Dudian left the hotel with Aisha. He didn’t greet Lothick but bumped into Lothick’s daughter, Lothick.
Dudian didn’t expect the little girl to wake up so early. He glanced at her but didn’t say anything.
Loxanne also saw Dudian. She was angry but held back her anger. Yesterday she asked the butler about dudian. Although the Butler was vague but she heard some clues, dudian wasn’t a person to be provoked. Even her father didn’t dare to provoke him.

chapters.title: Chapter 886
chapters.content:
Chapter 886 – Chapter 876: Burn
Dudian left the hotel and called for a carriage. He was ready to leave the city.
Rosik gave him an identity certificate and a stack of gold notes. Dudian smoothly went through the interrogation of the guards. After leaving the king’s city, he took Aisha and took a detour through the wilderness, along the way, he met many wolves, tigers, leopards, snakes and strange insects. Fortunately, these were things that ordinary people were afraid of. After more than three hours of traveling, he found the cave where the parcel was originally hidden.
There was a six to seven meter long python coiled in the cave. There were traces of fighting and bloody bones. Moreover, the mouth of the Python was full of dense teeth, it was obvious that it didn’t just swallow the prey and digest it.
Dudian stepped into the cave. When the Python pounced from the darkness, he raised his hand and swung the blade. The blade hit the head of the Python. The head of the Python tilted and hit the rock wall. It fainted.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to it. He went into the depths of the cave and dug out the soil. He took out the backpack and left the cave. He found a spacious and comfortable place in the woods. There was a small waterfall and a pool, he sat on the rock and quickly opened the backpack. He looked at the bottom of the cave and picked up the jar that was sealed with crystal worms.
He looked at the container and saw that it was full of dark silver mucus.
Dudian used the splitter to lift the lid of the container. He saw that the container was full of silver mucus. It seemed to be frozen or flowing. The light shone on it and it fluctuated.
Dudian was prepared. His figure flashed and disappeared from the spot. A moment later he came back like a gust of wind. He was holding a three to four meter long tiger. The tiger was clamped by Dudian’s waist like a big cat. It struggled and roared, but no matter how he twisted his head he couldn’t bite Dudian.
Dudian threw the mildly mutated tiger to the pot. The Tiger’s Red Fur stood up and glared at Dudian. It was ready to pounce but it didn’t directly rush towards Dudian, simple thinking told it that the human in front of it was very dangerous.
It growled as it tried to scare Dudian away. The mutation suddenly happened.
The dark silver mucus in the pot next to the tiger’s feet suddenly shot out like poisonous snakes towards the nearest tiger’s back legs.
The change startled the tiger. It roared and wanted to jump away but it was already entangled. Soon, the mercury mucus spread to its body and drilled into its hair.
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he saw the scene. Although he had expected that the thing was not completely dead but he didn’t expect that it could survive in the tank without oxygen for so long!
Was this a living creature?
Wasn’t this already beyond the category of living creatures? !
Dudian didn’t bother to save energy and immediately used x-ray vision to check. He was shocked as he saw the mercury mucus drilling into the body of the red-haired tiger. It was like a spiral silk thread that spread out and covered the Tiger’s bones, flesh and blood, at a glance, the tiger’s internal organs and other organs had formed a silver interwoven net. Moreover, the spread of the net was rapidly extending from the back half of the Tiger’s body to the front half of the Tiger’s body. It then flowed through the neck and into the brain!
Roar!
When the mercury mucus entered the tiger’s brain, the Tiger suddenly roared. The next moment, it quieted down. There was no painful roar or roar.
It quietly stood there. The wind blew through the forest and there was a bit of coldness.
Dudian saw that the silver silk net quickly covered the tiger’s brain. He had a bad premonition and a creepy feeling. The next moment.., dudian saw the tiger’s body slightly shake. The amplitude was very light. The tiger slowly raised its head. There was a bit of silver blood on its amber eyes. It looked a bit strange.
“Don’t give up?”Dudian frowned as he saw the Tiger’s eyes.
Roar!
The next moment, the tiger suddenly rushed over.
Its speed was as fast as lightning. It was like a red flame that flashed in front of Dudian’s eyes.
Dudian’s body suddenly sidestepped to avoid the attack of the tiger. He raised his hand and chopped down with the splitter.
Puff! The head of the tiger fell to the ground.
Blood spurted out from the broken neck but stopped after a part of it spurted out. The wound was quickly covered with silver mesh mucus. It seemed to stop the injury. Then a strange scene happened. The headless tiger turned around, it ‘looked’at Dudian.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He wasn’t afraid of the crystal worm, but the strangeness of this thing refreshed his cognition time and time again.
While he was frightened, the ground suddenly moved and the sound of falling leaves was heard. Dudian glanced at it from the corner of his eyes. His face slightly changed again. He saw many silver whiskers growing under the head of the cut tiger, they were like tender buds as they crawled towards the Tiger.
Dudian felt his teeth ache as he looked at them. What was this thing?
Although he had a premonition of what was going to happen next but he didn’t stop it. Instead he wanted to see the scene.
As he had expected, the head of the tiger crawled to the feet of the tiger. The silver mucus immediately gushed out from the neck of the tiger. It was like dozens of small silver blood vessels that meandered down. The head of the tiger on the ground was turned upside down, the two pieces of silver mucus met and immediately stuck together. The head of the Tiger was pulled up and returned to the neck. Except for the hair on the wound which was stuck together with blood, no one could see that the head had been chopped off!
Roar!
The roar of the tiger sounded again.
Dudian stared at it for a moment and sighed in relief. He didn’t expect that the head would not only be connected but could also be used again. This showed that all aspects of the organization had been reconnected and healed. It also showed how difficult it was to deal with the crystal worm!
“Dead but not stiff. I’m Talking About You!”Dudian quietly looked at it. Although he was shocked by the strange ability of the crystal worm, but he wasn’t afraid. The current him was different from the past, from the speed of the tiger which was controlled by the Crystal Worm, he knew that it was not his opponent.
Whoosh!
While Dudian was thinking, the tiger once again pounced on him. At the same time, it suddenly opened its mouth.
Dudian came back to his senses and quickly dodged.
Puff!
A white light flashed and hit the pool behind Dudian. The next moment, there was a cracking sound. Dudian looked at it and his face slightly changed. He saw that the undercurrent of the pool suddenly froze!
Dudian was secretly scared. Sure enough, he couldn’t be careless.
Whoosh!
The tiger opened its mouth towards Dudian again.
Dudian narrowed his eyes. The moment it opened its mouth he dodged. Although the tiger could still use the crystal worm’s move but its speed was much slower.
Dudian noticed this. He quickly approached the tiger and swung his knife.
The tiger wanted to jump away but its speed was too slow. In Dudian’s eyes it was like a slow motion. Poof! The sword cut through the tiger’s nose and went all the way to its waist, it could be said that the tiger’s body was cut into two.
The sharp blade should have easily cut through the tiger’s body. But after being controlled by the crystal worm, the strength of the Tiger’s bones and the toughness of its internal organs had increased exponentially. It was unable to cut the tiger’s tail directly.
Dudian looked at the white beard squirming in the wound. His face was slightly cold. He raised his cold claws and swung them down from the Tiger’s back. Bang! The ground shook and the tiger fell to the ground. There was a huge pit under its body.
Dudian pulled out his sword and cut the tiger three times. The Tiger’s body was immediately cut into several pieces.
Dudian cut its head into several pieces and coldly looked at the ground. Although the crystal worm controlled the tiger and burst out with strong fighting strength, but the Tiger’s foundation was too thin. Although its bones and internal organs were strengthened.., but it couldn’t support its burst of strength. It could barely reach the level of the wasteland level. Even if Dudian’s strength was the same as before, he could easily cut it into pieces.
However, to be able to raise an ordinary mutated creature to the level of the wasteland level in a short period of time was already quite terrifying.
Dudian looked at the corpse on the ground. He frowned and jumped to the side. He quickly cut a few big trees and took out a match. He peeled the bark and ignited it. The leaves and bark quickly burned up.
Dudian circled the corpses on the ground. The flame was burning. Soon, white foam emerged from the corpse which was closest to the flame. But if one looked carefully they would find that it was strands of silver silk. The next moment.., the silver silk crawled out from the corpse and gathered towards the center of the Ring of Fire.
It was too difficult to move the corpse but the speed of the silver silk was very fast. It was like tiny snakes.
Dudian saw the dense silver threads coming out of the corpse and gathering on the largest corpse in the center of the Ring of Fire. He laughed and sprinkled a handful of fallen leaves on the tiger corpse. Then he flicked a match. The fallen leaves were ignited, the tiger hair was the first to burn. Then the entire corpse was burning.
Creak!
Dudian heard the ear-piercing scream from the flames. He couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows. He didn’t think that this thing could make a sound. The vitality of this thing couldn’t be described as “Tenacious”!
After the flame was extinguished, Dudian saw a pool of silver mucus curled up under the charred body. The silver mucus contrasted with the charred body. Dudian used the knife to open the body and put the silver mucus into the pot.
At the moment, the area of the silver mucus was reduced to less than one-third of the previous size. However, it was still as big as a football.
Dudian put it into the pot and set up a fire rack to burn it.
The crystal worm should be called the polar ice worm now. According to the records in the books of the temple its vitality was extremely strong. It was very difficult to kill it.
But there was only one way to kill it and that was to burn it!
Polar Ice Worms were afraid of fire. They didn’t want to get close to the general temperature of the fire.
The first step to absorb the polar ice worm was to kill it!
Dudian thought that it was on its last breath after being sealed in the pot for so long. But the scene just now was a slap in the face. It was still alive and kicking. He could only burn it with fire.
As the flame of the pot became more and more vigorous, the pot suddenly emitted a piercing scream. Moreover, the scream was not one but numerous. It was like there were countless babies and children hidden in the pot, they were screaming in pain.
Dudian listened to the ear-piercing scream. After a while, the sound gradually weakened. Dudian continued to add firewood. The pot was still burning. After a few hours, Dudian cut down a few big trees in the vicinity, he chopped firewood and added it to the fire. However, the pot didn’t change at all. There were no more screams and no more movement. Dudian tried to touch the pot. He was surprised that the pot was cold!
It had been burning for a long time but the pot was ice cold!
The pot was made of metal and it had excellent heat transfer. Even if it was burned for half a minute, it would still be boiling hot, let alone a few hours?
“No wonder there wasn’t even a bubble inside. I was wondering why it didn’t boil…”dudian muttered and continued to add firewood. This thing was not so easy to die, which showed how rare and rare it was.
It burned for a day!
The sun set and Dudian was still burning firewood. Fortunately, there were trees in the surroundings. Moreover, he only burned seven or eight trees during the whole day.
Dudian looked at the sky which was gradually turning yellow. He looked up and saw that it was the sunset. He didn’t expect that time would pass so quickly. He touched the pot. It was still cold but not as cold as before.
Dudian sighed in his heart and continued to add wood to make the fire stronger.
By midnight, Dudian was paying close attention to the metal pot on the fire. After so long the pot had become warm.
Who would have thought that the polar ice worm, which was afraid of touching a match, would be able to hold on for such a long time?
After another two hours, bubbles slowly appeared in the pot. It was a sign of boiling.
Dudian was excited and continued to add firewood.
The next day at dawn, the pot was completely boiling. However, the bubbles didn’t splash in all directions. Instead, they were viscous and fluctuating in the pot.
Dudian continued to add firewood until noon. The mucus in the pot had boiled until noon. Moreover, it had shrunk to half the volume of a football.
Dudian saw that it was about time. He waited for the firewood to extinguish. He lifted the pot to the side and waited for a while. After the boiling in the pot had subsided, he quickly left and returned in less than two minutes, there was a four to five meter long python in his hand.
The Python was lying in its hand. He didn’t know if it was dead or dizzy.
Dudian cut a bloody wound on the Python’s body and threw it to the pot. He quietly waited.
Two hours later the metal pot had completely cooled down. Dudian put the head of the Python against the mouth of the pot and sat next to it.
A Day passed quickly. At night, there was still no movement in the pot.
Dudian caught a few small insects in the jungle and threw them into the cooled pot. Some of the small insects sank down and some crawled on the surface of the mucus.

chapters.title: Chapter 887
chapters.content:
Chapter 887 – Chapter 877: New Magic Body
Dudian stood a few meters away and used his x-ray vision to observe the movements of the small insects in the pot.
The three small insects were struggling violently in the mucus. Soon they slowly suffocated to death. The remaining small insect climbed to the pot. Its body was very light. It seemed to be able to walk on water, however it seemed to be very panicked. It climbed to the pot and kept climbing up. However the inside of the metal pot was very smooth. Every time it climbed a few centimeters high it would slip down.
However, the little worm persisted after repeated times.
If there was no silver mucus, it would be an inspirational story.
After ten minutes or so, the little worm finally accepted its fate. It lay on the inside of the metal pot. It was unable to move. Its legs were raised from time to time. It still wanted to climb but it seemed that it was powerless.
Dudian looked at the silver mucus. The reason why he found the Python and the Little Worms was to verify whether the silver mucus was still alive. According to the book of the temple, the polar ice worm could be killed by fire. However, it didn’t say how long it would be burned by fire. It was probably because the temperature of different flames was different. The size of the flame would bring different temperatures so there was no detailed record.
However, it was said that the polar ice worm would melt into liquid after being burned. If there was no reaction then it would be completely dead. That was why he found the Python and a few small insects.
However, he had suffered from the flesh of the Aragami. This time he didn’t dare to rashly believe in the letter. Perhaps the polar ice worm wasn’t completely dead but it was too injured?
Dudian planned to observe for a few more days.
In the blink of an eye, Dudian stayed in the forest for three more days. In the past three days he had found all kinds of beasts and poisonous insects. He threw them to the metal pot to test its reaction. However there was still no movement. Dudian tried to scoop out a small part and knock out a cheetah, he took the blood from the neck and dripped onto it.
The blood flowed onto the mucus but it was like flowing onto glass.
Dudian continued to observe for a while. He was relieved to see that the silver mucus didn’t even absorb fresh blood. He knew that he had been bitten by a snake for ten years, he saw that the internal structure of the silver mucus didn’t change. It was obvious that it was completely dead.
Dudian poured part of the mucus into the metal pot. The density of the mucus was high. Although the blood of the cheetah was sprinkled on it but it didn’t mix with it, dudian took out the syringe and other auxiliary tools. The process of absorbing the polar ice worm wasn’t complicated. It was similar to the process of upgrading the magic marks. He injected the polar ice worm into the magic nest so that the magic marks could absorb it and transform.
There were two main difficulties. The first was to completely kill the polar ice worm. The second was to endure the pain of the transformation.
Dudian had solved the first problem. The next step was to endure the pain. The price of failure was death!
This was the point emphasized in the book. It was said that many rulers had failed to completely destroy the consciousness of the polar ice insects after they got hold of them, they were controlled by the polar ice insects.
As for the second point, if they couldn’t endure it then they would be in a coma. In the worst case they would have a mental breakdown and their nerves would be weak. It was difficult to repair the injury. At least with the current level of medical treatment they wouldn’t be able to recover, even if he became an abyss, his strength would be greatly reduced. First of all, his nerve reaction speed was slower than other abyss. Secondly, when he suffered a serious injury, his ability to resist pressure was weak. For example, the enemy was good at sound attacks, for people with weak nerves, the ability to emit high-pitched or sharp sounds was no less than the magic sound entering the brain.
Dudian took a deep breath. He didn’t dare to be careless. It was very difficult to kill the polar ice insect. He had to be careful and endure the pain. It was obvious that the pain he was going to face was far beyond his imagination.
He didn’t know if he could withstand it. Although he had suffered a lot of injuries and thought that his ability to resist pain was quite strong, he wasn’t confident at the moment.
However, this step was inevitable.
Dudian moved his body and let Aisha Stand Guard. He didn’t want to be disturbed by some small beasts. After adjusting, he took out a syringe and inserted it into the metal can. He inhaled a full syringe, he took off his shirt and looked at the crack on his chest. It was the demon nest. The color of its skin was like a black crack.
The demon nest was like a sharp sword when he had acquired the first magic Mark ‘fear dye’. Now that he had acquired the splitter, the demon nest had changed more and more due to the evolution of his physique.
After a series of basic procedures, Dudian injected the silver mucus into the demon nest. At the same time he used X-ray to pay close attention to it. He saw the silver mucus pouring into the demon nest, the hairy ball curled up inside the nest woke up. It retreated to the other end of the nest as if it was facing a great enemy. It vigilantly looked at the silver mucus. But soon, as the silver mucus continued to be injected, it gradually expanded to the entire nest.
The hairy ball seemed to be forced into the silver mucus. Soon, it was wrapped by the silver mucus.
Dudian stopped after the nest was filled. He stared at the movement of the nest. When the hairy ball rushed towards the silver mucus, he felt a tearing pain in the nest. It was like a sharp blade cutting through his skin, but he could endure the pain.
However, the pain quickly expanded and became more and more sharp.
At the same time, the ball of hair was stained with silver mucus. It rolled violently and hit the surface of the skin. Sometimes the sharp edge of the small thing would pierce the skin, there was an extremely sharp object on the skin. It was about to pierce the skin but in the end it didn’t break. The sharp edge shrank back.
During the process of the sharp edge hairy ball’s violent struggle, waves of pain spread from his chest to his entire body. Dudian felt cold all over his body. His head was hot and cold. The pain was as if it was going to split open, the pain gradually came from all parts of his body. It was as if he was barbecuing over a fire.
Dudian’s face was wrinkled as he clenched his fists in pain.
At this time, he suddenly understood why enduring pain was the second most difficult point. In addition to pure pain, there were all kinds of uncomfortable feelings, intense dizziness, cramps, pain, numbness, etc. , at this moment, he even wanted to die or pass out.
However, under the stimulation of the intense pain, although he was about to go crazy, he didn’t pass out. He felt that even if he passed out, he would probably wake up from the pain again. He even felt that he didn’t want to become an abyss!
Time slowly passed and the pain gradually calmed down.
Dudian also slowly woke up. The first thing he did was to look at his chest. He found that the silver mucus in the nest was gone and the sharp hairy ball was still curled up inside, but this time there was a touch of silver on the surface of its body.
Dudian couldn’t wait to use the magic body. He saw that there were some silver spots on the surface of the magic body. It was cold to touch.
Dudian tried to move for a moment but found that his physique hadn’t improved much. It seemed that he hadn’t reached the abyss yet.
He was regretful but not too disappointed. This was within his expectations. After all, the previous absorption of the polar ice worm was less than one-thirtieth of its original body. This meant.., he needed to endure the pain and discomfort for another thirty times. The corner of his mouth twitched as he thought of this.
Dudian sat on the ground to rest. He wasn’t in a hurry. The previous feeling was still fresh in his mind. He didn’t want to try a second time in the short term.
He suddenly admired the other Abyss walkers. Could it be that these people had experienced such pain? How Strong was their willpower?
He secretly admired himself and encouraged himself. He looked at the silver mucus in the metal container. He suddenly felt that the world was so beautiful, why should he enjoy the scenery?
He sat on the rock and admired the frozen pool and the forest that he had cut down. After half an hour he picked up the syringe and came to the metal container.
Another round of injection.
Pain, dizziness, nausea, cramps and other feelings made Dudian Dizzy. He was about to collapse. After these feelings gradually calmed down, he woke up again. He was glad that he didn’t pass out, he persisted and didn’t pass out.
Although he was desperate to pass out during the absorption process, he knew that once he passed out, even if his nerves were not weak, there would be some defects.
Dudian continued to rest. This time he rested for more than two hours before he picked up the syringe again. He felt like a brave warrior who had stepped onto a battlefield that was bound to lose. After a burst of screams, the third absorption ended.
In the blink of an eye, another two days had passed.
A burst of unbearable curses sounded in the forest. Ten minutes later, it ended. Dudian sat on the rock and panted, “Twenty-eight times…”he looked at the remaining silver mucus in the metal pot, he felt that the injection would be over after three or four times. He was relieved. As the number of times he absorbed the mucus increased, his resistance to pain became stronger.
He didn’t know whether it was because he was numb to the pain or because his physical quality had improved.
He recalled the two days of experience and the first time he absorbed the mucus. He suddenly felt relieved. He was glad that he didn’t suffer in vain in thorn flower prison. If he hadn’t experienced too much pain.., perhaps he would have fainted during the first absorption, or even completely collapsed.
After all, compared to the other Abyss walkers, he was too young.
The Age of the other Abyss walkers was obvious. As they got older, their sensory nerves were stronger, and their resistance to pain was stronger. Moreover, they had experienced more battles. The more battles they fought, the more injuries they suffered, their resistance to pain was much stronger than ordinary people. If there was no torture in the Thorn Flower Prison, he would have collapsed on the first absorption.
After all, he didn’t fight many times. Most of the time he was in the giant wall. Except for the early days when he was a scavenger and Hunter in the consortium, he didn’t fight much in the middle period.
As he silently thanked the treatment in the thorn flower prison, there was a trace of nostalgia in his heart. He suddenly felt that the life at that time was not as bad as he imagined. It was just a bit bitter.
Thinking of this, he laughed at himself and shook his head. It was probably because of the long time that he couldn’t remember clearly. People always felt that the past pain was nothing. The current pain was the most painful. But every time he faced the current pain.., he felt that it was the most painful time in his life.
In the blink of an eye, it was noon to evening. Dudian’s eyes were tightly closed by the campfire. There was fine sweat on his forehead. This was the last time he absorbed the pain. It was also the quietest time. He didn’t scream, he didn’t need to use anger to relieve the pain. He just silently endured the pain.
He didn’t know how much time had passed but his eyebrows slowly relaxed. He slowly opened his eyes and looked at his hands. There was no change. He looked down at his chest. The black crack on his skin seemed to be bigger, but the crack was only a color. It wasn’t a real skin crack.
He used x-ray vision to see that the silver mucus in the nest had disappeared. The sharp hairy ball had turned into a sea urchin-shaped ball. It was slightly different from the sea urchin.
It wasn’t the first time that Dudian had seen the shape change. The shape of the sharp edge fur ball was changing bit by bit as the number of times it absorbed the polar ice worm increased, he didn’t feel that there was anything wrong with it. However, if the sharp edge fur ball suddenly changed to such a shape then the difference was very obvious.
“Is it over just like that?”There was a trace of doubt in Dudian’s eyes. The polar ice worm had been absorbed but there seemed to be no movement? In the past when his physique had improved he could feel the obvious burning sensation as well as the pleasure of the sudden increase in strength. But this time he didn’t feel anything. It was very dull.
With the experience from last time, he didn’t continue to quietly watch but jumped into the forest to try his fists and feet.
Dudian was shocked again. The change was too big!
It was the same as the last time when the basic values of his body increased by four or five times. He stepped out for more than ten meters.
Dudian was excited as he was shocked. He had succeeded!
He couldn’t wait to activate the power of magic marks. The blade melted and covered his whole body. He entered the magic body state. There were big changes in his magic body during the different stages of hunter and limiters as well as pioneers and rulers, for example, the body of a frontiersman was white bones. But when he was a pioneer, there were sharp blades all over his body. When he was a ruler, the number of sharp blades increased and the carapace of many parts also changed.
Therefore, to verify whether he had broken into the abyss or not, he had to look at the magic body.
When the magic body was activated, Dudian suddenly felt a rush of heat flowing through his body. It felt as if his hands and feet were filled with abundant power. It was an indescribable wonderful feeling, soon it was replaced by shock and ecstasy.
His magic body was formed.

chapters.title: Chapter 888
chapters.content:
Chapter 888 – Chapter 878: Evolution
When the magic body covered his whole body, Dudian immediately felt an unprecedented sense of power as well as a new sense of dominance. He didn’t even have to look down to observe his limbs and body. He wanted to see these images, it was a very mysterious feeling. It was as if his consciousness was above his body. He could see everything including his back!
Dudian knew that his vision was further expanded.
He saw his own appearance through the omni-directional vision. It was a brand new magic body. There were several similarities but they were very different. The first was the neck, in the past it was covered with a black shell. His hair had solidified into sharp horns. But now the black shell on his face was protruding. It had turned into a black helmet. The Curly armor was elastic, it was able to withstand a strong impact. The solidified hair horns were longer. There were a few short and thick horns at the center of the horns. There was a faint dark red light flashing.
Dudian knew that the dark red light hidden in the horns was to provide him with an omni-directional vision!
In addition, there were spikes protruding from his body. At first glance, he looked like a giant monster with long hair. But these hairs were sharp blades. The structure was special. The edges of the cones were concave and the sharp blades were protruding out, it was similar to the tri-edged military spikes that Dudian had seen before. He knew that these spikes were extremely sharp. If he hit them, he would be crippled even if he didn’t die.
In addition to the sharp spikes, there were also big changes to the limbs of the monsters behind Dudian. The width and length had increased a lot. Moreover, the sharp blades were twisted like joints. Dudian tried to swing them twice.
“I have evolved?”Dudian was pleasantly surprised. He couldn’t help but feel a bit incredulous. He didn’t feel much when he was injected with the mucus of the polar ice worm. But at this moment it was a world-shaking change, compared to the current magic body, the previous magic body of the splitter which he was proud of seemed weak. It was like the difference between a short man and a strong man.
His current magic body was like a berserk armored vehicle. No one could stop him even if he went on a rampage!
The improvement of his physique and the transformation of his magic body told Dudian that his body had evolved from the master’s limit. Wasn’t it the Abyss?
Abyss..
The level of the giant wall master was the real big shot in this world!
He didn’t need to rely on the protection of the giant wall to cross the Abyss!
In Dudian’s mind, the Abyss was a symbol of freedom.
He had been looking forward to becoming an abyss Walker but he didn’t expect that the day would come so soon. He was worried that the polar ice worm wasn’t the polar ice worm in the books, it was just an extremely similar thing. Now it seemed that this worry was unnecessary.
Feeling the abundant power in his body, Dudian couldn’t help but laugh. It had been a long time since he was so happy. After laughing for a while, he looked at Aisha, the Strange Dark Golden Eyes stared at her. Although at the moment the eyes looked like those of a monster, but there was a clear gentleness in the eyes, “We are one step closer to our goal. Now That I am an Abyss Walker, crossing the Abyss is safer and faster. After we go to the divine kingdom, perhaps with my power, I will be valued and find a way to heal you very soon…”
He did not restrain himself. His face was filled with joy and his eyes were filled with yearning.
As his power increased, the pressure in his heart lessened. In the past, he was only a ruler, desperately searching for a way to the abyss, but there were no clues and no hope. This made him depressed because he knew.., the Abyss could only be a threshold, which could only be regarded as the passing line for important figures. If it was not even the abyss, even if he went to the divine kingdom, he would most likely not be able to make it, let alone get in touch with the core secrets of the Monster Research Institute.
The Monster Research Institute was spread across all the giant walls. The emperor who ruled the divine kingdom must have known about it, but he still indulged in it. It was not difficult to imagine that all the experiments conducted by the Monster Research Institute could be authorized by the royal family.
If it were in the old era, the monster research institute would be equivalent to a place like the Chinese Academy of Sciences. The things inside were all related to state secrets. Even high-ranking officials might not be able to find out about the things inside, let alone an ordinary small figure.
However, now that he had become the Abyss and was on the same level as the wall master, his chances of blending into the core group of people in the divine kingdom were even greater.
He was full of smiles. Soon, he could see that the way he smiled was a little terrifying. The current him could not be described as a “Human”at all. He could only be described as an upright monster, there was nothing similar to a human’s body. Every part of his body was covered by a demonic body. In the past, when he was a hunter and a delimiter, he was only covered in a part of his body. Now, he was completely covered!
Although it meant that his defense and strength had been expanded, but from the appearance, there was no trace of a human.
His eyes were dark gold. His pupils were as big as a thumb. But with his current height, they were not protruding. The bridge of his nose was a protruding black horn. His ears were covered with a black cuticle, only a small hole was exposed.
Dudian raised his hand to touch. His fingers were sharp blades. It was not an exaggeration to say that they were sharp claws. Moreover, the five sharp fingers were extremely long. If they were fully closed, they could become sharp cones like arms.
In addition to the changes in his body, Dudian also found that his vision had become omnidirectional. He could see the fine dust in the air and some bubble-like objects. These bubble-like objects were almost transparent, the traces of turning left and right were caused by the wind. This also meant that he could see the flow of the wind!
Dudian was a bit curious about the different abilities brought by the new magic body. He tried to test the changes from the physical changes to the changes in the various organs of his body. In the end, he found that his sense of hearing and smell had increased by several times, in addition, his sense of hearing could hear infrasonic waves. There were two strange insects whispering. From the picture, the two insects were lying on the leaves. There was no movement. No one knew that they were whispering to communicate.
However, Dudian didn’t understand the language of the insects so he couldn’t understand what they were saying.
Dudian thought that it was a useless ability but soon, he had a sudden idea. Although he didn’t understand the content of the language but he could get some information from the rhythm of the language.
For example, when he patted the leaves, the insects were frightened and made strange noises. It could be regarded as the language of the insects when they were frightened. In the wilderness, it could be used as a means of early warning or detection.
Dudian still felt that he would rather have a stronger combat ability. However, since he had such an ability and couldn’t change it, he could only think of a way to make better use of it.
“The perspective ability is still there. It can be used to capture heat. The night vision ability is also there…”Dudian experimented again. He found that although the magic body had changed a lot, there weren’t many new abilities, he didn’t know whether it was because he didn’t find the right environment or method to activate them or if the new abilities had been added to the attack. For example, the sharpness of his body had been strengthened, the sharpness had increased and so on.
Dudian felt that it was better to use the monsters he met along the way to test out his abilities. There were all kinds of monsters so that he could test out the changes in his abilities.
Dudian immediately thought of Rosik. It wasn’t that he had feelings for Rosik but he thought about the conversation he had with the others last night. The banquet was related to the Abyss and the polar ice worm, although he didn’t know if the others had deliberately released the news but it didn’t seem like he would lose anything. After all, he was in the abyss. Although there were three known abysses in the giant wall but he felt that.., these three should not have attacked him at the same time. If they met alone, the other party would most likely know his identity and would not fight to the death with him.
When there were three ferocious tigers in a territory, everyone would be afraid of being injured.

chapters.title: Chapter 889
chapters.content:
Chapter 889 – Chapter 879: Purpose
Dudian took Aisha back to the king’s city after he packed his backpack and metal cans. Rosik had given him a golden ticket so he didn’t have to spend much effort to enter the city. He secretly handed Aisha a golden ticket and successfully passed the check, he didn’t even need to show his identity card.
Dudian had been away for almost a week. He didn’t know if the banquet had started or not. But he had heard Rosik mention that the banquet was going to take a long time, he could wait for the magic marks of the supplicants to approve it.
In this case, the banquet shouldn’t have started yet.
Dudian called a carriage and told the name of the place. The Coachman immediately drove the carriage to the hotel.
The carriage arrived after more than an hour. Dudian looked at the streets and found that the king’s city was really big and prosperous. It was three points better than the imperial city of Sylvia.
Dudian was relieved when he saw Rosik and the others. It seemed that the banquet hadn’t started yet.
Dudian got off the carriage and handed Aisha a golden ticket. He pulled Aisha and walked towards the hotel.
The Coachman looked at the golden ticket in his hand. It was enough for him to pull the carriage for half a year. He wanted to tell Dudian that he couldn’t afford it but he saw that Dudian’s back was far away. He looked up and suddenly realized, he stopped talking. He pretended to be dumb for a moment. He saw that Dudian didn’t look back to ask for money. He immediately drove the carriage away.
Dudian had just entered the hotel when Lothick and the other two rushed over. They saw Dudian drinking tea in the lounge next to the hotel lobby. They were stunned for a moment, “Mr. Dean, where have you been for the past few days?”
Dudian glanced at him. He knew that the two pioneer level guards behind him had noticed him. He said: “I have some private matters to deal with. There is no need to explain it to you.”
Lothick’s face flashed with a trace of embarrassment, but soon he smiled: “Of course, I was presumptuous. But the king’s city is full of people. It is better for Mr. Dean to inform me in advance where he is going. If it wasn’t for Stephanie who saw you leave, I would have thought that Mr. Dean was missing…”
How could Dudian not know his thoughts? He was worried that he would find other lords and cause trouble for him, dudian waved his hand: “Don’t make a fuss. I’m a big man. I don’t think anyone would dare to abduct and sell me. By the way, the banquet has begun. Why are you still here?”
“Mr. Dean is joking.”Rosik smiled, he said: “There are many lords invited this time. Some of them are far away so the banquet will be held in two days. Fortunately Mr. Dean came back in time. Otherwise it would be a pity to miss the banquet.”
“It’s just a banquet. What’s there to regret?”Dudian indifferently replied.
Rosik looked around. He saw that no one was paying attention to him so he pulled a chair and sat down, he lowered his voice: “Mr. Dean doesn’t know. It is said that this banquet is related to the Abyss and the polar ice worm. The rose family seems to be under the command of an Abyss Lord. It seems that they are going to the outer wall to find the polar ice worm…” He looked at dudian.
He had estimated Dudian’s strength from his previous attitude and inquiry. He knew that Dudian was a master level expert. He desired the polar ice worm the most.
Dudian knew that Lothick was aware of his strength and identity. But at the moment he had become an abyss. Although he was still interested in the polar ice worm but he didn’t have to get it as before, his eyes lit up as he asked: “Are you going to find the polar ice worm outside the giant wall? Is this the purpose of the banquet?”
“Most likely.”Lothick saw that Dudian was moved so he quickly replied. If he could send Dudian away then he could immediately apply to cancel the application for the magic marks of the supplicant. Although he would have to pay one-third of the fee, the temple would put a heavy amount on the credit line but at least two-thirds of his wealth would be recovered.
Dudian looked at rosik: “Let’s wait for the banquet to start. I don’t know where you got the news but it is just information.”
Rosik nodded and stood up: “Mr Dean, since you are back then I Won’t disturb you. You can tell me if there is anything in case you miss the banquet.”
Dudian nodded and drank his tea.
Rosik turned around and left. The two guards behind him sneaked a glance at Dudian. Although Rosik claimed that Dudian was just a guard of his house, but the two guards who Rosik had trained for many years knew Dudian’s true identity. They also knew that their other companion had died at the hands of the young man.
“Ice Worm, searching outside the giant wall…”
Dudian ignored the surrounding eyes. He looked at the scenery outside the hotel. He was immersed in his thoughts. He felt that the banquet was a trap. Otherwise the contents of the banquet wouldn’t have spread out so quickly. Even Rosik knew about it, most of the other lords were aware of it. Even the other lords who weren’t invited had also received the news. Sometimes the news that flowed in the dark spread faster and more widely than the news that was widely advertised.
However, Dudian didn’t think that there was a conspiracy. Was this banquet going to be a hongmen banquet? He didn’t believe that so many lords would be killed in the king’s city. In that case, the territories controlled by the Lords wouldn’t be in chaos. The king’s city wouldn’t want to see such a situation, unless the person in charge of the king’s city was a brutal and muddleheaded wall master.
Dudian thought carefully about the idea of brutal and muddleheaded. After all, strength reached the abyss. It didn’t mean that one’s moral character, inner content, and self-cultivation had reached the abyss.
There were many strange people in the world who had created records in their own professional fields. However, their moral character and knowledge were in a mess. Even some people who specialized in knowledge and literature were the same, a writer who could write praises for life might not have great reverence for life. Perhaps all he had was the ability to sketch out such reverence.
He had seen far too many examples in Sylvia, using those famous people to create momentum when he usurped the royal family. Many masters who were known as upright and upright, and scholars who were known as ascetics, all succumbed to money and authority.
The so-called upright and upright might just be a selling point for their profits.
The more he thought about it, the more he realized that he was wrong. He couldn’t help but shake his head and smile bitterly. He didn’t have the mood to think about it anymore. In any case, he was different from before. Even if there was a conspiracy, he believed that he could withstand it. After all.., in addition to himself being an abyss, Aisha was also the same..

chapters.title: Chapter 890
chapters.content:
Chapter 890 – Chapter 880: Get Out Of The Way
Two days passed quickly.
Dudian took Aisha to eat and drink in the king’s city. They enjoyed the rare peaceful time. In the blink of an eye, the banquet began. Dudian and Lothick rode in the same carriage. They followed the carriages of the other lords and headed to Rose Manor, the venue of the banquet.
“Rose Manor has a history of more than 100 years. The street was renamed as Rose Street 60 years ago. This time the Grand Duke of Rose opened the Violet Square. It has become one of the four most prosperous areas in the king’s city. People will think of Rose Manor and the Grand Duke of Rose. They are hereditary nobles who have survived from their ancestors…”
Inside the carriage, Lothick was introducing the Rose Manor to Dudian.
Dudian casually asked a question. He didn’t interrupt Lothick as he was listening to the story.
It didn’t take long for the convoy to enter a bustling area. Lothick lifted the curtain and looked out. There was a trace of awe and yearning in his eyes, he sighed: “Violet Square is almost here. It is worthy of being one of the four flourishing areas of the king’s city…”
Dudian glanced at the caravan. He felt the prosperity of the king’s city. The streets were crowded with people. Although there were flags of many lords on the caravan but it was still difficult for them to move. There were several teams of knights coming to maintain order.
Lothick whispered: “They are the retinues of the Duke of Rose.”
Dudian remembered the emblem on the Knight’s shoulder. It was the shape of a rose. It matched the title of the Lord.
After half an hour the convoy finally arrived in front of an empty street. There weren’t many people on the street. Most of the passers-by took a detour, there was awe in their eyes as they looked at the place.
Dudian lifted the curtain and looked around. He immediately understood the difference between the lord of the Rose and the other lords. The manor stood in front of the convoy. It was vast as if it was a green grassland, there were more than ten maids and gardeners in the manor. They were pruning the tea trees and lawn. There were buildings standing in the distance.
Ordinary people could barely see the black outline of the buildings.
The size of the manor was shocking. It was even more exaggerated than the palace that Dudian had seen before.
“In the king’s city, such a large manor territory was built. It doesn’t include the private area outside the king’s city…”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He had a more intuitive understanding of the strength of the Rose Manor.
At this time, seven or eight teams of knights galloped in front of the manor. Their armors were bright and the feathers on their helmets were bright red. They stood up and talked with the guards at the gate for a while, the gate of the manor was opened and the leading team drove in. The rest of the carriages followed and slowly drove into the vast manor.
After entering the manor, it was as if he had entered another world. The previously noisy noise had completely disappeared, and it became very quiet and peaceful.
Losic smacked his lips and lifted the curtain to secretly size up the entire way. Although he was a lord, he rarely had the opportunity to come to Grand Duke Rose’s manor as a guest. At this moment, compared to this rose manor.., he thought about his own castle and manor which he was proud of. He felt ashamed.
Lothick wasn’t the only one who was moved. The other lords were also moved. They had seen the majestic atmosphere of the Rose Manor and the majestic financial resources.
Dudian wasn’t interested in these things. He had seen too much gold and silver wealth when he usurped the wall master. Although the Rose Manor was quite grand but in his eyes it was just like that.., moreover he saw himself as a fighter. He believed that the strong was respected by the iron law. He didn’t care about the superficial fancy. He understood that this kind of fancy wasn’t just pure beauty and atmosphere, it was an invisible show of force.
Ten minutes later the convoy passed through the manor and came to the top of the hill. They saw a magnificent castle which was located in front of the tallest and largest building on the hill, knights stood in line and decorated the gate of the building.
The carriages drove to the main hall and everyone got off.
“That is the third son of the Duke of Rose, Crodie.”Lothick whispered to Dudian.
Dudian nodded but didn’t say anything.
Lothick knew what Dudian really cared about so he didn’t say much. The reason why he introduced him was because he was afraid that Dudian would cause trouble. Although he was eager for Dudian to get into trouble but now he was following him, if something happened then it would inevitably implicate himself.
“Stephanie, Yar, come here.”Lothick waved to the two women who got off the car.
The two women were accompanied by the guards. Lothick glanced at Dudian who was standing next to Lothick. There was a trace of dissatisfaction in her eyes but she didn’t show it, she didn’t know much about the war but she wasn’t completely ignorant. At least in terms of etiquette, she knew to restrain herself. Especially for people who were in awe of her father.
Loya was the elder sister. She smiled as she looked at Dudian: “Dad, there are so many lords coming today. When are we going in?”
“Now.”Loic looked at the surroundings: “Mr. Dean come with me or the guards will have to stay outside.”
Dudian nodded.
Everyone walked towards the main hall. Krodi waited for Lothick to come forward, he said in a friendly tone: “I have long heard of Lord Lothick’s name. I have seen him today. He is extraordinary. These two are your daughters. They are so beautiful and elegant!”
Lothick was flattered: “Thank you, thank you.”
Krodi smiled as he looked at dean and Aisha: “Who are these two?”
Lothick replied: “They are the children of my relatives. They are coming to see me.”
KRODI frowned: “Alright, please go ahead.”
Lothick was relieved as he saw Dudian agree. He brought Dudian into the main hall.
Rosik and Luoya who were born in noble families couldn’t help but take a deep breath as they entered the hall. They couldn’t help but look shocked. It was too magnificent, the main hall was very spacious. It could accommodate thousands of people. It was like a small square. There were more than ten large tables. There was a lot of champagne and a large number of plates, there was a row of chefs who specialized in serving food and maids who were shuttling back and forth in the banquet.
The crystal lamps were hanging above their heads. They were arranged in an orderly manner. The atmosphere was exquisite. The two women held their breath.
Dudian saw this scene. He suddenly thought of the village that he had met on the outermost edge of the giant wall. It was old and muddy. There were also starving villagers. He sighed in his heart. He didn’t sympathize with those people. There was no need to.., there was only a faint regret. He couldn’t say why he regretted it. Maybe it was because of this polarization phenomenon. He clearly hated it, but he couldn’t change it. Or maybe he saw through it and agreed.., and became one of them.
While Dudian’s thoughts were drifting, a voice suddenly sounded from behind him.
“Get out of the way!”
The voice was rough and full of dignity.
Dudian turned his head and saw that Lothick had already entered the main hall of the banquet with his two daughters. Only he and Aisha who were holding his arm were standing at the door.
However, the main hall was very spacious. The door was naturally spacious enough to accommodate seven or eight people. Dudian wasn’t standing in the middle of the hall. There were five or six people who spoke to him. If they weren’t walking side by side.., he did not have to make way.

chapters.title: Chapter 891
chapters.content:
Chapter 891 – Chapter 880: Participate
Dudian suddenly remembered that many years ago, when he was a scavenger, he attended a low-class banquet organized by Mellon Consortium as a scavenger. At that time, he was reprimanded, although he was full of anger, but he could only swallow his anger and retreat to the side. He didn’t expect to see the same scene again after so many years.
The difference was that he was no longer the Scavenger who was easily controlled by others.
However, the same thing was that he had changed, but the world had not changed.
“Which family are you from?”The person who spoke was a tall middle-aged man. His clothes were gorgeous and elegant. At a glance, he looked very elegant. His square face and thick eyebrows had a bit of dignity. He slightly frowned when he saw that Dudian didn’t respond, he spoke again.
Dudian came back to his senses and quietly looked at him. He didn’t say anything and didn’t kill anyone. He held Aisha’s hand and walked into the main hall.
“You…”the middle-aged man was angry. He didn’t expect that he would be ignored by a junior. He wanted to scold him but Dudian had already turned away. If he scolded him again, it would be rude to raise his voice, he coldly snorted: “Nowadays some people’s upbringing is getting worse and worse. They don’t respect their elders!”
“Lord Vero is right. The younger generation is getting more and more rude. Don’t be angry with these juniors. It’s not worth it.”Someone tried to persuade him.
“Good, good. Let’s enter.”
“The banquet is about to begin.”
The others immediately changed the topic and broke the awkward atmosphere.
Vero’s cold face softened a bit but he secretly remembered Dudian’s face. He wanted to embarrass himself in front of everyone, it would be best if his parents personally sent him to apologize!
His expression quickly returned to normal. He smiled: “Everyone Please. I don’t know if the Lord of the Rose is present.”
“The main hall is really big. It is worthy of being the home of the Lord of the Rose.”The people next to him exclaimed.
The few of them went into the main hall. Soon they were attracted by the magnificence of the main hall. It seemed that nothing had happened before.
Dudian took two sips of champagne from the table after he entered the main hall. The taste was good. He took some exquisite snacks and sat down in the next lounge area. There was a sofa and several sets of sofas surrounded a table, there were only seven or eight young people sitting in the rest area. It seemed that their parents had brought them here to play.
Their parents were busy making friends at the banquet. This kind of aristocratic banquet was a place to socialize. It could expand their network and increase their reputation. The most important thing for the nobles was their face in addition to resources, if they were invited, they could at least say that they had attended the banquet held by the Lord of the Rose. From the side, they could tell others that their relationship with the Lord of the Rose was not shallow.
If someone wanted to attack them, they might have to consider the lord of the rose behind them.
Dudian took the snacks and found an empty table. He ate while looking at the groups of nobles in the splendid hall. He looked at one of them and quickly moved away, he continued to eat his snacks in boredom.
“Hi, how are you? Is it convenient for me to sit here?”A handsome voice came from the side.
Dudian looked up. It was a blonde youth. He looked to be in his early twenties. He was very young and had a bright smile.
“It’s not convenient.”Dudian looked back and replied.
The young man was stunned. He didn’t expect that Dudian would answer like this. Most people would find a reason even if they didn’t want to. For example, someone would come. But Dudian didn’t even bother to find a reason, it didn’t seem like it, but it was!
The corner of the young man’s mouth twitched. He smiled and said: “This place is empty. I will sit and leave.”He pulled out a chair and sat down, his eyes quickly turned to Aisha who was next to him. Although Aisha was wearing a veil, but the thin veil could not cover the outline of her face. It was obvious that she was a beautiful woman.
Moreover, this kind of hazy feeling made people curious and wanted to explore.
“Is this your female companion?”The youth looked at him and turned to ask Dudian. There was a trace of expectation in his eyes. He hoped that Dudian would answer no. If it was just his sister or sister, he might have hope.
Dudian heard his words. The calm expression on his face suddenly disappeared. There was only coldness left as he said: “Get Out!”
The youth was tongue-tied. He looked at Dudian as if he had seen a ghost. He was just asking. Even if it was your female companion, she wouldn’t be so angry, right? The kind smile on his face quickly disappeared. He frowned: “I’m just asking. If you have offended me, you can tell me. There is no need…”
“I said, Get Out!”Dudian turned his head and looked at him.
The youth’s face turned red. Anger rushed from his chest to his head. But when Dudian stared at him, he suddenly felt a chill. The pores on his body tightened. He couldn’t describe what he felt, but he felt fear in his heart. It was a very real fear!
His face changed for a moment. He gritted his teeth and got up: “Which Lord are you from?”
“Get Out!”Dudian didn’t even bother to look at him.
The youth clenched his fist and stared at Dudian. He turned around and left. Even if Dudian didn’t say anything, he would be able to find out. After all, it wasn’t a difficult matter.
The people at the other tables had noticed the movement of the youth. They began to whisper when they saw the youth leave dejectedly.
Dudian knew the identity of the young man. He was the youngest son of a famous noble lord. He was too lazy to listen to them, if it wasn’t troublesome then he would have solved it.
Dudian sat for half an hour. The main hall slowly closed and the banquet began.
At this time, Dudian saw the famous Rose Lord. She was a woman in her early thirties. Her temperament was elegant and noble. She was a bit cold and charming. It was easy for people to have a primitive desire to conquer her.
There were two guards next to the Rose Lord. They were wearing low-key armor. However, the heat waves in their bodies were not hidden. They were all masters!
Dudian’s eyes narrowed. He noticed that the two guards were also looking at him. They looked away after they saw Dudian’s appearance.
Dudian knew the reason why they were looking at him. The nobles in the main hall only brought their children and family. They didn’t bring guards, let alone weapons. This was a banquet and not a meeting hall, if anyone brought guards into the hall, they wouldn’t give face to the lord of the Rose. However, there were three or four lords who brought guards. These guards were pioneer level experts who were mixed in the crowd, they weren’t eye-catching.
But through the heat source, they could see that Dudian was also a guard brought in by a noble.
After a series of polite greetings, the lord of the Rose said a few things. It had nothing to do with the ice worm and the abyss. It was about the construction of the king’s city and the construction of the new city. The construction of the new city required the efforts of many noble lords, there were benefits to the efforts. After the new city was built, the nobles could choose the most prosperous areas in the city. Once they occupied good areas, they could open shops, the wealth brought to these nobles was endless.
Dudian heard the Rose Lord talk about the construction of the new city in detail. It seemed that he didn’t mention anything else. He couldn’t help but frown. Could it be that the rumors that Lothick had heard earlier were just rumors?
His eyes flashed as he quietly sat and ate his snacks. He didn’t leave on the spot. Since he was here, he wasn’t in a hurry to leave.
The atmosphere of the banquet was harmonious with the melodious music and the songs of the poets. In the blink of an eye, it was evening. Lothick suddenly came to Dudian’s side, he whispered: “Mr. Dean, do you want to participate in the matter of the Polar Ice Worm?”
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “How?”
Lothick saw Dudian’s expression and knew what he meant, he whispered: “If you want to participate then I can ask for a place from the Rose Lord. This time the new city is to select a place to participate. However the Rose Lord’s intention is very clear. If there are no free money and resources then you can leave. You see many lords have left the banquet. The ones who are staying are the ones who want to participate.”
Dudian looked up at Rosik. He saw that Rosik didn’t seem to be lying. Dudian looked at the Rose lords who were chatting with the noble lords. He thought for a moment and said: “Yes, but I want to hear the details.”
Rosik was relieved, he replied: “Of course. Since Mr. Dean has agreed then I guess the Rose Lords will talk about this matter when the banquet is about to end. At that time Mr. Dean will know what is going on. I don’t know what is going on. But I got the news from other sources. If you want to participate then you might have to send people above the pioneer level. So if Mr. Dean wants to participate then I hope you can represent me…”
Dudian knew what he was thinking: “You don’t have to worry about this. I Won’t go back on my words if things are similar to what I thought.”
Rosik looked at him and nodded. He turned around and left. He mixed into the crowd and began to chat with people.
The banquet was about seven o’clock in the evening. There were less than one-third of the people left in the hall. Dudian glanced at the people who had asked him to make way.

chapters.title: Chapter 892
chapters.content:
Chapter 892 – Chapter 882: Message From The Abyss [ First Update ]
“Everyone, please be quiet. Miss Hillman has something to say.”At the end of the banquet, a middle-aged man dressed as a tuxedo butler appeared and attracted everyone’s attention.
Everyone who had gathered in small groups to chat immediately stopped and knew that the main event had begun.
Under everyone’s gaze, the Rose Lord, who looked to be in her early thirties, smiled faintly, she said, “Regarding the construction of the new city, the lords who are interested can come over in three days to discuss it in detail. Today, we have another matter to discuss. Speaking of which, we were also entrusted by Mr. Horani to pass on the message.”
Hearing this, although everyone had long received the news, they could not help but exclaim in surprise.
There were many people called holani, but there was only one person who could be addressed as Holani by the Rose Lord. That was one of the three abyssal powerhouses, Ghost Shadow, Holani. She was also the founder of the Ryan Chamber of Commerce. Hearing her name now.., everyone knew that the news they had heard earlier wasn’t groundless. For a moment, many people had thoughts in their hearts, and their eyes flashed.
“The Ghost Shadow Hunting Group under Mr. Holani has recently found traces of the polar ice worm at the outer edge of the magic pit swamp area outside the giant wall. I don’t need to introduce what the polar ice worm is to everyone, right? This time, our rose family sent a message on behalf of Mr. Holani. Currently, Mr. Holani is preparing a hunting group of 10,000 people who are at the level of beheading. He is preparing to explore the magic pit of the swamp and look for the polar ice worm.”
Hikari looked around the hall with an elegant smile on her face. She knew that her family’s prestige would increase after the end of the banquet. After all, she was able to build a friendship with an abyss lord, it was enough to make the other families who coveted them to be scared.
Dudian guessed the identity of this Holaney. It seemed that the rumors that Rosik and others had heard were intentionally spread by the Rose Lord.
“The lords who are willing to participate will not only have the opportunity to gain the friendship of Mr. Holaney but will also be rewarded by Mr. Holaney. Of course, they will also receive the friendship and cooperation of our rose family.”Hikari saw that many lords were moved, she smiled in her heart. It was a rare opportunity to work for the Abyss. They would pass the message on their behalf.
Although she was already a grand duke and had a higher status than 99% of the people present, the Lords that had stayed until now were not small characters. The economic and trade cooperation that she usually had could also bring her huge benefits.
“Miss Hikari, can we just send people out?”Someone immediately asked.
The others also looked at Hikari, their eyes burning with passion.
“If you want to participate, you only need to send 10,000 beheading level hunters to participate immediately.”Hikari lightly smiled, “Of course, the more hunters participate, the greater the benefits will be. This time, our rose family is prepared to send two rulers, five demon generals, and ten 10,000 beheading level experts to help Mr. Horani obtain the extreme ice insect!”
Everyone was in an uproar, their faces filled with shock.
Although they knew that the rose family was very strong, they didn’t expect to dispatch so many people to participate. Just two rulers were of endless value, and they were also the foundation of the Rose family’s standing in the ranks of large families. One had to know that.., even if a lord like Lothick dug out all of his assets, he could only nurture one demon general. However, the rose family had five demon generals and two rulers, not to mention ten ten ten thousand beheading level experts, once such manpower was lost, the blow to the rose family would plummet. They might instantly fall from a large family in the capital to a small-to-medium-sized lord that was slightly better than Lothick.
Moreover, once the rose family was weak, the businesses under them would be a huge piece of meat. The competitors who had coveted them for a long time might take the opportunity to devour them. At that time, it was unknown whether the rose family’s flag could continue to fly in the wind.
“Miss Hikari, what if the search fails?”Someone asked worriedly.
Hikari looked at the person who spoke and smiled, “This time, Mr. Holani will personally lead the team. There is basically no possibility of failure. Even if it fails, Mr. Holani will give corresponding compensation and at the same time receive Mr. Holani’s protection. If it succeeds, the benefits will be even greater. I think there is no need for me to say anything more. Everyone knows the stakes involved.”
After saying this, everyone looked at each other.
The lords present were all aristocrats who controlled a region. They were different from the hereditary aristocrats in ordinary dynasties. Here, the aristocrats fought over resources. Those who could become lords were all hedonistic sons who relied on hereditary inheritance, everyone thought for a moment and knew how great the benefits were. If they failed, the manpower they sent would be lost, which would be a blow to the family. However, to be able to receive the protection of Holani, one could only say that it was a win-win situation.
If they succeeded, Holani would be able to obtain the polar ice bug, and his strength would increase even further. He might even be able to surpass the other two great abysses, and might even be able to stand on equal footing with the wall master. In this way, as the ones who contributed.., they could naturally be listed as members of Holani’s faction. They would be able to trade with each other, and they would also be able to resist the enemy together. There were too many benefits.
No matter how one looked at it, this was definitely a win-win situation.
A voice was heard as everyone was moved: “Miss Hikari, Mr. Holaney’s ghost hunters and ghost sabers are full of talented people. Why do you want us to participate?”
Hikari glanced at the man, “Good question. The reason is very simple. Mr. Holaney’s two divisions are restricted by the wall master so they can not be fully used. Secondly, if we can get the polar ice worm this time, Mr. Holaney’s strength will be further improved. At that time, we will naturally expand the business circle. This time we will let everyone participate. It is also an assessment. In the future, the people who participate will become people in the business circle established by Mr. Holaney. I Won’t mention the benefits. Everyone will think about it.”
Many people whispered to each other.
Dudian was deep in thought. Could the polar ice worm make the Abyss go further? In other words, the Abyss was not the end of the abyss. There was a stronger existence above the abyss. The polar ice worm was similar to the god’s marrow. It could increase the power of the abyss.
It seemed that the more the better.
At the thought of that, he became even more determined to participate this time. He could travel to the divine kingdom at any time, but the polar ice bugs were extremely rare. If he had not accidentally obtained one from the Amelia tribe.., he was still unable to become an abyss. He thought about the giant wall of Sylvia. Such a large divine wall, but in the past hundreds of years, there was only one abyss, and Aristotle’s daughter had not even become a ruler.
It was not stupid. In fact, the current evolution system was no different from talent. Talent could only be used in combat. What life needed was nutrients, even if it was a cripple or even a retard, as long as there were magic marks and God’s marrow, they could still be piled into pioneers. However, Aristotle could not make his daughter become the second abyss in the giant wall. It was clear how difficult it was to get the polar ice bugs!
Every time Aristotle left the giant wall, it would be five or ten years. Did he not want his daughter to become an abyss? Could he suppress the other forces in the giant wall after he left?
Unfortunately, he did not have the polar ice worm. Even if he went to the God’s kingdom, he could not get it. It was clear how precious this thing was!
However, it made sense when he thought about it. One polar ice worm could create an abyss. Even if it was a mountain of gold, he might not be able to buy it!
“Miss Hikari, my family is willing to participate. I will send two generals and five ten thousand people to assist Mr. Holaney!”Someone in the crowd shouted.
Everyone looked at the person who spoke. They were secretly speechless. Two generals. This was a big deal!
The others took the lead.
Rosik slowly came to Dudian’s side: “Mr. Dean, are we going to participate?”
Dudian looked at him, he asked: “I don’t think this matter can be hidden from the abyss. The other two most likely know that since he is not afraid of the news being leaked. He is determined to pull you out. Either he has ulterior motives or he has difficulties. Do you know what the situation is?”

chapters.title: Chapter 893
chapters.content:
Chapter 893 – Chapter 883: Eve [ Second Update ]
Lothick’s eyes narrowed. He didn’t think that Dudian would consider this. He pondered for a while, he whispered: “I have some guesses. Although Mr. Holaney is from the Abyss but his relationship with the other Lord of the Abyss is poor. He is relying on the middle of the wall to mediate. It seems that he doesn’t want to rely on his own guards. It seems that he doesn’t want to lose too much of his own guards.”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he nodded.
Although Lothick’s words were a bit strange but he could understand that there was no room for two tigers in one mountain. If the two Abyss had conflicts with each other then they couldn’t personally take action. At this time they had to rely on their underlings to fight for their reputation, if their underlings were too weak and were defeated by the other party’s underlings then they would lose face.
If they invited Lothick and the other lords to participate then they would sacrifice themselves. It wouldn’t affect Holaney. As for protection, it was just a matter of words to him.
One word could make countless lords willing to work for him. This was influence. It was a very worthwhile deal.
Moreover, since the banquet was held, it meant that the news of the polar ice worm couldn’t be hidden. Therefore, this Lothick didn’t deliberately conceal it.
Dudian said: “Then participate. How many people do you plan to send?”
Rosik’s face flashed with embarrassment: “Mr Dean You are joking. You know that I am just a small lord. If it wasn’t for you I would have quit.”
Dudian understood what Rosik meant: “You have guts. Let me help you. Later you will sell to Holaney. This deal is worth the loss of a supplicant right?”
Rosik hurriedly said: “Mr Dean, I have no such intention. Don’t take offense if you don’t want to…”
Dudian waved his hand to interrupt rosik: “Of course I will participate. If it wasn’t for the fact that you are still useful then your life would have been lost.”
He was very straightforward. In fact he didn’t need to modify his words.
Rosik’s face turned pale but he was relieved as he thought of Dudian’s terrifying power: “Thank You Mr. Dean. I will urge the temple to get magic marks for you as soon as possible.”
Dudian waved his hand but didn’t want to say anything.
Rosik saw that Dudian didn’t intend to get angry. He slowly retreated into the crowd and waited for the others to sign up. He opened his mouth to sign up.
This kind of action was considered the most stingy among all the lords. However many people recognized Lothick. They didn’t say anything as they saw that he had the courage to participate.
After a moment everyone began to participate in the banquet. The people who were planning to observe the situation chose to give up after some consideration.
Hikari listened to the butler beside her reporting the news to her in a low voice, and a hint of satisfaction appeared on her face, she said in a clear voice, “Lord Holani will be leaving the day after tomorrow.
