Everyone, please gather your men tomorrow. This exploration outside the giant wall is no small matter. I hope that you can send your most capable elites. If you can get Mr. Holani’s appreciation or help him, you might be able to receive Mr. Holani’s recommendation in the future. There are many benefits. Don’t miss such a great opportunity.”
Everyone laughed in agreement. However, they were all thinking of sending their most elite subordinates? In their dreams. What kind of place was the swamp magic pit? Although no one had ever left the giant wall, they had long heard of it. Even if they stepped into the abyss, they might encounter danger. This was also the reason why some people chose to give up, if horaini also fell into the abyss, then this investment would obviously be a loss.
Although the Abyss was strong, but it was not invincible. Moreover, it was an adventure in the swamp.
Hikari finished talking about the exploration outside the giant wall. After some small talk, the banquet officially ended.
Hikari invited all the participants to stay in the Rose Manor. As for those who left, they went back to their homes to find their mothers.
Dudian and Rosik left together with the other lords and stayed in the Rose Manor.
Most of the Lords stayed behind because they wanted to make friends with the Grand Duke of Rose. At the same time, they wanted to visit the rose manor or to meet some big figures. In any case, many lords chose to stay.
Dudian returned to the room arranged by the housekeeper’s assistant. He used his X-ray vision to observe the entire Rose Manor. The area was very large and there were many servants. Knights and squires were scattered around the manor like stars, most of the knights and squires were hunters. There were a few teams of about a hundred people who were at the boundary level. There were more than thirty pioneer level experts and they were scattered around the manor.
These people were obviously not the full strength of the rose family. After all, the Rose Manor was located in the middle of the king’s city. The number of troops that could be stationed there was not too much. Their real private territory was the base camp.
However, the number of experts here was enough to kill Rosik hundreds of times.
Dudian saw seven or eight masters and three Masters of the Wasteland!
The rose family sent two masters to lead the exploration. There was still one left. Moreover, there was likely to be a master in their private territory. From this point it could be seen that the rose family was one of the most powerful lords.
In the past, Dudian would feel pressure. However, he didn’t feel anything when he sensed the presence of the three masters. After he broke into the abyss, his perception of the masters had become very weak, although he hadn’t fought with other masters but the power of evolution had made him ignore the ordinary masters from the depths of his heart. In his senses, let alone three masters, even if there was a zero behind.., he might not even be able to take them seriously.
This did not mean that he could easily defeat the combined attacks of thirty rulers. If these rulers were all offensive, perceptive, or defensive types, he would have the confidence to defeat them head-on. However, if some rulers were adept at ambushes.., sneak attacks and poison, then even if he was an abyss, he would not be able to escape unscathed.
The reason why he didn’t care was that if there were thirty masters, although he might not be able to face them head on, but if he wanted to leave, they might not be able to stay!
After understanding the strength of the Rose Manor, Dudian hugged Aisha to sleep. The next day, Dudian took Aisha out of the Rose Manor. When he went out, he met Rosik. Rosik greeted him and went out shopping.
Rosik saw that Dudian was so relaxed. He smiled and told him to come back early.
After leaving the Rose Manor, Dudian went straight to a street. Along the way, he admired all kinds of strange things sold in the shops on the street. He followed the smell and slowly approached the target.

chapters.title: Chapter 894
chapters.content:
Chapter 894 – Chapter 884: Exposure
“Lord Vero, all the jewelry here was made by master Dylan. Take a look, the color of this gemstone…”in a luxurious and resplendent shop on the street, a few people with extraordinary bearing were casually looking at the jewelry inside the counter. The light of the Emerald Diamond was reflected by the mirror on the wall, making people dazzle.
Vero looked at them casually. Although the ornaments here were claimed to be made by master Dylan, how many of them were actually made by him? However, even if it was just one, it could still carry the name and attract many wealthy people.
While the few of them were casually looking, they didn’t notice that a handsome man and beautiful woman were slowly walking by outside the street.
Whoosh!
The sound of air being torn apart was suddenly heard.
The face of a burly young man standing next to vero suddenly changed. He quickly turned around and raised his hand, but he felt a cold sensation on his crotch. It was as if a strong wind had blown past. His face turned even paler, but soon, he heard a scream coming from behind him, it instantly woke him up. He quickly turned his head and saw that Lord Vero, who was choosing a crystal pendant by the counter, had actually fallen to the ground. He couldn’t stop screaming and moaning.
“There’s an assassin!”The burly young man felt a chill in his heart. This place was very close to Rose Manor. Who would dare to ambush him here?
He couldn’t care less and quickly activated his demon body. In the blink of an eye, he turned into a lizard-like monster in the shape of a human and stood straight on the spot. The sharp lizard head stuck out its tongue. Although the outline of its face was human-like.., it didn’t give off a familiar feeling. Instead, it was even more terrifying.
The screams of women could be heard from inside the jewelry shop. Everyone left the vicinity of the burly young man. Some of them turned around and ran out of the shop.
The guards outside the shop heard the commotion and hurried over. The scene immediately turned into a mess.
The people outside the street heard the commotion inside. They were afraid of causing trouble, so they quickly stepped aside and retreated to the side of the road.
The burly young man narrowed his eyes. He couldn’t care less about the contemptuous and terrified gazes from the people around him. He quickly looked around the crowd, looking for the assassin who had launched the sneak attack.
At this moment, the guards from the shop arrived. The experts behind the shop also appeared. They came to Vero’s side and saw that his right knee was bleeding non-stop. Some of them quickly helped him stop the bleeding while also checking his injuries.
Soon, a copper coin was taken out from Vero’s knee. It was the copper coin that pierced through Vero’s knee and embedded in it.
Seeing that the copper coin was not poisonous, the expert of the shop was relieved. He immediately ordered people to send vero to treatment.
..
On the street, Dudian held Aisha’s hand as if nothing had happened as they continued to go shopping. He felt that he was very merciful. It was good that he didn’t directly take Vero’s life.
He didn’t pay attention to the follow-up situation. He didn’t want his mood to be ruined by such a small role.
It was a rare leisure time. Dudian took Aisha’s shops to play. There were some famous places in the king’s city such as Fountain Square, Crystal Garden and so on.
Dudian was a bit tired after the day. He found that the energy consumed by shopping was not inferior to fighting. He couldn’t help but smile bitterly in his heart. He looked at Aisha who was still as quiet as a virgin. He sighed in his heart, but he quickly picked himself up and said: “I bought a lot of things today. Let’s go back. The two sets of clothes should fit you well. Let’s go back and change them. What do you think?”
Aisha’s expression was calm and indifferent.
Dudian slightly pursed his lips and led her back to Rose Manor.
On the way back, he heard the Lord talk about Lord vero being attacked and injured. But for the time being he hadn’t found out who the murderer was. But some people guessed that the other Abyss had received the news and came to warn him.
Because of Lord Vero’s injury there was a tense atmosphere in the manor.
Dudian didn’t expect that his casual lecture would cause such a reaction. He went back to his room and closed the door. He took out all the jewelry, snacks and other things from the bag and piled them on the table, he handed them to Aisha one by one.
In the blink of an eye, two days passed.
The lords in the manor began to gather in the training field behind the Rose Manor. The injured Lord Vero was limping. His legs were wrapped with white gauze and he was holding a cane, however, the number of guards around him increased from one to three. Seeing this scene, the lords who did not have a good relationship with him secretly held back their laughter. Some of them directly went forward and teased him, causing Willow’s face to turn black.
”… Lords, please send your elites forward to register.”After exchanging greetings, Hikari went straight to the point. At this time, the other lords whispered to the guards. The guards stood up and lined up to register.
“Mr. Dean…”Lothick looked at Aisha. He didn’t think that Dudian would bring her to such an occasion.
“Both of US will participate in the registration in your name.”Dudian directly said. He held Aisha’s hand and went forward to register.
In addition to their names, they were required to write their magic marks on the registration form. According to Hikari, this form would be handed over to Mr. Holaney so that they could be assigned responsibilities.
Dudian thought for a moment and wrote the name “Hundred Executioner”on his magic marks.
This was the name of a legendary monster. Its ability was similar to the splitter and it was also good at attacking. However, it didn’t have the ability to fly. Its weakness was very obvious. It was ranked below the top twenty.
Dudian also wrote a name for Aisha’s magic marks. It was also an attack type monster so that they wouldn’t be separated from Aisha.
Hikari smiled as she looked at the crowd: “I have good news for everyone. Today, Mr. Holaney will come to the scene!”
Whoosh!
The crowd was boiling. Many of the Lords exclaimed in excitement.
Dudian returned to Rosik’s side and sat down. Rosik and Loya knew that Dudian would represent their family. Their attitude towards Dudian had become much friendlier, especially Rosik, although she didn’t like Dudian in her heart, but she no longer looked at him.
“Mr. Holaney is coming over.”
“Tut Tut, the last time I saw Mr. Holaney was when he was crowned Duke William!”
The lords whispered.
At this time, Hikari suddenly felt something. She looked up and saw two black shadows appear in the sky. The shadows were elongated under the Sun’s light. Soon some people noticed and exclaimed, the others looked up and the exclamations became louder.
“Oh my God! Miss Monica is here too!”
“Why is she here?”
Everyone was surprised. All the Lords couldn’t help but stand up. No one dared to sit down.
Dudian’s heart felt depressed when he saw the appearance of the two people. His face slightly sank. It felt like a dense space was suddenly filled with things.
He retracted his eyes as he didn’t want to attract attention.
“Eh?”Monica who was in her early twenties suddenly looked down at the crowd. Her face was a bit surprised.
Holaney who was next to him saw her appearance: “What’s Wrong?”
“It’s a bit strange. eh?”Monica suddenly exclaimed. This time she was even more surprised. She looked at a woman wearing a purple veil: “Undeads? How is that possible!”
“Undead?”Holaney was very sensitive to these two words. Her face slightly changed as she followed her gaze, “It is indeed the smell of undead.”
Dudian saw that the two looked at him and knew that Aisha was exposed. He sighed in his heart. The sensitivity of the Abyss was indeed not to be ignored. He was just holding on to the idea of trying and hoping to hide it, but now it seemed that he was dreaming.
He thought of the last time when he was outside the giant wall. The Abyss had seen through Aisha’s identity and the two of them were the same. Dudian was a bit depressed. However, he and Aisha were inseparable. Since they had been seen through.., he couldn’t pretend to be a pig and eat a tiger. He didn’t care. At most he would be able to cooperate and suffer a bit more.
Monica and Holani whispered to each other as they slowly landed beside Hikari.
“Mr. Holani, Miss Monica!”There was a trace of surprise on Hikari’s face as she looked at Monica. She didn’t expect that she would come over.
Holani gently smiled: “Miss Monica wants to go with you. Don’t be surprised. is everyone here?”
“Everyone is here.”Hikari replied.
Hoolaney nodded. No one dared to speak. There was only reverence and respect on their faces. Hoolaney looked at dudian, he whispered: “Sir, is the female companion next to you an undead?”

chapters.title: Chapter 895
chapters.content:
Chapter 895 – Chapter 885: Level
“Undeads?”
Everyone was shocked as they looked in Dudian’s direction. They saw the woman sitting quietly by his side. She didn’t move at all. They felt a strange and inexplicable chill.
Since it was Holani who spoke, it wasn’t as simple as asking. Seven or eight lords who were sitting around Dudian got up in a hurry. Some of them were in a hurry and almost tripped on the legs of the chair, however, no one laughed at him. They looked at Dudian and his female companion.
“Are they undeads?”Rosik who was sitting next to Dudian almost fell onto the grass. He looked at Dudian in horror. He saw that Dudian’s expression was calm as if he had acquiesced. There was no intention to explain, rosik wanted to get away from Dudian but he was afraid that this move would anger dudian. He was frozen in place.
“What is her identity? Do I need to answer you?”Dudian’s eyes were calm as he looked at holani: “You just need to know that she is my female companion.”
Holani slightly raised his eyebrows. He didn’t expect that Dudian would be so arrogant. But he thought of Monica’s previous words which she whispered to him. In addition to Dudian’s attitude and tone, it was obvious that.., dudian tacitly admitted that his female companion was an undeads. He didn’t argue. Moreover, he didn’t seem to be afraid of catching her.
His eyes slightly narrowed as he knew that Monica’s guess was most likely true. However, he was the abyss. His attitude alone was enough to scare him, it was a bit self-deceiving.
He glanced at the lords around him. He looked at dudian: “You are not from here right?”
Dudian indifferently said: “Yes, I am from another wall.”
Dudian knew that he could no longer hide his identity when Aisha’s identity was exposed. However, even if he was exposed, he wasn’t worried about his own safety.
Dudian’s words made the lords who wanted to scold Dudian choke. They were shocked as they looked at dudian. They didn’t expect that there was someone from the other giant wall sitting next to them, although they didn’t like to leave the giant wall but they knew that the environment outside the giant wall was very dangerous. If they could cross the giant wall to come here, wouldn’t they be Abyss Walkers?
While the other lords were puzzled, Holaney smiled: “I don’t know why you are here.”
“I’m just passing by. I heard that you know about the polar ice worm so I want to inquire about it. I think that you have gathered so many cannon fodder to help you explore the way outside the giant wall. Most likely you are not confident enough to get the polar ice worm. How about we cooperate and whoever can find it will get it. How about it?”Dudian calmly looked at Holaney and Monica, there wasn’t the slightest bit of tension.
The confident appearance of Dudian made Holani and Monica frown. After all, they were two abyss but Dudian was alone. He dared to be so arrogant in a one-on-two situation. Moreover they felt that.., dudian was aware of the situation inside the giant wall. At least he knew that the master of the giant wall hadn’t arrived yet. There were three abyss on their side!
However, it seemed that Dudian didn’t care about it.
Was his magic marks ability good at escaping?
Or was his strength beyond the ordinary abysses?
The expressions of Holaney and Monica turned serious as they thought of the two points. It would be fine if the first one was good at escaping. But if the second one was good at fighting then it would be very difficult.
They looked at each other for a while. Monica shook her head as she looked at Dudian.
Dudian sighed as he saw the softness in her eyes. He wanted to test Dudian but Monica refused to cooperate. There were many suzerains who attacked Dudian, it was inevitable that the suzerains would be affected. After all, if the suzerains died there would be chaos in their territory.
The war would bring a large number of innocent civilians casualties. Horeni didn’t care about this. He would normally consider it but he was too lazy to care about it in this special situation, however Monica wasn’t willing. If Dudian was the second possibility then he would be at a disadvantage.
“Since your excellency knows this news, I have nothing to say. But we found this thing first. Why should we cooperate with you?”Holaney coldly said.
The surrounding lords were overlords. They were shocked to see Holani’s reaction. They couldn’t help but look at Dudian. However the next moment Dudian’s words caused an uproar among the lords.
“I am also an abyss. There is no reason for me to give up this thing. At least you two can’t make me give up even if the wall master comes.”Dudian spoke in a calm tone, although he hadn’t fought with the abyss but he was confident that he wouldn’t lose much. Moreover he was sure that the relationship between the three Abyss wasn’t that close. It was impossible to form an alliance to fight with him. After all.., the polar ice worm was just a piece of information. It was hard to say whether he could get it or not.
“He… He is an abyss?”Lothick looked at Dudian in shock. He thought that he had overestimated dudian but he didn’t expect that Dudian was also an abyss. He was as noble as Holaney!
The other lords were stunned as they subconsciously moved away.
Lothick and Loya were sitting next to Dudian. Their faces were full of shock. Although they had never participated in territorial rule but at least they knew who was the master of this world, lothick’s face turned from red to white as he remembered the words he had said to Dudian.
“So what if we are in the Abyss? Don’t forget that both of us are in a one-on-two situation. Do you think you have a chance to win?”Holaney sneered.
Dudian glanced at him, “Is that so? Why Don’t you attack? Are you afraid of affecting the Lords? Or are you not confident? Or are you not willing to attack alone to avoid getting hurt? “Since you have noticed my female companion before, you should know whether I am one against two. In my opinion, any one of you who is in partnership with me will be the strongest alliance here. What do you think? Think About It?”
Hearing Dudian’s words, Holani and Monica’s faces slightly changed. They looked at Aisha who was next to them. Although they didn’t know why Dudian would let an undead be so obedient as if it was controlled.., but they knew the characteristics of an undead. If an abyss expert deliberately nurtured it, the strength of the undead would be beyond their imagination.
Thinking of this, their hearts trembled.
Holani’s face changed for a moment. He said in a deep voice: “It’s too bad that you want to sow discord between us. No matter who is your partner, you will be defeated in the end.”
“It doesn’t matter as long as the conditions are not bad.”Dudian laughed, “I don’t want to force you. If you want to join me, you can join me at any time. Especially Mr. Holani, I think highly of you. After all, the information about the polar ice worm was found by your hunting group. You know the details. In any case, I think we can discuss about the partnership. What do you think?”
“You two probably don’t want to have a big fight with me here either. It Won’t be good for anyone. As for the Polar Ice Bug, it’s fair who gets it. Besides, it’s one thing to find it or not. Am I right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 896
chapters.content:
Chapter 896 – Chapter 886: Compromise
Horaney and Monica looked calm but their hearts were filled with anger. It was true that Dudian had said that the method of instigation was very bad but the conditions given by Dudian were not bad, they were basically sure that Dudian was an abyss. In addition to the controlled undeads, it was possible that there were two abyss level forces. Moreover, both forces were controlled by the same will!
However, they were different. They couldn’t be 100% united. If the other side secretly cooperated with Dudian, this exploration of the polar ice worm wouldn’t be a big deal. If they used Dudian to plan the situation inside the giant wall.., it would be truly terrifying.
The situation of the three sides inside the giant wall had been formed for many years. Horaney and Monica were close to each other. They were fighting against the giant wall. They knew that no matter who was in trouble.., the giant wall would swallow the remaining one.
But now there was an external force that was stronger than them. It could even contend with the giant wall!
Even if they knew that it was dangerous to partner with Dudian they wouldn’t agree. But they had to say that because of Dudian’s words they were on guard against each other.
Although they were angry but they didn’t have the intention to fight with Dudian on the spot. This was the king’s city. Once they started to fight, the damage would be immeasurable. Moreover, it would be a waste to the wall master.
“Don’t talk about such nonsense. As an intruder, you should leave as soon as possible. Don’t forget that there are not only two of us here. If we fight to the death, you might not be able to win.”
Dudian smiled. He was telling Monica that they were on the same side. He wouldn’t betray them. At the same time, he hoped that Monica wouldn’t be confused. However, he had expected that.., he casually said: “Including the wall master, there are three of you. If you don’t want to cooperate with me, I think I will cooperate with the wall master. I don’t know what kind of rewards I will get if you are excluded.”
The pupils of Holaney and Monica Shrank. Their faces emitted cold air. Monica’s usually calm and gentle face had completely turned cold, “The wall master will not cooperate with you. Instead of cooperating with you it is better to continue to maintain our current situation. Don’t think that you can sow discord between us. You are an intruder with ulterior motives. How could the wall master collude with outsiders to murder his own people?”
“That is true.”Dudian easily agreed with her words. His attitude made Monica frown, dudian continued: “I don’t plan to cooperate with the wall master for the time being. At present I only want to get the polar ice worm. You Two, you are just leading the way. The one who gets it will get it. This matter is very fair. In any case, I am the same as you. Don’t you think that you won’t give me face?”
Hoolani and Monica were relieved to see that Dudian didn’t mention anything about cooperating with the giant wall. They thought about what Dudian said and felt that it wasn’t a big problem. He was just leading the way, even if Dudian was on the same level as them, he would be qualified to participate.
After thinking for a moment, Holaney slowly said: “We need to discuss this matter. We will give you a reply tomorrow.”
Dudian looked at him, “Do you think I am a Fool? In addition, do you have the qualifications to negotiate with me? Don’t forget that this is your old nest. It is not mine. I’m afraid that the wall master will have a headache? Are you really going to force me to make the king’s city unstable?”
Both of their faces slightly changed and their eyes turned gloomy. Indeed, half of the reason they were worried about Dudian was because of this point. If they couldn’t kill Dudian on the spot, then Dudian was in the dark while they were in the open, they could protect themselves, but they might not be able to protect the civilians in the wall, especially the forces under their faction and their own forces.
Other than these, they also had their wives, children, and parents. They were all here.
These family members were their bonds. Although using their family members to threaten them might not really make them lower their heads, they knew that one of them would definitely lower his head!
After all, if the son of the wall master was killed, then the succession of the position of the wall master would be a huge problem!
“Alright, I Promise You. Let’s go now. We will find the polar ice worm together. I will provide clues to whoever finds it.”.
Monica tilted her head and looked at him. Her eyes flashed as she suddenly understood something. She didn’t object but looked at Dudian in silence.
“Smart.”Dudian praised: “Gather the people and get ready to go. If we don’t hurry then the news will reach the ears of that person. Who knows what will happen?”
The corner of Holaney’s mouth twitched: “You don’t need to worry about that.”
He turned to the stunned hikari: “Gather the people and gather at the south gate. The three of us will go over first.”
Hikari was stunned for a few seconds before she replied: “Yes.”She glanced at Dudian who was not far away. Her heart was beating fast. She didn’t expect that there was an abyss lurking in front of her eyes, it was like a poisonous python that was lying in bed.
Vero’s legs were weak and his face was pale. He thought about his words yesterday. His heart was about to explode. The lords who were close to him were far away from him, they were afraid to attract Dean’s attention.
“How should I address you?”Holaney turned to Dudian.
“Dudian.”
“Well, Mr. Dudian, let’s go first. We will prepare at the south gate.”Holaney said.
Dudian nodded and held Aisha’s hand.
Holaney and Monica didn’t say anything more. They wanted to talk to the Lords to appease their hearts. However, Dudian’s previous words of gathering cannon fodder made him not want to say anything more, he just wanted to leave as soon as possible. He wasn’t afraid that the Lords would go back on their words. After all, everyone could see how bad his and Monica’s mood was at the moment. If they got into trouble at this time, they would be asking for trouble.
The two took off and went back the way they came.
The splitter’s sword on Dudian’s back flowed with dark mucus. It formed a branding mark on his back. Soon the branding mark turned into a real object. The wings of the splitter stretched out and overturned the surrounding chairs, with Aisha in his arms, he soared into the sky and soon caught up with Horaney and Monica, leaving only the shocked lords on the ground.
..
..
I sent my wife back to my father-in-law’s house for New Year’s Eve dinner. I happened to be alone in another city, and I don’t have any relatives to visit. I’ll pick up my wife the day after tomorrow when I go to visit my father-in-law. The updates will be the same these two days, and there might be more. It’s almost 12 o’clock, i wish everyone a happy new year and a prosperous year of the dog

chapters.title: Chapter 897
chapters.content:
Chapter 897 – Chapter 887: Huaxia’S Wall [ First Update ]
The eyes of Horaney and Monica swept over the malevolent wings on Dudian’s back. Their eyes slightly flickered. There was no one like this in their wall, apparently it came from the giant wall where Dudian was.
“Mr Dean, you are passing by here. You can tell me where you are going. I am going to a place too. Maybe we are going the same way!”Horaney smiled as Dudian caught up, since he had agreed to cooperate with Dudian, he wouldn’t keep a straight face anymore. It would be more useful to take the opportunity to inquire about Dudian’s situation.
“Where are you going? Why Don’t you tell me? Maybe we are going the same way?”Dudian’s expression was indifferent as he repeated Holaney’s words.
Holaney’s mouth twitched: “Mr. Dean doesn’t want to suffer any losses.”
“Same to you.”Dudian glanced at them: “Your magic marks don’t seem to be from here right?”
“How do you know?”Holaney smiled: “Have you seen all the legendary magic marks here?”
“No, but I have seen the supplicant and the Enchantress.”Dudian said. In fact he hadn’t seen the two magic marks after merging into the human body. But he could infer from their abilities.., dudian wouldn’t be able to understand if he didn’t use the strongest legendary magic marks.
Moreover he knew that Abyss walkers could cross other giant walls or even go to the Kingdom of God. It wasn’t difficult to get non-local magic marks. After all, if they lived in the local area and used local magic marks, it was inevitable that they would be targeted, every magic mark had its weakness. However, if they used legendary magic marks from other areas, their abilities would be unknown. Ordinary people wouldn’t be able to target them!
Hoolani raised his eyebrows. He knew what Dudian meant. He didn’t deny it: “Mr. Dean, if you are interested, we can exchange magic marks information. How about it?”
“Alright.”Dudian quickly agreed.
Hoolani stared at Dudian for a while and laughed: “Forget it. There is no point in talking about this.”
Dudian shrugged his shoulders. The premise of exchanging information was trust. Both sides couldn’t trust each other. This exchange was obviously a joke. Only a fool would tell the other about his real magic marks ability.
“Mr. Dean, which giant wall are you from? Why Don’t you tell me? Maybe we are from the same camp?”Holani looked at dudian.
“Really?”Dudian’s eyes lit up. The same camp? Could it be that the giant wall would form an alliance? At this time, he thought of Aristotle who was going to the Kingdom of God. He suddenly realized that these wall masters would go to the Kingdom of God. Naturally they would have the opportunity to meet and make friends in the Kingdom of God. There were even big figures above them, there would be struggles and factions where there were people. This was the eternal truth.
Dudian asked: “What is the name of your place?”
Holaney saw that Dudian wasn’t willing to take the initiative. He helplessly said: “We are the ‘giant wall of Kagar’. Kagar is the name of our God of war. It represents ‘Courage’in the god of War!” There was a trace of pride on his face. Even if he became an abyss walker, it didn’t prevent him from worshipping the god of war. This was a belief that had been rooted in his soul since he was young!
“Kagar…”Dudian murmured. He didn’t doubt that Holaney would lie to him. After all, he could ask any lord about this kind of thing. But he didn’t pay attention to it and ignored it.
“Mr. Dean, it’s Your Turn.”Holani frowned and urged dudian.
Dudian came back to his senses, “The place I live in is called China. The God of War is the dragon. So we call ourselves the descendants of the Dragon. The Spirit of ‘Dragon’is to strive for self-improvement and fight against all disasters!”
“Huaxia? The God of war is called Dragon?”Holani was startled, he looked at Dudian suspiciously. The name was a bit strange. He had never heard of it but he had heard of many giant walls. So he couldn’t tell if Dudian was lying. But looking at Dudian’s expression.., it didn’t seem like he was lying.
“How is it? Are you an ally?”Dudian interrupted Holani’s thoughts. He didn’t want him to think about it.
Holaney shook her head: “I don’t know. I have to ask the Wall Master.”
Dudian didn’t care. In fact, he didn’t care about allies. He had to stand aside in front of the polar ice worm.
At this time, the three of them had already flown to the south gate of the king’s city. Holaney was the first to glide down. Monica was close behind. She inadvertently pulled a little distance away from Dudian.
Although Monica’s performance was very subtle, but Dudian still felt it. He couldn’t help but look at the back of the woman. He narrowed his eyes and had some thoughts in his mind.
The next moment, he also landed on the south gate of the king’s city.
“Greetings Mr. Horaney!”
“Greetings Miss Monica!”
The guards on the gate saw the two of them and hurriedly bowed their heads to welcome them.
No one recognized dudian and Aisha but they didn’t dare to neglect them. After all, they were people who could follow the two abyss. How could they be simple people?
“Is everyone here?”Holaney regained his calm and natural dignity.
One of them quickly said: “Everyone is here.”
Holaney looked forward and squinted his eyes. He was about to say something when his eyes moved. He and Monica turned around almost at the same time and looked back.
Whoosh!
A figure flew over and landed on the city wall.
The surrounding guards were shocked when they saw the man. They knelt down in panic: “Your subordinate pays respect to the lord of the city!”
Dudian’s eyes focused as he looked at the man who had landed five meters away from him. He was a middle-aged man with a full beard. His strong skin was full of strength. His eyes were bright and his eyebrows were broad. He was full of the dignity of a superior, dudian turned his head and looked at Aisha. There was a deep meaning in his eyes. He looked at Holaney and Monica: “There is no need to be polite. Who Is This?”
Holaney didn’t expect Dudian to come in person. He was shocked but quickly calmed down. It wasn’t strange for him to come. He immediately introduced: “This is Mr. Dudian from Huaxia Temple.”
“Huaxia Wall?”Barker looked at dudian: “What is the purpose of Mr. Dean’s visit?”
Dudian felt that his lie had been seen through. He didn’t feel embarrassed, he calmly said: “I was just passing by. I heard the news about the polar ice worm so I came to inquire about it. I hope that the wall master will fulfill my request. After all, the importance of this thing. Even if I give up, the Wall Master Won’t believe me. So why don’t we work together to overcome the difficulties first? In the end, the one who gets it will be the one who gets it.”
Barker’s eyes flashed slightly, he nodded and said, “That’s true. The treasure belongs to those who are capable. Moreover, this polar ice worm is in the swamp magic pit. With an expert like Mr. Du, it will also have an additional guarantee. I don’t have any objections. Horani, do the two of you agree?”
Horani hurriedly said, “Of course we agree. With Mr. Du joining us, it will be easier to do things.”
Barker nodded slightly and said, “Since that’s the case, let’s set off early.”
“We?”Jolene and Monica were stunned. Their expressions changed slightly, but they quickly returned to normal. Jolene smiled and nodded, “Yes, but there are still some people who haven’t gathered yet. Please wait a moment, Wall Master.”
Barker nodded slightly.
Monica suddenly said, “Wall master, if you want to go with us, isn’t it too dangerous? If anything happens, we still need you to oversee this place!”
Barker looked at her with a gentle face: “I have arranged everything. There is no need to worry.”
Monica’s lips moved as she saw Barker’s confidence. She didn’t try to persuade him.
Hoolani was still smiling but she was cursing in her heart. Originally Barker wouldn’t participate but now he had come to intervene. He didn’t expel Dudian, obviously he wanted to use Dudian to weaken their strength.
He sneered in his heart. He wanted to see who would be weakened in the end!

chapters.title: Chapter 898
chapters.content:
Chapter 898 – Chapter 888: Arrival Of [ Second Update ]
Dudian felt a sense of crisis after Barker’s appearance. However, Barker’s appearance didn’t surprise him too much. When he was exposed, he considered that he would face the joint attack of the three Abyss, he also considered that there were hidden experts of the abyss. He was ready to face four abyss at the same time. From the current situation, Barker didn’t seem to want to participate in the fight. But now he was involved because of his existence, he wasn’t sure what his purpose was.
It was possible that he would join forces with Horaney and Monica to deal with him. There was another possibility that he could get rid of them.
Dudian didn’t continue to think about these possibilities. Plans were never as good as changes. Especially in the situation where the wall was constantly changing. If he was weak then he would be attacked by a group, the only way to ensure his safety was not to get injured.
He slightly pulled away from Barker, Holaney and Monica in case the three of them suddenly launched a sneak attack.
Barker and the other two noticed Dudian’s actions but didn’t say anything. It was normal to have such concerns. If they didn’t then they would be too confident and even stupid.
A moment later, the experts gathered by Hillman arrived one after another. Dudian saw that there were hundreds of pioneer level experts gathered on the plains outside the south gate. There were eight masters and twenty-three experts from the inner wilderness, such a lineup completely crushed the power of Sylvia!
Holani went forward to reorganize. A moment later, a pioneer level team of nearly 500 people was formed. Five masters, including Dudian and Aisha, led the team. Seventeen Masters acted as assistants as they marched out of the giant wall.
“Isn’t it time to share the information about the underpolar ice worm?”Dudian asked Holaney.
Monica and Barker’s eyes lit up. They didn’t seem to hear Dudian’s words.
Holaney looked at them and smiled: “Of course. I will tell you when we get to the giant wall. It is not suitable to discuss here.”
Dudian didn’t say anything as he saw that Holaney agreed.
In less than half an hour they arrived at the giant wall. The pilots and pioneers who had the ability to fly were the first to fly up the giant wall. They threw down the rope to lead the other pioneers.
Dudian, Barker, Holaney and others were the first to climb up the giant wall. They stood at a height of 1,000 meters. The blue sky and white clouds seemed to be close to the giant wall.
Holaney came to the edge of the giant wall. She took out a scroll and spread it on the edge of the platform. It was a map.
Cold Wind Blew. Holaney pressed her palm on the map and pointed to one of the places: “This is the outer edge of the swamp magic pit. This is the southwest part. My hunting group found the trace of the polar ice worm.”
Dudian didn’t get too close in case they suddenly attacked. After all, they were of the same rank. If they were ambushed, it was inevitable that they would be seriously injured or even lose their lives. It was like two adults together, the person who ambushed could kill the other with a brick.
The map was very detailed. It was the first time that Dudian saw such a detailed map of the giant wall. The giant wall stood in the middle of the map. It took up less than one-tenth of the total area of the map, the terrain was divided by different colors. There were gray areas, light red areas, green areas and so on. The place that Horaney pointed to was a black area!
There were a few white letters in the middle of the black area. It was the meaning of the swamp magic pit.
Dudian’s eyes swept over the area. In addition to the swamp magic pit, he also noted down the other areas in the vicinity. At this time, he looked at Barker and Monica, suddenly he said: “Master, you are the Master of a wall. Do you have any suggestions?”
Barker frowned as he saw Dudian’s reaction: “After all, Holaney knows the most details. Let’s listen to what he has to say.”
Holaney’s face slightly changed. He knew that Barker wanted to know the most details from him. He snorted in his heart but was calm on the surface, “The trace of the Polar Ice Worm is at the edge of the swamp magic pit. Everyone knows that the temperature of the center of the swamp magic pit is the lowest. So I think the polar ice worm will go there.” Dudian pressed his finger on the center of the black area.
Monica and Barker frowned but didn’t say anything.
Dudian paid attention to the expressions of the three of them. He pondered for a moment, “Do you have any good suggestions? As far as I know, the deeper the magic pit is, the more dangerous it is. Even if the five of us work together, there is no guarantee that there won’t be any accidents. Do We have to force our way through?”
Holaney indifferently smiled, “Mr. Dean is joking. It’s impossible to force our way through. Even if we have twice the number of people, we will suffer a great loss. Let’s go to the location of the polar ice worm first. Monica will see if she can track the whereabouts of the polar ice worm. If she can find it, then we will follow the route of the polar ice worm. How about that?”
Dudian didn’t speak but looked at Barker and Monica. To be honest, what Holaney said was all nonsense. However, at least there was one piece of information that was revealed. Monica’s ability was related to tracking.
There were two pieces of information derived from this information. Barker and Holaney were not good at tracking.
Tracking could be classified as perception. Those who were not good at perception were good at attack and defense.
Barker saw that Dudian had no objection. He looked at Monica: “Are You Sure?”
Monica slowly nodded: “Let’s try.”
The decision was made. They continued to climb over the giant wall and headed towards the swamp.
Dudian asked for the map from Holani. He looked at it a few times and asked: “What are these regions?”
Holani knew that Dudian wasn’t familiar with the situation so he couldn’t refuse. He casually explained a few sentences. In fact, even if Dudian asked a lord he would know the information on the map. He was too lazy to hide it.
They passed through two large areas. One was a gray area which was close to the giant wall. In this gray area they met many undeads and high-level monsters, occasionally the weaker ones were at the level of a senior hunter.
Fortunately, the lowest level of the group was the pioneers. There were no injuries at all.
After passing through the gray area, they came to a yellow area. The level of the monsters here had obviously increased by a level. Occasionally they would encounter pioneer level monsters. Some of them were good at hiding while others were lurking in the mud, some of them were disguised like stones. Even Dudian couldn’t tell if they were real or fake. Of course, he didn’t look at them carefully. He was prepared to fight in the swamp.
The other masters or generals had seen through the monsters along the way and directly cleaned them up.
There were about 500 people in the team. There were many perceptive experts and their perceptive abilities were strange. Some had special vision, some had special hearing and some had mysterious perception to predict the danger, it was difficult for ordinary monsters to hide in front of such a large team.
After four or five hours of trekking, they finally arrived in front of the swamp magic pit. Dudian clearly felt that the atmosphere in the hunting team had calmed down. The whispers were reduced, as they approached the outer edge of the swamp magic pit, they met a general-level monster. It was like a giant undeads. It directly attacked them and was killed by a master who was leading the way.
“We are here.”Holaney said. He looked up at the lifeless land and occasionally saw the remains of cement buildings. He whispered: “Pass down the order. Everyone should be alert and lurk forward.”
A general next to him immediately passed down his words.
Dark golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes. The radiation concentration in this area was far stronger than other areas. The monsters loved to live in areas with high radiation concentration!
Long term living in the nuclear radiation environment would increase the mutation rate of the monsters. Their growth and reproduction would also increase. The monsters themselves would carry a lot of bacteria and nuclear radiation, nuclear radiation and bacteria would also spread denser. It could be said that they complemented each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 899
chapters.content:
Chapter 899 – Chapter 889:280
While Dudian was observing the situation, Holaney sent out a ten-man vanguard led by a master to explore the swamp.
Ten minutes later, the exploration team sent back the security information. Holaney waved his hand to let the rest of the team follow.
Barker and Monica didn’t have any objections and handed over the command to Holaney. After all, the initiator of this operation was Holaney. The intelligence came from his men, although Barker was a wall master, he couldn’t say anything at the moment. Moreover, the current situation was complicated. He wanted to leave more time for other things.
As for Monica, she didn’t like to stand out. As long as Holaney didn’t make a big command mistake, she didn’t intend to speak.
Dudian also didn’t have the intention to stand out. He wasn’t familiar with the situation here so it was best to hand over the command to them. So the five of them stepped into the swamp with Holaney as the leader.
“Let’s be careful. This is the monster paradise. Most of the monsters are at level 10 or 100. Don’t fall behind.”Holaney told the master.
The master replied and immediately sent the message.
Dudian knew from the top secret information collected by Aristotle that there was more than one magic pit outside the giant wall. However the word “Swamp”was added in front of the magic pit, dudian didn’t see any swamp basin so he couldn’t help but ask Holaney.
Holaney smiled, “The swamp magic pit is not an ordinary swamp but a magic swamp. It is said that there is an extremely terrifying monster in this magic pit. Its body is huge and it can transform into a huge swamp. Anyone who steps into it will die without a doubt. Even the abyss like you and I are no exception. So this place is called the swamp magic pit.”
Dudian was surprised. He didn’t expect the name to come from such a place. He thought that it was full of swamps and wetlands. However, the monster that Horaney mentioned was even more terrifying than the swamps and wetlands. What kind of size was it? What kind of magical structure was it?
Dudian couldn’t imagine but he couldn’t help but think of the strange tree that ate life in the despair forest. Could it be that the monster was on the same level as the despair forest?
Holaney saw that Dudian’s face was changing, “Mr. Dean don’t worry. The pit is very big. The monster has always liked to appear in the south side of the pit. The low-lying terrain is suitable for it to form a swamp basin. We won’t meet it unless we are really unlucky. But even if we meet it the vanguard will send back information in time. By then we will have enough time to retreat.”
Dudian slowly nodded. He thought that he would be able to intimidate the Aragami’s flesh and blood if he met it.
He glanced at Holani. He thought that Dudian wasn’t afraid of the Aragami’s flesh and blood?
Holani’s heart jumped as he saw Dudian’s eyes. was he able to see what he was thinking? Was this his magic marks ability? Was it similar to mind reading?
Horaney quickly rejected the idea. If Dudian really had mind reading, then it wouldn’t be this reaction. Moreover, mind reading was too magical and couldn’t explain the principle. In his opinion, all the magic marks ability.., were based on biological changes, including the illusion of the soul charm. Although it sounded magical, but there were many living beings in the natural world who had this kind of ability. It was something that could be achieved by living beings.
But he didn’t think that such magical abilities such as telekinesis and killing people would exist because no living things had such an ability. It was beyond the range of biological energy and couldn’t be explained.
Dudian didn’t know that the man in front of him was thinking about some strange things. He glanced at him then turned his head as if nothing had happened and continued to move forward.
It was true that this was the monster paradise. Not long after Dudian and the others came in, they were ambushed by monsters one after another. In less than half an hour, more than a dozen pioneers had been killed, the Vanguard team had also collapsed. Only the leader of the team had escaped. He had brought back two giant pythons and was chasing after them.
Everyone saw that there weren’t two giant pythons but a two-headed python. It had a huge body and a thick tree trunk. It crashed into the new tree and flattened it, the old cement foundation that had collapsed in the grass and mud was once again crushed.
“Fire and Ice Dragons!”Holani’s face slightly changed as he saw the two-headed python chasing after them. He didn’t expect to encounter such a troublesome monster. He turned to look at Dudian, “This is a level 280 monster. Master can’t be defeated so we have to rely on our own strength.”
Dudian noticed his words: “Almost”. This meant that master could be defeated. He said: “A level 280 monster shouldn’t need our help right?”
He said casually but he knew that his words were a bit pretentious.
It was the first time that he had heard of such a high-level monster. He didn’t know what stage it would be when it was converted to human level. However, from Holani’s words.., he had a vague guess.
Holani saw that Dudian was so arrogant and smiled wryly, “Although it isn’t level 300 yet but the ice and fire dragons have special abilities. Their strength has been underestimated by a lot. Even if we meet them it will be very difficult to kill them. Especially the perceptive abyss. We might not even be a match for them. We can only rely on us to end the battle as soon as possible. If we hand it over to the other masters then the losses will be too serious. We will make too much noise and attract more terrifying things.”
“Holaney is right. We can only rely on us.”Barker nodded.
Monica glanced at dudian: “If Mr. Dean doesn’t want to take action then we won’t force him.”
“Really? Then I won’t take action.”Dudian indifferently said.
Monica frowned as anger flashed in her eyes. Her hand touched the loose skirt as she took out a silver sword and rushed towards the ice and fire dragons.
Hoolani and Barker didn’t say anything but followed her.
Dudian crossed his arms and watched from the spot.
Hoolani said that it would be difficult to deal with the Beast if the Abyss met alone. But if the three Abyss attacked at the same time, it would be much easier.
Soon, the three of them fought with the ice and fire dragons. The two snake heads of the ice and fire dragons roared in anger and bit towards the three of them. One of the snake heads spat out cold mist while the other one spat out flames, their abilities were exactly the same as their names.
One of them was using a spear while the other was using a saber. They tacitly pincer attacked from both sides. Soon, the flaming snake head was heavily injured while the other snake head that spat out cold mist was held back by Monica and could not provide support for the time being.

chapters.title: Chapter 900
chapters.content:
Chapter 900 – Chapter 890: Molt
Dudian found that the three of them didn’t use their magic bodies. It seemed that they didn’t want to let him know their magic body shape and ability. However, although they didn’t use their magic bodies but the three of them cooperated well, dudian quickly suppressed the fire and Ice Dragons. He wanted to watch a good show but his expectations were disappointed. He only hoped that the monster would be able to turn the tables and at least force out something.
Unfortunately, his hope did not come true. Under the three people’s effortless attacks, the fire and Ice Dragons’flaming snake head was quickly cut off. After dealing with one of the snake heads.., the three of them worked together to attack the remaining snake head that was spewing cold fog. In less than two to three minutes, the head of the snake head was pierced through and killed with a sword.
“Good!”
The large group of onlookers could not help but cheer in a low voice.
Although their voices were somewhat suppressed, the cheers of nearly 500 people were still relatively loud, which scared Horaney and the other two who had just finished their battle. Horaney glared angrily at the people around him and hurriedly shouted in a low voice, “Silence!”
Hearing this, the crowd finally stopped speaking resentfully.
Monica frowned slightly. She raised her silver sword and cut off the fangs in the mouths of the ice and fire dragons, burying them on the spot. Then, she said to Barker and Horaney, “I’ve had enough. The rest is yours.”
Holaney smiled bitterly. What Monica took was the most valuable thing on the ice and Fire Dragons. The four fangs were excellent materials for weapons. They could be forged into weapons with the characteristics of fire and ice, moreover, this weapon was self-poisoned and could numb the nervous system. If it was forged into a weapon, it would definitely be a great killing weapon!
Considering that Monica had contributed the most, Holaney and Barker did not say much. Their low demand for weapons was related to their magic bodies. Once they were demonized, their arms would turn into beasts and they would not be able to hold a sword, unless the weapon was made into a weapon that could be used as a handle after demonizing, it would be useless.
Holani went forward and cut off a few scales from the snake’s head, burying them at the side.
Barker smiled bitterly and said, “The good ones were all taken by you two. You’re really sneaky.”
Holani smiled and said, “Please don’t say that. Even if I give you this thing, I don’t think you would like it. Monica’s is more like it.”
Monica said in a bad tone: “Don’t drag me into this.”
Barker smiled: “Alright, Let’s get ready to go.”
Holaney nodded. The cheers from the crowd were loud. It was inevitable that some monsters would come to the area. They had to evacuate the area.
Dudian didn’t say anything as he saw the three of them share the prey. After all, he didn’t do anything. Moreover, they had buried the prey. It was obvious that they didn’t really care about it, it wasn’t a treasure.
“Mr. Dean, do you want to go up and pick some?”Holaney smiled as she came back to Dudian.
Dudian indifferently replied: “No need.”
Monica glanced at him but didn’t say anything.
They continued to move forward. Soon, they encountered monsters again. They were just a few pioneer level monsters. They were easily killed by the pioneer team. After half an hour, they finally arrived at the place where the polar ice worm appeared.
Holaney pointed to a snake-like slither mark in front of them: “Well, this is the trace of the polar ice worm.”
Dudian, Barker and Monica didn’t wait for him to say anything. They had already looked at the slither mark. The grass around the slither mark was completely frozen. The air was filled with a faint moist and fishy smell.
Dudian looked around. The moisture in the air was thicker. He was familiar with the smell. It was the smell of the crystal desolate worm. He was relieved. He was completely sure that it was the crystal desolate worm, he had absorbed the polar ice worm.
Monica and Barker looked around. After a moment Monica nodded, “This smell is indeed the smell of the polar ice worm. From the concentration it should be less than five days away from here. Moreover this polar ice worm seems to be in the molting stage. I don’t think it will go far.”
Barker was interested: “How do you know that it is in the molting stage?”
“Look carefully. There are wrinkles like scales inside the skid mark.”Monica pointed.
Dudian and Barker looked at the skid mark. It was very smooth on the surface. But after focusing on it for a moment, they could see very fine convex lines. Dudian couldn’t help but look at Monica, could it be that her perception was related to her vision? But looking at her previous fighting skills with the fire and ice dragons, her swordsmanship was sharp and her figure was ethereal. She was not inferior to Holaney and Barker.
Was she hiding something or were they hiding something?
Barker nodded as dudian pondered: “That’s true. Let’s look around. I hope it hasn’t finished molting.”
“Alright.”Holaney said and ordered the master: “Ten people in a team. Organize ten teams to search within fifty miles.”
“Yes.”
After the chief sovereign relayed his orders, horlenny said to Barker, “We can’t stay here for too long. This scent will attract other things. Let’s leave this place as soon as possible. Let’s look ahead.”
“Alright.”
Under Horlenny’s lead, everyone continued to move forward. The ten teams of the main force, a total of a hundred people, spread out in the surrounding area. Once they found traces of the polar ice bugs, they would send out a signal.
Looking at the yellow signal shot out from the ruins, Holaney called for the group to continue to move forward. At the same time, a red smoke bomb rose from the four o’clock direction. It was a warning signal and also a signal for reinforcements.
Holaney’s face slightly changed. He was about to send reinforcements but stopped. His eyes flashed with a trace of gloominess.
Dudian’s heart slightly moved as he saw the change in Barker’s expression: “The team that just went there is in danger. Should we send reinforcements?”
Barker slightly shook his head: “I don’t think so. It seems that the people there are in danger.”
Dudian didn’t care about his ability to expose himself. Monica and Barker knew that his hearing wasn’t his main ability. He was good at attacking. His superior hearing was just a side effect, dudian knew that Hoolani wasn’t a threat to him. He said: “They should have met a big monster. It has gone.”
Dudian asked: “Aren’t we going to avenge them?”
Hoolani’s face turned dark: “The leader of the team is a master. Most of them are level 300 monsters. We shouldn’t provoke it since it has left.”
Dudian replied but didn’t say anything.
Holaney cursed in his heart: are you really stupid or are you playing dumb? He glanced at the surrounding troops. He saw that many of them were scared out of their wits. The fear in their eyes was obvious. He couldn’t help but feel angry. He coldly looked at Dudian and strode forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 901
chapters.content:
Chapter 901 – Chapter 891: Arctic Ice Dragon 1St Update
After following the skid mark for seven to eight minutes, the mark suddenly disappeared.
Horaney seemed to have expected this, and he said to Monica, “My hunting team didn’t find any news when they tracked it here. Can you tell where it went?”
Without waiting for him to ask, Monica had already used her ability to observe the small clues at the end of the skid mark. A moment later, she frowned and said in a low voice, “This thing seems to have been taken away by something else.”
“Taken away?”Holani and Barker’s expressions changed slightly. In the next moment, their eyes flashed as they stared at Monica.
Barker said in a deep voice, “Really?”
Monica knew their guess and did not care. She pointed forward, “There is some mucus left behind by something else here. It has dried up. You Can’t smell it. This mucus has no smell. It should be a monster that is very good at hiding. You can pry open the soil below and touch it to know.”
Holani winked at the ruler beside him. The ruler understood and immediately went forward to pry open the place Monica was pointing at. He dug a small hole and found that his fingers were sticky. He turned around and returned to Holani’s side, he nodded and said, “Sir, there’s something strange about the soil. It’s very wet.”
Holani glared at him. “Nonsense. Miss Monica already said that there’s monster mucus there. How can it not be wet?”
Master was startled but quickly reacted. He bowed to Monica: “Miss Monica, I didn’t mean to offend you. Please forgive me.”
“Nothing.”Monica’s expression was indifferent: “The polar ice worm has fallen into the hands of this monster. It will be more difficult for us to find it. Do you have any countermeasures?”
Dudian and Barker looked at each other and pondered.
Dudian had noticed the mucus in the soil. Although he was an attack type but his vision was also excellent. He thought that Holani and Barker would be able to see it too. He didn’t expect that only Monica would notice it, he glanced at the three and asked: “If the polar ice worm is found by the monster, will it eat it?”
The three turned to look at Dudian. There was a trace of surprise in their eyes.
Dudian was puzzled by the three and immediately realized that he was asking a common sense question. However, he had exposed the mistake. He didn’t hide it and frowned: “What’s the matter?”
Holaney saw that Dudian didn’t seem to know. He couldn’t help but smile, “Did Mr. Dean just become the Abyss?”? The polar ice worm was the ancestor of the parasitic soul worm. The parasitic soul worm could live in the body of the monster so naturally the polar ice worm could also live in the body of the monster. Moreover, it was easier than the parasitic soul worm to invade the body of the monster. Even if the monster had parasitic soul worms in its body, it would have to abdicate in the face of the polar ice worm. Otherwise it would be eaten.”
Dudian’s eyebrows twitched. No wonder the three of them were so surprised. In their eyes, this was basic common sense. As for Hoolani’s probing words, he was too lazy to care about it. After all, he had just become the Abyss not long ago, now that he denied it, the truth was confirmed.
“If the polar ice worm is parasitic in this monster’s body, will it be useful for us to catch it?”Dudian asked again. He didn’t care if this question would make him look ignorant. As long as he could get the answer he wanted.., after all, if they really wanted to fight, they had to rely on their hands.
“Of course it will be useful.”Horaney smiled but didn’t explain why it was useful for Dudian.
“Why?”Dudian continued to ask.
Holani was a bit speechless. But since Dudian asked, he didn’t want to be vague, dudian said: “The ordinary parasitic soul worm will passively control the ability of the monster. But the polar ice worm is different. It can control the ability of the monster. At the critical moment, it can remove this ability and return to its own purity.”
Dudian understood. He thought for a moment but didn’t ask any more questions.
Monica and Barker looked at Dudian. Their expressions were calm and didn’t reveal any thoughts.
“Monica, can you tell the size and type of the monster?”Holaney turned to ask Monica.
“It’s not more than ten meters tall. It’s a reptile. It’s a cold-blooded creature. It’s as good at hiding as other cold-blooded monsters. I don’t know anything else.”Monica calmly replied.
“Then can you track its whereabouts?”Holani asked again.
Monica rolled her eyes at him and said, “If I could find it, I would have said it long ago.”
“That’s true. If that’s the case, even you can’t find its tracks. This is going to be a bit tricky. Do we have to do a blanket search?”Holani felt a headache. If it was in another area.., they could still spread out and search in a concentrated manner, but this was a swamp magic pit. Monsters above level-300 were very common, especially in the central area. There were even monsters that they could not defend against, such as the monster in the swamp.
“We can assume that the polar ice worm has already controlled this monster. The polar ice worm likes low-temperature areas. If I remember correctly, there is an ice lake in the swamp magic pit. It is very likely to go there,”Barker said.
Horani glanced at him, he said, “But that is the inner area of the swamp magic pit. It is close to the center of the magic pit. Moreover, there is an polar ice dragon living in the Ice Lake. The evaluation of the Divine Kingdom’s Monster Institute is that its hunting level is 372. Even if the few of us work together, we might not be able to defeat it. Moreover, it is in the Ice Lake. That is its home ground.”
Barker shook his head, “That’s true, but don’t forget how many people we have here. If we encounter that thing, we only need to pin it down for a moment so that others can fill up the ice lake or evaporate it. It’s like a bird with broken wings. It may not be our opponent on land. Don’t you have the ability to register these people? See how many of them have the ability to use fire or move rock and soil.”
Horaney thought for a moment and asked Monica and Dudian: “What do you think?”
Monica nodded: “Although the risk is a bit big, but it is feasible. We can take the opportunity to kill this ice dragon and then come here in the future. It will save us a big hidden danger so that it won’t mutate again after staying here for a long time.”
“I don’t care. I will listen to you.”Dudian also expressed his position.
“Alright, then we will go to the ice lake according to the plan of the Wall Master.”Holani made a decision and immediately ordered. At the same time he called back the ten teams that were exploring the surroundings, however at the moment three out of the ten teams had sent out danger signals. Most of them were in trouble. Holani was too lazy to mobilize other people to help them. He directly abandoned them. This time he had gathered so many people.., it was meant to be used as scouts and cannon fodder.
If they went to help the cannon fodder, it would be more dangerous if they were delayed here for too long.
After all, danger could happen outside the wall at any time, and this magic pit was a dangerous area. If they stayed for one more minute, they might encounter even more terrifying monsters. After all, there were four to five hundred of them gathered here, the heat source emitted was enough to alarm many monsters. Although most of them had used items to conceal their auras, it was hard to say if they could hide it from the perception of the abyssal-level monsters.
Hoolani’s worries came true very quickly. In less than three minutes after the main group changed their direction to go to the Ice Lake, the vanguard team exploded with an angry roar. It was deafening even though they were more than ten miles away, dudian and others felt that the ground was shaking because of the sound wave. The surrounding trees and weeds were slightly tilted. Even the small puddles on the roadside rippled.
Dudian’s eyes flashed with golden light. He looked at the ruins in front of him. He saw a giant monster that looked like a rock. It was almost twenty meters tall and looked like a human, it was a giant that was piled up with rocks.
“A quartz monster!”Monica whispered.
Hoolani and Barker’s faces changed as they looked at each other. Hoolani immediately made a decision: “Kill it as soon as possible!”
“What level is this?”Dudian frowned.
“Three hundred and twenty-six.”Barker whispered a number. His breathing was heavy.

chapters.title: Chapter 902
chapters.content:
Chapter 902 – Chapter 892: Meet The Enemy
“Abyss Level?”Dudian’s heart shivered.
Through the conversation of Holaney and the others, he understood the strength of the human hunters. More than 300 of them should belong to the first level of the abyss. The Ice Dragon had reached 372, undoubtedly, it was an extremely strong level in the abyss.
“Quartz Beast?”
“This is the outer edge of the swamp magic pit, how did we meet this thing!”
“What, what should we do?”
The hunting group behind him was a little chaotic and panicky. Although Horani’s voice was very low, the people present were all pioneers, or even the rulers of the inner wilderness. Their hearing was sharp, and they could even hear a pin drop. In addition, some of them had excellent vision, or their senses were sharp, and they could directly sense the situation in front of them. When the four words “Quartz monster”were said, it immediately made people panic. Although there were five abyss overseers present.., but… There was a very powerful abyss monster in front of them. would these five abyss stand up for them as cannon fodder?
Previously, when Holani did not hesitate to abandon a few exploration teams, everyone in the hunting group was in danger. If Barker was not present, they would have long prepared to scatter and escape.
However, most of them had already made up their minds. If there was danger, they would save their lives first. As for whether they could return to the giant wall or not, they didn’t care about whether Barker would chase after them.
“It’s too late to escape. Even if we can run, they can’t. Without them, we will have to rely on ourselves to explore the way.”Holani saw Dudian frown, she immediately said: “It’s not difficult to kill it. I don’t believe that one against five can turn the sky upside down!”
Dudian naturally knew the truth and said: “Alright, but it’s just an abyss monster. The four of us are enough.”
The three of them saw that Dudian didn’t intend to let Aisha take action. They slightly frowned. Monica said: “If we want to end the battle quickly, it’s better for the five of us to take action together. The bigger the commotion, the worse it will be for us.”
“I know. I think it is better to take action right now. I don’t believe that four people can’t take care of one of them!”Dudian said in a cold tone.
Monica frowned and wanted to say something. Barker interrupted: “In that case, let’s Go!”He jumped up and rushed towards the direction of the quartz beast. In the blink of an eye, he flew four to five miles away.
Holani saw that Dudian was trying to mediate the situation and was the first to attack. He didn’t say anything and ordered the other people to stay on the spot.
Dudian ignored Monica and chased after her with Aisha. Although he didn’t plan to let Aisha attack but he was used to keeping her by his side.
When Dudian flew close to the battlefield, he saw that Barker and Holaney were already fighting with the quartz monster. However, they were fighting while retreating, obviously they wanted to wait for Dudian and Monica to come over to help.
Dudian saw that both of them didn’t use their magic bodies. He sneered in his heart. He didn’t use his magic body either. He pulled out his sword and rushed forward. He saw that the body of the quartz monster was petrified as if it was made of stone, however it was impossible for the stone to disintegrate into a living creature. It was most likely that the monster liked to eat stones which caused its body to disintegrate into a rock shape. Dudian rushed forward and cut off a few stones from its toes.
The quartz beast which was originally attracted by Holaney and Barker roared in anger. It looked down and waved its huge stone fist towards Dudian.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He cursed in his heart and immediately retreated.
The quartz beast roared and chased after Dudian. It completely abandoned the two and went straight for Dudian.
Dudian was angry and angry at the same time. He had underestimated the shamelessness of the two. Although they seemed to be restraining the quartz beast but they didn’t cause any actual harm to it, dudian cut the monster and immediately pulled the aggro.
Monica was also chasing after Dudian. She was stunned for a moment as she saw the quartz beast chasing after Dudian. She quickly understood and rushed forward.
Dudian was relieved as he saw Monica coming from behind. Although she didn’t like him but she was ‘simple’compared to Barker and Holaney, dudian was ‘anxious’to catch up with the quartz beast but he kept a distance. It seemed that he wouldn’t be able to catch up no matter what.
He didn’t lead the quartz beast to Monica but stopped. He rushed forward. The quartz beast didn’t react and Dudian took the opportunity to pass by its legs.
The quartz monster turned its head and immediately caught up with Holaney and Barker who were chasing in the air.
The two of them didn’t expect that Dudian would suddenly play such a trick. Their faces changed but they couldn’t pretend anymore as they were facing the quartz monster. They had no choice but to continue to restrain it.
Dudian’s face turned cold as he saw the two of them attack. They were like two bees that were circling around the flower, he said: “If we don’t get rid of this thing as soon as possible and attract other monsters, then we won’t have a good ending.”
His voice wasn’t loud but Holaney and Barker could hear him clearly. There was a trace of embarrassment in their eyes, barker was the first to speak: “Brother Dean misunderstood. The surface of this quartz beast is thick. Although we have attacked with all our strength but it doesn’t have much effect. It seems we have to use all our strength to enter the battle.”
Dudian snorted: “What are we waiting for?”
Holaney smiled as the weapon in his hand quickly melted. In the blink of an eye his body turned into a three meter tall black bird. His head was protruding like a crow and his face was covered with feathers, there were four wings on his body. They were as black as ink. There were no feathers. If one looked carefully they would find that there were sharp black needles attached to the wings. If the wings hit or hugged him then it would cause terrible damage.
Dudian’s eyes flickered as he saw the changes in Barker’s body. He had never seen such a demon body before.
Barker had also entered the demon body state. His body looked like a human skeleton but there was a pair of huge bone wings on his back. He looked like a demon who had returned from the underworld. His arms were in the shape of a human skeleton’s palm, he was holding the original pitch-black bone sword. There was a thin black membrane on his chest which made his white ribs stand out.
Dudian hadn’t seen the magic body before. He looked at Monica who was coming from behind. She had entered the magic body state. Her body was like an agile moth. Her skin color had turned white like putty powder on the wall. Her eyes were blood red, it looked strange. Although her cheeks were still beautiful but it was impossible for people to have any evil thoughts.
After the magic body, the original appearance changed.
Dudian’s heart was touched. The two of them were originally handsome men and beautiful women. But after entering the magic body, they became as evil and terrifying as monsters. People didn’t dare to look at them directly.
This was the fundamental reason why nobles discriminated against warriors.
At this time, the three people behind the magic body looked at Dudian. Barker coughed and said: “Brother Dean, What are you doing?”
Dudian’s face turned cold as the splitter in his hand melted. He quickly entered the magic body state. At the same time he dodged the Fist of the Quartz Beast. The sand and dust flew as his body soared into the air.
His body was covered with spikes and sharp blades. It looked like a mixture of countless sharp blades. The sinister magic body floated in the air. The three of them were stunned.
The appearance of the monster was usually related to its ability. Although it wasn’t an absolute but it could be used as an important reference. Dudian’s terrifying appearance gave them the feeling of destruction!

chapters.title: Chapter 903
chapters.content:
Chapter 903 – Chapter 893: Magnetism
“Brother Dean, your magic body should be an attack type right? How about we fight the quartz monster head on? Let them flank from the side and finish the fight quickly!”Barker took a deep look at Dudian, a smile appeared on his face as he spoke loudly.
Dudian turned his head. In fact he didn’t need to turn his head to see Barker. He could clearly see the expressions of the three of them. But in order to cover this point.., he looked at dudian: “Alright, but can they hurt this thing?”
Holani smiled as he saw Dudian agree: “Mr Dean don’t worry. Leave it to us.”
Dudian looked at him but didn’t say anything. It was undoubtedly the most dangerous thing to deal with the quartz monster. However he was too lazy to deal with it. Moreover there was Barker with him, the strength of the Abyss lord was stronger than that of Monica and Holaney. There wouldn’t be any danger if the two of them helped him.
In fact, he felt that it wouldn’t be a problem for him to deal with the monster alone.
He could easily dodge the previous attacks of the quartz monster without entering the magic body. If the quartz monster maintained its speed then he would be able to get close to it and tear it apart!
He was confident that he could cut the toes of the quartz monster. Moreover the magic blade behind the monster was even sharper.
However, he didn’t want to expose too many of his fighting methods in case they were on guard. After all, there would be an intense battle after they found the polar ice worm!
Roar!
The quartz beast raised its fist and punched its chest. It roared in anger and rushed towards Dudian and Barker who were flying in front of its eyes.
“I’ll go up and you go down.”Barker took the initiative to fly towards the shoulder of the quartz beast. The bone sword in his hand cut down and created a deep trench.
The petrified skin on the shoulder of the quartz beast seemed to feel pain. It roared and reached out to grab Barker.
Dudian saw that Barker had attracted the attention of the quartz beast. He didn’t hesitate and rushed towards its chest. Since Barker had taken the initiative to attack the upper body of the quartz beast and shared the main danger, he couldn’t stay idle, he had to do something.
Puff!
Several magic blades were thrown out and swept onto the chest of the quartz beast. There were several cracks as if a huge claw had torn it.
Dudian was shocked. He had used 30% of his strength to avoid attracting attention. He was prepared to leave a shallow mark. If it was only a shallow mark then the beast might not notice him, in this way he didn’t have to bear the anger of the beast.
But he didn’t expect that 30% of his strength would cause a wound that wasn’t inferior to the one created by Barker’s bone sword. It was even wider and deeper!
Dudian bitterly smiled in his heart. He saw that the quartz beast had stopped. It looked down and let out an angry roar. It abandoned Barker and raised its hand to hit dudian.
Dudian quickly dodged. At the same time he paid attention to Barker’s figure so that he wouldn’t take advantage of the chaos to attack him. At the same time he was looking for an opportunity to sneak attack him.
If he could kill one of them then the pressure on him would be greatly reduced. He wouldn’t be afraid of losing his life even if their relationship broke down.
“Good job brother Dudian. No wonder you have the courage to cross the Abyss.”Barker saw Dudian lead the quartz beast away. He looked at the chest of the quartz beast and was shocked, he didn’t think that Dudian’s attack would be so terrifying. Although they didn’t use their full strength when they attacked the monster but they knew about the physical defense of the monster. Even Barker had to use his full strength, however he wouldn’t easily attack. He had used less than 70% of his strength to attack the monster. But now it was obvious that Dudian’s attack was much more powerful than his, wasn’t much inferior to his.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to his address as “Brother Dudian”. He took a few breaths and tried to maintain a calm appearance, he said: “Master is too kind. Let’s deal with this thing first.”
Barker knew that this wasn’t the time to talk. Otherwise it would be hard to avoid making others feel that he was too skilled. He glanced at Dudian from the corner of his eyes, he rushed towards the quartz beast again.
Roar!
