The quartz beast was ready to attack Dudian but saw Barker flying over. The previous human had injured its shoulder. The pain was unbearable. It didn’t expect that Barker would appear at this moment. It roared and stomped on the ground.
Bang!
The ground trembled and dust was raised.
Dudian was about to wait for the dust to disperse before attacking. Suddenly his eyelids twitched. He was shocked and immediately dodged. Whoosh! A sharp rock thorn pierced through his position. If he dodged a step later.., even if he didn’t die he would be injured.
Golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes. He looked through the dust and saw the surrounding scene. He couldn’t help but be shocked. He saw dozens of sharp thorns protruding from the ground. These thorns grew from the soil, it seemed that they were controlled by the quartz beast.
What ability was this?
Dudian was shocked. He couldn’t figure it out.
The next moment, he felt that his body was suddenly covered by an unknown force. It pulled his body and flew towards the quartz beast.
At the same time, the rock on the chest of the quartz beast changed and protruded out a sharp stone horn. Dudian’s body was flying towards the stone horn.
“What kind of power is this?”Dudian’s eyes were wide open. There was a trace of fear in his heart. After all, he had experienced many life and death situations. He quickly reacted and flapped his wings with all his strength, he broke away from the strange force and once again opened the distance between him and the quartz beast.
Barker’s body flew over and hit the corner of the Quartz Beast’s shoulder. Barker suddenly swung his sword. Bang! The corner of the stone was cut off, barker’s feet stepped on the Quartz Beast’s shoulder. He pushed it and flew backwards. He opened the distance again. Compared to Dudian’s escape, he was more at ease. He used the momentum to counterattack the quartz beast.
Dudian looked at the scene. It seemed that the previous strange force was created by the quartz monster. But what kind of ability was this? Could it be telekinesis?
Dudian felt that it was impossible. This ability was too magical. He didn’t dare to think about it.
At this time, the ground suddenly fluctuated. Dense stone cones flew out and rained down on the four people.
Dudian was startled. He suddenly understood. He was surprised. Could it be that the quartz beast showed the same ability? If so, he would have guessed what its ability was.
Magnetic Force!
Through its own magnetic field it could control the surrounding magnetic field and gravity. Moreover, from the current attack, the quartz beast seemed to be able to control only stones. The reason why it was able to pull Dudian over was because it could control stones, but it controlled its own stone. Through its own gravity it was able to pull Dudian over.
Dudian suddenly felt that the clumsy quartz beast’s fighting skills could be called art.
Whoosh! He waved the sharp blade and smashed the stone awl under his feet. At the same time he looked at the back of the quartz beast. Horaney and Monica were close to its back. The winner and loser would soon be revealed.
At this time —
Bang sound came from the back. It was the sound of a signal flare. Dudian had heard it a few times before so he was familiar with the sound.
He looked back from the horn on his head. He saw more than ten red warning signals shot into the air. The distance was where the rear troops were staying.
Dudian’s eyes focused as he looked at the signal flare. His face changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 904
chapters.content:
Chapter 904 – Chapter 894: Instant Cut
A blazing and vigorous heat source appeared in the middle of the group. The heat source was like a small mountain. It was more than ten meters tall. It was oval in shape and red in color. It was in sharp contrast to the other heat sources, it was like the difference between dark red and light pink. The color of some of the heat sources was much lighter than the one in front of him.
Another abyss monster?
Dudian’s mouth twitched. Although he knew that this pit was extremely dangerous and it was very likely that he would encounter an abyss monster. But he didn’t expect to encounter two abyss monsters in the same place! Most of the monsters had territorial terrain. It was almost impossible for there to be a second monster of the same level in the same territory. This was related to the struggle for survival resources in the territory. It was intolerable. But the facts in front of him told him that.., nothing was impossible.
“It’s an Abyss!”Holaney exclaimed. Apparently, he had noticed the movement behind them.
“Damn it! How could it be so unlucky? Let’s get rid of this one or we will be in trouble!”Barker shouted as he raised his bone sword and rushed towards the quartz monster.
Holaney seemed to know that the situation was critical. He suddenly let out a sharp whistle. The crow-like beak emitted ear-piercing sound waves. Its wings were full of sharp thorns. Its speed was twice as fast as before. It rushed towards the back of the quartz monster’s neck.
Hoolani’s ear-piercing screech attracted the attention of the quartz beast. It gave up on chasing Dudian and Barker. It turned around and rushed towards Hoolani.
Hoolani’s face changed as he saw the quartz beast turn around. He wanted to stop his body but his body stopped for a moment before he rushed towards the quartz beast again. This time he didn’t control it but was pulled over.
“No!”Holani roared. He flapped his wings wildly, but he still could not stop his body. In the next moment, the quartz daemon raised its palm, blocking out the sunlight, and slapped down viciously from above Holani’s head.
Holani’s face was filled with shock and anger. Just as the stone palm was about to hit him, he suddenly stopped resisting. He even increased his speed by flapping his wings, instantly dodging the stone palm. His body flew towards the quartz daemon at high speed like a meteorite. This time, he could no longer stop. The Quartz Daemon’s reaction was also very fast. When Holani dodged his attack, the surface of its chest quickly protruded with sharp stone spikes. They were incomparably thick and could completely pierce through Holani.
“Save me!”Holani could not help but cry out. There was a hint of fear in his voice. However, Monica, who was closest to him, was also more than twenty meters away from him. There was no time for her to help him.
Hoolani tilted his body and spread his four wings. He changed the trajectory of the wind and his body flew upwards, this curve allowed him to avoid the stinger on the chest of the quartz beast. However the end point was the mouth of the quartz beast.
The quartz beast seemed to be clumsy but its reaction was very fast. Hoolani was about to fly over but it suddenly opened its mouth and made a strange sound. The next moment, Hoolani didn’t have time to stop, it went straight into the mouth of the quartz beast and was swallowed by it!
Dudian’s pupils shrank. Was it eaten just like that? Was it because of the weakness of the Abyss? No, it was not because he was weak, but because the quartz beast was too strong!
“Beast, Let Go!”Barker waved his sword and cut the shoulder of the quartz beast. He had just arrived and saw that the quartz beast was swallowed. His face was full of anger. If he had been half a second earlier.., he would have been able to snatch Holani from the mouth of the quartz beast.
A half-meter-deep stone scar was cut on the shoulder of the quartz beast. There was no blood, but it seemed to feel pain. It let out a muffled roar and raised both of its hands to smash towards Barker.
Barker did not choose to take it head-on. Comparing strength with the quartz beast, it was undoubtedly using the short to hit the long. His feet stepped on the shoulder of the quartz beast and used the force to retreat. However, he had just flown halfway when his speed suddenly slowed down, as if he had suddenly fallen into a swamp.
Barker’s face changed. He used all his strength to flutter his wings to break away from the binding force. His vision suddenly turned dark as two huge fists smashed down.
Bang!
Barker’s body hit the ground like a cannonball. The ground shook and dust flew up. Barker’s body was hit more than ten meters deep into the ground. It was clear how terrifying the power of this punch was!
Dudian saw that Barker’s body was not dead. However, four or five of his ribs were broken and he was on the verge of death.
In the blink of an eye, one of the two abysses was swallowed. It was unknown whether he was alive or dead. The other was seriously injured!
Everything happened so fast that Dudian couldn’t believe it. Although he knew that monsters were much stronger than humans but he didn’t expect the difference to be so big!
Roar!
The quartz beast roared in anger as it stomped on the ground where Barker was buried. The soil on the ground shrank as it stomped on the ground. Barker spat out a large mouthful of blood as he struggled desperately.
At this time, Monica who was like a white moth suddenly appeared behind the quartz beast. She stabbed the silver sword into the Quartz Beast’s head, monica tried to pull back but found that the sword couldn’t be pulled out!
Her face slightly changed. She decisively abandoned the sword and quickly said to dudian: “Your Attack is stronger than mine. I will control it. You will attack. Let’s end this quickly!” The white skin on her hand quickly squirmed and formed a bow. She took out a golden arrow from the middle of her armor. It was originally part of the armor. Dudian didn’t know until now that.., it turned out that it could be disassembled.
Monica aimed at the eyes of the quartz beast.
There were two black holes in the eye sockets of the quartz beast. The arrow went straight into the eye sockets of the quartz beast. The quartz beast let out a furious roar as it covered its eyes with one hand. It cried out in pain and immediately chased after Monica.
Monica’s figure floated like a nimble butterfly. She dodged between the giant palms of the quartz beast. It seemed light but was extremely dangerous.
Dudian didn’t think much about the crisis. He couldn’t continue to hide his strength. Otherwise, he might reveal more cards to deal with the other abyss.
Whoosh!
Dudian rushed over from the side.
This was the first time he had attacked with full strength after becoming an abyss. His body flashed like a shadow. He wasn’t used to it.
The quartz beast seemed to be in a rage. It didn’t pay attention to Dudian’s approach. Dudian quickly caught up to it from the side. He didn’t feel that it was difficult. He raised the height and flew to the side of the Quartz Beast’s neck. There was a flash of cold light in his eyes, he raised the four sharpest spikes on his back and threw them out.
Puff Puff Puff Puff!
The Quartz Beast’s neck was cut open in an instant!
The sharp blade on his back was 2.2 meters long. It cut through his body. The wound was about 1.67 meters long. If he had been a bit closer.., he would have cut off its head!
The four sharp blades left a huge wound. Less than a third of the neck of the quartz beast was left. Dudian quickly raised his leg and kicked it.
The stone on the neck of the beast couldn’t withstand the force of the kick. The huge head fell down like a huge stone, the stone hit the ground and made a few deep pits. It rolled a few times before it stopped moving. The beast that had lost its head ran a few steps forward. It lost its balance and fell forward.
Dust flew. The huge quartz beast fell to the ground but didn’t move.
Dudian used his X-ray vision to look at it. He saw that the heat source on its body was quickly dispersed. The concentration of heat was rapidly decreasing. It looked like it was dead.
He was stunned. He felt incredulous. Did he kill it just like that?

chapters.title: Chapter 905
chapters.content:
Chapter 905 – Chapter 895: Rotten Mud Ghost
Monica was also in disbelief. She was completely stunned when the huge head of the quartz monster fell down. It was a quartz monster which was famous for its terrifying defense, how could it be so easily beheaded by Dudian?
She couldn’t believe it but the huge head of the quartz monster fell in front of her. She couldn’t help but believe that the IQ of the quartz monster was lower than the average abyss level monster. It didn’t know how to fake its death, moreover she could tell that the quartz monster was really cold.
Crack!
Barker climbed out of the mud. He looked at the other place where the head of the quartz monster fell. There was a trace of shock in his eyes when he saw the head. He didn’t think that his perception was real, no wonder the density of the mud that the quartz monster had collected suddenly stopped.
He turned his head and looked at Dudian. His eyes flashed but quickly returned to normal. He sat on the ground and panted as he asked: “Did you two kill him?”
Monica looked at him. She knew a little about Barker’s ability. She didn’t believe that he didn’t know anything about the outside world while he was underground, however, she was too lazy to expose him. It wouldn’t be good for her to make enemies, she could only follow his words: “It has nothing to do with me. Mr. Dean was the one who took care of it. If we knew that Mr. Dean was so powerful then we wouldn’t have needed to spend so much effort.”
Dudian came back to his senses after listening to their conversation. He glanced at Barker’s broken ribs. There was some doubt in his heart but he didn’t show it, he said: “I didn’t think that it would be careless. It was thanks to Miss Monica who attracted its attention. Otherwise I wouldn’t have found the opportunity to attack its weakness.”
“Mr. Dean is too modest.”
“It’s nothing. I’m just telling the truth.”
Barker didn’t know whether to laugh or cry as he saw the two of them being so modest. He said: “Don’t try to avoid it. In any case, this thing will always be killed by you two. Fortunately you acted in time or I would have suffered a great loss.”
“The wall master is strong. Even without us, you would have killed it sooner or later.”Dudian comforted.
Barker shook his head but didn’t say anything. He was analyzing Dudian’s words. Although he didn’t see what was happening outside but he knew the general situation through his vague perception, dudian was able to kill the quartz monster in one strike. His strength was much stronger than what Barker had expected. Moreover his attack was extremely terrifying. Otherwise he wouldn’t be able to kill the quartz monster even if he used all his strength, he might not be able to cut off the head of the quartz monster. It was estimated that he would be stuck in the middle of the cut. From this it could be seen that Dudian’s magic marks should be an extremely strong attack type.
Dudian was also thinking in his heart as he analyzed Dudian’s strength. He didn’t think that he could kill the quartz beast so easily, he wasn’t afraid of the quartz beast from the beginning to the end. The speed of the latter’s pounce and Chase as well as the power of his attack weren’t frightening in his eyes.
The reason why he was surprised was that he did not expect that Holani and Barker would be defeated by this thing. The defeat was so fast that the quartz daemon that had defeated two people in a row instantly rose a few levels in his heart. He had no choice but to attack with all his strength.
The result was that he killed it easily!
He suspected that Barker was deliberately pretending to be injured. In this way, he did not need to rush at the front. At the same time, he could hand the quartz daemon over to the uninjured him and Monica to deal with. He could take the opportunity to observe their strength. Secondly.., there was another abyss level monster in the distance. If they were injured then the heavy responsibility of dealing with that monster would naturally fall on them.
However, he saw that Barker’s injuries were very serious. If he was faking his injuries then it would be too ruthless.
Dudian thought for a moment. He felt that Barker’s injuries were half true and half false. In any case, his injuries had forced him to expose his strength. If he was faking it then he would admit it.
He felt that he couldn’t be careless about these abyss level experts.
“I don’t know if Holaney is still in its stomach. I have to find him first.”Barker said to Monica.
Monica shook her head, “I can’t feel its existence. I think it’s doomed. We should first deal with that one. I don’t know how many people will be killed.”
Barker frowned slightly, but what she said made sense. He immediately asked Dudian, “What do you think?”
“I’ll go and help first.”Dudian rushed over. Since he had decided, he wouldn’t stop.
“Wait for us.”Barker and Monica immediately caught up.
Dudian held Aisha and rushed to the hunting team. When he got close, he saw that the monster was surrounded by many members of the hunting team. It was a monster that looked like mud. Its whole body was squirming with mud. It was about 14 to 15 meters tall, it looked like a small building. It had no head, but the top of the mud seemed to be its head. There were no facial features on it. It kept extending mud tentacles from its body. It swept into the crowd and wrapped up the people who couldn’t escape in time, dean pulled it back into the mud and sank into it. Then a few small bubbles rose on the surface of the mud and it was completely silent.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He saw that the monster’s body was quickly pierced by the mud. The next moment it was crushed by the mud and mixed with the mud, after a while, the blood seemed to be absorbed by the mud and disappeared. The size of the monster was slightly larger.
The change was very small but Dudian noticed it.
“Rotten Mud Ghost!”Barker took a deep breath. His face was ugly.
Dudian saw that Barker recognized it and asked: “What do you mean?”
“This thing is indeed an abyss level monster. Moreover it is very difficult to deal with. Its hunting level is not fixed. The evaluation of the atlas is based on its height. The height is twelve meters. The hunting level is three hundred and five. The height is thirteen meters. The hunting level is three hundred and fifteen. It is equivalent to ten levels per meter. I think it is at least fourteen meters or more. Its hunting level is no worse than the previous quartz monster!”Barker clutched his chest and panted.
Dudian frowned as he felt that the situation was a bit tricky. The decaying mud ghost was different from the quartz beast. The quartz beast had a hard shell and Dudian wasn’t afraid of encountering a defensive monster. After all, there would always be a moment when the defense would be broken, however, the body of the decaying mud ghost was soft and sticky. He didn’t need to make a move to know that it was counter to him.
The extremely sharp blade could cut through steel but not water.
Without the sharp edge of the blade, the rotten mud ghost was ten times stronger than the quartz monster. He might not be able to deal with it.
“I should have thought of it. The quartz monster feeds on stones and usually eats precious ores. The rotten mud ghost likes the excrement of the quartz monster. It is a great tonic for it. No wonder it appeared here.”Barker’s face was a bit annoyed, “I should have retreated.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up, he said: “There is no point in talking about this now. I don’t think I can help you. I have exhausted my strength to kill the quartz monster. As you can see, I am good at attacking. Although my attacks are strong but they have no effect on this thing. Look at the arrows of others. Ordinary swords and arrows are useless against it.”
Barker’s expression changed slightly. He exchanged a glance with Monica, and a gloomy look flashed across his eyes, barker said reluctantly, “Brother Du, you’ve already paid a lot for killing the quartz beast. Indeed, I shouldn’t force you to do anything. It’s just that I’m too heavily injured and can’t be of much help. It’s too risky to rely on Monica alone. Why Don’t brother Du and I cover for each other and let Monica be the main attacker?”

chapters.title: Chapter 906
chapters.content:
Chapter 906 – Chapter 896: Monica’S Methods
“Alright.”Dudian nodded. He knew that they had to make a move or else they might not be willing to fight seriously.
While they were talking, more than a dozen people in the hunting group were killed. Some were shot by the mud spurting out from the body of the rotten mud ghost. Some were killed by the spikes made of mud, some were directly pulled into the body of the rotten mud and crushed.
Dudian, Barker, and Monica quickly rushed up. Monica went behind the rotten mud ghost alone. Fine particles slowly floated out of the moth-like white body like powder, it seemed that there was something in it.
Dudian and Barker rushed in front of the rotten mud ghost. Barker was the first to attack. The bone sword stabbed into the rotten mud ghost. The next moment, the mud rushed into the depths of the mud, it was going to swallow his arm.
Barker’s face slightly changed. He pulled out the bone sword and quickly cut through the mud. However, the wound healed in an instant.
Dudian also waved the sharp blade and stabbed into the mud. He felt that it was easy to stab into it. However, when he tried to pull it out, he felt that there was a corrosive power in the mud which was digesting his limbs, moreover, the speed of digestion was very fast.
He was surprised and quickly pulled out the blade. However, he saw that the color of the blade was a bit mottled. It seemed that the color was uneven.
“Physical damage is useless.”Barker retreated to Dudian’s side, he said: “I remember that there are a few masters of the magic marks in the hunting group. Let them attack. Maybe they can cause some damage. We will cover for them.”
Dudian nodded as he thought of the magic attack of the magic marks. At this moment the function of the magic marks of the supplicant was much stronger than that of his splitter. After all, it was the number one legendary monster here. However.., the cost of replacing the magic marks was huge. They needed to re-absorb the god’s marrow and the polar ice worm to recover their current strength. It was possible that they would never be able to recover their current strength. Therefore they had to be careful when choosing the magic marks, it would be difficult to replace them because they didn’t have so many resources.
Barker came to the edge of the encirclement. He called the Masters of the magic marks to his side. He told them his plan and then called Dudian to continue to rush forward.
Although their attacks were ineffective but at least they could attract the attention of the rotten mud ghosts.
The three masters of the magic marks sneakily followed after Dudian and Barker. They took aim at the opportunity and immediately approached the rotten mud ghosts, the Dark Magic Claws hit the rotten mud monster’s body. The place where the palm hit slightly collapsed. The color was black as if it had been corroded.
Before Dudian and Barker could rejoice, the mud that had collapsed quickly rushed out and recovered. At the same time, a few spikes protruded from the mud and shot towards the three masters.
Puff!
One of the Masters didn’t have time to react. The spear made of mud pierced his throat and he died on the spot.
The other two panicked and ran away. They didn’t dare to breathe.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. The level of the rotten mud monster was only more than ten levels higher than the quartz monster. It was several times more difficult to deal with. If he met it alone, he would have to run away. He was completely helpless against it, this also allowed him to see his weakness.
Coo Coo Coo!
Suddenly, a roar sounded from the body of the rotten mud. It was extremely angry.
Dudian was stunned for a moment. He saw a figure appear behind the rotten mud ghost. It was Monica. However at the moment her body was even whiter. White powder kept falling down like snowflakes, but it was finer and more deadly than snowflakes.
The white powder fell on the rotten mud ghost’s body. The place where it touched quickly hardened and no longer looked soft.
When the white powder fell on half of its upper body, Monica stabbed out with her silver sword. Crack! The body of the rotten mud suddenly broke like a rock.
Dudian and Barker looked at each other. They didn’t miss this rare opportunity. They quickly rushed towards the place where the rotten mud ghost was covered by the white powder. Crack! The upper body of the rotten mud ghost was completely crushed.
After the upper body was crushed, the lower body of the rotten mud ghost slowly shrank. It drilled into the ground to escape.
Dudian waved his sharp blade to cut the ground. He wanted to leave the rotten mud ghost behind. But the speed of the rotten mud ghost was extremely fast. It was like a fish in water. It was extremely flexible. Most of the time it would appear out of nowhere.
Barker and Monica tried to leave the rotten mud ghost behind. But like Dudian, they failed.
After the rotten mud ghost escaped, the three of them were exhausted. Barker sat on the ground and panted. He covered his chest and took out the medicine from his backpack to bandage himself. At this moment, he didn’t have the dignity of a wall master.
Monica’s body returned to the appearance of a human beauty. Her face and skin were pale. She looked at Dudian but didn’t say anything. She walked to the side and quietly sat down to rest.
Dudian also released his magic body. The battle didn’t last long. He didn’t consume much energy. It was easy for him to kill the quartz monster. He was surprised that the rotten mud ghost was difficult to deal with, he didn’t spend much effort. Moreover he found that even the rotten mud ghost seemed to be like this. If it wasn’t because of its soft body that he couldn’t hurt it then it wouldn’t be difficult to kill it.
He found that the speed of the rotten mud ghost’s attack wasn’t fast. He could easily dodge it. He didn’t know if it was because of its slow movement, or because his physique was higher than the ordinary abyss.
While Dudian was thinking about the analysis, the other members of the hunting group cleaned up the battlefield and helped the injured to heal. They buried the broken limbs and corpses on the ground. Some people proposed to cremate them on the spot. This was the custom of the hunters outside the giant wall, after all, it wouldn’t be long before a monster with a sensitive sense of smell would dig out and eat them.
This proposal was rejected. Some people thought that the previous movement was too big. If they continued to stay here to cremate the corpses, it would be difficult to guarantee that other monsters wouldn’t come. Moreover, the smell of the cremation process was thicker. It would be easier to attract monsters.
Moreover, although burying the dead on the spot might fall into the belly of the beast, for the living, it could be used as bait to lure away the monsters.
After a few words of discussion, someone looked for Barker to make a decision.
Barker was about to speak when a figure suddenly rushed over from afar. It was Horani, who had been devoured by the quartz monster earlier.

chapters.title: Chapter 907
chapters.content:
Chapter 907 – Chapter 897: Dragon
Dudian saw that Holaney’s body was covered with a sticky yellow liquid. It seemed to be the digestive fluid of the quartz beast. He said: “You Are Not Dead?”He had used x-ray vision to check, unfortunately he didn’t penetrate the body of the quartz beast. But he didn’t see Holaney’s heat source reaction. He thought that something had happened to him.
“You are lucky. The battle had just ended and you came.”Monica glanced at Holani. It seemed that she wasn’t surprised that he was still alive.
Holani bitterly smiled: “It was almost digested. Fortunately you killed that thing in time. Speaking of which, you three have become my benefactor. Isn’t this a rotten mud ghost? Is It Dead?”
“It just died.”Barkley replied. He wasn’t in the mood to care about Dudian.
Dudian saw that Monica and Barkley weren’t surprised that Holani had survived. His eyebrows twitched. It seemed that he had underestimated the shamelessness and blackness of the Abyss, it was possible that Holani had sensed the rotten mud ghost and deliberately let the quartz monster eat him. Even if Dudian didn’t kill the quartz monster, he wouldn’t be in danger.
Instead, he could use this opportunity to hide in the body of the quartz monster and wait to see how they would fight. After all, they had lost one person, and the three of them were under more pressure. Naturally, they could not hide their strength.
Thinking of this, he glanced at Barker. As the wall master, he was able to suppress Monica and Horeni. His ability should be stronger than the two of them, but his previous performance did not show how powerful they were.
In this way, it was him and Monica who exposed more in this battle. However, perhaps Barker and Holani already knew what Monica exposed, so there was no need to hide it. From the beginning to the end.., only he suffered the greatest loss.
“Rest up. Let’s leave this place as soon as possible. The quartz daemons are already dead. There is no master in this territory. There will most likely be new daemons invading. We should not stay here for long.”Barker bandaged the wound on his chest, he patted his butt and stood up. He looked at holani: “Let your people count the losses. Many people have died. Next we will face the ice dragon. We Can’t lose any more!” There was a hint of meaning in his words.
Holani didn’t seem to understand. He nodded: “It’s time to go. You should rest first. I will lead the way.”
Dudian was in no mood to argue. He sat aside and rested.
After a moment Holani organized the hunting group and counted the number of people. In just a few minutes the rotten mud ghost had killed four rulers, nine generals and more than 70 pioneers, there were only about 360 people left.
After organizing the hunting group Holani led his men to lead the way.
The area of the magic pit was very large. It was much larger than the other areas. According to holani, it was about the size of four giant walls. It could easily accommodate hundreds of millions of people.
Dudian thought of a long sunken island so he roughly knew the scope of the magic pit. Although there were only 100 million people in an island but the land area was still very large. In fact, it could accommodate more people, the magic pit was about half the size of an island. They were still at the outer edge of the magic pit. The Ice Lake was close to the central area and the distance was far.
After half a day of traveling they met some master level monsters. Holani took the initiative to lead the team to kill them but didn’t sacrifice many hunters. After leaving the territory of the quartz monsters they met two more abyss level monsters. However Monica sensed them in advance so they avoided them.
The sky was getting dark. Everyone was resting in a canyon. The wind whistled like the ferocious laughter of monsters. It made people uneasy.
In this kind of nervous mood, everyone hugged their weapons and fell asleep. They would be woken up at any time, however, he didn’t expect Dudian and Barkley to be so rude. They agreed as soon as he opened his mouth. However, he knew that they were angry at him for avoiding the fight during the day, he didn’t care about it.
Moreover, he didn’t dare to sleep even if he was allowed to sleep. He guessed that Dudian’s magic marks should be very good at fighting. He wasn’t good at perception so he left Dudian to guard, it was better to leave it to a master who could easily sense the surroundings.
The night outside the giant wall was always long. The howling of monsters could be heard from time to time. Many of the more ferocious monsters liked to appear in the night and hunt other monsters.
It was not easy to survive. It was not only because of hunters like Dudian but also because of the other weaker monsters. The night was a disaster. Most of the monsters would return to their nests early in the evening no matter how far they were from their nests, they would rush back.
The night passed quickly.
There were a few pioneer level and a master level monsters that found the canyon. But before they could attack, they were quietly killed by the night watchmen, Horaney and Monica.
When the dawn came, the dark world seemed to be full of hope again. The monsters that had been shivering in their nests all night left their nests to hunt for their prey. Dudian and the others also ate dry food, replenished water and set off again.
Under the leadership of Holaney, they headed towards the ice lake in the depths of the magic pit.
With Monica as an expert in perception, they avoided a lot of risks along the way. However, they still encountered many pioneering level monsters in the daytime. As for weaker monsters, they would encounter them from time to time, they were killed by the hunters.
Dudian borrowed a map from Holaney and looked at it. He waited until Holaney pointed out their location and the Ice Lake, they were still a long distance away from the Ice Lake. It would take them at least two or three days.
Two or three days of marching in the magic pit was no less than suicide.
Dudian looked at the rest of the soldiers who were sitting on the ground. There was a bit of pity in his heart. Not many people could go back alive. But they still held hope that there were several abyss.., nothing would happen to them. Even if something happened to them, it would be someone else. He would be the one lucky enough to survive.
But he knew that when they reached the ice lake, they would be the first batch of cannon fodder to rush to the front. They would wear down the power of the polar ice dragon and reduce the possibility of danger. At that time, even if everyone was sacrificed.., they wouldn’t care. In fact, it was more to their liking. After they got the ice worm, Barker and the others would return to the giant wall as fast as possible. They wouldn’t stay in the magic pit for long. After all, even if they were in the abyss.., they would die here.
Unfortunately, only he who had reached the abyss could understand this point. Others might have guessed it but they could only accept their fate sadly or humbly hope for mercy.
But the strong would never show mercy.
..
Two days passed.
Dudian, Holaney and the others led less than 300 hunters to the ice forest outside the ice lake. During the two days they met three abyss level monsters, although Monica and several other masters with strong perception and magic generals were scouting the way, they were still unable to find the three abyss monsters.
The battle was unavoidable.
Fortunately, the abyssal monsters were alone this time. It took them a lot of effort to deal with them.
Dudian was relatively low-key in the later battles. He took the opportunity to observe the magic marks ability of the three of them. He deliberately exposed flaws in the battle to give the abyssal monsters a chance to attack, dudian forced out some of their abilities.
In his observation, Holaney was good at using poison. At the same time he had strong perceptive ability. He was able to put poison in his mouth and wings. The poison was extremely corrosive and toxic. It could easily corrode metals and rocks, one of the Abyss Monsters was poisoned by Dudian. Its body quickly rotted away. The scene was extremely cruel.
Monica’s magic marks ability could not only harden things but also bewitch the enemy and make them lose their mind. Dudian deliberately made a mistake and drilled out of the encirclement of the Abyss Monster, dudian saw Monica’s magic marks. Although it only stunned the abyss monster for a moment but it was seen by Dudian. This made him pay special attention to it. This ability was hard to guard against and was the most difficult to deal with.
Dudian didn’t see much of the Old Fox’s ability. He knew that Barker’s bones were healing fast. He was sure that Barker was injured on purpose. Moreover he was pretending to be bandaged afterwards, it was a complete lie.
Dudian analyzed the abilities of the three of them. The three of them also gave an impression of Dudian’s ability. He was strong and sharp!
No matter how strong the defense of the Abyss Monsters was, they were as fragile as paper under Dudian’s sharp blade. They had to use all their strength to barely cause damage. However Dudian’s sharp blade could cut through them, this made the three of them quite afraid. Although they had their own abilities but Dudian might not be their opponent if they were caught off guard. But Dudian’s ability was the most terrifying in a head on fight, they couldn’t compete with him. Their weapons would be cut off. If Dudian’s fighting skills were high then with this ability he would be a god of death!
However the three of them were glad that Dudian’s ability seemed to be more extreme. He didn’t show any other abilities except for his sharp attacks. Even his perception was weak.
When they got to know each other, they came to the ice forest outside the Ice Lake. It was May and summer had just arrived, but the place was still very cold. The branches of the forest were covered with ice debris.
Dudian was surprised to see the ice and snow weather. It was completely unscientific. After all, this was not the Arctic. It was still frozen three feet in the summer, it was hot outside the ice forest but it was like entering another world in the forest. The reason why the Arctic was frozen all year round was because it was far away from the Sun.
“Be careful. The Arctic ice dragon might not stay in the ice lake all the time. It might also come to the forest to find food.”Holaney reminded the hunting group.
Monica curiously looked at the ice forest: “Is the area affected by the Arctic ice dragon so big that it can freeze here?”
“This Arctic ice dragon has lived here for a long time. It is said that it has lived here for 40-50 years.”Barker knew more, he whispered: “Because of it, the monsters around it have been infected with a similar ice constitution. These monsters live in this forest so the temperature here is so low. Be careful.”
Monica suddenly understood.
Dudian was surprised. Had they lived for forty to fifty years? It should be known that the war in the world of monsters was more brutal than in the human world. It was almost impossible to dominate the same territory outside the giant wall for forty to fifty years. Moreover, this was the abyss pit.., the ultra-high radiation in the pit was constantly causing the monsters to mutate. Every day a new overlord was born. The resources were limited. The new overlord and the previous Lord would fight for territory. The loser would be swallowed.., this was the law of survival outside the giant wall. How Strong was this extreme frost dragon to be able to guard this place for forty to fifty years?
Could it be that even that terrifying monster from the magic pool couldn’t do anything to it in these forty to fifty years?

chapters.title: Chapter 908
chapters.content:
Chapter 908 – Chapter 898: Shadow
Dudian made up his mind to retreat immediately if the situation was not right. Although the polar ice insects were rare and precious opportunities were hard to come by.
At this time, Holaney had organized the first group of cannon fodder. They were led by two masters and took the lead to enter the ice forest.
“How far is it from this forest to the Ice Lake?”Dudian asked Holaney.
Holaney looked at the forest in front of them: “If it is a straight line then it is not far. It is less than 80 miles. It would be very troublesome if we meet some troublesome things.”
80 miles was not very different from 800 meters in the eyes of ordinary people. But if there were poisonous snakes and dogs along the way then most people would not think that the path was very short.
Barker said in a deep voice: “Try not to take detours. It is too dangerous to take detours in the forest. It is best to pass through as soon as possible.”
Holani nodded: “I know.”
“Can’t we burn the Forest?”Dudian asked.
The three of them looked at Dudian with strange eyes. How violent was his character to think of such a thing?
“It is impossible to burn the forest.”Holaney cursed in her heart, she explained to Dudian: “Fire is the nemesis of all things. But the temperature in the forest is low and there are many monsters with ice constitution. It is very easy to extinguish the fire. It is almost impossible to ignite the entire forest unless we bring a lot of tarps. Even if we burn the forest the monsters will rush out.”
“That’s true.”Dudian nodded. He felt that this method was inappropriate.
After ten minutes or so, the expedition team sent back the signal that they could enter the forest.
The four of them walked in the middle of the team. The rest of the hunters were responsible for the rear. They formed a long snake team and moved forward.
After coming to the forest, Dudian put away his previous casual attitude and let Aisha follow him closely. He was ready to use demonization to deal with the sudden attack. At the same time, his eyes flashed with a dark gold color from time to time, he used his X-ray vision to observe the surrounding environment.
Not long after they went deep into the forest, they heard the sound of fighting. Everyone was shocked.
Monica looked ahead and indifferently said: “Don’t worry, it’s not the Abyss.”
The few teams of hunters were relieved. They felt that their backs were covered in cold sweat. Compared to the happy days of the beauties in the giant wall, this place was like a hell.
Holaney whispered: “This is the territory of the Polar Ice Dragon. There shouldn’t be a second abyss. Everyone should be careful not to be ambushed by other monsters.”
Everyone heard Hoolani’s words. Soon the speed of the team increased. There were sounds of fighting along the way. Dudian followed the team and came to the place where the sounds of fighting were coming from, there were several bloody corpses on the ground as well as two monster corpses that had been split in half. The monster’s hair was dark blue and emitted extremely cold air.
Dudian was silent. The ability of an ice dragon to turn all the other monsters in the territory into ice was beyond his imagination.
Half an hour later, they passed through the ice forest. There were more than ten corpses of their companions and several monster corpses behind them.
After they walked out of the forest, they saw a vast lake in front of them. The surface of the lake was quiet and the water was clear. Dudian looked at the lake and saw that it was frozen.
“Prepare to lure the old dragon out.”Holaney looked at the huge ice lake and said in a deep voice.
Barker’s eyes were serious: “I’m going to say this first. Later when we attack, if any of us try to play tricks, don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
Holaney’s face slightly changed: “Of course. Please rest assured.”
“That’s right.”Dudian immediately said: “I don’t want to make things too clear. The Polar Ice Dragon is not an ordinary abyss. The enemy is in front of us. If anyone tries to sneak attack or play tricks, I will just leave. I don’t want the polar ice worm.”
The three frowned but didn’t say anything.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to them. He was just saying it out loud. If the enemy wanted to sneak attack or deliberately save energy, he wouldn’t be able to do anything.
Dudian used the heat source to observe the frozen lake. He didn’t see any heat source. He said to the three: “I will go to the sky to take a look.”
“Alright.”Holaney nodded and continued to command the others to set up the formation.
Dudian flew to a height of 20-30 meters and looked down. The Ice Lake was very large. There was no wind or snow on the surface of the frozen lake so it was as transparent as a mirror. He could see the dark green lake water at the bottom of the lake.
“The extreme cold ice dragon lives here. I don’t know if there are other fish monsters at the bottom of the lake. If there aren’t any then what does it eat?”Dudian thought, the biggest problem for all life was eating and drinking. Especially for the large monsters which ate tons of food. They had to hunt or migrate every day. They even had to fight for food with the difficult hunters, they had to challenge the overlords in other territories. Once they were injured the difficulty of finding food would increase. They would starve. The hungrier they were, the more powerless they would become.
In the world outside the giant wall, countless monsters died every day. Many of these monsters were extremely fierce monsters.
From the current situation, the Arctic Frost Dragon was obviously an amphibious monster. It could even fly.
Dudian looked around the lake and soon found a mess of claw marks. It should have been left by the Arctic Frost Dragon when it went ashore to search for food. However, in addition to the claw marks, he saw some potholes and traces of fighting. In addition, he saw half of the broken gun inserted into the edge of the tree near the lake. It was covered by grass. If he didn’t look down from a high altitude and his eyesight was good.., he wouldn’t be able to see it.
“Have humans fought here?”Dudian’s eyes slightly moved but he didn’t think too much. The Ice Lake was recorded on the map in Holani’s hand. Naturally, there were humans who had explored this place.
He was about to land when a shadow suddenly flashed across the bottom of the frozen lake. Dudian thought that his eyes were blurred. A few seconds later, another huge shadow flashed past, it looked like a long snake.
Dudian’s eyelids twitched. Was this the Arctic ice dragon? Was it at the bottom of the lake?
He stared at the surface of the lake for a moment. The shadow once again flashed past. It was a long strip. It was estimated to be more than ten meters long. However, it only rolled over for a moment before drilling into the bottom of the lake.
He looked at the shadow for a moment but it didn’t appear again. He landed and looked at the hunters who were arranged by the lakeside: “Should we draw it out now?”
“Everyone is in position. We can start now.”Holaney said.
Dudian frowned: “Should we wait for the ice dragon to come out to hunt?”
“Wait for it to look for food?”The three of them weren’t rookies. They knew what Dudian meant, barker pondered: “When it looks for food, it means that it is hungry. Its physical strength is the weakest. It is best to attack at this time. However, we don’t know how often it eats. These cold-blooded creatures will eat for half a month. We can’t wait that long.”
Dudian saw that they weren’t aware of the ice dragon’s feeding pattern. He said: “Then prepare.”
“I don’t know if it is at the bottom of the lake or out looking for food.”Monica frowned: “If it isn’t at the bottom of the lake then we will alert it and take precautions.”
“I just saw a shadow at the bottom of the lake. I don’t know if it is it or not. But I guess there are no other monsters at the bottom of the lake.”Dudian said.
“You saw a Shadow?”The three were surprised. They knew that Dudian wouldn’t lie. It wasn’t good for him, holani immediately said: “In that case, let’s get ready. I will send people to blast the surface of the lake. I will lead it to this place. You will ambush it here. Try to lead it to the forest away from the Ice Lake.”

chapters.title: Chapter 909
chapters.content:
Chapter 909 – Chapter 899: Show Yourself
“Brother Dean, isn’t it time for your female companion to help you?”Barker looked at Aisha who was beside Dean. Dean had never let Aisha help him, they wanted to test Aisha’s strength but they knew that this female companion was a genuine corpse king. Her eyes were pure black and her body was full of corpse aura. It was not a disguise.
How terrifying a corpse king that was controlled and cultivated by humans would depend on how crazy dudian was. They knew that this young man wasn’t an ordinary person, the female companion of the corpse king that he controlled might be much stronger than his original body!
Dudian’s face turned cold as he heard Barker’s words: “I have my own judgment on whether or not to let her attack.”
“Brother Dean, you can’t say that. This old dragon is not an ordinary abyss. If we don’t unite now, we might not be able to fight it. Moreover, we have contributed. Shouldn’t you show some respect?”Holani also spoke.
Dudian narrowed his eyes. were they trying to force him? However, their calculations were obviously wrong. He wouldn’t fall for such a trick: “What do you want? Didn’t I contribute along the way? Don’t forget who saved your life and who killed the Quartz Beast!”
Holaney’s face turned stiff. He coughed and looked at Monica and Barker. It was obvious that he had nothing to say.
“Brother Dean, we know that you have made a lot of efforts. But we are the only ones who can deal with the Polar Ice Dragon. Everyone has paid a lot for the polar ice worm. You should understand.”Barker tried to persuade Dudian.
Dudian couldn’t help but laugh, “What? My Woman is an abyss so I have to take action? Am I not qualified to get a share? If we take action together then we will have two abyss level forces. What do I need to share with the three of you? Don’t tell me that you can take out two abyss level forces? I am qualified to share the power. Don’t tell me that the information about the polar ice worm is yours. It is good that no one knows about it. Since it is public, it is meaningless!”
The faces of the three changed. They didn’t expect that dudian would turn against them. However, the three of them were experienced people. They didn’t care about Dudian’s attitude. Barker looked at Holaney and pondered for a moment, “In that case, brother Dudian should ask your woman to help him in case of a crisis, right?”
Dudian indifferently said: “Of course. But if you don’t work and deliberately slack off then I won’t help you. I’m not joking this time. If the situation isn’t right then I will be the first one to withdraw. It’s best to distribute the tasks first. After we kill the ice dragon then we can discuss how to divide the polar ice insects. What do you think?”
“I think so too.”Monica nodded.
As for Dudian’s discussion, of course she knew what kind of “Discussion”it was.
Holaney and Barker also agreed. They didn’t force Dudian to let Haisha take action. If they continued to talk, they might completely fall out. Holaney said: “I will draw out the old dragon. The three of you will be responsible for stopping it.”
“Although it is difficult to draw it out, but the follow-up battle will depend on your participation.”Barker said. He wouldn’t be polite to hoolani. Now was a critical moment so he didn’t dare to be arrogant.
Hoolani frowned. He was unhappy but he knew that he wouldn’t let himself be so relaxed.
The few of them discussed for a moment and finally decided on a plan. They distributed their respective tasks and responsibilities.
After everything was ready, Holani entered his demonic form and flew up like a strange black crow bird. He hovered in the air for a moment before suddenly saying in a low voice, “I see it.”After saying that, he dove down, he raised his hand and pulled out a bow and arrow that he had borrowed from the demon general. He aimed at the peaceful surface of the lake and shot it.
With a whoosh, the sound of the arrow piercing through the surface of the lake pierced into the lake.
The Arrow’s penetration was strong but the resistance of the water was stronger.
Dudian and the others who were lying in wait by the edge of the forest held their breath. Suddenly, a roar echoed from the Ice Lake. Bang! Bang! Countless explosions were heard. The ice on the surface of the lake was broken, it was like a mirror that fell to the ground.
A black shadow was thrown out of the lake and swept towards Holani.
Holani was shocked and quickly dodged. The Black Shadow swept over and hit the surface of the lake like a whip. It created thousands of waves. The water splashed in the air but turned into ice. The next moment.., there was another fierce roar from the bottom of the lake. All the water droplets that were about to fall into the ice rushed up like sharp thorns. They were like thousands of arrows that covered most of the sky.
Holaney’s face changed. He used his wings to protect his body. However, when the ice droplets fell on his wings, he still felt cold and pain. His heart was shocked, although he had expected the strength of this ice dragon to be extraordinary, but he didn’t expect it to be so terrifying. Just the sound of the ice droplets could hurt him!
Dudian, Barker and Monica’s eyes flashed with a trace of shock. Although they weren’t Holaney’s guards, but they were experts after all.
“This is definitely not an ordinary abyss…”Dudian’s heart was cold.
At this time, a burst of white water shot out from the lake towards Holaney.
Holaney hurriedly dodged. At the same time, he raised his height and flew towards the lake.
Roar!
A dragon roar was heard. The lake water rolled and washed to the shore. The next moment, the surface of the lake rose. A huge figure flew out from the lake and covered the sky. Everyone felt that the sky above them had darkened.
Dudian’s mouth was slightly open. He was stunned.
What kind of huge dragon was this? The dragon’s wings were as big as a sail. Its body was leaning towards the structure of a Western Dragon. However, it didn’t have the feeling of a salamander’s big belly. The upper body of its head was leaning towards a flood dragon. There were many sharp horns on its head, the shadow that he saw in the lake was the slender tail behind it!
The tail alone was more than ten meters long!
The surrounding hunters including Monica and Barker were also stunned.
Could This ancient God be a match for it?
The first thought that came to Dudian’s mind was to turn around and run!
Even if he saw the ice dragon in front of him, he wouldn’t be able to see the heat fluctuations in its body. The latter should be a cold-blooded creature. Its scales and sharp blades were like ice, what kind of creature would grow a substance like ice on its body?

chapters.title: Chapter 910
chapters.content:
Chapter 910 – Chapter 900: Evaluation Error
The Arctic ice dragon that flew out of the lake chased after Holani. Before Holani could reach the shore, it had already caught up to him. It spat out a cloud of white mist from the dragon’s mouth, and Holani’s body was instantly covered in a layer of frost, the flapping speed of his wings also slowed down.
Holani was both shocked and anxious. The sharp thorns on his wings protruded out, shaking off the frost and diving toward the ground. However, the Arctic ice dragon was even faster. Its dragon claws descended from the sky and actually grabbed Holani in one go.
Dudian’s face was full of fear as he struggled. The claws contracted and made cracking sounds. Blood oozed out from the corner of his mouth: “Save Me! I Can’t Hold On!”
Dudian and the others who were lying in ambush by the edge of the forest were stunned by this scene. Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of hesitation when he heard the roar of the Ice Dragon. He could see that the ice dragon wasn’t pretending but was really panicking. The reason why he hesitated was because he was worried about the ice dragon. It had only been a few seconds since he had captured Holani. He might not be able to contend with such power.
At this time, he had already given up.
Although it sounded ridiculous but it was the truth. He wasn’t a rookie. He could see the power of the ice dragon at a glance. It would be difficult for them to gain any advantages, let alone kill it, unless Barker and the others were hiding power beyond his imagination.
Monica whispered: “We have to restrain it. We can’t wait any longer. Otherwise something will happen to him.”
Barker’s face was serious. It was unknown what was going on in his eyes. He looked at dudian: “What do you think?”
Dudian’s heart was moved as he looked at Barker. He suddenly understood that the relationship between the wall master and Monica wasn’t as close as he had previously shown, they weren’t on the same side. Although he didn’t say it but Dudian could see that Barker wanted to give up or continue to wait to force out his trump card.
Monica saw that Dudian and Barker didn’t say anything. She understood their thoughts. Her face slightly changed but she didn’t say anything. She looked up at Holani who was grabbed by the ice dragon’s claws. Her eyes were deep.
Holani roared twice. He saw that there was no movement on the edge of the forest. There was no response from his personal guards. He was angry and cold at the same time. He didn’t expect Dudian and the others to help him, when the cold air spread through his body, he clenched his teeth. A large amount of black mucus oozed out from the roots of his wings. It looked like he was sweating a lot.
More and more mucus oozed out and stuck to the dragon’s claws. The ice-like claws of the dragon suddenly emitted black smoke. The next moment, Horaney roared and struggled out of the dragon’s claws.
As soon as he struggled out of the dragon’s claws, he rushed into the forest.
Dudian’s eyes focused as he saw Holaney escape. The black mucus seemed to be poisonous gas. As soon as it appeared in the air, there was a strange smell which made his head dizzy, it seemed that this was one of Holaney’s trump cards. Although he knew that Holaney was good at using poison, he didn’t expect the toxicity to be so terrible. Just smelling the smell would make him uncomfortable. It should be known that his anti-poison ability was not weak, the other pioneers who smelled this smell were most likely already feeling very uncomfortable.
Roar!
The Extreme Frost Ice Dragon seemed to be angry. A large amount of cold air came out from its palm, freezing the sticky black liquid. It twisted its body and chased after Horeni again.
Horeni rushed straight into the forest. The Extreme Frost Ice Dragon followed closely behind. When its head reached the edge of the forest, a burst of fire suddenly shot out from the sand, instantly enveloping the extreme frost ice dragon like a sea of fire, it was the hunter group that was lying in ambush at the edge of the forest.
At the same time, hundreds of arrows were shot out from the forest. The fire cut through the air and hit the Ice Dragon’s head and wings. The sound of the arrows hitting metal was heard, some of the arrows hit the leaves of the forest and lit up the fire.
Dudian, Monica and Barker who were hiding behind the trees immediately took action. Now that the task was completed, it was time for them to take action.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Monica and Barker took the lead and rushed out. Monica’s skin turned Snow White. Snow White powder fell from her body and wings. Under the control of her wings.., the wind blew onto the Arctic ice dragon’s body and touched its head and sharp claws. Barker rushed in front of the Arctic ice dragon and swung his bone sword at its claws.
With a whoosh, the bone sword left a shallow mark on the dragon’s claws. The huge recoil force hit back, causing Barker’s wrist to hurt. His pupils constricted. At this moment, he clearly realized.., this ice dragon was more terrifying than what he had expected!
Roar!
The Ice Dragon roared and waved its claws at Barker. Barker quickly dodged and narrowly avoided the dragon’s claws.
Dudian had rushed out of the ice dragon’s side. He quickly entered the magic body state. The sharp blades on his body were raised as he slashed towards the side of the Ice Dragon!
The ice dragon suddenly stopped attacking Barker. It flapped its wings and flew up. At the same time it let out a loud roar. It looked down at Dudian who had missed. Its dark blue eyes were filled with mania, it opened its mouth and spat out a large amount of cold air.
Dudian was startled. He didn’t expect that the ice dragon would dodge. Moreover he felt that the ice dragon’s emotions had suddenly become intense. It seemed that it was angered. He didn’t dare to welcome the White Frost and quickly descended.
“DAMN!”Barker saw that Dudian’s sneak attack had failed. His face was ugly as he looked at Monica: “Your move seems to be useless. Call Holaney over. The three of us will restrain it and let Dudian attack alone!”
The previous plan of the few of them was to let Dudian attack. After all, Dudian’s attack ability was stronger than any of them. Monica’s ability was biased towards perception. Although her attack wasn’t weak.., her methods were a bit strange but her frontal attack was far from enough. Even if the ice dragon stood still and let her attack, it would be difficult to hurt its lifeblood.
Monica took a deep breath. She knew that she should take out her trump card. Otherwise, she wouldn’t be able to play any role in this battle.
Just when she was about to attack again, the loud roar of the ice dragon echoed from the sky. The next moment, the ice dragon swooped down and chased after dudian.
Dudian’s face changed as he rushed to the side of Barker and the others.
Barker quickly flew up and waved his bone sword towards the claws of the Arctic ice dragon. However the Arctic ice dragon was much more manic than before. It waved its claws and hit Barker to the ground at lightning speed.
The Arctic ice dragon didn’t even look at him as it continued to chase after Dudian.
Dudian was stunned as he saw the situation behind him. He felt that the Arctic ice dragon seemed to be targeting him!
I haven’t even touched you yet and you are holding a grudge?
He couldn’t help but curse in his heart. However his feet didn’t stop as he ran towards Holaney who was resting on the branches of the forest.
Holaney’s face turned black as he saw Dudian rush towards him. He wanted to rest for a while and force dudian and the others to use their trump cards. The previous luring action had exceeded his expectations, he thought that he would be able to successfully lure the ice dragon to the edge of the forest and fall into an ambush. However he almost fell into the trap. The Ice Dragon’s strength was much stronger than he had imagined, it was definitely not the level 372 monster that was assessed in the atlas.
“Help me to restrain it.”Dudian shouted as he saw Holaney.
Holaney’s mouth twitched but he still got up and flew towards the ice dragon behind Dudian.
Roar! !
The ice dragon saw Horaney rushing towards it. It seemed to feel threatened but it didn’t want to stop. It roared loudly.
The leaves of the tree rustled. The next moment, the ice dragon opened its mouth and spat out snow-white cold air.
Horaney’s face changed as he quickly dodged.
The cold air swept over and froze all the trees it touched into ice sculptures.

chapters.title: Chapter 911
chapters.content:
Chapter 911 – Chapter 901: Annihilation
Dudian felt the temperature in the air drop. It was early summer but he felt as if he was frozen. The cold air in his right hand seemed to be ready to move. The cold air flowed into his body through his blood, it made him shiver.
The Arctic ice dragon chased after Dudian.
Dudian was so angry that he turned around and ran away.
The Arctic ice dragon didn’t chase after Dudian. He was relieved. He looked at the Arctic ice dragon who was chasing after Dudian. It seemed that he didn’t miss anything, it was reasonable that Dudian didn’t hurt the old dragon. Why was it staring at Dudian?
At this time, Monica and Barker caught up with them. Barker was angry as he saw that Holaney was still in the tree, “Why didn’t you make a move? The old dragon’s scales are too thick. Only he can be hurt. If something happens to him, the operation will fail!”
Holaney came back to his senses and looked at him, he frowned: “It’s not that I don’t want to make a move. It’s that I can’t stop it. It is determined to kill him. I don’t know what he has done to anger it. I think our current plan needs to be changed. Since the old dragon wants to kill him, we will let him lure and restrain him. We will attack him. I don’t believe that the three of us can’t hurt him. If that’s the case then we should retreat!”
Barker was startled as he saw the ice dragon chasing after Dudian. His eyes flashed as he decisively said: “Alright, let’s Go!”
“There is no rush. He should be fine for a while.”Holaney suddenly said.
Barker looked at him: “What do you mean?”
“Didn’t you see? The undeads that he is controlling haven’t moved yet. It means that this guy still has some strength left. He doesn’t need our help. I want to see what else he is hiding. This is a good opportunity.”Holaney licked his lips, a cold light flashed in his eyes.
Barker understood and fell silent.
“I think we should chase after him as soon as possible. Although this guy is young, he’s not someone to be trifled with. If we force him into a corner, just like he said, we’ll just leave. Our losses will be too great.”Monica saw that the two of them were prepared to wait, she immediately spoke up.
Barker’s heart trembled: “That’s right. This kid might really do it. Let’s catch up with him.”
Holaney frowned. He wanted to say something but held back. He didn’t know Dudian’s character. If they were to leave then it would be awkward for them to stay. If they were to leave then.., they would lose a lot of people this time. Even a group of them would die on the way back.
The three of them quickly caught up to Dudian. But they were far away from the polar ice dragon and Dudian. The three of them were trying their best to catch up but the distance wasn’t getting closer. Instead, it was getting farther and farther. The three of them were more and more surprised, when the polar ice dragon was four or five miles away from them, the three of them were shocked.
They could understand that the ice dragon was fast, but the ice dragon was chasing after Dudian. It didn’t turn back or even stop until now. It meant that it hadn’t caught up! This also meant that Dudian was faster than the Ice Dragon!
Dudian didn’t think that he was fast. At the moment he wished that he had more legs or wings. He felt that he had used up all his strength but the ice dragon was still biting him, it was like a long distance run. He could accelerate in a short time but it wouldn’t last for long. He only hoped that the ice dragon would exhaust its strength earlier.
However, his hope failed again and again.
He felt that his feet and wings were as heavy as lead. The ground under his feet pulled his feet like roots. His body would slow down when he felt tired. It was as if he had triggered a self-protection mechanism.
However, humans had another layer of protection mechanism. They were afraid of death.
Dudian didn’t want to die. Although he was very tired, he still ran fast. He clenched his teeth again and again and increased his speed. He used the corner of his eyes to look behind him. The huge shadow was always hanging over his head, the cold air swept from behind him. It seemed that if he was a step late, he would be drowned by the blizzard.
He saw Barker and the other two who were chasing after the ice dragon. But they were too far away from each other. He wanted to turn around and beat them up. He didn’t expect that the three of them would gang up on him, he had noticed the three of them when they were discussing on the tree. But now they were slowly hanging behind him. It was clear that they wanted to see him being forced into a desperate situation.
Dudian clenched his teeth. He suddenly had an idea. He slowly slowed down and paid attention to the ice dragon behind him. When his speed slowed down, the ice dragon suddenly closed the distance, it opened its mouth and spat out a mouthful of cold air.
Dudian quickly dodged and went to the other side.
The neck of the ice dragon was very long. It twisted its head and neck. The continuous cold air swept over. All the trees in its path were frozen into ice. Even the poisonous snakes and insects hidden in the trees were turned into ice sculptures.
Dudian continued to run around in circles. He found that the Arctic ice dragon’s body would stop when it spat out cold air. Although it was still flying forward but its speed was very slow, he didn’t know if it was to control the cold air that it spat out.
After the cold air swept around, it didn’t Touch Dudian. The Arctic ice dragon roared and rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian jumped down from the tree and landed on the forest floor. He turned and ran.
Bang Bang Bang!
The sound of trees breaking sounded. The wings of the ice dragon touched the big tree. It was like two huge metal knives that destroyed the trees. Its claws fell from the sky and hit Dudian.
Dudian’s face changed. He accelerated and rushed forward 20-30 meters. He felt the ground behind him shake. It was the sound of the dragon claws hitting the ground. He turned around and rushed towards the direction of Holani and the others.
The trio saw the direction where Dudian was running. They knew what Dudian was planning. They cursed in their hearts but they still rushed forward.
“Hurry Up!”Dudian shouted as he sprinted again.
Roar!
The Arctic ice dragon landed in the forest. It took big steps and ran over. The forest was shaking.
The monsters that were lurking in the forest were scattered and fled. There were no stupid undeads here. All the monsters could feel the terrifying pressure of the Arctic ice dragon.
Hoolani flew faster than Monica and Barker. He looked at Dudian who was running towards him. He was about to open his mouth but Dudian ran past him. He didn’t look back as he ran towards the lake.
Hoolani’s face turned black. The next moment his entire figure was shrouded in shadow. The Ice Dragon looked at Hoolani and the other two who were in front of him. It roared at the sky. The scales on its body suddenly emitted a large amount of cold air.
Barker’s eyes focused as he pulled out his sword to protect his body.
Countless ice arrows were shot out from the hazy cold air.
The three men’s faces changed as they hurriedly waved their weapons to parry. However, the ice arrows were extremely strong. After continuous parry, the weapons in their hands were frozen by the shattered ice arrows.
“Damn it! I can’t block it!”Hoolani clenched his teeth. He saw that Dudian had disappeared without a trace. He had no intention to attack the ice dragon.
Barker waved his bone sword in a circle. However he missed a few ice arrows. He pulled out his shoulder. There was no blood in his wound, he shouted: “Let’s retreat to the lake. The three of us are too tired.”
Hoolani couldn’t wait for him to say that. He turned around and ran.
Roar!
At this time, the ice dragon’s body was covered in ice mist. It let out a long roar. Dozens of sharp ice thorns shot out from the ice mist. They swept towards Hoolani like a rattan whip.
Holani’s pupils constricted, and his body hurriedly dodged. However, there were too many ice thorns. He dodged four in a row, but was pierced through the chest by the fifth Ice Thorn, and his entire body was nailed into the forest.
“Not good!”Barker’s expression changed drastically, and he quickly retreated.
The ice thorns that swarmed over seemed to have stopped in front of Barker because the distance was not enough. In the next moment, the ice fog slowly dispersed, and the figure of the ice dragon appeared once again. As soon as it appeared, Barker and Monica were stunned, their faces instantly turned extremely pale.
At this moment, the appearance of the Arctic ice dragon had changed drastically. Although its body still retained its previous dragon form, its body was covered with snake-like ice tentacles that danced softly like fur.
Whoosh!
Barker came back to his senses and turned around to run without looking back.
Monica heard the movement and woke up in shock. She also quickly ran behind Barker.
The Dragon’s roar came from behind again. Barker looked back and saw that the ice spike that had nailed Holani to the ground had been lifted up. It had pierced Holani’s body. At this moment, his chest had been completely pierced, no matter what ability he had, such an injury was enough to cause serious injury. When the ice spike was lifted up, Holani struggled violently and suddenly waved his weapon to cut off the ice spike.
In the next moment, his body fell together with the half of the ice spike that had pierced through his body. However, before he landed on the ground, more than ten ice spikes attacked again. They intersected with each other and intertwined together like sea urchins.
Where the ice spikes intersected, Holeney’s body was completely pierced through and he was completely dead.
Barker and Monica saw this scene. The two of them were somewhat in disbelief and at the same time, they were somewhat terrified. They had killed Holeney by relying on ice alone. This time, they knew that Holeney was not acting.., he was really dead. After all, even his head had been pierced. There was no chance of survival. Horaney most likely still had some hidden cards, but unfortunately, he did not have the time to use them.
Or rather, even if he used them, it would not change anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 912
chapters.content:
Chapter 912 – Chapter 902: A Landslide Defeat
Dudian noticed the situation behind them. He felt cold in his heart when he saw that Horaney was killed by the Polar Ice Dragon. It hadn’t been long since they had lost an abyss teammate. So far, they hadn’t had a direct confrontation with the Polar Ice Dragon!
Run!
Dudian didn’t have the idea to kill the polar ice dragon to find the polar ice worm. The price to pay was too high. Not only would he die, but Aisha would also be in trouble. He didn’t want to take the risk.
Barker and Monica woke up as Dudian ran at full speed. They looked at the polar ice dragon that was rushing towards them and the ice spikes that were constantly protruding from the ground. Although they were barely able to remain calm, however there was a trace of panic in their eyes. They couldn’t get close to Dudian because of the cold air that could be frozen into ice. Now they could control the cold air to turn into ice. The key was that they were very fast, their eyes could barely catch the shadow of the ice spikes.
It didn’t take long for Dudian to run to the lakeside. He looked at the hunters who were lying in ambush. They probably didn’t know that Holani was dead but some of them seemed to have sensed something.
Dudian stopped his body and called Aisha to his side. He turned around and looked at Barker and Monica who were running at full speed. He saw the continuous attacks of the ice blades and the huge body of the Arctic ice dragon, he took a deep breath and shouted: “Come over here and fight back!”
Barker and Monica were busy dodging the ice dragon’s sharp blades. They couldn’t help but look at Dudian’s words. They almost got hit by the sharp blades.
Dudian looked at the two who were rushing over. His eyes flashed with a trace of coldness. He stamped his feet and shouted: “Prepare to fight back!”
Barker and Monica were shocked as they didn’t know where Dudian had the courage to counterattack. The strength of this ice dragon wasn’t at the level of the Abyss. The Monster Atlas was wrong, it was already good enough that they could barely escape.
However they didn’t stop Dudian as he rushed over.
Barker’s body slightly turned as if he was going to turn around. The moment Dudian was close to him he suddenly stabbed his sword towards Dudian!
“Don’t blame me…”Barker’s heart was cold but a crisp sound interrupted his thoughts. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes. He saw that Dudian’s sharp blade blocked the bone sword in his hand.
“How…”Barker felt incredulous. How could he guard against the speed and suddenness of the sword?
Could it be..
He suddenly understood. There was some joy in his heart and some anger. At the same time, he felt a trace of fear.
Dudian’s feeling was similar to Barker’s. He didn’t expect that his sneak attack would be blocked. After a moment of shock, he understood. He opened his body like a hedgehog and all the sharp blades shot out.
Barker was shocked and angry. He tried to parry but his bone sword was cut off. This bone sword was the hardest material that he had demonized. It was cut off just like that.
The sword was broken but he wasn’t able to parry Dudian’s other sharp attacks. His body was pierced through dozens of holes and his arm was cut off. Monica saw everything that happened in an instant. She even thought of launching a sneak attack, but she didn’t have the time to attack.
She was shocked when she saw that Barker was defeated and seriously injured. Although she knew that Dudian was good at attacking. But she didn’t expect that the mysterious Barker.., it should be known that there was no time to delay. The ice dragon was chasing after them. No matter what cards Barker had, this moment of defeat would be fatal.
Dudian kicked Barker’s chest and sent him flying back. He didn’t have time to continue to attack Monica. If the sneak attack on Barker was successful.., there was still a chance for him to attack again. Monica was already on guard against him. If they continued to fight, they would all become food for the ice dragon.
He controlled Aisha to turn around and fly to the other side of the lake.
Barker’s body flew backward. His face was extremely ugly. The injuries on his body healed quickly. This was his core ability. His biggest trump card was the “Immortal body”!
The immortal body wasn’t really immortal.
Barker wasn’t afraid of dealing with Dudian. No matter how his body was damaged, he would be able to heal. He would be able to come back to life and recover, because his magic body was beyond the range of human life. His brain wasn’t the core of his body. Neither was his heart. Instead, his bones were the core of his body.
He basically did not care about fighting against other abysses as long as they did not have the ability to corrode. His life-saving ability could be considered top-notch in the abysses. However, no matter how many times he could be heavier.., under the attack of the Extreme Frost Ice Dragon’s cold air, it would lose its meaning.
Ice and fire were two extremes. Fire was the nemesis of all things, and ice was the same.
He controlled his bone wings to stabilize his body, but the cold air coming from his back made him feel his body slowly stiffen, and even his mind slowly stiffen. In an instant, only the terrifying thought of death remained in his mind.
At this moment, he suddenly became no different from an ordinary person.
In the face of death, it seemed that no one was an exception.
The thick cold air spread over, and Barker’s body quickly froze. His bone wings could no longer flap, and his body slowly fell to the ground. His feet shattered into a few pieces of ice.
Monica, who was running at full speed toward the lake, saw Barker’s miserable state. She was both shocked and sad. She did not expect that the target of a long-planned hunt would be herself in the end.
Monica quickly flew to the lake, but the extreme frost ice dragon followed closely behind. The hunting group that was lying in ambush by the lake immediately rushed out from under the soil and the leaves of the forest. Like a group of moths flying toward fire, they rushed toward the Extreme Frost Ice Dragon.
Their figures were majestic and fearless, revealing all kinds of strange demonic bodies. Their postures were ferocious, and they seemed to be filled with power, or their forms were strange, as if they had a magical ability. However, the moment they got close to the extreme frost ice dragon.., cold air spread out from under the scales of the extreme frost ice dragon, like a small hurricane spreading out.
