Then, everyone was like fallen leaves in the autumn wind, falling and falling, one after another, they fell to the ground, turning into ice sculptures, their expressions were lifelike. Some opened their mouths and cried out, some looked terrified, some looked shocked, and some looked desperate.
The ice dragon’s claws stepped over, and the frozen people were crushed. Ice shards flew everywhere, and the ice dragon continued to chase after them.

chapters.title: Chapter 913
chapters.content:
Chapter 913 – Chapter 903: The Pursuit
Monica’s face turned ugly as she saw the hunters fall one after another. She had been looking forward to the sea of people tactic but it was completely ineffective. She knew that the sea of people tactic was useless in the face of a real monster, however the hunters weren’t ordinary soldiers. The weakest of them was at the level of 10,000 people. There was a master leading the team. Even if the abyss was surrounded by so many people, they might not be able to escape unscathed.
However, the power of the polar ice dragon was beyond her imagination. Moreover, its ability was just enough to restrain the group attack tactics. Moreover, Holaney had died and Barker was frozen into an ice sculpture. The only ones left were her and Dudian, moreover, Dudian controlled the king of corpses.
At this point, she naturally wouldn’t seek cooperation with Dudian. Previously, Dudian took the risk to counterattack and sneak attack Barker. She felt that if Barker didn’t have the same intention.., she would be the next target after Dudian’s sneak attack hit. The reason why Dudian would take the opportunity to get rid of them was obvious. His goal was to have power in the giant wall!
If the giant wall master died and she and Holaney died then no one in the giant wall would be able to compete with Dudian.
God knows how many years would pass before the Kingdom of God knew about Barker’s death.
Her first thought was to rush back to the giant wall. She didn’t have any hope for the polar ice worm. She only hoped that she could return to the giant wall and stabilize the situation.
She flew over the lake and looked at the back of Dean and Aisha. Her eyes flashed as she turned around and flew away.
When Monica flew in another direction, the polar ice dragon rushed out from the encirclement of the hunters. There were dead bodies on the ground behind it. It roared in anger as it took off, the huge wings turned into a shadow that swept across the lake like scissors. It didn’t chase after Monica who was close to it. Instead, it ran in the direction of Dean who had already disappeared.
The rest of the hunters held their weapons and stayed in place. They didn’t dare to chase after Dudian. There were broken ice corpses all around them. They were friends who had been talking and laughing with Dudian.
The hunters reacted slowly but they knew that the so-called encirclement was a joke. They had been chased and killed by the ice dragon from the very beginning, the few abysses that they had pinned their hopes on didn’t have any effect. They only cared about running for their lives. When Monica’s figure disappeared into the forest, everyone knew that they had been abandoned.
Everyone looked miserable. Some were angry, some were desperate, some had tears on their faces, and some knelt and begged.
In the depths of the magic pit, they didn’t have the protection of the abysses. Staying here was death, and returning was also death.
Dudian and Aisha quickly moved forward in the ice forest. Along the way, they met many monsters with ice constitution. These monsters didn’t emit any heat source and were mixed with the forest. When Dudian approached.., some monsters were waiting for the opportunity to launch a sneak attack. However, before they could touch dudian, they were pierced by the protruding limbs of Dudian’s body. or they were cut into two halves.
The roar of the dragon came from the back. Dudian’s face slightly changed. He used his perception to look back and saw the giant body of the ice dragon flying in the air, the trees in the forest were bent by the strong wind. The roar of the dragon was mixed with anger and murderous intent. Dudian could clearly feel the intention of the old dragon to kill him.
Dudian hadn’t noticed the first and second time it was chasing after him. But now the ice dragon was still chasing after him. It completely ignored the others as if it had a deep enmity with him, he could basically guess what attracted it to him.
Except for the magic marks which were different from the three of them, there was only one difference. He had the power of the Aragami’s flesh and blood in his body.
Although he did not know how to control this power, the pale golden color on the blade of his magic body was enough to prove that the power of the Aragami had already seeped into every part of his body. In the past, when he was in Sylvia, he already knew that the Aragami was guarding the giant wall, it had a deterrent effect on the terrifying existences in the abyss. Similarly, the flesh and blood of the Aragami would also attract some powerful daemons. These daemons did not know how terrifying the flesh and blood of the Aragami was. Instead, they would be attracted to it.
It was very likely that the ice dragon was attracted by the smell of the flesh and blood of the Aragami.
Although he understood this but Dudian’s mood was more depressed and powerless. He couldn’t hide and remove the flesh and blood of the Aragami. This meant that he would be chased by the ice dragon until it didn’t want to chase him anymore.
But where was its bottom line?
Dudian desperately ran out of the forest. He only hoped that it would stop after they were out of the forest.
The Dragon’s roar was getting closer and closer. It seemed that it was coming from the top of Dudian’s head. The sound echoed in all directions. All the monsters living in the nearby forest fled in panic. It saved Dudian a lot of trouble.
Dudian ran as he felt the light above his head dim. He looked up and saw that the ice dragon had already caught up to him. His face changed and he began to run, however he had used up all his strength to run but he couldn’t change the fact that the distance between them was shortened. The Ice Dragon had grown an ice beard and was faster than before.
Roar!
The Ice Dragon opened its mouth and spat out cold air.
Dudian’s pupils shrank. The range of the cold air was too wide!
He quickly stopped but there was no time to dodge!
The cold air could freeze Barker, so naturally it could also freeze him. Once he was frozen, he would be completely finished!
“Aisha!”Dudian clenched his teeth and quickly shook the bell.
The short bell rang very frequently. Aisha, who had always been silent behind Dudian, suddenly had a trace of bloodlust in her eyes. The gauze on her cheeks automatically moved without wind, and her body rapidly changed, the bones in her body cracked. In the blink of an eye, she turned into a dragonman-like monster. Her body was covered with red scales. White spikes protruded from her back. Her beautiful face was covered with dragon scales and veins.
She looked up at the cold air that was falling from the sky. The snow-white tree was touched by the cold air. The tree was frozen. Under the strong wind, some of the tree tips were broken into pieces of ice.
Roar!
Aisha roared into the sky. Her voice was hoarse and was somewhat similar to the roar of the Ice Dragon.
A thick red light emerged from Aisha’s chest to her neck. It seemed to contain a ball of flame. When she opened her mouth, a lava-like flame shot out from her mouth and hit the cold air. In an instant, the cold air was shot into a hole, the flame was also quickly extinguished.
Dudian saw that he had won the opportunity and immediately controlled Aisha to rush out of the cold air hole with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 914
chapters.content:
Chapter 914 – Chapter 904: Joint Attack
As soon as he rushed out of the cold air hole, he saw the giant mouth of the extreme cold ice dragon coming towards him. Dudian’s pupils shrank and the wings on his back suddenly twisted. He used a lot of strength to change the trajectory of the dragon’s mouth, he dodged.
At the same time, the sharp limbs on Dudian’s body were like dozens of black soft swords. He stabbed towards the neck of the dragon.
The sound of cutting rang out. The sharp limbs that had always been indestructible cut into the dragon’s neck less than half a meter. The momentum was greatly reduced. It was like an ordinary sword cutting into the gravel and mud. It was blocked. It could only pierce more than half a meter before it could no longer go deeper, it could only use the momentum of the polar ice dragon’s gliding to cut a dozen wounds.
Roar!
The Polar Ice Dragon roared in anger. It flapped its wings and flapped towards Dean. At the same time, it twisted its huge body and turned to attack Dean again.
Dudian didn’t care about Haisha anymore. Otherwise, both of them might die here.
He released his control over Haisha and let her fall into a bloodthirsty battle state.
Roar! !
The same roar that didn’t lose to the ice dragon came out of Haisha’s mouth. The scales and claws on her body increased by a few inches. Her body was slightly larger. At the same time, there was a flame under the scales on her chest and neck, the Flames were getting more and more intense. It seemed that the scales could no longer be suppressed. The next moment, her whole body was burning with flames. She turned into a burning drakonid.
In the burning state, she rushed toward the dozens of wounds on the dragon’s neck. Her sharp claws instantly grabbed the dragon’s neck. She opened her mouth. Her white teeth were extremely sharp, her beautiful face became extremely ferocious and even ugly. When she opened her mouth, there seemed to be a flame spurting out from the depths of her throat. The next moment, she fiercely bit the dragon’s neck wound.
The Arctic ice dragon seemed to feel the terror and threat. Its cry became more urgent and angry. However, its size was too big. It couldn’t avoid Aisha who had already grabbed its neck. Its head couldn’t twist and bite Aisha, until Aisha bit it.
The hot flame flowed out from the gap of Aisha’s mouth. The flame spread along the place where Aisha bit. It was like magma or blood. It violently rushed into the neck of the ice dragon and dyed its ice-like neck red, the flame spread farther and farther and suddenly exploded.
Bang! The explosion pushed Aisha away. Even Dean was sent flying.
Dudian tried his best to stabilize his body as he was sent flying. He didn’t want to touch the cold air around him.
But at the moment his eyes were sad and even a little painful.
He didn’t want to let Haisha participate in the battle because he didn’t want to see her face that was as pure as an angel. She had such a crazy and bloodthirsty expression on her face. But the reality always oppressed him and forced him to struggle to survive.
After Aisha was sent flying, she fell into the cold air. However, her body was not frozen. Instead, the cold air rushed out of her body. By the time she fell to the ground, she had already reduced the impact to the minimum. As she rolled, she landed on the ground. With a tap of her toes.., once again, she charged toward the Arctic ice dragon like an arrow leaving the bow.
A large amount of cold air spewed out from the neck of the Arctic ice dragon. It twisted its head and looked at Aisha who was flying toward it again. It roared and spat out an icicle that shot toward Aisha like raindrops.
Aisha waved her dragon claws and used an extremely complicated set of blocking skills with high fighting memory. However, she was still unable to dodge the icicles. Her body was pierced by the icicles one after another. The strength of the icicles was strong.., the icicles broke through the hard scales on her body. However, before the icicles could pierce deeper, they were melted by the flames on the surface of her body. They spread like Steam. It looked like her body was covered in flames but it was covered in hot steam.., she still fearlessly rushed over.
Dudian was paying attention to Haisha’s safety at all times. Seeing that she was injured, his heart was immediately raised. But soon he found that her performance was a bit strange. Compared to the past when she fought purely based on instinct, now she used skills, whether it was the first time she aimed at her wound or chose to use fire to attack, there was a purpose. Did she also know that using fire to attack the Polar Ice Dragon had additional damage?
If that was the case, didn’t it mean that she had intelligence?
Was it the recovery of memory or the evolution of intelligence?
Dudian’s face changed. Although he didn’t want to admit that Aisha was the king of the undead but the truth couldn’t be changed. He had to face the truth if he wanted to cure Aisha, he had to consider the change of the king of the undead. The general king of the undead would eventually evolve intelligence. No one knew whether it was the recovery of memory or the change from ignorance to growth as a new species of corpse.
When he was attracted by Aisha’s changes, Aisha and the Extreme Frost Dragon fought again. Aisha’s body was full of flames. She was like a newborn dragon. She roared and fought with the Extreme Frost Dragon, like a newborn warrior challenging the king of the old generation, the Extreme Frost Dragon Roared. For a time, it couldn’t do anything to Aisha. Instead, Aisha cut several wounds on its body that couldn’t be healed.
Dudian quickly woke up and joined the battle.
He took advantage of the situation where Aisha was in front of him and quietly flew over from the side. He went around the tail of the Arctic ice dragon. The sharp blades on its body rotated like a fan. The sharp sound of friction was heard as it suddenly slashed down.
Several sharp blades overlapped and chopped at the same place. In an instant, they entered the tail of the Arctic ice dragon and cut a huge wound. Almost the entire tail was cut off from the root.
The Arctic ice dragon had noticed Dudian but it didn’t pay attention to him. It turned around and opened its mouth to spit ice thorns at Dudian.
Dudian’s body was full of sharp blades. It seemed that there were countless swords blocking the ice thorns. However the impact of the ice thorns was very strong. Each of the ice thorns was like a boxer’s fist, his body was hit by the two icicles. The cold air spread and almost froze his body.
Dudian didn’t dare to meet the attack. He turned sideways to escape.
At this time, Aisha took the opportunity to pounce on the belly of the Arctic ice dragon. Her dragon claws grabbed onto its snow-white belly. The burning dragon claws quickly dug deep into its belly. She opened her mouth and bit. The sharp blades on her back stood up, dragon scales grew out of her flesh wings. They all stood up like the tip of a wing. The tip of the wings instantly became as sharp as a knife. It carried flames as it stabbed towards the ice dragon’s belly.
The Ice Dragon roared in pain. Its dragon claws touched Aisha’s body.
Aisha hit the ground like a meteorite and knocked down a tree.
Dudian’s eyes turned red. He roared and rushed towards the ice dragon. The sharp blades on his body stood up as he crazily cut the roots of its tail and the end of its spine. In the blink of an eye, hundreds of fine cuts were made.
The dragon’s tail which was cut in half was cut off. It fell from the sky and shook the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 915
chapters.content:
Chapter 915 – Chapter 905: Brain Worm
The extreme cold ice dragon hissed in pain. The pain of its broken tail made it mad. As Dudian continued to cut its back, a sharp ice blade shot out from the root of its broken tail. Puff! Puff! It pierced through Dudian’s ribs, it pierced through its body.
Splitter’s weakness was revealed at this moment. Its defense was far weaker than Aisha’s magic dragon. Dudian was stimulated by the pain and cold. He didn’t expect that there would be a sharp ice blade from its broken tail, he was caught off guard. He felt a burning pain in his chest. It was cold and hot. He quickly cut off the limbs of the blades. His body flew out and rushed towards the direction where Aisha fell.
He saw Aisha shoot up from the dust. Her body was burning with flames as she screamed and rushed towards the ice dragon.
Dudian was relieved to see that she was not injured. He was a bit hesitant. Anger was anger. He knew that it was too difficult for him and Aisha to kill the old dragon, moreover, he was already injured. After pulling out the ice blade from his ribs, the blood stopped. However, his chest was in extreme pain. At this time, he wished that his body could also lose the sense of pain like his right arm.
Although he wanted to retreat, he still chased after her and let Aisha stop the ice dragon alone. The consequences were unimaginable.
Roar! !
The Ice Dragon looked up at the sky and wailed. It was full of anger and pain. Its body fell from the sky. It waved its dragon wings and created a hurricane that pushed Aisha away. Its body fell heavily to the ground and crushed the forest.
Aisha stopped her body and rushed towards the Arctic ice dragon again. It seemed that she would not rest until she was dead.
The Arctic ice dragon opened its mouth and spat out cold air. The cold air was wrapped with countless sharp blades and shot towards Aisha like raindrops.
The Flames on the surface of Aisha’s body forced the cold air to disperse. She waved her dragon claws to smash the sharp blades. However, her body was still pierced by a few sharp blades. However, only a little bit of the scales were penetrated. The Flames melted and the wounds healed in a flash.
Dudian approached from the other side. He was less than 30 meters away from the Arctic ice dragon when he was noticed by the Arctic ice dragon.
Dudian was not Aisha so he didn’t dare to resist. His face slightly changed. He quickly turned around and retreated.
However, the Arctic ice dragon seemed to have noticed him. When he approached from the other side, the Arctic ice dragon sensed him again and used the cold air to force him back.
Dean saw that the Arctic ice dragon only cared about defense while he couldn’t get close for a while. Aisha was also blocked by the sharp blade of the Arctic ice dragon. She couldn’t get close. It seemed that she was temporarily in the upper hand, but the longer it dragged on.., dean and Aisha’s advantage was weaker. He had noticed that the surrounding cold air was getting thicker and thicker. If the Arctic ice dragon was an abyss-level human, he would even feel that the other party had used cold air to force it back several times.., perhaps it was only secondary. The real goal was to emit cold air and completely envelop the surroundings. When the nearby world completely fell into the cold air, it would be the domain of the Arctic ice dragon!
Moreover, Aisha’s entire body was bathed in fire. This fire was made from the fat and energy in her body. It consumed a lot of her body and couldn’t last long.
Thinking of this, Dean’s intention to retreat became stronger. After being pushed back again, he immediately shook the bell and called Aisha to open a path from the cold air and prepare to retreat.
After Aisha heard the bell, she stopped her attack and flew to Dean. Then she continued to fly forward. The burning flames on her body dispersed the white cold air like a beacon.
Dean followed closely behind and quickly fled.
He cut off one of the tail of the Arctic ice dragon. He felt that it should not chase after him anymore. Even if it wanted to chase, its speed was not as fast as before. For flying monsters, the tail was very useful, it was responsible for adjusting the balance and direction of the body. Without the tail, its speed would be greatly reduced.
Roar!
The Arctic Frost Dragon saw that Dean and Aisha had escaped. It roared angrily and flapped its wings. However, it didn’t chase after them.
In the blink of an eye, the cold air blocked the path behind them. It was hazy. Dean heard the Dragon’s roar from the white fog. His heart was slightly relieved. It didn’t take long for him and Aisha to rush out of the cold fog, they rushed towards the distance of the forest.
After leaving the cold fog, the flames on Aisha’s body gradually extinguished. There were some sticky blood vessels on the surface of her scales.
Dudian and Aisha flew thirty miles away before they slowly landed. Dudian saw that the ice dragon didn’t chase after them. He and Aisha landed on the branches of the forest. He looked around, he only saw a few small monsters hiding in the forest. There were no powerful characters, so he was relieved. He untied the magic body, and Aisha also untied the magic body.
After returning to human form, Dean immediately saw three bloody holes in the ribs of his chest. The flesh on the edge of the holes had stopped bleeding. He reached out and wiped it. It was very cold, and there was a bit of ice residue left.
The color of the ice residue was bright. It was frozen blood.
Dudian looked at Aisha. She had blood on the corner of her mouth and her arm was strangely bent. His heart suddenly tightened. He used X-ray to carefully look at it. It turned out that the bones in her arm were broken, his eyebrows slightly trembled a few times. He held her hand and slowly twisted it to align the bones. Then he took out the medicine and small scalpel from his backpack. He cut open her arm and removed the bone fragments from her arm. He then sutured the arm, he bandaged the wound.
Except for the arm, there was no major injury.
After Aisha was cured, Dudian sat on the branch next to her. He took off his armor and removed all the frozen rotten meat from the edge of the bloody hole. There was no anesthetic. He could only grimace and endure, after cutting off the rotten meat, he bandaged the wound with medicine.
His head was full of sweat. It was painful but also tiring. He leaned against the tree and took a deep breath. The air in the forest was very fresh. There was no movement from the back, dudian estimated that the old dragon would not chase after him.
“The hunting level is 372. It is really powerful.”Dudian muttered. His mood was a bit complicated. If his previous guess was correct.., the ice dragon should be one of the monsters that would be attracted to the flesh of the Aragami. The group that was afraid of the flesh of the Aragami was stronger than the Ice Dragon. It was the target of the Aragami’s remains.
He thought that he was one of the top people in the abyss.
However he was in such a sorry state in front of the ice dragon. He was in the Abyss but was killed in an instant. Barker’s life was unknown. Monica was lucky and most likely escaped.
What would happen to him if he met a monster that was afraid of the flesh and blood of the Aragami?
Dudian didn’t dare to think about it. The pressure in his heart was very great.
He didn’t know what kind of monster the Aragami had fought. But he knew that he was far from the Aragami. The smell of the Aragami could intimidate some terrifying existences. The Abyss was not the end of power, what was above the Abyss?
He didn’t know that he had spent a lot of effort to reach the abyss. But now he was even more confused.
Could it be that he had to create nuclear weapons in order to eliminate all obstacles?
If that was the case, wouldn’t it be another doomsday?
Dudian leaned against the tree as his thoughts drifted away. Many thoughts and confusion appeared in his heart, making him silent.
After resting for half an hour, Dudian and Aisha continued to move forward. Although the Arctic ice dragon didn’t chase after them, they were still in its territory and could appear at any time.
After half an hour, Dudian came to a high mountain. There was a cave on the mountainside where a seven to eight meter tall monster tiger was entrenched. This monster tiger looked like a tiger or a spider. Its body was strange, its strength was close to the master level. Dudian easily killed it. However, the monster’s green saliva almost touched Dudian’s body.
Although it was avoided but the green saliva fell on the rock. The seemingly hard rock melted in an instant. Moreover, it melted to ten meters deep into the soil before it slowly stopped.
Such a strong toxicity made Dudian’s expression change. He became more and more careful.
Although some monsters had weak physiques, but the toxicity was fierce. Even the abyss would be easily poisoned to death.
Dudian took a rest in the cave. He picked a few pieces of flesh from the monster’s body. He barbecued them and ate them together with Aisha to fill his stomach.
After eating and resting, Dudian was ready to wait for his injury to recover before rushing. This was a magic pit and he could meet the Abyss at any time. Although he had clairvoyance but the range of visibility was limited. Moreover he couldn’t use clairvoyance at all times, it was too strenuous for his eyes.
In the blink of an eye, three days passed.
Dudian and Haisha hid in the cave and ate the monster’s corpse. Dudian would recall the knowledge recorded on the super chip when he had nothing to do. In the past he had memorized it by rote so he could use it flexibly when he had time.
When he was tired of thinking about the knowledge, he would think about the previous battle and reflect on his mistakes.
Although Dean’s injury was heavier than Haisha’s, but his healing speed was faster than hers. Although Haisha’s constitution was strong, but the undead’s constitution made her injury almost permanent. Her self-healing ability was very poor.
However, Dean found that every time she ate fresh blood and flesh, her internal injury would heal faster.
After her injuries healed, Dudian didn’t directly leave the magic pit. Instead, he took Aisha back to the ice forest and quietly sneaked into the place where the previous battle had taken place.
There was almost no change in the forest for three days. The forest affected by the battle was still in a mess. The trees had collapsed. Dudian found the place where the dragon’s tail had fallen. However, the dragon’s tail was gone. There were many icicles scattered on the ground.
There were claw marks of the Arctic ice dragon on the ground. Dudian looked in the direction of the claw marks. He had returned to the Ice Lake.
Dudian went around the ice lake from the other side of the forest. He went to the place where he and the others were fighting with the Arctic ice dragon. Soon he found the corpse of the Arctic ice dragon. It was impaled on a sharp ice blade, the corpse was in tatters. Half of its face was impaled by the ice. Dudian couldn’t see its full appearance. However the clothes on its body were his. At the moment it had reverted back to its human form.
Dudian sighed in his heart as he saw the corpse of an abyss hanging in front of him. He touched Horaney’s corpse and used his X-ray vision to scan it.
He wanted to use x-ray vision to see if there was anything good hidden under Holaney’s clothes. He didn’t expect to see a strange thing in his body. It was a pale white worm that looked like a parasitic soul worm, it was two to three centimeters long. The worm was curled up in Holaney’s head. It seemed to be eating his brain tissue. It was the only living thing in his body!
Dudian thought of the information recorded by the Monster Research Institute. The parasitic soul worm in the body of the Hunter would die together with it.
He had seen many dead hunters.
But the information didn’t record the situation after the death of the Abyss. This was the first time he had seen the corpse of the Abyss!
Could this little worm be Holaney’s parasitic soul worm?
Dudian felt that there was an 80-90% possibility. After all, the temperature in the forest was so low. Holaney’s corpse was hard and almost frozen. It was impossible for it to be rotten.
Dudian stretched out his fingers and cut the top of Holaney’s head.
His fingernails were sharper than knives. Holaney’s scalp was cut open but the skull was very hard. Dudian couldn’t cut it open with his fingernails. However he used two fingers to stab into Holaney’s eye socket, dudian used his other hand to press his chin. He pulled the skull open and saw a small white worm squirming on the frozen brain tissue.
Dudian felt his scalp itch. He didn’t touch the little thing. Some monsters had strange abilities. Even the Abyss would fall. He took out the small bottle from his backpack and pulled a small branch from the side, he made a small wooden stick and gently poked the little worm.
The slow body of the little worm was touched by the wooden stick. It shrank into the depths of the brain tissue. Its speed was as fast as lightning. Dudian was shocked.
He immediately cut off the head of the little worm from the neck so that it wouldn’t run into his body.
He threw the head of the little worm onto the stone next to him. He used the wooden stick to slowly remove the brain tissue. The Little Worm had nowhere to hide and drilled into the nasal cavity of the little worm.
Dudian took out a scalpel and cut open Holani’s nose bone. He dug out the little worm and put it into a small bottle.
The little worm wriggled inside the bottle. Dudian raised it and looked at it. He suddenly found that the little worm’s body was covered with white hair. The hair was very thin and he didn’t notice it before.
The little worm’s movement slowed down after the hair was raised. Dudian was about to put it away when all the hair on the little worm’s body suddenly pierced into the bottle. The special hard glass bottle was broken, it should be known that even a burly man wouldn’t be able to break the bottle with a stone. But now it was broken by the little bug which was less than three centimeters.
After breaking the bottle, the little bug quickly fell to the ground. It quickly hid in the snow and rushed forward. In the blink of an eye, it ran to the place where Dudian couldn’t see.
When Dudian hurriedly looked at it with heat vision, he couldn’t see any heat source reaction.
Dudian looked at the broken glass bottle in his hand. His face slightly changed. What was this little worm? Apparently the parasitic soul worm didn’t have such destructive power!

chapters.title: Chapter 916
chapters.content:
Chapter 916 – Chapter 906: Dragon Hunting
Dudian thought for a moment and slowly turned away. He threw the broken bottle on the snow.
He went back to the forest by the lake. He could smell the faint smell of blood. If the temperature wasn’t low then the smell would be more obvious. Soon he saw the place where the hunters were ambushing. There were ice fragments and half of the head was frozen. There were broken arms, sternum and blood splattered on the white leaves, it was covered with pale ice like blood spots.
There were hundreds of hunters but there were only corpses on the ground. Dudian glanced at them. There weren’t many corpses. He estimated that there were at most a hundred of them. In other words, there were more than two hundred people left alive, but most of them had already left the place. The ice dragon had been chasing after him so he didn’t pay attention to them.
Dudian was silent as he looked at the arm that was frozen. From the armor on the arm it could be seen that it was Barker’s hand.
His body was frozen after Dudian kicked the ice dragon. He fell into the forest but Dudian only found his arm. He didn’t see any other limbs. He felt that Barker was probably not dead. Maybe he had left.
The Fierce Crusade eventually turned into a massacre and a farce. Dudian sighed. He was one of them. Sometimes he could see clearly but he might not be able to do it alone.
Looking at the frozen lake in the distance, Dudian estimated that the old dragon was probably recuperating in there. He was a bit unwilling. Originally he had given up on snatching the ice worm, but later when he cooperated with Aisha.., he found that the old dragon was not as powerful as he had imagined. Or rather, he had underestimated his own strength. From the previous performances of Holaney, Barker, and the others, he felt that he was stronger than the Abyss, he should be a bit stronger. In addition to Aisha’s flame, he could restrain the ice mist attack of the Polar Ice Dragon.
Although his chest was almost pierced through and he died on the spot, but the ice dragon also lost its tail. Both sides were injured.
“It would be good if this place is close to the giant wall. I can use the steel inside the giant wall to make several traps…”Dudian looked at the surrounding woods. His eyes flashed. He had some ideas about hunting the Arctic Frost Dragon.
It was the stupidest to rely on direct combat to hunt monsters. Previously, Holani, Barker and others were there. Moreover, the warriors of the hunting group were not Dudian’s subordinates. Dudian didn’t say anything, in fact he felt that with the cooperation of so many pioneers he could create a swamp trap. Even if the ice dragon was twice as strong it would be skinned alive.
At that time he was worried that the ice dragon wouldn’t be able to withstand a single blow from the combination of the four forces of the Abyss. If the ice dragon was killed soon.., it was their turn to fight for the polar ice insects. So he didn’t say much during the ambush. His goal was to consume the hunters under the command of Holaney. At the same time, he wanted to take the opportunity to see their true cards.
However, the situation was reversed at the beginning of the battle. The subsequent changes were too fast. It was too late to organize an effective ambush which led to a one-sided massacre.
Dudian felt that the extermination of the team had something to do with his selfishness. If he was in charge, with so many people present, he would be able to kill the old dragon even if his eyes were closed.
Dudian felt a bit regretful but he didn’t feel guilty or self-reproach. He believed that Barker and Monica also had the same idea, moreover, Holaney was aware of their thoughts. She was willing to cooperate with them to weaken the number of hunters. She didn’t plan to make traps for a long time.
It was a pity that the ice dragon had shown its strong power. It made their small thoughts and scheming look ridiculous and sad.
Dudian felt that he had the opportunity to kill the old dragon. It was just that it would take a long time for him to prepare the traps.
In the ancient times, there was a huge gap between the strength of humans and beasts. However, they had created a wooden spear and dared to fight with the bloodthirsty beasts. It was the will to survive and the spirit of a hunter, the gap between the strength of Dudian and the ice dragon was smaller than the gap between a normal human and a tiger. It wasn’t a one-sided slaughter. At least he could fight back.
So he felt that there was no reason for him to retreat.
Dudian had been thinking about this matter for the past few days. He hesitated but in the end he decided to return to this place. He looked at the situation. The lake was calm but he felt that it was necessary to try, after all, once he succeeded in obtaining the polar ice worm, his strength would increase by a lot. At his level, he couldn’t rely on the resources in the giant wall to increase his strength. He could only look for opportunities in the wilderness outside the giant wall.
The current adventure was also to prepare for his future arrival in the Kingdom of God. In the place where humans lived, he needed more strength. This kind of opportunity was hard to come by. He didn’t want to be weak in the Kingdom of God in the future, he was bullied and schemed but he couldn’t resist. That was another cruel world. The price of being weak was also bloody.
Dudian took Aisha and sat down at the edge of the forest. He looked at the surrounding environment and thought about the layout of the trap. Although the body of the ice dragon was hard and invulnerable, but it used trees as arrows and rattan as bows, if the pulling force was enough, it could still cause a lot of damage and impact to it. If one tree was not enough, then ten. With the size of three to five people hugging a giant tree in the forest, the force of the ejection would definitely not be good.
Moreover, the ice dragon was huge. Although its flying speed was very fast, but its turn was not flexible enough. These were its weaknesses.
In the blink of an eye, a few hours had passed. Dudian thought of several hunting plans. He was about to get up to cut trees and make traps. Suddenly he felt the ground tremble slightly. His heart skipped a beat as he looked at the lake.
The surface of the lake was as calm as a mirror. After two or three seconds it suddenly rose. The ice on the surface of the lake quickly broke. A huge figure jumped out of the lake. Water splashed all over its body. Its huge scissor-like wings spread out, it was the Arctic Ice Dragon!
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he held his breath.
The tail of the Arctic ice dragon had grown out but it was much shorter than the previous one. After it landed on the shore, it shook its body and walked towards the forest. Its claws were pressed on the ground, the sound was low.
Dudian was relieved. He almost thought that it had noticed him. If it wasn’t for the fact that the location of the old dragon was on the opposite side of the lake, he would have turned around and fled.
“The healing speed is quite fast. Could it be that it came ashore to search for food?”Dudian’s eyes flashed. The previous battle was more intense. For these large monsters, they needed to fill tons of food to replenish their energy, it was normal for them to come out to hunt.
Dudian didn’t leave. He was going to wait for it to return to the lake to cut wood.
After two or three hours, Dudian thought that the old dragon had abandoned its nest and moved to another place. The Arctic ice dragon flew back from the sky. It didn’t land on the shore but dove into the lake, a huge wave was set off. The water of the lake surged and hit the broken ice on the shore. It was like a fence made of sharp blades.
“Alive?”Dudian saw the thing in the mouth of the ice dragon. It was a three meter long blood lion yak. It wasn’t a monster from the ice forest, it was a monster from the plains outside the forest. Moreover, the blood lion yak was in groups. It was extremely violent. It was Level 42. It wasn’t scary to pull it out alone, however, a group of blood lion yaks was enough to make many monsters that were level 100 or higher shy away from them.
The blood lion yaks clearly belonged to the “Food”category in the depths of the magic pit.
Dudian was surprised because he didn’t expect that the food that the ice dragon was hunting wasn’t the ice monsters from the ice forest. What was even more strange was that it was carrying a live one, it could swallow it in one bite. It didn’t need to chew. There was no need to take it back to its nest to enjoy it?
The waves on the lake were still rolling. The Snow White Figure of the Arctic ice dragon gradually sank to the bottom of the lake. Dudian looked up. The lake was very deep. He could barely see the depth of the lake, however he could see the life source of the Blood Lion Yak.
The heat source of the blood lion yak suddenly disappeared without any warning.
Dudian was surprised. Was it swallowed by the Ice Dragon? Even if it was swallowed the body of the Blood Lion Yak wouldn’t lose its heat source but would slowly disappear.
He felt that it was a bit strange but he didn’t pay much attention to it. After the surface of the lake was completely calm he turned around and went to the forest. He cut down trees and piled them up. He also met some forest monsters when he was cutting down the trees, there were giant lizards that were as white as snow. There were also giant pythons that lurked under the snow. There were also strange insects that lived inside the giant trees.
Dudian casually killed these monsters. Some of the monsters used poison to attack him. He cut off their poison sacs or pulled out their fangs to use as trap materials.
Five days passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian had cut down thousands of trees. He heard a faint dragon’s roar coming from the Ice Lake. He sensed for a while and found that the ice dragon had gone out to look for food.
He stopped making traps and went to the edge of the Ice Lake to wait. He found that the old dragon had a chubby monster in its mouth.
If the first time was a coincidence then the two times were the same. It was enough to determine the taste of the old dragon. Dudian was happy. He was worried about what to use as bait but now it was simple.
Dudian peeled the cut trees. The surface of the trees was shaved. After he peeled the bark, the inside of the trees was still rough. Fortunately, these giant trees lived in the cold temperature. The tree trunks were extremely hard. Ordinary swords might not be able to cut them.
Dudian lit the fire and refined the bark into tree oil. He smeared it on the tree trunks so that the surface of the tree trunks was smooth. Then he sharpened one end to make a giant bow. He found some vines and wove the bow rope.
There were few vines in the forest so Dudian could only spin the silk and then wove it. It took him three days to make two bows.
The bow was fixed by a few big trees. The rope was woven by himself so the tree arrows were the easiest to make.
Dudian picked a good position and waited for the Arctic ice dragon to go out to search for food. He quietly dug a hole by the lake and buried the bow. In addition to the tree arrows, he also prepared a giant net so that the giant net could be ejected from the ground, it was enough for the ice dragon to struggle out of the hole.
Time passed by unknowingly.
In the blink of an Eye Dudian stayed by the Ice Lake for three months. Traps were everywhere around the ice lake. Some traps were destroyed by other monsters. He had to dig deep trenches on the ground outside the traps, he made the beasts’feces around the traps to stop the monsters.
In the past three months, Dudian had figured out the ice dragon’s hunting patterns. It was almost once every three days. Each time it would bring back a monster. Moreover, once the monster entered the bottom of the lake.., it would suddenly lose its heat source reaction. This strange phenomenon would appear every time. Dudian was very curious. He even thought about diving into the lake to take a look when the ice dragon left. But in the end he held back, he was worried that his smell would stay in the lake and cause the old dragon to be vigilant.
The sky was blue.
Dudian quietly waited by the lakeside. At noon, the lake rippled and the figure of the ice dragon flew out.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he stepped out from the edge of the forest.
The ice dragon that was about to leave suddenly stopped. It turned its head and growled at Dudian. It flapped its wings and flew over the lakeside towards Dudian.
Dudian saw that the ice dragon seemed to have forgotten who he was. He wasn’t in a hurry to use his magic body. He tightly held onto the splitter.
The ice dragon descended from the sky. The wind blew Dudian’s hair into a mess. It landed on the ground and opened its mouth to bite Dudian. It seemed that it didn’t take Dudian seriously.
The moment the ice dragon opened its mouth, its mouth and sharp fangs were still stained with blood and flesh. Dudian suddenly made a move. His body slid to the side and the splitter instantly passed through the corner of the ice dragon’s mouth, the sharp edge of the knife cut into the sand. Dudian held the knife tightly and drew three or four meters forward. He waited for the Ice Dragon to roar in pain before pulling out the knife and retreating.
The Ice Dragon roared to the sky. It raised its wings in pain. When it lowered its head again, it opened its mouth and spat out cold air.
Dudian was prepared. He quickly took off and flew back into the forest.
He deliberately flew higher so that the ice dragon would have to take off to attack him.

chapters.title: Chapter 917
chapters.content:
Chapter 917 – Chapter 907: Acquisition
As expected, the Arctic ice dragon saw Dudian flying high into the sky. It roared and chased after him. Its huge wings created a hurricane that blew snow into the surrounding forest. It opened its mouth and spat out a sharp ice blade, it shot towards Dudian like an arrow.
Dudian turned around and swung the sharp blade. He cut the ice blade and dove towards the direction of the forest.
The ice dragon quickly caught up with him. Its ferocious mouth stretched out and almost swallowed dudian.
Dudian’s eyes were cold. He didn’t panic. After flying for hundreds of meters, the ice dragon’s cold breath pierced his spinal cord. He glanced at the forest and saw a giant tree bent over in the snow, dudian swung his arm and the sharp blade fell off his body. Whoosh! It pierced into the snow on the side of the giant tree.
There was a muffled sound as the giant tree suddenly rose. At the same time, the snow on the ground of the giant tree also bounced up. The black rope was pulled straight from the snow. The next moment, a dozen meters in front of the forest.., suddenly, several huge white shadows shot out. They were six sharp giant trees.
The trunk of the tree was smooth like six giant arrows that were shot towards Dudian’s back.
The speed of the giant arrow was very fast. The Ice Dragon and Dudian were only 150 meters above the ground. Dudian deliberately lowered the speed of the giant arrow, the momentum of the giant arrow reached its peak in an instant!
The Ice Dragon roared in anger. It wanted to dodge but its body was too big. It was difficult for it to turn around. Even if it turned sideways, it couldn’t avoid it.
Bang Bang Bang!
Six explosions sounded as the giant arrow hit the Ice Dragon. The strong impact caused the giant arrow to break into pieces. There were countless small particles in the fog which completely surrounded the ice dragon.
Roar! !
The angry roar of the dragon came out from the black fog. The cold air swept and dispersed the black fog. The ice dragon that rushed out from the black fog changed its appearance. Its ice blue body became black and covered with black particles.
A trace of joy flashed through Dudian’s eyes. The plan was going smoothly!
The purpose of his special giant tree arrows was not to injure the ice dragon. The fact proved that the ice dragon was hit by six giant arrows. Its body only staggered for a moment but didn’t leave any wound.
However, the resin and tree oil were sprayed on the ice dragon’s body. The tree oil was mixed with resin and had a strong adhesive property. As for the Fluffy Black Fog.., countless pieces of charcoal powder were crushed. The moment the arrow broke the tree oil was sprayed onto the body of the ice dragon. It made the body of the ice dragon turn black.
The reason why Dudian thought of the charcoal powder was a coincidence. When he poured the tree oil into the hollow part of the giant arrow, the tree oil was frozen by the cold climate, so he had to dig a path outside the hollow part of the giant tree. The path was filled with the charcoal powder in order to keep warm and prevent the tree oil from freezing.
Roar!
The extreme cold ice dragon was completely angry. It flapped its wings angrily and spewed out burning breath as it rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian continued to fly forward.
When he passed through the valley, he once again threw out a sharp blade limb. He had spent three months to figure out the technique of cutting off the limb. It could be used as a long-range arrow attack.
At this moment, the falling blade became the key to activate the mechanism.
When the sharp blade entered the valley, the snow in the valley instantly loosened. A huge black shadow flew out from the snowflakes and swept into the air with lightning speed.
The Arctic ice dragon was aware of this. It roared in anger as it flapped its wings. The wind swept down and the huge black shadow’s momentum was reduced. However, it still touched the abdomen of the Arctic ice dragon. It was a big black net, it was wrapped around the two claws of the ice dragon.
Dudian saw that the big net wasn’t able to completely cover it. He felt sorry but didn’t stop. He continued to dive down. He reached a hundred meters above the ground and threw a sharp blade into the forest.
Bang!
The snow in the forest bounced up and another huge net flew out.
The Ice Dragon was caught off guard. It was covered by the huge net from bottom to top. The huge net was so big that it completely covered the ice dragon from head to tail. The stones at the bottom of the net were tied together under the pulling force.
The Extreme Frost Ice Dragon’s wings were bound by the huge net. It roared and struggled violently. Just as it was about to tear the huge net apart, another huge net shot out from the ground!
This huge net once again covered the extreme frost ice dragon. At the same time, huge arrows shot out from four directions at the same time. There was a total of 12 arrows that stabbed towards the extreme frost ice dragon like swords. Bang Bang sounds spread continuously and the huge arrows shattered, the tree oil sprayed out and splashed onto the ice dragon’s body. The layer of charcoal powder turned into black mist and completely covered the ice dragon.
“Now!”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as the bell on his body shook.
Roar!
A low roar echoed out from the forest. The blazing fire shot out like a cannonball and directly hit the Ice Dragon’s body.
Bang! A light sound was heard. In the next moment, flames emerged from the sound and spread rapidly, burning the black net and spreading to other places along the burning net. When it touched the tree oil, the fire became even more intense.
The charcoal powder that was stuck to the tree oil also increased the fire’s intensity at this moment.
The Ice Dragon instantly turned into a blazing fire dragon and burned in the air. Like a fire cloud, it stretched out from the Sea of fire towards the sky and howled in pain. However, its wings were unable to break free for a long time, its huge body fell from a hundred meters above the ground. It was like a burning meteorite that hit the ground. A strong shockwave spread out and sent the surrounding trees flying.
Bang! There was a loud crash followed by the high-pitched scream of the Ice Dragon.
The ground where the ice dragon fell completely collapsed. More than 200 meters of the ground collapsed. There were sharp boulders protruding from the ground like fangs, some of the boulders were covered with green or black objects. Dudian had taken out the venom from the monster’s body.
Dudian couldn’t help but clenched his fist when he heard the scream of the Ice Dragon. He had succeeded!
He didn’t think that it would be so smooth. If the ice dragon broke out of the giant net or persisted for a long time and fell two hundred meters away from the place where it had fallen, then the two hundred meters pit that he had dug would be completely wasted, it would be a complete waste!
He couldn’t predict the specific falling range of the extreme frost dragon so he deliberately dug out a large area of more than two hundred meters. In fact, with the size of the extreme frost dragon, only fifty meters of the pit would be enough to accommodate it.
Dudian was excited but didn’t rush to make a move. His trap wasn’t over yet. He raised his hand and threw out a sharp blade towards the forest in the distance. A huge shadow suddenly shot out from the forest, it was a giant rock with a length of seven or eight meters. At the same time, a few big rocks shot out from the shadows of the trees around the pit.
The trap that he cut was connected to all the catapults. More than twenty boulders flew out. Some hit the outer edge of the giant pit while others hit the body of the Arctic ice dragon, only seven boulders hit the Ice Dragon. Dudian had estimated that the best place for the Ice Dragon to fall was the place where the seven boulders would fall.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to do too much. He didn’t expect that the plan would be so smooth. Moreover the location of the boulders had a high requirement on the terrain. Some of the terrain couldn’t reach this position.
Seven boulders fell in a row. The Scream of the Arctic ice dragon was louder. Although its physique was strong but the impact of the boulders wasn’t inferior to the Fist of the Abyss, the impact of the boulders made it deeper.
The boulders broke and covered the body of the Arctic ice dragon. Dudian saw that the Arctic ice dragon couldn’t struggle so he flew over at full speed.
If time allowed, he planned to fill the pit with tree oil. But the project was too big. It would take more than half a year to complete. But for hunting monsters like the ice dragon.., it wasn’t a long time to prepare for half a year. Most hunters would prepare for half a year to a year or even longer if they were to ambush a level 20 or 30 monster, it was possible that the monster would be eaten by other monsters.
The Arctic ice dragon screamed as it raised its burning wings and opened the huge rock on its body. When Dudian flew over, it felt that the eyes of the angry dragon were filled with dark blue blood, the next moment, a large amount of cold air spread out from its body. The white cold air covered its entire body. The originally vigorous flame was quickly extinguished.
Dudian saw the cold air spread out and his body suddenly stopped. Killing intent flashed in his eyes. The sound of a bell rang. From the forest behind him, Aisha who was full of DRAKONIDS rushed over at high speed. Her body was covered in flames, she plunged into the cold air.
Dudian immediately followed her.
Bang!
Aisha roared and raised her dragon claws. She tore the dragon wings of the Arctic ice dragon.
Dudian followed behind her. He used the liquid flame on her body to disperse the cold air. He took advantage of the situation to attack the position next to her. He cut the side of the ice dragon like a sword, he cut deep marks.
The Ice Dragon let out a painful roar. It turned its body and flattened the stone spikes around the pit. It twisted its claws in an attempt to grab Dudian.
Dudian and Aisha were tightly attached to its side. Dudian used the two sharp blades on its back to pierce its body. The front end of the sharp blades extended out barbs and firmly grasped its flesh. Its body was like a mixer, the sharp blades rotated and pierced into its side. Soon, a huge hole was cut.
Aisha seemed to smell the blood on the other side. She immediately abandoned her dragon wings and drilled into the hole that Dudian had made. It was like a ball of fire drilling into the back of the ice dragon, dudian could see a red shadow inside the surface of the extreme ice dragon.
When aisha drilled into the hole, the extreme ice dragon screamed loudly. Its body suddenly climbed up from the ground and flew forward. However, before it flew out of the deep hole, it suddenly twisted like a cramp, it hit the wall of the deep hole.
Dudian took the opportunity to continue to cut. The area of its wound was getting larger and larger.
The extreme cold ice dragon struggled violently. The cold air around its body was getting thicker and thicker. The surrounding rocks and soil were frozen. Dudian also felt cold. It was so cold that he was trembling. Fortunately, Aisha was not far from him, the flame emitted a warm feeling. He was barely able to resist the terrifying cold. At the same time, there was a trace of inexplicable warmth in his heart.
The attack on his hand became more and more fierce and fast to prevent the old dragon from retaliating.
Aisha was like a ball of flame that crawled into the body of the Arctic ice dragon. The Arctic ice dragon’s scream was even more shrill. The dragon’s claws slapped and crushed the surrounding rock walls and ground, however, the dragon’s claws could not reach to its back to attack Dudian. It could not reach into its own body. The cold air was its strongest means of self-protection. However, it had no effect on Aisha who was its nemesis.
Aisha and the indestructible dudian had already sent the ice dragon to the road of death when they cut the ice dragon’s body.
The dragon’s roar gradually turned into a wail, and eventually calmed down.
Aisha cut a hole in the ice dragon’s throat and drilled out. The Flames on her body dimmed a lot. Dudian jumped down from the ice dragon’s back and stepped forward to support her. He looked at the blood stained on her body, there was also digestive residue in her dirty organs. He was silent as he gently held her in his arms.
After a long time, Dudian let go of her. He turned his head to look at the surrounding ground. He found that the place was in a mess. The corpse of the ice dragon made him feel cold, it was charred black. Aisha had torn a hole in one of the dragon’s wings. There was a seven to eight meter long wound on the side of its back and a two meter long hole.
Its claws were broken, as if it was broken by itself when it hit the ground. There was a dent in its abdomen, which was caused by a giant arrow.
No matter how magnificent and beautiful it was before, it was weak when it died.
Dudian once again sighed at the iron rule outside the giant wall. It was a luxury to die here.
“Bear with it a little longer.”Dudian whispered to Aisha.
Aisha had returned to her human form and her body was dirty. After hearing Dudian’s words, she didn’t respond and remained silent.
Dudian went forward and cut off the head of the Arctic ice dragon. He used a sharp blade to cut open its skull. The brain tissue inside was still intact. He inserted the sharp blade into the skull and turned it around, a white cold air suddenly shot over.
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he turned his head to avoid it.
At this time, he saw what was inside the head of the Polar Ice Dragon. He was relieved.
It was the polar ice worm.
It was really here. It was parasitic in the head of the Polar Ice Dragon.
The size of this polar ice worm was smaller than the previous one. Dudian smiled as he went forward to pick it out.
The polar ice worm wanted to struggle but its body was not dominant. When it wanted to spit cold air again, Dudian immediately cut its body into pieces.
He took out the backpack and put it in.
Dudian was very happy to get the polar ice worm. He didn’t expect to take the risk and still get the little thing.
He looked at the corpse of the Polar Ice Dragon. He wanted to cut off its claws so that he could forge weapons in the future. However he thought about the luggage that he had to bring. He didn’t lack weapons, he wanted to forge the polar ice worm for Mason and Sergei. But now that he had the polar ice worm he had to go to the Holy Kingdom. He didn’t know how many years it would be before he would meet Sergei and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 918
chapters.content:
Chapter 918 – Chapter 908: Parasite
Dudian took Aisha back to the ice lake. He was curious about the monster that the ice dragon had brought back to the bottom of the lake. He let Aisha stay by the shore to look after the luggage and the ice worms. Dudian jumped into the water and activated his magic body. He fell straight into the depths of the lake like a sharp sea urchin.
The deeper he dived, the dimmer the light.
Dudian saw more clearly. When he came to a hundred meters into the lake, he suddenly saw a huge oval shadow at the bottom of the lake. After diving for more than ten meters, Dudian saw the appearance of the shadow, he was so surprised that he couldn’t speak.
This was a flying saucer-type spaceship that was commonly seen in old movies. The surface of the spaceship was covered with moss. He swam around the spaceship. The spaceship was so huge that even the size of the polar ice dragon could fit in it. Soon, he saw that there was no moss near the hull. The surface of the ship was slightly raised. It seemed to be a huge cabin door. There were many scales of the polar ice dragon on the soil under the door.
Dudian’s eyes slightly moved. He went over and found that the cabin door was not closed. There was a small secret passage that looked like an air vent that went straight into the cabin.
He swam along the secret passage. After seven or eight meters, he saw a weak light above the secret passage. He immediately floated up. His head left the water surface and came into contact with the air.
It was an extremely wide cabin. There was no water in it. He climbed out of the secret passage and stood in the cabin. He found that the cabin was covered with a lot of dragon scales and the hair of an unknown monster. Beside the secret passage that he entered.., it was a huge door. The metal bulge next to the door had dragon scales on it. It was expected that the extreme frost dragon scratched it when it entered.
However, how could the polar ice dragon know how to open the door?
Moreover, how could there be no water in the cabin?
Dudian was a bit confused. Soon, he thought of the ship in Amelia’s tribe. were the two ships from the same race?
He slowly walked forward. The water on his body fell on the ground. As he slowly walked forward, his mind gradually became clear. The Polar Ice Dragon knew how to enter this place. It was most likely controlled by the polar ice insect in its brain, in other words, it was most likely the ship of the polar ice worm. If that was the case, the polar ice worm might be an extraterrestrial life form!
There were several skeletons in the empty space in the cabin. Most of them were monsters hunted by the Polar Ice Dragon.
In addition, there were pools of dark green mucus on the ground in the corner of the cabin. It was emitting a fishy smell. Dudian walked forward for more than ten meters. He saw two broken blades on the ground.
His eyelids twitched. was there a human being here? Or was it a human corpse brought back by the Ice Dragon?
He picked up the broken blade and looked at it. There was no dust on it. It seemed that it had just fallen. There was a sticky liquid on the edge of the blade. He didn’t dare to touch it.
Dudian gently put down the broken blade and continued to slowly walk forward. He used his x-ray vision to scan the surroundings. Soon he found that the material of the spaceship was the same as the previous frozen coffin of Sylvia. The X-ray vision couldn’t penetrate through it, the interior of the spaceship was covered with red metal mesh.
His heart was tense. He didn’t know if there was anything alive inside.
At this time, he suddenly regretted leaving Aisha by the shore. The thought made him realize that Aisha had brought him hope and a sense of security.
He slowly walked along the passage in the cabin. His feet didn’t make any sound. He found that the passage in the cabin was like metal and the intestines of some animals. The passage was covered with viscous liquid, there was a fishy smell and stench. Some of the joints in the cabin looked like the muscles of insects. It was disgusting and strange.
It was too quiet.
Dudian could only hear his heartbeat. It was getting louder and louder. He had to use the dragon’s blood spell to control his heartbeat. He suppressed his body’s function and slowly groped forward like a ghost.
He walked along the passage for more than ten minutes. He passed by several cabins and rooms. Some of the doors were closed. There was Snow White ice residue on the doors. From the traces of the ice residue, it looked like splashing blood.
Some of the doors were open. There were shriveled corpses lying on the ground. They looked like insects. They had been dead for a long time but they seemed to be in a deep sleep. They could wake up at any time.
Dudian’s body was covered in cold sweat. He felt extremely depressed. It seemed that there was something terrible waiting for him in front of him. He almost stopped breathing and walked forward step by step. He was extremely nervous, he noticed that the metal bulges on the floor of the cabin scratched the scales of the ice dragon. He was able to breathe a bit. He walked along the passage. Some of the lights in the passage were very bright and some were broken. It was pitch black, the passage was illuminated in black and white.
The further he went, the deeper the darkness became.
Dudian seemed to have an illusion. The darkness stretched out like tentacles at the edge of the passage.
His body was in a combat state. He clenched his teeth as he slowly walked to the exit of the passage. The scene in front of him made his heart twitch. He even had the impulse to turn around and run away.
The exit of the passage was a huge dark space. The insect muscle-like metal pipes were spread around the dark space. They were connected to the wall like vines of a dead tree or scattered intestines, there was a stench coming from the inside. There was a pile of black roots in the middle of the space. There were complex pipes that were connected to the wall.
There were two rows of thick branches that stretched out from the black roots. They looked like blood vessels. The surface of the branches was covered with dark green liquid. It looked like they hadn’t been cleaned for hundreds of years.
There were pupae hanging from the branches. There were big and small pupae. The Darkness couldn’t stop Dudian’s vision. He saw a few human-sized pupae with a pale human face.
There were two strange heads sticking out from the other two pupae. One of them was the head of the Bloody Lion Yak.
Dudian suddenly understood why the polar ice dragon had captured its prey. It was because of this place!
No wonder the prey had suddenly disappeared. It was because of the spacecraft that blocked his vision.
There were seven or eight white tentacles embedded in the center of the black tree. The body of the insect was like an enlarged peanut. Its body was white and smooth. There were no eyes or mouth, no one would think that it was a living creature if there weren’t ferocious antennae attached to its body.
Dudian held his breath and didn’t dare to make any sound. He had never seen such a strange thing. The most terrifying thing was that he found that the thing was alive. Something was constantly being extracted from the pupa and flowed into the body of the thing.
The Arctic ice dragon was actually feeding such a strange creature!
No, it should be said that the polar ice worm in its head was feeding this thing!
Dudian felt that he had seen some secrets hidden in the deepest part of the world. He didn’t know if this thing was the most terrifying existence but he just wanted to leave this place as soon as possible!
Just when Dudian was about to turn around and retreat, there was a rustling sound. Dudian’s footsteps stiffened. He saw seven or eight white fat figures drilled out from the holes in the black roots, there was a sharp contrast between the white bodies and the black roots. He recognized these strange things at a glance. He couldn’t be more familiar with them.
Polar ice insects!
These seven or eight things were polar ice insects!
Dudian was in disbelief. In order to capture one polar ice insect, Holaney had gathered many people but failed miserably. Now there were seven or eight polar ice insects in the mysterious spacecraft deep in the lake, this could create seven or eight abysses!
The polar ice worms slightly raised their bodies like Vipers as they looked at dudian. They clustered around the white peanut-like multi-tentacled monster in the middle and quietly observed for a moment, two of the polar ice worms suddenly crawled along the blood vessels like sticky tubes. Their speed was very fast. It didn’t take long for them to swim to two of the pupae.
One of the pupae was big and the other was small. One of them was a human, and the other was a long, ferocious-looking monster.
In the next moment, the two polar ice bugs climbed up the hanging string to the top of the pupae. Soon, they crawled into the unknown substance on the surface of the pupae. In a moment, the substance on the surface of the two pupae slightly stirred and broke open, the long pupae landed on the ground, and a monster with an insect-like head and a snake-like head crawled out from it. Its body was like a crocodile, and it crawled on the ground with an extremely long tail.
Another human pupa also fell down. The pupa broke open and inside was a naked woman. Her body was covered with sticky liquid. Her full chest was slightly up and down. There was even a heartbeat!
Dudian’s eyelids twitched. He glanced at the other pupae. His eyes focused and his heart was cold. He saw Barker!
Barker was wrapped tightly. Only his facial features were exposed. He didn’t recognize Barker!
Barker was caught here and turned into a pupa!
No wonder he didn’t find Barker’s body!
Dudian saw a familiar face in addition to Barker. It seemed that he had seen it somewhere before. He was startled to wake up. This person was the abyss that he had met before he came to Barker’s giant wall, at that time he hadn’t become an abyss. It wasn’t easy for him to get rid of this person. He didn’t expect to meet him here!
Roar!
A low roar was heard. The crocodile-like monster growled as it rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He quickly turned around and ran.
Whoosh!
A sound was heard as Dudian’s perception looked back. He saw that the naked woman was chasing after him. She was faster than the monster next to her. The strangest thing was.., there was an ice worm coiled around her neck. If one looked carefully one could see that one end of the ice worm was wrapped around her head. It seemed to extend into her ears.
Was the ice worm controlling her?
Dudian didn’t dare to stay. He rushed forward along the cabin.
The Naked Woman’s speed was extremely fast. In the blink of an eye she caught up to him. She raised her hand and hit Dudian’s back.
Dudian was shocked as he swung the body of the blade on his back.
Ice spread out from the naked woman’s arm and covered her entire arm. She reached out and grabbed onto the body of the blade. There were several sounds as the body of the blade cut through the ice on her arm but failed to cut off her arm, instead her five fingers reached out and grabbed onto one of Dudian’s limbs.
Hiss!
The ice worm wrapped around her neck opened its mouth like a white snake and roared.
The naked woman pulled back her arm.
Dudian’s face slightly changed as his body moved. Bang! The naked woman pulled back the sharp blade and almost fell down. Dudian’s speed didn’t decrease as he continued to rush forward.
Hiss!
The ice worm on the neck of the naked woman let out an angry roar. Its snake-like mouth was full of fine teeth. The naked woman was under its control as she quickly rushed forward like a meteor.
Dudian was secretly shocked. The Naked Woman’s physical quality was very strong. She didn’t enter the magic body but was able to catch up with him. This should have nothing to do with the control of the ice worm. After all, it was behind them.., the giant monster had been left behind by forty to fifty meters!
Dudian suddenly threw out a sharp blade as he saw the naked woman approaching again. It was like a spinning top blade storm.
The Naked Woman’s body quickly turned into ice. She used both hands to protect her body. The sharp blade cut through the ice on her arm hundreds of times and left dozens of fine wounds. But the strange thing was that there was no blood flowing out of the wound.
Dudian saw that he couldn’t kill her. He didn’t look back as he ran.
The naked woman once again madly chased after him. The polar ice worm on her shoulder screamed.
Dudian looked at the cabin exit which was getting closer and closer. He suddenly thought that the polar ice worm could control the cold air. Wouldn’t it be able to burst out at a faster speed in the lake?
Even if it couldn’t, wouldn’t it be more dangerous for him if he used the cold air to control the lake?
In this second, his brain was spinning rapidly and suddenly stopped his body.
The naked woman who was more than ten meters behind didn’t stop. When Dudian stopped, she immediately chased after him. Her whole body was frozen. The ice block was like a sharp blade. She raised her hand to grab Dudian, once she grabbed him, Dudian’s body would immediately be pierced by the sharp thorn in her chest.
Dudian’s eyes flashed with a bright light. He turned back. His hands suddenly returned to the shape of a human arm. His fingers grabbed the naked woman’s arm and his body bounced up, the sharp blades on her shoulder and back shot out like lightning. They were not aimed at the naked woman but at the polar ice worm on her shoulder.
The polar ice worm screamed and tried to control the naked woman to raise her hand to block. However the naked woman’s hands were tightly held by Dudian. She couldn’t break free for a while. The polar ice worm was cut into pieces, her body fell to the ground like a few pieces of snow white meat.
The sharp end of the ear that pierced into the naked woman’s ear also fell out.
Dudian was relieved to see that the naked woman suddenly collapsed. At the same time, there was a rumbling sound from the back of the cabin. The crocodile-like monster was aggressively chasing after them.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He turned and rushed into the secret passage. He didn’t know what he was thinking. He pulled the naked woman into his arms and jumped into the secret passage with her.

chapters.title: Chapter 919
chapters.content:
Chapter 919 – Chapter 909: Wake Up
The water was cold.
Dudian held his breath as he flapped his wings and swam towards the lake.
Bang!
The ship at the bottom of the lake shook as he swam for forty to fifty meters. The next moment the crocodile-like monster rushed out of the ship. It shook its tail and chased after him from the bottom of the lake.
Dudian’s body was as sharp as the wings of a fighter. The water flowed through him without any obstruction. He rushed out of the lake and flew into the air.
Roar!
When he had just drilled out of the water, the lake water rose up and a bloody mouth swallowed the water. The moment the mouth closed, Dudian flew out from the front of his mouth and teeth, narrowly avoiding the monster’s bite, he flew seventy to eighty meters into the air and then quickly flew to the lakeside.
After the crocodile-like monster had bitten empty air, its body fell into the lake, causing the lake water to flood. It swam in the direction of Dudian’s flight at full speed in the lake. The sharp blade on its back was exposed on the surface of the lake, like seven or eight shark’s dorsal fins. It was terrifying.
Dean flew to the side of Aisha by the lake. After landing, he threw the naked woman on his shoulder onto the shore. He suddenly turned around. The sharp blade on his body stood up. He stomped on the ground and turned around to rush over.
Roar!
The monster rushed out of the lake and opened its bloody mouth to bite again.
Dean was like a black bullet. He rotated and flew into its mouth. The mouth closed. Bang! Dean’s figure instantly broke out from the black stratum corneum in its head.
The monster howled and fell on the shore.
After Dudian defeated it, he didn’t continue to attack. Instead, he swooped down to the ground, picked up the naked woman, and called Aisha to fly with him into the distant forest.
The monster’s huge body shook as it tried to get up, but its skull was too heavily injured. It fell down halfway after several times. Blood came out of the skull and slid down the sharp teeth at the corner of its mouth, dyeing the shore red.
Dudian saw that the monster didn’t chase after him, so he was slightly relieved. He took Aisha and flew to the corpse of the Polar Ice Dragon. They arrived ten minutes later. He looked at the back of the ship, but he still didn’t see any pursuers. He landed, he waved his sharp blade and cut off the newly born tail of the Polar Ice Dragon. The tail was about seven or eight meters long. Dudian cut off the tail and gave it to Aisha to carry. Then he continued to take off and went around the forest in an arc, he went back the way he came.
Although there were ice worms in the head of the monster that was chasing after him, Dudian didn’t dare to be greedy. With his strength, he should have no problem killing the monsters and humans controlled by the ice worms, but he was worried that the strange peanut-like creature would chase after him. It gave him a strong sense of terror. He didn’t know if it would wake up.
A moment later, Dean flew out of the forest with Aisha. His figure didn’t stop. After he landed on the ground, he continued on the way back.
Along the way, he saw a lot of broken limbs and bodies, as well as weapons and armor. Dean had some impression of the armor. It was the armor of the hunters. Some of the broken limbs were relatively fresh and had died not long ago, most of them were the ones who were killed when the hunters returned.
Dudian followed their footsteps. Half a day later he came to a barren forest. He had exhausted a lot of his physical strength. Fortunately he didn’t meet any strong monsters, there were only some master level and pioneer level monsters. These monsters could only be considered as small monsters for him. As long as he wasn’t careless he wouldn’t capsize.
Dudian lit the fire and cut off a 20 cm long part of the tail of the Arctic Frost Dragon. The radiation of the Arctic Frost Dragon was very strong. It was a poison for Dudian, but it was a great tonic for Aisha.
After a few thrilling battles, Dudian realized the importance of Aisha. Although he didn’t deliberately cultivate Aisha’s physique. During the two years when he became the wall master, Aisha had naturally awakened, she had completed her seventh awakening.
Originally, the seventh awakening of a witcher’s physique had surpassed that of a ruler. It was stronger than the ordinary abyss. Moreover, because of the undead’s physique, Aisha’s body function was several times stronger than that of a normal seventh awakening, even the abyss like Holaney couldn’t compete with Aisha directly. This could be seen from the Battle of the Arctic Ice Dragon. Holaney, Barker and others had no resistance in front of the Arctic ice dragon. It would be difficult for them to withstand a strike from the dragon’s Claw. However, Aisha was able to dodge its attack, even if she was injured, it wouldn’t be a big deal.
However, the enemies that Dudian was facing were getting stronger and stronger. Sometimes he might not be able to deal with them by himself. He needed Aisha’s strength. The stronger Aisha was, the more help she would be to Dudian.
He didn’t plan to feed Aisha to help her increase her strength. Firstly, he was worried that her strength would be too strong. He wouldn’t be able to control her, secondly, he was also worried that Aisha would awaken a new consciousness in her body. If that day came, would he still be able to resurrect her?
Other than these two points, he always felt that if he gave her too much food to increase her strength, he would always feel guilty, as if she was his weapon in battle.
Sometimes he felt that this ambivalent mood was a bit pretentious, which was the main reason why he was unable to give Aisha a large amount of food.
However, if he ate and drank on a daily basis, Dudian was willing to try to choose some high-level monster’s flesh and blood. This way, even if he could not give Aisha more strength, he could supplement her body’s consumption.
After the dragon’s tail was cooked, Dudian handed the sword to Haisha. While she was eating, his eyes turned to the naked woman next to him. There was no evil intention in his eyes. Although he wasn’t close to women and was even a virgin, but he had strong control over women. Moreover, he had seen too many bloody scenes in the past.
