Especially on the battlefield, there were piles of broken limbs of men and women, at that time, there seemed to be no distinction between men and women. There was no distinction between man and beast. All the body parts were like pork on the slaughterhouse. It was disgusting.
Usually, hunters or warriors who had seen these bloody scenes would have a drastic change in their temperament. They would even wreak havoc on women. Their actions were crazy. Dudian was cautious. Moreover, he had Aisha by his side, he was almost cut off from women. He didn’t have much impulse in this aspect. At this moment, looking at the naked woman was like looking at a sculpture or even a skeleton.
No matter how beautiful a woman was, the miserable state she was in after being cut off would make people stop their evil thoughts.
In Dudian’s eyes, this woman was like a corpse. Moreover, it was an extremely strange corpse.
From a man’s point of view, this naked woman’s face was very delicate and beautiful. She had light golden hair that was slightly curled. Her nose bridge was high and straight. Her eyes were closed and her eyelashes were long and slender. There was also a bit of white ice on them. Her body was slender, there was no fat on her body. Her abdomen was flat and her legs were slender. She was full of beauty but also contained great strength. Her toes were like shells. Her body was extremely pale but there was nothing dazzling, it was enough to arouse any male’s primitive impulse.
Looking at her body, Dudian was a bit absent-minded. He thought of the disgusting and twisted scene in the spaceship. Pupae hung in dirty and dark places, there was a foul smell coming from the dark green mucus. It seemed that the mucus was still rotating in his nostrils. He frowned slightly.
Is this the nest of the polar ice worm?
How many such places are there?
How strong is the snow-white multi-tentacled monster in the core?
Does God’s kingdom know such a place?
Questions emerged in his mind. He felt that God’s kingdom should have grasped such things. There must be more than one such spaceship. Otherwise he would be an abyss traveler.., it was impossible for the Kingdom of God, who had been in charge of this land for hundreds of years, not to know about the things that happened during the magic pit hunt.
“The Kingdom of God… how many secrets does it know?”Dudian lowered his eyes and sighed in his heart.
After Haisha finished eating, Dudian carried the naked woman on his back and continued to travel with Haisha.
When it was dark, Dudian came to a place where the forest was luxuriant and surrounded the lake. He didn’t dare to stay. He took advantage of the last bit of sunset and continued to travel for more than twenty miles, he came to a grassland which was full of weeds. There were huge monster’s remains everywhere on the grassland which recorded what happened every day.
There were also collapsed buildings. Some of the buildings were huge statues but the people on the statues had already fallen. They were trampled into pieces of cement and submerged in the surrounding soil. The base of the statue was still buried in the ground.
Dudian used his X-ray vision to take a look and found that many buildings were buried under the sand. He dug out a piece of land and drilled into the basement of a buried house. He found that there was a rusty car parked inside.
He took Aisha and the naked woman into the car. He saw that there were three skeletons tied to the safety belt of the car. Two of them were big and one of them was small. It seemed that they were a family of three.
The hollow eyes of the skeleton looked at dudian. The next moment, its body was sat down by Dudian. The skeleton was shattered. Dudian let Aisha sit in the front while he and the naked woman sat in the back, in case the naked woman quietly woke up and waited for an opportunity to sneak attack.
The three of them hid in the dark underground. Dudian leaned against the chair in the car and regulated his breathing. He felt that time was passing by quietly. At this moment, it was very quiet. There was no wind and no sound.
He looked at the soil and darkness outside the window. He was slightly startled and suddenly wanted to light a cigarette.
But he didn’t have a cigarette addiction. He didn’t have any cigarettes on him so he had to give up.
When people were quiet, they would be in a daze. Their thoughts would wander. Sometimes they would think of this and sometimes they would think of other things.
There was no mobile phone and no entertainment. Dudian could only imagine the future. He only missed the past.
The more he reminisced about the past, the more he wanted to change something.
The more he wanted to change, the more he realized that he had nothing.
He didn’t know how much time had passed. The roars of monsters and howls came from the distance. There were hamster-sized things crawling on the ground and rustling the grass roots.
Monsters from all walks of life came out to look for food in this lonely night.
The footsteps of these monsters and the roars of fighting became the background music in Dudian’s ears. He hugged his arms and fell into a state of sleep and wakefulness.
In the blink of an eye, the night passed.
Dudian kicked the roof of the car. The rust-stained iron sheet broke open and sand splattered above. Dudian pulled the naked woman onto the ground and continued to carry Aisha.
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
Two figures flew over from the edge of the magic pit. Dudian was carrying the naked woman on his shoulder while Aisha’s tail was less than three meters long.
Dudian sighed in relief. He looked at the direction of the surroundings. He recalled the route and continued to carry Aisha.
There were many blood stains on his armor. He had met many monsters during the past three days. It had to be said that the number of monsters in the magic pit was extremely dense. There were few monsters in the barren areas, there were groups of monsters in the lakes and forests where there was sufficient water.
However, the number of monsters living in the dry and barren areas was small but it was more difficult to deal with.
Fortunately, Dudian was no longer the master who had just stepped out of Sylvia. He had experienced hundreds of battles in the abyss. With Aisha’s help, he was able to rush out safely.
After leaving the magic pit, Dudian returned to the giant wall of Barker along the route.
“I wonder what Monica has prepared for me?”Dudian thought about the things that would happen after he returned to the giant wall. He saw the remains of the hunters but didn’t see Monica’s corpse, it was expected that with the physique of the Abyss, there would be great hope for Monica to escape from the magic pit. Of course, he couldn’t rule out the possibility that she was extremely unlucky and was eaten by something terrible.
However, Dudian didn’t think that such a good thing would happen to him.
Although there was only one abyss left in the giant wall but Dudian didn’t dare to be careless. The nine people who invaded Sylvia were too careless and ended up with a crushing defeat, this lesson was right in front of his eyes. He wouldn’t repeat the same mistake.
The sun was shining.
Dudian landed on the top of a mountain after flying for forty to fifty miles. He glanced at the naked woman and threw her into the grass: “How Long Do You Want Me to hold you?”
The naked woman rolled into the grass without moving.
“Don’t pretend. Your heartbeat has betrayed you.”Dudian indifferently said.
Phisenia knew that she couldn’t pretend anymore. She sat up and slowly opened her eyes. It was the first time she had opened her eyes in the past few days. The strong light was coming from above Dudian’s head, she couldn’t even see Dudian’s face.
“Where is this? Who Are You?”She looked around and took a deep breath to calm herself down.
Dudian sat on the stone. He picked up a piece of withered grass and put it in his mouth. He looked at her as he looked at the scenery: “This question is meaningless. You should know that I am your benefactor.”

chapters.title: Chapter 920
chapters.content:
Chapter 920 – Chapter 900: Lord Of The Abyss
“May I know how to address my benefactor?”
“My name is dudian. This is my lover, Aisha.”Dudian looked down at her: “What’s Your Name?”
Her eyes swept past Aisha. Although she didn’t open her eyes because she was afraid that Dudian would notice her but she was aware that there was another powerful undeads around her, there was another powerful undeads. She was calm and didn’t show any strange expression: “My name is Felicia.”
“I want to know your identity.”Dudian looked at her and expressed his intention.
Felicia frowned. Dudian said that he wanted to know. He implied that she knew that there was no room for resistance, after a moment of thought she said: “My identity is very ordinary. I’m just a Demon Hunter. I accidentally fell into a trap and was caught by the thing at the bottom of the lake. You have seen what happened later. I have no memory of the process so I can’t tell you in detail.”
“I told you that I want to know your identity.”Dudian looked at her naked body but there were no ripples in his eyes, “As your benefactor, my request is not too much. You Don’t have to worry about anything else. I don’t have the luxury to save you. I will kill you as soon as you are done. There is a good saying that many friends have many paths. Of course, the premise is that you are not worthy to be my friend.”
Although Dudian’s words were not polite but his attitude was calm. There was no disgust in her heart but she was secretly relieved, she pondered for a while: “Benefactor is right. As I said before, I am a demon hunter from the 5th hunting team of the Blood Thorn Army. I Am the captain. Although I don’t know how you rescued me but you should have met my other partners. They are my team members.”
“Blood Thorn Army?”Dudian narrowed his eyes. He was surprised that this woman was from the Kingdom of God. Moreover she was the captain of the ‘Blood Thorn Army’. There were four teams in front of her, there were even more teams behind her. Dudian had seen the members of the team that she mentioned. It was very likely that the abyss that was chasing him in the wilderness was one of her team members!
He saw the bonfire when he came back. There were four or five people from the scene. It was basically the same as what Phoenix had said.
In other words, there were at least twenty-five abyss level experts in the Blood Thorn Army of the Kingdom of God. The number of Abyss level experts had doubled!
This was just an unknown army of the Kingdom of God!
Dudian’s heart was clear. He had expected the power of the Kingdom of God to be extremely strong. However, what Phoenix said was beyond his expectations!
After all, each giant wall was guarded by only one abyss!
No wonder the giant wall had no resistance in front of the Kingdom of God!
However, how many giant walls were there in this world?
Dudian didn’t know and didn’t ask Phisnia. This would expose too much information. He pondered for a moment and asked: “Are you here for the Polar Ice Worm?”
“It’s not…”Phisnia shook her head.
Dudian laughed and interrupted her, “I’m willing to make friends with you. I believe that you won’t refuse the friendship of the Abyss. There are many ways to make friends. It would be ridiculous if there is a lie between friends, right?”
Phisenia frowned and looked at him for a few seconds, she nodded: “In that case, I’ll be Frank. We came here to hunt the polar ice worm. We didn’t expect to meet the Polar Ice Dragon. We didn’t expect that there would be such a terrible thing hidden in the nest of the Polar Ice Dragon. If we knew that we wouldn’t have accepted the mission.”
Mission? Dudian asked: “Don’t you know what that thing is?”
“I’ve never seen it.”Phisenia shook her head.
Dudian stared at her. It seemed that he wasn’t lying but it was possible that his acting skills were too high, he continued: “In that case, your intelligence system is quite advanced. You actually know the clues of the polar ice worm thousands of miles away. Isn’t there no one living in the abyss? Where did you get the News?”
“The information was found by the army. We are only responsible for receiving the mission. As for how the Army got the information, I don’t know.”Phisenia shook her head again.
Dudian frowned. Her words were watertight. He couldn’t figure out anything from it. But at least he knew that the strength of the blood thorn army was unfathomable, it wasn’t an ordinary method to explore the clues of the ice worm in the abyss.
“I see that your strength is much stronger than the ordinary abyss. What is your rank?”Dudian looked at her with interest. He didn’t directly ask about the ranking of the Abyss so as not to expose his ignorance.
Phoenix frowned. She didn’t know if Dudian was trying to blackmail her or if he could tell that her strength was extraordinary, “You are wrong. I’m just a bit stronger and faster than ordinary Abyss.”
Dudian smiled: “Is That So? It shouldn’t be just a bit stronger to be able to catch up to me without entering the magic body.”
Fiona looked at him in doubt: “Catch up to you?”
“Don’t you remember?”Dudian slowly said: “When I saved you, an ice worm climbed onto your body and controlled you. At that time you showed extraordinary strength. I have seen other abysses and even fought with you several times.”
“The ice worm controlled me?”Phisenia was shocked. She woke up but didn’t remember how she left the Ice Lake. She heard Dudian talk about the control of the ice worm, the dark cage-like place suddenly appeared in her mind. She was wrapped like a silkworm. One by one the polar ice worms rushed out and surrounded the terrifying thing.
She believed in Dudian’s words. She wanted to raise her hand but she held it back.
Dudian looked at the change in her eyes. He guessed that she wasn’t acting but really didn’t remember that she was controlled by the polar ice worm, he said: “You can touch your left ear. The blood is still there. I don’t know if your eardrum has healed or not.”
Phisenia’s heart sank as she heard Dudian’s words. She was aware of the slight pain and discomfort in her left ear. She didn’t have time to restrain herself. She raised her hand and gently rubbed it, soon she saw that her hand was stuck with the hardened blood flail. There was a strange sound in her left ear. At the same time the warm breeze blew into her left ear. She felt a chill in her left head, she knew how she was rescued by Dudian.
“That…”she opened her mouth and wanted to ask.
Dudian said: “I cut down the polar ice worm. It was an emergency so I didn’t have time to pick it up and bring it back. It belongs to you. Do you blame me for losing it?”
Phisenia forced a smile. She felt that Dudian’s black humor was a bit cold. However, she thought of the scene where the polar ice worm drilled into her left ear. She felt a chill down her spine. She was horrified and disgusted at the same time, even though she had experienced many battles and seen countless bloody scenes and dead bodies as well as broken limbs and organs, but this scene happened to her. She felt a hundred times more intense.
“It’s always awkward when a lie is exposed. I sincerely want to make friends with you. I hope Miss Fasnia can open her heart. After all, if I want to hurt you, I can kill you when you are in a coma. Even if you wake up now, you don’t have a witcher so you can’t enter the magic body. I don’t think you are my opponent. What do you think?”Dudian’s attitude was still very calm, but there was a cold edge hidden in her words.
Phisenia’s face slightly changed. It wasn’t that she didn’t want to launch a sneak attack when she woke up. But when she was ready to attack, she realized that she was naked. Losing her clothes was a small matter but losing her witcher was a big matter!
If she couldn’t enter the magic body then her strength would be greatly reduced. Moreover Dudian was one against two. She wasn’t confident that she could kill Dudian in one blow so she endured it.
She understood Dudian’s warning. She knew that Dudian didn’t have the patience to listen to her lies anymore.
But a confession was something that only prisoners would obey.
Was she a prisoner?
It seemed so.
Without strength, she would be a prisoner if she let others kill her.
After a long silence she looked up at dudian: “Benefactor is right. I was muddle headed before. I am a bit stronger than the general abyss. I should be a middle abyss.”
“Middle Abyss?”Dudian raised his eyebrows: “So the captain of Your Blood Thorn Army is a Middle Abyss like you?”
Phisenia looked at dudian and smiled: “Mr. Dudian, are you living in the abyss of God’s Kingdom?”
“Oh?”Dudian’s eyes flashed: “How do you know?”
“Your dress, your accent…”there was a smile on her face, “To be honest, I admire Mr. Dean. It is very difficult to evolve into the Abyss in the wall. The resources are scarce and the competition is fierce. Benefactor your father should be the master of the wall or a big figure. Don’t misunderstand me. I don’t mean to inquire about your identity. There are many paths for friends. If benefactor is sincere then I am willing to be your friend. I don’t think anyone would refuse to have a friend from the Abyss.”
Dudian looked at her. He didn’t think that his accent and dress would expose him. It seemed that she had seen through his identity. It was just that she had been pretending not to say it, it was to express his good intentions.
“It’s about the same.”Dudian wasn’t angry, “Since you have figured it out then let’s talk while we walk. I think we have no conflict of interest. As for the Ice Lake, there are some people who know about it including Abyss.”
He didn’t know if the Ice Lake was an unspeakable secret for her so he deliberately reminded her not to try to silence him.
He wasn’t afraid but told her not to be stupid.
Of course, she knew what Dudian meant. She felt helpless. Dudian was overthinking. Although the secret of the lake was strange but it wasn’t enough to silence her. She would report it to the army when she returned to the Kingdom of God, maybe she would be rewarded.
She stood up from the grass. She didn’t feel shy and shy. She grabbed a piece of grass from the side and covered her sensitive parts. She remembered that Dudian had seen all of her body during the time she was unconscious, she was a bit angry. Although she had seen many bloody battlefields but it didn’t mean that she was indifferent to her body being exposed. She was a woman and a very beautiful woman, so she had the self-esteem that a woman should have.
Dudian saw that she was embarrassed. He took out a piece of clothes from his backpack and threw it to her: “There is a wall not far from here. Wait until you get there before you change.”
“Yes.”
“Is there a superior position above the Middle Abyss?”Dudian asked as he walked. Now that he had seen through his identity, he no longer hid the truth. He was eager to know more.
Phisenia didn’t hide the basic knowledge and explained it to Dudian.
The Abyss was divided into three stages: inferior, middle and superior. There was a level above the superior abyss called the Master of the Abyss!
As the name implied, at this stage, one could be considered as half of the Master of the Abyss. Not to mention crossing the abyss, even bulldozing half of the abyss wouldn’t be difficult. It would just take a lot of energy and time.
Dudian was shocked, excited, and sighed when he heard the words of Felicia.
He was excited because he felt that when he evolved to the Master of the Abyss and mastered the power comparable to nuclear weapons, he might be able to obtain many mysterious abilities that could bring Aisha back to life and restore her consciousness.
The sigh was that this process was too difficult.
According to Felicia, the main thing that the Abyss relied on to upgrade was the polar ice bugs!
If one wanted to advance from the lower level to the middle level of the abyss, they would need at least two polar ice bugs. From the middle level to the upper level, they would need five! As for what kind of conditions one needed to reach the lord of the Abyss, Phisnia did not know either.
“The important figures above the lord of the Abyss are the Seven Kings!”As Phisnia spoke up to this point, her beautiful face seemed to be flashing with light. She was like a little girl filled with longing and reverence, “That is the peak of the entire Kingdom of God. It is the strongest of all human beings. It is the limit of life. It is the closest to the ‘god’Level!”
“Seven Kings?”Dudian was shocked again. He didn’t think that the Lord of the Abyss was not the end. There were kings above the Abyss!

chapters.title: Chapter 921
chapters.content:
Chapter 921 – Chapter 911: Foreign Races
“Are the seven kings more powerful than the King?”Dudian couldn’t help but ask.
Phisenia gently smiled, “There is no king in the Kingdom of God. All domestic affairs are decided by the Parliament. The Seven Kings are the seven members of the parliament. They have a voting system.”. “The Seven Kings have their own legions. I belong to the Blood Thorn Army which was created by one of the Seven Kings. There are countless experts in the army. I’m only considered to be middle-class.”
Dudian was surprised. He didn’t think that the Kingdom of God wasn’t a dictatorship. It seemed that the seven kings were powerful figures. It was no wonder that Phisnia worshipped them so much, it wasn’t difficult to flatten any giant wall or sweep the abyss.
“Since the seven kings are so strong, why don’t they expel all the monsters in the Abyss? They should have the ability to do so right?”Dudian looked at him, dudian didn’t have a good impression of the seven kings. Although he didn’t want to kidnap the seven kings but from the power level described by Phisenia, the seven kings had the ability to purify the abyss. Once the abyss was purified.., there was no need for the existence of giant wall. The human race had gathered together and the speed of development was hundreds of times faster than the current closed stage?
Faconia wasn’t surprised by Dudian’s question but smiled, “You don’t know about this. The Abyss where we are located has been cleared by the seven kings hundreds of years ago. Do you think that such a strong wall can stop the invasion of Monsters?”? “Some monsters are so strong that you and I can’t imagine. But now the Seven Kings have eliminated all the monsters that are beyond the defensive level of the giant wall. There won’t be any left. Even if there are monsters, they are dormant and don’t dare to show themselves. Otherwise they will become the prey of the Seven Kings!”
Dudian was startled. was the Abyss area cleansed? He was puzzled: “Since they have eliminated all the Super Monsters, why are there remnants of the Abyss level monsters? Isn’t it just a matter of convenience for them?”
Phisenia looked at dudian, “This has nothing to do with the Seven Kings. Look at the surroundings of the wall. It has been cleared by the residents of the wall but there are still small monsters left. As long as the Devil’s aura is not removed, no matter how many monsters are killed, they will reappear. In the end, the Devil’s aura that gave birth to these monsters is the root of Evil! “The Devil’s aura can not be cut off unless the land is completely destroyed and rebuilt. But this is unrealistic. No one can do this unless they are gods.”
Dudian was startled. He understood what she meant. The Devil’s aura she was talking about was nuclear radiation. It was impossible to erase the effects of nuclear radiation just by relying on the power of the Seven Kings, even in the old era when technology was developed, it was impossible to remove the radiation from a piece of land. Moreover, the radiation covered a wide area and covered the whole world. No matter how strong the seven kings were, they still had physical strength.
Even in today’s ridiculously strong world, Dudian still felt that the power of science and technology was the ultimate dominator. Science and technology was equivalent to four taels of a thousand catties. If you had the strength of a thousand catties, how much would you move?
“Even so, it shouldn’t be difficult to expel the senior monsters in the Abyss by relying on the strength of the Seven Kings and their legions. It would be difficult to expel them once a year or once every ten years. The growth of these monsters would be curbed and their power would be limited. In the long run, these monsters would become our pets sooner or later. Maybe they would become endangered protection monsters in the future.”Dudian said.
Phesenia was stunned, then she burst into laughter, “Endangered monsters? You really can think of that, but you’re right. If we use all the power of the Kingdom of God and sweep them once every few years, we can indeed stop the growth of these monsters. After all, it takes time for the demonic aura to nurture the monsters. When that time comes, we might really be able to make these ferocious monsters into pets for every household, but…”
She changed the topic, she shook her head: “There are enemies of the Kingdom of God. The border is constantly in chaos. The Seven Kings have been guarding the border for years. They can’t spare the energy to clean up the abyss. It is enough to maintain the current balance. As long as everyone doesn’t leave the wall, there will be no danger.”
Dudian was stunned for a moment. His eyes lit up: “The border is in chaos? Are there stronger monsters in other areas?”
“Not only monsters but also some foreign races. Although I have never been to foreign wars but I have heard about foreign affairs from other companions. The most troublesome one should be the trolls in the south of the divine kingdom. They invade the border all year round. The trolls are savage and huge in size. They are born with strong brute force and destructive power. I heard that an adult trolls is comparable to our middle abyss. The stronger ones can even fight with the upper abyss. Moreover they have strong endurance and live in the primitive foreign lands. They have strong resistance in all aspects. They can only rely on real weapons. They use poison and flame but they have little effect.”
There was a trace of worry on her beautiful face. She had heard stories about foreign races since she was born in the Kingdom of God. The more powerful she was, the higher the position she would get, the more people she came into contact with, the more she heard. She had even seen the corpses of trolls transported back to the Empire from the battlefield. The huge size of the corpses shocked her so much that she could never forget them, so she told Dudian about the trolls.
Dudian was stunned by what she said.
Foreign races?
Trolls?
Is this the enemy that God’s kingdom is facing?
Dudian was worried when he heard about the existence of the seven kings. The power of the seven kings was enough to pacify the abyss. If there was no monster of the Abyss as an enemy then there would be internal troubles if they lost the enemy, it was obvious that the Kingdom of God hadn’t reached the point where they couldn’t rest easy. There was a terrifying alien race from abroad. It seemed that this woman wasn’t lying but was worried from the bottom of her heart.
This meant that the alien race’s strength was beyond his imagination.
But..
What was this alien race?
Was it a monster?
Or was it an alien life form that invaded earth?
Or was it something else?
Dudian’s mind was in a mess. The world picture that he had previously thought was torn apart. It wasn’t just a crack but the whole thing was torn apart!
According to the world picture described by Phoenix, the Abyss area outside the giant wall seemed to be the ‘wilderness’of the Kingdom of God. The real terrifying area was the lone land outside the border of the Kingdom of God, there were powerful alien races living in the isolated land!
Phisenia looked at Dudian’s changing expression and smiled. She knew that Dudian needed a period of time to digest these things. She had come into contact with the residents living in the giant wall, but the people who came into contact with the giant wall were only at the master level. They didn’t have the power to run amok in the Abyss and go to the Kingdom of God alone. Therefore their cognition was limited to the level displayed by the giant wall.
It was like a frog at the bottom of a well. Once it jumped onto the shore, the world it saw would be more than ten or a hundred times bigger than the narrow well?
She didn’t know what the frog thought at that moment. But she knew what kind of thoughts people like Dean who had never left the giant wall would have after hearing these words. There was fear, confusion, and even disbelief.
She could only give Dean time to digest and accept it.
The two walked side by side for a long time. Aisha also quietly followed behind Dean.
It was not until a jungle lizard suddenly jumped out that Dean woke up. Then he saw that the six-meter-long jungle lizard was kicked 20 to 30 meters away. Its skull was completely shattered and it died on the spot.
Dean looked at her and saw a beautiful smile on her face. Dean didn’t say anything. The jungle lizard that suddenly jumped out was just a small monster. He didn’t even need to thank it, he took a deep breath and said: “Are foreign races monsters or… other humans?”
Phisenia looked at him in surprise. She didn’t expect Dudian to be so calm. She thought that Dudian would suspect that she was lying. She didn’t expect that in such a short period of time.., dudian seemed to accept the fact and take into account the direction that she didn’t think about.
Human? She had never thought that foreign races were related to humans but her heart was moved by Dudian’s words. However her mind was quickly dispelled as she saw the corpses of trolls being dragged back from the streets, they were not human beings. They had nothing to do with human beings!
“They are a group of intelligent monsters.”Phisenia pondered for a moment: “They have nothing to do with human beings. I have said that the seven kings are the most powerful people. No one is stronger than them. If there is one then it is God.”
“There is no need to emphasize the strength of the Seven Kings. I am not a member of Your Army.”Dudian shook his head. It was obvious that the worship of the seven kings was deeply rooted. He asked a few more questions, he stopped thinking about the human race after he heard about the shape of the trolls. However he didn’t calm down.
Was the human race really the last group of survivors in the world?
Was there a similar existence in the Central Plains of China?
He asked about the foreign races in the foreign lands. She didn’t know much about foreign races. She only told Dudian about the names of foreign races that she had heard before. The names of foreign races were even included in the fairy tales, they became the Devils that the Warriors of Justice would conquer and fight forever.
Dudian talked about foreign races. He talked about the things in God’s country with her. She was very talkative. Soon the map of God’s country was sketched in Dudian’s mind.
Dudian couldn’t help but sigh. Sometimes he had to spend a lot of effort to explore things that he couldn’t. It was like a secret. But for people at that level, it was the most basic knowledge.
It was like a street beggar who always fantasized about the rich scene at the table of the aristocracy. But he didn’t know that the attention of the aristocrats would never stay on the table when they ate.
“The lord of the wall has the title of Earl in the kingdom. Above the earl are Dukes and grand dukes. The Grand Dukes are either the Lord of the Abyss or the vice-leader of our blood thorn army. They are rich people who have business all over the kingdom. They are people who have stayed from the previous era. They have retained the tradition of the previous era…”
Fusnia patiently explained to Dudian.
Dudian listened carefully and slowly understood the status of the lord of the wall in the kingdom. Count was a big figure but the title of the Lord of the wall was an outer title. The so-called outer title meant that the lord of the wall would be sent to the Kingdom of God, the Earl who managed the wall didn’t have real power in the Kingdom of God. The word “Outer title”was a nickname given by the nobles in private. Usually there was a bit of disdain in their tone.
Everyone in the divine kingdom knew that they were sent out to manage the giant wall. Although it seemed like they were given a title but what kind of place was the giant wall? There was a lack of resources and information. It could be considered an abyss nursing home.
The two chatted as they slowly returned to the giant wall where Barker was.
“Is this the giant wall that you live in?”Faconia looked at the giant wall. Her eyes flashed as she smiled.
Dudian didn’t deny or agree. He naturally wouldn’t expose the giant wall of Sylvia to Phisenia. Although they had a good conversation but it was related to his privacy, although the things that Phisenia had told him had opened up his new world view and helped him a lot. But he felt that he wouldn’t need to spend much effort to find out these things after he went to the Kingdom of God.
It was just a bit early.
As for some secret things, she didn’t say much. Some of them she didn’t know. Some of them she pretended not to know.
“I have something to deal with. Do you want to stay or not?”Dudian looked at her. He didn’t have any questions to answer. He knew what he wanted to know, phoenix didn’t give him an answer.
“Didn’t you say that you are going to God’s kingdom? I will wait for you.”Phoenix smiled.
Dudian nodded. He wasn’t worried that Phoenix would use local advantages to attack him. Firstly, it wasn’t necessary. Secondly, from the description of God’s kingdom, Dudian felt that he was very valuable, at least with his conditions, he could join any of the King’s legions. If he performed well, he could even become a captain very soon.
Felicia had invited him to join the Blood Thorn Legion but he didn’t give an immediate reply.
Dudian took Aisha and climbed up the wall. Felicia used both hands and feet to climb up the wall. It was like climbing but it was like running. The steep and smooth giant wall was under her feet as if it was flat ground.
Dudian went through several small villages along the way. He didn’t stop for a few hours before he finally arrived in front of the imperial city.

chapters.title: Chapter 922
chapters.content:
Chapter 922 – Chapter 912: Exploring Secrets
“I have something to do. I will meet you here in three days. What do you think?”Dudian wasn’t going to bring her into the city. He was going to smuggle her into the city, it was inevitable that she would see something if he brought her along. He felt that he should be able to find out what he wanted in three days. After all, there was an abyss in the God’s wall. There was no obstruction for him.
Phinea was a bit surprised. She didn’t expect that Dudian would part ways with her so soon. It seemed that it was not convenient for her to know what Dudian was going to do. She was smart enough not to show her curiosity, she naturally replied: “No problem. I will wait for you here.”
“Alright.”Dudian took Aisha and turned to leave.
Phisenia’s eyes lit up as she looked at Dudian’s back. He didn’t even express his hospitality as a landlord. It seemed a bit rude. was there something else going on?
After saying goodbye to Phisenia, Dudian walked around the moat. It didn’t take long before he arrived at the gate of the Imperial City. There were many people here. From time to time, he could see a large number of refugees. Some of them were dressed in shabby clothes, it seemed that they had migrated from places that had suffered from war and famine. Some of them were noble lords’carriages. There were also knights who used huge beast carriages to transport the corpses of beasts.
Dudian disguised himself and brought Aisha into the city with the refugees.
“Get lost! Get lost!”
“The entrance fee is ten copper coins. What? No Money? Get lost!”
“Scram, scumbags. It stinks. Don’t dirty the land here!”
Under the scolding of the city guards, some of the poor refugees were stopped. Some of them tried to barge in in despair, but were kicked away by the guards. They fell to the ground and could not get up for a long time. There were also some women carrying four or five-year-old children. Tears filled their eyes as they begged and sobbed. In the end, not only did they not receive sympathy from the guards, but they received even more hateful gazes and vicious curses.
Some of the refugees who had money rushed into the city, not daring to provoke trouble.
Dudian looked at the refugees who were stopped. He didn’t say anything. He paid the entrance fee for himself and Aisha and followed the other refugees into the city.
“If you don’t let us into the city, we will starve to death. I beg adults…”
“Humph, if we let you into the city, then you will be stealing everywhere. Sooner or later, you will be beaten to death. Sooner or later, you will die. Now is the time to die!”
Dudian walked in the shadows for a long time. Finally he came to the main street of the imperial city. The sun was shining and the street was full of vitality and noise.
Dudian looked around when he entered the city. He didn’t see any wanted posters. The reason why he was disguised was because he was worried that Monica would put him on the wanted list, it was inevitable that he would attract Monica’s attention when he entered the city. Although he wasn’t afraid of her combat ability but if she returned early then there would be enough time to set up a trap to deal with him.
He didn’t even look for the previous noble Lord because he was worried that Monica would place spies around him.
“I should first inquire about her news. If she didn’t come back and died outside the giant wall then it would be much easier.”Dudian thought as he walked along the street towards the central area of the Imperial City.
Dudian’s powerful hearing allowed him to listen to the conversations around him. Moreover his brain could automatically process the conversation. He could identify which direction the voice came from and who was speaking.
Dudian heard the news about Monica before he reached the central area of the Imperial City. It was coming from a tavern. It seemed that the people who spoke were hired thugs who were working for the nobles, they were talking about Barker’s whereabouts. Some said that Barker had died outside the giant wall. Some said that Barker had led Monica and other experts to hunt outside the giant wall and hadn’t returned yet, they talked about some strange actions in the imperial city in recent days such as the removal of the Head Knight of a certain royal knights and the promotion of a noble title.
Dudian stopped and listened for a while. Soon he had an answer.
Monica had returned and seemed to have taken control of the major forces in the wall. At present the entire imperial city seemed calm but in fact there was an undercurrent. From the conversations of the few nobles who lived at the bottom level Dudian found that he had overlooked one thing. It was the power and foundation that Barker and Holaney had left behind, all of these would become obstacles for Monica to rule the Imperial City!
She wanted to be on guard against him and gather the forces of the imperial city to deal with him. It was likely that she was too weak to do so. No wonder he didn’t see the wanted notice at the entrance of the city. He thought that Monica didn’t want to alert the enemy. But now it seemed that.., she hadn’t completely controlled the army of the Imperial City!
Maybe she came back earlier than him.
However, as the only Abyss left in the Imperial City, Monica didn’t use force to rule the wall. It was out of his expectations. Was there another abyss? Or was she concerned about something?
After thinking for a moment, Dudian gradually understood that Monica was different from him. He could use force to rule Sylvia because he never planned to stay in Sylvia, sylvia wasn’t his only home. He could leave at any time and abandon her.
But Monica couldn’t. She was born and raised here. She was likely to stay in the wall for the rest of her life. She wouldn’t be able to run away if the messenger of God came to visit her!
Although the Abyss was strong but it was an ant-like existence in front of the God’s kingdom.
As the Lord of the Abyss, people like Barker and Aristotle only needed an edict from the Kingdom of God to go and meet them. It was clear how low their status was!
Dudian sighed in his heart. Although he didn’t know if his guess was accurate or not, but it was 80% possible that it was so. It was absolutely stupid for Monica to forcefully rule at this time. Once the Kingdom of God found out.., they would think that she was the one who murdered Barker and usurped the position of the wall master. If she continued to keep a low profile then the Kingdom of God would send the news of Barker’s death to her. Perhaps the Kingdom of God would reward her for being the only abyss, as long as her brain wasn’t damaged she would choose the second option. She would have to endure for a few more years.
Monica was worried that Dudian wouldn’t die and would come back to plunder the rare resources in the wall.
Dudian shook his head and didn’t bother about Monica anymore. His goal was to find the secrets of the temple. The temple could sell legendary soul worms at will. It was incredible for Dudian, even if there were three abysses in the temple they wouldn’t be extravagant enough to sell legendary soul worms at will. There must be some hidden secrets.
That night, Dean let Aisha stay in a hotel to rest. He sneaked into a large temple. At this time, many temple staff were off duty. Only a few people were on night duty.
Through thermal vision and X-ray vision, Dean saw that there were seven or eight experts hidden in the temple. There was also a master overseeing the temple. He was a bit shocked by the strength of the temple, the strength of the temple wasn’t inferior to any of the Witcher’s legions!
If the temple had the abyss, it would be the most powerful force in the giant wall!
Dudian became more and more careful as he thought of this. Who could ensure that Monica was the only one left in the temple?
He carefully tried to sneak into the inner hall. However, as he stepped into the corridor, the eight experts and the master who were hiding in the dark suddenly changed their positions, they rushed towards his position.
“Exposed?”Dudian blinked but sighed in his heart.
Although the splitter’s attack was strong and its perception wasn’t weak, but its stealth was relatively poor. There should be a very good perceptive magic mark master among them.

chapters.title: Chapter 923
chapters.content:
Chapter 923 – Chapter 913: Hatching
Whoosh!
A sharp arrow suddenly shot out from the darkness.
The sound of the arrow was heard.
There was no shouting or greeting. It was a fatal attack. Moreover, it was from the most difficult position and the most tricky angle!
Dudian sighed again. His body suddenly turned around. The arrow that was shot towards his back suddenly appeared in his hand. He threw it in the opposite direction. The arrow was shot into the darkness at an even faster speed.
Clang!
Four Shadows fell from the corner and surrounded Dudian. The other four people were still hiding in the dark. The master was also observing in the dark.
“Come out. It is a bit despicable to hurt people with dark arrows.”Dudian said.
The few people who were hiding in the dark frowned. There were some doubts in their hearts. Dudian was able to detect them. It meant that his perception was not weak. Since he had sensed them in advance, why would he be so reckless to lurk in?
Two more people stepped out of the dark. The other three were still watching. They were confident in their ability to hide.
“Who are you? This is the temple. What do you want to do here?”A tall and cold youth said. His tone was as cold as his face.
“I’m a bit confused. I want to find someone to answer it. If you know then it will be easier.”Dudian slowly said: “Where did you get so many legendary soul worms from?”
“Humph! So you want to steal legendary soul worms. You are overestimating yourself!”The cold youth’s eyes showed disdain, “If you really want to know then I can tell you. But listen to me. These legendary soul worms are…”
Whoosh!
The woman behind Dudian suddenly rushed towards him like lightning. Her body was deformed like a cheetah. Her legs and knees were strangely bent and covered with hair, the sharp sword in her hand melted. Her nails protruded out and were longer than the sword. When the sound of wind echoed, she was already behind Dudian. Her full chest was almost on Dudian’s back, her sharp claws were almost touching the back of Dudian’s neck.
But in the next moment, her body suddenly stopped and stopped without any warning.
Then a sharp pain came from her chest. Then the pain came from all over her body. Her arms, abdomen, thighs, throat, forehead, eyes… she slightly opened her mouth and screamed in pain, after a while, her body fell straight down.
When she fell down, the bright moonlight shone on the ground, reflecting the shadow on Dudian’s back. It was full of spikes!
The spikes were like the back of a sharp blade. In fact, if Dudian wanted to, he could make the spikes on his back more abundant than hedgehogs, and more sharp!
“Impatient people will always interrupt others, but this is not good.”Dudian seemed to be talking to himself. However, the faces of the people around him suddenly changed. The speed of the people who fell was one of the best among them, the cold youth used words to distract Dudian’s attention. At the same time, he used the fastest speed to launch a sneak attack. Not only did he not succeed, but he was killed by Dudian instead. This reversal made them incredulous.
But the few people present were decisive people. They quickly reacted and rushed from four directions at the same time.
When they were close to Dudian, blood splattered out. In the shadow of the moonlight, a ferocious and dense black object rushed out of Dudian’s body and shrank back in an instant. It was so fast that it was like an afterimage, however, the few people who rushed towards Dudian stopped. Their bodies broke one by one and fell to the ground. Blood filled the air.
Dudian looked up at the three people who were hiding in the dark: “It’s your turn. Come out and answer my question. Maybe you can survive.”
The three people in the dark were pale. Including the master, they were stunned on the spot. Their legs had never been so sore. Their heartbeat had never been so strong. They clenched their teeth and held their breath. They wanted to turn around and run away, but when they thought about the first woman who was killed, their rationality restrained their impulse. They slowly walked out of the shadow.
Dudian saw that the three of them were tactful. He was very satisfied: “I ask, you answer. The hope to live is in your own hands. Don’t let me know that you are lying.”
The three trembled slightly and answered in fear.
Dudian repeated the previous question.
The master who was in his forties hesitated as he slowly opened his mouth, “We are not very clear about this. I heard that the headquarters has the divine power to hatch a large number of legendary soul worms. As long as there is a legendary soul worm as an egg, it can hatch many of them. However the cost of hatching is very high so the fees are relatively expensive.”
“Hatch?”Dudian frowned as he looked at the two people next to him. It didn’t seem like he was lying, “Parasitic soul worms can lay eggs? How come I don’t know about this? According to you, don’t you think that you can hatch a large number of legendary soul worms and produce a large number of deified legendary soul worms?”
The master’s face turned pale, he bitterly smiled: “Sir, I really didn’t lie to you. But it is not feasible to hatch a large number of soul worms to produce deified soul worms. Sir, you don’t know that these legendary soul worms can not be deified. It is said that there are no small sequelae. Relying on these hatched second generation legendary soul worms, they can not become Abyss walkers. Reaching my level is the limit!”
“Can’t be deified?”Dudian raised his eyebrows but his heart was more confused. He asked a few more questions but the master’s face was full of bitterness. He couldn’t explain the reason. The other two experts were also nervous, their eyes couldn’t hide their fear.
Dudian estimated that they weren’t lying. He thought for a moment and asked the three to lead the way. He was going to observe the temple in person. He wanted to personally check the legendary soul worm.
The three didn’t dare to refuse. They hurried to dispose of the bodies and lead the way for Dudian. They met some patrolling guards along the way and took the initiative to retreat.
Dudian smoothly went to the research rooms, libraries and other important places of the temple. There were also storage rooms for parasitic soul worms.
“Master, what kind of Soul Worms do you want?”The master carefully asked.
“I’m not in a hurry.”Dudian wasn’t in a hurry to look at the soul worm. He began to search through the research rooms. Some of the top secret documents were locked in a special box. Dudian violently opened them and looked at them.
The more he looked at them, the more frightened Dudian was.

chapters.title: Chapter 924
chapters.content:
Chapter 924 – Chapter 914: Assimilation And Deification
The night was getting darker and the moon was covered by dark clouds.
After the curfew of nine o’clock the traffic on the streets of the imperial city decreased. Some of the bars and small shops were closed. The curtains were drawn and the doors were closed. The Shadows covered the earth.
There was an oil lamp in the research room behind the temple. The light reflected on the side of Dudian’s face. The three of them stood next to him and carefully waited on him, they didn’t dare to look around or make any sound.
The sound of the pages flipping echoed from Dudian’s fingertips. There were a lot of books scattered under Dudian’s feet. They were all top secret information. Some of them were sketched with patterns, it was shocking.
“Split… Hatch… Aragami Research…”
Dudian’s eyes were filled with shock. He wanted to explore the secret of the legendary soul worm but he didn’t expect that it would involve the Aragami. He didn’t expect that such a sensational experiment would be carried out inside the giant wall.
These experimental data had confirmed his guess. The so-called temple was the monster research institute in Sylvia. It was wrapped in a layer of ‘God’mystery but the essence was unchanged. However, the experiments carried out by the Monster Research Institute were far more terrifying than the experiments carried out by the Monster Research Institute in Sylvia. The Aragami guarding the giant wall was used as experimental material!
Dudian had never been to the Kingdom of God but he knew that the Aragami were inviolable! The monster research institute was obviously “Against the rules”. It was estimated that even the Kingdom of God didn’t know about these experiments! Otherwise, there was no reason for Sylvia’s research institute not to study the mysterious Aragami. It was a precious experimental material that contained endless secrets!
The wind pushed the dark clouds and the bright moonlight once again shone on the quiet sky of the imperial city.
The pages of the book were flipped over from Dudian’s fingertips. His eyes slightly shook as the speculations in his heart slowly became clear, “The research of the Aragami has violated the rules. It has created a large number of pioneers and even rulers. It has used the temple to establish faith. It has used the struggle of the nobles to control the nobles. The manager of the Monster Research Institute… does he want to leave the Kingdom of God? !”
He had secretly cultivated the strong in order to grasp the power of the ‘God’!
He could feel the surging ambition and desire behind the ‘God’that was repeatedly mentioned in the top secret information!
Phisenia’s words echoed in his ears. The Seven Kings were the most powerful human beings and were the closest to the edge of God. However… Even the seven kings couldn’t compete with the omniscient and omnipotent God!
Once he mastered the god power, he would be able to cross the ‘Abyss’and ‘King’and directly become a god!
Was there really a God in this world?
There was no doubt that there was no god in Dudian’s knowledge.
So in his eyes, the person behind the temple was a complete lunatic!
He hadn’t seen the complete picture of the temple. All the veins, including the blood hidden in the dark, clearly appeared in front of him that night! If the temple was a beautiful woman, Dudian wouldn’t have seen the beautiful woman’s clothes. But at this moment, he saw the bones, blood vessels under the beautiful woman’s skin, ..!
“The legendary parasitic soul worm was split and used the flesh and blood of the Aragami to grow into a brand new parasitic soul worm. It inherited the previous ability but didn’t need to devour other similar soul worms to reach the Overlord Realm!”Dudian’s doubts were all solved, at the same time, he corrected his previous cognitive error from Sylvia.
According to this top-secret information, the “Deification”in his knowledge was not true deification, but “Assimilation”!
After devouring a certain number of soul worms of the same type, the assimilation would be completed. The assimilated soul worms’abilities in all aspects would be strengthened. At the same time, they would trigger the hidden power in their genes and obtain new abilities!
Completing the assimilation of Magic Marks was the first step to becoming a ruler!
Sylvia’s Dragon Mother, Wing King and the rest were all stuck at this step!
However, the deification that was defined in this top-secret information was actually these soul worms that they were selling! These soul worms were a part of the original body. After the Aragami factor extracted from the Aragami’s flesh and blood was mixed together, they would gain greater accommodation and potential. This also allowed all those who bought these Soul Worms to.., they did not need to repeatedly buy the same type of soul worms to devour them. They could directly break through to the ruler realm.
However, this was not a decision. According to the top-secret records, this deified soul worm experiment was not mature yet. Some soul worms were only semi-deified. They still needed to absorb the same type of soul worms to assimilate and grow stronger before they could break through the ruler realm’s bottleneck.
From the records of the top-secret Records, this soul worm splitting experiment was extremely complicated. The failure rate was very high. However, even so, a parasitic soul worm could still split into hundreds of soul worms, these split soul worms originally did not have the ability to act as magic marks. They were like puppets, or even a piece of unconscious meat. However, after mixing the Aragami factor, these split soul worms were ‘alive’.
However, although these ‘alive’soul worms had the same appearance and ability as the original soul worms when they were implanted with magic marks, and they could directly help others become rulers when they had sufficient resources, but.., they couldn’t fuse with the Polar Ice Worms! In other words, the “Deified soul worms”could only reach the level of masters and couldn’t step into the ranks of Abyss Walkers!
According to the experiment, the Aragami factor and the polar ice worms were repelling each other. It was difficult to fuse with them which also caused the experiment to be stuck at a bottleneck!
However, from the recent experiments, it seemed that the temple was trying to crack this bottleneck. It wanted to find a way to balance the Aragami factor and the polar ice worms. However, there was no good direction at the moment.
Dudian knew that once the method was found, it meant that the temple could mass produce abyss!
If there was enough abyss, even if there was a one in ten thousand chance, there would be a king or even a god!
This might be the ambition of the temple.
PA!
Dudian closed the data and looked at the ceiling. He slowly closed his eyes and opened them after a long time. He sighed in his heart: “Technology is really… changing life…”
The corner of his mouth twitched. The poor relied on mutation while the rich relied on technology.
If the experiment was completed then the temple would step into the peak of the Kingdom of God. Even if the temple couldn’t create a large number of abysses at the moment. Any middle level abyss would be able to flatten the temple, even the Master of the Abyss would have to bow down to them!
The three looked at each other in confusion. The master whispered: “My Lord, do you have any orders?”
Dudian looked at him. The three of them felt goosebumps all over their bodies. Dudian moved his eyes away and pondered for a moment: “Tell me about the defense and location of the temple headquarters.”
Although he had gained a lot from the temple but there were many pieces of top secret information. He was interested in the research on the Aragami. Through the experiment of the deified soul worm he thought about the changes in his body. Although he didn’t rely on the special machine in the temple to inject the flesh of the Aragami into his body but it was ‘alive’, moreover his right arm didn’t seem to have any electricity. Fortunately, he didn’t have any conflict with the polar ice worm. He didn’t know if his condition was deified or not?
If so, his magic marks should be at the same level as the deified ones?
However, he thought about the danger of the flesh of the Aragami. He would rather get rid of the deified power and destroy it from his body!
Hearing Dudian’s words, the three of them froze as cold sweat poured out of their faces. Did he tell them the location of the headquarters? And the defensive power? This was the rhythm of preparing to attack the headquarters! If Dudian wanted to sneak into the headquarters to prevent them from snitching, how could he leave them alive?
“This, this…”master’s face was full of embarrassment but his body was secretly storing power. He was ready to fight to the death.
Dudian glanced at the three of them: “Why? Are you worried that I will silence you? Yes, I do have such a plan. But now I have changed my mind!”
“Huh?”The three of them relaxed as they looked at dudian.
Dudian raised a finger, “I will kill two of them and leave one behind. Although it is a bit risky for me but I think the people who stay should know the consequences if they go to the headquarters to inform on me. Moreover you have survived such a big incident. The headquarters might not believe you if you inform on me. So I will leave one smart one behind. Well, I will leave the one who answers the fastest.”
The three of them were startled when they heard Dudian’s words. The woman in her early thirties reacted the fastest: “I know that the headquarters is located in the western suburbs of the royal city…”
The other two reacted: “I know too!”
If Dudian gave them time, they wouldn’t say anything. Perhaps they would be able to save their lives. But Dudian didn’t give them time to think, in particular, the long-haired woman was the first to speak. They didn’t want to think about other things. They only wanted Dudian to choose them!
At this moment, they weren’t revealing their human nature. Human Nature wasn’t so cheap. They were only showing the desire to survive that any living creature had. They were defending the temple together, at this moment, they had become the only enemy who had taken away their only chance to survive!
“Sir, you chose me! I’m stronger than them, and I know more than them. I’ve been to the headquarters, and I’ve been there a few times. They’ve only been there two or three times, they can’t be compared to me!”The middle-aged ruler in his forties hurriedly said.
Hearing this, the hearts of the two people beside him instantly turned cold. Immediately after, their eyes flickered with intense unwillingness and resentment, the long-haired woman gritted her teeth and said, “Sir, I was the one who spoke first. I spoke first. Although we haven’t been to as many places as he has, I’ve been to more places than he has. Moreover, the headquarters doesn’t allow us to move around casually. He might not know as much as we do. I know a minister in the headquarters, I…”
“I know a minister and several of them. I know more than them. I also know the underground structure of the headquarters…”
The middle-aged man was angry and angry. He opened his mouth to speak to Dudian but Dudian raised his hand to interrupt him. He pointed at the long-haired woman: “Tell me who is the most comprehensive one.”
The long-haired woman was relieved. She quickly spoke out what she knew.
Ten minutes later.
Dudian listened to the statements of the three and asked: “Does anyone have anything to add?”His eyes looked at the three of them. The meaning was obvious.
The three of them were stiff. They opened their mouths but had nothing to say.
Dudian sighed: “Then you can go.”
The three of them stared at him: “Didn’t you say…”
Puff!
A shadow flashed and a head flew out.
The long-haired woman and the scar-faced middle-aged man were frightened. They turned around and ran away. However two sharp blades shot out from Dudian’s back. They pierced through his chest. In the blink of an eye, three bodies fell to the ground.
“How naive. There are no outsiders here. Even if I go back on my word, who would know?”Dudian gently shook his head. It was not wise for him to take risks for the sake of his promise, a Promise was a lie. The value of a lie was to create value for oneself and not to bring risks. This was his understanding along the way.
He would only keep a promise to a person.
After leaving the temple, Dudian looked at the night sky. It was only early in the morning. There were still four to five hours before dawn. It was enough for him to explore the temple headquarters.
“Barker should know something about the temple. Even birds of the same feather would cover each other. The temple has brought too many pioneers to the temple. It has even given birth to two abysses, Holaney and Monica. The family behind them should know the secret of the deified soul worm. So they didn’t take the deified soul worm into the temple. Instead, they took the complete soul worm from the beginning…”
Dudian’s figure flashed through the streets as he rushed towards the temple’s headquarters.
He was too lazy to consider how long it would take for the matter of the branch to be exposed and spread to the headquarters.
Although the temple had given him a big surprise, but from the top-secret information, the temple didn’t have the ability to create an abyss. Even if they had hidden cards, it would be one or two abysses.
Dudian didn’t care if it was one or two abysses. Moreover, he didn’t think that there would be two. After all, Barker wouldn’t dare to leave the temple.
Whoosh!
Dudian quickly found the temple’s headquarters in the western suburbs and sneaked in through the side fence.
“Although I know the distribution of the defensive forces here, but my ability to sneak in is likely to cause trouble…”Dudian sneaked through the garden, he avoided many traps and hidden sentries in the garden. He prayed that he wouldn’t be discovered.

chapters.title: Chapter 925
chapters.content:
Chapter 925 – Chapter 915: I’M Back
As usual, the prayer was ineffective.
When dudian sneaked into the third laboratory of the headquarters, more than a dozen figures appeared around him. They were all pioneer level experts. There were two masters who were watching from the dark.
“Who are you?”One of them shouted.
Dudian sighed in his heart and looked up: “Your Grandpa.”
..
… ..
There was a Grand Duke’s mansion in the center of the Royal City next to Barker’s residence. Monica was leaning on her 3.6 meters wide pink bed. Her slender body looked very petite and lovely. She was wearing orange pajamas. She was flipping through the poetry collection of the poets. This was her favorite poet. She loved romantic poems and elegant words. She was even infatuated with them. She would read a few poems every night before she went to bed.
She had a lot on her mind these days. Even now, at three o’clock in the morning, she was still not sleepy. She flipped through the poems, and her restless heart gradually returned to peace. Soon, she threw away all her distracting thoughts, she wholeheartedly enjoyed the romantic and true love stories in the poems.
However, she was only halfway through the poems when she heard a series of short footsteps rushing upstairs. Although she had not knocked on the door, it had already pulled her back from that beautiful serenity to reality. She sighed and frowned, she placed the poem collection on the bedside table and waited quietly for the door to open.
Dong Dong!
“Come in.”
The door opened. The Butler, who looked to be in his seventies, with white hair and a tuxedo, lowered his head and slowly stepped into the room. He bowed towards the direction of the bed and said, “Miss, there is an urgent matter to report to you.”
“Uncle Lan, please speak,”Monica said softly. She knew that if it was not an urgent matter, at this time, the Butler ‘Uncle Lan’would have already fallen asleep and would not have come to find her.
“I just received a secret report. The temple headquarters sent an emergency request. There is an invasion. I hope miss will send reinforcements!”The Butler said in a low voice.
Monica was slightly startled. She thought it was something that happened in the palace. She did not expect it to be the temple that had always kept a low profile. Moreover, it was the temple headquarters. Suddenly, a sinister shadow flashed across her heart. Her eyelids twitched slightly, she said, “Someone invaded the temple? Their military strength isn’t weak, right? Over the years, the temple has accumulated a lot of death warriors, and there are about twenty rulers. Could it be that they invaded the Abyss?”
“It should be.”The Butler nodded and glanced at Monica at the same time. His dutiful face showed some concern, “Miss, could it be the outsider you mentioned last time?”
“It is possible.”Monica’s eyes flashed as she pondered for a moment, “Send people to tell the temple that I will bring people to reinforce them. Tell them to hold on. In addition, the defense plan that I told you about will be activated immediately. This person’s strength is extraordinary. Even if Barker and Holaney are there, the three of US combined might not be able to win against him!”
She had looked down on dudian but after the ambush of the ice dragon she knew that Dudian wasn’t alone, he was in control of an abyss level corpse King!
The Butler understood what Monica meant. Sending people to reply was the same as giving comfort to the temple. Monica had abandoned the temple!
“You finally came back. That Old Dragon didn’t kill you…”Monica’s eyes were deep as she clenched her fingers.
..
..
Dawn.
A single room in the imperial city. Aisha was sitting on the bed wearing a purple veil. Her posture hadn’t changed. Dudian took off his blood covered coat and threw it to the corner of the room. He opened the door. There was a fourteen or fifteen year old girl outside. She was yawning and holding a basin of hot water, she said in an unhappy tone: “Guest, the hot water you asked for.”
“Thank you.”Dudian threw two silver coins into her hand at any time. When the girl was in a daze, the door was closed. Dudian came into the room with hot water. He used the soap to wash his hands carefully and then washed his face, after washing his hair, the water became muddy and dark red. If he reached out to pick it up, there would be some pieces of meat in the water.
Aisha who was sitting on the bed slightly tilted her head and looked at the basin where Dudian washed his hands.
“Are You Hungry?”Dudian saw her reaction. He remembered that he hadn’t taken her to eat since he came to the imperial city. He felt ashamed and went out again. He was surprised to see that the little girl was still at the door.
The girl saw Dudian Open the door. There was a trace of surprise on her face. She quickly went forward and said: “Sir, what other instructions do you need?”
“How do you know that I have something to talk to you about?”Dudian was interested.
The girl smiled and pointed at the gap of the door: “I saw that the light was on inside. I thought that you might have something to do so I waited here for a while.”Her attitude was very different from before, she gave two silver coins to let her know that Dudian was a rich man. If she could help Dudian do something then maybe there would be a reward.
Dudian was a bit emotional. Who said that the people at the bottom were stupid? They were not necessarily stupid but “People”.
“Prepare twenty steaks for me. Take this basin of water and pour it into the sewer behind the kitchen. Then use this basin to bring me a basin of hot water.”Dudian said.
The girl was stunned. Twenty steaks? What kind of appetite was this? She was shocked by Dudian’s wealth again. She quickly responded and took the basin from Dudian’s hand.
Dudian closed the door and went back to his room. He wasn’t worried that the girl would see the blood in the basin. At this time, the sky was slightly bright. In order to save money, all the oil lamps in the passage were put out. It was dark inside so the color of the water couldn’t be seen clearly.
Soon, the steak and hot water were delivered.
Dudian did not let the little girl enter the door. He took the things back to the room and threw two silver coins to her as a smart reward.
Dudian fed the steak to Haisha. He fed her ten servings in a row. He saw that her abdomen was bulging and her stomach was full. He stopped and picked up the remaining ten servings and ate them himself. After a night of continuous fighting, he had consumed a lot of physical strength, he needed to replenish his energy.
“I didn’t expect that the research on the Aragami has been carried out so deeply. Moreover they have obtained advanced experimental equipment such as microscopes from the ruins of the old era. No wonder the master of the temple has such ambitions. The more you see, the harder it is to satisfy your heart…”Dudian muttered to himself, he couldn’t help but think of himself. He should be the most difficult to satisfy.
After all, he had seen the prosperity of the old era and even the bright starry sky. But now he was living on the giant wall and struggling to survive. He knew that if he didn’t go to prison.., perhaps he would slowly get used to it like a frog in warm water. Life would turn into an unexpected fork but it was difficult to go back to the right path.
Dudian sighed and used the hot water in the basin to wash his body again. He rubbed his fingers on his skin but the image of the temple headquarters appeared in his mind, it was destined to be the end.
The gains of the temple headquarters were much greater than he had imagined. He was excited when he saw the advanced experimental equipment of the old era. With these experimental equipment he would be able to study the cell structure of Aisha, this was the first step to truly understand ‘her’.
However, after reading part of the top-secret information of the temple headquarters, he was disappointed. He even hated the Master of the temple. He was too ambitious. The other party not only studied the Aragami, but also did not let the zombies go.
The Master of the temple had studied the zombie virus and the structure of the zombies through the experimental equipment. The experiments were extremely detailed. The precious experimental materials of the Aragami’s remains were probably a handful of zombies. Even the Zombie King.., it was easy for the temple to cultivate the undead but there was no way to control it.
The gender difference, age difference, body integrity difference and many other types of undead and undead kings had become the object of the temple’s research. However the final result had disappointed dudian.
He knew that even if he operated the experiment by himself, he wouldn’t be able to do it well. The experimental equipment could only deeply analyze the structure of the undead and the virus. The temple had already completed the analysis for Dudian.
According to the temple’s experimental records, the virus was an extremely aggressive bacteria. It had the infectivity of flu bacteria but it wasn’t like any other flu bacteria. It could invade not only humans but all living things, basically all of them would surrender in front of the virus. This included terrestrial animals, aquatic animals, and even small parasites.
Through the research of the virus, the temple deduced that the parasitic soul worms in the bodies of certain monsters known as named monsters were most likely caused by the virus!
And these monsters with parasitic soul worms were caused by the virus infecting the monster, so these monsters were equivalent to the zombies among the monsters!
However, this conclusion was not entirely true, because there was one thing the temple could not explain, which was that these named monsters were not as irrational as the zombies, fearless, and mad at the sight of blood!
On the contrary, the intelligence of many named monsters was much higher than that of ordinary monsters. They were extremely cunning!
According to the experiments of the temple, once infected by the virus, the cells would rapidly mutate, expand, divide, and strengthen. When fresh genes were involved, the cells would expand again.., divide… This was also why the zombies would go mad at the sight of blood. They could constantly mutate and grow by eating meat. For them, as long as new cells entered the body, they could divide and strengthen these cells, they could strengthen their own strength. Some cells would merge into the body during the process of fission. As a result some undeads would have different forms during the process of evolution and mutation.
Some were scythe undeads, some were extremely huge undeads, and some were like monkeys with vigorous hair!
The temple didn’t have a conclusion about the reason. But Dudian guessed that the effect of the virus on cells wasn’t simple fission and strengthening but a deeper level of genetic code recombination, even he wasn’t aware of the changes which made the cells with similar original genes overlap. So it could promote the mutation and change the form of the undead.
At the same time, Dudian thought of the experiments conducted by a crazy researcher who had appeared in the history of the Monster Institute in Sylvia. He used humans and monsters to feed the undead, there were also three kinds of “Feed”for beasts. It was found that when the undeads ate humans, the form of the undeads changed the slowest, but the speed of strength increase was the fastest, at the same time, the form of the undeads would rapidly change.
And the effect of devouring the beasts was relatively weak.
Combined with this experiment, Dudian’s understanding of the undeads was much deeper. However, this was still not what he wanted. He wanted to see how to get rid of the virus, how to restore the genes, and how to let Aisha regain her consciousness, he didn’t even know if the memory of the past was still in her mind. He didn’t dare to think about it. It was as if he didn’t want to touch the thing that he was most afraid of.
What made Dudian feel slightly better was that not all of the advanced experimental equipment in the temple could be used. Many of them had already been damaged. He didn’t know if they were damaged when they were unearthed or destroyed during the experiment, there were also some experimental equipment which were defined as “Damaged”because of the lack of power to start the experiment. He had to bring them back to Sylvia so that they could be repaired.
After all, there was no electricity here. Moreover he couldn’t memorize all of the manufacturing of the experimental equipment in the super chip. He had to follow the knowledge on the chip. And the Super Chip was in Sylvia. It was hidden in a secret place that only he knew about.
He did not intend to return to Sylvia with the experimental equipment. Firstly, the equipment could only allow him to understand the structure of the zombies and the structure of the virus at most. It could not solve Aisha’s situation from the root, it was like giving a pair of clearer eyes that could see where the wound was. However, the scalpel and the medicine that could heal the wound could not be made with these experimental equipment.
That was why he would rather not look at it.
He did not want to see things that made him even more desperate. He did not want to see his last hope destroyed. He did not want to carry the despair and look for solutions that he did not believe in.
After all, even if he had all the high-tech equipment from the old era, he had no hope of recovering Aisha. This involved a level that even the top medical and biological science of the old era could not achieve!
Only if the technology broke through again, such as cracking the technology in the spaceship that housed the polar ice bugs in the Ice Lake, might there be hope.
After all, that was alien technology. To be able to come to Earth from afar, at least it proved that some aspects were more advanced than Earth!
And the technology of these alien spaceships, or even the technology after cracking it, he believed that it definitely existed in the god’s country, especially after learning about the seven kings of the God’s country and existences like the Lord of the Abyss from Felicia, he was even more convinced that with so many powerhouses gathered in the place, how could there not be a few alien spaceships salvaged from the Abyss? Perhaps the Kingdom of God had already started conducting these research hundreds of years ago.
And when he went to the Kingdom of God, once he had the opportunity to come into contact with these, it was equivalent to taking advantage of the shade of his predecessors. It was far more efficient than doing it alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 926
chapters.content:
Chapter 926 – Chapter 916: You Are Going In The Opposite Direction
In addition to the virus, the temple’s research on the Aragami had given Dudian a lot of benefits.
The Aragami factor contained rich energy which could allow a dying person to recover in a short period of time. It could also be used on plants so that the damaged plants could be revived and grow well. If a small amount of it was added to the human body, it could extend one’s life. For example, the temple’s experiment on a dying old man. It didn’t take long for the old man to walk down the road from the bed, he could also undergo simple soldier training. His physique was even better than a normal adult, and he had lived for more than 20 years before he aged again.
However, when he was injected with the Aragami factor again, the old man “Stood up”again. However, in less than two years, he had weakened again. The effect was far less than the first time. Even so, this could be considered a miracle in medicine!
Without a doubt, the Aragami factor would greatly change the entire human world. It would become the favorite of the aristocrats and the rich.
