This was the profit value of the Aragami factor. For a strong person like Dudian, the Aragami factor was far more valuable than the achievements in medicine. The temple’s research found that the Aragami factor could stimulate magic marks and stimulate the potential of magic marks. There was a chance for new abilities to be born! Under normal circumstances, the magic marks would only become stronger when the human body evolved and evolved. It would further integrate with the human body and add more abilities. However, the Aragami factor could still be used under the condition that the constitution remained unchanged, the effect of allowing the magic marks to evolve was a priceless treasure to any hunter at any stage!
And this method was also known as “Divine Intuition”!
Although divine intuition was rare and precious, it was more risky. The temple had already experimented with successful cases of this experiment, but there were even more cases of failure. Fifty years ago, the success rate was less than 20% , but now it was much better, but there was still only a 70% success rate. It seemed to be a greater chance, but if one gambled with one’s life, even if it was 90% success rate, it would still cause people to be fearful.
Other than the effect of ‘Divine Instinct’, it could also be attached to the witcher device, allowing the warriors who had already implanted their magic marks to activate the Aragami factor in the witcher device to strengthen their demon body. This experiment had a higher success rate, moreover, the risk was not high. If they failed, they could just replace a witcher device. However, for most warriors who were financially strapped, it was also a kind of risk.
This practice was called “Deification of magic weapon”.
Deification of magic weapon would not restrict the growth of the warriors. It had no conflict with the polar ice worm. It was the path that most of the warriors with backgrounds chose.
Dudian initially thought that his situation should belong to the former. However, after a detailed controlled experiment, he found out that it was not the former. The former only used a very small amount of Aragami factor to complete the experiment, the Aragami factor extracted from the Aragami’s body was enough to complete the experiment of hundreds of warriors. However the Aragami’s flesh in Dudian’s body.., it was much bigger than the sum of hundreds of fingernails. Moreover it wasn’t injected into the body but directly swallowed into the stomach. The difference between the two was like heaven and earth.
His situation was not an exception. The ambitious temple had carried out experiments to directly consume the flesh of the Aragami. Moreover, the experimental subjects included monsters, beasts and other types of creatures.
Some died after consuming the flesh of the Aragami. Some were mutated and turned into monsters. Some had awakened high intelligence and almost escaped from prison.
There were all kinds of situations but none of them were like Dudian. He didn’t awaken high intelligence nor did he transform his body. He even suspected that he was one of those who had awakened high intelligence, but because his intelligence was very high, there was no effect… he quickly rejected the narcissistic idea. He felt that he was a bit smarter than the average person but compared to a real wise person.., he was miles away.
He understood human nature, and a wise person understood the mysteries of the universe.
There were countless great scientists born in history, and any one of them could instantly kill his intelligence.
At this point, he had to thank his right arm. Back then, his right hand, which had accidentally frozen, had restrained the Aragami’s flesh and blood, allowing him to escape. In the past, he did not know what would happen if that lump of Aragami’s flesh and blood drilled into his brain.., however, after reading the experimental records of the temple, he knew that it was very likely that it would be like the experimental records, “Awakening of Super Intelligence”. However, rather than calling it an awakening, it would be better to say that the original mind was being devoured, just like the humans, monsters, and beasts in the experiment that had an extremely high level of intelligence awakening, without exception, all of them showed a change in their minds that had never happened before, in the words of the experiment records: it was like a complete change of brain.
Yes, maybe it really was a change of brain.
This made Dudian more vigilant towards the flesh of the Aragami. Although it was silent but he didn’t dare to let down his guard. This thing… probably contained thinking, it could be seen from its previous attacks.
“The flesh of the Aragami contains independent thinking. If this is 100% true and not just speculation then what is this Aragami?”Dudian thought of the perfect face of the Aragami, he sighed in his heart. This thing might be the most terrifying thing on earth but the humans who survived the disaster were living with such a thing, they were even protected by them!
The sky was completely bright.
Dudian changed into a new set of cotton clothes. He took Aisha out of the hotel and paid for the room. He hired a carriage and went straight out of the Imperial City.
The carriage drove along the road. There were sounds of people talking in the shops, taverns and the square. Dudian soon heard some discussions about the temple. Last night he had broken into a branch of the temple, it seemed that news about the massacre of half of the headquarters had spread.
The temple’s position in the wall was supreme. It was comparable to a king’s power. The temple was in a terrible state and didn’t have the time to care about the news, most of the conversations were about the temple. However, the people were civilians after all. They were talking about the attack but they didn’t know the specific casualties.
Obviously, the scene was blocked.
Dudian estimated that Monica already knew about it. However, he had already done what he needed to do. There was no point in staying, he felt that he would have the opportunity to come back in the future. Maybe he would be able to get better equipment in the Kingdom of God. But the prerequisite was that he could get in touch with the core circle of the Kingdom of God.
The carriage drove out of the imperial city. Dudian handed the coachman a ten silver note with the lowest denomination. He pulled Aisha and left.
Before long, he was about to enter the beast-infested area in the suburbs and speed up. Suddenly there was the sound of horse hooves. He looked back and saw that the coachman was chasing after him.
Dudian was slightly surprised. After the carriage rushed in front of him and stopped him, he stopped.
The Coachman sat in the carriage and smiled: “Sir, do you want to go back and forth? I will pick you up here.”
Dudian thought of the little girl who was guarding his door. He shook his head: “There is no need. You can go back.”
The Coachman was disappointed: “Sir, do you want to go back? It is dangerous there. I am familiar with the road. How about I Send You Back?”
“Didn’t you just send me to the city gate?”
“You are joking. I was afraid that I would dirty the horse’s hooves and wheels. Sir is so generous so I should send you there.”
Dudian shook his head: “No need. You can go.”
The Coachman’s face slightly changed. He sighed: “Well, since Sir is so stubborn then don’t blame me.”He threw out his hand, he was holding a short dagger.
Dudian also sighed. At first he thought that the coachman was like the little girl who wanted to make more money. But later he realized that the other party was not only greedy, but also ruthless, he seemed to have lost all interest. His eyes moved away from the coachman. He didn’t even seem to see the dagger that was coming at him. He held Aisha’s hand and turned to continue forward.
Hiss!
The horse suddenly raised its hooves as if it was frightened.
Dudian and Aisha walked further and further away. The Coachman leaned against the carriage and rolled his head onto his crotch. Blood gushed out from his neck and only the horse continued to roar, his hooves were in chaos.
The Coachman was concerned about the proximity to the city gate. It was easy for accidents to happen to people. Dudian didn’t care.
..
..
After coming to the wilderness, Dudian and Aisha quickly moved forward. It didn’t take long before they came to a forest in a remote area.
The forest was full of leaves, so the humidity was heavy and the sunlight was sparse. Poisonous snakes and beasts were entrenched in the forest. There were colorful snakes swimming around the trees.
Dudian came to an open area. He picked up a small stone from the ground and threw it out. Swooshing sound and the sound of leaves being pierced rang out. One after another, poisonous snakes fell from the trees and bushes, the bark of the entrenched tree fell down and twitched weakly. In addition, there was an unknown half-meter long black-haired beast that fell in the bushes.
Dudian found a stone and sat down. He took out the polar ice worm from the Polar Ice Dragon’s head.
Dudian knew how to absorb the polar ice worm because of the information from the temple.
“It’s a pity that I didn’t take the one that was wrapped around the neck of the polar ice worm.”Dudian sighed. If it wasn’t an emergency then he would have taken two polar ice worms, but now he could evolve to the Middle Abyss.
The gap between the Middle Abyss and the Lower Abyss was the same as the gap between the Abyss and the master. It was obvious from the fact that he hadn’t entered the magic body yet.
Dudian took out the polar ice insect and began to absorb it according to the steps.
By noon the sun was high in the sky and the temperature in the forest had increased. Dudian was moving around in the forest. He was like a phantom as he moved through the trees, the leaves were blown to the left and right.
Dudian went back to his backpack. There was some doubt in his eyes. After absorbing the polar ice worm, he felt that his physique had increased by less than one-fifth. The effect was much lower than he had expected. He thought that his strength would at least double, two polar ice worms meant four times. It was similar to the difference between the low abyss and the Middle Abyss. But now it was only less than one-fifth. Did he have to absorb two polar ice worms to produce a qualitative change?
Dudian couldn’t think of an answer. He stayed in the dense forest until night time. He tried again but the result was the same. He had to give up and wait for the meeting with Phoenix.
Three days later Dudian arrived at the appointed place outside the imperial city. He didn’t see anyone from Phoenix. He frowned. was she going back on her words?
He waited for a long time before Phisenia’s figure floated over. She changed into a clean lady’s dress. She was wearing a light green dress. She looked like dudian: “Sorry I’m Late.”
“It’s alright. Women have the right to be late.”
“You are a gentleman.”
“Don’t misunderstand. I’m just casually saying.”
“Well, you are a warrior.”
Dudian held Aisha’s hand as they walked in front. He asked about the events that happened in the Imperial City.
“I had a lot of fun these days. I didn’t expect that there would be so many interesting things in the remote God’s wall. I brought you a gift…”.
Dudian took it and opened it. It was a small furry bear. It was wearing a bow and was pink in color. His mouth twitched as he returned the gift box: “I don’t need it.”
“It’s not for use.”Phisenia replied.
Dudian was speechless. He found that the other party wasn’t dressed like a lady. Phisenia covered her mouth and laughed: “Don’t give it to your girlfriend. She might like it.”
Dudian frowned: “I will choose the gift that she likes. You can keep it for yourself. After all the wilderness is lonely. It is good to accompany her.”
She shrugged her shoulders as she saw that Dudian didn’t want it.
Dudian asked her about the absorption of the polar ice worm. He told her about the method and effect of absorption.
It wasn’t strange that there was a polar ice insect in Dudian’s backpack. It was just that she was a bit surprised when she heard Dudian’s words, “It shouldn’t be. In general, the power should be doubled. You are just a low-level abyss, not a middle abyss. Wait, don’t Tell Me You…”
She looked at Dudian in shock.
Dudian was stunned for a moment. He was aware that the requirement for the Middle Abyss to become an upper abyss was five polar ice insects, was it possible that he was already a middle abyss? But he had only used one polar ice insect!
He frowned as he thought of the flesh of the Aragami.
Phisenia glanced at dudian: “It is normal for a medium abyss to have this effect. I told you that with your strength, how could you be a lower abyss? You lied to me before but now you are exposed.”
Dudian was speechless but he didn’t explain. He was glad that he didn’t tell her too much about himself. If she knew that he had used one polar ice worm to have this kind of power then it was hard to guarantee that she wouldn’t think too much about him.
Dudian didn’t tell her more about this matter. He continued to return to the previous trip to the Imperial City.
Dudian continued to move forward after he came to the giant wall.
After going down the giant wall, Phisenia followed Dudian for seven or eight miles. She looked at dudian suspiciously: “Why did you come here?”
Dudian replied: “Nothing.”
Phisnia was stunned: “You… Don’t you know the location of the Kingdom of God?”
Dudian saw her expression and replied: “Did I Go Wrong?”
Phisnia didn’t know whether to laugh or cry: “It’s not wrong. You are going in the opposite direction. If you continue to go this way you will be farther and farther away from the Kingdom of God!”

chapters.title: Chapter 927
chapters.content:
Chapter 927 – Chapter 917: Foreign Lands
This is awkward!
Dudian coughed twice. He was used to traveling alone. He didn’t think about it as there was a navigation system around him.
“Can you tell me the location and distance of the Kingdom of God?”Dudian looked at the forest in front of him.
“Fortunately you met me. Otherwise you would have been in Big Trouble!”
“What do you mean?”Dudian turned to look at her as if he had forgotten about the previous embarrassment.
Phisenia laughed: “This is the opposite of the Kingdom of God. You are getting farther and farther away from the Kingdom of God. Do you know where you will go if you continue to move forward? Isn’t this considered bad luck?”
Dudian’s eyes moved: “Do you mean… this is the place outside the border?”
“Of course.”
Dudian pondered for a moment. He had thought of such a result when he came out from Sylvia. But in his opinion, even if he couldn’t find the Kingdom of God, he would find other giant walls sooner or later, he would be able to see the new world. Perhaps he would be able to see the place outside the Kingdom of God. After all, the Earth was round.
“The place outside the god’s kingdom…”Dudian was excited as he thought of the trolls. He asked: “I heard from you that this place is remote. How far is it from the God’s kingdom? How far is it outside the God’s Kingdom?”
“Do you want to go outside the God’s Kingdom?” “Do you want to go outside the God’s Kingdom?”? “I advise you to give up on this idea. This is the east side of the God’s kingdom. I heard that there are trolls in the south, fire dragons in the east and snow apes in the north. I haven’t seen the fire dragons in the east but I heard that they are more terrifying than the trolls in the south. Although our strength is good but if we meet the fire dragons we will die!”
Dudian shook his head: “Tell me the location of the Kingdom of God. I might not go there.”
Phisenia frowned as she saw that Dudian didn’t give up. She picked up a dry branch and went to a soft place. She used the tree as a pen to draw a huge circle on the ground, she poked a small hole in the middle of the circle: “This is the Kingdom of God and our location…”
The tip of the tree cut to the east and poked a small hole in the middle of the circle: “This is our position. It is far from the Kingdom of God and belongs to the border zone.”
Dudian stared at the circle: “What is the distance between us?”
“I don’t know but it will take me a month to get here from the Kingdom of God. It will be smooth and smooth. It will take more than three months to get here by myself.” “Although we are close to the border but the closer we are to the border the more remote it will be. There are a lot of high-level monsters in these remote areas so it will take at least half a month for us to get to the border.”
Dudian nodded as he had a rough understanding of the map. He knew where Sylvia was. He didn’t expect that the weak Sylvia was closer to the Kingdom of God, if he had chosen the right direction then he would have arrived at the Kingdom of God.
“Do you know the coordinates of the other walls?”Dudian asked.
Phisenia shook her head, “The map we have doesn’t contain the coordinates of the wall. There are only marks of the magic pits. After all we are strong enough to destroy the wall if we go to the wall. Some people go out to carry out missions and ransack the wall. No trace will be left behind so no one will be able to trace it.”
“However, the Kingdom of God has a strict ban on this aspect. If there are other abysses that dive into the wall and destroy it, they will be punished the most severely. Not all abysses can guarantee that they won’t leave any traces. After all, once the information is leaked and the higher-ups send people to investigate, no one knows what kind of perception the masters of the abysses have. It is said that they have some terrifying perception. Even if you don’t go near the wall and destroy it from afar, you will be able to detect it!”
Dudian was startled. He didn’t think that there was such a rule. But it was reasonable. Otherwise, in such an environment where communication was blocked, God’s kingdom wouldn’t know what happened to God’s Wall for ten years, they would never know.
“Are you not interested in foreign countries?”Dudian looked at her.
“No!”Phisenia said firmly. It seemed that she wanted Dudian to give up the idea. She stared at Dudian, “It’s not a joke to be outside the border. Every year the Kingdom of God sacrifices countless soldiers outside the border. The fall of the Abyss is a common thing. Even the Master of the Abyss will fall outside the border. If I have a choice then I don’t want to go near the border. There is nothing to see. I’m not that curious. You should know that curiosity is often bad for people.”
Dudian didn’t expect her to be such a conservative person. However it wasn’t that she didn’t have the spirit of adventure. Perhaps living in the Kingdom of God made her feel more deeply about the outside world so she didn’t want to come into contact with it. But for him, when he knew that there were other places outside the Kingdom of God, he had a strong curiosity about the outside world. He was like a child living in the giant wall. He was eager to see the scenery outside the giant wall.
He wanted to see what the earth had become!
“Can you tell me about the East?”Dudian asked.
Phisenia didn’t expect Dudian to be so persistent, he sighed: “As your friend, I really hope that you can dispel this terrible idea. But I can’t persuade you with just a few words. Alright, I’ll tell you what I know. You should think about it carefully.”
“Thank you.”Dudian nodded in a sincere tone.
Phisenia shook her head and touched the branches on the ground outside the giant circle, “There are many powerful monsters in the east of the border. So the soldiers stationed at the border have to defend against the invasion of the Fire Dragon and the monsters at the border. Therefore, the defense here is very tight. No one can cross the border without the Order of the Seven Kings! “Unless we have the power of the seven kings or the power of the Lord of the abyss, it is impossible for us to cross the border. But once we cross the border, it won’t be easy to come back!”
Dudian frowned as the obsession in his heart disappeared.
Although he was eager to see the world outside the border. But it wasn’t just a matter of taking risks. It was a big problem to go out. As for coming back, it was even more dangerous!
Moreover, he didn’t dare to guarantee that if he was lucky enough to come back from the border and meet her again in the Kingdom of God, she would report his matter and betray him.
Phisnia saw that Dudian’s face was gloomy, she continued: “There are too many monsters on both sides of the border. Even if an unknown person like you isn’t killed by the monsters, he will be arrested by the border guards. The worst case scenario is that he will be killed on the spot. Even if I go near the border without the Order of the Seven Kings, it will be considered a serious crime. I will be stripped of my position and demoted to a pariah.”
Dudian was silent for a moment. The border wasn’t a small matter. Moreover the seven kings weren’t able to deal with the foreign races. It was easy to imagine the severity of the border defense.
“Alright.”Dudian exhaled.
Phisenia was relieved: “It’s good that you can think it through…”
“We will go and take a look. We will come back when we are close.”Dudian didn’t wait for her to finish her words. He looked at her stunned face and coughed, “Anyway, we are already here. We are so close to the border. It is good to know more about some things. There is an old saying that it is good to see more.”
“Some things are better not to see.”Phisenia’s face turned dark.
“But we have seen it. It is better to see the whole picture than the tip of the iceberg.”Dudian said.
Phisenia raised her eyebrows: “What do you want to Do?”
Dudian knew that he was speechless but he didn’t panic, “What can I do? Didn’t you say that you would introduce me to join the Blood Thorn Army when I go to the Kingdom of God? I think that with my ability, even if I don’t join the Blood Thorn Army, sooner or later I will be chosen by the big figures. Maybe one day I will be sent to the border defense.”
“You are thinking too much. The higher-ups will give you a detailed introduction when the time comes.”.
Dudian said: “I’m going to take a look anyway. Are you going or not?”
“You are a scoundrel!”.
Dudian shrugged his shoulders.
“Alright, I’ll go with you.”Phoenix sighed. She knew that she had no other choice. Although she was happy with Dudian as they had become friends but she knew that.., dudian wouldn’t let her leave so easily. It was possible that Dudian was determined to go because he wanted to test her attitude. After all, she knew one of Dudian’s big secrets — controlling the King of corpses!
Although she didn’t show anything strange about this matter for fear of attracting Dudian’s attention, but she knew that even if she was blind, Dudian would still be suspicious of her and even kill her!
“Go then.”Dudian said as he turned around and walked away.
There was a bitter smile on her face as she wondered if she had made a mistake. Maybe… if she said that they would go their separate ways, would she be able to escape?
She shook her head and threw away the branch as she followed behind Dudian.
As both of them went further and further away from the wall, the number of monsters they encountered gradually increased. From time to time, there would be more than 200 level monsters that would sneak out from the underground or the bushes.
In the past, when Dudian had just left Sylvia, he would inevitably be in a hurry to deal with them. He would even turn around to escape. But now he was casually killing them without any effort.
The longer he walked, the more he understood the meaning of the term ‘Abyss Walker’. It was too vivid. He could now completely maintain a straight line. Even if he encountered abyss-level monsters along the way, he didn’t need to be afraid, it seemed that the dangerous Abyss was just a suburban wilderness. He was a seasoned hunter.
Time passed in a hurry.
Puff!
Blood burst out. A hundred meters long reptile snake fell to the ground. Its back was covered with fine scales. It looked like a snake but also like a crocodile. Its tail was split. At the moment, one of its heads was broken and it lost its life.
After a while, she took out a small worm and collected it into the special soul worm jar given to her by Dudian.
The parasitic soul worm would die in a short time after leaving the host. However, it could live for one or two months in the special soul worm jar.
“Three-star legendary monster coiling rock soul worm!”She handed the special soul worm jar to dudian: “I didn’t expect our luck to be so good. We met two legendary monsters in just two days.”
Dudian took the jar and threw it into his backpack. The legendary parasitic soul worm was no longer attractive to him. He learned from the information of Phisenia and the temple that the Abyss was strengthened by the polar ice worm, there were other medicines that could stimulate the body and strengthen the body in a short time. However, these medicines had side effects.
There were some medicines that could permanently strengthen the body but it would be good if it could strengthen the body by one-tenth. These medicines were expensive and were priceless in the Kingdom of God!
The parasitic soul worm had lost its value in the abyss like Dudian. There was no effect after injection. It could only be used to nurture subordinates or give away loved ones.
Moreover, the parasitic soul worm was a three-star legendary monster. According to the information from Phoenix, there were five values of legendary monsters. They were one to five stars and five stars were the rarest, for example, Dudian knew that “Dreamer”was a five-star legendary monster while “Supplicant”was a four-star legendary monster. As for “Splitter”, it was a three-star legendary monster.
However, splitter was considered a precious existence among three-star legendary monsters. It was ranked at the top, it wasn’t something that ‘Pan Yan’could compare to.
Although Dudian knew that ‘splitter’wasn’t ranked high, he didn’t return to the divine wall to snatch the parasitic soul worm of ‘supplicant’. In his opinion, the star rating was.., it was just the evaluation published by the Research Institute of Magic. The evaluation was based on big data, not absolute data! At least in his opinion, the splitter was more useful than many four-star or even five-star legendary monsters. Although its overall ability was weaker by many levels, but its attack.., it was incomparable to many five-star legendary monsters.

chapters.title: Chapter 928
chapters.content:
Chapter 928 – Chapter 918: Purple Winged Dragon
According to phisnia, it was because of the splitter’s attack that it was classified as a three-star legendary monster. Otherwise, it would only be a one-star monster.
Dudian didn’t care about Phisnia’s words. He knew whether it was strong or not.
Ten days passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian and Phisenia continued to move forward. In addition to resting at night, they maintained a high speed during the day. They didn’t stop even though they passed through the territory of the Abyss Monsters, as long as they didn’t enter the magic pit, they would be able to move freely in the ordinary abyss areas.
“Let’s Stop Here!”Phisenia turned to look at Dudian after eating half of the roast meat, “We will soon reach the border. As you can see, the number of monsters we encountered yesterday and the day before yesterday is getting more and more powerful. If we continue like this we will soon touch the border. It is not too late to turn back now. You can see what you want to see.”
Dudian ate the roast meat in his hand. He stood up and pointed to the hundreds of meters high peak in front of him: “Let’s turn there. We should be able to see the border if we are close enough.”
Phisenia looked at him but didn’t say anything.
Both of them quickly finished their food and continued on their journey. In less than an hour they had reached the peak which Dudian had set his eyes on. There were corpses of monsters at the foot of the peak. Phisenia said as they climbed: “There are so many monsters living on this mountain. I guess it is the territory of some big monster. Be careful.”
“We can kill even the Abyss.”Dudian replied as he quickly climbed up the mountain. He didn’t see the Monster Lord, the air at the top of the peak was very fresh. Dudian looked up at the clouds: “Did you say that the Thunderbird is a bird raised by the Kingdom of God? There should be a lot of them living in the clouds.”
Dudian chatted with Phisenia while they were on their way. He knew that the Thunderbird was a war beast raised by the Kingdom of God. It was spread all over the abyss. Many rulers and the Abyss feared it, even the Lord of the Abyss didn’t dare to provoke a large group of Thunderbirds. The Thunderbirds lived in the clouds. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that they were overlords in the sky. When a group of Thunderbirds concentrated their power it was no less than ten thousand tons of lightning!
The effect of this kind of war beast was very good for the air defense of the border.
Phisenia nodded, “The number of Thunderbirds at the border is the largest. There aren’t many Thunderbirds in the clouds of the Abyss. The number is small and they are free range. It is different here. Even if the Lord of the Abyss crosses the border in the air, he will be killed by the Thunderbirds. As for people like us, I estimate that ten or eight of us will be turned into ashes in an instant. This is not to scare you. It is true.”
“Of course I believe what you said is true.”Dudian had a deeper understanding of the power of lightning. However, although lightning was strong but there was a way to restrain it, it would become the nemesis of the Thunderbirds. He suspected that the seven kings were using technology to enslave the Thunderbirds and use them as weapons of war.
He suddenly had a bold idea. Building a power station in Sylvia would cost a lot of money, but it would not bring much power supply. In the old era, the national power grid was mainly made up of nuclear power stations, wind, water, and solar energy could not be compared. However, the cost of building it was small, but it took up a large area. That was nothing in the old era. After all, although there were many people in the old era, the whole world was human territory, there was still a vast amount of land for human use.
However, in today’s world, the area inside the wall was limited, and the resources were also limited. In addition, the sky was covered by a thick layer of nuclear dust, and the light was thin. The most cost-effective solar power plants were not very effective, so they could only rely on wind energy and water energy.
However, these two things were barely effective inside the wall. After all, the giant wall that was a thousand meters tall was spread across the wall, so the wind force inside the wall would not be very strong. In fact, most of the time, there was no wind, so the efficiency of the wind power plants was extremely low. The same was true for hydropower. The water resources inside the giant wall were limited so it was alright for people to eat and drink. Moreover, a portion of the water resources would be recycled to provide electricity. At most, five small and medium sized hydropower plants would be built.
Moreover, the land inside the giant wall was limited. If he wanted to build a large number of hydropower plants, he would have to compress the living areas of the residents.
These were the most basic restrictions. Other materials, manpower and other aspects made it difficult for Dudian to build a large number of power plants at this stage. Therefore, the amount of electricity generated was not enough to electrocute an abyss.
It seemed that there was an excellent power source in front of him!
He suddenly felt that he was really stupid in the past. He couldn’t see the wealth in front of him.
“What are you thinking?”Phisenia frowned as she saw a trace of excitement in Dudian’s eyes. She had a bad premonition in her heart.
Dudian calmly replied: “Nothing. I just think that with the Thunderbirds there is no chance for them to launch an air raid. We just need to defend the ground.”
Phisenia nodded, “Yes, but the other races also have strong aerial beasts. But they are too weak compared to our Thunderbirds. The Thunderbirds that the seven kings have trained are not so easy to break through. Moreover there are rules in the kingdom that if you capture or injure the Thunderbirds you will be punished as treason! The Thunderbird is a war beast of our kingdom. It is also a guardian beast!”
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “What if the Thunderbird attacks us first?”
“We can’t hurt it. It will be a death penalty if we hurt it!”.
Dudian didn’t say anything but looked forward to it. He used his X-ray vision to look forward. His vision pierced through layers of the void. Countless dust was removed from his vision. It was far away in the distance, there was a giant gray shadow standing in front of him. He could only vaguely see a giant outline. It seemed that it was similar to a giant wall. However, it towered into the clouds and was very tall.
“That is the god of war’s Wall!”Phisenia pointed in the direction where Dudian was looking at, “With your eyesight you should be able to barely see the shadow. The God of war’s wall is hundreds of thousands of meters tall and completely isolated the border. Countless foreign races and beasts have crashed into the god of war’s wall but it is difficult to shake the god of War’s wall. This is God’s blessing. Only God can create such a great miracle!”
Dudian’s eyes slightly moved. Although he had heard her describe it before but he was still shocked to see the giant shadow with his own eyes. The God of war wall was one word taller than the god of war wall but the height was different, it was 3,300 meters tall which was more than three times the height of the god of war wall! It was not an exaggeration to describe it as a ‘miracle’. It was not something that humans could build!
Moreover, this god of war wall surrounded the entire kingdom of God. Its area was vast, and its length was comparable to the Great Wall of China, which had been around for 5,000 years. In the cold weapons era of the old era.., the Great Wall’s effect on China was similar to the god of War Wall’s effect on the Kingdom of God in the era of monsters. Its height was 100,000 feet, and it was enough to block off most of the beast tides on land!
How many corpses would it take to climb up the giant wall?
There were thunderbirds lurking in the clouds!
“Maybe the guy who created the god of war wall can really be called a ‘God’!”Dudian thought. At this moment he didn’t look down on the people who believed in the superstitions of the gods. No one had ever seen such a magnificent building, it was difficult for people to do such a miracle. But they believed in the existence of God. It was as if the god of war wall was telling the world that God existed and that they were the things left behind by God.
“The god of war wall is so high. How could the alien races break through?”Dudian thought of the countless casualties at the border. He had a clearer impression of the alien races.
Phisenia nodded, she sighed: “The alien races are much stronger than you and I have imagined. I have heard from my elders that although the alien races can’t destroy the god of war’s wall but they have many strange forces. They are good at climbing. The God of war’s wall is steep but in their hands it is like flat ground. In the end they have to rely on the warriors on the wall to fight.”
Dudian nodded. For some monsters, there was no difference between a kilometer and three kilometers in height.
“Have you seen enough? We should go.”
“Alright.”Dudian looked at the gray wall shadow. He turned around and went down the mountain with Phisenia.
Hiss!
At this time, a black shadow was flying through the clouds.
Dudian and Phisenia stopped to look. The black shadow was flying very fast. In the blink of an eye it was over their heads. Phisenia exclaimed: “Purple Winged Dragon? Is it a border guard?”
Dudian also saw that the Black Shadow was a flying dragon. However it was different from the flying dragon he had seen in Sylvia. The Flying Dragon seemed to be light yellow but it was purplish black. Its body was bigger, after he knew that the Thunderbird was a war beast that was raised by the Kingdom of God. He understood the real reason why the Flying Dragon wasn’t attacked by the Thunderbird. They were the lackeys of the same boss so they didn’t dare to fight with each other.
The purple winged dragon suddenly swooped down. Its body circled and turned back.
Dudian and Phisenia’s face changed. Soon, the purple winged dragon turned back and flew straight towards the two of them. The strong wind swept the mountains and trees. All of them bent down as if they were subservient people.
Dudian knew that it was too late to escape. He stood together with Phisenia. He looked at the purple-winged dragon up close. Dudian suddenly felt that the previous ice dragon was no more than this, the latter’s size was even smaller.
At this time, Dudian saw three figures standing on the dragon’s head. They were wearing strange clothes. One of them was wearing a scarlet cape. It was fluttering in the strong wind.
Two men and one woman were in their thirties. They were emitting strong aura. Moreover, they didn’t emit heat fluctuations. This was the reason why Dudian didn’t notice them.
Dudian knew that it wasn’t only cold-blooded magic marks that could hide heat sources. There were many secret manuals in the kingdom. For example, the ‘Dragon’s blood’of the Dragon Clan could control blood and hide heat sources.
“Two Abyss? eh? This is… King Corpse?”The three looked at each other, dudian’s heart sank as he saw the strength of Dudian and phisnia. He had hidden the heat source and so did phisnia. Moreover, the three of them saw Aisha, he felt a sense of crisis.
“Which wall are you from?”The leader of the group asked. He had a buzz cut and his eyes were full of sharpness. His voice was calm.
Dudian saw the eyes of Phisnia before he opened his mouth, phisnia stepped forward: “Sirs, I am the captain of the fifth team of the Blood Thorn Army. I met some things in the middle of the mission. I lost my medal. This is my blood tattoo!” She rolled up her sleeves. There was a blood red tattoo on her arm. It was a thorny flower.
The coldness in their eyes faded as they saw her blood tattoo. The tall woman on the left whispered: “What’s wrong with the King Corpse? Why didn’t it attack you?”
Dudian’s expression didn’t change: “Sirs, we met the King corpse when we were carrying out the mission. We used a special method to stop her ability to move. We are going to bring her back to the Kingdom of God.”
There was a trace of strange color in her eyes as she looked at dudian. She was ready to betray Dudian once he was exposed. She didn’t expect that Dudian would think of an excuse in such a short time, hand over the Kingdom of God? She had long seen that Dudian regarded the king of undead as more important than his own life. She could tell that he was most likely a loved one from his previous life.
She had seen a lot of such things. Many crazy people wouldn’t give up on their infected loved ones. They would lock them up and keep them by their side. They would even cut off their limbs and leave only one body, in order to stay by their side.
However, she knew that Dudian was different from these people. Even this king corpse was different from the other kings. She didn’t know the exact difference but she knew that it was a big secret of dudian.
The three heard Dudian’s accent. The youth with a buzz cut asked: “Aren’t you from the Kingdom of God?”
Dudian nodded: “I haven’t joined the Blood Thorn Army yet. I will be ready to join this time.”
“Three sirs, he came out from the wall and is ready to join the Blood Thorn Army.”
The three looked at Dudian but didn’t say anything. They didn’t think too much about the king of corpses. After all, it was impossible to control the king of corpses in the Kingdom of God but it wasn’t difficult to abolish the king of corpses’mobility, but it’s not that hard.
“It’s getting late, we have to hurry,”said another middle-aged man, who had one eye closed, as if he were blind and had only one eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 929
chapters.content:
Chapter 929 – Chapter 919: Arrive At The Border
The young man nodded slightly. He looked at dudian and Phisenia: “There is an emergency at the border of the Empire. We are short of manpower. Both of you should come with us.”
Dudian frowned.
Phisenia’s face changed: “My Lord, I have just finished the mission. I have to go back to the king to report the mission. I’m afraid…”
The young man with the buzz cut glanced at her, “The Blood Thorn Army is also a strong army of the empire. As a small captain of the army, why don’t you see the big picture at all? The border defense is a huge matter, and we are currently short of manpower. Since you are here, it’s only right for you to contribute a little. “Of course, I won’t mistreat you. This time, I’ll use the name of temporary recruitment to let you join the border defense army. When the time comes, your battle records will be recorded in your identity system. You should know how quickly you can accumulate battle records at the border defense. If you’re lucky, after this battle ends, you might be promoted from a small captain to a big captain, and you’ll be on equal footing with us.”
“Master, it’s not that I don’t want to contribute to the empire. It’s just that my task is more urgent. The king is waiting for me to report back. If I delay here and anger the king, I won’t be able to bear it!”
Not be able to bear it? A trace of coldness flashed through the young man’s eyes. He didn’t say anything. The Blood Thorn King was the Supreme King. He didn’t dare to offend him. However.., he remembered the threat this time.
“In that case, you should go back to report. The task of the king is more important.”There was no anger on the youth’s face. His eyes turned to Dudian, “This little brother has just come out of the wall and hasn’t joined the army yet. He will join the border defense. If you are lucky then you will be able to become a team leader of the army after the end of the battle. This is much better than going to the empire to report. You will have to carry out missions and accumulate merit points to advance. How can you accumulate merit points faster than the border defense?”
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He knew that it wasn’t a good thing. Since there was an emergency at the border then it meant that it was extremely dangerous. Oh No.., it should be said that there was a 100% chance of fighting with the alien races! In the border battlefield his strength wasn’t enough. He was like a general in the middle of an army. He was just like a duckweed in the water. He would be destroyed if he wasn’t careful!
As for accumulating merits and promoting to captain, as the young man said, he had to be lucky to accumulate battle achievements? He would be lying here forever.
“Master, phisnia has promised me to recommend me to the king. I have just come out of the God’s Wall and my experience is still shallow. I’m afraid that going to the border would cause trouble for all the masters. I will come back after a few years of training…”Dudian said.
“HMPH!”
A cold snort interrupted his next words. The youth’s face turned cold, he said in a condescending tone: “The border defense of the Empire is a big matter. We are the border guards of the empire. We have the right to forcibly recruit all the civilians. Do you want me to forcibly recruit you?”
A trace of gloom flashed through Dudian’s eyes. He turned to look at Felicia and asked her to help him.
Phisnia slightly shook her head as she saw Dudian’s eyes. She used her eyes to indicate that Dudian couldn’t help her.
Dudian’s heart sank as he saw that she was ready to do nothing. He was angry but it wasn’t directed at phisnia. After all, he and Phisnia weren’t really close friends. It was normal for them to fly away in the face of disaster, moreover, phisnia should be eager to leave him. At least her life would be guaranteed. It would be strange for her to speak up for him at this time. He was angry that he was powerless to refuse and that the young man had a tough attitude!
“Don’t waste time. Come on up.”The young man frowned.
Dudian’s mouth twitched as he looked at the young man: “Since the Lord has said so, I will follow the Lord to the border. We will meet again in the Kingdom of God!”
There was a trace of pity in Phisenia’s eyes. ‘meet again in the Kingdom of God?’? You probably didn’t know that people who were temporarily recruited were often sent to the front line of the war. The probability of survival was less than 10% . In other words, 90% of them would die!
What was the probability?
However, she didn’t want to break with Dudian at this moment. She knew what Dudian was thinking. She was worried that she would expose the secret of the undeads, there was no point. If Dudian died, the monarch would blame her for not bringing him back. As for talking about this with the three border guards? She didn’t even think about it.
They weren’t from the same system. Telling the secrets of Dudian to the three of them wouldn’t benefit her at all. On the contrary, it would help the enemy.
“I’ll wait for you.”She replied.
Dean looked at her but didn’t say anything. He went to the side and grabbed Aisha’s shoulder in a rough way. It seemed that he was wary of her counterattack. He brought her all the way to the front of the purple-winged dragon and jumped, he landed on the side of the dragon.
The back of the dragon was wide. It would not be a problem for seven or eight people to stand on it.
“If you kill this thing, you will have to go to the border to help. It’s useless to bring this.”The youth with the buzz cut frowned.
Dudian’s fingers tightened for a moment but soon loosened. He whispered: “My lord, this is the gift that I am going to hand over to the army. I am hoping to get a promotion in exchange.”
The one-eyed youth sneered but didn’t say anything. The Corpse King was a rare experimental material. It could be exchanged for a lot of money but you had to have the opportunity to return to the empire.
In his eyes Dudian was already a dead man.
“Let’s go.”The one-eyed middle-aged man urged.
The young man didn’t say anything. He glanced at the woman on the ground. He remembered the woman’s appearance. Today’s threat had damaged his face. He wouldn’t let her off easily if there was an appropriate opportunity in the future!
The purple winged dragon spread its wings and flew into the sky. It was thousands of meters high in the blink of an eye.
On top of the mountain, Phisnia instantly turned into a small dot. It became further and further away until it could no longer be seen.
“I hope we are not too late.”The tall woman’s beautiful hair fluttered in the wind as she looked ahead. Despite being ten thousand feet high in the sky, she did not show the slightest fear. Her eyes revealed a hint of worry, “I heard from the scouts that the situation this time is a little serious. I hope that there won’t be any big trouble in our hands.”
“Don’t worry. Nothing has happened to the god of war wall for hundreds of years. It Won’t be serious. It is most likely that the border guards were careless and let the alien beasts sneak attack us.”The young man with a buzz cut calmly said.
“It’s our bad luck. Only our 7th region has a problem with the 20th region of the god of war wall. These alien races are really stupid!”The one-eyed middle-aged man shook his head and sighed. He had changed his calm image.
The three of them chatted as they hurried along the way. It seemed that they didn’t notice Dudian at all.
Dudian listened quietly. The content of their conversation didn’t avoid him. It seemed that they weren’t afraid that he would hear something. Dudian got a general idea of the situation through the conversation of the three of them.
There were four sides of the god of war wall. It seemed that each side was divided into twenty regions. The three of them were the first responders of the 7th region. They were sent by the Empire to pacify the border war.
If the war didn’t calm down, the three of them would take full responsibility. It was because of this that the young man wanted to take them by force. Although the Abyss wasn’t a big deal in the border battlefield.., but it wasn’t a small bird. After all, the Kingdom of God wasn’t so terrifying that the border guards were all abyss soldiers.
However, there was the blood thorn king behind the border. Although the young man was angry but he didn’t dare to take them by force. If it was a very urgent matter then the Blood Thorn King would blame him, even if he defended the border and made a meritorious contribution, he might fail because of this.
After all, the word ‘blood’in the title of the Blood Thorn King was enough to show his character.
As the purple winged dragon spread its wings and soared, the gray giant wall in front of Dudian’s eyes became clearer and clearer. It was as if the gray fog had disappeared. From small to large, it was revealed in his sight. It was a steep and towering giant wall, originally in Dudian’s heart, it was a majestic building. But in front of this towering giant wall, it suddenly lost its momentum. It was as small as a weak child.
It really towered into the clouds!
Dudian’s heart was shocked. The border defense war was really considered a fight in the sky!
The purple winged dragon’s speed was very fast. The hurricane whistled by. In the blink of an eye, it took a few people to fly above the god of war wall. They followed the purple winged dragon through the thin clouds. The moisture of the clouds brushed past their bodies. The world above the clouds was particularly dazzling. The clouds in the distance were like cotton candy or a sprinkling of flour. Soon, the purple winged dragon flew into the clouds. The wind whistled.
In the whistling sound, Dudian faintly heard the sharp chirping of birds and the rumbling of thunder!
It seemed that a lightning flashed in his mind. It was the Thunderbird!
Before he could follow the sound, the sudden acceleration of the wind forced him to use his hand to tightly grasp the rope on the back of the purple winged dragon. His other hand grabbed Aisha to prevent her from falling down.
The clouds suddenly moved back, and his vision became clear in an instant. Dudian was stunned. He suddenly wondered if he had suddenly landed on the ground. In front of him was a vast square flat ground, there were countless soldiers stationed on the square. They were standing like javelins and holding spears. Their military posture was neat and imposing.
Dudian saw green trees and rivers on the edge of the flat ground. It was obvious that the vast square was the top of the god of war’s wall.
However, the width was large enough to form a battlefield!
Dudian suddenly understood why the god of war wall could shelter the Kingdom of God for so long. With the thickness of the wall, it would take several days for the abyss monsters to destroy it, moreover, the god of war wall should be made of the same material as the giant wall. It wasn’t made of ordinary rock. The great splitter had only left a few shallow claw marks on the wall of Sylvia. One could imagine the toughness of the material!
Whoosh!
The purple-winged wyvern quickly braked and stirred up a hurricane. The soldiers’hats and headscarves on the top of the wall fluttered in the wind. The war flags that were stuck on the side of the wall also fluttered in the wind.
Soon, a few figures quickly rushed over from afar. The leader was a sixty-year-old man wearing dark golden armor. His hair was white and he did not wear a helmet. His face was stained with blood. His armor was also stained with blood, there was also minced meat between the gaps of the armor. He saw the young man with a buzz cut and the others on the dragon. He was relieved and smiled: “Finally, I have waited for you. I can finally breathe a sigh of relief!”
The young man with a buzz cut stepped lightly and jumped down from the neck of the dragon. The tall woman and the one-eyed middle-aged man followed closely behind.
Dudian also jumped down with them.
When he and Aisha landed, the soldiers who were standing straight all looked over. For a moment, countless murderous aura quickly gathered on Dudian. To be precise, it was gathered on Aisha who was next to Dudian, countless spears and guns were directed at him.
At this moment, even Dudian, whose hands were stained with blood, felt a chill.
These soldiers were completely different from the ones he had seen in the past. He could see that these people were pioneers! The pioneers who were considered experts in the wall seemed to be at the lowest level here. However, these people were completely different from the ones he had seen in the past. Their bodies were full of murderous intent. It was as if they had climbed out of hell.
Dudian’s hair stood on end. He instinctively had the impulse to fight and resist.
“Eh?”The sixty-year-old man who had spoken earlier frowned slightly. His nasal voice was soft. The soldiers around him immediately received the message and put away their guns. It seemed that the previous scene didn’t exist at all.
However, the murderous intent still shrouded around Dudian. It seemed that once Aisha made any unusual movements, she would immediately take action.
“Who is this?”The sixty-year-old man looked at Dudian with some doubts. It seemed that Dudian was not a border guard. Moreover, he had never seen him before. However, he could see that this king corpse seemed to belong to this young man.
“Don’t misunderstand. He is a temporary sign that we are on the way here. I heard that the situation here is critical. He is at the level of the Abyss. I thought that he could be of some help here.”The young man with the buzz cut changed his arrogant attitude, he politely said to the old man.
The old man understood. No wonder he felt that Dudian was a bit strange. It seemed that he hadn’t reached the level of border guard.
“Who is this King Corpse?”The old man asked.
“He brought it with him. He is going to bring it back to the Kingdom of God and give it to the king.”The young man didn’t want to waste his breath on Dudian. He asked: “How is the situation here?”
The sixty-year-old man’s face turned serious, he said in a deep voice: “Last Night there was a group of strange beasts that sneaked onto the god of war’s wall. They hid from the sentries and almost broke through our defense. Fortunately we were able to detect them in time and didn’t cause a disaster. But…”

chapters.title: Chapter 930
chapters.content:
Chapter 930 – Chapter 920: Killing Intent
“But what?”
The old man sighed, “But these strange beasts have never been seen before. Although there aren’t many of them but they have caused heavy casualties to our warriors. The sentry in front of us had sent a warning message last night. They said that they saw traces of the fire dragon. There are many beasts that are moving towards this area. I guess they are the ones that are driving the beasts. The number of beasts that have been observed is “II”level. If they attack the seventh area then I’m afraid that we won’t be able to defend this area. So I sent a message to the empire to ask for reinforcements.”
Dudian’s heart skipped a beat. Did they send the message last night? It would take at least a month to get to the Empire from here. Didn’t it mean that they only used one night to send the message to the empire?
It was even faster. After all, if the Empire sent people to the Empire as soon as they received the message, it would take time for the three border guards to rush over.
Thinking of the flying speed of the purple winged dragon, Dudian calculated in his heart. He felt that if there were no obstacles along the way, it might be enough to cover more than a month’s time on the land, this was probably the efficiency of the “Air Force”.
“Level II Beast Group?”The three men’s face slightly changed as a trace of seriousness flashed through their eyes.
The old man nodded slightly, “The information we have so far is not very accurate, but the accuracy rate is usually around 80% . Currently, I have already sent people to patrol outside the battlefield fortress in front. If there is any movement, immediately report back. With the three of you rushing over to reinforce us, my heart is also at ease. If nothing unexpected happens, we should be able to hold the fort!”
“The border defense is a serious matter. We can not allow any accidents to happen. Otherwise, it would be our negligence!”The young man with the buzz cut displayed his attitude. Then, he glanced at the imposing warriors around him, he frowned and said, “You don’t have many strange daemons. How did you make the Warriors suffer heavy casualties? Could it be a group of high-tier daemons?”
The old man shook his head and smiled bitterly, “In terms of combat power, they are not as good as our warriors. However, these things are very good at hiding. The sentries in front of US actually did not notice them at all. Moreover, these things are full of poison, and they will self-destruct before they die, forming a poisonous area. If more than ten of them self-destruct in one place, the poisonous gas released would be almost like a swamp, and they would not be able to step into it. Many warriors did not have time to guard against it, and the poisonous gas entered their bodies. Currently, they are receiving treatment from the medical team, but the situation is not very optimistic. There are already many warriors who have been poisoned and died in vain.”
“So Powerful?”The young man’s face slightly changed. It was common for warriors to be injured and poisoned. But if they couldn’t be cured and died, then they would suffer a great loss. These warriors were painstakingly trained. They were the most elite warriors in the empire’s military, every single one of them was spent with countless resources and money!
Dudian was secretly shocked. The strength of the monsters was inferior to that of the pioneers but they actually caused such a great damage to the border defense. As expected, strength was not the only criterion to judge the enemy, the soft strength of many low-level monsters was more terrifying than the abyss!
“Let’s talk while we walk.”The old man turned around and glanced at dudian: “This young man seems to be strong. How Do you plan to arrange it?”
“You can arrange it according to the other temporary recruits.”The young man said without thinking. He knew that the reason why the old man noticed Dudian was not because Dudian was an abyss, but because Dudian was brought by them. Maybe he had a close relationship with them. Or maybe he was the child of an important figure in the empire.
“I know.”The old man nodded. Since the young man said so, it meant that he was not lying. The young man was really an unlucky guy who was recruited by him on the way.
“Raisa, you go and arrange the young man.”The old man said to a tall woman who was wearing a silver gray military uniform.
The woman was wearing a red frame and a military hat. Her temperament was sexy and charming but there was a bit of cold arrogance. Any man who saw her would be moved. Her face was cold as she replied: “Yes!”
The old man led the three young men and left the place. The others followed and surrounded them like stars surrounding the Moon. Only Dudian and the female officer named Raisa were left, the soldiers were stationed in the same place.
“What’s Your Name?”Reisha turned to look at Dudian.
Dudian replied: “Dudian.”
“Dudian?”Reisha looked at him and nodded: “Come with me.”
Dudian took Aisha and followed behind her.
The width of the god of war’s wall was very wide. The living area of the soldiers was close to the inner side. The outer side was the defensive line. Some of the enemies who climbed to the top of the wall would be killed outside the defensive line, it was also a temporary battlefield on the wall. The smell of blood was always lingering on the ground.
Dudian followed Raisa through the barracks. They walked for a long time and came to another group of tents. There were also soldiers stationed in the vicinity but there were few other idle soldiers, moreover, the soldiers were different from the ones who were outside the barracks. Although some of them were strolling around and chatting or even gambling but they were all wearing military armor, it seemed that they were ready to join the war at any time.
There was a lazy feeling in the eyes of the soldiers. Almost none of them were wearing full military armor. Some of them were only wearing military pants and white shirts. Some of them had messy hair, they were yawning as if they had just woken up.
The faces of the people changed when they saw Reisha coming over. The people who were joking immediately stopped.
Soon, everyone’s attention shifted to Dean and Aisha who were following behind Reisha. Some of them saw Aisha and their eyes flickered as if they had noticed something, some of them were gloating at Dean and Aisha while others were looking at them with sympathy.
Reisha ignored the people who were strolling outside the camp and went straight to the center of the camp. There was a big tent in the middle of the camp. It was very spacious. There was a desk at the top where a bald man was sitting. His feet were on the desk, in his arms was a young woman in a half-naked military uniform. Her flat abdomen was as smooth as silk. A rough hand was moving and kneading on it.
This big hand was even bigger than the woman’s waist. It seemed to be able to break her waist with one hand.
Seeing Raisa come in, the two who were in the middle of passion immediately stopped. The bald man looked up and saw that it was Raisa. He immediately swallowed the foul words that were about to rush out of his mouth. He said in a bad mood, “Can’t you get someone to report it?”
Reisha indifferently looked at him: “Is that necessary? Even if you are at a critical moment, I can wait by the side. It would be good to watch a live performance.”
Dudian didn’t expect Reisha to say such tough words. She was like an iceberg. He had seen a lot of such people, nowadays shy girls were much rarer than amorous aunts.
The bald man rolled his eyes but pushed the young girl away. He waved his hand to signal her to go down.
The girl nodded obediently. She put on her clothes and left in small steps. She looked at Dudian as she passed by him. Her face turned red as she saw Dudian looking at her, she hurried past.
Dudian’s face was calm. He knew that the girl’s face was deliberately shy. In fact, there were countless prostitutes who received clients. As long as there was a need, there would be a supply.
Raisa casually walked to the side and sat down. She glanced at Dudian who was standing at the entrance of the tent, she said: “This is a temporary recruitment camp. What are you good at? What are the magic marks? Tell This Dead Baldy to arrange a suitable army for you. He will be your boss from now on. Of course, he will be your second brother when I’m around.”
Baldy’s face was dark but he was familiar with her character. It wasn’t the first time that he ignored Raisa, he asked Dudian: “It seems that you are from the abyss. It is rare to see such a level of master in the temporary recruitment camp. What is your name? Also, what is the deal with the King Corpse next to you?”
He looked interested but didn’t think that the King Corpse was under Dudian’s control.
Dudian frowned, he whispered: “My Name Is Dudian. I caught her from the wilderness. I’m going to give her to the king after the recruitment period is over.”He heard others mention that the kingdom of god was called “Empire”, he deliberately used the word ‘return’to hint at his identity. At present he knew that he was the one who had come out of the wall. There were only three young men with short hair. But he felt that the three of them wouldn’t deliberately tell others that he had come out of the wall and not from the Kingdom of God.
As for the accent, Dudian had thought of a lot of reasons. For example, he was sent out to carry out missions when he was a child and he had interned in the wall.
“For the King?”Baldy and Raisa looked at him but didn’t show any strange expression, baldy nodded: “This king seems to be an abyss level corpse. It is quite capable to catch an abyss level corpse. However the king is easy to cultivate. There is no difference between an abyss level corpse and a hunter level corpse. It shouldn’t be able to exchange for many things. Why Don’t You Give It to me? I can give you something good.”
Dudian’s heart sank: “What are you going to do?”
Baldy didn’t care about Dudian’s rude tone, “Of course I’m going to have fun. You just came here and don’t know how boring it is. The top forbids drinking and gambling for more than an hour. The only thing I can do is to play with women. I’m tired of playing with these chicks. It’s been a long time since I’ve played with zombies. Hehe, I really miss them!”
Dudian’s eyes were cold as he clenched his fingers. But soon he let go of his hand. He lowered his head to suppress the anger in his body, he slowly said: “I was going to give her to the monarch. I have already informed her. I’m afraid it won’t be good if I can’t send her to the monarch.”
The bald man laughed: “What nonsense are you talking about? You should have been caught while carrying out a mission. You haven’t returned to the empire yet. How could you tell the monarch about this? Moreover, how would the King Contact You? It’s not a good habit to learn to lie.”
Dudian’s fingers trembled as he lowered his head, he shook his head: “I’m not lying. The leader of the 5th team of the Blood Thorn Army is PHISNIA. She was going to recruit both of us but she had an important mission. I told her about it. She will help me report to the king. So…”
“Phisonia?”The bald man frowned. He had never heard of this name but it seemed that Dudian wasn’t lying. The smile on his face disappeared as he stared at dudian. His fingers gently tapped on the table. The air in the tent seemed to be a bit oppressive.
If it was anyone else, they would have been anxious.
But Dudian was trying to restrain his killing intent.
“How about this? You can lend me for a few days. I will return it to you after I wash it. How about that?”The bald man emphasized each word.
There was silence in the tent.
The silence lasted for a long time before Dudian’s voice came out: “What If I don’t want to?”
The Bald Man’s eyes turned cold. He was about to open his mouth when Raisa interrupted him, she said impatiently, “Alright, let’s get down to business. Where are we going with this? You Bald Man, you have been fooling around with women all day. Now that you’ve gotten your hands on a zombie, aren’t you afraid that you’ll infect that thing or bite it?”
The coldness in the Bald Man’s eyes faded as if nothing had happened. A smile appeared on his face once again, he said, “I’m just joking. Why Are You So Serious? I’m just saying. However, there’s a different kind of excitement when it comes to dealing with zombies. You guys haven’t experienced it before. Besides, how can this thing be infected with a membrane cover? “I remember that I used to deal with undeads. I broke its teeth and put my work in front of it. The way it bit me was so good!”
“Enough!”Reisha frowned and scolded: “It’s not over yet. Have You Lost Your Mind? !”
Baldy’s face slightly changed. He knew that the joke had gone too far. He scratched his head: “I’m just saying. Alright, Alright. I Won’t say anymore. It’s all your fault.”
Raisa stared at him.
Baldy smiled but didn’t mention the matter anymore. He looked up at dudian: “What are your magic marks? Tell me your specific strength so that I can arrange you to join the corresponding army.”
“Splitter.”Dudian replied quickly. He didn’t hide anything. Although legendary magic marks were rare in the God’s wall but they weren’t rare in this place, would be valued. However, this wasn’t the main reason why he was so straightforward.

chapters.title: Chapter 931
chapters.content:
Chapter 931 – Chapter 921: Assault Camp
“The splitter?”The bald man smiled, “It’s a three-star magic mark. TSK, TSK, it’s rare. I remember that the splitter’s magic mark is good at attacking. In that case, you can only go to the frontline assault camp.”
Raisa glanced at him. “Aren’t you going to verify it?”
The bald man grinned: “What’s there to verify? I believe in the character of this little brother. He Won’t lie.”
Reisha rolled her eyes and glanced at Dudian who was silent. She shook her head. Her experience was too shallow. Not only did she offend the commander of the temporary recruitment camp, but she also had no brain, if Dudian said that he had magic marks of perception type or detection type, even if the Baldy was dissatisfied with him, he wouldn’t dare to openly divide him into the vanguard camp in front of him.
The private hatred in the border could only be resolved in private. If anyone was involved in the war, once it was detected, it wouldn’t be a small punishment.
Now that Dudian was assigned to the vanguard camp, it was clear that the time he could live could only be calculated by the number of days. Even she couldn’t change anything. After all, Dudian didn’t have any background so it wasn’t worth her help.
Dudian was relieved as he saw the bald man’s impatient look. He had made the right bet.
His vision was very accurate. If he offended the bald man then the other side would definitely find fault with him. If he said that he was a perceptive type magic mark then the other side might not believe him, they would even ask him to activate the magic body on the spot to verify it. Although his magic body was a splitter but it was different from the ordinary splitter. If they found out something then it would be more troublesome.
“Dudian, Splitter’s magic marks, Abyss Level…”Baldy took out a book from the table and wrote down the information about dudian, “Good, you have added a general. You should work hard and kill more enemies on the battlefield. With the destructive power of your magic marks, it will be easy for you to accumulate battle achievements. I guess you will be rewarded directly when you return to the Kingdom of God after your temporary enlistment!”
Dudian nodded but didn’t say anything. Although the Baldy’s words were very tempting, but his eyes and tone were obviously gloating. The Vanguard Camp, as the name implied, was obviously the cannon fodder who rushed at the front. The accumulation of battle achievements was fast, but the speed of sacrifice was faster. In such a level of battlefield, he was just a general, it was just a joke that the other party was in a good mood.
As for why Baldy was in such a good mood, Dudian also knew the reason. Once he died, Aisha would be ownerless!
“How long will the temporary conscription be?”Dudian asked.
Baldy smiled: “Wait until the Border Guard deactivated the emergency state. Your service time will be over. As for when the emergency state will be deactivated, it depends on when those guys outside the border will retreat.”
Dudian nodded but didn’t say anything.
“Go and wait outside. I have something to talk to Commander Raisa. I will take you to the assault camp to report and get your battlefield combat device.”
“Combat device?”Dudian’s eyes moved but he didn’t ask anything. He turned around and left.
Raisa looked at Dudian’s back as he walked out of the tent. She frowned and looked at the bald man: “You haven’t asked if he is from the lower abyss or the Middle Abyss.”
The bald man smiled: “Miss Raisa, do you like this gigolo? I found that the way you looked at her wasn’t right. I didn’t see you pay attention to those guys when they came to report.”. Moreover, if he was from the intermediate abyss, how could he be caught in our temporary recruitment camp? Those people are on the same level as us. They have backers in the empire. This kid obviously doesn’t have any background. He deserves his bad luck. Who doesn’t know that our temporary recruitment camp is the cannon fodder on the battlefield?”
Raisa’s face turned cold. “Watch Your Mouth.”
The bald man saw her change her expression and hurriedly laughed. He didn’t dare to take an inch and said with an apologetic smile, “Yes, yes, yes. It’s my bad mouth.”
Raisa snorted and said, “I’m warning you. Now is the time to use people. This person is an abyss after all. You’d better not use any tricks. Even if he dies, that corpse king won’t be your turn. I’ll take care of it.”
The bald man’s expression changed slightly. He frowned, but soon relaxed, he smiled again and said, “What are you talking about, Lady Raisa? Although this kid has a tough temper, I’m not so narrow-minded. Don’t worry, making the best use of everything is our rule here. I Won’t deliberately send him to his death. But about that corpse king, how about we discuss it later?”
Raisa knew that he was a military ruffian. He had been in the border defense for many years. He was an old fox. He was too lazy to argue with him. He got up and said: “You should take care of yourself!” He left the tent.
Baldy looked at her back as he licked his lips. There was a trace of greed in his eyes. He whispered to himself: “Bitch, one day I will make you beg for mercy!”
Dudian was waiting outside the tent. He heard the conversation between the two of them. It was as he had expected. However he was surprised that the cold female officer Reisha seemed to be talking to him, there was almost no communication between them. Was this the legendary cold heart?
Dudian knew that Reisha was coming. He turned his head: “Commander Reisha.”
Reisha nodded: “Follow Me.”
Dudian followed after her with Aisha.
Both of them passed through the tents and slowly moved away from the crowd and soldiers. They came to the inner edge of the god of war’s wall. From here they could see that the inner part of the wall was extremely vast and far away, the rivers and forests on the ground were quite beautiful.
Reisha stood at the edge. The Breeze blew her hair. It was as light as the clouds. Her face was blurred. She stopped and looked into the distance.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. He didn’t know why this woman brought him here.
He didn’t ask.
There was silence between the two.
Only the wind blew past.
After a few minutes of silence, Raisa spoke. The first sentence that she said made Dudian’s hair stand up: “This King Corpse is your lover right?”
Dudian couldn’t help but clench his hands. He looked up at her back. There was an impulse to attack but he didn’t see any murderous intent from Raisa.
“What did you say?”Dudian asked in a deep voice.
Raisa slowly turned her head and looked at Haisha. She looked at dudian: “If I’m not wrong, is she your lover? Or is she your partner who is fighting with you? How long has she been infected?”
Dudian’s face was gloomy as he stared at the woman’s face. He looked at her every pore carefully. However, he found that there was a touch of sadness and pity in her eyes, was she pitying him?
Dudian suppressed the killing intent in his heart and whispered: “Sir, you misunderstood. She is just the king of corpses that I caught.”
“You don’t have to lie to me. I Won’t tell on you.”Raisa shook her head: “If I have the intention to kill you then you won’t live past tomorrow. Moreover, I won’t do it myself. Do you believe me?”
Dudian’s palms broke out in cold sweat. He naturally didn’t believe it but he had to believe it.
He saw that Dudian was silent, raisa continued: “I have noticed her since you came. You said that you caught her in the wilderness. Hehe, you are just lying to others. Her clothes are cleaner than yours. There is no trace of flesh and blood in her fingernails. Her fingernails are neatly trimmed. It is obvious that she often takes care of her hands. She is even more diligent than me. How can I believe that she isn’t your lover?”
Dudian’s face changed. He didn’t think that he would be exposed because of these reasons. There was no point in denying it. He looked at her: “Yes, she is my lover. What do you want?”
Raisa shook her head: “I don’t want anything. I just have some feelings.”She turned her head and looked at the distance. Her tone was misty and sad, “My husband was infected with the virus and became the king of corpses.”
Dudian was startled.
“I saw him being bitten by the virus bit by bit. I knelt down and begged everyone to save him. But no one could do it. I could only watch as his skin turned paler and paler day by day. Then he completely changed and became the king of corpses. At that time I thought that if he became the king of corpses and bit me then I could become the king of corpses and accompany him even if I was destroyed…”
Raisa’s voice floated in the breeze: “But he didn’t.”
“Didn’t?”Dudian’s pupils shrank.
Raisa slowly said: “He didn’t bite me after he resurrected as the corpse king. Instead he pushed me away. Then he was destroyed in front of me…”
Dudian saw her slightly trembling shoulder.
There was a long silence.
Raisa seemed to calm down. After a long time she looked back. Her expression seemed to have returned to the previous indifferent look. However there was a trace of moisture in her eyes, “I see that you love her so much. I think you must love her very much. You are willing to sacrifice yourself for her. However, it is not the solution to keep her by your side for a long time.”
“You are now recruited to the temporary camp. You will lose your life at any time. When you die, she will not have a good ending. If you trust me, you can entrust her to me. If you can return to the Empire alive, it is naturally the best. If not, I can take care of her for you. At least, I won’t let her be destroyed…”
Dudian looked at the faint sadness in her eyes. He suddenly felt like he had found a confidant of his own kind. The previous conversation between the Bald Man and her was very clear. He would most likely die on the battlefield this time.
Although he didn’t want to agree with her, but there would be accidents at any time. Let alone on the battlefield, even if he was on the road in the wilderness, accidents would happen. If something happened to him, it would be a good thing for Aisha to have someone to rely on.
“Well, if anything happens to me, I’ll have to trouble you to take care of her.”Dudian thought for a moment and nodded.
“I’ll take good care of her.”Raisa slowly said, “But I see that she doesn’t seem to have the ability to move now. She can’t even eat and drink. How did you restrict her mobility?”
Dudian was about to open his mouth when his eyes flashed, “This restriction method has little damage to her body but it is more complicated. Through some tools she has restricted her bones and body as well as her brain’s perception system. So she has no reaction to the outside world. That’s why she has maintained her current state.”
A trace of disappointment flashed in Raisa’s eyes, “I see. This method is good. I have heard of it in the empire. Once the perception of the undeads is blinded, they will stop moving like puppets. Their thinking power is weak to begin with. They are basically wandering without sensing the prey.”
“That’s it.”Dudian nodded, “It’s complicated. Why Don’t We Go and report first? I’ll tell you more when I have the chance.”
Raisa nodded and sighed: “Alright.”
