She turned back to the corridor and led Dudian forward.
Dudian was a body behind her. He could see the Bulge on her shoulders and chest. Her beautiful side profile seemed to have recovered its usual indifference. He frowned slightly, he didn’t know if this woman was really like what she said or if she had another purpose. If she had another purpose, could it be that she realized that the state that he controlled Aisha was different from the General King of Corpses? So she wanted to find out from him?
If that was the case, why didn’t she report it? The empire should have the means to pry open a person’s mouth.
Dudian suddenly felt that this woman was not as simple as she looked. Perhaps she was not just the deputy of the old general.
The two of them walked for a while and came to a military camp next to the temporary recruitment camp. There were only twenty to thirty tents. Hundreds of people were active around the tents. Most of them were pioneers. The next largest was the master, dudian also saw two abyss-level heat source reactions. He didn’t know if there was a hidden heat source in the abyss.
“This is the assault camp.”Raisa introduced the place. She led Dudian to the largest tent in the middle. People who were casually sitting or chatting around saw Raisa and Dudian, although they were in their original position but their eyes were focused on the two.
Raisa lifted the curtain and walked inside. It was very spacious and was filled with weapons such as swords, spears and spears. There were several large metal racks on the other side which were equipped with wrist guards.
There were several people working in the tent. There was a fat woman sitting at the top table. Her height was less than 1.5 meters but her width was almost one meter. She was the kind of person who wouldn’t feel pain even if she fell, she looked up and was surprised: “Commander Reisha?”
“This is a newcomer, Dudian. He is an expert of the Abyss level.”Reisha pointed at Dudian and said to the short fat woman: “Prepare a suit of armor and a single soldier system for him.”
“Abyss?”The short fat woman was surprised. She looked at Dudian and soon noticed Aisha. She was surprised: “Is this the king of Corpses?”
“His spoils of war.”Reisha casually said.
The short and fat woman understood and didn’t ask: “I know. I will tailor it for him later.”
“Alright, I will leave him to you. I have to go back. The three border guards have arrived. I will go and see how they are going to deal with this matter.”Reisha turned and left, she gave Dudian a careful look.
The short and fat woman looked at Dudian after Raisa left: “Dudian right? I’ll write it down. You wait outside for a while and then come back to collect your combat equipment.”
Dudian curiously asked: “There is also combat equipment? Don’t we all have witchers?”
In his impression, armor was not very useful. Once one entered the magic body, their body would change greatly. They wouldn’t be able to wear armor.

chapters.title: Chapter 932
chapters.content:
Chapter 932 – Chapter 922: Individual Combat System
“Of course there is.”The short fat woman said in a matter-of-fact manner: “Fighting with magic body alone is like us humans fighting naked. Although some people’s magic body is extremely defensive and even tougher than the high-level military armor. But if there is a set of combat armor on the outside, it is equivalent to a double defense. For those who are good at perception or magic marks ability such as stealth or life-saving, the combat armor is more useful!”
Dudian nodded, “But…”
“Don’t worry about not wearing it. Miss Reisha said that the combat armor is tailor-made. It is completely suitable for the transformed magic body. What are your magic marks?”The short fat woman took out a small notebook and asked.
“Splitter.”Dudian replied truthfully.
The short and fat woman took a few notes on the notebook and threw the notebook back to the table. She walked to the metal rack with black bracers, “This is the auxiliary combat system for your soldiers. It is different from what you used to know.”
She took one of the bracers and threw it to Dudian.
Dudian raised his hand to catch it. He looked down and was stunned.
It wasn’t a wristband but it was worn on his hand. It was a bit like a wristwatch but its width was large. There was a display screen on it.
“It is worn on your hand which is rarely used in battle. If you are a normal right-handed person then wear it on your left hand. A left-handed person would wear it on his right hand so as not to be damaged during battle. Although it is very hard but the display board on it is not that hard.”The short and fat woman said.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. It seemed that he had thought of something but he wasn’t sure. He put it on his left hand. The short fat woman came over. She first checked if he was wearing it tightly. Then she stretched out her chubby fingers. Her nails were very sharp like claws, she gently touched the side of the display board. Soon, the display board lit up.
Dudian’s conjecture was confirmed and he couldn’t help but be stunned.
The fat woman saw Dudian’s reaction and smiled. Many people who came to the border were shocked by the system. After all, “Light”.., they had only seen it in flames and the stars above their heads.
The display panel was blue. After four or five seconds, the background slowly turned green. Then a white grid appeared. In the middle of the grid, there was a green dot. Next to the Green Dot was a dense yellow dot.
Dudian looked at it in a daze.
His reaction was completely within the expectations of the fat woman, she explained: “As the name suggests, this auxiliary combat system is to assist you in battle on the battlefield. This grid is a map. Each grid is one kilometer long. The size of the outermost grid is smaller. When you move there, the grid will return to the size of the central area.”
“The green dots are your own. The yellow dots are our allies. If there are red dots on them then they are our enemies!”
“The enemies are aliens and monsters. It is possible that they are humans who are not equipped with the auxiliary combat system.”
Dudian nodded slightly. He didn’t say anything but his heart was filled with mixed feelings. He was pleasantly surprised and worried. However he was pleasantly surprised in the end!
Electric power!
God’s kingdom had mastered electric power and had applied it to the battlefield!
Moreover not only electric power but also a deeper application of magnetic field!
It was enough to show that God’s kingdom’s grasp of technology was far higher than what he had expected!
Mastering electric power was the true difference between ancient and modern times. Moreover once one mastered electric power it meant that if God’s kingdom found the ruins of the old era, they could use the equipment that was accidentally preserved!
Moreover, electric power would be of great help to the advancement of industrial reform. It would greatly increase the speed of human’s scientific and technological progress!
Dudian could feel that it was not a short period of time for Kingdom of God to master electric power.
For him, the more advanced Kingdom of God’s technology was, the greater the hope of helping him revive Aisha! What worried him was that in the future when he went to God’s kingdom where the technology was advanced, the advantage of the super chip in his hands would be weak.
However, he believed that even if it was weak, it wouldn’t be that weak. At worst, he could just skip the electrical revolution. After the electrical revolution, there was the Third Industrial Revolution. It was the era of technology. The rise of biological cloning technology and aerospace technology was enough to bring earth-shaking changes to the world, moreover, he had the most powerful weapon in his hands: Nuclear Weapons!
However, when Dudian mentioned cloning technology, he couldn’t help but think of the temple in the wall of Barker. It was a deified soul worm that was created by cutting off the parasitic protozoa, it could also be called bio-cloning technology.
In this deformed era, technology seemed to be somewhat deformed. There were some things that God’s kingdom might have mastered after the third industrial revolution. After all, the old era was not completely destroyed. There were many relics left behind, there was the crystallization of human wisdom. It was not unusual for Kingdom of God to crack it and bring out the deformed growth of technology. It was even possible for Kingdom of God to create a nuclear reactor.
It was just that the probability was low.
After all, nuclear weapons technology was a secret of the big countries. The possibility of leaving technology in the ruins was not high.
“When did the empire create this auxiliary individual combat system?”Dudian asked her.
The short and fat woman was surprised. She didn’t expect that Dudian wasn’t asking about the magic of this thing but about its age. She frowned: “Why are you asking about this? This isn’t something you should be concerned about.”
Dudian quickly replied: “I’m just curious. The Empire is too amazing to be able to create such a magical thing. It is simply a masterpiece! So I want to know when the Empire was created. Could it have been created hundreds of years ago? The person who created these things is too amazing!”
His face was full of admiration.
The fat woman saw his appearance, she laughed: “It goes without saying that this is the masterpiece of the temple. It was created more than one hundred and twenty years ago. This is the fifth generation combat system. It is more advanced than the previous one. Not only can it sense the position of the Allies and the enemy but it can also be used for temporary communication within a certain range!” She stretched out her chubby fingers and pressed on the only slightly raised black particle next to the display panel. The display panel suddenly fluctuated like an audio frequency.
“Hey, Hey.”The short and fat woman came closer to test the sound.
Her voice suddenly sounded from the front of the combat system. But after the processing of electric current, it sounded different from the direct sound. It sounded more pleasant and young.
Dudian was startled. He didn’t expect that the radio would be developed by the Kingdom of God!
“Don’t be surprised. This is called instant communication. It is one of the abilities of the auxiliary combat system.”The short and fat woman thought that Dudian was scared, she indifferently said: “On the battlefield, you can communicate with your allies through this channel. But the range of your allies can not be too far…”
Next, she gave Dudian a detailed introduction of the various functions.
Dudian found that this thing contained a lot of technology. In addition to life detection and radio, there were also temperature and terrain display. It could be debugged and displayed in the grid. Moreover, it was completely waterproof, it would be fine even if it was soaked in water for a few days. The internal use was electronic. If the radio was not used frequently, it could be used for a month.
“Remember, no matter what the situation is, you can’t abandon this thing. You Can’t take it off, even if you take a bath. Of course, there is no condition for you to take a bath.”The short and fat woman looked at Dudian solemnly, she warned in a serious tone: “Even if your arm is cut off on the battlefield, you have to pick it up!”
“Otherwise, the other allies’combat system will show your position. They will reinforce you and you will be in danger!”! “If you lose this thing, it will be the most severe military punishment in addition to death. I guarantee that it will be more painful than death!”
Dudian nodded slightly. He thought that preventing the Allies from saving him was the next best thing. Most of the time he would use this to see our position. It was to prevent people from running away from the battle or even killing each other.
On the battlefield, unless it was other soldiers who graduated from the military academy, people like Dudian who relied on their own strength would not save others in the situation of their own safety? This was equivalent to looking for trouble for themselves.
As for the situation of their own safety, there was no need to mention that it was difficult to protect themselves. It would be good if they didn’t drag others down with them!
“Alright, you have nothing to do here. You Go. I will send someone to send your battle armor to you.”The short and fat woman waved her hand and sent Dudian away.
Dudian took Aisha and turned to leave.
There was a young officer with short hair outside the tent. He had a buzz cut. Nine out of ten warriors here had a buzz cut. It was more convenient to have short hair in battle. This was the experience of the veterans. In a long battle.., the hair would be mixed with the blood of the enemy or even mixed with the internal organs. It was very likely that the hair would fall down and touch the eyes or block the line of sight. So the short buzz cut perfectly eliminated the potential danger.
Of course, the reason why soldiers in the old era shaved their buzz cut was not so bloody.
“Are you new? Come with me. I will take you to your residence.”The young officer’s face was stiff. It seemed that he was serious and indifferent.
Dudian nodded.
The young officer took Dudian to a tent about a hundred meters away. The tent was rectangular. It was more than twenty meters long and more than ten meters wide. It was considered a medium-sized tent but it was also very spacious. There were forty beds in the tent, it was divided into four rows. Each row had ten beds. At the moment there were people sitting or lying on the beds. There were clothes and small parts piled up on the beds. For example, the skull of a monster, claws, fur pillows and so on.
Dudian looked around. There were only six beds with the same style quilt. There were thirty-four people living here. including him, there were thirty-five!
Without exception, all thirty-five people were men. It was estimated that the women were assigned to the women’s tents.
The young officer led dudian into the tent: “You can choose any of the empty beds here. Remember, don’t cause trouble here or else you will be punished by military law! In addition, if there was an assembly broadcast outside, be sure to gather in the square within ten seconds. Do you know where the square is? Don’t you know to ask others?” He turned around and left as if he had completed the task.
After he left, Dudian turned his head and saw many people in the tent looking up at him. To be precise, they were looking at Aisha who was next to him.
Greed, evil desire, and naked eyes.
Dudian’s face turned cold as he took Aisha to an empty bed. After a few steps, a leg stretched out from the second row on the right, it blocked his way.
“Brother, how was the discussion with you?”The owner of the leg was a thin young man in his twenties. There was a burn scar on his face and he looked a bit scary, he was full of excitement as he spoke.
Dudian slightly stopped.
The eyes of the others were full of interest.
Dudian lowered his head as if he didn’t dare to speak. But no one knew that his eyes stopped on the leg of the young man. Only the young man felt it. He smiled even more and didn’t intend to take back his leg.
— then he found that he couldn’t take back his leg.
Without any warning, the leg was broken from the knee. Blood gushed out when the leg fell to the ground.
The young man was stunned for a moment. The pain was transmitted to his brain. He immediately screamed and rolled on the bed. His face was full of pain as he stared at Dudian, suddenly he shouted: “Murder! Someone has killed someone!”
Others followed and laughed.
Some frowned as if they were thinking about something.
Soon, there was a sound of footsteps coming from outside. The young officer who had just left came back. There was an officer who was about the same age as Dudian. Both of them came over and lifted the tent. They saw the scene in front of Dudian, and the young man who was rolling on the bed.
“This…”
“What’s Going On!”The young officer who had sent Dudian over was furious. He stepped forward and scolded him. At the same time, he looked at Dudian angrily. At this moment, Dudian was standing in front of the broken leg. It was obvious that Dudian had done this.
Dudian’s expression was calm as he said in a cold voice: “He started the fight. I defended myself.”
Hearing Dudian’s words, the young man was so angry that he almost vomited blood. He immediately held back his screams, he cried to the young officer: “Sir, you have to help me! He didn’t do anything. He just talked to him about something and he attacked me. Everyone saw it with their own eyes. If you don’t believe me then ask everyone. Isn’t that right?”
“Yes!”
“That’s right, this rookie is too arrogant!”
“It was just a question, and he actually launched a sneak attack. Despicable!”
Immediately, there were people who jeered in agreement.
There were also people who looked on coldly and kept silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 933
chapters.content:
Chapter 933 – Chapter 923: Punishment
“Is that so?”The young officer’s face was gloomy as he coldly looked at dudian.
Dudian’s expression was indifferent, he said: “Of course not. He provoked me maliciously. He was going to attack me with his feet. I was defending myself. I didn’t expect him to be so weak. I thought that he was in the same Abyss as me. In the end he used too much strength and his legs were broken.”
Many people were surprised to hear Dudian’s words. They didn’t expect him to be from the Abyss!
Most of the people living here were pioneers. There were few abyss level experts. So at the beginning everyone thought that Dudian was a pioneer. At most he was a master.
For a moment, the jeering sound was silenced but there were still seven or eight people who echoed. It seemed that they were just watching the show and were not afraid of Dudian.
Everyone had different feelings when they heard the same sentence. Other people understood the power that Dudian’s words revealed. But the young officer heard a kind of arrogance and threat. What was wrong with the Abyss? How could the Abyss attack others?
The young officer snorted: “He is a pioneer. How could he have the courage to attack you? I just told you not to cause trouble. Do you take my words to Heart?”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he looked at him, “Because he is a pioneer, he doesn’t know my strength. Otherwise, how could I, an abyss, have the same knowledge as a pioneer?”? “He didn’t attack me. How could I attack him when I’m New Here?”
“How dare you!”The young officer shouted.
Dudian questioned him two times in a row, which made him even angrier, “I brought so many new people here and nothing happened. Why did someone provoke you?”
“How do I know this reason?”Although Dudian knew that it was because of Aisha, but he didn’t want to point it out because he knew that the young officer should be aware of this point even if he didn’t point it out, he just wanted to establish his own dignity.
However, if he really wanted to use him to establish his military prestige, he would shrink into an ostrich. Who knows how many troubles he would have in the future. Moreover, these troubles were not directed at him.
“You can’t say the reason. Your Fault. Come with me to the military training office to receive punishment!”The young officer said in anger.
Dudian didn’t move. Instead, he looked at him, “I have already said the reason. But you don’t accept it. There was no accident in the past because of me. is the responsibility on me? How can the truth be ignored? Can you judge who is right and who is wrong based on the comparison between the past and the present? In this case, I also want to ask. There are more than thirty people here. Why didn’t I attack others? Why did I attack him?”
The young officer was stunned. He didn’t expect Dudian to be so eloquent and clear. He choked and choked on the spot.
Although they were both masters of the Abyss but the young officer was different from the first-rate figures. Those who were in charge of the giant wall often interacted with people from different levels. He was sent to the god of War Wall to guard the border, he had learned how to hunt monsters since he was a child. He had come here to learn how to attack alien races. He wasn’t as sharp as Dudian.
For a moment he was unable to refute. He was angry: “You are unreasonable! In any case, both of you will follow me to the military training to receive punishment!”
“Sir, I am innocent!”The young man with the broken leg said pitifully.
“Shut up!”The young officer’s face was gloomy: “Don’t think that I don’t know what’s going on. I’ll take your other leg. I haven’t learned anything else but to cause trouble all day long. Don’t you see the strength of others?”
The Young Man’s face changed. He didn’t dare to say anything more. In fact, he had panicked when he knew that Dudian was the abyss. He had stayed here for so long. He knew how realistic and cruel it was, although the young officer said that he would deal with Dudian but it was only symbolic. After all, it was the time to use people. As a pioneer, he could only admit that Dudian had attacked him in bad faith.
He also accepted the punishment but there was a huge difference between the pioneer and the abyss.
Dudian looked at the young officer and didn’t say anything more.
Seeing that things had calmed down, the young officer looked at the people around him who were still watching the show. He angrily shouted, “Are you all very free? We will gather at the training field in three minutes. If you don’t train the sharp knife array today, you will suffer!”
Many people immediately shrank their heads and cursed their bad luck.
“You two, come with me!”The young officer shouted at Dudian and turned to leave.
Dudian and Aisha followed him.
The young man immediately picked up the broken leg from the ground. As long as the leg was still there, it could be reattached to the medical center.
He hastily bandaged the broken leg and quickly stopped the bleeding. He took out his witcher from under the bed and used a long spear as a crutch to follow him. Before he walked out of the tent, he heard a burst of laughter coming from behind, there was also a mocking voice.
The Young Man’s face turned green and white. He gritted his teeth and walked out of the tent.
He came to the tent of the military training center of the assault camp. A blonde old general with thick eyebrows listened to the young officer’s statement. He glanced at Dudian, then looked at Aisha and the young man, then his eyes fell on the young officer, “When you took him to report, didn’t you tell them that he is Abyss?”
The young officer was stunned as cold sweat broke out from his palms: “Sir, it’s My Fault!”
“It’s good to admit your mistake but it’s better not to make a mistake!”The blonde old general’s voice was calm, slowly he said: “You know what kind of place it is. To put it bluntly it’s a mob. Even if you lead a sow for them they will be played to death, not to mention the undeads.”
“Yes, Sir!”The young officer lowered his head.
The blonde general ignored him. He looked at Dudian and the young man with broken legs and sighed, “You don’t even know the strength of the enemy and you dare to provoke them. I really don’t know how a person like you got to the pioneer level. Don’t tell me that if you stay here for a long time without women and entertainment, your brain will be filled with shit?”
The young man with the broken leg blushed. He gritted his teeth and lowered his head. He didn’t dare to complain and bring up the broken leg to gain sympathy. At least he had some vision. He knew that doing so would only make him more humble and disgusted.
“Taking the initiative to stir up trouble. If it was under normal circumstances, you should receive 100 military whips. Considering the current state of alert, the punishment will be reserved first. However, a deduction of 100 will be deducted. In addition, wash the clothes of everyone in the camp for a week, including underwear and socks!”The golden-haired old general said indifferently.
The young man with the broken leg was stunned. He didn’t expect the punishment to be so severe! He didn’t think about the 100 military whips that were delayed. Just deducting 100 battle achievements and washing the socks and underwear of others was enough to make him suffer a lot. The people here were all recruited at the last minute, unlike the people who graduated together in the Military Academy, with the friendship of sharing a bed, it was no different from a prison here. It was just that the range of activities was a little wider.
If he washed clothes, underwear and socks for others, he wouldn’t be able to raise his head in the tent in the future. He would be ridiculed by everyone!
“Sir, I, I…”He opened his mouth and wanted to beg but the eyes of the blonde general made him forget what he was going to say.
The blonde general looked at dudian: “You said that the King Corpse is your spoils of war right? During the training period, it will be handed over to the military storage to be kept. You will pick it up after the battle is over…”
“Sir!”Dudian frowned as he saw the sharp look in the blonde general’s eyes. However he was a person who had seen great storms and waves so he quickly regained his composure, “Miss Reisha has allowed me to carry my things. This is a gift for the Blood Thorn King. I hope that you will give me some accommodation.”
The blonde general frowned as he saw that Dudian wasn’t afraid. He wasn’t angry because of Dudian’s interruption, “In that case, you will be responsible for anything caused by the king. Are You Willing?”
“Yes!”Dudian knew that he didn’t have a choice.
“Alright, go.”The blonde general waved his hand.
Dudian was a bit surprised. He didn’t expect that the blonde general would only criticize him. Although he didn’t expect that he would be severely punished but he didn’t expect that it would be so light.
Who said that military law was strict?
There was a difference in treatment everywhere and this place was no exception.
However, he was in a better mood because he wasn’t punished. No one wanted to suffer.
The young man was stunned. Was it over? Wasn’t he going to be punished? Why didn’t he have to wash socks and underwear? Why did he only punish me?
“What are you waiting for? Get Out!”The young officer shouted.
The young man clenched his teeth. He was unwilling but could only take his broken leg and leave.
Dudian walked past him like a gust of wind.
After all, two legs were faster than one.
The young man gritted his teeth but could only endure it, he turned to the young officer: “Sir, can my leg be treated first? If it takes too long and I can’t heal it, I will become a burden on the battlefield. I also want to serve the Empire!”
The young officer frowned but nodded: “Come with me.”
They turned in the other direction. Dudian took Aisha back to the tent. When he walked in, the tent was empty. Most of them had gathered on the training field.
Dudian picked an empty bed and let Aisha lie down. He changed her into a set of plain clothes to cover her body. At the same time, he covered her face with a piece of cloth and let her lie on his bed, he covered himself with the quilt and laid down on the bed. While he rested, he adapted to the new environment. At the same time, he considered his next plans.

chapters.title: Chapter 934
chapters.content:
Chapter 934 – Chapter 924: Attack
Two hours later, people came back to the tent one after another. They were talking about the military formation.
The tent was lifted and someone came in. They noticed Dudian who was inside the tent.
“Hey, wasn’t he punished?”
“Why is he still here?”
“Where is the unlucky guy?”
Some people curiously whispered.
They returned to their beds and looked at the quilt next to Dudian. Although the quilt was fluffy but they could see that there was a person hidden inside. It should be the king of corpses that Dudian had brought.
As more and more people returned to the camp, the tent gradually became lively. Many people looked at Dudian’s quilt from time to time. Their eyes flashed a bit strange but in the end they held back.
From Dudian’s quick return to the camp, it could be seen that he didn’t receive much punishment. However, the bird that stood out didn’t appear. People couldn’t help but guess his fate.
“I heard that you are Abyss?”A warm voice came from the side as Dudian closed his eyes.
Dudian slightly opened his eyes and saw a golden-haired man. He was handsome and gentle. His blue eyes were like the ocean. There was no trace of hostility in them.
“You too?”Dudian looked at him.
“I’m called Zac Like You.”The golden-haired man smiled, “You haven’t received your battle armor yet. The military armor here is very different from the ones we have seen in the past. The quality of the things used in the border defense is the best. No one dares to cut corners.”
Dudian didn’t refuse as he took the initiative to chat with him.
There were people looking at them from time to time as they chatted.
Zach naturally changed the topic: “Have You Seen the foreign races? I am talking about the Fire Dragon.”
Dudian’s eyes moved: “Have You Seen Them?”
“I’ve only seen them from afar.”Zac’s eyes were a bit complicated: “But I don’t want to see them again.”
As he spoke, the chatter around him suddenly weakened. Many people pricked up their ears to listen. Zac had never mentioned this before. They didn’t expect that he would mention it to Dudian, it was obvious that the other party had the strength of the abyss. This made many people envious and even envious!
“Is it so terrifying?”Dudian raised his eyebrows.
“It’s not terrifying…”Zac shook his head and sighed, “It’s just that kind of feeling. It makes me very uncomfortable. I feel disgusted and disgusted from the bottom of my heart. I didn’t see it clearly but it should be the same as its name. It is extremely good at the ability of fire. Its whole body is burning with flames and its speed is extremely fast.”
“Is it stronger than the Abyss?”Dudian asked.
Zaite shook his head: “I guess it is similar to the middle abyss. I haven’t fought with them but I feel that I might not be able to win.”
Dudian was silent for a moment. It seemed that the fire dragon wasn’t bad either.
“Have you been here for a long time?”Dudian asked.
Zach shook his head: “It’s only been a month. But I think I’m going to vomit from looking at the corpses. Were you captured from the Empire or from the wall?”
“I caught you halfway.”Dudian sighed.
“You are so unlucky.”
“Hehe…”
Both of them chatted for a while before Zach left and went back to his bed. After all, it was the first time they had met.
It didn’t take long for the young man to return to the tent. His face was ashen. He was still holding the broken leg in his hand.
Dudian glanced at him and understood the reason. There was a trace of indifference in his eyes.
The person next to the young man was surprised to see him: “Why didn’t you go to the Medical Center?”
The young man staggered back to his own bed. He was still in a daze.
The person next to him used his witcher’s stick to push him. The young man came back to his senses and looked at his friend. He felt like crying. Soon, he thought of something, he looked back and saw Dudian. There was a trace of hatred in his eyes.
“What happened to you?”The man frowned.
The young man’s mouth twitched: “The military doctor said that my leg can not be treated.”
“What?”The man next to him was stunned: “How is it possible? The medical technology here is advanced. How can you not be treated?”
The young man with the broken leg clenched his fists, he gritted his teeth and said, “The Doctor said that when my leg was cut open, the edge of the tissue was completely damaged and could not be healed with ordinary medicine unless some special medicine was used. However, those medicines were expensive and were used on generals and high-ranking officials. I could only buy them myself with Battle Records. I need at least 10,000 Battle Records!”
“10,000 Battle Records? !”The person next to is dumbstruck, “So expensive? Doesn’t that mean you…”
He didn’t say the rest, but the message was clear. You’re a Goner.
The young man with the broken leg gritted his teeth and did not speak. After a long time, he did not hear the voice of the person next to him. He could not help but look up, only to see that the latter had already returned to his bed and was chatting with the others, it was as if he had been forgotten.
..
..
After knowing that Dudian was the abyss, the people in the tent were more well-behaved in front of dudian. They didn’t dare to take the initiative to provoke him. Especially after the news about the young man with broken legs spread, no one dared to provoke dudian.
What a joke! The wound couldn’t heal. Even if it was just a broken limb or something like that it would be fatal. However the military punishment was based on the injury of the broken limb. Who would dare to provoke Dudian?
On the second day after Dudian entered the camp, he went with the others to the training field to practice the military formation. Everyone practiced according to their assigned positions. The current battle was still a cold weapon war. The importance of the military formation was very great, the destructive power of ten pioneers was comparable to that of twenty pioneers or even more.
However, on the third day after Dudian entered the camp, there was a loud horn and loud bell on the other side of the god of war wall!
At the same time, Dudian and the others who were standing on the training field saw purple lightning flashing above their heads. Golden figures were moving quickly, they were flying birds the size of an eagle. They were flying very fast towards the outside of the god of war.

chapters.title: Chapter 935
chapters.content:
Chapter 935 – Chapter 925: Battle
“Thunderbirds!”
“The Thunderbirds have been alarmed. Could it be a magical beast in the air?”
“The battle preparation horn has sounded. I reckon it’s time for battle!”
Everyone looked up at the golden birds flying past their heads. The feathers of these birds flickered with purple lightning. They were extremely fast, like rays of Golden Aurora. In the blink of an eye, they had flown into the clouds in front of them, with rumbling sounds, they flew further and further away, rushing toward the world outside the god of war wall.
While everyone was discussing, two military officers quickly ran over from the distance and spoke a few words to the instructor who was guiding everyone in the battle formation. Soon, the instructor turned his head and raised the assembly flag in his hand, he said loudly, “Assemble, get ready for battle. Return to the camp in one minute. Put on your respective battle armor and support individual combat systems. Gather here. Those who are out of date, be careful!”
He threw down the flag. Everyone immediately scattered and rushed towards the tent.
Dudian’s heart sank. He didn’t expect the war to come so soon. He wasn’t completely ready. But things had come to this point so he could only bite the bullet. He jumped over the heads of the others as fast as he could. He rushed into the tent. He took out the battle armor from the bed and put it on. As for the individual combat system, it had been on his wrist for a long time.
His battle armor had been delivered yesterday. It had a strange shape and there were many holes on its surface. Dudian had seen the positions of these holes. They were similar to the places where the sharp blades had suddenly appeared when he had entered the splitter’s body, however, since he had absorbed the blood and flesh of the Aragami, his body had changed a lot. There were some places where the sharp blades didn’t grow. Once he entered the body.., he would immediately tear the battle armor or strangle it inside.
Dudian had tried the toughness of the armor. With his destructive power, he had to use all his strength to cut it. It was considered an excellent defensive armor.
Although he felt that it was useless to wear it, but Dudian still wore it. If it was torn on the battlefield, he would say that it was destroyed during the battle. In any case, it was impossible to build a satellite in the current world, he monitored their every move in space at all times.
After putting on the thin animal clothes and the battle armor, Dudian picked up Aisha from the bed and took her back to the square. The whole movement was done in one go. When they arrived at the square, it had only been fifty-three seconds, at this time, there were still many people who rushed over.
The instructor noticed Aisha who was in Dudian’s arms. He frowned and asked: “What Is This?”
Dean immediately said: “This is the king of corpses. If the situation is critical, I can remove her physical restrictions and throw her into the middle of the enemy to fight for more opportunities for us.”
“Nonsense!”The instructor shouted: “This is war, not a child’s game! How can you be in the mood to remove her restrictions during the battle? Even if you do, what if she pounced on our people? Immediately bring her back!”
Dudian said, “If the enemy doesn’t break through our encirclement, she will be prohibited in the same place and won’t give us any trouble. If the enemy breaks through the encirclement, removing her restrictions will only benefit us. I guarantee that when the physical restrictions are removed, she will be sent to the center of the enemy. At that time, the enemy may also attack her. When they fight, we will have more opportunities to destroy the enemy.”
“Nonsense! I told you to bring it back!”The instructor shouted: “If you don’t listen to me then I will kill it!”
Dudian’s eyes turned gloomy as he coldly looked at the instructor: “We are short of manpower and the situation is urgent. We have one more king of corpses to help us fight. Don’t you know that?”
“How dare you!”The instructor was furious. His temper had always been bad. Previously when he commanded Dudian’s temporary troops some of them were clumsy and had exhausted his patience. Now Dudian was talking back to him, he was so angry that he was about to step forward when he was stopped by the officer next to him. The officer whispered a few words to him as he looked at Dudian.
After he finished speaking, the instructor’s face was slightly angry as he snorted, “If it wasn’t because of the urgency of the situation, I wouldn’t forgive you!”! “Send the king of undead to the Department of Undead. They will send him to the frontline. You will gather and guard the defense line that the officer has given you. Anyone who dares to retreat will be killed on the spot according to Military Law!”
Dudian frowned as he listened. He quickly understood why the undead king was sent to the front line of the battlefield? Apparently, there were a lot of undead gathered at the border as ‘bombs’. However, if they were to send Aisha to the front line of the battlefield, even if Aisha’s strength was close to the middle abyss, it would be difficult for her to survive!
“I’m the only one who knows how to restrict her body. It’s useless to send her to the undead department. She will only become a straw target. I will take her to the battlefield and control her. I Won’t let her hurt my allies,”Dudian said calmly.
“You!”The instructor was angry. He had never seen such disobedient soldiers. However, he also knew that these temporary recruits were a motley crew. They had their own minds and thoughts, it was a Fool’s dream to gather their wills. On the battlefield, the will of the army couldn’t be unified. It was like a pile of loose sand. This was why the temporary army could only be used as cannon fodder.
At this time, the sound of the horn echoed in the distance. It shook the eardrums of the people. The blood in their bodies seemed to boil.
The instructor and the two officers’faces slightly changed. The instructor turned to look at Dudian with cold eyes, he clenched his fist: “Kid, if there is a problem on the battlefield, I will be the first to teach you a lesson!”
Dudian was relieved. It seemed that he had agreed.
Although he knew that the battlefield ahead was very dangerous, but he still felt that it was safer to bring Aisha with him. Although the people in the tent had gathered here to fight in the front.., but the people on the god of war’s wall were not just those in his tent. There were many soldiers, reserve forces, and many senior officials. He would rather die in the battle with Aisha, he didn’t want to suffer for the rest of his life.
“Who is it? Where’s your battle armor? !”The instructor didn’t look for trouble with Dudian. He glanced at the assembled people and soon saw a short youth who wasn’t wearing a battle armor. He was angry.
The short youth’s face turned pale. He said in a trembling voice: “I… I don’t know where my battle armor went. I put it on my bed. I didn’t see it when I went to look for it.”
“Trash!”The instructor cursed as his eyes swept over the others. Needless to say, there must be someone who had a grudge with the short youth. They deliberately took this opportunity to mess with him, the appearance of such an emergency battle made him even angrier!
“Let’s Go!”The instructor looked at the number of people. He waved his hand and led the way with the two officers.
Dudian and the others lined up in a square formation.
Soon, they passed through the center line of the wall and came to the battlefield on the other side. There were many military equipment and strange shapes. There were metal platforms that looked like giant bows and arrows, there were also war chariots that were made of metal.
The ground was painted with bright lines. It was like a guide line for cars on the road. Everyone followed one of the guide lines to the other side of the wall, the vast world outside the wall suddenly appeared in front of everyone’s eyes.
This was the first time that Dudian clearly saw the scenery outside the wall. It was like a fairyland under the White Clouds. It was like a scene of Hell on Earth. There were many corpses scattered near the wall. Some of them were human, there were also monsters. The color of the soil had turned dark brown. There was a strong smell of blood when the wind blew from above.
The smell of blood was not the smell of fresh blood but a mixture of extremely fishy and rotten smell. There was also the stench of feces. Even Dudian who had been hunting for years felt sick to his stomach, he wanted to vomit.
How many dead souls were gathered under the towering wall?
“They”wanted to come in but they wanted to go out.
In front of the god of war’s wall there were a lot of troops and all kinds of military facilities. At the moment there was some kind of noise coming from the distant white area.
“Get Down!”The instructor shouted and stepped onto a steam airship with two other officers.
The steam airship was parked next to the god of war’s wall. It was obviously a product of the Kingdom of God. Although they had built a single soldier system and mastered electricity but it seemed that the steam airship was not obsolete.
There was a long row of 20-30 steam airships parked next to the god of war’s wall.
Dudian and the others boarded the airship in order. There were 37 people in total. They sat on ten steam airships and slowly descended from the god of war’s wall.
The steam airship stopped behind several large phalanxes in front of them. Dudian got off the airship and looked back. He felt a strong impact. The God of War’s wall was too majestic, especially when he was standing under its feet, the impact was even stronger. The soil around the god of war’s wall was messy. He could see scattered fingers and eyeballs in the uneven soil.
The giant wall under the god of war’s wall was dark brown and stained with blood.
At this time the instructor led dudian and the others along a straight path. They passed by the large phalanx troops.
These phalanx troops stood straight and looked dignified. It was obvious that they were regular troops.
Not long after, the instructor led dudian and the others to a towering fortress. The fortress was four or five hundred meters tall. It was made of huge stones and wood. There were many flags planted on it. The instructor led them to the left side of the fortress. There were several small phalanx that were neatly arranged. However, compared to the large phalanx at the back, the momentum was obviously insufficient. It was the same as Dudian and the others who were temporarily recruited.
The instructor led the group to the side of the small square formations. He trotted to the front of the three officers who were wearing the sword marks on their shoulders. He raised his hand and saluted.
One of the officers spoke to him. The instructor returned to the front of Dudian and the others. It seemed that he was their leader.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he looked at the back of the instructor.
Several square formations seemed to have gathered here. They were discussing in low voices. It could be seen that there was a difference between the regular army and the mixed army, it seemed that they were too lazy to be bothered with the temporary army.
A youth who was close to the instructor asked in a low voice: “Don’t we have the god of War’s Wall? Why are we fighting? isn’t it easier to defend with the god of War’s Wall?”
The instructor turned his head and glanced at him. Seeing that he was a ruler, the impatience in his eyes lessened a little, he snorted and said, “Use your brain more. Although the god of war wall is our strongest defense line, the number of people that can be accommodated on it is limited. If the Foreign Monster Army charged up and fought on top of it, breaking through our encirclement, wouldn’t they be able to charge into the wall?”
The young man was puzzled. “If that’s the case, why don’t we set up a few more lines of defense inside the wall?”
“How do you know there aren’t any?”The instructor asked back.
The young man was speechless.
Indeed, he didn’t see it, but that didn’t mean there weren’t any. Perhaps it was just very well hidden.
At this time, the sound of a horn as loud as a tsunami sounded again. It actually came from the top of the fortress. After the horn ended, suddenly a burst of rapid bell chimes sounded.
The faces of several military officers who were wearing swords on their shoulders turned solemn. They immediately ordered all the soldiers of the assault battalion to immediately go to the defense line of the fortress!
The instructor immediately took Dudian and the others along the steep stairs behind the fortress. They ran all the way to the top of the fortress to replace the soldiers who were originally stationed there.
Everyone knew that their task was to defend this place. In other words, they would be used as cannon fodder to ease the first wave of the enemy’s Attack!
Dudian guessed that the purpose of this fortress was not to fight with the enemy but to ease and contain the enemy’s attack, the impact on the god of war wall was too big. After all, once the god of war wall collapsed, no one would be able to repair it. It was known as the masterpiece of God.
Therefore, the Empire didn’t allow the god of war’s wall to collapse and be damaged!
Dudian stood on the fortress and the war flags were fluttering. He looked ahead and saw that there was mud and soil in the distance. Countless hoofs and claws were like sharp blades which caused terrible damage to the earth. At the moment the fortress was trembling, there was white fog in front of them. It wasn’t morning but noon. However the fog on the ground was particularly thick which blocked people’s vision.
In this white fog, a dark color seemed to gradually appear.
The trembling sound of the ground was also getting stronger.
Everyone’s expressions changed. Some people had already entered the devil body state ahead of time, nervously looking at the depths of the white fog.
Then, countless black shadows suddenly shot out from the depths of the white fog, piercing toward their pupils like black streams of light.
In an instant, it was as if tens of thousands of arrows were shot out at the same time, whistling through the white fog.

chapters.title: Chapter 936
chapters.content:
Chapter 936 – Chapter 926: Deserter Alliance
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Dudian narrowed his eyes as he saw black spikes that were three feet long. There were barbs attached to the front of the spikes. If they were pierced then they would be pulled out.
“It’s coming!”Someone shouted.
Many people entered the devil’s body state. It was like a mob of demons.
Dudian saw that the other two abyss and several masters didn’t activate their demon bodies. It was obvious that they didn’t want others to know about their abilities. In addition there were three pioneers who didn’t activate their demon bodies. They were on alert.
In the blink of an eye, the black thorns shot towards Dudian and the others. Bang Bang Bang! They hit the giant stone under the fortress and nailed the top of the giant building wood, more Black Thorns flew towards Dudian and the others. Dudian raised his hand and waved his witcher. There were several clangs as he blocked the incoming black thorns. The force of the collision made his arm slightly heavy. He was secretly shocked. The black thorns were equivalent to a pioneer’s full strength attack!
Although it wasn’t a big deal for him, but he shouldn’t forget how far away he was. He could still maintain such force. His body shouldn’t be underestimated!
The black thorns continued to shoot out from the white fog. The force gradually increased. Dudian looked at the white fog as he blocked the attack. He saw that the shadow was getting darker and darker. He could even see the vague outline of the giant. Through the heat source reaction, he could see a row of powerful and introverted heat source figures, they were like a row of giant tanks that were slowly moving forward.
“Ah!”
There was a scream coming from the side.
Dudian glanced at them. It was a strange pioneer who had a body like a lizard covered in cuticle. His chest was pierced by the black thorns. Although the Black Thorns didn’t hit his heart but he had lost his fighting ability.
He looked at the others as he blocked the black thorns. He found that the few pioneers who hadn’t activated their bodies were already dead. Their bodies were lying on the ground. From time to time, the black thorns would shoot at them and turn their bodies into hedgehogs.
They wanted to hide their demon bodies, but they had underestimated the power of the black spikes. They were badly injured in the first wave of defense. When they wanted to activate their demon bodies again, the continuous black spikes made them unable to find the time, in the end, they were killed before they could even use their demon bodies.
Besides the people in their tent, there were also many casualties among the temporary troops in the other tents. Most of them had activated their demon bodies, making the fortress look like it was full of monsters, it was like the fortress had been attacked.
Puff! Puff!
As the black spikes continued to attack, more and more people were unable to parry. Some were injured while others were directly pierced through the head.
“Save me!”
“Help me! I’ll give you a result!”
The injured people and others who were not injured felt the threat of death. They couldn’t help but move closer to Dudian. The other people who were far away from them moved closer to their masters.
Dudian felt that they were hindering him. He narrowed his range of action. He frowned slightly. He was feeling uncomfortable when he heard the angry shouts of the other masters. He looked up, there was a master who kicked the pioneers who were close to him. He was worried that they would hinder him. Even if he added 10% of the danger coefficient.., it was intolerable!
Under the leadership of the master, the other masters and the Abyss shouted at the pioneers who were close to him. Some Masters even activated their magic bodies on the spot.
Dudian retracted his eyes. The pioneers who were seeking shelter by his side also noticed this. They saw Dudian’s cold face. They were frightened and looked like they were begging, why didn’t they have a good relationship with Dudian in advance when they were in the tent? Otherwise it would be very precious to get the protection of the Abyss on the battlefield!
It wasn’t their fault that they didn’t have foresight. But most of them knew that they would fly separately in the face of a great disaster. If they were to encounter a dangerous abyss then not only would it not protect them but it might even push them out to block the arrows, they didn’t deliberately try to curry favor with Dudian. Moreover from Dudian’s cold aura they knew that he wasn’t someone who could be fawned over with just a few words.
It was only at this moment that they realized that they had overlooked one thing. Sometimes it was a fatal danger for them but it was a trivial matter for the abyss. If they were close.., the Abyss wouldn’t refuse to help them and this bit of strength was enough to save their lives!
It was too late to say anything to please them. Many people could only beg as they looked at dudian. They even wanted to kneel down to him.
Dudian retracted his eyes. He didn’t look at the people who were taking refuge around him. He continued to wave his cleaver to block the incoming black thorns. He maintained his original posture and blocked the black thorns, as for the people around him, he directly ignored them.
However, these people were surprised to see that Dudian didn’t chase them away. Although Dudian didn’t help them to block the black thorns but they could hide behind dudian, it was a safe zone. They only needed to block the black thorns that were over Dudian’s head.
The rain of spikes lasted for about two to three minutes before they gradually stopped. There was a river of blood in the wide passage of the fortress. A large number of corpses had fallen. Most of the corpses were pierced into hedgehogs. Their heads, eyes, throats, arms and other places were full of spikes. Dudian glanced at them. There were more than ten people who had fallen in their tent.
At this time, Dudian saw a row of six meters tall monsters slowly step out from the depths of the white fog. They looked like porcupines but had ivory-like white curved horns on their mouths, there were seven or eight of them. Their mouths were full of sharp teeth and they looked extremely ferocious. The dark black hair on their bodies seemed to be coated with oil.
The sharp black thorns that were shot over earlier were clearly the fur on the bodies of these monsters!
Behind these giant porcupine-shaped monsters, there was a row of even taller monsters. They were about ten meters tall and had a strong physique. They looked like a giant elephant but did not have a trunk. The sharp teeth protruding from their mouths were straight forward like two snow-white spears, there were vertical horns protruding from the top of their heads. They did not have any fur on their bodies. They looked rough and thick-skinned.
The movement of this large monster was slow. It shook the ground as it moved forward. The closer it got, the more intense the shaking was.
Dudian saw that the monsters were arranged neatly. His eyes flashed. They looked like an army. It seemed that they had been trained by something.
But since ancient times, only humans knew how to train animals. was there really a human outside the giant wall?
Dudian knew that the Earth was very big. He guessed that the last survivors might not only be from the God’s kingdom. There might be descendants of human survivors outside the giant wall. However, he couldn’t be sure because he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, but at this moment he was looking forward to it.
The others saw the giant beast slowly approaching. Even the masters’faces turned ugly. They usually only hunted near the giant wall or the giant wall of the God’s kingdom, although they had seen the beast tide but they were small-scale monsters. The momentum of the Beast Tide couldn’t be compared to the giant beasts in front of them. The momentum of the Beast Tide was like a tsunami, it made people feel despair and fear.
Whoosh!
Suddenly a gust of wind swept over.
The white fog pushed forward and spread over.
Dudian squinted his eyes as he looked into the depths of the fortress. He saw that there were countless red heat sources moving. He was shocked and wanted to retreat.
At this time, the engine of the fighter suddenly sounded.
Dudian looked up and was shocked. It was similar to the old era’s fighter bomber!
Although the shape was similar but the fighter bomber was driven by steam. There was a long white smoke coming out from the back of the plane. It made a loud buzzing sound. The fighter plane suddenly increased in height as it drove out of the fortress, the panel of the fighter plane was pulled open and bombs the size of gas tanks fell onto the giant beasts!
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The explosion suddenly sounded, and the originally orderly horde of giant beasts suddenly let out a loud roar, like the long hiss of a giant elephant or the roar of a lion. The explosion caused the horde of giant beasts to suddenly become chaotic, swaying left and right, some of the giant porcupine-like monsters in the front row retreated in a panic, while others rushed forward in a panic. Soon, they broke away from the white fog and the horde of beasts and rushed to the front of the fortress.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
At the shooting point in front of the fortress, a giant crossbow was pushed out. Six giant arrows that were more than three meters long and looked like steel spears were shot out at the same time. In an instant, they hit a giant porcupine monster that was charging at them, piercing its back and head, it was not even halfway in.
The giant porcupine monster was in pain, so it ran faster and faster. Its eyes were red, as if it had completely lost control.
Another row of giant crossbow arrows was shot out from another place. This time, the six giant arrows were shot vertically. In an instant, they were nailed from the top of the giant Porcupine Monster’s head to its tail. It was shot down on the spot, lying on the ground and twitching!
The people of the temporary army were stunned. They did not expect the counterattack of the border guards to be so fierce!
At this moment, they also suddenly felt that in such a vast battlefield, the strength of a person was too small, and the sense of presence was too small!
Whoosh!
Behind the panicking giant Beast Horde, in the depths of the white fog, huge rocks suddenly flew out and smashed into a steam jet that was as tall as the sky after dropping the bombs. It immediately fell apart, the pilot also fell down from the broken battle record, screaming miserably. He fell into the Roaring Giant Beast Horde, like a drop of rain falling into a mud pit, not causing any ripples.
Soon, more and more boulders were thrown out from the rear of the giant beasts. More and more steam jets were hit which forced the bombing to stop.
A fierce roar was heard from the rear of the giant beasts. The panicked giant beasts gradually regained order and continued to move forward. They stepped over the bodies of their companions.
White Mist gradually spread over the fortress. Dudian and the others’vision was compressed again.
The giant porcupine monsters in the front row came to about 500 meters in front of the fortress. Their hair suddenly stood up and then shot out. Another black spike flew over.
Dudian raised his hand to parry. He found that the strength of the attack was much stronger. It was comparable to the attack of an expert from the wasteland.
A few pioneers who were relying on themselves to parry the black spike were pierced by the black spike. They screamed in pain.
The others were shocked and immediately shrank to Dudian’s side. Some of them were close to the wall of the fortress.
“Fire!”Dudian heard a roar and suddenly felt a chill. Countless arrows flew out from the sky and almost covered the sky.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Ten thousand arrows were shot at the same time. It was like two consecutive rounds of fireworks.
The giant beasts howled in pain. Although their skin was rough and their flesh was thick, but their bodies were weak. Their eyes, nostrils and other parts were pierced by the arrows!
After two rounds of arrows, there was a rush of heat coming from Dudian’s back. The surrounding temperature seemed to rise suddenly. Then he saw the sky was red. It was another round of arrows, but this time the arrowhead was burning with flames. It looked even more spectacular.
The rocket broke through the white fog and dispersed a lot of the fog. It landed in the midst of the giant beasts.
Five hundred meters was not a long distance. Although the giant beasts were slow, but this distance had reached the point where they launched their attack. The trembling of the ground suddenly became violent. The earth churned and the vibration spread to the people’s feet, it spread from their feet to their bodies, hearts and brains. It made people feel shocked and trembling.
Dudian squinted his eyes and saw that the giant porcupine monster in the front row had stopped shaking and shooting hair. It rushed to a hundred meters away. The real battle was about to begin.
At this time, Dudian suddenly heard someone call him.
He turned his head and saw that it was Zac who had talked to Dudian.
“Dudian, we are going to fight!”Zac whispered to Dudian.
Dudian was slightly startled: “Escape?”
Zac was surrounded by a few masters and other experts. They looked at Dudian with expectation in their eyes.
“We are just cannon fodder here. We will be the first to die when the monsters rush over. We will be the first to die. Later on the Regular Army will take action. It will be their turn to fight. Instead of waiting for death, we should run away!”Zac said.
Dudian turned back and looked at the large square formations of the regular army. He frowned: “Where Are We Going? We will die if we run back!”
“We won’t go back!”Zac said: “We will die if we go back. We will die if we stay here. I have thought about it. We should run away from the god of war as far as possible. Maybe there are people living in the isolated land outside?”? “Even if there are no people living here, we can still survive by eating grass. I don’t believe that all the monsters here are so powerful. These monsters that came to attack us were obviously trained by something. We only need to find areas where the monsters are weaker to survive!”
His eyes were resolute as he spoke, as if he had made up his mind. His face did not have the gentleness and gentleness that he had before.

chapters.title: Chapter 937
chapters.content:
Chapter 937 – Chapter 927: Wall Breaking
Dudian’s eyes lit up.
He had always thought that there was a high possibility that there were survivors outside the god of war. According to his previous guess, the Kingdom of God should be in the old era of Russia. According to his calculations, there was the richest land in Asia, China. There was also the American continent thousands of miles away, he felt that there should be 100% survivors in Europe.
After all, the survivors in this area had already developed into the Kingdom of God. Other regions might not necessarily be destroyed. Humans had always reproduced very quickly, and their survival ability was also very strong. As long as there was a spark.., sooner or later, it would start a prairie fire.
However, this foreign land was completely an unknown area to him. It was a bit risky to leave the god of war wall.
Moreover, once he became a deserter, it would be difficult for him to sneak back from the border. He wouldn’t be able to go to the Kingdom of God to search for the secrets of the resurrected King.
“Don’t hesitate! They are coming!”Zac anxiously urged Dudian.
Dudian retracted his thoughts and looked at another abyss not far away. It was the second abyss in their tent. It was called Jason.
“Is he not participating?”Dudian asked.
Zach shook his head: “He wants to stay. I have tried to persuade him. He thinks that he is an abyss so he can survive in this war. Ridiculous!”
Dudian whispered: “I’m sorry. I also want to stay. My family is still in the wall. I Can’t Leave!”
“Family?”Zach looked at him. He couldn’t help but sigh as he saw Dudian’s determined eyes. He knew that a person like Dudian wouldn’t be persuaded with just a few words, moreover, family… he thought of his wife. She was a lovely child who had just learned how to speak. He was very happy when he was arrested to join the army. Unfortunately, everything had changed.
He wanted to live so he had to choose to abandon her.
“I know.”Zac was silent for a while. He patted Dudian’s shoulder: “Your choice may be right. At least you won’t regret it!” He turned to the people gathered around him: “We will withdraw from the flank when the monster attacks the city. Everyone throw away the auxiliary system. This thing can track our position.”
The others were disappointed as they saw that Dudian didn’t want to participate in the battle. They would have a much easier time after their escape.
Boom!
The fortress suddenly shook.
Dudian’s body shook as he looked down. He saw the giant porcupine monster hit the fortress like a tsunami. The giant rocks at the bottom of the fortress exploded and fell down.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The giant rocks flew out from the depths of the white fog and hit the fortress. The wall of the fortress was smashed into a huge hole. Some soldiers were smashed into meat paste on the spot!
“Go!”Zach shouted in a low voice.
He led more than a dozen people to retreat along the border of the fortress.
Their actions were not eye-catching in this huge fortress. At the moment the other parts of the fortress were in complete chaos. There were soldiers rushing over from the back of the fortress to supplement the positions of the sacrificed soldiers.
Dudian looked at Zach who led more than a dozen people down the stairs to the other side of the fortress. He frowned but didn’t say anything. He stepped forward and blocked in front of Aisha, he lifted the giant rock which was rolling towards him and used a soft force to throw it away.
Dudian pulled the giant rock which was about to fall down and threw it towards the bottom of the fortress. Although it was a common technique but it was rare to use it to such an extreme.
At this time, Dudian suddenly saw a dense number of red dots emerging from the depths of the white fog. The next moment, there were roars and some of them were short, about two meters tall monsters jumped out from the giant porcupine monster’s middle or legs. They looked like hairless chickens. Their bodies were black and rough. There were sharp horns on their heads. Their mouths were full of sharp teeth. They had four eyes. It was extremely terrifying.
These monsters had flexible bodies. Their jumping power was astonishing. They directly jumped onto the giant spikes protruding from the fortress. They used the spikes as a foothold to jump onto the fortress.
“Attack! !”The officer roared in anger.
Dudian suddenly grabbed the neck of a monster that jumped in front of him and threw it into the crowd behind him.
However, just as he repelled one monster, another one rushed up.
Dudian used both of his hands and punched it away.
At this time, two or three monsters climbed up from the side of the fortress and screamed as they rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian sighed in his heart. Zac had left with more than a dozen people. The side roads around him had turned into empty windows. No one was defending and they had broken through the encirclement in an instant.
He held the splitter and waved it in a strange posture. Three four-eyed monsters were beheaded. Green blood spurted out and splashed onto the passage of the fortress.
More and more four-eyed monsters climbed up the fortress. The giant porcupine monster had retreated to the second line. It was sprinting like a giant elephant behind them, the entire fortress shook as if it was going to collapse. The huge wooden supports behind the fortress cracked. Some of the supports cracked and the bark on the surface exploded.
Dudian looked down at the fortress. His face slightly changed as more and more four-eyed monsters rushed out. They used the giant porcupine monster behind them and the giant elephant monster in front of them as stepping stones, they jumped towards the fortress.
“DAMN!”Dudian cursed as he led Aisha to retreat. He saw that most of the people in the tent who were not involved in the escape had fallen under the claws of the four-eyed monsters, there were too many of these four-eyed monsters. Almost all of them had the strength of pioneer level. Their attacks were brutal and their sharp voices were terrifying. Many people were bitten off their heads before they could display their true strength.
Jason who did not participate in the escape was surrounded by four or five four-eyed monsters. He still did not activate his magic body. It seemed that he noticed that Dudian was ready to retreat. He repelled the two four-eyed monsters around him, he winked at Dudian.
Dudian understood what he meant and cooperated with him.
He nodded slightly.
Jason quickly moved. He swept away the four-eyed monsters and ran towards Dudian.
“There are too many of them. We can’t defend this place. Let’s defend while retreating.”Jason spoke quickly.
Dudian nodded. This was the first time he talked to Jason. The first time was on the battlefield. He was about to retreat when he saw Jason quickly make a gesture.
Dudian’s eyes moved as he stared at him.
“We can’t defend here. Let’s retreat a bit. We must not let these damn monsters get close to the god of war wall!”Jason’s eyes were cold. He spoke with determination as if he was a hot-blooded soldier, but his hand gesture was the opposite of what he meant.
Dudian understood why he did this. He should have seen the magic of the auxiliary combat system. He was worried that this thing could monitor their words and deeds, so he didn’t dare to speak out his true thoughts.
Perhaps the reason why he didn’t want to participate in the escape plan was the same.
Caution!
Dudian had an impression of him and responded to him with gestures.
Jason was relieved as he led the way. The meaning of his gesture was very simple. They were close to the fortress so as not to attract the attention of the regular army.
Dudian followed Jason down the fortress. He looked back and saw that there were a lot of four-eyed monsters climbing up the fortress, some of the four-eyed monsters jumped down from the fortress and rushed towards the soldiers behind the fortress.
The battlefield was in chaos.
Perhaps only by standing in the air and overlooking everything could they understand the situation.
But as a small soldier he was like a chess piece on a chessboard. He could only see things around him. At the moment Dudian could only see chaos. The four-eyed Monster’s breakthrough forced the regular army behind the fortress to join the battle. The fortress shook violently. It was estimated that it wouldn’t be able to withstand a few strikes from the giant beasts. Once the fortress fell the entire battlefield would be in chaos.
It was the most dangerous time. It was up to luck to survive.
“Guard the fortress! No one is allowed to leave!”
Dudian and Jason jumped down from the fortress. They suddenly heard the voice of the individual combat system. Dudian was familiar with the voice. It was the voice of the previous instructor.
“DAMN!”Jason’s eyes were filled with anger as he heard the voice. He wanted to say something but he quickly held back.
Dudian was also angry. The four-eyed monster was about to occupy the passage of the fortress. Moreover it was asking them to stick to their posts. Moreover the value of death was too low!
Jason looked at Dudian and asked with his hand gesture. What should he do now?
Dudian’s face was gloomy. He was silent for a few seconds. He raised his wrist and adjusted the scanners. Soon he found the coordinates of the other allies. A large area of the coordinates were on the fortress, they were the people who had died in the battle. However, he saw four or five yellow dots surrounded by green circles. They were allies of the same camp. The other regular troops were also allies, but the yellow dots were not surrounded by green circles.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. The instructor and several other officers had joined the same Allied channel so they showed green circles around the yellow dots.
Obviously, the few green circles and yellow dots were mostly the instructors and officers.
He narrowed his eyes and waved to Jason.
Jason slightly frowned and looked at him in doubt. There was a bit of vigilance in his eyes. But after hesitating for a while he approached Dudian. He felt that he had no communication with Dudian, dudian wouldn’t attack him at this time for no reason.
Although he thought so but he was secretly on guard.
Dudian whispered a few words into Jason’s ear. His eyes lit up as he gave a thumbs up to Dudian.
Dudian didn’t say much as he quickly climbed up the fortress.
The four-eyed monsters had completely taken over the fortress. There were only mutilated corpses left. The people in the same tent were the ones who had escaped with Zac and the others, only Dudian and Jason survived.
Dudian saw two four-eyed monsters eating a bloody corpse on the ground when he climbed up the fortress. Dudian had seen that man before. He had met him once and had greeted him. He was living in the next bed, but at the moment there was no breath left. The corpse was incomplete.
The four-eyed monsters looked up when they saw Dudian and Jason climb up. They opened their bloody mouths and screamed as they rushed towards them.
Jason quickly attacked and killed the four-eyed monsters. Dudian took advantage of the gap to pick up four pieces of the combat system that Zaite and the others had abandoned. He called out to Jason, he took Aisha down the fort and returned to the edge of the fort.
Jason followed him. Both of them hid in a dark corner of the stairs. Dudian took off the combat system and turned it off!
Jason saw Dudian’s operation. His face was full of surprise and admiration. Once again he gave a thumbs up to Dudian.
Dudian turned off the combat system that he handed over. The method was very simple. He pried open the back of the shell and took out the electronics.
Others didn’t know how this thing worked but Dudian was clear about it. How could he monitor them if there was no electricity?
Using this kind of mandatory method to turn off the machine would avoid supervision and there was no need to throw away the combat system. He would have an explanation if he turned it back on.
Dudian and Jason took the two combat systems that they picked up and continued to retreat.
“Stay at your posts and don’t retreat. If any of you dare to take a step back, you will be punished according to military law!”The instructor’s Angry Roar came out from the wristwatch.
Jason rolled his eyes and said in a low voice: “This idiot is asking us to die. If there is no one in the wall, I will kill him!”
“Don’t worry. He doesn’t know that we are retreating.”Dudian whispered.
Jason nodded. Many of the four-eyed monsters had rushed into the fortress and were fighting with the regular army.
Boom!
Dudian felt the impact. He turned his head and saw a huge hole in the fortress. Stones were flying and several monsters rushed in!
Hundreds of regular soldiers roared: “Block the hole! Kill!”
“Kill!”
Hundreds of soldiers roared in anger. The regular soldiers of the square formation were like ants as they quickly gathered in front of the giant beasts. They were like a sharp knife but the tip of the knife rushed in front of the giant beasts, it was trampled and crushed. The formation was instantly thrown into chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 938
chapters.content:
Chapter 938 – Chapter 928: Luring
Roar!
The giant beasts let out furious roars and charged wildly in the regular army. Many soldiers were trampled to death, and some were kicked by raised hooves. They were sent flying, and the entire formation was shattered, however, the loose soldiers were not as chaotic as the temporary army. Instead, they continued to surround the giant beasts tightly. They cooperated in small groups and quickly climbed onto the back of the giant beasts.
Then, they ran from the back to the top of the Giant Beast’s head. Some attacked the eyes of the giant beast, while others slipped into its ears. Soon, a giant beast let out a scream. Its hooves that were charging forward lost their balance and fell on the spot.
The surrounding warriors immediately swarmed forward and covered the giant beast like ants. Soon, the screams stopped.
However, at this time, more and more monsters drilled out of the hole in the back, including the giant porcupine-shaped monster that had previously retreated to the second line. As soon as it drilled out of the hole, it roared and charged forward while shaking the fur on its back, countless black thorns shot out and swept towards the regular army that was charging forward to reinforce them.
In addition, a large number of four-eyed monsters drilled out of the hole. Beside the hole, there were also giant beasts that used their horns to hit the cracks on their heads, making the hole bigger and bigger.
“F * ck!”Jason saw this scene and was shocked and afraid. Although he did not have a good impression of the regular army, he also felt a wave of fear when he saw the wild and Massive Attack of the monsters, especially when he saw the regular army being massacred in large numbers, he felt sad that he might die like this. He would turn into mud under the feet of the monster and stay with the mud outside the giant wall forever.
“Go!”Dudian took aim at the route and shouted. He took Aisha and rushed towards the direction where Zac and the others had fled. Although he didn’t plan to escape but he could avoid the limelight for a while. He would return after the battle was over, in any case his combat system had been shut down. It could be said that it was damaged during the battle. At that time he would be able to disguise as a lucky person on the battlefield instead of a deserter.
Jason followed closely behind. He saw two four-eyed monsters coming from the side. He immediately rushed forward. Dudian killed the other one as he killed one. His actions were clean and neat.
Jason’s eyes focused but quickly returned to normal. The Warriors in the assault camp were good at attacking magic marks. Moreover he and Dudian were at the Abyss level. Killing four-eyed monsters was like cutting melons and vegetables. However his attacks were mainly based on strength, dudian’s attack was extremely sharp.
“Are we going?”Jason frowned as he saw Dudian’s escape route.
Dudian whispered: “Avoid the front attack of these monsters. First go to the side of the battlefield to avoid the wind. Even if we meet them it won’t be a big deal. Don’t forget that our combat system has been shut down. We won’t be considered as deserters.”
Jason understood but he quickly thought of a problem: “But if we do that then the combat system will expose our route and expose them!”
Dudian whispered: “We can’t do anything about it. If we don’t have the combat system then we will fall into the encirclement of the monsters.”
Jason couldn’t help but look at him. The perception of the combat system allowed them to see the situation on the battlefield, including the number and distribution of allies and the number and distribution of monsters.
