It was good for them to avoid risks, at the same time they could choose the best way to retreat. But if the combat system was monitoring them then it would be tantamount to betraying Zach and the others.
He remembered that Zach had talked to Dudian several times. Both of them seemed to be having a good chat. He didn’t expect that Dudian wouldn’t hesitate to betray him. If Zach knew about this, he would go all out to find Dudian!
Zach’s heart was filled with fear and vigilance towards Dudian. Although he would do the same if it was him but Dudian took the initiative to do so. He had to pay attention to it. Who knew if Dudian would cheat him?
Hiss!
Hiss!
Dudian and Jason fled along the way. More and more sections of the fortress were occupied. From time to time four-eyed monsters jumped down from the top of their heads and rushed towards the regular army, some of them saw Dudian and Jason who were hiding. They rushed towards them but were killed by the two of them.
Bang!
A four-eyed monster’s head fell from the fort and almost hit Jason.
Jason couldn’t help but look up. He was more anxious as he found that the fort had been completely lost. At this time, the wristwatches in their hands let out a deafening roar: “You four bastards! Who told you to go there? Take one more step and you will be punished as a traitor!”
Jason’s face slightly changed as he looked at dudian.
Dudian ignored them and continued to move forward as if nothing had happened. He had taken four combat systems so the instructor thought that there were four of them.
“Bastard! Do you four think that I don’t know your names? Your combat systems have records. Whoever takes a step forward will be added to the list of defectors. I will give you one more chance. Rilla, Nello, did I call your names wrong? The instructor’s angry roar came from the wristwatch again, it was mixed with strong murderous intent.
“F * ck!”Jason couldn’t help but swear, “These bastards really did something to it. Damn!”
Dudian slightly narrowed his eyes. He opened the instant messaging button on the wristwatch and whispered, “Get Out!”
Jason was stunned as he looked at dudian: “What are you doing?”
“Scolding him.”
Jason almost vomited blood: “Of course I know you are scolding him. Why are you scolding him? Although this grandson is a bastard but what if you provoke him to anger? What if he comes after us?”
Dudian was stunned: “This, it can’t be?”
Jason was speechless: “Forget it, we have scolded him. Let’s run quickly. If he comes after us, we can see him. If he dares to chase after us, we will throw this thing away or turn it off.”
Dudian nodded slightly but there was a trace of disapproval in his eyes. However, Jason didn’t notice that he was running in front of them.
At this time, the voice of the instructor came from their wristwatches again. However, this time there was no anger in their imagination. Instead, it was particularly gloomy: “Very well, you continue. I want to see how you will escape!”
Jason stared at the wristwatch. He suddenly found that the green circle and yellow spots on the wristwatch were moving towards them. He was speechless: “This grandson is so narrow-minded. He is really chasing after us!”
He looked up at Dudian who was running in front of him. There were some complaints in his heart, he said: “Why do you care about this mad dog? If he likes to scold people then let him scold. But now he is excited to chase after us…”he wanted to say a few more words but was suddenly stunned.
He saw that Dudian didn’t answer. There was a trace of doubt in his eyes: “Did you deliberately lure him over?”
Dudian turned his head: “Why did you deliberately lure him over?”
Jason frowned as he saw Dudian’s innocent face. was he thinking too much?
He wasn’t sure but he was planning to leave a way out for himself. He suddenly felt that it wasn’t absolutely safe to follow Dudian to escape. Who Knew What Dudian was planning? If he deliberately lured the instructor over, was he going to use the instructor’s hand to kill Zac and the others? But what good would it do for him?
He couldn’t figure it out so his heart was full of doubts but he wasn’t sure.
The two continued to run for a while. They found that there was a hole in the front of the fortress. Many giant beasts and four-eyed monsters ran in. In addition there was a giant lizard which they had never seen before. Its body was covered with colorful bumps, it was obvious that they were highly toxic. Green poisonous gas was sprayed out from the small area of the battlefield. Many dead soldiers were lying in the poisonous fog. Their bodies were deformed. The surface was festered and full of poisonous sores.
Dudian and Jason looked at each other. They rushed into the battlefield. It was difficult to tell whether they were regular or temporary troops. However, as long as they were human, they could be considered as allies, moreover, Dudian and Jason had the positioning of the combat system. Even if the others saw them, they didn’t care. On the contrary, there were people who came close to them and prepared to cooperate with them.
“You two keep this colorful lizard in check. I will attack from the left!”A young warrior said to Dudian and Jason. He jumped to the side and gestured to them.
Dudian and Jason looked at each other. They were speechless but they still pretended to raise their weapons and rushed towards the colorful lizard.
The colorful lizard spat out a green poisonous fog. It stretched out its long red tongue and rushed towards the two.
Dudian and Jason rushed to the green lizard. The lizard opened its mouth and bit at them. The warrior who spoke earlier took the opportunity and rushed towards them from the side.
At this time, Dudian and Jason retreated at the same time. Dudian took Aisha and Jason quickly escaped to the other side of the battlefield.
When the two of them retreated, the colorful lizard lost its target. It suddenly noticed the young warrior who was attacking from the side. It swung its big mouth and bit at his waist. Blood spurted out.
The young warrior screamed and soon became the food of the Lizard.
Screams, roars, vibrations, roars… Dudian and Jason ran forward for seven or eight minutes. They suddenly saw a lake in front of them. There was no fortress by the lake, after all, it was impossible for the fortress to circle around the entire wall of God of war. The project was too huge. Even if the height and hardness of the fortress was less than one-tenth of the wall of God of war, it was not a project that could be completed by the current Kingdom of God.
Therefore, the edge of the fortress was often located in high mountains, rivers, lakes and other places. There were also some low-lying swamps and places suitable for making traps. Even if the monsters chose to take a detour, they would be hindered.
Even if they passed through the obstacles, there would be a large number of regular troops waiting behind them.
At this moment, Dudian saw many monsters in front of the lake. Some of them were giant ostriches that were flying at low altitude. Some of them were wet like giant frogs, there were even giant crocodiles that were crawling. However, they had spikes protruding from their backs. There were also spikes protruding from both sides of their tails. They were arranged like fish spikes. They could cause terrible damage when they were swept from left to right.
“There is no way!”Jason’s face changed when he saw the chaos in front of him.
Dudian’s eyes darkened as he whispered: “Can You Fly?”
Jason looked at him: “No.”
“I’ll take you.”Dudian said.
“Are we really going to retreat from here?”Jason hesitated.
“The god of war wall is very big. I heard from the border guards that this is the seventh region. The other regions should be safe as long as we cross this place.”Dudian quickly said.
Jason hesitated for a moment and nodded: “Alright, let’s Go!”
At this time, he saw the movement of the wristwatch from the corner of his eye. He was stunned: “Did he stop?”
Dudian looked at the wristwatch and saw that the instructor and the other two who were chasing them had stopped.
“Did he give up chasing us? or is there something bothering him?”Dudian frowned.
Jason saw that there was a trace of displeasure on his face. He felt that his guess was true. Dudian was deliberately trying to lure them over!
“Let’s go. There are more and more monsters coming. The fortress won’t last long.”Jason reminded him.
Dudian nodded. He didn’t open the wristwatch to stimulate them. It was too obvious. Not only Jason but also the instructor would be able to see it.
The Witcher in his hand was half melted and part of his body was demonized. Sharp blade-like wings grew on his back. He grabbed Aisha with his right hand and Jason’s shoulder with his left hand.
There were many warriors who could fly in the front. They flew in the air and used bows and crossbows to shoot. There were also special weapons such as grenades that exploded after being thrown, countless sharp spikes were shot out. It was easy to hurt the Allies. They could only be thrown into the depths of the monsters. The effect was very obvious. The sharp spikes were so sharp that they pierced into the monsters’bodies, the monsters screamed in pain as if they had been stabbed by a knife. It was like the scream of a strong man who had been stabbed by a needle. It looked funny but the monsters were different from humans, it could only mean that these small spikes were far more terrifying than they looked.
Dudian brought Aisha and Jason and flew low. They attracted the attention of many soldiers. Some of them seemed to realize that the three of them were deserters but they didn’t have time to care about them. They had to guard their posts on the battlefield. If they failed to catch the deserters, they would be punished. As for deserters? Someone would clean them up.
Dudian and Jason were relieved to see that no one cared about them. They avoided the poison from the monsters and threw stones at them. Dudian flew to the lake and saw the clear water, long Black backs swam to the lakeside and crawled out. They looked like mutated giant crocodiles.
“F * ck!”Jason could not help but curse when he saw this scene. He did not know whether it was because there were too many of these monsters or because he cursed the border guards for making them leave the god of war wall to fight these monsters.

chapters.title: Chapter 939
chapters.content:
Chapter 939 – Chapter 929: Rendezvous
Dudian landed on the opposite side of the lake. There were a few crocodiles wandering on the shore. It seemed that they were out of touch with the mainstream team. Several crocodiles twisted their bony tails as they saw Dudian and Jason Land.
Jason took the initiative to welcome them.
Dudian didn’t go up to help but looked around. He noticed that there were some footprints on the ground. The air was still filled with the smell of Zaite. It was obvious that they had escaped to this place.
In less than half a minute Jason had finished off the four crocodiles. He went back to Dudian’s side and asked: “Where Are We Going?”He didn’t even notice it, he was used to consulting Dudian’s opinion.
Dudian looked at his wristwatch. The green circles and yellow dots were still not moving. It seemed that he had given up on chasing them. He was a bit disappointed but didn’t show it. He thought for a moment: “Hide the combat system and find Zac and the others. They should still be nearby.”
“How do you know?”
Dudian looked back at the fortress which was in chaos: “They won’t be willing to leave until they see the collapse.”
Jason looked at him: “We refused to escape. What should we say if we find them now?”
“Can’t we regret it?”
Jason wryly smiled: “Alright. But if they are ready to leave then should we leave with them?”
“The leader should listen to the leader. If there are any opinions then we should go our separate ways. We are two abyss and he only has one.”Dudian glanced at him, “You will cooperate with me.”
“Alright, I will listen to you.”
Both of them followed the trail and smell on the ground.
There were no fortresses on the lake but there were no monsters. There was a bare mountain in front of them. It was not suitable for the monsters to attack unless the mountain was flattened, it was enough to attract the attention of the empire’s border guards.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a whistling sound broke through the air.
Dudian looked to the side and saw a sharp arrow coming from the god of war’s wall. There were several soldiers standing on the edge of the wall holding bows and arrows. It seemed that they recognized them as deserters.
The arrow stopped in front of the two and was easily dodged. The soldiers on the god of war’s wall didn’t shoot again but looked at them coldly. It seemed that the arrow was a warning to them.
Jason cursed. He was about to say something when he heard a loud noise coming from behind. He looked back in fear.
He saw that the fortress was slightly tilted and was about to collapse. There were a lot of giant beasts behind the fortress. It seemed that there were many holes in the fortress.
Dudian frowned. He didn’t expect the fortress to be so weak. However, it was no wonder that the fortress was not strong enough to withstand such a large scale monster attack. After all, it was a man-made civil engineering. If a pioneer spent some time, they would be able to dig a hole, the soldiers on the fortress were restrained by the four-eyed monsters. No one stopped the monster’s attack. Naturally, the fortress would collapse soon.
Dudian continued to follow the tracks.
Ten minutes later, Dudian and Jason came to the edge of a forest. There were a few figures who jumped out of the forest and stopped in front of them. They were Zac and the others who had defected. However, the number of them was obviously reduced by half.
“Why are you here?”Zac frowned as he saw Dudian and Jason. There was a trace of doubt in his eyes.
Dudian seemed to be relieved: “We have caught up with you. You are the smart ones. If we had run a bit later then we would have been buried there. You have seen that the fortress is about to collapse!”
Zac looked at Dudian for a while and relaxed: “Are there only the two of you? Where are the others?”
“They are dead.”Dudian shook his head and sighed.
Zac wasn’t surprised. It was a miracle that they were able to survive for such a long time. Only Dudian and Jason were able to survive because of the strength of the abyss, dudian and Jason wouldn’t be able to escape if the monsters were to appear at the beginning. They would be considered lucky. He felt a bit lucky for his foresight: “If you had come with us earlier we wouldn’t have taken such a risk. We wouldn’t have lost too many people.”
Dudian and Jason looked at each other and sighed. They didn’t want to talk about it.
Zach looked at them: “Did you bring the combat system?”
“Of course not.”Dudian shook his head: “That thing can locate our position. Jason and I were running halfway when we heard the roar of the coach. He told us to go back to our posts.”
Zach’s expression was as I expected. He was about to say something when his face changed. He stared at Dudian and Jason.
Dudian was stunned. He instinctively wanted to turn his head to look at Zach. However, he was the first to react. Jason who was next to him looked back: “Damn! Why is this grandson chasing us?”
Dudian knew that it wasn’t Zac who was blackmailing them but he didn’t turn back. He frowned as he looked at Zac. His eyes were fixed on him and Jason, there was anger and killing intent in his eyes. The other people around him were also angry.
“It’s not us.”Dudian immediately said, “We are not stupid enough to cooperate with these people to catch you. I don’t know how he found us.”
Jason reacted after hearing Dudian’s words, he quickly said: “Yes, we clearly saw them stop in their position when we threw the combat system. How could they chase us? Wait a minute. Did they deduce our escape route from where we threw the wristwatch? Or do they have super perceptive people?”He said in a surprised tone, it was extremely realistic.
Dudian had to admire them. Everyone was an award-winning actor at the critical moment. Although Jason’s reaction was slow but his acting wasn’t inferior. Moreover it was more realistic and natural. Even he could be deceived, he even suspected that Jason’s reaction was slow to blur his judgment.
Zachet stared at the two of them. His eyes were full of killing intent: “We are temporary troops. We are cannon fodder and dead people in their eyes. I hope you don’t make a mistake and do stupid things!”
“Of course we won’t.”Dudian sighed.
At this time, the instructor and two other officers had caught up with them. They stopped about thirty meters away from each other. The instructor’s face was gloomy, he saw that there were Dudian, Jason and Zach among the group of people. In other words, none of the Abyss had contributed to the war.
“Why aren’t you running? !”The instructor’s voice was ferocious.
Dudian tilted his head and looked at the instructor. He could see Zach and the others from the corner of his eyes: “Aren’t you afraid that you won’t be able to catch up?”
“Why are you so stubborn?”The instructor’s eyes were cold as he stared at Dudian, suddenly he said: “I’ll give you a chance. Catch this kid and go back with me to plead guilty. I’ll spare your life. You will be punished to serve for half a year and be admitted into the regular military camp. If you are qualified then you will be directly transferred to the regular army or be discharged.”
As soon as he said this, the others were moved.
When they saw the instructor and the other two officers, the rulers and pioneers around zaite were already in despair. At this moment, the instructor’s words were undoubtedly giving them a ray of hope.
Although they knew that this might be a poisonous apple, they still couldn’t help but want to eat it.

chapters.title: Chapter 940
chapters.content:
Chapter 940 – Chapter 930: The Middle Of The War
“Don’t you feel ashamed to say such a low-level instigation?”Dudian asked in a calm tone.
The instructor sneered, “Military orders are like mountains. In front of you, my words can represent military orders! Soldiers are not allowed to lie. Believe it or not, I have given you the opportunity. The current war is the time to use people. It is meaningless to kill all of you deserters. So I will give you a chance to choose. If you make a wrong step, you will have the opportunity to repent. If you choose the wrong path again, don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
“Even if they have done meritorious deeds, they will still be used as cannon fodder by you. The next time they are sent to the front line of the battlefield, sooner or later they will die.”Dudian calmly said, “But now, we have three Abyss in the field. There are three of you. It is not certain who will live and who will die!”
“Hahaha…”the instructor laughed, “Three against three? You are wrong. I am enough to deal with the three of you alone! “You should have heard that the abysses also have different levels. You are only the lowest level of the inferior abysses, and I am just a little stronger than you. It is more than enough for me to fight the three of you alone. Moreover, I have them by my side to hold the line. Do you really think that you have the ability to resist?”
Zach, Jason and the others were shocked.
They had learned about the hierarchy of the Abyss from the god of War. Especially Zach and Jason. They knew about the hierarchy of the abyss before they were captured. But they didn’t expect that the instructor was from the Middle Abyss, he was more than twice as strong as them? It wasn’t a lie to say that they were one against three. Moreover there were two officers next to them. Even if they were from the lower abyss, they wouldn’t be able to escape!
Zach looked at Jason. Jason looked at him and then looked at dudian. There was a trace of hesitation and struggle in his heart. He saw that Dudian had hidden many means. He wanted to fight with Dudian, most likely he would suffer some losses. But if he continued to stand on the same side with Dudian then he would be facing the middle abyss instructor and the other two abyss instructors.
“If I’m not wrong then they are just the lower abyss right?”Dudian narrowed his eyes, “We are short of manpower on the battlefield. Even if we are deserters we don’t need to chase after us. I think the three of you shouldn’t be any better. You went AWOL in the name of punishing us to avoid the battlefield. What is the difference between you and deserters?”
The instructor and the two young officers’faces slightly changed. The two young officers immediately entered the state of magic. One of them was like a cheetah. He was crouching on the ground and his face was covered with spotted fur. The other one was half-human and half-snake. There was a sharp blade on his arm, his pupils became vertical as he coldly stared at Dudian. It seemed that he would attack at any time.
“You are courting death!”The instructor’s eyes were cold as he spoke word by word.
Zach, Jason and the others were aware of their reactions. Their faces turned ugly. It was true that they were deserters. But at this time, the instructor sent three Abyss soldiers to chase after them, it was completely unreasonable to ignore the battlefield. It could only mean that they were deserters but they had legitimate reasons. At most, they would be punished.
Now that they had been pointed out, the instructor most likely wouldn’t let them live!
As for the previous punishment, most of it was fake!
Zach and Jason thought of retreating. But at this time, Dudian suddenly opened his mouth, “You two, restrain those two officers. The others cooperate with you and kill them as soon as possible. I will restrain the instructor. To be honest, I have fought with the Middle Abyss. I should be able to hold on for half an hour!”
Zach and Jason were shocked as they heard Dudian’s words. Did he fight with the Middle Abyss? He could hold on for half an hour?
They were in disbelief. The gap between the Middle Abyss and the lower abyss was like the gap between the master and the Abyss. However, since dudian took the initiative to speak, it was obvious that he had some confidence. However, was it true? Could it be that Dudian took the opportunity to escape while they were holding him back?
Both of them hesitated for a moment.
The instructor sneered at Dudian’s words: “Don’t brag unless you meet the weakest middle abyss. I have been fighting at the border for many years so I will let you experience what the true Middle Abyss looks like!” The bones of his body cracked as the dual-blade in his hand melted and covered his body. In the blink of an eye he turned into a monster like a chimpanzee.
However, he was different from the ordinary giant gorilla. His hair was shiny and sharp. His fingernails were long like claws. The most eye-catching thing was that there was a red eye on his forehead. It was extremely strange.
Dudian didn’t say much. He took off his armor and melted the blade. In the blink of an eye, he entered the splitter’s magic body state. Sharp blades protruded out of his body. The edge of his body was suffused with a golden luster, it was like an object made of countless sharp blades. Its appearance alone was enough to scare people.
“Splitter?”The orangutan instructor slightly raised his eyebrows. He remembered the information about Dudian’s magic marks. However, at the moment, Dudian’s magic body seemed to be somewhat different from the splitter’s magic body in his impression.
He didn’t dare to be careless. He had been in the battlefield for many years. He had learned to be careful and avoid any dangerous possibilities. This was why he had the power to crush Dudian and the others but he didn’t choose to directly attack, he wanted to use provocation to make Dudian and the others fight against each other so as to reduce his own risk. He would try to avoid even the slightest bit of risk. This was his instinct.
Whoosh!
Dudian stomped his claw-like feet and rushed out like a gale. He was about thirty meters away from the orangutan instructor.
Orangutan Instructor’s eyes sank. He didn’t dare to attack. Although his magic marks defense was outstanding among the legendary Magic Marks and was more thorough than Dudian’s demonization, but he had heard of the splitter’s limit attack, even a master level splitter’s sharp blade could cause damage to him.
However, it didn’t mean that he had to escape. He raised his thick palm and hit the splitter’s sharp blade.
The Orangutan Instructor’s eyes suddenly moved as he stretched out his claw-like palm.
Whoosh!
Dudian pulled back with a gloomy face. He saw that the orangutan instructor’s body didn’t have the slightest injury. It was almost unimaginable that he was unscathed by his previous attacks, it wasn’t because of the latter’s terrifying defense but because all of his attacks had been evaded by the other party!
Although the orangutan instructor’s body seemed to be bulky and heavy. He was a strength-type warrior but his movements were terrifyingly agile. He could clearly see that all of his attacks had been pushed aside by his sharp claws, how good was his eyesight, how accurate was his technique, and how fast was his reaction speed?
Dudian suddenly understood that the orangutan’s body seemed simple and unadorned, but it was extremely terrifying to enhance the inner strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 941
chapters.content:
Chapter 941 – Chapter 931: Battle Of Wits
“You Run Fast.”The orangutan instructor retracted his rough palm and coldly looked at dudian: “Your speed is indeed better than the ordinary abyss. However, that’s all!”
As soon as the word “Already”fell, his huge body suddenly shot out like an arrow from a bow. It was as if he had appeared in front of Dudian in an instant. His huge body was full of pressure.
Dudian felt a strong wind blowing against his face. His vision suddenly darkened and he saw a hairy chest. His pupils shrank and his body suddenly shot out like bristles. At the same time, his body rapidly retreated.
Bang!
There was a sudden pain in his waist and abdomen. Dudian felt as if his whole body had suddenly lost its strength. He flew out of control.
After flying for a short distance, Dudian felt that his back was supported by a gentle force. The impact was canceled out and then he was gently put down. He looked in all directions and saw that it was Jason who caught him.
Jason had entered the state of a monster. He looked like a werewolf. He had ears on top of his head and hair covered his face. His hands were sharp claws but his palms were soft and thick. His knees were bent forward, he looked like two scimitars. His entire body was extremely thin and his eyes were faintly emitting a dark blue fluorescence. It was very mysterious.
“Are You Alright?”Jason put Dudian down. His voice was low and hoarse.
Dudian shook his head. He saw that there were several wounds on Jason’s chest and wrist. Blood was oozing out from the wounds. He looked at Jason, he looked at Zach and the others who were still in human form. He took a deep breath, he said in a deep voice: “I will deal with him. You guys hold the others back. We have no way out. If I die, he won’t let you escape!”
Zac knew that Dudian’s words were meant for him. He didn’t reply or deny.
Dudian ignored them as his eyes turned serious. This was the first time he had fought with the middle abyss. It was like what the instructor had said. The difference between the Middle Abyss and the lower abyss, it was like the difference between a master and an abyss!
He didn’t care about the middle abyss in the past. Firstly, he had coerced Phisonia. Secondly, he had absorbed the polar ice insect. He thought that he was a middle abyss.
Dudian knew how big the gap was between a Middle Abyss and a Middle Abyss without a magic body! Moreover he understood that he wasn’t the intermediate abyss!
The result didn’t make him depressed but made him excited and expectant. It meant that his potential was higher than what he had expected!
“There is no blood?”The orangutan instructor looked at Dudian’s waist. He was surprised that the splitter’s defense wasn’t very weak?
Dudian was focused as he slowly walked to the side. He was ready to move the battlefield.
Orangutan Instructor saw Dudian’s intention. He sneered and said to the two officers: “I’ll leave the rest to you. You should have no problem with the two small fish, right?”
“Of course.”
“I hope I can enjoy myself!”
The two officers slightly grinned. Their serious faces suddenly revealed a bit of a grin. They rubbed their hands and stretched their muscles. They didn’t take Jason, Zach and the others seriously. As for the other rulers and pioneers.., they were like air in their eyes. They were not even included in the ranks of “Trash”.
Hearing their words, Zasite and Jason’s eyes flashed with a cold light. They were somewhat angry, but more serious. Although these two officers did not look like the middle abyss, and their physiques were on par with theirs.., however, the other party was, after all, an officer who had been stationed at the Empire’s borders for many years. They had rich combat experience. It was very likely that they would not be able to defeat them.
However, they had the advantage in numbers. Although the others couldn’t interfere in the battle at the Abyss level but a few of the masters could help, perhaps they could seize the opportunity to defeat them.
The battlefield was divided into two parts. Dudian and the orangutan instructor moved to an open space hundreds of meters away. Orangutan Instructor took the initiative to stop. He looked at Dudian with a cruel face: “Kid, your magic body seems to be different from the ordinary magic body. Have you eaten anything special?”
“I ate your mother.”Dudian replied in a light tone as if he was saying a very ordinary sentence.
Orangutan Instructor’s face turned gloomy but soon revealed a sinister smile, “You want to provoke me, Kid, you’re thinking too much. After I kill you, I’ll bring your corpse back to be dissected, and I’ll be able to find the abnormality of your demonic body. Oh right, you seem to value that zombie very much. She should be one of your family members, right? Or your wife? What do you think will happen if I fuck her? I forgot to tell you, many people here don’t mind following the zombies…”
Whoosh!
A sharp blade flew out and shot towards the orangutan instructor.
The orangutan instructor quickly raised his hand and flicked his sharp nails. Whoosh! The sharp blade flew to the side and stabbed into the ground.
Dudian’s shoulder slightly trembled. Soon another sharp blade grew out. He stared at the Orangutan Instructor and didn’t say a word.
Orangutan Instructor saw Dudian’s angry look and knew that he was right. He smiled. Dudian tried to provoke him but was provoked by him. He had gained the upper hand even before the battle began, the outcome of the battle would be revealed.
“Kid, look behind you!”Orangutan Instructor’s smile disappeared as he shouted.
He rushed towards Dudian almost in an instant! Who would have thought that he would choose to launch a sneak attack in the face of overwhelming strength? Because it was more stable!
What he liked the most was stability!
Dudian was obviously shocked by his words. He turned his head.
But it was too late!
The orangutan instructor grinned and raised his huge palm to hit Dudian’s face. This should be the weakest point of Dudian’s defense.
When his palm was about to fall, suddenly, the orangutan instructor’s hair stood up. He felt a chill coming from his body. His pupils shrank and his body suddenly retreated. However, he felt a sharp pain coming from his chest.
Puff!
When he retreated, he felt pain and cold in his chest. Blood splashed out in front of his eyes.
His eyes were wide open in disbelief. He saw Dudian take advantage of the situation to chase after him. The third eye on his forehead slightly narrowed. He clapped his huge palm. The sound continued for four to five seconds before the two suddenly separated.
The instructor panted slightly. He felt that the claws on his fingers were trembling. There was only one wound on his chest. Dudian’s follow-up attack didn’t cause any harm to him.
The orangutan instructor looked at the sharp wound on his chest. The surface of the wound was hooked. There were barbs on Dudian’s sharp blade. The structure of the blade was very magical. It looked like a flowing blade, in fact, it was a very small sawtooth. It was so small that the wound caused by the sharp blade couldn’t be healed. Blood was flowing non-stop!
The core of the splitter was the word “Cut”.
“Brat, you did it on purpose!”The orangutan instructor angrily looked at dudian. Previously, Dudian deliberately turned back to make him relax his vigilance. Moreover, when he turned back, he deliberately acted as if he had reacted, he almost completely believed it!
This also caused him to be too confident.
If a person was confident, it was inevitable that he wouldn’t notice something.
Dudian’s body slightly rotated. The blade that stabbed the orangutan instructor was still dripping with blood. “You can do it on purpose. Why Can’t I do it on Purpose?”His tone was calm, he wasn’t angry like before.
The orangutan instructor immediately knew that Dudian’s previous anger was intentional. This made him even angrier!
Failure always made people angry, especially the failure of intelligence!
But the orangutan instructor’s combat experience was too rich. When the blood flow in his body accelerated, his instincts suddenly warned his brain and he calmed down in an instant.
He took a deep breath and clenched his fists. He didn’t dare to be careless. Although he was confident that he could kill Dudian, but Dudian could also kill him. He had experienced Dudian’s sharp blade attack, it was much sharper than the rumors.
Only one blow!
Dudian could kill him with only one fatal blow!
So he couldn’t give Dudian this opportunity. The best way was to kill Dudian in one blow or to pull out Dudian’s sharp blade!
At this moment Dudian’s body was like a hedgehog wrapped by a sharp blade. To kill him in one blow needed to grasp the opportunity. It was relatively easier to pull out the sharp blade.
“I forgot to tell you that my sharp blades are stained with poison.”Dudian looked at him with a smile, “It should be called a virus. Have you forgotten that I have the king of corpses by my side? It is easy to get the saliva of the king of corpses.”
The orangutan instructor felt as if he had been struck by lightning. His mind suddenly went blank. Dudian suddenly rushed towards him.
The orangutan instructor immediately reacted. He saw that Dudian had rushed in front of him. All the sharp blades were surrounding him. His pupils shrank. His body hurriedly retreated. He raised his hand and slapped the blade.
When his palm pushed towards the third blade, the blade suddenly twisted and turned. It was originally a vertical blade but it turned into a horizontal blade. His palm was pushed towards the side of the vertical blade to avoid the edge of the blade, but the edge of the blade was directly aimed at his palm.
He was shocked and broke out in a cold sweat. His palm changed in a flash. He flicked his finger and pushed away the blade from the top down.
Puff! Puff!
The surrounding blades changed direction at the same time. Some changed, and some didn’t.
Although the reaction speed of the orangutan instructor was fast, but it was limited. When he pushed away seven or eight sharp blades that suddenly changed direction, his arms were grazed by the edge of the blade, leaving two bloody scars.
At this time, the orangutan instructor had retreated out of Dudian’s attack range and pulled away.
Dudian stopped in place and didn’t continue to pursue. In terms of speed, he couldn’t be compared to the orangutan instructor. He had used all his strength in the previous attack but didn’t expect that it would only cause minor injuries. He couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
The Orangutan Instructor’s physical strength was stronger than his. Moreover his magic marks were enhanced. If his reaction was a bit slow then he would have died in his hands.
“The Middle Abyss is nothing more than this.”Dudian stood in place and indifferently mocked.
Orangutan Instructor’s face turned black. He gritted his teeth as he looked at dudian. Dudian’s counter attack had disrupted the rhythm of the battle. Moreover he was distracted by Dudian’s words. He felt ashamed that he had been suppressed twice in a row.
However, the final victory was the most important thing!
He quickly wiped away the anger from his face. He looked at Dudian and thought about the battle strategy.
He thought for a moment and looked at Dudian’s hedgehog-like body. He still couldn’t think of a good idea. Suddenly, he realized that he could defeat Dudian from the front. Why should he think of a strategy?
Previously, he was trying to use a stable strategy. As a result, he was injured.
After thinking about it, he suddenly felt relaxed. He grinned and rushed forward. In an instant, he was in front of Dudian.
Dudian seemed to have been waiting for a long time. He swung his sharp blade.
Whoosh!
The body of the orangutan instructor suddenly disappeared and appeared on the side. He punched Dudian’s neck from the gap between the two daggers. Bang! Dudian’s body flew out and hit a piece of rock.
The orangutan instructor almost chased after Dudian’s body which was flying out. When he hit Dudian, he immediately attacked and punched Dudian’s face.
It was too fast. Dudian barely saw it but he didn’t have time to swing the dagger. It was the first time he felt that his action was so slow!
Bang!
Pain came from his face. Dudian felt the friction of the soil on his back.
The sharp blade of his body suddenly rotated. Whoosh! It moved in all directions and forced the orangutan instructor to move away.
Dudian stood up from the Mud Pit. He slightly panted. He felt the pain in his neck as if it was broken. He clenched his teeth and stared at the orangutan instructor. Suddenly, he smiled.
The Orangutan Instructor’s heart was gloomy as he saw Dudian’s smile. He was about to make a quick move but suddenly his face changed. He felt that his body was a bit numb. He looked down and saw that Dudian had cut the wound on his chest, the blood that flowed out was pale green.
Poison!
The orangutan instructor’s face changed. He was angry but also frightened. At the same time, he felt a trace of relief. He was glad that he was infected with the poison and not the zombie virus that Dudian had mentioned. At least the former would be able to survive, the latter is certain to die!
“I told you it was poisonous. If you cut off the meat you will last longer.”Dudian didn’t rush to attack. He gently shook the soil off his body, the poison was collected from a highly toxic monster he and Phisnia hunted on their journey and smeared on the witcher. When it was demonized, the poison would naturally appear on the blade. If the physique was weak, they would die of heart paralysis on the spot.
The orangutan instructor gritted his teeth slightly. Although he was angry, he held it in. Anger would increase the circulation of the blood and the poison would deepen. He took a deep breath and turned his head to look. He saw that the outcome of the battle on the other side was about to be decided, it was the two companions who had the upper hand.
He heaved a sigh of relief. A hint of killing intent flashed in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 942
chapters.content:
Chapter 942 – Chapter 932: Forward
“Do you expect them to help you?”Dudian sneered as he saw the expression of the orangutan instructor. He suddenly flew out and the sharp blade shot out like a storm.
The orangutan instructor’s vertical pupil narrowed. His huge body was as light as a fallen leaf. He dodged or pushed away the sharp blade. He had made up his mind. As long as he could delay until his two companions defeated Zasit and the others, they would come over to reinforce him.
Dudian’s attack was like the wind. It was getting faster and faster. The sharp edge of the dagger became more flexible. For a moment he had the upper hand and completely suppressed the orangutan instructor.
Whoosh!
A sharp edge cut across the side and suddenly changed direction. The orangutan instructor didn’t have time to dodge. His arm was cut and blood spurted out.
The orangutan instructor’s face slightly changed. He felt that his body’s function was getting slower and slower. He pulled back and was angry. At the same time he glanced at the battlefield from the corner of his eyes, he saw that his two companions had forced Zach and Jason to retreat. They could only barely hold on.
Whoosh!
A sharp blade flew towards his face.
The orangutan instructor’s pupils shrank. He raised his head to dodge but the sharp blade suddenly changed direction and slashed at his throat. His face suddenly changed. He stomped his feet several times and pulled away again. However his back was covered in cold sweat.
Dudian continued to chase after him.
The orangutan instructor hurriedly parried and retreated.
Dudian’s attacks became more and more fierce. He felt that his movements became more and more smooth. He didn’t feel tired at all. His limbs and fingers were like his hands and feet. They could bend, change direction, fall off or twist at will.
His attacks became more and more tricky and unpredictable. It seemed that the wind was supporting his body.
“I can be faster…”Dudian’s eyes were filled with excitement as he moved faster and faster.
Puff! Puff!
The two sharp blades suddenly changed direction and moved close to the abdomen and thigh of the orangutan instructor.
The Orangutan Instructor roared. All the hair on his body stood up as he waved his rough palm forward. He grabbed the two sharp blades in front of Dudian’s chest and pulled them out!
Dudian didn’t retreat. Instead, he rushed towards orangutan at a faster speed. The sharp blades on his body were like a peacock’s tail. The hands of the orangutan were like hooks, he grabbed the hair on the chest of orangutan instructor and closed the distance.
Orangutan Instructor’s face changed. He quickly raised his hand to tear Dudian’s face. He wanted to force him to retreat.
However the tip of Dudian’s nose suddenly grew. The black magic substance protruded along the tip of his nose. It turned into a sharp blade.
Puff!
The sharp blade pierced through the orangutan instructor’s palm. Dudian stretched out his hand and hugged him. His cold face was infinitely close to him.
“No –”the orangutan instructor roared in fear. He saw Dudian’s emotionless eyes. The next moment, intense pain came from all parts of his body. He was completely embraced by Dudian!
The sharp blades of Dudian’s body were closed like a clam shell. The sharp blades penetrated into the orangutan instructor’s body from the side.
Orangutan Instructor’s body stiffened as he struggled. His eyes opened wide and saliva flowed out of his mouth. He would never have thought that he would fall into the hands of a lower abyss!
Whoosh!
Dudian let go of his hands and took a few steps back. The sharp blades that pierced into orangutan instructor’s body were pulled out. Blood flowed out of the wound. The Orangutan Instructor kneeled down and his body slowly fell down.
Dudian’s tensed heart also fell down. He suddenly felt a wave of fatigue coming from the roots of the sharp blade. He gently exhaled and looked at the battlefield in the distance. Zach and Jason were injured and in danger, he estimated that they wouldn’t be able to hold on for long.
“I originally wanted to leave you there and rely on you. I didn’t expect that I would be able to solve it myself.”Dudian muttered. He raised the sharp blade behind his back and cut off the head of the orangutan instructor, the latter didn’t have the slightest possibility to disguise himself.
He turned around and stomped his feet. He flew towards Zach and the others.
“Eh?”One of the officers with small eyes suddenly sensed something. He looked at them from the corner of his eyes. His face changed: “How… How is this possible!”
The other young officer was stunned. He avoided Jason who was struggling to survive. He turned his head and saw Dudian who was flying towards him. He saw the orangutan instructor who was lying on the ground not far behind him.
He blinked and suspected that he was hallucinating.
However, Dudian arrived in the blink of an eye. The strong wind made both of them come back to their senses. They were shocked and angry. They immediately surrounded Dudian from left and right.
Dudian’s toes slightly touched the ground. His body suddenly spun like a top. The sharp blade protruded like a flaming wheel. Bang! He hit the small-eyed officer who was rushing towards him from the right.
Puff!
The small-eyed officer’s chest was hit by Dudian. His body was instantly torn into pieces!
The young officer who was ready to attack on the left was stunned. He looked at the scene in shock. His face was full of disbelief but the shock only lasted for half a second. He turned around and fled!
Whoosh!
Dudian stepped on the ground. The ground was dozens of meters long. In the blink of an eye he caught up with the young officer. He threw out a sharp blade and pierced through the young officer’s back. The blade pierced through the young officer’s chest and then went up, the young officer’s upper body was split into two. He was killed in an instant!
Blood splashed onto Dudian’s body. He slowly turned around and walked towards Jason and Zach.
Jason and Zach stood in place. The change was too fast. From the moment Dudian rushed over to kill the two officers, it didn’t take more than five seconds!
At this time, both of them suddenly thought of something. They turned around and saw the body of the orangutan instructor who was hundreds of meters away.
Dead?
Both of their eyes were wide open.
The intermediate abyss level instructor was killed by Dudian? ! How is this possible? !
Zach’s throat rolled as he saw Dudian approach. He instinctively took a step back and asked in a trembling voice: “Are you also from the Intermediate Abyss?”
Dudian saw the fear in Zach’s eyes: “If so, the battle would have ended long ago. It was just a fluke.”
Would there be a fluke in a battle with an experienced enemy like the instructor? The answer was obviously no. Zach didn’t dare to ask any more questions. He knew that everyone had their own secrets. He forced a smile as he felt bitter in his mouth.
Jason who was next to him was also a bit afraid. He knew that Dudian wouldn’t attack them. Otherwise it wouldn’t be too late for him to kill them.
“Let’s Find a place to take refuge.”Dudian opened his mouth and pulled back the two’s thoughts.
Zach quickly replied: “Yes Yes Yes. We shouldn’t stay here for long. We should go to the forest first. We should observe the situation before we think about how to proceed. What do you think?”
Dudian nodded and put away his magic body: “Lead the way.”
Zac and Jason also put away their magic bodies. Zac and the other two severely injured pioneers led the way. As for the others, they were all killed by the two officers. There were only four of them left, including Dudian and Aisha, there were six of them.
Boom!
As they stepped into the forest, they suddenly heard a huge roar coming from the distance.
They stopped and looked over. They saw a blazing flame burning in the fortress like a volcano eruption.
Dudian immediately jumped to the top of a nearby giant tree. He saw a seven or eight meters tall red figure in the flame above the fortress. The figure looked like a human or a reptile. There were bull-like horns on its head, the tail on its back was extremely long. It was burning like a fire whip. At first glance it looked like Aisha’s demonized half-dragon.
“Is this… The Fire Dragon?”Dudian’s eyes slightly moved.
At this time, Jason and Zac also looked at the top of the nearby giant tree. Zac whispered after he saw the situation on the fortress: “It’s the Fire Dragon. They are leading the monster army to attack the god of war wall!”
Jason, who was beside him, asked curiously, “This is the fire dragon alien race? Have you seen it before?”
“I was lucky to have seen it once, but it was dead. The Flames on its body will not be extinguished after it dies. It is said that it will only return to normal after it dies for more than three years.”Zahit’s gaze was solemn, “Once the flames on its body are touched, it is almost impossible to extinguish it. The only way is to wipe away the place where it is touched. If the hand is touched, cut off your own hand. This is the fastest way to save your life. Otherwise, the flames will continue to burn along your hand until you are reduced to Ashes!”
Jason said in surprise, “Is it that exaggerated? Is it that even water can not extinguish it?”
“Of course.”Zaite’s voice was low, “This is not an ordinary flame. Have you seen the oil fire? The more water is poured, the faster the fire will spread through the water. Although this is not an oil fire, it is more special. Unless a wet cloth is used to completely cover the fire, it is possible to extinguish it.”
Jason raised his eyebrows: “It is not that terrifying. Just jump into the water.”
Zach bitterly smiled: “It is easy to say. But how can you jump into a pool during a battle? Fire Dragons usually do not appear in places with water. They can only be seen in barren wasteland and rubble.”
“How do you know?”Jason looked at him in surprise.
“I heard it from a veteran.”Zach sighed.
Dudian looked at the fire dragon on the fortress. He saw that the soldiers were in the front line of the regular army. The Flames on their bodies touched the soldiers and immediately lit them up.
Dudian suddenly had an idea as he saw the fire dragon crazily attack and Roar. Why was it so desperate to climb over the god of War Wall?
From Zach’s words and the behavior of the Fire Dragon, Dudian knew that it was an intelligent creature. Although it might not have the same level of intelligence as humans but it was definitely not an ordinary monster.
“Why are they attacking the god of War Wall?”Dudian frowned as he looked at the towering god of war wall, such a giant wall isolated the kingdom of God and the giant wall. So why did the alien race try to climb over the wall?
Was there something in the wall that they desired?
Or did they want to “Get out”?
Rumble!
At this time, there was a vibration coming from the edge of the forest.
They turned around and saw a group of dark beasts slowly moving towards the fortress.
Zach’s face changed, he looked at dudian: “The size of the beast group is too large. There are fire dragons and other races involved. The fortress will not be able to hold. They will retreat back to the god of war wall. We should find a place to hide so that we don’t meet the Stragglers.”
Dudian nodded. He could only continue to hide.
If he returned to the fortress at this time he would be sent to the front line. Even if he mixed with the other regular troops and retreated back to the god of war wall he would be caught. After all the empire’s border guards had been fighting for many years, they were very good at defending against deserters.
“Retreat first.”Dudian said.
Zac and Jason immediately took the two injured pioneers and moved forward along the forest.
There were some crawling monsters living in the forest. Their physiques weren’t high. They were at the hunter and limiter level. It was rare for them to meet a pioneer level monster. This place was close to the god of war’s wall. Usually they had cleaned it but there were no large monsters living here.
Zac and Jason’s determination to survive grew stronger as they passed through the forest. They used to think that the outside of the wall was as terrifying as the military had claimed. They found that there were powerful alien races, just as they had guessed, there were also areas with low-level monsters. Not all areas would encounter foreign races.
As they traveled forward, the booming sounds and killing shouts coming from the fortress grew further and further away.
Zac and Jason led the team in front. When the killing sounds at the fortress gradually faded away, they slowly stopped moving forward.
The few of them found a place to rest, eat and drink for a while before continuing on their journey.
“Sleep here tonight.”Jason looked at the two severely injured pioneers. They had suffered a lot along the way, but they didn’t say anything about rest, most of them were afraid that Dudian and the others would abandon them as a burden, so they endured the pain and followed them.
Zach saw that there were no large monsters around and nodded: “The environment is good. What do you think, Dudian?”
Dudian shook his head: “The battle at the fortress will be decided sooner or later. There is a high possibility that the alien race will lose. Once they lose, the monsters will flee in all directions. It is very likely that they will bump into us.”
“It makes sense. We are too close to the god of war.”Zac agreed with Dudian’s idea.
Jason hesitated: “But we are too far away so we can’t see the situation on the battlefield. When will we return? Are We Going to stay here forever? Just the few of us?”
Zach frowned and the two injured pioneers became silent.
“It’s easy to know the situation of the fortress. We will leave traces and traps along the way. If the alien race is defeated then the number of monsters in the vicinity will increase. We will return to observe the situation.”Dudian said.

chapters.title: Chapter 943
chapters.content:
Chapter 943 – Chapter 933: Treason
“Alright.”Jason reluctantly agreed.
He didn’t want to be a traitor. He would be wandering outside the god of war wall for the rest of his life. He would be with the monsters and lead a savage life. But the battlefield was in chaos. He would be sacrificed if he went back.
Everyone was led by Dudian.
Half a day later, they came out of the forest and came to a high mountain. The mountain was two to three hundred meters high and there were many monsters living there. The Lord of this place was a crawling monster. It looked like a crouching spider but its legs were sharp blades, his strength was comparable to a ruler, but he was killed by Zaitt with two strikes.
They took the mountain as their king and rested here.
From the high mountain, they could vaguely see the scenery outside the wall more than twenty miles away, and they could also see the scene behind the Beast Tide. From time to time, there was a loud and Majestic Beast Roar from the Dark Beast Tide, as if it was a command.., the aftermath of the beast tide could be vaguely felt even if they were more than twenty miles away.
Zac and Jason’s eyesight was not weak. Although they could not see the shape of the monsters in the Beast Tide clearly, they could see the scale of the entire Beast Tide.
“Was the Beast Tide in the past also this large?”Jason turned to Zac and asked with a shocked face.
Zac was slightly stunned, hearing that, he smiled bitterly and said, “Don’t ask me. Although I came earlier than you, I have never been on the battlefield. “But… it should be on this scale. No wonder they recruited these unaffiliated people at the last minute. It has been five to six hours since the battle began at dawn. Not counting the magical beasts that have already invaded the fortress, just this area alone should have fifty to sixty thousand of them, right?”
“I guess so…”Jason was not sure either, “We can’t see the end… fortunately we ran out in advance. If we had listened to the words of that bastard then we wouldn’t have been able to defend the fortress even if we had ten lives. It’s too terrifying. We have seen many beast tides in the past but the monsters are generally weak. Our tactics are useless in front of us. However there are so many big monsters here. Even if the upper abyss is surrounded by the beast tide it will peel off a layer of skin!”
Dudian’s eyes were solemn. He was also surprised. The battle had lasted for five or six hours but the scale of the Beast Group was still so large. Most of the fortress had been conquered. He didn’t know if the impregnable god of war wall.., would it be able to defend against the invasion.
“Look! It’s a fire dragon!”Zac suddenly raised his finger.
They looked in the direction of Zac’s finger. They saw the Black Tide behind the Beast Group. The red color was in sharp contrast to the black tide, it was as if they were jumping in the herd. They quickly went from the tail to the front of the herd until they disappeared from everyone’s sight.
“Twenty-eight, twenty-nine…”
Jason’s lips moved. He took a deep breath as he counted to thirty-three: “Thirty-three!”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he pondered. He suddenly had an idea. He felt that this idea was a bit too bold and even outrageous!
He had heard from Phoenix that the fighting strength of the fire dragon alien race was not inferior to that of the giant devil alien race. The adult giant devil alien race had the power of the Abyss level. Some of them were stronger than the middle abyss, the fire dragon alien race was the same. They were even stronger. Phoenix had taught Dudian how to judge the strength of the fire dragon alien race. It was the color of their flames!
The Blue Flame of the fire dragon alien race was the weakest. Their fighting strength was lower than that of the abyss.
The Red Flame of the fire dragon alien race was comparable to the lower abyss.
The fire dragon alien race with Golden Flame Heart was a royal family of the fire dragon alien race. Their strength was close to that of the upper abyss!
Only the Master of the Abyss could barely deal with the Golden Flame of the fire dragon alien race!
According to the rumors, the fire dragons were the strongest among the fire dragons. Their flames were white like steam. They were the kings of the fire dragons. Only the Seven Kings could kill them!
The previous thirty-three fire dragons were all scarlet flames. Two of the Flames contained a wisp of gold. Their fighting strength could even defeat the three border guards who had brought Dudian Here!
However, the three border guards relied on the natural protection of the god of war wall. It was not difficult for them to block the more than thirty fire dragons.
“I heard that the strength of the fire dragons is related to the strength of the flames…”Zac began to talk about the fire dragons’strength according to the color of the flames.
Jason and the other two listened carefully.
“Doesn’t this mean that more than 30 abysses have passed through?”Jason was flabbergasted.
Since when were abysses so common?
One had to know that in the wall, the lord of the wall was the true abyss, but on this battlefield, more than 30 abysses had appeared all of a sudden! Moreover, they had not paid attention to the battlefield on their way. Who knew if more fire dragons had passed through during that period of time?
Was this the world outside the god of War’s Wall?
Jason, Zaitt, and the others’hearts became heavy. It was too brutal. If they wanted to survive here with their proud strength, they could only rely on luck!
Even if they hid in areas where the monsters were generally weaker, but… powerful monsters could move and come out to look for food. If they happened to meet them, wouldn’t they become food on the plate?
They were still young and could live for a long time.
There were three hundred and sixty-five days and eight thousand seven hundred and sixty hours in a year. In terms of hours, their lives were really too long. Even if they lived for more than eight thousand hours in a year, they would always be on the edge of their wits, it was enough to drive people crazy, let alone ten or fifty years?
For a time, even the determined Zaite could not help but have the urge to retreat. He suddenly regretted his decision and even felt that it was a little reckless.
No one spoke. There was silence on the mountain.
The atmosphere was gloomy.
The Beast Tide was still moving in the distance. From the color change of the beast tide, it could be seen that there were different monsters coming from the back. It seemed endless.
Zac suddenly asked: “Do you think that the god of war wall has been broken?”
Dudian’s eyes moved as he remained silent.
Jason and the other two pioneers were surprised: “It can’t be. The God of war wall has protected the empire for so many years. How could it be breached?”
Zach replied in a low tone: “It didn’t happen before but it doesn’t mean that it will never happen. There is no absolute defense in this world!”
Jason could only admit his words: “Are we the Bane of the Empire? I don’t believe that the Empire has collapsed when we arrived.”
“If it didn’t collapse then how could the beasts continue to advance? is the battlefield consuming them so fast?”Zach frowned. His suspicion was based on evidence.
Jason naturally knew this. Although he had some doubts in his heart but he didn’t want to believe that the god of war’s wall would be broken, “I think there are big figures on the god of war’s wall. I think the possibility of the god of war’s wall being broken is too low. The Empire has been established for so many years and the god of war’s wall has been protected for at least two hundred years. I don’t believe that it will collapse today!”
Zac looked at dudian: “Why don’t we go back and take a look?”
Dudian looked at Zac and Jason. He saw that they were waiting for him to make a decision. He didn’t answer Zac but asked: “Do you want the god of war to collapse or not?”
Zac and Jason were stunned. Zac hesitated for a moment, he said: “From our current position I hope that there is a problem with the god of war wall. Maybe we can sneak in and follow behind the alien races.”
Jason looked at him but didn’t say anything.
Dudian looked at Jason: “You don’t want it?”
Jason shook his head, “I don’t know. I want the god of war wall to collapse. The reason is the same as Zach. We can sneak in but I don’t want it to collapse. Once the protection of the god of War Wall is gone, the people inside the wall will die…”he slightly opened his mouth, he wanted to say something but held back.
Dudian bluntly said: “I want it to collapse. At least we can live. But it is a bit rebellious. But we are deserters now. Regardless of military law or the laws of the empire, we will be executed countless times. I am not afraid that you will listen to me. This is my true opinion.”
Zach nodded: “Yes, although it is a bit scary to say such words here. But there is no one else here.”
“Since you have such thoughts, I think we can help the other races.”Dudian immediately said.
Zach and Jason were shocked as they looked at dudian: “Help the other races? You… you mean…”
“If the other races have the hope to break through the god of war wall then we can help them. We will have the opportunity to steal back the god of war wall. The Seven Kings will come to repair the god of War Wall and kill the other races.”Dudian persuaded.
Jason hesitated: “This… this is not good. If they know about it then we…”
“I think so.”The gentle and elegant Zaite was very decisive, “Dudian is right. Once the god of War Wall is broken, the Seven Kings will come to reinforce us. If they take action then the invaders will be swept away. They won’t hurt too many people. Anyway there is no god of war wall near here. Maybe the invaders will fight with the monsters inside the wall!”
Jason saw that he and Dudian had the same opinion. He knew that there was no way to change it, he said: “But we are weak. How can we help them? They can send out a few fire dragons and they will be more effective than us.”
Zach sneered: “That may not be the case. We are familiar with the situation on the god of war wall. The other races only know how to fight but we can lead them to find the weak points to attack.”
Dudian nodded: “It is the simplest way to kill people.”
Jason sighed: “That is true.”
The few of them discussed the details. They stayed on the mountain for a few hours under Dudian’s suggestion.
The sky gradually darkened. At dusk, the sky was filled with burning clouds.
The number of the Beast Tide had become sparse. It was no longer a black mass. From time to time there would be fire dragons rushing out of the Beast Tide to rush to the front of the battlefield.
Dudian, Jason and Zach ate dry food and returned to the battlefield.
It was early in the morning when they were dozens of miles away from the god of war. They could see the giant outline of the god of war.
When they looked at the seventh region of the god of war, they saw the flames of war. The towering god of war was splashing in all directions. The roars and shouts of the beasts seemed to come from the sky.
Dudian, Jason, Zac and the others were surprised as they saw the scene. They were surprised that the beasts had continued to attack for so long. However, the regular army on the god of War Wall was able to hold on. The wall outside the god of war wall was stained with blood. It looked like a waterfall formed by blood was pouring down from the highest point of the wall. The wall was more than three thousand meters long.
On the ground outside the god of war wall, the corpses of magical beasts piled up like a mountain. They were over a thousand meters tall, and there were tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of corpses piled up. They formed a steep slope, and the magical beasts that rushed up from behind climbed up the steep slope of the corpses one after another, they climbed to the top of the wall, or jumped up. However, there were boulders rolling down from the wall from time to time, or gunpowder cannonballs were shot out, killing the magical beasts that climbed up the wall.
Every time the shells exploded the entire god of war wall seemed to vibrate. Fortunately the shells were far away from the god of war wall so they didn’t explode close to the wall. The aftershocks of the shells burnt the wall.
Dudian, Jason and others didn’t expect that the god of war wall wouldn’t be broken. They didn’t even see the hope of being broken.
Dudian frowned and stared at the wall in silence.
Half an hour later, the battlefield continued to charge forward and tenaciously defend. The corpses of monsters fell from the god of war wall like raindrops. The height of the corpses was increased by another 10-20 meters.
“They actually defended the wall!”Zach’s face was ugly.
Jason was silent. It was impossible to tell what he was thinking.
Dudian looked at him for a moment: “Let’s Go and wait for a while.”
Zac was unwilling: “Aren’t we going to harass them?”
“If the god of war’s wall is on the verge of collapse then we have a role to play. But now it is still impregnable. Our role in such a battlefield is too small. There is no way for us to play a role in the outcome.”Dudian sighed.
Zach was aware of this but he wasn’t willing to accept it. This was their last hope!
“Let’s wait for a while. Maybe there will be changes.”Dudian comforted him and left without looking back.
Dudian leaned on the hillside and continued to look at the battlefield. He was waiting for the opportunity.
Two days passed in the blink of an eye.
Dudian and the others returned to the god of war to observe the situation. The height of the corpses had increased but the battle was still going on, they couldn’t break through the defense of the wall. Many of the corpses of the fire dragons fell into the steep slope and became one of them.
On the fourth day, the battlefield finally changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 944
chapters.content:
Chapter 944 – Chapter 934: Alien Deserters
The situation that Dudian and the others had been looking forward to didn’t appear. Instead, the Beast Tide gradually thinned out. There were many groups of beasts that left the main force and headed towards the surrounding area.
Dudian and the others met two groups of small groups of beasts that had retreated back. In the battle, two injured pioneers were killed. Currently, only Zac, Jason and Dudian were left, haisha was left.
Originally there were more than ten people in the group but in a few days there were only a few of them left.
Zac’s thoughts of escaping gradually faded. He suddenly felt that he would rather be punished than stay in the wall.
He couldn’t imagine what kind of life he would have if Dudian and Jason were gone and he was the only one left. Would he gradually lose his humanity? Would he be unable to speak in the end?
“What should we do now?”Zac and Jason looked at dudian. Even though they were used to being in a high position and had independent thoughts, they were at a loss at the moment.
Dudian’s heart was also a bit confused. He didn’t expect that such a huge attack from the alien race wouldn’t have much impact on the god of war’s wall. They often returned to the periphery of the battlefield to observe, they tried to help when the monsters were strong but they didn’t have the opportunity to do so.
The battle was about to end. Obviously, such an opportunity was impossible!
It meant that they had to choose between continuing to flee or disguising as fallen soldiers and returning to the god of war wall.
In Dudian’s opinion, it was impossible for Zac to return to the god of war wall. His wristwatch was left on the fortress. The God of war wall should have recorded the action route of his wristwatch. He could only continue to flee towards destruction.
However, his own combat system and Jason’s were closed. There was no record of their escape route. If they returned then there was a low chance that they would not be regarded as deserters. However, the technical personnel of the border guards were not fools. They were sent to the front line. The battle had lasted for so many days. There was no reason for them to survive. They must have defected.
The outcome of deserters would be death or sent to a place like the monster research institute or coolies to display their remaining value.
He sighed. He was a bit upset. He didn’t pay attention to Zac and Jason’s questions. He sat on the hillside and pondered.
Zac and Jason saw that Dudian had no idea. Their Hearts were cold. They were silent as they thought about their own way out.
Three days later, on the eighth day of the battle, a large number of monsters retreated and fled in all directions. However, the battle had continued until now. The number of monsters that survived was less than one-tenth of the previous number, the difference between the retreat and the previous orderly attack was huge. They were like headless flies that scattered in different directions.
After encountering several monsters that had fled in succession, Dudian knew that they couldn’t stay here for long. If they encountered some difficult monsters, they would most likely die here. The monsters that were able to survive in the war were either lucky or had special abilities. It was rare to see pioneer level monsters.
“Let’s go.”Dudian put away his magic body and spoke to Zach and Jason.
“Where are we going?”Zach asked.
Dudian looked at the direction of the god of war’s wall. His eyes flashed for a moment. He sighed and turned to face the front: “Continue forward!”
Zach and Jason were startled. Zach sighed. He had thought about the possibility of returning to the god of war’s wall. But the result was obvious. The invasion of foreign monsters had ended and the border guards weren’t short of people, a deserter like him would most likely be executed or sent to an extremely evil place to extract energy and rare minerals for the empire. It would be no different from death or even more painful!
Jason slightly clenched his fist and hesitated for a moment, in the end he said to dudian: “Isn’t our combat system shut down? If we return we won’t be considered as deserters right? You said that we can find other excuses and eventually be punished…”
Dudian shook his head, “It was possible but I didn’t think that the battle would last for so long!”! It had been seven or eight days and the fortress had already been breached. How could our strength hold out for so long on the battlefield? There is only one conclusion that can be explained and that is that we have defected!”
Jason didn’t give up: “We can say that after the fortress was breached we didn’t have time to escape back to the god of war. We temporarily hid in other places. Isn’t that considered as a direct defection?”
Dudian sighed, “But the higher-ups gave us a death order to defend the fortress. Only the soldiers of the god of war. There are no soldiers who are struggling to live. In their eyes, we only have one ending. We will die in the fortress. If we survive then we will be deserters!”
There was a bit of struggle in Jason’s eyes. He opened his mouth and wanted to say something. But in the end he shut his mouth and didn’t say anything.
Zach was stunned as he heard their conversation: “Did you close the combat system? How did you close it?”
“It was destroyed so naturally it was closed.”Dudian didn’t elaborate, “Let’s continue to move forward. We can only try to move forward. I suspect that there might not be all monsters outside the border. It is very likely that there are humans or other intelligent life forms. Maybe we can communicate with them. For example the fire dragon alien race. If we meet them, we might be able to cooperate with them.”
“Cooperate?”Zach and Jason looked at him in doubt.
“The fire dragon alien race wants to invade the god of war wall. Naturally they want to understand the situation inside the god of war wall. If it were us, we would capture a few enemy soldiers and get information from them.”Dudian said.
Both of them reacted. Their eyes flashed with a trace of strangeness. It was worse than defecting. However, this was also one of the chances for them to survive.
“Let’s Go!”Zac was decisive.
Dudian took Aisha and continued to move forward.
There were monsters chasing after them from time to time. Fortunately, they had been paying attention to them and were hiding in advance. Few monsters noticed them as they were fleeing in panic.
They crossed the mountains, plains and wasteland and met many monsters along the way. Most of them were pioneer and master level monsters. There were few abyss level monsters. Their gloomy mood gradually brightened up.
They had met hundreds of abyss level monsters in the previous war. However, they had recovered a lot of confidence. After all, the Abyss was one of the few.
“This is the trail of the Fire Dragon!”Dudian looked at the burnt black tree in the forest. His eyes were solemn.
Zac walked forward and was about to touch it. Jason suddenly said: “Don’t touch it!”
Zac quickly retracted his hand and turned to look at him.
“This thing seems to be poisonous!”Jason picked up the dead branches from the ground. He opened the burnt black bark and saw that it was covered with sticky green sap. The sap slightly shook and changed its color when they saw it clearly, the sap was made up of countless small insects. The number of insects was terrifying.
Although it was an abyss but they were more careful than hunters. They wouldn’t easily underestimate any monster including a small insect.
The previous few people had seen the fire dragon’s flames which were enough to burn the entire tree. But at the moment it only burned a piece of bark. It was very likely that it was because of the green insects.
Dudian looked at the forest. He saw more and more trees burning in a straight line. It should be the path of the Fire Dragon.
Would it lead to the nest of the fire dragon?
Dudian’s heart was full of expectation. He didn’t know why he was looking forward to it. If he really encountered it he might die. But there seemed to be an impulse of adventure and exploration in his bones.
Roar!
Less than ten minutes after they went deep into the forest, a roar suddenly came from behind. It was hoarse and high-pitched. It was like the roar of a tiger. It was full of intimidation.
The pupils of the three people shrank. The hair on their bodies stood up. They immediately hid behind the trees.
The roar was familiar to the three people. They had heard it countless times in the past few days. It was the roar of the Fire Dragon!
Dudian hid behind the tree and stared at the back. He saw a beautiful sun-like shadow rapidly approaching. It was the shape of the fire dragon.
However, the fire dragon seemed to be seriously injured. Half of its body was broken. It would occasionally land on the ground and use its feet to exert force instead of relying on the remaining half of its wings.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he thought of intercepting the alien fire dragon. But at this time, he suddenly saw two red dots approaching from the back of the alien fire dragon. The heat was low and it was only at the level of a pioneer.
However, how could a pioneer chase the alien fire dragon to escape? It was obvious that the other party deliberately suppressed the body heat!
Jason who was behind the big tree gave Dudian a look. Apparently, he also saw the alien fire dragon chasing after them.
Dudian gestured for them to stay still and not to attack.
At this time, the fire dragon was approaching in a straight line. Before they reached the forest, a burst of wind came from behind. It almost hit them.
The fire dragon’s body turned around and dodged the attack. However, another heat source quickly closed the distance. It launched a fierce attack as soon as it got close to the fire dragon.
At this time, the three of them could see the battle clearly with their naked eyes. The two heat source’s face was human and their body had been demonized. One of them looked like a giant crocodile. His face was elongated while the other had green curly hair, there were countless slender limbs under his body. They looked like centipedes but they were sharp like blades.
Dudian’s eyes moved as he saw the woman with green curly hair. He thought of the two children he had adopted in the giant wall of Sylvia. One of them was Gabriel and the other was Tekka. Tekka had green hair.
He had adopted them out of curiosity. At that time he hadn’t seen anyone with green hair. He thought that it was the exclusive hair color of some hidden families in the inner wall, however he hadn’t seen anyone with green hair since he had occupied the inner wall. Therefore he didn’t pay attention to Tekka. He thought that she was living on the edge of the outer wall and had been exposed to radiation all year round, he did not expect to see another person with green hair here.
However, he did not know if this person’s green hair was a transformation of the demon body, or if it was originally like this.
“Restrain it!”The man whose body was like an upright crocodile shouted and flew down. There was a pair of extremely short wings on his back. Compared to his fierce appearance, it looked a little cute. He rushed to the ground, he picked up the black spear that he had thrown earlier.
The green-haired woman twisted her body like a poisonous snake. The slender and sharp blades under her limbs waved, forcing the fire dragon alien to retreat repeatedly.
This fire dragon alien had a red flame on its surface, but there was a wisp of golden flame inside. It was actually an elite fire dragon alien whose combat strength was close to that of the upper abyss. At this moment, half of its body was broken, as if it had been cut off by something shoulder-length, the green-haired woman’s fierce attack forced it to retreat.
However, the green-haired woman didn’t dare to push too hard. Every time the fire dragon race attacked, she would retreat. She didn’t dare to be swept by the flames on its body.
