The crocodile short-winged man pulled out the black spear. He was about to turn around and attack when his body suddenly paused. He rushed out with the black spear towards the fire dragon race.
Dudian’s heart sank when he saw the man’s body stop. He knew that the three of them were most likely exposed!
Dudian turned to look at Zac and Jason. Jason was still focused on the battle. Zac looked at him as if he saw that he was exposed.
Dudian nodded to Zac and raised his hand.
Zac was surprised to see Dudian’s intention. At this time, Jason also noticed Dudian’s gesture. He was surprised and looked puzzled.
“If we don’t attack then we will die!”Dudian said in a low voice.
Zac and Jason’s face changed. The two of them dared to pursue the fire dragon. It was obvious that their strength was several times stronger than theirs. It was possible that they were from the upper abyss! It could be seen from their offensive that they were faster and fiercer than the previous orangutan instructor!
However, they were from the three inferior abyss. Even if it was a sneak attack, they were a bit timid.
“We can escape!”Zac made a hand gesture.
Dudian frowned slightly. Escaping was indeed a method. He wanted to see if he could kill the two men during the sneak attack. If he could do so, he might be able to send their bodies back to the god of war wall, in exchange for a chance to live!
After all, these two people were from the upper abyss. The higher-ups wouldn’t think that they were killed by him. Even if they thought that he was a deserter, they might be able to forgive him. If these two people had a strong background then he would send their bodies back.., perhaps they would be protected by the people behind them.
However, Zach and Jason had no intention to attack. They wouldn’t try their best to force them.
Without their help, it was too risky to rely on him and Aisha alone.
Dudian made a gesture. “Let’s wait and see.”

chapters.title: Chapter 945
chapters.content:
Chapter 945 – Chapter 935: Fear
Zasite and Jason looked at each other. They were reluctant but Dudian was the strongest. They couldn’t stop him since he insisted on staying.
Roar!
The roar was heard. The fire dragon was completely suppressed by the two of them. They were unable to escape from the encirclement of the two. They had new injuries and old injuries. The more they fought, the more tired they became.
The black spear in the croc-like short-winged man’s hand seemed to be unafraid of the fire dragon alien race’s flames. He waved his black spear and attacked fiercely, shaving the scales on the fire dragon alien race’s body by several inches. The Flames covered the black spear and extinguished in an instant, it was as if it had been absorbed by the Black Spear.
The green-haired woman seemed to have some misgivings. Although she cooperated with the croc-like short-winged man to restrain the fire dragon alien race, she did not dare to get close. She could not avoid the flames on the fire dragon alien race’s body in time.
Both of them had a tacit understanding and rich combat experience. They didn’t give the fire dragon any chance to break out of the encirclement.
Dudian looked at them for a moment. He sighed in his heart. The two of them were too stable. They didn’t advance at all. They didn’t give the fire dragon any chance to counterattack. If this went on the fire dragon would be exhausted to death!
They could join forces to kill but they chose to delay the war of attrition. The reason was obvious. The other side was holding back to prevent their sneak attack!
“Let’s Go!”Dudian looked at Zac and Jason helplessly.
Zac and Jason were relieved as they saw Dudian’s hand gesture. They were worried that Dudian would do things his own way. It wasn’t realistic to sit back and do nothing.
Both of them quietly lifted their feet and followed Dudian to leave.
“Eh?”The alligator short-winged man who was fighting with the fire dragon looked at the distant forest from the corner of his eyes. At this time, the fire dragon seemed to have noticed the flaw. It growled and rushed towards Dudian. It opened its mouth and spat out a thick flame.
The blazing flames were extremely fast, even faster than their bodies!
The alligator-shaped short-winged man’s expression changed slightly. The blazing flames spat out by the fire dragon were extremely destructive. Even he did not dare to be hit. Previously, he had been paying attention and was prepared to dodge when it had the premonition to open its mouth, however, at this moment, things happened suddenly. He hurriedly raised his hand and waved it. He spun his black spear like a windmill and countless spear shadows shot towards the blazing cannonball. With a bang, flames shot out in all directions!
The Flames were destroyed, and wisps of flames spread out. Some touched the croc-shaped short-winged man’s body and immediately burned up.
The croc-shaped short-winged man was very decisive. His demonized arm and sharp claws struck out, tearing down the places where the flames touched along with the skin and flesh. He threw the flames to the ground, and the flames fluttered without stopping, but they did not extinguish.
When he dug out the flames on his body, the croc-shaped short-winged man discovered that the fire dragon alien race had already taken the opportunity to charge forward. However, he did not run far before he was stopped by the green-haired woman on the other side. If it was not for the green-haired woman holding the line.., that attack just now might have allowed him to take the opportunity to escape.
“Damn it!”The croc-shaped short-winged man gritted his teeth. Enduring the intense pain on his body, he charged forward with his spear.
The intense battle continued for about ten minutes before the fire dragon finally exhausted its strength. It faced the sky and cried out in grief. It was pierced through the chest by the croc-shaped short-winged man with his spear. Fresh blood splattered and it fell to the ground. The green-haired woman and the croc-shaped short-winged man also looked a little miserable. One of them had half of his elegant curly hair burnt off and was emitting a burnt smell. It was very bad for his appearance. The other person’s body was covered in bloody holes, he was bleeding non-stop.
“He’s finally dead.”William let out a sigh. He felt tired, but he didn’t relax. He swooped down with his spear and pierced through the neck of the alien fire dragon, he cut off its head as well.
At this point, he finally felt relieved. He said to the green-haired woman who was slowly descending, “There was some movement in the forest. Did you notice it?”
“There were three people. They seemed to be from the Abyss.”Shaenema’s eyes were cold. “They should be deserters. Humph, I always meet such idiots in every war. They like to seek their own death!”
William’s lips curled into a cold smile, “It seems that they are still smart enough to retreat in time. I thought that they would ambush US and attack us. I was just waiting to suppress this alien drakonid, so I deliberately pretended to be injured and lured them to attack.”
SHAENEMA said coldly, “Are we going to get rid of these scum?”
“No need. They don’t need us to get rid of them. Don’t waste our strength.”William smiled lightly, “Don’t forget that they have other values. There are always idiots like them who like to fight for bait. They think they can grab a chance to survive, but they don’t know that they’re just a pathfinder for us.”
“That’s true.”Shaenema nodded, “Other than US officers of the Cross Legion, the others probably don’t know that their battle armor is equipped with special positioning devices and sight mirrors. Their every move is observed by the higher-ups, hoping that they will walk better and better. Free Pathfinder stones are much better than spending a lot of money to send people to explore lonely places every year.”
“This is called waste utilization.”William chuckled.
“Well, let’s not talk about this anymore. Let’s hurry up and move the body of the fire dragon alien back. We wanted to capture it alive, but unfortunately, with our strength, we can’t capture a golden-flame DRAKONID alive. Hopefully, this body can provide some value.”Shaenema sighed.
William nodded. He took out a string of rope from his small military bag and tied it to one of the fire dragon alien’s legs. This rope was completely black, like an iron chain. It made a clanging sound and was also like a rubber. It could actually stretch longer.., at this moment, the Fire Dragon’s leg was burning, but there was no sign of fire.
“Let’s go.”William grabbed the rope and dragged the fire dragon.
Shaenema nodded slightly. She untied her demon body and used her witcher’s sharp sword to lift the fire dragon’s head and followed behind William.
“Wait!”
Suddenly, Shaenema called out.
William looked back: “What’s Wrong?”
Shaenema looked at the head of the Fire Dragon. Her eyes were wide open. There was fear and fear in the depths of her eyes..
..
..
Whoosh!
The three of them followed the burn marks on the trees.
After running for more than half an hour, the three of them gradually stopped. Dudian looked back for a moment and sighed in relief: “It seems that they didn’t catch up.”
Zach and Jason looked at each other but didn’t find any trace of the two.
“Should we follow the trail of the Fire Dragon? What if we find their nest?”Zach looked at dudian, hoping that Dudian would change his mind.
Dudian had the same concern in his heart. Although he was deeply interested in the nest of the fire dragon but his life was more important. However, if they didn’t explore the nest of the fire dragon then they would have to wander alone outside the border to survive. But this wasn’t a long term plan. If they were unlucky and encountered something terrible then they would be directly killed and become rations.
The world was very big but it seemed that they couldn’t even accommodate three people.

chapters.title: Chapter 946
chapters.content:
Chapter 946 – : Chapter 936: Production
It seemed that it was the rainy season.
Light rain fell from the gray sky and fell on the forest and wasteland. Everything was covered in a clear shadow.
Dudian and the other two found a cave and killed the sleeping thorny-tailed tiger. They skinned it and cooked it. They ate as they looked at the rain outside the cave, they were lost in their own thoughts.
Dudian looked at the flickering flame of the bonfire. He was silent. He felt like he was back when he was a hunter hunting low-level monsters in the ruins outside the giant wall. However, this place was more hopeless than the ruins outside the giant wall, there was no hope because there was no home.
If a person didn’t have a home, he would be homeless.
People who were wandering usually didn’t talk much.
Dudian didn’t know how long he would have to stay outside the border to find hope. He suddenly thought that he should keep moving forward in a straight line. Maybe he would find a new place where humans lived.
However, the Earth was so big. How far and how long would he have to go?
In that boundless region, there were no humans. Monsters had lived for hundreds of years. What kind of terrifying existence would be born?
He sighed and suddenly heard a croak. He saw a toad crawling out of the cave. It looked like a half-year-old baby lying on the ground. Its mouth was slightly bulging and half of the insect’s legs and wings were exposed. It gently chewed, it slowly swallowed.
Then it slowly climbed in.
Blood splattered.
Zasite threw a stone and hit its head. Its body flew out and landed in the muddy rain outside the cave.
Dudian suddenly felt that they were very similar to the low rank magic frog. Would they accidentally enter a territory and be killed?
Peaceful coexistence was advocated by humans but no one could achieve it. Monsters didn’t have such a concept.
Rumble!
The sound of thunder echoed as the rolling thunder seemed to sweep over his head.
Dudian could feel the slight tremor as he sat in the cave. He looked at the sky outside the cave. The flash of white light seemed to be reflected in his eyes. Suddenly, his eyes lit up.
Lightning!
Dudian’s eyes were getting brighter and brighter. It was impossible to return to the god of war from the wall. But he could fly through the sky as long as he could avoid the detection of the Thunderbirds.
“As long as I master the Lightning I can go back!”Dudian’s heart was burning with Hope. He began to think carefully. Soon he came up with two methods. First, he would find an opportunity to lure the Thunderbirds away and then take the opportunity to sneak in! Second, he would create a set of insulation equipment or a conductive device to dissolve the attack of the Thunderbirds. In this way, he could completely block the attack of the Thunderbirds.
“I don’t know what the Thunder Bird feeds on…”Dudian looked at the drizzle outside the cave. He was lost in thought. The air above the clouds was thin. There shouldn’t be any other creatures living there, was the Thunder Bird looking for plankton on the clouds for food? Or other birds? Or lightning in nature?
He suddenly felt that it was necessary to investigate. But the premise was that it was best to create a set of device to neutralize the lightning.
This was a wasteland without any tools or materials. It was extremely difficult to create a conductive device out of thin air.
But in the absence of hope, even if it was impossible, it was worth trying!
Moreover, he was not an ordinary person. It was difficult to cut down trees without tools.
Thinking of this, he immediately recalled the knowledge on the super chip. He made tools and then used tools to upgrade the tools. It was equivalent to a person using natural materials to evolve from the primitive era to the steam machine era.
The rain slowly stopped.
The three of them came out of the cave. Dudian said to Zac and Jason: “Let’s Find a place where the distribution of monsters is weak. I have a way to go back.”
“A way to go back?”Zac and Jason were surprised as they looked at dudian.
Dudian nodded: “Yes, but the premise is to make a lot of tools. We need your cooperation and a suitable environment for us to live in for a long time. We will be able to go back in one or two years.”
Zach’s eyes lit up: “Is what you said true?”
“What method?”Jason asked.
“Fly back from the sky.”Dudian didn’t hide anything: “There are Thunderbirds in the sky above the god of war. So we need to make some tools to resist the attacks of the Thunderbirds.”
“Fly Back?”Zach and Jason looked at each other. The excitement in their eyes decreased, zac frowned: “It’s not possible. The Thunderbirds are distributed over the god of war’s wall. The number is unimaginable. Even the alien races outside the wall can’t invade.”
“That’s why we need the help of tools.”Dudian said: “I know the tools to resist lightning but I don’t know if I can make them.”
Both of them looked at dudian suspiciously. A tool to resist lightning? They had never heard of it.
However, they didn’t have a better way so they could only try.
“Are we still looking for the traces of the Fire Dragon?”Zach looked at the blackened trees which were wet by the rain. He could faintly see green insects crawling inside.
Dudian shook his head, “We have no choice but to look for the fire dragon. If they have intelligence then we can cooperate with them. But it is too risky. Even if they can communicate with others they may not sit down and negotiate with us. It is better not to contact them unless we have no choice. Otherwise we will be directly skinned and eaten because of the difference in race.”
“Yes.”Zach nodded. He had the same concern before.
“Then let’s Find a place.”Dudian turned around and took the lead.
The three of them headed deeper into the wilderness with Dudian as the leader.
They would judge the distribution of the monsters along the way. They would change their route and continue to move forward when the monsters were getting stronger.
After a few days, Dudian brought Aisha, Zac and Jason to a plain. There were wolf packs living on the plain but their physique was not high. Their vision was wide and there were no large monsters nearby, it was suitable for living.
The only problem was that there were no resources here. Stone and wood were very scarce.
However, Dudian saw the foundation of the old era buildings in the depths of the plain. Obviously, this area was once a civilized area!
The few of them used grass to weave tents in the low-lying areas of the plain. They found sticks and leaves from the nearby woods to build a nest. Then they picked a grass patch on the plain where there was less water. They dug deeper and dug for stone.

chapters.title: Chapter 947
chapters.content:
Chapter 947 – Chapter 937: Solitary Undeads
Although they didn’t have tools to dig the ground, but they were from the abyss. They could easily dig the ground with their demonized claws. What surprised Dudian was that Zac’s magic marks were not only strong in attack but also very good at drilling the ground. He was like a loach and in less than 10 minutes he was able to dig to a depth of 100 meters, he touched the rock layer deep in the mud layer.
“There is iron in these stones but they have rusted. They should be used by the people in the upper epoch to cast buildings and fixed them.”Jason said after looking at the concrete blocks.
“The people in the upper epoch are very intelligent. They feel that they are smarter than us.”Zac replied in order to avoid Jason from talking to himself.
Dudian frowned: “We have to move fast. We are not sure if there are any iron ores in this area. If there aren’t any then we have to move to another place.”
Jason stopped chatting and followed Zach to help him move the soil.
After a few hours, the three of them worked together to dig a 400-500 meter deep well. They were mining some impurities iron ore, low-grade copper ore and some other elements from the deepest layer of rock, they even mined an extremely small gold mine.
Although the output was low compared to some large mining areas that were rich in minerals, but for Dudian, it was barely enough.
He let Zaite and Jason continue to mine the ore while he dug another 20-meter deep pit. He used the ordinary stone to build walls around the pit to make an underground furnace.
Jason saw Dudian busy in the pit when he returned to the surface: “What is this for?”
“To refine iron ore.”
“Do you know how to refine iron ore?”
“Why else would you look for iron ore?”
“UH…”
Jason was choked by Dudian. He smiled but wasn’t angry. He was aware of Dudian’s character and didn’t care about it. He laughed: “You are right. Do you need my help?”
“Can you use stone to cast stone pots?”Dudian asked.
Jason thought for a moment: “It should be possible…”
“Then go and find firewood. The more the better.”Dudian said.
Jason helplessly coughed. He looked around the plain and sneaked towards the woods in the south.
After Dudian built the underground furnace and sealed all the holes in the surroundings, he looked at Zac and Jason who were sitting on the side: “You will start the fire and wash the ore.”
Zac looked at him curiously: “Have you smelted iron ore before?”
“No.”
“Then how do you know?”
“I’m smart.”
”…”
The short chat ended once again. Zac jumped down and picked up the firewood that Jason had found. He threw it to the bottom of the furnace and lit it. Dudian saw that Zac had filled the bottom of the furnace with firewood. The flame was very weak. He slightly shook his eyebrows: “Don’t you know how to light a fire?”
Zach was stunned: “Isn’t the fire already lit?”
“The fire is too small.”
“But the firewood is already filled.”
“The firewood is already filled. How can there be room for the flame to burn?”
Zach was stunned. Although he had never done this kind of work before but he understood what Dudian meant. He immediately took out half of the firewood and the flame increased.
Zach was a bit surprised. He shook his head: “I didn’t expect that there would be so many ways to do such simple things.”
Jason looked at the piles of minerals: “Do we need to wash the iron ore? But there aren’t so many sources of water…”
Dudian shook his head: “I’ll wash it. You can classify the minerals.”
Jason coughed: “How do I classify it?”
Dudian looked down and picked it up. He distinguished iron ore from copper ore and other minerals such as coal and oil sands.
Jason observed Dudian’s classification and quickly learned it. He followed the law and saw Dudian rubbing the sticky stone on the surface of the iron ore.
“Is this washing?”Jason was stunned.
Dudian slowly said: “It is a simple cleaning of the iron ore to prevent other trace elements from being added to it.”
Jason understood and also followed the example to clean up the iron ore.
Dudian waited for the temperature of the underground furnace to be about the same. He threw the cleaned iron ore into the furnace and covered it with a huge stone cover.
Jason took the initiative to pick up firewood when there wasn’t much firewood.
Dudian used the remaining stone to build a wall. He saw Dudian build a wall to surround the surroundings, he asked: “These stones won’t be able to stop the monster’s attack. Do you want to dig some harder granite?”
Dudian glanced at him: “This is to shelter from the rain.”
Zach was stunned for a moment. He decided not to take the initiative to talk to dudian.
Dudian had just finished building the wall when he saw Zach’s figure come back. There was no firewood in his hand but he was holding a… Human Figure?
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he looked at the figure.
Soon he saw that Jason was holding a human but it was an infected zombie.
Jason ran all the way to Dudian and threw the female zombie to the ground. She looked to be in her twenties but her mouth was cracked and her fangs were exposed, her lips couldn’t be closed. Her face was twisted and her eyes were red. There was no rational light in her eyes.
Zac noticed the UNDEADS and quickly jumped up: “Undeads? There are undeads here?”
Dudian immediately said: “You should start the fire. Once the temperature drops then it will be difficult to raise the temperature.”
Zac looked at him. In the end he turned back to the underground furnace and continued to start the fire.
Dudian squatted down to look at the clothes of the undeads. The clothes were torn and stained with dried brown blood. The breasts of the undeads were exposed but the skin was wrinkled, she was as black as an African but she wasn’t an African but an Asian.
Dudian carefully identified the clothes for a moment before he recognized that they were from the old era. His heart sank, he looked at Jason: “They are undeads from the previous era. I guess this land is the same as the wall of God of war. There are monsters and undeads everywhere. There are also fire dragons.”
“When we attacked the god of war wall, I found that those fire dragons seemed to be able to command monsters. could they be the rulers of this land?”Jason asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 948
chapters.content:
Chapter 948 – Chapter 938: Flaming Soul Crystal
“I guess so.”Dudian didn’t deny it. He had noticed that the fire dragon seemed to be the mastermind behind the attack on the god of war’s wall, he firmly believed that the fire dragon’s intelligence wasn’t inferior to that of humans!
However, how could there be such a powerful race on Earth in just 300 years?
Could it be the alien race that was left on earth?
If the fire dragon alien race was an alien race, then what was the troll alien race? And what was the “God”of the Aragami?
Dudian felt that these alien races should not be on the same level as the Aragami. Although he had never seen the power of the Aragami, but after he controlled Sylvia he had seen a lot of descriptions from the classical materials, the power of the Aragami was beyond the Abyss and was regarded as a ‘god’!
An Aragami’s corpse hidden in the wall could deter extremely dangerous things. This was something that the alien races could never do.
“Since there are undeads here, do you think there will be people living here?”Jason’s eyes looked at dudian.
“Maybe. If we can find a future generation of undeads then we can prove whether there are survivors here or not.”Dudian didn’t raise his head but used his hands to pinch the arm, shoulder and other parts of the undeads, he felt the hardness of the bones. They had evolved to be more powerful. He estimated that they had the combat strength of pioneer level. If there were no parasitic soul worms then maybe they would become king undeads.
“How do you know that she is an undead from the previous era?”Jason looked at him curiously. He felt that Dudian seemed to know a lot of things that he didn’t know. This was the reason why he remained humble.
“This dress is from the previous era.”Dudian didn’t hide it. It wasn’t a secret.
“Do you recognize the clothes from the previous era?”Jason was surprised. He thought that Dudian had used some other method to distinguish it.
“Haven’t you studied history?”Dudian glanced at him, “There is always a benefit to reading more.”
Jason smiled, “I don’t have time to read. I have time to think about how to hunt monsters. No matter how much I read, when I fight with monsters, I still have to rely on my fists!”
“That’s because your vision is not long enough.”
Jason was speechless but he felt that what Dudian said made sense. At least everything they did now needed to rely on Dudian’s knowledge. Even if they were from the abyss.., they didn’t understand the knowledge of smelting iron ore that an ordinary civilian could grasp. Although violence was the most direct way to solve problems, there were many problems that violence couldn’t solve.
“If we meet other undeads and they don’t have clothes on, how can we distinguish them?”Jason asked modestly. This was a very critical problem. Only a few undeads had clothes covering their bodies, most undeads had long been in years of combat and jungle life. They would wear off their clothes and rely on their tough skin to resist external attacks like beasts.
“It depends on the feeling.”Dudian interrupted.
”…”
Jason was silent for a moment. He suddenly thought of something. He grabbed the head of the female undeads and handed it to dudian: “Take a look. What is in its head?”
“Cold crystal?”
“Cold crystal? Are you talking about the Soul Crystal?”
“Yes.”
“Look at the soul crystal in its head.”Jason said in a mysterious manner.
Dudian’s heart was moved as he saw Jason’s appearance. His nails were slightly protruding. The color of his transparent calcareous nails suddenly turned black like a sharp dagger. He cut the head open, a large amount of red jam-like substance flowed out of the head. It emitted a strong fishy smell and was like magma. It was boiling hot. When it dripped onto Dudian’s palm, it felt as hot as boiling water!
Dudian frowned as he shook off the blood from his palm. He picked up the hair on his head and shook it. The blood flowed out of the cut and fell on the weeds, it seemed to be corroded.
Patter!
A blood red crystal fell down from his head along with the blood. The water in the blood was evaporated by the rose-like blood red crystal.
“Soul Crystal?”Dudian’s pupils shrank.
The diamond-shaped surface and size of the blood-red crystal was exactly the same as the cold crystal he had seen!
However, the color of the two crystals was very different. The cold crystal was transparent and had a touch of light blue. However, this one was completely blood-red and was as hot as a flame.
“This soul crystal is completely different from the ones we have seen before. The soul crystals we have seen are as cold as ice. But this one is as hot as fire. Do you think the soul crystals in the heads of other undeads are the same?”Jason’s eyes moved away from the blood-red crystal, he stared at Dudian.
Dudian was in a daze as if he didn’t hear Jason’s words. After a long time he slowly recovered. He saw that the temperature of the blood flowing from the ground had gradually decreased. It was not as hot as before but it was gradually returning to normal temperature, this phenomenon was the same as when he took out the cold crystal from the head of the undeads. When there was no soul crystal, the body and brain tissues of the undeads would gradually return to normal temperature.
“One ice, one fire…”Dudian’s mind was in a mess. He faintly felt that he had grasped some clues that led to the unknown and the most mysterious secret.
Jason saw that Dudian was at a loss and finally felt that they were equal. He bitterly smiled in his heart. Suddenly he had an idea and asked: “What do you think will happen if we absorb this thing?”
“Absorb?”Dudian was silent for a moment: “I don’t know, but I think we will die miserably.”
Jason sighed: “That’s true. One is extremely cold and the other is extremely hot. The body will definitely not be able to endure the two extreme energies. But do you think we have a country here?”
Dudian knew what he meant. When he saw the red soul crystals, his mind sketched out a brand new world map. There were cold crystal undeads in the territory of God’s kingdom. There might be new countries outside the border, there might be soul crystals of fire. There might be other energy-type soul crystals in other places. Perhaps each energy-type soul crystal was controlled by a country!
If that was the case, then the size of the human forces in the post-disaster world was beyond his imagination!
Originally in his imagination, the post-disaster human forces were curled up in a corner of the world. At first he thought that the giant wall was the gathering place of the last survivors in the world. Later he found out about the empire. But now he suddenly found out that.., there might be other countries outside!
He didn’t know if his guess was correct. But the flame soul crystal and the Fire Dragon’s alien race really made his imagination run wild.
“It would be good if I could see the whole picture of the world at a glance…”Dudian sighed in his heart. It was like walking in the endless darkness. Although it was exciting, but there was also some fatigue.
“If I find other undeads, I will bring them back for you to identify.”Jason saw that Dudian had nothing to say. He didn’t waste any more time. He stood up and went back to the forest.
Dudian picked up the flame soul crystal from the blood. The temperature of the soul crystal was not as strong as before. He suddenly thought of something. He raised the Soul Crystal and looked at the Sun, the color of the soul crystal was getting more and more beautiful. But in the depths of the blood red soul crystal there seemed to be a shadow. It was like a small worm that was bent and fixed inside.
“Sure enough…”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He thought for a moment and used the cleaver to cut the soul crystal.
The hardness of the soul crystal was extremely high. It was comparable to a diamond. But the sharpness of the cleaver was even greater. It was cut in half by the friction saw. The blood like mucus was flowing out, there was an ant-sized worm in the mucus. It seemed to be dead. It was motionless as the blood-red mucus flowed out.
Dudian used his fingernails to pick it up. He looked at it. It was a very small worm. There was nothing special about it.
He repeatedly observed it but couldn’t find anything unusual. He had to give up.
“There might be such a little bug in other soul crystals. But how could it be dead? Is it because I saw the soul crystal? Or… is it just an embryo?” Dudian suddenly felt a chill down his spine.
Why were these undeads born?
If the virus that infected them was deliberately created, then what was the purpose?
Dudian was immersed in his thoughts for a long time. It wasn’t until Zach called him for the third time that he came back to his senses. The temperature of the furnace was enough. The iron ore inside had shown signs of melting.
Dudian immediately put away his thoughts and jumped to the underground furnace. He checked the degree of smelting of iron ore. Then he prepared the stone pot, stone hammer and other tools to forge the first iron.
Dudian didn’t have high requirements for the first iron. It would be enough if the purity of the iron could reach the level of a farmer’s hoe. By then he would be able to greatly improve the purity of the subsequent iron.
Time flew by and three days passed in the blink of an eye.
The underground furnace was constantly burning. A complete set of large iron tools and several sets of iron models had been smelted. The progress was very fast.
In the past three days, Jason had brought back six undeads while he was collecting firewood. All of them were naked and their bodies were mutated. Some of the undeads were hard to identify as ‘human’. Sharp bone spikes protruded from their bodies, there were bulging teeth and monster-like hair. Some of them even had seven or eight eyeballs on their faces. It was very frightening.
Even Dudian couldn’t identify whether the undeads were from the upper epoch or survivors of the disaster.
The soul crystals that were cut out from the head of the undeads were all red soul crystals.
Dudian caught two small monsters on the plain in his spare time. He used surgery to embed the soul crystals into their bodies. Through experiments, Dudian found that there was no effect if the soul crystals were directly embedded into the bodies of the monsters, on the contrary, the embedded parts would gradually rot, die and grow malignant tumors.
So he put the dead unknown insect into the body of the small monster. It didn’t take long before the body of the small monster changed and its physique greatly improved.
When Dudian killed the small monster, he found that the ordinary small monster had turned into a named monster. There were parasitic soul worms in its body!
This shocking discovery surprised Dudian. He didn’t expect that the small thing in the soul crystal was actually the larva of the parasitic soul worm!
He suddenly thought of the records in the Atlas of the Empire. He felt cold all over his body. It was obvious that the Kingdom of God had long grasped this secret. The monsters with magic marks were known as ‘named monsters’. Why were they called ‘Named Monsters’? The ‘named monsters’seemed to tell the reason.
Maybe these monsters were created by the experiments of the Kingdom of God. They were given new lives and new names.
Why did God’s kingdom create these monsters?
Was it just to use these things to nurture magic marks warriors?
Dudian thought of the Silvia’s witcher family. They were the fighters before the era of magic marks warriors. They used the bodies of monsters to create half-human and half-demon monsters! However, this experiment gradually came to an end. It retired from the stage of history. It was replaced by the glorious and more popular magic marks warrior evolution method!
The current Abyss and even the Lord of the Abyss were all relying on magic marks!
But what about the king above the abyss?
Dudian suddenly felt a bit confused. He didn’t know if the end of his method of using magic marks to evolve would be just to become the Lord of the Abyss!
Would this be a wrong path?
He felt that his thoughts were very messy. There were too many things that he didn’t understand. So many of his conjectures were very likely to be wrong or there were other explanations.
He slowly gave up on the speculation and continued to invest in industrial manufacturing.
The purification of iron ore was very smooth. Many copper ores were also refined and made into brass and copper wire. Copper wire was the main material of electrical wires.
On the seventh day when everything was going smoothly, an accident suddenly happened.
In the early morning, Zaite was searching for ore underground. Jason was collecting firewood. Dudian forged the iron into utensils. As they were busy, a figure suddenly came from the end of the plain.
It was a human figure.
Dudian was stunned as he looked up.
He had never thought that he would see other humans on this plain — unless it was the pursuers of the border guards.
But there was a real human standing in front of him. It was a girl who was about fourteen or fifteen years old. She was wearing a primitive linen dress but her skin was white. She had bright eyes and white teeth. She looked very clean and beautiful.
Her hair was tied into a ponytail. She looked lively and cute. At the moment she was also surprised as she looked at Dudian and the other two.
“You, you…”the girl looked at Dudian and the other two.
Dudian was startled as he heard her words. He didn’t expect that he would be able to hear her. He didn’t expect that she would speak the common language of the giant wall. Did she come from the god of War? !
Jason and Zach rushed to Dudian’s side. They were stunned as they looked at the girl.

chapters.title: Chapter 949
chapters.content:
Chapter 949 – Chapter 939: Attack
“Human, human?”Zach was stunned. Although he had imagined that there might be humans living in the isolated land outside the border, he didn’t expect to meet them here. Moreover, it was so sudden that he wasn’t prepared at all.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he saw the strength of the girl’s heat source. She was only at the pioneer level but there was no killing Aura from her body. It was as if she was a little girl from an ordinary family.
Whoosh!
Jason’s figure flashed and blocked the girl’s path of retreat: “Who Are You? Why are you here?”
The girl didn’t seem to feel his killing intent. She looked at him in surprise: “Who Are You? Why are you here?”
“Are you from the Empire?”Jason frowned as he noticed her words.
“Empire?”The girl was stunned for a moment. She raised her hand and pointed at the direction where Dudian and others came from: “Are you referring to the Shenluo Empire on the other side of the Wall?”
“Shenluo Empire?”Dudian’s heart skipped a beat. was this the name of the Shenluo Empire?
Jason stared at her: “That’s right. Where did you come from?”
The girl seemed to ignore his question. She curiously asked: “How did you come over? Are you the vanguard sent by the Shenluo Empire to explore?”
“You haven’t answered my question!”Jason coldly replied.
Zac saw that he looked like he was facing a great enemy and chuckled, “Jason, don’t be so nervous. Don’t scare the little girl.”
Jason’s expression did not change and he said coldly, “You better not be careless. Don’t forget what kind of place this is. Do you really think that ordinary people can survive here?”
Zac returned to his usual gentle and elegant demeanor and smiled, “Nothing is impossible. She shouldn’t be living here alone, right?”He then asked the girl.
The young girl giggled and said, “That’s right. I live here with my father. Many years ago, when I was still very young, my father brought me here from the Shenluo Empire and lived here.”
“With your father? Many years ago?”Jason frowned. “So, there are only you and your father here? How did you two get here? Why are you living here?”
The girl was slightly dissatisfied with his questioning attitude. She frowned slightly, but she still answered, “I have to ask my father about this. By the way, my father is very powerful. As long as you don’t provoke those fire drakonids, the monsters here can only hurt him.”
Jason snorted coldly. He didn’t need you to say it. He knew that your father must be very powerful to be able to live here for so many years.
“Fire DRAKONIDS, are you referring to those fire dragon alien races?”Zahit immediately asked, “Do you know where they live?”
“You want to look for them?”The young girl looked at him strangely, she said, “Let me give you a piece of advice. Don’t Go South. That is their gathering place. If you encounter them, it will only be a dead end. Even my father wouldn’t dare to easily go there.”
Jason stared at her, “You better answer my question. Why do you live here? Since your father is so strong, why did you leave the Shenluo Empire and come here?”? “If you don’t say it, I don’t mind using force. Although I know that your strength might not be inferior to ours, the three of US combined have some confidence in keeping you here.”
“Hey Hey.”Zach said: “Don’t go too far.”
He looked at Dudian and hoped that he would persuade her.
Dudian looked at the girl and didn’t say anything. He felt that there was something wrong with the girl. Jason’s words reminded him that there was a high possibility that the girl was hiding the intensity of the heat source. Maybe it was the abyss or even the middle.., even the upper abyss. The three of them might not be her opponent. It was obvious from her fearless attitude.
Dudian would never believe that she was innocent and didn’t know fear.
“How can you be so fierce!”The girl frowned as she heard Jason’s words. However she knew that Jason could do as he said, feeling wronged, she said, “Father said that there are no good people in the Shenluo Empire, so he brought me to escape outside the wall. I thought that I would meet new humans here, but in the end, the fire drakonids here are not easy to deal with, so we can only live here.”
Jason said coldly, “If you still don’t tell the truth, don’t blame me for forcing you!”
“I’m telling the truth!”The girl bit her lips slightly, “What father said is indeed correct. None of you people from the Shenluo Empire are good people! “If you dare to bully me, my father will not let you off. This area is my family’s territory. He knows that I’m out to play. If I don’t return on time, he will come out to look for me. When that time comes, he will definitely find you!”
“This place is very big. We Can Fly far away. You Don’t have to scare me.”Jason snorted coldly.
“You!”The girl looked at him in anger.
Zach saw that the atmosphere was a bit stiff, he quickly said: “Jason, don’t be so fierce. Didn’t she say that her father is here? Should we go and see her father? They have lived here for so long. Maybe they can show us the way. If you offend her then we will be able to escape. Don’t tell me that we will be wandering outside the border for the rest of Our Lives?”
Jason frowned as he looked at dudian.
Dudian was silent. In fact, he was thinking about this point. If they directly captured the girl then the relationship would be completely strained. It would extinguish the hope that they had seen with great difficulty. But if they followed the girl to see her father as Zachet had said. If her father’s strength was stronger than the three of them combined then they would be the weak party.
Moreover, they weren’t sure whether the “Father”she said was true or not. If they went back with her, the strong people of the entire race would be waiting for them.
“Dudian, you decide.”Zach handed the idea to Dudian.
The girl saw that the Silent Dudian was the leader of the three. She curiously looked at Dudian and then looked at Haisha who was next to Dudian.
“My partner has offended you. I hope you can forgive him.”Dudian thought for a moment and slowly said, “I have a few questions to ask you. I hope you can tell us the truth.”
The girl saw that Dudian’s attitude was calm. She nodded and said: “You can ask. I will tell you the truth as long as you don’t hurt me.”
“What level is your true strength?”Dudian stared at her.
The girl pouted. She didn’t expect that Dudian’s question was more sharp than Jason’s but she had agreed, she reluctantly said: “I don’t know. But I heard from my father that I should be at the ‘abyss’level of the god Luo Empire.”
“Abyss? !”
Zach and Jason’s pupils shrank. Although they had expected it but they didn’t expect that the girl in front of them was as strong as them!
Dudian’s eyes narrowed: “There are several levels of the abyss. which level are you at?”
“Several levels?”The girl was surprised: “Really?”
Dudian stared at her for a moment. He couldn’t tell if she was lying or not. He wasn’t sure so he skipped the question and continued to interrogate her. Although what he was doing now was to interrogate her but at least his face was acceptable, he asked again: “What Level is your father?”
The girl shook her head, “I don’t know. My father is more powerful than me. He can kill many monsters that I can’t defeat. If the abyss is divided into several levels then maybe my father is the most powerful one!”
Dudian was silent.
He knew that her father was the Lord of the Abyss! So the girl shouldn’t be lying.
Zach and Jason looked at each other with complicated expressions. The girl was an abyss but her father was ‘very powerful’, otherwise they wouldn’t be able to stay here if they captured the girl.
After a short silence dudian asked a few more questions.
“What’s Your Name?”
“My name is Dana. Dad said that this is a flower that will never wither.”
“What do you live on?”
“We hunt monsters and eat some plants.”
“What do you do to improve your strength?”
“Dad said that these insects are called soul worms. Are you the same?”
Dudian didn’t answer but stared at her: “Have you eaten human flesh?”
Diana shook her head: “How is it possible? There are monsters here. We can’t eat human flesh like corpses. Dad said that there is a virus in their flesh.”
Dudian gently nodded: “Is your home far from here? We want to visit your father.”
Daina smiled: “It’s not far. I can lead the way. It has been a long time since I met the people from the god Luo Empire. I will be happy to see you.”
“I hope so.”Dudian smiled as he picked up the luggage and backpack. He looked at Zac and Jason: “You should pack up and prepare to leave.”
Zac and Jason were stunned. They didn’t expect that dudian would make such a quick decision. Jason opened his mouth but hesitated. He knew that Zac was leaning towards the front, so it was useless for him to say it.
“Should we go now?”Zach saw that Dudian was ready to leave. He was stunned: “Don’t we need to pack up the things here?”
“It’s not too late to pack up after we come back.”Dudian said as he picked up his luggage and walked towards Daina.
Zach was speechless. He wanted to say that it wasn’t easy to burn the underground furnace to such a high temperature but he saw that Dudian was already in front of Daina. He couldn’t wait and knew that it was useless to say it, he picked up his luggage and backpack. As he was running to catch up to Dudian, he saw a cold light flash past. Dudian smiled as he walked towards Daina. He threw out his cleaver, he cut off Daina’s body.
He cut her in half!
The beautiful girl fell to the ground. There was a bit of shock on her face.
“Go!”Dudian had already thrown away his luggage and entered the magic body.
Whoosh!
Daina’s body was broken into two pieces. She hit the ground and her body slid forward. The lower half of her body was pierced by the sharp blades and instantly shattered into palm-sized pieces of flesh.
Zach and Jason couldn’t react to the sudden change. However Jason’s reaction was faster than Zach’s. He rushed into the magic body and quickly crawled on the ground like a gecko, the sharp thorns on her body pierced through Dinah’s abdomen. She fell to the ground and screamed in pain.
Dudian quickly went forward. The black sticky substance on the arm of the magic blade retreated like the tide. He punched out and hit Dinah’s temple. The scream stopped and she fainted.
“Go!”
Dudian turned around and picked up his luggage. He took Aisha and ran along the plain.
Jason grabbed Diana’s upper body and quickly crawled on his hands and feet.
Zac was the last to react. He was stunned for a moment before he picked up his luggage and followed.
They had run for four to five hours and were already two to three hundred kilometers away from the iron-smelting plain. They had met many monsters along the way but most of them were pioneer level monsters. They had only met two abyss level monsters and were quickly killed by the three of them.
The three of them stopped at a peak that looked like an extinct volcano. Dudian threw his luggage aside and sat down to rest.
Zach and Jason gasped for breath. Zach immediately shouted: “Why did you kill her? Did she say something wrong?”
Jason sat opposite to Dudian. Although he knew that Dudian wouldn’t hurt him but Dudian’s sudden attack on Dina had left a shadow in his heart. He looked at Dudian in confusion, he was waiting for his explanation.
“She lied.”Dudian said after his breathing gradually calmed down: “She said that her home is not far from here. If that’s the case, we have been here for seven or eight days. They should have noticed.”
Zach was stunned: “Because of this reason?”
Dudian shook his head and looked at him: “The power in her body is very strange. She didn’t just rely on magic marks. She suddenly appeared here. I think she should have known about our existence and come here.”
“This is all your speculation!”Zac couldn’t help but be angry.
Jason quietly looked at dudian: “What else do you know?”
Dudian looked at him in silence.
“What else?”Zac looked at Dudian anxiously.
Dudian’s eyes fell on half of Daina’s body: “Strip her naked and wake her up.”
“You!”Zaite stared at him.
Jason’s eyes moved. He used the witcher to cut open Daina’s clothes and put her body on a dark rock.

chapters.title: Chapter 950
chapters.content:
Chapter 950 – Chapter 940: Double Magic Marks
The girl’s body was as white as jade, as smooth as silk, emitting a charming smell. However, in the middle of her chest, there was a dark red centipede-like mark, which looked like a magic mark but was different from a magic mark.
The magic mark protruded slightly on the skin, like a burn scar. It was very smooth and had no pores. However, her mark was like a birthmark, perfectly fitting with the skin, as if it was painted on it.
Zach went up to observe for a moment and asked: “Is there anything strange?”Although he saw that Diana’s marks were strange, but it was a bit far-fetched to attack her.
“Is this the source of her strength? It is indeed different from ours.”Jason carefully observed for a moment and asked Dudian: “Wake her up?”
Dudian nodded.
“Should we break her arm first?”
“Of course.”
Zach saw that Dudian and Jason were discussing like butchers. It seemed that there wasn’t a beautiful girl in front of them but a domesticated beast. He couldn’t help but look at the two of them, but he didn’t stop them.
Although he thought that he was a gentleman, but since they were enemies at the moment, he naturally had to guard against Diana’s sneak attack.
Jason gave special envoy Zassi a look and said, “You break her arm. I will seal the back of her neck to prevent her from resisting.”
Zassi sighed. After Jason pressed his witcher on Dinah’s throat, he picked up his witcher’s saber and stepped forward. With two swooshing sounds, blood burst out and two white jade arms fell down, blood continued to flow.
“Ah!”Dina screamed in pain as she woke up.
She opened her eyes and saw the knife on her throat. It was filled with the smell of slaughter.
Her face was pale. She turned to look at Jason who was holding the knife. She looked at Zach who was standing by the side. Her eyes fell on Dudian who was deep in thought.
“Why… Why did you do this to me?”Diana asked in a trembling voice.
“Why did you lie?”Dudian asked back.
Diana clenched her teeth: “I didn’t.”
“You said that you came to live here when you were very young. You ate monster corpses and plants. Why is your body so clean? Why are your teeth so neat?”Dudian stared at her.
Zach and Jason were stunned. They noticed that Diana’s body was as white as a princess. Even a well-maintained noble lady might not be as white as her skin. The teeth that Dudian mentioned made them surprised.
The toughness of the monster’s flesh was extraordinary. It was impossible to cook it in the wilderness. At most, it would be cooked by fire. The meat was usually very tough, if one grew up eating such meat, their teeth would naturally become sharp.
Tears welled up in Diana’s eyes, “Because of this?”? “My father found a water source underground. I can wash my body every day. When I was young, I ate plants and the meat of small monsters. At that time, I had the ability to hunt small monsters. It wouldn’t affect the growth of my teeth.”
“Of course I have thought that since you are living here you must have control over the water source. But even so you can’t wash your body every day.”Dudian slowly said, “The radiation concentration here has penetrated hundreds of meters deep underground. Even the abyss can’t resist the erosion of the body. You Can’t use the water here to wash your body every day. If so, your body would have long grown radiation spots as ugly as the scalp of a wild dog.”
Daina bit her lips: “My father made a set of equipment to filter the water. We use clean water. Do you want to kill me because of this? What did I do wrong?”
Zach frowned as he saw her aggrieved look: “Is it because of this?”
Dudian’s eyes turned cold: “Haven’t You Seen a woman? Do you believe what she says? Do you know how difficult it is to make a set of equipment to filter the water?”
Zach’s face turned ugly as he didn’t say anything.
Dudian didn’t care about the resentment in his heart, he continued to talk to Diana: “This is just one of the doubts. Second, you said that your house is not far from here. I don’t know how far you think ‘not far’is. At least I didn’t see any traces of people living or walking around here! “Thirdly, when I asked you if you ate human flesh, your body’s reaction was obviously a little different. I don’t know if you were scared by the ‘eating human flesh’or if I was right. I Can’t guess, but this is enough to make me pay attention and become a knot in my heart
“Fourthly, it’s not only the power of magic marks in your body, right? “I don’t know how your father smuggled you out of the god of war’s wall, but he probably doesn’t have the ability to bring too many things. In this wilderness, he has nothing. It’s very difficult to create some tools out of thin air, unless your father is a very smart person who is good at research.”
Dinah’s pretty face turned pale, she said, “I’m really not lying. We live underground, so you can’t see us. When you asked me if I ate human flesh, I was shocked. I thought you were going to eat me, so I was a little nervous. “As for what you said about my body, other than the magic marks, there are other powers. Indeed, my father has injected some strange things into my body. I don’t know what it is, but I really don’t have the intention to lie to you. You didn’t ask this, and I don’t know how you know…”
The more she spoke, the more aggrieved she became. Tears welled up in her eyes.
Zaite didn’t speak and didn’t defend her. Jason asked Dudian: “Are we really wrong?”
“Maybe.”Dudian didn’t deny it, indifferently he said: “It is possible that what she said is true. Maybe I am too suspicious. But in any case, my suspicions are enough to make me act. I believe that torture is more than interrogation. Even if I miss the opportunity to make friends with her father! On the other hand, if we take the risk to go, who knows what will be waiting for us?”
“Are you so sure that they have eaten too many monsters here? Don’t they want to eat human flesh?”
“Or is it really just her and her father who are waiting for us? And not a group of survivors living alone in this foreign land?”
Zaite who had been silent all this time said in a low voice: “So you are planning to kill her based on your own guess?”
“Are you really going to wait for us to fall into the trap and expose her flaws?”Dudian felt his dissatisfaction but his heart was even more dissatisfied, he asked: “She can live here and dare to wander around alone. Do you believe that she is brainless? If she deliberately approached us, how would she expose her flaws?”
Zac was silent and didn’t speak again.
Jason saw that there was a gap in his heart and quickly tried to persuade him, “Dudian is right. Although there is no evidence, I think she is not so simple. It is always right to be cautious.”
Zac shook his head slightly, “I know. I just think that we might have missed our last chance to live because of his caution! “If what she said is true then we will be friends with her father and cooperate with each other. Maybe we can learn from her father how to sneak back to the god of war wall. That is the hope that we have finally met!”
“Hope is always tempting. But when you see Hope, you have been infected!”Dudian’s face was cold, “Everyone who came here is not a good person. Don’t you have the blood of the same kind in your hands?”? “No one wants to die. It is not easy to live. If we were to fall into the trap and die, then the innocent people who died in our hands would have died in vain.”
“What do you think we should do now?”Zach suppressed his anger and stared at Dudian.
“The hostage is here. Of course we want her to confess.”Dudian said in a cold tone: “After we open her mouth we will know the information we want. If what she said is true then we can achieve our goal. Who said that we have to be better with her father in order to get the method to smuggle back from her father?”? If you can kill one then why can’t you kill two?”
Zach and Jason were shocked as they looked at dudian. They didn’t expect that his idea would be so crazy!
“Didn’t you hear her say that her father is much stronger than her? It is very likely that he is the lord of the Abyss!”Zach couldn’t help but angrily say.
Dudian indifferently said: “So what if he is the Lord of the Abyss? He is indeed stronger than us in a head on fight. But now he is in the open and we are in the dark. Who asked you to foolishly fight head on?”? A seven or eight year old child was holding a dagger. He could stab the enemy’s throat and kill an adult who was several times stronger than him. Do you need me to teach you this principle?”
Zaite slightly choked, he clenched his teeth: “Of course I know to rely on sneak attacks. But the difference in strength is too great! Although there is a big difference in strength between children and adults but they are only one dagger away from each other! What should we use to make up the gap between us and the Lord of the Abyss? What kind of trap can kill the Lord of the Abyss?”
Jason nodded, “It is true that metal weapons have great lethality to ordinary people but they have no effect on the abyss. In the end, there is a limit to weapons. No matter how tough the material is, the blade may not be comparable to the claws of some high-level monsters. No matter how we arrange or sneak attack, in the end we will have to fight in close combat. At most we will be able to seize the opportunity. But the gap between the Lord of the Abyss and US is too big…”
Dudian shook his head as he felt that their thoughts were very rigid, “Of course I know the limitations of weapons. Even gunpowder can not hurt the abyss. But don’t forget that there is one thing that people are afraid of no matter how strong they are.”
“What?”Jason was curious.
“Virus.”Dudian said: “The virus has been raging in this land for hundreds of years. No one can resist it. Let alone the Abyss. I think even kings will avoid it!”
Zach and Jason were stunned. Zach frowned: “But if he is infected then it will be more dangerous for us. How are we going to get the clues from him?”
Dudian shook his head: “We will talk about it later. Let’s think about how to pry her mouth.”
Zach and Jason looked at each other. They were suspicious as they saw that Dudian seemed to be confident. However they could only continue to believe in Dudian. They were in the same boat.
“You, you evil people!”Daina’s face turned white as she heard the three’s unbridled talk. She was angry and angry, “Kill me. I will never tell you about my father. When my father finds you he will definitely kill you!”
“Who will interrogate her?”Dudian looked at Jason and Zach.
Jason said: “I will go first. I have been in prison before so I know a bit about interrogation methods.”
Dudian looked at him and nodded.
“How about we remove her magic marks first?”Jason asked.
Dudian pondered for a moment and nodded: “Yes, I want to study it.”He raised his arm. His fingernails suddenly protruded out. The color of his fingernails turned dark. He pointed at the marks on Diana’s chest.
Blood spurted out as Dudian grabbed the dark red centipede-like marks. There was a meat sack in the middle of the meat sack. There was a slit in the middle of the meat sack which divided the meat sack into two. There were two different shapes of soul worms curled up inside.
Dudian had long seen the strange situation of Diana through his X-ray vision. The two soul worms were in different meat sacs. One was extremely cold and extremely cold while the other was as hot as fire.
Dinah screamed out. She shook her head and tried to struggle but she didn’t dare to resist because of the sharp blade hanging on her neck. Her hands were cut off and her body was like a human stick.
“I’ll leave it to you.”Dudian grabbed the flesh sacs and went back to the peak. Zac looked at Dudian and then looked at Dinah to supervise her so as not to hurt her.
Although he was dissatisfied with Dudian’s attack on Daina because of guesses but since things had come to this point he could only choose one path.
“Two types of soul worms?”Dudian held the blood sack in his hand, “Could it be that one is the magic marks inside the god of war and the other is the magic marks outside the giant wall? The two types of soul worms can co-exist. In other words, she has two types of magic marks…”
Dudian had seen this point before he launched a sneak attack on Diana. If it was a frontal attack, he felt that he was not confident in dealing with her. In fact, the three of them might be killed by her.
It was because of this speculation that he couldn’t be sure that she had malicious intentions towards them. Otherwise, she would have directly attacked them.
However, who could tell the truth? Dudian would rather be a villain. Even if Diana was an innocent little girl and was kind enough to invite them home as guests.., but the three of them had killed her like bandits. He had no choice but to do so.
There was too much blood in his hands. He didn’t care about more sins. After all, God’s eyes weren’t good so he wouldn’t punish a villain like him.

chapters.title: Chapter 951
chapters.content:
Chapter 951 – Chapter 941: Mistakes
Pain, threats, intimidation..
Jason had many methods of torture, and they were very professional. He tried all kinds of torture. He knew that pain alone was not enough to make Dinah yield, so he chose to find Dinah’s weakness through all kinds of methods — what she was afraid of.
Dinah did not live up to her abyss-level identity. Her willpower was exceptionally strong. Not only did she not confess, she did not even beg for mercy.
However, Jason’s methods were obviously not limited to these. He strangled Dinah’s sleep and weakened her willpower.
The interrogation wasn’t done overnight. After staying on the peak of the extinct volcano for a day, Dudian moved his position to prevent his whereabouts from being tracked.
Dinah was constantly tortured while she was moving around. She was not allowed to sleep at the same time.
She was severely injured. She had been suffering from insomnia for a long time. Her face was weak and weak. It seemed that she would die at any time.
Zach couldn’t wait for the fifth day. He came up with some ideas to pry open Daina’s mouth. Although he didn’t agree with Dudian to attack Daina. But now it was a done deal. He wanted to get some useful information from Daina.
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Daina who hadn’t slept for half a month was on the verge of collapse. She had suffered all kinds of torture which ordinary people couldn’t imagine.
Even Dudian thought that he couldn’t endure so much pain and torture. He suddenly felt that he was far inferior to Jason and Zaite in terms of torture.
Most of the torture he had seen and heard was in Thorn Prison. But it was just a small prison in Sylvia. Although there was no light and no hope in the prison, it was a physical torture, what Dinah suffered was a double blow to her body and soul. Zach deliberately slandered her ears and told her many unbearable things about her father.
After being forced to the limit, Jason and Zaitt took a seductive approach. From shallow to deep, they slowly asked Daina. When she listened to them, they would reduce the punishment and torture appropriately.
“Tell me honestly, who else is here besides your father? !”On the hillside.., jason looked at Daina, whose body was dirty and her hair was messy. His eyes were cold as he questioned her. At the same time, he held two brightly-colored vipers in his hands. The Vipers struggled to wrap around his arms, but they could not bite down and kept wriggling, it was disgusting.
Dina’s eyelids were barely open. She said weakly, “Only… only my father.”
Jason snorted coldly and hung the two vipers on her neck. When he let go of his hands, the Vipers immediately climbed onto her chest. The other vipers wrapped themselves around her neck and tightened, as if they wanted to take revenge on this human.
However, the two vipers were only low-level monsters. Although the poison was strong, it was almost useless against their anti-poison ability. The strength of the entanglement was also very weak to Dina, but the twisting vipers were enough to make her feel disgusted, however, she was already used to such things and did not have much reaction. What she wanted to do at the moment was to close her eyes and have a good sleep.
However, every time she closed her eyes for more than three seconds, a sharp pain would pierce into her body, forcing her to open her eyes.
“Why did you approach us?”Jason said coldly. After half a month of interrogation, he had basically confirmed that the “Father”that Dinah spoke of should really exist, otherwise, when Zahit had made up the sordid affair between her and her father, her reaction would not have been so intense, as if the most precious part of a virgin had been violated.
Dina panted and gritted her teeth. “What did I do wrong?”
Jason frowned and did not answer her.
No one could answer this question. Compared to the torture she had suffered, no matter what she had done wrong, she should not have suffered such a painful life. But life is not math. One plus one would be equal to two. When the result came out, the process was the truth, even if you couldn’t accept it.
Zach and Dudian sat at the side to rest. They looked at Jason’s actions. Although they felt that it was a bit too much, but they didn’t say anything to stop him.
Dudian suddenly found that when you do a bad thing, you will become a devil.
In the blink of an eye, another three days passed.
Dinah finally broke down. Her tears fell like rain as she answered all of Jason’s questions. However, her answer made Dudian and the other two frown.
Because her answer was exactly the same as the first time. She went out for a stroll and met Dudian and others. She only lived with her father. She lived in the underground base hundreds of miles away from the plain. Her father was much stronger than her. She didn’t know what level he was at, but she said that her father was a very smart man. There were many machines in their residence, all made by her father.
She and her father had lived here for many years. She really wanted to return to the god of war wall, but her father stopped her every time she asked.
She had seen the fire dragon alien race, but she had never interacted with them. She only knew that the camp of the fire dragon alien race was in the south.
The double magic marks in her body were implanted by her father, using the mechanical tools that her father had made himself.
She did not mention her father’s magic marks ability. Under the repeated torture of Jason and Zaitt, she still stubbornly resisted until her spirit broke down and she became a crazy person who only knew how to laugh foolishly.
Jason and Zac thought that she was pretending to be stupid. They told her a lot of dirty and despicable things.
“Your father is a despicable person. He is dirty and shameless. If so, then laugh at me.”
“Hahaha…”
In addition to screaming in pain, Diana only knew how to laugh.
Dudian suddenly felt that he couldn’t bear to watch. Jason and Zac’s interrogation methods were more despicable than he imagined. However, he didn’t stop them. It was useless to say anything now, his heart was filled with a new thought. He thought that if Dinah was really crazy, would she speak the truth? How could he make her speak?
Dudian told his thoughts to Jason and Zach. Their eyes lit up. They thought that the Crazy Dinah might be easier to torture than before. So they used all kinds of methods to try.
From torture to Candy Temptation. It was proven that for a crazy person, the effect of pain was not as good as candy temptation. When the pain no longer brought fear, it would be meaningless.
Under the comfort and temptation of both of them, Dina slowly learned to nod and learn basic communication from a fool.
However, after a few days, when Jason asked all the questions again, the answer was the same as before!
Jason, Zach and Dudian couldn’t accept this result. They had to admit that they had done something wrong! Dinah didn’t intend to deceive them. It was all their suspicions!
The three of them realized that they had done despicable things in the past few days. They suddenly felt that they despised themselves.
However, this feeling was temporary and soon faded away. Many people wouldn’t allow others to make any mistakes but would soon forgive themselves.
“What should we do now?”Jason asked Dudian.
Zac looked at Dudian with dissatisfaction in his eyes: “I have said that your guess is just a guess. Why Can’t you think of the good side of everything? Why do you think of others as Evil?”
Dudian looked at him but didn’t say anything. He took his criticism as a lesson for his decision. Such an idea might be very ruthless. After all, this mistake would cause a person to suffer and even lose his life. But the fact was that the winner would never pay for his mistake. At most, he would regret it, or it would be like Dudian’s self-warning. Even if such a mistake caused countless casualties.
After thinking for a moment.., dudian said: “In any case, we have at least obtained her father’s address. Although I don’t know what her father’s magic marks ability is, but I think it is most likely the same as her. It is likely that she has double magic marks and has the ability of two kinds of soul worms!”
Zach coldly snorted, “So what if we know this? Originally we would have followed her back. Maybe we have already gotten clues from her father to smuggle back to the god of war wall. Moreover we have already returned to the god of war wall. We don’t have to live in this godforsaken place in fear!” He could not help but spit and curse in his heart.
Jason saw that there was a lot of tension between them, he tried to persuade him, “It’s all in the past. It’s useless to talk about it now. Let’s think about what we should do next!”! “In my opinion, her father should have searched everywhere since she went missing for so long. It shouldn’t be difficult to find the plain where we smelted steel. He would definitely be able to recognize us if he picked up our scent from there. So even if we disguise ourselves as passers-by, it’s useless. We can only follow Dody’s words and go all the way to the dark and take down her father!”
“Do you still listen to him?”Zach raised his eyebrows.
Jason looked at him: “If we fight against each other then our chances of survival will be even slimmer!”
Zach’s eyes were gloomy. He wanted to speak but he suppressed his anger. He knew that it wouldn’t be good for him if he fought with Dudian at this time. No matter if Jason was on his side or not.., dudian’s strength was enough to defeat both of them.
“The enemy is in the open and we are in the dark. Since we know her father’s address, we should prepare for a sneak attack.”Dudian calmly said.
Jason frowned: “Do you have a plan? It is too difficult. Moreover her father has two magic marks.”
“Although it is difficult but there is hope.”Dudian said.
Zach sneered: “Even if you are the middle abyss but both of us are the lower abyss. Can the three of us fight against the Lord of the Abyss? Even if his father is the upper abyss then it would be easy for him to kill us. Let alone a stronger existence!”
“It is true that we are at a disadvantage but we also have an advantage.”Dudian ignored his tone, he calmly said: “Don’t forget that we have two key advantages in our hands!”
“We still have chips and advantages?”Zaite asked.
Dudian raised his hand and pointed at Daina who was on the ground, “This is our winning chip. As for the advantage, I have said that the enemy is in the open and we are in the dark. This is the first advantage! The second advantage is that Jason said that her father is likely to pick up our smell and trace it. This is our big advantage. We can use our smell to bait him!”
Jason and Zach were stunned.
Zach couldn’t help but look at Dudian seriously.
“I didn’t think that this was an advantage in your eyes!”Jason sighed: “I was worried that our smell would be exposed and make things more difficult. According to you it is indeed a great weapon!”
“That’s right.”Zach nodded. Although he wasn’t willing to let Dudian make the wrong decision but he had to admit that Dudian was right. Moreover his opinion was unique.
“You said that she is the winning chip. How Do You Know?”Jason asked: “Do you want to use her to hold her father hostage?”
“Of course not.”Dudian shook his head: “We can use her hand to severely wound her father. No matter what her father will not guard against his own daughter right?”
Both of them were startled. They couldn’t help but look at Dudian. There was a trace of fear in their eyes.
This young man looked much younger than them. Not only was he ruthless but he was also cunning. Fortunately, he was not their enemy.
“How can she attack her father?”Zach pondered: “Is it training…”
Dudian shook his head and interrupted: “We have stayed here for a long time. Let’s change the location first.”
The two didn’t ask any more questions. The three packed their luggage and left.
That night Dudian called Zach and Jason. They left Daina alone at the destination. Dudian observed Daina to prevent her from running away, he whispered to the two: “We will try to see if she is crazy. If she is, we will train her to be close to us.”

chapters.title: Chapter 952
chapters.content:
Chapter 952 – Chapter 942: “Dana”
Zach and Jason didn’t expect that Dudian’s vigilance was so strong that they felt that it was a bit redundant. However, they agreed with Dudian’s point of view because of the one percent possibility that Dana was playing dumb.
They only had one life. They didn’t want to take risks unless it was necessary.
In the next few days, Zach, Jason and Dudian used all kinds of methods to test Dana. For example, two of them went out to hunt while one of them stayed behind to guard. The guard’s attitude was more casual. Either he had his back to Dana, or he would be attracted by the sudden appearance of the small monster and walk away.
Diana seemed to be really stupid. She would only lie on the ground and laugh foolishly.
Dudian tried to deliberately dig a hole for Diana during training to test her reaction. However, the response was still a silly smile.
After a few days of trying, the three of them were finally convinced that Diana was really crazy. or her acting skills were so profound that there was no flaw!
“This is brown leaf juice. It can cover up the smell on our bodies.”When Zaite went out hunting, he brought back some thick and plump leaves. With a gentle kneading, he could make a dark green juice, “In case we suddenly meet her father and we don’t have time to react. “Although we have been constantly changing locations to cover up the smell, there will still be some flaws. A senior once told me that as long as it appears, it will definitely leave something behind. When we meet someone with strong perception, it will be a fatal flaw!”
“Brown Leaf Juice?”Jason saw the leaves in his hand and was surprised: “There are brown leaves here?”
Dudian saw that both of them seemed to recognize this item. He took it without saying anything.
Zac and Jason rubbed the leaves onto their bodies and then applied the excess onto Diana’s body. During the process they naturally touched each other. Both of them kneaded each other in tacit understanding.
Diana smiled but didn’t resist. She even groaned when she touched the sensitive part of her chest. It was very tempting.
“Unfortunately, the lower half of her body is gone.”Jason was a bit regretful.
Zac smiled but didn’t say anything.
Although they weren’t seduced by beauty but they were men after all.
Dudian glanced at Zac. Previously he tried to stop them but now he seemed to enjoy it. It was like a person who had done something extremely bad. He didn’t feel anything or even feel ashamed.
After smearing the brown leaf juice, the three of them once again shifted their position. After half a month of exploration, they found that as long as they were close to the god of war’s wall, they wouldn’t encounter too strong monsters. If they went deeper.., they would encounter more lord-level monsters. They might even encounter two or three families from the abyss.
Five days passed in the blink of an eye.
The three of them changed their positions many times. They stayed in each place for less than a day. They used all kinds of leaves, water, soil, and the hair of the monsters to change their smell. In addition, Jason told Dudian and zasite a secret to eliminate the smell. He mixed the blood of the monsters with ashes. He also brought a bottle of special ash powder. He mixed the water and mixed it into a paste and smeared it all over his body, it could seal the pores and minimize the spread of the smell.
“Come, tell me, Kiss Daddy.”
“Kiss, Kiss Daddy, Daddy…”Diana giggled intermittently.
Jason who was training her smiled and said: “How do I Kiss?”He handed a blood-stained monster leg to her.
Diana giggled and bit it. She tore off a large piece of flesh and laughed: “Kiss, Kiss Daddy…”
“Good boy.”Jason patted her head to show his appreciation.
Dina’s face was as comfortable as a cat’s, and she enjoyed his touch.
Jason pointed at a poisonous python that had been hunted and killed. “It’s Daddy.”
“Daddy, Daddy… ?”Dina’s reaction was a little slow. She turned her head and saw the dead poisonous python lying on the ground. Her eyes slowly revealed a silly smile from before. She pushed her arm against the ground and quickly rushed over to hug the poisonous python, she opened her mouth and bit off a piece of flesh. Her voice was muffled as she said: “Daddy…”
“Good girl.”Jason smiled in satisfaction as he patted her head.
Daina’s face was full of obedience as she leaned into his arms.
Zac and Dudian were sitting on the stone next to them. They were chewing grass roots. Zac looked at dudian: “Is this method really possible? What if his father has a strong toxin resistance?”
“Then we can only blame our bad luck.”Dudian shook his head. He used sneak attacks to hide the venom in the back of Diana’s teeth. When she bit, the venom would be injected into the body of the target, it was like a poison monster.
“Is your poison really effective?”Zac wasn’t convinced.
“It can directly poison the abyss. It should be considered a relatively poisonous poison. If we can find something more poisonous then we can replace it.”Dudian said. The poison in his body was made from the venom of the Arctic ice dragon, it was a mixture of poison from other monsters. There was also poison from poison arrow frog. This kind of poison had made the ruler who invaded Sylvia lose the ability to fight.
