Now the effect of the poison was greatly increased, it was not difficult to poison the abyss but it would be greatly reduced if they encountered the abyss which had high resistance to the poison.
However, there was a benefit to this. Usually, people with strong resistance would have defensive magic marks. This meant that their perception and attack were slightly inferior.
They had repeatedly moved positions for so many days but were still not caught up by Dinah’s father. It was clear that his father’s perception was not strong.
“If it was two magic marks, if it was me, I would choose one perception, one attack, or one defense. His father should be like this…”Dudian thought, his eyes flashed as he glanced at Zac.
Three days later.
The three of them were ready to set sail and return to the iron-smelting plain.
After two days of travel, the three of them were getting closer and closer to the iron-smelting plain. That night, the sky was cloudless and the stars were bright. The three of them gathered at the edge of the forest and ate all the low-level monsters they had hunted. After filling their stomachs, they sat on the branches and looked at the Moon.
There was no way to entertain themselves during the long night. Daydreaming and daydreaming became the only way for them to pass the time.
“The Moon is so beautiful. I wonder if we can fly up there.”Jason found a topic to talk about and said in a whimsical manner.
Zahimt suddenly laughed. “How can we fly up there? Just the Thunderbirds on the clouds are enough to kill us.”
“There are no thunderbirds outside the border.”
“But I heard that the higher you fly, the colder it will be. In the end, you will be frozen into an ice sculpture.”
“That’s true. It’s the same as how we live.”Jason sighed as he looked at the dark forest: “We humans are probably the only ones in the world who know how to look up and appreciate the stars.”
Zaite shrugged his shoulders: “Of course. What do these low-level monsters know? I heard that in the last century we humans had spread all over the world. We were the masters of all living things!”
Jason nodded. There was some yearning and regret in his eyes.
Dudian listened to their chitchat. Under the moonlight there was a bit of desire to talk but he held it back, after a while he slowly said: “Maybe it is because you know how to look up and appreciate that you want to conquer and destroy.”
Jason curiously asked: “Conquer? You mean someone wants to conquer this piece of starry sky?”
“Everything you see, you want to keep for yourself unless it’s trash, right?”Dudian asked back.
“That’s true.”Jason nodded.
“Especially the beautiful girls.”Zach laughed.
Jason laughed.
Dudian got up: “I’m going to relieve myself. I’m going to look around to see if there are any monsters from the Abyss.”
“Do you want me to accompany you?”
“No.”
“Don’t go too far. Be careful.”
“Signal if there is danger.”
Both of them instructed.
Dudian jumped down from the treetops and took Aisha out of the forest. They walked to the mountain next to them. First, he took a piss. Then he took Aisha and continued to walk for more than ten miles, he handed Aisha the roasted flesh of the monster. He cut it with the Cleaver and let her eat it one bite at a time.
After she finished eating, he used a clean handkerchief to wipe her lips.
When he was about to return, he suddenly saw a heat source approaching from the limit of his vision.
“Human?”Dudian’s pupils shrank as he saw the outline of the heat source. It was an upright human. Although it was different from the human body but it looked like an oval red shadow. However, he had used the heat source to identify countless humans, he was very experienced.
The hair on his body stood up. The first thing that came to his mind was ‘Dad’!
Did he chase after them?
Dudian calmed down and frowned. He felt that the man’s reaction was a bit strange. It seemed that he wasn’t Daina’s father. If her father was tracking them then why would he walk slowly? He should have hidden in the dark or rushed at full speed.
However, the heat source was walking very slowly. It seemed to be walking normally and stopping at times as if it was trying to figure out the direction.
Dean’s eyes flashed. He thought for a moment and finally took Aisha with him. If it wasn’t Dinah’s father, then who was it? He was very curious. was there someone else in this isolated place? Or was it a local resident?
Ten minutes later, he and Aisha quietly approached the place.
Dean peeked out from a giant rock crack. He was shocked. He opened his eyes wide. This person was actually Dana!
The same style of linen clothing, the same color of light golden hair, and the same face. The only difference was that her body was as good as before, just like when Dean first met Dana!
Dudian’s heart violently twitched. Even though he had seen countless vicious and bloody scenes, at this moment there was a moment of absent-mindedness. He felt that he had seen a ghost!
Wasn’t Daina with Zac and Jason? Wasn’t her waist cut off by him? Wasn’t she tortured by them until she went crazy?
“Who? !”“Daina”who was standing in front suddenly turned back and looked straight at the place where Dudian was hiding.
Dudian’s face was ugly. He didn’t expect that he would make such a low-level mistake after experiencing so many dangerous battles. He wasn’t calm enough, maybe he felt guilty and ashamed about torturing Dana so he had such a big reaction?
He couldn’t explain but he knew that he had to stand out. There was no point in hiding.
When he came out from behind the Boulder, Dudian suddenly found that there was a difference between “Dana”and the previous “Dana”he had met. Their hairstyles were different. The previous “Dana”had a ponytail and looked very innocent and lively, this “Dana”had loose hair that fell on her shoulders like waves. She had a bit of princess-like elegance and her expression was more indifferent.
“Human?”After “Dana”saw Dudian, her eyes flashed with surprise. She immediately noticed Aisha who was next to Dudian.
“I’m passing by. My name is dudian. And you are?”Dudian asked. He took the initiative to show his friendliness but his heart was a bit nervous.
“My name is Dana.”The girl said.
Dudian’s pupils contracted for a moment but quickly returned to normal. There was no change in his expression. He smiled as if it was the first time he had heard of this name: “This is a good name.”
The girl looked at him: “Have you heard of this name?”
“I had a friend named this name when I was young. It seems that this name is not bad.”Dudian smiled.
The girl stared at him. She saw that Dudian’s smile was natural. She slowly withdrew the spirit in her eyes: “Why are you here? Listen to your language. Where did you come from?”She raised her hand and pointed at the god of war wall.
Dudian nodded. There was a trace of embarrassment on his face: “Not long ago there was a war. I was separated from the main force and ended up here. I am afraid that I will be treated as a deserter.”
The girl asked: “Are You Alone?”
Dudian shook his head. He shook his head like a rattle-drum, “There are eight people who got separated with me. We are a squadron. They are resting on the other side. I came out to take a piss and patrol the surroundings. I didn’t expect to meet you. Are you a resident here?” Her eyes lit up as she looked excited.
The girl shook her head: “I am the same as you. I came from the other side of the wall but I have been living here for a long time.”
“Living here for a long time?”Dudian was surprised: “Isn’t there a fire dragon circling here? Didn’t you meet them?”
“We have ways to hide.”The girl shook her head. She didn’t want to talk about it, she looked at dudian: “Are your teammates there? Why Don’t you take me to see them? I have been here since I was a child. I haven’t seen what the people outside are like!”.
Dudian couldn’t help but think of Diana. She had an innocent smile and eyes.
“They are rude. If you don’t mind, please come with me.”Dudian said in a serious tone. He turned his body and made an invitation. He waited for the girl to slowly approach him, step by step, it was as if she was stepping on his heart.
Dudian smiled as the girl walked in front of him. He stepped forward to guide her.
The girl looked around and asked: “Have you seen a girl who looks like me? Her name is Dana and she is my sister.”
Dudian was surprised: “Do you sisters have the same name?”
The girl nodded: “Have You Seen Her?”
Dudian shook his head: “No. If we have seen her then we will invite her to join us.”
“That’s true.”
Dudian curiously asked: “How come you have the same name as your sister? Did she get separated from you?”
“Yes, she went out to play half a month ago and never came back. My father was worried to death. I have been looking for her everywhere during this time. I have been looking for her until now. It is late at night.”The girl sighed, there was a bit of sadness on her eyebrows.
Dudian looked at her appearance. He couldn’t bear to look at her. But he still showed a regretful and sympathetic expression: “She should be lost. Or…” He suddenly waved the splitter in his hand.
Clang! Sparks flew.
The sound of the collision was particularly loud in the night.
Dudian and Dinah pulled away from each other. Both of them were surprised.
Dudian didn’t expect that Dinah who had been listening to him would react and block his attack. The girl also didn’t expect that Dudian’s attack would be so fierce. Although she was prepared but she was almost unable to withstand it. At the moment her weapon was broken and her arm was cut open.
“You were prepared?”Dudian’s face turned gloomy. He hoped that the previous sound would alarm Jason and Zach. But the distance was too far and they wouldn’t be able to hear it.
“Where is my sister?”The girl coldly looked at Dudian.
“How do you know that I have something to do with her?”Dudian asked.
“Although your performance was flawless but there is one thing you may not know. Your backpack has already exposed you!”The girl sneered.
“Backpack?”Dudian was startled. Lightning flashed in his mind: “Do you mean the thing inside?”
“Yes, it is the flesh of the Aragami!”The girl said in a cold voice: “My father detected the reaction of the Aragami’s flesh not long after you came to the plains. But he was in the middle of an experiment and couldn’t get out. So he asked my sister to bring you back. I didn’t expect that she would fall into your hands!”
Dudian was slightly startled. were they exposed as soon as they arrived at the plains? Did Dina already know about them?
How could it be!
He couldn’t accept it. He didn’t want to believe it. But he felt that there was no reason for this “Dina”to deceive him. He gradually calmed down and slowly recalled the situation when he first met Dina. He carefully thought about it and suddenly found many details. There were many flaws and doubts, it was definitely not just the few points that he had observed earlier.
For example, when Dina saw them, she was obviously surprised. Now that he thought about it, it was even more obvious that she was putting on an act.
In addition, Dina showed no fear at all. Anyone who stayed in this place where the monsters resided would know how to be careful. However, Dina directly approached them. There was no stealth, no disguise.., even when she saw them, she did not show any obvious fear. If it were an ordinary person, meeting a few of their own kind with unclear abilities would definitely not be just a pleasant surprise.
Because of Dina’s naivety and vivacity, they mistakenly thought that she was too naive and did not know that humans were evil. That was why they believed them so easily. However, the other party’s purpose was actually to bring them back to her father.
As for the goal, it was very likely to be the Aragami’s flesh and blood in his bag.
They thought that others were naive, but perhaps they were just as naive in Dinah’s eyes.
However, there was something that he could not figure out. He asked, “Why did your father not let the two of you come over together? With your strength, you should be able to capture us directly, right?”
The young girl snorted coldly and said, “There’s no harm in telling you. My sister and I have very different habits in life. She only comes out during the day and cowers at home at night. Meanwhile, I only come out at night. I don’t even go out during the day! Moreover, my father has already found out that the three of you are inferior abyss. My Sister’s strength is enough to subdue the three of you easily!”
Dudian’s face slightly changed. The two of them alternated day and night? What was the reason? He didn’t believe that it was just their living habits. It was very likely that it was because of their magic marks or other reasons. Some monsters liked to hunt at night while others liked to hunt during the day.
Besides, her words revealed a lot of information. First of all, her father could actually sense that they were from the lower abyss! After all, they had hidden the heat source, and how far away was his father? At least outside of their perception range! Not only could he sense them from such a far distance, but he could also know their specific strength. This was simply unbelievable!
But if his father’s perception was outstanding, then why didn’t he catch up with them? Could it be that he couldn’t escape? He felt that it was impossible. After all, it had been almost a month.
Could it be that her father had used some instruments to detect their strength?
Dudian noticed that she had said “Detect the reaction of the flesh of the Aragami”. Although “Detect”and “Perception”sometimes meant the same thing, but in Dudian’s eyes, they were two different things.
In his opinion, perception only represented the body’s ability. Detection included not only the instrument but also the body’s detection.
If it was an instrument, then it would explain why her father didn’t track her.
However, this also extended to another information. Her father was in possession of a very sophisticated instrument. It was very high-tech!
As he was thinking about the stakes, he was suddenly shocked, and his face turned a little ugly. He glanced in the direction he came from, and it was Jason and Zaite, as well as… the “Crazy and stupid”Dinah.
During the previous repeated interrogation, Jason naturally questioned her about whether she had a motive or if it was a coincidence, but the answer Dinah gave was “No”! From the beginning to the end, her answer had not changed, so much so that the people they interrogated believed that she had completely confessed.
However, if it was an ordinary captive, the answers would always be a little different. The things that they wanted to hide at the beginning would gradually loosen up after they forced her to confess.
But Dinah had not changed at all. This was a very big doubt, but for some reason, they mistakenly thought that she was too innocent and did not lie from the beginning. She was a naive and kind girl.
It seemed that her confession couldn’t be taken seriously.
Moreover, she shouldn’t be crazy. If a person was stupid, how could he make the same answer and reaction as before?
The more Dudian thought about it, the more frightened he became. He suddenly felt that he had made a big mistake. The reason for this big mistake was that he had underestimated Dinah.
Not only him but also Zac and Jason were deceived by Dinah.
They had a preconceived idea that Dinah might be an innocent girl. That was why they thought that the torture would make her crazy. But now it seemed that Dinah deliberately approached them to bring them back to her father. The reason why she didn’t take a strong direct attack was very simple. If he was in her position, he would have chosen to use a more gentle method to lure them over, this way, it was more labor-saving.
If they had rejected Dina back then, they might have faced her lightning attack.
In fact, if he had not taken the initiative to attack back then, perhaps Dina would have attacked first!
Just like at this moment.
When he had waved his saber just now, the young girl had already been on guard, so she was able to parry in time. Moreover, she had already seen through his identity. He suspected that she might have taken into account the fact that he had defeated her sister, so she did not attack him directly from the beginning. Instead, she had the same intention as him, to sneak attack him at close range!
Otherwise, why would she act defenseless when she came over?
Didn’t her behavior make him relax his vigilance?
There were countless cases of failure or death because of contempt. Dudian knew that he shouldn’t underestimate anyone. A lion needed to use all his strength to kill a rabbit. However, he still made this mistake. Moreover, it was fatal.
It was inevitable for anyone to make a mistake. This was something that even the deepest philosophy couldn’t change.
Fortunately, he met the girl. Otherwise, they would have taken Daina who was pretending to be stupid to attack her father!
He was glad and even grateful to the girl in front of him.
“Your sister’s perceptive ability should be pretty good right?”Dudian suddenly asked.
The girl indifferently said: “It seems that you have experienced it?”
Dudian slightly nodded and sighed in his heart. It was too dangerous! At this moment he had the answer to the last doubt in his heart. They had tested whether Dinah was crazy or not. Maybe she had heard about it. They pretended to leave but hid in the dark to observe. Maybe they were also in her perception.
From the beginning to the end, Dinah had been foolishly smiling at them. Maybe the silly smile on her face was a mockery to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 953
chapters.content:
Chapter 953 – Chapter 943: “Aragami”Duel
“With my sister’s strength, it’s easy for her to deal with you. What despicable means did you use to make her fall into your hands?”The girl coldly said.
Dudian indifferently said: “Didn’t you experience it yourself?”
“So that’s the case.”The girl thought of Dudian’s sneak attack. Her eyes turned cold: “In that case, you should prepare to be buried with her!”Dark red mucus slowly emerged from her body, it was like thick blood that slowly covered her arms, neck and other parts of her body.
Dudian saw that the dark red mucus covered her body. It was very similar to when they entered the demon body. However, he didn’t see the girl using the witcher. It seemed that the mucus was coming out from her pores.
As the mucus covered her body, her limbs slowly changed and mutated. Her petite body became more and more ferocious and strange. Her blonde wavy hair was slowly covered by the mucus and became like a helmet, at the same time, the ends of her hair turned into six or seven strange sharp horns.
Dudian was convinced that the strange mucus was the same material as the witcher. It helped her to enter the complete state of the magic body.
He didn’t dare to be careless. The splitter in his hand melted and quickly covered his entire body. Sharp blades protruded out of his body. The sharp blades reflected cold light as if they could cut his vision.
Dudian looked at the girl. She didn’t look like a ‘human’at the moment. Her body was tall and her legs and hip bones were lying on the ground like scorpions, there were seven or eight sharp claws. The upper half of her abdomen was Snow White. But this white skin wasn’t the delicate skin of a human. It was a layer of fish scales and gel like skin. It was extremely smooth. There was a human face on this extremely smooth skin, the outline of the face was similar to that of the girl.
Her arms had become more than one meter long. Her arms were covered with armor and spikes. The head on her neck had become extremely terrifying. Her face was completely twisted. Her eyes were as big as a baby’s fist. Her pupils were blood red, it seemed that blood was about to drip out of her mouth. Her mouth protruded out sharp teeth of different lengths. She looked like a beast.
In addition to the strange appearance of the magic body, the thing that caught Dudian’s attention the most was that her magic body faintly had a layer of pale golden light. He had seen this feeling before. It was the same as the layer of pale golden light brought by the power of the Aragami.
Could it be that her body also had the power of the Aragami’s flesh and blood?
When Dudian looked at the girl, the girl also looked at Dudian. When she saw that Dudian’s tyrant-like body was full of sharp blades, she suddenly felt that it was a bit tricky. It was like the status of hedgehogs and porcupines in the animal world, even if they met a beast that could kill them, they would find it difficult to eat it.
Both of them looked at each other. They were observing and measuring each other. At the same time, they were analyzing each other’s weaknesses and strengths.
The night was extremely quiet.
Dudian looked at the pale face of the girl’s abdomen. His heart was moved. He didn’t know if the core weakness of the girl was the ferocious head on her neck, the faint face on her abdomen had inspired him. He used the dragon blood spell to control the muscles in her abdomen. He spoke in ventriloquism: “Do you have the flesh of the Aragami in your body?”
His mouth opened in response to the ventriloquism but he didn’t make a sound.
The girl didn’t respond to him. After a short silence her figure suddenly flashed and rushed towards him.
Whoosh!
The eight claws on her lower body quickly moved like a scorpion or a spider. It was almost instantaneous.
Dudian’s heart was shocked. The hormones in his body suddenly burst out. He crossed his feet on the ground and suddenly rotated. He swung the sharp blade like a hedgehog gyroscope. This was the strongest defensive move he had thought of, the spiked shield!
Clang! Clang!
The girl swung the strange arm. The moment it touched the edge of the rotating blade it made a cutting sound. She immediately retracted her hand but saw that the wrist of the strange arm was cut off.
She retreated dozens of meters. She looked at Dudian with a ferocious face. It seemed that she didn’t expect that Dudian’s sharp blade would be so sharp. She had always been very confident in the strength of her body. Even if she was bitten by some abyss monsters that had amazing bite power, she would only feel a little pain but wouldn’t be hurt. She didn’t expect that in front of dudian, just a touch.., she would be directly cut off!
She suddenly understood why her sister would fall in the hands of this person.
Perhaps the opponent’s strength was not as good as hers. But with such a terrifying attack, it would only take one blow to kill her!
The anger in her heart gradually calmed down. At the same time, Dudian didn’t pounce on her. It was obvious that he intended to stop her.
“Her speed is faster than the ape instructor. The opponent’s magic marks have a great increase in speed. Her magic body has become so exaggerated. It is obvious that the increase in physical strength is weak. But she still has such speed. Is She from the Upper Abyss?”Dudian’s eyes flashed, his face was solemn. He had killed the ape instructor. He had a new definition of his strength. He was comparable to the middle abyss.
But in front of him was a superior abyss. There was a huge gap in strength!
Fortunately, his eyes could still catch the girl’s movements. Otherwise, he would be dead for sure.
Puff!
At this time, the girl suddenly waved another strange arm and sharp claws. She cut the wound that was cut by Dudian. The thickness of the cut was two centimeters. The blood spurted out faster but stopped in less than ten seconds, the wound seemed to have a scar.
After dealing with the wound, the girl continued to look at Dudian. Half a minute later, she rushed over again. When she was close to Dudian, her body suddenly swayed and appeared on the side. She moved like lightning, there seemed to be a phantom on the spot.
Dudian immediately used the shield defense again. The rotating blade had no blind spots.
The girl was ready to attack from the side. She saw that Dudian had successfully used the shield and immediately retreated. Her face became more ferocious. She suddenly opened her mouth and puffed up her cheeks. Her cheeks were as big as a toad’s.
A jet of black water shot out.
Dudian didn’t have time to release the shield to Dodge. His face slightly changed as he saw the jet of black mucus. He could only watch as it rushed towards him and hit him.
Although the Shield’s defense was very strong but its shortcomings were obvious. It was easy to get dizzy after a long time. Moreover the physical strength was consumed quickly so he couldn’t move his position.
Dudian felt a chill when the black mucus touched the sharp blade. At the same time his rotating speed was slowly reduced. He tried to improve but found that it was extremely difficult.

chapters.title: Chapter 954
chapters.content:
Chapter 954 – Chapter 944: Struggling
“What’s going on?”Dudian was shocked but didn’t dare to stop.
At this time, the girl’s bulging cheeks were getting smaller and smaller. The black mucus in her mouth was slowly shot out. Before Dudian could relax, she took a deep breath. Her cheeks were bulging again.
Dudian’s face changed. He quickly stopped his body and jumped away at the critical moment. He avoided the black mucus that the girl spat out.
As he jumped, Dudian saw his body’s condition. The blade was stained with black mucus. The mucus was like sticky glue. It was pulled out of the black silk and wrapped layer by layer, it was like a big net. It was extremely difficult to swing and stretch the blade.
He didn’t have time to think about what the black mucus was and whether it was toxic or not. He saw the girl quickly rushed towards him. The face was full of violence and malevolence, the teeth in her mouth protruded a few inches. They became more and more sharp as they bit towards Dudian’s face.
Dudian was scared. He quickly raised the sharp blade and stabbed towards the girl.
Suddenly, the shadow flashed. The sharp blade went through the girl’s body but there was no blood. The shadow disappeared.
At the same time, a cold air suddenly came from the side.
The girl’s claws were like sharp knives as they stabbed towards Dudian’s waist.
The change was too fast. Dudian didn’t have time to turn his body. The girl thought that her attack had succeeded. Suddenly, she felt pain in her palm. Her face suddenly changed. The eight claws under her abdomen crawled at an extremely fast speed. Not only did they stop temporarily.., but they also pulled away in an instant.
She looked at the sharp blade that pierced through her palm. The pain made her face ferocious. When she looked up again, she saw a sharp blade slowly appear on Dudian’s body.
This incomparably sharp blade could actually be ejected!
The girl clenched her teeth. She was obviously stronger than Dudian but she had suffered two losses in a row. However, the two losses were not without gains. The first time she knew that Dudian’s sharp blade was sharp. The second time she knew that Dudian’s sharp blade could fall off and shoot out.
“If he spins and throws out all the sharp blades, he might be able to kill a circle of abyss…”the girl calmly looked at Dudian. In her heart she was secretly trying to figure out Dudian’s hidden ability and combat skills. However, she thought that Dudian didn’t shoot out the sharp blades when he spins. It shouldn’t be to hide this point but to shoot out a single sharp blade when he spins. He couldn’t control the accuracy and cause damage to her.
If he shoots out all the sharp blades then when Dudian reproduces the new ones, the gap would be fatal.
Moreover the effect of this move to deal with group attacks was very good. But in a one on one fight it would be a bit of a waste.
Dudian looked at the girl who was temporarily forced to retreat. His face was gloomy. In a head-on fight, his physique was completely crushed. Fortunately, the sharp blade was sharp enough. Even if the girl was much stronger than him, he could still severely injure her, or even kill her.
However, the speed of his attack couldn’t touch the girl. He could only rely on surprise attacks. However, the girl wasn’t a fool. She had more battle experience than him. If she didn’t know his background, she wouldn’t have been attacked continuously.
Now that he was on guard, it would be difficult for him to hurt her again.
However, he could do nothing to her.
Therefore, after two consecutive times where he seemed to have taken advantage of her, his mood became more and more depressed.
Whoosh!
Another sharp blade suddenly shot out.
The girl’s body swayed and easily dodged it.
Although the speed of the Sharp Blade’s ejection was fast, it was still slower than the brandishing of the sharp blade. After all, the ejection of the sharp blade mainly relied on the compression of the muscles and the push of the bones. There were very few tissues that could transmit strength.
“Humph, I have overestimated you with this bit of strength.”The girl pulled out the sharp blade from the palm of her claw but didn’t throw it away. She grabbed the other end and held it as a sharp sword.
Dudian saw that she wanted to use his own sharp blade to attack him. He couldn’t help but feel that it was funny and ironic. Fortunately, after these sharp blades left his body, they would gradually become qualitative and weak, he couldn’t withstand a single blow.
Whoosh!
He shot out another sharp blade. At the same time, he stimulated his bones to accelerate the growth of a new sharp blade.
The girl easily dodged again.
After half a minute, Dudian shot out another sharp blade and urged the growth of the new sharp blade.
After a few times, the girl saw Dudian’s thoughts. She frowned and no longer gave Dudian the opportunity to replace the sharp blade. She quickly rushed over. The moment she was close to Dudian, she suddenly jumped forward, the eight claws under her abdomen turned into countless afterimages and covered Dudian’s body.
Dudian didn’t have time to use his shield. Even if he used it, the initial speed was not fast enough and he would be defeated. He could only swing the sharp blades around his body. They were like countless hair bands that fluttered in the wind. They shot forward at different angles.
He couldn’t Dodge the girl’s attack so he had to attack instead of defending.
Puff! Puff!
In the blink of an eye, both of them had attacked each other more than a hundred times. It was like a repulsive force exploded from the middle of the two.
Dudian took a few steps back. The sharp blade behind his back pierced into the soil and stopped his body like a third leg. He looked down at the three big bloody holes in the root of the blade.
The girl’s injuries were much more serious than Dudian’s. Two and a half of her eight claws had been cut off. There were deep and shallow scratches on the remaining claws. Blood was flowing out of the wounds.
The girl had seen the power of Dudian’s blade. The wounds couldn’t heal. She had to cut off the stab and cut off the flesh. She had to create new wounds by herself, the wound that she had created could be healed. It wouldn’t completely destroy the blood vessels and flesh.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Dudian shot out one sharp blade after another. At the same time, he accelerated the growth of the new ones. In the blink of an eye, all the sharp blades were restored to their original state.
The girl wrapped her own wound. She looked at Dudian who was restored to his original state. Her face was ferocious. It seemed that the battle had returned to the starting point. Only the injuries on her body proved that the previous battle had existed.
“Your magic marks are very good. Unfortunately, your ability is too simple!”The girl’s mouth was slightly raised. Her face was distorted by the teeth, “Since you have forced me to this point, I won’t Let You Die!”Her body suddenly doubled in size. Sharp spikes grew on her back and her upper body leaned forward, she looked like an eight-legged reptile lizard.
“God’s Thorn!”
The girl’s low voice was heard by Dudian. Her figure had turned into a black shadow. It was impossible to see her body’s appearance. All he could see was a long black shadow sweeping by.

chapters.title: Chapter 955
chapters.content:
Chapter 955 – Chapter 945: Broken Leg
So Fast!
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he saw a black shadow suddenly appear in front of him. There was no time for him to use his shield, he was hit before he could rotate.
In a hurry, he instinctively raised all the sharp blades of his body to block or stab.
At this time, the black shadow suddenly flashed like a ghost’s arc.
Dudian’s omni-directional vision clearly saw the girl turn into a black shadow and go behind him. His face turned white in an instant. He couldn’t believe that she could turn at such a fast speed? Wasn’t that the limit of her speed?
He saw the girl’s movement. However, at this moment his sharp blades rushed forward. It was too late to defend.
In less than half a second the shadow hit the root of the sharp blade behind Dudian’s back. Although his body was covered with sharp blades but the gap between the blades was the weakness of his body.
Bang!
Dudian’s body flew forward. The pain made him feel as if his entire back was torn. It was like a sharp awl had pierced through his spine. He groaned in pain. Before he landed on the ground he saw the girl following him like a shadow, two snake-like tentacles shot out from his armpit and wrapped around Dudian’s legs.
Dudian’s legs were extremely sharp. However the snake-like tentacles were wrapped around the gaps of the spikes. Dudian felt pain in his legs, his body rolled forward.
He didn’t care about the pain as he used the momentum to climb up. He used the sharp blades to protect his body. He looked for the girl’s figure but his face changed. The tentacles under her armpit were slightly bent and wrapped around a leg full of sharp blades.
This leg was naturally his.
He felt that one of his legs had been cut off from his knee. He was bleeding non-stop.
The girl’s face was full of violence. She looked at Dudian with a sinister smile. She casually threw off her leg which was wrapped by tentacles, her leg was shattered into pieces of flesh and broken bones. There was no possibility of reconnecting it.
Dudian’s eyes were gloomy as he looked at her. His forehead was covered in cold sweat. It was common to be injured in battle and broken limbs were also common. It was fortunate that he was able to survive in such a disadvantageous situation.
The strength of this girl was much stronger than he had imagined. Her physique was completely superior to his. She had many abilities. He felt that he was like a trapped beast that couldn’t escape.
The pain and anger as well as the cold mood made Dudian’s mood difficult to calm down. However he tried to hold back many distracting thoughts and forced himself to calm down. He didn’t think about what his future life would be like after his leg was broken, would it affect his future strength? Would he become a cripple? At the moment he only wanted to escape from this place or how to turn the defeat into victory!
However, as the girl said, his weakness was too simple.
Extreme attacks were strong, but if this point was restrained and couldn’t attack the enemy, or the enemy could withstand your attack, then you would lose all the advantages.
“Blood Hunter!”The girl smiled and suddenly flew over.
Dudian’s pupils were concentrated and his vision was improved to the extreme. He caught the girl’s figure. It was clearer than before when he only saw an afterimage. He could see her limbs, but it was still blurry.
Whoosh!
Dudian was about to defend when the girl suddenly changed direction and appeared on the side.
Dudian was prepared for this. He quickly changed direction.
However the girl’s figure turned and appeared behind him.
When his blade turned to the back, the girl changed direction and appeared on the left side. This time Dudian’s blade couldn’t keep up with her speed. He felt a pain in his left waist. The girl’s figure appeared more than ten meters in front of him, there was a piece of meat mixed with carapace and flesh in her mouth.
Dudian looked at the bloody wound on his waist. His face was ugly but his brows were tightly wrinkled. He seemed to have seen the girl’s specialty, which was extreme speed change! In high speed movement, she could still maintain a fast change of position and direction. This was simply a godly skill in close combat.
Most of this ability came from the eight claws on her lower body.
Dudian noticed that her claws were not only sharp but also had some strange structures. There were cartilage and hoofs on the inside of the claws. Most of the credit for the fast change of direction came from these two structures.
He had seen it before but didn’t think too much about it. After all, the structure of the magic body was strange. At most he could deduce the type of ability of the other party.
Whoosh!
The girl rushed over again.
Dudian’s heart tightened but he didn’t panic. His eyes flashed as he thought of a way.
Puff!
The girl once again tore a piece of flesh from his body while he was thinking.
At the moment he was like a weak tiger. He could only let the Falcon Peck at him but he couldn’t resist.
When the girl rushed over again, Dudian suddenly had a flash of inspiration. He put away the sharp blade and covered the surface of his body like a feather. It looked like he was wearing a layer of armor. His defense was greatly increased.
The girl’s lips curved into an evil smile. She quickly approached Dudian and changed directions. When Dudian didn’t have time to react, she suddenly attacked him from the front!
She believed that Dudian had been ambushed by her from the side and from the back several times. He had long been on guard against these places. However, he paid less attention to the front.
However, when her claws and mouth came into contact with Dudian’s body, the sharp blade that covered his body suddenly opened up like a sharp spike. The speed of the ejection was extremely fast.
Although the girl moved fast, she didn’t expect such a sudden reaction. Moreover, this way was out of her expectations. She couldn’t avoid it for a moment.
Puff Puff Puff!
Several bone-piercing sounds were heard. Dudian felt that his chest was hit hard. He couldn’t help but groan. His body flew out like a cloth bag, he saw the girl standing thirty meters away. Her arm and other arm had been cut off from the elbow. There was a deep scratch on her neck.
There were two scratches and a bloody hole on her face. She was bleeding profusely.
Dudian was relieved. Although he wasn’t able to kill her but it was good that he was able to severely injure her.
The girl screamed in pain. She stomped on the ground and crushed the weeds.
Dudian was about to take advantage of the situation to attack but the girl suddenly stopped. She stared at Dudian with her blood red eyes. The murderous aura that she emitted made Dudian stop his body.
At the moment the girl was like the chosen one. She emitted a terrifying murderous aura. Dudian felt that she was dangerous just by looking at her.
He felt that the girl didn’t look like a coward. He hesitated for a moment but chose to stop.
The girl’s ferocious face looked even more terrifying in the blood flow. Her mouth was full of protruding teeth. It looked like she was going to eat people. Dudian thought that she would attack again, suddenly the girl raised her head and let out a loud roar. It lasted for a few seconds before she stopped. She continued to stare at Dudian and didn’t move.
Both of them were in a deadlock for a few minutes. Dudian was alarmed as he thought that the roar was a kind of call?
He was so scared that he broke out in cold sweat. He turned around and ran away.
He did not run towards Zac and Jason. Instead, he ran straight towards the god of war’s wall.
After knowing that Dinah was not really crazy, he knew that his previous plan had gone bankrupt. Now, being able to leave alive was the biggest problem.
As for Zac and Jason, they were no different from dead people. He chose to give up.

chapters.title: Chapter 956
chapters.content:
Chapter 956 – Chapter 946: Miraculous Effect
“Do you want to run?”The girl saw Dudian turn around. Although one of his legs was broken, but with the help of the limbs and wings on his back, his speed was not slow. Her reaction was not slow either. She was as fast as a ROC spreading its wings and flew away. In the blink of an eye, she was close to Dudian’s back.
Whoosh!
Dudian suddenly turned around as he was running for his life. The sharp blades shot out like raindrops.
The girl’s figure flashed. It seemed that she had expected this.
Dudian didn’t stop as he continued to run forward. He turned around but the sound of a bell was heard.
The girl heard the bell but didn’t think much of it. She saw Dudian running away again so she immediately chased after him. She quickly closed the distance with Dudian. Her body suddenly accelerated as she got close to Dudian’s back.
Whoosh!
Dudian threw out the sharp blade from his back.
The girl’s figure flashed as she moved to the side. Her sharp claws stabbed towards Dudian’s side.
At this time, Dudian suddenly turned his head and looked at her fiercely.
The girl was startled. She didn’t expect Dudian to guess that she would attack this side. At this time, her sharp claws had pierced into Dudian’s side waist. Before she stopped, Dudian suddenly roared and counterattacked.
The girl’s face slightly changed as she looked at the sharp blades. She hurriedly retreated.
Hiss!
A very faint but sharp sound suddenly appeared.
It came from behind.
The girl noticed the sharp sound as she was pushed back by Dudian. Her first reaction was surprise. Did he come so fast? But the next moment, the surprise suddenly turned into coldness. She suddenly thought that if he came, she should have sensed it in advance.
In this split second, she hurriedly turned her head and saw a burning red body flying towards her. The pure black pupils and the slightly ferocious face made her pale with fright.
Wasn’t this… the corpse king who had been dumbstruck at the side?
Whoosh!
Liquid Flames spurted out from Aisha’s mouth, covering her face and rushing towards the girl’s back. At the same time, Haisha’s demonized dragon claw was like an iron hook that was attached to the girl’s shoulder. The violent force from the Dragon Claw tightened, and the girl’s body was suddenly pulled.
In this moment of delay, Dean had already approached from the front. The sharp claws of the monster were like pear blossoms!
“No!”The girl screamed in fear.
Puff! Puff! Puff!
Blood splashed. The sound of bones being cut was continuous. The sound was very pleasing to the ears because the cutting was very fast.
Plop!
The hideous head on the girl’s neck was cut off and fell to the ground. Her face was still ferocious, but her blood-red eyes gradually dimmed.
Dudian was about to continue to cut her body into pieces when the girl’s arm suddenly pierced through the gap of the sharp blades. It was aimed at Dudian’s chest and heart.
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he retreated.
The headless girl’s body turned as spikes and tentacles suddenly shot out from her body. They hit Aisha’s chest and pushed her away.
Dudian’s eyes sank as he looked at her abdomen. It was as smooth as white scales, but there was a faint outline of the girl’s cheek. He had guessed it before, but he didn’t expect it to be true. Her brain had been transferred to his body’s abdomen during the demonization!
However, based on her height of 1.6 meters before she was demonized, it was indeed at her current abdomen. However, when she was demonized, he only saw her body expand, but he did not see her head move. It was most likely transferred from the tissues in her body.
The Flames were still burning on the girl’s back. Pieces of shell-like flesh were burned off, and black viscous liquid seeped out from it, emitting a fishy smell. It was like her blood, or like the rotting water from a sewer.
The black mucus touched the flame and the liquid flame that was difficult to extinguish gradually extinguished.
Roar!
Aisha growled and pounced on the girl again.
The outline of the girl’s face was clearly visible and her expression became lively. Previously, she deliberately hid the fatal point, but now that the head on her neck had been cut off, this place was exposed, she didn’t care to hide it anymore. At this moment, seeing that Aisha was fearless, her face slightly changed. She glanced at Dudian who was ready to attack and then looked at Aisha who had already pounced on him.
Whoosh!
She immediately rushed to the side.
However, Dudian’s previous rain of attacks not only cut off her head and cut her body, but also cut off three of her lower body’s claws and legs. In addition to the previous battle, he had severely injured two and a half of her strange legs, at the moment, she could barely use her two legs, so her running speed was obviously not as fast as before.
Aisha roared and chased after her. She opened her mouth and shot out a mouthful of liquid flame.
The speed of the flame was faster than her own speed. The girl wanted to change directions quickly, but her only two intact legs could barely make her run in a straight line. Even when she turned the corner, she felt that her body was shaking, and she was somewhat out of balance, she couldn’t adapt to it at the moment, so she could only look at the liquid flame rushing in front of her. She puffed up her cheeks and spat out a mouthful of thick black mucus, which actually canceled out the liquid flame.
Dean hadn’t let Aisha make a move before because he thought that if he couldn’t defeat the girl, it would have a magical effect when he retreated. After all, the girl shouldn’t have thought that Aisha would be under his control. The effect of letting Aisha take action was better than he had imagined. He had gained the upper hand in the blink of an eye. The truth was always unpredictable. He immediately took advantage of the victory to pursue and cooperate with Aisha’s pincer attack.
The girl stumbled into the forest not far away. Before she stepped into the forest, Dean and Aisha caught up with her and pincer attacked from both sides.
“You, you can control the King Corpse!”The girl saw Aisha’s strategic attack. She knew that she was under Dean’s control. Moreover, she noticed that every time the king corpse made a new move.., the bell would ring.
The crisp and melodious bell sound.
At the moment, it sounded like a death bell in her ears.
Roar!
Aisha pounced from the right side and bit her. Her beautiful face was full of malevolence.
The girl’s face slightly changed. She knew what would happen if she was bitten by a zombie king. Even if a pioneer level zombie king bit her, she would be infected. Moreover, Aisha was obviously an abyss level zombie king, moreover, her combat strength was comparable to that of the middle abyss.
She immediately dodged Aisha’s attack and waved her sharp claws to parry. However, Dudian suddenly appeared behind her. His blade was as sharp as a knife. Several shadows flashed. The girl couldn’t help but spit out a mouthful of blood and fell forward.
A pair of short wings were cut off from her back. Moreover there were several vertical cracks on her back. Her bones could be seen and blood was flowing.
Dudian was about to take advantage of the situation to chase after her. Suddenly, there was a sharp sound as if something was cutting through the air.
Dudian’s face changed as he stopped his body. He saw a strong wind pass by his nose. If he continued to move two inches forward, most of his nose would be pierced.
Dudian’s perception spread out. He didn’t need to turn his head to see the direction of the strong wind. A burly man slowly walked out. There were two demon-like horns on his head, his body was bronze in color. His muscles were strong and full of explosive power. His body was only half demonized. There was a strange red pattern on his face. It was as if there was lava flowing in his body, it was as if his body had been burnt.
Dudian’s face changed when he looked at the source of heat.
It was as red as blood. It was extremely dense. It was like the Sun in the sky. It was emitting an astonishing amount of heat. The heat spread to more than twenty meters around his body.
“Master of the Abyss?”Dudian’s heart slightly trembled. This kind of heat source was much stronger than the girl’s. The girl didn’t hide her heat source but the amount of heat she emitted was less than half of this, the strength of the girl was superior to that of the abyss.
He thought of the scream of the girl. He didn’t think that the person in front of him was their father!
Dudian was stunned for a few seconds. He looked at the girl who was rushing towards the burly man. His eyes flashed with killing intent. He burst out with speed that was comparable to escaping. He caught up with the girl who was crawling with only two strange legs, the sharp blades of her body were like wings. They wrapped around her body from the back. The tip of the sharp blade was in front of her body. She only needed to use a bit of strength to tear her body into two halves!
The girl stopped. Her face was pale. She felt that the wound on her back was blocked by a sharp blade. It was Dudian’s arm that had been demonized. He only needed to gently stab it and it would pierce through her back, it went straight through her abdomen.
She didn’t dare to act rashly. She stopped in place and looked at the man who was slowly walking towards her. Her eyes were filled with hope.

chapters.title: Chapter 957
chapters.content:
Chapter 957 – Chapter 947: Retreat
“Stop!”Dudian said in a low voice.
The burly man slowly stepped forward. His face was as thin as an axe. There was no expression on his face.
“Stop! !”Dudian growled. A sharp blade stabbed out from his left shoulder and cut the girl’s cheek. The girl screamed in pain but quickly bit her lips.
The man stopped in his tracks. There was a trace of coldness on his expressionless face. He asked in a hoarse voice: “Are you from the Shenluo Empire?”
“Are you her father?”Dudian looked at the man who stopped in his tracks. He was relieved but he was still very nervous. However his expression was indifferent and cold. It seemed that he had nothing to fear, “I heard that you are from the Holy Empire. Are You a traitor?”
The man coldly looked at Dudian. He looked at the girl for a moment and then back at dudian: “Let Her Go. I can let you die a quick death.”
Dudian sneered: “Both of your daughters are in my hands. If you want them to live then you have to do as I say.”He could only act like a ‘kidnapper’, he took hostages to save his life.
The man looked at him in silence: “Are you deserters of the Empire?”
“What do you want to say?”Dudian narrowed his eyes.
“Even if I let you go you won’t be able to survive here. As for returning to the Empire…”there was a trace of ridicule on the man’s cold face: “You should be living a life worse than death.”
“Maybe we are the vanguard of the Empire?”Dudian said with a faint smile.
The man indifferently said: “Not long ago the fire dragon gathered the Beasts to attack the god of War Wall. The scale of this attack is enough to damage the god of war wall. How would we have the energy to send the vanguard to investigate the alien race?”
“You seem to know a lot.”Dudian whispered: “Since you knew that the alien race had summoned the Beasts to attack the god of war wall but didn’t inform us in advance, you are no different from us. You have betrayed the Empire!”
“Betrayed the Empire?”A cold light flashed in the eyes of the man: “The Empire has betrayed me!”
Dudian was startled. His mind quickly turned and his tone softened, “Since we are the same, the enemy of the enemy is a friend. Perhaps we can cooperate. After all, you have killed US and there is no benefit for you. But with us, we have a few more helpers.”
The strong man saw that Dudian intended to make peace. His eyes shined but his expression was still cold: “Whether you can be my friend depends on how much sincerity you have.”
Dudian smiled: “Of course I have sincerity. But forgive me for not letting go of your daughter for the time being. After all, I don’t see your sincerity.”
The strong man stared at him: “What do you think is sincerity?”
“There is no need for oaths and promises. I think we can exchange letters and secret signals. You leave first. I will release your daughters and let them go back. Then we will arrange the location of the letter. We will meet again next time.”Dudian quickly said, it seemed that he was prepared.
The burly man stared at him for a moment. He sighed and whispered: “Your cleverness is making me impatient!”
Dudian was startled.
The burly man’s body suddenly disappeared from Dudian’s retina. He turned into a dark red shadow and appeared in front of dudian.
Dudian’s tensed heart jumped. He grabbed the girl’s sharp blade and quickly pincer attacked her. He believed that when the burly man went to the side to attack him.., he would be able to die together with the girl.
In this moment of life and death, that was all he could think of.
Puff!
Suddenly, a hard object broke through his chest. The violent force shook his body. He felt a cold tearing sensation and a burning pain.
His eyes widened as he looked at the burly man in front of him. One of his arms transformed into a giant claw and penetrated through the girl’s chest, two birds with one stone.
“You…”Dudian was shocked. At the same time, the shadow of death covered his head. He didn’t want to stay in a daze. At this critical moment, his right arm was released and revealed a huge claw that was frozen, he punched at the muscular man.
The muscular man was startled. He raised his other arm to block.
Bang!
The ground shook and the impact spread. The muscular man’s body slightly shook and leaned back more than ten degrees. Dudian’s body suddenly moved back. The giant pincer that was stained with blood came out of his chest, blood sprayed out.
Dudian retreated to the side of Aisha. He looked at the strong man whose arm was undamaged. His heart was shocked and cold.
It should be known that the power of his ice claw was ten times that of his left hand. It was comparable to the full power of the upper abyss. However, the strong man didn’t demonize. He just relied on his human body to block it.
Was this the power of the Lord of the Abyss?
Or was it an even stronger existence?
“Dad, Dad…”the girl looked at the strong man who was hugging her. Her voice was weak as she called out longingly.
The strong man released the demonization of his arm. When the giant pincers returned to his arm, they appeared extremely slender. He pulled them back from her broken chest. There was a trace of gentleness on his cold face, he whispered: “I’m hurting you. Wait for me here.”He used his hand to stroke her hair.
The girl forced a smile. She opened her mouth to say something but coughed out a mouthful of blood.
The Brawny man slowly put her body on the ground. He looked up at dudian. The gentleness in his eyes had long disappeared and was replaced by cold killing intent, but when his eyes fell on Dudian’s huge right arm, he was stunned. The killing intent in his eyes was restrained and he slightly frowned.
Dudian’s eyes were gloomy. He didn’t take the opportunity to escape because he knew that with his legs he wouldn’t be able to outrun the burly man. It would be a waste of his physical strength. He thought of a way to escape but after thinking about it, his brain turned to headache. He still couldn’t think of any hope.
His life ended just like that?
He didn’t feel too sad. He just felt a bit unwilling, regretful, and relieved. He had experienced too many life-and-death situations, so he was numb to this feeling.
The biggest regret was that he couldn’t resurrect Aisha.
This debt could only last until the next life — if there was a reincarnation in this world.
“You are smart to not run away.”The man slowly walked towards Dudian: “Where is Diana? She is the first girl you have caught.”
“She is dead.”Dudian was expressionless. He didn’t intend to use Diana’s life to make a deal. He knew from the moment the man didn’t hesitate to Pierce through the girl’s chest and hurt him, his two daughters might not have such high status in his heart. They wouldn’t let him make mistakes or take risks.
“Do you want to die?”The Brawny man came in front of Dudian and looked down at him.
Dudian saw the distance between them. There was a glimmer of hope in his heart. He expressionlessly said: “Since I have fallen into your hands, I have nothing to say. I have killed people and I am ready to be killed.”
“You think too much.”The man slowly took two steps forward: “But death is not the most terrible thing.”
“What do you want?”Dudian looked up at him, “Torture? Torture? Or get information about the empire from my mouth? If you have these hobbies, I can satisfy you. As for the Empire, I don’t mind telling you what you want to know. After all, I am also a rebel.”
The burly man heard Dudian’s intention to retreat in order to advance. It meant that Dudian still had a trace of survival in his heart. His cold face showed a smile for the first time. He was about to speak when suddenly.., a flash of cold light suddenly whistled past.

chapters.title: Chapter 958
chapters.content:
Chapter 958 – Chapter 948: Ice Taboo
Whoosh!
Two sharp blades suddenly attacked the brawny man from the side.
At such a close distance, Dudian was confident that he could cut off the Brawny Man. The speed of the sharp blades was so fast that he couldn’t see clearly.
Clang! Clang!
Two sharp sounds made Dudian’s eyelids jump. He saw that the Brawny man’s two sharp blades were grasped by the Brawny Man. His palms were covered with complex patterns, it was as if he was wearing a layer of mechanical gloves.
Blood flowed out from the burly man’s palms and slid down the sharp blades. Time seemed to stop at this moment.
The burly man looked down at dudian. His face was expressionless. He twisted his palms and snapped two of Dudian’s limbs. Sticky black blood oozed out from the broken blades.
“Is this your resistance?”The Brawny man quietly looked at Dudian.
Dudian’s heart sank to the bottom of the valley.
If he was caught off guard and the distance between them was so close, he believed that even if the Brawny man was the Master of the Abyss, it would be difficult for him to react. But now he had reacted. Not only was his hand demonized, but he had also caught his sharp blade. This could only mean that he had been prepared. Or his strength was not limited to the Master of the Abyss!
Silence.
Dead Silence.
The burly man looked at Dudian who was silent as if he had taken out his energy. He indifferently said: “Take Me to see Dinah. I can leave your corpse intact or let you die quickly.”His tone sounded like he was ordering, it seemed that he knew that Dudian wouldn’t refuse.
Dudian didn’t refuse. It seemed that no one could refuse in front of absolute power.
“Come with me.”Dudian slowly turned around. He wasn’t worried about exposing his back in front of the strong man. It would be easy to kill him.
The strong man turned around and picked up the girl who was lying on the ground. His movements were gentle. There was a bit of gentleness in his cold eyes. No one would believe that the girl in his arms was injured by him.
Dudian also picked up Aisha’s body. He used the bell to vaguely let her undo the demonization and return to the corpse puppet state. Then he led the way.
Both of them walked along the plains and forests. Their feet stepped on the mud and grass. They were silent as if they were a group of travelers.
“Is your right arm caused by the ice crystals?”The burly man was the first to speak: “How did you come to the god of War Wall? Did you come directly from the god of War Wall?”
Dudian expressionlessly said: “Why can’t you come from the Empire?”
The man laughed as if he was in a good mood: “If the people of the Empire saw your right arm then you would have become a mouse in their hands. Don’t you know that this is a taboo?”
“Taboo?”Dudian was startled. He didn’t think that his right arm would be a taboo in the empire. However, he didn’t think that the strong man would lie to him. It was impossible for the strong man to stay in the giant wall. Most likely he was a senior member of the Empire. He knew more things than Dudian so there was no need to lie to him.
He thought of the Mother Dragon of the Witcher Dragon Clan. Her entire body was frozen. He thought of the Holy See secretly capturing the ‘ice blood disease’patient, he said: “What is there to be afraid of? The worst case scenario is that her body is frozen. Although it is a self-destructive power but it is not enough to be a taboo right?”
The burly man laughed: “It is not unusual for her body to be frozen. However, it is rare for a part of her body to be frozen like you. It has never happened before.”
“What is the difference?”Dudian’s eyes slightly moved. He suddenly noticed that the reason why the burly man didn’t kill him was not because he wanted him to lead the way but because he was interested in his right arm.
“The difference is bigger than you think.”The burly man laughed: “Most people who are infected with ice crystals start from a ‘point’and then spread to the whole body with this ‘point’as the core. That is to say, before the spread, they will be like you. Only part of the body will be frozen. However, the speed of the spread is very fast. Especially when the body is frozen in battle, the ice blood will flow all over the body and the whole body will be frozen!”
“However, it seems that there is no sign of diffusion. How did you do it?”
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he slowly said: “Maybe I was lucky.”
“This is not something that can be explained by luck.”The burly man said in a meaningful tone.
Dudian was silent and didn’t speak again.
The burly man didn’t ask any more questions. It seemed that they were just casually chatting.
A moment later, Dudian arrived at the place where they were staying. He felt the smell of Zach and Jason. He frowned and slowly led the burly man up the mountain.
“Eh?”
The burly man’s figure suddenly moved halfway up the mountain. He rushed out from Dudian’s side and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
The next moment, there were two screams coming from the top of the mountain.
Dudian was silent. He had seen through the heat source that Zac and Jason had noticed that he had returned. Moreover, they had also noticed that something was wrong. He deliberately chose to walk slowly so that the two of them could escape.
However, he didn’t expect that the burly man would also notice that the two of them hadn’t escaped far before they were caught by the burly man.
He tightened his fingers slightly and slowly led Aisha up the mountain.
He did not take the opportunity to escape. With the burly man’s speed, he reckoned that he would be caught before he reached the foot of the mountain. Moreover, he knew what the burly man would see when he went up the mountain, so he did not want to make unnecessary struggles to anger him at this time.
When he reached the top of the mountain, he saw Zahit and Jason lying on the ground, groaning in pain. Both of their legs were broken and bent at a terrible angle. The bones inside were protruding out of the skin, the broken bones were stained with bone fragments.
Not far away from the two, the burly man stood like a black tower. His body was exuding a terrifying murderous aura. His back was facing him and his head was lowered. In front of him was Daina who was lying on the grass nest… Daina who was left with only her upper body and no hands.
From a distance, Dudian could feel the terrifying murderous aura coming from the burly man’s body. It was shocking. All the pores on his body felt a chill.
“Dudian, you… You Bastard!”
“I will kill you!”
Jason and Zac couldn’t help but roar as they saw Dudian climb up the mountain.
“You have betrayed us! You will die a horrible death!”
“Even if you die, I Will Curse You!”
Both of them stared at Dudian. They were full of hatred and resentment. They wanted to eat Dudian alive.
Dudian was silent. He wanted to say “I don’t have a choice”but he felt that there was no need to say it. Did he expect them to forgive him? So what if he forgave them? When death was in front of him, everything would become dull.

chapters.title: Chapter 959
chapters.content:
Chapter 959 – Chapter 949: Base
“Dad, Dad…”a weak voice came out of Dana’s mouth. Her eyes were full of excitement, grievance, and relief, tears flowed out from the corner of her eyes. No one knew what kind of humiliation and torture she had suffered during this period. Compared to the physical pain, the psychological trauma that Zac and Jason had given her was the most painful.
But she endured it.
The reason why she had such tenacious willpower was because she knew that once Dudian and the others succeeded, it would endanger the life of her “Father”. Even if she knew that Dudian and the other two were not her father’s opponents.., she would never allow her father to suffer a little danger.
At this moment, she felt that everything was worth it as she looked at the strong man standing in front of her. She was looking forward to this moment and fantasized that it was finally here!
Jason and Zach were stunned as they heard Diana’s voice. They turned their heads and looked at Diana who was standing on the grass in front of him. After a long time both of them turned their heads stiffly. They looked at each other and slowly turned to Dudian. They saw Dudian gently shaking his head. There was a trace of coldness in his eyes.
Both of them were stunned on the spot. Their mouths were slightly open but they couldn’t say anything.
At this moment, they understood that Dinah wasn’t crazy. From the beginning to the end, their plan was in Dinah’s eyes.
Both of them couldn’t blame Dudian. Their eyes were full of despair.
“Daddy is here.”The strong man slightly squatted down. His voice was low and hoarse. He gently picked up Dinah as if he was holding a newborn baby. His face was as gentle as an axe: “I’m here to take you home.”
“I finally… waited for you.”Daina revealed a sweet smile with a hint of tiredness on her face. She slowly closed her eyes and fell asleep.
She had been putting in a lot of effort these days, and she had not had a good rest. At this moment, she finally could not hold on anymore.
The burly man kissed her forehead gently and looked at her gently.
For a long time, a long time.
He slowly turned around, and the gentleness on his face had turned into an expressionless indifference. His gaze fell on Zaite and Jason who were on the ground.
“Sir, sir, it wasn’t me who did it. It was him. It was them who did it. I tried to persuade them but they didn’t listen to me…”Zac’s face was full of despair. He kneeled towards the burly man, his face was full of begging as he pointed at Jason and Dudian: “Please let me go. I am willing to do anything for you, even if it is to be your pathfinder stone.”
“You!”Jason was furious but at the same time he was terrified. He climbed towards the Brawny Man, “Sir, it was his idea. It has nothing to do with me. I have a lot of information to give you. I know the flaws of the god of war’s wall. I also know the secrets of the Empire. Please let me go. I can be your subordinate and help you with anything…”
Both he and Zach knew that crying and begging were not enough to make people soft-hearted. In fact, it would only make people upset. However, benefits were available. So they tried their best to tell the man that they had value and could bring him help.
The man looked at the two of them expressionlessly. After a moment he slowly opened his mouth: “How did you hurt her?”
It seemed that the two of them had found a gap. They rushed to talk about dudian, “He launched a sneak attack and cut her in half. We were going to follow her to see you but he suddenly attacked us. We saw that he had already done so. It is impossible to continue to see you. We can only accompany him to the end. It was all his doing!”
The burly man squinted his eyes as he looked up at dudian.
Dudian was covered in cold sweat but he didn’t say anything to explain. The burly man’s eyesight was so good that even if they didn’t say anything, he would be able to guess what was going on.
“Blood must be repaid in blood. I will let you live but you won’t be able to escape.”The tone of the strong man was calm. There was no anger or coldness in his tone.
Zasit and Jason were startled. They felt a chill coming from their arms. They turned around and saw that both of their arms had fallen to the ground.
The pain was like needles stabbing into their brains. Both of them screamed but didn’t dare to scream too loudly.
They had controlled the life and death of many people so they knew what kind of scene they didn’t like to see.
The Brawny Man’s body didn’t seem to have changed. Even Dudian who had been watching him didn’t see how he attacked. The Brawny man looked at the two who were in pain but didn’t dare to shout. There was a trace of coldness in his eyes. He glanced at dudian: “Take them back with me.”
He turned around and walked away.
Dudian sighed in his heart as he walked towards Zach and Jason. Both of them looked up at him. There was anger in their eyes but they restrained themselves. Dudian lifted them one by one.
Both of them looked at the arms on the ground. They wanted to ask Dudian to help them pick up the arms but they didn’t dare to. As long as the arms were there there was a possibility of healing. But since the strong man wanted to cut off their arms, if he saw that they were still holding onto the idea of reattaching the broken arms, it was hard to guarantee that they wouldn’t do anything else.
While both of them were hesitating, Dudian had already picked them up and followed the footsteps of the strong man.
There was silence along the way.
Occasionally monsters would jump out of the soil and attack the strong man in front of them. However the strong man didn’t move as the monster’s body broke. Blood splashed and fell to the ground.
Dudian and the others returned to the iron-smelting plain at dusk. They passed by the underground mine and underground furnace where they were smelting steel, the three of them immediately saw the footprints of the burly man and another pair of small feet. Obviously, they had been here for a long time.
“Did you do this?”The burly man asked as if nothing had happened.
“I did it.”Dudian replied.
“You know about smelting? What did you do in the past?”The burly man’s tone was flat. It seemed that he was just chatting.
Dudian felt that the man was temperamental. He whispered: “I have studied tailoring and medicine. I also know a little about smelting and purification.”
“I have learned a lot.”The man indifferently replied.
“I’m just casually learning.”Dudian humbly replied.
Compared to the other abyss who focused on hunting and fighting as well as monsters and politics, he was rich in life skills. Moreover, he knew more than that, however, he didn’t say everything out loud. He wanted to leave some cards for himself. Although the situation was bad enough, but who knew if there was any hope of survival?
Zasit and Jason heard the conversation between the two. Their eyes were gloomy. Both of them attacked Dinah. Moreover, Dudian was the mastermind. Why did they end up in the worst situation? On the contrary, Dudian seemed to be fine.
However, they could only think about it. They weren’t stupid enough to complain to the burly man.
After a while, they went along the plain and came to the edge. There was a bare mountain. The mountain was filled with strange rocks.
The burly man stopped and found a sandy land. He stretched his hand into the sand and pulled it up. The sand quickly slid down. A black iron cover was lifted. There were dark stairs leading to the depths of the underground.
“Go in.”The burly man turned to Dudian and said.
Dudian took Aisha and took Zac and Jason inside. With the dark vision, they wouldn’t trip.
The burly man also stepped in. He closed the iron cover and blocked out the last light.
They walked down the stairs for about twenty meters. There were no more steps in front of the stairs. There was a two-meter wide path. There was a heavy iron gate at the end.
Dudian used his X-ray vision to scan the place and found that it was an underground base made of steel and concrete.

chapters.title: Chapter 960
chapters.content:
Chapter 960 – Chapter 950: Experiment Subject
The burly man passed by Dudian and pressed on the wall next to the iron gate.
Dudian had seen through the x-ray vision that there was a secret compartment inside the wall which was connected to the bearing and lead wire. As the burly man pressed on the loose wall, the iron gate slowly opened and opened to both sides. There were hidden sharp blades and poisonous arrows waiting to be fired. If someone forcefully broke the iron gate, it would trigger the mechanism.
Behind the Iron Door was still a dark world. Everything was hazy in the darkness. But Dudian could clearly see that there was an extremely spacious room. There were sofas and tables made of animal hair and cloth, there were also several rows of bookshelves and several spacious tables. There were messy papers piled on them. In addition, there were several strange instruments in the open space of the room.
Dudian recognized one of the instruments. It was a microscope.
From the shape and steel, it seemed that it came from the old era.
The burly man wiped the wall as he entered the room. The room suddenly lit up with a dazzling light. The color was orange and yellow. After his eyes adapted to the light, he felt that the light was gentle and warm.
Zac and Jason were shocked when they saw the sudden light. Their eyes widened in surprise.
The burly man gently put Diana on a sofa and covered her with the animal hair blanket. He turned around and put the girl on the other sofa. He bent over and put her down.
Dudian’s eyebrows twitched as he heard the burly man’s voice.
The burly man frowned as he looked at the girl. Her face was red but not shy. It was as if she had a fever. Her eyes were closed as she frowned in pain, at the same time, a large amount of hot sweat was oozing out from her forehead.
He reached out to touch her arm, then reached into her clothes to touch her back. However, he felt a moist, hot sweat on his hand.
If it was an ordinary person, he would immediately think that she had a cold and fever with such symptoms. However, who was the young girl? How could she possibly catch a cold and have a fever? With her resistance, the bacteria that caused the fever could be easily wiped out.
The burly man suddenly thought of something. He lifted the girl’s eyelids and saw that her eyes were full of blood capillaries. The ends of the blood capillaries were faintly black.
The burly man was shocked. He withdrew his hand and turned his head. His eyes fell on Dudian who was at the door.
Dudian saw his expression and said with a bitter expression: “It’s not my fault. I just want to save my life.”
The burly man coldly looked at him. He glanced at Aisha and coldly said: “If I’m not wrong, if I didn’t meet her, would you use the zombie virus to deal with me?”
Dudian reluctantly said: “How could it be? Even if we had the courage, we wouldn’t dare to attack you.”
“Really?”The burly man sneered: “If we didn’t dare to, why would we go in such a big circle and come back here?”
Dudian could only shut his mouth. Since the Brawny man had guessed it, there was no need for him to continue to hide it.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
There was only the sound of heavy breathing in the quiet room.
The sound came from the girl’s mouth. Her chest was rising and falling faster and faster. Her heartbeat was increasing and the blood flow in her body was also increasing. This also caused her body temperature to rise rapidly. If one looked carefully.., they would find that her white teeth had become sharp like canine teeth.
Zach and Jason saw the girl’s appearance.
The burly man looked at dudian: “I will deal with you later. You three wait here.”He picked up the girl from the sofa and quickly went into the room, he opened another door and went in.
Bang! The door was closed. The sound made Zac and Jason Tremble. Both of them were frightened.
Zac was surprised as the burly man left: “Is she infected with the virus?”
Dudian threw both of them onto the ground and sighed: “I met her on the road. I didn’t need any means to save my life. I was already dead. I had no choice but to protect myself.”
Zach and Jason looked at each other.
They had touched the reverse scale of the strong man when they had kidnapped Dina. Now their second daughter had fallen into their hands. Moreover she had been infected by the zombie virus, the situation was worse than Dina’s.
They didn’t dare to imagine what kind of anger they would have to endure.
Dudian saw through the x-ray vision that the man came out of the room. He sent the girl to a huge laboratory and locked her in a cage.
There were many other cages there. Many strange things were locked in there, including the undeads.
At the moment the girl had become one of them.
He was in a complicated mood. He couldn’t say whether he was happy or disappointed, but he was mostly disappointed. It wasn’t because the strong man didn’t care about family. It had nothing to do with him, but because he had left something behind, he had expected to see a glimmer of hope from the strong man, but he didn’t expect that he would be helpless against the virus.
The strong man went straight to the sofa and sat down. He picked up a towel and wiped his hands. He looked up at Dudian, Zasit and Jason: “Do you know why I didn’t Kill You?”
The three of them were silent. They didn’t dare to speak out even if they had a guess.
The burly man casually said: “One of my two daughters was injured and the other was infected by the virus. Basically they are dead. One of them is dead and the other is injured. Killing you alone is not enough to vent the hatred.”
The three of them felt their hearts sink.
Zach carefully said: “My lord, this is all caused by him alone. He is the main culprit and we are at most accomplices. I am willing to do anything for you. I am absolutely loyal to you. I hope you can forgive my mistake.”He spoke in an extremely sincere manner, his posture was low as if he had become the servant of the Brawny Man.
Dudian’s expression didn’t change as he heard Zach’s words.
The burly man’s eyes fell on Dudian as if he didn’t hear Zach’s words. He slowly said: “You only need to do one thing for me. If you are lucky then you might be able to survive.”
Zach and Jason’s eyes lit up. Although they knew that this matter might be difficult but they saw hope.
Hope always made people excited.
Dudian was silent like a stone. He didn’t have any expression on his face.
“Sir, I will do my best!”Zac quickly said.
“Me too.”Jason didn’t want to be outdone.
The burly man nodded: “I happen to lack some abyss level experimental materials. You three stay here and accompany me to finish my experiment. I hope you can live until the end.”
“Experiment?”
“Experimental materials?”
Zaite and Jason were stunned. The excitement on their faces instantly collapsed.

chapters.title: Chapter 961
chapters.content:
Chapter 961 – Chapter 951: Imprisonment
In the divine wall, Zaite and Jason had more or less come into contact with the Monster Research Institute, so they naturally knew how terrifying the experiments they conducted were.
