And the strong man said that they were used as experimental materials, so naturally they conducted experiments on humans, or experiments on magical modifications. These experiments sacrificed more people every year than even those who died in the war, however most of the people used in these experiments were vagrants or poor people. So the effect on the peace and stability of the wall was not obvious.
Dudian’s eyes were gloomy. He had expected that the strong man would bring them back instead of killing them. But he didn’t expect that he would treat them as experiments. He thought about what Dinah said when he was interrogating her. Her father liked to do experiments. It seemed that the burly man’s experiment level was extraordinary.
“Sir, why don’t we find other Abyss Level Warriors for You?”Zachet’s desire to live was very strong, “I can go to the god of War’s wall and lure the soldiers there to attack us. Then we can take the opportunity to bring them back as captives. We Won’t defect to them so you can trust us.”
“Yes!”Jason’s eyes lit up, “With the cooperation of the three of us, we can lure the Abyss over. You can easily capture them. We can be the bait so that your experimental materials will be endless.”
He winked at Dudian to persuade him.
Dudian was silent and didn’t speak.
The burly man didn’t wait for Zach to continue to speak. He raised his hand to interrupt them, “Of course I have considered this point. But the alien race has just invaded the god of war wall so they won’t invade wantonly for the time being. The Warriors on the god of war wall won’t easily come down to hunt you. Even if they want to hunt you down, they will come down as a small team.”
“But there is still you!”Zaitt hurriedly said, afraid that he would give up on this idea.
The Brawny Man shook his head. “The secrets inside the god of war wall are much more than you can imagine. Once I get close to it, I will be detected. This is the empire’s border defense. Do you think the sensing device here will be so weak?”
Zaitt and Jason were stunned and could not say a word.
They suddenly thought that the Brawny man was hiding outside the border but not doing experiments in the wall. Most likely he was the same as them. He couldn’t stay in the wall or he was expelled, they didn’t dare to easily expose their identities.
If there was an opportunity, they could use this information to exchange for a chance to live. However the other side wouldn’t let them leave this place.
“My name is Boro. You can call me doctor in the future. As for your names, I have no interest to know. You are number one, number two, and number three.”The strong man pointed at Zach, Jason, and dudian, he got up and went to the shelf next to them. He opened the drawer and took out three small bottles of purple liquid.
Boro looked at the three of them: “One bottle each. Drink it.”
Zac and Jason looked at each other with hesitation.
“Is this the experiment?”Zac carefully asked.
Boro’s eyes turned cold: “Don’t waste my time. I’ll give you ten seconds. Don’t force me to do it.”
Zac and Jason bit the bottle. They hesitated for a moment. They closed their eyes and drank the bottle.
Dudian picked up the bottle. His eyes flashed as he opened the Cork and poured it into his mouth.
Zac looked at himself as he put down the bottle. He suddenly felt uncomfortable. There was a sharp pain in his buttocks. He turned his head but didn’t see anything. He felt that all the blood in his body was rushing to his buttocks, then, the blood suddenly flowed backward. It almost made him spit out a mouthful of old blood. After he held it in, he felt his limbs go weak. It was as if he had not slept for months. His whole body could not lift up, and his spirit was scattered, he could not even lift his eyelids.
He was so tired.
Zasite’s will could not gather and struggle. He slowly closed his eyes.
Plop. He fell down.
Not long after he fell down there was another thud. Jason also fell down.
Dudian’s body swayed as he fell down.
Boro coldly looked at him: “Number Two and number three, you two stand up!”
Number Two was Jason and number three was dudian. There was no reaction.
Boro sneered. He took out two bottles of purple liquid from the drawer. At the same time he took out a copper syringe. He grabbed Jason’s shoulder and sucked the syringe into the purple liquid, then he injected the syringe into Jason’s shoulder.
Jason’s body trembled when the syringe was inserted into his shoulder. He wanted to struggle but the strong man’s knee suddenly pressed against his back. He was unable to resist and was quickly injected with the purple liquid.
Dudian didn’t expect that Jason didn’t swallow the syringe but deliberately pretended to be unconscious. He didn’t expect that his and Jason’s performance would be seen through. He thought that from the looks of it.., there was no problem with his reaction. Could it be that Jason had the same perspective as him?
He slowly sat up as he thought. Boro had finished injecting the syringe into Jason’s body. He turned around and saw Jason sitting up. Boro wasn’t surprised as he expressionlessly sucked the syringe into the purple liquid. He grabbed his arm and injected it into Jason’s body.
Dudian felt a sharp pain in his chest. It was the location of his magic marks. The blood in his body seemed to concentrate towards his chest. The pressure made his heart beat violently. He couldn’t breathe but the next moment.., all the blood seemed to have dispersed. He felt weak and extremely tired. He clenched his teeth and tried to hold on. But in the end his vision turned black. His brain buzzed and he fell down.
He shouted out the last thought in his mind as he hit his head on the ground. It sounded more like a dream. “Don’t hurt her. I. . . I know…”
Before he finished his words, he was completely unconscious.
Boro looked at the unconscious Dudian and glanced at the beautiful figure standing next to him, “Even if you don’t say it, I will keep her. It’s the first time I’ve seen such a strange King Corpse.”
Cold, his limbs were cold!
When Dudian woke up again, he found himself in a pitch-black cage.
He was stunned for a moment. He turned around but didn’t see Aisha. His heart was beating fast. He clenched his teeth and stood up. He felt weak in his limbs but he still took a few steps forward, he grabbed the iron pillar in front of the cage and shouted: “Boro! Boro!”
Roar! Roar!
Hiss, hiss!
The response to Dudian was a roar of beasts and strange sounds.
Dudian noticed that he wasn’t the only one in the silent cell. Zac and Jason were in the next two cages. Both of them seemed to be in a coma, he also saw the girl who was infected by the virus. But at the moment she had completely woken up. She was wandering in her own cell. Her hands and feet were shackled as if she was a walking corpse.
His shout naturally startled the girl. She immediately jumped onto the iron pillar of the cage. She grabbed onto the iron pillar and screamed at Dudian. Her eyes were pure black and she had turned into a king corpse.
Dudian was startled. He noticed that there were other strange monsters in the cage next to her. They were struggling in the cage and hitting the iron bars.
“This is the previous cell.”Dudian was startled. He suddenly found that his vision wasn’t clear. The light in the cell wasn’t pure black. There were several electric lights on the wall and there were several light bulbs hanging in the middle of the corridor, he could only see the place where the light was shining but he couldn’t see the shadow in the depths of the cell.
His usual dark vision seemed to have failed.

chapters.title: Chapter 962
chapters.content:
Chapter 962 – Chapter 952: I Used To Be The King
Dudian found out that he had lost not only dark vision but also power and magic marks. He only had physical strength but it was greatly weakened. He was only at the level of a pioneer. He didn’t have the ability to add the splitter’s magic marks. It was like… The Magic Marks had been removed from his body.
But the magic marks on his chest were still intact. He thought that the purple liquid injected into his body should have suppressed his magic marks ability.
“I don’t know if it is permanent or time-limited.”Dudian thought. It was the first time he had encountered such a magical drug that could make an abyss lose the magic marks ability.
Creak.
The door of the cell was pushed open and burly Boro walked in. He gently snorted. In an instant, the noisy cell became silent. The terrifying shadows in the cells trembled and stopped making noise, only the corpse girl who was biting the iron bars was crouching in the depths of the shadows. Her pure black eyes were filled with malevolence and brutality.
Boro looked at her and sighed. He walked along the corridor to her cell and looked at her quietly.
The girl reached out from the cell and scratched. She was full of bloodlust.
Boro stared at her for a moment. He slowly turned his head and looked at dudian, “Do you know how to control undeads?”
Dudian was silent. He didn’t deny it.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to cover up the secret, but that he couldn’t. Although Boro looked rough on the outside, but he was meticulous. On the way back, he would be able to see through Aisha’s abnormality. After all, Aisha was following him like a shadow. It was a strange thing.
“Did you get this method from the Empire or from the ruins?”Boro didn’t directly ask about the method, but suddenly asked about the source.
Dudian looked at him: “Where is she?”
“She is very good.”Boro looked at him: “She seems to be a puppet without your control.”
“She is not a puppet.”Dudian immediately corrected him.
“I said she seems to be.”Boro casually replied.
“She is not!”Dudian replied in a deep voice.
Boro slightly frowned. There was a hint of understanding in his eyes, “Is she your lover? Or a relative? I have seen many cases like yours. It is not rare to be infected with the virus in this world. There are always some people who have their friends or relatives infected with the virus but they are helpless. Even I can’t change the people infected by the virus.”
There was a trace of pain in his eyes but it was hidden very deeply, he continued: “However, you are the first one to be able to control the people infected by the virus. Even the group of despicable nerds in the Empire couldn’t find a way. If you want to live a better life, you can tell me about this method.”
Dudian was silent.
Boro seemed to be very patient. He quietly looked at Dudian and waited.
After a moment, dudian slowly said: “This method is not strange. It’s just that you are focused on drugs and research.”
“Oh?”Boro was interested.
“Do you know ‘Conditioned Reflex’?”Dudian looked at him. Although it seemed that he had mastered this method and it was his trump card to survive, but he knew that even if he didn’t say it, the latter would have a way to make him confess, for example, using Aisha to coerce him or using drugs to destroy his willpower.
Although he thought that he was strong enough, reality could easily break his stubborn shell. Just like how many strong-willed people would bow their heads in front of the poor.
“Conditioned reflex?”
Boro was stunned. He had studied biology for many years and naturally knew the most basic knowledge. At this moment, he knew what was going on. He couldn’t help but laugh.
“I didn’t expect that such a simple thing would be placed in front of us. Everyone turned a blind eye to it. It’s a good conditioned reflex. Haha…”Boro couldn’t help but laugh. However his laughter was full of ridicule, he didn’t know if it was self-mockery or ridicule.
Boro looked at Dudian with appreciation in his eyes: “Using conditioned reflex to control undeads. You really can think of it. The training process must be extremely painful and difficult right?”
“It’s alright.”Dudian wasn’t proud or happy, he said in a calm tone: “Compared to your research, this is just the tip of the iceberg. I’ve heard that you can clone life but I’ve never seen it before. I didn’t expect that you have put this rumor into practice. Moreover, it is so successful. If you were still in the Empire, with this achievement alone, you should be above ten thousand people. You are only second to the Seven Kings.”
Boro slightly raised his eyebrows and sneered: “Even if I didn’t have this, I would be above ten thousand people. Seven Kings? Hey, I used to be a king, but…” Boro frowned as if he thought of something unpleasant. He stopped talking.
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he heard Boro’s words. was he a King? ! Boro was a King? !
Boro snorted as he looked at Dudian in disbelief, “What’s so strange about a king? They are just a bunch of cowards who are struggling to survive. The funny thing is that everyone thinks they are great heroes. They worship and love them. They are willing to be driven like cows and horses. It’s ridiculous!”Boro’s face was full of ridicule, there was also disgust and contempt.
Dudian was startled. He asked: “Struggling to survive? They are the strongest existence in the human race. Do they need to be so humble?”
Boro heard his words. He sneered but didn’t say anything more, he said: “I’m telling you this because you are honest. You told me how to control the undeads. You Don’t need to know anything else. It’s not a level that you can come into contact with. It’s useless to know. Ants have the lives of ants. They don’t know how high the sky is. They are happy to spend every day. Why think so much?”
Dudian was silent. He wanted to say that he was an ant or a dragon? However it seemed that he was the one who had the final say. If he killed Dudian then he would be an ant. He would be an ant in the wilderness, what was a mere abyss? It was just a star in the vast sea of stars. Who would notice it?
Dudian stopped bolo as he saw him ready to leave: “Have you removed my magic marks? What kind of experiment are you going to do with me?”
“If you don’t remove it then what use do you have?”Bolo turned his head and looked at him, “But your current state is no different from having your magic marks removed. I advise you to be honest. Don’t try to run away. There are many mechanisms here. Be careful not to lose your life.”He turned and walked away.
Dudian was disappointed as he saw that burrow didn’t mention anything about the experiment. But he knew that burrow wouldn’t say anything to him. After burrow left he turned to look at Zac and Jason who were lying in the two cages, “Did you hear that?”
Zac and Jason slowly sat up. Jason sighed: “It seems that we are going to die here.”
“This person was actually a King!”Zac’s eyes were still filled with shock. He said with lingering fear, “We actually tried to kill a king before. This is simply crazy!”
Jason laughed bitterly. He suddenly thought of something and said, “I seem to have heard that there was once a king who defected from the Empire. Could it be him?”
Zac looked at him in shock. “Where did you hear that from?”
“A wall master.”Jason sighed again: “Now we can only leave it to fate.”
Zach’s face was gloomy: “I should have followed Diana. I wouldn’t have become a prisoner.”
Dudian glanced at him: “The other side brought us here to save time. They had planned to make us their guinea pig when they noticed us.”
“At least we will be treated better than now.”Zach looked at him in anger. He was angry at Dudian but because Dudian’s strength was higher than his he could only swallow his anger and obey Dudian’s will, but at the moment they were prisoners. He wasn’t afraid that Dudian would dare to attack him. Moreover Boro had said that they didn’t have any fighting power.
“Stupid!”Dudian snorted.
“It’s all your fault!”Zac gritted his teeth as he looked at him.
“Enough!”Jason growled as he stared at Zac, “What’s the use of arguing now?”? Moreover Dudian was right. Don’t you see that the person in front of us is her daughter? If he really had deep feelings for his daughter then he would have tortured us to death. Even if he kept the value of the experiment, he would have tortured us to death. It’s better to die than to live. If you want to blame, blame us for not escaping in the first place!”
“Are we going to die if we don’t escape?”
“Aren’t we going to die now?”
“Who knew that the result would be like this?”
“Hehe…”
Dudian sat back in the depths of his cage. He looked at his broken left leg as he gently rubbed the scar. Previously, he had relied on the magic blade to support his left leg, at the moment he had lost his magic ability and became a cripple.
He had been walking by the river and his shoes were wet.
Compared to other hunters who often left the giant wall to hunt, most of them retired with a broken body. He was considered lucky to have lost a leg after so many years.
Dudian stopped thinking about the broken leg. He believed that the technology of the god Luo Empire would be enough to regenerate his limbs. After all, he had been in the giant wall of Sylvia, the top life faction alchemists of the dark church were able to do this. However, the degree of regeneration was relatively small.

chapters.title: Chapter 963
chapters.content:
Chapter 963 – Chapter 953: Meat Soup
The next day.
Boro came to the cell. He opened the cell and took Zac away.
Not long after they left Dudian and Jason heard a faint scream coming from the floor. It seemed to be Zac’s. Their faces turned gloomy.
Dudian could only judge the time by the hunger level of his stomach. But he knew that the longer he stayed in the cell, the more blurred his body functions would be.
At about six or seven o’clock in the evening, the cell was opened. A girl wearing a white dress pushed a metal car and slowly walked in. Dudian and Jason saw her face.
It was Dinah.
But soon, Dudian found that this “Dinah”was not the same person as the first Dinah he met. Although they looked the same, but their temperaments were different, he could tell at a glance.
Dudian was silent as he thought of Boro’s cloning experiment. He didn’t know how many ‘Dana’There were in this underground base.
The white dress ‘Dana’didn’t seem to notice Dudian and Jason. She pushed the metal car and stopped in front of the first row of cages. She opened the white cloth on the car. There were four metal buckets inside. She opened one of the buckets, the smell of meat spread out and caused the shadows in the cages to roar. They didn’t dare to hit the iron bars.
She picked up a metal spoon from under the cart. She scooped out a spoonful of meat soup. There were several pieces of fat floating inside.
The Shadows couldn’t hold back anymore. They began to lick and eat.
Dudian and Jason who had been hungry for a day couldn’t help but feel hungry when they heard the sound.
The girl finished two spoonfuls and pushed the dining cart towards the second row of cages… the entire cell was filled with the sound of licking and swallowing as well as the sound of teeth chewing on bones.
The girl glanced at Dudian. She scooped out a spoonful of meat soup and poured it into the stone trough in front of dudian. She added another spoonful. There were two pieces of cartilage and fat meat. The meat was stained with black fur.
The smell of meat floated out from the stone trough. It was not enough to numb Dudian’s taste after starving for a day. He looked at the meat and meat which were half submerged in the stone trough. He frowned and hesitated for a long time, in the end he picked up the meat soup and drank it. He grabbed the meat and stuffed it into his mouth. He didn’t dare to taste the strong smell of meat. He simply chewed a few mouthfuls and swallowed it.
He felt disgusted when he ate the pieces of fat meat covered with black fur. However, his face was dark as he pulled off the fur and ate it.
The taste was difficult to describe. Since he came out of the slums in Sylvia, he rarely felt that the food was so hard to swallow.
“What… What is this? !”Suddenly, Jason’s trembling voice came from the side.
Dudian’s heart tightened. He turned his head and saw Jason lying in front of the stone trough. He spat out something from his mouth. The light from the top of the corridor shone on it. Dudian’s pupils shrank as if he was struck by lightning.
It was a finger that had been chewed!
A human finger! !
Dudian felt as if his stomach was suddenly hit by a fist. It rolled in an instant and the gastric juice rushed to his throat. He covered his mouth and clenched his teeth. The veins on his face bulged and slightly twitched, he took a deep breath and swallowed the things that rushed to his throat and mouth. Then he felt as if he was exhausted. He leaned against the iron bars and panted.
Dudian saw this scene and his mind suddenly moved.
The girl pushed the dining cart to the last row of the cell. She scooped everything out and pushed the cart back. She saw Jason vomit on the ground. She curled her lips as if she was sneering but didn’t say anything, she directly left the cell.
“Bastard!”
Jason spat on the ground as soon as the girl left. His face was full of anger and resentment.
Dudian’s eyes were cold. Although they had killed countless people and seen countless limbs and internal organs but they had never thought of eating people. In particular, he had personally eaten people. This feeling was even more disgusting, he even felt that his body had been sullied.
After the anger, Dudian and Jason fell into silence. The cell was extremely quiet. There were only sounds coming from the other cells. It seemed that they were snoring.
Dudian’s mind calmed down. He unconsciously thought of the finger in the broth. Who Did it belong to? Was it Zac’s or someone else’s? Or was there more than just a few of them?
After a long time.
Dudian felt that it was noon the next day but he still didn’t see Tashi being brought back. The girl was pushing the dining cart but this time it wasn’t meat soup, it was weeds, mushrooms and mushrooms.
Dudian looked at the hand-length weeds, a few pieces of mushroom and three palm-sized mushrooms. He couldn’t help but ask the girl: “Can We Eat this thing? It Won’t be poisonous right?”
The girl handed out the corpse “Diana”who looked like her to dudian. She glanced at dudian: “Don’t worry. I Won’t kill you. Daddy will keep you for use.”
Dudian was relieved as he thought that it was true. But looking at the mushrooms and grass which were similar to the weeds that could be seen everywhere outside, he felt that there was no way to eat them.
The girl indifferently said: “It’s not your hand anyway. Why do you care so much?”
Jason clenched his teeth as he waited for the girl to walk in front of him: “I haven’t given you mine!”
“Didn’t You Throw Up Yesterday? Since You Are Not Hungry, you won’t have a share today.”The girl didn’t turn back.
Jason was so angry that he almost died. He stared at her back.
The girl was walking when she suddenly turned her head and her gaze fell on Jason’s line of sight.
Jason’s heart trembled and he quickly averted his gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 964
chapters.content:
Chapter 964 – Chapter 954: Out Of The Cage
By the time the girl left Dudian had finished eating all the mushrooms and mushrooms in his stone trough. The grass which looked like weeds wasn’t as hard to swallow as he had imagined. The taste was bitter but not rough, it was easy to swallow after chewing.
After eating he leaned against the iron pillar and continued to daydream.
Time passed by quickly as he was immersed in his thoughts. When Dudian felt hungry in his stomach, the cell door opened again. It was the white dress of the girl. Her dress was fluttering and her face was serene and beautiful, she looked like an angel. She was almost like a pair of wings and a halo.
The girl pushed the dining cart to feed the cage. Her clothes seemed to float up as she walked. Her well-developed chest carried a different kind of temptation.
However, Dudian’s taste was more mature. He didn’t feel anything towards this kind of young girl. Especially when he knew her true colors under her white dress.
Just like yesterday, two spoonfuls of meat soup were scooped into the stone trough.
Dudian looked at it and slowly moved closer to it.
The girl continued to feed the other cages but jumped over Jason.
After the girl left, Dudian looked up from the stone trough. The meat soup in the stone trough was not reduced at all. He was just pretending to lie down so that the girl would not see him not eating and cut off his lunch tomorrow.
Although he was ruthless enough, but he thought that today’s meat soup might be made from human flesh mixed with the meat of monsters. He felt that it was difficult to swallow. In the case of extreme hunger, his rationality was still there.
“You… Don’t want to eat?”A voice came from the side.
Dudian looked over and saw Jason licking his dry lips. He looked at the stone trough in front of him. His eyes flashed with a trace of heat from time to time.
“You want to eat?”Dudian quietly looked at him.
The heat in Jason’s eyes suddenly disappeared as if he had woken up. He hesitated for a moment, it was difficult for him to say: “I, I don’t want to eat. I just want to drink some soup. I am too thirsty. I was seriously injured and my body is severely dehydrated… can you give me some?”
Dudian was silent. After a while, he slowly reached out his hand and picked up a handful of meat soup. He handed it to Jason from the gap of the iron bars. Jason looked at the meat soup in Dudian’s hands. There was a trace of complexity in his eyes. He whispered “Thank you”and slowly stretched out his head to drink the soup. Dudian could feel that his tongue was licking his palm. It was wet and hot like a dog.
He suddenly felt disgusted but didn’t take his hand away. He silently looked at it. His heart was full of bitterness and deep anger.
He abandoned his dignity and lived in order to survive.
Was every life born in such a tormented fate?
If there was a god, did he create life to play with? !
“Thank you, thank you!”Jason’s words made Dudian withdraw his thoughts. The deep anger gradually buried in his chest. He picked up a handful of broth and handed it to him, suddenly he felt that he was like a lake in the mountains. Occasionally he would be hit by the rain from the sky. But in the end he was calm as if nothing had happened. He looked up at the sky, his posture was reflected.
Who Wasn’t like this?
After eating three servings of meat soup, Jason’s hunger and thirst eased. He saw that Dudian was going to bring it to him. He resisted the temptation and refused. He thanked him and went back to the depths of his cage. He leaned against the wall and didn’t say a word.
Dudian looked at him. He picked up the remaining meat soup and threw it to the other side of the cage. The shadow of the cage was attracted by the meat soup and came over to lick it, dudian saw its appearance by the light. It was a wolf-like monster. However it had three tails. The hair on its tail was thicker. There were sharp horns on the tip of its tail. Moreover, it was under its abdomen, it had shell-like thin limbs that coiled around each other. It seemed to be a hidden weapon.
Soon, the monster finished licking the broth. It looked up at dudian. There was a bit of humanity in its green fluorescent eyes.
Dudian smiled. He grabbed the meat from the stone trough and threw it over.
The monster immediately caught it with its mouth and ate it.
Dudian gave the meat soup and several pieces of skin to the monster. After the monster finished eating, it looked at Dudian. After dudian said “No more”, it was still unmoved, dudian didn’t throw it to the monster again. He turned around and went back to the corner.
The next day.
The girl came back to the cell and distributed weeds and mushrooms to Dudian and Jason for lunch.
“Where is our companion? Why isn’t he back yet?”Dudian took the opportunity to ask her.
“It’s none of your business.”The girl glanced at him and walked away.
Dudian frowned but didn’t ask any more questions.
This went on for four or five days. Dudian only ate weeds and mushroom vegetables at noon and gave the meat soup to the monster next to him at night. The monster’s attitude towards Dudian had changed after eating the meat soup for a few days. It would lean on the iron pillar next to Dudian. Dudian was brave enough to touch its hair but it didn’t resist.
“You look like an unlucky guy who was caught. Your body has been transformed into such a strange shape.”After a few days of observation, Dudian had clearly seen the fine crustacean tissue under the belly of the monster. It should be from the aquatic monster, the monster in the sea was obviously not compatible with the body of the monster but it still grew in its belly.
The three-tailed wolf growled as if it was responding to Dudian.
Dudian sighed. He thought that Boro knew about cloning and organ transplant. Boro must have mastered a lot of technology from the old era. He didn’t know why he betrayed the Empire.
The next morning.
The cell was pushed open. Boro looked tired as he walked in. He glanced at Dudian and Jason and said to dudian: “You, come with me.”He helped Boro to open the Iron Lock of the cage.
Dudian was startled. He didn’t expect that it would be his turn so soon. He couldn’t help but look at Jason who was next to him. He thought that Jason would be in front of him.
“Are you going to do experiments?”Dudian asked as he stood up.
Boro nodded slightly.
“What experiments? I have entered the ruins of the old era. I have found many ancient books. I have learned some things which may help you.”Dudian immediately said.
Boro looked at him, boro shook his head: “You won’t understand. I have long been ahead of the old era in biological research. The information in the ruins doesn’t have much effect on me. It is ridiculous to think about it. The old era has developed for such a long time. The other aspects of technology are so advanced that it is hard to imagine. But there is no progress in the human body. Even an organ transplant is considered a difficult experiment. Not to mention cloning and modifying the gene chain.”
Dudian was startled. He didn’t think that he would know so much about the old era. He thought about the microscope. After all, the latter was once a king, how many ruins were hidden inside? Boro must have seen a lot of things in the ruins. Although his understanding of the old era wasn’t as good as the people of the old era but it wasn’t much different.
“The environment is different. The emphasis is naturally different.”Dudian explained: “The environment in the old era is comfortable. It’s not like now. It’s different from the natural development.”
Boro looked at him with interest, “That’s true. But the real reason is that we humans are hypocritical!”! Those pedantic humans of the old era advocated the idea of humanity and human-oriented shit. Not to mention using human bodies as experimental materials, even apes and orangutans who were biased towards human genes would be banned from experiments! In such a situation, how slow was the progress of the experiment? How much time would it take to change the different materials and adjust the experiment?”
“It can’t be helped. If we were allowed to kill our fellow countrymen, everyone would be in danger.”Dudian frowned.
Boro laughed, “Self-destruction is impossible. Only the weak will be destroyed while the strong will continue to dominate! I remember that many wars broke out in the old era. Why didn’t anyone stand up and say that they respected life? Reason is reason after all. Only honest people think that reason is greater than the heavens! But in fact, the Fist is the greatest! Those who went to denounce after the event, why didn’t they take the Hammer of justice to stop it? Facts have proven that the strong will never follow reason, and only use reason. So forget about the ridiculous talk of harming fellow countrymen and causing mankind to self-destruct. In the end, it’s still hypocrisy. No one has the face to tear off that fig leaf!”

chapters.title: Chapter 965
chapters.content:
Chapter 965 – : Chapter 955: The Path Of The King
“Maybe this is the difference between us and the monsters.”Dudian didn’t argue with him: “You used the Abyss to experiment. Do you want to research the power that surpasses that of a King?”
Boro smiled: “You are not stupid. Come out.”
Dudian stepped out of the cage and followed Boro: “Do you want to become an Aragami?”
“Aragami?”Bolo didn’t look back, he laughed: “Although Aragami are strong but they are out of their essence. I don’t want to become something that isn’t even a ‘human’. Otherwise I will be honest and be my king.”
Something that isn’t even a human?
Dudian was surprised. He thought about the ten meters tall Aragami. It seemed that his previous guess was right. Aragami weren’t human.
“As long as your mind is your own, why should you care if your body is human?”Dudian deliberately said: “Our current posture shouldn’t be considered as human.”
“The alienation of the body is a small matter.”Boro glanced at him, “But some things can affect your thinking. For example, some magic marks will bring strength to the body. They will subtly transform the body so that the colonists will love the fresh blood and meat. In the end, they can only feed on monsters or humans. When they are hungry, they may not be called ‘human’. But after they fill their stomachs, they will return to normal thinking. Such changes can only be considered weak.”
Dudian was slightly startled. He knew that although magic marks couldn’t directly affect the brain but it would change the body. The changes in the body would affect the brain. It was like the smell of fresh blood, the resistance of the brain to the blood might be weakened. It might not feel disgusting anymore. It might even feel delicious and sweet.
“So, the Aragami will affect the thinking, and so will the king?”Dudian asked.
“Of course, the more you get, the more you lose. As for what you lose, it varies from person to person. Some care about it, some don’t.”Boro said indifferently: “But if you originally cherish something, when you become a king, your thinking will change, but you will no longer care about it, then do you still want to become a King?”
Dean was shocked.
His first thought was about Aisha. If… His obsession after becoming a king was no longer to resurrect her or even think that she was unimportant, then what was the meaning of all his efforts?
He suddenly felt that God was playing tricks on him. He was like an ant on a chessboard. He thought that he was taking the right step, but he didn’t know that there was an invisible “Line”under his feet!
How many people had forgotten what they wanted in the process of growing up?
Perhaps it was like a fish in a ditch. When it rushed into the river, it could only move in the same direction as the waves of the river. There was no way to go against the current or change it. It could only drift with the current.
“Stop is the abyss, forward… or the abyss.”Dudian muttered to himself. He was a bit confused.
“We are here.”Boro’s voice came out and pulled Dudian’s mind back.
They left the cell and went through the spacious living room. They went down the stairs from another corridor. Boro pushed open the heavy door in front of him. There was a bright laboratory inside. The walls were made of white aluminum, there were many instruments and three hospital beds inside.
Dudian looked at one of the experimental beds and saw Zaite’s figure lying on it. But at the moment his appearance was very strange. Other than half of his face, his body was completely unrecognizable, there was a black thigh-thick body protruding from his abdomen. It looked like the tail of a very thick poisonous snake. His broken arm was connected to the swollen tissue. It looked like two bloated intestines with a purple surface, it was emitting a fishy smell.
Dudian’s heart slowly sank. He looked at the other parts of the laboratory but didn’t see Aisha. He clenched his teeth and asked in a low voice: “Where is she?”
“Who?”
“Aisha.”
“Is she the corpse king?”Boro reacted, boro chuckled: “It seems that you care about her. Don’t worry. I don’t Lack Corpse Kings so I don’t need to use her for the experiment. Moreover she is different from ordinary corpse kings. She should be a descendant of the Witcher family.”? “This is a rare treasure. After I finish this experiment, it won’t be too late to study it. If I can find something new, maybe…”
He licked his lips and didn’t continue. He went straight to a tall cross next to the laboratory and waved to Dean.
Dean was relieved to see that Aisha was alright for the time being. However, his next words made his heart colder. However, he knew that anger was useless. He restrained his killing intent and slowly walked over.
It was a cross made of steel. There were shackles on it. It seemed to be used for fixing people. The edge of the cross was stained with Rust and blood.
“Go up.”Boro said.
Dean followed Boro’s instructions and stood up.
Boro smiled. He was very worried about obedient experiments like dean. Unlike some experiments which knew that struggling was useless. It was a pity that he accidentally damaged them.
Although he knew that Dudian was sensible, Boro still handcuffed dudian. He pushed a cart from the side. There were various tools and drugs on it. He took out a syringe and a tube of liquid, he injected it into Dudian’s body.
Dudian felt his body gradually become numb.
“Anesthetic?”Dudian opened his mouth. He felt that his tongue was a bit numb. Although he knew that he would become an experiment subject or even be cut open, but he didn’t know how.., he wasn’t afraid. Perhaps he was mentally prepared when he was arrested. But at this moment he was curious about the efficacy of Boro’s anesthetic!
Boro took off his animal fur coat and put on a white coat. He looked like a doctor. He took out disinfectant from the car and sprayed it on a pair of gloves. The air was filled with the smell of disinfectant.
“You are not nervous.”Boro put on the mask and looked up at dudian. He didn’t judge from Dudian’s expression but from his heartbeat and body functions.
“I have done these experiments before but I never thought that I would become someone else’s experiment one day.”Dudian used his numb tongue to continue, “What is the difference between the Abyss and the King? It shouldn’t be the number of polar ice insects.”
“Do you want to know?”Boro took off Dudian’s clothes. Dudian didn’t wear the standard armor from the god of war’s wall. The armor had hindered his transformation and had been discarded long ago, boro easily tore off the shirt and short sleeve that he was wearing. In the blink of an eye he was standing in front of him naked.
Boro took out a silver knife from the small car. It seemed to be made of silver. After disinfection he touched Dudian’s six abdominal muscles and slowly cut them open.
Dudian looked at his body that was cut open. There wasn’t much fear. Maybe it had something to do with the lack of pain. He said: “Of course I want to. I am a dying man anyway. I want to get rid of the confusion in my heart before I die.”
Boro gently smiled. He took a cloth from the side and sprayed an unknown potion on it. He slowly wiped the wound on Dudian’s abdomen. Soon the blood stopped.
“It’s very easy to become a king.”Boro’s hands moved as he spoke. It was boring for him to stay here alone. It was the first time that he met an experiment like Dudian. He was happy to chat with him, boro said: “As long as you find a polar ice worm king or cultivate one yourself.”

chapters.title: Chapter 966
chapters.content:
Chapter 966 – : Chapter 956: The Road Of No Return
“Polar Ice Insect King?”Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. However he thought about it. There were different levels of people. There were kings and dukes. Beasts had territories and occupied land as kings. Naturally there would be kings of insects.
Suddenly he thought of the ship under the Ice Lake where the Polar Ice Dragon lived. The strange thing was stretching like a branch. Could it be that it was the polar ice insect king? !
If it was the polar ice worm king then wouldn’t he miss it?
Was the opportunity to become a king in front of his eyes? !
“Why? Are You Nervous?”Boro felt Dudian’s heart beat faster. Boro looked at him with interest: “Or have you heard of the Polar Ice Worm King? Or have you seen it?”
“It’s impossible to say that I’m not nervous.”Dudian pretended to be calm but Boro could tell that he was pretending, “This is the first time I’ve heard that there is a king among the polar ice insects. It is very difficult to subdue them. I guess the strength of the polar ice insect king is stronger than the Abyss?”
Boro glanced at Dudian, “It is slightly weaker than the Lord of the Abyss. However there are groups of polar ice insects around it. It is very difficult to capture it. Many Abyss lords who have reached the bottleneck go to capture the polar ice insect king but accidentally become the food of the insect king. So the path of the king is not that simple.”
“Why don’t you ask the King for help?”Dudian was curious. He knew that the existence of the Lord of the Abyss was a high-level existence in the empire. The Empire was controlled by seven kings. It was equivalent to dividing into seven camps. There was no neutral faction that didn’t join the king’s faction. It meant that they were enemies with all the kings, it was best to ask the King to help. Once they succeeded and became the new king, it would strengthen the king’s faction. It was the best of both worlds.
“Ask the King to help?”Boro sneered: “If the King knew about the existence of the polar ice worm king, how would he share it with others?”
“Isn’t the King the Limit?”Dudian was surprised: “Is it like the Abyss? The more polar ice worm king you absorb, the stronger you will be?”
Boro sneered, “Of course not. The Lord of the Abyss is the limit for us humans. As for a King… Well, we don’t know if he is a ‘human’or not. They will only destroy the polar ice worm king. For them, a true king is Enough!”
Dudian was stunned, “But aren’t there other races waiting for the opportunity outside the god of War Wall? The more powerful the empire is, the better. One More King, one more power. They can even completely exterminate the alien races. Why should they suppress them? Are they afraid of seizing power? But can’t they think of other ways to suppress them? It should be a supreme honor and vanity to have a king as their slave.”
“What does the alien race have to do with them?”Boro sneered, “Do you think that the alien race can hurt them?”? “The world is so big that even if the empire is destroyed, they will still exist. No one can hold back a king who wants to escape unless the Aragami is resurrected. But that is impossible. The Aragami have long been extinct. Forget it, you don’t understand.”
He continued to dissect Dudian’s abdomen. He slowly removed part of his internal organs and intestines.
Dudian’s face was ugly. One was because of Inboro’s words. The other was because he saw his intestines being pulled out and cut off. Even if his psychological quality was good, he still felt goosebumps all over his body. He was full of horror and fear.
He turned his eyes away from his abdomen to dispel the image in his mind, he continued to ask: “You said that the king couldn’t be considered as a human. What is the reason? Did you say that their thinking has been changed?”
“Almost.”Boro didn’t raise his head as he focused on the things in his hands.
“Is there a big gap between the polar ice worm king and the Polar Ice Worm King? The ones who can become king should be the best among the Masters of the Abyss. They can actually change their thinking. Are there any magic marks that are not affected?”Dudian continued to ask, boro wasn’t afraid to offend him as he didn’t know whether he was dead or alive.
Bolo wasn’t angry. He looked up at Dudian: “Who told you that the reason for the change in your thinking is because of the magic marks?”
“What is that?”
“The polar ice worm king isn’t just a nutrient to provide energy for the human body to evolve.”Bolo’s face was indifferent, “You should know that the vitality of the polar ice worm is so tenacious that it has surpassed all the living things on Earth. The Polar Ice Worm King has reached the extreme in this aspect. There is almost nothing that can destroy it except for the high temperature of the solar level.”
“Lightning, low temperature, and crushing are all useless.”
“No matter how small the crushing is, it is still alive. It lives by crushing individuals. When countless divided individuals get close to it, they will gather and be reborn!”
“I have said so clearly. You should know the reason now, right?”
Dudian was stunned. Suddenly, his face changed.
Although Boro didn’t say it but he had thought of the answer. Nothing could destroy it. It meant that the polar ice worm king wasn’t like the polar ice worm which could become energy and be absorbed by the human body, it could be used as nutrients for evolution.
In other words, when the polar ice worm king was absorbed into the body as nutrients, it would be used as an ovary for the polar ice worm king. The polar ice worm king would grow in the human body and even divide and multiply!
No Wonder Bolo said that a king might not be called a “Human”.
He suddenly felt a chill in his heart. Could it be that the seven kings in the Empire were breeding polar ice worm king in their bodies? ! So the one who controlled their bodies was themselves or the polar ice worm king? !
If this was the only way to advance to a king, wouldn’t it be a road of no return? !
Boro had sewed Dudian’s abdomen while Dudian was in a trance. Boro helped him to get rid of the shackles and carried him to the next bed. Boro took out shackles from the bedside and locked his hands and feet, boro went to another cabinet. There were transparent glass bottles filled with all kinds of strange things. There were eyeballs, strange tongues and a beating heart, there was a huge stomach and so on.
Boro took out a bottle. It was filled with twisted intestines that were about the size of a thumb. He went to Dudian’s bedside and cut open his abdomen. He then opened the lid, he took out the twisted intestines. It seemed that he wanted to connect them to Dudian.

chapters.title: Chapter 967
chapters.content:
Chapter 967 – Chapter 957: God Reproduction
“Is there no way to wipe out the consciousness of the polar ice worm king? Even if its body can survive, it will still be a pile of unconscious cells.”. “Dudian pondered for a moment and asked Bolo. He didn’t care about the strange intestines that were being grafted onto his body.”.
Bolo didn’t expect that dudian would still be thinking about this matter. He looked up at Dudian and said with appreciation: “It would be great if all the experimental subjects were as calm as you. It would save me a lot of effort.”
Dudian’s eyes fell on the crooked intestines in his hand. The color of the intestines was a bit dark. It looked like a suntanned skin but there was a bit of golden light on it, it was as if Golden Sand was smeared on it. Obviously it wasn’t a human’s inner intestine. Even the normal organs of monsters wouldn’t be like that.
“If I could kill the consciousness of the polar ice worm King I would have done it. I have done experiments to research how to erase the consciousness of the polar ice worm king while preserving the nutrients in its body. However I have tried everything but there is nothing. The only way to kill it is the high temperature of the solar level. However it would be burned along with its body. There is no point.”Boro lowered his head again, he carefully operated on Dudian.
Dudian frowned: “How are you going to surpass the king? Are you going to skip the polar ice worm king and replace it with something else?”
Boro looked at him in approval: “Smart!”
“The only way is to replace the polar ice worm king with something else.”He continued: “The undead that you have tamed is the body of a witcher. You should know that a long time ago, human evolution relied on the blood and flesh of monsters to enter the body and change the genes. Later on, because of the characteristics of the parasitic soul worm, it is more convenient than the witcher experiment. The potential is greater and it is easier to popularize.”
“The difference between these two evolution methods is that one is to directly transform the body, while the other is to transform the body and hand it over to the parasitic soul worm. The latter is equivalent to installing a second heart in the body, which is the core that stores energy. Once the core is gone, the energy will also be gone! “On the other hand, in order to strengthen the energy, one needs to strengthen the core. However, the parasitic soul worm is also a living body, so there is a limit
“The Lord of the Abyss is the limit of the parasitic soul worm! If you want to go further then you have to create another core which is the polar ice worm king!”
“So if you want to become a king by your own will then you have to find something else to replace it. For example the Aragami or the blazing soul worm in the body of the Fire Dragon!”
Dudian gradually understood what he meant: “Do you want to use the outdated evolution method of the witcher to mix the power of the Aragami to reach the point of surpassing the King?”
“That’s right!”Boro smiled. This was his proudest idea. Although many people from the monster research institute had thought about it and even experimented on it but there was no progress.
“I remember that there are two kinds of magic marks in your daughter Daina’s body. One is the cold crystal soul worm from the Empire and the other is the flame soul worm from here?”Dudian looked at her thoughtfully, “But her strength doesn’t seem to have reached the level of a king. Shouldn’t she be an incomplete experiment?”
The smile on Bolo’s face disappeared as he heard him talk about Daina, “Yes, they are only fifty percent complete. If they can adapt to the Aragami gene then they should be able to surpass the king and become a new God. They might even be stronger than the Aragami!”
“So the experiment you are going to carry out for me is to colonize the blazing soul worm to their level and then colonize the Aragami’s genes?”Dudian’s face turned cold as he looked at Bolo.
Bolo indifferently replied: “Yes and No.”
“What do you mean?”
“Do you know why no one in the Empire has two magic marks?”Bolo didn’t directly answer but looked at dudian, “Such an experiment is carried out every day in the empire but there is no progress. Soul Worms are very exclusive. There can only be one parasitic soul worm in a body. If a second parasitic soul worm is bred into the body, one of them will become food and be devoured.”
“The reason why I was able to complete the experiment of twin magic marks in their bodies is mainly because of the flame soul worm. This kind of soul worm is completely opposite to the extreme cold soul worm in the empire. In theory, they can not co-exist as one. But the wonderful thing is that they hate each other and repel each other. It makes them reach a wonderful balance like magnetic force.”
“The human body is this magnetic field!”
“Therefore, in order to reach the double magic marks, we must use the soul worm.”
Dudian understood quickly: “One ice and one fire, melt each other and reach a balance. The Empire’s divine court should have studied such a method, right?”It was not difficult to see from Boro’s words, the Divine Court was the Monster Research Institute that he had previously thought of.
Boro sneered: “Of course they know. But what’s the use of knowing? Those guys aren’t allowed to have twin magic marks. It means that there is a possibility that they will have power that surpasses them.”
“Not allowed?”Dudian was startled. He understood that if he was a superior then he wouldn’t allow anything that could endanger him to appear.
“Can the twin magic marks become a King? Is it possible to find the polar worm king and the flame worm king? If so, the king should be stronger than them? “Right, if you eat the polar worm king and the flame worm king at the same time, will they be like the polar worm and the flame worm? Will they cancel each other and reach a balance?”Dudian’s eyes lit up, his eyes lit up.
Boro was stunned, he laughed: “You are talented in this area. But I have thought about it and experimented with it. Unfortunately, the polar ice worm king and the blazing flame worm king are not easy to find. I have experimented with them twice but they have failed. Either the polar ice worm king or the blazing flame worm king has swallowed the polar ice worm king.”
Dudian was stunned as he looked at him. Had he experimented twice? ! Didn’t it mean that he had used up four insect kings? ! One insect king was equivalent to the key to the king’s Gate. If he used it to create kings then he would be able to cultivate four kings! ! !
It must be known that there were only seven kings in the entire Shenluo Empire!
The image of Bolo soared in Dudian’s mind. He was using four insect kings to experiment!
Dudian was stunned, bolo continued to talk: “Although the experiment failed but the idea should be correct. If we can find two polar ice insect kings and blazing flame insect kings with the same strength then maybe we can reach a balance. We can use two magic marks to become a king. Moreover we will have independent consciousness so we won’t be affected or disturbed. It’s just that it is too difficult!”
He couldn’t help but shake his head. There was a trace of regret in his eyes.
Dudian reacted and was about to ask but he realized that it was indeed too difficult! It was extremely difficult to find one worm king. It was like a peerless treasure. It all depended on luck, not to mention finding two!
Moreover, the strength of two worm kings was exactly the same. It was the same as finding two people with the same physical quality in the Sea of people. It was impossible to find two people with the same physical quality in terms of the number of humans! After all, there were thousands of people with similar physical quality. However, it was impossible to find people with the same eyesight, hearing, vision, strength and combat experience that could determine the outcome of a battle.
Moreover, the number of insect kings was very small. If they were a bit stronger, they might be able to win the battle.
After a while, Dudian felt a strange feeling coming from his abdomen. It was like numbness. However, he had been anesthetized so he couldn’t feel anything. He couldn’t feel the other parts of his body, he looked down and saw that Boro was lying on his abdomen. The light was too dim so he couldn’t see the situation inside his abdomen.
He thought for a moment but didn’t mention the numbness. He continued to ask: “Since the magic marks can’t become the king, what are you going to do now? According to your previous statement, there is no way to do it.”
Boro seemed to have heard nothing. He was concentrating on the task at hand.
Dudian began to think. He felt that if he could live, this might be the problem he would face in the future.
After a long time, Boro’s voice came again: “Who said that two magic marks is not enough? Did I say it? I didn’t say it. Two magic marks is the only way to become a true king!”
Dudian retracted his thoughts and found that Boro had stitched his belly. The surgery seemed to have finished. He felt that his abdomen was warm. At the same time, the numbness turned into an itch and he wanted to scratch, it was like a small ant was pincing his abdomen.
Boro wiped the sweat from his forehead. He took out a towel from the car and wiped his blood covered hand. There was a relaxed smile on his face, “In the past, I directly implanted two magic marks into my body. This led to the balance of the magnetic field in my body. I couldn’t inject other energy into my body to strengthen my constitution. If I was careless, I would deviate and fail!”! “But later, I thought of a new idea.”
“What?”Dudian subconsciously asked.
“First, I implanted the power of the Aragami.”Boro smiled, “I used the Aragami to replace the worm king as nutrients. I found that the flesh of the Aragami had an inhibition effect on the soul worm when I was working in the Divine Court. In the past, I would first use the two magic marks and then use the power of the Aragami. However, this would disturb the balance of the two magic marks. So now I have changed. I will use the power of the Aragami and then use the second soul worm!”
“In this way, when the first soul worm is suppressed by the power of the Aragami, it should be combined with the second soul worm to form a triangular magnetic field. In the future, as long as I continue to strengthen the power of the Aragami in my body, my own power will become stronger.”
Dudian was startled. His body suddenly turned cold as he said in shock: “Did you just implant the innards of the Aragami into my body? !”
“Smart!”Boro snapped his fingers.
Dudian’s heart was cold and angry, he clenched his teeth: “Do you know that the vitality of the Aragami is more tenacious and will enter your brain? Although I don’t know what will happen after entering your brain, but it is very likely to seize your consciousness!”
Boro looked at him in surprise: “You actually know about this?”
Boro touched his chin as he looked at Dudian. His eyes glanced at Dudian’s frozen right arm from time to time, he said: “Have you implanted the flesh and blood of the Aragami into your body? No, if that’s the case then your brain would have long been damaged. Strange, what method did you use to suppress it?” His eyes lit up as he turned to look at Dudian.

chapters.title: Chapter 968
chapters.content:
Chapter 968 – Chapter 958: How Old... Are You?
Dudian once again experienced the feeling of being slaughtered. He had swallowed several pieces of the flesh of the Aragami to satisfy his hunger. He had almost lost his life. He regretted it but at this moment Bolo had directly implanted half of the Aragami’s innards, this was simply taking his life!
Although he guessed that Bolo might have a way to restrain the Aragami but what if the effect wasn’t as good as he had imagined? At the moment he didn’t have the strength to stop the flesh of the Aragami from jumping into his brain.
Boro saw that Dudian didn’t speak and didn’t expect him to answer honestly. Even if he did, he wouldn’t believe that what he saw was real. He immediately left the bed and went to the side to take out some tools and test tubes.
“Interesting. I’m more and more interested in your body.”Boro came to Dudian and took out a brand new green ring from a transparent bag. It was like an emerald bracelet but its diameter was as long as a palm.
Boro used a scalpel to cut open Dudian’s neck. The anesthetic effect on his neck was weak. Dudian could feel the slight pain and Boro’s fingers rubbed against his neck. He had never experienced such a feeling before. It was a wonderful feeling, he was also angry and scared.
He felt that his Adam’s apple had been cut open. The flesh on his neck was pulled open by Boro’s fingers. The back of his neck was also moved. For a moment he felt as if his head was separated from his body.
“What a clever hand!”
This idea popped up in Dudian’s mind. Although Bolo looked strong and rough but he was more careful than a woman. If it was him then he wouldn’t dare to guarantee that the dissection would reach such a level, would the experimental subject survive.
But from this skillful technique he had to come up with a fact. He had done this kind of experiment many times!
Dudian felt that he couldn’t make a sound when his Adam’s apple was touched. He lay down and looked at Boro’s face. He lowered his head and focused on his neck.
He could even see the pores on Boro’s face and the small dust particles inside.
If he could enter the magic body, he would be able to cut off Boro’s head with one blow!
Dudian silently thought but his body was unable to move. He didn’t feel anything. The anger in his heart slowly calmed down. The past years slowly emerged in his mind.
He found that he was so attached to life when death was standing in front of him!
After an unknown amount of time, Boro finally looked up. He picked up the emerald ring on the metal frame and gently pulled it. The ring was divided into two parts. There was a hidden buckle in the broken part. His eyes were solemn and extremely serious, he inserted the ring through the skin layer of Dudian’s neck.
Crack!
Dudian heard the sound and saw Boro was relieved.
Next was the suture operation.
After ten minutes, Dudian felt that his brain and neck were connected again. The feeling of fullness made him feel happy. He slightly opened his mouth and tried to ask: “What is this thing?”His voice was hoarse. His Adam’s apple trembled as he spoke. It seemed that something was pressed against his Adam’s apple. It felt cold and smooth.
Boro wiped the blood from his hands and gently exhaled, he smiled: “This is uranium ring. It is a natural element. I have found that uranium can inhibit the Aragami factor in my experiments. Although I don’t know what method you used to suppress the Aragami Force in your body. But to be on the safe side, I have to equip you with the uranium ring. In this way, the Aragami factor in your body will not jump into your brain. It will be sealed in your body and slowly assimilated by your body. It can be activated in battle and become your strength!”
“Uranium? !”Dudian was startled.
The corner of his mouth twitched as he thought of the color of the jade. He didn’t doubt Bolo’s words.
He had to think of nuclear fuel and nuclear weapons when he mentioned uranium.
Since the discovery of uranium fission, uranium had been listed as an important rare element by the major countries. He had tried to look for uranium in the past two years when he was the wall master in Sylvia. However there was no uranium in the wall. He didn’t know where it came from.
“Uranium can suppress the Aragami factor. Is it because of its natural radiation?”Dudian’s face slightly changed as he thought about the characteristics of uranium. If that was the case then wouldn’t his body be the first to suffer?
He saw that Boro didn’t want to elaborate so he changed his words: “This thing can suppress the power of Aragami. Doesn’t that mean it can also suppress my power?”
In his opinion, inserting uranium crystals into one’s body was simply courting death. In the long run, one’s neck would definitely fester, and the radiation would even change one’s bodily functions, causing sterilization, tumors, deformities, and other conditions.
“Don’t worry. Since I’m doing this, I naturally have my reasons.”Bolo smiled lightly, “When the twin magic marks enter your body, the magnetic field of the ice and fire energy will help you to offset the radiation of the uranium ring. It is strange. Soul Worms are afraid of the power of Aragami but Aragami are afraid of the radiation of uranium. Soul Worms have a strong resistance to the radiation of uranium. When the Twin Soul Worms are in your body, you will be immune to the radiation of uranium. You will be immune to most of the radiation in the air. Even if you go to the deepest part of the pit and are swept by the dark nuclear storm in the pit, you will be safe.”
Dudian’s pupils shrank.
This was the first time he heard the word ‘nuclear’from someone else’s mouth!
After a moment of shock, Dudian quickly reacted. Bolo had said that he had read many books from the ruins of the old era and had a detailed understanding of the old era, so it was not strange to know about nuclear radiation and nuclear weapons.
“Now, let me enjoy your body!”Bolo licked his lips and looked at Dudian’s body as if he was looking at a beautiful piece of art.
Dudian felt that he was a naked beauty. But he knew that Bolo didn’t have any special fetishes. He wanted to probe into the secrets of the Aragami’s power.
Bolo took tweezers from the side. He took a bit of flesh from Dudian’s abdomen, the joint of his right arm and shoulder, and his temple, then he took the tweezers to the other side of the laboratory.
Dudian looked at Bolo’s back. He felt that the numbness in his abdomen was spreading more and more. He knew that it was most likely because of the internal organs of the Aragami that were corroding his body, he asked: “The size of the Aragami is so huge. Which part of its intestines did you transplant?”
Boro didn’t respond. He was concentrating on adjusting the microscope.
Dudian looked around and saw that Zachet had woken up. He was still pretending to be asleep. He shook his head and Winked at Boro.
Dudian knew that Boro was waiting for an opportunity.
However, Boro wouldn’t give them such an opportunity.
Dudian sighed as he looked at the white ceiling. He felt that time was hard to endure.
He asked Boro again: “Did you make the instruments here or did you move them from the ruins?”
Bolo didn’t hear anything.
Dudian continued to ask: “You defected from the Empire. Do the Seven Kings Hate You?”
There was silence.
“Were your previous subjects clones of Your Daughter?”
“Do you know where the Fire Dragon came from?”
“There are only seven kings in the empire. have there been any kings who have died in battle?”
Dudian asked many questions but Boro didn’t respond. Dudian didn’t think much of it. He felt more comfortable as he was able to create some noise to disturb the latter.
Time passed unconsciously. Boro suddenly looked up from the instrument when Dudian asked if Boro had seen the sea. Boro’s face changed. He looked at Dudian in surprise, he asked with uncertainty: “How Old… Are You?”

chapters.title: Chapter 969
chapters.content:
Chapter 969 – Chapter 959: Anger
“How… Old Are You?”
Dudian was stunned by Boro’s words.
After a few seconds he realized what Boro was asking. He was surprised: “Are you referring to your age?”
“How Old Are You?”Boro asked again as he stared at Dudian.
Dudian was uneasy but he quickly replied: “I can’t remember. I should be around twenty-two years old.” He hadn’t calculated his age since he left Sylvia. He didn’t know how long he had been in the wilderness.
“Twenty-two?”Boro narrowed his eyes: “Shouldn’t it be three hundred and twenty-two?”
Dudian’s heart shrank as he asked: “What did you say?”
Boro looked at him deeply. He got up from the instrument and slowly walked over, “I didn’t expect that you would hide such a secret. More than 300 years ago was the time of the cataclysm. You… should be from the old era!”
“The old era? What did you say?”Dudian’s face was blank.
Boro’s mouth slightly curved up, “Although I don’t know how you survived and lived for so long but you are still a small inferior abyss. But your body doesn’t lie. interesting. I didn’t expect that I haven’t met the people of the old era. Moreover you are so weak. If I knew this earlier I wouldn’t be in such a hurry to use your body to do experiments.”
Dudian’s heart sank. He knew that there was no way to hide it. The latter had extracted his flesh and blood on the instrument. It seemed that the instrument had identified his physical condition. However, he couldn’t understand. The freezing chamber had completely frozen his body. His body’s function was still in his twenties. How could it be able to identify the age of his body after freezing.
Suddenly, he came to a realization.
Although he was in a frozen state, time was not static. It was like the frozen meat stored in the refrigerator.
From this it could be seen that the instrument used by the latter was not a simple microscope.
“322-year-old man from the old era…”Boro came to the front of the bed. There was a bit of excitement in his eyes as he looked up and down at dudian. It was as if he was looking at a rare and protected animal in the zoo.
Zach who was pretending to be asleep heard Boro’s words. There was a trace of shock in his eyes. He looked at Dudian who looked like a youth. 322-year-old? Old Era Man?
He suddenly felt that his brain wasn’t enough. His rich life experience seemed a bit ignorant at this moment.
Dudian was uncomfortable as Boro looked at him. He could only remain silent. He knew that Boro would dissect him from inside out.
Boro looked at him for a moment and said: “Tell me how you survived for so long but you are so weak. I am curious about your life experience.”
Dudian’s mouth twitched. After a moment of silence he slowly said: “There is an instrument called ‘Freezing Chamber’. Have you heard of it?”
“Freezing chamber?”Boro’s eyes lit up: “Is it a freezer that stores the remains of Aragami?”
“More or less.”
“And then?”
Dudian looked at him, “Sleeping in the freezer can stop the body’s functions. As long as the energy of the freezer continues, it can continue to sleep. As for me, I have been sleeping for 300 years.”
He didn’t intend to hide anything about the freezer. Firstly, the freezer was useless to him. Secondly, even if Boro got it, it wouldn’t affect him much. It was just a device to avoid the world.
“I can sleep in the freezer for 300 years and then come back to life?”Bolo looked at him with a strange expression. “Do you think I’m a three-year-old child?”
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “You don’t believe me?”
“At least from what I know, freezing can keep the body in the state it was in when it was alive. But it can only be used to store dead things. Once a living thing is frozen, its heart will stop beating and it will be dead. After thawing, it will not be able to come back to life. Do you want to use this to let me experiment with it and take the opportunity to escape?”Bolo’s face showed a mocking expression, obviously he felt that this idea was ridiculous.
Dudian was a bit speechless but he quickly thought that his hibernation chamber was completely different from the general freezer. Boro obviously understood that the freezer was a freezer. He sighed, he explained: “It’s true. The freezer is different from the frozen storage that you imagine. Although they are frozen but the freezer is specially made for living people. It will stimulate your heartbeat and make you recover. I don’t know the details but what I said is true. If you don’t believe me then you can find it and study it yourself.”
“Where is it?”
“It’s in a wall called ‘Silvia’.”
Boro sneered: “So I have to climb over the god of war wall and find this wall before I can get your so-called freezer?”
Dudian sighed: “Why is the truth more untrustworthy than a lie?”
“You don’t have to say anymore. I have my own way to check whether what you said is true or false.”Boro waved his hand and turned to leave.
Dudian saw that Boro was ready to leave. His face was a bit ugly: “Are you going to torture me?”
Boro didn’t respond. He pushed the door open and went out.
“F * ck!”Dudian cursed angrily. As a suspicious person, he naturally knew how difficult it was to obtain “Trust”. Just like when they caught Dinah, he didn’t dare to believe what she said. No matter how sincere and sincere she was, he couldn’t believe it. Only when he pushed her to the extreme, or even drove her crazy, would he feel that her words were credible.
However, Karma wasn’t good. In the blink of an eye, he was reduced to a prisoner. Just like Daina at that time, he had witnessed all the torture that Daina had endured. From body to soul, he naturally didn’t want to see such things happen to him, especially the torture of the soul. Boro knew his weakness, which was Aisha.
He absolutely did not want to see that kind of nightmarish thing happen.
If it really happened, he felt that he would definitely go crazy!
Anger, powerlessness, hatred, violence, and even wanted to destroy everything. But in the end, the weakness from his body made him want to die.
Zach looked at Boro as he left. He wanted to take the opportunity to ask about Dudian’s age, but he saw that Dudian’s face changed. Sometimes he was angry, sometimes he was ferocious, sometimes he was sad, and his emotions were very unstable. He tactfully stopped talking, he looked at him with pity and closed his eyes again.

chapters.title: Chapter 970
chapters.content:
Chapter 970 – Chapter 960: Life
When Dudian was full of anger and fear, the door of the laboratory was pushed open and Boro came back.
There was a sound of footsteps behind him.
Dudian’s heart was in his throat.
But the next moment, he saw that the footsteps behind Boro was not aisha but “Dina”.
However, this “Dina”was different from the other “Dinas”he had seen before. She had a cold temperament and was dressed in a scarlet robe. Although her cheeks were young, but her eyes were deep and full of dignity, she looked like a queen.
Dudian was relieved. He frowned but didn’t say anything. He looked at Boro who was walking towards him.
“Don’t try to resist. She will enter your dream and read all your memories.”Boro looked down at dudian, “All the lies will be exposed and all the secrets will be revealed. Let me see how the world was destroyed three hundred years ago!”
Dudian was startled. Did He enter a dream?
While he was in a daze, Diana had already stepped forward. She stretched out her small hand and pressed it on his forehead. There was a cold and soft feeling. Dudian saw that her arm began to change. Dark liquid seeped out from her pores and covered her hand. Her cute little hand turned into a sharp spider leg, there were fine hairs attached to it.
“Magic marks ability?”Dudian was surprised.
Suddenly his forehead hurt.
It was as if a sharp needle had pierced into his forehead. The needle slowly went deeper and deeper as if it was going to pierce through his head!
Dudian’s expression was uncontrollable. He felt a numbness in his forehead. It was as if something had entered his brain. His brain buzzed and his clear vision was blurred, the girl and Boro in front of him turned into multiple afterimages. The world slowly went dark as if they had fallen into an abyss.
He didn’t know how long they had fallen. It seemed like a few minutes or hours.
Suddenly a ray of light appeared.
The light slowly expanded. It was reflected in the line of sight. It was a complete picture. It was an oval metal shell.
It’s a familiar metal shell… Dudian’s mind murmured.
His eyes suddenly turned to the side. Dudian saw a few color mottled buttons and a finger-thick bar screen. There were three blood red numbers: 300!
Dudian’s heart was shocked as if he was struck by lightning. This familiar number and familiar button. Wasn’t this the first thing he saw after he woke up from the freezer?
It was the number that made him know that he had been sleeping for three hundred years!
The next moment, Dudian saw a very pale little boy sitting up from the freezer. He looked around blankly. After a long time, the little boy mustered his courage and climbed out of the freezer. When he pushed the door open.., what greeted him was not the first ray of light but a piece of rotten and stinky garbage. It collapsed from the top and poured into the freezer. It almost pressed him down.
The little boy was stimulated by the smell and vomited on the spot. The thing he vomited was still the breakfast he had eaten before entering the freezer. After he vomited, the smell of vomit in the air became even more unpleasant.
The little boy gritted his teeth and pushed aside the garbage. Like a rat in a sewer, he crawled out. His clean body was already extremely dirty. Then, he saw a low and dilapidated refugee shelter.
The Little Boy stood in a daze for a long time. He shook his weak body and slowly walked towards the refugee shelter. His back gradually merged with the poor and dark environment.
Dudian was completely stunned as he looked at the scene. Wasn’t this him?
His memory seemed to be swept by the tide at this moment. His eyes followed the little boy’s body and slowly moved forward. He saw the torrential rain that washed away the dirt on the little boy’s body. He also saw the rainy night, the little girl in the purple cheongsam appeared like a fairy. Her porcelain-like delicate face was particularly dazzling in the dark night, flashing in the thunder.
Then, he saw the little girl pick up the little boy who had fallen in the mud. She led him to a shabby eaves and handed him a sandwich with meat.
The rain stopped.
The little girl wiped the water off his body and brought him to an orphanage. She left the handkerchief to him and floated away.
The Little Boy stood alone in front of the orphanage. Eventually, he slowly walked in and lived in the orphanage.
He silently learned the language, silently endured the ridicule, silently observed the world, and silently watched the children in the orphanage kill stray cats and dogs, he silently listened to his companions talk about the tragic fate of some of the adopted children. Then, it was his turn. He chose between the gardener and the doctor. He chose the woman with the beautiful smile and followed her “Home.”.
Then he was sent to study, captured by hunters to be examined, and sent to the special training camp for scavengers..
The past scenes were “Played”in front of his eyes.
Including the hunting outside the giant wall..
He accidentally got the first magic mark, “Fear dye”..
There was also the first love that was immature and full of all the beautiful fantasies. There was also the dark cage after it was broken. There was disappointment in his eyes as he left. There was also despair crying in the corner..
Dudian’s heart trembled. He had sealed the failed beautiful memory in the deepest part of his memory. He didn’t want to touch it. Even after he became the wall master he didn’t look for the other party. But at this moment.., all of these played out with the memories in front of him.
The warm eyes and gentle tone of the two when they were in love reminded him of the softness in the deepest part of his heart. But in the end it was broken with the last goodbye.
He looked at the youth who was suffering in prison. He saw the youth silently planning to escape from prison. His heart gradually calmed down. The past was the past. His thoughts were calm. There was a bit of expectation in his heart, he even hoped that the memory in the middle would be omitted as soon as possible.
Dudian finally saw her again during the long broadcast.
It was the first time they met outside the giant wall. She was wearing a purple cheongsam which looked like a blooming epiphyllum.
The familiar voice echoed in his ears once again.
He felt that there was a hot and humid liquid that fell on his face. It felt very real.
“If I had made the phonograph earlier, how good would it have been!”Dudian thought in pain and regret.
He had made so many things but he didn’t make the phonograph and the retro camera first. The technical difficulty of these two things wasn’t that great. They were just non-military items, the benefits for him were low so they were ignored.
But how much beauty could these two things retain in the world?
Sometimes when he stared at the road ahead, he would always ignore the beautiful scenery on both sides of the road.
Wasn’t this also a kind of tragedy?
The memory continued until he saw the figure of the Beast Tide once again. The blood on Dudian’s body once again trembled and solidified. It was as if all the blood had turned cold.
He wanted to roar but he couldn’t make any sound.
He was like a bystander. He could only see the scene happening. He could only look at the figure of the teenager holding her. He couldn’t help but Roar in despair.
He suddenly hated the teenager. If he was a bit stronger then all of this wouldn’t have happened!
As the memory faded, Dudian’s mood turned from grief to numbness. He looked at the scene behind him expressionlessly.
The intruders were attacking..
He was going to become a wall master..
He left the giant wall of Sylvia and went north. He met the Amelia tribe..
