The last memory stopped in Boro’s laboratory. The girl put her hand on her forehead.
The memory after the hibernation turned into a full stop.
His eyes were still on the last memory. It was as if the video was stuck halfway through.
Dudian was silent. He slowly guessed what the Queen’s magic marks ability was. He felt that the latter should have seen all his memories.
His secret was revealed to her without any hidden cards.
This was the first time he had completely exposed himself in front of the enemy. His heart was completely cold and even a little depressed.
However, when he thought that Boro didn’t plan to use Aisha to force him, he couldn’t help but feel relieved and comforted.
He didn’t know how much time had passed, but suddenly, the memory that was stuck turned back quickly. It was like a rewind. The speed was extremely fast, and in the blink of an eye, he returned to the scene when he was lying in the freezer.
Then the little boy in the freezer closed his eyes and closed them.
The world was dark.
The Darkness seemed to only last for a few minutes. When the little boy opened his eyes again, he saw three faces that made Dudian’s heart tremble: father, mother, and sister.
This was the last image he saw when he entered the freezer.
The image was still in the form of a fast rewind. It was so fast that Dudian’s line of sight couldn’t keep up with it.
Until the image suddenly stopped and stopped.
The stopped image was a white ceiling. Then Dudian saw a middle-aged man bending down and approaching him. At this moment, he seemed to have returned to the first point of view.
Although this middle-aged man’s face was much younger, but he recognized his father at a glance.
Then he saw his father hugging him. His face was full of joy and his eyes saw his chubby little hands.
Is it my new memory?
Dudian thought in his heart. He felt a warm and sentimental feeling. He basically didn’t remember anything about the age of one or two. He had forgotten about the things that happened when he was three or four years old. Only a few events left a deep impression on him, however, he couldn’t remember them clearly. But at this moment, under the magic marks of ‘Dana’, these sealed memories were dug out. He could clearly see what happened after he was born.
Perhaps this was an unexpected surprise?
Looking at his excited father, he felt that he couldn’t help but smile.
But the next moment, he was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 971
chapters.content:
Chapter 971 – Chapter 961: “Dean”
Dudian looked at his father who was in middle age. His memory was different from when he woke up 300 years ago. He couldn’t hear sounds. It seemed that his hearing was blocked when he was born, he had trained his ability to read lips over the years. Through his father’s mouth, he could understand what he was saying.
However, there was one sentence that made him wonder if he had mispronounced it.
Could it be a homonym?
However, Chinese emphasized that the characters were upright and round. Even if it was a homonym, there were slight changes to the lips.
While he was puzzled, his father, who was holding him, turned around. His line of sight changed as well. He saw a gentle and virtuous woman wearing a white coat. It was his mother.
At this moment, his mother’s face was full of smiles: “Yes, we finally succeeded. That’s Great!”
Dudian was slightly startled as he read her lips. He was a bit scared because of his father’s words. Soon, he noticed that his mother was not lying on the delivery bed, her clothes were intact in front of him.
Wasn’t this the time when he was born?
He was at a loss. He saw his mother take him from his father’s hands. She was holding him in her arms but she was holding him low. He could only see his father’s chest and neck. He couldn’t see his face, naturally, he couldn’t see whether he was talking or not.
Not long after the hug, his mother gently put him back to his original position and kissed his forehead.
Looking at her face full of joy, Dudian suddenly felt that he was thinking too much. His mood was good again and his heart was full of warmth. At this time, his mother turned her head and said to his father.
From his point of view, he could see the upper body of the two and the ceiling above their heads.
“We haven’t named him yet. What do you think?”His mother smiled.
His father slowly calmed down from his excitement. He touched his chin and thought for a moment: “How about we call him Adam?”
“Adam?”His mother was surprised, “Isn’t the name too vulgar? Those foreign movies like to copy the Bible. If so, wouldn’t you be called the Lord?”
Dudian nodded as he felt the same. ‘Adam’? What kind of joke is this? ! How vulgar is this? !
His father laughed and scratched his head: “What do you call it then?”
Dudian slightly grinned. He thought that his mother was more reliable.
Then he saw his mother’s lips move: “How about… Pangu?”
Pangu?
Dudian almost fell down.
“This name seems a bit too eye-catching. Well, let’s change it.”His mother quickly changed her name. She also felt that this name was too “Arrogant”.
“It seems a bit.”His father nodded. He pondered for a moment and suddenly turned away from Dudian’s sight.
Dudian’s mouth twitched. What do you mean by ‘seems’? It was obvious! It’s either Adam or Pangu. Can you give him a normal name? !
After a while, his father appeared in front of Dudian’s eyes again. He was holding a book with a black cover. There was a layer of transparent plastic film protecting the cover. The cover of the book was a bit tattered, his father looked at the book with a serious expression. After about ten minutes, he looked up and said: “How about Andy?”
Dudian’s mouth twitched. Did you call him the wrong way? !
“Andy?”His mother was a bit surprised: “It seems to be a foreign name. What does it mean?”
“In Aslan, Andy was a fallen God. Although it is the name of the devil, but the original meaning is ‘divinity’!”His father closed the book, slowly he said: “I hope our children will have divinity in the future and benefit mankind.”
His mother shook her head slightly, “Not good. This is the name of the fallen God. How can it be used on our children?”. “I remember that the Aslan language is somewhat similar to English. In English, ‘God’is spelled backwards, which means ‘dog’. What does Andy spell backwards mean?”
“Spell backwards?”His father was obviously stunned. He opened the book again and flipped through it for a moment. He seemed to be relieved and smiled. “Then let’s call him dean. In Aslan, it means light.”
“Light?”His mother thought for a moment and then nodded: “Yes, I hope our children will act in an open and aboveboard manner in the future. They will never be sullied. Just like the Sun, they will shine on Everything!”
“Good!”His father made a decision: “Then let’s call him Dean!”
The two discussed and decided on the name.
Dudian who was reading lips looked at him in a daze. He didn’t think that his name would come from this. He didn’t think that his name would contain such a meaning and expectation.
Open and aboveboard?
Enlighten all things?
There was a trace of bitterness on the corner of his mouth. He thought that it was better to call him Andy. At least he fit the meaning of the word “Depravity”. was “Divinity”really “Light”?
After the parents finished discussing the name, they left together.
After they left, Dudian saw a transparent cover slowly fall down and cover him inside.
Time passed quickly.
After that, his father and mother would come to visit him on time. They would kiss him and sometimes hug him.
Dudian felt touched, sad and sad. He thought of his father’s expectation and mother’s exhortation when the freezer was closed. He hoped that he could live on, if he had the ability then he would continue to be a hero of the human race!
He had forgotten about this task when he was a hunter. Time would make people forget some precious things. This time he remembered it clearly.
But…
There was a side to the bitter sea..,
there was no shore to turn back to..
More than half a year later, when his parents came to visit him again, he felt that he could hear faint sounds. It was as if his hearing had just developed. This made Dudian happy, he once again heard the familiar voice of his father and mother.
It was like warm spring water flowing through his heart.
He suddenly felt that it was a beautiful thing to be interrogated by “Diana”.
“My body seems to be very weak. I actually have to stay here every day. I Can’t go down the road.”Dudian looked at his parents leaving again. There was some regret in his heart, he also knew that his body couldn’t leave the “Breeding room”. Sometimes he could feel that his young body was extremely weak. It would be difficult for him to turn around.
He bitterly smiled in his heart. He didn’t expect himself to be so weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 972
chapters.content:
Chapter 972 – Chapter 962: The Beginning Of The Disaster
Young Dudian was sleeping most of the time in the breeding room. Sometimes when his parents came to visit, they would wake up and go back to sleep. It seemed that they would never be able to finish their sleep.
One day, Dudian heard a light tapping sound coming from outside the transparent glass of the breeding room. He opened his eyes and saw a little girl with delicate features. From the outline of her eyes and lips.., it was his sister.
Dudian felt a sense of familiarity that he hadn’t felt for a long time. But soon, his eyes closed. Little Dudian only took a glance at her and went back to sleep.
Dudian smiled bitterly in his heart.
Day after day, he went to sleep intermittently. Time passed by in a hurry. Dudian could feel that Little Dudian’s body was becoming stronger and stronger. He was able to stand up and sit in the breeding room.
One day when his parents came, they opened the incubator and picked up the young Dudian from inside. They taught him how to walk.
After several falls, the young Dudian barely learned to walk.
Although he was staggering, his father and mother were very excited. They heard his mother say: “Dean can finally walk. Great! I thought it would be a few years later!”
“After all, he is three years old. Although his development is poor, but it is not too late.”His father hugged his mother and comforted her.
Dean silently remembered that he was three years old..
So he had been in the breeding room for three years.
At this time, his father and mother led Little Dean out of the laboratory. When they reached the door, Dean suddenly wanted to look back to see what kind of breeding room he had lived in for three years. Unfortunately, Little Dudian went out directly without looking back.
What he saw was just his childhood memories. He couldn’t control it.
After leaving the laboratory, Dudian quickly met his sister. The little girl who was carved from Jade was now six or seven years old. She was dressed in a pink princess costume. She was very cute.
Dudian’s eyes were gentle. He wanted to reach out and pinch her. He found that the proud and aloof sister was so cute when she was young.
“This is your sister, Little Wa.”
“This is your brother, Dudian.”
His mother introduced them to each other.
Dudian looked at this warm scene. He suddenly felt that it was not bad to stop time.
But soon, he thought of Aisha and remembered that he was in the underground base of Boro. His mood suddenly became gloomy.
Time flew by.
In the blink of an eye, Little Dudian grew up and reached the age of seven.
In the past four years, he was sent to an aristocratic kindergarten to study. Although his physical strength was still very poor, but his brain had already shown the wisdom of a genius. The teacher taught him simple math problems, the other children didn’t understand it at all, but he only listened to it once and could understand it.
He had only been in kindergarten for two years. When he was five years old, he was sent to a place called “Young Talent Class”. There were half-grown children in there. The oldest of them was only seven or eight years old, but he was already at the level of a third or fourth grade primary school student.
Little Dudian quickly caught up with the study and his results were getting better and better.
In addition to going to school every day, he would play games with his sister, play video games, hide in the laboratory, or sneak out of a laboratory to secretly watch his father and other researchers doing experiments.
The cold laboratory was his home.
He didn’t think that it was cold and quiet here. Everything was beautiful and warm.
Until one day, their father told them that the laboratory was going to be relocated.
Then they moved back to their motherland from abroad. After they moved back, Dudian and his sister’s studies were naturally interrupted. Their father and mother didn’t sign them up for a new school.
The two siblings had nothing to do at home every day. They played video games.
Later on, Little Dudian found that his sister had become dull and less and less to play with him.
One day, Little Dudian who was playing games on TV suddenly saw his sister rushing over. His face was full of panic and panic. He grabbed the remote control in his hand and took out the game card, he switched to the normal TV channel, a sports channel.
However, even the evening news didn’t broadcast the sports channel. At this moment in the afternoon, it was switched to the news broadcast. There was a video on it, it was like a video clip from a sci-fi movie. One by one, strange spaceships fell from the sky. They broke through the clouds and landed on the ground.
“The beginning of the Cataclysm…”Dudian’s heart trembled as he looked at the picture on the TV.
He knew that this was the beginning of the cataclysm when he was sent to the freezer.
Dudian, who was seven years old at the time, was also frightened by the video on the TV. Moreover, he could tell at a glance that it was not the special effects of the movie, but the real world.
If it were other children, they would have mistaken it for special effects. They would be fascinated by this magnificent picture and feel excited. But at that time, Dudian was only confused. Then he saw the fear on his sister’s face.
Fear was like a virus. It would spread and spread.
Since that day, Dudian never saw his sister smile again. The smile seemed to have been taken away from his father and mother’s faces.
There seemed to be an invisible dark cloud shrouding the house.
Dudian was seven years old. He was like an insect in this depressing atmosphere. He was rapidly maturing.
They would stay in front of the television every day to watch the breaking news from all over the world. At that time, all the channels seemed to be occupied by the news. There was no TV series, no movies, no cartoons, no entertainment programs, as soon as he turned on the TV he saw the disaster scenes from all over the world as well as the situation of the construction of the magnificent shelters. There was also a meeting between the leaders of the countries.
Dudian was also silently watching the news. Although he had watched it when he was young, but after all he was only seven years old. There were many things that he couldn’t understand even if he saw them, he only remembered the disaster scene and some shocking pictures of the shelter. At this moment, Dudian remembered the news from his memory. He saw the contents of the leaders’talks.
Biological and chemical weapons, thermal weapons, missiles..
All the means of human attack were used on the invading monsters.
These monsters were all human beings with twisted bodies. They were not undeads but had mutated into extremely strange creatures.
Although missiles could destroy these ‘infected’strange humans, but they would often kill a lot of people.
It seemed that there were invisible dandelions floating in the sky and into the bodies of more people.
As more and more people were infected with the monsters, the defense lines of the countries had to be contracted again and again. However, in just half a year, the earth had changed completely.
In the end, the leaders of the countries put forward the ultimate plan.
Nuclear Destruction!
“I thought that I could die together with these monsters. But now it seems that it was just wishful thinking…”Dudian thought of the nuclear fallout in the sky and sighed in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 973
chapters.content:
Chapter 973 – Chapter 963: Unknown Fault
Dudian didn’t wait until he saw the nuclear explosion before he was sent into the freezing chamber.
As the freezing chamber slowly closed, the memory also ended.
His vision fell into endless darkness again.
Dudian’s mind was still filled with the faces of his parents. He suddenly felt sad. His past life had passed in such a hurry. Where was the future of his present self?
A sharp pain suddenly came from his forehead. Dudian instinctively felt that he had regained control of his body. He was no longer in the “Soul”wandering state. He immediately opened his eyes, he saw the first ray of light.
It was as if he had woken up from a deep sleep in the freezing chamber.
However, the girl’s face woke him up. At the same time, he saw Boro waiting in front of the bed.
“How is it?”Bolo looked at the girl who let go and asked immediately.
The girl nodded slightly. “No problem.”
“That’s good.”Bolo heaved a sigh of relief and asked, “How is it? is what he said true? is he really a person who survived 300 years ago?”
“That’s right.”The girl’s expression remained indifferent and calm as she nodded slightly, “Through the dream I looked through the memories of his past life. He was from the old era. His parents sent him to the freezer when the disaster broke out. He had been sleeping for a long time. When he woke up it was the present era. He woke up in a remote and weak God’s wall. He climbed from a poor man to the position of the Lord of the God’s wall. Strictly speaking, he was a traitor. He left the God’s wall and was about to go to the empire. Unfortunately he was caught in the god of war’s Wall and participated in the last battle.”
She summarized Dudian’s life in a few words. She didn’t elaborate on the details because she didn’t think it was important.
“So that’s the case.”Boro’s eyes lit up: “It seems that kid is quite sensible. He didn’t lie to me. is the wall far away from here? is the freezer still there?”
“The wall is located in the south. It is some distance away from here. The freezer is still there but there is no energy. Even if we get it we won’t be able to use it. We don’t have the technology to create the energy needed for the freezer.”The girl calmly said.
Boro felt a little regretful, “Whether it can be used or not is secondary. It’s a pity that it’s too far away. Otherwise, if we were to find someone to study it, if something were to happen in the future, we might be able to use it as a life-saving item or bury a spark. When it’s born in a few hundred years, perhaps the world at that time will have a wonderful change!”
The girl raised her head to look at him and said, “Father, as long as your experiment is successful, you’ll definitely be able to live for a few hundred years or even live forever. This thing is completely useless to you.”
Boro smiled and said, “That’s true, but this freezing chamber can freeze a living person for hundreds of years and still keep them alive. The core technology inside is extraordinary. Perhaps it can be used by analogy and has an effect on my experiment.”
“Then, why don’t I carry it over?”The Girl Thought for a moment and asked.
Boro shook his head, “Forget it. It’s too dangerous for you to go into the wall alone. Let’s talk about this later. It’s not too late to consider it when my experiment has reached a bottleneck and I really can’t improve any further. Tell me about what happened 300 years ago. At that time, the Earth seemed to be very beautiful. What exactly happened that caused all these changes?”
“When he was sleeping in the freezer, he was only about eight years old. Most of the time, he was locked up in his home and school, so he didn’t know much.”The girl slowly said, “But from what he saw at that time, it was similar to the world described in those ancient books. At that time, there were no such ferocious monsters on Earth. The strongest monsters on land were the Lions and tigers mentioned in the books. However, these monsters were small and could be easily killed by ordinary hunters.”
“Is that so?”Bolo looked forward to it and sighed, “What a beautiful world. It’s a pity that humans are always lazy in the midst of beauty. Is this considered cheap?”
The girl did not reply to his muttering, she continued, “The world at that time was just like what the ancient books said. Humans dominated the earth and spread all over the world. We were the rulers of this planet, the supreme of all living things. “However, even though we didn’t have any racial enemies, the countries all over the world were fighting each other to maintain the population balance.”
“Where there are people, there will be battles. This is inevitable.”Bolo smiled faintly. He seemed to be used to such things. He asked, “Did he sleep in the freezer because of a disaster?”
The girl nodded, “This disaster, just like what you’ve guessed in the past, came from outer space. In the words of the old era, it was an “Alien invasion.”At that time, the human countries did not have the ability to resist. In the end, they chose to detonate all the nuclear weapons hidden in the countries and destroy them together with the alien races. Only some people who were hiding in the underground shelter were left with the Tinder.”
“No wonder there were so many remains in the ruins we found. What a pity.”Boro sighed and then frowned. “So, the blank space in the middle is still unknown?”
The girl nodded slightly.
Bo Luo sighed. “I was hoping that I could use his memories to find the truth of the empire’s founding. It seems that this divine wall was indeed created by the Aragami…”he suddenly thought of something, he asked the girl, “The alien race that invaded us, were they aragami?”
The girl shook her head, “He was too young at that time and did not know much. He only saw the spaceship that carried the alien race and did not see the alien race with his own eyes. However, the alien race’s ability was to infect humans and transform them into monsters. From this point, it does not seem like they were Aragami. Moreover, the alien race’s spaceship is more similar to the alien spaceship that you brought us to before.”
“Is it similar to that spaceship?”Boro came to a realization, “So the alien species that invaded the planet were the polar worm and the flame worm. Strange, aren’t they natural enemies? Why did they come to Earth to attack us?”
The girl thought for a moment: “Did they cooperate for a short time?”
“Maybe.”Boro didn’t deny it. He knew that these insect kings had very high intelligence and were not inferior to humans.
Boro asked about the old era and then turned to the source of Dudian’s cold arm and how to control the Aragami gene in his body. The girl was able to answer the questions smoothly as she told about Dudian’s experience.
“He accidentally got a magic mark of ‘fear dye’. He used this magic mark to lead other magic marks of the same rank to have super resistance. He directly absorbed the unpurified cold soul crystal which led to the invasion of cold air. His right arm was frozen… Originally, the freezing would continue to his body. But when the signs of freezing appeared, he used flames to burn his arm. By accident, the cold air was suppressed in his right arm. So he was different from other infected people. It was not a systemic infection.”
“Later on… He became the wall master and left the divine wall to head to the empire… on the way, he met the survivors of the old era who were left in the wilderness. They were a secret tribe and they met the Aragami that they worshipped there… under hunger, he ate the Aragami’s flesh. Not long after, the Aragami’s flesh and blood recovered and was about to corrode his brain, but he stopped it by strangling his throat.”
“Later, the flesh of the Aragami was frozen in his arms and slowly became obedient…”
“That’s it?”Boro was slightly stunned after hearing the girl’s words.
The girl nodded, “That’s it.”
Boro’s face was strange but he didn’t doubt her. He turned to look at Dudian who was lying on the bed, “Using the throat to resist the Aragami is really ruthless. I think the neck was almost broken.”
Dudian didn’t say a word as he looked at Boro coldly.
“You are lucky. You didn’t use any external instruments or drugs to control the Aragami. It is a miracle. If an ordinary person ate the flesh of the Aragami then they would have been doomed to die!”Boro praised, he asked the girl: “Is there anything else?”
“No.”The girl shook her head.
Dudian’s heart moved as he looked at her.

chapters.title: Chapter 974
chapters.content:
Chapter 974 – Chapter 964: “Longevity”
“What?”Boro squinted his eyes as he noticed Dudian’s gaze.
Dudian looked away as usual, he indifferently said: “Nothing. I suddenly thought that her magic marks ability could be used to look into my memory. I don’t know if it can be used on undeads or not.”
Boro’s doubt faded away as his lips curled up, “Interesting idea. As expected of the people from the old era. Their thinking is more flexible than those idiots in this era.”. Unfortunately, although this ability could look into the memories of undeads but it couldn’t wake up the memories of undeads. To be precise, most undeads had intact consciousness except for the ones with brain defects. However they couldn’t control the body. The memory was like a piece of data and the body was just a carrier. They didn’t have the authority to control it so they could only be a bystander.”
Dudian’s pupils shrank: “Do you mean that the undeads still have memory? But they can’t control the body?”
“Yes.”Boro was in a good mood. He was happy to communicate with Dudian, a human from 300 years ago, “You can think of the undeads as a kind of machine. I remember that in the old era there was a technology called ‘camera’. The undeads were like a camera that could capture the scenery. But it was a dead thing and needed us to control it.”
“For the undeads, we who control the shutter of the camera are the viruses in their bodies.”
Dudian looked at him in a daze. His heart was burning with hope and his eyes lit up, he couldn’t help but say: “So as long as we can find a way to cure the viruses in their bodies, won’t we be able to let them regain control of their bodies?”
“Impossible!”Boro decisively interrupted Dudian’s fantasy. There was a smile on his face, boro said: “First, the virus can not be cured. There should be nothing more terrifying than the zombie virus. I don’t know whether it should be classified as a virus or a toxin. In short, from what I know, there is nothing that can expel the virus in the zombie’s body. There is no such super antibody!”
“Second, even if the zombie is cured, it will be a dead person carrying the memory. Their memory cells will gradually weaken and die.”
Dudian was startled as he felt cold water pouring over his head. He couldn’t help but ask: “Why?”
Boro indifferently smiled, “Haven’t you heard of ‘soul’?”? “I’m not talking about the unrealistic undead in the empire. I’m talking about the origin of life. Simply put, it is our consciousness. But it is more complicated than consciousness. Perhaps it is a kind of natural energy of the universe or a kind of magnetic field of life. When life dies, this energy will disappear. Memory is just a piece of data that exists in the brain. It is meaningless. It is like a gear. Although it can walk but it has lost the most basic kinetic energy. In the end, it will only rust and Rot!”
“Soul…”Dudian’s face was pale as he muttered. In just a few sentences he had climbed from hell to Heaven but fell into a deeper hell. There was no hope.
He thought that he could find a way to cure the undeads in the Kingdom of God. But now it seemed that there was no answer he wanted.
Soul..
What a distant thing!
It was so far away that no one dared to believe its existence, but at the same time, they could not deny its existence!
He had already prepared for the worst. Even if he could not find a solution in the Kingdom of God, he could still use the more advanced technology in the Kingdom of God and the knowledge in the super chip to think of a way to cure Aisha.
But Bolo’s words were like a heavy punch in his heart.
Even the most advanced knowledge of the old era recorded in the super chip couldn’t touch the level of “Soul”..
Looking at Dudian’s ashen face, Bolo seemed to know what he was thinking. He laughed with a bit of ridicule in his tone, “It’s not impossible for you to cure the King Corpse. As long as you can survive my experiment, you will be able to have a long life or even reach the level of “Longevity”. With such vitality, if you painstakingly study for hundreds or thousands of years, you may be able to find a way. Of course, the premise is that you have to survive.”
Dudian’s heart suddenly came to life after hearing his joke. It was as if he was suddenly enlightened. Yes, the technology in the Super Chip couldn’t be reached, but it didn’t mean that there was no way!
Technology was endless!
If he could learn the technology in the chip and continue to develop based on it, he might be able to find the existence of ‘soul’!
He was excited again and took several deep breaths.
Boro was surprised to see that Dudian’s belief was so persistent. He didn’t expect that Dudian would take his words seriously!
Boro smiled in his heart. It wasn’t bad. At least an experiment with a hundred times more confidence and hope was better than an experiment with a dead heart.
“You said that you can live forever after your experiment?”Dudian calmed down again. He looked at Bolo. The topic of immortality had been unceasing for thousands of years. It was the eternal pursuit of all life.
However, there was a limit to the number of times a cell could divide. The more times it divided, the older the person would become. The body’s function would gradually weaken. If one wanted to live forever, they could only make a theoretical assumption. Moreover, there would be many loopholes.
Boro slightly raised his chin. There was a trace of enthusiasm and pride in his eyes, “If the experiment is completed, although I don’t dare to say that I can live forever, but it is very likely that I can live for thousands or even tens of thousands of years. Of course, I won’t be killed by external forces. However, there will be no external forces that can kill me unless the Earth is destroyed.”
His words were full of confidence.
Dudian thought of his previous goal of surpassing the king and becoming a god. He understood that Bolo wanted him to become a legend and become immortal like a god.
But was it possible?
“Well, you rest first. I have something to do.”Bolo looked at the time. His expression was restrained as he recovered his indifferent attitude, “As I said before, don’t move. Don’t get out of bed. Otherwise, I don’t mind cutting your beloved corpse king.”
Boro turned and left.
The girl glanced at Dudian and quietly followed.
Dudian’s expression turned gloomy when he heard the threat from Haisha. He watched Boro leave and slowly closed his eyes. He was thinking of a way to escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 975
chapters.content:
Chapter 975 – Chapter 965: Exposure
After an unknown period of time, Dudian felt that his body gradually regained consciousness. The burning pain was coming from his abdomen. Moreover, his brain had become swollen and painful. It seemed that he had suddenly stuffed a lot of things into his brain. He reluctantly raised his hand, he rubbed his temples. He felt that his muscles were sore and swollen.
Could it be that he had doubled the amount of memory because he had reviewed the entire memory?
Dudian’s mouth twitched as he thought of something. He asked Zach who was pretending to be asleep: “How long have I been asleep?”
Zach slightly opened his eyes: “Do you mean?”
“She used her ability to read my memory.”
“Oh, about half an hour has passed.”
Half an hour..
Dudian was startled. Although he expected that it wouldn’t be too long but he didn’t expect it to be so short. In just half an hour he had read his entire life.
Suddenly he thought of something. If Diana used her ability to read his memory and used the time difference to do other things, wouldn’t she have tens or even hundreds of times more time to think than others?
Previously, when his memories were flipped through, although his mind had always followed his memories, he was still able to think about other things. If there were any complicated problems that he couldn’t figure out, in that state.., wouldn’t he be able to think as much as he wanted in peace?
Thinking of this, he suddenly felt that this Daina’s magic marks ability was simply terrifying. Its use in support was also ridiculously strong.
If he practiced fighting in the memory space, he would become a master of fighting in a few days.
“Such an ability should be the top five-star legendary monster. Is It really the dreamer?”Dudian murmured. His heart was filled with desire as he thought of Boro’s words. If he could also get such an ability.., wouldn’t he be able to look through Aisha’s memory? In her memory, he would meet her and listen to her voice and smile..
He slowly regained his calm. The most important thing now was to escape from here.
However, how could he escape?
He thought of the cage-like strength of Boro and his own state. He fell into silence.
“Was the world 300 years ago as clean and beautiful as the Bard’s singing?”Zac’s voice was filled with longing and curiosity.
Dudian glanced at him: “Do you still have the mood to think about this?”
“Anyway, what else can we do?”Zac laughed at himself.
Dudian was silent.
Zac looked at dudian: “You said that if his experiment succeeds on You Then you should be stronger than him. Do We have a chance…”
Dudian shook his head, “If the experiment has reached that stage then he must have a way to subdue me. He is not stupid enough to create a monster that he can not control. This is a mistake made by a low-level alchemist.”
Zac’s eyes dimmed as he bitterly smiled: “That’s true.”
Dudian frowned as he felt the pain in his abdomen getting more and more intense. Moreover, the numbness seemed to have converged into a mass. It was like a worm that was crawling in his body. There was a slight tingling sensation wherever it passed, the feeling spread to his neck. Dudian couldn’t help but raise his hand to strangle his neck. Suddenly, the tingling sensation quickly retreated back to his abdomen.
Dudian suddenly thought of the uranium ring on his neck. He didn’t think that this thing could really resist the erosion of the Aragami.
Creak!
At this time, the door of the laboratory suddenly opened without warning.
Dudian saw Boro’s figure appear at the door. There were three figures standing behind him. All of them had the same face. They were dressed differently. The previous scarlet robe was also one of them, the other was Daina who was feeding them food. The other was Daina who was wearing a rough beast suit. Her skin was a bit dry. It seemed that she often did physical work.
Boro’s face looked very gloomy. Dudian’s heart skipped a beat. was there something wrong with his experiment?
Boro walked over and gestured to Daina.
White Diana nodded and helped dudian up: “Come with me.”
“What?”Dudian couldn’t help but ask.
White Diana rolled her eyes: “It’s all your fault that we were exposed!”
“Exposed?”Dudian was surprised. He was relieved but he didn’t dare to show too much joy, “How is it exposed? We didn’t send a message to the god of war. We are deserters. You can ask her if you don’t believe me.”She was referring to Diana.
“Of course I know that you are deserters. Idiot!”Diana said in disgust: “The armor that the god of war distributed to you has a tracking device and hidden pinhole camera transmission. Your every move is in the military’s system. To put it bluntly, they have long considered the possibility of deserters. The reason why they didn’t chase after you is because they think that you are deserters. It is much easier than training death soldiers!”
Dudian was stunned.
There were monitors on the armors?
Were they being quietly monitored?
He suddenly felt a chill in his heart. Wasn’t this a waste?
“Don’t dawdle. Get Up.”Diana pulled up dudian who was weak.
Although Dudian had regained consciousness but his body was still weak. He was like a puddle of mud on Diana’s body. The latter showed an even more disgusted expression but didn’t push him away, it seemed that she was afraid of hurting him and destroying the experiment that Boro valued the most.
“How did you know?”Dudian asked subconsciously as he was dragged to the other side of the laboratory. His mind was still on the exposed matter.
White Daina snorted and disdainfully said: “Of course I was smart enough to discover the secret of the armor. Fortunately I discovered it early. Otherwise the enemy would have quietly come over one day.”
Dudian remembered that Zac had been sent here. His own armor had been discarded but Zac and Jason’s were still wearing it. After all, the quality of the armor was good, zac’s armor would naturally be stripped off and the secrets would be found out by Diana.
Dudian calmed down after connecting the dots. He saw that the white-clothed Diana had brought him to a corner of the laboratory. There was a cryo chamber and a metal coffin-like instrument, he asked: “What Is This?”
“Cut the crap and go in!”The white-clothed Diana was in a bad mood. She opened the metal chamber and pushed Dudian in.

chapters.title: Chapter 976
chapters.content:
Chapter 976 – Chapter 966: East Continent
Dudian fell into the metal cabin. He felt that it was very soft and comfortable. There was a spongy material surrounding it. He didn’t know where Boro got it from.
“Don’t make any noise.”Diana put one hand on the cover of the metal cabin and looked down at Dudian. She swung her arm and closed the door.
Dudian’s eyes quickly swept over the cabin as the door closed. He saw Boro and Diana carrying the equipment in the laboratory.
“Are they preparing to move the position?”Dudian was startled as his vision went dark.
The sound of the cabin was also closed when the door was closed.
It was dark and quiet.
Dudian could only hear his breathing and heartbeat in the narrow metal cabin. He thought of Diana’s words. He was looking forward to it. If the people of the god of war saw Boro through the monitoring of the armor.., would they recognize him? Would they send a large number of experts to stop him?
The answer was obviously yes.
It could be seen that Boro was afraid as soon as he sensed the urgency of the matter.
Maybe this was a chance for him to survive?
He prayed in his heart. He turned his body and put his ears on the metal cabin. Very soon he heard a slight sound of collision. It seemed that the equipment was being dismantled. There seemed to be friction on the ground, in addition he faintly heard a miserable roar.
This roar was somewhat familiar. Dudian couldn’t help but think of Zachet who was lying on the bed next to him.
Was he resisting?
No, he should be dead.
The Scream didn’t continue. It stopped abruptly. Dudian guessed that Bolo didn’t plan to take Zachet with him. Bolo didn’t want to keep him.
He sighed in his heart. At the same time, he felt a bit lucky.
Fortunately, he was alright for the time being.
Not long after, Dudian felt that the metal cabin was lifted. His body tilted as if it was being towed.
Dudian suddenly thought of Aisha. His heart tightened. Bolo had to abandon Zachet because of the emergency. Would he abandon Aisha too. He couldn’t hold back anymore. He raised his fist and punched the metal cabin.
Bang! Bang!
His fist shook the metal cabin.
Dudian felt that the metal cabin had been flattened. He immediately stopped.
The cabin door opened. Diana looked at him with a murderous look: “Didn’t I tell you not to make any noise? Do you want me to cut off your arm? !”
Dudian didn’t care about her threat and hurriedly said, “You want to move? Can you take Aisha… Even the king of corpses with you? As long as she is here, I promise to cooperate with all your experiments!”
“In Your Dreams!”Diana said without thinking, “You have to bring so many things. How can you have the strength to bring a king of corpses?”
“You!”Dudian’s eyes were cold as he looked at her: “If you don’t bring her along then I guarantee that you won’t get any benefits from me!”
“Do you dare to threaten me? !”Daina raised her eyebrows and raised her hand. She was ready to teach Dudian a lesson.
“Forget it.”Boro’s voice came from not far away: “Bring her along. She has some research value anyway.”
Diana heard his words and respectfully nodded, “I know, Dad.”She glanced at Dudian in the metal cabin and snorted, “I’m warning you. If you make noise again, I will cripple your arm. I will forgive you this time!”She closed the cabin door without waiting for Dudian to speak.
Looking at the closed door, Dudian was slightly relieved. With Bolo’s words, AISHA should be fine, should..
He slightly clenched his fist. He wanted to smash the metal cabin with one punch and kill all of them. However, his body was weak, so he could only lie there with anger and killing intent.
After taking a few deep breaths, dudian gradually calmed down. He changed his position and continued to listen to the metal cabin.
The metal cabin was moved. Dudian felt that the metal cabin seemed to be going up the stairs. After a while, the metal cabin was put down again. The surroundings became quiet.
He tried to listen but he couldn’t hear anything.
He didn’t know how long had passed before he heard the sound of the collision again. He couldn’t hear the vague conversation.
The sound of the collision came and went. After about an hour Dudian suddenly felt the ground tremble. It seemed that the ground was shaking, then he heard a heavy sound coming from the metal cabin. It seemed that the beast was trampling on the ground.
After a while, the sound stopped. Dudian felt that the metal cabin was lifted up. After a shake, it stopped. It seemed that it was placed on something.
After a long wait, Dudian suddenly felt that the metal cabin was shaking slightly. However, he couldn’t hear anything. He felt that his body was weightless. It was as if he was flying.
It was still very quiet outside but Dudian could hear a roar or two from time to time. It was deep and vigorous. It was definitely not a sound that a human’s vocal cords could make.
Dudian listened attentively but the metal cabin’s sound insulation effect was very strong. Even if his ears were attached to it, he could only hear some loud sounds. When the roar came from a long distance below his body, Dudian roughly guessed the situation outside. The migration seemed to have begun.
“I don’t know if the pursuer can find the traces left behind by him. I didn’t hear the explosion before so the underground base shouldn’t have been destroyed…”Dudian’s eyes flashed but he wasn’t happy at all, the possibility of leaving the underground base was very low. Even if they emptied the base they would find traces. If it was him then he would have buried some means in the base, the pursuers and the underground base would disappear together.
In the following time, the outside fell into a permanent silence. Dudian couldn’t hear any other sounds except for the occasional strange roars and bumps.
Slowly, Dudian felt hungry.
It seemed that four or five hours had passed.
His mood was complicated. Sometimes he was resentful, sometimes disappointed, and sometimes he looked forward to it. He was resentful that the white-clothed Dinah had cracked the secret of the armor so quickly, and he was disappointed that the pursuers had not found him after so many days. The strong ones he had been looking forward to were just as strong as Bolo, so he could reap the benefits, he could take advantage of the chaos to escape.
As all kinds of thoughts crossed his mind, his mood became more and more frustrated. He knew that only losers would have such messy thoughts. Only when they were forced into a dead end and had no way to do anything about it.., he would blame others for the failure and entrust the redemption to others.
The metal cabin suddenly floated as if it was falling at an extreme speed.
Dudian’s mind suddenly scattered. He grabbed onto the spongy material in the metal cabin. He was nervous and excited. Could it be that the pursuers had come?
Bang!
Suddenly there was a violent vibration.
Dudian’s body shook as his head hit the spongy material in the metal cabin. He almost twisted his neck. He shook his head and immediately put his ears on the metal cabin to listen.
Crack!
The cabin cover suddenly opened.
The light shone in. Diana stood on the edge of the metal cabin and looked down at Dudian. Dudian was still in a listening posture. He felt a bit embarrassed but he quickly recovered his indifferent expression, his eyes quickly glanced outside the cabin cover. He saw a cyan neck stretched out like a giraffe. However the neck was much thicker and longer than the neck of a giraffe.
Dudian immediately sat up and took the opportunity to quickly observe the environment outside.
There was a dense forest around the monster with cyan neck.
Sure enough, this was no longer the underground base.
Diana kicked the metal cabin as she saw Dudian’s anxious look: “What’s there to see? It’s because of you that we have to continue to drift.”
Dudian wasn’t in the mood to pay attention to her. He looked for Aisha after he saw the surrounding wilderness.
He saw that the metal cabin was tied to the back of the monster. The monster’s body was huge. Its neck was about one meter in diameter and its back was wide, it was filled with all kinds of instruments in the laboratory. Most of the instruments were covered to prevent damage.
Dudian saw Diana sitting on the wings on both sides of the Beast’s back. She was wearing a scarlet robe and another beast robe. He had captured and tortured Diana, she was soaked in a glassy container. Her body was still half broken but there was a lot of growth under her waist. There was a vague outline of a thigh.
Soon, Dudian found Aisha’s figure in a pile of miscellaneous instruments.
Her body was tied by ropes and wrapped around a heavy instrument. She was still standing straight and expressionless.
Seeing that she was well, Dudian was relieved. It seemed that Bolo was still keeping his promise.
At this time, a low roar came from the side.
Dudian turned his head and saw that there was a giant beast standing dozens of meters away in the sparse forest. It looked like a lion. Its wings were snow white but its abdomen had long legs.
At the moment the giant beast was chewing something. Blood was squeezed out from its teeth from time to time.
There were a lot of instruments on the back of the giant beast. Some of them were wrapped in animal skin. It was hard to tell what was inside.
“I didn’t expect that there would be such a beast hidden in the underground base. Moreover, it has been domesticated…”Dudian thought in his heart.
“Ah!”At this time, Diana threw an object to dudian.
Dudian raised his hand to catch it. It was a piece of meat that was sealed after being fried.
“Hurry up and eat. Everyone will finish eating and then we will continue on our way.”White Diana rolled her eyes and said impatiently.
Dudian knew that he had to supplement his body with food. He asked: “Where Are We Going? Are We Going to wander aimlessly?”
“What Do You Care?”White Diana snorted.
Dudian wasn’t angry, he continued: “If we continue to drift aimlessly then we won’t be able to continue the experiment. I think we should secretly return to the god of war wall. We should find a quiet place and kill our way to the empire. Isn’t that better?”
“Idiot!”White Diana’s face was full of disdain, “Do you think that the god of war is so easy to cross?”? If it was just the few of us then of course we would be able to sneak back. But the target is so big. How could we sneak back? Do you think that the Warriors on the god of war are as weak and useless as you?”
Dudian ate the meat in his hand: “If I didn’t run away then how would your Father Meet Me? How would he experiment with me?”
Diana snorted: “That’s all you are worth.”
“Same to you.”Dudian indifferently replied.
Diana stared at him: “Do you want to be beaten?”
Dudian’s eyes turned cold as he looked at her raised hand. He turned his head and didn’t talk to her.
“It’s about time. Get ready to go.”Boro who was sitting on the head of the Beast said. He didn’t look back but looked into the distance, “Hurry up and try to reach the eastern continent tonight.”
“Yes, Dad.”Daina respectfully said. She pulled the metal cover of Dudian’s cabin. The cover almost hit Dudian’s head.
Dudian lied down but Boro’s words echoed in his mind. He was a bit surprised. Eastern continent?

chapters.title: Chapter 977
chapters.content:
Chapter 977 – Chapter 967: Firebird
Roar!
The Giant Beast roared and set sail again.
Dudian lay in the metal cabin as his thoughts ran wild. Boro’s words “The east continent”made his imagination run wild.
It didn’t take long for Dudian to hear a cry coming from far away. It was getting clearer and clearer. He could feel the noise even through the metal cabin, it seemed that thousands of birds and beasts were attacking.
Dudian was surprised as he felt the metal cabin sway to the side. It seemed that the beast was turning at a very fast speed.
Was it attacked?
Dudian was surprised and happy. He listened carefully for a moment but didn’t see any human voice. He was surprised. wasn’t it the pursuer?
Soon, he thought of the Thunderbird above the Shenluo Empire.
The cyan-brown giant beast was also flying high in the sky… could it be that there was a flock of Thunderbirds that lived in the clouds? !
Dudian was nervous. He wasn’t worried that Boro wouldn’t be able to defeat them. He was worried that Boro wouldn’t be able to protect Aisha who was tied to the cyan-brown giant beast.
The sound of the alarm was getting louder and louder. The sound insulation of the metal cabin seemed to be a bit weak. Dudian estimated that if he was outside, he might not be able to hear it clearly. Through the distribution of the alarm, the image of the cyan-brown monster surrounded by a group of ferocious beasts appeared in Dudian’s mind.
At this time, Dudian heard the alarm suddenly become fierce. There was a sharp and loud long sound. It seemed to be a command. There were also panicked bird sounds. Obviously, Boro and the few Dinas had made their move.
Bang! Bang!
Dudian suddenly felt that the metal cabin was hit. The hatch was slightly dented. He didn’t expect the attack from outside to be so violent.
Soon, the sound of the collision was replaced by a scream.
Soon, the surrounding cries became denser. It was like a tidal wave. The metal cabin was hit from time to time. The Dent was extremely sharp. It seemed that it was hit by a sharp weapon.
Crack!
The gap of the metal cabin’s cover suddenly cracked. The buttons were opened and the cover was pried open in the strong wind. The light shined into the darkness, the sound was ten or a hundred times stronger than before. It pierced into Dudian’s eardrums. He felt as if he was in the center of a tornado. He couldn’t hear anything.
Dark Shadows were flying in his line of sight. The first thing that Dudian saw was a huge dark red bird. It completely surrounded them. The scorching sun at three o’clock in the afternoon was completely blocked by these birds.
Whoosh!
A burst of air-piercing sound came.
Dudian hurriedly looked back and saw a huge dark red bird with sharp claws flying over. The bird’s body was almost five meters tall. Its sharp claws could easily lift a person up.
“Get lost!”A white shadow flashed in front of Dudian’s eyes. A monster that looked like an orangutan flew out. Its body was almost three meters tall and it had six arms. It grabbed the bird’s claws and wings, dudian punched its head twice. Bang! Blood sprayed out.
Dudian saw the monster covered in snow white hair. Its face was similar to Diana’s. He smelled the familiar smell and immediately understood that it was the white Diana.
Dudian no longer looked at her. He looked at Aisha who was in the previous position. She was still tied to the heavy equipment. Her body didn’t move and she ignored the disaster in front of her.
Dudian was relieved to see that she was safe and sound. He secretly took a breath. Once she was in danger, he would issue a command to let her save herself.
Even if there was an opportunity, he would let her escape with him!
Although the bell was not with him, he had already anticipated a similar desperate situation. He had preset the second command method, whistling.
However, what worried him was that the surroundings were so noisy. could his whistling sound be transmitted to Aisha’s ears?
“You go first. I will cover the rear!”Suddenly, a low and hoarse voice sounded. It was as if the devil had woken up from the abyss. It was full of unspeakable horror.
Dudian looked at the voice. He saw a figure with twelve black wings on its back. It was almost three meters tall. Its skin was dark and blue. However, its body still maintained the appearance of a human, moreover, it looked like a fallen angel from a fairy tale.
Dudian’s pupils shrank. What Magic Mark was this?
The next moment, the Twelve Wings Bolo rushed into the surrounding dark red birds. The towering figure was like a black scythe. With a light shake, seven or eight dark red birds’heads fell off and were cut off from their necks, the cut surface was extremely smooth.
Dudian saw that twelve-winged Boro was holding a huge black sword. The sword was very wide. It looked like a sword used by the shield warriors of the hunter mercenary group.
“This is… semi-magic?”Dudian was shocked as he saw the scene. The speed of these dark red feathered birds was no less than that of a master. However they were like static dolls in front of Boro.
He was like a black blade as he rushed into the flock of birds. The birds and beasts exploded along the way.
When the birds and beasts were cleared out, the green-brown long-necked beast immediately let out a low howl. It turned its head and flew to the other side of the flock.
Dudian saw the head of the green-brown long-necked beast. His pupils shrank and he almost bit his tongue. There was a human face on the head of the Beast!
However, the skin of the human face was as rough as the skin on the neck. There were many small bumps but the facial features were undoubtedly human!
“Lower Your Head!”A shout was heard.
Dudian quickly hid his head and climbed into the metal cabin.
He saw a shadow pass over the top of his head. At the same time, he felt a faint heat coming from the body of the beast.
Dudian thought that it was a close call. He turned his head and saw white-haired Diana flying towards him. She grabbed another bird that was attacking Dudian and tore it apart.
On the other side of the cyan-brown giant, a blood-red spider-like figure was fighting with the bird. There were black patterns on its body. The spider’s legs jumped and easily pierced through the bird, it was like a few sharp spears.
Twelve Wings Bolo blocked the birds and beasts from the rear. Feathers flew out from its black wings from time to time and pierced the eyes or neck of the birds that crossed the line. Some were seriously injured while others were killed on the spot.
The birds and beasts continued to chase after them for four or five minutes. Hundreds of them were killed or injured.
At this time, a high-pitched sound was heard. Suddenly, the birds and beasts in the surroundings began to retreat.
“Are you ready to go?”Dudian’s eyes slightly moved. He was relieved but also a bit regretful.
However, Dudian soon felt that the situation was not right. The birds and beasts slowly gathered and formed a large dark cloud behind them. To be precise, it was a dark red cloud. It looked like blood was oozing out from the cloud.
Dudian suddenly felt that the temperature around him was a bit hot. It was getting hotter and hotter. In less than half a minute, he felt that the temperature had risen to the point that his skin was burning. His face slightly changed but he saw that the flock of birds had a huge change, if it was a dark red bird before, then at this moment it was already a scarlet red bird. The feathers of each bird had become extremely bright. The remaining black had faded and become as red as blood.
Whoosh!
When the wings of one of the birds were burning, it was as if a fuse had been lit. The wings of all the birds and beasts were constantly emitting flames. The Flames grew bigger and bigger and covered the whole bird. In the blink of an eye, it had turned into a fire bird!
The whole flock of birds had also turned into a sea of fire!
The scorching wind and waves made Dudian’s mouth dry. He felt that the white hair on Diana’s body seemed to be slightly curled up. There was a burnt yellow feeling.

chapters.title: Chapter 978
chapters.content:
Chapter 978 – Chapter 968: Descent
“Dad!”Diana couldn’t help but shout. Her face was full of anxiety.
In front of the Sea of flames, Boro was like a Hell Shura. He was holding a black greatsword with his back facing the crowd. Dudian couldn’t help but hold his breath. was this the calmness of a King?
The temperature in the air reached boiling point. The air seemed to be slightly distorted. Dudian suspected that he only needed to light a match, the air could spontaneously ignite.
All the Firebirds immediately responded with a high-pitched cry. At the same time, the flame on the Firebird’s body surged and condensed into a blazing fireball in front of its chest.
When the fireball reached half a meter in diameter, it shot out with a bang.
Tens of thousands of fireballs flew forward and gathered together. They were like a cascading waterfall of fire that swept down from the sky. Their imposing manner was magnificent and shocking.
Dark ripples suddenly appeared all over the twelve-winged Bolo’s body. He looked like a halo emitted by a character in a game. At the moment when the Sea of fire swept across the sky, he let out a low roar. Like a lion or a tiger, his momentum was breathtaking, he raised the giant sword and rushed into the Sea of fire.
The Sea of fire swallowed him in an instant.
But in the next moment, the Sea of fire quickly separated into two sides. A black figure appeared. It was twelve Wings Bolo.
He and the giant sword in his hand were like reefs on the edge of the waves. They stood in the air. The Sea of fire was split by the giant sword but it didn’t hurt his body at all. The feathers on his wings didn’t burn.
Dudian’s eyes were wide open. It wasn’t an ordinary flame. He could feel that the temperature of the flame was much higher than ordinary flames. If it was him then he wouldn’t be able to withstand it, even if the splitter’s blade was ten or a hundred times sharper then it would be swallowed by the flame and melted.
At this time, the flame fragments swept towards the brown giant beast. The giant beast growled. It flapped its wings and created a hurricane. The flame fragments fluttered away and turned at high speed, it flew towards the distant sky.
Dudian looked at the twelve-winged Bolo who was getting farther and farther away. He saw the dark fluctuations surrounding his body. He suddenly thought of the magic marks ability of the supplicant, one of them was the dark energy that came with the attack.
The “Dark energy”was the official name given in the Atlas. In fact, it was the biological energy that the magic marks brought to the human body. It was the same as the liquid flame created by Aisha after she transformed into a demon.
Obviously, the dark fluctuation of the Twelve Wings Bolo was similar to the energy.
In addition to the image of the fallen angel in the mythology, it was most likely the top five-star legendary magic marks!
Soon, the cyan-brown long-necked giant beast carried Dudian and the others out of the battlefield. The high temperature around them was sucked away by the wind and gradually became cool. Dudian turned his head and looked back. He could only see a red fire cloud in the sky but he couldn’t see Boro’s figure.
Soon, the beast landed on the edge of a lake in the wilderness. There were two lizard-like monsters lying on the lake. Their bodies were more than ten meters long. They saw the intruders, they immediately got up from their comfortable leisure state. Their amber eyes revealed a brutal and bloodthirsty luster. They quickly crawled towards the giant beast and surrounded it from left and right.
“HMPH!”A cold snort sounded. The snow ape-like white-clothed Dana jumped down from the Giant Beast’s body and stepped on the head of a lizard-like monster that was flying over. With a bang, its relatively small body was like a huge boulder, it actually smashed the head of the monster deep into the ground and shattered it instantly. Brain matter sprayed out and flowed all over the ground.
The other monster was picked up by the monster’s long neck and bit its head. The human face opened its mouth and revealed its long fangs. It bit the head of the monster and ate it!
Dudian’s scalp went numb. He didn’t know if the monster was controlled by a human or a beast.
After eating the lizard-like monster, the monster bent its neck and drank water from the lake. The three ‘Dainas’removed their magic bodies one after another. Daina jumped onto a tall tree and looked into the distance.
After a while, she cried out in joy, “Daddy Is Back!”
Daina was relieved. The Scarlet Robe was calm.
Dudian turned his head and saw Boro’s figure slowly flying back. He was surprised when he saw Boro’s figure. Boro was in a sorry state. There were many burn marks on his body, four of the twelve wings on his back were torn by sharp claws. The feathers were messy and bloody.
“Dad, you are injured!”Daina rushed up.
Boro slowly landed. The wings on his body quickly retracted. The color of his skin gradually faded. His upper body was naked and there were several bloody claw marks on his back.
“I’m fine.”Boro comforted Diana.
Diana saw the injury on his back. Her eyes were filled with tears. She immediately ran back. She took out first aid medicine from a small box and gave it to Boro.
Boro went back to sit on the back of the giant beast. He glanced at Dudian. He was relieved to see that Dudian was fine. He said to the other two dinas: “Take a rest. The flaming birds won’t chase us.”
“Yes, Dad.”The two Dinas nodded.
Dudian looked at Boro who was resting. He curiously asked: “Are the flaming birds like the Thunderbirds in the Empire? Are they used as military air defense weapons?”
The white-clothed Dinas who was applying hemostasis medicine on Boro immediately stared at him.
“Do you know about the Thunderbirds?”Boro wasn’t angry. He looked up at dudian: “You can understand it that way.”
Dudian was surprised. He thought that there might be other survivor’s gathering place or a Second Empire, otherwise Boro wouldn’t have gone to the east continent. It seemed that the possibility was very likely to be true.
Could it be that there was another colossus like the god Luo Empire?
“Are there people living in the eastern continent?”Dudian asked directly. He wasn’t afraid to Anger Bolo.
Bolo nodded: “Of course there are.”
Dudian noticed that he said “Of course”. Was it possible that there were survivors of the empire in other places besides the eastern continent?
“Since there are people, why didn’t you go there before? With your strength, you should be able to easily climb to a high position there.”Dudian looked at him. He guessed that there was something that he couldn’t say, maybe there was something that threatened him.
“Why do you talk so much? !”Diana shouted in anger.
Dudian didn’t even look at her as if he didn’t hear her. He stared at Bolo. Diana was even more annoyed. She was about to stand up but Bolo raised his hand to stop her.
“The situation in the eastern continent is more complicated than you think. You will know when you go there. But you won’t have the chance to see it.”Bolo didn’t taboo these topics. He took out his mechanical pocket watch and looked at the time, he sighed: “I won’t be able to make it tonight. Let’s Find a place to rest.”
Diana put the bottle back into the box. She immediately came over and removed Dudian’s metal cabin door. She took out tools from another metal box to repair it.
Dudian knew that she wanted to quickly repair him. He glanced at her and turned to look at Boro, he asked: “Your previous magic marks should be the top legendary magic marks. It seems that your body hasn’t been completely transformed.”
Bolo changed into new clothes, he said indifferently: “If you can live then I will give you this magic mark. By the way, the name of this magic mark is very cool. It is called ‘Dark Angel’.”
“Dark Angel?”Dudian was surprised: “It doesn’t have the word ‘person’?”
“Person?”Boro smiled, “Only the later named monsters have the word ‘person’. Most of the initial named monsters have their own names. However the ‘Dark Angel’has disappeared so there will not be a second one. It will not be recorded in the atlas. Of course, all the King’s magic marks wouldn’t be recorded in the Atlas. This is a top secret.”
“I see.”Dudian understood.
Boro tidied his clothes and went to check the cargo on the giant beast. He waved his hand and said: “Let’s go.”
At this time, Diana had repaired the metal cabin. She seemed to be very good at mechanical things. She connected the cabin cover and closed Dudian.
They took off again.
This time they stopped after walking for a while.
The cabin door opened. Dudian found that the sky had darkened. It was about six or seven days in the evening. The cold wind was blowing. He saw a vast Black Sea in front of him!
Dudian was surprised. The eastern continent was on the other side of the sea?
He had speculated that the Shenluo Empire was in the Russian region. If it was across the sea then could it be that the eastern continent was in the west?
He looked at the Black Sea. The tide rolled up and hit the surface of the sea. The sea was so deep that he couldn’t see the bottom. There were countless secrets and killing intent hidden in it!
“Rest here.”Boro’s words came out.
Dudian’s mood was complicated as he asked: “The east continent is on the other side of the sea. Why don’t we go there directly?”
“It’s not safe to cross the sea at night.”Boro replied and turned his head away.
Dudian was about to ask more questions when Diana came over with a piece of roast meat. She stared at him and raised her hand!
Dudian immediately stopped. After all, a wise man wouldn’t lose out in front of his eyes.
He raised his hand to take the roast meat from Diana. He slightly pulled but found that her hand was still holding the roast meat. It seemed that she didn’t want to give it to him. Dudian’s face turned cold. He was about to open his mouth when his pupils suddenly shrank.
He saw that Diana’s face was still fierce. Her mouth slightly moved as she opened her mouth to speak but she didn’t make a sound. When she noticed that her throat did not make a sound, she could not help but reveal a trace of surprise. Then, her surprised expression froze forever.
A circle of dark red marks appeared on her snow-white neck. Then, her head slowly slid down like ice skating.
At the same time, at the same level, dark red blood also appeared on the lower part of the wrist of the hand that she had raised. It slid down together.

chapters.title: Chapter 979
chapters.content:
Chapter 979 – Chapter 969: Battle Of The Kings
Plop!
Diana’s head and broken hand fell onto the back of the giant beast and rolled down.
Dudian was completely stunned by the sudden change.
The next moment, he suddenly felt a bone-chilling chill coming from his back. It was as if a chill was coming from his spine to the back of his neck. He couldn’t help but shiver, then he heard an indifferent voice coming from the sky: “Night Devil, how have you been…”
Dudian’s body was stiff. He felt as if there was an extremely terrifying monster standing behind him. He didn’t dare to look back or even move.
At the same time, the headless body of Diana fell down from the body of the giant beast.
Dudian’s line of sight also saw Boro standing on the neck of the giant beast behind her. Boro’s expression was particularly gloomy at the moment. His black eyes were emitting strong murderous intent.
“Long time no see, Night Devil. Why? Don’t you recognize our old friends?”A charming voice floated into Dudian’s ears. It was as if there was a gentle red lips breathing in his ear, his heart was throbbing. There was an inexplicable excitement and physiological reaction.
He was shocked. He reluctantly twisted his neck and looked back.
It seemed that the whole world had collapsed!
The boundless darkness pressed down and made his vision fall into a short period of darkness. He couldn’t see anything. After a while his vision gradually recovered. He saw three figures standing in the sky, two men and one woman. The man was tall and strong. His whole body was shrouded in darkness. The woman had a graceful figure. She was wearing a jade green dress. She didn’t have shoes on her feet. Her snow white slender bare feet were exuding endless temptation.
“This is… The King? !”Dudian suddenly thought of the identity of the three people. He felt that the blood in his body was frozen. His thinking had become slow.
“Blood Thorn, Demon Moon, Red Eye, are there only three of you?”Boro’s voice echoed. His eyes were cold. His burly body seemed to have become stronger.
“Just the three of us are enough to bring you back.”The previous indifferent voice came out from the mouth of a tall man. His body was shrouded in darkness. It was hard to see but the outline of the armor was very eye-catching, it was like sharp blades protruding out of the armor. It made Dudian think of the splitter armor he had received. It seemed that the man was very good at attacking.
Dudian’s mind had recovered from the strange deterrence. His eyes were calm as he looked at the three people. He suddenly remembered that they were separated in the past. She had said that he was under the command of the Blood Thorn King.
“I didn’t think that you would come to the outside world after so many years. No wonder I couldn’t find you anywhere in the Empire.”There was an irresistible charm in the woman’s voice, dudian’s heart was moved by her voice. He even had a feeling of ‘love’. He was willing to kneel under her bare feet and work for her.
Dudian woke up from the strange feeling after she finished her words. He was secretly shocked. Even the beautiful Aragami couldn’t make him feel tempted or lustful. But at the moment this woman’s voice.., was it her magic marks ability that made him have such an impulse?
Boro heard their words and sneered: “I have a headache if that guy from the light comes over. But you three dare to come over to die? Aren’t you looking down on me?”
“Ha, after so many years, your tone is still so arrogant.”The man in sharp armor said indifferently, “If it were the night demon king in the past, we would still be helpless. But now, you have betrayed God. I alone can take you down!”
“Is that so?”Bolo looked calm with a mocking smile on his face. He looked at him indifferently, “You can come and try.”
“How can you not let me participate in such a Thing?”The enchanting woman next to him smiled gently, as if she had suddenly discovered something, she giggled a little exaggeratedly and said, “Isn’t this dina? There are actually two. Oh, there should be three. One of them was accidentally ‘injured’by me just now. Hehe, after so many years, you still haven’t forgotten her? Don’t tell me you plan to resurrect her?”
Bo Luo’s face turned cold, and a monstrous killing intent suddenly surged out of his eyes. All the bones in his body cracked, and his body became straighter and straighter. Dark green mucus also appeared on his pale skin, which had not been exposed to sunlight all year round. At the same time.., the back of his shirt was propped up and torn apart, and pure black wings extended out from it. Twelve of them were slightly raised, like a demon king who ruled the world!
“Eh?”The enchanting woman looked at Bolo’s devil body and was a little surprised. “After stripping away the ‘king’, you can still keep the twelve wings of the ‘Dark Angel’?”
“Tonight, you will give her a burial!”Bolo’s voice became deep and sinister. The horns on his head were bent, and black marks spread to his face, like a strange curse. His eyes became pure black without whites!
The enchanting woman slowly put away her smile as she felt the pressure from Boro. The three of them looked at him. Their eyes flickered with a deep killing intent. There was a strange emotion in their eyes. It was like greed.
Dudian saw that the momentum of both sides was getting stronger and stronger. His whole body tensed up. He hoped that the fight wouldn’t affect him.
Whoosh!
Boro suddenly shot out like a black scythe. He cut through the sky and slashed towards the three of them.
The bodies of the three of them suddenly separated and appeared in three different directions. The only one who didn’t move was the man in the armor. The sharp blades on his armor suddenly changed as if they were “Alive”, in the blink of an eye, the entire body of the man had increased by several times. It turned into a round ball of sharp blades. It looked a bit like Dudian’s splitter but was more ferocious and violent than the splitter.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Several sharp blades shot out from the sphere as fast as a phantom.
The Black Greatsword in twelve Wings Bolo’s hand suddenly swung. The sharp blades were cut off and his body was infinitely close to the sphere.
At this moment, his body suddenly stopped as if there was a wall in front of him.
Dudian found that the body of the enchanting woman and the man who had been silent the whole time had begun to change greatly. The body of the enchanting woman began to expand. Her slender arms and thighs began to swell rapidly. She looked like a bloated fat intestine which had become extremely disgusting and bloated. Her body also began to expand and no longer looked like a human, it turned into a mixture of intestines. In the middle of the mixture there was a blood red pupil which was half a meter in diameter. It looked like a blood red moon which was emitting a strange evil aura.
The other man’s body turned into a giant which was four to five meters in size. His body was still in the shape of a human but it was different from a human’s. He was holding a weapon which looked like a staff, the top of the weapon was a crescent moon.
Dudian thought of the title of King which Boro mentioned. He quickly put them in his seat.
“Three Kings…”Dudian clenched his fists and carefully climbed out of the metal cabin. This was a once in a lifetime opportunity to escape!
However, as soon as he climbed out of the metal cabin, he saw Daina in front of him.
“Go Back!”Daina coldly looked at dudian.
Dudian didn’t think that she would have time to pay attention to him. He was so angry that he almost cursed: “Aren’t you going to help your father?”
Diana’s expression remained cold: “Go Back!”
Dudian gritted his teeth. He looked at Aisha who was behind her. In the end he held back his intention to let her attack. Aisha might not be a match for the two Dinas.
Damn it! He was angry but he slowly moved back.
Puff!
Suddenly, a bloody light flashed in front of his eyes.
Daina’s expression was a bit stunned as her head fell down.
Behind her broken neck, a head like hers was revealed — Red Robe Daina!
Dudian was stunned.
Daina kicked the Headless Beast’s body. She grabbed Dudian’s shoulder and whispered: “If you don’t want to die then follow me!”
She turned around and jumped down from the other side of the giant beast.
She whistled as she jumped down.
Dudian’s heart was cold when he heard the whistle, but he quickly reacted. This woman looked through his memory and naturally knew… that he controlled the various commands of Aisha.
As he expected, Aisha, who was tied to the cargo, suddenly made a move. She cut the steel cable on her body and quickly caught up with Daina, closely following her.
Dean was relieved to see Aisha following him. He was about to ask where the scarlet robe was going to take him. But when he turned his head, he saw that her expression was particularly serious. She was focused on running forward, apparently, she didn’t have time to pay attention to his question.
He simply stopped talking. He heard a fierce bombardment coming from the top of his head. He looked up and saw that twelve-winged bolo was already fighting with the bulbous blade demon king, on the other side, the giant monster Moon King who was holding the crescent moon staff also joined the battle. As for the “Enchanting woman”whose entire body was like intestines intertwined in the giant blood-red pupil, she only watched from afar, however, the giant blood-red pupil in the center of her body gave off a strange red light, as if blood was about to seep out.
In a one-on-three situation, twelve-winged bolo was at a disadvantage in the blink of an eye. Two of his wings were cut in half. The King of Blood Thorns didn’t suffer much damage. Every time twelve-winged Boro’s greatsword was about to cut him, it would suddenly stop as if there was an invisible barrier.
“This is the ability of a King?”Dudian was more and more surprised. The speed of the fight was too much for him to take in. Moreover, there were strange attacks from time to time which he couldn’t understand.
Dudian was relieved as he saw that Boro was surrounded by three people. He couldn’t help but feel excited.
At this time, Diana had led him to run more than ten miles away. The battlefield was left behind in the blink of an eye.
Dudian suddenly noticed that Diana was running in the direction of the bottomless sea. He was shocked: “Are you crazy? This is a dead end!”
Even Bolo didn’t dare to cross the sea at night. Diana was running straight towards him.
Diana ignored Dudian’s shout. She was looking straight ahead. She was extremely focused. It meant that she was very nervous. Her body began to change as she looked at the approaching sea, silver scales appeared on Dudian’s arm. They were extremely smooth like fish scales. There were also wavy cracks on her gills.
Dudian suddenly thought that she had two kinds of magic marks just like the other Dina!
Could it be that her second magic mark was a sea monster? !
Soon, Dina Proved Dudian’s guess with facts. She grabbed Aisha who was following behind her. She grabbed Dudian with her other hand and jumped up from the shore.
She jumped down.
Splash.
The cold sea water covered her whole body.
Dudian almost choked. The next moment, he saw a ferocious mouth open. The mouth was pitch black.
His pupils shrank. He hurriedly raised his hand to resist. However, his magic marks ability was suppressed. As soon as he raised his arm, he was swallowed. The sharp teeth on his arm hurt. Then he felt that he had entered a very tight space, his body was tightly wrapped and he couldn’t move. He could only barely breathe.
“I was swallowed as soon as I entered the water…”Dudian’s heart was in despair. His luck was so bad that it was unbelievable!
He tried to struggle but his arms and feet were firmly pressed down. He couldn’t move at all.
Fortunately, he felt that he could continue to breathe.
