After a flurry of struggling, dudian quickly calmed down. He suddenly found that he didn’t continue to slide deeper. There was no sticky gastric acid around him. He couldn’t even feel the burning sensation of digestion, moreover, he could breathe oxygen.
After about four or five minutes, he felt a push from the top of his head. The soft membrane-like flesh wall around him was also pushing. He felt as if he was squeezed out.
He sat down and felt as if he was sitting on a lump of meat.
He tried to open his eyes but he couldn’t see anything. At this time he felt happy that he had dark vision!
“Don’t move.”A cold voice sounded as Dudian was at a loss.
Dudian immediately recognized that it was the voice of Diana.
“Where are we?”Dudian asked.
“We are in the stomach of an underwater monster.”Diana gasped.
Dudian’s face slightly changed but he quickly calmed down, “Do we have a way to get out? Why did you come to the sea? Aren’t we courting death? Do you have a way to escape?”
Faced with his series of questions, the scarlet-robed Dana was slightly silent. There was only the sound of panting in the darkness. Only when the panting slowly calmed down did her voice be heard, “Escaping on land is only a dead end. No matter who survives in the end, they will capture us.”

chapters.title: Chapter 980
chapters.content:
Chapter 980 – : Chapter 970: The Devil
Dudian knew that she was right, but..
“Can you survive from the sea?”Dudian looked at the darkness in front of him. Although he couldn’t see Diana, but he could feel her breathing and knew that she was in front of him. Since she chose this path, it meant that she was somewhat confident.
“If nothing unexpected happens, it should be possible.”Diana whispered.
Dudian’s heart was slightly cold. He didn’t expect her to have such ability. He gently sniffed and smelled Aisha’s scent. His heart was slightly relaxed. He had seen her bring Aisha with her when they went into the sea, he knew that she wouldn’t leave him halfway. He couldn’t help but feel grateful.
However, she knew that he brought her with him because of her purpose.
“Can we get out of the belly of this sea monster?”Dudian asked.
Diana whispered: “No. If we go out now there will be other sea monsters. We will be torn apart. This is my temporary shelter.”
“Shelter?”Dudian’s heart moved: “Do you intend to let this monster swallow us?”
“Yes.”
“Why did you betray your father?”Dudian looked at the darkness in front of him. He knew that Dina could see his expression so he didn’t hide his doubt.
The air fell into a short silence. After a few minutes, Dina’s voice sounded again with a mocking tone, “Father?”? “From your point of view as a human, he was pregnant with us. He is our father. But as you can see, we are just tools in his eyes. Do you know what he called me?”
“What?”Dudian was surprised. weren’t they called ‘Dana’?
Dana seemed to see Dudian’s expression. She laughed in a mocking tone, “We have two names. One is called ‘Dana’. This is the name he uses when there is no one else around. But when there are other ‘Dana’, he will use another name to distinguish us. For example, my name is ‘sixty-seven’!”
“Sixty-seven?”Dudian was startled. His pupils shrank: “Is this the serial number of your production? !”
“Production…”the corner of Dana’s mouth twitched as she heard the word, “It is very vivid. It is indeed production. In fact, I am not the last one to be produced. There are many after me. But as you can see, there are not many who can survive. The other ‘dana’have all died in his hands and become his experiments.”
Although Dudian had expected this, but he still felt his heart palpitate and inexplicable sigh.
Earlier, when Bolo picked up Daina who was tortured by him, his gentle movements and extremely gentle eyes made him feel as if he saw himself. Anyone would think that the other party was a loving father, who would have thought that the latter would personally bury so many ‘beloved’daina.
“You may not know the feeling of personally dissecting and burying ‘Dinas’into the furnace. To me, they are me and I am them.”Dinas voice was a bit sad, it wasn’t as arrogant as the previous queen. Instead, it was pitiful: “I was lucky and succeeded. That’s why I was able to survive.”
Dudian was silent for a moment: “He gave you the same name ‘Dana’. This name should be very important to him right?”
“What’s the use of that? We are not the real ‘dana’after all. We are just experiments. A substitute. A puppet to comfort his lonely heart. That’s all.”Dana sneered.
Dudian thought of the infected Dana and Bolo’s cold attitude towards her. He knew that she was right. These clones were just experiments created by Bolo. It was a sad existence.
“The other two seem to be loyal to him.”Dudian suddenly thought of the white-clothed Dana who had tried to attack him several times. The latter’s loyalty to Bolo was obvious.
“Of course.”Diana’s tone suddenly became indifferent: “He wouldn’t dare to keep us by his side if he wasn’t loyal enough. There was one who was ready to betray him and escape from the Devil’s lair but he was able to detect it in time.”
“In that case, you have hidden well.”Dudian said in a relaxed tone.
Diana didn’t reply to him.
The darkness fell into silence again.
Dudian felt that the wall of flesh around him was slightly squeezing and shaking. It seemed that the sea monster was swimming at an extreme speed, he couldn’t help but ask: “Are we going to stay in its stomach? What if it goes into the deep sea?”
“No.”Dina indifferently replied.
Dudian was surprised to hear her confident tone: “Why?”
“Because I’m controlling it.”
Daina’s answer stunned Dudian. He was about to say something when he remembered that Daina’s magic marks ability was able to flip through memories. The premise of flipping through memories was to connect to his brain, could it be that… she was able to connect to the monster’s brain?
He suddenly felt that this ability was heaven-defying!
Why didn’t he have such good luck to meet such a powerful legendary monster?
Otherwise, he would feel that his life would be much easier. He would have been able to unify Sylvia long ago. Moreover, he would have been able to reach the Shenluo Empire in advance by relying on the correct route of magic marks reading, moreover, he would be able to use this ability to get to the level of the Lord of the Abyss. Moreover, he would be able to probe into the secrets of countless empires.
Dudian’s mind kept wandering for a while. As the surroundings shook violently, he came back to his senses, “What’s Wrong?”
Dinah didn’t speak. It seemed that he was the only one left in the darkness.
Fortunately, the faint sound of breathing told him that Dinah was still there.
After a few minutes, Dudian felt that the writhing wall around him had relaxed again. At this time, he heard Dinah’s voice, “We just met a monster and almost got into an accident. Fortunately, we were lucky. We met a powerful sea monster when we went into the sea.”
Dudian was relieved. He bitterly smiled: “Isn’t this bad luck? Speaking of which, we were swallowed as soon as we went into the sea. What kind of monster was that? Was it killed?”
He heard Dina’s angry voice: “It was me, Idiot!”
Dudian:”…”
“It’s my second magic body.”Daina rolled her eyes and explained.
Dudian realized that Daina’s body had changed before she went into the sea. He knew that she was telling the truth. It seemed that she had swallowed him to provide him with oxygen and hide her smell.
He thought of the mouth of the monster. How Big was the magic body to swallow him in one bite?
“Since you have the monster’s body, why didn’t Bolo let you control a monster in the sea and take us to travel at night?”Dudian immediately asked.
After a while, he heard Diana’s indifferent tone: “This is my secret. He doesn’t know.”
“Secret?”Dudian was surprised: “Didn’t he colonize your magic marks?”
Dinah didn’t Answer Dudian. It was obvious that she didn’t want to tell Dudian the secret.
Dudian was puzzled. He felt that with Bolo’s cautious personality, she could hide her rebellious heart. It was because of her high acting skills that she was able to hide the secret of her body, it was a bit incredible.
“Why did you bring us?”Dudian asked another question.
After a moment of silence, Diana spoke again. Dudian’s body suddenly felt cold, “It’s probably because we are almost the same.”
“Almost? What is almost?”Dudian’s body was stiff.
Diana’s voice slowly echoed, “I have seen all of your memories. You are like me. We are both orphans. If there is a chance, I want to see the world. If it can abandon me, I can destroy it!”
Dudian was startled. His mood was a bit complicated. He corrected: “The one who abandoned you is Bolo. It has nothing to do with this world.”
“No!”Diana’s voice was firm: “He is just a part of this dirty world. It is this world that has made him dirtier. One day I will purify this world!”
Dudian opened his mouth but couldn’t say anything. He didn’t expect that her thoughts would be so extreme. It was as if she was possessed by the devil. The evil she got from one person turned into hatred for the whole world.
“Don’t You Hate This World?”Diana seemed to see through Dudian’s thoughts. Her tone was cold, “I know that although you don’t say it but you are the same person as me. You really like the old era when you were a child. It was a clean and beautiful world. It wasn’t the world that you grew up in after waking up. So you learned to kill people. The more you kill, the more you kill. Moreover you have no guilt in your heart. To you, they are like animals from another world. You Can’t even call them ‘the same kind’. People will never have mercy in their hearts when they hunt otherworldlings.”
“So you are the real devil in this world!”
Dudian shook his head after a moment: “You are wrong.”
“Wrong?”There was a trace of displeasure in Diana’s voice.
Dudian wasn’t afraid, “I never thought about killing people but I have felt the threat of death. When I felt that others wanted to kill me and could kill me without paying too much price, I really woke up. The first time I killed someone was an old alchemist. I accidentally killed him. It was that time that I experienced the feeling of killing people.”
“Many things are like this. When you start, you can’t stop.”
“Especially more and more people. I feel that killing them is not enough as a punishment!”
“Unfortunately, death is the biggest punishment.”
“Don’t you hate them?”Diana coldly questioned. Her tone was full of disbelief.
Dudian knew that she wouldn’t believe him even if he denied it. But he didn’t want to deny it, “I hated you when I was in the most desperate situation. But that desperate attitude isn’t permanent. I Won’t hate you when I get out of that state of mind. I know who my enemy is and who I should kill.”
Daina sneered, “Stupid.”
Dudian wasn’t angry. He felt that his soul had become purer after saying these words. It was as if he had been baptized. He was more clear about his goals and beliefs.
But..
There was always a worry in his heart.
“Maybe one day when I am completely hopeless, I will become like you and want to destroy everything.”He muttered to himself.
Dina smiled but didn’t say anything.
After a long silence, Dudian heard a roar from outside. His heart shivered. The next moment he felt that his body was hit and thrown to the other side of the wall.
“DAMN!”Diana cursed in a low voice.
At this time, Dudian felt that the soft wall around him had become as hard as a steel plate. His body began to shake as if the sea monster’s body was rapidly swimming forward.
Bang!
Bang!
The sound of collision came from time to time.
The body of the sea monster crazily twisted and turned. Dudian’s body also rolled and shook.
After about ten minutes the battle outside was over.
Dudian was relieved as he saw that the sea monster was still alive. He looked at Diana: “Will it be able to reach the shore?”The previous battle was so intense so it was estimated that the sea monster had suffered a lot of injuries.
“It depends on luck.”Diana replied.
Dudian was silent. There were countless monsters in the endless sea so he could only rely on luck.
“This world is really bad…”he sighed in his heart. He thought that if they were unlucky and the sea monster was torn apart by the more terrifying monsters, they would inevitably be buried in the belly of the fish. Perhaps.., that was the end of his life.
He couldn’t help but feel regretful.
Suddenly, he thought of something and asked: “Are there any monsters in the sea? Why Can’t they fly over at night?”
Dina snorted: “Do you know what is on the other side of the sea?”
“Isn’t it the East Continent?”Dudian naturally remembered.
“Do you know what is on the East Continent?”
“What?”
“Another empire.”
Dina’s words made Dudian’s heart jump. His previous guess was confirmed.
There were indeed survivors on the east continent.
“Is it the same empire as the Shenluo Empire?”Dudian couldn’t help but ask.
“How else can it be called an empire?”Diana asked back.
Dudian asked: “But what does it have to do with not being able to fly over the sea at night?”
“Idiot!”Diana said in a bad tone: “There are Thunderbirds in the sky of the Shenluo Empire. Naturally there are defenses in the sky of the Eastern Continent Empire. They are the flaming birds that we have met before! The flaming birds perched on the clouds. It was said that they fed on sunlight so they couldn’t fly too high. If they flew too low they would attract the attention of some terrifying monsters in the sea. Some of them had poor eyesight and were almost blind. Some of them had good eyesight and had adapted to the dark environment of the deep sea. However those monsters with poor eyesight would ignore the monsters swimming in the sea. They would treat the flying things as prey.”
“Even if they are prey, can they fly?”Dudian’s face was strange: “Moreover, how do you know so clearly?”

chapters.title: Chapter 981
chapters.content:
Chapter 981 – Chapter 971: Arrival
“I have been here before. Of course I know.”Dean couldn’t refute Diana’s words. He suddenly felt that he had asked a stupid question. Since Boro knew about the east continent, he had been there before.
“The first time we passed by here, we were almost attacked by a flying sea monster. This sea area is like a defense line for the east continent. We can only cross it during the day or take the east continent’s invisible airship.”Diana explained to dean: “But crossing it during the day is also very risky. Although the sunlight can prevent the sea monsters from attacking, but the flame birds are active during the day. Occasionally they will go to the low altitude to hunt other flying aliens.”
Dudian was a bit curious about the ‘Invisible Airship’that she mentioned. It seemed that the technology level of the East Continent Empire wasn’t inferior to that of the Shenluo Empire.
“Why did you come back to this desolate place?”Dudian asked. He didn’t believe that Boro wouldn’t be able to find a place to hide in the east continent.
“This desolate place is close to the god of war wall. It is convenient for us to observe the situation of the god of war wall.”Diana indifferently said: “Moreover living in the east continent isn’t as comfortable as you think. Especially him. He accidentally exposed his identity when he first came to the east continent. If he was exposed again then the consequences would be very dangerous!”
Dudian was startled but quickly understood.
The East Continent Empire wasn’t a big secret to the king of the god Luo Empire. However the East Continent Empire was able to stand tall and not fall. Obviously there was a king level existence.
At this time Dudian once again felt the body of the sea monster sway. His body tilted as if he was on a roller coaster. He didn’t talk to Diana to avoid distracting her.
Half an hour later, the sea monster gradually slowed down after several battles. Dudian clearly felt that the sway had slowed down. It didn’t take long before Diana spoke: “We are here. Get ready to go ashore.”
Dudian’s heart relaxed. At this time, he suddenly saw a ray of light shining down from above.
With the help of this ray of light, Dudian barely saw a grotesque shadow standing in front of him. It looked like a giant spider. He was startled but quickly remembered that it was the shape of Diana’s magic body, her spider legs pierced into the flesh wall and sank deep into it. It seemed that she had become one with the sea monster.
“Go!”Diana shouted.
Dudian’s eyes swept to the side. He saw another beautiful figure standing there. He grabbed her hand and jumped towards the passage where the shimmering light was coming from. He jumped up a few meters away.
The sound of the waves came from all directions. The smell of seawater permeated the surroundings. Dudian saw that he was standing on the back of a black fish. The Sea was endless and terrifying.
Hundreds of meters in front of him was a shallow beach.
The body of the sea monster was too thick. It was impossible to swim into the shallow beach.
He didn’t know if it was because of the weather, but the water in the shallow beach was still very dark. He could see the jagged reefs protruding. He didn’t dare to jump into the water and swim over. Although it was a shallow beach, there were probably many small sea monsters, there were also some highly toxic sea monsters.
He wanted to spread his wings and fly over, but he suddenly remembered that his magic marks ability was still suppressed. He could only turn his eyes to Aisha and whistle.
Aisha quickly entered the magic body state. Dudian hugged her body and let her fly over with him.
After he flew, the sea monster suddenly growled and let out a manatee-like low howl. The next moment, a black shadow flew out from the middle passage of the fish’s back. Its body changed in mid-air. The bat-like wings spread on its back and it quickly chased after him.
Dudian looked at Dina who was chasing after him. His eyes flashed. This was a rare opportunity to escape!
He had just thought about it, but it quickly cooled down. Now he wanted to escape. The only person he could rely on was Aisha. However, Dina knew all of Aisha’s orders. She was afraid that before he could let Aisha launch an attack or escape.., dinah would react and use the command to restrict Aisha and capture him.
“Wait…”Dudian silently thought. There would always be an opportunity.
At this time, Aisha brought him to the sofa. Dinah also landed and put away her demon form.
Dudian also let Aisha return to her human form. He looked up at the distance outside the sofa. There were sparse giant trees. In the distance there seemed to be a plain.
“Where are we going now?”Dean asked.
Diana looked around and frowned. After a moment, she looked at dean and said: “Let her enter the magic body and take us away. We don’t want to leave any footprints.”
Dean frowned. Although he was a bit uncomfortable but he knew that she was right. He let Aisha enter the magic body again and hugged her from the side. At this time, Dina also hugged him from the other side.
Dean was startled: “Aren’t you able to fly?”
“I want to save my physical strength.”Dina glanced at him. Although her expression was indifferent, but there was a hint of fatigue between her brows.
Dean thought that she should have used a lot of physical strength and mental strength to control the huge sea monster, so he didn’t say anything more.
“Go that way.”Diana pointed in the direction.
Dudian let Aisha fly in the direction of her finger.
In the blink of an eye they flew for more than two hours. The scenery along the way was monotonous and boring. Most of them were plains and rolling hills. Occasionally there were forests but they flew past in a few minutes.
“Wait!”Diana suddenly shouted, “Hurry and land!”
Dudian was shocked and immediately let Aisha land.
“Restrain your aura. There are fire dragons!”Dina whispered.
Dudian’s face slightly changed as he shrank his pores to hide the smell. He whispered: “Are these fire dragons monsters of the Eastern Continent Empire? How could they appear in the desolate land across the sea? Can they fly?”
“Who told you that they are monsters?”Dina stared at the distance without looking back.
Dudian was stunned: “What is that?”
Daina glanced at him but didn’t answer.
After a moment, Dudian saw a faint red light in the distance. In the blink of an eye it ran in a straight line and disappeared from his sight.
Daina stood up and dusted off her sleeves: “Let’s go.”
Aisha took Dean and Daina off again. They flew in the direction that Daina Pointed. There were lots of monsters along the way.
Dean found that the strength of the monsters here wasn’t high. They had encountered countless monsters along the way but the strongest ones were barely at the level of the Abyss. They were “Safer”than the wasteland that was cleared by the Shenluo Empire.
“We are here.”Suddenly, Dinah’s voice sounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 982
chapters.content:
Chapter 982 – Chapter 972: The Third Magic Mark
Dudian looked up and saw a magnificent building standing in front of the vast wilderness. It looked like an ancient city wall. It was built with three or four meters of huge square stone. It was two or three hundred meters tall.
However, after looking at the giant wall which was thousands of meters tall, Dudian wasn’t shocked. Instead, he was a bit surprised, he asked Diana: “The Empire didn’t build a giant wall like the god of War?”
“Of course they did. But by the time you see it we will have been exposed.”Diana laughed, “The sea was the first line of defense of the empire. The Army of the god of war couldn’t cross that line. Their god of war wall was built in the inland area. We are only on the outer edge. This is just a shelter built by the refugees.”
“Refugee Shelter?”Dudian looked at the giant wall which was getting closer and closer. He was surprised as he suddenly thought of the barbarians who had been expelled from the outer wall of the giant wall of Sylvia. Perhaps this was the same existence.
Moreover the giant wall was obviously built by manpower. It wasn’t like the giant wall which was built naturally.
“Did you come here with Bolo?”Dudian asked.
Dinah glanced at him, “Of course not! There are many refugee shelters in the east continent. This is just one of them. We came to other shelters. How could I go to the same shelter? It would be suicide. If he doesn’t die then I will chase after him.”
“A lot?”Dudian’s eyes slightly moved. He remembered that she had deliberately led the way. Most likely she wanted to bypass the previous route, he said: “Maybe it would be safer to go to the previous shelters. The most dangerous place is the safest place. He wouldn’t think that we would dare to go to that shelter.”
Diana indifferently said: “That makes sense. Unfortunately you don’t know him. He is suspicious. He is more suspicious than you. He will try to figure out my thoughts and think that I will use a ‘smart’way to escape. If I go there then I will be exposed.”
Dudian saw that she had her own understanding so he didn’t say anything more.
At this time, the two gradually approached the towering ancient city. Dudian saw that the ancient city was similar to the giant wall. It was a square but the shape of the building was similar to the ancient Chinese city. At the moment there were teams of soldiers patrolling above the city. They were wearing armor but their faces were Western. They had white skin and blue eyes. There were ancient firearms on their waists.
Seeing the appearance of these guards, Dudian was even more convinced that the eastern continent should be in the old era of the west.
At this time, the guards on the city seemed to have seen them. They rang the bell and many soldiers quickly gathered on the route they were flying.
Dudian glanced at Dinah. She didn’t slow down Aisha. She must have some idea.
Whoosh!
A pair of dark red wings protruded from Daina’s back. She let go of Aisha and flew straight ahead. The degree of demonization on her body also increased. Soon, she turned into a three to four meter tall giant, her skin was red and slowly burned with flames. The wings on her back were also burned into fire wings. Her body showed more obvious changes.
Dudian was stunned.
This, this is..
A brand new magic body? !
Dudian remembered clearly that her first magic body was a giant spider monster which could read memories. Her second magic body was a sea monster with scales all over its body. But the strange appearance in front of him was clearly a new magic body! !
She had a third magic mark? !
Dudian’s face was full of shock. Suddenly he remembered what Diana had said in the belly of the sea monster. Boro didn’t know about her second sea monster’s magic marks!
He immediately understood.
Boro had inserted two magic marks into each “Dina”as a balance. One was from the Shenluo Empire and the other was from the eastern continent. It was the same for Dina, boro should have inserted the first magic mark to read her memory and the current blazing magic mark. It was very likely that she had secretly implanted the magic marks into the body of the sea monster.
And it had been hidden!
It had been hidden under Boro’s eyes!
Why did she take such a big risk to colonize the third magic mark of the sea monster?
Obviously it was impossible to increase her combat power. Dudian could feel the vigorous energy from the change of the blazing magic body. It should be an extremely powerful magic mark!
The only explanation was that she had to use the magic marks of monsters in the sea.
For example… escape!
She had been waiting for this day for a long time! And she was silently preparing for it!
When the opportunity came, those who were prepared would be able to seize it!
Dudian felt a chill in his heart. He thought that his scheme was profound enough. But he didn’t expect that Dinah was bolder than him!
What if Boro wanted to check her body? Wouldn’t she be exposed?
It would be crazy to take such a big risk for an unlikely opportunity!
Dudian’s pupils contracted as he saw an incredible scene!
The body of Diana was gradually becoming complete. The outline of her body was gradually becoming clearer. Dudian couldn’t forget the posture of the magic body!
The burning flames, the dragon-like body… The Fire Dragon Alien!
This magic body could actually become a fire dragon alien!
Dudian had witnessed it in front of the fortress outside the god of war. He would never forget it.
However, compared to the fire dragon alien that he had seen, Daina’s body was much smaller. Moreover, she seemed to be missing something. He couldn’t say what exactly was missing. It seemed that she wasn’t violent enough, there was no soul-shaking fear.
While Dudian was stunned, Dinah had already flown over the city. The burning shadow brought strong pressure and didn’t stop. It flew over the heads of the soldiers.
Dudian and Aisha followed closely behind. He looked at the soldiers who had retreated. They were frightened and scared. He gradually understood what was going on.
Until Dean flew far away, the soldiers didn’t move. They continued to watch from afar. No one used firearms to shoot and let them fly over.
After flying for a few minutes behind the city, Dean saw the second high wall. The height of the high wall was about 200 meters. It was square and in the middle of the high wall was a group of ancient Chinese buildings, it was bustling.
Dudian was surprised to see the style of the building. He didn’t understand it.

chapters.title: Chapter 983
chapters.content:
Chapter 983 – Chapter 973: Control
There were guards patrolling on the second defense wall. When they saw Dinah flying towards them, they went from alert to kneeling. Dudian’s guess was confirmed, the fire dragon should have a very high status in the East Continent Empire.
Even the royal family here.
Dudian’s expression was a bit strange as he flew into the ancient city. He saw that there were many western faces living in the ancient buildings in the east. He began to doubt his previous guess.
At this time, Diana flew straight to the center of the ancient city. The building was a bit like the Forbidden City. There were rows of patrolling guards. Most of the guards were Asian. There were very few western faces.
The patrolling guards also noticed Dina when she was above the building. However, they ignored her as if they didn’t see her.
Soon, Dudian saw three or four figures walk out of the largest palace-like building. All of them were Asian and looked up at Dina.
Whoosh!
The Flames on Dina’s body gradually converged and slowly descended. When she landed on the steps in front of the palace, her demonized body had gradually returned to human form.
Dean and Aisha followed close behind and also landed on the side. He saw the doubts on the Asian faces and his heart slightly moved. He stepped back for a distance.
“You are?”A middle-aged man who was standing in the middle looked at Dana in confusion. The language he spoke was surprisingly Chinese!
Hearing the long-lost Chinese, Dean’s heart rose with an indescribable feeling. It was as if he had returned to his hometown!
Diana’s face was calm as she slowly walked forward: “I was ordered to come here. Are you the manager of this place?”She was also speaking Chinese!
The doubts on their faces disappeared but there was still a bit of vigilance. The middle-aged man said: “Who Are You? Who ordered you to come here? We…”he suddenly stopped.
Dina, who was slowly approaching them, suddenly accelerated and turned into a black light. The distance of more than ten meters was as short as a step. She instantly arrived in front of them. Puff, puff, puff. Among the three people standing on both sides of the middle-aged man.., two of them had a bloody hole in their chests. The middle-aged man and another woman wearing a qipao embroidered with peony flowers reacted faster. The middle-aged man raised his hand to block, but his body was knocked away. One of the woman’s arms was cut off, and her body was sent flying to the side, however, she managed to save her life.
However, Dinah’s attack was successful. She was like a shadow as she chased after the middle-aged man. The woman in the dress looked at her in horror. The demonized sharp arm suddenly pierced through her forehead. Her body didn’t stop as she flew towards the palace.
All of this happened too quickly. Although Dudian expected a battle but he didn’t expect that Dinah would be so sinister and cautious. She was obviously stronger than the other party.., but she deliberately let down the enemy’s guard and took the opportunity to launch a sneak attack.
He took Aisha with him but saw Dinah holding the neck of the middle-aged man and lifting him up. The burly middle-aged man looked like a weak chicken in front of the graceful and Petite Dinah.
The maids and servants in the palace were stunned but they quickly reacted. They drew their swords and lined up in front of the highest throne in the palace. A handsome young man was sitting on the throne, he looked about twenty-four or twenty-five years old. He had sword-like eyebrows and star-like eyes. His temperament was cold but there was a bit of surprise on his face.
“Who are you? !”After two seconds of delay, the cold young man regained his dignity. His eyes shot out a dazzling light. His whole body was covered in black mucus. He had entered the devil body state ahead of time.
Dina didn’t answer. She held the middle-aged man as if he was a stone statue.
There was a moment of silence in the hall.
Dudian who was standing behind Diana clearly saw that a sharp black thorn suddenly appeared from the palm of the middle-aged man’s hand. It pierced through the middle-aged man’s jaw. The middle-aged man’s eyes were white and lifeless, it seemed that he was dead.
Read Memories?
Dudian immediately thought of Diana’s ability. He didn’t think that she would dare to do such a thing in the presence of a strong enemy.
The cold youth couldn’t hold back anymore. He waved his hand and the surrounding guards rushed forward.
At this time, Dina slowly raised her head and looked at the malevolent figures who had entered the state of the Devil. Her eyes flashed with a trace of flame. The heat wave swept through the hall.
In the next moment, Daina, who was covered in flames, shook off the middle-aged man and rushed forward.
“Ah!”
“Ah!”
Screams of pain rang out one after another. The guards who had rushed towards Daina were knocked away by her. Some of them flew backwards, some of them were torn apart, and some of the flames that had touched her body started to burn rapidly, no matter how hard they tried, they could not extinguish the burning flames.
Dinah did not seem to see these guards. Her figure went straight for the cold-looking young man on the throne.
The cold-looking young man’s face was full of shock. He had already seen that Dinah’s strength was far beyond his imagination.
“Go to hell!”In despair and fear, he suddenly roared and pulled out a long black spear from under the throne. The green-black sharp claw held the spear shaft and stabbed towards Dinah. The shadow of the spear was like the wind.., in an instant, thousands of spear flowers bloomed.
The blossoming spear flowers were incomparably beautiful, but the more beautiful they were, the faster they withered.
The spear flowers instantly shattered and extinguished. A Ray of black light flashed past. With a clang, the metal fell to the ground, but the spearhead was broken.
The cold-looking young man’s growling body also froze. Two slender fingers that were arranged side by side like sword fingers stopped in front of his pupils. Although these fingers definitely did not look like a hand holding a weapon, but like a small hand that was used to embroider at home.., he did not dare to act rashly.
The cold killing intent that enveloped his entire body disappeared like the tide in an instant. The cold-looking young man felt as if he had gotten a breather from drowning. He only felt that his entire body was already covered in cold sweat, but Dina, who was not emitting any killing intent.., at this moment, she appeared graceful and beautiful to the extreme. However, in her pair of indifferent eyes, there was a condescending arrogance. She was like a queen who ruled over the world. His heart was filled with panic and grief. He gritted his teeth and said, “What do you want?”
“I’m staying here temporarily. I need to stay here for a while. You just have to serve me well.”Diana put down her hand. The demonized flame on her body had long been extinguished. She only said indifferently.
The cold-faced young man was slightly startled. He secretly heaved a sigh of relief and immediately changed into a respectful smile. He said, “You can stay here as long as you want. If you need anything, just tell me. As long as there is something here, you can choose anything.”
The surviving guards below the steps were all stunned. They looked at each other and looked at the cold-looking young man in disbelief. They had never thought that this cold and lonely king, who had always been serious, would actually show such a flattering and humble smile.
They thought that only low-class people like them would need to be fawned on.
So, it turned out that it was the same for everyone..
“Let’s settle the matter here first,”Dana said indifferently.
The cold-looking young man naturally knew what she was referring to. He smiled obsequiously and said, “Yes, let them leave now.”
After saying that, he turned his head to look at the guards and maidservants below the stage. In an instant, he returned to his proud and aloof attitude, he said coldly, “All of you, leave. You are not allowed to spread the matter here. Otherwise, you will be killed without mercy! In addition, from today on, seeing this lord is like seeing me. No, it’s more respectful than seeing me. If anyone is disrespectful, don’t blame me for killing three generations!”
“Yes, Lord.”The guards hurriedly bowed their heads.
Dudian looked at the cold youth. He admired the latter’s quick change. His temperament was extraordinary.
After the guards left, Diana said to the cold youth: “Sit Down.”
The cold youth’s face slightly changed: “You should sit here.”
Diana glanced at him and stretched out her hand.
There was a trace of fear in the cold youth’s eyes. He instinctively wanted to raise his hand to block. But in the end he held back. He felt that Diana didn’t have the intention to kill.
The next moment, Dina’s hand touched his face.
So Soft.
The cold youth thought that his hands shouldn’t be stained with killing but should be used to serve others.
Suddenly, his forehead hurt and his vision went dark.
Dudian saw Dina’s action and knew what she was going to do. He couldn’t help but envy in his heart. The memory reading magic mark was too practical. He could quickly understand the local situation and make a judgment in any strange place, it was thousands of times better than interrogation.
Five minutes later, Dina let go of his hand.
Dudian was surprised. How could he read memories so quickly?
When his memory was read, he felt as if he had experienced a new life. Although there were slides that played quickly but it felt like more than ten years had passed.
Soon, Dudian noticed that although Dina let go of his hand, the cold youth didn’t open his eyes for a long time. On the contrary, a lot of cold sweat was oozing out of his body. There was a faint pain on his face.
Dina ignored him and quietly pondered.
After more than ten minutes, the cold youth slowly opened his eyes. There was a bit of confusion in his eyes.
When he saw Dina, his eyes suddenly became clear. He stood up and respectfully knelt down, “Greetings to my King!”He covered his chest with his hands. His posture was pious. It was completely different from the previous humble and respectful posture, it was as if he loved her from the bottom of his heart.
Dudian was stunned. He remembered that Dinah was able to control the sea monster. Apparently, her ability was not as simple as reading the memory. She could even tamper with the memory!
He felt a chill in his heart. If she used this ability on him… wouldn’t he be completely enslaved? !
This thought made him feel a great sense of danger. It was even more terrifying than when he was in Bolo’s hands. At least at that time, his consciousness was still his own. However, in Dina’s hands, once she altered his memories, he would be completely finished!
“Pass down my orders. Block the news of my arrival. In addition, tell the research institute to stop all current experiments and transport all the steel, cables, and other materials used in their experiments to the moon-facing palace. From today onwards, without my permission, no one is allowed to enter the moon-facing palace!”Dina’s expression was cold, he ordered one order after another.
“Yes, my King!”The cold youth said respectfully.
A moment ago he was trying to be polite but now he was completely under Diana’s skirt.
Dudian’s mood was complicated but he quickly noticed the things mentioned in Diana’s order. He was surprised: “Are you going to do an experiment?”
“Of course.”Diana indifferently glanced at him.
At the moment she was standing in front of the steps. The cold youth was kneeling on the ground. His small body was wrapped in a scarlet robe but he looked down at everything.
Dudian suddenly felt a chill when she glanced at him. It was not because of the majesty but because of the meaning in her eyes. He suddenly found that he had just left the tiger’s Den and entered the wolf’s Den!
It seemed that Dina wanted to do something to him.
Did she want to continue Boro’s Experiment?
Dudian’s face was ugly. No wonder she would take him and Aisha away at such a critical moment! Perhaps she had already paid attention to him and helped him to escape. She just took him away from Boro as an experiment!
That night.
Under the arrangement of the cold youth, Diana, Dean and Aisha moved to a side hall behind the palace called the moon-facing hall.
Diana was familiar with the place as if she had returned to her own home. She made a list of the materials needed. She told the names of the people who could be used to make arrangements for the cold youth.
Dudian looked at her copper and cable. He guessed her thoughts: “Do you want to make electricity and return to the Empire?”
“You are not stupid.”Diana glanced at him: “No wonder you can climb all the way to this position. If it was me, I might not be able to do it.”
Dudian was not proud of her praise. He was depressed because his idea was confirmed: “You should return to the Empire because you want to go back to Sylvia to retrieve my Super Chip.”
“This is only one of the reasons. Of course, it is also the main reason.”Diana didn’t refuse to answer Dudian’s question, “It is a pity that you haven’t mastered the Super Chip. Otherwise I would be able to grasp the knowledge from your memory. But it doesn’t matter. I have a photographic memory so I can learn quickly. Moreover it is safer to go back to the Holy Empire. If Boro was still alive he wouldn’t have thought that we had returned to the Holy Empire. After all, I can’t sneak through the god of war wall with my strength alone.”
Dudian felt an indescribable anger and helplessness. He was more desperate than when he was facing bolo. Diana knew everything about him. He had no secrets in front of her so he couldn’t find any way to escape.
“Even if you made a way to avoid the thunderbird, it is still very risky. Why Don’t you continue to stay here?”Dudian wanted to persuade her to stay. It wasn’t because of the super chip but because he suddenly felt that.., if Boro found her then there might be a better chance of survival.
Diana glanced at dudian. It seemed that she saw through Dudian’s thoughts. There was a sneer on her face but she didn’t answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 984
chapters.content:
Chapter 984 – Chapter 974: The Only Flaw
The next day, Daina sent coolies to transform the temple into a laboratory. Large amounts of materials were transported to the square outside the temple.
Dudian was surprised that this seemingly ancient sanctuary didn’t lag behind in technology. It actually had electricity. Of course, this electricity was only in the hands of the upper class. It should be the technology brought out from the empire of the eastern continent.
After the transformation of the temple, Diana wholeheartedly devoted herself to the experiment. She called the Master of the research institute to be her assistant.
Dudian was ordered by Diana not to leave the temple. He could only wander around the temple and think of ways to escape.
Since he knew that Diana could tamper with his memory, he had been thinking about how to prevent her from tampering with his memory. He didn’t want to fall into the same situation as that cold youth.
However, no matter how he thought about it, he felt that there was no solution.
After all, from the point that Diana knew how to use electricity to avoid the thunderbird, it could be seen that not only could she check the memory, but she could also grasp all the thoughts in your heart.
No matter what plan he had, when she read his memory, it would be understood.
“My memory should not have been tampered by her. Otherwise, I would not want to leave her…”Dudian sat on the stone railing outside the hall. He looked at the golden-armored guards who were moving the materials back and forth. His eyes fell into deep thought.
He repeatedly recalled all the images and details of the sanctuary. He slowly found the reason. There should be a lot of damage or resistance when Diana tampered with his memory.
He could see this point from the painful expression of the cold youth’s memory. He remembered that he didn’t feel much pain when he woke up from the hospital bed. Perhaps it was because of this.., at that time, Diana didn’t tamper with Dudian’s memory. After all, Bolo was next to her. If he acted strangely, Bolo would know that she had done something to him.
Later on, he was also the object of Bolo’s attention. Diana couldn’t find the opportunity to touch him and tamper with his memory.
Later on, they fled all the way. Diana also didn’t have the opportunity to attack him.
However, when she fled to the eastern continent, she had the opportunity to deal with him. However, she didn’t attack him for unknown reasons.
Did she know that he couldn’t escape so she had nothing to fear?
Dudian didn’t understand. Perhaps there was a deeper reason behind it. But no matter what the reason was, it wouldn’t be a good thing for him.
“After the suppression of my magic marks is over, she should be on guard against me. The best way is to tamper with my memory. I have to be on guard in advance.”Dudian thought in silence.
It was easy to say, but how could he be on guard?
When Dinah wanted to tamper with his memory, his thoughts would be known by Dinah. Even his thoughts would be understood by Dinah. How could he be on guard?
His heart was sad as he thought of this.
“My memories when I was born were dug out by her. Even if I made a plan in advance and forgot about it, she would find out about it. Damn it, she would know about my current thoughts and dig deeper…”Dudian couldn’t help but rub his hair, he wanted to rip his head off. He was too upset and distressed.
It was useless to think about it. If he didn’t think about it, would he sit and wait for death?
He felt more powerless than if he had fallen into Bolo’s hands. At least at that time his thoughts still belonged to himself. Even if his mind was MMP, Bolo wouldn’t know about it.
When he was in a bad mood, he suddenly heard a call coming from the front.
“Young master, Young Master!”
“Young master, where are you?”
“Young master, come out quickly. Don’t scare us.”
The voice wasn’t pleasant to hear. It was a woman’s voice.
Dudian was in a bad mood. He looked towards the direction of the voice. He saw a sixteen or seventeen-year-old boy hiding in front of a pile of copper materials. He was dressed in satin clothes. He was wearing expensive clothes. At the moment he had a silly smile on his face, there was a bit of pride on his face.
“Young master is here.”A gold-armored guard who was transporting building materials saw the boy and immediately called out to the woman.
The woman was overjoyed and immediately ran over.
The boy heard that there was a snitch. He angrily glared at the gold-armored guard and suddenly rushed over like a crazy person. He hugged the boy’s hand and bit it.
The gold-armored guard was a bit panicked. He quickly hugged the boy and said: “Young Master, don’t Break Your Teeth.”
The young man continued to struggle and clawed at his throat.
At this moment, the woman had already run over and hurriedly said, “Young master, don’t hurt yourself.”
The young man turned his head to look at her and then looked at the golden-armored guard in front of him. Suddenly, he sat down on the ground and kicked his legs wildly. He started to cry loudly like a child. To be precise, he cried like a baby.
The woman seemed to have already responded. She quickly took out a candy and a small puppet from her pocket and handed it to him. She coaxed, “Young master, what do you think this is?”
The young man opened his eyes and looked over. When he saw the candy and the puppet, he immediately stopped crying and grabbed them, giggling foolishly.
The woman and the golden-armored guard both heaved a sigh of relief. The golden-armored guard cupped his hands at the woman and left hurriedly, afraid that he would get into trouble again. The woman took the young man’s hand and dusted him: “Young Master Listen to me. We are going back. The king is waiting for you. If we don’t go back then they will go out.”
The young man heard her words. He was nervous as he grabbed her hand and ran forward.
“Young master, please slow down…”the woman shouted.
Dudian rolled his eyes as he watched their back gradually disappear. He was bored by this episode. He was about to get up and return to the hall when suddenly his mind seemed to be hit by something.
“Retard… idiot…”he muttered.
“Idiot…”
“Idiot…”
His confused eyes became brighter and brighter. He suddenly thought of an existence — mental illness!
What was mental illness?
Dudian didn’t seriously learn this knowledge so his understanding was similar to most people. In his opinion, mental illness was difficult to understand.
Yes, it was impossible to understand!
How could a normal person understand mental illness?
He couldn’t help but laugh. It was as if he saw a ray of light in a desperate situation.
“It turns out that her magic marks ability is not perfect!”Dudian felt that he had unexpectedly found the flaw of Dinah’s ability. Reading memories could read the memories of others, moreover, he could understand other people’s thoughts. But wouldn’t Dinah be disturbed in the process?
The answer was of course no.
Dudian thought of the arrogant attitude of Dinah when she read the memories of the cold youth. She was like a monarch who had been sitting on the throne for a long time. The change in her temperament was very obvious. He hadn’t noticed it before, however, he had noticed it when he had been thinking about these details.
Of course, it was possible that Diana had such a temperament. After all, in the beginning her posture was like a queen. But now it was more obvious.
This discovery couldn’t be used as strong evidence. But Dudian firmly believed in another point of view: When you stare at the darkness for a long time, your eyes will adapt to the darkness.
Generally speaking, the more you see, the more changes there will be. It’s like a person’s growth experience.
People will mature because they see more things, and they will develop different personalities because of different environments. Each person’s memory is each person’s own environment. When Diana reads the memory, it’s the same as experiencing such an environment. There will inevitably be some changes in personality, and something will be added.
What if she saw the memory of a psychopath?
Would she also become a psychopath? Or would she become neurotic?
However, Dudian naturally wouldn’t let himself become a psychopath. But he could try to make his thoughts as complex and weird as a psychopath. He could think of all kinds of strange ideas.
When Dinah read his memory, these ideas would flow into Dinah’s mind and collide with her own world view.
Dudian was gradually excited. This was a god’s idea of a counterattack!
He began to think hard about the specific implementation process and many strange ideas that would impact Dinah’s thoughts.
Time went by and the sky turned dark.
When an attendant came to inform Dudian to eat dinner, Dudian woke up. He found that the sky had turned dark. He had been sitting here for the whole afternoon!
Dudian dusted off the dust on his pants and followed the guard back to the hall. He left his dinner on the table. Dina sat on the upper seat and ate a chinese-style dinner.
Dudian saw the familiar dishes that he hadn’t seen for a long time. He felt nostalgic and sat down at the table.
“You are such an adult. Why do you need to be called to eat?”Dina glanced at him after he sat down.
Her eyes seemed to have a profound meaning.
Dudian’s heart shivered but his expression remained the same. He indifferently replied: “Isn’t it because I don’t want to disturb your work?”He bowed his head and ate.
Dina didn’t say anything. She stretched after eating her own food: “Chinese food is really good. It is much more flavorful than the previous ones.”
“At least it is rich.”Dudian casually replied.
Dina got up and left after eating. Dudian looked at her back. The excitement in his heart gradually disappeared. He suddenly realized that there was an obvious loophole in his thoughts.
Letting Dina read the memories of mental illness could indeed change her thinking. However, it was just a change.
Perhaps this change would make her more violent and crazy.
But his ending would not change just like that.
Moreover, he could not become a real psychopath, which meant that he would destroy himself first.
When Dinah read his memories, many of the thoughts that he had set up would be controlled by Dinah, including the reason for these thoughts, the purpose of these thoughts, and so on. All of them would be understood by her.
Therefore, his afternoon of meditation was in vain.
The excitement in his heart was quenched again. He felt that the dinner had become dull and tasteless.
After a very slow dinner, Dudian slowly calmed down from the disappointment and despair. He felt that he could at least try again or think of other ways.
As long as he didn’t give up, there might be a way out.
He went back to his room and continued to think as he slowly fell asleep.
Another two days passed.
Diana called dudian to a separate laboratory in the moon-facing hall. The appearance of the laboratory was similar to the one in Bolo’s underground base. Dudian’s heart sank.
Dina had inherited Boro’s idea. Not only did she treat him as an experimental subject, but she also wanted to complete Boro’s experiment on him!
“Don’t be nervous. I just want to install a small thing for you.”Dina looked at the gloomy face of Dudian. Her expression was indifferent. She took a syringe from the hand of a gray-haired old man.
Dudian looked at the liquid in the syringe. He knew that it was an anesthetic. He didn’t speak or resist.
After the anesthetic was injected, Dudian felt that his body gradually became numb and he lost consciousness. Diana moved him to the hospital bed and locked his hands and feet.
“Sleep well…”Diana took another syringe. The liquid inside was blue.
She injected it into Dudian’s neck vein. Soon, a wave of drowsiness hit him.
Dudian opened his eyes but found that it was extremely strenuous. His eyelids seemed to weigh a thousand pounds. He bit the tip of his tongue. He was slightly awake due to the weak pain. However, in a few seconds, endless drowsiness hit him again.
Dudian finally couldn’t hold on any longer. His vision went dark.
He didn’t know how much time had passed. Dudian felt a burst of pain in his brain. He was startled and woke up in an instant. Could it be that during the time he was unconscious, her memory had been tampered with? !
Soon, his tense muscles relaxed again. He felt that he was still hostile towards Daina. He was sure that his memory should still be intact.
The next moment, he felt a slight burning and tearing pain coming from his neck. He slowly turned his eyes and saw a gentle white light shining on his face. There were several old figures walking around, they were holding strange materials in their hands.
At this time, Dudian noticed that many things in the laboratory were not related to electricity. It seemed that Dina was not making an insulating electric suit.
One of the old men saw Dudian wake up and quickly left. Soon, Dinah’s figure appeared by the bedside. She bent down and looked at dudian. There was a bulging chest gap on her neck, she stretched out her soft hand and touched Dudian’s forehead. After feeling for a while, she nodded: “The fever has subsided. Not bad. How Do You Feel?”
Dudian thought of what she had said before. He opened his mouth but found that his voice was hoarse: “What did you install for me?”
Diana smiled, “It’s nothing special. I installed it for you in advance. If you betray me in the future, this thing will take your life!”
At this point, she blinked. “No matter how strong you become, it will take your life!”

chapters.title: Chapter 985
chapters.content:
Chapter 985 – Chapter 975: Return
“You! !”Dudian’s face was full of despair.
Diana smiled as she saw Dudian’s expression. She turned around and left.
The two gray-haired old men smiled as they followed. They fully showed the obedience of their assistants.
The despair on Dudian’s face gradually disappeared after the people left. His dark eyes were like a bottomless abyss. He had thought of this when Diana said that she would install something for him, there was no accident.
Moreover, the biggest problem for him was to crack Dinah’s memory and leave her side.
If he couldn’t do this, he wouldn’t be in the mood to care even if there was a bomb hidden in his body that could explode at any time.
However, Dinah’s action made him a lot more careful. This meant that Dinah had no intention to read his memory for the time being. So he deliberately showed an expression of grief and despair.
However, how could he crack her memory reading?
Dudian’s heart was really powerless and desperate. No matter what he thought, when his memory was read, his thoughts would be spied on by Dinah.
It was like a theory of time and space. There was no answer.
Dudian pondered for a night but still had no clue.
The next morning, Diana came to the laboratory. She saw Dudian lying in bed. She patted his face and woke him up: “Wake up. Today you will make the electric suit and battery with me.”
Dudian opened his eyes. He knew that she was going to return to the Shenluo Empire.
There was no resistance and no question. Dudian climbed up. There was no life in his eyes. He was like a puppet. He quietly got up, washed up and ate breakfast, he quietly followed an old man to the laboratory where Daina was making electric suits. There were a lot of materials that had been processed and smelted.
These materials were produced by the workshops in the city. The industrial strength and manpower of the entire city were gathered. The progress was fast.
“In addition to the electric suits, we also need a set of armor to wear outside to defend against the sharp claws of the Thunderbird. We will leave this to them. Our task today is to make electric suits, batteries and electric balls.”Daina saw Dudian coming, she immediately told him her idea and plan.
Dudian quietly listened and said: “The material of the electric suit can not be made of aluminum wire. Although it is considered a good insulating material, but under high voltage, it is easy to melt. The same is true for plastics.”
Dana nodded: “I know that the aluminum here has another role. Let’s make the electric suit first. You will be my assistant.”
Dudian nodded. His memory was read by Daina. Daina also knew the knowledge that he didn’t know. She also knew more than him so he didn’t have anything to show off, he had to be honest with her.
Time passed by in the experiment.
Two days later, two sets of electric clothes were made. Dudian and Daina selected them after different voltage tests. Although the insulation of the two sets of electric clothes was still unable to resist the high voltage, but it was the best set of electric clothes that could be made at present.
Moreover, considering the limitations of the insulating materials, Diana also installed a conductive device on the electric clothes. When the voltage was too high, the electric clothes would absorb part of the voltage and store it in the battery connected to the back of the electric clothes.
There were eight long batteries behind each electric clothes. In addition, there were more than 80 batteries stored in the insulation backpack. When the batteries in the electric clothes were full, they could be replaced.
In addition, Dinah came up with an idea to make electric balls and electrodes. Three seconds after the electric balls were opened, they would release electricity. The electrodes were two short rods that collided with each other to produce electricity. The principle was very simple.
The reason for making these two things was that Thunderbirds lived in the clouds and ate lightning. When they encountered groups of Thunderbirds, they might be able to use electricity to lead them away so that they could buy time to escape.
After everything was ready, another day passed. Diana gathered dudian and Aisha and left the ancient city together.
Dudian couldn’t help but feel a bit regretful as he thought of returning to the Shenluo Empire as soon as he arrived in the east continent. He felt that he was like a duckweed that was drifting with the current.
“What’s inside?”Dudian asked curiously as he saw that Diana had a backpack.
Diana didn’t hide it, “It’s the legendary flame soul worm from the east continent. We can continue to carry out Boro’s experiment after we return to Sylvia and Find Your Super Chip. I know a bit about this experiment. Don’t worry. I’m confident that if I get some useful knowledge from the super chip then I will be more confident. You will soon become the first immortal God in this world!”
Dudian’s mouth twitched. His fate hadn’t changed. He taunted: “Even a god has to obey your orders, right?”
Dinah smiled. It seemed that this sentence had touched an itch in her heart, she patted Dudian’s shoulder and said: “Don’t be so depressed. As long as the experiment method is correct I will become an immortal God after you become a god. We can create a large number of gods to rule the world. At that time you will be my number one general. I Won’t mistreat you. I can even give you freedom!”
Dudian’s eyes lit up: “Freedom?”
Dina smiled: “Yes, Freedom!”
Dudian nodded but didn’t say anything. His eyes were no longer as dull as before.
Dina smiled as she saw Dudian’s change. She waved her hand: “This world will soon be ours!”
“I hope so.”Dudian said. He thought for a moment and looked at her: “You can change that person’s memory. You should be able to change my memory. Why Don’t you do that?”
Dina pursed her lips, she smiled: “I thought you wouldn’t ask. It is alright to tell you. Although it is not difficult for me to change my memory but it will have a great impact on the victim. The person’s brain nerves should have been damaged a lot. I Won’t be able to see anything in a short period of time. After a long period of time there will be problems such as amnesia, slow reaction and so on. If it is serious then there will be dementia.”
Dudian was startled. He didn’t think that there would be such a big risk. No wonder Dina didn’t do it to him. It was probably because she didn’t want to hurt him.
He smiled wryly in his heart.
“Don’t be disobedient if you meet a flock of Thunderbirds.”Dina turned her head and looked at him: “You don’t want her to be buried with you.”
Dudian knew what she meant. He was afraid that he would meet a flock of Thunderbirds and fight to the death with her.
“I won’t do anything stupid.”Dudian said.
“That’s good.”Dina nodded.
Half a day later, Dina led them back to the shore.
It was noon and the sun was high in the sky.
Dina looked at the sky. She turned her head and looked into Dudian’s eyes: “Have you recovered your magic marks ability?”
Dudian was surprised as his pores shrank. He wanted to deny but he held back. He felt that his physical strength was gradually recovering. His vision was getting wider and wider. His strength was increasing rapidly and the power of magic marks was returning to his body, his body was filled with a strong feeling.
However, he had always been careful to hide it, and he had tried his best to act as usual during the experiments. He had not expected that he still could not hide it from Dina.
Deny It?
If that was the case, would she read his memories?
After all, reading his memories without modifying them would not do him any harm. She definitely would not mind doing so.

chapters.title: Chapter 986
chapters.content:
Chapter 986 – Chapter 976: Light
After struggling for a moment, Dudian finally chose to admit it: “How do you know?”
“The effect of this ‘anti-magic Potion’will last for half a month at most.”
Dudian was glad that he didn’t lie. He looked at Diana: “What are you going to do? Continue to imprison my magic marks?”
“Don’t be nervous.”Diana smiled, “I don’t need to give you the ‘anti-magic’because of that thing. Moreover you will be a burden if you don’t have the magic marks on the way back. I may not be able to protect you if you encounter the Thunderbirds. However you don’t want to take this opportunity to escape. Once you cross the god of War I won’t be able to see your figure. The thing in your body will take your life. I don’t need to personally take action.”
Dudian knew that she was warning him. He did have such thoughts but he wouldn’t dare to try her words. After all, he would lose his life if he made the wrong choice.
“I know.”His voice was low and sullen.
Diana’s eyes shined but she didn’t care. She said: “In that case, let’s prepare to set off. The weather is clear today and it is daytime. Let’s fly over!”
“Will we encounter the flame birds?”Dudian asked.
Diana glanced at him: “The flame birds are flying over the clouds to enjoy the sunshine in such weather. As long as we don’t fly too high.”
Dudian knew that she might be more thoughtful than him so he didn’t say anything.
Black mucus gushed out from Diana’s body. Four thin wings protruded out from her back. The rest of her organs were still in human form.
Dudian didn’t hide anymore. Black mucus also gushed out from his black body. Two black wings grew out like two giant blades. He didn’t lose his witcher. He was like Diana and Boro. He used his witcher to live in his body. He needed to be able to break it down and enter his body at any time.
Dudian had a new understanding of the use of magic marks after he fought with the second Diana. He had a deeper feeling when he saw Boro attack later on. Boro had never entered the full demon body state except when he met the flaming birds during the migration. Dudian even felt that the twelve-winged demon body might not be the full demon body of Boro. After all, the twelve-winged demon body looked.., other than the skin color change and the extra wings, the rest of the demon body was almost the same as a human body. This was very different from the other high-level deep fusion of the strange shape of the demon body.
Most of the Abyss’demonic bodies were almost 100% fused. Once they were demonized, they would almost be in monster form, and not many humans could be seen.
During his daily experiments, Bolo only partially demonized his body. Sometimes, he even used a finger to demonize. This kind of partial demonization required a lot of skills, and its effects were very obvious. It could save a lot of stamina in a prolonged battle, if used well, it could even play a stronger combat power than the whole demon body.
After these days of observation and comprehension, Dudian gradually mastered the skills of the half demon body. At the moment, he only demonized the splitter’s wings on his back. His body was still in the human posture.
Daina smiled indifferently as she saw Dudian’s change. She knew that Dudian had observed the half demon body since the last time she read his memory. She didn’t expect that he would complete observation and implementation in such a short time, people of the old era were smart.
Dudian grabbed Daina who was wearing armor. He took off and followed behind Daina.
Daina flew towards the sea. Her body gradually rose to a height of 300-400 meters above the sea surface.
Dudian followed her. He felt that the sunlight was burning his body. It emitted intense heat through the Clouds and mist.
He flew through the shallow sea.
The magic marks in Dudian’s body were moving. There were rings of pale golden light in his pupils. They looked like the eyes of insects. The world had changed a lot in his sight. He could see countless tiny dust. There seemed to be tiny flies lying on top of the dust. They would flap their wings and fly out from time to time. However, ordinary vision alone couldn’t see this scene.
No one would have thought that there would be so many tiny dust and tiny flying insects in the seemingly pure and transparent air.
If an ordinary person lived in such a place and inhaled a large number of tiny flying insects, their body would soon collapse and all kinds of diseases would appear.
In Dudian’s eyes, Diana’s body in front of him was gradually infiltrated. His vision penetrated through the armor. He could even see the metal material inside the armor that forged the veins. Then he saw the electric suit inside the armor. When his vision continued to penetrate, a white body appeared in his eyes. But soon, the white body also quickly skimmed through and entered a deeper picture.
The pores were enlarged and the vision became blood red. The complex capillaries, deep veins, blood vessels, bones and so on were attached to the epidermis.
Dana’s body appeared in Dudian’s vision like a cocoon being pulled out of silk. There was no secret to study. It also allowed him to completely see the structure of her body.
“This, this body…”Dudian’s pupils slightly contracted. There was a trace of horror in his eyes. If it wasn’t for his strong control, he would have been scared out of his wits.
He suspected that he was looking at a monster!
However, when his eyes withdrew, the figure in front of him was still Dinah’s graceful figure.
His face changed. He was shocked, but at the same time he felt a different kind of horror.
As he had expected, there were three magic marks in Dinah’s body. Two of the magic marks were under her chest. The third magic mark was at the back of her neck. It was embedded in the top of her spine and was hidden very deep.
The inside of that spine was hollowed out, and a flesh sac was placed there. The magic marks rested in the flesh sac. The soft tissue seeping out of the flesh sac was mixed with extremely fine blood vessels. Like hair, they drifted out along the gaps of the spine, connecting with the flesh outside of the spine. They drew blood from the body and circulated together with the blood circulation of the whole body, at the same time, they could also transmit the power of the magic marks in the flesh sac.
It had to be said that this level of experiment was simply a gorgeous art. It was so exquisite that it made people speechless.
He suspected that the third magic mark should have been implanted by Dinah herself. The method was completely different from the other two magic marks. It was more exquisite!
In addition to the three magic marks, the most shocking thing was the various organs in Dinah’s body. It was too strange. For example, her stomach was definitely not a human stomach. It looked like a purplish-black water sac, there were two inches of soft tentacles on the surface of her stomach. They were firmly attached to the surrounding flesh and blood. In addition, her intestines were even more terrifying. Her large intestine was only a short segment but it was full of sharp teeth. Her small intestine was like a poisonous snake. There were obvious dents and bumps. The surface of her small intestine was unusually smooth. The inner wall of her small intestine was covered with thick butter.
Moreover, her bones were very strange. It was not a complete one but a skeleton made of different bones.
“How many experiments did Boro do on her…”Dudian felt that the dark laboratory had appeared in his mind. Boro had repeatedly dissected the body of a girl in front of the experiment bed, it was crazy to grow into the tissues of ugly monsters!
“Have you seen enough?”Dina’s voice was heard.
Dudian was surprised. The light gold color in his pupils disappeared and his pupils returned to pitch black. He asked: “What?”
Dina tilted her head and looked at him. There was a faint smile on her face: “Don’t you have the magic marks ability to see through my body?”.
Dudian wasn’t moved at all. In fact, he wasn’t interested in the structure of her beautiful body. Even if she was naked in front of him, he would feel disgusted, at the same time, he had a new understanding of Bolo’s ruthlessness. He shook his head: “I didn’t see. Speaking of which, will we meet Bolo or those kings?”
Seeing that Dudian had changed the topic, the corner of Diana’s mouth twitched. But she knew the answer so she was too lazy to pursue it, she casually said: “I deliberately took a detour. It was more than 300 kilometers away from the previous place. If we met him then we would be considered as unlucky. But I have always been lucky.”
Dudian smiled wryly. But I have always been unlucky..
Maybe this time Dudian really took advantage of Diana’s light. He flew across the sea. He didn’t encounter any birds in the sky nor any attacks from the sea.
Both dudian and Diana heaved a sigh of relief when they arrived at the isolated place. Diana smiled: “I told you that my luck was good.”
Dudian smiled wryly.
“Let’s Go!”Dina continued to walk in the forest.
Dudian followed her for more than ten hours. It was already two or three o’clock in the evening. They finally saw the god of war’s wall which stood at the end of their field of vision.
The God of war’s wall was more than three thousand meters tall. It was like a continuous mountain that brought endless pressure.
“Rest for one night. We will set off tomorrow at Noon.”Diana retracted her eyes and spoke to Dudian.
Dudian nodded. If they were to sneak into the Thunderbird’s attention at night then it would be easy to attract the attention of the empire’s border guards. It would be better during the day.
Both of them picked a big tree in the forest and slept on the tree.
The poisonous snakes from the forest hadn’t come close to the two of them. Their bodies broke and fell down. Their bodies twisted in pain.
“Your perception seems to be good.”Dudian leaned against the tree as he looked at the night sky.
Diana indifferently said: “Haven’t you guessed it? My First Magic Mark is the ‘Dreamer’.”
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He had connected her memory to the ‘Dreamer’. He didn’t expect that it would be so. All Kinds of information about the ‘Dreamer’appeared in his mind, there were very few descriptions about the ‘Dreamer’in Sylvia’s Monster Atlas. She only knew that the ‘Dreamer’could pull people into an illusion through poison. It could make people unknowingly fall into an illusion during battle.
From the ability that Dina displayed, it was obvious that the ‘Dreamer’ability was not limited to this.
This should be the top five-star legendary monster!
Whoosh!
Dina’s body suddenly moved. She jumped into the undergrowth of the tree and grabbed a monster that looked like a rabbit or a cheetah. The monster’s body was covered in leopard prints but its size was only the size of a rabbit. There were two pointy ears on its head but its sharp teeth were longer, it looked like the teeth of a saber-toothed tiger.
Dudian turned his head and saw that her finger was demonized. Her fingernail turned into a black needle and pierced into the forehead of the small monster.
After a while, the demonization of Daina’s finger was restored. She threw away the small monster that was twitching and jumped onto the tree where Dudian was lying.
“What?”Dudian had a bad premonition.
“Nothing. I want to see what you have been thinking about.”Diana indifferently replied.
Dudian’s face changed. He instinctively wanted to raise his hand to resist but he saw a ray of meaningful light from the depths of Diana’s eyes. He suddenly thought of the unknown things that were installed in his body. He became silent.
Diana’s figure flashed and instantly approached Dudian. Her palm touched his forehead.
Dudian felt that his vision went dark. Countless images were moving in front of his eyes. This time it was faster than the last time. It had been a few days. He opened his eyes and saw that it was still night. Diana had retreated and stood in front of the tree branch, he looked at him with interest.
Dudian knew that his thoughts had been completely exposed these days. His face was completely gloomy. However he was happy to think that he was still hostile towards Diana. This meant that his memory had not been modified.
“You are a threat.”Daina smiled.
Dudian’s body was cold as he heard her words. He forced a smile: “I have given up.”
“I know.”Daina smiled, “However, to think of using mental illness to interfere with my reading of my memory and even to reverse modify my memory is considered ingenious. Unfortunately, it is all in vain.”
Dudian smiled wryly.
“Since you have given up, then obediently follow me.”Dina leaned close to Dudian and held his chin with her hand. She gently blew out a breath of fragrance.
Dudian felt that she was becoming more and more masculine. Sure enough, reading the memories of the cold youth and himself had a certain impact on her.
“I will.”Dudian looked at her sincerely.
Diana smiled as she looked into his eyes. She retreated to another tree, “I won’t believe you. Who knows what will come out of your mind. Sleep. There may be a hard battle tomorrow.”
Dudian’s mouth twitched as he sighed. His disguise had been in vain these days.
He knew why Diana would suddenly read his memory. It was not a whim but because she was worried that there would be an accident during the smuggling.
Facing such a cautious enemy, he felt like he was weak in the kidney and saw a beauty. He lay down and looked at the stars through the gaps between the leaves.
The stars were bright and the universe was vast..
The starry sky was always mysterious and beautiful.
Dudian looked at it. Suddenly, his mind seemed to be struck by lightning.

chapters.title: Chapter 987
chapters.content:
Chapter 987: – Chapter 977:20 Seconds
Night always passed quickly. When dawn came, Dudian and Dina slowly woke up. They were like buds buried in the soil and darkness. They opened their bodies to welcome the new day’s Sunshine.
After eating the monster barbecue for breakfast, Dina didn’t leave immediately. She sat on the treetop and quietly waited.
When the clock of the mechanical watch pointed to “XII”, Dina heated up the remaining monster barbecue for lunch. After eating with Dudian, she got up and carried her luggage, looking at the distant God of war wall, her expression gradually became solemn.
“Get ready,”dina whispered.
Dudian nodded slightly and magic wings appeared on his back.
Whoosh!
Dina took the lead and took off into the sky.
Dudian grabbed Aisha and quickly caught up with her like a sharp arrow.
The two of them flew straight into the sky. In the blink of an eye, they reached an altitude of three to four kilometers. From Afar, they could see the tiny figures of ants on the god of War Wall. Dina continued to increase her altitude. In the blink of an eye, she had reached an altitude of six thousand meters. She was already surrounded by thin clouds.
The clouds looked like smoke, but it gave off a wet feeling. It contained moisture and gave off a cool feeling.
Dina continued to fly up into the sky above the clouds. The Sea of clouds around her was like cotton. They were bulging. The sky above the clouds was very blue and curved. This was enough to prove that the Earth was round.
“Keep up, full speed!”Diana whispered. Her body was like an eagle as she quickly flew forward.
Dudian’s eyes were serious as he accelerated to catch up. Rings of pale golden halos gradually appeared in his eyes. His field of vision increased as he saw that the surrounding clouds were full of moisture and countless small strange insects.
In less than ten minutes, Dudian saw that the towering god of war was standing about three to four kilometers below the clouds. It was like a giant axe that cut through the mountains and rivers.
He didn’t know if the people on the wall of the god of war could sense them.
Dudian’s eyes flashed but he wasn’t too nervous. It might be a good thing if they could sense him.
At this time, a bright red spot appeared on the upper edge of his field of vision. It spread to his eyes like a disease. Dudian looked at it and saw a bright red heat source appear in the clouds above his head.
“Thunderbird!”Dudian’s heart tightened.
Although he had imagined that he would encounter a flock of Thunderbirds and Dinah would be killed by the Thunderbird, he would take the opportunity to escape. But it was obviously too wonderful. If he really encountered danger, he might be the first to sacrifice himself to cover for Dinah.
