“Go!”Dinah said in a low voice.
Her speed suddenly increased again. She drew a snow-white arc in the thin clouds around her. But from the ground, it was a straight line.
Dean’s heart sank. He raised his hand to shake the bell and pushed Aisha out.
Whoosh!
The Bright Red Wings spread out from Aisha’s back. She entered the state of full magic and turned into a drakonid. It was similar to the fire dragon alien race, but it was obviously two different species. Her wings were flesh wings, and there was no flame on her body, the red-brown cuticle layer was extremely thick and tough. Part of her body was covered with scales. It was completely different from the fire drakonid’s burning flames, but the shape was similar.
After letting go of Aisha, Dudian immediately increased his speed and chased after Daina at full speed.
At this time, he suddenly found that Daina’s strength was more than twice that of the previous two Daina. He used all his strength to barely keep up with her. However, her heartbeat was still steady, her breath control was also very stable. There was no feeling of difficulty.
Dudian’s heart sank. This was not a good thing for him. He felt that Dina might have the strength of the Lord of the Abyss!
As the two accelerated, the scarlet heat source in front of them seemed to notice them. It immediately rushed towards them like a burning cloud.
Two minutes later, the scarlet heat source appeared in Dudian’s line of sight. It was a huge strange bird with dark purple feathers. There were curved horns on its head. There were claws attached to its wings as if it was an arm, the wings were only attached to the robe.
“Go!”Diana’s eyes were like lightning. Black cuticle appeared all over her body. Her body was in a semi-demonized state. Her limbs were not deformed but her skin and organs were demonized.
Screech!
Screech!
The screeching of birds sounded. It was especially sharp.
Dudian saw that lightning was jumping out of the dark purple birds. He knew that it was a Thunderbird. He took a deep breath and mimicked Diana’s appearance. His skin was also demonized, a layer of black shell appeared on his body.
Whoosh!
Diana’s body drew an arc as she dived down.
They had been flying at full speed for the past two minutes. Their flying speed was close to ten kilometers per minute. They could fly twenty kilometers in two minutes. Even if they landed here, with their skills.., they would be able to escape before the scouts behind the wall caught up to them.
But..
Screech!
The Thunderbirds approached in the blink of an eye. They were as fast as Dinah, especially when they were diving down. All the Thunderbirds were jumping like lightning.
Boom!
A bolt of lightning flashed towards Dinah. The speed of the Lightning was so fast that Dinah couldn’t react at all. She was shocked and almost fell.
Dean’s face slightly changed when he saw this scene. He quickly asked Aisha to put away her magic body. At the same time, he retracted the splintered wings that extended out from the back of the armor. He let his body glide forward and fall.
Although the insulating conductive clothes in the armor could protect them, but the wings that were demonized were enough to be the target of the electric current. This was a problem that they couldn’t solve. They could only rely on luck.., they had to add electric balls to support the natural fall.
Once they reached the ground, they would be safe.
But how long would it take to fall from a height of 6,000 meters?
Dudian and Diana had previously calculated that it would take about 50 to 70 seconds for an ordinary person to fall from a vertical position. Their fall speed was obviously faster than that. Firstly, their bodies were denser and heavier. Secondly, there were lead plates embedded in their backpacks. According to their calculations, they would naturally fall, it would only take about twenty seconds.
Twenty seconds was very short.
But at this moment, it was a matter of life and death for them.
Whoosh!
In less than three seconds, the flock of Thunderbirds approached again. The distance between them was less than a kilometer.
Hiss! Hiss!
A dazzling lightning shot out from the Thunderbirds’bodies and hit Dudian and Diana. The lightning flashed and illuminated the sky.
Although Dudian was armed to the teeth but his body was tightly wrapped by the electric suit. He felt numbness all over his body as if there was a weak electric current flowing through his body.
The electric current exploded on the surface of the armor and pushed their bodies to fall down faster.
Dudian didn’t care about the speed of the fall. He knew that the eight batteries on the electric suit were close to saturation and this was only the first round of Attack!
Moreover, not all the Thunderbirds were launched at the same time!
A golden halo appeared in Dudian’s eyes. He could see the blood flow and skeleton of all the Thunderbirds. Soon, he saw that there was an electric current in the blood vessels of the Thunderbirds. The electric current was white and as thin as a hair. The amount was so large that it was frightening, suddenly, a bolt of lightning shot out.
It was so fast that Dudian couldn’t Dodge it at all. He couldn’t even raise his hand to block it.
He was hit again. The numbness in his body was even stronger. He even had a slight feeling of being electrocuted.
The battery was saturated!
Whoosh!
At this time, Diana’s hand speed was very fast. She took out two electric balls from her backpack and threw them to the right. The balls of lightning were extremely fast. In the blink of an eye, they flew for a thousand meters and exploded into a dazzling ball of lightning.
The scorching lightning quickly attracted the attention of the Thunderbirds.
The Thunderbirds that were close to the balls of lightning immediately broke away from their formation and flew towards the balls of lightning.
The chaotic lightning that was shot out from the balls of lightning hit the Thunderbirds that were close to them. They let out waves of joyful sounds as if they were bathed in lightning.
Soon, one of the larger Thunderbirds, the fastest, flew to the front of the ball of lightning. With a cry, it opened its mouth and picked up the ball of lightning, swallowing it in one gulp!
Whoosh!
At this moment, Dina threw another ball of lightning to the other side. Soon, it scattered the Thunderbirds by the side and many of them rushed over to fight for it.
There were about a thousand Thunderbirds in the flock. At this moment, there were about one or two hundred of them scattered. There was still a black mass of them, and they continued to chase after Dina.
When Dina threw out the electric ball, she held a few electric rods in her hand. She threw two of them at the same time, and they flew into the flock of Thunderbirds in front of her. The electric rods intersected with each other and collided with each other, instantly, a dazzling electric light that was even hotter than the electric ball exploded.
The flock of Thunderbirds immediately became a little chaotic, and they swarmed up to fight for it.
During this short break, Dina quickly took out the battery in her backpack and replaced it with the battery on the back of her electric suit. Her hand speed was unbelievably fast, and she completed it in almost a second!
Such speed was very difficult even for an abyss.
Dudian had already replaced the battery when she threw the ball. He threw out the eight saturated batteries.
Dozens of Thunderbirds noticed the eight batteries. They flew over and swallowed them.
Dudian didn’t wait for the Thunderbirds to return to their formation. He took out the lightning balls from his backpack and quickly threw them.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Lightning balls were thrown to the left and right.
The originally orderly flock of Thunderbirds was now loose and scattered. They were chasing after the surrounding lightning balls.
Dudian and Diana took turns to throw the lightning balls. Most of the Thunderbirds were distracted. However, there were still two to three hundred Thunderbirds staring at them.
Fortunately, they were able to withstand the lightning bolts but they didn’t have enough time to replace the batteries.
Dudian felt the numbness in his body again. He took out three lightning balls and threw them at the group of Thunderbirds.
The lightning balls exploded and three balls of lightning flashed.
The group of Thunderbirds slowed down as if they had hit a wall. They rushed towards the three balls of lightning.
The surrounding Thunderbirds rushed over but soon the three electric balls were swallowed by the three fastest Thunderbirds.
When the electric balls disappeared the flock of Thunderbirds once again rushed towards the two.
Dudian had replaced the third battery and threw out the replacement battery.
The batteries were snatched by the Thunderbirds as soon as they flew out.
Dudian saw that the Thunderbirds seemed to have gained experience. Their speed was getting faster and faster. The electric balls were snatched away by the Thunderbirds before they could fly far. Some of the electric balls were swallowed by the Thunderbirds before they could explode, the lightning ball exploded on its neck but didn’t cause any harm to it.
Dudian glanced at the ground. His heart sank. The size of the objects on the ground was about the same as what he had seen from the top of the god of war’s wall. It had been so long but there were still two to three kilometers of height. It meant that they had to hold on for ten seconds!
But..
The lightning balls and electrodes in his backpack had been used up by more than half!
Moreover, the Thunderbird was getting closer and closer to them as it chased after the lightning balls. It had almost surrounded them. The lightning balls couldn’t be thrown far away so the pulling effect was greatly reduced.
Screech!
A Thunderbird screamed as it rushed over. It opened its claws and tried to grab Dudian.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he clenched his fist which was wrapped by the steel gloves. Bang! It hit the Thunderbird’s claws.
The Thunderbird’s sharp claws were broken and its body flew diagonally to increase the distance between them.
At this time, the Thunderbird was getting closer and closer. From time to time, lightning would shoot over.
Dudian saw a Thunderbird pouncing towards Haisha and hurriedly whistled.
Haisha, who was falling vertically, suddenly grabbed the flying Thunderbird. She opened her mouth and bit on its sharp blade, tearing off a piece of flesh.
The Thunderbird screamed in horror. It was in so much pain that it quickly pounced on its body. Its whole body exploded with a strong electric light.
Dean’s face changed. Although Aisha’s electric suit was different from theirs. What stored the electricity was not the battery, but a big ball of electricity in the bag behind her. But the saturation of this big ball of electricity was limited, at most, it was equivalent to three sets of batteries. Once it was saturated, it could not be replaced! This was also why he and Dinah did not choose to use the big battery.
Although replacing the batteries was risky and troublesome, if they were to repeatedly replace them, the six batteries they had equipped were equivalent to the storage capacity of two big batteries.
This big battery battery storage suit was specially made for Aisha by Dinah. After all, she did not say that they had to replace the batteries in her instructions.
After the previous continuous electric shocks, the big battery in Aisha’s backpack should be almost saturated, or even full!
While dean was nervous, Aisha’s ferocity did not decrease. She kept gnawing on the Thunderbird’s sharp claws.
Dean quickly blew out the order to stop the attack.
Aisha let go, and the Thunderbird broke free from her hand and flew away in a hurry.
Dudian looked at the big ball of electricity in Aisha’s bag. He saw that it was already saturated. His heart tightened. He was about to use his wings to hug her when he found out that she was shocked by the electricity, however, her body didn’t suffer much damage. Her hair was a bit burnt.

chapters.title: Chapter 988
chapters.content:
Chapter 988 – Chapter 978: Super Awakening
“Is the electric shock ineffective?”Dean’s eyes moved. Aisha’s body was only slightly injured after being struck by the Thunderbird. It seemed that she had a unique resistance to lightning.
Maybe this is an opportunity?
Escape… Dean immediately thought of this but quickly extinguished it. Diana also had the command to control Aisha.
However, Aisha’s special lightning resistance could at least make his pressure much easier. He immediately whistled and issued the command.
Whoosh!
Aisha lifted her demonized wings and her entire body demonized into a dragonman.
Dudian grabbed Aisha’s demonized dragon tail. With a whoosh, Aisha’s body flew down vertically like an arrow.
The ground was rapidly approaching.
Screech!
A Thunderbird noticed Dean and Aisha’s rapid retreat and immediately dived down. But at this moment, Aisha was also flying at full speed and was not caught. Bolts of lightning shot from the Thunderbird and hit Dean’s body. They passed through the surface of the armor and reached Aisha’s body, but her body did not change at all. There was not even a moment of stiffness or pause.
Dudian turned his head and saw that Dinah’s body was still falling vertically. However, her speed was obviously very slow. In the blink of an eye, he had pulled away from her.
The Thunderbird didn’t catch up with Dudian. It immediately turned around and rushed towards Dinah. Soon, Dinah was surrounded by the Thunderbird.
At this time, Dudian was led by Aisha. The ground was close to him. It was only about a kilometer away. He saw that the Thunderbird didn’t follow him. He also demonized the Thunderbird to eat its wings. He cut Aisha’s wind current and quickly landed.
After landing, Dean looked up. Dinah was still about two kilometers high. She was rapidly falling. However, she was surrounded by layers of Thunderbirds. Lightning flashed and there seemed to be a cluster of thunderclouds in the sky.
Dinah’s figure was no longer visible in the Thunderbird’s encirclement. He could only see the hot lightning that burst out from time to time, causing a small disturbance.
Dudian’s eyes were fixed on the Thunderbird as he prayed in his heart.
Although this was a rare opportunity but he didn’t intend to leave. The first reason was that he had been implanted with an unknown object by Dina. Although he couldn’t feel what it was but from the equipment in the laboratory.., it didn’t seem like Dina was deliberately blackmailing him. The second reason was that although Dina was in danger, he felt that she hadn’t used her trump card yet.
Whoosh!
The Lightning was suppressed in the tight encirclement of the Thunderbirds. Dudian’s scalp went numb. Even if the king came in person, he would be in a terrible situation!
At this time, the Thunderbirds which were gradually gathering into a formation suddenly slowed down.
Whoosh!
A figure suddenly knocked away a Thunderbird and rushed to the ground. Her body was burning with flames. It was Dinah!
At this moment, her body was bathed in flames like a fire dragon. In a flash, she shook off the Thunderbirds and rushed to the ground.
“Go!”
She stomped her feet. The terrifying impact caused the ground to explode. Her body was like a refraction light as she quickly flew forward. The flowers, plants, and trees along the way were all ignited and burned.
Dudian was startled for a moment. He quickly followed Aisha and chased after her.
Screech!
The Thunderbirds in the sky screamed. They quickly dove down and shot down bolts of lightning.
Dudian’s head had been cut and demonized. It was like a monster’s head growing on his neck. His field of vision was expanded to 360 degrees. With the combination of perspective and dynamic vision, he carefully observed the Thunderbirds, when he saw the white electric wires gradually accumulating on the surface of their bodies, he knew that they were about to be struck by lightning. He quickly turned his body.
Bang! Bang!
Lightning struck the ground or the trees. Some of the trees were split open by the Lightning.
After running for a while, a waterfall appeared in front of them. The ground seemed to be torn apart, revealing a deep gully. The water of the waterfall fell vertically and white waves surged.
Dinah took the lead and dived into the gully.
Dudian followed closely behind.
Screech!
The Thunderbirds above their heads let out ear-piercing screeches. Their bodies slowly slowed down and stopped above the waterfall.
Dinah dived into the pool at the bottom of the waterfall. The body of the fire dragon quickly converged and turned into the body of the sea monster. Fine silver scales grew on its body and it quickly swam in the water. Soon, the water turned red. Under the surging of the waterfall, more and more blood water dyed the pool red.
When Dudian rushed into the water, he saw a huge body that looked like a dragon upside down in the water. There was a huge wound on its chest. It was obviously Daina’s masterpiece.
Daina swam towards the front of the pool. There was a crack in the stone.
Dudian told Aisha to converge her body. Both of them followed along the way.
After passing through the narrow crack in the stone, the three of them came to a large lake. Arm-long strange fish rushed towards them. The mouth of the fish which was the size of a fist suddenly opened and was full of sharp teeth, it was so big that it could swallow a human head.
Dudian quickly cut it off with his magic blade. He used his X-ray vision and saw that there was a lake. There were more strange fish in the distance. In addition there were a few huge shadows.
He immediately rushed up and jumped up from the lake.
Dina also jumped out of the water. She changed her body again and returned to her flaming dragon body. She flew towards the lake.
Screech!
The sound of the Thunderbird came from the sky but the distance was obviously far away.
Dudian took Aisha and flew to the shore. He looked up and saw that the Thunderbird was still hovering over the waterfall. It seemed that it didn’t notice that they had escaped to this place.
Daina landed on the shore. Her magic body was retracted and her hair was wet. She wiped the water from her hair and looked at Dudian who had landed beside her, she smiled: “Why didn’t you take the opportunity to escape?”
“I didn’t want to leave you.”Dudian said indifferently.
Daina covered her mouth and laughed: “You are good at talking.”
Dudian slightly shrugged his shoulders. His eyes casually glanced around. He saw that Dina’s armor and electric suit were gone. No armor could adapt to three different types of magic body. The electric suit was even more so, there was only a vertical opening on her back. Once she entered the full magic body, the electric suit would be torn.
There was no armor or electric suit. Dina’s body was covered with a thin cloth-like underwear. It was wet and stuck to her body. It made her petite but plump body extremely attractive.
“Is she good-looking?”Dana looked at him and asked.
Dudian looked at her naturally without any shyness, “She is good-looking.”
“Better than her?”Dana glanced at Aisha who was silent.
Dudian smiled, “You have seen my memory. What do you think?”
Dana slightly curled her lips, “Boring.”She ignored Dudian and took off the backpack.
The backpack wasn’t made of ordinary cloth but was made of pieces of alloy iron. It was similar to a mechanical watch’s strap. There was a gypsum insulation layer inside.
Daina took out the clothes from the backpack and glanced at dudian: “Turn around.”
Dudian quickly turned around: “Let’s wait for the Thunderbirds to retreat. If they catch up then nothing can stop them.”
“Of course.”Dina’s voice came.
Dudian took off his damaged electric suit and armor. He didn’t bring any extra clothes. He could only wear his upper body. He wrapped the cloth around his waist and used it as a primitive trouser skirt.
“I didn’t expect undeads to have a good resistance to lightning. I didn’t notice this before because of the lack of water in their bodies. I’ll study it later.”Dina’s voice came from behind.
Dudian’s mouth twitched. He knew that she had noticed that he had let Aisha lead him to the ground. He was silent for a moment and said: “Are You Hungry? I’ll catch some fish to eat.”
Dina rolled her eyes at him: “Go.”
Dudian immediately got up and went to the lakeside to catch fish. Soon he caught a few big fish that were half the size of a human. These fish had sharp teeth and looked ugly. Some of the Fish’s blood was green. It was obvious that they were extremely poisonous.
Dudian picked two edible fish monsters. He skinned them and cut off their heads. He picked a few places where the meat was the most delicious. He found dry wood and set up a campfire to roast them.
While Dudian was busy eating, Dina walked around the lakeside. She found that the area of the lake was not big. It was like a vertical depression basin. There was a small forest behind the shore where they were, with her vision, she could see the end of the lake.
“The water from the waterfall flowed into the lake. The water from the lake should have flowed to other places. There should be a secret passage underground.”Dinah sat back by the campfire and smelled the fragrance of the fish, she smiled: “If the Thunderbirds don’t Leave Tonight, we will leave from the bottom of the lake.”
Dudian nodded. He didn’t have the right to speak so he could only agree.
Soon, the fish was ready. Dudian handed her one and took the other two. His fingers turned into sharp blades and cut the fish into thin slices. He fed Haisha.
“The undeads who eat cooked food, tsk tsk.”Diana laughed. It seemed like she was both mocking and sighing.
Dudian indifferently said: “Haven’t You Seen My Memory? She has been eating cooked food for a long time.”
“Sometimes you are quite stupid.”Diana sighed: “If you were a bit more ruthless and fed Sylvia’s life to her then maybe she would have the strength of a king. After all, she is a witcher who has turned into a king. There is a big difference between her and an ordinary king. In addition to the evolution of flesh and blood, her body will continue to awaken naturally. In the future she will become a king or even surpass a king.”
“Don’t exaggerate.”Dudian glanced at her: “Even if she ate everyone in Sylvia, she would at most be able to evolve faster. Moreover she has already awakened seven times and reached the limit of awakening.”
“Who told you that seven times awakening is the limit?”Diana looked at him in ridicule.
Dudian was startled.
“The information about the dragon race is limited. From a certain point of view, seven times awakening is the limit. But that is the limit of being a human!”! “However, for the zombies, there is no limit!”Dina said indifferently, “The reason why the awakening is divided into one to seven degrees is that, when the seventh awakening occurs, the monster genes that are implanted into the body of the Witcher warrior will be fully awakened and completely fused with their own cells. This is the limit of the Awakening
“However, there is still the Super Awakening!”
Dina laughed, “However, the super awakening is a bit troublesome. There are too many monster genes and it is easy to affect the thinking. Generally, people who are super awakened will have a big change in their temperament. They will even think that they are monsters and not humans.”
Dudian was stunned. He didn’t expect such a change.
“Moreover, the super awakening is not the limit!”Dina’s words stunned Dudian again, “Super Awakening is just a change from humans to Weirdos. But for the undeads, when the body is super awakened, the monster’s genes are in the majority. There is no meaning because they have no thought! After the Super Awakening, the monster’s genes in their bodies will continue to divide and mutate. Under the interference of the virus, they will continue to mutate endlessly. No one knows what they will become in the end because there is no end!”
She looked at Dudian who was stunned, “Although she will awaken naturally, but the speed of the natural awakening is very slow. Of course, compared to when she was still human, it can be said that the speed of the natural awakening is very fast. But after the super awakening, it will slow down. At this time, if there is a large amount of flesh and blood, it will accelerate their body evolution and cell division.”
“So, if you are willing to give her up, she is now a king. She is an existence that even a king can not compete with. She can be called a corpse God!”
“Corpse God…”Dudian was stunned.
Diana finished eating the fish in her hand and licked the oil stains on her fingers. She looked at dudian with interest: “Do you regret it?”
Dudian sighed: “A little.”
“If you had known about this, you might have been ruthless enough to bury the life of the entire Sylvia. You would have gone on a killing spree to help her wake up. In that case, she would be your strongest force.”Daina indifferently said: “By that time, you would be able to rely on her help to seize control of the empire. You would have time to slowly study how to restore her. It wouldn’t be like now when you are in a desperate situation, right?”
Dudian’s heart was shocked. He had thought about it before. Dina spoke out his thoughts almost word for word. It seemed that she knew him better than he did.
“However, this is also good.”Dudian’s mood quickly calmed down: “I was tempted by the power of a king. But even if I knew about it, I wouldn’t have done it.”
“I know you wouldn’t.”Dina indifferently said: “You are worried that the higher the awakening of her body, the more dissimilation there will be. In the end it will be more difficult to recover, right?”
Dudian bitterly smiled: “Do you have mind reading?”
“Of course. I should be the one who understands you the most in the world!”Dina blinked her eyes.
“Is it fun to seduce me in front of her?”Dudian asked back.
Dinah’s mouth twitched, “Boring!”
Dudian didn’t say anything more. He leaned on the tree to rest and recover his strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 989
chapters.content:
Chapter 989 – Chapter 979: Domain Monsters
The flock of Thunderbirds hovered over the waterfall and didn’t disperse for a long time.
Dudian and Diana sat by the edge of the forest to rest. Half an hour later, Diana suddenly opened her eyes and looked up at the flock of Thunderbirds. She frowned as if she thought of something, she whispered: “Prepare to retreat!”
Dudian saw that Dina had guessed it. He opened his eyes and asked: “What’s Wrong?”
“Thunderbirds are the special forces of the Empire. They are smart and intelligent. They have been hovering here. They should be sending signals to the border guards of the god of war. We have to go!”Dina’s face was gloomy, she quickly packed her luggage and kicked the campfire into the lake to erase the traces on the ground.
“Let’s Go!”Diana’s face changed as she was about to enter the water.
Bang!
Seven or eight figures jumped down from the surrounding stone wall and surrounded Dudian and Diana.
“Hidden sentries!”Diana frowned as she saw the black uniforms of these people. She glanced at other places but didn’t know if there were people hiding in the dark.
Dudian didn’t expect that the hidden sentries behind the god of war wall had already come over. He was surprised. He used his thermal vision to look at them but found that there was no heat wave coming out from their bodies. They looked like dead people, moreover, there was a smell of soil on their bodies. It was no wonder that he and Diana didn’t notice it.
However, these people didn’t attack for a long time. They were either waiting for them to be alone and expose their flaws or there weren’t many people coming. They didn’t have the confidence to deal with the three abyss level experts.
“Stop!”One of the burly men said in a low voice. He was wearing a black mask like the others, only revealing a pair of sparkling eyes.
“What?”Dina looked at him calmly with an innocent expression on her face.
“Who are you people? What are you doing here? !”The burly man said in a low voice.
“Is it forbidden to enter here? Didn’t you see the notice?”Dana smiled.
Dudian couldn’t help but sigh as he saw the conversation between the two. It seemed like a simple and normal question but in fact it revealed the purpose of both sides. The problem exposed by the hidden sentry was undoubtedly fatal!
Originally they weren’t sure if there was an ambush in the surroundings. But the hidden sentry seemed to be normal but in fact it was deliberately delaying time. After all, it could alert the Thunderbirds and alarm them, no matter what the purpose was, it wasn’t something that could be clarified in a few words. The best way was to arrest them and interrogate them.
The best way to arrest them was to use all their strength to put psychological and physical pressure on the other party.
The reason why Dinah spoke was to probe. She had found out the answer through the second sentence.
The burly man snorted: “You are also an Abyss Walker. Don’t you have a map? The God of war’s wall is not far ahead. It is a forbidden area within a hundred miles of the god of war’s Wall!”
“Really? How come I didn’t know about it?”Dinah was surprised but there was a hidden smile in her eyes.
The burly man was about to speak when a black shadow attacked him. Dinah cut into the demon’s body. She was as fast as a shadow as she approached the burly man.
So Fast! The burly man’s pupils constricted. Although he had been prepared for this, he did not expect that Dinah would suddenly explode. Moreover, her speed was so fast that it exceeded his reaction. He hurriedly raised his hand and instinctively brandished his dagger to block.
Clang!
The dagger was hit, and the shock caused his mouth to go numb.
At the same time, a feeling of pain suddenly spread from his chest. Then, he felt a cold wind.
He looked down and saw that his chest had been pierced by a sharp black spear!
This was not a weapon’s spear, but a sharp leg.
Puff!
The sharp leg was pulled out, and the black figure suddenly retreated, dodging the two sharp swords coming from the back of the burly man.
In this gap, one of the masked sentries quickly hugged the burly man who was slowly falling down. Although his face could not be seen clearly, from his figure, it was obvious that he was a slim woman. There was a trace of grief in her eyes, and tears welled up, however she didn’t hug the burly man and call out to him. Her emotions were out of control as she whispered: “Kill!”
The other six sentries were activated at the same time.
The six of them turned into six monsters in the blink of an eye. Some of them were half-human and half-snake. Some of them looked like gophers. Their bodies were covered with sharp black fur. Some of them had pink oval wings, there were also tentacles on their foreheads.
“Master, Master…”Dudian’s eyes swept around. He was relieved as he saw the heat waves emitted by the dark sentry, he didn’t turn around as the three dark sentry rushed towards him. However he knew the situation behind his back. He threw out three sharp monster limbs from the back of his spine.
Puff! Puff!
The three hidden sentries thought that Dudian didn’t turn back but they were shocked by the sudden appearance of the magic limbs. The speed of the magic limbs was extremely fast. It was faster than Dudian’s running speed. The three of them stopped but it was too late. They could only raise their magic weapons to block the attack.
In the blink of an eye, the two of them were cut in half. It was as if the magic weapons were cut into tofu.
The remaining one felt uneasy when he lifted the magic weapons to block. He rolled on the ground and dodged. He saw the corpses of his two companions fall to the ground. His face turned pale.
Whoosh!
The three limbs of the monster swung to the left and quickly turned back to stab at the surviving dark sentry.
The Dark Sentry hurriedly turned around and ran. The speed of the explosion was beyond Dudian’s expectations. It was at the level of Abyss Walker.
However, it was only an inferior abyss.
Puff!
Three sharp limbs quickly caught up to the Sentry. They pierced through the Sentry’s back. The Sentry’s body broke into several pieces and fell to the ground.
“It’s actually three abysses. The control ability of the heat source is simply top-notch!”Dudian sighed in his heart. It was easy to expose the smell and body state when one entered the demonization, although the three sentries leaked some heat but they were still restrained. He was ashamed of his ability to control the heat source. He estimated that he would have to train the dragon’s blood for another year and a half.
By the time he finished off the three sentries, Diana’s battle was over.
“Let’s Go!”Diana shook off the Slim Sentry. The Sentry’s chest and heart were pierced. He was dead like a burly man. His throat was crushed and there was a small hole in her forehead.
Dudian had seen that Dinah had read her memory.
Splash!
Dinah quickly jumped into the water without stopping.
Dudian held Aisha and followed closely behind.
Dinah’s magic body turned into a sea monster. This time, Dudian saw it clearly. It turned into a five to six meters long strange fish. It looked like a shark but there were six to seven sharp blades on both sides of its body, these sharp blades were sharp weapons that could easily cut the body of other fish. Moreover, there was a strange mouth full of sharp teeth under its abdomen.
The eyes of the strange fish could still vaguely see the appearance of Dinah. Its face was elongated and protruded. It looked very strange.
Whoosh!
Dinah opened her mouth and swallowed Dudian and Dinah.
Dudian once again felt that his body was tightly wrapped. It was like he was swallowed when he went to the sea area of the eastern continent.
However, this time he wasn’t blind.
“In her mouth…”Dudian’s heart was pounding. This time his magic body wasn’t suppressed and was in Dinah’s mouth! What a good opportunity!
His pores slightly contracted and his heart was extremely nervous. He was calculating all kinds of images in his mind.
Entering the demonic body, all the sharp blades in his body attacked at the same time, tearing and piercing Daina’s body from the inside out… This process only required a little more than a second for him. The extra bit was the speed of his attack, and that second was the speed of entering the demonic body.
It was also this second that was extremely crucial.
If he had already entered the demonic body at this moment, he would have attacked without hesitation. He didn’t believe that Daina would be able to react in time. However, that one second of the demon body was enough for Dina to feel it and spit him out in an instant.
He was hesitant and conflicted in his heart. After more than ten minutes, he suddenly felt his body being squeezed out. When he opened his eyes, he saw a bright light. He had arrived at a shallow river, and his surroundings were a green bank and a forest with a wide field of vision.
Phew… he let out a sigh of relief in his heart. He felt both regretful and relieved. It might have been a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but it was also possible that he was destined to fail. After all, Dina knew about his demon body.., she knew that he wouldn’t give up but she still dared to put him in her mouth. It was enough to show that she was confident and prepared.
“Maybe she knew that I was suspicious and wouldn’t make a move?”Dudian thought. His eyes flashed and he bitterly smiled. He was too suspicious!
However, he felt that the possibility was very low. No one would dare to put their life in the hands of others. A person who was always suspicious might have a decisive moment.
“Hurry up and Go!”Dinah jumped onto the shore and quickly transformed into her magic body. She spread her wings and flew away.
Dudian picked up Aisha and used his magic wings to chase after her.
When they were parallel, Dudian asked: “Are there any hidden experts around?”
“Yes.”
“What did you read from the Hidden Sentry’s mind?”
“This is not what you should ask.”Dinah glanced at him.
Dudian slightly shrugged his shoulders.
Both of them flew forward. They passed through mountains and rivers. The ground quickly retreated under their feet.
After flying for four to five hours, they met a few flying strange birds along the way. They were easily killed by Diana. Finally, they came to a dark forest to rest.
“At this speed, I estimate that we will be able to return to Sylvia in a few days.”Dudian sighed.
Previously when he came out it would take him a week to travel this distance but now it only took him a few hours. No wonder he was called ‘Abyss Walker’. As long as he didn’t run to the depths of the magic pit he wouldn’t encounter much danger.
Diana leaned against the tree and closed her eyes: “Prepare dinner.”
Dudian sighed as he saw that he was being treated as a servant. He got up and went to search for monsters. Soon he picked up two furry tiger-sized monsters and threw them on the ground. Then he picked up a bonfire to skin and roast them.
After the barbecue was done, he handed a thigh to Daina. Then he took a slice and fed it to Aisha.
After Aisha finished eating, he also enjoyed it.
After eating, Dudian buried the surplus corpses. He planned to put out the bonfire as well. After all, they didn’t need to warm themselves by the fire. But Daina stopped him.
“It’s comfortable to sit by the fire.”Diana said.
Dudian stopped and went to find some firewood.
The night was coming.
Dudian and Diana were resting on the tree. From time to time monsters would be attracted by the fire. Diana treated Dudian as a guard and asked him to deal with them in advance.
The night passed in the blink of an eye.
There were more than ten monster corpses of different sizes lying around the place where they were resting.
Diana stretched and got up to call Dudian to continue their journey.
In the blink of an eye, four days had passed.
Two figures flew over a forest and stopped. “Is this the despair forest?”Diana looked at the vast forest. Although she had seen it in Dudian’s memory, but Dudian’s memory was based on his own perspective, the area that he could see was limited, but at the moment it was a panorama.
“Do you know what kind of Monster is under this forest?”Dudian’s heart was moved when he heard her words. He thought of the huge monster tentacles under the soil when he passed through the forest. If the entire forest was alive.., what level of monster was it?
“It should be a domain type monster.”Dina said as she flew forward.
“Domain Type?”It was the first time that Dudian had heard of such a thing.
“I have heard from Bolo that this kind of monster is huge. It can be considered as a living thing. It is the ruler of their territory. Even if a king enters it, there will be danger.”Dina said casually, “However, they will not take the initiative to attack. They have their own hunting habits. It is like this forest. As long as they don’t step into it, they should be fine.”
Dudian nodded slightly.
However, at this time, two black tentacles with a diameter of four to five meters suddenly shot out from the forest.
Diana’s face changed: “Fly Higher!”
Dudian didn’t need her to tell him to increase the height and avoid the black tentacles.
“She wouldn’t dare to follow me if I rushed down. But in this case, although I’m out of her control, I’m also in danger. Moreover I don’t know what she has installed for me…”Dudian’s eyes flashed, finally he sighed. He was a bit disappointed in himself. He was too powerless!
The forest returned to silence after the two flew to a thousand meters high.
Diana was relieved but her face wasn’t too good. She snorted: “We will burn this thing to ashes when we succeed in our experiment!”
Dudian was silent.
Dudian looked at the familiar red wasteland after flying through the forest. There were Dead Warriors’armors everywhere on the ground. They were filled with mud, embedded in the ground and decayed weapons.

chapters.title: Chapter 990
chapters.content:
Chapter 990 – Chapter 980: No One Could Stop Him
“I’m back…”Dudian looked at the red wasteland. He could clearly see the traces of the previous Silvia Warriors. Although he was still a master when he came out.., but he had control over the power of the Silvia. However, he couldn’t even control his own life and death when he came back. It was difficult to say whether he had gained or lost.
Bang! Bang!
A two story tall giant beast jumped out from the ground. Its body was covered in black iron armor. It looked like a rhinoceros.
Dudian saw that it was a level 83 rhinoceros. Its combat strength was comparable to the Masters of the wasteland. Its destructive power was strong but its body was clumsy. Its weakness was obvious so it was easy to deal with.
However, its skin was rough and its flesh was thick. The Warriors of the wasteland didn’t dare to hunt it alone.
Soon, Dudian saw that there were four heat source figures chasing behind the rhinoceros. However, there was a clear gap between their speed and that of the rhinoceros. Once the rhinoceros began to run.., unless it was a master of speed, it was impossible to catch up to them.
Dudian saw the four heat source figures and his body suddenly fell down.
Whoosh!
He fell from the sky and stopped three meters away from the ground. He looked at the approaching bone rhinoceros and felt as if he was hit by a train.
He slightly inhaled and raised his hand.
Roar!
Bone rhinoceros didn’t slow down but growled as it sped up.
The next moment, its head hit Dudian’s raised palm. Whoosh! Dudian’s body was pushed back by the force. He was pushed back for more than twenty to thirty meters before he gradually stopped.
There were two deep trenches under the hooves of the rhinoceros.
Roar!
The rhinoceros roared in anger. It stepped on its hooves and prepared to collide again.
Dudian smiled. Two magic blades suddenly jumped out from his armpit. Whoosh! As if they were cutting tofu, they pierced into the face of the rhinoceros, the huge body of the two-story building shook slightly and fell to the ground.
Bang! The ground was filled with dust.
Dudian loosened his hand and the magic blades shrank back. The skin of the rhinoceros was extremely hard but it was still unable to resist the cutting blades.
Whoosh!
The four heat source figures quickly caught up and appeared in Dudian’s sight.
Dudian squinted his eyes and saw the standard armor and the scars on the pauldrons. They were dragons!
At this time, the four people seemed to have noticed Dudian and the fallen rhinoceros. They slowed down and stopped. They looked at each other and whispered to each other. After a while, one of them flew out, he slowly came in front of dudian.
When he saw Dudian’s appearance, the man was stunned: “You, you are a traitor… Wall Master?”
Dudian indifferently looked at him: “Do you know me? This should be the depths of the red wasteland. Aren’t you stationed near the defensive line? Why are you chasing after this monster?”
The man was stunned for a moment. He quickly reacted and changed his expression, he said in a humble and respectful tone: “Dragon’s power pays respect to the wall master. I heard that you went out. You Don’t know that our defense line has been moved to the depths of the red wasteland. The outer wasteland has been cleared into hunting areas. We have been ordered to clear the depths of the red wasteland and develop it into the outer wasteland.”
Dudian’s eyes slightly moved: “Ordered? who ordered?”
Power’s face slightly changed. He was about to speak when a figure suddenly appeared in front of him. It was Dinah.
“Come over.”Dinah looked indifferent as she raised her slender palm.
Power was startled as he noticed the petite and beautiful girl. He quickly reacted. This should be Dudian’s female companion. He didn’t dare to disobey and respectfully said: “Yes.”
Diana’s palm quickly pinched his face as he flew close. One of her fingers magically turned into a black spike and shot into his forehead. Odin’s eyes became dull as he struggled. After a few minutes he slowly regained consciousness but his eyes were blank.
“So that’s the case.”Diana thought as she slowly raised her height and said to dudian: “Let’s go.”
Dudian wryly smiled. It was good to read memories. It was reliable and fast.
Whoosh!
Daina’s figure was like the wind as she rushed forward.
Dudian followed her and soon arrived in front of the three people who had stopped in the distance. However, Daina didn’t slow down. She completely ignored the three people and flew straight away.
The three people had sent Audrey to investigate the situation. They saw that Daina and Dudian were about to run away when they saw that the other party didn’t seem to care about them. They turned their heads to look, they saw that the shadows of Dudian and Dinah had turned into black dots and were about to disappear from their sight.
After a moment, Odin returned to the front of the three.
“What was that?”The three asked.
Odin smiled bitterly: “You may not believe it but it was the rebellious upper position of the outer wall. I didn’t expect that I would bow down to the Pariahs.”
“It’s him?”The three of them were surprised. They had heard of Dudian’s legendary story. He had climbed from a pariahs to the highest position in the inner wall. He was superior to many noble families and merchants, even the ancient families of Witchers had to look up to him.
“I heard that he left the giant wall and went to the Kingdom of God. How come he came back so soon?”
“Doesn’t it take several years to go to the divine kingdom and back?”
“He is so fast. He should be more than a ruler, right?”
They looked at each other and saw the shock in each other’s eyes. It was either a ruler or an abyss!
“Just now… the person he was hugging seems to be our former Saintess, Her Highness Aisha, right?”Suddenly, one of them asked in puzzlement.
“It’s her. I saw her with my eagle eyes. But she seems to be infected as the rumors say. Her eyes are completely black.”Another graceful woman sighed.
“I don’t know what kind of storm will rise in the giant wall when he comes back at this time. I guess there will be another massacre…”olly muttered to himself.
..
..
“What do you see? What’s the situation inside the wall?”Dudian asked Diana.
Diana replied: “The Amelia tribe that you met has moved into the wall. Moreover, they have taken control of the wall.”
Dudian wasn’t too surprised. The Amelia tribe had run out of ammunition and food. They had to find a new shelter or they would slowly decline. Although the map that he gave wasn’t trusted but as long as there was a trace of possibility.., if it was him then he would try.
It was difficult to resist the power of the Amelia tribe. After all after the invasion of the intruders and his rule the high-end forces in the wall had suffered great losses. They no longer had the strength of a dragon mother.
“You are lucky.”Diana glanced at dudian who was gradually catching up to them, “Not long after you left the Amelia tribe, the Lord of the wall, Aristotle, came back. Your so-called friends are wanted. I don’t know if they are alive or dead. But fortunately the Amelia tribe has moved over and avenged you.”
Dudian was startled: “Was he killed?”
“It is unknown whether he is alive or dead. There is no news of him being killed. He should be captured and imprisoned.”Dina smiled: “You don’t seem to be worried about your friends.”
Dudian calmly said: “There is nothing to worry about. I have made preparations before I left. I have told them that life and death are up to fate. Whether they can survive depends on their own luck and wisdom.”
“You are open-minded.”Dina slightly curled her lips.
“The more I read, the more I will be open-minded.”Dudian shrugged his shoulders.
“Not necessarily. The more I read, the more I will care. It is like reading too many dirty things. People will have mysophobia. After listening to too many ghost stories, they will be afraid and become timid.”Dina indifferently said.
Dudian didn’t refute. His mind suddenly turned. Ghost Story?
Whoosh!
The two of them left the red wasteland region and came to the outer edge.
They saw monsters running on the ground or gnawing on their prey. They also saw a team of pioneers surrounding the monsters.
Dudian found that the number of pioneers here was obviously higher than when he left.
Was this the effect of Amelia’s tribe management?
“What are you going to do after you find the Super Chip?”Dudian asked.
Dina indifferently replied: “It’s just a small giant wall. If It’s a Kingdom of God then I can reluctantly accept it.”
Dudian was speechless.
“But I would like to see the spaceship of the Amelia tribe. Let’s use it as our laboratory.”Dina said with interest.
Dudian shrugged his shoulders.
Both of them spoke as they flew. The situation inside the giant wall had been fixed.
Soon, the giant wall of Sylvia slowly appeared in front of their eyes. The majestic giant wall was still shocking.
Both of them flew above the giant wall. They could see that there were soldiers patrolling the giant wall.
Whoosh!
A signal flare suddenly shot into the sky. Obviously the soldiers on the giant wall saw Dudian and Dinah.
When the two of them were less than 300 meters away from each other the loud voice came from the giant wall: “Stop!”
Dinah didn’t slow down but accelerated instead.
The soldiers on the giant wall changed from a vigilant state to a defensive formation. More than a dozen soldiers pulled out a silver long-barrelled gun and aimed at Dinah.
Whoosh!
The bullet was faster than a rifle bullet, reaching five times the speed of sound.
Dina slightly tilted her head, and the bullet brushed past her neck. It was just a hair’s breadth away.
This was not a thrilling experience for her, but there was no need for her to deliberately avoid it too much.
Her figure was like a phantom butterfly, floating around. It was as if eight or nine Dinas had appeared in the air, rapidly approaching the giant wall. The bullets flashed past like a stream of light, and none of them hit.
When Daina was close to the giant wall, the soldiers quickly abandoned their guns and pulled out their sabers.
Puff!
Daina’s body was burning with flames. The Flames suddenly spread like a ring of fire at an extremely fast speed.
The surrounding soldiers who had just entered the Devil’s body were hit by the Ring of Fire. Their bodies were cut off and the flesh and blood on the wounds were burned by the flames.
Dudian flew over and looked at the Dead Warriors. From the marks on the armor, he knew that they were from the wing family of the Witcher family.
“This gun…”Dudian picked up a gun. He found that the structure of the gun was much better than the simple firearms he had made in the wall. It was better than the rifles of the old era.
Diana continued to fly forward. She didn’t care about the dozens of people she had killed.
After flying for a while, Dudian saw the outer wall. It was the same as when he left. The wall of sighs was still firmly blocking the inner wall and the outer wall. It separated status and wealth.
Diana’s figure flew past the outer wall and the wall of Sighs.
The warrior stationed on the wall of sighs immediately sent out a signal when he saw the two people passing by from high above. However, the two ignored him. Soon, he sent out another signal with a longer curve.
After entering the inner wall, Dinah flew to a quiet place in the suburbs. There was a waterfall. There were no villages and towns in the vicinity. There were only plains with few weeds. It was not suitable for monsters to hide and there were no small prey.
Dinah flew into the waterfall. After a while, she returned with a small copper box in her hand.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He was silent.
Dina opened the box and took out a small box. It was about the size of a diamond ring box. There was a password on it.
She opened the box and found a chip inside.
“It’s a good place to hide it.”Dina praised.
Dudian’s mouth twitched but he didn’t say anything.
“Let’s go to the palace.”Dina smiled. She was in a good mood. Although she knew the location of the super chip from Dudian’s memory but it had been a long time. Who knew if there would be an accident.., it was lost.
Dudian quietly followed.
After a while, the two flew over the count’s cities and arrived at the imperial city.
At the moment the imperial city was fully armed. There were many people in the daytime but the city gate was closed. Even the drawbridge was lifted. The Shadows of the moat were shaking.
“It seems that they are ready to welcome us.”Dina smiled. Her body was burning with flames as she flew towards the city gate.
Whoosh!
A shell shot out from the city.
There was no shouting as they began to fight.
Daina’s eyes lit up as she looked at the black shell flying towards her. She stretched out her white hand and gently caught the shell. Her body rotated at the same time, the shell turned in an arc and was thrown out.
The cannonball hit the city tower and exploded.
Dudian sighed in his heart as he saw her soft hand.
He didn’t attack as he slowly thought about other things. He didn’t have much time. He had to think about it before the next memory was read..
Diana didn’t plan to let Dudian attack. For her, these attacks were as light as scratching an itch. Her body didn’t stop as she flew forward. Along the way, there were shells and pioneers who had the ability to fly.
The pioneers flew up and shouted “Who are you?”. However, the Flames shot out by Dinah penetrated their bodies and quickly fell down.

chapters.title: Chapter 991
chapters.content:
Chapter 991 – Chapter 981: Divine Light Wave
In the palace, dozens of figures dressed in strange clothes stood at the bottom of the steps, each of them exuding a powerful aura. They raised their heads to look at the figure in front of the throne. It was a petite young girl with golden hair that looked like a waterfall, she also had a pair of extremely beautiful and moving golden eyes that were like a lake. They were pure without any impurities, yet they carried a noble aura that could not be looked at directly.
The young girl stood in front of the throne, and on the throne sat an old woman with a stooped figure and a kind expression. She held a golden scepter in her hand and wore a crown. She looked graceful and beautiful.
“The Wall Guardian has just sent a message. An intruder has entered and has arrived outside the imperial city. Everyone, who is willing to lead the army to battle?”The young girl looked around the entire place. Her gaze was calm, and there was not a hint of fear in her small body.
“Reporting to Goddess, this subordinate is willing to go!”Someone immediately said.
As soon as he finished speaking, another tall and strong man said, “Reporting to Goddess, Daze, the city guardian of the Western Region, has been sacrificed. The enemy is definitely not an ordinary pioneer. He should be the ruler. Let Me Go!”
“I will go too. The two of us are more confident!”Another woman in tight black clothes said. There were two daggers at her waist. It was obvious that she was good at speed and assassination.
“I’ll go too!”
“This subordinate is also willing to serve!”
The others spoke one after another.
Seeing that everyone was so enthusiastic, the young girl nodded slightly, “Everyone, there’s no need to fight over it. Pudi is right. The enemy is very likely to be the ruler. The rest of you, follow me and watch. Pudi, senxi, you two lead the troops forward. Try not to accidentally injure the civilians.”
“Yes!”The strong man and the black tight-clothed woman received the order at the same time.
The two of them quickly left.
At this moment, a servant wearing golden armor quickly ran over. His entire body was engraved with strange patterns. It was a desolate guard. He said to the girl, “Reporting to her highness, the ‘Heavenly Eye’has been activated and locked onto the enemy.”
“Is that so? Switch the scene over,”the girl instructed.
A screen of light was projected from the sky above the palace hall. It floated in mid-air. There was no physical screen, but there were clear images in the light. At this moment, three figures were flying in mid-air. There were cannonballs continuously shooting over, they were gently held back by a petite girl at the very front, who looked to be only seventeen or eighteen years old. She did not destroy the balance of the cannonballs, but instead, she threw them toward the buildings in the distance.
Boom!
The ground exploded, stirring up dust and mist. Splinters and wooden planks appeared at the edge of the image. Although there was no sound, it was not difficult to see how tragic the scene was.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
More than ten figures flew over from the ground and transformed into demonic bodies. They turned into half-human and half-demonic monsters and roared as they pounced on the young girl. Flames suddenly burst out of the young girl’s body. Flames shot out like sparks as long as fingers. They flew out as fast as light arrows.
The bodies of these warriors who were charging at them were instantly pierced through. They had no resistance at all.
“How is this possible!”
“This…”
“They killed them without doing anything? !”
“These are all members of the Blue Wilderness team, how could they be so weak! ?”
Upon seeing the images on the screen, the people in the hall gasped, their faces filled with shock. The few people who had previously requested to fight were now filled with fear. If the goddess had just allowed them to fight.., they would die!
“It’s him!”The old woman and the girl in front of her looked at the image. Their eyes were attracted by the person behind the girl. They didn’t expect that he was still alive after such a long time!
They came to the giant wall but didn’t meet Dudian. They knew that he had been in the wilderness. The wilderness was extremely dangerous. Even the ruler wouldn’t be able to stay for long. But after such a long time Dudian was not only alive.., but he had returned!
In addition to them, there were two inconspicuous figures in the back of the hall. They were shocked and surprised!
“It’s Dean!”
“He is back!”
Both of their eyes were filled with excitement as they clenched their fists.
At this time, the image of the flame girl was moving forward. Along the way, there were arrows, bullets, shells and other long-range attacks. All of them were dodged or caught without causing any damage. In less than a few minutes, a figure suddenly flew over from the video. Like a cannonball, it charged forward at high speed. The two wings on its back were like huge palms, covered in blood threads and protruding meridians, it was the Brawny Man, Pudi, who had left the hall earlier.
“They’re going!”
“Good luck, Pudi!”
Seeing Pudi arrive, everyone in the hall heaved a sigh of relief, but they were still a little nervous. From the Flaming Girl’s previous methods, she was definitely a ruler. She was even considered an extremely powerful existence among rulers. Just by relying on Pudi and senxi.., they might not be her match, but they could at least slow her down..
Just as everyone was thinking this, Pudi had already rushed in front of the flaming girl. Whoosh! Pudi’s strange wings suddenly tightened, and like two gigantic fists, he ruthlessly smashed towards the flaming girl.
Bang!
Pudi’s body froze, and his body, which had used up all the strength in his body, suddenly stopped. Then, everyone saw the Flames on the flaming girl’s arm fade away, and her slender, white, and tender little hand was raised, pressing down on Pudi’s gigantic, strange wings.
In the next moment, flames emerged from her fingertips, which were as white as scallions, and spread rapidly.
Whoosh! In just an instant, the flames crawled all over Pudi’s body!
From the scene, everyone could see Pudi’s miserable cry. His face was filled with pain, and his body fell rapidly.
At the same time that he fell, a black light suddenly shot out from the building below. It was as fast as lightning, and instantly shot to the flaming girl’s back, revealing her figure. It was senxi, who had gone with her.
At this moment, Senxi had a dark tail on her back. Fine black fur grew all over her body, and there was a small horn on her head. Her body was still graceful and curvaceous, and one could see her flat abdomen and bulging chest, her fingernail-like claws held two black daggers tightly. When she was close to the flaming girl’s back, her body suddenly spun, and the daggers danced in a whirlwind.
Spiral Stab!
This was SENXI’s signature combat technique.
Bang!
A ball of flames suddenly shot out from the flaming girl’s back, instantly enveloping the black spiral storm of blades, sending her flying. She fell in an arc from afar, her body burning like a meteorite.
“Hiss…”
The sound of people sucking in cold air rang out in the hall. Everyone’s eyes widened, and their faces were filled with disbelief.
In just one exchange, the two rulers were both defeated? !
“They… are from the abyss? !”After a brief silence, a voice filled with shock said.
The others immediately came back to their senses. Without a doubt, such power was definitely from the Abyss!
“Goddess, I request to activate the Divine Light Wave!”
“Goddess, only the divine light wave can kill them!”
Someone immediately called out to the goddess on the steps, his eyes filled with urgency.
In reality, they did not need to request. The girl had already realized the seriousness of the problem when Pudi was defeated. She had already passed the order to the golden-armored desolate guards who were waiting at the side, her order had already been brought to the wilderness divine hall behind by the golden-armored desolate guards.
Buzz!
The entire hall buzzed slightly. Everyone felt a tremor under their feet, as if there was a slight earthquake.
Feeling this familiar tremor, everyone heaved a sigh of relief. They secretly admired the goddess’quick reaction.
Whoosh!
The goddess leaped up from the steps and flew out of the hall.
Everyone followed closely behind and filed out. In front of the palace, there were thousands of steps that were majestic and grand. On both sides of the steps, there were two Aragami statues that were more than a hundred meters tall, the appearance of this Aragami was not that of Sylvia. Instead, it was the Aragami that they were worshipping. It was also the one in the Earth Dragon Cave.
At this moment, the ground beside the two Aragami statues was lifted up. The floor was actually made of metal. A steel support that was half a meter thick was used to prop it up. From within, two turrets slowly rose up. They looked like ancient war chariots. Below them was a base that was more than ten meters long, it was four to five meters tall. On top of it, there was a bright silver cannon tube that was more than twenty meters long. Under the sunlight, it reflected a dazzling rainbow halo.
“Charge!”The goddess’eyes were filled with dignity as she said in a deep voice.
Beside the base under the cannon tube stood two warriors wearing silver armor with strange patterns engraved on their bodies. When they heard the goddess’order, they immediately grabbed their chests and whistled.
Soon, there was a transparent glass area behind the cannon. There was obvious light gathering and gradually filling the transparent area.
“Lock on the target. Countdown to ten. Prepare to fire!”The goddess said in a low voice. Dudian’s face flashed through her mind. She silently said in her heart: “I’m sorry. You shouldn’t be so overbearing. It’s not that I’m ungrateful!”
… ..
..
Whoosh!
All the attacks and enemies along the way were casually killed. She looked at the palace which was getting closer and closer. Her expression was calm.
Dudian followed closely. He looked at the army which was rushing towards him. He sighed. Suddenly he felt something and looked up. At the same time, Diana seemed to feel something. She strangled the neck of a soldier who was rushing towards her. She looked up at the bustling place in front of her.
“Eh?”Daina frowned slightly. Suddenly, she felt an inexplicable sense of unease, as well as a sense of trepidation. It was as if something terrifying was about to appear.
Her premonitions had always been very accurate. However, she was somewhat puzzled as to what could possibly threaten her in the Amelia tribe. She suddenly felt a bit of regret. The two rulers she had killed previously had a very high status here. If she hadn’t read their memories, she would definitely have known more.
She put away the idea of attacking. She thought about taking a roundabout route and capturing a few overlords to investigate before attacking. She didn’t want to fail because of carelessness.
As she was thinking, a strong chill suddenly surged through her, causing all the hair on her body to stand on end. A terrifying sense of danger instantly covered her entire body, and her scalp felt numb.
What was that? !
She was shocked, but at the same time, she felt some fear.
Whoosh!
In her line of sight, a dazzling light suddenly appeared, like a white dot!
“No!”Her pupils constricted, and her body wanted to rotate to dodge, but this white light instantly arrived. When she saw it, it had already arrived. A sharp pain suddenly came from her chest, hot and cold.., it seemed that she could feel the cold wind passing through her chest.
The white light still remained in her retina but the attack had ended.
She looked down in a daze.
She could see the building behind her chest. Her chest was completely penetrated!
It was not… possible!
Her body fell rapidly.
Dudian’s left arm was missing and his left wing was pierced. He had sensed the danger ahead of time and guessed something, he had reacted in time. Otherwise, his head would be missing instead of his left arm!
“Laser cannon… No, it’s not a normal laser cannon. Such a range…”Dudian’s mind was occupied by pain and shock. He looked at Diana who was pierced through the chest. His mind suddenly became hot, he was so excited that he didn’t even care about the pain.
“One of them died!”
“Haha, Who Cares about the abyss? It’s useless in front of the divine light waves!”
“The one called Aristotle was scared to tears by our Divine Light Waves!”
“He dares to invade the Abyss? He is courting death!”
The crowd cheered as they looked at the projection outside the steps of the palace.
The goddess was relieved. She looked at Dudian who was falling with her. She took a deep breath and ordered: “Ready the second shot. Ten Seconds Countdown!”
The silver armored warrior under the base of the cannon immediately whistled.
Soon, the second shot was fully charged. At this time, the projection showed the location where dudian and Diana fell. Dudian quickly climbed with one arm after landing. His whole body was demonized and soon a hole was dug in the ground, he used a few sharp limbs to gently wrap Aisha and drilled into the hole.
On the other side, Dinah fell. Because of the strong force of the fall, a deep hole was created in the ground. A lot of dust was raised and the corpse couldn’t be seen clearly.
“Quick reaction!”
“It’s a pity that our holy light wave has a life tracking device!”
“Haha, it was arrogant before, but now it’s running away like a dog!”
“This time I have avenged Pootie and Senxi!”
“It’s a pity that I didn’t know that these two bastards were from the Abyss.”
The second wave of Holy Light cut through the sky.
Dudian’s scalp went numb and his hair stood on end. He quickly hit the ground. Bang! When his upper body came out of the ground, his leg was pierced by the light beam, there was nothing below the knee.
Dudian growled in pain and fell to the ground. Cold sweat oozed out of his forehead. The excitement in his heart was gone and he was full of fear. He didn’t expect that there would be a second such terrifying attack. would there be a third attack? ! A fourth attack? !
Was he going to be killed just because he was relieved? !
Dudian’s heart was filled with grief and anger. He looked at Aisha who was being swept by the sharp blade. Previously, because of the excessive movement, the sharp blade tightened and cut her body. There were a few scratches, it was not used to protect the limbs.
Looking at her injured because of him, Dean’s heart was sad. He clenched his teeth and suddenly hugged her. He kissed her deeply on her forehead.
“Live on… even in such a posture…”Dean looked at her. The grief in his eyes was gone at this moment. There was only gentleness and a touch of sadness. The next moment, he pushed her out. At the same time, he pulled out the golden bell from his waist and shook it for five seconds.
When the bell stopped, he crushed the bell.

chapters.title: Chapter 992
chapters.content:
Chapter 992 – Volume Eight, The New King, Chapter 982: Leave
Bang!
The moment the bell was crushed, Aisha suddenly stomped her feet and shot out like an arrow. She didn’t pounce on Dudian but flew in the opposite direction.
“Go… no matter what, live on…”Dudian watched her figure slowly shrink and disappear in his sight. The gentleness in his eyes was gradually replaced by pain. He didn’t expect that in the end.., he could only stop at this point in his life.
There was no miracle, no luck. who had ever been blessed by God? !
Whoosh!
Aisha’s figure gradually became so small that it was difficult to see clearly. He could only faintly see the pioneers flying away. The power of the Abyss was clearly displayed at this moment. Even if they didn’t enter the demon body, no one could stop them!
“It’s finally over…”
“We are free…”
Dudian lay on the ground and looked at the blue sky above his head. The tiredness in the depths of his heart surged like a tide. The slightly raised hair reminded him that danger was coming, but he didn’t have the strength to hide anymore, he didn’t even want to hide anymore.
Whoosh!
A white light suddenly shot over. With a bang, the blazing light pillar lit up the street and enveloped it.
The dust quickly dissipated in the light, turning into powder and vanishing into the tiniest matter.
“Bastard! !”
Above the palace, the faces of the originally excited people were now filled with anger, and they did not have the slightest bit of excitement of annihilating the enemy. They only saw the turrets on both sides of the palace steps slightly tilt at this moment, and the silver-armored warriors under the turrets.., had already fallen into a pool of blood. Standing beside their corpses were two tall and sturdy young figures. One was a golden-haired handsome youth with the label of a noble.
The other looked slightly younger, as if he was only about 23 or 24 years old. He had short brown hair, and his figure was as tall and sturdy as a bear. He looked very ordinary, but he had thick eyebrows and big eyes. He also had an imposing aura.
“Traitors!”
“You actually dare to betray the Goddess!”
“Kill them!”
“Such lowly people of the original wall shouldn’t have stayed in the first place. Kill!”
The people surrounding the goddess were so angry that their faces were distorted. They were so angry that their bodies were trembling. They were already prepared to welcome the victory and cheer. However, at the critical moment, the two little characters who had always been unremarkable among them actually rushed out and pushed the cannon, trying to stop their attack!
Once they succeeded in stopping it, it was equivalent to giving that Abyss a chance to survive!
That was equivalent to their end!
Fear, anger!
Everyone roared and did not wait for the Goddess’s orders. They activated their demonic bodies and rushed towards the two people beside the turret, wanting to tear them apart.
The two people standing beside the turret looked at each other and activated their demonic bodies at the same time. They did not face the many people who were charging forward with strange and ferocious postures. Instead, they turned their backs towards them and used all their strength to bombard the turret!
Bang! Bang!
The turret was hit with a loud bang. The ground of the entire palace trembled slightly!
“Die!”
“Die! !”
“Kill! !”
A series of sharp, hoarse, or half-male, half-female voices roared in anger. The demonization did not only change their bodies, but also their vocal cords.
The two men also roared in anger and launched a second wave of attacks.
Boom!
The turret shook slightly, but it was not overturned.
The ferocious roar behind them was still approaching. A hint of despair and unwillingness flashed in their eyes. Could this be the best they could do?
Whoosh!
The air suddenly became scorching hot, as if the Sun hanging in the sky was approaching in an instant.
The high temperature made everyone feel as if they were about to melt. The two could feel the terrifying heat coming from behind them, and could not help but turn their heads in shock. Then, they saw a red figure that filled every part of their pupils.
Bang!
The floor was broken and the high temperature instantly swept out like a volcano erupting.
The ferocious and strange demonized people who pounced towards the two of them did not have time to stop in their shock. In the next moment, a magma-like blazing current swept out like a ring of fire, starting from this blazing figure, it shot towards their side in one direction.
Whoosh!
As the Flames swept out, everyone was instantly ignited, and their bodies were cut in half.
Miserable cries and terrified cries spread throughout the entire palace.
On this day, the guards and maidservants in the palace saw a scene that they would never forget in their lives.
A figure that was as beautiful and domineering as the blazing sun slowly rose from the front of the palace, like a fire Phoenix or a fire dragon. Her posture was perfect, snatching away all the light in the world, causing everything around her to pale in comparison.
“Impossible!”The goddess who did not make a move on the steps saw the blazing figure suddenly jump out from the ground. Her delicate face that was originally frowning because of the betrayal of the two people was instantly filled with shock. In the next moment.., she reacted in less than half a second. Without turning her head back, she turned around and ran into the palace hall.
The door of the Palace Hall slowly closed after she entered.
The last scene that was revealed from the gap of the closed door was that the demonized bodies of the people in the palace turned into fiery flowers that bloomed in the air and withered..
The two people by the base of the battery were completely stunned. They couldn’t believe their eyes when they saw this unbelievable scene that suddenly reversed.
“It seems that he didn’t make the wrong friends.”The figure bathed in flames turned around slightly. The Flames on his face swirled and receded a little, revealing a pair of bright but beautiful eyes that were like autumn water.., it was also like the ice in the extreme north. Her tone was calm, carrying the dignity of a superior.
After she finished speaking, she turned her head and dove down like a flaming meteor.
Boom!
The sealed door of the palace was suddenly dented, and a hole was created.
This towering palace door was actually forged from heavy metal. However, at this moment, it was dented into an extremely deep arc. The edge of the crack was charred black, and even the metal seemed to be showing signs of melting.
“She’s not dead?”The two slowly reacted. They were still quite shocked. There was such a large hole in their chest, and their hearts had already turned into ashes. How could she still be alive? She was simply a monster!
However, the two’s attention quickly returned to another place. They quickly looked at the blurry projection in the air. They saw that the divine light had already disappeared, and the target of the attack, the dust, had already dispersed, there was a bottomless hole in the ground. At the edge of the hole, a figure lay a few centimeters away. His eyes were closed and he did not move at all.
“We missed!”When the two saw this scene, they were pleasantly surprised. They were so excited that they wanted to hug each other. However, the golden-haired young man quickly said, “Let’s go quickly. The energy shockwave seems to have hit him. He’s unconscious. We can’t let anyone get close.”
“Yes!”
“Master, we are coming!”
Both of them were so excited that their bodies trembled. They jumped down from the palace and quickly rushed out.
Although the area of the imperial city was large and could accommodate tens of millions of people, but with the speed of both of them, it took them less than half an hour to reach Dudian’s side. They saw that the scene was full of people, many residents who lived nearby also came over to watch the excitement. When they saw that the destroyed building was only a few streets away from their home, they couldn’t help but secretly rejoice.
The two pushed away the outer crowd and forcefully squeezed in. They saw that a group of pioneers had formed a square formation and surrounded Dudian. The soldiers of the boundary level rushed over to clean up the scene and disperse the crowd.
The two looked at each other. They clenched their teeth and rushed out of the crowd.
“Who is it? !”The leader of the pioneer team saw the figure who suddenly jumped out, he was shocked. The invasion this time was unforgettable. He thought that the enemy had another partner. When he saw the face and dress of the newcomer, the hostility on his face quickly disappeared and he put on a smile.
“So it’s the two lords. What are you doing?”
“The goddess wants him. Leave Him to us!”The golden-haired youth said coldly.
The leader of the pioneers did not suspect him. He smiled and said, “We are going to send him to the goddess. We are just afraid of waking him up and don’t dare to touch him.”
“He has been dealt with. Tell the crowd to disperse. You should also disperse and return to your positions.”The golden-haired youth ordered.
“Yes, sir.”The leader of the pioneer team nodded respectfully. After all, he had given the thing to the other party. Even if something went wrong, it was none of his business. He did not dare to stay with a terrifying existence who dared to invade the imperial city at all times, although the latter seemed to be unconscious at the moment, who knew when he would wake up? Perhaps in the next second!
The pioneer team separated. The two of them stepped forward and looked at the familiar face on the ground. They felt a wave of heat in their eyes and slightly clenched their fists.
The golden-haired young man bent down to carry him and turned around to leave.
The brown-haired young man followed behind. The two of them pushed aside the crowd and left quickly.
Half an hour later, the two of them took a detour out of the Imperial City and came to the wilderness.
“Go to the dark fortress,”the golden-haired young man said. He aimed at a direction and rushed in a straight line at full speed.
Not long after, the two of them came to a count city. With the badge on their armor, they charged forward. The soldiers guarding the city gate didn’t dare to block the way. After the two left they looked at their backs with envy..
It didn’t take long for the two to arrive at a manor in the city. The owner of the manor was a noble and immediately went up to greet them.
“Eh, this is?”The owner of the manor saw the blonde youth carrying Dudian. He was surprised and puzzled as he felt that he had seen him somewhere before.
The two ignored him and quickly entered the castle. It seemed that they were the masters here. In fact, the word “Seems”could be removed.
The two walked into a secret passage in the manor. The Master of the manor bowed slightly. He put his hand on his chest and respectfully sent them off.
