There was a square at the end of the secret passage. There were many buildings inside. The dome was decorated with bright chandeliers. They were illuminated by electricity as if it was daytime.
The two of them found a large hall and ordered everyone who was working inside to leave. The consul on duty saw the two of them and quickly ran over with a smile.
“The best room, the best doctor. No one is allowed to disturb you! !”The golden-haired young man stared at him and said quickly.
“Yes, sir.”
..
..
Bang!
A beam of light shot past.
Daina, who was bathed in flames, tilted her head slightly. The beam of light swept past her neck and pierced through the flames. At the same time, it pierced through the dome of the Great Hall behind her.
“How is this possible!”The goddess’face was filled with shock. She glanced at the silver-white gun in her hand. This was not an ordinary bullet gun, but a laser gun. In such an attack range, there was absolutely no way to dodge it!
However, the person in front of her dodged it easily!
“Laser Gun… the technology is indeed much more advanced. Unfortunately, it is a little deformed. In other aspects, it is too close to the primitive society…”Dina straightened her tilted head and stood in the air, looking down at the goddess, and the old woman behind her, the great priest!
“How can you still be alive!”The goddess gritted her teeth. She felt that the god was joking with her. Her heart had been pierced, but she was still alive. wasn’t this deliberately trying to take her life? !
“Your name is Amelia, right? This little girl is quite ruthless. She even made a vicious move on her former benefactor. Fortunately, those two little fellows were loyal enough to stop her in time. Otherwise, my experimental subject would have been destroyed by you.”Dina’s expression was indifferent, her tone was old and domineering. “Tell me, how do you want to Die? !”
The goddess was Amelia. She stared at Daina, “You Can’t blame me for this. He led you on a rampage and wanted to occupy the giant wall. If he came back quietly, I could give him half of the authority to repay his kindness, but he obviously wants to take it all away! “This is the foundation of our tribe. We will never give it away!”
“Hehe…”Daina chuckled. “A frog in a well. You are satisfied just by living in a corner. What a pitiful human!”As she said that, her body slowly floated towards Amelia.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Amelia quickly pulled the trigger and a few laser beams shot out.
Daina’s body swayed slightly. The laser beam flew past the edge of her body by a hair’s breadth. The heat that it brought was like a dagger cutting her body. However, she was bathed in flames and did not care about the burning sensation at all.
“How is this possible!”Amelia’s pupils dilated and her face was filled with shock. She kept pulling the trigger, but the laser still missed. Not a single shot hit.
Whoosh!
Daina suddenly flashed and her body appeared beside Amelia as if she had teleported. The Flames on her body were retracted, revealing her normal body. She raised her hand and grabbed Amelia’s hand that was holding the gun, she chuckled and said, “A gun is a good thing. It’s a pity that the person who uses a gun is too weak. It’s really embarrassing that it’s so easy to predict the trajectory of the bullet.”
Amelia’s expression instantly became extremely ugly. She struggled with her hand, but she was unable to shake it off. The other party’s slender and tender little hand seemed to be an iron hoop that firmly held onto her wrist!
“Give it to me!”Daina said with a smile. Her wrist shook slightly, and Amelia’s hand involuntarily loosened. It was so painful that she let out a soft groan.
The laser gun fell into Dina’s hand. She admired it for a moment, and the corners of her mouth curled up. Her fingers suddenly grew longer and pierced into Amelia’s forehead.
“Stop!”An angry roar came from the side. The hunchbacked great priest suddenly stood up. The wrinkled skin all over his body suddenly contracted and recovered its vitality at a speed visible to the naked eye, turning from yellow to white and tender, the skin also slowly expanded. There were no wrinkles, and it was so tender that water could almost be squeezed out.
“It’s not your turn yet.”Dina’s gaze was indifferent. Without even looking, she raised her hand and fired a spear.
Bang!
The palm that the great god priest had just raised, which had become young, was instantly pierced by the laser.

chapters.title: Chapter 993
chapters.content:
Chapter 993 – Volume Eight, New King, Chapter 983: New Experimental Subject
“Don’t move!”
The black muzzle of the gun was aimed at the high priest’s forehead. Dana tilted her head slightly, her expression slightly cold.
The high priest, who had just recovered his youth and battle prowess, was instantly silenced. The sharp pain in her palm came through. She gritted her teeth and suppressed her anger. “What exactly do you want? !”
“Everything here.”Dina’s answer was simple and direct. Amelia, who had been lifted up by her, had already stopped struggling. It was as if she had gone into shock. However, her body would tremble from time to time, as if the pain had stirred up her nerves.
The great divine priest glared at her angrily. He controlled the muscles in his palm and sealed the blood vessels to stop the bleeding. However, his body did not dare to move at all. If it was just a competition of strength, she believed that she could still take one or two moves. However, Dina held a laser gun in her hand. Moreover, she had already taken the initiative to strike first. She had already drawn the gun out and locked onto her. At this moment, even if she had a laser gun in her hand.., she did not have the time to draw it out for her.
In Amelia’s hand, this laser gun was useless. However, in Dina’s hand, it was completely different. The speed and trajectory of the gun were not something Amelia could compare to.
After a few minutes of stalemate, Dina swung her hand and threw Amelia, who was still unconscious, towards the high priest.
The high priest hurriedly took it, only to see that the cut on Amelia’s forehead had already disappeared. It was as if a leech had sucked her blood. The wound automatically healed, and not even a single drop of blood flowed out.
“HMM…”Amelia snorted softly and slowly opened her eyes. She was somewhat at a loss, but when she saw the high priest’s face, she was instantly shocked. In the next moment, she suddenly raised her hand, and her fingers were aligned like knives. With a PU sound, under the high priest’s shocked gaze, she stabbed into her plump chest.
“Go to hell!”Amelia’s attack succeeded, and she quickly retreated. She returned to Dina’s front and stared coldly at the high priest.
“Amelia… Li!”The great god priest stared blankly. He had never thought that she would use such an expression to face him. His eyes revealed a genuine killing intent. She was definitely not faking it. She wanted to kill him?
She was somewhat at a loss. She was confused, but more than that, she was sad.
Dina, who was behind Amelia, had already recovered from her thoughts. She looked at the Great God priest with interest, “I didn’t expect your race to be born like this. You call yourself a descendant of the “Aragami”. Heh, don’t you think it’s a little ridiculous and pitiful to call yourself that every time?”
The high priest’s gaze slowly shifted from Amelia to Daina. Suddenly, she woke up. Amelia had suddenly changed into a different person. It should be related to this woman. She took a deep breath and covered her injured chest, “What did you do to her?”
“I simply modified her memory.”Diana wasn’t angry that she didn’t obediently answer, she smiled: “Your family is very interesting. I wouldn’t have left any of your previous sins behind. But now you are qualified to be my experiments. With you as the foundation, my success rate has increased by 20% . Fate seems to be guiding me. Everything I need has been sent to me. Haha…”
“Experiment?”The priest’s face slightly changed. He suddenly remembered that she had described Dudian as an “Experiment”. “Are you the ruler of the Kingdom of God?”
“No, but I’m about to be.”Diana smiled. The Flames on her body gradually converged into her body, revealing her delicate and slender body. At this time, the priest saw that her chest which had been penetrated by the holy light was now covered with dark purple twisted limbs. They were like snakes intertwined together and twisted slightly, the scene made people vomit.
“You, you are not a human!”The High Priest’s pupils contracted as he cried out in shock.
“I am a god, the god of the future!”Dina raised her head slightly and her body slowly flew in front of her. She looked down at the high priest and slowly stretched out her slender snow-white palm and pressed it on her forehead.
The high priest wanted to resist, but his entire body seemed to be enveloped by an aura. It was as if as long as he made a slight movement, he would face a lightning attack and be doomed beyond redemption.
Dina’s fingers rapidly turned into sharp spikes and pierced into the great divine priest’s forehead. The great divine priest’s body, which was still flickering in his eyes, suddenly stiffened. His eyes became confused as he slowly closed his eyes.
After a long while, Dina withdrew her palm and panted slightly. It was as if she had suddenly experienced a bitter battle.
After adjusting herself for a moment, she let out a light breath and looked at the great divine priest in front of her who still had his eyes tightly shut. There was a hint of disgust and a hint of excitement in her eyes, “Interesting body, interesting ideas. I hope you can give me a surprise!”
..
..
“Master!”
“Master!”
Someone called out in the dark.
Who Was It?
Dudian slowly opened his eyes. His vision turned from blurry to clear. He saw that the light was dim. Several faces were close to each other. Their faces were full of tension, concern and surprise. He felt that his brain was a bit muddled. His brain paused for a few seconds before slowly reacting. He recognized the familiar faces and couldn’t help but slightly open his eyes.
“It’s You?”Dudian felt like he was in a dream. But his physical discomfort quickly reminded him that he didn’t die.
“It’s us, young master. You finally woke up!”
“Young master, we finally waited for you to come back!”
The few of them looked at Dudian in excitement. It seemed that they had a lot to say.
“Neuss, Barton, Macon, Zach, Aurora…”Dudian looked at the faces. He felt that the blood in his body seemed to warm up. It was as if he had come to the desert from the North Pole, his eyes swept over the faces of the few of them. He slowly calmed down and asked: “Where am I? Didn’t I get hit by that thing? Did I miss?”
He knew the power of that thing. There was only one possibility for him to be alive.
“Young master, this is the dark fortress. It is our territory.”Gold Haired Neuss smirked, “Barton and I hit the barrel of the cannon when the third wave was shot. The direction was a bit off so we missed.”
Dudian was puzzled: “Holy Wave? Where did this thing come from? How did you get there?”
“This is the secret weapon of the palace. It was created by the intruders who claimed to be from the desolate race.”Neuss was the most eloquent, he continued: “Barton and I were present at the time. We were the representatives of the palace. We were ready to stop the first wave of the Holy Wave. But the others were watching intently. It was very difficult to catch you off guard. The result was that you were almost in danger. Your subordinate deserved to die!”
Barton knelt down.
Barton also knelt down.
Mason, Zach and Aurora looked embarrassed. They wanted to say something but held back.
Dudian saw that Mason and Zach didn’t seem to be as casual as before. The relationship between them seemed to be a bit strange after the farewell. He couldn’t help but feel regretful.
“Get up. I said that there is no need to kneel to anyone.”Dudian helped Neuss up.
Both of them didn’t resist. They knew that Dudian didn’t like to play games.
“You are members of the royal house. What is going on?”Dudian curiously asked.
Neuss was relieved as he heard that Dudian didn’t blame him. He slowly told Dudian the reason.
“I see…”Dudian gradually understood what had happened during this time. Neuss and the others changed the household registration information according to his instructions. They took the resources that he had given them and hid in the wall.
It didn’t take long for the previous master of the wall, Aristotle, to return.
Along with him was the messenger of the Kingdom of God. He rode a dragon and landed in the palace.
The messenger of the Kingdom of God didn’t return that day but stayed in the palace.
Aristotle was furious after he heard about the changes in the wall. He massacred the remnants of the troops that Neuss sent to stay in the palace. He liberated the suppressed nobles and looked for Dudian, Neuss and others, he found many accomplices.
For example Pope Richelieu who was forced by Dudian to work in the outer wall. He was addicted to drugs. He was no longer the Pope of the past. He had become a skinny old man with no temperament, he was caught in a tavern that was secretly selling marijuana. He was executed after parading in the streets of the Imperial City and the 12th Earl.
In addition to Pope Richelieu, many elders of the dark church including Hawkeye who had once followed Dudian were also caught and killed.
Although they had erased their identity information but their foundation was too deep. They weren’t like Neuss and Barton who had a shallow foundation. Hawkeye and Pope had been in high positions for many years. The number of people who had come into contact with them was hundreds or thousands of times more than Neuss and others. The more complicated the network was, the more they wanted to wipe it clean.
Aristotle was vigorously searching for the remaining traitors while rebuilding the order of the inner wall. The various large witcher family clans as well as the Fey Research Institute had all regained their former status. In just half a month, to the residents of the inner wall.., it was as if the entire world had been turned upside down. There were earth-shattering changes.
But at that moment, a ray of light descended on the sky above the giant wall.
The intruder who claimed to be a member of the desolate race came out from a huge and majestic spaceship.
The first to bear the brunt was the messenger of the Kingdom of God. He rode the Flying Dragon and was killed by the holy light waves outside the spaceship.
Aristotle was scared and ran away from the giant wall. However, he was caught.
Then a new round of change began.
When the desolate race completely took control of the giant wall, Neuss, Macon, Barton and others who were lucky to survive also came out from the dark. They pretended to work for the desolate race. They were prepared to get a position in order to grasp their internal information, they could cooperate with the outside world when Dudian came back.
However, in the end only the talkative Neuss and the honest-looking Barton managed to get into the position of a member of Parliament. However, they were only in a fake position and didn’t have real power. What Amelia wanted was that they were very familiar with the various circles within the giant wall, it would help them to completely control all the forces within the giant wall as soon as possible.
“Is this your secret gathering place?”Dudian looked at the place where he was lying. It was a dark and luxurious room. He smiled, “The monastery is used to manage the dark and light division of the outer wall. You have secretly learned it.”
Barton laughed: “Young Master, although the monastery is not strong but their method is very effective.”
Dudian nodded. A three-year-old child could speak the truth of the world. Even in the god Luo Empire, there was a similar management method. It wouldn’t be inferior just because the method came from the small giant wall of Sylvia, everything in the world was always changing.
“It seems that you have learned a lot.”Dudian could feel the changes in the few of them. Barton looked as honest as before but his mind had become more sensitive.
Neuss was better at hiding his true thoughts.
As for Mason and Zach, he had thought that their relationship had become unfamiliar. But through the observation of Neuss, he found that it was not so. They were more mature and knew how to control the interpersonal relationship.
However, what made Dudian happy was that no matter how big the changes were, their loyalty to him had changed slightly.
Neuss and Barton had risked their lives to break the cannon barrel for him. If it wasn’t for them, he would have died.
“How long have I been unconscious?”Dudian asked.
“Two days.”Neuss smiled.
Dudian’s heart tightened but soon relaxed. As long as he was still alive, the Amelia family would be easy to deal with. As long as he wasn’t as arrogant as Dinah, he would be able to directly confront them.
If he was playing dirty, even if he was just a ruler, he would be able to take back the dominion of the giant wall. Moreover, with his current strength, only the holy light wave could pose a threat to him.
Of course, it couldn’t be ruled out that the Amelia family had prepared other things.
“This holy light wave shouldn’t be an ordinary laser cannon. It has such a long range. There are only a few hundred miles from the palace to there…”Dudian’s eyes flashed. Such things were suitable for long-range attacks, but they were weak at close range.
He couldn’t help but smile. Although Diana had read his memory and knew about the existence of the laser cannon but she didn’t expect to see it, the Amelia Tribe was able to take out a super long-range laser weapon like the holy light wave. Diana wouldn’t be so arrogant if she knew about this.
Moreover, the divine light was hidden deep. Dinah had read the memories of the pioneers of the Dragon Clan but it seemed that they had never seen it before.
Under these factors, Dinah became cannon fodder and blocked the cannon for him.
Dudian couldn’t help but laugh. He asked Neuss: “What’s the situation in the palace? Did they send people to kill you?”
“No.”Neuss shook his head, “According to our report, your friend has captured the goddess and the priest. She has taken away the ruling power of the palace. However she hasn’t left the palace but has gone to the forbidden area behind the palace. I’m not sure about the situation inside…”
He suddenly found Dudian stunned on the bed.
“Master?”
Dudian slowly opened his eyes: “Who are you talking about?”
“The friend who came with you. The one who was hit by the Holy Light.”Neuss saw that Dudian’s expression wasn’t right.

chapters.title: Chapter 994
chapters.content:
Chapter 994 – Chapter 984: Crimson Moon [ First Update ]
“Dana?”Dudian felt as if a basin of cold water had been poured over his head: “She didn’t die?”
“Master, is she your enemy?”Neuss was aware of the problem and his face slightly changed. He and Barton were present at the time and knew how fierce this woman’s strength was, if she was an enemy… it would be a disaster!
Dudian stayed for a long time. In a short period of time he had experienced several great joys and sorrows. He felt like he was going to collapse. However, he had trained his strong mind and endurance in the past. He wanted to roar but his body was still numb as he sat on the bed. He felt so powerless at this moment.
The happy atmosphere in the room suddenly fell into the ice valley. Barton, Mason, Aurora and others looked at each other. They didn’t expect that they would have to face an even more terrifying enemy in the blink of an eye.
Moreover it wasn’t difficult to see from Dudian’s situation that the woman was more powerful than Dudian!
“Master, should we move immediately? With your strength, you can survive even if you go to other giant walls. We are willing to follow you to the death!”Neuss came back to his senses and immediately came up with a plan, dudian might have the answer in his heart.
Dudian was silent for a moment, he shook his head: “I have nowhere to go. If what you said is true, there are only three possibilities. The first is that she is seriously injured and needs to recuperate. The second is that there is something in the palace that attracted her and made her ignore me. The third is that she knows my location. If I plan to escape, she will appear immediately.”
“The first possibility is 30% . The second possibility is 10% . The third possibility is the biggest.”
Neuss and Barton were startled. Mason asked: “How did she know your location?”
Dudian looked up at him: “There should be a tracking device installed in my body. I have been in a coma for the past two days. I didn’t move so she didn’t come over.”
They looked at each other. They didn’t expect that dudian would be in such a miserable situation.
“We should give it a try but don’t hold too much hope.”Dudian put away his negative emotions, “You can’t be exposed. Continue to follow your original trajectory. If I am sacrificed then don’t seek revenge on her. The only one who can defeat her is God…”
“God?”
Neuss and Barton looked at each other. They didn’t expect that woman to be so terrifying. Wasn’t she invincible? !
“If you can live longer and become stronger in the future, you can help me if you have the opportunity…”Dudian looked up at them, “If I have a body left, help me to preserve it. If you find Aisha in the future, give her my body. It would be best if she eats it…”
They were shocked as they looked at him.
When their eyes met Dudian’s eyes, they found that the eyes of the youth who was in control of everything had been filled with frost. The childishness on his face had long faded, the young face was very mature.
How long had passed in the blink of an eye?
They were in a trance. They suddenly found that time had passed in a hurry and carved many marks on their bodies.
“Dean, don’t say that. No matter what the danger is, I will follow you. This is our original agreement!”Mason’s eyes were slightly red. He clenched his fists and spoke in a loud voice.
“Young master…”Barton opened his mouth slightly. He wanted to say something but he wasn’t good with words. Although he had trained his eloquence over the years, but when he stood in front of Dudian, he seemed to have returned to his original nature, he became as honest and straightforward as he used to be in the orphanage.
Dudian shook his head and smiled, “This is the worst case scenario. I can’t escape but you still have your life. Unfortunately, you haven’t enjoyed your life with me for a few days but you have to live like a mouse.”
“Young master, if it wasn’t for you, I would have died in prison!”Neuss clenched his teeth. There were tears in his eyes. He rarely cried because of women but this time he felt extremely sad and sad. Barton was a childhood friend of Dudian’s orphanage. Mason was a good friend of Dudian’s childhood. He had accompanied Dudian for a long time, he was the longest among them.
He had accompanied Dudian through the prison trials. He had fought carefully in the early stages of the prison break. Later on he became Dudian’s assistant. He was more familiar with Dudian than Mason, Barton and others.
Such an indomitable person in the prison but at the moment he was asking for their help. How helpless!
“I have helped you and you have helped me. We are already equal. Don’t mention the past. If it wasn’t for you and Barton, I would have died.”Dudian smiled and patted Noyce’s shoulder.
Noyce and Barton clenched their teeth but didn’t speak.
Dudian glanced at them and asked: “Where is Gwyneth?”
Aurora snorted: “She is dead!”
“Dead?”Dudian was startled as he felt regret in his heart.
Noyce explained: “Gwyneth was determined to return to the magistrate after you left. She was born there but later she relied on her privileges to return to the magistrate. She was ready to use her authority to investigate the rats in the dark corners of the inner and outer wall.”
“In the end, the nobles, the Monster Research Institute, and other major forces secretly had some shocking and despicable deeds. In her anger, she killed a large number of nobles, provoking the wrath of the heavens and the resentment of the people. The people in the wall were anxious. Not long after, the previous wall master returned. She was prepared to hide her identity, but no force offered her protection. Later, a noble pretended to protect her, but secretly set her up. Her identity was exposed and she was killed by Aristotle. She was paraded in the streets for a week until her body began to smell.”
Dudian was startled. He didn’t expect Gwyneth to end up in such a miserable state. But he didn’t look angry as he looked at Neuss, Aurora, Mason and others. He thought for a moment and understood. After all, the biggest dark forces should be blamed on them. If Gwyneth wanted to investigate these dark forces, it was inevitable that there would be friction with them.
In the end Gwyneth could only rely on the nobles to seek asylum.
He deeply sighed. The image of Gwyneth appeared in his mind. Gwyneth had just come out of prison. She had followed him to war and dared to advise him.., gwyneth didn’t hide her disgust towards some despicable acts. She had learned from the magistrate that her views wouldn’t change if she was wronged.
“She is a good person. It’s a pity.”Dudian muttered.
They were silent.
After a moment of silence Dudian stopped talking about Gwyneth: “Is there a library here? Take Me to see it.”
“Are you going to read?”Neuss was surprised. Mason and Barton were also surprised. Shouldn’t they seize the time to escape?
Dudian smiled: “There is a golden room in the book.”
Neuss knew that Dudian wouldn’t do useless things. He didn’t ask: “Yes. I can take you at any time if your body recovers.”
“Now then.”
Three days later.
A Golden Armory took a letter and delivered it to Neuss. Neuss took the letter and rushed to the library, he found the young man who was sitting cross-legged under the bookshelf.
“Young master, there is a letter from the Palace!”Neuss shouted.
Dudian’s eyes looked up from the book. He looked at the letter in Neuss’s hand. He opened the letter. There was only one sentence in the letter: “Have You had enough fun? Do you need me to personally invite you over?”
Dudian’s eyes were calm. Diana’s indifferent expression appeared in his mind. He looked at Neuss: “It seems that I don’t need to use escape to test whether she has installed a tracking device on me.”
Neuss bitterly smiled, “It seems that she has mastered the Amelia tribe in the palace. She knows about our secret base with the help of your tracking device. Otherwise, her letter wouldn’t be sent directly to you.”
“Don’t worry. She is not interested in the power here. She is just playing with it. She will leave after the matter is settled.”Dudian stood up and dusted his body, “After she leaves, the desolate race will be severely injured. You can wait for an opportunity to launch an attack. Prepare well during this time. If I am still alive then I will help you to exterminate the desolate race.”
“Young master…”Neuss’s eyes were full of worry. He didn’t care about the secret base being exposed.
Dudian patted his shoulder, “The envoys of the Kingdom of God have died here. The Kingdom of God will send people to investigate. There are many strong people in the Kingdom of God. The road to the throne is too high and difficult. If you can take them to another place to find a giant wall and live a small life there. That might be more happy.”
Neuss felt sour in his nose as he heard Dudian’s words. He clenched his teeth: “Master, if anything happens to you I will avenge you for the rest of my life!”
Dudian shook his head, “It’s not worth it. I don’t want to rescue you from prison. You have tied yourself to my prison. You have your own life. Find a small village and live a good life.”
..
..
“Your Majesty Crimson Moon, the person you invited has arrived.”A golden-armored desolate guard said respectfully.
Above the palace hall, a slender figure dressed in a scarlet flame robe sat on the throne, looking down from above. On both sides of the hall were the leaders of many forces. There were the Earls of the twelve cities, the deans of the Monster Research Institute, and so on, the head of the Witcher family and so on.
“Bring him in.”The indifferent voice came from the throne. It echoed in everyone’s ears.
Dudian heard Diana’s voice as he stood outside the hall. He followed the golden-armored guard into the hall. Soon he saw the patriarch of the wing clan and the Rock clan. There was also the dean of the monastery, there were several outstanding academicians of the institute and several nobles who had flattered him.
On both sides of the throne, they saw Amelia and the priest.
“They are familiar faces…”Dudian laughed.
“Your Majesty Crimson Moon, Dudian has brought them.”The guard bowed respectfully.
Diana nodded slightly and asked dudian: “Did you have a good time these days?”
“How can I enjoy myself without you?”Dudian smiled.
Daina raised her eyebrows as cold light flashed in her eyes. She seemed to have thought of something. Her lips curved up: “I’ll ‘play’with you later!”
Dudian heard her deliberately ambiguous tone. He knew that she was angry. He shrugged his shoulders: “I hope your skills haven’t deteriorated in the past few days!”
The corner of Dinah’s mouth didn’t decrease. She suddenly found that she had made a mistake. She was far from being a match for a man who was flirting with her.
Although the conversation between the two was short but the people on both sides of the hall were surprised.
They had heard about the inside story of the change of the throne from their own intelligence channels. Naturally they knew about Dinah’s strength. Dudian was an old face for them. He was a legendary figure in the past, however, compared to Dinah, Dudian was obviously not a bit inferior. It was just that they didn’t expect that Dudian would have a relationship with such a person.
Many people looked at Dudian with envy, jealousy, and a few exclamations.
“I called you here today for no other reason than to tell you how you used to be underlings. Don’t play tricks on me.”Dinah no longer paid attention to Dudian, she spoke to everyone in the hall.
Everyone knew that Dina had called them here to inform them about the succession of the throne. But they didn’t expect her to be so straightforward and simple.
“Didn’t anyone hear what I Said?”Dina smiled as she saw that everyone didn’t answer.
“Yes, the Zavu family will always be loyal to Her Majesty!”
“The wing family is willing to be loyal to Her Majesty Crimson Moon!”
No one dared to stand out at this time.
Daina waved to Amelia. She stood up and said to dudian: “Come with me.”
Dudian was relieved. He thought that Amelia really had the intention to manage the giant wall. Fortunately, she was impatient and didn’t want to be moved.
“How Do You Call Your Majesty Crimson Moon?”Dudian curiously asked as he entered the back hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 995
chapters.content:
Chapter 995 – : Chapter 985: Testing [ Second Update ]
“This is my name.”Dana didn’t look back. “I came up with it myself. You have to call me that in the future. Do you understand?”
Dudian slightly curled his lips: “Do you want to bid farewell to the past? Why is it called ‘Crimson Moon’? Is there any symbolic meaning?”
“Don’t confuse me with you mortals. You like to name names with the meaning of blessings or future expectations. I just want to remember the day I was born.”Dana indifferently said.
“Oh?”Dudian pondered for a moment, “There is no festival called ‘Crimson Moon’.”
“This is not a festival.”Dina walked to the corner of the corridor and glanced at Dudian, “The night I was born is the night when the Crimson Moon is in the sky. The stars are dim. I am the birth of the Crimson Moon. I am destined to shine like the Crimson Moon. You are just the stars that I can’t see.”
Dudian was surprised. He smiled: “As far as I know, the Moon is white or silver. But it is rare to see a Crimson Moon.”
“Of course, if I can see it every day then it is nothing special. Only this kind of special celestial phenomenon is worthy of me.”Diana scorned.
Dudian smiled but didn’t discuss the name with her, “Are the experimental materials ready? You should have gone to their spaceship to see the results of the conquest of the Amelia tribe. Aren’t you going to use other experimental materials to test them?”
“Don’t worry, I will save you until the end.”Diana, who had changed her name, glanced at him as if to say that he didn’t need to be afraid of death.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to her eyes and said: “You have already obtained the Super Chip. You haven’t finished learning the things inside. It’s not too late for you to call me when you are done so that I won’t cause trouble for you.”
“You are quite honest. I thought you would be stupid enough to escape.”Crimson Moon’s face was indifferent, “It’s a pity that Aisha is such a good experiment subject but you let her go. Even if you don’t use her as an experiment, she can still be cultivated into a super fighter. She is the crystallization of the experiment subject of the witcher. She has eaten the flesh of the Aragami. Her potential is much more terrifying than you think. I guess she can eat to the level of a king just by eating!”
Dudian was startled as he didn’t expect this. He couldn’t help but say: “It’s not so exaggerated. Even if undeads rely on food to evolve, but there should be a limit. How much food do they need to eat to reach the level of a King?”
“Who knows? Anyway, there is nothing lacking in this land. There is no shortage of people or monsters.”Crimson Moon pushed open the door of the back hall, she said as she walked: “But even if she becomes the king, it will be fine. The ones who should have a headache are the ones in the empire. It will be very easy to find her once our experiment is completed. I don’t believe that she can climb out of the god of war wall. If she does that, it will definitely alarm those guys.”
Dudian was surprised. Indeed, if Aisha ran all the way to the god of war wall and relied on the bloodthirsty nature of the undeads, she would certainly rush up and massacre. Then the king of the Empire would come to suppress her.
Thinking of this, he was a bit nervous.
Crimson Moon seemed to see through Dean’s worries. She sneered: “Think about yourself. You Can’t even protect yourself. It’s ridiculous to think so much!”
Dean coldly looked at her. He suddenly thought of something. His eyes swept over her chest. It was still round and full. Under the cloak of the robe was a scarlet tight armor. It complemented her petite and graceful figure. It was very tempting, he raised his eyebrows: “I remember that you were pierced through the heart by that thing. You Didn’t die?”
He was very direct. Crimson Moon looked at him, “I have disappointed you. Heart is not a fatal organ for me. It is not a special ability. If you want it, I can slightly modify you so that you can obtain such an immortal ability. How about it?”
Dudian had thought of this when he found out that she was not dead. But he didn’t think that it was true. So the only fatal part of her was her brain? Or should he say that even if he cut off her brain, he might not be able to kill her?
“If there is an opportunity in the future, the best way is to burn her body into ashes…”Dudian thought in his heart.
Crimson Moon glanced at him. Her eyes seemed to be looking into his heart. She beckoned a teenager over: “Take him to do a physical examination.”
The back hall had been transformed into a laboratory. It was filled with high-level equipment used by alchemists from different factions. There were many masked figures working in front of the equipment. They looked to be in their fifties or sixties, the youth’s hair was gray or completely white. He was the youngest among them. The other three middle-aged men were the youngest.
The youth was shocked when he saw Dudian. His eyes were wide open when he saw that both of Dudian’s legs were broken. He was walking on magic blades which extended from his knees.
“Why? Haven’t you seen a disabled person?”Dudian smiled at the teenager.
The shock on the teenager’s face quickly disappeared. He looked at Crimson Moon who was frowning at him. He bowed his head and apologized. Then he helped Dudian to another instrument and asked him to lie down for a physical examination.
“From today onwards, your daily life will be here. You are not allowed to leave without my order. I will provide you with everything you eat and drink. You are not allowed to eat any other food. Do you understand?”Crimson Moon came over, she ordered Dudian who was lying on the examination bed.
Dudian finally understood why she called him over so early. She wanted to observe the change in his body index in advance. He nodded: “I understand.”
Crimson Moon turned around and left. She spoke to the others and went to a small room in the back of the hall.
Dudian saw that she was sitting in the small room. She took out the super chip and the screen to study.
“Old… We are going to draw blood and check your magic marks. Please take off your clothes.”The teenager bowed his head and politely said.
Dudian looked at him but didn’t reply. He tore off his clothes and lay naked on the examination bed. He closed his eyes.
The teenager saw Dudian close his eyes and let out a sigh of relief. He began to methodically take out the instruments to draw blood for Dudian. He checked the body’s bones, heart rate, fat and other data.

chapters.title: Chapter 996
chapters.content:
Chapter 996 – Chapter 986: Transformation
“Blood test…”
“Fat coverage of 12% …”
“Magic marks activity identification…”
Dudian lay on the bed and let the teenager test his body. He closed his eyes and thought about his own matters.
The teenager helped Dudian up after collecting all the samples: “You can go to the side and rest for a while.”
Dudian looked at him: “What’s Your Name?”
The teenager’s face slightly changed: “My name is Samba.”
“Samba…”Dudian slightly nodded. He got up from the bed. There was a magic blade on his broken knee. He stood on the ground and poked the floor, he walked towards the rest area on the other side of the back hall.
During lunch, the maidservant brought food, medium-rare steak and a glass of milk.
Dudian lay on the sofa and closed his eyes to rest.
Crimson Moon stayed in the small room and concentrated on learning the knowledge from the super chip. The other masters from the monastery and Monster Institute were busy with the experimental tasks that Crimson Moon had given them.
In the afternoon, Dudian saw three ragged girls who were about seven or eight years old. They were led to the rear hall by a golden armored guard.
“Sir, your experimental items have arrived.”The Golden Armored Guard respectfully said.
An old man wearing a white coat and monocle came forward. He frowned and pinched his nose: “It stinks. Where did you find them?”
“I found them from the slums. They don’t have household registration.”The Golden Armored Guard respectfully replied.
The old man frowned and waved his hand: “Take them out and wash them. Don’t send such Dirty Things to me. Don’t defile this place!”
The golden armored guard was startled: “Yes, I will take them out to wash them.”He grabbed the three girls and quickly left the back hall.
Dudian was lying on the sofa not far away. He opened his eyes and looked at the scene. After the Golden Armory Guard left, the old man seemed to have noticed something. He looked at dudian, the old man smiled and licked his lips. He looked like a hungry prey enjoying a delicious dinner.
Dudian closed his eyes and ignored them.
In the evening, three clean little girls were sent to the hall. The old man wearing monocle led them to another isolated laboratory. It didn’t take long for the sound of screaming and crying to come from inside.
The sound came out of nowhere and ended quickly.
Dudian frowned slightly. He turned his body and continued to close his eyes to rest.
“You are quite honest. Why didn’t you go out today?”Crimson Moon came to Dudian’s side and smiled.
Dudian opened one of his eyes and glanced at her: “Have you finished learning?”
Crimson moon stretched her slender body, “I’m tired. Take a rest. The people of the old era have good points. Maybe we can make nuclear weapons in the future to pacify the earth and regain the absolute rule of mankind!”
Dudian was too lazy to talk to her.
Crimson Moon’s eyes lit up. She was full of confidence in the future. She didn’t say anything as Dudian ignored her. She hummed a classic song and left.
The next day, Dudian’s first physical examination report came out.
The report was sent directly to Crimson Moon’s small room. Dudian didn’t have the opportunity to read it. He continued to collect samples for the second time.
Time flew by.
Dudian had stayed in the back hall for half a month. He had to complete the collection of specimens every day. Every day the changes of the body data would be sent to Crimson Moon. He was like a mouse that was being injected into a cage.
During this half a month, the golden armory sent a number of “Experiments”. Most of them came from slums. No one knew about their death so it was not easy to investigate, occasionally, they would send some strong hunters. The three little girls were dragged out on the third day.
The strange meat wrapped around their heads like dried corpses. They were screaming as if they were trapped in a quagmire.
Dudian silently watched the batch of experiments being sent out and then turned into piles of failed materials. It was the first time that he clearly felt the terror of the Monster Research Institute, they had been secretly doing this for many years..
There was only a string of data left.
“It seems that the small intestine of the Aragami that Boro implanted into your body has begun to work.”Crimson Moon called Dudian into her small room. There was a stack of 4A paper in her hand, it was full of Dudian’s body data. She looked up at Dudian and said with interest: “Do you feel that the food tastes strange these days?”
Dudian knew that he was a guinea pig being interrogated. He didn’t struggle: “I feel that the taste is a bit disgusting.”
Crimson moon smiled: “I can give you a delicious meal later.”
Dudian frowned: “When are you going to do the experiment?”
“What’s the hurry? I’m not in a hurry.”Crimson moon smiled: “Let’s observe for a few months. We can use other experimental materials to experiment. There are many polar ice insects in Amelia’s tribe. It’s enough to strengthen these experimental materials.”
Dudian’s face sank but he didn’t say anything.
Crimson Moon saw that Dudian was in a bad mood so she didn’t joke with him. She waved her hand and asked him to leave. Then she took out the super chip and continued to study.
In the evening, Dudian saw what crimson moon said was “Delicious”. It was a bloody raw steak!
He frowned when he saw it. But the next moment, he suddenly found that the fresh blood on the steak was as tempting as the butter on the side of the cooked steak. He couldn’t help but salivate.
The smell of blood from the steak made him have an inexplicable impulse to eat.
He sat on the table and looked at the bloody smell coming from the plate. His nose was itchy. He swallowed his saliva and thought of Crimson Moon’s words, “Is this the change brought by the small intestine of the Aragami? Do Aragami eat raw meat?”
Dudian felt a chill down his spine as he thought of the image of the beautiful Aragami biting raw meat.
Dudian hesitated for a moment before he finally raised his knife and fork. He cut the raw steak into pieces and ate them. He felt that each piece was incomparably delicious. He was intoxicated by the feeling of blood being squeezed out from the beef.
Dudian wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth after he finished eating. He looked at the empty plate and sighed. What would he become?
He shook his head. He didn’t think about these troublesome things. He focused his mind and continued to think about the unfinished things in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 997
chapters.content:
Chapter 997 – Chapter 987: Violation Of Taboos
Two months later.
Dudian and a few old men in white coats were standing outside a glass window in a laboratory in the back hall. There was a serious operation going on inside. A square-faced young man was lying on the operating table, he was in a coma due to anesthesia.
There were two pairs of long and thin transparent wings on the back of the young man. There were black wings on the wings which spread out like veins. At this moment, Crimson Moon was personally operating the operation. Several old men in white coats were assisting from the side, she completely flipped open the stomach of the square-faced young man and busied herself in his stomach. From time to time, Crimson Moon would take out a small piece of dark yellow intestines from the side and stuff it into the young man’s stomach, at the same time, she pulled out a large piece of twisted intestines and internal organs from within.
His stomach was connected to a piece of intestines and it was moved to his chest. His stomach was slightly deflated and there was not much food in it.
“I don’t know what kind of effect will be produced by the combination of monster genes and the flesh of the Aragami. It would be great if we can balance the ice and fire magic marks and stimulate new power at the same time!”
“I hope we can succeed!”
“I’m really looking forward to seeing the birth of God!”
The old men in white coats looked at the situation in the laboratory. They were excited and whispered. Their eyes were emitting the light of a hungry wolf.
Dudian slightly frowned. He felt that their words were a bit harsh. He glanced at them. The old men noticed that Dudian was looking at them with an unfriendly expression, he retreated to the other side. He didn’t dare to explain or argue with Dudian. After all, Dudian was the only rare experiment. But they could be replaced. If Dudian really killed them then crimson moon wouldn’t avenge them.
Dudian’s eyes turned to the laboratory. He prayed in his heart that Crimson Moon or others would make a mistake and lead to the failure of the experiment.
Once the experiment was successful, it meant that Crimson Moon’s deity experiment was one step closer. It wouldn’t be long before the experiment would be used on him.
Soon, his prayer was successful.
No one made a mistake, but when Crimson Moon stitched up the square-faced young man’s stomach, the square-faced young man suddenly woke up from the anesthesia. His eyes were wide open, and they were bloodshot, almost protruding out of his eye sockets, he let out an angry and savage roar. The veins on his neck bulged, but the color of the veins was pitch black.
In the next moment, the square-faced young man’s stomach swelled up high. The wound that had been stitched up halfway suddenly burst open, and dark green blood spurted out from it. Crimson Moon reacted quickly and pulled up the sterilized white coat to block it. Several holes were instantly burned on the white coat, as if the blood was sulfuric acid.
The few old men in white coats next to them were not so lucky. Although they had studied and experimented all year round, their physiques were not high, and things happened suddenly. Immediately, dark green blood splattered all over their bodies, and one by one, they cried out in pain, they covered their faces and rolled on the ground, knocking over the surgical carts around them. Various types of surgical knives, tweezers, pliers, and other props that required different requirements were scattered all over the ground.
Whoosh!
When the dark green blood splattered out, a few dark green strange limbs suddenly shot out from the square-faced youth’s abdomen. They looked like arthropods, and there were long sharp barbs on the strange limbs that twisted randomly, the barbs swept across another white-robed old man who was slightly closer. The barbs landed on the side of his waist and sent him flying.
Crimson Moon frowned slightly. A cold light flashed in front of her eyes. She did not make a move. A silver light flashed past the strange limbs, and the strange limbs immediately fell down. The dark green blood that flowed out corroded the metal floor, leaving potholes.
“Squeak Squeak!”
A sharp cry came from the square-faced young man’s abdomen. A bloody head the size of a fist stuck out from it. There was a turtle-like carapace on top of his head. He had a single eye, and his face looked like a human’s, his nose and lips were arranged under his eyes. He had no eyebrows, a sharp nose, and an extremely large mouth. The corners of his mouth were split to the ends of his ears, and when he screamed, he revealed his sharp teeth.
The thing soon noticed crimson moon in front of it and immediately pounced on her.
Crimson Moon frowned slightly. A metal can appeared in her hand out of nowhere. When the little thing jumped out, she suddenly swung her hand. With a bang, she covered the metal can and quickly sealed it.
Bang! Bang!
The Little Monster’s strength was incredibly great. It hit the metal can and made it bulge slightly, as if it would break out of the can at any moment.
Crimson Moon stared at the metal pot. It struggled for a moment. After a few minutes it gradually weakened and returned to its calm state.
“Is it dead?”Dudian was relieved.
Crimson Moon frowned and opened the metal pot.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a bloody shadow jumped out of the pot and jumped towards Crimson Moon’s face like a monkey.
Crimson Moon quickly raised her hand and stuffed it back into the metal pot. She sealed it again and put it into another groove of the laboratory table. The metal pot was just inserted into the pot. No matter how hard it struggled, the pot didn’t move.
Crimson Moon looked at the few old men in white coats rolling on the ground, screaming and groaning. Her expression was as cold as ever. She said, “All of you, get out. Wash your bodies and receive treatment.”
Her words seemed to have a magic power, causing the few old men in white coats who could not calm down amidst the screams to stop struggling. The few of them were sweating profusely. They gritted their teeth, covered their ulcerated faces, and turned to leave the laboratory.
“How could we fail?”
“Kern, Are You Alright?”
“Quick, I’ll take you to treatment.”
The few old men who were waiting immediately went up and took the injured old men away.
There was only Crimson Moon left in the laboratory and the little monster who was no longer struggling. The square-faced youth seemed to have died. His body didn’t move at all.
Dudian used his X-ray vision to see that the heat source on his body was quickly dissipating. Many of the blood vessels in his body had shriveled up as if they had been dried by the sun. The magic marks on his left shoulder and chest were embedded, there was no trace of the magic marks at the moment.
Dudian roughly guessed the origin of the small monster. It should be the magic marks in his body!
“There are too many active cells of the Aragami that have been injected into his body. He used his body as an ovary and used the magic marks as a supplement to nurture new life…”Dudian’s eyes were full of seriousness, the ability to create life was something that only ‘gods’had since ancient times!
However at this moment Crimson Moon had done it. She had touched the forbidden area.
Although the experiment had failed, but this alone was enough to make her proud.
“This little thing ate two magic marks in a row. It should have inherited part of the ability of magic marks. It was born with such a fast speed. Its growth is amazing. From the perspective of biology, it may be considered as a higher level life form than humans. Moreover, from its previous sneak attack, its IQ is not low…”Dudian looked at Crimson Moon who was standing in front of the square-faced young man’s corpse, twinkle in the eye. Next, she should study the little monster, so that he has a lot of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 998
chapters.content:
Chapter 998 – Chapter 988: “God”
In the laboratory, Crimson Moon did not directly throw away the square-faced young man’s body. Instead, after a moment of silence, she took out the equipment next to her, dissected the body, and extracted specimens from it for analysis.
After all the specimens were examined and recorded in the experimental data, Crimson Moon asked someone to dispose of the remaining “Garbage”. Then, she brought the little monster that was locked in the metal jar to another laboratory.
Time flew by.
The experiments in the back hall were carried out in full swing. Every day there were experimental materials sent to the magistrate. The magistrate had become Crimson Moon’s subordinate.
Dudian had been staying in the back hall. He didn’t know anything about the outside. But he didn’t hear any news about Neuss and Barton. It was the best news for him. He hoped that they would be able to endure.
“Crimson Moon has asked you to go over and check your body.”Samba whispered as he walked behind Dudian.
Dudian looked out of the window. He knew that the day was coming. After a lot of experiments, Crimson Moon’s God creation plan was going to be perfected, it was going to be implemented on him.
Fortunately, his preparations had been completed.
“Go.”Dudian turned around and followed samba.
They went to the laboratory. Samba did the same as before.
After the data was done, an old man came over and asked Dudian to go to Crimson Moon’s office.
“Are you looking for me?”Dudian opened the door and saw Crimson Moon sitting in front of a stack of experimental data. He closed the door.
Crimson Moon didn’t raise her head: “Are You Ready?”
“Are we going to start?”Dudian narrowed his eyes.
Crimson Moon looked up from the report in her hand. She looked at dudian and suddenly smiled: “It seems you are mentally prepared.”
“If it was anyone else, they would have been numb for a long time.”Dudian indifferently said.
Scarlet moon gently smiled: “Other people wouldn’t have such an opportunity. Once you succeed, you will be a living God!”
“I hope so.”Dudian didn’t comment.
Scarlet Moon quickly finished the report and threw it onto the thick experimental data. She got up and said: “Sit here.”
Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed as he sat on the sofa in front of her desk.
“Let me see what you are thinking about.”Scarlet Moon smiled as she sat next to Dudian. There was a faint orchid fragrance coming from her body.
Dudian didn’t resist as he looked at her white hand. He quietly looked into her eyes.
Scarlet Moon’s small hand was very cold and soft. She touched Dudian’s forehead. In an instant, there was a slight tingling pain. Dudian felt that his vision was suddenly pulled into the darkness and his body fell infinitely, then he fell into a perpetual darkness.
The intense pain surged from the endless darkness. He tried to endure it but the pain soon exceeded his tolerance limit and he fainted.
“Eh?”Scarlet Moon slightly frowned. She opened her eyes and looked at Dudian who had fainted on the sofa. Her eyes flashed with a strange color. She closed her eyes and opened them again after a few minutes. There was a bit of surprise on her face, she pursed her lips and smiled, “Sure enough, people can’t let their guard down for a moment. The will to resist is really strong. In such a desperate mood, you actually have such a fantastic idea. Do you want to hypnotize me? Unfortunately, your thoughts will be understood by me. Fortunately, I didn’t mess up the order and watch from the back. Otherwise, I might have been hit!”
She looked at the young man in admiration. The more she understood, the more she admired Dudian. She knew that if she was in such a desperate situation, she would never think of such a strange method of resistance.
Moreover, this method was not completely ineffective!
If she was careless and directly looked at Dudian’s memory from the back, she might be hypnotized. At that time, Dudian would counterattack!
This move almost made Dudian become the master!
She didn’t expect that Dudian would find flaws in her ability to read memories. This man was too terrifying!
She couldn’t help but feel a bit of fear in her heart. This man couldn’t let people relax a bit. No matter how big the adversity was, he could find a gap to drill out!
She slowly closed her eyes as her eyes flashed.
A moment later, she withdrew her hand and got up to pour herself a cup of water. She sat back on the sofa and quietly drank. There was a slight sweat on her forehead.
The pain faded from the darkness. Dudian felt that his body was a bit warm. He slowly woke up and opened his eyes. He saw Crimson Moon sitting next to him drinking tea. There was a bit of surprise and gentleness in his eyes as he hugged her.
Crimson Moon wasn’t surprised as she let Dudian hold her in his arms. She smiled: “I just left for a while but I can’t bear to leave!”
Dudian buried his head in her neck and took a deep breath. He smelled the fragrance of the girl’s body and gently said: “I don’t want to leave even for a minute!”
Crimson Moon smiled and gently pushed him away: “Don’t be like this. We have things to do. We will do experiments tomorrow. You should have a good rest tonight. Don’t let your imagination run wild!”
Dudian grinned: “I Only Miss You!”
Crimson Moon’s cheeks were slightly red. Although she knew that this was the result of modifying her memory, but it was the first time that she was treated like this. Moreover, from Dudian’s eyes, tone and expression, it could be seen that he was sincere from the bottom of his heart.
She suddenly felt jealous of Aisha who had turned into a zombie king. They were both products of the experiment. How could she get such love? !
However, this jealousy came and went quickly. She was too lazy to care about a zombie.
“When the experiment is successful, the world will be ours.”Crimson Moon held Dudian’s face and looked at his handsome face. She thought of the experiences of this man since he was a child. Her heart beat slightly, she gently said: “When we conquer the world, I will accompany you to the highest mountain to see the most beautiful sunset.”
Dudian looked at her gently: “We will be immortal!”
Scarlet Moon smiled. Her mind couldn’t help but think of their long-lived romantic years. She whispered: “No matter how many experiments you make in the future, you will be the only one for me.”
“You too.”Dudian looked at her affectionately.
Scarlet Moon’s body was slightly heated by his eyes. She lowered her head and gently kissed his lips. By the time Dudian came back to his senses, she was already standing behind the desk. She looked like an innocent girl in the blooming season. There was a touch of shyness on her face: “You go out First!”
Dudian touched his lips in a daze. It seemed that he was reminiscing. After a long time he smiled and left the office, he closed the door: “Don’t stay up late. I will adjust my condition to the best. I will help you to complete your experiment.”
Scarlet Moon nodded.
Scarlet Moon’s face slowly faded away after the door was closed. She sank into deep thought. After a long time she shook her head and continued to read the previous experiment materials.
Dudian went out to have dinner. He went back to his sleeping place. It was late at night. He looked at the stars in the sky and listened to the busy laboratory staff who were doing the final instrument testing tonight.
The starlight reflected on the windowsill. He quietly looked at it.
The next morning, all the laboratory staff were present. The atmosphere in the back hall was obviously different from before. It was especially serious.
All the laboratory staff were very solemn. When Dudian got up, someone immediately took him to wash up. After he took a bath and changed into a sterilized anti-bacterial suit, he went to the largest laboratory in the back hall.
At this moment, all the laboratories in the back hall had stopped working. All the people were waiting outside the laboratory and were ready to be dispatched.

chapters.title: Chapter 999
chapters.content:
Chapter 999 – Chapter 989: Sun Beast Soul Worm
“You are here.”Crimson Moon walked out of the laboratory. She was wearing a white coat and anti-bacteria mask. Her eyes could be seen from the mask.
Dudian’s eyes lit up when he saw her. He relaxed his body.
“Are You Ready?”Crimson Moon looked at him with tenderness in her eyes.
Dudian took a deep breath and smiled with confidence: “I believe in you. You can do it!”
Crimson Moon looked at him: “I Will!”
The laboratory was very spacious. There weren’t many instruments but they were relatively complex. There was a metal platform in the middle of the laboratory. There were scanners, dialysis lenses and other equipment. Dudian looked at it and sighed in his heart. Although he had the knowledge taught by the super chip but it was not easy to make these things in a short time.
However, this was also the reason for the rise of Sylvia’s overall industrial technology. In his two years as the wall master, electricity had been popularized. Under the industrial development driven by electricity, the progress was very fast, this allowed crimson moon to have the capital to produce these things in a short time. Moreover, the manpower invested in it was beyond his imagination.
Under the guidance of Crimson Moon, Dudian lay on the metal platform.
Crimson Moon put on the mask again. Her expression was solemn. She looked at Dudian and saw the trust in each other’s eyes.
“Don’t be nervous, come on!”Dudian comforted her.
Crimson Moon nodded and took a deep breath. She looked at the five old men who had been following her for many days: “Get ready to start!”
The eyes of the five people flashed with excitement. They had been waiting for this day for months. This was the moment to witness the great miracle and they were the architects of the Miracle!
They had carried out the same experiment many times. They had memorized all the procedures and procedures. But today they had changed the object. This object was the last experiment and also the most precious experiment, failure was not allowed.
Although they were excited, the five of them were more cautious than before.
“Anesthesia!”
“Bone cutter!”
Crimson Moon took off Dudian’s anti-bacteria suit and revealed his white and strong chest. Even if he was lying down, he could see the outline of his six-pack ABS. Dudian didn’t deliberately pursue a perfect body, but in the long-term battle.., his body naturally became beautiful.
The five old men acted as assistants and handed over all kinds of scalpels to crimson moon.
Anesthesia was applied, the belly was cut open, support was used, and the internal organs were moved..
Scarlet Moon’s movements were skilled. Her eyes were calm and focused. She was used to the bloody scene in front of her. It didn’t take long for her to complete the prelude of the operation. She constructed a new magic mark ovaries inside Dudian’s body.
“Take the soul worm!”Scarlet Moon ordered.
An old man in white coat immediately handed over a transparent jar to hold the soul worm. There was a soul worm curled up inside. It looked like a scale. It was rectangular in shape and its body was almost transparent, there were only a few flame-like red threads wrapped around its body.
It was a soul worm from the eastern continent. In addition to the ability of the soul worm, it also belonged to the flame attribute.
However, if it was a soul worm that was bred alone, its flame attribute was basically equivalent to nothing. It belonged to the hidden attribute. Only when it coexisted with the soul worm of the Shenluo Empire would the flame attribute become dominant, there was a conflict.
Dudian felt that he had lost consciousness from the neck down. The anesthesia was slowly extending to his brain. His thoughts were slow. His head was dizzy from time to time. His vision would turn black from time to time, he used the corner of his eyes to see the transparent scale-shaped soul worm. He could see that there were many small whiskers on its body. It looked like countless thin feet. He asked Crimson Moon about the origin of the soul worm.
The Sun Beast..
The name of the monster that hid the soul worm in the eastern continent was not given by the word “Person.”This soul worm was taken from the body of the “Sun Beast.”Its main function was related to light and heat. According to Crimson Moon, the Sun Beast was an extremely rare monster. It was extremely powerful and was especially good at long-range attacks. However, its close combat ability was also extremely terrifying. It had almost no flaws. Its only weakness was that it was afraid of the dark.
At night, the strength of the Sun Beast would plummet.
The Sun Beast was one of the top soul worms in the East continent that Crimson Moon had collected.
Dudian could see that Crimson Moon didn’t hold back in this experiment. Although it wasn’t a gamble but she had given up everything.
Soon, the Sun Beast Soul Worm was sent into Dudian’s abdomen by crimson moon. It seemed that it had smelled blood. The soul worm suddenly regained its vitality and quickly drilled into the magic marks’ovaries in Dudian’s abdomen. Soon, blood vessels began to bulge and a large amount of blood was pumped into the magic nest.
Crimson Moon was relieved to see that the artificial magic nest had stabilized the soul worm. The basic experiment had been one-third successful.
“God’s blood!”Crimson Moon said.
An old man quickly handed over a small bottle of black blood that was as thick as a finger.
Crimson Moon used a syringe to inhale the blood and injected it into Dudian’s heart. Soon, the black blood flowed into Dudian’s heart along the blood vessels. The red heart was dyed black and then in the heart, it quickly spread to the whole body. The color of all the blood vessels became dull, including Dudian’s lips. The color gradually deepened and became black!
Dudian couldn’t see the changes in his body but he suddenly felt a burst of pain in his brain. His body “Felt”incomparably hot. He had lost consciousness under anesthesia but at this moment it seemed that he had regained control of his body, the high temperature made his scalp numb. But very soon, there was an extremely cold feeling coming out from the high temperature. It began with his right arm and quickly covered his whole body.
However, the hot feeling was not to be outdone. It quickly rose up again.
Cold and boiling heat quickly alternated. Dudian felt that his brain was swollen to the point that he couldn’t think. His brain was in pain. His vision was pitch black and he couldn’t see anything. He felt that his body seemed to fall into a dark vortex, he was sinking and sinking..
“The blood of the Aragami seems to be flowing into his brain!”An old man whispered. He raised his hand to support Dudian’s closed eyes but saw that there was no reaction from his eyes.
Crimson Moon was busy with Dudian’s abdomen, she didn’t raise her head: “Don’t worry. The uranium ring on his neck can block the blood of the Aragami. The only thing that is flowing into his brain is the mutated blood which is infected by the blood of the Aragami. It doesn’t have the characteristic of self-devouring.”
The old man was relieved. At this time he heard crimson moon shout again: “No! Hurry! Prepare the cold crystals!”
They saw a strange scene. Half of Dudian’s body was frozen and the other half was red like fire. The two different temperatures were half of Dudian’s body, the skin had begun to fester. Under the Battle of ice and fire, it was freezing and high temperature. The gene chain was close to collapse and the body couldn’t bear it.
“How…”the few of them were in disbelief. Although they had seen such a situation in their previous experiments but they had improved it. They could stabilize the situation with the blood of God, why was it ineffective now?
At this time, Crimson Moon grabbed the cold crystal and quickly cut it open. She sucked the cold liquid into the syringe and injected it into the left side of Dudian’s body. Soon, the temperature of the left side of his body gradually decreased, however, it soon became hotter than before.
Scarlet Moon’s face turned ugly: “The Magic Marks don’t match. The Soul Worm of the Sun Beast wants to swallow the splitter. Damn it!”
She had encountered a situation where the soul worm and the experimental soul worm didn’t match. However, the stability of the god’s blood had suppressed the two. However, the situation was obviously different this time, the reason why she could rely on the god’s blood to suppress the soul worm was because the previous soul worm was too ordinary. The Soul Worm of the Sun Beast and the soul worm of the splitter were top soul worms.
Especially the Soul Worm of the Sun Beast was inferior to her ‘Dream Maker’soul worm. It was much stronger than the soul worm of the splitter.
Normally the soul worm of the splitter wouldn’t have the strength to fight. But she knew that Dudian’s soul worm had swallowed the same kind of soul worm. Moreover it had swallowed the Aragami factor, it was a real deification to strengthen the splitter soul worm! The characteristic of deification was enough to make the splitter become more extreme. According to the Empire’s five-star soul worm classification system, deification splitter could be classified as a five-star soul worm!
Although it couldn’t rank among the top five-star soul worms but it could be considered as one of the top soul worms!
She didn’t expect that it wouldn’t be able to suppress the Sun Beast Soul Worm in this situation.
Scarlet Moon soon realized that the Sun Beast Soul Worm had absorbed the blood of God and completed deification. Its quality was higher than that of the splitter, it was one of the best among the five-star Soul Worms.
“His body can’t take it anymore.”Someone saw that the skin of Dudian’s body was broken and rotten.

chapters.title: Chapter 1000
chapters.content:
Chapter 1000 – Chapter 990: Heart Change
The situation of body collapse had happened many times in the previous experiments. Scarlet Moon had already found a way to deal with it. She didn’t panic and asked her assistant to take another bottle of God’s blood, she injected it into Dudian’s body.
The Black God’s blood flowed into the rotten flesh and blood. The effect quickly appeared. The rotten flesh and blood rapidly transformed and new pink flesh and blood were born. After the appearance of the new flesh and blood, the surface of the rotten skin quickly lost its luster and became dull. Then like dust and soil, it slowly faded and no longer emitted a foul smell, it was like a lump of mud that had been rubbed out after years of not bathing.
An assistant immediately shoveled away the completely dead flesh and blood under the instruction of Crimson Moon. At this time, it was obvious that there was a black line in the middle of Dudian’s body that separated the temperature of ice and fire.
Although the experiment was a bit dangerous but it was still under control. There was no unexpected situation that exceeded the previous experimental data.
Crimson Moon and the other old men were relieved. They carefully injected all kinds of antibiotics into Dudian’s body as well as the latest stabilizer. They quietly waited for Dudian’s body to fuse.
“After the body has recovered its constant temperature, prepare to suture. Pay attention to the content of blood in the target’s body.”Scarlet Moon calmly ordered. The experiment was almost two-thirds complete. Next was Dudian’s self-characteristics.
Under the injection of a large number of top-level antibiotics extracted from all kinds of monsters, Dudian’s body temperature slowly recovered. The body temperature of the right side of his body gradually increased while the body temperature of the left side of his body gradually decreased, the black lines of the God’s blood in the middle of his body were gradually fading. The three lines gradually sank into Dudian’s body.
Scarlet Moon’s heart dropped. The God’s blood and the Magic Marks had reached a balance in Dudian’s body. At this moment, Dudian’s body was no different from hers. Her body.., in Bolo’s words, it was called the god’s embryo!
She was only one step away from becoming a god!
However, the next key step was the real result of her experiments for months!
The characteristics of Dudian’s body in the old era were needed here: low radiation pure body, super strong genetic stability!
After reading Dudian’s memory, Scarlet Moon knew that Dudian’s preciousness was more important than Bolo had thought. It could be said that he was unique! It was not just because he was a life of the old era. Whether it was from his background or the experience of sleeping in the freezing chamber for 300 years, it was enough to see that his body was different from the others!
Only she knew that the freezing chamber was not a mature work. An ordinary person would definitely not be able to sleep in it for such a long time. When the critical point of an individual was exceeded, the long-term cryogenics would be frozen, it would completely freeze a person’s life. Even if they were lucky enough to wake up, their brain function would not be fully restored. The possibility of becoming an idiot and a retard was as high as 90% !
After all, the human brain was too mysterious. It contained consciousness, soul, and thoughts. These were all mysteries that scientists were still unable to solve. For example, why did a person dream? How did a person obtain consciousness, how did people’s thoughts come into being? Where was the human soul?
These were unsolvable riddles!
Dudian’s parents might have considered the possibility that dudian would become an idiot. Therefore, most of the important knowledge of the old era, especially the industrial reform, was recorded in the Super Chip, it was recorded in the form of words and pictures. Even if Dudian became an idiot, he might be able to rely on the knowledge in the chip to restore some intelligence. It didn’t matter even if he was an idiot who didn’t know how to learn, if the chip fell into the hands of other survivors, it could play a huge role in rebuilding human civilization and restore the brilliance!
Crimson Moon thought that her guess was right. The poor man thought that he had placed all of his parents’hopes on him. In fact, his parents only held a glimmer of hope for him, the real intention was to keep the super chip. That was the most important thing!
“Let me see what effect the pure body that hasn’t been exposed to radiation or eaten the nuclear residue of mutated creatures can have!”Crimson Moon stared at the unconscious Dudian.
At this time, the temperature of both sides of Dudian’s body had gradually become unified. At this moment, there were faint red lines emerging from his right arm. They were blood vessels that were emitting hot blood, the entire ice arm was constantly emitting steam.
“Check body temperature, 42 degrees!”An old man observed the changes in Dudian’s body and reported to Crimson Moon.
Crimson Moon nodded slightly. Although 42 degrees was a high fever for humans, but for Dudian, it was still within the tolerance range.
As time passed, Dudian’s body temperature became more and more stable. It gradually fell from 42 degrees to 40 degrees. However, at the same time as his body temperature fell, there was a new change in his body, aging.
His skin became drier and drier, and the flesh on his face also gradually relaxed. In the blink of an eye, he had turned from a handsome youth to a mature middle-aged man with a face full of frost. Moreover, the aging continued, it was visible to the naked eye that every minute and second changed. It didn’t take long for him to become more than 50 years old. His skin gradually wrinkled and his temples were slightly white.
“The cells in his body are accelerating to fission!”An old man looked at Crimson Moon and waited for her instructions.
Crimson Moon frowned. She didn’t expect that dudian would encounter all the negative symptoms that they had encountered before. First, the imbalance between heat and cold almost caused the body to tear. Now he was aging. Fortunately, she had encountered both of them before and had found a solution, she immediately ordered: “Inject nutrient solution and life essence into his body. The Aragami Factor and magic marks in his body are competing with each other to devour his body. He will use these to resist. Once his body stabilizes, he will recover.”
The old men quickly followed her instructions. By the time Dudian was in his sixties, the nutrient solution and life essence had been injected into his body. The rate of aging slowed down and gradually stabilized.
“The last step is to change the heart!”Crimson Moon’s eyes were deep. An old man handed her a fist-sized black-purple heart. The old man was as respectful and pious as if he was holding a Bible. The heart was taken from the body of the goddess of Sylvia. Who would have thought that the heart of a ten-meter-tall Aragami would be so small? It was almost the same size as a normal human heart!

chapters.title: Chapter 1001
chapters.content:
Chapter 1001 – Chapter 991: Failure
Scarlet Moon’s eyes were cautious. This last step couldn’t be experimented previously. The success or failure depended on Dudian’s own characteristics. She had transformed Dudian’s body into a body that fit the heart of the Aragami. But whether it could be a perfect match would depend on luck.
“Test the condition of the experimental body.”Scarlet Moon ordered.
The old men immediately took out various instruments and began to work on Dudian. After a moment, all kinds of data were collected.
“Blood pressure is stable…”
“Spirit is stable…”
“Magic marks are stable…”
“The God’s blood is dissolved and stable…”
..
Scarlet color appeared in Scarlet Moon’s eyes as she listened to the reports of the old men. The world in her eyes immediately changed. She saw many things that she couldn’t see before, dudian’s body gradually calmed down. The blood and magic marks in his body became horns. They faced each other and stabilized.
“Get Ready.”Crimson Moon took a deep breath. She took out the scalpel and slowly cut open Dudian’s chest. The tough skin was cut open like thin film in front of the special scalpel. Her small hands became agile. She saw that Dudian’s chest was cut open layer by layer. Even the ribs in his chest were cut off by her.
The whole process was silent. It was like a piano master playing a great piece of music.
Dong Dong!
A red heart was beating in Dudian’s chest under his ribs. The blood rushed out of his chest. The Red Heart was originally a human heart but now it was dark. It was infected by the God’s blood.
Crimson Moon paused for a moment and then her fingers quickly moved. In an instant, many afterimages appeared. In the blink of an eye, the red heart in Dudian’s chest had fallen into her hands and was still beating.
A gentle tremor came from her five fingers. Scarlet Moon didn’t abandon the heart but gently put it on the tray. She took out the dark purple Aragami heart and quickly connected the blood vessels, she buried it in Dudian’s chest.
The experiment continued.
The whole room was silent. The few old men didn’t dare to breathe. They stared at the magical scene. They had seen some crazy alchemists who had done heart replacement experiments and even brain replacement experiments, but the process was much more brutal than this. There were countless experiments and there were few who succeeded. Even if they succeeded, it didn’t mean that they would always succeed in the future.
