This thing depended on the probability and luck.
After a long time, when Crimson Moon’s fingertip was lifted from Dudian’s chest, the few old men woke up from their dreams. They saw that Dudian’s chest had been stitched by the silk thread. The silk thread could secrete healing mucus, it would gradually dissolve in body temperature to help speed up the healing of the wound. This was the favorite material used by hunters to sew wounds.
Scarlet Moon’s forehead was full of sweat. She was not tired but nervous. She took the towel handed by the old man and wiped it. She was relieved to see that Dudian’s chest was slightly fluctuating, she thought of Dudian’s heart. She was about to tell him to refrigerate the heart for future use. But before she could say anything, her face changed.
Dudian’s chest was covered in a thick black color. The skin on the surface seemed to be dyed black. The black color spread like black ink. Half of his chest was blue and purple.
At the same time, the unconscious Dudian frowned. His face was full of pain. The two magic marks on his chest and abdomen once again emitted vigorous cold air and boiling heat, the surface of Dudian’s body quickly lost its luster. His skin gradually decayed.
“How…”the few old men were shocked and nervous when they saw the abnormal situation.
Crimson Moon’s face was ugly as she quickly said: “Check his body condition.”
The few old men reacted and quickly took out the instrument to check. Soon, the data were checked. All of them were abnormal reactions. They were either over the limit or lower than the original index, including Dudian’s heart rate, it had reached a shocking level. It was expanding three times per second and the frequency was getting faster and faster. The amplitude of the vibration was getting larger and larger. The naked eye could see that Dudian’s chest was shaking violently, even the metal table that he was lying on seemed to be trembling slightly. It was as if one heavy fist after another was hitting it. The power was terrifying.
Under the violent beating, Dudian’s chest faintly showed signs of tearing. It seemed that the heart inside was about to break out of its shell.
“Your Highness, if this goes on the test subject will collapse!”
“He can’t take it anymore!”
Several old men looked at Crimson Moon and waited for her order.
Crimson Moon’s face changed as she clenched her teeth. She grabbed Dudian’s chest and growled: “Inject nutrient solution and God’s marrow into her body. First stabilize his body. In addition, get the cold insect’s marrow and inject it into him!”
An old man’s eyes were wide open: “Your Highness, if we inject the cold insect’s marrow then his splitter’s magic marks will evolve again. Will it be out of balance…”
“Go!”Crimson Moon glared at him. If it wasn’t for the urgency of the situation she would have killed him.
The old man’s body trembled as cold sweat dripped down his body. He was scared to the extreme. He quickly turned around and ran away.
A moment later, the old men took the materials and injected them into Dudian’s body according to Crimson Moon’s instructions. With the injection of nutrient solution and God’s marrow, Dudian’s body fluctuated slightly. However, his heart was still beating violently. Even though Crimson Moon was in Dudian’s heart, his shoulders were pushed up and down, the fluctuation of his entire body was in accordance with Dudian’s heart rate.
After the cold insect plasma was injected into Dudian’s right arm, the cold air spread and spread to the right side of his chest. But soon, the spread of the cold ice quickly retreated. At this moment, Dudian’s skin had turned blue, moreover, the color was gradually dark. It was purple near his chest and abdomen. Some parts were even black. This was not a tanned skin color, but a pure black that could absorb light.
Thump!
Thump!
Dudian’s heartbeat seemed to be coming from his chest. It was as if a sledgehammer was hammering his chest.
Crimson Moon clenched her teeth. She could feel that Dudian was holding on to a struggling life form. If it wasn’t for her special pupil.., she even suspected that the Aragami heart that was replaced by Dudian had evolved into a separate life form.
After the injection of the cold insect plasma, the heartbeat of the Aragami was once again vigorous and stronger than before.
Crimson Moon immediately ordered people to continue the injection.
After five bottles of cold insect plasma were injected into Dudian’s body, the heartbeat rate gradually increased. It seemed that the cold insect plasma could no longer restrain the strong heartbeat.
“Your Highness, this won’t do. His body simply can not fit. If this continues, his body will completely decompose!”An old man who seemed to be in a high position said.
Scarlet Moon clenched her teeth. How could she not know this? But the experiment had come to this point. was she really going to give up?
At this time, the skin around Dudian’s chest was rapidly rotting. The chest that Scarlet Moon was holding had become soft like mud.
She was angry but she held back. She quickly took out the scalpel and cut open Dudian’s chest. This action was much more rough than before. She had just cut off his ribs, she saw two purplish-black tentacles suddenly reach out and wrap around her wrist.
She was slightly startled. The next moment she felt the blood rushing out from her wrist. The purplish-black tentacles were like leeches. They reached into her wrist and sucked her blood!
Her face was ugly. She quickly dug her palm into Dudian’s chest. At this moment she didn’t have time to care about the damage to Dudian’s body. The latter was already a waste, she was worried that she wouldn’t lose the Aragami’s heart. After all, she only had two Aragami Hearts. One belonged to Sylvia and the other belonged to the Aragami that was worshipped by Amelia tribe.
When the Aragami Heart was taken out, it had already changed greatly. It was no longer the oval-shaped heart from before. Instead, it was a purplish-black ball that was filled with tentacles. It looked like a sea urchin, but its tentacles were longer than the thorns on the surface of the sea urchin. Moreover, it was soft.., it kept swinging, as if it had its own life.
Looking at this strange heart, the old man and Crimson Moon felt a chill run down their spines. Sylvia had already died a long time ago, but her heart was not dead yet. Moreover, it was actually hiding such vigorous vitality!
Was this the life force of a God? !
Crimson Moon took a deep breath and quickly pulled out the purplish-black tentacle that was wrapped around her wrist, throwing the heart that was constantly writhing to the old man beside her. “Keep it well, seal it!”
The old man quickly caught it with a container and sealed it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1002
chapters.content:
Chapter 1002 – Chapter 992: Waste
After sealing the heart of the Aragami, the old men and Crimson Moon looked at dudian who was lying on the metal table. His chest was torn and his ribs were broken. The tissues in his chest were scattered, previously, Crimson Moon was in a hurry to take out the heart of the Aragami. She didn’t care about Dudian’s body so his body looked broken. His vitality was getting weaker and weaker.
The experiment failed.
The old men’s faces were ugly. They didn’t dare to breathe. They didn’t dare to ask Crimson Moon for fear that she would vent her anger on them.
Crimson Moon stared at Dudian who was on the verge of death. She was silent for a long time before she slowly said: “You can leave first.”
The few of them respectfully took their leave as if they had been granted amnesty. One of them looked at Dudian who was on the metal table, he carefully said: “Your Highness, since he is a failed product, we can use waste to transform him into an undead or remove his organs and transfer him to another…”
“Get out.”Crimson Moon calmly said.
The man stopped and didn’t dare to say anything. He bowed his head and respectfully said goodbye. He and the others hurriedly left the laboratory.
After they left, only crimson moon and the unconscious dudian were left in the laboratory. Crimson Moon quietly looked at dudian. She suddenly thought of something. She tilted her head and looked at Dudian’s heart on the tray. At the moment, the beat of the heart had slowed down. It would expand once every four to five seconds, every time it expanded, blood would spurt out from the blood vessels next to the heart.
Compared to the heart of the Aragami, Dudian’s heart was completely different. It had only been taken out for a short period of time but it could no longer hold on.
Scarlet Moon looked at Dudian’s broken chest. The previous movement was too big. It had damaged many organs, especially the heart. The surrounding tissues were either devoured by the Aragami’s heart or torn apart by her, it was impossible to repair it in a short period of time.
This man’s vitality had come to an end..
The corner of Crimson Moon’s mouth twitched. If Dudian was just a simple experiment, she would have abandoned him. But after reading Dudian’s memory and knowing all his thoughts, Crimson Moon knew how difficult it was for this man to reach his current position and achievements. He had endured a lot of pain and suffering.
She also knew his ideal. He wanted to be a hero when he was young. He wanted to live a peaceful life when he grew up. Later on, he hoped that he could control his own life. But in the end, he couldn’t do it.
This ideal was so great and so humble!
If the experiment was successful, she would personally help him to complete his ideal. But if it failed… failure meant that everything didn’t exist. Everything lost its meaning!
“You didn’t give up in prison. You didn’t give up in the face of the splitter. You didn’t give up in the face of the invincible monster… Unfortunately, your luck is too bad!”Crimson Moon whispered to herself, there was a trace of sadness in her eyes. She slowly bent down and stretched out her small snow-white hand to touch Dudian’s cheek.
Although he was in a coma, Dudian’s eyebrows were still slightly wrinkled. It seemed that there were a lot of troubles gathering in his eyebrows.
Crimson Moon felt sorry, sympathy, and loss. She wanted to accompany him to become a god, but you… didn’t live up to expectations!
She gently kissed his forehead and sighed. When she raised her body, the regret on her face had disappeared. There was a bit of coldness in her eyes. She simply treated the wound on Dudian’s chest, she put the broken internal organs back into place and sewed the surface. She called the assistant outside and ordered: “Send it to the freezer. We will use it in the future.”
The old men nodded as if they had expected it. The freezer was the place where all the previous failed products were kept. Those failed products that had no value were abandoned, they were directly abandoned on the mountain of corpses.
“Your Highness, this heart?”
“Seal and freeze it.”
“Yes.”
The few old men quickly got busy. They sealed Dudian’s heart and moved it along with his body. They sent it to the last underground cold storage of all the laboratories. The temperature in the cold storage was extremely low and filled with cold air, it was like a mortuary. There were strange corpses lying on metal beds. Most of them were human shaped but they were incomplete. Some of them were half-human and half-beast. Some of them had human heads but their bodies were twisted, it was disgusting.
The few old men found an empty metal bed and carried Dudian to the other beds. They put his heart into a safe-like cabinet and locked it.
The old men escaped from the freezer. It was too cold inside. They felt that their bodies were frozen, it wouldn’t take long for Dudian to do the same.
However, they didn’t have any pity for the failures. The failures were rubbish and worthless. Even though Dudian was once a strong man who ruled over Sylvia but in their eyes.., at the moment he was just a failed experiment. Moreover he had lost his life and only his organs were left with research value.
“Your Highness, are we going to use experiment No. 3 as the final material?”The few old men went back to the laboratory. They saw crimson moon calmly sitting in front of the instrument to examine the Aragami’s heart.
Experiment Number Three was the best experiment that they had found in the past few months. It was second only to Dudian. He was a witcher and had ice blood disease. Moreover he had awakened his bloodline. His body was special and his adaptability was very strong, it was very likely that he could be used to cultivate into a god.
Crimson Moon slightly looked up and glanced at the few of them, she indifferently said: “There is no hurry. This experiment has failed. Go back and find the reason. Tomorrow you will hand the report to me. I will solve the problem of the final experiment. There will be a more suitable experiment than him to replace him. We must learn from this lesson. Next time we must not make mistakes. Otherwise, you will be used as experiment materials!”
The old men’s faces changed. They nodded as if they were pecking rice.
At the same time, the cold air spread over the corpses in the freezer. Dudian’s fingers and hair were covered with thin ice.
The extreme cold was like a burning flame.
Dudian slowly woke up from the pain. Before he opened his eyes, he felt cold all over his body. He felt dizzy as if he had drunk five kilograms of wine. He wanted to open his eyes but his eyelids were heavy, he barely opened his eyes and saw the world covered in white mist.
After a long time, his vision was clear and he could see his surroundings clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1003
chapters.content:
Chapter 1003 – Chapter 993: Coming
There were frozen corpses in the room. Dudian felt as if he was lying in the morgue. He looked at the pain and saw a huge scar on his chest. It was from his neck down to his abdomen. It was obvious that he had been in a coma for a long time, how much had his body been dissected.
He frowned and focused. A dark golden light appeared in his pupils. His gaze penetrated the skin of his body and saw the inside of his chest. He was stunned. Although he had some guesses, seeing the broken ribs and organs in his chest.., he could not help but feel disappointed. Moreover, he saw that his heart had disappeared. The place where his heart had been buried was now filled with broken tissue.
At this moment, waves of dizziness were transmitted over. Using the vision ability of the splitter’s magic marks, it accelerated the exhaustion of his physical strength. He saw that the blood in his body was stuck in all the blood vessels. There was no circulation. Waves of hypoxia made his vision go black, the vision ability soon lost its effectiveness. His chest was once again patched. He was unwilling to accept it, but he could not hold on any longer. Endless fatigue weighed down on him and he fainted again.
In the back hall of the palace, the various laboratories continued to operate. A large number of experiments were sent every day, dissecting, implanting, and dissecting bodies… one by one, corpses were carried out, and the same experimental data were sent to Crimson Moon’s office.
The experiments in the palace made the various organizations tremble with fear. Everyone was afraid. The wall was calm on the surface, but undercurrents were surging. The various forces were discussing in secret, unwilling to continue being exploited, but once the discussion reached the point of crusading against Crimson Moon.., every faction fell silent. No one was willing to go all out to pave the way for others. Furthermore, Crimson Moon’s power was like a huge mountain. Even if all the champions of every faction gathered together, they would not be able to shake her in the slightest.
The discussions and discord broke out again and again. Meanwhile, the experiment in the palace was still going on in full swing. Moreover, the experimental subjects that were needed were no longer just lowly commoners. More and more of them involved nobles.., high-level warriors of the Witcher family and so on.
No one noticed that a figure quietly flew over from outside the giant wall of Sylvia. He was tall and sturdy, with six pairs of black wings on his back. His dark feathers seemed to reflect dark light under the sunlight.
His gaze moved from a map scanner that looked like a single soldier combat system on his arm to the towering giant wall in front of him. The corner of his pale mouth curled into an arc as he slowly flew over.
Half a month passed.
The second official scale deity creation experiment was held. Crimson Moon personally operated the knife, using experiment number three. This was a direct descendant of the Rock clan of the Witcher family, the younger brother of the new Patriarch. His talent was extremely high, he was once a popular figure among the younger generation of the wall. He was highly sought after by the young ladies of noble families, and was the idol in the hearts of countless warriors. However, at this moment, his head was shaved off, and his face was Haggard as he lay in front of Crimson Moon’s scalpel, his handsome face was a little thin, and he no longer had the arrogance he once had. There was only loneliness, fear, and despair left.
“No, don’t…”the young man’s lips moved slightly. He wanted to beg for mercy, but his voice was already hoarse.
Crimson Moon smiled sweetly, and the entire world seemed to brighten a little. She gently held the young man’s face and said softly, “My dear, believe me, you will become the first God in this world!”
“B * Tch…”the youth clenched his teeth and squeezed out two words.
The smile on Crimson Moon’s face disappeared. She slightly frowned and suddenly found that the same thing that was used on Dudian was not applicable to this person. She had modified his memory. She was the woman he loved the most, he was the music genius that he had been pursuing. But now, in the face of life and death, he had retreated. The oath that he had made in his heart was as weak as white paper.
It turned out that not all emotions could withstand the test of life and death..
She sighed softly and reached out to press his forehead.
The young man struggled slightly, but soon, his eyes rolled back as if he had fainted and his body stiffened.
A moment later, when Crimson Moon removed her hand, he still had not woken up. However, Crimson Moon did not seem to have any intention of waiting. Her expression had already returned to its icy cold expression. “Prepare to be anesthetized.”
The few old men around knew that the experiment had begun, so they immediately perked up. They did not doubt that what Crimson Moon had said the last time was just words spoken in anger.
Two hours later.
In the incomparably quiet laboratory, only the sound of instruments colliding could be heard. Crimson Moon and the few old men had solemn expressions on their faces as they looked at the young man who had just entered the Aragami’s heart. Success or failure depended on this one move.
Pu!
Suddenly, a purplish-black limb shot out from the young man’s chest. He seemed to have sensed the figure standing beside the metal table and immediately stretched out towards the old man who was closest to him.
The old man was so frightened that his face turned pale. He hurriedly retreated, but the purplish-black limb was extremely fast. In an instant, it wrapped around his arm. Very quickly, his arm withered at a speed visible to the naked eye, this withered trend extended from his wrist all the way to his elbow and arm.
Pu! An old man reacted quickly and chopped off his arm with a knife. A gray arm that was as shriveled as skin and bones was flung away by the purple-black limb like a withered flower stalk that had lost its nutrients. Then, it turned around and rushed toward Crimson Moon.
Crimson Moon’s face was gloomy. A silver light flashed between her fingers, and the young man’s chest was cut open. The situation inside was extremely horrifying. The ribs in his chest were all gone, and all his organs had disappeared, only a lump of purplish-black wriggling flesh was filled inside.
With a whoosh, Crimson Moon threw out both her hands at the same time. Silver light flashed on her fingertips, and the dark purplish flesh in the young man’s chest had just reached out a few tentacles and shot toward crimson moon when the entire lump of flesh suddenly bounced up and escaped from the young man’s chest, then, it was gently carried by an invisible force. With a bang, it smashed into the huge container that had been prepared by the side. ka, it was sealed shut.
Bang! Bang!
The dark purple blood clot turned inside out. It reached out and hit the container. It shook slightly.
The old men’s faces turned pale. They didn’t expect the experiment to fail again. Moreover the rebound was faster than the last time. Dudian was able to hold on for a while. Moreover the speed of the Aragami’s heart was clearly visible, but this time there was such a big change. This was the result of half a month’s experiment. Was it because of the difference in physique?
Crimson Moon looked at the Aragami Heart in the container and her gaze landed on the young man’s chest. After taking out the Aragami Heart, his chest was empty, leaving only a layer of skin, furthermore, the layer of fat inside the skin was purple in color. It was obvious that it was infected by the Aragami factor.
Meanwhile, the young man had already stopped breathing. His expression was frozen with fear and struggle. His mouth was slightly open like a statue.
“Throw it away.”Crimson Moon retracted her gaze and said indifferently. Her expression was very calm, and there was no anger after the failure of the experiment. However, the more this was the case, the more the few old men felt a chill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1004
chapters.content:
Chapter 1004 – Chapter 994: Crimson Moon’S Counterattack
Clap Clap Clap!
At this moment, a burst of applause suddenly sounded.
Who was gloating?
A few old men suddenly turned around and glared at him, but the anger in their eyes was immediately replaced by astonishment. They saw a tall figure like a demon god slowly flying over from outside the hall, and twelve dark wings flapped gently, the curved horns on the top of his head and his cold face were exactly the same as the image of a demon in the legends. It was simply a deliberate fabrication of the image of a demon!
A powerful aura enveloped the entire laboratory. The few old men with average physiques found it difficult to breathe. Their eyes were filled with incomparable shock.
Crimson Moon looked at the figure that suddenly arrived. There was a trace of shock on her face, but it was quickly withdrawn. However, she was still caught by the person who came. Hence, the smile on her face became even more intense.
“You’re NOT DEAD!”Crimson Moon’s face was gloomy, and her fingers were quietly clenched.
“With just the three of them, it’s still a little difficult to kill me.”The person who had arrived was Bo Luo, who had been surrounded by the three kings. At this moment, he had a smile on his face as he glanced at Crimson Moon’s tightly clenched hands, he smiled faintly and said, “My dear, obedient daughter, you’ve been away for so long. Do You Miss Daddy?”
Daddy? The few old men were stunned. They looked at each other, feeling that they could not understand the situation.
Crimson Moon spat and said coldly, “Don’t put on a show with these disgusting words. How did you find this place? Could it be that I have a GPS device on me?”
Bolo smiled faintly. “You’re indeed my smartest daughter. If I didn’t have a trick up my sleeve and hid another GPS device in your body, I’m afraid that you would have really shaken me off.”
Crimson Moon revealed an expression of “As expected.”Her eyes moved and she suddenly asked, “This thing is installed in the uranium ring?”
“Smart.”Boro looked at her approvingly. Then, he glanced at the huge laboratory and chuckled. “Why? Do you want to inherit my experiment and complete my god-creation plan?”
Crimson Moon touched the uranium ring embedded in her neck. She could not remove this thing. Otherwise, the Aragami factor would immediately invade her brain and she would lose herself. She took a deep breath and said: “As your daughter, shouldn’t you inherit your ideals?”
“Unfortunately, you are not good enough. The conditions of this experiment are good. There is an 80% success rate but you failed.”Boro shook his head to express his regret and disappointment.
Crimson Moon’s eyes narrowed: “You have been here for a long time?”
“It has been a while.”Boro said: “Where is the idiot who was kidnapped by You?”
Crimson Moon frowned. She knew that Boro was referring to Dudian. She didn’t know why but she felt a bit uncomfortable when she heard others insult Dudian. The latter was useless in her eyes.
“He is dead. His body can not withstand the heart of the Aragami.”Crimson Moon calmly said.
Boro replied with a trace of regret: “What is the reason? You should have experimented many times. Why did you make a mistake? This should be a very low level mistake!”
“His body’s adaptability is still not enough.”Crimson Moon looked at Boro, who was fearless and did not rush to attack. Similarly, she was not in a hurry to attack either, even though their auras were locked onto each other, however, on the surface, they seemed to be discussing academic research as if they were friends, “After the Aragami’s heart was implanted, the balance of ice and fire in his body was broken. His body was unable to restrain the power of the Aragami’s heart. Perhaps this heart is too powerful. In the past, I was only focused on selecting an experimental subject, but I neglected to study the power of this heart. It should not be something that a normal human body can withstand.”
“Oh? Does that mean that only a king can adapt to this heart?”Boro asked with interest.
Crimson Moon said indifferently, “Perhaps.”
“Sir, please…”an old man saw that the two were talking about the experiment and didn’t seem to be enemies, so he immediately said obsequiously. Number Three’s experiment had failed, and they could be killed by Crimson Moon at any time. If they could please this middle-aged man.., they might be able to keep their lives.
However, before he could finish his words, his body suddenly stiffened. A vertical mark appeared on his forehead, and blood slowly gushed out. Then, more and more blood gushed out, and his body fell straight to the ground.
Behind him, Crimson Moon raised her slender little hand, holding a black feather between her fingertips. The previous attack seemed to be aimed at killing the old man, but in fact, it was aimed at her.
“There are too many nosy ants.”Bolo glanced at Crimson Moon’s tightly held black feather indifferently. “It’s been a few months, and your strength has improved quite a bit. Or perhaps, you already have this kind of power?”
Crimson Moon released the feather and looked at him coldly. “Since you’ve already come, there’s no need to say so much. It’s either you die or I die. But even if I lose, my body will not become your experiment!”
Bolo smiled lightly. With a whoosh, his body suddenly disappeared. In the next moment, he suddenly appeared half a meter in front of Crimson Moon. He raised his hand and reached out, as fast as lightning.
Crimson Moon’s pupils constricted. She looked at the large hand that was quickly reaching out. She felt as if the entire world was shrinking. Her body seemed to be pulled over by the large hand. She gritted her silver teeth and the tip of her tongue bled. The pain caused her cerebral cortex to heat up, her body retreated rapidly, instantly distancing herself from Bolo.
“Huh?”Bolo’s gaze moved slightly, and he was a little surprised. “The Lord of the Abyss?”
Crimson Moon panted slightly, and she felt as if her entire body was overflowing with cold sweat. She stared at Bolo, not saying a word. She was afraid that the momentum she had accumulated would be broken by her words, so she only focused on being on guard against Bolo.
“I gave you your life, and I gave you your strength. Why would you betray me?”Bolo looked at her quietly.
Crimson Moon’s lips twitched slightly. She knew that Bolo was not deliberately trying to distract her by talking to her. With the latter’s arrogance, unless it was an extremely bad battle, he would not bother to use such a scheme.., she adjusted her breathing and said sarcastically, “You gave me my life, but that doesn’t mean that you can trample on it as you please. You gave me my power, but that doesn’t mean that I can’t control my own life!”
Bo Luo stared at her for a while and nodded slowly. “Alright!”
As soon as he finished speaking, his body disappeared once again, leaving only an extremely faint afterimage on the spot.
Crimson Moon’s pupils constricted, and her expression was a little flustered as she continued to retreat explosively.
Whoosh!
Bo Luo’s figure was like a ball of black gas, following closely behind her like a shadow as he closed in. The powerful aura made her feel her hands and feet go cold.
“Since you can’t be obedient, why not destroy…”Bolo’s gaze was extremely cold, without any emotion. He stretched out his large hand. It seemed extremely slow, but in fact, it was rapidly approaching Crimson Moon’s throat, about to strangle her!
Pu!
A silver light flashed, and blood splattered.
Crimson Moon’s body stopped. Bolo stopped as well, staring at her in a daze.
The panic and despair in Crimson Moon’s eyes completely disappeared, replaced by an incomparably cold killing intent. The broken hand that had twirled twice in the air slowly fell to the ground. It was Bolo’s hand.
“How could it be…”Bolo was a little in disbelief, but a sense of crisis instantly surged into his heart. Although he did not have time to think, his body had already leaped away quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1005
chapters.content:
Chapter 1005 – Chapter 995: Dark Domain
Whoosh!
A white beam of light shot up from the bottom and brushed past Bolo’s chin. A burning sensation burned his chin, and at the same time, he felt as if his nose was bleeding. He reached out to touch it, but he felt something sticky. He felt an intense pain, and when he looked down, his nose was gone. There were only two nostrils left, and fresh blood was gushing out from his nose.
“What is it?”Bolo’s pupils shrank. His vision could not catch the attack just now, only a remnant white light.
The unknown brought fear, and it was no exception for anyone.
Crack! Crack!
The bones in Bolo’s body shook violently, and his nails grew longer. Dark scales protruded from his body, covering his whole body like armor. There was a dark pattern of a silver cross in his eyes, which looked very strange.
When the distance between them increased, Bolo scanned his surroundings carefully. When he looked around, his expression changed slightly. He saw that the underground, walls, pillars, and other places in the hall were all made of metal, only the surface was covered with soil and rocks. Black holes with a diameter of about five centimeters appeared on the metal pieces inside. They were like small hand cannons from the old era, giving him a signal of danger.
“You expected me to come?”Bolo’s face darkened. This was a trap!
Crimson Moon looked at him coldly, “Do you think I don’t know what you did in the uranium ring? Although your actions were very covert, I learned a very reasonable saying not long ago, ‘If you don’t want others to know, don’t do it yourself.’although you were always on guard against me, among the failures that were buried in your hands, one person accidentally saw what you did, and I happened to search the memories of ‘them’When I was dealing with ‘them’!”
“No wonder…”the silver cross in Bolo’s eyes shot out a cold killing intent, “I knew you were a double-edged sword, but I didn’t expect you to be so sharp! You are doing experiments here and deliberately lured me here. Do you expect to use these things to defeat me?”
Crimson Moon said indifferently, “I thought you would fall at the hands of the three kings. I didn’t expect you to survive. I was just taking precautions. Fortunately, the Almighty God never mistreats those who are prepared.”
Bolo stared at her, his eyes flashing slightly. Since the latter had expected him to come, he was most likely well prepared. He understood her well. She had endured hardships for many years and was a cautious person. Naturally, she would not be careless here.
Although he believed that with his own strength, it was difficult for external objects to threaten him, he was different from other kings. He was familiar with the power of technology. No matter how powerful a king was, under a small technological weapon.., it was possible for him to be turned into ashes easily. Even the heavy weapon of the old era, the “Nuclear weapon”, was enough to annihilate all life on Earth. These were all technological weapons that could be created by mere mortals!
“Heh, you want to kill me with just these? Aren’t you too naive!”Bolo suddenly revealed a trace of a cold smile. His body leaned forward slightly and suddenly exerted force, pouncing forward like a phantom.
Crimson Moon looked at him coldly, not afraid at all.
A white light suddenly shot out from Bolo’s front, hitting the place where Bolo had passed by. Whoosh, it hit accurately, but… There was no blood!
Bolo’s body gradually dissipated after being hit. At the same time, an even faster phantom retreated rapidly and rushed out of the Hall!
In this instant, the forward sprint and reverse run were connected perfectly. Crimson Moon immediately understood that the latter’s words were just to confuse her. In fact, the attack was just a pretense, and he had not used his full strength in the sprint, only then could he retreat at an even faster speed.
Whoosh!
In an instant, he dashed to the front of the hall. Bolo’s body suddenly stiffened, and he almost fell down. At the same time, more than a dozen white lights shot out from the front. Bolo’s brain tensed up, and he felt blood rush to his head from all over his body, in this critical moment, he forcibly stopped his body. Whoosh, the white light swept past less than two centimeters in front of his body. It was just a little bit short of penetrating his body!
At this moment of pause, the hall door closed heavily, closing everyone in the laboratory.
However, today was the day of the final experiment for test subject number three. There were not many workers in the hall. They were mainly a few old men and a few assistants who listened to orders. At this moment, a few assistants were standing in the hall. They were dumbstruck and had blank looks on their faces.
“Electricity?”Bolo looked at the place he had passed by earlier. There was an invisible electromagnetic field in the air there. When he had passed by earlier, he had been struck by the high-intensity electric current, causing his entire body to be paralyzed. If not for his strong constitution.., he had been stuck on the spot, twitching and falling to the ground.
“You can’t get out anymore.”Crimson Moon’s cold voice came from behind him.
Boro glanced at the tightly shut door and slowly turned his head to look. Crimson Moon had already entered her demon body state. Sharp spider legs grew out of her body. There were yellow and black patterns on them, and her upper body was tall, her cheeks were whiter than before. They were like snow, becoming more exquisite, beautiful, and cold. She looked down at him like the Queen of spiders.
Boro noticed that there were very fine blood-red patterns on the edge of her spider leg patterns, giving off a strange temperature. This detail made his heart tremble. The latter was actually able to combine the energy of the dreamer demon body.., adding the energy of the other demon bodies, was this considered a combination of two demon bodies?
“You seem to know that I will make a move today,”Boro said with a slight squint. The high-voltage electric wall that had blocked his escape earlier was obviously prepared. He had not seen it when he had entered earlier.., moreover, this thing should have been activated by someone or by Crimson Moon herself, while they were talking earlier.
“I just didn’t expect you to be so obedient and really choose this day to come,”Crimson Moon said indifferently, “When you appeared earlier, you did not make a move directly. I knew that you were observing and waiting. You probably already knew from those idiots that I was going to carry out the experiment. Therefore, I knew that you definitely wanted to witness the birth of this miracle with your own eyes. As expected, you did not disappoint me.”
Boro’s mouth twitched: “Did you see me before?”
“Speaking of which, I learned the idea of the trap from Dudian’s memory. He used this trick to kill a large number of senior pioneers and even master them.”Crimson Moon looked at him indifferently, “Moreover, you are too ignorant. What you have seen and heard in the past is too small. Your lurking ability can indeed hide from my perception. But don’t forget that the power of technology is the greatest. A small life sensor can reflect your whereabouts. Hehe, the king is just so-so…”
It was the first time that Boro was called “Ignorant”. He suddenly felt that the DINA in front of him was a little different from the DINA he knew in the past. She had changed a lot. He had not noticed it in his previous observation, but now he found that.., her thinking, attitude, and temperament seemed to have changed greatly. He had only read about the word “Technology”in the books of the old era, and it was already outdated. The previous Dina did not even bother to say these two words, it was called Arcana.
But now, the way she said the word was very natural, including the look in her eyes.
He suddenly thought that she had read Dudian’s memory. Maybe she had the thinking of the old era!
He took a deep breath. Boro’s body changed again. The tightly covered scales suddenly loosened as if he was breathing. A large amount of black gas gushed out from his body, his wings flapped, and a gust of strong wind blew. The black gas filled the hall. Although it was blown away, and the area became larger, the color was not diluted, and everywhere it passed, it was pitch black!
This was his magic marks ability, and it was also his battle skill that was extremely famous in the empire, the dark domain!
It was this ability that allowed him to be invincible in a one-on-one fight in the empire, and was only countered by one person!
Whoosh!
Black gas quickly filled the entire hall. It was pitch black.
If someone with dark vision were here, they would also be surprised to discover that their night vision ability had completely disappeared.
This included people with heat perception who would also discover that they were unable to capture any heat source fluctuations from the darkness. All that was left was a darkness that had lost their vision. There was no light at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 1006
chapters.content:
Chapter 1006 – Chapter 996: Shatter
Crimson Moon felt as if all her senses had been taken away in an instant. She could neither see nor hear. All that was left in the world was darkness. Her body gradually became numb, as if it had been eroded by darkness. In this absolute silence of darkness, her body seemed to gradually disappear, leaving only her consciousness floating in the air. Perhaps her consciousness would eventually gradually disappear and fall into a deep sleep.
If it were any other person, they would have long fallen into panic. However, Crimson Moon was surprisingly calm. She only looked curiously at the darkness in front of her. Suddenly, her demonic body changed rapidly. Flames burned all over her body, covering her.., her body seemed to change shape in the flames. The fire of desire regenerated and she turned into a human-shaped burning man. The burning flames extended behind her in the shape of a dragon’s tail.
However, the fire in her vision flashed and disappeared. Soon, she fell into darkness again.
The fire dragon demon body was still unable to burn this dark domain.
Beside Crimson Moon who could not see or hear, a few old men were shrouded in darkness. Before they could feel the loss of vision, hearing, and other senses, they were stimulated by the burning pain from their bodies and let out painful screams.
However, they could not hear the screams themselves. They could only feel the screams coming from the depths of their souls.
In the dark, Boro’s figure flashed past the few old men without even looking at them. His dark domain was not as simple as simply depriving the enemies of their senses. There was a corrosive poison in the Black Fog.., the bodies of those below the Abyss would be corroded to the point that not even their bones would be left after staying here for an hour. The few old men were not even pioneers. As soon as their bodies were touched by the black fog, they melted quickly.
When Boro saw the Fire Dragon Demon body that Crimson Moon had activated, his eyes did not reveal any surprise. Instead, he sped up and rushed over. A pitch-black longsword had unknowingly appeared in his hand. It was like it was forged from a pure black gemstone, he suddenly lifted it up and a strong wind swept out. With a thunderous momentum, he slashed towards Crimson Moon.
Crimson Moon, who had entered the fire dragon demon body, still did not feel anything. Just as the blade was about to slash down, Boro suddenly felt an unusually dangerous signal coming from in front of him. The sword momentum in his hand paused slightly. The sword blade that was pressing down was raised up, however, he was still too slow. With a flash of white light, Bolo felt a burning pain on his wrist. The Black Longsword flew up, and a fingernail-long palm was still tightly held on the hilt of the sword.
In the next moment, Bolo suddenly felt a strong chill coming from all directions. His pupils constricted, and he hurriedly closed his wings to defend himself. However, in an instant, countless white lights appeared in his vision, completely filling up the dark world, his vision became a vast expanse of whiteness.
“How… can…”Boro felt his consciousness being stimulated by the white light until he was a little dizzy. Then, the dizziness became more and more intense, and he slowly closed his eyelids.
After an unknown amount of time, the black fog gradually faded, as if something was attracting them. It gathered toward the ground and turned into streaks of black gas, surging into the objects on the ground.
Crimson Moon’s vision, which had been deprived, slowly recovered. She looked towards the direction where the black gas was surging. Due to the cover of darkness, she could not see clearly what was on the ground. However, there were dozens of them, big and small.
After about ten minutes, the black gas was completely absorbed by the things on the ground. It also revealed that the things that were devouring the black gas were lumps of flesh and blood, as well as broken limbs!
Crimson Moon let out a sigh of relief and smiled. She glanced at the wriggling flesh and broken limbs on the ground, as well as the pierced wings. Obviously, this was Bolo’s body! Four to five meters in front of her, Bolo’s head was lying there. His head had been pierced through from below, and his head had been split into two halves. However, his brain did not spill out. Instead, it was attached to the inside of his skull and was still wriggling gently, it was like a wriggling earthworm.
Although she had expected it, Crimson Moon still took a light breath and sighed. What kind of tenacious vitality was this? No wonder kings were said to be existences that had already surpassed humans! However, even if they had surpassed the scope of human life, it did not mean that they could become gods!
At the thought of this, a trace of fire flashed in her eyes, and her desire for eternal life became even more enticing.
“Although your dark domain is strong, and with my ability, I have no way to break it, it doesn’t mean that there is nothing else in this world that can break it.”Crimson Moon stepped on the broken limbs and flesh around her, she came before the head of Boro, which had been split into two. Who would have thought that Boro, who had displayed his strongest killing move in a dignified manner, would be smashed into pieces in the blink of an eye.
“This is specially prepared for you. From the moment you stepped into this place, it was already destined to be the end.”Crimson Moon’s lips curled into an arc. This was a weapon that she had dismantled from the spaceship of the Amelia tribe, the beam of light particle waves that were released not only reached the speed of light, but their destructive power far surpassed that of a king’s attack. This was the power of technology. Even a king that had evolved to the level of a demon could not rely on his body to withstand it!
On the ground, Boro’s eyes slightly turned as he looked at Crimson Moon. There was no hatred in his eyes. Instead, he was surprisingly gentle. Half of his lips slightly moved but he couldn’t make any sound.
However, Crimson Moon had read Dudian’s memory and had long learned lip language. She slightly frowned when she saw what he said: “You have finally grown up.”
“Yes, I have indeed grown up.”Crimson Moon wasn’t sure if he was mocking her. Boro’s eyes made her feel uncomfortable. She bent down and picked up the two halves of Boro’s head, at the same time, a finger turned into a sharp blade and pressed on Boro’s forehead. It could pierce into Boro’s head at any time.
At this moment, a cracking sound could be heard from where Bolo’s head had broken off. The tissues in his head were quickly gluing together like countless tiny tentacles, intertwining with each other and completely filling up the gap, squeezing out all the excess air, the skin on his face was also quickly healing. In the blink of an eye, a complete head appeared.
This scene was extremely magical, but Crimson Moon was not surprised at all. She just stared at him. If he made any strange movements, she would take his life. Although only one head remained of Bolo, she was still fully alert.
“You’re very similar to her,”Bolo said slowly. His expression was exceptionally calm when his head was fully recovered, and there was even a hint of nostalgia. There was an unconcealable sadness and gentleness in the depths of his eyes, “It’s a pity that I won’t have the chance to resurrect her in this lifetime. If there really is a soul and heaven, I hope I can go and see her…”
Crimson Moon looked at him indifferently. She knew who the “She”he was referring to was. “I’m not her. I’m me. My new name is Crimson Moon.”
“Crimson Moon…”Bolo muttered. “Crimson Moon was born. Her name is Crimson Moon…”the corners of his mouth curled into a bitter smile, he sighed softly and said, “Indeed, you are not her. She would never treat me like this. She is gentler and kinder than anyone else…”
“There is no meaning in death,”Crimson Moon interrupted him, he said coldly, “Even if one is praised for their greatness after death, it is still better to trample all living beings under your feet when you are alive! “I only believe that the world I see now, Heaven and Hell, is just a ridiculous belief weapon created by the church to discipline mortals. “Without yearning, how can mortals fight? “Without fear, how can mortals restrain themselves? “Rather than hoping for that elusive thing, it’s better to grasp everything in your own hands and hold it tightly!”
Boro was slightly silent. After a long time, he slowly said, “You spared my life because you want to treat me as your experiment?”
Crimson Moon’s lips curled up slightly, “As expected of my good father. You are indeed the person who understands me the most. You are the best experiment that I have been looking forward to for a long time. Even the lucky person from the old era is not as good as you. I hope that you can give me a surprise!”
Boro’s expression had already returned to a cold and emotionless one. He said, “If you think that you can control me after I become a god, I don’t mind becoming the first God in this new world!”
Crimson Moon grinned. Her white teeth looked a little cold, “My Good Father, you will become a god. This is your dream. No matter what, I will help you achieve it. As for now, don’t even think about struggling with your broken limbs.”
After saying that, the broken limbs and pieces of flesh that were secretly squirming and gathering behind her suddenly pushed off the ground and attacked Crimson Moon’s back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1007
chapters.content:
Chapter 1007 – Chapter 997: Fragile
Whoosh!
Crimson Moon did not turn around, but flames suddenly swept out from behind her back, turning into a giant flaming palm. It smacked towards the broken limb and the sharp piece of meat that had transformed into a cone. Sizzling sounds could be heard, and the flaming palm seemed to have materialized, it smacked away Bo Luo’s broken limb, but a few sharp pieces of meat pierced into the palm. However, just as they entered the palm, they were instantly ejected.
The broken limbs, which had been riddled with injuries, were now charred black, and the sharp pieces of meat that were ejected had the smell of barbecued meat.
Crimson Moon smiled. “As expected of a former king. Although the extreme ice insect king’s consciousness was killed, its body still evolved to the level of a king. This kind of vitality is almost comparable to ‘them’.”
Bo Luo’s cold face had already changed. He suddenly opened his mouth, and his tongue shot out like a poisonous snake, pulling up extremely long, and instantly pounced toward Crimson Moon’s face. However, Crimson Moon seemed to have been prepared. When the bright red long tongue lapped over, a vigorous flame surged out from her body. It turned into four or five slender hands that quickly grabbed and pinched the long tongue. The flame seemed to have substance as it tightly pinched the long tongue, sizzling sounds of burning could be heard as the flame spread along the long tongue.
Bolo let out a miserable cry. He gritted his teeth and bit off his tongue. Fresh blood flowed out from the corner of his mouth.
The flaming palm casually flung the long tongue aside. Crimson Moon looked at Boro quietly, looking down on him like a queen who controlled life and death, she said indifferently, “After so many years of being together, your methods still haven’t improved.”
Boro stared at her and slowly took a deep breath. Suddenly, a relieved smile appeared on his face, “I knew you wouldn’t let me down. You Don’t need my protection anymore. I hope you… Can Live Well.”
Crimson Moon raised her eyebrows slightly. “What do you mean?”
Boro smiled. There was only kindness in his eyes. There was no pain or hostility.
Crimson Moon frowned slightly. Suddenly, the corner of her mouth curled up slightly. “Are you trying to say that you’re doing this just to nurture me with your deep feelings?”
Boro looked at her gently, “I knew long ago that she wouldn’t be able to come back. Although you’re not her, your appearance is hers. All of your genes were extracted from her body. In other words, your body is hers. At least this is enough. Protect this body well. This Way… my wish will be fulfilled.”
Crimson Moon fell into silence.
Bolo’s eyes were filled with love as he said softly, “Don’t be sad. My body will still be by your side in the future. Just This Alone is enough for me.”
Crimson Moon remained silent. Bolo only looked at her gently and did not speak anymore. It was as if he was looking at a child who had finally grown up. There was nostalgia, emotion, deep affection, and tender love.
After a long time, Crimson Moon raised her head slightly, as if she had woken up from her silent thoughts. When she saw Boro’s expression, she bit her lip slightly. There was some hesitation and hesitation on her face. When Boro was about to speak again, this expression suddenly disappeared, a smile hung on her face, causing Boro to be slightly startled.
“Is this the expression you want to see?”Crimson Moon looked at him with a smile.
Boro’s face changed slightly. “What?”
“You say it so affectionately. Are you trying to make me soft-hearted?”Crimson Moon smiled gently, “What a great story. You played the bad guy, gave everything, and finally died in the hands of your beloved. This really touched me. After all, I have her memories in my memories. Unfortunately, her memories are just fragments to me. Your understanding of the magic marks of the dreamer is only superficial. How could I, the user of the magic marks, understand it?”
Bolo was stunned and his face turned ugly. “You deleted her memory?”
“Of course not.”Crimson Moon smiled, “This memory is filled with love for you. Although it didn’t affect my subjective consciousness, it did affect me. That’s why I couldn’t bear to do it. I didn’t delete it. I know that my love is affected by the memory, but I still didn’t do it. Sometimes knowing doesn’t mean I can do it. This is probably love.”
“Then why did you betray me?”Boro seemed to heave a sigh of relief, and then he looked at her with eyes full of pain.
Crimson Moon could not help but smile, “If you were really the good guy who played the bad guy in the story, I would be really touched. Unfortunately, you’re not. You’re just a bad guy through and through. I know you too well, maybe even better than you know yourself. If your initial obsession was to resurrect her, then later, when you became more and more desperate, your obsession had long changed. You just wanted to become a god and satisfy yourself. People will always change. No matter how good your feelings are, no matter how hard you persevere, in front of time and inflated desires, they are as weak as paper.”
“You’re talking nonsense!”Bolo roared furiously.
Crimson Moon shook her head. “When I saw through you, even if she existed in my memories, I had already lost my love for you. You’re not worthy!”After saying that, she did not wait for Bolo to speak, the sharp thorn that was pressed against his forehead suddenly pierced in.
Bolo’s face trembled. He was as stiff as a statue, and his eyes rolled back.
After a long time..
Crimson Moon suddenly opened her eyes and shook Boro’s head off. Her eyes were full of pain. She hugged her head and squatted down.
..
..
Dark and cold.
Dudian felt like mud. His body was soaked in the deep water. He was shivering. His vision was dark and he couldn’t see the end. He couldn’t see the border. There was no time but he could feel that a long time had passed, a long time.
Was this the world after death?
Was he going to linger here for countless years?
If so, he would rather lose his consciousness.
As time went by, the long wait made him feel boring, lonely, painful, and fearful.
When his mind was about to collapse, he suddenly felt the bone-chilling cold gradually fade away. Not long after, he felt a warmth. This warmth was just a feeling. He couldn’t say where he felt the warmth, because he could not feel the existence of his body at all.
After a long time, he slowly heard a faint gurgling sound, like the flow of water in a small stream.
Not long after, he suddenly heard a pleasant voice coming from an extremely far place. He could not hear it clearly, but he could vaguely hear two words, “AWAKE!”
At the same time, he suddenly saw a ray of light that illuminated the darkness. It was extremely dazzling. He subconsciously closed his eyes and wanted to raise his hand to block it. However, when the light still shone over without any obstruction.., his “Closed eyes”had no effect.
At this moment, he suddenly felt that the light was more uncomfortable than the darkness. It turned out that after staying in the darkness for a long time, the light had become something that could hurt him.
The dazzling light gradually became gentle. At this time, Dudian saw a few fuzzy faces in his line of sight. They were familiar faces: Barton, Neuss, Aurora.
Dudian was relieved to see them. Neuss loosened his fingers. He pulled Dudian’s eyelids.
Dudian slightly turned his eyes and looked around. He found that the surrounding light was not strong. It was a dim room which was similar to the room in the dark fortress, he saw a short teenager standing behind Neuss. It was samba who was helping him to check his body in the laboratory in the back of the palace.
Samba’s face was full of tension. It was mixed with excitement and joy. He didn’t know where to put his hands.
Dudian understood what happened in an instant. He smiled: “Did You Bring Me Out?”
Neuss and Barton stepped aside and let Samba stand in front of dudian.
Samba was nervous and excited. He nodded: “Teacher, she had an important experiment today. She didn’t have time to take care of the cold storage. I took the opportunity to secretly transport you out.”
Dudian smiled: “In the Blink of an eye, you have grown so big. You even gave me the name of Samba. I almost didn’t recognize you, Edward.”
Samba smiled, “They also said that I have changed a lot. It is natural that the teacher didn’t recognize me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1008
chapters.content:
Chapter 1008 – Chapter 998: Conclusion
“Young master, it’s all thanks to samba that we’ve been able to hide in the dark fortress all these years.”Noyce’s attitude was respectful and he had a smile on his face, “Ever since you left, we’ve all changed our names. Samba used this new identity to display his outstanding talent in Divine Arts. He was nurtured by the Monasteries and the Monster Research Institute. Through this, he spread his network and provided us with a very convenient channel to do things in secret.”
They were used to calling Edward “Samba”. His name was like a fleeting cloud that was forever buried in the darkness.
“No, my aptitude is dull. The teacher taught me the Divine Arts. I haven’t completely understood it.”Samba smiled and scratched his head.
Dudian smiled. He couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. Who would have thought that a random student would save his life and give so much help to Neuss and the others.
“There is no end to the divine arts. You are good enough.”Dudian encouraged.
Samba nodded: “There is no end to learning. Teacher, you said that Samba has always kept it in mind!”
Dudian nodded as he looked down at his chest. There was a golden light in his eyes. Everything under his chest was revealed. He sighed as the golden light in his eyes dimmed down. He looked up at the crowd, he slowly said: “I don’t have much time left. I can send you to God’s kingdom or other giant walls before I leave. It is too dangerous for you to stay here. My body is gone. She will definitely find you. Do you want to go to other giant walls or God’s Kingdom?”
Everyone was stunned. Their eyes were wide open, noyce hurriedly said: “Young Master, don’t be discouraged. We will definitely be able to get through this difficult situation. In the past, we have persevered through dangerous situations. In Thorn Flower Prison, you are the first person who can escape. What is this? At worst, we can leave this place. The world is so big. Is there no place for us?”
“Yes, yes. Master, you can’t Give Up!”
“Dean, you weren’t so easy to admit defeat in the past.”
Barton and Mason also tried to persuade him.
Dudian didn’t answer. Samba suddenly thought of something and looked at Dudian in surprise: “Teacher, you… you didn’t…”he had been working in the palace for several months, samba had long known that Crimson Moon had the ability to read and modify memories. He had met several masters from the Institute of Magic and she had read their memories. She had even modified their memories, he had become a loyal servant.
On the eve of the experiment, he had seen Dudian and Crimson Moon. He knew that his memories had been modified. He thought that he could use force to keep Dudian and slowly help him get back his original memories, he didn’t expect that Dudian didn’t have the intention to find Crimson Moon immediately. Instead, he took them away. It was clear that he was hostile!
Dudian smiled: “Her memory was modified. She did it but she didn’t succeed.”
Neuss and others looked at him and samba in confusion. They didn’t know what they were talking about but didn’t interrupt.
“Why?”Samba was also puzzled. He knew that the ability to read memories was very brutal. He had always expressed his loyalty because he was worried that his memory would be read, crimson Moon would know his identity and all his plans would be in vain. He would even implicate dudian. He had thought of a way to resist Crimson Moon’s ability. But in the end he couldn’t think of a solution!
He couldn’t figure out how Dudian did it. He could only say that a teacher is a teacher and your Grandpa Will Always Be Your Grandpa!
“A little hypnotic trick.”Dudian smiled, “It is not unsolvable to read the memory. In fact, there are many flaws. Hypnosis is only one of the methods to control it. Although she knew that I wanted to hypnotize her when she read the memory, but this is only the memory that I deliberately passed to her. It is also the medium to start the hypnosis. In other words, I first hypnotized myself and used the memory of the hypnotized myself as the medium. In turn, I hypnotized her. When she reads my memory, she will trigger the medium and be hypnotized by me.”
He spoke in a roundabout way but samba understood what he was saying. He was aware of the stakes involved. He looked at Dudian in disbelief, this man had broken the unsolvable ability!
The man who was once a genius of the holy church was now so powerful and unfathomable!
Neuss and Barton could barely understand Dudian’s words. They looked at Dudian in astonishment. They didn’t expect that Dudian could find a flaw in such a terrifying enemy.
“Hypnosis and reverse hypnosis…”samba muttered to himself. Hypnosis wasn’t a rare skill but he didn’t think about it. Occasionally he would think of it, but once he considered the ability of crimson moon to read memories and understand all thoughts, he dismissed the idea. He thought that hypnosis was useless but Dudian had to find another way. He first hypnotized himself and then hypnotized Crimson Moon.
If memory was a roll of tape, then Dudian would play the tape from yesterday and fold it onto today’s tape. So the memory that Crimson Moon saw was from the day before yesterday to yesterday, without today’s memory, it was impossible for Crimson Moon to observe dudian’s memory from the beginning to the end. Otherwise, Dudian’s step by step ideas and hypnotic means would be seen through.
“Although reading memory is powerful, but it is also a double-edged sword.”Dudian slowly said: “There are many possibilities. If reading memory is considered as a kind of eating, then you should know that eating anything has the possibility of poisoning. Hypnosis is not considered as poison. It can only be considered as chewing a grain of sand. With her willpower, it is almost impossible to completely hypnotize her and maintain a permanent effect.”
Samba nodded. He felt that Dudian’s words were not to teach him how to solve the problem, but to tell him how to think in the face of the problem.
“Teacher, why don’t you hypnotize her? Even if it’s just for a moment, you can take the opportunity to kill her!”Samba curiously asked. Although he knew that there must be a reason why Dudian didn’t do so, but he couldn’t think of the reason.
Dudian smiled, “Her will and vigilance are stronger than we imagined. If I hypnotize her and change her original thoughts, she will immediately notice. I can only slightly change her original thoughts. For example, I hypnotized her so that she thinks that she has modified my memory.”
Samba suddenly understood, “In fact, she didn’t change it. But teacher hypnotized her. She thinks that she has changed it. No wonder she didn’t notice it. Sometimes I want to do something but I don’t do it. But in my heart, I mistakenly think that I have done it. This is a very normal reaction and also a deviation of memory. As long as I hypnotize her, I can hide it.”
Dudian looked at him approvingly, “Not bad.”
He wanted to hypnotize more but he felt that Crimson Moon had read his memory. His willpower was extraordinary. In the end, he chose to gently move a bit. This was the safest way.
“Master, since you have used hypnosis to avoid the disaster, why did you say that you don’t have much time left? While she is busy with experiments, she has no time to pay attention to us. We can leave this place immediately!”Barton couldn’t help but say.
Dudian sighed and shook his head slightly.
Samba saw Dudian’s expression and seemed to think of something. His face slightly changed and became silent.
Neuss, Mason and others saw Samba’s reaction. They knew that he knew some secrets. After all, he had been working in the laboratory of the Royal Palace.
“Samba, what is going on?”Neuss didn’t ask Dudian but asked Samba in a deep voice.
Samba’s body slightly trembled as he looked up at dudian. There was sadness in his eyes but he quickly thought of something, “Teacher, your heart is gone. How did you survive? No, I, I mean, since you can survive, can we…”
His words were incoherent and people didn’t know what he was trying to say. But Neuss, Mason and others heard the first sentence and their minds went blank. They stared at Dudian in a daze.
His heart was gone?
How could it be!
How could he survive without a heart?
But when they thought of the Crimson Moon who was pierced through the chest by the holy light wave, their ability to accept things had become much stronger. Although Samba was a teenager, he rarely made mistakes.
Dudian smiled. He was not disappointed or depressed. On the contrary, he was calm beyond imagination. He had experienced so many setbacks and ups and downs recently. Moreover, he had lost Aisha. His mentality had changed a lot, he was more indifferent to things. Moreover, he was more aware of the changes in his body than anyone else. To be honest, he already felt that it was very magical to be able to live and talk.
He didn’t expect such a broken body to be able to live a meaningful life. He continued to pursue things that were out of his reach.
“Although I don’t know the reason, but I shouldn’t be able to live for long.”Dudian smiled, he comforted him: “My Heart was taken away by Crimson Moon. But it seems that there is a small organ in the original position of the heart. It is barely able to replace the role of the heart. In addition, I used the dragon blood technique to control the amount of blood in my body. It has reduced my vital signs and reduced the burden of the heart. So I am barely able to live. But this is only temporary. It Won’t be long.”
Neuss, Mason, Barton and others gaped as they looked at him.
If it wasn’t for Dudian’s calm eyes, they would have suspected that Dudian was joking with them. However, the current atmosphere was obviously not suitable for joking. Everyone slowly accepted Dudian’s words, however, their mood became extremely complicated and uncomfortable.
“Is there no other way? Since your body has created other organs to replace the heart, then as long as you take care of your body, you will definitely survive!”Neuss wanted to encourage Dudian, however, he felt that his words were a bit pale. He knew nothing about Dudian’s situation. He didn’t know many things.
Dudian shook his head. He didn’t want to talk about this matter anymore. He also hoped that this organ would always exist and be perfected to completely replace the heart. However, he could feel the changes in his body, it wasn’t his own flesh and blood but the flesh of the Aragami mixed with part of his own flesh and blood!
Perhaps this was caused by the terrifying vitality of the Aragami factor.
He didn’t know if the organ would gradually devour his body after it grew up. Sooner or later he would have to remove the uranium ring on his neck. He suspected that the thing that Crimson Moon had implanted into his body was hidden in the uranium ring.
Other than the uranium ring, which his X-ray vision could not penetrate, he had checked every part of his body. He could not find the fatal device that Crimson Moon had mentioned.
Without the resistance of the uranium ring, the Aragami factor would corrode his brain. With the uranium ring, he would fall into Crimson Moon’s hands again. This was a dead end with no choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009
chapters.content:
Chapter 1009 – : Chapter 999: Leave [ First Watch ]
The atmosphere in the room was gloomy. Dudian broke the silence and asked samba: “How long have I been in a coma? How is the situation in the palace?”
Samba woke up from his thoughts and quickly replied, “Teacher, you have been in a coma for twenty-six days since you entered the freezer. Half a month after you were unconscious, that woman conducted another experiment. She used the third experimental subject with the most unique circumstances, but in the end, she still failed. “However, on the day of the experiment, I heard that an extremely terrifying person had barged into the palace. The few masters who assisted her in the experiment were all dead. They were never seen again. That terrifying expert also did not come out. The laboratory has always been sealed. I and the other researchers did not have the chance to enter.”
“The laboratory was opened two days ago. She called us to continue the experiment. Today we are using the newest breed of Witcher from the Witcher Dragon Clan. It is said that their bloodline is extremely high. So today’s experiment is very grand. I and other researchers have been sent out. There are only a few masters from the Monster Institute who are assisting us.”
“A terrifying expert?”Dudian frowned as he heard samba’s words: “Is she an expert of the Hunter Family?”
Samba shook his head, “No, the Hunter family has long submitted to her. It is impossible for them to attack her. Moreover that person is very powerful. None of the guards outside the palace were able to stop him. All of them were killed. These guards are the highest guards of the desolate family. Their strength is comparable to the peak of the inner wilderness. It is difficult to kill them even if you are a master. It is very likely that the person is from outside the giant wall.”
“Outside the giant wall? Abyss Walker?”Dudian’s eyes flickered, it was possible for an expert to directly attack the center of power within the giant wall. But there was something strange about it. The wandering outside the giant wall should know that every giant wall had an abyss, why was the other side so confident that they could directly attack the enemy’s nest?
“Is this news true?”Dudian was a bit doubtful.
“It should be true.”Samba hesitated but didn’t dare to guarantee, “Although I didn’t see it with my own eyes but many people on duty saw it. The Maids and guards who were waiting outside the hall were also witnesses. I asked them and found that the situation was almost the same. The description of the body of the expert was almost the same. He said that he was like the fallen angel in the myth. He had twelve wings and was very tall.”
“Twelve wings?”Dudian’s pupils shrank as the image of the devil appeared in his mind. He wasn’t Dead? Moreover he had found this place? How could he know about the giant wall of Sylvia?
They had crossed over half of the empire and every time they set off they would erase the traces. He couldn’t believe that Bolo had tracked them through his super perceptive ability! If he didn’t rely on his own ability then could it be… location? !
Dudian thought about the location device hidden by the Shenluo Empire’s border guards. He felt that it should be like this. One of them must be Bolo’s location device. Perhaps both of them had it in their bodies!
Uranium ring!
Dudian immediately thought of the thing under his neck. The only thing that could hide the location device was inside the uranium ring. After all his flesh and bones had been checked by X-ray, everything was normal.
He suddenly felt a chill in his heart. Bolo had their location device but it hadn’t appeared until not long ago. Moreover, it was in the image of the twelve wings. It meant that he had not only escaped from the encirclement of the three kings, moreover, his injuries were not serious.
The other party should have been able to catch up to them but had been secretly following them. Perhaps the other party had used them as bait and wanted to take advantage of them!
“The Three Kings didn’t die. I have underestimated him…”Dudian’s fingers slightly clenched, he stared at samba: “Didn’t you say that the person who summoned you to do the experiment was Crimson Moon? Are you sure it was her?”
Samba was a bit nervous as Dudian looked at him, he replied: “I, I only heard about it but I didn’t see the expert they mentioned. It was Crimson Moon who summoned us to do the experiment. is that person your friend?”
Dudian felt his nervousness. He knew that the murderous aura that he had inadvertently emitted had scared him. He felt a trace of apology in his heart. His expression was calm again, “We used to be enemies but now we can be considered friends. No matter what, it is best to stay away from her. But are you sure that it was crimson moon who called you to do the experiment? Are you sure?”
Samba was relieved: “Teacher, I can guarantee that this is true. It is Crimson Moon who summoned us. Although I haven’t talked to her up close, but I can’t mistake her appearance.”
Dudian frowned: “How is it possible?”
He couldn’t understand. How could bolo appear without any defense? He was able to escape from the hands of the three kings. He was definitely one of the best among the kings. He was stronger than the other kings. His strength was enough to kill Crimson Moon even if he was injured, it was no different from squashing an ant. But Bolo had disappeared and crimson moon was left behind.
Neuss and Mason looked at each other. Neuss asked in a soft voice: “Young Master, is this man very strong? is he stronger than the woman named Crimson Moon?”
Dudian looked at him and nodded: “He should be one of the top experts in the human race. Even if thousands of wall masters besieged him they would be easily killed.”
Neuss and others were stunned. In their eyes the wall master was as strong as the devil but he was so weak in front of that man? The wall master wasn’t a first-rate figure at the top of the human pyramid?
“Did Crimson Moon surrender and work for him again?”Dudian thought about it. He felt that there must be something he didn’t know. He shook his head and didn’t think about it anymore, he looked at Neuss: “The situation here is more dangerous than I thought. We must leave as soon as possible. You should gather your trusted people and leave together.”
They looked at each other and hesitated. This was their hometown. Although it wasn’t easy to survive but in their hearts the world outside the giant wall was unknown. It was dark and filled with dangerous monsters. There was no hope.
“Dean, do we have to leave this place?”Mason asked. His eyes were calm. There was no fear or confusion. He stared at Dudian, “Is there any other way?”? “For example, we can hide our identity and change our identity. Sylvia is so big. We live in the wilderness and near the giant wall. She may not be able to find us.”
Dudian looked at Mason’s eyes and immediately understood his intention. He wasn’t afraid of death but he wanted a more stable solution.
“It’s too dangerous.”Dudian sighed, “Although Sylvia is big but if she really wants to find us it’s easy to find clues. As long as she can find one of us or someone related to us, she can read our memories and deduce the location of the rest of us. The safest way is to stay far away.”
He sighed again, “Originally, you don’t have to leave this place. Her main target is me, but in order to find me, she might find you first. So, it’s too dangerous to stay here. Leaving is the only way.”
Noyce, Barton, Aurora, and the others were all silent.
In less than two seconds, Barton was the first to speak. “Dean, wherever you go, I’ll Go!”
Neuss also spoke: “My Life is given by you. I am willing to follow you no matter where I Go!”
Aurora’s expression was cold: “You let me have the ability to avenge my sister. My Life is yours. It doesn’t matter even if I have to live outside the giant wall.”
Mason smiled as he heard their words. He was happy for Dudian. There were so many people who were willing to use their lives to follow him. Such a man was his brother. He could entrust his life to his brother!
“If we leave, I suggest we go to another giant wall. If the woman’s experiment is successful, she will definitely go to a big place like the Kingdom of God. We can go to other giant walls first. We will go to the Kingdom of God when we have enough strength.”Mason said.
He wasn’t afraid of Dudian’s misunderstanding. He believed that Dudian would understand his intentions.
Dudian’s eyes swept over their faces. There was a trace of warmth in his eyes. Time would change many things but it didn’t seem to change them. They were comfortable, lazy and enjoyed the most irresistible things in human nature, but it didn’t change their hearts. He suddenly felt ashamed. Compared to them, he had paid too little. This trust made him feel ashamed.
Dudian’s expression didn’t change, he said: “Then go to other giant wall. Before you leave, gather the people who are willing to follow and absolutely loyal. Inform the other brothers who didn’t come. In addition, prepare the food and medicine for the journey.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss nodded respectfully. There was a smile on his face. It seemed that he had returned to the days when he was under Dudian’s command.
“Can we get uranium crystals from the channels in our hands?”Dudian asked.
Neuss was surprised but quickly returned to normal: “Is it an experimental uranium crystal? It is rare. Master, if you need it, you can buy some from the underground markets but the quantity is very small.”
“Find it as much as possible, no matter how much it costs.”Dudian said.
Noyce nodded, “I know.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1010
chapters.content:
Chapter 1010 – Chapter 1: Change [ Second Update ]
In less than an hour, Neuss, Barton and others gathered their trusted aides in the new secret stronghold. There were twenty-four people including Neuss and others, dudian didn’t know most of them but none of them didn’t know him.
“Sergei is stationed in the dark wall of the outer wall. I have sent people to send a message to him but it will take a long time.”Neuss said to Dudian.
Dudian nodded: “Is there any news about the uranium crystal?”
“It will take some time. I have used all my connections and intelligence network to collect it. Many people have promised to trade it. I estimate that it will take about five or six o’clock in the evening to recover it.”Neuss said.
Dudian took out his pocket watch. It was two o’clock in the afternoon. In other words, he would have to wait for three or four hours.
“I’ll go to the outer wall and meet Sergei. In addition, I’ll leave a person here to recover uranium crystals.”Dudian got up. He felt dizzy as if he was anemic. He paused for a moment and quickly recovered, he walked out.
The eyes of the people gathered in the hall were filled with awe. They immediately moved aside to make way for him. They looked down at their toes but didn’t dare to look up.
Neuss, Barton and other Dudian’s confidants followed. They came out of the stronghold. There were no pedestrians on the street. There was only a group of black ponies gathered on the side of the street, they were about the same height as a donkey. Even a short woman could sit on them.
