However, although these black ponies weren’t big, they were the kings of the horses. They were very famous and were called Wolf Horses.
Wolf horses had flexible bodies. They were wild and bloodthirsty. They fed on meat. Even hunters would find it difficult to subdue them. They could travel three thousand kilometers in a day and ten thousand kilometers in a night. Their maximum speed could reach two hundred and fifty kilometers per hour. They could gallop freely even if they were outside the giant wall.
Wolf horses were expensive. They were only sold by the Monster Research Institute. They were usually equipped for the experts of the family.
Dudian was surprised to see the wolf horses. He didn’t expect that Neuss and the others were doing better than he had imagined.
“Young master please.”Neuss led the way.
Dudian came to the front of the pack of wolf horses. The wolf horses turned their heads as he approached them. They bared their teeth and showed their sharp teeth. Their heads were like horses and wolves. They were full of murderous intent.
Dudian ignored them and walked straight over.
As he got closer and closer, the sharp teeth of the wolves quickly disappeared. They whispered and retreated as if they were afraid of something.
Dudian turned over and sat on the back of a larger wolf. The Wolf’s limbs were weak and it was about to lie down. It kept whining. Dudian looked down and saw that the wolf’s urine and feces were flowing, its limbs were shaking as if it was going to lie down at any time.
Neuss and his confidants were tongue-tied. They knew that the wolf horse was violent and difficult to tame. They didn’t expect that Dudian didn’t do anything and the Wolf Horse was scared to the point of fainting. What was going on?
Dudian was also puzzled. He didn’t deliberately release his killing intent nor did he reveal his magic marks. Logically speaking he should be like an ordinary person. How could this wolf horse be so unbearable?
“Master, why don’t You Change One?”Neuss came forward and wiped his sweat.
Dudian was a bit helpless. He turned over and walked to the wolf horse next to him.
The other wolves behind the wolf horse instinctively retreated. It seemed that the wolf horse which Dudian was staring at also wanted to retreat. But its limbs were nailed to the ground. It didn’t move for a long time. It whined as if it was begging, its limbs couldn’t help but tremble.
Dudian was speechless. He stopped and said: “You ride the horse. I will fly over.”
Neuss saw that the wolves didn’t dare to get close to Dudian. There was a trace of embarrassment on his face: “Master, I will find another carriage for you.”
“There is no need.”Dudian shook his head. He wanted to activate the magic marks of the splitter.
However, the familiar feeling didn’t appear. He suddenly found that he couldn’t feel the power of the magic marks!
“How…”Dudian couldn’t help but look down at his body. He tried to activate the magic marks of the splitter… but there was no response.
Dudian was a bit surprised. was his magic marks removed? He couldn’t help but want to look at the situation inside his body. His vision changed as if it was instinctive. His clothes and skin were penetrated and he could see the bones, internal organs and other organs inside his body.
He was startled for a moment and his vision quickly returned to normal.
“I still have the ability to see through things. Why is there no reaction from the magic body…”Dudian was relieved. He couldn’t help but have some doubts. Soon, he recalled the feeling he had when he activated the ability to see through the pupil. It seemed to be the instinct of his body, it wasn’t the first time that he used the magic marks power in his body.
“Could it be…”he thought.
Puff!
The sound of cutting echoed. There was a sound which stopped as he screamed.
Dudian instinctively wanted to look behind him. His vision changed as he saw the situation behind him. He entered the 360-degree vision of the splitter. He saw the clothes on his back were torn, the black splitter’s wings were like steel blades. Because of the sudden extension and the close distance between them, Dudian accidentally cut the wolf into pieces.
Neuss was also scared. He was standing close to the wolf and was almost hit.
“Fortunately…”Dudian was relieved. He naturally noticed that he almost hurt Neuss. Fortunately, he felt the splitter’s wings on his back. It felt like an extended arm, he was able to control it but the splintered wings seemed to be different from the past. He was about to carefully feel it when he suddenly thought of something. He looked up and saw Barton, Mason and their confidants staring at him in a daze.
“You go first. I’ll be right behind you.”Dudian immediately ordered.
Barton, Mason and others came back to their senses. They looked at Dudian but didn’t ask anything. They immediately called their confidants to get on the wolf horses.
“Master, do you know the way?”Neuss asked Dudian
“Yes, go.”Dudian smiled.
Dudian’s expression calmed down as he waited for Neuss to leave. He slowly felt the wings on his back. Soon his body was covered with black scales. In the blink of an eye he entered the state of the splitter, he looked like a monster that was covered in blades. There was something strange about his pupils. He couldn’t find the shadow of a human. He was completely demonized.
Dudian slightly raised his hand and waved the blades on his body. He was surprised as he looked at his own body. The splitter’s body was very different from before. First of all, it was more thoroughly demonized, his face had been covered with sharp blades and black armor. It was impossible to distinguish it. If his body was turned upside down then no one would think that it was his head.
Moreover, the joints of the splitter’s body had a dark golden layer. It was a strange material. It was very hard and perfectly protected the weakness of the splitter’s body.
Moreover, the process of entering the demon body this time was different from the past. In the past, he first activated the power of the demon marks, stimulated the demon marks, and then combined with the energy in the witcher device to enter the entire demon body. But now, he felt that as soon as his thoughts arrived.., the power in his body spread out and formed the body of the demon body. Then, a clear feeling came from these bodies. The nerves were tightly connected, and he could control them freely.
This feeling was like the power of the Magic Marks had completely merged with his body. He no longer needed the magic marks as a medium. In other words, his body had become a huge magic mark!
He skillfully controlled the magic body and moved for a moment. Dudian put away the magic body and only revealed the split wings on his back. He flapped his wings and flew hundreds of meters into the air, he turned into a black line and flew straight into the distance.
He felt that he wasn’t flying fast but the streets and houses under his feet were rapidly retreating. The strong wind was blowing against his face. He couldn’t hear any other sounds.
After a few minutes he saw the wall of sighs. He flew straight over.
He went over the wall of Sighs and went straight down into the sky above the outer wall area.
The familiar outer wall, the familiar structure, the commercial and residential areas, and the slums were divided into three spaces like a rectangular box. It was more crowded and small compared to the inner wall area, the outer wall area occupied only 20% of the area of Sylvia.
Dudian landed in a quiet and uninhabited place in the commercial area. He raised the dust on the ground. He closed his wings and followed the smell. He came to the front of a magnificent magistrate.
There was a group of black ponies in front of the magistrate. There were people sitting on the backs of two of the ponies.
Both of them were startled when they saw Dudian. They jumped down from the horses and trotted over.
“Master, you are here.”
“Where are they?”
“Lord Noyce and Lord Barton have gone in.”
Dudian nodded. He didn’t expect that their second stronghold was the magistrate in the outer wall. This place was a good choice. Who would have thought that this place was the symbol of justice and the Holy Magistrate, was the place where the dark believers hid?
The Darkness was always hidden in the brightest places because it was covered.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he saw the secret underground building under the magistrate. He saw Neuss and Barton lead their men to find Sergei.
Sergei was still bald. There were two more scars on his face. One of them crossed the bridge of his nose as he was meeting Neuss.
“I thought that the king would come back. I didn’t expect that he would leave dejectedly…”Dudian looked at his old friends in the underground building. There was a trace of sadness in his eyes. He thought that he would either die.., or return in glory. Who knew that he would end up in such a situation?
Dudian sighed. He didn’t know when he would be free like the clouds in the sky.
After a while Neuss came out with Sergei and his confidants.
Sergei knew that Dudian had come back. He knew that Dudian had been captured to the palace to do experiments. He couldn’t help but rush forward in surprise when he saw that Dudian was alive, he laughed: “Haha, I Knew That You Wouldn’t die so easily!”
Neuss frowned: “How can you talk like that?”
Sergei patted his head: “I forgot. Young master please don’t take offense.”
Dudian waved his hand: “Let’s Get Ready.”
“Yes, Young Master.”Neuss respectfully nodded and turned to greet his confidants.
Soon, these confidants took out a lot of baggage from the magistrate. They rode on their own horses and were ready to set off at any time.
“Let’s go.”Dudian stretched out his magic wings and flew straight out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1011
chapters.content:
Chapter 1011 – Chapter 1,001:
Noyce and the others walked along the Quiet Street. There were almost no pedestrians on the road. They had already sent people to seal off the route they were taking. In this outer wall area, his power was spread all over, it was not an exaggeration to say that he could cover the sky with one hand.
When they reached the golden fortress at the border, Noyce had his confidant pull the signal flare in advance. A yellow smoke bomb immediately rose from the fortress. When the group of people rode over, the city gate under the fortress had already opened.
The wilderness was the outermost edge of the golden fortress. It was overgrown with weeds and ferocious beasts could be seen everywhere.
With the strength of Neuss and the others, they didn’t need to worry about these low-level mutated beasts. It didn’t take long for them to reach the towering giant wall. There were two teams of knights wearing the Holy Church’s light armor standing at the passage under the giant wall. They bowed to Dudian and Neuss as they approached.
Dudian put away his magic wings and entered the passage.
Neuss and Barton jumped down from their horses and led their horses into the passage.
They walked through the dark passage. When they came out again they were outside the giant wall. The smell in the air seemed to be very different. There was a fresh and bloody smell.
“Master, there is our stronghold in area 9. Do you want to stay there for the time being?”Neuss asked Dudian.
Dudian nodded: “Yes, lead the way.”
Neuss got onto the wolf horse and took the lead.
Barton and his confidants followed him. Dudian stretched out his magic wings and flew at a low altitude.
They met two undeads who were wandering near the giant wall. Neuss casually pulled out his sword and killed them. Half an hour later they arrived at area 9. There were corpses lying on the street, almost all of them were zombies. Most of them had their heads cut off or had their foreheads pierced by sharp objects. In addition, there were some black furry monster corpses. They had been dead for a long time, and their flesh and blood were rotting, they gave off a disgusting smell.
The stronghold that Noyce mentioned was a large building that was relatively well-preserved. It seemed to be a company building from the old era. A lot of the glass on the building was broken, and the rest was covered in dust, however, it still reflected a dazzling light under the sun.
There were hundreds of corpses piled up outside the building. They had long been decomposed into white bones. Judging from the position and posture of the corpses, it seemed that they were employees who had rushed out of the building.
Whoosh!
A figure suddenly jumped down from a broken window on the fourth floor of the building and landed in front of Noyce. It was a young man in black. After landing, he knelt on one knee and said respectfully, “Your subordinate greets Lord Black Crow!”
Black Crow was Noyce’s nickname in the Dark Vatican. It was rumored that Black Crow was a bird that rested on the demon king’s shoulder. Every time the demon king woke up, Black Crow would roam the world, bringing disaster and pain to the world.
Noyce’s expression was cold as he said, “Has anyone come to the ninth district?”
“Reporting to Your Excellency, a hunting squad passed by twenty-four days ago, but did not stop. They should have passed by here on a mission.”The youth dressed in black said respectfully.
Neuss nodded: “Get Ready. We need to settle down here. We need to vacate a large room first.”
“Yes, sir.”The youth in black nodded respectfully.
At this time, three shadows flashed and appeared in front of the building. They saw Neuss and the others who were led by the youth in black. They immediately saluted. They were all wearing the same uniform as a special unit.
Dudian was surprised as he saw the strength of these people. They were pioneers. Such a person was considered a first-class expert in the giant wall. How could he be stationed in the ninth region which had been cleared out by the hunters?
Golden light flashed in his eyes. Soon, the situation in the building appeared in his eyes. He was stunned as he looked at Neuss.
“Young master, the ninth region is one of our strongholds outside the giant wall.”Neuss deliberately slowed down his pace and followed Dudian, he whispered: “I heard about the development of new shelters outside the giant wall. After you left I was worried that something bad would happen inside the giant wall so I secretly built a few shelters outside the giant wall. If I can’t stay inside the giant wall then I can stay here.”
“Smart.”Dudian smiled.
Neuss smiled: “It was your idea.”
The youth in black who was leading the way and the other three bowed their heads as they saw Neuss’s appearance. They didn’t know Dudian but they knew that Neuss had saved them from suffering, they knew how powerful Neuss was. They didn’t expect him to be so humble.
“Please.”The youth in black removed a collapsed stone slab. There was a door behind the door. Behind the door was a dark staircase that led to the underground.
Dudian wasn’t surprised. He had seen that Neuss had transformed the building into an underground base. The underground base was equipped with all kinds of equipment, there was a luxurious living and resting area. There was a working area filled with all kinds of equipment. There was also an arsenal full of explosives and firearms.
There wasn’t much difference between the firearms of the old era and the firearms of the old era. The only difference was the accuracy and power of the bullets. But it could be considered a genuine pistol!
The youth in black wanted to take Dudian and Neuss to the largest room to rest but Dudian waved him off, he turned to Neuss: “Let the others rest first. We will go to the wall to see how the collection of uranium crystals is going.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss nodded respectfully.
Dudian and Neuss returned to the giant wall after they settled Barton and the other confidants. They didn’t ride horses this time. Neuss used his full strength to barely keep up with Dudian’s speed.
Dudian felt that he should improve the strength of Barton and the others. Although he left a lot of resources but they were ordinary resources. The strength of Neuss and Sergei was stuck at the peak level of the inner wilderness. They were on the same level as dragon mother and wing king. Although they had a lot of magic marks to choose from and a large amount of God’s marrow to consume, they had to strengthen their magic marks in order to become rulers.
There were very few legendary magic marks, so it was very difficult to find five identical legendary magic marks to strengthen. As a result, Noyce and Cage had reached the peak of the inner wilderness long ago, but they were still stuck at this step.
Neuss sprinted as fast as he could. Both of them quickly returned to the inner wall. They passed through the outer wall and returned to the secret stronghold in the inner wall.
“Is there any situation?”Neuss asked the contact in a dignified manner after entering the secret stronghold. The stronghold was very simple but it was equipped with a telegraph. Since Dudian had brought electricity to thousands of households, Sylvia’s industrial development was progressing at a rapid pace. Edward was taking advantage of the climax of the Industrial Revolution, he was quickly on the wave.
“Sir, there are two telegrams. They have bought uranium crystals and are on their way.”A young woman wearing a veil was stationed in the secret stronghold. Her voice was pleasant and her fingers were long, she looked very flexible.
Neuss nodded slightly: “Urge them to get it in half an hour at all costs. Even if it is hard!”
“Yes, my Lord.”The woman looked at Dudian. She didn’t dare to ask but quickly typed out the telegram.
“Master, please sit.”Neuss didn’t let Dudian stand and immediately brought out a chair.
Dudian didn’t give in. He pulled out a chair and sat down.
Ten minutes later, two groups of men in black sneaked over. They came in after the secret hideout. They took out two bags. They were about the size of a head. They were two pieces of uranium.
The uranium ore looked like a piece of stone with a touch of green. Dudian frowned as he looked at it. However, he remembered that Neuss had equipment to refine uranium. He put away the two pieces of uranium ore.
A few groups of people came in one after another. They sent different amounts of uranium ore and refined uranium crystals.
Dudian saw that the amount was enough and immediately left. He didn’t wait for the next group of people to come.
By the time he returned to the base of the ninth region outside the giant wall, the sky had gradually darkened. It was autumn and the Sun had set at about five o’clock in the evening.
Time was tight. Dudian took the uranium ore and fine uranium crystals to the second level of the base where all kinds of instruments were arranged. He ground the uranium ore and soaked it. He found a sharp knife and quickly separated the uranium from the ore.
He ground the uranium crystals into sand. He found a tough beast skin and rolled it up. The Beast Skin was rolled into a ring which was just big enough to wrap around Dudian’s neck.
Dudian completely filled the beast skin ring after he separated two pieces of uranium ore. He handed the remaining uranium ore to Neuss and put it into his backpack.
Dudian took a deep breath as he looked at the rough beast skin uranium ring. He asked Neuss to bring a mirror and sit in front of the mirror. He took out a few scalpels and anesthetized his neck.
He used the scalpels to cut the surface of his neck after he lost consciousness. His pupils were golden and the situation inside his neck was clear.
The scalpels rotated at his fingertips and cut the surface of the skin without hurting the blood vessels. The skin peeled off and revealed the jade-colored uranium ring in the flesh and the Adam’s apple.
The jade-green uranium ring seemed to be full of vitality but it was actually fatal. The flesh around the uranium ring had died. The color of the capillaries had changed to a jade color. It seemed that they had been infected by radiation.
Dudian took a deep breath. A splitter’s sharp blade stretched out from his back. He slowly moved to the front of the uranium ring and gently cut it.
The sharp blade cut iron like mud. The hard uranium ring was easily cut. There was no debris.
Dudian’s eyes were solemn. He grabbed the uranium ring with both hands and quickly pulled it out. He quickly grabbed the needle and thread that had been prepared. He lifted the surface of the skin and stitched the wound, then he tied the previously made beast skin uranium ring around his neck. This action was done in a minute.
“Young master, what is This?”Neuss was shocked as he watched Dudian perform the surgery alone. He didn’t expect that dudian would wear such a thing on his neck, it was obvious that Dudian didn’t put it on himself. It was hard to imagine what he had experienced before. He knew that this man was calm and patient as usual!
“Find a monster and put it on. Find a strong one who likes to hunt.”Dudian pointed at the cut uranium ring.
Neuss was puzzled: “Master, why did you put it on yourself? It seems that the uranium crystal is not good for the body.”
“It can restrain the Aragami factor in my body.”Dudian said in a short sentence as he got up and walked outside. Although he had made the uranium ring on his neck but the effect was no different from the previous uranium ring. After all the Aragami factor was afraid of the radioactive radiation of the uranium. The reason why Boro embedded the uranium ring into the skin of his neck was because he was worried that it would be easy to break or hide the things inside the uranium ring.
Dudian saw that Neuss had picked up the uranium ring. He turned around and picked it up from his hand. He used x-ray vision to scan it but it was still impenetrable.
His eyes flashed as he took the broken uranium ring to the metal foil that was used to grind the uranium crystal. He used a metal hammer to crush it.
Soon, a metal chip was revealed from the broken uranium ring. It was about one centimeter square.
Dudian was relieved to see it. It seemed that the problem was in the uranium ring.
He smashed the other half of the uranium ring but this time there was nothing inside.
Dudian frowned. This shouldn’t be!
If this metal chip was Bolo’s embedded positioning device then what was the thing that Crimson Moon had implanted into his body? Was she deliberately trying to blackmail him?
He looked down at his body. Through x-ray vision, he looked at his body from head to toe. However, there was still no metal in his body. Only part of the mutated flesh was infected by the flesh of the Aragami.
He pondered for a moment but still couldn’t come up with a clue. He gave the metal chip to Neuss: “This is the positioning device. Find a monster to install it.”
Neuss immediately took the metal chip.
Dudian went back to the first floor of the base. He asked Barton to call everyone and prepare to set off.
“Master, it’s already dark. Do you want to continue?”Barton asked.
Dudian nodded: “It doesn’t matter if it’s dark in this area. Don’t worry.”
Barton thought that it was true. He could wantonly wander around here with his strength. Moreover Dudian was much stronger than him.
“Everyone get ready to go! Take your luggage!”Barton shouted at the rest area.

chapters.title: Chapter 1012
chapters.content:
Chapter 1012 – Chapter 1002: Heading South
Neuss embedded the metal chip into the body of a blood firefly that came out at night to hunt for food. This blood firefly was as big as a fist. Although it was a low-level monster but its range of activity was wide. It was often accompanied by powerful monsters, the blood firefly attracted other monsters with its own blood-red light. The powerful monsters around it were responsible for killing them. The leftovers left behind by the monsters would be the food source for the blood firefly to survive.
Dudian took the group and headed towards the south.
If there was an opportunity, dudian would like to see what kind of creatures the trolls were. would there be other human empires there?
After entering the wasteland, the number of monsters they met along the way increased significantly. There was no need for Dudian to act. Neuss, Barton, Sergei and others rushed to kill them, however their strength was not inferior to the wing king of the family. When Dudian was the wall master, he had robbed the top secret fighting skills and many precious fighting skills of the three families. Not only did he learn them but he had also taught them to Neuss and others, they had learned more complex and rich things. However the time for learning was limited.
“Young master, there is a black wasteland ahead. It hasn’t been developed yet.”Neuss looked at the map. He had prepared a map of the wasteland outside the giant wall when he knew that Dudian was ready to leave, it detailed the situation of the Hunter family’s stronghold and Monster Branch.
Dudian nodded slightly: “Go straight ahead.”
The undeveloped wasteland was quite dangerous for the Hunter family, but it was nothing in front of him. The strength of Neuss and the others was enough to sweep the place. After all, this place was close to the giant wall and the probability of the appearance of Abyss level monsters was very low.
Not long after they entered the black wasteland, they met a monster that was four to five stories tall. It was like a small hill, crawling on the ground. Its back was uneven, like jagged rocks. If it was not for the heat source vision, they would have mistaken it for a small hill, they would have mistaken it for a protruding hill.
“Hunting a level 62 Rock Mountain Beast, inner wasteland…”behind Noyce, a woman in a black leather coat wearing a mask sensed the monster and reported to Noyce in a low voice.
Neuss’s eyes narrowed. The Rocky Mountain Beast was known for its terrifying defense. It was almost impossible to hurt it. The only way to defeat it was to attack the splitter or the dragon.
Dudian flew over. This time he didn’t give Neuss and the others a chance to practice. It would be a waste of time.
Dudian saw the Rocky Mountain Beast move a bit as he felt Neuss approaching. However it quickly continued to crawl on the ground. He didn’t know if it wanted to wait for Neuss to sneak attack or if it knew that the enemy wasn’t easy to deal with.
Dudian gently landed on the back of the beast. He felt that the beast seemed to tremble slightly. He smiled and a black blade suddenly extended from its spine, it was like a black lightning bolt that quickly entered the back of the Beast and quickly extended to the bottom.
Roar!
A low roar was heard mixed with pain.
There was a flash of black light as it pulled back. A ten meter long gash was created and blood bloomed.
The Rock Beast’s body was cut in the middle but it didn’t die for a moment. It screamed in pain as its body shook. It struggled to get up from the ground but fell down after a few steps.
Dudian waved to Neuss and others: “Hurry up and catch up.”
Neuss, Barton and the others quickly caught up with him.
It was the first time that the confidants behind them saw Dudian attack. They were stunned as they thought that Dudian was a monster of the inner wilderness level. How could he die just like that?
Although they had heard that Dudian was very strong and had killed the master. But it was just a rumor. They didn’t see it with their own eyes. They knew that the rumors were exaggerated. They only knew that Dudian usurped the position of the wall master, the real master of the giant wall, Aristotle, was not in the giant wall. But now it seemed that Dudian’s strength was not much worse than that of the master of the giant wall!
Neuss and the others passed by. The monster was still lying in a pool of blood. It didn’t die immediately nor could it move. It could only wait for the other monsters to smell the blood and eat it.
Dudian flew above everyone’s head. It didn’t take long for him to meet another level 40 mine wolf. Its attack was swift and fierce. There was a slight biological electric current on its claws which could paralyze its prey.
Neuss and Sergei took the lead and rushed out. They quickly surrounded the mine wolf and killed it.
Dudian and the others finally left the black wasteland at around 12 pm. They killed hundreds of monsters along the way. Almost half of them were pioneer level monsters. They also met two overlord level monsters which were killed by Dudian.
“I didn’t meet any legendary monsters.”Neuss smacked his mouth. It was the first time he felt that the scenery outside the giant wall was so beautiful. Although he had met many monsters along the way but he felt that he was safer than ever, including their confidants, no one had sacrificed. On the contrary, he had obtained four rare named monsters. Of course, there were many ordinary named monsters and rare named monsters. But his trusted aides were equipped with the magic marks of rare named monsters, therefore he didn’t pick up the rare named monsters and directly threw them away.
Dudian smiled: “We will meet them when we go to the Abyss.”
Neuss wryly smiled: “It’s better not to meet them. It’s too dangerous.”Although he knew that Dudian had the ability to kill legendary monsters but they had a long way to go so it was best for them to avoid fighting, if they were injured then there would be a chain reaction or even a team wipe out.
“Two hundred miles ahead is the edge of the Abyss.”The woman in black leather reported to Neuss.
Neuss nodded and looked at dudian: “Are we going to rest here? Isn’t it too dangerous to travel in the Abyss at night?”
Dudian smiled: “It doesn’t matter. There are different levels of the abyss as long as we are not close to the magic pit.”
“Magic Pit?”Neuss was stunned.
Dudian told them about the abyss as he went forward. He told them about the name of the God’s kingdom and the border outside the God’s kingdom. Neuss, Sergei, Barton and the others were stunned. They didn’t expect the world to be so vast. It seemed that Sylvia was nothing but a small corner of the world!
An hour later they came to the edge of the abyss. There were signs and flags on the ground. However the words on the signs were blurred after the baptism of wind and frost, it was covered with dark green mold.
They looked at the front and vaguely felt that the world ahead seemed to have become deeper and darker. The light seemed to have been swallowed by a lot. They couldn’t help but feel a bit nervous.
Dudian didn’t stop and flew straight past them.
Neuss, Sergei and others hesitated for a moment. They quickly followed after them. They looked around and didn’t dare to fall behind.
Dudian didn’t dare to let his guard down as he came to the Abyss region. Golden light flashed in his eyes from time to time. He used x-ray vision to observe the surroundings. Although he wasn’t afraid of the monsters lurking around, but he was afraid that the monsters would attack Neuss and the others first.
Dudian didn’t meet the “Despair forest”after crossing the border of the Abyss. There was a vast plain in front of him. There were mountains at the end of the plain.
There were no traces of monsters on the seemingly endless plain. There were piles of bones of giant beasts and strange birds gliding over. They picked up the worms and flew away.
“Eh?”Dudian’s eyes focused as he looked at the grassland in front of him. There were no foreign objects on the grassland but there was a light colored heat source reaction flowing in the grassland, if it wasn’t for his sensitive heat source vision, he wouldn’t even be able to detect it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1013
chapters.content:
Chapter 1013 – Chapter 1003: The Magic Of Instinct
Neuss and the others saw Dudian suddenly stop. They looked around but didn’t see anything unusual.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he looked into the grass. He saw that the soil under the hot source grass was covered with black poisonous snake-like roots. The roots were gently twisting in the soil and blood was flowing from them, it was a living creature!
“Wait here.”Dudian’s body quickly flew away.
When he flew over the heat source grass, seven or eight black rattan whips shot out from the swaying grass. They were as fast as lightning and wrapped around Dudian’s limbs and thighs.
Neuss and Sergei who were watching from behind saw that Dudian was hit. Their faces changed. They didn’t listen to Dudian’s instructions and quickly rushed over.
The plains trembled slightly as they rushed out less than 100 meters. They saw a large number of seaweed-like vines growing crazily in the grass. At the same time, the grass was also raised high, it was like a small hill. The surface of the grass twisted like a poisonous snake.
Puff!
Neuss and others were shocked. The top of the strange monster suddenly cracked and a figure flew out. It was Dudian. His arms and thighs protruded out sharp blades, the other parts of his body were still in human shape.
“Roar!”
The monster growled like a tiger in the forest. The next moment, the monster’s body quickly straightened and shot out like thousands of javelins, it suddenly stabbed towards Dudian.
Dudian looked down from the sky. He didn’t Dodge. A long black tail covered with scales and sharp blades suddenly extended out from his spine. The scales on the tail were all standing up like a row of dense blades, the sharp tentacles of the monster were cut off. Dark green blood flowed out from the broken part of the body. It emitted a strange fishy smell.
“Abyss level…”Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed. He didn’t expect to meet a monster that was more than 200 levels. This vast plain was most likely its territory. No wonder there were no small grassland monsters on it.
His body moved and a few meters long black spikes suddenly appeared on his body. He suddenly dived down.
The chaotic tentacles on top of the monster’s head suddenly split open. There was a sharp mouth inside which was full of layers of snow white teeth. It bit towards Dudian.
Whoosh!
The long black tail on the back of Dudian’s spine swung. It was like a giant black ruler. It hit the monster’s “Cheek”from the side. The scales on the long tail stood up and tore off a large piece of the monster’s mouth.
With the power of the long tail, his body spiraled in the air. The steel-like feathers on the wings closed up. At first glance, it looked like two black knives. It was like a propeller as it rushed towards the monster.
The monster let out a shrill roar as its body gathered together. It turned into a sharp giant spear and shield. It was waiting for an opportunity to shoot at Dudian.
However, the sharpness of its wings was not inferior to the long tail of Dudian. It easily cut off the giant spear as soon as it touched the body, the hundreds of thick shields couldn’t block it and were cut into a giant mouth.
Dudian’s own rotating power was canceled out. Before his body stopped, the long tail suddenly pierced through the gap of the shield. It quickly extended and directly pierced into the giant mouth of the monster.
The monster let out an ear-piercing scream. Its entire body was shaking as if it had gone mad. Its body quickly drilled into the ground as it tried to escape.
Dudian wouldn’t let the prey run away. He was like a ferocious splitter as he rushed towards the monster. His body was covered with sharp blades as he quickly cut off the monster’s body, there were many sharp wounds on the monster’s body. The tissues in the wounds were completely cut and couldn’t be healed. However the pain made the monster run away faster.
Dudian’s heart was anxious. He wanted to throw the sharp blades to pierce through its brain.
Suddenly a weak flame rushed out from his blade and touched the monster’s body. It suddenly burst into flames and its screams became louder and sharper.
Dudian was surprised. He quickly looked at his own body and found that all of his blades were covered with flames. His body was like a burning splitter!
However, the flame didn’t hurt him. Instead, he felt very warm.
At this time, the monster’s body which was half submerged in the fire began to roll in the mud. It wanted to put out the flame but the flame was like the liquid fire of the dragon. It couldn’t be put out, no matter how it tried to extinguish the flame, it would burn more and more!
In a few seconds, the monster’s struggling gradually weakened until it stopped moving. The flame was burning on its body like a fireball.
Dudian was slightly startled. He suddenly thought of another magic mark that Scarlet Moon had implanted into his body in the experiment. It was the ‘Solar Beast’! This was a rare legendary magic mark in the eastern continent. Its ability was inferior to the ‘Dream Creator’. Its comprehensive ability was a full score of five stars. It was especially good at long-range attacks, moreover, it was super long-range. It could control the light and heat.
The Flames on the edge of the blade seemed to be brought by the ability of the Sun Beast. There was no other possibility.
However, he heard that the Combat Power of the Sun Beast’s magic marks would weaken by several levels at night. At noon, the combat power would be at its strongest. It could even surpass its own level!
“It is late at night. There is no sun so I can’t use the natural light. But my combat power doesn’t seem to be weak…”Dudian glanced at the flame ring that was burning in the distance. The weeds were ignited and quickly burned into ashes, the ground was scorched. The flame went out by itself when there was no combustible material. However the expanded flame ring spread through the plains along the weeds. The flame was comparable to the dragon’s breath!
Soon Dudian thought of another problem.
He could activate the ability of the Sun Beast Soul Worm when he was in the splitter’s body?
He was a bit surprised. He tried to control his blade with his mind. Soon the flame came out from the blade and floated in the breeze. It was not a coincidence!
He was a bit surprised. He had been in contact with Crimson Moon for a long time. He saw that every time she used a different magic mark ability she would switch to the corresponding magic mark. If it was the ‘Dreamer’magic mark that read the memories.., then she wouldn’t be able to use the fire dragon’s fire power! Although she had three magic marks but she could only use one magic mark in battle.
But… He didn’t need to switch at all!
“Is this the aftereffect of the experiment?”Dudian was startled.
“Young Master.”
Neuss and the others quickly rushed over. They didn’t dare to touch the flame as they had seen the power of the flame. Previously they had grabbed the legs of the flying magic marks and jumped down one after another, they were surprised as they stepped on the scorched ground but they could still feel the heat of the ground.
Dudian looked at them. Although the flame was fierce but he wasn’t worried that they would be affected by it. If he couldn’t deal with it then he would be underestimating them.
“See if there is a soul worm in the body of this thing.”Dudian put away the splitter’s body and looked at the burning mass of grass. His heart suddenly moved as he tried to touch the flame.
The flame floated on his fingertips but he didn’t feel hot. He was surprised but soon understood that it wasn’t because the flame knew how to recognize its master but because his magic marks had merged into his body and become an instinct, just like how he activated his demon body, it was no longer driven by his magic marks. Therefore, the moment his finger touched the flame, the Sun Beast Soul Worm’s instinct to control the heat had already lowered the temperature in the flame.

chapters.title: Chapter 1014
chapters.content:
Chapter 1014 – Chapter 1004: Load
Noyce and the others did not dare to touch the flame. Instead, they used a long-blade witcher that was one of their trusted aides to cut the body of the grass monster. The body of the grass monster that was burned by the flame was no longer as tough as before. It was easily cut into several pieces. The part of the flame on the surface was cut off. A little of the flame touched the long blade. After rubbing on the ground for a moment, the flame was extinguished.
The smell of roasted meat floated out from the monster’s body. Neuss and Barton searched carefully but didn’t find any parasitic soul worms. They were disappointed.
Dudian was also disappointed. He waved to Neuss and the others and continued on their way.
There was a vast forest in front of them after crossing the plains. There were forests, lakes and the occasional buildings of the old era. There were broken highways and some collapsed rusted cars.
There were corpses everywhere on the road. There were monsters and skeletons that died in the disaster of the old era 300 years ago.
Most of the monsters that they met along the way were pioneer level. Occasionally, there would be a few small monsters. However, they sensed the smell of the crowd and fled in advance.
“Young master, how far are we from the other giant wall?”Neuss asked curiously as he handed the barbecued meat to Dudian.
Dudian took the meat and took a bite, “I don’t know. I haven’t walked this route but I will meet them sooner or later. Even if I don’t meet them, I will see the southern border of the Empire. I should be able to find someone there to ask about the giant wall.”
Neuss was startled. He understood that Dudian was trying to avoid the mysterious and powerful woman in the palace of Sylvia. He thought of the scene described by Dudian. There was a trace of yearning and curiosity in his heart, he had thought that Sylvia was the only gathering place for humans. But now it seemed that there was a vast world outside the Kingdom of God.
How Big was the world?
This question was enough to move people’s hearts.
After dinner they put out the bonfire. They hid in the woods to rest. Dudian was responsible for patrolling the night. He was worried about the others. Neuss and Barton felt ashamed but they couldn’t do anything about it.
On the third day of their journey, they once again entered the territory of an abyss level monster. When Dudian saw the strength of the monster, the other side also noticed them. There was no way to avoid it so they had to fight.
It was a monster that looked like a western dragon. Its body was nearly twenty meters long and its wings were spread out. Its body was covered in black scales and there were sharp spikes protruding from its back, there were three huge eyes on the oval belly. They quickly opened as they flew towards Dudian. They were scarlet eyes like a moon.
Dudian let Neuss and the others retreat. His body suddenly burst into flames. There were flames burning on his hair but his hair was not burnt. He had bright red hair growing on his body, his body became strong. His chest was like granite and his muscles were full. His pupils were like angry eyes. There was a long black tail behind him.
The Sun Beast and the splitter were mixed together. The Sun Beast was a lion-like monster. To be precise, it was more like a unicorn in Chinese mythology. There was a protruding red bone on its forehead, it was like a gem that could store sunlight so that the sun beast could display a certain amount of combat ability at night.
At the moment, there was also a bright red bone protruding on Dudian’s forehead. The sunlight reflected the dazzling light. It was noon and the Sun Beast’s magic marks ability user’s combat ability was at its strongest, the moment the green scale dragon flew over, Dudian’s mind moved. The special red bone on his forehead suddenly shot out a dazzling beam of light!
That’s right, it was a beam of light, just like a laser!
This was the ability that Dudian had developed over the past three days. In the continuous battle, he had gradually understood his own body. In terms of ability, he was several times stronger than before the experiment. His physique was also stronger, he felt that he should have the strength of the upper abyss or even stronger!
The light beam instantly reached the body of the green scaled dragon. It couldn’t dodge. The green scaled Dragon felt the danger coming. Its head instinctively moved but the light beam had already arrived. Bang! It hit the Left Eye of the dragon’s head. The eye socket exploded, blood flowed. The tough scales were directly penetrated by the light beam. The sharp pain made it crazy. It flapped its wings and flew. It roared as it rushed towards Dudian at a faster speed.
Dudian aimed at its head.
Whoosh!
The second beam of light shot out.
The Blue Scale Dragon’s head was hit. The light burned a fist-sized hole in its skull. The hole was charred black.
The attack made the blue scale dragon fall down from the sky. It fell into the forest and broke a lot of trees. It crouched on the ground and roared in pain. It raised its wings and hugged its upper body.
Dudian frowned. There was a golden luster in his eyes. He saw the structure of the Green Dragon’s body. He saw the weakness in the gap between its wings, there were no bones but flesh and blood.
Whoosh!
The third beam shot out from his forehead. It pierced through the gap between the wings. The beam went straight to the right eye of the dragon behind the wings.
The green scale dragon loosened its wings and turned around to run.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. The fourth beam of light gathered on his forehead. He wanted to seize the opportunity to attack but he suddenly felt dizzy. At the same time, he felt a sharp pain in his chest as if he was suffocating. He couldn’t help but tremble in pain.
He grunted. The light gathered on his forehead naturally dissipated and turned into heat energy stored in the special red bone on his forehead. He clenched his teeth and held his breath. He tightened his muscles and endured the sudden pain, the pain gradually eased. When he looked up, the green scaled dragon was left with a tiny shadow and couldn’t catch up.
“Master?”Neuss was watching Dean’s situation. He saw Dean’s abnormality and rushed over with a concerned face.
Dean slowly landed and put away the flame and the splitter’s tail. He couldn’t see that his face was as pale as paper. The pain in his chest was still lingering. He took a deep breath and wiped off the cold sweat on his forehead, “I’m fine.”
Neuss looked at him in doubt. He knew that Dudian’s body had been severely injured in the experiment. After all, there was a sequela, the abnormal pause and the terrible complexion could explain this point.
“Teacher, you don’t have a heart. Don’t fight. It’s too dangerous!”Edward squeezed out a group of confidants to protect Dudian. Although he was studying the divine arts but his body was at the pioneer level, his physique was similar to those of his confidants but in terms of combat ability, any one of them could easily kill him.
Neuss, Barton and the others nodded as they heard Edward’s words. Their faces were full of worry.
The surrounding confidants were stunned as they suspected that their ears were wrong. However, they couldn’t help but feel strange as they saw the expression of Neuss and the others. They didn’t have a heart but they were still alive, moreover, they had such a powerful fighting strength!
Dudian’s heart moved as golden light floated in his pupils. He looked down at his chest and saw that there were many blood vessels and wounds on the original part of the heart, it looked like a small heart. At this moment, it was pulsing. The blood in its body was flowing back and forth. The previous pain was coming from the black heart.
“Is it because I used too much strength and couldn’t bear the load?”Dudian pondered. Previously he had used the power of the Sun Beast to cast light. Each time he could kill the monster in one blow, he had used it three times in a row today. It seemed that he had reached his limit by the fourth time.
“It seems that I can’t use too much strength in the future to prevent the death organ from exploding.”Dudian thought. He saw Neuss and Barton looking at him with concern. He smiled, “Don’t worry. It’s just that I’m using too much strength. I’ll be able to control myself in the future.”
Neuss and Barton looked at each other. They could see the helplessness and bitterness in each other’s eyes. They wanted to stop Dudian from fighting and taking risks. But they knew that it wasn’t realistic without Dudian, they couldn’t survive for a day here. Although they knew that it was dangerous for Dudian to continue to fight but they had to acquiesce. It was just that this grievance made them yearn for more strength.
Dudian didn’t use his splitter wings but followed Neuss and the others on the land. He used his X-ray vision from time to time to check the surrounding environment. Although using X-ray vision would be a burden on his body but occasionally opening it wouldn’t affect him.
After ten minutes Dudian felt that his body gradually recovered. His limbs no longer felt cold and weak. He was relieved as he recalled the previous battle, the power of the Sun Beast Soul worm was too exaggerated. It was even more terrifying than the splitter. He had almost killed the green scaled dragon before it got close to him!
Such a terrifying long-range attack was enough to make the enemy despair.
“The magic mark that Scarlet Moon gave me is really compatible with me. The close combat splitter is my strong point. The long-range splitter is basically invincible. The only thing it lacks is defense and perception. But if the enemy is killed in an instant then there is no need to defend.”He felt that the Sun Beast Soul Worm that Scarlet Moon had given him.., splitty’s magic marks were taken into consideration. Splitty not only wanted to transform him into a god but he also wanted to become a brutal god of combat!
Dudian’s heart couldn’t help but become active as he felt his strength was unprecedentedly strong. He suddenly felt that his situation wasn’t as bad as he had imagined, he could salvage the situation.
For example, if he could stabilize the black heart, would he be able to live forever? Or would he be able to find a human heart to replace the Black Heart? Would he be able to solve the hidden dangers of his body?
In any case, Dudian decided to understand his own situation first. He was a scientist. As long as he had the resources, he would be able to perform an operation on himself!
“According to Phoenix, it will take about three months to travel from the east side of the wall to the empire. Sylvia is about a month away from the empire. It will take about two months to travel to the south side of the wall…”Dudian calculated the time in his mind, the worst case scenario was to go directly to the south side of the wall and find a sentry to interrogate the map.
Autumn.
Drizzling rain.
The God of war wall was located in the south of the Empire, close to the sixth magic pit.
At this moment, at the outer edge of the sixth magic pit, five figures were standing there. Two of them were holding a strange instrument in their hands, and one of them was holding a metal box the size of a recorder. The outside of the box was connected to a cable, on the other end of the cable were two speaker-like things. The other person was holding the two speaker-like metal devices and sweeping them in the surrounding air.
He only put away the trumpet-like metal devices when he felt enough.
At this moment, the other person grabbed the rotten mud from the ground and sealed it in a transparent test tube.
“Let’s go inside and take a look,”a middle-aged man wearing a black mask said in a low voice. His mask was obviously not an ordinary dust-proof mask. There was a precise net on it.., it was specially designed to prevent the tiny parasitic magic bugs floating in the air in the magic pit.
Just as the few of them were about to go deeper, the middle-aged man suddenly stopped. He raised his hand and made a shushing gesture. At the same time, he looked at his wrist. There was a strange wristwatch that was vibrating slightly.
His gaze was solemn. He quickly opened the wristwatch and saw a dark green grid on it. There were a large number of red dots approaching it.
“A herd of beasts?”The middle-aged man frowned and pressed on the side of the wristwatch. The grid was enlarged and a row of data appeared. He was immediately stunned. “Humans?”
Soon, the wristwatch showed the life data of the group of red dots.
He stared at them for a moment and frowned. It seemed that he was hesitating.
After a moment, he made up his mind and said to the others: “Follow Me.”
Whoosh!
Dudian flew in the air. Golden light flashed in his eyes as he looked at the forest in front of him. There were many heat sources in the forest. All of them were small monsters. Suddenly, his eyes landed on one of them.
“Stop.”Dudian raised his hand.
Neuss and the others on the ground stopped and looked around cautiously.
“Wait for me here.”Dudian said. He spread his wings and flew away as fast as a rainbow!
Whoosh!
The strong wind swept through the treetops.
Dudian’s body quickly stopped as he stood in the air. He coldly looked at the five figures who were carefully moving under the tree. His eyes flashed with a trace of gentleness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1015
chapters.content:
Chapter 1015 – Chapter 1005: Instant Kill
The five of them looked up at the sky and saw Dudian appear in the air.
“80,000 life energy…”the middle-aged man wearing a mask glanced at the data on his wristwatch. His face slightly changed, he looked at the people around him: “The opponent’s perception is very strong. They should have hidden their strength. Get ready to fight!”
“Eighty thousand?”The other four frowned. Their fighting strength was not inferior to theirs.
Whoosh!
Dudian flew away and landed in front of them. He didn’t deliberately disguise himself. He had estimated the strength of the five of them through the Solar Beast’s thermal energy, even if the other party hid their strength, it was not much different.
The five saw Dudian appear in front of them. Their lips curled into a sneer. They knew that Dudian had underestimated them. They were sent to the magic pit to carry out the mission, it was because of their superior perception and profound hiding ability.
They looked at each other. The leader of the group looked up at Dudian who was slowly landing. He coldly asked: “Who are you?”
Dudian wasn’t in a hurry to attack. He looked at the instruments in their hands: “Are you from the giant wall?”
Kasamo was also looking at Dudian. He frowned as he saw the exquisite armor on Dudian’s body. He felt that things were different from what he had expected: “Are you from the other giant wall?”
“It seems that you are the residents of the giant wall.”Dudian muttered to himself. There was a smile on his face: “Can you lead the way for me?”
Kasamo’s face turned gloomy as he saw Dudian ignore his words. He casually put his palm behind his back and made a gesture to his companion: “Are You An Abyss Walker?”
“You too?”Dudian looked at him in surprise. The other party had guessed his strength and dared to show such an expression. He thought that his ability to hide life fluctuation was very strong, he didn’t expect to meet someone who was stronger than him.
The four people behind Kasamo’s face changed as they noticed Dudian’s words. They understood the reason why Kasamo made a gesture. They quietly moved back.
Dudian noticed their movements but didn’t pay attention to them. He was confident that he could deal with them even if they were five abysses. Moreover his intuition told him that it was impossible for them to be five abysses, he had never met a giant wall that could nurture so many abysses.
“Are you the Master of the Giant Wall?”Kasamo stared at Dudian.
Dudian smiled: “I used to be. But I’m not interested in being a master of the giant wall. You Don’t have to be nervous. I just want to find a place to rest. I’m not interested in the giant wall that governs you. I hope you can lead the way.”
Kasamo was angry as he heard Dudian’s tone. He wanted to laugh but he held back: “The giant wall doesn’t welcome outsiders. I advise you to leave. Don’t cause unnecessary fights!”
Dudian frowned and sighed: “So you don’t intend to lead the way?”
Kasamo pulled out the dagger from his back. It quickly melted into his body. His whole body turned into a giant lizard in the blink of an eye. But it was different from ordinary lizards. His whole body was not made of tough skin but scales, his claws were sharp and curved. Once he grabbed the enemy, he could easily tear off a piece of blood skin. In addition, the scales on his body were colorful as if they were poisonous. Under the sunlight, there was a kind of magical color.
He hooked his fingernails and threw the wristwatch off his wrist into the hands of his partner. His amber eyes stared at Dudian as his body emitted a murderous aura.
“It is the abyss…”Dudian felt the heat in his body. He glanced at the four people behind him who had moved far away as if they were afraid of being affected by the battle. It was obvious that the other side wasn’t blind and arrogant, they knew that they couldn’t interfere in the Battle of the Abyss. It seemed that the other side only had one abyss. Moreover, it was a lower abyss.
He didn’t try to persuade them. Flames appeared on his body and special red bones appeared on his forehead.
Kasamo saw that Dudian was also using his magic body. He was about to launch a surprise attack when his companion shouted. His heart skipped a beat as he instinctively glanced at his companion, the youth holding his wristwatch was stunned as he looked at the wristwatch. He trembled as he said: “Life Energy is 940,000… one million…”
The three people who were next to him heard the youth’s words and hurried over. They were stunned when they saw the data on the wristwatch.
“Eh?”Dudian heard their conversation. He was puzzled when he saw their shocked expressions. However he didn’t stop. There was a flash of light on his forehead and a beam of light shot out.
Kasamo was a bit confused by his companion’s words. He even had the impulse to take back the wristwatch. Millions of life energy? How could it be! As his thoughts were diverted, he suddenly felt a sense of danger. The scales on his body stood up and his heart was beating wildly. He felt as if a cold arrow had pierced through his heart. His body was stimulated by this dangerous premonition.
Before he could react, a ray of white light flashed through his pupils. The next moment, all his thoughts suddenly stopped. The only thought was that it was very hot..
Plop!
Kasamo fell to the ground. The light beam went through his forehead. He was good at hiding, disguising, and his combat ability was not weak. However, his defense was his weakness. He couldn’t be compared to the green scale dragon. Even the toughest skull.., he couldn’t block the Sun Ray that Dudian shot.
The four people behind him were shocked. They opened their mouths and were stunned for a second. Then they woke up and fled in all directions.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Three rays of light shot out from Dudian’s forehead. This special red bone was like a gemstone. The edge of the bone was diamond shaped. It could shoot out rays of light in different directions at the same time. Three rays of light flew out and arrived in an instant, three people who were about to escape were hit in the head. In the blink of an eye, there were three more corpses on the ground.
“Sure enough, the density of light can be adjusted…”Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed. Through continuous battle, he became more and more familiar with the sun’s rays. Previously when he was fighting with the Green Dragon.., the density of the sun’s rays was compressed to the maximum. It could only shoot four rays to reach the body’s limit. However, if the density of the Rays was adjusted to a lower level, the number of rays would increase, the corresponding destructive power would decrease.
However, to deal with these people, even if the solar rays were lowered by two levels, it would still be able to kill them.
Dudian floated down and landed in front of the youth. He glanced at the wristwatch in his hand and picked it up. The latter was like a statue. His body was still stiff and didn’t dare to move.
Dudian glanced at the wristwatch and saw his own virtual projection. Next to the projection was a string of numbers such as heart rate, thermal response, bone hardness and so on. There seemed to be a string of comprehensive data under the data. At the moment the data was changing rapidly. There were more than 1.2 million fluctuations.
“This thing can detect my strength?”Dudian was a bit surprised. He had made a biological detector which could automatically detect life but it could only detect the strength of the thermal response of the organism. The thermal response might not represent strength, but this wristwatch instrument was obviously more advanced than the biological detector. Through the comprehensive data collected, a comprehensive score was obtained to evaluate the strength of the enemy.
The technology contained in this small thing was very profound.
“Sir, sir, don’t kill me!”The young man hurriedly knelt down as if he had woken up from a dream. His face was full of fear as he looked at Dudian. He wanted to show the most humble posture to beg for a trace of pity.
“Answer my question honestly. I can consider letting you live.”Dudian fiddled with his wristwatch and said without raising his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1016
chapters.content:
Chapter 1016 – Chapter 1006: Guarding The God’S Wall
Under the threat of death, Peder was very spineless. Not only did he tell Dudian everything, but he also helped Dudian to plan how to sneak into his hometown.
Dudian put the wristwatch on his wrist. Through Peder’s introduction, he already knew the usage of the wristwatch. He also knew what the data on the wristwatch represented, it was the comprehensive data of the physique. He could roughly judge the strength of the enemy but it was not 100% accurate. For example, if someone like him knew how to hide his life energy then it would be very difficult for the wristwatch to detect all of it, it would give the wrong information.
“If the life energy is more than 100,000 then it could be the abyss. If the life energy is more than 500,000 then it could be the wall master of Berga. He could suppress many experts of the abyss. It seems that I should be the strength of the upper abyss or even stronger…” Dudian had a clearer understanding of his own strength. After all, the 1.2 million life energy wasn’t his full strength.
“My lord, the magic marks of the Wall Master of Berga are the magic devourers. Everyone’s magic marks will be weakened by half in front of him. But with your previous ray attack, as long as you find the opportunity to sneak attack in the dark, you will be able to kill him in one shot!”Peder’s eyes were sharp.
Dudian was surprised: “What kind of ability is this?”
“This is not the ability of a magic Mark Devourer. It is said that a magic mark devourer can devour other magic marks. So Ordinary Soul Worms are afraid of a magic Mark Devourer. They can not display their normal strength. But the situation of a legendary level magic mark is a bit better. Ordinary magic marks can not even display one-tenth of their combat power in front of him.”Pidel quickly explained.
Dudian didn’t expect that there would be such magic marks. There were many special ability users that he didn’t know about.
“Sir, this is the sixth magic pit. We shouldn’t stay here for long. Should we go back to the giant wall?”Peder carefully looked at Dudian.
“There is no hurry.”Dudian bent down and picked up the equipment that had fallen to the ground. It was like an electric box. It was connected to a speaker. There was soft cotton inside. It seemed to be some kind of special collector. He picked it up and looked at it, “What is this?”
Peder quickly said: “This is the magic energy collector. It is used to detect the concentration of magic energy in the pit. In addition we need to collect the soil and bring back the blood and flesh of the monsters for research.”
“Why do you want to do that?”Dudian was curious. Normally the giant wall wouldn’t be able to take care of itself.
“The responsibility of the holy wall is to take care of the sixth magic pit. We need to report to the Empire as soon as there is any abnormal situation. So every month we will come over to collect the magic energy.”Peder’s face was full of enthusiasm, he wanted to let Dudian feel his sincerity.
Dudian raised his eyebrows. It was no wonder that the giant wall could create such a thing. It was the giant wall appointed by the empire. It had a special mission. It was estimated that the giant wall was connected to the empire, it was much more convenient than the other giant walls. They had obtained a lot of technology and knowledge from the empire.
“Come with me.”Dudian threw the magic energy collector to him. He looked at the corpses of the others. He didn’t find anything valuable so he turned back.
Peder took the Magic Energy Collector and followed behind. He didn’t try to escape.
Dudian went back to Neuss and the others. He called out to them and said to peder: “Lead the way to Borja.”
“Yes, sir.”Peder respectfully nodded and turned to lead the way.
Neuss and Barton saw Dudian suddenly lead a person back. They were shocked but quickly reacted. Their eyes were full of surprise. Someone told them that there was a giant wall nearby, it was obviously a place name.
Neuss and the others had been looking forward to meeting other giant walls for a long time. They were full of expectation as they followed Peder.
“Sir, Kasamo had sent us an early warning signal. It has been sent back to the giant wall. It is estimated that the giant wall will be on alert when we return. We can only sneak in.”Peder led the way, they climbed over a hill and took the opportunity to talk to Dudian.
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. He didn’t expect that these people would do such a thing under his nose. He looked at Peder. The latter had said this matter. It was clear that he had chosen to defect. He nodded slightly, “Yes, as long as nothing happens to me, you won’t die.”
Peder was excited to hear Dudian’s promise. He knew that with Dudian’s strength he wouldn’t go back on his promise. He immediately said: “Thank you sir. I will do my best to help you.”
“Tell me about the situation inside the giant wall. The number of experts in the Abyss.”Dudian said.
Peder nodded. Even if Dudian didn’t ask, he was going to tell Dudian. He knew that as long as Dudian entered Polga, he would be punished even if Dudian died. Unless he planned to kill Dudian, however, such an opportunity was unlikely to exist. Moreover, he could see that Dudian’s strength was far from ordinary abyss ability. His intuition told him that Dudian’s previous move to kill Kasamo was enough to make him kneel down, it was very likely that Dudian’s thigh was thicker than that of the wall master. Of course, he had to hug it tightly!
“In addition to the previous kasamo, there are eight other lords in the wall. They are stronger than Kasamo. Each lord has an assistant who is on the same level as kasamo. Kasamo is the assistant of Lord Red Lotus. This time it is Lord Red Lotus’s turn to investigate the situation of the sixth magic pit…”Peder said, he couldn’t help but pause for a moment. He wanted to say that he didn’t know that Kasamo was so unlucky and arrogant. He had brought them to meet Dudian. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have lost his life. After all, the assistant of the eight lords was leading the exploration team, it was rare for accidents to happen.
“So there are sixteen abysses and the giant wall?”Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise. There were so many abysses in a giant wall. In comparison, there wasn’t even a ruler in Sylvia, there wasn’t even a master in Sylvia. The gap was a bit exaggerated!
“The giant wall has three abysses under its command. Their strength is on par with the eight lords.”Pidel quickly said.
Dudian smiled wryly. It seemed that he had encountered an incredible giant wall. No wonder the Empire arranged to guard the magic pit. In other words, there should be similar giant walls around the other magic pits.
“My lord, don’t worry. With your strength, you have a chance to rule this place.”Peder saw Dudian’s helpless smile. He was worried that he would be scared away, dudian wouldn’t mind killing him, he quickly said: “My Lord, your strength is enough to kill Kasamo. You should be stronger than the eight lords. Even the wall masters might not be your opponent. Although there are many of them but the strong are never afraid of a sea of people. Moreover we are in the dark and they are in the open. We can break them one by one!”
Dudian looked at him. He naturally didn’t have the intention to retreat. He felt that things were a bit troublesome. However Peder was quite smart. He smiled, “What’s Your Plan? Tell me.”
Peder was surprised to see Dudian smile. He didn’t know if his words gave Dudian confidence or if Dudian had hidden his cards. He thought for a moment, he whispered: “Lord, I know the residence of the eight lords. We can lead them out and kill them one by one. When others are aware of it they will be on alert. But we have been in the dark so it is useless for them to be on alert. After a long time they will slowly reveal their flaws.”
His eyes flashed with a trace of ruthlessness, he said, “Even if they all cower, we can still guard the wall master. As long as we kill the wall master and temporarily seize control of the wall, the eight lords can only surrender if they don’t want to die. At that time, we can cut off contact with the empire or use false information to pass on to the empire. It Won’t be a problem to deceive them for two to three years in a short period of time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1017
chapters.content:
Chapter 1017 – Chapter 1007: Infiltrate
Dudian smiled and said to Neuss, Barton and others: “What’s Your Idea?”
Neuss looked at Dudian but couldn’t see through his thoughts, he whispered: “Master, I think this method is feasible. But we can also try to create traps. If they are detected halfway, we can lure them into the trap and catch them all.”
Barton pondered: “I think it is not too late to familiarize ourselves with the situation inside the wall. After all, we don’t know anything about the holy wall. We can’t rely on his words.”
Sergei saw Dudian looking at him: “Don’t look at me. I have never been good at thinking.”
Mason laughed: “We can blend into the middle level of their forces and find out their background.”
Peder couldn’t help but look at them. It was obvious that the other party was more thoughtful than he thought, he quickly echoed: “We are in the dark. We are not in a hurry to act. We can understand the situation first.”
Dudian smiled: “Let’s take a look first.”
Not long after they finished their discussion, peder led them to the wilderness outside the giant wall. The number of monsters in the surroundings had obviously decreased. The number of low-level monsters had increased. When they came to a basin.., peder was the first to notice the situation in the basin. He whispered: “Sir, there are people in front of us. They should be hunting teams. Should we go around them?”
Dudian waved his hand: “Kill them.”
“Yes, sir.”Peder respectfully nodded as he saw Dudian’s order. He quickly sped up and went into the basin. It didn’t take long before his body turned back. He was holding two frightened heads in his hands, he looked at dudian: “Sir, there are only a few hunters. They should have come out to carry out the mission. I have already disposed of them. Their bodies are left in the same place. Do you want me to pretend that they have been killed by monsters?”
“Go.”Dudian nodded.
Peder immediately took the two human heads and left.
Neuss whispered to dudian: “Master, this person can not be reused.”
“Of course.”Dudian smiled.
After Dudian and others entered the basin, Peder had finished disguising the scene. Dudian casually glanced at the scene. There were no flaws. It was obvious that Peder was someone who had reached the level of Peder, it wasn’t the first time he had done this kind of thing.
“The wall is not far ahead. It is about ten miles away.”Peder respectfully said as he saw Dudian coming.
Dudian nodded slightly and let him lead the way. It didn’t take long for him to see the wall Peder was talking about.
The wall towered into the clouds. It was thousands of meters tall. Its appearance was no different from that of Sylvia. It was magnificent and majestic. However there were a lot of red heat sources on the wall. They should be soldiers stationed on the wall.
Sylvia couldn’t be compared to them in terms of alertness.
“Sir, I have a pass. I can go in directly.”Peder quickly said.
Dudian shook his head: “Use the pass to go in. Your Superior will know about your return to the wall. We will find the best opportunity to sneak in.”
Peder was startled. He wanted to say something but hesitated. In the end he nodded. He didn’t know if Dudian was aware of it or if he really thought so. There was no doubt that using the pass to enter the city would be beneficial to him. He could find an excuse to report the situation to Lord Red Lotus. At the same time he could put aside his relationship with Dudian and the others. Although he didn’t intend to betray Dudian and the others, but at least if they failed to invade the city he would be able to put aside his relationship with them and protect himself. At that time it could be said that Dudian and the others had sneaked into the city by themselves.
After all, the soldiers guarding the city might not remember the appearance of Dudian and the others. Moreover, he could find someone to secretly kill the batch of soldiers who had seen him lead Dudian and the others into the city.
If he entered through the secret passage, once the matter was exposed, if he didn’t return to the giant wall to register, he would inevitably become the focus of suspicion.
Although he was helpless, but he didn’t dare to refute dudian. Moreover, he felt that if he refuted, Dudian might not listen to him. On the contrary, the trust that he had painstakingly built up would collapse.
“Find a place to rest first. Peder, tell me about the situation of the giant Wall’s guards.”Dudian ordered.
Neuss immediately called many of his confidants to find a place to hide and rest. At the same time, he sent people to patrol in case the hunting team saw them.
Peder saw that Dudian had made up his mind. He could only tell Dudian about the situation of the guards. Dudian pondered for a moment and said: “Rest first. We will sneak in at night.”
Night soon came.
Everyone took out pure water and food from their backpacks to eat and drink. They recovered their physical strength. Dudian looked at the clouds in the sky. They covered the moon and the ground immediately became dark, he looked at Neuss and Barton: “Take Peder to the vicinity and Lure a monster to attack the city to attract their attention.”
“Yes, Master.”Neuss nodded.
Peder smiled in his heart but his face was full of admiration: “Master is wise!”
Dudian looked at the situation on the giant wall after they left. He saw that the guards were working in shifts as Peder had said. He glanced at the others: “Apply Cold Crystal Powder and prepare to sneak in.”
“It’s done.”Mason grinned.
Although he was about to sneak into the giant wall which was inhabited by 20 Abyss but he didn’t feel nervous. It was as if he had returned to his childhood when he participated in the Scavenger training with Dudian. No matter how dangerous the situation was.., there was always a way to solve it.
The other confidants weren’t as optimistic as Mason. They looked serious and didn’t dare to breathe.
After a while, an angry roar came from far away like rolling thunder. Dudian’s eyes lit up as he looked towards the source of the sound. He saw Neuss, Barton and Peder. There was a huge heat source behind them, it was like a giant lion.
“Wait here.”Dudian said as his figure disappeared into the night.
Neuss and Barton were running for their lives as they wanted to grow more legs. They wanted to attract a monster within their range but it was obvious that these monsters were not for them to choose from, the strength of this monster was more than twice as strong as they had estimated. Fortunately the giant wall was in front of them. If they were further away they would be in despair.
“Hurry! We will be in front of the giant wall!”Neuss gritted his teeth and cheered for Barton and Peder.
Peder was bitter in his heart. The monster was a master level monster like him. Although he could escape from the mouth of the monster but Neuss and Barton were doomed. He didn’t expect that these two people who were trusted by Dudian.., their strength was so weak. They were only at the inner wasteland level. If he escaped alone then Dudian would definitely investigate and even sacrifice him in anger, so he could only run behind Neuss and Barton. From time to time he would turn back and attack the monster behind him.
Roar!
The monster with blood-red fur roared in anger. It jumped and pounced towards Peder who was at the back.
Peder felt the movement behind him. He clenched his teeth and activated his magic body. He was ready to turn around and attack the monster’s speed. However the angry roar suddenly stopped. He let out a cat-like howl, he saw a god-like figure appear behind him as if he had teleported. Both of his hands were holding onto the front claws of the monster.
Peder saw that it was Dudian. He was relieved as he saw Dudian’s body twist. The monster in his hands was thrown towards the giant wall.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
There were several huge searchlights on the giant wall. The white light beam shone down and shook in all directions. Soon it found the monster that had fallen to the ground.
Although Dudian had thrown the monster far away. It rolled seven or eight times but it quickly got up. It didn’t seem to be injured. It was illuminated by the searchlights. It opened its mouth and roared.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Neuss and Barton didn’t wait for Dudian to say anything. They quickly turned and ran.
Dudian grabbed them and shouted to peder: “Retreat!”
His figure flashed as he disappeared into the darkness with Neuss and Barton. Peder saw that he didn’t have such treatment. His mouth was bitter but he couldn’t complain. He hurriedly ran away.
At this time, the guards on the giant wall had been alerted by the giant lion. A row of giant crossbows shot down from the giant wall. However, the giant crossbow was thousands of meters high. Although it was fast but its accuracy was off by more than ten meters.
The Giant Lion was angered and roared at the giant wall.
Dudian brought Neuss, Barton and others back to the gathering place. He waited for Peder to catch up with them. He took the lead to lead the way and quickly came to a passage under the giant wall.
Dudian saw that there were four guards stationed in front of the passage. All of them were pioneers. At the moment they were looking in the direction of the Roar. They didn’t pay attention to the situation in front of them.
In addition, the guards above the giant wall had moved to the right of his cordon line. Although they were still on patrol line but they were clearly out of the middle position.
When the distance was close to five miles, Dudian suddenly increased his speed. It was as if a ray of dark light was rushing out. There were no weeds in the area outside the giant wall. It wouldn’t affect the vision of the guards so he could only sprint ahead of time.
“Eh?”One of the guards seemed to sense something. He raised his wrist and his face changed: “Someone is approaching!”
