As soon as he finished his words, he saw a black lightning coming towards him. His pupils shrank.
Whoosh!
A Ray shot out from Dudian’s forehead and pierced through the man who was about to call out.
The other three guards reacted. They saw the speed of Dudian. They were scared and panicked. It was too fast. It felt like a giant beast was coming towards them. The next moment they would be trampled to pieces.
Fortunately, they were well-trained. They shouted for help after a second.
Whoosh!
Another Ray shot out and pierced the forehead of the first person who reacted.
At the same time, Dudian’s body was close to them. The strong wind almost flipped them over.
Dudian cut the back of one of them’s neck with a palm knife. His other hand grabbed the neck of the other person and strangled the voice in his throat.
The one who was grabbed by Dudian was a woman. Her skin was white and her face was full of fear. Dudian indifferently looked at her as he knocked her out.
Dudian took out a small metal bottle from his waist bag. He opened the lid and poured a drop of black blood into the mouth of the unconscious woman. He opened the passage behind them, neuss and Peder quietly rushed over in the dark. They were covered in cold crystal powder to cover the heat.
Dudian glanced at the wristwatch of the first person he killed. It was similar to the wristwatch that he had snatched. However it looked simple and crude. He fiddled with it a few times and felt that the program was much simpler, there was no way to detect the life energy value.
Neuss and the others had rushed over and quickly entered the passage.
“Sir, this…”Peder looked at the corpses on the ground. His face was ugly. It was not because he felt sorry for the dead but because it was inevitable that he would be exposed if he was searched.
“Go in!”Dudian whispered.
Peder quickly went into the passage.
There were soldiers on the other side of the passage but they didn’t expect that the passage would suddenly open. They were knocked out before they could see the situation clearly.
“Go.”Dudian led the way and quickly went into the vast wilderness.
Neuss and Peder followed him. In the blink of an eye they disappeared into the wilderness.
Dudian stopped when he was far away from the giant wall. He felt some pain in his chest. He had tried to stop the people from calling for help but his heart was unable to bear it.
“Sir, if they see the corpse…”Peder looked at Dudian again. He was complaining but didn’t dare to say it out loud.
Dudian waved his hand: “Don’t worry. They have just finished their shift so they won’t be replaced for the time being. By the time they replace the corpses they will have been destroyed. It will be difficult to find the traces.”
Peder was puzzled: “Did you ignite the corpses?”
Dudian looked at him. wasn’t igniting the corpses to tell others that it was man-made? He turned to look at the giant wall in the distance. It seemed that the noise had subsided. Most of the giant lion monster had been killed or scared away.
The undeads blood in the woman’s mouth should play a role. By the time the guards changed shifts in the morning, the corpses and the unconscious man would have been eaten by the woman, although there was something strange about the woman being infected as an undead, the death of a few guards was a small matter. Normally, it wouldn’t alarm the higher-ups.
As for the guards stationed in the wall, they were knocked unconscious before they could see clearly. They didn’t know what happened. Even if someone reported it, there was no evidence.
“Let’s find a place to rest.”Dudian didn’t stay any longer and said to peder: “Find a way to help all of us get a legal identity as soon as possible. Remember, you are also smuggled in.”
Peder’s heart skipped a beat. He bitterly smiled but his face showed respect: “Sir, I have long decided to live and die with you. We are on the same boat. I will never betray you.”
“Lead the way.”Dudian waved his hand.
..
… ..
He finally got his driver’s license. He had one hundred out of the other three

chapters.title: Chapter 1018
chapters.content:
Chapter 1018 – Chapter 108: Phoenix Lord
The giant wall of Berga was located in the center of the giant wall. It was also the core area. The territory of the eight lords surrounded the capital. Each lord managed more than a dozen cities, there were hundreds of towns and countless villages.
Peder led Dudian and the others to a remote village. The village was close to the wilderness. There were sharp fences outside the village. They were used to resist the wolves and beasts that wandered over from the wilderness.
There were some ordinary residents in the village. The young and strong ones went to the nearby towns to work for the farmers or to do small businesses. The ones who stayed in the village were old people and children. There was a blacksmith shop, a tavern and a grocery store in the village. The owner of the store was still sleeping at home during the day. There weren’t many businesses throughout the year so he could barely make a living.
On the muddy gravel path in the middle of the village, a few big roosters were pecking at the small insects in the mud. Dudian and the others came and scared the Big Roosters away, a woman carrying a wooden basin full of dirty clothes came out of the house. She was going to wash clothes in the nearby river. She saw Dudian and the others walking in the village. She stopped and looked at them nervously.
Peder’s figure flashed and appeared in front of the village woman. The village woman was scared and threw the wooden basin out.
Peder took the basin and tried to use a kind smile to ask: “Where is the village chief?”
The village woman rarely saw such a handsome young man. Moreover, he was very close to her. It was obvious that he was a big shot. Her face was hot, she stammered nervously: “Village… village chief is in the front of the manor. Are you looking for the village chief?”
“Thank you.”Peder smiled as his figure teleported back. He respectfully said to dudian: “My Lord, Please Follow Me.”
He led the way in front and walked along the gravel path to the end. He saw a wooden fence surrounding the manor. It was called a manor but in fact it was a slightly sturdy wooden house. The wooden fence didn’t cover a large area, there was a dog and a cage of chickens in the house. The dog was tied up. At the moment it felt the smell of a stranger. It immediately began to bared its teeth.
Peder coldly stared at the Black Dog. The dog looked at him in fear. It shrank to the corner of the house and didn’t dare to bark again.
At this time, the barking of the dog startled the people in the house. An old man with gray hair came out. He was wearing rough linen clothes. There was an old metal clip in his chest pocket. He saw Peder and Dudian standing behind him. He was shocked as his eyes widened. He could tell that Dudian and the others were extraordinary from their clothes and temperament.
“Are you the village chief?”Peder’s face didn’t show the previous kindness to the village woman. Instead, he showed a condescending attitude: “We are from the Red Lotus Army. We need to collect some supplies. You should get them ready.”
When the village chief heard the words ‘Red Lotus Army’, his face immediately turned pale with fright. His originally stooped body became even more stooped, and his wrinkled old face became uneasy, “Please, may I ask what resources you need, my Lord? Our Place is barren, and we don’t have anything. I’m afraid…”
“Cut the crap. If you don’t have anything, prepare to go to prison and die!”Pidel berated and interrupted him.
The village chief trembled at his berating and didn’t dare to speak again.
“Prepare thirty sets of clothes. I’ll give you half an hour,”Peder said arrogantly.
The village chief was startled and said hurriedly, “Sir, we’re all wearing coarse clothes here. There’s no silk or brocade at all. I can’t even take out one set!”
Peder frowned and thought for a moment, then said, “Then prepare thirty sets of linen clothes. Be quick. If you delay our time, your old life can’t afford it!”
The village chief was relieved. Although the village was poor but thirty sets of linen clothes could be gathered.
“My Lord, Please Wait a moment. I will go and find them.”
The village chief nodded and bowed. After Peder gave his permission, he quickly walked away. When he passed by Dudian and the others, he felt suffocated as if he was passing by a group of ferocious beasts, it seemed that he would be torn apart at any time.
Not long after, the village chief brought a strong man with him. The strong man’s wrist was rough and full of the smell of iron. He was a blacksmith in the village. He had always had a bad temper. But at this moment, his sturdy body was trembling and his face was full of tension, he was holding a sack which was full of linen clothes.
“Is the quantity correct?”Peder opened the sack and looked at it.
Village chief quickly said: “Absolutely correct. I counted it myself.”In order to prevent the wrong number, he deliberately gave five more sets.
Peder estimated that he didn’t dare to play tricks. He looked at Dudian and asked for instructions.
Dudian nodded slightly and turned to leave.
One of his confidants picked up the sack from the ground and followed behind the crowd. The group left the village.
After watching Dudian and the others leave, the village chief and the blacksmith let out a long sigh. They felt that their heads were full of cold sweat. The humility on the village chief’s face was gone. His narrow eyes slightly moved, he asked the blacksmith: “How is it? Is it possible that they are imposters?”
The blacksmith bitterly smiled, “Old Lu, you know that I have worked as a scavenger in the past. I have seen many big figures. In my opinion, these people are not only members of the Red Lotus Army but also the trump card army! “However, they are actually gathering resources here, and they are even some tattered linen clothes. I really don’t know what they are doing.”
The village chief was startled and immediately said seriously, “You are not allowed to tell anyone about this. Just pretend that it never happened, understand?”
How could a blacksmith not know the stakes involved? It was not beneficial for them to be associated with such a big shot.., “Old Lu, you should tell these words to those women. They have seen it. They will ask questions later.”
“I will warn them.”
“Hopefully this matter will pass.”
..
… ..
After leaving the village, Dudian and others came to the wilderness. They opened the sack and poured out the clothes. There were five more pieces than what Peder wanted. Dudian immediately ordered everyone to change into linen clothes. He left the bag and the witcher. He told Sergei to find a remote place to hide and guard.
“You wait here. We will come to pick you up after we settle down.”Dudian said to Sergei.
“No problem. You can go. I’m not good at this kind of thinking.”Sergei patted his bald head and said to Dudian.
Dudian led Neuss, Barton and others to follow Peder. After they changed into linen clothes they didn’t look so conspicuous anymore. But if they had the intention to observe they would be able to see the difference at a glance, after all they were people who had been fighting on the edge of life and death for a long time. Their temperament was obviously different from ordinary people. Their backs were straight and their eyes were like lightning.
“The plan is to infiltrate the major forces to understand the situation in Borja. Then we will listen to the next instruction.”Dudian told Neuss and the others his idea and plan as he walked, “Before there is a new instruction, your task is to infiltrate the major forces. You will be able to blend in to the extent that you can. Just like in Sylvia.”
Mason licked his lips and excitedly said: “Can we attack after we have a clear understanding of the situation?”
“That depends on the situation. Don’t think about starting a war. Maybe there won’t be a war this time. We are just passers-by. We will be able to stay here and have enough resources for us to use.”Dudian seriously said.
Mason was a bit disappointed but he quickly understood that this was the safest way.
Peder’s eyes lit up after he heard Dudian’s words. It seemed that Dudian didn’t have much confidence or interest in invading the giant wall. If he could hold on until Dudian and the others quietly left.., it would be the safest way for him.
Barton and the other confidants were relieved. Although the previous plan was to attack the giant wall one by one and eventually control the abyss. But the other side was twenty Abyss after all, this wasn’t even counting the existence hidden in the dark. It was too dangerous to rely on Dudian alone. It was the best if they could get along peacefully.
Neuss had been with Dudian for the longest time. He knew that Dudian’s character wasn’t a pacifist. He remembered what Dudian had said before he left Sylvia. He didn’t have a heart and could die at any time. Obviously, even if Dudian took down the giant wall and hid the news like Peder had said.., but in two or three years they would be found out by the Kingdom of God.
Without Dudian’s protection they would all suffer.
In addition, Dudian let them sneak into the forces of all parties. Most of the time he was worried that if he suddenly died, they would be able to continue to live in the giant wall and have a place to live!
Neuss’s nose was slightly sour as he thought of this. He looked at the people around him who were obviously relaxed. He felt bitter in his heart. He was probably the only one who knew Dudian’s intention, in fact, he was more simple and serious than anyone else!
Dudian asked Peder to lead them to get a new identity.
Although Peder had never done such a thing before but it didn’t hinder his understanding of these things. He immediately brought Dudian and others to a nearby town to find the household registration management office, under the threat of force and financial resources, he quickly got three identities.
In fact, in this small town, he had the ability to acquire the identities of all the people. But Dudian told him to only acquire three identities. The rest of the people would go to other towns or cities to acquire three identities, after all, the authority of the village was limited to the nearby villages. If they were to reach the top level and their background was found out, it was inevitable that they would attract attention.
Dudian gave the three identities to himself, Neuss and one of his confidants. The three of them were ordinary residents of different villages so they were exempt from slavery.
After having the identity, things were much more convenient. Dudian rented a few hotels so that Barton and others could rest. He went around the town. Although he wasn’t able to see everything but through the environment of the town.., dudian had a clearer understanding of the holy wall because there were several houses in the small town but there were light bulbs!
There was a good saying that the industry wouldn’t be too bad where there was electricity.
“It seems that the giant wall is connected to the Empire.”Dudian couldn’t help but smile. It was good news for him because he needed a lot of materials to make experimental instruments.
Dudian went back to the hotel after he understood everything, he looked at Neuss: “Go to the nearby big cities and find a force to rely on as soon as possible. I will give you one month. You must make a name for yourself and then take them to get an identity.”
Neuss nodded: “Yes, Master.”
Peder was stunned: “Master, What About Me? I will handle the small matter of getting an identity.”
“You stay by my side.”Dudian faintly said.
Peder couldn’t help but smile. It seemed that Dudian wasn’t completely at ease with him. He sighed in his heart. He felt that this wasn’t necessarily a bad thing. The less things he had to do for Dudian, the safer it would be for him.
“You are responsible for taking care of them.”Dudian said to Neuss’s confidant.
Lucy respectfully nodded: “Yes, Master.”
“Barton, you stay with her in this town for the time being. I will go to the nearby cities to meet her.”Dudian told Barton and the others.
Barton, Aurora and the others were reluctant but nodded in agreement.
After arranging Barton and the others, Dudian took Peder and left the town. He hired a carriage and went to a nearby big city. The money he used along the way was all from Peder. He was the master of the Red Lotus, he had saved a lot of money over the years. He had savings in the four big banks in the Berga Wall. He could feed hundreds of people with just a small amount of money.
Although PIDEL was smuggled into the city so it was inconvenient for him to reveal his identity. But he had the Red Lotus Legion Medal. After showing the medal, he directly entered the city. Even the entrance fee was waived.
Dudian didn’t stay in the city. He changed to a hired carriage and went to the next city.
They met a small town along the way. Dudian asked Pidel to give him a new identity. Two days later, Dudian and Pidel came to one of the eight lords, phoenix Lord lived in the main city.
It had to be said that the grandeur of the main city couldn’t be compared to other ordinary cities. The height and shape of the city walls were magnificent. Especially the main city of the Phoenix Lord.., on the flat and towering city walls, there was a divine bird that looked like it had been painted with bright red paint. It was exactly the appearance of the mythical Phoenix. It looked extremely magnificent and awe-inspiring.

chapters.title: Chapter 1019
chapters.content:
Chapter 1019 – Chapter 1009: Recruitment
It was difficult for Peder to enter Phoenix City with the Red Lotus Legion medal alone. He had to provide identification and entrance fee. Fortunately, he had applied for a new identity along the way. Although he was an ordinary villager but he was still qualified to enter the city.
After entering the city, Dudian went to look for a job. Peder took him to the recruitment association in the city.
The Recruitment Association was a building that occupied a large area. The square and the hall were filled with people. There were more than ten seats in the square. It was set up by the recruitment room. There was a long line in front of each seat, a large number of job seekers were holding their resumes and identification cards.
Dean and PIDEL squeezed into the hall. They saw the bulletin board that was hanging on the wall. It was a bit noisy. Dudian carefully looked at all the recruitment jobs and slightly frowned.
Peder whispered: “My Lord, What’s Wrong? Are there any jobs that you like?”
“What is the name of the organization?”Dudian whispered.
Peder was startled, he whispered: “My Lord wants to work in the Magic Institute?”? “Their recruitment is not here. They only recruit civilians here. The personnel in the demonic research institute are recruited directly from the demonic research institute. To enter the Demonic Research Institute, you need to have a very outstanding brain. However, there is no requirement on the household registration. Sir, you can first enter the demonic research institute to get a graduation certificate before you can apply for a job in the demonic research institute.”
“How long will it take to get a graduation certificate?”
“The fastest is two or three years. There are a lot of things to learn.”
“Too slow.”Dudian gave up the idea as he continued to search for jobs.
Peder knew that Dudian wouldn’t go to the Magic Institute. He quietly stayed by his side and waited for him to choose.
Soon, Dudian found three jobs: Piano Apprentice, gardener of the standing family and chef of the Bourne family.
The requirements of these three jobs were the highest. Among them, the piano apprentice was the most honorable. Even in this recruitment association, piano apprentice was considered a hot occupation. Once the students were successful in their studies, they might be able to become a piano master in the future, if they could compose one or two beautiful songs by themselves, they would be loved by the aristocrats. They would have endless wealth and status.
Many aristocrats and rich people were proud of being invited by a famous piano master. One could imagine how high the status of the piano master was. He was an artist.
The other two professions were relatively ordinary. They were working in big families. Their salaries were much higher than the gardeners and cooks of ordinary families. However, the requirements for their skills were also very harsh.
Dudian picked the jobs and lined up at the next window to receive the recruitment materials.
After waiting for half an hour, he successfully got the recruitment materials for these three professions.
“Let’s go.”Dudian didn’t apply for the job but directly turned around and left.
Peder was puzzled and followed him out of the recruitment association. He asked Dudian: “My Lord, aren’t you going to apply for the job?”
“I’m going to investigate first.”Dudian said.
Soon, Dudian found the work place of the piano apprentice. It was a busy street. There were many noble carriages parked on the roadside, there were guards waiting by the side of the carriage. They were waiting for the owner to come back from shopping.
There was a huge piano room with a width of 20 meters. There was a recruitment notice hanging by the door. There weren’t only piano apprentices but also waiters, guards and other professions.
Dudian and Peder had just walked to the door when the guard next to them stopped them. He frowned: “Why are you two here?”
Dudian didn’t answer. He looked inside and saw that there were many pianos in the huge piano room. There was also a rest area. There were scattered nobles who were dressed brightly. There were special family badges on their clothes, there was also melodious piano music coming from the room.
“It is a profession that can contact the upper class.”Dudian looked at them. He was ready to leave.
The guard who was blocking them was impatient: “Leave if there is nothing. Don’t block the way. This is not the place for you civilians.”
Peder’s blood rushed up as he heard the guard’s words. He was the ace of the Red Lotus Army. He had never been humiliated and looked down upon, however he clenched his teeth as he thought of his identity. He coldly looked at the guard. His eyes were full of murderous intent.
The guard’s scalp was slightly numb as he stared at him.
Dudian had turned around and left. He was neither angry nor angry.
Pidel quickly caught up to him. He asked Dudian: “Sir, are you not satisfied with this place?”
“It’s alright. Let’s look at the other two places.”Dudian said.
Soon, they hired a carriage and arrived in front of the manor of the standing family. It was a prime location surrounded by jewelry shops and grand hotels. However, there were few people on the street in front of the manor, all the passers-by seemed to be far away from the side of the manor. Occasionally, they would pass by the gate and Quicken their footsteps.
Over 10 knights in silver armors were standing in front of the manor of standing clan like javelins. They were standing straight and imposing. Their cold eyes seemed to contain cold electricity. Whenever passers-by passed by, they would feel like being stabbed by needles, they felt uncomfortable all over.
In addition, there were four vicious dogs next to the Knights. They were all two-headed dogs. They were half the height of a man and looked like a small horse. Their whole body was covered in black hair. Their fangs were sharp. It seemed that they would pounce out at any time and bite the throat of the pedestrian!
Dudian and Peder got off the carriage and came to the manor. They looked at the manor. They could feel the solemn atmosphere. However, Dudian’s vision was very far away, he saw that there were many gardeners working on the green lawn. There were maids dressed in white who were playing with children on the path of the manor.
Golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes. The walls of the manor were penetrated. Everyone appeared in his vision. There were a few hidden guards in the dark.
“One master, eight pioneers…”Dudian’s eyes lit up. He didn’t think that any family would be so powerful that they could subvert the entire Sylvia.
He thought for a moment and left.
“Master, the standing family is an old family in the main city of Phoenix. However they are declining day by day. Many of their businesses have been annexed by other families. However I heard that the third daughter of their family has a lot of fighting talent. She has become a disciple of the Lord of Phoenix. I estimate that in a few years the standing family will be able to regain its former strength.”Peder followed behind Dudian, introduce to him.
“You know a lot.”Dudian indifferently said.
PIDEL laughed: “I am here after all. I know a little about these things.”
Dudian didn’t say anything more. He hired a carriage to go to the territory of the Bourne family.
The Bourne family lived on the other side of the main city. The distance was far but they were in the west of the main city. Otherwise they wouldn’t send the recruitment letter to the same recruiter association.
Dudian found that the Bourne family was much weaker than the standing family. The fence was much shorter and not majestic enough. There was rust on the iron fence which made it look old, there was a lot of withered yellow grass on the lawn of the manor. There were only eight knights guarding the gate but each of the Knights had a large Python on their body. It was terrifying.
Although there were a few passers-by outside the manor of standing clan, there was nothing in front of the manor of Bourne clan. Not even a shadow could be seen. There were very few people on the street nearby.
“Sir, this Bourne clan is notorious. They have been accused of child abuse. Additionally, many people have witnessed their disciples abusing children. However, they are too weak to oppose them.”Peder looked at the manor of Bourne clan in front of him, there was a trace of disdain in his eyes. Although he was fierce and had killed many people, but he was very disgusted with those who abused children.
As Peder spoke, Dudian felt the eyes of the eight knights at the door fall on them. Their eyes were cold. If it was an ordinary person he would have turned and left in a hurry. However he was calm and didn’t care. A golden light flashed in his eyes. Soon the situation in the manor of the Bourne family fell into his eyes.
Sure enough, the number of guards in the manor was far less than that of the standing family. However, in terms of the number of experts, the Bourne family was stronger than the standing family. There was a master and ten pioneers in the manor, there was another figure who didn’t have any heat emitted from his body. However, he was sitting in the same room as the other master. It seemed that he was playing chess.
Of course, the chess here was Western chess. The people in the giant wall were like Sylvia. Most of them were leaning towards western faces.
“Eh?”Suddenly, Dudian’s eyes flashed with a strange light.
Soon, the golden light in his eyes disappeared: “Apply here.”
Peder was surprised: “Why?”
Dudian didn’t explain. He walked to the eight knights who were seven or eight meters away from the door. There was a nervous expression on his face: “I, I’m here to apply for a chef. Are you recruiting a chef?”
The eight knights frowned. One of them coldly said: “If you want to apply, go to the recruiter’s Association. We have submitted the recruitment information to the association. We don’t accept private applications.”
Dudian quickly said: “Thank you.”He quickly turned around and left.
He heard the laughter of the eight knights behind him as he left in a hurry. They seemed to think that Dudian’s fleeing figure was a bit funny. It brought a bit of fun to their dull life as a guard.
Peder saw Dudian coming over. He thought that he was good at disguising but the youth in front of him was better than him. Moreover there was no anger on his face, he was really not angry.
This was the demeanor of a strong man. He could bend and stretch. He didn’t have the same knowledge as the watchdogs!
Peder’s heart was full of admiration. He quickly showed his admiration on his face. He left with Dudian, he said in admiration: “Sir, are you really going to work for the Bourne Family? I think the Bourne family is notorious. I don’t think they will treat their subordinates well. Of course, with your strength, they won’t be able to threaten you. But they will be easily exposed…”
“It’s alright. I have my own plans.”
Dudian waved his hand and got into the carriage. He went back to the recruitment association.
Soon, the two of them squeezed into the hall. They looked at the recruitment information. The one from the Bourne family was still there. The one from the piano room and the one from the gardener of the standing family were missing.
“Sure enough, the Bourne family is notorious. No one is willing to go. Moreover the salary is so low.”Peder laughed.
“I’m satisfied.”Dudian was very satisfied. He waited in line. After a moment it was his turn. He submitted his identity but was told by the brown haired beauty behind the counter that he needed to provide a chef’s certificate.
Dudian patted his head and forgot about this.
He left the crowd and smiled. The Recruitment Association was also responsible. They didn’t dare to recommend anyone to the employer. He could only follow the procedure. He asked Peder: “Where can I Get a chef’s certificate?”
Pidel understood, he was annoyed: “I forgot about it. It’s easy to get a chef’s certificate. You can either go to the College of Chefs and graduate with a chef’s certificate or go to the College of chefs. I suggest that we go to the College of chefs. As long as you know a thing or two and spend some money, you can easily buy a certificate.”
Dudian nodded. The certificate was the key to finding a job and money was the highway for the certificate.
Soon, they found a chef training academy. Peder paid 100 gold coins to buy a senior chef’s certificate.
The Senior Chef’s certificate was the limit of the money. As for buying a master’s certificate, they needed to bribe more people. The cost would be 10 times or 100 times more. One had to know that 100 gold coins was equivalent to the salary a high-level chef could earn in ten years. Moreover, the certificate bought did not necessarily mean that one was really a high-level chef. After applying for the job, one would have to face the employer. If one did not have any skills.., one would be fired very soon. Therefore, no one would be foolish enough to buy a high-level chef’s certificate. However, some rich children were exceptions. The certificate could increase their social connections and show off.
Of course, nobles wouldn’t buy these civilian professional certificates. They usually bought certificates such as piano master to gild their identity.
After getting the certificate, the two returned to the recruitment association. The recruitment of the Bourne family was still there. Soon, Dudian used the senior chef’s certificate to smoothly apply for the job. After all, the above requirements only required him to be an intermediate chef.
..
… ..
I hope the students who finished the exam can find a good job in the summer vacation!

chapters.title: Chapter 1020
chapters.content:
Chapter 1020 – Chapter 110: Strange Castle
“Master, you have gone to the Bourne family. Where am I going?”Peder and Dudian walked out of the recruitment association. They saw that Dudian didn’t want them to join the Bourne family.
Dudian glanced at him: “You should find a job near the Bourne family. You should be ready to be dispatched at any time. It is best if you don’t leave the range of the Bourne family. You should understand the consequences if I can’t sense you.”
Peder was shocked. Range of perception of 30 miles? He was also a person with excellent perception. He could sense movement from 30 miles away in the wilderness or even further. However he couldn’t sense clearly. In the crowded Phoenix city, it was extremely difficult to lock onto people from ten miles away. After all, it wasn’t something that could be done simply by relying on smell and hearing.
“Sir, Pidel is loyal to you. I hope you don’t doubt me. I will never betray you. We are on the same boat.”Although Pidel was shocked but his reaction wasn’t slow, he replied with a respectful smile.
Dudian indifferently said: “It’s best if you are a smart person. Even if my identity is leaked, it will be very difficult for the people here to keep me. If I can escape then you should know how terrifying an Abyss Avenger is hiding in the dark.”
Peder bitterly smiled in his heart. He naturally knew this. It was because he knew that he didn’t want to betray Dudian and secretly inform on him. After all, if Dudian survived then his situation would be dangerous, it would be a thankless task. Moreover he couldn’t explain to Red Lotus. He couldn’t say that he had deliberately used a scheme to lure them over. Red Lotus might not believe him but would think that he was afraid of death.
After hiring the carriage, the two came to the outside of the Bourne family.
Dudian told Peder to wait by the street. He held the recruitment certificate issued by the Recruitment Association and came to the gate of the manor. The eight knights looked over. Apparently they still remembered Dudian, when they saw the recruitment certificate in Dudian’s hand, they slightly raised their eyebrows. There was a faint sneer on their lips. It seemed that there was another meaning behind it.
Dudian ignored it and calmly said, “I’m here to apply for the position of Chef. This is the certificate issued by the Recruitment Association.”He handed over the certificate.
The giant python coiled around the knight’s shoulder slightly raised its head. Its vertical pupils were staring at Dudian. It seemed that it would bite at any time.
The Knight was worried that the giant python on his shoulder would suddenly attack Dudian. He touched the head of the giant Python and comforted it. He took the certificate from Dudian and looked at dudian. He was a bit surprised, as a civilian, Dudian’s face was fearless. If it was an ordinary person who saw their pets, they would be scared to death.
He didn’t think too much. His eyes fell on the certificate. He looked at the seal and saw that it was from the recruitment association. He nodded and said: “Come with me. I will take you to see the Butler.”
He opened the door and led the way.
Dudian followed him into the gate. He looked back and saw that the gate was closed by the Knights on both sides. He looked through the iron fence and saw Peder. Both of them knew what each other meant.
Peder nodded slightly and left.
Dudian retracted his eyes and followed the knight. He casually looked at the scenery in the manor.
There weren’t many servants in the manor. Along the way he saw two old gardeners trimming the landscape trees. Some of the sprinklers were still sprinkling on the lawn while others had cut off the water, it was obvious that there was a malfunction in the equipment. It couldn’t be compared to the previous standing family. There was a bleak and dilapidated feeling. It seemed that they were a declining aristocrat.
Dudian climbed over the hillside and saw several towering buildings in front of the forest. They were hundreds of meters tall. The architectural style was more Gothic. There was a strange and gloomy feeling which gave people a very quiet feeling.
When he came to the edge of the forest, Dudian saw a fat little boy squatting on the grass. He was about five or six years old. He squatted on the grass and kept drawing something, he looked like an ordinary child playing with stones on the roadside.
The Knight saw the fat boy and respectfully bowed: “Master Leo.”
The fat boy was slightly stunned. He turned back and stood up from the ground. At this time, Dudian saw that both of his hands were covered in blood. It was extremely sticky and looked like red fruit juice. He looked at the rabbit lying on the ground, the head of the rabbit was twisted one hundred and eighty degrees.
Dudian slightly frowned as he looked at the Fatty.
The fatty stared at the knight and Dudian. He didn’t say anything but his eyes were very strange.
The knight forced a smile: “Master, this is the new cook. I will cook some delicious food for you. I will take him to report to the Butler.”
He stepped forward.
Fatty had been watching them leave for a long time. Dudian looked back and saw that fatty was still staring at their back.
“We are here.”The voice of the knight came from the front.
Dudian looked up and saw that they had come to a towering building along the gravel path. The building was covered in moss. It looked like it had been in disrepair for a long time. There was a huge bat pattern on the door, it was baring its fangs and claws.
There were two expressionless knights guarding the door. They opened the door for the two of them after the Knight explained the purpose of their visit.
The inside of the door was dark and cold. Dudian felt that the temperature around him had dropped a bit. He saw that the Knight’s face was stiff and unnatural, but he still raised his feet and walked inside.
The light in the cold building was dim. There was only one lamp lit. The flickering light was lonely and cold.
Dudian’s vision was not affected by the darkness. He saw an empty throne above the building. There were knights in black armor standing on both sides of the stone pillars. Their bodies were almost one with the darkness. It was difficult to see them clearly, moreover their bodies stood motionless like stone sculptures.
At this time, a young woman who was dressed as a maid came over from the darkness. Her face was white and there was a soul-stirring beauty. She smiled at the Knight who was leading the way: “Who is this person?”
The knight who was leading the way saw him and hurriedly bowed his head: “This is the candidate recommended by the Recruitment Association. He is a chef.”He handed over Dudian’s certificate.
The young woman didn’t take it. She glanced at dudian and nodded: “Wait here. I will call the Butler.”
Her body seemed to float away as she walked quietly.
Dudian saw that her feet landed on the ground. Her steps were very strange. There was a good technique hidden in her steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 1021
chapters.content:
Chapter 1021 – Chapter 10011: Temptation
It didn’t take long for the charming maid to come back. She was followed by a figure wearing a black tuxedo. It was a pale middle-aged man with dark blue eyes. His eyes were deep and his nose bridge was high, his cheeks had a three-dimensional outline. He was very handsome.
His face was cold as he looked at Dudian. He took the certificate of the Knight who was leading the way. Dudian’s identity was recorded on it. He nodded slightly, “Senior Chef? My salary is only 20 silver coins per month. Are You Willing?”
Dudian looked disappointed as he hesitated: “Can… can I add more?”
The middle-aged Butler frowned and pondered for a moment: “Since you are a senior chef, I will give you five silver coins. If you are willing then stay. If you are not willing then leave.”
Dudian hesitated for a moment but finally showed a determined look: “I am willing.”
The middle-aged Butler slightly raised his eyebrows in surprise. His dark blue eyes slightly narrowed as he stared at dudian: “Why? With your conditions, you should be able to find a better place.”
“I need money urgently.”Dudian lowered his head as if it was difficult for him to speak. Both of his hands were constantly rubbing the clothes. He looked very restrained and nervous.
The middle-aged Butler’s eyes lit up, dudian indifferently said: “I’ll tell you in advance that you have to work for at least one year. Otherwise, you should know the price of violating the labor contract. However, I can predict your salary for three months in advance. What do you think?”
Dudian looked at the butler with gratitude: “Thank You Sir!”
The Butler smiled and said to the maid: “Angela, take him to the kitchen and see his cooking. Second Miss is hungry so let him make a pastry.”
“Yes, Butler.”The charming maid smiled and nodded. She winked at Dudian: “Mr. Cook, please follow me.”
Dudian’s face turned red as he bowed his head.
Angela led dudian through the hall and came to the back of the hall. They went through a few rooms and went through a door. The kitchen was at the back of the building.
Dudian saw three people wearing chef’s clothes sitting on the wooden bench outside the kitchen. They were playing a game of drawing ghosts. The three of them were startled when they saw Angela. They quickly stood up and respectfully said: “Hello Miss Angela, why are you here?”
Angela glanced at the three of them and slightly frowned: “Why? I Can’t come here?”
The three of them hurriedly waved their hands. One of them laughed: “Of course you can. Miss Angela, you are as beautiful as ever. Eh, who is this person?”
Angela was immune to his flattery, she waved her hand: “This is the new chef. He is younger than you but he is a senior chef. You should learn from him in the future. Now go out. I want to see his cooking skills.”
The three of them looked at Dudian in surprise. They didn’t expect that the young man in linen clothes was a senior chef. The three of them heard Angela’s words. Their eyes flashed as they looked at each other. They laughed as they bowed their heads and left.
After the three of them left, Angela closed the kitchen door and walked to Dudian. She gently raised her hand and cupped Dudian’s chin. Her snow-white cheeks were full of charm, she licked her lips: “Mr. Chef, you are so handsome!”
Dudian was startled as he saw the desire in her eyes. His fingers slightly clenched but soon loosened. He blushed and looked away: “Miss Angela, you are joking. What do you need me to cook to prove my cooking skills?”
Angela smiled and turned to Dudian’s face. She moved closer to Dudian. Their lips almost touched. Dudian could smell the strong fragrance coming from her body, he leaned back and forced a smile: “Miss Angela, you seem to be too close to me.”
Angela’s eyes lit up when she saw Dudian’s shy look. She lifted Dudian’s chin with her finger and said in a soft voice: “Your Chef’s dishes are right in front of you. Aren’t you going to try them?”
Dudian bitterly smiled: “Miss Angela, if we don’t make the pastries soon, won’t second miss wait for too long?”
Angela’s upper body was leaning on Dudian’s body. Her fingers gently tapped on Dudian’s chest. She was very playful and had a fatal temptation, “Mr. Chef, don’t you want it? Don’t you understand the intentions of others? Don’t you like to be passive?” She looked up at dudian.
Dudian sighed in his heart and hugged her body: “Of course I like to be active.”
Angela felt Dudian’s arm strangle her. There was a bit of intoxication in her eyes as she said: “I like you like this…”she stopped before she finished her sentence. Her head shook and fell onto Dudian’s shoulder, her body also went soft.
Dudian gently put her body aside. His face had recovered its coldness. He turned around and turned on the water tap in the kitchen. He washed his hands several times before he turned off the water tap, he looked at the kitchen. It could be seen from here that the technology of the giant wall of Berga was widespread. In Sylvia, one needed to scoop water from the well.
However, the underground water pipes and pumps were used here.
Dudian opened the cabinet and found flour and some ingredients. He began to cook in the kitchen.
Soon, a piece of steamed western-style pastry was out of the oven. He turned around and opened the kitchen door. Three figures fell in. They were the three chefs from before.
The three of them quickly got up and looked around. They saw Angela lying on the ground. She seemed to be sleeping soundly. They were a bit surprised but quickly recovered. They awkwardly asked: “How are you?”
Dudian frowned as he saw the three’s eyes. He suddenly remembered that he had overlooked something. He blocked in front of Angela and asked: “What Flavor of pastry does second miss like?”
“Sweet, Sweet.”The three quickly replied.
Dudian nodded and closed the kitchen door.
He turned around and pulled out Angela’s clothes. He washed his hands and made a pastry. This time he added a lot of sugar and fruit juice. He opened the kitchen door.
The three chefs were sitting not far away. They looked through the gap of the door. They didn’t look carefully but now they saw that Angela’s clothes had been touched. The white outline of her chest was clearly visible. It was very attractive.
The three came over and gave a thumbs up to dudian: “Brother, Awesome.”
Dudian asked: “Where is the room of the second miss? Do you need me to personally deliver the cake?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1022
chapters.content:
Chapter 1022 – : Chapter 10012: Morbid Family
“Is this the second Miss’s pastry?”The three of them were slightly surprised. One of the bearded middle-aged men quickly said: “The second miss lives in the sixth room on the second floor. You can send it to her.”
Dudian nodded and left with the pastry.
Not long after he walked out of the kitchen, he heard three people whispering behind him.
“Hey, why did you ask him to deliver food to the second miss? We haven’t tasted it yet. What if it doesn’t taste good?”
“You know the second miss’temper. If she isn’t satisfied with the food, this brother will be in trouble.”
“You two idiots. Didn’t you hear what Miss Angela said? He is a high-level chef and so young. Angela is already attracted to this gigolo. If he stays here in the future, won’t this kitchen be under his control?”? The three of us will be his subordinates. If he is driven away then our lives will be more stable.”
“Well, that’s true.”
“This kid has good luck with women. Tut Tut, that slut Angela likes this kind of gigolo.”
“Shhh, if Angela hears your words, she will skin you alive.”
“What are you afraid of? Didn’t you see that she was made to sleep? It will be great.”
Dudian walked further and further away, but the three of them were still able to hear their words clearly. He slightly raised his eyebrows but didn’t stop. He carried the pastry to the stairs and then walked up the rare wooden stairs, he saw several maids standing at the stairs.
These maids were genuine maids. They were obviously different from Angela. They were dressed in maid’s clothing. Their hands were crossed under their abdomen. They lowered their heads and looked at each other. They were silent like white stone sculptures.
Dudian went up the stairs. The nearest maid immediately stopped him with a cold expression: “Who are you? What is this?”
“I am a new cook. This is pastry for second miss.”Dudian said in a cautious tone.
The maid looked at him and thought that he didn’t have the courage to lie. She nodded and said: “Come with me.”She turned around and led the way.
Soon, the two came to the sixth room. The maid gently knocked on the door and whispered: “Second miss, the pastries you wanted are here.”Her voice became very soft and pleasant, it was different from the cold tone she used to speak to Dudian.
Standing outside the door, Dudian could faintly hear strange moans coming from inside. He could feel the situation in the room. His eyes flashed a bit strange. When the maid turned around, she returned to her reserved look.
“Come in.”
A light and elegant voice came from the room.
The maid was relieved and pushed the door open.
The first thing Dudian saw was a blood-red fluffy carpet. When he entered the room, he saw that it was an extremely spacious room. There was a big bed in the huge room, four to five meters wide, there was a lifelike oil painting hanging on the wall behind the bed. In the painting was a beautiful woman. She was elegant and dignified. However, at this moment, a strange scene was playing out under the painting.
Two muscular young men were naked and tied to the bed. In front of them was a young girl wearing a black silk short skirt. She was holding a rugged black whip in her hand. The corners of her mouth were raised in an arrogant arc, one of her feet was stepping on the back of one of the young men. She looked down at the two of them from above. She looked like the Queen of the battlefield, but the entire bed was filled with a lustful atmosphere.
The maid seemed to be used to this. She looked down at her feet and respectfully said: “Second miss, your pastries are here.”
The girl turned her head and glanced at Dudian’s appearance. Her eyes lit up as she turned around with interest. She slightly raised her head and arrogantly said: “You, come here.”
Dudian sighed in his heart but still walked over.
“He is good looking but unfortunately he is a civilian.”The girl looked at dudian: “Take Off your clothes and let me see.”
Dudian was surprised as he didn’t expect the girl to be so direct. He quickly replied: “Second miss, I have just applied for the position as a chef. I have specially brought you pastries. I hope you can taste them.”
The girl frowned: “Are you a chef?”
Dudian nodded.
“Humph!”The girl snorted as her expression turned cold: “You don’t know what’s good for you!”
Dudian was speechless in his heart. He suddenly felt that this family was a bit morbid. Whether it was the young master called Leo or the girl in front of him, including the butler.., all of them gave him a strange and morbid feeling.
However, when he thought about the scene of the family underground, he more or less understood.
“You go out first.”The girl said to the maid.
The maid respectfully took her leave and closed the door.
The room suddenly became quiet. Only the two young men who were tied up made strange sounds from time to time. Dudian felt a chill and his scalp went numb.
“I’ll give you another chance. Take off your clothes.”The girl arrogantly said.
Dudian felt a headache. He thought for a moment and put the pastry on the table. He stepped forward and whispered: “Miss, are you going to take off your clothes like this?”He untied his belt.
The girl’s impatience was slightly restrained. It seemed that she was a bit hesitant but soon she proudly said: “Hurry up.”
“Is that so?”Dudian’s movements were very slow and his voice became erratic.
There was a trace of absent-mindedness in the girl’s eyes. She still maintained an impatient tone: “That’s it.”
“Is it really so?”Dudian’s fingers were still moving slowly. But if someone saw it, they would find that Dudian’s fingers were not moving the belt. Instead, his fingers were rotating, leaving behind afterimages, when both hands were moving at the same time, there seemed to be countless afterimages.
There was a trace of confusion in the girl’s eyes: “So it’s true.”
“Miss, look carefully. Is It True?”Dudian slowly approached. There were more and more afterimages between his fingers. He slowly raised his fingers and approached the girl’s eyes.
The girl looked at him in a daze.
Dudian whispered: “Miss, you are sleepy.”
The girl instinctively yawned. Her eyelids drooped.
“You need to rest.”Dudian continued.
The girl’s face was more sleepy. Her body slightly swayed as if she would fall down at any time.
“Miss?”One of the tied youth felt strange. He turned his head and saw the countless afterimages of Dudian’s fingers. He couldn’t help but be surprised.
Dudian ignored him. He continued to look at Miss: “You need to rest now. I Won’t disturb miss. You can sleep…”
Miss slowly closed her eyes. Her body swayed as she fell down.
Dudian grabbed her and slowly put her down.
He hit the other youth and knocked him out.
The youth’s eyes were wide open as he saw the shadow of Dudian’s fingers. He looked at him in disbelief.
Dudian slowly approached and turned his fingers: “You are very tired. You need to rest…”
The youth looked at him in horror. He wanted to shout but Dudian pinched his mouth. He felt that the back of his head had been hit. His mind was a mess and he was a bit confused, the fingers that appeared in his eyes were like beams of light.
“Forget all this. You need to rest…”
Dudian’s voice echoed in the ears of the young man. His eyelids slowly drooped.
After a moment Dudian hypnotized the young man to sleep. He picked up the pastry and ate it with a fork. He turned around and left the room.
“Phew, it’s really troublesome.”Dudian sighed as he closed the door. He felt a bit helpless. He shook his head and walked along the corridor. He passed by the maid who looked at him but didn’t say anything.
Dudian went back to the kitchen. The three of them were surprised to see that Dudian’s hands were empty. They couldn’t help but ask: “Where’s the pastry? Did you give it to the second miss?”
Dudian nodded slightly.
“Did she eat it?”
“Yes, she said it tasted good.”
“Ugh…”the three of them felt as if their throats were choked. After a while they reacted and came over to congratulate him.
Dudian smiled as he casually echoed a few sentences. He went into the kitchen and saw that Angela was still lying down as before. He gently touched her. Soon, Angela woke up and opened her eyes, she suddenly sat up.
As soon as she sat up, she saw the messy clothes on her body. She couldn’t help but blush. She felt a bit shy but soon she woke up. She turned her head and stared at Dudian, “Why did I Fall Asleep?”
Dudian smiled and said ambiguously: “Your body is too weak.”
Angela almost laughed out of anger. Her body was weak? She was a pioneer and an expert among pioneers. How could a civilian say that her body was weak? She looked at dudian suspiciously. Suddenly she stretched out her hand. Her nails protruded out like sharp knives. She grabbed at Dudian’s face.
Dudian was stunned for a moment. It seemed that he didn’t react at all.
Angela stopped when her nails touched Dudian’s cheek. She frowned as she looked at dudian.
A smear of blood appeared on Dudian’s cheek. He touched it and saw the blood on his fingers. His eyes opened wide as he looked at Angela in horror. He stepped back but fell down.
The last doubt in Angela’s heart was dispelled when she saw Dudian in such a sorry state. The master who could make her unconscious was at least at the master level. How could he be in such a sorry state?
She could feel that Dudian didn’t react at all. Even the pores on his body didn’t shrink. If he was really an expert and felt her killing intent, even if he tried his best to endure it, his body’s instinct would change, but Dudian didn’t. This could only mean that his fighting instinct was too weak. He was just an ordinary person.
“Have I been too tired recently?”Angela frowned slightly. She felt strange. She suddenly felt that it was necessary to go to the doctor to see if there was anything wrong with her body or if she had some disease.
She didn’t have the mood to make out with Dudian. She quickly stood up and tidied up her clothes. She quickly returned to her previous dignified appearance and left.
After watching Angela leave, Dudian was relieved. He was still in shock.
The three people outside the door saw that Dudian was in such a sorry state. They secretly laughed in their hearts and secretly gloated over his misfortune.
Therefore, Dudian’s entry into the family was smooth and stable. In the evening, he worked with the other three chefs to prepare dinner for the earl, his three sons, and his five daughters, of course, there were also his seven wives.
Serving food was not his business. For these nobles, the Cook was also a pariah occupation. They were not worthy of a seat unless they were master chefs. Such chefs often had a better name: Gourmet.
Dudian and the other three chefs were busy cooking for the other big shots. They were the guardians of the Bourne family. Dudian sensed that the master was one of them, there were ten pioneers as well.
Dudian knew the names of the pioneers and the master while he was cooking. He also knew that the person who had played chess with the master had hidden his body heat, his status was equal or even higher than the master. He was qualified to sit on the chair and eat with the Bourne family. The three chefs called him Lord Black Mage.
Dudian’s Day’s work was basically over after dinner. The three chefs were temporarily responsible for helping Dudian familiarize with the kitchen, the master and the young masters.
Late at night.
Dudian returned to his assigned residence and slept in the same room with the three chefs. It didn’t take long for the three chefs to fall asleep and Snore.
Dudian leaned against the pillow and looked at the moonlight shining through the window. His eyes flashed with a golden light as he looked at the movement of the castle.
He saw that the family head of the Bourne family had fallen asleep. The second miss he had hypnotized didn’t show any unusual behavior during the previous dinner. The hypnosis effect was very successful. At the moment she was in her own room, she was playing the sick game in the afternoon.
In addition, Dudian saw the son of the patriarch of the Bourne family sneak into his wife’s room and do something against ethics.
“This family is really hopeless…”Dudian felt that everything here was absurd. He knew that the master and the ten pioneers were aware of the young master’s improper behavior, however, they didn’t inform the patriarch of the Bourne family.
The name of the Patriarch of the Bourne family was barret. Bourne was an ordinary civilian but the heat in his body was slightly higher than that of ordinary people. It seemed that he had taken some special medicine to strengthen his physique.
“It seems that the master is not 100% loyal to the Patriarch.”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He could see the entire Bourne family in his eyes, he had discovered this huge secret. From this point he could feel the complicated relationship within the family.
He wasn’t in the mood to understand this kind of relationship. But he felt that the twisted young master might be able to use it.
He saw the person called black mage enter the castle through the secret passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 1023
chapters.content:
Chapter 1023 – Chapter 10013: Rebirth
The basement of the castle was a three-story basement. This kind of underground building was not uncommon in other noble castles. Most nobles liked to build cellars, where they kept some high-quality wine and books, they also had their own gold, jewelry, and wealth. However, in this underground building of the Bourne family, there were no such things as mentioned above. There were only instruments and people.
There were a variety of instruments placed in the basement of each floor. Some instruments were more like torture instruments. There were eight rooms in each basement. The rooms were either stacked with torture instruments or imprisoned people. Most of them were around twenty years old. Their bodies were strong and healthy, and they were at the peak of their vitality.
The person called the black mage was an old man around sixty years old. He wore a black hood and his hair was extremely neat and beautiful. Silver and black hair interweaved, and his face was deep. Although he was old.., one could still tell that he was once very handsome when he was young. At this moment, he came to the basement through the secret spiral staircase. The people guarding the basement were all dressed in black robes, looking like ghosts.
Seeing the Dark Wizard’s arrival, the black-robed guard lowered his head and bowed.
The Dark Wizard went straight to the second floor of the basement and stopped in front of the fourth room in the middle. He pushed open the door and saw a laboratory. At this moment, a woman with a full figure was lying on the metal bed in the laboratory, her hands and feet were shackled to the side of the bed and she was in a semi-conscious state. When she heard the movement, the woman slowly opened her eyes. When she saw the black mage, her face immediately revealed a ferocious and vicious expression.
The black mage was not frightened by the ferocious gaze on her face. Instead, he smiled slightly. “Not bad. It seems that you have already adapted to it. Blindly struggling will only hurt yourself. Very good.”
The voluptuous woman glared at him and gritted her teeth. “You scum. One day, the temple will arrest you and burn you with the Holy Fire!”
The black mage lifted his hood and his silver-gray hair fell down. Under the dim yellow light, his body was straight. Just by looking at his back, he looked like a majestic Holy Knight. However, there were wrinkles on his face, and the erosion of time could not be resisted, with a smile on his face, he shifted his gaze from the woman’s face down to her neck and slowly moved to her chest. This was definitely not a part that a man would be impulsive upon seeing, but a scene that would cause his eggs to shrink in an instant.
The woman’s collarbone was still snow-white, but her skin came to an abrupt stop here. The lower half of her neck was cut open, and inside was clearly visible flesh and blood, as if it had been skinned alive. and at the lower part of the flesh and blood.., at the level of the heart, a few collarbones opened up like the claws of a skeleton. Inside, there was a cluster of slightly twisting dark red tissue and a red beating heart.
The Black Mage’s eyes were shining, as if he was admiring a perfect piece of art. There was a hint of fanaticism and intoxication in his eyes, although he could see it very clearly with his vision.., but at this moment, his body could not help but lean forward. He moved closer, as if he wanted to see every single blood vessel carefully.
The woman saw his expression and felt nauseous. She looked at him with disgust. “You betrayed Lord Bourne. Sooner or later, you will be executed!”
When the black mage heard his words, he tilted his head slightly and looked at her, he chuckled. “If I’m going to be judged, then only God can judge me. Unfortunately, there is no God in this world. Those people in the temple only know how to play tricks. “Besides, their business is not much better than mine. The only difference is that they are powerful, so they are legal. I don’t obey their rules, so I’m not legal.”
The woman spat, “A villain like you should die without a burial place!”
The black mage smiled and turned to leave. He waved his hand and said, “Since you want me to die so much, you should live well. Otherwise, how could you see that day?”
After saying that, he left the room and casually brought the room with him.
After leaving the room, the black mage went to a laboratory on the third underground floor. This laboratory was soaked in all kinds of organs that had been cut off. There were the heads of infants, the severed hands of women, as well as the eyeballs and sharp claws of wild beasts.., there were also the hearts and stomach organs that were soaked in a dark red color. It was impossible to tell if they were human or monster.
Black mage took off his coat and hung it on the side. He changed into his lab uniform and took out a small glass tube from the freezer. There was a parasitic soul worm inside. He took it to the table and turned on the lamp. He used tweezers to pick out the parasitic soul worm. He used a knife to slice it and put it in front of the instrument to observe.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he saw the instrument. It was a microscope. The structure was similar to the old era but the material was obviously made by the later generations. There were obvious splicing marks.
“It doesn’t take much effort.”Dudian smiled but didn’t act immediately. He was going to observe again to see if there were any forces behind the Bourne family.
One night passed.
Dark mage fiddled with all kinds of organs in the laboratory. Dudian observed the whole night. The next morning, Dark Mage felt tired. He left the basement and went back to the castle to rest. Dudian took the opportunity to close his eyes and rest. Less than an hour later, the dawn of dawn shone on the castle. Dudian sat up with a sleepy face and yawned.
At this time, the other three also got up one by one and washed up.
Dudian washed up and followed the three to the kitchen. At this time, the vegetable vendors in the market had sent their orders to the castle. They went to receive them, then a carriage specially equipped with the kitchen was used to transport the few large packages of vegetables back to the kitchen.
Next, the few of them divided the work. Washing vegetables, cutting vegetables, making cakes and so on.
Breakfast was easy to make. Milk and vegetables, this was Barrett’s. Bourne’s, the taste was light. Milk and bacon, this was Barrett’s sons’, milk and snacks, this was the ladies’.
As for the other ten pioneers and rulers, they were all milk and steak, eating high-calorie food early in the morning.
After they finished making breakfast, they prepared the dishes for lunch in advance and waited until the time to make it.
During this time, they could take an hour off to rest. The three of them were sitting in the corner of the kitchen chatting or yawning. Dudian leaned against the chair and closed his eyes to sleep.
Three meals a day were soon over. In the evening when Dudian was ready to go back to rest, he met Angela. She deliberately came to find Dudian. As one of the top ten pioneers in the castle, her status was only slightly lower than the butler, the strength of the Butler was not strong. He was just an ordinary person. But in this world, power was more important than strength. No matter how strong a person was, he had no background. He was just a senior fighter.
As for rebellion and rebellion? There would always be other experts who were willing to submit or were held hostage by means of subjugation.
“You, come with me.”Angela stopped Dudian and the other three on their way back to the dormitory. She pointed at Dudian who was walking in front of them.
Dudian slightly frowned and nodded.
When he followed Angela not far away, he heard the envious voices of the three people behind him.
“This kid is really lucky in love.”
“It seems that Angela is addicted to him.”
“It seems that this kid is going to be squeezed dry.”
Dudian looked at Angela who was in front of him. She should be able to hear such a voice but there was no reaction. It seemed that this woman didn’t have too many taboos in this area.
Dudian walked to a lawn and asked: “Miss Angela, where are you taking me?”
“Go to my room. I have something to talk to you about.”Angela stopped. Her face was no longer cold but had a hint of charm.
Dudian wryly smiled: “Miss Angela, those three seniors are strong. Why Don’t you go and Find Them?”
Angela’s face turned cold: “What kind of person do you think I am? Do you think I will be interested in any kind of goods? Just because of those three pigs? They are as ugly as a pile of shit. Bah! They are not even qualified to carry My Shoes.”
Dudian couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
“Hurry Up! Don’t waste my time. It’s getting late.”Angela urged.
Dudian’s heart was moved. He quickly followed after her.
Angela turned her head and walked away. However she heard a scream from behind. She looked back and saw that Dudian had fallen to the ground.
“How could you be so careless?”Angela hurried to help him up.
Dudian looked up. There was a bloody scar on his cheek.
Angela was shocked: “What Happened to you?”She saw that there was a small stone where Dudian was wrestling. It was stained with blood. Apparently Dudian’s face had scratched it.
Dudian’s facial features wrinkled in pain: “It hurts! It Hurts!”
It had to be said that no matter how good-looking a face was, as long as one was willing to pay attention to it, they would be able to make an ugly gesture. At the moment Dudian’s facial features were wrinkled. His lips were curled up. His eyes were rolling and his cheeks were distorted. He looked very ugly.
Angela suddenly felt that she had lost all interest. She didn’t expect that a small scratch would make Dudian look so miserable. For her, getting injured was just a common occurrence. But looking at Dudian’s appearance.., he was clearly a genuine pretty boy. He had a handsome skin bag. He would die if he got injured. Although she could use her good-looking skin bag to negate all the shortcomings, but at the moment Dudian was not good-looking and weak. She was disappointed and let go of her hand that was originally supporting him, she frowned: “Don’t shout. Go and find Mr. Rand. or go back and clean your wound. It’s not a serious injury. You Won’t die.”
Dudian covered his injured face. He was in so much pain that his nose was running. He endured the pain: “But, but, I have to go to your place…”
“There is no need to go.”Angela said impatiently before he finished.
Dudian was stunned. He had forgotten about the pain on his face.
Angela was even more annoyed when she saw his stunned eyes. She turned around and walked away.
As she walked, she suddenly thought, how could there be such a coincidence? She had just despised the other three ugliness when Dudian’s face was cut. Could it be that he did it on purpose? She couldn’t help but turn her head to look at him. The thought disappeared as she saw Dudian covering his face. His shoulders were shaking and he was sobbing. It was… painful!
She shook her head and quickly walked away. She wanted to find some other fun while it was still early in the night.
Dudian didn’t look for Rand. He covered his face as he went back to the dormitory. He used his fingers to gently scratch the wound to prevent it from healing.
In fact, the wound wasn’t caused by his knock. Even if he used force to rub the stone on his face, he might not be able to cut the wound. He used his fingernails to cut his cheek as he fell, then, he threw his face onto the stone. Only then did it appear as if he had knocked against it.
He discovered that after experiencing Crimson Moon’s experiment, his body’s self-healing ability had increased by several levels. First, his legs and hands, as well as the scars that he had left behind in prison, had all healed!
His broken legs had also recovered. The dark scars from before had also faded away. Inside, there was brand new skin. Not a single scar could be seen on his body. Even the magic marks on his chest had disappeared.
Unfortunately, this amazing healing ability did not affect his chest. His heart was still incomplete.
However, after these days of observation, Dudian found that the heart seemed to have grown a little bit. It seemed that it would grow.
This ignited hope in Dudian’s heart. Perhaps the heart would continue to grow until it completely adapted to his body and became a new heart in his body!
The three people in the dormitory were shocked when they saw Dudian coming back with blood on his face. They quickly came over to inquire about the situation. Dudian only said that he was hurt by a stone. Although the three of them were jealous of Dudian but they quickly poured water for him and helped him clean his wound. Dudian looked at them in a different light.
The three of them took out the first aid hemostatic medicine from the dormitory and applied it on Dudian. They gave a few instructions before returning to their own beds.
The three of them quickly fell asleep at night. Dudian used his X-ray vision to observe everything in the castle. He saw the young master who climbed to his father’s concubine’s room from the window last night, tonight he climbed to another young girl’s room from the window. It was Barret’s eldest daughter. She seemed to be the same father and mother as the young master.
Dudian sighed. The young master was full of energy.
Dudian’s attention was mainly focused on the black mage. He found that the black mage was the key person in the castle, moreover he wasn’t a guard or Knight hired by Barret. It was similar to the identity of a guest. However it seemed that the black mage wasn’t just a guest in the castle.
At the moment, the black mage was reading in his study. His study was very spacious and there were many books on display. Through the perspective, Dudian could see the words on the back of the paper, he found that he was looking at a few strange drawings of human anatomy. The human and monster’s limbs were mixed together. It looked like the experiment of the insect-man in Sylvia. It was a combination of half human and half monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024
chapters.content:
Chapter 1024 – Chapter 1014: Coercion
Dark mage was immersed in all kinds of books in the study. Dudian also used perspective to look at all kinds of books. However it was very difficult to distinguish the reverse side or the side side, but this inadvertently made Dudian more proficient in the ability of perspective. He was able to penetrate the paper industry one by one.
The night was getting darker.
Black mage seemed to be tired. He took out his pocket watch and looked at the sky. He closed the book and left the study room.
At the moment the young masters and young ladies in the castle had fallen asleep. Count Barret had also fallen asleep. Black mage went down the stairs to the underground research institute. He selected several instruments from the sixth room on the first floor, he came to the fourth room on the second floor. Lying here was the plump woman whose chest had been replaced by a strange tissue. Dark green blood vessels could already be seen on her neck and arms, the strange tissue on her chest was gradually eating away at her body.
The black mage looked at it for a while and was very satisfied. He turned around and took out anesthetic and other things to inject the plump woman who was sleeping.
The moment she injected it, the plump woman woke up in shock. When she opened her eyes and saw the black mage and the anesthetic in his hands, her expression immediately turned ugly, and there was a hint of despair, she gritted her teeth and said, “You Sinner, the glory of Lord Byrne, will finally punish you!”
The black mage smiled lightly, “It’s a pity that he has been dead for more than two hundred years. Otherwise, I would really like to use his corpse to study it. I heard that the first batch of Lords walked on the path of evolution other than magic marks. They were all battle geniuses, unlike the nobles of today, who were just a bunch of pigs who only knew how to eat, drink, and enjoy making feces. It should be said that they were worse than pigs. At least the pigs could be slaughtered and eaten.”
“The thing I regret the most is that I persuaded him to accept you!”The voluptuous woman gnashed her teeth.
The black mage smiled. “In consideration of the favor I owed you back then, I left the most precious thing to you. Otherwise, you would have been thrown into the mass grave like those experimental subjects and disposed of like trash.”
The voluptuous woman spat. She wanted to say more, but she felt her tongue go numb. The anger in her eyes immediately turned into fear. She knew that the anesthetic effect had already taken effect. Once her entire body was anesthetized.., she could only let the demon in front of her do whatever he wanted.
The black mage noticed her strange behavior and chuckled. “Sleep well. So many years have passed. Why Struggle? You should have accepted your fate a long time ago.”
The voluptuous woman bit her lower lip. The pain was so intense that she could feel it. However, her brain still felt dizzy and drowsy, and she could not stop it.
“This is a good environment.”At this time, a sudden voice was heard.
The two were startled by the sudden voice. The black mage and the plump woman turned their heads and saw a young man dressed in linen clothes. Although he was wearing ordinary linen clothes.., but they could still feel the temperament of the young man. He looked at them with disdain. It was as if his every movement had its own dignity.
The plump woman was in a daze. From the way Dudian dressed, it was obvious that he wasn’t a subordinate of the Black Mage. But how could a villager appear here so suddenly!
The moment the black mage saw Dudian, his pupils slightly shrank. His body quickly took two steps back. His muscles tensed up and the bones in his body moved. He slowly adjusted his body posture and coldly stared at dudian, “Who are you?”
Dudian indifferently said: “You ate my food last night. Don’t you remember me?”
Black mage was startled: “You are a newly recruited chef? Who Are You? What is your purpose in coming here? !”He was a bit nervous as he asked. was his whereabouts exposed? The young man in front of him had a pure temperament. He had a dignified and masculine aura. Moreover he was able to appear here quietly. His strength was extraordinary. Most likely he was the temple’s enforcer who had captured him.
Dudian smiled as he felt the old man’s trembling and nervousness, “I should be asking you these questions. You have done so much behind Barret’s back. He shouldn’t know about it. You have betrayed him and are doing these prohibited experiments. Who else is behind you?”
He wanted to continue to observe for a few more days to familiarize himself with the Bourne family and the mysterious black mage. But later he found that there was no point in continuing to observe. He knew most of the things he needed to know, it would take several times more time to find out the clues from the clues. The most direct way was to interrogate him.
Black Mage’s face slightly changed. Dudian’s words seemed to be tacitly accepted. He knew that today wouldn’t be a good day. He quickly thought of a way to escape. Although he wasn’t afraid of Dudian.., but if the other party infiltrated the Bourne family to capture him then his whereabouts would have been exposed. There would be other Temple’s law enforcers waiting outside.
“Those damn beasts!”He cursed in his heart. He deliberately said with a fierce face: “Cut the crap, Kid. You Dare to come here alone. You Are Dead!”
Dudian indifferently smiled: “It seems it is necessary for you to be obedient.”
Black mage sneered. He was about to open his mouth but suddenly his pupils shrank. He felt a sense of danger creeping up his back like a poisonous snake. His whole body was numb and his hair stood up. He hurriedly retreated but was still too slow, dudian suddenly enlarged several times and was close to him. Bang! He felt his head buzzing. His cheeks were burning and he was in extreme pain. His neck was a bit twisted.
The black mage reacted quickly. He growled and Black Mist appeared all over his body.
Bang!
There was another crisp sound.
The mist dispersed as if it was slapped by a palm!
Black Mage’s face twisted to the other side. There were red handprints on both sides of his face. His hood was also slapped off.
“Are you obedient?”Dudian quietly looked at him and asked.
Black Mage’s mind was a bit confused. He was stunned for a while before his scattered thoughts gathered again. He looked at Dudian who was close to him. His pupils constricted: “Who are you? !”
“If you don’t listen to me then I will take away your death. If you listen then I Will Be Your King!”Dudian’s voice was calm as if he was talking about a very ordinary matter.
Black mage was startled for a moment. He suddenly said: “Aren’t you a law enforcer of the Temple?”
Bang!
A crisp sound was heard.
Black Mage’s face tilted to the side. After two seconds he reacted. There was anger in his eyes as he stared at Dudian. However his anger subsided as he looked at Dudian’s calm black eyes. He clenched his teeth, “If you like to humiliate me then come at me!”
“I’m not interested in humiliating an old man.”Dudian indifferently said: “It’s just that it’s not your turn to ask questions so don’t ask blindly.”
Black mage gritted his teeth and swallowed his anger.
Bang!
Another crisp sound was heard.
