Blood flowed out from the corner of Black Mage’s mouth. He angrily shouted: “What do you want? !”
“I didn’t ask you to be silent. I asked you to answer my question. I don’t want to repeat it a second time.”Dudian indifferently replied.
Black Mage’s body trembled in anger as he thought of Dudian’s initial words. He had been humble throughout his life but he was in his twenties. He wanted to become strong because of those humble experiences, he yearned for strength so he walked on this path.
He hadn’t been bullied since he set foot on this path. He was used to the feeling of superiority in other people’s lives. He didn’t expect that today he would be beaten back to his original state. It was pure humiliation and oppression, it was more intense than the anger brought by the temple’s law enforcers who made him hide!
Black mage took a few deep breaths and slowly suppressed the anger in his heart, he whispered: “Barret knows about these experiments. I didn’t hide it from him. I’m legal. I was authorized by him. I’m just hired by him.”
“You can’t make these things by yourself. Where did you buy them? Do you often meet with peers?”Dudian asked.
Black mage whispered: “I bought these instruments in a black shop. I don’t like people from the Magic Institute.”
Dudian nodded slightly and walked towards the plump woman. The effects of the anesthetic had spread to her entire body. Her eyelids were half-drooping and her head was unable to move. She couldn’t even speak, there was only consciousness. At the moment her eyes were moving back and forth as if she was struggling. It seemed that she was trying to send a message to Dudian.
Dudian saw that she wanted to speak. He knew that she wanted to tell him a lot about black mage. But he wasn’t in a hurry, he looked at black mage: “Is there anything that can cure the anesthetic? I think she should know a lot about you. After all, you are old friends right?”
Black Mage’s face slightly changed: “There is no antidote here. I don’t think the potency of the anesthetic is too short.”
Dudian didn’t force him. After all, he didn’t know about the drugs. The latter couldn’t deny it. Blind intimidation would reduce the effect of intimidation, he ordered: “Let’s go to the third floor.”He turned around and walked in front. He opened the door of the laboratory.
Black mage looked at Dudian’s back. His eyes flashed as Black Mist slowly emerged from his body. The moment Dudian opened the door, he accelerated like a Black Phantom.
Whoosh!
Silver light flashed as the sharp blade pierced out.
Puff! Silver light turned into an arc and bounced back into a full moon.
A long black blade was raised like a poisonous snake. The tip of the blade was emitting cold light. It was like a poisonous snake. It was slightly swaying as if it had eyes that were looking at the black mage.
The Black Mage’s face was covered with scales. He was forced to attack halfway through his demonization. He was afraid that Dudian would notice him in advance. However his arm had been demonized but at the moment one of his arms.., along with his sleeve.
There was a demonized broken arm lying on the ground behind his feet. It was covered in black scales. Its fingernails were very long and looked like daggers.
“Do you have a grudge against me or your own hand?”Dudian’s indifferent voice was heard. The black mage was so angry that he almost fainted. He covered his broken arm. He didn’t dare to make a sound because of the pain, there was more fear in his heart.
He felt that it was because he didn’t enter the magic body. But at the moment his strength had doubled and his vision had become much stronger. Because of this.., he was able to see the gap between his strength and Dudian’s. The sharp blade appeared almost in an instant. The speed of his body’s demonization was incredible. One had to know that the power of the magic marks was the driving force of the cell tissue mutation, it took at least a few seconds but the terrifying blade appeared in an instant. It didn’t even take a second!
What kind of demonization speed was this?
Black mage hurriedly replied: “I… I didn’t mean it. I have a grudge against my own hand.”He felt a bit embarrassed.
“But I did it on purpose.”Dudian slightly tilted his head and glanced at him: “Which part of your body do you have a grudge against? I will take revenge for you.”
The Black Mage’s face turned green as he felt the cold air emitted from the tail blade: “No, it’s gone.”
“Is it really gone?”
“It’s… It’s gone.”
The tail blade behind Dudian’s spine quickly retracted. It was as fast as lightning so the black mage didn’t see it clearly. But when the tail blade completely retracted, he saw that Dudian’s pants were intact, the tail blade was coming out from the gap in his pants!
His eyes were wide open. He didn’t expect that he had the time to let the tail blade come out from the upper edge of his pants! What kind of calm was this? !
He felt that he could roughly estimate Dudian’s strength. At least he was at the Abyss level. His heart was like dead ashes as he silently followed behind Dudian. He didn’t wait for an opportunity to sneak attack. He felt depressed, at the same time, he felt that he was a bit stupid. Since the other side dared to give his back to him, naturally they were on guard and waiting for him to attack.
Sure enough, after doing experiments for a long time, his combat experience was as stupid as a pig.
Black mage sighed in his heart. He used his robe to wrap around the wound on his broken arm and quickly stopped the bleeding. However, the pain was transmitted from time to time. Fortunately, it was within the range that he could endure.
The ghost guards who were distributed in the second floor were stunned as they saw Dudian swagger out. They didn’t see anyone pass by but they saw Dudian’s appearance, it was clear that he wasn’t a prisoner.
However, when they saw the black mage behind Dudian, the Ghost Guards didn’t go forward to stop him. They tactfully ignored him.
The black mage was so angry that he almost vomited blood. The enemy had sneaked in and didn’t see them. But now they were swaggering in front of them. How could they pretend that they didn’t see them? were they blind? !
The black mage thought that if there was an opportunity, he would have to replace this batch of waste.
At this time, Dudian had led the way to the third underground floor. The ghost guards saw Dudian and the black mage coming together but they didn’t move.
Dudian came to the front of a laboratory. The door was locked. He slightly turned his body and glanced at black mage.
Black mage saw that Dudian was familiar with the way. He was secretly shocked. At this moment he saw Dudian’s gesture. He quickly took out the key and opened the door.

chapters.title: Chapter 1025
chapters.content:
Chapter 1025 – Chapter 1015: Blood Of The Devourer
The laboratory was equipped with all kinds of experimental equipment. There were component meters, flasks, titration tubes, balance scales, low-light hourglasses and so on. Of course, there were also microscopes that Dudian cared about the most.
“Did you buy these from a black shop?”Dudian asked.
Black mage nodded.
Dudian picked up a few experimental equipment that he couldn’t recognize and asked black mage for their use. The black mage whispered to answer him one by one. His face regained confidence. He was a professional in this experimental field. Moreover, as a black mage, he was studying the existence of the life technique. He had a sense of superiority in his bones like other peers. Even in the face of the experts from the abyss, his heart was filled with disdain.
Dudian went around and found that the instruments in the laboratory were used in biological and chemical research. He was very satisfied. This saved him a lot of time. He went to the microscope, he took out a drop of his blood as a sample and carefully observed it under the microscope.
Black mage looked at Dudian who was concentrating on the microscope. His eyes flashed slightly. There was a hint of killing intent in his eyes. However there was a trace of fear in his eyes when he saw the end of Dudian’s spine, he didn’t know if Dudian was testing him again. But he estimated that this was not the best time to assassinate him. Dudian would be shocked by this great magic tool and exclaim.
He was waiting.
However, after waiting for a moment, Dudian seemed to be asleep. He didn’t move and was still focused on looking at the microscope.
He slightly frowned. His heart was a bit conflicted. He felt that he couldn’t understand Dudian’s thoughts.
After ten minutes, Dudian slowly raised his head. His expression was fluctuating. Sometimes he was shocked and sometimes he was confused. If not for the previous repeated confirmation, he really suspected that he was wrong!
Blood cells and plasma were the main components of blood. But in his blood, in addition to these two basic substances, there was a small cell. It was light black. The cell was not round but bullet-shaped. It was very sharp. It pierced into the blood cells and fused into them, just like the fusion of sperm and eggs! After accepting the light black cone-shaped cells, the color of the blood cells became dark. A black outline could be seen inside as if it was pregnant with something. The color of the blood cells was also changing, the surface of the blood cells slowly grew sharp black thorns like sea urchins.
One by one, the blood cells were drilled into the cone-shaped cells. They continued to fuse as if they were infected by a virus.
The speed was medium. Dudian couldn’t help but think of his own body. At this moment, all the blood in his body was being fused by the black cone-shaped cells. His body was constantly changing!
This kind of feeling made his scalp tingle. He felt panic in his heart. No matter who felt that he couldn’t control the change, they would be afraid — afraid of losing themselves!
However, the black cone cells were only the mysterious third substance in his blood. He found that the composition of his blood was very different from that of a normal human. There was a small amount of plasma protein in his blood, however, it contained a large amount of hydrochloric acid.
In other words, that substance could not be called hydrochloric acid. The salt and acid base were only the main components of the substance. In addition, there were also substances that he could not recognize mixed within. All of them were combined together, this made the hydrochloric acid in the blood plasma extremely corrosive. It was even more terrifying than sulfuric acid. However, the amazing thing was that the hydrochloric acid in the blood plasma did not corrode the glass pieces that he took from the blood.
It was more like a devouring property than a corrosive property. This property had no effect on inanimate substances but it was a deadly poison to other life forms!
“Is this the Sequela of the Crimson Moon Experiment? Could it be the material of Aragami?”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he pondered for a moment. He turned to black mage: “Call one of your guards in.”
The black mage was startled. He didn’t know what Dudian’s intention was but he left the laboratory. He summoned a guard from the cloister.
The guard in Black Robe entered the laboratory. He lifted his hood and revealed a snow white face. It was a beautiful woman wearing crystal earrings. She had an elegant temperament, she quickly glanced at the scene in the laboratory. She lowered her head and looked at the black mage: “My Lord, what are your orders?”
The black mage looked at dudian.
Dudian got up from the chair in front of the microscope. He slowly walked to the front of the beautiful woman: “Raise Your Hand.”
The woman was stunned. She looked at the black mage who was next to her. The latter nodded to her.
The woman didn’t dare to ask any more questions. She raised her hand. There was a shiny bracelet hanging on her white wrist.
Dudian’s face was cold. He grabbed her hand. He cut her hand as she blushed.
“Ah!”The woman shouted. She saw Dudian’s palm had retracted. There was a bloody mark on her palm.
She looked up at the tall and handsome Dudian. There was a look of grievance on her face.
Dudian raised his hand. The fingernail on his other hand rose a few inches. He gently cut a wound on his finger and squeezed it. Soon, a few drops of blood fell from the wound, the blood dripped onto the wound on the woman’s palm.
Dudian put the cut finger into his mouth and took a sip. When he took it out, the wound on his finger had already healed. At this time, the woman suddenly cried out in pain. Her body bent down and took two steps back. White smoke was coming out from the wound on her palm.
She wanted to pinch her hand but Dudian quickly grabbed her wrist. He brought her to his front and carefully looked at her.
The woman felt the burning pain in her palm. She knew that the black mage had been doing experiments for many years. Although Dudian was wearing linen clothes but his temperament was extraordinary. She naturally wouldn’t treat him as an ordinary person, moreover from the Black Mage’s performance it was very likely that they were his peers. They were using her as an experiment! She couldn’t help but struggle as she thought of the terrifying experiments of the black mage. She wanted to pull her hand back.
Dudian frowned as he raised his hand.
Puff!
The woman’s hand was broken from the elbow. The cut was smooth.
The woman fell back. She screamed as she saw Dudian holding the beautiful hand.
Dudian turned back and went back to the microscope. He adjusted the distance of the microscope and put the woman’s hand which was emitting white smoke under the microscope. He observed it from the microscopic world.
He was stunned.
After a moment he slowly looked up. There was no shock on his face because everything was as he had expected. The woman’s hand only confirmed his speculation — his blood could devour the cells of other creatures!
In short, his blood was equal to sulfuric acid for other creatures!
If he didn’t cut off the woman’s hand and let his blood corrode, her life would be lost. It was just a matter of time.
“Is this the God’s blood created by Crimson Moon?”Dudian’s face changed. Even he himself felt that it was terrifying. Just a drop of blood was enough to kill her.
As he was thinking, the white hand by the microscope quickly rotted and dried up. More white smoke came out of the surface. The area of the rot spread from the palm to the entire palm and quickly extended to the wrist.
Black mage was stunned. He could guess the reason but he didn’t dare to believe it.
A moment later, the beautiful hand completely rotted. Even the bones had turned pitch black. The bones were stuck with black mucus. It was bent like a few black leeches.
The white crystal bracelet was hanging on the wrist bone without any damage. It was particularly eye-catching.
Dudian also noticed the change. He didn’t expect that in less than ten minutes his blood would burn the arm of a limiter. He saw the pure black and crystal mucus. He took out a pair of tweezers from the side, he picked up a bit and smeared it on the glass. He took it to the microscope and observed it.
As he thought, the black mucus was the black cone-shaped substance in the blood. The cone-shaped cells were like black holes. They devoured all the cells on the woman’s hand but didn’t leave any residue, it was as if all the swallowed cells were transported to another world.
Dudian felt goosebumps all over his body. He couldn’t help but look at the few drops of blood that he had taken out earlier. The color of the blood was dry and black. It was the same as the black mucus!
“Don’t tell me that I will be swallowed by this thing in the end?”Dudian’s heart was scared. He took the few drops of blood and continued to observe.
Soon, he found that his blood was different from the black mucus on the woman’s hand. His blood still maintained the appearance of blood cells. However, the red blood cells and platelets in these blood cells were swallowed, the blood cells were like a black sea urchin. The surface of the blood cells was covered with sharp thorns. It looked like a very dangerous virus.
Dudian frowned. He cut his palm and observed it under the microscope.
Half an hour later, he was relieved. Although the blood in his wound had been swallowed and turned into the strange appearance of a Black Sea Urchin, but the mutated blood would still touch the oxygen in the air, it would bring vitality to the body.
He knew that sooner or later all the blood in his body would mutate. But he didn’t know what would happen to him after the mutation.
Perhaps, Crimson Moon didn’t know about this change.
Black mage looked at Dudian as he studied his body. There was a strange look on his face. There was deep fear in his eyes. He felt that compared to himself, Dudian was more like a monster.
The woman who had lost her hand was curled up by the door. She didn’t shout. She knew that doing so would only make her die faster. After all, the patience of a superior would never be used on a lowly person like her unless she had other intentions.
By the second half of the night, Dudian had more or less understood his blood. He continued to collect samples from his body. For example, his right arm which had been frozen before.
Now his right arm had been defrosted and returned to the appearance of a normal person’s arm. It seemed that the cold air in his arm had been digested and his arm had regained consciousness. Through the observation of the microscope, Dudian found that there was no difference in the structure of the right arm and the left arm. The frozen right arm which had troubled him for many years was miraculously solved after the experiment of Crimson Moon.
Dudian tried to look for his magic marks but he couldn’t find any magic marks.
“It is not enough to rely on a microscope. The mitochondria are not detected. It seems that more advanced instruments are needed.”Dudian sat in front of the microscope. His biggest harvest tonight was to understand the changes in his blood, he was mentally prepared.
“Lord, it is almost dawn.”Black mage whispered.
Dudian recovered from his thoughts and glanced at him: “Don’t sleep today. Accompany me to the black shop.”
Black mage was startled: “Lord, the black shop usually opens at night.”
“Then accompany me to go shopping.”Dudian indifferently said.
Black mage slightly opened his mouth. He bitterly smiled and agreed.
The woman who was hiding by the door couldn’t help but stare at Dudian. She didn’t expect that black mage who was like a devil in her heart would call this young man “Master”.
Dudian was ready to go out when he noticed the woman who was stunned by the door. He frowned: “Go and bandage the wound. Don’t get infected.”
The woman was stunned. She didn’t expect that Dudian would care about her. She was touched. She knew that her hand was cut off by the young man but she was touched by his words.
However she calmed down and quickly complied.
Dudian opened the door and gestured to the black mage: “Go ahead.”
The corner of the black mage’s mouth twitched. He wanted to secretly signal the woman to send the message. But it seemed that it was impossible.
Dudian didn’t go back to his room after he left the underground laboratory. The sky was still dark. There was still an hour before daybreak. He followed the black mage to his room and asked him to take out some gold coins, he asked about buying equipment in the black shop. He found out that he didn’t need gold coins but the exclusive currency of the Dark Temple.
Black gold was a special metal that was refined by the black mage. It was used as currency in the black shop. It was very hard and more expensive than gold.
“Black gold can be exchanged with points and magic tools. It can also be exchanged with gold coins. The exchange rate for gold coins is 10:1. Ten gold coins for one black gold coin. The ‘Microscopic Mirror’that your excellency used just now costs 90,000 black gold coins. It is equivalent to 900,000 gold coins. It is enough to buy half of the street’s industry.”The black mage introduced to Dudian.
Dudian asked: “How much are the properties of the Bourne family worth?”
Black mage was surprised: “Are you going to sell all of Barret’s properties?”
“Why do you have to answer my questions?”Dudian frowned.
Black Mage’s face stiffened as he coughed, “Yes, the total value of the property of the Bourne family is estimated to be millions of gold coins. But most of the properties are commercial land and some mines. It is very difficult to sell them. Moreover, they are legal people. It is very difficult to take them away. They have to go through the procedures of the magistrate. It is very strict to check the prices of real estate. Generally, private transactions are not allowed. The tax for private transactions is very high. It is equivalent to making money for them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1026
chapters.content:
Chapter 1026 – Chapter 1006: Three Great Artifacts
Dudian looked at him but didn’t say anything. He sat in his study room and looked at the research materials. He found that the black mage had a wide range of knowledge. He was especially good at research in the field of biology as well as making poisons.
“Neurotoxin, hemophilia, Bergenmosis…”Dudian looked at the drug experiments. Some of them were the poisons developed by the black mage while others were the famous poisons developed by his peers.
He read ten lines at a glance. His super strong memory allowed him to have a photographic memory. Suddenly, he flipped to a book that wrote ‘Witchcraft’s blood’. It was more like a diary than a book. There was the handwriting of the black mage on it.
This was a kind of nerve poison which could be inherited. Once it was infected, the descendants would inherit it. After being infected by witchcraft, the character would become bloodthirsty, violent and impulsive. It was extremely easy to be emotional. Sometimes they would be irritable and sometimes they would be depressed. According to the records, some people who were infected by witchcraft would be emotionally killed in the street. Some would be arrested. Some would be cold-hearted and commit suicide.
Dudian saw the cases recorded above. The names were shocking. When he turned to the last page, he saw Barret. There was a string of surnames behind the name.
“Did you cast witchcraft on Barret?”Dudian’s face slightly changed as he looked at the old man.
The black mage knew that things would be exposed when Dudian turned to witchcraft, he wryly smiled: “I was forced to do so. You know that wizards like us need a lot of money to research things. I came to Barret to exchange my ability for the corresponding reward. But he was a noble and often owed me wages. In the end I had no choice but to rely on myself.”
Dudian sneered but didn’t expose him. He knew that the old man was lying. Although Barret was a noble earl but the black mage was the master, barret was a big shot in the castle. He wouldn’t default on such a master’s salary no matter how stupid he was. He was aiming at the Bourne family because of his motive.
However, this had nothing to do with him.
He suddenly thought of the young master called Leo who he had seen when he first came. The young master who had sneaked into his husband’s concubine’s room at night. There was also the second miss who liked to play sick games. obviously.., these people were under the influence of the Dark Mage’s witchcraft. Their desires were out of control and the only thing they could bring was destruction!
“What a vicious poison.”Dudian whispered.
The black mage smiled: “I’m also trying to protect myself…”
“I like it.”Dudian smiled: “Why don’t you throw such a good thing into the giant wall? Do you need to worry about being arrested by the temple?”
The black mage was stunned: “Isn’t it too dangerous?”
“Are you afraid of Danger?”
Black mage saw Dudian’s serious eyes. He felt that Dudian’s idea wasn’t to test him. However, this idea was too crazy. He had never thought about it.
He suddenly felt that he was a bit stupid. Why didn’t he put this thing in the whole city?
His heart was excited but soon the excitement was quickly extinguished. He thought of a great existence.
“What?”Dudian narrowed his eyes as he noticed the change in his expression.
Black mage shook his head: “If it is put in a large area then it will cause the temple to go all out to search for me. If it is just the temple then it will be fine. But if the movement is too big then it will definitely attract the attention of the sorcerer King. Once he makes a move then my whereabouts will be exposed. In the past there were sorcerers who broke the rules and went on a killing spree in many small towns. Later on they were arrested by the sorcerer King before the temple’s law enforcers could get there. They were executed in the underground Asura Square.”
“Witch King?”Dudian raised his eyebrows: “Is he more powerful than the eight lords? Even so, he can’t resist your witchcraft right?”
Black mage bitterly smiled: “The most terrifying thing about the witch king is not his strength but his omniscient and omnipotent witchcraft. Although my witchcraft is magical, but in his hands, it will definitely be broken.”
“Are you so confident in him?”
“There is no other way. He has the three great weapons that all sorcerers dream of. All sorcerers will be broken in front of these three great weapons. The sorcerer King who has these three great weapons is invincible!”
Dudian was surprised: “What are the three great weapons? Tell me about them.”
“The three artifacts are the eye of the gods, the Sun Mirror, and the pearl of the dead.”Black Mage’s eyes lit up with envy, “The eye of the gods can destroy all wizards and see through all illusions. It can see through the mirror of the dead and solve all problems! The Sun Mirror is even more powerful. It can shine magic rays and create light!”
“It is said that you can hear the voice of the dead from the pearl of the dead. It is the only treasure among the three artifacts that has strong combat ability. Even the wall master is afraid of the Pearl of the dead. This is the reason why the temple doesn’t dare to annihilate us. We can offend the temple and the wall master but we must not offend the Mage King. Otherwise no one can protect you.”
The black mage observed Dudian’s expression as he spoke. He was surprised to see that Dudian was listening to him. He was just testing him. He didn’t expect that Dudian wasn’t a member of the witchcraft.
However, Dudian was skilled in using the micro mirror. It wasn’t the first time he used it. was he a member of the Magic Institute? Did he betray the Magic Institute?
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that it was possible.
Dudian didn’t know that the black mage was immersed in the joy of seizing his “Weakness”. He was shocked by the three magic tools that he had mentioned. Especially the undead pearl. If he only heard the voice of the deceased.., he didn’t care about it. He didn’t even care about it. Any phonograph could do it. However, it wasn’t in the scope of the phonograph.
“It seems that these three items are very high-end instruments of the old era. I wonder what the prototype is?”Dudian’s eyes lit up. If he could get the three instruments.., his experiment would be smoother.
He thought of Crimson Moon. He couldn’t help but feel a bit sorry for her. If she knew about the giant wall and got the three instruments, perhaps the experiment would have been successful.
At this time, the sky was already bright. The sound of Knights’training came from the training field behind the castle. The servants of the castle also came out to work. They carried water, washed clothes, and sunned quilts.
Dudian put the witchcraft blood into his pocket: “Let’s go out for a walk.”
“I want to ask Barret about this.”Black Mage’s eyelids twitched as he saw Dudian put away the witchcraft blood. He knew that the other party had something on him.
“Have you consulted him about the experiment?”
“Uh, okay.”
“I met the guard. Tell him that you are taking me out to do something.”Dudian pushed the door open.
Black mage bitterly sighed and followed behind dudian.
By the time the two went downstairs, the black mage was in front while Dudian followed behind.
Dudian crossed his hands behind his back as he walked down the street: “The other master of the Bourne family seems to be in cahoots with you.”
Black mage was surprised as he didn’t expect Dudian to know about this. He suddenly felt that he couldn’t see through dudian. It was obvious that the other party didn’t know so many secrets after two days as a chef. It was very likely that they had paid attention to him.
He became more cautious as he thought about this.
“He and I are in a cooperative relationship…”black mage pondered over his words.
Dudian nodded slightly as he got his recognition.
Dudian went into a pub and ordered some good dishes. He began to eat and drink.
Black mage bitterly accompanied him as he thought about ways to escape. However he found that there was nothing he could do.
After dinner, Dudian bought a set of high-class clothes. His temperament was like a young elite from the upper class. He bought a set of clothes to go to a black shop in the evening. Then he hired a carriage with black mage, they walked around the city. They rolled up the windows and enjoyed the scenery along the way. From time to time they would sigh. Black Mage didn’t know what Dudian wanted to do.
In a short day Dudian went through the entire Main City of Phoenix.
“Two Abyss and twenty-seven masters. Is this the power of the Lord of Phoenix…”the carriage passed by the manor of the Lord of Phoenix. Dudian saw the background of the Lord of Phoenix, just one lord was enough to easily crush Sylvia.
In the evening, the black mage led Dudian to the most lively black shop in the city.
It was the most lively and naturally the most expensive place.
The Black Shop was located in a bustling street. The shops on the street were all jewelry, hotels, weapons shops, real estate rental and so on. Most of the celebrities came here. The black shop was located in the underground of the entire block, there were three entrances. One of them was the highest underground passage of the hotel. According to the black mage, the reason why there were three entrances was to allow the temple’s law enforcers to search the place, they could also quickly evacuate.
However, the black shop was under the protection of the Phoenix Lord. The temple’s law enforcers wouldn’t come over so it was the safest black shop.
After coming out of the secret passage of the hotel, Dudian saw the underground world. There were colorful lights hanging from the dome. The electricity was very popular here. All kinds of light bulbs were made in various styles, it was exquisite and beautiful.
There were a lot of shops on both sides of the long passage. The owners of the shops were wearing a ghost mask. They were waving flagpoles. The advertising slogans were written on them to attract guests.
Dudian and black mage were also wearing masks. One of them was a leopard head while the other was a wolf head. They were mixed in the crowd.
The Wizards in the crowd were wearing masks of different formats. Some of them were wearing masks and veils to hide their faces in the dark.
Dudian’s eyes swept through the shops on both sides. He saw many new things. There were many instruments used in experiments. He even saw small flashlights and electronic watches.
Other than these things, the most eye-catching ones were the experimental materials. Some of them were limbs soaked in jars. Some of them were the hearts of rare monsters. There was also a red test tube that was sold, it was marked with the blood of a certain noble.
Dudian whispered to the black mage. He knew that the ancestor of this noble was a lord. He had excellent fighting strength. There was someone who had awakened and gained extraordinary fighting strength in his generation, the blood of this noble had good research value.
Soon, Dudian saw a microscope in one of the largest shops. The price was slightly higher than what Black Mage had said. It was 98,000 black gold!
“The price has increased again. Fortunately I bought it early.”Black mage couldn’t help but sigh.
Dudian looked around and saw the phonograph. The price of small items like cameras wasn’t cheap. The phonograph cost 8,000 each and the camera cost 20,000 each. Dudian asked the black mage to pay for a set of the most expensive ones.
The shop owners shouted at Dudian and the Black Mage.
Dudian and the black mage came to the black shop at the end of the street. According to the black mage, this was the place to handle the registration of the sorcerers.
Dudian walked around and knew that black mage’s words were true. He grabbed a woman wearing a rabbit mask and asked: “Have you heard of the three great instruments of sorcerers? Tell me about them.”
The woman wearing a rabbit mask was pulled by Dudian. Her body was startled as she coldly looked at dudian: “Let Go!”
Dudian glanced at black mage and gestured to him.
Black mage smiled and coughed. He took out a black medal from his black robe. There were five star marks engraved on it.
The woman wearing the rabbit mask saw the medal. The coldness in her eyes turned into shock: “Are You… Are You Lord Holy Witch?”
Black mage coughed: “Tell him about the three artifacts.”He knew that Dudian was trying to verify his words. Fortunately, he didn’t lie.
The woman was stunned for a moment. She quickly reacted and explained to Dudian. Her attitude was very respectful and she explained in detail.
Dudian nodded slightly. He asked: “Do you know where the Witch King Lives?”
The woman shook her head: “I don’t know.”
“This is not something they can understand.”Black Mage said.
Dudian let go of the woman wearing the rabbit mask and turned back: “Let’s go and find the Witch King.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1027
chapters.content:
Chapter 1027 – : Chapter 1017: Thunder Filter
Black mage was scared by Dudian’s words: “Looking for the Mage King? Do you want the three great artifacts? !”
Dudian didn’t comment: “Lead the way and tell me about the Mage King.”
Black mage saw that Dudian seemed to be serious. His face changed as he whispered: “Elder, this is not a small matter. Let’s talk about it. I’m begging you.”
Dudian walked forward as if he hadn’t heard anything.
Black mage was anxious as he followed close behind him, he whispered: “Master, the whereabouts of the wizard King is uncertain. Even I don’t know where he lives. We can’t find him. If you want the three artifacts then I have other ways to meet your needs.”
“Oh?”Dudian’s eyes moved: “Tell me about it.”
Black Mage was relieved, he quickly said: “Master you want the three artifacts. They should be used for witchcraft or something else. We can use other similar functions but the effect is weak.”
“For example?”Dudian frowned.
Black mage whispered: “As far as I know, there have been high-quality replicas of the three artifacts. Someone has made reference to the effectiveness of the three artifacts. Although the final effectiveness is not comparable to the three artifacts but they are top-notch artifacts. Their names are the eye of God, the Magic Mirror, and the soul capturing Pearl! Moreover, in addition to these three high-quality replicas, there are several top-notch magic tools. Their effects are similar to the eyes of the gods. They belong to the enhanced version of the mirror of insight. However, the price is expensive and they are not sold on the market.”
“Do you know the owner of these magic tools?”Dudian immediately asked.
Black mage nodded and whispered: “My lord, instead of looking for the Mage King, we should look for these people first. If the magic tools in their hands can’t satisfy you, then we can look for the Mage King. Don’t you think so?”
Dudian nodded slightly. This was good. If he had no other choice, he wouldn’t want to provoke the Mage King. But he had to find out his physical condition as soon as possible. If he could survive.., he had to hurry to find Aisha so that she wouldn’t wander into the magic pit or the vicinity of the empire. Although she was a middle-level Abyss Walker and could run amok in the Abyss region, but in the center of the magic pit.., there were many existences that could threaten the upper abyss, such as the Polar Ice Dragon that they had killed.
Seeing that Dudian had agreed, the Black Mage’s heart relaxed. He thought that it was a close call and finally persuaded Dudian. If Dudian really wanted to find the wizard King, he would most likely become cannon fodder.
“It’s not convenient to talk here. Sir, let’s go out first?”The black mage looked at the other wizards who were passing by and whispered to Dudian.
Dudian looked at him and nodded. He followed black mage out of the shop.
The night was shrouded in starlight. The night was especially quiet.
Dudian and black mage rented a room in a nearby hotel. Dudian casually sat on the sofa and said to black mage: “Speak.”
Black mage coughed and sat down on the sofa opposite Dudian, “The three replicas of the Magic Mirror and soul capturing Pearl are in the hands of the eight lords. The eyes of God are in the hands of the vice-chairman of the council. These three are not to be trifled with. Especially the vice-chairman of the council. He is an expert in the Abyss and two of his students have stepped into the abyss. It is said that the strength of the vice-chairman is much stronger than the eight lords.”
Dudian frowned. He was most concerned about the eye of the gods. It was the super enhanced version of the microscope. It should be able to see the molecular level and even the quark level.
Black mage secretly looked at Dudian’s expression, he immediately said: “My Lord, in addition to the three replicas there are two top-level magic tools. They have the ability to observe the microscopic world. They are more powerful than the microscopic mirror. They are the eye of destruction and the Thunder filter! It is said that the Thunder filter can see the movement of electricity. It is very magical.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He could see the movement of electricity? Doesn’t that mean that he could see the electronic layer?
“Who has the Thunder Filter?”Dudian immediately asked.
The black mage was about to introduce them one by one when Dudian asked, he said: “The Thunder filter is in the hands of a member of the council. We can think of a way if you want it. I know about the situation of this member. His name is Bronk and he has the power of a ruler. However it is said that every member has the protection of the Abyss level. He is in his fifties but he has created six five-star witchcraft. Each of them is enough to cause a destructive disaster in the city. Moreover it is said that he has created a weapon called Lightning Gun.”
“This weapon is classified as a taboo weapon and has not been used. But the guards around him must be equipped with this kind of weapon. It is said that the power of this electric gun is more than a hundred times that of the gunpowder gun. It can not be dodged and the attack will arrive in an instant. Moreover, it has a paralyzing effect. Even a group of pioneers with electric guns can kill the ruler. It is because of this that it has been classified as a taboo by the Mage King.”
“Electric gun?”Dudian was startled as he thought of the laser gun. However, the latter should have relied on the Thunder filter to invent it. It was different from the laser gun but it couldn’t be denied, if it was as black mage said then the electric gun was a very terrifying weapon.
“Do you know where he lives?”Dudian asked.
Black mage coughed, he said in an awkward tone: “I don’t know the address of the councilman. Moreover the councilmen should have other identities. I don’t know what the free identity of the councilman is. But from his previous experience it seems that he doesn’t lack money. He should come from a rich family.”
His face turned red. There were at least 30,000 rich families in the giant wall of Berga.
Dudian frowned and pondered for a moment. He suddenly asked: “Where do the members hold meetings?”
Black Mage’s eyes lit up when he saw Dudian didn’t blame him, he quickly said: “There are several kinds of meetings for the members. The meeting place is different too. If it is a big event then all the members will meet at the headquarters of the Black Shop! If there is a problem in the area under the jurisdiction of a member then the king will send a trusted representative to inquire about it and hold an interim meeting with the local members!”
He didn’t wait for Dudian to ask any more questions, he was excited: “Sir, I know about the jurisdiction of Bolang. In the main city of the Lord of Nile, it manages all the dark channels in the territory of the Lord of Nile. As long as we cause trouble in the territory of the Lord of Nile and break the rules of the Wizards, the King will certainly send people to find him to understand the situation. By that time we will be able to find Bolang in the dark.”
Dudian got up. “Let’s go.”
..
..
Before leaving Phoenix territory, black mage sent a letter to Lord Bourne in front of Dudian’s letter. It was a request for leave. Then he followed Dudian to the Nile territory.
The Nile territory and the Phoenix territory are far apart, two people in the outskirts of the rapid travel, half a day later, came to the Nile territory before, paid the entrance fee, into the main city of the Nile territory.
The main city of the territory was as magnificent as the main city of the Phoenix. The security here seemed to be more strict than that of the Phoenix territory. From time to time they could see teams of patrolling guards passing by.
“What do you think is the fastest way to attract their attention?”Dudian asked black mage as they walked on the street.
Black mage saw that Dudian had thrown this difficult problem to him: “Sir, we might as well secretly kill some wizards. The more we kill, the more attention they will pay.”
“They are your peers.”Dudian glanced at him.
“They are my peers.”The Black Mage’s face was natural.
Dudian shook his head: “This is too slow. I think your witchcraft blood can be used.”
The black mage’s face changed: “Elder, are you going to cast witchcraft blood in the city? This is too big of a disturbance. Moreover the damage is too terrible!”
“How can we quickly attract their attention?”
“But the people in the city are innocent. They are our compatriots. How can they kill innocent people…”
Dudian glanced at him: “How can you say such words? How can you bear the bones buried in the ground of the Bourne Manor?”
Black Mage’s face stiffened. He no longer tried to persuade him. He had guessed that Dudian had chosen to use witchcraft blood not only because of the noise but also because he had created the witchcraft blood, this meant that he had to cooperate with Dudian. Once Dudian was finished and the witchcraft blood went out of control, he would be noticed by the Mage King.
Once he was ordered to kill the witch, there would be no place for him in the world!
“I don’t have any witchcraft blood poison with me. How about we just forget about it?”Black Mage struggled.
“We can either go back and get it or we can find the materials in the shops nearby.”Dudian gave him two choices.
Black Mage’s mouth twitched. He sighed and chose to find the materials in the vicinity to do it himself. The amount of voodoo blood poison he had left in the Bourne family was very small.
Three days later.
Dudian and black mage sneaked into an underground public well in the main city of the Nile territory. They threw the voodoo blood poison that black mage had refined into the well. The well would provide food, clothing and shelter for thousands of families every day, however, these people who used the public well lived at the bottom of the city. They were like rats in every corner of the city. They worked as coolies and services.
Their wives would rush to the public well every morning when the weather was slightly cold. They would fetch water and wash clothes. By the time Dawn came, there was already a long queue in front of the public well. The supply of well water was in short supply.
In addition to the public well, Dudian had sneaked into the manor of two small nobles and put witchcraft blood poison into their well water.
“Next, we will wait for your witchcraft blood to explode.”Dudian and black mage sat on a high building overlooking the building. The view from the top of the building was extremely vast.
Black mage looked at the street below the high building. There was a smile on his face but his heart was cold. Although he had caught many people as experiments but he didn’t catch more than ten at a time, it was easy to be exposed if he caught too many at a time. However Dudian had killed thousands of people. He felt that he was ruthless enough but this youth’s heart was colder and more vicious than his!
He would do anything to achieve his goal!
On the fifth day after the voodoo blood poison was released, bloodthirsty fights broke out one after another. Not only did the defense department in the territory of Nile pay close attention to it but the whole city was on alert. The dark shops were closed one after another, many dark shops were no longer open.
“It seems that things have fermented enough. We can go to the headquarters of the dark shops in the Nile.”The black mage took Dudian out of the dark shop, they turned around and walked towards the city center of the main city of the Nile territory.
“Isn’t your five-star medal attached to this area? Can you go in?”Dudian asked.
He knew a lot of things as he had been with black mage for the past few days. The sorcerers here were similar to the dark church in Sylvia. They couldn’t be seen in the light. He couldn’t help but think that the king of sorcerers.., could it be that the wall master himself was acting?
“There is no problem to enter. I just can’t participate in their meeting here.”Black mage laughed.
Dudian nodded. Both of them came to a manor in the center of the main city of the Nile. It was a large manor. There were well-equipped knights standing in front of the gate, it looked more imposing than the standing and Bourne families that Dudian had met.
Black mage was fearless. He whispered a few words in front of a knight. He lifted his robe and revealed his chest. There was a black flame tattoo engraved on it. The knight who was about to intercept the birth was startled. He immediately stepped aside and made way. His face was full of respect.
Black mage put down his robe and strode forward.
Dudian followed behind but wasn’t checked.
After entering the manor, Dudian immediately used his x-ray vision to scan the situation in the manor. He soon found that there was a huge square-like underground world under the manor. It was very lively. There were many people gathered there at the moment, most of the firefly-like heat sources were at the level of a frontiersman. A few of them were at the level of pioneers. However only a few of them emitted heat sources that were as vigorous as the sun, they were as dominant as the black mage.
However, there were experts who knew how to hide the heat sources. The defense of the underground world was not as simple as it appeared on the surface.
Soon, Dudian and black mage followed the guide of the attendants and entered the underground world through the secret passage of the manor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1028
chapters.content:
Chapter 1028 – Chapter 1018: Tracking
“Twenty black gold for a radiation baby? Boss, you are robbing me!”
The shop in the underground world was bustling. There was a shop on the left of Dudian and black mage. Dudian looked in the direction of the voice, the counter of the shop was piled with all kinds of bottles and specimens nailed to wooden shelves. Most of them were strange flesh or some kind of limbs. Some of the bottles were full of human babies.
However, the bodies of these babies were deformed. Some of them had strange hands on their abdomen and some of them had strange mouths.
Dudian saw that Dudian was interested, he whispered: “This person bought the radiation baby. It is a research material for low-level witchcraft. It is one of the raw materials for witchcraft blood poison. The price is very cheap. However, it is a bit expensive here. Generally ten pieces of black gold are enough.”
“The other shops have closed down so the goods here have increased.”Dudian retracted his eyes and asked: “Can the radiation baby be sold for ten pieces of black gold?”
Ten pieces of black gold was equivalent to one hundred gold coins. In his understanding, the orphans in the orphanage were sold for a high price. These orphans lived in slums. They drank polluted water and ate poor quality bread. Their bodies had been corroded by radiation. They were considered as radioactive people.
Black mage smiled, “Most of the radiation babies sold in the dark shops are of good quality. The radiation level is more than 70% . If an ordinary person wants to accumulate the radiation in their body to such a degree, they would need to live in the heavily polluted radiation zone for two to three years. If a newborn baby lives in such an environment, it is estimated that it will die in less than three days.”
Dudian frowned: “What are these?”
“These radiation babies are infected by the mother. Their mother’s radiation concentration is very high. They live in the high radiation zone when they are pregnant so the radiation concentration in their body will exceed the standard and they won’t die.”Dark mage smiled, “Some babies in the mother’s body can not withstand the radiation contained in the mother’s body and die early. It takes a lot of time and energy to produce radiation babies. It is not expensive to sell ten pieces of black gold but twenty pieces is a bit too much.”
Dudian was silent. What kind of terrifying and dark industrial chain was this? This kind of industrial chain was only one of the many products in the shop.
“Did you hear that the camp area was attacked by witchcraft?”
“I have long known. I don’t know which bastard did it. It caused all the shops to close down. The things in the headquarters were sold at sky-high prices. My experiment just reached a bottleneck. I need materials urgently. Damn it!”
“I reckon it was done by some wandering magus. He’s really lowly. The people living in camp are all commoners. If this person used witchcraft on a noble or a rich person, it would be understandable. At least he could earn some money. What harm is there in killing those useless people in Camp? The energy wasted on killing them is worth more than their lives!”
“With such a big commotion this time, this idiot is definitely done for.”
The Wizards wearing all kinds of masks were talking about witchcraft.
Black Mage’s hearing was very good so he naturally heard everything. The corner of his mouth twitched. This was the first time he was scolded by so many people! He looked at dudian and said: “Elder, if witchcraft is found out you can’t ignore me.”
Dudian glanced at him: “Even if it is found out, you have the means to get out.”
Black mage bitterly smiled: “My Lord, you think too highly of me.”
“Can you sense which one is bolang?”Dudian looked at the majestic building at the end of the underground square.
Black Mage’s eyes revealed a bit of seriousness. He carefully observed for a moment and shook his head: “I can’t sense it. There is a strange fragrance surrounding the black shop. I Can’t smell the situation inside.”
Dudian slightly frowned. He also smelled the strange fragrance. The fragrance was very faint but it lingered around the building for a long time. It was like a fragrance barrier that covered the building inside. However, it didn’t affect his perspective observation. However, there were so many people inside. Without Black Mage’s identification, he could only rely on himself to slowly observe the building.
At this time, there was a commotion behind the square.
“Get out of the way!”
“Get out of the way!”
Shouts came from behind.
The crowd quickly crowded and pushed Dudian and black mage to the side of the road.
Dudian turned his head and saw a group of knights wearing black armor. There was a dark red scepter tattoo on their breastplates, they were escorting a black-robed figure who was wearing a fox mask.
“It’s Councilman Bolenke!”
“Why is he here?”
“You don’t Know? It must be because of the incident in Camp!”
“It seems that the rogue wizard will be punished soon.”
The crowd was discussing.
Dudian was startled. He didn’t expect that the latter would appear so soon.
He looked at black mage who whispered: “My Lord, I’m not familiar with this bronk. They are local wizards. You Can’t blame me for this. I have no intention to hide it.”
Dudian made a shushing gesture as he looked up at Bronk who was slowly walking towards him. His eyes flashed as he saw through the mask. He was a bit surprised, the material of the mask wasn’t ordinary plastic or metal. It was made of a mixture of alloy and fiber. It looked like a big net.
From the structure of the mask, it wasn’t just a mask but also a very strong defense. It was estimated that ordinary rifle bullets wouldn’t be able to penetrate it!
There was a plain middle-aged man’s face under the mask. The only thing that left a deep impression was his eyes. They were calm and reserved. It was as if there were two dark stars embedded in his face, the ordinary face was embellished with a unique style.
Dudian took a deep look and remembered the face. He was about to take back his eyes when he saw something. He was startled. The Golden Light in his eyes appeared again. His eyes went straight through the fox mask, his eyes fell on the middle-aged man’s face. He found out that the ordinary face was also a mask!
The material was colloid and very thin.
“Double mask?”Dudian’s eyes moved. His line of sight quickly penetrated into the deepest part of the man’s brain. He quickly pulled back and pretended as if nothing had happened.
“Eh?”Bronk felt a strange touch on his face. It was as if there was something terrifying staring at him. His eyes turned and looked at the people on both sides of the road. He saw many strange masks, behind the masks were expressions of excitement, surprise, respect, and indifference. Many of them had a trace of hatred in their eyes, which he had caught.
However, the feeling of hatred from these people was not strong.
“What’s going on?”Blanc was confused. The strange feeling from before had disappeared. It was like an illusion, but the terrifying feeling was very real. He was secretly shocked, he suddenly felt that the attack on the camp wasn’t just an ordinary wandering wizard breaking the rules. Perhaps there was another conspiracy behind it.
Soon, Blanc walked in front of him.
Dudian quietly watched as Blanc’s figure left. He entered the palace-like building behind the square.
The crowd that was separated from the square once again merged together and dispersed.
“Are you sure that this bronk is over fifty years old this year?”Dudian asked as he looked at the Black Mage.
The black mage was surprised: “Sir, many wizards know about this. You can ask them if you don’t believe me. I have heard about it. If you are wrong then I guess everyone is wrong.”
“What kind of wizards do you have here that can restore the appearance of a fifty-year-old to the appearance of a twenty-year-old?”Dudian asked.
Black mage was stunned. He knew that Dudian was referring to Bronk. However, wasn’t Bronk wearing a mask? How did Dudian know that his face was that of a young man in his twenties?
Soon, he thought of Dudian’s perceptive ability. A trace of shock flashed through his eyes but he quickly realized that he couldn’t let Dudian know that he was aware of this, he quickly took the opportunity to say: “A person in his fifties is in his twenties? How is that possible?”
Dudian looked at his stunned face. He frowned but didn’t say anything. He turned around and walked towards the palace.
Black mage quickly caught up: “Sir, let’s wait outside. It’s too dangerous to enter.”
“I know.”
Dudian went outside the palace. He asked black mage to buy a few magic tools from a shop. Both of them were resting in a corner.
“It seems his identity is true.”Dudian murmured. There was a flash of golden light in his eyes. He saw that the people who saw him greeted him as he entered the palace, the people who were sitting quickly stood up. The people who were standing quickly went up to greet him. Their attitude was very respectful. It seemed that he wasn’t a substitute in disguise.
After Blanc entered the building, he called over a dozen people to meet on the third floor. Dudian could read what they were talking about. They were talking about witchcraft.
Dudian quietly watched them discuss and make a decision. His eyes turned to the eight black armored knights who came with Blanc. All of them were equipped with a uniform lance and waist sword, at first glance there was no difference between them and ordinary knights. However their physiques were quite astonishing. Although they suppressed the heat reaction but the density of bones and the internal structure of the body were all at the dominant level!
Dudian used X-ray to observe the body structure of people with different physiques. He had a set of methods to distinguish the strength of the body from the internal organs. The density of bones was only one of them. He found that people with higher physiques.., the more complex the internal structure of the body was. The number of bones and the changes of the nerves and veins were different from that of normal people. This was the transformation of magic marks.
The higher the physique, the larger the body was transformed.
This kind of transformed body could adapt to the larger area covered by the magic body or even the whole magic body.
“He is also the ruler of the eight guardians. He should be at the peak of the ruler. There are scales growing on the bones in his body. His heart is surrounded by complex ribs. It seems his ability is related to defense.”Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed, even if their combat ability wasn’t as good as the abyss, it wasn’t too bad. If their ability was a bit special then they might be able to trap and kill the Abyss!
“This Bolenke is a member of Parliament but he isn’t from the Abyss. He should be lacking polar ice insects.”Dudian thought. It seemed that polar ice insects were rare even in this giant wall, this also meant that it was extremely difficult for Barton and the others to advance into the abyss.
Two hours later, the meeting ended. Blanc went to the office in the building to correct the documents.
Four or five hours later, Dudian waited for him to come out. He called black mage and left the underground shop with Blanc.
“Master, should we follow closely?”The black mage didn’t see Bronk and the eight knights. He tried to use his sense of smell to track them but found that the smell had disappeared. He couldn’t help but ask Dudian.
“Don’t worry. We will be exposed if we follow too close.”Dudian said. He suspected that Bronk had noticed him when he used his X-ray vision. The latter had ordered his men in the office to correct the documents, he wanted them to pay attention to the people who were coming in and out of the headquarters. In the future they would have to register their names in case someone sneaked in.
“But they have disappeared.”Black mage couldn’t help but worry.
“Don’t worry. I know what to do.”Dudian’s eyes flashed as Golden Light appeared from time to time.
Dudian quickly went out of the manor. He jumped to the roof of the street and chased in a direction.
Black mage saw that Dudian seemed to be able to find Bronk so he quickly followed after him.
Ten minutes later, Dudian and black mage stopped under a tall clock tower. Black mage looked ahead and saw eight figures dressed in black robes riding fast horses, they were escorting a man who was also dressed in black robes.
These people stopped in front of a red wine villa. There were guests coming in and out of the villa.
Black Mage’s face slightly changed: “He is going to blend into the crowd!”
Dudian whispered: “I have locked onto him.”
Black mage looked at him. He saw the golden light in Dudian’s eyes. He couldn’t help but feel a trace of fear.
At this time, Dudian saw Bronk and his eight guards enter the red wine villa. They went straight to the cellar of the villa. It was full of good wine. Ordinary guests seemed to be unable to enter.
Soon, Bronk and the eight guards were served by a graceful and beautiful woman behind the counter of the wine manor. They changed their clothes and masks. They changed into suits, tuxedos and so on.
After a while, the eight guards and Bronk came out of the manor. They mixed with the surrounding guests like successful people.
Soon, Bronk came out with a wine gift box in his hand. The eight guards followed behind him. They talked and laughed like good friends.

chapters.title: Chapter 1029
chapters.content:
Chapter 1029 – Chapter 1019: Make A Move
Dudian watched as Bronk and the others left the winery. He took the noble carriage that had been prepared in front of the door and left. He called out to black mage and called for a carriage.
There was a busy area outside the winery. There were often carriages that came to pull customers.
“Have they come out?”Black mage was surprised as he saw Dudian call the carriage. He had carefully observed more than a dozen people who had come out from the winery but he didn’t see anything suspicious.
Dudian didn’t answer him but turned around and got into the carriage.
Black mage quickly followed after him. The coachman slowly drove the carriage and asked: “Where Are you two going?”
“Straight ahead.”Dudian ordered.
“UH, there is no place name…”the coachman didn’t finish his words. A gold coin bounced onto the chair next to him. His eyelids slightly trembled and he stopped talking.
A gold coin was worth half a month’s worth of running. Moreover, business was booming.
The Coachman didn’t talk anymore as he drove the carriage forward.
“Turn left at the intersection ahead.”Dudian commanded.
“Yes, sir.”The Coachman quickly responded and turned.
Two hours later, the carriage stopped in front of a magnificent manor. There were two knights stationed outside the manor every two hundred meters. They were all pioneers. There were twelve silver armored knights guarding the front gate, through the gap of the iron bars of the front gate, one could see the green grass inside the manor. It stretched far away. There were tall buildings at the end of the green grass.
“It’s actually here?”Black mage was a bit surprised. “We have passed by this street several times before. How…”he suddenly realized that the other side was most likely worried that someone was following them.
Dudian got off the carriage. He saw that Bronk and his eight guards had entered the manor in batches. The size of the manor was as big as five international football fields, they could ride horses on the gravel path of the manor.
“Three masters…”golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes as he saw the scenery of the manor. There were three masters in the manor except for Bronk and his eight guards. There was no hidden heat source, the aura emitted from them was much stronger than the eight guards.
Black mage whispered to dudian: “We should wait until night time. The vigilance in broad daylight is too strong.”
Dudian shook his head, “If you think so, others will think so too. The vigilance at night is more alert. No one would think that someone would dare to intrude here in broad daylight. Moreover, for the people inside, the night is no different from the day. They can only hide from the eyes and ears of ordinary knights.”
Black mage was startled. He felt that what Dudian said made sense, he asked: “Should we make a plan to understand the strength of the guards? It would be best if we sneak into the gap where they are working.”
Dudian raised his head and looked around. There was a thoughtful look in his eyes. After a moment he said: “Later you make some noise to attract the guards. I will take the opportunity to sneak in to find Bronk and take him away.”
Black Mage’s eyes were wide open: “I will attract his guards? Isn’t this too much? You are trying to take my life!”Although he was a master.., but he wasn’t good at fighting. The other side had seven or eight masters. He thought that Dudian was going to use him as a sacrifice.
Dudian looked at Black Mage’s eyes, he indifferently said: “You can’t think about things like that. First of all, you attract fire and they will chase after you. If they find out that Bolenck is missing and their master is missing then they will understand that they have fallen into a trap. They will know that you have an accomplice. Will they kill you? “Of course not. They will interrogate you and make you confess.”
“At this time, I will be able to bring Bronk back to save you. At that time, your life will be here and Bronk will fall into our hands. Killing two birds with one stone. At most, you will suffer a little at the last minute.”
The Dark Mage was stunned and looked at him blankly.
After a few seconds, he suddenly reacted. It seemed like… that was the reason.
However, he wasn’t someone who could be fooled with a few words, “How can you be sure that you will be able to catch Bronk? What if your plan fails and I fall into their hands?”
“I need the Thunder filter so I will catch him.”Dudian indifferently said: “If it wasn’t because I was afraid that the other forces in the city or the Lord of Nile would come to support me then I would have been able to solve the problem by myself. But it wouldn’t be safe. If they have some special ability and are held back then things would be unpredictable.”
The black mage was stunned as he saw that Dudian had considered the reinforcement. He suddenly felt that the latter was more thoughtful than he thought. No wonder he could easily sneak into the Bourne family and easily arrest him.
At this moment, he had a common goal. He suddenly felt that it was a good thing to have a partner like Dudian. He thought for a moment, “According to you, the more guards I attract, the more confident you will be in success?”
“Yes.”
Black Mage took a deep breath: “Alright, I’ll do it!”
Dudian looked at him. He was a bit surprised. He thought that he would waste more words. He didn’t think that he would be able to make sense of it.
Black Mage agreed very quickly. But he had thought about it. Even if he refused, Dudian would send him to take the initiative. He was a prisoner and had no choice, moreover, he felt that he was useful to dudian. He wouldn’t abandon him so easily as long as he could capture Blanc.
He was confident that Dudian would be able to suppress him. Although his fighting strength was at the middle and lower level of the master level but his vision wasn’t bad. It was obvious that Dudian was an abyss!
No matter how strong Bolenck was, it would be difficult for him to deal with an abyss.
After making the decision, black mage and Dudian discussed the details again. They went to the side of the manor and suddenly appeared. They killed the two knights in front of the wall, they flew into the manor and rushed towards the distant castles.
“There’s an enemy attack!”
“There’s an intruder! !”
“Someone come quickly, there’s an intruder!”
Alarms immediately sounded throughout the manor, and a large number of patrolling knights stationed in various parts of the manor rushed to the front of the ancient castle. When they saw the black mage rushing over, they immediately shouted and asked.
The black mage wore a mask and roared as he charged into the patrolling knights. Like a wolf entering a flock of sheep, he instantly killed several people. His attack method was extremely cruel, and in a short moment, his entire body was covered in blood, and he laughed wildly.
“Men, you’re courting death!”A thunderous roar came from the sky above the castle. A figure flew out from the top of the castle. He held a golden spear in his hand and attacked the black mage like a god.
The Black Mage roared loudly and swung the knight beside him. With a poof, he was pierced through by the Golden Spear. The tip of the spear did not deviate at all. He did not care about the life and death of the knight who was thrown towards him.
“Blood feud, I want to Kill, Kill, kill! !”The black mage roared towards the sky, his voice spread across several ancient castles. He entered his demonic body and leaped up abruptly to meet the Golden Spear. His demonized arm and sharp claws struck the spear shaft. With a bang, he felt his hands and claws become numb from the impact. He could not help but tremble and use the force to retreat, he turned into a black shadow and escaped at high speed.
“You want to run away?”The youth who was holding the golden spear shouted. A pair of dragon wings extended from his back. His golden armor was broken and fell to the ground. He turned into a golden dragon and chased after the Black Mage.
At the same time four more figures flew out from the castle.
“Get Out! Get Out! Get Out!”The black mage shouted. He looked at the patrolling knights. He was flustered. This time it wasn’t an act. He was really anxious, he could feel that there were four people chasing after him. Their strength wasn’t inferior to his. He didn’t dare to think about fighting one against five. He just wanted to run far away to buy time for Dudian.
He knew that the longer he delayed, the higher the probability of Dudian’s success. So he had to think of a way to attract fire. He even deliberately said the words of blood feud, he had to let Bronk know that he was his enemy. Once he let such an enemy escape, who knew where he would hide?
So Bronk would certainly send more people to chase after him!
However, if he sent four more people at once and they caught up with him, he would be defeated very soon.
Whoosh!
Like a Tyrannosaurus, the black mage charged into the patrol knights. With a wave of his sharp claws, he tore apart the Knights blocking his way. The soles of his feet dug huge holes in the ground, and in the blink of an eye, he had arrived outside the manor, he immediately ran down the crowded street.
Whoosh!
Roaring at full speed, the Golden Dragon gave chase.
..
..
“Father, is this ruler your enemy?”In the castle, in front of an office windowsill, stood a handsome golden-haired young man. He had sharp eyebrows and bright eyes, a high nose bridge, and thin lips, which made him appear somewhat sharp and heartless, at this moment, he looked into the distance and saw the Golden Wyvern and the four figures behind him disappear from his sight. He then withdrew his gaze and asked Bolenke, who was sitting in the office and correcting documents.
Bolenke said indifferently, “Since you barged into this place, you are naturally my enemy.”
The golden-haired young man looked at his father’s calm expression, and his heart was filled with admiration, yearning, and a bit of worship. Since Young, no matter what happened, his father had always been so calm, as if nothing could make him lose his composure.
“Although our family’s businesses have some gray income, I don’t think they would provoke such enemies. Could they be wizards?”The blonde youth asked curiously.
“I don’t know,”Bolenke said indifferently. “I’ve offended too many people in this line of work, so many that I can’t even count them. Maybe it’s a wizard who was robbed of his witchcraft creation, or maybe it’s a child from a broken family who went astray and grew up to be a ruler with hatred. He came here to take revenge, or maybe it’s a bastard child born by a woman…”
The golden-haired young man was stunned for a moment before he couldn’t help but sigh softly.
Indeed, a tall tree attracts the wind. Other than the people that they had offended, the people that their clan’s subordinates had offended would also blame them for this grudge. They had countless enemies..
However, he wasn’t afraid at all. Instead, he felt a sense of pride. Having more enemies meant that they were extraordinary.
After all, the more ordinary a person was, the fewer enemies they had.
Just as he was thinking about this, he suddenly felt a gust of cold wind blowing from his neck. The air suddenly felt a little cold, just like winter had suddenly arrived. He could not help but glance at the windowsill behind him, the trees in the courtyard outside were filled with yellowish maple leaves. It was still autumn. How could it be so cold?
When he retracted his gaze and was about to continue asking his father questions, he suddenly noticed a figure in the room.
A young man in a black robe was wearing a hood, but the hood had already been taken off. There was a leopard mask on his face, which was a bit strange.
“Wizard!”The golden-haired young man’s pupils constricted. He immediately recognized the attire. He couldn’t help but want to open his mouth and call out, but in the next moment, he felt his entire body stiffen. The blood in his body seemed to freeze, and his hands and feet were frozen, he could not move. The intense fear made his mouth open, but he could not make a sound. He could only hear his heart thumping wildly, deafening.
He had never thought that there was anything that could make him so afraid. Even if it was the poisonous snakes that he hated the most, he would not be so afraid that he could not speak. However, at this moment, he had an indescribable fear, it was even more terrifying than seeing thousands of poisonous snakes in front of him. However, he could not say what he was afraid of. He was clearly just a human.
Blanck’s face was gloomy. His eyes were staring at the figure that suddenly appeared in front of him. With his perception, he could not figure out how this person came to be here.
Moreover, he suddenly realized that sending four guards to chase after him earlier seemed to be a wrong choice. It was a simple trick to lure the tiger away from the mountain. However, he had fallen into the trap!
“Who are you?”Blanc took a deep breath. His palm slowly moved to the drawer where there was a button. His heart sank when he saw Dudian take off the mask.
The other party was not afraid to show his true face. It meant that today’s matter was difficult to be settled!
Whoosh!
He quickly touched the button.
Puff!
The table suddenly cracked. It seemed that the function of the button was to split the table. Blanc’s fingers touched the top but before he could press it, the table had already cracked. The wires behind the button were cut, it was destroyed.
“If you want to call for help, the moment you open your mouth, you will have my blade in your mouth.”Dudian’s eyes flashed with a strange light as he smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1030
chapters.content:
Chapter 1030 – Chapter 120: Zerg Apparatus
Blanc’s face was ugly. He felt that a strange killing intent had locked onto him. Any reaction of his body would be detected. He took a deep breath to calm himself down. He believed that.., even if he didn’t send out the alarm, they would be aware of the situation. What he needed to do was to stabilize the current situation and understand the enemy.
“Are you in cahoots with the people outside?”Blanc stared at Dudian, “If my guess is correct, you should be related to the witchcraft incident in camp. What’s Your Purpose? To kill me? Or do you want to get something from me?”
“It’s simple to talk to smart people.”Dudian smiled: “I heard that you have a magic tool called ‘Thunder Filter’. Can you lend it to me?”
Blanc was relieved: “What Thunder Filter? I’ve never heard of it.”
Dudian shook his head, “I just praised you for being smart. Do you think that we would take such a big risk to attack your house? Do you think that we wouldn’t investigate in detail? Or do you want to delay the time until they come to rescue you?”
Blanc’s face sank, “Even if the Thunder filter is in my hands, I will not lend it to you. It is a top-grade magic tool. It is a treasure that can not be duplicated. If it is broken, it will be permanently broken. No one knows how to repair it. Even I will not easily use it.”
Dudian looked at him seriously. Blanc also looked at dudian. His eyes were resolute.
“Alright!”Dudian sighed and took the lead to look away.
Blanc was relieved. He felt that he had temporarily grasped the situation. But the next moment, a scream echoed out. He looked at the source of the scream and his face changed. He was furious as he stood up from his chair, he saw the blonde youth by the windowsill. There was a black dagger in his chest. The Dagger was aimed at his heart. His entire body was nailed to the wall. The Scream didn’t last for long before it stopped. His head drooped down.
“You!”Blanc’s face was livid. Black mucus rushed out from his body and quickly entered the magic body.
However, when the magic body was halfway into the magic body, the figure in front of him flashed. Dudian appeared in front of him as if he had teleported. His palm hit his shoulder. He felt as if his shoulder was broken and his whole body sank down.
The next moment, a cold and piercing pain came from his neck.
He slightly lowered his eyebrows and saw that one of Dudian’s arms had turned into a sharp blade.
The black mucus in his body suddenly stopped. It was like boiling water that had been extinguished.
“Your wife, daughter, grandson, granddaughter and your own life are here. Who Do you think is more important than the Thunder Filter?”Dudian whispered.
Blanc’s body was stiff. The anger on his face had long disappeared. There was a trace of fear in his eyes. Dudian was more terrifying than he had imagined. It was the first time he had met someone who had forced his magic body to be unable to enter. The most important thing was.., dudian didn’t enter the magic body. His human body had burst out with such terrifying speed! There was no doubt that the other party was an abyss. Moreover, it should be an abyss that was good at speed!
Even if Lord Nile was here, he might not be able to save him!
The room was suddenly knocked open. At the same time, the roof above Dudian’s head suddenly exploded and a figure jumped down. In addition, a person jumped into the window, in the blink of an eye, four people stood in the room and completely surrounded Dudian. They were the remaining four of the eight guards who were guarding the room.
“Master!”
The four people looked at Blanc who was being held by Dudian and the blonde youth who was nailed to the windowsill. Their faces turned ugly. The enemy had broken into the room but they didn’t feel anything, if it wasn’t for the screams of the blonde youth that alerted them and made them release their senses to explore the room, they wouldn’t have known about the situation here.
“Dog is here.”Dudian glanced at the four people and smiled: “Have you thought about it?”
Blanc’s face changed. After a moment he took a deep breath: “I Promise You!”
“Master!”
The four people didn’t know what he promised. They couldn’t help but call out. They looked at each other in an attempt to find a loophole to attack and rescue blanc.
Blanc knew that the four of them alone wouldn’t be able to save him from the hands of an abyss. He sighed and said: “You go back first. Don’t worry. I will take him to get the Thunder Filter.”
The four of them understood Dudian’s intention. They slowly retreated.
Dudian carried blanc out of the room and asked him to show them the way.
The four of them exchanged glances with each other after Dudian left the room. Two of them followed behind while the other two left through another way to ambush dudian.
