After a moment, Dudian and Bronk followed the secret passage to the basement of the castle. They passed through layers of traps which were cancelled in advance because of Bronk’s guidance.
Finally, the two stopped in front of a secret room in the basement. As the door of the secret room slowly rose up, a seemingly magical instrument appeared in front of them.
“Is this the Thunderbolt Filter?”Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise. The instrument was like a three meter tall globe. However, what was embedded in the middle of the instrument was not the earth but a circular ring, the edge of the metal ring was engraved with mysterious and complicated runes. It looked like some kind of language. There was an extension of a cylindrical mirror at the connection between the ring and the tray of the instrument. The cylindrical mirror could bend and be perpendicular to the instrument.
The entire instrument didn’t look complicated. In fact, it was quite simple. It was even more ordinary than the structure of a microscope.
“This is the Thunderbolt filter you want.”Bronk’s eyes were gloomy: “You can take it but you must promise me that you will not find trouble with my family.”
Dudian took him to the front of the Thunder filter. He looked at it for a moment and asked: “How do I Use This?”
Blanc hesitated for a moment but still went forward to give him directions, “This is the switch. The Thunder filter relies on electrical energy but there are batteries stored in it. You can charge it after the battery is used up. This is the observation mirror, this is the sample support mirror and this is the multiplier mirror…”
Dudian listened carefully. The Thunder filter looked very simple. It was like a simple metal ring. But he didn’t expect that there were many small things on it. But the overall operation wasn’t complicated. It was similar to a microscope.
“Open it for me to see.”Dudian told Bronk. He didn’t do it himself. After all, this was a giant wall with electrical energy. Even if he was in the abyss, he would be turned into ashes in front of the overload voltage.
Bronk sighed in his heart as he saw Dudian being so careful. However he didn’t deceive dudian. He immediately opened the Thunder filter.
Hiss!
Dudian saw the sizzling electricity coming out of the metal ring when the filter was opened. The complex runes engraved around the metal ring were flashing with mysterious blue light. It was like an electric circuit that lit up the entire metal ring, soon, more and more electric light flashed in the metal ring. It seemed that there was a special magnetic field in the ring that was pulling the flashing electric current to each other.
It didn’t take long for the electric current to build a large net in the metal ring. It looked like electric light was flashing. It was extremely shocking.
“What you need to observe is a strand of hair.”Bronk pulled a strand of silver hair from his head and threw it into the flashing electric current in the metal ring. The silver hair was instantly hit by the electric current and turned into powder. Blanc came to the observation mirror next to the metal ring. He wasn’t afraid of the electric current. He moved his eyes to the cylinder, “Now you can see the composition of all the materials in the hair. Do you want to take a look?”
Dudian was stunned. He didn’t think that the usage of the Thunder filter would be like this. It was the first time he heard that an object would be broken down by electric current. Wouldn’t the experiment be destroyed?
He didn’t ask but followed Bronk’s instructions. He first looked through the observation mirror.
However, he didn’t directly go up. He focused on the distance. Soon he saw countless small balls moving in the observation mirror. The color was pitch black like black grapes.
“Is this the structure of hair?”Dudian frowned. He suddenly felt that the effect of the Thunder filter wasn’t very big because he didn’t know what level of hair he was looking at.
However, since he had succeeded, it would be a waste of effort if he didn’t use it.
“Turn it off.”Dudian said.
Blanc immediately turned off the button. The electric current in the metal ring gradually decreased until it was extinguished. The Secret Room returned to darkness and there was no sound of electric current.
“Where did this thing come from? Is it from the ruins?”Dudian tentatively touched the metal ring. He felt that it was a bit warm. He estimated that it would be hot after a long time. He looked at the runes engraved on the ring and suddenly felt that.., this thing didn’t seem to come from the old era.
Sure enough, Blanc’s words confirmed his guess, “It is said that this was found from an ancient civilization spaceship in the depths of the magic pit. It is in good condition. Unfortunately, the ancient civilization spaceship seems to have been destroyed. It has been in disrepair for a long time and has been broken.” Blanc still had a feeling of regret.
“It is really those insects…”Dudian’s eyes lit up. Since the last time he saw the spaceship in the ice dragon’s nest he was sure that the insects came from an alien planet, they were able to cross the Sea of stars to invade the Earth. They must have mastered technology that humans didn’t have. After all, the technology of humans couldn’t fly out of the Solar System when the old era was destroyed!
Dudian thought that this was the technology from the insects. Even if it was useless to him at the moment, it had a very high research value.
“Is there anything to pack?”Dudian asked Bronk.
Bronk thought that this was the problem, “No, this has to be handled carefully by several people. Otherwise, it might be damaged. This is the reason why I haven’t moved this thing since it was moved here.”
Dudian frowned and didn’t say anything.
Bronk sneered in his heart. He had guessed that Dudian’s accomplices wouldn’t be too many. He estimated that there were at most three of them. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have sent only one person to lure his guards, the risk was too great if he failed! Moreover, even if Dudian had accomplices, he wouldn’t dare to come over. His guards weren’t easy to deal with.
“Well, call your guards over.”Dudian said after thinking for a moment.
Blanc was slightly surprised, “Call them over?”
“Help to carry the goods.”Dudian said.
Blanc almost choked on his own saliva. He couldn’t help but stare at Dudian. However, when he saw Dudian’s unquestionable expression, his eyes softened. He felt as if he was robbed by a dog, how could he send people to help him? Was there such a thing? ! Was there? !
Dudian took Blanc out of the underground chamber and walked to the door. Dudian looked at the three guards hidden in the surroundings. There were two guards outside the door, he indifferently said: “All five of you come over.”
The eyes of the three guards were filled with shock. They were the best at hiding among the guards. They didn’t expect that dudian would be able to see through them.
Smell? Life reaction? Heartbeat? Heat? They thought that they were all hidden. They were hiding in the surroundings like stones! Even if they were in the magic pit, they would be able to hide from the abyss level monster hunters. But now they were seen through!
Bronk’s eyelids twitched. He only saw two guards but he knew that there must be an ambush in the dark. He didn’t expect that Dudian would say it out loud. The last trace of hope in his heart was destroyed.
“The one who licked his lips, still not coming out?”Dudian opened his mouth again.
The face of a youth who was hiding in the dark stiffened. His tongue that was licking his lips was stiff. He didn’t dare to move. But soon he was like a deflated ball. He slowly walked out of the dark, if he still thought that Dudian was deliberately blackmailing him then he was really out of his mind.
The other two who were hiding in the dark were shocked as they slowly walked out.
“You tell them.”Dudian looked at the five people standing in front of him.
The corner of Blanc’s mouth twitched as he resisted the urge to strangle Dudian’s neck. He clenched his teeth: “The five of you, come with me to the secret room. Take out the Thunder filter and help him send it out.”
The five of them were stunned as they looked at each other. They suspected that they had heard wrong. But after looking at Blanc’s constipated expression, they were convinced that this was not a joke.
Ten minutes later, Dudian took blanc out of the manor. The five guards behind them were carrying the Thunder filter. They were extremely careful regardless of whether Dudian could escape or not, they didn’t dare to damage the Thunder filter.
“It seems I can’t wait for Lord Nile to come.”Dudian whispered as he looked at the street outside the manor.
Bronk’s eyelids twitched as he heard Dudian’s words. He didn’t expect Dudian to be so calm all the way. However he didn’t forget about all the guards around him, there were six people left in his castle but there were only five people who carried the Thunder filter. He knew that Dudian had gone to the Lord of Nile to ask for help. He didn’t expect that Dudian would guess it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1031
chapters.content:
Chapter 1031 – Chapter One Thousand Twenty-One: Escape
Dudian followed the direction of the Black Mage’s escape. They jumped on top of the buildings on the street like a group of assassins wandering on the gray edge.
A moment later, Dudian met the black mage on the edge of the square. He had been caught. One of his arms had been cut off and his body was covered in blood. It seemed that he had experienced an intense battle.
The black mage was being escorted by a handsome youth who was holding a golden spear. He was accompanied by four guards who had already unlocked the magic body. At the moment, he was leading the black mage back along the original path, he was going to hand over this unknown person to Bronk.
When they met Dudian and Bronk, the handsome youth and the others were stunned. They didn’t expect to see their master here.
Black mage saw Dudian holding blanc. His eyes were covered with blood. His old face was full of surprise. He didn’t expect that Dudian had succeeded! Moreover he had found him so quickly! In this way, he wouldn’t have to suffer the pain of being escorted back by these people!
“Master?”The handsome young man looked at the dark-faced Bolenke. He swept his gaze over and saw the five people behind him, as well as the Thunder filter they were carrying. He could not help but widen his eyes. Soon.., they understood that they had fallen into the enemy’s scheme.
“You actually betrayed Master!”The handsome young man shouted angrily at the five people carrying the Thunder filter.
The corners of their mouths twitched but they didn’t answer.
Bronk sighed: “You guys, let him go.”
Dudian smiled: “Smart, you know what I’m going to say.”
Bronk was praised by Dudian but he didn’t feel happy at all. Instead he felt humiliated.
The handsome youth and the four people behind him changed their expressions: “Master, this man is his accomplice. We can’t let him go so easily!” He shouted at dudian: “If you let our master go then I will let him go. One person for one person!”
Dudian faintly smiled: “Do you think his life is comparable to your master’s?”
The youth sneered: “Since you have found him, it is hard to say if he is worth your exchange!”
“Is that so?”Dudian looked at blanc: “Your servants don’t seem to care about your life and death. In that case, let them have an eye-opening experience. For example, this way…” Blanc’s arm was twisted to 180 degrees. The sound of breaking was heard.
Blanc cried out in pain. His head was covered in cold sweat: “Quick, let him go!”
The handsome youth’s face changed. He didn’t expect that dudian would be so unscrupulous. He wasn’t afraid of angering him. He wanted to use Dudian’s side to torture the hostages, he didn’t dare to gamble as he tore off Dudian’s mask. Moreover his chips were the ones that saved his life.
“Get Out!”The handsome youth clenched his teeth and coldly pushed the black mage out. He believed that even if the black mage returned to Dudian’s side, he would hold a grudge against him. The relationship between the two was estranged.
The black mage was relieved and quickly ran to Dudian. He was extremely angry with the handsome youth. He was afraid that the latter’s attitude would be tough. In that case, he felt that Dudian might give up on him. After all.., his weight couldn’t be compared to Blanc! Fortunately, Blanc was afraid of death so he gave in. Otherwise, he would be in danger today.
“Get them out of here.”Dudian said to Blanc.
Blanc gritted his teeth and endured the pain. At the same time, he had to endure the humiliation: “You can leave first.”
“Master!”The handsome youth couldn’t help but call out.
“Listen!”Blanc’s voice became heavier.
The handsome youth clenched his teeth and finally led the four guards behind him to back away.
“If we find out that you are secretly following us, your master’s life will not be lost but he won’t be able to live comfortably.”Dudian smiled as he passed by them.
The handsome youth’s eyebrows were raised as he looked at Dudian’s back. His fingers were clenched and his fists were cracking.
“Can you walk on your own?”Dudian looked at the black mage who was limping in front of him.
The Black Mage’s face was full of pain: “It’s alright. Fortunately you came in time. Otherwise I would have been killed by these bastards.”
Dudian nodded: “Since it’s alright then you will be responsible for moving the Thunder filter. Is that Alright?”
The black mage was stunned as he looked at Dudian.
Dudian didn’t seem to be joking. He looked at the five people who were carrying the Thunder filter. He bitterly smiled: “It will be a bit difficult for me to move it by myself.”
“Then I will leave one to help you.”Dudian quickly made a decision. He looked at bronk: “Let four of them go. One of them will follow.”
Bronk’s face slightly changed: “This is impossible. What if you break your promise after you take the filter? Either you release me with them and you take the filter with you or they will follow!”
“You are not qualified to talk about conditions.”Dudian coldly said.
Blanc stared at him and took a deep breath, “Don’t forget that the filter is in my hands. Your purpose is to get the Thunder filter right? If something happens to me then my people will smash the Thunder filter. You Won’t get anything!”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He didn’t think that he would think of this. He wasn’t a simple character. He indifferently said: “Destroying the Thunder filter isn’t good for anyone…”
“If I’m going to die then I don’t care about the pros and cons.”Bronk was acting like a bachelor. He could see that Dudian cared about the Thunder filter. Even if he deliberately hid it, he would be able to see through it, after all, he had been a member of Parliament for so many years. This was his bargaining chip, “Everyone takes what they need. You need the Thunder filter. I only want to save my life. You are holding me hostage because you want to leave safely. I can promise you that I will not pursue you. But at the same time, you must promise that you will not disturb me and my family in the future.”
Dudian looked at him in silence for a moment: “Alright, let your people put the Thunder filter to the side. Then I will release you.”
Blanc frowned: “What if you take the filter and don’t release me?”
“It’s very simple. The Thunder filter is such a big object. Two people have to carry it to send it away. How can I carry the filter if I take you with me?”Dudian indifferently said.
Bronk frowned. He pondered for a moment and finally agreed.
The five guards immediately put the Thunder filter on the ground. Dudian asked the black mage to take care of it. Then he took Bronk to the front of the five guards: “I always keep my word. Let’s go.”
Bronk was relieved. The next moment he felt a cold sensation on his back. He felt a tearing pain coming from his chest. He looked down and saw a sharp blade coming out from his chest. It was the heart.
“You!”Blanc’s eyes were full of fear and despair.
Dudian pulled out the sharp blade and pushed Blanc towards the five of them. His whole body was burning with flames. A special blood-colored bone appeared on his forehead. The sun was shining down from the sky.
“Die!”Dudian’s eyes were cold. The blood-colored bone shot out several rays.
The five guards were stunned by the sudden change. They rushed forward to catch the body of Bolenck when it was pushed in front of them. They hoped that Bolenck would be able to save his life.
However, they found that Bolenck was completely dead.
At the same time, some of them reacted fast. They were ready to attack Dudian but Dudian had already entered the magic body state. The rays from the blood bone in his forehead shot out like a beam of light, the five people’s foreheads were penetrated in an instant.
At the same time, five rays were shot out. Dudian felt that his heart was beating violently. He even felt a trace of pain. He panted as his face turned pale, he quickly turned around and flew to the front of the Thunder filter. He said in a hoarse voice: “Go!”
Black mage was shocked by Dudian’s attack. He could clearly see that the five guards were killed in an instant. Their heads were shot through! They were the five masters!
The black mage’s heart was pounding as he heard Dudian’s hoarse voice. Was this the Combat Power of the abyss level? ! No, even in the abyss, it should be considered a very strong existence right? !
He quickly moved the Thunder filter with Dudian.
The two carried the filter and rushed forward. They left the place in the blink of an eye.
Not long after, the two of them rushed out of the main city of the Nile territory. The patrolling guards on the city wall chased after them desperately, but they were soon left behind by the two of them. The two of them continued to run forward. After running for more than an hour, they finally stopped. They came to a wilderness near the giant wall. Low-level mutated beasts could be seen everywhere around them. They were infected by radiation and had mutated genes. Their hair was rotting, and their bodies were oozing pus.
Black Mage panted as he put the Thunder filter on the ground. He didn’t care about his image as he sat on the ground. One of his arms was cut off and he was left with only one arm to hold the Thunder filter.
“Phew, Phew, why didn’t you agree with him? We took away the Thunder filter and they left obediently. They didn’t dare to offend us so we didn’t have to suffer. I guess Lord Nile has been alerted. We are definitely wanted criminals in his territory.”Black Mage panted as he spoke.
Dudian sat next to him. His chest was slightly up and down. He wiped the sweat off his face, he said in a bad tone: “Of course it’s best if we do that. But how could Bolenck be willing to let us take away the Thunder filter? Once I let him go, he only needs to join hands with his five guards to attack the Thunder filter. We will have to protect the Thunder filter. At that time the initiative of the attack will be in their hands. Once the deadlock is over, the other guards will arrive. Lord Nile will also arrive. Even more important figures will be alerted. Our plan will be in vain. Moreover, we will be exposed!”
Black mage was stunned. He found out that this was very dangerous. It was difficult to guarantee that Bronk wouldn’t attack the Thunder filter in order to restrain them.
“You are thoughtful.”Black mage took a deep breath and said with a trace of admiration.
The more he interacted with Dudian, the more he admired and respected him. Dudian made him deeply understand what it meant to be fearful of the later generation!
A strong fighting strength wasn’t scary. What was scary was the mentality and the ruthless shrewdness!
At this time, Dudian’s breathing gradually calmed down. He stood up and took off his black robe, including his boots. A ball of flame burned in his palm. He looked like a magician, he burned the black robe and boots in his hand. He looked at black mage: “Take Off your clothes and eliminate the smell. You are ready to leave.”
Black mage saw Dudian’s magical fire ability. He couldn’t help but think of the scene where he killed five masters in one breath. His eyelids twitched. It was the first time he had seen such a magical ability, he had never heard of it before.
Suddenly, his heart shivered.
Dudian noticed the change in his eyes: “It seems you have guessed it.”
Black mage was stunned: “What?”
“My identity.”Dudian looked at him with a smile.
Black Mage’s body was covered in cold sweat but his expression changed from stunned to confused: “What Identity?”
“There is no need to act. Your body has made an honest response.”Dudian smiled: “Since you have guessed it then you should know that I am capable of doing anything here.”
Black mage forced a smile: “My lord you are joking.”
“Let’s go.”Dudian grabbed the Thunder filter. He stretched out his wings and carried the Thunder filter on his back.
Black mage looked at Dudian’s back as he flew away. He quickly caught up with him. The more he thought about it the more he felt excited.
That night.
There was a small town on the outer edge of Phoenix. There were only three or four wealthy families in the town. Their houses had large manors. The land in the town was cheap. Several of them had built large manors, the size of the land was not inferior to that of the main city of Phoenix.
At the moment, in one of the manors, the dim light made the hall covered with wallpaper a bit gray. A few servants, a few women and young men were shivering in the corner of the hall.
The black mage sat on the sofa at the side and asked a young maid to peel an apple for him. The maid’s hand that was holding the knife was shaking non-stop, and the apple was almost peeled until only the core was left.
“Silly girl, you’re courting Death!”The black mage was extremely thirsty. Seeing the apple that was peeled to the size of an orange, he could not help but roll his eyes and raise his hand to slap the maid’s face. If he really hit her, the maid’s chin would be dislocated.
“Be careful.”Dudian’s voice came from the middle of the hall, “It is a coward’s behavior to casually attack the weak.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1032
chapters.content:
Chapter 1032 – : Chapter 1222: Infinite Evolution
The black mage’s raised hand paused. He turned around and smiled: “I was just joking with her. I wouldn’t bother with a lowly maid. Hitting her would dirty my hands!”
The maid was scared and her face turned pale.
“Alright, we are going to stay in this town for a few days. Don’t go too far.”Dudian was too lazy to waste his time to argue with the black mage. He focused on studying the Thunder filter.
Black mage smiled and nodded. He turned his face away. He thought to himself: “How much better can you be than me? You are still teaching me, you crazy murderer!”! He was too lazy to argue with the stupid maid. Although he was dissatisfied with Dudian’s tone and attitude but he felt that his words were reasonable. It was indeed ungraceful to casually attack the weak.
Of course, it was different if he had a purpose.
Dudian opened the Thunder filter. The flashing electric current came out from the metal ring. It was connected to each other to form a net. The huge metal ring looked like the frame of the Thunder Mirror. He bit off a piece of his fingernail and threw it into the electric current. The hard fingernail was hit by the electric current. It floated in the electric net. After a few rolls it turned into ashes and disappeared.
Dudian immediately looked at the observation mirror. He saw some pale yellow particles appear in the observation mirror. He adjusted the magnification from 200 times to 500 times. The pale yellow particles were gradually enlarged, these tiny particles contained countless small particles. The surface of these small particles was cracked. It looked like the lines of a palm. He continued to magnify the magnification from 500 times to 1,000 times and then 1,500 times..
The small particles kept expanding and contained new tiny particles. It was very magical.
Dudian couldn’t remember how many times he had twisted. When the multiplier button was turned to the bottom, he saw a magical scene in the observation mirror. It was like the Earth in the starry sky!
It was a light yellow ball. It was like a planet floating in the starry sky. However, it didn’t spin. However, there were four different colored lights revolving around it. It was like the Moon was revolving around the earth, the four small balls were red, blue, gold, and white. Their orbits were constant and the magnetic fields between them were very stable.
When the multiples were slightly reduced, they could see that the four balls of light were revolving around the ball. Their surface was covered with a nearly transparent membrane which covered them inside.
If one had to describe it, it would be like… the universe and the starry sky!
Dudian was stunned by this wonderful scene. If it wasn’t for the initial light yellow particles that were magnified step by step, he would have suspected that there was something wrong with the instrument. He couldn’t believe it, this was the smallest landscape of his fingernail material. Of course, it was possible that what the Thunder filter saw was not necessarily the smallest.
After a long time, Dudian slowly shrank back and saw the initial light yellow particles. He chose to reset the filter. The scene in the observation mirror was quickly cleared away and only darkness was left.
Dudian thought for a moment and put a bit of the fruit on the table next to him into the lightning net.
The fruit powder was quickly crushed. Dudian looked through the observation mirror and saw a bubble-like ball. It was the nutrient composition of the fruit. He continued to zoom in and finally saw a connected ball of different colors, colorful.
“It seems I have to try to know what I see.”Dudian muttered to himself. He called the black mage who was resting next to him and asked him to help move the Thunder filter to the main room, then he cleaned the bookcase and desk in the main room. He stuffed them into the bedroom next to the main room so that no one would notice the unusual situation.
“You are in charge of these people. Don’t leak the news.”Dudian told the Black Mage.
The black mage laughed: “Leave it to me.”
Dudian closed the door and studied the Thunder filter in the main room.
After a few days, Dudian had completely mastered the Thunder filter. During this time he had broken down the samples including paper, table, Lamp’s plastic shell, blanket, Beast’s skin and so on, there was even the blood of the black mage, the other maids in the manor, the blood of the manor owner and his children, flesh and so on.
Through the observation of the Thunderbolt filter, Dudian found an amazing phenomenon. His own blood composition was completely different from the others.
When his blood expanded to the extreme, the scene he saw was almost the same as the scene he saw on the first day when his fingernails were broken down. There were four small balls surrounding a ball, the four small spheres were also red, blue, gold, and white. However, the spheres that they surrounded turned from light yellow to blood color. It was probably because the samples were taken from blood.
Dudian tried different parts of the blood. It was the same. He also tried his hair and found that there were four small spheres surrounding the sphere. However, the sphere that was surrounded turned black.
When the multiples shrank, the large sphere and the four small spheres were wrapped by a translucent membrane. It looked like a whole sphere. From the outside of the membrane, there were four vague traces of four colors. However, when the multiples shrank.., there were countless membrane spheres around the membrane spheres. There was actually a membrane on the outside of all the membrane spheres that covered all the membrane spheres.
As the membrane sphere continued to shrink, it was also covered by a larger membrane sphere.
His blood and flesh samples were collected and observed the final landscape. There was no change. He even planned to cut his bones to observe. Logically speaking, different parts should have different compositions. However.., his body couldn’t be measured by a normal human body. After all, he had been implanted with magic marks and his body had been deeply modified by magic marks. Moreover, he had been experimented by Crimson Moon. In a sense, he was no longer a human.
Dudian found that the blood landscape of the black mage was similar to the blood landscape of the maids in the manor. The black mage had two balls of the same size surrounding each other, like the Yin and Yang Pisces, the two balls were surrounded by a shining star ring. The maids were also surrounded by two balls of the same size but there were no star rings around them.
“I don’t know what is the definition of a human. Is it a cell or a gene? Or is it something deeper or something else?”Dudian had a toothache, this was his biggest headache. There was no basis for measurement. Although he could observe the smallest material composition, he didn’t know what it represented and how to define it.
Time flew by. Dudian stayed in the manor for almost a month.
Many people came to the manor to look for the master. But they were sent away by the master. Some of his men came to report the income and expenditure.
The master’s family didn’t dare to act rashly. They didn’t even have the chance to sneak a glance at him.
Dudian stayed in the main room. He had changed from using the Thunder filter to observe the material. He used the Thunder filter to observe the changes of the material and deduce the general characteristics of the material.
As he observed more and more, he found something incredible.
He felt that the final scene he saw through the Thunder filter wasn’t the real final scene in his body. There should be more wonderful scenes in the interior of the big ball. However, he wouldn’t be able to see it with the help of the Thunder filter.
In addition, by comparing the genes of a ruler like the black mage and the genes of ordinary humans like the maids in the manor, he found that his body had many characteristics that their bodies did not have!
First of all, his healing ability was fast. Under the situation where the magnetic field of the most basic structure was stable, even if his body was cut open, it would heal quickly. The strong magnetic field would quickly gather and restore the divided material.
Under the same experiment, Black Mage’s healing ability was obviously weakened by more than ten times. He only needed more than a minute to recover. Black mage needed nearly half an hour while the maids needed a day or even two days.
In addition, Dudian found that when other materials mixed into his blood, the final scene he saw was the four-colored ball around the big ball. It was still maintaining a constant trajectory. When other materials invaded it.., it was like hitting a train when it encountered the four-colored sphere. It was immediately destroyed and the fragments merged into the big sphere.
But the strange thing was that the big sphere had absorbed other substances but its volume didn’t increase and there was no change.
When he was mixed with other substances and reached a certain amount, he found that there seemed to be a faint shadow ring on the four-colored sphere around the big sphere!
Especially when he mixed in the blood of the parasitic soul worm. The final scene of the parasitic soul worm’s blood was not two spheres like that of a human. Instead, it was a sharp blue awl that looked like ice, when the ice was close to the big sphere and the four-colored sphere, it was immediately smashed by the four-colored sphere along the trajectory. The fragments of the ice were sucked into the big sphere, the Phantom of the ring around the four-colored sphere became clearer.
Dudian made two surprising discoveries after repeated attempts. The first was that the big sphere in the final landscape of his body was attractive! He found that every time the material was smashed, it would be absorbed instead of falling naturally. The sphere had the ability to devour. It was like a tiny black hole in his body. Every drop of blood in his body.., there were countless such small black holes!
Other than the devouring ability, he also discovered that the blood of the parasitic soul worm could facilitate the birth of the mysterious star ring!
However, when he experimented with the black mage’s fresh blood, he realized that there was something different. The two spheres that formed the landscape and the star ring that surrounded the outside of the black mage’s body, when they collided with the ice shards of the parasitic soul worm, they actually suffered mutual damage.., the ice was broken and the ring and the two spheres were also broken. They were separated from each other and didn’t merge with each other. There seemed to be some kind of repulsive force between them.
“It seems that my body is very different from ordinary people. I don’t know if it is because of the abyss or because of the Aragami gene in my body.”Dudian pondered over the past few days, it was an eye-opener for him. After repeated experiments he had an incredible guess which was the potential of his body!
After repeated experiments he found that the ring that formed the outside of the landscape seemed to be the power of magic marks!
He could confirm this point after repeated experiments.
There was only one ring for the black mage. It meant that his magic marks were one kind.
His final form was a large sphere and a four-colored ball. After absorbing the blood of the parasitic soul worms, the four-colored ball had a star ring on it. Every time he absorbed one, a star ring would appear on the outside of the small sphere.
For this, he had no choice but to let the black mage travel back and forth between the town and sneak into the black shops in the city to buy a large number of different low-level parasitic soul worms.
Fortunately, he was only using them for experiments. The requirements weren’t high. He didn’t need rare or legendary level parasitic soul worms. Even ordinary parasitic soul worms could be bought. It wasn’t difficult for the black mage to buy them. He could even buy them in batches.
After absorbing four different parasitic soul worms, the four-colored sphere was surrounded by rings. Dudian continued to try the fifth type. However, he was shocked to find that there was an additional ring on one of the four-colored spheres!
The two rings looked more gorgeous.
Dudian found that there was no limit to the number of rings on the four-colored spheres!
After adding more than thirty different parasitic soul worms, the number of rings was still stacking up! There were eight or nine rings on each four-colored sphere which almost covered the original light of the four-colored sphere!
This was only a part of the blood experiment, but the experiment was successful.
Dudian couldn’t help but think, could my body be like this? Infinite Absorption, infinite evolution?
This idea was a bit bold, even shocking. But the experiment in front of him couldn’t help but make Dudian think otherwise. This result was too shocking, but it also brought great excitement. If it was really possible.., he didn’t dare to imagine what kind of terrifying power a person who could absorb two, three, four or even more magic marks would have!
“If it is successful… maybe he is really a God!”
Dudian thought of Crimson Moon’s pursuit. Could it be that her experiment was successful on him!
If so, wouldn’t his body be considered as a god’s body!
In any case, Dudian felt that it was necessary to give it a try. In any case, his current situation couldn’t be any worse! Moreover, the repeated experiments with the Thunder filter over the past month had given him a lot of confidence.
A week later, Dudian and black mage left the town and moved the Thunder filter away. They found a cheap house in a remote place. Dudian contacted Barton and the others and asked them to take care of it.
Barton and the others had blended into the circle of the giant wall of Berga. Many of them had a legitimate identity but there were still a small number of people who hadn’t had the time to take care of the Thunder filter.
“Look at the ranking of the strongest legendary monsters here. Is there a place to sell legendary parasitic soul worms?”Dudian and the black mage were drinking tea in a cafe. The Black Mage’s broken hand had been bandaged, he was also used to one-handed activities. He was ready to give himself a new arm when he was free.

chapters.title: Chapter 1033
chapters.content:
Chapter 1033 – Chapter 123: Fusion
“It’s easy to rank the legendary monsters. I’ll give you a copy of the Magic Institute’s Atlas. But there are places that sell legendary parasitic soul worms. But with our funds, we can’t compete with others even if we sell them.”Black mage was about to drink the coffee, he slowly put it back on the table after hearing Dudian’s words.
Dudian looked at him: “How did you get the legendary parasitic soul worm?”
Black mage wryly smiled: “I have been saving money for so many years to buy it. Since I became the master, the subsequent funds have been invested in the experiment. I don’t have much savings. It’s not that I’m reluctant to give it to you.”
“Isn’t it enough to add the Bourne Family?”Dudian narrowed his eyes.
Dark Mage was startled, he hesitated: “It is enough. But the Bourne family’s industry is a fixed asset. It would be a loss if we want to liquidate it as soon as possible. Moreover the Bourne family is a big family. If we suddenly sell off our own industry, it will attract the attention of other families. If they find out anything then we will be exposed.”
“Is this the reason why you didn’t attack Bourne?”Dudian thought for a moment and got up: “Show me the Atlas First.”
Black mage quickly got up and followed.
After returning to the hotel, black mage asked someone to buy a copy of the Atlas from the nearby Magic Institute. The Atlas was like a magazine express, but the paper was smooth. It was made of high-grade coated paper with color pictures taken by a camera on the surface, it wasn’t like the drawing in the giant wall of Sylvia.
The first thing that caught his eyes was the sequence of monsters. Legendary, rare, rare, and ordinary. There were forty-seven legendary monsters. The first legendary monster was called ‘Gilgamesh’, it didn’t have the word ‘person’. It was an ancient legendary monster. Its introduction was at the beginning of the introduction. It was labeled as a five-star legendary monster!
“Gilgamesh is a five-star legendary monster. It is reported that there are only three Gilgamesh in the world. One of them was captured and self-detonated before death. There are no parasitic soul worms left behind. The other two are still missing…”Dudian looked at the information, his eyelids twitched. This ‘Gilgamesh’legendary monster had never been captured. Didn’t this mean that no one had its parasitic soul worms?
Black mage saw Dudian turn to the page and smiled, he sighed: “This legendary monster is not only the No1 of the giant wall of Berga. I heard that it is one of the top five legendary monsters in the empire. It is very rare. No one has obtained its parasitic soul worm since ancient times. Even the big figures in the empire are the same. It’s a pity.”
Dudian didn’t think that he would know something about the empire. He couldn’t help but look at him. He thought that the giant wall of Berga was different from Sylvia. It was closely connected with the Empire and was assigned by the Empire to guard the magic pit, it was normal for the residents to know more about the empire than the residents of Sylvia.
His eyes fell on the blurred picture below. It was a picture taken by a camera but the focus wasn’t right. It was a blurry picture. It looked like a vast forest, a giant monster with a humanoid body was walking in the forest. Its arms were extremely long and almost fell to its knees. Sharp blades protruded out of its arms. The head of the monster was like a tree branch that was cutting off leaves, it had irregular sharp horns and its body was silvery white. It was very strange. The most eye-catching part was that there were four huge wings on its back. They looked like black blades.
Dudian carefully looked at it but found that the forest under its feet was only below its knees!
Most of the forests in the world had been crazily growing because of the nuclear radiation. The trees in the forest were twenty to thirty meters tall!
According to this ratio..
Wouldn’t Gilgamesh be more than one hundred and fifty meters tall? !
Dudian’s pupils contracted as he felt an inexplicable tremble. He wasn’t reading a story book but reality. A monster that was more than one hundred and fifty meters tall was living in the same world as him. It was blocked by a giant wall, he shivered as he thought about it! It wasn’t a problem to block the monsters with the height of the giant wall. But wasn’t it a leap in front of a monster like Gilgamesh!
It was hard for Dudian to imagine that such a huge creature could grow on earth. It wasn’t called inflation but rampage!
The sense of crisis was very strong but Dudian quickly calmed down. The ancient Chinese said that if the sky collapsed then there would be a tall monster to hold it up. If such a monster appeared in front of the giant wall, the unlucky ones would be the tall ones and the weakest civilians. The free civilians would be able to leave at any time.
“Resistance, seven stars…”
“Speed increase, seven stars…”
“Constitution increase, seven stars…”
Dudian saw the following introduction but it was labeled as the data from the experiment.
It was the first time that Dudian had seen a seven-star assessment. The highest he had seen before was five stars. He thought that five stars was the maximum. It seemed that Gilgamesh’s power.., it was beyond the concept of an ordinary legendary monster. The basic increase in all aspects was comparable to the increase in speed of a low-rank legendary monster.
The second legendary monster was called Leo. It was also an ancient legendary monster. From its name, it could be seen that it was a monster that controlled lightning. Its body contained extremely terrifying electricity, and it fed on lightning and Thunderbirds, some people said that it was the king of Thunderbirds, but others said that it was the nemesis of Thunderbirds, or even a jinx.
However, it was also because its life habits were simple that it was easy to be captured. It only needed to use lightning or Thunderbirds as bait to easily lure it. Although it was powerful, it could not withstand humans who were used to defeating the strong with the weak, this was the ability of humans to stand on Earth!
Leo was also a five-star legendary monster. Its basic amplification was five stars. Leo’s magic marks ability had the ability to control electric current. Moreover, it was immune to all electric shocks.
Dudian saw that it was said to be immune to all lightning. He knew that it was not rigorous enough. Even if the cells of the body modified by Leo’s magic marks could contain lightning, there was a limit. Even the monster itself.., dudian didn’t dare to say that it could withstand all lightning. After all, lightning and fire were the same. There was no upper limit to the power!
Dudian continued to scroll down. There were four-star legendary monsters behind him. From Gilgamesh who was the No1 to the third ranked legendary monster. The difference between their abilities and rarity was dozens of times.
Black mage noticed Dudian’s expression and guessed his thoughts, he explained: “Gilgamesh is a famous legendary monster in the entire empire. If it hadn’t appeared in our area then it wouldn’t have been recorded in the Monster Atlas of the giant wall of Berga. Leo is a local legendary monster. More than 200 years ago, the third lord of the giant wall of Berga killed a young Leo. He inherited Leo’s magic marks and was transferred away. I heard that he became a high official in the empire. This not only allowed his descendants to enjoy life but also brought advanced technology to the giant wall of Berga.”
“I know that each atlas only records the legendary monsters that have appeared in the territory of the giant wall.”Dudian indifferently replied. He estimated that only in the empire would he be able to see the general list of legendary monsters, there was only one five-star legendary monster in the giant wall of Sylvia. Moreover, it had appeared before but no one in Sylvia had ever obtained the magic marks of the ‘Dreamer’.
Dudian continued to read the rare chapter after he finished reading the legendary chapter.
There were 271 kinds of rare monsters which could be considered as a rich variety.
“Henrik?”Dudian was startled as he saw a familiar name. He didn’t expect that there would be ‘Henrik’in Berga. It was one of the top ten rare monsters in Sylvia but here.., it was ranked forty-two among the rare monsters.
The past slowly flooded into his mind. Dudian was silent for a moment before he slowly came back to his senses. He picked up his mood and continued to read.
Two hours later, Dudian finished flipping through the thick atlas of the monsters.
“Help me see where I can get the parasitic soul worms of these seven monsters.”Dudian handed the eight names that he wrote down to black mage.
Black mage reacted to why Dudian wrote down these names. He glanced at the names of the legendary monsters. He was relieved as he saw that there were no names of the legendary monsters. However he felt a headache when he thought of the eight rare monsters, “These rare soul worms can be bought in the black shops and underground black markets. They can also be bought at a high price in the Magic Institute. But the price of eight rare soul worms is not less than one legendary soul worm. Although legendary soul worms are rare but they are usually priceless.”
“Even if I have the money to buy them, I won’t be able to find eight kinds of rare soul worms to sell. There is no such coincidence unless we go to the Magic Institute to buy them. They are available all year round but the price of any one of them is equal to half of the price of a legendary soul worm.”
“Then go to the Magic Institute to buy one first.”Dudian said.
Black mage opened his mouth and wanted to slap himself!
“This… which one do you want to buy first?”Black Mage’s heart was bleeding.
Dudian looked at the rare monster named ‘Turtle Shell’. It was a monster that was good at defense and hiding. Both of its abilities were excellent. Usually when a turtle shell encountered a monster that was stronger than itself.., it would turn its entire body into a rock. It could strengthen its defense and hide its aura. At the same time it could turn into a rock to ambush other monsters.
Black mage’s eyelids twitched: “I know. I’ll go and ask if there is one.”
“I’ll wait for you outside.”Dudian patted his shoulder.
Black mage bitterly smiled in his heart. It was obvious that he was afraid that Dudian would say that he didn’t have one.
Black mage disguised himself and entered the Magic Institute. It didn’t take long for him to come out, he looked at dudian: “We are lucky. I have paid the deposit. I’m transferring from the headquarters. We will arrive tomorrow.”
Dudian nodded. He had heard the exchange: “Let’s go back.”
The next day.
The scheduled turtle shell soul worm was taken back from the Magic Institute.
Dudian took black mage to the remote manor where the Thunder filter was kept. He took a drop of blood from the turtle shell soul worm and put it into the Thunder filter. He was relieved when he saw that the final scene in the blood was ice-like, although he hadn’t used the Thunder filter to see the cloning of the soul worm in the ‘temple’of the giant wall. But he expected that the soul worm would combine with the Aragami factor and the final scene would be different.
The deified soul worm was a pit. Once it was used, there was no hope for it to become an abyss.
“It seems that the magic institute has cultivated a lot of soul worms. Any one of them should be available. It shouldn’t be a simple coincidence.”Dudian thought, he was curious if the Magic Institute had a method to breed soul worms. But it was useless for him to know. Even if he had a method, he would need materials and resources.
This was a big deal. He had no place to live so he couldn’t operate it.
For him, the most important thing was power. Power was the status and everything. After all, since ancient times, only power was the path to the supreme. In the old era, education was the hardest to get a job. For the people in the society, money was the hardest skill. Even if you were a waste, you could still stand high and be supported by others.
For those countries, the strongest thing was nuclear weapons. Only with nuclear weapons would they have the capital to negotiate. Otherwise, no matter how good your country’s culture and economy was, it was just a fat pig that could be slaughtered at any time.
“What can’t kill you will make you strong… if I don’t die, this body’s self-created heart will be able to withstand my extravagance. The Seven Kings of the Empire, wait for me…”Dudian’s eyes flashed, the most efficient way to find Aisha was to become one of the Seven Kings and gather all the power of the giant wall of the Empire to search the entire territory.
Aisha would always be in this territory anyway.
Dudian took a deep breath and cut open the body of the tortoise beetle. It looked like a cockroach but its body was gray, at this moment, cold, pale black blood dripped from its body and fell on the wound on his palm.
“Absorb it to prove that my guess is right…”Dudian closed his eyes and prayed in his heart.
A moment later, he felt a strange tickle on his palm as if something was going to come out from it. He opened his eyes and saw that the wound on his palm had healed, but the wound was like a mosquito bite, it made him want to scratch.

chapters.title: Chapter 1034
chapters.content:
Chapter 1034 – Chapter 124: Defective Product
Dudian quickly cut the wound. He took out the blood from the wound and threw it into the Thunder filter. Soon he found that the final scene in the blood had changed. There was a small blue ball surrounded by a four-colored ball, it was surrounded by a faint ring of stars.
Was this the power of magic marks?
Dudian’s heart was filled with joy and expectation. He moved his fingers and used the power of magic marks as usual. Blood poured into his body and tightened the meridians in his fingers. In an instant, his fingers turned white and turned into a stone palm!
It really worked!
Dudian was so excited that he almost jumped up. It had been a long time since he was so excited that he couldn’t control himself!
The experiment proved that his guess was correct. His body… could contain many kinds of magic marks genes!
After the excitement, Dudian quickly thought of the original splitter’s magic marks. He immediately activated the splitter’s sharp blade. There was no obstruction and a sharp thorn extended from his back, he tried to turn the petrified palm into a sharp blade. A strange scene appeared. His arm turned into a stone-colored sharp blade. It looked like a stone sickle!
The power of the magic marks overlapped!
Dudian’s eyes widened as he looked at the petrified arm. He felt that his whole body was about to be petrified. This was too incredible. The first thing that came to his mind was the terrifying possibility of this result!
It took a long time for Dudian to slowly come back to his senses. He was still unable to adapt to the reality. He suddenly felt like he was dreaming. It was as if he had suddenly obtained the power of God from an ordinary person!
Although his physique wasn’t weak and was very strong, but he was only at the first-class level. He was still far away from the top existence like the Seven Kings. Moreover, it was very difficult to make up for the gap. After all, the ice worm king was rare, might be even rarer than a five-star legendary monster like “Gilgamesh”.
However.
At this moment, the petrified arm of the Sharp Blade gave him great hope, as well as endless possibilities!
The overlapping of magic mark abilities, as well as the multiple absorption of magic mark abilities! This meant that Bolo’s guess had been confirmed. The god that he had thought of was created by Crimson Moon!
The ability to gather a large number of magic marks and stack them up to the top. There were no shortcomings and no flaws. This was almost the ideal model of a “Perfect creature”!
Perhaps the end of evolution was like this.
“Is this the bitter end? The God creation experiment actually succeeded…”Dudian touched the petrified blade, he felt that it was a bit unreal. He was glad that Crimson Moon had abandoned him. If she knew that his experiment didn’t go wrong, he would have become her number one fighter.
However..
Dudian suddenly thought that crimson moon had abandoned him because of the failure of the experiment. He thought of the heart in his chest. He suddenly felt that he was one step away from the “Perfect creature”. At least his heart wasn’t perfect. It was the only flaw.
Perhaps he could only be considered as a defective product of God!
“A defective product of God… Should I call it ‘devil’…”Dudian muttered to himself. The excitement in his heart gradually disappeared. If Crimson Moon’s theory was correct then with his current body.., even if it was a defective product, it had the potential to surpass the seven kings. Moreover, he didn’t need the polar ice insect king to evolve to the point of surpassing the Seven Kings. After all, relying on the polar ice insect king would eventually be affected by the insect king, that wasn’t the purpose of Bolo’s experiment.
“Crimson Moon’s experiment is still ongoing. I don’t know if there will be a real god. Maybe a new era will come. An era that belongs to God. Human beings will be ruled by God…”Dudian looked at the lightning flashing in front of him, he was a bit absent-minded.
It wasn’t impossible for him to connect the dots. Although it was far away from the problem he was facing. But Confucius said that people who don’t think far ahead must have immediate worries. The difference between ordinary people and rich people in this world was that most of the ordinary people were thinking about the life in front of them. However, businessmen were aware of the changes of the times. They had to prepare in advance to meet the changes.
Dudian had to consider in advance what would happen if the crimson moon mass produced “Gods”. He would be able to survive in this change.
His thoughts seemed to drift thousands of miles away. He stood in a daze for the whole afternoon. In the evening, the black mage knocked on the door to deliver dinner. Dudian came back to his senses and suddenly noticed the soul worm in his hand, the soul worm was on the verge of death. He immediately asked the black mage to put down the dinner and drive it out. He then absorbed the soul worm into his body. After a short period of strange itchiness, his body gradually returned to calmness.
Dudian checked and found that he could enter the Turtle Shell’s magic mark state. His body was petrified and curled up like a rock. There was no smell.
After dinner, he rested for a night. The next day, Dudian brought the black mage back to Bourne Manor.
After returning to the basement of the manor, Dudian heard the report from the guards. He learned that the plump woman who had been tortured by the black mage had died on the operating table. After they left.., although the guards provided food and drinks for the prisoners, the tissues of the plump woman’s body had mutated. There were pus bags all over her body. The strange insects hatched from the pus bags and bit her to death.
The guards were scared to death by the hellish scene. They used their cameras to take a few photos.
Dudian frowned as he looked at the photos. Although he didn’t look in the mirror but he felt that his face had become tense.
The black mage covered his mouth and vomited as he saw the picture. His face was ugly.
Dudian told the black mage to get rid of all the prisoners after he vomited. It was impossible for them to be sent back. The prisoners would be exposed and they would be put to a comfortable euthanasia.
Although it was very cruel but Dudian didn’t need to face the inequality of life. “Human”was just a word to him. The number of deaths and injuries was just a number, only when he saw the tragic state of death would he be triggered by the physiological reaction. But when he didn’t face the bloody situation, he wouldn’t feel anything even if the things he did were very cruel.
Maybe everyone was the same.
After sending away the group of people, Dudian told the black mage that he was going to slowly sell the business of the Bourne family to raise money as soon as possible.
Black Mage didn’t have a choice. He felt that he was not only Dudian’s prisoner but also his subordinate. Several months later, the Bourne family’s business was sold one after another. The precious jewels, agate and oil paintings of famous families were also auctioned at high prices.

chapters.title: Chapter 1035
chapters.content:
Chapter 1035 – Chapter 125: Half A Year
Another ‘slave’Pidel accompanied black mage to help Dudian sell off the Bourne family’s business. Dudian was reading all kinds of books in the libraries of the main city of Phoenix, he quickly learned about the situation of the giant wall of Berga. In addition he learned many things about the empire and the secrets of the magic pit from these books.
As he guessed, the magic pit was the place where the nuclear weapons of the old era fell!
No wonder the nuclear radiation in the magic pit was so strong. It was dozens of times stronger than the outside world. Moreover the exploration team sent by the giant wall of Berga had found many “Strange”things in the magic pit. From the black and white photos they had taken.., it was clear that there were all kinds of broken pieces of spacecraft. Some of them were broken cannon tubes, some of them were the rudder of the spacecraft. In addition there were broken spacecraft that had been found.
“The nuclear weapons didn’t destroy these strange insects. Instead, the earth was completely destroyed…”Dudian sighed in his heart. He felt that the world was created by nuclear weapons, in the end, the revenge was on human’s head.
However, it was not difficult to see from the information that the magic pit was the main location where the magic insects appeared. Perhaps the reason why the nuclear weapons had chosen to crash here was to attack the base camp of the magic insects.
Unfortunately, he wasn’t the only one who could see this point. It was estimated that all the magic pits in the empire had been plundered countless times by the seven kings. They had even deliberately let the giant wall of Berga guard them, the purpose wasn’t as simple as it seemed to be to detect the changes of the magic radiation in the magic pit.
Dudian wasn’t interested in going to the sixth magic pit. Instead, he thought of the ship in the nest of the Polar Ice Dragon. There were many polar ice worms in the ship. In addition, there was the thing that was suspected to be the polar ice worm king.
Although his body didn’t need these things to evolve but he could give them to Neuss to improve his strength.
However, he didn’t plan to go there for the time being. The thing that was suspected to be the king of polar ice insects had left a big shadow on his mind. Moreover Neuss and Barton hadn’t found a foothold in the giant wall of Berga, in addition he had many experimental ideas that he hadn’t used the Thunder filter to verify.
Regarding the theft of the Thunder filter, it did not cause much of a stir in the Nile territory. The main reason was that this thing was originally a magic tool and could not be seen in the light. Moreover, the murderer who assassinated Bronk did not leave any clues behind, even the professional judicial deacons of the court could not trace the clues to a useful result, so they could only continue to track it in the dark.
However, the theft of the Thunder filter caused quite a stir among the wizards. Rumors were flying all over the place, and there were all kinds of speculations. Many wizards even threatened to find the murderer and avenge Bronk.
And more wizards secretly paid attention to the relevant news, wanting to get the Thunder filter.
In the blink of an eye, half a year passed.
Time passed very quickly. Noyce, Barton, Macon, and the others had completely taken root in the giant wall of Berga. They had their own identities, some were lawyers, some were musicians, and some were admitted into the Knight Hall, some joined the magistrate and became apprentice knights. Everyone was like a big net. Neuss had deliberately arranged for them to join the circle of the giant wall.
In the past six months, Dudian’s harvest was the greatest. He had successfully absorbed five soul worms by relying on his own genetic characteristics. In addition to his own splitter and sun beast soul worm abilities, it was equivalent to having seven soul worms.
Among the five new soul worms, except for the original turtle shell which was a rare monster, the other four were all legendary!
One of the four legendary worms was purchased from the industry sold by the Bourne family. The other three didn’t come from soul worms but from humans!
This was one of Dudian’s biggest gains. He had killed several pioneers of the Bourne family and the black mage who were cooperating with the black mage to divide Barret and the Bourne industry, he was going to use their corpses for research but he suddenly had a whim. He thought about whether the magic marks in their bodies could be stored in his own body. In the end he was able to do an experiment!
Dudian’s original thinking was broken. After many attempts he found that he could not only absorb the ability fragments from the soul worm’s body but he could also devour other creatures to absorb their characteristics, for example, if he directly swallowed a bloodthirsty leech, his body would have the bloodthirsty Leech’s ability to absorb blood. He could rely on the bloodthirsty leech to make up for his own consumption.
But there was a flaw in this kind of direct absorption. The appearance of the gene would mutate. After absorbing the gene of a wolf, thick hair grew on the surface of the sebum. He suspected that if his body directly absorbed the gene.., he would also become a wolf. The more genes he absorbed, the more parts of his body would be mutated. In the end, his body would turn into a shape that he didn’t dare to imagine.
In contrast, the soul worm seemed to be a filter.
Dudian had figured out that the original soul worm that he saw in the cave of the Earth Dragon of the Amelia Tribe was a primitive soul worm that didn’t live in any living creature. The soul worm was produced from the polar ice worm, but not all soul worms could grow into polar ice worms. It seemed that the environment didn’t allow it or something was missing. Although they were born in the mother’s body but they couldn’t become polar ice worms.
But the soul worms had a characteristic that polar ice worms didn’t have. They could live in the body of another living creature and rely on other living creatures to survive.
At the same time, the soul worm would absorb the genes of that living creature and copy its genes into its own body. When it was transferred to the body of another living creature, it would copy the genetic ability of its body into a new parasitic body, slowly transforming the body of the new parasite was like moving to a new place. The original residence was still very nostalgic. So the new home was renovated into the original residence.
Of course, for these Soul Worms, perhaps they were not nostalgic but adaptive.
If he directly absorbed the gene chain copied from the soul worm’s body, his body would be able to control the scope of the reason. There wouldn’t be too much change on the surface. It would be like throwing away some rough things, only the core genes were extracted.
However, through the observation of the Thunder filter, Dudian found that the negative effect of absorbing directly from other magic marks was smaller than the absorption from the soul worm. It was like the magic marks ability was the second filter!
After absorbing the ability of five different magic marks in succession, Dudian found that the final landscape of his cells. The surface of the four-colored sphere was surrounded by illusionary rings. The blue sphere was surrounded by two rings.
He didn’t recklessly continue to stack them. Although he could absorb them infinitely from the previous experiments but he didn’t know what would happen if he added too many genes that didn’t belong to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1036
chapters.content:
Chapter 1036 – Chapter 126: Chaos In The South
There was a manor in a small town on the outskirts of Phoenix territory. The spacious hall was full of people with different temperaments. However most of them weren’t easy to deal with. Dudian sat on the sofa in the middle of the hall. He looked around and saw that Neuss, Sergei and others had arrived, he said: “It’s not a big deal to call everyone here tonight. I’m going to leave to find something. I’ll be back in a few months. You Don’t have to worry. We will continue to lurk according to the original plan.”
Everyone looked at each other. They knew that Dudian wouldn’t change his decision for them.
Neuss’s heart sank after he heard Dudian’s words. Although he had expected that there would be such a day, but he didn’t expect that day to come so soon. He clenched his teeth and said to dudian: “Master, I want to go with you!”
“Me Too!”Mason quickly said.
“I’m going too.”Aurora also quickly raised her hand.
“Teacher, there is still me.”Edward hurriedly called out.
“There is still us!”
“I want to go too!”
The others didn’t want to be left behind and quickly expressed their stance.
Dudian slightly raised his hand and suppressed the noise. He looked at Neuss’eyes which were full of sorrow, “Don’t make it like a life and death separation. It’s not like I won’t come back. You will only hinder me if you follow me.”. Neuss, I need you to take care of this place while I’m away. If anything goes wrong, you will be punished. Don’t say that I didn’t remind you.”
Neuss was startled as he saw Dudian’s gentle eyes. He felt that he had misunderstood. He couldn’t help but ask: “Master, will you really come back?”
“Of course.”Dudian smiled, “My body is recovering well. There shouldn’t be any big problems. You Don’t need to worry. You should take good care of yourself while I’m away. It’s best to make this place your nest or even your future home!”! “Maybe in the future we will have the opportunity to move to the empire which is in charge of the giant wall. But the environment there is more complicated and dangerous than here. I hope you can adapt to it in advance and live well.”
“Young master, do you really intend to go to the Kingdom of God?”Barton was surprised.
“That depends on the future situation and your performance.”Dudian clapped his hands. He didn’t want to talk about his long-term plan. “Let them rest first. I have something to tell you.”
Neuss, Barton, Mason and others understood and asked their confidants to leave.
“If possible, I want to know about the situation of the eight lords of Borja. Especially the wall master and the mysterious wizard leader, the Wizard King.”Dudian said to Neuss: “But don’t be too hasty. Don’t let them uproot you. I will deal with any news when I come back.”
“I understand, young master.”Neuss nodded.
“I’ll leave Peder and the Dark Wizard to you. Although they are stronger than you but their current identity is not good. You should try to use them to deal with them.”Dudian said to Neuss.
“Yes, Young Master.”Neuss said in a serious tone.
Sergei was stunned: “Young Master, those two are the masters. We are still in the inner wilderness. What if they don’t listen to us? Isn’t it too dangerous?”
Dudian didn’t speak, neuss turned to him: “Use your brain. We have their weaknesses. We have the support of the young master. They don’t dare to fall out with us. Don’t forget how the young master dealt with the enemies who were stronger than the young master.”
Sergei scratched his head: “But the young master is the young master. We are the young master. Can we deal with them?”
Neuss rolled his eyes: “Do you think that I will stay by the young master’s side for Nothing?”
Dudian smiled as he looked at his pocket watch. He saw that the curfew was coming so he asked Neuss to dismiss his confidants and let them return to the city ahead of time.
The next day when Dudian was ready to leave Polga, a huge airship suddenly arrived outside the giant wall at dawn. The bright silver hull reflected the rainbow-like arc light in the Sun. The ship.., the sails and the hull of the ship were exactly the same as the ship. The only difference was that there was a rocket-like red and blue flame under the ship.
There were locusts that were like raindrops behind the airship. It was obvious that there were many small airships carrying less than five people, however the number of airships was huge. They covered the entire giant wall and surrounded the aircraft carrier sized airship. It was a spectacular sight.
Dudian had just backed up the pure water that he needed in the wilderness. He opened the window and saw the shocking scene. He felt like he was watching a sci-fi movie. Moreover, it was about Star Wars!
“What’s the situation?”Dudian was confused.
The residents who had woken up early in the giant wall also saw the spectacular scene. They were looking up at the window.
At this time, Dudian saw the strange patterns engraved on the hull of the giant spaceship. It was a blood red twisted vine. It was the symbol of the badge.
He was relieved to see this symbol. He had seen it before. It symbolized the blood thorn king, one of the Seven Kings of the Empire. He had heard about it from Phesonia. Later on, the Blood Thorn King went to attack Boro, he had seen his appearance as well as his armor. The symbol on it was the same as this.
“I thought it was an alien invasion…”Dudian slightly curled his lips. His eyes swept over the giant spaceship and the other airships. Golden light flashed in his eyes, he quickly saw the internal structure of the spaceship and the airship. He found something strange. The internal energy of the spaceship was not from aviation fuel but from a huge crystal.
The crystal was like a battery. It was connected to the densely packed circuits. The special energy was constantly transferred from the crystal to the propeller of the spaceship. It turned into flames and propelled the spaceship.
In addition, the spacecraft was floating not only because of the flame but also because there were many rows of air vents under the hull. It was like an air conditioning exhaust. Strong wind whistled out from the gaps of the exhaust wind and supported the spacecraft, moreover, the exhaust wind was active. It could adjust the angle and control the direction.
“Is this the technology of the Empire?”Dudian slightly narrowed his eyes. The energy output of the crystal was as transparent as a crystal. However, the crystal would never be converted into such strong energy. This technology alone was ahead of the old era.
The speed of the spaceship slowed down as it slowly approached the center of the giant wall of Berga. The surrounding airships that were like locusts also gradually closed up like a huge net.
Dudian frowned as he saw the trajectory of the spaceship. It seemed that the spaceship was going to stop at the giant wall of Berga. was there something terrible in the No. 6 magic pit that was guarded by the giant wall of Berga?
Dudian was deep in thought. He wasn’t just thinking about the purpose of the spaceship but also the information that the spaceship brought — the technology of the Empire.
He didn’t know how advanced the technology of the Empire was. But he knew that there were electric lights in the giant wall of Berga more than one hundred and fifty years ago! It should be known that the time that humans used electric lights in the old era was less than one hundred and fifty years. In other words, according to the trajectory of the old era, the civilization of the empire was not inferior to the old era.
Moreover..
If the electric lamps of the giant wall of Berga were passed down from the empire, then who knew how many years it took for the Empire to pass down to the giant wall of Berga?
Just like Sylvia, she had not learned how to use electricity for more than 300 years before him.
If the giant wall of Berga did not have the task of guarding the sixth magic pit, perhaps the fate of the giant wall was not far from Sylvia’s.
He suddenly thought that the empire had deliberately suppressed the technology within the Great Wall, just like how the nobles in the inner wall of Sylvia monopolized the technology. could the purpose of doing so be just stupid greed and selfishness? One must know that the life of the empire was not easy. They had to constantly resist the invasion of foreign races at the borders, maintain the harmony of the abyssal region within the god of war wall, and also eliminate the terrifying existences that might be born from the magic pit, all of these were enough to bring a sense of crisis to the empire. The empire urgently needed strength.
However, suppressing the technology within the giant wall would cut off their own arms.
Dudian couldn’t figure it out. He had read many secret information when he ruled Sylvia but there was no record of it. He felt that there must be a reason that he hadn’t thought of yet, what was the reason why the empire had to suppress the technology within the giant wall when they wanted strength!
He thought hard for a moment but still could not figure it out. However, he realized that his thoughts had gone astray. He could not care less about the reason why the empire had suppressed the technology within the giant wall. However, the Empire’s technology was so advanced that he had barged into the empire alone, wanting to seize the throne was undoubtedly a Fool’s dream!
If the Empire’s technology was similar to the giant wall, he could still rely on the knowledge from the old era in the super chip to create advanced electrical weapons, laser weapons, and the like to rule the empire. However, now.., the technology of the Empire had reached the point where he couldn’t even understand it. His biggest trump card — the knowledge of the old era was completely useless in the empire!
This meant that he had to become a king in the empire. He had to learn the technology of the empire as soon as possible and then surpass it in the field of science and technology. Otherwise, his strength would be several times stronger than ordinary kings, so strong that they didn’t have time to use science and technology to defend!
However, Dudian deeply understood how terrifying the power of Science and technology was. Even a king wouldn’t dare to step out of the Earth. But Science and technology could do it. Even if he surpassed a king, he would still be reduced to ashes in front of nuclear weapons!
This was the power of science and technology. It was something that biology couldn’t do.
He couldn’t help but want to smash everything in front of him with one punch. He thought that by relying on his current body and growing to surpass the power of a king, it would be easy for him to seize the throne of a king in the empire, using the power of a king to find Aisha, everything was wonderful! However, this wonderful idea was suddenly shattered. Even if he surpassed the power of a king, what could he do?
The other seven kings wouldn’t be stupid enough to fight him one-on-one. They wouldn’t be stupid enough to know that he was strong enough to become a king, so they made him the eighth king to take over their own resources and territory.
The real result would be that once the seven kings knew of his existence they would use all kinds of methods to attack and destroy him!
He wasn’t afraid to rely on his physical strength to fight. However the empire was the nest of the Seven Kings. It had been established for many years. Moreover it had the technology that he didn’t understand. Even if he wanted to have a fair fight it would be wishful thinking!
Originally he felt that he would be able to get over it in one step. But now it was as difficult as climbing to the sky. Dudian wanted to grab the impulse to burst the air but he held it back in the end. He gradually calmed down.
The goal wouldn’t change, so he had to find a way to complete the goal, no matter how difficult it was!
Dudian took a few deep breaths and calmed his mood. He was ready to see what the spaceship was doing in the giant wall of Berga.
At five o’clock in the afternoon, Dudian watched the sky full of airships chasing after the airship. They left the sky above the imperial city and flew away from the golden clouds in the sky until they completely disappeared.
Dudian immediately looked for Peder and black mage to find out the purpose of the airship.
Both of them were forced by Dudian to spend a lot of money. They carefully searched for information from various channels and finally brought the news back to Dudian, “I heard that there is a war in the south of the empire. This airship is the 7th Army of the Seven Kings of the Empire. It is going to the southern border to reinforce. It seems that the elder brother of the giant wall is the commander of the 7th Army…”
The information that the two brought back was almost the same.
Dudian knew that the information was reliable when he heard about the king of the blood thorns. However he was surprised by the information that Peder brought back. He didn’t expect that the elder brother of the giant wall would be working for the king of the blood thorns, it seemed that the giant wall was also under the jurisdiction of the King of the blood thorns?
Dudian didn’t care if the news was true or false but he was concerned about the war in the south. He remembered that the empire was surrounded by enemies. There were fire dragons in the east and trolls in the south, the snow apes in the north were the best. They faced the sea and rarely fought. However when the tide rose there would be a big mess. Even the god of war wall could be destroyed.
Compared to the other three sides which had been in chaos for years, the west side didn’t move. Once there was a problem, it would be a big problem!
“The giant devil race launched another attack in the southern war…”Dudian’s eyes lit up. He was a bit curious. He had seen the fire dragon race in the east, he knew that the Fire Dragon Race had an eastern empire which wasn’t weaker than the god Luo Empire. He didn’t know if the giant devil race in the south was the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 1037
chapters.content:
Chapter 1037 – Chapter 127: The Second Coming
Although he was curious to see it but Dudian didn’t plan to follow in the footsteps of the Blood Thorn Army. His original plan was still the same but the southern border was included in his future itinerary.
That night Dudian left the giant wall of Berga.
The full moon was in the sky. The sound of frogs and strange hissing became the eternal music of the world outside the giant wall.
Dudian carried his luggage and headed east.
