By the second half of the night, Dudian had completely left the area of the giant wall of Berga. He didn’t stop as he continued to fly at a low altitude.
Occasionally he would leap out of the ground to bite him but he easily dodged. His body would shoot out sharp blades and cut them off. His body didn’t stop as he flew away like a puff of smoke.
Dudian casually killed seven or eight master level monsters and an abyss. The next day at dawn he came to a bare hill. He sat down to rest and took out pure water to drink a few mouthfuls, he ate a few pieces of smoked meat.
The warm feeling touched his face. Dudian looked at the vast plain and small forest in front of the hill. He could still see traces of the old era’s road from the weeds on the plain, he suddenly felt a little lonely. In the past, when he was adventuring in the abyss, he had Aisha by his side. Although he was the one who talked along the way, he always had a companion by his side.
But this time, he was the only one left.
The entire old era had been destroyed, and he was also the only one left.
To live until the end, how could he be happy?
In a daze, missing.
Dudian sat on the hill in a daze.
After a long time, he recovered from his daze. Then he picked up his mood and continued on the road.
Half a month later.
Dudian came to a forest with strong radiation concentration. He stood on the top of a tree in the forest and looked at the surrounding environment. He muttered to himself, “The ice dragon is dead. The temperature is still so low. The snow in the forest hasn’t melted. Is there a new master?”
The purpose of his trip was to find the magic bug spaceship in the Ice Dragon’s nest.
Dudian’s figure flashed as he jumped from the forest. He met many monsters with ice and snow bodies along the way. Their body structure was completely different from ordinary monsters, most of their bodies were Snow White. Their scales were crystal clear. Their hair was pure white. The horns on their heads were like ice. Most of their blood was white, there was no heat emitted from their bodies.
Dudian felt that it would be interesting if he threw these monsters onto the experimental platform to study.
In this world, the changes of living things had exceeded the progress of research. When people analyzed the body structure of a monster, new monsters and mutated creatures would appear. Since ancient times they had never been thoroughly studied, there was a variety of things that people couldn’t imagine and expected. Different environment and factors would create different lives.
Dudian casually cut off two monsters that had been seen through but were still waiting for the opportunity to ambush them. He came to the end of the forest without any obstruction. The lake where the Arctic ice dragon lived was still as smooth as a mirror, it was quiet.
“The spaceship is still…”Dudian’s eyes pierced through the surface of the lake. He could see the depths of the lake. His vision wasn’t able to reach the depths of the lake but at the moment it was very easy to reach the depths, his vision and perception were not limited to perspective. He had the magic marks ability which was a legendary magic mark which was extracted from the body of a ruler. It could increase the range of vision by more than ten times. It was like bringing his own telescope, it was an icing on the cake for him as his vision was very far away. However, the power of the magic marks was just a small ability that came with the legendary magic marks. It was like the perspective ability of the splitter.
The material of the spaceship was still unable to penetrate through. However, Dudian was relieved to see that the spaceship was still there. It meant that Phisnia had not been here before.
At this time, he saw a snow-white shadow on the other reef at the bottom of the lake. “A sea python?”
Dudian looked through its scales and saw the structure of its body. He quickly took back his sight and threw a huge rock into the lake.
The mirror-like surface of the lake was broken by the waves. The sleeping eyes of the snow-white Sea Python at the bottom of the lake suddenly opened. There was no emotion in its dark golden amber eyes. It looked up at the place where the huge rock fell, its coiled body slowly pulled and swam upstream.
Soon, Dudian saw a shadow more than ten meters long appear on the surface of the lake. He flew over and approached the surface of the lake.
The Snow White Sea Python was swimming under Dudian’s feet. Its figure coiled and seemed to find that Dudian was motionless on the surface of the lake. It gradually became restless and suddenly jumped out of the surface of the lake. Splash. Water splashed in all directions, a big mouth full of sharp teeth came towards Dudian. Its mouth was enough to Swallow Dudian whole!
A blade tail extended out from Dudian’s back. The black blade tail suddenly shook. Puff! Puff! The ferocious mouth suddenly broke into pieces. White blood splashed out like milk but it was very cold when it fell on his body, it was like frozen water.
The body of the Snow White Sea Python fell into the lake and slowly sank.
Dudian immediately changed the place. He took a deep breath and dived into the lake. He quickly swam towards the deep part of the lake and soon arrived in front of the spaceship.
He went through the previous entrance and came to a place inside the spaceship that looked like a water tank. There was a cloister inside the spaceship. The cloister was covered with bronze steel pipes, it was as if the spaceship was the body of a giant creature. The complicated dark green steel pipes were its blood vessels and veins.
There was no water in the spaceship. The mysterious reason made Dudian have no time to think. The technology of the magic bug spaceship was far ahead of Earth’s. It was beyond his understanding that it could travel across distant galaxies to Earth.
He wrung the water out of his body and used the heat brought by the magic marks of the sun beast to dry his clothes. The water evaporated and he released the perception of the magic marks, he could sense the movement of the metal under his feet.
The sound of wind came from the corridor. There was a slight rubbing sound mixed with the sound of the wind.
Dudian’s mind floated to the picture of the worm that was covered in the sticky liquid. His eyes were solemn as he slowly walked along the corridor. He didn’t know if.., his current strength could suppress all the polar ice worms and the giant worm that was fed by the polar ice worm.
Dudian saw that there were traces of blood on the ground as he walked along the corridor. It seemed that the place had been replenished with “Fresh blood”.
After passing through two corridors, a metal door was closed and the corridor was cut off.
Dudian was startled. It seemed that the door hadn’t been closed the last time!
“This place is closed. Could it be that they are protecting themselves?”Dudian raised his hand to touch the door. He tried to sense the situation behind the door but he felt nothing but air, the range of his ultra-long distance touch was only about four or five meters. It was very limited but it was a very strong ability in close combat. It was an ability that he had learned from a pioneer’s magic marks.
Dudian gently cut the metal door with the cutting edge but he couldn’t leave any trace. Although it was related to the strength but this was the first time he had encountered something that the cutting edge couldn’t hurt, it was beyond his imagination.
Dudian felt that his surprise was a bit funny. The magic bug had used this ship to cross the galaxy. The sturdiness of the ship was naturally beyond the ordinary metal material. It would be abnormal if he easily cut it open.
Since there was no other way, he had to find another way.
Dudian was ready to go back the way he came. Suddenly he saw a raised ball by the door. It was flashing red like a camera. He went over to take a look. He was suspicious. This thing could emit light. Didn’t it mean that the spaceship had energy?
There was a sudden click sound as he was thinking.
Dudian’s expression changed. He couldn’t control his body. His body suddenly shot out numerous sharp blades. The sharp blades were burning with flames. He was like a hedgehog. The next moment, the fear in his eyes was replaced by astonishment, he saw the closed door slowly open.
“There is someone here… is there something controlling it?”Dudian looked at the slowly opened door. His pupils slightly contracted. He felt a chill crawl up his back.
The door opened. There was nothing in the passage behind. It was like the internal organs of insects. There were traces of blood and hair on the walls. Dudian’s perception quickly extended to the end of the corner. There was the sound of wind. The sound of mucus sliding became louder. There was also a very low frequency COO COO. The sound was very strange. It was like an unknown language.
Dudian hesitated for a moment. In the end he braced himself and went in. He thought that there was no point in hiding if he had been found. Since he had come, he might as well see what the hell was inside.
Soon, he walked along the corridor and came to the spacious space that he had seen before. The rich smell of rotting corpses came from far away and filled the nearby passages, there was a huge black tree rooted in the middle of the spacious open space like a church. There seemed to be a bird’s nest in the middle of the huge tree. There was a fat worm that was almost three meters tall, but it had extremely thin and sharp antennae.
The branches of the giant black tree stretched out in all directions. It looked like a giant who was embracing the world. There were four or five pupae hanging under the two thick branches. They were of different sizes. The heads of these pupae were exposed, but their bodies were tightly wrapped in white silk.
Some of the heads were like the heads of lizards and some like the heads of leopards.
The last time Dudian saw Barker was long gone.
Dudian found that the monsters in the chrysalis were not dead. Their heads were still breathing. Maybe that was the reason why they only showed their heads.
Hiss!
A familiar sound was heard.
Dudian turned his head and saw that there were many snow white pythons like polar ice worms coming out of the hole in the roots of the giant black tree. They raised their heads but their heads were not triangular like snakes. Instead, their heads were oval, there were no eyes or mouths on their heads but because of this, it brought more intense fear.
One, two, three… ice worms kept coming out from the holes and looked at the intruders.
Some of the ice worms had their heads split open. They had mouths which were full of sharp teeth.
“It seems no one has come.”Dudian was relieved as he saw the same situation as last time. But he thought of the door which had opened for no reason. He felt that there seemed to be a pair of invisible eyes in the dark, they were staring at him.
He didn’t dare to relax. He had to deal with the polar ice insects first.
Soon, the polar ice insects climbed onto the hanging pupa and drilled into the eyes or nostrils of the monsters. The monsters woke up one by one. They opened their eyes with murderous intent, the pupa broke open and the monsters slid out. There was a lot of water that fell along with them. To be precise, it was unknown mucus.
The monster shook its hair and rushed towards Dudian.
“There are only five of them. It seems that you are not enough.”Dudian raised his hand and covered his arm. A seven to eight meter long lizard monster jumped towards him. It opened its mouth and took the initiative to face it.
Whoosh!
The body of the Lizard Monster crossed each other in an instant. The arm cut through the corner of the mouth of the Lizard Monster. Blood splashed all the way to its abdomen. It was almost cut into two pieces.
At this time, the other monsters also rushed over.
Dudian moved his body to avoid the attack. In less than a few minutes, the five monsters were crippled by Dudian. Either their heads were cut off or their bodies were cut into huge wounds, their internal organs fell out and couldn’t be moved.
The strength of these monsters were all at the master level. Only one of them was close to the abyss level. It wasn’t enough in front of him. After all, it wasn’t as strong as the previous time.
Five polar ice insects crawled out from the head of the monster. They formed a defensive line and guarded in front of the giant black tree. To be precise, they were guarding the giant snow-white insect on top of the giant tree.
They were protected by so many polar ice insects. It should be the polar ice insect king.
Dudian was a bit excited but he wasn’t too excited. Although the polar ice insect king was the path to becoming a king but he knew from Boro that once one became a king it would be the same as being possessed by the devil, even if he got the polar ice insect king he wouldn’t be able to give it to Neuss and the others. However, it didn’t mean that the polar ice insect king was worthless to him.
The appearance of a polar ice insect king would cause a sensation in any place!
He didn’t need it but there were too many people in the empire who needed it including the Seven Kings.

chapters.title: Chapter 1038
chapters.content:
Chapter 1038 – Chapter 128: Communication
The confrontation didn’t last for long. The Polar Ice Worm didn’t know what it meant to stop at a moment’s notice. It couldn’t help but take the lead to attack.
Dudian’s expression was calm. He wasn’t as panicked as last time. When the polar ice worm was close to him, his whole body was burning with a blazing flame, the high temperature instantly dispersed the cold air around him. The metal under his feet quickly heated up.
Seven or eight ice worms saw Dudian burning. They were stunned for a moment. But soon, they opened their mouths and spat out saliva, the saliva would quickly freeze. It was more powerful than the frozen liquid. However, when the saliva met Dudian’s flame, it quickly melted and emitted white smoke.
The Sun Beast from the blazing soul worm seemed to be the natural nemesis of the polar ice insects. Moreover Dudian’s physique wasn’t weak. He was able to fully display the strength of the Sun Beast. At the moment he was attacked by the polar ice insects, the flame on his body was slightly weakened but the effect wasn’t big. Dudian’s heart calmed down. He released the cutting edge and quickly rushed towards the polar ice insects.
Whoosh!
Puff!
The burning flames were like one polar ice insect after another. These polar ice insects didn’t dare to use their bodies to wrap around him. They just kept spitting saliva. Dudian quickly closed in on them and cut them into pieces, they turned into lumps of sticky white meat and fell to the ground. However, they were still slowly wriggling. Their tenacious vitality made them almost immortal.
However, there was no true immortal.
The power of nature was enough to destroy everything. Dudian’s burning boots stepped on the lumps of white meat. The white meat quickly shrank as if it was melted ice, he estimated that after a few minutes of burning, it would completely disappear.
But he didn’t do that.
He didn’t come here to kill all the polar ice insects but to capture them.
Dudian walked towards the giant black tree from the ground. His eyes were golden and his perspective was fully activated. He was on guard against any possible mutation.
The pieces of the polar ice insects were slowly gathering and reassembling. But it would take time. This time was enough for him to fight with the thing that was suspected to be the king of polar ice insects.
The giant black tree wasn’t a real tree. It had a complex structure like a living creature. It didn’t have a heart, digestive organs, and other organs, but there were things like blood flowing in its body, most of these things flowed into the body of the giant snow-white worm. Then they were extracted from the body of the giant worm and circulated back and forth.
“Unfortunately, if you had a human carrier, you would be able to communicate with each other. But now you can only use violent means.”Dudian stood in front of the giant black tree. He felt that the branches around him were trembling slightly, the roots of the giant tree were also slightly trembling. It seemed that it couldn’t bear the high temperature of his body. He expressed his sympathy and then used his hands to create a sharp blade.
Puff!
The sharp blade pierced into the giant black tree. Through the ultra-long distance touch, Dudian’s perception extended out of the flame. He could feel a burst of cold.
Suddenly, an ear-piercing scream came from the top of the tree. The Scream was extremely high in decibel. It was so piercing that people’s eardrums hurt. However, the hair on Dudian’s ears stood up. His ears shrank and the sound was lowered, he looked up at the source of the sound. It was coming from the body of the giant snow-white worm. It had woken up!
The middle of the body of the giant snow-white worm slightly opened, revealing a huge mouth. When the mouth opened, the whole body was divided into two. The extent of the opening made all snakes ashamed.
“Buzz, Buzz…”
“Quack…”
Suddenly, the giant snow worm’s mouth emitted a strange sound. Dudian was puzzled when suddenly something came out of its mouth. He was stunned: “Human, Please Stop!”
This was the language of human. Moreover, it was the common language of the giant wall. Moreover, it was fluent and very magnetic.
“Human, please stop!”At this time, the giant Snow Worm said the same thing. But this time, it changed the language. It was the English of the old era!
Dudian continued to be stunned. The giant White Worm taught Dudian what a master of language, Russian, Spanish, as well as some small languages in Africa… it took seven or eight turns to speak. Some of them Dudian had never heard of before, finally, it spoke Chinese.
Dudian heard Chinese. He couldn’t help but ask: “What are you?”
The giant white worm saw that Dudian finally reacted. It seemed to be relieved as it spoke in a magnetic Chinese accent: “We are not here to hurt you. Please let us go and leave.”
Dudian couldn’t help but ask: “Why Did You Say Our Words? Did you read them from the memory of the carrier?”
The giant white worm repeated the above words. Its tone didn’t change.
Dudian couldn’t help but repeat his question. However the giant snow worm didn’t move. He couldn’t help but feel angry, “What the Hell Are You? Why Did You Say Our Words? If you don’t answer properly then I won’t give you the chance to kneel down!”
The giant snow worm opened its mouth as if it was in a daze, after a while it said: “Human, in your spoken language we are called the polar ice worm. We are the ancestors of the parasitic soul worms used to strengthen your body. We don’t mean to be rude. We hope that you will let us live. We are hiding here because we don’t want to be found by you.”
Dudian narrowed his eyes: “So you are the polar ice worm king?”
“You can say that.”The giant snow worm admitted straightforwardly.
Dudian wasn’t excited but calm. He found that the king of the polar ice insects seemed to be an old driver. It understood the languages of the old era as well as the language of the giant wall, it knew the names given to them by humans. It was enough to show that it had experienced many things. It was very likely that it had survived from the old era until now!
300 years of lifespan was something that humans couldn’t reach, but it wasn’t a problem for these extremely strong polar ice bugs.
However, the polar ice bug king’s behavior was a little strange.
It was too honest and didn’t hide anything from it! Logically speaking, knowing so much of the human language of the old era and understanding the situation of the giant wall era, it should have come into contact with many humans and obtained this knowledge from them. However, since it was able to obtain this knowledge.., it should have learned that humans were cunning and cautious. It shouldn’t be so honest.
Soon, Dudian understood why the polar ice insect king was so “Honest”. Perhaps it wanted him to know that he was the polar ice insect king! With Dudian’s current strength, he would be a king in the Abyss stage. The possibility to continue to become stronger was to absorb the polar ice insect king! If he wanted to absorb it then it would be the same as giving it a chance to control him!
“If it was any other abyss then it would be ecstatic!”Dudian thought. If it was any other abyss then he would be ecstatic. Unfortunately, he knew many secrets about the king from Boro, he didn’t plan to rely on the polar ice worm king to become the king.
Dudian didn’t kill the polar ice insect king as he felt that it was a trick. Instead, he said with joy: “How long have you been hiding here?”
The polar ice insect king replied quickly: “It’s been a long time. I can’t remember clearly.”
Dudian smiled: “How do you know the language of humans?”He knew the answer.
The ice worm king hesitated for a moment: “I need the blood of other creatures to maintain my life. My children accidentally caught you humans when they were hunting prey.”
Dudian smiled in his heart as if he was watching his prey fall into the net: “This is your spaceship. Are you from Another Planet?”
Spaceship was the name of Earth but Dudian believed that it could understand as it could read human’s memory. Polar Ice Worm King replied in a sincere tone, “We didn’t expect to run out of energy and fall here. We have fought with you for this. But please believe that we are definitely offended. We will leave this place when we find the energy.”
Dudian was shocked as he saw that it admitted that it was an alien. As a person from the old era, he had been dreaming about other life forms in the dark and quiet universe, he had imagined the appearance of an alien. It had a thin head and huge eyes… but he didn’t expect that the alien life form that appeared on Earth would be this big fat but not cute monster.
The reason why it was unlovable was because the thin, sharp blades that had shrunk to the back of its body and the mouth full of sharp teeth were enough to send chills down one’s spine.
At this point, he could finally confirm that the disaster of the old era was caused by the invasion of alien monsters.
Although he had made some guesses before, and even believed that it was because he had seen some reports on television before he fell asleep, he was still young at that time and had never seen the news footage of the arrival of alien monsters. After that, he had grown up in Sylvia.., he had come into contact with many dark things. He was a bit suspicious of everything. Sometimes he would even think that this thing was secretly made by the countries of the old era in order to change the pattern of the old era.
This kind of nonsense continued until this moment!
However, was the reason for their visit to Earth really because of energy exhaustion?
Dudian naturally didn’t believe it but didn’t expose it. After all, he didn’t have any reference. He might not be able to get the truth from the torture. If the other party insisted on a story or another false story.., he could only believe it. But it was different now. He could induce it to tell the truth and then extract the information that he thought was true.
“Why did you pass through here?”Dudian asked.
Polar Ice Worm King was silent for a while, “Maybe it was too lonely. For thousands of years we were the only ones on our planet so we were ready to look for new life partners in the universe. We were going to go to another planet but we happened to pass through here and found you. Moreover because of the language barrier there was a war which we didn’t want to happen. Both sides suffered heavy casualties.”
“Go to another planet?”
“It’s not a planet but a region. We detected that there was a special signal coming from that region. It seems that there is life so we went there.”
“So you didn’t land because of the exhaustion of energy but because you found our planet?”Dudian changed the topic. He felt that.., it was deliberately trying to catch him.
“In fact, there are two reasons. We didn’t have much energy and we found you so we landed.”The ice worm king’s tone was a bit awkward but there was only one mouth moving on its smooth body, there was no expression on its face.
Dudian sneered and pretended to be angry. However he was suspicious because it mentioned that there was a life signal reaction in another area. He didn’t know if it was true or not. If it was true.., were there other life forms in the universe? If it was false then it meant that the original target of these monsters was Earth. They must have detected the signals sent by earth to the universe and deliberately came!
In the old era when mankind had developed space technology, they had never stopped looking for aliens. Many scientists and famous science fiction writers had mentioned that when mankind found the alien race.., it was very likely that a disaster could not be avoided. Either mankind was weak, oppressed, or even ruled by extinction, or the extraterrestrials they found were weaker than mankind and were colonized by mankind!
Regardless of the outcome, it was not good for mankind or the extraterrestrial race. However, mankind still did not stop their fanatical and dangerous actions and persisted in searching for extraterrestrials.
Some people said that it was because humans were too lonely in the vast universe.
But… you are F * cking lonely. Don’t you want to die? !
Dudian felt that if his guess was true, the polar ice insect king would be able to rub the faces of those fanatical intellectuals on the ground!
After thinking for a moment, Dudian felt that the second possibility was more likely. These insects were coming to Earth. Otherwise, it would be impossible for them to sense the existence of life in other star areas but not the existence of earth.
It was obvious that they didn’t have good intentions to start a war. It was the same as the two outcomes. They would devour humans and rule the weak.
Every life had a common characteristic which was the need for survival. Humans needed food and beasts needed prey. Even a tree needed water to nourish it, this was a very common reason. These monsters took a fancy to the Earth’s resources and environment.
Of course, there was another reason that the possibility of existence was low. They were bloodthirsty and liked to kill. That was why they found Earth.
“Do you know about Aragami?”Dudian suddenly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1039
chapters.content:
Chapter 1039 – Chapter 129: Cattle And Sheep
The king of the polar ice insect suddenly became silent.
It was as if it had suddenly become an insect that didn’t understand human language.
Dudian wasn’t anxious but quietly looked at it. His golden pupils could see the internal structure of the body of the king of the polar ice insect. It was pure white and even more beautiful than snow. It was hard to imagine that such a pure and clean body structure.., it would be such an ugly worm — or perhaps it was very beautiful but he couldn’t appreciate it.
There was only a sticky sound in the Silent Hall. The broken polar ice worms were slowly gathering around. One or two of them had recovered most of their bodies and were crawling towards Dudian.
“Are you trying to stall for time?”Dudian asked.
The king of polar ice insects suddenly woke up: “Ah? No, no. I will make them retreat to the side so that they won’t die in vain.” The polar ice insects that were crawling towards Dudian suddenly stopped. They looked up at the king of polar ice insects on the giant black tree. Then they turned their heads and slowly climbed to the dark corner of the hall.
Dudian looked at them but didn’t say anything. His inner confidence made him feel that these polar ice worms were not a threat. Even if their bodies were healed, he would be able to kill them again without any effort.
“Aragami…”the king of polar ice worm sighed and pulled Dudian’s thoughts back to it, “They are also extraterrestrials. They are the ones that released the unknown life signal. They have also found Earth. “However, they are different from us. Their planet is lacking in resources and they plunder everywhere. They are bloodthirsty and brutal by nature. Moreover, they need to constantly devour other life forms in order to maintain their lives. You call them “Aragami”. Hehe, this name was originally given by our race, but there is only one word, “Desolate”
“The symbolic meaning of this name is very simple. Wherever desolate passes, it is barren! No life forms can escape from their hands. Even if it is an ant, they will not let it go!”
“However, later on, they were regarded as ‘gods’by you. Aragami, Hehe…”
There was a bit of bitterness in his voice.
Dudian was stunned. He didn’t think that things would turn out like this. Did It mean that it didn’t lie? Were they really just passing by earth? But how could it be explained that they didn’t notice the Earth in advance?
He was filled with doubt and did not dare to believe it for a moment. After all, the extreme ice insect king had said that the Aragami were bloodthirsty and brutal, devouring other creatures. It made him think of the Aragami’s flesh and blood that he had seen before, as well as the situation after he had eaten the Aragami’s flesh and blood, indeed, the Aragami Factor had an extremely strong devouring ability. He felt that the reason why his body could absorb other magic marks was most likely due to the effect of the Aragami gene.
However, the berserk nature of the Aragami gene was neutralized by Crimson Moon’s experiment so it didn’t pose much of a threat to his body. However, he still didn’t dare to take off the uranium ring. He needed further experiments to confirm it.
“So the Aragami are the ones who are at war with humans?”Dudian deliberately asked.
Polar ice worm king said: “Not exactly. The enemies of humans were mainly us. These Aragami were hidden in the dark and exacerbated the conflict between humans and US. Although they are brutal and bloodthirsty but their intelligence is very high. They incited us to start a war with you humans so that we could reap the benefits. Unfortunately no one saw this at the beginning. It wasn’t until they showed up that the truth was revealed. But it was too late. At that time the humans were ready to die together with US and launched the strongest plan to destroy the world…”
Dudian was startled. Firstly, he didn’t think that the ice queen would admit that he was the enemy of the human race. Secondly, he wasn’t sure if what it said was true or false.
Dudian’s mind was stuck for a moment. He suddenly reacted. No matter what the ice queen said was true or false, it was enough to shake his mind, it wasn’t a simple ‘honesty’that could move him.
“So you and our ancestors were fooled. Why did the giant wall and Empire appear in the end? Why did we call them ‘Aragami’?”Dudian asked.
The Ice Worm King was silent for a moment, he slowly said: “I don’t know why the giant wall appeared. We had to avoid the sharp edge of the world because of the destruction plan launched by humans. I have been here for a very long time. I have never left nor could I leave. I know the situation outside. I have captured and searched the memories of human explorers who came here. I only know the appearance of the current world but I don’t know the history in the middle.”. But I guess that desolate used despicable means to cover up their crimes. Instead, they threw all the crimes to our family. In the name of helping humans, they ruled over humans but in reality, they were just breeding humans.”
“After all, their family loves to kill and devour. But if all the creatures were plundered, they would also die. So breeding humans is the best way. You humans have good reproduction ability. If you kill in moderation, you can use it for many years…”
Dudian frowned. Was It True? He couldn’t tell. The ice worm king’s words were logical. The only thing that he could guess and confirm was that it should have hidden some other things. However, there were no loopholes in the main events, moreover, the possibility was very high. Even if it didn’t say it, he would have guessed it.
“Breeding, killing…”Dudian thought of the towering giant wall. His heart suddenly felt cold. It was obvious that the thousand meters tall giant wall was not built by humans, was it really just to protect humans?
He suddenly thought of the pigs, dogs, cows and sheep that humans raised. His face couldn’t help but slightly change. Humans used the fence to raise pigs and sheep. wasn’t it to protect them? wasn’t it worried that they would run out and be captured by others? But if they continued to stay in the fence, sooner or later they would be ‘sheltered’by their masters and killed!
Could it be that the final fate of the inhabitants of the giant wall was like this?
Dudian thought for a moment but felt that something was wrong. He had never heard of unknown forces or figures in the years he had been the master of the giant wall of Sylvia. He had never heard of a large number of people being captured or massacred. Occasionally there would be large-scale casualties because of the improper handling of the bodies of refugees. The plague caused by the accumulation of the corpses of rats in the streets was caused by other disasters.
“If it is hidden… that’s not right. I am looking at the secret files which are the most confidential things in the giant wall. It is impossible that there is no record of it. Unless the giant wall and the Aragami are in the same nest.”Dudian frowned as he pondered, suddenly he thought of something that he had overlooked: “The Aragami are dead. Does that mean that they died after building the giant wall?”
Very soon, this thought was overturned by him.
He felt that the Aragami should not have been exterminated from this world.
After all, humans had survived. As the final winner, how could the Aragami be exterminated?
If the Aragami existed and raising humans was their purpose, then the incident of humans being slaughtered would definitely be recorded. Do not forget about the great humans who had survived in dogmas and justice, their beliefs were beyond the imagination of ordinary people.
No matter if it was a great person or a sinner, when they reached a certain height, they had to pay the same amount of faith.
Dudian raised the doubts in his heart with the polar ice worm king. He looked at its response and answer.
“I don’t know. Maybe it has happened but you don’t know. After all they won’t do it openly and cause panic. Humans can pick a lamb from the flock and slaughter it. They don’t care about the thoughts of other sheep because humans think that these sheep don’t have intelligence. But you humans obviously know about the fear of intelligent life. They won’t do it.”The Polar Ice Worm King thought for a moment: “It is possible that they say that they will pick from different giant walls and won’t harvest in one giant wall.”
No more harvesting inside the giant wall? Dudian’s eyes lit up. Was Sylvia too weak? was such an activity only carried out in the empire?
He felt that he couldn’t distinguish the truth from the falsehood. He decided to put the matter aside for the time being. He couldn’t continue to be led by the nose by the polar ice worm king, “In that case, I can find out what you know. In that case, you don’t seem to have any value.”
The Ice Worm King didn’t expect that Dudian would suddenly turn hostile, it anxiously said: “I’m telling you the truth. I’m not hiding anything from you. But I really don’t know anything else. How about this? I’ll tell you the way to continue to become stronger. In addition, I’ll give you my children. They will accept you unconditionally.”
Dudian sneered: “Even if they resist, do they have the ability?”
“This…”the ice worm king was a bit disappointed: “What do you want?”
“I don’t want anything. You and your children belong to me.”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he smiled, “You seem to have forgotten that I am the abyss. The way for humans to become the Abyss is to eat your children and further strengthen their physique. However, your children are not enough. If I can eat you, I should be able to reach the top of the human race.”
The ice worm king was shocked: “You… You Said you wouldn’t hurt me!”
“How come I don’t remember?”Dudian sneered, “It doesn’t matter if you resist or obey. But it is best to advise you to be obedient so that you won’t suffer. If you perform well, I might leave one for your children.”
The ice worm king was so angry that it began to shout. The languages of different countries and different races were coming out.
Dudian listened quietly. He was amazed and appreciative. He had never heard of a scene where many languages were mixed together. Moreover, he had never seen an insect’s acting skills soar to such a high level. It was a pity that the old era was destroyed, the Oscar statuette couldn’t accept it.
After cursing for a few minutes the polar ice insect king gradually managed its own language system, it angrily said to dudian in Chinese: “You Bastard! You humans are despicable and Shameless! You are a greedy and selfish race! You deserve to be imprisoned! You deserve to be a father of thieves!”
“You are a god of Thieves!”Dudian corrected it. His words also showed that he believed in its previous words.
The king of polar ice worm angrily cursed: “Despicable! Shameless!”
“Chinese is broad and profound. It is the most advanced language on our side. But you have only learned a few words to scold people. It is really…”Dudian shook his head.
Polar ice insect king obviously found that it was much worse than the purebred earthlings in terms of scolding people.
“You must keep your word this time!”Polar ice insect king seemed to be gnashing its teeth.
“Of course. I don’t need your child when I reach the bottleneck.”Dudian said.
The Polar Ice Insect King was silent for a long time before it finally agreed.
Dudian was relieved. He felt that he should be matched with Oscar. Oh No, one might not be enough. He needed a dozen.
“By the way, why was the door closed when I came in? It didn’t seem like that last time.”Dudian thought of the strange opening of the door and immediately asked.
Polar Ice Worm king said in a weak tone: “The spaceship has recovered some energy. I told my children to close it. I wanted to quietly recuperate. Who knew…”it seemed to have suddenly reacted, two black eyeballs protruded out of its fat white body. They were the size of soybeans. It was very hidden: “How did you open the door?”
“It opened by itself.”Dudian frowned. “Tell me honestly, is there something else here?”
The ice worm king seemed to want to jump. Its voice suddenly increased by eight degrees. “The door opened by itself? How is that possible! My children are here. They can’t open the door without my permission!”
Dudian looked at it. He wasn’t sure if it was acting this time. But it seemed a bit real. Was it really not opened by it? Or was there something hidden here that it didn’t know about?
If it was, then that thing opened the door and used him to come over… thinking of this, Dudian’s hair stood up as he looked at the darkness around him, he said in a deep voice: “The door opened by itself. If you are hiding it, don’t blame me for falling out with you. If you aren’t hiding it then I guess… There is something here that you don’t know about! Moreover, it can control this ship!”
The ice worm king wanted to say that Dudian had turned against it. What was so strange about that? However, Dudian’s words made it nervous. Its black eyes quickly looked around. It knew that Dudian didn’t want to lie so there was no reason for him to deliberately say that, if the door opened by itself… it would be a f * cking ghost!
Dudian could only hear his own breathing in the Dark Hall. He tried to expand his perception to the limit. He wanted to sense the surroundings but many channels couldn’t be explored so his perception range was limited.
He couldn’t find anything within his perception range.
However, this made him even more uneasy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1040
chapters.content:
Chapter 1040 – Chapter 130: Raising Money
“Follow me and leave this place.”Dudian ordered the polar ice insect king. His original plan was to subdue the polar ice insects and explore the spaceship, he hoped to find some technology that could be dismantled and transported back. After all, this was the technology of the magic insects. Even small items could give a huge boost to human technology.
However, the strange opening of the cabin door wasn’t done by the polar ice worm. The thing hidden in the dark could hide from the polar ice worm king and control the spaceship. It was most likely an existence that he couldn’t imagine. He had to leave as soon as possible.
There was no need for Dudian to say that the polar ice worm king also intended to leave immediately. It was frightened by Dudian’s words. This spaceship was its territory. Without its permission, the cabin door was opened, it felt like a girl found a strong man in her room. Moreover, he was masked..
Soon, the polar ice insect king dragged its fat white body and climbed down from the giant black tree. It looked like there was a suction cup under its body. It was able to climb straight down the tree. At this time, the polar ice insects that were watching from the dark quickly gathered around the polar ice insect king.
“Let’s go.”The Polar Ice Insect King was afraid that Dudian would misunderstand and quickly said.
Dudian coldly said: “Let them follow you. I will be the first one to look for you!”
“I know.”The polar ice insect king bitterly smiled. It knew that Dudian was worried that it would secretly send its children to other places to control the spaceship and let them escape. Unfortunately, the energy of the spaceship was limited, even if it wanted to do so, it would take a lot of effort. Moreover, Dudian was aware of this possibility. Moreover, it felt that even if it sent a child to secretly sneak into the command room.., it would be killed by the strange existence in the dark.
Since the latter could control the cabin door, it was obvious that it was standing in the command room. It was observing every movement through the monitor screen!
Dudian counted the number of polar ice insects. There were thirteen of them. Including the king of polar ice insects, there were fourteen of them. The harvest this time was enough to make countless people envious. Thirteen polar ice insects could create thirteen abyss, unfortunately, they were only inferior abyss.
Dudian sighed in his heart. He suddenly thought that the king of polar ice insects called them “Children”. In this case, wouldn’t it be able to breed polar ice insects?
“This is a golden chicken that lays eggs…”Dudian’s eyes lit up.
The king of polar ice insects suddenly felt a chill behind its back. It turned its big black eyes and looked back. It saw Dudian smiling at it. It suddenly felt a chill in its heart, dudian may have known the path to the king. Its fat body moved forward more powerfully.
Whoosh! Whoosh.
The Polar Ice Worm King led a group of polar ice worms to climb up. These polar ice worms were agile but the polar ice worm king’s body was big and slow. It was like a swollen caterpillar that relied on its ‘abdominal muscles’to move forward.
Soon, the polar ice worm king came to the cabin door which should have been closed. It carefully observed the cabin door and found that there were no signs of fighting and no signs of damage, it looked through the gap of the cabin door and saw that the cabin door was still shrinking. Its heart was shocked again. It was more and more anxious to move forward. However, it was moving at full speed, the surrounding scenery was moving backward at a slow speed.
Dudian maintained his normal walking speed and followed behind. He looked at the ice worm king which was moving forward. He felt strange. was this guy deliberately stalling for time? He didn’t urge it but was ready to continue to observe for a while. Soon, he saw that it had increased its speed. The fat on its body trembled and its body vigorously arched, it moved forward… but its speed had only increased from ‘walking’to ‘fast walking’.
Was this thing a turtle? !
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows. He could see that this thing was working hard. However, you should move!
Dudian shook his head and shouted: “If you can’t move then let your child carry you.”
The polar ice insect king reacted: “Yes.”It was a bit embarrassed and immediately let the child carry it.
Whoosh!
After seven or eight polar ice insects carried it, it quickly ran away.
Dudian and the rest of the polar ice insects quickly followed. In the blink of an eye they came to the exit of the spaceship.
The king of polar ice insects took Dudian to the emergency passage of the spaceship. There was a bottomless pool which led to the lake outside. The king of polar ice insects said to Dudian and jumped in.
The rest of the polar ice insects quickly followed.
Dudian also entered the lake. He saw seven or eight polar ice insects pushing the king of polar ice insects forward like propellers.
After they went around the passage to the outside of the lake, the few polar ice insects suddenly released a large amount of cold air. The lake water quickly froze and the cold ice spread in all directions.
Dudian’s body released flames to disperse the cold air around him. He quickly approached the king of polar ice insects.
“I… I don’t want to attack you. I want to speed up and leave.”The king of polar ice insects said in a hurry.
Dudian knew that the worm king didn’t have the guts to attack him but he was still angry. He raised his hand to cut off the polar ice worms and drilled out of the frozen lake.
At this time, the polar ice worm king let the other polar ice worms to float out. The broken polar ice worms were brought out by the other polar ice worms.
Soon, the surface of the lake was completely frozen and turned into a block of ice. The king of polar ice worm slid on it and said to Dudian who was flying in the air: “Where Are We Going Now?”
“Home.”Dudian took out a folded black net from his backpack. It turned into a huge net and spread out. The net was very thin but its tenacity was terrifying. It was enough to bear the weight of a hundred tons.
“All of you go inside and I’ll take you home.”Dudian coldly said.
The polar ice insect king quickly said: “We agreed to cooperate with you but you have to let me go.”
“Alright.”Dudian nodded. Although he had lost one but he had saved a lot of effort. If the polar ice insect king struggled it would be difficult to go back to Borja. After all, there were too many of them, even if they could kill all of them it would be difficult to carry them.
The Polar Ice Worm King was relieved. It gratefully said: “Thank You!”A polar ice worm immediately climbed out of the Swarm. It slid to the other side of the lake and looked into the distance.
“Let’s go.”Dudian urged.
The polar ice worm king climbed into the black net while the rest of the polar ice worms obediently poured into it.
Although the black net was tough but if they wanted to resist then they only needed to freeze the black net and it would be easily broken.
Dudian let them control the release of cold air from their bodies so as not to freeze the black net.
Dudian took off with the polar ice worm king and the group of Polar Ice Worms.
“I don’t know what is hidden inside…”Dudian looked back at the frozen lake before he left. His eyes flickered but he retracted his gaze and flew forward.
Half a month later, Dudian returned to the giant wall of Berga with a group of insects.
The giant wall of Berga was heavily guarded. In addition to the sensorial guards who patrolled the giant wall day and night, there were also intelligent sensors installed. Dudian chose to increase the height and descended from the sky.
He directly landed on the giant wall.
The scenery was very beautiful. The clouds were like cotton and there were several layers of sea of clouds. He chose late at night. It was already curfew time in the wall. The guards were patrolling the streets looking for people who had sneaked past the curfew. The night shift guards were in high spirits as they looked at their posts, no one yawned so no one looked up at the monotonous night sky.
Dudian landed in the suburbs. He quickly left after landing and didn’t attract any attention.
Dudian returned to the secret stronghold inside the wall. He observed the area outside the stronghold. He was relieved to see that the people inside the stronghold were the confidants of Neuss and the others.
“Ah, it’s young master!”
“Young Master!”
“Young master you are not…”
Dudian raised his hand to interrupt the surprised voices: “Send the order to Neuss and everyone else. Tell them to gather here in three days. Tell them that I’m back and ready for the meeting.”
The guards were slightly less confused as they heard Dudian mention Neuss’s name. After all, it was not difficult to disguise as someone else. They were worried that Dudian was a fake.
One of Aurora’s trusted aides had the courage to ask about Dudian and the names of the adults before he left.
Dudian didn’t get angry but didn’t answer. He directly released the magic body of the splitter. Everyone immediately believed him. The young man was trembling in fear.
Dudian patted his shoulder: “It’s good to be cautious.”
The young man felt as if he was exhausted. was he being praised? He looked up and saw the envious eyes of others.
Three days later.
Neuss, Sergei and others came with a group of confidants. They also brought Peder and Black Mage.
Both of them had been working with Neuss. They didn’t expect that Dudian would come back so soon. They were glad that they didn’t counterattack and kill the remnants of Dudian’s party.
Dudian was relieved as he asked: “How about the money? Can We Buy Five Legendary Soul Worms?”
Neuss knew that Dudian intended to cultivate their strength. His face turned red as he heard Dudian’s question, he said in embarrassment: “Master, we haven’t had enough time to raise money. I think we can only raise one legendary soul worm.”
A legendary soul worm was worth a lot. Dudian knew that time was tight. Moreover they were sensitive in status. They didn’t dare to use other means to earn gray income. After all, all the fast ways to make money.., it had been written on the criminal case of the magistrate.
Dudian asked about their respective circles and professions. He asked black mage and Peder to help him with his judgement. He selected seven or eight circles that could make money quickly, the most profitable ones should be the circle of wizards that Edward had infiltrated. He only needed to create a high-level witchcraft or a high-level magic tool to earn a lot of money.
However, it was very difficult for the people who were born and raised in the giant wall. Their thinking and cognition had been limited by the environment. It took talent to break out of the cocoon and become a butterfly.
However, for people like Dudian who had seen different scenery, this was a piece of cake.
He intended to let Edward Rise quickly. He immediately asked him to wait at the side of the meeting room. Then he picked one person from the room. It was Noyce’s confidant. Her name was Amelia. She was a young woman in her early twenties, she looked as cute as a young girl. She blended into the music industry as a music apprentice. She was the kind of person who paid to study and then helped out with chores and errands.
If she wanted to learn, she could only rely on her usual opportunities of being close to the water, observing and learning on her own, and diligently seeking advice.
However, Amelia had studied piano for four or five years in her childhood, so she had a good foundation. However, her family was later destroyed, and she transformed from a young lady from a well-off family into, well, an orphan, then, she stumbled to Noyce’s side and became the sidekick of the man who had brought light to her desperate life. She was willing to sacrifice her broken life for him.
Her days as an apprentice were not high-profile, and she still maintained a humble and studious appearance. Although she was young, her acting skills had long been refined in the dark church.
A person’s age was never the standard to evaluate a person.
Dudian asked Neuss and Sergei to lead others to find a way to raise money as soon as possible. However, they couldn’t cross the line and expose their identity. In fact, it wasn’t difficult for them to make money. It was just a matter of time.
After the meeting, Dudian called Edward and Amelia to his office. Teaching knowledge was more complicated. Dudian asked Edward to wait by the side. He looked at the girl who was nervous and enduring, dudian said: “I heard from Neuss that you had some foundation in piano. Weren’t you forced to learn it by your parents when you were young?”
“Yes, Young Master.”Amelia quickly replied.
“I will teach you a few pieces of music. Later you will publish them one by one. Tell them that they are your own creations. If someone wants to buy your music then you can sell them but the price must be high.”Dudian said.
Amelia was stunned. She thought of Dudian’s plan to raise money during the meeting, she couldn’t help but ask: “Master, why do you want to sell? I can use these songs to publish and package them to become a master musician. By that time I will be able to make money faster.”
“The cycle of packaging is too slow.”Dudian shook his head, “But you can also do that. But you can also sell a part of the songs. But when a newcomer makes an amazing debut with a song, it will certainly attract the attention of some people. If you reveal the news that you have a new creation, there will be people looking for you to buy songs. Of course, you can also continue to publish other songs. Anyway, we don’t lack this thing. Come and tell me when you are done.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1041
chapters.content:
Chapter 1041 – Chapter 130: South
Amelia suddenly realized that she was not a child after all. She immediately thought of the money that could be generated from this and the connections that could be extended. She immediately agreed. After she agreed, she suddenly thought that the method was not bad. However, what about the music? Could it be that she was planning to copy the movements of the Masters from Sylvia? It was indeed a good idea. However, even if she was in a depressed mood she wouldn’t be able to remember the movements of the masters. She could only roughly hum a few melodies, however, it was impossible for her to record the entire piece.
After all, she was in a mood to enjoy the concert instead of learning and recording. Even if she listened to it ten or eight times she would only be able to remember a few favorite melodies.
Dudian saw her puzzled expression. He took out a notebook from the side, dipped it in ink and quickly wrote. The notes floated on the tip of his nose as if they were going to fly out of the notebook.
In the dimly lit room, there was only the sound of the goose quill brushing against the snow paper and the sound of Edward and Amelia’s breathing.
Amelia looked at the notes jumping out of the Goose Quill. She quickly filled one and then turned to a new page. She was completely stunned. She opened her mouth for a long time but didn’t say anything. When she came back to her senses, she immediately closed her mouth, she was afraid that her voice would disturb Dudian’s train of thought and interrupt the pen in his hand.
Half an hour later, Dudian closed the pen and closed the book.
The ink on the book had long dried up. Even the last page was the same. The Magic Marks of the Sun Beast had brought him the ability to control the temperature. He had dried the ink when he touched the paper. However the paper wasn’t lit, this was his control.
“Consider it yourself. Make the most of it.”Dudian handed the book to her.
Amelia took the book with both hands. She bowed and nodded. She heard Dudian ask her to step back. She bowed again and respectfully took her leave. Then she slowly left the room and closed the door.
Amelia felt that the air had returned to normal. She took a deep breath and gently exhaled. Her footsteps were fast and silent as she left the room. She slowly opened the book as she came to the front of the stairs, the first movement had a name on it-moonlight lover.
This was a famous movement in Sylvia. Almost all the couples who had good conditions would listen to it when they confessed their love or when they had their first date. Some would choose a restaurant that played moonlight lover because they didn’t have the money to go to the concert, they ate exquisite meals and listened to the imitation of moonlight lover. It was obvious that this was a classic and commercial movement.
Amelia’s eyes were full of surprise. She didn’t think that Dudian could memorize this movement. She had heard it many times but it was almost impossible for her to memorize it.
She quickly flipped through seven or eight pages. It was the second movement and another famous movement from Sylvia.
Amelia quickly turned back to the third and fourth movement.
“Is he going to read the dictionary when he has nothing to do?”Amelia was surprised. She knew that their work was very busy and they didn’t have much time for entertainment.
Amelia went downstairs and greeted her friends.
She knew that Dudian didn’t specifically tell her how to operate it. It was a test of her ability. If this matter was done then she would be put in an important position in the future. At least she would be promoted from the confidant of Neuss.
If she could work directly with Dudian then her status would be even more different.
However, she didn’t expect to have direct contact with Dudian. She preferred to stay by Neuss’s side. If she could see this man every day then it would be even better!
..
… ..
Dudian leaned on the back of the chair to rest after sending off Amelia. He had memorized so many movements in one go. Although his memory was close to photographic memory but the human brain was after all a human brain, not a machine, he couldn’t make a 100% record. Many fragments needed him to think, recall, and constantly dig before he could remember them again.
When the rest was almost over, Dudian called Edward and began to teach him new inventions.
Edward was very serious. Today he felt that he had seen the erudite side of his teacher. In addition to complex inventions, he actually knew music and such works of art. Moreover, his own combat strength was strong, he felt that his teacher was a rare genius in a hundred years. He was smarter than anyone he had ever met. So he was very respectful and learned very carefully.
Two days later.
Dudian, Neuss, Sergei and the others met again. This time they were asked to choose the first person to become the master.
Neuss, Sergei, Barton and the others were stunned when they heard the news. In the past Dudian had directly appointed them but this time they were asked to choose by themselves. They weren’t used to it.
However, under Dudian’s order, they finally chose Neuss.
The reason why they chose Neuss was very simple. He had been with Dudian for the longest time. He was the most trusted by Dudian. He wouldn’t betray Dudian. He was the smartest among them. Neuss had faintly shown the shadow of dudian during the time when Dudian had left. He was able to control the situation in an orderly manner. He had helped many people to retreat.
Now in the giant wall of Berga, they needed to stand firm. Many things needed a smart person to step out. Neuss was undoubtedly the person who participated in the most important things. If he had the corresponding strength, many things would be easy to handle.
Dudian had expected this result. He himself was the most optimistic about Neuss. Although Macon was his childhood friend and had experienced several life and death trials. But Macon’s character wasn’t suitable to control the overall situation. Sometimes he would be impulsive, he didn’t have a good view of the overall situation.
Moreover Barton was too calm. It was easy to lose the opportunity.
Aurora was too young. Her fighting talent was exceptionally high. But in terms of management it was difficult to convince the masses.
“Then Neuss, you don’t need to Shirk.”Dudian made a decision.
Neuss slightly opened his mouth and smiled bitterly. He knew Dudian’s character. He didn’t like to be polite.
Dudian handed him the Atlas and asked him to pick a legendary monster that he liked.
In the past, Neuss had been a testers by his side. Now Neuss had trained him to be a testers. Moreover he didn’t need his help to test the poison anymore, he could even digest the poison that could kill Neuss.
Noyce saw Dudian’s eyes and knew what he meant. He was ready to let him take charge.
He was excited, regretful and a bit sad but it was all hidden. He took a deep breath and flipped through the pages. His eyes were serious as he looked at the ability of each legendary magic mark, he estimated that this ability was suitable for use. He knew that this time he didn’t need to choose an auxiliary ability. He wanted a comprehensive ability or a part of an extremely strong ability.
“This one, ‘Soul Summoner’!”Neuss pointed at one of the pages.
Dudian took a look. ‘Soul Summoner’was ranked seventh among the legendary monsters. It was a three-star legendary monster. Its main ability was to interfere with the enemy’s spirit and ignore the body’s defense. In addition, it could hear the whispers of the dead, it could communicate with the ‘undead’.
What was an ‘undead’?
According to the forced explanation of science in the old era, it was a kind of energy in the human body. It could be understood as an electromagnetic field. However, no one could answer this explanation. Although humans could see the universe hundreds of light years away, they couldn’t answer whether they had a ‘soul’or what a ‘soul’was.
However, the ability of the ‘Soul Summoner’could do things that couldn’t be explained. It was like many things that humans could do instinctively but couldn’t explain the principle behind it.
The ability of magic marks was the ability of living creatures.
It could be done but it couldn’t be explained.
“Are you sure?”Dudian looked at him.
Neuss had chosen the path so he didn’t interfere.
Neuss nodded: “Master, I want this.”
“Good!”Dudian nodded. This ability wasn’t bad for Neuss. Moreover he felt that Neuss should have asked the prices of magic marks from the Magic Institute, the price of ‘necromancers’wasn’t too expensive. They didn’t need to spend a long time to raise money to buy five of them.
One and a half months later.
Noyce absorbed five soul summoners and successfully strengthened his magic marks, obtaining the qualifications to become a ruler. As for the God’s marrow, its price was thousands of times cheaper than magic marks. They had already stored a lot for Noyce to directly absorb the ruler.
The group worked together to raise money to buy five legendary parasitic soul worms in one and a half months. The speed at which they earned money was already quite terrifying. After all, they had never touched the forbidden area, although there was a lot of gray income, however, the gray income was within the permitted scope of the rules.
For example, the bets of the Gladiator Arena, the sale of Edward’s witchcraft, the sale of Amelia’s movement but reneged on it, the use of the recording of the transaction to blackmail and obtain a large amount of compensation.., it was really just a matter of time. His bank was everywhere.
Dudian took out a polar ice worm and helped Neuss to absorb it. Soon, Neuss jumped from a ruler to an abyss. It was only a month and a half!
At this point, Dudian was relieved. Neuss’current strength was enough to subdue Pidel and black mage. He could withdraw and retreat. However, before he left, there was a problem to be solved. That was the polar ice worm.
He planned to leave these polar ice insects to Neuss. However, the combat power of the polar ice insects was comparable to that of the inferior abyss. If Neuss’s magic mark was a solar beast that could defeat the polar ice insects then it was possible for him to use the power of the inferior abyss, he could subdue dozens of polar ice insects or even the king of polar ice insects.
“Young Master, are you planning to leave?”Neuss found Dudian on the second day after he became the abyss. After a night of excitement and excitement, he felt the sadness of leaving.
Dudian saw Neuss who came to the office. He sighed in his heart. The person who had followed him for the longest time knew him very well, “Yes, I’m planning to go to the south to see the results of the war.”
Neuss was startled. He wanted to say that there was nothing to see but he quickly thought that Dudian wouldn’t do something without benefits. It was possible that he wouldn’t go to the south just to see a war.
He sighed: “Young Master, isn’t it too dangerous? What can I do to help you?”He felt powerless because he knew that he couldn’t keep Dudian.
“Help me take care of them and yourself.”Dudian smiled: “It’s normal to do dangerous things. I’m not used to doing things that aren’t dangerous.”
Neuss’s mouth twitched. He felt that the joke was a bit cold.
Seven days later.
Dudian left the giant wall of Berga. He waved goodbye to Neuss, Barton, Sergei and others. Neuss was in charge of dealing with the remaining twelve polar ice insects, he had imprisoned the polar ice worm king in a blazing flame coffin. He found that the polar ice worm king was as weak as the polar ice worm in terms of flame resistance.
The temperature of the flame coffin was high enough to form a cage. The only trouble was that it couldn’t be put out. It needed to be burned in the furnace at all times.
However, Dudian and Neuss had made other preparations. If the polar ice worm king broke out of the coffin then he would expose the place to the lords of the giant wall. Even if they couldn’t catch the polar ice worm king then.., it was estimated that there would be a bloody storm which would greatly weaken the power of the giant wall. It would be convenient for Neuss and the others to rise up.
Dudian once again began to travel alone in the wilderness. He began to embark on a new journey towards the south.
Dudian stopped and walked along the way. The once dangerous Abyss region was no different from the wilderness in front of him. Occasionally he would meet Abyss level monsters which he thought was just a warm-up, it added a bit of fun to the monotonous travel.
Dudian saw a lot of post-apocalyptic scenery along the way. There were remnants of human products left by the broken river banks. Occasionally he saw high-speed trains which looked like snakes but the carriages were already crooked, there were only a few undeads wandering around.
A month later Dudian came to the south.
Through his omniscient perception he saw a few hidden sentries before he arrived at the southern God of war wall. He quietly went over to solve them and took out maps and food from them.
Dudian was surprised that the map covered more than half of the Shenluo Empire. The southern wall of God of war was the core of the map. It radiated for thousands of miles. He also saw the giant wall of Polga and the other seven giant walls, there were also three magic pits.

chapters.title: Chapter 1042
chapters.content:
Chapter 1042 – Chapter 131: Climb The Wall
Dudian took down the map and rolled it up.
“Tell me, what is the situation of the war ahead?”A sentry who was hiding in the grass was tortured by Dudian.
The Sentry was scared by Dudian who had sneaked in. Before he could resist, Dudian’s sharp arm was pressed against his forehead. The skin between his eyebrows had been cut, the pain made him realize how sharp the blade was.
However, the sentry didn’t give in. Although he hadn’t read any books but he knew that since Dudian had attacked him it meant that he was an enemy of the empire. If he gave in then it would be tantamount to treason.
It was something that had been carved into his bones since he was young. He decided that he would rather die than give in!
Dudian didn’t expect that the sentry that he was going to interrogate was actually a hard bone. However he didn’t care. He had encountered too many such roles in the past.
It didn’t take long for the Sentinel to kneel in front of dudian. Pain, fear, pain that pierced into his nerves… when the pain was too much for him to bear, his belief didn’t play a role in alleviating it. In fact, he completely forgot about it at this moment.
Soon, Dudian dug out the information he wanted from the Sentinel’s mouth. He relied on the time the Sentinel told him about the arrival of the blood thorn army to determine whether what he said was true or false. After he understood the situation, he also cut off the Sentinel’s limbs, the Sentinel was freed.
Flames emerged from the center of his palm and stuck to the body of the Sentinel. Soon, it burned away and left only burn marks on the spot.
The clothes of the sentinel were neatly piled on the side.
Dudian took off his armor and changed into the standard uniform of the Sentinel. At the same time, he used his hands to pinch the bones of his face. As for the color of his hair, he couldn’t change it. Fortunately, the Sentinel had a military cap. He cut his hair into a buzz cut and put on a military cap. He copied the look of the Sentinel and hid in the rock, waiting for the night to fall.
At night, a figure quietly approached.
Dudian noticed it early but didn’t move. He saw the figure approach. He looked around and knocked on the rock.
Dudian used the magic marks of the turtle to climb out of the rock. He stood up and said in a low voice: “Why did you come so late?”
It was a youth who was less than 30 years old. The skin on his face was rough and dark. He heard Dudian’s words and stared at him: “Damn, I took a piss on the way. I was just a bit late.”
Dudian snorted: “I’m going back.”
The young man waved his hand and quickly drilled into the rock.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he saw that nothing was exposed. He turned around and ran along the path of the young man. When he reached the end of his vision he used the smell left by the young man to guide him.
The smell left by the young man was very faint. But there were shallow prints on the ground. As a hunter he couldn’t hide it from him. After half an hour he came to a valley behind the valley, the towering god of war wall was faintly visible. Under the Moon and stars, it was like a giant black beast entrenched in heaven and earth. It was full of oppression.
Here, it was closer to the god of war wall.
Dudian’s eyes fell on the valley. Golden light flashed in his eyes. He saw that there was an underground structure in the valley. It was not a well-equipped underground base but a very simple underground cave.
Seven or eight figures were living in the cave. Some were sleeping, some were chatting, and some were busy reading small magazines.
“Found it.”There was calmness and indifference in his dark eyes. Dudian took off his sentry uniform and stood naked in the night. The Breeze blew and his body rolled up the spikes, he quickly rushed into the valley.
Ten minutes later, a figure slowly came out of the valley. Half of his chest was stained with blood. He was holding a pure water bucket. He lifted it and poured it over his head, he evaporated the water on the ground. He picked up the military uniform and put it on. Then he trotted towards the direction of the god of war wall at a moderate speed.
He hadn’t been able to get information from the Sentinel about the alternate positions of the Sentinels. He had thought that the Sentinels lived on the god of war wall. He didn’t expect that they were in a hidden valley nearby. However, someone had to report the information to the god of war wall.
Dudian came to the front of the god of war wall. He took out the inner layer of the Sentinel uniform and blew the whistle.
Whoosh!
In less than a few minutes a figure flew down from the god of war. There was a pair of huge bird wings on his back. He looked like an angel.
“What’s the matter?”The man stopped when he was four or five meters above Dudian’s head. Dudian had to look up at him: “Is there a monster attack?” Although their main duty was to prevent people from approaching but in most cases, no one would be stupid enough to attack the god of war alone unless they were the evil heretics in the empire.
Dudian quickly said: “Someone attacked us!”
“It’s people?”The youth’s eyes were full of seriousness. He saw that Dudian didn’t seem to be lying. He didn’t dare to lie. He pondered for a moment and asked: “How many people have run away?”
“I don’t know. I saw that everyone was dead when I went back. But their wounds weren’t caused by monsters.”Dudian immediately said.
The youth frowned. He didn’t see it with his own eyes… he believed that although the other was just a sentry but it shouldn’t be wrong.
“Come with me.”He grabbed Dudian’s shoulder and took him to the god of war wall.
“I’ll take you to the brigade commander. Tell her the details.”The youth coldly said.
Dudian’s eyes were attracted by the scene on the god of war’s wall. He had seen two or three huge spaceships like the Blood Thorn Army, however, it wasn’t engraved with the badge of the Blood Thorn King but a blood red vertical pupil. It was very strange.
In addition, there were more than hundreds of small airships that carried four or five people.
In addition, Dudian saw small fighter planes that were almost the same as those of the old era. There were passenger planes as well as box-like black square objects that looked like large cargo boxes.
Dudian was shocked by the technology displayed here. Although he had expected it but he was still a bit surprised to see it with his own eyes. In particular, he saw several large “White pots”with a diameter of seven or eight meters, it was like a radio telescope but he didn’t know whether it was a telescope or a wireless signal receiver.
“There wasn’t such a thing on the east wall. Could it be that it was created in such a short time? It’s impossible. Even if there is an explosion of technology it would be impossible for it to develop so fast in just a few years. Do you mean that the equipment is mainly used to deal with the giant alien race in the South?”Dudian’s eyes were filled with doubt, he quickly thought about it. The foreign races in the east could fly. The fighters in the east wouldn’t be able to display much combat power.
After all, in the era of evolution after the disaster, the strength of mortals was stronger than that of machines.
“If that’s the case then the foreign races in the south won’t be able to fly?”Dudian guessed.
“Don’t look around.”The youth who was leading the way shouted: “We are here. Remember what you saw. I will report to the brigade commander.”
Dudian nodded.
The youth went into the tent and came out after a moment. he shouted at dudian: “Go in.”He lifted the curtain of the tent.
Dudian was very cautious. He walked into the tent and saw a woman in uniform standing in front of a sand table. She was frowning. She had blonde hair, delicate cheeks and high eyebrows, she looked a bit heroic.

chapters.title: Chapter 1043
chapters.content:
Chapter 1043 – : Chapter 132: Staff Sergeant Ryan Dudian
“Brigade Commander.”Dudian took the initiative to call out but didn’t show too much respect and humility.
The woman’s eyes moved away from the sand table and looked at Dudian. She saw that Dudian was neither servile nor overbearing. He seemed to be a bit arrogant. She couldn’t help but slightly frown, “I heard that your sentry post was attacked? What’s the situation? Tell me in detail.”
Dudian nodded slightly and told the details of his previous plan. It was so small that he had to observe and speculate the footprints. Moreover, he added some of his own judgment, “The time of the enemy’s attack was half an hour during my shift. In half an hour I killed all of them. At least it was the power of the Abyss. Moreover, it was a fast attack.”
“The enemy did not cover up any traces, which means that they left in a hurry. Of course, it’s also possible that they intentionally left clues in these traces to frame us, or to lead us in the wrong direction.”
A Ray of light flashed in Parina’s indifferent eyes. From the initial indifference to a slightly serious look, she sized up this young man who kept talking. Other than his handsome appearance, the latter’s speaking temperament.., her first impression was that the sentry was very good and excellent!
“I know.”Parleena waited for dudian to finish, “The investigation team will also think of what you said. There is no need to tell me more.”
Dudian was startled for a moment. He bitterly smiled: “I know.”He glanced at the sand table behind her. There was a hill basin. The mountains were high and low. There was a curved river in the middle.., there were two green flags at the top of two of the peaks. According to the rules of the sand table, they were allies.
There were four or five mountains in front of them. There were red and black chess pieces.
Obviously, red represented the enemy while black represented the unknown region.
Parleena frowned as she sensed the change in Dudian’s eyes: “Do you understand?”Her voice was cold with a trace of dissatisfaction. After all, the sand table was the layout of the battlefield in front of them, it wasn’t something that a sentry could touch. If it wasn’t for the good impression that Dudian gave her, she would have asked him to get out.
“A little bit.”Dudian said modestly but didn’t want her to think that he was being modest. He continued: “If it were me, I would choose to attack by water.”
“Water?”Parleena couldn’t help but Snort. Her face turned cold. The good impression that Dudian had given her was destroyed at this moment: “You can go out.”
She turned around and no longer looked at dudian.
Attack by water? This idea was indeed shocking. If it was put forward by a military staff officer, it would arouse her curiosity. But a sentry said such ridiculous words, but she had no interest in it at all. Waterways were equivalent to a dead end here! To pass through the water, one had to kill the monsters in the water. Just this point alone would cause the loss of many soldiers.
Dudian frowned slightly. He didn’t think that this woman’s patience was so bad. In other words, his identity couldn’t make her be patient at all. He could only express his thoughts quickly and briefly, “It seems that a large number of soldiers will be lost in the water attack. Moreover, the attack will attract the attention of the enemy. They will be trapped in the water and beat the dogs. But on the other hand, there are benefits!”
Parleena didn’t expect that Dudian would dare to speak after she had sent him away. She was about to get angry when she heard Dudian’s last words. She couldn’t help but frown. She had to say that Dudian’s previous words were very correct, he had told her about the weakness of the water attack. It was obvious that he didn’t casually put forward the idea. Especially the last words had successfully aroused her curiosity.
“What benefits?”Parleena asked.
Dudian was relieved: “The enemy wouldn’t expect us to attack from the water. I didn’t mean to attack from the water but from the water!”
“Underwater?”Parleena was startled. It was as if something exploded in her mind. She suddenly woke up and looked excited. She had thought of many ideas just from Dudian’s reminder, she felt that this idea was very feasible!
