Dudian looked at Parleena’s flickering face. He didn’t say anything but quietly stood behind her.
Ten minutes later, Parleena seemed to wake up. She came to the sand table and looked at Dudian. Her eyes lit up as she clapped: “Good Idea!”
Dudian took advantage of her joy to remind her of his existence: “Congratulations Brigade Commander!”
Parleena turned to look at Dudian who was neither servile nor overbearing. She felt that the sentry was pleasing to the eyes. She smiled, “Your idea is very good. There is a possibility that it will work. What is your name?”
Dudian was relieved: “My name is Ryan Du.”Ryan was the surname of the Ryan family in Sylvia.
“Ryan Du.”Parleena read it and nodded: “Alright. From now on, you will work with me. How about it?”
Dudian’s face was full of joy: “Thank You Brigade Commander!”
Parleena smiled and suddenly thought of the previous matter: “I will send an investigation team to check the situation. I will make sure that your friends die in peace!”
Dudian’s face was solemn. There was a bit of emotion in his eyes. He clenched his teeth and seriously said: “Thank you, Brigade Commander!”This sentence was extremely heavy as if he had used all his strength.
Parleena was very satisfied with Dudian’s gratitude. She picked up the bell on the table and gently shook it.
A sergeant who was waiting outside the tent came in.
“Take him to change his clothes. Give him a set of sergeant uniform.”Parleena ordered the sergeant, she turned to Dudian: “You don’t have any merit. I can only give you the rank of sergeant. After this battle is over and you win the war, your name will be on the merit list. I will apply to the higher-ups to promote you to my side.”
Dudian was moved: “Thank You Brigade Commander!”This was the third time he had said the same thing but the context was different.
Parleena smiled and waved to the sergeant to take Dudian back.
The sergeant looked at Dudian with a strange expression. He didn’t expect that a sentry would become a sergeant in the blink of an eye. His rank was as high as Dudian’s.
After leaving the tent, Dudian was led by the sergeant to lead the military uniform and register the identity of the sergeant. He knew that he was temporarily rooted in the god of war so he could personally participate in the war, moreover, he wasn’t cannon fodder. He wouldn’t personally participate in the war unless there was a special emergency. It would be convenient for him to observe the trolls.
After all, he had not figured out the situation yet. It was too careless to sneak into the world of trolls.

chapters.title: Chapter 1044
chapters.content:
Chapter 1044 – Chapter 133: Integration
“This is Captain Moss’s camp. This is Captain Handrow’s camp…”the sergeant took Dudian around the camp of the brigade commander, he told Dudian about the residences and territories of the bigwigs so that he wouldn’t accidentally trespass. At the end, the sergeant brought Dudian to a group of tents near the edge of the god of war, “This is the platoon commander’s camp. I will take you to see him. The brigade commander didn’t say which platoon commander you will be assigned to.”
He saw Dudian’s puzzled expression, he explained: “Platoon Commander is the trusted aide of the brigade commander. He is directly under her military power. Although he is only a platoon commander but his status is higher than the other company commanders. Even the eight regimental commanders will be polite to him. So You Shouldn’t act rashly. You should perform well. With your current rank, if you perform well, you will soon become the deputy platoon commander.”
Dudian saw that he was serious: “Thank you for telling me. May I know your name?”
Sergeant laughed: “My name is Len. I’m just trying to please you. Don’t forget your brother when you get promoted.”
“No, no. I’m relying on your good words.”Dudian quickly said.
Dudian and Len entered the encampment surrounded by tents. They saw a few burly figures sitting in the open space. There were two strong men in the middle of the encampment, both of their faces were red. The veins on their foreheads were bulging.
Bang!
One of them couldn’t hold on any longer. The back of his hand was pressed down.
“Haha! Come on! Money!”The winner laughed.
The loser’s face was dark. He was about to ask for money when he saw Dudian and Len. he shouted: “Who are you? What are you doing here?”
The winner turned his head. He seemed to recognize Len. He looked at Dudian who was next to Len. He turned his head and smiled at the loser: “Come On! They have nothing to do with you! Pay Up!”
The corner of the man’s mouth twitched. He reluctantly took out a few gold coins from his pocket and threw them to him.
The Brawny man smiled as he put away the gold coins. He turned around and looked at Len: “Are You looking for platoon leader Fett? Who Is He?”
“He is new. He has been assigned to you.”Len laughed: “He has won money again. It’s My Treat Tonight!”
“Come on. I’m happy with my money. It’s your treat.”The burly man smiled as he looked up and down at dudian: “Hello, my name is Guli. What’s Your Name?”
“Ryan Dudian, please take care of me.”Dudian smiled.
Guli nodded and blinked: “Are you interested in playing?”
Len said in a bad tone: “He just came and you are bullying him. Why Don’t You Play with Captain Fett?”
“Who dares to play with monsters…”gu li whispered and shrugged his shoulders: “I’m just playing with him. How can I bully him? Maybe I can’t beat him.”
“Forget it.”Len couldn’t help but roll his eyes: “Who doesn’t know that your magic marks are strength-based? Why Don’t you compete with him in long jump?”
“It’s okay, I’ll play with him.”Dudian spoke out. Len was kind enough to help him. He didn’t want him to help too much.
“Good, you have guts!”Gu Li laughed and gave dudian a thumbs up, “How about a handful of five gold coins, brother?”
“No problem.”Dudian nodded.
Len saw that Dudian had agreed. He couldn’t persuade him but looked helpless.
The man who had lost earlier also came up. He looked at Dudian’s figure and shook his head: “Unlucky Kid, this stupid Dali is too cheap.”
Dudian’s figure was well-proportioned. His chest had the outline of his chest muscles and abdominal muscles. But compared to Guli who was a muscular man, he looked weak. It was obvious that he wasn’t a strength type magic mark.
“Come!”Gu Li took out five gold coins and put them on the metal table. He stretched out his arm.
Dudian also stretched out his arm and shook hands with him.
The losing man used the iron chains on the table to wrap around their hands and wrists.
“Where are your gold coins?”Gu Li frowned as he saw that Dudian wasn’t going to pay.
Dudian smiled and showed his white teeth: “I will win.”
Gu Li was stunned and laughed out loud.
Len and the burly man were speechless as they didn’t expect Dudian to be so confident.
“Well, you are here anyway. I’m not afraid that you will go back on your word.”Gu Li didn’t insist that Dudian pay them. Five gold coins was just a small amount of money.
“Help me shout ‘start’.”Gucci said.
The burly man clenched their fists and shouted ‘start’.
Bang!
The metal table slightly shook as Gucci’s hand pressed on the table.
Len and Burly Man’s eyes widened.
Gucci was also stunned. He felt like he was in a dream. Why did he fall down before he could exert his strength?
“Thank you.”Dudian smiled as he grabbed the five gold coins in front of Gu Li.
Gu Li quickly said: “No, it doesn’t count…”
“How can it not count?”The man who was watching the fight quickly interrupted him: “If it doesn’t count then my previous one doesn’t count!”
Gu Li was a bit speechless but he knew that he was in the wrong. He was a bit depressed: “Well, I was careless. Let’s have another round.”
“One round is enough.”Len immediately persuaded.
Gu Li hesitated. If he continued to insist it would be a bit too much. He didn’t mean to bully Dudian, he wasn’t stupid enough to offend others for no reason.
“It’s alright. I just want to have fun.”Dudian smiled.
Guli was relieved: “Brother Dean is right. I Won’t be careless this time.”
Dudian smiled.
ARM wrestling began again.
The back of Guli’s hand was pressed against the metal table. He was stunned. His rough face was slightly red and hot. It was difficult for him to speak.
Len and the big man saw the situation and laughed.
“Brother Dean, I’m not ready…”gu li said in embarrassment.
Dudian laughed: “Then come again. But first, give me the money.”
Gu Li was relieved. He took out ten gold coins from his pocket and handed five to Dudian. He put five on the table: “I’ll give you five more if you win.”
“Alright.”Dudian replied.
Gu Li was slightly stifled. He clenched his teeth in his heart. When the burly man was ready to shout ‘begin’again, his palm slightly bulged. He secretly exerted strength. When the word ‘begin’sounded, his arm quickly exerted strength and the muscles on his arm bulged.
He was secretly happy that he finally exerted strength.
Bang!
Gu Li’s heart was filled with joy. The back of his hand suddenly hit the metal table. Gu Li’s mouth slightly opened and his eyes were a bit dull.
“Hahaha…”the man next to him laughed exaggeratedly. He held the metal table with one hand and covered his stomach with the other.
Len was surprised. He looked at Dudian and found that things were not so simple.
Dudian smiled as he put away the five gold coins in front of Gu Li. He pushed the ten gold coins in front of him, “I’m not familiar with this place. Brother Gu Li, if you are free tonight, why don’t you treat me to a meal? I’ll give you the money for the meal.”
Guli came back to his senses. He was embarrassed and confused. However he saw Dudian’s kind gesture and accepted it: “I lost. Brother Dudian’s magic marks should be agile type. It’s too fast!”
Dudian laughed but didn’t deny it. He gave the other a way out.
“Let’s go. I’ll take you to see the platoon leader.”Guli grabbed the gold coin and patted Dudian’s shoulder. His attitude was very friendly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1045
chapters.content:
Chapter 1045 – : Chapter 134: Trolls
Dudian waved goodbye to Len and followed Guli to the largest tent. He saw a slender and gentle youth sitting behind the desk in the tent. He was reading a book, dudian looked up as he heard Guli’s voice. His eyes fell on Dudian who was next to guli.
“Boss, this is the new guy. His name is Ryan Dudian.”Gu Li said.
“Hello, Platoon Leader.”Dudian called out as he looked at the platoon leader. The latter was younger than he had imagined. He was different from the people outside. The other party had a scholarly aura but he didn’t appear weak, it was obvious that he was a person with a restrained killing intent.
Fitter smiled: “We are family here. You Don’t have to be polite.”
“Yes, boss is easy to talk to.”Gu Li smiled.
Fitter glanced at him: “You Lost in arm wrestling but you still have the cheek to take back the money. Your face is getting thicker and thicker.”
Gu Li was stunned: “Boss, you know that. You Can’t blame me. Brother du is an agile type magic mark. I lost before I could react.”
Fitter snorted: “He lost but he still found an excuse. Alright, take him down to change into our platoon’s uniform. Tell him about the rules of our platoon. Don’t bother me if there is nothing else.”
Gu Li smiled and took Dudian away.
“Don’t look at boss like that. He is actually very easy to talk to.”Gu Li explained to fitter as they left the tent.
Dudian smiled: “I know. I can see that he is a good person.”
Gu Li laughed: “Yes. Big Brother is much better than the other platoon leaders. You will know in the future. Let’s go. I will take you to change clothes. Then I will take you to eat a big meal.”
There was a trace of excitement in his eyes.
Dudian frowned as he vaguely smelled what he meant by ‘open meat’. It seemed that there should be military prostitutes here. The lives of these people were miserable. It was very likely that they were refugees from the small giant wall, the slums of the Empire or other places.
“It is not good to open meat as soon as you come. I will treat you next time.”Dudian smiled, “I’m new here so I’m not familiar with this place. Tell me about it. I heard that the giant monsters outside the god of war are very fierce and strange. Do you know where I can see these trolls? Their corpses are also good.”
“You haven’t seen trolls?”Guli was surprised but didn’t ask. Although he looked rough but he wasn’t stupid. He wouldn’t offend the privacy of others, he laughed: “The trolls are strange. They are covered in metal armor. Their eyes can shoot out red light. Moreover their perception is terrifying. They can find you no matter where you are hiding.”
“So Powerful?”Dudian was startled: “Are all trolls like this?”
Guli replied, “Their abilities are similar but there are some differences. For example, some trolls can hold a huge light shield to block attacks. Whether you are a physical attack or energy type, including fire and ice, they will be blocked. Oh right, these trolls are also very terrifying. They are immune to poison!”
“None of the venom can harm them, not even the zombie virus!”
Dudian’s heart beat faster than usual. The zombie virus couldn’t be infected? ! Could it be that the trolls’genes had antibodies against the zombie virus? !
He was so excited that he wanted to rush out of the giant wall to find a troll to dissect for experiments. But his rationality made him restrain his excitement.
“What’s wrong with you?”Gucci looked at him and found that Dudian’s shoulder was slightly trembling.
Dudian came back to his senses, he shook his head and smiled: “Nothing. I just think that this troll is really terrifying. It is immune to all poisons. In that case, we will have to rely on real weapons to fight the trolls.”
“Yes, we can only rely on brute force.”Guley nodded, guley grinned: “But it’s not our turn to fight with trolls. If we encounter trolls then we can only commit suicide. Even if they stand there for us to kill, we can’t hurt them. The metal armor of the trolls is so hard that we can’t communicate with them. We can only rely on the abyss walkers.”
Dudian was curious: “You haven’t fought with the trolls? How Do You Know About This?”
“I haven’t shot a bird. I haven’t seen a bird fly!”Gully shrugged his shoulders: “You have been here for a long time and have participated in several battles. You will understand. But I think you should pray that you don’t understand. Usually when we have the opportunity to see the battle between the Abyss Walker and the trolls the situation on the front line will be very critical. At this time even our gunner group will be affected.”
“Gunner Regiment?”Dudian was stunned.
“Didn’t Len Tell You?”Guli was surprised to see his reaction, “Our platoon belongs to the 9th platoon of the 3rd Company of the Gunner Regiment. Most of the time we operate the cannons to attack from the back. Most of the time we are fighting on the god of War’s wall. Occasionally we will be sent outside the wall but we will attack with cannons.” He suddenly thought of something and looked at dudian: “Do you know how to use artillery?”
“No.”Dudian shook his head. He understood that the reason why Parleena assigned him to this platoon was because she was worried that he would be in the front line.
Last time he was used as cannon fodder in the east of the god of war’s wall but this time he was used as a gunner in the rear. The gap between them was incomparable.
“It seems I have to take you to practice first. Don’t worry. This thing isn’t difficult but it takes a lot of energy.”Guli laughed.
It was the first time that Dudian knew that being a gunner was a labor. He thought about guli and the other soldiers he had seen before. They were rough and robust. It seemed that the cannons here were different from what he thought.
Guli brought Dudian to the military uniform camp. He helped Dudian choose two sets of uniforms. He brought Dudian to familiarize himself with the surrounding environment. Finally, he brought Dudian to the front of the artillery.
Dudian finally understood why the artillery was a manual job. The shape of the artillery was similar to those of the old era but the size was completely different. The base alone was five to six meters tall, the caliber of the cannon on the base was about 50 centimeters. The barrel was seven to eight meters long. There were binoculars behind the barrel as well as a handle to control the angle of the barrel. The whole thing looked rough.
“The general firing is relatively simple as long as you hold it well. But to hit the monsters at a specific location, you need to control the angle. Once the cannon is activated, it can be fired for about ten minutes. The base is full of shells and will be filled automatically. But we need to control the angle. After the cannon is activated, the angle of the twist needs to bear a large recoil force. Look at my hands. They are all made by this thing.”Guli explained to Dudian, he stretched out his hand to show him.
Dudian noticed that his hands were full of calluses and burns. He looked at the place where the barrel was connected to the base and found that it was mobile. The recoil of the barrel was less than the pressure on the base.
“The base is full of ammunition. The barrel is mobile. We have to rely on manpower to offset the recoil…”Dudian found that the designer of the cannon was very smart. He had improved the old era’s artillery to perfectly adapt to this era, relying on a gunner as the base could increase the power of the original cannon by dozens of times. However, the barrel of the cannon could withstand the continuous firing of shells.
“I’ll get a cannon manual for you to read before you practice.”Guli smiled, “Fortunately, we have repelled the troll invasion a few days ago. There shouldn’t be any war in the next few days. There should be enough time for you to practice.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1046
chapters.content:
Chapter 1046 – Chapter 135: Infiltration
That night, Gu Li was ready to take Dudian out to eat and drink. But he was called by fitter to introduce Dudian to everyone. Dudian also got to know the other people in the ninth platoon. There were forty-eight people in total. There were fifty people including the vice platoon leader and platoon leader.
There was no division of classes in the queue. It was not like the boot camp. There was no squad leader. Usually the person in charge was the vice platoon leader Hunter. He had to make a decision to find fitter.
The queue was full of males. Dudian joined the small group after dinner and wine. Guli had drunk too much. He told Dudian the embarrassing story of arm wrestling. He patted Dudian’s shoulder and vaguely said that he admired him. Dudian knew that this rough looking man.., in fact, he knew that he had lost to him not because of his fast hands but because his strength was inferior to his own. He was embarrassed to admit it because of his face.
The others knew that Dudian, who didn’t look like a strength type warrior at all, actually beat Gu Li in arm wrestling. Gu Li could be considered as one of the top ten players in the queue. In terms of pure strength, the number of people who could beat him was not more than five fingers. For a time, Dudian had become a famous person in the queue, strength was respected everywhere, especially in the army.
By the time the dinner was over, many people had withdrawn from the banquet. Some people were drunk and passed out in their tents.
Dudian helped Gu Li to leave and sent him back to his tent. He went outside and found a quiet place. The surrounding lights were dim. The smile on his face gradually disappeared, he looked up at the night scene. The clouds and the Moon were gradually revealed. The dark night sky and the rivers that divided the land.
“Where are you…”Dudian muttered to himself.
After a long time Dudian’s eyes suddenly narrowed. At this time a voice came from behind him: “It’s so late. Why aren’t you going to rest?”The voice was familiar.
Dudian turned his head and saw that fitter was carrying a bottle of wine. He smiled: “Platoon Leader, are you still awake?”
“I can’t sleep.”Fitter smiled. He looked at the direction that Dudian was facing. He sighed: “Are You Homesick?”
Dudian shook his head: “My Home is gone.”
Fitter was startled but didn’t say anything to apologize. He patted Dudian’s shoulder and handed the wine to him: “Come, drink with me. I won’t have any worries if I get drunk.”
“That’s true.”Dudian smiled and took two sips.
“I can drink for two days but I can’t Drink the day after tomorrow because the trolls have just been defeated. They won’t attack for the next few days so I can take a breather.”Fitter laughed.
Dudian took a sip and curiously asked: “Why won’t they attack again?”
“Every time the trolls attack, they will attack at least seven days apart. This rule has been going on for decades.”Fitter laughed.
Dudian frowned: “But is there any risk? If they attack again and again we will be caught off guard.”
“You think too much.”Fitter took the wine from Dudian’s hand and drank two sips, dudian wiped his mouth: “There is a movement in front of us. If the trolls attack, we will know about it a day in advance. So there is almost no situation where the trolls attack. Even if the trolls avoid the attack of the relief camp, we will be able to react in time. Even if we are drunk, we are not afraid. The military medical camp has given us a lot of sobering medicine. Once the battle starts, the drunk will be able to wake up and wake up!”
Dudian understood that he was worrying too much. The God of war’s wall had been standing for hundreds of years. The defense here was like an iron wall.
“Tomorrow I will ask someone to take you to familiarize with the artillery. Try to master it as soon as possible before the next war.”Fett patted Dudian’s shoulder.
Dudian nodded: “Thank you platoon leader.”
“If you don’t understand anything, you can look for Hunter or you can look for me directly.”Fett smiled and handed the bottle to Dudian. He turned around and waved his hand.
Dudian looked at the bottle in his hand. He felt that his throat was slightly warm but he wasn’t drunk. He couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. It was very difficult for him to get drunk with his current physique, his body’s excretion of alcohol was too fast. Moreover, it was out of control.
“Maybe I am drunk. Maybe they are drunk.”Dudian whispered. He looked into the distance and suddenly threw the bottle away. It seemed that he wanted to throw away all the depression in his heart. However, the bottle that he threw out was only the bottle, the bottle without wine.
The next day.
Dudian and fitter called the veterans to learn the operation of artillery. In the evening, Guli found an opportunity to take Dudian to eat and compensate him.
The two went to the largest and only food street of the Artillery Group. Dudian found that the food street was similar to the food street in the city. It was full of food stalls and taverns, there were many signs in the food street. There was a common flag. Guli knew that behind the flag was an Earl of the empire.
The Earl in the empire was on a completely different level from the earl in the giant wall. It could be said that the aristocrats in the empire were the real aristocrats. Most of the aristocrats in the giant wall were the descendants of the ancestors of the giant wall, there was no difference between a self-proclaimed title and a civilian in the empire.
“The business of the aristocrats is on the god of war’s wall…”Dudian looked at the food street. He felt that the empire’s mucus was scattered all over the ground.
After dinner, Guli wanted to take Dudian to the sensual service pub to relieve his boredom. Dudian refused. Dudian didn’t need a lot of women. Moreover, he had people who were worth his life.
Guli seemed to be thirsty. He could only tell Dudian the way back and hurriedly ran away.
Dudian took the opportunity to leave the food street. He used his x-ray vision to scan the surroundings. He looked at the artillery regiment and other places. Through his X-ray vision he found that the strength of the artillery regiment was beyond his imagination. There were seven abysses in the military camps near the food street, this was not the full strength of the artillery battalion.
“It seems that all the strong ones have been sent to the border defense. Aristotle has been in the Empire for ten years. Could it be that he is going to serve in the border defense?”Dudian thought.
He was more careful to conceal his aura and body. He didn’t dare to approach the abyss. If the other side had the ability to see through his body then they would be able to see through his body. Obviously, in such a large battlefield the perceptor would have the ability to see through his body. However, it was another matter if the other side would use the ability to see through his body. He could only pray that he wouldn’t be so unlucky, he had to keep a low profile as much as possible.
However, this was not a long-term solution. He still had to find out the situation of the trolls as soon as possible and leave this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 1047
chapters.content:
Chapter 1047 – Chapter 136Th: Go To War
In the blink of an eye, Dudian had stayed on the god of war wall for three days. On the morning of the fourth day, Fett suddenly summoned everyone. He said that the front line had sent a task and their artillery regiment needed to rush to the front line to fight.
Dudian and the others had only one hour to prepare. They had to arrive at the front line at noon.
“Little Dean, how is Your Artillery Training?”The vice platoon leader Hunter found Dudian. He looked like he was in his forties. There were two cross scars on his thick and hairy arms.
“I have completely mastered it.”Dudian quickly said.
Hunter saw that Dudian was so active. He shook his head and smiled, “I wanted to give you an excuse to rest. Since you have mastered it, you should go and prepare. This is your first battle. Moreover, you are going to the front line. You should follow the others and retreat. Be Smart. In addition, don’t care about the artillery when you retreat. If you lose it, you will lose it. Life is the most important thing!”
Dudian nodded: “Thank You Vice Platoon Leader!”
He suddenly found that the people he met this time were pretty good.
In less than half an hour, everyone had gathered in the small field inside the tent. Hunter and fitter took the lead and left the platoon. They walked in the direction of the outside of the god of war wall along the wide road in the middle of the tent area, when they reached the end of the line, they saw the scenery outside of the wall. However, it wasn’t the mountains and rivers that they had imagined. Instead, it was a devastated and potholed land.
Dudian looked at the wall but didn’t see the fortress wall outside the wall. It seemed that the enemies on each side of the wall were different, this was probably the reason why he didn’t see so many high-end technology and spacecraft on the wall.
“Report to the 9th row of the 3rd Company of the Artillery Regiment!”Fett shouted.
The young man who was wearing military uniform and had a gold star on his shoulder looked at him. He looked at the short-haired female assistant: “Register them on the ship.”
“Yes.”The short-haired woman nodded and went to Fett to register.
Under Fett’s lead, everyone boarded the next airship. Each airship carried five people. There were six pilots in total. While Dudian and the others were waiting in line to register, Fett and the other four had already boarded the airship and left. Soon the second airship followed them. In the blink of an eye it was Dudian. He stood with Guli, they boarded the same airship.
The airship was connected in a line as it sailed out of the god of war wall. Clouds and mist lingered around. Their line of sight passed through the devastated land. At the end of the world, they could faintly see the darkness.
Everyone felt depressed because of the darkness. No one spoke on the airship. Even Gully who was a bit talkative was silent. He told Dudian a few words but didn’t say anything.
Half an hour later, the airship slowly landed.
Dudian quietly estimated the distance and the speed of the airship. He found that the battlefield in front of him was at least two hundred miles away from the god of war’s wall. Although this distance was nothing to him but it wasn’t close on land, it could be seen that the war in the south wasn’t limited to the god of war’s wall but had been developed outside the wall. This also meant that the Empire’s defense in the south was in a state of suppression.
The airship slowly landed as Dudian thought about this. Guli sighed: “I hope everyone can survive this time.”They were thinking about whether they would die in this war.
“We will see the trolls soon.”Dudian was looking forward to it.
The place where the airship landed was a trench. The ground was full of trenches and there were anti-aircraft turrets. There was a 50-meter high stone wall in front of them. There were many monsters flashing outside the stone wall, however, it was difficult to get close to them under the heavy bombardment.
They got off the airship.
Fitter had been waiting in front of a trench. The people who got off the airship had lined up in formation. Dudian, Gully and others quickly rushed over and stood behind the team. Fitter spoke as the last group of people came from the airship, he loudly said: “We have received news that the trolls are likely to attack in an hour. The front line soldiers sent by the trolls are pretending to attack to test our defense. In the next hour, everyone must adjust their status and hold their positions. They are not allowed to leave without the order to retreat. Otherwise, they will be punished according to military rules!”
“Yes!”Everyone shouted in unison.
Fett nodded slightly and asked Hunter to lead his men to their respective positions. There were already cannons set up next to the trench. There were huge steel wheels under the base of the cannons which could be pushed. But at the moment the wheels had been lifted and braced, they were firmly fixed on the ground.
Two people each had a cannon and took turns to operate it.
Dudian and a familiar person were assigned to a cannon. The person seemed to know that Dudian didn’t know him. He stood on the base of the cannon and smiled: “Hello, Ryan Dui? My name is Delai.”
“Hello.”Dudian nodded: “Please take care of me.”
“Don’t say that. I’m also a rookie.”Delai smiled as he looked at the stone wall in front of him, “These monsters can break through the defense of the front line and attack our artillery battalion. It seems the invasion of the trolls is not small.”
Dudian was surprised: “Aren’t we at the front line?”
“Of course not. Our Artillery Battalion is in the middle and later part of the battlefield. There is an army fortress in front of us. These monsters must have gone around the army fortress and sneaked over to this side. Otherwise, the situation at the Army Fortress is dangerous.”Delai frowned.
Dudian was puzzled as he didn’t know how the battlefield was divided. But he guessed that there might be a special retreat channel for the army. Otherwise, it would be impossible for them to be so far away from the artillery battalion, otherwise, they wouldn’t be able to resist the retreat of the monsters. The artillery battalion could only watch as the army and the monsters fought together. They couldn’t attack.
“Trolls…”Dudian looked at the front. He couldn’t see anything except for the occasional monsters that jumped up high. It seemed that his vision on the ground was gradually blurred.
An hour passed by. There was a roar in front of the stone wall. Everyone was shocked as the pores on their bodies shrank. They entered a tense fighting state, looking through the telescope on the cannon, they saw a few vigorous red dots appear behind the stone wall. As these red dots slowly approached, more and more red dots appeared. They were densely packed, and in just a few breaths.., they occupied the entire telescope!
This telescope had an infrared function. It could penetrate the fog outside the stone wall. All it needed to do was to aim and shoot according to the red dots.

chapters.title: Chapter 1048
chapters.content:
Chapter 1048 – : Chapter 137: Troll God Cannon
Woo! !
The melodious sound of a bugle horn came from the turret behind the stone wall. The bugle horn was made of the horns of a monster. The sound was simple and powerful, and it could stimulate one’s fighting spirit. The stone wall was placed in front of the battlefield, and it was infinitely long. There was a turret every dozens of meters. At this moment, the bugle horns on all the turrets sounded at the same time, like the howls of a sleeping ancient giant beast. The sound was so powerful that it resounded throughout the entire battlefield.
The sound waves of the bugles made many soldiers feel numb. Their blood was boiling and their fighting spirit was surging. Dudian felt that only the ancient bugles were playing. He couldn’t hear anything else. The killing intent in his body was gradually awakened. It was easy to be emotional in such a battlefield. He took a deep breath, he quickly calmed down but heard a roar coming from the side.
He turned his head and saw that Delai was clenching his fist. His face was nervous and excited. His eyes were full of ferocious killing intent. He clenched his teeth and looked forward. It seemed that he had forgotten everything.
Hundreds of years of border war had refined the war. The opening of the war had boosted the morale of the soldiers.
The horn gradually stopped and the drums sounded. It was the drumbeat of the attack.
“Let’s begin!”De Lai didn’t forget to say something to Dudian. He grabbed the artillery and rotated the wheel. He aimed at Dudian: “I’ll go first. I’ll change you when my hand is sore!”
“Alright.”Dudian nodded. He stepped back to give up his position.
Boom Boom Boom!
There was a sudden explosion accompanied by the drumbeat. It seemed that the entire world was shocked. Hundreds of artillery were fired at the same time. The sound of the artillery echoed and shot into the stone wall, it would accurately hit the target.
In an instant, the earth-shattering explosion echoed outside the stone wall. Dudian felt that the base of the artillery was shaking even though he was thousands of meters away. There was still such a strong aftershock from the earth, it was clear how terrifying the power of the artillery was.
However, Dudian wasn’t thinking about the damage that the artillery had caused to the monsters. He was thinking about the devastation that he had seen from the high altitude. No matter what kind of battle it was, it seemed that the planet would suffer the most damage.
“After a few years, even if human regains the ruling position of the Earth, Will the Earth be able to return to the past…”this thought flashed through Dudian’s mind. His heart was slightly sad but soon.., the ear-piercing sound of the artillery pulled his thoughts back to reality. He forgot about the previous feelings. The reality in front of him always made people forget about illusions.
“These monsters are all pioneer and master level…”golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes. He looked through the stone wall and saw the scene outside. Countless monsters were rushing over, however they were killed by the concentrated firepower of the cannon. Under the suppression of the firepower, these monsters couldn’t get close to the stone wall. The power of the cannon was much greater than he had imagined. Moreover, it was destructive in range, it seemed to also contain a lethal poison.
He saw some shells explode, shooting out countless shrapnel and scattering in all directions, causing secondary damage. In addition, the dust that exploded was dense and did not disperse. Many monsters surged into the thick fog, and their bodies obviously slowed down. Moreover, the wounds on their bodies rapidly rotted. Any place with blood touching the dust fog would quickly fester and Ooze.
The effect of chemistry at this moment was far more terrible than that of the abyss.
There were many kinds of monsters. It seemed that they were not afraid of death. However, there were also some monsters who were scared out of their wits by the bombardment of the shells. However, the monsters behind them were like bulldozers, some of them ran slowly. Some were knocked over and trampled by the monsters behind them. Some were killed on the spot by the continuous bombardment.
Dudian frowned as he didn’t see the monster’s figure.
“My hands are sore!”De Lai shouted. His previous fighting spirit was drowned by fatigue. He turned to dudian and said: “Come and pick me up.”
Dudian nodded. He rotated the wheel and aimed at the place with the most number of monsters.
As the shell shot out, the strong recoil pushed the barrel towards Dudian. Dudian held onto it with both hands. He used dark force to remove the impact.
At this time, a group of dense red dots flew over from the high sky.
The drum on the turret quickly changed. Dudian remembered the command that the drum represented. The change in the drum was directed by the elite group of the Artillery Group. They were to adjust the barrel and attack the sky.
A group of black clouds swept over from the sky. Dudian carefully looked at them. They were all skeleton-like magic birds. Their mouths were extremely large and sharp. There was a rotten smell on their bodies.
The row of barrels in front of the stone wall quickly raised and turned high into the sky. Suddenly there was a roar. The cannons fired in unison. They drew a red arc as they shot towards the black clouds. The black clouds were scattered, countless skeleton birds screeched and flew in all directions.
Dudian frowned as he felt that these cannons might not be able to withstand the attack. He began to think of a way out but his hands didn’t stop as he continued to fire.
Woo!
At this time, a horn sounded from above. A medium-sized spaceship rose into the sky in the blink of an eye. The spaceship was not equipped with many weapons and there were not many crew members, however, there was a huge horn on the spaceship.
The spaceship slowly stopped when it reached the stone wall.
The next moment, Dudian and everyone on the battlefield heard a deep and simple hum. The sound wave spread out from the spaceship and spread to the high sky outside the stone wall.
The skeleton birds that flew in all directions were like frightened birds. They turned and fled in panic. Some fled far away while others fell down.
Dudian was slightly startled. He didn’t expect that the skeleton birds would be afraid of the sound wave attack. He suddenly realized that the empire had been fighting with the foreign races for many years so they were familiar with the monsters outside the border, he would be able to find the weakness by capturing a few prisoners of war.
He thought of the trolls. Perhaps the empire had already grasped the weakness of the trolls. He couldn’t even imagine the situation of the entire foreign races.
At this time, a beam of light suddenly appeared and pierced through the spaceship above the stone wall.
The beam of light was more than ten meters in diameter. It came from a very far distance. Dudian’s perspective couldn’t see the end of it. At this moment the beam of light flashed and pierced through the spaceship. The sound of horn disappeared and the spaceship exploded, it swayed and fell down from the sky.
The elite group of artillery under the spaceship retreated in a hurry. However the artillery that was left on the spot was hit by the spaceship.
Dudian looked at it in a daze. He felt that his skin was trembling and his heart was pounding. He was too familiar with the beam of light. It was a laser! The alien giant could use a laser!
If the laser was aimed at him… maybe he wouldn’t even have time to react before he was killed!
The laser was more than ten meters wide and his entire body would be turned into ashes and disappear!
The sudden sense of danger made him want to leave the battlefield immediately. It was rare for a small laser cannon to be able to release such a large amount of energy!
Dudian turned his head and was about to say that his hand was sore. He saw that Delai was staring at the explosion of the spaceship. It seemed that he didn’t expect the sudden situation. He coughed and interrupted Delai’s daydream, “My Hand is tired.”
Delai was stunned for a moment. He quickly stepped forward to take over. Cold Sweat was oozing out of his forehead.
Dudian saw that Delai was also afraid. He asked: “Haven’t you seen this situation before?”
Delai shook his head: “Yes, I have seen it. But the troll cannons are used here. Are they really going to attack? I hope it isn’t true…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1049
chapters.content:
Chapter 1049 – : Chapter 138: Mecha
Dudian felt that his words were a bit strange. What did he mean by attacking? Was the Troll Invasion just an Act? In any case, this defensive battle seemed unusual. He extended his perception to the surroundings and was ready to retreat at any time.
At the same time, a dense drumbeat sounded. At the same time, the horn howled. It was a signal for the entire army to retreat.
Dudian quickly pulled Radley, “Run!”
Radley felt that his body was suddenly out of control. By the time he reacted, Dudian had dragged him under the artillery. He didn’t have time to think. He looked up in a hurry, he was relieved to see that the other people on the artillery were also quickly retreating. He turned around and ran after Dudian.
Boom!
Both of them ran for a few steps. Suddenly there was a violent explosion behind them. The strong impact shook the ground. Both of them turned around and saw that the stone wall was broken. There was a huge hole in the wall. The edge of the wall was charred black as if something was burning through it.
Roar!
Ferocious monsters rushed out from the hole. There were centipedes that were thirty meters long, monsters that were half snake and half dog, monsters that were covered in mud and mucus… there were countless strange monsters that made the hole bigger and bigger. There was no suppression from the cannons, the monsters quickly approached from outside the wall. Soon, there were monsters climbing in from the top of the wall. They opened their bloody mouths and let out ear-piercing roars.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He looked back and saw that there were no signs of reinforcements coming from the wall. His heart sank. He frowned. He felt that something was strange but he couldn’t tell what it was.
“Run!”At this time, Guli, fitter and the others also ran over. They quickly caught up with Dudian and Delai.
Delai was sweating as he ran. However his speed had only increased by a bit. He was still much slower than guli and fitter. Dudian didn’t care about jogging with him. He sped up and caught up with fitter.
In the blink of an eye, they arrived at the back of the battlefield where the airship was docked. Dudian and fitter quickly got into the same airship. Fitter shouted at the frightened pilot: “Take Off!”
The pilot was startled: “The people aren’t full…”
“Bastard! Hurry up! They are coming!”Fitter roared as he punched the back of the chair.
Dudian suddenly realized that he didn’t recognize the platoon leader. He was far from the previous gentle and refined image. His heart sank, “Platoon leader, has this happened before? Isn’t our artillery group behind the battlefield? Did the trolls attack?”
Fett looked at him as his anger subsided, dudian clenched his teeth: “I don’t know. There must be a mistake. I don’t believe that those bastards from the Intelligence Department don’t know the situation in front of us. They are telling us to retreat now. Damn it!”
Roar!
At this time, a roar came from the distance. Dudian’s pupils shrank as he saw a row of black beasts that were more than ten meters tall. They had broken through the stone wall and pushed it over.
The bodies of these giant beasts were strange. They were in an upright shape. Their bodies were covered with sharp blades and barrels. At first glance, they looked like giant beasts!
The head of the giant beast was in the shape of a giant lizard’s head. However, it reflected a metallic luster. At first glance, it looked like a machine. Its long red eyes were like two diamond-shaped rubies.
This wasn’t a monster but a machine!
After the shock, a golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes. His X-ray vision penetrated through the body of the giant beast. The scene made him stunned again. The internal structure of these giant beasts was indeed made of mechanical parts. However, in the chest of the giant beast.., there was a human’s hand, foot, neck, forehead and other parts that were inserted into the tube. It was as if their bodies were connected to the giant beast.
“Mecha… Human…”Dudian was stunned as he was unable to react.
Dudian saw the blood red eyes of a giant beast shoot out a red light which detonated a cannon nearby. He couldn’t help but grab fitter and ask: “Are these trolls? !”
Fitter’s body swayed as Dudian grabbed him. He was shocked as he looked at Dudian’s anxious eyes. He instinctively replied: “Yes, these are the Trolls!”
Dudian’s mind went blank. It took him two seconds to recover but his mood was difficult to describe. He had always thought that trolls were the same as the East Fire Dragon. It was possible that there was a human empire that was not inferior to the Shenluo Empire and the trolls were the warriors of the empire. He even thought that the magic marks in the body of the trolls might be different from the polar ice worm and the blazing soul worm. After he got it, he might be able to research something to help him improve his strength.
However, at this moment he found out that the trolls were actually mechs!
The airship had already started. The starting steps were a bit shaky and Dudian’s thoughts were shaken back.
He looked at the destruction of the giant monster. His expression was complicated but soon he thought of a problem. Although the giant monster was a mech but the person inside the mech was an alien race. In other words.., there might be a super empire outside the south wall! Moreover the technological level of the empire was very high. It was good at technology and machinery! Moreover, the Empire didn’t use magic marks to evolve humans to cultivate warriors!
As a person from the old era, Dudian was in favor of science. The power of science had been engraved into his bones. A small amount of chemicals could easily poison a hunter or even a pioneer, this was the charm of science.
In general, even the existence of the Seven Kings wouldn’t be able to withstand the impact of nuclear weapons.
The high temperature of the explosion was enough to melt everything.
“Maybe I can find a way to save the undeads here…”Dudian’s mind was filled with such thoughts.
“Wait for us!”
“Come!”
“Take off! Damn it! I’ll let you take off!”
At this time, there were roars and roars coming from the surroundings. Dudian heard a few familiar voices from the ninth row. He looked down and saw a few ninth row warriors who had chatted with each other during dinner, at this time the other airships were ready to take off. The pilots of these airships were aware of the danger of death when they saw the trolls. They couldn’t wait in accordance with the military regulations. Some airships took off and some flew into the air, the soldiers who were chasing jumped onto the underside of the airships. They grabbed onto the support and almost fell down.
“Platoon leader, Save Us!”Someone in the crowd shouted as he saw fitter.
Fitter’s face was ugly. He clenched his teeth but didn’t say anything.
Dudian looked at him but didn’t say anything. Although he thought that fitter and gully were good people but who would risk their lives in a life and death situation? The usual warm help was completely different from the help in a life and death situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1050
chapters.content:
Chapter 1050 – Chapter 139: Capture Alive
Roar!
At this time, a broken black cannon barrel rolled down from the bottom.
“Not good!”Dudian shouted in order to warn the pilot.
The pilot was stunned for a moment. Before he could react, the cannon barrel had hit the support of the airship from the bottom. The huge force instantly flattened the support and penetrated into the airship!
Dudian reacted in advance and hid to the side. The barrel was hit but the other warrior who was sitting next to fitter didn’t react. His legs were broken and his body was distorted, his internal organs were all broken. It seemed that he wouldn’t be able to live.
The airship broke into two halves and fell from the sky.
Dudian’s eyes swept around and saw an airship slowly rising. He immediately stamped his feet and jumped towards the airship. The strength was just right and he grabbed the landing support of the airship.
The airship slightly shook and the people on top of it cried out in alarm. They saw that Dudian was holding onto the airship. They were anxious and angry but they were too embarrassed to chase it down. They could only pray that the airship wasn’t overloaded, dudian pulled the airship down.
The other end of the broken airship fell to the ground. He rolled out from the broken iron pieces. His face was pale as he followed the other warriors who didn’t have time to ride the airship. At the moment the monsters were approaching, even if they took the airship they wouldn’t be able to take off in time. They could only rely on their legs.
“Are these the soldiers of the border defense…”Dudian frowned as he looked at the soldiers who were fleeing. He was disappointed but also puzzled, the border defense was able to predict the invasion of the trolls so accurately. The detection system was strong and the war was delicate to the point of subtlety. Why were they so weak now? These soldiers had no blood in them. How were they different from the ordinary pioneers in the giant wall?
It felt like an exquisite feast. The main dish was rotten. The so-called war was ultimately a battle between people. But other than being able to operate cannons, the soldiers didn’t see the unity, blood, and killing intent that a soldier should have!
Suddenly, Dudian thought of himself. After a short training, he was sent to the battlefield and became a soldier.
What did this mean?
The Empire was short of people!
The border defense was short of people!
Every year there was a war. Every time a war broke out, more or less there would be casualties. It would take a lot of resources to train a pioneer level expert. It was acceptable for the weaker giant wall. But if it was an expert from the inner wilderness.., or even a ruler, it would require a lot of resources to nurture. However, such experts were countless in the border defense. Every war would result in a large number of deaths!
Even with the Empire’s foundation, it would be difficult to maintain such a consumption!
Therefore, although there were many soldiers at the border defense, they were not proficient. There might only be a very small number of elite soldiers who had received strict training. After all, to train a qualified soldier with strong willpower, as well as such an army.., it would take more than one or two years. It might take three to five years to get used to each other. But such a soldier would be exhausted in a war!
Therefore, such an elite army was very few in number!
Although ordinary soldiers like fitter were veterans but strictly speaking, they were just miscellaneous soldiers.
“The alien race controlled the monsters to attack and put a small number of their own people to control the direction. The Empire has the god of war wall but they can’t drive the monsters over. They can only rely on human soldiers to resist. It’s not worth it.”Dudian thought.
The airship was slowly rising higher and higher. The battlefield on the ground was shrinking. The huge cannons looked as small as a palm. The ten meter tall trolls were like small people, the soldiers of the companies were fleeing on the ground like ants.
All the soldiers on the airship were watching in silence. Although they had the heart to help but the fear of death made them more rational. They chose a more advantageous way to survive. But seeing their compatriots being slaughtered, eaten and chewed by the monsters, they couldn’t help but feel sad. This kind of emotion was not hypocritical but human nature was stimulated by vision.
Dudian looked down and saw that a toad-like monster was chasing after him. The monster’s poisonous tongue shot out as fast as lightning. It landed on Fitter’s body and sucked him into its mouth.
He had thought that if they were in danger then he would try his best to help them. But now he could only watch them die. At this moment he would attract the attention of the trolls, he didn’t know if the army’s intelligence system had covered the battlefield. If it had covered the battlefield then he would be exposed.
“The intelligence is wrong. Why isn’t the reinforcements here? Why is the intelligence so slow?”Dudian frowned, he looked at the trolls that were pushing towards him. Suddenly a giant net shot out from the hand of one of the trolls. It caught the three soldiers who were fleeing in front of it, the line behind them was quickly pulled back. The net tightened and pulled the three back to the front of the trolls.
The three of them were like tigers, crocodiles, birds and wolves. They used sharp teeth and claws to attack the giant net but they couldn’t break it.
The trolls didn’t move forward but turned around and retreated along the original trajectory.
“Catch them alive?”Dudian was startled. He saw that the other trolls rushed in front of the fleeing soldiers. They also shot out large nets to cover the soldiers and bring them back.
Dudian suddenly realized that there was a more terrible problem, “These trolls are capturing the soldiers of the empire. They must want to bring them back for Research!”! The alien race wanted to analyze the flaws and secrets of the Empire. The empire had been fighting with the trolls for so many years. How could they not know the secrets of the trolls? Fisnia had said that he had seen the corpses of the trolls in the Imperial City!”
“The alien race must have been opened up by the Empire! The Empire has long known that the trolls are just a mech. The humans inside are the same race as us. They are all human!”
“But the Empire hid the news, and no one ever mentioned that the trolls were controlled by humans, and they had always been known as the troll alien race, standing side by side with the fire dragon alien race in the east. It seems that the troll alien race wants to annex the Empire, and the Empire wants to annex the troll alien race as well!”
“It’s very likely that the Empire has already sent people to infiltrate the troll alien race, and it’s even possible that the troll alien race has sent spies to infiltrate the Empire.”
Both sides were human. It was too easy to infiltrate each other.
Dudian felt that the relationship between the empire and the trolls was complicated. It was difficult to see the position of a small soldier unless he was one of the Seven Kings, he could see the relationship from the top of the Empire’s military.
“I want to learn the technology of trolls. Maybe I can join the empire. They are human anyway…”Dudian’s eyes lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1051
chapters.content:
Chapter 1051 – Chapter 140: Pursue And Kill
Dudian pondered for a moment. He thought of other factors and finally made a decision. He let go of his hand. It seemed that his grip was unstable. He screamed as he fell down.
Dudian didn’t look at the trolls but at the direction of the god of war. He didn’t see any reinforcement from the spaceship or the abyss!
“The trolls have appeared here in large numbers. They have used the giant cannon to bombard the ship. The reinforcements haven’t arrived yet. The trolls have captured the soldiers. It is too obvious. Some people in the giant wall have deliberately sold these people to the trolls. Are they fearless or do they have other reasons?”Dudian retracted his eyes, he ran after the soldiers but he couldn’t run fast.
The giant wall and trolls were enemies. They were old enemies so they knew each other the best. Dudian didn’t know how the giant wall fought but it had been a long time since they had reinforcements and the trolls had captured the soldiers alive, it was undoubtedly the best evidence. There were traitors in the giant wall. They had deliberately designed this battle so that the giant wall could provide empire soldiers as their experimental subjects!
“Such means may have appeared in the alien races. They have infiltrated each other and understood each other.”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he looked at the soldiers who were getting further and further away from him, he shouted for help but no one paid attention to him. He turned his head and saw a seven or eight meter tall wolf jumping from behind. It was biting him with its stinking teeth.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he raised his hand to defend. However his palm was petrified. At the same time his fingers turned into sharp blades and cut off the wolf’s tusks. He used his fingers to cut the wolf’s head.
The wolf’s body hit Dudian and pushed him back more than ten meters.
After a while, Dudian climbed out from under the wolf’s body. A troll came close and saw Dudian. The Lizard’s eyes suddenly shot out two lasers!
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he saw the eyes of the troll turn red. He felt the danger. His body was petrified and his arms were in front of his head. He felt the burning pain coming from his arms, he looked down and saw two small holes on his petrified arm!
“Why did you kill me? Why didn’t you capture me alive?”Dudian’s face slightly changed. Did he expose his strength by killing the Monster Wolf? But he had done enough to conceal his strength. Suddenly, Dudian thought of the reason. The trolls were mechs with complete equipment. Naturally, there was no lack of sensing equipment. Moreover, the sensing equipment was likely to be a combination of smell and hearing, the vision and other aspects of the sensing equipment were well developed. It was very likely that the top-notch sensing equipment of the empire was used as reference. Therefore, the people in the trolls knew that he was extraordinary.
Fortunately, his petrification ability was enough to withstand the laser beam of the trolls. The power of the laser was far from that of the trolls!
“I heard that trolls are comparable to the power of the abyss. But my strength is not limited to the power of the Abyss!”Dudian’s eyes flashed but he didn’t use his full strength. Instead, he used his magic marks to petrify his body, he fled to the side of the battlefield. The speed and strength of the initial Abyss had burst out. The blood and heat in his body had been released to a certain extent. It seemed that he had used his full strength.
Dudian wasn’t sure how sensitive the equipment of the troll was. He could only try to fool it?
The troll saw that Dudian was about to run away. Iron Wheels rolled out from under its legs and rolled over the corpses of the soldiers. Its huge weight directly crushed the corpses, the sound of bones breaking was heard.
At the same time, the troll’s eyes were shooting lasers. It seemed that it had locked onto Dudian. Every laser hit him.
Dudian’s body was petrified. The laser hit his back and the back of his head. He roared as he grabbed the stone slab. The stone slab vibrated as if its density had shrunk, the laser hit the slate and penetrated the slate. It lost its power and hit Dudian’s body.
Dudian was relieved. He didn’t think that he would be able to use his ability on external things. Sure enough, fighting was the fastest way to improve his strength.
The troll saw that the ray couldn’t do anything to Dudian. It angrily chased after him. There was an ear-piercing sound coming from the top of its head. It was the siren of the old era! If people didn’t know that the troll was a mech and didn’t have the concept of a mech, they would have mistaken the siren for the roar of the troll. The roar was so strange that it was shocking.
Dudian found that the two trolls were chasing after him when the siren sounded. He knew that the siren was a signal. But he didn’t expect to hear such a familiar sound after so many years. He missed it, he felt that it was a bit funny.
Dudian ran along the side of the battlefield. He quickly withdrew from the main position of the Artillery Group. The three trolls were still following him, dudian used his ability to compress the super stone slab into powder. He grabbed the giant tree along the way. He uprooted it and activated his ability. The giant tree was also petrified. Its thickness was shocking and the rays were easily blocked.
However the weight of the petrified giant tree had increased. Its size was huge and it swept all the other trees along the way. Dudian was struggling to hold it.
“This ability can actually change things. I don’t know the reason. Unfortunately I only know how to use it but I don’t know the reason…”Dudian thought in his heart. His ability was released by instinct and not like other magic marks warriors, there were illustrations and references. The same magic marks had taught him the characteristics of the ability so he knew how to use it.
The three trolls saw that the radiation couldn’t do anything to Dudian. The armor on his chest, arms, shoulders, abdomen and other parts of his body was turned over. There was a black barrel coming out from the inside. His wrist was thick and strong, countless shells flew towards Dudian.
Dudian’s heart jumped as he saw the situation from Splitter’s point of view. He didn’t know if he could withstand the petrification.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The shells bombarded the stone tree. Dudian could smell the strong smell of sulfur and the pungent smell. He knew that the shells were mixed with poison!
He looked at the stone trees behind him. The trees were damaged but not damaged. He was relieved as he was surprised at his petrification ability. The turtle shell was indeed a defensive magic mark!
“DAMN! It’s too hard!”The three trolls didn’t expect that they wouldn’t be able to kill Dudian. They clenched their teeth in anger, it was the first time that they had encountered such a tough defense. If it wasn’t for the fact that Dudian’s speed wasn’t fast and his body’s heat reaction wasn’t strong, the life index of the troll was only at the level of the inferior abyss, they would think that he was a middle or even superior abyss expert!
“His defense magic marks are estimated to be at the top level. Prepare to use the magic knife!”The youth in the middle of the troll spoke. His voice was transmitted to the two next to him through the communication device, “If we can capture him, he will definitely be a good source of material. If we can analyze the structure of his magic marks and apply it to our giant demon mecha, we will definitely be able to make a great contribution!”
The eyes of the Warriors in the two giant demon mecha on the left and right lit up when they heard this. An abyss with top-level defensive magic marks like this was most likely an important mission for the empire. Capturing him would not only be able to analyze the magic marks, but it would also be able to extract a lot of information, it was definitely beyond imagination!
The three of them worked harder as they thought of this. Their fingers were as fast as phantoms as they operated on the virtual keyboard of the mech.
“Although the quality of the turtle shell is average, but my physical quality is too high. I have pushed the magic marks to the extreme. The effect is really good. If it was a top defense magic mark, I think they wouldn’t be able to kill me even if I used it.”Dudian thought as he ran, at this time, he suddenly saw the three mechs behind him put away the gun barrel. Each of the Mechs had a giant knife that was flashing with electric current!

chapters.title: Chapter 1052
chapters.content:
Chapter 1052 – Chapter 141: The Same Race
“Electric energy, light energy…”Dudian’s eyes lit up as he looked at the complex elements on the giant sword. His eyelids twitched as he felt a trace of danger. He looked at the back of the giant sword, he had left the main battlefield of the artillery group but he could still see the stone walls and the roars of beasts. He took a deep breath and rushed forward.
“He increased his speed again!”
“How is it possible? wasn’t his speed the limit?”
“His magic marks are defensive. How could he have such a high speed?”
The three people inside the giant were stunned. They didn’t think that Dudian could increase his speed. But in an instant, they reacted and pushed the booster forward to the maximum gear. The giant shook slightly, the sound of wind could be heard from behind. The giant body was almost off the ground as it rushed towards Dudian.
“He shouldn’t be able to hold on for long. We must kill him!”The youth in the middle of the giant mech gritted his teeth.
The other two looked serious as they activated the booster of the Giant Mech.
This speed was comparable to the limit of an agile inferior abyss Walker!
Dudian was relieved as he sensed that the troll was increasing its speed. He continued to run forward for a while but gradually slowed down as if he was tired.
The three of them were overjoyed as they saw the situation. They were ready to catch up but they saw Dudian Roar and increase his speed again.
However this time he didn’t persist for long and gradually weakened.
However, when the three of them were about to close in on Dudian, he roared again. His body once again increased the speed and threw away the distance.
After repeating this for four times, the three of them felt angry and impatient. They didn’t expect the will of the alien to be so tenacious. If it was an ordinary person, they would have been drained of their physical strength.
Once again, Dudian’s speed weakened. The three trolls approached him. This time, Dudian didn’t increase his speed. Soon, the trolls were less than ten meters behind dudian, the trolls swung their swords. Lightning was thrown out from the swords. It was as fast as lightning.
Dudian was aware of the situation. He was surprised as he quickly dodged. The light from the sword cut into the ground and created a trench four or five meters deep.
“The energy of this weapon can be shot out at close range. The distance should be limited. Otherwise I would have used it.”Dudian’s eyes lit up as his body flew forward. But this time he didn’t roar. He didn’t try to force himself. He shot out like an arrow.
Dudian suddenly stopped when the three of them were stunned. His body didn’t move at all. It seemed that he had been standing there for a long time.
He turned around and looked at the three of them. They weren’t fast enough to stop. There were more than twenty meters of footprints and gear marks on their feet. The astonishment on their faces turned into anger, they knew that they had been fooled. Dudian had been hiding his strength!
The youth in the middle of the troll mechs suddenly looked down at the map. His heart turned cold as he saw that the three of them had completely separated from the main force, he was afraid that they wouldn’t be able to rush over in time.
“They deliberately lured us away from the main group. Are they trying to kill us?”The young man’s expression was gloomy, “Could it be that this attack was originally a conspiracy? “They used these cannon fodder soldiers to intentionally arrange for the Abyss to be in there. I don’t know if there are any other abysses other than this one…”he smelled the scent of trickery and betrayal, he felt that there was a traitor among his own clansmen, but he was unable to think deeply about this at the moment.
“Both of you, we have fallen into a trap. We will lose even more if we run away. We will fight!”The youth immediately contacted the people in the other two mechs.
The two of them had reacted and agreed. They turned on all the weapons systems in the troll mechs.
“This language…”Dudian’s golden eyes looked at the three troll mechs. He saw the lips of the three people who were communicating with each other. He couldn’t help but sigh, he whispered: “Since you are from the same clan then I will let you die!”
His body suddenly rushed out.
“It’s coming!”The eyes of the three people in the giant mech tightened. They were about to react but their faces changed. Their eyes were filled with shock. Bang! The left side of the giant mech was broken, something Sharp cut the middle of the giant mech. The body was cut in half from the middle of the eyebrows!
The young man and the other person were so scared that their minds went blank. It was too fast. They were so scared that they didn’t have time to react.
Bang!
The troll mecha on the right side was also cut in half. The mecha operator inside was in the same dead state as the troll mecha.
Plop!
A pair of feet landed on the head of the troll mecha in the middle. It pushed the mecha down slightly and sank into the soil.
The young man’s face turned pale as he looked at the owner of the feet. There was a palm-sized tail on his back, the monster’s tail was the one that had broken the troll mech!
“Monster!”The young man’s eyes were filled with despair. The intense fear made him unable to breathe.
“Come out. Let’s talk.”Dudian put away the dagger and smiled.
The youth was stunned as he heard Dudian’s words. He stared at him in disbelief. He was more shocked than when he saw Dudian’s magic body.
After a long time he came back to his senses. He looked at Dudian who was sitting on the shoulder of the troll. He knew that he couldn’t run away. He hesitated for a moment but finally pressed the switch, the chest of the troll slowly opened and the youth’s chair pushed him out. He climbed onto the other shoulder of the troll and sat down. He looked at the height of more than ten meters. He took a deep breath and stared at Dudian, “Who are you? Why do you… Speak Our Language?”
Dudian smiled: “This is my language too. It is my mother tongue.”
“My Language?”The youth was stunned for a long time: “You, you are from our family? Yes, you are one of us. But, you, why did you kill them? Your Magic Marks…”
“It’s a long story.”Dudian shook his head and sighed. He turned his head and looked at the youth curiously, “Do you expect to use these to fight? Your physique seems to be slightly stronger than ordinary people.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1053
chapters.content:
Chapter 1053 – Chapter 142: Torture
The young man looked at Dudian. There was some doubt in his heart. He couldn’t see any killing intent or hostility from Dudian. It seemed that the previous chase was an illusion. From the appearance, Dudian was definitely one of his clansmen. He had black hair and black eyes, the color of his skin was the same. Moreover, he knew that their language was very complicated. It would be difficult to learn them. Even if he could learn them, his accent would be seen through.
However Dudian’s accent was very pure. It was obvious that he was a member of the same race.
Were they spies sent to the other races? But why would they attack us?
The youth was puzzled, he shook his head: “We are different from the other races. We have skin and hair. How can we let these dirty insects parasitize us? Even if this thing can bring power to us humans, it is still an external thing! Moreover, the experts said that this thing is a double-edged sword. After the parasitical body matures, it will take away the body. So the end of this path is not hope but destruction!”
Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of surprise. He didn’t think that this was a secret taboo in the giant wall.
“So you don’t have magic marks but rely on these mechs?”Dudian asked.
There was a bit of pride on the youth’s face: “Of course, these mechs are the crystallization of technology. We believe in the power of technology and not some evil ways!”
“There are top-notch kings in the giant wall. It should be impossible to threaten them with such level of mechs. Do you have more advanced mechs? or more powerful thermal weapons?”Dudian looked at him, he asked.
“Of course, this is the lowest level of battle mechs. We have the Dragon God and the most powerful Wargod!”The Young Man’s face was full of pride, he didn’t realize that he had said so much. Fortunately, these weren’t important secrets. He was relieved as he made up his mind.
“You are a member of my family. Why did you appear in the giant wall? Why did you have magic marks inside your body?”The youth turned to ask Dudian to find out his identity.
“I have my own identity. You are not qualified to know.”Dudian smiled. His words weren’t polite but his expression was calm: “Don’t ask about my identity. Just answer my questions.”
The youth was slightly startled. He was angry but his eyelids suddenly twitched, “Is he really a spy sent by my family?”? If he was a spy, how could he be ignorant about my family’s affairs? Strange, could he be a survivor of my family? No, those survivors had long forgotten my family’s language. How could he still remember it? No, no…”
“I just heard you mention the word ‘expert’. It seems that your history should record many things of the old era?”Dudian asked.
The youth woke up from his meditation and frowned: “I can’t tell you this before I know your identity!”
“Why?”Dudian shook his head and sighed. The next moment, the sharp tail blade went around the back of the troll’s neck and reached to the youth’s cheek. The youth felt the hair on his body tremble as if there was a bloodthirsty tiger sitting next to him, there was a sea of blood all around him. Even though he had been trained and had been to more than ten battlefields, he was shocked by the sudden killing intent. His face turned white and his teeth were chattering.
“You…”he looked at Dudian in fear. A moment ago he thought that he might be able to survive but at this moment he felt like he was being held by a tiger and could die at any time.
All kinds of speculations about Dudian’s identity were dispelled at this moment.
“I ask, you answer.”Dudian stared at him.
The youth clenched his teeth: “Kill me if you want. I Won’t betray my nation!”
“Do you have a wife? Think about your wife, children, your parents, your friends…”Dudian quietly looked at him, “Is it worth dying here? No one will remember you. Even if you are stubborn to the end, I can find someone else. You can be stubborn, but it doesn’t mean that others will be stubborn. There will always be people who are loyal to their family and willing to sacrifice. Do you have the heart to let your parents not see your corpse?”
The youth was stunned and couldn’t speak. He wasn’t married yet, but the parents that Dudian mentioned hit his heart. He thought of the two ordinary faces in the depths of his memory, as well as the expectations in his eyes, he couldn’t help but want to cry.
“Loyalty to family is the only way to be loyal to the nation. Your resistance and death are meaningless. Even if you tell me, it doesn’t mean that you have betrayed me because I will know sooner or later.”Dudian continued, his voice was calm but it was like a magic sound that entered the youth’s ears and guided him.
The youth sat on the shoulder of the mech in a daze. His eyes slowly woke up as he took a deep breath, “You are right. Unfortunately…”he laughed: “Our ancient China has never had a surrendered warrior!”
He took out a dagger from nowhere and stabbed it towards his throat.
His wrist was broken and the dagger fell to the ground.
Dudian stood in front of the youth and looked down at him: “How dare you kill yourself without my permission?”
The youth was stunned. The next moment he screamed out in pain as he hugged his broken arm.
“Do you know what will happen if you go against me?”Dudian lifted the youth’s shoulder and brought him to the ground in front of the mech, “I can find out your identity from others. I can find your parents, friends, your lover, your first love, anyone who has anything to do with you! I can make them suffer and die. I can also make them suffer humiliation. They can live like dogs and beg for Death!”
He bent down and pinched the wound on the young man’s hand. The strength of his fingers was sometimes heavy and sometimes light.
The young man screamed in pain. He looked at Dudian in horror. Dudian’s words filled him with anger and fear. He screamed: “You are a devil, a despicable devil!”
“Your instructor taught you to die bravely and sacrifice your life for the country. But your parents have raised you for so many years. How can you repay them? Do you listen to their teachings? You would rather listen to the words of an instructor who met you halfway than listen to the words of your parents. It is you who killed them…”Dudian continued, his words became more and more sharp. They pierced into the youth’s ears like needles.
At the same time, golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes. He completely mastered the body structure of the youth. His fingers turned into sharp blades. His fingertips were burning with flames. He roasted the bones of his palm and continuously stabbed at the nerves of his arm, the intense pain caused the youth to faint on the spot. However, he was slapped awake by Dudian. Soon he fainted again.
Dudian repeatedly woke him up and tortured him both physically and verbally.
Two hours later, Dudian jumped into the young man’s mech. There were scorched marks on the ground. It was the corpse of the young man.

chapters.title: Chapter 1054
chapters.content:
Chapter 1054 – Chapter 143: Homecoming
Although he was struggling but the youth’s physique was not high. His endurance was much weaker than the hunters who were on the edge of life and death. The only difference was that the hunters in the giant wall could endure pain but their faith was easily shaken. Because they often licked the blood of the hunters they would cherish their lives and use life and death to threaten them, they didn’t even need to use too many means to interrogate them.
Dudian “Asked”the youth as he fumbled around. He had completely mastered the black lizard class troll mech.
“Start!”
Dudian pressed the button. The support under the metal chair shrank. He pulled the chair back into the chest of the Troll Mech. Many virtual keyboards and monitors gathered around him.
“Please scan the iris and log in to AI-O2187.”There was an electronic synthesized voice coming from the top of his head. Dudian was prepared. He flipped his palm and two eyeballs appeared in his palm. He raised them and moved to the iris scanning hole.
“Iris scanning…”
“Scanning complete…”
“Logging in…”
A series of voices echoed one after another. After ten seconds, Dudian successfully logged in. He put away the youth’s eyes and rubbed his face. He quickly adjusted his face.
His fingers quickly tapped on the virtual shoulder. A small splint popped out. There was a large space inside and there were some personal items. This was the small storage room of the mech. It was usually used to store pure water, dry food, and personal items such as private communicators.
Dudian seemed to know the inside like the back of his hand. He took out a small mirror from the bottom of the room and looked at it. He found that his appearance was similar to that of the young man but his temperament seemed to be different.
The temperament of the young man was more peaceful. He had the feeling of a soldier. However his temperament was reserved and his eyes were deep. He looked like a killer in the dark.
“It seems that I need to temper my temperament.”Dudian frowned. Temperament was more troublesome than appearance.
