He only needed to adjust his bones and facial muscles to create his appearance, it was easy for a person with extraordinary physique like him but temperament was engraved into his bones. He needed to carefully act. Fortunately, although it was troublesome but it was not impossible to adjust.
Dudian closed his eyes and thought for a moment. When he opened his eyes again, his expression had become determined. His thick eyebrows were full of righteousness.
He looked at the mirror and felt that it was almost the same. He took the mirror and jumped out of the mech. He raised the two mechs next to him and threw them to the other two places. He designed the scene so that no one would see the flaws.
After dealing with the scene, Dudian returned to the troll mech and drove it to the south.
The troll mech stumbled along the map. Sometimes it would hit a hill and smash it into pieces. The black paint on the surface of the mech was scratched. Dudian went into the woods as he passed by. The troll mech would occasionally hit the trees and break the trees. However there were many branches and leaves in the gaps of the mech.
“Search location…”
“Search location…”
After continuous search Dudian finally saw other marks of the trolls at the edge of the battle network. They were black dots. If there were red dots then they would represent the enemy.
As the distance closed Dudian saw more and more black dots. There were about seventy or eighty of them.
Dudian was secretly surprised. These trolls represented the Combat Power of the Abyss. There were so many of them. Moreover, they were used in a small battle!
The black dots were moving towards the south but their speed wasn’t fast. Dudian was trying his best to catch up with them. He couldn’t help but feel a bit nervous. Finally, he could see the trolls in front of him through the visual screen, the ten meter tall mechs were like Giants walking in the wilderness. Some of them had sharp barrels protruding from their bodies. They looked like hedgehogs.
“Are they going to return to the base camp…”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he slowly followed behind the troll mechs.
At this time, he saw that some of the trolls were holding large nets in their hands. Some of them were struggling in anger while others were ashen faced.
The group of trolls went through mountains and rivers for more than half an hour. Suddenly, a troll made a buzzing sound and turned to face Dudian’s mech, dudian heard a loud voice coming from the communicator: “Where Did you go? I thought you were dead. Why did you appear so late?”
Dudian turned his head and looked at the mecha. There was a golden light in his eyes. He saw that it was a fatty in his twenties sitting inside the mecha. His eyes flashed with understanding, he said in a bad tone: “You have a bad mouth. You Didn’t say the right thing but you almost said the wrong thing.”He adjusted his voice. He had paid attention to the youth’s voice when he was interrogating him, he had deliberately let out the sound of crying and laughing so that he could listen to it. At this moment, his imitation was almost the same.
“Damn, did something really happen?”The fatty in the mech was shocked. The Mech turned its head and looked at Dudian’s mech. He saw the friction of the black paint on the mech, as well as the branches and green leaves stuck in the gaps, he cried out: “What Happened? Is there an abyss in the enemy’s army?”
“It might be a middle abyss. Fortunately, my reaction was fast enough to escape. However, the other two who were with me didn’t see their mechas.”Dudian said in a deep voice. The fatty in the mech was a good friend of the youth. His name was Zhao Dabao and this youth was called Su Ming.
“Middle Abyss? How is that possible? The attack this time was planned in advance by the higher-ups. In this case, wouldn’t we lose two people?”Zhao Dabao’s face was full of shock, if the higher-ups knew that they had lost two people, it was unknown how furious they would be!
“Maybe we have been set up!”Dudian clenched his teeth.
Zhao Dabao also thought of this. He nodded after hearing Dudian’s words: “These damned alien races used these soldiers to exchange for two of our mechas and two of our mechas. What a good plan!”
“It’s my fault.”Dudian sighed, he said in frustration: “At first I thought that he was just a descendent of the abyss. I wanted to chase after him and kill him. Who knew that he hid his strength. He was deliberately trying to seduce me.”
Zhao Dabao looked at him with a complicated expression: “Old Su, I know that your sister is in trouble and is in urgent need of money. But the battlefield is not a child’s game. I will find some brothers to help you. You should deal with them first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1055
chapters.content:
Chapter 1055 – Chapter 144: City
Was his sister sick?
Dudian’s face was calm but his heart was cold. He was careless. Although he questioned Su Ming about his family relationship but Su Ming didn’t take the initiative to tell him that his sister was sick, he didn’t expect that Su Ming was facing such trouble.
Zhao Dabao saw that Dudian was silent and sighed, “In any case, solve your sister’s matter first. Don’t think too much. But this time we lost two pilots. The higher-ups are going to interrogate you. If they want to take you to investigate, then you go. I’ll think of a way to solve your sister’s matter.”
Dudian nodded slightly and whispered: “Thank You!”
Both of them followed behind the group of trolls. Zhao Dabao saw that Dudian was less talkative and seemed to be in a low mood. He found some interesting things to chat with Dudian. The dull atmosphere gradually dissipated. Half an hour later, the group of trolls went over a towering mountain range. They suddenly saw open plains. At the end of the plains, there was a towering giant wall under the sunlight.
“Giant wall…”Dudian looked at the majestic giant wall. He found that although the giant wall was majestic but it was completely different from the empire’s giant wall. Its height was only about two to three hundred meters, moreover the giant wall had the outline of a beast head. It was very ferocious. There were dragon head, leopard head, lion head and so on. At first glance, these monster heads seemed to be embedded in the giant wall, it was enough to intimidate monsters with low intelligence.
In addition, there were turrets, arrow towers and beacon towers on the giant wall. It was a bit like a city in ancient China!
“This is where they live…”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He had learned their identity from Su Ming. They were citizens of ancient China. They had the same blood. Most of the people here were Asian from the east. They had a long history of family names. It meant that there was no fault in the civilization and the inheritance was not lost, the ancient country that stood for thousands of years in the old era was still standing in the face of the Cataclysm!
“The south of the Empire is China. The position of the Empire is in the direction of Russia in the old era.”Dudian thought. Suddenly he thought of the ancient buildings in the giant wall of the Fire Dragon tribe, all of them were in the eastern style. Could it be that they were part of the forces of China?
The team drove into the plain and came to the front of the ancient city. A signal flare was shot out from the back of the lead troll mech. It exploded in the air. A few minutes later, the sound of drums could be heard from the city.
The lead giant’s feet were covered in flames as it flew towards the city.
The rest of the mechs followed behind.
Dudian pressed the keyboard and waited for the giant to take off.
“There is no gate in the city. Fortunately the Mechs can fly for a short time. If the people inside want to go out then there should be other means of passage.”Dudian thought.
When he flew over the city, his line of sight was parallel to the city. He found that the walkway over the city was as wide as a parking lot! There were many mechs, armored vehicles, carriers and so on. In addition there were small fighter planes and passenger planes!
Dudian was a bit surprised. Golden light flashed in his eyes as he looked through the ground above the city. He saw that the thickness of the city was about 40-50 meters! There were a lot of stone pillars behind the city. Each layer was more than 20 meters high! There were many weapons, fuel, gunpowder and other things. There were also many computers and monitors.
Dudian suddenly found that the biggest difference between the city and the giant wall was not the height but the construction.
The giant wall was a tall wall. It was bare and smooth inside and outside. It was difficult to adhere to. But the city was man-made. It could hide many equipment. Every design was prepared for war and defense!
“The giant wall was created by the Aragami. It was created by humans. I don’t know if there is a giant wall or Aragami…”Dudian felt that his teeth were sore, he had forgotten to ask about the Aragami.
Some secrets were hidden in the empire but he could easily get the answers if he stood outside the empire.
“But there will be opportunities in the future. As long as I can sneak in…”Dudian comforted himself as he slowly calmed down.
He followed the other trolls as they landed. The gears under the feet of the trolls protruded as they glided along the track to the parking space. The trolls carrying soldiers in the large net in their hands drove into a container area. There was a crane-type machine gun there. When these trolls lifted the large net above a container.., several streams of light shot out from the crane-type machine guns.
The soldiers in the large net seemed to have realized the danger and struggled violently. However, they were still hit by the streams of light and their bodies immediately went limp.
The net fell into the container and the top of the container was closed. The next moment, there was a violent struggle in the container but it soon stopped.
Batch after batch of soldiers were sent to the container. Some of the soldiers had high physiques so they were able to avoid the light. However, after the first round, there was a second round. More and more light shot out until the soldiers in the net stopped moving.
Dudian sat in the giant mech and looked at the scene from afar. His dynamic vision clearly captured that the streamers were toothpick thin ice. When the streamers shot out, the thin ice melted quickly and turned into sharp water, the effect of the streamers was similar to that of anesthetics but the composition was a hundred times stronger.
Some of the soldiers were smart enough to dodge the streamers but pretended to be dead. However, when they landed in the container, thick mist sprayed out from the container. They couldn’t avoid it and passed out like the others.
“It seems that these people will be sent to do experiments…”Dudian quietly looked at the giant wall. He guessed that the same thing would happen to the giant wall. This was war. There was no right or wrong, only a stand.
After all the soldiers were put into the container, the chest of the other trolls that were parked at the berth cracked open. Alloy ladders extended out from the chest and the other pilots walked out one after another.
Dudian and Zhao Dabao came down from the other side of the mech. He took the things in the compartment of his personal belongings. In particular, the private communicator and wristwatch were similar to the mobile phones of the old era, he looked at the other pilots who were wearing them. He didn’t think that anyone would forget about such things.
“We have caught a lot of demon warriors this time. There should be a lot of rewards. Unfortunately, neither of us have caught them.”Zhao Dabao walked to Dudian’s side, he looked at the trolls who were coming back from the container area with envy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1056
chapters.content:
Chapter 1056 – Chapter 145: Magic Marks Detection
“It’s good that nothing happened.”Dudian smiled bitterly.
Zhao Dabao knew what Dudian was worried about. He patted his shoulder: “What’s there to be afraid of? There is a problem from above. We are unlucky. You Can’t be blamed for it.”
“I hope so.”
The two followed the crowd to the alloy floor of the parking lot. The metal floor slightly trembled as they descended.
The metal plate fell to the lowest level. There was a passage in front of them with Chinese characters and English translation. Everyone lined up in front of the passage and entered the door at the end of the passage.
“Physical examination exit…”Dudian looked at the door at the end of the passage. His eyes flashed but he didn’t say anything.
Soon, the people in front of the group all left. It was Dudian and Zhao Dabao’s turn. Both of them entered the door one after the other. It was very spacious. There were a few strange instruments, one of the instruments shone a green light and scanned their bodies.
“Please come over here.”The woman in military uniform stood next to the instrument. She was valiant and valiant as she guided the two.
Zhao Dabao was obviously familiar with the way. He was very cooperative as he stood on the instrument designated by the woman in military uniform. Dudian was brought to the same instrument on the right side by the other woman.
“Can this thing detect anything?”Dudian casually asked in a mocking tone.
The round-faced woman smiled sweetly: “This is a special device to detect the fallout from your body. It can only detect nuclear radiation. Please take off your uniform.”
Dudian took off his jacket to reveal his underwear. He touched the wristwatch communicator and casually looked at the instrument in front of him. There was a ring-like object on top of the instrument. It slowly landed on top of Dudian’s head. Dudian secretly used X-ray to look at the object in the ring. There were some uranium crystals in the ring, he felt a wonderful feeling in his body. The pores on his body slightly opened. He felt comfortable.
He thought of the broken uranium ring wrapped in simple animal skin. He put it away with Su Ming’s personal belongings.
“Can this thing purify the nuclear radiation in the body?”Dudian thought.
The circular object landed at his feet and slowly rose. After repeated cycles, the instrument stopped trembling and ended the test.
“Radiation value 8.26% …”the round-faced woman looked at the data displayed on the back of the instrument and slightly frowned, she looked at dudian: “Shangguan, your body’s radiation index is close to the critical point and needs to be reduced. Please fill in this form and register for the surgery.”
Dudian frowned. He was a bit unhappy but he was relieved. He had asked Su Ming about the problems he would face when he infiltrated the city. Su Ming had told him about the medical equipment, every pilot would check their constitution after they returned to the city. The radiation test was just the first step. There were magic marks test, epidemic test and so on to prevent the demons from infiltrating the pilots, or the mecha operators would accidentally get infected by the strange virus and bring it back to the city.
“It seems that it is really like what she said. I can only check the radiation value. Fortunately, the radiation value in my body is not much. It is different from other hunters. Perhaps my body comes from the old era…”Dudian thought, logically speaking, he was a hunter in his early years and was imprisoned in the cave by the splitter. The two times alone were enough to make the radiation value in his body soar. But in fact, it didn’t.
The reason why he dared to come over for a test was because his entire body did not have dark spots and radiation-dissimilated tissues accumulated from the radiation infection. When the radiation amount exceeded the critical point of 10% , some parts of the body would have different degrees of dark spots of radiation, such as rotting sarcomas. There would also be mutations when the radiation content reached about 7-8% , such as the women who went to the tavern to receive guests, although the body was no different from an ordinary person but the private parts of the body were rotten.
Dudian turned to look at Zhao Dabao who was on the other side of the instrument. He heard the valiant female soldier in front of him laugh: “The radiation content is 3.67% . Although it is high but it is still within the control range.”
Zhao Dabao was relieved. He turned to look at Dudian. He saw the round-faced girl take out the form. His face changed: “Old Su, your radiation content is over the limit?”
Dudian sighed: “I used to operate a mech when I was escaping. I think I inhaled a lot of it.”
Zhao Dabao was startled. He wanted to ask in detail but he knew that it was not suitable for him to do so.
If the radiation level exceeded 5% then he would need to enter radiation therapy. Dudian’s radiation level was close to the critical point. He had to undergo surgery. Otherwise no one knew where the mutation would be, this small mutation was enough to destroy a well-trained mech!
Dudian took the pen and filled in the form. There was a time for the operation which he had agreed on. He randomly picked a date and twenty days later.
“Well, please come here to do the second Test.”The girl put away the form and registered Dudian’s identity. She took Dudian to the second instrument.
The instrument was like a coffin. The girl opened the instrument and said to dudian: “Please.”
Dudian looked at Zhao Dabao. He saw that Zhao Dabao had already laid down. He didn’t hesitate and laid down in the instrument.
“If the magic marks are detected, the accumulated voltage inside this thing will be released in an instant…”Dudian thought. Although he was confident, but he couldn’t help but feel a bit nervous.
When the instrument was closed, Dudian saw that there was a blue light wave on the cover. It fell on his body and scanned from head to tail.
After a few minutes, the instrument was opened.
Dudian was relieved and sat up.
The girl smiled sweetly: “Shangguan, this way please.”
Dudian followed her to another room. This was the epidemic detection room.
“There are no magic marks in my body. I can’t detect it…”Dudian thought. He was different from the other magic marks warriors. Scarlet Moon had transformed his body and the splitter soul worm was gone, the splitter soul worm was swallowed by his body and turned into a part of the gene chain. Later on, the turtle shell and other soul worms were directly swallowed and not implanted into his body. Therefore, there was no magic nest in his body, there were also no demon marks hidden in it. If he were to take off his clothes, his body would be no different from an ordinary person. The only difference was that his skin was stronger and there were no scars on it.
The scars that were left behind from the ordeal that he went through in the Thorn prison in the early years had long fallen off. His skin was completely new. This was the effect of the powerful vitality of the Aragami genes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1057
chapters.content:
Chapter 1057 – Chapter 146: Message
The final epidemic detection was the one that Dudian was most worried about. He needed to draw blood. He didn’t know if his blood would be detected by the mixed Aragami factor and several magic marks genes.
He was prepared for the worst. If he was exposed then he would directly attack the city and hide.
He believed that he could hide himself even if they investigated. There were countless residents in the city as cover.
The girl sent Dudian to the quarantine room. There were seven or eight people wearing white coats and masks inside.
Dudian waited behind Zhao Dabao.
He checked the physical characteristics, blood test, colonoscopy, X-ray scan and other items. In addition there were several tests that were not available in the old era. For example, saliva test, dandruff collection, blood dripping into a small test tube, there was a worm in the test tube.
Dudian saw Zhao Dabao’s blood fall into the test tube. The baby centipede-like worm was soaked in the test tube. In the blink of an eye, the blood in the test tube was reduced by a few milliliters. At this time, someone used tweezers to take out the worm and extract its blood for testing.
“Bloodworm?”Dudian asked.
The male doctor who was helping Dudian to test looked at him and nodded: “Yes.”He replied to Dudian’s words. He didn’t say anything more and didn’t explain. Obviously he felt that.., dudian was aware of what bloodworm was.
Dudian looked at the worm, he thought: “The bloodworm mentioned by Su Ming is this thing. He said that he found a special kind of magic worm from the body of the monster. It is a kind of parasitic worm. Because of its special body structure it was used as a tool for border inspection.”
Bloodworms liked magic blood. The so-called magic blood referred not to the blood of magic marks warriors, but to the blood contaminated by germs and parasites, such as the blood of all kinds of monsters. These monsters lived outside the giant wall, and there were countless parasites and germs in their bodies. Any one of them was enough to infect people. Even the pioneers with strong physiques did not want to drink the blood of monsters to quench their thirst.
But for the bloodworms, the blood of monsters was their delicious meal. All kinds of parasites and bacteria in the blood were their pastries.
If it was pure blood, they wouldn’t be interested.
“It seems that Zhao Dabao’s health is not very good.”Dudian saw a female doctor testing the blood of the bloodworm. He thought that the bloodworm would differentiate the bacteria and parasites in the blood and slowly digest them, or it could be arranged into feces. From there it would be possible to know which hidden bacteria were in the blood.
Some bacteria could not be found by relying on the equipment here. But if it was differentiated by the bloodworm then it could be found. So this was the second line of defense.
Soon, it was Dudian’s turn.
“I hope my guess is right…”Dudian thought. He glanced at the male doctor who was drawing his blood. If the matter was exposed, he would be the first to be killed.
The male doctor lowered his head and dropped the blood into the test tube. He didn’t know that there was a pair of magic eyes on his head. He knew that his life would be harvested at any time.
The blood worm was soaked in the blood when it fell into the bottom of the test tube. It stretched out its tentacles to suck the blood. But the next moment, the blood worm seemed to be frightened as it retracted its tiny tentacles. Its body twisted violently as it stretched out two big pliers from its body. It drilled out of the blood and crawled out of the test tube, it seemed that it wanted to escape from the straw.
Dudian observed the blood worm’s panic. But in the eyes of the male doctor, the blood worm was as big as a green bean. As for the tentacles, they were even smaller, it didn’t want to stay in the tube.
“The little worm still wants to run!”The male doctor took out tweezers and clamped it.
“It didn’t suck my blood. It is afraid of the Aragami factor in my blood. Although the little thing doesn’t have much wisdom but its instinct for danger is still there. But it also shows that the Aragami factor is too terrifying. If it sucks it will be swallowed!”Dudian thought.
Soon, the Doctor took out the test report of the bloodworm. He looked at it and nodded: “It is healthy.”
Dudian nodded slightly. The bloodworm had been raised by them. There was no bacteria in its body and it didn’t suck his blood. The results were normal.
Ten minutes later, Dudian and Zhao Dabao took their medical reports and left the Quarantine Center.
“I have a cold. Fortunately, I didn’t get infected with anything from the demon race.”Zhao Dabao patted his chest and said with lingering fear: “When I saw the doctor frowning, I thought I had a big problem.”
Dudian looked at his physical examination report. Other than the results of the cardiopulmonary function test which was not very healthy and required exercise, everything else was satisfactory. He was able to sneak in for the time being. However, his physical examination report would be recorded into the computer and compared with Su Ming’s physical examination report. At that time, he would find that their blood type was not the same. The other states of their bodies were also quite different. If he had the intention to identify them.., they would find that they were not the same person.
However, Su Ming had said that the physical examination reports of their mecha operators were classified as Grade A files. Only those who specialized in management were qualified to look at them. Under normal circumstances, they would not look so carefully. After all, there were so many mecha operators.., who would remember the data of their previous physical examination reports? As long as they were qualified, it would be over.
“No matter what, there is still the risk of being denounced. We must find a new identity as soon as possible. First, we must get familiar with this place as soon as possible.”Dudian thought.
“Are You Alright?”Zhao Dabao saw that Dudian didn’t answer and touched his shoulder with his arm, “Is there something wrong with the body?”? “If there is any suspicious speculation, we have to look at it in time. The physical examination here might not be able to detect all of it. There was an unlucky guy who was bitten by a strange insect that flew into the exhaust of the mech and drilled into his neck. He said that he felt a mosquito bite his neck. But the mech is so clean, how could there be a Mosquito?”
“Later, the physical examination didn’t find out. It wasn’t until a short time later that he felt unwell. He went to the hospital for a check-up and was found to be ill. Moreover, there was no way to treat him. In the end, he was sent to the crematorium to be destroyed. I heard that his body was full of parasitic eggs. He casually spat out a mouthful of saliva. There were white eggs inside. It was very disgusting.”
Dudian casually said: “If there is no physical examination here then there is no hope for other places.”
“Not necessarily. Although the examination here is strict and the equipment is advanced. But if there is any problem then we can go to the Saint Institute to check. It is just that the cost is high.”Zhao Dabao said.
“So there is no hope.”Dudian pointed at himself: “Did you forget that I Need Money?”
Zhao Dabao’s face slightly changed, “Do you really feel unwell?”
“No, haven’t You Seen My Medical Report? I haven’t left the mech, and I don’t feel like being bitten by mosquitoes. It is impossible for insects to fly into the mech and parasitize me.”Dudian shrugged his shoulders.
Zhao Dabao stared into his eyes, “You didn’t lie to me?”
“Lying to you is like lying to a dog.”Dudian looked at him with the same seriousness. He was afraid that this brother of Su Ming would secretly find some advanced medical equipment for him to check himself.
Zhao Dabao was relieved, “That’s good. No matter what, life is the most important thing. Money and so on. Anyway, I can earn in the future. At most, I will have a few more missions.”
Dudian nodded. At this time, the two came to a small helicopter. The people on the helicopter saw the two’s dressing and waved.
“Just three people are full. Let’s go.”The middle-aged man on the plane was also a pilot. He had finished the physical examination in front of Dudian and Zhao Dabao.
Dudian and Zhao Dabao sat on the helicopter. The helicopter started and slowly rose into the air.
Zhao Dabao didn’t talk to Dudian about private matters as there were outsiders around. He talked to the man about the mission. He couldn’t help but curse the devil.
Dudian looked at the scenery outside the helicopter. It was empty and sparsely populated because it was close to the edge of the city. Once the war broke out there would be a lot of troops. It was not suitable to be developed as a prosperous district. They needed to take more than half an hour plane to go back to the military headquarters. It would take them more than a hundred miles.
“Beep Beep!”
Suddenly, a slight trembling sound came from his wrist.
Dudian was slightly startled. He looked down at his wristwatch. There was a message on it.
“Is it your sister?”Zhao Dabao stopped chatting with the middle-aged man and looked over.
Dudian saw that the name didn’t appear on the communication. It was no longer in the contact list. He frowned, a man’s voice came from the other side: “Is it Mr. Su Ming? Your sister is in the operating room. She is preparing for the operation. Please be there.”
“Operating room? !”Dudian’s pupils shrank, he was about to ask which hospital but suddenly thought of something. He changed the words: “I will go right away. You must use the best doctor to perform the operation!”He took the initiative to hang up.
Zhao Dabao’s face changed: “Is your sister going to do the surgery?”
Dudian’s legs trembled as he thought of something: “Damn! I forgot to ask which hospital he is from!”
“Of course it is the previous Anhai Hospital. Little Pearl has been treating him there.”Zhao Dabao put his hand on Dudian’s shoulder and comforted him: “Don’t worry. We will go now. We will make it in time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1058
chapters.content:
Chapter 1058 – Chapter 147: God Of Science And Technology
“Can I trouble you to fly faster?”Dudian asked the pilot.
The pilot nodded: “We will be there soon. Don’t worry.”
“Thank you.”Dudian was grateful.
He rubbed his palms as if he was in a hurry. However he was thinking in his heart. He had questioned Su Ming about a lot of things but it was inevitable that there was an oversight. His sister’s illness was the biggest oversight at the moment, he had to be careful and not give himself away. Otherwise, not only would his hands be stained with blood, he would also be causing trouble for nothing.
Helicopters flew across the vast tarmac. There were fighter jets on the tarmac, and there were rows of troll mechas. Many people were driving repair cars to repair and inspect these mechas.
Suddenly, at the end of the tarmac, in front of a lush forest, there stood an ancient sculpture. It was more than two or three hundred meters tall. It was a man with a western face. He had a handsome face and wore a crown, one hand was holding the holy flame while the other hand was holding a book. There were chains wrapped around his feet.
“Statue of Liberty?”Dudian was stunned when he saw the familiar pose. He had interrogated Su Ming. What did the people here believe in? Su Ming had given him the answer of the god of Science and Technology!
Could it be that this was the god of Science and Technology?
But this pose was completely a copy of the American statue of Liberty!
However, this person was also a European and American face. Dudian had a feeling of chaos. He couldn’t help but think of the initial stage of the disaster. A survivor led the rest of the people to survive, reproduce and gain the right to rule, then he made such a statue of the god of Liberty for himself!
“How boring is this person…”Dudian’s mouth twitched. He noticed that Zhao Dabao and the other middle-aged man were in awe and lowered their heads.
The helicopter went around the statue but didn’t directly jump over the head of the statue. It was obvious that this statue had extraordinary significance.
Dudian wanted to confirm the identity of the statue but he didn’t know how to open his mouth. He sighed: “Every Time I see it I feel that it is too handsome. It is impeccable!”
Zhao Dabao patted his shoulder, he smiled: “Of course. The God of Technology is a god of wisdom and beauty. He is much stronger than the Monsters of the demon race. Those Aragami are paralyzed in the lower half of their bodies. They are clearly devils. They are worshiped as gods. They believe in Devils and humans believe in gods!”
Sure enough, it was the god of Technology! Dudian thought in his heart. He remembered that the lower body of the Aragami was a distorted monster. He couldn’t help but think that it was possible. It was impossible for a god to exist. The Aragami were either alien races.., they were either the first generation warriors who had combined with the monsters. However, it was said that the Aragami had existed since the beginning of the battle between humans and magic insects. It was more likely that they were alien races!
The helicopter flew through the lush forest. After a long time, he saw many steel buildings standing at the end of the forest. They looked like dense silver bamboo shoots that were inserted into the ground. In addition, Dudian saw many steel buildings that were surrounded by rails. It looked like a slide in an amusement park. He was puzzled when he saw a maglev train coming from the distance, he followed the track to one of the steel buildings and stopped.
Then he saw the maglev train open. Many people came out from the exhibition stand outside the steel building.
“The level of technology is so high? !”Dudian was shocked by the old era’s imagination of the future of the city, he didn’t expect that the old era’s imagination had come true. Even the maglev train was built in the air. Although it was still far from the real maglev train, it needed to rely on the track, but it was a great progress!
“If the technology of the old era hasn’t been cut off and passed down, after more than 300 years of development, it is indeed possible to reach such a level, or even far beyond…”Dudian’s eyes flashed, he felt that his blood was boiling. The technology here was much higher than he had imagined. No wonder he could create such a huge war machine!
A moment later, the helicopter stopped on the roof of a steel building.
Dudian and Zhao Dabao quickly got off the helicopter. Dudian was in a panic when he got off the helicopter. He tripped and fell down. Zhao Dabao was shocked and quickly went forward to help him: “Are You Alright?”
“It’s alright. Take Me to Anhai Hospital.”Dudian gritted his teeth and pretended to endure the pain.
Zhao Dabao saw that Dudian’s face was red. He didn’t try to persuade him but helped him to walk quickly.
Dudian let Zhao Dabao lead the way. He took the elevator from the side of the steel building. His movement was inconvenient so Zhao Dabao pressed the floor and went directly to the elevator.
After they got out of the elevator, Zhao Dabao took Dudian to an extended booth and waited.
A moment later, the whistling sound came from a very fast place. After four or five seconds, they saw a silver-white maglev train rushing along the track. It stopped at the edge of the booth and two doors opened, a lot of people came out of one carriage. The other carriage entered. Zhao Dabao supported Dudian into the carriage. He saw that there were many empty seats.
Zhao Dabao helped Dudian to sit on the chair and put on the seat belt. He saw that Dudian’s hands and feet were inconvenient so he helped him to put on the seat belt.
“Thank you.”Dudian whispered.
Zhao dabao laughed: “Don’t worry, we will be there soon.”He pointed his watch at the lens in the middle of the seat belt.
Dudian noticed that there were many other mecha operators in the carriage. They did the same thing after putting on the safety belt. They raised their hands and used their wristwatches to scan the safety belt.
The maglev train began to move. In just a few seconds, it accelerated to hundreds of miles. The scenery outside the window became beautiful. When the track curved, the maglev train also curved and flipped up and down, it was like a roller coaster in an amusement park. However, the gravity inside the carriage was constant. The people inside the carriage didn’t feel that they had flipped over unless they looked at the scenery outside the window.
The maglev train passed by one steel building after another. It stopped and started again. Half an hour later, they arrived in front of a steel building. Zhao Dabao opened the middle button of the safety belt on his chest and took Dudian off the train.
After arriving at the steel building, the two took the elevator and descended to the ground floor of the building. There was actually a subway track.
“These buildings are actually parking stations. There are lounge and entertainment places on each floor. It’s too luxurious.”Dudian couldn’t help but exclaim when Zhao Dabao wasn’t paying attention, he felt as if he had come to the capital of technology, the future world.
Suddenly, he thought of a problem. The technology here was so advanced that nuclear weapons should have been produced long ago. They could even mass produce laser cannons and other weapons. But why were there traces of monsters here? Why were the cities built so ferociously to deal with monsters?

chapters.title: Chapter 1059
chapters.content:
Chapter 1059 – Chapter 148: Federation
Under the lead of Zhao Dabao, Dudian entered this modern, no, more accurately, futuristic metropolis hinterland. The moment the train left the ground.., dudian felt as if he had taken a time machine back to the old era. He was familiar with the three-dimensional box-shaped buildings, traffic lights, roads… all of them projected the shadow of the old era’s civilization.
“Is this the last refuge of the survivors of the old era?”Dudian looked at the place in a daze. He suddenly felt an inexplicable sense of relief and sadness. His father had given him the super chip but he had inexplicably appeared in the giant wall of the Shenluo Empire, he had experienced hardships there. If he had woken up here in the beginning, would he have lived happily for more than ten years?
He thought for a moment and shook his head. He thought that even if he woke up here, his life would be a hundred times more comfortable? I will never meet her in my life. What is the meaning of everything?
A moment later, Zhao Dabao brought Dudian to a grand hospital. The reason why it was grand was because the hospital was like a high school. In front of the hospital there was a ten-meter stone tablet of the god of Science and technology. There was a garden, grassland, and pool, there was also a beautiful bird forest. The main entrance of the hospital was extraordinary. The pedestrians were in a hurry, but it was orderly. Only the faint smell of medicine floated out from it. Dudian slightly frowned.
Zhao Dabao pulled Dudian into the hospital. They took the elevator and came to the front desk on the 24th floor. “We are the family members of SU Mingzhu. which operating room is she in?”
“Please Show your identification.”The nurse at the front desk said expressionlessly.
Dudian handed over the wristwatch. This wristwatch was not only a communication device but also contained a lot of information related to him. It was equivalent to an identity card.
The nurse at the front desk used an instrument to scan the wristwatch. Dudian’s identity information popped up on the computer. She took a look at it and her face suddenly changed color. She looked at Dudian in surprise, she quickly said: “Hello, your sister Su Mingzhu is in room C-8. Please follow me.”She came out from the front desk and personally led the way for Dudian.
Dudian asked as he walked: “Has My Sister’s surgery started?”
The nurse shook her head: “Not yet. The family members haven’t arrived and the money hasn’t arrived. So she is temporarily resting.”
Dudian was furious, “Isn’t the situation critical? Why don’t we carry out the surgery first? !”
“This is the rule. My Lord, please atone for your sins.”The nurse said in a trembling voice.
Dudian’s face was full of anger. He followed the nurse to room C-8. He opened the door and saw that there were four beds in the ward. There were metal covers on the sides of the beds. The isolation of the beds was quite high-end but Dudian ignored it, “Why isn’t it an independent ward? !”
“Sir, your sister didn’t pay the medical fees so…”the nurse looked embarrassed but her good impression of Dudian was lost. She was secretly contemptuous. She was pretending to be so angry, but she didn’t pay the medical fees for her sister. She still had the face to blame me!
Dudian clenched his fists. The nurse led him to a white metal covered bed. He saw the nurse open the metal cover. There was a pale girl wearing a hospital gown. She looked seventeen or eighteen years old.
“Brother?”The girl was surprised to see the face outside the metal cover. She was pleasantly surprised: “You Are Here!”
Dudian’s heart was slightly moved. He suddenly thought of his sister. He took a deep breath and went forward to hold her hand: “Rest assured, brother is here. I will cure your lung cancer!”
When he entered the ward, he took advantage of the fact that the nurse and Zhao Dabao were not paying attention to him. He used the fluoroscopy to scan the room. The other three beds were occupied by two old men and a middle-aged woman. Only this girl echoed his sister’s age, therefore, he confirmed her identity and took the opportunity to scan her body. At a glance, he could see that Su Ming’s sister had lung cancer. The area where the lung cancer cells spread was not small. Moreover, there were traces of excision, obviously, the surgery had been performed before but the cancer cells could not be eradicated. Once again, it spread and grew.
Generally speaking, the probability of a woman getting lung cancer was very low. After all, she did not like smoking like a man, let alone such a young girl in the prime of her life.
Although Dudian was puzzled but he quickly thought that it might be because of the environment.
Su mingzhu bit her lip and whispered: “Brother, I have given you more trouble.”
Dudian rubbed her head: “Silly, what kind of trouble is this? I have even killed demons. How can I not defeat this little disease in your body?”
SU mingzhu smiled: “I know, brother, don’t worry. The situation is not so bad this time. I can still save it.”
Dudian couldn’t help but smile but didn’t continue to talk to her. He turned to the nurse: “How Much is the surgery fee?”
“I don’t know the exact amount, but if your sister has lung cancer, the surgery fee is usually between 200,000 to 400,000 federal dollars.”The nurse quickly said.
Dudian frowned and his face slightly sank.
“Let’s do the surgery first. I will help you collect the money.”Zhao Dabao said, “Your money has just been paid off. You Can Pay me back next month.”
Dudian looked at him and knew that he didn’t mean to pay back the money. He was afraid that it would hurt his self-esteem and give him a way out. Although Su Ming was dead, he had a good brother. However, he didn’t think it was necessary. Even if Zhao Dabao didn’t give him face, he would beg for money to treat his sister’s illness. In the face of life and death, how much was face worth?
“Thank you.”Dudian patted his shoulder. He secretly thought that Su Ming was most likely a face-loving guy. Otherwise, he wouldn’t let his brother take care of his face so much.
Zhao Dabao was relieved as he saw that Dudian agreed. He immediately ordered the nurse.
Soon, the doctor came over and sent Su Mingzhu into the operating room.
Dudian and Zhao Dabao were waiting outside. Dudian didn’t expect Su Ming to be in debt. No wonder a mecha operator didn’t have the money to treat his sister’s illness. But speaking of which.., no matter what, a mecha operator was considered to be a guard of the border. His relatives couldn’t get free medical treatment? He felt that it was necessary to go back to the army to familiarize himself with the treatment and benefits of a mecha operator. At the same time, he wanted to understand the social structure of this place through the military.
Not long after, Su Mingzhu was sent out. Dudian used X-ray to take a look. He found that the cancer cells in her chest and lungs had been removed. He was relieved. Although the fees here were high.., but the medical level was much better than the old era.
“You should stay in the hospital to recuperate. I have to go back to report to the police. I Can’t accompany you anymore. I will come back to see you after the matter is over.”Dudian said goodbye to his sister.
Su Mingzhu was very weak. She barely said a few words and fell asleep.
Dudian was relieved as he walked out of the hospital. He knew that he had finally passed this dangerous stage.
“Let’s go back.”Dudian said to Zhao Dabao.
Zhao Dabao nodded. He helped Dudian who was injured ride the train back and forth.
Dudian and Zhao Dabao returned to the military headquarters at dark.
The military headquarters was located in a remote suburb outside the city. It was very secretive. There were sentries hidden hundreds of miles away from the military headquarters. There should be a lot of technology to monitor this place. Dudian and Zhao Dabao entered the military base. They needed to enter their irises and scan their identities.
Dudian asked Zhao Dabao to scan their irises. He quickly took out Su Ming’s eyeballs and scanned them.
Su Ming’s eyeballs were completely frozen and didn’t rot. Dudian used the heat control ability brought by the magic marks of the sun beast to reduce the temperature around the eyeballs and freeze them.
The underground base was like an inner intestine of an insect machine. There were complex corridors and checkpoints. Many checkpoints around the perimeter needed to be scanned.
Dudian was worried that there would be surveillance in the corridors. He secretly let one of his eyeballs shrink into the soft tissue of his skull before scanning. He pressed Su Ming’s eyeball into his eye socket. It felt very cold and uncomfortable, but it was still within the range of his pain tolerance.
After going through more than a dozen checkpoints, there was no need to scan his identity anymore. Dudian quickly removed Su Ming’s frozen eyeball. Then he bulged his own eyeball and rotated it a few times. He felt that his eyes were sore, the uncomfortable feeling disappeared after a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1060
chapters.content:
Chapter 1060 – Chapter 149: God Of Creation
“Sergeant Su Ming, Captain Li is looking for you.”
Dudian and Zhao Dabao returned to the reporting hall of the base. After they finished checking the registration records on their wristwatches, a young man who was as strong as a bear came to Dudian and asked him to meet Captain Li.
“It’s alright.”Zhao Dabao gave Dudian a look and patted his shoulder.
Dudian nodded and followed the youth through the corridor. A checkpoint was opened like a fan. There was a spacious office inside.
“Captain Li, Sergeant Su Ming has arrived.”The youth pressed his palm on his chest and bowed.
There was a dignified middle-aged man sitting in front of the office. His beard extended from his temples to his chin. He had a deep and masculine face. He looked at the monitor on the desk, he didn’t raise his head: “I know. You can leave first.”
The youth took his leave and left Dudian alone.
“Leader.”Dudian used the same gesture to salute.
The middle-aged man slowly raised his eyes. His eyes were indifferent: “Tell me about Cai Changkang and Sun Yong.”
Dudian took a deep breath and repeated what he had said to Zhao Dabao. But this time it was more detailed. It included how to chase and how to escape.
“One strike struck the abyss of the black lizard…”captain Li’s finger gently tapped on the table. He was silent for a long time. Suddenly, he looked at Dudian with sharp eyes, “So in the end, you became a deserter?”
Dudian quickly said: “Captain, I didn’t escape because I was afraid. I wanted to bring back this information. I think that on the battlefield, not only do you want to die, but you are also a warrior!”
Leader Li slightly raised his eyebrows, he sneered: “As a soldier, you didn’t properly respond to the accident. You didn’t take responsibility afterwards. If everyone was like you and spoke eloquently about running away, how would you fight the war? HMM?”
Dudian was trembling in fear. He didn’t dare to say anything but he was relieved.
“I know your situation. Your Father’s company went bankrupt and he owed a huge debt. You need to pay it back so you urgently need money. However, the battlefield is not a child’s game! Don’t be blinded by money. This time because of your negligence, two of your comrades died. How are you going to face their families?”Captain Li coldly looked at him.
“Captain, Please Punish Me!”Dudian lowered his head.
Captain Li’s eyes gradually converged. He indifferently said: “It’s good that you know your mistakes. Remember, don’t publicize this matter. There are too many things involved. Be careful not to cause unnecessary trouble.”
Dudian nodded: “Thank you captain for your reminder!”
“Reminder? HMPH, you are smart.”Captain Li waved his hand: “Go Down. I think highly of you but it doesn’t mean that I can tolerate your repeated mistakes.”
Dudian bowed his head and left.
“Smelly Kid, I guess you are scared because of this incident. Your brain is more flexible than before.”Captain Li looked at Dudian’s back as he left.
“It seems that there is a problem with their operation. There are traitors in the military or spies in the giant wall. This matter involves many big figures. I should not get involved in this mess. I should get familiar with this place as soon as possible and then leave.”Dudian thought of Captain Li’s words, he quickly left the place and returned to the barracks.
“Are You Alright?”Zhao Dabao and Dudian lived in the same dormitory. He saw that Dudian had come back so he went up to ask.
Dudian shook his head: “I’m Alright. I told you about the situation. Captain Li told me not to spread the news. Don’t spread the news so there won’t be any trouble.”
Zhao dabao nodded: “I know. It’s good that you are alright.”
“I want to go back to see my sister. Do you want to Go?”Dudian deliberately invited him.
Zhao dabao shook his head: “I want to go but we can’t. I know you are worried about your sister but don’t do anything stupid. Don’t violate military discipline. I will accompany you back to see your sister when there is a holiday. Or We can go after the next battle.”
Dudian’s face was silent. He was a bit depressed but he understood in his heart. He knew that it was not so easy for a mecha operator to enter and leave the military camp. He heard from Zhao Dabao that even though they had just finished the battle, they didn’t have a holiday, it was clear how strict the control was on them!
Next, Dudian pretended to be in a bad mood. He laid on his bed and tidied up his personal belongings. There were a few books. He picked up two books which were about the knowledge of mecha. One was a storybook, there was also a booklet that recorded the rules and common sense of the mecha operators.
Dudian was happy. He pretended to casually pick up the storybook and read it. At the same time, he sensed his surroundings. Zhao Dabao’s attention gradually shifted away. It seemed that he wanted to let him be quiet. He slowly put down the storybook in his hand, he pretended to be bored as he read the booklet.
Su had obviously read the things written in the booklet. It was something that every mecha operator had to read. He could even recite them. However, these things were very useful to him.
“Rules for mecha operators…”
“One-star mecha operators are paid 100,000 federal dollars a month…”
“During the non-battle period, eight hours of mecha training every day. Three mecha battles per week…”
Dudian quickly flipped through the book. He casually threw it aside and picked up a book on Mech Knowledge. He casually flipped through the book but his mind quickly began to think.
“I didn’t expect that the days of these mecha operators were not easy. Eight hours of training every day consumed a lot of physical and mental energy. The salary was 100,000 federal dollars. With Su Ming’s salary, it would take two and a half months to earn money for his sister’s treatment. But he still owed a huge debt…”Dudian’s eyes flashed, he thought of the scenes he saw when he entered the city. Not all of them were from the east, but there were also a few from the west.
The meaning of the word “Federation”was very obvious. This was not an empire, nor was there only one race!
“It seems that this is indeed the place where the survivors gathered after the great calamity ended. Regardless of technology or culture, they have all been passed down. The humans in the giant wall should also be survivors. It’s just that the technology there has been suppressed. However, I have never been to the Holy Kingdom. I don’t know if it is the same in the imperial city where the Seven Kings Live. But the technology of the Empire is not that bad.”
“But why does the empire suppress the technology in the giant wall? Is there any place where the technology has been suppressed?”Dudian thought but put away his thoughts.
He couldn’t even deal with his own matters so it was useless to think about it.
“Su Ming is a one star mecha master. According to the above, there are five levels of mecha masters. One star to five stars! A one star mecha master operating the black lizard mecha has the combat power of a lower abyss. However the destructive power of the mecha is enough to kill a middle or even upper abyss. However the other hardware doesn’t match. It is very difficult to hit the enemy with such a powerful weapon like the laser battle knife. The overall combat power is only that of a lower abyss.”
“A two-star mecha operator operating a flying dragon is comparable to a middle abyss. A three-star mecha operator operating a sky executioner is comparable to a upper abyss…”
“A four-star mecha operator operating an Athena is comparable to the Lord of the Abyss!”
“A five-star mecha operator operating a god of creation is comparable to a King!”
“A one-star mecha operator like Su Ming needs to train hard every day. He doesn’t have the right to ask for leave. He will only be allowed to take special leave if his relatives die…”Dudian’s eyes were half closed as he calculated in his heart, “But a three-star mecha master can ask for leave. A three-star mecha master can be the captain of the black lizard mecha on the battlefield. He is also known as a mecha master!”
“As for a four-star mecha master, in addition to the official ‘four-star Mecha Master’title, he is also known as the king of Mecha!”
“And a five-star mecha master is known as a legend!”
Dudian sighed in his heart. If it wasn’t for the fact that there was a condition that prevented him from becoming a five-star mecha master, he would have become a five-star mecha master no matter what, in this way, he would be able to get a creator-level mecha which was comparable to the combat strength of the King of the Empire!
However, it wasn’t difficult for him to become a three-star mecha master. He could easily meet the requirements of his brain and body. If he spent more time, he would be able to become a four-star mecha master. As for a five-star mecha master, he could complete the test in two months’time. Although a five-star mecha master needed to reach the level of a master in terms of military tactics, he also needed a huge amount of mecha knowledge, there were also many other types of knowledge, but he could learn all of them. The only thing that he could not do was that a five-star mecha master needed to hand over all of his loyalty!
The loyalty here wasn’t something that a Knight’s oath could represent. Instead, it was to hand over his body to the military. He would be modified by them, and he would be placed in a balance. His life and death wouldn’t be up to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1061
chapters.content:
Chapter 1061 – Chapter 150: Abnormal
Dudian wasn’t in a hurry to apply for the mecha master exam. Instead, he finished reading the two books related to mecha by Su Ming’s bedside. After reading the two books, he found that his caution was correct. These two books completely subverted the concept of “Mecha”in his mind.
Although he had interrogated Su Ming about the operating methods of the mecha, but he only focused on the basic operation of the mecha. His understanding of the “Mecha”itself.., it came from the imagination of the sci-fi stories and movies of the old era. However, the federation’s mecha was not a battle weapon that was assembled from metal machinery. Its structure was extremely complicated, and it even looked like a living being!
The titanium alloy outer shell, the complicated circuits that looked like blood vessels, as well as the cooling liquid and recovery liquid that flowed in the circuits, were just like the blood of the mecha. In addition, the mecha was just like humans. The heart and brain were the core forbidden areas, the brain carried the computing and intelligent mainframe of the mech. The heart was the core of the energy source. All the energy needed for the movement of the machine was exported from the heart.
“It’s not simple fuel energy, nor is it nuclear energy or electricity energy. This is a brand new energy source…”dudian muttered. Three hundred years had passed and the wise men were born out of the survivors, they had developed a brand new energy source. This kind of energy would allow the mech to be used as a weapon in the fantasy. It would burst out with terrifying non-human strength. It could also drive thousands or even tens of thousands of tons of spacecraft into the sky.
“If I can get the blueprints of these mechs, I can control a lion army. As long as I have the resources, I can continue to expand. This is much faster than cultivating an abyss. It will help me to overthrow the empire at the fastest speed. I can control the empire and then find her…”Dudian’s eyes were getting brighter and brighter, he couldn’t help but feel excited. It would be too difficult for him to overthrow the seven kings of the Empire by himself!
However, if there was an abyss lion in the imperial capital, it would be enough to help him pacify the forces under the Seven Kings. Moreover, if he could make a creator’s mech then he would have enough strength to fight against the Seven Kings!
The reason why the federation had been in a stalemate with the empire for so many years was very complicated. Perhaps the federation was like the Empire. There were enemies at the other borders that needed to be dealt with, however Dudian felt that the main reason was that the federation’s attack couldn’t pass through the god of War’s wall.
The Empire took advantage of the geographical advantage of the god of war’s wall. It was easy to defend but difficult to attack. They only needed to put in half of their forces to defend. The federation might have other reasons or because they weren’t united enough. There were too many interests involved so they hadn’t been able to attack the Empire with full force, the troll God cannon that they had seen on the battlefield was enough to cause heavy losses to the Empire’s border guards.
If it wasn’t for the god of war wall that was three thousand meters tall then the empire would have long been destroyed.
However, Dudian had a way to sneak over the god of war wall. If he could send a large number of mechs to the imperial capital then it would be enough to cause the greatest damage!
“The troll god Cannon could even kill a king. It could even Pierce through a spaceship. No matter how strong a king’s body is, it can’t be compared to titanium alloy. However the abilities of these kings are strange. If their bodies aren’t completely turned into ashes then they might be able to survive even if their hearts are pierced. Just like Crimson Moon.”Dudian thought, the federation had technological weapons that could intimidate the king. If he could learn how to make them, it would be the beginning of his war!
The next day.
Dudian and Zhao Dabao went out together with their roommates. They came to another mecha master training room in the base. This training room was very spacious. It was a common training room. There were no mechas in it. The training relied on a mecha simulation helmet and a smart computer to carry out the training. It could be set up on different battlefields, there were plains, deserts, swamps, hills, forests and other different environments.
There were 20 to 30 people training in the training room. Dudian and Zhao Dabao picked two simulation training machines and put on the helmet. They scanned their irises and logged into the mech.
Dudian deliberately took Zhao Dabao to a remote seat. When Zhao Dabao’s earphones rang with the electronic sound of “Registration of the Mech”, he quickly took out two frozen eyeballs from his pocket and stuffed them into his eyes, the light from the iris scan shone into his eyes from the helmet. An electronic female voice came from the headset, “Identity scanning… identity recording… Staff Sergeant Su Ming, do you want to start the simulation training?”
“Yes!”Dudian said. He quickly removed the two frozen eyeballs and put them into his pocket. He took a deep breath and puffed the air into his eyeballs. He squeezed his eyes out, the scene in his sight was no longer in the training room. It was filled with countless flying lights. There were many mechas. Some of them looked like human-shaped wild boars with two tusks on their heads, some of them looked like tigers lying on the ground.
Only the black lizard that Dudian had seen before was not black and white.
“Su Ming is a soldier. His identity is bound so he can only choose this military black lizard to train. The other mechas are commercial entertainment mechas developed by the company that made this training system…”Dudian understood the situation from the booklet, after a simple glance at the other mechas, he chose the only black lizard that was displayed on the military page to train.
After choosing the mecha, he began to choose the scene and difficulty.
The difficulty was divided into six levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced, difficulty, master, Abyss!
As a one-star mecha, the difficulty of the black lizard mecha was also a one-star difficulty match. When the master level difficulty was completed, it meant that the operating standard would be able to steadily pass the two-star Mecha Master Assessment.
As for the Abyss difficulty, it should be the full potential of the black lizard mecha simulated by the AI. If it was operated by a human, it would be possible to pass unless it was as perfect as the AI and there were no mistakes.
Dudian was curious and looked forward to the first time he played with a mech. He didn’t make things difficult for himself. He chose a plain environment first. However he found that the beginner and intermediate difficulty were gray and he couldn’t choose, the lowest difficulty was advanced difficulty. This meant that Su Ming had passed the intermediate difficulty and his standard had reached advanced level. He was considered to be above average among the 1-star mecha operators.
After the selection was done, the interface in front of him was quickly broken. The actual battle scene was loaded.
A moment later, Dudian found himself in a mech. He looked out of the mech’s mirror and saw that he was surrounded by a plain. He looked down and saw that all the buttons were the same as those in the black lizard. The simulation was very realistic.
At this time, the countdown to the start of the battle came from the top of his head.
Dudian looked around and put his hands on the operating table.
Eight beams of light appeared around him. When the beams dispersed, there were eight giant monsters made up of virtual data. They were eight nocturnal wolves that were more than ten meters long.
These nocturnal wolves had black fur and green fur. Their bodies were agile and their mouths were full of fangs. They were drooling and making low growls. It was as if they were real monsters that surrounded the mech.
Soon, the first night wolf took the lead and rushed over from behind dudian.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. His hands quickly reacted on the operating table. He lifted the joystick and the mech slid to the side to avoid the attack of the night wolves. At the same time, he used his super fast hand speed to trigger the laser knife of the mech, it went through the stomach of the night wolf and cut it into two pieces.
At this time, the other seven night wolves howled and pounced at the same time.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he used his super fast hand speed to trigger the thrusters of the mech. He briefly took off and the machine guns on his body shot out. Bullets rained down and bombarded the night wolves in the dust.
At the same time, he used his super fast hand speed to attack. At the same time, he opened the infrared detector. He saw the shadows of the seven night wolves in the thick fog. He immediately rushed towards one of the night wolves at the edge.
The laser blade of the mech was very flexible in his hand. He cut off the night wolves with one slash. He then killed the other three night wolves.
At this time, the remaining four night wolves locked onto him. They roared and rushed at him.
Dudian turned the joystick in his hand. His fingers were as fast as a phantom. The legs of the mech suddenly began to smoke. The next moment, it suddenly began to spin. The laser blade in his hand was raised. The brilliant light of the blade turned into a circle, the four night wolves were killed at the same time!
When the four night wolves disappeared into white light, Dudian heard the sound of “Congratulations on passing”. He couldn’t help but be startled. He was relieved. He didn’t expect that he could pass the advanced difficulty on the first try, it seemed that after he was completely familiar with it, he would soon become a three-star mech pilot. He could apply for leave to leave the base and go outside to understand the full face of the federation.
After the screen returned to the page, Dudian saw the screen full of jubilant scenes. His mood became better as he continued to choose the next difficulty.
While Dudian was immersed in the training of the Mecha, a twenty-seven or twenty-eight year old youth was making a cup of coffee and yawning in an office of the Military Archives Management headquarters of the Federation’s Border Defense Mecha Division, he looked at the computer in front of him which kept flashing data. His task was to manage the files of all the soldiers in the military. However, although it was said that he was in charge of it, in fact, these files were managed by a brain, he didn’t need to operate them manually so his position was quite empty. He wanted to go to work and play games.
Unfortunately, the records management department blocked all external signals and cut off internal signals. He could only stare blankly and couldn’t do anything.
Suddenly, a notification popped up on the computer in front of him: “Soldier Information Abnormal.”
“Abnormal?”The young man was just about to stand up and stretch his neck when he saw the notification pop up. He couldn’t help but be stunned. He immediately opened it and a page of information popped up, recording all the information of a soldier.
“Abnormal Blood Type?”The young man was stunned. He suddenly thought of something and pulled out the latest battle time of the border defense of Region 3 from the computer next to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1062
chapters.content:
Chapter 1062 – Chapter 1,51St: Hosk Company
“The battle ends on the afternoon of the 21st…”the young man looked at the time of the recent battle in zone three and the details of the battle. Then, he looked at the data of the soldiers that had been entered into the database, the latest refresh time, it was the 21st.
The young man’s eyes were a little confused. After thinking for a moment, his face suddenly changed. “Not good! A demon has sneaked in!”
He suddenly stood up and was prepared to report this matter to the military so that they could find out the spy that the demon had sneaked in. However, when his finger opened the communication list on the communication device, the name at the top of the list suddenly made him realize something. He immediately took the lead to open this name and report the matter to the military.
“A demon spy has sneaked into the military?”A gentle male voice came from behind the communication device. After hearing the young man’s words, he fell into silence as if he was thinking.
The young man responded, not daring to urge him. Even though they were separated by the communicator, his back could not help but bend slightly, and his attitude was humble. Not long after, the gentle male voice behind the communicator spoke again, he said, “Contact little six and have him enter the mecha training system from the background to check on this person’s mecha training situation. Also, there’s no need to report this matter to the military. Send me a copy of this person’s information.”
The youth was startled for a moment and quickly nodded: “I understand, Boss.”
Dudian appeared in a swampy area in the base’s mecha training room. There were many crocodiles swimming in the swampy area. His back was like a withered tree. He felt that the mecha was gradually sinking. Both of his legs had sunk into the mud. The Abyss difficulty environment was not optional. The system would change it immediately. Perhaps during the battle the swampy environment would suddenly turn into a desert.
“No wonder it is Abyss difficulty. It is in a desperate situation.”Dudian was calm. He had experienced countless life and death battles. Such a dangerous situation didn’t move him at all. He didn’t stay in a daze. He quickly attacked, ordinary people wouldn’t be able to reach the hand speed no matter how much training they had. The kinetic energy exploded in an instant. Flames shot out from the legs of the mech. The swamp exploded and the mech rushed out of the swamp.
The surrounding crocodiles sensed the movement and quickly roared as they rushed forward.
Whoosh!
Some crocodiles opened their mouths and shot out sludge shells. The power was enough to break the giant tree.
Some of the scales on the body of the crocodiles stood up and scattered like shrapnel.
Dudian immediately raised the energy shield of the mech and pulled the joystick. The Mech Shook Like a ghost. He took out his laser knife and found a gap in the dense attacks. He stepped on the swamp but didn’t fall, he rushed towards the crocodile as if he was walking on flat ground. The light of the knife rotated and quickly cut off a few large heads.
Five minutes later, Dudian took off his helmet and exhaled. He felt a bit sour.
“I have passed the Abyss. This result is enough for me to apply for the two-star exam.”Dudian thought. Although the difficulty of the Abyss was close to perfection but it was only relative to ordinary people, his physique had far surpassed ordinary people. Whether it was reaction, hand speed, thinking speed, or the ability to adapt in battle, it was not something ordinary people could compare to, as long as the mecha could withstand it, he could do it to the extreme.
“The speed of upgrading from advanced to Abyss is a bit fast. I don’t know if it will attract the attention of the higher-ups. But there is no time for me to slowly hide. Once the blood test report is noticed, the blood type will be different from Su Ming’s.”Dudian thought, he had to leave as soon as possible to find a new identity.
However, it was much more difficult to get an identity in the federation than in the giant wall of the empire. After all, the technology here was advanced. The streets were full of monitors. The identity information of all the civilians was recorded in the central computer, it was impossible to fabricate. However, fortunately, these problems were only difficult for ordinary people. He believed that the federation must have an invisible dark side and there was an underground transaction.
Moreover, he felt that even if the technology here was more advanced than the old era, it wouldn’t be able to record all the data of the residents into the central computer. He only needed to find a person with status, he would replace them just like how he replaced Su Ming.
He looked at the time. Only half an hour had passed and there were seven and a half hours of training.
Dudian thought for a moment and put on his helmet. He chose the Abyss difficulty again.
The first place that appeared was in the forest. It was surrounded by giant trees which greatly restricted the movement of the mechs. Dudian saw many monsters on the detector. He turned the mechs into semi-automatic mode. Half of the mechs were handed to the intelligent custodian. For example, when the enemy appeared behind the mechs, the mechs would automatically shoot the machine guns, he didn’t need to operate it.
Most of the pilots were in semi-automatic mode. It was easy and stable. After all, the human brain’s reaction speed was not as fast as the AI system.
This time, Dudian deliberately injured the mech to damage it. He observed the parts of the mech and the system.
When the arm of the mech was bitten off by a forest wolf, Dudian saw black liquid spurting out of the mechanical arm. It looked like blood but the color was pitch black. It looked like oil. It was the repair liquid that was transferred from the energy belt of the mech.
The repeated observation caused the mech to be damaged and torn apart by the monsters. The challenge was also declared a failure.
Dudian continued to log into the challenge and continue to observe. He was completely uninterested in fighting.
The eight hours of training soon ended. When Dudian heard the sound of the notification, he took off his helmet. He saw that the others in the training room were doing the same action. However, most of them were twisting their necks and sighing, they looked very tired.
Dudian and Zhao Dabao went to the canteen to eat dinner. They went back to the dormitory. They were about to lie down to rest when someone came to look for him. It was the burly youth who had taken him to leader Li’s place.
“Leader Li is looking for you.”The burly youth called out to Dudian.
Dudian frowned. His heart sank. was he going to kill his way out of here tonight?
He got up and quietly followed.
Zhao Dabao was also puzzled but didn’t ask any more questions. He got up and comforted dudian.
Soon, Dudian saw Captain Li again. He was still in his office. However, he wasn’t the only one in the office. There were three other young men. From their uniforms, they were also pilots.
“They are all here.”Captain Li saw Dudian come in, he nodded: “You are very lucky. HAWSK company has selected four of you from the hundreds of one-star pilots in our three regions. You should pack up and go to Hawsk Company for the interview tomorrow. Of course, if you don’t want to go, you can stay. The great cause of border defense also needs you.”
Dudian was at a loss. He looked at the three people next to him. They were full of surprise and disbelief. It seemed that they had obtained a good thing.
“Hosk Company? The company can actually come to the military to recruit people? What kind of company is this?”Dudian was puzzled. He wasn’t familiar with the forces in the federation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1063
chapters.content:
Chapter 1063 – Chapter 152: Consortium
“I want to quit.”
Dudian opened his mouth after a moment of hesitation.
The three people turned around in astonishment. Some were puzzled while others looked like fools.
Captain Li looked at Dudian in surprise. He didn’t expect that there would be people who would quit. Although he said so but he didn’t expect that these people would stay. After all, everyone knew what the border defense was, it couldn’t be compared to HAWSK company. If Hawsk Company gave him an acceptance letter, he would be willing to resign from the position of captain.
“You want to quit?”Captain Li couldn’t help but ask. He was afraid that Dudian would make a mistake and say the wrong words.
Dudian nodded: “I’m willing to stay and continue to maintain the great cause of the border defense!”
The three people’s mouth twitched as they felt as if they were going to F * ck a horse.
Captain Li was speechless. He was just saying polite words. Who knew that the Hothead would actually listen to him!
After a moment of silence.., captain li sighed: “I am very pleased to have your words. But Su Ming you have to think carefully. Although the border defense also needs talents like you but the invitation from the Horsk Company is a good opportunity. Don’t you lack money? The salary of the Horsk Company is at least three times or even higher than your current salary. In addition, the Horsk Company also said that the four of you were selected by them. Please be present for the interview. If you really want to continue to stay at the border then you should give up during the interview. But I still suggest that you seriously consider it.”
At this moment, he sincerely hoped that Dudian could think clearly and stay in the Horsk Company. He knew about Dudian’s family situation. He didn’t want him to be confused by his words and choose the wrong path.
“Do you have to go for an interview?”Dudian was surprised. He felt that there was something unusual about this interview, “Why did you choose Su Ming out of hundreds of pilots?”? His conditions and skills were ordinary. Was it because I had passed the Abyss Difficulty Yesterday? If so, then the other three were also pilots who had cleared the abyss difficulty?”
“If not for this reason, then… I have been exposed!”
Dudian’s heart was frightened. The more he thought about it, the more he felt that the possibility was greater. If his identity had been exposed, then the interview invitation from the HAWSK company was obviously a banquet. The three people next to him were just a foil, in order to make him less prominent and to reduce his vigilance.
“If the enemy knows that I am a demon then this interview is bait…”Dudian’s eyes flashed.
“You should think about it.”Captain Li saw that Dudian was silent. He didn’t know what was going through his mind so he tried to persuade him, he said to the other three: “This is just an interview invitation. It is not a 100% acceptance. So the military will retain your military status for the time being. If the interview fails then you can come back and continue your work. If you pass then I wish you good luck.”
“Thank you leader Li.”The three of them thanked him.
Leader Li waved his hand and sent them away.
After leaving leader Li’s office, the three of them were so excited that they couldn’t help but rub their fists. They wanted to pack their things and bid farewell to the prison-like training base. Suddenly, a cold voice called out to the three of them.
They looked back and saw that it was the hothead who refused the invitation from the HAWSK company.
“Have you passed the Abyss Difficulty?”Dudian asked the three.
One of them suddenly thought of something and smiled: “Yes, I just passed half a month ago. I am preparing to take the two-star Assessment!”
The other two were startled: “We are almost the same.”
“So everyone has passed the Abyss difficulty training?”One of the youth with a mole on his face laughed: “It seems that this is the reason why the HAWSK company chose us.”
“Haha!”
“Let’s go back and pack our things. Don’t delay tomorrow’s interview.”
The few of them laughed as they left.
Dudian stood in the same place. Was it because they had passed the Abyss difficulty? So only four of the hundreds of pilots had passed the Abyss difficulty?
Or was it because of the disguise of the HAWSK company?
“If I refuse then I will be exposed. If I don’t refuse then I will be ambushed…”Dudian walked forward, “I don’t know what the existence of the HAWSK company is. If they know my identity then why not let the military arrange a mission to ambush me at the mission location? Wouldn’t it be more natural and easier?”
