“In any case, since I can’t escape, I can only go and take a look. If it is a trap, I don’t know if it will be able to trap me unless there is a Creator…”Dudian felt uneasy and went back to the dormitory.
Zhao Dabao asked him about it. Dudian immediately told him about the interview with Hawsk Company.
The reaction was the same as those three. It was even more exaggerated than those three. Zhao Dabao was completely stunned. The other people in the dormitory were also stunned. They fell into a short silence. After a while, they burst into cheers, they ran to Dudian’s side. They hooked onto his neck and hammered his chest. They were jealous and envious.
“Su Ming, is there smoke coming from your ancestral grave? You actually got an interview invitation from Hawsk Company? ! My God!”
“Get lost! Your ancestral grave is smoking. I have already seen Su Ming’s face. He has a bright future!”
“Su Ming, you’re lucky this time. Don’t forget about us brothers when you soar in the future.”
“You actually managed to get into Hosk Company. You’re still pretending to be so calm. Do you know what Hosk Company does? Even if you work as a cleaner, your salary is higher than ours!”
“Nonsense, how can Hosk Company have a cleaner? They’re all machines that sweep the floor!”
“HAWSK company cultivates master mecha. This is a seed company of the Rockefeller Consortium. Su Ming might be able to see a god of creation in the future. He might even have a chance to touch it!”
Dudian was surprised as he listened to their words. He gathered some useful information from them. HAWSK company was a company that made mechas. Most of the military mechas came from HAWSK company, this company was also one of the four consortia of the federation. It was the number one seed company of the Rockefeller Consortium!
It was likely that they were recruited to work as mech testers in the company. Their status was high. The most important thing was that HAWSK company’s benefits were far better than the military, it was the Holy Land that countless mechas dreamed of.
The next day.
Dudian and the other three packed their things and put on their luggage. They boarded the army vehicles outside the base and drove towards the Hosk Company.

chapters.title: Chapter 1064
chapters.content:
Chapter 1064 – Chapter 153: Highway Of Death
The Army’s war vehicle escorted them to the edge of the city. Dudian and the others saw several black beast-like cars parked on the roadside. The quality of the cars was obvious from the texture of the paint, these cars were top-grade cars.
A middle-aged gentleman in a tuxedo was waiting by the side of the car. He was dressed meticulously. His hair was very neat. He had dyed blonde hair which made him look like an upper-class aristocrat, the dark golden hand on his wrist showed his mature temperament. He waved to the war vehicle and waited for it to stop. He came forward to show his identity. He was the assistant in charge of the administration department sent by the HAWSK company to pick up Dudian and the others.
Dudian and the others were surprised to see that an assistant in charge of the administration department looked so elegant. They had a deeper understanding of the HAWSK company.
The few of them got off the vehicle and were transferred to the black car. Dudian understood that in peacetime in the federation, army vehicles were prohibited to enter the city. This rule made him smell a different meaning.
The car drove along the road into the city. The scenery outside the window was getting clearer. The fog that shrouded the road gradually faded. It didn’t take long for Dudian to see that there were people on the road in front of the car, they were walking with crutches. They looked like beggars. Their hair was disheveled as they walked along the road.
The car approached. It seemed that Dudian heard the roar of the car engine. He looked back and saw a dirty face. It was a teenager but he was starving. The Rag on his chest was lifted up by the wind, the ribs inside were shriveled. It was a shocking sight.
The teenager’s eyes suddenly lit up as he saw the car. He opened his hand and rushed towards the middle of the road. He stretched out his hand to stop the car.
“Damn scavengers!”The middle-aged man in a tuxedo who was sitting in the passenger seat saw the teenager’s figure. He cursed in a low voice. His tone was full of disgust. He took out a handkerchief from his pocket and covered his mouth, he ordered the driver to roll down the window and reach out to the window. There was a gun in his hand!
Dudian’s eyes flashed cold as he saw the gun.
Bang!
The gunshot rang out. The youth who tried to stop the car was shot to death. The middle-aged man’s marksmanship was very outstanding. He directly hit the youth’s forehead. The terrifying power of the bullet blew up the youth’s head, the teenager’s head turned into a headless corpse and fell down. Blood flowed out and dyed the road red.
“Go around.”The middle-aged man pulled back his hand and rolled up the window. He used a handkerchief to cover his mouth to wipe the gun. It seemed that the gun was infected with germs. He wiped the gun very carefully, at the same time, he coldly ordered the driver.
The driver’s technology was very skillful. The body of the car shook slightly and went around the body of the teenager. The people sitting in the car didn’t feel much shaking.
Dudian looked out of the window. The blood of the teenager was still flowing out from his neck. The wind of the car drove the leaves on the ground to cover up the blood. However more blood was flowing out from the leaves.
Dudian turned his head and looked at the other three pilots in the car. He found that their expressions were normal. It seemed that they were used to it.
He was silent for a moment. He suddenly felt that something was missing in his heart. He didn’t know what was missing but there was a voice muttering in his heart: it was the same everywhere..
When he first entered the federation, he saw tall steel buildings, beautiful buildings and clean cities. He felt that the civilization here had never been lost. He felt as if he had returned to his home 300 years ago. However, the actions of the middle-aged man in a tuxedo.., he found it hard to believe. It was as if he had woken up from a beautiful fantasy. His heart became extremely cold.
He didn’t ask why he shot the youth. What was a scavenger? But he knew that the one who had fallen was a life.
The most frightening thing was that the soldiers, warriors and mecha operators who were protecting the federation and the border defense… the three next to him turned a blind eye to it. They were used to it.
Who were they protecting?
The car roared like a beast as it ran on the empty road. It passed by the mountains and trees at a very fast speed. But under Dudian’s dynamic vision, everything felt very slow, it was enough for him to distinguish every scenery on the road.
He saw bones wrapped in rags on the road. Some of the bones had bullet wounds. Some of the bones were intact. Some of the bones were rotten corpses. They had been dead for less than two weeks. There were birds with black feathers on the corpses, their mouths were as big and sharp as turtledoves as they gnawed at their flesh and blood.
The car ran over the edge of the corpses. Some of the rotten bones were crushed by the wheels of the car. Dudian saw other scavengers like the teenager. They were dressed in rags, some of the scavengers were as thin as firewood. There were two or three of them. Some were big and some were small. They seemed to be a family. Some of the scavengers saw cars and rushed to the road to stop them. However, they were shot by the middle-aged man in a tuxedo.
Some of them quickly moved aside when they saw the cars. It seemed that they knew that their weak bodies couldn’t stop the steel monster that was making beast-like sounds.
As they drove for more and more time, Dudian saw more and more scavengers. Later on, he saw groups of scavengers wandering aimlessly along the road like zombies.
When he saw these groups of scavengers, the middle-aged man in Tuxedo asked the driver to open the window on the roof of the car. He put on a machine gun and put on a gas mask. He stood on the co-pilot and was ready to shoot.
There seemed to be a leader among the group of scavengers. He saw the posture of the middle-aged man in Tuxedo and quickly scolded the scavengers who were excited to see the car. However, his scolding seemed to be insufficient. Some scavengers listened to him, however, most of them had the courage to rush onto the road. They waved their hands and tried to stop the car.
Bang Bang Bang!
The machine gun was spitting fire. Seven or eight scavengers were shot into pieces. The power of the machine gun was extremely strong. Their bodies exploded after being shot.
The car slowed down and ran over the body.
The rest of the Scavengers hid on the other side of the road. They were trembling in fear. Pairs of black and white eyes looked at the middle-aged man in a tuxedo in fear.
Dudian looked out of the window at the scavengers. He suddenly guessed why Su Ming’s sister had lung cancer at such a young age. No matter how beautiful the world was, there was always a shadow because of the light.
The car gradually drove to the end of the road. Dudian couldn’t remember how many “Scavengers”he had killed until the shadow of the steel building appeared at the end of the road, the middle-aged man put away the machine gun on the roof of the car. He took off his helmet and sat in the front passenger seat. He used a new handkerchief to wipe the sweat on his neck and face.
“Everyone, when you go to HAWSK company, you have to refuel and try to pass.”The middle-aged man in the tuxedo said after his breathing was smooth, he turned to dudian and smiled politely: “Otherwise, I don’t want to make another trip on the way back. There are too many damn things.”
“Of course, we will pass.”
“I also hope to pass.”
The three people around Dudian smiled.
The other person patted Dudian’s shoulder: “Don’t worry, we will pass.”
Dudian raised his head and looked at him. A smile slowly appeared on his face.
The man saw Dudian’s smile and also smiled. He talked to the middle-aged man in the tuxedo. He wanted to ask about the content of the interview.
No one paid attention to Dudian and no one understood his smile.
The car entered the city. There were no scavengers outside the window. The scenery became more and more lively. There were more and more steel buildings in the surroundings. The car stopped at the junction of an extremely prosperous and imposing square.

chapters.title: Chapter 1065
chapters.content:
Chapter 1065 – Chapter 154Th: Money
“Here we are.”
The middle-aged man in a tuxedo pushed open the door of the car. He was a gentleman who didn’t know how to swear. He turned around and opened the door of the car. Dudian and the others were invited out.
The four of them got out of the car. They were shocked by the magnificent world in front of them.
“Is this Udier District? !”The mole youth next to them was shocked.
The other two came back to their senses and looked at each other: “Is this the most prosperous udier district in our copper ship city? !”
Dudian immediately cooperated with them. He was shocked but secretly remembered the name of the border city.
“That is the headquarters of our HAWSK company’s branch in Copper Ship City!”The middle-aged man in Tuxedo wasn’t surprised by their shock. There was a faint superior smile on his face, he raised his hand and pointed at a magnificent building at the end of the square, he slowly said: “The entire UDIER district is the territory of our HAWSK company. I heard that the reason why this place is called ‘Udier District’is because the grandson of the 7th Master of the ROCKEFAY Consortium is named UDIER after him.”
Dudian was slightly startled. He understood the foundation and wealth of the Rockefeller consortium as well as the influence of the consortium in this place!
The three people next to him were stunned. After a long time they took a deep breath and sighed.
“Udier district is actually the name of a person. The place with the most rich people in our copper ship city is actually the property of the Rockefeller Consortium. If I have a street that can be defined by my name in my lifetime then it would be worth it even if I die.”
“I’ve long heard of the name of Urdil District. I heard that even the roads here are made of gold. Looks like even though the rumors are exaggerated, it’s not much different.”
“If we can pass the interview, we can stay here forever!”
“Yeah, this place can only be entered by level five citizens. Although we are qualified to come, the training in the base is endless. Without becoming a three-star mecha master, we are not qualified to go out.”
The more they talked, the more excited they became. There was even a trace of madness in their eyes. They wanted to pass the interview no matter what!
The middle-aged man in the tuxedo smiled as he heard the three’s words. He couldn’t hide the smile on his face, “The rumors have not been exaggerated. Even poverty has limited the imagination of the rumors. You See, although the road is not made of gold, but the road is made of Bluestone. Bluestone is not only expensive and rare, but also extremely difficult to cut. The cost of the road is not inferior to gold. It will only be more expensive!”
The three of them were stunned.
The middle-aged man glanced at Dudian. Although he was curious but he didn’t say anything. He looked at Dudian but didn’t find anything strange. After all, some people were introverted, they didn’t like to talk too much.
“Let’s go.”The middle-aged man took back his eyes and walked forward.
The three of them lifted their feet and were ready to follow. However, they thought of what he said. Their steps were light and silent. They were afraid that they would step on heavy stones, they felt as if their bodies were about to float.
Dudian followed behind the three of them. He turned his head and looked at the square. He saw people coming and going. Everyone was dressed luxuriously. Any small jewelry in their hands looked expensive, even the salaries of the mecha operators stationed at the border wouldn’t be enough to buy one piece. In addition there were monitors installed on many buildings. There were also some guards patrolling the edge of the square.
“Money is the master of the world of ordinary people…”Dudian thought.
In the world of the giant wall of the empire, wealth didn’t represent everything. Power was the master. But here, wealth was power!
Soon, the four of them followed the middle-aged man. They came to the largest building at the end of the square. They climbed up the broad steps and came to the front of the tall building. There was a statue standing by the fountain, it was an old man. He looked kind. He was either a great figure or a person with great power. He glanced at the statue and followed the others into the building.
As soon as they entered the reception hall on the ground floor of the building, Dudian and three other mecha operators saw two giant mechas standing in the hall. One was 15-16 meters tall while the other was more than 20 meters tall. It seemed that these two mechas were put out for exhibition. There were many people looking at them. There were also people taking photos. They were as short as ants in front of the mechas.
“It’s the shark hunting mecha!”
“That’s the Jianhu T-3 Mecha! Oh My God!”
When the three people beside them saw these two mecha, they could not help but widen their eyes in excitement.
These two mecha were not part of the military and had not been in service. They were not as mature as the official military mecha like the black lizard mecha and the flying dragon mecha. The maturity referred to here included many aspects, such as the mecha’s manufacture, operation.., practicality, adaptability, and so on. The black lizard mecha was definitely not the best among the low-end mecha, nor was it the one with the strongest combat power. However, its overall factors were enough to rank in the top three, which was why it was listed as the representative of the military’s low-end mecha, the most important factor was that the production cost was relatively low and could be mass-produced!
However, the shark hunter mecha and the sword tiger mecha in front of them were the kings of mid-to low-end mecha and the cream of the crop of high-end mecha. These two mecha were developed by the Hosker Company!
In the eyes of many mecha enthusiasts, the shark hunter mecha was the uncrowned king of mid-to low-end mecha, instantly killing the black lizard mecha!
However, the production cost of this mecha was too expensive and could not be mass produced. Furthermore, it was relatively difficult to operate and could only be operated by a two-star mecha master! However, the flying dragon mecha operated by a two-star mecha master was a notch better than the shark hunter mecha. Moreover, it could be mass produced, which caused the position of this mecha to be a little awkward, however, it did not affect his powerful position in the hearts of mecha enthusiasts.
“The last time I saw a shark hunter mecha slaughtering a level seven Impala Magic Beast in the Magic Armor Battle Arena, don’t be too strong and kill our black lizard mecha in an instant!”A mole youth clenched his fists in excitement, his face full of excitement.
“I saw that video too. It’s too exciting!”
“I really want to go up and have a good time!”
The three mecha operators were excited.
The middle-aged man in a tuxedo smiled. His words brought the three of them back to their senses. He brought them to the reception desk to register and then took the transparent elevator upstairs. Sitting in the elevator, the few of them looked down at the hall. Only then did they feel the grandeur of this building. The entire hall was very spacious. Other than the two giant mecha on display, there were also many military weapons listed, such as modified Army Chariots, the entire body was filled with sharp battle knives. When it charged into the battlefield, it would definitely be a killing machine!
The most important thing was that this huge army chariot was actually hanging on a bracket on the wall, like a toy for people to watch.
Very quickly, the elevator stopped at the 20th floor. When they got out of the elevator, the middle-aged man in a tuxedo swiped his card in front of an elevator beside them. This elevator required a VIP card to take. After waiting for a while, the elevator door opened, he led them to the elevator.
The elevator stopped on the 87th floor. The middle-aged man in a tuxedo brought four people to an office. He knocked on the door and heard a dignified voice, “Please come in.”
The three men subconsciously swallowed their saliva. They looked nervous.
Dudian used his X-ray vision to quickly scan the room. There was no ambush. There was only a middle-aged man with broad shoulders sitting on the office chair. He looked out of the window at the bustling city.
“Supervisor, they are here.”The middle-aged man in tuxedo respectfully said.
The middle-aged man turned his head and looked at the four people. He picked up a stack of information, “I have read your information. It meets the requirements of our recruitment. I will ask you a few questions on the spot to see your performance.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1066
chapters.content:
Chapter 1066 – Chapter 1555: Pass
“Please Ask.”
The young man with Mole couldn’t hide the tension in their eyes.
“First question, how many keyboards are there in the Flying Dragon?”The supervisor looked up at the three people. He looked at Dudian who was behind them.
Although it was just a casual stop, but Dudian was keenly aware that the person was coming for him!
“Has his identity been exposed…”Dudian’s eyes flashed. There was no longer any hope in his heart. He just didn’t understand the other party’s purpose.
The three of them looked at each other in dismay. It wasn’t that the problem was too difficult, but… it was too simple. It was too ordinary! If it was an ordinary one-star mecha master, they might not know about this. However, they had been training in the military for many years and had paid attention to the flying dragon mecha. As for the basic keys, the mecha’s introduction was clearly written on it. How could it be considered a difficult question?
However, was the interview at the Hosk Company really that simple?
The three of them hesitated. They felt that there was a trap in this question. They fell into deep thought and repeatedly thought about every word that the supervisor asked.
“What, no one can answer it?”The supervisor frowned slightly.
The three of them looked at each other, the mole youth braced himself and said, “Supervisor, if I remember correctly, there are a total of 84 keyboards in the Flying Dragon Mech. Among them, there are 28 primary keys, 16 secondary keys, 17 mechanical keys, nine induction keys, and 18 exclusive keys of the Flying Dragon Mech…”as he said this.., he raised his head to look at the middle-aged man with some uncertainty.
The middle-aged man met his gaze and nodded slightly. “Not bad. Your answer was very accurate and very detailed.”
The mole-faced young man was stunned, but then his face was filled with excitement as he hurriedly thanked him.
The two people beside him were somewhat dumbfounded. They had not expected the question to be so simple. They hurriedly opened their mouths, wanting to answer, but were pressed down by the supervisor with a raise of his hand, indicating that there was no need to continue.
“Next, the second question. When you came in, you should have seen the Jianhu T-3 model in the hall. Tell me your views on the pros and cons of this mecha,”the middle-aged man said slowly.
“I know.”The muscular young man beside him immediately raised his hand. This question was not difficult, but it was much broader than the first question. However, the pros and cons of the Jianhu T-3 mecha.., he had already been analyzed by experts on the mecha website. As a mecha fan, he had also read this type of article and remembered it clearly. He immediately listed it out. Just as he finished speaking, he suddenly felt a little nervous.
“That’s right. You’re roughly right.”The middle-aged man nodded slightly.
The muscular young man could not help but be overjoyed, his face filled with excitement.
The mole-covered young man and the crew cut young man next to him were filled with annoyance. They could also answer this question. After all, the Jianhu T-3 mecha was too famous. There were countless analysis articles about this mecha.., they had naturally read the few articles that were publicly acknowledged.
“The third question. You answer this question.”The middle-aged man looked at the crew cut youth who had not answered the question before and said indifferently, “What do you think the main components of a mecha are?”
The crew cut youth was stunned for a moment. He could not help but be overjoyed. He was still annoyed that he did not have the time to answer. He did not expect the supervisor to personally give him the opportunity. Moreover, this question was too simple.
“The main components of a mech are the body, energy fluid, mechanical heart. The body can be subdivided into the outer shell…”the youth spoke out the knowledge in the textbook. His face was full of confidence.
The middle-aged man nodded: “The answer is right.”
“You answer the last question.”The middle-aged man raised his hand and pointed at Dudian: “What do you think is the most powerful two-star Mech? What is the reason?”
The three turned to look at Dudian. This question was also very simple. It seemed that Dudian could also answer it. Perhaps the four of them would be accepted.
Dudian thought for a moment and said: “I think it is the Flying Dragon.”
The three couldn’t help but open their eyes wide. They wanted to pat him to see if he was awake.
The middle-aged man smiled: “Why?”
“The Flying Dragon is a two-star mech. I believe that it is the strongest!”Dudian replied with certainty. However, the three people next to him heard his words.
This reason was too simple and brainless. It was like a hot-blooded youth. Anyone who liked to research mechas knew that the strongest two-star mech was the nine God. People preferred to call it the Bacchus, however, even a three-star mecha master would find it difficult to operate this mecha. The requirement for hand speed was too high. If it fell into the hands of an ordinary two-star mecha master, its power would be less than half of that of the Flying Dragon.
However, in terms of mecha, this was a worthy two-star King!
However, the supervisor was next to them. The three of them didn’t have time to remind him. Otherwise, the supervisor would be dissatisfied with them and drag them down. They could only give Dudian a sigh.
“Good.”The middle-aged man smiled: “The interview is over. You, stay. The other three can leave.”
The three looked at the direction of Dudian’s finger. They couldn’t help but suspect that he was pointing at the wrong direction. The youth with a crew cut asked: “Did we pass or did he pass?”
“He passed.”The supervisor replied.
The three of them were stunned. The youth with Mole couldn’t help but ask: “Why? Didn’t we all answer yes? Only his answer is wrong. Why can he pass if he is wrong?”
“The mecha operators that Hawkes wants to recruit need to cooperate with us to develop new mecha. So we need a mecha operator who has both technology and thinking. Your answer is correct but obviously your thinking has been deeply rooted in the market. It is not necessarily a good thing if you know too much.”The middle-aged man indifferently said: “The rules of this interview are like this. If you answer wrong then you will pass.”
“Furthermore, not only did he answer incorrectly, he even thought that the Flying Dragon Mech was the best two-star Mech. Perhaps you would think that he was a cynical youth, but what’s wrong with being patriotic?”
The mole-covered young man and the other two were stunned speechless. They felt their minds go blank. There was only one voice that answered them, telling them that this great opportunity had been lost just like that..
The three of them didn’t dare to question the words of the middle-aged man. They left the office in a daze.
Dudian quietly stood in the same place. His expression was very calm. He didn’t believe the words of the supervisor. It was too far-fetched. If they wanted to test their creativity, they could use smarter and more professional questions.
The biggest problem was that although the questions he asked were simple, they were unsolvable for the federation’s mecha operators.
“Hello, my name is Rocco.”The supervisor announced his name after the three people left. Apparently he didn’t think that the three people who had left were qualified to know his identity, “You have passed the interview of Our Hawkes Company. You can officially enter the company. I will take you to the production area of our Hawkes Company.”
Dudian quietly looked at him but didn’t move, “I am very curious. You know my identity. Why is there no trap here? Do you think that this steel building can stop me? Or is your life not valuable?”
Rocco’s pupils slightly shrank. The smile on his face froze. After a moment he slowly calmed down: “Mr. Su Ming, what do you mean? Do you have any dissatisfaction with our company’s interview?”
“You must know something. Before I use force, it’s best to say it.”Dudian’s voice was very calm.
Rocco’s eyelids twitched and he bitterly laughed, “Sure enough, you devil warriors have the ability that ordinary people don’t know. We didn’t want to alert the enemy in advance. But now it is alright to tell you frankly. Our Hawkes Company has no malice towards you. We sincerely want to recruit you.”
He felt a chill down his body. Although Dudian’s expression didn’t change but he suddenly felt as if he was being stared at by a poisonous snake. His hair stood up and he had goosebumps, his face slightly changed, he hurriedly said: “I know I can’t stop you but if you kill me then your identity will be exposed. The entire federation will be pasted with your wanted poster. I hope we can have a peaceful talk. I will let you see the sincerity of Hawkes company!”
Dudian felt his pores shrink. He was extremely nervous. The killing intent in his eyes faded away, “You went through a lot of trouble to bring me here from the military. I don’t think you want to kill me. Tell me, what is your purpose?”
Rocco’s heart jumped. He didn’t expect that Dudian had already noticed the abnormality. He took a deep breath, “To tell you the truth, what I said before is true. We sincerely invite people like you to work in our Hawkes Company. We need people with extraordinary physiques like you to operate the top mechs!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1067
chapters.content:
Chapter 1067 – Chapter 156Th: Demon, God
“You have one more chance to tell the truth.”Dudian’s eyes were cold as he looked into his eyes, “Although I don’t know much about you. You asked three questions to test me. There are many things that I don’t know but I don’t know as much as you think. YOUR MECHS have an intelligent auxiliary system which is enough to make up for your physical weakness. Even an ordinary person with the aid of an intelligent auxiliary system would be able to sense attacks that are faster than the speed of sound. Why would a demon fighter be your mecha master?”
Rocco was startled, he wryly smiled: “It seems you have mastered a lot of things in such a short time. You are right. There is an intelligent auxiliary system which allows our mecha operators to fight against the experts of the demon race. However, although the intelligent auxiliary system can help but it is not perfect. There are some battle situations that the intelligent system can not deal with. After all, the abilities of the demon race warriors are strange. Their battle methods are different and will continue to change. Even if the intelligent system records all of your known battle methods, there are countless unknown battle methods that the intelligent system can not deal with.”
Dudian frowned as he looked at him. Although he was nervous but he wasn’t lying.
“Moreover we rely too much on the intelligent system. In the end our mecha operators will become useless. Some people want to build all-intelligent war mechas. They rely on intelligence or artificial control. There is no need for a mecha operator! “Once such a mecha appears, it will be subversive to the war and to your demon race. Moreover, it will bring about an unpredictable change to our federation.”
Luo Ke smiled faintly, he said, “Our Hosk Company insists on the belief that human strength is superior to AI. We put people first. We believe that the most powerful mecha will definitely be a mecha that is operated by humans in battle! “However, it is difficult for the human body to keep up with the reactions of the mecha. Even if there is an intelligent auxiliary system, sometimes the mecha operators will make mistakes and be killed by you.”
“So you want to let the Demon Warriors operate your mecha?”Dudian looked at him, “I heard that your company is a seed company of the Rockefeller Consortium. It mainly produces and sells mechas. are all the parts of your mechas produced and assembled in your own factory?”
Rocco was stunned: “Of course. Our mechas manufacturing industry chain is very perfect. Otherwise it would be impossible for us to monopolize the market. Even the military’s mechas are provided by our company.”
“All the parts, including the Intelligent Auxiliary System?”Dudian stared into his eyes: “The monopoly of mechas? Aren’t the other three consortia involved in the mechas industry?”
Rocco didn’t understand why dudian would ask about such trivial things. There would be time to understand these things in the future. Shouldn’t he be concerned about his future or treatment?
“Our Hawkes Company’s foundation and financial resources are enough to protect you. But the premise is that you have to listen to our company’s arrangements. You Don’t have to worry about the rest.”Rocco thought for a moment.
Dudian shook his head, “I just think that if you really monopolize the mech market then you won’t take such a risk. You want to use the demon fighters to develop your own mech. I think that there should be other consortia who are threatening the cake in your hands. Or you want to complete a real monopoly. Or your goal is not just to monopolize the mech!”
Rocco’s eyelids twitched as his heart beat twice. He didn’t think that Dudian’s question was about this. He couldn’t help but look at the youth. He looked a few years younger than him. How could he be so shrewd?
“I don’t know about these things.”Rocco shook his head as he avoided Dudian’s eyes, he frowned: “You Shouldn’t care about these things. You have infiltrated our federation. Your identity has been exposed. Even if you kill me you will be buried with me!”! Today’s interview wasn’t just about you and me. Many people were paying attention to this place. Do you think that our company wouldn’t consider the fact that you are disobedient when they know that you are a Demon?”
Dudian indifferently said: “Of course I know. There should be a lot of people behind the surveillance cameras watching our conversation. As long as I wring your head the alarm will sound. You have already prepared the force and will immediately surround this place. Don’t worry, I will cooperate with you. I am also very interested in your mechs.”
“As long as you cooperate.”Rocco was relieved in his heart. He had been appointed by his superior and was given a death order. He even arranged his wife and children in advance. He was in the mood to go to the battlefield to interview Dudian, he didn’t want to anger the demon if it wasn’t necessary. After all, he was the director of Hawkes Company. His life was more valuable than a demon’s!
“May I know your name, Sir?”
“Dudian.”
“Dudian?”There was a trace of strangeness in Rocco’s eyes. This was the surname of the federation’s Huaxia Civilization. However, the name was a bit of western beautification, he stood up: “Mr. Dudian, please follow me to our Hawkes Company’s Demon Mech Factory.”
Dudian nodded.
Both of them left the office. The middle-aged man in a tuxedo had returned. Rocco told him to prepare the car. There were several dark black vehicles parked in front of the hall. There was a falcon mark on them.
Both of them got into the middle car. There was a man and a woman sitting in the car. Their eyes were fixed on dudian.
Dudian was surprised to see the two of them. The heat in their bodies completely exceeded that of ordinary people. They were comparable to pioneers! Dudian’s identity had been exposed so he didn’t bother to hide it anymore. Golden light flashed in his eyes as he looked at the two of them. He frowned as he saw that there was a magic mark on their chest!
Sure enough, there were two magic Mark Warriors.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. It seemed that what Rocco said was true. Moreover they had been working on the development of the demon’s mech for a long time.
The war chariot started and roared out of the UDIER region.
“Are these the demon fighters who sneaked in?”The two pioneers looked at Dudian and asked Rocco.
Rocco nodded, he introduced to dudian: “These two are also demon fighters. His name is song Ming and her name is Xue Han. They are three-star demon fighters. The level of our demon fighters are the same as the ordinary ones. They are divided into five levels. However the difficulty of the operation is completely different. If they pretend to be ordinary fighters then they can be classified as five-star legendary level.”
“Luo Supervisor, pay attention to your words, we are not demon warriors, we are God Warriors!”Called Song Ming youth coldly looked at Rocco, eyes a few points of hostility emerged.

chapters.title: Chapter 1068
chapters.content:
Chapter 1068 – Chapter 157: Stamp
“A Protoss warrior?”Dudian frowned as he looked at song Ming. Song Ming was speaking Standard Chinese and he wasn’t old, he didn’t have the same killing Aura as the other pioneer level warriors. Could it be that he was a demon warrior trained by the Federation?
Rocco coughed as he was scolded by Song Ming, “I was careless. Both of you are outstanding protoss warriors of our company. This is dudian. He is a demon from the Devil Wall.”
“Is he a real demon warrior?”Song Ming and Xuehan looked at Dudian. The outline of Dudian’s face was clear. It seemed that he had a lot of combat experience. His body was well-proportioned and his clothes faintly revealed the strength of his muscles, but he wasn’t ostentatious. There was nothing special about him.
Song Ming looked at dudian in disappointment: “Did you sneak into our federation because of a superior’s order? Or did you do it yourself?”
Dudian turned his head and looked at the scenery outside the window.
Song Ming’s face was angry: “I’m asking you. Your identity has been exposed. Why are you pretending in front of me? Do you believe that I can make you kneel down and Beg?”
Rocco’s face slightly changed: “Song Ming, he is the person wanted by the higher-ups. The Board of directors is very interested in Mr. Dean. His identity can not be easily exposed. Otherwise you and I will be punished!”
“Board of Directors?”Song Ming’s eyelids slightly twitched. Although he was quite proud, but the “Board of directors”was not something he could provoke. Everything he got was given by the consortium so naturally he could take it away.
“Forget it. Don’t bother with a demon.”Xue Han knew that song Ming cared about his face so she gently persuaded him.
Song Ming snorted but didn’t speak.
Dudian looked back at song Ming and smiled.
“You dare to provoke me…”song Ming saw Dudian’s smile. He was furious. This kid thought that he didn’t dare to hurt him so he deliberately laughed at him. However, before he could finish his thought, he suddenly felt a shadow flash in front of him. Then he felt a sharp pain coming from his cheek. He forgot everything in an instant.
He felt that his cheek was about to be crushed. He even felt death.
The force pulled him forward. His body couldn’t help but follow the force. He didn’t dare to resist because he was afraid that his face would be torn off.
Song Ming slid out of the chair and kneeled on the Chariot.
At this time, the pain on his face disappeared. Song Ming opened his eyes and found himself kneeling in front of dudian. He was shocked and angry. He was about to activate the matchless power in his body when he saw Dudian raise his hand, there was a crisp slap accompanied by a buzzing sound. He felt dizzy and his vision was shaking. He couldn’t help but fall to the ground.
The next moment, a boot stepped on his face.
“I’m not polite to you but a warning!”Dudian was still smiling. He stepped on song Ming’s face and looked up at Xue Han.
Xue Han saw Dudian’s smile and heard his words. She felt cold sweat all over her body. She was sitting next to Song Ming. She saw Dudian move very fast. He grabbed song Ming’s face and pulled him up from the chair, she wanted to help but it was too fast. Moreover she had a kind of danger warning in her heart when Dudian first made his move. Even if she made her move she wouldn’t be able to save anything, she would be attacked!
It turned out that her intuition was right. Although it was a sneak attack but she was able to defeat Song Ming. Her strength wouldn’t be inferior to hers.
“Mr Dean!”Rocco was stunned. He saw song Ming fall at the feet of Dudian. He didn’t think that Dudian would attack song Ming, the impression of the bloodthirsty demon had been deeply engraved in his heart. He couldn’t help but be afraid that Dudian would be angered and start a massacre! From a rational point of view, it wouldn’t be good for Dudian to start a massacre. However, who could guarantee that these bloodthirsty demons would be rational people!
“If you kill me, you will be wanted by our HAWSK company!”Xuehan replied coldly after hearing Rocco’s words.
Dudian smiled.
Bang!
Suddenly there was a sound of a slap. Xue Han’s head was hit to the side. She hit the car door. Her forehead was slightly red. There were five faint fingerprints on her face.
“Your life is not worth to damage me.”Dudian’s voice was very soft: “Although my identity has been exposed and I’m in a difficult situation, but it doesn’t mean that you can be rude and impudent in front of me!”
Xue Han’s brain was buzzing. The slap made her feel that her brain was shaking. It took her a long time to recover. She opened her eyes wide in disbelief. She didn’t expect that Dudian would be so fierce, this quiet and handsome young man would actually fight against her!
Rocco didn’t dare to breathe. He was relieved after he heard Dudian’s words: “MR, Mr Dean, don’t be angry. They don’t have malicious intentions…”
“I don’t mean any harm.”Dudian smiled: “Otherwise they would have died.”
Rocco’s heart trembled as he didn’t dare to say anything more.
Snow Han’s hair stood on end as she heard Dudian’s words. She didn’t doubt the truth of Dudian’s words. The demon race was famous for their brutality. They had the bestial nature of monsters. It wasn’t rare for them to eat human flesh.
The war chariot fell into a short silence.
The body of the war chariot shook as it drove out of the city.
“Can you make him get up?”Maybe it was because Dudian didn’t take any further malicious action. Or maybe it was because Dudian’s gentle and handsome appearance was difficult to associate with the word “Brutal”, snow Han whispered to Dudian.
Dudian turned his head and looked at her in surprise, “Who?”
Xue Han’s face was embarrassed, “It’s the one under your feet…”
“He has offended me. Give him a chance to kneel down.”Dudian smiled, “Many people won’t even have a chance to kneel down.”
Xue Han slightly pursed her lips and wanted to persuade him again. But when she saw the smile on Dudian’s face, her heart suddenly turned cold and she didn’t dare to speak again.
Rocco was worried that he would offend song Ming. At this moment he saw that Xue Han had given up trying to persuade him. He was calm and quiet. At the same time he glanced at song Ming who was firmly stepping on Dudian’s feet, he thought of the other party’s attitude which made him lose face. He was secretly happy.
Song Ming tried to raise his head but he found that his foot was stepping on his face. His jawbone was about to break. He couldn’t say anything. He thought of his awkward posture, his heart was filled with incomparable pain, and his resentment surged to the heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 1069
chapters.content:
Chapter 1069 – Chapter 158: Do Not Provoke
Dudian didn’t see any magnificent sky railway or shining steel buildings in the town. There were only ordinary concrete and brick bungalows. There were many ordinary people dressed in plain clothes, dudian rode a rusty bicycle through the streets. It was like the old feeling of the eighties. It was very different from the bustling city which was full of futuristic technology.
Dudian saw scavenger in ragged clothes lying on the roadside. The scavenger was as skinny as a stick. He was surrounded by flies. The civilians tried to avoid him as they covered their noses.
“Is the factory in the suburbs?”Dudian asked Rocco.
Rocco’s heart trembled as he replied: “Mr Dean don’t be impatient. The wilderness outside the factory is still a distance away from here. But with the speed of our Puss trains we will arrive soon.”
Dudian frowned: “This city was built by your ancestors right? If there aren’t so many people in the city then why do you want to encircle such a large area?”
Rocco wryly smiled: “In the past the population of our city was much more than now. Because of the pollution of the water resources, more and more people were infected by the nuclear radiation. It affected the fertility and the number of offspring slowly decreased. Moreover after the establishment of the central government the people from the edge of the city slowly migrated to the city center. Over time the towns near the city center became overcrowded. The suburbs became ghost towns and no one lived there. Only those damn scavengers lived in those ghost towns.”
Dudian was silent.
Suddenly there was the sound of gunshots coming from the front.
Dudian and Rocco looked forward and saw a middle-aged man dressed as a police officer roll down the window of the carriage. He opened fire and killed a scavenger who was blocking the way.
The carriage quickly passed by the dead scavenger. The body of a seven or eight year old child was lying on the ground. His eyes were fixed on one spot.
“Why are they called scavengers?”Dudian looked out of the window and asked Rocco.
Rocco slightly covered his nose and frowned. It seemed that he would smell something bad through the window. He didn’t hide his disgust and disgust when Dudian asked, “These things are like rats. They look for food everywhere. They eat whatever they can find. So they are called scavengers. Their bodies are full of bacteria and viruses. Mr Dean must not get close to them. Even a demon warrior like you may not be able to resist the viruses. Moreover, these things can not be killed. If you kill one batch then another batch will appear.”
Dudian couldn’t help but frown. He noticed that Rocco had called the scavengers “These things”twice in a row. They should be his own kind, scavengers were people who were seriously infected by nuclear radiation. Rocco and the middle-aged man in tuxedo who he had met before knew that scavengers would eat anything. They didn’t think that if they weren’t too hungry.., who would eat garbage?
Sympathy and compassion were for the weak. But in their eyes, these scavengers weren’t even considered weak. It was like people’s first reaction when they saw cockroaches was to pick up slippers and beat them to death.
This kind of regional discrimination had never disappeared since the old era. It was the same as “Foreigners”and “Country people”. Even the person who spoke wouldn’t feel that his words had a discriminatory meaning, but it was just a form of address.
Dudian felt dull as he thought of this. He leaned back on the seat. His body swayed slightly as his thoughts drifted away.
Half an hour later, the chariot drove from a dry plain to a green field. There were more than a dozen giant windmills outside the green field. In addition there were many solar panels on the ground to absorb heat energy.
Xuehan pushed the door open and jumped down first. Rocco followed after her.
Dudian also got up and bent down to get off the carriage. His feet naturally stepped off song Ming’s face.
Song Ming immediately got up after Dudian got off the carriage. He felt that his neck was a bit stiff like a pillow. He clenched his teeth and twisted hard. He heard the sound of his neck bones cracking. He felt much more comfortable, however, the burning pain on his face was still there. He clenched his fists. He didn’t dare to look at Xuehan outside the car. He glanced at her clothes and knew her location. He jumped out of the car and clenched his fists, his heart was filled with hatred as he stared at Dudian.
Dudian turned his head and saw song Ming’s eyes. He faintly smiled: “You can hate me but you can’t provoke me. Do you understand?”
Song Ming felt anger rush to his head. He was about to explode but he held it back. He clenched his fists and his body trembled. Dudian’s meaning was that he could hate him, but he couldn’t show it in front of him. Even if he hated him, he could only hate him from the bottom of his heart!
He didn’t put him in his eyes at all!
Xue Han looked at Song Ming. He was so angry that his fists were trembling. She knew that song Ming had always been proud of his face. But now he was completely looked down upon by others.
However, she was relieved to see that song Ming was able to hold back his anger.
“Mr. Dean, Please.”Rocco opened his mouth in time. It seemed that he was trying to smooth things over for song Ming but he was happy in his heart. In his eyes, song Ming was no different from Dudian. Both of them were ugly demon warriors? Bah!
Rocco led the way. Dudian and Xue Han followed. Song Ming was at the end.
Dudian suddenly slapped song Ming. Song Ming was caught off guard and fell onto the grass. He was stunned as he looked at Dudian. He was puzzled but soon his eyes turned red, he grabbed the grass on the ground and crushed it. His body trembled as he shouted: “What are you doing? !”
Xue Han and Rocco were also puzzled. They looked at Dudian but hesitated.
“I said that you can hate me but don’t provoke me.”Dudian retracted his hand: “It is wrong of you to show killing intent behind my back.”
Xue Han and Rocco understood. Xue Han quickly went up to help song Ming: “Let’s go back first. Follow me.”
Song Ming shook off her hand. He clenched his teeth and walked forward.
Rocco coughed: “Mr. Dean, this way please.”
They walked to the middle of the grass. There was a small bungalow made of metal behind a few rows of solar panels. Dudian used X-ray to scan the inside of the bungalow. It was an underground processing factory, there were many machines and workers.
There were guards in front of the bungalow. They stopped song Ming: “Please Show Your ID card.”
Song Ming shouted: “Are you blind? I just left this place. Can’t you see? !”
The few guards looked cold. One of them raised his laser gun: “If you don’t Show Your ID card then I will shoot!”
Song Ming was so angry that his body was trembling. He took out his ID card from his pocket and threw it at the guard.
The guard looked at him and nodded. He returned the ID card to Song Ming.
“Guard dogs wait for me!”Song Ming put away his ID card and angrily walked into the small bungalow.
Rocco took Dudian and Xuehan to the guard. He showed them a document. The guard opened it and nodded.
There was an elevator in the small bungalow that led to the underground factory.
Dudian saw a huge golden sculpture on the first floor of the factory. It was a handsome young man with an eastern face.
“This is the founder of our Rocco non consortium, Rocco Non Polk.”Rocco respectfully introduced the golden sculpture to dudian.
“I have seen a handsome man who is second only to the god of Science and technology. He is close to perfection.”Xuehan smiled as she looked at the face of the golden sculpture.
Dudian faintly said: “A perfect person is a god.”
“The god of Science and technology is a perfect God!”Rocco laughed.
“A perfect God is a devil.”Dudian smiled.
Rocco and Xue Han were stunned as the smile on their faces disappeared. Rocco frowned: “Mr Dean, Don’t talk nonsense. It is a serious crime to slander the god of science and technology. Alright, let’s go.” They took Dudian to the first floor of the underground processing factory.
They knocked on the door.
“Come in.”
Rocco pushed the door and entered. There was a rough man sitting on the revolving chair. There were two bottles of red wine on the table in front of him. There were several thick gold rings on his fingers.
“Manager.”Rocco complimented.
The man looked up and saw Dudian: “Is this the demon?”
“This is Mr. Dudian from the Devil Wall.”Rocco politely said.
The man stood up: “I know. There is nothing for you here. Go back.”
Rocco nodded and left the office. His task was over.
“You come with me.”The burly man said to Dudian and walked out of the office.

chapters.title: Chapter 1070
chapters.content:
Chapter 1070 – Chapter 159: Cage
Dudian immediately followed but he saw that Xue Han didn’t follow him. He turned to look at her: “Isn’t your responsibility as a bodyguard? Aren’t you afraid that I will attack and kill this big guy?”
The Man in front heard Dudian’s words. The corner of his mouth twitched as he snorted, “Mr. Dudian, I know that you are very strong but I advise you not to do something stupid. Otherwise your identity, image and data will be released to the world. With the strength of our federation it won’t be difficult to catch you!”
Xuehan knew that Dudian was deliberately trying to scare the man. She smiled: “My duty is to escort you here. Now that you have arrived there is nothing for me to do.”She turned around and left.
Dudian shrugged his shoulders and retracted his eyes. There was a trace of coldness in his eyes.
The burly man led the way. They came to an elevator and took a ride together.
Dudian looked up and down at the base. He saw many heat sources. Most of them were hunters and a few of them were pioneers. There were only twenty to thirty of them, there were four master level heat sources.
“This should be a branch factory. HAWSK company is located in hundreds of cities in the federation. There might be abyss level experts in the headquarters factory.”Dudian thought, it wasn’t difficult to cultivate abyss walkers. However the demon warriors were the dark side of the federation. They were enemies of the border and were not allowed to exist in public.
Soon, the elevator arrived at the fifth floor of the underground factory.
Two of the four main heat sources were on this floor. There were less than thirty people on this floor.
Golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes as he looked at the fifth floor. There were many huge mechs on this floor. They were very strange. There were parts of flesh and blood in the mechs, there were three huge dark areas on this floor which he couldn’t penetrate through. It meant that the materials of these dark areas were very hard.
Dudian frowned as he slowly walked out of the elevator.
“This way please.”The burly man looked back as he added the word ‘please’. He didn’t want to anger the bloodthirsty devil.
Dudian followed him along the long corridor. He saw many giant mechs standing on the edge of the wall. Some of them were more than ten meters tall and looked like human figures. Some of them were more than twenty meters long. They were crawling on the ground like crocodiles. The surface of these mechs was covered with scales and some of them had metal shells. Most of them had muscle fibers. It seemed that they were half metal and half flesh mechs!
“Don’t tell me that these mechs are modified from the bodies of monsters!”Dudian was secretly shocked. He didn’t say these words to avoid exposing his ability to see through things.
A moment later, they came to an oval building. This building was one of the three dark areas that Dudian couldn’t see through. The burly man raised his hand and took a fingerprint on the door. The building was opened. He said to Dudian and took the lead to enter.
There was a spacious room inside the door. There were many mechs standing inside. There was a glass cylinder in the middle.
The burly man walked in and gestured to Dudian.
Dudian also stood inside the cylinder. He saw the burly man record the fingerprint on the button next to the cylinder door. Soon, the cylinder door was closed. The next moment, the cylinder sank down like an elevator. It fell down for more than ten meters, suddenly there was a bright light in the surroundings. It fell into a huge silver-white room made of pure metal. There was a protruding observation deck in the air in front of the room. It looked like the head of a spaceship had crashed into it.
At the moment there were four or five figures standing behind the observation deck. In the middle was a handsome young man. He looked gentle and refined. He was chatting with the people around him.
Dudian looked at the youth. The latter also looked at him. Both of their eyes met. The youth smiled and nodded to Dudian.
Dudian’s heart sank. He suddenly grabbed the shoulder of the man.
The man was scared: “What… What are you doing? !”
Dudian’s fingers slightly tightened. The Man’s face twisted in pain as he begged for mercy.
At this time, the cylinder sank to the bottom of the metal room. The people on the high platform stopped talking and looked down at dudian. Someone frowned when they saw Dudian holding the burly man.
“Hello, What’s Your Name?”A gentle male voice came from the metal wall. It seemed that it came from all directions.
Dudian looked at the surroundings. There was no individual speaker. The voice seemed to resonate through the metal wall. His face turned cold as he indifferently said: “Dudian.”
“Hello, Mr. Dudian. I’m Felix, the president of the copper ship branch of Hawsk Company.”The gentle male voice continued to come. Dudian saw the mouth of the handsome youth in the middle of the viewing platform moving. It was obvious that he was talking.
He had become the president of Hawsk Company’s branch at such a young age. It could be seen that he had a great background.
Dudian coldly said: “Can we talk about business now?”
Felix smiled: “Since Mr. Dean can’t Wait, I won’t say any more nonsense. We have asked you to join our HAWSK company. As you can see, you are not alone here. There are many demon warriors like you. I hope you can be like them and contribute to our HAWSK company. We will not mistreat you in the future.”
“Can I leave this place if I Say Yes?”Dudian looked at him.
Felix smiled: “We can sign the contract if Mr. Dean agrees. In addition we need Mr. Dean’s cooperation to implant the god’s core into our body.”
“God’s core?”Dudian was puzzled. He used his X-ray vision to scan song Ming and Xue Han’s body.
“It is a very small chip that needs to be implanted into your brain. But you can rest assured that our technology is very advanced. It will not cause any damage to you.”Felix smiled.
“Isn’t this the same as the military needs the absolute loyalty of a five-star Mech Pilot? Why Don’t you just say that you want to bury a bomb in my brain?”Dudian’s face turned cold.
Felix sighed, “Yes, but this is the only way to ensure our peaceful communication. As long as you don’t have any malicious intentions, we will never hurt you. Everyone is very assured. I hope you can seriously consider it.”
Dudian couldn’t help but smile, “If that’s the case, why not plant a bomb in your brain? I believe that at that time we can also maintain peaceful communication. Well, I can even be generous. I don’t need to plant anything in your brain. I can also peacefully communicate with you.”
The smile on Felix’s face faded as he calmly said: “Since Mr. Dean hasn’t thought it through, I can only let you think about it for a while. Now You can come out.”
His words were somewhat contradictory but Dudian reacted in an instant. He knew that Felix’s last sentence was directed at the burly man next to him. He deliberately didn’t mention his life. Maybe it was to make him stunned and give him a chance.
Sure enough, when Dudian noticed the burly man, he saw that the man was enduring the pain. His fingers quickly pressed the button on the door. The next moment, Dudian felt a sense of crisis.
He quickly grabbed the burly man’s shoulder and pulled half of the man into his arms.
The burly man was stunned. His eyes opened wide and his face was full of fear.
Puff!
Two lasers rose from the top and the bottom. They connected together and formed a barrier. The half of the burly man’s previous position was covered and isolated. But because of Dudian’s grab, the lower half of the man’s body didn’t have time to move over, it was cut off from the waist down by the laser!
If Dudian continued to grab his shoulder then his arm would be cut off by the laser!
Intestines and organs flowed out from the abdomen of the muscular man. They fell onto Dudian’s boots and feet. The position of the muscular man was suddenly ejected. The legs of his lower body bounced to the top and were sent out.
Dudian released his hand. The muscular man was dead.
The five people on the viewing platform frowned as they saw the bloody scene. Felix coldly said: “Did you know about it?”
Dudian saw the cylinder was opened. He walked out and shook off the stomach organs and intestines on his instep, he indifferently said: “It seems that you are very skilled in using this trick. In order to send me to this cage, you didn’t hesitate to let a manager accompany me down. However, your mistake was that you shouldn’t have marked the ground and divided the area of the station.”
Felix nodded slightly. “That’s right. This is indeed our mistake. Mr. Du, you have observed carefully. Your opinion is correct. I will accept it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1071
chapters.content:
Chapter 1071 – Chapter 160: Magic Battle Mecha
Dudian was surprised to see that the manager wasn’t angry about the death of the Brawny Man. After all, the manager wasn’t a scavenger. He was a legal citizen of the Federation and was protected by the laws of the Federation. Dudian was relieved. Hawsk might not have the right to kill a legal citizen. But the death of the Brawny man wasn’t witnessed by anyone. He could find a reason to cover it up. For example, a work accident that led to death, then he would compensate the family some money and the matter would be over.
“I will come back when Mr. Dean has thought it through.”Felix looked at Dudian and smiled. He turned around and walked away.
The few people around him hugged and left with him.
Dudian retracted his eyes and looked at the pure metal room. It was thousands of square meters wide and forty to fifty meters high. If the size of the cage was used to rank it, it would definitely be the luxury of a presidential suite.
Golden Light appeared in his eyes as he looked at the surrounding walls. He saw strands of light scattered on the pure silver walls. These lines could be seen through by his eyes. It meant that this place was not made of iron, perhaps the function of these lines was to transmit sound or to replace air? In any case, this was a breakthrough for him to escape!
Dudian didn’t act immediately. He scanned every inch of the room and checked the surveillance. However, he found that there was no surveillance installed in the room. Obviously, the installation of the surveillance would lead to a flaw in the perfect cage, secondly, even if the surveillance was installed, if it was not hidden, it would be destroyed by the anger demons.
The only monitoring system was on the observation platform. Most of the areas in the cage could be seen but the bottom of the platform was out of reach.
Dudian went to the outer area of the monitoring system under the observation platform. He was about to activate the splitter and try to attack the wall but he stopped.
“Insidious!”! The monitoring on the observation table might be deliberately made. Since they have locked me here, how could they not try to control all my actions? Anyone would think of coming here to avoid the monitoring. In this way, what’s the meaning of their monitoring? This is just a decoration. I feel at ease to display my strength here and expose my secret. A person alone is the most relaxed and careless. They should have a way to monitor me through other means.”
Dudian’s face sank. The level of technology here was very high. It was not unusual for there to be technology beyond his knowledge to monitor him.
After a moment of silence, Dudian used the magic marks ability of the turtle shell. The skin on the back of his hand became like a rock. Fine yellow scales grew out. He punched the wall. The wall was not damaged at all.
Dudian’s face sank. He used the power of the inferior abyss to punch him. It was possible that the other party was monitoring him. It was possible that the other party could sense the strength of his body through his attacks. It was like a life detector, so it was more realistic to expose the power of the inferior abyss. After all, the latter knew his identity. It was possible that the other party would track down the entire process of his infiltration into the federation.
If the other side had seen the other two mechs that he had cut open and obtained information from the military, it wouldn’t be difficult to analyze his strength at the level of the Abyss. Moreover, it was close to the level of the intermediate abyss.
“It seems that this thing was specially made for me…”Dudian looked at the wall which was still flat. He suddenly thought that there were three dark areas which he couldn’t see before. Could it be that the other two cages.., were also locked up by the demons?
“It seems that the Rockefeller consortium might not only interfere with the military but could even secretly control the battlefield!”Dudian’s eyes lit up. The influence of the Rockefeller consortium could be seen from the battle to capture the abyss, there were three such consortiums in the federation. This was a world dominated by consortiums. Financial power was equal to military power and noble status!
The next moment, Dudian’s face revealed an angry expression. It seemed that he had used all his strength. His whole body was petrified. The petrification power extended along his arms and turned into two extremely sharp stone swords in his palms, the stone swords seemed to be connected to his body. They were part of his body.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Dudian was knocked back by the two collisions. He rolled out of the shadow area under the observation platform. He quickly put away the petrification and removed the magic body. He climbed into the shadow and took a deep breath.
Dudian got up and walked to the wall. There were only two shallow white marks left on the wall.
This was a desperate result. With the stone sword’s attack, it was possible to cut through the wall thousands of times! However, it was only a possibility. No one knew how thick the wall was!
Dudian looked disappointed as he sat on the ground.
This scene appeared in front of the screen. Felix’s eyes lit up as he looked at the monitor screen, he said: “I didn’t expect such a guy to sneak into our federation. Fortunately we found him. Otherwise I don’t know how much damage he would have caused!”
“The president is right. This is all thanks to you.”
“This little fellow is already in despair. Haha, I guess he is thinking of cooperating with us now.”
“The demon race warriors are indeed extraordinary. The power contained within these dirty bodies is really terrifying. They can actually destroy this chrome alloy wall with their physical bodies.”
A few well-dressed gentlemen beside him complimented and sighed.
Felix smiled slightly and said, “Looking at this person’s magic power, he should be a defensive type. He can petrify the body. Not Bad, not bad. This way, he can give our mecha practice and last for a period of time.”
“The CEO is WISE!”
“Haha, he thinks that by rejecting us, he can not serve us. This is ridiculous. From the moment he entered, he was destined to serve us.”
“President, if he is killed by the mech, can I apply for his body to our R & D Department?”
Felix chuckled: “Of course, but his value should be to help us improve the mech. Everyone, go and inform the others. The Magic Battle Mech has begun. Remember, you can place bets but you can not influence the outcome. You can not sell his information. Otherwise, once you are found out, no matter how much you eat, you will have to spit it out, including your life!”
The others nodded as they understood the rules.
“It shouldn’t be so boring to lock me up like this…”Dudian leaned against the wall as his lips curved into a smile, “If it was me, they would use me to do mech training. If they didn’t think of this, maybe I should think of a way to hint that I can leave. Oh No, it would be meaningless to leave…”
..
Third Watch!
I knew that two words would definitely appear in the book review section: Shock!

chapters.title: Chapter 1072
chapters.content:
Chapter 1072 – Chapter 1661: The Fight Between Trapped Beasts
In the blink of an eye, Dudian stayed in the pure silver room for three days. Felix didn’t come to disturb him. But every day when it was time for meals, bloody ingredients would be thrown into the dark valve.
Dudian tried to attack from the dark valve. But the design of the dark valve was very clever. It was like a drainage pipe. The space inside was very narrow. It was only as thick as the mouth of a bowl, the top of the dark valve was the same hard metal valve. Even if he shrank his bones and drilled into it, he would be blocked by the upper valve.
Obviously, these people didn’t see him as a “Human”. The ingredients that were thrown in were all fresh blood. There was no tray or other utensils. It was like… throwing food to a ferocious beast!
Dudian secretly checked the flesh with x-ray vision. It was full of protein and nutrients. It was not infected by the virus nor was it contaminated by destructive bacteria. There were only some common bacteria, these bacteria might make ordinary people sick or have a fever. But for him, he could completely ignore them. As long as there was no zombie virus, Dudian felt that the Aragami factor in his body was enough to kill most of the bacteria.
Dudian ate, drank and defecated in the pure silver room. Moreover, there was no paper after defecating. He could have used the magic marks ability to solve the hygiene problem, but in order to avoid exposing his ability, he endured it, he made himself dirty and embarrassed.
“Do you want to wear down my patience? It’s useless, I won’t admit defeat!”
“I won’t be convinced even if you lock me up for a hundred years!”
Dudian would come to the monitoring area of the observation deck from time to time while he was resting and attacking the wall. He would roar loudly in the hope that his words would give the other party some hints.
However, as time went by, there was still no movement from above. If it was an ordinary person, they would be a bit irritated at the moment.
Dudian’s expression was very irritated. He was sitting inside the room and thinking. His eyebrows were tightly locked. From time to time he would suddenly raise his fist to hit the wall or stomp his feet. It seemed that he was in an anxious mood.
He knew that the other party didn’t come out for a long time.
On the fifth day.
Dudian’s face was gloomy as he leaned against the wall and rested. Suddenly there was a sound coming from the top of his head. He looked up and saw Felix and a few other well-dressed middle-aged people coming to the viewing platform, obviously they were the senior executives of HAWSK company. The Voice of Felix was gentle: “Mr. Dudian, are you thinking about cooperation?”
Dudian’s face was gloomy: “Don’t even think about it!”
“I know that you demons are tough.”Felix smiled, “It’s a pity that you have the strength of a devil but don’t have a brain to match it. Even if you refuse us, you will still serve us. No one in this world can refuse me and Rockefay!”
Dudian’s heart jumped. He was surprised but his face slightly changed: “What do you mean?”
“You won’t be able to get out of the cage but I can let our mecha in.”Felix smiled: “The latest battle between you and our company will help us improve the battle system. You have no choice but to cooperate with us. If you don’t fight then you will be killed by our mecha. You can only choose to fight until you die!”
There was a gentle smile on his face, but his words were very cruel.
Dudian was relieved, but his expression was gloomy: “Aren’t you afraid that I will destroy your mecha? Kill the mecha operators that you have painstakingly trained? !”
“There is no need for waste products. HAWSK only needs quality products!”Felix’s response was very straightforward.
Dudian looked at the young man who was in his twenties. The latter’s cold-blooded was not inferior to the corrupt nobles and hunters in the giant wall. He didn’t feel cold in his heart but was happy instead. If he wasn’t such a cold-blooded and cruel person.., dudian wouldn’t dare to use such means to force him. His expectations would be disappointed.
“Since you are so confident, then let’s see how powerful you are!”Dudian said with a proud expression.
Felix smiled, “Before the battle starts, you can clean up the place. I will send people to clean up Mr. Dean’s excrement and food so as not to affect our viewing experience. I hope Mr. Dean won’t do anything stupid. If you kill the person who is cleaning up the place then no one will help you clean up. You may be drowned by your own excrement in the future.”
Dudian sneered but didn’t answer.
A moment later, another part of the passage suddenly split open and revealed a passage!
There was a trembling cleaner standing in the passage. He was wearing anti-bacteria cleaning clothes with HAWSK’s logo on it. His face was full of tension and fear.
Dudian saw the man and rushed over. He passed by the man and came to the end of the passage behind him. He saw that there was a valve blocking his way. He used the magic mark of the turtle shell and his arm turned into a stone sword, he cut the valve but only left a shallow mark.
“It’s useless, Mr. Dean. The material here is the same. You Can’t break it.”Felix’s voice was heard.
Dudian ‘refused to give up’. He tried twice but failed. He walked back with a gloomy face.
“The second valve will only open when Mr. Dean comes back. So you won’t have the chance to come out.”Felix smiled, he looked at the cleaner: “Do you want to stay inside with him?”
The youth was scared and his body was trembling. He slowly walked over and took out tools to clean the dirt on the floor.
Dudian coldly looked at Felix and ignored the cleaner.
After a moment, the room was cleaned and the air was much fresher. The cleaner returned to the passage and the valve landed. The pure silver room was like an oval cage without any gaps.
“I need a set of clean clothes, tissues, and a bottle of urine.”Dudian suddenly said to Felix.
Felix was slightly startled and nodded: “Yes.”
Soon, the things that Dudian wanted were delivered by the cleaner.
Dudian put on new clothes and indifferently said: “Didn’t I send your mech over? Now it’s ready.”
Felix smiled: “There is no hurry. It is not time yet.”
Dudian quietly sat down and closed his eyes.
A moment later, Dudian heard the sound of a valve opening. A crocodile-like figure slowly climbed into the pure silver room. After it came in, the valve behind it closed.
Dudian’s eyes flashed. He saw a thin blonde youth sitting inside the mech. There was a magic mark in his body. The heat source of his body was pioneer level. At the moment, it was located in the heart of the crocodile’s abdomen, there weren’t metal instruments connected to his body but blood vessels that pierced into his body and connected to his nerves.

chapters.title: Chapter 1073
chapters.content:
Chapter 1073 – Chapter 1662: Defeat
“Eh, this is…”Dudian was surprised as he saw the scene inside the mech. It wasn’t that the strange scene scared him but the blood flow in the golden-haired youth’s body, he felt that the golden-haired youth and the mech seemed to have become a whole. Their blood was the same and their nervous system was probably the same!
At this time, Felix’s voice came from all sides of the room, “Magic Battle Mech, Begin!”
Dudian turned to look at the observation deck. He saw Felix and a few well-dressed people looking down at the place as if they were looking at a rare species in the zoo.
“Magic Battle Mech? What kind of strange name is that?”Dudian’s eyebrows twitched, he turned his head and saw a large bloody mouth that occupied all his vision. The mouth was half a human’s long fangs. It was extremely sharp. Its long scarlet tongue was covered with fine barbs. If it was bitten by dudian, it was estimated that it would lose a layer of skin.
Whoosh!
Dudian’s body quickly retreated. Yellow scales appeared on his body. He jumped up and jumped onto the back of the crocodile. There were smooth alloy scales on its back.
When Dudian landed on its back, the alloy scales under his feet suddenly shot up. They were like sharp blades as they cut onto Dudian’s legs. Fortunately, his feet were protected by the magic marks of the turtle, it was only a little painful. It was easy to imagine that if there was no magic, the sharp scales would be enough to cut off his lower body!
“Go to hell!”The golden-haired youth’s face was ferocious. His eyes were slightly red as if he had suddenly become extremely brutal.
Dudian saw that a row of rocket launchers which looked like land missiles were ejected from the back of the crocodile’s waist. It was still warm when it was ejected. The missiles were launched in a flash. Bang Bang Bang.., several missiles were launched in succession. The interval was less than 0.01 seconds.
It was the first time that Dudian saw the combination of the monster and the mech. He was surprised and found it interesting. He raised his arms. The yellow scales on his hands were petrified and turned into stone arms. Bang! The missiles hit him, the terrifying impact sent his body flying. He hit the wall behind him and exploded. The pungent smell of gunpowder filled the air. The ground was covered in smoke and dust.
“The god-headed crocodile mecha is indeed powerful. It hasn’t even displayed the power of the demon race, yet it has already beaten this demon race to the point of being unable to retaliate!”On the viewing platform, a well-dressed old man with a white beard clapped his hands and laughed.
Beside him, another middle-aged man in his forties laughed lightly and said, “Looks like you are the same as me. Both of you are betting on our mecha.”
“This godhead crocodile mecha has been under development for more than two years and is already nearing perfection. It can perfectly connect to the neurons of demon warriors, and it’s also under Luke’s control. Defeating a lower level Abyss isn’t an easy task,”the white-bearded old man said with a smile.
Felix smiled and said, “I’ve told Luke to hold back and not kill him so easily. This is just an appetizer. If we don’t stimulate those fellows, how would they be interested in betting?”
At this time, the smoke in the room gradually faded away. They looked down and found that there was no sound of battle in the faint smoke. The crocodile was quietly lying on the ground as if it was waiting for an opportunity to move.
Some people looked for Dudian’s figure in the smoke but didn’t see him.
It wasn’t until the smoke completely disappeared and was sucked away by a passage in the dark valve on the wall that they found that Dudian had appeared on the back of the crocodile, however the crocodile didn’t respond to the attack.
“What is going on? What is Luke doing?”The white bearded old man frowned.
Felix’s eyes flashed: “It seems… He has won.”
Dudian seemed to have sensed his words as he looked up at the crocodile. He smiled and jumped down from the back of the crocodile. He drilled to the bottom of the crocodile. A moment later.., he came out from the bottom of the mech. There was an unconscious figure in his hand. It was the operator of the Mech, Luke!
“Thank you for the delicious meal.”Dudian smiled.
“DAMN!”The white bearded old man was flustered. He wasn’t as elegant as before: “What is Luke doing? Why did he lose? Did his brain atrophy last night? Damn it! Damn it!”
“How could the divine-headed crocodile mech lose…”someone next to him was stunned.
“This damn Luke. I bet five million on him! !”Another middle-aged man was filled with murderous intent and his face was filled with malevolence.
Felix’s eyes were flashing with light, “Interesting. In a while, get the technical department to analyze the situation inside and send it to everyone. Don’t let them think that we are manipulating things behind the scenes. I would like to see how this demon used the power of the lower abyss to break our divine-headed crocodile mech.”
“President, I think we should execute Luke!”
“That’s right, he betrayed us!”The white-bearded old man was the first to step out and echo.
