Felix glanced at the few of them with an extremely indifferent expression, as if he was looking at a few lowly worms dressed in gorgeous clothes, he snorted coldly and said, “Who can be blamed for betting wrongly? Next time, Keep Your Eyes Open! Your losses are a small matter. If you can find the flaws of the god-headed crocodile mecha and perfect it, what’s this little loss? !”
The few of them didn’t expect that the usually gentle young man would change his face. However, they knew that this young man was ruthless. He was definitely not a good person. They nodded but were dissatisfied in their hearts.
“Mr. Dean, the battle has ended. Please hand over Luke and the mech. We will send people to clean it up. I hope you will cooperate.”Felix turned to Dudian who was in the pure silver room.
Dudian sneered: “If you enter my territory then the things will be mine.”
He pulled Luke into the crocodile without looking back.
Dudian woke up the blonde youth who was called Luke.
Luke saw that Dudian was holding onto his shoulder. His face was pale: “How… How did you get here?”
“You haven’t fully displayed the power of the mech, have you?”Dudian’s eyes were extremely cold. He didn’t hide his killing intent: “Can you use your magic marks to display the power of the Mech?”
Luke’s heart was beating fast as he saw Dudian’s killing intent. He wanted to resist but the hand on his shoulder was crushing his bones. Moreover the Energy Index of the mech was checked.., he knew that Dudian was an abyss level existence. He was very clear about the classification of the demon race. His own combat power was like a baby in front of Dudian!
“How… How do you know?”Luke’s face was pale: “Don’t kill me! You Can’t kill me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1074
chapters.content:
Chapter 1074 – Chapter 1,63Rd: Research
Dudian knew that his guess was correct. This mech was the product of the monster’s body. The function of the magic marks was equivalent to the heart of the monster!
He seemed to see the original intention of the Hosk Company to develop these mechs. They were strong monsters that were hunted in the dark outside the city. They had a complete and strong body but no consciousness, they were natural superior materials! And Hosk had made use of them to transform them into biological mecha, allowing their bodies to display battle prowess that surpassed that of when they were alive!
However, this battle prowess could not be driven. For this reason, the company had nurtured a batch of magic marks warriors, filling them into the various monster mecha, acting as the heart and brain of the monster mecha, allowing the power of these monster mecha to recover!
Moreover, this power was controlled by the magic marks warriors. The magic marks warriors were controlled by them. It was the same as them “Resurrecting”the ferocious monsters so that they would listen to their orders!
This was the layout of the Hosk Company. It was also the layout of the Rockefeller Consortium. They were pursuing power so they must have bigger schemes and greed!
These thoughts flashed through Dudian’s mind. He knew more about the Hosk Company. Moreover he was sure that the Hosk Company’s magic marks mech plan had appeared a long time ago, it was possible that it would last for hundreds of years. After all, the Hosk Company’s magic marks mech was very advanced. It couldn’t be improved in a short period of time. They could even use the magic marks in the bodies of the magic marks warriors to work on the mech!
This was equivalent to… the magic marks warriors were just parasitic soul worms buried in the bodies of the mechas!
Each of the monster mechas had parasitic soul worms. They had extraordinary power and were far more powerful than ordinary monsters!
“What kind of amazing discovery will there be if the technology contained in this is used in undead research?”Dudian’s heart was boiling as his eyes lit up, “The federation is mainly composed of the four consortia. The Rockefeller consortium should have other core businesses. It is impossible for the hidden industry to be the production of undead. Perhaps… some consortia are focused on undead research!”
He was excited as he thought of this. He wanted to find the leaders of the four consortia and interrogate them one by one.
However, this was obviously unrealistic. He restrained his excitement and thought of a faster way to understand the core business of the four consortia.
For example, he could find out from Felix’s mouth.
The four consortia were opposed to each other so they must understand each other. Felix was the president of the branch so he would be satisfied with what he knew.
Dudian looked at Luke who was next to him. He wanted to try and ask him about the other three consortia.
The result was out of Dudian’s expectation. Luke knew about the other three consortia. Moreover there were consortia who were studying undeads!
“Milan Consortium, Terras Consortium and Michael Consortium!”Dudian wrote down the names of the three consortia. Milan consortium mainly dealt in arms. Most of the arms of the military and border defense were provided by Milan Consortium! Michael consortium was good at business. Every city in the federation had their own land, shops and businesses. In addition, they were involved in the field of mechas and arms, although they were not as independent as the rockefay Consortium and Milan consortium but they had the second share of the market.
The Terras consortium was the most mysterious of the four consortiums. Most of the famous scientists in the federation were gathered in the Terras Consortium! All the new technologies were mostly promoted by the Terras Corporation. Among them, the mecha of the Rockfield Corporation had many parts that were dependent on the factories of the Terras Corporation. They could not produce them themselves and could only purchase them!
In addition, many of the core parts of the thermal weapons of the Milan Corporation also came from the factories of the Terras Corporation!
Other than that, the Terras Corporation was also trying to develop an antidote to the zombie virus infection. However, even though these words had been announced for a long time, there was still no antidote that came out. They were still in the process of developing it.
However, the Terras Consortium gave great hope to the civilians of the federation. It was the most prestigious consortium among the four consortiums!
“I have to go to the Terras consortium if I have the chance.”Dudian thought. He had the impulse to leave but if he left then he would become a wanted criminal, it would be more difficult to enter the Terras consortium.
“I have told you what you asked. Can you let me leave now?”Luke carefully asked as he saw Dudian was silent.
Dudian glanced at him, “You can leave if you want. Tell me the map of each floor, the area of the room, the entrance and exit, the emergency passage, and the location of the armed guards. In addition, tell me the knowledge of how to operate this mech.”
Luke was tongue-tied: “This, these are all confidential!”
“Confidential?”Dudian’s arm petrified and turned into a stone sword. He put it on Luke’s neck and asked.
Luke’s face stiffened, he embarrassedly said: “Sir, you are family. It is not a secret to tell you. But I have told you everything. Will you really let me go? I have no enmity with you. I am following orders to fight with you…”
“Cut the crap. As long as you don’t play tricks, I will let you go.”Dudian snorted.
Luke was relieved as he told Dudian the information he wanted.
“Mr. Dean, if you refuse to cooperate, we will stop the food supply for the next week!”Felix’s voice came from outside the mech.
Dudian turned a deaf ear and let Luke continue to whisper.
“President, what is this kid trying to do? Did he really eat Luke?”The white-bearded old man was puzzled.
Another middle-aged man frowned: “I think he is trying to control the crocodile. He thinks that he is a demon warrior so he can operate it. But he doesn’t know that every mech needs something to help it complete the connection.”
“What do you guys think, if an abyss demon were to control this god-head crocodile mecha, what kind of power would it display?”Someone asked curiously.
The white-bearded old man shook his head and said, “It’s useless. The Pioneers have already satisfied the supply of the god-head crocodile mecha. If it were the demon race’s ruler or the abyss, they would still be able to display this level of power. After all, the limit of the god-head crocodile mecha is there.”
“I see.”The person who asked the question was resentful. Although he was a senior but he didn’t pay much attention to these things.
Felix listened to their conversation and frowned. The disgust in his heart was even stronger. These people relied on their connections to get to this position, however, he was too lazy to understand the things in his hands. This was already an attitude problem. However, if it wasn’t necessary, he was too lazy to blame them. After all, the demands of these people were only to get the salary of this position, it was convenient for him.
“Go to the control room and show the images inside.”Felix saw that Dudian didn’t respond. His face was cold as he turned to leave.
They went down to the control room and asked the technician to show the images inside the crocodile. They saw Dudian and Luke sitting in the command room of the crocodile, dudian was holding a few connected pipes. He looked up and down as if he was studying. Sometimes he would petrify his arm into a sword and stab it into the armor to check its internal structure.
“He is indeed studying the armor.”Felix narrowed his eyes.
“This kid thinks that he can learn how to operate the armor. He is too naive!”The white bearded old man couldn’t help but sneer.
“This kid is disobedient. We should give him a taste of his own medicine. Otherwise, if this continues, no one will be willing to go in and fight,”another person said.
His words immediately attracted the approval of a few people. Felix also nodded slightly. “When we drag the mecha out later, let’s teach him a lesson.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1075
chapters.content:
Chapter 1075 – Chapter 164Th: Punishment
Dudian looked at the interior of the crocodile for a while. He felt that it was similar to what he had seen from his perspective. There were no secrets in his eyes. He felt that if he was given the corresponding mechanical parts.., if he was given a little more time, he would be able to complete the assembly and even transform the living monster into a biochemical mech.
“If such mechs appeared in the giant wall, it would be enough to create a terrifying army!”Dudian thought.
He suddenly remembered that when the federation attacked the god of war wall, in addition to mechs, there were a large number of monsters. Those monsters were genuine monsters. It seemed that the federation had some means to control these monsters, moreover, there should be some connection with the monster mechs.
“Lord, I…”Luke’s legs trembled as he looked at dudian.
Dudian glanced at him. He saw that he had finished asking questions. The latter was honest and didn’t lie. The buildings on each floor were similar to what he had seen from the perspective. Moreover, he had given up.., there was another abyss of the real demon race in this place.
“You can leave now.”Dudian said. He suddenly changed the topic: “But before you leave, say a few words to curse Felix. The more vicious the better. It is best to harm your family.”
Luke was stunned: “Curse? Curse President Felix?”
“Yes.”
“Why, why?”Luke was a bit confused.
Dudian was a bit speechless. This Westerner’s brain was a bit straight, “Don’t care so much. After we go out, if others ask us what we are doing inside, you say that I am researching the mech and want to operate it to escape from here. As for other things, don’t say a word.”
Although Luke’s reaction was a bit slow, but after listening to Dudian’s words, he suddenly realized that Dudian was forcing him to be tied to a ship. Once he responded to the strange questions that Dudian asked.., dudian would also use his words to curse Felix. Even if Felix knew that he was being forced, but it was a fact that he was cursing him. There would be no good consequences in the future.
“But even if I curse him, no one will know.”Luke was relieved.
Dudian drilled a bloody hole into the control room of the crocodile. He found a huge horn. There were a few palm-sized trumpets behind the horn. Dudian took them apart, luke was puzzled as he removed the wires and energy blocks from the mech. A moment later, Dudian assembled a unique recorder.
“Hey, Hey.”Dudian tried it.
The recorder also made a “Hey, hey”sound.
Luke was dumbfounded as he looked at it.
“You can say it.”Dudian looked at Luke.
“How… How did you do it?”Luke looked at Dudian as if he had seen a ghost. He was shocked. In his eyes, the demon race was bloodthirsty and brutal. It naturally made people feel that the civilization was low and barbaric, however Dudian used the roaring horn in the mech to assemble a recorder. Even a student of a federal higher education institution would find it difficult to do so!
“It’s not difficult. I just need to modify it a little.”Dudian casually said. In addition to the sound of the crocodile’s throat, there was also a huge horn installed in the body of the mech, the sound of all kinds of monsters were recorded. The purpose was to scare other real monsters. He only needed to modify it a little and it could be used as a tape recorder.
Luke was stunned for a moment. He was speechless. Dudian looked at him as he cursed Felix.
“If you don’t curse enough, you will die. For example, if you pray for the bankruptcy of the Rockefeller Consortium.”Dudian said.
Luke’s mouth twitched. If he really said that, he would die without a burial place. Even if Felix could tolerate him, the Rockefeller consortium wouldn’t allow him to live in this world.
“Can you change to another one?”
“No.”
“I really can’t say that.”
“Alright.”
A moment later, Luke’s voice was played out from the recorder. He cursed the non-consortium and Felix. Dudian nodded in satisfaction, “You can leave now.”
Luke covered his red and swollen face. He looked at Dudian with bitter eyes. He turned around and rushed out of the body of the mech to call for help.
Soon, Felix sent people to pick up Luke. He also sent two mobile mechs to drag the crocodile away. Many people were sent to clean up the scene. One of the two valves was closed during the whole process so Dudian couldn’t take the opportunity to leave.
“Mr. Dean, I can only give you a taste of the bitter taste. I hope we can cooperate happily next time.”Felix looked down at dudian. There was an implicit smile on his face. He turned around and left.
Dudian suddenly felt a pungent smell coming from the room. It was like a faint mist that covered the entire room. The smell was full of Rancid, fecal and fishy smell. It was disgusting.
Dudian slightly frowned. Although he had expected Felix to punish him, but he didn’t expect it to be such a trivial thing.
However, in order to prevent the other side to do more excessive actions, he pretended to be very uncomfortable. He covered his nose and curled up on the ground.
In the following days, Dudian found that no food was put into the cage. The pungent smell was absorbed after a day. Obviously, they knew that although the smell was unpleasant.., but after a long time, it didn’t have much lethality.
In the evening, there was a strange and ear-piercing sound in the pure silver room. It made Dudian unable to sleep.
Dudian suddenly felt that the person who designed the cage was a bit childish. Was this a punishment?
He didn’t sleep for a night. The next day, the sound disappeared and he fell asleep. However, as soon as he fell asleep, the ear-piercing sound was heard again.
Dudian wasn’t upset after he woke up. Instead, he was a bit surprised. He didn’t expect that the other party could not only monitor him, but also detect his physical condition.
“I don’t know what I told Luke. Do they know…”Dudian thought. The next time they would send someone to catch him and ask if anything happened to Luke.
He continued to lie on the ground. He closed his eyes and pretended to be asleep.
The harsh sound didn’t continue to ring out.
Dudian suddenly understood. It seemed that the instrument was using his physical condition to detect whether he was sleeping or not. It seemed to be very high-end.
“According to the sleep characteristics, as long as my body is still awake when I sleep, it can be avoided. But in this way, the muscles don’t get rest, only mental rest and replenishment.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1076
chapters.content:
Chapter 1076 – Chapter 1665: Performance
It sounded complicated but it was easy to do. Dudian closed his eyes to calm his mind. He stood up from the ground and slowly raised one foot.
After the posture was stable, his consciousness slowly entered into sleep.
Soon, he fell asleep. His body was still in the posture of standing on one foot. In order to maintain the balance of one foot, his body muscles instinctively maintained a slightly stretched state.
Dudian opened his eyes but didn’t hear the ear-piercing sound. He couldn’t help but smile. It seemed that the other party’s detection device wasn’t that high-end.
He sat down and rubbed his feet to eliminate fatigue. He recalled the previous body structure of the crocodile and the huge mechs he saw along the way from the workshop, at that time he used X-ray to scan the condition of the mechs. He made a comparison with the crocodile and found that they were half-biological mechs.
“I can leave after one more battle.”Dudian thought.
Seven days passed in the blink of an eye. There was no food thrown. There was a pungent smell from time to time. There would be ear-piercing sounds whenever he went to sleep. These punishments were stopped on the eighth day.
A large piece of bloody beef was thrown down from the food pipeline.
Dudian leaned against the wall. He heard the shouts from above and knew that there was food coming. He got up and opened the valve. He took out the beef and chewed it.
“It seems that I can leave soon.”Dudian thought as he chewed the beef.
After eating, he lay down to sleep. He found that the harsh sound was gone. He knew that the battle would begin tomorrow.
As he expected, Dudian saw Felix standing on the observation deck early in the morning. Felix smiled as he saw him wake up: “Mr. Dean, have you rested well these days?”
Dudian smiled: “I slept very well.”
Felix smiled: “That’s good. We will send a newly developed mech to fight with you. If you are the same as last time then the punishment will be doubled.”
Dudian smiled: “Kill One!”
The smile on Felix’s face slowly disappeared: “In that case, I will wait and see!”
“This devil is too arrogant!”The old man angrily said. He was very angry with Dudian. Last time he had lost a lot of money.
“It’s just a glib tongue.”Felix’s temperament was still very gentlemanly and elegant: “This time we will send two together so that our competition will be more exciting. At the same time we will give him a taste of pain.”
“Two?”Someone next to him was surprised. “Isn’t this too difficult? If we kill him…”
“Kill him. His corpse is still valuable!”Another middle-aged man in a white suit said with a smile. There was a smell of medicine on his body. When he said this, the faces of the people next to him changed slightly, they subconsciously moved away from him.
“Go and prepare!”Felix ordered.
The people saw that he had made up his mind. They didn’t dare to persuade him and left.
Dudian leaned against the wall and looked forward to the battle.
A moment later, there was a slight vibration coming from the passage behind the valve. Dudian’s eyes lit up as he knew that the prey was coming.
The passage opened and two huge mechs came out!
Dudian was surprised and couldn’t help but laugh. It seemed that Felix was angered by him and wanted to teach him a lesson!
One of the two half-monster mechs was a twelve to thirteen meter tall snow-white giant ape. Its body was covered in white hair like steel needles. The muscles on its chest were embedded with dark silver metal. There were two rocket launchers on its back, when it prostrated on the ground, the rocket launchers on its back could be fired, or it could stand and shoot at enemies in the sky. In addition, in its hands, it was actually holding a huge metal battle saber, and there were two of them!
The other half-monster mech looked very familiar. It actually looked very much like the flood dragon in Chinese mythology. However, if you looked carefully, you would find that the claws on the belly of this flood dragon were all embedded with metal, and the scales on its body.., most of them were made of metal. There was an eye on its forehead. But if you looked carefully you would find that it was made of alloy. The eye was empty.
Dudian used X-ray to scan the dragon’s forehead. He found that there was a laser transmitter on its forehead. Apparently it could shoot out from its forehead.
“Is the person who designed this mech a Chinese? He forced the Python to install four sharp claws and added a flaw to it!”Dudian thought, he could see the flaws of these mechas. After all, his vision was very high. He had seen real monsters and these mechas were designed by him.
The designer didn’t have his rich combat experience and understanding of strength.
“The laser on the dragon’s forehead can hurt me. The blade in the hand of the snow ape is hard but not sharp enough. It is much thicker than my cutting blade.”Dudian looked at the two mechas, he understood the result. He thought about it but didn’t directly attack them. Although it would shock Felix and the others but it would be useless, instead it would add trouble to him.
“It’s time for the show again.”Dudian sighed in his heart and took the initiative to rush towards the giant ape.
The giant ape roared like a living monster. It brandished its dual blades and swept towards Dudian.
Dudian entered the magic body of the turtle. He took the blow and was sent flying.
“Good!”
The white bearded old man and others behind the screen couldn’t help but applaud. They had planned to bet on Dudian but Felix had sent out two mechs. They had directly bet on the side of the mech, at this moment they couldn’t help but cheer when they saw Dudian was sent flying.
Dudian had just got up when the dragon roared and rushed over. It was full of momentum but its speed was a bit slow. Dudian couldn’t help but sigh. If it wasn’t for the four metal claws that were in the way, its speed would have doubled!
He didn’t move. He resisted when the dragon approached. He turned over and rode on the dragon.
The scales on the back of the dragon shot out. The metal scales were like bullets as they cut his body.
“One punch from here will shock the strength of the mecha operator inside. It will be over…”Dudian thought but he didn’t do it. He pretended that he couldn’t hold it and was thrown off the back of the dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1077
chapters.content:
Chapter 1077 – Chapter 1666: Breaking The Cage
“This kid can’t hold on much longer.”The white bearded old man laughed.
“After all, it’s the divine monkey and the dragon. They are stronger than the crocodile. If the two mechs attack together, even the middle abyss would kneel down.”Someone sighed with confidence.
Dudian was at a disadvantage in the pure silver room. He was in a panic because of the two mechs. He was injured from time to time. It seemed that he couldn’t hold on much longer.
However, after seven or eight minutes, Dudian was able to find a loophole in the encirclement of the two mechs. He was able to reverse the situation. It was very exciting.
“Although they are strong but their cooperation isn’t enough. Otherwise this kid would have died.”The white bearded old man looked worried as he saw that the situation was in a deadlock.
Someone laughed: “The longer they drag it out, the more tacit they are. This kid will lose. I bet twice this time. If he wins then he will get back what he lost last time!”
Dudian estimated the time in the room. He felt that it was almost time for his performance. Ordinary people like Felix couldn’t understand the subtlety of his performance, moreover it was almost impossible for their naked eyes to catch the details of his battle. If it was any other abyss then they would be able to see through his performance. After all, his performance was fake.
Dudian began to counterattack from the Dragon Mech. He knocked away one of the metal claws of the Dragon Mech. Although the claw was firmly embedded but it wasn’t growing. It was directly broken by him and exposed the gap inside.
Dudian immediately went in.
“What’s going on?”The white bearded old man and others in front of the screen were shocked as they saw the sudden counterattack. It seemed that the Dragon Mech had failed. Dudian had broken one of the claws and drilled into the mech!
Felix’s face sank: “Get the Monkey Mech Ready. If the Dragon Mech is in danger or out of control, kill it immediately!”
At this time, the Dragon Mech suddenly stopped moving. At the same time, a figure jumped out of the mouth of the Dragon Mech and jumped into the Monkey Mech.
The Monkey Mech tried to pull Dudian out but it didn’t take long before its body fell to the ground.
The outcome of the battle was over in the blink of an eye. There was no fierce battle and the scene became strange and quiet.
Felix’s face turned ugly as he looked at the motionless scene: “Use the thermal conductivity meter to check the situation inside. See if the pilot is still alive!”
Soon, the technician next to him called out the situation of the two mechas. The pilot of the dragon was unconscious while the pilot of the monkey was being held by Dudian’s hand, the body had been disconnected from the mech.
“This…”the white bearded old man and the others widened their eyes. Their faces turned pale as if they were the ones mentioned by Dudian in the picture. The odds of winning were too high. They had bet too much, they had lost everything!
At the moment, Dudian was holding the strong pilot in the body of the monkey: “Do you know Luke? where is he now?”
The burly man looked at Dudian in horror. He knew that Dudian was a real demon. It was said that demons would eat human flesh. He didn’t think that he would be able to face such a terrifying existence without the protection of the mech, he felt like a girl who had lost her clothes.
“I, I know. Last time when Luke fought with you, he lost.”The burly man’s voice trembled.
“I mean, where is he now?”Dudian frowned.
“He has been in the training room every day since he lost…”
“Why is he in the training room? Was it Felix’s Order?”
“No, no. It was probably because someone laughed at him. They said that he was defeated by an inferior abyss demon. He didn’t have the face to see people so he hid in the training room…”
Dudian was relieved. It seemed that Felix and the others couldn’t hear his conversation. At most they could only see his image. He began to interrogate the Brawny Man.
“The map of the Federation’s Hundred Cities? I don’t know…”
“The food supply of the factory? I’m not in charge of these…”
Dudian finished asking everything he wanted to know. He looked at the cowardly Brawny man and coldly said: “I’m going to interrogate the one in the dragon. If the answer is different from what she said, Hehe…”
The man panicked: “I don’t know the map of the Federation’s Hundred Cities. But I know the map of the Copper Ship City. Every city uses fighter jets to transport resources. There are monsters outside the city…”
He answered some of Dudian’s previous questions. After he finished speaking, Dudian turned around and left. He went into the Dragon Mech. The pilot was a mature woman with a full body, he knocked her unconscious but she was still unconscious.
He patted the woman to wake her up. He threatened her and continued to interrogate her.
“Mr. Dudian, I will give you another chance. Let them out!”Felix’s voice came from outside the mech.
The woman looked at Dudian in anticipation. Dudian’s cold expression responded to her: “Don’t bother about them. Continue.”
Dudian took out the recorder and let them curse Felix and Rockefeller consortium like Luke. In addition there was the god of Science and technology who had the highest status in the federation.
Dudian let them go after he finished cursing the four consortia and the god of Science and technology. He walked out of the mech and looked at Felix: “Take them away!”
Felix took a deep breath and smiled: “Very Good.”
Soon, robots came in to transport the mechanical suit away. Cleaning machines came in to clean the place.
After everything was cleaned up, the passage closed again. Felix waved his hand and the staff who had been prepared for this moment turned on the switch. A strange frequency sound wave came out from the pure silver room and pierced into the brain like a magic sound.
The sound was not loud but very sharp.
Dudian frowned slightly. Was it an ultra frequency sound wave attack? He immediately petrified his ears and shrank all the pores in his body to shield the sound wave. At the same time, he covered his head and squatted on the ground, pretending to be in pain.
“You deserve it!”Felix saw this scene and turned away.
The ultra frequency sound wave attack continued until evening. The pure silver room was always as bright as day and night. However, Dudian could identify it through his body’s biological clock. It was night time and it was around eight or nine o’clock.
He waited for another three hours. It was late at night.
“Felix, I’m Coming.”A Ray of light flashed through Dudian’s dark eyes. His body suddenly turned into a monster. The sharp limbs of the splitter protruded out from his body, his whole body was like a monster that was emitting a tyrannical aura. The terrifying sharp blades were dancing wildly. He rushed to a wall. His body suddenly shook and the tail of the splitter heavily hit the wall.
* Pu! * !
The wall split open, revealing a wound!
* … *
[ is the charm of the second watch so great? ]. [ = ? ]? [ the monthly ticket is actually still within the top 200, making me feel embarrassed to go to the second watch. Could it be that something is going to happen this month? ]?

chapters.title: Chapter 1078
chapters.content:
Chapter 1078 – Chapter 167Th: Capture The Head
Dudian pulled out the tail blade from the wall. Several sharp blades from his shoulder and back quickly stabbed into the wall next to the gap. The angle of each blade was either parallel or vertical. In the blink of an eye, it had pierced through several holes and left long cracks on the wall.
Dudian retracted the blade from his arm and used his fist to hit the middle of the holes. Bang! The wall caved in. It was a metal alloy wall.
“I don’t know if my cutting blade can cut through this alloy material…”Dudian’s eyes moved as he saw the caved in alloy wall. Previously he had attacked the thin gap on the wall, in his eyes the wall was like a grid. The sharp blade could accurately fall on every line of the grid. Even if he used the petrified blade of the turtle shell, he could break the wall.
Whoosh!
Dudian raised the tail blade and swept it towards the wall.
Dudian felt the sharp impact and slight pain. He felt that the tail blade had sunk into an extremely hard thing. He saw that the alloy wall was torn and the tail blade was stuck inside.
“Thirty centimeters thick…”Dudian checked the edge of the alloy wall. If the thickness reached one meter, even his splitter blade wouldn’t be able to pierce through it.
Dudian didn’t stop. He drilled into the sunken alloy wall. The cutting edge of his body suddenly changed. Yellow scales appeared on his skin. His whole body was petrified. He looked like a stone man who had drilled into the dark layer of the wall, there were wires and pipes everywhere. His petrified arm was almost insulated. There was no blood flow in his arm. The blood in his body had transformed into a strange particle under the change of the turtle shell factor.
However, the core of his brain was still a body of flesh and blood. Once it was completely petrified, he would stop thinking!
Although his body would remain petrified forever and he would be almost immortal, but he would always become a stone statue!
Dudian roughly destroyed the wires which contained a strong voltage to avoid getting close to his brain. Although the outer part of his skull was petrified and insulated, but the voltage of the strong current was too high. If he got close to his brain.., there was still a possibility that the electricity would reach the deep layer of his brain.
These wires were equivalent to the second defense of the cage. Once someone violently destroyed the wall, the wires would also be destroyed. The room was made of metal. The current would instantly permeate the entire room and kill it.
Dudian was in the shape of a monster. He destroyed the wires and climbed out. He quickly climbed to the wall behind the wires. The material of the wall was also impenetrable, he cleared the wires around him and his body remained petrified. His arm turned into a splitter and cut the wall.
The ear-piercing sound of metal cutting rang out. His arm pierced through the wall but was stuck inside.
He pulled out and hacked again.
Four or five times in a row, the wall was forced open by him. He looked outside the wall and saw that there was a long corridor outside the cage!
Dudian didn’t stop. He poked his head out of the hole. After he landed, he glanced around. The complete map of the entire factory from Luke and the other two appeared in his mind. In addition to the terrain that he had memorized when he came in.., he quickly rushed to the left.
He had run less than 100 meters when the alarm sounded in the basement of this floor!
The ear-piercing siren made Dudian’s eyes full of killing intent. He didn’t stop. According to the complete map in his mind he rushed to the east of this floor.
After turning two corners, a ferocious beast suddenly jumped out from the third corner. It was 14-15 meters long and looked like a poisonous lizard. Its body was full of colorful bumps. It opened its bloody mouth and bit at Dudian.
Dudian seemed to have expected this. His body was depetrified and several sharp blades shot out from his back and shoulders. He quickly waved them. The sound of cutting echoed as Dudian rushed out from the skull of the giant lizard. His body was stained with blood, he landed on the back of the giant lizard. He stepped on the smooth metal scales and quickly rushed back as if he was trying to escape.
The operator of the giant lizard was dumbfounded. He didn’t expect that his best mech would be torn apart by Dudian. He controlled the mech to turn around but saw that Dudian’s back had disappeared, it was too late to chase after him. Although the mech could fight without its head but its combat ability was greatly weakened. Many circuits in its head were destroyed and some weapon systems couldn’t be activated.
“Is this the demon who is fighting with Luke?”
Whoosh!
Dudian rushed to the east side of the factory. A figure appeared in his golden eyes. His eyes narrowed and his tyrannical aura became stronger. He was like a beast that was crawling and jumping up and down, in the blink of an eye he rushed to an empty room which was built on a metal frame. There were a few coffee tables on the outside. The floor was made of wood and there were a few pots of flowers next to it. It was very comfortable.
Dudian kicked open the door. There was an ear-piercing alarm sound. His tail blade pierced through the door and the alarm stopped.
Bang!
A scorching beam of light suddenly shot over. Dudian slightly tilted his head and dodged.
The room was dark. Felix was already awake when he rushed over. He kicked open the door and got out of bed. He didn’t turn on the light but immediately touched the laser gun next to the bed, he shot towards the door.
This ability to adapt to changes was extremely outstanding for an ordinary person.
However, in the eyes of the dark vision, all of Felix’s actions were clearly seen. He easily dodged the bullet. Dudian didn’t slowly approach him but flashed in front of him, the black mucus on his arm faded away, revealing his pale arm. He grabbed the back of Felix’s neck and lifted him up from the bed.
At the same time, a sharp blade rolled on his shoulder. The cold light flashed and the gun in Felix’s hand fell off. The hand that held the gun also fell off.
Felix who was always smiling and elegant suddenly screamed. At this moment, there was no trace of calmness in the youth’s body. His hair was messy because of his sleep, he looked a bit hysterical and miserable.
Dudian untied the splitter’s body. Green scales suddenly grew on one of his arms. This was another of his poison magic marks. It had the effect of hallucination and paralysis.
His fingernails gently scratched Felix’s wound. Felix suddenly felt a cool sensation on his broken wrist. The burning pain actually disappeared. He opened his mouth and was stunned for a moment. He turned to look at Dudian, his face turned ugly: “What Do You Want?”
“Aren’t you curious about how I ran out?”Dudian’s pale golden eyes were a bit strange in the dark.
“It’s useless to be curious. You kidnapped me. Do you want to take me as a hostage and let you leave?”Felix took a deep breath, “If so, I Promise You That I won’t release your news. No one will know if you leave from here. I will help you to fix the identity verification loophole that you exposed when you infiltrated the military. You can mingle in the federation. No one will know of your existence!”
“It’s easy to talk to smart people.”Dudian felt that it was the right choice to relieve the pain in his arm. He smiled: “But I don’t want to leave for the time being. The environment here is good. I like it.”
Felix’s eyelids twitched, “I know that I was rude to you. I hope you won’t take it to heart. I think my attitude is good. We can discuss if you have any needs. It Won’t be good for you if you kill me. I don’t mean to threaten you. I just want to say that I can meet your needs.”
Dudian didn’t expect that Felix would surrender so quickly. It seemed that his identity as a ‘demon’was scary enough. In their eyes he was the kind of person who would kill and eat living people, dudian smiled: “Well said. The first thing you need to do now is to let everyone go back and have a good rest. You should be considerate of your subordinates, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1079
chapters.content:
Chapter 1079 – Chapter 168Th: Breakthrough
The corner of Felix’s mouth twitched as he heard the alarm. He knew that he would fall into Dudian’s hands once he dismissed the guards who were alerted by the alarm, who knew how the vampire would treat him? He would never believe that he wouldn’t retaliate.
However, he had no choice but to obey.
Felix’s brain was working fast as he thought of a way to escape. However he couldn’t think of any idea in a few seconds, “I know. I’ll tell them to turn off the alarm and go to rest.”
Dudian smiled, “Don’t you want them to know that you have been kidnapped by me?”? “They will investigate the surveillance and know that I’m here. Do you think they will surround this place and try to rescue you?”? “Then I will accidentally kill you in the process of their rescue?”
Felix’s back turned cold as he asked: “How should I put it?”
“You should understand.”Dudian’s face was indifferent, “Now is the time to test whether you are obedient or not. Your performance will determine whether I let you live or Die. If you want to live, you only need to pay your loyalty.”
Loyalty? When Felix heard this word, this word had always been derogatory in his mind. A Knight’s loyalty to a noble was loyalty, and a subordinate’s loyalty to a king was loyalty! Without exception, those who received loyalty and those who paid loyalty were always in a superior-subordinate relationship. Because of this, he had never been loyal to anyone, because he had never taken other people seriously, even those with prominent statuses.., in his eyes, they were just stepping stones that would be surpassed sooner or later.
“I understand.”Felix felt as if his voice was squeezed out of his throat. He took a deep breath, as if he had made a difficult decision, he said, “I will let all three-star and below-three-star mecha operators return to their respective positions. I will let the two four-star mecha operators come to rescue them. This way, the others will be reassured. After the two four-star mecha operators come over, you will take me hostage and force them to stop attacking. Then you will take the opportunity to defeat or kill them. After that, I will announce that you have died together with the mecha operators.”
“In this way, your existence will be invisible. No one will pay attention to you.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he heard Felix’s words. He nodded slightly: “Yes, that’s right. They are coming.”
Felix was relieved as he saw Dudian agree with him. He sneered in his heart. Dudian and Felix walked out of the room. Dudian was holding onto Felix as he gave out orders.
There was a supervisor of security standing behind several mechs: “President, don’t compromise. We will try to rescue you. The demons will not be able to escape!”
Felix was furious: “Compromise your head! You have so many people surrounding you! Are you trying to kill me? If you don’t do as I say then I will fire you!”
The supervisor was scared and didn’t dare to hesitate. He quickly explained the situation. Although his experience as a guard wasn’t very wise but Felix was in the hands of the demons so he had to compromise.
Soon, the surrounding mechs were gradually evacuated. It didn’t take long for Dudian to see two mechs rushing over. There were two master level pilots sitting inside the mechs. Obviously, these two were the four-star Mecha Masters!
Dudian took a deep breath. He learned from Luke and the other two that the most powerful mecha masters trained in this factory were four-star mecha masters. Their combat power was enough to rival the Lord of the abyss of the demons!
There were also five-star mecha operators in the HAWSK company. But in the headquarters, their strength was comparable to that of a King!
Of course, this was the concept of Luke and the others. In fact, they had never fought with the king of the empire.
“Let them go to the first floor!”Dudian coldly said to Felix.
Felix was startled. He knew what Dudian was thinking. He originally planned to use the hands of the two four-star mecha operators to get rid of dudian. But he didn’t expect that Dudian would want to take him away from here!
Once he left, Dudian would obviously throw him away as a burden under the pursuit of the two four-star mecha operators.
Dudian’s fingers touched the back of Felix’s neck as his sharp nails cut through his skin. Felix shivered. He clenched his teeth and passed on Dudian’s words.
The others watched as Dudian took Felix away. Dudian proposed to go to the ground after they reached the first floor.
Felix had expected this and could only do as he was told.
Dudian grabbed Felix and ran away after they went to the ground.
“Save me!”Felix shouted.
The two mechs quickly caught up to Dudian.
However, Dudian activated the magic body of the splitter. The wings on his back flapped. His speed was no slower than the mechs. In the blink of an eye, he had left the factory hundreds of miles away.
Dudian rushed towards the wilderness. He was carrying Felix who was knocked out by the strong wind. Dudian put Felix on the ground when he reached a basin. He wanted to throw him down, but he was afraid that his body would be weak and he would fall to his death.
Dudian quickly turned back after placing Felix. A red gemstone appeared on his forehead. It looked like a demonic eye. The heat was concentrated. Suddenly a ray flew out from his forehead and hit the chest of one of the mechs.
Bang! The chest of the Mechs was pierced through. However there was a metal plate in front of the pilot’s seat which blocked the beam.
Dudian frowned as he sighed in his heart. It was night and there was no sunlight. The effect of his solar beast ray attack was less than 30% . It was not enough to kill the pilot of the mech.
“It will consume too much physical strength.”Dudian thought as he turned around to pick up Felix. He gave him a slap to wake him up. He looked at the confused Felix and quickly lifted him up, he said: “Let them stop the attack.”
Felix’s head was buzzing but he woke up after Dudian lifted him up.
“This… this won’t do…”Felix’s face was pale. He was no longer a gentleman.
Dudian coldly said: “If you don’t say it then you will die!”His nails pierced into Felix’s flesh.
In the end, Felix was a rich second generation. Although he had a good education and had seen many bloody experiments, but he didn’t suffer much. At the moment he was stabbed by Dudian’s nails, dudian quickly said: “I will say it.”He shouted out Dudian’s words.
The two mechs rushed towards Dudian. They stopped when they heard Dudian’s words. They looked at Felix who was in Dudian’s hands. The two mechs hesitated.
“They want to attack me. I will use you to block them.”Dudian said to Felix.

chapters.title: Chapter 1080
chapters.content:
Chapter 1080 – Chapter 169Th: Pure Gold Heart
Felix’s face turned pale as he tried to persuade them: “Stop! I order you to stop!”
The two mechas stopped in place as if they were in a difficult situation.
Dudian whispered to Felix: “Let one of them come down to negotiate with me.”
Felix knew what Dudian was thinking. He was extremely anxious but he couldn’t help but shout: “He wants one of you to come down and talk to him. The one who is the ghost variant. Come down!”
The left side of the mech looked like a Buddha but its body was made of black metal. There were a few giant arms and claws on its body. It looked very ferocious. Its back was hunched high as if there were whiskers floating on it. It looked like a ghost. The pilot’s face slightly changed when he heard Felix’s order. He didn’t act immediately. After a moment of silence he used the communicator to talk to the right side of the pilot.
Dudian used his x-ray vision to see this scene. He knew that it was bad.
Sure enough, the strange buddha-like phantom slowly came over. It seemed that there was no malicious intent. However, a vertical pupil suddenly opened on his forehead and shot out a laser!
The laser was thick enough to completely envelop dudian.
Dudian saw that the vertical pupil had opened and quickly retreated.
Bang!
The laser beam pierced through the ground in front of him.
Felix was stunned as he looked at Dudian. he shouted in anger: “What are you doing? !”
The two mechs didn’t respond but rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s face sank. He had guessed the thoughts of the two mechs. Things had become a bit tricky. He took a deep breath and threw Felix to a big tree behind him. His whole body burst into flames, the sharp blades of his body were red like soldering iron. The black splitter had turned into a bright red splitter. The Magic Marks of the Sun Beast had merged into the sharp blades, the surging power made him feel as if he could destroy the world with a single move!
However, the sound of his heart beat violently at this moment. It made him feel the pain of being torn apart.
“Let’s end this quickly!”Dudian’s eyes were terrifyingly cold. His burning wings flapped as if a fireball was falling from the night sky.
A laser shot out from the forehead of the mech. The interval was very short.
Dudian’s body moved up and down to dodge the laser. Although the speed of the laser was so fast that it was difficult for him to react, but he could see the hidden laser charging device behind the vertical pupil, he quickly adjusted the direction so that the mech didn’t have time to change direction.
In less than two seconds Dudian approached the ghost variant mech. He was greeted by four strange arms. These arms grew out from the armpit of the Buddha. There were very long hair on the arms. The nails were sharp like claws, his skin was blue. He was holding a hammer, knife, sword and shield. At this moment the hammer and knife were cut down. The shield was in front of him and the sword was raised from the bottom.
“Break!”
Dudian roared. He felt his heart contract. He didn’t care about reducing his strength. The Flames on his body scattered out and turned into a fire shadow. It blocked the vision of the mech. At the same time, he dodged the giant hammer, dudian rushed to the side of the giant knife. He swung the tail of the knife. Bang! The knife was cut off!
Dudian went over the knife and rushed towards the shield. The sharp blades of his body suddenly gathered and turned into a cone-shaped spiral blade in front of him. Bang! A hole was drilled in the giant shield.
Dudian’s wings flapped rapidly and once again fiercely pushed his body into the chest of the mech like a burning Firebird.
Plop!
The mech fell to the ground.
Dudian came out from the back of the mech. Before he had time to breathe, he felt a tingling sense of danger coming from his scalp. He hurriedly dodged.
He didn’t look back but he saw that it was another nine-tailed fox-like mech. The laser attack was extremely powerful. It seemed that every mech was equipped with it.
At the moment, the nine-tailed Fox jumped up and down. It quickly rushed towards Dudian. Its nine tails flashed and shot out a large number of silver needles.
Dudian petrified the sharp edge of the blade. He wasn’t hurt at all. He didn’t even feel pain. He had shot the chest of the nine-tailed Fox with the heat ray. At the moment, the hair on his chest was still broken, the metal armor was exposed.
Dudian’s eyes were gloomy. The vertical pupil on his forehead opened again. He tried to dodge the silver needles but suddenly shot out a beam of light.
Bang!
The beam hit the metal plate on the nine-tailed Fox’s chest. It looked like the nine-tailed Fox had hit the metal plate on its own.
Dudian found that although the semi-biological mech was strong but its combat experience was obviously not comparable to the abyss in the giant wall. Perhaps its performance was comparable to the Lord of the Abyss but when it met the real lord of the abyss.., the level of combat experience would make the battle one-sided.
He no longer chose to fight head-on in case his heart couldn’t bear it. He felt that his heart seemed to be broken. He had to kill one person as soon as possible.
Whoosh!
His body was petrified as he dodged the nine-tailed Fox’s attacks. From time to time he would find his weakness and shoot out a thermal ray.
The thermal ray would hit the metal plate on the nine-tailed Fox’s chest every time. If you looked carefully you would find that it hit the same place every time.
The nine-tailed Fox seemed to be aware of Dudian’s intention. Its attack became more and more impatient. It suddenly looked up at the sky and roared. The ear-piercing sound waves came. Dudian felt dizzy. It was like a dream. It was like he was drunk.
At this time, a terrible feeling came over him. Dudian woke up from the intoxicated feeling. He felt cold sweat all over his body. The laser in his eyes enlarged. He instinctively dodged to the side, however, he was still hit by the laser. He felt that his body was a bit lighter. He swept his eyes and saw that the few sharp blades protruding from his right shoulder had disappeared. Even a fist-sized part of his right shoulder had disappeared, the flesh and bones were exposed.
“Spiritual magic marks ability?”Dudian’s face changed. The cells in his body were surging. The broken blades were reassembled but the bones and flesh in his shoulder couldn’t heal in a short time, he transformed into a splitter and rushed towards the nine-tailed fox.
The nine-tailed fox swung its nine tails. The tip of its nine tails was extremely sharp. It was made of metal and looked like nine sharp blades.
Dudian suddenly increased his speed and dodged the nine-tailed Fox’s attack. But the speed was beyond his body’s limit. His heart felt like it was being torn apart again. He clenched his teeth and pounced on the nine-tailed Fox’s chest, he saw a woman who was panicking in the cab. His eyes were filled with brutality as he crazily shot out a few sharp blades.
Puff! Puff! Puff!
The body of the beautiful woman was riddled with holes. A lot of blood flowed out of the wound. Her beautiful face was blurred by the blood. She looked like an evil ghost. The Flames rushed out of her body and burned her body.
Dudian opened his mouth and inhaled. The flame that was attached to the cockpit was sucked into his mouth like air and disappeared.
Dudian removed the magic body and looked down at the beating heart in his chest. He saw that the baby’s fist-sized heart had expanded by half. Moreover, the color of the heart had become golden. It looked like pure gold, however, the shape was a bit strange. There were four lumps of flesh protruding from the heart.
“The heart is still unable to bear the full strength of the body…”Dudian clenched his teeth. The four lumps of flesh on the heart made him feel uneasy. He had always felt that.., the heart would slowly fit with the body and then completely become his heart. It would grow to be able to bear the full strength of his body. However, the sudden appearance of the four lumps.., it gave him a terrifying feeling.
Dudian went down from the mech after resting for a few seconds. He came to the tree and took down Felix who was hanging on the treetop.
Felix was terrified as he saw Dudian defeat the two strongest four-star mechas in the factory. He knew that his previous estimation of Dudian was completely wrong! This was obviously the existence of a Master of the Abyss. How could it be a lower abyss? !
..
… ..
He found out that the two new leaders had been blown up yesterday. They were a bit fierce. He had to express his gratitude to [ BKSABER ] and [ seize the night ] , he also thanked [ Hehe No. 11] , [ coollinker ] and more than thirty other leaders for their gifts

chapters.title: Chapter 1081
chapters.content:
Chapter 1081 – Chapter 170: Lucifer
Based on Felix’s understanding of the social system of the demon race, the Lord of the Abyss was a big figure in the demon race. His status was second only to the seven kings who ruled the demon race. How could such a golden body take the risk to infiltrate the federation alone?
He didn’t understand but he knew that the demon race had a big secret.
“Don’t kill me. I have cooperated with you to escape. If you want to leave, I will help you erase your identity and leave clues. I swear that I will never arrest you!”Felix was scared when Dudian mentioned the mech, he shouted in panic.
“I didn’t say that the environment here is good. I don’t want to leave for the time being.”Dudian’s expression was indifferent, “There is a communication device in the mechs. Contact the people in the factory and tell them that you are safe. Two mechs have rescued you. Ask them to send chariots to pick you up.”
Felix’s face changed: “Do you want to go back?”
“Why else would I come out?”
“You…”Felix’s face was pale. If Dudian went back then he would be controlled at all times. He didn’t know whether he would live or die. He suddenly understood that Dudian planned to infiltrate the base and hide in the dark!
“Is this the purpose of the demons? To infiltrate the Federation and try to disintegrate us from the inside…”Felix thought. But he didn’t have time to think about it. Dudian was staring at him, he braced himself and sent Dudian’s words back through the communicator. The senior executives on the other end of the communicator were relieved and cheered when they heard that Dudian was alright.
“Do you want to go back with me?”Felix looked at dudian. He had the answer in his heart: “Even if you cover your face, they will ask you if they see you. How should I answer?”
Dudian indifferently said: “There is no need to go through so much trouble.”He came to the front of the mech. He took off the jacket of the pilot and burned his body.
He changed into the jacket of the pilot and sat in the cockpit. At the same time, he pulled Felix to the co-pilot cabin next to the cockpit. The co-pilot cabin was not connected, it was mainly used to rescue companions on the battlefield. Moreover, the space was not big and could only accommodate five people at most.
“You know how to operate a Mech?”Felix saw Dudian’s posture and couldn’t help but be surprised. He remembered that Dudian was directly closed after he came to the factory. There was no one to train him. How could he control the mech?
Dudian’s next second action responded to him. He pressed the login device in the cockpit. The surrounding few tentacles suddenly danced and wrapped around Dudian. Then they connected with his skin and penetrated into his body. In an instant.., a lot of information seemed to flow into Dudian’s mind. It was about this monster!
Ability, habits, taste..
After four or five seconds, Dudian’s eyes revealed a clear look. He felt that his body seemed to have become infinitely huge. His perceptive ability was magnified by several times and extended to the surrounding world, he could feel the wind caressing his body. He could feel that the ground under his feet was extremely fragile. It was a comfortable feeling! It was the first time that he had connected to the monster. He didn’t expect to feel so comfortable. He couldn’t help but control the mech to jump up.
Whoosh!
The Mech suddenly jumped up hundreds of meters high and fell down.
The earth trembled but Dudian felt that his body was full of incomparable explosive power. He felt that he could easily destroy a city!
Felix looked at the demon in disbelief. Even if they were professional trained pilots, they would need more than three minutes of resonance connection to control the mech, in the process of the resonance connection, the pilot would need to be skilled and remember the information from the mech. The huge amount of information was enough to make an average person’s brain ache! But Dudian completed the resonance connection in a few seconds. How Strong was his brain? !
“I can go back.”Dudian smiled. He was in a good mood. The monster not only gave him an extraordinary experience but also made him excited. If he was the one to control the monster.., it would be easy to kill the other masters of the Abyss.
On the way back he tried to activate the magic marks of the splitter. The power of the magic marks surged out from his body. The next moment he felt that the power seemed to flow out of his body and into a larger container, he felt that there were more than ten meters thick blades growing out of the body of the mech. In addition there were two huge wings protruding from the back of the evil Buddha!
“The magic marks ability can extend to the monster’s body without any obstruction!”Dudian was shocked. His body suddenly sprinted forward. Whoosh! The scenery around him was as fast as lightning. In the blink of an eye, he had crossed thousands of meters, this speed was two to three times faster than his previous speed!
Co-pilot Felix looked at the scenery outside and was shocked. He felt that this mech seemed to have broken the limit of their design!
Suddenly, he thought of something and hurriedly said: “Not good. Your strength is too strong. If you use all your strength, the mech will not be able to withstand it!”
Dudian was startled. He felt that the joints on the outside of the mech were slightly loosened. It seemed that there was a disintegrating force. He quickly slowed down and put away the power of the magic marks.
“Most pilots use their own energy to drive the power contained in the mech.”Felix sat on the co-pilot and smiled bitterly, “The energy in your body is too strong. It is stronger than our mech. Not only can it fully stimulate the potential of the mech, but it can also be overloaded.”
“So if you give me a mech that can withstand my power, no one should be able to defeat it, right?”Dudian’s eyes lit up.
Felix’s mouth twitched and he became silent.
It didn’t take long for the two to see a few chariots approaching.
“Even if you wear his clothes, they will recognize you.”Felix shook his head.
Dudian raised his hand and pressed on his face to adjust his bones. Soon, his face was 70-80% similar to that of the previous ghost change pilot. It was impossible to recognize him in the night without careful observation.
Felix saw this move and couldn’t help but take a deep breath. He bitterly smiled and didn’t say anything more.
“We are here to pick up the president, Lucifer!”A middle-aged man with a righteous face called out from inside the vehicle. He was the security supervisor of the previous factory.
Felix looked at him. The corner of his mouth slightly twitched as he asked Dudian to bring out the external projection of the mech. He used the horn of the mech and said: “There is no need. Lucifer will send me back. You can escort me from the back!”
“This pilot’s name is Lucifer?”Dudian’s eyebrows twitched as he remembered the name.

chapters.title: Chapter 1082
chapters.content:
Chapter 1082 – Chapter 171: Isolation
“President, that demon…”the head guard carefully asked. After all, Dudian had escaped and he had to bear the main responsibility.
Felix looked at Dudian and indicated how to answer.
Dudian whispered a few words. Felix was startled as a bitter smile appeared on his face, he looked at the head guard: “The Demon has escaped. Qiu Ling is chasing after it. I don’t know what the situation is like. Let’s go back first in case the demon comes back.”
The supervisor was shocked as he didn’t expect Dudian to be able to escape from the encirclement of two four-star mechs. He saw that there was no protection around him so he quickly said: “President please go back to the factory. I will cover the rear.”
Felix felt that his words of loyalty were ridiculous. He sighed and turned off the external projection, he turned to dudian and whispered: “I have done what you told me. What do you want to Do? You want a legal identity of the federation. I can do it for you. I hope you can leave or you will be exposed sooner or later. At that time I won’t be able to protect you!”
Dudian smiled: “They will send people to check the battle. You can send a few of your trusted aides to investigate. I will stay here for a period of time.”
Felix’s face was ugly. Dudian wouldn’t be able to control his life for a day if he didn’t leave. It wasn’t a good feeling.
Dudian told Felix some things on the way. It didn’t take long for them to return to the underground factory. They saw a few higher-ups waiting at the door to welcome them. They were relieved to see Felix coming out of the mech, they went forward to greet him.
Felix asked Dudian to follow him. In order to express his gratitude for Dudian’s rescue, he promoted Dudian to the position of the manager of the mecha.
The original manager of the mecha was the woman who was driving the nine-tailed fox. Now that she was dead, her position was vacant. It was a matter of course for her to fall onto Dudian’s head. No one had any objections.
Dudian and Felix went back to the lowest floor of the office. They closed the door. Felix who was leading the way bowed slightly, dudian went straight to the chair and sat down. He looked around, he looked at Felix: “You are the President of HAWSK company. Tell me about the consortium and the ATLAS Consortium. Also, give me a detailed map of the federation’s Hundred Cities. Pay attention and don’t play tricks.”
Felix looked at Dudian who was giving orders. He was a bit angry but he obediently listened to him. There was a smile on his face.
Dudian learned a lot about the federation from Felix. He had designed a few small traps to test whether what Felix said was true or false, he had learned from Luke and the other two pilots. He roughly believed about 70-80% of what Felix had said but he still had a trace of doubt.
“It would be great if I had the magic marks ability of the dreamer.”Dudian thought about the ability of crimson moon. He was a bit envious. Unfortunately the ‘Dreamer’was a five-star legendary monster.
Dudian asked about all kinds of equipment in the factory. As he had learned before, many of the equipment here were very helpful to him. After all, although there was no research on undeads but Hosk was making semi-biological mechs, he had a deep understanding of the monster’s body. Therefore, the equipment here were top-notch biological research equipment. It was enough for him to understand his own situation.
Dudian waited for Felix to finish speaking. He asked him to vacate a separate factory. Then he selected some equipment and asked him to send someone to deliver it.
After doing all this, the sky was already bright. Dudian couldn’t help but feel a little tired after a night of fighting.
Felix saw that Dudian seemed to be in a good mood, he gathered his courage and whispered: “Mr Dean, I really don’t understand why you didn’t threaten me at the beginning. You are so strong so you won’t be tortured in the first place.”
“Torture?”Dudian smiled as he thought of his punishment: “I came here with a cooperative attitude. I didn’t expect that you would lock me up.”
Felix was startled: “Really?”
“Of course not.”Dudian smiled.
Felix’s mouth twitched as he controlled his anger: “Why didn’t Mr. Dean take action from the beginning?”
“I didn’t know who was in charge at the beginning.”Dudian laughed, “You sent a manager to receive me in the cage and then you appeared. I didn’t know if you were the biggest behind-the-scenes commander. I could only stay inside to feel the situation. I didn’t know that you were much simpler than I thought.”
“Is that the reason?”Felix heard Dudian’s sarcasm. He felt a bit aggrieved. He regretted that he couldn’t go back to the past.
“If you break the cage from the beginning it will scare you but your defense isn’t weak. If you contact the military and send people to encircle me then I will be in a more dangerous situation.”Dudian slowly said: “On the contrary, if I stay inside I will have time to observe you. You think that I am the one who is trapped but in fact it is you who are trapped.”
Felix’s pupils shrank as he felt a trace of coldness in his heart. He finally knew how sinister and cunning this demon was. It was definitely not the other demons in his previous impression.
“So you know how to operate our protoss mecha. Did you get it from Luke’s mouth?”Felix clenched his teeth as he thought of Dudian’s methods.
Dudian nodded.
Felix clenched his fists. He wanted to tear Luke and the others into pieces. He had sent people to ask them what had happened when Luke and the others came out, but they didn’t mention anything about Dudian forcing them to confess. It was a blatant betrayal!
“We don’t need to report about the escape of the demons. You can suppress this matter.”Dudian said to Felix: “I don’t want the military to investigate us now.”
Felix’s heart sank.
“In addition, I know that you have a way to send information to the outside world. But you know the consequences. It is not good for you. You will be the first to die!”Dudian stared at him.
Felix’s heart was trembling. Their factory was located in a remote place in the suburbs. At the moment in Dudian’s hands it was like being isolated on an island.

chapters.title: Chapter 1083
chapters.content:
Chapter 1083 – Chapter 172: Cover Up
“President, your breakfast is ready.”
A gentle and sweet voice came from outside the room.
Felix frowned and said impatiently: “I’m not in the mood to eat.”
“Let’s go.”Dudian looked at him: “After one night, the others should want to tell you something. For example, how to deal with the aftermath of the escape.”
Felix’s face slightly changed: “Yes, Let’s go together.”He shouted at the woman: “Wait, I’ll put on my clothes.”
Dudian and Felix changed into a set of clothes and went to another restaurant which was built in the air. The restaurant was built on the lowest floor of the factory. It was surrounded by glass pipes.
The dining table was very long. There were exquisite vases and the tablecloth was covered with perfume. It was clear what kind of taste Felix liked to pursue in life. After Dudian and Felix sat down, Felix ordered two steaks. Usually, they would wait for him to come before they cooked the steaks on the spot. The chef who fried the steaks was next to the restaurant. He was a star chef.
Felix ate slowly. He felt that the delicious steaks were like wax at this moment. He was a bit absent-minded.
After eating for a while, there were footsteps coming from outside. He saw the white beard old man and several other senior managers of the factory come in. They saw Felix who was eating at the table and immediately greeted him, then they saw Dudian who was eating with them. There was a look of understanding in their eyes. They knew that Felix was grateful to Dudian for saving him so he invited him to eat with them.
The senior officials went up to Dudian and politely greeted him. They were concerned about Felix’s body and finally told him their purpose.
“President, I heard that the demon escaped. He should still be in our copper ship city. Should we contact the military to search for him?”The white bearded old man politely asked.
Felix’s heart was slightly cold. He subconsciously looked at Dudian but saw that Dudian was smiling as if it wasn’t related to him. He narrowed his eyes and thought for a moment, “Don’t alert the military. Don’t report it to the headquarters of the consortium. Once the military is alerted and the background of the demon is investigated, we will be involved! If we report it to the headquarters of the consortium then they will blame us for not doing our job well. Not only will I be criticized but everyone present will also be punished.”
Everyone frowned as they heard Dudian say the word ‘punishment’.
“President, how should we deal with this demon? Should we just let him leave like this?”Someone asked.
Felix thought for a moment and said, “We’ll talk about it later. When the time comes, we’ll say that we accidentally found traces of the demon and report it to the military. This way, once we catch the demon, we’ll be rewarded instead.”
Everyone looked at each other and said to Felix, “President is WISE!”
“President, why don’t we report this to the military now? We have found traces of the demons. If the demons stay in the city for one more day, the citizens will be in danger.”A middle-aged man in a white suit asked in confusion.
Felix shook his head and said, “The identity that he sneaked in is the identity of the military. For the time being, he is also using the appearance of the military. He has just left. It is estimated that he will not change his identity in a short time. Instead, he will use the identity of the military to sneak into the city and find a place to stay. If we report this to the military now, once we find him and see his appearance, our matter will be exposed.”
The middle-aged man in the white suit said in admiration: “The president is thoughtful.”
Felix bitterly smiled in his heart. He thought that the devil was sitting in front of him and eating breakfast with him. They were talking about how to deal with him in front of him. It was really ironic and funny.
They exchanged a few words and left together.
After they left, Felix looked at dudian: “What do you think?”
Dudian nodded: “Not bad.”
The chef heard their words. It was the first time that Felix praised his culinary skills.
Dudian asked Felix to take him to the prepared laboratory. The laboratory was very spacious and full of all kinds of instruments.
“You can use it at any time.”Felix said.
“I want to use a respectful title in private.”Dudian said.
Felix bowed his head: “Yes.”
Dudian looked at the laboratory and left. He didn’t use it immediately. He asked Felix to take him to see the mechas in the factory and the production line of the mechas.
“The most powerful mechas that we have made here are the nine-tailed fox mechas. They have been used by Autumn Ling.”Felix took Dudian to the warehouse where the mechas were parked, there were many ferocious mechas standing or crouching there. Dudian saw the nine-tailed fox that had been recovered. It was standing alone in the innermost part of the warehouse. The mechas had been repaired in just one night.
“This nine-tailed fox is very strong?”Dudian was surprised. He didn’t feel it during the previous battle.
Felix thought about how Dudian had defeated two mechas in a row. The nine-tailed Fox didn’t last long in his hands. His heart ached, felix bitterly smiled: “This is the strongest mech we have. It is very compatible with Autumn Ling’s magic marks. Her basic abilities are flash vision and multi-neuron vision. One is enhanced vision which is equivalent to the enhanced version of dynamic vision. She can see every frame of a bullet shot out of the gun. Multi-neuron vision is her ability to multitask. Moreover her neural reaction is exceptionally sensitive. It is three times more than the other dominant mechas. This nine-tailed fox is a sensitive mech. Her ability can maximize it.”
“Does she have the ability to make people dizzy?”Dudian asked.
Felix wryly smiled, “This is her core ability. It is not to make people dizzy but to make them hallucinate. Maybe your physique is too strong so you will only feel dizzy. If it was someone else, they would have fallen into the illusion.”
“So you also fell into the illusion?”
Felix nodded. A trace of coldness appeared in his eyes, “These two bastards actually want to kill me. We spent a lot of money to nurture them and let them enjoy their current status and life.”
“Because you are not the king, you can’t get their loyalty.”Dudian said.
Felix was not convinced: “But I can give them everything they want. They shouldn’t betray me!”
“In between betrayal and life, they chose their own life. After all, benefits are benefits, not faith.”Dudian said in a teaching tone.
Felix was stunned. He suddenly realized that Qiu Ling and Lucifer knew that Dudian was holding them hostage. If one of them got off the mech, Dudian would kill them. So in order to protect himself.., they planned to kill him and Dudian together. Then they would say that Dudian killed them.
Although they would be punished but it was nothing compared to losing their lives.
Thinking of this, Felix thought of Luke and the others. He couldn’t help but feel angry and inexplicable loss. The continuous betrayal made him doubt himself.
However, he was a person who had climbed out of the consortium and had gone through tempering. He quickly put away his thoughts and introduced other mechas to dudian.
In addition to the nine-tailed fox, there were two other four-star mechas. The rest were mostly three-star and two-star mechas.
“Only the headquarters has the ability to produce five-star mechas. Their combat power is comparable to the kings of your demon race.”Felix said to Dudian.
Dudian was curious: “Are the five-star Mechas produced by you the best? In that case, what’s the difference between them and the military’s five-star mechas? Their power doesn’t seem to be superior to theirs.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1084
chapters.content:
Chapter 1084 – Chapter 173: The Upper Abyss
Felix smiled: “Do you know how many ‘God of Creation’mechas there are? How many mecha operators can operate the god of Creation?”
“Oh?”Dudian was interested.
“It is the dark era and resources are scarce. All kinds of minerals in the federation have been mined. It is different from 300 years ago. Humans have been all over the world and can find more resources.”Felix smiled: “The cost of creating a ‘god of creation’Mech is too high. Even our Locke non-consortium has to make a careful choice.”
“There are very few mecha operators who can operate the god of creation. After all, the physique of an ordinary person can reach the level of a five-star mecha operator. In addition to high talent, it requires high-intensity training and hard work. These are indispensable!”
“However, the protoss mecha that we are making is different. The cost of using the remains of monsters as raw materials to make a five-star mecha is less than one-fifth of the cost of the god of Creation!”
Dudian nodded: “The cost is understandable but for the pilots, any of the demon warriors you have trained here can pilot the god of creation.”
“They can pilot but they can not pilot it.”Felix said: “The five-star Mech is the focus of the people in the federation. It is the same for the five-star pilots. They are all star level characters. If a demon pilot pilot the god of creation, it is easy to be exposed.”. Moreover, it is convenient for the pilots of the mechas. They are specially appointed by the military. Even if we put one in, it will be detected by them. Don’t think that our consortium can interfere with military affairs or even poach people from the military. But the demon is the bottom line of the military. It is also the bottom line of the people. It can not be touched!”
“Who is in charge of the military?”
“The president of the Federation.”
Dudian asked: “Don’t the military know that you are privately researching about these monsters?”
“The people don’t know about it and the soldiers don’t know about it. But the president of the federation and some generals of the military know about it.”Felix laughed: “Although this kind of thing can not be exposed or everyone will shout at us. But the fact that we are not producing the devil’s mecha is beneficial to the federation. We are nurturing the Devils so that they can operate the mecha and attack you. The interests in this area are in line with the main purpose of the federation. So the president won’t ask about it. As long as we don’t expose it and provoke the people to protest, nothing will happen.”
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he sighed in his heart. He thought of the Holy Church and the dark church in the giant wall of Sylvia. It seemed that the world was always black and white. In other words, it was a chaotic gray world, because people had distinguished the good from the bad, they had to define the other part as evil. Just like how humans had defined elegance, they had to define the other part as vulgar.
“The demon fighters and monster mechas that you have cultivated are equivalent to private force. Will the president of the Federation allow it? What kind of agreement should there be between you?”Dudian asked Felix.
Felix nodded slightly, “I don’t know the details of the agreement. But the monster mechas of our Locke’s non-consortium need to sign military service contracts. In other words, the military has the right to use them unconditionally in times of war.”
“Is the contract still valid at that time?”
“I don’t know. Maybe there are other supplementary agreements or checks and balances. But I’m just a small member of the Rockefeller Consortium. I don’t know much about them.”Felix shrugged his shoulders.
Dudian carefully looked at Felix. He was able to tell if Felix was lying from the beginning to the end.
Dudian went to the assembly line workshop after he finished looking at the mechas. He saw that there were three main types of production workshops. The first was the raw materials processing workshop, the workshop was filled with the bodies of the monsters. These monsters were dead but their bodies were still intact. Only a small part of them were damaged.
The second was the Assembly workshop. This was where the metal was processed into the bodies of the modified monsters, making the two compatible.
