The third was the factory workshop. This was where all the final details of the mech were perfected, including the intelligent system detection, circuit detection, Mech Weapon System detection and installation, and so on.
Each type of workshop had many subdivisions. For example, the Assembly workshop was divided into intelligent assembly and metal assembly. There were rooms inside, and there were not many workers. Each worker was behind a huge conveyor belt in the workshop, they were wearing metal gloves and special glasses. Through the instrument they could observe the small tissue inside the monster’s body. Then they used the metal gloves to connect the mechanical arm to install the circuit into the monster’s body, it was equivalent to an extremely delicate operation. The difficulty was extremely high.
“Do you want to go to the pilot training room?”Felix suddenly suggested after Dudian finished visiting the Mech Workshop.
Dudian glanced at him: “No, go back and rest.”
Felix’s heart trembled as Dudian looked at him. The reason why he suggested Dudian to go to the training room was because he knew that the training room had the ability of demons. There was no lack of people with strong perception, perhaps they could see through Dudian’s identity and bring some trouble to Dudian. But it seemed that they had seen through him.
Dudian went back to Felix’s room and found some wound medicine to speed up the healing of his shoulder. He said to Felix: “Is the day of the battle coming soon?”
Felix was startled: “I will get people to withdraw it.”
“No need.”Dudian waved his hand: “The sudden withdrawal will attract people’s attention. We will proceed as usual. You will pick someone from the division who has the same ability as me. You will dress up like me and let people drive the nine-tailed Fox to fight. We will end the battle quickly and kill them quickly so that the end of the competition will be more natural.”
Felix’s face slightly changed: “I know.”
“In addition, give me the information about the demon race.”Dudian said.
Felix felt uneasy but agreed.
The next day.
Dudian asked Felix to take him to see the other real demon race. Felix introduced the origin and strength of the demon race to Dudian. It was an upper abyss, the second captain of the Ninth Legion under the command of one of the seven kings of the demon race had been imprisoned here for eight years. He had appeared here before Felix accepted the copper market.

chapters.title: Chapter 1085
chapters.content:
Chapter 1085 – Chapter 174: Secrets Of Magic Insects
Felix didn’t take Dudian to the observation deck but went directly to the monitoring room. He saw that Dudian’s face was calm. He wasn’t surprised at all, he pointed to one of the monitoring rooms: “This is him. His name is Lucian.”There was a technician in the monitoring room.
Dudian was a bit respectful. He looked at the monitor and saw Lucien sitting under the observation table. He was bored to death. He picked his nose and then put it into his mouth and ate it. Everyone was speechless.
Lucien was a burly man with a rough face. There were several claw scars on his arms and neck. Dark brown scars were left behind. He had thick eyebrows and big eyes. It seemed that he had a lot of perseverance, his face was full of beard. He looked a bit down.
“What is his ability?”Dudian asked.
Felix said: “According to our observation and test, his ability is flame. It can change the structure of the fat in the body in an instant. It produces a special oil. The oil will spontaneously combust through the friction of the muscles. It can be released from all parts of the body. Moreover, it won’t hurt himself. There will be a layer of special membrane to protect him. In addition, he has heat vision and a set of special combat skills.”
Dudian nodded. Flame type magic marks were very rare. They were similar to Dragon type magic marks. They were inclined to attack and destroy.
Dudian didn’t stay for long. He didn’t greet Lucien and left with Felix.
On the third day, Dudian felt that his shoulder was almost recovered. He brought Felix to the laboratory that he had built. He asked him to accompany him as an assistant. Afterwards he operated the equipment and drew blood from his body, in addition he cut off a piece of flesh and used it as a planter. He picked a parasitic soul worm from the factory and planted it into the flesh.
There were many parasitic soul worms stored in the factory. They were used to cultivate the mecha operators of the demon race. However they didn’t classify the parasitic soul worms. They didn’t even know what the corresponding ability of the parasitic soul worms was, it was far less perfect than the Shenluo Empire. So the strong ability of the demon pilots depended on their own luck.
Dudian couldn’t identify the parasitic soul worms so he could only randomly select them.
Felix was watching Dudian’s experiment. He knew that Dudian was monitoring him but he took the opportunity to observe Dudian’s secret. He didn’t expect that Dudian would want so many experimental instruments! Was he going to study himself? !
Felix had a strange feeling that Dudian was very different from other devils.
After several days of Research Dudian had gained a lot. It was as he had guessed. The genes in his body and the Aragami factor had been completely mixed together. Each cell had a nucleus made of Aragami factor, it was very strong and could devour the bacteria that had invaded his body. His anti-toxin and anti-bacterial ability had been greatly improved.
In addition, his gene chain was very strange. It was actually made up of different genes. After the analysis of these genes, it turned out that there were several groups of magic marks genes. One of them was the Aragami factor gene. In other words.., his whole body was made up of Aragami factor and magic marks genes. There was a part of his own genes but only one-third of it was made up of his own genes.
This discovery made Dudian’s hair stand on end. If he absorbed more and more magic marks, would there be less and less of his own genes?
In the end, would he still be a human?
However, he was glad that his current position was still in the human state. He had the seven emotions and six desires of a human.
Afterwards, Dudian used the cut off part of the flesh to cultivate parasitic soul worms. He continuously inserted the genes of many kinds of parasitic soul worms. He found that the gene chain in the flesh was more complex. However, what surprised him was that.., the proportion of his genes as a ‘human’didn’t decrease. It was still about one-third! After repeated observation, Dudian knew the reason. Although he had added many parasitic soul worms, but the genes of these soul worms swallowed each other and fused. There was no diffusion ratio.
“Aragami factor takes up one-third, soul worm gene one-third, oneself one-third…”Dudian looked at his body’s condition and felt a bit strange. He tried to add dozens of soul worms in succession, the proportion of soul worm genes in the flesh didn’t increase. It was still one-third! He was a bit surprised by the result. Later he found out that the genes of these soul worms were very similar. This was the reason why they could fuse with each other.
In short.
These soul worms seemed to be a whole!
Each soul worm seemed to be a part of the whole!
Dudian was shocked by this discovery. Could it be that all the soul worms came from the same mother?
Or could all the soul worms be reconstituted into a giant soul worm?
He knew that these parasitic soul worms were born from the polar ice worms. Didn’t it mean that these polar ice worms came from the same mother?
Dudian was excited as he thought of this. If all the magic worms came from the same mother then it meant that controlling the mother meant controlling all the Soul Worms on earth!
This was a shocking discovery!
Because it was a shocking discovery that could help mankind to recapture Earth!
Dudian checked all the parasitic soul insects stored in the factory and found that all of them could fuse with each other!
He didn’t know if all the soul insects in the outside world were like this. But at least he felt that he had a great clue and weapon. If he used it well.., maybe he could completely destroy the magic worms that invaded the earth.
But soon, Dudian woke up from the Crazy State. He felt extremely bitter. Only he knew the secret but he couldn’t reveal it to the public! The Seven Kings of the Empire were controlled by the magic worms. This was a secret. But he didn’t know what the top secret of the federation was. If he were to rashly reveal it, it might bring disaster to himself.
It felt like he held the secret of saving the world in his hands, but he was unable to become the Savior. He could only hold the secret in his hands. Perhaps this was a sin? However, he felt helpless. He couldn’t even save the person he loved the most, so how could he save the world? Even if he could save the world, what was the point if the world wasn’t his?
He knew that this thought was a little selfish, but he suddenly felt dispirited. He immediately gathered his emotions and buried this secret in his heart. He might use it someday, but it was definitely not now.

chapters.title: Chapter 1086
chapters.content:
Chapter 1086 – Chapter 175Th: Failure
Dudian was ready to find the secret of the Aragami factor as the experiment continued. In addition, he wanted to know why the part of his genes as a human could be maintained at one-third. Could it be that his own genes.., could be comparable to the Aragami Factor and soul worm?
In order to verify, Dudian asked Felix to find a few test subjects. These “Test subjects”were poor refugees bought by Hawsk from the refugee area. Most of them were in their teens. Their families didn’t have the conditions to support them, they could only sell their children for money to support other children and adults.
When these children were sent here, their bodies had been washed. They were wearing simple clothes. They didn’t look dirty but very ordinary. However, there were a few good-looking girls among them, they were more conspicuous among the many test subjects.
The role of these test subjects was naturally to be used for biological development experiments in the factory. Some of the talented ones might be selected and used as magic marks to be nurtured as mecha operators.
Dudian looked at the children and thought of himself and Barton who were in the orphanage. If they were born in the federation, they might face the same situation. Although he was touched but there was no pity in his eyes. He chose two physically strong children as his experiments. He gave them the Aragami factor and the soul worm.
If they were successful, it would be a great opportunity for these children to become strong.
The two children were clearly nervous as they lay on the operating table. Their eyes were full of fear and a trace of pleading. However, Dudian was wearing a pale coat and his face was cold. Their pleas were ignored.
The operation was successful. Dudian successfully transplanted part of his Aragami factor into the bodies of the two children. He gave them magic marks and observed the changes in their bodies, he found that the Aragami Factor and soul worm were fighting each other in their bodies but they seemed to have reached a delicate balance. Each of them occupied half of their bodies. The situation was a bit similar to his.
However, before Dudian could look away, the first child who finished the surgery suddenly turned pale. He trembled on the hospital bed. The next moment, a large amount of blood spurted out from his wound and dyed his hospital gown red, the blood-red tentacles broke out from his body and twisted around the wound like the claws of a monster. However, it didn’t take long for the blood-red tentacles to shrink, age, and lose its moisture and luster.
The child’s body also stopped struggling and moving. He was already dead.
This scene not only scared the second child who did the experiment, but also scared Felix. Although he had seen some biological experiments, but it didn’t seem to be such a bloody scene.
Dudian sighed in regret. He quickly took out the body of the dead child and dissected it. He tried to find the reason for the failure of the experiment.
Felix didn’t know whether Dudian’s sigh was a pity for the life of the child or for the failure of his experiment. He sat by the side and looked at Dudian’s busy figure on the operating table. His scalp felt numb, he had an impulse to escape from this place.
It didn’t take long for Dudian to find the reason. The Aragami Factor had swallowed the soul worm. At the same time it had swallowed the child’s cells. Most of the organs in his body had disappeared and there was a lot of corrosive liquid, the Aragami Factor and the soul worm couldn’t reach a complete balance in his body!
At this time, the second child’s body also showed the same condition. He died miserably on the hospital bed.
Dudian dissected the child. The result was the same. He felt strange so he asked Felix to find a strong guard to be the test subject.
This time, Dudian was not in a hurry to experiment. He was thinking about the transformation that Crimson Moon had done to his body and what Crimson Moon had said to him. Their idea was to create a god with the help of the super healing ability of the polar ice worm, the cells would be able to divide and recombine in a cycle.
Dudian did experiments on the guard the next day. This time the sequence was a bit different. He first implanted the magic marks into the guard’s body and trained him to become a hunter. Then he implanted a small amount of Aragami factor into the guard’s body, then he used uranium to help him stabilize the Aragami factor in his body.
However, the experiment had reached this step. Although the Aragami factor in the guard’s body was stabilized with the help of uranium, but the soul worm cells suddenly burst out and swallowed the Aragami factor which was suppressed by the uranium, it rapidly grew. The strengthened soul worm gene made the guard’s body unable to withstand it. Many important organs in his body rapidly turned into ice. Some of them were frozen, some had signs of frostbite, and some had accelerated to split into strange tissues.
“Strange!”This situation was out of Dudian’s expectations. How could he fail the god-making experiment? How could the guard die with the help of the uranium ring? Was it because of his weak constitution?
Dudian thought about the time when he ate the flesh of the Aragami in Amelia’s tribe. He was the master at that time. He immediately asked Felix to call one of the two masters in the factory.
The man was called Umek. He had pale yellow hair. He had a western face. His face was cold and arrogant. He nodded to Felix as he entered the laboratory. He glanced at Dudian but didn’t take the initiative to speak, in his opinion Dudian was Lucifer. Although he had replaced autumn to become the manager but there was no need for him to suck up to him. Maybe the next time Dudian died the position of manager would fall to him.
“Do we really need him?”Felix looked at Umek. He hesitated. After all, they had spent a lot of effort to train the master level pilot, dudian’s previous experiments were all dead. He wasn’t optimistic about Umek’s fate.
Umek looked at him suspiciously. He didn’t know why Felix was asking Dudian as the president. It seemed that he couldn’t make the decision.
“Just him. He is just a master anyway. There is nothing to be reluctant about.”Dudian casually said.
Umek was furious, he shouted: “Lucifer, what do you mean by that? Don’t think that you can do whatever you want just because you saved the president. If I go that night, not only can I save the president but I can also catch the demon. If you have the ability then you can have a fair duel with me!”
“Noisy.”Dudian came in front of Umek. He suddenly stretched out his hand in front of Umek’s angry eyes. It seemed slow but in an instant he grabbed Umek’s neck and lifted him onto the operating table.
Yumike’s mind was in a daze. He didn’t see Dudian’s movements but the five fingers on his neck were as hard as an eagle’s claw. He was shocked: “How… How can you have such strong strength?”
“Shhh.”Dudian made a gesture.
Yumike’s mind buzzed and he fainted on the spot.
Dudian locked him on the operating table and began to dissect him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1087
chapters.content:
Chapter 1087 – Chapter 176Th: News
Dudian’s first step was to copy umek to his original state. Then he would analyze the thought of crimson moon and carry out the experiment. However, the unexpected thing happened again. Umek’s body had just been implanted with the Aragami factor. His body was quickly rotten and his death was as tragic as the others.
“How could this be?”Dudian didn’t understand. It seemed that the difference in physique was useless in front of the Aragami factor. Why couldn’t the master of the Aragami factor absorb the Aragami factor while he could?
Was it because of the magic marks of the splitter?
He couldn’t figure it out. The scene that flashed through his mind when Crimson Moon read his memory appeared in his mind. He was familiar with his parents’faces in the laboratory. His heart suddenly twitched, the next moment, he turned over the operating table and smashed the things around him. He turned around and left the laboratory.
Felix was scared out of his wits but he obediently followed behind Dudian. He didn’t dare to get too close to him so as not to be angry.
“What kind of experiment is he going to do? It’s so difficult!”Felix looked at Dudian’s back as he walked in front of him. His eyes lit up, he knew that Dudian was changing the materials of different experiments. However, even Umick who had the dominant physique couldn’t withstand it. It was clear how dangerous the experiment was!
Dudian didn’t continue the experiment for the next few days. His mood was very unstable. Felix was scared. He wanted to run away from Dudian but he was afraid that this action would anger him.
The two of them had attracted the attention of other high-level people. However no one dared to ask. There were even some rumors. For example, Felix liked men. As for why Lucifer didn’t like men.., the reason was very simple. The two of them stood together. Felix’s handsome face always looked feminine. He wasn’t as rough as Lucifer. It was obvious who had a problem with their sexual orientation.
These rumors naturally fell into Felix’s ears. He was so angry that he was twitching but he couldn’t take the initiative to provoke him. He could only bite the bullet and swallow the bitter fruit.
“President, Mr. Farrow will come tomorrow at 11 o’clock.”
Felix’s secretary passed the news of Mr. Farrow’s schedule to Felix. There was a trace of envy in her eyes as she looked at Dudian who was sitting on the sofa, felix had always doted on her. But now she wouldn’t invite her into the office when she wasn’t working.
Dudian felt the inexplicable hostility. He recovered from his thoughts and glanced at Felix’s secretary. He frowned and carefully looked at her for a moment. He didn’t want to torture her.
“Mr. Farrow is coming?”Felix was surprised but he was secretly happy. This way he would have the opportunity to spread the news!
He nodded and ordered: “Prepare a sumptuous lunch tomorrow. Mr. Farrow’s favorite foie gras. Remember to send it by air tomorrow morning.”
The secretary nodded and left.
Felix was relieved, he turned to dudian: “Farrow is the special consultant of the consortium. He will visit twice a year. It is June now. He is probably here to evaluate our performance in the first half of the year. I want to entertain him.”
Dudian nodded but didn’t say anything.
Felix saw that Dudian didn’t stop him. He was relieved and sneered in his heart.
The next day.
A white man came to the factory with two bodyguards. Felix and a few higher-ups were on the ground to greet them. Felix was surprised that Dudian didn’t follow them. It seemed that he didn’t want to show his face.
Felix guessed that Dudian should have taken into consideration that Farrow’s bodyguards had the ability of demons. He was afraid that he would be exposed so he hid. This was convenient for him to pass the information!
He was happy as he hugged Farrow and went to his own restaurant at the bottom of the factory.
Several high-level officials accompanied Farrow to eat and drink. During this time Felix secretly passed the information that he had prepared to farrow. Farrow was puzzled but there seemed to be another reason for the look in Felix’s eyes. He quietly put it away. After the meal Farrow went back to the room that Felix had arranged for him. He opened the note, he immediately saw the contents.
“What? !”
“The demons actually kidnapped him, and they’re hiding by his side? ! They’re actually a demon at the level of the Lord of the Abyss!”
Faleau’s expression changed drastically, and he was a little shocked. He even suspected that this was Felix’s prank, but thinking that he probably wouldn’t dare to make such a big joke, he immediately paced back and forth in the room with a serious expression.
In the evening, Farrow found an excuse to say that the inspection was over. He took two bodyguards and left in a hurry.
Farrow gave Felix a look to stabilize the situation after the helicopter took off.
Felix nodded slightly. Both of them waved goodbye.
Felix returned to the factory but found that Dudian was not in his office. He immediately asked his secretary. The secretary saw that he was looking for Dudian. He was angry but could only answer honestly: “Mr. Lucifer said that he is in the laboratory. No one should disturb him.”
“Laboratory? Did He do that Ghost Experiment Again?”Felix thought of the tragic death of Dudian’s experiment subject, he shivered. He noticed that the secretary was looking at him with her eyes. He could see the two halves of the collar.
He felt his blood pressure rise. He had been afraid of Dudian for a long time. It was a rare opportunity for him to leave Dudian’s sight!
However, the evil thoughts in his heart were extinguished. This rare opportunity was not to be wasted on a woman. He quickly found someone to arrange the evacuation.
“Mr. Farrow, why are you in such a hurry to go back? Didn’t you say that you wanted to play here for a few more days?”The helicopter pilot asked Farrow. He had long heard that the test products here were not bad and wanted to take the opportunity to play tonight, he did not expect that he would have to leave before the sky turned dark.
“There are demons here that have escaped and kidnapped Felix!”Farrow said with a gloomy expression.
The pilot of the helicopter was shocked when he heard that. He said in astonishment, “How is that possible? I see that the people in the factory are orderly. They don’t feel like they’ve been kidnapped at all!”
“This is the scariest thing!”Farrow took a deep breath. His blue eyes were filled with fear, “This demon took over the magpie’s nest and claimed this place for himself. If I hadn’t broken through it today, I don’t know how long it would have taken. Moreover, this is the Master of the Abyss. The headquarters will need to send at least two five-star mechas to be able to rescue Felix from his hands.”
Hearing this, the pilot sucked in a breath of cold air. The expressions of the two bodyguards beside him also changed abruptly.
“Eh, what’s That? !”Suddenly, the pilot cried out in surprise and looked at the display on the radar.
The helicopter’s base suddenly exploded. Faleau, who was sitting inside, was stabbed by the shrapnel on the spot and hit by the violent impact, his body turning into a pile of minced meat.
The two bodyguards reacted. Their faces were full of fear. Just as they entered the demonic body, a black shadow rushed over and swept past them. Their bodies were cut into seven or eight pieces and scattered in the air.
The pilot was so scared that his face turned pale. He shouted and operated the helicopter, trying to stabilize the crash. However, a sharp blade suddenly stabbed out from the back of the seat and pierced through his head.
The helicopter whistled as it fell down. The throttle was hot and it exploded.
A figure appeared in the flames. It was Dudian. He used his palm to burn the bodies of the few who were burned by the gasoline. He burned the bodies into ashes. There was no trace left and no way to know how they died.
Dudian quickly turned back to the factory.

chapters.title: Chapter 1088
chapters.content:
Chapter 1088 – Chapter 177: Trade
Felix was preparing to retreat while he sent his trusted guards to guard Dudian outside the laboratory. They would report to him as soon as there was any movement. However, the guard he sent ran back not long after he left.
Felix’s heart skipped a beat when he saw the guard rushing back. He heard the guard hurriedly say: “President, Mr. Lucifer is not in the laboratory. I asked the guard but no one saw him enter!”
Felix’s heart sank.
The next moment, he suddenly thought of Farrow who had just left. His face changed.
“President, are you looking for me?”A light voice was heard.
Felix instinctively shivered. He looked up and saw Dudian slowly walking down the steps. He was smiling and was very easy-going. However, he could feel the coldness in his eyes as if he had fallen into an ice cave.
Felix reacted after two seconds. He forced a smile: “Where Have You Been? I was going to look for you!”
The guards heard his words and looked at Felix in a strange way.
Felix wasn’t in the mood to pay attention to other things. His heart was beating fast and full of fear. He was afraid that Dudian would kill him on the spot. This demon was tyrannical and cruel. He would do anything.
“Then let’s go to your office to talk.”Dudian said.
Felix’s face was pale. He nodded: “Alright.”
Both of them entered the office and closed the door. The sound insulation effect of Felix’s office was very strong. Unless there was a loud quarrel inside, they wouldn’t be able to hear what was being said even if they were standing by the door. After all.., after all, these people had ordinary physiques.
Dudian sat down on Felix’s office chair. He saw that no one was eavesdropping outside, he said to Felix: “Are you going to sneak away? You are a smart person. Why do you always do such stupid things?”
The corner of Felix’s mouth twitched. He felt that his mouth was a bit sore. He touched his mouth and bitterly smiled: “How could I sneak away? This is the wilderness. There is no place to run.”
Dudian saw that Felix didn’t admit and didn’t continue to ask. He sighed: “There is such a big opportunity in front of you but you see it as a danger. This is the reason why you are so ordinary. The opportunity is in front of you but you can’t grasp it.”
Felix was stunned for a moment. He was confused. Dudian said that he was ordinary which made him speechless. He was the president of the copper ship’s HAWSK company. Even the mayor of copper ship had to be polite when he saw him, you Call Me Brother? How can you call me ordinary? ! How can you make those people who are quietly building a society feel embarrassed? !
He could only think about this idea but didn’t dare to refute. He innocently asked: “Opportunity? What Opportunity?”
Dudian was speechless: “Am I Not Your Opportunity?”
“Uh…”Felix was a bit dumbfounded. He didn’t dare to ask but was afraid to provoke dudian. He pondered for a moment, “Although you are powerful but I’m just an ordinary person. I really don’t understand…”
Dudian suddenly felt that he might have chosen the wrong person. He was silent for a moment, “I can make a deal with you so that your position in Locke’s non-consortium will rise to the position that you dream of. I also need you to give me some small help. After all, my identity is a bit sensitive in the federation so it is not suitable for me to show my face in public.”
Felix suddenly realized that Dudian was looking for him to cooperate!
“The opportunity he is talking about is cooperation. No, this is not cooperation. He wants me to become his puppet and help him to lurk in the Federation!”Felix woke up in an instant, his heart was cold. His first reaction was to refuse but he was afraid to provoke Dudian. He was ready to use a tactful way to express or promise to stabilize the demon..
A thought suddenly appeared in his mind. Maybe I can climb to a higher position in the family with the help of the power of the demon clan!
He was startled as he thought about it. He quickly dismissed the idea and didn’t dare to think about it.
The crime of colluding with the demon clan was the biggest death penalty in the federation!
Although he had cultivated the demon clan in private but it was completely different from colluding with the demon clan! Cultivating the demons was the business of the Rockefeller Consortium. The consortium was the one who instigated it. However, colluding with the real demons was not only harmful to the interests of the people but also the victims of the four consortia, no one would stand on his side and bear the responsibility for him!
Dudian quietly looked at Felix. Although his face was calm but his eyelids were quivering slightly. His heart was beating fast and cold sweat was oozing out from his pores.
He didn’t disturb him but quietly waited for him to sort out his thoughts.
After a moment Felix’s heartbeat gradually calmed down but it was still very fast: “I’m a bit curious. Why didn’t you talk about cooperation with me in the beginning?”
Dudian looked straight into his eyes: “Because the moment I came out of the cage I wanted to kill everyone here.”
Felix took a deep breath. He felt that the air was cold and his heart was almost frozen. He suddenly thought of Dudian’s indifferent eyes when he was doing experiments. It seemed that he didn’t have any feelings, he had treated everyone in the factory as dead people!
If this place was completely massacred then naturally Dudian’s whereabouts would be hidden!
“Then why did you change your mind?”Felix asked in a trembling voice.
Dudian thought for a moment: “Because I think that you have some value.”
Felix was startled for a moment. His heart was a bit relaxed but suddenly he became nervous. Dudian saw his value. Wasn’t it the deal? If he refused the deal then it would be equivalent to suicide!
“I promise you.”Felix didn’t think too much about it. As long as he could get rid of Dudian then there would be a lot of ways to punish him.
“Rockefay Felix, 26 years old this year. He was born in the rockefay consortium. His father is a director of the consortium. He is unmarried and graduated from the Royal University of Holy Warblers. He has a phd in the department of Mecha…”Dudian’s tone was indifferent, he told him about Felix’s information.
“How… How do you know? !”Felix was shocked as he interrupted Dudian’s words.
Dudian indifferently said: “You are not the only one who is willing to submit to me here.”
“But you have never left me!”Felix couldn’t help but shout.
“But you need to sleep.”Dudian said.
Felix was startled. He understood that Dudian had contacted others while he was sleeping. He had slept many times. Who knew how many things he had done in such a long time?
He suddenly felt that the people around him were not trustworthy. No one knew if there were traitors who had defected to Dudian.
Dudian saw his surprised expression and guessed his thoughts. This was the effect he wanted. In fact, he didn’t have any contact with other people, he used Felix’s fingerprint to log into his computer while he was sleeping.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089
chapters.content:
Chapter 1089 – Chapter 178: The Last Operation
“Your father is one of the thirteen directors of the Rockefeller Consortium. Your father has many children. You are not the most outstanding one. Your Brother is the regional president of the eight cities in North China. Your sister is the president of the HAWSK branch. Their position is higher than yours.”Dudian’s fingers tapped on the table, dudian slowly said: “If you cooperate with me in the future you can squeeze them out and inherit your father’s board of directors position. On the contrary, you will lose the competition. You know what will happen if you fail.”
Felix’s face was ugly. Dudian spoke to his heart. Although he was a top figure in the copper ship city. He was young and high in status. He was loved by the local rich businessmen. He was the son-in-law in their eyes, but everyone had their own difficulties and pressure. Dudian’s pressure was his big brother and sister. They were doing better than him.
Needless to say, his big brother was the president of North China Region! His sister’s city was one of the twelve star cities in the federation. It was far from the copper ship city in the border. It was rich in resources and had a large population. Naturally, they had a wide range of contacts, in the future he would be able to compete for the position of his father’s board of directors.
“What do I need to do if we cooperate?”Felix asked.
Dudian indifferently replied: “I need a legal identity in the federation. Then I will operate in this identity and become a new large group in the federation. At that time the power of this group will be divided to your side. This is your power. It is also the trump card for you to compete with your brother and sister for the position of your father’s board of directors. I will use this group to continue to snowball and get what I want. If you are obedient enough, in the future you may not only get a small board of directors position but also the chairman of the entire Rockefeller Consortium!”
Felix’s eyelids twitched when he heard the words “Chairman”. His heart beat rapidly but he quickly suppressed himself. The chairman of Rockefeller was a real giant in the federation, naturally, it was his dream to pursue. But to be fair, he knew that his ability to inherit his father’s position was the limit.
“The federation is not as strict as you demons. It is very difficult to become a large group in a short time. Money is not so easy to earn.”Felix calmly said.
Dudian was able to deduce the change in his mentality from his heartbeat reaction. Although he was moved but he was able to restrain himself, “You don’t need to worry about this. I have my own methods. Order is the collar of a slave. Some people are willing to wear it while others are unwilling.”
Felix’s face slightly changed: “Don’t mess around. Although you are very strong but there are surveillance cameras everywhere. If something happens then it will be easy to trace back to you!”
“Who said I will use force?”Dudian didn’t want to say more: “Did the four consortia follow the rules set by the Federal President? No, but they can ask the federal president to change the rules.”
Felix frowned as he understood Dudian’s meaning. He couldn’t understand how dudian could operate a large group with an ordinary legal identity of the Federation? Even he couldn’t do it. After all, the business and social strata here had solidified. It was impossible to break them. Occasionally, there would be a few nouveau riche who would rely on opportunistic business to prosper, even if there was a revolutionary and innovative business or plan, it would eventually be acquired by the big consortia. The big consortia could only taste the sweetness.
“If you don’t use violence and kill the innocent, I can cooperate with you.”Felix hesitated.
Dudian smiled and patted his shoulder, “Understand your situation. Either you pay absolute loyalty and cooperate with me, or you choose another way to protect your federation and consortium. After the memorial service, no one will think of you — except your creditors.”
Felix’s face slightly changed: “I Promise You.”
“In that case, prepare my identity in seven days. A clean resume will be enough. I’m about twenty years old. It’s best if I graduate from a biological research university. I don’t have any family ties.”Dudian said.
Felix nodded: “It’s easy.”
Dudian knew what kind of power and corruption he meant by ‘easy’. He smiled, “In addition, we will sign a contract. This is our cooperation contract. I will need your financial help but not too much.”
Felix knew that Dudian was going to tie him to the contract. He knew that he couldn’t get rid of dudian. This demon was more intelligent than he had imagined, moreover, he seemed to be very familiar with the system of the Federation. It was difficult for other demons to understand the federation even if they explained it to him. After all, it was a different culture and system. It would be difficult to master it in a short time, however Dudian was like a fish in water. He suspected that this demon had long obtained information about the federation. It was a senior spy sent by the demon.
However, this had nothing to do with him. He only hoped that Dudian could fulfill his promise. Otherwise, he had no other choice.
Dudian turned around and left after negotiating with Felix. He didn’t imprison Felix anymore. He had blocked the latter’s escape route. He believed that Felix wasn’t a person who would sacrifice himself for justice, dudian didn’t want to die with him. After all, he was a child of a business family. The concept of interests was deeply rooted and his thoughts had long been corrupted.
Dudian went to the laboratory. Before he left, he was ready to do one last experiment to check his heart!
The four lumps of flesh on the golden heart had not subsided. He used x-ray vision to check the situation inside but found that what he saw was a muddy golden color. It was not as clear as before. Moreover, he always felt that.., there seemed to be something inside the heart. Sometimes he would hear an inexplicable heartbeat. In addition to his own heartbeat, there were two kinds of heartbeat.
He did a CT scan but there was no effect. He could only do a heart test.
The surgery was very dangerous. Moreover, he had to do it himself. The posture was very inconvenient.
Dudian asked Felix to send people to guard the laboratory. After he was ready, he applied a large amount of anesthetic on himself. He felt his chest gradually become numb and began to operate. He opened the skin on his chest and demonized a sharp knife, he carefully cut the ribs on his chest and tore the muscle membrane. He saw the beating Golden Heart inside.
..
..
Don’t wait

chapters.title: Chapter 1090
chapters.content:
Chapter 1090 – Chapter 179: Aragami
Dudian carefully cut open the surface layer of the golden heart. He felt that his body was not too uncomfortable. He cut into one of the lumps. The heart membrane on the surface of the lumps was cut open and automatically shrank to the bottom of the lumps. It was a hard object. It was not pus or other liquid as dudian had imagined, moreover, the shape of the lump was very strange. It looked like a meatball the size of an eyeball.
But if he looked carefully, the surface of the meatball was stained with blood and there were tiny protruding horns.
Dudian slightly frowned and felt a bit disgusted. After all, this was something that grew on his body. Moreover, it was on the most secretive heart. He took a deep breath and cut open the other three lumps one by one, he found that two of the lumps were wrapped in a black tentacle. It was very small and messy. At first glance, it looked like the tentacles of an octopus. Under each tentacle, there was a semi-transparent crescent-shaped hook. The hook was very tender, it was like a cartilage. However, Dudian felt a chill. He had killed many monsters. There was no lack of young monsters. The cartilage hook was clearly a claw that had not yet grown!
He suddenly had a strong fear. At this time, the second heartbeat would appear in his ears. His pupils shrank, and he had the impulse to immediately cut open the heart to see what was going on.
But he knew that if there was an accident, he would definitely die!
After adjusting his breathing, Dudian held his breath and cut off a small piece of the edge muscle from the heart. This would not affect his life. Then he quickly used the hook scissors to pull the heart membrane and stitch the heart back to its original state.
Dudian saw that the wound was healing. He estimated that it would take less than an hour to remove the suture. He felt that the suture was being decomposed by the heart. He didn’t need to remove it.
After all, the suture was extracted from the monster’s tail. It could be digested.
Dudian didn’t rush to test it. He used the ultrasound to check the condition of the heart. Soon, the image of the heart appeared on the intelligent drawing board. It was as vivid as a picture taken by a camera, the color was bright.
Dudian saw an unforgettable scene. A thumb-sized head appeared in the middle of the Golden Heart!
There was a human head in his heart!
Dudian almost jumped up as he saw the scene. It took him a long time to recover. He looked at the thumb-sized head. It was an extremely white baby’s head. Its eyes were closed, the eyelids were transparent and the eyes could be seen inside. However the eyes were golden and seemed to be staring at him through the membrane of the eyelids. It was full of strange and indescribable horror.
In addition to the head, the baby’s body had also grown into shape. The four lumps were its body!
Two of the lumps were eyeball-sized meatballs. They were two small clenched fists. The protruding horns were its fingers!
The other two lumps were like octopuses. They were messy and sinister.
“What… What is this thing? !”Dudian couldn’t help but take a deep breath, even though he had experienced a lot of things, he was still frightened by the strange and frightening scene. Moreover, this thing was growing on his body. He felt his scalp go numb and his blood was frozen!
He thought that his heart was just overworking and there was a small problem. He didn’t expect the picture to be so shocking. Could it be that this little thing had existed in his heart for a long time? ! It was just that it didn’t appear in the past. He overworked his heart and caused the blood flow in his body to accelerate. At the same time, the growth of this little thing led to the growth of his limbs? !
No matter how he thought about it, it was terrifying!
Dudian’s back was cold. He stared at the drawing of the heart of the baby for a moment. Suddenly his pupils shrank as he exclaimed: “Is this an Aragami? !”
The baby’s upper body was human but its lower body was like a messy octopus. He couldn’t help but think of the image of Aragami that he had seen in the giant wall of Sylvia and other giant walls, it was the same for the Aragami in Amelia’s tribe!
There was actually a baby Aragami in his heart? !
Moreover, he didn’t notice it at all. If it wasn’t for the fact that his heart was overloaded and had grown four bumps which made him uneasy, he didn’t know how long it would take for him to discover the existence of this thing!
Perhaps it would grow unconsciously until… it broke the heart and was born!
Dudian’s face turned pale as he thought about this. The Aragami had appeared in his heart. Although it was a larva but it was too terrifying!
“Don’t tell me that all the Aragami were born in this way? If so then there would be many people like me in special circumstances!”Dudian’s face turned green, if it was as he had speculated then the water in the empire was far deeper than he had imagined. The Seven Kings might not be the ultimate combat strength of the empire. After all, if it wasn’t because of the burden of the heart then his body would be able to burst out with the combat strength of a King!
This point had been verified by many experiments.
If each Aragami came from the body of an existence like him, how many Aragami were there in the Empire? Each giant wall had one. There were at least dozens of giant walls, or even hundreds of them!
This meant that there were hundreds of kings and these were all cultivated by the Empire!
However, why were the seven kings the rulers of the Empire on the surface?
Dudian felt that his thoughts were in chaos. If the other Aragami were dead, then why didn’t they resist? Moreover, his body transformation experiment was completed by Crimson Moon. Crimson Moon’s experimental knowledge came from her creator, ‘Bolo’, although part of it was combined with the technology from the old era’s super chip, but those technologies were just auxiliary functions. They couldn’t become the core technology and concept of her God creation experiment.
Boro was once the King of the Empire. It was impossible for her to want to transform herself into a container to nurture the Aragami!
What went wrong?
Dudian felt that his brain was in a mess. He wanted to flip over the operating table in front of him. He had a lot of troubles. Now there was such a thorny problem. How should he take out the heart? If he took it out, would the heart fail?
Dudian squatted on the ground. For a long time, he felt that the storm of thoughts in his head gradually stopped. He panted and drooled on the floor. He slowly stood up, dudian controlled his emotions and calmed himself down. He picked up the cut heart muscle to test. Anger and anxiety would not solve the problem. He could only explore step by step. The more he walked on the tightrope, the more he had to remain calm at all times.

chapters.title: Chapter 1091
chapters.content:
Chapter 1091 – Chapter 180: Demon
Half a day later, the gene chain in the heart was analyzed so that Dudian had a more intuitive understanding.
The main component of the heart was the Aragami factor. There was no part of his genes as a human, but there were many soul worm factors that he had absorbed as well as the cell residue of the polar ice worm.
In addition, there was a strange dormant cell in the heart. He speculated that it was part of the Aragami gene, but he didn’t know what kind of changes would happen to him after the dormant cell was revived.
Dudian used the deep electric wave to draw the situation of the Aragami’s body. He found that the larva had a heart the size of a green bean. Its beating rate was extremely slow, he occasionally heard the second heartbeat. It was the heart the size of a green bean. The power of the heartbeat was not inferior to his golden heart.
Dudian always had a feeling that this was a demon that lived in his heart. It could break out at any time!
Dudian asked Felix to send a large number of experimental subjects to carry out experiments according to the composition of the heart. After breaking out the structure of the heart, he had a new idea which was in urgent need of verification.
The hundreds of experimental subjects that were originally put into the breeding program of the demons were quickly used up. Dudian’s experiment finally had a breakthrough and new progress when it came to the ninetieth test subject, the results gave him a glimmer of hope!
“My guess may be correct!”
“The Aragami in the empire have been sealed for a long time. They were Aragami that fell from the war in the old era. In that era, humans didn’t have the technology to cultivate Aragami!”! Moreover, the Aragami in Sylvia were sealed in the freezing chamber. It proved that they came from a place with extraordinary technology. In addition to the polar ice worm king, most of the Aragami that were sealed in the giant wall of the empire came from an extraterrestrial planet just like the magic worm.”
However, the Aragami in my body was artificially bred
This might be a coincidence! Even Bolo and Crimson Moon did not know the results of such an experiment! Their theory was correct. They used the devouring and fusion ability of the Aragami factor as the core of the composition of the gods! However, they did not predict what would happen when the Aragami factor and the extremely tenacious polar ice bug were mixed together. From the results before their eyes, that would be ‘resurrection’
“The genes of the soul worms are similar. Both of them have tenacious vitality. The Aragami factor instinctively swallowed and merged with the Polar Ice Worm. It inherited the strong vitality of the polar ice worm and came back to life. That’s why it gave birth to a new life in my heart!”
“The Aragami reproduce asexually. There is no need to mate!”
“But now… There is finally close combat in the experiment. If I can complete it… I can create Aragami!”
This guess was completely different from his first thought. But Dudian felt that the possibility was higher. Moreover the experiment on the experimental body had given him a glimmer of hope. If he was given time and resources.., he felt that one day he would be able to create artificial Aragami!
This was a huge surprise for him!
The Aragami was born with the top combat power. In the old era he could pacify the invasion of the magic insects. If such a group of combat power was in his hands he would be able to overthrow the current rule and establish his own dynasty!
At that time he would not only have the strongest combat power but also the greatest freedom. He would be able to use all his resources and strength to find a way to resurrect the undeads!
The more Dudian thought about it, the more excited he became. The first half of the day he felt that death was approaching and his heart was in despair. But now he felt that the world had opened a brand new door for him. He saw Infinite Hope!
“It just so happens that I want to create a group. I can carry out my experiments in the federation…”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he thought in his heart.
He ended today’s experiment. The excitement brought by this new conjecture gradually subsided. His eyes returned to his own body. This was the biggest problem at the moment, it was impossible to remove the heart while keeping it. However, if he removed the heart, he would definitely die. This seemed to be a dead end.
However, now that his horizons were high, and he had been absorbing the technological knowledge of the federation through the computer these past few days, he was not in despair. The heart needed to be removed, but he could find a new heart to replace it after it was removed!
Heart replacement surgery wasn’t a secret in the Federation but a patent of the rich!
The technology of the Federation was advanced. This kind of surgery was involved in the authoritative hospitals of the old era. It was very perfect now.
However, Dudian knew that his physical condition was special. He couldn’t bear the pressure of his body when he transplanted the heart of an ordinary person into his own body. It was like giving a chain to a sports car to drive it, it could only suppress the heart of an abyss level warrior. But the federation didn’t have much experience in this kind of surgery.
After all, their rich people were ordinary people.
Dudian felt that he had to develop too many things. Fortunately, although the situation was bad but it wasn’t very critical. Moreover, the young Aragami were bred in the heart, he tried to control the rate of blood flow back to slow down the heartbeat and reduce the consumption of the heart. It should be fine if he didn’t go through a war for a short period of time.
“It’s time to leave.”Dudian looked around the laboratory. He printed out his experimental data and the computer’s log records. He removed the backup and closed the laboratory.
“When you see the Devil in Your Heart, you will be the devil…”Dudian pushed open Felix’s room. He saw that Felix was reading a masterpiece of a great writer. He casually sat on the sofa, he poured himself a cup of fruit juice to moisten his throat.
Felix saw Dudian and immediately put away the book. His face wasn’t as nervous as before. Now the two of them were working together. He knew that Dudian wouldn’t hurt him so he relaxed a lot, he felt that he had found the freedom that he hadn’t seen for a long time.
“Is the identity ready?”Dudian asked.
Felix was surprised: “So Soon?”
“Do you want me to stay a bit longer?”
Felix smiled: “Of course.”
Dudian rolled his eyes. He was too lazy to tease him: “As soon as possible. I’m going to see the demon tonight. I want to talk to him.”
Felix thought for a moment: “Alright.”
Dudian sat in front of the computer after dinner. He checked the information of the consortia and the major groups of the Federation. He drank tea after dinner. He left the room at nine o’clock.

chapters.title: Chapter 1092
chapters.content:
Chapter 1092 – Chapter 1881: Leave
Dudian came to the viewing platform. He saw Lucian lying lazily in the cage. He smiled: “I heard that you are a subordinate of the King of light. Why are you captured here?”
His voice was transmitted to the cage through the PA system.
Lucian lazily said: “It’s none of your business.”
“I’m also from the Empire. I want to understand the situation with you.”Dudian’s tone was still calm.
Lucien sneered: “I don’t care what you do. Don’t Disturb my sleep.”
Dudian thought for a moment and said: “I got it.”
He turned around and left. He asked Felix to take him to the mech warehouse. He saw that the nine-tailed Fox operated by Qiu Ling had been repaired. He immediately boarded the mech, through the special code provided by Felix, the original login identity was canceled. Then he entered his fingerprint and Iris. He logged into the Mech’s smart library and opened the connection.
“Boring tricks.”Lucian lay in the cage. He rolled his eyes when he saw that Dudian had really left. These foreign races had used all kinds of methods to interrogate him, beauty, alcohol indoctrination, torture, intimidation and so on. He felt that it was a bit ridiculous. Although these methods were good but they were too weak.
This time they actually sent people to pretend to be their own kind. It seemed that they were at their wit’s end.
Crack!
At this time, the passage opened.
Lucian slightly opened his eyes. He was a bit surprised. Could it be that he was going to activate the magic battle mecha again? Why wasn’t he informed in advance?
At this time, a nine-tailed fox crawled in from the tunnel. The metal on its tail flickered with a cold air. A trace of solemnity flashed in Lucien’s eyes. He had fought with this nine-tailed Fox mecha before, and its strength was not inferior to his. was the opponent planning to use force?
Humph! Lucien sneered in his heart. All these years, he had been locked up here. Although his physique had not improved, his combat skills had been honed to the minimum during the battle. He was confident that he was much better than other upper level abysses of the same level. Even this nine-tailed fox mecha.., might not be able to suppress him steadily. Moreover, he already knew the weaknesses of these mecha. They were all in the core cockpit. As long as he killed the people in the cockpit, he would be able to stop this thing.
“It’s been a long time since I sent someone here to die. I’m tired of living again today!”Lucien grinned hideously and stood up from the ground. His whole body was demonized, like a lion burning with flames. His amber-like eyes narrowed, with sharp murderous intent, he suddenly pounced on the nine-tailed Fox Mech. He was the first to strike!
The nine-tailed Fox Mech suddenly rose into the air like a white shadow. When Lucien looked up, he saw the sharp claws of the nine-tailed fox clawing at the metal wall of the cage and running quickly on the wall, the flashing nine tails were a bit dazzling.
Lucien was shocked. This time, the nine-tailed Fox seemed to be more agile than before. He took a deep breath, and the flames on his body were much stronger. He carefully watched the gaps between the nine-tailed fox’s running and suddenly pounced on it.
Whoosh!
The nine-tailed Fox flipped in the air and landed on another ground.
Lucien’s pounce failed. He landed and sneered, “What? Your master sent you here to run laps?”
At this moment, the nine-tailed Fox rushed over.
Lucien was a bit surprised. He did not expect his opponent to be so unprovoked. Then, he was very happy. He was like an angry lion, slapping the ground and biting at the neck of the nine-tailed fox.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Suddenly, a few white shadows flashed in Lucien’s sight. In the next moment, a violent force came from his chest, which he could not resist.
Lucien felt that the silver wall in his sight was moving forward at a high speed. His body was moving backward at a high speed. With a bang, his back hit the wall, causing pain in his spine. Before he could fall down, a few white shadows flashed, after hitting his chest one after another, all the bones in his body were shattered. The pain almost made him faint, and he coughed out a large mouthful of blood.
Lucien looked up and saw a spiral-shaped fox tail. Because of the spiral shape, the tip of the tail was extremely sharp, like a sharp awl, floating in front of his forehead.
A dense killing intent came from the nine-tailed Fox’s eyes. Lucien felt his heart tighten, and his whole body was covered in cold sweat. He did not even dare to breathe.
The next moment, the nine-tailed Fox put away its sharp tail and quietly lay on the ground. At this time, a calm voice came from its chest, “Do you have time to talk to Me Now?”
Lucien’s pupils shrank and his eyes widened. The voice was from the previous person! He took a deep breath. He knew that the other party had already shown mercy by manipulating the nine-tailed fox. However, he also knew that the other party did not dare to kill him, he sneered: “So it has been so long since you came to find me. You have secretly cultivated a big killing machine. Humph, you can forget about getting anything out of my mouth. I have already said everything I need to say.”
The nine-tailed Fox’s chest was split open. There was a flesh wall inside the cockpit. Several blood vessels were holding the pilot’s chair. Dudian sat on the chair and quietly looked at Lucian: “Do you want to live?”
Lucian looked at dudian. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes: “Are you really from the Empire?”
Dudian didn’t speak. His whole body was covered with sharp black blades. There were spikes on his head. His hair was covered like a monster. His pupils were slightly red, he felt the heat in the air: “I can rescue you or let you die here. It depends on whether you are willing to listen to me or not.”
Lucian’s pupils shrank as he felt the familiar feeling in Dudian’s body: “Are you the Lord of the Abyss? No, you are the Lord of the Abyss? !”
“You can think of it that way.”Dudian indifferently replied.
“These alien races can’t breed the Abyss. They don’t know how to breed the abyss. Your magic body is so thorough. Even if you aren’t the Lord of the Abyss, you are a superior abyss just like me!”Lucian’s eyes were full of doubt, “You are from the Empire but why do you know how to operate a mech? Why are you here? Where are they?”
At this time, he found that there were no guards coming over.
“This is my territory now. I have read your records. You were arrested nine years ago. The criminal’s rank is 3s and the strength of the Upper Abyss.”Dudian indifferently said: “I want to know the reason why you were captured. As a subordinate of the King of Light, why did you come to the god of war to participate in the Border War? What was the critical battle nine years ago?”? In addition, tell me about the king of Light.”
Lucien was more sure that Dudian was from the Empire because the other races would only call him “The wall of magic”! He changed his expression and smiled: “It’s a misunderstanding. Since we are all on the same side, let’s leave this place first!”
He was about to get up and approach Dudian when suddenly a murderous intent enveloped his body. He saw Dudian’s cold eyes looking at him as if he was looking at a dead body.
“We are all people of the empire. We are not necessarily on the same side. I want to know if you are a spy of the empire, a traitor, or an innocent person.”Dudian coldly said.
Lucian’s face slightly changed. He looked at dudian: “You seem to have a grudge with the king of light. I Won’t tell you anything about the light. Even if you kill me it will be the same!”
“Then go to hell!”Dudian said as he pulled back into the mech. The nine-tailed Fox was ready to move.
Lucian’s face suddenly changed, he quickly shouted: “Misunderstanding, misunderstanding. I was just joking. To tell you the truth, I was sent by the King of light to reinforce the god of war wall. But I have a secret mission which is to take the opportunity to sneak into the alien race. I didn’t expect that my mission was exposed. I was caught in the process of sneaking in and then sent here…”
“How can I believe you?”Dudian coldly asked.
Lucian wryly smiled: “It’s true. There are gaps between the border guards. I suspect that there are gaps between them in the empire. Moreover their status is very high. It is possible that they are a King!”
Dudian’s face slightly changed as he frowned.
“Are you trying to sow discord between the kings? I want to know about the matter of the king and the Empire.”Dudian shouted.
Lucian wryly smiled as he told Dudian about the story of the King of light. Dudian asked about the situation of the empire and he answered in full detail, it seemed that Dudian didn’t understand about the empire.
His heart became more and more scared. Was this a real alien race? ! If that was the case, didn’t it mean that the alien race had the means to cultivate the combat power of the abyss level? ! This was not good news for the Empire!
He secretly complained in his heart. Unfortunately, he couldn’t pass the news back. He didn’t lie to Dudian. He was a spy sent by the King of light to infiltrate the empire, moreover, he deliberately leaked his mission to the other King’s men. He was exposed and arrested. He had been waiting for the opportunity to leave so that he could pass the news to the King of light.
A moment later, Dudian drove the nine-tailed fox and left the place.
He wanted to take this opportunity to understand the situation of the King of Light and the Empire. The result was that he knew more than he had expected. This was actually an imperial spy. Moreover, the situation in the empire seemed to be more complicated! The spies of the Federation had infiltrated the upper echelons of the empire. Did this mean that the empire had infiltrated the upper echelons of the federation? !
“The technology of the imperial city is not inferior to that of the federation. They have deliberately suppressed the technology and prohibited private research. All the power is in the hands of the Seven Kings. The seven kings are puppets of the magic insects. It seems that the magic insects have deliberately suppressed the technology. What is the reason?”Dudian sent the nine-tailed Fox back to the warehouse, he was thinking as he walked. suddenly his heart trembled: “Since the Seven Kings are controlled by the magic insects, why are their forces fighting with each other? Don’t tell me that the magic insects are not United?”
He thought of the results of his previous experiments. His heart was even more confused.
Dudian suppressed the chaotic thoughts in his heart and said to Felix: “I plan to take Lucien out.”
Felix was surprised: “Why? If we let him out, what if he wreaks havoc…”
“I want him to wreak havoc outside. I want to see the strength of the federal guards.”Dudian said.
Felix was startled. He hesitated for a moment, he said: “The strength of the federal guards is stronger than you think. If he is caught then it will be easy to find out that we are the ones who escaped. It will be hard for me to absolve the responsibility. It is very likely that I will be fired. At that time no one will be able to help you!”
Dudian said: “I have thought about it. I will modify the identity data that he has entered into the computer. The higher-ups will thoroughly investigate all the factories in Hosk. I will find a singer to cover for him. I will be able to hide it for the time being.”
Felix bitterly smiled: “Since you have thought about the thorough investigation then it means that you have thought about it. But it is a small matter for the higher-ups to thoroughly investigate our factory. I can hide it. It is not difficult to modify his identity data. But what if he is captured alive? What will you do?”
“Don’t worry. A madman won’t talk.”Dudian said.
Felix was startled. He felt cold all over his body.
“In addition, give me a detailed map of the city where your two dear brothers and sisters are located. The location of their factory is not a simple map. I want to know the distribution of the forces inside.”Dudian said.
Felix’s eyes lit up: “Are you going to deal with them?”
Dudian smiled at him.
Felix nodded: “I will give it to you in a moment. But don’t make too much noise. In addition, it is best not to deal with the two of them at the same time. Otherwise father will suspect me.”
“Don’t worry. You just need to cooperate with me.”Dudian patted his shoulder. He thought that he wouldn’t be able to deal with them at the same time. Otherwise, how would he listen to me?
Two days later Dudian officially left the factory.
In the past two days he and Felix had finished dealing with the matters in the factory. They had covered up the news of his escape. The records of his capture had also been cleaned up. Felix had even sent people to the border of the city, they had erased the records of their comings and goings.
In the Copper Ship City, Felix could cover up the sky. It wasn’t difficult to hide a person.
Dudian took Lucian out of the factory in the wilderness. They went along the road covered with maple leaves to the city center. Lucian sat in the co-pilot’s seat. He was very honest. From time to time he would touch a black collar on his neck, he bitterly smiled: “Even if I don’t have this, I won’t be ostentatious. This is the federation. How can I cause trouble?”
Dudian put the black collar on him. Moreover he told him that it was a monitoring device. Once he caused trouble, he would activate the collar. At that time his location would be exposed. Exposing his location in the hinterland of the federation was no different from sending himself to his death.
After trying, Lucien found that the material of the collar was the same as the cage that imprisoned him. It was something that he could not destroy. It was also a tool made by the federation to enslave the real devils.
A moment later, the car came to the poor town at the edge of the city.
Lucien looked at the residents of the town with a strange expression: “Aren’t these people people?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1093
chapters.content:
Chapter 1093 – Chapter 182: Qin Mo.
“What do you think?”Dudian casually asked.
Lucian wryly smiled: “I thought that there were only a few human traitors in the alien races. I didn’t expect that there would be so many people in a small town. Don’t tell me that this place is completely made up of human forces?”
“Don’t tell me that you, as a spy, don’t know about this information?”Dudian was surprised.
Lucian was unhappy with his question, “If I knew, why would I be a spy? I only know that there are a few human traitors among the alien races. I didn’t expect that they are all made up of humans. What is the meaning of our war?”
“Isn’t it the meaning of our war to rule the same race and monopolize the resources?”Dudian said: “Didn’t your parents teach you to work hard to be ‘superior’?”
Lucian frowned: “The monsters are lurking outside and we are still fighting among ourselves. When Will We Get Real Peace?”
Dudian looked at him in surprise. He didn’t expect that this rough looking man had such ideals and beliefs. As a spy, he had something that he would defend to the death, dudian patted his shoulder. He thought that he would be sending him off. He couldn’t help but feel a bit regretful. However, the plan wouldn’t change.
The car left the poor town and came to several small towns. Suddenly, Dudian saw a face on the side of the road. He stopped the car and rolled down the window: “Su Ming’s sister?”
Su Mingzhu was shocked. She turned to look at Dudian but found that she didn’t know him. However the car he was in was a symbol of identity. She was nervous and excited: “Do you know my brother?”
Dudian nodded: “Your brother has been accepted by HAWSK company. If someone wants to ask you for debt, tell them to go to HAWSK company to look for your brother.”
Su Mingzhu’s eyes widened: “My brother has been accepted by HAWSK company? Really, really?”
Dudian once again understood the influence of HAWSK company from his performance, dudian nodded: “Go to Hawsk Company and tell them to look for your brother. They will settle you down and you don’t have to live in such a shabby place anymore.”He glanced around, the town was similar to the previous few poor towns. The environment was harsh. The streets were littered with garbage. There were dirty underpants in the gutter. It was probably the work of a thief.
The air pollution was serious and the water resources were not pure enough. It was no wonder that Su Mingzhu had lung cancer at such a young age.
Su Mingzhu’s eyes opened wide. She felt like she was in a dream.
“Do you have a communication device?”Dudian asked.
Su mingzhu quickly replied: “Yes, I do.”
“Remember this communication signal.”Dudian gave her Felix’s communication signal. He waited for her to input it: “Contact him if there is anything. Tell him that Qin Mo introduced it.”
Su Mingzhu was startled. She bowed and thanked dudian. Her eyes were moist. She didn’t doubt Dudian’s words. After all, she was poor and had no money. Her brother was a military man, a normal human trafficker wouldn’t be able to abduct her. Moreover, she recognized the logo of the car. It was a high-level mechanical car made by HAWSK. The other party had given her the communication signal, obviously she had considered that if she went to HAWSK company without any proof, she would be kicked out. If it was another big shot, he wouldn’t be so careful.
“Are you good friends with my brother?”Su Mingzhu carefully asked after she finished thanking him.
“I guess so.”Dudian thought, “I killed your brother. Can I be considered a ‘good friend’?”?
Su Mingzhu wanted to say more but Dudian had already rolled down the window. The car hummed and the mechanical engine roared. It sped up and left the street.
“Brother…”Su Mingzhu looked at the tail of the car which had disappeared. Her eyes were full of hope. She felt that the world had changed from gray to color. She was full of hope. She fantasized about meeting her brother again, she had to personally cook his favorite dumplings.
“You seem to have been here for a long time.”Lucien said with interest.
Dudian nodded, “I pretended to be a pilot and sneaked in. This girl is his sister. Speaking of which, this person is quite bitter. Her parents are divorced, and her mother ran away with a rich man. Her father left all the debts to her children. Her brother was killed by me. If the debtor knew that her brother was dead, he would definitely force her to death. Maybe she would use her body to pay off the debts.”
Lucian was a bit surprised. He didn’t expect that Dudian would tell him such details. He didn’t think too much about it, he nodded: “In this case, this girl is very likely. Moreover, she is actually grateful to the murderer of her brother. It is really ironic!”
“With the help of HAWSK company, her future life is at least beautiful. Even if she knows that her brother is dead, the pain will eventually fade away. She will find her lover and continue to live her life.”Dudian casually said.
“In that case, you are quite caring.”Lucien laughed.
Dudian laughed: “I have always been very caring. It’s just that the target is picky.”
“That’s right. If you have love for everyone and treat everyone equally, then what’s the difference between you and an animal? At least you should treat your parents and your lover better than others, right?”Lucien laughed.
Dudian casually said: “You have a lover?”
“Do you think I’m Ugly?”
“No, I’m just worried that the world won’t understand your beauty.”
“Haha, I Like What You Said.”
The two chatted as they drove towards the city center. Their relationship seemed to be that of old friends.
When they arrived at the city center, Dudian parked the car in a square and took Lucien to the nearby high-speed maglev train.
The train came very fast. Dudian used Felix’s federal identity to buy the ticket. His new identity was called Qin Mo. . He was a well-known biology student. He was going to graduate in a year. His parents were divorced and he was an only child, felix couldn’t find a perfect match because of the time constraints.
As for the real owner of the identity, he might not be alive at the moment.
Although there was still a year left until graduation but Qin Mo had already reached the stage of free breeding. He didn’t need to go to school every day to report. Those in the same grade as him had already entered the company to practice or started their own small business.
Dudian used the temporary identity card to buy tickets for Lucien. This was the temporary identity that Felix had spent a lot of money to get. It only existed in the federal identity database for twenty-four hours.

chapters.title: Chapter 1094
chapters.content:
Chapter 1094 – Chapter 183: Conflict
“Mobei City?”Lucian was surprised to see where he was going, “Where is this? If I remember correctly, we are in the nearest city to the border. Why don’t we leave from here?”
“This city is called copper ship city. It is one of the border cities. We are going to Mobei city which is the hinterland of the Federation.”Dudian said: “If we leave from the border then we will be able to reach the god of war wall very quickly. But how terrifying is the defense force of the border? It is impossible for us to leave with only a temporary identity. We can only go to the black market to buy a legal identity.”
Lucien was slightly startled. He looked at Dudian with a bit of doubt in his eyes. But he wasn’t sure. His first instinct was to suspect that Dudian had defected to these people, he deliberately lured him to their core city. But Dudian openly said that they were going to the hinterland of the federation. He couldn’t figure out what Dudian was thinking.
“He can easily subdue me by relying on the mechs in the factory. He shouldn’t be taking me to the hinterland of the federation to deal with me. Maybe it is true…”Lucian thought.
The maglev train passed through the tall buildings of copper ship city. Endless Wilderness appeared from the glass windows of the train. The scenery of the wilderness was endless, many people on the train were surprised. Some of them were excited as they looked at the wilderness. They were filled with yearning and curiosity towards the outside world.
Dudian saw that the maglev train was moving along the transparent pipeline to the endless wilderness. The pipeline was built on the high wall of copper ship city. There were hundreds of meters of ground under the train. No one would be spared if the train crashed.
“The train route is not buried underground but built at high altitude. Could it be that the danger underground is greater than the high altitude? It is difficult to guard against monsters that drill into the ground. It is easy to detect the bird monsters at high altitude…”Dudian thought.
He sent the question to Felix through the communication device. Soon, Felix answered him. It turned out that the god of Science and Technology of the Federation had created a kind of ultrasonic resonator, it would release ear-piercing sound waves that were unbearable for monsters. However, the effect of this thing in the underground was not obvious. So the train would pass through the high altitude. Even if there were flying monsters.., it would be able to use the resonator on the train to scare them away.
The train arrived at the next city after two hours.
In the middle of the journey, some people saw monsters appear in the wilderness. But their vision was separated by hundreds of meters so they couldn’t see clearly. This made them excited and excited.
After about twelve hours, the train finally arrived at Mobei City. The outskirts of the city was a desert so it got its name. There were few green plants and most of the soil was sand. Dudian saw the desert sand, there were many small monsters living in the desert. He also saw a team of mecha operators hunting monsters outside the desert. This scene was naturally seen by other passengers. Some seemed to be used to it but some were so excited that they leaned against the window.
“Let’s go.”Dudian took Lucien off the train and followed the flow of people to the city.
He hired a car on the side of the road and ordered: “Go to Asima Company.”
The middle-aged bald driver started the car and asked in surprise: “You are employees of Asima Company? Amazing! The treatment of Asima company is very high, right?”
Dudian casually replied: “Not bad.”
Lucien who was sitting next to Dudian seemed to be interested: “What do you think of Asima Company?”
Dudian looked at him but didn’t stop him.
The middle-aged bald driver’s tone didn’t conceal his envy, “It goes without saying that Asima company is the most famous company in Mobei City. They rely on the support of large consortium terras. After joining Asima Company, their status is directly upgraded to first-class citizenship. The treatment they enjoy is not too good. Just the tax exemption alone is enough to make people envious. Third-class citizens like us can earn half and pay half. Ah!”
Lucian smiled: “Do you know what the company does?”
The middle-aged bald driver was surprised: “Aren’t you from the company?”
“We are going to apply for the job.”Lucian didn’t wait for Dudian to speak.
Dudian frowned and said to the driver: “Don’t be distracted. We don’t have much time. Don’t delay our interview time.”
The middle-aged bald driver saw that Dudian’s face was cold and hard to talk to. He didn’t say anything but sneered in his heart. He didn’t think that he would be able to get the job!
The car was silent on the street. When it came to the front of a building that was under construction, there was a sudden bang. The door was knocked open and Lucien who was sitting next to Dudian suddenly jumped out.
Dudian’s eyes narrowed. In front of the middle-aged driver’s horrified eyes, he casually patted his seat and head on the front of the car. His brain burst and then he flashed out of the car. The moment he left, he controlled the heat, he detonated the car.
The car suddenly exploded. The other cars and passers-by were all scared. They covered their heads and squatted on the ground. Some rushed to other places as fast as lightning and instinctively fled.
Dudian looked at the direction of Lucian. He took out a remote control and gently pressed it.
Bang!
Lucian felt that his neck suddenly exploded. The intense pain made him scream. But the next moment, he felt that his neck loosened. The strong metal locator actually exploded and fell off.
He was a bit puzzled but his heart was relieved. He quickly ran towards a small path.
Although he didn’t know what Dudian’s purpose was, but through the middle-aged driver’s description, he knew that Dudian absolutely didn’t take him to the black market. Dudian lied to him, so he must have other intentions. He could only rely on himself.
In fact, he never really believed in Dudian. Previously, Dudian had told him everything, so he felt a bit strange!
As a spy, his vigilance had always been high. At this moment, he was running away with great risk. However, he was prepared for the worst. At worst, he would be captured and interrogated again. At that time, he would also confess to Dudian!
