The sudden change in the street scared the surrounding passers-by. But soon, the hidden alarms in the vicinity sounded. At the same time, the situation here was sent to the Defense Department of Mobei City.
In the chaos of the crowd, Dudian quietly came to the place where Lucien left. He picked up the black metal ring on the ground, turned around and left. Like the other panicked people, he scattered in all directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1095
chapters.content:
Chapter 1095 – Chapter 1,84Th: Silence
“Without a GPS device, I can hide in the crowd. They might not be able to find me, but I have to avoid the hidden surveillance here first…”while Lucien was escaping, his mind was working fast. Suddenly, he glanced around, he saw a large shopping mall in front of him, which was crowded with people. His eyes lit up. He was really sleepy, so he immediately rushed over.
An alarm suddenly sounded outside the shopping mall. Although the mall’s guards did not react, the intelligent system detected Lucien’s unusual identity and issued an alarm.
The alarm spread throughout the entire shopping mall. For a moment, all the people who were shopping in the shopping mall were stunned. They looked at each other in confusion. Most of them were locals of Mobei city and had never left this place in their lives, the distant border war was like a different world to them. Their lives consisted of coffee, celebrities, entertainment, work… In the federation, there was strict order and the crime rate was extremely low. There were basically no petty criminals, there were also no robberies. After all, there were surveillance cameras everywhere. Among them, it was the first time anyone under the age of 20 had heard the alarm in their lives.
After a short period of silence, the crowd suddenly became noisy. They frantically looked for the exit and were ready to leave the mall. Although they did not know what was going on, the sirens meant danger and disaster. It was instinctive to stay away.
When everyone rushed to the exit, the exit appeared crowded, which gave Lucien an opportunity to take advantage of. He aimed at an exit that was crowded with people and rushed over. His figure was as fast as a gray lightning. When he entered the crowd.., he quickly twisted the muscles of his face with his hands and pinched the muscles and fat into another face. Then, he cut off his hair with his fingernails and cut off a buzz. As for the hair that he cut off, he burned it to avoid leaving any clues.
After doing all this, he took off his coat and pretended to be in a panic. He rushed to a luxury store next to it. Under the panicked and confused eyes of the staff, he quickly took a set of clothes and went to the changing room.
A moment later, a man with an ordinary face and a brand name walked out. Although the shop assistant was alarmed by the alarm, it was not good for her to run away when she saw a customer coming to her door, she braced herself and said, “Hello, Sir. The price of this wolf suit is…”
Lucien did not wait for her to finish and ran out of the shop quickly. He was only slightly faster than the ordinary people around him.
The shop assistant was stunned for a moment, then she cursed loudly. She did not expect that Lucien would take advantage of the situation. She immediately chased after him, but her high heels were not convenient for running. Soon, she was blocked by the chaotic crowd, lucien lost his sight.
Not to mention that the shop assistant called the police in anger, Lucien followed the crowd to the exit. He looked panicked, but his eyes were cold. Looking at the nervous faces of the people around him, he sneered in his heart, at this time, he heard the girls talking excitedly about the alarm. He guessed that there was a fire in the mall or something.
He was a bit irritated by the noise. He felt that the noise was harsh and unpleasant. He was so angry that he wanted to strangle the girls to death, but his reason told him to hold it in.
However, the girls did not stop talking. He could not hold it in anymore and shouted angrily, “Shut up!”
The girls did not expect him to be angry. They were shocked and then a bit angry. One of the long-haired girls looked at him coldly and said, “What do you care if we talk?”Her tone was like a boy’s.., she did not look like a lady at all.
Lucien was furious. He wanted to strangle her to death, but his reason made him try his best to hold it in. The veins on his forehead bulged, and his face was horrifying.
The girls were scared by Lucien’s look, but the long-haired girl was not scared at all. She comforted her friends and said, “Don’t be afraid. If he dares to touch me, I’m sure he’ll be in big trouble.”
The other girls suddenly remembered her father’s identity, and they were not scared at all. At the same time, they found that although Lucien’s face was terrible, he was so angry that he was trembling, but he did not dare to make a move. He looked a bit timid, and they looked down on him even more, one of the girls said, “Judging from his ordinary clothes, he should be an ordinary elite. Humph, if he dares to speak rudely again, go to his company and complain about him, and make him lose his job!”
Lucien’s eyes were cold. He clenched his fists so hard that they were cracking. Then, he suddenly roared, “Shut up! Do you believe that I will kill you all? !”
Other than the girls, the others were also shocked by his sudden roar. One of them, a strong young man who often worked out, took a step forward and pushed Lucien’s chest, “Uncle, why are you shouting at these girls? What kind of ability do you have to bully women?”
Lucien’s brain exploded with a loud bang as if an oil tank had been set on fire. His eyes were red, and there was a strong smell of blood in the air. The strong killing intent made him want to go crazy and drown his reason, he did not even have time to think about why he was so angry all of a sudden, but the last trace of his reason was firmly restraining his fist. The violent anger made his body tremble slightly.
“How can this person be like this? He’s so rude.”
“He’s yelling. He’s so rude.”
“He’s already dozens of years old, and he’s still bullying a little girl.”
The others around them were pointing and discussing.
If it was Lucien in the past, he would not care about the comments around him at all. After all, he was a trained spy. He still had some patience. Moreover, he was on the road of escape, so he could tolerate even the scolding of thousands of people, however, at this moment, he felt that these comments were buzzing in his mind, and it made him have the urge to destroy everything and make the world quiet down.
His breathing became heavier and heavier, and the killing intent in his mind became more and more violent.
“Get lost!”The voice was almost squeezed out through the gaps of his teeth.
The strong young man shouted, “Who are you asking to get lost? Are you crazy?”After saying that, he pushed him again.
“Get lost!”Lucien suddenly burst out and raised his head abruptly. The bloodlust in his eyes was like two balls of fishy smell, as if he had escaped from an abyss.
When the burly young man saw Lucien’s eyes, he suddenly felt a chill all over his body, as if he was being pricked by Needles. He could not help but feel a sense of fear in his heart, as if he was facing an evil beast. In the next moment.., he felt a buzzing sound in his head.
Bang!
Lucien’s fist smashed the young man’s head into pieces!
Brain matter and blood splattered all over the ground!
Many of the brain matter splattered on the faces of the little girls who were protecting the young man. The little girls’slightly provocative expressions instantly froze, and in the next moment, they let out ear-piercing shrieks!
The people who were pointing and talking around were all shocked. They looked at this scene in horror, and their mouths were open, and they even forgot to breathe.
The scene was too shocking. A punch to the head was not something a human could do!
“Go to hell! !”Lucien roared. He took the lead and rushed to the girls. He grabbed the head of the long-haired girl and pulled her to him.
The long-haired girl’s hair was in pain. She screamed, “Bastard, let go! Let Go of me! Do you know who my father is? My father is…”
Bang!
The sound suddenly came, and her head and face exploded instantly. She was smashed into pieces like a ripe watermelon.
Lucien was like a wolf in a flock of sheep. He strode out, grabbed the remaining little girls, and smashed their heads into pieces one by one!
When the others saw this horrible scene, they screamed and fled in all directions.
“Keep shouting! Keep shouting!”Lucien’s face was covered in brain matter, looking at the fleeing crowd, Lucien grinned and ran after them. He picked up their clothes and punched them. Some of them were pierced through the chest, and some of them had their necks broken, in Lucien’s hands, these people were as fragile as paper.
In the blink of an eye, all the people around him were killed. Blood flowed all over the ground. It was like hell on Earth.
“Finally, it’s quiet…”Lucian closed his eyes as if he was intoxicated. He breathed a sigh of relief and felt comfortable all over.
At this moment, there was a rumbling sound. Suddenly, a beam of light shot over.
Lucian sensed danger a second in advance. He flashed in an instant and avoided the laser beam. Seeing the burn marks left on the ground, his face darkened. He knew that the mecha had come, but he had no intention of escaping. He raised his eyes and looked around, soon, he found the position of the mech and grinned, “You too, be quiet!”
After saying that, he rushed out quickly.
While running, his body transformed rapidly and entered the demonic body. Like a burning lion, he rushed out of the shopping mall. At this time, he saw that there were seven or eight mechs surrounding the square outside the shopping mall.
“Kill! Kill!”
The appearance of these mechs reminded him of the painful experience when he was imprisoned by Felix. The killing intent in his heart increased and he rushed towards the nearest mech.
During the battle between Lucian and the mechs, the other people around the shopping mall had already been protected by the guards and robots. However, there were still many citizens hiding in the tall buildings to watch. At the same time, they used their comlink to record the scene.
Dudian was also standing on a tall building to watch. When he saw Lucien rushing towards the mech, he was relieved. The corner of his mouth curved up. It seemed that the effect of the drug had taken effect. The time was almost the same as what he had calculated.
In fact, the black ring on Lucien’s neck was not a GPS device. It was a kind of bacteria that he had made. It could make people anxious and crazy, just like what he had told Felix before, he wanted to release a madman, not a “Person”.
When the black ring exploded, it cut Lucien’s skin and infected him with the bacteria. No matter how he hid it, when the drug took effect, he would go crazy and expose himself.
“So many mechas can be transferred so quickly. Is this the City Defense Force?”Dudian looked at the mechas gathered in the square. He recognized the models of these mechas. Most of them were mechas produced by Locke non-consortium, however there was only one four-star Mech and the rest were three-star mechas. It was difficult to kill Lucian in a short time.
Soon, Lucian killed one of the mechas. He was also injured. He rushed into the crowd.
Dudian was able to see Lucian clearly through the magic eye. Lucian’s face was ferocious and he was in a crazy state. However his battle instinct seemed to be there. He didn’t want to fight head on, he was planning to use the geographical advantage to destroy the mechs one by one.
“No wonder the empire has cultivated the abyss. The battle has long been in the bone marrow. Even if it is crazy, they will choose the best way to fight.”Dudian sighed in his heart.
Lucian’s speed was so fast that he quickly rushed into the crowd of onlookers. The onlookers were like pieces of paper. They were crushed in front of him or thrown away. For a moment the crowd scattered and fled in all directions, some of them ran in the direction of the chasing mechs, hoping that they could protect themselves. However, this had a great impact on these mecha guards, so they did not dare to chase after Lucien with all their strength, lest they step on these citizens to death.
Lucien ran forward, destroying many buildings along the way. Many passers-by were also killed by him, causing more and more damage.
The Mech couldn’t be used in the crowded city and was soon left behind.
Dudian didn’t chase after him but used his thermal vision to track Lucien. Although he couldn’t see Lucien, the heat he released was like the scorching sun. As long as he was in Mobei City, he could see the heat at a glance.
“An abyss can rampage here…”Dudian thought. Suddenly, he found that the heat in Lucien’s eyes was rapidly decreasing as if his life was dying. He was shocked, he stared at his heat source and found that the heat was fading away. After ten minutes, he was completely like an ordinary person.
“What is it that gave him such a serious injury? It is impossible for him to hide the heat source. Moreover, he didn’t move…”Dudian’s face was full of doubt, he thought for a moment but didn’t rush over to watch. He was ready to wait for Tomorrow Night’s news in Mobei City.
No matter what happened to Lucien, the news would be released to give the citizens an explanation.
At night.
Dudian connected to the network through the communicator. He immediately saw the latest headlines in the city. There was a disaster scene in the mall. There was even a small exit where a large number of corpses were scattered.
Dudian saw that the corpses were killed in one shot. He knew that it was Lucien’s masterpiece.
What surprised him was that the video was not edited. Such a bloody scene was made public.
At this time, the news anchor also talked about the demons. Dudian immediately understood that this was to train the federation people to be hostile.
No wonder the federation magic marks warriors such as Felix and Luke were so afraid of the real demon race. Most of them were influenced by the news and thought that they were extremely evil.
At the end of the video, Dudian saw the picture of Lucian being defeated. A beam of light fell from the sky above Mobei City. It was as fast as a meteorite and blasted Lucian into the ground.
“Is this a missile? No, it’s a beam-like thing. But it’s not a laser. Otherwise, the size of the image would turn Lucian into ashes instead of heat source slowly disappearing.”Dudian frowned, he didn’t expect that the federation’s hidden technology was more terrifying than he had imagined. They had such powerful city defense weapons. They could easily defeat a superior abyss. Even if the empire attacked them, they wouldn’t be able to face these city defense weapons, they could only surrender. Unless they had the corresponding high-tech weapons, or a king was dispatched to destroy the city defense weapons before sending troops to attack.
Otherwise, they could only use them as cannon fodder.

chapters.title: Chapter 1096
chapters.content:
Chapter 1096 – : Chapter 185Th: Above
While Dudian was watching the news, a few helicopters and more than ten chariots came to the square outside another landmark building in the North Desert. They were full of special training of the Ace Combat Police. Although they weren’t magic marks warriors.., but the special potion made by the Federation had strengthened his physique. But the enhancement was far from magic marks. It was only two to three times stronger than the strength of ordinary people.
Don’t underestimate these two to three times. In real life, when interacting with ordinary people, it was enough for him to act like a Superman.
After the wardens got off the vehicles, they quickly surrounded the square and kept a close watch on the surroundings. The sound of the demon’s attack during the day had tightened the defense forces of the entire Mobei City. Although Lucien was killed.., but why did this demon appear? Did he have any accomplices? What was the purpose of his sudden exposure? These were all questions, which made the higher-ups of Mobei city uneasy.
“General Yao!”In front of a helicopter landing, Li Li, the minister of Mobei City’s Defense Department, slightly narrowed his eyes and saluted the burly middle-aged man who got off the helicopter, then, he went forward and shook hands, “I didn’t expect that the chairman would send you here. Now, the demons will suffer.”
Yao Jie smiled and said, “It’s nothing. Minister Li is too polite. The chairman has already contacted the mayor. He sent me here to assist you in finding the demon race’s accomplices. This demon race has already been killed. I heard that according to the results of the forensic autopsy, the strength of this demon race is comparable to a four-star mecha. It has reached the upper abyss level of their demon race. This is considered a big shot among the demon race. They actually took the risk to enter deep into the hinterland and appear in our stomachs.”
“General Yao, this way please. It’s windy outside, let’s talk inside.”Li Li smiled as he led the way.
Accompanied by a group of secretaries and security guards, the two of them arrived at this landmark building in Mobei City. The security level of this building had reached the highest level in the federation. It was said that even a missile strike would not be able to harm the people inside the building, the glass outside the building was made of a colloidal alloy glass. It was incomparably tough and could even be compared to the hardness of a diamond. This type of glass was used in many high-end mechanical combat vehicles and tanks, this was also a synthetic glass invented by the federation. With this invention, the inventor obtained a lifetime achievement award and was recorded in the textbook.
After arriving at the building, Li Li invited Yao Jie to the meeting room. After that, he instructed his secretary to serve tea and prepare the information.
“General Yao, you’ve come a long way. It’s been hard on you. If there’s anything you need, feel free to mention it to me. We’re all family, so there’s no need to be polite,”Li Li said with a laugh.
Seeing his secretary taking so long to prepare the documents, Yao Jie frowned slightly, he said, “Minister Li, let’s not talk about other things for now. This time, the sudden appearance of the demon race in Mobei city has not only attracted the attention of the chairman, but also attracted the attention of many people. I hope to know the identity of this demon race as soon as possible. How did he come here? Who are his accomplices? I wonder if you have any results here?”
Li Li saw that he was in a hurry to get things done, so he did not bother to chat with him anymore. His face turned serious, “After the incident, I immediately retrieved the surveillance footage. I’m ashamed to say that I did not see how he managed to sneak in. He seemed to have suddenly appeared in the mall and started a massacre. From the surveillance footage of the mall at that time, he pretended to be an ordinary pedestrian and had an argument with a few girls. Later on, he was furious and tore off his disguise.”
Yao Jie frowned and said, “How is that possible? Your Mobei City is heavily guarded, and there are surveillance cameras everywhere on the streets. It’s impossible for him to appear here out of thin air. Have you checked the records of the border guards?”
Li Li nodded, he said, “We have, but there are no suspicious points. The only suspect is a student. Not long before the incident, a taxi suddenly exploded and ignited. Through the slow playback of the surveillance cameras, we found that the door of the taxi was pushed open. With such great strength, it must be a demon. It means that the demon was in the taxi at that time. Then, we checked the record of the taxi pulling passengers and found a student and his friend. The two of them came from Tongshi city by magnetic levitation high-speed train.”
“In that case, this student might be his accomplice!”Yao Jie asked, “Then where is the student now? Have you interrogated him?”
Li Li was slightly startled. His expression was a little strange as he said, “This, how should I put it? At first, this student was quite suspicious, but after an investigation, it was found that he should be innocent.”
“Innocent?”Yao Jie looked at him in confusion.
Li Li nodded and said, “After the car exploded, he was thrown out of the car and was lucky enough to survive. Later, that demon appeared not too far away and attacked the civilians. His performance was no different from the others and they were all quite frightened. Our forensic expert, based on his many years of experience, judged that he did not lie. He used the AI to test his performance at that time, and the result was also completely true.”
“After that, the demon race appeared in the shopping mall and escaped after fighting with the city guard mecha. He did not chase after them. From these points, I feel that although he is a suspect, he should not be the murderer. At most, he was held hostage by the demon race.”
Yao Jie was stunned, he could not help but say, “However, he was sitting in the same taxi as the demon race. Furthermore, they just happened to arrive at your Mobei City today. Just these alone are enough to capture him and interrogate him. He would rather catch the wrong person than to miss out on any suspect. This is the demon race. Missing out on one is equivalent to a devastating disaster!”
Li Li smiled wryly, “Originally, I planned to capture him and interrogate him. However, the higher-ups said that this man has a special identity and couldn’t be a demon. Therefore, we didn’t need to divert our attention to him. Through his actions, I felt that he doesn’t look like a demon accomplice.”
“The higher-ups said that?”Yao Jie narrowed his eyes, which flashed with a cold light, “Who? The four major financial groups?”
Li Li shook his head slightly and pointed upwards, but he didn’t say anything.
Yao Jie’s pupils contracted slightly, and he was a little shocked. After a moment, he slowly withdrew the shock in his eyes and was silent for a moment, he said, “Since it’s from the higher-ups, then it seems that he is indeed not a suspect. In that case, are there any other suspects and clues?”
Li Li nodded, “Yes, when that demon appeared, there were a few onlookers who behaved abnormally. They were very suspicious. In addition, the forensic doctor dissected the face of this demon and found that he had changed his appearance at the last minute. There were obvious signs of twisting on his facial muscles. However, he was bombarded by the true light cannon until his body was not intact. His face was severely damaged. It would be very difficult to comb his facial muscles back to their original appearance. It would take some time.”
Yao Jie let out a sigh of relief, “After the forensic doctor restores his original appearance, we will know what he looked like before. An upper-level abyss didn’t move here alone. There might be some despicable people behind him who tried to use him to do something. Unfortunately, he broke free.”
Li Li glanced at him and knew that he was referring to the four major financial groups. Only they had the ability to make a demon appear in one of the core cities of the federation stealthily.

chapters.title: Chapter 1097
chapters.content:
Chapter 1097 – Chapter 1,086: Blockade
“In recent years, the actions of the other three major consortia have become more and more radical!”Yao Jie said with a slightly cold look, “I guess some people couldn’t sit still anymore. Chairman is very concerned about this matter. He might want to make an example of the others. You must investigate it carefully. Whoever is involved in this demon’s attack must be found out. Otherwise, the ‘riot of zombies’80 years ago and the ‘nuclear explosion’30 years ago would be staged again!”
Li Li’s heart skipped a beat. He knew that the chairman was going to be serious this time!
As for why Yao Jie was talking about the three major consortia, he could guess the reason as well. This did not include the Terras Consortium. This was because the first generation leader of the Terras consortium was the god of Technology. After the god of technology passed away.., the forces under their command gradually formed the Terras Consortium. They held the most secrets and weapons of the Federation, as well as the highest level of technology. They were undoubtedly the number one consortium among the four major consortia!
However, although the Terras Consortium had great power, they had always kept a low profile. They focused on researching technology, pushing the Federation’s technology forward. More than 80% of the technology in their daily lives came from the Terras Consortium, almost all of them came from the Terras Consortium!
In addition, it was said that the previous federation presidents were all people who were manipulated by the Terras consortium to assist them.
The three consortia had long been wary of the Terras consortium, but they didn’t dare to openly fight it out. None of them wanted to be cannon fodder for the other two. They could only develop behind the scenes and try to replace Terras, or.., not Be Threatened by the Terras consortium anymore.
“Why would such a troublesome matter appear in our Mobei city…”Li Li smiled bitterly in his heart. If this was the worst possibility, then he would also be involved in the fight between the consortia, as the Defense Minister of Mobei City, he was only a small role in front of such a giant. He could be dismissed or disappear at any time.
Dudian had just finished watching the news when his communicator rang. He picked up the call as he saw that it was Felix.
“Your action this time is too risky!”Felix’s anxious and helpless voice came from the communicator. He chose to make a video call, dudian picked up the voice call. He felt a bit nauseous to see the man’s face up close, “The movement this time is too big. I heard that the four consortia are paying attention to this place. I think they will send many people to investigate. Even if your action is secret, there will be flaws and clues. This is the federation. There are surveillance cameras everywhere. It’s not your demon race!”
Dudian calmly said: “Don’t panic. Even if you find something it doesn’t matter. As long as there is no sufficient evidence, you won’t be punished.”
“You think too simple. This kind of action involves the demon race. As long as there is a bit of relationship, you will be beaten and forced to admit it. Just like the medieval times in the old era. As long as people say that you have a relationship with the witch, whether it is the magistrate or the surrounding villagers, they will think that you are evil because of fear! Our Federation’s fear of You Demons is the same as the fear of witches! Forget it, you don’t know about this!”Felix was a bit angry, he wasn’t so modest and afraid of Dudian’s attitude.
Dudian indifferently said: “If the person who was wronged was a noble or a landlord, the villagers and Magistrates wouldn’t act Rashly.”
Felix who was in the factory office slightly opened his eyes. He was surprised that Dudian knew the history that he was talking about? He couldn’t help but shout: “Are you really a federal person? Are you a disguised devil?”
“No matter who I am, our identity will not change. Why do you care so much?”Dudian casually said.
Felix was so angry that he almost vomited blood. No matter what his name is, I Will Always Be Your Grandpa! He held his breath for a long time before he said: “We should be considered as partners now. Our status is equal.”
“As long as you are happy.”
”…”
After a few seconds of silence, Felix took a deep breath and said in a serious tone: “I will say hello to them. If they catch you, let them give you a lighter sentence.”
“No, this will implicate you.”Dudian refused.
Felix was startled. He didn’t think that Dudian would say such warm words. He thought that even if he didn’t help, Dudian would ask him because he was afraid of implicating him and exposing his arrangements? But without his help, his federal identity was a poor student. How could he get away from the military?
Dudian hung up the communicator. He didn’t give Felix the opportunity to ask questions. On the other side, Felix opened his mouth slightly. He looked at his wristwatch and saw that the call had ended. He suddenly had the urge to curse, he felt that all the good qualities that he had cultivated since childhood had been wasted on Dudian!
“If you take me as a suspect of the demon’s accomplice then you should take me to check the magic marks detection equipment. I have tried several times but I couldn’t find it. It means that my physique is different from ordinary magic marks warriors. It is probably because the magic marks have been digested by the Aragami Factor.”Dudian looked at the night sky outside the window, he pondered in silence.
At this time, the communication device rang again.
“I forgot to tell you that the whole city has been locked down. You can only stay there for a period of time.”Felix’s voice was heard after the call was connected, “But this kind of blockade won’t be able to resist the public’s will. It will be unlocked in a few days. Don’t worry. If you are ready to rush out then it would be best for you to hide for a few days.”
“We haven’t lost our identity yet.”Dudian indifferently said: “Moreover this blockade will last for at least a week or even half a month.”
Felix was stunned: “Why?”
“The public’s will in Mobei city is too weak compared to the public’s will in the entire federation. Locking the city is the same as keeping the Devil’s accomplices in the city. But if it is unlocked then it is the same as letting the devil’s accomplices into the entire federation. The people in other cities won’t do it.”Dudian said.
Felix understood. He wanted to ask why he deduced that it would take a week. He was about to ask when he suddenly thought of something. He understood that with the traffic and trade of Mobei City, it would be the limit to lock the city for half a month, otherwise, the city would be cut off from food and water.
“I didn’t expect you to even consider this.”Felix sighed. He was about to say a few words of admiration when he found that the communicator had been disconnected. The corner of his mouth twitched.
..
He was so tired last night that he didn’t eat dinner. It took him a lot of time to make breakfast in the morning. In the end, he didn’t even cook it well! ! ! !

chapters.title: Chapter 1098
chapters.content:
Chapter 1098 – Chapter 187: Dream Company
The attack of the demons was on the news. The whole city was talking about it and it had become a hot topic.
Dudian rented a house in the commercial district using the federal coins given to him by Felix. He went around during the day. There were many large companies in the commercial district as well as some top groups of seed companies, he also saw several outsourcing companies that were cooperating with HAWSK company. They were helping to produce mech parts. There were pharmaceutical companies which had some strange medicines.
“Seeds of life, cosmetic needles, water pills…”
Dudian looked at several pharmaceutical companies and suddenly had an idea. He contacted Felix and said: “I want to open a pharmaceutical company!”
Felix knew that Dudian was going to build a company but he didn’t know what type of company he was going to build, he couldn’t help but ask: “Pharmaceutical company? You should think carefully. Pharmaceutical companies are more troublesome than us. Moreover the market is saturated with pharmaceutical companies. Unless you can develop a new drug, there is no hope.”
“I know. Later you will transfer the money to me to start the company.”Dudian said.
Felix knew that he didn’t listen to his words. He rolled his eyes and said: “I know.”
Dudian hung up the communicator. It didn’t take long before there was a notification from his communicator. There was a sum of money being transferred into his account. He looked at it. It was one million federal dollars but the account was not Felix’s, it was an unfamiliar name. He knew that Felix was afraid that he would be exposed and implicated.
Dudian didn’t act immediately after receiving the money. He went to the science park in the business district. There were many technology companies here. He went around and saw many instruments used in the research of biology, there were microscopes everywhere. He had seen other special instruments in the factory. Moreover they were more high-end than the ones sold here. They should be high-end products manufactured by top technology companies.
In the afternoon, Dudian went to the Federal Bureau of Industry and commerce to apply for a company.
“Please enter the name of the company.”The robot behind the counter said. The face of the robot was that of an Asian beauty. It looked no different from a real person.
Dudian thought for a moment: “Dream Company.”
“Input complete. Verify the name.”The robot said: “Please submit the company address.”
Dudian didn’t immediately submit but interrupted the application. After he left the Federal Bureau of Industry and commerce, he found the rental center in the commercial district and rented an office building with an area of more than 500 square meters. The office building was ready to use. The interior decoration was exquisite but the price was not cheap. The monthly rent was 80,000 yuan. It was higher than the annual salary of many border guards.
After paying the rent and deposit, Dudian made a copy of the rental contract. At the moment it was late. The Federal Bureau of Industry and commerce had closed. It would never open at night. He could only wait until tomorrow.
“It has been a day but they haven’t come to arrest me. It seems they don’t suspect me.”Dudian left the office building and returned to his rented room. There was no trace of anyone entering the room. He was a bit surprised, could it be that the other party found out that he was related to Felix so they ignored him? It shouldn’t be. If the investigation had reached this point then he would have to torture him even more.
Dudian thought for a moment but still had no clue. He could only attribute the reason to the useless security force of the federation.
That night, he used the communication device to connect to the internet and issued a recruitment notice on a rental platform. The next day, Dudian prepared all the materials and went to the Federal Bureau of Industry and commerce. He registered the company and got the business license.
He went back to the business district. He took the list in advance and bought all the equipment he needed. In the blink of an eye, another day had passed.
After a few days, the company was fully formed. The equipment was ready and Dudian’s recruitment notice also played a role. There were seven or eight people who came to apply. Dudian chose three of them to stay. They were two men and one woman.
The three employees looked at Dudian who was busy moving all kinds of equipment into the company. They were a bit dumbfounded. They didn’t think that they would enter a new company. Moreover the boss was so young. It seemed a bit unreliable.
It was a pity that they had signed the contract. They had to work for one year or they would have to pay compensation for breach of contract.
“Boss, are we a pharmaceutical company?”Ma Jing was encouraged by the other two. She braced herself and went to find Dudian, she carefully asked: “I don’t know what kind of medicine we are going to produce. Do you have the formula?”
Dudian saw that they couldn’t hold back, he said: “You don’t have to worry about this. After a few days the materials will be delivered. You will have to work overtime every day for the first week. You should be mentally prepared. Of course, the overtime pay will be calculated for you.”
Ma Jing saw that he was so confident. She quickly said: “I know. Boss has worked hard.”
Dudian waved his hand and sent her away. He left the office building and continued to buy materials.
After a few days, everything was ready. Dudian called Ma Jing and the other two in his office. He gave them the formula and the production project, “This is the formula. You should follow the operation process. The new drug is still in the trial stage. Remember to keep it confidential!”
Ma Jing and the other two nodded. Ma Jing said: “Boss, don’t worry. We have signed a confidentiality agreement. We will not leak the formula.”
Dudian nodded slightly. He was more assured about this so he didn’t say anything harsh. Sometimes the law was more useful than harsh words.
“Regenerative drug?”Ma Jing was surprised to see the name of the formula. She asked Dudian: “Boss, is this a kind of cell proliferation drug?”
“Almost.”Dudian casually said: “The effect of the finished product can probably allow people to regrow limbs. You can use mice to test this. Try to make it within a week.”
The three of them stared at Dudian in disbelief. Regrow limbs? ! The effect was so strong? !
Soon, the three of them thought of another matter. Their hearts couldn’t help but sink. Dudian said that the effect was so good. It meant that they had to make such a drug. If the formula didn’t work, Dudian would blame them for being incompetent.
The three of them felt heavy in their hearts. They felt that the salary of the company was higher than that of their peers.
After the three of them left Dudian also got up and left the company. The formula of the regenerative medicine was learned from other alchemists when he was an alchemist in Sylvia. This kind of medicine was not rare in Sylvia, but it was hard to find in the federation.
Although the technology of the federation was flourishing but most of it was used for external applications such as mechs and thermal weapons. The federation was constantly facing the threat of monsters and demons. These were terrifying existences that far surpassed ordinary people. They urgently needed strong strength to protect themselves, in the wars of the old era, it could be considered a divine medicine of war. However, in such a situation where human strength was nothing but cannon fodder, mechas and firearms were the only useful things. Otherwise, it would be useless even if it allowed one to live forever.., after all, the difference in strength was too great. If one could not defeat the enemy, everything would be nonsense.
Meanwhile, in a place like Sylvia, the Empire had intentionally suppressed the development of technology. Without firearms, they could only rely on mutation.
The technological focus of the two was the exact opposite. One was inclined towards the development of mechs, while the other was adept at studying the mysteries of the human body to enhance the strength of humans.
However, there was definitely a market for regenerative medicine in the Federation. It was just that due to the external environment, the four major consortia were more inclined to study things with great destructive power. As the saying went, “When the Sky Falls, it will hit the tall Guy”, the four consortia were undoubtedly the top tall guys in the federation. When small companies were racking their brains on how to make money from women and children, they had to think about how to deal with monsters and demons and how to find absolute power, to rule the federation.
Now, Dudian was a small guy. He could collect money that the four consortia didn’t have time to collect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1099
chapters.content:
Chapter 1099 – Chapter 1,888: Sales Promotion
“Among the four consortiums, the Terras consortium is the most involved in the pharmaceutical industry. However, the Terras consortium is not focused on the pharmaceutical industry. The most influential drug they have launched is the ‘tai chi anti-cancer pill’. According to the official information, it is an anti-cancer drug made from a substance extracted from the demon God’s body, which can kill all cancer cells. The Demon God mentioned by the federation is the Aragami. This should be the Aragami gene that has been decomposed.”
“The pharmaceutical industry is the highest status in the federation. The name of the medicine is the ancient Chinese culture ‘tai chi’. It shows that the legacy of the old era has been preserved here. Even Felix knows about the witches and the stories of the Middle Ages.”
Dudian thought about his next plan as he walked out of the company. Terras was not focused on the pharmaceutical industry. Although other consortia had their own pharmaceutical companies but their results were average, the medicine in the Federation was able to meet people’s normal needs. Most of the diseases could be treated. Many of the fatal diseases of the old era had been solved.
Only a few diseases could be fatal and there was no cure. For example, they could be infected by zombies or seriously infected by nuclear radiation.
However, people living in the Federation wouldn’t come into contact with zombies. Only soldiers who went out to hunt would accidentally get infected. As for nuclear radiation infection, it was needless to say. Most of the people who were infected were the poor people of the federation. Their living conditions were poor. Even if they weren’t infected by nuclear radiation, it would be equivalent to incurable diseases. After all.., poverty itself was the most terrible disease.
“There is no market for conventional drugs. Even if they are optimized, they won’t be able to earn much money. The regenerative medicine will certainly cause a storm. The rich and the military have a need for it. This is not a basic need but a desire. Other consortia will also see this. They may come to snatch it. We have to be careful in advance…”Dudian came to the street, he glanced at the people on the street and the surrounding steel buildings. He felt like he was living in the jungle.
He called a car and told the driver the address.
It didn’t take long before he arrived at his destination. It was a high-end residential area. There were many villas in the area. Most of the people living there were rich or powerful people, the robot that was guarding the door asked him to show his identity.
“I’m here to visit Mr. Zhang.”Dudian told the robot the purpose of his visit.
“Please log in and let me inform you.”The robot said sweetly.
Dudian scanned his identity and said: “The reason for my visit is about Mr. Zhang’s leg. I can make him recover.”
“Alright, I will remember. Amy will pass the message to you as soon as possible.”The robot smiled.
After a moment the robot spoke again: “Mr. Zhang has refused your visit.”
Dudian frowned: “Tell him that if he misses this time our dream pharmaceutical company will blacklist him forever. We will not sell him the ‘Regenerative Medicine’developed by our company.”
“I will pass the message to you now. Please don’t be angry. Mr. Zhang may be very busy.”The robot said again. Its tone was still very sweet. There was no trace of impatience. Dudian’s dissatisfaction was relieved, he couldn’t help but sigh. It was true that robots had replaced humans. Especially in this kind of labor and service industry. It was far better than humans.
After a moment the robot shook its head again: “I’m sorry. Mr. Zhang has rejected your visit and blacklisted you.”
Dudian’s face turned black. He didn’t think that his psychological tactics wouldn’t work. It seemed that the man had completely taken him as a liar.
“Since he blacklisted me, I can only blacklist you!”Dudian thought in his heart. He was a bit angry but quickly dispelled the idea. He turned around and left. He called a taxi and continued to the next target.
Villa No. 7.
“Dad, why don’t you meet this person? Maybe he is real.”There was a beautiful girl sitting on the luxurious sofa in the living room. She was eating a plate of strawberries, as she ate she looked at the middle-aged man who was reading a mechanical book. The middle-aged man was tall and strong. His face was as sharp as a knife. It was obvious that he was very handsome when he was young.
“He’s just a boring liar. Humph, he actually found our home address and even knew about my leg. It seems that our family’s information has been leaked out from somewhere,”the middle-aged man said unhappily.
“This person said something about dream company. The name is quite strange, but perhaps the ‘regenerative medicine’is real. If you reject him like this, what if he doesn’t sell medicine to you in the future?”The young girl pouted, although she said that, her persuasion was not strong because she also felt that the latter was more likely to be a liar. However, she was a little dissatisfied with her father’s attitude of not caring about her body at all.
“There is no such medicine.”The middle-aged man said indifferently, “Even if there is, it is created by the Terras Consortium. If they have a new medicine, there is no need to wait for him to come to me. I will know at the first moment that even if this dream company’s ‘regenerative medicine’is real, it is just an exaggeration and has some healing effects. My leg has been broken for so many years, how can it be regenerated? Moreover the prosthesis is quite good.”
The girl wanted to say but had to give up.
At the same time.
Dudian went to another high-end residential area to inform the robot.
“Mr. Wang please go in.”The robot seemed to have received the news from the other side and smiled at Dudian.
The robots were all women. However the robots didn’t differentiate between men and women. Although they were women but their combat ability could crush ordinary people.
Dudian was relieved. The robot led him to a villa. The door of the villa opened automatically. It was an intelligent automatic door.
“Please.”The robot said and left after Dudian entered the door.
“You don’t need to take off your shoes. Come and sit.”A bald middle-aged man sat on the sofa in the living room. There was a pile of toy mech parts on the table in front of him. He looked up at Dudian and was startled, he didn’t expect to see such a young man. The hope in his eyes disappeared and his expression turned cold: “Are you a Salesman?”
Dudian shook his head and walked towards him. He sat on the sofa next to him, “I am the chairman of the Dream Company. I know that you don’t have much patience. I Am the same. So to make a long story short, our company’s newly developed ‘Regenerative Medicine’has the same effect as the name. There is no exaggeration. As for the evidence, I can show it to you now.”
Wang Donglin’s eyebrows slightly trembled. He turned his head and stared at Dudian. His eyes were like a tiger’s. If it wasn’t for Dudian’s last words, his patience would have been exhausted by Dudian’s previous words, he would be kicked out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1100
chapters.content:
Chapter 1100 – Chapter 189Th: Join In
Wang Donglin endured for a moment and coldly said: “Evidence? How Do You See? If you want me to take your regeneration medicine now, it is impossible. I am not a white mouse.”
“You think too much. Our medicine is very expensive. How can we give it to you for free?”Dudian casually said: “Do you have a knife here?”
Wang Donglin’s eyebrows slightly moved. In fact, if he didn’t think that time had been spent on this, he would have been kicked out because of Dudian’s attitude.
“Don’t think wrongly. I didn’t kidnap you. I came in from the guard. If I kidnapped you, I would have been caught before I left the community.”Dudian said.
Wang donglin snorted: “Wait, I’ll get it for you.”
He went to the kitchen and took out a knife to cut the fruit. The knife was extremely sharp. It was made by a master. It was hand forged and not polished by a machine. The price was extremely expensive, only a rich man like him was willing to cut the fruit. Others would use it for collection.
“Here!”Wang Donglin coldly looked at dudian. He wasn’t worried that Dudian would kidnap him. He used to be a marine before he became famous. Even if Dudian had a knife in his hand he was confident that he could capture him.
Dudian took the knife and raised his other hand. Wang Donglin stared at the knife. The knife quickly cut his wrist and blood oozed out.
Wang Donglin was startled. He didn’t think that Dudian would self-harm. He frowned: “What are you doing? Are you threatening me with self-harm? Even if you commit suicide here, I won’t use fake medicine…”
“Shh.”Dudian glanced at him and handed the cut wrist to him: “This kind of wound can be healed in a minute. Look at it.”
Wang Donglin was startled for a moment. He looked down and saw that the wound on Dudian’s wrist was slowly stopping bleeding. It was healing at a speed visible to the naked eye. A trace of shock flashed through his eyes and his eyes became extremely solemn.
A minute passed by. The wound on Dudian’s wrist had healed. He reached out to wipe off the blood stains on the surface. The wound was restored to its original state. There wasn’t even a scar left. It was like a magic trick.
“This is the effect of the regenerant. Not only can it regenerate the broken limbs but it will also greatly improve the healing ability of your body. It will strengthen the trace elements in your blood. To some extent, it has the effect of delaying aging.”Dudian casually said.
Wang Donglin’s pupils shrank. He looked at Dudian’s white wrist. He was silent for a moment before he slowly said: “Can you guarantee that this medicine can regenerate the broken limbs? I mean the scarred limbs.”
“Of course, otherwise how can it be called a regeneration medicine?”Dudian said as a matter of course.
Wang Donglin didn’t feel that Dudian’s attitude was arrogant and arrogant. Instead, he felt that it was a kind of arrogance. He nodded slightly and smiled: “I have offended you before. How should I address you?”
“Qin Mo, you can call me chairman Qin.”
Wang Donglin’s mouth twitched: “Mr. Qin, I don’t know how to sell this medicine. How much is it? I want to order one first.”
Dudian said: “The official sale will be in ten days. As for the price, since I found you, naturally you are willing to pay. Originally, our company limited each person to order one copy of this regenerative medicine. But now is the pre-sale phase. If Mr. Wang Donglin is interested, you can join our company’s VIP list. The limit has increased to five copies. In other words, you can buy it for your friends and relatives or buy it yourself for another sale. The price is up to you but you can not break the market rules!”
Wang Donglin was slightly startled. He guessed why Dudian was looking for him: “How much does it cost to join a VIP?”
“Our company’s VIP system has a five-star rating. But at the beginning it is only open to one-star VIP. The annual fee is one million.”Dudian said: “The price of a regenerative medicine is two million. According to the market rules, you can set the price up or down by 30% . According to the five quotas, you can still earn money.”
Wang Donglin understood and his eyes lit up: “This isn’t an ordinary VIP right. Why do you have the feeling of an agent?”
“That’s the general idea. If you want to cooperate, then cooperate. If you don’t, then forget about it. You can wait ten days to buy it.”Dudian continued: “The regenerative medicine is only the first drug our company has launched. We will continue to develop other new drugs. Our company has Top-notch technology behind us. We will not let you down. You should understand the value of this medicine.”
Wang Donglin smiled: “Alright, I’m in. Do you have a contract?”
“I’ve brought it.”Dudian took out a stack of contracts from his bag and handed it to him.
Wang Donglin’s eyelids twitched as he saw Dudian put another stack of contracts into his bag. He felt that his decision was correct. Although he had never heard of this company but Dudian’s evidence of the efficacy of the drug.., although the price was a bit expensive but it was not outrageous. In his eyes it was worth a try.
“After you sign the contract you can transfer the money.”Dudian reminded him.
Wang donglin laughed: “Don’t worry, I trust you.”
Dudian secretly curled his lips. A second ago he was trying to distance himself from others but now he was trying to make friends. No wonder he was making so much money.
Although Wang Donglin’s words were beautiful but he carefully read the contract. After making sure that there were no business traps and loopholes he signed his name and recorded the scene with his comlink, in case there was evidence in case of a lawsuit. After signing the contract he logged into his account and transferred an annual fee to the account provided by Dudian.
Dudian’s communicator received a notification that a million yuan had been transferred into his account.
“Chairman Qin, please wait for a moment. I’ll make you a cup of tea.”
“No, there are other businesses waiting for me. I’ll leave first.”Dudian got up and left.
Wang Donglin wryly smiled as he saw Dudian’s figure leave the house. He immediately used the communicator to search for Dream Company. Soon, he found the company’s information. When he saw the registration time.., he couldn’t help but stare. He felt cheated. It was a company that had been registered for less than three days!
“Could it be a shell company?”Wang Donglin’s heart was beating fast. He had just paid a VIP annual fee. Although one million wasn’t a lot for him but who didn’t have money? Moreover he would feel uncomfortable if he was cheated out of even one yuan!
He frowned as he carefully recalled the scene when Dudian cut his wrist. He was sure that it wasn’t a magic trick. Suddenly, he thought of a way to check the blood on the knife. However, he found that… The knife was gone!

chapters.title: Chapter 1101
chapters.content:
Chapter 1101 – Chapter 190: Black Market
After coming out from Wang Donglin’s house, Dudian took a bus to other places. According to the information provided by Felix and the Internet, he selected some people who urgently needed ‘regenerative medicine’, he personally went to sell them.
Most of them refused to meet him. But there were many people like Wang Donglin who wanted to try their ideas. After meeting Dudian, they all signed the contract and paid the VIP annual fee. They didn’t realize that.., he was bound to the interests of the Dream Company.
“The money given by Felix is barely enough to start a company and buy equipment. By the beginning of next month, I won’t even be able to pay the salaries of the employees.”Dudian went back to his rented cabin, he took out the signed contract from his bag and checked the balance of his account on the communicator. There was a total of more than nine million points. This was the annual fee for the nine VIP customers today.
With the nine million yuan in his account, his company could basically operate normally. However, if he wanted to buy more advanced equipment and good quality materials, this amount of money was just a drop in the bucket. Fortunately, after the development of the ‘Regenerative Medicine’, after the trial and promotion of these VIP customers, it was enough to open the way for the company.
He rested for a night.
The next day, Dudian came to the company. He was busy in the laboratory. He personally experimented with the formula of the regenerative medicine. He felt that there was no problem.
After he was busy for more than an hour, Ma Jing and the other two came to the company one after another. They were shocked when they saw that Dudian was already in the laboratory. It was only the second day of work but he came later than the boss, they didn’t dare to slack off.
“You have to work hard these few days. When the first batch of drugs is developed, the company will buy machines to mass produce.”Dudian encouraged the three, “Yesterday, nine big shots have placed orders for our company. They have joined our company’s VIP customers. You should know about these people. Wang Donglin and Kurt.”
“They have placed orders?”Ma Jing and the other two were surprised. The drugs hadn’t been made yet and there were already customers?
“Boss, is it Wang Donglin from the Yangtze Group?”Zhao Fei asked with a surprised face.
Dudian nodded: “They are big customers. We have a good market for regenerative medicine. You should research and develop it as soon as possible.”
The three looked at each other in excitement. They had thought that the new company was a bit unreliable. Especially the boss was so young. It felt like he was playing with a rich second generation, moreover, he was researching regenerative medicine. It was a fantasy to think about it. They didn’t expect Wang Donglin to place an order. As for Kurt.., he was most likely the chairman of the Pria pharmaceutical company.
The three of them whispered to each other for a moment after Dudian left the laboratory. Soon they were excited to participate in the experiment.
Dudian didn’t follow them on the spot. He went to the Science Park after he left the company. He chose better equipment. One of them was called ‘TB gamma ray through lens’, this instrument integrated the function of the particle collider. At the same time it could scan the smallest material from the whole body. Moreover it wouldn’t damage the whole body. Moreover it had an intelligent record and analysis function. Its function was amazing but the price wasn’t cheap, the cheapest simple model cost eight million yuan without tax.
However, this thing could be paid in installments. Dudian paid three million yuan in advance and withdrew it back to the company. Then he bought several other equipment. In the blink of an eye he had nine million yuan left. He spent money like water.
“The equipment is ready. The only thing left is to buy a zombie on the black market or to catch one outside the city.”Dudian thought about it and decided to spend money to do things. It was easy for him to catch a zombie, however, it would be very difficult to catch one and bring it back to the city.
It was afternoon when the equipment was transported back to the company. Ma Jing and the other two stared at the equipment that Dudian had brought back. They recognized most of the equipment. They knew that the equipment was ridiculously expensive. Only the top hospitals and research institutes had them, moreover, only the rich were qualified to enjoy the equipment in the hospital. After all, the maintenance cost was not low.
However, Dudian told them that the equipment was not for them to use.
It was already evening when all the equipment was unpacked. Time and money were useless. Fortunately, the black market was still open at night. Dudian ate dinner and went to an ordinary shopping mall in Mobei City.
He took the elevator to the top floor of the shopping mall. There were obviously fewer people than below. Moreover, the clothes were extraordinary.
Dudian saw a shop called ‘Yang Gu’. It was selling clothes. It was a famous brand in the federation. There were famous chain stores in every city of the federation.
Dudian walked over. An elegant salesperson immediately came up to him. He smiled gently. Although most of the coolies could be done by robots but the top brand sales.., they still maintained manual sales. This was the difference between the top sales and ordinary shops in the federation.
“Hello, Sir. Come in and have a look?”The salesperson gently asked.
Dudian nodded slightly and walked into the shop: “Do you have a night suit?”
The salesperson shook his head: “Sir, this shop doesn’t have this brand of clothes.”
“Yes, I remember wrong. It’s a night suit.”Dudian said.
The salesman looked at him: “Yes, sir. This way please.”He took Dudian to the back of the shop, he looked at the middle-aged man who was sitting on the sofa: “Manager, this one is going to the night world.”
The middle-aged man looked up at dudian: “Have you confirmed it?”
“Yes.”
“I know, sir. Please follow me.”The middle-aged man got up and turned off the communicator. He shook hands with Dudian and took the initiative to go out.
Dudian immediately felt that there was a faint fragrance in his palm. Ordinary People’s sense of smell couldn’t detect it. It should be some kind of Mark. He didn’t erase it but turned to follow the middle-aged man and left the mall.
The middle-aged man took Dudian to the parking lot outside the mall and asked him to get in the car.
“Sir is a stranger. How did you know about the Nightworld?”The middle-aged man asked after getting in the car.
Dudian indifferently replied: “An acquaintance.”
“I know.”The middle-aged man slightly nodded and started the car.
Dudian leaned against the car and sat in a relaxed manner. The password and address were obtained from Felix. He didn’t expect that there would be such a dark place like the black market in this heavily guarded technology city.
The light was more dazzling and the darkness was deeper.
Soon, the middle-aged man brought Dudian to the black market. It was a luxurious five-star hotel.

chapters.title: Chapter 1102
chapters.content:
Chapter 1102 – Chapter 1991: List
The middle-aged man came to the front desk and took out a black card from his suit pocket and handed it to the front desk. When one of the front desk staff saw the black card, an unnoticeable fluctuation flashed through his eyes and he quickly took the black card, he swiped the card on the swiping machine beside the system and then smiled sweetly at the middle-aged man. “Sir, which room do you want?”
“Number one.”The middle-aged man said.
The attendant smiled, “Please follow me.”
She left the reception and led the middle-aged man and Dudian to the other side of the hotel lobby. They came to a remote corner of the elevator. She scanned her work card on the elevator and opened the elevator door, she led the two into the hotel.
Dudian was at the back. He used his X-ray vision to scan the hotel. He saw that the work card of the attendant was the same as other people’s work card. However, there was a black metal card inside. It was the same as the card of the middle-aged man, there was an underground square twenty meters deep under the elevator. There were many people inside. It was bustling with activity.
At this time, the elevator sank. A sense of weightlessness came over and soon it stopped. When the elevator door opened again, there was a dark passage in front of them. The waiter called out, the middle-aged man took Dudian to the passage. There was a huge square outside the passage.
The middle-aged man didn’t take Dudian directly to the square. He opened a door next to the passage and came to a small room. There was a huge mainframe and a helmet in the room. There was a storage cabinet next to it, the middle-aged man said to dudian: “Sir, if you want to buy anything, you can place an order here. In addition, this is an anti-detection mask. It can protect your identity from detection.”
He took out a black clown mask from the cabinet and handed it to Dudian.
Dudian asked: “What does it sell?”
The middle-aged man looked at him in surprise, he said: “After you become a star customer of the city, you have the right to enter the free market. You can sell your personal items or buy from others. The price is free and tax free. If you have money that needs to be transferred to another account, you can trade in it.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. No wonder the black market was able to survive. The tax exemption alone was enough to attract a large number of rich people. He asked: “How do you become a star customer?”
“You will automatically become a star customer if you spend more than ten million here.”The middle-aged man smiled.
Dudian nodded: “I know.”
“Sir, you will stay in the black market for two hours. There is one hour and fifty-two minutes left. I Won’t delay your visit. I will wait for you outside the door.”The middle-aged man politely said.
Dudian nodded. The rules of the black market were very overbearing. All non-star customers could only stay in the black market for two hours a day. If they came to the black market twice without spending money then they would be disqualified from entering the black market.
“The black market is located in the center of the city. There should be a lot of powerful people behind it…”Dudian’s eyes lit up. He sat down in front of the mainframe and put on the helmet, soon a virtual image appeared in front of his eyes. It was as if he was standing in front of the image.
“Biological category, Science and Technology category, HOT weapons category, cold weapons category, chemical weapons category, Monster category…”Dudian glanced at the general classification and took the lead to click on the biological category, he saw some very clear pictures. The first one was a little girl with handcuffs. Her eyes were big and her skin was white and tender. She was exquisite like a porcelain doll. The price was 2.3 million federal dollars.
Dudian looked at the default ranking. It was ranked according to the sales. However there was no number of sales. He looked at the name of the little girl: “Stubborn White Virgin with pure natural weakness.”
There were details below the name of the product such as hair color selection, height selection, weight selection, age selection, and degree of rebellion selection.
In addition, there was a detailed introduction. It turned out that the girl in the picture was a black market specialty. She was loved by the rich. She could be bought back as a servant and a toy. It was like adopting a puppy. She could be trained, if she was killed, she could contact the black market and destroy the body.
The second item was a cat tiger. It looked like a cat but also like a tiger. It was a genetic combination. It was only the size of a puppy when it reached adulthood. However, its appearance was more like a tiger. It was very cute and had a certain degree of aggression. However, it was trained, it could be raised as a dog. It could also be used to guard the house. It was almost a necessary status symbol for the rich families.
Dudian looked down and saw many other animals with genetic union. He wasn’t interested in them so he switched to the science and Technology category.
The first item in the science and technology category was the freezer.
Dudian’s eyes opened wide in disbelief. He clicked on it and found that the freezer was different from his own. Although the effect was to freeze the living and let them sleep for a long time, but there was a risk in freezing.., moreover the longest time was only 80 years! Some people had terminal diseases so they could use the freezing chamber to freeze themselves. In the future when the technology was developed they would wake up and then be treated.
“Compared to my freezing chamber, this one is too bad. The technology here is so advanced but they haven’t created a more perfect freezing chamber than my freezing chamber…”Dudian felt proud in his heart, he didn’t think too much about it.
In addition to the freezing chamber, Dudian saw a lot of magical scientific and technological items. A mech with mind control needed to wear a ring of thought to operate. It could fly into space! But the price was incredible. It was as high as two billion!
“This should be something for the rich to go to space for sightseeing. The earth is too dangerous so it is safer to go to space for sightseeing.”Dudian looked at the detailed introduction below. It mentioned space tourism.
After a quick tour of dozens of goods, Dudian switched to thermal weapons. He saw a lot of destructive thermal weapons. One of them was called ‘Giant Thunder Cannon’, its effect was ten times more terrifying than an intercontinental missile. It could destroy a federal city from a long distance!
Such weapons were absolutely taboo weapons. However they could be bought on the black market. It was estimated that they could be sold to terrorists or some consortia or rich people. They could have their own private force.
However, the price of this thing was ridiculously high. It was 9.8 billion yuan!
The ones who could afford this thing were either top-level tycoons or consortia.
“Monster…”
“Virgin undeads. The corpse is preserved for a week…”
Soon, Dudian saw the undeads he needed. However the undeads sold here seemed to be man-made.

chapters.title: Chapter 1103
chapters.content:
Chapter 1103 – Chapter 1992: Circle Of Peace
“Use the virus extracted from the corpse to infect humans and then sell them. The price is… 1.8 million!”Dudian opened the details of the “Virgin undeads”, there were four major choices in terms of race. There were yellow-skinned East Asian races, white-skinned Caucasian races, black-skinned negroes, and brown-skinned rare races.
In addition, there was a large area of choice in terms of age.
However, the upper and lower limits were shocking. It was as low as a three-year-old girl and as high as a seventy-two-year-old woman.
”… They have been trained, vocal command control…”Dudian looked at the specific introduction and was surprised. The Virgin undeads here had been trained, and the method used was also the conditioned reflex method that he had thought of.
In addition, there were “Original ecology”types which referred to Virgin undeads that had not been trained.
Moreover, the so-called “Virgin undeads”was the general name of the industry. It could be divided into “Virgins”and “Non-virgins”. For example, it was almost impossible for a 72-year-old woman to be a virgin, it also satisfied the needs of a small number of people.
“The power is not strong, but the desire is endless…”Dudian quickly finished the tour. He could smell the bloody slaughter behind the industry chain as well as the protection of power. This was the result of collusion between officials and bandits, if he sold one of them, it would be 1.8 million federal coins. Moreover, it was tax-free. If he could sell 10 or 100 of them, it would be enough to earn more money than he could spend in his lifetime.
Money always made people take risks and go crazy.
Dudian took a deep breath and continued to look down. In addition to the Virgin undeads, there were ordinary undeads. These undeads were captured from outside the city. Their bodies were either rotten or incomplete. There were men, women, Old and young, the strength assessment had a total of nine stars. However, the highest level of undeads sold here was only four stars. The last five stars were all gray and could not be selected.
The lowest one-star undead was priced at 200,000 for one.
Dudian was relieved. He still had more than one million left. He couldn’t afford to buy that female undead, but there was no problem in getting an ordinary undead back to study.
He immediately placed the order and paid. After the payment page was finished, he went back to the list.
He continued to browse down. In addition to the undead, there were many pictures of monsters. These pictures were taken from various angles. It was as if the monsters were cooperating with the photographer. The prices were low by tens of thousands and high by tens of millions, there were hundreds of millions of them. One of them was a nine-star monster’s corpse. The preservation rate was 97% and there was almost no damage. The price was 820 million!
Dudian got the detailed data from Felix. He knew that each star’s evaluation was based on the data. If it was the level of magic marks warrior in the Empire then it would be from early hunter to the middle abyss. The nine-star monster would be the middle abyss, the Upper Abyss was known as the Forbidden Beast or the Super Beast. The Lord of the Abyss was known as the Devil Beast.
There were the rarest five Hell Beasts above the Devil Beast. Each of them had the strength to surpass the Devil Beast. There were only five of them in the years since the establishment of the Federation.
“Using electromagnetic nuclear device to destroy the brain tissue?”Dudian looked at the details of the corpse of the nine-star monster. He couldn’t help but be surprised when he saw the method to kill it, what kind of weapon could kill a middle-level abyss monster without any damage? Wouldn’t this weapon be able to easily kill the middle-level abyss of the empire if it was used in a war? Dudian’s heart turned cold. The strength of the federation was more terrifying than it looked on the surface. The Empire might not be a match for the federation if they were to go all out against the empire. However, the Federation didn’t seem to be one piece of iron, the infighting was endless.
He was going to ask Felix about the situation of this weapon after he left the black market.
Dudian continued to tour for a while. He saw many corpses of monsters. These monsters were sold in the black market. They were mainly sold to consortia or some monster research institutes.
Two hours passed. Dudian exited the black market shopping list. He heard the middle-aged man knock on the door. He took off his helmet and got up to open the door.
“Sir, are you shopping?”The middle-aged man asked politely.
Dudian nodded: “Yes.”
The middle-aged man smiled, “I forgot to tell you that the address of the black market is absolutely confidential. We will disguise as other items when we deliver the goods. We will not arouse your suspicion. Moreover we will make an appointment with you in advance.”
“I know.”Dudian filled in the address of the company. He had asked Felix about the basic operation.
The middle-aged man smiled and took Dudian away from the black market.
“I’m just taking a walk. You Go back first.”Dudian didn’t take the middle-aged man’s car after they left the hotel.
The middle-aged man nodded and left.
Dudian walked by the roadside as he used the comlink to ask Felix.
“Electromagnetic nuclear device to kill monsters?”Felix was surprised as his eyes lit up, “Yes, how could I forget about this? Haha, Mr. Dean, with your strength it is very easy to kill monsters. I can lend you a mech. You Can Catch a few monsters in a month and it will be worth half a year’s sales for a large group!”
Dudian rolled his eyes: “I’m not asking you to give me a money-making idea. I’m asking what this thing is.”
Felix was stunned for a moment. He didn’t expect that Dudian would be unmoved. He frowned, “This is a special weapon. It can directly destroy the brain of monsters. But it is mainly used against monsters with hard bodies and weak brain tissue. It is not suitable for all monsters. Moreover, this kind of thing is used for indiscriminate attacks. So it is banned by the military. Generally it is only used to kill monsters.”
“Once the wandering teams find traces of large-scale monsters, they will investigate in advance and scan the body structure of the monster. After the analysis, they will choose the corresponding killing weapons to capture the monster. The less the damage, the greater the value. For example, the body of the monster used to make mechs should not be more than ten percent damaged. Otherwise, the price should be reduced by at least half!”
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows: “So the monsters are no threat to you?”
Felix laughed, “They are not no threat. After years of war, we have expelled the monsters into the dark area outside the peace circle. If a single monster intrudes into the Peace Circle, it would be suicide. However, it would be extremely difficult for our army to go deep into the dark area to catch all the monsters or drive them further away! There are too many monsters gathered there. Although our weapons are powerful but our resources are limited. Excessive fighting will deplete our weapons. I heard from my father that there is a military expert who analyzed that all the weapons in the federation have been used up and all the resources have been mined. We can only eliminate one third of the monsters in the first continent!”
“So as long as the monsters don’t intrude into our peace circle, we will not launch a large-scale attack. After all, there are still demons outside. With our creativity and wisdom, sooner or later we will be able to develop a brand new energy source. In the next few hundred years, we may be able to capture all the monsters and take back Earth. Our Home!”
“Hundreds of years…”Dudian murmured. He stopped and looked up. The street was brightly lit and the night sky was hazy. Although there were no clouds and mist but there were no stars and Moon. It didn’t look like the Empire’s night sky was dotted with stars, it was pure and eye-catching.
He shook his head and turned off the communicator. He walked along the street.
The street was the same as before. It was like the world in his memory but it didn’t give him any familiar warm feeling. It was as if he had just woken up from the freezer. There was only loneliness and loneliness in the foreign land.

chapters.title: Chapter 1104
chapters.content:
Chapter 1104 – Chapter 1993: Scapegoat
The next day, a package was delivered to Dudian’s company.
It was a three-dimensional metal box that looked like a refrigerator. Dudian used his X-ray vision to scan the box and saw that it was locked by a blonde male zombie.
“Is it Mr. Qin Mo?”The one who delivered the zombie was a handsome robot. The logo of a transport group was engraved on its chest. It seemed to be an ordinary transport robot. However, Dudian knew that.., it should be a special robot used by the black net. After all, the black net members didn’t want to expose their important secrets, it was impossible for the black net to let ordinary group companies participate in it.
“It’s me.”Dudian went forward to sign for it.
The robot scanned the identity information in Dudian’s communication device. After confirming it it put the item in front of the door of the company. It was very friendly: “Mr. Qin, do you need me to open it for you?”
“Yes.”Dudian nodded. The company didn’t have a robot yet. If he carried the Big Guy to the company he would scare Ma Jing and the other two to death.
The handsome robot immediately moved the metal cabinet that stored the undeads. It followed Dudian into the company. They came to Dudian’s exclusive office and put the things down.
“Mr. Qin, do you have any instructions?”The robot smiled.
“No, thank you.”Dudian sent the robot away. He looked at the undeads in the metal cabinet. From the bone density and the degree of body mutation, it was only at the level of a primary hunter, most of the body still retained the appearance of a human. However, the decay and dryness were not serious. Although it was not made by the federation, but it did not seem to be mutated undeads from the Cataclysm 300 years ago, it was possible that some of the travelers from the federation were infected.
“There is a sponge inside. It absorbs sound and isolates all smells, including the air…”
Although the undeads were not trained but they were very quiet. Most of the time it was because of the metal box that isolated the outside world. Even when it was moving it was very honest.
“It is not convenient to study this thing in the company. It seems that we have to find another nest…”Dudian heard Ma Jing and the other two whispering to each other about making regenerative medicine outside the office. Although the sound insulation material in the office was very good, but it was useless in front of his ultrasonic hearing. If the undead cried and howled during the experiment, most likely Ma Jing and the others would notice the strange sound.
Dudian didn’t hurry to open the metal cabinet. He jumped onto the sofa and turned on the communication device to find a suitable house. He searched for half an hour, he finally found an abandoned graphene battery factory in the suburbs. The annual rent was 350,000 yuan. It had a large area of over 1,000 square meters.
