Moreover, it didn’t include the green space and parking area.
Dudian didn’t go to investigate. He looked at the screen for a moment and felt that it was suitable.
It had to be said that many things in the federation were very convenient.
Dudian went to the used car market and spent 30,000 yuan to buy a small van. After he picked up the van, he drove to the company and asked the robot security guards to help carry the metal box to the car, then he drove it to the abandoned battery factory.
The battery factory was heavily polluted. The nearby drains were full of black mucus and unidentified substances. Dudian took the opportunity to tour the factory. Other than the poor environment, everything else was fine. It was quiet, there were few people in the vicinity. The nearest commercial street was about ten minutes’drive away. There were few pedestrians on the road outside the factory.
Dudian put the metal box away and drove back to the company. He bought the equipment that was specially used to study the UNDEADS.
After a few rounds of driving, his driving skills were completely proficient. The federal cars and road signs were very different from the old era. Fortunately, he could use the communicator to share knowledge. There was a teaching video inside, with his control and reaction ability, in addition to his near photographic memory, he could learn it after two rounds of tutorials.
“The latest progress of the demon attack…”
After dragging the equipment to the factory, Dudian looked at the most popular news in Mobei city. Although he was busy with the company in the past two days, he was always paying attention to the matter of Lucien, the news was good news. The official announced that several of the Devil’s accomplices had been captured!
Dudian’s mouth twitched as he saw the word “Accomplice”. He looked at the picture and saw a pockmarked young man. There was a trace of malice in his dull eyes, this was the first accomplice who had been captured. His life and identity as well as the place and address where he used to work were listed. In addition it was mentioned that this man was a member of Pantheon.
Next was the second picture. It was a middle-aged man with a clean beard. His appearance was ordinary. There was a mole at the corner of his mouth. He was wearing a blue and white striped shirt. It was very simple. There was a lot of information about him listed below.
Dudian looked down. There were four people who had been captured. They were called the accomplices of the demons. In addition there was a video showing the attack of the demons. The first person in the picture was in the shopping mall where Lucien had rushed into, the video was the surveillance of the mall. It showed that the man didn’t rush out of the crowd but ran back as if he was going to rush back to the mall.
There were experts who said that he was going to rush back to save his accomplices.
Dudian’s eyes focused as he looked through the communicator. He saw his own wrist instead of the internal structure of the person in the video. He was startled for a moment before he reacted, his vision wasn’t able to see through the screen. Even the thermal vision was useless. He thought for a moment and enlarged the screen. He carefully looked at the screen and slowly played every frame in his eyes.
“His expression…”Dudian noticed that the person’s expression was very anxious. There was even some fear. But his body was being pushed out of the exit by the crowd. His expression was very realistic and didn’t look like a disguise, it was clear that he was really anxious. Under such circumstances, the strength he displayed was insignificant. It was still within the range of an ordinary person’s strength.
“Could it be that he is just an ordinary person?”Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of seriousness.
He looked at the “Evidence”of the other three people. Two of them were also in the mall and made suspicious moves. One of them shouted loudly while the other’s arms were bulging, the other one was kneeling on the ground and kowtowing as if he was a madman.
“Lucian’s appearance in the mall was an accident. There can’t be four demons in the vicinity of this small mall! Even if other forces secretly trained him, it’s impossible for him to be released without supervision.”Dudian suddenly thought of something, he immediately contacted Felix.
“Have you seen the news about Mobei City?”Dudian coldly asked.
“Wait a moment.”Felix said. He spoke to the others through the communicator, he said to dudian: “I have seen the news about Mobei city. There are so many eyes in the federation. But fortunately, they didn’t find you. It seems you are safe.”
Dudian knew that he was safe when he saw the four “Devil’s accomplices”. He was a bit surprised that the other side didn’t find out about him. But he wouldn’t take the initiative to provoke them, he asked: “The four Devil’s accomplices that they caught should be scapegoats right?”
Felix was surprised: “How do you know?”
“Nonsense, how can there be so many demons in the vicinity of a small shopping mall? According to the ratio, the number of demons in the whole of Mobei city would be as many as the hairs on an ox’s back!”Dudian said.
Felix nodded: “You are right. These four unlucky fellows are just cannon fodder. You can carefully look at their resumes and find the problem. I guess there will be targeted reports in the news tonight.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1105
chapters.content:
Chapter 1105 – Chapter 194Th: Infighting
Dudian’s eyes quickly glanced at the resumes of the four people. He saw that three of the four “Devil’s accomplices”had one thing in common, they believed in “Pantheon”.
“What is this pantheon?”Dudian asked Felix.
Felix was surprised: “You know about it so soon?”? It’s a long story. Pantheon is the largest religion in the federation. Its believers are spread across all levels of society. There are several members of the board of Directors in our Rockefeller Consortium. They are all believers of Pantheon!”
“Religion?”Dudian frowned as he thought of the holy church in Sylvia. It seemed that religious beliefs could take root in any form of society. It didn’t matter if it was backward or advanced. Was it because.., human beings needed to believe in order to survive?
“The attack of the demons in Mobei city has caused a sensation. They didn’t look for you to interrogate. I think they want to use this incident to make an example of you. The existence of you isn’t important. They want to attack the Pantheon Church. This is something that the past presidents of the federation have always wanted to do. When the belief is high to a certain extent, it is the right!”Felix said: “Pantheon Church has crossed the line!”
There was a trace of realization in Dudian’s eyes. No wonder he wasn’t taken as a suspect and interrogated. He didn’t expect that there would be so much internal strife in the federation, he thought for a moment and said: “From your tone, you don’t seem to be a believer of Pantheon.”
Felix proudly smiled, “Of course. I don’t believe in Gods and ghosts. If there is a God then why do you devils exist? Don’t tell me that God can’t destroy the Devil? If so, how can you be called a God?”
“It seems that your awareness is quite high.”Dudian said.
Felix smiled: “If I didn’t have this awareness then I wouldn’t have the position I have today. This time I have captured several believers of pantheon. I think I will take the opportunity to fight with pantheon. We will take this opportunity to secretly make a fortune. How Is Your Company?”? “Is the capital enough?”
Dudian heard a trace of ridicule in Felix’s voice. He guessed that he had only given him one million yuan. He guessed that the money would be used up soon and he would have to ask for it, he said: “The capital is enough. When the company opens, there will be a large amount of money in the account. Don’t talk about this for now. Find the information about Pantheon and send it to me later.”
Felix was a bit surprised. He secretly laughed. He wanted to see how long the company could last.
Dudian checked the news in the evening. He found that the news had shifted from four devil’s accomplices to pantheon. However he didn’t directly say that the followers of pantheon were Devil’s accomplices, it was said that there were Devil’s accomplices who liked to pretend to be the followers of pantheon. The federal government didn’t want to completely fall out with pantheon so they took the opportunity to smear the name of Pantheon.
The core concept of pantheon was deeply rooted in the hearts of every citizen of the Federation. It was stressed that all things had a spirit and all things would give birth to a god. It was the same for pots and pans. There was a pot god, a bowl god.., there was a road God, an earth God and so on.
It was almost impossible for the federal government to overturn this concept. After all, many high-level government officials also believed that all things had a god. So they cleverly chose to beat around the bush — there was no problem with pantheon, but the followers of Pantheon were dirty places!
“What a good framing!”Dudian sighed in his heart. This group of people were good at playing politics but they were better at scheming people. They had taken the initiative this time, it was enough to deal a painful blow to the pantheon. However he was inexplicable as he had given them a knife to kill each other.
“If the seven kings of the empire sneaked in and caused trouble here then I don’t think they would need a single soldier to make the Federation fall apart.”Dudian shook his head, there were some feelings of regret and disappointment.
He didn’t pay attention to it. The next thing he knew was the public relations counter-attack of the Pantheon. The news would become lively in a short period of time but it had nothing to do with him.
Dudian went to a dilapidated office in the factory. It had been transformed into a simple laboratory. Although the house was simple but the equipment inside were expensive and high-end, dudian released the golden-haired undeads from the metal box. The undeads’hands and feet were locked by the chains that were connected to the box. They growled at Dudian.
Dudian didn’t react to its hideous body and face. He took out a small scalpel and cut off a piece of rotten flesh from its body. He used the instrument to test its composition and genes.
Soon, the genes in the flesh and blood of the undeads were found to be very different from human genes. They didn’t have the ability to divide cells. It was no wonder that the wounds of the undeads couldn’t heal and recover.
However, although they couldn’t divide, they could transform into other forms when they were stimulated by external forces.
Dudian felt that a new door was opened in front of him. He was completely immersed in the experiment.
In the blink of an eye, the company was established on the seventh day. Dudian estimated that the production of the regenerative medicine should be almost done. He drove to the company early in the morning. He found Ma Jing and the other two sleeping on their desks, it was eight days in the morning. It seemed that they had spent the night in the company.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. His eyes quickly fell on an instrument in the regenerative medicine laboratory. There were three small bottles placed in front of the instrument, it seemed to be regenerative medicine.
Dudian didn’t suppress his footsteps. He walked into the company. Ma Jing and the other two who were sleeping on the desk were woken up. They were surprised to see Dudian, ma Jing’s sleepiness was swept away. She stood up and excitedly said to dudian: “Boss, we succeeded. Six days! We only used six days to make it!”
“We made three bottles?”Dudian asked.
“How do you know?”Ma Jing was stunned but didn’t think about it. She excitedly said: “Yes, I will show you now. The effect of this regenerative medicine is too strong. When the finished product is made, it will definitely cause a sensation!”
Dudian saw that she ran into the laboratory and took out three small bottles. They were the three that he saw. He asked: “How is the experimental effect?”
“This is the most perfect regenerative medicine so far. It can even be said to be a finished product. But it hasn’t been tested by human. But the effect is amazing. It can help it regenerate more than 50% of the cells in the body. I think it can be achieved in humans as long as the dosage is suitable.”Ma Jing handed the three vials to Dudian, with a face full of excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 1106
chapters.content:
Chapter 1106 – Chapter 1995: Drug Trial
Dudian looked at the three bottles in his hand: “In other words, as long as these three bottles are successfully tested on the human body, they will be able to be marketed.”
Ma jing nodded: “Although it is the most troublesome and difficult part of the drug trial, but we are confident!”
“In that case, I will recruit a few people to test the drug. You should prepare the contract for the trial.”Dudian explained. In fact, even if there was no trial.., he knew that there wouldn’t be any big problems with the regenerative medicine. As long as they strictly followed the formula he had given them, they would be 100% successful. Ma Jing and the other two were the elites that he had recruited, they had participated in the research and development of many medicines. The possibility of making medicines according to the formula was very small. Therefore, the three bottles of regenerative medicine in their hands were basically equivalent to the finished product!
However, there were rules in the federal pharmaceutical industry. They had to go through human testing and verification in order to pass and become a legal drug!
Dudian came to his office. He used the communicator to skillfully open several recruitment websites. In order to save time, the salary was higher. Each time was 10,000. According to the number of times.., most of the trial-takers were long-term. From the first trial of drug research to the final product. If they were lucky, they might end up trying three or four times. If they were unlucky, they might try more than ten times, they might even lose their lives.
This also led to the high salary of the trial-takers. Generally it was around 80,000 to 20,000 yuan. In comparison, Dudian’s remuneration was not bad.
After the recruitment was sent out, Dudian contacted the customer service of the website. He transferred 20000 Yuan and asked them to help him put the recruitment on the recommendation page. Half an hour later, someone contacted him.
“I, I want to apply for your testers.”There was a stuttering and timid voice on the other side of the phone. However, the voice of a middle-aged man seemed to be speaking.
Dudian asked: “Have you read the recruitment notice? Is it in accordance with our conditions?”
“Yes, yes.”The man quickly replied.
Dudian said: “Come to our company tomorrow.”
“Good, good. Excuse me, is it true that the remuneration is paid on the same day?”The man carefully asked.
Dudian said: “It is true. Come to test the drug tomorrow and pay the money tomorrow.”
“Really? Great! Thank you, thank you!”The man was a bit excited.
Dudian didn’t say anything more. He hung up the phone and sighed. Although he didn’t see the man but he could feel that the man was a low-level civilian who was forced by life. After all, the drug tester was a dangerous profession. It couldn’t even be called a profession. It was often because of a lack of money or an infection or lack of money to treat, it was likely that the temporary emergency would be alleviated. However, he would be tormented by the pain caused by the drug test for the rest of his life. He might even commit suicide!
After a while, Dudian’s communication device rang again. It was another job seeker.
Dudian frowned slightly. He felt that he needed a secretary. It would take too much time to open a company. He didn’t want to spend all his energy on it.
Soon, he posted a recruitment notice for a secretary on the website. This time he didn’t give the website any money. A secretary was a popular profession. It was better to add the money to the salary of a secretary.
The next day.
Dudian took Ma Jing and the other two to receive the tester in the company. There were seventeen people who called him yesterday. After ten o’clock in the evening, the recommendation of the website was removed from the shelves. No one continued to call him to ask for a job.
General drug regulations required more than three testers to pass the examination. He only kept the first three but rejected the others. After all, this was a finished product in his eyes, the price was expensive. Not only did he give them expensive drugs but he also gave them money. Such a good thing might not happen in the entire federation.
“Let me see your injuries.”Dudian and Ma Jing sat on one side of the office. The other three job seekers sat on the other side. Two of them looked uneasy while the other middle-aged man looked calm, dudian found that the middle-aged man’s temperament was a bit tough. He was different from ordinary people. He had a kind of military spirit but also a bit of noble spirit.
Such a character should not be for money.
Dudian had observed the three’s bodies when they arrived. At this moment he was just going through the process so that Ma Jing and the other two wouldn’t be suspicious.
“This, this is my injury.”The middle-aged man on the left was nervous. He raised his left hand. There was a finger missing and bandage. There was blood inside. Even Ma Jing and the other two could see that.., this was an injury that he had just received yesterday.
“This finger of yours was broken yesterday?”Ma Jing could not help but ask.
The middle-aged man was a little nervous and uneasy. He said, “It was accidentally broken while I was working yesterday morning. I heard that you guys are researching regenerative medicine. I should be agreeing with your recruitment request, right?”
Ma Jing came to a realization. She smiled and said, “In that case, your luck is really good. There are basically no defects in our medicine. If nothing goes wrong, this finger of yours can grow back. Moreover, you can also get a trial fee of 10,000 yuan.”
The middle-aged man’s eyes lit up when he heard the word “Ten thousand”. His heart beat faster.
Dudian saw that his finger was broken at night. It was broken not long after the end of the phone call. The purpose was probably to get ten thousand yuan.
Ten thousand for a finger. It should be a good deal for him.
The middle-aged man with thick eyebrows and big eyes, who was sitting in the middle, glanced at the person on the left. There was a hint of mockery in his eyes, but he didn’t say anything. Instead, he lifted his shirt and took it off, revealing his strong chest, however, there were a few deep scars on his chest. Under the scars, there was a dent in his abdomen. There was actually a lump of flesh missing.
“It’s easy to say whether it’s money or not. Can your regeneration medicine cure my wound? It has already formed a scar.”The middle-aged man said.
Ma Jing and the other two looked at his body. They were scared and screamed.
“No problem.”Dudian calmly said.
The middle-aged man looked at him: “Are you the Boss? What’s Your Name?”
Dudian frowned: “You are here to test the medicine, not the boss.”
The middle-aged man was stunned: “Well said. I hope your medicine is useful. Otherwise, I will be very disappointed.”
Ma Jing and the other two could see that this man’s identity was not ordinary. However, his tone was a bit uncomfortable, ma Jing curled her lips: “Our medicine is certainly useful. You are taking advantage of us. Otherwise, when our medicine is on the market, you may not be able to afford it!”
The tough middle-aged man laughed and said, “I hope your medicine is as sharp as your mouth.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1107
chapters.content:
Chapter 1107 – Chapter 1107: Chapter 1996: Miracle Drug
Ma Jing was so angry that she wanted to hit the table. But she suddenly remembered that Dudian was next to her. She suppressed her anger and checked the identity of the last tester. Then she took them to the laboratory for a physical examination, the three of them agreed with the requirements of the Tester: Healthy Body, no other diseases and body defects.
“This is the regenerative medicine. Now I will inject it in sequence.”Ma Jing took out three tubes of the regenerative medicine. Dudian was watching from the side. Her expression was a bit serious and nervous. She took a deep breath and took out three syringes, she inhaled the regenerative medicine into the syringes in sequence. Then she came to the front of the first cowardly middle-aged man and said: “Relax Your Body, don’t be nervous.”
“I… I’m not nervous,”the middle-aged man stammered. His face turned red after he said that.
Ma Jing was speechless in her heart, but she was too lazy to persuade him. She injected the regenerative medicine into his arm.
For a moment, everyone’s eyes were on the middle-aged man.
Ma Jing did not continue to inject the second person. If the first person failed, then there was no need to continue to inject the medicine to harm others.
“How do you feel?”After waiting for two minutes, Ma Jing and the middle-aged man stared at each other and finally could not help but ask.
The middle-aged man scratched his head and said, “It seems that my body is a little hot.”
“Don’t you feel uncomfortable?”Ma Jing asked.
“No.”The middle-aged man’s expression immediately became nervous.
Ma Jing immediately gave the other two a look. They went forward to take the middle-aged man’s blood and took it to the side for testing.
Just as they were about to go for the test, the middle-aged man suddenly cried out in surprise, “It’s so Itchy!”With that said, he hurriedly tore off the wound on his severed finger. The wound was indeed very new and had not yet healed. The sticky gauze tore open the blood skin, a large amount of blood flowed out again.
However, the middle-aged man did not seem to feel any pain and wanted to stretch out his hand to scratch.
Ma Jing was shocked and quickly grabbed his hand. “Don’t move, it’ll get infected.”
“But it’s Itchy!”The middle-aged man was a little impatient.
Ma Jing stared at him sternly. “Even if it’s itchy to death, you have to endure it!”
The middle-aged man’s face was pale. He gritted his teeth. In less than half a minute, the blood on his finger suddenly stopped. Then, under everyone’s shocked gaze, the scar on the broken finger slowly protruded and grew at a speed visible to the naked eye, four to five minutes later, a pink finger gradually took shape. During this process, the laboratory was silent. No one knew who suddenly let out a burst of cold sound and broke the silence.
“It can actually regenerate!”
“The effect of the drug is too, too strong!”
“We… succeeded!”
Ma Jing and the other two looked at this scene in a daze. The effect of the drug was beyond their expectations. Although they had seen similar scenes in mice, but after all, they were mice. Who would have thought that it would be used on humans, the effect was so terrifying!
Dudian was secretly relieved as he saw the scene. Although he was full of confidence but after all it hadn’t been verified.
“How is it? Can you feel your fingers? Can you move them?”Ma Jing quickly reacted after the shock. Her eyes were full of fanaticism as she stared at the middle-aged man, it seemed that she wanted to take out all the feelings and thoughts in his mind.
It was the first time that the middle-aged man was looked at by a woman with such fanaticism. He suddenly felt nervous and inexplicable restlessness. His heart beat faster. He muttered: “It’s a bit itchy. But… I can move it.”He bent his finger, it felt no different from the previous finger. Moreover, the touch of this finger was more sensitive. It could feel the weak airflow and temperature in the air.
Ma Jing looked at him as he moved his finger. She looked up at dudian: “Boss, we have succeeded! We have created a regenerative medicine. We will change the entire Federal Pharmaceutical Industry!”
Dudian was very calm. He knew that she was a bit excited: “Let’s test the other two first. Only one has succeeded. Don’t be happy too early.”
Ma Jing came back to her senses and nodded. She wanted to say that even if the other two failed, as long as one of them succeeded, it would be enough to prove that the regenerative medicine was feasible. It was just that they lacked time to continue to perfect it.
“It really works!”The eyes of the middle-aged man slightly shrank as he saw this scene. There was a trace of heat in his eyes. When Ma Jing picked up the syringe and came in front of him, he couldn’t wait to raise his arm.
Ma Jing was a little displeased with him. Seeing this, she snorted lightly, but still injected him seriously.
The tough middle-aged man lowered his head to look at the scar on his chest and the missing pit. His eyes were both excited and nervous. Although the others had succeeded, his injury had been too long. It had already formed a scar. Who knew if it would regenerate? Moreover, everyone’s constitution was different. This was also the reason why it was required for more than three test-takers to pass before they could be approved for listing.
Five minutes later, Ma Jing saw that his body had not changed. Her expression changed slightly and she asked nervously, “Why? Do you feel anything?”
The stout middle-aged man’s expression was slightly unsightly. He said, “I feel that my entire body is heating up. The wound is a little itchy.”
Ma jing sighed in relief: “It should be effective soon. You have a lot of injuries and it will take a while.”
The hard middle-aged man secretly prayed in his heart.
After another two or three minutes, the hard middle-aged man suddenly clenched his teeth and growled.
Ma Jing was startled and stepped back: “What Happened to you?”
“It’s Itchy!”The middle-aged man growled.
Dudian stepped forward. He didn’t know when but there was a scalpel in his hand. He quickly cut the scar on the middle-aged man’s body. Blood flowed out from the scar but soon stopped, the scar healed quickly. The blood stained the scar and it seemed to wither. Soon, fresh flesh grew out from the scar.
In addition, the pit on the sturdy middle-aged man’s abdomen was slowly filled up. Not long after, pink flesh grew out.
“Success, success!”The sturdy middle-aged man widened his eyes and was so excited that his body trembled.
Ma Jing and the other two heaved a sigh of relief and could not help but cheer.
After the sturdy middle-aged man’s body had completely recovered, Ma Jing injected the third person again. Soon, the medicine took effect again. The third person’s severed arm grew out. The entire process took about half an hour, and just as the arm grew out.., the man cried out that he was so hungry, and then he fainted.
“We succeeded!”When the three of them had all taken effect, Ma Jing and the other two could no longer hold it in. They hugged each other excitedly. As medical professionals, they naturally knew what regenerative medicine meant.., the scale of the market was terrifying!
It could be said that they had created a divine medicine that would definitely be recorded in the medical history books!

chapters.title: Chapter 1108
chapters.content:
Chapter 1108: Chapter 1997: General
Translator: 549690339
Dudian’s reaction was very calm as Ma Jing and the other two cheered. He knew that the real difficult thing had just come. Although he had created the regenerative medicine but it was still unknown whether it would belong to him.
“It has been regenerated.”The strong middle-aged man sighed. He gently touched the tender flesh of his abdomen. The feeling was so clear and delicate that he could even feel the rough fingerprints, he was surprised by the miraculous drug. He thought of something and looked at the calm Dudian.
“Boss, you don’t seem to have any surprises?”The tough middle-aged man was curious. He didn’t look down on this young man. He knew that the person who could create such a drug would shock the entire federation.
Ma Jing and the other two were surprised to see that Dudian didn’t look too excited. The surprise in their hearts faded a bit as they calmed down.
“There is nothing to be surprised about. It is within our expectations.”Dudian casually said, “Since the trial has been completed, I will transfer the reward to your account. Please go back. In the future if there is any need for the drug audit, I may contact you again. I hope you can help me.”
The timid middle-aged man and the third youth nodded repeatedly. They left after saying some words of thanks.
“You are not leaving?”Dudian looked at the indifferent middle-aged man and frowned.
“Very few people will chase me away.”The middle-aged man smiled: “My Name Is Yao Jie. I’m lucky to have met you. May I know the name of the Boss?”
“My name is Qin Mo.”Dudian said. He looked at the man and felt that his name was familiar. Soon he remembered that the name had been mentioned in the news about the attack on Mobei city, he was a famous general of the federation. However he didn’t know the details and there was no photo posted on the news.
“Qin Mo?”Yao Jie nodded: “Mr. Qin has cured my body. I Can’t repay you for this favor. If Mr. Qin encounters any trouble in the future, you can look for me. I will send you my communication signal later.”
Dudian directly said: “I have seen your name in the news about the recent attack of the demon race. It seems that you are a general. I see that your temperament is meticulous. Your sitting posture and standing posture are straight. It is obvious that you are a soldier. Are you that general?”
Ma Jing and the other two were startled when they heard this. They looked at Yao Jie in astonishment. This man was actually a general? ! An army general was sitting in front of them? !
Yao Jie shook his head and smiled: “I didn’t expect that Mr. Qin would recognize me. I would like to formally introduce Mr. Qin, Yao Jie, from the 3rd Division of the Federal Fighting Department.”
“Hello.”Dudian nodded. He was a bit speechless. He thought that if you are low-key then why did you expose your name.
Ma Jing and the other two couldn’t help but open their mouths. They didn’t think that such a big shot would appear in front of them. Ma Jing reacted the fastest, “General Yao, I have offended you before. Please forgive me. I was blind…”
Yao Jie waved his hand: “You don’t have to mind. Moreover you have contributed to the treatment of my injury. I have to thank you.”
Ma Jing heaved a sigh of relief when she saw that he really didn’t seem to mind, she hurriedly said, “General Yao, what are you saying? It’s our good fortune to be able to help you. General Yao, your injuries should be caused by monsters, right?”? “I heard that the Fighting Machine Division is mainly responsible for suppressing the foreign threats hidden in the cities. For example, monsters infiltrating the cities or the attack of the demons this time, it’s all up to your fighting machine division to take care of it. I heard that everyone in your fighting machine division has Beyonder powers. Is it true that you can fight against ten by yourself?”
Yao Jie heard her flattering words and smiled: “It is not as exaggerated as the rumors. It is not difficult to fight against ten people by yourself.”
Dudian was a bit surprised. He could see that Yao Jie’s physique was that of a strong ordinary person. He was able to fight against ten people by himself. Could it be that he had superb fighting skills?
Yao Jie didn’t pay attention to Ma Jing and the other two. He turned to look at Dudian. He found that the youth’s expression was still calm. He couldn’t help but smile, “Mr. Qin, you should have just graduated not long ago. You are so young but you are able to develop the miracle of ‘Regenerative Medicine’. The younger generation is really awesome!”
Dudian shook his head: “I haven’t graduated yet. I’m currently starting a business in school.”
“That’s even more amazing!”Yao Jie praised.
It was the first time that Ma Jing and the other two knew about Dudian’s matter. They couldn’t help but look at him in astonishment. was he starting a business in school? The Big Boss that they followed was actually a student? ! Thinking of this, the three of them felt speechless and embarrassed. They had been in the Society for so many years, but in the end, they were working for a student. All these years were wasted!
“Mr. Qin, I have to remind you.”After Yao Jie finished praising them, his smile suddenly disappeared, he said seriously, “Once this regenerative medicine of yours is released, it will definitely cause a huge earthquake in the medical world. Although it is a little cruel, I have to tell you that at that time, there may be many people who want to buy the manufacturing rights of this medicine from you, or even forcibly seize it. Moreover, it is very likely that they will encounter trouble during the approval process.”
Hearing his words, Ma Jing and the other two were stunned. Their faces turned ugly. They were old shrews in the society. They immediately thought of the stakes involved.
Dudian’s face showed surprise, confusion, and finally frowned.
Yao Jie comforted him: “I will help you with the audit. They won’t make things difficult for you.”
“How difficult?”Dudian asked.
Yao Jie smiled. He was still too young, “The review materials you submitted are enough to expose the importance of this regenerative medicine. It is very likely to arouse the greed of some people so that your review will not pass! Even if you provide all the perfect review materials, as long as the other party wants to find fault with you, they will find it. They can delay the time of your review while quickly copying the information and developing the same batch of regenerative medicine. Then they will announce the birth of the medicine. At that time, they will be the rightful owner. In turn, they will be able to sue you for theft. Moreover, plagiarizing research technology is a felony in the federation. You will be imprisoned for at least ten years.”
Ma Jing and the other two couldn’t help but shiver when they heard these words. One person was basically ruined after ten years in prison.
Dudian was like a hothead who had just come out of the society. His face was full of anger, he asked: “If you say so, wouldn’t the same thing happen to the other drugs? If so, who would dare to research such an excellent drug?”
Yao Jie shook his head, “Ordinary drugs are naturally not worth the risk of others. But the value of your drug is too high. There will be people who are willing to take risks. This is not the first time such a thing has happened. You have seen many famous drugs on the market. How many bloody wars have happened behind the scenes? Moreover, it is difficult for the federation to deal with this kind of thing. Unless you are a large group or have a deep background, it is not difficult for a small company like you to take away your achievements.”
Dudian angrily said: “Does the Federation Not Care? The result of this will only stifle geniuses and good drugs!”
“This is the result of the general environment. There is no way to change it. It is not something that one or two people can change.”Yao Jie slightly shook his head. He had seen too many such things and was used to it. If it was not because of Dudian’s medicine that cured his injury.., he was too lazy to remind him.
Dudian was silent. He didn’t act at this moment. He was silent for a long time before he said: “I know. Thank you general Yao. The audit department should not make things difficult for us.”
Yao Jie nodded slightly, “But this is only the first stage. I think there will be a large group to buy your company soon. If you don’t want to take risks then you can sell the company. If you want to struggle then you can look for me. I will return the favor of your treatment.”
“I will consider it.”Dudian said.
Yao Jie looked at him with regret in his eyes. The environment of the federation was like this. Killing Geniuses was the most comfortable life in the world. On the contrary, it was the mediocrity. How ironic!

chapters.title: Chapter 1109
chapters.content:
Chapter 1109 – Chapter 1998: Momentum
Yao Jie didn’t stay for long. He left the company after a few words with Dudian.
Dudian sent Yao Jie to the entrance of the company. He saw him get into an ordinary taxi and leave. His eyes flashed. He hesitated for a moment but gave up on tracking.
“Is the general in charge of the arrest of the demon’s attack here to probe or is it a pure accident?”Dudian frowned. If the latter was deliberately probing then he would expose himself by tracking the past.
Moreover, he couldn’t figure out the real reason why Yao Jie was here. He was a general of the federation so his identity was very noble. He would anonymously come over to be a drug tester. If there was a problem with his drug then he would be poisoned to death, the general’s reputation would be ruined and he might even die a funny death.
Moreover, with his identity, if he really wanted to see a doctor and treat him then he would have to tell a small company like him to send the drug over. Why would he need to personally come over?
But if it was not to test the medicine, why would he take the risk to take the medicine to test himself? If he was suspected, he could directly arrest him and interrogate him.
These two contradictions made Dudian unable to understand, but he felt that there must be something that he had overlooked. After thinking carefully for a long time, Dudian suddenly thought of a possibility. Yao Jie’s abdomen was not just missing a piece of meat, but even the internal organs under the piece of meat were missing. This led to a big hidden danger in his body. He would become thinner and weaker day by day.
Perhaps, not many people knew about this hidden danger!
Yao Jie didn’t want others to know, so he didn’t send people to pick up the medicine from him. He secretly came over. Although there was a risk of death in trying the medicine, but it was only a small number. The latter obviously chose to take a risk, he didn’t know whether to call it crazy or rational.
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that it was so. As for why the latter told his name and exposed his identity, maybe it was because his body had been cured. He didn’t care about being exposed. Even if his enemy knew.., he couldn’t target it anymore.
“It seems that as a general, it is not easy to get by.”Dudian thought. He suddenly regretted not chasing after the general. If the latter secretly came over, he wouldn’t alert the military to monitor the situation, he would be able to find out the address of the general. If he could find out the address of his family then it would be easier. He would have a trump card in his hand.
The identities of these generals were confidential as they were high-level members of the Federation. They were protected. Even Felix who was a young master of a big consortium didn’t have the right to know.
Although it was a pity but Dudian didn’t continue to be upset. He knew that he would continue to lose his time. It was the basic reason of a wise man to stop the loss in time. He turned back to the company and went back to the office, ma Jing and the other two knocked on the door and ran in. They were worried: “Boss, what General Yao said might happen. What should we do?”
Dudian said: “This is not something you should consider. I hired you to help me manufacture drugs, not to let you operate products. Do you want to earn extra money from me? I Won’t give you a salary increase.”
Ma Jing and the other two were stunned. They didn’t think that Dudian would be in the mood to joke. Ma jing bitterly smiled: “Boss, we are just worried about the situation of the company. The company is our home…”
Dudian waved his hand, “Don’t think of the company as your home. Home is your home. There is only one place for you to work. It is the best if you feel comfortable and can make money. The environment is bad so you have to endure it. I will recruit people to promote our drug. We should release the news as soon as possible. If you want to snatch it then you have to be willing to take it.”
Ma Jing and the other two had strange expressions on their faces. It was the first time they had seen such a boss. However they thought about it carefully. There was no reason for them to be anxious. There was no way to solve the problem.
Dudian sent out the recruitment notice after the three of them were sent away. He suddenly felt that if Barton and Neuss were by his side then he would be able to trust them and help him, the recruits would be poached at any time and the company’s secrets would be leaked. But he couldn’t slowly cultivate the loyalty of the staff. In the peaceful environment of the Federation where the rule of law was maintained, even the military would find it difficult to maintain loyalty, let alone an ordinary person? They were driven by interests. They were working for money and not for him.
“It is not difficult for me to sneak out of the federation with my current identity. I can get Felix to help me if I want to come back. If I want to go over the god of war’s wall then I can go through the clouds. The federation has the equipment to isolate the lightning. It is enough to deal with the Thunderbirds that live in the sky above the god of war’s wall. It will take at least half a month to go back and forth. Moreover Neuss and Barton have come over. They have to adapt to the environment of the Federation and learn about this world.”Dudian thought for a moment, he felt that calling them over wouldn’t solve the urgent problem. He had to wait until the situation was stable before making a long-term plan.
Even if he didn’t advertise the regeneration medicine, it would reach the ears of some big figures in a few days. He had to let everyone know that it was his.
“I can only promote and market it. Let the civilians of the federation know that I did it. I need a lot of advertising but the advertising fee is not low…”Dudian’s eyes lit up.
Some of the advertisements on hot TV and news were calculated by millions. He only had a few hundred thousand in his hand.
“I can only try low-cost marketing. If the popularity is not enough then I can borrow from Felix. Although he can at most take out tens of millions of savings. But as the president of HAWSK company he can use the name of the company to mobilize a lot of funds. But if he is found out then he will be unlucky. But once the reputation of the regenerative medicine is established then the order will be in short supply and the funds will be withdrawn quickly…”Dudian’s mind quickly turned, he thought about all kinds of things and decided to try low-cost marketing.
Soon, he wrote a few marketing documents and was ready to hand them over to the operations department.
Because he paid money to buy ads for the website, the recruitment was scrolling on the front page. Soon, people began to call over. Dudian asked them to come over for an interview.
There was a secretary recruitment on the way. Dudian asked a few questions and felt that the general conditions were in agreement.
In the evening, the communicator rang again. Dudian thought that it was another job seeker’s call but heard a gentle voice: “Is it boss Qin?”
Dudian was surprised: “You are?”
“I’m Song Jin. You said that the regenerative medicine would be sold in seven days. Can you buy it now?”The person in the communicator asked in a gentle tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1110
chapters.content:
Chapter 1110 – : Chapter 1999: Scatter
“Yes.”Dudian asked: “How much do you need?”
Song Jin was relieved: “I’ll have one first.”
“Alright, the items are valuable. Come and get them yourself.”Dudian said.
“Alright.”Song Jin agreed.
Not long after they hung up the communicator, two people who had signed a VIP contract with Dudian came over. Dudian told them to come over tomorrow to collect the goods.
The next day.
When Dudian came to the company, there were already many people waiting for him. One of them was the secretary he had hired. She was a twenty-seven or twenty-eight year old beauty. Her name was Zhu Ying. She looked very capable. She was not the kind of capable secretary of a normal company, but she was really capable. It was obvious that she was an efficient person.
Dudian casually looked at her and hired her. Then he handed the recruitment to her.
Zhu Ying didn’t expect her new boss to be so young. She was a bit nervous. No matter how she looked at it she felt that Dudian was like a rich second generation. He just came out to start a business. She had to think of other ways to be a secretary for such a person, she secretly made up her mind. If Dudian was just a playboy then she would take the initiative to resign and leave. Even if the salary of the job was very good.
After handing over the chores to Zhu Ying, Dudian waited for three VIP customers to come over to buy the medicine. He took them to the reception room and let Zhu Ying make three cups of tea and a cup of coffee, because one of them was a brown-haired foreigner.
“Boss Qin, where’s the medicine?”Song Jin asked after drinking a small mouthful of tea.
Dudian called Zhu Ying and asked her to find Ma Jing to get the medicine.
Soon, three portions of the medicine were delivered to Dudian’s hands. Dudian pushed the medicine to the three of them, “This medicine has been sent for approval. It will take two days to pass. It can not be sold on the market for the time being. But if you need it urgently, we can sell it to you now. There is no problem with the medicine. Our testers have already tried it. By the way, one of the testers is general Yao Jie.”
“What?”Song Jin didn’t hear it clearly: “What general?”
“General Yao Jie?”Wang Donglin heard it clearly: “Are you talking about general Yao Jie from the fighting department? !”
Dudian calmly said: “Are there many generals with the same name?”
Song Jin understood and looked at him suspiciously: “How is it possible? General Yao Jie has such a high status. Why would he be a drug tester for you? Even if he wants to test the drug, do you dare to give him a try?”
“No matter how bold I am, I don’t dare to pull a general to make a tiger fur coat. You will know about this matter when you go to investigate. In addition, I have the file of their drug trial. I can show it to you.”Dudian called Zhu Ying, he told her to get the file of the drug tester from the safe. Then he told the whole story of Yao Jie’s drug trial in front of the three people.
At this time, Zhu Ying’s tester file was sent over.
Dudian handed it to the three. Wang Donglin took it first. His eyes opened wide when he saw the name and picture on the file. He couldn’t believe that he was a soldier. He had met Yao Jie several times, he recognized that this person was the noble general Yao Jie. He didn’t think that such a famous person would be a tester for Dudian! Soon, he thought of another question. He asked Dudian: “General Yao, what kind of injury do you need to use your medicine?”
“Isn’t it not good to pry into the general’s Privacy?”Dudian looked at him.
Wang Donglin came to his senses and smiled: “Forget about it. I have bought the medicine. I will transfer the money to you. If it is good, can I order another batch?”
“Yes, just follow the contract.”Dudian indifferently said.
Wang Donglin was relieved. He used the communicator to transfer the money to Dudian. He asked: “How do I use this medicine?”
“This is an injection.”Dudian said. He asked Zhu Ying to send a new syringe to Wang Donglin, “You can use it now. It will take effect immediately. If there is a problem here, I can not go back on my word. They can also be witnesses. Come on.”
Wang Donglin was stunned. Did he think that he was a lab rat? However, what Dean said made sense. Although general Yao Jie was testing the drug, he was still a bit uncertain. After all, it was not approved by the Audit Bureau. He hesitated for a moment and decisively rolled up his sleeves, he injected the drug into it.
“These two fingers of mine were pressed by the stone slab. The situation was urgent so I cut them off. I don’t know if they can grow back.”Wang Donglin looked at his hands and then looked up at dean, “How long will it take for the drug to take effect?”
“Five to ten minutes.”Dudian said.
Wang Donglin, Song Jin and another brown-haired race ‘Martin’were shocked, “So fast?”
Song Jin looked at his watch and began to count. Four minutes later, Wang Donglin shouted. The flesh on his broken fingers was squirming slightly. Then the flesh and bones slowly grew, two pink fingers grew out.
Song Jin and Martin were stunned.
“This… This is a miracle drug…”song Jin was shocked as he muttered to himself.
Dudian accompanied song Jin and Martin to complete the drug injection. Soon, the parts of their bodies were regrown. The three of them felt as if they had been reborn, they were surprised from time to time in the reception room.
After they finished the drug, the three of them immediately looked for Dudian to place an order. Each of them ordered five sets. This was the upper limit of their one-star VIP purchase. The deposit for each set of drug was 50% , which was one million, dudian had received 15 million from the deposit alone. In addition to the money of six million from the three of them, he had 21 million. It was enough to squander in the black market.
“Mr. Qin, I want to raise the VIP level. Is it enough to increase the annual fee?”Wang Donglin deliberately waited for song Jin and Martin to leave.
Dudian looked at him. The former soldier was very cunning, he said: “It can be done with money. But four-star level requires other conditions. I haven’t thought about the specific conditions. I don’t plan to open it for the time being. If you want to raise the annual fee, I can raise it to three-star VIP level.”
“Ten million annual fee? !”Wang Donglin was speechless, although he was a rich man in Mobei City but ten million annual fee was a shocking amount. It was not a comparison of assets but a pure one-year expenditure. Even some of the top clubs.., they didn’t need such a high annual fee.
“The purchase limit for a three-star VIP customer is fifty copies. The pay and return are the same.”Dudian indifferently said.
Wang Donglin’s eyes lit up. He calculated that if he increased the price by thirty percent according to the contract, he could earn eighteen million. In addition to last year’s fee, he could also earn eight million, it was the same as picking up eight million for nothing. If the medicine entered the market, fifty copies would be sold out immediately. He was a bit happy as he thought of this. Eight million was not a small amount. It was worth more than half of his annual income.

chapters.title: Chapter 1111
chapters.content:
Chapter 1111 – Chapter 1100: Contact
Wang Donglin didn’t immediately add ten million annual fee but went back to mobilize the funds. After all, although he had money but a lot of funds were put in the various industries under his name. He needed to let the financial reports of these industries come out.
That day, Dudian’s company recruited several members of the planning department and Advertising Department. Dudian asked Zhu Ying to call them over and then he wrote a few pieces of text planning for them to do.
After reading the copy, several advertising department members were stunned. They didn’t think that advertising could be played like this!
The next day.
The afternoon news in Mobei City had such a piece of news. Two people in a certain square had taken a fancy to the same clothes. They quarreled over it and then it escalated into a scuffle. One of them was pushed down from the second floor of the mall, he broke his arm on the spot. Some people in the crowd called the police. But before the police came over, the person who pushed him took out something from his bag and injected it into the person who had broken his arm. By the time the city mobile police arrived.., the person who had broken his arm had already stood up from the ground. His body was intact. Under the adjustment of the police, he did not have any intention of blaming the person who pushed him. The two of them had actually reconciled.
This strange incident quickly attracted the attention of some people. Through the surveillance screen, it was exceptionally clear. People also discovered that the person had indeed broken his arm, but it quickly recovered on its own!
This strange incident quickly attracted the attention of the majority of the citizens of Mobei.
Very soon, a netizen found an advertisement after an inconspicuous small TV series that was broadcasted on the Mobei region news channel. The medicine sold in this advertisement was actually called “Regenerative Medicine”, and its effects were described very miraculously, it was so magical that it was even somewhat fake.
After this advertisement was found, it quickly attracted the attention of people when compared to this hot news.
At the same time, there were a few more trending events that happened that night. They all happened around the ordinary citizens of Mobei City. Some of them even shot a funny video and broke their arms, then, they showed it to the netizens at 360 degrees to prove that their arms were indeed broken. Then, after injecting a tube of medicine, their arms healed not long after.
There was no special effect added to the video. Moreover, the creator of the video also admitted that the injection of the medicine was called regenerative medicine. It cost two million federal dollars per bottle!
The expensive medicine was almost sky-high in price. The magical effect instantly aroused the curiosity of the citizens of Mobei. Even people from other cities had noticed the news and anecdotes. The reputation of regenerative medicine was getting more and more famous.
In the company.
Dudian, Ma Jing and others as well as the advertising department and the planning department were in a meeting. They were listening to the report of the advertising department. Everyone felt as if they were dreaming, even Ma Jing and others who were focused on the research of the drug felt that it was very magical. They were amazed by Dudian. Who would have thought that dudian would let the news platform take the initiative to advertise for him?
The investment in advertising was very small. However, it had become a news event. It had attracted the attention of some hot news platforms. It was pushed to the main page and made the regenerative medicine become popular in just a few days, moreover, they had come out in time to admit it. Moreover, they had announced the price and the purchasing channel. This made the regenerative medicine become the most popular name in Mobei city.
The people who admired Dudian the most were the employees of the advertising department. They had many years of experience in advertising planning but they had never thought of such a strange advertising method, however, the results made them have to dispel all doubts. Fame was everything. The role of advertising was to bring strong popularity. Dudian’s copywriter had done this.
“I have finally stood firm in front of them.”Dudian was quite satisfied with the development of the company. Originally he just wanted to try but he didn’t expect that the effect would be so fast. The review of the regenerative medicine had been done in the past few days, he could sell it on the market. He had received calls from some unknown people who wanted to buy his company but he had rejected them.
It was very difficult to use force unless he used a shady method to eat away his achievements bit by bit.
Under the purchase of a large number of customers, a steady stream of funds was transferred into his account. He took out part of the funds to develop the company’s site. He also bought factories and pharmaceutical robots to mass produce.
“I have 800 million in my hand. Including the new VIP customers, the number of agents has increased to more than 50. Most of them are local rich. I can be considered to have a firm foothold in Mobei City.”Dudian calculated the harvest of the past few days, although the time was short, but the changes were fast. He estimated that the savings of Felix, the Young Master of the Rockefeller Consortium, should not be as much as his own. At most, he would have 100-200 million.
Although Felix had billions of funds in his hands, but it was the money of the HAWSK company. All of the funds were in the accounts. He needed to report that the money was fake, it was very difficult to make money in the Rockefeller Consortium. But it wasn’t impossible to make one or two hundred million. In Dudian’s eyes it was the best.
“Beep Beep!”
The Communicator Rang.
Dudian picked up the phone: “Who is it?”
“Hello Boss Qin. I’m Zhang Zhicheng. I want to…”there was a nervous voice coming from the other end of the phone.
Dudian felt that the name sounded familiar. He remembered that it was the first VIP customer that he had visited, “Mr. Zhang, I remember that you have blacklisted me. Why are you looking for me?”
Zhang Zhicheng was a bit embarrassed. The name of the regenerative medicine had spread throughout the whole of Mobei city. It had even appeared in the federal news. Although it wasn’t a household name but it was still very popular. Moreover, it was still continuing to ferment, many jokes with regenerative medicine as the core were spreading and becoming more and more popular. He heard about it from his daughter. After personally understanding it, he found out that the person who came to find him.., was not a liar as he thought.
“Boss Qin, you must be joking. At that time, we have never met before. I hope you can forgive us. I also have a reason…”Zhang Zhicheng’s attitude was sincere. He was ready to complain but was interrupted by Dudian.
“Since I have been blacklisted, there is no need to say anything. My time is precious. I wish Mr. Zhang Good Health.”Dudian hung up the communicator.
Zhang Zhicheng’s face turned ugly when he heard the sound of the phone hanging up, “Isn’t it just a bottle of medicine? I don’t believe that I can’t buy it. You blacklisted my ID card right? I can find someone else to buy it. How can money be difficult for me? !”
He was extremely angry and immediately found his friend’s communicator to contact him.
After Dudian hung up Zhang Zhicheng’s communicator, he blocked his contact code. He knew that although he didn’t sell the medicine but the latter would definitely be bought from other channels. He might even be able to buy it on the black market, it wasn’t difficult to get things done with money. He wasn’t in the mood to care about such a small matter. He picked up the communicator and slowly entered a number.
“Is it the External Advisor of the Tras Consortium?”Dudian whispered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1112
chapters.content:
Chapter 1112 – Chapter 1101: Go
A strange male voice came from the other end of the communicator: “This is the terras foreign affairs department. Who Are You?”
“My name is Qin Mo. . I’m the Chairman of Dream Company.”Dudian said: “The regenerative medicine sold on the market these days is manufactured by our company.”
“Oh?”Jing Chao was a bit surprised. He had heard about the regenerative medicine that had been widely spread these days. He heard that the headquarters had bought the regenerative medicine and was analyzing the ingredients. He didn’t expect that the owner of this popular medicine.., would take the initiative to contact them.
“Mr. Qin, what’s the matter?”Jing Chao didn’t mention the regenerative medicine but asked in a calm tone.
Dudian frowned as he heard the other’s tone. He didn’t expect the big consortium to be so arrogant. He thought for a moment.., “I hope to make an appointment with the Steward of Your Consortium. I have a business to talk to you about.”
“Talk to us about business?”Jing Chao couldn’t help but laugh, “Mr. Qin, Our Minister of Foreign Affairs is busy. If Mr. Qin wants to sell the shares of your company, I can inform you. But if you want to talk about the distribution of regenerative medicine then forget about it.”
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows, he said: “I want to talk about the business of another kind of medicine. This medicine is not on the market yet, but the market will not be inferior to the demand of regenerative medicine. I want to sell this medicine to your consortium. Do you think we can meet face to face to talk about this business?”
Jing Chao was surprised: “Your Company has a medicine that is similar to regenerative medicine? This… Alright, I will pass on this matter to you.”
Dudian replied with a dry “Thank you”and hung up the communication device. He didn’t expect that the Terras consortium was more arrogant than he had imagined. It seemed that they didn’t care about regenerative medicine, he was worried that they would come to seize the patent and pharmaceutical companies. It seemed that he was worrying too much.
“The ATLAS consortium has dominated the federation for hundreds of years. It is a force passed down by the god of Science and technology. It has a long standing and respected position. Even an ordinary employee is so arrogant. I don’t know what kind of high-level people are in the consortium. The empire that has existed for hundreds of years will be destroyed by corruption. Let alone a consortium. It may be full of ruins. Once it is destroyed, it will collapse…”Dudian’s eyes flashed.
It didn’t take long for Felix to send a message: “How is it? Have you contacted the Terras Consortium?”
“Yes.”Dudian said. He got the communication signal from Felix. Ordinary people didn’t know about the communication signal of the Terras Foreign Minister’s office.
Felix let out a sigh, he probed: “I heard that you made the regenerative medicine? You should have made a lot of money, right? Why would you sell such a good thing to Tesla? Is it to protect yourself? If you sell this to our Rockefeller Consortium, I will ask my father to come out and eat it. Moreover, I can use this to get promoted. When I get promoted, I will give you more assistance. I. . .”
Dudian interrupted his long speech, “You have been dormant for many years. Isn’t it time for you to get promoted? Do you want to enter the eyes of your brother and sister and be targeted by them? How sure are you that you can protect yourself from them? Your father hasn’t died of old age. Isn’t it better for you to wait until he passes the throne?”
Felix wryly smiled: “You have a point. I’m afraid of an accident.”
“Are you afraid of an accident or your father?”Dudian asked.
“Of course I’m afraid…”Felix suddenly whispered: “Why do I feel that there is something wrong with your words?”
Dudian indifferently said: “You are overthinking. I have something to talk to you about. Don’t you know that the performance of Hawsk Company is average? You Don’t know how many years it will take for you to be promoted. I plan to invest 500 million yuan in your company.”
Felix didn’t hear him clearly: “How much did you invest in me?”
“Five hundred million?”Dudian asked.
Felix was stunned: “Where did you get so much money…”he suddenly thought of the regenerative medicine in Dudian’s hand, “How did you earn so much money by selling regenerative medicine? My God, the sum of my salary from the consortium and the money I saved over the years is not even five hundred million!”
“So this is the gap between us.”Dudian bluntly said.
Felix almost vomited blood. was there anyone who would talk like that?
He took a deep breath, he clenched his teeth: “If you give me 500 million, I can do a lot of things. But there is a risk. Once I succeed, I will get a huge return. At least I can enter my father’s sight.”
“Your goal is to enter your father’s sight?”Dudian was a bit disappointed.
Felix heard Dudian’s disappointed tone: “This is the first step for me to replace him.”
Dudian thought for a moment and said something else. He was afraid that the goal would be too big and scare him away. He immediately said: “I will transfer the money to you. But this money is to sign a contract. I Won’t give it to you unconditionally.”
“I knew it…”Felix whispered.
Dudian hung up the phone when he agreed to sign the contract.
That night, the Secretary of the Minister of Foreign Affairs contacted Dudian. They agreed to meet at noon tomorrow and send a special plane to pick him up.
Dudian rested for a night to recuperate. He sorted out the information and came to the company the next morning. He handed the simple things to Zhu Ying and asked her to take care of the operation of the company. Then he took a car and left the company, he came to the South Airport of the desert north city. It didn’t take long before an armed fighter with Atlas English logo slowly landed. A few burly bodyguards came out.
Dudian went forward to meet him. The person in charge of receiving him was a strong blonde middle-aged man. He claimed to be the deputy of the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Atlas.
The armed fighter took off from the sky of Mobei City. The wilderness outside the city was in front of his eyes. He saw the air tunnel from Mobei City to other cities. The armed fighter gradually flew high and passed by the wilderness, they passed by many cities along the way.
Dudian flew over these cities. He felt that the large area of these cities could accommodate 10 to 20 million people. Moreover he could occasionally see monsters and undeads in the wilderness, there were few birds and beasts in the Peace Circle. Even if there were, they would be frightened away by the high frequency sound waves released by armed warplanes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1113
chapters.content:
Chapter 1113 – Chapter 1102: Study
The blonde middle-aged man didn’t talk much on the way. Dudian could see that although his expression was gentle and polite but there was pride in his eyes. It was obvious that he didn’t take him seriously. He wanted to find him to inquire about some things that the terras consortium couldn’t find on the internet. But he knew that it was useless to ask about it. He was too lazy to pay attention to him.
Two hours later, the armed warplanes flew in a straight line to Duyue city, one of the five major cities of the Federation. This was the hinterland of the Terras Financial Group. It could be said that in this city, the terras financial group was the local emperor. Every shop here.., behind the land, there were countless connections with the terras financial group. It was also the headquarters of the Terras Financial Group. Just like the other three major cities in the five major cities, it was also the headquarters of Locke Fei and the other three major financial groups.
The most noble major city was called Peace City. It was the place where the president and senior officials of the Federation lived. However its prosperity was a bit weaker than the major cities occupied by the four major consortia, however it didn’t affect the most noble impression and status of Peace City in the hearts of all the citizens of the Federation.
The Terras logo on the armed fighter plane allowed the fighter plane to avoid border inspection. The sentry put it into the parking lot of the city. The blonde middle-aged man Nicol took Dudian out of the fighter plane, there were top brand cars made by Tras companies waiting outside. Nicol took Dudian to the Foreign Affairs Office Building of the Tras Consortium. It was located by the Half Moon River in the city. The employees were sitting in the office, they could directly see the winding clear half moon river outside the building. It was one of the most expensive places in the city.
“Please.”Nick got off the car and politely said to dudian.
Dudian looked at the towering building and the huge green area surrounding the building. He couldn’t help but feel the financial strength of the Tesla Consortium. The foreign affairs building was so magnificent, no wonder the headquarters of the consortium was built on the island in Dudian’s city.
Nicholas led Dudian to take the Commissioner’s elevator. It didn’t take long for Dudian to arrive at the office of the Minister of Foreign Affairs. However the Minister of Foreign Affairs was in a meeting so he had to wait here.
Dudian was the only one in the huge office. There was a beautiful but capable secretary and a cup of coffee in front of him. He looked out of the French window and saw the Half Moon River in the distance, there were countless high-rise buildings that were shorter than buildings. The pedestrians on the street were as small as ants.
Dudian casually turned his head and looked at the wall. He found that the material inside the wall was special. It was like metal or wood. Obviously it was difficult to build such a high-rise building with ordinary construction techniques. He saw the other offices on this floor. There was Nick’s office. The sign on the table and the door showed that he was a secretary.
In another meeting room Dudian saw Foreign Minister Yan Changze. He was a Chinese man in his fifties, he was telling others about the commercial lawsuit between the Terras Consortium and Michael Consortium.
Dudian’s eyes penetrated into the man’s body. He found that the man’s bone density was high and his physique was three times that of an ordinary person. He was able to fight against ten people at the same time, such a physique could be considered as a special forces soldier.
“I didn’t expect that a minister of foreign affairs like Terras would have such a physique. It should be caused by taking drugs. I heard that Terras Consortium has studied undeads and monsters. They have researched a lot of drugs. Some of the banned drugs are not available on the market. Even ordinary citizens don’t know about the existence of these banned drugs. But in the ears of the military and other consortia this is not a secret. He should have injected Terras’biological drug, TK27!”Dudian thought.
This medicine was specially sold to the military. It was also one of the sources of money for Terras. The price was extremely expensive. It was said that it was worth ten million each!
In comparison, his regenerative medicine was considered a cheap product.
“Felix said that this medicine was banned and not sold to ordinary people. He was afraid that the Constitution of ordinary people would be too high and it would easily cause chaos. If he killed people in anger, it was very likely that a large number of people would be killed before the police arrived. If it was in the old era, it was possible. But the federation was surrounded by foreign enemies and there were monsters lurking. Such a promising medicine was not popularized by the people. Most likely, the weight of the pharmaceutical materials was not much. In addition, the Federation did not have a higher military force to suppress…”
Dudian looked at Yan Changze but didn’t see any hidden disease in his body. He was a bit disappointed. If the other party had an incurable disease, he might be able to use the opportunity to get close to him. But the other party had been in a high position for a long time, it was obvious that the senior management of Tesla had taken good care of him. Even if there were some minor ailments, he had been cured.
While Dudian was thinking, Yan Changze’s meeting was over. After the crowd dispersed, the secretary reminded him to return to the office. He saw Dudian sitting on the sofa drinking coffee, his expression didn’t change as he sat down at his desk. He asked the secretary to pour a cup of tea: “Mr. Qin Mo? I heard that you have a business to talk to us?”
Dudian smiled as he felt the pride in his bones, “Since Minister Yan has heard of me, I will be Frank. I have a medicine that is better than the regenerative medicine. Once it is launched on the market, it will cause a sensation. I am willing to sell this medicine to you. I don’t know if you are willing to accept it.”
Yan Changze was unmoved, he smiled: “Mr. Qin Mo, you look like you are in your early twenties. You are really young and promising. We need our experts to judge whether the medicine is good or not. I don’t know what Price Mr. Qin wants to sell it for.”
Dudian said: “Not much. One billion in cash and an opportunity to study in Randy’s Company.”
Yan changze slightly raised his eyebrows, “One billion in cash?”? Mr. Qin was really good at joking. Even if it was proven to be as useful as you said, it was not worth one billion! Moreover, Randy was the pharmaceutical company of our Tesla Consortium. It was doubtful whether Mr. Qin was there to learn or had other purposes.”
“I didn’t expect the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Tesla Consortium to be such a petty person.”Dudian gently smiled, “My Regenerative Medicine has been released for a few days but it has already earned 800 million yuan. To put it bluntly, the market value of the regenerative medicine is 10 billion yuan or even higher. One billion yuan is just a small amount. Do you think it’s too much?”? Do you really think that I’m a poor student who doesn’t know anything?”
Yan Changze’s face sank. He didn’t expect that Dudian would suddenly turn hostile. However he was surprised that the regenerative medicine had already earned 800 million yuan for Dudian. The speed of earning money was too amazing, his face quickly changed, he smiled: “Mr. Qin you are joking. If your medicine is as you said then we can talk about it. But we need to verify the medicine you are talking about. Otherwise it will be useless to talk about it.”
Dudian took out a small bottle, “This medicine is called Oxy. It can treat deformities and mental illness. It is also very effective in treating cancer. I have investigated and found that the cost of treating cancer is five times less than the cost of the market. It will become a monopoly drug.”
Yan Changze’s eyes lit up. He had never heard of such a thing. He immediately said: “I will contact the experts and ask them to test the drug.”
“Sign the contract first. In addition, I have recorded everything we said on the video.”Dudian raised the communicator.
Yan Changze’s face slightly changed: “Mr. Qin is cautious.”
“What do you think?”Dudian indifferently replied.
Yan changze sneered: “Alright, I will call the experts for you.”He was about to use the communicator when the communicator suddenly rang. His face changed as he saw the number, even the back of the chair slightly bent as he nodded. After a moment the communicator hung up. He looked up at dudian: “Randy Company has promised to let you study.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1114
chapters.content:
Chapter 1114 – Chapter 1103: The Mysterious Terras
“Did Randy Company agree?”Dudian was shocked as he thought of the communication he had just picked up, he immediately asked: “Who was looking for you? You haven’t reported to Randy Company. How could they agree? Did they know that I would make such a request?”
Yan changze saw Dudian’s shocked look. He felt that the horror in his heart had faded a lot, he calmly said: “The news came from the headquarters. As for why they knew about it, I guess it was because you leaked it. The Information Network of our Terras consortium is spread all over the federation. As long as we want to know, nothing can be hidden from us!”! “It seems that the consortium is very optimistic about Mr. Qin. I hope that Mr. Qin won’t let the consortium down.”
“The secretary-general of the headquarters personally called?”Dudian’s face slightly changed. He felt that the situation was a bit strange. It was out of his control. Yan Changze was shocked that the headquarters would pay attention to a small figure like him. However, he was shocked.., how did they know that he would propose to study at Randy’s company? He had never told anyone about this matter. He had only calculated in his heart. could other people guess his thoughts?
However, he had never met the secretary of the headquarters. Even if he had magic marks ability, he couldn’t read other people’s thoughts?
Could it be that he had deduced it from his own actions? If that was the case, not to mention that his every move was monitored by the Terras Consortium. The person who had deduced his actions was also a terrible person!
These thoughts flashed through Dudian’s mind. His eyes turned solemn. He pondered for a while and decided to go.
If the Terras consortium had malice towards him, he would be able to easily catch him. It would be better to take the initiative to go and see what their plans were.
“When can I go?”Dudian asked.
Yan changze said: “The headquarters has called. They should have informed the company. You can report to the headquarters of the company.”
“But my medicine hasn’t been tested…”
“There is no need to test it. Mr. Qin can take it to the company and hand it over to the experts there.”Yan changze politely smiled.
Dudian’s heart sank. He nodded slightly, put away the bottle and left the office. He took the elevator and left the magnificent office building under the lead of Secretary Nicole.
“The medicine hasn’t been tested yet and they have already agreed to my request. It means that they already knew that I would make this request. Moreover, whether the medicine is real or fake, they are willing to let me go.”Dudian felt that there seemed to be a pair of cold eyes behind his back, the owner of these eyes seemed to want to see him. In that case, he would go and see him!
Dudian immediately called a car and went to the headquarters of Randy pharmaceutical company in the capital city.
“It seems that they are sure that I will go…”Dudian sat in the car and looked at the scenery outside the window. His eyes were calm as he thought about the situation, it was unlikely that the other party had malicious intentions. The reason why the other party found him was not because of his pharmaceutical ability but because of his identity as a demon!
He didn’t understand what else was worth the attention of the Terras Consortium.
“Felix, I want to go to the headquarters of Randy’s company. They took the initiative to invite me. I suspect that their purpose is not pure. If there is any accident then spread the news that Randy’s pharmaceutical company is hiding monsters.”Dudian contacted Felix through the communicator, although he felt that Randy’s company didn’t have any malicious intent. Otherwise they could have directly arrested him. But who could be sure if they deliberately let him think so? Maybe they wanted to lure him into their trap. They were afraid that he would counterattack and minimize the casualties.
Therefore, he had to keep a contingency plan.
“Is it the Randy’s company from the Terras Consortium?”Felix was a bit shocked, “Why did you go there? Since you know that their purpose isn’t pure, why did you go there?”
“I suspect that they know my identity as a demon.”Dudian replied in a low voice.
Felix was stunned: “How is it possible? I didn’t tell anyone. If they know your identity then why did you go there? Hurry up and run!”
“It’s useless to run.”Dudian shook his head. The other party’s intelligence network knew his identity as a demon. If he wanted to escape then he would be caught before he left the city.
“You… If something happens to you then don’t Tell on me. If I go in there there will be no one to bail you out.”Felix’s voice was a bit nervous.
Dudian indifferently said: “I know but if you don’t think of a way to get me out then come in and accompany me.”
Felix gritted his teeth: “I will think of a way but you have to give me time.”
“I will be at Randy’s company in two hours. If there are no problems then I will contact you in one hour.”Dudian said: “If I don’t contact you then it means that something has happened to me.
