You have to think of a way to get me out in forty-eight hours. If anything happens then I’m afraid that I won’t be able to live for more than forty-eight hours.”
“It’s too tight, the time is too tight!”Felix couldn’t help but say.
“It’s settled then.”Dudian hung up the communicator and didn’t continue to argue with him.
“Tesla Consortium is the leader of the four consortia. It has been passed down for hundreds of years and was founded by the god of Science and Technology…”Dudian narrowed his eyes. Among the four consortia, the Tesla consortium was aloof from worldly affairs, however most of the technological products in the Federation came from Terras Consortium. The foundation of this consortium was so powerful that the three consortia were deeply afraid of them.
This was also the reason why the consortium was eager to develop the monster mech.
It was normal for consortia to have a gap between them. But if the gap was too big then people would feel fear and unease.
Obviously, the other three consortia felt fear from the bottomless foundation of the Terras Consortium. They were afraid that they would be swallowed one day.
“There is only one possibility that they know the identity of the demons. It is the attack of the demons in Mobei City!”Dudian narrowed his eyes, “Based on the details of their investigation, I should be arrested and interrogated. However, they didn’t. In the end they sent out a few members of the Pantheon to attack the Pantheon. It seems that they have let go of the essence of the matter. It seems that they have long noticed me but didn’t alert the enemy!”
“Since the Terras consortium knows about this, it means that Mobei city is also a secret force of the Terras Consortium. General Yao Jie is in charge of the investigation. He is a high-ranking official of the federation. I didn’t expect him to be a member of the Terras Consortium.”
Dudian took a deep breath and placed his hand on his heart. Maybe a fierce battle was coming or maybe it was just a false alarm. He could only hope that the result would be good.
Two hours passed by quickly.
Dudian came to the entrance of Randy’s company. The headquarters of Randy’s company was more magnificent than the previous foreign affairs building. The surrounding environment was very green. It was spacious and clean. There was a huge sculpture standing at the entrance of the company, it was the god of Science and Technology of the Federation.
Dudian looked up and felt that the latter seemed to be looking down at him. There was a smile on his face and there was a mysterious feeling.
Dudian took a deep breath and walked into the hall. He showed his identity certificate. Soon, a woman who was in charge of the office trotted over and looked up and down at dudian, she said: “Mr. Qin, headquarters has arranged for you to come to our R & D Department. Please follow me.”
Dudian was slightly startled. He quietly controlled his strength and nodded: “Please.”
The woman led the way and took the commissioner elevator. She took Dudian to the vast factory building behind the company. They walked from the building to another building, they passed through four or five buildings before they stopped.
“This is the R & D Department of our company. We are famous academicians here.”The woman couldn’t hide the respect and pride on her face, she took him to the registration office of the R & D Building.
“It seems… … You really want me to come over to study?”Dudian was surprised. He felt that he couldn’t understand the terras consortium. The woman in front of him wasn’t in disguise. Most of what she said was true, terras consortium actually dared to let him come to the place where these precious academicians worked? Weren’t they afraid that he would casually kill a few of them?
“Don’t tell me they don’t know my identity as a Demon?”Dudian’s heart was suspicious, “Just because of the regenerative medicine, they have raised me to such an extent?”
Soon, he followed the woman to the registration counter and reported his name. The young woman who was responsible for registration opened her eyes as soon as she heard his name. She quickly searched the virtual screen in front of her, soon, she found the information she wanted. Her expression immediately changed and she revealed an extremely respectful smile. She said, “Mr. Qin, you are authorized by the company. You have the highest authority in the company and can participate in all drug experimental projects.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1115
chapters.content:
Chapter 1115 – Chapter 1104: Undead Experiment
The woman’s eyes widened as she looked at the young Dudian. It should be known that many famous scientists had developed many drugs for the company, they didn’t have the highest level of authority. The highest level of authority was only available to the legal person of the company and the existence of the consortium.
Even the directors of the consortium couldn’t get their hands on it!
Dudian’s eyes moved as his mood tensed up. Although he didn’t know the management system of the company but the highest authority shouldn’t be given so easily, was there really such a big charm? Moreover, the company actually allowed him to participate in all the drug experiments of the company. This was a bit of nonsense!
“Millie, are you seeing things?”The woman in business attire could not help but ask as she wiped away the shock on her face.
Millie shook her head and said, “The system records are like this. There’s no way it’s wrong. Unless our system has been hacked, no one in the entire federation should be able to hack into our system.”
The woman in business attire was startled. She thought to herself that it made sense. The people in the federation who were so awesome in network technology were all in their terras consortium. Who would be able to hack into their company’s system? However, if the system was correct, would the consortium really place such great hopes on this young man?
Dudian heard the words of the two and asked: “Can I participate in any experiment? What if the experiment fails because of my participation?”
Millie respectfully said: “Mr. Qin, you have the highest authority and are qualified to participate in all the experiments. As for destroying the experiment, I don’t know. But your identity is the same as the chairman of our company. Only the board of the consortium can revoke your identity.”
Dudian slightly nodded but his mood was a bit heavy. He couldn’t guess the thoughts of the consortium but there must be something fishy going on. He could only take one step at a time to understand the situation.
“Miss Millie, please introduce your company to me.”Dudian thought for a moment and said.
Millie nodded.
The woman who was next to Dudian couldn’t help but feel sorry. Although she didn’t know why this young man was so appreciated by the consortium but it was definitely not wrong to curry favor with such a person, unfortunately, she had missed this opportunity.
Dudian had a general understanding of the composition of Randy’s company. He estimated that it was almost an hour later. He interrupted Millie’s explanation and went to the corner, he used the communicator to contact Felix.
“Are You Alright? That’s Great.”The Communicator was quickly connected. Felix’s voice was clearly relieved.
Dudian said: “I’m Alright for the time being.”
Felix smiled: “It seems that you were too suspicious. I’m busy now.”
“Wait.”Dudian said: “I will contact you in two hours. If I don’t Contact You Then we will continue to carry out the original plan.”
Felix was stunned: “Is it necessary?”
“Yes!”
Dudian hung up the phone.
Dudian went back to Millie and listened to her introduction of the scientific academicians of the company. He took his employee card from her hand and went to the elevator to scan the employee card, he went to the laboratory floor above the high building.
The elevator door opened and Dudian saw many people wearing white coats and isolation suits walking through the corridor.
Dudian avoided the surveillance and used his x-ray vision to scan the entire floor. He saw that there were five huge laboratories. Each laboratory had two or three to five or six white coat academicians who were dressed like doctors, four academicians in one of the laboratories were even more exaggerated. They were fully armed and wearing gas masks. The door of the laboratory was a double-layered spiral metal door which was tightly locked.
Dudian estimated that with his own strength, he would need to use a punch to blow it open.
“So many drugs…”Dudian saw that the shelves of the laboratories were filled with glass bottles. All of them were produced by Randy Company. Some of the drugs that were widely distributed on the market were also among them, the academicians inside seemed to be researching how to improve.
The rich atmosphere of research permeated the entire floor. It made people want to participate in it. Of course, this was referring to the people who were also obsessed with pharmaceuticals. Dudian praised the management of Randy’s company in his heart. He turned into the elevator and continued to climb up.
He came out from each floor to observe for a moment until he came to the top floor of the laboratory. Only the academicians with level 1 authority could come in. Even if the others wanted to come in, the authority set on the staff card was not enough, the elevator couldn’t go up.
There were only three laboratories on this floor. The area was more spacious. Two of the laboratories were empty. Only one laboratory was in operation. There were three older academicians. There were two men and one woman. There was an old man with golden hair, the outline of his face was deep. It was clear that he was handsome and elegant when he was young. The other one had white hair. She was Chinese. There was a woman in her forties. She was also Chinese. She had a quiet and elegant mature temperament.
Dudian was attracted by the situation in the laboratory. There was a trace of coldness in his eyes. He saw two slightly mutated undeads tied to two metal crosses in the laboratory, it was obvious that the undeads had been infected by humans not long ago. Their skin still retained the color of human skin. They were wearing the simple uniform of Randy’s company.
“Are these the lab rats cultivated by Randy’s Company?”Dudian looked at the two undeads. One was a young man and the other was a young woman. Their faces were full of malevolence as they growled at the three academicians who were talking.
The other experiments on the lower floors were using lab rats. They were studying the drugs that were circulating in the federal market. Only here was the pain of the federal government which couldn’t be exposed.
Although Dudian was mentally prepared but he felt a little sad as he saw the other side of the company which was highly praised by the citizens of the Federation.
Dudian was excited. Felix was right. The Terras consortium was trying to study the secrets of the undeads.
“We have come to the right place!”Dudian was happy as he looked at the instruments in the laboratory. He had never seen these instruments before. He couldn’t find them on the market. He couldn’t even identify them.
The next moment, Dudian’s mind suddenly became alert. Randy had raised his authority to the highest level. Could it be that they wanted him to participate in the UNDEADS experiment!
Weren’t they afraid that he would be scared and spread the word?
Unless they knew that he was a demon. They would never be scared by such a small matter!
They knew his identity!
Dudian narrowed his eyes. Cold light flashed as he slowly walked towards the laboratory.

chapters.title: Chapter 1116
chapters.content:
Chapter 1116 – Chapter 1105: Eternal Life
Di —
Dudian swiped his card at the door. The metal spiral door of the laboratory opened. The three people inside were startled by the sudden opening of the door. They turned around and saw a strange face.
“Who are you?”The quiet woman frowned and whispered.
Dudian smiled: “My Name Is Qin Mo. . I just came to your company to take a look at the experiments here. Are the three of you studying these two undeads?”
“Qin Mo?”The blonde old man frowned. He didn’t remember this name. He noticed that Dudian was able to open the door of the laboratory: “Do you have level one authority?”
Dudian smiled: “The Consortium has given me the highest authority to participate in all the experiments of the company.”
“The highest authority?”The three were shocked. They had been in the company for so many years and had made countless contributions. However they had only obtained level one authority, it was impossible for the highest authority of the company to be granted to them.
“Are you sent by the Consortium?”Another white haired old man frowned.
Dudian smiled: “I’m just here to learn. I have disturbed the three experiments. I hope you will forgive me.”
The white haired old man saw that Dudian was avoiding his question so he didn’t continue to ask. He was a bit dissatisfied in his heart. The consortium had raised such a young junior to the highest authority of the company, what was the meaning of this?
However, he had seen too many things that relied on his background to be in a high position. Although he was dissatisfied but he didn’t show it. He slightly nodded to Dudian and continued to look at the experimental data in his hand.
“Is it Qin Mo? For the sake of insurance, I have to verify your identity.”The quiet and mature woman smiled: “My Name Is Chu Huiru. I’m an expert in bioinformatics.”
“Hello.”Dudian nodded and handed his employee card to her.
Chu Huiru was startled for a moment as she saw the result of the scan. She sighed in her heart but her face was as gentle as usual. She returned the employee card to Dudian: “Mr. Qin Mo is really young and promising. I hope that we can cooperate happily in the future.”
“The three of you are my seniors. I hope that the seniors will not be stingy with their teachings.”Dudian smiled.
The three of them saw that Dudian’s attitude was humble and sincere. The dissatisfaction in their hearts gradually faded and their attitude eased. They introduced themselves. The Blonde Old Man’s name was Sovas and the white-haired old man’s name was Qian Yi.
“Master Qian Yi, do you want to research the medicine to cure the undead?”Dudian casually asked.
Qian Yi shook his head and smiled, “Of course not. The medicine to cure the undead hasn’t made any significant progress for so many years. The company has less funding for research in this area. Now there is no one to do such useless research. We are extracting the virus from the corpse and decomposing the virus. We hope to extract the cyclic fission gene from the undead virus.”
“Cyclic fission gene?”Dudian’s face was full of curiosity.
Qian yi smiled: “This is a conjecture made by an expert from undead research twenty years ago. Unfortunately he has passed away. In recent years the cyclic fission gene conjecture has been confirmed by people. It seems that it does exist. We have found some clues in our research. If we can really extract it then the effect will be great. It will allow us ordinary people to live indefinitely. It is possible to reach immortality!”
“Eternal life?”Dudian was surprised, “Is there any life in this world that can live forever?”
“Not in the past, but it’s hard to say in the future.”Qian Yi revealed a mysterious smile.
Chu Huiru’s expression was serious, “Even if you can’t make people live forever, you can still greatly increase their lifespan. It’s not a problem to live for four or five hundred years. Think about it. If everyone’s lifespan can be greatly increased, the butterfly effect will be so powerful. A person who has lived for five hundred years will have profound knowledge. In addition to our human reproduction, the territory will be expanded more than ten times. Maybe we can regain the dominant position on Earth.”
Dudian nodded. Even if his lifespan was doubled, the butterfly effect would be unimaginable! However, how could there be such a thing in the zombie virus? He thought of the body structure of the polar ice worm. The cells that were immortal and indestructible would divide and transform endlessly. The virus appeared after the invasion of the worm. It seemed that it was most likely the virus that the worm had released on Earth.
“Are there no ways to make the undeads return to human form?”Dudian asked the trio.
Sovas shook his head: “Once they are completely infected into undeads, there is no way to save them. The cells and memory carriers in the brain have been torn apart by the mutation of the virus. Even if the body returns to human form, the brain will not be able to recover. The human brain is the most complex machine. With the current technology, it is impossible to completely repair a completely damaged brain.”
Dudian’s heart was cold. He felt as if a sharp thorn had pierced into his heart, but he still forced himself to ask: “Is there no way? There are so many infected humans. If we can cure them, the value of the cure shouldn’t be much higher than making an immortal medicine, right?”
Qian Yi laughed, “How can it be mentioned in the same breath? If there is an immortal medicine, then the value is incomparable. What in the world is more attractive than immortality?”? “Those who are infected are just ordinary people. Even if there is a cure, who will buy it? “Do their relatives have so much money to buy the medicine? If there is, they won’t let their relatives leave the city to be infected by the virus.”
Dudian was stunned.
He felt as if his heart was tightly gripped by a palm. He tried to squeeze and contract it.
Qian Yi’s words made his head heat up. He even wanted to tear the three of them apart. However, his rationality made his body stand on the spot like a nail. Perhaps, he should have seen through this long ago.
The big shots wanted to live forever and continue to enjoy themselves. However, ordinary people only wanted to keep their lives and treat illnesses. However, the big shots controlled most of the resources. It was destined that these resources would be allocated according to their wishes.
Even if they could develop drugs suitable for ordinary people, it was only because of the market demand.
“So the company doesn’t carry out research in this area?”Dudian was silent for a long time before he slowly opened his mouth.
Chu Huiru was keenly aware of the fluctuation of the young man’s aura, she immediately said: “It’s not that the company doesn’t carry out research in this area, but no one is willing to study it. The difficulty is not to mention the lack of funding. If the research fails, it will be criticized. Unless there is a 70% to 80% chance of success, otherwise it is just asking for trouble.”
Dudian gently exhaled: “I know. Can you let me participate in this experiment? I will only observe. It Won’t affect you.”
The three looked at each other with a troubled expression. But they thought that Dudian was the highest authority so they couldn’t refuse. Qian yi nodded: “Alright, you are still young. It will be good to see more.”
“Thank you master Qian.”Dudian thanked him.
Qian Yi smiled and began to work with the three of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1117
chapters.content:
Chapter 1117 – Chapter 1106: Undead Army
Dudian watched from the side and didn’t disturb them. He casually went to the other side of the laboratory. There was a row of metal cabinets like the ones in the mortuary. Dudian casually opened one, there was a pale girl lying inside. Her lips were ghastly pale. There were no clothes on her body. Her body was clean and there were no wounds.
Dudian looked at her and pushed her back. He opened the metal cabinet next to him. There was a baby who was not yet one year old. It was like a ceramic sculpture.
“Qin Mo, what are you doing?”Chu Huiru whispered as she noticed Dudian.
Dudian turned his head and smiled: “Nothing. I’m just looking around. I’m not disturbing you right?”
Chu Huiru shook her head, “Most of them died of diseases and their families donated. We used their bodies to do research. We hope that we can gain something from it.”
Dudian smiled: “If we use their bodies to research medicine for the benefit of society then it would be a good thing for them.”
Chu huiru smiled: “This is something we have to work hard for.”
Qian Yi and Sovas seemed to have a conflict and immediately pulled Chu Huiru over.
Dudian walked to the metal shelf next to the freezer. There were many bottles and jars of different sizes. There was a letter label on them. There was no name nor record effect, it seemed that Qian Yi and the others could recognize what was inside from the label. He casually picked up two copies and went to the other side of the laboratory. There was a row of bookshelves with a lot of documents on them.
He took out two copies and looked at them. One was the genetic data of the coiling tiger and the other was the investigation report of the molds of melanosis.
He quickly flipped through the documents and memorized the knowledge. Although he couldn’t understand some things but he could slowly learn them in the future. He read seven or eight documents in a row, he deeply felt the high level of technology of the Federation. He had never heard of many things and couldn’t understand them at all. He estimated that even if he learned all the knowledge in the super chip, he would barely be able to deduce one or two things.
Dudian sighed in his heart. At the same time, he was excited. This was a good thing for him.
Chu Huiru, Qian Yi, and Sovas paid attention to Dudian from time to time while they were discussing. They saw that he casually picked up the experimental data and looked at it. It seemed that he was just pretending.
She looked at it a few times and no longer paid attention to it.
“Corpse limb replacement surgery…”Dudian suddenly pulled out a thick document. He opened it and saw the title of the document. His eyes lit up as he quickly scrolled down.
The document was about an operation. The experimenter had a fantastic idea. They were trying to find out the secrets of the bodies of different undeads. From the results of the experiment.., different undeads had changed their arms and legs but there was no effect!
The experimenter’s exquisite surgical suture allowed the body of one undeads to be embedded into four or five other undeads’arms. Each of the undeads’arms could move when they attacked!
“The neural existence of undeads…”Dudian looked at the experimenter’s conclusions and conjectures. He felt that he had gained a lot. He had never thought of using such a method to study undeads, he didn’t expect that the limbs of the zombies were not repelled by each other. They could even reconnect the broken limbs.
Dudian didn’t linger after reading the document. He inserted it back and continued to read.
Time passed quickly. In addition to the sound of Dudian flipping through the paper, there was the sound of Chu Huiru and the other two talking about the experiment. From time to time they would perform an autopsy and adjust the electronic beeping sound of the instrument.
“Conditioned reflex training method…”Dudian saw the method of using conditioned reflex to train the undeads from one of the documents. He couldn’t help but feel a bit strange. His heart was full of regret and admiration. He had to say that.., there were many smart people in the world. The Federation had accumulated wisdom for hundreds of years. They had done research on the undeads from various aspects, including the previous zombie limb replacement surgery, he had also seen a related conjecture from another document, which was to piece together many zombies to create stronger zombies.
Then, he would use conditioned reflex to train an army of zombies!
It was also mentioned in this document that when zombies evolved to a certain extent, the mutated brain tissues would extend new consciousness. This kind of consciousness could be said to be instinctive, but it was also possible to have a “Dream recall”situation, the so-called “Dream Recall”was when the remnant memory fragments of a human in the mutated brain of a zombie were preserved, and they might be integrated into the new consciousness and instincts.
Simply put, it would give birth to a consciousness with a few fragments of past memories. However, this consciousness was dominated by the instincts of zombies. They were bloodthirsty and killed. Some zombies would even speak simple words after giving birth to consciousness, however, there was no moral judgment, no concept of life and death. Moreover, the temptation of fresh blood was irresistible. Even the people closest to them would bite to death.
The experimenter used a well-bred child zombie as an experiment. After the child zombie gave birth to a consciousness, it would already speak simple words. It would even giggle foolishly. The experimenter would find her close relatives and try to wake up her memories, the baby rushed towards her mother. Although it was trapped in the cage, its face was full of blood. It even shouted for its mother.
Many experiments showed that zombies that were born with consciousness were harder to control than ordinary zombies. The broken memory would not give them human morality. Instead, it would make them grow up slowly and become treacherous, they could learn to disguise and even use simple tricks!
Dudian thought of the king undead that had bitten Aisha. He would never forget the battle that day. He could still vividly remember the treachery shown by the King Undead. Obviously, it was a king undead that had been born with consciousness for a long time, it had become cunning and insidious after being trained in the wilderness.
“The consciousness of the birth of zombies is generally at level seven. About one in a thousand is at level six. About six percent is at level eight…”the statistics on the data were very complete. Dudian compared it with the army and found that level seven was around the pioneers.
“Use the limbs of high-level undeads to suture the brain of low-level undeads. Use the conditioned reflex training to cultivate high-level undeads…”Dudian’s heart thumped as he read the results of the data, he felt a chill. The federation might have implemented this long ago. In addition to the mechs, they had a group of high-level undeads who were not afraid of death!
The way zombies evolved was simple. All they needed was flesh and blood. It was not difficult at all to nurture a group of high-level zombies!

chapters.title: Chapter 1118
chapters.content:
Chapter 1118 – Chapter 1107: Research
“It is the fastest way to increase our strength…”Dudian felt that he would be able to use this method in the future, if he wanted to overthrow the federation and Empire then this was the best way to quickly arm his own forces!
Dudian was ready to continue to read. Chu Huiru suddenly came over and smiled: “Qin Mo, it’s late. Let’s have dinner together.”
Dudian turned around and saw that the three of them had taken off their gloves and opened the anti-bacteria coat. It seemed that they were ready to get off work. He took out the book and put it back. He nodded: “Alright!”
The three of them left the laboratory and locked the metal door. This lock was not the lock that they had locked previously. It required the fingerprints and iris of the three of them to open it. Otherwise, even if Dudian had the highest authority.., he would not be able to open the door. Of course, there was another way. It was to activate the emergency security system. But in this way, the entire building would know and sound the alarm.
The three of them talked about the next direction of the experiment. Most of the words they said were professional terms. Dudian didn’t understand them at all. The technology system of the federation was not the same as the old era, in addition to the list of elements, the name of the old era was still used. Many new particles and experimental methods were replaced with new terms. They needed to learn the special system to know.
“Qin Mo, you don’t seem to be afraid of undeads?”Chu Huiru asked Dudian.
Qian Yi and Sovas also remembered that Dudian didn’t care about the undeads in the laboratory.
“Aren’t they locked? What is there to be afraid of?”Dudian smiled at the careful woman: “Speaking of fear, they should be afraid of us. After all, they are just experimental materials in our hands. They have the same status as mice.”
Chu Huiru was surprised: “You really have a big nerve.”
Qian yi smiled: “It’s a good thing to be bold. In our line of work, we don’t have the courage to do any research. Qin Mo has a future. He may surpass us in the future.”
Dudian modestly said a few words. Soon they took the elevator to the restaurant of the building. They saw the restaurant in the middle of the building. The elevator door opened and a melodious piano music floated into their ears, the decoration of the hall was gentle. It was not bright or dark. It was very quiet. Only a few people were eating.
The four of them found a seat and sat down. A waiter immediately came forward and asked. The three of them ate here every day. Soon they reported the food and juice that they wanted. Dudian didn’t care about these. He ordered a steak and hot drink.
Qian yi smiled at dudian: “Mr. Dean, I see that you don’t have any repulsion towards undeads. Do you want to do relevant research in the future?”
Terras consortium focused on undead research but there were many other aspects of research. Even Randy pharmaceutical company would choose all kinds of monsters as objects in addition to undeads, some of the monsters contained special antibiotics or vaccines. Some of them were beneficial to humans and could strengthen the human body’s immunity.
Dudian knew that Qian Yi and Chu Huiru were experts in undead research. They were experts in this area and knew a lot. Letting them study monsters was the same as changing careers. Qian Yi said.., he also wanted to recruit Dudian to join the faction. He had the same idea, dudian took the opportunity to say: “I don’t think too much about the future. I am interested in undead and monsters. I have read a lot of information today. Although I don’t understand a lot of it but it seems more interesting to find undead.”
Qian Yi’s eyes lit up: “Oh? Interesting?”
“I saw a piece of information which said that undeads can insert other undeads into their body. It feels quite magical. I think that there are monsters all over the world but the number of undeads can not be ignored! Moreover, I think that undeads are more important than monsters!”Dudian seriously said.
Qian Yi’s eyes lit up. Sovas was curious: “What do you mean by ‘more important’?”
“Many aspects!”Dudian said: “I think human wants to take back the Earth. Maybe we can solve the secrets of the undeads.”
Chu Huiru’s eyes lit up: “What do you mean?”
Dudian looked at the woman’s eyes, “I don’t know what is the root of the destruction of the old era. But monsters are rampant and the undeads are everywhere. These monsters are mutated beasts of the old era. Although there are many of them but their intelligence is generally low. They are unable to unite and can be ignored for the time being. But the undeads are different. They are the humans of the old era or adventurers who have been infected by the virus for hundreds of years. If they can regain their memory and intelligence and become human again then it can be imagined that the number of US humans has increased by more than ten times, or even dozens or hundreds of times!”
“There is strength in numbers. If we increase the number of humans by a hundred times, why should these monsters be afraid of them? Even if we have to fight and consume, we can still fight!”
Qian Yi and the other two looked at each other in dismay. They didn’t expect that Dudian’s mind was so broad. He was actually starting from the future of the entire human race. Such breadth of mind and vision shocked the three of them, they were a bit ashamed. They had considered that the particularity of the undeads was more mysterious than the monsters. The potential of research was greater and the value would be more. It would benefit the human race.
But they had never thought that this kind of experiment would have an impact on the entire human race. It would help the human race to take back the Earth and return to the dominant position!
Qian yi sighed: “Qin Mo, you have thought far ahead. Even I haven’t thought about this. But this idea is good but it is impossible to do it.”
He sighed, qian Yi continued: “The consortium has been researching for hundreds of years but they have failed. It is irreversible. It is like a dead person who can not be resurrected. Even if the current technology can restore the heartbeat and vitality of the dead body, it is meaningless. They can only be a vegetable and let the living corpse accompany their family to comfort their thoughts.”
Dudian’s face was gloomy. He had come to terras with hope but the answer was always the same — there was no way!
His heart was full of anger. He wanted to smash the dining table in front of him but there was no progress after hundreds of years of research. Are you all good-for-nothings? Are you all good-for-nothings? But he didn’t say it out loud. After a few breaths, his anger was suppressed. He knew that these experts were intelligent. Because of this, the blow to him was extremely heavy!
Hundreds of years of research by countless experts had no answer.
Could he do it alone?
Although he didn’t want to admit it in his heart, but the probability was so low that it made people powerless.
He never looked down on himself nor would he think highly of himself. But even if the hope was slim, so what? Would he give up? If he gave up, who in the world would fight for this matter?
Who else would fight for her?
Dudian felt a sharp pain as he thought of her wandering in the wilderness like a ghost. It was like a sharp knife stabbing into his heart. He couldn’t let go of her hand! Even if he had to fight for his whole life!
“If I can live for a long time, then I can live for a hundred years. If I can’t live for a hundred years then I can live for a few hundred years. In the next few hundred years, the level of technology may be unimaginable. At that time, there will definitely be a cure!”Dudian thought, he suddenly felt a burst of hope. He thought that the technology of the old era from the steam engine to the nuclear bomb launch in the sky was less than a hundred years.
Once the technology took off, the speed of development was unimaginable. He believed that there would be more magical technology in the future.
Qian Yi saw that Dudian suddenly became silent as if he was hit by a blow, qian yi comforted him: “Don’t be discouraged. Although we can’t do what you said but the value of the undeads is very high. We can dig out more good things to benefit the society. We Can’t take a big step but we can take small steps. Sooner or later we will reach the highest position in the world!”
Dudian’s mind was clear. He nodded in agreement. He pretended to think and said: “I plan to apply to the company to study the undeads.”
Qian Yi was surprised: “So soon? Aren’t you going to participate in our experiment?”
Dudian smiled: “Of course I’m going to participate. I want to learn more from the seniors. I will do my own research after I have learned enough. If there is anything I don’t understand then I will ask you to teach me.”
“Haha, That’s Easy.”Qian Yi laughed.
The waiter served their dinner.
They chatted about experiments and recent news.
After they finished eating they went back to their respective residences.
Dudian told Felix that he was safe. He went to find Millie and asked her to take him to the residence assigned to him by the company.
The residence was located in the company building. The environment was not inferior to a high-end hotel. Dudian was lying on a soft bed after he took a bath. He looked at the splendid night view outside the French window and looked at the huge crystal chandelier on the ceiling, he felt like he had returned to the old era.
But he knew that this was not the old era. Although it was a modern technology world, but things had changed.
Dudian closed his eyes and fell asleep comfortably.
It had been a long time since he had such a relaxing rest. Dudian slept until dawn. He felt full of energy. He washed up and went to the restaurant to eat breakfast. He happened to meet Chu Huiru who was also there. He took her table and ate together.
“You are up so early?”Chu Huiru was surprised at Dudian’s diligence.
Dudian smiled: “There is time to sleep when you are old. It is better to be active when you are young.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1119
chapters.content:
Chapter 1119 – Chapter 1108: Help
“I heard that Mr. Qin Mo has created a regenerative medicine. He has done such a big thing at such a young age. He is indeed extraordinary.”Chu Huiru’s tone was gentle as she casually said.
Dudian knew that Chu Huiru had gone back last night to inquire about his intelligence. Perhaps she knew that he was just a poor student who didn’t have any background, at this moment he was curious why Dudian was favored by the consortium. He didn’t answer directly. He smiled humbly and pretended to be mysterious.
Chu Huiru saw that Dudian was seamless. She didn’t ask directly but chatted with him for a while. Afterwards she went to the laboratory with Dudian.
Although Dudian couldn’t understand the meaning of the consortium but since they had given him the highest authority he could participate in all the experiments, he was happy to use this shortcut to understand the many experiments of the company and the secrets of the ordinary people in the federation.
During the day he would watch the experiments of Qian Yi and Chu Huiru. Sometimes he would flip through the materials to learn about them. In the evening Dudian would go back to his residence and contact Felix. He would send people to manage the dream company.
Originally he didn’t want to mix the dream company with Felix. He wanted to use the company as his base in the federation. In the future he would accept Barton and Neuss to help him, there were nests in the empire and nests in the federation. In the future he would be able to get benefits no matter which side the war was. But the appearance of Terras had broken his fantasy.
Even his identity had been exposed. The Dream Company naturally didn’t hope to operate under the eyes of the Federation. It would hide a large number of demons. He would let Felix manage it and help him seize power in the Rockefeller consortium as soon as possible, he would be able to work for himself in the future.
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Qian Yi and Chu Huiru’s experiments were coming to an end. In the past half a month Dudian had seen many experts with level 1 authority in addition to observing in their laboratory, dudian also went to the expert laboratory to study the monsters. Although monsters and undeads were different research but in his opinion they were both living things so it was inevitable that they would have something in common.
It turned out that his idea was right. There were many references to undead experiments in the laboratory, some people even listed some classic cases of undead research to prove their own ideas and conjectures.
“It’s still not working…”
In the laboratory, Chu Huiru’s usually calm and elegant face was wrinkled. Qian Yi and Sovas looked gloomy and didn’t say a word.
Dudian was reading the information. He heard their movements and knew that their experiment for so many days had been declared bankrupt. The three of them tried from many aspects but in the end they couldn’t make the longevity drug.
In fact, the experiment had reached a bottleneck a week ago. However, the three of them didn’t want to give up. They tried to try everything but failed.
If the project failed, the three of them would have a lower score in the company. They would be fired by the company.
Dudian quietly put down the experimental materials and left the laboratory. He didn’t want the three of them to vent their anger. Although they didn’t dare to show their anger but they would be angry in the dark.
Dudian went to the restaurant to order food. He saw a white haired old woman sitting in the corner. She was dressed in expert clothes. She was dressed in plain but her temperament was very dignified, she was staring at the bowl of noodles in front of her.
“Granny Lan Xin, what happened to you?”Dudian immediately went over.
Zhang Lanxin came back to her senses. She saw a handsome youth. She couldn’t help but smile: “It’s Qin Mo. .”
Dudian knew that she was a faction that studied monsters. He asked: “Granny Lanxin, is there something wrong with the experiment?”
Zhang Lanxin shook her head and smiled: “It’s nothing. I just miss the children.”
“What children? Lanxin, did those bastards come to find you again?”An old but dignified voice was heard.
Dudian looked up and saw that it was Kong Zhi who was often working with Zhang Lanxin. He couldn’t help but be surprised: “Master Kong, who dares to find trouble with Granny Lan Xin?”
Kong zhi recognized dudian. He knew that Dudian had a great background. His attitude towards Dudian was relatively calm. He didn’t treat Dudian as a junior, “They are a group of damn things. I think we shouldn’t care about these scumbags. It’s best to let them live and Die!”
“You can’t say that. They are innocent!”Zhang Lanxin’s soft face slightly wrinkled as if she was angry.
Kong Zhi was a bit scared as he saw the situation, he turned to Dudian: “You don’t know that your Granny Lan Xin likes to do good things. She has a lot of love. Unfortunately, good people don’t get good karma in this world. She has been doing research in the company for years. All the money she has earned has been donated to the people in the poor areas of the outer city to treat cancer and radiation infections. It was a good thing but who knew that your Granny Lan Xin’s two experiments had failed. She didn’t have any money in her hands. Those who had been helped by her found her and asked her to pay for the subsequent treatment.”
“You said that she has to live in the company. How can she pay for their treatment when she has no money? In the end, these bastards are blocking the entrance of the company every day as if they owe them.”
Dudian didn’t expect such a small matter.
Kong Zhi turned to Zhang Lanxin: “You can borrow money from me to do other things but I will never agree to donate it to these heartless bastards!”
Zhang Lanxin sighed: “It’s all my fault, it’s all my fault…”
Dudian was speechless. Although he could see that this mother-in-law was kind, but he didn’t expect her to be so kind, he shook his head: “It’s not your fault, mother-in-law. I will help you solve this matter. You Don’t have to worry about it.”
Zhang Lanxin was startled: “Are you willing to lend me money?”
Dudian asked: “Are you willing to continue to fill the gap between them and the vampires?”
Zhang Lanxin sighed: “They are relatives in the ward. They are anxious for money.”
Kong Zhi was about to get angry when Dudian said: “There are too many people like this in the world. Grandma how much can you help?”
“That’s right!”Kong zhi immediately shouted.
Zhang Lanxin hesitated for a moment: “If you lend me money to help them then I won’t do such things in the future.”
Dudian was relieved as he saw that she seemed to have come to her senses: “No problem. Leave it to me.”
Kong zhi snorted and turned his head.
Zhang Lanxin knew that he was still angry. She sighed but didn’t say anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1120
chapters.content:
Chapter 1120 – Chapter 1109: Funeral
Dudian didn’t delay after he promised Zhang Lanxin. He went outside the company building. He saw a group of people who were dressed in plain clothes. Their faces were yellow. It was obvious that the living conditions of these people weren’t good, some of them hadn’t bathed for many days. They were sweaty and smelly. Dudian frowned as his sense of smell was very sensitive.
These people sat under the shade of the trees. It seemed they knew that Randy’s company was not to be trifled with. They didn’t go near the company but waited by the roadside. It was no wonder that the security guards of the company couldn’t chase them away.
Although the consortium was powerful and it was easy to kill a few people. But obviously they didn’t have the intention to kill a large number of poor people for Zhang Lanxin. Moreover, Zhang Lanxin didn’t report to the company so she had to suffer.
Dudian glanced at more than 40 people. He didn’t immediately go forward but used the communication device to contact his secretary Zhu Ying. He asked her to transfer the money that the company had recently received into his account, he looked at the amount of the remittance and walked towards the group of people under the shade of the street.
The seven people under the shade of the tree looked alert when they saw people coming over. They stopped fanning and slowly stood up. They looked at Dudian with vigilance.
The other beggars in the shade stood up as they stared at Dudian. There was a bit of tension in their eyes.
“Are you looking for Zhang Lanxin?”Dudian looked at the people in front of him.
The tension on the faces of the surrounding people disappeared and turned into anger. A middle-aged man stepped forward. He seemed to be the representative of the group, “Who are you? Who are you to Zhang Lanxin?”
Dudian saw that they were aggressive: “Why? Do you want to behave atrociously in Randy’s company? Don’t you know where this is?”
The middle-aged man snorted: “Who said that we are going to cause trouble here? We are just waiting for people to pass by. Why? Aren’t people allowed to stand on the roadside?”
Dudian smiled: “Don’t be excited. I’m here to send money on behalf of Zhang Lanxin. She knows that you are in trouble so she asked me to help you out.”
Everyone was relieved.
“Who are you to Zhang Lanxin? Her son?”The middle-aged man looked at Dudian. His face turned cold: “We are all waiting for money. Do you have so much money?”
“How much do you need?”Dudian smiled.
The middle-aged man and the others looked at each other. At this time, the others slowly came over and surrounded Dudian. If it was an ordinary person who saw this scene, they would think that it was a robbery. However, Dudian’s expression was calm as he quietly watched them discuss. He even saw that the middle-aged man seemed to think that his attitude was good. He was young and was ready to ask for more money.
“We have a total of forty-three people here. Some of them want money to treat their illness. Some of their houses have collapsed. Some of their sons have died and they need money. Each of them needs at least one or two hundred thousand. The total is eight or nine million. Do you have any?”The robust middle-aged man talked to everyone, he slightly raised his head and coldly said to Dudian.
Dudian narrowed his eyes: “Two hundred thousand federal coins. It is worth more than half a year’s income of a rich family. You really dare to ask for it!”
Everyone saw that Dudian was unwilling and began to talk.
“200,000 federal coins is a lot for us, but what does it mean for you rich people? !”
“Zhang Lanxin is an expert of Randy’s company. I don’t know how much money she earns every year. Do you think she can’t take out such a small amount of money? Do You Think We Are Fools?”
“That’s right. You are too cold-blooded. We are so poor that we can’t even eat. We are reluctant to give you a bit of money. You have so much money. Aren’t we the common people who give it to you?”? Aren’t we the ones who give you food and clothes?”
“You can save a bit of money. It will be enough for us to use for a Lifetime!”
Dudian smiled as the crowd clamored. He didn’t even blink his eyes. The robust middle-aged man didn’t expect the young man to be so calm. He knew that there was no point in denouncing him. He raised his hand to signal everyone to be quiet. Soon everyone stopped.
“Zhang Lanxin can easily earn money from a TV program. We don’t want much. If you can’t give us the money then ask Zhang Lanxin to come out and tell us. I don’t believe that she doesn’t have money!”The robust middle-aged man said in a cold voice.
Dudian gently smiled: “You are right. We can still afford this amount of money. Isn’t it just eight or nine million? I have ten million here. As long as I can help everyone.”
Everyone was stunned. They didn’t expect that dudian would agree to it after a few words. They were embarrassed but soon they thought that they would get the money. Their eyes became fervent as they stared at Dudian, they wanted to personally Rob Dudian. However the rule of law in the federation was so deep that they didn’t dare to do so. They stared at the communicator in Dudian’s hand.
“I told you that Granny Lan Xin is a good person. How could she be reluctant to give money?”
“It would be better if she gave it earlier. We don’t need to waste time waiting here for so long.”
“That’s true. Little Brother, hurry up and give me the money!”
Everyone urged him.
Dudian raised his hand, after everyone quieted down he said: “Don’t worry. You have worked hard to get money. I will give you the money. I will call a few cars to send you back. I hope you will live well after you go back. Don’t let Granny Lan Xin Down.”
“Yes, yes.”
Everyone agreed.
Dudian immediately used the communication device to access the company’s internal authority. He mobilized a magnetic train. Although it was a train, but it was only slightly wider and longer than the old era buses. The internal space was more comfortable.
After everyone got on the train, Dudian also got on the train. He set the train to auto-drive and then chose a route. Soon, the train started smoothly.
“Where is the money? Are you coming with us?”The robust middle-aged man saw that Dudian also got on the train. His face was not friendly. It seemed that he felt that something was wrong.
Dudian slightly raised his hand and loudly said: “Everyone, let’s start to transfer the money to everyone. Sit down one by one. Don’t mess up the order. Otherwise, if someone doesn’t get the money then don’t blame me.”
The effect of his words was very good. Originally there were some people who were surprised but also took their seats.
Dudian immediately began to transfer the money according to the seats from front to back. Everyone was relieved when they saw that he really transferred the money. They were excited.
It didn’t take long for the people on the train to receive Dudian’s transfer.
Dudian sat in front of the train after the transfer was over. He looked at the scenery outside the window. The train was very fast. It had moved along the urban track out of the rich areas and came to the remote towns in the suburbs.
Even a big federal city like the first covenant city had barren places but not many.
The train continued to move through two remote towns.
“My home is here. Stop the train.”Someone saw that the train was about to leave the town.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to it. He waited for the person to shout louder. Dudian said: “First send the distant ones and then send the close ones. Don’t be anxious. Take it as a tourist.”The train had already left the town, the Man was angry but had no choice but to sit down.
After the train left the town, it came to the outskirts of the town. There were two roads. One Road was marked with paint and the other road was dilapidated. However, the train was heading towards the dilapidated road.
At this time, many people had noticed that something was wrong. The robust middle-aged man was the first to stand up. He glared at dudian: “Where Are you taking us?”
Dudian also stood up from his seat. He turned around and looked at the crowd: “Where Are We Going? Of course we are going to send you to your death.”
As soon as these words were said, the whole car went into an uproar. Everyone stood up and shouted in excitement. Some of them scolded dudian. A few youths who were closest to Dudian’s front seat stood up and stretched out their hands to grab Dudian, they wanted to hit him.
Dudian slightly raised his leg and gently kicked. The sole of his foot hit the chest of the person in front of him. The sound of ribs breaking could be heard. The youth knocked down the people behind him and stacked them into a turtle. He couldn’t get up for a long time.
“What do you want to Do?”The robust middle-aged man angrily shouted.
Dudian indifferently said: “I said, I will send you to die.”
“You dare to kill people?”
“Do you want to die with us? If something happens to us, you won’t be able to live!”
“There is no law. Don’t think that you are a rich man. Killing people? Hehe!”
Dudian heard the angry shouts of the crowd. He faintly smiled, “Of course it is great to be rich. Otherwise, why do you work so hard to earn money? Do you really think that your life is worth much? Although the law will protect you, but the law is also a man’s decision. What Are You Trash?”
Many people were panicking after hearing his words. After all, there were people who held respect for the nobility and the upper class.
The robust middle-aged man’s face changed as he sneered: “You killed so many of us. Do you think you won’t be on the news? When the time comes, you won’t be able to escape the death penalty!”
“Then I won’t need you dead people to do it.”Dudian smiled.
The middle-aged man seemed to see that Dudian didn’t mean to threaten them. His face changed and his tone softened: “I don’t want the money. I will return the money to you. Stop the car! Stop the car!”
“What’s the use of money? This money is meant for your coffins.”Dudian faintly smiled, “Although your life is not worth a penny in my eyes. You have hands and feet. You Can’t Kill Monsters for human and you can’t work to build a society. You are just worms that will consume food and produce feces. I invested this money in others. Since you love this money so much then you should take it and die!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1121
chapters.content:
Chapter 1121 – Chapter 1110: Lord God
Many people were scared and begged for mercy when they saw Dudian’s indifferent expression.
“We have no enmity with you. Why do you want to Kill Us?”
“Please let me go. I don’t want money. I will return the money to you. I Won’t trouble you anymore.”
“Let me out of the car, please.”
The middle-aged man saw that begging for mercy was useless. he shouted: “Don’t think that you are a member of a big company. If something happens to so many of us, no one will be able to protect you!”
“Ignorant ant.”Dudian indifferently smiled, “You have forced an old man to give you money. You should have died. There are few good people in this world. There are even fewer people who have the ability to help others. Unfortunately you poor lazy people live in ignorance. You Can’t control your greedy nature so there are fewer good people. So you will meet evil people like me. Unfortunately there is no turning back.”
The robust middle-aged man shouted: “F * ck you! Let’s kill him first!”
Many young men reacted from the panic and immediately rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s expression was indifferent. He raised his leg and kicked the man to the ground. Some people approached from the side and were hit in the face by his hand. They turned around like a top and fell into the crowd.
The people behind him were shocked by his fierce strength. Their eyes were wide open in disbelief.
Dudian indifferently smiled. He raised his hand and hit the automatic navigation system of the train. Sparks were produced and the navigation system was smashed. Then he jumped and hit the metal plate on top of the train, he stood at the edge of the hole.
Everyone was shocked as they had never seen such terrifying inhuman strength.
The robust middle-aged man woke up and saw a collapsed fault at the end of the road in front of the train. His pupils contracted as he screamed out in fear.
Dudian’s feet slightly touched the ground as he fell down from the train. The train’s navigation system was damaged but it continued to move forward. The speed didn’t decrease after he jumped down, dudian rushed straight towards the fault and crashed down.
Dudian slowly walked to the edge of the fault. He saw the train rolling down the slope from the fault to the cliff hundreds of meters below. The train was smoking. His eyes flashed but he didn’t go up.
..
… ..
The headquarters of the Tesla Consortium.
It was located in the center of the city. It occupied an area of tens of millions of square meters. It was the king of luxury houses! One had to know that every inch of land in the center of the city was extremely expensive. Even a hundred square meters of residential buildings would cost millions of federal dollars. What was the concept of over ten million square meters? It was equivalent to the core of the downtown area of Duyue City. All of it was included in the garden of the headquarters of the Terras Consortium. Just this piece of land alone was worth hundreds of billions!
Even the federal government of Duyue City had moved to second-tier areas.
This was the dominance of the four major consortiums. To them, money was just a number. After all, the Terras consortium was still responsible for printing money for the Federation. Money? No one knew how much money the Terras consortium actually had. However, they knew that the Terras consortium’s businesses were spread throughout the various cities of the federation. The products they produced were sold to tens of thousands of households. Regardless of whether you were a man, woman, old or young.., they would use the products of the Terras Consortium, food, clothing, shelter, and all other aspects!
At this moment, in the Terras Consortium’s villa complex, on the top floor of the tallest building in the science and Technology Building, a dim light enveloped every part of the room. There was only one huge room on the top floor, which was extremely spacious, like a palace, however, it was simpler than a palace, and there were not too many extravagant decorations. There were only a few light holes embedded in every corner of the room, emitting a weak light. The floor was not the floor, but rather, it was like a transparent mirror.
Wearing a black and gold robe like a priest, Heslodi slowly walked in from outside the room. His feet stepped on the transparent floor as if he was walking in mid-air. This transparent floor wasn’t the next level, instead, it was a deep and vast darkness. There was a bit of light, like the stars in the universe.
Heslodi’s body was straight, but his head was slightly lowered. Every step he took, he looked at the area less than five meters in front of his toes. He didn’t dare to extend any further. He just walked step by step, silently memorizing it in his heart, when he reached the twelfth step, he immediately stopped, then slightly bowed. His tone was incomparably respectful as he said, “Hei Si Luo di greets the lord sovereign. May I know what orders you have for me?”
A young, but extremely indifferent and disdainful tone came from above Hei Si Luo Di’s head. “That demon has caused trouble again. Go clean up the mess.”
Black Slody was slightly startled. puzzled, he said, “The one that was sent to Randy’s company? He didn’t obediently stay in the company, but he still dared to cause trouble?”
“He did it on purpose. He wanted to see my bottom line of tolerance.”That cold voice didn’t contain a hint of emotion. “Go.”
Black Slody’s heart tightened. He hurriedly lowered his head. “Yes, Lord Sovereign.”
After saying this, he slightly bowed and bowed, then slowly turned around and left. Before he left, he glanced ahead from the corner of his eye. What he saw was an incomparably dazzling light. It seemed to be the light of a God! He silently walked out of this room. After the alloy door slowly closed, he felt that the air had become much lighter. He gently exhaled, and his eyes flickered, he thought to himself: “It’s that demon again. Why is the lord paying so much attention to him?”
..
… ..
Dudian casually called a car and went back to the company.
Dudian used his x-ray vision to scan every floor of the company. He found Zhang Lanxin’s figure and went straight to the top floor of the laboratory.
The door of the laboratory opened. Dudian saw Zhang Lanxin and Kong Zhi who were busy with experiments. There were four other experts. They were in the same group, they would gain huge fame and benefits once the project was successful.
Many people turned to look at Dudian. They frowned but didn’t pay attention to him. They continued to busy themselves.
Zhang Lanxin saw Dudian come back. She put down the chemical in her hand and whispered: “Are they gone?”
“They are all gone.”Dudian said in a different tone.
Zhang Lanxin was relieved as she asked: “How much money did they ask for? Is it a lot?”
Dudian smiled and showed her the transfer form: “It’s not much. Two hundred thousand for each person. It’s more than eight million. I can afford it.”
“So much? !”Zhang Lanxin was surprised but quickly became angry. She lowered her head and sulked.
“Grandma Lan Xin, don’t take it to heart. It’s just a small amount of money. They promised not to come again. But Grandma, don’t bother with these people anymore. There are countless poor people in the federation. If you can’t help them then they will become ungrateful wolves.”Dudian persuaded.
Zhang Lanxin nodded: “I know. I have seen through this matter. I won’t do such a stupid thing in the future. But Child, your money…”she thought for a moment, she solemnly said: “I will return it to you.”
Dudian smiled: “We will talk about this later. Granny, you are busy with the experiment. I Won’t disturb you.”
Zhang Lanxin felt that the others were dissatisfied with her. She didn’t say anything more: “You can take a look here. If there is anything you don’t understand, feel free to ask me. I have to go.”
“Alright.”Dudian agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1122
chapters.content:
?Chapter 1122: Chapter 1111: study
Translator: 549690339
Dudian walked around the laboratory for a moment before leaving. He went to the next empty laboratory. He pulled a chair to the bookshelf and began to read as much as he could. He could freely enter these unopened laboratories with his authority. Compared to reading carefully in a human laboratory, he could be very casual here. However, most of these materials.., he couldn’t understand them.
However, he memorized all these formulas. He would be able to understand them as soon as he learned them.
He found a notebook and wrote down the things he didn’t understand. He went to the restaurant and ordered food. He ate while waiting.
After Zhang Lanxin’s laboratory experts came down to eat, Dudian immediately ordered the main meal. At this time, Zhang Lanxin was reminded by Kong Zhi. She noticed Dudian who was sitting in a prominent position, she was stunned for a moment before she walked over.
“Little Qin, thank you for this matter...”Zhang Lanxin’s face was full of gratitude and sincerity.
Dudian pulled a chair over and invited them to sit: “It’s a small matter. Granny Lanxin, you don’t have to thank me.”
“I heard that nine million is not a small amount even for us. These people are really ruthless. They are simply evil wolves. What poor people are pitiful? There must be something hateful about them. They are absolutely right!”Although Kong Zhi was old, but his tone was as indignant as a young man. If it wasn’t for Zhang Lanxin saying that Dudian had shown her the transfer slip and the name of the person on it, he wouldn’t believe that what Dudian said was true, after confirming that there was such a thing, he hated those people who collected debts even more.
Dudian smiled but didn’t deny it. Although nine million was nothing to him, but he couldn’t act too indifferent.
The three of them chatted as they ate dinner.
“Little Qin, I heard that you are studying experiments. You are preparing to apply for a research project. If there is anything I can help you feel free to tell me.”Zhang Lanxin was looking for an opportunity. She was afraid that Dudian would leave after dinner, she quickly said.
Dudian was waiting for this opportunity. Even if she didn’t open her mouth, he would take the initiative to open his mouth. He didn’t show too much joy but smiled, “I do want to apply for a project with the company. The higher-ups have sent me here. It’s not that I don’t have a task. But my qualifications are too shallow. I don’t understand a lot of things, including what you experts say. I need to learn well.”
Zhang Lanxin and Kong Zhi knew that Dudian was very eager to learn. Zhang Lanxin was happy to hear him say so: “If there is anything you don’t understand, I can teach you!”
“Yes, if there is anything you don’t understand, you can come and ask me.”Kong Zhi said with a smile in his eyes. He was very optimistic about Dudian.
Dudian scratched his head: “Will it disturb you and delay your energy...”
“It’s nothing.”Zhang Lanxin quickly said. She was afraid that Dudian would refuse and couldn’t find an opportunity to repay her.
Dudian no longer declined but agreed, he thought: “Some people get help from others but are greedy for more help. Some people get a little favor from others and feel uncomfortable. They try to repay them. Unfortunately, there are only a few of them...”
Dudian took out his notebook and asked them for advice.
Both of them were surprised to see Dudian write down so many things in the notebook. They didn’t expect Dudian to be so diligent. They appreciated him more and were happy to give him guidance.
“Little Qin, what you have memorized is not systematic. You shouldn’t have been a graduate student at your age, right?”Zhang Lanxin looked at the notebook and quickly saw Dudian’s level of knowledge.
Dudian nodded: “I just graduated from university. I was just playing. My results were average.”
Zhang Lanxin smiled and comforted: “It’s not too late to learn now. I will teach you from the beginning. Wait for me to go back tonight and tidy up. Tomorrow you will come to me after my experiment is over.”
Dudian’s face was full of surprise: “I am very grateful to Grandma. But Grandma You are old. Don’t stay up late.”
“It’s alright. I can eat and live.”Zhang Lanxin smiled.
After the two left, Dudian packed his things and went back to his residence. He looked at the evening news. Soon he saw the news about the car crash. The location and pictures were taken. It was the car that he had sent to the funeral.
“Zhang Lanxin went back to organize my study plan. I don’t have time to pay attention to the news. These experts usually only pay attention to the news in their own industry. Sometimes they have time to look at other news. For the time being they don’t have to worry about anything. Moreover they don’t report the names of the dead...”Dudian looked at the news, the train was smashed and the passengers’faces were covered with blood. However, it wasn’t clear. Dudian believed that Zhang Lanxin wouldn’t think of the debt collectors. Even if she did, it wouldn’t be a big deal, from the news, this incident was defined as the accident of the train navigation fault.
“It seems that the consortium is quite indulgent towards me.”Dudian thought.
“They know that I am a demon. They know that I have killed so many of you and they are covering up for me. They will know the real cause of the train crash.”Dudian’s eyes narrowed, although more than 40 people were ordinary civilians but the federation was a society ruled by law. It was the same as the old era. It was even stricter than the old era!
Murder? Robbery?
They would all be arrested!
There was no underworld in the federation. There were only police and strict laws. This was a humanitarian society. Even if tens of millions of rich people killed people, they would still pay with their lives!
Occasionally, there would be news about rich and powerful people who violated the good girls and were arrested and sentenced. The law protected every citizen. So the debt collectors dared to be so arrogant. As the saying goes, no matter how rich you are, no matter how powerful you are.., would they dare to kill me?
However, the Tesla Consortium who stood at the top of the society gave Dudian the answer. They would dare to do so!
The deaths of more than 40 people were defined as accidents. Dudian deliberately didn’t kill them. He even deliberately left fingerprints when he smashed the navigator. He was testing the energy and reaction of the atlas, in the capital city, it was not an exaggeration to say that atlas could cover the sky. It was not limited to the capital city but more than half of the federation..
“The consortium didn’t send people to warn me. It seems that this small matter hasn’t even touched one-tenth of their tolerance. They have given me the highest authority so that I can learn a lot of profound knowledge. It seems that they are helping me. But if they really want to help me, they should directly reveal their identity unless there is something difficult to say...”
Dudian felt that the goodwill of the Terras consortium was not related to helping him. There must be a purpose behind it.
It was late in the night. Dudian sighed. He felt like a small boat floating in the sea. It could be destroyed at any time. He couldn’t predict when the wind would blow, but the wind... would eventually come!
He made up his mind. He would first learn the knowledge and then solve the problem of his heart. If it wasn’t because of the poor load on his heart, he felt that his body could burst out with unimaginable power!
The transformation of his body by Crimson Moon was far beyond Crimson Moon’s expectations and what he felt.
“If I can burst out with the power of a king, even if the Terras consortium has ideas about me, I should be able to protect myself. The most powerful weapon they have aside from nuclear bombs should be laser weapons.”Dudian thought, it should be impossible to use nuclear weapons to attack him. After all, he was in the federation. It would be better to let him go in order to destroy a demon like him.
If he wanted to kill him in the federation then he would have to use laser weapons. But if he had the power of a king then the problem of his heart would be solved. Even if the laser pierced through his heart and destroyed half of his body, he would be able to regenerate!

chapters.title: Chapter 1123
chapters.content:
Chapter 1123: Chapter 1112: self-dissection
Translator: 549690339
Time passed by quickly.
Dudian read the materials during the day and studied by himself. In the evening he would look for Zhang Lanxin to make up lessons. Kong Zhi would occasionally teach him some obscure biological knowledge. Dudian’s level of knowledge was rapidly improving. He had a photographic memory and was diligent in self-study, he had made rapid progress. Zhang Lanxin had taught him many things. Dudian was able to completely grasp them. He was even able to draw inferences from them. Both of the experts were stunned by his amazing IQ.
Three months passed in the blink of an eye. Dudian felt that it was about time so he applied to the company for the Undead Experiment Project.
It was faster than he expected. The company didn’t make him wait long. They approved the project that night. The first batch of investment had reached 50 million and he was promoted to project director, he could choose other experts from the company to participate in the experiment.
After the news spread, Dudian immediately became the eyes of many experts. Although some people were jealous but on the surface they were very polite to Dudian. They even complimented him in hopes that Dudian would take a fancy to him, he was dragged into his experimental project.
After all, the first batch of experimental project had such a high amount of funding. It was obvious that the company and higher consortia had high hopes. Moreover they heard that Dudian was researching the Cure Experiment which hadn’t progressed for many years, once the experiment was successful, it would be a world-shaking work. They would become top experts and be recorded in the textbooks for hundreds of years.
Even if the experiment failed, it wouldn’t affect them much. The main person in charge was Dudian.
“I heard that Qin Mo is the illegitimate child of a director of the Consortium?”
“If he isn’t an illegitimate child, why would the consortium allow the company to do such nonsense? How is this research? It is obviously a waste of money!”
“A young man in his twenties is the director of an experimental project. It would be hilarious if word got out.”
“This is simply nonsense. Previously, the highest authority given to the company was to allow him to participate in our experiment. Anyway, he was just looking around and didn’t know anything. Now, he’s actually throwing money at him to play with. He’s really treating science as child’s Play!”
“It’s just a game for rich people, why do you have to take it seriously?”
“Sigh, we should do our own experiment. I guess when his experiment fails, it won’t be long before he is transferred away by the consortium. Maybe the other side is just doing experiments on a whim.”
Many experts in the company were discussing in private. This matter even spread to the ears of the ordinary experts.
Dudian heard the discussions of the crowd. He smiled. Although they didn’t dare to talk in front of him but his sense of hearing was so sharp that it was no problem to cover the entire building, although the sound insulation effect of each floor of the building was very good but his magic marks had the ability of ‘Super Sense’. He could hear clearly even in a completely sealed soundproof room.
“Don’t say that you can’t figure out what the consortium is thinking. Even I myself can’t figure it out.”Dudian smiled in his heart. After the meal, he considered the names of the experts who would establish the experimental project. There were only four of them, among them were Zhang Lanxin and Kong Zhi who taught him knowledge. There was also Chu Huiru and another Chinese old man named Malone. They were the only ones who weren’t jealous and sarcastic.
After receiving Dudian’s invitation, the four of them quickly went to the laboratory that Dudian applied for. Chu Huiru asked in surprise: “Qin Mo, are you going to invite me to participate in Your Experimental Project?”
“Yes, are you willing?”Dudian smiled.
Chu Huiru thought for a moment: “There is no problem. I don’t have any experimental project recently anyway. I just want to do some research.”
“I have no problem.”Ma long said.
“Little Qin, both of them are experts in undead research. They have many years of research experience. You are right to look for them. But you have invited me and Kong to participate. We are not good at this...”Zhang Lan was worried.
Dudian smiled: “Grandma Lan Xin, you and Kong have profound insights in the field of biological genetics and neurology. You will be able to play a different role in undead research. You have something in common with each other. Moreover you have studied monsters for many years. Maybe you can find something in common with the undeads and monsters and make a breakthrough in the experiment!”
Zhang Lanxin was tongue-tied: “Really?”
“Let’s try.”Dudian said.
Kong Zhi thought for a moment, “It makes sense. In that case, we will try. But Little Qin, why did you choose to do this research?”? “You should know that curing the undeads is basically impossible. The probability of failure is very high. If it fails, then so much money...”
“It’s okay. The consortium has money. They can afford to spend it.”Dudian said in an imposing manner. However the smile on his face had disappeared.
Kong Zhi and Zhang Lanxin looked at each other. They thought of the rumors outside and were relieved. If Dudian was really the illegitimate son of a director and was just thrown over to play, then it wouldn’t be a big deal if he lost money, at most they would be criticized. If it was them then they would be disgraced and kicked out of the company. Other companies wouldn’t dare to use such a resume.
The few of them didn’t refute. Dudian signed a non-disclosure contract with the four of them and officially started the project.
The funds for the experiment had been transferred into Dudian’s company account. He could use the company’s internal shopping channels to buy materials for the experiment. For example, the research undeads cost 50,000 federal dollars each, compared to the ones on the market, it was half cheaper. He bought ten of them in bulk. There were different kinds of undeads. There were men, women and children. The undeads were infected by the human race.
The next day.
Dudian, Zhang Lanxin and the other three held a meeting to discuss the experiment plan. After three days of continuous discussion, they finally formulated the experimental guidelines.
Zhang Lanxin and the other three took over most of the work of the experiment. Dudian didn’t participate but was alone in another research. He was the director. Although the others felt strange but they didn’t think too much about it, dudian was a rich young master who came to play but they could take this opportunity to study the undeads. Even if they failed in the end they could accumulate valuable experimental experience.
Dudian moved a set of equipment to his laboratory office. The research on the UNDEADS was just a pretense for him. Although he was eager to find a way to cure the undeads, but in the past three months he had learned a lot from the company’s experimental materials. He knew that it was a difficult task. It wasn’t something that he could accomplish in a few months.
The most important thing for him was to leave this place and regain his freedom. He would have the opportunity to slowly do research in the future.
“Last time I saw that there was a god in my heart. I don’t know the current situation of this god. The composition of the heart and my own body. Why can my body contain many kinds of magic marks...”Dudian’s eyes flashed, scarlet Moon had transformed his body. He had grasped the power but he wasn’t clear about the source of the power. He could only use it instinctively. It was obviously not good for him to think about how to improve the power in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 1124
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1124: Chapter 1113: Life Progression
Translator: 549690339
Dudian checked every corner of the office before preparing the experiment. After confirming that there was no monitoring, he turned off the computer system to record the experiment. Then he turned off the synchro networking function of many instruments, he turned these instruments into original individual instruments. Without the synchro networking function, the instruments would be weakened in data comparison and analysis. But once they were connected to the Internet, there was a possibility that they would be stolen.
“In this way, even if the Terras consortium can use some authority to control the network, or if there are experts like hackers behind it, they won’t be able to steal my research.”
Dudian moved out of the office all the equipment that needed to be connected to the internet. He only left the equipment that could be used even if it was not connected to the internet. Although this would increase the difficulty of his research, but it was worth it.
“This office is my territory. They can’t monitor me. I don’t know how long they can endure before they come to find me...”Dudian’s mouth curved as he began to study.
He extracted his blood, hair, bones and different organs and tissues for analysis.
