After the analysis of the data he bought the federation’s cultivated demon warriors through the company’s channels. At different stages they were from hunters to pioneers. As for the Master and Abyss Level Demon Warriors, the price was over 100 million, he could only wait for the second batch of funds from the consortium.
These demon warriors were sent to the laboratory. Their bodies were bound by chains and injected with special drugs. They could only exert the strength of ordinary people and become Dudian’s experimental objects.
Zhang Lanxin and others were surprised when they saw the three demon warriors that Dudian had bought. They asked Dudian but Dudian only said that his research was useful. The four of them didn’t say anything, after all, Dudian was the director and sponsor of the project. He had the right to control the funds. They could only use the equipment in the laboratory to busy themselves with their research.
The three demon warriors were tied to the iron frame of the office. It seemed that they knew their tragic fate but no one resisted. Their eyes were filled with despair. It seemed that they had lost their will to live.
Dudian disassembled them one by one. Brain tissue, heart, magic marks, blood and other parts. In his hands they seemed to be lifeless machines. He activated the networking function of the equipment when he was studying the demon fighters. The company knew that he had purchased the demon fighters for experiments. Even if the consortium used the networking function to know the data of the demon fighters.., it wasn’t a big deal for Dudian. After all, these demon warriors were the products of the federation. They should have been on the experimental bench of the consortia.
Dudian’s research speed was greatly increased after the instrument was connected to the network. Many data were automatically analyzed by the system. He didn’t need to slowly analyze them and record them one by one.
“This is the picture of magic marks and human beings...”Dudian looked at the three’s physical condition through the genetic level. The hunter’s DNA was mixed with less magic marks DNA. It was about one-tenth of the original, just one-tenth of the magic marks DNA had changed the hunter’s original human DNA.
The most direct manifestation of this change was that the hunter’s strength was beyond that of ordinary people. In addition, when the adrenal glands were secreted, it would stimulate the body. The magic marks DNA in the body would cover a large area of human DNA in a short period of time, the magic marks on the body would change and a monster-like body would appear. However, this state could not be maintained for long.
When the magic marks DNA covered the body, the cells would quickly divide. There was a limit to a person’s cell division. When the division reached a certain level, the cells would wither and die. Activating the magic marks power was equivalent to overdrawing one’s life!
Dudian understood why the hunters in Sylvia died at the age of 70-80. Although they had been modified by the magic marks DNA, the speed of cell division was much slower, moreover the number of times had increased but the years of battle had consumed their lives.
If the lifespan of an ordinary human was around 80 years, then the lifespan of a hunter would be 150 years. But the years of battle had made their lifespan similar to that of an ordinary human. In fact, they would age faster and die earlier than ordinary people!
In contrast, the DNA of the limiter was mixed with the Magic Mark DNA. It was about one-seventh. When the body was stimulated to enter the magic body, the coverage of the Magic Mark DNA reached one-third, this was why when the hunter stimulated the power of the magic mark, the appearance of the Hunter was similar to that of a human. The only difference was that the eyes of the hunter changed color, or the teeth grew, or the nails grew longer. But when the frontiersman stimulated the power of the magic mark, the body would appear to be mutated, for example, the arm turned into the claws of the monster and became non-human and non-beast.
When the frontiersman arrived, half of the Magic Mark DNA was mixed into the body of the frontiersman. The body of the frontiersman changed greatly during the battle. The arms turned into claws of the beast, or extended out the tail, the head had horns and so on. The transformation was extremely obvious, it was also known as the “Magic Body”!
From their experiments, it could be seen that the later stage of the battle, the more closely the magic DNA and human DNA combined. Dudian thought of all the stages of the strong who used the magic body to fight. Once in the Abyss, once they entered the magic body.., basically, they were completely transformed into beasts and no human shadow could be seen. Although the human face was still visible, but the eyes and the skin on the face were not human, or his skin was colloid or scaly.
“The DNA in the Pioneer’s body is a molecular double-chain structure, but mine is a triangular structure. Each side of the triangular structure is made of different DNA. On one side is the human part of my body, on the other side is the Aragami factor, and on the other side is the white factor. It is like the genetic structure of the polar ice worm...”Dudian didn’t know if the other abyss was like this, however, he felt that this possibility was very small.
However, what made him feel strange was that the higher the physique of the Magic Mark Warrior, the more magic mark DNA he had. However, the human genes in his body were very strong. They were not devoured by the Aragami factor, they were not covered by the polar ice magic bugs either.
In addition, his splitter, turtle shell and other Magic Mark DNA did not appear in the structure of his DNA. It seemed that they did not exist in his body.
He repeatedly checked but couldn’t find the DNA of these magic marks. He could only give up for the time being and began to scan his own heart.
The embryo in his heart was beating slightly with the heart. The heart wrapped around it as if it was its breeding ground. However, it seemed that this heart was its heart. Every time it beat, its body was slightly stretched, it was as if life was breathing.
“When it is born, it may be the time of my death...”Dudian’s eyes sank. This was a time bomb in his body and he didn’t know when it would hatch.
He carefully extracted part of the heart tissue so as not to stimulate the heart and the embryo.
It was just a little bit of tissue. Although he felt a little pain, but he could endure it. After all, his constitution was not an ordinary person.
If his original heart was still there, he felt that even if he was shot through, he would be able to recover and not die.

chapters.title: Chapter 1125
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1125: Chapter 1114: God said
Translator: 549690339
“This part is the pure structure of the Aragami Factor...”Dudian’s eyes lit up. The pure flesh of the Aragami was living in his body, it had become the core organ of his body to supply blood to his body. It was involved in all aspects and there was no repulsion. It was like the body of a beast. It would only cause the tissues around the body to die but there was no such situation around his heart. The flesh of the Aragami and his body seemed to be integrated into one body.
Through Research Dudian found that the flesh of the Aragami seemed to be a collection of Aragami elements in his body. The Aragami genes were too powerful so they didn’t completely integrate into his body, they were gathered together in the form of a heart. This meant that as long as he could find an organ that could replace the heart, he could remove the golden heart. He could also embed the flesh of the Aragami into other parts of his body, for example, fingers. The wings of the Aragami could increase his fighting ability.
The embryo in the heart seemed very small. The structure of the embryo was very unstable. Dudian estimated that he wouldn’t be in any danger in the short term.
He used all kinds of instruments to continue his in-depth research.
In the following days, he bought a lot of materials from the company’s internal shopping channels. There were different kinds of undeads and different kinds of monsters. He also bought a batch of insects and monsters. Half a month later.., he also bought some plants contaminated by nuclear radiation from the company’s channels. There were also some strange semi-biological plants.
For some unknown reason, this semi-biological plant grew flesh-like tissue. If it was injured, it would bleed red blood or dark green blood.
Although there weren’t many such plants in the post-disaster world, but the federation had searched for hundreds of years and found countless of them. It was detailed in the textbooks.
Dudian thought of the despair forest that he had encountered when he first stepped into the abyss. There were enormous plants lurking underground, waiting for the opportunity to kill the creatures on the surface. No matter if it was a human or a powerful monster, they would become food on the plate, they would be digested until there were no bones left.
In the old era, there were plants like venus flytrap that would passively prey on the things that touched it. But the roots and vines in the despair forest that Dudian had encountered were extremely fierce. It was as if they were conscious.
For Dudian, living plants were not that shocking.
Zhang Lanxin and others were speechless and confused by Dudian’s series of actions. They didn’t know what he was doing. He was clearly studying the undeads but he had found a lot of messy things, could it be that they wanted to find the common points of the undeads from these monsters and plants?
They could only think of this explanation. Although they felt that it was a bit whimsical, but they couldn’t dissuade Dudian.
..
..
In the highest building of the Terras Consortium’s manor.
Black Slody was dressed in formal clothes. He lowered his head and walked into the starry room. There were deep darkness and vast stars under his feet. The world around him seemed to be infinitely distant, it was as though he was truly in the vast universe. This was no longer his first time here, and he wasn’t as stunned as he had been in the past, silently counting the steps in his heart.
“Lord Sovereign, the Demon Kid You Asked Me to take care of has applied for a new batch of research funds from the consortium. Is there a need to approve it?”Hei Si Luo di stopped and respectfully asked.
“Approved.”One word. His voice was extremely indifferent, carrying an awe-inspiring majesty that could look down on all living things.
Heslodi respectfully acknowledged, and then he said, “Lord Sovereign, you asked us to monitor that demon kid, but he does experiments in his office every day. In addition, he has destroyed all of the surveillance equipment in his office, and none of the equipment is connected to the internet. Without alerting the enemy, we can only guess what he is doing through his consumption channels. Only, his behavior is a bit strange, as if he is playing around. I suspect that he is intentionally consuming us, or is testing our patience.”
After he finished speaking, there was no sound above his head.
While Heslodi was feeling nervous.., that extremely indifferent voice slowly said, “He just thought he was smart. He thought that he could deceive others by destroying the surveillance cameras, but he didn’t know that it was a cover-up. The stupidity of mortals is nothing more than this.”
Heslodi was stunned for a second and said, “Could it be that he is secretly planning something?”
“He is borrowing the high-end equipment of the laboratory to study his own body. It seems that he is very confused about his own body. This also shows how backward the Demon Race Empire’s society is, and how weak they are!”That indifferent voice had a hint of arrogance, it seemed to be filled with disdain.
Hei Si Luo di lowered his head and laughed. “Lord Sovereign is right. How can the demon race empire’s civilization compare to ours? They are just a group of ignorant primitive people whose minds have been blinded by power. If it wasn’t for finding remnants of civilization in the ruins of the old era, they would probably still be living a life of raw meat and blood.”
“The demons have been fighting frequently recently. It seems that there are some unusual movements. You must send people to investigate the reason.”
“Yes.”
“Leave.”
Black Slody bowed his head and slowly left the room. He was relieved when the door closed behind him. His expression turned solemn as he looked at the hole-shaped monitor above his head, he slowly walked out.
..
... ..
Two months passed.
Dudian came out of the laboratory and felt a sense of revival. When the sunlight shone on his body from outside the window, he felt that his stiff body seemed to have recovered a bit of vitality.
In the past two months, the progress of Zhang Lanxin and the others was extremely slow. They had failed many times but the results were very few. This made the four of them suffer a blow. However, they were glad that Dudian didn’t blame them because of this, if it was any other laboratory, they wouldn’t have given them a good face. They would have declared the project a failure.
However, Dudian continued to insist.
His persistence not only touched Zhang Lanxin and the others but also made him surprised.
Two months of in-depth research on many kinds of life. Originally it was to compare with his own body, Aragami factor and magic marks genes. But in the process of research, it was as if a beautiful new world had opened up, he saw the richness of life and even saw the essence of life!
At present, if he was willing, he could even perform brain surgery to transfer brain tissue to another body so that life could continue in the new body.
Such top-notch surgery could only be done by the top medical experts in the federation. Moreover, the failure rate was very high. Even many rich people didn’t dare to try it unless they were forced to die, only then would they take the risk to try it.
“The fragility of life, the tenacity of life, the essence of life, the ultimate of life...”Dudian stood in front of the window and looked at the Sun in the distance. His eyes were shining: “Maybe there really is a god in this world!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1126
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1126: Chapter 1115: God’s path
Translator: 549690339
In Dudian’s view, life had evolved to the limit and all its potential had been stimulated. It was enough to be called “God”!
The so-called God had an endless lifespan and was omnipotent. Its power could destroy the world. Even nuclear weapons wouldn’t be able to kill it!
“The potential of life has been brought into full play. It is enough to become such an existence...”through research, Dudian saw this possibility. For example, the polar ice worm had a long lifespan and could adapt to all kinds of harsh environments, no matter how powerful the toxin was, the environment was oxygen-deficient or there was no food, it could survive. The only way to kill it was to freeze it at absolute zero or high temperature.
Under absolute zero freezing, its body could be destroyed. But once it was out of absolute zero, it would recover again. The high temperature would be even more thorough and it would be destroyed into dust.
This was also the reason why the nuclear weapons of the old era had been used to repel the demonic insects.
Compared to the polar ice worm, the Aragami seemed to be its natural enemy. The omnivorous nature of the Aragami cells allowed them to completely devour and digest the tough cells of the polar ice worm! Through research, it was discovered that other than the polar ice worm, the Aragami genes could also devour other living beings and turn them into their own food. They could even digest plants. It could be said that they were super omnivorous animals.
Even rocks and soil could be extracted from them!
They could eat anything!
If the abilities of these two races were combined, in Dudian’s eyes, they would be invincible and God!
His body contained these two kinds of genes. This was probably the crystallization of Crimson Moon’s research. She also thought that he was a god!
“All along, I thought that magic marks brought strength to the body. I didn’t expect that it was not the case.”Dudian’s eyes flashed. These two months of research had allowed him to see the relationship between magic marks and the human body, just like the relationship between the key and the treasure. Magic marks were just a key to stimulate the potential of the body and bring out the ability of magic marks. In fact, the potential of the cells was extremely broad.
Different magic marks brought different abilities. Just like different keys to open the same treasure house. But each door was different so the power released was different! The magic marks were only the primer, and the source of the power still came from oneself.
This was just like how humans, when infected with different viruses, would develop different diseases and have different changes. However, if it was a stone, there would not be such a change. After all, the root of the change was.., it was still because humans had the ability to extend such changes!
When he was researching earlier, he did not see his own magic mark genes in the gene chain. Later on, he found out that these magic mark genes had long been devoured by the Aragami factor, and the door that they opened had been permanently opened!
This meant that even if he were to peel off the magic mark, he also possessed such an ability.
For ordinary hunters or even pioneers, once the magic mark was peeled off and replaced with a new magic mark, the original magic mark ability would be lost. This was because the hidden door in their bodies was not enough to be opened by their own power. Simply put.., just like when the door was halfway open, and the key was pulled out, the door would automatically close.
However, the Aragami’s genes had melted the key. It was completely embedded in the hole of the ‘door’so the door couldn’t be closed again.
This discovery was of great significance to Dudian!
He didn’t dare to absorb too many magic marks because he was afraid that his strength would be complicated. He was afraid that his body would be damaged. He was like a glutton who would eventually die from abdominal fissure torture.
However, now that he knew the reason, he could absorb different magic marks without any restraint. He could use these magic marks to activate many of his body’s abilities.
However, when he saw the possibility of a “God,”the surprise was not that big.
In his opinion, this was an ability that was naturally mastered after one’s life had advanced to a certain level. Perhaps after one surpassed a king, one would possess such an ability. One did not need to use magic marks to just rely on the tempering and control of one’s genes, one could make the genes extend out different abilities. Every cell in the body was like one’s own fingers. They could be controlled and trained at will.
One could make a fist or a sword finger. The variability of cells was far more complicated than five fingers. They could change thousands of times. If one wanted to condense clairvoyance, they could condense it. If one wanted to grow scales on the body.., then they could grow scales.
At this stage, they would no longer be humans or beasts. They could transform into beasts, giants, rocks, water... in Dudian’s eyes.., this was the evolution of life that had been tempered to the extreme. In other words, it was ‘God’!
It sounded like a fantasy but it was the possibility that Dudian saw with the most sophisticated high-end equipment. If his research data were published online, it would be enough to shake the scientific community of the Federation, it would shatter the worldview of countless people.
However, Dudian never thought that things that couldn’t be explained by technology didn’t exist. Moreover, what he saw brought about this conjecture. It was exactly what the scientific instruments helped him to see.
Technology and knowledge were just tools to help people understand the universe. If technology couldn’t be explained, it didn’t mean that it didn’t exist.
Existence was the truth. If technology couldn’t explain it, it could only mean that technology was too backward.
“The magic mark is like a phantom. The process of releasing the power of the magic mark is just like how a human body can copy the Phantom of the magic mark. During the hunter stage, it can only copy as few as a Phoenix’s feather or a qilin’s horn. At the Abyss Walker stage, it can completely copy the power of the magic mark, turning into a monster and increasing its combat power. But in the end, these are just copies. Once the “Original painting”of the magic mark is gone, it will lose its power.”
“But how can the real strong rely on copying?”? “The king of the Empire was unable to copy but the magic marks were living in his brain. He was like an infatuated painter. He was completely infatuated with the concept of the masterpiece and forgot about himself.”
“In the Empire, the earliest warriors were not magic marks warriors but witcher warriors like Aisha. The flesh and blood of the monsters were also similar to copying. However, after the witcher warriors gradually disappeared, they were not replaced by the magic marks warriors. There seems to be a gap in the middle. Perhaps, there was once a warrior who evolved by himself and showed extraordinary strength!”Dudian’s eyes flashed, the top-secret information and some historical records that he had read in his mind flashed across his mind. It was not impossible!
However, if there was, it meant that the empire’s waters were deeper than he had imagined!
If there was a warrior who had evolved beyond the strength of ordinary people, why did he disappear without a Trace?
Unfortunately, he did not come into contact with the core secrets of the empire, including what he saw now. It was also a path that he had explored by relying on the instruments in the federation to detect it.
Who was the one who came up with the advanced methods of hunters, limiters, pioneers, and even the abyss? Who came up with it? Would the empire honestly impart this method to all the citizens of the giant wall?

chapters.title: Chapter 1127
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1127: Chapter 1116: Come
Translator: 549690339
Dudian wanted to explore the secrets behind the empire. But he knew that he couldn’t protect himself with his current strength. However the research had brought him a huge harvest. He saw the shadow of ‘God’.
There was a possibility to do so.
“Using magic marks to stimulate is just a drop in the bucket. It Won’t stimulate my full potential. I need to find a more efficient way through research...”Dudian thought, but it was very difficult to take this step. He wasn’t the first one to see this possibility. For example, Boro and Crimson Moon had done research which showed that they had also seen such a life state.
It was just like how humans saw the Sun. But to climb up to the sun was ten thousand times more difficult?
After a short rest, dudian continued to invest in new experiments. This time he was no longer studying himself so he connected all the instruments in the office to the Internet.
“Consortium will find out about my research through the network of instruments. They won’t be able to understand what I’m studying. Instead they will think that they know my secret but they won’t know that I cut off the Internet to study my own body.”Dudian thought, he no longer closed the office after a few days of research and ded himself to his own experiment.
At this time, the experimental data that he had read before came into play. There were many experts who tried to stimulate the potential of life, such as electrical stimulation, nerve pain stimulation and so on.
For Dudian, the effect of nerve pain stimulation was obviously not great. He had fought countless battles since he woke up and suffered countless injuries. It was clear that the effect of this method was too bad, so he could only choose to use electrical stimulation.
He used the internal channels of the company to buy new materials. There were undeads, monsters, special bloodthirsty plants, and young men and women of different ages. The price of ordinary people who didn’t have any skills was very low. Compared to the higher prices, ordinary people were trained as maids or had special talents.
Zhang Lanxin and others were not surprised when they saw the undeads and monsters. They were surprised when they saw four young men and women of different ages, chu huiru quickly asked Dudian: “Qin Mo, have you reached the Living Body Stage of your experiment?”
Dudian vaguely replied: “Almost. I have some confidence.”
The four people were shocked. They didn’t expect that Dudian would be locked in the office for two months. The four people were excited and expectant. Although they felt that the probability of Dudian’s success was very low, but they couldn’t help but hold a glimmer of hope.
The four young men and women who were transported saw the surrounding environment and the conversation of Zhang Lanxin’s group. Their faces were pale and their eyes were filled with despair.
However, even the kind and merciful Zhang Lanxin didn’t plead for them. She only showed a bit of pity. This wasn’t because Zhang Lanxin had seen through people’s hearts because of the debt collection, she had seen a lot of such things. Moreover, she had personally experimented with living people. For her, this was a job and didn’t involve any other emotions.
Moreover, the company had told them about the origins of these people. They were volunteers that the company had spent money to recruit from the society.
The experiment continued.
One week later.
Suddenly two people came to Dudian’s laboratory. Zhang Lanxin and others who were busy with their own experiments saw the two people. They were shocked. They quickly stopped the experiment and took off their silicone gloves, they came to the front of the two people and greeted them politely.
“Boss!”
“Mr. Wendi.”
“Mr. Wendi!”
Zhang Lanxin and the others greeted him one by one.
The “Mr. Wendi”they called him stood on the left side. He was tall and slender. He wore a black suit and was meticulous. He was wearing a mechanical watch made by a famous master. He had golden hair. Although he looked to be in his forties, he was very handsome, he was a handsome uncle. The person next to him was a burly man with short hair. His eyes were as sharp as lightning. He was Chinese and wore a sleeveless green shirt. His muscles were bulging and he looked like a bodyguard.
Zhang Lanxin and the others directly ignored this person. However, the next moment, they realized that the CEO of Randy’s Company was also the biggest BOSS of the company. He only smiled slightly, then, he said to the burly man next to him with some politeness and humility, “He’s inside. Please wait a moment.”After he said that, he instructed Zhang Lanxin, “Call Qin mo out.”
Zhang Lanxin and the others were very sensitive when it came to observing people’s expressions. They were immediately shocked. They took a deep look at the burly man who looked like a bodyguard and two words appeared in their minds: Financial Group.
Only the people from the Tesla consortium would make Wright so polite. Otherwise, with his identity as the boss of Randy’s company, he wouldn’t have to be so humble even in front of the directors of the Rockefeller Consortium and Milan Consortium.
“Are you looking for me?”Dudian walked out of the laboratory. When the two came to the building, he noticed that they were talking casually with each other. It was the people from the headquarters of the Tesla Consortium, it seemed that they were going to take him away.
Zhang Lanxin saw that Dudian had come out so she didn’t go forward. She asked Wright: “Boss, why are you looking for Little Qin?”
“There is nothing for you here. You can go out first.”Wright shook his head. His attitude was a bit cold.
Zhang Lanxin, Chu Huiru and others looked at each other. It seemed that they felt that the person who came was not friendly. In the past, Wright would always greet them with a smile. He was the pillar of the company, he was very polite to the guests and would never be so rude.
However, the other party was the boss, so they had no temper and could only leave.
Before leaving.., zhang Lanxin said with a worried expression, “Boss, if Little Qin’s experiment made the company feel awkward or spent too much money, I hope you can be merciful. I can take part of the burden for Little Qin. The failure of the experiment is not his fault alone...”
Wright shook his head and smiled: “Alright, go out. You Don’t need to worry about it.”
Zhang Lan wanted to say something but stopped. She was dragged away by Kong Zhi who was next to her.
When the door of the laboratory was closed, Wright wanted to talk to Dudian but saw that Dudian was already sitting on the chair next to him. He crossed his legs as if he was the master of the two guests.
His eyebrows slightly raised. He was unhappy but he knew the identity of the latter. His face was cold: “Mr. Qin Mo, the consortium wants to see you. Please go.”
Dudian looked at the strong man next to him with interest, “Rank 10, oh no, it should be rank 11. I didn’t think that the consortium of the Federation could cultivate such a strong person. I remember that rank 9 is the master. Rank 10 is the abyss. Rank 11 is the standard of the Middle Abyss in the empire. I don’t know what kind of power you would be able to display if you were to pilot the non-consortium’s Monster Mech.”
Wenti was stunned and turned to look at the man next to him.
The eyes of the bodyguard-like burly man narrowed slightly. Then, he smiled coldly and said, “No wonder you are a genuine demon. Your perception is very strong.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1128
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1128: Chapter 1117: fierce battle
Translator: 549690339
“Is the consortium finally unable to endure?”Dudian looked at him with interest.
Wright couldn’t help but ask: “Did you know that we knew your identity?”
“Are you talking about tongue twister?”Dudian glanced at the boss of the company, “They suddenly invited me to the consortium. I want to know the reason. is the observation period over or are they going to interrogate me?”
The strong man coldly said: “You will know the specific reason when you get to the consortium.”
Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows and smiled: “So you are ready to kidnap me? This is the central area of Odin District. How much damage do you think will be caused if a battle breaks out here?”
Wright’s eyelids twitched. He couldn’t help but look at the burly man next to him.
The burly man sneered: “The higher-ups said that if you resist then you will be killed! If you don’t want to die then come with us!”
“Do you mean to threaten me?”Dudian looked at him with a smile.
The burly man sneered: “You can understand it that way.”
Dudian gently tapped the table with his finger, he whispered: “There are eight level 10 experts in the building, eight laser guns, three god of creation mechs, five thousand troops and twelve combat helicopters waiting in the emergency tunnel three streets away. Is this the confidence you have to threaten me?”
Wright’s face changed and the muscular man’s pupils shrank.
At this time, the smile on Dudian’s face disappeared bit by bit. He slowly stood up and coldly looked at the muscular man: “Come over and kneel!”
“What? !”The muscular man felt that he had heard something incredible, his eyes opened wide and he laughed out loud, “So what if you have sensed it?”? “I was afraid of your strength. Since your perception is so strong, it means that you are a demon warrior with a weak combat ability. Since you know that we are fully prepared, you should be obedient...”
“Noisy!”
Dudian snorted as his body moved as fast as an afterimage.
The Strong Man’s face changed as he pushed away Wright. His skin had mutated and entered the devil’s body. However, only a thin layer of skin like scales had grown on his skin, a cold face appeared in front of him.
The Strong Man’s face turned pale as he instinctively raised his hand to resist.
Crack!
The Brawny Man felt his body sink down. Dudian was one head shorter than him but at this moment he had to look up to see him. He was kneeling on the ground, however his kneeling posture was very strange. His knees were bent back and bent into ninety degrees. Dudian’s hand was firmly holding onto his shoulder so that his body couldn’t move and stand up.
“You!”
The Brawny man grimaced in pain. His eyes exploded. He felt a great humiliation. At the same time, he felt a chill down his spine. Especially when he saw Dudian’s cold eyes. He felt like he was being stared at by a wild tiger. He didn’t dare to believe it, according to the information it was said that the demon race wasn’t the abyss. Why was it so strong? The speed of the demon race was so fast that even the naked eye couldn’t keep up with it!
“It seems that the Abyss cultivated by the federation is a fake product.”Dudian casually said.
Wright got up from the ground. He was shocked as he saw the strong man’s knees. The shadow of the demon race had been engraved in the memory of his generation, at the moment he saw Dudian’s vicious means. It was like confirming the rumors. He couldn’t wait to escape from this place.
“You... You Can’t run away!”The man clenched his teeth as he endured the pain in his knees. His forehead was covered in sweat, he trembled: “As long as you leave this place, they will kill you immediately. The god of Creation Mechs will attack and destroy you. No matter how strong you are, you won’t be able to withstand the encirclement of three god of creation mechs. Our Army will evacuate the people in the vicinity. We Won’t give you the chance to take hostages. Even if you take hostages, it won’t affect our judgement. We can completely suppress them if they die!”
He said these words in one breath, but his heart couldn’t help but beat. After all, his life and death were in the hands of others. It was a feeling that he couldn’t help but be afraid.
“The consortium asked you to take me there. What are you going to do?”Dudian faintly asked.
The burly man was startled: “I don’t know. I was ordered to bring you back to the consortium.”
“You don’t Know?”Dudian narrowed his eyes, “The consortium has known my identity for a long time. They have allowed me to live here. There are creator Mechs waiting for orders and a lot of monitoring. Although I seem to be free but I have been raised in this company. Now they want me to join the consortium. Do you think this is a good thing or a bad thing?”
The Burly Man’s face slightly changed: “I don’t know. Perhaps only the directors know that you can’t escape. It is better to surrender.”
Dudian patted his face and smiled, “It seems that the consortium knows that I am an abyss level demon. But they have allowed an abyss demon to live in this prosperous area. They are not afraid that I will go crazy and kill everyone. It shows that the consortium’s leader is not only confident but also cold-blooded. He is confident enough to destroy me in this prosperous city. He doesn’t mind killing some civilians. It is difficult for me to think that he is kind.”
The Burly Man’s face turned ugly: “What do you want?”
“Freedom.”Dudian laughed.
The burly man was stunned.
Dudian snapped the neck of the burly man. At the same time he lowered his head and shot out like lightning.
Puff! Puff!
Four laser beams shot out at the moment he lowered his head. They pierced through the windows of the building and burned several black marks on the ground. Wright’s body trembled in fear.
Dudian rushed out of the building. His whole body was demonized and his back was dissected. He nimbly flapped in the air and jumped into a nearby building. There was a restaurant in the building and the scenery was beautiful, there were many socialites sitting in the building. There was melodious music. At this moment, as the glass outside the building broke, all the tranquility was broken.
Dudian rushed in and saw a young man wearing a black hood sitting by the window. He was holding a metal laser cannon.
“Die!”Dudian dived down. The wide blade cut through the corridor of the restaurant. The floor and walls were cracked. Two waiters were standing in the corridor in a daze. They were holding red wine and plates, dudian’s body was cut in two by the wings.
The youth holding the metal laser gun saw Dudian running towards him. His face changed. His skin turned green and his arms stretched like vines. He gave up on the laser gun. He broke the window and escaped.

chapters.title: Chapter 1129
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1129: Chapter 1118: Encirclement and kill
Translator: 549690339
Dudian quickly chased after them. He was about to dive down when a dangerous omen came. He stopped in time and shot down several lasers from less than half a meter in front of him.
“Bye Bye!”The youth who climbed out of the building saw that Dudian was shocked by the laser cannon. His heart was relieved. He smiled and didn’t stay any longer, his body stuck to the glass of the building like a gecko. He quickly climbed to the far side. As long as he was far away from Dudian, the long distance laser shots from the others would be enough to kill him.
Puff!
Suddenly, a burning feeling came from his forehead.
The youth’s smile froze on his face. His eyes were wide open and full of disbelief. There was an indescribable fear and despair.
When the world went dark, the body of the young man fell from the building. It hit the flower bed on the side of the road and made a loud noise. The passersby were stunned.
Dudian’s eyes were indifferent. He turned around and stomped his feet. The restaurant was filled with panic and horror. He broke out of the window. The huge black wings spread out like a giant eagle, dudian rushed to the rooftop of another building. There were two figures holding laser cannons. One was a man and the other was a woman. They were wearing sunglasses. They looked like killers.
There was a trace of panic on their faces as they saw Dudian rush over. They immediately used the laser cannon to lock onto Dudian’s body. However Dudian’s body was floating in the air. He moved away from the scope before he took aim. After several times they finally knew that they couldn’t lock onto Dudian’s body with the laser cannon. After all, it was not a missile, they could install an automatic tracking function.
“Run!”
The two panicked and shot a few shots to slow down Dudian’s speed. They turned and ran to the other side of the building.
They activated their magic bodies. The woman was like a spider. She was crawling on the ground. Her abdomen was extremely swollen. A large number of small spiders shot out from her lower body. These small spiders scattered around the rooftop. They quickly pulled the web in an attempt to intercept dudian.
“Die!”
Dudian was in mid-air. He didn’t plan to land. Cold light flashed in his eyes. Two beams of light shot out from the red gem protruding from his forehead. They went into the back of the spider woman and the neck of the crocodile man, both of their bodies stopped as if they were electrocuted. They fell to the ground. The laser cannon in their arms was thrown out of the rooftop and fell into the street.
Dudian didn’t stop. His body drew an arc as he rushed towards another building.
“How is it possible!”
The five people who were hiding in the other three buildings saw this scene. Their faces were full of shock. They couldn’t believe that under the encirclement of the eight of them, the target had killed three of their teammates at lightning speed, they weren’t ordinary people but super experts who had obtained the power of the demon race. They were able to look down on the people of the federation.
It had been a long time since they had felt the threat of death since they had obtained the power of the demon race. However at this moment they felt a chill down their spine. They could feel the thick killing intent and shadow from the figure of the Devil, in comparison they seemed to have degenerated into ordinary people who could only rely on guns. Even if they had guns they wouldn’t be able to aim and kill them!
“This is not an ordinary abyss demon!”Two snipers looked at Dudian who was rushing towards another building. Their faces were full of fear. They tried to aim but Dudian’s figure was like a ghost, they couldn’t lock onto the target and could only shoot randomly. However they were evaded. It seemed that the enemy clearly knew the time and location of their shots!
“Hey, Hey! Headquarters, headquarters! Requesting reinforcements. The enemy is not an ordinary Abyss!”
“What’s going on?”A dignified voice came from the earpiece.
The two reported anxiously, “The enemy easily killed Myron. He can dodge our laser cannon shots. He has the power that surpasses an ordinary abyss. He also has the ability to fly. He also has the ability to shoot from a distance. He is suspected to be firing laser-like attacks. At the same time, he has super strong perceptive abilities!”
After saying so much in one breath, the two of them felt a trace of fear in their hearts. They suddenly realized that the target’s magic marks ability covered too much area. Magic marks that were good at perceptive ability were naturally weaker in combat. They had different aspects to focus on! However, the target seemed to have displayed an all-rounded ability up until now. Every single one of them was incomparably powerful. What kind of rare magic marks was this? !
Compared to this, their magic marks abilities were simply not on the same level!
“How is this possible? ! Chairman, why are you here? What?”A series of exclamations came from the earpiece, causing the two of them to be stunned. Very quickly, the boss in the earpiece seemed to have taken a deep breath. He adjusted his breathing and gave the order, “Everyone, retreat to the front line and cooperate with the creator god Mecha to kill the target!”
The words were transmitted to everyone’s earphones through their communication channel. The voice of the boss echoed in the earphones of the three dead people. Unfortunately, they couldn’t hear it anymore.
However, the remaining five or four people were relieved after receiving the order and immediately retreated.
“Retreat?”Dudian threw away the demonized snake-people who had their necks broken. He glanced at the four people in two groups in the other two buildings. He saw that they were in a hurry to retreat, he released his perception into a wider range. He saw that the three god of creation mechs in the underground emergency tunnel had been activated and were surrounding the building.
In addition, the army in the tunnel had all moved out to evacuate the people in the surrounding buildings.
“Are you ready to get on the mechs?”Dudian narrowed his eyes. It was the first time he had seen a god of creation. It was known as the top five-star rating of the Federation’s military. It was said that it could shake the king of the Empire, it was said that it could kill the abyss. At this moment it rushed out of the emergency tunnel and showed extraordinary speed. It quickly surrounded the building but didn’t attack immediately.
The three mechs were waiting for the army to evacuate the crowd.
The longer it took, the more advantageous it would be for them.
Dudian wasn’t in a hurry to attack. He held the laser cannon of the demonized snake people. He stood on the edge of the rooftop. There was an abyss-like street under his feet. The pedestrians were as small as ants. He quietly looked at the three creator’s mechs, his brows were slightly wrinkled. He wasn’t thinking about how to break out of the three mechas. He was thinking about the motive and purpose of the consortium.
He had been in the company for so long but now he was killed because of disobeying orders. It seemed that there was something wrong.
While he was thinking, the surrounding army had dispersed many people. Dudian also saw that Zhang Lanxin and others in the building of the company were escorted by the army to the emergency passage.
At this time, a few helicopters flew up and hovered in the air. The helicopters took out high-speed machine guns and laser cannons and aimed at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1130
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1130: Chapter 1119: fighting against the god of creation
Translator: 549690339
“You are courting death!”
Dudian’s eyes narrowed. He raised the laser cannon in his hand and fired it. The laser beam shot out and pierced one of the armed helicopters. The propeller blades of the helicopter were broken, the helicopter tilted and flipped over. There was a scream as it fell into the nearby building. A large net shot out from the wrist of one of the mechs and caught the helicopter.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to it and turned to shoot at the other armed helicopters.
The armed helicopters didn’t expect that dudian would aim at them. They panicked and launched laser and missile attacks. When the missile was shot out, it was halfway.., dudian’s back was like a machete. A black light suddenly shook out of his wings. It was like a black feather. It hit the missile. Bang! It detonated halfway and stopped in mid-air.
Whoosh!
Dudian’s body flashed as he dodged the laser cannon. The laser cannon was not comparable to the early days of the old era. In the early days of the old era, the laser guns and laser cannons could not kill the enemy, especially the laser guns could only destroy the pupils of the enemy, make the enemy blind and lose their combat ability. So although the name was very awe-inspiring, but the effect on the battlefield was ordinary.
But today’s laser cannon and laser gun had achieved the same as the movies in the old era. The laser seemed to be real. It could pierce through steel plates with high temperature. Moreover, it could ignore the weather and could be used in all-weather combat.
The laser cannon was also strengthened by countless times. The diameter of the muzzle was about 60 centimeters. It was enough to destroy half of a human body into ashes.
However, the speed of the laser was fast. It was like a flash of lightning. But the person who operated it had a normal physique. The finger trigger was like a slow motion in Dudian’s eyes. There was enough time for him to dodge.
Dudian fired the laser cannon after he evaded the attacks of the laser cannons. Although both of them were laser weapons but the power of the laser cannon in his hand was obviously stronger. It pierced through the head of the helicopter, the cockpit exploded and the armed helicopter that had lost control also fell down. However it was rescued by the god of creation and didn’t directly crash.
Dudian held the huge laser cannon and walked in the rain of bullets. He casually picked up the cannon and the armed helicopter fell down.
A moment later, there was no more helicopter in the sky. Dudian stood on the top of the tall building. He could see more than half of the city from the top of the building. He saw small aircraft flashing in the distance, it was the camera that was shooting the scene. It should be the reporters from the nearby news agencies or the people who were interested in it.
Dudian naturally didn’t worry about the problem of exposure. His identity had been leaked and there was no place for the Federation to hide. Even if he was a fugitive, he could change his face.
At his level of strength, his face was no longer important. He could change it at any time. He only cared about his inner self. Even for Dudian, his inner self was no longer important. He only cared about his heart.
If he wanted to gain more power, he would have to take away his heart that was full of divinity!
“It’s time to get serious...”Dudian muttered. At this time, the god of creation that caught the falling helicopter had already settled down the few armed helicopters and dispersed the people in the helicopters, the people who were escorted to the emergency tunnel by the troops were far away from the nearby underground emergency tunnel. There were only a few frightened figures in the thousands of meters radius.
Dudian’s eyes fell on the three god of creation mechs. They looked like humans. They were extremely huge. They were about 12 meters tall. Their bodies were golden in color. There were wings on their backs, they clearly had the ability to fly. At first glance they looked like a golden god. They were tall and strong. In terms of appearance they were the best among the mechs.
Dudian’s line of sight penetrated through the layers of layers. He saw the pilots of the mechas. They were three rank 10 warriors.
The military had put an end to the demons. Even if the Federation had trained the demons, they were either assembled by the Terras Consortium or sent by the consortium into the military.
He took a deep breath. He didn’t wait for the three mechas to make a move. He used the blood red crystal on his forehead to shoot out a beam of light towards the one who had saved the helicopter.
They were waiting for the army to clean up the battlefield but Dudian couldn’t continue to delay. Perhaps the three demons in the mech wouldn’t care about the lives of ordinary people, but they would care about the other forces who would take the opportunity to attack the Terras Consortium.
The beam was extremely fast. The Mech didn’t react. But when the beam hit three meters in front of its head it suddenly created a ripple. It was an automatic energy shield that blocked the beam.
Dudian’s eyes sank as he raised the laser cannon in his hand.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Seven or eight laser beams shot out but all of them hit.
Although the creator’s reaction was to predict dudian’s finger and muzzle but Dudian’s aiming speed was too fast. He was one step ahead of the creator to predict all of its dodging positions.
The energy shield outside the creator’s mech rippled like water waves. When Dudian’s last shot was fired the energy shield was broken and hit the shoulder of the mech, the golden shoulder armor was left with faint burn marks.
Dudian squinted his eyes. The toughness of the Creator’s mech was beyond his expectations. The power of the laser cannon was enough to wipe out all life forms at the level of the Abyss. Unless some monsters evolved special armor or scales.., if it was an abyss level human then no one would be able to stop them without using their magic body. But at this moment the paint on the surface of the creator’s mech couldn’t even be wiped off.
Of course, maybe the golden color wasn’t paint.
Whoosh!
Dudian threw away the laser cannon which had exhausted its energy plate. He swooped down from the tall building. He spread his wings and shot towards the creator’s mech like a sharp sword.
The short-haired youth sneered. Both of his hands were inserted into two white balls. There was a ring on his head. He waved both of his hands and the arm of the creator Mech followed, however his speed was extremely fast. The sound of wind whistled as the mech’s intelligent system predicted the best trajectory for Dudian’s dive.
Dudian’s body suddenly stopped and twisted. The strong momentum made his wings feel like they were tearing. However, he changed the trajectory and rushed to the top of the creator’s head twenty meters away, this distance was within the blink of an eye for him.
However, the short-haired youth didn’t intend to let Dudian attack. He suddenly waved his hand and pulled out a burning knife from the front of the mech’s knee. It was like pulling out the leg bone from the knee, the heat wave swept towards Dudian. The air was scorched and distorted. Strong energy was released from the knife. In addition to light and heat, there was also strong radiation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1131
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1131: Chapter 1120: Escape
Translator: 549690339
Dudian’s body twisted again. He skidded to the back of the creator’s shoulder. He felt an unusual sense of danger as his wings expanded, the Gale filled the inner part of his wings and stopped his body. He saw a white light flash past the gap between his shoulder and the creator’s.
Dudian saw the mech next to him shoot out a laser from his finger.
“Holy Light Strike!”
Anger flashed across the short-haired youth’s face. He coldly looked at the mech next to him. Although he was angry but he didn’t miss this opportunity, the target had entered the range of fifty meters of holy light. He immediately used the most violent way to counterattack!
Dudian was paying attention to the operators of the three creator mechas. He guessed what the short-haired youth was going to do when he saw the button. He narrowed his eyes and moved forward instead of retreating, he continued to pounce on the latter. At the same time he used the Sun Beast Gem on his forehead to shoot out beams of light. These beams of light were not scattered aimlessly but covered the entire body of the creator Mech.
When the short-haired youth activated the Holy Light Strike, the armor of the creator Mech’s fingers, shoulders, chest and other parts of the armor suddenly deformed. The dark caliber of the muzzle was revealed from the inside. There was a faint pre-heating emission of light, the whole pre-heating process was less than 0.1 second! However, Dudian seemed to have predicted it in advance. When the armor of these parts was removed to reveal the firing caliber, the beam from his forehead just happened to shoot into these caliber, in an instant, a violent explosion sounded from the body of the creator. The short-haired youth who was sitting in the cockpit was completely stunned.
The violent vibration of the mech and the shaking of the screen made him feel dizzy. He couldn’t help but open his eyes wide in disbelief.
“Break!”Dudian took advantage of the gap between the explosion and closed in. This time even the two creator mechas didn’t expect such a situation to happen. They didn’t make a move in time, the blade of his body was like a tail. It turned into a sharp blade and suddenly stabbed out thousands of times. The special gold alloy on the surface of the mech was broken and there were many cracks, there were holes of different sizes.
Dudian growled as he swung his tail. It was like a black tornado. He swung the blade onto the neck of the mech. The head of the mech was cut off along with the jumping electricity.
Dudian quickly tore the fiber-like transmission pipeline in the neck. He retracted his wings and drilled into it.
“You!”
The pupils of the short-haired youth shrank to the size of a pinhole. He looked at Dudian who had forced his way into the cockpit. His face was full of fear as if he had seen a ghost. Before he could use his magic body, Dudian’s chest suddenly shot out a sharp blade and pierced his head.
After doing this, Dudian shrank the sharp blade in his body so as not to cut the surrounding equipment. He pulled the body of the short-haired youth and threw it along the neck of the mech. Then he sat on the seat in front of him, he glanced at the control panel in front of him.
Compared to the black lizard which he had used in the military, the level of the Creator’s mech was much higher. However its interface was more concise. It was not like the black lizard, there were hundreds of basic keys and complex keys. There were only eight keys in total. It was mainly connected to the mecha by nerves. Although it was said that it was operated by humans but the intelligent system of the mecha would also assist the human brain. It was a combination of man and machine, it was the highest crystallization of the federation’s technology.
“It is worthy to be evaluated as a mecha that can fight against a king. Its performance is top-notch. Fortunately, I have understood the operation methods of the creator’s mecha. I have seen some promotional videos of the Creator’s mecha. Otherwise, the ‘holy light strike’alone would be enough to blast most of my body into ashes.”Dudian looked at the other two creator’s mecha, he checked the damage of the mech.
“Energy Shield charging. 28 minutes 47 seconds...”
“Weapon system damaged 23.7% . Seventy-three laser tubes are broken. Do you want to replace them?”
Dudian frowned as he heard the words from the intelligent voice. He didn’t wear the helmet to connect to the mech. The creator’s mech was bound to the short-haired youth. Only the manufacturer had the ability to unlock it, he could only use the original method to operate the mech. He once again felt the terror of the Creator’s mech when he heard the inspection report.
He had to withstand seven or eight laser shots to barely penetrate the energy shield. However it only took half an hour to repair it. The damage caused by the holy light which he had extinguished covered the entire body of the mech, it was less than one-fifth. This meant that although the holy light attack was powerful, it was not the full attack of the Creator’s mech. Moreover, it could be replaced!
“This kind of endurance is more terrifying than a king’s. I don’t know what kind of energy is used to drive the mech. Even nuclear energy might not be able to bring such continuous combat ability.”This thought flashed through Dudian’s mind, he immediately chose to change the laser tube. The joints of the mech were opened and broken metal pieces were ejected from it. Soon the intelligent system’s notification sounded. The laser tube had been changed and could be used again!
Dudian didn’t continue to operate. He looked at the two mechs that were slowly pincer attacking from the distance. He could see the expressions of the two inside through the perspective.
“If I didn’t know about the mechs and could see the operation of the mechs from the perspective, I might not be a match for them.”Dudian’s eyes lit up as he looked at the two, the reason why he didn’t run away was because he knew that he would die faster if he ran out of the city.
With the strength of the Terras consortium, they could send more god of creation mechs to encircle him. He didn’t need to worry about the casualties and excessive damage.
However, he would be able to display several times his strength if he got a god of Creation Mech. There was no need for him to continue to fight with these people.
“Holy light strike, Shunt!”
Dudian’s fingers quickly swept across the virtual keyboard. The upper and lower body of the mech suddenly turned in different directions. A burst of light shot out and enveloped the two god of creation mechs.
At the same time, Dudian activated the wings of the mech and glided out from the side. The soles of the mech’s feet shot out blazing flames. The speed was extremely fast. It was like a meteor passing through the tall buildings, in the blink of an eye he disappeared thousands of meters away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1132
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1132: Chapter 1,121: self-destruct
Translator: 549690339
After Dudian left in the creator’s mech, a few officers received the news from their earphones. They raised their fists and signaled the troops to stop.
“Why aren’t they leaving?”
“Hurry Up!”
“What’s going on?”
Many scientists and executives of Randy’s company who were under the protection of the Army saw the sudden stop of the army. They couldn’t help but feel anxious.
“Lanxin, is that person Little Qin?”Kong Zhi, Zhang Lanxin, Chu Huiru and other scientists stood together. At this moment everyone was anxious but Kong Zhi was very calm. The old man looked worried, he whispered to Zhang Lanxin who was next to him.
Zhang Lanxin’s face was complicated. She was speechless.
Although they were in a hurry to retreat but they saw the scene of Dudian’s gunship. They heard the words of the officers. They knew that it was an invasion of the demon race. But the demon race.., but the demon was Qin Mo!
Zhang Lan’s mind repeatedly recalled the few months they had spent together. The enthusiasm, seriousness, focus and kindness of this young man made her feel that there was nothing wrong with him. She really couldn’t combine the handsome face with the fierce face of the demons. But the fact made her believe that it was true. She couldn’t help but think that there were good and bad demons?
“Everyone, quiet down!”
Amidst the noisy and anxious voices around them, a tall and sturdy military officer with strong arms shouted, after everyone quieted down, he said loudly, “The demon race has already left this place and is heading to another place. This is the safest place for the time being. Everyone, don’t panic. If we continue to retreat, it’s hard to guarantee that we won’t encounter this demon race again. Everyone, stay here for now and wait for the detailed situation on the surface to be reported before making any plans.”
When everyone heard that the demons had left, they immediately heaved a sigh of relief. Some of them patted their chests as if they were heaving a sigh of relief.
“He’s Gone?”Kong zhi glanced at the top of his head and seemed to have heaved a sigh of relief.
Zhang Lanxin noticed his expression and her heart skipped a beat. Then, as if she had thought of something, a trace of gentleness appeared on her aged face, she said in an extremely low voice, “Perhaps he is a good demon. I hope he can leave. If he is caught, I hope that the higher-ups will give him a chance to change his ways...”
Chu Huiru’s eyes widened as she heard the two’s words. She felt that the two old scientists were crazy. They were worried about a demon.
“It’s a pity. I Won’t be able to see him in the future.”Kong Zhi’s mouth revealed a bitter smile. He recovered his indifferent expression after he sensed that someone was looking at him.
Whoosh!
The wind whistled in Dudian’s ears. The building under his feet was rapidly retreating. The two creator mechs were desperately chasing after him. However the performance of the mechs were the same. Dudian rushed out of the encirclement and pulled away, although he had activated the fastest speed of the mech but he could only maintain the distance. He couldn’t close the distance unless Dudian’s energy was exhausted first.
From the previous intense battle it was clear that his energy consumption was higher than the two mechs. However the remaining energy was enough to support him to rush out of the city and leave the federation.
“I will go to the monster zone outside the circle of peace. I hope I can find a chance to escape.”Dudian’s eyes were serious as he thought of a way to escape. However he suddenly felt that something was wrong, it seemed that he had overlooked something.
At this time, there was a towering wall at the end of Duyue City.
“I have run for three minutes. They shouldn’t have time to mobilize other mechs to surround me...”Dudian looked at the wall which was getting closer and closer. He frowned and hesitated for a moment, he clenched his teeth and pushed the mech to rush over. There was no absolute plan. He had to take risks at the critical moment.
Soon, Dudian got close to the city wall. He saw a large number of artillery coming towards him.
Dudian was relieved to see that the city defense weapons were locked onto him. He quickly looked at the surrounding environment. He didn’t see any other mech. He was sure that he could cooperate with the smart system of the mech, the SMART system of the mech detected the strength of these attacks. Some of the strengths could be ignored. Only the ones that could affect the speed of the mech could be chosen, as well as the attacks that would cause damage to the mecha to be dodged.
It had to be said that this mecha’s AI system was extremely powerful. In such a disadvantage, it still picked out the best plan, and it was calculated in seconds. It was many times faster than the human’s own judgment.
The god of creation mecha was like a golden bolt of lightning, rushing out from the flames that filled the sky. The golden mecha was like a god, unharmed. Its terrifying defensive power shocked the many soldiers on the city walls.
Before they could continue the second wave of fire attack, two golden beams quickly rushed over. The military officer immediately gave the order to let them through.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
After the two golden beams rushed over, a tsunami-like roar swept over from behind. It was as if the whole world was roaring. It was the sound of the wind brought by the mech.
“Energy 37% ...”Dudian looked at the energy display on the mech. It was only three and a half squares. The things he had learned during this period of time, the range of the Peace Circle and the area covered by the Peace Circle appeared in his mind, he quickly calculated in his mind and compared the distance he had experienced with the energy consumed. The result was that he was barely able to rush out of the Peace Circle.
Whoosh!
A laser shot from behind and hit the back wings of the mech. The mech was out of balance and almost fell to the ground. However the balance system and intelligent system of the mech quickly adjusted and stabilized the tilt, however the speed was greatly reduced.
“Demon, Surrender!”
A cold female voice came from the communicator of the Mech.
Dudian glanced at the two mechs behind him. He saw that one of the mechs was talking to the woman. He frowned. He felt that the bad premonition that he had ignored previously resurfaced.
“You are so stubborn! Prepare to die!”The woman saw that Dudian ignored her. There was a trace of anger in her eyes.
Dudian’s face changed. It was not because of the woman’s words but because he finally thought of what he had overlooked!
“Not good!”Dudian was about to stand up and rush out of the mech.
Suddenly, a tough alloy belt extended from the back of the cockpit chair. It tied his body firmly to the cockpit chair. At the same time, the virtual keyboard in front of him automatically shrank. There was only one window, it became blood red and a number “3”jumped out!
“Start the self-destruct program...”the artificial brain of the Mech said in a dull voice.
Dudian’s pupils constricted. He didn’t touch the self-destruct program of the mech. The scene in front of him confirmed his guess. Everything was a trap. From the moment the level 11 federation demon found him.., the trap had been set up!

chapters.title: Chapter 1133
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1133: Chapter 1122: Stone Ball
Translator: 549690339
“Break! !”
Dudian’s hair stood on end as he growled. His body crazily grew sharp blades which pierced through the driver’s seat. However his heart was beating wildly as he used too much strength. The vibration spread throughout his body. It was as if the muscles of his body were trembling and contracting along with his heartbeat. His brain was also buzzing, he was dizzy.
Dudian’s eyes flashed a bit but he woke up in the blink of an eye. He waved the sharp blades around his body and slashed at the alloy belt that was binding his body.
Buzz!
The sharp sound of the alloy belt being cut was ear-piercing. What shocked Dudian was that the toughness of the alloy belt was beyond his imagination. He had been using the invincible cutting blade for so many years! He wasn’t able to cut the alloy belt which was less than one centimeter thick!
“How is it possible? !”Dudian was stunned for a moment. The number on the screen had reached ‘2’. When he noticed it, the number once again jumped to ‘1’!
His pupils slightly shrank. At this moment he felt that all the blood in his body seemed to flow back into his mind. The unprecedented sense of danger made him feel that the time around him seemed to be at a standstill.
No! No! No!
His consciousness was shouting. The next moment, the cutting edge of his body crazily shrank back into his body at an unprecedented speed. The whole process took less than half a second. The moment the cutting edge shrank back into his body.., the rich light emitted from his body. It was incomparably dazzling. At the same time, the temperature in the cockpit soared rapidly!
Whoosh!
Dudian’s body melted like magma and ‘flowed’out of the alloy belt. One of the blobs of red mucus rushed out the fastest. It suddenly turned into a sharp blade and rushed along the neck of the mech.
The whole process happened in a second. It was as fast as a phantom. When the red mucus turned into a sharp blade and rushed out of the mech, the scene outside the mech appeared in Dudian’s sight. He was about to breathe a sigh of relief when he was stunned.
Bang!
The god of creation suddenly exploded in mid-air!
It was as if a nuclear missile had exploded in mid-air. The loud sound could be heard for hundreds of miles. It could even be heard over the nearest city.
The debris and smoke from the explosion spread out like a mushroom cloud. The small monsters on the ground were scared and immediately ran back to their nests.
Before the smoke dissipated, two golden flashes rushed into the mushroom cloud. Half a minute later, two mechs rushed out of the mushroom cloud and stopped in the air nearby, one of the god of Creation Mechs had a square energy matrix in its giant mechanical palm. In this energy matrix was a stone ball. It was round and round, but the surface of the stone ball was full of cracks. Some of the cracks were broken, revealing pits.
“There’s still life!”The red-haired woman in the mecha gasped slightly. Her eyes were filled with shock. Through the mecha’s intelligent system, she could detect that this stone ball contained heat. Although it was extremely weak.., it was the heat of a living being!
And this stone ball was also the only object at the center of the explosion. It was obviously that ferocious demon!
“This is the demon’s demonized form? How could this be? We seemed to have seen him transform into that monster with blades all over his body. Could it be that he could transform into two demon bodies?”The middle-aged man in the other mecha was somewhat shocked, his gaze became solemn.
“I’ve never heard of a demon that could transform into two forms. No wonder the higher-ups ordered that we must capture him alive. It seems that this demon is somewhat special,”the red-haired woman replied through the communicator. After she finished speaking, her gaze once again landed on the stone ball, she said, “This demon’s defense is too terrifying. He was actually able to survive the self-detonation of the god of Creation Mech. Moreover, we had just used the energy matrix to bind the surroundings of the mech, compressing the explosive energy within the matrix. It’s hard to imagine how powerful the explosion inside was. Not only did he not turn into ashes, he actually survived. This vitality is too terrifying!”
The middle-aged man nodded slightly when he heard that. There was some fear in his eyes as he said, “Let’s go. Send him back as soon as possible so that there won’t be any complications.”
“Alright!”The red-haired woman nodded. “We’ll leave this place to the people behind us to clean up. There shouldn’t be anything left out.”
After the two of them finished speaking, they turned around and left while piloting their mecha.
After flying for less than a kilometer, they met two Genesis god mechas that had rushed over from behind. Adding the three mechas from before, there was a total of five! This was Terras’foundation. Just to capture a demon, he had sent out five genesis mechas in one go. The performance of each mech was comparable to that of the kings of the Empire!
After about ten minutes, the two mechas flew back to a desert on the outskirts of Duyue City. This desert was surrounded by stone walls, enclosing the entire desert. In the desert, windmills and power stations could be seen everywhere, there were also solar panels, some strange white birds, and soldiers in black uniforms who patrolled from time to time. If one looked carefully, they would also find some small black bugs crawling on some plants in the desert. However, these bugs had a metallic luster on their carapaces. They were scout bugs with mechanical structures that were scattered all over the desert.
This desert was also one of the main bases of the Terras consortium.
Two mechs stopped in front of a group of buildings that looked like an ancient castle in the middle of the desert. There were a large number of soldiers in black uniforms stationed outside this group of buildings. There were a few war chariots parked inside the ancient castle. In addition, there was a large shed that covered an area of thousands of square meters, there were all kinds of mechs lined up inside.
“It’s us. Open the door.”The red-haired woman connected to the communication screen of the base. Her figure also appeared on the virtual projection of the base. The door in front of the ancient castle opened very quickly, she controlled the mecha to come to a building next to the castle. This building was like the dorsal fin of a fish, with sharp and strange buildings erected. At the bottom was a deep and huge entrance, like a huge mouth.
The red-haired woman and the red-haired woman carried the stone ball into this deep and huge entrance, all the way to the base below the castle.
The two sat in the mecha. Through layers of identity verification, they came to the lowest level of the base. There were many people standing on a high platform, as if waiting for the two of them, and they had long prepared the cage.
This cage was a huge square energy shield, about ten meters in length. At this moment, the red-haired woman had sent the stone ball in the mecha’s hand into the energy shield. The entire energy shield instantly solidified from its illusory state. In addition, outside the energy shield.., another five energy shields were erected. There were a total of six energy shields, stacked layer by layer, trapping the stone ball inside.
On the alloy floor under the energy shield were six grooves. Each energy shield rose from the grooves and formed in midair.
“Is this the demon?”The people on the high platform looked at the stone ball in the energy shield with different expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1134
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1134: Chapter 1,123: Awakening
Translator: 549690339
While everyone was discussing the stone ball, a tall and slender middle-aged man walked over. He was wearing a long black robe with gold-rimmed patterns. He looked like a priest in a church or an ancient gentleman, his every move displayed the elegance of etiquette.
Seeing this middle-aged man appear, everyone was shocked and quickly called out, “Chairman.”
Heslodi nodded slightly. He looked at the stone ball in the huge energy shield in front of the high platform. He was stunned for a moment and frowned. “Is this the demon?”
Everyone looked at each other. No one answered.
At this moment, the red-haired woman in the cockpit jumped down and landed under the high platform. She bowed, she then lowered her head and said, “Reporting to chairman, this is the demon that you wanted us to arrest. His strength is very fierce, killing many of our companions in a row. From the close combat, he displayed extraordinary abilities. I suspect that he has two different magic marks abilities. Fortunately, the AI had already arranged for us to ambush him. He was successfully tricked and snatched a creator’s mech. The AI detonated the mech and severely injured him.”
When Heslodi heard her say the word “Brain,”his eyelids twitched, but no one noticed. When the red-haired woman, Alexis, had finished, he asked, “Then why is he a stone now?”
Alicia said in a low voice, “Although he looks like a rock, this should be caused by his magic marks ability. I speculate that he must have activated this magic marks ability the moment the creator’s mech self-destructed. His entire body was petrified, maximizing his defensive power. However, the power of the self-destruct of the Creator’s mech is so fierce that it is no less than a nuclear weapon. Although he barely survived, he should be unconscious at this moment. His mind is not clear, but his body is instinctively maintaining his magic power, so he will maintain this state. When he wakes up, he should return to his human form.”
Hearing her words, Heslodi nodded slightly, indicating that he understood. After hearing her words, the other higher-ups behind him had a look of realization. They thought that this demon that was deeply concerned by HESLODI was originally like a rock, which was why it was so special.
“Chairman, can you give this demon to me?”An old man wearing thick glasses said with respect and fanaticism. He was not tall and had a hunchback, so he was shorter in the crowd. However, when the people around him heard his words, they looked at him with some fear.
“Chairman, Alicia said that this monster could have two kinds of magic marks. If It’s true, once I find out the secret of its body, the combat power of the demons that we produce in the future will be greatly improved. This is the best experimental material. I hope that Chairman can give it to us!”Another old man who looked like a white medical robe said, his figure was thin, and one of his eyes was only white. He looked somewhat terrifying.
When the other higher-ups heard that these two were snatching this demon, they all revealed a mocking smile as if they were watching a play. A few of them revealed an imperceptible sneer on their lips, as if mocking them for overestimating their own abilities.
When Alicia heard the old man say the word “Production,”her fingers that were hanging by her legs curled slightly, but they soon loosened. Only a trace of anger and killing intent flashed in her lowered eyes.
“Stop arguing.”Heslodi slightly frowned and interrupted the two people, “This demon has to be handed over to the higher-ups. It’s not something you can touch.”
“The higher-ups?”Hearing Heslodi’s words, the others were stunned for a while before their faces changed.
After all, Heslodi was the chairman of the Terras Corporation! Even the other high-status directors of the Corporation had to nod and cheer in front of him. He also had the right to expel the other directors!
As the person with the highest status in the Terras consortium, it could be said that even the federation chairman had to take the initiative to greet him when he saw him. After all, the other ordinary citizens did not know about it, but they knew that the past federation chairmen.., most of them were supported by the Terras Consortium to rise to the top. Be it the military or other departments, they all had their own people. As long as Heslodi was willing, he could even ‘remove’a chairman!
In the entire federation, the ones who truly held the lifeline and power were the four great consortiums!
And as the most well-established consortium among the four great consortiums, there was probably only one existence that could be called ‘superior’by Black Slody.
When they thought of that Lord’s existence, everyone was silenced for a moment. They looked at each other and no one spoke again.
The two old men, who had already thought of a way to describe the situation, stopped speaking in embarrassment. They stared at each other in embarrassment.
“Go and do a test on him first. Don’t weaken to the point of death,”Heslodi instructed. “The rest of you should disperse. Don’t let this matter spread to the outside world. Otherwise, it will cause unnecessary bad effects.”
“Yes, Chairman.”
Everyone agreed. Some left, some went to find a technician to test the stone ball in the energy shield, while the rest waited at the same place. This floor was where they worked, obviously, they couldn’t just leave Heslodi alone and go to work.
Soon, the test report of the stone ball came out.
