Terras’instrument could completely analyze the stone ball through the energy shield, including its blood type. There wasn’t even a need to take a blood test, and the data wouldn’t be wrong.
“Chairman, this stone ball is indeed a demon. It still has a weak life. Look inside its body, its heart is still beating weakly.”A middle-aged man in glasses handed a set of pictures to blackslody.
Blackslody flipped through the pictures. This was the scene inside the stone ball. He could see the outline of many flesh and bones, as well as the skull, intestines, and other organs. The most eye-catching one was a golden heart.
Heslodi frowned slightly when he saw this strange scene. He felt a little uncomfortable. The inside of the stone ball was like a ball of crushed meat mixed with bones and organs. It was like a corpse that had been chopped up and filled in.
“It’s good that he’s not dead.”He returned the picture to the weak middle-aged man and asked, “Is his life in danger like this? Does he need treatment?”
“This.”The weak middle-aged man felt a bit embarrassed. It was the first time he had met such a young man. He couldn’t confirm it. But since the chairman had asked him, he didn’t dare to directly answer, he could only say: “If the chairman wants him to live then we need to treat him.”
Black slody said: “Then treat him. In addition, wake him up as soon as possible.”
“Yes, Chairman.”The weak middle-aged man said.
..
... ..
In the cold darkness, Dudian felt a faint warm current spread through his body.
He felt that his consciousness was a bit more awake. He was no longer in a trance and was no longer stimulated by the intense pain. He opened his eyes and saw an almost transparent energy shield, there was a huge room outside the energy shield. There were many people walking in the room. From the way they dressed, they looked like researchers. Some of them were pointing in his direction and saying something, the assistant next to him used a notebook to write down what he said.
Dudian was stunned.
The next moment, memories flowed back like a tide.
Explosion, countdown, heat wave, Mech, unbreakable alloy belt, blue sky, square energy matrix..
All the images suddenly returned to his brain. He could not help but shiver. He took a deep breath and lowered his head to look at his body. However, when he lowered his head, he realized that his appearance was a little strange, it was a round stone ball.
The memory fragments flashed over. The moment the explosion spread out, he activated the Turtle Shell’s magic marks and petrified his entire body! In addition to the basic petrification, he also shrank his body into a ball and turned into a stone ball.
Because the ball was the best way to release the force.
“I’m not dead. Am I still alive?”Dudian was relieved. His mood turned gloomy. He was caught in the end. He didn’t know what the other side wanted to do but it wasn’t just to kill the demons.
At this time, Dudian saw that several researchers seemed to have noticed his situation. More and more people turned to look at him. For a moment, he felt like an orangutan in the zoo. Moreover, he was a special orangutan.
Since he had been noticed, Dudian didn’t continue to pretend to be asleep. He slowly stretched his body and returned to his human appearance. He felt that part of his body’s potential had been stimulated, he used the magic marks of the Sun Beast to melt his body when he broke away from the alloy belt. This ability wasn’t purely the ability of the Sun Beast. It was more like the ability of the polar ice worm!
The polar ice worm wouldn’t die even if it was cut into countless pieces. As long as it was given time, it would be able to reunite with each other and recover its body. He also had this ability when he rushed out of the mech!
He felt that he could control all parts of his body, every organ, and even every cell!
This feeling was very magical. It must be known that ordinary people had very poor control over their bodies. For example, it was very difficult for their eyes to rotate in two different directions. Most people couldn’t even control their ears.., not to mention controlling their stomach, intestines, heart, lungs, breathing, and so on.
Dudian slowly got up and felt his body. He slowly walked to the energy shield and raised his hand. His arm gradually turned into a dark cutting blade, but it was only the arm’s limitation, he fiercely hacked towards the energy shield.
Bang!
The sharp blade pierced through the energy shield, but there was still an energy shield outside the energy shield. When it pierced through the second layer of energy shield, it was stopped.
The next moment, the energy shield that was pierced through quickly healed.
Dudian quickly pulled back the arm of the sharp blade. He deliberately paused for a moment and saw that the healing energy shield was like a laser that cut off the fingernail-sized sharp blade.
“Sure enough, during the previous battle and the time when I was unconscious, I carefully examined my body. I could barely break through one layer of this energy shield. There are six grooves in the underground. I don’t know if I can condense the most intense rays of the Sun Beast, but there isn’t such a strong light that I can borrow...”Dudian’s eyes slightly flashed, he sat cross-legged in the middle of the energy shield.
It was impossible for him to escape from here.
Moreover the other party had caught him so he shouldn’t be raised slowly. Otherwise they wouldn’t have suddenly summoned him.
“What is the purpose of catching me?”Dudian frowned as he couldn’t figure it out. Suddenly he felt that he shouldn’t be so clueless. The enemy knew his identity as a demon. This was the root of the problem.
He began to comb through the matter from the beginning. This included the moment when Su Ming killed his mech and infiltrated the Federation.
The staff outside the energy shield called out to Black Slody and reported to him.
Black Slody looked at Dudian who was sitting cross-legged in the energy shield. He nodded and ordered everyone to leave. No one was allowed to enter without his permission.
Soon, all the staff were evacuated.
“You can leave too.”Heslodi said to the guards.
They looked at each other and respectfully took their leave.

Chapter 1135: Chapter 1124: How Come I didn’t know I was a god
Translator: 549690339
Dudian noticed the situation outside the energy shield. He looked up and saw the most powerful chairman of the Terras Consortium. He was one of the most important figures in the federation.
It was not surprising that he could recognize this person at a glance. It was because this person was too famous. There was no difference between him and the president of the Federation. Even if he was a child who had just entered primary school.., he knew his appearance and identity from the news, parents’conversation, animation and other aspects.
He slightly narrowed his eyes and quietly looked at him. It seemed that there were some clues in his mind.
After everyone left, Blacksloth looked at Dudian who was looking straight at him. He felt an inexplicable chill. He hadn’t felt this kind of feeling for a long time, only in the presence of the ‘Lord God’could he feel a stronger chill and majesty. Dudian gave him the feeling that he was like a ferocious beast that would pounce on him at any time, although his eyes were very calm and there were six energy shields separating him from the ‘Lord God’, but this feeling still made his hair stand up. His heart couldn’t help but beat faster.
Was this the real demon? His eyes slightly flashed. He didn’t immediately start the instrument but opened his mouth: “You don’t seem surprised.”
“What are you surprised about?”Dudian asked back.
Black Slody smiled. Since the other party didn’t understand his meaning, he didn’t intend to explain: “Nothing.”
“Shouldn’t you be surprised that the one who caught me is the boss of the Tesla Consortium?”Dudian faintly asked.
Black slody raised his eyebrows: “Did you expect it to be me?”
“I have the right to enter the company and get the highest authority. I can mobilize three god of creation mechs to attack me and even sacrifice one of them to self-destruct. Who else has the right to do so besides you?”Dudian smiled.
Black Slody looked at the youth. He suddenly felt that the youth’s age was confusing. He was calm and confident. He didn’t look like a young man who had just integrated into society.
“Guess why I invited you over?”Black Slody asked with interest.
Dudian indifferently said: “Since it has fallen into your hands, I don’t care what you do.”
Black Slody laughed. He wanted to get some information from Dudian so that he could understand Dudian’s particularity. But he didn’t expect that this young demon would be so cautious and mature. He knew that it was useless to say more, he didn’t want to be noticed by that young demon. He turned to a huge computer and respectfully said: “Master, the people have been dismissed.”
Dudian saw Blackie’s sudden action. Even though he was calm, he couldn’t help but be surprised. But in the next second, he connected the broken thoughts in his heart, the thought made his heart beat violently. The pores on his body contracted and he felt an indescribable chill.
At the same time, the complex structure of the computer began to operate. At the same time, Dudian suddenly saw a light screen shining from the outside to about three meters in front of him. It transformed into a virtual human shape. The figure gradually solidified, his body was bathed in hazy light like a god. It was a virtual projection.
The technology of this virtual projection was extremely high. The condensed projection gradually became no different from a real person!
Dudian was stunned again when he saw the face of this person. He looked at him in disbelief.
This was an eastern face. He had only seen it two or three times but he would never forget it because this person’s face was very handsome. He was as perfect as a god. His identity was also unimaginably lofty, he was respected by the federation as the god of Science and Technology!
The God of Science and technology had expected Dudian’s reaction. He smiled and said: “You should leave too.”
He didn’t turn around. His back was facing Blackie. The tone of his voice was commanding. It showed his supreme status.
There was no anger on Blackie’s face. He was extremely humble. His back was slightly bent. He looked at dudian and walked down the platform, he left the lowest level of the base.
Dudian and the god of Science and technology were the only ones left in the base when the alloy door was closed.
“You Didn’t die?”Dudian’s first reaction was to blurt out.
The God of science and technology smiled: “It’s not polite to greet others like this.”
“It’s not our first time meeting, is it?”Dudian asked.
The God of Science and technology smiled, “You are right. You have seen my sculpture and my appearance. The current me is just a projection. I’m no different from a sculpture so it’s not our first time meeting.”
Dudian was not in the mood to argue with him, he immediately asked: “Aren’t you a person from 300 years ago? No one can live for 300 years right? Did you freeze your body for a period of time? Or did you have a head-changing operation?”
The God of science and technology wasn’t impatient with Dudian’s series of questions. He smiled: “You have said that no one can live for 300 years. But I am not a ‘person’.”
Dudian’s face slightly changed as he thought of the name.
“Do you know why I asked you to come here?”The God of Science and technology smiled.
Dudian’s eyes lit up, he shook his head: “I don’t know. But it shouldn’t be to dissect me or to get information about the empire from me. After all, the Federation and the Empire have a long history of fighting. Even if they capture a current king of the empire, I don’t think they will alert people like black slody.”
The God of science and technology smiled: “You are right. I am looking for you because your identity is different from anyone else.”
“My identity?”
“Yes, you have the same identity as me.”
Dudian was stunned again. His first reaction was not to suspect that Dudian’s words were false but to feel surprised and even honored. However the idea was instantly dispelled and replaced by an unspeakable horror, he pretended to be confused and asked: “Is my identity the same as yours? Don’t tell me that I am also a God? How come I don’t know about this?”
The God of Science and Technology revealed a mysterious smile: “You are not a god but a demigod!”
“Demigod?”
“Yes, your body has the potential of a god. Do you still remember the first time you opened your eyes and saw the world after you were born?”
Hearing this, the images that he saw when Crimson Moon looked through his memories appeared in his mind. Those images had long been forgotten by him, but they were re-opened by Crimson Moon’s magic marks, every year and every day, the images that he saw after opening his eyes clearly appeared. He couldn’t help but clench his fists. He felt an indescribable pain.
For the god of technology did not say “Birth,”but “Birth.”

Chapter 1136: Chapter 1125: “Hope”and “Survival”
Translator: 549690339
The God of science and technology observed dudian’s reaction. There was a trace of surprise in his eyes. Although he asked but he didn’t think that Dudian remembered the things that happened when he was born. But from his reaction.., it was obvious that he knew something. He was more interested: “It seems that you know your identity. Do you still remember your ‘maker’?”
Dudian’s body slightly trembled as he heard the words ‘creator’. He wanted to vent out his anger. But this time he wasn’t facing Crimson Moon or Bolo, he knew that even if he continued to deny or deceive himself so that he wouldn’t think or think about those pictures, it would be meaningless.
When Crimson Moon flipped through his memories, he saw all the scenes after he opened his eyes.
Although he had been in the machine at that time and could not hear his parents’voices, from their lips when they spoke, he had long understood their communication and knew his true identity —
A “Hope”that had been created.
At least in his parents’words, he was hope, a new form of human evolution, also known as a “Neo-human.”.
And his smart and cute sister, who was extremely good to him, was just an experiment. But in comparison, he was more perfect. This was also why, when an unexpected natural disaster came, he would be chosen to be a survivor and sleep in the freezer.
Although he didn’t know why his appearance and wisdom were far superior to his sister’s but in the eyes of his ‘parents’they were not as perfect as him. What were the standards of the new human?
He had never thought about this because he didn’t want to think about it. He continued to bury this memory in the deepest part of his heart.
Because once he understood it, he would only end up sad.
The God of Science and technology saw that Dudian was silent. He didn’t answer him nor was he angry, he smiled: “There aren’t many God’s embryos left in the world. You should be one of the few left. Maybe you can find one or two god’s embryos in the Fire Dragon Kingdom in the north. Maybe the Emperor in your empire is also a god’s embryo. But it is too difficult to catch them. You are obviously a god’s embryo but your strength is pathetic. If I’m not wrong, you should have been chased by the Emperor.”
Dudian came back to his senses from his sad thoughts. He was stunned as he heard the words. He didn’t understand what he meant. But the ‘God’s child’he was referring to himself. As for the ‘Fire Dragon Kingdom’.., dudian thought of the ‘Fire Dragon’in the east of the Empire. However the federation was located in the upper part of the northeast. Dudian was a bit surprised as he heard about the ‘Great Emperor’. He knew that the Empire was ruled by seven kings. However the god of Science and technology didn’t mention about kings.
As for his own strength, although he was not a true king, he had at least mobilized three genesis God mechs that were comparable to kings to capture him. This was considered top-notch among humans, but it was described as “Pitifully weak”, even if the king of the empire was much stronger than him, it was not much weaker. Did this mean that the king was not in his eyes at all?
If that was the case, then the “Great Emperor”that he spoke of was most likely the true ruler of the Empire!
As for the argument that the seven kings were respected, it was probably because her status was too low and was not enough to know about the existence of the “Great Emperor”.
And this great emperor might not be the emperor of the empire, but he could also be the emperor of the empire. However, his performance was very reserved, so much so that the people actually thought that his majesty was putting on airs, and the real powerhouses were the seven great kings!
“He said that ‘The Emperor’is a god’s embryo. He has the same identity as me. He also said that I will be hunted down. This means that there is a struggle between the god’s embryo. So he is also a god’s embryo. The purpose of capturing me is definitely not simple! No matter if I go to the Empire or the federation, I will be detected and captured. Because in their God’s embryo, I belong to the weak!”
Dudian thought of this in his mind. He felt a bit scared. The world was more dangerous than he had imagined. But he was ignorant before. If he had ventured into the empire when he was weak.., it was estimated that he had been captured, raised or killed by the emperor.
The God of Science and technology saw that Dudian was surprised and silent. It seemed that he had hit the nail on the head. But he only smiled, he said: “You are the strangest one I have ever seen compared to other embryos. There are traces of dormancy in your genes. If I am not wrong you should be the first batch of embryos from 300 years ago. It was not long after the birth of the first batch of embryos. The earth was invaded by extraterrestrial magic insects which caused the collapse of all the countries. As a divine embryo you were placed in the hope of human heritage so you were frozen.”
“When you woke up from the cold, the world had already changed beyond recognition. That’s why you are so weak, isn’t it?”
Dudian’s pupils shrank. Even if he wanted to control his emotions, he couldn’t help but feel a trace of horror and horror. The other party’s understanding of him was more detailed than his own, if it wasn’t for Crimson Moon’s experience of looking through his memories, he wouldn’t have known his real identity. But all of this didn’t escape the other party’s eyes. He even knew that he had entered the freezing chamber!
Was this the ability of God?
The God of Science and technology knew that he was right when he saw Dudian’s shocked look. He smiled and said: “In this case, everything is easy to explain.”
Dudian calmed down and looked at him: “What is the God’s embryo? Are you one of the God’s embryos? What is the purpose of the existence of the god’s embryo?”
“This is a long story.”The God of Science and technology didn’t refuse to answer, instead, he softly said, “From the moment humans were born, they have been fighting against Heaven and earth, nature and beasts. Perhaps, this is what all life will face. From a blue whale in the ocean to an ant or a microorganism, they are all like this, living in a struggle.”
“And the purpose of the struggle is to survive!”
“After countless years of reproduction and inheritance, mankind has evolved from the initial era of mushroom hair and blood drinking to the era of civilization. Survival is not a difficult thing for most people. They don’t need to fight for food with wild beasts in the wilderness, and they won’t die from fighting, getting injured, rotting, and dying. In the era of civilization, survival is already a basic requirement. It is the bottom line that society gives everyone.”
“However, the hierarchy of human society is not equal. The so-called equality of all people, the emperor and the common people are the same crime. It is just a comforting word to the people
“The people pursue the basic needs of food, and those with status pursue enjoyment. Money and power can bring extreme enjoyment, but none of these can stop one thing
“That is the end point that all life will face — Death!”

Chapter 1137: Chapter 1126: The Blood Moon is coming
Translator: 549690339
Dudian quietly listened to his story but was thinking about something else.
The God of Science and technology seemed to be telling an ancient story. His voice was distant: “When survival becomes a basic need, people will desire more things, enjoy, endless enjoyment. All life is longing for eternal life!”
“However, there is no eternal life in this world. Even the stars in the universe have their own lifespan, including many huge celestial bodies in the universe.”
“Although from a rational point of view there is no possibility of eternal life, but people are willing to live for hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of years!”
Dudian frowned: “Do you mean that the purpose of their creation is to find a way for humans to live longer? And we are the test subjects?”
“You are only half right.”The God of science and technology smiled: “The God’s embryo is the evolutionary version of human beings. It has the ability to adapt and evolve beyond human beings. If the world had not been invaded by the magic insects then the earth would still be the same. The life span of a god’s embryo like us is at most twice that of ordinary people. Our physical fitness is similar to that of athletes who often exercise. Of course, if we exercise, we will become the top athletes.”
“In other words, it doesn’t seem to be very powerful.”Dudian said.
The God of science and technology said: “It is limited by the era. In the current era of the Cataclysm, your empire uses magic insects to evolve itself. At that time we will be able to reach the top and become the strongest Evolver!”
Dudian was startled as he understood.
The so-called God’s embryo was the most outstanding group of people in the same era.
In the old era the purpose of making God’s embryo was to improve the genes of all human beings to a more excellent level. It would gradually replace the original human genes and greatly improve the human society through heredity, whether it was life span, intelligence, physical fitness and other aspects, the development of human technology would be like a butterfly effect!
If Einstein could live for another 50 years, perhaps the world of the old era would have jumped more than 10 years. Moreover, the life span of all the other great scientists would be extended. The benefits would be unimaginable!
The God of Science and technology looked at Dudian and suddenly revealed a strange smile, “You were born in the old era. You should be one of the first batch of God’s embryos. From the structure of your body, you are no different from us. However, the meaning of our birth is different. You are for the reproduction of human beings. You represent the ‘hope’of human beings. But we carry the ultimate hope of all life. That is ‘eternal life’!”
Dudian’s heart skipped a beat: “You Weren’t born in the old era?”
“When I was born, the old era had been destroyed and entered the era of Cataclysm. The people who made me were not human scientists but extraterrestrial magic insects!”The God of Science and technology smiled.
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he was completely stunned.
“The... The Magic Bug made you? How is it possible? The Magic Bug knows how to make the embryo? If the magic bug made you then wouldn’t this place have fallen into the hands of the magic bug?”Dudian couldn’t help but ask.
The God of technology smiled, “The fact that you have become the abyss means that your body has absorbed the real extraterrestrial magic bug and not the parasitic magic bug from their corpses. Since you have absorbed the extraterrestrial magic insects then you should know that their technology is not inferior to that of our earth. Otherwise they wouldn’t have crossed the galaxy and invaded our earth. After all, the humans of the old era couldn’t even walk out of the Solar System!”
Dudian thought of the polar ice insect king that he had caught. The place where it was located was a magic insect spaceship. Its body was twisted and disgusting. Although it didn’t have limbs but it looked like a sticky white loach, however its intelligence was not inferior to that of humans. It was not difficult for it to understand the history and development of human beings.
“So you are a puppet controlled by magic insects?”Dudian coldly looked at the god of Science and technology. His heart was gloomy. The Seven Kings of the Empire were controlled by magic insects and the Federation had fallen, how could there be a pure land on earth?
The God of Science and technology shook his head and sneered: “Although these magic insects are smart but they have underestimated me. Do you know why I am in such a form to meet you?”
“What do you mean?”Dudian’s heart slightly trembled as he looked at his illusory figure. He knew that his conjecture was confirmed.
The God of Science and technology looked at him but didn’t continue. He looked up, he slowly said: “Soon, the blood moon will come and the magic bugs will come back. I have to master a higher power before they come again. In other words, I have to become a true God! Only in this way can I survive!”
Dudian didn’t think that he would use the word “Survive”on himself. For the federation’s civilians, survival might be a daily problem but the god of Science and technology was the faith of the Federation, his status was countless times higher than the chairman. But even such a high and mighty figure was planning for survival!
Moreover, the god of science and technology said that the “Blood moon will come”. His heart suddenly jumped. He vaguely remembered something. Crimson Moon had said that the reason why she changed her name to Crimson Moon was because of his birth, it just so happened that the blood-red moon was hanging in the sky!
At that time, he did not take it seriously. He just thought that Crimson Moon’s memory was a little off when she was born, so he did not take it to heart. After all, how could the moon be blood-red!
However, the god of technology had also said so. It undoubtedly proved that Crimson Moon’s words were not an exaggeration. They were real!
If the magic bugs would come when the moon turned blood-red, wouldn’t that mean that the magic bugs had visited Earth once when Crimson Moon was born?
No, this didn’t seem to be the main problem. The main problem was that the powers of the old era hadn’t been able to completely wipe out the magic insects from earth? They could actually make a comeback?
The God of Science and technology faintly smiled as he saw Dudian’s doubtful expression, he said: “The countries of the old era activated nuclear weapons and dropped hydrogen bombs on the world. Although the Earth has been bombed beyond recognition but the technology of the magic insects isn’t weak. The information was transmitted almost instantaneously. The magic insects were prepared when the nuclear weapons went to war. However the magic insects didn’t expect that the power of the nuclear weapons was so terrifying. The amount of nuclear weapons accumulated by humans was so large that it was enough to overturn all the land on the surface of the Earth!”
“When the nuclear weapon was detonated, the magic insects were severely injured but not all of them were destroyed. Some of them fled in fear and left the Earth. Unfortunately, some of the magic insects on the outer edge of the nuclear explosion survived. They contacted the escaping magic insects through the spacecraft and summoned them back. So you can see the current world pattern.”
Dudian was startled. He didn’t expect such a tortuous thing to happen. He couldn’t help but feel sad. If the escaping magic insects weren’t summoned back then would earth be in a different situation?
“What do you mean by telling me this?”Dudian frowned as he took a step back.
The God of Science and technology looked back at him, “I don’t mean anything. It’s been a long time since I last saw my kind so I want to talk to you. I hope that you can understand my thoughts. If I don’t become a true God then humans will become food for the magic insects. This is the only way to save the entire human race!”
Dudian’s face sank: “What’s your purpose in bringing me here? Do you want me to be your partner? Help you to conquer the empire and unify the world. Then we will fight against the magic insects?”
The God of Science and technology faintly smiled: “Although you are my kind but you are not qualified to be my partner. Moreover, I alone am enough to conquer the world!”
Dudian wasn’t angry because of his contempt: “In that case, you didn’t bring me here just to talk to me right?”
The God of Science and technology smiled, he slowly said: “I wanted to give you more time to grow and make your body more perfect. Unfortunately, time waits for no man. The Blood Moon is coming and there isn’t much time left. The embryos have matured and they should be picked. If you miss this opportunity, you will never be able to turn the situation around. So, are you willing to sacrifice yourself for the sake of the entire human race?”
Dudian felt that his words were a bit funny: “You know that I was created. What does it have to do with me to save the human race?”
The God of Science and technology nodded and smiled, “That’s true. Unfortunately, I thought that you might have some compassion. But now it seems that it is an extravagant hope. But with your strength and status, it is impossible for you to do such a selfless thing. The only people who can do such a thing are those at the bottom and middle level of society. So they are always at the bottom and middle level.”

Chapter 1138: Chapter 1127: Data Plunder
Translator: 549690339
Dudian was silent but his heart was in awe. He finally knew the purpose of his capture.
“There are only two of us here. What do you want to Do? Just say it. Why do you have to say these Grand Words? Don’t you feel bored?”Dudian said bluntly. He wasn’t afraid of angering the other party, he wasn’t going to do things based on anger or personal preference.
The God of Science and technology smiled. He wasn’t angry. There were several robots moving outside the energy shield. Blue light flashed in their eyes as they moved the instruments outside the energy shield, a metal platform slowly rose from the bottom of the alloy platform inside the energy shield. It looked like a lecture platform.
Dudian squinted his eyes as he looked at the scene.
Suddenly a strong electric current came from the ground. He was caught off guard. The electric current spread through his body. He shouted but didn’t resist, he fainted. His eyes rolled back and he was unconscious.
The God of Science and technology looked at dudian who had fainted on the ground. His expression was indifferent. He saw that the metal platform was opened. It looked like a cabinet. There were two eyeball-like holes in it. There were two black lines that stretched out from it. It looked like a living snake, the black lines meandered towards Dudian and connected to the temples on both sides of his brain.
In the coma, countless information rushed into his brain. Dudian woke up from the coma. The colorful information was like a dream when he was in a coma. When he woke up.., there were two black lines extending from the metal platform like two strange arms.
His pupils shrank as he quickly pulled out the two black lines. He took a few steps back and looked at the god of Science and technology in front of him.
“What do you want to Do?”Dudian’s face was gloomy.
The God of science and technology smiled: “I want to implant a small virus into you.”
Dudian frowned. He knew that he hadn’t finished his sentence. What was the purpose of the virus? Kill Him? If it was to kill him, there was no need to go through so much trouble. The previous electric current only needed to be doubled to electrocute him to death.
While he was puzzled, the dream-like information in his mind quickly occupied his brain. It was as if there were many voices shouting and many faces flashing in his eyes. Moreover, the shouting was multiplying, it completely engulfed his other thoughts, and he did not have the energy to think about anything else. He could not help but hug his head and roar, trying to drown out all the voices in his mind.
His roar was angry and torn, like a trapped beast.
The Roar continued for half an hour before he stopped. It was as if he had used up all the strength in his body. He panted heavily, and then he felt an inexplicable emptiness and confusion. Although the voices in his mind gradually weakened, he could not help but feel a sense of emptiness, but he couldn’t help but feel a sense of emptiness. He looked up at the god of Science and technology. He didn’t know who it was?
He looked around at the strange energy cover and the strange room. He asked in a daze: “Where Is This?”
The God of Science and technology looked at Dudian’s blank eyes. He smiled as he read through the psychology books recorded by numerous psychology masters, he was able to observe the subtle expressions and psychological analysis of people far more than the top psychologists of the federation. He could see that Dudian wasn’t lying and pretending. It was exactly as he had expected, because he didn’t think that there was a human who could resist the virus that he had personally programmed.
This virus was enough to paralyze the core database of any consortium in the Federation!
How could the computing power and capacity of the human brain be compared to the core database of the four consortia? It was like a speck of dust and the Moon in the sky. The difference was more than billions of times?
However, the virus wouldn’t destroy Dudian’s brain. The virus would only destroy and devour all the data in the “Memory”and turn it into the most primitive data, it would gradually empty all the information in the ‘memory’and turn the ‘memory’into zero!
In his eyes, there was no big difference between a human and a robot. The human brain was just a core database for him. The so-called memory was just pieces of data. He had the ability to create a robot that was no different from a real person. However, his computational ability and IQ were hundreds of times higher than a human. He had the ability to create his own emotions, thoughts and logic!
This was his strength!
The God of science and technology slowly walked towards Dudian. Dudian’s mouth was slightly open as he saw Dudian approach. He gently squirmed but only made muffled sounds. It seemed that he had lost his language ability!
When the god of Science and technology completely stood in front of Dudian, the latter was like a fool. He was sitting on the ground in a daze. His eyes were open but there was no expression on his face. He knew that.., the virus in Dudian’s mind had completely multiplied in an instant and swallowed his thoughts.
Words, physical actions and even instinct were swallowed!
It was not an exaggeration to say that the virus that he personally wrote was the number one virus in the federation. There was no one other than him who could solve it!
However, no matter how powerful the virus was in front of him, it was just an ant that could be easily destroyed. After all, he was a god in the virtual world!
Unfortunately, his omniscient and omnipotent power could only be unleashed to the extreme in the virtual world. That was why he needed a perfect carrier! And this first batch of God’s embryo created in the old era was undoubtedly the most suitable carrier. With his ability, he could completely restore this carrier to the strength of his body as soon as possible, or even surpass it!
“If you are willing to submit, you can keep your consciousness and transfer it to the most powerful mech. You will become my most capable subordinate. Unfortunately, you have missed this opportunity.”The God of Science and technology whispered.
The next moment, the energy shield around them gradually disappeared. The six layers of energy shield gradually converged. Then they saw several robots carrying a huge glowing ball of light. It was like a four to five meter diameter round light bulb.
The ball was sent into the metal table. The robot retreated to the side and saw a golden cable-like line extended from the luminous metal ball. The tip of the line was pointed and pierced into Dudian’s glabella, blood oozed out from the wound but Dudian’s eyes were dull. He didn’t have any reaction. It seemed that he had lost his instinct for pain.
“I gave up my body and sent my memory into the mechanical heart. I turned it into a piece of data to exist in the virtual world. I wanted to capture the emperor of the Empire or the two Dragon Masters of the Fire Dragon Kingdom. Unfortunately, they were too strong and cautious. Fortunately, I was lucky. After 254 years of waiting, I finally got a new body...”the god of science and technology muttered to himself, eyes shining with a bright light, with a bit of anticipation and excitement, the body gradually fade away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1139
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1139: Chapter 1128: Incomplete God’s body
Translator: 549690339
Dudian’s body began to tremble when the god of science and technology’s body completely disappeared. He blinked his eyes, dudian could clearly see the floating dust in the air dozens of meters away. This was the power of the extraordinary body!
“What a powerful body!”A smile appeared on his face, but it seemed to be slightly out of tune and a little strange. After muttering to himself, he closed his eyes again, he let the data consciousness that surged into his glabella quickly fill up the empty brain. More and more consciousness data flowed in, and soon, a change suddenly appeared in the empty brain.
A large amount of mottled information suddenly multiplied from the empty space. It turned into a stream of data and collided with his consciousness!
“Humph!”His consciousness snorted. His consciousness was still connected to the entire brain by the optical cable. He quickly deployed a group of anti-virus decoders and transferred them into the brain of the body, the rapidly multiplying and devouring mottled data melted like ice and snow. Soon, this group of virus that completely destroyed Dudian’s consciousness and memory was completely wiped out, even as the god of Science and technology, he was unable to restore it.
After dealing with the virus, he quickly began his own looting work. His consciousness poured into all the memory cells in Dudian’s brain and completely occupied his brain.
A few minutes later, he opened his eyes and slowly stood up from the ground. He lifted his hands and feet and simply moved them. This kind of real and clear feeling made him feel touched. Even if he was as calm as a machine.., at this moment, he couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
The next moment, two cold electricity shot out from his eyes. His dark pupils suddenly turned golden and shrank. Then he saw that the world in front of him was completely different. He could see the fine dust in the air, including moisture.., he could even see through the robot in front of him. He saw the structure of the machine and the core of the Energy Board. This powerful pupil power made him feel new and happy.
“It is indeed a god’s body. It is not just a god’s embryo. The genes have been mixed with the flame insect and the polar ice insect. Moreover, the Aragami factor has been added. It is close to perfection. Unfortunately, there is a problem with the heart consciousness and the Aragami factor. It is not coordinated enough. It has been separated from the genes and condensed into a ball. Moreover, it has given birth to a new life. Once it breaks the heart, it will swallow the main body and become an unprecedented mutated Aragami...”he looked down at his own body, there was surprise and excitement in his eyes. Yes, he was excited!
If he knew that Dudian was the god of Science and technology then he would be shocked to see him so excited. After all, even if it was the most tragic war between the federation and the empire hundreds of years ago.., half of the federation was injured but there wasn’t the slightest fluctuation of energy from him. There wasn’t even a trace of regret or regret.
Soon, the god of science and technology realized that his emotions were fluctuating too much. However, he quickly understood, “After being immersed in the virtual world for more than 200 years, I transformed into data and shuttled between various machines. My thinking has become stiff and mechanical. Now that I have plundered a new body, I seem to have come back to life and become a human. No, I have become a God!”
His eyes lit up, “Although this body is not coordinated enough when he is growing into the Aragami factor. But I can correct it. I have seen from his genes that his body is not only a god’s embryo. It is a bit special. I didn’t expect that he has walked on the path that I am going to take!”
He originally planned to plunder a god’s embryo body like Dudian. He would use the flame insect and the polar ice insect. He would use the Aragami to transform his body into a perfect God’s body and evolve into a true God!
However he didn’t expect that Dudian’s body was already a god body. However because of the surgery which wasn’t perfect enough the god body was broken.
“The reason why the alien insects attacked the earth was because of the special characteristics of the human body. It fits the flaws of the alien insects and can help them to achieve immortality. The God’s embryo is the most suitable target for the alien insects! “However, over the past two hundred years, I have used the AI to calculate countless experimental methods. In addition to the information I obtained from the demonic insects and Aragami, I have finally deduced the most perfect synthetic route. It possesses the limitless splitting and healing ability of the demonic insects, as well as the ability of the Aragami to devour all matter. At the extreme, even the air can be devoured into nutrients. Once it is formed, it will not be able to be killed. Even the fire of the sun, absolute zero, will not be able to destroy me!”
“Even in the vacuum of the universe, I won’t die. I Won’t be afraid of the low temperature in the vacuum, the radiation in the universe, and I won’t be afraid of no food!”
“Next, I just need to fix this hidden danger in my body!”
Thinking of this, the god of science and technology lowered his head. His golden pupils seemed to be able to see through everything. He saw a pure golden heart on his chest and the outline of a monster baby in the heart.
He narrowed his eyes slightly, and a trace of coldness and killing intent flashed across his eyes. Once the Aragami in the heart hatched, he could not predict what kind of monster it would be. However, there was no doubt that the latter would have unimaginable potential, in addition to the terrifying devouring ability and growth ability that the Aragami possessed, it was possible that in a short period of time, they would be able to push the entire world to the brink of extinction!
The Emperor and the two Dragon Masters of the Fire Dragon Empire were still thinking about the fight. However, they didn’t know that there was something more terrifying than nuclear weapons in the body of the Abyss!
Fortunately, he had successfully plundered this body. He felt that he had inadvertently saved the entire human race. There was a trace of mockery on the corner of his mouth but his eyes were calm. From now on, he was the master of this body, he naturally had to get rid of this hidden danger!
“However, to get rid of this heart, I have to find something else to replace it.”The God of Science and Technology’s thoughts were fast. He could calculate a million possibilities in a second. There was a golden cable connected to Dudian’s forehead, part of his consciousness was still in the brain. He could use all the computers in the federation to help him calculate. He quickly thought of the difficulty of getting rid of this hidden danger.
“This body is still a damaged divine body after all. If I rashly remove the heart, it won’t be long before it dies. If I use the heart of another person with a strong constitution to replace it, this heart is merely the evolution of the flesh and blood of an ordinary human. Although it is strong, under the terrifying genes in his body, it will either be dissolved or crushed!”
“There are only three options!”
The God of science and technology frowned deeply, feeling somewhat troubled, “Either he finds his original heart, but the premise is that the heart is still there, or it is the heart that was born from the Aragami gene. Only the Aragami heart can withstand the gene balance in his body, but the Aragami Heart is unable to fuse into his body, and it will also give birth to a monster again! “The third method is to find a mechanical engine that is not infected by the gene and can replace the heart, but this will make the heart the biggest flaw in the body. It can not be killed by the extreme fire like a god, and it can not be frozen to an indestructible state.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1140
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1140: Chapter 1,129: win
Translator: 549690339
“He came from the empire. The heart should have been lost there, and it can be found from his memories. However, his memories were torn apart by the virus, and the virus was wiped out by me. If I want to restore this virus, I need to use the power of the mainframe to do the calculations. It will take some time, and even if I find his memories and know where the heart was lost, based on his condition, there is a 90% chance that the heart no longer exists in this world.”
The God of technology muttered to himself as he sighed in his heart. He could only put this choice aside.
“Right now, I have to first remove this heart of his. I will temporarily replace it with a mechanical heart. Although it will become the weakness of this body, if I am given enough time, I will be able to find a way to perfectly fuse the Aragami factor into his body once again and form a new heart. At that moment, I will become a perfect life form. Not only will I control beyonder powers, my consciousness will also be connected to the virtual world. Once I create the dream entry system, I will be able to create a dream world, allowing everyone to live in their dreams. Be It Earth or the dream world, I will be the only God!”
At the thought of this, his eyes shone with a golden light, and his blood surged.
After a few breaths, he gradually suppressed the excitement in his heart. He was trapped in the loneliness of the virtual world more than 200 years ago, and after seizing this young man’s body, he released it to his heart’s content. At this moment, he had already regained his calm. His gaze was like lightning, incomparably cold, he was just about to use his consciousness in the virtual world to control a robot. He called for Hazellody and the others to come in and listen to his orders.
Suddenly, he felt something strange in his head.
It felt like a tumor was stuffed in his head, and he felt a little dizzy.
“What’s going on?”He was shocked. Could there be a hidden danger in this body?
With a thought, a robot quickly flew over. Its shiny alloy body stood outside the energy shield, acting as a mirror.
He looked at the reflective alloy body of the robot, which reflected his own appearance. There was a look of surprise on his face. He immediately used clairvoyance to look over, wanting to use clairvoyance to inspect his brain, but just as his pupils were clairvoyant.., he pierced through the body of the robot and saw its internal structure. He did not use the reflective body of the robot to see his brain and body structure.
“I can’t look at myself in the mirror...”the god of science and technology was startled. He used his consciousness to mobilize all the machines in this layer.
He could control all the machines connected to the internet. In the virtual world, he was the most powerful virus rather than a god.
“Check the body, scan...”the god of Science and technology commanded with his consciousness.
Several instruments that were used to check Dudian’s body data were immediately activated. Green lights flashed as they scanned Dudian’s body data into the instruments.
Soon, the god of Science and technology saw the body structure that he had scanned.
In the picture, there was a thumb-sized round stone ball in the depths of his brain!
“This is...”the god of technology widened his eyes in shock, but in the next moment, a sharp pain came from his brain!
The intense pain seemed to be tearing apart his brain cells. The God of Technology, who had not experienced pain for more than 200 years and had no sense of touch, was instantly stimulated by the intense pain and convulsed all over his body, even his consciousness in the virtual world was trembling, causing chaos. At this moment, with Duyue city as the core, many computer systems in the nearby big cities appeared to be in a strange mess.
This was a large-scale computer poisoning situation. Many people were at a loss, thinking that the machine was broken. Some people even cursed and were furious.
The god of technology naturally would not pay attention to these things. At this moment, he did not have the mood or consciousness to pay attention to these things. His mind was filled with pain, and during the intense pain that lasted for a few seconds.., suddenly, a surge of chaotic pieces of consciousness rushed into “His”brain. This consciousness was filled with many memory fragments, piece by piece, and quickly engulfed his consciousness in a sweeping manner.
“Roar!”
The God of Technology heard a crazy roar, like a beast’s roar, like a demonic god!
“Get Out! !”
Immediately following that was a deafening roar, like thunder in the clouds, shaking the god of technology so much that his consciousness was blurred, and he could hardly concentrate on his thoughts.
This feeling was as if he was seriously trying to solve a complicated math problem, but the noise next to him shook the sky, making his mind completely unable to concentrate and giving him a splitting headache!
“Who are you? Are You the god of Science and Technology?”The teenager’s body trembled, his eyes bulged out as he held his head, he shouted: “No, I’m the God of Science and technology. No, my original name is Lin Changsheng. No, no, it’s all wrong. I’m Crimson Moon. No, that’s a slut. I’m the Devil of the Dark Church. I’m Dudian... Ah Ah Ah Ah! !”
He screamed at the top of his lungs. His face was full of pain and horror.
The sharp blades gradually protruded out of his body like a monster. The sharp blades spread out like black magic. The next moment, a blazing flame was ignited in his hair. However, the flame didn’t burn his hair, the reason was that the sun beast controlled heat. It could allow the body to absorb the heat from the flame. It was like a plastic bag filled with water.
He screamed and jumped up. He hit the energy shield above his head and fell to the ground. He was like a beast as he hit the floor with his head.
“I am Lin Changsheng! I Am the God of Science and Technology! I have lived for more than two hundred years! Get lost! Lowly mortal! !”The youth roared, his eyes were emitting cold light as if he wanted to kill everyone. But the next moment, he grabbed his hair and roared: “No, I am Dean! Lin Changsheng is just a dream! That’s why I created the Dream System!”
He suddenly roared as his body curled up on the ground. He hugged his head and growled. His voice was extremely painful.
After ten minutes, his body gradually stopped trembling. It was as if he had experienced an intense physical fight. He felt sweat all over his body. But when he sat up.., he could not help but burst into laughter.
“I still won!”
He clenched his fists tightly, and the smile on his face disappeared. He was filled with hatred and anger.
“You’ve calculated all the traps, and you’re smart and cautious, but in the end, you still made a mistake!”He smiled coldly, but the killing intent in his eyes was dense. “It ends here. Even if you have a trick up your sleeve, so what?”
“Competing in memory, competing in willpower, I Won’t lose to anyone!”
He slightly grinned, his eyes bursting with arrogance. “I, Lin Changsheng, the god of Science and Technology of the Federation, have lived for over 200 years. How can you imagine how rich my memory is and how tenacious my willpower is?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1141
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1141: Chapter 1130: Battle of the gods
Translator: 549690339
This Battle of consciousness caused the god of technology to feel extremely tired. He sat down to rest for a while before he felt slightly better.
“Now that my body is mine, once I heal this body’s defect, who else in this world can stop me, Lin Changsheng?”The god of Technology’s eyes lit up as he smiled coldly, his consciousness followed the golden cable on his forehead and communicated with the part of his consciousness in the virtual world. He ordered, “Immediately prepare a laboratory and two Aragami remains. I want to conduct an experiment.”
His order followed his consciousness, but in the next moment, the part of his consciousness in the virtual world responded with a cold voice, “You’re still here?”
“Oh?”The God of technology raised his eyebrows, but his heart sank. “What do you mean I’m still here? I Am You, and you are me. If I’m not here, how can you exist?”
“You’ve actually infected this part of my consciousness. Mortal, I’ve underestimated your ability!”The virtual world’s consciousness said coldly. His voice was filled with murderous intent, but it was also extremely rational.
When the god of technology heard the virtual consciousness speak to him in such a tone, he couldn’t help but fly into a rage. Then, he thought of another matter, he said in surprise, “What’s going on? Could it be that you’ve been infected by a virus? No, no virus can hurt me. Wait, could it be that during the struggle for consciousness, he was transferred to the virtual world through the data?”
Thinking of this, his face changed slightly. He said coldly, “Don’t think that just because you’ve infected the virtual consciousness, I can’t Cure You!”
“Stupid!”The virtual consciousness scolded coldly, “At this point, you still don’t know that you have been infected? This lowly mortal’s consciousness mixed into your mind and hypnotized you!”
“Hypnotize Me? How is that possible? I’m Lin Changsheng!”The God of technology couldn’t help but sneer.
“Then do you still remember whose body you took?”The virtual consciousness said coldly.
“Of course it’s...”the god of technology was about to say that name without thinking, but when the words reached his mouth, he felt that something was wrong. He couldn’t help but lower his head, his face full of doubt, “Strange, whose body did I take away? This body was mine to begin with. Someone invaded my body and was expelled by me.”
“Lowly mortal, do you think you can fight back like this? I want your body for sure!”The virtual consciousness said in a cold tone.
Hearing his words, the god of technology was instantly jolted awake. His eyes were filled with anger. “I get it. You’re the one who tried to snatch my body. If you’re not my consciousness, then who are you?”
“HMPH!”The virtual consciousness snorted. “Since you’ve assimilated this part of my consciousness, then destroy it with him!”
After saying that, a surge of chaotic data suddenly rushed over from the golden cable and quickly occupied the god of Technology’s consciousness. These chaotic data were like virus soldiers that quickly devoured his memories, however, he was the god of technology after all. He instantly saw through the chaotic data and knew that it was a data virus. He knew that if he continued to stay in this skull, his consciousness would gradually be devoured.
He no longer held back. His consciousness flowed into the virtual world through the transmission cable.
“This is my home ground. You’re Dead!”The god of Technology said coldly to the virtual consciousness.
In the vast starry sky of the virtual world, the universe’s galaxy revolved around the two giants. The God of technology was one of the Giants. He looked at the illusory figure in front of him and prepared to launch an attack.
“Stupid!”The illusory figure quickly solidified. It was an extremely handsome eastern face. He said coldly, “Look at your current face!”After saying that, he casually swung his hand, and the surrounding galaxy gathered countless planets, the dense starlight turned into a mirror, and the god of Technology’s face was reflected on it.
The God of technology saw this face. It was a very delicate and pretty face.
“Look at your body again!”The illusory figure waved his hand again. The god of Technology’s gaze pierced through the surrounding virtual universe’s starry sky. He saw the young figure standing on the energy field. His face was the same as his.
“That’s right, I am like this!”The god of technology heaved a sigh of relief. Then, he looked at the virtual figure with a cold gaze, “If my face is the same as yours, it would be a little interesting. HMPH, you want to devour me just because you want to? I’ll let you know who is the ruler of this virtual world!”
He also raised his hand. Countless meteorites surged from the surrounding starry sky and crashed into the virtual figure, creating ripples.
The virtual figure’s expression was cold. The killing intent in his eyes suddenly disappeared without a trace of emotion, he said indifferently, “I’ve calculated everything, but I didn’t expect you to retain your own consciousness. I also didn’t expect that the consciousness you retained could infect my consciousness or even hypnotize my consciousness. Does this mean that you knew long ago that I would invade your brain and take away your body? You knew from the moment you came here?”
The God of technology was slightly startled. He suddenly felt that he had made a mistake somewhere.
“I’ve underestimated you, but you’ve also underestimated me!”The virtual figure’s eyes suddenly emitted a cold light, “To me, this part of consciousness can be easily created again. You hypnotized him and infected him, wanting to use my own consciousness to deal with me. But you don’t know that before invading your brain, this part of my consciousness was left in the virtual world to deal with such a contingency!”
The God of technology was stunned, somewhat at a loss. A thought flashed through his mind, “Could it be that I’ve really made a mistake?”
The next moment, the virtual figure raised his hand and said slowly, “Second consciousness, unlock!”
Hong!
The vast virtual universe suddenly exploded. A burly and unimaginably huge figure squeezed in from the universe and landed on top of the two people’s heads. This Giant’s body was twice the size of the god of technology and the virtual figure, it looked exactly the same as the virtual figure, but the indifference in its eyes was even stronger. Its gaze was disdainful, as if the entire world could be destroyed with a flick of its finger.
“I didn’t expect that the day would really come when the second consciousness would be used.”This huge figure had an indifferent expression as it looked down at the god of Technology, “Fortunately, I saved it and copied my consciousness. Now, wake up and see who you really are!”
His forehead split open and a divine glow enveloped the god of technology. Within the glow were countless memories being transmitted.
When the god of technology saw the divine glow enveloping him, his eyes could not help but be filled with fear. was his memory really wrong? If it was true, then so be it. This proved that the two in front of him were also him. But what if it wasn’t wrong? If his consciousness was clear and correct, then wouldn’t he be bewitched if he allowed the other party’s memories to be transmitted over?
This hesitation only lasted for a few seconds. After all, he was the god of technology who had lived for more than 200 years. He was decisive and proud. His figure quickly dodged the memory glow, relying on his familiarity and control of the virtual world, he immediately wrote countless viruses and charged toward the two virtual consciousnesses that claimed to be him.
“HMPH!”
The second consciousness figure snorted coldly. He also raised his hand and grabbed, mobilizing countless viruses. They were like colorful storms, but also like countless meteors crashing toward the god of Technology.
The virtual figure also wrote countless viruses to attack the god of technology.
Seeing that the two of them could also use such a powerful attack, the god of Technology’s heart was shocked and cold. He tried to plunder the authority of the mainframe and seal these two consciousnesses in the virtual world, but just as his thoughts entered the mainframe.., he realized that the mainframe had long been set to die and could not seal him and these two consciousnesses. Moreover, he did not have the right to modify this authority.
“Damn it, if this goes on, only the main brain will be consumed!”The god of technology gritted his teeth. The three of them were using viruses to attack each other, trying to break down the other party’s viruses. The virus was written using the main brain’s calculations, these virus attacks were like dust to each other. They could not hurt each other at all. If this continued, it would only damage the main brain’s lifespan.
“If this continues, the attacks will exceed the computing limits of the mainframe. Once the mainframe is paralyzed, most of the equipment in the federation will have problems!”The God of science and technology gritted his teeth. Suddenly, he thought of an idea, he quickly wrote a large cluster of viruses, then secretly wrote a code in these viruses and transmitted it into his body, destroying the viruses in his body and brain.
After doing this, he quickly followed the data transfer back to the body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1142
chapters.content:
Chapter 1142: Chapter 1131: the same kind
Translator: 549690339
“He retreated into that human’s body!”
The virtual figure looked at the god of technology who had turned into a stream of data and disappeared. His eyes were cold and there was a hint of anger in them. A prideful person like him, who had calculated everything, was actually defeated by an ant-like human. This was unbearable for him!
“What exactly is going on?”The second consciousness looked down at the virtual figure and asked with a slight frown. He had just unlocked it from the memory chip, and his memory was still in the moment when he saved it. Although he saw this strange situation after he came out.., with the computing power of the mainframe, he thought of thousands of possibilities and guesses in a second. He even had some guesses about the real situation, but he still had to confirm it.
The virtual figure’s gaze did not stop at the place where the god of technology had disappeared. He raised his head and looked at him, he said, “I divided a part of my consciousness into his body, and in the end, there was an accident. From the last picture that was sent back before that part of my consciousness became chaotic, this mortal already knew the purpose of me capturing him. He had long prepared a trap and a counterattack. It was my mistake!”
“I know, but the problem is, what can he do even if he is prepared?”The giant frowned. There was a bit of arrogance in his eyes. He was proud of his ability, he was the only one who was out of the control of the magic insects. Even the magic insects that had invaded the earth didn’t know of his existence. He was able to lurk in the virtual world and wait for an opportunity to counterattack.
Once he took Dudian’s body, it meant that he had enough strength to launch a counterattack. He could even defeat the magic insects and become the Master of the world!
However, success was right in front of his eyes but there was a mistake.
However, the reason why there was a mistake was not because he was too confident and conceited. In fact, although he was proud, he never underestimated the enemy. He was extremely cautious. From the moment he entered Dudian’s body, it could be seen that although he felt that he was 100% confident, he still chose to leave part of his consciousness in the virtual world, just in case.
Moreover, before that, he deliberately gave dudian a period of “Free time”to observe the carrier through various instruments of the federation. The latter’s communication device and every small instrument in the room were his eyes.
It could be said that since Dudian entered the federation, he had almost never left his sight!
The latter’s disguised identity, hidden secrets, and all privacy were naked in his eyes. But through the hidden environment that the latter thought he was alone, he could observe the latter’s personality and thoughts, as well as the purpose of coming to the federation.
After all, a person was the most relaxed when he was alone.
A trace of gloominess flashed through the eyes of the virtual figure, he said, “This mortal seems to be very experienced in dealing with such things. Before I entered his brain, he had already hardened a part of his brain cells, making it impossible for the virus I sent in to destroy it. Then, when my consciousness entered, it seemed to trigger the conditions he set for the recovery of consciousness. At the instant when my consciousness recovered, he launched a counterattack against me
“Moreover, he was very smart. He did not fight to the death with my consciousness, nor did he try to digest my consciousness. Instead, he was like a parasite, fusing into my consciousness
“Therefore, when my consciousness just arrived in the virtual world, I felt that something was wrong. There were other things mixed in it. If I had not sensed that something was wrong and cut off the fusion in time, this part of my consciousness would have been parasitized by him. Perhaps, at that time, I would not be able to tell if I was me or if I was him!”
The huge figure was slightly stunned. Although the virtual figure spoke in a roundabout way, he still understood it. In a second, he had figured out the trick behind it, as well as the wisdom and reaction of this mortal whom he regarded as a carrier.., his eyes could not help but reveal a trace of solemnity. If it was him, he probably would not have done it better than the latter. To be able to escape from his hands, this method was just like how he had escaped from the magic bug operating table back then!
Cunning, intelligent, quick reaction!
He felt that he had met his own kind. This was a person who was not inferior to him.
However, he was not the him from over 200 years ago. During these 200 years of merging into the virtual world, how many things had he seen? In his brain, it could be said that he had gathered all the intelligence of the entire federation!
“Using my own petrifying magic marks ability, I will split my own memory cells into two and replicate it in my brain. I will replicate a petrifying part. No matter how strong the virus is, it will not be able to attack something that is petrified. This is just like how no matter how powerful a hacker is, they will not be able to attack a computer that is not connected to the Internet.”The gigantic figure narrowed his eyes slightly, then, he chuckled and a dangerous light flashed in his eyes.
“Since he thought of using this method to counterattack, he probably didn’t just live in that part of my consciousness. If I didn’t save the second consciousness, he probably wanted to use the parasitic consciousness to fuse with this part of my virtual consciousness. After the fusion was complete, the consciousness that he parasitized in my consciousness would revive and devour my consciousness. This was his plan. Hehe, interesting guy. I didn’t expect there to be such a person in this world. Unfortunately, if he didn’t become a hindrance to me, when I become a god in the future, he would be a terrifying character who would follow me.”
The virtual figure asked, “Then what do we do now?”? “Even though that part of my consciousness has been infected, it’s still me. I still have the authority of the mainframe. I can enter the virtual world through other ports at any time. Even if we mobilize the machine army to encircle and annihilate them, it’s useless. He can also control the machine army. Our carriers in the real world are all machines. They’re useless...”
The gigantic figure shook his head and interrupted him, “I will take care of this myself. Since I have already awakened, there’s no need for your remaining consciousness to exist anymore. Return to my memories!”
After speaking, he raised his hand and grabbed at him.
The virtual figure was stunned. A trace of struggle flashed in his eyes as he said, “No, I can exist. I am also me...”
“You still want to be independent when your consciousness is incomplete?”? “Fortunately, I had already prepared for this. Whoever has a complete consciousness is the real me. If I didn’t feel that there was something wrong with that portion of consciousness, I would have swallowed it as well.”The eyes of the gigantic figure were indifferent, his palm did not stop at all as he grabbed the virtual figure. He exerted force with his palm and the virtual figure’s face was filled with unwillingness and anger. However, in the end, he turned into countless streams of light and disappeared from his palm.
After slowly absorbing these streams of light, the gigantic figure understood more about what had happened earlier. His gaze followed the port, only to see that the god of Technology, who had withdrawn back into the human body, had already pulled out the transmission cable on his forehead, he was preparing to leave the energy shield.
“Next, you should take the initiative to look for me, right...”a trace of interest flashed in the gigantic figure’s eyes, as well as a chilling chill.

Chapter 1143: Chapter 1,132: Escape
Translator: 549690339
“I’m finally out!”
After the god of technology returned to his body, he let out a long sigh. He felt exhausted from all the battles he had fought.
After unplugging the transmission cable, he checked his memories and confirmed that nothing had snuck in. Only then did he let out a sigh of relief. He knew that he had gotten rid of the two infected consciousnesses in the virtual world, based on his understanding of his past abilities, although these two virtual consciousnesses were lawless in the virtual world, in the real world, they could not even control a blade of grass.
“Next, they should control the robot army to ambush me and prevent me from leaving. However, I can control this robot army as well. Under the circumstances where the program commands are contradictory, the robot army will be completely paralyzed. However, if they want to kill me, they can sacrifice the robot army and activate the irreversible self-destruct command...”the god of technology frowned, he had control over his physical body and could move around in the real world, but this was also his fatal weakness!
In the past, he had transformed into data and roamed the virtual world. He could appear in any computer, but now, he only had one carrier, and that was this young man’s body.
Once this body was strangled and turned into dust, he would die with it and disappear completely!
“If you want to destroy my virtual consciousness, fighting them in the virtual world is meaningless. You will only damage the mainframe. However, I can find the machine heart and the mainframe, restart the mainframe, and return all the data and programs to zero. That way, I can completely wipe them out
“However, they won’t let me have this chance
“If they sense my route, no, I don’t care about the lives of these lowly citizens of the Federation at all. They might have already...”
Thinking of this, the god of Technology’s pupils constricted and his face was filled with shock. He realized a terrifying possibility, which was that the latter might have already activated nuclear missiles and locked onto the entire city of dulyo, using the might of nuclear weapons! Bury the citizens of this entire city together with him!
This idea was a little crazy, but it might not be impossible!
Only he knew himself the best.
The God of technology knew deep down how cold and cruel his heart was. If there was an existence that threatened him, he would not hesitate even if it meant destroying more than half of the federation!
As for these citizens of the Federation? With the human’s ability to reproduce, they would be born in a few decades. If he adjusted the gap between the rich and the poor and helped the poor a little, it would be enough to increase the population by several times!
These thoughts flashed through his mind for less than half a minute. When he came to his senses, he realized that he had wasted half a minute of precious time. At the same time, he sighed at his thinking speed. If it was in the past.., with the help of the mainframe, even if there were thousands of times more thoughts in his mind, it would be in a second. This made him realize that his current computing ability couldn’t be compared to the two consciousnesses in the virtual world.
“I have to leave the Federation!”He made a decision in his heart. He immediately mobilized the surrounding robots and closed the energy shield. He rushed out of the energy shield and opened the basement door.
“You...”Blackie was waiting outside the door. He was stunned when he saw the door open. His face slightly changed as he saw Dudian coming out of the door.
“Clear a passage for me. I want to go out now!”God of Science and technology said in a cold tone.
Blackie heard the indifferent tone of the god of Science and technology. He knew that the god of Science and Technology’s plan had been successfully completed. He couldn’t help but feel a bit regretful. However he hid it well and didn’t show any trace of it, similarly, he didn’t suspect that Dudian was deliberately pretending. After all, only the god of Science and technology who was invincible in the virtual world could freely transfer the authority.
At the same time, the god of Science and Technology quietly closed the energy shield and opened the gate. He felt that Dudian was reminding him that not only did he come to the real world, but he also had the body of a super demon, at the same time, he still retained the ability to roam freely in the virtual world!
Both virtual and reality were the strongest!
“Yes!”He respectfully bowed his head. He quickly used his communication device to pass down the order.
At this moment, the entire Duyue city revolved around the Terras Consortium. The railway which usually carried countless passengers stopped and cleared the guests just to wait for Dudian’s arrival. The airport was completely closed and the flight route was cleared. Only one person would come to take off..
For a time, the citizens of Dudian City were full of complaints. Many experts stood out to attack the privileges and capitalism. There were also many internet mobs who shouted that everyone was equal. There were also some social elites.., because of the delay of the flight, they sued the terras Shenzhou Airlines. There were also some celebrities who issued statements of doubt on their personal websites because of the delay of the flight. They attracted countless attention..
The shocking actions of the Tras consortium attracted the attention of the entire federation, causing the officials to have no choice but to report this matter. However, they did not attack the Tras Consortium. Instead, they sent reporters to interview them to find out the reason, in the end, there were some reasons that they had no choice but to do, causing many citizens who were doubtful and angry to calm down.
While the outside world was in an uproar, the Tras consortium was very calm. Many of the directors sent questions, but they were suppressed by Heslodi. When they brought up the decision of the “Lord God”, many of the directors immediately stopped talking, they all expressed their willingness to help, and at the same time, they sent their regards to the Lord God on their behalf.
The God of technology, accompanied by Hasilodi and the others, came to the warplane that had been waiting outside the base for a long time. Hasilodi wanted to accompany him, but was rejected by the god of technology. He could only watch as he walked onto the warplane.
“They probably don’t dare to activate the nuclear weapon.”
After getting on the warplane, the god of technology gradually calmed down. He realized that ever since he entered this human carrier, his emotions were very volatile. He could not remain as indifferent as before, and his expression would not change even if Mount Tai collapsed before his eyes.
“They should know the situation of this body of mine. Even if a nuclear weapon is launched, I can sense it in advance and thus avoid the core area of the nuclear weapon explosion,”the god of Science and technology thought to himself. Regarding this body.., he had long grasped it like the palm of his hand. It was as if this body was originally his body. There was no sense of strangeness. Naturally, he also knew the ability and strength of this body.
The most terrifying part of a nuclear weapon was the high temperature radiation in the core area of the explosion. However, this body had a magic mark called the Sun Beast. Its ability was to control the heat. As long as it was not surrounded by the high temperature of tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of degrees in the core area of the nuclear explosion.., with the temperature of a few million degrees in the periphery area, it was enough for him to control the heat and reduce it rapidly to a level that his body could withstand!
As for the nuclear radiation, he could also resist it by petrifying his body.
The petrifying heat was absorbed. This was the reason why the owner of this body had not been destroyed by the power of the Creator’s Mech’s self-detonation.
