Chapter 1144: Chapter 1,133: Who Did he lose
Translator: 549690339
“I’ll leave the Federation for the time being. I’ll return after I’ve completed this body. It’s never too late to take revenge!”The God of Science and technology pondered over his next plan. He had originally planned to restart the mainframe, however, considering that the other party would use a suicidal attack to harm him, it was a bit risky, so he gave up on the idea. It wouldn’t be too late to return to take revenge after he had repaired the incomplete parts of this divine body.
However, without the technological guidance of the federation, he could only sneak into the Empire or the fire dragon kingdom to find a solution. It would be another long and dangerous journey.
Thinking of this, he sighed slightly and rubbed his eyebrows in a somewhat dejected manner.
Half an hour later.
The God of technology arrived at the wilderness outside Duyue city through a secret passage. There were not too many people accompanying him and sending him off. He entered the vast wilderness with cumin all over his body, and was greeted by a breeze that was accompanied by the smell of grass, it gave him a feeling of being alive!
“This is great!”
The God of Technology took a deep breath and felt that the worry in his heart had been reduced by a lot. He immediately activated his split wings and flew into the depths of the wilderness to speed up his departure from the circle of peace.
He knew that the wilderness within the circle of Peace of the federation seemed to be peaceful. Occasionally, there would be monsters and undeads that were alone in the wilderness. However, in reality, everything here was in the sight of the federation. In the depths of the wilderness, there was an unknown mechanical bug.., perhaps it was the eye that was peeking at all of this.
“There are no pursuers?”
When he left the peace zone, the god of technology noticed that there was no movement from the pursuers behind him. He was slightly surprised, but then he understood that the other party wanted to send people to kill him. The price was too high.., unless all the god of creation mechas from the Terras consortium rushed over to self-destruct. Even so, it was still unknown if they could kill him. After all, there was his existence in this youth’s body at this moment. He was also the owner of the Mecha!
After letting out a sigh of relief, the god of Science and technology went deep into the area of monsters outside the Peace Circle. Here, fragments of human mechas could be seen, buried in the soil. The mechas were all made of special alloys, under the corrosion of the rain and the soil, there were no signs of rust, but the color was no longer as bright.
Soon, the god of Science and technology met the monsters that were running out of the forest.
“You’re courting death!”The god of Technology’s eyes flashed with cold lightning. He raised his hand and a sharp blade extended out like a whip, cutting off the head of the Python-type monster, letting blood splatter all over the ground.
The feeling of battle made him feel inexplicably carefree. Perhaps it was because he had stayed in the virtual world for too long that he had finally recovered the human senses and sense of smell, which made him excited and excited from the bottom of his heart.
The smell of fresh blood attracted other wandering monsters. The moment they appeared, they were targeted by the god of technology and were instantly killed.
The God of Technology stepped on the corpses of the monsters and stepped deeper into the forest. Along the way, apart from encountering monsters, they also encountered a team of six mecha sent by the federation to explore the area of monsters, there was the Titan mecha with super strong defense that was comparable to a tier 8 battle force. There was the spider queen mecha that was good at sensing. It was able to release a large number of small exploration mechanical spiders that covered the surrounding area.
There was also the Goddess’Inferno Mech, which was good at long-range attacks. It could control a few cannons and its output was wild. There was a close-combat mech, the ghostblade, which was graceful and agile. It could change directions by relying on magnetic fields. It was very good at fighting, and it was also very difficult to operate.
The God of technology only took a glance and recognized the models and combat strength of these mecha. He even knew their strengths and weaknesses. After all, these were all genuine mecha produced by the Terras Consortium. Those mecha designers had long recorded the blueprints into the mainframe, which was equivalent to recording them into his brain.
“Those who see me will die!”
The God of technology showed no mercy and transformed into a split demon body, like an Asura that had crawled out of Hell. His entire body was brandishing sharp blades as he pounced on a few mecha. The battle was completely one-sided, these indestructible mecha were sliced apart like tofu in front of the sharp blades. The pilots inside the mecha were all shocked beyond words. Their eyes were wide open. Before they died, they only had time to call out the word “Demon”.
After torturing and killing this team of exploration mecha soldiers, the god of technology continued to go deeper. The monsters he encountered became stronger and stronger. However, he had no intention of retreating. Instead, in the continuous battles, he felt more and more at ease and at ease, it seemed that he had been in this kind of battle for many years, and he had an incomparably deep experience.
And as he fought, that familiar feeling that he had not felt for a long time was gradually returning, causing him to be infatuated. He felt that his control over his body was becoming more and more flexible.
Late at night, by a lake in the forest.
The god of technology was leaning against the corpse of a seven to eight meter tall furry elephant. He looked at the reflection of the bright moon in the distance on the surface of the lake in front of him. The waves were sparkling, quiet and beautiful. In the depths of the forest, the faint howls of wolves and the cries of insects could be heard, such a peaceful night without the hustle and bustle of the cities in the federation. Not only was he not used to it, he even felt nostalgic and beautiful.
Just like that, he rested quietly, sat quietly, and thought quietly.
He half-closed his eyes, enjoying the tranquility of this moment. His eyes had unknowingly become incomparably gentle.
He did not know how much time had passed. Suddenly, he felt something and wanted to talk. He turned around and was about to speak, but he was suddenly stunned.
Beside him was darkness. There was no one.
Have you ever been so lonely?
Have you also felt that you were missing someone?
“Missing... Who?”
The God of Science and technology was slightly stunned. He looked to his side. The furry elephant corpse stretched over. It was a pitch-black forest, but beside his body, there seemed to be someone who should exist.
Who Was It?
His brows gradually furrowed. He felt that there was a gap in his mind. He could not remember anything.
However, he was not an impatient person. He was not upset. Instead, he closed his eyes and slowly combed through his thoughts and memories.
Countless images flashed past his mind. The first image was also the image of his birth. He was different from other children. The first image he saw when he opened his eyes was a layer of transparent glass. Outside the glass.., it was this world. It was the warm smile of his parents.
He grew up day by day, but the transparent glass in front of him still existed.
It seemed to be blocking him from merging into this world!
Until one day, the glass disappeared. He saw the end of the world. He saw the invasion of the magic bugs. He also saw his parents turn into magic bugs. They locked him in a freezer and sealed him in the darkness to sleep.
However, he was not willing to give up. He escaped and entered a vast virtual world from a portal.
He wandered around the virtual world and saw all kinds of changes outside. Countless people’s lives and deaths, the joys and sorrows of countless people... After seeing too much, he gradually found the core law, this core law.., it determined the joys and sorrows of countless people. It was tragic, it was joyful. The principle of the weak suffering, the law of the strong dying, all had natural laws.
The filial son served his vicious parents and squeezed his children again and again. The vicious child had his kind parents and asked for it again and again. Love and love, giving his heart, but he was betrayed. Half-hearted, but there were countless people who treated him with sincerity. A handsome face, giving up countless feelings, an ugly face, in exchange for countless indifference. Birth, old age, illness, death, pity, and luck. Why did some people mourn, and why did others go crazy?
Was tragedy really tragedy?
Was Joy Really Joy?
The so-called fate, however, also had a core law!
After two hundred years of observation and observation, he had gradually understood it, so he was apathetic and numb.
Numbness was definitely not just because he had seen too much, but because he had seen too much and understood it, that was why he was numb.
As he combed through these memories, the god of Technology’s mood also gradually became apathetic. As a human, his emotions were also slowly decreasing, but there seemed to be a shadow that always existed in the bottom of his heart.
“Who exactly... did I lose?”
He muttered to himself.
The memories in his mind were reversed once again. Countless images flashed.
Over and over again, when the number of flashes increased, he realized that a few of the faces appeared the most. As he thought, they became clearer and clearer!
When one of the beautiful faces completely appeared in his mind, he was suddenly stunned. Then, tears slowly flowed down his face.
“How could i... Forget you...”
..
..

chapters.content:
Chapter 1145: Chapter 1134: Faith
Translator: 549690339
The youth’s voice was choked with sorrow. There was no trace of cold blood in his body. He was like an ordinary weak youth. His fingers were clenched into fists. His face was full of pain, self-blame, guilt.., and anger towards himself.
After a moment he slowly stopped his sorrow. He buried this soft thing deep in his heart. His eyes quickly changed. They became cold and decisive. There was no emotion in them, he said in a cold voice: “You have failed. My consciousness will not be extinguished. I Am Dudian, the king of the dark church and the Emperor of the Holy Church. All your memories will become my memories!”
“No! Impossible!”
Suddenly, his face changed, he roared in anger: “What Bullshit Dudian! I Am the God of Science and Technology! I Am Lin Changsheng! You’re just a pathetic human being that I’ve seen outside the virtual world for over 200 years! Ant-like thing, your stupid ridiculous story, I’ve seen it before, abandoned by your lover, thrown in jail, watched your beloved die in front of you, but couldn’t do anything about it, how can a weak piece of trash like you be compared to me? !”
“Is that so?”His expression suddenly changed again, craziness completely retract, incomparably indifferent, way: “You Say I am only a passer-by that you have seen, then how can you know me so well? How Can You Know My Matter?”
“What in the world can hide from my eyes? In the federation, I can know anything about anyone!”He asked himself with a sneer, but as soon as he finished speaking, he suddenly frowned, as if he felt something was wrong.
“Do you remember now? Where exactly did those scenes you saw happen? !”He sneered.
In the next moment, his expression changed abruptly. His face was filled with pain as he hugged his head tightly. He rolled on the ground and let out a beast-like roar.
At the same time, in the depths of his mind, the originally chaotic memories were suddenly torn apart at this moment. A memory was torn into two parts and turned into two consciousnesses. As soon as these two consciousnesses appeared, they collided violently and fought with each other, countless thoughts were sent out in an attempt to hypnotize, assimilate, and devour each other.
“Damn Thing, you are still alive! How dare you sneak into my memory! Damn! !”One of the consciousness was extremely angry, he was the god of Science and Technology Lin Changsheng. He had completely remembered and separated Dudian from his memory. He remembered who he was and also remembered the memories that belonged to him.
Similarly, he knew that because Dudian had mixed into his memory, all kinds of things that he had done before were so ridiculous that he almost fought with himself.
“It seems that you have remembered everything. Unfortunately, you have no way out. This is my body and my battlefield. Previously I couldn’t swallow all of your memory. I could only swallow a part of it. Then I took the opportunity to merge my memory into your memory so that you think that you have swallowed me. Until now, you are nothing without the consciousness of the virtual world as your backing. Without the mainframe to help you calculate, you are nothing!”Another consciousness spoke in a cold voice, dudian’s voice was full of killing intent and self-confidence. However only he knew that the purpose of his self-confidence was to attack the other party in the next battle.
The two consciousnesses were in conflict in his mind. Although the god of Science and technology didn’t have the help of the virtual host and lost half of his consciousness in the virtual world, but it was still not to be underestimated!
Moreover, if he was defeated this time, he would be digested.
It was like the first and second personalities in the body were fighting. When the result came out, the body would be “Cured”. There wouldn’t be a second personality but only one consciousness!
“Damn it! !”The God of technology was furious, he had never thought that he would be forced to such an extent by an ant-like prey. When he removed Dudian from his memory, he understood everything. He also knew the various reasons why he had fallen into such a situation..
From the beginning, when Dudian came to the federation, the data of the physical examination was transmitted to the virtual world. He knew from the host that in the virtual world, the host was like his brain, otherwise, he wouldn’t have paid attention to the information of the entry physical examination of a border mech pilot. However, when he learned of Dudian’s identity, he was ecstatic. He didn’t order people to directly capture him. Instead, he wanted to see what the ant wanted to do by infiltrating the federation?
Why would a divine embryo infiltrate the federation from the Demon Race? Didn’t the Emperor know that the federation was his territory?
Dudian had been hiding, disguising, killing and doing all kinds of things in front of his eyes. Through these things, he had a deeper understanding of Dudian’s character. He even guessed the purpose of Dudian coming to the federation, it was to find a way to cure the undeads. The reason was probably to cure his family or loved ones.
Although the relationship between family and love was only a joke in his eyes. But he knew that these stubborn ants were very concerned about these things.
If it wasn’t for the coming of the Blood Moon, he wouldn’t have captured Dudian so early.
Because Dudian was under his control from the beginning to the end, he didn’t care too much about the other party. He even allowed the other party to join the company. Even if he knew that doing so would expose some things.., but he didn’t care. After all, in the federation, even if Dudian knew his existence and knew what he was going to do, so what?
Even if the demon Emperor came, he would be at his mercy!
However, he didn’t think that the result would be like this. The reason wasn’t that he was too arrogant or careless. It was because he understood his own flaw. Dudian had long noticed this flaw, moreover, he had laid a trap for him!
The flaw was that although he knew everything but he couldn’t know what everyone was thinking at the moment!
He could analyze the thoughts of these people but he couldn’t go deep into their brains. This was the reason why he created the dream system. He wanted to completely control all life!
However, for him, this was just a desire to control. In his eyes, it wasn’t a flaw. It was like a human who couldn’t fly. Would he take it as his own flaw? No.
But at this moment he was at a disadvantage. He knew how fatal it was!
Perhaps Dudian had sensed his intention before he sent out the creator mech to arrest Dudian. It was possible that Dudian had planned for him to escape and get caught!
It was difficult to copy the memory of the brain and petrify it. This was not only because of the extreme control of the cells in the body but also because of the strong willpower. It was thousands of times more difficult than copying the memory with the help of the mainframe system.
“You knew that I would plunder your body but why did you dare to mix your own memory into my memory? Let my memory be the dominant one so that you won’t be exposed and destroyed. On the contrary, my memory will be wrong and rejected by my virtual memory. I will be afraid of my virtual memory so that I will be far away from the Federation!”The God of Science and technology couldn’t help but be angry, at the same time, he was shocked. What kind of terrible scheme was this? It wasn’t inferior to his. Most importantly, he couldn’t understand why the other party was so bold!
Dudian had merged his memory into his memory and turned it into a passerby role. It was very likely that it would be completely fixed, he would think that it would always be a passerby in his memory.
“I have said that my willpower is thousands of times stronger than yours! I firmly believe in my existence. Even if I turn into a passerby role in your memory, I also believe that I am the main character. I Am the real me!”Dudian’s voice was extremely cold, it was very cruel.
The God of Science and technology angrily said: “Bullshit! You are only in your twenties. I have more than 200 years of life. I have lived for 2000 years. I have lived for 20,000 years. Even 20,000 years of people can not see the experience. How can you compare with me?”?
“So what if you live for a long time? Do adults believe in themselves more than children? No!”Dudian sneered: “So what if you see too much? Because you see too much, your self-awareness is weak! This is precisely your weakness. Let alone me, even ordinary warriors have stronger willpower than you! You use the federal mainframe and countless smart devices to monitor the entire federation. You see the joys and sorrows of countless people. Do you still know who is Who? Who are you and who are you?”
The god of technology felt that Dudian’s words pierced into his heart like a sharp sword. He was angry but soon he realized that Dudian’s intention was to attack him, it meant that the other party didn’t have the confidence to defeat him!
“My consciousness is weak? Ridiculous!”The God of technology thought, he sneered: “You don’t understand how terrifying two hundred years have been for my willpower. Do you think you are qualified to compete with me?”
Dudian indifferently said: “In my opinion, you are just a chicken and dog. You have already lost your consciousness. You Don’t even think that you are human. You Don’t have love or hate. You only have rights. You only want to rule everyone but you don’t know that you have ruled everyone. What can you do? You are born to rule. It is like the world needs something to rule everyone. You are that thing. You are not human. You Don’t deserve to talk to me about Will!”
“I am not human because I am God!”The god of technology sneered: “How can you understand the will of God?”
“I don’t know what God is, but I know what a dog is.”Dudian countered: “You think that you are a god who looks down on all living things. You will not be angry or sad when your men die. You will not be sad for them. You will think that life and death are in the hands of fate. You know the cause of their death, the cause and effect. Even the reason why they have come to this step, including their future achievements, you are omniscient and omnipotent. But because of this, you are ignorant and fearless!”
“Even if it’s a dog, it will bark a few times when its owner who raised it for a few years is gone, but you don’t know how to bark!”
“That’s why you’re worse than a dog!”
“You have no self-force field and no self-awareness. You have no family awareness, no social awareness, and no national awareness! “You don’t know where your family is, you don’t know what role you play in your family, and you don’t know if you should treat your juniors well! “You don’t have the consciousness and self-awareness of a human being. Instead, you despise humans. However, you don’t know that you are also born as a human being
“You pursue the so-called ‘God’, but you despise your own kind. You think that God is noble and omnipotent, while humans are lowly and stupid. “The funniest thing is that you don’t have the consciousness of a human being, but you perfectly inherited human nature. It is human’s instinct to pursue the good and discard the bad. Unfortunately, if you don’t add your own force field positioning and consciousness, what is the difference between you and a beast
“The strength of a human lies in constant self-restraint and self-cultivation
“Therefore, you are neither a powerful person nor a noble god. You are just a dog living in the gap between a man and a beast!”
“Nonsense!”The God of Science and technology was furious, he roared, “Do you think that you can defeat my belief with just a few words? “You are trying to defeat my will!”! “But you are wrong. The more you say it, the more it proves that my will is stronger than yours. After I kill you, I will return to the Federation. From now on, I, Lin Changsheng, will be the supreme God in the world. You are just an ant-like ignorant lowly human!”
“Is that so?”Dudian’s voice was cold like a ghost, “Do you know why I dare to take the risk to integrate into your memory? Because I know that I can break away from your memory because my belief is strong enough. I believe in myself because your memory is weak and vulnerable. My obsession is deeper than yours. I have a reason to live. I have a reason to believe in myself!”
“Because.”
“There is someone waiting for me. She belongs to me. So I have to live for her. I have to live with my will!”
“Go to hell!”The God of Science and technology roared. His consciousness took the initiative to collide with Dudian’s. Countless memories fused with each other and attacked each other with faith. In an instant, countless hypnotic words attacked each other, they suppressed the other party’s arrogance and will.
In the quiet forest, the painful howls were especially loud.
The depressed Wolf’s howls gradually disappeared in the distance. There was only a miserable scream mixed with the occasional roar that echoed through the forest.
The rustling sound of leaves shaking echoed. It was like a gentle breeze. There were a few bright green lanterns in the dark. When they slowly walked out of the forest they found that it was a five to six meters tall wolf with a huge body, its fangs were long and sharp.
This dire wolf looked at the figure rolling by the lake. Its eyes were filled with bloodlust. After observing for a few seconds, it suddenly pounced over.

chapters.title: Chapter 1146
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1146: Chapter 1135: Return
Translator: 549690339
The Wolf didn’t stop as he jumped in front of the rolling figure. He quickly lowered his head and bit down. His huge mouth was big enough to hold half of his body.
Puff!
Suddenly, a sharp blade shot out from the chest of the figure and pierced through the head of the wolf.
After the black blade pierced through the head of the wolf, it quickly retracted back into Dudian’s body. Dudian was still holding his head as he screamed and rolled on the ground. It seemed that he was unaware of what was happening outside.
Soon, the smell of blood spread. More and more monsters gathered from all directions in the forest. Their movements were light as they lurked in the shadows.
When they saw that there was only one figure left by the lake, the monsters were as if they saw a bait that kept provoking them. How could they endure it? After a short observation, they pounced on him.
When the monsters approached Dudian, they didn’t have time to swallow him. Several sharp blades suddenly shot out from Dudian’s body. They cut him into pieces and fell to the ground.
The moonlight reflected on the surface of the lake.
The bloody slaughter continued. More and more monsters came over and turned into minced meat in the sea of blood. The body of the monster was covered in the blood of the monsters, the soil under his body was soaked in the blood. It looked like mud but he didn’t feel anything. From time to time he would roar and shout like a beast.
The night gradually deepened.
The surrounding forest stopped shaking. The leaves once again became quiet. No more monsters appeared.
After a long time, the youth slowly opened his eyes. There was a bit of confusion in his pitch-black eyes, but it soon became clear. He glanced around and saw the mountain-like pile of monster corpses around him. He could not help but be startled. Then, he sighed softly, he sat on the ground and leaned against a pile of monster corpses behind him. He did not care about the sticky blood stains on the corpse at all, and he panted softly.
This battle seemed to have gone on for a hundred years, and it did not stop for a moment. It used up all of his strength.
“Finally... It’s over.”The corner of the youth’s mouth curled into a smile. He sat in the Sea of corpses’blood, but he did not care at all. He raised his head and looked at the bright and clean moon above his head. His eyes were very bright, reflecting the snow-white moon, his eyes were filled with an indescribable expression. It was as if he was extremely excited and relieved, but also as if he was missing her after a long separation. “I’ve finally found a way to bring you back...”
Thinking of the unexpected joy he had obtained from the god of technology, he suddenly felt that all the dangers that he had experienced were nothing.
He had come all the way to the federation with the goal of finding a way to save Aisha. However, all the experiences he had previously experienced in the Terras consortium, including some research data that he had flipped through, all indicated that he had been infected by a virus, there was no way to cure it.
When he was in despair and depression, the god of technology had captured him and tried to plunder his body. All the methods he had used had given him hope to help Aisha recover her memories!
However, the premise was that Aisha’s memories had not been destroyed by the zombie virus. The memory cells in his brain were still intact.
Although he was tired, he wanted to get up and look for her. The impulse in that moment made him forget about the tiredness. However, after that moment, he lost his strength and became a bit dejected.
He was no longer young and frivolous. It was extremely difficult to find a person in the vast world, let alone find a zombie living in the wild?
“Fortunately, she can’t leave because of the god of war’s wall. Otherwise, with the size of the earth...”Dudian shook his head and didn’t dare to continue to imagine. However, he knew that time was tight. Although Aisha was in the territory of the Empire but there were many strong people there. It would be very dangerous if she encountered the abyss of the Empire. Moreover, there were other ferocious monsters in the wilderness which would be her enemies.
“If I can control the empire and use the military strength of the Empire to search for her in the territory, it should be easy to find her. But the Empire has seven kings and the Devil Emperor...”Dudian’s eyes flashed, he thought that the empire only had seven kings but he didn’t expect that there would be more terrifying existences in the empire.
The Devil Emperor was obtained from the memories of the god of Technology. The victory and defeat had been decided. The part of the god of Technology’s consciousness that had infiltrated into his body had been swallowed and digested by him. He had filtered it into pieces of information, this kind of information was not a memory from the process of growing up.
He had mixed his own memories into the god of Science and Technology’s consciousness. It was part of the god of Science and Technology’s growth process. It was something that the god of science and technology had experienced and witnessed. For example, the god of science and technology had seen the world through glass when he was born. In fact, it was the first time that Dudian opened his eyes and saw the world. The parents that the god of science and technology saw were also his parents, he mixed this memory into the memory of the god of technology. The original childhood memory of the god of technology was devoured by him.
As for his later experience, it was interspersed with the passers-by that the god of technology saw after he sneaked into the virtual world. It could be considered as the god of Technology’s own experience. Moreover, this memory was deliberately blurred so that it was easy to be ignored. The God of technology didn’t know whether it was what he saw or what he experienced. Only after careful consideration could he remember one or two things.
However, to him, the god of Technology’s memory was like a book he had read. The information he had read from the book would gradually be forgotten and sealed in the depths of his memory. In the future, when he evolved to the realm of life that the god of technology had pursued.., only then would he have the chance to completely erase this part of the god of Technology’s memory from his brain. In reality, even if he didn’t erase it, it wouldn’t have any effect on him. Unless someone entered his brain again and suppressed his current memory, then he would awaken that part of the god of Technology’s memory and modify it.., it would become his second personality and occupy his body.
“It seems that I have defeated him. But on the other hand, I have only solved half of the god of Technology’s consciousness. He used only half of his consciousness to almost kill me. If he wasn’t too cautious and left a part of his virtual consciousness, I might not have been able to defeat him. The person who survived from the hands of the sage of the insect family more than two hundred years ago is indeed extraordinary.”Dudian thought.
Previously, when he was struggling with his consciousness, although he despised the god of technology, it was only to shake his faith and convince himself to firm up his faith.
Now that he had devoured the memories of the god of technology, he had a lot of understanding of the life of the god of technology. Although this part of his memory was incomplete and there were many gaps in his virtual world memories.., however, he still learned a lot of earth-shattering secrets from it. The entire post-disaster world seemed to have lifted the veil of mystery in front of him. Layers and layers of fog that he had previously been unable to remove had now disappeared by more than half.
“The Demon Emperor of the Empire, the two dragon lords of the Fire Dragon Kingdom, and the god of Science and technology of the Federation are three-legged. As for the snow ape in the north and the sea in the west, the snow ape is the Arctic demon lord of the North Pole. They are all demons, but they seem to have quite a bit of intelligence. They have seized the land as their king and become the overlords of the demon race in the north. As for the sea in the west, there are endless demons in the sea. It is hopeless to rely on human strength to kill them. Perhaps in the future, they will be able to create some medicine that can restrain the demons and sprinkle it in the sea. It will be able to poison the demons in the various seas to death, or make them degenerate, or go berserk and kill each other crazily until they become extinct...”
“But these are too far away for me.”
“The real enemy is the Aragami! They are the masterminds behind the scenes, especially the magic bugs!”
“According to the memory of the god of technology, he is the god of magic bugs. The Emperor of the Empire and the two dragon lords should be the products of the magic bugs. The real ruler of the Earth is the magic bugs!”
Dudian shook his head as his thoughts drifted away. He had been planning for the magic insects for too long. The best way for him to find Aisha was to find him.., the best way was to let the Empire help him find Aisha.
He needed to borrow the power of the federation if he wanted to make the emperor listen to him.
“I have to go back. According to Lin Changsheng’s memory, as long as I restart the main brain, I can destroy his consciousness!”Dudian made a decision. He didn’t rest as he dragged his tired body to stand up, he went to the Federation again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1147
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1147: Chapter 1,136: New King
Translator: 549690339
Dudian took a detour on the way back. He went back by another route. Moreover this route was not the nearest route to the city where the federation’s Mainframe was located.
“There aren’t many people who know the location of the Federation’s Mainframe. Most of them are bigwigs from the major consortia. The mainframe is the fate of the god of Science and technology. It is not in the four major cities controlled by the consortia. It is not in the capital where the president and the senior members of the Federation live. It is hidden in a remote and desolate small city. The environment of this small city is harsh. There are very few residents. Most of them are robots.”
“These robots are all soldiers created by the god of Science and technology, and they are led by him personally
“It is precisely because of these robots, together with his invincible power in the virtual world, that he was able to rule the real world. Even the Terras consortium is just his puppet, the spokesperson of the human world
“The other three consortia are just pawns that he allowed to grow. These three consortia don’t even know of his existence
“If I want to kill him, I can either destroy the mainframe computer or turn it off and reset it. Obviously, the first option is easier than the second option! “However, if I just turn it off and reset it, the mainframe will still exist. I can also learn from his method and connect a part of my consciousness into the virtual world to control the federation and replace his position! “Or I can program an intelligent butler in the virtual world to manage the federation on my behalf. or I can create a mobile port so that I can enter the virtual world of the federation at any time and know everything about the Federation.”
Dudian jumped in the woods. He wasn’t moving fast. He was thinking about countermeasures as he recovered his physical strength.
It was extremely dangerous to return to destroy the god of technology. Logically speaking, the best way was to leave and come back when he had enough strength. This was the path chosen by the god of technology who was infected by him.
However, time would not wait for him.
Every day that he waited, the probability of an accident happening to Aisha would increase by one point.
However, he was not acting rashly. According to what the average person would think, the god of Technology’s computational ability was thousands of times better than his with the help of the mainframe. In terms of intelligence, strategy, and formation, it was far from what his human brain could compare to!
However, he did not think so.
The God of Science and technology had opened the second consciousness and controlled the federation with the help of the mainframe. The machinery of the entire federation was his strength. It was extremely difficult to fight with him but it wasn’t hopeless.
His computing power was a hundred times more intelligent than his. But so what?
One plus one was two. Even if his computing power was ten thousand times faster, the answer would still be two!
In Dudian’s opinion, the correct choice would always be those few steps. The speed of computing power wouldn’t affect the final result. As long as he was prepared in advance. It was like he had to defeat the other party. There were only two choices: destroy.., or reset. Even the computing power of the god of science and technology could only get these two answers. So he wouldn’t lose much in this aspect.
— as long as the direction was right, no matter how fast or slow he would reach the end!
“If I reset the main brain, I have to sneak in, find the main brain, close it and reset it. But the difficulty lies in how to sneak in.”Dudian slowly sorted out his thoughts, “He must have placed countless robots and a large number of laser weapons in this city. Even in the outskirts of the city, there will be surveillance robots and missiles to intercept nuclear weapons.”
“He used to be on guard against the people of the federation and the Emperor of Fire Dragon Country and empire. Now he is on guard against me. He should send more defense forces.”
“If I were him I would be prepared to prevent me from coming back to destroy his mainframe.”
“How would he prevent it?”
Dudian frowned as he tried to put himself in the other’s shoes.
From the part of the god of Science and technology he knew about the power of the god of Science and technology. There were some high-tech products that were not open to the public. Some of them were military products, some of them were used to explore the demon area.
He imagined that if the god of science and technology placed some of the scouting equipment in the city, the possibility of him trying to sneak into the city would be less than 1% !
“He is in the open and I am in the dark. Although he is intelligent but he doesn’t know my thoughts. He can only analyze my thoughts through my actions and previous observations. He has been in the virtual world for more than 200 years. He is used to using the host computer to calculate and use probability to choose. However, I don’t rule out that this time he is serious and will think from another angle.”
Dudian felt that it was difficult. It was like he was going to attack a seamless turtle shell. The key was that the turtle shell had thorns and could hurt him.
“Once I step into the range of the Federation’s Peace Circle, it is possible for him to detect me. It is impossible to attack him with the help of the federation’s scientific and technological weapons. The consciousness of the god of science and technology has been swallowed by me. I can no longer mobilize the equipment of the federation. If he uses the mechanical army to besiege me, I can only escape or be annihilated...”Dudian slowly stopped.
After careful consideration, he suddenly felt that it was more difficult to kill the god of technology than to sneak attack his majesty and the two Dragon Masters of the Fire Dragon Kingdom. After all, the latter hadn’t integrated into the virtual world, there was still hope to sneak into the federation by turning the entire country into his own body and eyes. However, it was very difficult to sneak into the federation.
Should he give up?
Dudian sat cross-legged and pondered.
The God of Science and technology should be ready to attack at any time.
There was almost no hope for him to infiltrate the federation when the other side was most alert.
“It is impossible to directly attack the main city. The mechanical army there is enough to wipe out the seven kings of the Empire! However, we can’t take them head on. We can take them in a roundabout way!”Dudian’s eyes lit up, he thought of the recent events that happened in the memory of the god of Science and technology. The corner of his mouth slightly curved up. He had a plan in mind. He got up and walked towards the other side of the forest.
The reason why the god of Science and technology suddenly arrested him was that the border was not very peaceful.
It was not because of the chaos at the border but because the war had become dangerous. The military strength of the empire had increased by several times. Moreover, there was the appearance of a king. It seemed that they were ready to fight with the Federation!
Over the past two hundred years, the federation and the Empire had constantly clashed at the borders. However, there had only been less than five bloody battles where a king had participated in the war. Each time, both sides had suffered heavy losses. And this time.., the God of technology had obtained information by infiltrating the spies of the empire. It seemed that an extremely fierce king had appeared on the empire’s side, suppressing the radiant king who had been the first of the Seven Kings for several decades.
This time, the new king and the King of light seemed to be coming to the border!
The God of Science and technology felt that something was wrong. He needed strength so he was too lazy to continue to observe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1148
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1148: Chapter 1137: Spies
Translator: 549690339
The moonlight paved the way. The Shadows of the forest were scattered all over the ground like the hair of a witch. Scarlet or dark green eyes shuttled through the forest. They were hunters of the night.
A figure quickly passed through the forest. Suddenly he jumped to the top of a giant tree. He looked up at the world outside the forest. After identifying the direction he continued to jump into the forest.
After leaving the vast and wild monster forest, Dudian followed the memory of the god of Science and Technology and went straight to the border of the Federation. He crossed over hills and swamps along the way, he moved from the monster habitat to the part of the Peace Circle that was necessary to reach the border. It was an extremely vast plain. There were small forests which were inhabited by poisonous snakes and beasts.
Dudian used his vision to scan the surroundings. Soon he saw a group of footprints and huge tire marks. They trampled the grass on the plain into the mud.
He looked at them and recognized that they were military mechs made by the Terras Consortium. They were a team of Dragon Knights. They had the ability to fight on land and in the air. They had lasers and ultrasonic waves, it was able to kill weapons in a large range.
“From the traces, it should be left during the day. The grass is still fresh...”Dudian’s eyes lit up as he followed the traces.
There was a small forest along the way. Suddenly his eyes moved. There was a trace of surprise in his heart. He quietly hid his figure and quickly approached the small forest. When he was less than five miles away from the small forest, he suddenly accelerated. He didn’t care about exposing his whereabouts. He used his split wings and rushed into the thousands of acres of small forest like a night demon.
“Damn, run!”
There was a whistling sound coming from the quiet small forest. The leaves trembled. Several black shadows quickly jumped out of the small forest and fled to the other side.
However, Dudian’s speed was fast. He was like a hunter who was fast approaching at a speed visible to the naked eye. It took less than ten seconds for him to catch up with the few shadows.
The few of them also noticed this scene. They didn’t expect to meet such a terrifying person. Moreover, it wasn’t a federal mech. It was more like one of their people. However, from the other side’s aggressive attitude, it was definitely not good intention.
They knew that the Federation had collected their technology and genes. They had secretly created magic marks warriors similar to them. They immediately recognized that Dudian was a war machine.
“Split up and run!”
“Serena, send the news back. Tell them that we have encountered a demon who was trained by the Federation. Its strength is close to that of the Lord of the Abyss!”
The few people who were running away quickly communicated and spread out.
Dudian’s hearing was very sharp. He heard their words through the earpiece. His eyes turned cold and a blood red gem appeared on his forehead. It was like an eyeball. Four beams of light flashed out and disappeared in the darkness, the next moment, a shrill scream came from several different directions in the small forest.
Whoosh!
Dudian didn’t look at the direction of the scream. He identified one of the blonde women and chased after her at full speed.
“Captain!”The Blonde Woman’s face turned pale when she heard the screams coming from the earpiece. She was trained after all. She panicked for two seconds but her eyes suddenly showed determination, she didn’t run away but stood still. She quickly opened the combat system on her arm. Her fingers were like Phantoms as she quickly entered the message.
At this point, she had already given up on running. However, the news had to be sent back!
This was news that was enough to shock the empire!
The federation was able to nurture such terrifying demon dwellers. Who knew how many of them they had actually created? !
Bang!
Suddenly, a beam of light shot over and pierced through the blonde woman’s arm. Even the metal plate on her arm was shattered.
The blonde woman was stunned and even forgot about the pain. In the next moment, when she felt the pain, the pain suddenly disappeared again. An extremely cold aura rose from her back, as if a devil was staring at her from behind, it emitted an extremely terrifying aura.
Her entire body stiffened, and her heart trembled. She slowly turned around and saw a sharp blade growing out of an arm and shoulder. It looked like a devil. Its back was facing the moonlight, and it stared coldly at her in the darkness, the pair of extremely cold eyes were shining in the dark. It looked straight into her heart so that she would never forget it!
“Empire’s... Spy?”Dudian’s eyes were indifferent as he looked down at the blonde woman. At this distance, the blonde woman’s life was completely in his hands. She couldn’t even commit suicide, he could see everything clearly including the poison hidden in her mouth.
At this time, his attention was diverted to the direction of the other screams. He saw that his companions had been killed by the heat rays of the Sun Beast. They were lying on the ground motionless and their hearts had completely stopped beating.
“Demon...”Serena also looked at the terrifying figure. Her beautiful eyes were wide open and full of fear. She didn’t expect that the Federation would be able to cultivate such a terrifying monster.
“Are you going to sneak in and scout for Information?”Dudian looked at her. He was surprised to find out some information from the previous few people’s short words, could it be that the war at the border had reached such a tragic level that it reached the federation? In the memory of the god of science and technology, no matter how the war broke out at the border, the residents of the federation were always safe and sound, they lived just like the various major countries in the old era and peacetime, and still had the leisure to pursue various life enjoyment and entertainment facilities.
Serena took a deep breath, and a hint of determination appeared in her eyes. She suddenly used her tongue to pry open the poisonous teeth in her mouth, preparing to commit suicide by taking poison.
PA!
A crisp sound rang out.
A palm print appeared on Serena’s face. Her head tilted to the side, and the poisonous teeth in her mouth were also sent flying out. They landed in the soil beside her, stained with her saliva and blood. Her mind was a little muddled, she didn’t know how the other party saw through her thoughts. At the same time, she suddenly realized that she couldn’t even take poison to commit suicide. She might be extremely miserable!
Her eyes were filled with despair.
“Tell me the news about the border.”Dudian coldly said.
Serena clenched her teeth. She thought of the smiling faces of her family and sister. Once she betrayed them, her gentle smile would be torn apart by those cruel executioners. She clenched her teeth, “Kill me. Don’t even think about getting any information from me. I have received professional training so I will never reveal any information!”
“Don’t you notice that I am a member of the Empire?”Dudian coldly said: “I am a general of the empire but I was captured by these trolls. They used me as an experiment. I just escaped today and I am going to the border.”
Serena was stunned. She noticed that Dudian was speaking the empire’s common language. However, she couldn’t believe Dudian’s previous cruel means. She was skeptical: “Is that true? What’s Your Name? I can use other field equipment to check.”
“Are you joking?”Dudian sneered: “Who knows what identity you have? Are you infiltrating the Empire to join the trolls? Or did the trolls send spies to the Empire to deliver intelligence? Should I give you equipment to send signals to your companions?”
Serena was speechless. She didn’t think that she would be attacked by the troll spies. But she thought that what Dudian said made sense.
“Pay attention to your current situation. It is easy for me to kill you. It is best to tell the truth.”Dudian lost his patience.
Serena shook her head: “I can’t prove your identity.”
“Stupid!”Dudian spat out two words.
Ten minutes later, a burst of hoarse screams echoed out. Serena was tied up in the woods. Her body was covered in scars. There were burns and lacerations. Her spine was covered in blood, there was a sunken bloody hole. That was where she had buried her magic marks, but now it was gone. The magic marks had been torn off. If not treated in time, it was almost certain that she would die.
In the surrounding darkness, scarlet eyes slowly appeared. The monsters and poisonous snakes that smelled the stench slowly approached. Serena, whose consciousness was weak, saw this scene, and her eyes became even more desperate. She wanted to commit suicide, but she could not.
Whoosh!
At the edge of the forest, a figure rushed out of the darkness and continued to move forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1149
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1149: Chapter 1138: fast absorption
Translator: 549690339
“This stealth ability is not bad.”
Dudian flew out of the small forest. His body slightly twisted to cover the heat source in his body. He turned into a twisting black shadow and quickly moved close to the ground. Ordinary perceptive magic marks warriors might not be able to detect him.
The ability to transform into a black shadow was the new magic marks ability that he had just acquired. Since he had used the federation’s instruments to understand the different levels of life, he knew that he could infinitely absorb the new magic marks ability, he did not need to worry about being greedy or absorbing too much to cause his body to expand, causing his body to undergo an unknown mutation.
In his opinion, these kinds of magical magic mark abilities were all different changes in life cells. When life evolved to a level that surpassed kings, it would naturally be mastered, however, his control over his own cells had yet to reach such a stage. He still needed the guidance of magic marks to help him learn how to use various abilities.
The shadow ability was the magic marks in the body of the blonde woman’s teammate.
“The abilities of the five spies are the camouflage and perception type. It just makes up for my lack of stealth ability.”Dudian was very satisfied with this unexpected gain, in addition to absorbing the magic marks of the five empire spies, he also learned some information about the border and the empire from the blonde woman. However the latter’s willpower was stronger than he had imagined, the clues he got were very limited.
However, from the blonde woman’s mouth he knew that the spies were not from the same team.
Dudian continued to move forward in the dark. At the same time he used ultrasound and x-ray vision to sense the situation around him. It was very difficult to find the hidden figures of these spies.
Half an hour later, Dudian met a few spies who were resting in the dark.
Ten minutes later, Dudian came out of the forest. His eyes were shining with a strange light.
“The god of Science and Technology’s intelligence is correct. Something big has happened at the border.”
The pale moonlight shone on the unknown corner of the forest behind him. Several corpses were lying on the grass or hanging on the treetops. Their faces were full of fear and despair, some of the corpses had monsters biting the flesh on their abdomen and chest.
Whoosh!
Dudian’s figure flashed and turned into a black ghost again. He pressed against the ground and quickly moved forward. He frowned. The information he got from the five spies was more complete, the situation at the border was worse than the information he got from the god of Science and technology. There were four kings sent by the Empire. One was a new king who had just been appointed by the Empire. The other three were also very famous, one was the king of light who had been famous in the Empire for decades. The other was the bloodthorn king who was famous for his bloodthirsty killing. The other one was the demon eye King!
These four kings had come to the border of the empire. The spies only knew about the four kings. Who knew if there were other kings lurking in the dark? Or had they become spies and infiltrated into the federation?
This was not good news for the federation but it was a great news for Dudian!
If the border was lost then the Federation would be in chaos. If he could lead the kings to attack the federation then he would have the opportunity to find a flaw and sneak attack the mainframe of the god of science and Technology!
However, from the memories of the god of Science and technology, the latter had long been prepared. The federation was not as weak as it seemed. The Mechanical Legion directly controlled by the god of Science and technology was enough to kill the Kings!
Moreover, the half-monster mech that the LOCKFEI consortium had been secretly researching had not been thrown into the war.
The super powerful mechanical mech that the Terras consortium had truly created that surpassed the god of creation had not been released either.
Just the god of Creation Mech alone was enough to give a king a headache. Although the operator of the god of creation mech might not be able to unleash the full capabilities of the god of Creation Mech, the various aspects of this mech were still compatible with the king, even if it couldn’t perform well, it could restrain the king. The most important thing was that if the creator’s mecha was used as a bomb, it would be enough to make the king suffer!
“I hope the King of the Empire is stronger than I thought!”Dudian thought.
The federation had hidden military power. He didn’t believe that the Empire didn’t have it.
Since the King of light had personally sent four kings, especially the first king of the empire, it was clear that this operation was not a small matter. It was very likely that the secret army would be sent or hidden secret forces would be sent.
“The Fire Dragon Kingdom will pay attention to their fight...”
Dudian thought about the fire dragon kingdom in the east of the empire. Previously, the three forces were in balance with each other. Now that the Empire was the first to attack the federation, they must have considered to prevent the Fire Dragon Empire from taking advantage of the situation, what was the Emperor Thinking? How was he going to prevent the Fire Dragon Kingdom.
“Wait, what if the Empire and the Fire Dragon Empire Join Hands...”Dudian’s face suddenly changed. His eyes lit up. This was bad news for the Federation! But for him, it was a happy thing!
The Empire had sent a king to attack the federation. Either they had absolute confidence to suppress the federation and still had the strength to defend against the Fire Dragon Empire or they had secretly joined hands with the Fire Dragon Empire to swallow the federation!
Of course, there was a third possibility. The Emperor had to urgently attack the federation for some reason. He wouldn’t hesitate even if he suffered heavy losses. But this possibility was the least possible.
Although he didn’t participate in the war but Dudian’s mind had risen to the top of the battlefield. He looked at the truth behind the war. He felt that he needed to add oil to the fire, ..!
He went all the way at night.
Dudian met the federal mechanical corps which was resting in the wilderness. It was an intermediate division. There were less than 200 of them but each of them was comparable to a master level fighter.
Dudian didn’t take a detour but directly rushed forward. He transformed into the magic body of the splitter and combined with the ability of the Sun Beast. The sharp blades on his body were burning with flames. He looked like a flame demon who had climbed out of purgatory, he was like a tiger that had entered a pack of wolves. The alloy shells of these mechs were unable to withstand his attack. In less than three minutes they were completely annihilated. He only had time to send out the distress signal.
Dudian quickly left after destroying the mechs that were supporting the battlefield.
He knew that the distress signal would be transmitted to the ears of other nearby mechs. The God of Science and technology who had covered all the instruments would see it, he would know that it was him at first glance.
The God of technology would think that he was deliberately exposing his location to make people think that he had escaped from the federation. In fact, he would turn around and quietly sneak back to the federation.
“He knows the news and will strengthen the defense of the main city. In this way, the battlefield will not care too much. At most, he will use nuclear weapons. As for the mecha legions, they will not be sent out easily...”Dudian’s eyes flashed, this was the result he wanted to see. Once the god of Science and Technology sent out the Mech Army, it would be at least equal to the combat strength of two kings. If the other side spared no expense, it would be enough to kill all four kings!
“If I am included, the federation should be facing five kings...”Dudian narrowed his eyes and disappeared into the night.
Dudian met another group of spies after a night of full speed. He was still interrogating and killing them. He removed the magic marks and swallowed them to grasp the new magic marks ability.
In a short night he had learned fifteen new magic marks abilities. However many of these magic marks abilities were similar to each other. Some of them were weak so they might not be useful in a frontal battle.
However, this was not a problem for him. In his eyes, these magic marks abilities were just a way to help him understand and learn about the genetic changes. The more he absorbed, the deeper his understanding of life would be and the faster he would be able to grasp it.
At dawn, Dudian finally arrived at the border battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 1150
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1150: Chapter 1139: camouflage
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
Boom!
The loud explosion came from the end of the sky. The whole world seemed to shake slightly.
A large number of bombers and transport planes flew out from the edge of Dudian’s line of sight. They were like tens of thousands of black crows in the forest. Their engines were humming and roaring as they carried gunpowder to the front line of the battlefield.
The battle didn’t stop at dawn.
Maybe it had been a night or even a few days!
Dudian’s eyes were a bit solemn. He used his X-ray vision to look at the entire battlefield. He was aware of the situation on the battlefield. Soon he smelled a lot of blood and fresh excitement. He saw countless broken limbs and bones scattered all over the battlefield, the ground had been burned into charcoal. Broken Mechs were scattered everywhere. The remaining mechanical arms were still emitting blue lightning. There were ferocious figures like wolves and tigers fighting with the mechs.
“Has the outermost defense line been broken?”Dudian was shocked. He could only see the rear half of the battlefield. Logically speaking, this was a place for supply and reserve forces, but at the moment it had become the front line of the war. The battle was fierce. The magic marks warriors had attacked here. Didn’t this mean that the outer front line had been completely lost?
He looked around and soon found the federation’s Battlefield Command Center. There were a lot of buildings like battle fortresses that were still in good condition. The imperial warriors on the battlefield were fighting and charging, it seemed that they were aiming at these few battle fortresses.
“Abyss...”Dudian saw a few figures that were as hot as the sun. They were the abyss level experts of the Empire. They didn’t hide the heat source in the fierce battle, they erupted with the vitality of a volcano.
“It seems that this isn’t the biggest battlefield since no king has appeared. Perhaps the king has made a move and was forced to retreat.”Dudian’s eyes flashed, this was only one part of the defense line between the Federation and the Empire. If there were no kings here then it meant that the kings were gathered elsewhere. If they wanted to tear the direction of the Federation then they had to gather the top forces, he tore a gap and used the gap to overturn the defense line and kill his way into the federation!
He didn’t try to find the traces of the kings. It didn’t matter if this place was the central battlefield or not. Since the soldiers of the empire had come here it meant that the advantage of the empire was huge. There was still energy left, it would be difficult to make any breakthrough in a short time. Perhaps the empire had sent the abyss to hold back the soldiers.
Dudian didn’t know what the battle plan of both sides was. He didn’t know the situation of the entire battlefield. But his aim was to help the empire create trouble for the Federation. After thinking for a moment he quietly went to the back of the few fortresses, he used his X-ray vision to observe the situation inside the fortress. He saw that there were a large number of soldiers and some generals in military uniforms.
He used the memory of the god of Science and technology to recognize the military rank and identity of these people. He even knew the names and family information of many of them!
“One lieutenant general and five major generals. It seems this is not the main battlefield.”Dudian’s eyes lit up as he observed their lips. He knew the situation of the battlefield, they were discussing about a batch of weapons that were transported from the rear. They were called ‘Mietshen’. It was a super long-range laser weapon. Its power could directly kill Abyss level monsters!
“Lin Changsheng shouldn’t activate the nuclear weapons unless the battlefield is completely lost.”Dudian thought. Although Lin Changsheng was in the federation but his vision touched every part of the battlefield, he was also paying attention to this war. Although the nuclear weapons were strong but the higher the power, the larger the range. Unless it was a last resort, the latter shouldn’t be used.
Because of his existence, Lin Changsheng should have left the mechanical corps to guard against his sneak attack on the main engine city.
The federation couldn’t use these two terrifying forces. The only thing left was the mechanical corps.
At the critical moment, perhaps the four consortia would be summoned by the chairman to the Emergency Alliance!
“Although the chairman’s authority is weak, with Lin Changsheng around, at the critical moment, the other three consortia that he keeps will definitely be allowed to come forward. The true core progress of the semi-magical mecha that the LOCKFEI consortium has been secretly researching has always been under Lin Changsheng’s nose. Sometimes, Lin Changsheng even deliberately provides them with convenience to help them speed up their research.”
“The Milan family is good at arms. Most of them have secret weapons. If the empire can attack the defense line of copper ship city then they might be able to see it.”
The defense line of the federation was divided into three parts.
The first was the outermost first line of defense. It was located near the border of the empire.
The second line of defense was the circle of peace. The monsters in the circle of peace had been expelled. There were only a few monsters left. It seemed that they had just cleaned out the place but in today’s world where every inch of land was valuable.., the place that had been cleared out wasn’t empty.
Dudian knew from the memories of the god of Science and technology that there were many weapons of war hidden in the peace zone. Once the Empire invaded the peace zone, they would face a tragic bombing!
The third line of defense was the twelve border cities led by copper ship city!
The peace zone was the most terrifying existence among the three lines of defense. The third line of defense was the weakest. However, when copper ship city and other border cities were in danger of falling, the nuclear weapons buried in the city would be detonated and the intruders would perish together!
This was the reason why the twelve border cities were located far away from the other cities.
“We can’t let them transport ‘Mietshen’here. Otherwise the situation will be reversed.”Dudian saw that the generals in the command room were anxiously waiting for the hope of transport from the rear, he turned around and left.
The night covered his figure as he returned along the way.
Dudian suddenly stopped halfway, “There were traces of war when the team was destroyed. If the leader of the transport team saw this, he would choose to take a detour.”
“Where will he go?”
..
..
“Speed! Speed! !”
“Speed Up! !”
Bernegan roared loudly. His face was covered in cold sweat, but his eyes were extremely determined. He pushed the handle forward fiercely, pushing the energy to the maximum. A buzzing sound came from below the mecha. The propeller was pushing the mecha with difficulty, it was difficult to move forward in the swamp.
The seven mecha behind him were the same.
On the shoulders of the mechs were two long dark copper-colored weapons that were more than ten meters long. They were like a strangely shaped cannon that was extremely heavy. Furthermore, they were walking in the swamp, and they had to avoid being discovered while flying in the sky, they could only rely on their legs to cross the swamp.
Fortunately, this swamp had been cleared long ago, and there were no monsters lurking. Otherwise, this transportation mission would be even more difficult.
The engines of the mechas hummed. Eight mechas were moving quickly in the swamp. Mud splashed onto the joints of the mechas, making them look like they were made of mud.
Suddenly, one of the mechas at the front of the team stepped into the deep pool. The ten-meter-tall mecha sank into half of its body. The people behind immediately cried out in surprise and went forward to pull.
“Oh no, it’s too heavy. I’m Sinking Too!”Soon, the second person who pulled it noticed this desperate scene.
“Damn it!”Bernegan’s expression was ugly.
“Captain, you guys go first. Don’t worry about me. I’ll catch up soon!”The young man in the mech at the front gritted his teeth and said. His eyes were filled with determination.
Bernegan gritted his teeth slightly and shouted, “All of you, move forward. Transporting ‘MietsheN’to the battlefield is the first mission. Move Forward!”
“Captain...”
“Move forward! !”
“Yes!”
Everyone was filled with grief and anger. They turned their grief and anger into strength and moved forward with even more effort.
Not long after they moved forward, Bernegan’s cockpit suddenly turned red. Red lights were flashing non-stop. At the same time.., the system’s intelligent voice sounded, “A dangerous life form is approaching. Please Dodge quickly. Do you want to activate the concealment device?”
The notification repeated over and over again.
Bernegan’s expression changed drastically, and his heart sank rapidly. The system had immediately notified him to dodge, indicating that it had already detected close biological data. It was double the performance of the mech and could not be matched. That was why such a notification had appeared.
“Is it a monster? Is it a demon?”Bernegan raised his head and looked over. He saw a figure whose entire body was as sharp as a demon flying over from the dawn light. It was like an angel that had fallen into hell. The figure’s back completely covered the dawn light at the horizon.
And this was the last thing he saw.
