Chapter 1151: Chapter 1,140: despair
Translator: 549690339
The first defense line of the Federation, Zone 5.
The combat preparation area in charge of supplies had already turned into a purgatory battlefield. Mechas and demon dwellers were fighting each other, and the ground was littered with debris.
The generals and officers in the battle fortress saw that the small sections on the battle network had turned red. They were extremely anxious, like ants on a hot pot, pacing back and forth, trying to squeeze out some useful ideas from their minds, however, their anxious mood made it difficult for them to calm down. One of the major generals could not help but slam the table and roar, “Has ‘Mietshen’not been delivered yet? ! are those white pigs all snails? !”
“Mooney, what do you mean? Did We White People Offend You? !”Another middle-aged major general with blonde hair and white skin berated them.
“Enough! It’s not the time for you to talk nonsense!”The only lieutenant general in the battle fort, Su Lei, flew into a rage, he glared fiercely at the two of them, then turned to the major who was in charge of the transportation team at the side and called out, “Where are they now? There’s still no news?”
The major was trembling with fear. Just as he was about to reply, he suddenly heard the news from his earpiece. His eyes instantly lit up, and he said, “They’re here, they’re here!”
“They’re here?”Su Lei was startled, and his eyes suddenly lit up.
“General Su, the two transport mechas are requesting permission to enter the combat preparation area. Do you wish to pass through?”Another female officer called out.
“Quick, let them in,”su lei hurriedly called out.
Another technician switched the image on one side screen to the two transport mechas. At the same time, a beeping sound rang out from another side. A female officer dressed as an operator hurriedly said, “General, they’re requesting permission to communicate.”
“Permission granted,”su lei said without thinking.
Very soon, two faces appeared on the side screen. They were two blonde white men. Their expressions were very ugly. After the signal was connected, they asked anxiously, “Sir, has Captain Bernegan arrived?”
Su Lei was slightly startled and somewhat puzzled. A senior colonel who was in charge of this matter stepped forward and frowned. “Isn’t Bernegan in charge of transporting ‘Mietshen’? Didn’t you guys come together?”
Hearing this, the expressions of both of them changed. One of them gritted his teeth and said, “Something happened!”
Seeing their change, everyone’s hearts skipped a beat. They had a bad premonition.
“What happened?”Mooney, who had fired the racial cannon earlier, suppressed his bad temper and called out.
“Sir, on the way here, we saw the remains of the white lion mecha clan on the way. From the situation at the scene, we should have encountered an enemy attack. There are demons who have sneaked into the peace zone. They even know our military route. From the traces of battle, the demons who sneaked in are very fierce. They are at least level 10 and above!”The faces of both of them were covered in cold sweat, one of them said quickly, “After Captain Bernegan found out about this, he was worried that the enemy would continue to ambush them, so he changed the route. Moreover, he disassembled the energy source of ‘Mietshen’and transported it separately. We transported the energy source and took the air route in order to attract the demons.”
“Another energy source was transported over from the land of another route. Captain Bernegan led the others to take the most hidden route and transported ‘Mietshen’over. I just tried to contact them, but I found that they had lost their signal. If they didn’t come here, I’m afraid that...”
The Command Center was instantly silent.
Everyone felt a chill rise from the soles of their feet to their backs. In the end, all the hairs on their bodies stood up.
Even if it was just a small technician present, they were all elites who had stood out from the competition. They instantly thought of an even more terrifying matter.
However, without ‘Mietshen’, how could the battle situation in front of them be reversed?
To request the Federation base to send more?
It was too late.
Su Lei seemed to have been petrified as he stood rooted to the ground. After a long while, he finally reacted. Taking a deep breath, he forced himself to remain calm and said, “Send someone to receive them immediately. There might still be hope!”
“Yes!”
The others also recovered from his words and quickly reacted.
However, there was a sorrowful and despairing aura in the air that could not be dispersed.
..
..
At the edge of the battlefield.
A spiderlike demon man was fighting with a Dragon Knight Mech. The combat strength of this dragon knight mech was comparable to that of the nefarious sangha. Among other mechs of the same level, its defense was one of the best and its performance was extremely balanced in all aspects, it was equipped with a laser gun for shooting, as well as an ancient laser gun that looked like a cold weapon. It could even pierce through the carapace of an abyss demon.
However, the spider demon was very agile. The legs that had mutated under his armpits and thighs moved his body as fast as an afterimage. Moreover, there was a blood-red vertical pupil on the spider demon’s forehead, there were spider-web-like black patterns in the vertical pupil, which made his vision more sensitive. He could slow down the speed of moving objects. He could slow down an object that was twice the speed of sound to a hundred meters per second.
With his agile skills and extreme dynamic pupils, the spider demon seemed to be able to deal with the Dragon Knight mecha with ease. Very soon, the spider demon used the spider silk secreted from under the spider legs to wrap around the dragon knight Mecha’s entire body, it formed a huge cocoon.
The laser guns in the dragon knight mecha’s hands were unable to move. Its mechanical arms were tightly bound and its joints were stuck. It was about to become the prey of the spider demon. At this moment of despair.., the young mecha operator in the Dragon Knight Mech had a crazed look in his eyes. He raised the self-destruct button and slapped down. Instantly, the entire cockpit flashed with a red light.
“Let’s die together, damned demons!”
A hysterical roar resounded in the cockpit.
However, the next moment, this roar came to an abrupt end. A black light flashed past and the entire Dragon Knight Mech exploded into two halves.
The spider demon who was sitting on top of the mech with victory in his hands narrowed his eyes. Even the blood-red vertical pupil on his forehead shrank to its limit in an instant. Countless dense black webs appeared and occupied the entire pupil, then, he saw a demon-like figure suspended in the air in front of him. His entire body was covered in sharp blades, like bone spikes growing out of his body, like a ferocious sword armor.
“It’s one of us.”Spider monster was relieved after its shock.
At this time a sharp blade shot out from Dudian’s body and pierced through spider monster’s shoulder blade. The tip of the sharp blade suddenly curved and turned into a barb. It grabbed onto spider monster’s body and pulled it, it was pulled in front of dudian.
Dudian raised his hand and grabbed spider monster’s throat. It was as if the latter took the initiative to come over and hold it.
“You!”The Spider Monster’s eyes were wide open. Its face was full of fear and confusion.
Dudian’s figure flashed. He turned around and rushed out of the battlefield. After leaving the battlefield, he turned into a ghost-like shadow and sneaked away from the ground. He didn’t stop until he was twenty miles away from the hillside.
Dudian turned around. He could still see the movement of the battlefield from here.
“Where are the Kings?”Dudian indifferently asked as he threw Spider Dudian to the ground.
Spider Dudian knew that Dudian was at least an abyss level existence. He was far from being his match.

chapters.title: Chapter 1152
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1152: Chapter 1141: Central Battlefield
Translator: 549690339
“Are you looking for Lord King? Who Are You?”Spider Monster was bewildered. It felt that Dudian’s identity was strange.
A sharp blade extended from Dudian’s hand and was placed on the neck of spider monster. Dudian indifferently said: “You are not qualified to ask questions. You will answer whatever I ask or you will die.”
The body of the spider monster trembled. It hesitated for a moment before giving in.
This place was far away from the battlefield. There was no monitoring. Even if he leaked the secret no one would know.
Dudian was surprised to see that the spider monster had chosen to betray him so quickly. However he was relieved. The spider monster was just a member of the border warriors. It was not a spy who had received strict training to infiltrate the federation, it was normal for the loyalty of the soldiers to not be so high. Moreover most of the soldiers of the empire had experienced wilderness hunting. They cared more about their lives.
Ten minutes later.
Dudian left the place and left the corpse of the spider monster.
Although the spider monster was very happy to surrender but Dudian killed it after he asked the questions. It was not that he was afraid that Dudian would go back to leak the secret but the magic marks on the Spider Monster’s body made him interested.
“This magic mark is called ‘Poison Queen’. It is somewhat similar to the ability of ‘Black Weaver’. But after the mutation of ‘Black Weaver’, it will become ‘Dreamer’. If I can get the magic mark ability of ‘Dreamer’Then I won’t need to waste my time interrogating it. I can directly flip through the memory.”
Dudian turned into a dark shadow. But there were spider-like tentacles extending from the shadow. These tentacles were not spider legs, but bifurcated shadows. This was the effect of the combination of the two abilities, the speed of his stealth had been greatly increased by half. Moreover the main ability of the ‘Poison Queen’was poison attack. The spider web and spider legs were poisonous attacks which were fatal to magic marks and monsters of the same rank, but in front of the federation’s Mechs it was useless.
“If the combination is good then the poison can be added to the cutting edge or the solar radiation. If it is a large-scale attack then it can be added to the solar radiation. The destructive power of the solar radiation can be reduced. As long as it can hurt the enemy then the poison can be injected into the solar radiation...” Dudian was thinking about how to use this ability in actual combat. Otherwise the ability would be useless.
From the information given by the spies and Spider Monsters, Dudian was familiar with the entire battlefield. The four kings were assigned from the Empire to the central area of the first defense line of the Federation’s border, once the central area was broken, the Federation could only activate the second line of defense. At that time, the empire’s troops who had just broken through the first line of defense would suffer heavy losses.
Dudian rushed over to help them break through the central defense line. He also wanted to give them a reminder.
The more dangerous the federation was, the more opportunities he had.
Half an hour later, Dudian arrived at the central defense line area. The distance between them was not too far and not too close. It would take him half an hour to travel at full speed. It would take at least four to five hours for a pioneer level army to travel, unless he took a carrier plane.
Dudian saw the smoke of war as soon as he arrived at the edge of the Central Warzone. A large amount of saltpeter dust filled the air. It was gray and there was light and shadow in the dust from time to time. In addition.., a large number of fighters were flying in the air like insects. Their firepower was like rain as they slanted down.
On the other side of the battlefield it was equally intense. Groups of Thunderbirds were flying in the air. They released lightning which destroyed one fighter after another. At the same time there were Thunderbirds which were hit by the missiles of the fighters.
On the ground there was a scuffle between the mechs and the demon dwellers. Dozens of powerful figures were flying in the air. They were fighting with more than ten Athenas. Each Athenas had a four-star rating which was comparable to the performance of the Lord of the Abyss, although the battlefield wasn’t as flexible as the real lord of the Abyss but it was enough to crush the Superior Abyss.
Dudian hid by the edge of a bush. His golden eyes narrowed as he looked at the chaotic battlefield. A large number of people were dying every minute and every second, there were also many carefully cultivated masters and Abyss who were killed by missiles and lasers. The battlefield covered half of the city but it was still very crowded.
It was the first time that Dudian saw such a scale of war. Compared to here, the previous outer defense line was small and insignificant. It was like fighting between divisions, however, it was like the end of the World War. He stopped here for ten breaths and saw that three of the abyss-level heat sources on the battlefield had been killed!
Ordinary soldiers were unable to step into this war. Even the specially trained special forces were unable to do so. Just the sound of the explosion was enough to tear their eardrums and make them dizzy.
The Federal artillery was wilder than Dudian had imagined. Although they didn’t use nuclear weapons but all kinds of thermal weapons took turns to attack. The missiles were directly thrown to the back of the Empire to kill the reinforcements who were rushing to the battlefield. In addition to laser and small missiles as well as metal storm there were some artificial intelligence tanks that were charging on the battlefield.
These war chariots were like sea urchins with sharp blades all over their bodies. Their speed was extremely fast, and when they charged into the imperial army, they immediately plowed a bloody trench.
In addition, there were seven or eight metal balls the size of soccer balls floating in the air. Within a radius of a hundred meters around the metal balls, waves of sonic shockwaves would be emitted from time to time. It was an overclocking attack, it caused damage to the magic marks warriors who were fighting purely with their flesh and blood. It ignored their physical defenses and directly hit their internal organs and brains. However, the Federation soldiers who were hiding in their mecha were immune to the mecha and ignored this overclocking attack.
From the situation of the battlefield, it was obviously not the first day of battle. Both sides had fought from a long distance to a melee. It was estimated that this was the credit of the kings. Without them, the empire might not have reached here, they would have been blasted into ashes.
“The first defense line doesn’t lack lasers that can kill kings. The giant God cannon is enough. It seems that the first defense line has a problem. There are traitors...”Dudian narrowed his eyes, the Empire didn’t seem to be fighting but had been brewing for a long time. Perhaps they had been planning for decades.
After all, both the federation and the Empire were existing human superpowers. The infiltration and investigation of each other as well as the desire to devour each other’s hearts were equally strong.
“Although Lin Changsheng is the god of Science and technology. He can overlook the entire federation through the virtual world. But even if he can monitor every corner of the world, he can’t see half an inch of the hearts of the people...”Dudian thought, he was lucky to survive because the latter couldn’t read his thoughts. But he had to thank Crimson Moon. He had the experience of being read by her so he could think of preventive measures in advance, otherwise he wouldn’t have time to think about defense and counterattack.
Dudian was thinking when there was a huge roar coming from the battlefield.
Dudian was startled. He looked up and saw several huge mushroom clouds rising from the back of the battlefield, from the side of the federal defense line he saw several seven or eight meters long intercontinental missile-like metal cannons flying out.
At this time, a figure suddenly flew up from the rear of the imperial army. It seemed very small in the air. However, Dudian’s vision still noticed that the person was flying in front of him, it happened to be in front of the range of the missiles.
“Blood Thorn King?”Dudian’s pupils slightly shrank. His vision enlarged again and he saw the face of the person. He immediately recognized that the person was one of the seven kings of the Empire, Blood Thorn King.

chapters.title: Chapter 1153
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1153: Chapter 1142: Level Two!
Translator: 549690339
The appearance of the blood spike king immediately alerted the many abyssal powerhouses and the Athena mecha on the battlefield, especially the Athena mecha. The moment the blood spike king appeared, it sounded the alarm, the notification sensed the appearance of a lifeforce that surpassed the peak of the mecha, causing the pilot to retreat.
“It’s this damn thing again!”
The blood thorn monarch looked at the few missiles that were whistling towards him. His slightly pale face had a hint of gloominess. He suddenly raised his hand and pointed. Sharp thorns rapidly grew on his pale and powerful fingers. These sharp thorns grew rapidly, they turned into blood-colored vines. Messy sharp thorns protruded from the vines again. The sharp thorns grew rapidly again and turned into even thicker vines!
In a short moment, his fingers and arms turned into a fluffy giant blood-red thorny ball. It was hundreds of meters in diameter. It was extremely eye-catching in the air. What was even more unbelievable was that this fluffy blood-red thorny ball.., it was just one of his arms!
Dudian’s eyes widened as he saw the scene. His face was full of shock. He couldn’t believe his eyes!
Human’s body was made of flesh and blood. Even if he transformed into a monster’s body, he would be a miniaturized monster. At most he would be four to five meters or six to seven meters, unlike the blood thorn king who had transformed his arm into a giant blood thorn ball with a diameter of hundreds of meters!
“Is this the true face of a King?”Dudian’s heart was beating fast. He felt the gap between them. He thought that his combat power was comparable to a king but now it seemed.., there seemed to be a huge gap. At least he couldn’t demonize his body to such an extent. If the Blood Thorn King’s body was demonized then wouldn’t it be thousands of meters in size?
After all, the height of the giant wall was only thousands of meters!
“But when he was demonized just now, his cells were divided and changed. Maybe I can try...”Dudian’s eyes revealed a thoughtful look.
At this time, the Blood Thorn King’s arm was demonized into a hundred meters blood thorn ball. It was like a blood red ball in the air. His body couldn’t be seen but the huge blood thorn ball was like a blood red meteorite in front of the missile, the blood thorns shot out like sharp blades and wrapped around the missile from the side.
The blood thorn ball that was fluffy to a hundred meters suddenly tightened into five blood thorn vine balls that were ten meters in diameter. In the next moment, a violent and deep explosion was heard from the blood thorn vine ball, and the entire sky seemed to be shaking, the air was rippled with aftershocks like transparent water waves, and the dull sound was like a few muffled thunders. However, on the battlefield below the missile, the demon dwellers and mechs that were fighting in the melee were somewhat stunned by the vibration, this was especially true for the demon dwellers with lower physiques. Their eyes were filled with rage and bloodlust as they froze on the spot.
At this moment, the five blood thorn vine balls spread out like palms. Waves of green smoke came out from them, and a large amount of dust and dried vines drifted down. The remaining blood vines that were in relatively good condition shrank back and gathered towards the blood thorn monarch, they slowly shrank back to their original form and returned to the appearance of his arms. However, the skin color of his arms was a few times paler than before.
During this process, a pair of golden eyes stared at the distant edge of the battlefield.
“Eh?”The blood thorn monarch suddenly felt as if he was being watched. He frowned slightly and raised his head to look around. The feeling had disappeared. It seemed to be an illusion.
He frowned slightly and then felt relieved. After all, he was a king. It was normal for him to be the center of attention on the battlefield.
However, he remembered this feeling. The feeling of being the center of attention made him feel unusual.
After looking around the battlefield, he didn’t stay any longer. He landed and returned to the fortress. There were three figures in the fortress. Each of them was more terrifying than the other. They were exuding the cold aura of the sea.
“He is gone.”Dudian looked at the blood thorn king who had retreated from the battlefield after dealing with the missiles. His eyes shined with golden light. He raised his hand and stared at his palm.
He recalled the scenes that he had seen before. The Blood Thorn King’s arm had transformed into a blood vine. The cells had changed and the bones had changed. They were constantly dividing and reassembling.
If he didn’t see it clearly the first time, then when the Blood Thorn King’s arm returned to the human arm, the process would evolve again. This time he had completely memorized it.
“The second level of life. The cell activity has been enhanced to the extreme. The control of the body has reached the extreme. It has evolved to creatures like the polar ice worm. Conventional means can not be killed. The heart can be pierced and restored. The head can be cut off and regenerated. From the conventional use of hands and feet and the body to control all the cells in the body to fight in a myriad of ways!”
Dudian thought of the potential of life that he had seen with the instrument. There was no doubt that the Blood Thorn King had reached the second level of life. It could use all the cells in its body to fight!
This kind of fighting method had broken the understanding of human thought. All creatures used their claws, sharp teeth and body to fight. But this was the most primitive fighting method.
Humans created fighting skills and practiced different fighting postures, but they still used their fists, elbows, teeth, knees, and other parts to fight, they did not learn to use their ears, flesh, and internal organs to fight.
This was impossible in the old era, but it was not impossible for magic marks warriors, whose physiques were thousands of times higher than humans.
The end of science was theology, and the end of life was God!
The combat style of the blood thorn monarch was close to that of God!
“I should be able to...”Dudian stared at his palm as he looked for the feeling of his cells being restless when he used the magic body, he felt that his consciousness seemed to be connected to all the cells in his arm. It was a wonderful feeling as if he could control all the parts of his arm, he could even make a part of the skin protrude into a sharp angle!
This kind of control was a hundred times more difficult than controlling the ears to fold and the eyes to turn in different directions!
But Dudian did it and felt very relaxed. He closed his eyes and the scene of the arm demonization of the Blood Thorn King appeared in front of his eyes again. Countless cells were decomposing and the cell nucleus in the cell was changing and dividing, then the nucleus of the cells would grow into new cells and continue to divide!
Breeze, tender grass, soil.
Dudian suddenly “Touched”these.
He opened his eyes and saw a sea urchin-like ball filled with sharp thorns. The black iron-like ball was nearly two meters in diameter and was constantly extending. It was like the branches of an old tree, however, what extended out were sharp blades that were incomparably sharp.
His gaze landed on the starting point of the sharp blade ball and saw his elbow. The part above his elbow was still a human arm, but below his elbow, it had turned into a black sharp blade pillar!

chapters.title: Chapter 1154
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1154: Chapter 1143: pull out the heart
Translator: 549690339
“I succeeded!”
Dudian was surprised and happy to see this terrible scene. If it was an ordinary person who saw his body become so terrifying, they would have fainted. But Dudian was very excited.
He could sense the things around him through the magic blade below the elbow. Moreover, his sense of touch was more than ten times sharper than before, the sense of touch of human skin was far less clear than the sense of touch that came with the demonized blade.
He gently moved the blade and it left a crack in the soil. He could feel the friction of the sand in the soil as if his fingernails had cut through the sand.
“This is a cutting blade! But it is different from the splitter. The sharp blade can become soft like a soft iron snake sword.”Dudian casually waved his hand, he felt that the two meters diameter of the sharp blade was not as heavy as it looked. All the sharp blades were aimed in the same direction as he controlled his fingers!
Dudian was pleasantly surprised. He tried to control them for a moment. He felt that he was not unfamiliar with them so he tried to restore the sharp blades to human appearance.
He recalled the time when the arm of the Blood Thorn King was restored. He used his X-ray vision to see the changes in the micro-world. Soon, all the sharp blades shrank and slowly returned to the appearance of his arm. He tried to clench his fist as he felt that it was full of power.
“Is this the means of a King? I can do it too!”
Dudian was pleasantly surprised. He had seen the terrifying demonization of the Blood Thorn King. He felt a bit troubled and depressed. But he didn’t expect that he would secretly learn it in the blink of an eye. Moreover he had a feeling that if he used his full strength.., he could demonize his arm to the appearance of a hundred meters sharp blade. But that would consume more cells. Moreover it would increase the number of targets he would be attacked. It wasn’t a good thing in a one-on-one fight.
“It seems that my previous assessment was correct. I do have the strength of a king but I lack the king’s offensive means. Now I have learned the offensive means. I should be no different from other kings.”Dudian thought, he was very satisfied with the result. Although the king wasn’t the strongest but at least he was at the top of the list.
Now that the war between the federation and the Empire had broken out, if he did not even have the strength of a king, it would be even more difficult for him to obtain benefits from this war.
Once he missed this opportunity, he might have to lie low for ten years, or even twenty to thirty years of painstaking work before he could surpass kings and even bring them down.
At that time, he would already be middle-aged.
Although being able to reach the status of a king at middle-aged was already very impressive, Aisha could not wait!
“No Wonder Lin Changsheng wants to seize my body. He is right, my body is indeed worthy of being called a god’s embryo! To use a certain term to describe it is to break through the barrier in the body. It can continue to evolve and there is the possibility of evolving into a God!”Dean’s eyes flashed, this was the capital of his rise and also his biggest trump card. Although he wasn’t the only God’s embryo in the world, but fortunately there weren’t many of them.
Dudian tried to use his other hand to demonize. Soon his other arm was demonized into a sharp blade with a diameter of several meters.
He tried to demonize other genes. After a few attempts he gradually mastered them.
“This kind of berserk demonization might not be practiced by all kings...”Dudian repeatedly tried but he understood the berserk demonization. All of his limbs were bifurcated, the feeling of bifurcated expansion was similar to that of the blood spike king. The reason was that he had learned the berserk demonization from the blood spike king so it included some of the characteristics of the latter.
The other kings might not necessarily be this kind of bifurcated berserk demonization.
“This kind of berserk demonization is not the only embodiment of the second life level.”
“The definition of the second life level is thousands of changes! Although I can demonize my arm to this extent, it is already a big change, but it is not the true meaning of thousands of changes!”
“It seems that both the blood thorn king and I belong to the initial stage of the second life level. We can only master some changes and then bring the changes to the extreme!”
Dudian was sure that berserk demonization was like a fighting technique. Whether it was the blood thorn king, the Monster Eye King or the King of light.., they all had their own abilities and not omnipotence!
However, if they couldn’t be omnipotence then in Dudian’s definition they wouldn’t be considered as the pinnacle of the second life level!
If he could reach the pinnacle of the second life level then it would be easy for him to transform into a king’s ability!
“They should be similar to me. They will grow magic marks in the early stage and demonize again and again. After becoming a king they will have a deeper control over their own body. They will learn how to control their own body. The difference is that before they used magic marks to demonize. Once they lack magic marks then they are nothing. But now he is using his body to demonize. It doesn’t matter even if he doesn’t have magic marks!”
Dudian’s perception of the king’s situation became clearer. At the same time he thought of Lin Changsheng. Lin Changsheng had been in charge of the federation for so many years. Once he took control of his own body.., it was estimated that he would soon reach the peak of the second life level.
His heart sank as he thought of another matter.
“Lin Changsheng knows how to become a god but he can’t solve the problem of the heart. is my body unable to lose the heart?”Golden light flashed in Dudian’s eyes as he looked down at his chest, the Golden Heart was beating slightly behind the layers of blood membrane. There was a humanoid shape in the heart. His eyes turned gloomy as he tried to control the flesh around the heart, he wanted to condense a human heart.
He thought it would be difficult but after controlling it he found that it was unexpectedly simple!
The second heart which was condensed from blood and flesh appeared next to the Golden Heart!
Dudian hesitated for a moment. He took a risk and carefully moved the golden heart out of his body.
Soon, the flesh on his chest was separated. The golden heart slowly protruded out. Dudian transferred all the cardiovascular and other tissues to the human heart. He isolated the Golden Heart, when it completely moved to the surface of his chest, he reached out and grabbed it. He was ready to slowly pull it down!
Whether it was his own feelings or Lin Changsheng’s memory, they told him that sooner or later this heart would give birth to a terrifying thing that would bring him death!

chapters.title: Chapter 1155
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1155: Chapter 1144: Catalysis
Translator: 549690339
Dudian held the beating Golden Heart. It felt sticky and slippery. There was a strange look on his face as he tried to slowly pull it off. However, as soon as the heart was pulled, he felt a piercing pain. His vision became blurred and the strength in his body seemed to be withdrawn, it was as if his life was slowly fading away.
He immediately released the Golden Heart and gasped for breath. His vision slowly became clear and the feeling that he would die at any time disappeared.
“How could this be?”Dudian looked down at the golden heart hanging on his chest. If it was an ordinary person who saw such a scene, they would have long fainted. However, his face was not too good, he had doubts about stripping the heart but he didn’t expect that his body would be unable to leave the heart!
No wonder Lin Changsheng was troubled by this matter after he got his body.
“This heart is made of Aragami genes. Could it be that losing this heart will break the balance in my body? But if I don’t discard this heart, Will I become the incubator of this monster?”Dudian’s face was gloomy, this matter was more important to him than the previous changes in the battlefield. It was directly related to his own life. Although he didn’t want to admit it but the current situation was that he couldn’t leave this monster’s heart!
“If I can find my original heart then maybe there is a way. But I don’t know if Crimson Moon has abandoned the heart or not. The possibility of finding it is very slim or if I can replace it with something else.”Dudian’s eyes flashed, he lowered his head and pondered. After a moment he had an idea. Although his current situation was bad but it was not hopeless.
He had thought of several solutions. The possibility was very low but he could try.
After thinking of a way out, Dudian calmed down. He stuffed the Golden Heart back into his body. At the same time he broke down the human heart and fused it into his body, the human heart couldn’t exert his power. Only the monster’s heart could.
“I have to get rid of Lin Changsheng as soon as possible. If I can get the mechanical heart, there might be hope...”Dudian muttered. He looked up at the battlefield in the distance, suddenly he took out a one-arm combat system from his backpack. It was like an alloy arm. It could be used to locate and communicate with the spies.
Dudian turned off the system and turned on the communicator. He found a person named ‘zero’. He rubbed his chin and pondered for a moment, he quickly wrote a message and sent it over.
..
... ..
“General Monchi, the spy has sent a message!”
A technician received a message from the computer in the third command center. He turned around and reported to the general who was pacing back and forth anxiously.
“What message?”Monchi stopped and frowned slightly.
“Reporting to the general. The message says that the mechanical corps of the Troll Federation can not be used. There is an internal conflict in the federation. There is also a map of the federation’s first line of Defense,”the technician quickly said with a sonorous voice.
Monchi was stunned for a moment. He widened his eyes and said, “You didn’t see wrongly?”
The technician also realized the value of this piece of information. He said forcefully, “General, I didn’t see wrongly!”
Monchi quickly rushed to the front of his computer and quickly saw a piece of information. The words on it and a map attached below it. He looked back and forth twice and his body could not help but tremble slightly.
But in the next moment, he suddenly thought of a missed spot. He was shocked and felt a chill. He immediately said to the technician, “Check if the person who sent the information is the spy himself.”
“Yes!”The technician nodded and quickly sat back in his chair. His fingers tapped on the keyboard. Soon, a camera image appeared on the computer. In the image was a trench-like ditch in the grass, leaning against a rough-looking blonde middle-aged man, his face was full of determination and his temperament was steady.
“Identity verification...”
The technician quickly tapped on the keyboard a few times. Soon, a circular needle scanned the face and at the same time, an identity information table popped up. The picture on it was enlarged and it matched the face perfectly!
“The identity is correct!”The technician turned around and reported.
Monchi’s eyes were slightly red. When the technician brought up the spy’s identity information table, he found that there was no problem with the spy’s identity. This meant that this information was indeed obtained by the spy, it was not sent by the enemy on purpose to lure them into the trap.
He could not help but tremble in excitement. He stood up abruptly and shouted, “Send the information to the front line immediately and request to speak to the king of light. I have something to report! !”
“Yes!”
“Yes!”
All hell broke loose in the command center.
..
..
Patter!
Dudian shut down the soldier system, then kneaded his face and changed back to his own appearance. He had expected this when he met several spies, so he had already interrogated the operation of the soldier system, using the tools of these spies to send messages with great credibility, and just in case, he deliberately turned into the spy who used the system.
The purpose was to worry that the other party had something to verify their identity, something that even the spies did not know about.
After all, if a spy brought such a communication tool deep into the enemy’s territory, it was very likely that they would be used by the Federation. It was impossible for the empire to not take precautions.
As for the map that was used to send messages, it was drawn from Lin Changsheng’s memories. Even the weak points in the defensive line were marked out. Under the circumstances where the mechanical army did not appear.., if the empire couldn’t break through the first defense line then it meant that their determination and military strength were the same. There was no need to pay attention to it.
“Next we will see the changes on the battlefield. I don’t know if they believe that he disguised as the spy.”Dudian continued to pay attention to the battlefield.
The killing on the battlefield continued until noon. The explosions and sounds of killing continued. The aircraft in the sky crashed one batch after another. The Thunderbirds were no longer densely packed and covered the sky.
It was hard to imagine that the war could last so long.
In the face of war, life was just a number.
Dudian thought that his message was not accepted. Suddenly, he found that the situation on the battlefield had changed. A group of monsters were driven into the battlefield by the magic humans. They rushed towards a weak point in the defense of the Federation, at the same time, two figures rose from the back of the battlefield. One was the blood thorn king that Dudian had met before. The other was a slim woman.
Dudian was stunned when he saw the woman’s appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1156
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1156: Chapter 1145: Darkness descends
Translator: 549690339
Crimson Moon!
Dudian’s face was full of shock. He didn’t expect to meet her here. Suddenly, he thought of the news he got from the spies. There was a new king in the empire. Moreover, the new king had come to the battlefield. Apparently, the new king was none other than her!
The shock on Dudian’s face slowly disappeared as he thought of what she had said before. Crimson Moon had said that she would go to the empire sooner or later to unify the world, this woman’s ambition was no less than any man’s!
“She was able to defeat the king of light who had ruled the empire for decades. Not only did she become the king but she was also the strongest king. It seems that the experiment was successful. Her body was most likely transformed into a god’s embryo or a body similar to a god’s embryo.”Dudian’s eyes lit up, scarlet Moon’s research technology and ideas were inherited from Boro. She was a clone created by Boro but she had her own thinking.
Most of the knowledge that she had learned was taught to her by Bolo.
Bolo had been the king of the Empire for a long time. He wasn’t willing to be controlled by the magic insects so he was forced out of the Empire and hid everywhere. Bolo’s experiment was to make his body reach the god level without the help of the magic insects. He wanted to surpass the living creatures and become immortal!
It was the same for Crimson Moon’s experiment. Now that she had become the king, it meant that the experiment had been successful.
Dudian’s mind quickly thought of her trajectory after the experiment. She had entered the Empire to challenge the kings and become a new king. This was the first step for her to rule the world!
If it was before, Dudian would be afraid of her. But now he couldn’t help but feel pity for her. Since she had become a new king, it meant that... she had been subdued by the Devil Emperor!
Burrow knew about the existence of the Devil Emperor but Crimson Moon didn’t know about it!
It also meant that the devil emperor was more terrifying than he had imagined. With his current strength he might not be able to resist!
“If she knew about the existence of the Devil Emperor, she would be able to become the Queen of the Empire. With her ambition, she might be able to reach the top of the world in the future...”Dudian thought, he shook his head and smiled. Crimson Moon was ambitious but so was the devil emperor? How could Lin Changsheng who had lost part of his memory be willing to be ordinary?
Every one of them was ambitious but the world structure was fixed. It was difficult to overcome. Now the Devil Emperor had obtained Crimson Moon. No wonder he would attack the Federation!
“This crimson moon can defeat the king of light. Her strength can be seen from this. Perhaps defeating the King of light isn’t her strongest strength. She alone may be able to match up to an army of one million and the other seven kings! !”Dudian thought, this speculation was not exaggerated. Crimson Moon was not a reckless person. She was cautious and cautious. Since she would go to the empire, she was ready to be besieged by the seven kings, it meant that she believed that she wouldn’t be afraid even if she met the Seven Kings!
“If I give her more time to grow, she might be a female devil emperor. The Devil Emperor sent her here. In addition to leading the front line, she most likely has other intentions...”
“In any case, it is a good thing for me to have her here. If I can get her magic marks, my strength will rapidly increase. It will be of great help to me in the battle with Lin Changsheng. Moreover, I can ask her about the whereabouts of my heart.”
Dudian narrowed his eyes as he focused on the changes on the battlefield.
Scarlet Moon and blood spike king were like two cannonballs as they rushed towards the center of the federal defense line.
The federation was also in an emergency action. Dudian saw that there were missiles and laser cannons set up at the back of the battlefield. Especially the trolls which could kill the king were warming up.
In addition, Dudian saw some other laser weapons that were not to be underestimated. Some of the laser weapons had strong corrosive properties. Once they were hit, the body would quickly dissolve, although the destructive power was not as strong as the laser cannons but it was also extremely terrifying.
Dudian looked at Crimson Moon as he wanted to see how she would deal with it.
At this time, the blood spike king who was behind Crimson Moon suddenly raised his hands. Both of his arms turned into a large number of blood vines that rushed down to the ground. The vines intertwined like two giant trees that were dozens of meters in diameter, after a few seconds, blood red vines shot out from the soil around the ground. They were like sharp swords and javelins that pierced through the surrounding mechs.
The ground that his arms pierced through seemed to form a blood thorn forest. That was the territory of the Blood Thorn King.
Dudian used his X-ray vision to observe the cell changes of the blood thorn king very carefully. His understanding was also slowly improving. At this time, the sky suddenly darkened. It was noon and the sky was blue, in an instant, the light dimmed. It was as if a black curtain appeared in the sky and completely covered the light.
Dudian was slightly startled. His attention shifted from the Blood Thorn King to Crimson Moon who was in front of him. He saw black mist coming out of her pores. The mist was like silk and floated in the air, it was expanding at a speed visible to the naked eye. It was as if the air was infected. However, the black mist was not diluted. Instead, it was denser and deeper.
In the blink of an eye, more than half of the sky was covered in darkness.
“Dark domain...”Dudian’s pupils shrank. There was a bit of horror on his face. This scene made him think of Bolo’s ability.
“How could she use Bolo’s ability? Bolo’s ability is a rare ancient monster. It’s basically extinct now!”Dudian was surprised and doubtful, most of the ancient monsters were extinct. Only a few remained. For example, the ‘poison queen’that he had absorbed was an ancient monster. Because of the good living environment and slow evolution, it survived.
But most of the other ancient monsters either evolved into new forms or became food and were extinct.
The ancient monsters didn’t mean that they were strong. But Bolo’s ancient magic marks were extremely rare monsters. They were powerful and terrifying existences in any era.
“Could it be that she killed Bolo?”Dudian thought of this possibility. If it was true then it meant that his previous guess was right, crimson Moon had the same ability as him. She could absorb magic marks from others. Moreover, she could absorb them infinitely!
At the same time, the federal missiles were launched after the darkness covered the sky. At the same time, the Troll God’s cannon aimed at Crimson Moon. The laser shot through the sky and crashed into her.
The deafening sound of the explosion echoed.
“How is it possible!”Dudian almost cried out in alarm.
A few minutes passed but the dark curtain in the sky didn’t disappear. Instead, it was getting larger and larger as if it was going to engulf the entire battlefield!

chapters.title: Chapter 1157
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1157: Chapter 1146: Killing Machine
Translator: 549690339
“This ability can actually digest the troll god Cannon!”Dudian’s face was full of shock. He was able to see more clearly than the others. The troll god Cannon rushed into the Dark Curtain released by Crimson Moon, it was entangled by the black energy in the Dark Curtain. The dark energy quickly seeped into the troll god Cannon and disintegrated it, in the end, the heavily damaged troll god Cannon crashed into a ball of energy condensed in the darkness and broke apart. It did not cause crimson moon any harm!
One had to know that from Lin Changsheng’s memories, this troll God Cannon was a super powerful laser weapon that could pierce through a god of Creation Mech!
According to the federation’s speculations, it was enough to kill a king. Moreover, with the speed of the troll god Cannon’s trajectory, an ordinary king would not be able to react at all. In history, there were not eight kings who died under the troll god Cannon, but at least five!
However, the situation before their eyes had completely overturned the previous record. The giant demon god cannon that could threaten a king had lost its effectiveness in front of Crimson Moon. What else could the federation use to defend against it? A group attack by the creator god Mecha? Or an extremely large nuclear bomb? ! A hydrogen bomb? !
At the same time, in the Federation’s Command Center, many of the generals were looking forward to it. When they saw that crimson moon was still hovering in the air after the giant demon god Cannon had dissipated, there was instantly complete silence. Everyone’s eyes were wide open, and their faces were filled with shock, then, their faces turned ashen and their bodies trembled slightly.
“What kind of monster is this?”Someone trembled.
“She is the new king of the demon race? Her ability can actually withstand the giant demon god Cannon? What kind of ghost ability is this!”
Everyone panicked, but soon, a loud voice rang out. “Immediately mobilize all the giant demon god cannons and aim at this female demon king. Shoot her to death!”
Hearing this, everyone seemed to have found a backbone. They immediately calmed down and began to command the battlefield.
At this time, the situation on the battlefield had undergone an earth-shattering change. The black curtain spread and quickly covered the edge of the battlefield, as if it wanted to envelop the entire sky. Behind the black curtain, the heavenly blood vines that were formed from the blood thorns monarch’s arms seemed to have absorbed the nutrients of the Earth after they took root on the ground. They quickly multiplied and split, and the blood vines pierced through the ground like Earth Dragons, the mechs below four stars were pierced through by the blood vines. They were as fragile as paper. The blood thorn forest gradually took shape on the ground. Its coverage was getting larger and larger.
Just the appearance of two kings had brought an overwhelming advantage to the situation on the battlefield.
Dudian had never thought that the strength of a single person could be used to such a terrifying extent in such a war between millions of soldiers.
“The situation has collapsed before the emergence of the other two kings. I wonder what will happen if all seven kings of the Empire descend? However, the federation will certainly activate nuclear weapons!”Dudian thought.
At this time, Dudian found that many of the mechas that were fighting with magic marks had malfunctioned. Some of them were stunned on the spot while others were flying in a straight line and hit their companions, it seemed that they had completely lost control.
Dudian used his X-ray vision to look at the mechas. He found that many of the mechas were affected by the special magnetic field. These mechas were three-star and below. There was no problem with the four-star Athena mechas that were fighting with the abyss.
“By the way, why didn’t I think of it!”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. The Federation relied on the power of science and technology. Lin Changsheng didn’t have a body but his consciousness had infiltrated the virtual host. So he didn’t promote the magic marks warriors on a large scale in the federation, he used the power of science and technology to fight against the monsters and the empire. Science and technology were supreme. The reason for this was that Lin Changsheng could control the entire federation. The federation had to rely on his puppet consortium-terras.
Once the federation became like the Empire, magic marks warriors would become the main force in the battle. They wouldn’t rely on science and technology. Lin Changsheng’s sense of existence would be weak. He could even be replaced, enslaved, and destroyed!
However, because of relying on technology, Lin Changsheng could rule the federation. But if there was no technology, mechanical corps, electricity and other energy sources, the Federation would enter the Primitive Society and Lin Changsheng wouldn’t be a threat!
“If there is a way to stop the power supply of the mainframe city or use some magnetic field to interfere with the signals of the mechanical corps, it would be the same as cutting off Lin Changsheng’s limbs!”Dudian’s eyes lit up.
At this time, there was another change in the battlefield. The federation had activated many technological weapons and more than ten giant devil cannons to fire at the same time. However, the effect was not great. There were a few cracks in the dark curtain, it didn’t take long before the dark curtain was sewn together again.
The federation’s technology and detection instruments couldn’t find the exact location of Crimson Moon. They were aiming at the incarnation of Crimson Moon condensed from the dark energy in the Dark Curtain! Only Dudian could barely sense the location of Crimson Moon’s real body through his X-ray vision. She was hidden in the depths of the Dark Curtain.
In this dark curtain, crimson moon could easily condense an incarnation. She could also hide in any place as if she was in control of the territory.
Under the leadership of the two kings, the magic marks warriors on the ground charged forward and forced the mech army to retreat. There were a lot of casualties. The aircraft in the sky crashed when the Dark Curtain appeared, the rest of the aircraft had to fly back to the tarmac at the back of the battlefield.
The Thunderbirds in the air seemed to be extremely afraid of the black curtain. They didn’t wait for the aircraft to retreat and took the initiative to fly away from the black curtain.
Even the Thunderbirds were afraid of Crimson Moon’s ability.
Although the Lightning released by the Thunderbirds was enough to kill the kings, but these thunderbirds were not human beings. They would stay away from things that they were instinctively afraid of.
“It seems that Lin Changsheng doesn’t plan to use the mechanical corps. The troll God cannon is ineffective. I guess he will use the real weapons of war here. I don’t know if they will be able to withstand it!”Dudian’s eyes lit up, through Lin Changsheng’s memory, he knew the trump cards of the defense line.
As he expected, it didn’t take long for the mechanical corps to retreat. The Magic Marks Warriors took advantage of the victory to pursue and attack. When they were about seven or eight miles away from the command center, an underground base behind the defense line slowly opened. A mechanical platform was pushed out from the base, there was a huge cannon on top of it. It was more than 20 meters long but the base was connected to the mechanical platform. There was a vast plain near the platform. There were a lot of windmills and solar generators, there were also hydroelectric generators. There were two nuclear reactors buried in one of the underground bases.
“Superconducting Raytheon Cannon!”Dudian’s eyes focused as he looked at the huge dark tube.
It was a weapon that Lin Changsheng had prepared for the Devil Emperor. The concentrated electric energy was terrifying to the extreme. Even a king would be turned into powder if they touched it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1158
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1158: Chapter 1147: together
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
Dark purple light emerged from the muzzle of the ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannon’when it appeared in Dudian’s eyes. More than ten meters outside the muzzle, the air was slightly distorted and electric currents flashed. It was like a storm magnetic field, there was an obvious straight line in the center of the magnetic field. There were no electric sparks in the air. It was like an invisible transparent pipe.
The next moment, the electric sparks in the air suddenly condensed and contracted to the straight line. It was in a horizontal line with the muzzle of the cannon. Bang! It was as if a thunderbolt had exploded on the ground, the violent sound was deafening from dozens of miles away.
Dudian felt his skin go numb as if there was a weakness flowing through it. His hair seemed to be slightly raised. A purple light beam pierced through the sky and left a mark on his retina. The next moment.., the black curtain that filled the entire battlefield was suddenly torn apart. A purple crack appeared as if a black painting had been cut open.
Even with Dudian’s eyesight he wasn’t able to capture what had happened at this moment.
There was no foreshadowing and no pause. The energy gathering and firing speed of the ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannon’was beyond Dudian’s imagination. Perhaps it had already been fully charged when it was launched.
Dudian quickly reacted after a moment. He looked at the battlefield. The Dark Curtain was torn and the blood thorn forest that was entrenched in the battlefield behind the Dark Curtain was penetrated. The King of Blood Thorn had long hidden in the depths of the blood thorn forest, he had disappeared!
The next moment, Dudian saw that the territory of the blood thorn forest was constantly expanding. All the vines had stopped moving. They were twitching and soft on the ground. They quickly split and dissolved into bright red blood.
A Sea of blood suddenly appeared on the battlefield. The rest of the broken limbs were soaked and submerged. Even some of the broken mechas were covered by the Sea of blood. The surface of the mechas was dyed red.
Dudian’s golden pupils slightly contracted. He quickly searched the battlefield but didn’t find the figure of the Blood Thorn King.
“Dead? !”Dudian took a cold breath. His face was full of shock. The blood thorn king who could almost control the situation of the battle had died. It was simply terrifying!
Suddenly, he thought of Crimson Moon in the sky. He looked up and saw that the black curtain was gradually moving. It seemed that it was slowly recovering. There was an extremely black figure hidden in the black curtain, it was Crimson Moon!
She didn’t seem to be injured!
“That shot should be aimed at her. It connected her and the blood spike king in a straight line. The destructive power of the ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannon’was enough to kill both of them at the same time. It seems that the target wasn’t her real body but a clone of dark energy...”Dudian’s eyes turned serious, with the speed of that shot and the time it took to gather energy, Crimson Moon had no time to react at all. It could be seen that the target of the “Superconducting Raytheon Cannon”was wrong. If she wanted to fire another shot, it would take at least 30 seconds to gather energy!
Just the previous shot alone had drained one-tenth of the electrical energy on the battlefield!
It did not sound like much, but this was the central battlefield of the Federation. It provided countless mecha systems with power and equipment to operate. One-tenth of the electrical energy was already very terrifying!
“It will be very difficult to kill her once her domain is developed. The hidden figure I saw might not be her real body. It might be her clone. The purpose is to confuse the high-end detection equipment. Maybe her real body has already merged with the darkness. There is no difference at all.”Dudian looked at the Dark Curtain in the sky, it had to be said that Scarlet Moon’s ability was too troublesome. Perhaps he would be able to fight against her when the sun was at its strongest.
However, he didn’t know if this was her final trump card!
A beam of light suddenly shot across the sky from the battlefield of the empire. It was like a particle beam. Its speed was extremely fast. It was far faster than the speed of sound. It arced towards the position of the ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannon’.
“The King of Light?”Dudian saw that the light beam was a human-shaped light particle cluster. He suddenly thought of the identity of another king.
At the same time, the Dark Curtain in the sky also changed. A huge pupil suddenly condensed in the Dark Curtain. The pupil was blood red. It looked like the eyes of a monster. It also looked like a red sun, overlooking the entire world.
When the pupil appeared, Dudian felt Dizzy. The next moment, he saw an extremely familiar figure appear in front of him. It was Aisha who was smiling at him!
The moment he saw her, Dudian’s body trembled. He was so excited that every cell in his body was jumping. Even though he vaguely felt that it was an illusion, he didn’t want to think about it. He even preferred to continue this moment, even if it was fake, it would be worth it if he could see her!
However, Aisha who was smiling suddenly changed. Her body emitted black smoke as if she was possessed. The smile on her face was covered by the black smoke and her expression became cruel, she was cold and even her entire face had changed. Under the transformation of the black smoke, she had become a ferocious undead. Her hair was flying in the wind. She was more like a peerless undead emperor than an undead, that kind of monstrous aura was not something that an ordinary corpse king could pass off as.
Dudian stopped in his steps.
He was startled for a moment. The next moment, his fingers slowly clenched into fists.
“Monster Eye King! !”A murderous aura was emitted from Dudian’s body, his pupils had turned golden. Moreover, there were two flames burning outside his golden pupils. The Flames were close to his skin but would not burn him because he could control the heat of the flames on his body, however, the heat of the flames caused the air outside to distort.
Golden cracks appeared all over his body, and golden flames appeared on the cracks.
“Eh?”In the sky, the giant blood-red pupil suddenly turned slightly, and a hint of doubt appeared in its eyes. It swept its gaze across the battlefield. In that instant just now, it suddenly felt an intense killing intent aimed at it, this killing intent caused its heart to turn cold. It seemed to be extremely threatening. However, only other kings, or at least kings, could threaten it.
Could it be that the Troll Federation had nurtured a King?
As he thought of this, his heart turned cold, and his eyes turned cold. So what if it was a king nurtured by the federation? In front of them, who had been through hundreds of battles, he was simply no match for them!
Even though they were both kings, the disparity between them was extremely great.

Chapter 1159: Chapter 1148: START
Translator: 549690339
Bang!
Dudian’s heart was filled with killing intent when he heard a loud noise. He turned his head and saw the metal platform where the ‘superconducting thunder god Cannon’had been, the special alloy tube that was used to guide the Lightning was cut off. The surface of the tube was sharp and neat. A white-robed priest was floating in front of the platform. He was wearing a gold embroidered hat. His back was straight, he looked like a sharp sword!
Dudian’s pupils shrank. His eyes flashed for a moment. His heart was filled with murderous intent. He calmed down. He knew that it was not the time to find them.
After destroying the ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannon’, thousands of soldiers rushed out from the Dark Curtain. Some of them looked like human knights while others looked like ferocious mobs, some of them were monsters with huge bodies. They were all formed by the Black Fog. They charged out from the dark curtain, stepping on the sky and charging towards the mecha corps on the ground. This scene was like an epic, extremely shocking scene.
Some of the unmanned AI mecha on the ground were not affected by the giant blood-red eyes. When the Black Fog Corps charged over, they took the initiative to meet the attack. They raised their hands and shot out a large number of armor-piercing bullets, damms, and other bullets with extremely high lethality, flames spewed out, like clusters of orange flowers blooming on the ground. However, the bullets that were like a rain of fire brushed past the figure of the Black Fog Army, but they pierced straight through, leaving behind ripples of faint light on their bodies, bringing with them wisps of black fog.
These Black Fog Army troops pounced on the mechas, instantly turning into a cluster of black fog that wrapped around them. The black fog that spread out was like strands of ropes that wrapped around the mechas. These unmanned mechas quickly froze on the spot, the joints of the mechs and the alloy joints were emitting black mist. When the black mist gradually floated out of their bodies, it was as if their lives were taken away. The mechs fell to the ground.
“This Monster Eye King is good at Illusion?”Dudian looked at the motionless mechs on the battlefield. He used his X-ray vision to look at the command center. The heat source figures were also frozen on the spot, it seemed that they were all affected by the illusion. He slightly frowned. The illusion of the Monster Eye King was indeed terrifying. It was enough to kill a million lions on such a large scale.
However, the federation had long responded.
Buzz!
An ancient horn sounded from all directions of the battlefield. It seemed that there were mountains resonating with it.
Dudian felt that his mind was much clearer. His thoughts were several times faster than before. He knew from Lin Changsheng’s memory that this was the barbarian God which Lin Changsheng had developed to crack illusions. This strange sound wave would stimulate the cerebral cortex.., it was refreshing to break most of the illusions. With the coverage of the hypnotic illusion used by the Monster Eye King, it was not unusual for it to be broken.
Just as he had expected, the mecha warriors who were in a stalemate on the battlefield woke up when they heard the sound of the horn. The generals in the command center also regained their mobility. Soon, the battle started once again, however, in the short few seconds when they were in a daze when they were in the illusion, the situation on the battlefield had become overwhelmingly tilted. The Magic Marks Warriors did not stay idle. They attacked quickly and the mecha warriors suffered heavy losses.
The Mech Warriors were ordered by the command center to retreat while defending. They abandoned most of the defense line and retreated to the last defense line in front of the command center.
“The first defense line is going to be lost.”Dudian saw the situation and knew that it was only a matter of time before the first defense line was broken through. He had used all his trump cards and could no longer stop the four kings.
He slowly went into stealth and retreated.
The shouts of the battle seemed to follow him. As he retreated, the shouts of the battle echoed.
The flood of magic marks warriors flooded the land. Countless mechas were destroyed in the flood. The defense line was defeated one after another. Dudian saw that many armed fighters took off from the parking lot behind the command center. They were carrying generals and military officers with medals on their shoulders.
“Next is the peace zone...”Dudian narrowed his eyes as he turned around and left. He quickly rushed to the peace zone.
Three hours later.
There was a group of more than ten mechs in the forest of the peace zone. They were in a sorry state. More than half of the mechs were injured. Some of the mechs had their arms torn off, some of the mecha’s bodies were covered in claw marks that tore through the alloy. Some of the mecha’s hooks had some animal-like sharp claws that were stuck in the hooks’chains and could not be shaken off.
This team of mecha ran all the way to the peace zone and came to this forest with beautiful scenery and green trees. Just as they were about to stop to rest and reorganize themselves, a black shadow suddenly shot out from the forest.
This black shadow went straight for one of the mecha and instantly pierced through it. The pilot inside the mecha instantly died tragically and turned into meat paste.
The Black Shadow did not stop and continued to pounce on the next mecha.
The other pilots reacted and panicked. They kept shouting “Enemy attack”. In a short 20 seconds, all the mecha fell to the ground. In the open space, three pilots were lying on the ground in a sorry state, their faces filled with fear, they looked at the approaching Black Shadow. They had many years of experience in border defense. They could see that the black shadow was almost a monster. It was a demon warrior because of its pale metal face, it still had a human’s outline.
A few minutes later, Dudian killed the three people. He learned from them that the first line of defense had been lost. The demons were reorganizing and preparing to attack the federation.
“They are finally coming.”Dudian thought for a moment and left the place. After the defense of the Peace Circle was activated, it was very likely that they would be eliminated together. He had to find a way to sneak into the federation.
Dudian quickly found a way to disappear into the forest after going through the memories of the forest.
The smell of blood filled the forest. The small monsters that were living in the forest were ready to move. They picked up the dead bodies of the pilots and chewed their heads, broken arms, and Bones.
In less than half an hour when the group of monsters were eating, the surface of the lake by the edge of the forest suddenly shook slightly and rippled. Then, the entire land trembled slightly. Many monsters that had been circling and resting after eating stood up from the ground, they looked into the distance vigilantly. Then, the monsters seemed to have sensed something and let out a wail. They turned around and ran in the direction of the federation, abandoning their nest in the forest.
After they left, the ground shook more and more loudly. The sky was filled with yellow sand and a black cloud, pressing down like a gloomy storm!
In the federation’s 12 border cities, there was an austere atmosphere. The city lords of the 12 cities were gathered in the virtual network, sitting on the 12 golden seats. Their faces were gloomy. The federation’s first line of defense had been broken through, this had happened before, but it was a rare occurrence. Every time it happened, there would be a world-shaking and tragic battle. It was the time for the demon race to invade and fight to the death!
After every battle, the Federation would suffer a great loss of vitality and require more than 10 years of recuperation.
“According to the news from the battle network, they have already stepped into the circle of Peace!”One of the city lords crossed his hands and propped them on the table. His fingers covered his chin as he said gloomily.
The other city Lord said in a deep voice, “Since they are here, let’s Bury all these damn beasts!”
“According to the information from the first defense line, the situation this time is not optimistic. The four kings of the demon race have gathered together. Although one of them was eliminated by the ‘superconducting thunder god Cannon’, the remaining three are not simple characters. One of them is the bewitching eye king who is good at hypnosis, one is the light king who is the fastest in attack, and the other is the new king of the demon race. We don’t know her specific abilities for now, but she can release black energy to block our line of sight. She can condense the black energy to form an attack method that can penetrate into the armor. The effect of a mecha against her is very weak. Perhaps only if we send out the Demon Beast Army or the undead Army will it be effective!”
“I suggest that we activate the defense system of the peace zone first. In addition, we should request the chairman to use the MT2 hydrogen bomb to kill them all at once! No matter what kind of king they are, they will all die!”
“I second that!”
“Now that things have come to this, we must use nuclear weapons to intimidate these animals!”
