Chapter 1160: Chapter 1,149: The Ring of destruction
Translator: 549690339
14:39 pm that day.
Outside the federation’s Hundred Cities, in the vast circle of peace.
A mighty army swept over like a torrent of steel. It was the fully armed imperial border guards, dressed as knights, riding warhorses that the Empire had bred by borrowing monsters from the empire. In the sky behind the army, a large number of fighter jets and steam airships flew in the sky like a swarm of locusts. Behind them were all sorts of federation military weapons that had been captured from the first line of defense.
Naturally, there were also a large number of captives who had already submitted to the empire and activated their weapons for the empire.
Although the empire mainly developed genetic power, their technological level was not low either. In terms of research in biological genes, they were far more advanced than the federation by over a hundred years. In other aspects, their technology.., was also close to the level of the third industrial revolution of the old era.
In the middle area of the Legion, a large number of generals were accompanying four tall and imposing figures. These four people were vaguely led by a graceful and slender woman. The three people behind them also had extraordinary bearing, the youth who was standing on the far left was wearing a red robe and silver gloves. His face was pale like a vampire in an ancient castle. His eyes were sunken and he looked sickly.
If Dudian was here he would recognize that this was the blood spike king who had been destroyed by the ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannon’!
“Most of the troops have entered the peace circle of the Trolls Federation.”The white robe of the Lord of light who was half a step behind Crimson Moon slowly spoke. His eyes glanced at the beautiful figure behind her, his line of sight could even see the fine hairs on the back of her neck, and a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes.
Crimson Moon looked ahead, her eyes revealing a thoughtful look. After a moment.., she then said, “The demon Emperor said that there are many traps hidden in the peace zone of the Federation. It is the second line of defense of the Troll Federation, and also the most terrifying line of defense. When we enter the peace zone, although no one will come out to stop us, it will be convenient for the Troll Federation to activate their world-destroying weapons and capture us all in one go!”
“I think we can split into two groups.”A youth with a devilishly handsome face and two long dark golden eyes on his cheekbones on the far right suggested. His voice was neither male nor female, it seemed to have a strange charm.
“Split into two groups?”The blood thorn monarch frowned. His pale face was slightly gloomy. “I attracted the firepower earlier and was heavily injured by that thing. I need to recuperate for the time being. Don’t expect me to appear again.”
The devilish youth glanced at him, recalling the destructive lightning. A cold light flashed in his eyes. He knew that if he had been hit by that thing, he would definitely have died, but the blood thorn monarch had survived, it was clear that his ability to survive was stronger than his.
“There’s no need to split up,”Crimson Moon said, her voice indifferent, carrying an unquestionable dignity, “The enemy doesn’t only have one doomsday weapon. If we separate, we’ll only face a greater blow. We can still work together to resist. The key is that this place is called the ‘Peace Zone’. It’s not peaceful. Most of the traps inside don’t pose much of a threat to us, but there’s one weapon that can hurt us!”
“Huh?”The eyes of the three kings focused as they looked at her in surprise. For her to think this way, it was most likely true. Thinking about the ability that the Queen of Darkness was good at, their expressions became even more serious.
“This weapon has a long scientific name, and it’s called the ‘ring of destruction of life’. Once activated, all living things in this area will be exterminated! No matter how strong or weak their physiques are, it will be difficult to resist!”Crimson Moon said slowly, she had found this information in the minds of several of the highest commanding officers of the first defense line.
“No matter how strong or weak their physiques are?”The blood spike king’s expression changed slightly. “Isn’t that even more powerful than their world-destroying weapons? We can’t resist them either?”
Crimson Moon shook her head. “The attacks of this thing aren’t physical. They can be resisted by simply relying on the strength of the body. Instead, they are directly acting on the magnetic field of the life form itself. You can think of it as a ‘soul weapon’. It directly attacks the soul and causes your soul to dissipate. Even if you can split your body, you won’t be able to defend against it. In terms of lethality, it is indeed more powerful than the world-ending weapons.”
The Three Kings looked at each other. They didn’t expect the Troll Federation to have such a terrifying thing.
“In that case, are we going to return empty-handed?”The Monster Eye King frowned and looked at Crimson Moon. He felt that she had other ideas since she was so calm.
The light king standing behind Crimson Moon had a smile on his face, like a kind priest. He glanced at the distant sky, but didn’t say anything.
“Return empty-handed?”Crimson Moon seemed to have heard a joke, he sneered, “Why would I do something that is halfway done?”? Although this “Ring of extinction of life”was terrifying, its coverage was limited. It was called a “Ring”, and it had already exposed its flaws. Since it was a ring, it was one-sided. We can cross it from the sky or underground. There are many ways.”
Monster Eye King was stunned. He came to a realization, patted his head, and laughed bitterly.
Although he looked like a young man, his actions and expression seemed somewhat mature.
The blood Spike King’s furrowed brows relaxed, and his expression was cold, he said, “I’m afraid it’s risky to let all the troops sneak in from the sky or underground. I have two suggestions. The first is to use the abyss as the leader and split up the army. We’ll use guerilla warfare to outflank them from all directions. The enemy’s doomsday weapons are basically ineffective, and the traps on the ground can be blocked by the abyss. Then, we’ll sneak in from the sky.”
“The second method is to let the main force continue to move forward. We’ll bring a group of elites and sneak in from the sky. We’ll let the main force move slowly. When the enemy’s attention is on the main force, we’ll sneak into the Troll Federation. Even if the enemy uses world-ending weapons to attack the main force, it won’t matter. As long as we win in the end, these trolls of the Troll Federation can all be used as soldiers!”
Monster Eye King nodded. “I think so too.”
The radiant king smiled as if he did not hear it. He neither agreed nor denied it.
Crimson Moon had an idea. She said, “Let the main force continue to move forward. Then we will split up a few groups of Abyss and lead a small force to flank from the side to attract the enemy’s attention. The rest will follow me and sneak in from the sky.”
Blood spike king asked, “Why not underground?”
“There are world-ending weapons buried under every city in the Troll Federation. They have the most advanced sensing system. Once they sense us, activate the world-ending weapons and sacrifice one city. It’s enough to bury us all!”Crimson Moon said coldly.
The blood-spike King’s pupils contracted, and he said nothing more.
Soon the plan was put into effect.
A moment later, Crimson Moon and the other four kings led a group of Masters of the Abyss and Abyss Elite, into the clouds in the sky, disappeared.
..
..
Outside the federation’s Copper Ship City, a group of mecha operators who had escaped from the first line of defense rushed over. Hundreds of mecha landed on the huge receiving platform that was the size of an aircraft carrier. A group of mecha operators disembarked in a panic, we need to evacuate to the city corridor.
“Ma Jin, run!”
“I’ve sprained my ankle. You Go ahead. I’ll be right with you.”
Another person was about to go forward to support him when suddenly, there was a commotion at the end of the plains outside the reception platform. Mecha Operators’vision and hearing were much sharper than ordinary people. They could faintly see the color of the sky darkening, that person’s expression changed. He immediately turned around and ran without looking back. He followed the crowd and rushed into the city passageway.
“Ma Jin”who was still at the same spot turned around to take a look. His eyes flashed. Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention, he rushed to a corner of the reception platform. Although this was outside the city’s protective shield.., but it wasn’t within the range of the ring of extinction. He looked at the Empire’s troops who were rushing towards the end of the plain. He didn’t think that they would directly rush into the Peace Circle.
“With her ability, even if the Devil Emperor didn’t tell her anything, she should have found out something. She wouldn’t attack so rashly. What method would she use? If it was me...”Dudian fell into deep thought, after a moment, his face changed. He looked up at the sky and narrowed his eyes: “Are you going to attack the main city of the Federation?”

Chapter 1161: Chapter 1150: Nuclear Explosion
Translator: 549690339
“There is a protective shield and detection system above the federation’s Hundred Cities. Their traces will be discovered soon. However, compared to the ‘ring of extinction’, the city’s energy shield is nothing.”Dudian turned his head, he looked at the rear of the city which was the hinterland of the federation. “He should have expected such a situation. With his intelligence and computing ability, what kind of trap would he set to receive them?”
Thinking up to this point, he was somewhat expectant. At this point, he would no longer interfere in the war between the Empire and the Federation. Crimson Moon and Lin Changsheng, who would live or die, would be a great revenge for him. If Crimson Moon and the others appeared in the main city of the federation.., going deep into the hinterland of the federation meant that this attack was not a bluff. The Empire did not dare to risk the lives of the four kings.
Once the loss of the Crimson Moon and other four kings, the strength of the empire greatly weakened, from the side will arouse the federation and the Fire Dragon Kingdom covetous.
Therefore, the two sides must fight to the Bitter End!
Dudian wouldn’t make a move even if all four kings were killed because he believed that the devil emperor wouldn’t see such a situation happen. Maybe it wasn’t just the four kings who would come. The Devil Emperor might also appear on the battlefield, it’s just nobody knows it.
..
..
More than ten minutes later, the imperial army entered the depths of the Peace Circle. At the same time, a few loud bangs suddenly erupted from the battle hammer citadel of the 12 border cities, such as copper warship city. One after another, intercontinental missile-like lights and shadows flew out, with a long tail of gas.
Near the circle of peace where the Imperial Army had entered, the ground burst open, and the continuous sound of explosions exploded together, forming a huge mushroom cloud that engulfed the imperial army completely.
At the moment of the explosion, an invisible shockwave rippled out from the underground of a border defense city that the imperial army had entered. It swept across the plains like a wave. The green grass swayed like a breeze, but wherever the breeze passed by.., the bodies of the venomous snakes, stone scorpions, and other small monsters hidden in the grass stiffened and stopped moving. Even some wandering zombies were sluggish. However, after a moment of sluggishness, they continued to wander.
The traps of the Peace Circle, the attacks of the twelve border cities, and the “Ring of extinction of life”hidden in the deepest part were launched at the same time. When these attacks were combined, it was enough to wipe out the large-scale beast tide in an instant, however, in an unremarkable city behind the twelve border cities, a huge cannon suddenly shot out and shot into the place where the imperial army was attacked, falling into the dust and fog.
Boom! !
The next moment, the entire sky seemed to brighten up slightly. Following that, the sound of the sky shattering rang out, spreading across more than half of the federation!
Not long after, a mushroom cloud that looked like a volcanic eruption appeared, spreading rapidly in all directions. The air was also quickly swept apart, and scorching heat currents swept around like a storm. If an ordinary person were to stare at this place, just the scorching light from the explosion alone would be enough to make one lose their sight, it was enough to make them lose their sight!
The mayor of the 12 border defense cities, who was also the Defense Minister of the Federation, nervously looked at the place of the explosion, waiting for the detection system to return the data and filter the image.
At a height of 10,000 meters above the sky that was invisible to the naked eye, a figure appeared. The violent sound that came from the ground made everyone’s pupils contract slightly. Even though they knew in advance that the Troll Federation’s world-destroying weapon, they had never seen it before after all.., at this moment, just hearing this world-shattering loud sound made their hearts palpitate. If they were in the middle of the sound, even Crimson Moon and the others did not have the confidence to survive!
“This is the world-destroying weapon, destroying the old era...”Crimson Moon’s eyes flickered slightly. There was some fear, but more than that, there was a strange light.
The blood thorn monarch’s pale face turned even paler. This sound seemed to have awakened the fear that was sealed in the depths of his memories. It made him have the urge to turn around and flee. At the same time, terrifying scenes that shook the world appeared in his mind, it was not just a world-destroying weapon, but a lot of smoke that covered the entire world..
The radiant king and Monster Eye monarch’s expressions were not good. The thing they feared the most in the depths of their memories was triggered. At the same time, they could not help but feel a strong killing intent towards the huge federation beneath them. It was a thought that they must destroy!
“Get Ready, Kill!”Crimson Moon regained her senses and a cold glint flashed in her eyes. With a low shout, she took the lead and dived down. Her body flickered, like an illusion that shuttled between reality and illusion, appearing and disappearing at times. It was difficult to capture.
The rest of the people followed her as she dived down. Like a sharp cone, their target was one of the cities.
Looking from a high altitude, the pattern of the federation’s Hundred Cities was very obvious. The 12 outer border defense cities were ordinary cities on the inner side of the border defense cities. On the inner side were the four main cities. At the center of the four main cities was the federation’s main city, it was also the place where the federation’s chairman and the representatives... lived!
The explosion was not only a signal for the destruction of the Empire’s army but also a signal for Crimson Moon and the others to start a war!
Dudian saw that the Empire’s army was swept by the nuclear bomb and the “Ring of life extermination”. He didn’t pay attention to it anymore. He recovered his original appearance and rushed into the sky. He flew out of the energy shield of the copper ship city and went straight to the direction of the main city of the federation.
Soon, Dudian saw a heat source appear in the sky. The number of these heat sources was extremely shocking. There were about forty to fifty of them. The lowest one was the abyss level heat source reaction!
“They are attacking the main city of the Federation!”Dudian narrowed his eyes. It seemed that Crimson Moon didn’t know about the existence of Lin Changsheng. It meant that the Devil Emperor didn’t tell her about this. Otherwise she wouldn’t take the risk to go deep into the hinterland, but they were attacking the federal president.
Dudian’s heart suddenly shivered. What would he do if he was the Devil Emperor?
“The main city!”Dudian was shocked. Did the Devil Emperor sneak into the federation and wait in the main city? He would let Crimson Moon attack the main city of the federation to attract the attention of the federation. After the chairman and the representative were killed, the four consortia would split the regime. In order to avoid losses, Lin Changsheng had to step out to preside over the overall situation, he would expose himself.
Maybe he would use the second puppet, which was the Terras Consortium.
“The Devil Emperor wants crimson moon to force him to send the mechanical corps to deal with Crimson Moon. Then he will wait for the opportunity to sneak into the main city and destroy Lin Changsheng...”Dudian’s face turned a bit strange as he thought of this speculation, from the point of view of the Devil Emperor, this method was good. It was very likely that Lin Changsheng would fall. However, the Devil Emperor didn’t know of his existence.
However, Lin Changsheng wouldn’t forget him. The more chaotic it was, the more alert he would be. He would be on guard against the attack of the host city.
“If he thinks the Devil Emperor is me then the Devil Emperor will be in bad luck...”Dudian muttered. He suddenly thought of another matter. If Lin Changsheng didn’t know that the Devil Emperor had sneaked in but focused on dealing with him.., he would certainly design a trap to lure him to attack. The first thing that he wouldn’t be able to control would be the Devil Emperor who was waiting in the dark. The Devil Emperor would become his scapegoat and fall into Lin Changsheng’s trap.
No wonder the Devil Emperor wasn’t cautious enough... He didn’t understand the situation.
“If that’s the case then I can sit back and watch the Tigers fight...”Dudian couldn’t help but laugh. He began to hope that his speculation was correct.

chapters.title: Chapter 1162
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1162: Chapter 1,151: Division
Translator: 549690339
At this moment, Crimson Moon and the other four kings descended from the sky, leading numerous abysses. In less than four to five seconds, they appeared in the sky above the main city of the federation. They were like meteorites, and their momentum was terrifying. They immediately attracted the attention of the main city of the federation, the City Defense Department was in chaos. Countless people were like ants on a hot pot. They set up loud and clear alarms on the streets of skyscrapers all over the city. Everyone who was working, drinking tea, or shopping.., they were all shocked by the sound of the alarm.
This kind of city defense alarm would be put on once a year. Every time it was put on, it would be notified in the news beforehand. There was a set date, but at this moment, it was outside the set date. Without any warning, all the citizens were stunned for a few seconds, they immediately panicked and rushed into the underground tunnel towards the emergency entrances of various parts of the building. These passageways and escape methods had been seen countless times during the act. Even a seven or eight-year-old child would know about it.
The time was too short. Crimson Moon and the others had mysteriously appeared in the sky above the federation’s main city. Without giving the city defense department any time to react, they crashed into the energy shield of the federation’s main city. With Crimson Moon as the leader.., they forcefully tore a huge hole in the energy shield. Crimson Moon’s body was suffused with electric currents, repelling the electric currents on the energy shield outside of her body, creating a gap. The rest of them quickly passed through the gap.
After entering the energy barrier, the entire federation’s main city was under everyone’s feet.
Dozens of Abyss kings and four kings looked down at this city that was completely different from the empire. In the next moment, they swooped down like the Grim Reaper. Crimson Moon and the other kings headed straight for the Federation government in the center of the city, while the rest of the Abyss flew towards the parliament and other places, there were also some who pounced towards some tall buildings. With a casual strike, they shook this steel-like sturdy building until it was on the verge of collapse.
The federation capital was shrouded in a wave of wails. The Abyss was destroying and massacring all over the city. Some news agencies had just captured the scene of the building being destroyed by the Abyss, even the cameras and a few brave reporters were crushed into minced meat. All of this was broadcasted to other cities, causing countless people to be terrified. They did not expect the demon race to be so Savage. Some children and women were so frightened that they cried out loud.
At this moment, the Ministry of City Defense mobilized the god of creation mecha and a few other types of five-star mecha. Some of them were auxiliary mecha that were specially responsible for stabilizing the cities. They were not good at fighting, but they were very good at cleaning up the battlefield, there were also mecha that were responsible for transporting some of the refugees who had been affected by the disaster and sending them to the shelters.
The place where the many abysses swept through was a complete mess. Crimson Moon and the other four kings charged into the government. Through memory reading, Crimson Moon quickly found the federation chairman and captured him, searching through his brain’s memories. With one look, she realized that this federation chairman was just a puppet.., the real manipulator behind him was the highest-ranking person in charge of the Terras consortium, Hei Si Luo Di!
After learning about this information, Crimson Moon’s face turned black. However, she did not kill this puppet chairman in a fit of rage. Instead, she used the federation government’s news platform to broadcast this scene live to the various cities in the federation and used the highest authority.., to occupy all the other information platforms.
At this moment, all the citizens of the federation, even those young men and women who did not care about the survival of the federation and only knew how to have fun, saw this scene from their favorite entertainment devices. No matter how they switched.., they were unable to turn off this scene. They could only watch this boring scene indignantly.
In front of the camera, Crimson Moon and the three kings stood with cold expressions. They were tall and tall, and their auras were cold and arrogant. They all had the appearance of humans. Moreover, in terms of human aesthetic standards, they were all handsome men and beautiful women. They were all extraordinarily handsome, many women screamed when they saw the handsome youth-like monster eye king and the cold-looking Bloodthorn monarch. Their eyes flickered with light, unwilling to believe that they were those bloodthirsty and savage demons who even ate humans.
They even felt that even if they were really demons, they had no choice but to eat people..
Crimson Moon held the Federation president in her hand, her slender snow-white hand holding the fat president. The contrast was clear. The originally dignified president was now like a thin and weak chicken, looking completely disrespectful, causing many of the older generation to find it hard to believe, they were extremely disappointed, but at the same time, they were also extremely angry. They were incomparably resentful towards the demons. On the other hand, many of the younger generation were incomparably curious about Crimson Moon, the blood thorn sovereign king, and the others. At the same time, they also expressed their disdain and ridicule towards the Federation president, who was currently showing no strength at all.
Crimson Moon held the Federation president hostage and ordered the various cities to open their city gates wide, allowing their large troops to enter the cities. She also promised various things, such as that they were not demons, and that the citizens had been deceived by the federation’s higher-ups, they had come here because they had no other choice. They were once of the same race and had been expelled by those in power. Her words were incomparably true, causing many citizens to be shocked. It was as if they had seen a brand-new true face, and many people immediately believed her words.
Crimson Moon had read the memories of the Federation president and some officials, as well as the memories of ordinary people and low-level soldiers. Naturally, she knew what impressions the Empire had in the hearts of the people at various stages of the federation. Everything she said had hit the nail on the head, there were also many complaints in the hearts of the citizens. Her words quickly turned into another kind of truth. It went against the original “Justice”.
Dudian looked at the broadcast on the wristwatch. He couldn’t help but shake his head and smile when he heard Crimson Moon’s words. Lin Changsheng was going to vomit blood at this moment. Even if the demons were completely expelled this time, it would be difficult to explain to the citizens of the Federation, crimson Moon’s words were like a seed that had been planted. Lin Changsheng could only use iron-blooded methods to suppress it. Perhaps it would be slowly diluted after more than ten years.
“It’s a pity that there is a devil emperor. Otherwise she would become an emperor!”Dudian thought. If Crimson Moon held the president of the Federation and directly ordered the city corps to stop the action, it would arouse the blood of the citizens of the Federation, but at the moment the so-called truth was used to divide the citizens of the Federation. Many soldiers would be affected. Even if the battle failed they would be able to train a group of ‘Spies’.
Although it wasn’t domineering enough but it was more useful than arrogant words.
Dudian closed the wristwatch and put it into his bag. He turned around and continued to head towards the main city. That was the real battlefield.
Although the wristwatch was an item of the federation but if it was used simply, even if Lin Changsheng could appear in any intelligent instrument of the federation, he wouldn’t know that the wristwatch was used by him, after all, it was impossible for him to integrate his consciousness into the host at all times. He would scatter his consciousness in countless instruments to monitor everyone who used the instruments. In this way, his consciousness would be weakened and eventually he would completely lose his will, the program that was turned into a federal intelligent mainframe would even be erased as an abnormal program.
It didn’t take long for Dudian to arrive outside the mainframe city. The exterior of the mainframe city looked ordinary and the city walls looked old. However, Dudian could see that the city walls were made of thick steel plates, the defense of the city walls was far higher than that of the federal capital.

chapters.title: Chapter 1163
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1163: Chapter 1152: Enter the city
Translator: 549690339
Dudian looked at the host city for a moment. He converged his aura and turned into a dark shadow.
“There are detection systems in the sky and underground. Many flowers and plants on the ground have been modified and implanted with tiny detectors.”Dudian narrowed his eyes as he looked at the grass in front of him, he saw that there was a toothpick-sized metal bar embedded in the middle of the grass. It was very soft. The metal bar detector wouldn’t be damaged if the weeds were stepped on.
Only Lin Changsheng knew about this detector. He had used his mechanical corps to secretly set it up to guard against the people of the federation. This was his nest, the heart!
If other people were to lurk here, no matter how careful they were, they would fall into Lin Changsheng’s line of sight. With Lin Changsheng’s huge computing ability, no matter how disguised humans were, they would be able to deduce the flaws in their actions.
However, Dudian who knew about Lin Changsheng’s memory was already on guard. The radius of these detectors was around fifty meters. Moreover, the angle of each detector was different so there were no blind spots on the surveillance screen.
However, these were not difficult for him. There were no blind spots, so he could create blind spots.
A pair of shadow wings stretched out from the back of his incarnation. They looked like two giant palms. They seemed to be very slow but in fact, they were extremely fast. It seemed that they were moving more than ten cubic meters of air around them, a gentle wind was set off. It slowly floated dozens of meters away and bent the grassland where the detectors were buried. At the same time, his body quickly approached the grassland. By the time the gentle wind subsided, he was already more than ten centimeters below the grassland, drowning his body in the soil and turning into a black shadow that looked like a pangolin.
With his current ability to edit genes, he could write a unique breathing organ that could also absorb oxygen in the soil.
“Lin Changsheng was on guard against me. When I calculated that I had obtained part of his memories and knew about the traps outside the mainframe city, he might have thought of ways to avoid these traps. Logically speaking, there were other ways to avoid these traps and take another route. However, with Lin Changsheng’s intelligence and the mainframe’s computational ability, he was able to come up with seven or eight countermeasures and set up a tighter defense in other places
“This is the safest path for me.”
“However, he may have calculated this point. He may have gone the opposite way. He left the original layout on the outside and let me lower my vigilance.”
Dudian crouched in the mud as he calculated in his mind.
Although his computational ability couldn’t be compared to Lin Changsheng’s but he could slowly clear his mind. He wasn’t in a hurry. The speed of his thinking wouldn’t affect the result.
He and Lin Changsheng weren’t the only ones on the chessboard this time. There was an unknown moving chess piece, the Devil Emperor.
However, the “Unknown”here was for him. Perhaps the Devil Emperor had already entered Lin Changsheng’s line of sight and was the target of Lin Changsheng’s game.
“I intervened in the previous collapse of the first defense line. Maybe Lin Changsheng will notice my purpose. In this case, the Devil Emperor might not be regarded as me.”Dudian slowly frowned, he felt that he had acted rashly and should not have interfered in the border war. Based on his understanding of Lin Changsheng, the latter had the ability to calculate the detailed results of the war, including the specific casualties.., as well as the process and time of the collapse.
Although the battlefield was constantly changing but Lin Changsheng’s computing power was too strong. One minute was equivalent to a hundred years of thinking. It was enough to completely calculate the situation of the battlefield. But because of his intervention.., the situation of the battlefield was different from what Lin Changsheng had predicted. He could detect the heretics and guess his own intentions.
When the game reached the extreme, the cards of both sides were basically open cards. Using open cards against each other relied on instantaneous changes and judgment.
“The worst case scenario is that Lin Changsheng knows that there are three people on the chessboard and has deduced our position. The Devil Emperor also knows my existence through other means. Everyone has the same information and my advantage is gone.”Dudian was a bit worried, although he knew that this was the worst case scenario but he had to prepare for the worst case scenario.
“If I was the Devil Emperor then I would have infiltrated the mainframe city. I wouldn’t have infiltrated the city during this sensitive period of war. Everyone who entered the mainframe city during this period would be put on the list of suspects by Lin Changsheng. He would closely monitor every corner of the city.”Dudian’s eyes flashed, “Even if the devil knows about my existence and knows that there are people waiting for the oriole behind, there is no way to continue to lurk.”
“The war has broken out. Crimson Moon has made his move. The opportunity has appeared. I can not miss it. I just need to wait behind him.”
“However, he may not be willing to be picked by others. He will have other arrangements. If I were him, I would attack now and retreat...”
Boom! !
Dudian’s eyes turned golden as he saw the distant host city through his eyelids and mud, there was thick black smoke coming out of the city. After the loud sound, there was a burst of crackling sounds as if there was a riot in the city.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he pondered. After a while, he seemed to have made a decision. He stretched out a few shadows and turned them into small hands. He fanned the breeze and bent the grass that was implanted with the detector, after clearing out a blind spot, he climbed out of the mud. He waved the wind and rushed forward. He avoided all the detectors in the grass as well as some mechanical snakes and insects.
A few minutes later, Dudian appeared in the host city. He was familiar with the way and avoided Lin Changsheng’s arrangement. When he was ready to enter the city, suddenly there was an alarm. The patrolling mechanical soldiers quickly heard the news and came over, countless machine guns pointed at him and issued a humane warning. However, before the warning was finished, it seemed to be interrupted by something and shot fiercely.
Dudian knew that Lin Changsheng had seen this scene through them and forcefully controlled these mechanical soldiers.
Moreover, as he had guessed before, he had avoided the mechanism according to Lin Changsheng’s memory. He didn’t expect that the alarm would be triggered in the end. It was clear that this place was well prepared.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
As soon as the machine gun was fired, Dudian suddenly felt a sense of danger. This ordinary loaded machine gun actually made him have a feeling of death. His scalp suddenly exploded and burst out with full speed. He suddenly moved sideways, at the same time a large number of sharp blades flew out from his body. They were like scales as they shot towards the mechanical soldiers.
These sharp blades were as sharp as knives. The metal shell of the mechanical soldiers looked like ordinary flesh and blood. They were cut by the sharp blades.

chapters.title: Chapter 1164
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1164: Chapter 1153: Bait
Translator: 549690339
After dodging the first round of fire from the mechanical soldiers, Dudian saw that the bullets from their machine guns had hit the ground, leaving only a deep hole. It was not the laser ray that he had imagined. He frowned slightly, he turned around and took out a large number of sharp blades. They swept out like fallen leaves. Soon the group of mechanical soldiers were cut into pieces of metal and scattered all over the ground.
At this time, Dudian came in front of one of the soldiers. He picked up the gun in its hand and deftly disassembled it. He took out the magazine, the Bullets in the magazine were no different from ordinary alloy bullets. He squeezed the bullets with his fingers and broke them. Transparent egg-like mucus flowed out from the bullet.
Dudian carefully observed the transparent mucus. His pupils shrank as he recognized the real face of the thing!
Virus!
To be precise, it should be stronger than the virus secreted from the teeth of ordinary undeads. It was not an exaggeration to say that it was the original fluid of the virus!
No wonder he suddenly felt a sense of horror. Once he was hit by the virus, even if it was just a scratch, he would be infected. Then his genes would go berserk and he would become an unconscious undeads!
Dudian’s face turned cold as he looked at the scattered mechanical soldiers. Lin Changsheng didn’t change the arrangement of the periphery. But there was a detection system hidden in the gap. The machine guns of this group of ordinary mechanical soldiers.., they were equipped with an unsolvable zombie virus. If he was a little careless, he would die here.
“I didn’t use a high-strength alloy to create an ambush. I knew that with my ability, even an intelligent machine like the creator’s mech wouldn’t be able to keep me. I used the most ordinary mechanical soldier. He was equipped with a seemingly ordinary gun but the interior of the gun was modified with a special texture. The power of the bullet is higher than armor-piercing bullets. It is enough to hurt me. Humph!”Dudian understood Lin Changsheng’s intention, his eyes were somewhat cold. Suddenly, he thought of another matter. Lin Changsheng wanted to seize his body, so why would he use the unsolvable zombie virus?
Thinking up to this point, his body suddenly trembled, and his eyes revealed an uncontrollable excitement.
Although he had obtained Lin Changsheng’s memory, that memory was only a part of it. It was incomplete, so he also had no way of truly knowing whether Lin Changsheng had the method to crack the zombie virus or Not!
At this moment, Lin Changsheng was using the unsolvable zombie virus to attack him. Either he didn’t care about his body and wholeheartedly wanted to kill him! Or, Lin Changsheng had the antidote in his hands!
No matter how he looked at it, the possibility of the latter was far greater than that of the strong. Although Lin Changsheng had suffered a hidden loss under his hands, but after all, he was a person who had lived for more than two hundred years. He would never be angered because of these losses, regardless of the consequences.
Thinking of the antidote, Dean thought of Aisha. He had studied in Randy’s company for a long time and read a lot of information about medical experiments in the federation. He clearly knew that it was almost impossible to develop the antidote by himself, even if the antidote was developed, it would be decades or even a hundred years later. and at that time, who knew what Aisha would become? Who knew if the antidote could restore the zombies that had been infected for hundreds of years? He couldn’t believe it himself. He didn’t even dare to fantasize about it.
Hope appeared again in front of his eyes.
Dudian took a deep breath. He saw several groups of soldiers rushing towards him. He knew that they were mobilized by Lin Changsheng. He had sensed that he might be sending special mechanical soldiers to this place.
He didn’t stop as he rushed into the city to shake off the mechanical soldiers.
Along the way, his body was changing rapidly. He kept changing his image and magnified his perspective to the extreme. He searched for residential areas in the city and mixed with the crowd. Only then could he get rid of Lin Changsheng’s surveillance.
Boom!
Boom!
There was a huge vibration coming from the distance. Dudian suddenly saw seven or eight creator mechs appear in the sky. They formed a triangle. There was an energy link between each of the mechs. It seemed that they were sharing the energy of all the mechs.
Dudian faintly felt the threat. He sighed in his heart. This place was worthy of being the base camp of Lin Changsheng for more than 200 years. The hidden power was so terrifying that it was beyond the knowledge of the outside world. However he was aware of it through Lin Changsheng’s memory, he knew a little about the situation here. He quickly shook off the mechanical soldiers and jumped over the plains of the city. He passed through some towns and came to a human city.
His body was changing rapidly. He controlled every part of his body and changed his appearance. If he wanted to, he could even change the color of his hair. After watching the berserk demonization of the blood thorn king.., his understanding of the genes had a new upgrade. During this period he had absorbed a lot of magic marks. He was able to control his own demonization. He could change the shape of his body at will.
Soon, Dudian sneaked into the human city. At the moment the city was in a panic. A large number of citizens were accompanied by the mechanical guards. Dudian also sneaked into one of the shelters, many people took out their wristwatches and read the news. Some of them were excited to take photos and post them in their own virtual space.
Dudian took advantage of the crowd to knock out a beautiful woman next to him. The woman’s body went soft and fell into his arms. He took the opportunity to hug her. At the same time he threw her arms around his neck, she was like a little girl who was afraid. She buried her head in his arms. He took off her wristwatch and put it on his hand. He read the news on the wristwatch.
The explosion of the mainframe city was quickly broadcasted to other cities. Although Crimson Moon had seized the federal president and occupied the official platform of the government, there were many private media that could release other news. For example, the attack of the mainframe city, the local media was the first to release the news. It attracted the attention of other cities. The atmosphere was tense and tense.
Dudian saw the battle situation from the pictures. The densely packed mechanical corps rushed into a city and occupied the streets. The sky was filled with mechas like locusts, these mechas could fly for a short time.
There was a black-robed figure standing in the sky. It was as if it was walking on flat ground. Its head was covered by a hood. Dudian couldn’t see its face but he casually hit it, there were four-star mechas that were destroyed. There were many five-star mechas that were destroyed.
Dudian’s eyes narrowed. was this person the Devil Emperor?
He was stronger than an ordinary king. Even he wouldn’t be able to tear a four-star mech apart. After all, a four-star Mech was comparable to the Lord of the Abyss. Its performance was close to that of a king, it was just that its outstanding performance couldn’t be fully displayed.
“If the devil has appeared, why didn’t the other four kings appear?”Dudian frowned. He felt that something was wrong. At this time, there was a news broadcast. He immediately clicked on it, he saw an intense battle. Several creator Mechs joined hands to attack the black-robed man. However, they were defeated by the black-robed man.
Their movement speed was very fast and the video was very blurry. It was difficult for ordinary people to see clearly. However Dudian could see that although the black-robed man was aggressive but he wasn’t as strong as he thought.
“This is not the Devil Emperor!”
Dudian came to this conclusion. He suddenly thought that if the Devil Emperor appeared here then the empire would have no one to hold down the fort. It would be impossible for the remaining four kings to hold down the two dragon masters and many experts of the Fire Dragon Kingdom, moreover his speculation was that the Empire and the Fire Dragon Kingdom would join hands. The possibility of this speculation was the highest
“This is a bait!”Dudian narrowed his eyes, “The Devil Emperor is hiding somewhere else. It is possible that the two dragon masters of the Fire Dragon Kingdom will appear. At least one of them will appear. There are at least four people on the chessboard. Their target is Lin Changsheng...”

chapters.title: Chapter 1165
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1165: Chapter 1154: Inside Information
Translator: 549690339
“Hey!”
Suddenly, a hand stretched out from behind Dudian and patted his shoulder.
Dudian’s mind was clear. He was shocked. His perception swept to the back of the man. He found that the man was an ordinary citizen with a weak physique. His tense body couldn’t help but loosen up, he didn’t expect that he would be scared by an ordinary person.
“What’s the matter?”Dudian looked at him.
The person who patted Dudian’s shoulder was a young man. He looked at the woman who was knocked unconscious by Dudian. He suddenly noticed the bracelet on her wrist. He was angry and grabbed Dudian’s clothes, “How dare you touch my girlfriend! You are courting death!”
Dudian didn’t apologize. He raised his hand and gently shook his wrist. The pain made the young man let go of his hand. Dudian pushed him away: “Since she is your girlfriend, I will give her back to you.”
Dudian pushed the unconscious woman into the arms of the young man. He turned around and squeezed into the crowd.
The young man was about to rush up but didn’t see Dudian’s figure. He held the unconscious woman in his arms and stared at the direction where Dudian had left. After a long time the anger on his face slowly disappeared.
“UGH...”the woman woke up from the youth’s arms. She covered her head and looked at the youth who was holding her. She was confused: “Who Are You?”
The youth didn’t speak. It seemed that he was going to reach out to hold her. But his arm suddenly accelerated and hit the back of the woman’s head. She fainted again.
“Is he the variable...”the youth looked at the direction of Dudian’s departure. He whispered in an inaudible voice.
..
... ..
Dudian left the sanctuary and prepared to go to the location where the mainframe was buried.
The federal mainframe was buried in the center of the city. The defense system was spread out layer by layer with the mainframe as the center. No matter from which angle the attack was from, the difficulty was the same.
Dudian wasn’t worried that Lin Changsheng would move the mainframe. The first reason was that the intelligent mainframe was extremely large. There were a lot of attached machines connected to it. The second reason was that there was no place safer than this city in the entire federation!
Once the mainframe was moved out, it would be the same as throwing gold out of the door. It would be very easy for them to find it.
Dudian avoided the patrolling mechanical soldiers and the monitoring of the city. He carefully lurked forward. When he was fifty miles away from the smart mainframe, he saw the news from the woman’s watch, the black-robed man had been killed by the robot army. His body was shattered by the Superion Cannon. He couldn’t be more dead.
Dudian narrowed his eyes. If he didn’t know that the black-robed man was the bait sent by the Devil Emperor then he would have attacked the main computer by himself.
“The role of the bait is not for Lin Changsheng to see but for me. Most likely the Devil Emperor has found out about my existence. It is not an exaggeration to say that my identity is top secret in the federation. Only a few of the higher-ups of the Terras consortium know about it. The only ones who know the truth are probably Black Slody and the directors who were there at that time.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. It was either the Devil Emperor or the Devil Emperor disguised as one of them. If it was the latter then it would be too scary!
Dudian found a pool in a nearby park. He was waiting for the Devil Emperor and the others to make a move. He didn’t want to help them.
Dudian dug a small hole at the bottom of the pool. He used the power of the sun beast to dry the water in the hole. He was able to extract oxygen from the soil, even without oxygen he could survive for months. He took out his wristwatch and continued to observe the situation outside. He was waiting for the Devil Emperor to launch a general attack.
A few hours passed, and the sun set at dusk.
Crimson Moon led the four kings to occupy the federation’s main city, suppressing the federation’s army from the inside out. The entire federation could only rely on the private armed forces of the four great consortiums to resist. It was only at this moment that countless civilians in the federation saw just how terrifying the private armed forces of the four great consortiums were, they were not inferior to the federal government army at all. Moreover, the many military weapons that were exposed were each more terrifying than the last, shocking countless people’s eyeballs.
The Rockfield Consortium took out their secretly researched monster mecha and displayed a power that even the god of creation mecha could not compare to on the battlefield, resisting the attacks of a large number of the abyss. The Milan consortium provided a large amount of military ammunition to all the armies in the hundred cities. This consortium that lived by selling military ammunition seemed to have an endless supply of ammunition. Moreover, the channels for transporting goods were extremely rich, even in times of war.., the various cities were sealed off, yet they were actually able to transport their own ammunition over in large quantities.
And among the four major financial groups, the only one that had nothing to do with Armed Forces was the Michael Financial Group. It could be said that their wealth was comparable to that of a country. If one were to say that the various fields of technological products in the Federation had the shadow of the Terras Financial Group.., seven out of ten of them were manufactured by the Terras Financial Group. Then, the sellers of these products were basically eighty to ninety percent from the Michael Financial Group, whether it was real estate, arms, or entertainment industries, they were all sold under the Michael Consortium’s name. They held the most abundant sales channels, the highest reputation of the merchants, and the number of products sold by the manufacturers of the same product, however, they were far from the number of products sold by the Michael Consortium’s agents.
In fact, the Michael Consortium was even able to use its own business capabilities to strangle a product that could become a household name in the home of the manufacturer.
At this moment, the amount of money that the Michael Consortium had provided to the battlefield was so much that it made countless civilians suffocate. Although they knew that the Michael consortium was rich and could easily build a wealthy family, they did not expect that it was nothing at all, someone compared it and was shocked to find that the annual income of the entire federal government was not even 1% of the financial strength that the Michael Consortium had displayed!
What kind of concept was this? ! It meant that the foundation of this consortium was enough to match the operation of the federal government for a hundred years!
This was an unbelievable number!
The Terras consortium also sent out a large number of god of creation mechas and all kinds of magical technology. It was a great hindrance to the invasion of the abyss.
Dudian was touring the situation of the Federation. At the moment the federal government was almost paralyzed. Although more than half of the Empire’s legions in the peace circle were killed by nuclear bombs but there were still many who survived. It seemed that many legions came later.., they crossed the Peace Circle and attacked the twelve border cities of the Federation.
“Without the federal government, the four consortia will be able to hold up the situation. It Won’t be long before the four kings are defeated.”Dudian read the news. At the same time he combined the memories of Lin Changsheng in his mind, although the current situation had reached the hinterland of the federation but the military strength of the empire was not enough for them to swallow the entire federation. The four consortia were the limbs of Lin Changsheng. At this moment they were able to display unimaginable combat strength.
The five-star Monster Mech developed by the Rockefeller Consortium was able to suppress the King!
The Abyss had encountered a five-star monster mech and was killed not long after the battle!
Dudian knew that the cities of the Federation still had ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannons’. This was a city of the federation. The energy reserves were enough for the ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannons’to display terrifying endurance!
Moreover, Lin Changsheng’s elite mechanical corps hadn’t been dispatched yet!
The opportunity of the Devil Emperor would be missed when Crimson Moon and the others were defeated. Dudian had no choice but to make a move.
Dudian waited quietly. He was a bit nervous. If the Devil Emperor didn’t make a move then he would have to make a move. It would be very difficult for him to kill Lin Changsheng if he missed this opportunity!
This was also the only opportunity for him!
Moreover, he was in a more dangerous situation than the Devil Emperor. The Devil Emperor could retreat back to the empire but he couldn’t!
Night was approaching.
The four kings were forced to retreat by the monster mechs and a large number of creator mechs as well as the ‘Superconducting Raytheon Cannon’. Although they couldn’t use nuclear weapons in the city but Lin Changsheng seemed to have considered such a situation, just the monster mecha and the “Superconducting Raytheon Cannon”were enough to suppress the four kings. Soon, the first king to be sacrificed appeared. It was the blood thorn monarch, who had been seriously injured.
After the blood thorn monarch, the second king to be injured was the monster eye monarch. His hallucinogenic ability had lost its effect on the mechanical corps and the monster mecha.

chapters.title: Chapter 1166
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1166: Chapter 1155: King’s Mechanical Corps
Translator: 549690339
As soon as the bewitching eye king was injured, he immediately withdrew from the battlefield and disappeared without a trace. There were no other news reports.
Only Crimson Moon and the radiant king were left on the battlefield. However, the Federation’s Mechanical Corps and mecha seemed to be endless, especially the creator’s mecha. Although their reactions during battle were not as good as the real King’s.., however, its performance was not lacking in any aspect. Once it was damaged, it would immediately withdraw from the battlefield and be replaced by a new mecha. The injured mecha would then return to the factory outside the battlefield to be repaired.
The one who repaired the mecha was also a top-notch professional repair mecha. In less than ten minutes, a tattered creator’s mecha was refurbished and thrown back into the battlefield.
As long as the parts and materials were not lacking, the god of creation would be able to repair and fight non-stop!
Although Crimson Moon and the king of light were brave but it was difficult for them to fight against four hands. Moreover there were more than twenty god of creation mechas. The depth of their foundation shocked Crimson Moon and the king of light as well as countless residents of the federation.
“Are you still able to endure?”Dudian saw the news reports. There were too many media. At the moment many media were risking their lives to live broadcast on the edge of the battlefield. There were also many videos of refugees, the other cities that were far away from the battlefield also saw the fierce battle.
Dudian looked at the sky from afar. The Dark Curtain and the dazzling sun were suspended in the sky. It was the demonization domain of Crimson Moon and the King of light. Their strength had reached the limit of their lives. They were like supermen of the old era. They could withstand missiles and cannons, even ion cannons and laser swords could hardly hurt their bodies.
However, the manpower was exhausted. By the time the stars covered the sky, Crimson Moon and the King of light had been injured many times. Their momentum was not as strong as before. However, the federation’s losses were even more severe, there were countless broken mechanical soldiers on the streets. The other three-star and four-star mechas had lost hundreds of them. More than a dozen of the creator mechas had been destroyed. Nearly ten of them had self-destructed.
Dudian frowned as he became more and more nervous.
Ten minutes later, Dudian who was browsing the news suddenly felt a burst of dazzling light and loud sound coming from the distance. He looked up and saw the night sky in the other side of the main city, it was as if the Sun had risen and lit up more than half of the main city.
Dudian was relieved. His first reaction was that the Devil Emperor couldn’t wait to make a move. This was a good thing for him!
He quickly moved from his hiding place and rushed towards the explosion.
At the same time, his vision was expanded to the extreme. His pupils kept contracting. His golden pupils shrank like a golden bean. His vision quickly passed through the skyscrapers and saw the situation of the explosion, there were eight figures who were as vigorous as the Sun at the center of the explosion. The heat emitted from their bodies was shocking. They were all king level life energy!
Dudian was shocked. He didn’t expect that there were so many kings hidden in the city!
The location of the explosion was where Lin Changsheng’s mainframe was hiding!
A speculation came to his mind. He had used Crimson Moon and the King of light to restrain most of the forces of the Federation. The purpose of the explosion was to attract Lin Changsheng’s attention. Perhaps the more important reason was to buy time for them.., he wanted to know the whereabouts of the mainframe.
“Eight kings. Are they the hidden forces of the Empire? No, the kings of the Fire Dragon Kingdom are coming too!”Dudian narrowed his eyes, his body slowed down as he looked around to find the hidden devil emperor. He was 100% sure that the Devil Emperor was in the city. At least one of the two dragon lords would come, he wouldn’t let the Devil Emperor collect the spoils of war.
At this time Dudian saw metal robots rushing out from the heat of the explosion. They looked similar to humans. Some of the metal robots looked exactly the same as humans. It seemed that they were made from the same batch of molds, some of them were strange in shape. They appeared in the center of the explosion but weren’t affected. They were the top robots arranged by Lin Changsheng.
Some of Lin Changsheng’s memories jumped out from Dudian’s mind. He quickly recognized the models and functions of these Mech Warriors. Some of them were good at close combat, the chip recorded the moves of countless master fighters. Some of them were equipped with terrifying firepower which was enough to kill a King!
Every mech warrior was comparable to the creator’s mech. Moreover, their combat ability was stronger than the creator’s Mech!
Lin Changsheng had tested that these mech warriors could easily defeat the creator’s Mech!
However, at this moment, the number of these Mech Warriors continued to rush out. In the blink of an eye, there were seventeen or eighteen of them. In the blink of an eye, the number of them had increased to more than thirty. It was not until the forty-ninth mech warrior came out that the number stopped.
Forty-nine kings!
The number of them was more than the eight kings!
Dudian knew that he was still under great pressure. He wanted to send a message to the devil emperor or the eight kings to tell them how to solve this batch of robot warriors.
The eight kings seemed to be very proud as the robot warriors appeared in front of the building where the mainframe was buried. They didn’t attack immediately. After observing for a while only one person stepped out.
Purple scales appeared on the body of the person. His body slowly elongated. He prostrated on the ground and transformed into a purple scaled flood dragon. His body was about 30 meters long. Suddenly he roared and his body expanded, he was more than 30 meters tall. He stood in front of the mechanical warriors. He raised his claws and hit the ground. The momentum was terrifying. There was electricity flowing out from the scales on his body. It seemed that the static electricity had strengthened his body.
Dudian was startled. There was a trace of pity and indifference in his eyes.
These mechanical warriors were different from humans. They didn’t have heat source and murderous aura. It was difficult to determine their strength without fighting. These kings obviously didn’t expect that all the mechanical warriors in front of them were comparable to them.
Soon, the king who had transformed into a purple scaled dragon took the lead and rushed out. The electricity gathered on the horn of his head and formed a ball of lightning. It shot out streams of electricity towards the mechanical warrior.
Bang! Bang!
The electric currents hit the mechanical warrior and produced crackling sounds and green smoke.
However, the mechanical warriors all set up a defensive barrier to block the electric currents and did not suffer any damage at all.
This scene made the purple-scaled flood dragon somewhat surprised. His magic marks could create strong electric currents between his muscles, which was no less than lightning. They had the ability to restrain the mechanical objects that were powered by electric energy, but they actually failed at this moment?
While he was shocked, the few mechanical warriors that were attacked by him seemed to have activated a program. They immediately attacked. Some of them directly pounced over. Their explosive speed was extremely fast, and they instantly rushed in front of the purple-scaled flood dragon, raising his hand, he slashed out with a white laser battle saber that was suffused with purple light. It cut open the scales of the purple-scaled flood dragon. The scales were so deep that the bones could be seen. It was almost chopped off in one strike!
“Not good!”When the other seven people saw this scene, they turned pale with fright. It was already too late for them to help.
The purple-scaled flood dragon king was surrounded by a few mechanical warriors and was quickly cut into several pieces. His body didn’t even have the time to shrink and demonize before he was killed.
The mechanical warriors were not weaker than kings to begin with. Furthermore, they were attacking together. The larger the body of the purple-scaled flood dragon demonized, the more it would be hit. On the contrary, it would die even faster. It was so fast that the others didn’t even have the time to help.
At this moment, the eyes of the other mechanical warriors glowed red. They suddenly moved together and charged toward the seven people.
“Not good!”
“Run!”
The seven people were kings after all. From the moment the mecha warriors moved, they knew that these metal lumps were many times stronger than the mechanical warriors they had seen before. They immediately retreated without hesitation.
The seven kings had retreated thousands of meters when they suddenly stopped. They saw an energy shield surrounded by lightning as if it was a barrier matrix. It surrounded them. The electric current added to the energy shield made the air feel burnt.
“The purple scaled Dragon King is good at controlling lightning. If he doesn’t die then they will be able to escape.”Dudian sighed as he looked at the Lightning matrix, the only way to survive was behind the lightning matrix. Although the strength of these mech warriors was terrifying but the biggest drawback was that they couldn’t get too far away from the mainframe. Their maximum distance was at the location where the Lightning matrix rose.
The reason why they couldn’t get too far away was because of the energy problem.
In the old era, the concept of technology had already crossed the solar system and looked to the galaxy outside the Milky Way. But because of the energy problem, they couldn’t even leave the Solar System. This problem also troubled the current federation and Lin Changsheng. Although they had made new breakthroughs in new energy sources, these mech warriors consumed too much energy and had to be recharged at all times.
And the area they were moving in was a huge charging board. Once they left, they would lose their ability to move and no matter how strong their battle strength was, it would be difficult to display it.
This was also the reason why Lin Changsheng was unable to conquer the Empire despite having these fierce mech warriors.

chapters.title: Chapter 1167
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1167: Chapter 1156: bombing
Translator: 549690339
As the Seven Kings were forced into a desperate situation, there was a sudden roar. A hole was formed in the energy shield which was surrounded by lightning. The Seven Kings saw the hole and went through it.
There was a middle-aged DRAKONID with red scales standing outside the gap. He had sharp horns on his head and his body was emitting terrifying heat energy. The air around him was slightly distorted.
Dudian’s face changed as he saw the man. He recognized him from Lin Changsheng’s memory. He was one of the two Dragon Masters of the Fire Dragon Kingdom. He was called ‘Fire Dragon Master’and was in charge of the north of the Fire Dragon Kingdom, the other ‘Fire Dragon Master’was in charge of the south of the Fire Dragon Kingdom. He didn’t expect that the Fire Dragon Kingdom and the Empire would join hands to attack the Federation!
“The most powerful people in the world have gathered here. The top experts are also here...”Dudian’s eyelids twitched. This wasn’t a random war but a peak war, the result was directly related to the future of mankind.
At the same time, the Fire Dragon Lord raised his hand to blast open the Thunder Energy Shield. When the seven kings gathered around him, his face was red and his hair was spread out. He raised his hand and pushed forward. The palm of his hand was red like a hot iron. The Red Energy left his palm, it grew larger in the air and turned into a hot burning palm. It slammed into the lightning energy shield that was slowly recovering and directly hit a mechanical warrior.
The hot energy directly burned the energy shield that was erected outside the mechanical warrior’s body and imprinted itself on his body. With a bang, the blazing palm suddenly tightened and grabbed the mechanical warrior. With a whoosh, it pulled him back, it appeared in front of Fire Dragon Lord.
The moment the mechanical warrior’s body left the Lightning Energy Shield, the red light in the mechanical compound’s eyes immediately dimmed. Before the weapon that was triggered during the resistance could be swung out, its body stiffened and it did not move at all.
Fire Dragon Lord’s eyes flashed as it grabbed the mechanical warrior and threw it thousands of meters away.
“This is?”
“It seems to have lost its target.”
“Will these mechanical warriors stop attacking after leaving this lightning energy shield?”
The seven kings were surprised and doubtful when they saw this scene, but they were more excited. If this was the case, they still had a chance to counterattack. Otherwise, they could only flee. After all, nearly fifty kings were attacking together, it was too terrifying!
“These mechanical warriors can not leave this area. capture them or push them away,”the fire dragon Lord said slowly. His previous methods had confirmed his information, so he immediately told the seven kings, at the same time, he raised his hand and slapped out two fiery palms, blasting open the lightning energy barrier. He grabbed the two mechanical warriors inside and prepared to pull them out.
However, before the flaming palms could be pulled back, the mechanical warriors beside him attacked one after another and destroyed the two flaming palms.
The other seven kings knew how to break the Lightning Energy Shield, so they each attacked from the outside. Some threw out vine-like weapons and broke through the Lightning Energy Shield, locking down the mechanical warriors and dragging them out. Some of their arms became hundreds of feet large and violently tore apart the lightning energy shield. Lightning appeared on the back of their hands, and they were not afraid of the Lightning on the energy shield. They grabbed a group of mechanical warriors and threw them out.
These Mech Warriors either resisted, dodged, or counterattacked. However, compared to kings, they lacked the ability to transform. They could only rely on their alloy bodies to fight. With Kings’attack power.., they could not break the special alloy on their bodies, but they could drag them around. Once they were dragged out of the Lightning Energy Shield, the Mech Warriors would lose their energy supply. The energy stored in their bodies was not enough for them to launch an attack, its body immediately stiffened.
It must be known that their speed and every attack was at the king level. The energy they needed was extremely shocking. Their small bodies were filled with all kinds of weapons, there was no extra space for larger energy plates. Once the energy plates were too large, it would become their weakness and be easy to target.
Dudian looked at the mechanical warriors being dragged out one after another. Although their bodies were undamaged but they had lost their energy as soon as they left the Thunder Energy Shield. They had become scrap metal. This was enough to flatten any country, dudian couldn’t help but sigh. At the same time he was a bit afraid of the Fire Dragon Kingdom. The weakness of this mechanical army was top secret. Besides Lin Changsheng.., only a few of the past chairmen of the Terras Consortium knew about it. Even the current chairman of the Terras Consortium didn’t know about it.
He didn’t expect that the Dragon Lord of the Fire Dragon Kingdom would know about it. It was hard to imagine how deep the infiltration of the federation was. Perhaps he had secretly infiltrated the federation from decades ago or even hundreds of years ago.
“But even if we know the secret, it is too difficult to break through this place.”Dudian thought.
The remaining forty or so mech warriors suddenly retreated back to the building where the mainframe was located. They were far away from the energy shield so that the attacks of the Seven Kings and Fire Dragon Lord couldn’t extend so far, after all, the Lightning Energy Shield was an attack weapon that couldn’t be underestimated. It couldn’t allow them to demonize the genes.
“If they continue to stand there, there’s nothing we can do.”
“Damn it, isn’t the hidden strength of the federation a little too terrifying?”
“These metal lumps can be created as long as there are resources. They are unlike us, who can not be nurtured by relying on materials.”
The Seven Kings stood outside the energy shield. They were angry and anxious, but they were helpless.
Fire Dragon Master’s face was calm: “There is no hurry. If they don’t come out then let them stay here forever!”
The Seven Kings looked at him. Their eyes were filled with awe. They didn’t dare to ask.
After a while, there was a continuous roar coming from the distance. The light of the explosion illuminated the night sky. Everyone turned to look.
“Battle Network?”Dudian looked at the direction of the explosion. He was stunned for a moment. His eyes focused. The explosion was as long as a mountain range. Moreover, the explosion happened in a short time, the three supercomputers that were assisting the mainframe were destroyed. If the three supercomputers were destroyed then the instruments of the Federation would be paralyzed!
Fire Dragon’s eyes lit up as he whispered: “Retreat!”
He took the lead and retreated.
The seven kings were stunned but their reaction wasn’t slow. They quickly followed.
The moment they left the Lightning Energy Shield, a ray of dawn shot through the sky like a signal bomb. It fell towards the city. The target was the building where the mainframe was located.
Missiles were launched around the city at the same time in an attempt to intercept the ray of dawn. However, many figures flew out from the darkness and blocked the interception of the weapons and the robot soldiers.
“Nuclear bomb? !”Dudian’s golden pupils dilated as he saw the appearance of the dawn.

chapters.title: Chapter 1168
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1168: Chapter 1157: base
Translator: 549690339
Dudian could see the internal structure of dawn through the perspective. It was a nuclear bomb. If it wasn’t for the intercepting missiles around him he would have thought that Lin Changsheng was preparing to self-destruct, it could only mean that the mainframe city was a pit that Lin Changsheng had set up. It was beyond his expectations that everyone could be buried.
But now it seemed that the missile should have come from the Empire or the Fire Dragon Kingdom.
He thought of the airship built by the Empire which he saw on the god of War Wall as well as many other technological items. With the technology of the empire, it was not difficult to build a nuclear bomb.
Since the nuclear bomb was not dropped by Lin Changsheng, Dudian did not plan to turn around and flee. He was more than ten miles away from the center of the nuclear bomb. Even if the nuclear bomb exploded, it would not hurt him, moreover, Lin Changsheng wouldn’t just stand by and watch.
As Dudian quietly watched the changes, the nuclear bomb fell. Suddenly, from the front of the building where the main engine was buried, the street-like ground rose like a metal plate. Two black holes were exposed from the inside, inside were triangular-shaped launchers. The energy was rapidly gathered. Two dark blue beams of light shot through the sky and hit the nuclear bomb.
Boom! !
The nuclear bomb was detonated in mid-air. The world lost its color for a moment. The world suddenly became silent. It was as if there was a long tinnitus in his ears. He couldn’t hear anything but what he saw.., there was a sudden burst of intense light in the sky. Even Dudian’s eyes were slightly squinted as he felt pain.
Ordinary people would lose their sight if they closed their eyes.
Dudian felt the ground under his feet tremble as if the earth was trembling in fear.
The next moment, the world seemed to recover from the silence. The explosion of the light swept out a burst of blazing light. It spread in all directions like a light pillar and drowned everything, any color paled in front of the strong light. The world became pure white and all the buildings were drowned by the light.
Everything was shrouded in darkness. There was also the blinding light.
Dudian squinted his eyes as he tried to observe the power of the nuclear bomb. Soon he could barely see the buildings near the place where the nuclear bomb exploded. The buildings were quickly destroyed. The terrible high temperature and radiation quickly crushed everything, it was like a fast moving cutting machine. The heat wave quickly spread out and spread in all directions. A large number of buildings turned into ashes or were scorched by the high temperature as if they were going to melt.
The buildings buried by the mainframe were razed to the ground. The streets on the ground were showing signs of melting. The streets seemed to be made of bricks but in fact they were made of metal. They were melting and deformed under the high temperature.
The Fire Dragon Lord and the Seven Kings were not in the center of the explosion. At the moment each of them had demonized layers of limbs. They collapsed under the high temperature but their bodies were not injured.
When the explosion swept in front of dudian, he quickly absorbed the heat source in the air. At the same time his body turned into a huge rock. Under the destruction of the explosion pieces of rock cracked out but the core of his body was not affected.
Soon, the nuclear explosion gradually subsided. Fire Dragon and the Seven Kings rushed to the place where the main engine was buried. They saw that the huge castle-like building had disappeared, the more than 40 robot soldiers guarding the building had also disappeared. There was no trace left on the ground.
“Have they been wiped out?”
“This is too terrifying!”
“Don’t think so. I saw them hiding in the underground base.”
Soon, some kings who didn’t notice the underground base also noticed that there was an underground base under the building that had been razed to the ground. Their faces changed. If the more than 40 robot guards were in the underground base.., there was nothing they could do except to launch another nuclear bomb.
Someone looked at Fire Dragon and waited for him to make a decision.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he looked from afar. He knew that Lin Changsheng only had one trump card left. Although the more than 40 robot soldiers weren’t destroyed but they had lost their function because.., the purpose of the nuclear bomb wasn’t to directly destroy the city but to destroy the city’s power grid and energy supply system.
Under the baptism of the nuclear bomb, the city’s power grid was completely paralyzed, and the nearby energy supply channels were also destroyed. The remaining energy supply channels were not enough to support so many mech warriors to fight, and this underground base.., was Lin Changsheng’s nest, also his turtle shell. Even if another nuclear bomb came, it would not be able to blast open this underground base. The entire base used a special alloy, extremely precious, and its hardness was more than three hundred times that of diamond.., lin Changsheng’s two hundred plus years of accumulation had all been invested here. This was also the reason why Lin Changsheng was unable to move the mainframe out of this city.
The materials of that batch of king-level Mech Warriors had only been fused with a few incomplete special base alloys. This was enough to block the attacks of a king, and this underground base was enough to withstand the bombardment of thousands of missiles, even nuclear bombs could be blocked. The only way to break through was to use some special magic marks abilities.
There were all kinds of magic marks abilities. Some of them could digest stones, some of them could melt metal, and some of them could eat fire... according to Dudian’s understanding, there were several magic marks abilities, they were aimed at this special alloy base.
“They should have learned about the changes of the magic marks.”Dudian’s eyes lit up as he prepared to let them take the lead.
As he expected, fire dragon had brought the seven kings to the underground base. Their bodies changed and melted into the special alloy base like mucus.
Dudian tried to penetrate the underground base but was blocked. The materials of the underground base were similar to the materials of the magic insects and Aragami ships. After all, these ships were flying vehicles that came to Earth from the stars, they were able to resist the cosmic radiation and were extremely dense. If they didn’t have the few magic marks ability, they wouldn’t be able to crack it.
Dudian didn’t rush to follow them but waited in the same place. Many mysterious figures had appeared in the sky to block the interceptor missiles. He was a bit afraid of them, the Devil Emperor was still eyeing them.
“Lin Changsheng should be able to defend them...”Dudian was worried. He hoped that both of them would be injured.

chapters.title: Chapter 1169
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1169: Chapter 1158: hostage
Translator: 549690339
After the Master of Fire Dragon and the others went into the underground base, the surface gradually returned to calm. The aftermath of the nuclear explosion also gradually subsided. However, the heat wave in the air was still lingering. It seemed that their vision had become somewhat turbid and distorted.
A few minutes passed in the silence. Dudian didn’t see the appearance of the Devil Emperor. The latter seemed to be watching or waiting outside to meet the Master of Fire Dragon and the others. This also confirmed his idea of waiting outside.
