Time passed by.
Dudian’s anxiety was increasing at a rapid rate. Suddenly, a ‘beep’sound came from his hand. He was startled and looked down, it was the sound of the wristwatch that was snatched from the woman’s hand.
When he looked down, a face suddenly flashed on the wristwatch and occupied the entire surface.
“Lin Changsheng!”Dudian’s pupils shrank but he quickly calmed down. He stared at Lin Changsheng: “You have known my position for a long time. Have you been using this to monitor me?”
“Help me!”Lin Changsheng opened his mouth but didn’t respond to Dudian’s words, he directly said: “Come in and help me. I didn’t expect the Fire Dragon Kingdom to be involved in this. There is a devil emperor lurking in the dark. I don’t know his position. Come and help me!”
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “Are you drunk or not awake?”
Lin Changsheng looked at him as if he was a robot, he said word by word: “I know how to treat the undeads. I have a way. If you want to know then come in and help me. Otherwise, the mainframe will be destroyed or rebooted. The top secret information will be destroyed. You will never find a solution by yourself!” The head flashed like an electric current and disappeared.
Dudian looked at the watch which had returned to normal. His face turned gloomy. His fingers clenched into fists. His intuition told him that Lin Changsheng was lying. After all, he had plundered part of the opponent’s memory, there was no way to solve the problem of the undeads. However, it was only part of the memory. So he didn’t dare to gamble. If it was true then he would miss it forever.
Dudian clenched his teeth and rushed out. His body quickly changed as he went into the underground base. It felt very wonderful to penetrate through the special alloy.
After penetrating through the outer shell of the base, Dudian saw that the inner structure of the base was an extremely spacious metal room. It was like a container that was magnified hundreds of times, there were no small rooms or offices to rest and work in. There were all kinds of machinery. Some were auxiliary hosts, some were maintenance robots, and some were fighting robots.
But at the moment the place was in a mess. The ground was littered with the remains of the previous kings. Many instruments had been destroyed. There were two kings’corpses lying on the ground. Their heads and bodies were in pieces.
There was a huge hole in the front where a lot of pipes were concentrated. At the moment, there were fierce sounds of battle and screams. The screams were like monsters and evil ghosts.
Dudian’s heart suddenly turned cold when he heard the screams that didn’t sound human. Two words flashed through his mind: undeads!
He suddenly remembered that Lin Changsheng still had the undead army in his hands!
Even if the nuclear bomb destroyed the energy channels around the base and turned the king robot into scrap metal, there was still an undead army!
Dudian looked at the corpses of the two kings. He found that the corpses weren’t destroyed by machines or thermal weapons but were torn apart. The method was extremely bloody and brutal.
He demonized the outside of his body into stone skin. He slowly approached the hole and looked at the terrifying scene. The second floor of the underground base was under the hole. At the moment there were strange limbs dancing inside, the giant octopus-like tentacles were waving. There was no human shadow.
Under the attack of the berserk demonized limbs, a figure with disheveled hair was baring its fangs and brandishing its claws. Its movements were rough and violent. Although its speed was shocking but there was no heat source reaction from its body.
“Undeads!”Dudian’s face changed as he saw the figure with disheveled hair. He didn’t expect that Lin Changsheng really left undeads here to guard. Moreover, the strength of this undeads made him feel a death crisis, it was far more terrifying than ordinary kings.
“Black wind won’t be able to hold on much longer. If it dies, the mainframe will fall into the hands of the Fire Dragon Lord.”As Dudian looked around, the figure of Lin Changsheng appeared on a broken instrument, he looked at Dudian expressionlessly: “If you want to know how to save the undeads then help me.”
Dudian’s face sank, “You have other cards up your sleeve. I don’t believe that you didn’t calculate that the fire dragon kingdom would interfere. This scene should have been in your calculations. What is your plan? Are you going to catch us all in one go?”
Lin Changsheng expressionlessly replied, “I’m not an omnipotent God, so it’s impossible for me to calculate everything. Moreover, I didn’t think that they would be able to smuggle a nuclear bomb into the territory. There are traitors in the upper echelons of the federation, and they have hidden themselves too deeply. Although I can use all sorts of devices to monitor every corner of the federation, not all the information that is monitored will be fed back to my brain. Otherwise, I would know everyone’s secrets, and my consciousness would have long been squeezed to the limit! “People’s hearts are hard to predict. Even I can’t see the thoughts of others. It’s the same as when I didn’t see your thoughts.”
Dudian sneered: “Do you think I would believe you? I’m beginning to suspect that you arranged a team of ordinary soldiers to shoot me with special zombie virus bullets. The purpose is to pull me to help you at this moment. I believe that you have a way to solve the problem of the undeads. You know what I’m asking for so you can understand my thoughts.”
Lin changsheng indifferently said: “There is no point in talking about this. You might not believe me even if I tell you. In short, if you want to solve the problem of the undeads then help me. If you don’t want to, then when black wind is defeated I will detonate all the nuclear bombs in the city and die together with you!”
Dudian’s heart trembled but he soon felt relieved. With his ability, as long as he rushed into the air in time and was not in the center of the explosion, he should be able to survive.
“I will help you to repel the Fire Dragon Lord. You must tell me how to deal with the undeads. I Won’t help you with anything else. Moreover you know the purpose of my coming here. It is impossible to resolve the enmity between us.”Dudian coldly said.
Lin changsheng indifferently said: “Alright.”
Dudian didn’t say anything more. He took a deep breath and jumped into the hole. The sequence of the various genes appeared in his mind. The genes in his body were active like boiling water. They quickly split and went berserk.
In an instant, countless sharp blades grew out of his body. They quickly extended to more than ten meters. Moreover, they continued to extend. Each of the sharp blades was designed to cut through the structure of the blade, moreover, the surface of the blade was attached to a terrifying high temperature. It was like a hot knife.

chapters.title: Chapter 1170
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1170: Chapter 1159: Evolution
Translator: 549690339
“Watch Your Back!”
Dudian heard an angry shout as soon as he appeared on the second floor of the base. There were seven or eight ferocious monsters on the second floor. They looked like angry monsters. All of them were ten to twenty meters tall, some of them looked like octopuses with blood-red tentacles. Some of them looked like crocodiles and pangolins. Their mouths were full of sharp teeth and their backs were covered with sharp spikes. Some of them looked like cobras but their bodies were thirty to forty meters long and as thick as a water tank, sharp blades that looked like fish fins grew out from both sides of their bodies.
The most eye-catching one among them was a monster that looked like a mythical dragon with flames burning all over its body. Unlike the mythical dragon, it did not have antlers on its head. Instead, it had sharp horns that looked like branches of a dead tree, there were seven to eight spikes that were more than two meters long on its back. There were purple whiskers on both sides of its body. It looked like it was sticking close to its body, but it seemed like it could open up at any time and turn into a sharp blade.
The terrifying heat was emitted from the body of the Fire Dragon. The other monsters around it also avoided three feet away from it.
Dudian judged that the fire dragon should be the result of the berserk demonization of the fire dragon. At the moment it was fighting with a human-shaped zombie with disheveled hair. The appearance of this zombie was close to that of a human, its hair was solidified into a solid. Its pupils were blood red. Its arms were half as long as a human’s. There were six or seven fingers on its palm like claws. There were black blades on its knees and back. Its movement was extremely fast, he was like an afterimage as he shuttled back and forth between the Seven Kings.
When Dudian appeared, the king who was standing at the back didn’t participate in the battle. He immediately shouted to remind him.
Dudian quickly looked at the situation of the battlefield and the positions of the kings. He made a judgement and made preparations for the battle. At the same time he noticed the structure of the room. It was extremely wide and the walls were made of metal, there were no furniture and other miscellaneous items like the first floor. There was a giant tree-like instrument behind the battle between the fire dragon and the undead. It stretched out a complicated pipe which was twisted like a intestine, at the moment there was a semi-transparent energy shield in front of the instrument. One of the King’s limbs hit the energy shield. It seemed that the energy shield bounced back and turned into a bloody mist.
“Go to hell!”
The king who didn’t participate in the battle shouted as he rushed towards Dudian. He saw that Dudian’s physique was similar to his through the heat source so he didn’t hesitate to rush towards him.
“Eh?”Dudian noticed that the closest king monster was coming towards him. It was a furry monster that looked like a civet cat. It was seven or eight meters tall and had sharp claws, it didn’t seem to be very aggressive.
Dudian noticed from the corner of his eyes that the other two kings were rushing towards him. He took a deep breath as a trace of madness flashed in his eyes. His body had expanded to more than ten meters and his body was as long as a sea urchin, however the sharp blades were more flexible than the sea urchin’s spikes. At the moment it looked messy but the sea urchin’s line of sight was cut off.
“Die!”
Dudian growled in a low voice. In the blink of an eye, he collided with the monster. The hair on the monster’s body grew crazily and wrapped around Dudian’s sharp blade like a sponge, he tried to wrap the sharp blade.
Dudian felt that there were layers of obstacles on the body of the sharp blade. It seemed that there were thousands of strands of power pulling the blade. However, the next moment, the pulling force suddenly disappeared, the high temperature of the blade burned the fur of the king. Puff Puff Puff. The blade hit the body of the king. Although it didn’t directly cut off the body of the king but it was deep enough to see the bones.
Dudian felt a slight pain in his chest when the blade hit the opponent. He couldn’t help but glance over. He saw that there was a crack on his petrified chest, he didn’t know when he was attacked.
Whoosh!
At the same time, the King pulled back and landed in the distance. There was a bit of shock in his eyes. It seemed that he didn’t expect Dudian’s attack to be so terrifying. It almost cut his body into several pieces, if he hadn’t observed a five-star legendary Monster’s defense which was extremely terrifying. The bones and flesh of his body were made into the body of a five-star legendary monster. He would have been killed in an instant!
“What a terrifying sharp blade. Fortunately he has been hit by my stinger. After I kill him I will be able to observe the structure of his sharp blade...”the raccoon king secretly calculated in his heart, the eyes of the Raccoon King turned fiery as he looked at dudian. Dudian was already a dead man in his eyes. He was best at using poison. It was because of this that there was no place for him in the face of the terrifying undeads, dudian stayed behind to provide support. After all, the undeads virus in the opponent’s body was the most unsolvable and terrifying poison in the world. It was enough to kill and assimilate all the poisonous bacteria.
Dudian felt that the wound wasn’t deep so he didn’t care. It was obvious that the monster’s attack power wasn’t strong. His petrified body was relatively hard. He was about to attack again when he suddenly felt that something was wrong, he felt a throbbing pain in his chest. He quickly used his X-ray vision to look at his own body.
He saw that the inside of the petrified chest had turned black. The petrified body seemed to be moldy as fine hair grew out!
“Is This... poison? But my body is petrified. How can I be poisoned?”Dudian’s heart was beating fast, if he was poisoned in such a situation where he was outnumbered then it was unknown if he could survive. Moreover the other two kings had rushed over and launched an attack. He immediately used his sharp limbs to push them, he evaded the attacks of the two kings and retreated to the corner of the room.
Dudian didn’t have time to think about why the petrified body was black and infected. Moreover the black parts were spreading at an alarming speed. He clenched his teeth, with perspective to see the dark hair of the material deep, suddenly saw countless black balls and particles in the spread of division.
At the same time, he divided his mind, burning his whole body in flames, attached to the sharp blade, causing the sharp blade to burn in flames, and quickly waved it, setting a sharp fire shield around his body, cut off and burn the limbs of the two kings who came in.
The two kings screamed in pain. They didn’t expect that Dudian’s monster’s limbs would be so terrifying. There was no obstruction in cutting their bodies. If they were cut into the main body, wouldn’t they be cut into two pieces on the spot?
Dudian’s other part of his mind was focused on the black hair. It was moving in his eyes, splitting, invasion, devouring... All these changes were in his eyes. It was much more complicated than the other demonized limbs. However, the trajectory of the movement was repeated over and over again.
“There is no hurry. He has been poisoned by my poison. It will soon infect his whole body.”King tanuki climbed to the side of the other two kings. He looked at the Fireblade Shield in front of him.
The two kings looked at each other. They were hesitant. They didn’t have much confidence in the latter’s poison. However Dudian’s blade was too sharp and there was a terrifying high temperature. They wouldn’t be able to attack him in a short time, they wouldn’t be able to attack him unless they used some means to injure themselves. However it wasn’t worth it. Moreover they were in the hinterland of the federation. Who knew what kind of danger they would encounter. They had to conserve their strength.., only then would they be able to deal with the unknown.
At this moment, an angry roar sounded from another location. The Fire Dragon Lord and a few other kings surrounded the terrifying zombie. However, only the fire dragon Lord’s flames could suppress this terrifying zombie. The attacks of the other kings.., they were easily dodged. Adding on to the fact that the latter was only around three meters in size, which was almost half the height of a normal human, it appeared incomparably small in front of the demonized bodies of the kings. It was like a nimble mouse.
“This zombie’s combat thinking is just like a human.”The Tanuki King and the other two kings had been paying attention to the fire dragon Lord and the terrifying zombie. Seeing that they couldn’t take it down for a long time, they couldn’t help but feel shocked, this zombie’s combat methods were especially flexible, and it didn’t seem like a normal zombie that only knew how to fight.
Pu!
At this moment, one of the kings with blood-red tentacles that looked like an octopus was suddenly seized by the terrifying zombies. He crashed into the roots of the blood-red tentacles and directly sank into his body.
The king immediately let out a terrified scream. One of the blood-red tentacles suddenly shook violently and then bloomed like a flower bud. A naked young man was thrown out and flew behind Fire Dragon Lord.
When the young man flew out, the giant octopus-like demon body stopped moving.
Fire Dragon Lord’s demonized fire dragon eyes flashed with a cold light. It suddenly spat out a large amount of flames and engulfed the empty shell demon body. At the same time, it swam to wrap around the empty shell demon body and crazily tore it apart with its sharp claws.
Bang!
When Fire Dragon Lord tore the empty shell demon body apart, a horrifying zombie figure crawled out from one of the unremarkable tentacles and turned around to pounce on another king nearby, scaring the king so much that he turned around and ran.
“Blood hand has lost his magic body. He can’t fight anymore. I will go and support him!”A king who looked like a white tiger and had a mouth full of wild boar’s tusks said in a low voice. He was about to rush into the battlefield.
Suddenly, the sharp blades that were waving in front of them slowly stopped. The Flames disappeared and revealed Dudian’s original body.
“Is the poison out?”The eyes of the king lit up when he saw this scene.
However his face changed when he saw Dudian’s appearance: “How is it possible!”
At the moment Dudian’s chest had healed. There was no sign of blackening near the wound. The King couldn’t believe that his poison was more like a curse than poison, it was a special kind of supermaterial. Whether it was stones or trees, they could be destroyed and assimilated. If it was a body of flesh and blood then the speed of destruction would be even more shocking.
In his eyes, it was an unsolvable existence. With just this move, he could easily kill monsters.
But at this moment, his poison seemed to have lost its effect.
But he clearly noticed that Dudian was indeed poisoned.
“You...”the two kings next to him noticed the tanuki king’s expression and immediately knew that something was wrong. Their faces slightly changed as they stared at Dudian.
“Is this what you are good at? Poison Attack?”Dudian looked at Tanuki King. His expression was serious as he asked: “Why did you choose such a stupid way of fighting? Isn’t it meaningless?”
Tanuki King’s face changed. He felt that his face was burning. He didn’t argue with Dudian, he growled: “I miscalculated. Let’s attack together!”
The two kings nodded. There was a bit of seriousness in their eyes as they pounced towards Dudian.
“Poison is used as a means of attack but it is easy to break it. As long as you know the structure of this thing and change your cells into the same material, assimilate it and change it back into your own body. But it seems that I can’t solve this poison. Could it be that other kings can’t learn how to demonize genes as fast as me?”Dudian looked at the three kings, however, he was not as worried as before. When he was dealing with this strange poison, he had vaguely guessed that his body was different from other kings.
Although kings could learn other genes and undergo corresponding changes, there seemed to be some limitations. However, his body did not. This was also the fundamental reason why Lin Changsheng coveted his body.
And this also meant that he could quickly grow!
For example..
He had mastered the strange poison of the Cat King’s self-confidence!
Whoosh!
Dudian’s body suddenly stretched out and turned into hundreds of sharp blades. They stabbed at the three kings who were surrounding him. More than ten of them stabbed at the cat king, the other thirty sharp blades attacked the white tiger king from different angles. The remaining blades released flames and attacked the scorpion-like king who was attacking from the right.
Each blade was boiling hot, emitting high temperatures. Half an inch behind the blade, there was an additional notch, and boiling black venom flowed inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 1171
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1171: Chapter 1160: Insect Emergence
Translator: 549690339
Dudian felt a resistance in the air from another scorpion-like king. There seemed to be an inexplicable repulsive force around him which slowed down the speed of his blade.
However, his other ten or so sharp blades hit the king. The king’s fur covered body turned into layers of soft shield which wrapped the sharp blades like a sponge. However, the flames from the sharp blades cut off the fur, it directly cut the body. However this time the king was prepared. The fur on his body grew extremely thick. It greatly slowed down the damage of the sharp blades.
The king’s face slightly changed. He didn’t expect that he would be injured by Dudian. He was about to turn around and attack again when he suddenly felt that something was wrong with his body. The wound was cut by Dudian, there was no sign of healing. He didn’t have time to check and withdraw from the battle. He retracted his hair and looked at the seven or eight cuts. The color of the cuts had turned black!
“Poison?”The king was stunned. He was too familiar with the signs of poison. It was his own poison!
The next moment he reacted. He looked at Dudian who was besieged by the king of White Tiger and the king of Scorpions. Could it be that the latter was able to analyze his poison and duplicate his ability!
Every king could analyze other abilities to control the body and learn from the genetic level to control new abilities. But it would take time. To analyze the structure of an ability would require very detailed observation, it would take a lot of time to learn. Some abilities were in conflict with the body. Even if he could analyze it, he wouldn’t be able to learn it. He would have to choose an ability that was suitable for him.
In the Tanuki King’s impression, only the Fire Dragon Lord and the Kirin Dragon Lord could quickly control and learn new abilities. However, when encountering complex abilities, the learning time would increase correspondingly. The specific length was different, and it depended entirely on one’s comprehension ability, for example, his ability was the five-star legend magic mark ability. In addition, he had studied different poison-type monsters for many years, observed their poison, and combined it with many poisonous liquids to create a poison ability that belonged solely to himself, even if the fire dragon master wanted to crack it, it would take a lot of time. But the other party had mastered it in just a few minutes?
The king of the civet cat suddenly thought of the two kings who were still fighting with Dudian. He quickly shouted: “Be careful! There is my poison on his blade. Don’t be hurt by him!”
In fact, both the king of the White Tiger and the King of the scorpion had avoided Dudian’s blade. They had felt the sharpness of the blade from the first contact, in addition, they didn’t know about Dudian’s ability so they didn’t dare to be hit easily. They had rich combat experience in their life. Some people would smear the zombie virus on their weapons even if their strength was weaker than theirs, there was also a possibility that it could kill them so they would never be careless.
After reminding them, the king saw that they had temporarily suppressed Dudian. He didn’t think much and quickly mobilized the genes in his body to assimilate the poison. Although the poison was terrible but it was his own poison after all, it was basically ineffective against him. However, when he thought about it, he suddenly found that the genes he had mobilized were unable to assimilate the poison. In fact, the part of the poison that he had transformed into was being melted by this part of the poison!
“How is it possible?”The king was a bit stunned. He suspected that he was wrong. He once again transformed the surrounding tissues of the poisoned area into poison and assimilated it. However, very soon.., the tissues that were transformed into poison were quickly absorbed by the poison. The rate of infection was even faster.
The king was shocked. The poison seemed to be a sign of his own poison but the poison was different from his own. The other party had not only broken through his poison.., moreover there were other poisons mixed into it which made the poison even more ferocious than his own!
Using poison was his specialty, but at the moment he was crushed by someone using poison. The King’s face was ashen, but he was more afraid. He didn’t have Dudian’s comprehension and ability to quickly analyze the genetic structure and learn to copy, moreover, he knew the terror of his venom. Even if he cut off the flesh, it would be useless. The poison had already invaded his body through the blood, but it was dormant in various places.
“Don’t tell me I can only abandon this body? Damn it! Damn you!”The Tanuki King’s expression changed, in the end, he gritted his teeth and roared. The fur on his body shrank and his forehead split open. A pink, fleshy worm crawled out from within. This worm was as thick as an infant’s arm and was two to three meters long, even with the Tanuki King’s huge demonized head, it could only fit the body of this worm.
There was a thin mucous membrane on the body of the insect which looked like a wet liquid. After the body climbed out, the mucus also fell off. After it fell to the ground, its body twisted a few times and sweat-like mucus oozed out of its body, it formed a protective membrane again.
“I can’t interfere in this battle anymore. I can only leave it to them. I hope they can completely kill the embryo of the Ice Devil!”The pink insect turned its head and looked at the main direction of the battle. It then looked at Dudian who was besieged, there was a trace of unwillingness in its eyes. It twisted its body and merged into the metal wall. It left the underground base and came to the surface.
“There is still that damn puppet in the dark. I have no body. I have to leave quickly...”the pink worm appeared on the ground. There were four long and narrow cracks on its head. There were blood-red eyes inside, it looked around vigilantly. It rushed towards one of the places where there was no danger.
Suddenly, a gust of strong wind swept over and picked up the pink demonic worm.
With a smack, a slender and pale palm caught the pink demonic worm. The owner of the palm was wearing a black robe with dark golden edges and a huge hood. His face was in the shadows, but the tip of his nose was extremely white.
“Flaming demonic worm, where are you going? Why did you abandon your body?”The black-robed man’s voice was gentle and contained a hint of ridicule.
The pink demonic worm was so frightened that its four eyes widened as it screamed, “Release it to me and let Fire Dragon Lord know that you have broken the agreement and will definitely go to war with Your Fiend Kingdom!”
“It’s fine as long as he doesn’t know.”The black-robed man smiled gently as he pulled down the hood on his head, revealing an extremely handsome face that contained a hint of feminine melancholy. This face was so handsome that it was impeccable and flawless.., at this moment, there was a smile on the corner of his mouth. He suddenly opened his mouth, and in an instant, his mouth was half a meter wide. His originally beautiful white teeth instantly turned into a mouth full of ferocious sharp teeth.
“No! I...”The pink demonic insect let out an ear-piercing scream, but soon, the voice became muffled and was stuffed into the black-robed man’s mouth. He closed his mouth and chewed non-stop. As he chewed, his mouth also slowly shrank, becoming smaller and smaller until he returned to his previous handsome and normal appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1172
chapters.content:
Chapter 1172: Chapter 1161: Illusion and reality
Translator:
549690339
A corner of the second level of the base.
Dudian didn’t pay attention to the king of the White Tiger and the king of the Scorpions after he noticed that the king of the White Tiger and the king of the Scorpions had retreated from the battle circle. His sharp blade attack was close to the king of the white tiger but it strangely passed through the opponent’s body, it seemed that the king of the white tiger in front of him was just a phantom. But the sharp attack and killing intent were not illusory!
It was the first time that Dudian had encountered such a strange ability. It could be said that it was the first time that he had fought a king in front of him on the second level of the base. It didn’t matter if it was the strange poison of the previous king, it was unheard of for the White Tiger King to have such a strange and illusory ability. It was extremely rare even among five-star legendary monsters. Moreover, it had been improved by the king, it became unique.
The White Tiger King’s body that had dodged the sharp blade pounced in front of Dudian. The figure that seemed to pass through the sharp blade was aggressive. It waved its sharp claws and fiercely hit dudian’s “Shoulder”, the shoulder had been demonized into an oval shell. There were seven or eight ferocious short thorns on the surface. The White Tiger King’s sharp claws pierced through the short thorns. Dudian was surprised when he suddenly felt a huge force coming from his shoulder, he flew backward and crashed into the floor of the room.
The floor bore the weight of his huge body but there were no signs of cracking. His sharp blade had only scratched the surface of the floor but there were shallow cracks. Unless he used all his strength it was possible to dig a deep hole, it could be seen how hard the metal material in the room was.
“What’s going on?”Dudian quickly stood up from the ground. He looked at the White Tiger King who was coming at him again. There was shock in his eyes. He clearly saw the sharp claws Pierce through his shoulder like a phantom, but how could it hit his shoulder?
Moreover, the White Tiger King’s strength was incomparably fierce. It felt that it could crush him in terms of brute force!
Splitter, Sun Beast, turtle shell, Poison Queen and other magic marks were not strength type magic marks. The Sun Beast was a long-range energy type soul worm. Splitter was an extreme attack type. It was a sensitive assassin type, the rest were either defense type, perceptive type or poison type. The only thing that was lacking was a powerful strength type soul worm. He suddenly found that his strength was about half weaker than the other kings.
White Tiger King saw Dudian quickly get up. There was a trace of seriousness in his eyes. His attack was no small matter. It went deep into the surface of Dudian’s shoulder and hit his flesh, it could be said that he could ignore all defense. In addition to his focus on the berserk power of evolution, very few people could withstand his attack. Even kings who were good at defense would lose their advantage in front of him.
Because his phantom ability was designed to counter defense type warriors!
At this time, Scorpion king saw that Dudian was repelled and immediately seized the opportunity to attack. But as soon as it got close, it was blocked by Dudian’s flame blades and didn’t dare to get close.
White Tiger King frowned as he saw Dudian’s layers of flame blades. His phantom ability could indeed penetrate the flame blades but it would cause damage to his body, this was the reason why he didn’t attack when he saw Dudian use this move. He wanted to wait for the toxic effect of the cat king but he didn’t expect the latter to be a weakling, on the contrary he was forced to abandon his magic body because of the other’s poison.
“This person is a bit strange. He is good at several kinds of abilities: flame energy, sharp blade attack, stone skin defense, Poison. I don’t know what else he knows. Let’s solve it as soon as possible so as to avoid any accidents.”White Tiger King turned to Scorpion King.
The scorpion king bitterly smiled: “You have the Phantom ability so you can get close to him. But I don’t know how to deal with his Rogue Defense!”
“I know. Give me more power and I will try to kill him in one hit!”The White Tiger King said in a deep voice.
The Scorpion king saw that the king was ready to attack. He was excited: “Well, you go ahead!”
The White Tiger King felt that his body was much lighter than before. He took a deep breath and let out a tiger roar. He suddenly rushed towards Dudian’s flame blade shield.
Whoosh!
His body directly penetrated the fire shield!
Dudian’s pupils shrank as he saw White Tiger King jump into the fire shield. Although he had expected and worried about it but he didn’t expect it to happen. The other party’s ability was too strange. Fortunately he was prepared.., the rest of the sharp blades suddenly stabbed towards him.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The sharp blades pierced through the White Tiger King’s body but didn’t hit it.
Dudian’s face changed. He wanted to retreat but it was too late. The White Tiger King’s speed was more than twice as fast as before. In the blink of an eye it was in front of him. The huge Tiger Claw hit his head, it was his head!
“No!”Dudian roared. A large number of sharp blades grew out of his head. They crazily stabbed towards the tiger claw but they still pierced through.
He retreated but the White Tiger King was faster. Bang! Dudian’s body was sent flying. The sharp blades suddenly stopped. The inertia caused them to collide with each other. The sharp blades cut each other, dudian’s body was sent flying. He fell to the ground and didn’t move for a long time.
The White Tiger King landed. He was relieved. He couldn’t use his phantom ability too much. Moreover his body was in extreme pain when he passed through the flames.
“I’ll eat him!”The Scorpion king saw that Dudian didn’t move. He quickly climbed over.
He climbed to Dudian’s side. The Scorpion tail behind his back was bent. He was about to make the last cut when he suddenly shouted. His body suddenly jumped back like lightning. At the same time, the sharp blades scattered on the ground, some of the intact blades were raised like willow branches and suddenly stabbed. However the scorpion king dodged in advance so he wasn’t hit.
He had experienced the sharpness of these blades. If not for his quick reaction, he would have been cut into pieces. Although he would not have died, but he was still seriously injured.
“Not Dead?”The White Tiger King endured the pain in his body and was shocked to see this scene.
Dudian slowly stood up. He felt the concussion in his brain. He couldn’t help but have lingering fear. If he hadn’t transformed his brain into a stone armor at the critical moment and transferred part of his memory to his neck, he would have died.
However, after this attack, he knew the opponent’s ability.
“Is it painful to pass through my flame?”Dudian looked at the white tiger king who was frowning. There was a trace of excitement in his eyes. It was an extremely rare ability. If he had time, he would be able to grasp it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1173
chapters.content:
Chapter 1173: Chapter 1162: Contraction
Translator:
549690339
“I didn’t kill you so you think you are very powerful?”White Tiger King retorted to Dudian’s provocation. But his heart slowly sank. He knew that Dudian had guessed the characteristics of his ability, moreover, the latter just happened to master the energy system ability. If he used the energy system ability as a defense then his next attack would be very difficult.
Dudian’s mouth curved into a smile. His body suddenly burned with surging flames. His body was like dry firewood under the bonfire. He curled up in the flames. The fire was vigorous and covered his body.
The White Tiger King’s face sank. He took a deep breath and said to the scorpion king: “He has seen through my ability. I’ll leave it to you.”
Scorpion king nodded. He knew that White Tiger King wasn’t trying to hide his ability. Generally speaking, a king could defeat another king but it would be very difficult to kill him, moreover he felt that this king was a bit strange. He had many different abilities. If he focused on defense then they wouldn’t be able to do anything.
Dudian looked at the Scorpion king next to him. The strange force field around the Scorpion King’s body made him vigilant. He secretly turned his skin into stone and his bones into stone bones, he tried to decompose the genes on the blade just like the illusion ability of the White Tiger King.
He didn’t see any clues when the White Tiger King attacked a few times. But when he finally understood his ability, he knew that it was difficult to see the uniqueness of his ability, he wasn’t even able to see whether he was using his ability or not. The interval of time was too short to be captured.
“The moment of the attack, the whole body’s genes will be separated like water!”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he pondered. This time he couldn’t use the perspective to observe the genes and directly simulate the learning. He could only understand the composition of the other party’s ability.
When science entered the quantum field, it had been proved that whether it was humans or other creatures, in fact, they were not a “Whole”. Just like the sand piled up by people, they seemed to be a whole, however, it was made up of countless “Sand particles”. There were naturally cracks in it. However, humans didn’t turn into loose sand like the sand people because of the biological magnetic field in their bodies.
Dudian was glad that he was a modern man so he could quickly think of the particularity and structure of the White Tiger King’s ability. If it was another king who didn’t have sufficient scientific knowledge, he wouldn’t be able to figure it out even if he racked his brains, he would only define it as ‘magical’. Most kings liked fighting and politics. Only a few of them would study scientific knowledge.
“Controlling the magnetic field in the body will allow the body to be separated for a short time! In the moment of attack, the body will become like countless loose particles. It will be able to dodge the attack but not the energy attack. The flame can burn all kinds of substances. Even water can be dried. However, no matter how sharp the knife is, it can not cut the water flow. So it can be immune to my sharp blade attack but will be burned by the Flame!”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. Although he had figured out the ability of the white tiger king, but to achieve this step, the core was to control his own biological magnetic field.
Suddenly, he thought of another thing.
What would happen if he infinitely contracted the density of his body?
It must be known that there was a lot of space in the cells of the organism. What would happen if the space was contracted? Would the body become smaller? That was for sure. But what would be different?
Dudian was eager to give it a try. For a king, ability was a kind of development of the potential of the body. The ability was ever-changing but it came from the body. Developing the body was equal to developing the ability!
Dudian used the flame to protect himself while he controlled the sharp blades to lay down a round shield. He controlled the sharp blades to feel the tiny units in the sharp blades. Then he felt the force field between the tiny units.
He didn’t have much time. It was like raising his hand. Soon he felt the force field between the tiny units in the sharp blades. But when he wanted to control the force field he found it was extremely difficult. The first thing he needed to do was to control the tiny units, he felt that he couldn’t exert any force. It was like an ordinary person controlling their ears. He felt that his own strength couldn’t reach there.
“The sharp blade doesn’t have my nerves. It is too difficult to control it. Try to control the arm.”Dudian gave up on controlling the sharp blade. He felt the tiny units and force field on his arm. This time the speed was faster, he immediately felt that countless tiny cells on his arm were moving slowly. He tried to control some of the cells and quickly controlled their movements.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He slowly tried to control the force field in his arm. After two minutes he slowly controlled the force field to create a gap in the middle of his arm. He used a sharp blade on his back to cut down, he aimed at the gap in the force field. He saw that the sharp blade didn’t touch anything. There was no blood.
“Success!”Dudian was surprised.
He pulled out the sharp blade. There was no change in his arm. It seemed that there were no cracks but only he could feel that part of the force field was separated.
“His ability is like this.”Dudian was excited. He tried to control every part of his body. Four to five minutes later, he could control the separation of the force field on his feet, chest, neck and other places, it was the same for his head. But after the separation of the force field on his brain, his mind would fall into a moment of confusion. It was as if his reaction was slow.
After repeated tests, Dudian’s excitement gradually faded. Although he had mastered the ability of the white tiger king in less than ten minutes, but he found that he wanted to use it as skillfully as the White Tiger King, it was very difficult. He needed a lot of time to practice. His current fastest speed was more than thirty seconds to separate a part of the force field from his body. However the White Tiger King was able to complete the battle in less than 0.01 seconds, moreover, his whole body was separated at the same time!
“He can seep into my body while separating my body. There is a way.”Dudian was deep in thought. The ability of the White Tiger King was not as easy to duplicate as that of the Raccoon King, he needed to study and practice for a long time. He thought for a moment but he didn’t think about it. He thought about the idea of compressing the space in his body.
He immediately tried to shrink the space between the cells so that the cell membrane tightly wrapped around the cell nucleus.
The process was a bit difficult. As the cell membrane shrank, his body felt waves of pain and numbness. Soon, he found that his body was shrinking at a speed visible to the naked eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 1174
chapters.content:
Chapter 1174: Chapter 1163: Poison
Translator:
549690339
The smaller the body, the bigger the world.
In Dudian’s line of sight, the size of the king of White Tiger and the king of Scorpions was constantly increasing. The vast metal room was also expanding. He felt that his body had almost doubled in size before he stopped compressing his body, at this time, he found that the force field in his body had become more solid. It was more difficult to separate the force field. However, the cutting edge that extended out of his body didn’t shrink because the structure of the cutting edge was not a body cell, in addition, the neurons inside were weak. Their control was limited so they couldn’t contract.
“There seems to be no change.”Dudian tried to move forward but didn’t feel any difference.
White Tiger King and Scorpion king saw Dudian’s fire shield approaching. They thought that Dudian was going to take the initiative to attack. They slowly retreated and waited for Dudian to run out of energy or expose a flaw.
“What are you doing?”A figure rushed over. It was a monster with a human head, snake body and many arms. There were broken wings on its back. At the moment the end of its tail was twisting and the layer of broken skin was peeled off.
“Be careful. This person’s ability is strange and changeable.”Scorpion king reminded.
The snake body monster looked at the fire shield. Its vertical pupils seemed to penetrate the flames and saw Dudian’s body. It was surprised and was about to open its mouth, suddenly there was a roar coming from the distance. It was the shriek of the undead. He turned his head and looked at Dudian. His face slightly changed, he said to the two: “Fire Dragon Lord can only restrain the undead. We need to kill it!”
White Tiger and Scorpion King turned to look at the battlefield in front of the mainframe. They found that there were two kings who had given up their magic bodies. Their magic bodies were resurrected like puppets. They showed far more violent fighting strength than before, they were besieging the Fire Dragon Lord.
“DAMN!”White Tiger King’s face was ugly. He turned his head to look at the approaching fire shield. There was a trace of cruelty in his eyes as he rushed forward. His body suddenly turned into an illusion.
“Huh?”Dudian noticed the white tiger king when he rushed over. He knew that it was the same old trick. He sneered in his heart. The flame on the blade suddenly shrank and the temperature instantly dropped.
The Sun Beast can control the heat, the temperature change allows him to control the flames and the ice, at this moment quickly absorb the heat, the flames disappear, the temperature drops TO-100 degrees below zero and still quickly absorb the temperature, in theory, he can control his blade by attaching absolute zero to the field of extreme cold!
But it’s hard to do it this extreme, like a normal person lifting a 200-pound boulder!
Sou!
The White Tiger King’s figure passed through the sharp blades, but the cold air from the sharp blades covered the White Tiger King’s body. In the next moment, more sharp blades arrived.
The White Tiger King’s pupils suddenly constricted, and his face was filled with shock. He hurriedly wanted to separate his body again to dodge, but he discovered that the cells in his body were frozen by the cold air. His movements were slow, and his speed of control had obviously slowed down!
“No!”The White Tiger King raised his sharp claws, and a metallic luster appeared on his body. His hair tensed up as he forcefully withstood the attacks of the messy sharp blades.
Pu Pu Pu!
Numerous sharp blades pierced into the White Tiger King’s body, and the sound of flesh being pierced and bones being cut rang out. However, when all the sharp blades were pulled back, the White Tiger King’s body crashed heavily onto the ground like a decaying leaf, a large amount of blood splattered out of his body, and he was on the verge of death. Even his head had been pierced seven or eight times by the sharp blades. If it wasn’t for his tenacious vitality, he would have died long ago.
“Damn it!”The Scorpion King and Snake Body King’s expressions changed when they saw this scene. They were both shocked and angry, and they quickly rushed forward to block the sharp blades that pounced over again, dragging the White Tiger King back.
However, Scorpion King’s body was also stabbed by four or five sharp blades. The Snake King’s tail was cut in two. The cut was neat and the pain of the broken tail made him clench his teeth.
“What is this thing? How can it be so sharp!”Snake King dragged the White Tiger King who was bleeding all over his body back. He looked at Dudian in shock and anger. Although he felt that the White Tiger King’s attack was very sharp when it was injured, but he didn’t expect that his strengthened scales would be hard to resist. It must be known that his snake scales could resist even missiles. He could even bounce laser weapons and bullets!
The surface of the scales was unusually smooth. The normal blade and claws would slip away when they hit it. He had used the snake’s smoothness to the extreme but he didn’t expect that it would be cut off by Dudian’s sharp blade. It was simply too terrifying!
In fact, even Dudian himself didn’t realize that he had already used the splitter’s blade to the extreme. The sharp edge of the blade was constantly strengthened. It was beyond the level of a three-star legendary monster.
“Quick, let him go!”Scorpion king shouted.
Snake King looked down and was shocked. He quickly let go of the White Tiger King. The wounds on the White Tiger King’s body hadn’t healed yet. The blood that was flowing out of the White Tiger King’s body had turned from red to black, it gave off an abnormally foul smell, making people feel nauseous. The White Tiger King’s snow-white hair had also turned black, and in just a few breaths, it had spread all over his body!
“Is this sharp blade poisonous?”The snake-body king screamed and quickly swam away from the White Tiger King. Suddenly, he remembered that he had also been stabbed by the sharp blade, and his expression instantly became extremely ugly. His arm suddenly turned into a scimitar, he suddenly slashed a few meters away from the broken tail and blood spurted out from the wound. However, his muscles quickly contracted and stopped the blood. Black spots appeared on the red flesh inside the broken tail bit by bit, then, it quickly expanded. If it was a little later, he would have cut off even more snake bodies!
He was shocked and broke out in cold sweat. If he did not habitually control the flesh near the wound to share with his body, the poison would have flowed through his body along with the blood!
Thinking up to this point, he looked at Scorpion beside him and saw that he had already taken off his shell. He couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief and said angrily, “He has such a terrifying poison, why didn’t you say so earlier?”
“I also didn’t expect him to suddenly injure Fantasy King.”Scorpion king smiled bitterly.
At this time, the forehead of the white tiger king on the ground cracked open and a bug covered in flames crawled out. Some of the flames were black and the bug bounced to the side the moment it crawled out. Suddenly, its body shook violently, in the next moment, an even smaller flame insect crawled out from the end of the flame insect and quickly crawled to the empty space beside it. It raised its head like a poisonous snake, and a sharp voice came from the flames, “My demon body is useless. I Can’t help you here. I’ll retreat First!”
The Scorpion King and the Snake King looked at him with complicated eyes. Greed flashed in the depths of their eyes, but it was restrained. The Scorpion King said in a low voice, “You go. Be careful.”
The blazing bug seemed to know that it was not a good place to stay, so it did not say anything. It quickly turned around and disappeared into the metal wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 1175
chapters.content:
Chapter 1175: Chapter 1164: Devil Emperor
Translator:
549690339
“The two of us can’t do anything to him.”The king of White Tiger left, the king of scorpions sighed: “He has mastered at least three ultimate abilities: temperature control, sharp blades and poison. If we focus on defense then it will be very difficult to hurt him.”
Snake King’s face was ugly. Although he had his own unique abilities but Dudian’s three abilities were equally difficult to deal with. It was not easy to deal with either of them, snake King was a difficult existence to deal with. He was a bit conflicted. If he admitted defeat then it would be too much of a loss. Moreover the pressure on fire dragon’s side was doubled because of him. It was equivalent to double losses!
“Go!”
Suddenly, an angry roar came from behind.
The Snake King and Scorpion King’s bodies shook. They glanced at the battlefield behind them and saw that fire dragon lord was covered in blood. The Flames covering his entire body were even stronger than before. There was a nine-tailed cat monster in his claws.., he suddenly threw out a ball of flames and sent a pitch-black human figure flying. He turned around and charged towards the metal room’s dome above his head. His body quickly entered it.
“What? !”The Scorpion King and the Snake King were shocked. They did not expect the Fire Dragon Lord to be defeated.
At this moment, they suddenly noticed that in the distance, other than the ferocious human-shaped zombie, there were three huge demon bodies beside it. Each of the demon bodies looked like a huge and terrifying monster. Their foreheads were cracked, their bodies were emitting an aura of death. With the Fire Dragon Lord’s departure, they all turned their attention to this place.
Both of them didn’t dare to stay any longer. They shrank their bodies and drilled into the metal wall above their heads.
“Do you want to leave?”Dudian noticed the situation in the distance. He saw that the two of them were ready to leave. He immediately took action. His body was covered in ice, he cut the Snake King that was closest to him.
The Snake King was shocked. It turned around and sprayed out a black poisonous mist. The mist touched Dudian’s sharp blade and corroded it. The edge of the blade became dull.
The snake king quickly shed its skin and plunged into the metal wall.
The Scorpion King left its shell and quickly climbed into the metal wall. It seemed as if it had sunk into a silver swamp and disappeared.
Dudian felt a bit regretful as he saw that he didn’t leave them behind. However, he had seen the ability of a king to escape. It was very difficult to chase and kill him. Unless the other side would fight him to the death. Otherwise, even if he couldn’t win.., there was a high possibility that he could escape.
Roar!
At this time, a hoarse roar came from the front. It was filled with malevolence and brutality.
Dudian was startled as he saw the humanoid undeads coming over. The three king undeads behind it had been infected by the undeads. Their eyes were bloodthirsty, their bodies were covered with the rotten smell of undeads.
“Lin Changsheng!”Dudian took a deep breath, he shouted: “I know you can control it. Don’t forget that I Can Too! You said that I will help you to force the Fire Dragon Lord away so tell me the way to deal with the undeads. Now the Fire Dragon Lord has left. It’s time for you to fulfill your promise!”
The terrifying undeads suddenly stopped as he spoke. Its ferocious face was still staring at Dudian as if it was trying to restrain something.
At the same time, a ray of light shot out from the distance. It was Lin Changsheng’s shadow. He was wearing an exquisite blue suit, indifferently smiled: “I’m talking about forcing the Fire Dragon Lord back. But he didn’t retreat. He just left here and returned to the surface. He will join hands with the Devil Emperor to make a comeback. They won’t miss this opportunity. My black wind alone isn’t enough to repel them. I need your help.”
Dudian was furious: “You are going back on your word!”
“If you want to think like that then it’s up to you.”Lin Changsheng smiled.
Dudian clenched his fists. He was angry: “Aren’t you afraid that I will join hands with them to deal with you?”
“I can’t resist them anyway. It doesn’t matter if there is one more. Since there will be death then we will die together.”Lin Changsheng said indifferently.
Dudian clenched his teeth. He was extremely angry. He knew that Lin Changsheng was holding his weak point. Although he knew that the possibility of him holding the solution to the undead was very small, but.., thinking of Aisha who was wandering in the unknown wilderness at the moment, he wanted to vent his anger but he suppressed it.
After a moment of silence, Dudian looked up at Lin Changsheng and said: “Alright, if they come again, I will help you to restrain the Fire Dragon Lord. If you go back on your words again, no one can save you!”
Lin changsheng indifferently said: “I always keep my word...”
Dudian turned around as if he was too lazy to listen to him. He slowly walked to the end of the room and disappeared into the wall.
“There won’t be a next time.”Lin Changsheng looked at Dudian’s disappearing back. His eyes flashed with a trace of killing intent. Soon he regained his indifference and his figure gradually faded away. The ferocious undeads suddenly growled and pounced on the two kings who were on the ground.
On the ground, Fire Dragon threw the nine-tailed cat to the side. Then he saw the scorpion king and Snake King crawling out from the other side. His face was ugly, he didn’t expect that this battle didn’t hurt Lin Changsheng. Moreover, he had lost four of his generals.
He slowly undid his demon body and returned to his human form. The other three kings also undid their demon bodies and looked at each other with ugly expressions.
“You didn’t finish off that King of the Federation?”The Fire Dragon Lord’s gaze was gloomy as he looked at the scorpion king and Snake King.
The Snake King’s heart skipped a beat, he bitterly smiled, “Fire Dragon Lord, I just rushed over. Before I had the time to act, the illusion king was finished off by that kid. This kid is a bit strange and has mastered several ultimate abilities. I really can’t do anything to him.”
Scorpion king quickly said, “Fire Dragon Lord, this king is no weaker than the light king under the Devil Emperor. We are no match for him. Even the illusion king was easily killed by him.”
The corner of Fire Dragon Lord’s mouth twitched. He wanted to curse, but he held back. He knew the illusion King’s strength. Among the many kings of Fire Dragon Country, the illusion king was considered a strong existence. The latter could kill the illusion king in a short time, it was obvious that he wasn’t an ordinary person.
Sou!
At this time, a black figure came from afar and landed in front of them.
“What? You failed?”The figure landed. It was a black-robed youth. The hood on his head was blown off by the wind, revealing a handsome face. His long eyebrows carried a hint of melancholy, he looked like a young noble in the garden.
“Demon Emperor!”The eyes of the scorpion king, Snake King, and the nine-tailed cat king, who had returned to his young female form, narrowed when they saw him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1176
chapters.content:
Chapter 1176: Chapter 1165: father
Translator:
549690339
“HMPH!”The Torch Dragon Lord snorted and said, “This Lin Changsheng has lived for more than 200 years and is the oldest divine embryo. He is indeed difficult to deal with. If not for you worrying too much, we would have destroyed his mechanical heart together!”
The black-robed youth raised his brows slightly, he said indifferently, “What, is brother torch dragon venting his anger on me? We have already agreed beforehand that I will guard the outside in case he detonates the nuclear bomb and self-destructs. You led your men to attack. Now that you have failed, is it my fault?”
Zhulong’s expression was ugly. He was indeed the one who had proposed this matter, but the reason was that he was worried that if the demon lord attacked and Lin Changsheng was killed by him, the mechanical heart would fall into his hands.., this thing was a technological item created by the extraterrestrial demonic insects and was extremely precious. In other words, grasping the mechanical heart was equivalent to grasping the power of half of the Federation!
Their goal was not to kill Lin Changsheng, but to seize the federation in Lin Changsheng’s hands. They also wanted to get rid of Lin Changsheng, this great enemy, as a side gift.
However, Lin Changsheng was indeed worthy of being an old monster who had lived for more than two hundred years. He was crafty and cunning. He did not expect that he could actually cultivate such a terrifying zombie, which was close to the limit of his life. It would not be an exaggeration to say that he was a physical Aragami!
“This matter has exceeded my expectations. For now, we can only attack together.”The Torch Dragon Lord did not retaliate against the demon lord’s words. He suppressed the anger in his heart, he said in a deep voice, “This old dog Lin Changsheng has cultivated a zombie that is close to the limit of his life. He has fed God knows how much flesh and virus crystals and cultivated a powerful king. Now, three kings have been infected by that zombie and become its corpse puppet. Before I left, I saw two demon bodies on the ground. I reckon that they have also become the corpse puppet of that Zombie!”
“Although he doesn’t have any mechanical warriors, the power he has now is not much weaker than ours. It’s almost impossible for me to destroy the mechanical heart alone!”
The demon lord frowned and said, “If I go in and force him into a desperate situation, he will detonate the nuclear bomb and perish together. Who will stop him?”
The fire dragon Lord said, “Don’t you still have a few kings under you on the battlefield? Just transfer them over.”
The demon lord shook his head and said, “We need them on the frontlines to hold them back. We have to think long and hard about this matter. I feel that it’s not safe to counterattack now. Now that our positions have been exposed, there’s no need to hide anything. As for Lin Changsheng’s trump cards, we have basically figured them out. What’s next is a head-on war of attrition. He’s entrenched in this machine main city, and this is his heart. We can send people to guard this place and hold him here. Then, the rest of you will follow me to attack the federation first and completely control it in our hands. At that time, we won’t have to worry about anything. We can also send an army to attack and use all our strength to destroy him!”
The Fire Dragon Lord was slightly startled. After thinking for a moment, his eyes flashed and he said, “Then, who do you think will stay here to guard and who will take over the Federation?”
The demon emperor said indifferently, “In my opinion, Brother Fire Dragon has fought with that zombie before and has experience in dealing with it. It is most suitable for me to stay here. I can go and take over the federation. After unifying the federation, I can come over with the United Army to help.”
Zhulong lord sneered and said, “According to what you said, aren’t you asking me to be your guard, to pin down Lin Changsheng, and then to let you annex the federation and Pluck all the fruits? I would be wasting my efforts instead?”
The Demon Emperor raised his brows and said, “I don’t have that intention. After the federation is reclaimed, we will still follow the previous rules and split it 50-50. Moreover, the true strength of the federation is the mechanical heart. This thing is in Lin Changsheng’s hands. If you guard the mechanical heart, are you afraid that the federation will fall into My Hands?”
“Although the mechanical heart is powerful, it’s still an inanimate object. The federation that you’ve recovered is filled with billions of people. If you include the commoners of your empire, it will bring you benefits that are not inferior to the mechanical heart.”The torch dragon lord coldly said, “I’ll go recover the Federation while you hold Lin Changsheng back here. If you’re unwilling, then forget it. I’ve already helped once, and I’ve done my best!”
The Demon Emperor frowned and was silent for a moment. He then nodded and said, “Alright, I will stay here and guard this old dog.”
Torch Dragon Lord heaved a sigh of relief when he saw that the demon Emperor agreed. He then said, “Since that’s the case, there’s no time to lose. I will leave first. Send a message to your subordinates so that there won’t be any misunderstandings.”
The Demon Emperor nodded.
Torch Dragon Lord immediately led the three kings and left, disappearing into the horizon.
The demon lord looked at their departing figures and narrowed his eyes. A cold light flashed across his eyes as he turned around to look at the underground base, “A zombie that has evolved to the limit of its physical body? I wonder how much it will allow me to evolve if I eat it. Perhaps... I can reach the height of my father?”
..
..
In another corner of the underground base, a black shadow emerged from the metal ground. It was like a black shadow that was elongated when sunlight shone on the surface of the ground. It was extremely concealed. There was no heat source, no smell, and no sound.
Two dark golden pupils suddenly emerged from the Black Shadow. They scanned the surroundings. After they saw that there was no danger, they quickly rushed forward. In the blink of an eye, they were thousands of meters away from the place, the surrounding ground was empty. There were no hidden buildings. The nuclear bomb had leveled the ground. The ground was still hot and cracked. Dudian saw the broken buildings. They were distorted in the high temperature and were on the verge of collapse, the empty windows were like the eye sockets of a skeleton.
Dudian hid in a broken supermarket building.
Dudian checked the surroundings to make sure that there was no one around. He took out his wristwatch. He was surprised to see that Lin Changsheng didn’t call him. Was it possible that the Fire Dragon Lord and the others didn’t counterattack?
In his opinion, after the Fire Dragon Lord and the others escaped from the underground base, they would have to kill their way back. Moreover, it was possible that they would join forces with the Devil Emperor and the other kings under the Devil Emperor. After all.., their purpose in coming to the federation was to destroy Lin Changsheng. If they retreated because of a zombie then wouldn’t the alliance of the two countries be a joke?
“Lin Changsheng didn’t ask me to help. It seems they don’t plan to counterattack...”Dudian pondered for a moment. He felt that this peace was only temporary and very short, he could seize the opportunity to absorb the new abilities he had learned in the underground base.
“With my perspective ability and the fast evolution of the divine embryo physique, as long as I’m not killed, I will become stronger and stronger. The current me is much stronger than ordinary kings. I should be able to kill the blood thorn king with one slash!”Dudian’s eyes lit up, he felt that his future was bright. At the same time, he vaguely understood why the Devil Emperor would join Fire Dragon to attack Lin Changsheng.

chapters.title: Chapter 1177
chapters.content:
Chapter 1177: Chapter 1,166: Rapid Progress
Translator:
549690339
Although the Demon Emperor and the two dragon lords both had the divine embryo physique and could evolve rapidly, constantly learning new abilities, there was still a difference in strength between them!
The more abilities they mastered, the more pinnacle they were, the closer their bodies were to perfection, close to the omnipotent God!
However, no matter how deep and rich the accumulation of the Demon Emperor and the two Dragon Lords was, they were far inferior to Lin Changsheng! With Lin Changsheng’s IQ and the knowledge he had learned from the main brain for more than 200 years, he would be able to evolve into countless abilities as soon as he got the body of a god. His knowledge reserves far exceeded that of any other person in the world!
If it wasn’t for the fact that Dudian’s body had a heart defect, the part of Lin Changsheng’s consciousness that got his body had already developed to the point of being close to a god. He would have become the first person in the world!
This was also the reason why the Devil Emperor and the two Dragon Lords didn’t join forces with Lin Changsheng. The threat of Lin Changsheng was the greatest among them.
“Unfortunately, when I defeated Lin Changsheng’s consciousness, I didn’t know that my body had such a fast evolution characteristic. His consciousness didn’t have the idea to develop my body in advance. Otherwise, I would have been aware of it... I think that to him, getting my body is the most important step. As for how to develop it, I don’t even need to think about it.”
“Now his memory is gradually settling down. I have forgotten a lot of his memories. If I get the ability like Crimson Moon, I can flip through his memories. I can use the advanced knowledge in his memory to stimulate the potential of my body. At present, I can only use the part of Knowledge I remember to stimulate my body...”
Dudian controlled his body to master the Phantom ability of the White Tiger King as he recalled Lin Changsheng’s memory.
“Gene storage...”
“Cell fusion pile...”
A lot of advanced knowledge appeared in Dudian’s mind. It was Lin Changsheng’s research on biology. The Terras Consortium and the Rockefeller consortium were focused on studying the secrets of the undead and the monster’s body, both of them belonged to the biological class. They were extremely thorough in their biological structure. All the research materials were stored in the mainframe and stored in Lin Changsheng’s brain.
Although the biological knowledge carried by the part of Lin Changsheng’s consciousness was incomplete, but there were some complete knowledge. Some of them had been forgotten but the rest was still very rich, it was enough for Dudian to study it for a while.
“Split brain cells, split personality...”
Dudian used the knowledge of Lin Changsheng to try to split the spongy body in his brain. He copied the memory into two parts. Soon, another head grew out of his shoulder. However, the facial structure of this head was relatively rough, there were only simple eyes, nose, ears, no eyebrows. The color of his skin was very strange. It was yellow like skin. At this moment, he opened his mouth and spoke in a sharp voice:
“I actually succeeded!”
Dudian’s original head tilted his head and looked at the second brain on his shoulder: “The thinking seems to be connected. The memory seems to be shared. It seems... is it equal to two of me thinking at the same time?”
“In this case, my thinking ability can be doubled!”The second brain on his shoulder continued to speak. However, his voice was sharp and it seemed that his vocal cords were not fully developed.
Dudian didn’t carefully construct the second brain. After all, he would have to put it back into his body when he finished using it. It was impossible for him to walk around with two heads at any time.
“The three-headed six-armed God in the ancient myth thought that it was the imagination of the ancient people. I didn’t expect that after the Cataclysm by relying on evolution and genetic control, he could really achieve this step. It is far more than that!”Dudian muttered to himself, he felt that his body was becoming less and less like that of a human. In the past he had entered the devil’s body and felt that he had gradually become a monster. But now he had a deep understanding and control of the genes. He felt that he was getting closer and closer to God!
The Bible once said that God had no face, body and image. God was the almighty Lord.
He felt that it was not wrong. He could change his face and body at will. He didn’t need to be fixed on a specific image. The definition of the body was not as narrow as the definition of a human.
Moreover, he could even transform his body. He didn’t need oxygen, light and heat, and he didn’t need to eat. He could regenerate his fingers like an ice worm. He could survive in any harsh environment.
“It is said that God is omnipotent. My current body is close to God. If I really become an omnipotent God, I wonder... can I help her solve the zombie virus and let her recover?”Dudian thought of Aisha, his heart was boiling. Once again, he felt that time was pressing. He restrained his thoughts and stopped wasting time. He began to seriously think and practice his ability.
His second brain controlled part of his body to practice the phantom ability of the White Tiger King.
His main brain used Lin Changsheng’s knowledge to control another part of his body to practice the new ability. It could be considered as self-development.
“I use the solar beast’s ability to absorb heat. The heat is stored in my body but it is not well used. I can create a special ‘nucleus’in my cells to store heat. The heat can be transformed into my physical strength and kinetic energy. It can also be gathered together and compressed into light energy...”Dudian thought, he controlled his body to slowly transform.
He completely analyzed the structure of the Red Crystal formed by the Sun Beast’s ability on his forehead and used this structure to cover his entire body. He slowly formed a blood-red crystal armor on the surface of his body, which was as smooth as scales.
Then, he released the heat stored in his body through the crystal.
Puff! Puff! Puff!
Beams of light shot out from all the blood-red crystal scales on his body and scattered in all directions. As it was his first attempt, he injected less heat into it, so the beams of light were extremely weak. They were as thin as needles and disappeared in a flash, it didn’t cause any substantial damage.
“If I compress the heat energy to a limit, then I can shoot out high-intensity rays... by the way, I can use the refraction method to increase the power. Previously, there was only one crystal on my forehead which couldn’t be refracted. But this time it is different...”
Dudian’s eyes were getting brighter and brighter. Every time he thought of an idea, he would succeed after trying it. It meant that his strength had improved by a big step!
Soon, he began to create complex three-dimensional ridges inside the red crystal. He refracted the thermal light inside the single crystal. The limit of this process was nine times and the power was increased by more than ten times! After the refraction was released from the single crystal, Dudian let the surface of the crystal grow into a concave crystal. The rays emitted were reflected on the concave crystal and refracted again!
Bang!
A stone by his feet was pierced through!
Dudian looked at the black hole which was as thick as a finger. His eyes were shocked. The heat energy he used wasn’t high and there was no difference from before. But the result was completely different. The same heat energy had hit the stone before.., it was like a gentle breeze. There wasn’t a trace left behind. But this time it directly pierced through the finger-sized hole. This was just a reconstruction of the crystal!
If he were to use all his strength to release rays that could penetrate the bones of kings, how terrifying would it be after being refracted? !

chapters.title: Chapter 1178
chapters.content:
Chapter 1178: Chapter 1,167: Counterattack
Translator:
549690339
On the frontlines of the Federation, the Federation Army and the Imperial Army were engaged in a bloody battle. The corpses piled up like a mountain, and blood flowed like a river.
Crimson Moon and the radiant king were forced out of the federation city by the numerous creator’s mecha and fled back to the rear of the imperial army to rest. Although Crimson Moon had kidnapped the federation chairman, it did not have much of an effect, the federation’s military power had already been split up by the four major consortia. At this time, the people had also seen the hidden foundations of the four major consortia, which were spread across all levels of the federation.
The four major consortia led their armies to face the Empire’s army. Lin Changsheng mobilized the creator’s mecha to reinforce them, to contain crimson moon and the radiant king, so that they did not dare to show their faces on the battlefield.
This was the federation’s hinterland after all, so there was no need to worry about the issue of energy supply. The artillery fire was not extinguished. On this day, the people saw a golden-red sky that they had never seen before. That was the color of the artillery fire.
The imperial army was struggling to hold on. At every moment, a large number of steam airships would fall, and the land warships would be destroyed.
All sorts of strange limbs were piled up on the battlefield. Most of the soldiers had died in their demonic forms, and the broken limbs still maintained their demonic forms. This made the battlefield seem like a demonic purgatory in an alternate dimension.
“Has the demon Emperor and the others not succeeded yet?”In the military tent at the rear of the imperial army, the Radiant King looked at Crimson Moon, who was sitting on top of a golden saber. Crimson Moon was dressed in a blood-red robe, and her beautiful face was as cold as blood.
“The nuclear bomb has already been launched. The Federation Army’s hot weapons bombing stopped for a while, so they should have been affected. Their side should have already attacked the core machine by now. Let’s Wait a little longer.”Crimson Moon’s eyes were ice-cold, her voice was also exceptionally cold, as if it was seeping with blood.
The radiant king nodded slightly, sighed, and said, “I didn’t expect the Troll Federation to hide so deeply. There are actually so many king level trolls.”
Crimson Moon’s expression was cold and indifferent. She was completely unmoved. Although she had been forced out by the creator god Mech, only she herself knew how much effort she had really put in.
Suddenly, the communication device on her wrist lit up. She looked at the name of the message and frowned slightly. She quickly picked it up and said, “Your Majesty, are you done on your end?”
“Demon Emperor?”The King of light immediately pricked up his ears.
“Fire Dragon Lord is going to meet up with you. You guys cooperate with them to attack the federation first. As for the specific situation, Fire Dragon Lord will tell you when he arrives.”Demon Emperor’s tone was indifferent, as if he did not like to talk too much, after that, he directly hung up.
Crimson Moon frowned slightly and fell into deep thought.
The King of light at the side glanced at him as if nothing had happened and said with a smile, “It seems that your Majesty’s plan seems to have gone wrong, but it doesn’t affect anything. When Fire Dragon Lord arrives, we can counterattack.”
A strange look flashed across Crimson Moon’s eyes as she nodded and said, “That’s right.”
Not long after, the Fire Dragon Lord led the Three Kings to the military camp at the rear of the Empire’s army to meet Crimson Moon and the King of light. Seeing that there were only the two of them here, she could not help but ask, “Are the two of you the only ones left?”
Crimson Moon said indifferently, “The others are all dead.”
The three kings beside the fire dragon Lord raised their brows slightly, slightly dissatisfied with Crimson Moon’s attitude toward the Fire Dragon Lord. However, when they thought that he was a king beside the demon Emperor and was not loyal to the Fire Dragon Lord, they could not argue with her.
“It seems that old dog Lin Changsheng has really turned his nest into a turtle shell.”The Fire Dragon Lord snorted coldly, his eyes flashing with a cold light, he said, “The demon lord should have already told you guys. From now on, you guys listen to my command and take down the federation as soon as possible. Then, you can go and reinforce the demon lord. Do you have any objections?”
Crimson Moon and the light king looked at each other. The light king smiled kindly and said, “The demon lord has already informed us. We will help you take down the Troll Federation.”
The fire dragon lord nodded slightly and said, “In that case, follow me. We will capture the leader of the bandits first and let the Army hold them off from the front. We will attack the enemy’s rear and destroy them in one go!”
Crimson Moon and the Lord of light nodded. No objections.
..
..
In the border city behind the federal army, the core representatives of the four major consortia formed an alliance legion here, closely watching the battlefield and discussing strategies to deal with it. Now, the four major consortia had become the main force of the war. Although they suppressed the imperial army, their weaknesses were also exposed. Every important operation was discussed and decided by a meeting before a vote was taken.
There was no unified voice in the meeting room. Every time, there was a different voice. Although the Terras Consortium’s Heslodi was authorized by Lin Changsheng, the effect was not great.
