Although the people of the federation worshipped the god of Technology, Lin Changsheng.., however, something like “Veneration”did not seem to be worth much. When it came to personal profits and losses, Lin Changsheng’s words were no longer effective.
Although Lin Changsheng tried to use his ability to control all virtual instruments to intimidate the three financial groups, it still did not have much of an effect. After all, machines could not completely dominate the world. Otherwise.., there was no need to care about the wishes of the three financial groups.
It was precisely because of the internal discord that the battlefield orders were transmitted slowly, resulting in the remnants of the imperial army that had been killed countless times by the traps of the peace circle still being able to survive.
“I suggest activating the blue weapon and directly bombing the rear of the demons to cut off their supplies!”
“I think we should use the creator’s mech. With the power of the Creator’s mech, it is enough to flatten the demons, and we will not lose any of our soldiers.”
“I think we can send the monster mech to the plains in the west. We can launch a charge there and heavily injure the demons!”
In the meeting room, everyone discussed and suggested sending different military forces.
“The Monster Mech of our Rockfield Consortium is still under development. It is not stable on the battlefield. Unless it is absolutely necessary, it is better not to invest. I suggest direct missile bombing.”
“HMPH, how can there be so many missiles? Moreover, what if the missile bombing accidentally hurts our own army?”
“Stop arguing. Let’s vote on it.”
The secretaries and sergeants at the edge of the circle table silently watched these upper-class people arguing endlessly. They were impatient and wanted to make a decision on their behalf. However, they also knew that they were just a small fry.., i don’t think so.
As soon as the vote was decided, it was sent to the front, and just as they were about to vote on the next plan, there was an urgent message from the front.
“The demon king is on the move. Request to send the Genesis Mech to battle! !”
The whole conference room was alarmed, but this time the decision was swift, and the same voice rang out: “Permission granted!”
..
..
The Fire Dragon Lord took Crimson Moon and the light king, along with three other kings, and flanked them into the rear command camp of the Union Army, where they descended from the sky and slaughtered. They approached noiselessly, suddenly appeared, plunged the command camp into chaos, and many generals and chiefs of staff who had built up their illustrious achievements fled in all directions under the cover of a large number of soldiers, the four-star Athena mecha that was sent out in an emergency had yet to be activated when it was destroyed by an unknown strange tentacle. The mecha operators inside the mecha were smashed into meat paste before they could react.

chapters.title: Chapter 1179
chapters.content:
Chapter 1179: The final volume, if only life was like the first time, chapter 1,168: Occupy
Translator:
549690339
When the command center was overrun by Fire Dragon Master and the others, more than a dozen Genesis god mechas whizzed over. Fire Dragon Master and the others immediately abandoned the remaining generals in the camp and went up to the surrounding Genesis God mechas.
“Fire!”
Fire Dragon Master’s entire body was demonized, and his scales expanded explosively. In mid-air, he transformed into a fire dragon that was more than a hundred meters long. He bared his fangs and brandished his claws, causing the countless soldiers below to be stunned. At this moment, he had taken the initiative to charge towards a creator’s mech. In front of his demonized gigantic dragon body, the 15.7-meter tall creator’s mech was like a toy. He had actually opened his mouth and swallowed one of it, chewing it in his mouth.
This savage scene not only shocked the general and the ordinary soldiers below who were unable to escape, it also caused the expressions of the other kings who were fighting with him to change in shock. This was especially so for Crimson Moon and the light king. They had personally fought against the Creator’s mech before.., compared to the other kings who had only seen things from the information, it was even more profound. Other than the slightly inferior operation, the performance of the mech itself was definitely not inferior to a real king!
Moreover, once the creator god Mech self-destructed, its lethality was enough to heavily injure a king. This was also the reason why a King was unwilling to fight against the creator god Mech.
“Be careful of it self-destructing!”The light king immediately warned. He was worried that fire dragon master would be heavily injured.
Torch Dragon Lord gave a cold snort. Suddenly, he opened his mouth and spat out a piece of black metal. The surface of the metal was rugged, and one could vaguely see that it was in the shape of a long strip. In some places, one could see that it was the armor shoulder of the creator’s mecha and the laser tube.
However, this charred metal lump could not be associated with the dazzling supreme mecha, the creator’s God, whose entire body was covered in gold.
“This...”the radiant King’s pupils constricted, and a hint of shock flashed in the depths of his eyes. Even if he used his full strength, he would not be able to destroy a god of creation mecha with such a crushing force. Moreover, from the looks of Fire Dragon Lord.., it seemed as though it was effortless.
Crimson Moon saw this scene, and her eyes narrowed slightly. She clenched her fingers slightly, and the corners of her mouth slowly curved into an imperceptible arc. She turned around and threw herself into the battle on the other side, taking the initiative to restrain a god of creation mecha.., using the Dark Domain, the battle was difficult to resolve.
“These metal lumps that old dog Lin created are really hard. They almost hit my teeth!”The burnt black metal lumps that fire dragon lord spat out shot onto the ground like meteorites, creating a large crater and sending a large amount of dust flying, he moved the bones in his mouth and jaw, shook his head, and turned around to continue pouncing at the other creator’s mecha. At the same time, he swept his tail horizontally, knocking away the five creator’s mecha that were surrounding him from the side.
Two of the creator mechas swung their high frequency particle sabers at his fire dragon tail. However, as soon as the high frequency particle sabers got close to the flames on his tail, they melted like ice and snow, and then they were swept away together.
Fire Dragon Master opened his mouth and swallowed another creator Mech, chewing hard.
“HMPH, do you really think that I only know fire ability? Old Dog Lin, these things that you created can only bully these primitive people.”Fire Dragon Master’s face was full of disdain. He was able to easily deal with the seven to eight creator mechas surrounding him, the particle weapons and special rays that these god of creation mechas released were all easily blocked by him.
The Fire Dragon Kingdom had long investigated the information of the god of creation mechas in detail. They were also aware of the federation’s many high-tech weapons. To him, as long as he knew the principles of these weapons, he would be able to simulate them with his own body, or perhaps he would evolve the corresponding restraining ability.
Furthermore, he had reached the limits of his fire ability. Just his fire ability alone was enough to break through hundreds and thousands of abilities and technologies, allowing the creator’s mech’s body to be sturdy and the system to be advanced.., however, under the terrifying corrosion of the Flames released from his body, all of them failed. The machine had its limits, and the high temperature that he released had already exceeded the limits of the Creator’s Mech’s heat resistance!
Far Beyond!
Theoretically speaking, he could make his body’s temperature rise infinitely, but once it exceeded a certain limit, his body would also be affected. His consciousness would be burned and blurred by the flames, and his brain would stop thinking, he would live in a form similar to “Things”.
At that time, his body would lose control, and the temperature would rise infinitely, until his body could not bear it anymore. When it rose to a certain height, it would completely vanish from the world!
This was his strongest trump card, and also his life-saving ability. It was also the reason why the Demon Emperor did not dare to touch him lightly.
“So Strong!”
The snake-bodied king was entangled with a creator’s mech, and the battle was somewhat strenuous. The poison that he specialized in had lost its effectiveness in front of the creator’s mech, and he could only rely on his own strength to engage in hand-to-hand combat. The battle was somewhat tiring.., when he noticed the battle on the other side of Fire Dragon Lord, he could not help but be shocked. Although he had long known that Fire Dragon Lord was very strong, much stronger than kings like them, he did not expect the gap to be so huge!
Under the siege of seven or eight creator god Mechas, Fire Dragon Lord kept swallowing one creator god Mech after another, spitting out pieces of metal. The number of creator god Mechas on the scene quickly decreased.
“Is this the power of a demon emperor...”the light king was fighting fiercely with one creator god mech while paying attention to fire dragon lord. To him, if he used all his strength, he could instantly finish off this creator god Mech in front of him, however, he did not need to reveal his full strength at this time. Moreover, he knew that even if he were to go all out, he would only be able to deal with two or three of them. He was far inferior to the Torch Dragon Lord who treated the world creator mecha like a toy.
In less than ten minutes, the number of world creator mecha present had dropped to two or three. The pilots inside no longer had any desire to fight. They turned around and fled. However, they were chased by the Torch Dragon Lord and were quickly destroyed one after another.
“Attack the city!”Fire Dragon Lord roared into the sky and swam into the city first.
Crimson Moon and the others followed closely behind.
A large number of military Athena Mechas, Dragon Knight Mechas, and so on rushed out of the city. However, in front of Fire Dragon Lord, their formation was immediately broken, and they could not withstand a single blow.
That night, the federation’s border city was declared to have fallen, and the imperial army entered in large numbers.
The next day, under the leadership of Fire Dragon Lord and a group of kings, the Imperial Army occupied one city after another. The federation citizens inside were controlled by the invading imperial army. The ordinary civilians all surrendered, and the imperial army took over the city defense.
On the third day, the headquarters of the Milan Financial Group, one of the four major financial groups, was destroyed by the Torch Dragon Lord and announced that they had submitted.
On the fourth day, the Terras Financial Group, which was the only one of the four major financial groups that was struggling to survive, was completely destroyed by the Torch Dragon Lord, Crimson Moon, and the other kings. Blood flowed like a river in the capital city, and the lake island in the city, which was once the headquarters of the Terras Financial Group that was worth tens of billions of dollars, was completely destroyed, it was razed to the ground, and the scenic villas designed by countless famous teachers were destroyed. Only corpses littered the ground, washing the entire land in blood. It was extremely desolate.
On the fifth day.
The Torch Dragon Lord, Crimson Moon, and the others, accompanied by the military, business, and other top leaders of the various worlds who had submitted to the three major corporations, held a conference to announce the occupation of the entire federation!
As for the reform and the naming of new names, the Torch Dragon Lord did not do it. He would take it slowly in the future.
After occupying the federation, he cut off all the resources in the mainframe city and froze all the nuclear weapons in the nearby cities!
Next, it was time to attack Lin Changsheng’s core lair!

chapters.title: Chapter 1180
chapters.content:
Chapter 1180: Chapter 1,169: decisive battle
Translator:
549690339
“So they are planning to cut off Lin Changsheng’s escape route.”
Dudian saw the Fire Dragon Lord and others appear on the battlefield. No wonder they didn’t immediately counterattack. They wanted to cut off Lin Changsheng’s escape route and force him into a desperate situation!
Although Lin Changsheng could freely travel in the virtual world, the mainframe was his foundation. In the virtual world, Lin Changsheng was the master. However, many instruments still needed to be activated by humans, many machines that could be independently operated by Lin Changsheng could also be manually shut down, cut off the energy, and permanently refrigerate!
This was Lin Changsheng’s fatal weakness. At this moment, in front of the Fire Dragon Lord and the Devil Emperor, there was nowhere to hide and he was completely exposed.
In the next few days, the Fire Dragon Lord led Crimson Moon and others to occupy the federation. When the chairman’s meeting was held, Dudian knew that they were going to start to attack Lin Changsheng, and Lin Changsheng was bound to call him again.
“This is the last bloody battle.”A cold light flashed in Dudian’s eyes. After a few days of Epiphany, he used Lin Changsheng’s memory to research and develop abilities, his strength was several times stronger than before. He had a new understanding of himself. The only regret was that he didn’t have time to hone many powerful abilities. If he was given a few more years, he was confident.., no matter how many traps Lin Changsheng had planted in the main engine city, he would be able to flatten them all along the way and kill them all!
If he had someone else come up with a plan and choose a smart choice for him, he would naturally retreat for the time being and hibernate for a few years before coming out again.
But when he thought of that lonely figure wandering in the wilderness, his heart began to ache. He had lost her, forgotten her, so how could he let her go now?
He didn’t want to retreat even if his life was in danger. Although it was possible that Lin Changsheng was lying but what if it was true? What if?
“It’s coming.”
Dudian suddenly noticed that there were several sun-like figures approaching from the distant horizon. There was no hidden heat source. It should be the Fire Dragon Lord and others.
“This time, they may join forces with the Devil Emperor to attack.”Dudian frowned.
Beep!
The communication device lit up and Lin Changsheng’s virtual figure appeared, “You should be waiting for this moment. You have been reading the news from your wristwatch for the past few days. You should know their actions. They have frozen all the nuclear weapons in the federation. Even I can’t start them. This time they are ready to completely destroy the mainframe. I need your help!”
Dudian knew that he was very familiar with his actions in the past few days. However, he was limited to the travel records in the wristwatch. There were no surveillance cameras around so he didn’t know about his new ability, after all, they would have a fight sooner or later after the matter between the Devil and the Fire Dragon Lord was settled.
“What do you want me to do?”Dudian indifferently asked. His expression didn’t change.
Lin Changsheng smiled, “Last time we agreed. This time you will help me to restrain one of the Devil Emperor or the Fire Dragon Lord. I will deal with the rest. I will tell you what you want. I Won’t go back on my word!”
Dudian was silent for a moment: “How do you guarantee?”
Lin Changsheng was startled: “I guarantee my reputation. I can make a copy of this paragraph and give it to you. If I go back on my word then you can broadcast it throughout the Federation.”
Dudian’s face turned cold: “Do you think this kind of thing will affect you?”
Lin Changsheng frowned, he sighed: “It will affect me. After all I am the God of Science and Technology of the Federation. If I go back on my word then even if I repel the devil and others how will I be able to stand in the Federation?”? “Since you don’t believe me then I don’t know how to promise you. After all I don’t have a body and my consciousness is in the virtual world. There is nothing that can threaten me except the host. But I can’t tell you about the host. It is equivalent to suicide!”
Dudian’s eyes flashed, he indifferently said: “I don’t need you to tell me about the host. I know a little about it from the memories of the plunder. If you go back on your words then I will never help you. In addition, I need you to prepare a top-notch mech. With my ability, I can fully display the performance of the Mech.”
Lin changsheng wryly smiled: “I don’t have any mechs here. They have already emptied this place. They can’t transport anything over. If they weren’t in a hurry to destroy me, I would have died without a fight.”
Dudian saw that he couldn’t extort any benefits. He was too lazy to talk to him: “Alright, I will go.”He broke the wristwatch.
“He is still trying to test me. It seems he doesn’t know what is in the part of memory that I swallowed. There may be a big secret in it but unfortunately there isn’t one in the memory.”Dudian pulled off the broken wristwatch, he threw it aside and prepared to help Lin Changsheng after the Devil Emperor and the others entered. He didn’t believe that Lin Changsheng wouldn’t be able to hold on for a few minutes.
“It’s better to restrain the Fire Dragon Lord later. The Devil Emperor should be stronger than the Fire Dragon Lord since he is the sole ruler of the empire. I don’t know what he plans to do with the undead.”Dudian stood in place, he felt that Lin Changsheng was hiding something, “He knows that the hatred between us can not be resolved. My killing intent towards him is not inferior to that of the Devil Emperor and the others. I can help him this time. If I break the contract then I can join forces with the Devil Emperor and the others to continue to force the palace. He should be able to think of this.”
“So he will either fulfill the agreement and tell me the way to deal with the undeads. Or he will have other preparations to break the alliance between the Devil Emperor and me. However the second possibility is very low. He can’t deal with the Devil Emperor alone. In addition it will be more difficult for me. If he can deal with the undeads then there is no need to beg me. The possibility of him knowing the way to deal with the undeads is quite high.”
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he thought about this point.
At this time, Dudian saw the heat source disappear from the ground. He stayed for half a minute before he quickly approached it. He observed it from a distance and saw that there were no signs of human habitation on the ground, as he approached it, he could smell more than ten different kinds of body odor in the air. One of them was very familiar to him. He narrowed his eyes as a strong killing intent flashed through his eyes.
“Crimson Moon!”
Dudian remembered her body odors. She was the one who had killed him. His memory of her body odors was still fresh in his mind. His nose was more sensitive than a hound’s. He wouldn’t forget the things he had smelled, let alone Crimson Moon who had left a deep memory in his mind.
“It seems that they have come. There were only three heat source figures. The others should have habitually hidden their body heat source but didn’t eliminate their own body odors.”Dudian thought, hiding heat source was the instinct of old hunters. They could make the enemy unable to distinguish their own strength. As for the smell, there was no need to eliminate it for Crimson Moon and the others, in any case, Lin Changsheng knew their tracks from the moment they entered the city.
“Crimson Moon is here. The Devil Emperor must be here too. They have joined forces.”Dudian looked at the ground under his feet. He felt a slight tremor. He immediately bent over to listen, although the material of the underground base was unusual but there was still a weak sound. He heard the sound of fierce fighting and impact. It seemed that something hit the dome. The earth on the ground trembled slightly.
Dudian stood up. His eyes flashed. He felt that it was a pity. If he could see through the material of the underground base then he would be able to accurately find the time to cut in.
“Thirty seconds more.”Dudian thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1181 - Experimental Subject
chapters.content:
Chapter 1181: Chapter 1170: Experimental Subject
Translator:
549690339
The second level of the underground base.
The virtual projection was projected onto the ground. Lin Changsheng wore a smile as he stood proudly in front of the Demon Emperor, the Torch Dragon Lord, and the others. In his eyes, there was only the demon Emperor and the Torch Dragon Lord. As for the other kings behind them, they were all as thin as air.
There was not the slightest sign of tension on his body. He was still talking and laughing with a smile on his face, and his voice was also very gentle.., he said, “Demon Emperor, Fire Dragon Lord, now that the hundreds of millions of people of the federation have all fallen into your hands, you’ve already obtained everything that you should have. Do you really still want to continue fighting with me?”
Fire Dragon Lord had originally wanted to attack the Federation mainframe behind Lin Changsheng the moment he arrived. Seeing him appear and say this, he could not help but sneer, he said, “What’s the use of humans? If you really want to create humans, do you really need this little bit of manpower? The most worthless people in this world right now are humans. We want to cut the weeds and eliminate the roots. We don’t want to fight with you, but we also don’t want to keep you to take revenge on us in the future.”
Lin Changsheng smiled. “You cut off my energy and turned this city into a dead water city. After a few years, what can we use to fight with you? “But now, it’s still a bit difficult for you to completely destroy me. Even if I can’t drag you down with me, at least I’ll be able to hurt you. Moreover, the few people behind you probably won’t be able to leave this place alive.”
Hearing his words, the demon emperor, the snake-bodied king behind the Fire Dragon Lord, and the other two kings’expressions changed slightly. A trace of fear flashed in their eyes as they looked around vigilantly. Crimson Moon, on the other hand, had a calm expression as the corners of her mouth curled up into a disdainful arc. The light king beside her had a smile on his face as if he didn’t hear the threat in those words. He maintained a posture and an expression from the beginning to the end.
The demon emperor said indifferently, “This meeting can be considered a moment in the annals of history. It seems that the three of us have never really met. “Unfortunately, when we meet, it is also the time of departure. You are the first generation divine fetus from more than 200 years ago. You have lived in the virtual world for more than 200 years. The things you have seen and heard are far from what we can compare to. Even if we live for another thousand years, the things we have experienced may not be as much as what you have seen in a year. To use another way to describe it, your realm has already reached the level of ‘God’. You only lack a perfect divine body. When you find a perfect divine body, perhaps no one in this world will be your match.”
“I think that this result is not what we want to see, so don’t put us in a difficult position.”
Lin Changsheng’s eyebrows slightly twitched as he thought of Dudian’s figure. He gritted his teeth in hatred. Not only did he hate the latter’s craftiness, which made him underestimate the enemy and lead to his failure to plunder the body, but also.., he had asked him for help, and the other side had agreed. But now, he hadn’t appeared for a long time. He could even guess Dudian’s thoughts and wanted to make him suffer more!
This brat would take revenge for the smallest grievance!
Although he was angry but his expression didn’t change. There was a smile on his face, he said: “I think you are worrying too much. You should know the rarity of the god’s embryo. It isn’t so easy to get it. Moreover, the methods to cultivate the god’s embryo are in the hands of those old things. We are just the test subjects.”
Fire Dragon Lord raised his head slightly, he sneered and said, “What if those old things create new test subjects and you obtain them? “They haven’t been living on Earth for long and are beyond our reach. They don’t know the situation here as well as you and I do. If they know, do you think you can still live well in this virtual world?”
Hearing his words, the kings behind him looked at each other, somewhat stunned. They felt as if they had come into contact with an incredible secret, as if this world had opened up a corner for them.
Divine Fetus? God?
When Crimson Moon heard these words, her eyes slightly narrowed. She looked at Lin Changsheng with a hint of hidden greed.
She did not notice that the eyes of the radiant king beside her also flickered when he heard these words.
Just as Lin Changsheng was about to reply to the Torch Dragon Lord, the demon lord suddenly spoke, he coldly said, “It’s useless to say more. If you have any backup plans, bring them out. I believe that you’ve been preparing for today’s battle these past few days. With your computational ability, you should have simulated everything that happened in today’s battle. No matter what kind of accident happens, you might have calculated it. I wonder, have you calculated how to deal with it?”
Lin Changsheng slightly frowned. Just as he was about to speak again, the demon Emperor suddenly raised his hand and threw out a beam of black light. It was hard to see how it was released, but the black light was like an energy ball, piercing straight through Lin Changsheng’s projected chest, it smashed into the body of a gigantic demon entrenched on the ground behind him. This was a demon that was covered in tentacles that looked like sarcomas, but it was the demon body of a king that had been left here previously.
The dark energy ball hit the monster but there was no sound. It was like ice melting and a hole was pierced through the body of the monster.
“Go!”
Torch Dragon Master saw that he had already made a move. He didn’t want to talk to Lin Changsheng anymore. He led the king behind him and rushed forward.
Lin Changsheng’s face slightly changed. He was angry. He wanted to continue to use words to stall for time. He knew that Dudian couldn’t see the situation inside. Maybe he would come down in a while. But he didn’t expect that there would be a fight.
“Damn, is he really not coming?”Lin Changsheng couldn’t help but look up at the ground. There was no monitoring near the base. The nuclear bomb had leveled the ground so he couldn’t see the situation outside the base, he wouldn’t be able to sense the situation unless Dudian merged his body into the base.
Roar!
The undeads standing proudly in front of the mainframe roared. They led a few undead kings and rushed up to fight against the Fire Dragon Lord and the Devil Emperor.
Lin Changsheng stood in the middle of the battlefield and watched the fierce battle between them. Occasionally, he would bump into his virtual projection. He was like a person standing in the middle of the battlefield doing nothing, appearing somewhat eye-catching.
“Damn it!”Seeing that the undead was being held back by the Fire Dragon Lord and a young queen, Lin Changsheng’s expression became unsightly.
Although the other king-level demon bodies had become incomparably violent after becoming undead, increasing their strength by half, they had also lost their rationality and were not flexible enough in battle. In addition, the Demon Emperor led the light king and a few other kings, using numbers to bully the weak.., soon, the two king demon bodies were torn into pieces and could not move anymore.
“Go, destroy the host!”
The Demon Emperor’s body was still in human form, but his entire body was surging with dark energy that covered his entire body. It was as if a special energy was attached to his hands, feet, and skin. Each punch and kick caused terrifying damage to the king demon body, each punch was a hole. After repelling one of the King Demon’s bodies, the demon emperor called out to the radiant king beside him, telling him to attack the mainframe in front of him.
The Radiant King’s gaze slightly changed, but without hesitation, he nodded and charged over.
Lin Changsheng slightly gritted his teeth, took a deep breath, and transmitted his command through the virtual consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1182
chapters.content:
Chapter 1182: Chapter 1171: Battle of the gods
Translator:
549690339
Bang!
The seemingly seamless metal wall behind the mainframe suddenly opened. It was pitch black inside, but suddenly, a ray of light appeared inside. The extremely dark light was even deeper than the darkness in the cave. At the moment the metal wall opened.., it suddenly rushed out and rushed straight towards the radiant king who was attacking the mainframe.
The Radiant King’s pupils constricted as he instinctively felt an indescribable dangerous aura. He was shocked and hurriedly retreated, but the black shadow closed in on him in the blink of an eye. It was even faster than the radiant king who was known for his speed, like a black bolt of lightning.., with a bang, the radiant King’s retreating body was sent flying back at an even faster speed. Fresh blood sprayed in the air, and with a bang, he crashed into the metal wall on the other side of the base thousands of meters away. The entire underground base trembled slightly!
The Fire Dragon Lord, who was restraining the terrifying undead, also noticed this, and his expression changed slightly. Although he had expected that Lin Changsheng most likely had a backup plan, he had not expected that he really did have one, and it was so fierce!
The demon lord did not look at the king of light who was sent flying backwards. Instead, he narrowed his eyes and sized up the Black Shadow. This was a human-like person, but it was not a human. Its lower body was like a spider, with seven or eight strange legs.., on its back were two pairs of demon-like black scythe wings. On its forehead was a blood-red eye that was filled with a brutal aura. The pores all over its body were overflowing with a ferocious killing intent and a bloody aura. It was as if it was an evil spirit that had crawled out of a sea of blood!
“Aragami!”A cold glint flashed across the Demon Lord’s eyes, and the dark energy all over his body rippled.
“Aragami?”On the other side, the torch dragon lord frowned, feeling that something was not right. This thing did not seem to be a pure Aragami. There was always a sense of evil that he could not describe.
“The two of you, can we have a proper discussion now?”Lin Changsheng’s projection in the middle of the battlefield asked, pretending to sigh, he said, “Although you have frozen the nuclear weapons to prevent me from dying together with you, with it around, if the two of you really want to fight to the end, I can at least drag one of you down with me. Do you believe me?”
The Fire Dragon Lord forced the terrifying zombie away. The latter seemed to have received the order as well, so he did not pursue the victory. “This is your trump card? A modified Aragami?”As he spoke, the Fire Dragon Lord glanced at the demon emperor not far away.
The demon emperor indifferently said, “Just a corpse is not enough to negotiate!”After saying this, he attacked again.
Lin Changsheng’s expression slightly changed. He had wanted to use this opportunity to buy some time, but he did not expect that the demon emperor seemed to have sensed something, or perhaps he had other thoughts. Every time, he would interrupt his plan, as if he was determined to kill him.
Some anger also rose in his heart. With a cold snort, he quickly transmitted the order.
Roar!
The demon-like Aragami roared. Its three eyes were red as it took the initiative to pounce on the demon lord.
The demon lord snorted. The clothes on his back suddenly split open, and a large number of ferocious arms stretched out from it. It was as if his back was an Asura hell, and countless evil spirits crawled out from it. At this moment, as these arms stretched out, they grabbed at the Aragami. Every arm was emitting black gas, and it was covered by that special dark energy. The arms were extremely long, and as soon as they touched the Aragami, they corroded its flesh and blood.
The Aragami roared towards the sky and its entire body suddenly softened like mucus. Then, countless sharp blades shot out from the mucus towards the demon lord. Some of the mucus even turned into shields to block the countless arms that were coming at the demon lord from behind, in addition, there was also mucus that turned into nozzles. Poisonous bullets shot out from it and landed on the demon lord’s arms and legs. It immediately corroded a hole like sulfuric acid.
The demon lord let out a low growl and his entire body turned into a pool of black mucus. From the mucus, swords, sharp claws, shields, axes, and other objects kept coming out. It was difficult for him to fight against the mucus that the Aragami had turned into.
When Crimson Moon, who was on the battlefield behind him, saw this scene, her eyes flashed slightly. Other kings might find it difficult to understand this strange scene of a battle, but he knew that this was a battle of life that had reached the pinnacle!
Without a specific form, without a specific method, everything could be created at will, and the body could change in myriad ways. This kind of battle method had already broken the limits of human thought, and it was not an exaggeration to say that it was a “Divine battle”.
This was the level of life that she dreamed of, and also the level of life that she had already reached!
However, after reaching this level, she knew that humans were divided into higher and lower levels, and gods were the same.
On the other side, Zhulong, who was restraining the terrifying undead, was divided into two parts. He sized up the battle between the Demon Emperor and the Aragami, but he was not in a hurry to help. This was a rare opportunity to understand the background of this demon emperor. Once Lin Changsheng was done.., it would be their fire Dragon Kingdom’s war against the Empire. At that time, it would be even more intense, and they would fight to the death. This world could only accommodate one emperor.
Because the emperor was the only one, he was respected!
“The speed of life reconstruction is too fast. It’s a little faster than me.”Fire Dragon Lord looked more and more serious. At his level, he knew how difficult it was to continue improving his combat strength. His abilities and demonic insects.., to them, it was no longer important. What was important was their control over their own bodies. At this moment, when the demon Emperor’s body was reconstituted into various sharp blades or swords and axes, his speed was extremely fast. It was almost instantly formed.
In this kind of competition, even if he was only one-thousandth of a second faster, he would still attack first and then win!
“Oh?”Suddenly, Fire Dragon Lord discovered that when the Aragami reconstituted its various limbs, its speed was even faster than the demon lord. After more than ten sharp blades shot out from the mucus, when the demon lord transformed into a sword and shield to parry.., sharp spikes suddenly split out from the sharp blades. From the sharp blades, it transformed into a weapon that was like a mace. It smashed onto the sword and shield, shattering the sword and shield that was just right to counter the sharp swords. This caused the demon lord to have no choice but to reconstitute his new defensive equipment to deal with it.., for a moment, he actually felt that it was somewhat difficult to defend against it.
“How is this possible? Could This be a living Aragami? !”Fire Dragon Lord’s eyes widened in disbelief.
While he was shocked, the terrifying zombie beside him seized the opportunity and bit onto his shoulder, tearing off a piece of flesh. When he came back to his senses, his shoulder quickly burned into flames. All of his cells turned into fat, burning together with the virus that invaded it. The latter’s virus infection was completely useless to him, unless he wanted to die.., otherwise, it was almost impossible to be infected.
If it were any other king, it would not be so easy to deal with this terrifying zombie. Even if they could break limbs, shed skin, and shed shells, they would need time. Moreover, they could not endlessly break limbs, shed skin, and shed shells.
“We can’t delay any longer. You Go and destroy the mainframe!”Torch Dragon Lord saw that the demon lord was at a disadvantage and did not want to delay any longer. Otherwise, he would also reveal his trump card, so he immediately said to Crimson Moon who was beside him.
Crimson Moon curled her lips slightly and said, “I’m not going.”
“You? !”Torch Dragon Lord’s eyes widened in anger. He did not expect that a king would dare to disobey him.
Crimson Moon was not afraid of this at all. She walked away without any care and turned to help the injured King of light attack the other king’s demon body, leaving this terrifying zombie to torch dragon Lord alone.
Torch Dragon Lord was so angry that he almost flew into a rage, but in the end, he held it in. He was extremely angry. Previously, he thought that the new king under the demon lord was obedient and obedient, but he did not expect that he would use such a move on him at such a critical moment.., unfortunately, he was unable to withdraw and pursue the matter. Otherwise, his alliance with the demon lord would definitely be torn apart, and Lin Changsheng would benefit instead.
At this moment, another aura appeared above everyone’s heads.
The demon lord, the Torch Dragon Lord, and the other kings were all shocked. Could it be that Lin Changsheng still had a terrifying trump card?
But very quickly, the torch dragon Lord felt that this aura was very familiar. He immediately thought of the Federation king from last time and heaved a sigh of relief. A mere king could not affect the overall situation.
“HMM?”Crimson Moon released her senses and suddenly felt that this feeling was a little familiar. Soon, she suddenly recalled the identity of the newcomer. She was stunned for a moment and her eyes immediately lit up. She immediately abandoned the king demon body in front of her, she rushed toward the first level of the underground base.
“Where are you going?”The King of light hurriedly shouted.
“I’m going to intercept that person,”Crimson Moon said without turning her head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1183
chapters.content:
Chapter 1183: Chapter 1172: The Great Sage
Translator:
549690339
Dudian had just entered the first level of the underground base when he felt several powerful auras coming from the second level of the base. His perception quickly spread out from the hole, he didn’t have time to see the second level but he felt a familiar aura rushing towards the hole. It seemed that it was heading towards the first level of the base.
“Crimson Moon?”Dudian’s eyes turned cold.
Whoosh!
A beautiful figure jumped out of the hole and landed on the ground. It was Crimson Moon. She didn’t release her magic body at the moment. She looked beautiful but wasn’t as gentle as when she first met Dudian, there was a bit of cold and domineering aura.
“You are still alive.”Crimson Moon looked at dudian. Her eyes were full of surprise. She knew that Dudian was heavily injured. She thought that he would die but he was abandoned by her, she didn’t expect that Dudian’s partner would secretly transport him away. By the time she reacted she had already left the giant wall of Sylvia. Although she was a bit angry but she was too lazy to chase after him because she knew that this man had no heart and wouldn’t live long.
But now Dudian was standing in front of her. His aura and energy magnetic field were not inferior to the other kings she had met.
In addition, the Fire Dragon Lord had told them that Lin Changsheng had nurtured a difficult king. He didn’t expect that this person was dudian!
“Your experiment seems to be successful.”Dudian coldly looked at her. He sneered: “Unfortunately, you have struggled for so long but you have returned to the Devil Emperor as his dog.”
Scarlet Moon frowned but soon relaxed: “I didn’t expect you to secretly come to this foreign country. What method did Lin Changsheng use to let you live until now?”
“Do you think I will tell you?”Dudian sneered.
Scarlet Moon’s eyes flashed. Her arms shook and turned into two sharp blades. She rushed towards Dudian: “Since you don’t want to tell me then go to hell!”
Dudian didn’t expect her to suddenly attack. However he was ready to deal with her. His arms turned into two sharp blades and rushed towards Scarlet Moon. Bang! Four sharp blades crossed each other, scarlet Moon’s arms were split but not broken. Even so she was surprised and quickly pulled away.
Dudian immediately took advantage of the victory to attack. Several sharp blades shot out from his chest and shoulder. They were like poisonous snakes that followed closely behind.
Anger flashed across Crimson Moon’s face. Suddenly a large amount of black mist burst out from her pores and covered her whole body. The black mist spread around her and formed a dark domain. Dudian’s line of sight also lost Crimson Moon’s figure, a few sharp blades pierced through but missed.
Dudian’s eyes turned cold. He immediately switched to the Solar Beast’s ability. Crystals slowly formed on his skin and heat quickly gathered.
“It has been so long. I didn’t expect that you have improved to such a degree.”Suddenly, Crimson Moon’s voice came from behind Dudian like a ghost.
Dudian didn’t look back. His vision could see 360 degrees. There were no blind spots. There was still black fog behind him. He couldn’t see Crimson Moon’s figure. It seemed that the darkness was her body.
“However, it is impossible to kill me with this bit of strength.”Crimson Moon’s voice was very leisurely. It seemed that she wasn’t in a hurry to fight. She didn’t have the previous murderous aura: “I will give you a chance. Do you want to cooperate with me?”
“Cooperate?”Dudian was startled. He quickly restrained his thoughts and looked around to avoid being distracted.
“Don’t worry. You are already in my dark domain. It is easy for me to kill you. I didn’t mean to disturb your mind.”Crimson Moon seemed to see through Dudian’s thoughts.
Dudian’s eyes were deep. He didn’t comment on it. He suddenly thought of what Crimson Moon had said. Her goal was to become a god and rule over all life. However, she was now under the Devil Emperor, most likely she was unwilling to cooperate with him. Was she planning to rebel? If so then there was a possibility.
“How?”Dudian asked.
Crimson moon laughed: “Do you know who is the ruler of this world?”
Dudian replied: “The Devil Emperor of the Empire, Lin Changsheng of the Federation and the two Dragon Lords of the Fire Dragon Kingdom. As far as I know it is the four of them who have divided the human survivors.”
Suddenly, Crimson Moon’s figure appeared more than ten meters away from Dudian. Her skin color was abnormally white and seemed to be emitting light in the dark. She was so delicate that even the glossy pores on her body could be seen clearly, there was a proud smile on her face: “You are half right. The human kingdom is indeed controlled by the four of them. As for the northern snow apes and the endless sea monsters, they are just a pile of loose sand. There is nothing to worry about.”
Dudian’s heart slightly moved. He had heard about the snow apes in the north. It seemed that they were created by the undeads. The Endless Sea monsters should be the most powerful force on Earth. However the area of the sea was too big. The sea monsters lived in the sea and fought with each other. They couldn’t care about the creatures on land, it was like they were fighting for the throne on land. They couldn’t care about the monsters in the sea.
“In the end, the four of them are just spokesmen.”Crimson Moon slowly said. Her words shocked Dudian.
“You are from the old era. You have personally experienced the doomsday disaster. You should know what the root of the disaster is.”Crimson moon faintly smiled: “Although humans launched the nuclear annihilation plan but the magic insects were not completely wiped out. Moreover the penetration of the magic insects into humans was deeper than you think. They had already known about the nuclear annihilation plan in advance.”
“However, they didn’t reach their goal. They were greedy and hesitant. They didn’t withdraw in time and most of the magic insects were destroyed. However, the great sages of the magic insects left Earth with the surviving magic insects.”
“The great sages?”Dudian was startled.
Scarlet moon smiled: “They are the leaders of the magic insects. They are the wise ones who lead the survival of the magic insects.”
“How do you know?”
“Do you think that I didn’t do anything when I became the King?”Crimson Moon asked.
Dudian understood and no longer questioned.
“However, the remaining magic insects on earth were not completely extinct. The situation on Earth was transmitted by the magic insects. The great sages who escaped from Earth received it. So they returned to Earth...”
“Then, the Trolls Federation that you’re currently in and the Fire Dragon Kingdom were established!”A strange look flashed across Crimson Moon’s eyes as she said, “So, you should know who really controls this world, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1184
chapters.content:
Chapter 1184: Chapter 1173: Giant Wall Cemetery
Translator:
549690339
Dudian frowned but wasn’t too surprised. Bolo had told him about the secrets of the King Long Ago. The last time he helped Lin Changsheng to defeat the kings, he had seen the magic insects coming out of their shells.
These magic insects were parasitic in the king’s brain and interfered with their thoughts. However the king’s main thought was his own consciousness. This also made the Kings not unite with each other.
He thought that the magic insects were only capable of this but he didn’t expect that they would be controlled by the magic insects.
“You mentioned the Trolls Federation and the Fire Dragon Kingdom but didn’t mention the Empire?”Dudian looked at her.
Crimson Moon smiled, “The Empire is different from the federation and the Fire Dragon Kingdom. As you can see, the Empire has a natural giant wall. It seems to be man-made but it is natural. This is not the technology of the magic insects nor the technology of humans. It is the technology of the Aragami!”
Dudian’s heart was shocked. It was as clear as the moon in front of his eyes: “The Empire is controlled by the Aragami? So there are Aragami’s remains guarding each giant wall?”
“It is better to say that it is a memorial.”Crimson moon smiled: “Every giant wall is a cemetery to honor the Aragami. It is also a prison to keep experimental objects. Otherwise, with the fear and hatred of the Aragami, why would the magic insects keep their remains and become the faith of humans?”
Dudian’s face slightly changed. It was obvious that she was referring to human beings.
He suddenly thought of the technology that was blocked in the giant wall of Sylvia. In other giant walls, the technology was not high. After three hundred years of development, even if there was no complete inheritance of the technology of the old era.., human beings would not fall in the Middle Ages.
He had already known that the Empire had sealed off the technology of the giant wall from the moment he ascended to the position of the giant wall lord. However, he did not know what its purpose was. It was clear that the border needed strength to defend against the strong enemies, yet it had stopped the development of the technology in its own territory, what he had thought was a very contradictory matter. Now, he finally had an answer.
Humans were kept as experimental subjects. No wonder they were not allowed to control technology..
“Wait, you said that the empire is controlled by the Aragami. Doesn’t that mean that the emperor is under the command of the Aragami? The Federation and the Fire Dragon Kingdom should know about this. Is Your Union a conspiracy? Are you really going to deal with the Emperor? !”Dudian suddenly thought of this, his hair stood up. Was this a plot against the emperor?
Crimson Moon saw Dudian’s surprised look and smiled, “You are so cute. What kind of person is the Devil Emperor? How come he doesn’t know their identities? Even I know about this. How can I hide it from him? I haven’t told you yet. There is a war between the magic insects. Just like the flame soul worm that you saw.”
Dudian was startled: “There is a war between the magic insects?”
“The magic insects are what we call them. In fact, the magic insects are divided into two races. One is the polar frost magic insects and the other is the polar flame magic insects. One is cold and the other is hot. They are natural enemies and hate each other. The war has been going on for thousands of years.”Crimson Moon smiled, she slowly explained: “The environment of the planet where the magic insects live is extremely harsh. The magic insects are born in the natural magic caves. The environment of the planet is extremely extreme. Both hot and cold are half of the planet. The two kinds of magic insects have evolved in different extreme directions. The hatred between them is getting deeper and deeper!”
“However, it is precisely because of its extreme nature that it has reached its peak!”
The faint mockery in Crimson Moon’s eyes slowly disappeared, she said, “You have obtained the polar ice bug before. You should be able to see how tenacious its vitality is. It can survive even in an environment without oxygen and light. It is simply a super virus!”
“Other than its strong survivability, the lifespan of a magic bug is also beyond your imagination. Ordinary magic bugs can live for more than a thousand years. The more powerful ones can even live for three thousand years!”
“The great sages of the magic insects are at this level. You can imagine what kind of terrifying intelligence and combat power a creature that has lived for three thousand years can evolve.”
Dudian was stunned. Although he felt that his ability to accept things was very strong, but he was still scared by Crimson Moon’s words.
Live for more than a thousand years? This was more than ten times the lifespan of a human!
However, he quickly understood that there were some long-lived life on Earth. Not to mention the almost immortal lighthouse jellyfish, even small things like turtles and ocean clams could live for hundreds of years, with the ability and specialty of the polar ice insects, it was not strange for them to live for thousands of years. Their physique was extremely cold and their aging was slow. Even if Crimson Moon said that they could freeze themselves into ice and survive for thousands of years, he would believe it.
“Although the lifespan of the magic insects is long, few of them can live until the end of their life.”Crimson Moon said: “The environment of the magic insects planet is harsh. Most of the magic insects would be killed by the environment or killed by the Aragami even if they don’t fight with the enemy magic insects. That’s why they would travel the galaxy to find a new place to live and then find our Earth.”
Dudian was startled: “Are they hunted by the Aragami? Do Aragami also exist on their planet?”
“Of course not.”Crimson Moon said: “For the Aragami, the magic insects are just their food. The planet where the Aragami Live is not far from the magic insect planet. The magic insects are like poultry that the Aragami Raise.”
“Poultry?”Dudian was shocked. He didn’t think that the relationship between the magic insects and the Aragami was like this. No wonder the magic insects were afraid of the Aragami.
“The Aragami are gluttons. They are like a bottomless pit. They will devour all the resources around them, including stones, weeds and water.”Crimson Moon slowly said: “So the Aragami planet is very barren. Almost all the planets are eaten up! However, the Aragami are more terrifying than the magic insects. They can use their bodies to travel in the vacuum of the universe. The countless rays and absolute zero temperature in the universe can not kill them!”
Dudian was startled. He felt as if he was listening to a fairy tale.
Scarlet Moon saw that Dudian didn’t believe her, “Don’t think that it is difficult. You can do it when you reach the strength of the Devil Emperor. The extreme cold magic insects and extreme flame magic insects can live in the universe for a short time. They can build a life reactor in their body so that they won’t be completely frozen and stop thinking.”
Dudian frowned as he saw her relaxed expression. He asked: “Where did you learn these things? Do all kings know these things?”
“Have you forgotten my ability?”Crimson Moon looked at him with a smile: “Do you want to reminisce about it?”
Dudian snorted, “Your words are full of loopholes. Since the Aragami controlled the empire, how could the Aragami allow the existence of the federation and the Fire Dragon Kingdom?”? You said that the federation and the Fire Dragon Kingdom are controlled by the magic insects so the fire dragon kingdom is naturally controlled by the extreme flame magic insects and the federation is controlled by the extreme cold magic insects. Why is it forbidden to use magic insects to transform the body in the Federation?”? “Why do you choose to use human technology?”
Scarlet moon indifferently replied: “What I said is true. Maybe there is something you don’t understand but there might be something else. In any case, I’m not lying to you. I’m telling you this because I want you to know my sincerity. If you want to cooperate with me, I will tell you about the virus. Don’t you want to know the source of the virus?”
Dudian’s pupils shrank but quickly returned to normal. His heart was slightly shaken. The source of the virus? If he knew the source of the virus, did it mean that there was hope to find a way to crack it?
If he could crack it, would he be able to treat her?
Crimson Moon saw that Dudian seemed to be moved. She gently smiled, “The situation is in a deadlock. I think that Old Kid Lin Changsheng has used all his cards. The only final move may be to self-destruct the mainframe. He will not use it unless he is desperate. I hope you can help me get the mainframe!”
Dudian’s eyes lit up: “What do you want the mainframe for? To control the Federation?”
“You don’t have to worry about that.”Crimson Moon replied.
Dudian had guessed that Lin Changsheng’s knowledge was enough to help any God to quickly become a true God. Moreover, Crimson Moon could quickly become the strongest king of the empire, most likely the experiment was successful. Perhaps it was because of the body of a god. Lin Changsheng was a great tonic for her!

chapters.title: Chapter 1185
chapters.content:
Chapter 1185: Chapter 1174: true or false
Translator:
549690339
“What do you want to Do?”Dudian asked.
Crimson Moon thought that Dudian had agreed, “We will pretend to fight fiercely and look for opportunities. If Lin Changsheng can’t defeat the joint forces of the Fire Dragon Lord and the Devil Emperor then we will help Lin Changsheng. If he can stop the two of them then we will continue to watch. If necessary we can help Lin Changsheng kill the fire dragon lord or the Devil Emperor. No matter who dies, the rest of them will have to cooperate with us if they want to get Lin Changsheng. The initiative will be in our hands!”
“Your target is the Master of Fire Dragon and the Master of Fire Dragon?”Dudian deliberately asked: “Aren’t you going to deal with Lin Changsheng?”
“I want the host. Their target is the host. If we directly kill Lin Changsheng then we won’t have the capital to compete with the Master of Fire Dragon and the Master of Fire Dragon.”Crimson Moon replied.
Dudian nodded but he understood crimson moon’s idea. He wanted to kill one of the Master of Fire Dragon and the Master of Fire Dragon and force the other to deal with Lin Changsheng. When Lin Changsheng was killed then the host would become ownerless, then he would deal with the other one!
If this was Crimson Moon’s intention then at least it meant that she was confident to fight the devil emperor or the Fire Dragon Lord alone!
“I know. I will cooperate with you.”Dudian said.
Crimson Moon smiled, “In that case, let’s put on a show. The outside is covered by my dark domain. They haven’t revealed the previous conversation so they have no way to sense it. But it’s easy to be suspicious if there is no movement for so long.”
He took the initiative to attack Dudian.
Dudian had long felt that her dark domain was extraordinary. He saw that she didn’t use her magic body. He immediately retreated. He didn’t use her magic body but his pores were tense, he didn’t dare to underestimate the enemy. No one knew if she could see that his physique was different from ordinary kings. She knew that it wouldn’t be easy to kill him so she said such words to make him careless.
Scarlet Moon looked at Dudian’s eyes as if he was cautious. She knew that this man was as cautious as a cat. He was meticulous and suspicious. She didn’t change this point.
Soon, Scarlet Moon’s palm hit Dudian’s forehead. Dudian raised his hand to block. He felt a soft but powerful thrust. His body flew back and hit the metal wall of the first floor of the base.
Dudian took the initiative to attack Crimson Moon. When he was close to her, he suddenly stopped his attack and secretly defended, at the same time he whispered: “Why do you know the Dark Domain? Is this your father’s ability?”
Crimson Moon’s face slightly changed: “This is my business. Don’t ask!”
“Are You Crimson Moon or Boro?”Dudian stared at her.
“It has nothing to do with you!”Crimson Moon shouted. Her arm turned into a huge scythe and slashed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s arm was petrified and blocked the huge scythe. It was cut a few inches deep and some stone chips were cut off. He stepped back and frowned: “Don’t go too far!”
Crimson Moon snorted. Her scythe arm returned to its original state: “How did you become Lin Changsheng’s helper? Did he solve the problem with your body?”
“It has nothing to do with you.”Dudian also refused.
Scarlet’s face sank but it quickly returned to normal. She indifferently said: “If you don’t say it then don’t say it. Act well and don’t let them see through you.”
“As you wish!”Dudian’s shoulder shot out several sharp blades and stabbed towards scarlet.
Scarlet’s eyes flashed as a large number of dark knights appeared from the surrounding fog. They raised their shields to block the sharp blades. However the black shields formed by the fog were like paper and easily pierced by the sharp blades, she suddenly raised her hand and shot out a large amount of white silk which formed a silk shield to block the front. She felt a heavy viscous force when the sharp blades pierced into it.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. He quickly withdrew the sharp blades to prevent the sharp blades from sinking. He had no choice but to keep the blades to protect himself.
“You have used the ability of the splitter to the extreme.”Scarlet Moon smiled.
Dudian indifferently said: “You are not bad.”Although he said that but his heart was in awe. There were few things that could withstand his sharp blades. But Scarlet Moon’s white silk shield.., it could block the sharp blade. Once it pierced deep it would be stuck. If his sharp blade was strong then the white shield was soft.
“I can use the solar beast’s ability to burn the white shield.”Dudian’s pupils turned dark gold. He used X-ray to penetrate into the white shield and observe the structure of the white shield, the inner structure of the silk hole was connected to Crimson Moon’s arm. The ability to form a shield outside the body required more control over the body. Long-term practice could help him better control the body.
“Again.”Crimson Moon saw that Dudian was no longer attacking. She shouted and took the initiative to meet him.
Dudian also immediately met her. It was as if the two were sparring. Dudian took the opportunity to learn from her many changes in her ability.
On the second floor of the underground base, the projection Lin Changsheng looked up at the first floor of the hole. It was covered in black fog. He couldn’t see the battle clearly but he could hear the sounds of the fight from time to time, he had seen Crimson Moon’s fighting style from other instruments. He knew that Dudian was surrounded by her ability. It would be difficult for him to escape unless Dudian could crack her ability, he would use the same ability to counter the pressure.
“Useless Thing!”Lin Changsheng was angry. He thought that Dudian would be able to help him delay the attacks of several kings. However he knew that Dudian had the ability to do so, moreover he knew that Dudian’s growth was too amazing. Given time and battle he would be able to evolve quickly. However he didn’t expect to meet the first king of the Devil, he wasn’t able to escape for a long time.
He felt that Dudian was deliberately delaying because he didn’t want to do his best.
But he had no other way to continue to provoke Dudian. He could only focus on another battlefield.
Bang!
The Aragami suddenly turned into a giant hammer and smashed down on the Rhombus Shield which the Devil Emperor had hastily turned into. Dudian was forced to retreat for dozens of meters. Then his body suddenly split into two parts. His height and appearance were the same as before, one of them rushed towards the two kings who were trying to sneak up on the mainframe, while the other continued to rush towards the demon monarch in an attempt to pin him down.
“You dare to fight me with only half of your body? !”The demon monarch saw his actions and his body returned to its original state. A cold glint flashed across his eyes, and dark energy that was like bubbles emerged from his body and spread throughout his entire body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1186
chapters.content:
Chapter 1186: Chapter 1175: The Demon King defected
Translator:
549690339
While the demon king was busy dealing with one of the Aragami’s avatars, the other avatars had already arrived in front of the two kings who were trying to bypass the battlefield to attack the mainframe. One of the kings was the nine-tailed cat king while the other was the snake king, at this moment, when they saw the Aragami’s avatars charging over, their expressions changed. They looked at each other and quickly decided to join forces to attack. They did not believe that with the strength of the two kings, they would not be able to deal with half of the Aragami’s body!
The two of them attacked left and right, displaying their respective ability domains.
At the instant they exchanged blows, the two of them suddenly realized that they were wrong, and they were ridiculously wrong! They did not know how terrifying the strength of a demon lord who was on par with the Torch Dragon Lord was!
The moment the Aragami avatar approached the two of them, its body suddenly split apart. From its brain to its chest, it completely split into two parts. Each of them quickly demonized, and its cells rapidly split apart like inflated balloons, then, the two parts of its body turned into the nine-headed cat and the nine-headed snake. They pounced on the nine-tailed cat king and the Snake King at the same time. The nine snake heads spat out a thick, dark green poisonous gas that covered an area of over a hundred meters, forming a poisonous gas domain.
The nine-headed cat, on the other hand, let out a strange screech that was extremely ear-piercing, causing one’s mind to become dizzy.
The Snake King felt its thoughts stop for a moment. Then, it saw that the poisonous gas that it spat out was completely neutralized by the poisonous gas that the nine snake heads spat out. Furthermore, the nine snake heads pounced on it quickly and actually wrapped around its body.
Pu Pu Pu!
In the next moment, the nine snake heads bit down at the same time. Fine and sharp teeth grew out of the snake heads. It was not just two poisonous snake fangs, but sharp beast teeth that bit through the scales on the snake-body King’s body and ate the flesh inside.
The snake-body king let out a pained cry and quickly cut off the pain in his body. However, the pain from the bite was still transmitted to his brain through his nerves. The latter’s bite seemed to have made his sense of pain particularly sensitive and contained neurotoxins.
On the other side, the nine-tailed cat tried to pounce on him to help, but was blocked by the nine-headed cat. The nine-headed cat bared its teeth and gave off an indescribable threat, making the nine-tailed Cat King not dare to act Rashly.
The snake-body King’s body quickly twisted and demonized into sharp claws. Like a flood dragon, it tried to grab the snake’s head, but it was pierced by the sharp blade that grew out of the snake’s head. A new snake head grew out of the snake’s neck, in the blink of an eye, it turned into hundreds of snake heads and bit at the same time. Soon, the snake-bodied King’s struggle weakened. Suddenly, a wound appeared on his forehead and a red figure popped out.
This red figure was a half-meter long red worm. It jumped out of the gap between hundreds of snake heads. When it landed on the ground and wanted to escape, hundreds of snake heads suddenly rushed up and drowned it.
By the time the snake head retracted, the extreme blaze demonic worm was no longer on the ground.
After eating the extreme blaze demonic worm, the snake head slowly turned into a bloody mouth. No one could tell what kind of monster’s mouth it was, but it was extremely ferocious. It swallowed the Snake Body King’s broken body that was covered in bite marks.
After chewing for a few times, the huge mouth retracted and returned to the human half of the Aragami Avatar. The other half of the body was still a nine-headed cat that had grown out of its body, but it also quickly retracted back, in the blink of an eye, it had returned to the form of a complete Aragami avatar.
The nine-tailed cat king’s cat eyes contracted tightly. She did not expect the snake body king to die so quickly. She did not have the strength to resist at all.
Run!
She turned around and ran. Her actions were swift and fierce. In the blink of an eye, she had pulled away from the Aragami avatar.
The Aragami avatar did not seem to have any intention of chasing after her. Instead, it turned around and charged towards the fire dragon lord on the other side.
At this moment, Torch Dragon Lord was holding back the terrifying zombie. Although he had spare strength and could be distracted to observe the other battlefields, he could not free himself. When he saw the nine-tailed cat king and Snake King that he had sent were defeated by the Aragami Avatar, he could not help but feel angry, at the same time, he turned his gaze towards the demon lord. He saw that he was still maintaining his human form as he fought fiercely with the other Aragami avatar, suppressing it. However, it seemed that it was impossible to determine the victor in a short period of time.
“Demon Lord! You Can’t even deal with half of the Aragami’s body? Why is it taking so long? !”Fire Dragon Lord roared furiously as flames raged all over his body.
A black vertical pupil split open on the demon lord’s forehead. His attacks were several times more violent, suppressing the Aragami avatar that was engaged in battle until it was forced to retreat.
However, the Aragami avatar that had eaten the snake body king did not have any intention of returning to support him. Instead, it charged straight towards Fire Dragon Lord.
The Fire Dragon Lord pushed away the terrifying undead and roared at the sky. His entire body was burning, and the terrifying heat instantly engulfed the entire second floor of the underground base. Everyone felt as if they were in a furnace, and the surrounding metal walls became extremely hot, their sweat was instantly evaporated, and the hair of the terrifying undead closest to the fire dragon lord was completely burned. The clothes on their bodies were also burned to ashes. They were completely naked, but they were expressionless. Their attacks were still ferocious and fearless.
After the Aragami avatar flew over, it suddenly twisted its body and transformed from a human into a dragon. However, unlike the Torch Dragon Lord’s Inferno Fire Dragon, it turned into an extremely cold ice dragon that was covered in ice crystals. It released a large amount of cold air, freezing the ground.., under the cold and heat, the surrounding metal walls began to crack, as if they were about to crack. When Lin Changsheng saw this scene, his expression changed slightly. He hurriedly tried to persuade the Torch Dragon Lord, but his words were ignored by the Torch Dragon Lord.., it was ignored automatically.
The extreme frost ice dragon pounced at the fire dragon lord with bared fangs and brandished claws. It spat out streams of cold air, freezing the flames around the fire dragon Lord’s body.
The Fire Dragon Lord was shocked and angry. He did not expect that this Aragami, who only had half of its body, could release such powerful energy. It was no wonder that the demon lord could not finish off the Aragami Avatar.
Ice and fire countered each other. Fire could extinguish water, water could extinguish fire. At the root of it all, whoever was weaker would be countered. At this moment, the Fire Dragon Lord felt a trace of coldness. The raging flames outside his body were touched by the ice dragon breath that the other party spat out. The fire was greatly reduced, as if it was going to be extinguished.
“I don’t believe that you can release absolute zero!”The Fire Dragon Lord clenched his teeth slightly. Absolute Zero was the ultimate ice ability and also a restricted area. This was because once his ability was suppressed to absolute zero.., his body would also be frozen, and even his thoughts would stop. It was equivalent to a suicide attack.
His body was constantly secreting fat and dragon oil, and the temperature outside his body was slowly rising. The scales and bones all over his body had crystallized. It was like a dancing flame inside, driving away more than half of the cold air around him. He roared as he pounced towards the Aragami.
At this moment, the terrifying zombie rushed over from the other side. It hugged his dragon tail from behind and pulled it back forcefully.
He roared angrily and swung his dragon tail. However, with this pause, the Aragami spat out seven mouthfuls of extremely cold air. The Flames on his body were almost extinguished, and the air was once again bone-chilling.
“Bastard!”Torch Dragon Lord was extremely furious. He once again stimulated the heat in his body. However, he saw the terrifying zombie hugging and biting the dragon tail. He had no choice but to create a layer of barrier bones within the dragon tail to isolate the zombie virus.
“Let me help you!”The demon lord’s calm voice suddenly came from the other side.
Torch Dragon Lord was slightly startled. He turned his attention and saw the demon lord rushing over. On the ground behind him was a dying Aragami avatar. His entire body was covered in dark energy and was constantly being eaten away.
“You’ve finally solved it. Hurry up and Chop This Thing Off!”Torch Dragon Lord heaved a sigh of relief and immediately swung the dragon tail towards the demon lord.
The Demon Lord’s black hair fluttered in the wind as his entire body was shrouded in dark energy. He rushed over at an extremely fast speed and suddenly raised his hand to smack torch dragon Lord’s tail. The dark energy transformed into a sharp black blade and instantly pierced through the dragon tail, he sprinted forward, sticking close to the back of the dragon tail and slashing at Torch Dragon Lord’s back. Fresh blood splattered out from the exhausted flames and scattered all over the ground.
Fire Dragon Lord was shocked. He turned his head to look at the Demon Emperor. When he saw the demon emperor’s pair of cold eyes filled with killing intent, he immediately came to his senses. His eyes turned red as he roared, “How Dare You Betray Our Alliance? I want you to die! !”
Before he could turn around and pounce on the demon emperor, another dense ball of cold air crashed into him. The Flames on the dragon’s head were immediately extinguished, and his beard, hair, and scales showed signs of being covered in ice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1187
chapters.content:
Chapter 1187: Chapter 1,176: Betrayal
Translator:
549690339
“There is only one true God in this world, and that is me!”The demon lord’s expression was cold as the dark energy around his body suddenly turned into thousands of black snakes that coiled around fire dragon Lord’s dragon body and bit it, the scales that were as indestructible as fire crystals were ruthlessly bitten off, leaving a bloody mess.
Fire Dragon Lord looked as if he was about to explode. He raised his head and roared furiously. The fresh blood flowing all over his body suddenly burned like gasoline, turning into a raging fire that burned thousands of black snakes until they were distorted. Then, they turned into dark energy once again and returned to the demon lord’s side, he forced the demon lord to retreat.
“Effiny Hughes, you will die a horrible death!”Fire Dragon Lord roared with killing intent. “Even if I die today, I will drag you down with me. Don’t even think about obtaining him by yourself. When you die, the Kirin Dragon Lord Will Flatten Your Empire and destroy the foundation of Your Aragami on Earth!”!
The demon lord’s entire body was shrouded in black fog. His fair face was faintly discernible and his expression was extremely cold. “Kirin Dragon Lord? How do you know that I’m not doing this because of him?”
Torch Dragon Lord roared, “What did you say?”
“Many years ago, I once made a deal with him but I never found a suitable opportunity to repay him. This cooperation can coincidentally complete that deal. Haven’t you thought about why you were the one sent instead of him after your discussion?”The Demon Lord said indifferently.
The Flames around Torch Dragon Lord fluttered violently as though they were about to turn into a raging sea of flames in the blink of an eye. It was also as though they were about to be extinguished at any moment. The demon lord’s words were like the twilight drum and the morning bell as they slammed into his heart. Back then, he was discussing this matter with the Qilin Dragon Lord.., he had a strange feeling in the bottom of his heart, but he did not think too deeply about it. He did not expect things to turn out in the worst direction as expected.
“Impossible, impossible!”Fire Dragon Lord felt that his heart was bleeding, he roared in pain, “The Qilin Dragon Lord is my brother, my blood brother. How could he harm me? If it was not for him, I would have died countless times. He wants me to die. As long as he speaks to me personally, why would there be a need for outsiders to do anything? I don’t believe it. He must have some other reason. Don’t even think about disturbing my thoughts!”!
At the end, the Fire Dragon Lord suddenly roared. Ignoring the extreme frost ice dragon, he turned around and charged at the demon lord. The raging flames all over his body suddenly swept over several hundred meters, burning the metal wall until it was boiling red. He opened his mouth.., a lava-like pillar of fire spewed out of his mouth and enveloped the demon lord.
The demon lord’s expression changed slightly as he roared, “Lin Changsheng, why aren’t you helping me? I’m going to get injured. Just wait for me to bring the qilin dragon lord over to surround and kill you again!”
The projection on the ground, Lin Changsheng, frowned slightly. Seeing that the demon lord was being chased by the pillar of fire and was only focused on fleeing, he had no intention of taking it head-on. He knew that the demon lord was still planning to save his strength to deal with him after the Fire Dragon Lord died. After all.., from the start of the battle until now, the demon lord had yet to show his demon body, or rather, his Aragami body. It was estimated that he had only used less than 50% of his strength.
He snorted coldly in his heart, but he did not continue to stand idly by. He saw the Aragami that had remained where it was and transformed into an extremely cold ice dragon suddenly pounce towards the fire dragon lord. The extremely cold ice qi around its body quickly extinguished the flames, creating a large amount of steam, this steam enveloped the entire second layer and quickly became scalding hot, making everyone feel as if they were soaking in boiling water. If it was an ordinary person, they would have long died from the heat under such high temperatures. However, to other kings.., they only felt a slight heat.
“Scram!”The Torch Dragon Lord Roared and slammed his head into the extreme frost dragon’s body, forcing it to retreat. “Lin Changsheng, let’s work together to kill the demon lord. After we kill him, I will immediately leave. I will definitely not continue to make things difficult for you!”
Lin Changsheng sighed. “Unfortunately, he thought of this long ago and blocked my path. I can only work together with him to kill you. I’m sorry.”
When the distant demon lord heard his kind words, he slightly narrowed his eyes. A dense killing intent flashed in his eyes, and he no longer held back. His entire body turned into a lump of black mucus as he suddenly pounced towards the Torch Dragon Lord.
When the Torch Dragon Lord saw the black mucus, he roared in anger. The flames around his body rose once again and the temperature doubled. The metal walls were as red as iron, but the mainframe that looked like a giant tree in the distance was not affected much, it was as if Lin Changsheng had already prepared for this.
“When you proposed to take over the federation last time, you had already planned it, right? You knew that I was worried about you taking it over, so you stayed behind to watch over him. You can take this opportunity to collude with him!”The Torch Dragon Lord glared at the demon lord angrily, the hatred in his heart far surpassed his greed for Lin Changsheng, but he did not lose his reason. He sneered, “You want to take him for yourself, but I won’t let you have your way. I’ll only kill you! !”
With that said, his body was engulfed in flames, enveloping the demon lord.
The demon lord’s expression changed slightly, and he roared at the Aragami on the other side, “Hurry up and suppress him!”
The Aragami snorted and spat out a symbolic breath of cold air, weakening the flames on the Torch Dragon Lord’s body a little, but it soon began to burn again.
Seeing that the demon lord did not have any intention to attack sincerely, the demon lord knew that the demon lord wanted to use the torch dragon Lord to weaken his own battle strength.
