Fortunately, he had enough strength to deal with the demon lord after the battle ended. He was secretly angry, and his eyes grew colder and colder. These changes.., he had long anticipated this and was also within his plan. However, when it really happened, he still felt a little angry, and the killing intent in his heart towards Lin Changsheng grew even stronger.
“Effiny Hughes, you’ve trapped yourself in a cocoon. You could have become a god with me, but you chose to perish together with me. I’ll Grant You Your Wish!”The Fire Dragon Lord roared with laughter, his voice shaking the walls, he knew that it was impossible for him to leave this place alive. Although Lin Changsheng seemed to have lowered his attacks, his goal was only to use him to weaken the demon lord’s fighting strength. Once he wanted to leave.., the two of them would immediately use lightning techniques to destroy him.
Moreover, even if he managed to escape alive, he did not know where else he could return to.
Although he didn’t want to believe it but he believed it deep down in his heart!
“Burn everything with my body!”Fire Dragon roared as the restrictions in his heart were lifted. His blood, veins and bones turned into flames, the huge dragon’s eyes turned into two floating fireballs. Even Dudian and Crimson Moon who were on the first floor of the underground base felt extremely hot as if their bodies were about to be burned.
“Not good! This old dragon is going to die together with the Devil Emperor!”Crimson Moon’s face changed. She quickly put away the dark domain and rushed out of the underground base.
Dudian quickly followed after her as he saw her leave. The two of them seemed to be in an intense battle but in fact they were paying close attention to the situation. They were shocked by the sudden change of the Devil Emperor but it seemed to be what they wanted, if the Master of Fire Dragon was really dead then they could join hands with Lin Changsheng to deal with the Devil Emperor. In the end they would fight for Lin Changsheng. There might be some hope!
However he felt that the Devil Emperor seemed to be prepared. The sudden defection made him feel that something was wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 1188
chapters.content:
Chapter 1188: Chapter 1177: escape
Translator:
549690339
Not long after Dudian and Scarlet Moon rushed out, another figure jumped out of the ground. It was the king of light.
The moment the King of light appeared, he saw Dudian and scarlet moon standing on the ground. There was a trace of vigilance in his eyes. He quickly pulled away from them and stood on the other side, he smiled: “Scarlet King, do you need me to help you deal with him?”
Crimson Moon said indifferently, “If you want to make a move, feel free to try.”
The king of light understood the meaning behind her words and smiled lightly. He turned his head to look at the ground under his feet and felt the gradually boiling temperature under his boots, he said with a smile, “I didn’t expect that His Majesty the Demon Emperor would ally with Lin Changsheng. The Fire Dragon Lord seems to be doomed this time. It’s just that I don’t know if His Majesty will be implicated by him and be dragged along with him. Don’t let that Lin Changsheng benefit for nothing.”
Crimson moon indifferently said: “His Majesty is such a character. Why would he do something that he isn’t sure about?”
The King of light smiled and didn’t say anything more.
Dudian looked at the two of them. He felt a bit strange. He deeply looked at the king of light. The latter should have known about Crimson Moon’s betrayal but he didn’t seem to be too surprised, was the king of light loyal to the devil or to himself? If it was the latter then the meaning of his words was worth paying attention to!
At this time, the metal on the ground gradually turned red as if magma was about to erupt. The high temperature made the air around them hot and distorted. The water molecules in the air quickly evaporated and the water in their bodies was quickly lost, their lips were dry and cracked.
Soon, the three of them changed color at the same time. The temperature was beyond their expectations. If an ordinary person stood here, their body would be burned and their blood would boil to death!
The King of light took a deep breath and took the lead to fly hundreds of meters above the ground.
Dudian and Crimson Moon looked at each other. They didn’t dare to stay on the ground. The underground base was like a volcano that could erupt at any time. It was even more terrifying than a volcano. It was like a pressure cooker that was holding its breath, it was like a pressure cooker that could explode at any time!
“The main engine is still in the underground base. The temperature is so high. Is it burnt?”Dudian’s eyes flashed with a trace of worry. Although he knew that Lin Changsheng would be extra careful but the temperature was too terrifying, he didn’t know if Lin Changsheng would be able to cope with the temperature.
The temperature continued to rise. The three of them felt as if they were being grilled on a stove. They couldn’t stand the heat. From the high altitude they saw a huge red square on the ground, it was the outline of the underground base. The high temperature spread out from it. The temperature in the main engine city was rising rapidly. The ground near the underground base had cracks like magma. The ground gas was spewing out from it, the water pipes in the nearby underground burst. A large amount of steam tore through the road and covered the city in white fog.
The white fog couldn’t hinder the vision of Dudian and the other two. Their faces became more and more serious. In the end they became a bit ugly. No one had expected that the strength of the Fire Dragon Lord was so terrifying, it could release such high temperature which was not inferior to the nuclear bomb’s central area. It was simply a human-shaped sun!
The high temperature continued to expand. Dudian and the other two looked at it in fear. At a certain moment, it reached its limit!
Boom! ! !
An earth-shaking loud sound shook the entire world!
Before the explosion, the three of them had already sensed that the explosion was coming through the melted metal cracks on the underground base. However, they were still caught off guard when the explosion happened. The violent sound frightened the three of them, they felt that their hearts had stopped beating. Their eardrums were ringing. All the thoughts in their minds were scattered. They saw that the ground was blooming like a flaming lotus. Countless Golden Flames were spurting out!
A large amount of molten metal splashed into the sky. The three of them instinctively used their ability to defend. Scarlet Moon’s body was covered in black mist. Countless knights rushed out from the Black Mist. They raised their shields in front of them, dudian’s body was petrified. Sharp blades extended out from his petrified skin. The tip of the sharp blades suddenly twisted and turned into a rotating conical shield.
On the other side, the body of the King of light turned white as if it was transparent. His whole body was shining like a god.
The next moment, Crimson Moon’s knight was hit by the Golden Light. The golden light splashed onto his body. His snow white skin was burned and melted. The flesh and blood inside his body quickly evaporated, his bones were burnt and left a black mark.
Dudian’s sharp blade rotated the shield. The golden light was thrown to the side of Crimson Moon and the King of light. It caused secondary damage to Crimson Moon.
The King of light didn’t use any defense. It seemed that he was very confident in his own photochemical ability. But when the golden light passed through his body, his face suddenly changed. It seemed that a sharp blade had pierced through his body. There was a bit of pain on his eyebrows, he was enduring the pain. When the golden light passed through his body, he couldn’t help but roar. There was no trace of kindness on his face. Instead, he looked at Dudian in anger.
It was the first time that Dudian saw such a fierce appearance. He was a bit surprised. He sighed in his heart.
Soon, the golden rain of fire gradually disappeared. Except for Dudian, Crimson Moon and the King of Light’s faces were very ugly. They looked at Dudian with anger and killing intent.
Dudian ignored them and cut off the burnt cone shield. He looked at the battlefield below.
The ground base was completely exploded like a magma pool. The earth cracked open and lava flowed out of the ground. The entire main city was in a mess. The burning smoke condensed into gray clouds in the air, it gradually gathered into a dark cloud.
Dudian was about to use his x-ray vision to penetrate into the magma pool. Suddenly a white figure jumped out from the pool. Its body was emitting an astonishing cold air as it fled to another place.
At the same time, a ball of black mucus jumped out from the other side of the magma pool. The mucus formed a big mouth and roared: “Hurry Up! Don’t let him run away with the mechanical heart!”
With a glance, the three of them knew that this black mucus was the demon lord, while the escaping snow-white figure was a four-winged ice bird. It was most likely the Aragami that Lin Changsheng had controlled.
Meanwhile, in the lava pool below, the high temperature was still boiling. They could vaguely see that in the middle of the lava pool, there was still a figure that was emitting a terrifying high temperature standing there. However, the figure was no longer in human form and had become distorted.., it seemed to be the Fire Dragon Lord.
The three of them didn’t have time to think and quickly chased after the ice bird.
The Ice Bird’s speed was extremely fast. However, Dudian and the other two could barely keep up with it. Especially the king of light. His speed was the fastest. He was like an aurora as he kept closing the distance between him and the ice bird.
However, when the distance was close to 500 meters, he stopped closing the distance. It seemed that he didn’t want to leave the ice bird in case it retaliated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1189
chapters.content:
Chapter 1189: Chapter 1178: reversal
Translator:
549690339
Dudian had long seen that the king of light wasn’t loyal to the Devil Emperor. Otherwise he wouldn’t have come out with them. He would have helped the Devil Emperor. He looked at the ice bird, there was a complicated mechanical sphere embedded in its body. It was the core of the virtual host!
It could be said that this was the engine of the virtual host and also the brain of the virtual world.
Once the mechanical heart was destroyed, the virtual world would be closed. Even if it was opened again, it would be the world after the restart. Lin Changsheng was like a virus that was automatically deactivated.
“It seems that he has controlled the Aragami. Is it an invasion of consciousness...”Dudian squinted his eyes. He turned back and saw the demon king’s handsome youth with two huge black wings flapping behind his back, he was chasing after them but his speed wasn’t fast. Moreover the aura of the Aragami was a bit weak. His face was pale and it seemed that he was injured.
Dudian frowned as he thought of the terrible explosion. He knew that if he was in the depths of the explosion he might not be able to survive. It seemed that there was still a gap between him and the Aragami.
In the blink of an eye, the ice bird flew to the edge of the main city. The towering city wall was clearly visible. There were no civilians left in the city. There were only mechanical wreckage and collapsed buildings.
Although these buildings were built to prevent earthquakes but the chain reaction caused by the earth gas eruption after the main fire of the Fire Dragon had a great impact on the city. It was not comparable to the tremors caused by the giant beasts outside the city.
The ice bird suddenly stopped in front of the city wall. It turned around and looked at Dudian and the others who were chasing after it. The bird’s head turned into a human but it was expressionless, “You three can make it. Why are they chasing after me?”
Dudian frowned. He believed that Lin Changsheng knew that he knew the reason. The question was more likely to be directed at Crimson Moon and the King of Light. Moreover, he understood the meaning behind the question.
“Oh? Why?”Crimson Moon was interested but didn’t seem to know.
The King of light looked curious as he saw her speak.
The ice bird indifferently said: “Because I know the way to become a god. I also know how to solve the problem of all the monsters and undeads in the world. The Fire Dragon Lord has set himself on fire. The Devil Emperor has been severely injured by him. If the three of you cooperate with me to kill the Devil Emperor, I can tell you the method. But even if you know the method, it will be very difficult for you to become a God!”
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He was sure that the ice bird was part of Lin Changsheng’s consciousness. It was the incarnation of Lin Changsheng. It seemed that he hadn’t found the divine embryo and was facing the attack of the Devil Emperor and the Fire Dragon Lord, he had to find a spare tire to use as a combat body.
Lin Changsheng’s words were clearly directed at him, Crimson Moon and the King of light. On the one hand, he told them that he could solve the problem of undeads and make them cooperate. On the other hand, he also told them how to Bewitch Crimson Moon and the others to become gods.
“Humph!”At this time, the Devil Emperor had rushed to Dudian and the others. He had heard the ice bird’s words, “Don’t listen to his nonsense. It seems that you are at the end of your rope!”
Crimson moon smiled: “That’s right. I didn’t think that you would say such a stupid thing. I advise you to stop...”
Before she could finish her words, she suddenly attacked. Her palm was covered with a terrifying black mist as she slapped towards the demon emperor.
“You’re courting death!”The Demon Emperor snorted coldly. There was a hint of anger in his voice. He was not surprised or caught off guard. It was as if he had expected this. Dark energy covered his entire body as he punched out.
With a bang, the Black Fist collided with the palm covered in mist. Crimson Moon groaned and her body flew backwards. She put some distance between her and the demon emperor as her expression turned cold.
The demon lord withdrew his fist and said coldly, “You dare to betray me? !”
The coldness in Crimson Moon’s eyes suddenly disappeared. She said with a faint smile, “What betrayal? I just want to know if what he said is true or false.”
The demon lord sneered, “You believe such a stupid thing? It seems that you are also very stupid!”
“So, you and Fire Dragon Lord didn’t kill him to become a god?”Crimson Moon said with a chuckle, “Can you guarantee that?”
The Demon Emperor’s expression turned cold as he looked straight at her, but he did not answer.
He could lie and pretend, but he could see that crimson moon and the radiant king beside her already had the answer in their hearts, so there was no need for him to lie anymore.
“Since the opportunity to become a god is right in front of us, why don’t you tell us? What’s the point of being loyal to such a Master?”Crimson Moon chuckled and glanced at the radiant king beside her. “What do you think?”
The King of light smiled sheepishly and said, “His Majesty didn’t tell us. Naturally, His Majesty has his reasons. Crimson King, you’d better apologize to His Majesty...”
“Stop pretending. He Won’t give you another chance to launch a sneak attack,”Crimson Moon interrupted him, he snorted coldly and said, “Just now, my sneak attack was guarded by him. He didn’t trust us at all. Moreover, you came out to observe but didn’t help. Do you think he won’t settle the score with you?”
The smile on the face of the King of light was stiff. It seemed that his face was trembling. He took a deep breath and sighed as he slowly floated to Crimson Moon’s side, “Your Majesty, you don’t trust us so much. It is difficult for us to deal with you!”
The Demon King’s face was cold as he glanced at Dudian.
Dudian didn’t expect that the relationship would be broken in an instant so that Lin Changsheng could succeed. He sighed in his heart. If it wasn’t because of Crimson Moon’s strength that he was a god’s child, he would have continued to pretend like the King of light, he wouldn’t have directly torn off the relationship and let Lin Changsheng sit on the mountain and watch the Tigers fight.
“I can help you if you tell me the way to deal with the undeads.”Dudian said to the ice bird.
The ice bird raised its eyebrows: “I will tell you when I deal with the Devil Emperor!”
“I can promise you as long as you tell me. I will help you!”Dudian said. He didn’t want to fight with the Devil Emperor. He faintly felt that the one who was injured wasn’t the Devil Emperor but Lin Changsheng!
The Devil Emperor was aware of Crimson Moon’s hidden identity and strength. So he deliberately turned against the Fire Dragon Lord to give Crimson Moon a chance to jump out!
He wanted to get what he wanted before the battle. Moreover the initiative was in his hands so he was qualified to negotiate.
Ice Bird’s face turned gloomy as he stared at Dudian for a moment. He sneered: “I’ve changed my mind. Devil Emperor, I suggest that we kill him first before we discuss other things. Is that Alright?”
Dudian was startled.
The eyes of the devil emperor flashed as he coldly said: “It’s good that there is one less hindrance!”
Crimson Moon slightly frowned. She had made an alliance with Dudian to deal with the Devil Emperor. Dudian could be considered as her assistant. However, she knew that the King of light was standing by her side, it would be easier to deal with the remaining King of light and Lin Changsheng. Moreover, she wouldn’t have to worry about Dudian and the king of light coercing her.
She nodded: “Yes!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1190
chapters.content:
Chapter 1190: Chapter 1179: Fight for your life
Translator:
549690339
Dudian’s face changed. The situation was reversed in an instant. Originally, Lin Changsheng had been chased to a dead end by them but now the situation was reversed, he had become the target of everyone in this situation.
He could guess the reason why Crimson Moon would agree but he didn’t know why the Devil Emperor would agree! Was he just worried that he would help Lin Changsheng in turn?
He felt that the reason wasn’t so simple, but he couldn’t think of any other reason at the moment. He looked at the devil emperor: “I can help you to deal with Lin Changsheng. I know his secret!”
“There is no need!”The Devil Emperor coldly said.
Dudian was startled.
He looked at the Devil Emperor’s cold expression. He suddenly realized what he was thinking!
He was planning to clear out the place. He was going to follow Lin Changsheng’s intention. He could clear out the insignificant bystanders. Then he could cooperate with Crimson Moon or Lin Changsheng to solve the other side. In the end, Lin Changsheng would be left alone to enjoy!
He looked at Crimson Moon and spoke quickly: “We have formed an alliance before. You Can’t go back on your words. This is their scheme!”
Crimson Moon paused for a moment. It wasn’t that Dudian said that she couldn’t go back on her word. For people of their status, a promise was just a scheme. There was no feeling of embarrassment after breaking the promise, that was the mentality of ordinary people. She also felt that the reaction of the Devil Emperor was a bit strange. If it was a scheme, then..
“They were in the underground. Maybe they had conspired at that time. The Devil Emperor knew your identity and strength. He deliberately defected and killed the Fire Dragon Lord. He gave you the opportunity to betray him!”Dudian hurriedly said, he hoped to persuade Crimson Moon. Otherwise he would face the most desperate situation.
“Humph!”The ice bird snorted and said: “What are you talking about? Kill him. I will join hands with you to deal with Effiny Hughes. I will give you a share of what you want!”
Crimson Moon frowned slightly and hesitated.
The ice bird sneered, “Why? Do you really believe his nonsense? “If I joined hands with this old devil, why would I be afraid of Him? “Isn’t it an easy thing to kill you? “Why bother wasting my breath with you? Since this man is wavering, wanting to help the Devil Emperor and me, keeping him is a disaster!”
The King of light looked at crimson moon and whispered: “What he said makes sense.”
Crimson Moon’s eyes flashed for a moment. She clenched her teeth and shouted: “Kill him first!”She took the lead and rushed towards Dudian. Black Mist covered her body and turned into a dark domain. A large amount of mist monsters rushed out from the dark domain, she barked at Dudian.
Dudian’s face turned red. He was angry and angry. He didn’t expect that Crimson Moon would be persuaded with just a few words. Did she really think that his strength could solve the problem of the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng! How confident was she in herself? !
In her eyes, her value was equal to or even inferior to that of the King of light so she could abandon him.
In this situation, it was best to get rid of a marginal figure like him!
The situation was reversed by him. Although the Devil Emperor and Crimson Moon had different thoughts but it wasn’t easy.
“Get lost!”
Dudian roared. The sharp blades of his body expanded as he killed all the monsters in the Black Fog.
At this time the Devil King rushed over. Dark energy surged out from his body as thorns shot out from his arm. The thorns were like sharp needles that turned into rattan whips that wrapped around his body.
On the other side, a pure white gem appeared on the back of the hand of the King of light. He raised his hand and shot out beams of light. They were extremely sharp and penetrated through his neck and arm, he could feel that the blood and bones in his body were burning hot after being pierced by the beams of light.
In the blink of an eye, the three of them joined hands. On the other side, the ice bird spat out mist and also covered him.
Dudian was in a desperate situation. He felt as if his blood was burning. His eyes were bloodshot and ferocious. He looked at Crimson Moon, the Devil Emperor and the King of Light, everyone’s expression was indifferent. It seemed that they wanted to finish him as soon as possible.
He thought of a sentence: “I’m a meat on the chopping block!”!
In the eyes of Crimson Moon and the Devil Emperor He was a meat on the chopping block!
But he knew that he wasn’t. He could feel the anger and anger of the Fire Dragon Lord. No wonder he chose to die with the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng. Unfortunately he couldn’t do it.
“Since you want to kill me, then prepare to die!”Dudian roared. His body suddenly shot out countless sharp blades, the black blades were covered with thick flames. They instantly cut off the dark domain of the Crimson Moon!
On the other side, he swung the sharp blades to cut off the Devil Emperor’s thorns. They went straight for his head!
The Devil Emperor frowned. It seemed that he didn’t expect that the king of the Federation would be able to burst out with such powerful momentum and strength. He wasn’t inferior to the king of light who had been by his side for many years.
He didn’t want to meet the enemy head on. He stepped back to avoid Dudian’s sharp blade.
“Crimson Moon!”Dudian’s eyes were red. They were full of destructive madness and extreme killing intent. He wanted to skin crimson moon as he had the deepest enmity with him, at the moment he ignored the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng as he directly rushed towards Crimson Moon.
Crimson Moon’s face slightly changed. She didn’t expect that Dudian would choose her as the main target. She didn’t expect that Dudian’s sudden burst of energy would be so powerful that he wasn’t inferior to the king of light, he was several times stronger than the previous fake will battle in the underground base. He was completely beyond the scope of an ordinary king. Both the speed and strength of gene reconstruction were not comparable to an ordinary king.
Crimson Moon didn’t want to reveal her strength too early. She was forced to retreat by Dudian’s sharp blades. The next moment, the King of light released beams of light towards Dudian, he didn’t intend to engage in close combat.
“Don’t you want to become a god? Aren’t you concealing your strength? Aren’t you very confident in yourself? !”Dudian’s body extended hundreds of meters, his body was demonized to be hundreds of meters long. He looked like a strange devil tyrant. His body was covered with sharp blades including his face. His hair had condensed into two black axes. He could cause terrifying damage if he hit his head.
There was no part of his body that wasn’t an attack blade.
This terrifying image surprised Lin Changsheng and the Devil Emperor. Especially the Devil Emperor. He didn’t know much about dudian. He didn’t expect that there would be such a powerful king hidden here. He suddenly understood.., why did Lin Changsheng choose to kill Dudian first? This was definitely a hidden variable!
Crimson Moon was forced to retreat by Dudian’s attack. The dark area around her body was riddled with holes. Dudian’s sharp blade had flames attached to it which directly tore her black mist. It wasn’t a pure physical attack.
She tried to use her own bones to demonize a shield to block Dudian’s attack but was cut into pieces by Dudian’s sharp blade. She didn’t expect that Dudian’s sharp blade would be so terrifying, it was far beyond her expectations.
“You are courting death!”Crimson Moon saw that Dudian was chasing after her, she knew that she couldn’t continue to retreat. She could only reveal her hidden strength under Dudian’s storm-like attack. Otherwise she wouldn’t have a chance to live!
However, once she exposed her strength, the situation would be out of her control. She was extremely angry and wanted to tear Dudian apart.
Dudian saw her angry appearance. He felt that the anger in his heart seemed to have been vented a lot. He couldn’t help but laugh out loud. However, after laughing a few times, he felt his chest twitch and couldn’t help but tremble.
He didn’t suppress the limits of his body. He urged the power in his body. This made his heart overwork. It beat extremely violently as if it was going to explode.

chapters.title: Chapter 1191 - Chapter 1180: Rapid Evolution
chapters.content:
Chapter 1191: Chapter 1180: Rapid Evolution
Translator:
549690339
Dudian clenched his teeth and endured the pain in his heart. He knew that he was recklessly squandering the strength of his body. The monster in his heart would get more nutrients and wake up earlier, but things had come to this point. There was no use in scheming. Since he couldn’t survive, he might as well destroy everything. In any case, he was tired of this random world!
“Devouring domain!”Crimson Moon’s face was full of anger. She shouted in a low voice. There were finger-sized holes all over her body. It was extremely dark. A large amount of black smoke was ejected from her body. The smoke was as thick as silk and didn’t melt, it seemed that she was conscious as it enveloped dudian.
Although Dudian was angry, but at the moment he was maintaining his clairvoyance. When the Black Mist was ejected from Crimson Moon’s body, he saw that the air was quickly devoured, the oxygen and other components in the air were quickly digested and assimilated. This was a power that she didn’t have in the previous dark domain. He didn’t Dodge nor did he have time to dodge. Instead, he rushed forward.
Whoosh!
Two huge wings suddenly opened on his back. He fiercely flapped and swept up a small hurricane to block the Black Mist released by Crimson Moon.
The Black Mist was more special than he had imagined. The hurricane couldn’t completely blow it away. However he didn’t expect to rely on the wind to crack the ability of Crimson Moon. As long as he could block the spread of the Black Mist.
“Reconstruction!”Dudian stared at the Black Fog. His perspective was crazily permeating through the black fog. His perspective was more like a microscope than a perspective. At the moment he was crazily shrinking and peeling the layers of the black fog, he saw the deepest source of the black fog. Every particle’s structure and changes were seen in his eyes. It was an extremely complicated pattern of movement. Ordinary people would feel dizzy just by looking at it. They might even suffer from agoraphobia, however, he used all the memory hippocampus in his brain to forcefully imprint this pattern.
At the same time, his body rapidly changed according to the pattern imprinted on it. He used a demonized monster limb as an experiment. He disassembled and reconstructed the genes inside and simulated it into a black fog.
Soon, black smoke rose from the demonized monster limb. In the blink of an eye, it turned into a black fog. The black fog looked loose and drifting, but he felt that he could control the black fog. There seemed to be something invisible, like a thread.., it connected the black fog to him.
From a biological point of view, there were no veins or nerves in the black fog. It was impossible to control it. But at the moment, he could feel his control over the black fog, in addition, he could feel the temperature in the air through the black fog.
He didn’t know the reason why Crimson Moon had created the black fog. But he suddenly understood that the ultimate direction of their evolution was “God”. God was omnipotent and had no form, didn’t it reflect this theory?
“Life is not just flesh and blood. It could be something else. For example, my stone skin...”Dudian’s eyes flashed with a hint of understanding. Although he had demonized limbs many times but none of them were human flesh and blood, but he didn’t really understand this point. It was like many people who had heard many great truths but never really understood the truth.
Only if they personally understood it would they be able to speak and act. No matter how much outsiders taught them it would be futile.
All of this happened in a very short period of time. The Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng weren’t in a hurry so they didn’t interrupt Dudian’s attack on Crimson Moon, crimson Moon was shocked when she saw Dudian’s black mist. She didn’t expect that her ability would be copied by dudian in a few seconds even though she knew that Dudian had the constitution and potential of a God! But wasn’t the speed of learning too fast? !
Even she didn’t think that she would be able to learn such a difficult ability in such a short time.
The Devil Emperor and the King of light saw Dudian’s black mist. They were so shocked that they forgot to continue the attack. The Devil Emperor’s face was full of shock. He didn’t expect that the latter’s identity wasn’t just a king, but he was the same as them!
The King of Light’s eyes flashed with a trace of jealousy and killing intent. But he quickly hid it. The attack in his hand was several times stronger than before. The density of the beam was far from comparable to before. It was fast and sharp, the sharp blade easily pierced through Dudian’s body.
Dudian was about to use the black fog to fight with crimson moon when he was interrupted by the King of light. The killing intent in his eyes was boiling. He coldly glanced at the king of light. The warning in his eyes was very obvious.
The King of light didn’t seem to understand. His face was indifferent as the light on the back of his hand kept flashing.
Dudian’s body was pierced by beams of light. The pain came from all parts of his body including his heart. However the beams disappeared after they went into his heart. It seemed that they were digested, however the beams of light from other parts of his body exploded. Blood Mist burst out from his body.
Dudian thought of the killer move to deal with Crimson Moon but was forced by the King of light. He was so angry that he almost burst out of his chest. He couldn’t wait to abandon Crimson Moon and pounce on the king of light.
However he knew that once he opened the distance between him and Crimson Moon he would be attacked from both sides. Crimson Moon wouldn’t miss the opportunity to kill him.
“I’ll find you after I kill her!”Dudian stared at the King of light. Crystals suddenly appeared on his body. When the king of Light’s beam hit the crystal, it bounced back, however it didn’t bounce back in a straight line but slanted to the other side. It almost hit the Devil Emperor.
The King of light didn’t expect that dudian would use such a method to counter his attack. He couldn’t help but frown. His hand movements slowed down. If he wanted to continue to cause damage to Dudian then he would have to use close combat or use his true ability, but he didn’t want to be exposed too early.
After thinking about it for a long time he held back. He slowed down his shooting speed and shot at Dudian’s eyes, throat and other weak points.
Dudian created another eyeball on his forehead. The vision became clearer. The eyeball was focused on the king of light. The eyeball was focused on his body and arms. When the eyeball was focused on his brain.., dudian saw that there was a hairy worm with short white fur in the soft tissues of his brain. There was a clear difference between this worm and the one he had seen before, it had a large golden eye.
He didn’t have time to think about the special reason for this worm. He remembered that this was the weakness of the King of light. This was the difference between the king and them. The God’s embryo didn’t rely on the magic worm so there was no weakness, once a king was killed, the magic worm in his body would be crippled or die.

chapters.title: Chapter 1192
chapters.content:
Chapter 1192: Chapter 1181: Divide and conquer
Translator:
549690339
At this time, Scarlet Moon saw that Dudian had learned her own devouring domain. She immediately changed the structure of the domain and mixed poison into the black fog so that Dudian’s black fog couldn’t assimilate it, by relying on her own quantity, she could in turn devour part of the black fog that Dudian had demonized.
All these changes were very clear in Dudian’s eyes. When he saw that the black fog of the Crimson Moon had changed again, Dudian immediately guessed her thoughts. But at the moment, he had no time to continue to follow the changing structure, after all, one was an independent structure and the other was a simulation. It would always be a beat slower. Moreover, the black fog of the Crimson Moon had already enveloped the area.
“Flame!”
Dudian growled. The Black Fog suddenly turned into a red blood fog. It then began to burn like a huge fireball. It collided with the Black Fog of Crimson Moon. The Black Fog of crimson moon shrank rapidly like snow, crimson Moon was forced to retreat. The high temperature of the blood fog had a suppressive effect on the black fog of Crimson Moon. Although it was mixed with poison, but in front of the high temperature, it was all burnt to ashes.
Scarlet Moon’s face changed. She quickly used her mind to create ice in the Black Mist. It emitted thick cold air to compete with Dudian’s blood mist. But she soon found that the temperature of Dudian’s blood mist was extremely terrifying, the ice that she created was completely unstoppable. Unless she used all her strength to push the ice to more than 200 degrees below zero then it would be possible to suppress Dudian’s blood mist.
“He has a deeper understanding of the flame structure than I do!”Crimson Moon quickly realized this and quickly retracted the black mist. She didn’t go head to head with Dudian. Although the latter didn’t continue to simulate her black mist structure.., but the destructive power of the flame structure had surpassed her. This was her specialty but Dudian had defeated her in this aspect!
She thought that Dudian was once a lamb waiting to be slaughtered by her scalpel. But now he was able to defeat her in her own field. She felt humiliated and angry. She hated and was angry at Dudian!
“You want to run?”Dudian saw Crimson Moon retreat and immediately ridiculed, “Didn’t you want to kill me? Why did you run away? !”
“How Dare You Provoke Me!”Crimson Moon was furious. Blood flashed in her eyes as she stopped her body. She naturally wouldn’t be fooled by Dudian’s provocation. However she knew that there was no point for her to continue to retreat, it could be seen from Lin Changsheng and the Devil Emperor’s casual attacks that they wanted to use Dudian’s hands to deal with her. Even if she cried out for help at this moment they would only do it symbolically and wouldn’t do their best.
If she threatened, it was possible that she would end up like Dudian and become the first target of the public. In turn, she would cooperate with Dudian to attack her.
There was no real alliance here. She could only rely on herself.
She regretted that she shouldn’t have agreed to Lin Changsheng’s proposal. She had paid the most in the siege of Dudian. She had neglected the harm that Dudian had caused and the hatred that Dudian had for her.
People would always forget the people that they had hurt and remember the people who had hurt them.
“Since you have run away from me, I will let you die this time!”Crimson Moon gnashed her teeth as she looked at dudian. Suddenly her pupils turned silver white and a nearly transparent fluctuation surged out from her eyes.
Buzz!
Dudian who was chasing after Crimson Moon felt his brain shake. He felt dizzy. When he regained consciousness, he felt a sharp pain all over his body. He saw that many of the sharp blades on his body had been cut off. In addition, he felt a burning sensation on his forehead, it was the light beam shot by the King of light. Fortunately he had strengthened his skull so that it didn’t Pierce through his brain. Otherwise, although he wouldn’t die but his memory would be destroyed.
“You are courting death!”Dudian’s eyes were gloomy, he knew that the previous moment of dizziness was most likely from Crimson Moon. He saw the strange fluctuations coming from her silver pupils. It seemed that it was some kind of special ability to attack the brain. It was very complicated, it was several times more complicated than the structure of the black fog. He didn’t have the time to observe and copy it in this rapidly changing battle. He could only think of ways to defend.
He searched all the memories in his brain, including a part of Lin Changsheng’s memory which hadn’t been forgotten. Soon he found a special material. It was the metal structure of the magic bug spaceship.
It was the memory of Lin Changsheng dismantling the magic bug spaceship. Dudian saw the structure of the metal spaceship. He didn’t even think about it. He immediately made the skull of the brain look like that special metal. However the skull wasn’t made of metal but was made of bone, it was arranged according to the density of the metal and the elements. If he could see his own head then he should be able to see the strange texture on the surface of the skull.
“I can’t even see through my own perspective so it shouldn’t hurt my brain.”Dudian thought as he shouted to crimson moon: “Let’s Join Hands and kill the King of light. I will assist you in killing the Devil Emperor. How about that?”
Crimson Moon was startled. She didn’t expect Dudian to suddenly propose an alliance. They had already fallen out and they were fighting to such an extent. How could dudian still want to form an alliance with her?
However, she quickly reacted. There was only interest between them. Dudian’s proposal was completely in line with Dudian’s interests. She was willing to do so.
“Alright!”
Scarlet Moon immediately agreed. She saw that Dudian’s strength was not much inferior to hers. He was far stronger than the King of light. The latter’s weakness was too obvious, it was normal to have such a weakness. But in front of their ever-changing attacks, the king of light couldn’t protect the magic worm in his head.
The aggressive battle and hatred suddenly formed an alliance. The Devil Emperor, Lin Changsheng and the king of light were surprised. The King of Light’s face changed when he heard Crimson Moon’s agreement, the handsome face contorted in anger: “Crimson King, how can you go back on your words!”
“Isn’t this my style?”Crimson Moon laughed.
“A king dares to disturb the situation here!”Dudian stopped the momentum of rushing towards Crimson Moon. He coldly looked at the King of light.
The Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng stopped their attacks at the same time. It seemed that they didn’t want to interfere.
The battle in the sky seemed to have turned into a battle between dudian, Crimson Moon and the King of light. The three of them should have been allies.
“Despicable earthling! !”The King of light roared. His body glowed as he rushed into the distance. He was faster than the speed of sound.
“I can particle too!”Dudian snorted. His whole body turned into particles. His speed increased as he chased after the king of light. There was a spiral hole on his back, his speed increased as he slowly caught up with the king of light.
Crimson Moon narrowed her eyes as she chased after the king of light. She thought that she was the only one who had hidden her strength. She didn’t expect that Dudian was also disguised.
Soon, Scarlet Moon’s body turned into a particle and caught up with the king of light.
Dudian raised his hand and threw out a flame blade. Even if the King of light was in a particle state, he would be injured. This wasn’t a pure physical attack.
The King of light roared as he saw the flame blade whistling towards him. His body suddenly split into two. After the flame blade passed through his body, his body closed up again and continued to escape.
“You can’t escape!”Crimson Moon sneered. With a raise of her hand, spears made of black fog shot out, enveloping the radiant king’s body for dozens of feet like pear blossom spears.
The Radiant King’s expression was unsightly. Suddenly, his entire body shone brightly. Countless light arrows shot out, colliding with Crimson Moon’s black fog spears and canceling each other out.
Crimson Moon raised her hand again, and countless black spears were formed.
The King of light continued to use the light beams to block. They collided almost every second. It was extremely beautiful. In just a few minutes, they had collided hundreds of times.
Dudian and Crimson Moon cooperated. He threw out his flaming blade in the gap between the structure of Crimson Moon’s spear. The King of light was tired of defending. Soon his face turned pale and his body slightly trembled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1193
chapters.content:
Chapter 1193: Chapter 1,182: The Great Sage
Translator:
549690339
“Don’t force me!”The Radiant King panted heavily, his face ferocious. “Don’t think that I don’t have the ability to drag you down with me. I’m willing to quit. If you continue to pursue me, I’ll kill whoever goes first!”
Crimson Moon frowned slightly and slowed down. She hesitated. During her time in the empire, she knew some secrets about the radiant king. She knew that he wasn’t an ordinary king. The demonic insect in his mind was extremely powerful, it had swallowed the human will in his body. It was completely controlled by the magic worm. It wasn’t like other kings who were affected by the interference of the magic worm.
“Who knows when you will come back?”Dudian raised his eyebrows as he saw Scarlet Moon’s hesitation, he imitated the indifferent expression of the king of light: “If I’m Like You Then I’m willing to quit. I’ll sit back and watch the Tigers fight. Wouldn’t it be better to intervene in the end?”
“You!”The King of Light glared at him. He didn’t expect that Crimson Moon wouldn’t be the one to attack but the king of the federation.
“What do you think?”Dudian looked at the ice bird and the Devil Emperor. The Ice Bird was the incarnation of Lin Changsheng. He didn’t take advantage of the chaos to leave or the Devil Emperor would chase after him, dudian and Crimson Moon would join forces with the Devil Emperor to kill him. So he was indifferent as if he didn’t care that he was the target of everyone.
The Devil Emperor didn’t respond.
The ice bird seemed to be detached from the matter.
Dudian sneered: “Let him go since he doesn’t want to be the first one. I Won’t be the last one.”He stopped his attack.
Crimson Moon’s face slightly changed. If she let the King of light run away then he would have time to recuperate. If he came back then she would be weak and would be able to help him.
Her eyes flashed as she looked at the devil emperor: “Your Majesty, if you don’t speak then let him go.”
The devil emperor indifferently said: “Since he is a problem then let’s solve it. Why are you looking for trouble?”
The Light King’s face changed, and he said angrily, “Your Majesty, I have followed you for so many years, and I have fought everywhere. Even if I haven’t contributed much, I have worked hard. I am willing to help you. Why did you abandon me? !”
The demon king said indifferently, “Don’t you have an answer to this question in Your Heart?”
“You knew long ago?”The Light King’s face changed, and he looked at him fiercely, “But I knew that you knew. You even knew her secret. She is the same as you!”! “But you pretended that you didn’t know. You ambushed the Fire Dragon Lord. It is obvious that you are giving her a chance to jump out. You must have joined forces with Lin Changsheng. We will kill Crimson Moon after we die!”
He was referring to Dudian.
Dudian didn’t show any reaction. On the contrary, Crimson Moon’s face slightly changed. She didn’t want to believe it but at the moment she felt uneasy. If she was dealing with the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng.., she felt that she could barely cope with the situation. But the key was that the death of the King of light and the presence of Dudian made her unable to control the situation!
“What’s the point of struggling? Great Sage?”The eyes of the Devil Emperor turned cold, “Do you think I don’t know the purpose of your compromise by my side? You were captured by my father and used to protect my family’s tomb and territory. You knelt down in hopes that one day you would be able to stand up. But you didn’t know that I had already seen through your thoughts.”
“You’ve knelt for too long. Your Horizons are too limited. Don’t you want to return to your own planet? Don’t you want to find the formula for perfect life? “HMPH, it’s a pity that the formula is already available. Your ice demon insect clan had already completed their experiment on Lin Changsheng over two hundred years ago. It’s a pity that he dodged it. Do you know why every time the Crimson Moon descends, I gather all of You Kings to discuss the battle
“Sea Beasts? Snow Apes? I don’t even care about those little things of theirs. I just want you all to stay under my nose and not give you the chance to report me.”
At this point, the demon lord sneered, “The apostles that you secretly sent out to infiltrate the Federation were also killed. Do you know why? “That’s right. Two hundred years ago, my father signed a confidentiality agreement with Lin Changsheng. This agreement will continue to extend to me, and it will continue to continue in the future. The ice magic bugs that returned to Earth will never be able to know the true situation on Earth!”
The eyes of the King of Light opened wide in disbelief.
Scarlet Moon’s eyes lit up. She turned her head and coldly looked at the devil. It seemed that she was ready to attack at any time.
Dudian was a bit surprised. He didn’t think that there would be such secrets. He thought of the fierce battle on the border. He suddenly felt that it was a bit funny. The generals and soldiers at the bottom were fighting with passion, the story of the war was moving. But he didn’t know that the top rulers had secretly conspired to form an alliance.
So, what was the meaning of these sacrificed soldiers?
He felt that the value measurement was too cruel and ruthless.
There would be leaders and leaders in the group. It was like a pyramid system. When there was a pyramid system, there would be a situation where the top looked down on the bottom. When life was no longer equal, there would be tragedy and tragedy.
When one was born in such a group and existed in such a form of life, perhaps it was already destined that one would have to face such a thing and endure such a thing, be it obedience or the king’s Landing!
The demon lord seemed to know the killing intent in Crimson Moon’s eyes, but his expression did not change, he said indifferently, “However, the confidentiality agreement is only to keep Lin Changsheng’s existence a secret, and Lin Changsheng will also pay a corresponding price. But outside of this agreement, it does not prevent us from fighting each other. Just like the two dragon lords of the Fire Dragon Kingdom, they were also one of the people who signed the confidentiality agreement. But Now? “The Fire Dragon Lord is dead!”
Crimson Moon continued to look at him coldly, her killing intent not lessening in the slightest.
The light king said angrily, “Since the two of you have colluded in the confidentiality agreement, who knows if the two of you have colluded in other agreements now? For example, to get rid of us first? To let us kill each other, and then you guys clean us up before finally fighting each other?”
The demon lord said indifferently, “If you guys are worried, you can just get rid of Lin Changsheng first. What do you mean by killing each other? Isn’t that too laughable? Are the two of you considered to be on the same side? “If it weren’t for your own ulterior motives, how could you be incited by Lin Changsheng’s Light Words?”
The King of light was slightly stifled, his face turning purple.
“Don’t think that I don’t know your plans. You Already Know Crimson Moon’s power and used her to deal with me. No matter which one of US dies, you will take away the body of the dead and achieve the perfect state of life that you seek.”The Demon Emperor sneered, “It’s a pity that plans can’t be changed. I’m guessing that you have the same plan, Lin Changsheng?”? “You already knew that this little brother has a special constitution and isn’t an ordinary king. You wanted us to finish him off first and then take away his body. In this way, none of us will be your match!”
His words suddenly shifted to Lin Changsheng. The ice bird was slightly startled, but she did not deny her current identity. She coldly snorted, “This person is not from our federation but from your empire. Otherwise, how would your new Crimson Moon King Know Him?”
Dudian saw that the demon king wanted to hide his relationship with him but didn’t immediately expose it. Although it would slap Lin Changsheng’s face but it would be disadvantageous to him. Perhaps Lin Changsheng had expected this.., so he had the confidence to say so.
The Devil Emperor looked at Dudian. He frowned as he saw that Dudian was indifferent. It seemed that he was a bit disappointed but the emotion didn’t stay on his face for a second, he said: “In any case, my suggestion is to get rid of the great sage. As for the next matter, we will talk about it later.”
Scarlet Moon looked at Dudian. She was silent for a moment before nodding her head.
Dudian also expressed that he had no objection.
Ice bird indifferently said: “That’s good.”
For Lin Changsheng, the King of light had to be killed or else he would be exposed. If he didn’t want to get Dudian’s body to deal with the current situation, his first target would be the king of light.
The King of light was so angry that his whole body was shaking. His face turned red. He was the king of the Empire and the great sage of magic insects. No matter what kind of identity he had, he was incomparably noble, but now he was sentenced to death in a few words. He didn’t even have the space to interrupt. This kind of feeling made him want to self-destruct. But he knew that even if he tried his best.., he wouldn’t be able to kill the Devil Emperor, Crimson Moon and the others.
“Kill!”Dudian shouted.
Crimson Moon didn’t take the lead. She was afraid that the king of light would do the same to her.
The Devil Emperor didn’t stand idly by. He was the first to rush over.

chapters.title: Chapter 1194
chapters.content:
Chapter 1194: Chapter 1183: Dead or alive
Translator:
549690339
“Whoever wants to kill me will die with me!”The face of the King of light was twisted. If everyone was a king then he would be able to escape from here, however the Devil Emperor and Crimson Moon as well as Lin Changsheng were not simple characters. Even if he revealed his true form it would be difficult for him to escape death. He could only fight to the death and sacrifice himself for his own race!
Seeing the Devil Emperor was the first to rush over, he immediately locked his eyes on the Devil Emperor. The light from his body suddenly blazed like a high-energy incandescent lamp. It illuminated the sky and Earth in pure white. It was dazzling. Even with Dudian’s strong vision.., he felt that his vision was pure white. Countless light particles completely blocked his vision. He couldn’t see through it. He felt as if his body was molting and burning.
“Counter attack?”Dudian thought of the terrifying movement of the Fire Dragon Lord’s counter attack. His eyes moved but he didn’t retreat. Instead he tried to turn his eyes to search for the shoulder, neck, cheek and other parts of the body, seven or eight eyes suddenly popped out. They kept rotating and gradually filtered out a vague figure from the intense white light. It was Crimson Moon!
Whoosh!
He suddenly rushed forward but didn’t reveal any killing intent before the attack. His expression was calm. The strange eyeballs on his body were also very calm. However, when he was about thirty feet away from Crimson Moon, the crazy killing intent could no longer be controlled, the muscles all over his body suddenly squirmed. Terrifying sharp blades whistled out from the inside. They shot out from all parts of his body, including the part of his neck where the eyeballs grew out. The eyeballs closed and the structure instantly changed, the sharp blade shot out.
The sound of flesh being cut echoed. Hot blood splattered all over his face. Dudian narrowed his eyes. He saw that Crimson Moon’s figure was pierced but strangely turned into a distorted smoke, he quickly floated to another place and turned into a humanoid again. A large amount of black fog burst out from his body and covered his entire body. He disappeared into the black fog.
“Go to hell!”
Suddenly, a crazy roar came from another place.
Dudian felt the hair on his body stand up. He felt the sharp blade cutting towards his neck. Death was approaching in an instant. His brain was stiff for a moment. He stopped thinking but the moment was extremely short. By the time he reacted.., the first thing he did was to put some distance between his body and the danger. He saw the intense white light shrink and transform into a compressed beam of light. It suddenly pierced through the slender figure of the devil emperor, it went through the sky from the back to the far end of the horizon!
This scene was more terrifying than all the laser cannons he had seen!
Dudian was startled for a moment. The white light in his line of sight gradually disappeared. He saw the king of light in front of the Devil Emperor turn from a handsome youth into a white-haired old man in the blink of an eye, it seemed that the blow had completely drained his life energy!
While he was surprised, the other eye noticed that there was a mass of black fog flying towards him from the other side of his line of sight.
Dudian quickly came back to his senses. He didn’t pay attention to the situation on the side of the Lord of Light. The length and width of the sharp blades on his body were rapidly increasing. The size of his body was also rapidly expanding. In the blink of an eye, he had turned into a giant with sharp blades all over his body, to be precise it was a giant humanoid monster. The back of its hands and arms were curved like dragon thorns and sharp knives.
He roared as he rushed towards the black fog. The sharp blades turned red as flames appeared. The Black Fog was instantly torn apart, revealing the dark moon that was made of ink. The black mucus on her face had faded. Her face was pale and ugly, she stared at Dudian with anger: “You Dare to Sneak Attack Me? No one can save you today!”
Dudian didn’t say a word. He crazily attacked. The burning sharp blade turned into thousands of cold light and covered Crimson Moon’s body.
Crimson Moon roared. Her voice turned hoarse like a wild beast. There was no trace of human voice. The next moment her body changed, her arms and legs were bent into multi-limb claws. Twelve Black Wings grew out from her back. However, there was thick mucous membrane between the wings. There was an unusually cold face behind her head, it was the disappeared bolo!
Dudian was startled for a moment. He thought of something and said in a deep voice: “You Are Not Scarlet Moon. You Are Bolo!”
“You are wrong. I am both her and Bolo.”Crimson Moon’s body was no longer standing straight. She was prostrating on the ground. Bolo’s face was revealed from the back of her head, the voice was Crimson Moon’s female voice, “Our memories have become one. She swallowed me. I didn’t know that she would read my memories. I deliberately looked for her to die. Only when we die can we become one. I will never be separated from my Dana!”
His voice was full of affection.
Dudian sneered: “Your Dana has long died. Crimson Moon is just a substitute for you. Although I don’t know how you devoured her memories but her body is still hers. She is confused by your memories. She thinks that she is you!”
“Hehe, don’t you dare to use such words to mess with my mind. You Don’t understand my current situation. Although Crimson Moon is a replica of me but she has inherited all of Dana’s memory. Memory is the core that distinguishes everyone. The outer skin is not rotten flesh and blood. It is the same. The reason why you are you is because your memory tells you that you are you. If it were other memories, would you still be you?”Crimson Moon sneered, he wasn’t in a hurry to attack but continued to demonize his body. His body was getting bigger and bigger.
“Memory is just the past. The combination of body and memory will allow your future thoughts to be your own.”Dudian looked at her coldly, “Your Daina is already dead. You have intercepted her memory and given it to Crimson Moon. You have only preserved her past. But is Crimson Moon’s own memory mixed with your Daina’s memory? Is she still your complete Daina?”
“You’re just deceiving yourself!”
“You’re BULLSH * t! !”Crimson Moon suddenly flew into a rage, boro’s face emitted Crimson Moon’s female scream, “You don’t know anything. You’re just a lucky person who was blessed and created by God. You’ve obtained everything from the very beginning. How can you understand me? How can you understand how perfect my current state is? You Don’t know what is eternal and what is resurrection! You are just a waste who can not use tools. I will eat you and let you feel inside my body. What is true perfection?”!
“You have gone mad!”Dudian sneered, “I don’t know what you have set up in your memory. You have hypnotized Crimson Moon’s memory so that she will think that you have seized her body. But you are dead after all. You are just a clown living in her memory. Your Dinah has long died. You have nothing left. The Real Crimson Moon, you should wake up!”! ”!”
He suddenly shouted at the end.
Crimson Moon’s movement was slightly stiff but soon she began to giggle like a ghost chewing on a bone: “You want to disturb my thinking but I have been giving you a chance to stall for time. Now, you should die!”
Her huge body which was almost 20 meters tall shook slightly. She suddenly opened her mouth and spat out a large amount of black fog. Thousands of white threads shot out from the fog and shot towards Dudian like sharp arrows.

chapters.title: Chapter 1195
chapters.content:
Chapter 1195: Chapter 1184: God’s cage
Translator:
549690339
“How would you know that I am deliberately letting you delay time?”Dudian slightly grinned. He opened his mouth and spat out a flame. The flame was like a waterfall, the flame was so strong that it swept half of the sky. The white silk that touched the flame was quickly ignited, burned and turned into ashes. It didn’t have time to display its effect.
Dudian had already seen through the structure of Crimson Moon’s body. The white silk was both soft and sharp. He couldn’t cut it but the white silk could wrap around his body and cut it into countless pieces, if it was just a king who was good at physical attacks, this move alone would be enough to kill him. But the flame that Dudian brewed just so happened to restrain the white silk.
Dudian knew that the core ability of Scarlet Moon was ‘Dreamer’. It should be the ability that she was most proficient in. Although people like Scarlet Moon who had a divine body could control the body to learn any ability, however, no matter how many kinds of abilities he had learned, he was still proficient in the first time. It was just like how he was most partial to the control of the cutting edge.
The dreamer was evolved from the Black Weaver. Its original form was a spider. The Black Weaver was good at burrowing into the ground and spitting out silk, leaning towards escape and assistance. The Dreamer’s ability was many times better in this aspect, not only could it burrow into the ground and spit out silk, it also carried a strange neurotoxin. It could see the memories of others and could also cause others to fall into confusion, as if they were in a dream.
The poison was extremely strong and there was no medicine to cure it. If one touched it, they would be infected. If one was attacked by her poisonous stinger during the battle, their consciousness would immediately be confused. Even if it was only a short period of confusion, it would be fatal.
However, as long as a god like Dudian thought of a preventive method, he wouldn’t be infected. He could build a barrier in his body to isolate the poison.
However, Crimson Moon would obviously optimize the basic ability of the dreamer. Whether it was the white silk or the core of the poison attack, they were very different from ordinary dreamers. The poison was like a corrosive acid, the speed of the corrosion was fast enough to destroy the barrier that Dudian had built. However, the power of the flame was enormous. As one of the basic elements of the world, as long as the temperature was high enough, in theory it could burn everything!
Countless white silk was burned by the flame and quickly melted. Although the white silk was extremely tough, but in front of the flame it was quickly burned into ashes like water.
Boro’s face sank but he didn’t stop spitting silk. However this time the direction of spitting silk was divided into three directions. Part of the white silk rushed towards the flame. This part of the white silk was covered with cold air, the other two white silks were very long. One on the left and the other on the right. They surrounded Dudian like two snow-white strips.
The white silks quickly became wide and formed a big ball. Both dudian and Crimson Moon were wrapped in it. The diameter of the ball was over a thousand meters.
The white silks secreted a strange yellow mucus. The flame was extinguished when it came into contact with the yellow mucus.
The heat brought by the flame increased several times as the environment was sealed. It was as if he was in a sea of fire.
Although the temperature had increased but Dudian frowned. He immediately understood the intention of crimson moon. She wanted to isolate the air. After the air in the white silk ball burned out the flame would be extinguished and he would be at her mercy.
This huge white silk ball is like a giant cocoon.
“Humph!”Dudian snorted. He turned around and cut the white silk wall. The white silk ball was as soft as cotton, his cutting edge quickly sank in, and the white silk ball was much thicker than he had ever seen before, and in that short time, the latter had not only constructed such a large white silk ball, it’s also expanded the thickness by more than 100 times.
Moreover, his perspective was blocked by the waxen mucus, unable to penetrate further, his vision was yellow and orange, shaking his eyes, so that he had to stop using perspective to see the white silk ball.
“This was originally intended to deal with the effiny Hughes and that Old Dog Lin Changsheng Cage, did not expect to be used on you, this half-finished body, you deserve to die ten thousand deaths, ten thousand cuts are not enough to regret!”Bolo said with a hideous smile.
Dudian’s face was gloomy as he waved a few more blades. However he was once again trapped in the white silk ball. It seemed that there were thousands of hands in the white silk ball. He was unable to pull out the blades.
“It’s useless. No matter how sharp the attack is, it won’t be able to break my carefully prepared cage. I have been thinking about it for a long time. No matter how many abilities you have, you won’t be able to escape from my cage!”Boro smiled.
The flame in the white silk ball was rapidly shrinking. Crimson Moon’s figure was faintly visible behind the flame. Her body had become one with the white silk ball. Only her head was sticking out as if it was embedded in the inner wall of the white silk ball, the Face on the head was Boro’s.
Dudian tried to heat up the sharp blade which was embedded in the white silk ball. The strong pulling force was loosened but he felt that the heat in the sharp blade was quickly disappearing.
“It’s useless. My divine thread can absorb heat. You Can’t destroy my cage unless you can burst out with the same kind of temperature as fire dragon Lord! However, if you want to burst out with that kind of temperature then your mind will be blurred and you will stop thinking. Just like Fire Dragon Lord, you will turn into a human-shaped sun and keep burning until your body’s energy is completely exhausted. Nothing will be left!”Boro laughed.
Dudian’s previous flame gradually extinguished as he spoke. The air in the sphere had been burnt out.
The Darkness didn’t affect Dudian’s line of sight. He saw the white silk ball where Crimson Moon’s body was. The inner wall of the white silk ball slightly squirmed. Sharp white silk stretched out from the inside and aimed at him like a spear.
There was no flame in the white silk cage. It was Crimson Moon’s domain that dominated everything.
The short-term lack of oxygen was a small matter for Dudian and Crimson Moon. It didn’t affect their actions.
“Do you think there is no flame because there is no air?”Dudian suddenly opened his mouth. There was a bit of ridicule in his eyes: “If so, the fire dragon kingdom would have been exterminated!”
Boro sneered: “Then you continue to consume your body!”
Dudian had released the oxygen stored in his blood. At the same time, he had created a large amount of gas in his body, the flame lit up the entire cage at the same time.
The white silk around Crimson Moon was like a poisonous snake. She sneered at Dudian as she waited for him to exhaust his body.
Dudian knew that this wasn’t a long term solution. He couldn’t create endless gas. At this moment he used the flame to balance scarlet moon. There were several sharp blades on his body. Each of them was suffused with cold air.
The water couldn’t be cut but the ice could.
Puff! Puff! Puff!
The sharp ice blades penetrated into the white silk ball. The cold air was released and spread out in an instant. The white silk ball was frozen and hardened. Dudian waved a few red hot blades to cut the frozen white silk ball, he cut a few cracks.
Dudian’s eyes lit up as he increased his strength. The sharp blades that were deeply embedded in the white silk ball also released cold air. The frozen area was enlarged.
“Hehe, do you think that I won’t consider the ice because of the Flame?”Boro suddenly sneered. The next moment, Dudian felt that the frozen white silk ball quickly softened. The cold air inside seemed to have been sucked away.
Dudian’s face slightly changed. Dozens of sharp blades shot out from his body. All of them pierced within a radius of dozens of feet. The cold air was released and instantly froze the white silk ball. At the same time.., the sharp blades on his back quickly cut open the hardened white silk. There were several deep crevices. He was about to drill into it when the white silk suddenly softened and absorbed all the cold air, at the same time, it absorbed the dozens of sharp blades and sank deep into them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1196
chapters.content:
Chapter 1196: Chapter 1185: mutual destruction
Translator:
549690339
Dudian frowned as he suddenly thought of something. His face changed and became gloomy. He cut off the dozens of sharp blades and let them be absorbed into the swamp-like white silk wall.
He didn’t attack again. He quietly waited for the flame to extinguish as he thought of a new method.
“Why aren’t you attacking anymore?”Boro squinted his eyes and grinned, “It seems that you are smart enough to sense it. Unfortunately, it is useless for you to know. You will only become more desperate. You will be like a flying insect struggling on the spider web. You will see the spider coming but you won’t be able to move!”
Dudian was silent. He didn’t pay attention to her. Crimson Moon was right. His current situation was like a flying insect trapped in the spider web. He was trapped in the white silk blade wall, he was aware that the white silk blade wall was special. It was no wonder that Crimson Moon called it ‘cage’. Even he couldn’t think of a way to crack it.
“Don’t you realize that even if you don’t attack, your life energy is quietly draining away? There are several layers of my cage. I have absorbed and stored the Flames and ice that you released. My energy alone is enough to eat you. Moreover you have given me so much energy. Unfortunately you are too smart. If you were to attack me a few more times then my cage would be more solid!”Boro’s smile was very exaggerated, but his eyes were extremely cold as if he was a cold-blooded animal sizing up its prey.
Dudian felt that the heat in his body was dissipating bit by bit. His surroundings were pitch black. However, the darkness wasn’t just the visual darkness without light, it was the real dark matter. Even under the sun, it was still there. The Darkness was like the Black Fog released by Crimson Moon. It was just that the concentration wasn’t that strong so he didn’t notice it because of the white silk blade wall, but even if Boro didn’t say it, he would soon notice it.
“This is the combination of Boro’s dark ability. The two abilities have reached the extreme. It is indeed terrifying.”Dudian’s eyes were serious as he rapidly decomposed the surrounding dark matter. At the same time, his body rapidly simulated the decomposition of the dark matter, he released a dark matter mucous membrane which protected his body like a bubble. It repelled the gradually encroaching darkness but his heart gradually sank.
The thickness of the divine cage that Crimson Moon had constructed was beyond his imagination. He could not tear it apart with just his sharp blades. If there was energy attached to the sharp blades, this energy would be absorbed by the white silk blade wall. Simply put.., regardless of whether it was physical or energy attacks, they were ineffective. On the other hand, energy attacks would become Crimson Moon’s nourishment. From this point, his current situation was practically a dead end!
However, he did not sit still and wait for death. After thinking for a short while, before the flame was extinguished, he suddenly demonized a huge sharp blade that was dozens of meters long and fiercely slashed at the white silk blade wall.
The sharp blade quickly broke through the surface of the blade wall. After penetrating seven to eight meters deep, it gradually lost its strength. The power on the sharp blade was weakened layer by layer and could not penetrate deeper. He wanted to use brute force to push it deeper, however, he felt that the resistance was even stronger. After pushing it less than two meters, he felt exhausted. However, from the feeling on the sharp blade, there were still no signs of penetration.
By the time he wanted to pull the sharp blade back, the sharp blade had already been stuck. A large amount of viscous force pulled it, but it could not be pulled out. It could only break at once, breaking the part of the sharp blade that had gone deep into it. The rest was retracted back into his body, the next moment, pieces of ruby-like material appeared outside his body. The cutting blades all over his body were retracted and turned into crystals that covered his body. At the same time, several crystals extended from his body and looked at each other.
“Eh?”Boro saw Dudian’s strange appearance. His reaction was very fast as if he thought of something. The white silk blade wall around Dudian suddenly began to wiggle slightly.
Dudian didn’t bother to explore the strange shape of the white silk blade wall. He took a deep breath and condensed the energy stored in his body into a beam. A fist-sized ruby shot out from his forehead!
The beam shot out more than a dozen times through the complex structure of the ruby. It reached the limit of the ruby structure. It rushed out of the body and went through the refraction of several concave crystals which dudian had demonized, finally, the last concave crystal was shattered. It turned into a red ray of light as thick as a bucket and flew towards the white silk blade wall.
Puff!
The Ray of light instantly entered the white silk blade wall and pierced through a huge hole. However, the white silk blade wall began to squirm crazily like a wave. Dudian saw that the ray of light had penetrated dozens of meters into the wall, the energy was used up and the end of the wall was still the black white silk blade wall!
It didn’t Pierce through!
Dudian felt a chill in his heart. He couldn’t believe it but he suddenly thought of something. His body went berserk as he stretched out many sharp blades and hit the white silk blade wall which was hundreds of meters away.
Bang! More than ten sharp blades pierced into the wall of white silk blades like gears. They went four or five meters deep and then suddenly loosened. They pierced through the cage!
Dudian’s eyes lit up. He was about to drill out but he felt soft and sticky white silk wrapped around the front end of the blade. His eyes turned red as he tried to push it out, however it seemed like it would never end.
“DAMN! !”He shouted. His reason controlled him to cut off the connection with the blade and retreat.
“That was close!”Boro took a deep breath. He put away the strange smile on his face and looked at Dudian with admiration, “I almost let you escape. Fortunately, I caught up in time. Unfortunately, you shouldn’t be able to launch a second attack with such intensity, right? Even if you can, I’m prepared. I Won’t give you any chance!”
Dudian’s face was extremely ugly. He was in disbelief when the sun rays didn’t penetrate the white silk wall. But he quickly thought that the cage was made of spider silk from Crimson Moon, these spider silk were her limbs. They were moving according to her will. In other words, the thickness of the balanced and round cage had been weakened and transferred to the place where the sun rays attacked.
That was the moment when the divine cage was at its weakest. By the time he reacted and attacked, Bolo had also reacted and saved it in time.
All of this happened in an instant. If he had reacted a thousandth of a second earlier, he might have rushed out at this moment.
“It would have taken more time to kill you but you have given me such strong energy. It has accelerated your death!”Boro smiled: “Those two fools outside are still quietly watching. They don’t want to help because they are afraid of wasting their strength. They think too highly of you and look down on me. After I eat you, my body’s energy will surpass theirs. At that time, they will pay the price for not doing anything. I will take revenge for you!”
Dudian gritted his teeth. He was furious. If the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng were to attack from the outside, it would be easy for them to tear open the cage. However, they were in a stalemate. No one was willing to take action. The possibility of him being saved.., it was almost zero!
“You had escaped from my hands. I wanted to spare your life but you were courting death. Now you have turned from a small abyss into a demigod. Unfortunately, I still ended you!”Boro smiled, “This is your fate. You are a supporting role. No matter how hard you try, you will eventually become a stepping stone for me. You will help me ascend to an unprecedented state of life!”
All the white silk inside the blade wall stood up as he spoke. It was like hundreds of millions of white steel needles were aiming at Dudian.
Dudian was silent.
Perhaps it was because of his nature or because of his years of experience. He always felt that he was rational at all times. Although he was angry but he knew that the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng couldn’t help him, he could clearly see his current desperate situation.
Unwillingness, grievance, anger. All sorts of emotions interweaved in his heart, but most of them were reluctance.
He was not willing to suffer so much, suffer so much, abandon everything, and struggle to this day, yet he had to die here. It was as if the villain in all the stories had to die in the end. Could it be because he had done too many bad things.., he had killed too many innocent people, so he couldn’t escape retribution in the end?
But who would repay crimson moon?
The Demon Emperor, or Lin Changsheng?
Then who would repay them?
Although he was unwilling, he knew that he didn’t have the chance to search for this answer. What made him miserable was that he would never have the chance to see her again. Even before he died, he wouldn’t be able to see her again.
In this world without him, who would take care of the Lonely King Corpse who was wandering in the wilderness?
How insignificant was he and she to the millions of lives in this world?
“In the end, she is still a failure...”Dudian lowered his head and sighed. He bitterly smiled.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Countless white steel needles flew over. It seemed that they would pierce him into a hornet’s nest in an instant.
However, when he lowered his head, a dense flame spread out from his body and swept over, turning into a soaring flame that soared into the sky, instantly enveloping his entire body, the monstrous flame burned to a height of over a hundred meters, and the flame was about to touch the white silk blade wall at the top.
The white steel needles that shot out from the surroundings were instantly burned into ashes by the flame, completely submerged.
“Continue to struggle!”Boro licked his lips. His eyes were filled with excitement.
At this time, the flames on Dudian’s body didn’t stop but turned into a flaming tornado. He was standing in the center of the storm. The Flames were getting bigger and the temperature was getting higher, the yellow mucus on the white silk blade wall seemed to have dried up.
“Eh?”Boro frowned as the excitement on his face disappeared. He felt that something was wrong. The temperature of the flame continued to rise and there was no sign of stopping.
