He was aware of Dudian’s thoughts, boro’s face contorted in anger: “Do you want to burn yourself to ashes like the Fire Dragon Lord? !”
Dudian’s face was calm as he stood in the center of the tornado. He looked at Bolo: “Unfortunately I can’t kill you but at least I can make you suffer heavy losses.”
“Bastard!”Bolo’s voice was hysterical: “Stop! I can let you live!”
“There is no need.”
Dudian gently looked at him and slowly closed his eyes. He felt that his blood and bones were burning. He controlled his cells to continue to divide and demonize limbs to burn as fuel, the temperature outside his body continued to rise and became more and more vigorous!
His body was going beyond the limit again and again as he rapidly demonized the limbs to burn as fuel. The heart in his chest was beating violently as if it was about to tear. The pain made him feel suffocated.
At this point, even if his heart exploded, it was not surprising to him. He tried to transform his heart into a flame but found that he could not control the changes. It was like an independent thing in his body, something that was parasitic on his body.
“I hope I can burn you too...”Dudian muttered to himself.
Suddenly, an idea flashed through his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1197
chapters.content:
Chapter 1197: Chapter 1186: Open
Translator:
549690339
“The body is the container...”
Dudian thought of this point through the uniqueness of the heart. The idea of the “Container”made him think of a possibility of survival, which was to create a container that would not be burned by the flames, he would seal his own brain!
This inspiration was also connected to Crimson Moon’s special situation.
His body was like the Fire Dragon Lord, trapped in an endless cycle of nature, constantly splitting, regenerating, and then burning. However, there was a limit to the body. When the body’s potential was exhausted, it could no longer continue to split, the Flames in the body would gradually extinguish. However, during this process, the consciousness of the brain had long been blurred by the high temperature and stopped thinking. All of the hippocampus would also burn out and the memory would disappear.
However, if there was a container that could seal his brain and prevent the flames from burning until his thoughts stopped, he could also prevent himself from self-combusting!
The purpose of self-combusting was to break through the limits of his body and reach an extremely terrifying temperature. He would destroy Crimson Moon’s divine cage and break out of it. If his divine cage was destroyed, his consciousness would be able to wake up in time, he would be able to save his life by preventing his body from continuing to spontaneously combust. Although the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng wouldn’t let him go but at least he would be able to live for a while!
His will to survive made him unwilling to give up easily. He wanted to hold on as long as there was a glimmer of hope.
“What should I use as a container?”Dudian quickly thought. He felt that the flames had burned to the point that he couldn’t bear it. The pain in his body made his thinking extremely difficult and painful, it was like thinking about how to write an academic paper when his brain was about to crack. However his willpower was extraordinary. He felt that his teeth were almost crushed. However, he endured the intense pain.
The first thing that came to his mind was the ice. It was the opposite of the flame. It was the most suitable container. However, he quickly rejected it. Then he thought of the stone. He quickly rejected it. With his ability, he was unable to construct a stone that could isolate heat, most of the stones were heated very quickly, especially in this terrifying heat. If the skull was made into a stone, the brain tissue inside would probably boil!
He thought about the materials one by one. At this time, Bolo’s angry roars kept coming, shouting at him to stop. He even tempted, traded, and even begged, but he threw them all to the back of his mind and ignored them.
Soon, he suddenly realized that he had fallen into a misunderstanding. It was almost impossible to find materials that could isolate this terrifying high temperature, and it was not something that he could construct with his current ability, in the end, he still thought of the ice that he had considered from the very beginning. Although the ice would be quickly evaporated by the high temperature, it was the most suitable method at the moment. He planned to use the ice to seal his brain, after the high temperature melted the ice, if Crimson Moon’s divine cage had not been destroyed, he could only continue to burn and be devoured by the flames.
If the divine cage was broken, he could stop the spontaneous combustion and save his life.
Thinking of this, he immediately demonized his body into a strange shape, like a gourd-shaped monster. The head was huge and occupied almost half of the body. The surface was still burning with flames, but the inner layer formed an area.., the inside was covered with low-temperature air currents, and the air pressure was extremely low. The layer that was burning with the skin was formed into ice. The temperature of the ice was also below zero due to the extremely low ambient temperature, which slowed down the burning speed.
He constructed a total of three ice shields, each with a small space between them. A small lump of meat ball that stored all the brain tissue was sealed inside. The surface of the meat ball was another layer of warm material to block the cold air.., it was to prevent the brain tissue from freezing.
And this lump of brain tissue had been hidden the deepest, so it had lost contact with the body. It was like a completely sealed and isolated tissue. At this moment, the person in charge of controlling the body was another part of the brain tissue that he had copied. In other words, from now on, everything that he had experienced would be completely destroyed along with this part of his consciousness burning up, it would not be known by his awakened self.
However, he had already stored everything that was about to happen and what he was going to do in his origin memories. It was like a precaution. When his origin consciousness woke up, he would also know what he had done previously, and what he was going to do next.
All of this was done in a few seconds. In this moment of extreme survival, his potential had been completely squeezed out. He no longer cared about the load on his heart. He urged his body with all his might. The outer layer of the ice barrier did not even last half a second, it was burned into soda. In the end, even the steam and white fog were burned out. Even the second layer of ice barrier was melting rapidly.
However, this part of his consciousness was responsible for reconstructing the ice barrier at all times. Almost at the same time that the ice barrier melted, a new ice barrier was reconstructed.
The outer layer of his skin kept demonizing the limbs outside his body. They were still like dry wood that turned into raging flames. They were burning fiercely. From the outside, it was impossible to know the structure of his brain. Even if Crimson Moon had mastered the ability of perspective.., it was impossible to see through the flames and the demonized limbs on his skin. These demonized and burning limbs were like walls that were constantly erected. Before the perspective could completely permeate through them, they were blocked by a new wall, it was impossible to see the scene inside his head. It was enough to deceive the world.
“Bastard! !”
Boro felt the heat on his body. He felt that his face was burning. His vision was filled with tornadoes. The fire was more vigorous than before. It almost occupied the entire cage, he didn’t care about Dudian’s escape. He quietly released a lot of needle-like holes in the cage to vent the heat but it was still a drop in the bucket.
“If this continues you will die!”
“There will be nothing left. You will die completely!”
“I can let you live! I promise! I Promise You!”
Boro was furious. He shouted but Dudian was like a silent stone statue. He didn’t respond. It seemed that he had made up his mind.
Soon, the inner wall of the white silk gradually cracked. Boro had to release a large amount of cold air to put out the fire. But it didn’t take long before he felt the burning signs again. If he continued to persist he would be burned by Dudian.
Boro saw that Dudian’s body had been deformed by the flames. The demonized limbs had stopped multiplying. Only his main body was still burning, the temperature was high enough to paralyze all the functions of the Creator. Even if other kings appeared in the cage they would be burned alive!
“DAMN! !”Boro had a violent feeling, dudian thought that he would be able to kill Dudian and eat his body to make up for the loss. However the other side didn’t leave anything for him and damaged his cage, most of his physical energy was used up. If the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng attacked him then he wouldn’t be able to escape!
The more he thought about it the angrier he got. But Dudian’s current appearance had stopped the demonization of his body. It was obvious that he had stopped thinking. His mind was blurred and his body was maintaining the will power of the previous will power, when the flame was completely burnt out there would be nothing left!
He couldn’t stop this process unless he used the cold air which was more terrifying than Dudian’s desperate burning. But it was impossible. Only a real God could do that, it was the perfect life that they were after!
He wanted to grab Dudian and crush him bit by bit. But in the end he quickly opened the cage. He didn’t want to compete with a self-igniting bomb. His reason told him that he should think about how to deal with the next trouble, this was the necessary calm and reason of a superior. He should stop the damage in time. He shouldn’t be immersed in anger and lose more things or even lose his life!
When the Divine Cage was released, the demon lord and Lin Changsheng, who were in midair outside, immediately felt a monstrous flame sweep out. Their expressions could not help but change, and they quickly retreated over a thousand meters. They saw the Crimson Moon retract her countless white threads, retreating to the other side of the flame, their bodies were blurred by the flame, so they could not see clearly. They also did not continue to pay attention to the Crimson Moon, but were attracted by this ball of flame!
It was too fierce!
The flame tornado became even wilder when it came into contact with the air. It was like the flame in the bomb had left the shell of the bomb and suddenly exploded. The tornado was hundreds of meters tall and dozens of meters wide, it instantly became thousands of meters tall and hundreds of meters wide. The temperature released by the fire tornado seemed to sweep the entire world. It was expanding at an astonishing speed. Everything in the air was burning, it seemed to be the medium of the flame transmission.
“Self-ignition?”The Devil Emperor’s face slightly changed. His eyes flashed with a trace of seriousness. He quickly recovered from the shock of Dudian’s self-ignition. He looked for Crimson Moon’s figure behind the flames.
It was obvious that Crimson Moon’s strength was a bit beyond his expectations.

chapters.title: Chapter 1198
chapters.content:
Chapter 1198: Chapter 1187: fall in the destruction
Translator:
549690339
The Ice Bird’s face was gloomy as it looked at the scene of the Sea of fire. Its special vision allowed it to see the figure at the center of the fire. It was dudian who was melting like a candle, he didn’t expect that the cunning kid would use such an extreme method to destroy him. From the intensity of the fire, it was obvious that it was burning out of control. It was the same as the Master of Fire Dragon in the underground base.
Dudian’s death meant that he would have one less divine body to spare and a way to counterattack the Devil Emperor.
The eyes of the devil emperor flashed as he searched for Dudian behind the Sea of fire.
At this moment, both the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng’s eyes were fixed on Dudian for a very short time. They didn’t pay attention to the man who was bound to die.
Therefore, they didn’t notice that Dudian’s huge head slowly cracked open. White steam was coming out of it. However, the steam hadn’t risen yet.
Dudian felt as if he had slept for tens of thousands of years. When he woke up, he felt intense burning pain and the terrible high temperature that would melt his body.
He instinctively quickly formed ice to cool down. At the same time the chaotic memories in his mind were quickly sorted out. The last memory was the words that he had told himself to tell the current situation that he would face when he woke up.
When he saw the memory, he was completely awake. The first thing he did was to look at the situation outside. When he saw the Endless Sea of fire, he couldn’t help but change his expression. Soon.., his burning eyes saw a few figures thousands of meters away from the Sea of fire. The Ice Bird Forest and the Devil Emperor stood on one side. They were hundreds of meters away from each other. Crimson Moon was on the other side of the Sea of fire, at the moment, she was constantly spitting out translucent silk which gathered in the air. It seemed that she was creating a trap.
Dudian saw that they didn’t rush to attack him. He was relieved but soon he was pulled back by the burning sensation in his body. He immediately controlled the cells in his body to stop the splitting and burning. However, when his willpower was transmitted over.., his body didn’t respond. His face changed. He tried to control his body to raise his arm but found that the reaction was weak.
“The temperature is too high. is the body out of control?”Dudian felt that the situation was critical. He quickly used the tissue in his brain to demonize the stem cells. He injected them into his body and built nerves in his blood and flesh, however, it was burned by the terrifying high temperature as soon as it was constructed. It was like a cotton thread in a flame.
“No, I have to lower the temperature first. The temperature here is too high. I have to get out of here first!”Dudian’s thought process was very fast. The first thing he did was to construct two ice-covered wings on his head. There was ice at the end of the wings to insulate the heat, the wings were constructed by the magic insect spaceship. The ignition point was very high. When the wings were constructed, the temperature quickly rose. It became hot and red but it didn’t melt.
Dudian immediately controlled the wings to fly away.
Whoosh!
The wings flapped the flames and carried his body away.
The unusual movement in the Sea of fire attracted the attention of Lin Changsheng, the Devil Emperor and Crimson Moon. The three of them were shocked when they saw that Dudian didn’t die. Especially Crimson Moon, there was a crazy killing intent in her eyes. But she held back in the end. No matter if Dudian died or not, she would face the following troubles.
Moreover Dudian had survived but if he was killed then he would be dragged into the Sea of fire. Even if he didn’t die then he would be burned off a layer of skin which would be very disadvantageous to the next action.
“This cunning kid...”the ice bird’s eyes flashed with cold light. Its killing intent towards Dudian was more intense but it didn’t make a move.
The shock on the demon king’s face quickly disappeared. He looked at the figure struggling to fly in the Sea of fire. His expression was calm but no one could tell what he was thinking.
Whoosh!
Dudian dived towards the ground and quickly escaped from the Sea of fire. All of this happened in a very short time. It hadn’t been more than ten seconds since he broke out of Crimson Moon’s cage. He felt that he had made the right bet, crimson Moon didn’t dare to waste too much energy to kill him. However, it was urgent to reverse the trend of spontaneous combustion of his body. He used the brain tissue to demonize new cells and then used new cells to construct the ice magic limbs, he reduced the heat around his body.
Boom!
His body crashed into the ground like a meteorite. The fire on his body quickly ignited the surrounding weeds and other combustible materials. The fire quickly spread in all directions.
“No, my body is burning through!”Dudian felt that his body was completely dead. He couldn’t control it. After all, he wasn’t a complete god. He had lost his heart so he couldn’t directly abandon his body. Otherwise, he could only become a parasite, he could live in other life forms and then rob other life forms to survive. But in that case, his God’s body would be even more incomplete.
“The temperature can’t be lowered and the nervous system can’t be constructed to control the body!”
“Damn, don’t tell me it will stop after it is burned clean?”
Dudian’s face was ugly. The burning flames on his body burned his brain. It was as if his brain was being pricked by Needles. The pain was unbearable. It was extremely difficult for him to calm down and think, if it was an ordinary person, they would have covered their head and screamed.
“Do you need my help?”Suddenly, a cold voice came from the air.
Dudian was startled. He looked up and saw the ice bird, the Devil Emperor, and Crimson Moon. They were looking down at him from the air. It seemed that they didn’t plan to attack but it seemed that they would attack at the same time.
“It’s more than enough for me to drag you down with me!”Dudian clenched his teeth as he fought back against Lin Changsheng.
“It seems that you don’t want to die.”The Ice Bird’s face changed into Lin Changsheng’s. A cold smile appeared on its face, “Although I don’t know how you stay conscious in such a high temperature but it seems that it is a bit difficult for you to live. Why Don’t you just die?”
Dudian gritted his teeth. He knew what they meant from their expressions. If he died of spontaneous combustion then they wouldn’t attack him. If he wanted to stop the spontaneous combustion then.., they would immediately kill him!
At this moment, he had to stop the spontaneous combustion of his body. It was extremely difficult and anxious. Moreover, he was facing their coercion. It was like a person who was struggling in the water but was stopped by the people on the shore.
Although he had thought of this situation when he thought of using self-ignition to break Crimson Moon’s cage, but when it really happened, he still felt furious!
The next moment, he no longer controlled his own self-ignition. He suddenly rushed into the sky. His whole body was burning with flames as he rushed towards Crimson Moon!
Crimson Moon was startled. She suddenly became angry. The meaning on her face was very obvious: “It is clear that Lin Changsheng is provoking you. Why are you trying to kill me? !”
The Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng smiled as they saw the situation. They knew that Dudian didn’t attack Lin Changsheng because if he tried to kill Lin Changsheng then the Devil Emperor and Crimson Moon would have no choice but to attack, if Lin Changsheng was killed by Dudian then the mechanical heart would be burnt. Dudian would be facing a joint attack of three people. However they would only watch as he tried to kill Crimson Moon.
From this it could be seen that Dudian really wanted to find someone to take the fall before his death.
Crimson Moon’s face turned ugly. She cursed at the madman and quickly retreated. She didn’t want to fight with Dudian. She just wanted to drag him until he burned himself to death.
Crimson Moon used her dark domain to cover a few miles. Her body flickered in the dark domain. Dudian’s attacks missed again and again.
It had to be said that if two people with the same strength wanted to kill each other, it was almost impossible for the other party to kill the other party unless both parties were fighting to the death.
Dudian was even more angry as he saw Scarlet Moon’s plan. However he was in a bad condition at the moment. Half of his body was burning and he couldn’t use much strength. Scarlet Moon was trying to dodge so he wasn’t able to chase after her.
The most desperate and powerless thing was that he wouldn’t be able to catch up to her even if he tried his best!
Whoosh!
His body fell to the ground like a pile of mud. His body was still burning with flames.
After a few minutes of chasing, his last bit of willpower and physical strength was exhausted. He could only look at the sky as Crimson Moon gradually converged her domain. His eyes gradually became lifeless and his consciousness became blurred.
“It’s still over...”his remaining consciousness thought bitterly.
Finally, his perception slowly contracted, and the entire world became blurry and dark. Then, the light gradually dimmed, and all the light beams were compressed in front of his eyes, converging into a blurry, gentle face.
He smiled bitterly. He wanted to clench his fists and muster his last bit of strength to fight, but he found that he did not even have the strength to clench his fists.
His vision gradually blurred, and his hearing gradually weakened.
The entire world seemed to have become incomparably dark and silent.
Dong Dong!
Dong Dong!
There was only the sound of thunder-like throbbing, rhythmically and steadily beating. Moreover, the faster he jumped, the more rapid it became. However, this kind of urgency could no longer bring him an unbearable pain, because the pain in his body had long been burned away by the flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 1199
chapters.content:
Chapter 1199: Chapter 1188: Life in the heart
Translator:
549690339
“A trapped beast is struggling to survive!”Crimson Moon looked down at Dudian who had fallen to the ground and was still burning. There was a silver crescent in her eyes as she looked through the Flames to see Dudian, her Heart was relieved as she saw that Dudian had closed his eyes. She knew that it was difficult for him to continue and that he would gradually burn himself to death. Her eyes turned to the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng.
At the same time, the Devil Emperor and Lin Changsheng withdrew their eyes from Dudian. They knew that the latter was at the end of his rope and would die without a doubt. They no longer paid attention to each other but looked at each other.
At the moment the situation was three-legged but Crimson Moon was the weakest one!
Crimson Moon spoke to Lin Changsheng before the devil emperor opened his mouth: “There are only three of US left. It is easy for accidents to happen in a free-for-all. Are you interested in cooperating with me to get rid of Effiny Hughes First?”
The Demon Emperor narrowed his eyes at this, a cold glint flashing through them.
Lin Changsheng gave a faint smile and asked, “Why do you want to work with me instead of Your Majesty?”
Crimson moon sneered and said, “Calling him your Majesty is just hoping that he will lead the way. I’ve long wanted to take care of him.”
Lin Changsheng tilted his head and glanced at the demon emperor. With a faint smile, he asked crimson moon, “What confidence do you have that I’ll work with you and not him?”
“Because he’s a little stronger,”Crimson Moon said coldly. She did not mind admitting that the demon emperor was stronger than her, especially at this moment.., “If you cooperate with him, after you kill me, you’ll have to face him alone! “But I’m different. Earlier, this kid used up too much of my energy, greatly reducing my strength. After we finish him off, my strength will decrease a little more. At that time, if you face me, your chances of winning will naturally be a little better than if you face him, right?”
Lin changsheng chuckled, “That’s true.”
The Demon Emperor did not interrupt when he heard the two’s words, nor did he propose any conditions. When Crimson Moon had invited Lin Changsheng to cooperate, he had already considered this point, so he knew that saying anything else was just nonsense, so he might as well not say it.
“Demon Emperor, your judgment isn’t very good!”After Lin Changsheng said this, he teased the demon emperor to the side.
The demon emperor indifferently said, “Don’t be too pleased with yourself. Perhaps we can work together to deal with you. There’s no absolute hatred. As long as the benefits I propose are appropriate, she might not cooperate with you.”
Lin Changsheng raised his brows and indifferently said, “No matter what conditions you propose, when you achieve your goal, you will take them back. If she’s smart enough, she should know this.”
These words were meant for crimson moon. In reality, Crimson Moon knew this even without Lin Changsheng saying it. On the contrary, the tone of Lin Changsheng’s words made her feel very uncomfortable, but acting was a small matter to her, the key was the final result.
The Demon Emperor indifferently said with his hands behind his back, “If I really wanted to give her benefits, she would definitely agree, because the benefits I gave her would immediately be used by her, but...”
“But what?”Lin Changsheng frowned, feeling a hint of threat.
“But I don’t want to give it to you,”the demon Emperor indifferently said. “To me, an extra half-baked person to help you is only so-so.”
Lin Changsheng heaved a sigh of relief in his heart, and at the same time, he laughed loudly. “Good, what a good demon emperor. As expected, you are arrogant. Since that’s the case, let us properly experience your magnificence!”
He transformed into an ice bird and rushed towards the Devil Emperor. The air in the air froze as if the entire sky was frozen.
Crimson Moon saw the situation and immediately used her special magic silk to bind the Devil Emperor. She didn’t use the previous cage. With her current energy, she could only seal one at most. If there were two of them, she would be killed.
The Flames on the ground were burning more and more. The area was very large. The fire was burning along the ground. The place where Dudian fell had been burned into the core magma, blood red lava was flowing. Dudian’s body was floating in the magma. He was being burned at all times. At the same time his body was instinctively going through the magic fission, he turned into an endless stream of fuel and injected it into the flame.
Dudian’s eyes were dull and lost his spirit.
His mind gradually stopped. The skin of his body was rapidly falling off and was burning. He was quickly reborn. There seemed to be no limit to the cycle.
But if one looked carefully, they would find that the speed of regeneration was gradually decreasing. The speed of healing couldn’t keep up with the speed of burning. The skin was gradually no longer healing and the flesh under the skin was constantly burning.
There were new rocks melting into the magma. Dudian’s body was suspended on the surface and the magma bubbles kept coming out.
Dong Dong!
Dong Dong!
Most of his chest was submerged. The magma was trembling slightly.
It shrank and shrank as if the magma was breathing.
Dong Dong!
The trembling sound continued and jumped more and more violently. It was unknown how much time had passed. Suddenly, the magma in Dudian’s chest seemed to have flowed into a hole and collapsed.
The next moment, the surrounding lava all rushed towards the collapsed hole. It seemed that this was the drainage hole at the bottom of the pool. It sucked the surrounding lava and crazily surged. Gradually, it formed a vortex!
The height of the lava rapidly decreased. When it was about one meter high, suddenly, a ferocious claw made of lava suddenly stretched out from the collapsed hole. The arm of the claw was full of cracks of the lava, it seemed that it would explode at any time. The Claw was extremely sharp. It ruthlessly grabbed the surrounding magma and then another magma claw stretched out!
The two claws reached into the magma at the same time. The surrounding magma seemed to be boiling and surging. It was quickly absorbed by the claws and covered the claws!
Soon, the magma reached the bottom. Dudian’s body also floated down to the bottom of the hot rock. The two magma claws were two to three meters long and stood beside him, it was a small beast that was less than 20 centimeters tall. Its body was made of magma. It looked like a human. Its eyes were white like a burning flame but there was no flame.
Its eyes were very big. There were no eyes or nose. It had two huge human ears. Its body was like a human baby. Its belly was bulging and its two feet were very short.
“Wa wa... ?”
The small beast made a puzzled sound. Its huge arms were very inconsistent with its body. It turned around and saw Dudian’s broken body lying on the side. It took a closer look and sniffed, “Wa Wa?”
It slightly tilted its head as if it was thinking. After a while, it suddenly opened its mouth. The baby’s mouth suddenly opened to more than two meters long. Its mouth was full of sharp piranha-like teeth. It Swallowed Dudian who was on the ground!

chapters.title: Chapter 1200 - Chapter 1189: ancestor of the Aragami
chapters.content:
Chapter 1200: Chapter 1189: ancestor of the Aragami
Translator:
549690339
Gulp!
The small beast swallowed Dudian and began to chew. The sound of bones being chewed could be heard. Soon, it raised its head and swallowed. Its short body was suddenly enlarged. It shook its body like a bird in the cold wind. As it shook, its body gradually became bigger. It was half a meter tall and its image became like that of a human child. It seemed that it had grown a lot in a short period of time.
At this moment, the sound of intense battle above its head attracted its attention. Its pure white eyes that were like flames raised its head and looked over. It saw streaks of silver threads shooting out explosively in midair, as well as black fog surging out, there was also the ice wall cold air that engulfed the sky and earth, as well as the laser-like rays that split out from within.
“WA-WA?”The little beast blinked its eyes. It was somewhat puzzled and also somewhat curious. Its eyes quickly revealed a bit of desire. It was like a hungry person who had seen a delicious feast. It licked its tongue greedily!
However, it didn’t rush up immediately. It suddenly raised its huge arm after absorbing the lava and plunged into the ground. Bang! The ground shook and the next moment the ground around it quickly collapsed, it was as if it had fallen into a bottomless black hole.
Its body was slowly growing as the ground collapsed. In the blink of an eye it had grown to a height of nearly three meters, at this moment, it had turned into a basin with a diameter of several kilometers!
The Devil Emperor, Crimson Moon and Lin Changsheng who were fighting in the air also noticed the unusual movement below. They were shocked. Could it be that Dudian could reverse the resurrection in that situation?
When they looked over, they found a huge funnel-shaped basin on the ground. At the bottom of the funnel in the center of the basin stood a creature that was made of magma. Its body was made of magma which looked like it would collapse at any time, they could see the red liquid flowing inside. It looked like blood or boiling flames. The body structure was humanoid and not complicated. There were no extra carapaces or fur scales. It was very simple and “Smooth.”.
“Huh?”
The demon lord, who was being forced by Crimson Moon, suddenly felt a fear in his heart. He caught a familiar feeling from this strange creature. It was familiar, but it also made him feel fear!
In these past few years, besides his father, who had appeared in his memories when he was young, he had also experienced fear from the sea monster he had encountered when he had gone out wandering when he was young, as well as those two terrifying monsters that occupied the wasteland outside his borders, there was nothing else that made him feel fear. Even if he was targeted by the nuclear bomb in Lin Changsheng’s hand, he would not feel the slightest bit of fear.
At the same time, Crimson Moon who used the divine thread to attack the devil emperor felt an inexplicable palpitation when she saw the magma creature. It was as if she was the prey of a hunter, like a frog who met a snake, she had an instinctive fear which shocked her. Ever since she finished the final experiment on Dudian and defeated Bolo, she had never met anything that made her afraid.
Even though it was the first time she had met the Devil Emperor in the Kingdom of God. She wasn’t afraid but at the moment she was trembling. She wanted to turn around and run away.
“What is this thing? Is It Dudian’s demonized body? No, it is impossible for him to give me such a feeling. The body structure of this thing is very special. It is changing all the time. Could It Be...”crimson moon seemed to think of something, her pupils shrank and her face was filled with horror. She stopped her attack on the Devil Emperor. She was shocked and doubtful as she thought about whether she should retreat.
Lin Changsheng didn’t have the strange palpitation of the Devil Emperor and Crimson Moon. He felt that this magma creature was a bit strange. He was wondering if it was Dudian’s demonized form. However, it didn’t seem like it.., he tried to change the structure of his pupils and infiltrate into the creature’s body. His face changed as he saw the situation inside the creature: “Impossible!”
At this time, the small beast on the ground twisted its arm and pulled out from the ground. Its magma-like arm was covered with a layer of metal. It looked at its own arms, there was a bit of curiosity on its face. The next moment, sharp spikes shot out from its arms. They were black and sharp. It was the cutting edge that Dudian had used previously.
The next moment, the sharp blade shrank back and turned into a burning flame. Then the flame disappeared and ice appeared. It emitted a thick cold air and then turned into metal, rock, and Black Fog, silver Threads also appeared. If one looked closely, they would find that they were the same as the threads that Crimson Moon had revealed. The silver threads only flashed for a moment and then turned into something else.
In just a dozen seconds, its arm had turned into hundreds of different structures. It was dazzling, and once again shocked the three people in the sky.
“Impossible! !”
“This... how is this possible? !”
“The structure is so fast!”
The three people were all incomparably shocked.
Little Beastie’s arm was still continuously constructing new substances, as if it had discovered a novel toy and was continuously trying it out.
After the three people in the sky recovered from their shock, the demon lord was the first to react, he decisively and solemnly said, “This is an Aragami, a true Aragami! It’s even more terrifying than our race’s Aragami ancestor. Let’s work together to kill it first. Otherwise, we will all die!”
“I agree!”Crimson Moon said almost immediately.
Lin Changsheng glanced at the two of them. Thinking of their special identities and bodies, he sneered in his heart. However, he did not deny the demon lord’s suggestion. The divinity that this magma creature displayed far surpassed any of them!
The so-called divinity was what he called extreme life forms. It referred to the control of cells, the ability to change genes, the speed at which matter was constructed, and so on. In theory, a God could create all things, and the battle between them.., the more special and tough the matter that was constructed, the faster the speed, and the greater the chance of victory. This was just like the difference between an ordinary person who punched fast and a person who punched slowly.
In the blink of an eye, from the three people who were fighting each other to the three of them working together, it only took a few seconds to decide. The three people’s eyes met, and they quickly agreed on an attack method. The Demon Emperor was the first to rush out, and crimson moon surrounded them from the side, releasing a large number of silver threads, he set up traps and domains.
On the other side, Lin Changsheng relied on his powerful knowledge to control the Aragami in his hand to create ice, fire, thunder, and other three elemental substances. A large amount of dark clouds gathered in midair, he used the magnetic field in the world to strengthen his attack. What made him regret was that the Aragami in his hand was only an ordinary Aragami. If he had not trained it for over a hundred years and grasped a large amount of knowledge.., the speed of the body’s structure was probably far inferior to crimson moon and the demon emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1201 - Chapter 1,190: fierce battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1201: Chapter 1,190: fierce battle
Translator:
549690339
The Demon Emperor dived down with murderous intent. Little Beastie sensed something and raised its head to take a look. Its white flame-like eyes fell on its body, and a sharp cutting blade extended from its arm like a venomous snake, instantly expanding to several hundred meters, it shot towards the demon Emperor’s head.
The Demon Emperor snorted coldly. As he waved his arm, a beam of dark energy slashed out like a crescent moon, cutting off this soft, poisonous snake-like blade.
The Little Beast did not expect to be injured. It was stunned for a moment before it quickly attacked again. Several strange wings appeared on its back. They were very asymmetrical, like the wings of different animals pieced together. There were butterfly-shaped oval wings.., there were bird wings and bat-like wings. They grew on its back in an uneven manner, carrying its body and soaring into the sky!
As it flew into the air, the little beast and the Demon Emperor collided. At the instant they got close, a large number of sharp blades shot out from the Little Beast’s arms and body. Every blade was covered in flames, like an inescapable net, it completely enveloped the space where the demon Emperor was located.
The Demon Emperor’s eyes turned slightly cold. The speed at which this magma creature was constructing its body was beyond his imagination. However, he was not a pushover either. He was also prepared. At this moment, his entire body suddenly expanded, and wings that resembled sharp claws grew out from his back, three sharp barbs stood on his forehead, curving like ox horns towards the sky. His body had also become more than ten meters long, and his entire body was covered in black patterns, like twisted demonic insects.
He raised his palm and shot out a black beam of light with a diameter of dozens of feet. It was filled with a destructive aura as it collided with the cutting blade in front of him.
The cutting blade that came into contact with this black beam of light was instantly annihilated. There was no sound of collision, as if it had silently shattered the wind and disappeared. The black beam of light did not lose any of its remaining strength as it flew towards the Little Beast’s body.
The Little Beast’s arms suddenly closed, turning into a flesh limb that was dozens of meters in diameter. The surface was flowing lava, but the top was like a volcano. The moment the black beam of light flew over, a large amount of lava suddenly spewed out from the top, tilting out.., it actually gradually swallowed the black beam of light.
When the demon lord saw this scene, he heaved a sigh of relief in his heart. Although this strange creature that emitted the aura of an Aragami gave him an extremely dangerous feeling, and its divinity was extremely high, the material it created did not seem to be of a high grade, it was as if it had a body full of strength, but it did not display it properly. In this way, it was not worth being afraid of.
He did not hesitate. He raised his hand and shot out a few black beams of light from his palm once again.
When the Little Beast’s incandescent eyes saw this scene, it suddenly narrowed its eyes. In the next moment, it folded its arms and turned into a small volcano that started to squirm. The surface of the volcano no longer showed traces of blood-red lava flowing, but was pitch-black like iron, when the black beam of light from the demon Emperor came crashing over, a gigantic black beam of light shot out from the crater at the top of the volcano. It had a diameter of twenty to thirty meters and was much thicker than the black beam of light released by the Demon Emperor.
With a whoosh, this gigantic black beam of light instantly swept past the black beam of light released by the demon Emperor and annihilated it. Then, it flew towards the demon emperor.
The demon lord’s pupils constricted, and the instant this massive beam of dark light collided with his body, his body suddenly twisted.
Whoosh!
The beam of light shot straight into the distance, disappearing into the distant horizon.
Lin Changsheng and Crimson Moon, who had been preparing their moves on the side, saw this scene. Their faces were filled with shock, and they looked at this strange creature in disbelief. Wasn’t this evolution ability a little too powerful? ! Just one exchange, and it had already learned the demon Emperor’s unique skill? !
In another place in the air, the demon Emperor’s figure was formed from transparent air. His face was filled with shock, and his face was somewhat pale. Just now, he had narrowly escaped death, and he had almost died from his own ability. He looked at this strange creature.., as if he had seen a ghost.
The Little Beast did not seem to think that he was still alive. It paused for a moment, then immediately shifted its cannon and aimed at the demon Emperor once more.
The Demon Emperor’s expression changed. He saw a dark beam of light of the same size coming at him again. However, he was prepared this time and immediately dodged it. He was not hit.
Little Beastie fired several times consecutively. Seeing that there was no effect, it retracted its closed arms. Then, its legs suddenly became longer and extended towards the ground. It was like two volcanic peaks made of lava, stabbing into the ground, it absorbed the material in the ground and converted it into energy in its own body.
With the Earth providing it with an endless supply of material, its body became bigger and bigger. Its arms turned into huge claws that were over a hundred meters long and slapped towards the Demon Emperor.
The Demon Emperor’s expression was unsightly. He did not forcefully resist. Instead, he shrunk his body to the size of a normal person. At the instant the sharp claws struck, he predicted the trajectory and dodged the claw attack by passing through the gaps between the sharp claws.
The small beast struck several times but did not manage to hit the demon emperor. It seemed to be a little irritated as it let out a low growl.
When he struck out with the sharp claws again, the demon Emperor still used the same method to dodge. However, this time, when he shuttled through the gaps between the sharp claws, countless sharp blades suddenly appeared from the gaps between the sharp claws and shot towards him, every sharp blade was covered with a thick dark substance, like shaking jelly. It did not look like energy, but an extremely soft gel.
The Demon Emperor’s expression changed. He suddenly curled his body, and like a small black hurricane, he charged out from the countless sharp blades.
The sharp blades were cut off, and the demon Emperor who flew out had countless wounds all over his body. However, they healed in an instant and did not hurt his core. However, the dark annihilation energy covered by the sharp blades caused great damage to his body, although it was repaired, the energy in his body had decreased by a lot.
Boom! !
Just as the little beast was about to attack the demon emperor again, a loud boom suddenly came from the sky. The Sky Ten thousand meters above them had been filled with dark clouds at some point. At this moment, the dark clouds were filled with thunder and lightning, and a fierce wind swept over, as if it was the end of the world. Under the dark clouds, Lin Changsheng was like a God floating high up in the sky. He raised his hand, and with a loud boom, the Thunder and lightning were drawn from the dark clouds to his hand. Then, he swung his arm and struck at the little beast below.
The small beast was caught off guard by the lightning strike, and its entire body immediately went numb. It froze for a moment, but soon, its incandescent white eyes revealed obvious anger. It was obvious that it had been angered by Lin Changsheng’s attack.
With a low growl, it pounced at Lin Changsheng.
Lin Changsheng’s expression was indifferent, and no one could see how he moved. The dark clouds above his head suddenly tilted down with countless pieces of ice. When these pieces of ice passed through the height of his body, they seemed to be strengthened by an invisible energy halo. From an ordinary block of ice.., they became solid, like crystals, incomparably sharp. Under the violent winds around them, they shot explosively towards the small beast like bullets.
The small beast raised its giant claw, and monstrous flames surged out from its surface. When countless ice crystals shot out, they struck the flames and caused them to become erratic, as if they were about to be extinguished. After a few seconds, the flames were truly extinguished.
Seeing this, Lin Changsheng did not have the time to reveal a happy expression. He saw that the giant claw that was covered in flames had actually turned into ice crystals, allowing those sharp ice crystals to crash into the giant claw, but they were disintegrated by the smooth giant claw.., perhaps the ice crystals were smashed into pieces, but the giant claw was safe and sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 1202
chapters.content:
?Chapter 1202: Chapter 1191: Devour
Translator: 549690339
Whoosh!
The giant claw suddenly streaked across, causing snowflakes to appear in the air.
Lin Changsheng’s body flashed with purple light as he dodged from the Giant Claw, appearing a thousand meters away as if he had teleported. His expression was extremely solemn as scales appeared on the giant claw, even larger than when it had first taken shape, some of the ice crystals that flew in the sky were shattered, while others were stuck to the giant claw, forming a messy pile of spikes.
“Be careful, its intelligence is not low!”The Demon Emperor on the other side said coldly.
The Little Beast raised its claw once more, preparing to strike. Suddenly, countless silver threads shot out from the sky, wrapping around the Little Beast’s giant claw and body. As soon as they stuck, the silver threads rapidly grew thicker and bigger, wrapping around the little beast.
The Little Beast struggled violently, but there were too many silver threads, and they seemed to grow as if they were alive. The more it struggled, the tighter the threads became.
“Cut off its legs and don’t let it continue to absorb the material in the Earth,”the Demon Emperor said to Lin Changsheng. Then, he suddenly swooped down, his arms transforming into two giant scimitars.
Whoosh!
The Demon Emperor’s speed was incredibly fast. He swept past the two lava peaks beneath the little beast. The peaks were connected to the Little Beast’s body, and they were no more than ten meters thick. When the demon Emperor swept past, there was a ‘crack’, the two-meter-wide lava rocks on the peak vanished into dust.
The Little Beast felt the pain and roared in anger. Large amounts of lava dripped down from the upper half of its severed legs, wanting to connect to the broken peaks below. At this moment, on the other side, Lin Changsheng raised his hand and pulled out a huge iceberg from the dark clouds. It was like a pyramid that was tilted upside down. His five fingers, which had demonized into withered vines and old trees, wrapped around the iceberg, suddenly, he threw the iceberg at the Lava Mountain below the little beast.
With a boom, the iceberg smashed into the two lava mountain peaks, instantly breaking the top of the mountain peak. Almost half of the peak collapsed, and the lava limbs that the little beast extended down were also frozen by the iceberg, like Amber Crystals.
But soon, the frozen lava burned through the ice and continued to drip down.
The Demon Emperor saw through the Little Beast’s goal and swooped down again. A layer of dark luster appeared on his sickle-like arms, once again cutting off the lava that was about to drip down to the broken peak.
The Little Beast roared furiously. From the dripping lava, it suddenly shot out a thorn-like, ferocious rock snake that slithered toward the demon lord at high speed.
The demon lord’s expression was cold. His arms quickly cut through the lava fire snake that was charging toward him, cutting it into pieces.
“Sickle Death!”Lin Changsheng looked down from above, looking down at the little beast whose body was more than half wrapped in silver threads. Looking at its head that was exposed outside, it roared ferociously. With a cold snort, his arm suddenly transformed into a black tentacle that was over a hundred meters long, the surface of the tentacle was covered with layers of black scales, like a giant python. However, there was a sharp needle that looked like a mouthpart at the top of the Tentacle. It suddenly stabbed toward the Little Beast’s head.
When the little beast saw the sharp needle coming toward it, it suddenly turned into a giant arm above its head. It clenched its fist and punched it. However, the surface of the black tentacle also turned into sharp blades that cut off the giant arm. The sharp needle of the mouthpart was as fast as lightning, it suddenly broke away from the black tentacles and shot out, directly piercing the head of the Little Beast.
The huge arm that was violently waving above the little beast’s head suddenly stopped and froze in midair. In the next moment, its head suddenly exploded, and magma-like red brain matter flowed everywhere on the silver thread ball.
Lin Changsheng heaved a sigh of relief, the corners of his mouth revealing a trace of a smile. This was one of his most high-level research results. He had researched it from the zombie virus, and the mouthpart contained his specially constructed virus.., any contact with flesh and blood would result in a rapid reaction, like a nuclear weapon being detonated. It would rapidly invade all tissues and tear them apart, no matter how tough the body’s defense was, or how soft the body’s structure was.., when the cells in the body collapsed on their own, all external defenses would be unable to save them, and only death awaited them!
He had originally planned to leave this move for the demon lord, but now he could only use it in advance. Fortunately, he had other preparations.
Seeing this scene, the demon lord and Crimson Moon’s eyes turned cold. They gave Lin Changsheng a deep look, and at the same time, they secretly heaved a sigh of relief. The sense of threat that this strange desolate God gave them was many times stronger than Lin Changsheng’s, being able to solve it made them feel much more at ease.
“Oh?”Crimson Moon’s brows twitched, and her expression changed. She hurriedly said, “Not good!”
Roar!
An angry roar resounded through the heavens and earth. It came from the small beast’s broken neck. A new head of lava flowed out from within. It looked angrily at Lin Changsheng in the sky, and with a roar, it spat out a long tongue, the tongue rapidly transformed into a thorny whip in mid-air, wrapping around Lin Changsheng.
Lin Changsheng’s expression changed, and his reaction was swift. He quickly raised his altitude and dodged the thorny whip, but his expression was somewhat unsightly. Although the amount of virus in the mouthpart was only enough to destroy this monster’s head, this monster’s head was already gone.., it could actually be reconstructed. This meant that the core of the monster’s life was not its brain at all!
The Little Beast’s attack on Lin Changsheng was not successful. Its lower body suddenly shot out countless lava and rain of fire, flying towards the demon lord.
The demon lord’s figure swayed, and he easily dodged the rain of fire. He was not hit. Once the Little Beast tried to connect to the ground, he would break it. If this dragged on, no matter how strong the divine nature of this strange Aragami was.., no matter how fast the material structure was, without energy, it would still be slowly dragged to death!
The Little Beast roared in anger. Its body demonized into all sorts of strange limbs, trying to tear apart the silver threads. However, just as it tore through a layer, it was entangled by a new silver thread. Its body was bound from beginning to end. It tried to use flames to burn and construct beams of light to attack, however, the effect was not great. Crimson Moon and Lin Changsheng were not to be trifled with either. They each constructed a material that countered each other to block and defend. As the three of them were the strongest experts in the world, they had an extremely deep reserve of knowledge, on the contrary, the things that the Little Beastie had mastered were rather ordinary. Most of the abilities it had learned from the three of them.
However, as a replicator, how could it keep up with the changes of its master?
Several minutes passed. The Little Beastie’s roar gradually weakened, and the intensity of the attacks it released also clearly weakened. It was like a cornered beast fighting, completely suppressed by the three of them.
Not long after, the three of them seized the opportunity and attacked at the same time. Silver threads danced in the air, and the Demon Emperor transformed into an angel of hell. He held a sharp blade in his hand as he weaved through the silver threads, tearing the little beast’s body into countless pieces.
Meanwhile, Lin Changsheng released ice or light beams, freezing or destroying these pieces of torn flesh. A moment later, only a seven or eight-meter-long frozen blood clot remained in the air, falling into Lin Changsheng’s hand.
“It’s finally solved. This desolate God doesn’t seem to have any human consciousness...”Lin Changsheng looked at the blood clot in his hand and muttered to himself. He could vaguely guess the origin of this strange desolate god, but he did not say it out loud.
The Demon Emperor and Crimson Moon looked at the blood clot in his hand, their eyes shining brightly. They could see that this desolate god was different from ordinary desolate gods, the difference was huge, and a characteristic of desolate gods was that they ‘ate together’..
Crimson Moon’s eyes flashed. Just as she was about to speak, a blood wind suddenly whistled past and with a whoosh, it engulfed her body!

chapters.title: Chapter 1203
chapters.content:
?Chapter 1203: Chapter 1192: Perfect Life
Translator: 549690339
“What!”
Lin Changsheng and the demon emperor were shocked. This situation was out of their expectations, and they could not react in time. Moreover, the speed of the blood shadow was extremely fast. Even with their vision, they could not see it. If it was coming for them.., it would probably be difficult to dodge.
The two quickly looked in the direction of the Blood Shadow, and immediately saw a suffocating scene.
In the sky that was covered with dark clouds, they saw a bright red demon figure with a huge body suspended in the air. It had a pair of huge wings on its back, which were mixed with the characteristics of the wings of different monsters. It looked like a feather, like a bat, like a butterfly, and like an armor. It was very strange, it seemed to be pieced together by force, which made people feel uncomfortable and scared. Its body structure was even more strange. On its forehead, there were many strange eyeballs. Some were long and thin, like human eyes; some were vertical pupils, like Snake Eyes; and some were red eyes, like compound eyes... They were all different. Its mouth was split open to the back of its head, and its sharp teeth were protruding out. It was ferocious and terrifying.
Its body was like a human’s. It had seven arms, and each arm was different. It had horns on its chest, like an ox. Under the horns was a huge mouth. At that moment, it was chewing on a few black legs that were shaped like limbs.
The black legs were twitching slightly, as if it was struggling. However, it was chewed and swallowed bit by bit, slowly disappearing from the eyes of the two people.
On both sides of the monster’s body, there were extremely fine red cracks, like lava veins, extending out in a complicated manner. The rest of its body was dark skin, like human flesh. There were no carapace or hair on its surface.
“What kind of monster is this? !”Lin Changsheng’s pupils constricted slightly, as he felt a terrifying pressure.
The demon lord beside him had a drastic change in expression. From the start of the battle until now, it was the first time that he had shown fear. Hearing Lin Changsheng’s words, his throat moved, and he said in a trembling voice, “This is... the Aragami from just now!”
“What!”Lin Changsheng was stunned. He widened his eyes and looked at the demon lord. When he saw the expression on his face, he was instantly stunned. His heart sank slightly, he quickly asked, “Are you seeing things? “Didn’t we kill the Aragami just now? Could it be that it was just a substitute? “Impossible, how could a substitute have battle consciousness? Moreover, under our eyes, it could not have split its own consciousness so quickly!”
The Demon Emperor was similarly in disbelief. The image of the desolate God’s lower body turning into a rain of fire attacking him appeared in his mind. He immediately came to his senses. The area covered by the rain of fire was extremely large, but there were not many places that had attacked him, he did not care about the rest of the rain of fire falling to the ground. Now that he thought about it, it was most likely that the desolate God had hidden its life core into one of the rain of fire and escaped to the ground!
Other than that, there was another possibility. That was that when the Aragami had plunged its body into the ground to absorb the energy from the basin, it had already secretly separated its life core and sent it deep underground, when they were fighting with their clones, they were constantly absorbing the energy from the ground to transform it into their own energy. They were growing rapidly until they had terrifying energy that surpassed them. Only then did they appear in front of them!
Regardless of which possibility it was, it meant that there were two worst-case scenarios.
Firstly, this Aragami had extremely high intelligence and was extremely cunning!
Secondly, this Aragami was not the Aragami that he knew of. Instead, it was the existence that all the demonic insects and Aragami had been searching for — a perfect life form!
Simply put, this was a true God!
A complete, indestructible God with unlimited potential!
Only a true God could grow so shockingly and absorb Earth’s matter in such a large scale to transform it into its own energy. Only a God could construct new matter so quickly and transform his body into any shape with a single thought!
Moreover, this god was still growing at a rapid pace. This was far from what demigods with only divinity could compare to. In just a short period of time after the battle, he had grown to such a terrifying level, the limbs and black legs that the monster at the chest was chewing on when he subdued Crimson Moon were clearly crimson moon’s demonized limbs!
Although there were elements of a sneak attack in this attack, the strength displayed was not inferior to theirs. Moreover, after eating crimson moon, this god’s strength would definitely increase greatly once more!
In a short instant, these kinds of thoughts flashed through the Demon Emperor’s mind. He clenched his teeth slightly. He did not expect everything to proceed according to plan. After getting rid of the Fire Dragon Lord, Crimson Moon was also about to be killed, but in the end, such a monster suddenly rushed out.., it had completely disrupted his plans. Moreover, considering the terrifying combat strength of this monster, even if Lin Changsheng was clearly right in front of him and the hope of becoming a god was just around the corner, he had no choice but to retreat!
This required great courage and perseverance. Countless people were tempted by desire, but how many people could restrain their desires? An ordinary person could not even achieve the laws of life, so how could he restrain his desires? Not to mention that he was constantly faced with the temptation of desire in a high position!
However, the demon lord’s Willpower was far from what an ordinary person could compare to. After scheming for many years, hope was right in front of his eyes. However, he suddenly restrained the impulse in his heart and immediately turned around to retreat!
The moment the demon lord moved, the Aragami in midair noticed him. It was as if he saw the delicacies on a plate suddenly climbing out of the plate. He was slightly displeased and suddenly pounced forward. With a raise of his hand, his palm turned into a cylinder, silver threads shot out from the cylinder and descended from the sky. Like a huge screen, they covered most of the sky, completely covering the direction the demon Emperor had retreated to!
Lin Changsheng was slightly startled. He did not understand why the demon Emperor would retreat. Could it be that even if they joined forces, they would not be able to defeat this monster? Very quickly, he thought of something, and his expression instantly changed. He ran at full speed from another direction!
“As expected!”The demon monarch’s heart sank when he saw the silver threads in the sky. His conviction to retreat became even more firm. If he was reluctant to part with the silver threads earlier, then this reluctance was also gone at this moment. He immediately cast a thick black light.., with his body as the center, it radiated in all directions, covering a diameter of several hundred meters. Like a black ball, it crashed into the silver threads in the sky!
All of a sudden, the silver threads turned into black threads, as if they were the same substance as the dark energy released by the demon lord. The black threads gathered together and turned into a huge claw that grabbed the huge black ball!
After the black ball was grabbed by the huge claw, it gradually shrank at a speed visible to the naked eye until it completely disappeared.
The Aragami did not show any joy. Instead, it was stunned. It suddenly felt something and looked into the distance. It saw an aurora figure disappear into the horizon like an illusion. In the blink of an eye, it turned into a bright light and completely disappeared.
It knew that it was too late to chase after it. With a low roar, it turned its head and its gaze fell on Lin Changsheng, who had turned into an ice bird and was fleeing at high speed.
“Damn it!”Lin Changsheng’s expression was ugly. The Demon Emperor was one step ahead of him and had already prepared a backup plan. He had tricked the Aragami and taken the opportunity to escape. At this moment, he was the only one left to face the enraged Aragami, moreover, he did not have the escaping methods of the demon emperor. Otherwise, he would not have waited until the demon Emperor and the others caught up to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1204
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1205: Chapter 1,194: A Lifetime
Translator: 549690339
“This is... the imperial capital?”
Seeing this familiar architectural style, he had some guesses in his heart. One after another, he saw some scenes in the wilderness. In this scene, a young man with a body full of ferocious and sharp blades pounced toward the existence in his line of sight.
“This is me...”he was stunned for a moment. Soon, he saw another sea area. When his line of sight rushed out of the sea area, he saw the person he saw lowering his head to look at the fish-scale-like body, a young man with an eccentric temperament was exhaling from his body. It was himself.
This familiar background made him suddenly realize that the scene recorded in the ball seemed to be the world that Crimson Moon’s eyes were observing!
This was Crimson Moon’s memory!
However, why did the demon lord appear in Crimson Moon’s memory?
Soon, he thought of another memory in Crimson Moon’s body, Bolo.
The images of the imperial capital that he had seen earlier, as well as the words spoken by some of the people from the imperial court, were all calling out the name of the ‘Dark Lord’. Clearly, those were Bolo’s memories, which Crimson Moon had read and recorded in her mind, they became her memories.
Soon, he saw familiar scenes. Crimson Moon captured him, dissected him at the giant wall of Sylvia, and studied his body.
He also saw Crimson Moon determine that his experiment had failed, assign him to a freezer, and then continue with new experiments. In these new experiments, Crimson Moon used a large number of test subjects, brutal and bloody. In addition, he also saw Crimson Moon Meeting Bolo, fighting with him, and swallowing him.
However, when Bolo died tragically, he did not struggle as he imagined. Having seen Crimson Moon’s form in the divine cage, he immediately felt that he could read the meaning in Bolo’s eyes before he died, it was a cold, compassionate, gentle and successful look.
In addition, he saw his own heart sealed by Crimson Moon. She had analyzed the structure of his heart and left Sylvia, he found the corpse of the Aragami guarding the other giant wall. He mixed it with the polar ice worm and the flame worm to occupy the other giant wall. He used the resources inside to gradually improve his body.
“My heart has been destroyed...”
Dudian found it difficult to accept what he had seen. His heart was sliced by crimson moon bit by bit. He studied it time and time again. In the end, there was nothing left. All of them became the victims of the experiment!
He would never be able to find his heart again. It would be something that he would never be able to find!
Dudian followed Crimson Moon’s memory. He saw her go to God’s kingdom to challenge the Seven Kings after she had finished improving her body. She had alarmed the Devil Emperor. She had surrendered to the Devil Emperor.
He also saw Crimson Moon and the Devil Emperor discussing the expedition to the federation. He also heard Crimson Moon’s thoughts and plans.
He quickly browsed through most of Crimson Moon’s memories as if they were carved in his own memory. However he found that there was no end to the number of balls that came in, he saw more scenes. Those Were Bolo’s memories. From birth to adulthood, Bolo was born into a noble family in the capital. He was a real noble with a noble title, however, Bolo’s father’s noble title was only a low baron. His territory was only a few villages and a small river.
Unlike other nobles, Bolo’s hair was black. His father had blonde hair and his mother had black hair. However, he inherited his mother’s hair color. As a result, he grew up under the bullying of his older brother and sister.
However, he was still a noble young master in his father’s territory. The clothes he wore were enough to make the villagers envious.
There was a delicate girl in the village. She secretly liked him and wrote love letters to him.
He met the girl he had admired all his life, Diana.
When he saw Diana, he found that her face was so familiar. She was exactly the same as Crimson Moon. Even her hair color was the same. It seemed that every finger and every inch of skin were the same, the only difference was that Diana’s eyes were very gentle. It was obvious that she was a kind-hearted person. Crimson Moon’s eyes were filled with arrogance and domineering conqueror.
The congenital conditions made Bolo’s love destined to be a tragedy. Diana was the daughter of the Marquis and was loyal to the king. Bolo was the son of a low baron. Moreover, he was the one who was the least valued, this caused his story to become very common, just like the stories often heard by traveling poets and fairy tales. However, unlike fairy tales, the love between the rich and the poor did not cross this chasm, instead, they were deeply buried by this chasm!
By chance, Bolo became a hunter. He displayed an astonishing fighting ability. In addition, he had been bullied since he was young, and his heart was gloomy. When he was a teenager, he had already been very shrewd and secretly killed his elder brother and sister, the second lady, who had framed her father, had secretly killed her father when the family was in an irreconcilable dispute. She then used her iron-blooded method to inherit the title of nobility.
After obtaining the title of nobility and fiefdom, he immediately sought refuge with an earl. He tried his best to show his value and the loyalty of his lackeys. He was appreciated by the earl and secretly hooked up with the Earl’s daughter. In the end, the Earl married his daughter not long after, he also plotted to kill the Earl and send all his children to slavery. The one who married him also gave him poison to commit suicide.
After becoming an earl, he sought refuge with a king. Using the king’s intelligence channels and resources, he quickly increased his strength and became stronger step by step. However, the Marquis had given Dinah, whom he loved, to a king as a concubine. She became a political sacrifice. In his grief and indignation, he participated in the hunting operation and left the team, however, he unexpectedly met an extremely rare ancient monster. This ancient monster was on its last breath and seemed to have just gone through a great battle. It was extremely weak and was lucky that he met it.
After obtaining the ability of this ancient monster, his strength rose sharply. When his strength increased rapidly, he was careful to hide it and did not dare to attract the attention of the king who had submitted to him, he secretly colluded with the witch demon in his own territory to do biological experiments.
Not long after, he received news that Dina had been strangled to death by that cruel king while serving her.
After receiving the news, Bolo was furious, but he did not act rashly. Instead, he sneaked into the cemetery of this king’s territory at night and secretly dug up the buried body of Dina, bringing it back to his own territory, he used the techniques he had learned to preserve the body.
He found the secret of the Polar Ice Worm and guessed the truth behind the king of the Imperial City. However he was determined to become the king for revenge.
However he used a special method to seal the polar ice worm which helped him to become the king. He only extracted its power but didn’t let it interfere with his consciousness. In the end he killed the king who had killed Diana, he also defected from the Empire.
Dudian was immersed in Boro’s past life. He was unaware of the passage of time. He gradually understood Boro’s crazy behavior when he saw the beauty of Diana.
He saw his own shadow in the latter.
However, perhaps it was because of his character. Boro’s character was different from his. Although he was tolerant but his character was more eccentric, cold and perverted!
“A person can not be resurrected after death. It’s easy to say a few words, but if the one who died was his true love, the meaning behind it is so sad that it makes people angry and powerless!” Thinking of Aisha who was nowhere to be found at the moment, he felt that he missed her very much. He wanted to immediately appear by her side, even if it was just to quietly look at her and protect her.
At this time, the ball was still pouring in from the gap. It quickly cracked as if there was an endless memory ball.
Dudian saw more images from the broken ball. In addition to the obvious images of Bolo’s memory, there were also some strange images. There were images similar to the giant city of the imperial capital. There were memories of children who had never seen them growing up, there were ordinary people born in ordinary families who studied as lawyers. There were young ladies born in noble families who learned to paint, marry, have children, and grow old.
There were many ordinary people’s memories after the broken ball. Most of them were for life. Some were for half of their lives. Some of them were teenagers at the beginning of their lives. Some were even seventy or eighty years old.
