Chapter 1204: Chapter 1,193: “He”
Translator: 549690339
Darkness, burning pain, tearing, warmth..
“He”woke up in a daze and “Saw”a blood-red world around him. This was the color of light reflected in his pupils, this color made “He”instinctively think the first thought:
I’m not dead?
Then “He”came up with a second thought: where is this place?
He tried to look at the world, only to see giant blood-red balls around him, like planets in the universe, countless, round and beautiful.
He was attracted by this beauty, and after staring for a long time, he suddenly thought of a third question: Why Am I here?
After this question, he immediately had a new question: Who... am I?
The more he thought about it, the more anxious he became. He was shocked and afraid. He could feel that he had existed before, as an independent entity, an existence that had been given a name, however, at this moment, when he tried to recall his name, his species, and his identity, he realized that he could not remember anything. There were only fragments that flashed past like ghosts, and it was difficult to capture them.
It was as if he had forgotten something that he was used to.
“He”used all his strength to think. Suddenly, he felt the world of the blood-red planet around him fluctuate violently. It was as if the universe was shaking. Countless blood-red planets trembled, followed by waves of intense pain.
The pain became more and more intense, as if it had been completely torn apart.
“He”felt “His”vision go black, and he fainted completely.
After an unknown period of time, “He”woke up again. When he woke up, he saw the familiar world of the blood-red planet. He was stunned for a few seconds before he slowly remembered what had happened before he fainted, at the same time, some fleeting fragments appeared in his mind. “He”saw the information in these fragments and suddenly woke up. He knew his true identity, but before “He”could rejoice.., the tearing pain appeared again and he fainted.
After a long time, “He”woke up again. When he saw the blood-red world in front of him, his first thought instinctively surfaced: I’m not dead?
Then, he had another question: where am I?
Then, “He”sized up this blood-red world. After a long time, he thought of a new question: Who Am I?
When the blood-red world shook for an unknown number of times, “He”fainted again and woke up in a daze.
He did this over and over again until the last time he woke up, when he saw countless familiar faces and a beautiful figure carved into the deepest part of his memory, he finally knew his name. This time, the blood-red world did not shake. The world seemed to become extremely quiet and lasted for a long time.
It lasted for so long that he had pieced together countless fragments of his memories. In addition to piecing together his memories, he had also read out the tiny fragments of his memories, and he knew that he had fallen unconscious time and time again in the blood-red world, he woke up again and again. When most of the time he woke up, he had forgotten who he was, and did not know anything. He was like a newborn baby, but there were very few who would remember his identity when they woke up, however, every time he woke up, before he could think about his current situation, the world around him would shake and tear him apart.
This blood-red world seemed to be extremely unstable and could fluctuate at any time.
However, this time, it was stable for a very, very long time.
After he searched for his memories, he tried to leave this place, but he found that his consciousness could not feel his body at all. It was like a wisp of soul floating in the universe of nothingness. He could not feel anything. He could only feel pain every time, could he feel pain.
He tried many methods, but none of them were effective. He could only watch the unchanged blood-red world in front of him, silently waiting for the next turbulence and tearing pain.
Perhaps this was the hell after death?
There was no 18 levels of hell, no evil spirits. He was just in a dull world, staying forever, repeatedly waking up and sleeping.
Loneliness was far scarier than loneliness. Loneliness was a state of mind. A lonely person could still live an interesting life, but loneliness was numb.
He could neither die nor age. Perhaps this kind of not being able to die, not being able to move, not being able to do anything, and not being able to improve at all was the scariest and most difficult thing to endure.
The blood-red world seemed to be frozen, so stable that there was not the slightest fluctuation. In the midst of the loneliness and boredom, all his thoughts had finished spinning, and all his patience had been exhausted. He even looked forward to the turbulence appearing. At the very least.., he could still feel the sharp pain of being torn apart, and he could have a different experience.
The desolation did not give him a new understanding of ‘life’. On the contrary, he was filled with endless desire for ‘life’!
If he was given another chance, he was willing to plan more meticulously, in more detail, more ruthless, and more despicable. He also wanted to ensure that he could survive!
After waiting for a few years, decades, or even longer, one day, the solidified and stable blood-red world once again fluctuated!
Seeing this fluctuation, he, who had long since become numb and stopped thinking about new ideas, felt as if he had just woken up from a stone statue. He immediately felt a wave of excitement and anticipation. He would rather be unconscious than wait in this lonely world.
The blood-red world cracked open, and a large number of colorful balls, which were slightly smaller than the giant blood-red balls, poured in from the outside. They continuously squeezed in front of him.
He was a little surprised. He had never seen such a situation before when he was unconscious.
In the next moment, the pink ball closest to him cracked open, and a voice suddenly emerged from within. It sounded like an audio playback in his ear, and the voice was extremely familiar. It was Crimson Moon!
Immediately after, another ball cracked open, and a scene emerged from within. It was a dark, hellish laboratory. Inside, there were all sorts of broken hands, broken limbs, eyeballs, and organs soaked in medicinal liquid.
The rest of the balls broke apart one after another. A scene or sound appeared in each of the balls. There was a Crimson Moon, an unknown stranger, and even his own!
In addition, in some of the scenes, he saw the demon lord. However, the demon lord in the scene was different from the demon lord he had seen in the federation. He appeared much younger and more vigorous. His temperament was not as reserved and deep as it was now. Instead, it was full of vigor, he looked like a king who looked down on the world, full of vitality.
Other than the demon lord, he also saw a large number of Aragami corpses. He also saw all sorts of mysterious halls, dark laboratories, and all sorts of strange experiments. Among them, there were seven or eight white-robed experimenters surrounding a huge platform that was more than ten meters long, in the experimental images of dissecting an Aragami, the upper body of the Aragami looked like a human. The ribs on its chest were all cut open. They were separated outward, revealing its internal organs at a glance.
In addition, he also saw an extremely majestic giant city. The buildings were like a forest, airships were cruising in the air, and armored knights were patrolling on the streets. The Majestic Palace occupied the bustling streets, like a crawling giant beast, countless passers-by with all kinds of skin colors were walking in the giant city kingdom.

Chapter 1206: Chapter 1195: Seeds
Translator: 549690339
“Are these the memories of others?”Dudian was puzzled. He suddenly saw a completely different scene at the end of the scene, it was as if he was jumping from one scene to another. One moment he was drunk with friends in a luxurious restaurant. The next moment he was in a spacious study room. There were bookshelves in front of him, there were piles of thick and heavy books.
This study looked familiar to him. He seemed to have seen it somewhere before. After thinking about it carefully, he remembered that it was the study that he had seen in Bolo’s memory. This was the study that Bolo had seen in the castle of his territory when he was a count.
The next moment, he saw the picture move. It was from the perspective of a pair of eyes. He saw two long and thick palms. They were wearing top-grade emerald rings. They were Bolo’s hands!
“I fell asleep again...”Boro’s voice appeared in the picture.
Dudian was startled. Was this Boro’s Dream?
The other memory spheres kept breaking. New memory images appeared. It was the life of a stranger. However, when he was in his twenties, he was suddenly killed in the street. Then the image changed and appeared in the Dark Bedroom, boro’s voice echoed: “It’s another nightmare...”
More and more memory spheres were broken. Dudian saw dozens of different lives. However most of his memories ended with Boro waking up. These different lives were all his dreams!
“Dreams?”
The more Dudian looked at Boro’s memories, the more confused he became. Previously when he looked at Boro’s memories, he only saw occasional dreams mixed with real life. However, those dreams occupied a small part of his memory. The dreams inside were very fragmented, there were only a few fragments, or a few blurred faces or the figure of a giant beast. But later on, he saw that Bolo’s dreams were very clear.
Everyone had experienced a lifetime. Some died young while others lived to the end of their lives.
After thinking for a moment, Dudian suddenly realized that these complete dreams were fake. Bolo had made them up. Because they were made up, they were very clear, the life of each identity was carefully designed by Bolo. There were some who looked very similar to Bolo. There were some scenes where the shadows of the Imperial City and the giant wall could be seen.
Some of them were completely different from Bolo. There were even women, old people and children who had nothing to do with Bolo. Under normal circumstances, who would become a woman or an old man in their dreams?
The main reason why Bolo deliberately designed such a dream was because of Crimson Moon.
Crimson Moon was a woman. If she wanted Crimson Moon to believe that she was Bolo’s dream, then her real identity was Bolo. She had to design such a dream. Moreover, she had to be vague so that there were children and old men in it.
“So this is the way that Bolo confused Crimson Moon’s memory...”Dudian finally understood why Crimson Moon thought of him as Bolo. When Bolo had tracked down Sylvia to find Crimson Moon, he had already planned for it, it was also within his expectations that Crimson Moon would betray and escape when the Blood Thorn King and others joined forces. He had long noticed that Crimson Moon was not like other clones and was completely obedient to him.
Before looking for Crimson Moon, he had planned to be killed by Crimson Moon. Then he would merge his memory and Crimson Moon’s body into one. He would be completely integrated with her and never be separated from her. This was his obsession!
Rather than saying that he was killed by Crimson Moon, it was more accurate to say that he had voluntarily given up on his own body.
Boro had expected that Crimson Moon would visit his memories after killing him, so he had woven a large number of clear dream memories into his own memories in advance. Dream life after dream life was extremely long, if Boro’s own life was ten memories, then the other fabricated false memories were five hundred!
Under the impact of a large number of clear dreams, Crimson Moon was confused. She mistakenly thought that she was a dream after Boro fell asleep. When a certain condition was met, such as fully using the magic body, it would trigger Boro’s hidden weapons, she woke up from the dream of “Crimson Moon”and became Boro!
It was like a person who had lived for ten years and suddenly became a beast. He had lived for ten thousand years. Perhaps he had already thought of himself as a beast and not a human.
“Zhuang Zhou Dream Butterfly...”Dudian sighed as he thought of an old story. He had to say that Boro was an outstanding wise man. However his obsession was too deep. If he used his body as an experiment.., he had already completed a demigod experiment on himself. He was comparable to the Devil Emperor. In addition to his intelligence he could fully display his body!
Dudian even felt that if the devil emperor had been locked in the cage, the latter might not have been able to break out of the cage.
“Fabricate a lot of memories and then cut off the idea of fabricating memories from the brain’s memory and remove them from the body. This way, the possibility of Crimson Moon being confused is very high.”Dudian looked at the memory spheres that were still breaking, he felt a trace of fear in his heart. If the memory spheres were not broken one by one so that he could see them, but like Crimson Moon’s memory tour, he would be able to watch them continuously from beginning to end, he would most likely be lost in this. He would think of his life as a dream of Bolo!
When a certain condition was triggered, perhaps he would think of himself as Bolo’s awakening and continue to complete Bolo’s goals and career!
“Although he is dead, but this hand is ready to ‘live’from a body at any time!”Thinking of Crimson Moon’s appearance, Dudian admired and sighed at Bolo. In a sense.., bolo’s method could make ‘him’live forever. As long as his memories were spread out, the more copies of ‘him’were spread out. These memories were like a seed.., a new Boro would be born!
But was this really living?
Dudian was a bit confused. It was always difficult to distinguish ‘life’from ‘death’.
However, it seemed that he didn’t need to distinguish what was really living because he was already dead when he was searching for ‘life’.
And this place was his hell.
He imagined that if he could still live and learn Bolo’s move, he would use Bolo’s method to awaken his memories in other living beings and turn them into ‘him’.
But was that him and the current him himself?
As he thought about it, he suddenly felt bored and simply could not be bothered to think about it. At that moment, the shattered balls outside the crack slowly decreased until they stopped pouring in.
The remaining balls in front of him completely disappeared after they were broken one by one. His vision returned to the monotonous, unchanging blood-red world.
Just as he was feeling depressed, the blood-red world suddenly shook violently. In the next moment, he felt his thoughts being pulled, gathered into a ball, and suddenly flew to a place!

Chapter 1207: Chapter 1196: The escaping Lin Changsheng
Translator:
549690339
Whoosh!
A bloody wind swept past, and a huge claw burning with black flames suddenly descended from the sky, blocking the direction Lin Changsheng had retreated.
“Illusion!”Lin Changsheng’s expression was unsightly. At the instant the huge black flame claw closed in, viscous dark energy suddenly rose from his entire body. With a whoosh, it pierced through the huge black flame claw, leaving his body unscathed, it seemed like the giant Black Flaming Claw was just a virtual projection, but in reality, it was Lin Changsheng who had combined the illusory ability of the White Tiger King and the dark energy of the demon lord to complete it.
The body’s illusory ability allowed Lin Changsheng to pass through matter, and the black flames on the giant claw were actually created by the Aragami imitating the demon lord’s ability. It was an energy attack. Lin Changsheng could see this, so he transformed his body structure into the same energy, reaching the “Same frequency”. Thus, he passed through without any hindrance and was not injured at all.
If the demon lord was here, he would have realized that Lin Changsheng had already grasped the mystery of his ability.
The Aragami’s Claw missed. It was obvious that it was stunned for a moment, as if it did not expect such a strange situation to occur. But it quickly reacted and quickly caught up, once again slamming down with its claw. This time, other than the black flames on the giant claw.., there was also a silver thread added to it. It was the special silk blade that Crimson Moon had used to construct the divine cage.
Lin Changsheng’s expression changed slightly. He took a deep breath and once again rammed his head against the giant black claw.
With a whoosh, he once again pierced through the giant claw. Even if it was crimson moon’s silver thread, he had already constructed it. In reality, he had already grasped the theory behind the inner structure of this silver thread. When he saw Crimson Moon use her ability.., he secretly tried it in his body and created it with a little modification. This was one of the methods he was prepared to use against the demon lord. It was also one of the reasons why he was confident that he could kill the demon lord without relying on nuclear weapons!
However, the Aragami that appeared out of nowhere was too strong. Moreover, he could already tell that this Aragami was clearly not as simple as a mere aragami. He could completely remove the previous word, it was truly... a “God”!
He knew that even if he obtained a divine body like that of the demon lord, with endless potential, he would still not be able to grasp so many high-end abilities in such a short period of time. This control over his body could be said to have reached the point where he could do as he pleased, any form could be achieved with a single thought!
Furthermore, the speed at which this Aragami absorbed the material from the ground to transform into its own energy was definitely not something that the demon lord could compare to. It was completely on the level of a “God”!
Although absorbing different matter and converting it into its own energy was nothing strange to Lin Changsheng, and even ordinary Aragami could do it, the key was the speed at which it absorbed it! This was just like a race between an ordinary person and a world champion. A common person was ordinary, and a world was unique!
In a world of slaughter, such a gap was terrifying!
“If I can obtain its body, I’ll immediately become a God!”Lin Changsheng’s eyes revealed a hint of madness, but his expression was extremely rational and restrained, “But I can’t fight it to the death. This damned Effiny Hughes might be hiding in the distance and watching. It hasn’t really gone far, so I can’t let it reap the benefits!”
“It would be great if I could immediately unfreeze the nuclear weapons, but I need time. My mechanical army will need at least six minutes to crusade against the Army and retrieve the nuclear weapons!”
Long before the demon lord and the others had attacked the underground base, Lin Changsheng had already transmitted his orders through the virtual world to a batch of mechanical army chips that he had created. If the demon lord and the others had communicated with the outside world at that time, they would have discovered.., the Federation army that had originally been subdued by the Fire Dragon Lord and Crimson Moon, as well as the imperial army that had moved in, had encountered the frenzied attacks of a mechanical army that had appeared out of nowhere when they had rushed to the mainframe city.
These mechanical armies had no life at all. They fought crazily and were fearless of death. They had slaughtered the federation until smoke and smoke rose into the air. Their target was the nuclear arsenal that Crimson Moon and the Fire Dragon Lord had sealed up.
In addition, the authoritative commander that Lin Changsheng had secretly arranged was immediately rescued from the prison by his trusted soldiers. Although this commander had pretended to submit, after Crimson Moon and the Fire Dragon Lord had occupied the federation.., most of the high-ranking officials in the army were immediately removed and sent to prison. However, this commander’s connections were extremely wide. When the Mechanical Corps launched an attack, he knew that it was Lin Changsheng who had given the signal.., he immediately contacted his trusted aides and released them.
After coming out of prison, the commander rescued many of the other upper echelons of the army and immediately intervened in the army that had submitted to the empire. These middle-ranking generals used to be extremely powerful. In addition, the ones who replaced them were the generals of the empire. Immediately, countless low-ranking soldiers responded. The Federation Army fought together, and the imperial army went to stop the mechanical corps from attacking the nuclear arsenal, however, they were forced to retreat in defeat. Without a king to hold down the fort, they could only rely on the federation’s technological weapons and the empire’s self-made weapons to barely resist.
When Crimson Moon and the others attacked the federation, Lin Changsheng had used the virtual host to simulate the follow-up situation. Everything was in his script, except for this Aragami that had suddenly appeared that exceeded his expectations, at this moment, he was silently calculating the situation that he had deduced from the outside world. There were still six minutes left until the end. This was supposed to be his second-hand preparation just in case, but now, he could use it on this Aragami.
It was just that he did not know if he could hold on for six minutes.
If it was the demon lord and the Torch Dragon Lord, with Crimson Moon and the others attacking him together, he was confident that he could still barely hold on if he used his full strength. However, this Aragami’s ability to improve was too fast, and he still had to retain his strength to secretly defend against the demon lord who had escaped.., six minutes seemed very short, but to him at this moment, seconds felt like years.
After escaping from the claws twice in a row, the Aragami was clearly a little angry. It slightly bared its teeth, and its mouth was filled with sharp teeth. It was extremely terrifying. It let out a low roar from its throat and suddenly struck out with its giant claws again.
This time, the giant claws were still black flames. The silver threads on them were like sharp blades, and dark green poison gas had been added to them.
When Lin Changsheng saw the dark green poisonous gas, he slightly frowned. He recognized that it was a poison that a king who had just died specialized in. He secretly brewed it in his body, and the instant it neared him, it was instantly formed.
Bang! !
The intense burning pain suddenly spread throughout his entire body. All his limbs and bones trembled as if they were being shattered. With a whoosh, the ice bird that Lin Changsheng had turned into shattered. It crashed into the ground like a blue meteor, creating a huge crater.
Lin Changsheng’s body was broken into pieces but he quickly recovered. His face was extremely ugly. He had been tricked by the Aragami!
He believed that the Aragami didn’t see through his ability. After all, he was close to the Aragami. It was almost impossible to see through the secrets of his ability in an instant unless he was like Dudian, however, the Aragami didn’t have the knowledge of a human. It shouldn’t have thought of this. However, it used the same method to attack but added another ability to it, it seemed that the Aragami was trying to deal with him but in fact it was trying to paralyze and confuse him.
The energy in the giant claw fluctuated as he pierced through the giant claw. He was caught off guard. He was hit by the energy and almost turned into dust, his body could be said to be scattered into countless particles, extremely fragile!

Chapter 1208: Chapter 1197: Crushing
Translator: 549690339
“Although I don’t have much knowledge and only know how to copy the ability, but my nature is cunning and my learning ability is amazing. I guess it won’t be long before I can use my body to create different abilities.”Lin Changsheng stood up from the hole, he looked up at the Aragami who was smiling strangely in the air as if he was laughing at himself for falling into a trap.
He didn’t get angry but frowned deeply. His face was solemn. If his guess was correct, this monster was bred from Dudian’s heart. From the moment Dudian died from spontaneous combustion to the moment the monster was born.., in just a few minutes, the monster had grown to such a level. Moreover, it was growing at an amazing speed. No one knew how far it would evolve in the next six minutes?
Was this the level of eternal life that the sages and Aragami sought?
He suddenly understood the extreme pursuit of these alien life forms. It was indeed a power that made people yearn for and be intoxicated!
His eyes flashed with a hint of heat, but he quickly hid it. Seeing that the Aragami was about to charge at him again, he suddenly had a thought and said, “Wait a moment, I can let you get what you need!”
The Aragami that was charging down acted as if it did not hear him. It waved its huge claws and charged straight down.
Lin Changsheng did not give up. He continued, “I know that you can understand my words. You can not kill me, or else you will lose even more! If you need anything, I can help you get it. I can be your servant!”
A hint of doubt appeared in the Aragami’s eyes. “WA-WA?”
Upon hearing its voice, Lin Changsheng was delighted. As long as he could communicate with it, he was confident that he could delay it for six minutes. Furthermore, there was no need for him to fight. This was because from the rate at which the Aragami was evolving in battle, he felt that it was very likely that the Aragami would become braver as it fought, if he treated him like a grindstone and waited for six minutes, perhaps even a nuclear bomb might not be able to kill it. If he could use communication to delay it, it would naturally be the best.
“There are many beautiful places in this world, many treasures, and many powerful enemies. I can help you to rule them as quickly as possible and devour them!”Lin Changsheng tried to understand the latter’s thoughts, naturally, he had to cater to its interests.
“WA-WA?”The Aragami slowly stopped and landed about a hundred meters in front of Lin Changsheng. A small silver-white claw demonized on the giant claw scratched its head, its face full of confusion.
“You don’t know how to speak?”Lin Changsheng was a little surprised. With this monster’s intelligence, it actually did not learn human language? Could it be that it was born too young and did not have time to learn simulation?
He did not continue to struggle with this point, even if it was mute.., he could still communicate. “Do you like eating people like that just now? I can take you to find many people like that, and there are many especially delicious things that I can take you to try.”
He demonized a tentacle from his arm and gently stretched it forward without any hostility. His tone was also gentle, “This is the sensor that I woven. You can weave the same sensor, and we can communicate mentally.”
The Aragami slightly tilted its head, somewhat puzzled, but a similar tentacle quickly demonized from its body. The speed was so fast that it made Lin Changsheng’s heart waver.
“As expected, it has just been born. Although it is naturally cunning and powerful, how can it be able to defeat the cunning schemes of humans?”Lin Changsheng looked at the Aragami’s dazed look and suddenly felt that the latter was somewhat laughable, but when the tentacle was about to touch it, he quickly put away these thoughts and revealed an incomparably sincere emotion, transmitting it through the tentacle.
The two contact bodies were like poisonous snakes that intersected and connected!
Roar!
In the next moment, Lin Changsheng suddenly felt a bloody mouth suddenly pouncing over in his line of sight. He was caught off guard and all the pores on his body constricted. However, he quickly reacted and knew that this was the connection between the two bodies, the thought transmitted from the Aragami was like a ferocious and angry beast. It let out a deafening roar and crazily attacked him. The entire world seemed to have turned into a blood-red world.
“Damn it!”Lin Changsheng immediately understood that the Aragami was playing with him. It had no intention of negotiating with him. When he wanted to retract his body, he found that the body was already swollen, and a large number of blood vessels had expanded on the surface, on the other end of the connection, something seemed to have rushed over from the Aragami’s body, making him feel an extremely terrifying sense of danger.
With a bang, he decisively cut off the connection. Blood splattered everywhere, and a large number of loach-like worms quickly crawled out from the wound. They were sticky and writhing on the ground.
“WA, WA, wa...”like a sharp laugh, a strange laughter came from the other side of the Aragami. The mouth of the Aragami was extremely cracked, and his face was filled with a strange smile. He patted his stomach, looking like a human laughing with his hands on his belly.
Lin Changsheng immediately felt a wave of humiliation. He had thought that this beast was naive, but he had not expected the latter to think that he was naive. Reality proved that he had indeed underestimated his enemy too much. He had actually deluded himself into communicating with a monster, and had almost thrown himself into it!
Rumble!
Suddenly, the surrounding ground shook, waking Lin Changsheng up.
He thought of something, and his pupils constricted. He suddenly rushed up, only to see that the light had dimmed. The surrounding several hundred meters of land, like the sharp claws of an octopus, rolled back, wanting to grab him inside.
“F * ck!”Lin Changsheng could not help but curse. His body suddenly turned into a beam of light, like the King of light, his entire body was white as he rushed out from the gaps of the eight-clawed land.
However, the structure of the land had long been secretly changed by the Aragami. The soft sand had become as hard as ore, shooting out sharp thorns covered in dark flames and silver threads, like the shell of a sea urchin.
“Get lost! !”
Lin Changsheng roared angrily, his face ferocious. It was the first time he had such a miserable expression. Blood-like mucus suddenly gushed out of his body, and a large number of sharp claws and arms stretched out from his body, striking straight at one of the sharp spikes.
Bang!
The land closed up!
A muffled sound came from inside. From Afar, the sand grass on the surface of the nearby ground was completely gone, leaving only the bare soil at the bottom. On the ground was a round ball several hundred meters tall, extremely round.., it was like a mini artificial earth.
Boom!
A loud sound suddenly rang out, and one of the parts of the round ball ruptured. A blood-red figure rushed out from within. It was Lin Changsheng.
“Damn, damn, damn, damn!”Lin Changsheng’s eyes were red. He had actually been teased by a monster. From the beginning, the latter had landed on the ground in order to plant his feet into the ground and set up a trap to kill him. If he had not used all his strength.., he might have really succeeded!
Compared to the suppression of strength, the teasing of intelligence made him even angrier.
“Four minutes left! !”Lin Changsheng felt that this number made him despair, previously, he had already expected that these six minutes would be very difficult to pass. Now, he realized that he had still underestimated this Aragami. Even if he could hold on for another minute, it would still be extremely difficult for him!
