Chapter 1209: Chapter 1198: Live
Translator: 549690339
Run! Run! Run!
Lin Changsheng had no intention of fighting the Aragami. He only wanted to leave as soon as possible. Before the Aragami fully matured, he wanted to use nuclear weapons to completely destroy it!
He exhaled a mouthful of thick fog. Like the ink of an octopus, it spread in the air and did not dissipate. This ink-black fog was different from the demon lord’s fog. It did not have any substantial offensive or corrosive power, however, the complicated and chaotic structure inside could withstand the penetrating power of the penetrating eye. It was impossible to see the situation in the depths. This was one of the methods that he had painstakingly thought of for a hundred years.
At the instant he released the Black Fog, his body quickly demonized. The streamlined wings of a fighter jet protruded out from his back. The side of his body also demonized into a metal diamond-shaped structure. His speed instantly soared to the extreme, the air resistance was reduced to the minimum, and the gravity on the ground was also blocked by the anti-gravitational material in his body. This was the best flying state that he had created with a large amount of knowledge!
Whoosh!
Three thousand meters in an instant!
His figure was as fast as a flash, more than ten times faster than when he had turned into an ice bird earlier!
Whether it was the ink black fog or his current flying state, they were all trump cards that he had painstakingly constructed. One could instantly cut off the enemy’s visual perception during close combat, so that even if the enemy’s hearing was sensitive, it would be useless, after all, the speed of sound transmission was not as fast as their attack speed, so it could be used to launch a surprise attack!
The second was to save his life. It was enough for him to easily shake off the other kings. It was precisely because of this that he had dared to transform into an ice bird and fly leisurely earlier. He seemed to be flustered, but his heart was calm and at ease. At the same time, he made use of the Demon Emperor and the others’thoughts.., instigating internal strife and delaying time, waiting for the mechanical army that he had secretly arranged to seize the nuclear weapon and completely control the situation!
In the blink of an eye, Lin Changsheng had rushed over ten li away, his speed approaching half of the speed of the intercontinental ballistic missile. This meant that the nuclear weapon would not be able to hit him. After all, his vision was more than five times faster than the speed of the nuclear missile, when the nuclear weapon appeared in his vision, he had enough speed to avoid the central area of the nuclear weapon’s explosion and was unable to be hit. As for the damage caused by the explosion in the non-central area of the nuclear weapon, it was barely enough for him to survive!
However, this did not mean that he was not afraid of the nuclear weapon.
The nuclear weapon’s status was still at the ruling level. A nuclear weapon could not pose a threat to him. If it was a large-scale indiscriminate attack, even if his speed was twice as fast, he would still be blasted into ashes!
Whoosh!
Lin Changsheng rushed forward at full speed like he was going crazy. Even though his explosive speed was a few streets faster than the demon lord and Crimson Moon, he was still extremely nervous. This Aragami was not the half-baked demon lord and Crimson Moon, but a true God.., any ability could be seen with just a glance. Once it saw the structure of its own body, it would definitely be able to immediately imitate it and track it down.
He only prayed that the dark mist that he had studied would be able to block the Aragami’s line of sight, and he would take this short gap to completely escape the Aragami’s line of sight and range of perception.
Five seconds later, Lin Changsheng was already 16 li away. An eyeball split open at the back of his head and turned slightly. When he saw that there was no one chasing after him, he let out a sigh of relief. However, his speed did not decrease, but instead increased as he charged forward once again.
On the other side, the Aragami dived into the dark fog and shook its head. However, the dense fog did not disperse, obstructing its vision. With a low roar, it opened its mouth and sucked in the thick black fog, however, it saw that there was no sign of Lin Changsheng in the air.
The prey that had fallen into its palm had disappeared just like that.
Roar!
The Aragami roared angrily. It was somewhat angry and exasperated. It slapped its knees like a monkey and flew down in midair.
It suddenly thought of something. It twitched its nose and sniffed the air. When it smelled a scent, it drifted into the distance. It immediately chased in that direction with a fierce look in its eyes.
A moment later, it stopped in mid-air. Looking left and right, it realized that all of its senses had disappeared. Whether it was the scent or the tiny trace of elements in the air, they had all closed up here.., it was as if Lin Changsheng had disappeared into thin air.
The Aragami’s head had many eyeballs that were extremely ferocious. It blinked its scarlet eyeballs and looked around, but there were still no clues. It could not help but clench its claws and roar in anger. It roared in anger, and its voice spread over tens of Li.
After roaring for a while, the Aragami’s body suddenly trembled. Immediately after, the eyeballs on its head had all closed up, and the gaps between its eyelids had also healed into skin. Only its original two eyes blinked slightly, and its expression seemed a little nervous, it looked down at its left shoulder. The flesh was slightly bulging and it was getting higher and higher. It was like a ball that was constantly rising. Finally, the outline of a head appeared on the top of the ball, the face gradually became clear.
If Lin Changsheng was still here, he would be shocked to find that this face was actually the face of Dean who had died from spontaneous combustion!
After his facial features were clear, Dudian’s expression was a bit shocked. After a moment of dullness, he slightly turned his head and looked at the heavy breathing coming from the side. It was a ferocious monster’s head!
He could even see the sharp teeth in the mouth of the monster’s head. At the same time, he also noticed that his current situation was actually growing on the monster’s shoulder!
“This is... Hell?”Dudian was a bit confused. He wasn’t afraid of the ferocious monster. After all, he had died once. So he looked at the monster, he turned his head and looked at the ‘hell’world. He found that it was no different from what he had seen when he was alive. There was also an unreachable sky and a huge dark land.
There was also a swaying delicate wind.
There was also a strong smell of blood that originated from life.
Dudian was stunned for a moment. His eyes suddenly swept over the outline of a small building in the distance. He felt as if he was struck by lightning. He felt the blood in his body surging. He found that this was not hell but Earth!
In other words, he was still alive!
He turned to look at the monster next to him. The monster’s body was covered with sharp blades like a hedgehog. He coldly looked at the monster.
The monster was also looking at him with excitement: “Wow Wow?”
Dudian frowned as he made a defensive posture. He looked at his lower body. His body was connected to the monster’s shoulder from the waist down. Could it be that the bloody world he had seen.., was inside the monster’s body?
In other words, he had been swallowed by it?
If so, why did he come back from the dead?
Dudian couldn’t figure it out. But he soon found out that the monster didn’t have any killing intent. Moreover, the eyes of the monster were obviously not human eyes. It was not human eyes but he could read them!
It seemed that the monster gave him a very familiar feeling.
0

chapters.title: Chapter 1210
chapters.content:
Chapter 1210: Chapter 1199: Mother Dean
Translator:
549690339
“Wow?”
The Aragami called out again when it saw that Dudian didn’t respond.
Dudian was startled as he carefully looked at the Aragami. He found that its hideous face wasn’t very ugly. Instead, it looked more pleasing to the eye. It seemed that he could read its thoughts and emotions from its expression, at the moment it was expressing excitement, attachment and a feeling of flattery.
“Wow Wow!”The Aragami shouted as it licked Dudian’s arm with its red tongue.
Dudian didn’t feel the malice so he didn’t Dodge. He pondered for a while and suddenly thought of a way to shrink the sharp thorns on the outside of his body. There was a soft light yellow touch extending from it, it contained the dreamer ability of Crimson Moon. Moreover, it was slightly modified. It could read the memory of other creatures and also communicate with their minds.
The tentacle slowly extended to the forehead of the Aragami. The Aragami didn’t Dodge. It seemed that it wasn’t worried that Dudian would hurt it. It squinted its eyes and laughed.
The next moment, a sharp mouthpart appeared in front of Dudian’s touch. It pierced its forehead like a poisonous snake.
The Aragami shook its head but didn’t move away. Its eyes turned crystal clear as if it was about to cry.
Dudian felt a brand new world through the touch. A lot of emotions came to his face. The main emotions were grievance, reluctance, dependence and close feelings.
At this moment, he felt that his blood seemed to be connected to the monster. There was an inexplicable feeling that he could not describe. It was like... Blood was connected! It was as if the monster was his closest relative. When he felt the grievance and sadness, he actually felt a kind of love and wanted to take good care of it.
He felt that his feelings were a bit absurd, but the feeling that was transmitted to his bones was so clear. It was as if his feelings for his father, mother, and sister were ten times stronger than that!
He didn’t dare to be immersed in such feelings. He quickly controlled his emotions and cut off the communication with it. He went directly to the core of its brain to explore its memory!
Soon, Dudian saw a lot of memories flying through his eyes. He saw his body burn, his body was swallowed, chewed, Crimson Moon was killed, and the Devil Emperor fled..
“I... was eaten by it?”Although he had guessed it before, but he was still in disbelief when he saw this scene. At the same time, he was shocked by what happened next.
Crimson Moon was killed by it and directly swallowed!
The magnificent Devil Emperor actually fled without fighting!
Lin Changsheng was like a dog that had lost its home. He was in a sorry state!
This monster was hatched from his heart. From hatching to defeating the three most powerful experts, it took less than twenty minutes!
“Is this... The Real God?”Dudian looked at the Aragami who was crying. He subconsciously raised his hand to touch its head, he found that his hand was already touching its head.
The tears in the Aragami’s eyes quickly stopped after it was touched. Its expression became cheerful as it grinned. Its mouth was full of sharp teeth that could bite through steel plates.
Dudian saw its teeth but he didn’t think it was ugly and hideous. He didn’t know if it was because of the long-term slaughter or because he had been dealing with monsters for too long, or maybe it was because of other reasons.
He looked away from its teeth, he pondered: “It hatched from my heart. My Heart was used by Crimson Moon. The heart is made of Aragami’s elements. Logically it should be an Aragami. However it is impossible for an Aragami to be so strong. The body controlled by Lin Changsheng is also an Aragami. The demon lord is also an Aragami but he was defeated by it.”
“Perhaps, the linked heart not only contains the Aragami factor, but also the essence of the extreme ice demon worm and the blazing flame demon worm. The path of the spirit that Bolo has developed is a mixture of the extreme ice demon worm, blazing flame demon worm, Aragami, and a human with a special structure, allowing many different powers to reach a perfect balance in the human body with this special constitution!”
“Extreme ice will be frozen, the flames will be burned, and the Aragami will self-destruct! Although they are all extremely powerful life forms, but they are too extreme. Only by reaching a balance and alternating cycles can they be immortal!”
“Crimson Moon’s experiment hasn’t been perfectly realized in my body, but the heart naturally formed the most perfect balance. Therefore, the Aragami that was born from it is not an Aragami, but a true God. An immortal creature has a terrifying evolutionary speed. It can quickly evolve at birth, adapt to various environments, and absorb all external materials into its own energy needs...”
Dudian’s body shook as he thought of this. He had an indescribable feeling. He was in awe, excited, and emotional at the same time. There was also a strong expectation!
From the current situation, the god that was born from the connective heart had a very good impression of him. It was very friendly. Could This make it a powerful help to him? !
The more he thought about it, the more excited he became. He suppressed the emotions in his heart and tried to slowly extend the touch to the forehead of the Aragami. This time he was much more nervous than before.
The Aragami instinctively looked back as if it knew that it would be in pain.
Dudian felt funny as he saw the Aragami’s body. He thought about the feeling of grievance he had felt before. He felt an inexplicable pain in his heart, even if the Aragami’s body was cut into tens of thousands of pieces, it might not be able to let out a scream. Was it afraid because it cared? Or was it because of emotional pain?
The most hurtful thing in the world was not a knife, but a knife-like word.
Although it was afraid, the Aragami did not Dodge. Instead, it looked like a wronged child. Its red eyes were full of tears.
Dudian wanted to comfort it. He thought that the Aragami did not understand his words. He slowly penetrated into its forehead like a leech sucking blood. There was no pain, then he felt fear and grievance.
He tried to communicate and comfort it.
The tears in the eyes of the Aragami quickly dried as if it felt its gentle comforting thoughts. It happily opened its mouth. At the same time, a lot of messages came from its mind like countless words.
“Mother?”
“Do you want to eat?”
Dudian was shocked by the thoughts coming from it. Although the spiritual communication wasn’t written but the feelings of each other were clearer than the written description. Did the Aragami treat him as its mother?

chapters.title: Chapter 1211
chapters.content:
Chapter 1211: Chapter 1200: bombing
Translator:
549690339
Was it because it was born from its own heart and absorbed its own genes?
Dudian thought of some beasts and monsters. Most of them didn’t rely on visual judgment to distinguish their children. Most of them relied on smell or sound. Perhaps this Aragami was the same.
However, he didn’t think that such a terrifying ultimate life form wasn’t a cold-blooded creature. Most of the monsters had the habit of devouring their children for food. Some of them would eat the monsters that mated with them. This aragami didn’t need his “Mother”to take care of it. It could even eat him as food. However, it didn’t rely on him.
“From the way it toyed with Lin Changsheng, this thing is naturally intelligent and cunning. It can eat me and become the most powerful existence in the world!”Dudian looked at the Aragami who was grinning, his eyes slightly flickered: “But it let me get close to it. It didn’t resist even when I stabbed it. If I was out of malice and had the strength, I could have killed it!”
“It should know this, but it still treats me like this. Is it because it doesn’t believe that I will harm it?”
“A monster is actually entangled by human emotions and put itself in danger...”
“Wow?”
The Aragami tilted its head and let out a cry. Several terrifying blood vessels separated from its neck and gently touched Dudian’s arm. It was soft and full of attachment.
Dudian woke up from his thoughts. There was a trace of complex emotions in his mind when he saw the move of the Aragami. However, he quickly restrained it. In any case, the situation of the Aragami was a good thing for him, if he could make good use of this power, he could easily flatten the empire and rule the federation!
He quickly had an idea in his mind. He used his telepathic perception to send a few words of comfort. Then he tried to communicate with the Aragami so that it could land on the ground.
The Aragami was very obedient and immediately landed on the ground.
Dudian tried to let it split the giant ball in front of him. The Aragami didn’t say a word as it demonized a huge sharp blade. It cut the giant ball and sent a coquettish feeling to Dudian, it was as if it was looking for praise but at the same time it was talking about hunger. The ferocious expression in Dudian’s eyes became pitiful.
“It is really obedient.”Dudian thought in his heart. He let the Aragami absorb the material from the ground to fill its hunger.
The Aragami felt wronged and a trace of resentment. But it obediently put its arm through the ground. Soon the elevation of the ground decreased. Dudian felt that there was a force flowing into his body, he felt that his blood was boiling and he was full of energy. It was as if a hungry person had suddenly eaten a full meal. He had strength that he couldn’t use!
“The energy it absorbed will also be transferred into my body?”Dudian was surprised, but he was calm on the surface. His eyes quickly flashed.
At this time, a dangerous omen suddenly came.
Dudian couldn’t help but raise his head. His pupils shrank as he looked in the direction of the cold feeling.
The Aragami that was happily absorbing the Earth’s material also looked up. It opened its mouth and opened its mouth. Its expression changed. Its red eyes were filled with anger!
“Nuclear bomb!”Dudian saw dozens of black dots whistling towards him. He recognized them as nuclear missiles. He quickly sent a telepathic message to the Aragami so that it could avoid them.
Aragami shook its head stubbornly. It told Dudian that it wanted to completely destroy these things!
Dudian was a bit anxious. He quickly sent a telepathic message to the Aragami to tell it about the destructive power of these weapons. Because of the telepathic communication, the speed was extremely fast. Moreover, it was able to directly transmit the terrible picture of the nuclear explosion to the Aragami.
The Aragami still stubbornly shook its head.
Dudian was stunned. It took a moment to react. The Aragami was smart and cunning. It wouldn’t be arrogant for no reason. In other words, he didn’t know enough about its power.
He wanted to give it to deal with and see how strong it was. But suddenly he thought that the appearance of these nuclear weapons was a bit strange. Shouldn’t these things be blocked by Crimson Moon and Fire Dragon? How could they appear here? Could it be that the demon king had escaped to take out these nuclear weapons? If that was the case, then the demon king would most likely return to observe the situation after the nuclear weapons exploded..
Dudian’s eyes focused. He saw that the missile had flown to the edge of the desolate main city. He once again sent a message to the Aragami and told it all of his thoughts.
It might take seven or eight sentences to finish these thoughts. However, the communication between the Aragami and the Aragami was only for a moment. The Aragami who was about to make a move was stunned for a moment.
It seemed to find this matter very interesting. It grinned at Dudian and revealed its white teeth. Its body shrank into the soil. At the same time, a rock armor appeared on its shoulder, it Protected Dudian inside so that he wouldn’t be rubbed by the sand.
Dudian was touched by its considerate action. He looked at it.
The Aragami grinned as it sensed Dudian’s eyes. It accelerated the speed of the dive. In the blink of an eye, it had shrunk to thousands of meters underground. The next moment, a loud rumble came from the surface. A terrifying force was coming from the Earth, it was as if a huge mountain was crashing down. The earth was shaking and the earth was being compressed. The terrifying pressure crushed countless grains of sand.
Dudian found that he could feel the changes in the surrounding soil through the Aragami’s body. However, he didn’t feel much pain. The Aragami’s body turned into a hard diamond when the huge pressure came down, the Aragami didn’t move at all despite the pressure of the surrounding soil. In addition it had formed several layers of outer shell which were full of small holes. It spat out black mucus which scattered into the soil like a spider web, the surrounding soil was sticky like the limbs of the Aragami. It could be controlled.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Continuous tremors came. It was like a giant holding a mountain. It kept hitting the ground above its head. Soon there was high temperature coming from the soil above.
“Precision attack? It seems there is an antenna in the federation that can monitor this place.”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he passed the message to the Aragami.
The Aragami slightly grinned as it told Dudian its thoughts.
Dudian was surprised as he sensed its plan. He looked at the Aragami. Why was it thinking the same as him?
After more than ten bombardments, a large amount of high temperature was released from the top of his head. The temperature kept rising. More than ten nuclear bombs were detonated in the same area. The nuclear fusion reaction caused by the superposition was like a landslide or tsunami, layer after layer of skin was peeled off from the ground, revealing the dark soil inside. The burning soil of the nuclear bomb turned red. It looked like the flesh and blood of the Earth was exposed. The melted magma looked like blood splattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1212
chapters.content:
Chapter 1212: Chapter 1201: Chase
Translator:
549690339
“The main engine city should have been destroyed by such a violent explosion...”Dudian felt the violent tremors coming from the top of his head but he wasn’t nervous. Instead he felt a sense of security, this came from the armor that the Aragami had given him. The armor was wrapped around his body and he didn’t suffer any damage. He felt a little stuffy.
At this time, the Aragami stopped diving. It suddenly split a large number of soft tentacles from its body and pierced into the hot rock layer above its head.
Dudian was puzzled. He waited until his body was full of energy before he realized that the Aragami was absorbing the power of the nuclear bomb?
“Is the nuclear bomb ineffective against it?”Dudian was shocked. The adaptability of the Aragami was too fierce. Could it be that only a moment of high temperature of hundreds of millions of degrees could kill it?
A moment later, the vibration of the nuclear bomb gradually stopped. The ground was ploughed out hundreds of meters deep. The rock layer which was thousands of meters above sea level was boiling hot like a red-hot stone pot. Dudian and the Aragami were in the crevice of the rock layer, however, he didn’t feel too much.
“It seems to have stopped.”Dudian listened to the movement from above. He was relieved, “Fortunately there isn’t a nuclear bomb like Big Ivan in the Soviet era. Otherwise this guy’s adaptability might not be able to withstand it. I don’t know if Lin Changsheng didn’t create such an amount of nuclear weapons or if the Devil Emperor didn’t launch it. is he worried about destroying more than half of the Federation?”
Big Ivan’s level nuclear weapon was enough to destroy half of the country. It could even move the continent a little. It was the giant of the nuclear bomb. It was also the main culprit that caused the cataclysm era.
No matter what, Dudian felt that he couldn’t continue to sit and wait for death. He immediately urged the Aragami.
“Wow Wow!”
The Aragami happily responded. Its body suddenly split into a pile of flesh and blood. Its body was torn and charred. It pushed the flesh and blood to the surface of the explosion, then it took Dudian to escape thousands of meters away.
“No matter how good the signal from the federation is, we shouldn’t be able to monitor the situation when the nuclear bomb explodes. We will appear in the federation when the dust from the explosion is gone. We will find Lin Changsheng First!”Dudian’s eyes lit up, the threat of Lin Changsheng was greater to him regardless of whether the nuclear bomb was dropped by the devil or not. Moreover, he would get more benefits after killing him.
It would be difficult to find the devil if he hid in the dark. However, Lin Changsheng was different. The federation was his nest so he wouldn’t be far away.
Whoosh!
The Aragami took him underground at top speed. He transformed into a monster that looked like an armadillo. Its scales covered its body as it moved through the mud like a fish in water.
A few minutes later, they came to the nearest city. There were many refugees there. Dudian saw through the x-ray vision that there were several underground shelters. They were full of people. There were still some wandering citizens on the surface, they hid under the bed and table like trembling mice.
Dudian sent the message to the Aragami. They passed through the mud and metal walls and quietly appeared in a shelter.
Dudian deliberately made the Aragami change its appearance into a human when they entered the shelter. The Aragami was very obedient. It transformed into a small girl about 1.4 meters tall. Her hair was black and smooth. She had bright eyes and white teeth. She had a beautiful face, at the same time, Dudian reminded her to use her flesh to demonize a long skirt. If someone touched the skirt they would find that it was made of flesh.
Dudian moved to the edge of her neck. He shrank to the size of a thumb and was covered by her long hair.
During this process, Dudian knew that their relationship was like a symbiotic life. If necessary, he could even completely shrink his body into her body.
“Dad, I Want Dad...”
“Woo Woo...”
The sound of a child crying was heard.
Dudian looked over and saw an officer who was dressed like a guard strode over. He fiercely said: “Don’t make a sound. If you continue to cry then I will throw you out!”
The mother of the child was like an angry lion. She held the child in one hand, she roared at the officer: “Why Are You So Fierce? Why did you let us out? We spent money to buy tickets. I spent so much money. Did the child’s Crying Offend You? !”
The officer’s face was gloomy and cold, he said, “The situation outside is very complicated now. There are many more people who want to come in than you can imagine. If you don’t want to stay here, I will send you out now. If you want to continue staying here, you have to be quiet. If you attract those damn demons here, even if you have nine lives, it won’t be enough for you to die!”
Hearing this, the woman’s arrogance immediately weakened. The people around also gave her a reproachful look. The woman felt the eyes of the people around her. It was as if her self-esteem had been pricked, she whispered in an indignant tone: “It’s useless to let these devils fight here. You have nothing to do. What’s the use of using our taxpayers’money to feed a group of good-for-nothings?”
The officer’s face turned cold. He wanted to flare up but he endured it.
Dudian’s heart moved as he saw the officer’s expression. It seemed that they didn’t know the specific situation outside? He retracted his eyes and sent a message to the Aragami.
The Aragami understood his meaning. It cleared its throat and smiled at a nervous youth: “Little Brother, what is the situation outside?”Her voice was sweet and melodious.
The Nervous Youth was stunned for a moment. He turned his head and saw the appearance of the Aragami. His pupils dilated as if he was shocked. He was stunned for a moment before he reacted. His face turned red, his body couldn’t help but sit up straight, he put on a friendly expression: “I don’t know. I heard that the President of the Federation sent people to seize the nuclear weapons. The explosion outside should be the sound of a missile. It should be very close to us. There should be no signal in the city so we can’t connect to the Internet. But those monsters should be in the neighboring cities.”
There was a trace of worry on Dudian’s face.
Dudian was surprised to hear that the federation sent people to seize the nuclear weapons? Could it be that the one who launched the nuclear weapons was not the Devil Emperor but Lin Changsheng? If that was the case then there was too much information contained in it. Lin Changsheng had hidden it deep enough!
“If there was no Aragami then Crimson Moon and the devil emperor would be completely annihilated...”Dudian thought about Lin Changsheng’s layout and secretly praised in his heart, at the same time he whispered into the ears of the Aragami: “If the one who launched the missile was Lin Changsheng, I think I know where he is now. Let’s go and find him!”
The Aragami who had turned into a human had also learned human language. There was no need for telepathic communication.
“Yes!”The Aragami nodded.
“Ah?”The youth looked at the Aragami in doubt. He saw the beautiful girl who was like a painting. She suddenly shrank and disappeared into the ground. The shelter was made of metal plates, it was still intact. Everything was like an illusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1213
chapters.content:
Chapter 1213: Chapter 1202: “Myth”
Translator:
549690339
Snow Mountain City.
Located in an unremarkable location on the western edge of the federation, there were more than a dozen cities in the federation that were located in such a remote and unremarkable location. Their economies were generally backward and their buildings were low, placing them at the bottom of the federation’s ranks, the citizens born in these cities were also jokingly called “Wasteland People”by people in other first-tier cities.
Snow Mountain City was famous in the federation for its famous scenery of snow mountains. Every summer, it would attract a large number of tourists to visit the snow mountains in snow mountain city that never melted all year round, bringing an objective income to snow mountain city.
At this moment, it was summer, but the snow mountains were desolate and uninhabited. The invasion of the demons had led to the collapse of the federation government, internal strife within the military, and other matters had affected the hearts of every federation citizen, with the exception of a small number of people who hid in shelters, the majority of the people were obediently hiding in their own homes, shivering. They were constantly paying attention to the news announcement of the federal government’s methods, hoping to see a piece of good news.
Whoosh!
A nearly transparent figure whizzed over from the horizon, stirring up a weak gust of wind. Like a snowfall, it landed on the Snowy Mountains. It was as light as a feather, and the blurry light around its body gradually disappeared, revealing Lin Changsheng’s face.
He glanced around and suddenly saw a few youths sneaking around at the starting point of the cable car. Taking a closer look, they were actually preparing to pry open the cable car and steal it for sale.
It was just a false alarm. He heaved a sigh of relief. With a cold snort, he raised his hand and waved it. The snow on the ground rolled up and turned into several steel needles that shot out, instantly piercing through the few youths who were busy being excited.
Before they could even scream, their bodies trembled and they fell to the ground.
Lin Changsheng couldn’t even be bothered to take a look. After conveniently taking care of a few things that were an eyesore, he shook his body and transformed into a small snow-white beast with short limbs. He plunged into the snow and quickly climbed.., very quickly, he sneaked into the bottom of the great snow mountain.
The great snow mountain stretched for three hundred Li, and the highest main peak was about three thousand meters. At this moment, Lin Changsheng had sneaked all the way from the top of the main peak to the bottom, and he had continued to climb down for about five hundred meters before stopping.., at this moment, a metal wall appeared in front of him, blocking him. Its structure was similar to the material of the main engine city’s underground base, and they were all forged from the materials of the magic bug spaceships.
His figure gradually faded, fusing into the metal. After passing through the orange-yellow world, he came to the interior of the metal wall. This was a huge warehouse, displaying a large number of missiles and Mech Warriors, every Mech Warrior was made from the federation’s top technology. They could instantly kill the Abyss and fight against a King!
Unfortunately, although the destructive power of these mech warriors was terrifying, the energy they needed was even more terrifying. Although Lin Changsheng had pushed for the development of energy technology, the energy had already been upgraded many times, however, it was still unable to satisfy the needs of these Mech Warriors. They could only be activated for a short period of time and could not fight as long as a king. Therefore, they were sealed here. Only the huge amount of energy in this base.., could allow them to wantonly fight and Squander!
Lin Changsheng quickly walked in front of a huge instrument that was like a giant tree and asked, “How’s the situation? Did you kill it?”
The huge instrument projected a shadow of Lin Changsheng. His expression was slightly cold and rigid as he said, “The situation in the explosion area is still being scanned. The signal has been interfered too badly. There will only be results in 1 minute and 32 seconds.”
Lin Changsheng slightly frowned, but he also knew that there was no use in panicking, he muttered to himself, “The explosion should be able to attract the attention of the Effiny Hughes. If this guy goes back to investigate, don’t let him get a bargain. No, we still need to prepare a second wave of missiles!”
The shadow said expressionlessly, “What about the mechanical heart? Is it damaged?”
Lin Changsheng shook his head, “It’s in my body, so I won’t take it out for the time being. If the Effiny Hughes appears, I’ll need to borrow the power of the mechanical heart to get rid of him and eliminate any future trouble! “Now that the blood moon is approaching, I have to settle everything before the Blood Moon arrives. Otherwise, I might not be able to escape this time...”
“According to my analysis, the probability of the effiny Hughes returning to investigate is 17.5% . The probability of hiding in the distance and following you to find this place is 31.9% , and the probability of directly leaving is 50.6% !”The Shadow said indifferently.
Follow Me? Lin Changsheng was startled, and his heart suddenly broke out in cold sweat. He felt that his back was somewhat cold. He had not expected this, but it had been neglected. He immediately released his perception, spreading out of the base and into the snowy mountains outside, only after he did not see any suspicious traces did he heave a sigh of relief. It was only one-third of the probability. It seemed that the effiny Hughes had not chosen to follow him, or perhaps he had seen the strength he had displayed.., knowing that it would be difficult to defeat him even if he caught up, he had left immediately.
“It seems that he is not as brave as his father after all. He is not like his father who, in order to become a god, went alone to the depths of the Pacific Ocean and chased after that white abyss among the billions of sea beasts...”Lin Changsheng shook his head, he felt sorry for Epsilon Hughes. This might be his last chance. Once he got rid of this Aragami and obtained its genes, he would become the most powerful life form in the world, the one and only God!
At that time, even if the blood moon came, what was there to be afraid of?
“The situation has already been scanned. I will send it to you on the screen,”the Phantom suddenly said.
Lin Changsheng nodded.
On the big screen, a scene of smoke and dust covering the sky appeared. From the gradually dissipating dust, one could see that the ground was charred black, like erupting volcanic magma. A huge and shocking gully separated the ground, from time to time, snowflakes would appear on the screen, but the scene analyzed was not very clear. Soon, Lin Changsheng saw the scene at the core of the explosion.
“That is?”Suddenly, Lin Changsheng noticed an extremely inconspicuous black dot. Upon closer inspection, he discovered that it was a charred corpse.
Corpse? A thought appeared in Lin Changsheng’s mind, but he quickly felt that something was wrong. After thinking for a moment, he could not help but sneer. This beast still wanted to play a trick on him. Using the same trick twice was too stupid!
However, he was already certain that this Aragami was not dead. Instead, it was hiding in the dark, preparing to give him a fatal blow!
Unfortunately, he did not plan to personally fight with this monster. If he could solve the problem with a nuclear bomb, why did he have to do it himself?
“Send out the message. Prepare for a second bombing. This time, use a mountain-splitting bomb. Continue bombing until it penetrates that place!”Lin Changsheng instructed.
The phantom coldly said, “According to the analysis just now, if this Aragami is not dead, there is a 93.4% chance that it has sneaked underground to hide before the missile bombing. If it continues bombing, it will sense that I have seen through its intentions and turn around to leave. This way, it will be impossible to find it.”
Lin changsheng coldly said, “I know. Continuing bombing is just to tell it that my attention is there. If it leaves, the first place it will go will be the nearby cities. Immediately activate the entire network surveillance and check every suspicious existence. Once it has locked onto a target, prepare to activate a hundred million tons of ‘myth’. Even if it is completely wiped out, it does not matter. From the bait’s corpse, it is enough to obtain its genes.”
Through the surveillance set up within the federation, as long as the Aragami sneaked in, he was confident that he would definitely be able to find out its disguised identity. Although the Aragami was cunning, his computer had never made any mistakes in its calculations. As long as he locked onto the target.., it would be 100% true!
“To activate the entire network surveillance, you need to insert the machinery hivemind,”said the Phantom.

chapters.title: Chapter 1214
chapters.content:
Chapter 1214: Chapter 1203: death by talking too much
Translator:
549690339
“I’ll give it to you.”
Lin Changsheng reached his hand into his chest. A moment later, he took out a magic cube-like magical metal. The color of the metal was like silver, but also somewhat transparent. It also seemed to have a fluorescent blue color, as if it was constantly changing colors.
It was this fist-sized thing that was the core engine of the Federation mainframe. It could drive the federation mainframe billions of calculations per second!
“Prepare to embed!”A light flashed in the Phantom’s eyes as it said indifferently.
Two metal rolls extended from the giant tree-like machine at the back. They absorbed the mechanical heart and sent it into a slot in the center of the machine to be loaded. A moment later, the Phantom seemed to receive a message from the mainframe, it said to Lin Changsheng, “The entire network surveillance has been activated. We are currently searching for suspicious unfamiliar faces. Results will be available in 48 seconds.”
Lin Changsheng nodded.
If this monster appeared in the federation, it would either appear in the form of a monster, or it would demonize into a human. If it was a human, he could search for unregistered black households on the household register and choose from within, if the monster ate a person and transformed into its appearance, then the second step would be to search for abnormalities in its behavior. With the mainframe’s computing ability, the result would be quickly obtained.
A moment later, the phantom said, “There are no suspects in the black household investigation, and there are no suspects in the investigation of unfamiliar faces. The probability of this monster infiltrating the federation has been reduced to less than 40% . Begin analyzing the behavior of the entire population, and search for suspicious objects!”
Lin Changsheng asked, “How long will it take?”
“About five minutes,”the Phantom said.
Lin Changsheng heaved a sigh of relief. Five minutes could still wait. After all, this step required too much data. To be able to complete it in just five minutes was already an inconceivable matter.
While waiting, Lin Changsheng thought of the charred corpse that was still at the site of the nuclear explosion and ordered, “Immediately send a team of robot soldiers to bring that corpse to the Fourth Research Institute.”
“They’ve already been dispatched,”the Phantom said.
Lin Changsheng nodded slightly. The Phantom was also him. With the mainframe’s assistance in calculations, it was more comprehensive than he thought.
“Beep Beep!”
Suddenly, the base lit up with a red light, and at the same time, an alarm sounded.
Lin Changsheng and the shadow were shocked at the same time. Lin changsheng quickly asked, “What triggered the alarm?”
“Something touched the defense circle and is quickly coming over here!”The Shadow’s expression changed. He was no longer expressionless and indifferent as before. He quickly moved the surveillance screen to appear on the big screen, the image of the place where the nuclear bomb exploded was replaced. In the image, a elongated shadow was rapidly swimming over from the snow mountains and mud. It was like a shark in the ocean, full of killing intent and extremely fast.
“Is it a monster? Impossible! Where’s the ability value detection? !”Lin Changsheng hurriedly shouted.
Soon, an energy fluctuation appeared on the side of the screen. At this moment, the energy value was blood-red, which meant that the energy value had exceeded the upper limit of the detection device!
“It’s it! It’s that monster!”Lin Changsheng was in disbelief, his face was extremely ugly. “How did it know this place? It’s impossible that I didn’t shake it off. If it knew my whereabouts, it would have chased me long ago. Why did it only come now?”
“It wants to wipe us out in one fell swoop!”The Shadow’s face was extremely gloomy. He spoke quickly, “It’s withdrawing from the mechanical heart. Hide in your body immediately. Without the mechanical heart, you can’t fight it!”
Lin Changsheng woke up and hurriedly rushed towards the giant tree-like machine. At this moment, the base suddenly shook. In the next moment, a terrifying qi spread out from Lin Changsheng’s back and filled the entire base.
This Qi was filled with a strange malevolence, malevolence, and ruthlessness, as if it had covered the entire base in a layer of blood.
“You’re really here.”A familiar voice came from behind.
Lin Changsheng was stunned. He turned around and saw a girl who was less than 1.5 meters tall standing in the distance. She was smiling at him but there was a trace of evil in her beautiful eyes, there was a fist-sized figure on her shoulder. It was Dudian!
“You are not dead? !”Lin Changsheng was shocked, “So this thing is you. I was wondering how it could be so cunning. It turns out that you are hiding in the dark. You... you can actually control this monster. Doesn’t it have self-awareness? !”
Dudian knew that he had misunderstood but was too lazy to explain. He noticed the posture of Lin Changsheng’s figure. Lin Changsheng had noticed it when they came in but didn’t run away. Instead he rushed towards the giant tree-like machine, his behavior was suspicious.
Dudian sneered as he thought about the mechanical heart and the federal mainframe that were hidden in the base, he said: “It’s a bit greedy to think about treasures when you are about to die. I didn’t expect you to live for more than 200 years. You are smart but you can’t escape from the greed of human nature. In the end you are just an ordinary person.”
Lin Changsheng woke up but didn’t dare to rush towards the machine. He saw that the slot of the mainframe had been opened. The mechanical heart was suspended in it. It seemed that there was a special force field that made it soar into the air, his throat rolled. This was the only capital he had to fight against dudian. However he knew that Dudian was smart and cunning. As long as he moved he would be able to see through his intentions.
Moreover from Dudian’s words he found that Dudian didn’t know the use of the machine’s heart. He was relieved.
“People die for money. Birds die for food. Aren’t you greedy?”Lin Changsheng followed Dudian’s words. At the same time his body naturally moved a few steps away from Dudian.
Dudian smiled: “How do you want to Die?”
Lin Changsheng laughed, “Die? Do you think you can kill me? More than two hundred years ago when I was nothing, I survived from the hands of the sage. Now I am one step away from becoming a god. No one can stop me!”
“I will know whether I can kill you or not. For the sake of your brain, I will leave you a complete corpse.”Dudian smiled.
Lin Changsheng’s smile suddenly disappeared as he sneered: “Don’t you know that villains always die because they talk too much? If you had attacked in the beginning, there would have been a chance. But now...”
He was now slowly approaching the giant tree. With his full speed, it would only take a moment for him to catch the mechanical heart!
“It’s true that he died because of talking too much...”Dudian shook his head and smiled.
Lin Changsheng was too lazy to waste time with Dudian. He had achieved his goal of delaying. His body burst out and rushed towards the giant tree!
Bang!
The main engine suddenly exploded!
A blood-colored touch stretched out from the ground. The moment of the explosion, the mechanical heart contracted!

chapters.title: Chapter 1215
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1215: Chapter 1204: The End
Translator: 549690339
“What!”
Lin Changsheng’s pupils shrank and his heart turned cold.
The next moment he roared as he rushed forward. However he saw a huge hole in the bottom of the metal. At the same time the ground behind him cracked open and seven or eight blood red tentacles rose up. They looked like poisonous vines that were waving in the air.
“Is this the mechanical heart?”Dudian’s upper body extended from the shoulder of the girl. He looked like the Genie of the Aladdin lamp. The lower part of his waist was elongated and he was holding a colorful Crystal Rubik’s Cube in his hand, the Devil Emperor and Crimson Moon were searching for this thing. He knew that this was the crystallization of the intelligence of the magic bug. It contained extremely high-end magic bug technology. The entire federation’s network system was driven by this small piece of mechanical heart.
If this thing was embedded into the spacecraft, it could allow the spacecraft to travel between the stars and space jump.
There were very few top technology products on the planet where the magic bug was located. This piece was one of the most outstanding pieces because it was the mechanical heart that was specially equipped by the Great Sage of Magic Bug!
“Give it back to me!”Although he knew that such words were meaningless, Lin Changsheng couldn’t help but roar out in anger.
Dudian ignored him as he flipped the mechanical heart in his hand. He gently twisted one of the planes: “Is this the reboot?”
“You! !”Lin Changsheng was so angry that his body was trembling. Both of his fists were clenched and his fingernails were deeply dented into his flesh.
Dudian looked at the shadow of Lin Changsheng. He knew that the part of Lin Changsheng’s memory that he had plundered didn’t lie to him, the restart of the machine heart needed to restore the 108 star maps that had been messed up. His method seemed simple but in fact, he had combined part of Lin Changsheng’s memory. He had found a shortcut to quickly restart the machine heart.
When the Machine Heart was rebooted all the systems of the Federation would be rebooted as if they were returning to the factory settings. The ‘Virus Lin Changsheng’would naturally be completely wiped out!
What was alive now was the memory of Lin Changsheng injected into the body of the Aragami. To be precise, Lin Changsheng was already dead. The Aragami was just living in the way of Lin Changsheng.
“You shouldn’t have said so much...”Dudian shook his head and smiled, “If we came in you would have taken this thing and used the mechanical warriors to stop us. It would have bought you some time. Unfortunately you are trying to play tricks with me so that I have time to decompose the metal structure of the base and assimilate it. Your Brain is Rusty. How can you be so stupid?”
“You!”Lin Changsheng’s eyes were bloodshot. He was so angry that his body was trembling. Although Dudian’s words were extremely sarcastic but he knew in his heart that what the other party said was true! If he directly rushed over from the beginning then he might have a chance to get the mechanical heart!
If he had the help of the mainframe, he could instantly think of thousands of possibilities and choose the best method through probability!
However, without the help of the mainframe, he felt that his thinking was extremely slow. He could only rely on his own feeling to think of the best method and not the real best method in the final probability.
“What else do you want to say? Forget it, I’ll See for myself!”Dudian said, dudian telepathically sent a telepathic message to the Aragami Girl. The girl understood and smiled. There was a very human-like playfulness in her eyes. She raised her hand and a large amount of blood shot out from the ground and filled the entire base, they shot towards Lin Changsheng!
“I can’t accept this, I can’t accept this! !”
Lin Changsheng let out an angry roar, his hair flying in the wind. It expanded by several meters, and shot out like countless steel needles. He pushed his hands forward, and his fingers demonized into yellow flying snakes, wrapping around and biting at the incoming blood-colored tentacles.
The Aragami Maiden watched with a smile, but she did not seem to move. The blood-colored tentacles that were fighting with the flying snakes suddenly shot out silver threads and black fog, surrounding Lin Changsheng and enveloping him in darkness.
“If there is a hell, I will wait for You in Hell!”
Lin Changsheng’s roar came out of the Black Fog. He was like a screaming beast.
Dudian faintly smiled, “With your wisdom, you shouldn’t believe in Hell and Heaven.”
“Break!”
Lin Changsheng’s body was wrapped by silver threads. The black gas on the silver threads gradually eroded his cells. It wanted to invade his body and rob his body. He mustered all the strength in his body and pushed, however, he found that the silver silk was still stuck to his body.
Despair, grief, anger, regret, and malevolence.
Lin Changsheng’s heart was already in despair. He was proud of his superior wisdom and rationality. However, at this moment, he sadly found that he could only be one step ahead of ordinary people. He was more aware of his current situation, he had given up on struggling earlier. Without the power of the mechanical heart, the strength of his demonized limbs couldn’t be compared to Dudian’s.
Up to this moment, he still thought that the monster was Dudian’s body.
From the silver threads that wrapped around him, he felt the fear of cannibalism. It seemed that the monster was the natural enemy of his body.
He suddenly thought of why the demon lord had decided to escape. He must have sensed the terror of this Aragami monster long ago. After all, the latter was a pure-bred Aragami!
“How did you know that I would be here? Did you plunder that part of my memory? Impossible, that part of my memory does not contain this. This is something I have just built!”Lin Changsheng did not resist the corrosion outside his body, he shouted to the outside of the black fog. He knew that he was going to die. He wanted to die to understand.
Dudian let the girl disperse the black fog. He smiled, “I can only blame you for being too careless. If you went to other bases in my memory, I might not be able to find you. But I guess you wouldn’t choose to go to those bases. You would choose to build a new base. After all, I know the location of the other bases. Although I can temporarily hide, but if I can’t find you anywhere, I will definitely go to those places to search. So it is necessary to build a new base.”
“And where is the most suitable location for the construction of a new base? “From here, we need to carefully consider. Since you have been forced to construct a new base to take refuge, it means that the situation is already the worst. Then, the location of this new base isn’t suitable for the main cities where the four great clans are located, nor is it suitable for those bustling and bustling places. This is because if even you need to take refuge, the federation will definitely have fallen into the hands of others, and it will be easy to be exposed in those bustling places.”
“Therefore, you can only choose a deserted place. Unfortunately, you have built too many bases. In that memory, you have considered many cities. Only this snow mountain city and the other seven remote cities have not been considered by you. Therefore, based on that memory, you can directly select the cities that have been considered in that memory. You will choose one of these eight cities as a new base.”
“As for this Snow Mountain City, it is located in a remote area and the great snow mountain is suitable for storing nuclear weapons. The reason why this city was discovered was mainly due to the invasion of the demons. Out of the eight cities, only this city did not send mechanical soldiers to fight or surrender. Instead, it relied on the weak city defense army and a batch of hot-blooded mecha operators to fight.”
“You are avoiding suspicion, so there are no mechanical soldiers stationed in this city!”
Lin Changsheng’s face turned ugly as he clenched his teeth: “But there are no mechanical soldiers stationed in other cities. Why did you think of this place? !”
“Of course it’s the terrain.”Dudian smiled: “Snow Mountain City and main engine city are the furthest cities on the map!”
Lin Changsheng’s heart was in pain. He understood how big his mistake was. Although Dudian’s two points sounded simple, but the combination of the two points was enough to arouse suspicion.
Your enemy will firmly help you remember the places that you have neglected!
“Now, you should be unable to spontaneously combust!”Dudian looked at Lin Changsheng’s body which had been penetrated by the black gas. The silver silk pierced into his body like needles, the Aragami girl would swallow him!
“Hehe...”Lin Changsheng smiled. He wanted to say something but Dudian didn’t give him the chance. He sent a message to the Aragami Girl. The next moment, Lin Changsheng only had time to let out a muffled groan, his body was quickly surrounded by darkness. The Darkness seemed to surge out of his body and enveloped him.
“It’s not the villain who dies because of talking too much. It’s the dead who are called villains. The surviving ones are the main characters!”Dudian muttered to himself. He looked at Lin Changsheng who was completely engulfed. He shook his head slightly, he asked the Aragami: “Did I keep his memory?”
“Yes.”The Aragami replied obediently.
Dudian nodded slightly. He glanced at the ruins of the base and said: “Go out.”
The girl took his body and left the underground base. They stood on the top of the snow mountain. The cold wind was biting and the world was Snow White.
“No matter how outstanding he was when he was alive, he was as miserable as a dog when he died. Maybe later generations will beautify this story. They will tell how tragic and brave he was when he died...” Dudian couldn’t help but sigh in his heart, “But with me around, he can only become a clown in the history of the Federation. It’s time to change the history of the Federation.”
