chapters.title: Chapter 1216
chapters.content:
Chapter 1216: Chapter 1205: God and God
Translator:
549690339
In the northern part of the federation, in the wilderness.
A crimson forest stretched for hundreds of miles. The trees in the forest were all fiery red, as if they were burning. Most of the monsters living in the forest had blood-red fur or scales on their bodies, the venom of the fangs contained fire poison.
This crimson forest was slightly famous in the federation. It could be considered as one of the many forbidden areas. The monsters living in it were generally around level 7. It was said that there were also top-tier tier 11 monsters living in the center, they were comparable to kings among humans!
At this moment, on a giant tree in the middle of the forest, the heart of the tree had been hollowed out, and there was a tree hole inside. Inside the tree hole, there were actually wooden beds, mirrors, bedding, and other items. Other than these living items.., there were also some strange metal machinery.
In front of one of the instruments that looked like a telescope, a tall and slender youth with a fair complexion sat there, adjusting the instrument in his hand. He was unscrewing one of the nuts when suddenly, his movements paused.., as if he had sensed something, he raised his head and looked out of the window of the tree hole. Outside was the fiery red shadow of the forest that extended into the distance, and at the end of the distance was the federation!
“Has something happened?”The young man frowned, and his gaze was somewhat solemn. He immediately stopped adjusting the instrument in his hand, turned around, and took out a metal box from under the bed. It looked like a pencil box, but its hardness was higher than diamond, he verified the fingerprint and unlocked the box. Inside was a strip of metal, and in the middle was a shrunken bar-shaped screen with a red asterisk pattern on it.
His pupils constricted slightly. Although he felt it in his heart, he still found it hard to believe that it had really happened.
He took out the metal bar and inserted it into a machine at the side. Soon, a large amount of data appeared in it. He entered a bar code, and the chaotic data quickly combined into a few screens and a large amount of information.
He slowly browsed.
After a long time.
He slowly closed his eyes after he finished reading all the information. He finally knew what had happened in the distant federation.
“God was born...”he closed his eyes and muttered to himself. After a moment he slowly opened his eyes, “Since God was born, it proves that the research of the great sage insect is right. As long as I have time to follow this direction, I will eventually become a God!”
“No matter what, as long as I live, there will always be a chance...”
“Dudian, I remember you. I don’t know what will happen in the future when the two gods fight? Hehe...”
His eyes looked at the direction of the Federation. There was a bit of expectation in his cold eyes.
..
Dudian held the mechanical heart in his hand as he killed Lin Changsheng. He felt that the entire federation had fallen into his hands. He was very excited as he had the federation as his supply station, moreover, he could command the Aragami girl to fight for him. It was only a matter of time before he could seize the empire’s ruling power! After he took over the empire, he could immediately order everyone to search for Aisha in the empire’s territory.
“Soon, I will see you soon...”Aisha’s face appeared in Dudian’s mind. There was a sweet smile on her face in the past. There was also a cold expression on her face after she turned into a zombie. It was so moving.
Dudian put away his thoughts and said to the girl: “Give me his memory.”
“Yes, Mom.”The girl nodded obediently. She raised her fair and slender palm which suddenly split open like a flower petal, the bloody scene was in stark contrast to her pure and beautiful face.
Dudian had long been used to the title of the Aragami Girl. He had sensed it from the spiritual communication so he didn’t pay too much attention to it. According to human aesthetic standards, even if he had given birth to her, he should be the father, however, in her world view, gender didn’t mean anything. If she wanted to give birth to children, she could have parthenogenesis or she could change her gender at will.
God was omnipotent and naturally included “Sex change”.
Looking at the brain matter of the forest, Dudian used crimson moon’s “Dreamer”ability to read its memory.
Through the previous spiritual communication, Dudian already knew all kinds of things that happened after he self-ignited. He also knew why he was in a symbiotic relationship with the Aragami Girl. The Aragami girl swallowed his body when he was born, the purpose was not to eat him but to break his body into countless cells. He would use the special structure in the Aragami Girl’s body to store them separately so as to prevent his genes from self-ignition.
As for the countless memories of Crimson Moon and Boro that he had seen earlier, they came from the information left behind by the Aragami girl after she had swallowed Crimson Moon. Unlike his situation, Crimson Moon had been completely swallowed and digested by her, all the shattered round memories were the manifestation of being devoured.
While reading through these memories, he had also passively learned all of Crimson Moon’s abilities. Other than the ability that she was best at, the ‘Dreamer’ability and Bolo’s ‘dark domain’ability.., there were also the abilities of many other legendary monsters that Crimson Moon had learned later on. In the imperial capital of the Empire, there were not only eight legendary monsters like what was recorded in the giant wall of Sylvia’s Atlas. Instead, there were 1,362 legendary monsters!
This number included all the legendary monsters that were active in the giant wall region. Many of them were extinct and were suspected to have died long ago or evolved into other monsters. These were known as ancient monsters. And now, the number of legendary monsters that were still discovered by wilderness adventurers was less than half of the number recorded in the Atlas. Even so, there were still five to six hundred of them!
The growth rate of each legendary monster was at least ruler-level, and those that were slightly lower could evolve to the abyss-level. As for the outstanding ones among them, it was not uncommon for them to evolve to rival kings, there were even some monsters that had evolved beyond legendary monsters and were classified as “Super Monsters”by the Empire. Each of these super monsters had the power to shake the giant wall!
During the years when the Empire was established, there was no lack of giant walls being destroyed by monsters. Every monster that could destroy the giant wall was classified as a forbidden level super monster!
However, super monsters were not the most terrifying monsters in the Empire’s exploration list..
Among the many legendary monsters, Crimson Moon had taken advantage of her privilege to learn the abilities of hundreds of legendary monsters after she submitted to the Demon Emperor. However, the more abilities there were, the better it was. After all, in a real battle.., the decisive blow was usually the final blow!
However, the abilities of these legendary monsters had their own strengths. They could use their strengths to merge with each other to create higher level abilities. This was the purpose of Crimson Moon’s hard work!
At the moment, the abilities of these legendary monsters were all in Dudian’s mind. He used the dreamer that Crimson Moon was good at to enter into Lin Changsheng’s memory. This memory was the main goal of the Devil Emperor and Crimson Moon, lin Changsheng was knowledgeable and knowledgeable. His scientific exploration and understanding could help him conceive more powerful abilities!
The strength of a God mainly depended on the strength of his ability.
Therefore, a god needed to be “Omniscient”.
Although Lin Changsheng had the wisdom of a god but his body couldn’t keep up with it. His ability was too profound. Although he knew how to structure it but his strength couldn’t match his heart. It was like a person who had never practiced splits. The body of the Aragami girl was extremely flexible. She could complete any difficult movement. As long as there was a posture to teach her, she would be able to learn it.
The body structure of the demon lord and Crimson Moon was very close to the body of the Aragami Girl. They were at the demigod level just like Dudian’s original body. If Lin Changsheng’s knowledge was added to the mix.., they could barely display the combat power of a god. It was enough to kill all the Kings!
As for the true God.
In the eyes of the sage insect, Lin Changsheng, the demon lord and the others, it was the existence that they yearned for. It had never existed before. It was the ultimate form of life that could be theoretically achieved!
Even if the scientific theory of mankind could cross the Solar System, explore the universe and colonize the planets, but after n years of the theory, mankind had just stepped out of their home and stepped onto the Moon. As for colonizing the Solar System.., it would be even more unattainable. It would be countless years later.
Therefore, a true God was an illusory existence. Under this, with the Demon Emperor and Crimson Moon’s artificial divine bodies coupled with Lin Changsheng’s erudite knowledge, they could unleash battle prowess that far surpassed kings, it could already be defined as a “God”!

chapters.title: Chapter 1217
chapters.content:
Chapter 1217: Chapter 1206: Blood Moon
Translator:
549690339
Dudian sorted out the memories of Lin Changsheng. The information in his mind was huge. It was hundreds of times more abundant than the memories of ordinary people. Even the memory of Crimson Moon which he had seen in the body of the Aragami girl.., it was far less than one percent of Lin Changsheng’s memory! It should be known that the memory of Crimson Moon had a lot of useless hypnotic memories woven by Bolo. However, it was nothing compared to Lin Changsheng.
Although Lin Changsheng had lived for more than two hundred years, and in terms of age alone, his memory was only twice that of an ordinary person. However, these two hundred plus years of living in the virtual world, Lin Changsheng’s life had been too rich and colorful, through the virtual world, he could read anything and everything in the federation. He could see all the major news, or the privacy of certain powerful figures, or some dirty underworld deals.
For ordinary people, most of the days in life were monotonous and repetitive. They would get up and eat. Then they would finish their daily work and rest after work. It was like a clockwork robot. It was extremely boring.
But for Lin Changsheng, every day was different. He could see interesting things every moment. When he encountered problems, he could think of thousands of ideas in a second with the help of the AI, although the useless ideas were abandoned and forgotten by him, but Dudian had dug them out when he read his brain’s memory. Moreover, they were scattered and needed to be sorted out slowly.
In the blink of an eye, five days passed.
Dudian finally accepted Lin Changsheng’s memory completely. He knew what kind of person he was from a comprehensive point of view. There was even a moment when he thought of himself as Lin Changsheng.
But in order to prevent Lin Changsheng from using Boro’s move, he was prepared in advance. He quickly woke up. He felt that Lin Changsheng’s experience was like a passing cloud, his feelings were no longer so profound.
“The Blood Moon is coming and the magic insects are reappearing...”Dudian squinted his eyes as he looked up at the sky.
It was noon and Snow was falling from the sky. There was gray nuclear dust stuck to the snowflakes. Although the main engine city was far away from this place but the impact of the nuclear explosion had spread over, it had affected the environment of most of the federation. The snow had covered the federation for several days. The nuclear radiation in the snowflakes had a great impact on the newborns and pregnant women. The Federation had given birth to millions of children in the past year and most of them were deformed children.
Although it was daytime but Dudian’s long-distance vision could still see the Gray Silver Moon in the sky. Who would have thought that the moon that had illuminated the earth for countless years was the source of the nightmares of Earth’s life?
Lin Changsheng had been preparing for the Blood Moon for more than ten years. This was the disaster that Lin Changsheng was most afraid of. Every time the Moon turned crimson, the murderer who had almost wiped out the human race would come to Earth again, and the place they would descend upon was the federation!
If Lin Changsheng was the guinea pig of the demon bugs, then the entire federation was the incubator of the demon bugs!
The millions of citizens of the Federation were not Lin Changsheng’s private property, but the private property of the demon bugs!
The demon bugs were the true rulers of the Federation!
And Lin Changsheng was merely a substitute for the demon bugs who had sneaked out of earth to occupy the magpie’s nest. If the demon bugs were to know that he was still alive, they would definitely restart the machinery heart and kill him!
And the one that replaced the magic bug in managing the federation was actually the artificial intelligence!
However, the artificial intelligence constructed by the magic bug had long been destroyed by Lin Changsheng’s invasion. The artificial intelligence was now completely a substitute that Lin Changsheng had created. It was worth mentioning that this artificial intelligence had appeared in the first two blood moons.., when the magic bug descended, it had actually deceived the magic bug sage who had come to test it.
It was the third time that the Blood Moon had descended. Lin Changsheng felt that it would be difficult for him to fool the Sage of magic insects. He had been planning for more than ten years to seize the bodies of the Devil Emperor or the two Dragon Masters of the Fire Dragon Kingdom, he would become a god in one step!
Even if the sage of magic insects led the army, it would be difficult to harm him. He would become his prisoner.
“The Devil Emperor and the Fire Dragon Lord came to attack the federation. It was him who secretly helped them!”Dudian read Lin Changsheng’s memory. He couldn’t help but be aghast. If it wasn’t for him and Crimson Moon’s existence.., this time the Devil Emperor and the Fire Dragon Lord had joined hands to attack the federation. Perhaps they would all be buried here!
Unfortunately, when Lin Changsheng’s plan was about to be completed, he found Dudian who had sneaked into the federation. So Lin Changsheng slowed down his plan and prepared to become a god from Dudian’s body.
If he could use Dudian’s body to become a god then the Devil Emperor and Fire Dragon Lord would come. He would be able to hunt both of them without any mistakes!
Unfortunately, Dudian’s body was incomplete. In the later battles he had bred the Aragami girl who was a true God. This caused all of Lin Changsheng’s plans to fall apart!
“I can’t calculate every unknown change in the world.”Dudian thought. Now that Lin Changsheng was dead, he would be the one to be dealt with when the magic insects arrived.
He couldn’t fool the magic insects like Lin Changsheng. He had to fight!
However he wasn’t worried. From Lin Changsheng’s memory he knew that although the sage was strong but he wasn’t a match for God!
God!
This was the ultimate life that the magic insects and Aragami were pursuing!
In other words, even for the magic insects and Aragami this was the ideal state they were pursuing but they were far from achieving it!
Therefore, the Aragami girl that was born in his heart was undoubtedly the most powerful existence in the world, the most terrifying life form!
Moreover, this life form was still obeying his orders, which was equivalent to him holding the most powerful power in the world in his hands!
After reading Lin Changsheng’s memories, the mysterious veil of this world was completely lifted in front of him. He was once just an ordinary person, or a hunter, but he always felt that this world was unfathomable, it was difficult to see the root of it, but now, he knew everything.
“The magic bugs are divided into two races, the Ice Magic Bug and the flame magic bug. The ice magic bug race controls the federation, encircling the land and researching it into a mystery. The flame magic bug rules the Fire Dragon Kingdom, and they are also researching into a mystery! “And the Aragami race occupies the central plains, and they also want to solve the mystery of becoming a god. They desire to live forever, to live together with the universe
“The war in the old era was too intense. The seven continents were torn apart by nuclear bombs. The humans activated the ‘Doomsday Plan’and prepared to perish together with the invading magic bugs. Unfortunately, they could not do so. They only made the environment on the surface even worse.”
“The small island fragments have already sunk under the claws of the sea monsters. The large continents are also gradually shrinking in size. The once large continents have now shrunk to less than the size of a large country’s territory!”
“The human countries, the federation, the Empire, and the fire dragon country are divided into three parts! The north is the zombie country ruled by the mutated Zombie King, the forbidden zone for the living

chapters.title: Chapter 1218
chapters.content:
Chapter 1218: Chapter 1207: in order to survive
Translator:
549690339
“In the post-apocalyptic plan of the old era, the humans did not kill the magic bugs, nor did they perish together with the magic bugs. The kindling of the humans who were lucky enough to survive had tried their best to reproduce, but in the end, they were still reduced to the experimental subjects of the magic bugs and Aragami. If the heads of the various countries and many scientists who came up with this plan knew of this result, who knows what kind of sorrow they would have?”
“However, the nuclear explosion caused great damage to the magic insects and Aragami. Although not all of them were destroyed but their vitality was greatly damaged. The main forces had left Earth and only the base was left to continue experiments on Earth.”
The world that Lin Changsheng saw from his memory was completely different from what Dudian had seen in Sylvia. In Sylvia, people believed in Aragami and there were countless bards who sang songs for Aragami, they sang about its virtues and their own stories and legends. There was a goddess statue carved on the giant wall which protected people from the invasion of monsters.
All of these made people firmly believe that the Aragami had fought for human beings and fought against the magic insects. It was the guardian God of human beings!
The history of the giant wall was also recorded in this way.
But in fact..
The Aragami had fought fiercely against the magic bugs. But they didn’t fight for the humans but for the delicious cake of the Earth.
In the early days of the war, the magic bugs had invaded from outer space. However the Aragami’s invasion was silent. They had infiltrated the human society in a parasitic way, there were Aragami behind the scenes.
Dudian’s impression of the Aragami was that they were gluttonous and ferocious creatures that would devour everything. In fact, the Aragami race did have the ability to absorb most of the material and turn it into their own life function, however, they were not stupid. On the contrary, they had the top IQ. If they tested their IQ in the human way, their intelligence was generally above that of humans!
It was just that their planet was too barren. They needed too much material for their own activities, so they had no choice but to plunder other life planets.
It was just like if there was a day when the population on Earth expanded and the food produced was not enough for humans to eat and drink, there would be a famine. A large number of people would starve to death and the population would be reduced. However, before such a situation occurred.., each country would formulate a family planning plan in advance to curb such a tragic matter.
However, the Aragami were different from humans. They were also in a famine, but they would not starve to death easily. Every Aragami could absorb the material around them at will. They could eat trees, water, and soil. Everything on the planet would be eaten up, just like locusts.
Moreover, the Aragami’s lifespan was extremely long. If they did not encounter natural disasters, they could live for thousands or even tens of thousands of years.
Hence, the Aragami had no choice but to kill each other.
However, the Aragami were not fools. When they killed a certain number of each other, they would cast their gaze towards the vast universe. In order to not exterminate their race, they could only continue to plunder to survive.
And the planet where the demon bug was located was the first life planet that the Aragami had explored!
However, the demon bug was not a simple character. The Ice Demon Bug and the flame demon bug occupied both sides of the planet. Ever since they were born, they had been fighting non-stop. and the long battle had caused them to constantly evolve and learn, becoming stronger and stronger!
Therefore, although the Aragami were terrifying, it was still very disadvantageous to cross the planet to fight on the demon worm’s planet. Furthermore, the demon worm’s reproduction ability was extremely strong, faster than the rabbits on Earth. However, unlike rabbits.., the demon worm’s reproduction depended on its own will. If it did not want to reproduce, it would not be able to reproduce.
Just like that, the war between the Aragami and the demon worm continued for a long period of time.
Until..
The Aragami obtained a conjecture from the demonic insects. This conjecture caused the Aragami race to boil. It was as though they had opened up a new world for them and found a new way to survive!
This conjecture was to become a god!
According to the definition of the demonic insects, a god would not age or die. They would not be born or die. They would have the ability to absorb all energy or matter and transform them into their own lives. They would be able to survive in any harsh environment. Theoretically speaking.., even a black hole that could swallow even light could not destroy it!
A God was omnipotent. There was no concept of life, because it was eternal!
This conjecture stimulated the Aragami’s hope of survival. They did not need to spend a large amount of resources to travel between the magic bugs and their own planet, transporting food back and forth. They could evolve themselves.., even if they could not become the somewhat unrealistic “Gods”, they could still evolve themselves to be more adaptable to the environment, to adapt to the universe. They could even survive in space, and they could survive on a planet without life!
Hence, the Aragami race began their evolutionary journey. After a long period of time, they had finally evolved to their current level, barely solving the problem of survival. But at that moment, the Aragami race began to yearn for the eternity that the demonic insects sought, hence, they frequently attacked the demonic insect planet.
The demonic insect planet had been in constant warfare for many years, and it was already unbearable. Seeing that it was about to collapse, the great sages of the demonic insect race and the Aragami race had no choice but to work together to discuss countermeasures and seek a way out. Hence, they migrated their spaceships and wandered in space, they were prepared to migrate to a new planet that was suitable for habitation.
When they were migrating, they did not notice that the Aragami race had secretly followed behind them. In terms of exploring the galaxy, the Aragami race was more advanced and professional than the demonic insects. After all, in order to survive, they had already searched for a new planet that was suitable for habitation before the demonic insects had even stepped out of the ancestral star, they had already searched everywhere for a new planet that was suitable for habitation.
During the long wanderings, the magic bugs had found the “Visitor”signal that humans had placed outside the solar system. Through the feedback of the signal, they had locked onto the location of the Solar System and then found Earth.
Countless human scientists explored the galaxy and felt that humans were too lonely in the vast universe. They wanted to find aliens. However, on that day, when the magic bugs arrived on a majestic and gloomy spaceship.., the entire Earth fell into an unprecedented panic.
When the magic bug invaded the earth, the Aragami that followed behind quietly descended to the Earth. They used parasitic characteristics to mix with humans and quickly understood the human social system and civilization, it was just like the first time they invaded the magic bug planet.
These information were the records that Lin Changsheng had found from the magic bug spaceship and the Aragami spaceship. He could still find some incomplete aragami spaceships and magic bug spaceships in different parts of the Earth.
Dudian had a fresh memory of the scene when the magic bug descended. He saw a huge spaceship appear in the clouds and descend on the city like a mountain. The whole city fell into panic.
No one knew that that day was the end of mankind. The enemies that mankind faced were not only the magic bug but also the terrifying Aragami that had infiltrated the human society.
In front of these two races that could cross the galaxy, humanity was like a child. They could not even withstand a single blow. Even using their strongest nuclear weapons could not change the outcome. Earth still fell into the hands of the Aragami and the demon bugs.
After the great calamity, the Aragami and the demon bugs had reached a balance. They found that not only was earth suitable for living, but the humans on earth were thermostatic creatures. According to the demon Bugs’experimental conjecture, if they wanted to become gods.., the only feasible way was to gather the extreme powers of the ice magic bugs and the flame magic bugs and fuse them together. Once they reached a certain balance, they would be able to live forever!
And warm-blooded creatures like humans were a turning point for them!
They tried to use the human body to find the balance between ice and fire in the human body. However, ice and fire were two extremes. Normal human bodies could not withstand it, so they tried to change the human body’s constitution. Hence, they built a base on Earth, which was the current federation, the Fire Dragon Kingdom.
On the other side, the Aragami sensed the intentions of the demonic insects and also built an empire base.
The three parties were doing their best to develop and research. They knew that if one of them was the first to create a “God”, the other two parties would definitely be struck by lightning, either destroyed or reduced to food!
The law of the jungle was the only law in the universe. Humans were not the only ones who experienced the end of the world. The Aragami and demonic insects were also suffering, including the countless other animals on earth. They were also in this end of the world.
The virus was rampant. Where was their original appearance?
And who could be left alone!
..
..
It was expected that “Dark King”would end at the end of this month. HMM, perhaps it would end on the 4th or 5th of next month. It would depend on how diligent they were..

chapters.title: Chapter 1219
chapters.content:
Chapter 1219: Chapter 1208: separation
Translator:
549690339
“The so-called divine embryo is suitable for balancing the body of the ice and fire magic bug. It is also the purpose of the magic bug and the Aragami to raise humans to do experiments. Therefore, there are magic research institutes in every giant wall. On the surface, it looks like they are studying the effects of magic beasts and magic marks on hunters, but in fact, they are studying humans
“More than two hundred years ago, Lin Changsheng was the only successful person in the experiment of the sage of the ice magic bug. However, he was lucky enough to fool the Sage of the Magic Bug and hide his consciousness in the virtual world. Meanwhile, his body was taken away from Earth by the sage of the magic bug
“My body also belongs to the god’s embryo...”
“But the magic insects hadn’t come to Earth when I was born.”
Dudian recalled the memories of his birth. He was in pain. Although he didn’t want to recall and believe but the scenes told him that he was ‘Made’and not ‘born’from the mother.
His birth came from the pursuit of long life on Earth. He was an experimental subject of the human race but he met the needs of the magic insects and became the god’s embryo.
His creator, his father, had frozen him for his own personal reasons when humanity was destroyed, hoping that he could become the last spark of humanity and pass down civilization.
However, in the world 300 years after his awakening, humanity still existed on Earth, spread all over the world, and was not completely destroyed as his father had imagined. Even without him, the “Heir,”he was still living very well, they were singing and dancing in the giant wall. On the other hand, he himself was struggling to survive in the human world after the cataclysm. Therefore, he came to his senses — this world did not need him, it could still operate.
He was not the savior of this world.
No one would care about an unremarkable person like him becoming the Savior.
As for himself, he had long extinguished the thought of being a hero to save the world. The many encounters brought about by the trajectory of life forward promoted the growth of people, from the immature to the mature, from the naive and rebellious youth to the sophisticated and docile middle-aged man.
It was a kind of sorrow but no one could change it. Just like the Earth around the Sun, it was the rule, the law, and it was irreversible. Moreover... he enjoyed it.
“Now that Lin Changsheng is dead, the federation has no leader. We will first recover the federation and then pursue the Devil Emperor. Let him be well prepared and catch them all in one fell swoop!”Dudian thought of the current situation, the world that used to be shrouded in fog was now completely clear in his eyes. The three forces were divided into three parts of the world. There was no need to worry about the monsters and the corpse kingdom.
This was because he was in a high position. He could see far but he had lost interest in them.
Some things would be painful if he saw them too clearly.
“Before we recover the federation, we have to separate the body.”Dudian looked at the Aragami Girl. He knew that they were in a community but it was not a purely symbiotic relationship, no one could be separated from each other. It should be known that the girl was born from his body. She would be able to live without him.
But he would die without a doubt.
In order to save his life, the girl would use her own body to nurture him. Because he didn’t have a heart. Once he left the girl he would die.
There were only two ways to break away from such a community. The first way was for Dudian to become a god. In this way all the problems would be solved. But after reading Lin Changsheng’s memory, Dudian found that it was almost impossible for him to become a god. It was even more difficult than solving the problem of the zombie virus!
Because he didn’t have a heart!
His body was incomplete and couldn’t be considered as a qualified divine embryo. Therefore the power of the fire and ice worm and the power of the Aragami could never reach a balance in his body!
Even if he used the magic tissue to construct a heart, it would be meaningless.
His original heart had been cut into pieces by the Crimson Moon and put into the experiment. The experimental subjects had been abandoned in the giant wall of Sylvia. Some of them had rotted in other giant walls and become maggots’feces.
However, there was another way to find a replacement heart.
However, the replacement heart couldn’t make him become a god. However, it could make him leave the Aragami Girl and live on his own.
The stronger the replacement heart was, the stronger the power he could use!
There was an excellent replacement heart which was the mechanical heart!
From Lin Changsheng’s memory, Dudian knew the use of the mechanical heart. It was not only used for machines like the mainframe. It could be embedded into the body to replace the heart.
However, a body that could use the mechanical heart must have a king-level body like his. If it was an ordinary person or even an abyss expert, they wouldn’t be able to connect to the energy interface of the mechanical heart, let alone bear the terrifying energy of the mechanical heart.
Previously, Lin Changsheng was able to control the body of the Aragami to fight with the Aragami Girl. He had used the energy of the mechanical heart to do so.
Before he was ready to embed the mechanical heart, Dudian used his telepathic perception to ask the Aragami girl. If he left her body, would she still treat him like this? The answer he got was yes.
Dudian was relieved. He could see that the girl was not so obedient because of the community.
He first pulled out the body from the body of the girl. The girl took the initiative to cooperate with him in the process. She helped him to separate the cells that belonged to him. They fell on the snow like a lump of soft meat, the bones, internal organs and other things were slowly erected inside the lump of soft meat. It transformed into a tall and slender youth. It was Dean’s original appearance.
At this time, he had completely separated from the body of the Aragami Girl. He suddenly felt that his heart was unprecedentedly empty. It was more desolate than the snow-filled world. He couldn’t wait to stuff something into it, to fill up this indescribable uncomfortable feeling, he quickly grabbed the mechanical heart at the side. His palm melted and wrapped around it. He pulled it along his arm to the heart in his chest. Then, he used his flesh and blood to demonize the interface, after connecting to the mechanical heart, two thumping sounds were immediately heard. It shook his entire consciousness, causing it to buzz slightly.
The next moment, the strong beating became clearer and clearer. The abnormal uncomfortable feeling in his heart disappeared and was replaced by a vigorous energy. It seemed that the blood in his body was surging and roaring, it was full of power!
“This is the energy source of the mechanical heart. No wonder it can drive the spaceship’s interstellar jump. It is enough for me to squander my body at will. It is no longer like before. If I use too much strength, my heart will be unable to bear the load!”Dudian felt the vigorous power in his body, he tried to use his fingers to quickly demonize different tissues. There were sharp blades, claws, shields and so on.
Hundreds of abilities flashed on his fingertips. The speed of demonization was extremely fast. It was faster than the previous full speed!
“This kind of power... even if I am not a god, I am not that bad.”Dudian was shocked. In addition to not being able to absorb the material of the universe and transform it into energy, he felt that he was no different from a god, compared to other kings he had seen before, he was much stronger. Just like the gap between ordinary people and the Abyss!

chapters.title: Chapter 1220
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1220: Chapter 1209: Snail God
Translator: 549690339
With the power of the mechanical heart, Dudian knew that he could defeat the demon Emperor alone without the assistance of the girl. After all, even if his body was incomplete, he was still a god, he was much stronger than the previous Aragami that Lin Changsheng had used.
Now that he had regained his freedom and possessed extraordinary power, Dudian didn’t delay any longer. He immediately took action. The first step was to eat the fat meat of the federation!
..
... ..
The hundred cities of the Federation were still in the Panic of being occupied by the demons. Except for the first batch of refugees who hid in the underground shelters, the rest of them were hiding in their own homes or seeking shelter in the temporary military safe houses.
The federation had never suffered such a catastrophe. The shelters prepared in the past couldn’t accommodate the residents of each city. The streets were filled with corpses of the empire’s soldiers.
When Lin Changsheng gave the order to activate the nuclear bomb, the already obedient federation military began a riot. A few military magnates took the lead in resisting, repelling the imperial army that was guarding the city and seizing control of a few cities. Then, they used this as a base.., they contacted the generals in the other cities, preparing to launch a counterattack.
There was no lack of capable and intelligent people in the imperial army. Very quickly, they were able to see through the secret communication between the Federation military. A bloody Battle of resistance and conquest began.
In this chaotic battle, apart from fighting against the imperial soldiers, the Federation military also had to fight against some military magnates who had betrayed the federation. These military magnates held the military secrets of the federation in their hands, and if they joined the empire, they would be promoted and promoted, at this moment, they were cooperating with the imperial soldiers to debunk many of the strategic arrangements of the Federation military, making this counterattack battle extremely difficult.
Fortunately, the Terras consortium, the leader of the four great consortia of the federation, actively cooperated with the military and invested a large number of mechanical armors, forcefully bringing the disadvantage back to the balance of power.
The other three great consortia did not make too much of a move, as if they were waiting for something.
Clearly, they were waiting for the outcome of the battle between the Demon Emperor and Lin Changsheng. This was related to their choice. After all, they were not like Hei Si Luo Di, a loyal dog that Lin Changsheng had personally groomed. They did not have a deep understanding of Lin Changsheng.., they could not place the fate of the entire Financial Group on their trust in him.
Slaughter, chaos, Blood, wails.
The entire federation was in deep trouble. The destruction brought about by the war was extremely destructive. All the good things were torn to shreds. Only the blood-stained fruits were left, becoming delicacies in the hands of the victors.
“Yu’er, don’t cry. Mommy is here.”
“Hai Yang, I will wait for you at home. Be careful on your way here. The streets outside are filled with demons. Don’t let them see you.”
“You, you bunch of animals. You even killed an old man!”
“Amen, Amen. Almighty God, please protect us...”
The various human situations in the disaster were displayed in every corner of the federation. The sound of bullets and explosions covered the cries of the children in the ruins. The firestorm-like bullets tore through the blue sky. Fighter jets whistled and circled above the city. Smoke filled the air, many buildings were destroyed or burned. The streets were filled with fighting between the demons and the army. The old scavengers were curled up and trembling.
Dudian flew out of the Snow Mountain City. The railway between the cities had been closed. Some of the air tracks were bombed and couldn’t pass through. He had to rely on himself to fly to the capital of the Federation, he used the equipment there to put an end to the war.
He saw the disastrous scenes of the cities along the way. Although he had experienced the coup d’état in Sylvia and a series of vicious acts later on, he still felt a bit sad.
Humans were afraid of suffering.
Humans often created suffering for each other.
On the battlefield, everyone was innocent but no one was worthy of sympathy because everyone was pathetic. Only the mastermind behind the war was the most cruel.
Dudian didn’t expect the devil to leave but didn’t order the withdrawal of the soldiers. It was reasonable to say that once he left, the forces left here wouldn’t be able to compete with Lin Changsheng!
Unless he thought that Lin Changsheng would also be killed.
“He doesn’t know about my existence so he thinks that after she kills Lin Changsheng, she will destroy everything. But she won’t rule the federation like humans.”Dudian thought, he glanced at the Aragami girl who was flying by his side. She was able to survive this time. Moreover, she had extraordinary power. Everything depended on her help. He was inferior to her in terms of strategy and strategy, he was defeated by Lin Changsheng.
Unfortunately, he wasn’t as lucky as he thought.
“What should I call you in the future?”Dudian asked her.
The girl looked at him in confusion: “What Should I call you?”
Dudian suddenly understood that although she had learned human language but she didn’t understand the rules of the human world, he thought for a moment: “You are not a human. You Don’t need a human surname. The first word you say after birth is ‘wa’. It will be used as your surname. You Don’t have a gender but since you have turned into a woman then you should use the word ‘wa’next to the word ‘woman’.”
“You are the first God in the world. It is possible that you are the only one. God is your name. I will call you ‘Wa God’from now on. How about it?”
The girl seemed to understand but didn’t understand. She clapped her hands and smiled: “Alright!”
Dudian was relieved to see that she didn’t reject him. In fact, he had a probing purpose in naming her. It seemed that she did think of him as a ‘mother’. Even if he told her.., she was the first God in the world but she hadn’t changed her mind. If it was a human then perhaps they would be proud or have ambitions.
But from her expression it seemed that she didn’t know what ambition was.
A moment later, Dudian and God wa arrived at the federal capital. He parachuted into the city and found that the war had ended a long time ago compared to the chaos in other cities, from the soldiers who were cleaning the streets, it could be seen that this place had been seized by the federal military.
Dudian brought God wa to the government building in the capital. He saw a large number of mechas and tanks lined up on the spacious streets. The streets were very spacious because of the military parade. However, they were fully armed at the moment, there were a few pieces of land that were exposed. Dudian used his X-ray to scan the depths of the building. A large number of figures were moving around in a hurry.
Dudian found a group of big figures wearing the general’s badge. They gathered in a well-defended office for a meeting. The projection of the meeting showed the situation of the other cities.
Dudian saw a familiar face among the big shots. It was the Supreme Chairman of the Tesla Consortium.

chapters.title: Chapter 1221 - Chapter 1210: Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 1221: Chapter 1210: Kill
Translator:
549690339
“The demons have been accumulating their forces in the Middle East. Are they planning to retreat?”
“Now that the capital has been taken by us, I heard that the demon Emperor has already retreated without a leader. Naturally, they should retreat. Even if they don’t, gathering in the Middle East is just digging their own graves.”
“I don’t think so. The terrain in the Middle East is flat and not conducive to defense. If they wanted to retreat, they shouldn’t have chosen to gather here. Aren’t they afraid that we will wipe them out in one fell swoop?”? “I think that with the demon race’s brutal and bloodthirsty nature, retreating is fake. They are most likely using this place as a springboard to directly attack the capital!”
“Directly attack the capital?”? General Nie was joking. The Middle East was two rivers away from the capital, there were countless ferocious beasts in the river, and there were eight mountains in between. The railway was completely sealed. How far would it take to march from outside the city to the capital? “By the time they are halfway there, our missiles will have already bombarded them
“As far as I know, there is a secret passage in the valley that leads directly to the capital. However, the environment of the valley is harsh and is occupied by the serpents. To us, these serpents are extremely poisonous and fierce beasts, but they are vulnerable to the demons. If they advance through the secret passage in the valley, they will be able to shorten the distance to the capital. Then, they will go around the valley to the Meifeng mountain range and attack the armory in the southwest of the capital. This will cause a huge blow to us!”
In the meeting room, when everyone heard General Nie’s words, their disapproving expressions turned solemn and their pupils constricted. If it was really as general nie had said, once the demons succeeded, the consequences would be unimaginable!
Someone immediately proposed to inspect the secret passage of the canyon. Soon, the map projection on the table enlarged and revealed a long, curved canyon with a large number of red heat source figures inside! One had to know that this canyon was filled with okra snakes, so how could there be heat source figures?
General Nie’s words immediately came true, and everyone’s expressions changed.
“These demons are detestable. The Demon Emperor has already retreated, yet they still dare to attempt to attack our federation. How dare they look down on us!”
“Outrageous! We’ve set up a trap in the canyon, and while their army is advancing, we’ll bury them!”
Everyone was furious and decided to attack the demons. At this moment, someone asked the silent hei si luo di, “Chairman, you said that the demon Emperor had retreated and was defeated by the god of Technology. Is that true?”
The moment these words were said, everyone’s gaze fell on Hei Si Luo Di.
“Of course it’s true.”Hei Si Luo di regained his senses and saw a hint of doubt in everyone’s eyes, he snorted coldly, “Would I lie to You? Do you think that the god of technology is no match for a mere demon emperor? Don’t forget who helped you take back the armory in the capital!”
Hearing that, everyone looked away, the person who asked earlier hurriedly smiled apologetically, “Chairman, you’ve said it too seriously. We naturally wouldn’t doubt the great god of Technology. Since the demon Emperor has left and his army still insists on attacking the Federation, why don’t you ask the other three consortia to help us destroy these damn demons?”
Haslodi snorted coldly. He was about to open his mouth when suddenly, with a bang, the wall of the conference room burst open. Dust flew everywhere, and steel bars protruded out of the wall. The layer of steel plate embedded in the middle was also pierced through, and the steel plate was electrified, at this moment, sparks were flickering in the cracked hole. A slender and cold figure stood in the dust fog, stepping on the broken stones on the ground and stepping into the conference room.
“Who is it? !”
“Guards! !”
“Demon Attack? How is it possible? Guards!”
Many generals and senior leaders of the Terras consortium were shocked. They looked at the figure who had broken through the wall. Their faces changed. This was their headquarters.., there were countless guards, mechs and chariots outside but the enemy had rushed in front of them. At this moment, they were no different from sheep who were stripped naked. In front of the demon, they were just ordinary people!
“Noisy!”Dudian’s cold eyes looked at the people in the meeting room. There seemed to be cold lightning flashing in his eyes, through the genetic strengthening of spiritual power, the entire meeting room was covered. A cold snort interrupted all the exclamations. Everyone’s mind was buzzing and they felt dizzy.
“It’s You! !”The cold-faced Black Slody jumped up from the chair when he saw Dudian’s face.
At this time, the sound of mechanical armor and orderly footsteps came from outside. It was the guards who followed them.
Many generals and directors of the consortium were relieved when they heard the voices of the guards. Someone saw Black Slody’s abnormal behavior and immediately asked: “Chairman, do you know this person?”
Black Slody’s eyes were wide open as he stared at Dudian.
Dudian glanced at him: “Don’t think about it. Your so-called God of Science and Technology Lin Changsheng has been destroyed by me. From now on, the federation will focus on me. Those who object will die! Those who resist will die!”
“Nonsense! Which King of the demon race are you? Tell me your name!”A burly general shouted in anger. Although he looked angry but his words were calculated. The purpose of his words was to understand Dudian’s identity, after all, as an old enemy of the Empire, the intelligence spies of the Federation had been collecting the king’s ability of the empire. They knew who Dudian was and naturally knew his ability. They could think of a way to defeat him.
The second reason was to delay time. He believed that it was impossible for Dudian to kill all the people outside. After all, if there was an accident, the outside would immediately send a message to them.
Therefore, he determined that Dudian had used some kind of means to force his way in in a very short time. He wanted to capture all the leaders of the federation and make them leaderless. Therefore.., at this moment, delaying time and waiting for rescue was the best choice.
“Noisy!”
Dudian’s face was cold. He raised his hand and pointed. A Ray of light shot out from his fingertip and pierced through the forehead of the general.
The latter’s body stiffened and his consciousness disappeared. It seemed that he didn’t expect that this man didn’t play by the rules.
The other generals saw Dudian raise his hand to kill. They were shocked and angry. They clenched their fists but didn’t dare to provoke Dudian.
“Who has doubts?”Dudian looked at the crowd.
Everyone’s face was ugly. No one made a sound as they waited for their subordinates to come to rescue them.
The sound of footsteps came from outside the conference room, a calm and magnetic voice was heard: “The demons inside listen. Please leave quickly. Our missiles have locked onto this place. There are ten creator mechs outside. They are ready to be ordered. If you dare to hurt anyone, we will cut you into pieces!”

chapters.content:

Chapter 1222: Chapter 1,211: Submit
Translator: 549690339
Hearing this, everyone instantly heaved a sigh of relief. The army outside was indeed safe and sound.
“Demon race, did you hear that? We have ten creator god mechas guarding us. Every single one of them can contend against you demon kings! “Although I don’t know what method you used to sneak in, but now that you’ve been exposed to our satellite surveillance, you won’t be able to escape even if you have wings. I advise you to leave quickly. Even if you kidnap us or even kill us, there will still be new generals to take charge of the overall situation and annihilate your demon race!”A square-faced middle-aged man with a righteous face shouted.
“That’s right! If you kill one of us, there will be thousands of us!”
“The federation will never surrender!”
The others saw that Dudian didn’t respond and responded loudly. Some of them were hot-blooded while others were trying to save themselves.
At the same time, Heslodi quickly took out his personal communication device. It was a star-shaped accessory like a wheel handle. It was the communication device that he used to contact Lin Changsheng.
He activated the communication device but it flashed with red light.
“It can’t be connected?”Blackie’s pupils shrank. He was shocked. This communication device could contact Lin Changsheng at any time. Lin Changsheng lived in the virtual world. He didn’t have the concept of hibernation. Even if he was in hibernation.., if he was busy with other things, he could sense his communication or use his doppelganger to take over his communication. There had never been a situation where he couldn’t be connected!
In an instant, he thought of Dudian’s previous words. His heart suddenly trembled. Was it true that Lin Changsheng was really dead?
As the chairman of the Terras Consortium, he was the only person who had come into contact with Lin Changsheng. He knew better than anyone in the federation how unfathomable Lin Changsheng was. He was intelligent and cunning! Such a person had countless mechanical armies in his hands. He could control the missile launch of the federation at any time. The military power of the entire federation was equivalent to Lin Changsheng’s hands and feet. He was almost invincible!
He couldn’t think of any way to kill him. This was god-slaying!
“Clamor!”
Dudian indifferently said.
“I’ll give you one more chance to choose. Live or Die!”Dudian indifferently looked at everyone. Everyone saw his eyes. The anger in his eyes cooled down like ice water, it was cold from head to toe.
Dudian slowly raised his hand. The next moment, his five fingers burst out and turned into a black blade. It cut open the top of the conference room and shattered it, all the powder was blown away!
The conference room was located at the bottom of the most secure building of the government building. It was more than ten stories high. At this moment, it had completely disappeared and revealed the blue sky above their heads.
The sun shone down on everyone’s body. Everyone was stunned as they looked up. It was as if they were looking at the most beautiful ray of light from the abyss of Hell.
A security level 3s building was destroyed!
However, Dudian’s action didn’t stop. The magic blade extended from his five fingers. It was dozens of meters long and looked like five thick chains, it pierced through the chest of five giant mechs that were more than ten meters tall. It was the cockpit of the mechs. The pilots inside were killed on the spot, the sturdy compound beehive-shaped outer shell could withstand the bombardment of countless rockets. However, at this moment, it was like a piece of paper that was easily pierced through!
When the five black chains were retracted, the pulling force caused the five genesis mechas to fall to the ground with a loud bang. The sound of the vibrations made people’s hearts skip a beat and their hearts tremble with fear.
The many generals and the directors of the consortium were all stunned. They could not believe the terrifying scene before their eyes.
The many guards surrounding the conference room had lost the barrier of the walls, and their positions were all exposed. It was as if they were stripped naked and standing in a world of ice and snow. They felt as if there was nothing to hide, and all the guards were stunned, especially when they saw the five god of creation mecha fall to the ground, they felt as if the entire world had collapsed. This was the federation’s most powerful mecha!
The ingrained strong image had collapsed in an instant!
The scene was silent for more than ten breaths. It wasn’t until someone’s legs went weak and fell to the ground that the others woke up as if they were in a nightmare. They found that their clothes were wet with cold sweat.
“No, this is impossible!”Blackie was the calmest but he couldn’t help but shout in his heart. He was completely convinced of Dudian’s words. If Lin Changsheng hadn’t been killed.., it was impossible to let an existence like Dudian appear here without any hint!
The reason why he participated in the Military Conference and didn’t seize power was because he knew that Lin Changsheng was still alive. As long as Lin Changsheng was alive, even if the entire federation collapsed, he would still be able to make a comeback!
On the contrary, if Lin Changsheng died, then the entire federation would be divided even if there was no internal chaos. The strength of the Federation would be greatly reduced!
“Is this choice very difficult?”Dudian looked at the silent crowd. There was a trace of killing intent in his voice. It seemed that he had lost his patience.
“I, I am willing to be loyal to you!”There was a panicked voice in the crowd. It was a fat man in a suit whose legs were trembling. From the way he dressed, it seemed that he was a director of the consortium.
People of any class had a tendency to follow the crowd. If someone took the lead then there would be others who would follow. The other directors also expressed their opinions.
Many generals changed their faces as they looked at Black Slody.
Black Slody’s face changed for a moment. He clenched his teeth and said: “I have no objection!”
The Generals’faces turned ashen. Their military strength would be reduced by half if they lost the support of the consortium. After all there were only two of the ten creation mechas in service, one of them had been destroyed by Dudian!
Dudian’s expression was neither happy nor sad. He wasn’t happy because of the Terras Consortium’s surrender. It seemed that he didn’t feel anything, he slowly said: “It seems that the remaining people are not willing to surrender. In that case, they will die!”
A sharp blade protruded from the back of his hand. It shot out like a chain and pierced through the head of the nearest general. His brain exploded and he died on the spot.
“General Yu!”Someone cried out in alarm.
“Don’t, don’t kill me. I submit, I submit to you!”
“Don’t kill me, I surrender, I surrender!”
The other generals who reacted quickly immediately raised their hands and surrendered. Some of them immediately covered their heads and squatted down, afraid that they would be hit by the terrifying chain of blades. This scene was even more embarrassing than when the directors of the consortium had surrendered, the guards outside looked at each other. They knew that it was inevitable.
The chain on the back of Dudian’s hand swam through the crowd like a poisonous snake. It swept over the heads of the stubborn generals who were unyielding.
Those who insisted on justice died. Those who were timid and greedy lived.

Chapter 1223: Chapter 1212: Emperor Dudian
Translator: 549690339
Under Dudian’s violent suppression, many high-level military officials had to surrender. As for how many of them were sincere and how many of them were hypocritical, there was no need to explore.
“Tell me about the current situation of the federation. Has the war of demons not subsided?”
Dudian sat on the chair in the top of the conference room. His fingers gently touched the table. The previously closed conference room had become an open-air camp. There were three layers of guards and mechs outside the conference room, there were mechanical guards and so on.
Many generals looked at each other. They didn’t feel comfortable to stand or sit in front of the soldiers.
“Mr. Dean, should we change the place to discuss the matter of the demons? After all, it is related to the war situation of the federation. What if there are spies of the demons...”blacksloth looked at dudian, he braced himself to speak to Dudian but was interrupted before he could finish his words.
“No need.”Dudian waved his hand and looked at him indifferently, “I want to correct you. I just said that the federation will be dominated by me from now on. This is naturally to tell you that the federal system has ended and changed to the imperial system. There is only one voice to give orders here and that is me! My status is equivalent to the emperor of an ancient dynasty. You Call Me ‘Mr. Dean’because you are looking down on my authority. I will spare your life for the first time. If someone makes such a low-level mistake in the future, I don’t think there will be any use in keeping that head!”
Everyone’s pupils shrank as they heard Dudian’s words. They were trembling in fear. They were secretly calling for a “Great dictatorship”but they didn’t dare to say it on the surface. In particular, some of the people who were deprived of their vital interests clenched their fists, they buried their heads even lower so that Dudian wouldn’t see the hatred and anger in their eyes.
“I know I’m wrong, d. . . Emperor!”Black Slade looked at Dudian’s emotionless eyes. He felt cold sweat all over his body. He quickly bowed his head and admitted his mistake. He sighed in his heart. The federation was a dictatorship in the past, however the dictator was Lin Changsheng who was hiding in the dark. Now it was Dudian who was a naked and undisguised great dictator.
His situation didn’t change much but for the other people who occupied a big city like the ancient feudal lords, the losses would be huge.
“Go on, tell me about the situation of the demon race.”Dudian snorted and leaned back on the chair. He looked at the people standing on both sides of the table. Many generals and directors of the consortium didn’t dare to sit down, they were afraid that their actions would anger dudian. There were blood of other rebels on the floor. Their bones weren’t cold yet. People could feel the bloody murderous aura in the air at all times.
“Yes, Emperor.”Black Slody was bitter in his heart. He politely nodded and addressed the military: “Generals, you are the most familiar with this matter. You can talk about it.”
The generals’faces changed, one of the generals with a black wolf tattoo on his arm said: “Great, Great Emperor, the demons are gathering in the Middle East. We are not sure whether they are going to retreat or sneak attack our capital.”
“Middle East?”Dudian’s eyes lit up: “Do you have a map?”
“Yes, but the equipment here has been...”black wolf tattooed general wanted to say that the equipment had been destroyed but he remembered that Dudian had killed people without warning. He was afraid that his words would anger him, dudian changed his words: “The equipment here is old. Why Don’t you move to the next front command? There are the most advanced equipment there. There are hologram images and battlefield intelligence.”
Dudian didn’t answer but asked: “Can we send news to the cities?”
Black Wolf Tattoo General was puzzled, he carefully asked: “Emperor, do you want to release news?”? “Yes. We have many channels to release news. Every city has established a disaster communication network which can transmit voice. If the equipment in some cities is well preserved then the signal tower will not be destroyed. We can also watch live news on TV.”
“That’s good.”Dudian nodded and stood up: “Go to the headquarters and arrange a live news broadcast there. I want to announce a few things to the country and calm down the chaos of the demons.”
Everyone’s face changed. They vaguely guessed what Dudian was going to announce. Once the news was broadcast it meant that Dudian’s identity would be confirmed. From then on he would become the number one figure of the federation.
“Well, if it’s confirmed then it’s confirmed. If we assassinate him in the future, we can also cripple him.”Many generals thought.
As Dudian moved, the shadow of the god of Wa followed him like a shadow. The others were amazed by the beauty of the girl but they didn’t have too many other feelings, naturally, she was also a demon. They had been in contact with the demon for a long time and knew that the demon could change their body, including their appearance.
A moment later, Dudian led many generals and directors to the command center. It was well-equipped. The generals who were there naturally knew the situation in the conference room of the building next to the command center. They were aware of Dudian’s strength, they were able to destroy five of the god of Creation’s mechs. They were able to defeat their strongest single combat force. This meant that unless they detonated their nuclear weapons, all the nuclear bombs stored in the capital city would be fired at the same time and Dudian would die, otherwise they could only obey his words. There was no room for resistance.
The two commanders came in and ordered the generals of the command center to Salute Dudian. This was not to curry favor with Dudian but to protect the generals of the command center. They were afraid that they would bump into Dudian and be killed by him.
In front of the commanders, generals and other distinguished generals, the generals of the headquarters could only silently accept this fact. At least for the time being, they couldn’t change it.
Soon, the headquarters pulled out the federation hologram map. It appeared above the central desk of the headquarters. The map showed the microcosm of the hundred cities of the Federation. Almost every city had some red dots. These red dots represented the demons, only the capital city didn’t have it. It was just a blue city frame. It was very clean. It meant that the demons here had been completely wiped out. Even if there were remnants, they might have hidden away from the detection of the detectors and surveillance cameras.
At this time, the live news channel was also set up in the command center.
Everyone’s eyes were focused on Dudian. From the commander General to the second lieutenant level information technician, including the reporters of the federal official news agency who had been invited to come. All of them were quietly watching the youth, the handsome face of the youth didn’t look like a devil’s executioner with blood on his hands. Instead, he looked like a brilliant star on TV.
However, the invisible dignity exuded from the youth’s body. It wasn’t deliberate but it made people feel a kind of inexplicable fear. The entire command center was silent. No one dared to make any noise for fear of alerting something.
Dudian asked the commander to get a pen and paper for himself. He quickly wrote a press release and handed it to the reporter, the purpose of the press release was to attract the eyes of the residents of the federal cities who were in deep trouble. They were filled with Hope and hope because the press release solemnly told them that God had come, he would immediately come to save them!
What could be more exciting than this moment of fear?
The reporter who received the news quickly glanced at the news. He was stunned by the content of the news. He couldn’t help but look up at Dudian. This person... actually claimed to be a “God”? !
The shock lasted for a short time. The beautiful anchorwoman who graduated from a top university was in charge of reading the news. She felt the cold atmosphere in the air and didn’t dare to ask any questions. No matter how unbelievable the content was.., she decided to press on and broadcast it.
When the live news was on, she immediately adjusted her expression and posture and began to recite the news that she had quickly recited earlier.
At the same time, the communication broadcasts throughout the federation, or the old radio, or the video websites on her wristwatch, or even the television sets that were popular with the elderly, were all broadcast or reprinted at the same time, the government’s latest news from the Federal Capital is broadcast or reprinted at the same time.
In this time of disaster, countless people are looking forward to the movement of the government.
Therefore, when the news was broadcast, countless people saw the news. Some cities were under the siege of demons. TV signals were destroyed and network equipment was also destroyed. However, they still had radios, for the education of the federation, most ordinary people could disassemble their own television sets or wristwatches and transform them into radios.
Radios were old-fashioned, but they still existed. In the minds of some warriors who went out to hunt, radios were better than wristwatches because wristwatches could not connect to the internet in the wilderness, however, radios could listen to the sounds coming from the cities of the Federation.
“The demons have disturbed the Order of the world. A great God has descended to punish the demons!”
“The God has said that in just one day, the demons will completely disappear from the Federation!”
“Everyone who is in the midst of a disaster, I can sympathize with you. Please hold on. Your prayers have come true. The God has really descended...”
The beautiful emcee spoke excitedly in front of the camera. Her voice was high-pitched and she displayed an extremely professional standard. However, she did not believe a single word she said in her heart.
If there was a god, why would god allow the world to exist in the demon race?
However, people in despair would not think about these things rationally and rationally like her. Even for a small portion of rational people, even if they were in despair, they would find this statement extremely illogical.
However, the legend of a God had always been spread in the federation. After all, the demon race had already existed. Shouldn’t there be a god?
This wasn’t the old era’s materialistic society. Although the Federation’s technology was ahead of the old era, but in such a world environment, most people firmly believed that there was a god in the world!
Dudian had absorbed Lin Changsheng’s memory. He had a deep understanding of the thinking of the federation’s civilians. The most important thing was that no matter if others believed it or not, he would use facts to prove it. After all, seeing is believing!
Many generals silently listened to the exciting performance of the beautiful host. Their eyes fell on Dudian. There was something strange and sad at the same time. A demon ran in front of them and claimed that he was a god. However they couldn’t refute, they didn’t dare to refute!
Soon, the beautiful host’s press release was over. The camera switched to the command center. Many generals gathered. The directors of the Terras consortium were gathered. Even Black Slody who was a well-known celebrity of the federation was present, it could be said that the stars were shining brightly. No matter who saw it, they would feel excited. This meant that the federation had not fallen and was still fighting against the demons!
Surrounded by many big figures stood two extraordinary faces. Dudian’s face was becoming more and more handsome as he evolved into the Abyss Walker. It was not an exaggeration to say that the face of the snail god was a disaster that could devastate cities and countries, the two of them stood together as if they were gods. The contrast between them was very strong as they covered the faces of the other generals.
“Is this god?”
“What a beautiful girl! What a handsome guy!”
“Is there really a God? How is it possible? Is It Fake?”
Countless people who saw the scene through the live broadcast were shocked. Some people who were in a relatively safe environment had fallen into the God’s face of Dudian and WA.
“Are these the cities that have been invaded by the demons?”Dudian raised his hand and pointed at the holographic virtual projection.
The commander was a bit confused. Didn’t I tell you before? Why did I ask again? Soon, he thought of the live broadcast. Dudian was deliberately putting on a show. He couldn’t guess what the purpose was but most likely it was to confuse the world.
“Yes, the red dots in these cities are the encroachments of the demons.”He was very cooperative but he was trying to figure out Dudian’s intention, he wouldn’t take the lead.
“God of Wa, do you remember these cities? Especially in this Middle East region, there are the largest number of demons. You should exterminate them.”Dudian turned to God of snail.
His voice was naturally heard from the live broadcast.
God Wa?
Countless people were excited and curious. Some of them were skeptical.
“Yes.”God wa nodded: “Are You Waiting for me here?”
“Yes, I’m waiting for you here. Hurry back.”Dudian smiled.
“Then I’ll go.”God wa smiled. Her perfect face made people stunned. Even the generals who knew the truth couldn’t help but look at her.
Dudian sent her a telepathic message. After God wa received it she smiled. She seemed to find it very interesting. Her body emitted silver light and a pair of snow white wings stretched out from her back, she wasn’t as ferocious as the broken wings in the previous battle.
She was like a fairy in the Moon. She existed in the mythology. Her beautiful face, Snow White wings, and her whole body was covered in hazy divine light. Her body slowly floated up and entered the dome of the command center, she disappeared, but the dome was not damaged at all. The camera outside the command center immediately switched to capture her back as she flew out of the building and into the sky.
It was so beautiful. If she was not a god, then what was she?
Everyone who saw this scene was stunned.
What followed was incomparable excitement and excitement. Some people even had tears streaming down their faces. Finally, someone came to save them. No, there was a god!
God, you are finally willing to take care of us! !
At this moment, many cities that were under the attack of the demon race all let out excited cheers. Their prayers had come true. Finally, they no longer needed to hide under the dark bed and tremble. God would come to save them!
Some people looked out of the window full of hope, hoping to see the beautiful figure of a god flying across the sky.
In those cities which had been less invaded by demons, many people saw this scene. Some people were inexplicably excited while some people were rational and doubtful. However, they were 70% confident, 30% doubtful, and most of them believed it, after all, this miraculous scene was real. Besides, there were many generals with numerous shiny medals, many directors of the Terras Financial Group, and the legendary figure, Hei Silodi, these people did not refute and clearly admitted it!
In front of so many powerful figures, how could a fake trick be hidden from them?
Therefore, this was most likely true!
