Chapter 1224: Chapter 1213: Devil
Translator: 549690339
Dudian was surrounded by many generals and directors of consortia. He looked up at the hologram that was floating in the air. The federation’s surveillance couldn’t detect the presence of God but from the speed of her departure.., he could guess her approximate location.
“Emperor, do we need to do anything?”A major general couldn’t help but ask Dudian. He thought that even if he was held hostage by Dudian but if he could use Dudian to repel the devils.., it wouldn’t be in vain for them to be humiliated here.
“No need.”Dudian indifferently said: “She alone is enough for a low-level demon. Everyone just stay here and watch. In less than an hour, the Middle East will become a forbidden area for the demons!”
Everyone was stunned as they heard Dudian’s words. Even the people who were watching the live news were stunned.
One person, one hour to wipe out the Middle East?
It was a large area and not just a city. There were countless demons gathered in the area. Even if the federal army attacked for ten days or half a month, they might not be able to take over the area.
Dudian didn’t explain much. God Wa was the first God on Earth. The Middle East didn’t even have a king. The highest commander was the Lord of the Abyss. He was like a baby in front of God wa! He said that he would give God wa an hour. He was worried that she would play around and waste time. In fact, he wouldn’t even need half an hour to kill the enemy, he would be able to defeat the demons in an instant!
“Hundreds of thousands of demons have gathered in the Middle East. They have disturbed the world and killed innocent people. If we can’t kill them in an hour then wouldn’t the civilians suffer?”Dudian said again.
The generals around were speechless. It was true but you have to be able to do it!
Some of the more thoughtful people heard the hidden meaning behind his words. It seemed like he was accusing the demons of being bloodthirsty and showing Dudian’s benevolence. In fact, he was saying that hundreds of thousands of soldiers of the demon race represented the strength of the Middle East, once the girl defeated the demons, a stronger image would be established in the girl’s body!
This image combined with Dudian’s previous words would undoubtedly make the crowd believe that they were gods!
If they weren’t gods, who could repel hundreds of thousands of devils alone?
Even they couldn’t deny this because they knew that even the king of the devil race couldn’t do it!
However, if it was the king of the Devil Race, there was another way to do it. It wouldn’t even take an hour for the Devil Race to retreat!
To order the demons to retreat in the name of the king of the demon race was tantamount to repelling the masses?
Someone thought of this and broke out in cold sweat. Could this be a plot of the demon race? Wouldn’t they be able to seize the power of the Federation without a single soldier?
The more he thought about it, the more scared he became. The quiet atmosphere was slightly shocking but suddenly there was an uneasy ripple. Dudian who was standing in the center of the crowd felt a trace of abnormality. His expression didn’t change and his eyes didn’t change, he used the corner of his eyes to catch the expressions and eyes of the people around him. He saw a trace of clues and guessed the problem.
Before he could open his mouth to break the guesses of the crowd, he suddenly felt the muscles of a general tighten. There was an abnormal reaction in his body. It seemed that he was ready to do something. The next moment, he saw the general clench his fist, the general angrily stared at him: “Evil Demon! Don’t think that your evil plan will succeed! You are a demon! You are not a god! Don’t think that you can...”
The voice suddenly stopped before he could say the word “Hostage”.
Dudian had reacted and made a move when the general opened his mouth to say the first word. Although the other party’s speed wasn’t slow but in his eyes, the actions of these ordinary people were as slow as a turtle’s speed.
“You don’t know life and Death!”Dudian raised his hand. The crystal particles in his palm refracted the light beam and turned into a golden color. It was like a ray of divine light that enveloped the man. The words that came out of his mouth were forced into his throat, he felt a strong wind coming from his mouth. He couldn’t breathe and his tongue was pressed to the point that he couldn’t move.
The other generals couldn’t help but change their expressions. They were ready to make their move but at this time the general who was covered in golden light suddenly let out a beast-like roar. It didn’t sound like a human’s voice but a monster’s roar, the generals who were ready to defend turned pale and looked back in horror.
Puff! A bloody tentacle broke through the golden light and hit Dudian.
Dudian picked up the notebook from the table and tore a piece of paper from it. There was a layer of golden light on the paper. Puff! It cut off the bloody tentacle.
The next moment, everyone saw the “True face”of the general. He had strange tentacles and a ferocious mouth. He looked like a monster with countless internal organs, his body let out a strange roar as he rushed towards Dudian.
“Purify!”Dudian raised his hand. Golden Light covered the palm of his hand as he hit the general. The palm of his hand instantly enlarged and turned into a huge palm covered in golden light, the general was hit to the ground of the headquarters. The ground shook and a huge pit appeared. The general’s body had turned into blood and was emitting a fishy smell.
Fortunately, the building was a shockproof building. Although it shook but the wall didn’t show any signs of cracking.
By the time Dudian retracted his palm, the people in the headquarters were completely stunned. They looked at the scene in disbelief.
The demons?
The demons had sneaked into their side and held a meeting with them?
This sudden change not only shocked everyone but also stunned the people in front of the live broadcast. But soon, everyone’s eyes were filled with tears and excitement.
He raised his hand and slapped the demons to death. His handsome face and invincible strength showed the demeanor of a God!
After a short silence dudian indifferently said: “I didn’t notice that there was a demon sneaking into this place. Fortunately he was reckless and exposed his identity.”
Everyone was shocked as they looked at the bloody pit on the ground. They couldn’t speak for a long time.
Black Slody was as shocked as the others. But he soon realized that something was wrong. If this general was a demon then why did he jump out to accuse Dudian? He absolutely didn’t believe in God because he had seen Dudian being captured and imprisoned like a dog. He was unable to resist because of Lin Changsheng’s research.
“Is it a double act? No, he can kill Lin Changsheng. There is no need to use such a clumsy method.”Black Slody frowned. He felt that this man was not to be provoked.
The other generals woke up from the initial shock. Some of them were aware of the abnormality of this matter. They were more vigilant towards Dudian and didn’t dare to criticize him. After all, although they were suspicious.., but they hadn’t seen how Dudian could turn an ordinary person into a demon. If he acted rashly then he would be in the same dangerous situation.
Dudian glanced at the crowd. There was a hint of warning in his eyes. It was very simple for him to turn the general into a demon. He only needed to inject part of his body into the ground through the soles of his feet, then he would drill into the bodies of others. Then he would destroy their brains, seize their bodies and wantonly transform their bodies.
On the surface, it was as if the demons had exposed their true bodies. This was the reason why he wasn’t afraid to open a live news broadcast. Even if someone jumped out to accuse him, he would still be able to suppress them and become a stepping stone for his image.
“The demons are everywhere. After this incident is over, we have to give everyone a collective examination to prevent other demons from sneaking in.”Dudian indifferently said.
Everyone heard the warning in his words. They felt that this man was like a devil. He was a hundred times more terrifying than the demon race!

Chapter 1225: Chapter 1214: One Day
Translator: 549690339
At this time, Dudian estimated that God wa was about to arrive in the middle east: “Can you bring up the details of the cities in the Middle East?”
The two commanders and many generals couldn’t help but look at the lieutenant general who was responsible for the battlefield information. The lieutenant general had never felt that the eyes of outsiders would be so sharp. If he agreed then it would be the same as following Dudian, if the federal government took back the rule in the future then he would naturally be held accountable. If he denied it then he would offend Dudian.
The lieutenant general hesitated for a moment between the future and his life. He chose Dudian’s side and immediately said: “You can transfer. Emperor please take a look.” He waved his hand and instructed the technicians to transfer the hologram of the Middle East region.
Dudian looked at the federal hologram floating on the table: “Can you bring up the surveillance screens of the cities?”
“Yes.”The lieutenant general replied.
Soon, a few square frames appeared on the side of the table. The sound of explosions and cries came out but stopped as soon as they were heard. A technician silenced the screen.
Dudian said in a calm tone: “Turn on the sound.”
The technician was afraid to alarm dudian. At the moment he heard the displeasure in Dudian’s words. He quickly turned on the sound and turned it on loudly.
The sky was filled with smoke. Buildings were bombed and collapsed one by one. The noise of wails and the sound of guns mixed together. Whenever a building collapsed.., rat-like people would escape from the bottom of the buildings. Those who were slower would be buried alive under the rubble.
Every video showed the purgatory of the human world. Large numbers of demons were gathered in the cities of the Middle East. They were in the most tragic area of the war. The original residents of the cities were either captured or massacred. Even the dignitaries hiding in the underground shelters.., they were also pulled out and slaughtered like cattle and sheep. Corpses were everywhere on the streets. There were old people and children. Even the gynaecological hospitals that were delivering babies were unable to survive in front of the cannonballs.
Such a tragic scene caused the faces of many generals in the meeting room to change.
The people in front of the live news broadcast all had tears streaming down their faces. Some of them had blood all over their bodies flowing backward. A surge of hot blood surged into their hearts. They wished they could kiss the battlefield, but they calmed down under the pull of their families.
Some of the people in the disaster area saw these pictures. They felt the same and cried. The residents of the cities that were affected by the disaster were shocked and angry when they saw the pictures of their compatriots being massacred. Only some naive teenagers and girls were still immersed in their own games, anime, shopping and entertainment. They didn’t care about the disturbance of the outside world unless the internet was cut off.
“These devils deserve to die!”Dudian looked at the miserable scene on the screen. There was anger on his face. It seemed that he was really angry.
Many generals and directors of consortia were still immersed in the battlefield on the front line. They were startled by Dudian’s words. They couldn’t help but be startled when they saw his face full of anger, they didn’t expect that he would be angry about the innocent deaths of these civilians. However when they saw the golden light on his body they immediately woke up. They bitterly smiled and felt ashamed for their naivety.
“Today I will exterminate all the Devils!”Dudian looked at the live broadcast of the news.
Everyone was surprised. A general couldn’t help but ask: “Exterminate all the Devils in one day?”
“Yes, one day!”Dudian’s eyes were cold: “All the Devils in the territory of the federation will be destroyed before the sun sets!”
Everyone looked at each other. They knew that Dudian was putting on a show. However, if he said these words in front of the live news broadcast, wouldn’t it be a slap in the face if the media exposed that the demons were raiding the city? Or was he really confident that he could order all the demons to retreat in one day?
Suddenly, there was a burst of exclamation.
The exclamation was very loud. Everyone couldn’t help but look at the source of the sound. They found that the sound came from the video screen. They saw a divine light flying from the sky. Then they saw a beautiful celestial figure coming down with beautiful wings on her back, wasn’t this perfect divine face God wa, who had just left not too long ago?
Everyone was stunned. One had to know that the journey from the capital to the Middle East region was a long one. Even the fastest fighter jet would take half an hour to reach there. However, how long had it only been? Less than ten minutes!
In the next moment, everyone saw God wa shuttling through various parts of the city like a streak of silver light. Countless demons on the streets had been killed. With a raise of her hand, she shot out countless streaks of silver light, piercing into the ground like needles, every demon that was pierced by the silver lights died suddenly!
This scene appeared on the surveillance screen and in the eyes of the people in front of the live news broadcast. Instantly, the entire city of the federation was in an uproar!
Even in the midst of despair and danger, everyone couldn’t help but let out excited howls!
God had really descended!
When God said that he wanted to save them, he really appeared on the battlefield and saved them!
The people in the command center were shocked by the power of God Wa. It was a bloody massacre!
At this speed, let alone an hour, half an hour would be enough to kill all the demons in the Middle East!
Dudian was a bit surprised. He didn’t think that the surveillance could capture the figure of God wa. But since it had been captured, there was no need to continue to film. If she showed some cruel means.., it would be bad if people thought of the devil race.
“Turn off the video and look at the situation of the devil race in the Middle East.”Dudian ordered.
The video was quickly turned off. However the people in front of the live news broadcast were not satisfied.
At this time, they saw the red dots in a city in the Middle East disappear at a speed visible to the naked eye. The originally dense red dots covered the entire city but at the moment it was like an eraser, the original blue pattern was revealed.
“It’s Blizzard City!”
“She is cleaning up the demons there!”
“Quick, contact the military there and tell them to stand guard. Send the previous video to them. Tell them to cooperate with her as much as possible!”
Many generals knew that this was not a show. Dudian was planning to really wipe out the demons. This was a rare opportunity. They immediately seized the opportunity to cooperate with Dudian.
At the same time, the change in Blizzard city alerted the upper echelons of the empire. They immediately called for a meeting. At this time, several Union generals who had defected to the Empire received the news from their subordinates. They immediately connected to the Internet and saw the live news broadcast. Their faces changed and they immediately found the top commanders of the empire, several masters of the Abyss.
After the live news broadcast, the Masters of the Abyss immediately asked them to bring up the live broadcast.
In the picture, the high-level officials of the empire saw the situation in the command center of the capital city. They saw Dudian surrounded by many generals. They also saw the video of WA slaughtering the soldiers of Blizzard city.
“Banish US within a day? Ridiculous!”
“I want to see what will happen if we can’t do it!”
“Have you analyzed the Combat Power Index of this woman?”
A moment later, the technicians of the empire used the latest equipment of the empire to analyze the data of God Wa’s body. The Combat Power Index was estimated to be 30 million! The Combat Power Index of the Seven Kings of the empire was estimated to be around 10 million. For example, the King of light and the new king of Crimson Moon were only around 20 million. Although it wasn’t their best performance.., they could still use this as a reference.
When the Combat Power Index of more than thirty million appeared, everyone was so scared that they almost jumped out of their chairs. The Lord of the Abyss, who had threatened to take action and destroy the god of Wa, also shrunk his neck and felt a chill run down his spine.
“This is a King?”Someone was shocked.
“The federation actually hid such a person. These damn things stole our power and actually nurtured a King!”
“Although a king is strong, it is not invincible. Use all the missiles to lock onto her and kill her!”
Very quickly, everyone regained their calm. Although the Combat Power of God wa was beyond their imagination, war was not something that could be resolved by just relying on individual combat power. They had brought along a large number of advanced weapons from the Empire, they had also seized quite a number of lethal weapons from the federation. Even if a king were to come, he would have to lie down and return!

Chapter 1226: Chapter 1215: Rise to the top
Translator: 549690339
In the capital headquarters, many generals and directors of financial groups raised their heads to look at the microcosm of the various cities in the Middle East. They could not help but hold their breaths as they watched the red dots on them disappear one by one.
The people of the Federation, who were watching the live news broadcast, once again revealed hope in their gloomy and despairing eyes as they watched this scene excitedly.
Time passed by minute by minute. The red dots were shrinking every moment.
Dudian ordered people to mobilize the city surveillance which had been cleared out. Everyone saw that the city which had been cleared out by the red dots was in a mess. There were traces of battle everywhere. There were huge craters where missiles were bombarded, the streets were filled with rivers of blood. Countless corpses of demons were scattered on the ground. The entire city was bleeding.
In this desolate scene, some survivors and civilians could be seen carefully walking out of the shelter and observing the streets. There were also civilians holding wristwatches in their hands, as if the wristwatches were being broadcasted live on the news, and through the live broadcast, they could see that the city they were in had been swept clean, and there were no demons.
Soon, more and more people walked out of their hiding places. Most of them had disheveled hair and dirty faces. After these people learned through the live broadcast that the city they were in was safe, they walked out of their hiding places, seeing the corpses of demons on the streets and the unprecedented silence, they could not help but shout in excitement on the streets. Even if they broke their voices, they did not care at all.
There were also people who ran around to spread the news loudly so that other survivors who were curled up in their nests would know.
Countless survivors who did not know each other felt sympathetic when they met each other. Some hugged each other excitedly, while others cheered together.
These scenes were seen by many people in other cities far away. It was as if they felt the same, and tears streamed down their faces.
In the blink of an eye, half an hour had passed. Everyone saw that the gathering of the demons in the Middle East had clearly changed. The red dots of the demons in each city were all drawn to the same place, and then they retreated to somewhere outside the Middle East.
Clearly, God Wa’s powerful attack had terrified the demons who were prepared to resist, and they could only retreat.
When a general said, “They are preparing to escape,”based on the information, countless people felt their minds shake. Half an hour ago, the Middle East was still a sea of demons, giving them an incomparable headache, at this moment, they had actually been swept out, and these terrifying demons had been pushed back!
All of this seemed like a dream, but from the scene on the screen, everyone could almost see what kind of Dangerous Battle God wa had gone through when exterminating the demons!
This wasn’t an act, this wasn’t an act, but a real fight to beat back the demons!
For a time, many generals found that their understanding of Dudian couldn’t be simply defined as a demon.
But they absolutely didn’t believe that he was a god.
But no matter what, Dudian had killed the demons, saved the federation, and also saved them!
In less than an hour, the god of Wa returned. She was pure and flawless. Her body was covered in silver light. She was incomparably holy. Her perfect face was quiet and elegant as if she wasn’t stained by any dust.
It was a big battle but there were no scars on her body. It was as if she had just taken a bath.
Everyone was shocked by her strength.
“I said that we will expel all the demons today.”Dudian smiled as he looked at the returning wa, he said to the generals: “The Middle East has been cleared out. The second region has been cleared out. Which region has the second largest number of demons after the Middle East?”
The generals looked at each other. A general who was standing next to dudian whispered: “In addition to the Middle East region, the northwest region has suffered the most. Many cities there have been deprived of food and water. Everyone is in danger.”
“Northwest region then.”Dudian ordered the people to pull out the map of the northwest region. He said to God wa: “You should go there.”
God wa smiled and nodded before leaving again.
The people in front of the live broadcast were excited. The fierce devils were like ants in front of dudian. They could be wiped out at any time. The Middle East region was the best evidence!
The people were by Dudian’s side. They were monitoring the situation in the northwest region. It didn’t take long for them to see that the number of devils in the region had decreased. They knew that the god of Wa had arrived. Soon, a city was cleared out. Dudian ordered people to monitor the city.
The people of the federation and the directors of the Terras consortium were shocked. They faintly felt that the situation couldn’t be salvaged. Maybe in one day all the Devils in the Federation would be expelled!
What would it mean if this matter was completed?
They didn’t need to think to know that from now on the people of the Federation would treat Dudian as a god! From then on, Dudian’s position in the Federation would be unshakable. Even if these authoritative figures jumped out to accuse him, Dudian might use the previous strange means to turn them into demons and kill them on the spot, after they died as demons, their families would be implicated and spurned!
There was no solution!
Everyone felt that it was almost impossible to trip Dudian. It was even a thousand times more difficult than expelling the demons!
Considering this point, many people began to think about their own position. Could they change their position and really submit to this strong man in exchange for the position of Elder?
Many people’s eyes changed as they looked at dudian.
Dudian could feel the changes around him but he didn’t care. Everything was within his expectations. The hearts of the people were unpredictable but the word ‘benefit’could manipulate ninety percent of the hearts of the people.
On the other side, as the fall of the Middle East and the last news were sent out, the other regions of the demon race all noticed the live news broadcast. They also knew about the existence of the god of Wa, from the battle prowess of defeating the army of hundreds of thousands of empires, he was even stronger than an ordinary king. This made the demons from the other regions feel both indignant and angry. In the end, they could only retreat with the large army.
After the northwest region had been swept clean, the remaining demons no longer had any thoughts of probing. One by one, they quickly mobilized their soldiers and left the terrifying demon den of the federation at full speed.
At 3 or 4 pm, the generals in the command center had already seen the demons gathered in the cities of the Federation. Only a few scattered soldiers could be easily killed. These scattered soldiers.., were also captured by the garrison forces that ruled the cities.
At this moment, the other three major consortia also joined in and helped to wipe out the remaining demons.
When the sun went down, the live news was relayed to another place. The government officially announced that all the demons were exterminated and the federation was restored to safety!
Countless people were crying because of the disaster. However, they were crying because of their loved ones who had died. The entire federation didn’t sleep at all. The live news was relayed to dudian. Dudian was surrounded by the generals. He commanded everyone to do the post-war compensation work. He cleaned the battlefield and the corpses. He restored the water, electricity and food in the cities.
Of course, for him, these were just words. It showed his will.
In addition, Dudian led a group of generals and high-level officials from the three consortia to visit some of the affected cities. In just one day, there were refugees who knew Dudian’s identity, they knelt down and cried at the sight of him.
Dudian healed some of the injured refugees and once again demonstrated his god-like ability. He returned to the federal government building in the capital in the early morning. He ordered people to inform the people to prepare for the Federal Assembly, all the high-level officials of the federation were present. The directors and leaders of the four consortia were no exception.
When the meeting was held, the live broadcast of the news was switched to all the cities. The military was busy in the night, transporting the wounded and building medical tents. All the disaster cities were gradually recovering.
When the preparations were done, the live broadcast of the news was once again aimed at the grand meeting. After Dudian’s brief speech, there was a general in the audience who spoke. He urged Dudian to become the president of the Federation.
As soon as these words came out, countless responses were received.

Chapter 1227: Chapter 1216: Dignity
Translator: 549690339
Everything in the meeting hall was like a rehearsal. It created a warm atmosphere and promoted Dudian to the position.
Dudian didn’t continue to play the role of a benevolent and kind face. He nodded and pondered for a moment, he said in a cold voice: “Although we have expelled the demons this time but the demons will come back. We are cheering for victory but at the same time you should look at your own comrades. You will never see them again! You should look outside and see how many people are crying and calling out the names of their loved ones!”
The warm atmosphere cooled down after hearing Dudian’s words. It was like a basin of cold water was poured on everyone’s head.
“Why did this happen? Have you reflected on it?”Dudian scolded.
The large conference hall was silent.
The crowd was silent before the live broadcast.
“The reason is simple.”Dudian coldly said: “First, the higher-ups of the federation are incompetent so the demons have a chance to take advantage of it! Second, there is no unity! What are the other three consortia doing when the demons invade? Third, the military is a complex faction. They don’t have enough support and intelligence to share in the war. In short, they are a pile of loose sand!”
“I. . .”A director of the Rockefeller consortium was about to open his mouth to explain but was immediately pressed down by the chairman next to him.
The meeting room was still silent.
The people in front of the live broadcast knew very little about these upper class groups. At this moment they understood the reason after hearing Dudian’s words. As for whether this was the real reason, they wouldn’t analyze it, firstly, they couldn’t analyze it. Secondly, it was impossible for them to lie in Dudian’s identity. After all, he was God!
What God said was right and what was right!
“This easily corrupt system should have been abandoned long ago!”Dudian’s eyes were full of disdain, “You are a group. The entire federation is a group. There is only one voice in the group! Only in this way will the efficiency and execution be greatly improved. The internal struggle will be reduced. So I think it is necessary to abolish the federal system and adopt a centralized system. I will temporarily manage the entire federation before the demons are eliminated. From now on, the Word ‘federation’will be removed and replaced by a dynasty!”
“Do you have any objections?”
Everyone in the conference hall knew that Dudian would rule the federation. At this moment they couldn’t help but sigh in their hearts. They knew that things had come to this point and there was no way to change it.
However, this kind of system change would naturally harm the interests of many people. Even if there were people who had predicted that Dudian would come out as soon as he finished speaking. He was a director of Milan Consortium.
“Please forgive me for not agreeing!”The director’s face was full of anger. It seemed that he had been suppressed for a long time but he was still rational, “The reason why the devil could invade the peace circle is because the devil personally led the Seven Kings to crusade. It has nothing to do with the federal system. Even if it is a centralized system, the result today will still be the same. I don’t think it is necessary...”
Dudian raised his hand and interrupted him. He didn’t explain: “Guard, take him out.”
The guard couldn’t help but stare at him. He didn’t expect that Dudian would act without scruples. He couldn’t help but shout: “This is a live news broadcast. You Can’t do this to me...”
The guard who had been waiting around the conference hall was expressionless. He pulled the guard out of the chair.
“Stop! He is right! Why did you take him out?”
“Do you really think that you are a God? Don’t think that we don’t know your true identity!”
“Do you believe that I will expose your fake identity in front of everyone?”
The more people spoke, the louder the voices were.
Dudian quietly looked at the eight people who jumped out: “Is there anyone else who has the same idea as them?”
The other generals and directors of the Tesla Consortium who were in the command center looked at them as if they didn’t see anything. They knew better than these people, dudian wasn’t as kind as he had shown on the live news broadcast.
God?
Even if he was a god, he was an evil god!
“Since there is no god, then take them out and lock them up in the prison!”Dudian coldly said.
The eight people who were talking were stunned. All of them were locked up in the prison? ! This was in front of countless people. You are a God! How could you do such an unreasonable thing? !
“Why are you locking us up? We haven’t committed a crime!”
“That’s right! Can’t we say a word here? If the federation falls into your hands then who can say anything?”
Two people saw the guards coming over. They were anxious and angry.
“Blasphemer! Kill them!”Dudian said to God wa: “Clean them up.”
God Wa knew what Dudian meant. She knew that Dudian was planning something. There was a rare serious look on her beautiful face. It seemed that she was angered by the words of these people. Her body was covered in silver light, she was as holy as she was when she was exterminating the demons. She raised her hand and shot out a few beams of light. They hit the eight people who were talking. Their bodies stiffened. The next moment their bodies shattered like ice crystals and turned into crystal powder, nothing was left behind.
The entire venue was silent. Everyone looked at the scene in disbelief. They didn’t expect that Dudian would dare to kill people in front of the live news broadcast, did he not care about the ‘God’image that he had created?
Some people were in disbelief but some people seemed to understand. They couldn’t help but sigh in their hearts.
“I know that changing the system will harm the interests of some insects so they couldn’t help but jump out. But they didn’t think so much!”Dudian looked at the crowd, “I know that some of you have the same idea as them but you chose to hide it. I know all of your thoughts. I didn’t bring you out because of the disaster. The federation needs people to build and help the people who have lost their homes to rebuild their homes.”
“If I find out that you have the behavior of insects in the future, I won’t let it Go!”
The crowd looked at each other and didn’t dare to make a sound.
Before the live broadcast, the crowd saw that Dudian had ordered the god to raise his hand and kill eight people. They were very excited.
This was God! He was thinking about them everywhere!
As for the eight people who jumped out to blame God, there were people who were angry when Dudian didn’t make a move. Many people applauded when they were killed!
Many people didn’t have a good impression of these high-level people. However, Dudian who expelled the demons in just one day had saved them from fear. It was as if he had remade their parents. Many people were grateful.
Through this matter, people felt that Dudian was a god. God naturally had the dignity of a god. It was a mortal’s sin to be questioned by mortals!

Chapter 1228: Chapter 1217: The Lord of the world
Translator: 549690339
Dudian only put forward the idea of reform during the meeting. He didn’t announce many specific policies and treaties. Although the people believed in him but he changed their living habits too quickly, it would inevitably lead to unnecessary chaos.
The first step was to recover the federation. The federation was just a stepping stone for him to rule the empire and the Fire Dragon Kingdom. He would be able to control the most powerful forces and the most abundant resources in the world.
At that time, even if he couldn’t find a way to solve the problem of the undeads, he would be able to de all his resources to research. As a person of the old era, his subconscious still believed that technology was omnipotent, if it wasn’t then it meant that the level of technology was too low!
After the meeting, the entire federation was like a huge machine that was running at full speed. All the injuries and grassroots construction were handed over to the officials. Dudian called the four consortia, they had a separate meeting.
The real upper class of the federation was still the four consortiums. Most of the power was in their hands, including the policy direction of the Old Federation. The four consortiums were able to influence and interfere. Of course, this interference was planned by Lin Changsheng. It made them think that everything was under Lin Changsheng’s control through the Terras Consortium.
The first step to change the federal system into a totalitarian dynasty was to integrate the power of the four consortiums.
The power of the federal system was too loose. Most of it was in the hands of the four consortiums. What Dudian wanted to do was to take back the power in their hands and give them the corresponding rights again.
Obviously, this was not unnecessary.
Dudian’s violent means had suppressed the discordant voices. The four consortia were like sheep in the eyes of a tiger, they were unable to resist.
The succession of the powerful and the changing of the times. Dudian’s actions would inevitably lead to the loss of the interests of some people. It would also lead to the tragic death of countless people. However, these were not exposed to the public, the people were trying to get used to the new policies and order brought by the new God.
What was order?
It was the rules set by the superior to the inferior.
In general, Dudian’s rules for the people were quite loose. After all, the new dynasty was established. The early stage was to please the people. It was easy to manage. When the situation was stable, there would be oppression and corruption.
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
The pain of the federation cities had gradually subsided. Some were hidden in the dark and had scars. The people enjoyed a lot of post-disaster benefits. They were more in awe and love of the new God.
However, in the upper class, the continuous half a month of iron and blood treatment made everyone scared of this god. Every time they saw the news of the people kneeling and praying in front of the statues of Dudian and WA.., many nobles who had heard of Dudian’s bloody methods sighed bitterly in their hearts. How was this god? It was a cruel and hypocritical devil.
After half a month of consolidation, Dudian felt that the federation had gradually become stable. All the unstable factors had been removed in this half a month. In this process, Lin Changsheng’s memory once again helped him a lot. Lin Changsheng knew the four consortia as well as many generals and federal officials. All of them were aware of their private secrets through his monitoring, dudian used them to make them surrender.
“Now the machinery heart is in my body. The federation’s brain has recovered its intelligence. It is no longer able to control the brain to monitor the entire federation. In the future, if I want to manage the entire country, I have to train a group of trusted and loyal guards.”
Dudian thought of Neuss and the others who were far away in the empire. There was a trace of nostalgia in his heart. He immediately called over Heslodi, he ordered: “I’ll leave the matters here to you for the time being. You should perform well. In the future when I ascend the throne I will confer the title to the world. Maybe I will give you a good seat.”
Black Slade was delighted. He had discovered that Dudian didn’t target him because he was a loyal servant of Lin Changsheng. It seemed that Dudian didn’t care about the past. This made him see that Dudian’s heart was big, but he was broad-minded.
He didn’t want to be a puppet in the beginning. He wanted to get rid of Lin Changsheng’s control. But now Lin Changsheng was dead. Although he wanted to rebel against Dudian but he found out that this was a more troublesome character than Lin Changsheng, since he couldn’t oppose Dudian then he might as well submit. Even if he submitted to Dudian then he would be in a high position. It was much better than the ordinary people in the world.
“Thank you, Emperor. I will do my best!”Blackie carefully complimented. He curiously asked: “Emperor, did you say the future? Don’t you plan to ascend the throne now?”
“I will ascend the throne after i wipe out the demon race and Fire Dragon Country.”Dudian indifferently said: “If I want to do it, then I will become the Lord of the world. What’s the point of being the Lord of a country? You can rest assured that this day won’t be long. At most half a year.”
With his current strength, it would only take him a few days to flatten the Empire and fire dragon country. The reason why he said half a year was to give the people at the bottom a time to adapt. He didn’t want to fall into chaos after the merger, it would be a waste of his manpower.
“The Lord of the World?”Blackie’s pupils shrank as he was shocked. He didn’t expect that Dudian would be so ambitious. He wanted to conquer the demon race and Fire Dragon Country and become the king of all living things!
However, it wasn’t difficult to understand that Dudian thought of himself as a god.
“I understand, Emperor.”Black Slody replied.
“I will go to the demon race and destroy the Devil Emperor. I will be back in a few days.”Dudian indifferently said: “There is nothing else. You can leave.”
Black Slody’s heart was in turmoil but he was very shrewd. Shock flashed across his face as he respectfully took his leave. He knew the terror of the Devil Emperor. Lin Changsheng had mentioned it many times but Dudian was able to kill Lin Changsheng, it wouldn’t be difficult to kill the Devil Emperor.
“The sky on this planet is really going to change!”Blackie was shocked and excited as he walked out of the building. He felt that he was going to experience a new era and the master of this era.., it was Dudian. This made him jealous but at the same time he felt happy and excited. Although he wasn’t the most dazzling person but he could enjoy endless wealth and power by following such a person!
Dudian was ready to leave the federation so he didn’t make too many arrangements. It was very convenient for him to go to the empire. If the Devil Emperor was in the capital then he could even fly in the morning and kill the Devil Emperor, he would return that afternoon.
“God, Let’s go.”Dudian said to the girl.

Chapter 1229: Chapter 1218: See You Again
Translator: 549690339
South of the Empire’s border, in the sky above the god of war wall.
The clouds were misty, and in the sky above the white clouds, there was an empty space. Above it, there was a cotton-like sea of clouds. At this moment, in this empty space, streaks of purple light flew past, shockingly, they were flying birds that were covered in purple lightning. They happily shuttled through layers and layers of the sea of clouds, gathering into the lightning that grew in the dark clouds as they searched for food.
This was the forbidden area above the god of war wall, guarded by them.
At the top of the clouds sat a bird herder dressed like a priest. His body was as light as a feather, and he sat on the clouds. This was his ability, and he could turn his entire body into the weight of a mayfly, he shuttled between heaven and earth effortlessly, but his combat strength was weak. He was a professional Thunderbird herder trained by the empire.
At this moment, the bird shepherd was half asleep and half awake. He suddenly felt two thunderbirds rush out from the clouds, leaving the flock of birds and flying towards the inner side of the god of war wall. He opened his eyes and looked in that direction. He frowned slightly, he took out a special whistle and blew it.
The surrounding Thunderbirds were slightly restless and gathered over. However, the two thunderbirds that had left the flock of birds still flew away without turning their heads.
The bird herder’s expression sank when he saw this. He stopped whistling and his body swayed. He flew out like a transparent soul. His speed was extremely fast and he soon caught up to the two Thunderbirds. He gave a soft cry and was about to raise his hand to capture them.
Suddenly, one of the Thunderbirds turned its head. Its long beak contracted and its furry face transformed into a handsome human face. Its expression was incomparably indifferent. Its pair of pitch-black eyes were extremely indifferent as it let out a soft snort.
“You...”
When the bird herder saw this change, he could not help but be shocked. Before he could speak, he felt his mind suddenly shake, and his consciousness instantly became chaotic.
In the next moment, blood flowed out of the bird herder’s mouth, nose, and eyes. It flowed all over his face like an earthworm. It was terrifying, and his body also collapsed. Just like that, he floated in mid-air and became a floating corpse.
Whoosh!
The two Thunderbirds turned around and flew away without looking back.
A few hours later.
Above the giant wall of Berga.
Two figures flew over from the distant sky. They were like meteorites falling from the clouds. They whizzed over the heads of the guards above the giant wall. Many guards cried out in alarm. Someone immediately reported the scene to the wall master.
Whoosh!
The two of them slowly slowed down when they landed within the giant wall. The strong wind pressure caused the flowers and plants on the ground to bend. It seemed that even the flowers and plants were kneeling to welcome them.
Dudian’s eyes were like stars as he stood in the air. He used all his strength to release his perception. The mechanical heart in his chest quickly operated. His perception easily covered the entire giant wall. Tens of millions of people appeared in his vision, it was like countless red spots. Soon, he found the familiar smell and voice. It was Noyce and Barton.
The next moment, Dudian flew towards Aurora who was the closest to him.
There was a team of cavalrymen standing in front of the mayor’s house in flying snow town. At this moment, the mayor’s house was welcoming the distinguished guests. All the delicacies and wine collected by the mayor were on the table. The mayor personally poured the wine and accompanied them to eat, the distinguished guest was the second miss of the standing family.
The standing family was an old noble in the Phoenix main city. Their territory was extremely large. Flying Snow Town was just a small town that was gathered under their business chain.
The second young miss of the host family passed by, and the mayor had no choice but to welcome her warmly.
“We are tracking the traces of the Ferret Magic Beast. You really don’t Know?”The second young miss was called aiweiya. She was wearing a set of silver lady armor that wrapped her breasts and buttocks perfectly. Her fiery red long hair was slightly curled over her shoulders, there was a hint of arrogance between her brows, which was in stark contrast to the mayor who was smiling apologetically in a burlap robe.
“Second Lady, I have already asked the most experienced hunters in the town. They have not found any traces of the ferret beast near the town. If such a beast were to appear around our town, I’m afraid that many people in the town would have already been sacrificed. However, in the past few months, there has not been any loss of population in the town, so I’m afraid that I won’t be able to help you,”said the mayor with an embarrassed smile.
Aivia nodded slightly and did not say anything more. She picked up the red wine from the mayor’s collection and took a sip. She frowned slightly. The taste was really hard for her to swallow, but the good upbringing of her family prevented her from spitting it out on the spot, in the end, she swallowed it. Looking at the table full of roasted lamb, suckling pig and other dishes, she already felt that it was tasteless. She stood up and said, “Let’s go, Aurora.”
“Yes, miss.”A short-haired girl next to her held a sword and nodded slightly. Her expression was slightly cold.
The mayor was a little surprised. He did not expect that the other party would not eat so much delicious food. However, he did not dare to force her to stay. He quickly went up to her and said, “Second miss, let me send you off.”
Aveya nodded slightly and did not refuse. She led the group of knights out of the door. The collision of the armor and the sword made a crisp sound. It was extremely pleasing to the ear.
Just as she stepped out of the door, Aiweiya raised her head and looked into the distance. This was a habit of hers. Looking into the distance always made her feel that her goal was very far-reaching, however, when she looked into the distance, she suddenly saw two black shadows appear in the sky in the distance. In the next moment, the Black Shadows expanded rapidly. In a short pause of a breath, from the initial tiny outline, she could already see their faces.
A man and a woman, both had near-perfect faces.
“Who is it?”At this moment, the surrounding knight Squires also noticed it. They quickly drew their swords and stood guard beside Aiweiya.
The sword-hugging girl standing beside Aiweiya raised her eyes slightly. Her originally indifferent expression suddenly froze. Her eyes widened slightly, revealing a hint of surprise. Then, a hint of surprise hidden deep in her eyes appeared.
Whoosh!
Two figures whistled and landed in front of the crowd. They looked down at the crowd. The strong wind pressure brought by the wind made everyone feel that the wind was blowing.
Dudian’s indifferent eyes fell on aurora but he didn’t speak.
“You Are...”aivea felt a huge pressure coming from the other side. She was shocked. This pressure was stronger than her teacher’s. She was about to speak when a surprised voice came from behind.
“Teacher.”Aurora shouted in joy. She stepped forward and bowed: “Teacher, you are finally back.”
Aivia was stunned as she saw aurora bow: “Aurora, what nonsense are you talking about? If the teacher hears you, he will not forgive you!”
Aurora did not apologize as she remembered. Instead, she looked up at the youth.
“Did you take him as your teacher?”Dudian asked Aurora.
Aurora bowed her head: “Yes, teacher. But I didn’t really take him as my teacher.”
“Well done.”Dudian nodded. He didn’t blame her.
Aivia and the other knights were stunned. It should be known that Aurora and Aivia were the same. Both of them had taken Phoenix as their teacher and Aivia was proud of it, the Phoenix Lord was one of the abyss experts of the giant wall of Berga. Its position was very high. If word of Aurora’s words got out, they would be skinned alive.
“Are you crazy?”Aivia couldn’t help but shout.
“Where are the others?”Dudian asked.
Aurora replied: “Neuss and the others have gone to other cities. They have stabilized. But your friend Zach seems to have an accident. I don’t know the specific situation. I have been learning from the Phoenix Lord so I rarely have the opportunity to contact them.”
Dudian frowned. He remembered that he didn’t sense Zach’s smell when he sensed the people’s breath. His heart sank. Zach and Macon were his companions when he was a scavenger, although they couldn’t fight side by side but it represented a kind of memory of his childhood.
“Follow me to find them.”Dudian said.
Aurora nodded: “Yes.”
Aivia was confused. She had never left the giant wall. Naturally, she didn’t think that Dudian and Aurora came from the outer wall. If it was any other expert from the abyss, she would be able to guess from the words.
“Aurora, do you know what you are saying? If the teacher hears you, you and he will be finished!”Aivia couldn’t help but pull Aurora.
Dudian seemed to notice aivea but his eyes fell on her beautiful face. He was indifferent: “Is she your friend or an enemy? Are you going to solve it?”
Aurora’s heart jumped: “Teacher, Miss AIVEA is my friend. She is also a student of the Lord of Phoenix. Moreover she is a miss of the Stein family. She has taken good care of me.”
Dudian replied: “Is that so? Since you owe them a favor then give them the city.”
Aurora was shocked as she knew Dudian’s character. Could it be that the teacher wanted to kill the giant wall?
Aiveya was stunned as she heard Dudian’s words. She couldn’t help but laugh. She wanted to open her mouth to ridicule Dudian but Aurora’s reaction was very fast. She quickly covered her mouth and shook her head.
“Let’s go.”Dudian didn’t stay any longer and flew forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1230
chapters.content:

Chapter 1230: Chapter 1219: Death
Translator: 549690339
Aurora’s heart was anxious as she saw Dudian fly away.
“Aurora, are you really going?”Aivia quickly pulled her back. If Aurora left then the news would reach her teacher’s ears. At that time no one would be able to save her.
“Little Ya, I want to follow my teacher. He has promised to give your family a city. Your family will take off in the future.”Aurora pulled away Aivia’s hand and turned to talk to her seriously.
“What City? He is not his majesty. He can’t give people fiefdoms.”Aivia felt that she was bewitched. She wanted to wake her up.
Aurora saw through her thoughts. She didn’t explain much but said: “It’s not a city, it’s a giant wall. My teacher is a great master. You will be able to witness it soon!”
She turned around and ran after Dudian’s back. After a few leaps and bounds, she stepped on the houses in the town and flew up to catch up with him.
Aivia looked at the three figures who had left. She felt that it was a bit absurd. They weren’t giving her a city but a giant wall? To her, this giant wall was the whole world!
A stranger actually said that he would give the world to their family. This was simply crazy!
Soon, she reacted. She glanced at the surrounding knights and squires. She knew that there was no way to hide this matter. The news of Aurora rebelling against the Lord of the Phoenix would soon spread to her teacher’s ears. She couldn’t cover it up, otherwise her family would be implicated. In this case, she could only take the initiative to report this matter.
“I’m sorry, Aurora. You are too muddle-headed...”
..
..
“Teacher, who is this?”Aurora followed Dudian and jumped in the forest. She saw the beautiful girl behind Dudian. Even though she was a girl, she was amazed and couldn’t help but ask, she knew that her teacher had someone in his heart. Moreover, he was deeply in love with her. Could it be that time could smooth out everything? was this the teacher’s new love?
“Her name is WA. She is my son.”Dudian casually introduced her.
“Son?”Aurora was surprised. She thought that Dudian wasn’t married yet. How could he have a son?
However, it was obvious that Dudian didn’t want to talk about it. So she didn’t ask further.
Soon, the two came to the nearest city. Dudian found a hotel and asked Aurora to gather everyone here as soon as possible. It didn’t matter even if her identity was exposed.
Aurora accepted the order and immediately sent a letter through the channels she knew.
“Teacher, are you going to leave this place?”Aurora asked curiously.
Dudian nodded: “I’ll take you to the Imperial City.”
Aurora was surprised. She had collected a lot of information from Phoenix during this period of time. She knew that there were hidden dragons and crouching tigers in the Imperial City. Although the Abyss wasn’t everywhere, but it wasn’t a rare character. The Lord of the Abyss was a giant in the imperial capital. The King of the Abyss was the king who looked down on the entire imperial capital!
In that kind of environment, they could only be more careful with their tails between their legs. They didn’t dare to be angry or make a fuss.
A moment later, Dudian led the people from the giant wall of Sylvia to return.
Neuss, Barton, Mason, Sergei and other familiar faces appeared one after another. Everyone was excited to see Dudian. They felt like rootless duckweed and homeless here, dudian was like the core of their family.
“Master, you are finally here.”
“Dean, you are finally back!”
“We have been waiting for you for a long time. We have done what you asked us to do.”
“I have infiltrated a senior noble family in the West Bay City and served as the captain of their family’s private army...”
In addition to excitement and surprise, everyone took the initiative to tell Dudian about what had happened during this period of time.
Dudian had a faster way to know everything about this place. For example, he could check their memories. But he didn’t do so. He wasn’t in a hurry. He slowly listened to them and waited for others to arrive.
After a few hours, most of the people had arrived. The rest hadn’t arrived yet. Some of them were caught in the struggle and were killed.
“Where is Zach?”Dudian asked Mason.
Mason’s excited expression stiffened as he heard Dudian’s words. He was silent for a moment: “Dean, Zach had infiltrated the army to steal secret information. But he was found...”
He paused for a moment: “He is dead.”
The hall became quiet. Everyone was silent. In addition to Zach, many others had died. However their relationship with Dudian was not as close as that of Zach and dudian.
Although he had expected it but Dudian felt a blow when he heard Mason’s words. He took a deep breath and said: “Since it is a blood debt, we will use blood to pay it back!”
Mason’s face slightly changed: “Dean, don’t be impulsive. There is more than one abyss expert in the giant wall of Berga. We are outnumbered so we will suffer big losses. We will come back to take revenge when our strength increases!”
Dudian looked at him: “You are mature.”
Mason wryly smiled: “You have seen so many things. If you are not mature then you are a retard.”
Dudian stood up and looked at Sergei, Neuss, Aurora and the others, he said: “I have called you here to take you to the imperial capital. I will take you there to witness and train your courage and mind. In the future when I get the world, you will enjoy endless wealth and power. You have to have a high position. This is a training for you!”
Everyone was stunned. They looked at each other and wondered if their ears were playing tricks on them.
Attack the Imperial City?
Many of them already knew what kind of monster the imperial city was. Even if it was a giant wall under the empire, it would be hard for them to breathe, let alone the Imperial City which was as deep as the abyss?
Dudian saw everyone’s expression. He knew what they were thinking but didn’t care. It was because he knew the limitations of their thinking that he was able to find them and bring them to the imperial city before he killed the Devil Emperor, he would be able to see the wider world so that he wouldn’t be intimidated by the imposing manner of his subordinates.
It could be said that this move was well thought out.
“Young master, the capital is very different from the giant wall...”Neuss looked at Dudian and carefully advised him. He was a bit disappointed. In his heart, the young master had always been a mastermind, he had never made such a reckless mistake.
“Don’t worry. I know the situation of the imperial city. A king can be destroyed in a snap of the fingers.”Dudian interrupted him as he looked at the crowd, “My current strength is not the same as before. The Abyss is not worthy to carry my shoes. You just need to relax and follow me to conquer this world. In the future, you will manage the world for me.”
Everyone looked at each other in disbelief.
Some of Noyce’s trusted aides couldn’t help but guess in their hearts. Could it be that the master had something wrong with his mind? However, they didn’t dare to say these words.
“Come, follow me to the capital.”Dudian didn’t continue to say anything as he walked out of the hall.
The hotel was booked by Aurora and the entire hall was filled with their people. At this moment as Dudian walked out, everyone split up and followed him.
After leaving the hotel, Dudian didn’t care about anything as he transformed into wings on the street. He took off and caused the surrounding passers-by to exclaim.
Neuss couldn’t help but pull aurora and whispered: “You are the first one to see the young master. Do you think he is normal?”
Aurora rolled her eyes, “Don’t you feel that teacher’s momentum is far from what it used to be? I think his strength shouldn’t be too difficult to kill the abyss. Maybe he has reached the King’s strength in the imperial capital.”
Neuss was startled: “It is possible.”
“Let’s go.”Aurora said.
Neuss and Mason led the others to catch up with Dudian. Some of them had the ability to fly while others were jumping on the ground, they jumped from the many buildings in the city and went straight to the capital of the giant wall of Berga.
The mayor of the city was alarmed by this scene. He sent the commander of the city guards to block the city. He saw Dudian flying over and immediately stopped him. However Dudian didn’t stop, the commander of the City Guards was hit by the air. He was sent flying back. It was unknown whether he was alive or dead.
Dudian flew out of the city and went straight to the capital city. He went over mountains and ridges and rushed into one city after another. The guards in the city came to question him. He was sent flying without any obstruction.

Chapter 1231: Chapter 1220: Palm Falls
Translator: 549690339
Dudian led Neuss and the others to the giant wall. They saw that the border of the giant wall was heavily guarded. There were many pioneers who were lined up like javelins on the giant wall, the leader was a group of inner wilderness and master level generals. It seemed that they knew the direction where Dudian and the others were coming from. The other sides of the city were not so heavily guarded. Only the south side was so guarded.
Neuss and the others saw the situation. Their faces slightly changed. They were ready to stop but saw that Dudian was still flying forward. He didn’t slow down at all.
“Who is coming?”A leader in golden armor stood in the air. His eyes were cold and cold. He looked down at the people who were flying towards him.
“You don’t deserve to know.”
Dudian’s face was indifferent. He put his hands behind his back and rushed forward like a rainbow. It seemed that he didn’t care about the soldiers on the top of the city wall.
The golden-armored chief commander’s face turned cold. The bat-like wings on his back expanded and his teeth turned into fangs. His face was distorted. He was transforming into a demon body when a cold light shot out from his body, he felt a sense of extreme danger locked onto his body. He was so scared that he couldn’t move.
At this moment, he felt that the heat from his body was taken away from his glabella.
Bang!
The golden-armored master fell from the sky. His half-demonized body fell onto the city wall. His armor fell to the ground with a tinkling sound.
“Get lost!”Dudian looked at the city wall indifferently. It was his first time to attack. He raised his hand and waved it. His palm was demonized to hundreds of meters in size. It swept across the city wall as if it was smoothing the dust on the table.
Many of the pioneers and wasteland generals were stunned. Before they could react, they felt as if their bodies were hit by a huge mountain. An unstoppable force pushed them and sent them flying, their heads were in a mess.
Dudian waved his hand and the huge palm quickly retracted. It seemed that the previous scene was just an illusion.
He didn’t stop at all.
This scene shocked the soldiers who were hundreds of meters away from the city wall. Neuss and the others were stunned. What kind of magic marks ability was this?
In their knowledge, no magic marks had such an ability.
After a short moment of shock, everyone reacted. They were excited as they thought of what Dudian had said. They quickly followed up. The hundreds of meters tall city wall was easily climbed by them.
The generals and guards who were far away from the wall finally came back to their senses. One of them shouted in anger. Everyone immediately used their demonization ability and rushed towards Neuss and the others.
“You don’t know my tolerance!”Dudian frowned. He didn’t wait for Neuss and the others to make a move. He raised his hand and his palm rapidly expanded into a crescent-shaped giant scythe. It was hundreds of meters long and it cut down diagonally, bang! A giant scar was cut on the ancient capital city wall. The city guards were cut from the top to the bottom of the city!
In his eyes it was a casual attack but in the eyes of others it was a shocking attack!
The other city guards who rushed over were shocked. They didn’t dare to think about such a terrifying power!
However this time Dudian didn’t take back the scythe. He casually hacked several times. The entire south wall was cut into several gullies. Even the people far away could clearly see it.
The surviving guards stood in place and didn’t dare to act rashly.
Dudian took back the scythe and continued to fly forward.
Neuss and the others weren’t less shocked than the other guards. They finally saw Dudian’s strength. It was far from what they had seen when they left. Everyone was surprised and excited as they tried their best to keep up with him.
The civilians in the capital city hadn’t heard about this yet. They were surprised to see a large number of strong people jumping up and down. The security in the capital city was very strict, such a scene had never happened before.
Some noble carriages were trampled on. The young ladies and Young Masters jumped out and cursed. However the perpetrators had already taken off and left the place.
Dudian led the way. In less than ten minutes they arrived in front of the palace of the capital. There were a lot of guards gathered outside the palace. The fall of the city wall had been known for a long time.
There were countless guards on both sides of the palace. Each guard was a pioneer level warrior. There were three extraordinary figures standing in front of them. One of them was wearing a black and gold robe. His chin was slightly raised, it seemed that he habitually looked down at the crowd. There was a white-haired old man and a mature woman in a red dress.
“Teacher!”Aurora’s pupils shrank when she saw the woman in the red dress. She didn’t expect that her teacher would come to the capital to help the wall master.
Dudian flew to the top of the palace. Everyone had to look up. He looked down at the many experts gathered in front of the palace. He indifferently said: “Who is the wall master? Come out.”
Although his tone was calm but there was an unquestionable dignity.
“How dare you!”A middle-aged man dressed in a royal robe stepped out from behind the three of them. His body flew backward and crashed into the wall of the palace.
This unexpected change made everyone’s face change. The three leaders couldn’t hold back their expressions. Their expressions turned cold as they looked at Dudian. There was a bit of fear in their eyes, how did Dudian make his move.
They had never heard of such a strange ability but they could deduce that he was from outside the giant wall!
“Which giant wall are you from? Or are you from the imperial capital?”The leader of the middle-aged men asked in a calm tone.
Dudian’s eyes fell on him, he indifferently said: “You are a wall master? You are at the middle level of the abyss. You are slightly stronger than the two beside you. I will give you 15 minutes to hand over the person who is in charge of the punishment and guarding the secrets.”
“Why are you looking for them? Did they offend you?”The middle-aged man frowned. There was a trace of vigilance in his eyes. Dudian was able to see through his strength, but he was still calm. It was obvious that he wasn’t afraid of him.
“Eh?”Dudian’s eyes fell on the middle-aged man. After a moment he slowly said: “It seems that you don’t cherish this quarter of an hour. In that case, you should die early.”
“What?”The middle-aged man was startled. He didn’t expect that Dudian would fall out with him. There were at least three abysses on their side. The next moment he saw Dudian raise his hand. His palm suddenly changed to hundreds of meters in size, it was like a huge mountain that blocked the light above their heads. The shadow fell down along with the palm.
The people in front of the palace were shocked. Although they knew about the fall of the city wall but they hadn’t seen the battle with their own eyes. Dudian’s ability was completely different from what they had imagined, it was completely different from the magic marks ability!
The palm was still the appearance of a human hand but its size was terrifying!
The middle-aged man was shocked but he quickly recovered. His eyes flashed with anger and killing intent. He roared and suddenly soared into the sky. His body was demonized and his robe was torn apart. He turned into a seven or eight meters long dragonman, he looked like an ancient Jurassic dinosaur but had a pair of wings on his back. There were sharp horns on his forehead. He looked up at the sky and roared. At the same time, he spat out a blazing flame.
Even the Phoenix Overlord, who was also an expert in fire, was afraid of the flames that could melt steel.
Sou!
The Flames shot into the palm of the giant palm, but the burning sensation did not appear immediately. The giant palm continued to press down with unstoppable force.
When the surrounding people saw this, they all fled in shock.
“Impossible! !”The black-gold-robed middle-aged man was shocked. His flames were actually ineffective?
In the next moment, he realized that something was wrong and prepared to retreat. However, his palm covered hundreds of meters and covered the entire front hall of the palace. He had no time to escape from the range of his palm and could only drill into the ground!
Boom!
The huge palm slammed down and the earth shook!
The Magnificent Palace Hall that was inlaid with gold was smashed into ashes and dust. Countless dust flew out from the cracks of his fingers. The stairs that were a thousand layers high were also smashed into pieces, leaving an extremely deep palm print!
The next moment, the giant palm shrank and became smaller and smaller. It disappeared into the dust. In a moment, the palm was raised from the dust and shrunk to more than ten meters. Two fingers were holding a seven or eight meters large object, it was the demonized draconic man!
The thick thumb and forefinger were holding his dragon head. The lower half of his body fell down and fainted. He was floating in the air. Dudian gently shook twice. The demonized tentacles between his fingers pierced into his brain to search for memories, soon he finished reading.
After he finished reading, his fingers exerted a bit of strength. The skull of the dragon head cracked and blood flowed out. He died on the spot.

Chapter 1232: Chapter 1221: Imperial capital
Translator: 549690339
The guards and generals outside the palace were stunned.
Neuss and Aurora were shocked as they looked at the corpse of the giant wall that had fallen into the dust. Such a talented person was killed by Dudian with a flip of his palm. He was like an ant!
Dudian raised his hand to show his extraordinary strength. All the surviving guards and generals outside the palace were stunned. No one dared to go forward. No one wanted to avenge the death of the giant wall.
Whoosh!
A red figure flew out from the edge of the dust. It was the Lord of Phoenix. She had sensed the danger when the giant palm fell. She had dodged in advance and luckily passed by the edge of the palm.
It was hard to believe her eyes when she saw Dudian pick out the wall master and crush him. However she had been in a high position for a long time and her mind was firm. She quickly reacted and rushed out of the dust. She knew that.., there was no use for her to hide in front of such a person. It would only accelerate her death. She might as well take the initiative to surrender.
“My Lord, please forgive me.”The Lord of Phoenix kneeled in the Void. Her heart trembled as she was afraid that Dudian would raise his hand to kill her.
Dudian indifferently glanced at her. There were three abysses in total including the wall master. The other white bearded old man tried to resist the palm of the wall master but was smashed into meat paste. However this old man had dodged in advance.., however she wasn’t his main target so he was too lazy to kill her.
“Since you are aware of your sin then you should leave.”Dudian indifferently said.
Phoenix’s heart relaxed. She bowed her head and retreated to the side. She looked at her toes. Because of her lowered head she saw many figures following Dudian. She saw a familiar figure. wasn’t he her latest student?
“Aurora?”Phoenix lord was slightly startled.
Dudian closed his eyes and opened them again. He indifferently said: “It’s all in the imperial city. I Won’t have to look for it.”He suddenly raised his hand. His arm grew up to a height of thousands of meters, his hand clenched into a fist. Diamond-shaped crystals appeared on the surface of his hand. Under the refraction of the sunlight, dozens of beams of light suddenly shot out. They were like laser beams that swept towards the buildings outside the palace.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
All the areas were shaken and filled with dust. It was as if they had been hit by a rocket.
Dudian retracted his palm and turned around. He said to Neuss and others: “Let’s go. Prepare to leave.”Through the memory of the wall master, Dudian had killed all the military personnel involved in Zach, there was nothing left to think about.
Everyone looked at each other. They thought of what Dudian had said before. He wanted to kill the people in the capital. They couldn’t help but feel excited. Some people felt that it was good to kill the wall master and occupy the magpie’s nest, why should they continue to fight and kill? But they didn’t dare to express their thoughts.
Dudian thought of something before he left, he turned to Phoenix lord: “There is only one abyss left. I promised a little girl that I would give this giant wall to her. You will supervise this matter. From now on, you will protect the little girl’s family. Do you understand?”
Phoenix lord was shocked. How could he give away such a huge giant wall? She saw that Dudian’s expression was indifferent and didn’t seem to be lying. She couldn’t help but ask: “I don’t know who you are talking about.”
Dudian didn’t answer but looked at Aurora.
Aurora quickly went forward and loudly said: “Lord, my teacher is talking about Aivia.”
Phoenix lord heard her voice. Although he had noticed her but he didn’t expect that she and Dudian’s identity was teacher-student relationship. His face changed as he heard Aurora address him, she understood the situation and couldn’t help but feel bitter. In fact, she was very fond of this new student. She didn’t expect that the latter didn’t really treat her as a teacher.
She had such a powerful person as a teacher so why would she need her?
She was a Lord after all so she didn’t bother about these things. She nodded: “I know. I will do as you say.”
Dudian turned around and flew away with God wa. Neuss and others followed after him.
Lord Phoenix looked at the back of these people. She vaguely guessed that she was able to survive from Dudian’s hands. Maybe the latter had seen through her identity, he had let her go because of Aurora’s face.
How long had it been since she had to rely on the face of her students to survive?
There were no obstructions along the way when Dudian and the others left the imperial city. Half a day later they left the giant wall of Borja and stepped into the wilderness area.
That night they officially entered the Abyss area which the giant wall of Borja hadn’t cleared out.
The night sky was clear and the stars were bright. The ruins of the Abyss area were lit up as if it was daytime.
They settled down in a forest and ate the food they had brought with them. They rested for half a night before continuing on their journey.
With the protection of Dudian and Wa, all the abyss monsters they encountered along the way were killed. The Dangerous Abyss seemed to be like a spring outing. Everyone followed behind them as they looked at the mysterious Abyss area, they saw the ruins of the old era. The buildings had collapsed in the wilderness and were covered in moss. They saw a lot of old era historic sites. They felt very novel.
Dudian saw a flying dragon flying in the air. He raised his hand and shot it down.
The Flying Dragon jumped out of the abyss. He didn’t have the time to shout as he was shot by a ray of light.
“This is the architect of the Flying Dragon. He is the representative of the Empire.”Dudian explained to everyone. He had people dissect the flying dragon and roast the dragon meat for lunch.
After a few days they came to the imperial capital.
They met a lot of monsters along the way. Some of them were named monsters. Dudian hunted an ancient monster and took out the soul worm. He gave it to Neuss and others to seal, it would help them to quickly improve their physique.
“We will disguise as an adventurer team of the empire. Don’t expose our identity.”Dudian said. Although his current strength was enough to break into the imperial capital but he didn’t want to alarm the Devil Emperor. The latter wasn’t a good-for-nothing like the lord of Berga, the Devil Emperor might not be in the imperial capital at the moment or he would be waiting for him in an ambush.
Everyone believed in Dudian’s words and didn’t have any objections.
