Chapter 1233: Chapter 1222: ability to become a god
Translator: 549690339
Imperial city.
The majestic giant wall seemed to go straight to the sky. It was much taller than the other giant walls that Dudian had seen. He remembered that the giant wall was the tomb of the Aragami. If that was the case then ordinary Aragami were buried in the giant wall, the people buried in the imperial city were the ancestors of the Aragami.
“Although the Aragami buried in the giant wall are ordinary Aragami, but they are also top experts in the Aragami clan. The real strength of the ordinary Aragami is weak. They are not much different from the pioneers. They are not enough to help the giant wall to suppress the monsters.”Dudian’s eyes lit up, killing the demon lord was a small matter for him. He was interested in the countless secrets buried in the imperial capital.
These secrets were related to the Aragami clan. It was something that Lin Changsheng didn’t have in his memory.
After a moment, they approached the giant wall. From the memory of the Lord of Berga, Dudian knew about the appearance of the imperial capital. After all, the latter had once rode a flying dragon to serve in the imperial capital.
Soon, Dudian led Neuss and others to the east of the imperial capital. The giant wall of the imperial capital was like the other giant walls. It was square in shape. The difference was that the east, south, west and north sides of the imperial capital.., each giant wall was four or five hundred kilometers away from each other. It could be seen how vast the imperial city was. It was more than enough to accommodate more than one billion people.
Dudian and God wa slowly landed in front of a giant gate in the east. They walked in step with Neuss and others. There were few forests in the vicinity. Along the way they could see some good armor discarded in the soil, some of them were broken armors. Some of them were buried with their owners.
Dudian had never been to the capital city but he was familiar with it. He knew that the capital city was a military city. Ordinary civilians were used to hunters, hunters were just dirty tools of the aristocracy.
In the capital city, hunters were a profession. They were more noble than lawyers, doctors and clergy.
Of course, ordinary hunters were too common. They couldn’t be compared to some famous doctors and lawyers. But at the level of ruler and Abyss, they were considered as the number one figure in the capital city, even the top lawyers didn’t dare to look down on such a person. Of course, they wouldn’t be too afraid.
After all, top lawyers and doctors were all loyal to kings or ancient families, so they naturally didn’t fear the ordinary abyss.
And the Lord of the abyss above them could already be considered a colossus in the imperial capital. To them, wealth and power had already reached their limits. The only existences they needed to fear were the seven kings and the Demon Emperor.
The Seven Kings were like seven dazzling stars looking down on the imperial capital. To the commoners, they were like gods on the clouds. They felt extremely honored to be able to see them. As for the Devil Emperor, his presence was weak and hidden. He was far less dazzling than the seven kings. But in the eyes of the top power giants, the fear of the Devil Emperor was ten times stronger than facing the Seven Kings!
Dudian made everyone dress up. He wrapped the few monsters that he had killed along the way. He carried them on his shoulders as if they were hunting items. Then he slowly walked towards the giant gate.
The giant gate of the Imperial City was open all year round. The imperial city was a military city so there were a lot of hunters. There were a lot of independent adventurers and Adventurers Guild. They often formed groups to hunt monsters, they could bring the monsters back to the imperial city and sell them to the monster research institute and some related institutions. They could also earn some money by selling the scales on the monsters back to the blacksmith shop.
In addition to the independent adventurers, the Seven Kings would often lead an army to the depths of the wilderness to kill ferocious monsters. They would train the combat ability of the army. There were iron hoofs and messy footprints everywhere near the giant gate, the air was filled with the smell of metal and human sweat.
Dudian saw another group of adventurers returning to the capital city as they approached the giant gate. There were twenty to thirty of them. Each of them was carrying a huge backpack. It seemed that they were carrying the corpses of the monsters they had killed.
Dudian saw the adventurers. There was a trace of vigilance in their eyes. The gate was the most chaotic place. The guards didn’t care about the things outside the gate so many people were lying in ambush outside the gate, they were bullying the weak.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The ground suddenly trembled.
Dudian sensed that a group of beast riders rushed out from the gate. They passed through the long passage of the gate and appeared in front of everyone’s eyes. They were a group of knights wearing silver helmets and dark silver armor, the design of the helmets was very strange. There were spikes sticking out. Only a pair of cold eyes could be seen from the armor. The chest of each armor was engraved with a blood jungle pattern.
Dudian knew that this was the badge of the King of Blood Jing.
This knight was also a subordinate of the Silver Moon Legion under the command of the King of Blood Jing. It was a subsidiary Legion of the Ace Legion and belonged to the reserve camp.
“The king of Blood Jing has died in the Federation. It seems that the King of Blood Jing hasn’t disbanded. There are too many kings who have fallen in the federation. The capital city will fall into chaos. The forces and territories under the king will become ownerless. The other hungry wolves and vultures will be eyeing them.”Dudian’s eyes lit up, he thought about the current situation of the capital city. The fall of the king would cause the situation of the capital city to be unstable. It would also cause a chain reaction among the grassroots.
This was a period of turmoil. The devil not only had to guard against his arrival but also had to clean up the situation of the imperial city.
Dudian’s mouth slightly curved as he led Neuss and the others into the city. As they passed by the guards, he threw a handful of special gold coins to the guards, they went straight into the city.
The gold coins weren’t taken from the Wall Master of Berga. He had used the soil on the ground to transform them into gold. However scientists needed to use instruments to change the structure of the material, he could directly change the structure of his body through demonization and then assimilate the structure of the foreign objects. He could then change the structure of the foreign objects into the things he wanted.
He could use a weed to demonize swords and other objects.
This was his current ability. In terms of the application of his ability, he was equivalent to a God!
The only difference between him and a true God was the size of the power. For example, the WA God could devour foreign objects and convert them into its own energy. Although he could do it, but the latter could convert ten tons at a time. He could at most convert less than half a ton, he would also suffer from indigestion.
After entering the city, Dudian saw the imperial city which was not much different from what Crimson Moon remembered. It was bustling, lively, and the security was tight. The buildings were strange and magnificent. Most of the people wandering around the giant gate were hunters. There were few ordinary civilians, there were small shops everywhere. They were selling the organs and scales of some monsters. There were also some small shops selling information and maps.
Dudian had slept for 300 years. The capital city was built after the disaster. It had been more than 200 years since the beginning of the disaster. The culture of hunting monsters had developed to the extreme.
Dudian wasn’t in a hurry to find the Devil Emperor. He took Neuss and others to travel around the city. They came to a bustling residential city near the capital city to eat and drink, they then took Neuss and others to the hunting market where soul worms were sold.
There were shops selling soul worms everywhere in every city. However these shops weren’t private shops but like franchisees. They belonged to the alliance under the soul worm industry operated by the Seven Kings.
All Soul Worms were sold with legal rights. Private selling of Soul Worms was an illegal act. If caught they would be sentenced to death.
There were places where Soul Worms were sold. There were shops that sold all kinds of Hunter’s equipment. It was not a secret to use five soul worms to strengthen their magic marks, it was public information.
Dudian saw the banner of the Blood Jing King hanging on the square. He knew that this place was an industry of the Blood Jing King. He made a Blood Jing King’s order and went to the Chamber of Commerce.

Chapter 1234: Chapter 1223: change
Translator: 549690339
The interior of the Chamber of Commerce was spacious like a giant mall. There were many independent shops as soon as they entered the building. There were different kinds of soul worms hanging outside. Some specialized in the business of Power Type Soul Worms, some specialized in the business of Latent Soul Worms. Some directly hung the name of a legendary soul worm which attracted the attention of many passers-by.
Dudian led Neuss and the others to the second floor. They didn’t look at the ground floor. There were shops run by noble families. The real good things were on the second and third floor, there were shops run by kings. The prices were reasonable and were equivalent to the official prices. The soul worms were genuine and genuine. There were no false packaging.
The environment on the second floor was much quieter than the ground floor. However there were still many strong hunters wandering around.
Dudian brought Neuss and the others to a shop. The servant’s eyes lit up as she saw the large number of people. She knew that a big business was coming.
“Sir, what type of soul worms do you want to see?”
Dudian took out the blood thorn token: “Let your manager come out.”
The servant’s face changed as she saw the blood thorn token. She respectfully stepped back and informed the owner of the shop. Soon she contacted the manager of the Merchant Union.
The manager of the merchant union was a middle-aged man. He was wearing a suit. His expression changed as he saw Dudian’s blood thorn token: “What do you need?”
“Prepare a batch of polar ice insects for me. Count them according to the number of people here.”Dudian ordered.
The middle-aged steward was startled. He glanced at Neuss and others behind dudian, he said: “My Lord, let’s not talk about the unusual period. Even if it is an ordinary period, the polar ice insects are under strict control. I’m afraid...”
“Unusual period?”Dudian looked at him: “Let me see.”He stretched out his arm and grabbed the middle-aged steward’s forehead. The inner part of his finger stretched out a tentacle and pierced into the steward’s head to read his memory.
The surrounding assistants and maids were frightened. They were about to shout out but Dudian’s mind moved. Several serpents like tentacles swept out from his arm and strangled the steward’s neck.
After a few breaths dudian withdrew his hand and said to the middle-aged steward: “Send all the ice worms that can be mobilized in this area.”
“Yes, my Lord.”The middle-aged steward replied. Dudian had tampered with his memory and made him a servant.
A moment later, three ice worms and more than a dozen legendary soul worms were sent to Dudian. There were only two two-star soul worms and the rest were one-star legendary soul worms. Dudian asked Mason, Aurora and Sergei to choose their favorite legendary soul worms. He gave them three ice worms and helped them to subdue them. Soon.., three Abyss experts were born in this commercial building.
Fighting skills needed to be tempered but the body needed resources to evolve.
When Dudian gave the soul worms to the three of them, he suddenly wondered if he could use his own ability to duplicate polar ice worms and replace the needs of Polar Ice Worms? If so, it meant that he could duplicate the king of Polar Ice Worms!
He could even duplicate a copy of the fighting memory and inject it into the brain of Neuss and the others so that they could gain rich fighting experience in an instant!
Dudian was shocked by this idea. If he could do it, it meant that he could build a world-shaking strong army!
It was very possible that he could do it!
Dudian did as he thought. He had the manager of the Chamber of Commerce lock down the commercial building and empty everyone. Only Neuss and the others were left. Then he tried to control his body and duplicate it from the genetic level to create the polar ice worm.
Soon, an ice worm hatched in his palm. It was a part of his body’s genes. He cut off the connection with the polar ice worm so that it could become an independent life form!
However, although this polar ice worm had all the external characteristics of the polar ice worm, it seemed to have no life and didn’t move.
“The polar ice worm doesn’t have a heart. Its structure is more complicated than the human body. It would be easy for me to create a heart. However, all the cells in the polar ice worm’s body are equivalent to a heart. It can continue to evolve and reproduce. The cells that I have constructed can no longer reproduce without my control.”Dudian frowned, the polar ice worm that he had constructed could be considered a real polar ice worm.
However, the polar ice worm would die as soon as its connection with him was cut off.
Its life span was only for an instant.
“How to give it life?”Dudian felt that it was a big problem. However, if he could solve this problem, it meant that his previous conjecture was no longer hindered. He could build a strong army in an instant!
“If I want them to live forever, I have to create a consciousness in their body so that this consciousness can drive the body to continuously operate...”soon, Dudian’s mind was fast enough to think of a breakthrough, he immediately weaved a memory and sent it into the body of the polar ice worm. Not long after, the polar ice worm slowly crawled up like a Snow White Snake. It swam to Dudian’s feet and rubbed his pants.
Dudian’s eyes lit up. It was really feasible!
Not to mention whether the polar ice worm could be implanted into the human body and replace the real polar ice worm. The current situation meant that Dudian could not only change the structure of metals, coal and other materials, can also create living life!
You know, the Polar Ice Bug is more complex than human structure, now the polar ice bug can be made, does that mean, also can make people? !
If so, how is that different from a true God?
Forgetting Noyce and the others around him, he moved excitedly, multiplying extra cells through his own cells, and moving them to his palm to form a human-like body, then he created a beating heart.
When he cut off the connection, the young man who was made of flesh and blood from his palm stood in a daze. His eyes were empty but his body was emitting a surging vitality!
Life!
Dudian was so excited that he suddenly stood up.
Neuss, Aurora and the others as well as their trusted subordinates saw this strange scene. They were stunned and in disbelief. In addition to shock, they also felt a bit of fear!
Dudian excitedly looked around the young man who was created. He used his X-ray vision to scan every bone and meridian in his body. He found that all the structures in his body were no different from a human’s.
The young man was also looking at Dudian. His eyes were blank. He suddenly raised his hand and touched Dudian. It seemed that he wanted to touch the world.
Dudian grabbed his hand. The young man immediately tried to break free but his strength was incomparable to Dudian’s. He couldn’t break free. The young man was a bit anxious. He used all his strength to twist his body, but he couldn’t change it. He suddenly opened his mouth and bit towards Dudian’s hand.
Dudian let go of his hand.
He wasn’t afraid that the young man would bite him but that the test had been completed.
“Although I didn’t create memories for him, but he was born with primitive instincts. It seems that he is like a giant baby...”Dudian’s eyes lit up, this young man was an independent life form!
Creating life..
It was incredible to think that he could easily accomplish such a thing!
“It turns out that the myths and legends are not all false. God is omnipotent. He can create things and create people...”Dudian muttered to himself. At this moment, he truly experienced the feeling of being a god.
So wanton and so powerful!
At the same time, he suddenly felt that human beings were not so great and life was not so precious!

Chapter 1235: Chapter 1224: insect memory
Translator: 549690339
“Neuss, he will follow you in the future. You will be responsible for teaching him.”Dudian handed the dazed young man over to Neuss. He wanted to see the life that he had created, it was very different from a real human.
After all, it was a life that was constructed based on his impression of humans. The only difference was that the vitality of this life was equivalent to that of a pioneer. However, there were no magic marks in the body but pure physical strength.
Neuss was stunned: “Young Master, this... This is your ability?”
“Almost.”Dudian smiled, “In the future when you come into contact with more things you will know that the ability is not a single thing. It is the key to develop your own potential.”
Neuss, Aurora and the others didn’t understand. In any case, they felt that Dudian’s ability was incredible. He was able to create polar ice insects and people out of thin air! Such a method was like the creator in the Legends!
Dudian picked up the polar ice insects that were close to his feet. He thought that since he could create polar ice insects, it would be easy for him to create legendary soul insects, he picked out a few types of legendary soul worms and asked the dark skinned woman what she liked and what she was good at.
The dark skinned woman replied in fear. She liked to fight head on and was good at violence.
Dudian picked out a type of legendary soul worm that focused on strength. He quickly duplicated the structure and quickly created six similar legendary soul worms. These soul worms were different from the ice worm, there was a unique digestive system and brain nerves in the body. When Dudian constructed them, these organs would automatically operate the body. It was a living life.
Dudian let the dark skinned woman continuously absorb and replace the original magic marks in her body. After a moment, her physique was upgraded from pioneer to master level. Then he prepared the polar ice worms and implanted them into her body.
It didn’t take long for the dark skinned woman’s physique to be upgraded again. She had become an abyss!
“It’s really effective!”Dudian’s eyes were filled with joy. He had guessed and looked forward to the success when the legendary soul worm was created to upgrade the dark skinned woman’s physique to master level, he was pleasantly surprised. This meant that he didn’t need to rely on any external force. He was a huge treasure house. He could create a large number of legendary soul worms and polar ice bugs to mass create a powerful abyss!
Moreover, he could fabricate fighting memories and input them into other people’s minds. He didn’t need ten years of hard training to become a strong Master!
“I’m Omnipotent!”Dudian couldn’t help but laugh. Now that he had absolute power in his hands, his character seemed to have been released. He was no longer as depressed as before, he was much more flamboyant. Neuss who was most familiar with Dudian was very sensitive to this point. He was surprised but didn’t think too much about it.
“Not only can I cultivate the abyss but I can also cultivate a king. It is not difficult to cultivate another god if I want to. However, only a fool would do such a thing.”Dudian’s face was full of smiles, this matter gave him great confidence. Such a powerful ability, the whole world was not worth mentioning to him. He didn’t even care about the coming extraterrestrial worm.
His only hope was to find Aisha as soon as possible. With his current means, he might be able to easily cure the zombie virus in her body and help her find the memories of these years.
Thinking of this, he felt his blood boiling. He couldn’t wait to move or use his eyes to scan every inch of soil in the empire to find Aisha.
However, even with his god-like ability, he couldn’t spread his perception to the entire empire. It would be extremely difficult to cover the entire empire.
“Neuss, give me the polar ice worm king.”Dudian said to Neuss.
Dudian had given Neuss the polar ice worm king which he had caught from the bottom of the Ice Dragon Lake. Now that he had left the giant wall of Berga, he had brought it along with him. It was sealed in a transparent alloy jar and wrapped in black cloth, neuss’s trusted aide carried it.
Neuss nodded and ordered his men to deliver the polar ice worm king.
Dudian opened the black cloth. He tore a crack in the solid alloy jar. Milk white meat slid out of the crack and squeezed out like a soft body, after a moment all of it was lost to the floor outside the jar.
The polar ice worm king collapsed on the ground but it seemed to sense something. It immediately drilled into the ground and prepared to escape.
Dudian’s palm grew bigger and grabbed it.
“King of Polar Ice Worm? Hehe, it is just a source worm of the polar ice worm clan. There are at least 80,000 source worms like you who were born in the ice pool.”Dudian smiled and casually said.
The king of polar ice worm heard Dudian’s words. It suddenly stopped and a lump of mucus turned into mouth and eyes. It looked at dudian in horror: “How do you know about this?”
“I know more than you think.”Dudian looked at it, “I am a bit curious. The Blood Moon has appeared twice in the past 300 years. Your Race has come to Earth twice but why are you still hiding at the bottom of the lake? Your spaceship should be able to send and receive signals but they didn’t come to pick you up. Are they abandoning you or are they afraid of the Aragami of the Empire?”
Polar Ice worm king was startled: “Blood Moon? My race has been here twice? How is it possible? If they came to Earth, how could they not come to find me? You are talking nonsense!”
“Eh?”Dudian was surprised. This polar ice worm king didn’t know about this? He suddenly felt that there was something strange and other reasons. He thought for a moment and directly pierced into its body to read its memory.
The ice worm king felt the tentacles that Dudian had pierced into its body. It quickly resisted but found that all parts of its body had been invaded. It seemed that an unknown power had entered its body and resonated with its body, it was difficult for it to distinguish which part of its body belonged to itself. Obviously, this strange feeling came from the human in front of it.
It was extremely shocked. How could this human grow so terrifying in such a short time?
A moment later, Dudian finally understood the reason. The memory of the polar ice insect king was an eye-opener for him. It turned out that the alien insects were not only divided into ice insects and flame insects but were natural enemies of each other, the ice insects and flame insects of the same race were not one piece of iron. They were like humans. There were different factions and each faction was loyal to a different great sage.
The polar ice insect king in front of him was one of the twelve ice insects that were loyal to the great sage.
The polar ice insect king was like a general of the human race. There were many such generals. Each of them controlled a spaceship and invaded Earth.
“The twelve great sages cooperated to invade Earth and capture the humans as the materials to become gods. They hoped to cultivate gods and destroy the flame insects and the Aragami race. Unfortunately the changes in the war caused a crack in the alliance of the Great Sages. The explosion of the nuclear weapons gave a fatal blow to the magic insects. Many great sages withdrew from Earth...”
Dudian was able to see more clearly about the war three hundred years ago. Layers of fog had cleared out in front of his eyes. The planet that was once covered with human footprints had become a planet filled with monsters. The main culprit and the various purposes behind it.., all of them had come to the surface.
“It seems that the great sage that you are loyal to is most likely dead.”Dudian smiled, “In this case, the other surviving magic insects should be the ones controlling the federation. I don’t know how many or only one.”
The ice worm king looked at him in fear: “Your... Your body is different from before. You have the smell of Aragami. No, it is stronger than Aragami!”
“I’ll give this to you. The taste should be good.”Dudian didn’t answer it. After exploring its memory, it had lost any value to him. It was the most suitable reward for God wa.
God wa smiled sweetly like a pure and beautiful girl. However there was a bit of hunger in her eyes which made her expression a bit strange. This was the first time that Neuss and others saw the change in the expression of this beautiful girl. Many people were stunned. However the next moment, God wa suddenly opened her mouth. Her beautiful red lips suddenly expanded to a few meters, she swallowed the ice worm.
This scene was so fast that the people who were in a daze almost screamed out in fear.
God Nuwa’s face was full of enjoyment. She licked her tongue and smiled at the crowd.
Many people couldn’t help but step back in fear.
Neuss and Aurora were also scared. But they had been following Dudian for the longest time. Their courage had been trained to be incomparably strong. Although they were scared out of their wits but they quickly regained their calm.

Chapter 1236: Chapter 1225: killing the emperor
Translator: 549690339
Dudian slowly closed his eyes as the body structure of the polar ice worm king appeared in his mind. The next moment, his body split into a mass of flesh and blood. After ten minutes.., the mass of flesh and blood gradually changed into the appearance of the polar ice worm king.
When the last step was completed, a polar ice worm king appeared in front of Dudian. When the connection with it was cut off, its body also stopped moving as if it was dead.
Dudian didn’t enter its memory this time. He didn’t need a live polar ice worm king to work for it. He just needed to use its body to bring strength to Neuss and others.
Dudian’s construction speed was getting faster and faster. In the blink of an eye he had created a set of resources that could allow people to evolve from the Abyss to the king stage.
Dudian gave it to Neuss so that he could become the first king.
With his help, Neuss quickly absorbed the legendary soul worm, the evolution cells and the polar ice worm. He quickly climbed from the lower abyss to the Upper Abyss. The Soul Worm didn’t have the time to eliminate the impurities in the body. Dudian helped to improve the situation. In less than half an hour, he had absorbed two source worms, neuss had successfully advanced to the king level.
Moreover, Neuss was different from other kings. He wouldn’t be disturbed by the ice worm king in his mind. He would always be free.
Everyone was stunned as they looked at the exaggerated scene.
Dudian had Neuss use his power to attack him. It was proven that Neuss had the strength of a king but he was unfamiliar with it. He hadn’t fully controlled the power in his body.
“Mass production of a king is the ability of a god. No wonder Aragami and magic insects are searching for ‘God’. Once they become a god, what problems in this world can not be solved?”Dudian was happy, he couldn’t help but sigh.
On that day, he asked God Wa to help. Both of them made soul worms and source worms. With Dudian’s speed, he could construct a set of resources needed to evolve into a king every half an hour. God wa only needed five or six minutes, moreover, the speed was gradually increasing.
Dudian didn’t let the King Flood. He first promoted Aurora, Neuss, Sergei and the others to the king level. As for their trusted aides, they would cultivate them in the future.
After doing this, Dudian thought of the memories he had read from the manager of the commercial building. The Devil Emperor had indeed come back to the imperial city. As for whether he had left or not, it was unknown to the small figures.
He left the commercial building and took Neuss and the others to the imperial city.
The Devil Emperor had stayed in the palace for a long time after the fall of the king. The current imperial city was full of dragons and snakes. The Masters of the Abyss who were under the control of the kings or some hidden masters of the ancient families had come out to investigate the situation, they were trying to seize the territory left behind by the Kings. Although the flags of the kings were still flying but the legions and industries under their command had been torn apart.
After the Devil King returned, he tried to suppress the chaos in the imperial city. However, he didn’t come out of the palace which caused rumors to spread.
“There is only one king left in the imperial city. He is the only king who didn’t participate in the Federal War. After the Devil King is killed, the imperial city will be leaderless.”
In Dudian’s eyes, there was no difference between a king and an ordinary person. By helping Neuss and others to evolve their bodies, his eyes and mind had become more open. There was a faint feeling of overlooking everything in the world.
Ordinary people would dress up to cultivate their temperament. The upper echelon would use power and wealth to cultivate their temperament. The emperor would use thousands of miles of land to cultivate his temperament!
Dudian led Neuss and others to the palace. They began to sense the daily scenes of the imperial city. After two hours they arrived at the central core area of the Imperial City!
Dudian’s perception extended to cover the entire imperial city. He soon felt that the imperial city was different from the past. There was a bit of chaos. He heard many family’s secret talks, he saw many dirty things but he didn’t feel anything.
Soon, Dudian saw the strict guards in the center of the Imperial Palace. Everything was in order.
“He is still here?”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He thought that the Devil Emperor would escape from the imperial city. After all, he didn’t care about the countless troops of the federation when he retreated, it seemed that he was in a hurry. However, the imperial palace was heavily guarded and there were no signs of chaos. It was obvious that he was still inside.
Dudian suddenly understood that the Devil Emperor had abandoned the army of the Federation. Perhaps he knew that he wouldn’t have time to manage the capital city after he returned to the capital city. Moreover, the capital city would be in turmoil after losing the Seven Kings, if he led a large number of troops back then the turmoil would be even more intense. Even before the attack there would be an extremely unbearable situation so he deliberately abandoned it.
Dudian had to admire the determination of the Devil Emperor. He was a ruthless person.
“Let me see what kind of confidence you have to guard the imperial capital!”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he strode over.
After a moment, they entered the imperial palace and went straight to the front of the imperial palace.
Dudian’s perception penetrated all over the imperial palace. Soon he saw a metal ship buried deep in the bottom of the imperial palace. His perception couldn’t penetrate into the ship but he searched the entire imperial palace and only saw a few concubines, there was no sign of the Devil Emperor. It was obvious that the latter was hiding in the ship.
Was he hiding or a trap?
Dudian didn’t rush to attack but said to Neuss: “Go to the imperial palace and catch the two Devil Emperor’s concubines.”
Neuss was stunned. This was the core of the imperial city. It was the place where the strongest person lived and the ruler of the giant wall! But he was going to the other side’s palace to catch the Other Side’s concubines?
Although he was surprised but he thought of Dudian. He quickly nodded and disappeared from the place. He passed by the guards in front of the imperial palace and went into the depths of the imperial palace.
After a moment there was some chaos in the imperial palace. Then he saw Neuss’s figure turn back. He was holding two women who were dressed luxuriously.
Both of them were in their early twenties. Their faces were decorated with special patterns. There was a kind of demonic beauty in them. Their eyes were indifferent and arrogant. It seemed that there was no emotion in them. They were thrown to the ground by Neuss, however they quickly raised their proud heads. There was anger on their faces as they stared at dudian: “Who Are You? How dare you break into the Imperial Palace? !”
“Take off your human skin!”Dudian indifferently said.
He raised his hand and cut the two women’s bodies with his five fingers.
The pupils of the two women constricted as their clothes suddenly burst. Their bodies expanded like a hurricane. In the blink of an eye they turned into two giant monsters that were more than ten meters tall. Their bodies were messy, there were strange and ferocious eyeballs everywhere, as well as strange mouths that were disordered. It was terrifying, even more terrifying than most monsters that were known for their terrifying appearances!
They were once as beautiful as gods, but they were also as ugly as demons!
Noyce, who had caught them with his own hands, was shocked. He was a little shocked. He did not expect that these two women, who were so beautiful that even he was moved by them, were actually such terrifying and disgusting monsters!
Aurora and the others were scared as they stepped back.
Dudian had seen the true face of the Aragami from the memories of Crimson Moon, Lin Changsheng and Bolo. He wasn’t surprised as he smiled, “In Your Aragami clan, you should be considered as beautiful women, right?”
The two Aragami let out a sharp and ear-piercing scream. It sounded like an angry roar as they rushed towards Dudian.
Dudian’s expression was indifferent. He raised his hand and grabbed. His fingers transformed into two giant cages. He imprisoned the two Aragami in the cage. Several giant thorns split out from the cage and pierced into their bodies.
It didn’t take long for him to read the memories of the two Aragami.
“They are back.”Dudian threw the two Aragami towards the god of wa: “I’ll give them to you.”
The god of Wa smiled. She raised her hand and her hand enlarged. Her palm was like a strange mouth. There was a bottomless vortex in the palm of her hand. The dense teeth were faintly visible as she sucked the two Aragami into it.
After a moment her arm returned to its original state.
“Tear down the spaceship inside.”Dudian said to God wa.
From the memories of the two Aragami Dudian knew that the Devil Emperor was hidden inside. The latter wouldn’t rely on a spaceship to protect him. Most likely there was a trap. His strength wasn’t what it used to be, but he wasn’t blindly confident. There were a lot of things that could go wrong. It was the most suitable thing for God wa to do.

Chapter 1237: Chapter 1226: ten million people will be buried with her
Translator: 549690339
“OH.”It seemed that Dudian had asked her to do a trivial task. He grinned and jumped up. He landed outside the palace wall.
The guards at the gate were shocked by the beauty of the goddess. It took a while for them to react. One of the guards was about to ask her identity and take the opportunity to strike up a conversation, suddenly, the beautiful girl raised her hand. Her arm suddenly expanded, and her slender, snow-white arm turned into a blood-red arm that looked like it was made of lava. She looked ferocious and terrifying.
Bang!
Goddess wa used her giant arm to smash down. The palace wall collapsed, and dust flew everywhere. Her arm pierced through the ground like an iron chain, directly touching the ancient spaceship in the depths of the imperial palace. Then, her arm turned into a rubber-like soft body, he wrapped the spaceship and pulled it up.
The buildings on the surface of the ground shook violently. The bricks protruded. The entire imperial palace and even the entire imperial city felt the tremor. Soon, a ring-shaped spaceship was pulled out of the dust and thrown onto the ground next to the imperial palace.
Neuss and others were shocked. They didn’t expect that the girl who was following Dudian in silence would have such terrifying strength. How many tons of strength was needed to pull such a huge spaceship out of the underground!
Puff!
The thin soft tissue wrapped around the spaceship quickly shrank and turned into sharp blades.
The spaceship was hit by the sharp blades. There were sparks and dents on the surface but it wasn’t broken.
God Wa was a bit surprised. One of the sharp blades turned into soft liquid and covered the spaceship. After a moment the soft liquid turned back into sharp blades and shot out again. Puff! It pierced a hole in the metal shell of the spaceship!
The other sharp blades flashed with cold light and stabbed at the same time.
Buzz!
The surface of the spaceship suddenly lit up with a blue fluorescent light. It was like a protective shield that blocked the countless sharp blades. However, it didn’t last long before it broke.
However, after the protection of the protective shield, the remaining strength of the sharp blades was greatly reduced. It didn’t Pierce through the spaceship.
At this time, a sinister voice came from the spaceship: “I don’t want to be your enemy. Don’t humiliate me too much. If you force me into a corner, I will drag you down with me even if I have to die!”
Dudian heard the voice of the Devil Emperor. He couldn’t help but feel a bit strange: “Don’t you know that I will come? Isn’t it too late to say these words? If you had taken the initiative to submit to me earlier then maybe I would have spared your life.”
“Submit?”? “In Your Dreams!”The devil emperor angrily said: “I don’t want to be your enemy. You had better not provoke me. Didn’t you check the surroundings on the way here? I have buried nuclear weapons in every corner of the imperial city. This is something invented by humans on Earth. Once I detonate it the entire imperial city will fall. You Won’t be able to escape in such a large area!”
Dudian used his perception to penetrate into the ground. He saw that there were nuclear weapons buried dozens of meters underground. He had only paid attention to the surface but had neglected this, after all, he didn’t think that the Devil Emperor would bury the entire imperial city.
“Do you think that nuclear bombs are useful to God?”Dudian retracted his perception and indifferently said: “I thought you would prepare some means to deal with it. But it is such a boring thing.”
“So you don’t want to let me go?”The devil emperor gritted his teeth: “Then let’s die together!”
Dudian frowned. He could think of the Devil Emperor’s plan through the arrangement of the surroundings. It was obvious that there were nuclear weapons buried in the spaceship!
Once the bomb was detonated, the Devil Emperor in the spaceship would be the first to be baptized by the nuclear bomb. He would be in the center of the explosion. He would be subjected to a high temperature of hundreds of millions of degrees. All the materials on Earth would be melted in front of such a high temperature, even God would be severely injured or even directly killed!
However, the effect would be different if he was prepared.
“Be careful!”Dudian didn’t have the time to dictate to Goddess WA. He quickly sent her telepathic thoughts.
The moment goddess Wa received the telepathic thoughts, her body was covered with a large amount of red magma-like carapace. It covered her body layer by layer like a blood red lotus.
Boom! !
Without any warning, the explosion suddenly sounded.
However, when God Nuwa erected her defensive armor, Dudian spread out a large number of tentacles and pulled Neuss and the others behind the giant lotus. Even so, when the impact of the explosion came.., his heart violently contracted.
They were very close to the spaceship at the moment. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that they were in the center of the nuclear weapons!
This was the first time he was so close to the nuclear weapon. It was as if he was facing death.
Everything happened in an instant. Dudian had just sent his telepathic message when the Demon King’s voice fell. The sudden explosion of vibration and dazzling light lit up the world as if it was daytime, it was as if a flame was rising and exploding on the planet!
Countless people in the imperial city looked up at the sky. The scorching white light pierced through the sky and the Earth. Countless people’s eyes were burned to tears and blood, before they could even howl in pain for their eyes, the sound of the ground rolling and trembling was like a huge wave pushing over. All of their senses were instantly numbed and they lost their senses.
Boom! ! !
The entire imperial city exploded into a huge mushroom cloud!
The intense trembling was felt by all the cities in the imperial city. Countless people looked towards the imperial city, the place where the monarch ruled the world. They saw a flash of light at the end of the horizon, even if it was a few hundred Li away, they could also see that the sky was extremely bright.
At this moment, the entire imperial city, which was surging with undercurrents, fell into silence. Everyone was shocked by the huge tremors!
On a tall mountain tens of Li away from the imperial city, a tall figure wearing a hat slightly raised his hand to cover his eyes. He narrowed his eyes and looked at the White Sun that was blooming in front of him. The mushroom cloud that was slowly rising stirred up a gust of wind, the hood that covered his face was blown away, revealing an extremely handsome and evil face. This was a face that everyone in the imperial city recognized.
“I didn’t expect that the first God born on Earth would actually be so close to humans. Moreover, this kid seems to have obtained Lin Changsheng’s memories and become a quasi-god,”he muttered to himself, then sneered, “Ten million people accompanying you to be buried is not a bad way to live up to your status as a quasi-god. As for this god, even if nuclear weapons can’t kill you, when our fleet arrives, we’ll use the star destruction cannon to destroy this planet. With the power of the planet’s explosion, it should be enough to bury a god that has yet to grow! ”
“I’m already a demigod. Even if I don’t have this planet, I can slowly perfect it in the future. Sooner or later, I’ll evolve into a God
“My race will eventually rule this universe. I Won’t die of hunger anymore. I’ll become Eternal!”

Chapter 1238: Chapter 1227: Recovery [ Third Update ]
Translator: 549690339
Rumble!
The earth trembled and violently shook.
The white pillar of light covered the entire imperial city. After the pillar of light disappeared, there was only a huge mushroom cloud and smoke that blotted out the sky, countless residents of the Imperial City felt that it was a glorious place. The imperial city had been razed to the ground under the dust and fog. It looked like the ground had been torn apart by a bloody wound.
Shaking!
Violent shaking!
Dudian could feel that the soil above his head and around him was shrinking and trembling. It was like a frightened animal tightening its pores.
In addition, the high temperature swept over from all directions. His senses were completely filled and surrounded. It was as if he was bathed in hot blood. At this moment he felt that he was so small, he was like a mosquito on a human body. He was not even a mosquito, but a tiny bacterium!
The mechanical heart in his chest was operating at full speed. He seemed to be able to hear the buzzing sound of the mechanical heart as it operated. The tissues outside his body were frantically splitting and reassembling, spewing out scorching flames that mixed with the temperature of the outside world, he did not create ice to weaken the terrifying high temperature. Otherwise, the continuous melting of the ice would turn into steam that would be enough to Steam Noyce and the others, including him.
On the contrary, by mixing the low temperature flame with the high temperature outside, they could gradually resist the terrible high temperature of the nuclear explosion.
It was unknown how much time had passed as the high temperature outside gradually decreased. At the same time.., dudian felt that God wa had taken them to the deepest part of the underground. They were far away from the core area of the nuclear explosion.
Dudian let God wa take them away from another place after they gradually calmed down.
Whoosh!
The Touch of God wa was like a lotus leaf. It wrapped around dudian, Neuss and the others. They quickly moved underground. After a moment they appeared in a rock layer hundreds of miles away and broke out of the ground.
A scorching wind blew over as they came to the surface. Neuss and the others felt as if they were breathing in flames. Their chests were burning and they were about to burst into flames.
Dudian looked at the distance. There was a green area outside the imperial city but it was scorched at the moment.
His vision shifted to the nuclear explosion area in front of him. The high temperature in the air became distorted.
The entire imperial city was gone. The only thing left was the scorched earth which had been barren for decades!
Dudian was startled. Even he was surprised by the Devil’s generosity. He suddenly felt that his heart was too small. If it was a bit bigger then maybe he would have thought of this.
However, he knew the potential of the god of Wa. So he didn’t panic when he found the missiles buried in the city. The nuclear explosion wasn’t a big threat to him but it was a pity for the imperial city.
This was the nest of the Devil Emperor. No one knew how many secrets of the Aragami clan were buried here. But now all of them were destroyed along with the people of the city.
“Are You Alright?”Dudian looked back at the lotus-shaped god.
The God shrank back a few lotus leaves and revealed a huge snow-white face, “I’m alright. Unfortunately this thing is too fast. If it was slower then I would be able to absorb and eat all of it. It would be delicious.”
Dudian was stunned. Eat a nuclear bomb?
He carefully thought about it and suddenly felt that it was not impossible. As long as they could absorb energy at the same speed as the explosion of the nuclear bomb then they would be able to synchronize the transformation.
However, it was very difficult. It was impossible for him. After all, the mechanical heart had a limit and it was difficult to bear. However, as a true God, the potential of God was endless. If he trained more, he might be able to do it.
“God is really a terrifying thing...”Dudian was more and more surprised. He thought of Neuss and the others. He turned around and used his x-ray vision to check. He found that only two of Aurora’s trusted aides were far away, they didn’t have time to pull to the side of God. They were vaporized by the high temperature. The rest of the people were alright. They were just scalded. Neuss and Aurora were unharmed.
“The entire imperial city has disappeared.”
“Oh my God.”
“Teacher, is this the work of the Demon Emperor who ruled over all the giant walls?”
Noyce and the others surveyed their surroundings and saw the mountains and forests in the distance. They could vaguely tell where they were, and all of them were so shocked that they couldn’t help but cry out. The imperial city had left a deep impression on them. It was magnificent, majestic, and magnificent, there was nothing left but scorched earth. It was simply devastating!
Dudian nodded slightly. He felt that there was something strange. He seemed to have overlooked it.
“Thousands of people from the imperial city were buried with me. Although this Devil Emperor’s style is grand and suitable for his identity. But his actions before his death were a bit strange.”Dudian recalled the previous events. The Devil Emperor’s performance was a bit impetuous, he wasn’t calm as he had seen before. Of course it was because he was forced into a desperate situation.
Many people were calm because they had spare strength.
But the strange thing was that the Devil Emperor wouldn’t stay here and wait for death.
After all, the nuclear bomb alone could scare him. But what about the second time?
This was not a long-term plan. If he was the demon emperor, he would definitely not use such a stupid method to save his life.
This demon Emperor did not give in at all during the negotiation. With such a tough attitude, the final method would only be mutual destruction. This feeling... was like he did not intend to live in the first place and had already prepared to detonate the nuclear bomb.
If that was the case, why did he have to say those meaningless words to expose his thoughts? If the nuclear bomb exploded without warning, the damage to him would be more serious and it might even kill him!
Dudian suddenly realized that the self-detonation of the “Devil Emperor”might just be a recording or a substitute!
The Real Devil Emperor was not dead!
He looked up and swept his perception in all directions. His perception swept through the surrounding mountains and forests. If the Devil Emperor was not dead, he would pay attention to the situation here.
Soon, his perception field expanded to the extreme. He locked onto all the animals in the vicinity but didn’t sense the aura of the Devil Emperor.
“Cautious guy. Has He left? He has also erased the smell.”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he withdrew his perception network. He was 100% sure that the Devil Emperor wasn’t dead.
Since he wasn’t dead then he would hide in the dark and continue to plan.
“The concubines in the imperial city are all Aragami. Even his own concubines are prepared to be buried with him. It seems that he isn’t the only one in the Aragami clan. There must be a mother seed to continue the descendants!”Dudian’s eyes lit up as he pondered for a moment, in the end he temporarily suppressed the pursuit of the emperor. The latter was hiding in the dark and was intelligent. It was almost impossible to find him. It was better to finish his own task first.
Now that the Devil Emperor had retreated, the capital city had almost fallen into his hands. He had almost completely grasped the world on Earth.
“When I find Aisha and nurture a group of kings in my spare time, I don’t believe that I can’t find him!”Dudian thought. Even if he couldn’t find the Devil Emperor, he didn’t care, after all, it was almost impossible to assassinate him with his current identity. Even if the Devil Emperor used the power of science and technology to launch long-range icbm-like weapons to attack his area, it wouldn’t be able to hurt him.
He only needed to enjoy the fruits of his victory. When he was free, he would send people to track down the demon Emperor and make him a stray dog, hiding in the shadows until it was unbearable.
After thinking through all this, the unhappiness in his heart dissipated. He immediately turned around, took Noyce, God Wa, and the others, and left, starting to reclaim the entire imperial capital!
..
He originally wanted to end the month and rest for a week next month to open a new book, but now it seemed that he could not rest at this rate (-) ..

Chapter 1239: Chapter 1228: Violent Suppression [ fourth update ]
Translator: 549690339
Dudian handed over the task of recovering the Imperial City to Neuss and Aurora because he didn’t have time to manage these trivial matters. After leaving the Imperial City, he parted ways with Neuss and others and found the only remaining king in the imperial city.
“Are you the tyrant King?”Dudian and Wa appeared in the king’s castle without anyone knowing. They were like transparent shadows that penetrated through the window of his study.
A tall blonde youth was sitting in the study. His face was handsome and narrow. His eyes were light red and calm. He had the elegant temperament of a noble. He wasn’t as fierce as his name.
“Who are you?”The blonde youth slightly raised his eyes. There was a trace of concentration in his eyes. He was able to quietly escape the detection of the guards under his command.
“Let me see your little head.”Dudian raised his hand. His palm was getting bigger and bigger in the eyes of the blonde youth. It almost completely covered his line of sight.
“You are courting death!”Red light flashed in the eyes of the blonde youth, he was the one who was the most easily angered out of the seven kings. Dudian’s intrusion had angered him but he had taken the initiative to attack. He felt that he was about to lose his rationality, the appearance of the noble’s gown was about to burst.
However, several sharp blades suddenly shot out from his palm. They were as fast as beams of light. Before he could see clearly, they had already pierced through his neck, shoulder blades, ribs, chest, and other parts, one of the sharp blades had just pierced half an inch away from his heart. With just a slight movement, it would cut through his beating heart!
The golden-haired youth’s pupils shrank. There was disbelief in his red eyes. Such a rapid transformation of the demon body was completely out of line with his logic!
“If you don’t want to die then be quiet.”Dudian indifferently said.
Although the golden-haired youth was prone to lose control of his anger, but in some moments he was able to control his anger. For example, when he was facing the Lord of light and the Devil Emperor. At this moment, he felt that his life was out of his control. He quickly controlled his anger. His face changed as he thought of the previous shock: “Did you cause the turmoil in the Imperial City?”
“It was caused by the Devil Emperor who was ready to die with me. Unfortunately, he wasn’t able to do it.”Dudian indifferently replied.
The Blonde Youth was stunned. There was too much information in this sentence. It was too shocking!
Dudian didn’t pay attention to the youth’s shock. He extended his tentacles and inserted them into the youth’s brain to read his memories.
A moment later, he retracted his tentacles and stabbed the dagger into the youth’s body. He frowned. He didn’t think that the Devil Emperor would hide his secrets so deeply. Even the king didn’t know the whereabouts of the other Aragami.
The tyrant King was like the other kings. He was just a slave of the Devil Emperor.
The real slaves were the polar ice insect king in their minds.
“From now on, you will follow me.”Dudian ordered.
The tyrant King’s eyes were dull for a moment. He gradually recovered and respectfully said: “Yes, my Lord. Thank you for helping me to get rid of the abominable polar ice insect king.”
“I didn’t help you to get rid of it. I just erased its consciousness.”Dudian indifferently said. He had entered some new memories into the tyrant King’s mind, for example, he told him that he had helped him to erase the consciousness of the polar ice worm king and what happened in the Imperial City.
The fastest way to make people surrender was to let them see your strength.
“Lord, I am willing to die to be loyal to you.”The tyrant King knelt down on one knee. This was the etiquette when he met the Devil King. He saw the death of the Devil King in the Imperial City and saw the extraordinary power of Dudian, he didn’t feel wronged to treat Dudian with such a big gift.
“Now the Imperial City is in chaos. You should help my friends to suppress the imperial city so that order can be restored as soon as possible.”Dudian said.
“Yes, Lord.”Tyrant king nodded respectfully. He sighed in his heart. He had just bid farewell to the Devil Emperor and welcomed a new master. It was difficult for him to turn the situation around. It was a bad feeling but there was nothing he could do.
..
..
The aftershock of the nuclear explosion spread throughout the entire imperial city.
The various factions immediately sent out their intelligence networks to contact the spies in the Imperial City to inquire about the situation. However, there was no news at all. Thus, they had no choice but to send new spies to the imperial city to gather information.
Just as the various factions were in a state of turmoil, there was suddenly news that a god had descended and killed the emperor!
The emperor’s crimes were monstrous, and he had offended a deity. He was punished with the wrath of a deity!
The news spread like wildfire. At first, people didn’t believe it, but later, the news of the imperial city being razed to the ground spread. At the same time, there was even more hard evidence that the imperial city had disappeared. For a time, the entire imperial city was in an uproar, everyone was blown away by this shocking news. They were in disbelief.
This was equivalent to the citizens of a certain country suddenly hearing that their capital had disappeared!
Without the capital, there would also be no emperor and countless upper-class nobles who maintained the country. When they thought of such a result, not only did the countless commoners not feel pleasantly surprised that they had regained their freedom, but they also felt anxious, as if they were homeless orphans, they felt uneasy and hoped that some important figure would appear above them and lead them in a new direction.
Soon, such a person appeared.
Noyce and the others descended as kings, suppressing all parties.
For a time, the snakes rose together. The various factions that were originally restless fiercely resisted, using all means to counterattack and attack Noyce and the others. They even created public opinion, gathered the will of the people, and created all sorts of rumors.
However, the strongest of the remaining first-tier giants in the imperial capital was only the Lord of the Abyss. Under the suppression of the absolute strength of Noyce and the others, they quickly submitted obediently. Some voluntarily submitted, and some vowed not to charge, they fought to the end with the soldiers under their command, and in the end, they were all massacred.
There were also some ancient families who were unwilling to accept such a once-in-a-lifetime chaotic situation being suppressed and replaced by someone. They used all the resources of their families to counterattack, but in the end, they were wiped out along with their entire family, completely exterminating their entire family!
When the tyrant King, one of the former seven kings, stepped out to protect the new king, the various forces in the imperial capital knew that the overall situation had come to an end. These kings had gathered together, and they no longer had a chance!
Blood washed and massacred. For half a month, the entire imperial capital was shrouded in a hazy blood color. One aristocratic family after another was wiped out, and one by one, the powerful heads of the military were unwilling to submit, and were sent to the guillotine.
The entire imperial capital was trembling. The Old Masters and new masters had taken turns, and blood was destined to flow like a river.
Even the ordinary commoners did not dare to casually go out on the streets. Many academies had even closed their doors, and there were even some who organized their students to take the lead in resistance. Similarly, they were mercilessly suppressed!
Bloody and brutal. The suppression methods of the imperial capital were far more violent and forceful than those of the federation. Everything was bloody and unconcealed!
Amidst the continuous massacres, the sounds of resistance gradually disappeared, and the voices of doubt no longer appeared. Everyone was paying close attention to what they were saying. In fact, even the children who did not know anything knew what to say and what not to say, they didn’t even dare to ask because they would get beaten by their parents.
When a topic became taboo, it would be forgotten by people over time. From taboo to forgotten, it was as if it didn’t exist. This bloody and dark history was destined to not be recorded.
Twenty days later.
Order had been restored in the imperial city. There were very few controversial voices. Neuss, Aurora, Macon and others were kings. They erected their king’s flags and took over the forces and territories of the previous seven kings.
When order was restored in the Imperial City, Dudian ordered Neuss and the tyrant King to send a message to all the giant walls. At the same time, he sent the Imperial City’s army to the Abyss region to search for Aisha.
He personally painted the portrait of Aisha. His extraordinary physical control made it vivid as if he had come alive from the painting.
The painting also spread throughout the capital, where she became the most famous woman of all time.

Chapter 1240: Chapter 1,229: The Fire Dragon surrenders
Translator: 549690339
Noyce and the others used their status as kings as an example to lead the army to explore the abyss and search for Aisha. The other independent adventurer organizations also joined in the search for Aisha for no other reason. This was a mission given by the new emperor of the Empire. The reward was so generous that it made countless people jealous. No one could resist it!
In addition to the reward of a city, it would help to fulfill a wish. Any wish would be fine, including resurrecting the dead!
In addition, it would help the person who completed the mission to become the king who looked down on all living things!
No matter if it was a thug who was in pursuit of power and wealth or a carefree person who didn’t want anything, it was difficult to resist the temptation. Who in the world didn’t have the desire and obsession to complete the mission?
In addition to the imperial capital, the Dragon Patrol Envoy took the portrait and Dudian’s task to go to the giant walls. They spread the news to every corner of the empire including the god of war wall which surrounded the empire, they also received the news at the first time. Once there was a trace of the person in the portrait, they would immediately intercept and report it.
Dudian received the news on the first day of the mission. There were people who had found the person in the portrait!
He was so excited that he almost jumped up. He went to greet the adventurers who were standing in the newly built imperial palace. There was a metal cage next to them, there was a shabby figure wrapped in chains.
“Aisha?”Dudian was startled. He looked at her but found that she wasn’t Aisha. Although her appearance was 70-80% similar but her smell was completely different. There was no bloodline power of the Witcher Dragon in her body.
“Is this the person you are looking for?”Dudian asked directly. His heart had cooled down and his voice was filled with killing intent.
Several adventurers felt chills all over the place as Dudian looked at them. One of them said: “Emperor, this is the person we have found in the painting...”
“Shit!”Dudian raised his hand and waved. The violent power shook out. The people in the hall were turned into dust. There was nothing left. They didn’t even scream or react.
Dudian raised his hand and smashed the undead in the metal cage into pieces. They were flattened along with the cage.
Neuss and Mason were stunned. They didn’t expect that Dudian would be so angry. They rarely saw Dudian in such a bad temper. Even if he was in danger, he wouldn’t lose control of his emotions and anger, he wouldn’t kill people easily. Although the number of people who died under Dudian’s hands was countless but most of the principles of Dudian’s killing had a purpose. It was beneficial to himself and not to kill the innocent.
Dudian shouted at the two: “Inform them that if anyone doesn’t clean their eyes and take this trash over to receive the prize, they will be cut into pieces!”
Neuss was shocked. He didn’t expect that Dudian’s anger would affect them. He was surprised and suspicious. He faintly felt that the current Dudian was slightly different from the Dudian he had followed, but he couldn’t tell the exact reason.
“Yes.”Neuss replied.
Dudian saw that Neuss was about to leave. he shouted: “Wait.”
Neuss stopped.
Dudian frowned. The anger in his heart had subsided. He thought for a moment, he shook his head: “Forget it. Some people don’t want to pretend to accept the award. If they are too strict then they will be scared off. If they meet her then they may not dare to confirm that they have met the real person.”
Neuss nodded: “I think so too.”
Dudian looked at him: “Don’t spread the news.”
“I will.”Neuss replied.
Dudian nodded and left the hall. He went back to his study room.
The next day, there was another news.
Dudian saw that it was another person who wasn’t Aisha. The excitement in his heart was extinguished again. But this time he didn’t get angry. He asked Neuss to give him some gold coins.
There was news coming in almost every day for a few days but none of them were the real Aisha.
Dudian’s patience gradually lost. He didn’t have much expectation when he heard the news again.
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Aisha was still not found. There was no trace of her.
However, the special envoy of the Fire Dragon Kingdom came to the imperial capital to visit. Dudian welcomed him. The special envoy immediately explained the reason. It was to express the intention of submission on behalf of the Fire Dragon King!
The Fire Dragon Kingdom was willing to submit to him unconditionally!
Neuss and the tyrant king were shocked as soon as the news came out. The tyrant King was the most shocked. The Fire Dragon Kingdom was on the border with them. There had been friction for more than 200 years and they had never backed down. Now the Devil King had just died, he was worried that the fire dragon kingdom would send troops to attack but he didn’t expect to receive a letter of surrender!
“Your Majesty, is there a trick?”Neuss was the first to ask. He had learned to change his words and no longer called dudian “Master”. He was keenly aware that Dudian wasn’t the “Master”of the past, he was a cold-blooded and cruel emperor!
Dudian grabbed the special envoy. He didn’t wait for the latter to resist but tried to probe his memory. Soon he saw the Master of the dragon and the attitude of the latter when he passed the order.
He was surprised that the latter was very respectful when he passed the order. It seemed that his eyes weren’t looking at the envoy but at Dudian who was reading the envoy’s memories.
Moreover, the Dragon Lord used the form of the magic worm to say hello to Dudian after the end of the order.
Dudian retracted his tentacles and shook off the envoy. There was a trace of cold light in his eyes. It seemed that the latter knew his situation very well. It was possible that the Lord of the dragon was hiding in the dark during the federal war.
“Great, great emperor...”the envoy’s face was pale. He trembled as he stood up and looked at Dudian in horror.
Dudian snorted: “Go back and tell the little dragon not to think that he is smart. Since he is sincere then hand over the military power of the Fire Dragon Kingdom and let the Imperial Army take over.”
The Special Envoy’s face changed. He wanted to say more but Dudian threw him out of the hall.
Dudian asked Neuss: “Haven’t you found Aisha Yet? Have you searched everywhere?”
“Not yet.”Neuss felt Dudian’s gaze. He didn’t dare to look directly at him, he bowed his head: “Most of the areas have been searched. We have also found many places where monsters and undeads gather. We have also found a few corpse kings who have learned human language. There is no news about her. There are only a few forbidden places that have not been explored. These places are the territory of mutated plants. Even kings don’t dare to venture into them.”
