?
Chapter 1241: Chapter 1230: Aisha the king
Translator: 549690339
Dudian frowned as he thought of the despair forest outside the giant wall of Sylvia. He had almost lost his life because of the mutated plants that were living underground.
Most of the plants were deformed or mutated into new species because of the environmental factors such as soil and air radiation. Some of the mutated plants were born with simple consciousness and were bloodthirsty, they would hunt like monsters. The probability of such plants being born was one in a hundred million, but every living plant that was born would become a huge hidden danger.
Whether it was humans or monsters, they would not care about the plants around them. This provided them with a natural protective umbrella when they were young, allowing them to sneak attack monsters and humans passing by and grow quickly.
In addition, they could absorb nutrients from the soil so they would never lack food.
Every area where the plants lived was marked as a forbidden area by the empire. The despair forest outside the giant wall of Sylvia was one of them.
“How Dare You Stop Me? Gather fire energy type warriors and sweep these forbidden areas!”Dudian frowned as he coldly said. He looked at the forbidden areas that the devil emperor was too lazy to clear, now he was going to flatten them all!
The world was under his feet so what was a forbidden area? !
Neuss was startled and respectfully said: “Yes.”
“If you don’t find any news about her within a week, I will cut the military by thirty percent and send her to do hard labor!”Dudian coldly said. His words were merciless as he stared at Neuss.
Neuss felt great pressure and quickly said: “Yes, Emperor. I understand.”
After he left the hall, Noyce felt his entire body become lighter. He was relieved from that extremely uncomfortable pressure. He let out a sigh of relief and smiled bitterly. He walked out of the imperial palace and just as he reached the wall, he saw Mason rushing over.
“Why? Is there any news?”Noyce’s eyes lit up as he went forward to ask.
Mason stopped in shock and shook his head with a bitter smile. “No, I’m just here to ask about the border guards.”
Noyce was stunned for a moment and smiled bitterly as well. “I advise you to wait for such a small matter. He’s not in a good mood right now.”
Mason noticed that his expression was not right and asked, “Why? Did he lose his temper again?”
“If we can’t find that Miss Aisha, he wants to reduce the army by thirty percent!”Noyce said with a bitter smile.
Mason came to a realization and said with a carefree smile, “It’s just disarmament. It’s not a big deal. The whole world belongs to us. It’s useless to have an army.”
Noyce opened his mouth slightly and wanted to say something, but he hesitated. Finally, he said in a low voice with a deeper meaning, “This world was conquered by him, not ours. In the future, if this is the case, it’s better for you to say less.”
Mason was stunned and somewhat puzzled.
Noyce did not say anything else and left in a hurry.
Mason stood where he was and watched his back as he left. He slowly frowned and seemed to be deep in thought.
In the blink of an eye, a week had passed.
The imperial city had gathered a large number of troops. With Noyce, Mason, Barton, Aurora, and the tyrant as the leaders, they had destroyed one forbidden area after another! Although these forbidden areas were dangerous, and even kings had to be careful when venturing alone, under the combined bombardment of numerous kings and large numbers of troops, even a demigod like the demon emperor had to temporarily avoid them.
The King of the Empire led his cavalrymen to sweep through all the forbidden areas. Finally, he found information about Aisha among the zombies that lived in one of the forbidden areas.
The news was quickly reported to Dudian.
“The ‘Jello’in the No. 7 forbidden area is a bloodthirsty monster flower. It has very high intelligence. There is a huge metal vein that stretches for hundreds of miles under the forbidden area. The monster flower lives on the vein and feeds on Gold and blood. The leader of the Zombie Group has developed intelligence and colluded with it to lure nearby monsters and adventurers to come close and then kill it.”
Neuss slowly reported the situation to dudian, who was sitting on the throne, “After we killed the demonic flower, we found the trace of Miss Aisha in the head of the zombie leader.”
Under his command, his trusted aides brought a huge metal cage and a huge tray.
There was a five-meter-tall zombie king locked in the metal cage. Its fangs were long and sharp like a zombie. The Zombie King didn’t struggle or resist. It knew that it was useless to struggle, it instinctively felt an extremely dangerous feeling, causing it to feel fear!
When it saw an extremely handsome young man on the throne, it immediately locked onto the source of the danger. It came from this young man.
It sniffed gently and immediately recognized that this young man was neither a corpse nor a human. The smell was very strange and made it thirsty. However, the abnormal sense of danger made it forcefully suppress its hunger.
There was a huge stamen in the tray. It was blood red and bright.
Dudian’s eyes fell on both of them. He analyzed the smallest structure in their bodies. The stamen was most likely the life core of the flower ‘Hierro’, at the moment it was beating like a heart. It was still alive. If it was slightly modified then it could be refined into an extremely powerful life armor!
This was a natural material for Hunter’s armor. It should be known that hunters would tear the original clothes after demonization. So the capital specially made a special material that was extremely soft, but its defense was weak.
Many thoughts flashed through Dudian’s mind as he stared at it. He had already thought of the use of the demonic flower ‘Hierro’. He threw it to the back of his mind as his eyes lit up, he looked at the corpse king in the cage.
The Corpse King couldn’t help but tremble in fear as Dudian looked at it. It felt like an ordinary person would be eaten at any time.
The next moment Dudian’s finger shot out for dozens of meters. He easily cut off the sturdy metal cage and turned into a bundle of hair. He wrapped the corpse king and pulled it in front of it.
The King Corpse struggled and screamed. The hair pierced into its mind and a large number of memories appeared in front of its eyes.
Soon, Dudian found a beautiful purple light in the chaotic and bloodthirsty memories. It was a beautiful figure. She was wearing a purple tang suit and her clothes were stained with blood, she stepped into the territory of the King Corpse.
Haisha!
Dudian recognized her at a glance. She was the Haisha he had been searching for! Even though Haisha’s hair was messy and her face was stained with blood and there were traces of blood on the corner of her mouth as if she had just eaten something bloody, Dudian recognized her at a glance. She was the person he was looking for.
In his later memory, Dudian saw Haisha fighting with the corpse king and defeating it. She was extremely powerful! When she defeated the Lord of the Abyss level undead king, it was a crushing victory!
After defeating the undead king, Aisha didn’t eat it. Instead, she became the new king of the territory and cooperated with the Demonic Flower Hierro, she commanded the undeads to lure the nearby adventurers and monsters to this forbidden area.
This action lasted for two to three months.
Aisha then left the territory of the monster flower ‘Hierro’and left alone without any undeads.
Dudian’s heart tightened as he looked through the memories of the undead king. However, he didn’t see Aisha again. He immediately counted down the memories of the undead King and found that it had been half a year since Aisha appeared. At that time, he had just entered the federation and was separated from her.
The vast land was far away from each other..
Dudian couldn’t help but grab his chest. Although he didn’t have a heart, he still felt a suffocating pain in his chest. He clenched his teeth and went back to the memory of the first time the king of corpses and Aisha met, then he slowly toured around.
In this memory, Aisha defeated the king of corpses and ate raw meat like them. She cruelly killed monsters that wandered into the territory and ate them raw. However, Dean soon saw the difference. Aisha would soak her body in water every once in a while. She wouldn’t move until the dust and blood on her body fell off.
This behavior was like a human taking a bath.
In addition, she would sit on the corolla of the Monster Flower ‘Hierro’. She would look at the nearby forest and stare at the Sun in a daze.
Dudian was shocked when he saw these actions. Could it be that a second consciousness was born in Aisha’s mind?
From Lin Changsheng’s research on undeads, he knew that after a certain level of physical fitness, a second consciousness would be born in the brain of the undeads. Just like an ordinary undead king, they would have a simple consciousness.
And the longer the time passed, the smarter they would be and the higher their IQ would be.
Some of the undead kings who had lived for hundreds of years were no less intelligent than the wily human experts.
At this time, Dudian also noticed the clothes on Aisha’s body. She used to like purple clothes the most, but now she was wearing them again. This was obviously not the same as when they parted. There was only one result, that was that she found such clothes to wear.
This also showed that she not only had wisdom, but also inherited some of the original preferences.
Could it be that her consciousness had recovered?
Dean’s eyelids twitched as he thought of this. He was extremely excited.
But soon, he calmed down. If he had such a fantasy in the past, then after looking through Lin Changsheng’s memory, his understanding of the undeads had become extremely detailed. On the contrary, he would not have such a daydream.
It was impossible for zombies to regain consciousness on their own.
In Lin Changsheng’s experiment, zombies gave birth to consciousness and inherited some of their original preferences. Although there were not many, there were about thirty percent of them. Some of the consciousness that were born had nothing to do with the past, for example, the consciousness that was born from a gentle and kind person was cruel, bloodthirsty, sinister and despicable.
Although she didn’t want to admit it, but Aisha’s actions were more in line with the thirty percent of undeads. The consciousness that was born was just a part of her original personality.
“If she recovered her consciousness, she would definitely go to Sylvia to look for me or return to Sylvia, but she didn’t.”Dudian thought of this and couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. He was full of disappointment and regret.
He had sent top experts to search for Aisha but there was no trace of her. It was clear that she had never returned to Sylvia after she left.
“No matter what, I have to find her first. After her original consciousness has recovered, I will give her the second consciousness to choose to get rid of or keep.”Dudian thought as he threw the corpse king out of his hand, he threw it to Neuss.
Neuss was scared and hurriedly took out his uniform to prevent chaos.
“From the looks of it, she has the strength of a king. If we can’t find her in the Empire then we will search outside the empire. Even if we have to search all the land and the whole world, we have to find her!”Dudian coldly said.
Neuss, Mason and others were startled. They didn’t think that Dudian’s will would be so persistent. They couldn’t help but sigh in their hearts. They had gathered all the resources of the Empire just to find a woman, it was already a waste of money and labor. If they searched the entire world, they didn’t know how many warriors would be sacrificed. It was like the ancient war games.
However, they had followed Dudian for the longest time. They knew that Haisha’s meaning to Dudian was incomparable to theirs. Even if Haisha became an undead, dudian would never abandon her, they couldn’t persuade her with a few words so they kept silent.
“You go. I will ask the Federation and Fire Dragon Kingdom to mobilize all the troops to look for her.”Dudian got up, he looked at Neuss: “I will go to the north. With her strength, it won’t be difficult for her to climb over the god of war wall. She will probably go to the north. Maybe she will find some clues there. I will be back soon. I will leave this place to you for the time being. Everyone should be alert and not slack off!”
Noyce’s heart tightened. He wanted to say something but stopped. Very soon, he sighed in his heart. He raised his head and said solemnly, “Yes!”

?Chapter 1242: Chapter 1231: Blood Moon descends
Translator: 549690339
Dudian asked Aurora to call God wa who was playing in the imperial capital to accompany her.
Although the northern undead kingdom wasn’t a threat but it wasn’t to be underestimated. The power of the undead kingdom wasn’t inferior to that of the empire. There was no limit to the growth of the undead, as a result, the territory occupied by the undead kingdom in the north was twice the size of the Empire and the Federation combined. It was almost the size of the entire Asian continent in the old era!
To the Demon Emperor and Lin Changsheng, the undead kingdom did not have a background to rely on, nor did they possess intelligence. Although they occupied a large area, and there were many king-level undead kings, they were the least harmful. After all, the undead could not become gods!
A moment later, God wa came back with Aurora. She was very happy.
Dudian’s cold face softened a bit as he saw her. He called her over and explained the reason.
God Wa didn’t care and agreed without thinking.
Dudian immediately took her out of the imperial palace. As soon as they stepped out of the palace, he felt that the world wasn’t right. Everything in the world was covered in a faint crimson color, it was difficult for ordinary people to see but it was very obvious in his eyes.
Suddenly he thought of something and looked up.
He saw that in the blue sky there was a blood red full moon behind the distant thin clouds!
Blood Moon!
Dudian’s pupils slightly shrank. He didn’t expect that the blood moon that Lin Changsheng had been worried about would come. However, the time was different from what Lin Changsheng knew. It was one month earlier!
“The blood moon will come. The ice worm spaceship will arrive on earth...”Dudian frowned as he thought of the blood moon that Lin Changsheng had experienced. The ice worm would come to the Earth’s inspection base which was the federation, lin Changsheng would hide in the virtual AI in advance and erase all the data about him. He would also clean up the rumors about him in the federation.
The people who were familiar with him would naturally clean up as well. For example, Heslodi.
The fact that Lin Changsheng who had the power of a demigod was so cautious showed how powerful the ice worm was. Although it wasn’t a true God but it was more than enough to crush a demigod!
Moreover, the ice worm controlled extraordinary technology and had the highest authority of the Federation’s Artificial Intelligence. It could forcefully restart the machine heart. This was a fatal threat to Lin Changsheng!
However, the machine heart had fallen into Dudian’s hands. Even if it was rebooted it wouldn’t affect him.
“They should be ready to land on Earth. The first place they will go is the federation. They will choose to escape or come to find me...”Dudian’s eyes flashed, he changed his mind and delayed his trip to the undead kingdom. He wanted to deal with the ice bugs that had landed in the federation.
Although these ice bugs could deal with demigods but they were far from true gods. With the help of God wa it wouldn’t be difficult to deal with them. He might be able to get some secrets about the undeads from them.
He was standing at the top of the world and had some understanding of the secrets behind the scenes. So far he didn’t know much about them. The undeads virus was one of the secrets he wanted to know the most.
God Wa had no opinion in front of Dudian. He agreed to go to the federation without any doubt.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Dudian transformed into a bird and flew out of the Imperial Palace with the god of Wa. They went straight to the south of the imperial capital.
Dudian and the god of Wa crossed the border of the god of War and came to the Federation. Now they crossed the border of the god of war. There was no need to sneak through the Thunderbirds in the sky. No one dared to obstruct them.
Dudian directly landed in the capital city as soon as he came to the federation. He released his perception and found that there was no shadow of the magic bug spaceship in the capital city. In addition, he sensed the presence of black slody and stayed in the capital city.
The next moment, Dudian appeared beside Heslodi.
Heslodi was having a meeting in an office building to discuss the reform of the federal system. At this time Dudian suddenly penetrated through the floor-to-ceiling window. He looked like a ghost, many people in the conference room were shocked.
“Great, Great Emperor.”Heslodi was stunned as he saw Dudian. He quickly went up to greet him: “Why did you come? Didn’t you inform me in advance so that I could pick you up?”
“There is no need. Is there anything unusual in the capital today?”Dudian said directly.
Blackie’s heart tightened as he saw Dudian come in a hurry. It seemed that there was something important. He didn’t bother to continue the small talk, he shook his head: “There is nothing important from the news reports. I don’t know which aspect you are referring to.”
Dudian looked at him. It didn’t seem like any major events had happened. Moreover the Blood Moon had just appeared today so the magic insects hadn’t arrived on Earth.
“Nothing.”Dudian shook his head and left the conference room.
Black Slody was stunned. He couldn’t do anything to Dudian who was nowhere to be seen.
The other people in the conference room didn’t dare to breathe. They had seen Dudian and knew the cruel methods of the emperor. They didn’t expect that he would come to such a small-scale meeting, some of the people who had dozed off were so nervous that they broke out in cold sweat. The legs under the table couldn’t help but tremble.
Dudian stood in the sky above the capital city. He looked up at the sky and squinted his eyes. He was waiting for the arrival of the magic insect spaceship.
He thought that he would have to wait for a long time. He didn’t expect that ten minutes later, he saw a few tiny black dots appear in the sky. They were getting bigger and bigger. It was the appearance of the magic insect spaceship.
“It’s Coming!”Dudian looked at God wa: “Ready for battle.”
God wa smiled: “Can I eat it?”
“Leave it for later.”Dudian said.
“Oh...”
At this time the spaceship was getting closer and closer. There were three spaceships in total. They looked like flying saucers but the surface of the spaceship was protruding with sharp spikes. In the blink of an eye they appeared thousands of meters high in the sky.
The spaceship suddenly slowed down as if it had detected dudian and WA.
After a while, the spaceship stopped hundreds of meters above their heads. The valve of the spaceship opened and four White Crystal Worm Kings flew out. Their bodies were plump but there were two pairs of translucent wings on their back, they flew over like flying snakes.
“Take them away.”One of the worm kings spoke in insect language.
The other three worm kings immediately surrounded Dudian and Dudian.
Dudian looked at their posture. He couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows but didn’t resist. This saved him from attacking the hull of the ship.

chapters.title: Chapter 1243
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1243: Chapter 1232: Earth Experiment Plan
Translator: 549690339
The three polar ice insect kings emitted cold air which froze the bodies of Dudian and WA. Soon they turned into two ice sculptures. They flew up and wrapped them up before they fell down. They dragged them back to the valve of the spaceship, they entered the spaceship.
Whoosh!
The valve of the spaceship was closed.
The internal structure of the spaceship wasn’t as long as a human spaceship. Instead, it was a vertical structure like a beehive. There were a lot of entrances and exits. The walls weren’t made of shiny metal but were made of a dark red wall, there were things that looked like blood vessels protruding from the surface. They looked like the internal organs of insects. The light was very dark. Occasionally, one could hear some smooth movements like some kind of animal crawling.
Soon, Dudian and WA were dragged to the center of the ship. There was an ovary-like throne which stood in the center of the complex maze of the ship. The surroundings were very wide, there were many vine-like tentacles that extended to the ovary throne. There was a long white worm coiled inside. It seemed to have hair. Its skin was wrinkled and gave people an old feeling.
The ice worm king that led Dudian and Lin Changsheng in let out a hiss, its words were translated in general: “Great Sage, these are two Earthlings. One of them has the smell of Aragami. Do you want to dissect them?”
It used a kind of honorific language like the insect language but it was omitted in the translation.
Dudian understood the insect language from Lin Changsheng’s memory. After all, the latter was not an insect. Although he could communicate with the magic insects but he didn’t understand some obscure languages. His body remained stiff and didn’t move at all, however the inner layer of his pupils contracted slightly. He looked at the old polar ice insect which was sitting on the throne in front of him.
In Lin Changsheng’s memory, it was one of the twelve sages of the ice magic insects who had descended to the federation twice.
The name was given to it by Lin Changsheng.
“Its body is mixed with the Aragami’s genes and it has the physique of a demigod. Unfortunately, it doesn’t have the exact balance like the god of Wa!”Dudian’s eyes flashed as he looked at the gene structure in its body.
“Huh?”The moon worm on the ovary throne looked at the two frozen humans. It suddenly stood up from its lazy curled position. It looked at the entire spaceship, there were two red cracks on its forehead. It looked like two long and sharp ruby eyes. It stared at the two for a moment. Its body rolled up as it shouted: “Kill them! Hurry!”
The surrounding magic insect guards were stunned. It seemed that they didn’t understand why the great sage was so excited. However, they obeyed the order unconditionally. They immediately sent out a large amount of cold air which turned into ice and spears and stabbed towards the two.
Bang!
Bang!
The two ice sculptures suddenly exploded. Dudian shook the dust on his sleeves. His eyes lit up as the high temperature was released from his body. It swept out and turned into several huge fireballs, the ice spears and Ice Swords were submerged.
Hiss!
The surrounding magic insects were shocked. They looked at the two humans in disbelief. How could they break the ice seal by themselves?
“One demigod and the rest are at the king level. There are more than thirty kings and hundreds of Abyss. It’s enough to flatten the ‘bases’of the Federation and Empire.”Dudian’s eyes were indifferent, he glanced around and finally landed on the sage of the moon insect: “It seems that you have mastered the experiment of the demigods. Unfortunately, it was used on you.”
The moon insect looked at it in shock. It was more sure that it wasn’t seeing things through its tentacles. It spoke in sharp federal language: “Who Are You? The Devil Emperor of the Empire?”
“You actually know about the empire. It seems that everything on Earth is in your control.”Dudian slightly raised his eyebrows: “Unfortunately, the one who should ask the question is me and not you.”
He turned to God wa: “Catch it. I want its memory. The rest will be your snacks.”
God wa happily clapped her hands: “Alright!”Her figure disappeared and appeared in front of the moon insect. Her fingers expanded and turned into a large amount of silver silk.
The Moon Demon Worm had been prepared when she attacked, but it was still frightened by the terrifying speed. In a hurry, it turned into a white sword and cut off the silver threads. Then, it retreated quickly and returned to the ovarian throne.
There was actually a huge tunnel that connected to all parts of the spaceship.
God Wa had seen through it long ago. She smiled slightly, but she did not show any signs of doing so. Suddenly, a large number of sharp blades and white threads shot out from the tunnel and forced the moon demon worm out. The white threads had passed through her feet and penetrated the ground of the spaceship. They were waiting for an opportunity in the passage.
The other magic insect guards saw that the great sage was in trouble. They screamed and rushed over. The entire spaceship was filled with cold air which froze the surroundings.
“Too Hard is easy to break. Too Soft is easy to fall.”Dudian thought of the old saying. He couldn’t help but sigh in his heart. Both the ice magic insect and the flame magic insect were extremely powerful. Unfortunately, they were too easy to control. Their weaknesses were too obvious, no wonder they had to fuse with each other in order to have the possibility of becoming immortal.
God Wa was surrounded by many magic insects. Its body was shrouded in cold air and it was difficult to see clearly.
Dudian didn’t plan to help. This was a good opportunity for God wa to train. He had seen that although God wa was a true God but it lacked training and experience. Its huge potential hadn’t been fully displayed.
A few minutes later the fierce battle ended.
The cold air was dispersed by a strong wind. The god of Wa’s body was covered with sharp blades. Each blade was covered with different abilities such as fire, ice, petrification, darkness, poison and so on. At the moment her image was extremely terrifying, no Evil God in the myths and legends could be compared to her.
The corpses of the magic insect guards were scattered on the ground. They were slowly crawling and reassembling their bodies.
There was a ball of white mucus in her huge claws. It was the moon magic worm.
Dudian was relieved. He saw that the moon magic worm had been subdued by her. It was extremely weak. He quickly released its tentacles and inserted them into its body. It assimilated with its cells and read its memory.
Ten minutes later.
Dudian pulled back his tentacles. His face was gloomy. He saw that the moon magic worm had grown up in this memory. It was a source worm that was born from the ice pool. Because of the excessive cold air in its body, it formed cold beads, it had become a sage of the ice worm family.
All sages were born.
After becoming a sage, it showed extraordinary wisdom. It took over the military power from its teacher. It led its line of ice worms to fight against each other. It also fought with the other sages to seize territory!
The environment of the magic worm planet was harsh. The living environment was very precious. It was extremely fierce. It was like a meat grinder that strangled a large number of magic worms. Because of this, it controlled the number of magic worms, otherwise, that planet might not even be able to hold all the magic bugs.
During the centuries of fighting, its life was very monotonous. Every day was a battle and killing, and the magic bugs did not have any human hobbies.
During these centuries, it had also experienced the disaster of the magic bugs. Aragami descended, and they killed the magic bugs as food.
Every time an Aragami descended, it was like the end of the world for the magic bugs. The terrifying digestive ability of the Aragami just so happened to restrain their magic bug race, making them unable to resist, just like the humans on Earth, unable to resist their descent.
It was not until the many sages discussed and opened up a new path of survival, gathering a large number of elites and embarking on an interstellar journey, that they found Earth.
Here, they saw the key to becoming a god and living forever, and that was the human race.
They analyzed the human constitution, which was completely different from theirs. It was very balanced and was the most suitable container.
For this, they began to transform the human into a perfect container. After all, although the original human was a very suitable material, his constitution was weak. It was like there were small branches on a tree trunk that needed to be polished.
The human resisted, and the global nuclear bomb exploded. Nearly half of the Great Sage was killed, and the rest fled in panic. It was also one of the surviving sages and left Earth with its defeated soldiers.
However, not long after it left, it received a signal from the surviving soldiers in the region. It knew about the situation on Earth, so it descended again!
This time, the Earth was beyond recognition, and there were very few human survivors.
They captured human survivors, raised them, dissected them, and used them as experimental materials.
In addition, they also tried to study the human culture and technology on Earth, wanting to understand why they were so weak, yet they could create such a terrifying thing! As a result, this base gradually expanded from the original slaughterhouse to the current federation!
Speaking of which, there was another part that needed to be added. At the beginning of their return to Earth, the Moon demon bugs weren’t a great sage. Just the ice demon Bugs alone had returned five, and the blaze demon Bugs also had four or five. The exact number wasn’t very clear to them.
After checking that the situation on earth was harmless, they finally relaxed and formulated an Earth experiment plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1244
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1244: Chapter 1233: Experimental Subjects
Translator: 549690339
Not long after this plan was formulated, the Aragami race, who had also been scared away by the nuclear bomb, appeared on Earth. They used the unique technology of the Aragami race to divide the land. At that time, they were thousands of kilometers away from the ice demon worm experimental base, they had built a cemetery to bury the warriors of the Aragami race who had died in battle. Similarly, those who had survived in that area were also kept by the Aragami race.
After the flame demon insect sages learned of the plans of the ice demon insect sages, they were unwilling to fall behind. They quickly encircled a large area and divided the land. Then, they captured the survivors in that area and allowed them to continue reproducing, they brought more fresh experimental subjects to them. This action caused the population to rapidly expand. The flame demon insect had endless experimental materials. In order to make it easier to manage, they allowed them to form a kingdom according to the culture of the humans of the old era, they themselves became the masterminds behind the scenes.
There was once a lack of culture. With the permission of the flame demon Bugs’sages, a portion of the culture was opened up, allowing the fire dragon kingdom to become the earliest land country!
The ice demon bugs and Aragami saw the benefits and convenience within and similarly adopted this model. As a result, the three major factions that came later faced off against each other. From the general process, it was not complicated, from simple to complex, however, the bloody experience and changes in the process were hard to bear and imagine with the human world view.
During that dark period, humans were once reduced to livestock.
What was livestock? Everyone was naked and slept with the corpses. They ate raw meat and drank dirty water. They didn’t care about beauty or ugliness.
Dudian had always been curious about why the Aragami and the Magic Bugs didn’t live on Earth. He had the answer in the memories of the sage of the magic bugs. After the nuclear explosion, the Earth’s nuclear dust covered the sky and volcanoes frequently occurred, the Earth was barren and the environment was extremely harsh.
Although the magic insects had strong vitality and could adapt to all kinds of environments. But forced adaptation wasn’t good for their bodies. Everyone could go hungry for a few days without eating. But it wasn’t good for their bodies.
The ice magic insects loved the cold and extreme ice environment while the flame magic insects loved the hot and warm environment. The temperature of the Earth’s environment was very different from day to night. One moment there was a blizzard and the next moment there was a volcanic eruption.
For the magic bugs, they could adapt to the marsh that was filled with methane, and they could also adapt to underwater creatures. They could even adapt to the lack of oxygen, and they could still survive for a long time in an oxygen-deprived environment. However, the change in temperature.., for them, it was the most uncomfortable. The temperature adjustment ability in their bodies was almost zero. At that time, the environment on Earth was just like humans in the Arctic. They were lucky that they did not freeze to death.
From the experimental base to the formation of the federation, humans had restored civilization and order under their control. It had been thirty years. In these thirty years, more than a dozen source insects had died due to strange diseases due to environmental factors. There was also a great sage.., they had also suffered from strange diseases. Their bodies were covered in extremely itchy hot spots. They wailed in pain every day. They could not think at all, let alone continue their experiments.
On the other side, the blazing demon bugs were not doing much better. They quickly learned of this situation. After all, they were of the same race, and they had hated each other for countless years, so they understood each other very well.
In order to survive, they had no choice but to discuss and eventually decide to leave Earth.
However, the prerequisite for making this decision was to pull the desolate god race in as well. If not, leaving the desolate god race on Earth would be too dangerous for their forces.
Although the Aragami clan was not afraid of the demonic insects, the secret of becoming a god was in the hands of the demonic insects. The research progress of the Aragami clan was the slowest. In the end, they agreed to this agreement with a large amount of precious information as a trade.
Before the three parties left Earth, they each left a portion of their clansmen on Earth to continue supervising the experiments here. They changed their train of thought and secretly led the development of human technology, allowing humans to study humans themselves!
The situation on Earth gradually stabilized. The nuclear dust clouds and volcanoes brought about by the nuclear bombs also gradually calmed down. Humans prospered among the three major forces. In just a short hundred years, they had developed to an extremely large scale, meanwhile, the nature of humans was also exposed in a comfortable and comfortable environment. They pursued more and more things. In addition to the technology in their hands, they were able to pick up the legacy of the lost civilization of the old era.
Although humans were gradually returning to the appearance of the old era, the decision to rule at the highest level was still in the hands of the demon bugs and Aragami. They were still under their surveillance. Therefore, in the imperial capital that the Demon Emperor was in charge of.., it was forbidden to develop technology within the giant wall. Only the imperial capital under the Demon Emperor’s eyes had the shadow of technology. Even if something terrible and destructive was developed, it could be stopped in time.
“The Empire forbade technology. The three forces had an agreement that they wouldn’t invade each other so there was less friction at the border in the early days. Later on there were more and more conflicts. I guess it was because of the long time. They wanted to test the effectiveness of the agreement. It’s ridiculous that the sacrifice of each other was human.”Dudian looked at the memory of the sage of the Moon Worm, he felt that the human race had been extremely sad for the past three hundred years.
The most ridiculous irony was that in the perfect order, human beings were living in comfort. They were pursuing food, quality of life, entertainment and so on. They didn’t know that they were under surveillance.
With his understanding, even if most people knew, they wouldn’t think much of it. After all, the perfect order had divided them into three, six, nine levels. Everyone had to struggle for their lives, how could they care about such distant things?
In addition, Dudian saw Lin Changsheng from the memories of the Great Sage of the Moon magic insect. But what surprised him was that Lin Changsheng had escaped from the experiment. In addition to Lin Changsheng’s own will, it was also their acquiescence!
And the federation’s largest experimental subject was Lin Changsheng himself!
Lin Changsheng thought that he had escaped from the hands of the magic insect with his own intelligence. But he didn’t know that all of this was under the supervision of the great sages. Lin Changsheng was the experiment subject that they had high hopes for. He was most likely to become a god!
And most importantly, this experimental subject would perfect his own experiments. When the experiments were about to be perfected, they only needed to come over and pluck them!
Lin Changsheng had calculated everything. Every time the blood moon descended and the magic bugs arrived, they would erase all traces of themselves. Now, it looked like a person playing hide-and-seek in front of the monitor. It was somewhat laughable and pathetic.
“The reason why the Devil Emperor attacked the Federation and the Fire Dragon Kingdom was because of the collusion between the Aragami and the flame magic worm. The ice magic worm family knew about it so they came to Earth in advance. The original agreement is now in name only. The moment the Devil Emperor raised his army to attack the federation, it has been torn apart.”Dudian suddenly felt that.., the matter of the Devil Emperor attacking the federation was not that simple.
The Demon Emperor knew of Lin Changsheng’s existence and wanted to conquer the federation and become a god himself. However, there were no other Aragami helping him during this process, which made people have to guess that he most likely wanted to hide it from the Aragami beyond the heavens and snatch the fruits to become a god himself!

chapters.title: Chapter 1245
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1245: Chapter 1234: Virus
Translator: 549690339
Dudian had always been curious about the blood moon. He had found the reason in the memories of the moon bugs. However, the reason was too shocking. He was shocked because the blood moon was the real Moon that had turned red. There was no special effect added here.
The reason why the Moon was red was because the entire moon had been occupied and transformed by the magic bugs. It was used as a telescope to monitor the humans on earth!
It was because of the magic insects on the moon that the sage of the Moon was able to know the general situation of the earth from the ancestral star. The reason why it had come early was because the magic insects on the moon had detected the abnormal activation of the mechanical heart, it had rushed to the ancestral star because of this matter.
It was the only Sage who had come.
The rest of the sages needed to stay on the ancestral star. In the past three hundred years, the magic insects had invaded the earth and the sages had moved out in large numbers. The sages who stayed on the ancestral star had fought frequently and competed for power, the ancestral star of the magic insects was in chaos!
Dudian knew the situation of the ancestral star of the magic insects through its memories. He was surprised to find that the four or five sages of the magic insects who were left on earth had dissected the human race and understood the human race, they had absorbed a lot of human culture. Naturally, these things were used as research materials and brought back to the ancestral star of the magic insects.
The demonic insect sages and other source insect sages who were involved in the research of humans were unknowingly influenced by human culture. After returning to the ancestral star, some demonic insects suggested that the ice demonic insects and the blazing demonic insects stop fighting and work together, to resist the desolate gods.
Some suggested that they wanted to destroy the blazing demonic insects and completely dominate the demonic insect planet, because they only needed one king!
Others wanted to destroy the blazing flame demonic insects and imprison them like how they imprisoned humans as experimental materials. They believed that this would definitely speed up their cracking of the secret code to become gods!
Under the many demonic insects’conflicting thoughts, the ancestral planet of the demonic insects became more and more chaotic. The ice demonic insects split into different factions and fought with each other openly and secretly. Many sages had the idea of unifying the ice demonic insects first.., then, they wanted to unify the flame demonic insects.
These thoughts came from the unified thought of human culture.
Therefore, in the past three hundred years, the ancestral star was in chaos. The four or five sages who had escaped back then fought secretly. Only three of them died, including the two sages who were newly born from the ice pool, these two sages were killed before they could experience the power of being sages.
Therefore, only the weakest sage of the ancestral star came to Earth. It knew that its territory would be plundered when it went back so it brought all the elites around it, unfortunately, it came to earth and met the god of Wa and Dudian who had become a demigod.
“Desire is really infectious...”Dudian felt ridiculous as he saw the chaos and struggle of the ancestral star. The insects had come to Earth and brought disaster and virus to the Earth, however, they were infected with human habits when they dissected humans. The ancestral star was in chaos and even the ice pond was about to be broken.
Who had infected who?
Who would be spared from the virus? !
Dudian felt that the change of the insect family was laughable. However most of the existence in the world could control the life and death of others. How many of them weren’t laughable?
Dudian finally knew what the virus was. He saw the original body of the virus! However he wasn’t happy but sad and angry because the birth of the virus was incurable. No one had ever thought of concocting an antidote!
Even the insect family only knew how to manufacture and release the virus. They didn’t know how to detoxify the virus!
Furthermore, the creation and release of the virus to Earth was not the demon Bug’s original intention. When they first arrived on Earth, they could suppress the humans on Earth with just their strength, engulfing one human city after another until the Aragami intervened.., when the humans retaliated, they were forced into a helpless situation. They had no choice but to develop such a thing. Not only could it destroy the humans, it could also suppress the Aragami, and it could also provide their race with an endless supply of food.
The virus was very special. If the Aragami’s constitution were to be exposed to the virus for a long period of time, the infection would be deeper. It would affect the body, causing the body to expand and the emotions to go out of control. They would eat crazily. When there was no food, they would even eat their own kind or even eat themselves!
To humans, the virus would allow the human’s constitution to improve rapidly until their genes collapsed. Their brain tissues would die and they would become zombies. Although they possessed extraordinary powers that surpassed humans, they would be completely different. They would have no consciousness and would not recognize their own kin, they were just like wild beasts!
When wild beasts were infected by the virus, they would become endlessly demonized. They would be savage and bloodthirsty, and they would continue to evolve until they reached the end of their evolution and completely collapsed!
To the demonic insect race, when infected humans became zombies, they could use their brain cores as food, while infected wild beasts could become the incubator for their offspring! In time, the entire Earth would become the second planet of their demonic insects.
However, although the ideal was good, the human’s counterattack had disrupted their plans. In addition to the Aragami’s encirclement, the Ice Devil and the flame devil were hostile towards each other.
After looking through the memories of the Moon magic insect, Dudian was satisfied that he didn’t meet it. The last trace of hope in his heart was lost. He felt extremely aggrieved. But soon he thought of the god of Wa, he thought of his current ability.
God was omnipotent!
It was better to ask for help than to ask for help. Since there was no hope in the world then he would create his own hope!
Moreover, Dudian recalled the chaotic situation of the ancestral star in the memories of the moon insect. He didn’t have much respect for these magic insects. On the contrary, he felt that it was ridiculous and contemptuous. If the ice insect and the flame insect weren’t so extreme.., they might have killed the natural enemy of the Aragami and solved the password to become a god. It was even possible that they had unified the universe!
Such an opportunity was placed in front of them but they were blinded by hatred!
Stupid! Ridiculous!
Dudian laughed as he thought about the stupidity. It was ridiculous that he placed his hope on such a stupid thing!
“It is a group of you who are so stupid that there is no cure. You have forced us to this point and almost exterminated our clan.”Dudian laughed. He shook off the sage of the Moon Worm.
Whoosh!
The god of Wa stuck out its tongue and rolled the sage of the moon worm like a frog.
The sage of the Moon Worm’s body wriggled and produced many sharp thorns. It tried to pierce through her tongue but it was useless. It looked like it was about to be eaten. It laughed in despair.
“God has already been born, but he is not of our race. He has given his prey a wedding dress for nothing. How laughable! How laughable!”
The laughter did not stop. It gradually died down and was swallowed by God wa mercilessly. After eating it, god Wa even burped and mumbled, “Such a cultured person. What human language are you learning?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1246
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1246: Chapter 1235: Country of corpses
Translator: 549690339
After dealing with the sage of the moon insects, Dudian erased the consciousness of the other source insects in the spaceship and stored them in the national treasury. He also disarmed the spaceship and made it into his bag.
“I have to go to the moon as soon as possible after finding Aisha. I don’t want to attract the attention of other sage of the moon insects.”Dudian thought. Although he wasn’t afraid of the sage of the moon insects but he wouldn’t underestimate them, he had easily dealt with the sage insects. He didn’t know that a true God had appeared on Earth.
If the other sage insects knew about this then they might discuss other countermeasures. After all this was a race that could cross the interstellar space. If he used other methods then he would inevitably have to pay some costs and losses.
The earth hadn’t been unified yet so he was worried about Aisha. He wasn’t in the mood to deal with these insects and Aragami. He would settle the accounts one by one after everything was settled.
“Let’s go to the corpse kingdom.”
Dudian controlled the spaceship and flew directly towards the corpse kingdom in the north. He had obtained the memories of the Sage of the moon magic bugs. It was easy for him to control the spaceship. Although the spaceship needed permission.., but he could completely replicate the body of the sage of the moon magic bugs. He could even input his own reading memories into it and “Rebirth”it!
The spaceship traveled at a supersonic speed. Outside, they could only see large clouds and mist, as well as the Endless Mountains, rivers, and forests beneath their feet.
In less than half an hour, they had flown to the bitterly cold north. The climate here was obviously lower than that of the federation and the Empire. There were extinct volcanoes everywhere, and there were fewer forests. All of them were submerged in swamps, stone walls that were hundreds of meters tall were erected at the border. However, the construction technology was clearly human-made. It was unlike the giant walls forged by the Aragami. They were perfectly in sync and were printed out using soil mixed with metal materials, there was no trace of gap.
The spacecraft whistled past the high wall and scattered the birds that were floating in the air. A large group of old crows were trying to catch up but were thrown away by the spacecraft in the blink of an eye.
Dudian saw a large number of undeads that were wandering on the ground. It seemed that they heard the whistling sound. Many of the undeads looked up with dull eyes.
These undeads had evolved in all kinds of strange ways. Some had arms like sickles, some crawled on the ground, some had lower bodies like spiders. Only the low-level undeads still retained their complete human appearance, at most, their fangs and fingernails were sharp.
“The strength of the undead kingdom is not to be underestimated...”Dudian looked at the countless undeads that he had seen along the way. His initial contempt had disappeared and he was a bit scared. The undeads here were as numerous as ants, moreover most of them had evolved to be fierce. They weren’t ordinary low-level undeads. If they were to attack the Empire or the federation under the call of the undead kingdom’s emperor...
No one would be able to stop them!
Undeads weren’t afraid of death. They fought crazily and were covered in viruses. Both the Federation’s Mechs and the Empire’s hunters couldn’t avoid them. It was difficult to resist the impact of the countless undeads!
However, from the memories of Lin Changsheng and the tyrant King, Dudian found that although the undead kingdom occupied the north, it didn’t like to fight with the Empire and the federation. It seemed to be independent from Earth and didn’t care about the war, it would never take the initiative to invade the Empire or the federation. Usually, it would be destroyed by the Empire’s army before it would launch a counterattack. Usually, it was very honest.
It was precisely because of this that neither the Empire nor the federation paid much attention to the corpse kingdom.
However, not paying attention did not mean that the demon emperor and Lin Changsheng had ignored it. They had always been thinking of ways to investigate the situation of the corpse kingdom, but it was extremely difficult for humans to sneak into the corpse kingdom. They could only send experts with special abilities.., however, these experts could only deceive the eyes of low-level zombies. If they encountered a high-level zombie king that had a consciousness, it would be very easy for them to be exposed. Even the Zombie Army that Lin Changsheng had trained with conditioned reflex had not been able to sneak into the corpse kingdom.
After all, it was difficult to complicate the instructions of the conditioned reflex. It was difficult to cover all aspects in order to infiltrate the Kingdom of corpses. In the end, the undeads would sink into the sea and never return.
When the spacecraft went deep into the hinterland of the Kingdom of corpses, Dudian found that the undeads that he saw along the way suddenly ran in the same direction as the spacecraft, it was as if... The undeads knew where he would land and deliberately rushed over!
“The Kingdom of corpses has also mastered technology...”Dudian’s eyes lit up. Apparently the spies at the border of the Kingdom of corpses had seen the spaceship and passed the information to the center of the Kingdom of corpses and then to the outer ring group of undeads, such a fast and tight communication method was not inferior to the Empire and the federation. He was more and more surprised. He looked at the god of Wa who was by his side. There shouldn’t be any trouble with her guarding the place.
A moment later, an imperial city appeared at the end of the spaceship. It was built almost like a human city, but it was even more magnificent and majestic. Inside the city were strange structures. Some looked like human limbs, and some looked like the organs of animals, looking from high up in the sky, it was as if countless giant corpses had been put together. It was a living demon city!
At the moment, there were a lot of undeads gathered in the city. They looked at the spaceship. Some undeads were screaming as if they wanted to scratch the spaceship down.
Dudian looked around and saw a few scorching lifeforce on the giant hand in the middle of the Kingdom of corpses. Most of them were the kings and experts of the Kingdom of corpses.
Whoosh!
The spaceship whistled over and slowly slowed down in front of the giant hand. There was a square on top of the giant hand. It was very spacious. There were many undeads standing on top of it. There were more than a dozen figures in the middle of the square.
There was a black-haired young man in white standing in the middle of the group. He looked like a handsome human compared to the strange undeads around him.
There was no change in his body. The smell of undeads was stronger than any of the undeads around him!
Crack!
The spaceship opened and Dudian and God wa slowly flew out. They looked at the undeads on the giant palm.
“Are you the king of the Undead Empire?”Dudian looked at the young man in white. He was about 1.78 meters tall. He looked like a small dot compared to the dozens of undeads around him.
“Are you the ‘God’who conquered the federation and suppressed the Empire?”The youth in white smiled as he looked at Dudian, “Do you want to use the same method to suppress our undead empire?”
Dudian was surprised: “You actually know about me? My news shouldn’t have reached your undead empire, right?”
“We naturally have a way to know.”The youth in white smiled: “It is very difficult for you to tame the undeads but it is very easy for us undeads to tame you humans. After all, you are smarter than us.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1247
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1247: Chapter 1236: Undead Emperor
Translator: 549690339
Dudian indifferently said: “There are advantages to being smart but there are disadvantages to being stupid. I don’t know if you are willing to be the smart one or the stupid one.”
The youth in white smiled: “I can make smart people listen to me. Naturally they are smarter people.”
“That would be the best.”Dudian looked at him, “It shouldn’t be too difficult for you to conquer the Empire and the federation. Why didn’t you do such a smart thing before?”
“War is not a smart thing. Only stupid people are forced to think of a better way to start a war.”The youth in white smiled: “They are like two boors. They can’t reason with each other and can’t negotiate. In the end, they have to act.”
Dudian indifferently said: “Unfortunately there are too many stupid people in this world. We can only use our fists to wake them up.”
“Fortunately I am not such a stupid person.”The youth in White said.
Dudian deeply looked at him. He thought that there would be a massacre and rivers of blood. He didn’t expect that the undead Emperor would surrender, but how many people in the world would choose the Smart Path?
“Can you tell the reason?”Dudian asked.
The youth looked at him, “You can suppress the Empire and the federation. I believe that you are the ‘God’that they pursue. But you are a human. I believe that even if you have been nurtured by one of them, you should be free now. Otherwise you wouldn’t have overthrown them, right?”
Dudian quietly listened: “That’s right.”
“In some ways, our positions are the same. After all, we were once... humans.”The youth put away the indifferent smile on his face. There was a bit of coldness in his eyes, “The Empire and the federation belong to the Aragami and the ice worm respectively. The Fire Dragon Kingdom is controlled by the flame worm. The three forces occupy the earth and use humans as experiments.”
“They are a balance. No matter which side I attack, I will break the balance. Once I break the balance, there will be a worse situation. This is one of the reasons why I don’t want to attack.”
“The second reason is for the ordinary humans.”
“Once the war breaks out, there will be countless casualties. At the same time, more people will be infected by the virus and become half-human and half-corpse like us. I don’t want to see that.”
Dudian’s eyes widened. He couldn’t help but be surprised. The Undead Emperor had said that war was a stupid thing to do. But now he said that he didn’t want to go to war, was it to prevent the Empire and the federation from sacrificing human beings? And to prevent them from being infected and becoming undeads?
The youth in white smiled as he saw Dudian’s face full of surprise and strangeness, “Although I know it’s strange to say so, but I’m serious. Logically speaking, the more infected people are, the stronger my power will be. It’s not impossible to unify the world, but...”
He paused for a moment and bitterly smiled: “You don’t believe me. In fact, I want to be a human.”
Dudian was speechless.
An undead emperor who controlled countless undeads and undead kings actually said that he wanted to be a human?
“Is this black humor?”Dudian said in a bad tone.
The youth in white shook his head, “More than 200 years ago, I was infected by the virus and became an undead. After a period of muddleheadedness, I evolved into an undead king and gave birth to my current consciousness. After the birth of my consciousness, I hunted a large number of humans and infected the strong ones. I made them become undeads and absorbed them as my subordinates. They accompanied me in battles!”
“At that time, the corpse kingdom was not established yet, and the empire was still building giant walls.”
“I killed countless people and monsters. My evolution speed was very fast, and I gathered a large number of corpse kings to work for me.”
“In order to become stronger, kill more people, and eat more delicious flesh and blood, I learned human culture, learned human technology, and learned human life...”
His eyes showed some gentleness, he said softly, “As I learned more and more things, I realized that these delicious foods are not just for eating. Humans are very interesting. Through understanding human knowledge, I also know what I am and the reason for my birth. I really want to know what the memory of being a human in my brain is.”
“What kind of person would I be before I was infected by the Undead?”
“Unfortunately, neither human technology nor the technology of the magic insects nor the technology of the Aragami can help me solve this mystery. Unless I become a God!”
“However, from the research data of the Aragami and magic insects, I know that it is impossible for the undead to become a god. So I also know that if the Aragami and the Aragami give birth to a god, my good days will be over.”
He sighed but wasn’t sad. He looked up at dudian: “Now that God has been born, and not the Aragami and magic insects, this is an unexpected surprise for me.”
Dudian listened in a daze. If he didn’t see the expression of the undead emperor, he wouldn’t have believed his ears. He thought that the undead emperor was like the Demon Emperor, he didn’t expect that the Grand Corpse Emperor would say such words. He wanted to become a human and was ready to wait for the birth of God.
“Since you know that God will be born, haven’t you thought of destroying the Empire and federation at all costs to stop their research? Wouldn’t the entire Earth fall into your hands?”Dudian couldn’t help but ask.
The youth in white sighed. He seemed to have experienced the vicissitudes of life, he said in a lonely tone: “I have ruled corpse country for so many years. My territory is as far as my eyes can see. No one dares to disobey my orders! But what is the meaning of this?”
“When your eyes see your subordinates, they will respect you, fear you, and fear you. But no one will understand you. They will know your ideals and ambitions. They will know your expectations and fantasies. They will not dare to speak freely with you. They will not be able to chat with you...”
“The throne, the throne, only one person sits on it. It is destined that the scenery he sees will be higher than everyone else’s, and it is also destined that no one will understand you!”
“Our Corpse Kingdom’s territory is larger than the empire, and larger than the federation. Even if we rule the entire world, how far can I See? It is just the end of the horizon. After all, this earth is round...”

chapters.title: Chapter 1248
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1248: Chapter 1237: Immortal
Translator: 549690339
“Is it because of loneliness...”Dudian stared at the undead emperor. From Lin Changsheng’s memory, he had experienced the feeling of being a “King”for more than 200 years.
However, he didn’t know if Lin Changsheng’s memory was affected by intelligence or because of lack of emotion. So he didn’t experience deep loneliness. On the contrary, he experienced the feeling of being in control of everything, it left a deep impression on him.
“It’s true that being a king is lonely, but how could an ordinary commoner not be lonely?”Dudian looked at it, he slowly said: “It’s the same loneliness. Everyone wants to explore and understand the loneliness of a king. But who would care about the loneliness of an ordinary commoner? Who would want to understand? If you don’t stand on a high ground and be watched by thousands of people, even if your mentality is as arrogant as a king and as lonely as a king, no one would want to know your thoughts and care about your feelings. Perhaps this is true loneliness?”
The youth in White was slightly startled, he bitterly smiled: “This loneliness is not the same as loneliness. Although humans have troubles in life, but they also have fun in life. They are happy, angry, sad and happy from the bottom of their hearts. However, when they become a king, there will always be only one kind of emotion, that is apathy. This kind of apathy is not pretending to be arrogant. It is just that I have seen too much and everything is clear. So everything is boring. I would rather be lonely than boring.”
Dudian indifferently said: “That’s because you have never been a human. You have never experienced despair and can not control it. It is worse than death. You will know when you taste it. Compared to controlling everything, loneliness is nothing? Moreover, loneliness is like good wine. You can slowly taste it. It is much more interesting to enjoy it with others. A group of people are happy. What is the difference between them and a group of Fools?”
The youth in white shook his head: “Everyone’s pursuit is different. It seems that we are destined to not talk together.”
“Why should the monarch and the minister talk together? This is what you mean by loneliness.”Dudian indifferently said: “Are you willing to sincerely submit to me and obey my orders?”
The youth in white looked at him deeply: “I am willing.”His answer was very straightforward. It seemed that there was no hesitation.
“What’s Your Name?”Dudian asked.
The youth in white smiled: “We have been talking for a long time and you want to ask my name. Are you too forgetful?”
“I’m not forgetful. It’s just that I didn’t need to know it before.”Dudian said straightforwardly.
The youth in White was stunned for a moment, “In other words, I was lucky to escape from a disaster. It’s true that with the strength of you and the true God by your side, if we were to fight with you, we would only be asking for trouble. Although our research on God is not as deep as that of the Empire and the federation, but we also know that the true God is immortal and has no flaws. Previously, the Devil Emperor detonated nuclear weapons and killed millions of civilians in the imperial city. His goal was not to kill the true God by your side but you. However, he still underestimated the ability of the true God.”
Dudian narrowed his eyes: “You know it in detail.”
The youth in white smiled, “My name is Berlin. I don’t know what my previous name was when I was a human. Do you have a way to solve the zombie virus so that all the undeads can become adults?”
Dudian’s eyes lit up: “Do you want to let the undeads recover or do you just want to see if I have the means?”
“Naturally, I want to let everyone recover. I want to become an adult.”Berlin laughed.
Dudian narrowed his eyes: “Do you want to become an adult?”
“I want to know what kind of person I used to be. I also want to be a human and have children.”Berlin’s smile disappeared as he stared at dudian.
Dudian was silent for a moment: “I need to look through your memory.”
Berlin was slightly startled but he wasn’t too surprised. He nodded: “Alright.”
Dudian looked at him. To look through the memory meant to touch the brain. It was the same as holding its life in his hand. He was willing to do such a thing. It was obvious that he was willing to submit to him. However, it was difficult for him to understand, his biggest wish was to become a human?
What was the long-cherished wish of the human race?
He raised his hand and pressed it on Berlin’s forehead. Berlin didn’t resist and allowed his finger to touch his forehead.
The next moment, Dudian searched through Berlin’s memories. A large number of memories were quickly flipped through in his mind. From the bloodthirsty killing when Berlin’s consciousness was born to the growth of intelligence, he would use all kinds of tricks to kill humans and monsters. At that time, there was no difference between humans and monsters. If there was a difference then it would be that one was weak and the other was strong.
He wantonly hunted and rapidly evolved. He used tough means to control other king corpses to serve him. Gradually, he formed a scale and became a territory. Then he gathered more and more undeads into his territory and became his warriors.
It led the zombie kings to sweep all over the place. When they met other zombie kings, they would not be subdued and would sit down. Their power was like a snowball rolling bigger and bigger, eventually forming a small country.
After fighting for decades, its killing intent gradually faded. It was as if it had killed too many and was tired of killing. Reality proved that if one did too many things in this world, they would find it boring.
In these years, it came into contact with the Empire and the federation. During the gradual in-depth contact, it gradually gained a deeper understanding of humans. It also inadvertently infected the habits of humans. In the end, it led many zombie kings to settle down in the north and occupied a large area of territory, it was equal to the Empire and the federation.
In its later memories, it rarely fought. Instead, it was like human beings, building palaces and residences, drinking tea and flowers, drinking and having fun. It played with all the things that human beings loved, and its desire for human beings grew, it hoped to become a real human being. It always wondered what it would feel like to drink fine wine with the taste buds of human tongues?
When a person was silent, he would often think about the past, but he always had no clue.
From the memories of the first two hundred years, the Berlin Undead Emperor didn’t lie. In the later memories, Dudian saw a memorable figure. It was Aisha.
In Berlin’s memories, Aisha suddenly appeared at the border of the Kingdom of corpses. She was informed by the undead king that an extremely powerful undead king had come to her territory. She personally went to meet him. She was surprised by Aisha’s appearance, she actually had a heart filled with admiration.
However, Aisha’s performance was very cold and distant. When the Corpse Emperor first met her, the two of them fought without a word. Aisha’s strength was not inferior to the corpse emperor’s, and it was actually a draw.
The corpse emperor stopped to ask for peace and brought Aisha to the corpse kingdom’s royal city as an honored guest. However, Aisha didn’t stay in the corpse kingdom for long and left this place. Before she left, the corpse emperor asked her where she was going. She only said that she was going to find a way for zombies to become gods.
..
..
It was almost over. The book had almost finished expressing what it should express. It was estimated that it would explode before it ended in the next few days

chapters.title: Chapter 1249
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1249: Chapter 1238: Waiting
Translator: 549690339
“She wants to become a god?”Dudian was stunned as he saw this. He let go of Berlin.
Berlin slightly twisted his neck as he heard Dudian’s words: “You told the world to look for her trace. Do you know her before? Do you know what kind of person she used to be?”
Dudian slowly came back to his senses: “She is a unique person. A kind and strong person.”
Berlin sighed: “In that case, she is indeed a good person. It is a pity that when you are a good person, it is always easy for things to happen to you. I guess I used to be a good person...”
Dudian glanced at him: “The people who are in trouble are not all good people. They are just the majority. You are not necessarily a good person. Maybe you are a villain.”
“It’s hard to say.”Berlin refuted: “Look at the battlefield. The most valiant people should be awarded the title of hero. It’s not the veterans who survived but the soldiers who have died in the battle. The people who survived from the battlefield might be deserters or cowards. They charge at the back so they survive. The valiant people usually charge at the front.”
When the two armies clashed, the faster they ran, the faster the strong ones died. Therefore, the strong died, and the weak survived. It was not the weak who died first. The strong survived tenaciously. In such a large battlefield, how could it be controlled by individual ability
Similarly, good people were prone to accidents. Why? Because good people were always kind-hearted and would help, and then they would lose themselves. On the other hand, those who stood by and watched were safe and sound
“If good people don’t help, they will naturally survive. But how can they be considered as good people?”? “So this is a strange theory. Use your human mathematical formula to calculate it. Good people are equal to death and evil people are equal to life. In other words, those who survive are evil people. If there are good people who survive, then nothing big will happen to the good person. So there is no need for him to stand up.”
Dudian indifferently said: “Human society is more complicated than you think. It is not just good people and evil people. It is not a simple two formulas to distinguish them. It is better for you not to do in-depth research. Otherwise, with your strength and status, it is inevitable that you will do harm to yourself.”
Berlin smiled but did not refute or agree.
Dudian was not in the mood to tell him more, dudian continued: “Since the undead kingdom has submitted to us, watch the border for the next few days. I will hold the coronation ceremony and unify all the forces on land. You should also respond to the banner. In the future you might join me in the war against the sea monsters. We will destroy the forbidden areas on earth one by one so that my people can step into every corner of the world!”
Berlin nodded with a smile: “I didn’t misjudge you. You will stand on the side of the human race.”
“That’s because the human race is under my control.”Dudian indifferently replied. He turned around and returned to the spaceship with God Wa.
Berlin looked at the spaceship which was leaving and disappeared into the horizon. He slowly retracted his eyes and sighed: “Although he is an evil person but what he has done is good.”
Just as he was about to turn around and return to the palace, a three-headed six-armed corpse king suddenly hugged him and bit him on the neck.
Berlin didn’t expect the corpse king to attack him. After all, these corpse kings were all under his control, so there wouldn’t be any master-devouring incidents. He was caught off guard, and the corpse king was very close to him and extremely fast, he did not manage to react in time and was bitten by the corpse king.
In the next moment, he suddenly erupted. With a shake of his arms, he pushed the corpse king away.
Buzz!
After pushing the corpse king away, he felt his brain buzzing and his eyes were bloodshot. An evil thought was born in his mind. A moment later, he panted heavily and slowly calmed down. The expression on his face changed slightly, the Aura on his entire body was also somewhat cold and demonic. It was quite different from the feeling when he was dressed in a gentle and elegant white robe.
“I didn’t make the wrong bet. God is controlled by humans, what a joke! “I knew it. As long as I’m willing to submit, I won’t fight. In the future, after unifying this planet, I won’t be able to resist the urge to conquer the starry skies and kill the demon bugs and Aragami’s nest.”Berlin’s eyes were cold, a cold smile hung on his lips. “After killing the demon bugs and Aragami, he won’t be able to resist the urge to continue exploring the universe.”
“There is no limit to this vast universe. No one knows if there are only the demon bug and the Aragami, the two alien life forms. Perhaps there are other life forms and higher civilizations...”
“Gods have a long lifespan. When they finish looking at their own territories, they will continue to open up new territories and continue to fight endlessly. They will only stop when they encounter powerful enemies that they can not defend against...”
“No matter what, when he conquers the universe in the future, how will this Earth be worth his attention?”? “When that time comes, it will fall into my hands. Even though it will be subservient to others, who in this world can truly be number one?”? “Who knows if there are stronger existences above number one?”
“Such a greedy pursuit, let him search for it. I am already satisfied that I can obtain the right to rule this planet...”
“But I’ll have to wait.”
“Fortunately, the ending is good. There is no harm in waiting. I’ve been waiting for more than 200 years...”
..
..
The spaceship whizzed past the corpse kingdom. Its speed was not as fast as before because Dudian did not know where to go.
Where would he find Aisha in this big world?
If it was the old era where humans were all over the world, an international wanted list would be enough to find the ends of the Earth. But now it was different. He could only rely on himself to find Aisha.
“I have to use the technology of the Federation to restore order to the Empire and the Fire Dragon Kingdom...”Dudian’s eyes flashed. He was a bit upset as he thought of this, it would take a few months to use the technology of the Federation to restore this place to the old era. It might take a year or two to get results. But at this moment he felt that it would be torturous if he didn’t wait for a day.
The world had been conquered but it was more difficult to find a person than to conquer the entire world!
“She is not in the empire and has left the corpse kingdom. She is not in the federation. The Fire Dragon Kingdom is also looking for her. So far there is no news from her. She doesn’t have many places to go. Could she be in the Deep Mountains?”Dudian used the elimination method to think, he frowned.
He didn’t return to the Empire but flew along the deserted desert, swamps and other remote places.
After half a day, the sun had set but Dudian still couldn’t find any trace. He couldn’t help but sigh. Finding a needle in a haystack wasn’t a solution. Moreover, Aisha could move. If it was wood, it wouldn’t move if it grew in one place, he turned the ground over inch by inch. Sooner or later, he would find it. But if Aisha was wandering around and happened to pass by him, wouldn’t she be wandering in circles?
“Where are you...”Dudian looked at the dark forest and sighed.

chapters.content:

Chapter 1250: Chapter 1239: God Dynasty
Translator: 549690339
Dudian piloted the spaceship back to the imperial capital.
That night, Dudian asked God Wa to go to the moon to search for the magic insect base inside the Moon. He used memory fragments to transmit the information about the moon to her so that she could conquer it for him.
“Mom, I’ll be back soon.”God Wa happily ran out like a child going to an amusement park.
Dudian watched her leave. There was a bit of gentleness in his eyes. God wa called him “Mom”. How could he not think of her as his own child? Moreover, they came from the same body, there was always a sense of kinship between them.
“The vacuum of the universe is difficult for my body to resist. Although she hasn’t learned how to defend but she should be able to slowly master it on the way out of the atmosphere.”Dudian thought.
The vacuum of the universe was a forbidden zone for living things. The reason wasn’t just lack of oxygen but also the radiation of all kinds of cosmic rays and the difference in temperature. The temperature near the sun was scorching while the back was bone-chilling. It was close to absolute zero!
Even the magic insect didn’t dare to rely on its body to drift in space. The sudden change in temperature was enough to destroy the balance of the living things in its body. But it wasn’t a problem for a true God, it could go deep into the core of the Sun and move in absolute zero. After all, the true absolute zero didn’t exist. It could only be infinitely close to it.
Moreover, even if it really entered the absolute zero environment, it could create a thermal reactor in its body. It could destroy the absolute zero environment and use its outer shell as armor to resist, they would be able to form another layer of environment to survive.
All of this was only a matter of time for a true God. But for Dudian, he needed to rely on the energy of the mechanical heart. Moreover, it was extremely difficult.
“Not letting her sit in the spaceship is also to train her to stimulate her own potential.”Dudian’s eyes flashed. Although God was a true God, but it was far from the complete form of the true God in the theory of Aragami and magic insects.
In the theory of Aragami and magic insects, God was omnipotent. It could even swallow the sun, assimilate the planet, and merge its body into any celestial body in the universe, including the black hole that could shatter light!
It was immortal, eternal and indestructible. It was omnipotent. It could live with the universe but not necessarily die together!
God Wa was far from being a true God. It was like a toddler!
But even if she was just a toddler, she had the power to suppress all life on Earth!
“Where are you...”Dudian looked at the night sky.
The next day, God Wa returned to the imperial capital from the sky. She passed the information about the Moon base to Dudian. It was as if Dudian had personally experienced it.
