All the magic insects in the Moon base were subdued by her, the rebels were eaten as food. The rest of the magic insects were instilled with the slave’s memory. They were loyal to her and acknowledged her as their master.
These magic insects continued to manage the Moon base for her. According to Dudian’s instructions, God wa told them to block the information about the earth.
Dudian thought for a while and called Neuss, Mason, Barton and others, he said: “The undead emperor of the undead kingdom has submitted to me. The Fire Dragon Kingdom has given the military power to us to control. The Dragon King is willing to follow the orders of the imperial capital. As for the federation, it has been under reform for a long time. The imperial capital is under our control.”
“Great Emperor is wise!”Neuss bowed respectfully. There was a bit of joy in his eyes.
Mason, Barton, Aurora and the others who were closest to Dudian were all happy. They knew about the surrender of the undead kingdom last night. The changes during this period of time made them feel incredible, it was like a dream.
Not long ago they were trembling in fear in a small giant wall. But now with the help of Dudian they had become kings of the Abyss. Even the Lord of the abyss.., they were nothing but ants in front of them!
In addition to their own strength, the most exciting and shocking thing was the power that Dudian controlled. The whole continent and the whole world belonged to them!
In the past, they wouldn’t even dare to think about such a thing. But now it had come true!
Dudian smiled: “When do you think it would be good to unify the forces?”
Neuss’s mind was flexible, he immediately said: “The world is united under the feet of the emperor. I suggest that we choose a good day to invite the emperor to ascend the throne and become the Lord of the world. We will integrate all the forces and build an eternal empire!”
“The sun doesn’t set?”Dudian paused: “There was such an empire in history but it was destroyed.”
“Let’s call it the Sun Empire!”A gentle youth who was standing at the back excitedly said. It was Dean’s student Edward. He said: “The Sun is eternal and the teacher’s dynasty is eternal!”
Dean smiled and shook his head: “The Sun has a lifespan but it is too long for humans. So it is eternal to be comparable to the Sun.”
Everyone was startled.
Neuss was the first to react. He was shocked as he didn’t expect Dean’s ambition to be so big. It was difficult to satisfy him even if he lived as long as the sun. He felt uneasy but didn’t show it, he recommended: “How about the dynasty of God? Live with God and live with the Universe!”
Dudian looked at him and smiled: “The universe is the meaning of time. It is a good moral. Let’s call it that.”
Everyone was relieved and congratulated him.
“You can choose the day of the coronation.”Dudian closed his eyes: “It will be held in three months.”
Neuss respectfully said: “I will find the best astrologer and choose the best day.”
Everyone slowly left the hall. Dudian had become the Lord of the world and had established the dynasty of ten thousand generations. They were the most trusted people in Dudian’s group. Naturally they had a high position and authority.
Half a month later.
Dudian personally chose the imperial capital of the dynasty. He didn’t find anyone to calculate the geographical structure. He didn’t believe in this. He directly appointed Sylvia as the imperial capital and rebuilt the giant wall of Sylvia. It was even grander than the current imperial capital.
Dudian also received a lot of information about the giant wall of Sylvia. There were also some flattering words from the noble marquises, most of them praised Sylvia’s excellent geography, proximity to the Sun, God’s blessed land, and the ability to nurture the aura of the emperor.
Dudian casually looked through some of the information. He was stunned when he saw one of the volumes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1251
chapters.content:
?
Chapter 1251: Chapter 1240: Out of control
Translator: 549690339
This volume of information was about the Aragami in the giant wall of Sylvia. The giant wall was the tomb of the Aragami. The name of the Aragami buried in Sylvia was “Sylvia”. However, the details of the identity of the Aragami were recorded here including her identity when she was alive... Human!
“Sister, Sister...”
Dudian looked at the identity of ‘Sylvia’in his hand. The photo was posted on the top of the file. It was his sister who had been separated for three hundred years!
The sister who had taken a last look at the freezer before it closed..
The sister who had taken care of him since he was young and stood up for him in everything..
She... was actually Sylvia!
After conquering the empire, Dudian learned some things about the Aragami from the information collected in the imperial capital. Although the core secrets of the Aragami were destroyed by the emperor and the imperial city but there were many ancient families in the imperial capital, some of the ancient secrets were not erased but secretly recorded and fell into his eyes.
As early as three hundred years ago, when the Aragami and the demonic insects invaded Earth, the demonic insects had invaded the earth head-on, fighting against all the countries on Earth. However, the Aragami were much more cunning, they invaded the earth from the other side, like parasites, they infiltrated the human society, parasitizing the human body. The best among them had blended into the upper class of the human society, urging the humans to fight against the demonic insects.
And this aragami named “Sylvia”had occupied the human body of her sister, Duannie!
Once an Aragami latched onto another creature, it would either devour the original consciousness of the creature and occupy the nest of the magpie, or be devoured by the original consciousness of the creature. Its body would become nutrients and become the power of the evolution of the original creature. However, there was a third unexpected situation. The consciousness of the original creature and the Aragami would interfere with each other and mix with each other. They would not be able to distinguish who was who. In the end, they would not be an Aragami nor a human.
This kind of accident also led to the ruin of the Aragami’s conspiracy. Many Aragami were exposed and pushed from behind the scenes to the front of the screen to participate in the war. This resulted in a large number of Aragami who died in the war!
“No wonder... No wonder my freezing chamber would appear in the giant wall of Sylvia. It would appear in the giant wall and not in the wilderness outside the giant wall...”Dudian was stunned. At first he thought that it was just a fluke, but now it seemed that his sister who was living in the giant wall had protected his freezer! It was unknown why his freezer had fallen out and piled up in the garbage.
In other words, his sister wasn’t dead when the giant wall was built!
It also meant that although his sister was living in the giant wall, she didn’t completely lose consciousness. It was possible that she had become a second or third type existence!
“Sister... She... helped me...”Dudian’s body couldn’t help but Twitch. He punched the table and the whole table turned into dust. He painfully closed his eyes. His sister was right in front of him, he didn’t find out about it in advance. He didn’t even notice it. Most importantly... he had dissected Sylvia’s body when he became the wall master.
Not only did he not repay his loved ones, he even ruined her body!
Bastard!
The documents in his hands were crushed. He punched his chest and broke the ribs on his chest. His body healed automatically. However, he waved his sharp blade in anger and tore the wound on his chest even wider. The pain was unbearable, every nerve in his body was affected. The pain was unbearable.
When the pain was unbearable, his thoughts became less clear, and the frustration and pain in his heart became less intense.
Physical pain could indeed replace the pain in his heart!
“Damn it, damn it, damn it, damn it...”he punched his body, and even his arm was cut off by the demonized sharp blade on his shoulder. He hated his arms, and he regretted his actions back then. Now, to him.., he could have as many Aragami bodies as he wanted but he couldn’t make up for what he had done.
No matter how strong he was, he couldn’t... Reverse Time!
The Maids and guards in the imperial palace heard the violent shaking of the walls as well as angry roars.
Neuss and Aurora who were living in the palace were startled. They were about to check the situation but Dudian roared out. They could only stand outside and wait. Their faces were filled with worry.
“What happened to teacher?”Aurora whispered.
Neuss looked at the room that was emitting golden light. He sighed and shook his head: “I don’t know what he is thinking...”
Aurora looked at him: “Teacher seems to be losing his temper recently.”
“He is more likely to lose control than before.”Neuss whispered. His voice was filled with bitterness. What did it mean to lose control? It meant that he would no longer restrain himself.
He knew that the world was Dudian’s. There was no need to be afraid of anyone or anything. Why would he restrain himself?
But what would a person become if he didn’t restrain himself?
Aurora wasn’t a little girl who had taken revenge for her sister. She had trained in the giant wall of Sylvia. She had experienced the ups and downs of the imperial capital. She had witnessed the ups and downs of countless aristocratic families during the succession of new kings, she had long been aware of the situation. She looked at the person who was the most familiar to her teacher. She suddenly felt anxious.
“Perhaps we haven’t found Miss Aisha...”aurora whispered.
Noyce silently nodded. He hoped that they would find her soon. She was probably the only one who could calm him down and restore his wisdom and calmness.
A night passed.
The haze over the Imperial City seemed to have been dispelled by the morning light. Dudian sat on the ground in the study room. His eyes were dull and listless. He looked at the air in a daze. After a night of venting.., his thoughts were clearer but the regret and pain were still lingering in his heart.
For a long time.
His numb thoughts started to move slowly. He suddenly thought of a problem. If his sister was occupied by the Aragami, what about his father and mother?
Thinking of this, he suddenly woke up and stood up from the ground. He quickly found Noyce and asked him to bring up all the Aragami information on the giant wall. Soon, a thick stack of information was piled up in his other study.
He quickly read through it five times in less than ten minutes. He didn’t see any trace of his parents. He was relieved but also a bit disappointed.
“God is omnipotent. It would be great if he could resurrect them...”Dudian thought. But his reason told him that it was impossible. Even if he could create his parents and sister.., he could only create people based on his memory of them. All the thoughts that he had when they were acting were instilled in their minds.
It was equivalent to him creating his parents from 300 years ago. They were not real parents who had experienced 300 years of changes in the world.
Perhaps this was true?
After all, his parents from three hundred years ago were also his parents. The subsequent changes in their conversation and emotions were also based on the reaction of his parents’character.
His heart suddenly became hot as he thought of this. He immediately began to try.
“Father, mother, sister, I want you all to come back to life!”Dudian’s eyes lit up. The cells in his body surged. A lump of flesh appeared on his arm and gradually turned into a human shape.
The first person who was demonized was the mother who created him. She was a clever female doctor.
Soon, his mother appeared in front of him. She was wearing cotton clothes which were made by transformation method.
The second person was his father. A middle-aged man with a thin face and a serious expression stood in front of him.
The third person was his sister in his memory. She was a little girl who was over ten years old. Her lips were red and her teeth were white. It was obvious that she was a beauty.
The three of them stood motionless like three statues.
Dudian went forward and instilled memories into them one by one.

chapters.title: Chapter 1252
chapters.content:
Chapter 1252: Chapter 1241: “The Savior”
Translator:
549690339
A moment later, Dudian entered all the memories into their minds. He felt an inexplicable tension in his heart. He took two steps back and looked at them with expectation, nervousness, and some fear.
At this moment, he didn’t have the indifference of a chess piece with the lives of millions of people. He didn’t have the majesty of a high and mighty emperor. He was like an ignorant youth who didn’t understand the world. All his emotions were expressed in words, it was shown on his face.
The first person to move was his mother. She was the first to accept the memory indoctrination. It seemed that part of the memory had been digested by her brain and absorbed by her body. Her dull eyes regained vitality and seemed to wake up, she turned her head and saw Dudian in front of her: “Who are you? where is this place? Dudian, wake up! Anne, you are here too! That’s Great!”
Her father and sister Anne woke up. Dudian was relieved to see that the mother and daughter were safe and sound. He looked at the surroundings and saw that Dudian was the only one present, he frowned: “Where is this place? Who Are You?”
Dudian looked at them in a daze. The familiar tone and familiar expression were so real. It was as if he was in a dream!
“I am Dean...”he couldn’t help but take a few steps forward. He was afraid that the structure would fail. He didn’t instill the changes of the world three hundred years after the disaster into their minds. He didn’t change his image in their minds, “Father, I am Dean. I am still alive. The end of the world has come. But I hid in the freezer and survived!”
The three of them were shocked. They carefully looked at Dudian but found that his appearance was somewhat similar to when he was a child, but he was more handsome.
“Are you really dean?”Father du Sheng was surprised. Not many people knew about the freezer. He went against the will of the nation and used the research results on his own “Child”, although the child was one of the research results of their laboratory.
Dudian nodded repeatedly, he said: “Father, this is the world after the disaster. The governments of various countries have been destroyed. I have listened to you and built a new home for the survivors. Moreover, I have mastered the technology of the alien monsters to bring you back to life.”
The three of them were shocked again. They looked at each other in disbelief. When they saw the buildings of different styles, they realized that the situation might be similar to what Dudian had said, their memories were stuck in the scene when Dudian was put into the freezer. Naturally, they knew what kind of disaster the earth was going to face. However, they didn’t expect that the human world wouldn’t be able to withstand this disaster. The governments of the countries were destroyed!
Thinking about the powerful forces in the hands of the countries all over the world, Dusheng couldn’t help but shiver. It was clear how ferocious the invading monsters were.
However, when he saw Dudian in front of him, he felt a bit relieved and proud. Although the governments of the world had been destroyed but the human race hadn’t been exterminated!
As a scientist, although what Dudian said was incredible, but he quickly believed Dudian’s words.
“Are you really little dean?”At this time, the small and lively girl Duanne came over with her hands behind her back. She looked up at dudian. In the past, she would often look down at Dudian in the same posture.
Dudian saw her cute appearance and couldn’t help but smile, “Of course, sister. I have grown up, but you have just been reborn. You are still as young as before. Remember when I was six years old and knocked over the potassium persulfate in the laboratory. You admitted it for me and let mom talk about it.”
Dudian stared at her and said in surprise: “Are You Really Little Dean?”
Dudian smiled and pinched her little face: “Of course I am. And now I can bully you as I please.”Dudian had used this trick to Knead Dudian, it was used to knead dudian.
She slapped Dudian’s palm away and angrily went back to dudian: “Dad, Look! He is older than me now! He is bullying me!”
Dudian’s heart was completely relaxed as he saw the siblings playing, dudian sighed: “The energy used to equip the freezing chamber was supposed to last for 300 years. I didn’t expect that it would really appear 300 years later. Moreover the technology has developed to the point that it can resurrect the dead. It is incredible. Dean, we want to go outside and see what the world will look like in 300 years!”
Dudian was very obedient: “Yes, father.”
He took the initiative to lead the way. He opened the door to open the way for his father, mother and sister.
There was a huge square outside the door. It was filled with luxurious and noble buildings. There were guards everywhere. The atmosphere was strict. Sergei was the commander of the guards. He was the new king of the Empire. He was too lazy to use his brain and didn’t have much ambition. He only liked to play with women, so he asked Dudian for a guard job. He didn’t need to care about anything. He just needed to patrol and guard the Imperial Palace.
It was a very leisurely job. It was good enough that Dudian didn’t bother others with his current strength. No one would come to the imperial palace to assassinate him.
Sergei was stunned as he saw Dudian lead the three out of the study room. He was shocked as he broke out in cold sweat. He had never seen anyone else enter this place. These three faces were very strange, they had slipped past his eyes. It was terrifying!
“Emperor...”Sergei quickly went forward. He was relieved as he saw that Dudian wasn’t injured.
“Sergei, come and meet my parents. This is my father...”Dudian was still immersed in joy. He took the initiative to introduce his parents and sister to Sergei.
Sergei was stunned. As the first group of people who followed Dudian, he naturally knew that Dudian’s adoptive parents were involved and both of them went into exile. So this was Dudian’s original parents? However, his parents abandoned him and reduced him to the environment of the orphanage. It was equivalent to murder. Logically speaking, it should only be hatred but Dudian’s face was full of genuine joy, he hadn’t seen Dudian so happy for a long time.
After a moment he quickly reacted. Although he was too lazy to think but it didn’t mean that he was stupid. After all this was Dudian’s private matter. He knew the way of the monarch and the minister so he quickly bowed and scratched his head in embarrassment, “Emperor, I... How should I address your parents and sister?”He was just a rough warrior of the giant wall of Sylvia so he didn’t understand the etiquette of the nobles.
Dudian was about to speak but Dudian waved his hand: “Just call us by our names. Are you the subordinates of Dean? How can you call him Earth?”
Sergei scratched his head: “Master is now an emperor so naturally he should be called Emperor or His Majesty.”
“Emperor?”Dudian knew that he had heard ‘emperor’but not ‘earth’. His face slightly changed as he looked at dudian, “Dean, What’s Going On? How did you become the Emperor? Could it be that you...”
Dudian’s mind was sensitive and he immediately thought of all kinds of possibilities. For example, Dudian used the chip that he gave to save the survivors. He received the gratitude of the survivors and was worshipped by the survivors as the king.
Dudian felt his father’s displeasure. He suddenly remembered the exhortation that his father had left behind — to bring hope to the survivors after the disaster and lead the survivors to live so that the human race would not be exterminated.
He had achieved this expectation.
He knew about the plan of the magic worm and the Aragami. He knew the true identity of the survivors in the giant wall. He was convinced of this point. Although his hands were stained with blood and he had killed countless people, the final result was good.
If there was no god of Wa and without him, the world would still be ruled by the magic worm and the Aragami. Once one of them created a god, it meant that all life would be enslaved!
From this point of view, although he didn’t act in the name of the Savior, but there was no doubt that he had become the savior of all mankind! As for the dark means in the process, the people who were killed would be completely overshadowed by glory! Compared to the people he saved, those who died were nothing? At least the result was the best. Human beings wouldn’t be exterminated, wouldn’t be enslaved, and wouldn’t be reared as guinea pigs!
Therefore, he didn’t disappoint his father’s expectations and entrustment.
“Father, it’s a long story. I’ll tell you in detail...”Dudian’s face was calm as he thought through these things.

chapters.title: Chapter 1253
chapters.content:
Chapter 1253: Chapter 1242: everything
Translator:
549690339
Neuss was still unable to digest the shocking news brought by Sergei. Dudian had found his biological parents? How was it possible! Although he had been a king for a short period of time but he had been studying all the time to make up for his lack of knowledge. This included the collection of information about the secret history of the giant wall, he had a fundamental understanding of the capital-the operation procedure of the giant wall.
He was most familiar with the giant wall of Sylvia. He knew that Dudian felt guilty about the death of his adoptive parents. So he looked up the relatives of his adoptive parents, including his ancestors, fortunately, he could find some branch relatives to compensate him.
In addition, he had looked for Dudian’s biological parents. But he didn’t get any useful information from the orphanage. He knew that Dudian’s true identity came from the old era 300 years ago!
His biological parents naturally came from that era!
However, Dudian survived by relying on the freezer. His biological parents were just ordinary people. How could they resist the erosion of time?
“Are you sure that their parents are ordinary people?”Neuss confirmed to Sergei.
Sergei replied without hesitation: “Of course. I am a king now. I can guarantee that unless his adoptive parents are also kings. But I am 100% sure that they are not. No matter how deep they hide, the strange smell of their body can not be hidden!”
Neuss naturally knew that his vision could be trusted. But he had a terrifying thought. If Sergei saw Dudian’s biological parents, then how did they come back to life? Or how did they appear in Dudian’s study?
He thought of Dudian’s ability and his heart couldn’t help but tremble. It was comparable to the power of a god. It was far from being comparable to kings. Even if they were kings, as long as Dudian was willing.., he could create a lot of them!
“Is it really possible to resurrect his own family?”Neuss muttered.
Sergei was stunned: “Resurrect? You mean his parents were resurrected by him? How is it possible? Even a god can’t resurrect a person?”
“If it is a god then maybe it is possible.”Neuss whispered. He didn’t say the last half of the sentence. Dudian wasn’t a true God but a quasi-god. There were only two choices for creation, the first was to completely duplicate the memories of his family members and mold them. The character of the family members created by this method was biased towards the subjective thoughts of the creator. It was one-sided and it was easy to have problems over time.
The second method was to flip through his memories and comb through them from beginning to end. He would separate the memories of his family members and analyze them from different angles, he would analyze their personality and finally summarize a set of personality memories!
Compared to the first one, the second one was slightly better. However, it was only relatively better. After all, no matter how thorough the analysis of personality was, there would inevitably be errors, moreover, Dudian had extracted the memories of his parents from his own memories. It meant that before he was born, his parents’childhood experiences were completely unknown to him, naturally it wasn’t 100% coincidence.
If it wasn’t a coincidence then it meant that the person who was created might not be the original person.
Neuss sighed in his heart as he thought of this. He couldn’t help but feel a bit scared. Since Dudian unified the imperial capital, he could clearly feel the change in Dudian. This kind of change made him feel inexplicable fear, he knew what he was afraid of. He was afraid of Dudian’s power. He was afraid that Dudian’s power was not controlled by others. It was comparable to the power of God!
Would you care about life when you can create life at will?
Would you care about your loved ones when you can resurrect them at will?
Neuss had witnessed too many tragedies of mediocrity. He had seen too many noble families fall. He found that the comedy or tragedy in the world was the most tolerant. There was no distinction between lowly or noble people, he would feel sad when he lost his beloved son. He would feel happy when he got what he dreamed of. It had nothing to do with status, money or power.
A noble would casually waste silk because he had seen too much.
It was the same as a Dalit would waste his rough linen clothes.
“Let’s go and find the young master!”Neuss clenched his teeth. He couldn’t continue to see Dudian’s extreme bigotry. Now he might be able to wake him up even if he had to pay the price of being driven out of the capital, he wouldn’t hesitate to take away his power. He couldn’t watch the young man who had supported and protected them lose his mind!
“Young Master?”Sergei was stunned. He was about to open his mouth to remind him that he couldn’t continue to use this title but he saw that Neuss had already walked away.
..
..
“It’s like this. All the survivors have been unified. The human race will no longer be consumed by infighting. We can gradually clean up the monsters on the land and then clean up the sea monsters to restore the earth to its original state.” Dudian whispered to his father.
Dudian told them about the three hundred years of post-disaster changes. Dudian and the other two were shocked. They didn’t expect that the world had become so dangerous. The virus created by the magic insects had turned the entire earth into a demon den!
The most tragic thing was that humans were enslaved by the magic insects and Aragami. They had become experimental materials and were constantly fighting with each other.
“I see. You have worked hard over the years.”Dudian sighed.
Dudian smiled and shook his head. He was about to say something when he frowned. The door of the study was pushed open. Neuss and Sergei hurried over.
“Master, I have something important to tell you.”Neuss took a deep breath and looked into Dudian’s eyes.
Dudian quietly looked at him: “I know what you want to say. You Don’t have to worry. I haven’t changed and I won’t change.”
Neuss was startled as he looked at Dudian’s dark eyes. He felt that it was difficult to see through the heart of this familiar person. He was silent for a few seconds: “Young Master, please forgive me. I want to talk to you.”
Dudian stared at him for a long time. He slowly nodded and said to his parents: “I’ll be right back. You can rest here. Sister, I’m leaving.”
“Well well, hurry up and go.”Dudian laughed.
Dudian followed Neuss and Sergei to the main hall.
“Go ahead.”Dudian sat on the emperor’s throne as he looked at Neuss and Sergei. His eyes were very calm.
Neuss suddenly knelt on one knee and looked up at dudian: “Master, do you remember the first time we met?”
Dudian indifferently replied: “Of course I remember. I was framed to enter Thorn Flower Prison. Your cell is not far from mine. There aren’t many people left who followed me out of the prison. Only you and Sergei are my favorites.”
Neuss’s heart was boiling hot but he quickly quieted down, he bitterly said: “I am very touched that young master can still remember this. I have sworn in my heart that I will always follow young master. No matter where I go, I will never betray you!”! However, I was weak and couldn’t help young master. I could only help you run errands. But now I have been rewarded by you. I have climbed to the clouds and become a king.”
Dudian looked at him: “You have saved me and followed me. This is what you deserve.”
Neuss bitterly smiled: “Although I am ashamed but I didn’t think to refuse. It feels good to be a king. I have control over the life and death of others. It seems that I don’t lack anything.”
Dudian was silent.
“I understand that when a person has everything, he will lose everything. Even the motivation to live will be lost.”Neuss looked at Dudian with sadness in his eyes, “Master, if one day we die in battle, will you feel sad for us?”
Sergei was shocked: “What nonsense are you talking about!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1254
chapters.content:
Chapter 1254: Chapter 1243: Doomsday
Translator:
549690339
“You won’t die in battle!” Dudian slowly said: “I will sweep away all the dangers on Earth. You just need to manage the operation of the dynasty for me. There are few things that can kill you. As long as you don’t fight to the death then nothing will happen.”
Neuss continued: “Will you feel sorry for us if we die?”
Sergei anxiously said: “Shut Up!”
“Yes!”Dudian said.
Neuss was startled. He didn’t expect that Dudian would answer so decisively. He wanted to ask but Dudian waved his hand to stop him.
“I know what you want to say. You are worried that I will lose my mind and forget myself. But you are overthinking.”Dudian’s tone was calm: “Power is just a tool for me. I have no interest in ruling the land or the earth. I Won’t be influenced by power. My current status doesn’t affect my mentality.”
“You are my friends. Now that you have been conferred the title of nobility, you seem to be my subordinates, but in fact, in my heart, I still treat you as my friends
“However, a country is a country after all. There are no rules. The upper class is chaotic, the middle class is bound to be corrupt, and the lower class will suffer. If you feel that you are living under me and are unwilling, I can give you a piece of land and make you a King!”
Neuss was stunned.
He looked at the youth sitting on the throne. His mouth slightly opened but he couldn’t say anything.
“Young master, you should know that I didn’t mean that...”he bowed his head.
Dudian’s face was calm: “You know me the most. Do you think that I can resurrect my parents and resurrect you in the future? So you are worried that I won’t take you seriously?”
Neuss’s body trembled but he didn’t answer.
Sergei’s heart was beating fast. In his heart dudian was the young master that he was loyal to. He was a monster that killed people without batting an eyelid. Neuss had offended him!
“You say that you have everything but you have nothing. In fact you are telling me that I have too much but I have lost too much. For example, emotions. When material things are satisfied, emotions will inevitably be empty. But this is just a mortal.”Dudian indifferently said: “How can I sleep if I don’t do this when I have the ability to resurrect my parents?”
“Even though I know that they are not my real parents, at least they are made up of my parents’memories. I have also thought about whether using them to replace my parents is a blasphemy
“But what you don’t know is that I miss my parents. Even if I see their substitutes, I will still be happy!”
Neuss buried his head and took a deep breath, he raised his head: “Master, I am not blaming you for reviving your parents. I just think that if a person’s thoughts are satisfied, he will have no regrets in his life. It will be a terrible thing. He will pursue more and more extreme things. At that time, I am afraid that you will no longer be you...”
“So you want me to have flaws in my life?”Dudian’s eyes were cold.
Neuss clenched his teeth: “Master, I don’t mean that. I’m just worried...”
“Your worries are unnecessary!”Dudian snorted, “People work hard in their life. All they want is to satisfy their own desires or desires. When their desires are satisfied, there will be no flaws. In the world of mortals, even if you become the richest person, have hundreds of millions of family assets or become the head of state, there will inevitably be things that can not be done. There will be unappeasable regrets!”
“It is because of these regrets that people want to become stronger and gain strength!”
“Weakness and oppression are the driving forces of progress. When you are finally strong, someone tells you that you should leave behind some regrets. Do you think that this makes sense?”
Neuss slightly opened his mouth as he looked at Dudian’s cold eyes. He knew that it was difficult to describe what he was thinking. But what he was really worried about.., the feeling that Dudian gave him was like an old hunter’s intuition!
But how to describe his intuition? How to make people believe him?
He fell into silence for a long time.
He wanted to struggle and try to say something but he found out that his words were too weak.
He thought again that perhaps he was worrying too much, but through this conversation, not only did the worry in his heart not decrease, it actually became much deeper.
In his muddle-headed state, Noyce did not even know how he walked out of the imperial palace. After walking for a long distance, he suddenly turned his head back and looked at the extremely luxurious palace. Suddenly, he felt a chill run through his entire body, it was as if something warm had been drawn from the bottom of his heart.
“Perhaps, this is the true law of this world?”Noyce muttered to himself. His eyes were blank, and there was also a hint of sadness and desolation. He thought of the changes that he had seen in the imperial city over the past few days, he had seen all the living beings in the various giant walls. The refugees at the bottom were struggling to survive. The nobles were fighting each other. The nobles were also fighting. Everyone was fighting and fighting!
Fighting to get out of the current predicament!
Fighting to get out of the mud!
But after getting out of the predicament?
It was still a new predicament, a new struggle and struggle!
When all the difficulties were solved, nothing would be difficult for him anymore?
Perhaps he would be like the corrupt nobles, having a good time every night, or like the foolish kings in history, indulging in the fragrance of wine and beauty.
When everything was perfect, as time went on, life seemed to become boring again. One could only endure the passage of time, wait for the time to pass, wait for the vitality to be sucked out of the body, wait for the body to rot, die of old age, and wait for one’s own thoughts.., he stopped thinking and completely drained all his strength!
“What is the purpose of living? What is the meaning of the eternal life pursued by the magic bugs and Aragami?”Noyce was confused, perhaps from the moment he was born, he had entered the whirlpool of misery in the world. If he struggled forward, it would be the same as the sea of misery. If he stayed where he was, he would sink into oblivion. If he retreated, where would he find the shore?
“So, the end of the world is not destruction. It is the end of the world if he is alive... it is the end of the world if he struggles to survive...”Noyce muttered to himself. Suddenly, he laughed out loud. His face was filled with loneliness, he turned around and left the square, as well as the luxurious palace. He swung his sleeves and walked toward the morning sun. His shadow was being pulled longer and longer, but his body was getting smaller and smaller.

chapters.title: Chapter 1255
chapters.content:
Chapter 1255: Chapter 1244: the ceremony
Translator:
549690339
Time flew by.
In the blink of an eye it was the day of the coronation.
The ceremony was held in the giant wall of Sylvia. The pioneers outside the giant wall of Sylvia had been swept away. Half of the monsters and undeads were nowhere to be found. The giant wall of Sylvia.., it had become the city within the city. It was the imperial palace that Dudian had registered and lived in in the future.
A larger wall had been built outside the giant wall. It had located the imperial city and moved to a large number of aristocratic families.
The Dark Abyss which had once surrounded the giant wall of Sylvia had been dispersed. The dangerous “Despair forest”had been burned into ashes by the joint efforts of many kings.
The Empire had secretly mastered the giant wall printing technology. It was only a matter of time and materials to print a more magnificent giant wall outside the region. It was completed in less than a week.
With the ascension of the new emperor, various departments and forces in the entire imperial capital were paying close attention to and trying to curry favor with him. They were also busy with this matter, and all the work was carried out extremely quickly.
At the giant wall of Wargod at the borders of the Fire Dragon Kingdom and the federation, the city gates were even ordered to be opened. Within the awe-inspiring giant wall of WARGOD, several towering city gates were dug out, making it convenient for the imperial capital, the Federation, and the Fire Dragon Kingdom to trade with each other, it was also convenient for them to come and visit the coronation ceremony of the new emperor.
Right now, the imperial capital and the Federation, as well as the Fire Dragon Kingdom’s many missionary books that hated each other, had all been burned. All of their beliefs had been unified, although all of this was somewhat special to the lower-class citizens, however, the higher-ups always had a way to let the lower-class citizens get used to it. It was only a matter of time.
Whether it was good or bad, it was only a matter of a single word from the higher-ups.
On the day of the ceremony, the world worshiped. The various aristocratic families, nobles, dukes, marquises and other leaders who had once taken root in the imperial capital personally came to pay their respects and congratulate them. The four major consortiums in the federation, as well as many warlords, also came from thousands of miles away. The many hidden aristocratic families in the fire dragon kingdom, generals and courtiers, all arrived at the scene.
On that day, the spaceship flew across the sky. The fighter jets whizzed across the sky like windshield wipers. Streaks of smoke that looked like rainbows flowed down from the sky. The many champions on the land rode on the tamed Daemons and entered Sylvia, the federation rode the top-tier mechs such as the god of creation and walked over like giants. The champions of the Fire Dragon Kingdom sat on the Earth Dragon and the flying bird. Each of them showed their style and abilities.
The rest of the important figures sat on extremely luxurious carriages. The surroundings were surrounded by the monster cavalry and the group of beautiful maids. They looked extraordinary.
Such a grand scene made the blood of the original inhabitants of Sylvia Boil. They were shocked and excited at the same time. During the period when the giant wall was being rebuilt, there was news from above, the original inhabitants of Sylvia knew that they had been chosen by the most respected emperor in the world to become the Imperial City of the imperial capital in the future. What surprised them the most was that the emperor did not order them to be driven out, but they were still allowed to live in the place.
This meant that they would be the people closest to the emperor in the future!
They were excited and proud to live at the feet of the Emperor!
However, although Dudian didn’t order them to be driven out, many big figures and forces in the Imperial City and the Federation still extended their hands into the giant wall and used legal means to buy the residences of many original inhabitants, many indigenous residents were shocked by the sky-high price of wealth of these big figures. They didn’t think about it and agreed. After all, their vision was limited. They didn’t know that even if they increased the price by ten times or a hundred times, they would still be able to sell.
Ryan family had been painstakingly operating in the outer wall area. Now they had become a prominent family in the inner wall area. Dudian had contributed a lot to this. Although he had cut off the connection with Ryan family after old Fulin’s death, it didn’t help much but Ryan family was the place where he had stayed. Other forces knew about this so they didn’t dare to provoke Dudian, no one would stop them from doing gambling or robbing mines.
Now that Dudian had become the emperor of the world, the big figures in the capital and the Federation naturally knew about his resume. They also knew about Ryan family in Sylvia. Ryan family was getting more and more prestigious, even in front of the many real nobles in the empire, they were superior to dukes and dukes. The Abyss knew about the relationship between the Ryan family and didn’t dare to provoke them!
“I didn’t expect that there would be countless giant walls outside the giant wall. Our giant wall of Sylvia is just a small city for the entire empire. Now, the Master of the Empire is Dudian...”
“Our Ryan family’s grandfather protected Dudian in the early years. In the future we will have a meteoric rise!”
“Oh my God! Look at that huge monster! It is a mount! What kind of terrifying character is riding it? !”
“Why are you panicking? Our Grandfather Protected Dudian. He will definitely repay our family. In the future it will be a piece of cake for each of us to play with it.”
“That’s true. The current Emperor has been shamed by our ancestors.”
Many young masters and young ladies of Ryan family stood on top of the castle. They looked at the noble flags and carriages that were erected on the wide street in front of their house. There were also many strong men and giant mechs that were riding giant beasts, they were so excited that they couldn’t control themselves. Their eyes were full of pride and excitement.
“Eh?”Barton rode a tamed Abyssal Beast. He mixed with the crowd and entered the city. He couldn’t help but glance at the familiar family flag on the castle. He frowned as he remembered, this was the Ryan family where Dudian had lived. He had heard old Fulin’s teachings but he had lost contact with them after old Fulin died.
“How dare you call Dean by his name!”Cold light flashed in Barton’s eyes. He was no longer the disabled child in the orphanage. The radiation in his body had been purified, his body was no different from a normal person. Moreover, he was the king of thousands of troops with Dudian’s help. He had conquered many abyss regions and killed a lot of monsters. His mind was different from the past.
In his opinion, Dudian’s help to the Ryan family was something that the Ryan family could never repay. It was unforgivable for the younger generation to talk about it.
He didn’t go forward to deal with them. He took a cold glance at them before looking away. He would teach them a lesson in the future.
Soon, Barton arrived in front of the imperial palace in the inner wall.
The newly-built imperial palace was as magnificent as a high-rise building. The square in front of the imperial palace could accommodate 100,000 soldiers. Stone pillars carved with dragons and phoenixes soared into the sky, hundreds of meters high.
“So many big shots have come...”Barton narrowed his eyes slightly.
There were many people who had the same thoughts as him. The big shots who had arrived long ago had already parked their cars outside the imperial palace. The convoy stretched for dozens of miles and was extremely magnificent. Many big shots walked forward and gathered in the square in front of the Imperial Palace.
While everyone was waiting, there was suddenly a commotion outside.
With the company of the directors beside him, Blacky and a few other chairmen of the Federation consortium couldn’t help but look over when they heard the commotion. They were a little surprised. They didn’t know who was so bold to cause trouble at the coronation ceremony.
Very quickly, everyone saw the source of the commotion clearly.
They saw dozens of figures with strange physiques appearing outside the square. Some had the face of a human and the body of a spider. Some had the physique of a cow. There were horns on their heads. Some were four to five meters tall. Their arms were huge scythes... from their appearance.., none of them looked like normal humans.
Seeing this strange body structure, many important figures’eyes shone brightly. They recognized at a glance that these were all zombies, and they were extremely powerful zombie kings. They had already gone through many mutations and evolutions, and their strength was no small matter.
In front of these zombie kings was a youth in white clothes. Compared to the zombie kings who were four to five meters tall, he was not eye-catching at all. However, all the zombie kings followed behind him as if he was the leader.
“The Northern Corpse Emperor!”
“He’s actually here!”
“How is this possible? Could it be that this great emperor has already suppressed and subdued the corpse kingdom?”
When the many important figures saw this, their hearts shook and they were extremely shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1256
chapters.content:
Chapter 1256: Chapter 1245: reaching the summit
Translator:
549690339
After Berlin entered the venue, he glanced at the elders of the various forces and then found a place to stand. Around him, the important figures of the other forces couldn’t help but make way for him. Although they knew that these king corpses wouldn’t cause trouble at the coronation ceremony, they still didn’t want to get too close and were afraid.
After the leaders of the various forces entered the hall, the time for the ceremony to begin was approaching.
In the Imperial Palace, Barton, Sergei, and the others stood in the great hall and looked at the figure on the throne with excited eyes. Although they had long known that this day would come, when it really came.., they were still excited by the lively atmosphere around them and the attention of thousands of people. Who would have thought that the humble figure who came out of the orphanage could climb up to today’s status and look down on all the heroes in the world, covering the sky with one hand!
Neuss quietly bowed his head in front of the crowd. His expression was calm and there was a trace of bitterness in his mouth.
“If only you were here...”Dudian looked out of the hall. There was a bit of nostalgia and regret in his eyes. He took a deep breath and slowly stood up, in an instant he had the aura of a monarch.
He walked down the throne step by step. Every step he took he couldn’t help but think of the humble figure who had struggled in Sylvia.
The figure was imprisoned in the cell. He stretched out his hand but couldn’t grasp his freedom.
The figure could only lower his head to endure the contempt and cold words of the nobles.
The figure walked alone in the Abyss and quickly fled like a frightened bird in the face of powerful monsters.
Those figures... flashed quickly in his mind, as if they were struggling and climbing up the stairs he walked down, but God extinguished all hope, leaving no door.
When he walked down the stairs, it was as if he met those struggling and climbing figures in his mind, then overlapped and merged together.
Once humble, now glorious, and in the future..
All his efforts were finally crowned as king today.
The corner of his mouth slowly curled up. It was cold, but it was also unruly and unbridled. His gaze was disdainful, and his cold eyes slowly burned with a flame that could engulf the world. This flame was hotter and more scorching than the sun above his head.., therefore, even when he stepped out of the palace, his eyes were still shining brightly under the bright blue sunlight.
Rumble!
Outside the square, a giant beast was dragged over.
It was an ocean-type monster. The fins and scales on its body were all the characteristics of an ocean-type monster. Although it had sharp claws, it was not suitable for crawling. The tail behind it was like a shark, but as sharp as a knife.
The people in the middle of the square quickly moved aside and looked at the ocean-type monster in shock. Their eyesight was extraordinary. They could tell at a glance that this monster was extraordinary. It was probably the overlord of the ocean!
However, this level of sea monster was half dead and half alive.
It was more difficult to capture a king level sea monster than to kill a top-level mutated plant. Even seven or eight kings might not be able to do it!
Dudian slowly stepped onto the high altar. When his figure appeared on the altar in the square, the noise from below quieted down. Everyone looked up and welcomed the dazzling sunlight, looking at the thin and straight figure, they felt that his whole body was shrouded in darkness. It was difficult to see his face but there was a chilling strange feeling coming from his body.
“Today, I declare that the world is one!”Dudian slowly said. His voice was clear but echoed throughout the square.
Everyone was shocked. They knew that the moment had finally come. The Federation and Empire had been in war for two or three hundred years. As well as the Fire Dragon Kingdom. No one could do anything to each other but was eventually unified.
Who would have thought that such a situation would happen?
But the truth was right in front of their eyes.
“Dragon Whale Shark, sacrifice to heaven!”Dudian indifferently said.
Everyone knew that the monster in the sea was called the dragon whale shark. They couldn’t help but take a look at it.
Barton who was standing at the back of the stage handed over the saber that he had prepared.
Dudian didn’t take it. He slowly raised his hand. His arm suddenly extended and turned into a giant saber that was hundreds of meters long. It seemed like a black pillar that was erected from the square. However the outline of the blade was very clear, everyone was shocked as the light of the blade suddenly fell. Bang! It cut into the body of the dragon whale shark and cut it in half!
“The sacrifice to heaven has been completed. We respectfully welcome the new emperor to the throne!”The Duke who was in charge of the etiquette system of the dynasty kneeled down first.
Aurora, Sergei, Noyce and others kneeled down one after another.
The leaders of various forces, many kings and Abyss, as well as the top-level mecha operators who had trained hard in the square in front of the altar kneeled down one after another. It was as if the wind was blowing in the rice forest.
At this moment, all the relatives and children who had accompanied the important figures to the giant wall of Sylvia heard the sound of the Coronation Bell. They were all in awe of the Coronation Bell, however, when they saw the others kneeling and saluting, they were so scared that they quickly knelt down.
Dudian looked forward. He was the only one who was standing in the sky. This was the royal power. It was supreme and unique!
He didn’t know why but he didn’t feel too excited in his heart. Instead he was a bit disappointed.
“I’m above hundreds of millions of people. I just find some comfort in the pain of life. It’s like a poor person picking up a small amount of money. They are so happy that they can temporarily forget their own suffering. But the joy will fade eventually. The happiness will pass quickly but the pain will last for a long time. Does this mean that we are born and live to suffer?”
Dudian sighed and left the altar. The rest of the cumbersome etiquette was handed over to the people below.
The ceremony was bustling. The streets of Sylvia were brightly lit. The liveliness lasted for three days and gradually faded away.
The leaders of the forces left the capital on the second day and returned to their respective posts.
The world had become one and the forces were adjusting and contacting each other. There were many things that needed to be done. Dudian sorted out the general framework for a few days and then handed over the details to his parents to manage.
He wanted to call Neuss to supervise but Neuss resigned after the coronation ceremony. He wanted to take charge of the wall and be a free wall master. He couldn’t persuade him so he had to agree.
The various forces were quickly merging, and the entire continent was changing. The monsters in the Abyss region were being hunted wantonly. Now, outside the wilderness, there were traces of adventurers hunting everywhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 1257
chapters.content:
Chapter 1257: Chapter 1246: stopping space
Translator:
549690339
The abyssal region, which was once uninhabited, had now become a wilderness area. It was cleaned up by adventurers and the Empire’s army. The monsters on land were hunted and slaughtered in large numbers, and the number of monsters on land was drastically reduced. The empire’s hunters were equipped with the federation’s precision detection equipment, and the combat arts that the Fire Dragon Kingdom was good at were popularized. Their overall strength had greatly increased, and in a short period of time, there was a frenzied hunt for monsters.
A few short months had passed.
The vast majority of the wilderness within the empire’s borders had been cleared. The dynasty’s soldiers’fortresses were stationed there. Some of the forests and swamps that were close to the fortresses were also preparing to build a wilderness supply market.
Everyone could feel that a glorious and grand era was coming.
The merger of the three forces brought about rapid development. Many social experts of the old federation predicted that within the next three years, human footprints would spread all over the land, the wilderness outside the wall was no longer a forbidden land that everyone feared. The land monsters would one day be exterminated. Some experts even joked that in the future world, the monsters might be included in the animal protection law.
When the land was opened up on a large scale, the high-yield hunting of monsters brought about the vigorous development of various sectors, especially the tourism industry. The leading groups among them had already smelled the business opportunities in the changing world structure in the future, and were preparing resources, they were building tourism channels in the wilderness that had been opened up for the young masters of the nobles and wealthy merchants to visit. In the future, different regions would be classified into different levels of tourist attractions.
The scientific research experts of the old federation and the various Alchemy Warlocks of the Empire merged. Their knowledge was connected and complemented each other, just like the combination of medicine and medicine in the early days of the old era. They competed with each other and argued endlessly, bringing about a chemical reaction, the overall level of the industry was quickly raised. After a certain amount of time had passed, they would merge with each other and accept each other. Then, they would erupt with even greater improvements.
Many special monsters were tested to be non-toxic and edible. They were sent to the tables of the nobles.
Many special plants and herbs were tested to have magical medical effects. They were even stronger than the penicillin of the old era and brought great help to the human medical institutions.
The entire dynasty was changing rapidly, becoming more and more beautiful. Everyone could look forward to an exciting future. The people at the bottom were trying their best to adapt to this rapidly evolving world, at the same time, they were praising the great emperor.
However, in the new research institute for the undead behind the imperial palace, the Emperor’s mood was getting worse every day.
He gathered the smartest people from all the major factions and the experts who had the deepest understanding of the undead. After a few months of research, he had also made use of the high-tech items from the old federation, as well as the technological equipment found in the magic bug spaceships and Aragami spaceships from all over the world, although there were many new discoveries in the research on the undead, they were all minor details. There was still no progress in the main research on recovering the undead virus.
No, it couldn’t be said that there was no progress. But the more he studied, the more he found that the hope of restoring the undeads to the original human was equal to zero!
“Magic Worm!”
Dudian crushed the yellowed old information in his hand. He was very clear about the source of the virus by looking through the information of the giant wall, the old federation and the Fire Dragon Kingdom, it was created by using the natural spring liquid of the ice pond and the flame pond of the magic insect planet. Moreover, it was mixed with many rare plants on the magic insect planet. The bacteria could fundamentally change the structure of life.
The purpose of the creation of the virus was to transform the human body so that the human body could adapt to the parasitism of the magic insect and prepare for the creation of gods.
Therefore, from the beginning of the creation of the virus, it had never thought of creating an antidote. Moreover, the magic insect was in a hurry because of the pursuit of the Aragami. It only had time to mix the virus before it was rushed to Earth and dropped down.
He looked through the spacecraft’s flight records and various research materials but didn’t find any hope.
“Mom, the Moon just sent a message. A space fleet is approaching the Earth.”God Wa pushed the door open and looked at Dudian in a timid voice, she had intruded into the Institute of undead research not long ago and interrupted Dudian’s research. She was scolded by him so she was afraid of her mother.
“Space Fleet?”Dudian recovered from his anger. His eyes were full of killing intent: “Is it the magic bug spaceship?”
“No, it’s not the magic bug. It’s the Aragami’s spaceship.”God of WA whispered.
“Aragami?”
Dudian was startled. A lot of information flashed through his mind. He sneered: “Is it the summoning of the Devil Emperor? Are they finally impatient? They want to attack the Earth. They are courting death!”
God whispered: “Mom, do you want me to deal with them?”
“No.”Dudian said in a cold tone: “Let’s wait for them to come to Earth. Maybe their spaceship will bring something useful and leave the spaceship behind.”
God was about to leave but was stopped by Dudian.
Dudian frowned as he pondered for a moment, dudian narrowed his eyes: “According to the records of the Aragami’s spaceships, their spaceships can easily block the meteorites. Such power is enough to seriously damage the earth or even detonate the earth!”! The Devil Emperor knew that our forces are different from the past. There is no chance of winning in a head-on fight. He asked them to come over. Should they want to blow up the earth...”
God wa was surprised: “Do they want to kill all of them?”
“It’s okay to kill all of them. They are not their clansmen.”Dudian snorted: “Go to space and stop them. Can you do it alone?”
God wa nodded: “No problem.”
“Go.”Dudian turned to look at her. His voice was gentle: “Be careful.”
God wa smiled and nodded. She turned around and left.
The next moment, an angel-like figure flew out of the Imperial Palace and rushed into the sky. In the blink of an eye, it was ten thousand meters high in the sky. It was approaching the atmosphere. The low temperature near the atmosphere was enough to freeze the energy of the plane. However, the angel-like figure was emitting flames which dispersed the low temperature. It rushed out of the atmosphere like a flaming meteor.
She came to the vacuum region of the universe and was infinitely close to absolute zero.
The outer shell of the angel-like figure was frozen. Her wings stopped flapping and quickly froze. However, a few holes suddenly appeared behind her body. The force of the jet was like fuel, pushing her body forward.
The mottled cosmic rays, the intense solar radiation, and many destructive energy attacked her. She stood still and charged forward. The statue-like figure was like a god who had descended to the mortal world, crossing the universe with her body, she had completely broken all scientific common sense.
“Mom, I will become your claw and sweep away all obstacles for you...”she murmured softly. It came from within the angel’s body. That perfect statue-like body flew past the moon and smashed pieces of meteorites into pieces, gradually, it approached a space fleet that was flashing with a dazzling light.
The huge fleet was sailing in the universe like an ancient warship. There were many ferocious and strange-looking Aragami standing inside the energy shield, emitting surging vitality.
No one noticed the petrified sculpture in front of the fleet which was mixed with the meteorite fragments.
However, when they were hundreds of miles away, the sculpture suddenly burst out with brilliant light and blocked the front of the fleet.
Boom!
Dudian felt the mechanical heart in his chest faintly beat. He looked up at the blue sky above his head, he could faintly see the trajectory of the white clouds. The clouds hadn’t healed yet.
His eyes slightly moved as he muttered to himself: “Her true God body is enough to adapt to the environment of the universe. Fighting in the universe is no different from fighting on Earth. It shouldn’t be a big problem to stop the Aragami...”
He was relieved to let God wa go alone. It was because he was a quasi-god body so it was difficult for him to display much combat power in space. The main reason was that he had been training for the past few months, goddess WA’s current strength was many times stronger than when she had first awakened. Even the Aragami spaceship left behind on Earth could be used as food to absorb and eat her. That indestructible special metal was like a piece of paper in front of her, it could not withstand a single blow.

chapters.title: Chapter 1258
chapters.content:
Chapter 1258: Chapter 1247: Shadow surging
Translator:
549690339
Dudian went to another secret hall of the Imperial Palace. He used a communication device from the magic bug spaceship to contact the Moon, he asked the magic bug to switch the battle scenes in outer space.
Soon, he saw a brilliant explosion of light. Battleships were destroyed one after another. There was a ferocious giant space creature sitting in front of the battleship. It looked like a giant octopus living in the deep space, however, the front end of its tentacles were curved black sharp blades. It was messy as it swept across the battleship. The aircraft flying out of the battleship was cut into pieces. The flame of the explosion was as weak as the waves in the silent space.
Dudian was relieved to see the ferocious giant beast. Although the giant beast didn’t have the beautiful shadow of the WA God in human form but he could recognize it at a glance. It was the WA God, perhaps this was the special connection between them.
The next battle was as he had expected. The Aragami warships were destroyed in front of the god of Wa. One Aragami after another rushed out of the warships to fight with the god of Wa. However they were either eaten or killed, they weren’t her match.
The god of Wa was getting stronger and stronger. The potential in her body was constantly stimulated. In the end she demonized a sword that was thousands of meters long and cut the Aragami warship in half!
“There shouldn’t be any life in the universe that can resist such power...”Dudian’s eyes lit up as he looked at the fierce battle in the picture.
..
..
Fire Dragon Kingdom.
No one mentioned this name but the landscape hadn’t changed much. There were many strange figures on the streets. Some of them were from the federation and some of them were from the empire, most of them were merchants who had come to trade. In the early days of this new era, they had taken risks to make a fortune.
In the former Imperial City.
The Kirin Dragon Lord stepped out of the palace and looked at the city ten thousand miles ahead of the steps. There were countless buildings, and countless people lived in them. They were all his people. Now, he was no longer a king. He had submitted to a new emperor. Furthermore, under the Emperor’s bestowment, he was conferred the title of a border minister and was still in charge of the Fire Dragon Kingdom. However, he was now managing the world for others, and not his own.
Furthermore, he knew that this was only temporary.
Once the three forces were completely compatible, that Emperor would definitely be free to kill him.
He let out a light breath, and a faint smile appeared on his chiseled face. He flew away and left the palace, leaving the eyes of the many people in the palace.
He flew over the imperial city and gradually rose higher. Clouds enveloped his figure, and after he was out of everyone’s sight, his figure suddenly changed, and his aura also changed completely.
After all, he was a demigod who had surpassed kings, and the abilities he possessed were far more than that of kings.
Soon, he descended from the clouds and sneaked into a hidden underground area in the wilderness outside the imperial city.
There was a spaceship hidden deep underground. This spaceship was isolated from all external senses and had the ability to become invisible.
When he arrived, the door of the spaceship automatically opened. He went straight into it and followed the blood-red passage inside the spaceship. He moved forward as if he was traveling through the intestines of a huge monster.
Soon, he came to an empty place, like a conference room.
There were eight figures standing there. They all looked like Earthlings. They were men, women, Old and young. However, they were all expressionless at the moment. The outline of their cheeks was hidden in the shadows. Their eyes were dull, as if they were dead.
When the Kirin Dragon Lord arrived, a squeaking sound came from the top of one of the girls’head. A red soft thing that looked like a snake and intestines came out from the top of her head. It coiled on her head and squeaked, this was the flame demon insect language. “You’re finally here. Quick, take a look at this!”
The Kirin Dragon Lord’s expression was solemn. In the middle of the eight people was a huge metal platform. As the flame demon insect finished speaking, a virtual projection appeared on the platform. The projection was a video of a fierce battle in space.
“This is... that God?”The Kirin Dragon Lord’s gaze focused.
“That’s right, it’s that damn god controlled by that Earthling!”Another handsome youth also had a flaming demonic insect crawling out of his head. His body coiled around the Kirin Dragon Lord’s neck, he let out a strange hissing sound. “Other than the god, there’s also that group of Stupid Aragami. These damn fellows seemed to be preparing to attack Earth, but they were stopped by this god!”
“Attack Earth?”The Kirin Dragon Lord frowned and snorted coldly, “They haven’t given up yet? Their nest has already changed owners, and they still want to turn the tables? HMPH, even if they come to Earth, they’re still delivering food to us!”
“No, they want to destroy Earth, cause a starburst, and destroy the Earthlings, that God, and all of us!”
“That’s right. If that’s the case, then only they have the secret to becoming a god in their hands. Moreover, they’ve already created a demigod, and he’s just one step away from becoming a god. That demigod’s lifespan is enough to survive for ten thousand years, and it’s enough to support them to wander in the universe, find new life planets, and continue to complete their experiments!”
The two flame demon bugs chirped.
The face of the Kirin Dragon Lord changed. He did not expect the Aragami to be so vicious. However, thinking about it, he felt that this was the smartest move. He felt a chill in his heart. Seeing the scene of the fleet being destroyed on the screen, he was secretly glad, he did not expect that he would almost die just like that.
“The gods have already stopped their conspiracy. Now, the Aragami race is probably only left with the demon emperor. It should leave this planet and wander the universe alone to search for a new intelligent planet. After all, it is meaningless to continue staying here. There is also the danger of being exposed. No one knows how far this god will continue to grow. Once it truly becomes a complete god, it will be omnipotent and omniscient. It will be an easy task to find the demon Emperor and us.”
“Fortunately, the god was controlled by that despicable human and didn’t absorb a large amount of nutrients. It’s only a larva now. Otherwise, we would have to move immediately.”
The Kirin Dragon Lord was startled and said respectfully, “From what the wise ones said, could it be that we still have hope and don’t need to move?”
“That’s right, there’s still a glimmer of hope!”One of the flame demon bugs sneered.
The Kirin Dragon Lord’s eyes lit up as he asked, “Lord, what do you mean?”
“A god is invincible, but unfortunately, this god is controlled by a human. From a perfect God, it has become a flawed god. Therefore, this god is not complete. In fact, it is not a real god!”! “Because of this, this god is not immortal!”
“The way to kill a God lies in that human’s body. He is the only flaw of this god!”
The Kirin Dragon Lord said in a daze, “Not a real God? What Lord Sage means is to use that human to kill the God? But that human is already a demigod, much stronger than me. I’m not his match at all.”
“HMPH, what demigod? It’s just the power brought by the SAGE engine of those idiots from the ice magic bugs. If we put the same sage engine into your body, your strength will not be inferior to his!”
The Kirin Dragon Lord smiled bitterly. “But even so, he has the help of a god. I’m not a match for this god.”
“Don’t worry, we’re not saying this to let you deal with him. We naturally have someone here who can deal with him. Moreover, this person is a god who won’t be hurt. An invincible person!”
“An invincible person?”The Kirin Dragon Lord was astonished.
“That’s right. However, this person hasn’t matured yet. He still needs to continue strengthening. We need to borrow your strength and borrow your demigod body!”Another blazing magic bug said in a deep voice.
The Kirin Dragon Lord’s heart trembled. He said without batting an eyelid, “What do you mean, Sage Lords?”
“For the sake of our race’s eternal life, for the sake of our race’s endless reproduction, we can only let you suffer.”
“Are you willing to sacrifice yourself?”
Hearing this, the Kirin Dragon Lord’s expression immediately changed and became incomparably ugly.
After a moment, he took a deep breath and said, “Since the sage Lords have already planned it, I’m naturally willing.”
“I’m making things difficult for you.”
“It’s fine...”the Kirin Dragon Lord had just finished speaking when he suddenly attacked. His expression became incomparably malevolent. “Only when I’m alive is I alive. What does it have to do with me whether you’re alive or not? What meaning does it have to me? All of you can go and Die! !”
“What a pity...”
Another flame demon worm sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1259
chapters.content:
Chapter 1259: Chapter 1248: sea hunting era
Translator:
549690339
Whoosh!
A slender figure descended from the sky and flew back to the imperial palace.
Dudian quietly waited in the study room of the imperial palace. He soon sensed the aura. He saw the tired face of God wa coming in from outside the door. She had returned to the appearance of a human girl, there was no trace of the ferocious body of the previous war in the universe.
“Are You Alright?”Dudian whispered.
The tiredness in God Wa’s eyes slightly disappeared. She grinned as if the whole world had brightened up: “I’m alright. They can’t do anything to me. I have attacked them from outer space.”
“I saw it.”Dudian nodded as he looked at her, “It’s all thanks to you this time. Otherwise the entire earth would have been destroyed. You should be the Savior and hero of all human beings and lives on Earth!”
God Wa smiled and looked at him: “I don’t want to be the Savior and hero. I just want to be by my mother’s side.”
“Now that the Aragami has been eliminated, the world is at peace. We will be together in the future.”Dudian smiled.
God wa nodded: “I will think of a way to strengthen the detection system of the Moon. I don’t want to use the same method to attack and destroy the Earth.”
“Yes.”Dudian looked at her in praise. God Wa didn’t only have extraordinary combat strength. She wasn’t inferior to ordinary people in terms of intelligence. She was emotionally bound and was willing to follow him, she might grow to a shocking level in a short period of time.
Dudian was calm after God wa left. He continued to participate in the experiments of the undeads.
Time flew by.
While Dudian was immersed in the laboratory, the old and new forces in the dynasty had undergone drastic changes. First of all, Barton, Sergei and Aurora were the leaders of the new aristocrats, they had divided a large number of troops and territories. They had slaughtered many of the old aristocrats who were obstructing them. The power of these old aristocrats was intertwined with each other. They were rooted in all classes and had long been corrupted.
Under Dudian’s acquiescence, Aurora and the others were like a few hungry new tigers. They crazily devoured their territory and wealth to strengthen themselves and become the new rising big families in the dynasty.
In addition to the changes in the structure of the dynasty, the effect of the merger of the three forces was gradually revealed. The rapid development brought about by the exchange of trade. The railroad tracks were spread to all areas of the wilderness. There was no so-called Abyss area now, all of them were collectively known as the Adventure Zone.
Apart from the giant wall, people built a lot of fortresses and new cities in the wilderness. The walls of these fortresses and cities were less than a hundred meters high and covered a large area. They were like flags that were planted all over the land.
From this trend, it could be predicted that in the future, the monsters could only retreat to the wilderness area at the border. Humans would once again display their innate aggressiveness and aggressiveness and take over the land, the monsters would once again become the beasts of the old era, excluded from the cities of human civilization.
While the land continent was being cleaned up, Aurora, Barton, and the others cast their eyes to the overseas world.
In the old era, the global nuclear explosion caused the land plate to move. The current continent belonged to the Asian region, but at the same time, it was combined with the surrounding islands. Under the push of the nuclear bombs and sea monsters, these islands collided with the continent, there were still other fragmented continents and islands on the other side of the distant sea. However the area was far from the main continent.
Dudian didn’t think much when Barton and Aurora suggested to Dudian to recruit overseas and sea monsters. He knew about the overseas land from the hidden information of the federation and the imperial capital, he also knew that there were human survivors on the land. It was just that these survivors were not disturbed by the magic insects and Aragami. They belonged to the abandoned human race. Their development was completely continuation of the real track after the human disaster.
Without any external help, they completely relied on the civilization of the old era to struggle in the end of the world. The battle was still at the stage of relying on weapons and firearms.
With the strength of Aurora and the others, it would be enough to lead an army to flatten them.
Therefore, he didn’t pay attention to them. As for the sea monsters, they needed to be cleaned up. Since Aurora and the others had volunteered, he was happy to let them train.
With Dudian’s permission, the era of expeditions began.
With Aurora, Barton, Sergei and the others as the leaders, they led the army to repair ships and build boats. They conquered the overseas land and also attacked the sea monsters. They began to hunt fiercely in the region.
When the sea monsters were being hunted in large numbers, the corpses of the monsters were transported to the dynasty. Scientists from other fields combined the technology of Aragami and magic bugs to research, and they found many valuable materials from them, they brought great help to the medical field and also created some new hunting weapons. This increased the value of the sea monsters, causing more hunters to chase after them, forming a virtuous circle.
As the number of land monsters decreased, hunters could only lock their eyes on the sea monsters. Sergei, Aurora and the others raised the banner of the dynasty to attack the coastal areas. Many hunters from free groups followed them to pick up the scraps, a new era of sea hunting began.
In the blink of an eye, three months passed.
Dudian took off his antibacterial fish skin gloves and left the research institute. He was in a good mood. Today’s research was going well. He had found a kind of stimulating cell from the gallbladder of an abyss-level shallow sea monster. It was very rare for him to have a good reaction to undeads.
“Your Majesty, this is a letter from Neuss.”Sergei went to the study room and found Dudian who was resting inside.
Dudian looked at the letter in his hand. He used his X-ray vision to scan the contents of the letter. He smiled: “Isn’t he in the giant wall of Henevin? Isn’t there an Internet connection there?”
Sergei saw that Dudian was in a good mood: “Your Majesty you know that he is not used to using that thing. He prefers handwritten letters.”
Dudian nodded: “I have read the letter. Write a letter for me and tell him that he can apply for any resources from the treasury. There is no need to report to me.”
“I understand.”Sergei smiled as he prepared to leave.
Dudian suddenly thought of something: “Send the order to the dragon master to come to see me.”
Sergei carefully said: “Your Majesty, What are you doing?”
Dudian indifferently said: “The three forces have been mixed together. The bottom level has adapted to it. It is time for him to retire.”
Sergei thought for a moment: “Your Majesty, you haven’t specially summoned him. Will he be suspicious if you call him over? Do you want me and Aurora to personally bring him over?”
“Alright.”Dudian thought for a moment: “Since you want to go, you four kings and twelve kings should go together. But let the others hide their identities. Don’t alert the snake.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1260
chapters.content:
Chapter 1260: Chapter 1249: War
Translator:
549690339
The four kings and twelve kings were the top forces in the dynasty. Most of them were close aides like Sergei and Barton who had followed Dudian since the beginning. Some of them were the first to join the old forces, the top of the pyramid.
