Sergei’s eyelids twitched as he heard Dudian’s words. He didn’t expect that Dudian would pay so much attention to the Dragon Lord. He didn’t expect that all the ‘kings’of the dynasty would come out. He was a bit hesitant, but in the end he didn’t ask any questions and accepted the order.
That day.
Sergei took the emperor’s order and led many experts to leave the capital overnight to capture the Kirin Lord.
Dudian didn’t take this matter to heart. It was a small matter for him. There were only three things that could make his mood fluctuate. The first was to find a solution to the undead virus, the second was to find Aisha and the third was to become a god.
Yes, although the birth of the god of Wa was a true God, but only the god of Wa was a god. There were many coincidental and unexplainable factors in the process of birth. If one wanted to artificially recreate a god.., the experiment of Aragami and magic insects could only continue. But it would take a long time for the results to come out.
Even if Dudian collected the genes of the god of WA and used a secret method to transplant them into the body of the god, there would be no effect. He wouldn’t be able to create an existence like the god of Wa.
So even if he was a false god, he wouldn’t be able to live forever. He wouldn’t be able to be omniscient and omnipotent.
At night, Dudian went to sleep with thick experimental materials. The lights were cold. Compared to the prosperous families outside the imperial capital, the imperial palace was very quiet.
The next day.
Sergei, Barton and others came to report to Dudian.
All four kings and twelve kings had returned. There was no conflict and everything went smoothly.
“Your Majesty, are you looking for me?”The Master of the Dragon clan saluted Dudian.
Dudian sat in the hall and waved to Sergei and others to leave. When only the Master of the Dragon Clan was left in the hall.., dudian said: “You have submitted to me and I have let you go. You are still the monarch of the fire dragon country. You have managed well and there is no conflict with the capital and the federation. However, you have submitted to me on the surface but you are plotting behind the scenes. Isn’t that inappropriate?”
The Master of the fire dragon was startled: “Your Majesty, What are you talking about? I am loyal to you!”
“Loyal?”Dudian’s eyes were indifferent as he looked at him: “The dynasty has been established for more than a year. Have you taken the initiative to come forward and tell us about the matter?”
The master was stunned. He opened his mouth but couldn’t say anything.
“I have given you a year of tolerance but you don’t know how to cherish it. Are you aware of your sin?”Dudian whispered.
The fear on the face of the dragon Lord slowly faded away. His face turned cold. He looked at Dudian who was sitting on the throne, “Your Majesty, why don’t You Say It? The world is peaceful now. You want to get rid of me so just say it. Why do you need to find a dignified reason? You earthlings are ridiculous!”
“Because the history of US earthlings tells us that we can save some trouble.”Dudian indifferently said: “Since you have confessed, I will give you two choices. The first is to confess all the things and plans of the flame insects. I have exterminated the ice insects on the moon. I don’t believe that the flame insects are willing to give up the opportunity to become a god.”
“What about the second one?”The Dragon Lord indifferently asked.
“Die.”Dudian only said one word.
The dragon lord sighed: “In that case, I can only choose the first one...”there was a bit of helplessness in his voice. It seemed that he had accepted his fate. However his body suddenly disappeared, he rushed to Dudian’s front like a phantom. His body was burning hot like a fireball.
Dudian looked at the ferocious face that was approaching him. His expression was the same as usual. He indifferently said: “Is this the purpose of you following them?”
Hundreds and thousands of sharp black blades were erected on his body. They were thin and sharp like a hurricane.
“Explode!”The Dragon Lord Roared.
Boom!
The Flames all over his body suddenly collapsed, like an extremely blazing fireball that suddenly exploded.
The destructive shockwave swept through the entire hall, melting the throne made of gold into golden liquid. It could be seen that the instantaneous high temperature had reached at least a thousand degrees Celsius.
Without waiting for the explosion to calm down, several black sharp blades suddenly slashed out amidst the blazing explosion. The sharp blades were accompanied by dark energy. It was a magic mark ability unique to four-star legendary monsters, dark annihilation energy.
The sharp blades swept out and quickly extinguished the intense flames. They were slashed out thousands of times in a second.
“Eh?”Dudian who was wearing a black horn helmet looked at the Dragon Lord. He raised his eyebrows: “You are also embedded with the sage engine? Is this how you dare to assassinate and challenge me?”
“Go to hell!”The Dragon Lord roared in response. He was angry but there was a bit of fear in his eyes. He didn’t expect that the move that he had been brewing for a long time would be easily neutralized by Dudian.
He once again burst out more blazing energy to simulate the atomic movement of nuclear fusion. It was the same as creating a nuclear bomb!
Boom!
An even louder explosion rang out and shook the entire imperial palace. The ground shook and the hall was completely destroyed. The dome no longer existed.
Aurora, Sergei, and the other four kings who had just retreated outside the imperial palace were frightened by the huge movement. They quickly rushed over when they sensed the source of the battle.
With their speed, they arrived at the square outside the palace in a few seconds with their full strength. They immediately saw a terrifying scene. They saw a black demon with many arms and sharp blades protruding from its chest, a blazing sun was stabbed into the blade of the blade. At this moment, the flames were still burning fiercely, but they were showing signs of exhaustion. With their eyesight, they could see the figure in the flames at a glance. It was the Kirin Dragon Lord who had been chatting and laughing with them along the way!
Bang!
The sage engine was broken.
The black giant blade was retracted and master Kirin’s body fell to the ground. The Flames on his body were quickly extinguished.
“Even if you use the sage engine to get the power of a demigod, it’s a pity that you don’t have the brain of a demigod...”Dudian looked indifferent as he stood with his hands behind his back.
Master Kirin’s face was Pale. He heard Dudian’s words and laughed, “Lin Changsheng’s memory is extraordinary. We are both demigods but I’m not your match. However you won’t get anything. Our magic flame insects have moved away from Earth. All the information has been burned by me. Don’t even think about getting any clues!” The weak flame on his body began to burn more and more vigorously.
“Self-destruct?”Dudian glanced at him and snorted. The sharp blades on his body retracted and dozens of holes appeared on his body. A large amount of cold air shot out and quickly extinguished the flame on his body and froze his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1261 - 50: Ten Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 1261: Chapter 1250: Ten Years
Translator:
549690339
A moment later, the body of the Master of the dragon was completely frozen into an ice sculpture.
Dudian also returned to his human form. He raised his hand and pressed on the master’s forehead. The black tentacles were like sharp needles. They pierced into the ice on the master’s forehead and went into his skull. He was reading his memory in the frozen brain tissue.
Sergei, Barton and others saw that Dudian was unscathed. They were relieved as they slowly approached him.
Dudian closed his eyes and looked for useful information in the long memory of the Dragon Lord. He saw the spaceship of the flame magic insect and the secret stronghold of the flame magic insect on Earth, he saw the plans and nests of the flame insects but he didn’t find anything useful for the experiments of the undeads. He didn’t see any other useful information.
“Have they evacuated earth?”Dudian slowly opened his eyes. There was a bit of disappointment on his face, although he had obtained a lot of information about the flame insects from the memories of the Dragon Lord but it was useless to him. The ice insects and the Aragami had been suppressed and destroyed so the remaining flame insects didn’t pose a threat to him, even if the magic worms were to come out in full force the god of Wa would be able to block them one by one.
He sighed as the sharp blade in his palm rose up. Bang! The Frozen Dragon Lord was cut into powder and turned into ice crystals.
“Your Majesty...”Sergei saw that the Dragon Lord was killed. His eyelids trembled as he lowered his head: “Do you need me to destroy the rebels of the Dragon Lord?”
Dudian glanced at the people who were standing around him. He was silent for a moment.
A few days later.
Dudian issued a killing order. Sergei and the other kings personally went to the Fire Dragon Province to kill the accomplices of the Dragon Lord. They were controlled by the magic flame insect so they couldn’t tell if they were human or magic flame insect, their thinking was affected and their strength was strong. All of them were upper abyss level existences but none of them were spared.
The memory of the Dragon Lord was used as a guide. A large number of the remaining members were pulled out and killed one by one.
A few months later.
Dudian was reading new research materials in the newly built imperial palace. The door of the study was pushed open. He saw a girl dressed in aqua green clothes. She smiled and walked in, she looked at dudian: “Mom, I heard that Uncle Barton and Sergei encountered difficulties in hunting sea beasts. Do you want me to help them?”
Dudian looked up at her, he smiled: “No need. Are you bored? You can leave the king’s city and go to other giant walls. Different giant walls have different cultural characteristics and interesting things.”
God of wa pouted: “But I’m tired of these things. I can see through the gambling games at a glance. I Can’t get addicted to them. I can read a few entertainment novels and movies to understand the general narrative structure and core ideas. I can write them myself. Only fighting is the most interesting. There are endless changes. Different enemies will always have different novel ways.”
Dudian touched his forehead and wryly smiled: “But fighting is the most dangerous.”
“Mom, didn’t you say that I am a God? There should be nothing in this world that can hurt me. I can help you kill all the sea beasts if you need me!”God Wa showed her two small canine teeth and smiled, she was a bit cunning.
Dudian shook his head: “We can’t kill all the sea beasts. We have to keep them.”
“We can’t kill all of them? Then why are Uncle Sergei and the others going to hunt sea beasts?”Wa was puzzled.
Dudian waved to her and waited for her to come close. He reached out and touched her head, “If we kill all the sea beasts then what should these powerful Abyss Hunters do all day? They can’t go back to their homes to embroider flowers. They have to do something.”
God Wa was enlightened. She revealed an ‘Oh’expression as if she understood, “Mom You Haven’t let me hunt the sea beasts. You want to leave them. You are afraid that the earth will be too harmonious and they will have internal strife. I know.”
“Good girl.”Dudian smiled.
God wa was curious: “Mom if you are worried that the Earth will return to peace then why don’t you find a bigger goal for them? For example, to conquer the universe above us. The universe is so vast. There must be other life forms besides Aragami and magic insects. Wouldn’t it be more interesting to conquer them?”
Dudian lowered his head and sighed: “Conquering the stars is a step that will be taken sooner or later. But now we have to find a way to solve the problem of the undeads.”
“Oh, I know. Mom wants to safely resurrect Miss Aisha on Earth and then join her in conquering the starry universe. Is that right?”God wa laughed.
Dudian gently knocked her head, “You are the smart one.”
God wa stuck out her tongue, “If there is nothing else, then I will leave first.”
“If you are bored, you can go and hunt a few sea beasts to play. But pay attention to protect the environment. Don’t damage it too much.”Dudian thought for a moment.
God Wa’s eyes lit up as she laughed, “I wonder what Uncle Sergei and the others will think when they hear mother’s words.”
Dudian laughed and chased her away.
The era of ocean hunting was still hot. There were many border cities built in the coastal areas. There were groups of adventurers coming from the inland to the sea to hunt monsters.
The Human Center had moved from the land to the sea. There would often be relevant news. For example, if a big figure hunted a top-level sea monster or if a research institute extracted a useful life essence from the sea monster.., it would add to the medical industry.
People gradually adapted to this era. From the closed environment in the giant wall after the disaster to the casual sightseeing on land. Even the unfathomable sea no longer brought fear to people, instead, it made people full of yearning and new impulse to explore.
Under Dudian’s order, the dynasty quickly established a religion. It was also the national religion and spread faith.
The Holy See had the emperor’s order behind it. It was easier for them to control the people.
After the dynasty stabilized, Dudian gradually let go of his power and handed over to his parents and sister to manage. He devoted himself to the experiment day after day.
In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed.
Dudian who was twenty-four or twenty-five years old was now a middle-aged man. He had been immersed in the laboratory for many years. He had neglected his own appearance. He had changed from a handsome youth to a middle-aged man with stubble all over his face, the cold face of ice and snow sculpture became colder and colder. The power accumulated between his eyebrows became thicker. The youth and vitality on his body had completely receded. Only calmness, introspection and calmness were left.
..
He had to go back for the new year to hold the wedding. He had wasted a lot of energy. He had planned to end the wedding in the middle of the month at the latest. However, it had been delayed until now. It was estimated that the end of the wedding would be in two days. He had basically explained everything. There was nothing to write about, it is the final ending.

chapters.title: Chapter 1262
chapters.content:
Chapter 1262: Chapter 1,251: Hidden Dangers
Translator:
549690339
It was the rainy season.
The sky was covered with dust and the rain was light. Other than the strong Abyss Walkers who didn’t need to care about the radiation rain, the other adventurers were curled up in the stronghold, they were wearing special protective clothing as they searched for prey in the rain.
The nobles were feasting their friends in the warm hall where the fireplace was burning. It was not suitable for them to go out during this season.
Dudian was sitting in front of the desk in the laboratory behind the palace. He was wearing a snow white fur coat. He was carefully reading the information in his hand. Maybe it was because he had been frowning for a long time. There were faint wrinkles on his eyebrows.
The rain was falling outside. Occasionally a lightning bolt would pass through the sky. He didn’t know when he put down the information in his hand. He sat in front of the desk in silence as usual. He looked like an ice-cold stone sculpture.
Ten years had passed but there was still no hope for the progress of the experiment.
Moreover, in the past ten years, he had searched every corner of the continent. The surveillance network had covered every corner of the continent but he still couldn’t find Aisha.
This meant that she might have left the continent.
Or... she might have died.
“God is omnipotent. Why Can’t he reverse time?”Dudian frowned. In the past ten years, he had been studying the secrets of becoming a god in addition to studying the undeads. The birth of the god of Wa was an accident. There was only the result.., but there was no way. He continued to search for the complete and correct method in the experiments of the magic insects and Aragami. However the progress was slow. Even if he had the cooperation of God of wa it would be difficult to find the deepest secret.
Knock Knock!
Someone knocked on the door.
Dudian knew who it was. He frowned: “Come in.”
Aurora who was wearing a black skirt walked in. There were white waves on her skirt. She looked at dudian: “Your Majesty, you haven’t been to the parliament for a long time. Aren’t you going to take a look?”
“There is nothing to see. Everything is peaceful now. The sea monsters are a threat but they will be solved sooner or later.”Dudian casually said.
Aurora looked at him for a moment. She hesitated: “Although it is peaceful outside but it is not the case inside. It has been a long time since you have appeared in front of people. I don’t know where God has been playing. I am worried that something will happen.”
“Inside? Why? Did someone provoke you or your husband?”Dudian looked at her, the biggest change in the past ten years was that the people who had followed him were now married. Neuss had found his beloved woman in the giant wall. Sergei was a womanizer and had hundreds of concubines, most of them were aristocratic ladies. They were graceful and beautiful.
His student Edward was outstanding in the field of research. He was surrounded by a large group of women.
Barton, Zach and Mason also had their own families.
Including Aurora in front of him. She had changed from a teenage girl to a twenty-seven or twenty-eight year old woman. She had two children.
Aurora bit her lips. She was no longer a naive girl who was full of revenge. She had been immersed in the power vortex of the Empire for ten years. Even if she didn’t like these things.., at least she understood. So after she heard Dudian’s words, she mustered up the courage to say the words.
She knew that in Dudian’s eyes, she was like Sergei and the others.
Even if they were the people closest to Dudian, they had to act according to the laws of the country. Otherwise it would be chaotic.
“Your Majesty...”Aurora’s mouth was full of bitterness: “You haven’t appeared for so long. Don’t you want to see the development of the dynasty?”
Dudian shook his head: “There is nothing to see. I know the general situation. What are you trying to say?”
Aurora opened her mouth as two cute faces flashed through her mind. Her heart slightly twitched and her eyes dimmed, she lowered her head: “Nothing, Your Majesty. I’m here to report to you about the Sea Beast Research Institute. They have created a potion to degrade the sea beasts. It can be mass produced for all the sea beasts that have been hunted.”
“I know.”Dudian said: “This kind of thing is a state matter. You can talk about it in the Congress. There is no need to tell me.”
Aurora bowed her head: “Yes.”She stood for a while as if she was thinking about something. In the end she didn’t say anything and slowly left the study room.
Dudian retracted his eyes and continued to read another volume of experimental data. He stopped halfway and muttered: “What is she trying to imply? Let Me Go to the Congress? Is there a problem with the Congress?”
He felt strange. Although he hadn’t managed the state affairs of the dynasty for a long time, but most of the things that happened outside were known from his own intelligence channels. The country was peaceful and the territory was expanding steadily, the land monsters were completely expelled and the remaining species were kept in captivity. It was like the zoo in the old era where a special hunting paradise was established.
In addition to the sea monsters that still occupied People’s eyes, there was basically nothing that was worth his attention.
“Is she hesitating because she was coerced or because Barton and the others wanted to say something?”Dudian’s eyes revealed a thoughtful look. After a moment, he called the guards outside, he asked them to inform his parents that he was going to attend the Congress tomorrow.
His parents rushed over to see Dudian.
“Son, are you willing to give up these experiments and take care of the country?”His mother looked at him with joy.
Dudian looked at them. He thought of Aurora’s words and asked: “Mother, is there anyone who is more domineering recently?”
His mother was surprised: “Why do you ask? Did you hear what they said? Who would dare to form a party? You are the only demigod in the world and the god of Wa is protecting you. Who would dare to form a party? Isn’t this a rebellion?”
Dudian nodded: “That’s true. But I’m afraid that these people will operate in the dark. The purpose is not for the throne but to have a higher status and better life.”
His mother thought for a moment: “It makes sense. Your father and I will investigate this matter.”
“How is it? Have you made any progress in the experiment?”His father asked.
Dudian sighed and shook his head.
“You have been doing experiments here all day. It is easy for bottlenecks to appear in your thinking. It just so happens that tomorrow is the day of prayer. We have prepared a special altar that can remove part of the nuclear fallout. Do you want to go over and take a look?”His father laughed.
“Yes. You should go out to relax. Your Sister has prepared a surprise for you.”Mother echoed.
Dudian looked at them and nodded: “Alright, let’s go out for a walk.”He got up. The family of three went out of the study and left the imperial palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 1263
chapters.content:
Chapter 1263: Chapter 1252: killing a family member
Translator:
549690339
The rain stopped when the three of them stepped out of the palace.
The rain stopped and the dark clouds were still there.
Father led the way while mother accompanied Dudian as they walked side by side. They talked about the interesting things between the marquises and dukes. They came to the gate of the palace where a carriage had been prepared.
With Dudian’s current strength, the carriage was not meant to be used for traveling but for bearing and leisure.
Eight horned dragon horses dragged the luxurious carriage along the spacious road. The attendants who passed by all knew that this was the emperor’s carriage.
“Child, you have been doing experiments all day. You are not young anymore. Do you really want to marry that girl?”In the carriage, his mother pulled Dudian to talk about marriage.
Dudian couldn’t help but smile bitterly. Even though he was an emperor, he was still urged to get married. Perhaps in the eyes of every parent, children’s marriage was always the top priority. He didn’t feel disgusted but felt warm instead, he shook his head: “Mother, you know that if it wasn’t for her, I wouldn’t be here today. I had just come out from the freezer and my body was extremely weak. It was raining heavily that day. If I hadn’t met her, I would have been drenched to death.”
These words sounded funny in the old era but it was very normal here. A cold wouldn’t happen but for an ordinary person who was in bad condition, it was very likely to lead to a life-threatening situation.
However, the dynasty had unified resources and the medical standards of the federation were strong. Such things wouldn’t happen in most prosperous cities except in the slums.
“She saved me more than once. Her family abandoned her and deprived her of her status as a saintess. She was bitten by the king of corpses because of me. If I don’t find her, no one in the world will care.”Dudian comforted his mother’s hand.
“Ah! I know that she has saved your life. But you shouldn’t delay your own matters!”His mother sighed.
Father interrupted: “Your Mother has been nagging all day. She wants to hold a grandson.”
Dudian smiled: “If you want to talk about grandchildren, you can treat God wa as your granddaughter. She is my child.”
“Nonsense!”Mother said in a bad tone: “We don’t want such a big child. We want to hold the child in our hands. Moreover, God wa is a god. We don’t dare to treat her as a child. You are not allowed to be too casual with her. If you anger her, no one in the world can stop her.”
Dudian laughed: “God wa won’t be angry. She is a good girl.”
“You!”His mother rolled her eyes: “Your Sister is about to get married. You have to hurry up.”
“Yes Yes Yes...”Dudian smiled.
His father said: “The world is peaceful now. The traces of Aragami and magic insects have disappeared. It seems that the previous demon Emperor has left the Earth. There were people who saw a beam of light cut through the sky from the South Sea. Maybe the demon Emperor has found a buried spaceship and left the Earth. I don’t know if the Aragami clan has been completely wiped out or if they will come back again.”
“Father don’t worry. According to the information I got from the Aragami spacecraft, the number of Aragami is very small. Many of them were killed in the last war. There are only a few of them left. I will destroy them when I have time in the future.”Dudian smiled.
“Aragami and magic insects must be completely wiped out. Otherwise they will sneak into the Solar System and attack Earth from space. We will all be finished.”Father’s eyes revealed a trace of seriousness.
Dudian nodded: “From the technology of their spacecraft it is impossible for them to hide from the detection of the Moon and attack the earth from a long distance. It will take at least a hundred years of development. I will go with God wa in another ten years.”
“Since you have decided to go, why don’t You Go Ahead?”His mother couldn’t help but ask.
Dudian shook his head: “It is a long journey. It will take at least a few years. I want to find her as soon as possible and crack the zombie virus.”
“Child, this is a matter that concerns the survival of all life on the planet. You Can’t treat it as a child’s Game!”His mother couldn’t help but say.
Dudian’s eyes looked at her face for a while before he moved away: “What does the entire planet have to do with me? People can be regenerated if they are gone. I can regenerate if they aren’t born.”
“This...”both of them looked at each other.
A moment later, the carriage stopped in a crowded square. There was a huge statue standing in the square. It was Dudian’s appearance.
There was a dragon head altar in the middle of the square. It looked like a dragon head was sticking out from the ground.
“This is it.”Mother lifted the curtain and looked outside. She smiled and turned to Dudian: “Your Sister has been waiting for a long time. Let’s go down.”
The three of them got off the carriage. The nobles and rich people who were shopping around had already avoided the emperor’s carriage. They were full of joy and curiosity as they stood on Tiptoe to see the appearance of the Master of the world.
Dudian quickly sensed his sister’s aura. He was eating tea in a restaurant next to the square. This restaurant was one of the top restaurants in the imperial city. Many young ladies from noble families had to make an appointment in advance if they wanted to eat.
His sister seemed to sense him as she moved towards him.
Soon, Dudian saw a young girl who was full of youth. She was holding a small food box as she walked out of the crowd.
“Dad, Mom.”Dudian’s footsteps were light. Soon, he came in front of the three. The crowd was crowded but there was a large space near where the three were standing. The people who were casually shopping stopped in their tracks, they looked over.
“Brother.”Dudian smiled as he saw Dudian: “Look What I brought for you. This is the best lobster bun in fragrant house. Come and try it.”
Dudian handed the box to Dudian.
Dudian smiled and opened the lid. There was a fragrance coming from inside. There were five exquisite steamed buns inside. He was ready to taste one just by smelling it, suddenly there was a sound of wind breaking.
Bang!
A sharp blade shot out from the box and stabbed towards Dudian’s chest.
At the same time, two cold air hit his back. It pierced through his clothes and into his flesh. However, the first time he felt pain, his body instinctively hardened into several layers of tough cuticle armor, he blocked the sharp objects.
This change was very sudden and very fast!
Dudian’s face suddenly changed and a trace of horror flashed through his eyes.
“This bun is good.”Dudian seemed to be unaware of the sharp objects on his body. He picked up the bun from the food box. The next moment, a row of sharp blades suddenly appeared around his waist, dudian opened his mouth and pushed Dudian and his parents away. He put the bun into his mouth and gently chewed it.
“Brother, you!”Dudian looked at him in a daze. As she retreated, a black shadow disappeared from her abdomen. The blood on the shadow was left on the surface of her clothes as if it was injured.
Dudian slowly swallowed. The faint smile on his face slowly disappeared. He sighed and looked up at his sister. He turned around and looked at his parents. His voice was a bit bitter, “Why?”
The previous assassination came from his closest parents and sister!
The assassination was extremely sudden and without any warning. Moreover, the attack was aimed at his heart. The goal was to kill him in one hit!

chapters.title: Chapter 1264
chapters.content:
Chapter 1264: Chapter 1253: “You Are God, but we are human [ second watch ] .”
Translator:
549690339
“Have you been prepared for this?”The gentle smile on his mother’s face disappeared. There was a hint of fear in her eyes.
His father’s face was gloomy: “I have said it before. He doesn’t treat us as his biological parents. He is always on guard against us!”
“Can you tell me why?”Dudian looked at them. His expression had calmed down. He had been calm since the assassination until now, however there were some difficult to understand emotions in his eyes. There was pain, confusion, and regret.
“Why?”Father’s face didn’t show any trace of kindness and love. He coldly said: “Because you are God but we are human!”
“Kill!”
He roared as white light spread out from his body. With Dudian’s help, they had successfully become kings. Moreover, they were the top five-star legendary magic marks. They belonged to the top of the dynasty, the previous assassination failed. He didn’t want to give Dudian time to react. He knew that his son was smart and intelligent, maybe one side was chatting with him while the other side was secretly brewing something. So he had to make the first move!
Dudian’s eyebrows slightly twitched. His perception quickly spread to cover all corners of the crowded and noisy square. The sudden battle stunned the surrounding crowd, the crowd reacted and immediately fled in panic. The square was in chaos. It happened to be the most expensive commercial street. Most of the people who came here to shop and play were aristocrats or rich people. Most of them had carriages, at this moment, the chaos had become an obstacle.
In the Panic of the crowd, Dudian suddenly felt that a large number of figures were coming in an orderly manner. It seemed that they were the patrolling guards.
Whoosh!
A beam of light shot towards him. It was his father. His ability was similar to that of the King of light. He could grasp the power of light. He could squeeze energy from his cells and control the attack of light waves.
Dudian slightly tilted his head and easily dodged. At the same time he said: “You should have been planning for a long time. The three of you are no match for me. Let the other party come out.”
“It is enough for us to kill you!”His father shouted. His legs emitted light and suddenly shot out. He appeared in front of Dudian as if he had teleported. A laser-like blade swept towards Dudian’s neck.
Dudian wasn’t surprised. His expression was calm like the lake. He raised his hand and gently flicked his finger. The light condensed on his fingertip and collided with the blade. The blade was broken.
Father’s pupils shrank as he didn’t expect Dudian’s strength to be so terrifying. He was a king and was considered a strong existence among kings. He had easily broken the three attacks, the gap in strength was overwhelming!
“Is this the power of a demigod?”Father suddenly felt a chill run down his spine. He hurriedly retreated in panic. He looked at Dudian from the side. He suddenly appeared in front of Dudian and quickly retreated, when he returned to his original place, he looked like he was frightened. He was panting and his face was slightly pale.
Whoosh!
Dudian didn’t look back but he could see that his sister Dudian’s body was covered with sharp blades. Dudian’s ability was the most successful magic mark of the splitter.
Dudian was silent. It seemed that he didn’t react in time. However the moment Dudian got close to Dudian, a ten meter long sharp blade shot out from his back. Puff! It instantly pierced through Dudian’s shoulder, the smooth blade protruded from the front of the sharp blade and pushed her body back. Half of her body was dyed red and blood was dripping.
Dudian’s use of the splitter’s ability and the accumulation of energy in his body were far superior to Dudian’s. The speed of the construction of the sharp blade was more than ten times faster than Dudian’s.
At this time, a large number of armed guards rushed over from the crowd. One of them rushed towards Dudian and asked: “Your Majesty, we are here to protect you!”
A sharp blade shot out from Dudian’s arm. Bang! It pierced the armor on his chest. The armor was not penetrated on the spot.
The guard flew out and landed on the spot. The other guards surrounded him but stopped moving. The eyes behind the helmet were nervously looking at Dudian.
“This thing has protected your breath. If you didn’t deliberately sense it then it would be easy to ignore the past. Is this the reason why you betrayed me?”Dudian’s eyes indifferently glanced at the guards, his eyes fell on his father and mother as he slowly spoke, “You chose the most prosperous area to attack me and lower my vigilance. You thought that there would be no danger in this crowded area. It shows that you have a plan.”
“Why?”He asked again.
“Kill!”The answer was a cold word.
The guards rushed forward as if they had received a command.
However, Dudian’s eyelids twitched. Although he had expected many things from the assassination of his parents, but he didn’t expect that the people they were working with.., they were all king level existences. They had exposed their aura and body energy!
There were more than a hundred of them!
He had a general understanding of the kings of the dynasty. There were less than ten kings except for Barton, Sergei and others. But the number of kings in front of him was ten times more than what he knew!
Every king had destructive power which was no less than a mobile nuclear bomb. If hundreds of kings attacked crazily, the entire planet would be destroyed!
“It seems that you have been planning for a few years. Was it ten years ago or eight years ago?”Dudian’s eyes gradually turned cold. His body suddenly expanded as the kings surrounded him, dark sharp blades shot out from his fingers, arms, shoulders, chest, knees and other parts of his body. They were like Scimitars and were dozens of meters long. The sharp blades were covered with dark energy fluctuations, they had the destructive power to destroy everything.
“Lightning Body!”
“Nothing!”
“Earth Gravity!”
Many kings saw that Dudian took the initiative to attack. They quickly used their own abilities. Some used life-saving abilities, some used offensive abilities, and some directly used control abilities to restrict Dudian’s movements, some sang strange songs and used spiritual attacks to attack Dudian’s brain.
The next moment, Dudian’s hundreds of blades swept out and hit the bodies of more than twenty kings. These kings relied on their own strange defensive means to resist Dudian’s blade attacks. But the next moment.., they screamed and their bodies flew out.
In just one attack, Dudian had severely injured more than twenty kings and killed six of them on the spot.
On the other hand, Dudian had been attacked by more than thirty kings. It was an energy-based attack but there seemed to be a layer of protective film on his body. He was unharmed when the attacks landed on his body, the strange spiritual attacks on his brain were completely blocked.
“How is it possible!”
“This...”
Everyone was shocked to the point that their eyes almost popped out. They couldn’t believe what they were seeing. Hundreds of kings were attacking at the same time. Even the entire imperial city would be blown to pieces, dudian was able to block them?
The most terrified of them were the kings who relied on their strong defense. At the moment their wounds were bleeding. There was also a corrosive power that was constantly corroding their bodies, like the plague virus, they had no choice but to quickly divide new cells to replace the injured ones. However, the speed of division was barely on par with the speed of corrosion, causing the wounds to be unable to heal.

chapters.title: Chapter 1265
chapters.content:
Chapter 1265: Chapter 1254: counter-attack -LThirdhWatchatch ]
Translator:
549690339
“His, his abilities are too complicated!”
“Our attacks are all ineffective, as if they’ve been assimilated!”
“Is this a God?”
“Isn’t he a quasi-god? Didn’t he rely on that Sage engine to barely have the combat power to surpass a king? Why is this happening? !”
Everyone looked at the devil-like figure in horror. They felt that they were experiencing a nightmare. They wanted to wake up but they knew that only death could free them from this nightmare!
The first step of their plan was to let Dudian’s biological parents and sister cooperate. They would choose this complex area to Lower Dudian’s vigilance. They would wait for the opportunity to launch a sneak attack and severely wound him, it would be best if they could kill him in one blow.
Both the environment and the person who launched the sneak attack would easily make Dudian lose his guard. In their estimation, the success rate of the sneak attack was as high as 70% !
However, the sneak attack failed.
However, they had already prepared a complete plan. The second step was to attack at the same time and kill Dudian in a flash! There were hundreds of kings gathered here. They knew how powerful their own strength was. If they were in Dudian’s position, they wouldn’t be able to handle two or three kings!
Although Dudian was strong but he was only a demigod. He was embedded with the sage engine to stimulate the potential of his body. He was only a demigod. He was far from being an invincible God, they were far from being able to kill him.
As long as it wasn’t a monster that Big Ivan couldn’t kill. They were confident that they could kill him. Moreover they knew that Dudian had a fatal weakness which was the heart!
Once the sage engine was destroyed in the heart then he wouldn’t be able to live for long. Moreover his combat power would decrease and he would fall to the level of a king. By then hundreds of kings would be able to beat him into a meat pie.
However, the second step of the plan had failed!
They had made full preparations but failed!
Moreover, the strength dudian had revealed was much stronger than they had imagined. In just one exchange, six people were killed and more than a dozen were injured. The rest of them were people who hadn’t touched Dudian’s sharp blade, if they touched it, they would be either dead or injured!
This terrifying sharp blade was like an electric baton that couldn’t be touched. Once it touched it, it would fall to the ground!
“The number of people is meaningless...”dudian slightly raised his eyes and indifferently looked at the eyes of many people behind the armor. The material of this armor was special. His penetrating vision couldn’t penetrate through it. The sharp blade could barely pierce through it, otherwise the previous attack wouldn’t have only killed six people.
“You!”Father’s eyes were filled with anger as he saw the scene. He didn’t look like the kind person that Dudian was used to. It was as if he had a deep hatred with Dudian. His face was twisted with anger and fear.
“Although you have become a king but the time is too short. Your control over your own strength is too weak. You are inferior to the kings who once dominated the imperial capital.”Dudian looked around, he indifferently said: “But even the former kings are just ants in front of me. They are no different from you. Quantity does not represent strength. It is like a hundred eggs. They will not break the stone. Even if it is a thousand or ten thousand eggs, it is the same.”
In addition to the crowd that was gradually moving away from the square, there was only Dudian’s indifferent voice.
Everyone looked at him in fear. Dudian’s words were like a knife that hit their hearts.
“Don’t listen to his nonsense. His strength is limited. He may not be able to use that kind of attack a few times. Even if he is exhausted to death, we have to kill him. We have no way out!”Duanni gritted her teeth as she climbed up from the pool of blood in the square.
Everyone hesitated as they heard her words. They thought of the mountains of corpses and the Sea of blood under the emperor’s feet. Their hands were stained with blood so they rushed over again.
“Ignorant!”
Dudian looked indifferent. Although he was surprised by the hundreds of kings but it didn’t mean that the hundreds of kings could defeat him. He had the vast memory and knowledge of Lin Changsheng for more than 200 years. Although he wasn’t a real god.., but the application of his ability was more abundant than that of the WA God. Moreover the speed of the SAGE engine to mobilize the energy in his body made him far superior to ordinary kings.
Even if the WA God fought with him he might not be able to defeat him in a short period of time.
Of course, he wouldn’t be able to defeat the WA God. On the contrary, she would secretly learn to adapt and grow quickly.
“Toxic Touch!”
“Prison Cage!”
“Magic Arrow!”
Many kings used their unique abilities, and the air was filled with all kinds of energy. The ground beneath the plaza cracked open, and the buildings in the surrounding commodity street collapsed. The nobles and wealthy people who were fleeing in panic were burned to death by the high temperature, some were struck by the Lightning in the air and turned into ashes, leaving nothing behind.
The sky was dyed red by the raging flames. The dark green poisonous gas spread in the air as if it was the end of the world.
The whole imperial city was affected by the attacks of the kings.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
One by one the kings with extraordinary fighting abilities rushed towards Dudian. Some of them looked like half-human and half-dragon. Some looked like bat-winged demons. Some of them were covered in sharp scales, they approached Dudian from all angles.
Dudian’s expression didn’t change at all. His body expanded into a ball shape. From every part of his body, there were sharp blades. Each of them was dozens of meters long. There were almost no blind spots.
The kings who were ready to get close to Dudian had seen the terror of these sharp blades. They could only quickly retreat. At the moment, Dudian was like a big hedgehog. They couldn’t attack him, all of them disappeared without a trace. All of his abilities were assimilated and absorbed.
Whoosh!
Dudian’s body suddenly became soft like a kelp. He swept out and hit more than a dozen kings who couldn’t Dodge in time. Some of them were cut in half. Some of them were turned into burning men. However after they were cut by the blade.., they were still cut and the wounds turned into black flames. It was like a devil’s mouth was chewing on them.
Plop!
One of the kings was stabbed in the chest and fell in front of Dudian.
He glanced at the king and brandished the sharp blades. He was ready to kill him.
But at this time, the armor on the king’s head fell down and rolled to the side, revealing his face.
The sharp edge of the dagger came to an abrupt stop.

chapters.title: Chapter 1266
chapters.content:
Chapter 1266: Chapter 1255: Eternal Life [ Fourth Update ]
Translator:
549690339
“Barton?”
Dudian looked at the face behind the armor. His mind went blank for a moment but it was only for a moment. He looked up at the kings around him, there was a small hole in the front of each blade. There was a long white silk that spread out like a spider web and stuck to the bodies of the kings. The white silk was thick and tough. Many kings were trapped and couldn’t break free.
“Why?”
A sharp blade covered with dark energy reached Barton’s chest. Dudian’s expression was blurred in the shadow. He couldn’t see clearly but his voice was low.
Barton didn’t think that his helmet would fall. He was stunned for a moment before he reacted: “Dean, I’m sorry. You have to kill me.”
“Why did you betray me?”Dudian’s voice was still low, “Did I mistreat you or did I do something wrong to You? I brought you out of the orphanage. You said that you would repay me with your life. Now, I have made you the king of millions of people. How many people in the world don’t Know You? I have never asked you to repay me for such a favor. But why did you betray me?”
Barton clenched his teeth and clenched his fingers. His face couldn’t help but Twitch under Dudian’s questioning. It was full of shame, pain, and a kind of sad despair, “Dean, I’m sorry. I’m worse than a beast. Kill me!”
“Why?”Dudian asked again.
Barton’s eyes were slightly red. Tears flowed down his eyes and fell to his temples. He raised his arm to cover his eyes and cried.
“Why?”Dudian looked up. His face was expressionless but his eyes were full of blood. He looked straight at his parents.
Many kings were struggling in the spider web. They didn’t dare to attack the other kings who were entangled by the spider web. However the material of the spider web was extremely special and it was constantly changing, even kings who had special means would find it difficult to break free. This made many kings shocked and afraid. They didn’t expect that dudian would be able to subdue them again.
“Why?”Mother coldly looked at him and took a deep breath, “You are a god and we are just mortals. You will live forever but we will die eventually! You have never shared the secret of becoming a god with us. You have no intention to let us become a god because once everyone is a god, they will be able to threaten you. You will no longer be superior to them!”
“So, only if you die, we can live forever!”
Dudian’s mouth twitched: “So, you want to Live Forever?”
“We have known for a long time that you have the ability to know your own past. You must have known that you are not our biological child. You are just an artificial species that we have created.”Father solemnly said: “We created you for the purpose. Do you still remember? It is to solve the problem of human medical treatment. It is to increase the lifespan of humans. It is to live longer!”
“As long as you become a god, you will be immortal!”
Dudian was silent for a moment: “In this case, you are the same as the magic worm and Aragami. You are pursuing immortality. You can even kill me for this, right?”
“That’s right.”
“If you had shared the secret of becoming a god earlier, we wouldn’t have done this to you.”
Dudian suddenly smiled and said to himself: “I resurrected you but you want me to die. Indeed, you are not my parents. I made a mistake at the beginning. It must be like this...”
His father and mother’s faces changed at the same time. They were both angry and afraid.
“Barton, What About You? Do you want to Live Forever?”Dudian looked at Barton and smiled.
Barton wiped his tears and looked at Dudian, he clenched his teeth: “Dean, I’m sorry. If I don’t make a move, my wife and my children will die! Kill me. I only beg you to let my wife and children go. They are innocent. I beg you.”
“Wife, children...”Dudian murmured. He shook his head and smiled, “I forgot that you are married and have children. You have your own family. You are no longer single. Well, they used your wife and children’s lives to hold you hostage. So you can help them to kill me. No matter how much I helped you and saved you several times, I am still an outsider in front of your family.”
“Dean, I’m sorry. Without You, I wouldn’t be here today. I...”Barton clenched his fists. His face was full of pain and regret.
Dudian laughed in a low voice: “Your Wife and children might not be able to completely convince you. I’m afraid that you also think that you want me to disappear.”
“Dean...”
Dudian laughed, “There is no rule in this world. There is always a reward for kindness. People’s hearts are always changing. This is probably the reason why I look down on life. Because your lives are really, really humble and worthless...”
The sharp blade that was hanging on Barton’s chest suddenly stabbed into Barton’s heart. Blood spurted out of Barton’s mouth as his eyes opened wide, it seemed that he didn’t think that Dudian would really kill him. But he saw that Dudian’s eyes had become extremely cold. It seemed that he understood.
He felt that the vitality in his chest was rapidly disappearing. It seemed that something was absorbing it. He used all his strength to beg: “Please, let my wife and children go. They are really innocent...”
The sharp blade was pulled out and blood spilled.
Dudian didn’t look at him again. His eyes slowly swept over the other kings, he spoke in a cold voice: “Take Off Your Helmets. Let Me See who else is involved.”
Many kings who had broken free from the spider silk looked at each other. No one took off their helmets. If today’s assassination failed, they could continue to hide their identities. Once they were exposed, they would be completely finished.
“Then let me personally see it.”Dudian’s eyes slowly narrowed. A cold light flashed as his body suddenly swept out. The sharp blades on his body were like a group of snakes dancing in chaos as he rushed towards the crowd.
“Ah!”
“I dodged. Why is it like this!”
“Damn, there is something invisible!”
More than a dozen kings were injured. Four of them were killed on the spot.
The other kings were frightened by Dudian’s fierce attack. Although they knew that their side had the advantage in numbers, but at the moment the huge number of people didn’t give them any sense of security, their eyes weren’t ordinary small fries. They could see that it was almost impossible to defeat Dudian by using the Sea of people tactic!
Some people had made a prompt decision to retreat.
The King’s defeat was faster than that of the ordinary soldiers. If it was a group of 100 soldiers, they wouldn’t think about retreating until there were only a dozen of them left. But the king was much smarter than the ordinary soldiers, so they had seen the situation earlier and chose to retreat earlier.
Perhaps this was the reason why a group of smart people gathered together would become a group of smart pigs.
“You...”Dudian was in disbelief as he saw the scene. He didn’t expect the king to have no ability to fight against dudian. It was a one-sided massacre. This was the first time they saw Dudian make a move, he had shown extraordinary strength. The last time he made a move was when Dudian killed the master of the dragon. But the battle ended very quickly so they couldn’t see anything.
Since Dudian had built the dynasty he had handed all the big and small things to Barton and others to deal with. He had been in the laboratory and hadn’t made any moves. So they didn’t have a strong concept of a demigod, they could only speculate from Dudian’s previous battles. But they had never personally observed those battles. They had heard about them from the way they fought. They didn’t expect that the gap between a king and a demigod was greater than the gap between a hunter and the Abyss!
“Mason?”Dudian’s sharp blade cut off the arm of a king and lifted his helmet. His eyes narrowed as he saw the stunned expression on the king’s face, the sharp blade cut off the king’s head like a shadow.
He was like a wolf as he chased after the other kings. The invincible sharp blade easily penetrated their bodies. It was difficult to resist even if one’s body was transformed into energy. The structure of his sharp blade wasn’t simple to cut the blade, instead, they contained annihilation energy and other special characteristics. After all, with Lin Changsheng’s vast knowledge reserves, it was equivalent to him obtaining the abilities of all monsters. It was even more than that.
..
Well, today’s grand ending was not going to happen. He could predict tomorrow with his eyes. Well, he could only predict it with his eyes

chapters.title: Chapter 1267
chapters.content:
Chapter 1267: Chapter 1256: Lonely King [ first update ]
Translator:
549690339
“Run!”
“We are not his opponent at all! The information is wrong!”
“He is a God!”
Many kings fled in all directions. Some tried to fight back but their attacks didn’t affect dudian. Even if some of the attacks were effective to cause damage to Dudian, they healed in an instant.
“Shadow ability, you are... Aurora?”Dudian saw one of the fleeing figures. He was wearing exquisite silver female armor which wrapped around his chest. At this moment he used his magic marks ability and turned into a shadow, he merged into the shadow of other kings. This was the five-star legendary ability that Aurora had chosen and strengthened. It was second to none in terms of life preservation and assassination. It was also known as the Shadow Queen.
Whoosh!
Cold light flashed in his eyes. A shadow suddenly extended from one of the sharp blades and flew out. In the blink of an eye, it caught up with the shadow of a king. The next moment, a figure suddenly flew out from the shadow, it was the female knight who had transformed into a shadow.
The sharp blade suddenly turned and softened like a kelp. It shot out a bolt of lightning and hit the armor on top of her head. It revealed the face of a tearful woman. It was Aurora who had reported the matter to him.
Dudian’s eyes flashed as he saw her sad face. The sharp blade turned and went around her. It pierced through the body of a king behind her and tore it apart.
“Cage!”
Dudian shouted. The ground within dozens of miles suddenly cracked. A large amount of white silk shot out from the inside and gathered in the sky. It was like a Snow White Bowl that was upside down on the ground.
The ordinary nobles and wealthy businessmen were all imprisoned in the area. They kneeled on the ground in fear and begged loudly.
The next moment, white spiderweb-like spears shot out from the inner wall of the cage. They pierced down from the sky like raindrops. The attack turned the entire land into a purgatory. Countless civilians were pierced through in an instant, the silver spear was highly corrosive. The bodies of the people who were pierced through quickly melted and turned into a pool of blood. The guards who were guarding the area were also hit.
All the kings who were fleeing were shocked. They didn’t expect the emperor’s methods to be so cruel. It was far more cruel than they had imagined. Even the innocent people involved were not spared!
They thought of their previous judgment and discussion. Once again they felt the coldness of the emperor’s heart as well as the disregard for Life!
“It’s useless. I have strengthened the cage. Your ability can’t break it.”Dudian’s cold eyes swept over the kings who had fled more than ten miles away. His perception locked onto their figures.
Many kings had tried to attack the cage in the sky but the silver cage was tougher than they had imagined. Both physical and chemical attacks and energy attacks were absorbed, even if someone had torn a gap, there was another layer of cage outside the gap.
Some kings tried to go underground but found that there was a complete sphere in the depths of the underground!
“Is your reason the same as Barton’s?”Dudian ignored the panicked kings and looked down at Aurora.
Aurora’s eyes turned red, she choked: “Your Majesty, my husband has made a big mistake. I know that he is being calculated by others. But if you know about it, you will not let him go. So I can only help them. I am sorry. I only hope that I can use my life to exchange for a peaceful life. I hope that you will not vent your anger on them. I...”
The shadow behind her suddenly moved. It turned into a sharp blade and pierced through her heart from the back.
Blood flowed out from the corner of her mouth. It was because of the burst of blood from her body.
“You gave me a chance to avenge my sister. I have always longed for a home. My children are really innocent. Your Majesty, Please...”Aurora looked at Dudian sadly, her eyes were filled with despair as she looked at the indifferent face.
Dudian stared at her.
He looked at her like a statue.
He saw that her eyes were gradually fading and her breath was getting weaker. Her life was fading but there was no fluctuation.
Until she fell to the ground and her body was completely dead.
He was silent. Only the silver spider spears continued to shoot from the sky. However, the area within a hundred meters of him was not affected by the attack. It seemed that the storm in the world had nothing to do with this place.
“Family...”he silently said.
“You, do you want to kill everyone before you give up?”A voice full of resentment and anger came from behind. The next moment, Dudian’s angry arms turned into scarlet blades, they rushed towards Dudian’s back.
Dudian didn’t turn around as if he didn’t hear her.
When Dudian was less than ten meters away from her back, a sharp blade like a sickle suddenly shot out from his back. Puff! It pierced through Dudian’s chest and pierced through the air.
“You...”Dudian looked at him in a daze. The next moment, the strange energy attack from the sharp blade entered her body and tore her internal organs. The pain twisted her beautiful face.
“Is eternal life really that important?”A face slowly appeared on Dudian’s back. He quietly looked at the girl who was struggling in pain.
Dudian’s body twisted in pain as he tried to break away from the sharp blade. However, there seemed to be a suction force from the sharp blade which firmly sucked her body onto it. She struggled, she screamed in pain: “You are a monster. You revived us to satisfy your inner desire. Sooner or later, you will kill us!”
“Sister, you have loved me the most since I was a child. Why are you doing this?”Dudian looked at her and asked.
Dudian’s body turned into a monster as if he was being burned by flames. He slapped the blade and screamed: “Monster, go to hell! !”
Dudian was silent for a moment. The next moment, Dudian’s body which was struggling on the edge of the blade suddenly froze and burst into countless pieces of flesh.
“Sister won’t hurt me at all. You are a failure...”Dudian indifferently glanced at the pieces of meat on the ground. His eyes fell on his parents who were trembling in fear, “You, too...”
Whoosh!
His body shot out, and his body was covered with sharp blades.
“Run!”His father shouted. His body turned into light and shot towards the distance like a laser. However Dudian’s body shot out several sharp blades. His speed was faster than his father’s, he pierced his body and nailed it to the ground.
“Failed product!”
“Failed product!”
Dudian whispered as if he was possessed. The sharp blades danced and tore his mother’s body. He rushed to his father who was nailed to the ground, he tore his body apart.
Dudian looked up at the king who was fleeing in panic. He rushed over again.
The slaughter continued in the cage. One King after another screamed in pain. Some were completely desperate. They knelt down and begged for mercy when they saw Dudian rush over. However, they were not spared and were directly killed.
Ten minutes later.
Dudian stood in front of the last king. The king was kneeling on the ground and trembling. He was so scared that tears were streaming down his face. The armor on his head fell to the ground. It was an unfamiliar face.
Dudian’s body was covered in blood. Every blade was dyed red by blood. The strong smell of blood rushed out. The king was almost suffocated. His heart was trembling. He kowtowed as hard as he could, dudian begged: “Your Majesty, I beg you. Whatever you want me to do, please don’t kill me. I beg you...”
“Isn’t it better to rely on my parents than to submit to me? Don’t tell me that hundreds of kings have been seized by them?”Dudian slowly opened his mouth.
The king on the ground knocked his head on the ground, he trembled: “Your Majesty, they are forcing us. We are secretly trained by them. If we don’t listen to them, we will be disposed of by them. Moreover, Your Majesty, you are a god. We can’t understand you. You can resurrect the dead. Our lives are as light as a feather for you. We... We have no choice...”
“Is that so...”Dudian murmured.
Puff!
A sharp blade cut off the body of the king and killed him on the spot.
The bloody wind blew gently and lingered around him. No one was left alive within dozens of miles of the cage. The buildings were destroyed like the battlefield of Purgatory, only he was left standing alone in this mountain of corpses and sea of blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 1268
chapters.content:
Chapter 1268: Chapter 1257: The Unsolvable Apocalypse (1)
Translator:
549690339
To the west of the dynasty, there was a giant wall.
This giant wall was located in a remote swampy area and was quite far from the imperial capital. Even in the current era of information sharing and trade between the giant walls, there were not many railroad tracks outside this giant wall, there were also no beautiful tourist sceneries. It was still a wild and dangerous land filled with weeds, hills, and swamps.
To the people in the giant wall, the giant wall they were in was their entire world.
In the center of this world, the core of the giant wall was the king’s city. The majestic buildings formed a forest, and in the center of these buildings was the most magnificent and towering palace. In the back garden of the palace, there was a garden full of fresh flowers, beautiful and alluring, there was a sandy area in one of them. Two three or four-year-old children were lying on the sandy ground, using the sand to build a fort. They were having a great time.
Not far away from them stood a middle-aged man with an imposing bearing. He stood with his hands behind his back. His posture was tall and straight. His golden hair was extremely pure. He wore a long, slim black suit that looked like a tuxedo. There were a few silver chains embedded in it, he looked slightly noble.
He quietly looked ahead and looked at the end of the sky.
The sky above this giant wall was clear and blue. However, at the end of the sky, there was a gray haze. It seemed like there was a rainstorm sweeping over.
He stared silently and gradually became lost in thought. No one knew what he was thinking.
“Lord Wall Master.”A soft call came from the garden behind. It was a well-proportioned young man. His face was somewhat pale and he was slightly panicked. He took three steps and rushed to the middle-aged man’s side, he said, “Something has happened, something big has happened!”
The middle-aged man woke up from his empty thoughts and slowly turned around. His expression was calm and there were no ripples. He said, “What happened?”
“Something big has happened in the Imperial City!”The young man’s voice trembled, he said, “I just received news that a large number of kings have appeared in the imperial city. They took advantage of the emperor’s patrol to attack his majesty. I heard that the main participants were his majesty’s biological parents. The entire imperial city has fallen into chaos. The area affected by the battle is extremely large. It is said that tens of miles of land have been razed to the ground. Countless people have died!”
The middle-aged man was slightly startled. He frowned slightly and muttered to himself, “Has this day finally arrived?”
The young man was a little surprised when he heard his words. He said, “Lord Wall Master, you knew this long ago?”
The middle-aged man shook his head slightly. He was about to speak when a forthright and forthright voice came from outside the garden. “Noyce, didn’t you say that there was rose wine brewed from flowers here? Where’s the wine?”
As he spoke, a burly middle-aged man walked in. He had a shaved head and the top of his head was shining. At this moment, there were a few hickeys left on the top of his head, which was very eye-catching.
This golden-haired middle-aged man was Noyce. He was slightly startled and said with a wry smile, “Sergei, you’d better wipe your head clean first.”
Sergei reached out his hand to touch his head and wiped a few hickeys on his hand. He didn’t care at all and said with a smile, “It’s just the attachment of some women. What’s there to be clean about? Quickly take out your rose wine and share it.”
Noyce signaled the young man to leave and then sat down in front of the tea table in the garden. The tea table here was a european-style black and white tea table. Usually, the noblewomen ate afternoon tea in the garden.
He casually poured a cup of tea on the table and said, “You’re not in the mood to eat the wine. have some tea to calm yourself down.”
Sergei was stunned. “Calm down? Did Something Happen? Don’t lie to me.”
“Someone tried to assassinate His Majesty.”Noyce’s voice was calm, but his words were shocking.
Sergei immediately widened his eyes and said in surprise, “Assassinate His Majesty? You, you said it wrong, which Emperor did you assassinate?”
“Our young master.”Noyce said indifferently, “Besides him, who else is His Majesty?”
Sergei was stunned for a moment, then he laughed and said, “I said it was a big deal. How can this be considered a big deal? which blind person is tired of living and actually tried to assassinate him? Isn’t this like a lantern in the toilet looking for SH * t?”
Noyce rolled his eyes, he said, “The people who assassinated him are his biological parents, the two who are now acting in the national affairs, and his biological sister. If I’m not wrong, Barton and Macon are also involved. Aurora... probably won’t be spared, and that student of his, Edward.”
Sergei was dumbstruck when he heard that, after a while, he said, “Are you crazy? Why are you spouting nonsense? “Why did his biological parents assassinate him, Barton, Macon, and the others? I even had a drink with them a few days ago. We were the first to follow his majesty, so there’s no way we would betray him. Why would we participate? “Furthermore, don’t they know how strong His Majesty is? With their strength, His Majesty could probably kill them with one hand.”
Noyce shook his head slightly and said, “My information came a little late. You are the leader of the imperial guards and can enter the dynasty’s intelligence network. You should be able to find out the whole story from there. Why not take a look?”
Kaki was stunned for a moment. He immediately rolled up his sleeves and quickly entered a secret key into his wristwatch. A moment later, his expression changed drastically. He jumped up from his chair and his body trembled slightly. In an instant, his head was covered in cold sweat, his face was filled with disbelief.
“How is it?”Noyce saw his reaction and slightly frowned.
Karch stood in a daze for a long time before he slowly sat down, he said in a daze, “You’re right. The imperial capital is already in chaos. There is indeed an assassination operation, and it is led by His Majesty’s biological parents. Barton is involved, Macon is involved, Aurora is involved, Edward is involved, and a few other kings are also involved. There are over a hundred kings present, but all of them are dead...”
Neuss’s eyelid twitched. Although he had made a prediction in his heart but his heart was still trembling when he heard about hundreds of kings. However he calmed down very quickly, it seemed that it should be the case.
“Why? Why did they do this?”Sergei was stunned. He couldn’t believe that Barton and Mason would betray Dudian, he didn’t believe that Dudian’s biological parents would lead the way!
Neuss sighed, “They have fought for the dynasty for the past ten years. Now they have their own families and found their own happiness. They are living more comfortably than the fantasy. They wouldn’t accept it if they were deprived of such days.”
Sergei looked up at him: “What did you say?”
“You didn’t participate. It’s probably because no one found you. Because they know that although you have many women by your side, you’re just playing around. You never use your emotions, and you can’t use them to hold you hostage. Moreover, you don’t have any children, and you don’t have any weak points. So, naturally, you didn’t participate.”Noyce sighed.
Sergei was stunned. “You mean, they were forced?”
“Since they participated, there’s no such thing as being forced. This is the path they chose. It’s a pity that they don’t know how terrifying Our Majesty’s true strength is.”Noyce shook his head, with a hint of regret.
Sergei couldn’t help but shout, “Are their brains damaged? were they kicked in the head by pigs? They actually want to assassinate his majesty. What benefits does this have for them? Is the wealth they have now not enough for them to enjoy? Is their status not high enough? What His Majesty can give them has already been given to the extreme! His parents are already in charge of the dynasty. They are not emperors, but they are better than emperors. Why would they still take such a big risk to do such a thing? Why?”
Noyce sighed, “There is no limit to the human heart. Acting as an emperor is still acting as an agent, which means that they still have to depend on others. You and I both know that His Majesty has the power of the creator and can resurrect the dead. Do you think they don’t know this? Do they worry that if they make a mistake, his majesty will reforge them
“So only when His Majesty is dead can they truly live.”
“But... But His Majesty doesn’t care about these things at all. The only thing his majesty really cares about is that Lady Aisha. To His Majesty, Power is just a tool to play with. He’s even tired of playing with it.”
Noyce smiled bitterly, “But sometimes, if you say you don’t want it, others may not think you don’t want it. If you say you didn’t hit him, but if your palm is there, others won’t believe you!”! “Besides, His Majesty is dead, and the secret of becoming a god falls into their hands. Who doesn’t want to live forever? “Who doesn’t want to live for ten thousand years, a hundred thousand years, a million years? “Even if the earth is destroyed, it can still coexist with the universe.”
“But...”kaki said bitterly, “Even if His Majesty is dead, that WA God is still there. She treats his majesty as her biological parents. How can she not avenge his majesty? Do they still want to kill gods? With just them?”
“That’s why goddess Wa wasn’t here during this operation. As far as I know, she left Earth half a month ago and went to outer space to play. She probably received some orders to go to outer space to do something, which is why she hasn’t returned yet,”Noyce said softly. “If the assassination is successful, when she returns, they can replace her with a dead peach. They can create a memory for his majesty’s corpse, then use his majesty’s corpse to control this goddess WA. It’ll be the best of both worlds.”
“Does that mean that God wa was deliberately moved away by them?”
“Otherwise, how would they have the courage to take action?”
Sergei opened his mouth and finally let out a long sigh, he said bitterly, “How stupid. They are living a good life, but why do they have to think about so many things? Isn’t good wine and women good? Can’t they be attracted to them? Why Can’t they just be content?”
Noyce glanced at him and turned to point at the two children playing in the sand. “Do you want to play with them?”
Sergei was stunned. He turned to see the two children building a castle with sand on the sand. He couldn’t help but laugh and said, “I’m talking about serious business with you. who has time to play such a childish thing with your children?”
These two children were obviously Noyce’s.
He was not angry when he heard this. Instead, he smiled faintly, he said, “You also know that this kind of thing is too childish, so you won’t do it. This thing can’t attract you, but it can attract them. At the same time, what you think is interesting now may be as childish and laughable as these two children building a castle in their eyes. Why would they enjoy it as much as you do?”
Karch was stunned.
“There are very few people in this world who have a common hobby. Everyone loves money, not because of the charm of money itself, but because money can buy them different things they want. Money is just a channel,”Noyce said slowly. “Different experiences, personalities, likes, and dislikes naturally have different pursuits. If you can’t understand them, they naturally can’t understand you. Therefore, they naturally can’t understand His Majesty.”
“Why?”Kaki was stunned.
“Because His Majesty is a god, and we are humans. How can humans understand God? People can only imagine god, Guess God, and analyze God, but they can never truly understand God.”At this point, noyce sighed softly, he said, “However, we are social animals, and we need a leader. The leader is the only one, and that is the highest. Only he can see the scenery that stands at the top. When he gains the world, it is also destined that he will lose the world and break away from the group. He is like a guide sheep, a horse pulling a carriage, walking at the front. What people can only see is his back.”
“To reach the peak, isn’t it also a dead end?”
Sergei’s expression changed, and he said hesitantly, “You mean, in His Majesty’s eyes, all of our thoughts and pursuits are as boring as building sand sculptures?”
“Maybe.”
“Is this the reason why the more you grow, the fewer friends you have?”
“When you are a grain of sand, you form a desert with the grain of sand. When you are a stone, you form a mountain with the stone. When you are a bird, you form a flock with the bird.”Noyce paused for a moment, then he continued, “But when you become a bird, you will no longer be accompanied by the grain of sand and the stone. You will no longer appreciate them. If you look at them one more time, they will not understand you, nor will they know you. They will also not understand that you were once a grain of sand and the stone. They will only think that you were born as a bird because they can not find the same characteristics in you.”
“If you don’t meet a flock of birds, you will only become a lonely bird. If you don’t meet other rocks, you will only be a lonely rock in the desert.”
Sergei was silent.
He was not stupid. He already understood.
Looking at the tea in the cup in front of him, the tea leaves swirled and fell, as if it was his fate. He was silent for a moment and asked, “You seem to have known that all this would happen?”
Noyce shook his head and said, “I just had a premonition, but I didn’t think that it would really happen. A Tiger doesn’t live with a dog. Even if this tiger is docile and protects the dog, the dog will still feel fear and fear, and then bark at it.”
Sergei was silent for a moment, and then.., he sighed and said, “You’re right, but it’s a pity that the world is peaceful now, but there are waves. The imperial city was also destroyed, and hundreds of kings died just like that. What a huge force it is to destroy itself just like that.”
Neuss shook his head, “The castle can be rebuilt even if it is destroyed. The chessboard can be rearranged. Even if there is no new game, the pieces can be restored. The only thing that is worried about the chessboard is not the player but the chess pieces. The one who is worried about the castle will be destroyed is not the child but the sand. His Majesty is the one who is playing chess. He is the child of the castle.”
Sergei was startled as he thought of Dudian’s creator-like ability. His heart suddenly trembled. He vaguely understood what Neuss was feeling. For the two children who were playing with the sand on the ground, the castle made of sand.., perhaps it was precious and it took a lot of effort. But if it was destroyed, they would cry or get angry.
After all, it’s not a child’s life!
But for them, it’s their destiny!
“Creation... is this the power of God? Why do I feel that this is more like the power of the devil, this is an ability that should not exist in the world, who has, who will care about life...”katch muttered to himself.
..
