chapters.title: Chapter 1270
chapters.content:
Chapter 1270: Chapter 1258: Unsolvable Apocalypse (2)
Translator:
549690339
“God or demon, they are not us mortals. We are not a race, so how can we get along?”Noyce said indifferently, “I will appreciate the flowers in the garden and take care of them carefully. To these flowers, I am a God! “But you will not appreciate them. You will even break branches or trample on them because they are in the way. That is why you are a demon
“But when it comes to the black snow season, when the weather is cold and the land is freezing, and when everything Withers, I’ll bury them into the ground and turn them into fertilizer for the next year. I Won’t build a greenhouse especially for them, because they’re just ornamental objects after all. When the next year’s flowers are brilliant, I’ll still be their God
“We don’t really care about these playthings, but these playthings naively define us as gods and detestable demons. They don’t know that we’re the same race and we’re the same family. What kind of playthings do they think they are? How dare they judge us?”
Karch was startled, and could not help but reassess him, saying seriously, “You are the one who sees things the most clearly in this aspect.”
“After all, I was once the person who followed His Majesty the longest. His Majesty had expressed the same meaning in those words a long time ago, just like the church of Sylvia. Light and darkness, the world views them as opposites, but they do not know that they are one. Poor people are mostly fools.”Noyce sighed softly, there was a hint of bitterness at the corner of his mouth. Even though he knew these principles, it was difficult for him to escape them. After all, he was still a “Fool”.
Sergei sighed, he said, “That’s true. The thing I admire most about his majesty is that he has no one to rely on. He worked hard all by himself, but he managed to climb to his current position! “All the nobles and dukes in the dynasty all think that His Majesty is a ruthless devil. But look at these commoners who live at the bottom. They love this era so much. Everyone can step out of the giant wall and live freely
“Perhaps others will think that his Majesty massacred the innocent and was cruel and brutal. This is indeed undeniable, but how many people have improved their lives because of his majesty? “When the Aragami invaded, who saved the earth? “When the Aragami and the demonic insects enslaved, who broke this situation? “Although His Majesty did not consider himself a savior, he did what a savior should do.”
“However, the people’s definition of a savior is too high and too flawless. They think that a savior is a hero and all actions are absolutely just. Little did they know that how can absolute justice split apart this dark world? “No matter how sharp the light is, how can it completely dispel the darkness? “Even if the sun is as dazzling as it is, it can not shine on the back of the Earth. That place still has to endure the fear of the night.”
Noyce nodded silently, he said, “Darkness can not be dispelled, just like light can not be extinguished. There will always be heroes born. However, these heroes are only the embellishment of this world. They are starlight. and the entire vast universe is ultimately darkness. Although starlight is brilliant, darkness is eternal. Those who desire peace in the world are just childish children. Mature people only desire relative and superficial peace, because that is already very rare!”
Sergei sighed, “It’s a pity that all the killings and sins were borne by his majesty, but no one will remember his kindness. Perhaps only the ordinary people will be grateful, but their gratitude is too weak and powerless.”
“His Majesty doesn’t care whether he is grateful or not. The gratitude of the whole world and the hatred of the whole world may be no different to him.”Noyce shook his head, “Just like what he is pursuing and caring about, not many people will care about it.”
Sergei wryly smiled, he said in a nostalgic tone: “I Really Hope His Majesty can go back to the time when he was in Sylvia. At that time, he was more or less human. He had emotions but now he is more like an ice-cold god.”
Neuss thought of the last conversation with Dudian when they left the imperial capital. The corner of his mouth slightly moved: “There are some things that can not be returned.”
“Yes, we can’t go back...”Sergei sighed.
Neuss looked into the distance, he said to himself: “Everyone will choose the ‘right’path. Everyone will grow and change themselves. They will change because of the environment. Their ideals and pursuits may change because they have to change and abandon them in order to adapt to the current living environment.”
“No one will think that they have gone wrong, and no one will think that all of their current ideas are bad. Even if they occasionally notice it, they will know it in the depths of their hearts. There is nothing they can do because this is what it means to survive and work hard to maintain
“When we change, it means that we have abandoned our previous selves and abandoned our previous ‘wrong’thoughts. Everyone knows that we should not keep walking on the wrong path, so we will keep looking for the ‘right’path. Unfortunately, we keep looking, but we never know what the right path is! “Saints can’t teach us this either. Saints can only teach us the same moral model, but the world is complicated. We can’t rely on the word ‘morality’to work. We can live long and go far!”
“So whether it’s right or not, we will only find one that suits us in the end.”
“If it suits us, it might be right.”
“If it’s right, then it won’t change anymore.”
Sergei was startled and looked at him deeply, he said, “No wonder you resigned ten years ago and came to this remote giant wall. At that time, we still couldn’t see through you. At that time, His Majesty had just ascended the throne and had countless riches and riches, but you abandoned all of them and lived in this remote and desolate place. Now, I’m the only one left among us who live in the imperial city. The others were blinded by greed. Some were forced into the whirlpool of battle and couldn’t extricate themselves. In the end, they could only end up like this. You chose the right path, and it suits you the most.”
“There is no right path.”Noyce glanced at the two children on the sand in the distance, and a hint of doting flashed through his eyes, he said, “Even I feel that the current days are too comfortable, and I feel a little uneasy. The Flames of war in the imperial capital have not even affected this place, but in the future, it will be difficult for this place to escape. I just hope that that day will come a little later.”
Ka Qi was startled, he said, “It can’t be, could it be that his majesty will vent his anger on us? With His Majesty’s methods, it should be very easy to find out our background. We are all clean. Moreover, after this incident’s Warning Bell, his majesty should not allow such a thing to happen again.”
“His Majesty will naturally not blame us, but others may not.”Noyce glanced at him, “We are all the people closest to his majesty. I don’t know how many people are eyeing our positions, hoping to replace them and become his majesty’s confidants. Since we can’t topple His Majesty, toppling US and subjugating his majesty, being above tens of thousands of people can be considered the greatest pursuit.”
“The power struggle will sooner or later seep into this place. Perhaps it has already begun to seep in, but we haven’t noticed it yet.”
Kache’s expression changed slightly, and he said, “With our strength and status, even if they want to assassinate us, it’s unlikely, right?”
“Assassinating naturally has its difficulties, but others can use his majesty’s hands to kill us. For example, they can create some opportunities for his majesty to Alienate Us, make His Majesty suspicious, and then use some methods to make us misunderstood by his majesty. Isn’t that a chance?”Noyce smiled lightly, his expression did not seem to care, but the words he said were enough to make people shudder.
Karch was stunned and could not say anything for a moment.
He was not afraid of open knives and spears, but it was impossible to guard against the conspiracies hidden in the darkness!
“Is, is there no way for us?”Karch could not help but ask, placing his hope on Noyce.
Noyce shook his head slightly, “We don’t need to think of a way. His Majesty is a person. His Majesty is now on guard against what I have said, so he will naturally consider it. Instead, he will use us to lure the snake out of its hole. No matter who tries to sow discord between us and his majesty, he will become the person his Majesty wants to kill!”! “After this incident, it is absolutely impossible for us to betray his majesty. How Can His Majesty Not Understand This?”
Sergei was stunned for a moment, then he let out a long sigh and said unhappily, “I told you, His Majesty is Wise. You said it was so dangerous that it almost scared me!”
Noyce laughed lightly, but the corner of his mouth was a little bitter, he said, “His Majesty is naturally wise. Looking at all the countries in the world, even the first emperor of the ancient Huaxia Dynasty, who was known as the first emperor of all time, is not as good as Our Majesty when it comes to great achievements! “Even if we give the first emperor a map of the world and let him unify the whole world, he would still be the emperor of mankind. He could only call himself the son of Heaven!”
“What is the son of Heaven?”
“The son of heaven! That’s why the Emperor ascended the throne to worship heaven!”
“And Our Majesty not only unified the whole world and all the systems, but also solved the external problems of mankind, expelled the monsters, and repelled the alien invaders such as the Aragami and the demonic insects. Just these achievements alone are far beyond the scope of the emperor and the emperor. Moreover, your Majesty has evolved to be close to a god. The strength of your body brings about the strength of your mind!”
“His Majesty no longer belongs to the emperor, but to God.”
“If the ancient Emperor was the son of Heaven, our Emperor would be the heaven!”
“Heaven?”
Sergei was stunned, he said, “That’s true. His Majesty is close to God, which is indeed not comparable to an ordinary emperor. In this way, we don’t have to worry too much. If any danger happens, His Majesty will take every precaution and solve it early.”
The smile on Noyce’s face slowly disappeared, and he said indifferently, “Although heaven is more noble than the son of heaven, what is ‘heaven’?”
“HMM?”Kache was puzzled and did not understand.
“Heaven Is Justice.”Noyce stared at him, he said, “No matter whether you are beautiful or ugly, noble or cheap, you can not escape death! Whether it is a wasteland or a swamp, or a flourishing city, when the rainy season comes, it will be drenched! “The heavens will not favor you because of your prayers, nor will they punish you with lightning because of your vicious curses!”
“The heavens are high above, above the clouds.”
“Looking down on all living things, they will not be moved by their joy, nor will they favor them because of their misery!”
“When the drought is over, they will not rain on you because you are pitiful! When the rain is overflowing, it will not stop because your home is destroyed!”
“What the heavens follow are the rules of the heavens. The emotions of the human world have no effect on it.”
“If you begged for it to appear, it would only be a coincidental encounter. After all, the world is suffering. There are more than ten million people begging for it. There will always be a blind cat running into a dead mouse.”
“This is the heavens.”
Sergei was stunned. After a long time, he finally reacted. His expression became a little ugly as he said, “Do you mean that his majesty will become like the heavens, cold and heartless?”
Noyce did not answer him directly. Instead, he smiled lightly, “No matter what, His Majesty will always have his Majesty’s considerations. We only need to abide by His Majesty’s rules. Don’t think too much. No matter what, at least for now, we are at peace. The future is too far away. To seek for eternal peace is itself an extremely cruel war! Isn’t using war to seek for peace the most laughable thing in the world?”
..
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1271 - Chapter 1,259: Unsolvable Apocalypse (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1271: Chapter 1,259: Unsolvable Apocalypse (3)
Translator:
549690339
“But all peace is obtained through war. This is something that can not be changed, just like how we can not change his majesty’s Will.”Sergei sighed.
Noyce was slightly lost in thought. After a moment.., he then whispered, “Indeed, this is something that can not be changed. Just like how we will eventually be destroyed, there is no way to stop it. Living in this apocalypse, who can escape from the Sea of suffering? Climb onto the shore, perhaps it is thorn prison.”
“Eventually destroyed?”Sergei was startled and frowned. “What do you mean?”
Noyce leaned back on his chair and looked up at the blue sky above his head. He felt that the clouds were moving extremely fast, as if a large area was gathering here.., he said faintly, “In the past, I always thought that I could rely on my own efforts to get out of the predicament and end the suffering, but it was not until I went to prison that I realized that there are many things that you can not change. Sometimes, what you have to deal with is not just one person, but the system that has lasted for hundreds of years, thousands of years, as well as the entire empire, and even all the civilians of the entire empire
“When you want to change, you have to destroy everything.”
“If you don’t want to change, you can only be destroyed or assimilated, smoothing out the edges and becoming the least prominent person in the crowd.”
Noyce was silent for a moment, after a moment, he said, “It was only after I was released from prison and grew up with His Majesty that I climbed up to the status of a king. My vision also expanded from the small giant wall to the entire world. I originally thought that all suffering would leave me and I would have no worries in my life. However, I later realized that I was wrong. I am no different from that weak prisoner who was trapped in the giant wall of Sylvia.”
“I am powerful and powerful, but I will eventually die. I will either die of old age or be killed
“From the moment you are born, you are counting down to your death. This is the truth of life. What a pitiful thing
“No matter how much you struggle, whether you are brilliant or sad, you will be forgotten after you die. Even if someone knows your name and spreads it for hundreds of years, what is the point? “Who are those people who remember your glorious achievements? “Are there despicable thieves among them? “Rapists? “Low-moral pariahs? “If there are, then what’s there to be happy about being remembered by these people?”
Sergei scratched his head and said, “Why do I hear you say that? I feel like you’re like those poets and writers who play with their brains. You either praise life all day long or discuss the meaning of life, whether to live or die.”
“The meaning of life?”Noyce glanced at him and chuckled, he said, “The meaning of life is meaningless! “What’s the difference between life and death? “All life will be destroyed when it comes to the end. Then, new life will be born from the destroyed corpses and continue to struggle and reproduce. In the end, it will still come to the end of destruction.”
“Meaningless?”Sergei shook his head and said, “Don’t you mean that those writers will vomit blood after hearing your words? Doesn’t it seem like they study this all day just to make a living? “I think it’s quite interesting. The ones who are destroyed are the weak, not all of us humans. The strong will not be destroyed.”
“That is only a matter of time.”Noyce smiled slightly, “As long as there is desire, the apocalypse will not stop. Humans will continue to roll around in this meat grinder. Eventually, the boiling blood will be spilled. The exquisitely dressed skin will be completely distorted. The tough and unyielding bones will be chewed until they turn into a pile of mangled meat. That is the final form of the meat grinder.”
“Can this form still be considered alive?”
Sergei was stunned. His thoughts were not as rough as his appearance. He could already hear the hidden meaning in Noyce’s words. When he thought of the deepest meaning in his words, he suddenly felt a chill.
As long as there was desire, the Apocalypse would not stop?
He thought about this sentence repeatedly in his mind, and the more he thought about it, the more he trembled.
“Whether it was in the old era or now, the Apocalypse has never stopped.”Noyce did not care about Sergei’s expression, he continued, “The Apocalypse represents death. Where there is conflict, there is death. Where there is desire, there is conflict. This is an unsolvable cycle. From the moment life was born, it was destined to struggle in the apocalypse. It was meant to work hard for survival. It was meant to work hard to raise its head and live. However, when the day comes where it can raise its head and enjoy the hard-earned dream life, will it still be as clean as before?”
“The Sage taught us to restrain our desires, and the law forced us to restrain our desires. Everything tells us that desire is the root of destruction
“However, the sage did not teach us how to live after restraining our desires. The law also did not tell us how to protect ourselves after restraining our desires
“Take a step forward, and you will be in the abyss of Hell
“Stop, it’s still the same.”
“Step back, the thorns behind you will pierce your heart with thousands of arrows.”
“We can only move forward, keep moving forward, and look for hope. That hope is like a fish fishing in front, and we are greedy cats, forever chasing and never getting that bite.”
Kache’s expression became extremely ugly, and he couldn’t help but interrupt him. “Is His Majesty unable to escape? His Majesty no longer has any desires, and is already like a god. is he unable to escape the whirlpool of the Apocalypse?”
Noyce glanced at him as if he had seen through his thoughts. His tone became somewhat cold, he said, “Do you think that by becoming a god and never dying, you can jump out of the Apocalypse? “However, what you don’t know is that His Majesty is the one who is in the deepest part of the whirlpool of the apocalypse. He is beyond redemption! “He has long died. The current him, even if he has truly become a god, how can he be the original him? “The apocalypse has long minced him into minced meat. No matter how you put it together, you can not find his original appearance. When you are beyond recognition, what is the difference between you and Death?”
Karch was stunned.
“Becoming a god... is there no way to get rid of it?”He felt a slight pain in his heart, and there was a stifling feeling that made it difficult for him to breathe.
Noyce’s eyes suddenly flashed, and he said, “It is not completely hopeless for his majesty. Perhaps... only with the appearance of that Girl Can His Majesty be put together into his original appearance.”
“You mean, Miss Aisha?”Kutcher’s pupils contracted slightly.
..
..
Half a year after the rebellion.
Large-scale reconstruction of the imperial capital, has been restored to its original state, but the royal families living in the imperial capital gradually reduced, fearing that there will be such an assassination attack, be implicated.
“Aurora, I heard that there is news of Aisha in the north?”Dudian sat on the throne in a dark golden robe, he indifferently looked down at the graceful woman.
Aurora respectfully said: “Your Majesty, the King of corpses only said that he saw the figure of Miss Aisha from the other corpse lords. But the details still need to be investigated.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1272
chapters.content:
Chapter 1272: Chapter 1260: Life Core
Translator:
549690339
“Investigate immediately.”Dudian’s face was cold. Ever since he issued the search notice for Aisha, there had been a lot of information about Aisha every year. But after a detailed investigation, none of it was true.
Aurora didn’t care about Dudian’s cold attitude. She was still very respectful. She turned around and left.
Not long after she left, a king named ‘Blood Count’came to the hall. He was a new king and was conferred a Marquis title. If it was in the former empire, the King would be a top figure who surpassed the duke. But now.., to be able to get the title of Marquis was already considered outstanding.
“Your Majesty!”Blood count bowed respectfully.
Dudian looked down to read the information in his hand. He didn’t raise his head. His indifferent voice was heard: “What’s the matter?”
Blood baron respectfully said: “Your Majesty, I have received news that the Miss Aisha you are looking for seems to have appeared in the vicinity of Yanze Mountain. The hunting adventurer team said that they had seen someone who looked very similar to Miss Aisha. But they didn’t see it clearly and couldn’t be sure.”
“Yanze Mountain?”Dudian slightly raised his eyelids as his eyes fell on blood baron. His cold black eyes seemed to be able to see through the deepest secrets of his heart, “Yanze Mountain is under the jurisdiction of the giant wall of Havanna. Since you know about this, why don’t you go to the Lord of Havanna Wall to investigate? You Can Report to me when you have a detailed result.”
Blood Jue’s heart trembled. He felt that the secret in his heart was exposed. There was no cover in front of dudian. He looked embarrassed, “Your Majesty, I have sent people to inquire but the Lord of Havanna Wall is not willing to cooperate with our investigation. I Can’t use force. Although he is a small lord but he was once a relative of your majesty. His status is noble. I’m afraid that I will offend...”
Dudian raised his eyebrows: “Are you saying that Neuss is not willing to cooperate with you?”
Blood Baron quickly lowered his head: “Your Majesty, Please Calm Down.”
Dudian looked at him but didn’t say anything. He raised his wrist and revealed a black wristwatch. He quickly contacted the other side, “Neuss, I heard that there are traces of Aisha near the Yanze Mountain. Do you know about this?”
“Your Majesty!”Neuss’s voice came out of the wristwatch, “I have heard about this matter. I have sent people to investigate it. It has been confirmed that the news is false. I have severely punished them. I didn’t expect that His Majesty would be alerted.”
Dudian nodded: “I heard that the blood baron sent people to investigate. Are you not cooperating?”
The body of the blood baron trembled. He didn’t expect that Dudian would directly question Neuss. He didn’t beat around the bush.
Neuss seemed to have expected that dudian would say so: “Your Majesty, the Blood Baron sent people to investigate and destroy my territory. Forgive me for being unable to cooperate.”
Dudian was silent for a moment: “Neuss, you should know what she means to me. I hope you won’t lie to me.”
Neuss said in a serious tone: “Your Majesty, I Won’t lie to you. Miss Aisha is His Majesty’s benefactor and my benefactor. If there is any trace of her, I will be the first to look for her!”
Dudian didn’t say anything. He hung up the phone and looked up at the blood baron who was about to speak. He was silent for a moment: “Come here.”
Blood Baron’s body trembled as his face turned pale: “Your Majesty, Lord Havanna is lying. He refused to cooperate. I didn’t mean to slander him but it is true!”
Dudian raised his hand. Several black threads shot out from his palm and wrapped around blood baron’s body.
Blood Baron didn’t dare to struggle. He was terrified as he begged and pleaded.
Dudian pierced a soft tentacle into the blood baron’s forehead. The blood baron’s body stiffened and soon stopped moving. Its eyes were straight and its face was dull. After a moment it recovered. It saw that the black silk around its body had loosened, its heart was relieved.
“There is nothing wrong with the memory. He did stop you. The news about the Yanze Mountain is true...”Dudian whispered as if he was talking to himself. However his cold eyes were fixed on the blood baron, “You went to report the news but he stopped you. Everything makes sense. But there seems to be a gap in your memory. Has It been adjusted?”
The blood baron’s pupils shrank as he relaxed. He felt that his soul was scared out of his body. He quickly shouted: “Your Majesty, I...”
Puff!
His body suddenly exploded and blood splattered everywhere in the hall. The next moment, Dudian’s body divided into a lot of small blood vessels which were like straws which sucked the scattered blood into his body, everything was restored to its original state. There was no blood left.
“Dad?”
A figure floated from outside the imperial palace. It was goddess Wa. She had changed the way she addressed Dudian under Dudian’s instruction.
Goddess wa looked around as if she saw the pieces of meat on the ground: “Dad, did someone make you angry again?”
Dudian’s eyes fell on her. There was a trace of gentleness in the depths of his eyes. Perhaps the one who was absolutely loyal to him was goddess Wa.
“No, I won’t be angry because of these small things.”Dudian smiled. He waited for Goddess WA to come in front of him. He touched her soft hair. There was a trace of strange color in his gentle eyes, he whispered: “Child, are you willing to do anything for your father?”
The goddess smiled: “Of course! I’m willing to do anything dad wants me to do!”
“Anything?”Dudian’s eyes stared at her.
“Yes, Anything!”The goddess’s black eyes were wide open as she looked at dudian: “Dad, are you in trouble?”
Dudian was silent: “I have encountered a problem that I haven’t been able to solve. I can’t find hope. I Can’t see the future so I need your help.”
“Can I help you?”God wa blinked her eyes in anticipation.
“Of course.”Dudian looked up at her with gentle eyes: “Have You Forgotten? God is omnipotent.”
God wa tilted her head: “But dad didn’t you say that my body isn’t perfect enough? I Can’t be considered as a true God. I’m just a false god who is closest to God. I don’t have a life core.”
“Yes.”Dudian whispered: “I used to think that I limited your growth. You are just a young God. But later I found out that a true God is omnipotent. There is no distinction between old and young. There is no distinction between time and space. God is everything. So God is omnipotent. If you were a true God you would have been able to assimilate the Earth with a thought. Even if you fell into the sun you wouldn’t be hurt. But you need to accumulate these great powers...”
God Wa held his hand and couldn’t help but ask: “Dad, can I help you if I’m not a true God?”
Dudian’s body slightly trembled as he looked down: “Should... Yes.”
“Great!”God Wa was happy like a child. It seemed that she didn’t care if she was a true God or a false god. She only cared if she could help Dudian.
“As long as it is useful to dad then dad will need me!”God wa grinned.
..
..
The last few chapters

chapters.title: Chapter 1273
chapters.content:
Chapter 1273: Chapter 1,261: Aisha’s appearance
Translator:
549690339
The giant wall of Havenna.
A slender young woman stood by the window of the castle. She looked at the tall, blond man beside her with a worried expression and said, “His Majesty just contacted you. Do you really intend to hide this matter?”
The blond man was Noyce. The young woman beside him was his wife. She had given birth to two smart and cute children for him. Although she was not born into a noble family, he was not picky about her. When he heard these words.., he could not help but sigh deeply. He looked away from the gloomy sky outside the window and turned his head to look at the beautiful woman. The light illuminated her jet-black hair, which was flowing with a luster.
A feeling of tenderness suddenly rose in his heart. He wanted to take her away from everything here and live on an isolated island that no one would ever set foot on.
However, he knew that this was a luxury. The current humans were more advanced than the technology of the old era. Their individual strength was also stronger. They had traveled all over the world. There was no place for monsters to live, so naturally, there was no place for him to live.
If one wanted to escape from the vortex, they would only tear themselves apart.
“If one day I am exposed, I will die, but you and the children will be fine. I understand him.”Noyce sighed.
“I don’t understand. Didn’t you say that His Majesty loves this girl the most? In order to find her, he is like a madman. He would not hesitate to kill thousands of people. This is his reverse scale, and it is not something that can be offended. With your relationship with his majesty, even if you have offended him with other things, he will forgive you. Why did you hide her tracks? Once His Majesty finds out, even you will not be able to withstand his anger!”The woman’s eyes were red, it was hard to understand what he was thinking.
Noyce sighed and said, “With my status and status, it is not difficult for me to live a peaceful life. However, if the world is destroyed, where would we find a place to live? “Although I am only a small figure, if I can save this world, I would be willing to sacrifice my life.”
“Why would the world be destroyed? isn’t everything fine now? All the monsters have been pushed back, and the sea monsters have been killed so that they don’t dare to come close to the land. Why are you worried about these impossible things?”The woman’s face was full of sorrow, although she questioned every word, she still spoke softly, but the more she spoke, the more tears she shed.
Noyce smiled bitterly. “The monsters were pushed back, but these monsters have raised the biggest devil. The power of the world has fallen into the hands of one person, and that person is tired of life and indifferent to it. He can be destroyed or created at will. It all depends on his mood. How terrifying is that?”
“But, in this world, there will always be one person who wants to be king, and the rest will submit to him. Isn’t that the goal of all wars?”The woman looked at him blankly, “In order to become the one and only king, the war has already drained the blood of our compatriots. Now that His Majesty has unified the world, there are no more civil wars. Why are you objecting to such a thing? “Regardless of whether it is unified or not, will war never leave us?”
The bitterness on Noyce’s face became even more intense, as if there was a yellow lotus in his mouth, “Life is destined to war from birth. We need to plunder other lives to fill ourselves. The existence of life is meaningless, but as a life that has already been born, since we can not choose to live or be destroyed, we have to think of ways to live out our own meaning, or to live a more comfortable life.”
“The world is in the hands of others. There is no threat, but his majesty is different. He is not a human. His heart is already close to God! “We must not let him find that girl. All the information and clues about her must be erased! “Once his majesty finds her, it will be the day of the extinction of mankind...”
The woman was stunned and asked hesitantly, “Why, why?”
“Because that is the last of his humanity.”Noyce sighed, and his voice was filled with endless exhaustion. “And humanity will change and rot.”
..
..
Three years passed in the blink of an eye in the era of sea hunting.
Huge sailboats could be seen everywhere along the coast, as well as an endless stream of adventurers. The sound of bugles and sails rose and fell, and huge steam and oil tankers sailed into the sea. Human footprints gradually invaded the mysterious world of the sea.
On the other side of the land, the capital city of the world was covered with roses. A large number of tourist trains followed the railway to the capital city. There were groups of tourists outside the imperial palace in the center of the Imperial City, they took pictures and longed for them.
At the moment, Dudian and a group of scientists were in front of a condensed version of the Particle Collider in the laboratory. There were no undeads in the laboratory, there were all kinds of high energy physics research equipment.
“Your Majesty, if you want to reverse time, you can only find the broken wormhole in space. But after you travel through it, you can’t locate the specific time.”A gray-haired old scientist said to Dudian.
Dudian frowned but didn’t say anything.
At this time, a young man came in from outside the laboratory. He was the assistant of the top laboratory. He saw Dudian and quickly saluted: “Your Majesty, there are apostles looking for you.”
Dudian’s eyes paused on the particle collider for a moment. He said to the old scientist: “I don’t care how much resources you put in. I want to see you come up with something new in a month.”
The old scientist’s face slightly changed. He saw Dudian turn around and leave without giving him a chance to refute.
“His Majesty is really obsessed. He wants to travel through space and time...”another old scientist shook his head and sighed.
“The resources in our laboratory are the best. It is useless no matter how much we have. His Majesty is forcing us!”
“Forget it. It is like accompanying a tiger. We should seize the time.”
Dudian came to the study room after leaving the laboratory. He saw a black-robed figure kneeling in front of him. He sat on the chair next to him: “What is it?”
The apostle in front of him was a newly established organization that specialized in serving him. It went deep into all levels of the dynasty and supervised the world.
“Your Majesty, there is news about Miss Aisha!”The apostle lowered his head and said in a shocking tone.
As soon as he finished speaking, he felt that the air in the room seemed to have been sucked out in an instant. There was an inexplicable feeling of suffocation. His originally tense heart was beating uncontrollably. His face was slightly pale and his heart was aghast, although he knew that this emperor’s martial strength was unrivalled in the world and was close to that of a god, he did not expect that it was even more terrifying than he had imagined. It was far beyond the concept of a king.
“Are you sure?”A low and slightly hoarse voice came from above. The air seemed to have turned into a sharp sword and pierced the black-robed man’s entire body. “Where is she?”
“Your Majesty, we found her at the giant wall of Grasse. We have already confirmed that she is waiting for you there.”The black-robed man resisted the trembling in his heart and said with great difficulty. However, his voice was still slightly trembling.
He felt that the suffocating air in the room had suddenly disappeared. It was as if the ancient ice that had accumulated on his body had suddenly melted. He looked up, but where was Dudian’s figure in front of him?
..
..
Tomorrow he would return to Shanghai and the day after tomorrow would be the end

chapters.title: Chapter 1274
chapters.content:
Chapter 1274: Chapter 1262: looking at each other
Translator:
549690339
Grasse giant wall.
It was located near the sea and was crowded with people. It was a paradise for adventurers and also a place for merchants to chase after. This place was close to the sea. Just the entrance fees for tourists and adventurers were comparable to the income of the other giant walls for a few months. Not to mention the taxes on the goods traded here was an astronomical figure, it was so huge that even kings coveted it.
“In two days, it will be the sacrificial sail festival of the giant wall of Grasse.”
“Aina, look quickly. This is the blue dragon jade of the giant wall of Rand. It’s a specialty of that place. The natural gold thread inside is said to be a live egg of a bug.”
“Egg of a bug? That’s disgusting. I want roses.”
“Okay, I’ll buy them for you. Roses are much cheaper than Blue Dragon Jade.”
“Hmph, I Want Bauhinia Roses. This is a bouquet of them that costs a hundred gold coins. Can you bear to part with it?”
“UH... of course, for you, I’m willing to part with anything.”
The streets within the giant wall were bustling with people. The festival of sacrificial sail that had arisen a few years ago was about to arrive. The city was bustling with activity. There were small wooden boats and figurines hanging by the street lamps. It was a festive scene.
A figure floated over. He was not eye-catching in the crowd, but if anyone noticed him, their gaze would not be able to shift away from him.
The figure passed by the couple on the side of the road and suddenly stopped. His gaze fell on the blooming purple rose in the girl’s hand. Each petal of the Rose had a complicated pattern, it gave off a noble and mysterious feeling.
This was the most expensive and rarest type of rose, the Bauhinia Rose.
“Purple...”the figure muttered in a low voice.
“What are you looking at?”The girl noticed that the stranger was staring at the Bauhinia rose in her hand. She raised her gaze and said with slight displeasure.
The young man next to her saw this and smiled lightly, he said, “Aina, don’t be angry. He probably wants to buy a bunch of Bauhinia roses for his girlfriend too. It’s just that he doesn’t have the money. After all, there aren’t many people who are willing to spend a hundred gold coins to buy a bunch of roses like me.”
“That’s true.”The girl smiled sweetly and sniffed the roses, feeling very satisfied.
“Boss, wrap up the Bauhinia Roses here for me.”At this moment, the stranger next to him spoke. His voice was very gentle and had a smile on his face. He didn’t care about the couple’s words at all.
The flower shop’s boss raised his head and looked at him when he heard that. He chuckled and said, “You want a bunch too? Bauhinia roses cost 100 gold coins a bunch. I don’t bargain here.”
“Wrap it all up,”the stranger said with a smile on his face.
As soon as he said this, both the owner of the flower shop and the couple next to him were stunned. They looked at him in astonishment, as if they suspected that their ears were hallucinating.
“You, you want all of it?”The owner of the flower shop asked in surprise.
The Stranger took out a golden card from his pocket and said, “I’ll pay from here.”
“Golden Card?”The Florist took the card and was a little curious. He had only seen silver and black cards. The most advanced one was a red card, which was made by a big figure in the giant wall of Grasse. This was the first time he had seen a golden card.
“I have 1,423 Bauhinia Roses here. I’ll wipe them off for you. It’ll cost 142,000 gold coins. Are you sure?”The florist looked at the man suspiciously. Even those nobles.., they would not spend more than 100,000 gold coins to buy roses for others. After all, roses were one-time use. They would soon wither and wither. Bauhinia roses were already considered a luxury item.
“I want all of them.”The stranger nodded with a smile again.
The florist thought for a moment. He first used the gold card to swipe across the machine. He did not want the roses to be bandaged properly. If the other party went back on his word, his roses would suffer in vain.
When the gold card swiped through the machine, the florist suddenly realized that the gold card didn’t have a password, so he immediately paid. The balance interface flashed on it, and he saw countless zeros.
“This...”the florist was stunned.
The stranger put away the gold card and waited quietly with a smile.
The couple next to him was speechless when they saw that this person actually paid more than a hundred thousand Yuan for the Rose. The girl suddenly felt that the bouquet of Bauhinia roses in her hand was a little shameful. She even wanted to throw it away, so she stomped her feet and ran away.
Soon, the florist wrapped up all the Bauhinia roses and said politely to the stranger, “Do you need us to help you deliver them? It would be inconvenient for you to take so many by yourself...”
The stranger did not wait for him to finish speaking. A few arms jumped out from under his clothes and hugged the roses. He lifted them several meters above his head to prevent them from being messed up by the crowd. Then, he quickly left the florist’s shop.
When he passed by a clothing store, the man stopped. After thinking for a moment, he entered the clothing store. When he came out again, he had changed into an extremely handsome black and gold suit, which made him look noble and gorgeous.
He combed his hair neatly and wore a formal suit. He held the rose and walked toward the inner city of the giant wall of Grasse.
The streets were crowded with people. As far as the eye could see, there were countless heads and carriages decorated with gold. If ordinary people were to play together, once they let go of each other’s hands, they might not be able to find each other, they could only communicate through communication.
However, in his perception, separated by the vast sea of people, countless figures, carriages, and buildings, he could still clearly feel that familiar aura.
It was like a red lantern, waiting for him there.
He could not stop smiling. His heart was incomparably excited and happy. He was unprecedentedly nervous. Even during the coronation ceremony, he could remain calm and calm. However, at this moment.., he was so excited that he could not help but want to jump and walk.
In a bustling ancient Chinese restaurant, a young girl wearing a purple cheongsam sat on the third floor. The environment here was relatively quiet. The noise of eating and drinking downstairs was not as noisy. She leaned against the railing, her snow-white skin color and alluring cheeks were extremely eye-catching, causing other customers on the third floor to frequently look over. However, everyone could tell that this girl was not from an ordinary family.
On the table in front of her, she randomly ordered a few dishes and two jars of wine.
She only drank wine and did not eat food.
Wine and water were the only human food that she could swallow.
However, wine tasted better than water.
This was because the hotter the wine, the colder the water.
She still remembered that there was once someone who liked to give her wine to drink. During that period of time, he had always been by her side.
She did not know how to face that person or how to face herself. Hence, she could only drink wine and drink it one mouthful at a time. During this process, her thoughts seemed to be able to stop and not think.
“HMM?”Suddenly, her gaze focused, and in the next moment, she suddenly sat up straight.
Bang!
The wine bottle in her hand fell and fell to the ground, startling the other eaters on the third floor who were peeking. They thought that they had been discovered and immediately lowered their heads to eat.
However, she did not even look at these people. She only stared blankly at the end of the street. That touch of purple was particularly eye-catching among the crowd, and it was approaching this place. and the most eye-catching thing was the person underneath that touch of purple, that familiar face..
Why was he here?
Her heart suddenly panicked. She looked left and right, wanting to find a place to quickly leave. But very quickly, her rationality allowed her to quickly consider the current situation. The other party was most likely here for her.
She could not hide.
Moreover..
Should she continue to hide?
Looking at that face that was full of smiles, she was stunned.
Tears suddenly flowed down from the corners of her eyes. That silly smiling face, where was the slightest bit of killing intent that could rule the world?
She covered her mouth, her shoulders gently twitching. Tears fell like rain, covering her face.
The figure in the crowd seemed to have also noticed the beautiful scenery in the tavern. His eyes became more excited, and his footsteps involuntarily sped up a little, pushing away the surrounding crowd. But it seemed that it was not fast enough.., his body soared into the air.
As soon as he soared into the air, the crowd cried out in surprise. No one seemed to have expected that someone would be bold enough to fly in the giant wall of Grasse. This was a violation of Grasse’s laws!
However, no matter how many cries of surprise there were, they didn’t catch his attention. His gaze was only focused on the breathtakingly beautiful figure in the tavern. Numerous pure white wings emerged from his back, flapping gently, like Angels, he carried a large number of Bauhinia roses and flew to the third floor of the tavern.
The two of them were separated by only a carved railing.
They looked at each other quietly.
Time seemed to have stopped at this moment.
All the sounds seemed to have disappeared into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1275
chapters.content:
Chapter 1275: Chapter 1623: depend on each other
Translator:
549690339
Dudian looked at the girl in a daze. It seemed that time had never left a trace on her body. She was still as young and beautiful as he remembered. Her fragrance was so nostalgic!
The familiar smell brought him into a trance for a moment.
“You... Do you remember me?”He trembled as he opened his mouth. He found that his throat was dry and hoarse. He was so nervous that he couldn’t speak.
He used to be calm in the face of thousands of lions. He managed millions of people and was indifferent. But now, in front of her, he seemed to have taken off all his defenses. He was so nervous that he didn’t know what to do.
Hearing Dean’s words, the tears in Haisha’s eyes flowed even more. The scientific research undeads had no tears. There were no tear ducts and no emotions. Even the second consciousness that was born only had consciousness, they didn’t have human emotions. But at this moment, her tears flowed like running water. Those few words were like raindrops hitting her heart.
The memories of the past were in her heart bit by bit.
How could she not remember you?
Dudian didn’t wait for an answer, but he had already seen the answer from her tears. His heart was agitated. At this moment, he couldn’t care about anything else. He crossed the fence and embraced her.
Her slender body was still cold.
The cold reminded him that she was still an undead.
But would an undead cry?
So what if she was an undead?
As long as he could see her, he felt that this was a gift from God!
He hugged her tighter and tighter. He wanted to merge her into his body and never separate them again. He wanted to transfer the heat from his chest into her body to warm her cold body. He wanted to sniff the fragrance in her hair and remember it in his heart.
He wanted... wanted too much, too much!
The two of them hugged each other quietly. They did not speak, but it was more than a thousand words.
On the third floor of the tavern, many customers looked over. Some were jealous, some were envious, and some were gloating. Below the tavern, many busybodies gathered and pointed at each other, waiting for the law enforcers to come and punish this person who did not know the immensity of Heaven and earth.
Many residents of the giant wall of Grasse sneered as if they were looking at an outsider who didn’t follow the rules and was about to be taught a lesson.
After a long time.
Dudian and Aisha separated from each other. Although their minds were focused on each other, their powerful senses were still disturbed by the noise. Dudian held Aisha’s soft hand and his eyes were as gentle as water, “Let’s go. I’ll take you to a place where there is no one. I have a lot to say to you.”
Aisha softly replied: “I have a lot to say to you too.”
A team of law enforcers came from afar. They flew behind Dudian but didn’t shout. Instead, they kneeled on one knee in the air and kowtowed:
“Your Majesty.”
“Your Majesty.”
All the giant walls were connected to the internet. There was a monitoring system in the giant wall. The first thing they did was to identify Dudian’s identity. The law enforcers gathered in a hurry and came to pay their respects.
In their eyes, the emperor had been living in the imperial palace for a long time. He rarely came out. He was in charge of the lives of the people in the world. His murderous aura soared to the sky, he didn’t dare to neglect him.
Dudian didn’t respond to such greetings. There was only the beautiful woman left in his eyes. He slowly flew higher and higher and gradually left the people’s sight.
On the ground, many busybodies were shocked when they heard the voice of the enforcer. They didn’t expect that this bold person was the legendary Emperor who banished the monsters and unified the world. He was almost like a God!
For a time, many civilians knelt down and kowtowed for a long time.
The Thunderbirds circled above the clouds.
Dudian held Aisha’s waist and flew onto the back of the leader of the Thunderbirds. The wings of the Thunderbird were more than ten meters long. There were more than ten people lying on its back. Dudian didn’t dare to resist, he withdrew the lightning from his body and slowed down as he slowly flew forward.
“These flowers are for you.”Dudian gently said as he handed the Bauhinia roses to Aisha.
Aisha looked at him and moved her eyes away. The tears in her eyes had been wiped away and her eyes were full of tenderness, “Every girl likes flowers. Although they are beautiful but I would rather look at you than waste the time to look at them.”
Dean pursed his lips, “I finally found you. I will never let you leave me. You will have plenty of time to look at me in the future. Every day, every moment, every minute, you can see me. We will look at each other for a lifetime, a hundred years, a thousand years. I want you to become a god and live forever!”
Aisha shook her head: “It is too difficult to become a god. As long as we are together.”
Dudian smiled but didn’t continue. He asked: “Your memory seems to have recovered. Where have you been all these years? Don’t you know that I’m Looking for you?”
Aisha lowered her head. There was a bit of guilt in her eyes, “My memory is a bit chaotic. I know that you are looking for me but I don’t dare to let you find me. I... I’m already an undead. I know that you are researching methods to restore the undead but there has been no results all these years. I know that I can’t go back. I don’t want you to see my ugly appearance.”
Dudian was slightly startled. He was silent for a while and slowly held her small hand, “You are the most beautiful in my heart and eyes. You are never ugly. You are the most beautiful and the most kind in both appearance and heart.”
Aisha looked up at him. Her body slightly trembled and she slowly lowered her head. She leaned her head on Dudian’s chest and looked at the clouds, she whispered: “I came to the giant wall of glass and guessed that you might find me. I am afraid and looking forward to it. I Can’t tell what it is.”
“Since you can’t tell, don’t think about it. We will always be together. Forever!”Dudian put his arm around her shoulder. The tip of her nose was touched by the wind. It was a bit itchy and very comfortable.
“Before you turned into a zombie, we had been together for less than two years.”Dudian looked at the blue sea and blue sky in the distance. He felt that all the pent-up frustration in his heart had been released. His whole person became happy, “But I have been looking for you for almost twenty years. I have been looking for you for so many years. Now that I have finally found you, I will never let you leave my sight. I will never lose you again!”
Aisha hummed softly and was speechless.
The Thunderbird slowly flew forward, further and further away.

Happy Valentine’s Day

chapters.title: Chapter 1276
chapters.content:
Chapter 1276: Chapter 1624: marriage
Translator:
549690339
The capital of a dynasty had a diameter of over a thousand miles.
Just the imperial city in the inner ring alone was comparable to the big cities like Beijing, Tokyo, and New York in the old era. Looking down from the sky, the imperial city was like a huge square mark in the center of the capital, branded on the ground, the huge wall blocked off the view of countless people, and it was difficult to see the splendor of the Imperial City.
The interior of the imperial city was extremely spacious. There weren’t many imperial guards, but all of them were abyss-level experts. Among them, the squad leader had already reached the level of an abyss lord, and his sensory abilities were sufficient to cover half of the imperial city, tens to hundreds of abyss lords guarded the imperial city, and all sorts of sensory domains were stacked on top of each other. Even if a grain of sand fell into the imperial city, they would still be able to sense it.
Although the imperial city was big, it was empty.
The Imperial Palace in the center was huge. It was comparable to a city district. The palace was tall and majestic. It looked like the residence of a god, it also looked like the residence of a god.
A group of Purple Thunderbirds came from the sky and flew into the imperial city.
The imperial guards who were guarding the imperial city were about to stop them. They stopped when they sensed the unfathomable aura of the Thunderbird. Everyone bowed their heads and worshipped the Thunderbird.
This was the majesty of the King.
It was also the pressure of God!
Whoosh!
Dudian held Aisha and floated down the steps of the imperial palace. He turned around and looked at the vast square which could accommodate millions of troops.
“I have been waiting for your return here...”Dudian looked at the world and whispered to the people around him.
Aisha’s body slightly trembled. There was an indescribable complicated look in her eyes. She lowered her head. The man beside her didn’t notice that when she looked up again, the emotion in her eyes had been restrained.
She took a deep breath and held Dudian’s arm. She whispered: “I don’t want these. I just want you.”
Dudian smiled and touched her head: “Fool!”
“I’m not silly.”Aisha pouted. There was a bit of playfulness but also a bit of seriousness.
Dean smiled, “Yes, of course you’re not silly. I’m silly.”
Aisha looked into his eyes and slowly lowered her head. She said inaudibly, “You’re not silly either.”
The Breeze swept over from the square. There was no obstruction, so the wind became stronger and stronger. When it blew in front of them, it was already a strong wind that lifted their clothes.
“Let’s go in. I have a lot to talk to you about.”Dudian protected her body as he slowly walked in. Although the cold wind wouldn’t make them feel cold, but his movements were still gentle, it was like caring for a weak and weak ordinary person.
They came to the imperial palace.
Dudian led Aisha as they walked. He introduced the imperial palace that he had built. He took her to a huge palace and said: “This is for you. It has been empty. Now it has an owner.”
Aisha looked up in a daze.
After a long time she slowly retracted her eyes: “I want to go to the old Sylvia. I heard that you didn’t tear it down but rebuilt the imperial city?”
“Well, Sylvia is on the west side of the imperial city. I haven’t changed the layout of the place.”Dean smiled: “Now Sylvia is considered the most noble person. I heard that the people living there have a bigger temper.”
Aisha didn’t speak but slowly walked with him.
Both of them came to the west side of the Imperial City. The towering giant wall was still towering. There was a high wall built outside the giant wall which separated the giant wall from the imperial city. The giant wall was the inner city of the imperial city. It was the closest to the imperial city, the people inside the giant wall were also the closest to Dudian. There were no longer poor people or refugees. All families had nothing to worry about.
The nobles were relying on their advantages and current status to develop their industries. They had expanded their business to other giant walls and become famous tycoons in the dynasty.
But these nobles knew that they couldn’t touch some taboos. So most of the children of the nobles moved out of the giant wall and lived in other giant wall industries. The giant wall of Sylvia was like a home for them, it was also like a Holy Land.
Dudian changed his appearance and put a veil over Haisha’s head. He took her to walk in the city.
The wall of sighs still existed.
The appearance of the city didn’t change much, but some old houses were demolished. Most of them were new houses. Even the outer wall area was luxurious and lively to the extreme.
“The change is so big...”Haisha muttered to herself.
Dean nodded: “Although I forbid them to rebuild the city, but some people have money, so they will renovate their houses. The more they renovate, the more gorgeous they will look. The air is not as bad as before. It is stinky and messy.”
“But that kind of air feels more real.”Haisha whispered.
Dudian was startled: “You are right. I will ask them to tear them down and change them back to their original appearance. They will be prohibited from leaving the giant wall.”
Aisha quickly said: “No, it will be too costly.”
“But such a giant wall is not what you want.”
“It’s nothing. Things will change, and so will people.”Aisha looked at the pedestrians on the street. She could no longer see the poor people in coarse clothes. They were all wearing silk cheongsam or mink coats.
The city was still there, but the people had changed.
Dudian heard her words and suddenly realized that he had been careless in this matter. There were not many things that could make him regret. Even if some important people died, he could recreate them, but he was not willing to use this ability on her. If it was an ordinary person, he could even erase the other party’s memory and bring Sylvia back to view.
But facing her, he was unable to do so.
“At least I haven’t changed.”Dudian stared at her as if he wanted to use his eyes to tell him all his emotions. This feeling had never been felt before. At this moment, he felt as if he had taken off all the gorgeous armor, he had become an ordinary person who had fallen in love.
Aisha nodded slightly and smiled: “I know.”
Dean saw her expression and relaxed. He continued to accompany her to play.
Dean held her hand and wandered in the imperial garden until dusk. He said: “Now that you have come back, I want to hold a wedding for us. Are you willing to marry me?”
“I’m very willing.”Aisha didn’t feel shy or moved. She gently embraced him: “Very, very, very, very... very willing!”
Dean felt that his body and heart melted at the same time.
He hugged her tightly.
..
..
The new book had been secretly released. It was good to see a few familiar faces.
The king ends today, and there’s a postscript tomorrow that breaks all thoughts and ends it.
