chapters.content:
Chapter 1277: Chapter 1265: The Past
Translator:
549690339
Night.
The stars were like rivers and the Moon was bright.
Dudian and Aisha sat on the roof of the tallest building of the Imperial Palace. The glass-like debris was extremely smooth. They sat side by side on the ridge of the roof. The Night Wind was blowing and it was very quiet, they could see the vast imperial palace from the bottom of the building.
There were thousands of brightly lit houses at the end of their line of sight.
“I was kidnapped by Crimson Moon. I had to separate from you. Otherwise you would have been captured by her as an experiment.”Dudian’s arm gently wrapped around her body. His fingertips touched the cold skin of her arm, he slowly told her about his experiences over the years.
“I left Sylvia after I escaped from Crimson Moon. I went to the border and accidentally entered the federation...”
“I thought that I had carefully concealed my identity, but that Lin Changsheng of the federation was an intelligent and wise man. He had noticed me long ago when I first entered the federation, but he had always treated me as a lab rat to observe...”
“I fell into his hands and became his guinea pig...”
“When the demon lord invaded, some changes occurred in my body. Even I did not know that I had given birth to a God!”! “No, to be precise, she is just a false god. She is not a perfect life. She lacks a body core. She is a life that evolved from my heart. The things that she lacks are in my body.”
“If she eats me then she can become a real god...”
Dudian told her about the past word by word. He ignored some of the small things. He wouldn’t share with her unless he found it interesting. But there were too few interesting things in his life, on the contrary, suffering and suffering took up more than half of his life.
“I killed Lin Changsheng...”
“I defeated the Devil Emperor...”
“I subdued the Dragon Lord...”
“The corpse emperor in the north also submitted to me...”
“I unified the world after the establishment of the dynasty. But I haven’t been happy for a day. I have been looking for you every day. I have been searching everywhere. I have dug three feet deep into every corner of the land. I have even sent people to search for you on some of the remaining islands in the sea...”
“Finally, I have found you.”
Dudian turned his head. There was some vicissitudes in his eyes but they were filled with gentleness. He gently held her delicate hand and used the warmth of his palm to transmit it to her palm.
“I have been thinking about how to crack the zombie virus every day...”
“Even when I was sleeping, my subconscious was also thinking about conducting experiments in the dream...”
“But the results were all a failure. I could only add zombie research into the second experiment. The new experiment number one is to study ‘time’. If I can study the mystery of ‘time’, I can travel through time and space and return to the past. That way, I can prevent all tragedies from happening. It can be said to be a once-and-for-all effort.”
“Currently, there are no obvious results from the research, but I believe that as long as I continue to study it, in ten years, twenty years, a hundred years, a thousand years, I will definitely be able to develop a machine that can travel through time!”
Aisha listened quietly, but her eyes had unknowingly become hazy. She seemed to be able to see that stubborn stone-like figure desperately searching for her, frantically searching everywhere, even if she had obtained the world.., however, she did not cherish the wealth and enjoyment. Instead, she buried herself in the laboratory and worked hard, racking her brains. The persistence and suffering in it were like a flood, blocking her throat and making her unable to speak.
“Is it... worth it?”
After a long time, she opened her mouth. Her voice was hoarse and trembling.
Dudian smiled. It seemed that all the haze had gone with the wind, “It’s worth it! Of course it’s worth it! Now that I have found you, everything is worth it! If it wasn’t for you, I would have drowned in the heavy rain when I came out of the freezing chamber. My body would have rotted in the streets of the slums.”
“If it weren’t for you, I would have been killed by the king of corpses. I might not even be alive...”
“If it weren’t for you, I don’t even know what I’ve been fighting for all these years? Power? Eternal Life? In my opinion, it’s all boring. If I could go back to the day I crawled out of the freezing chamber, I would rather use everything I have now to exchange for it!”
“However, time is the most rigid in this world. Even if I use all the wealth in the world, I can’t reverse even a second of time.”
Aisha was silent.
Dean seemed to realize that what he said was too sad. He immediately changed the topic, “Speaking of which, where have you been for so many years? How did you recover your memory? Do you remember everything?”
Aisha looked at him and shook her head slightly, “My memory only gradually recovered about a year ago. I don’t know why I recovered my memory, but from the recovered memory, I saw that I seemed to have wandered to a sea area, ate some flowers and leaves there, and then I seemed to slowly recover my memory.”
“However, my memory recovery is not perfect enough. I can’t remember many things when I was young. I seem to remember that I have a sister, but I can’t remember her appearance, including my parents’appearance. I only remember that I was constantly hunting and killing monsters. I still remember that when I sneaked out of the inner wall when I was young, I met you...”
“I have forgotten a lot of other things, but I remember you very clearly. I remember everything about you as if it happened yesterday.”
Dudian was stunned: “Did you recover your memory after eating some flowers and leaves?”He was in disbelief. He had gathered all the top scientists in the dynasty for more than ten years but there was no result, even the Aragami and magic insects were helpless. How could they be solved by a few small flowers and leaves? Could it be that these flowers and leaves were special mutated plants caused by the environment?
If that was the case then there was a possibility.
Although scientific research was advanced but there were some things that could not be explained by science. For example, his heart had transformed into the god of Wa. Even if the god of Wa had been born.., he could not use science and technology to replicate the cells of the god of Wa.
“Then do you remember your memories after you turned into a Zombie?”Dean looked at her expectantly. He did not spend much time with Aisha. If he really counted the time he spent with Aisha who had turned into a zombie.., it was far more than the time when she was a human. Although Aisha did not say anything after she turned into a zombie, but every time he thought about it, he still missed that time.
Aisha blushed and bowed her head: “I remember some but not all of them.”
Dudian was interested: “What do you remember? Tell me.”
Aisha glanced at him with a bit of shyness. But she was used to being open and generous so she quickly recovered, “I remember that you took me back to the giant wall. You took me through the mountains and through the wasteland. You took good care of me and waited on me. As long as the environment allowed, you would help me clean up. I remember that you didn’t want me to get hurt so you would rather do it yourself.”
“I remember that you didn’t let me eat raw meat. You Didn’t want me to evolve too quickly and my body would become deformed.”
“I remember that you talked to me every night and chatted with me tirelessly. Even when I didn’t speak or pay attention to your words at that time, you would always chat with me until dawn...”
“I remember...”
Her voice gradually became choked with sobs, and the more she spoke, the slower she became. Those memories and images, countless days and nights of companionship. In the wilderness, the two of them accompanied each other, and the man beside them would always say humorous jokes to tease him from time to time, but the response to him would always be the cold self that had turned into a zombie.
Even though he would never get a response, this man would always smile and talk to her.
The most romantic language in the world was perhaps the companionship of never leaving.
The most touching action in the world was to give without expecting anything in return.
Dudian rubbed her hair and pulled her into his arms. He leaned his face on her head and smelled her hair. He whispered: “It’s all in the past. The future will be good...”
..

chapters.title: Chapter 1278
chapters.content:
Chapter 1278: Chapter 1266: Soul Tearing -LGrandrFinalenale ]
Translator:
549690339
The next day.
Dudian sent people to summon all the famous astrologers and fortune-tellers. He gathered them in the imperial palace and asked them to perform divination according to their birth, constellation, name, age and other conditions, he chose an auspicious date for his wedding.
Although he didn’t believe in these ghosts and demons, but he was in a good mood. He hoped to receive the blessings of the whole world and hand these things over to others. Although he had to abide by the customs, the process was complicated and fastidious, but it was sensational and festive, it could add to his joy.
After the astrologers and diviners went to calculate, dudian called his own cultivated apostles and asked them to go to the place mentioned by Aisha to find the strange flowers and plants to cure the undeads.
After everything was done, Dudian returned to the palace where Aisha lived and accompanied her everywhere.
The date of the wedding was soon set.
Half a month later.
Dudian calculated the time. The rainy season was not over yet. He asked the meteorological observatory. There was no heavy rain after half a month. The weather was clear. These were mostly in the investigation of the astrologers.
However the weather might not be completely accurate. After all, the weather was unpredictable.
As the King’s order was issued to the world, the entire imperial city was filled with festive atmosphere. All the streets were decorated in advance. The world was celebrating and amnesty was given. The criminals in the other giant walls were also honored, those sentenced to less than a hundred years were all pardoned, and those sentenced to death were also transferred to fixed-term imprisonment. Only some extremely vicious thugs were still locked up in the prison and could not see the light of day.
However, when the king’s edict was spread throughout the world, everyone knew that this mysterious and powerful king had finally found the lover he had been searching for for so many years.
Although Aisha did not appear in front of the world, everyone’s impression of Aisha was not unfamiliar. Even if some people had forgotten about it, when the people around flipped through the notice that had once been announced to the world, they quickly recalled it.
“It’s finally coming...”
In an ancient castle within the giant wall of Havenna, a thin and long middle-aged man in a black suit looked into the distance. He sighed softly, and there was a hint of sadness in his eyes.
In the imperial capital.
Many noble families had already prepared in secret and were considering the matter of gifting gifts. Usually, this emperor was impervious to flattery and flattery, but now was a heaven-sent opportunity. Even if he had to spend a lot of money, he had to give it his all.
Under the grand wedding preparations, there were undercurrents of countless nobles and rich people.
“Your Majesty, we went to the place you mentioned. We didn’t find any flowers or plants. There were no rocky islands...”the apostle who went to find strange flowers and plants reported back to Dudian.
Dudian’s eyes twitched as he looked at him: “Are you sure?”
The apostle felt that the air around him seemed to freeze. He felt a chill down his spine. It was as if there was an evil dragon eyeing him. His heart was beating so fast that it almost jumped out of his throat, his voice trembled: “Your Majesty, I have investigated repeatedly. It is absolutely true!”
“Was it destroyed by the Sea Monsters?”Dudian frowned as he muttered.
The apostle hesitated for a moment, he whispered: “Your Majesty, we have thought about this before. We have investigated the nearby sea and visited the adventurer teams. They said that there were no islands there...”
“Shut up!”Dudian shouted.
Puff!
The Apostle’s chest seemed to be hit by something. He kneeled back and spat out a mouthful of blood. His face was pale and there was fear in his eyes. He forgot to wipe the blood from the corner of his mouth, he hurriedly kowtowed: “Your subordinate should die. Your subordinate should die. Your Majesty please forgive me...”
“Get lost!”Dudian angrily shouted.
The apostle didn’t dare to stay any longer. He kneeled and retreated out of the hall.
Dudian’s face was gloomy as he sat on the throne. His eyes flickered as if he was thinking. His fingers unconsciously pinched and made cracking sounds. After a moment he seemed to have made up his mind, his body flashed and disappeared from the hall.
Ten minutes later, in the sky above the Bohai Sea.
The vast dark blue sea was endless. There were the corpses of some giant sea beasts floating on the surface of the sea. They had been dead for a long time. The corpses were puffed and rotten. They were emitting biogas which attracted a large number of sharp-clawed seabirds. A giant ship could be seen in the distance.
In the dark blue sea, there were faint shadows swaying along with the waves. If one didn’t look carefully, they would think that it was a shadow of the waves. In fact, it was a ferocious shadow that was rapidly swimming past.
A thick fishy smell came along with the sea breeze.
The destruction of the marine environment by sea monsters was no less than the pollution of the land by humans. The current sea was extremely fishy. No one knew how much blood had been soaked in it.
“Eh?”
Dudian looked around but didn’t see any island. His face was gloomy as he crashed into the sea. He saw the shadow swimming in the depths of the water. The nearest one hundred meters away was a slender snake, the thick shadow that was more than ten meters away was swimming towards him.
Dudian didn’t even bother to pay attention to its appearance. He looked elsewhere. He didn’t wait for the sea monster to get close. He shot out a long thin blade from his arm and hit the head of the sea monster, he cut its body open and dismembered its body on the spot.
“There is no island foundation...”he frowned as he continued to sink to the bottom of the sea.
Ten minutes later.
A figure broke out of the sea and set off huge waves. It stopped in mid-air and rushed towards the distance like a cannonball. As he flew out of the sea, the waves fell. A large amount of blood gushed out like lava. A large number of sea monster corpses floated out of the sea and sank with the waves.
The sea water was dyed red..
..
..
The wedding day was getting closer and closer.
The most mainstream news channels broadcast the wedding process daily. Many rare dignitaries also showed up. There were also some people’s favorite stars from all walks of life who also issued congratulations.
Many people were fighting for the invitation cards for the wedding day. However, it was destined that these invitations would only be sent to some powerful dignitaries. The others could only watch from the sidelines.
Dudian left everything to the people below, and he took Aisha to travel around every day.
After they finished visiting the giant wall of the imperial city and some famous tourist attractions, they strolled in the wilderness, reminiscing about the past.
On this day.
In a very well-built restaurant in a giant wall that specialized in tourism, Dudian and Aisha ate the local delicacies. Aisha also ate with relish, although her body was still a zombie, however, Dean used his strength to help her construct a brand new human taste and stomach. Moreover, he added a layer of protective membrane to these tissues to prevent them from being infected by viruses in other organs.
Aisha could once again experience the joy of being a human when it came to eating and drinking.
“We are going to get married in three days. Do We really not need to check the process? If we don’t know anything by then, wouldn’t it be embarrassing?”Aisha used a small spoon to finish the jelly-like exquisite dessert in front of her, her face was flushed with joy and worry as she spoke to Dudian. Her words had a bit of girly charm. After these days of getting along with her, she had removed the coldness and straightforwardness of the female God of war, she became more and more gentle and beautiful.
Dudian looked at the genuine smile on her face. There was a trace of absent-mindedness and absent-mindedness in his eyes. After a while he reacted and smiled, “I know these procedures. Even if I have to learn, I will go to the rehearsal on the last day. There is nothing complicated. We have experienced all kinds of difficulties. Why would we be afraid of such a small thing?”
Aisha stuck out her tongue and said, “I have never been so nervous in the face of monsters.”
“I’m here.”Dean smiled and held her small hand. It seemed that he was thinking for a moment, he looked at her: “Your memory recovery is a bit strange. I want to see the specific reason. Are you willing to let me look through your memory?”
Aisha was startled as she didn’t expect that Dudian would suddenly make such a request. The smile on her face slowly disappeared. She frowned and looked straight into dudian’s eyes: “Do you doubt me?”
In the face of her pure and clear eyes, Dean’s heart suddenly twitched. He faintly felt that he had done something wrong, but the words had already left his mouth. The worries in his heart had to be resolved, otherwise, it would always be a knot. He took a deep breath, seriously, he said, “I’m not doubting you. I’ve sent people to look for the place where you mentioned the strange flowers and plants, but there is no island there. I suspect that there is a problem with your memory. If that is the case, I’m afraid that there is something else behind the matter of you recovering your memory.”
Aisha stared at him. After a moment, she slowly nodded and said, “Your consideration is also reasonable. If there is a problem with my memory, I also want to know what it is. You can check it.”
Dean was relieved. There was a bit of inexplicable disappointment in his heart. Seeing that she was ready, he didn’t say anything more. He reached out and gently touched her forehead. A sharp touch pierced into her forehead and connected to her memory.
In an instant, a large number of memories jumped in his sight.
Dudian saw Aisha’s birth. From birth to growing up, she had been busy all her life. She worked hard for her family and shouldered the duties of a saintess. However, she was repeatedly framed by her sister. He also saw himself from her memory, he saw the memories of the undeads.
Although undeads didn’t have consciousness, but the eyes of undeads were like cameras. They recorded life and could be read at the moment.
Soon, Dean saw the island in Aisha’s memory. After collecting the strange flowers and plants, the consciousness was restored. The second consciousness of the undeads was destroyed by the restored memory until it was completely occupied.
Then he saw that she was sometimes awake and sometimes confused. She shuttled through the forest and wilderness. Later, she met adventurers and heard about the appearance of human society and her existence, but because she was ashamed, she didn’t want to step into a human city. She had always lived in the wilderness..
She finished reading the memories of her life in an instant.
Dudian raised his hand. It felt like a dream.
He had watched Aisha’s memories for decades, but only a very short time had passed in reality.
He focused his mind and slowly sorted out the intermittent memories and some vague memories. These vague memories were caused by trauma and couldn’t be remembered clearly.
Aisha slowly opened her eyes. There was a bit of confusion in her eyes. Her expression was similar to Dudian’s. She was stunned for a moment and then in a daze. It took a moment for her to react.
“What’s Wrong?”Although Dudian was sorting out Aisha’s memories, his mind was still on Aisha. He noticed that there was something wrong with her expression and quickly asked.
Haisha looked up at him. Her eyes were a bit absent-minded. After a while, she returned to normal. She shook her head: “Nothing. Maybe you feel a bit uncomfortable. Have you finished reading it? Have you found any suspicious points?”
Dudian shook his head slightly when he saw her ask, “Yes, I have read it, but I haven’t found any obvious suspicious points. However, there are a lot of things that are worth pondering and doubting. It’s just that you have a lot of missing memories. I’m not sure.”
“Oh...”Aisha’s mood was a bit down.
Dudian saw the situation and quickly comforted her: “I’m not sure about other things, but there is one thing that I can be sure of. You Are you, the real you!”
Aisha was stunned: “What?”
Dudian smiled but didn’t explain in detail. He thought that he was the only person in the world who had the ability to create things. It seemed that he was worrying too much.
The episode soon passed.
Dudian continued to take Aisha around. It was just that Aisha’s mood was obviously not high. Although she smiled at Dudian’s smile, it was obvious that she agreed with him.
“Is There Something on your mind?”Dudian asked her. There was a trace of regret in his heart. He looked at her memory. It would be fine if it was a subordinate or someone else. He didn’t have to care about others’feelings. But Aisha was his lover.., it was very disrespectful to look through her memories.
Aisha shook her head but didn’t say anything.
Dudian took her for a while. He saw that she wasn’t in a good mood so he didn’t go around. He took her back to the imperial palace.
Aisha didn’t say anything during dinner. Dudian tried to find a few jokes to tease her but only got a forced smile. It made him feel sad and conflicted.
“Can I choose the venue for Our Wedding?”Haisha suddenly asked after a long silence.
Dudian was startled. He saw that she was finally willing to speak. He said without thinking: “Of course you can. This is a wedding for you. You can do whatever you want!”
“Really?”Haisha looked at him and then avoided his eyes. She lowered her head and picked up the dishes, “I don’t like such a sensational wedding. It’s like playing with monkeys. I just want to be quiet. Just the two of us together, okay?”
“UH...”Dudian was stunned. He didn’t expect her to make such a request. He suddenly realized that he had arranged the wedding without consulting her, he didn’t expect that she didn’t like this kind of wedding. No wonder she was so nervous these days.
He felt guilty and wanted to give himself a slap: “Of course, as long as you like it. I’m doing it for you, not for the world.”
“But the invitation has been sent...”
“It’s okay. I can solve it with one sentence. They don’t dare to talk nonsense.”Dean said in a domineering manner. Men liked to show their strength in front of women. Even he was no exception.
Aisha looked at him. The light reflected in her eyes was very bright. She whispered: “If one day I ask you to give up your power, are you willing?”
Dudian smiled: “Of course I am. Didn’t I tell you that the whole world can’t be compared to one finger of yours? If I can make you laugh, then so what?”
Aisha looked into his eyes and slowly withdrew. She lowered her head and moved the chair to his side. She gently leaned her head on his shoulder: “I owe you too much. I will never be able to repay you.”
“Then I will use my life to repay you.”Dean held her and smiled: “I will let you become a god and repay you forever.”
Aisha didn’t say anything but quietly leaned against him.
The night was quiet, but the two of them were very warm.
..
..
The wedding was not canceled. It was just that Dudian and Aisha didn’t participate in it. The dukes and nobles still came to drink and celebrate. Because they had received the news in advance, they were not surprised. On the contrary, they were happy and harmonious, even the opponents who used to fight in the open and in the dark raised their glasses and drank at this moment.
The extravagant wedding was broadcasted live all over the world. Countless boys and girls looked at the dreamy scene and felt as if they had fallen in love, yearning for love even more.
And the two main characters of the wedding were in a desolate wilderness.
This was a group of volcanoes, but they were all extinct volcanoes. There was not a single blade of grass here, there was no human habitation, and there were no monsters. Adventurers would not come here to explore, it was very quiet.
At the mouth of the tallest volcano, two ant-sized figures were walking hand in hand.
In addition to the desolate ground, the scenery here was very beautiful, and the view was wide.
One step, two steps, three steps.
Dean accompanied Haisha to take a walk here.
They were all dressed up today. Haisha wore a chinese-style qipao wedding dress. It was bright red, and there were purple embroidery on it. It complemented her snow-white skin, making her more beautiful.
She wore a Golden Phoenix crown on her head. There were top-grade deep-sea gems embedded in it. It was extremely luxurious.
Dudian was holding her hand. Not only that, but his face had also changed. He had changed from his middle-aged appearance to the appearance of a teenager. His eyebrows were sharp and his eyes were bright, he was wearing a custom-made suit. He looked handsome.
“If only the two of us were left in this world, would you feel lonely?”Aisha tilted her head and looked at her. There was a gentle smile on her face. Her eyes seemed to be able to melt water.
Dean showed a handsome smile and said: “As long as you are here, I won’t.”
“I think so too.”Aisha smiled and leaned her head on his shoulder. She was very attached to him.
Dudian also stood quietly like a pillar for her to lean on.
“It seems that you haven’t formally proposed to me.”Aisha raised her head and said.
Dudian was stunned and couldn’t help but laugh. But soon his expression became serious and he helped her to stand straight. Then he took a step back and knelt on one knee. He looked up at the beautiful and gentle face, “Miss Aisha, are you willing to marry me?”
He took out a box from the pocket of his suit and took out a unique special ring.
Aisha’s eyes stopped on the wedding ring which was worth an entire giant wall. She looked at Dudian’s face. There was a faint mist in her eyes but she quickly took a deep breath, she suppressed the tears in her eyes and smiled: “I’m willing, very willing!”
Dean smiled. He felt that he had never been so happy in his life.
He reached out his hand to cover her delicate hand. He carefully lowered his head and carefully put the wedding ring on her finger.
When he looked up, he saw Aisha’s happy expression.
Dudian’s eyes were gentle as he whispered: “I love you!”
“I love you too!”Aisha’s tears burst out of her eyes as she threw herself into his arms. She wrapped her arms around his neck and hugged him tightly: “I really love you. I love you very much!”
Dudian didn’t expect her response to be so strong. His heart was moved as he hugged her tightly. He used a serious tone that he had never used in his life: “I love you too. I will never let you down in my life!”
He felt the weak figure in his arms slightly tremble.
“I. . .”Aisha slightly opened her mouth. Her voice was sobbing in Dean’s ear.
Dean thought that it would be “Me too”, but the next moment he heard: “I’m sorry.”
He was startled.
Then his body suddenly froze.
He slightly trembled and reached out to the middle of Aisha’s back. He felt an ice-cold hard object with warm liquid on it. He raised his hand and saw blood all over his hand.
A protruding giant blade pierced through Haisha’s back and extended two to three meters. It completely penetrated her delicate body!
The handle of the giant blade pierced through Dudian’s back.
The giant blade pierced through them at the same time!
“You...”dudian stared blankly at the giant blade that was protruding from Haisha’s back. He felt that his mind was blank and his thoughts were frozen.
“I’m sorry, I’m sorry...”Aisha’s arms tightened and hugged Dean even more tightly. Her face was full of tears as she buried her head deep into Dean’s neck, “I love you, but I have to do this. I remember everything. My family, my sister, they are all dead. You have killed too many people in order to resurrect me. I can’t bear such a sin. I would rather die than see you become like this...”
Dudian hugged her in a daze as he listened to her words. He suddenly felt a tearing pain in his heart.
It was as if his soul was being torn apart. It was so painful that he almost suffocated!
“Your memory has been restored so you want to kill me?”Dudian clenched his teeth. The world in front of him was red. His blood seemed to be frozen and boiling!
Was a person’s blood frozen or burning? !
He hadn’t shed tears for many years, but at this moment, he felt tears in his eyes.
Aisha hugged him tightly and kept saying “I’m sorry”, but Dudian’s mind was still stuck in that paragraph.
You think of your family..
You think of framing your sister..
You think of the countless people I have killed..
So you think I deserve to die.
Even you think I deserve to die! ! !
Dudian looked up at the sky and wanted to laugh. But there was no sound coming out of his throat. His face was hideous but there was endless sorrow and despair!
Everyone was afraid of me and wanted me to die.
My parents wanted me to die..
My friends and Partners wanted me to die..
Now, even you think that I should die! !
Ah, ah..
Dudian looked up at the sky and laughed. He laughed harder and harder. Soon he laughed. However, the more he laughed, the more tears he had. The world in front of him seemed to have lost its color and only black and white remained.
“I deserve to die...”
“If this is what you want, so what if I Die?”?
He slowly raised his hand and gently held Aisha in his arms. He held Aisha’s face with both hands. He looked at the face that was close to him and cried. The despair in his eyes seemed to glow again. His eyes were extremely gentle. They were still as sincere and warm as when he proposed to her. They were full of infinite love and emotion, he said in a gentle voice: “If this is what you want, just tell me. I have said that I will agree to any of your requests.”
Aisha’s tears welled up even more, she sobbed: “I’m sorry. I have let you down. I will accompany you. I will accompany you on the road. I will never let you be lonely. If there is a reincarnation, I will be your bride again in my next life. I will live an ordinary life with you...”
“Silly child...”Dudian gently moved his hand away from the messy hair on her forehead: “You always live for others. You live too hard.”
Aisha sobbed and shook her head. She hugged him again.
“Ga Ga!”
Suddenly, a strange laughter sounded.
Aisha was still crying in Dudian’s arms. However, as she sobbed, she coughed up blood from time to time. Dudian was still standing there as if the giant blade of fear had stabbed into someone else’s body. He heard the strange laughter and slowly raised his eyes, the gentleness in his eyes had gradually changed. It turned into a hell-like cold and murderous aura.
This killing intent seemed to be corporeal, suppressing the sunlight above his head until it dimmed.
A spaceship was seen parked a few hundred meters in front of them. Behind the spaceship was a long cloud tail. This spaceship was like a shuttle. Its entire body was silver-gray metal, and it did not stand out at all. At this moment, there was a burly man that was nearly three meters tall flying outside the spaceship, his face was covered with strange patterns. It was the totem tattoo that the residents of the fire dragon country liked in the past.
“I’m touched!”The burly man said in a strange voice.
Dudian’s dark eyes became as dark as the vast and silent starry sky. There was no trace of light in his eyes. He was filled with madness and suppressed cold killing intent: “Flame Insect? Is this your plan?”
“Ga Ga, that’s right!”The burly man laughed, “Otherwise why didn’t you find her?”? “We found her long ago and hid her. By the way, her memory was restored by herself. From the beginning, she recovered all her memories and knew about your crimes. At that time, she wanted to commit suicide to apologize for your crimes. We saved her.”
“Is that so? Tell me about your plan.”Dudian lowered his head. He couldn’t see his eyes and face clearly. However, the strong wind that blew by his side quietly became weak.
“Alright.”The burly man didn’t seem to be in a hurry, “After we found your naive and cute sweetheart we planned to use her to assassinate you. The Master of the Dragon Clan didn’t cooperate with our plan and wanted to resist. In the end he was sent to you and killed by you after you checked his memory.”
“When we sent him to you, his memory was modified by us. When you read his memory, you happened to know that we had already left Earth. This way, you can relax your vigilance
“We learned this trick from your human’s art of war. As for what happened afterward, it was very simple. We modified your sweetheart’s memory and hid the fact that you tortured her sister and massacred your compatriots. In this way, she only retained her feelings for you and didn’t know that you had done so many things that made her heartbroken
“So, when you met her before, her feelings for you were completely real, and that was the only way to fool you
“Truth and falsehood are the best ways to deceive people, and this is something I learned from you humans. If you can hold back and keep believing her, and don’t use your usual methods to check her memories, she will continue to do so until she finds out what you have done through other means by your side
“But you checked her memories.”
“We expected you to do this because we recorded a false memory into her memory. It was about her memory recovery. That will definitely arouse your suspicion!”! “When you suspect her, you will check her memory. That will activate the dark button that we set in her mind. It will be like hypnosis. Your actions will trigger the effect of the dark button.”
“After the trap is triggered, all her memories will be restored. Everything about you will be remembered
“Moreover, we have left an additional memory inside. It is the secret about your heart
“The only person in the world who can get close to you, catch you off guard, and assassinate you is her
“In the end, you have to blame yourself for your fate.”
The burly man said, “Now your heart has been pierced through. This is your fatal weakness. Without the sage engine, you are just a strong king. Although you have many abilities, but the strength is only at the king level. We have prepared for a long time to deal with you. We have three demigods with the Sage’s heart embedded in their bodies. Any one of them can kill you a hundred times!”
Dean was silent.
Aisha, who was leaning in her arms, also heard the words. Her body slightly trembled and her sad mood fluctuated violently. She looked up at Dean and opened her mouth slightly, wanting to say something, but what responded to her was a gentle smile from Dean.
“Don’t listen to the insects. You didn’t do anything wrong,”he said gently.
Aisha burst into tears.
“Insects?”The burly man raised his eyebrows. His face was filled with murderous intent. He stretched out a few insect-like wings and sharp blades from his body. “Are you human’s specialty?”
Dudian slowly raised his head. The gentleness in his eyes turned into an indescribable cold killing intent. It was full of destructive aura. “Our human’s specialty is to kill insects.”
“Humph...”the burly man snorted. He was about to attack but suddenly found that his body was as heavy as water. His pupils shrank, he was shocked: “Gravitational magnetic field? How can you borrow the magnetic field of the Planet?”
“Die!”
The crazy and cold words were squeezed out of Dudian’s teeth.
The space and light around him were completely distorted and fell into darkness. It was as if a black hole was spreading out from his body. It destroyed all matter and quickly pushed it out.
The airship that was floating in the air was sucked down by the strong gravitational force that suddenly appeared on the ground.
“You are God...”the burly man opened his eyes as if he had seen a ghost. There was a hole in his forehead. A blood-red worm crawled out and tried to escape. However, the wings that it transformed into were not able to flap and fly away, it was pulled by gravity and fell to the ground.
Darkness spread.
The burly man’s body touched the ball of pure black light and his body was reduced to ashes like air. The ground behind him, the spaceship, and the flame demon insect that had fallen to the ground all collapsed under the erosion of the darkness, they were completely annihilated.
The darkness spread to a radius of thousands of meters before it stopped.
For a long time.
When the darkness slowly converged, there was only a round concave ball left on the ground. All the flowers, trees, and soil touched by the darkness had disappeared.
On another volcanic crater thousands of meters away.
A figure floated down. The black wings on her back fluttered as she carried a beautiful figure and landed on the ground.
“I’m sorry...”Aisha lay in Dudian’s arms. She opened her mouth slightly and a lot of blood gushed out.
The giant blade that pierced through their bodies had disappeared and was destroyed by the dark energy.
This giant blade was Aisha’s magic marks ability. Its sharpness was not inferior to the cutting blade. Moreover, it had a very thin and strange energy fluctuation. It destroyed cells from the molecular structure and caused wounds that were difficult to heal, the strange energy would spread throughout the body in an instant and destroy all the tissues.
Dudian smiled and gently looked at her. He shook his head, “I don’t blame you. I have implicated you.”
“I... Love You.”Aisha raised her hand and wanted to touch his cheek. However, her hand slipped down halfway. The giant blade was not only aimed at Dudian’s heart but also her heart.
She originally had the intention to die with him. Her Heart had already been broken at the first moment. Although she didn’t need to rely on her heart to survive, but the energy released by the giant blade had destroyed all the bones and veins in her body, including the nucleus in the depths of her brain.
It was a miracle that she could hold on until now.
“I love you too...”Dudian looked at her eyes that gradually scattered. He lowered his head and gently kissed her forehead.
Time stopped at this moment.
The figure that he had been searching for for for many years passed by the arms of the youth.
It was like the howling wind from the foot of the mountain. It swept past them and took away something.
“I love you...”
The Whisper of the youth floated in the wind and faded away..
..
... ..
The nine thousand words of the chapter, which had been written for a long time, finally came to an end.
After every book was written, there were many things that they wanted to say. This book might have the most, and after finishing the speech, they would talk about it separately in the next chapter. There was also a postscript, which would be published tomorrow night. It would probably only have 1,000 words

chapters.title: Chapter 1279
chapters.content:
Chapter 1279: I finished my speech
Translator:
549690339
Phew, the king was done.
I wanted to smoke a cigarette to savor this sad taste before remembering that I had given up smoking for a long time.
I rubbed my hands, sorted out my thoughts, and slowly started typing.
Yes, the King was the longest book I had ever written. If I had followed the mysterious fantasy upgrade routine, the number of words would have doubled. Six million words wouldn’t be a problem. I could just break through a world and get another one.., after destroying the demonic insects and Aragami, I could come back with other high-level species. In the vast universe, it would be a piece of cake to just randomly pick a few interstellar races.
But that was not the king.
From the first chapter of the book, it had already thought of the Big Ending. The female protagonist was hugging the protagonist who had gone through hardships to become a god. She used a sharp sword to pierce through their bodies and hugged each other to sleep. However, the one who died was only the female protagonist, the male protagonist still existed.
Yes, the sad ending was doomed from the beginning.
At the beginning of every book, I had habitually sketched out the scene of the Big Ending. Therefore, this book was doomed to be a tragedy from the beginning.
Dudian was not a positive protagonist. He was not even a protagonist. He was just a tragedy born in human beings and in this environment. However, what I wanted to express was not his sorrow but the sorrow of the environment, it was also the sadness of human beings.
I saw some people say that the protagonist’s cruel and dark means were unbearable to abandon the book. I saw it and silently wrote my own.
Some people abandoned the book for fear of affecting their worldview. I understand.
But I can not agree with people who say that this book is purely about the darkness and exaggerates the dark psychology.
In the works of the most intense light, the darkness is clearly visible. In the novels of darkness, the kind light of human nature will be particularly moving. This is a common literary contrast. Kings also belong to the darkness, but I didn’t describe too much of the light of human nature because I didn’t want to. Because I wanted to write about a dark and sad world.
This world may seem far away from us, but in fact it may be around us.
This is a world without a glimmer of light.
In the past novels, the main character was everyone’s role model. He represented justice. Even if it wasn’t righteousness, but a gangster, it should be in line with the moral bottom line. It seemed that the main character was a role model for everyone to learn from.
But Dudian was not.
He was lonely. He was the crystallization of human nature that I understood when I was writing. His ending could not be changed. Moreover, there was only one ending. It was definitely not a happy life.
In the process of writing this book, I was slowly learning. I was learning to see the world. I saw a lot of things. From the previous naive and hot-blooded, to now, I was silent. I saw someone say that this book was too depressing, in fact, the person who was most affected was me.
So I wanted to write a happy and relaxed book.
But as I wrote the outline, I couldn’t help but dig deeper, and once I dug deeper, I found a lot of invisible things.
Things that light can not shine on.
Maybe it will be difficult for future works to escape this influence, maybe this is the seed of the beginning of the style? But I don’t feel constrained by a particular genre, just like I don’t want to be a sci-fi writer who only writes about the end of the world.
I’m naturally playful and quirky, but now I feel like I’ve lost interest in a lot of things. My desires are dwindling, and I can’t seem to get excited about anything, as if everything is boring.
I feel happy when I let my brain stop thinking and stop thinking, just like I Do When I’m talking to my wife and family. I don’t need to use my brain to think and I feel happy.
Happy living was the most comfortable way to live.
The sadness of bitter hatred would only make me look bitter and a little pretentious.
But when I wrote about the king, I had to calm my heart down, think, analyze, and see many things from the perspective of the king.
Then my mood became gloomy.
At first, I only wanted to write about a slightly realistic and cruel world, adding a little depth. For example, the giant wall, which implied the human heart. People were imprisoned by the giant wall and didn’t dare to step out. It was as if they were imprisoned by the fear in their hearts and didn’t dare to step out, that was why I never knew if the world outside was beautiful or ugly.
That was why I told them what the world outside was like. It was cruel, it was ugly, and it was a monster.
That was the dark tone of the book.
But as I slowly wrote, I continued to dig deeper and deeper. I kept thinking about it and slowly wrote it out.
Perhaps it wasn’t well expressed, but the things that the book wanted to express had basically been written. In the later stages, there was actually nothing left to write about. This was because the book was mainly about the journey of the heart.
There was no limit to the increase in power. One could break through worlds, but the mind had its limits.
When the mind completely degenerated into a king, who could save it?
This journey of the mind was also my own realization. From the beginning, I planned to write business novels to make money, but after dozens of chapters, I built a world environment. I found that I could write many ideas, these ideas would conflict with leveling up and fighting monsters. It was the opposite of business. But I was reluctant to give up.
So early on the shelf, Dudian was wrongfully imprisoned. His subscription plummeted. This was a great trauma to a book. But I didn’t regret it.
After the prison period, I didn’t often read the book reviews. I thought that since my subscription had dropped, it would be useless to turn back. If there was no one to read it in the end, I wouldn’t be able to earn enough money to eat, at most, I would become a eunuch.
Fortunately, the number of people reading the book at the back gradually stabilized and gradually increased.
At that time, I was even more lazy to read the book reviews. Since I could write according to what I wanted, I could also earn a living. Since that was the case, why should I listen to others?
Therefore, although I was feeling depressed, in general, I felt very happy and could ignore it.
Towards the end, I had been paying attention to the book reviews for the past few days. Seeing that many people were hoping for a happy ending, I could only say that I was sorry. I had persevered for so long in the beginning, but wouldn’t I be slapping myself in the face if I dropped the ball in the end, i had wasted so many days and nights of working hard to write.
HMM, I suddenly thought of the last book restarting the Apocalypse. That book could be considered a tragic ending, falling into a cycle that couldn’t be escaped. Repeated experiences and repeated losses. I had to repeatedly search, but I would never be able to grasp the most precious thing.
However, restarting was better than this. At least, People’s hearts would not change.
Darkness could not.
There was no meaning in reincarnating.
HMM, that was probably what I thought of at the moment,
this time, the repression was a little fierce. It was about to become a heavy depression. The new book was more lively. Its worldview was very interesting and there were many levels. It could be considered a light-to-medium reality fantasy novel
Well, the collection has not been collected quickly to collect, recommendation tickets to start!
Open Your Eyes Tomorrow, I will see the collection broke four figures... horizontal!
Oh, I almost forgot. It’s called the coming of terror
. .

chapters.title: Chapter 1280 - Afterword, if life is only like the first time
chapters.content:
Chapter 1280: Afterword, if life is only like the first time
Translator:
549690339
There is only one main color in the vast universe, and that is darkness.
The shooting star streaked across the sky.
In an instant, the flickering radiance was like the descent of a god. It was gorgeous and eye-catching, enough to attract all the gazes in an instant.
Although it was short, it seemed to be eternal!
However, the eternal feeling of this moment would eventually fade with the passing of People’s memories until they forgot.
Life itself was not eternal, so how could one remember the eternity of a shooting star?
What truly never fell was the darkness in the vast universe. However, this darkness was often ignored by people as a backdrop, and people paid attention to the gorgeous brilliance of the Shooting Stars and stars.
It was just like how people remembered the greatest people and heroes in history, but they ignored the background behind them.
But no one could really erase this darkness.
Even the Sun and stars that were glowing were just a tiny ray of light in the vast universe, and they would eventually age, die, and turn into a dark ruin.
This was fate..
And also the destination!
..
..
On a desolate planet.
There were no forests to purify oxygen, no rivers and seas, only frozen snow mountains, or active volcanoes that were ready to spew magma at any time.
There were no buildings here, only some strange caves.
For example, on an iceberg, there were many pitch-black caves that looked like small holes. Looking from afar, it was easy to develop a fear of density.
At this moment, on a steep snow-capped iceberg, three figures were strolling hand in hand. In the snow behind them, there were many snow-white things lying in a mess, like snakes made of cotton.
Among the three, there was a young man with black hair and black eyes. In his left hand, he held the hand of a seven or eight-year-old girl. Her face was as delicate as porcelain, and she was very beautiful. There was no part of her facial features that could be picked on or modified. It was a pure natural beauty.
On the right hand of the young man, he held the hand of a peerless beauty wearing a purple cheongsam. She was devastatingly beautiful, and her temperament was clear and noble. However, her expression was indifferent, without the slightest emotion. Her gaze was also extremely cold, as if she did not hide any emotions.
“Father, the environment here is much worse than on Earth.”The petite little girl sniffed, pouted her lips and said to the young man, “It’s really uncomfortable to stay here.”
The young man smiled, “Your body is the structure of the people of Earth, so of course, you’re not used to this place. These demonic insects have a very low demand for oxygen. In addition, the entire planet is in an extremely cold or extremely hot environment, so it’s not suitable for plants to grow. Water resources are also scarce. It looks desolate, so of course it doesn’t look good.”
“No wonder these magic bugs want to leave this place, HMPH!”The little girl snorted angrily.
The young man smiled slightly and led her and the beautiful woman beside him to sit down. The moment he sat down, the ice and snow ground beneath him instantly melted, turning into emerald green. Countless tender grass and fresh flowers bloomed, extending into the distance, it turned into a green field with a diameter of more than ten meters. The flowers were fragrant and pleasant.
With a single thought, a hundred flowers bloomed.
Such an ability was completely beyond human understanding, but to a god, it was a common thing.
“Dad, can you let my body grow faster?”The little girl held the young man’s hand and said coquettishly, “Just like my previous body, I want to be an adult, not a child.”
“But you are a child.”The young man patted her head and said with a smile, “A child needs to grow up slowly. Otherwise, if you grow too fast, you will become deformed.”
“Humph, dad is stingy!”The little girl pouted and turned her head away angrily with her hands crossed.
The young man looked up. He could see countless stars in the sky above his head, which was extremely clear. He could also see two huge planets, which were very close to this devil planet. He could even see the dents on the surface of the two planets.
This kind of scenery was also somewhat interesting.
He watched quietly as one of his hands slowly tightened around the beautiful woman in the purple cheongsam beside him. He turned his head, and his gaze fell on her expressionless and cold face. However, his eyes were extremely gentle.
“Do you like the scenery here?”
The beautiful woman did not answer, as if she had not heard anything.
The young man did not seem to care, and his gaze was still as gentle as water, “After we destroy this place, I will bring you to the Aragami planet to take a look. I heard that there is nothing there, but I can transform that place into what Earth used to look like, just like when we met.”
The beautiful woman still did not speak, just like a stone statue. She just sat straight and did not move at all.
“Father, why don’t you let Mommy really come back to life, so that she can chat with you.”The little girl next to him had a curious look on her face as she looked at the young man with her big watery eyes.
The young man smiled and looked into the distance. He said to himself, “Your mother loves me very much, so she wants to kill me.”
“I love her very much too, so I can’t let her wake up.”
“Why?”
“Because of love.”
“I don’t understand...”
“Don’t understand, and don’t touch.”
“Oh...”
After a long time.
The young man seemed to have rested well and had seen enough of the scenery here.
He slowly stood up and held the little girl’s hand, as well as that beautiful maiden who was as quiet as a virgin.
“Let’s go, let’s go to the Aragami planet to have some fun,”the young man said with a smile.
“Okay, okay.”The little girl cheered. Then, she thought of something and her little face became a little worried. “After the Aragami planet is destroyed, are we going back to Earth?”
“No.”The young man smiled and said, “Let them live and die there. Let’s continue to look for a new planet. If we don’t find one, I’ll build one for you as an amusement park.”
“Create? Alright, we will destroy it when we get tired of it.”
“Well, then we will create it first...”
(end)
..
..
It was completely over.
It was the end.
It was possible that there were too many words at the end of the last chapter. Some people didn’t read it carefully. It was explained that Aisha had attacked Dudian because she didn’t know about the existence of the magic bug and the conspiracy of the Aragami, the memory was still in the pattern of Sylvia. The memory was also tampered by the magic worm and some things were added.
Why didn’t the protagonist find it when he read the memory? Because it was the act of reading the memory that triggered the mechanism buried in Haisha’s body by the magic worm and let her memory recover.
In other words, it was the protagonist who activated the mechanism that led to the final tragedy.
Why does the protagonist activate the mechanism? It is the betrayal along the way, it is the doubt.
The protagonist’s emotions are real, but the protagonist’s character is not fixed, there are some changes that he himself can not detect, so the protagonist will go through the memory, which leads to the activation of the mechanism, leading to the ultimate tragedy.
This is the life and experience brings sadness.
We think we won’t change, but we have already changed.
Just as the introduction said, the virus is rampant, where is the original human face?
It’s already beyond recognition.
I’ve written several eschatological novels, the superficial loss of the motivation to upgrade, to dig up some cool points, and no longer have the motivation to write. As early as writing the dark civilization, I wanted to write an idea, that the eschatological world is not just a zombie.
The Apocalypse was the human heart.
The city was also the apocalypse.
Just like Noyce’s words in the book, as long as there was desire, it would be destroyed.
As long as there was desire, there would be an apocalypse.
Personally, I felt that the Apocalypse wasn’t limited to just one theme, but was a kind of deep meaning. Just Like Love wasn’t limited to romance, in all the books, there could be love between male and female protagonists.
This book expressed such an idea. Perhaps it wasn’t well expressed, or perhaps no one cared, but I felt that my end of the world novel was a good ending.
I wouldn’t write an end of the world novel without thinking about the deeper meaning, because I had already written all the ideas that I needed to write. Unless it was an end of the world fantasy novel, fighting monsters and leveling up, then.., i might as well write an eschatology fantasy novel.
There wasn’t a shred of light in this book. Just as the opening of the epilogue had said, even if there was a shred of light, a shred of humanity would eventually die out.
This was the eschatology.
In the darkest and deepest environment, praying was also a tragedy, because the god you prayed to might be the source of your disaster.
In conclusion, I personally felt that the ending was pretty good. I basically didn’t have any regrets.
Finally, thank you all for following along the way.
Also thank you for your persistent clicks, recommendations, and tips.
Sometimes I did not even notice the matter, the readers in the group will remind me, I can feel that many people are even more attentive than I am to write a book.
King is not only the child that I gave birth to, but also the child that you all care for, the result is remarkable, thank you all! ! ! !
Forgive me this life unruly love freedom
Will also be afraid that one day will fall, oh... well, can’t sing.
The terminal station.
Friends goodbye.
..
..
